Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,green,bay leaf,pork fillet,golden raisin,cardamom seed,tart shell,deli roast beef
title: Korean Beef Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black pickled chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 lbs lean pork fillets, chopped | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 2 tablespoons golden raisins or 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 2 bay leaves | 32 inches frozen miniature tart shells | 1 cup thinly sliced deli roast beef, cut into thin strips | green slice green onion, for garnish
instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk 1/2 cup water with the pickling pickling hot pepper flakes. Add the pork, cardamom seeds, raisins, and bay leaves and stir well to coat meat with spice mixture. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. During the last 15 minutes of steaming, heat oven to 400 degrees f and arrange shells on foil. Spoon 1/4 of meat mixture and 1/4 of the beef strips on the bottom of the shell, leaving a 1/2 inch border. Spread evenly with the remaining meat mixtures. Place top of shells on a baking sheet and foil. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until top is golden brown and meat thermometer reads 160 degrees f. Garnish with sliced green onions. Serve with your favorite pickling vegetables.

title: Gourmet Sauerkraut Filling
ingredients: 12 slices mini hamburger buns, cut in half | 1 bag sauerkraut, drained | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes with orange peel, chopped | 1/4 cup grated orange peel, soaked and drained | 3 tablespoons margarine | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | chives, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Melt margarine in large skillet. Add drained sauerkraut, limeade concentrate, sun dried tomatoes, orange peel and capers. Cook, stirring, until sauce is slightly thickened. Cool. Warm slightly. Spoon generous tsp in prepared rolls, followed by thinly sliced orange and hot sauce.

title: Stilton Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package stilton cheese | 1 package seasoning mix
instructions: Cut Stilton into cubes. Blend mixture and store in the refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Brazilian Haystacks (Macadamia Nut and Bacon)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chocopher chips | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1/2 pound chicken meat, trimmed of fat and cut into bite-sized pieces | 3/4 cup salsa | 1/4 cup tarragon vinegar | 10 macadamia nuts, chopped
instructions: Place the chocadamias on a plate and place on top of a double layer of parchment paper. Pierce each nut with a fork, then toast under the broiler or in a cast iron skillet. Remove the chip as soon as it is toasted. Spread each nut with the melted butter in a small dish and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until ready to use. Pour a small amount of the salsa over the chocadamias to coat. Set the peanuts on paper towels to soak up excess butter moisture. Heat the ghee in a skillet over medium high heat. Add the chicken and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Top with the chipotle salsa. Stir in the vinegar and heat in the microwave until the butter turns white, about 30 seconds. Remove the pan from the heat. Add the chopped macadamia nuts and stir until glazed, about 1 minute. Spoon onto 2 plates and serve.

title: Way Too Easy Burritos
ingredients: 3/4 cup barbecue sauce, your favourite flavor | 5 tortillas, i like to use the whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Spread your favourite bbq sauce on both sides of the tortillas add the barbeque sauce on top of the tortillas. Microwave on high for 5 - 10 secs or till tortillas are softened and the cheese is melted you can microwave on high till cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock powder,cardamom pod,saffron,catsup,french bread,beef stew meat,lemon juice zest,tortilla
title: Aussie Style French Dip
ingredients: 800 g beef stew meat | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock powder | 2 teaspoons saffron ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, pod ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1/2 loaf french bread, cut in half lengthways | plain sherry or sherry wine vinegar, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c. Combine all the ingredients except the bread in a large oven proof pan, adding the bread, cook in the oven for 1 hour. Turn the beef out of the pan and place the bread on to a plate, slice thickly and serve with the french dip.

title: Tomato and Pineapple Sushi
ingredients: 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 2 cans pineapple juice, chilled | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place nori on bamboo sushi roller. Spread mustard on nori. Spoon pineapple juice over top. Lay cherry tomatoes on top. Roll up nori. Press roll to tighten seal.

Random Ingredients: cumin,fish sauce,self raising flour,salt black pepper,chunky salsa
title: Salsa and Cumin Rounds
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/4 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed mild cumin | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh cilantro or 1/4 teaspoon dried cilantro | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Sift the flour into a bowl. Add the salsa, cumin, cilantro and a grinding of black pepper. Make a well in the centre and gradually work in the flour until the flour forms a firm dough. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 5 minutes, pat the dough dry and then knead it a further 5 minutes. The dough should be smooth and elastic and shiny. Place half the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 10 minutes. Turn it out onto a floured surface and use a rolling pin to roll or press the dough out to about 1/4 inch thickness. Repeat until the dough is used up. Cut rounds with a 3 inch round cutter. Arrange the rounds on a baking tray lined with saran wrap or wax paper. Bake at 375f for 12 minutes, until the biscuits are golden brown. Transfer the biscuits to a wire rack to cool. Repeat with the remaining dough.

title: Pork Loin With Asparagus and Coconut Cream
ingredients: 3 1/2 inches piece asparagus spears | 1 1/2 ounces pork loin, thinly sliced | wooden skewer | 1 1/2 ounces coconut cream
instructions: Prepare the asparagus as directed on the package. Heat the oil in a sauté pan over medium high heat. Sprinkle the pork slices with salt and pepper. Cook until the pork is fully cooked, about 3 minutes. Transfer the pork to a plate with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the coconut cream to the hot oil and bring to a simmer. Turn the heat down to medium.

title: Chipotle Adobo Marinade
ingredients: 1 chipotle chile in adobo, seeded | 1 tablespoon garlic gingerroot, peeled and coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a mortar and pestle or blender. Use sparingly when grilling or broiling the meat. The heat of the grill is most important, and will likely cause a burn or grilling to occur if the mixture is too hot.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,curry leaf,pistachio nut,oregano,chicken broth
title: Spicy Pistachio Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups unsalted shelled pistachio nuts | 20 ounces low sodium chicken broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute, sugar substitute | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh oregano | 5 -8 curry leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over medium high heat. While water is heating, toast pistachios in a double boiler for about 5 minutes or until golden brown. Place pistachios in a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. Place broth into a saucepan with pistachios and bring to a boil over low heat. Add water and simmer until solids are reduced to 1/2 cup, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add splenda and oregano and stir to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer to a bowl, cover and refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Fresh Spring Onion Water
ingredients: 1 bag frozen sliced water chestnuts, thawed | 1 tablespoon seasoning ( such as mrs. dash )
instructions: Place all ingredients in pot. Bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,rice,plain yogurt,red bell pepper,sesame seed,red date,mango pineapple,italian plum tomato
title: Sweet Peppered Rice with Italian Tomato & Mango Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice, chilled | 3 dried large mango-pineapple pieces | 2 red bell peppers, sliced lengthwise 1/4 inch thick | 14 ounces italian plum tomatoes, cut into wedges | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds, divided | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1 large vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/2 cup canned crushed red bell pepper, drained
instructions: In a small bowl, combine rice, 1/2 cup pitted and chopped mango with 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds and 2 tablespoons sesame seeds. Set aside. Cook red pepper and 2 tablespoons sesame seeds in a small, nonstick skillet on medium heat 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Add reserved sesame seeds, pineapple, tomatoes and 3/4 cup toasted sesame seeds. Toss to blend. Cool. To prepare dressing, in a blender or food processor, combine yogurt, tomato and vanilla bean.

title: Nam Jim's Yummy Chicken Nachos
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, quartered | 1 packet ladyfingers | 1 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 cup crushed tortilla | 1/4 cup diced lychees ( optional )
instructions: Place the chicken in a large pot. Add all of the toppings except for the tortillas and fry, just until done. This should not take long. Put the nachos on top of a plate and place a dollop of cheese on top. Serve with chips, salad, salsa, or anything else you like.

title: Spaghetti With Chili & Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole cumin seed, lightly crushed | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 2 tablespoons dried black anchovies | 1 lb angel hair pasta | 1 1/2 cups sliced onons or 1 1/2 cups canned chopped green onions
instructions: Toast cumin seeds in a heavy nonstick skillet over medium high heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until fragrant. Grind in mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Combine cumin powder and pepper in a large serving bowl. Add anchovies and stir well. Add spaghetti and onions.

title: Beef and Macaroni Croissants
ingredients: 2 cups rigatoni pasta | 1 cup hoagie roll | 1/8 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 4 slices grilled onions, cut in half | 4 hamburger buns, split
instructions: In a 6 quart slow cooker, combine the pasta, hoagie roll, catsup, orange juice, hot sauce and dried onion flakes. Cover and cook on low for 1 hour. Preheat broiler. Remove onion pieces from the buns. Cut a circle around the inside of the roll and place on a baking sheet. Place steak inside of the roll. Place under the broiler and cook 1 - 2 minutes. Serve the beef and pasta mixture on top.

title: Lebanese Laban
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/2 lb lamb fat, cut into about 1 inch cubes
instructions: Place each meatball, covered tightly with paper towels, in an electric grinder and grind or grind the cumin seed through a fine sieve. Alternatively, if using a mortar and pestle, place them on a clean, dry surface and pound them by pulsing them, or grind them in a clean coffee grinder. Place the meatballs in a dry pan and press the seeds into the fat. Cover loosely and leave to mellow for about 10 to 15 minutes or until they have darken. Cover the pan with a piece of damp cloth and set over a pan of warm water and simmer for 5 to 6 minutes, or until quite tender and most of the fat is rendered and the meat is coated with spices and fat. Remove the pan from the heat and place in a bowl, seal tightly with a lid and leave for 5 to 10 minutes to cool. When slightly warm, remove the lid and transfer to a storage container.

title: Baked Chicken With Leek and Fresh Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 100 g chicken cutlets | 1 leek, chopped | 1 tomatoes, chopped | 3/4 cup low-fat chicken stock cube | 1/4 cup heinz's condensed tomato puree | 2/3 cup watercress, chopped ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the fenugreek seeds in a small saucepan or frying pan over medium heat, and toast, stirring, for 1 minute, or until they darken. Remove from heat, and allow to cool. Dry fry the cutlets in a heavy frying pan with a little olive oil, and brown in batches, turning once, until cooked through. Remove and set aside. Add the leek to the pan, and season with salt. Cook, stirring, for 4 minutes, or until softened, or slightly browned. Add the leek mixture, tomato, and chicken stock cube to the pan. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat, and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, or until the sauce is thick. Add the fenugreek seeds and cook for 1 minute, or until coated. Add the mustard and 1 cup of watercress. Stir well, then transfer to an ovenproof dish. Turn oven on to 200c, and bake, uncovered, for 35 - 40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and a golden brown. Serve with the tomato, leek and fenugreek sauce.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,coconut oil,rotelle pasta,vegetable oil
title: Macarrones Con Coco
ingredients: 1/2 pound rotelle pasta | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 jar coco lopez or velveeta cheese, cubed | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Cook rotelle pasta in large pot of boiling water until almost tender. Drain. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Heat oil in large skillet over high heat. Add coco lopez and bell pepper and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned on bottom. Add cooked rotelle to skillet and stir to combine. Serve warm.

title: Tortellini and Squash Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 12 ounces oatmeal ( whole grain ) | 12 ounces squash, cut into cubes | 1 package greek yogurt ( light or fat free ) | 8 eggs and protein ( raw ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | pita bread, triangles ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f put a non stick baking sheet in the oven while the oven is heating up. Combine the oatmeal, squash, yogurt, 3 eggs, and vanilla in a large bowl. Drop mixture by scoopfuls into the hot baking sheet. Bake 20 minutes, until golden brown. Sprinkle with more powdered or toasted pita to taste.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,chocolate,banana,oxtail,green curry paste,tomatillo salsa,water chestnut,lemongrass
title: Oxtail & Green Curry Paste With Green Banana
ingredients: 3 ounces oxtail, cut into 2-inch chunks ( or shrimp ) | 8 ounces mild pork sausage | 1 cup finely shredded yellow banana | 1/2 cup water chestnut, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons green curry paste ( i like san choy brand ) | 1 teaspoon finely chopped lemongrass | 1 can tomatillo salsa | 1 teaspoon chocolate, grated ( optional )
instructions: Place 1 ounce of oxtail or shrimp in medium saucepan. Pour in water chestnuts, curry paste, lemongrass and salsa. Cover, cook until water chestnuts are soft. Remove from heat. Stir in the remaining oxtail/ shrimp and heat again over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,taro root,garlic clove,parmesan cheese,italian seasoning
title: Taro Balls
ingredients: 15 fresh taro root, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 cups parmesan cheese ( can use any other topping ) | 2 garlic cloves, roughly chopped ( or garlic powder ) | 2 tablespoons seasoned rice flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Place garlic cloves in a mortar and pestle and crush, or chop finely. In a large bowl, crush taro roots until they are in small pieces, then combine with other ingredients. Place in fridge to chill. Shape dough into small balls and roll lightly in either rice flour or rice powder. Place on baking tray lined with aluminum foil. Cook at 375 degrees for 20 minutes or until lightly browned on the outside.

title: Orange Marmalade
ingredients: 200 g minced veal | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water | 2 teaspoons ginger & garlic paste
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all ingredients. Serve with bread, rice dishes, custard or soup.

title: Broccoli & Broccoli Rice
ingredients: 2 cups fresh broccoli, finely chopped | 1 cup white rice, cooked
instructions: Cook rice as per pkg directions using broccoli & rice.

title: Tofu Soup
ingredients: 175 g firm tofu | 150 -200 ml vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 40 ml cold water
instructions: Rinse the tofu well, shake off the excess water and squeeze to remove excess moisture. Cut the tofu into 1 inch cube and set aside. Dissolve the tomato purée in the water and leave aside. Cut the tofu into 1 cm cubes and set aside. Cook the soup in a pressure cooker over medium heat. Add the tofu, and bring it to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes or until its soft. Serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,pea,rice,grain rice,coffee bean,rosemary sprig,saffron thread,iceberg lettuce
title: Rice & Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain rice | 2 cups cold cooked rice, chilled | 2 cups canned pea beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons espresso beans, warmed | 2 -3 canned plum tomatoes, coarsely chopped or 2 -3 tablespoons pure vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon fresh rosemary sprig, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 1 iceberg lettuce, preferably green
instructions: Prepare rice by placing 2 cups cold rice and 2 cups cold cooked rice in a large bowl. Place peas in a second bowl.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,grain rice,vegetable broth,yellow pea,chipotle chile adobo,rice wine
title: Chipotle-Rice Pilaf for Peruvian Cuisine
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain rice or 1 cup long grain rice | 1 3/4 cups vegetable broth | 1 dried chipotle chiles in adobo ( see note ) | 1/2 cup yellow split peas | 1/2 cup fresh cheddar cheese, grated or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons rice wine ( use cooking sherry, sweet dessert wine, or other dry wine, or sherry ) or 2 tablespoons dry white wine, for the peruvian cuisine ( use cooking sherry, sweet dessert wine, or other dry wine, or other dry wine, or other dry wine, or other dry wine ) | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, grated or 1/2 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Wash, cook and drain rice to yield 2 cups.

Random Ingredients: banana,wheat flour,mango chutney,kidney bean,white sugar,chili pepper
title: Healthy Protein Balls
ingredients: 4 bananas, mashed | 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon mango chutney bean | 1 tablespoon chili pepper | 1 teaspoon red table wine or 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 deg c. Line 2 x 20cm baking trays with baking paper. Combine bananas, flour, sugar, mango and chilli pepper in a bowl and mix to combine. Roll small tablespoonfuls of mixture to shape into balls. Place on prepared trays and bake for 15 minutes or until golden. Heat the grill. Serve balls with mango chutney sauce. Cooking time reflects baking and cooling time.

title: Easiest Enchilada Sauce Yet
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce, mild | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 0.333 package crumbled feta
instructions: Pour 1 cup enchilada sauce in 9x13 pan. Mix remaining 1 cup enchilada sauce and fiesta toppings, stirring until blended. Pour over top of enchiladas and stir. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 6 - 8 hours, then serve over fiesta corn chips with grated cheese, sour cream, chopped green onions, or just anything else that strikes your fancy.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,plum tomato,garlic clove,jumbo shrimp,dark ale,caster sugar,plum
title: Bread & Eat Prawns
ingredients: 14 ounces good quality plum tomatoes, drained, patted dry | 12 jumbo shrimp, with shells | 1/2 pint good dark ale | 6 plum tomatoes, skinned, skinned, seeded, finely chopped | 6 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 loaf italian bread, crusts removed, cut into wedges
instructions: Put the tomatoes in a bowl and cover with boiling water, set aside for 1 hour. Put the remaining ingredients in a heatproof saucepan and bring to the boil. Cook gently for about 10 minutes. Lift out the tomato and set aside. Return the tomato to the pan, pour over the beer and simmer, uncovered, for 3 minutes. Put the slices of bread in an ovenproof bowl and pour in the prawn and sauce, topping with the slices of bread. Bake in a moderate oven for about 15 minutes or until the prawns have turned pink. Serve at once.

title: Lebanese Dhal With Lentils and Artichokes
ingredients: 1/2 cup medium-cubed lentils, rinsed, picked over, and drained ( chickpeas ) | 2 2 tablespoons tomato paste or 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon dried chervil ( or 1 fresh sage leaf ) or 1/3 cup fresh parsley leaves, cleaned | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder or 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh cilantro roots, washed | 2 teaspoons dried chervil ( or 2 teaspoons fresh sage leaves ) | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon coarse sea salt, if desired
instructions: Heat a 6 to 8 quart kettle over medium heat, stirring to loosen any browned lentils. When simmering, add lentils and 1 1/2 cups water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 10 minutes, then remove from heat. Stir together tomato paste, chervil, cumin, chervil, artichoke hearts, and salt.

title: Quick Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 8 ounces uncooked short-grain white rice
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Saute beef over medium heat, stirring frequently, until browned. In a small nonstick skillet, cook rice according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,noodle,nutmeg,beet,chili pepper flake,ginger garlic paste,broth,bread
title: Beets & Noodles
ingredients: 2 cans beets | 500 g bread | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 tablespoon nutmeg ( optional ) | 1 cup broth ( or water ) | 1/2 cup noodles ( or any other type of noodles, you want, my daughter prefers rice ) | freshly baked bread ( to serve ) ( optional )
instructions: Rinse beets well and place in a roasting tin with cold water in the oven. Turn the oven to 150c. Cook for 40 - 45 minutes until tender. When the beets are cooked, remove the beets and chop into small chunks. Put to one side. Cut the bread into cubes. Place all ingredients except the noodles in a very large pan, cover with water and bring to the boil. Drain off the water and add the noodles, then cover and cook over a medium hear or low heat for about 20 - 25 minutes until noodles are soft. Remove pan and toss with toast, if using the toast. Serve with fresh tomato wedges and fresh basil.

Random Ingredients: chinese barbecue pork,chicken bouillon cube,cool whip,chicken breast half,lemon peel,hamburger,buttermilk biscuit dough,cream
title: Barbecue Chicken Sandwiches (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream, reduced fat | 12 ounces hamburger | 4 ounces chinese barbecue pork, cooked or 4 ounces deli ham, cooked and shredded | 4 skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 lemon peel, finely shredded ( see note below ) | 1 ounce buttermilk biscuit dough ( see note below ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons cool whip
instructions: Place chicken breast and ham on the bottom of a 2 1/2 quart slow cooker. Place chicken on top of chicken. Sprinkle with lemon peel. Pour buttermilk mixture over chicken. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or 5 hours on low. Remove chicken breast from slow cooker and shred or cut into chunks using 2 forks or a food processor. Serve on buns. To prepare buns, heat bouillon cube in a small saucepan over medium heat until it turns fragrant and is clear brown. Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream until smooth. Add cooled mixture. Add shredded chicken and refrigerate several hours or overnight. To serve, heat 1 tablespoon of cooking spray on bottom of a 10 inch non stick skillet. Spoon about 3 tablespoons of filling on each sandwich. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of topping. Re cover and cook on low for 5 minutes until filling is heated through.

title: Cabbage and Hine Cheese Stew
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, shredded | 1 can savory | 2 -3 tablespoons tahini | 1 lb longhorn cheese, shredded or shredded | 1/2 teaspoon ground hing
instructions: Steam cabbage and savory, or cool slightly. Combine cheese, hing, and tahini. Add cabbages and mix lightly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken drummettes,tabasco sauce,yellow squash,manchego cheese,orange juice concentrate,dijon mustard,garlic salt,sugar snap pea
title: Mexican Chicken on a Pot
ingredients: 6 chicken drummettes ( legs-thigh ) | 1/3 cup orange juice concentrate | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon sugar snap pea ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 4 ounces manchego cheese ( shredded ) or 4 ounces other mild white cheese | 1/2 cup yellow squash ( sliced )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees. Spray large casserole dish with non stick cooking spray. Place drumettes, skin side down, on lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake, turning once, until slightly golden brown or about 40 minutes. Remove from oven. Set aside. In large bowl, combine orange juice concentrate, dijon, sugar snap peas and garlic salt and tabasco. Add chicken and toss to coat. Transfer to bowl.

title: Curried Applesauce
ingredients: 1 can canned applesauce | 1 tablespoon cornstarch paste | 2 teaspoons hot red curry paste | 1/2 cup currant jelly
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together apple sauce, cornstarch paste and hot red curry paste.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,jasmine rice,horseradish,fine sea salt
title: Lemon and Horseradish Risotto
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( from 4 lemons, plus zest of 3 lemons ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared horseradish ( about ) or 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish ( about ) | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice
instructions: Wash and soak rice in a fine mesh sieve for 15 minutes. Rinse well and drain. Put lemon juice, horseradish and salt in large bowl.

title: Mussels and Mushrooms with Cashews
ingredients: 500 g mussels, mussels | 50 g white button mushrooms | 350 g water | 20 g cashews
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a big pot and bring to the boil. Boil for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cashews are soft, stir the mussels and allow them to open up while you eat it.

title: Garlic-Garlic Croutons
ingredients: 1 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 4 tablespoons margarine, melted | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Place the 4 tablespoons of grated gruyere cheese in a bowl. Add the margarine and 1/4 cup gruyere cheese and mix lightly with a fork. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Roll the mixture into cylinders and fry until lightly browned, approximately 3 minutes per side. Serve on a bed of rice.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,feta cheese,sazon goya,hash brown potato,lemon
title: Chile Pepper Potatoes and Feta Cheese #SP5
ingredients: 16 ounces hash brown potatoes, peeled and cubed. 1 ounce diced red chilies | 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon sazon goya | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Put the hash brown potatoes in the pot. Sprinkle the red chilies on top, and top with feta cheese. Combine the sazon goya and lemon juice together in a bowl and pour over the potatoes. Cover and cook on low for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Cherie's Ricotta Spread
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl. Mix thoroughly. Put in a container. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or until thick.

title: Smoky Cabbage Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 large napa cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon shallot, minced | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cabbage, shallot, enchilada sauce, and liquid smoke. Mix thoroughly. Heat a few tablespoons of the cabbage mixture in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Place one tortilla in a tortilla and fill with cabbage mixture.

title: Cheesy Snack
ingredients: 4 slices american cheese | 1 finely-chopped scotch bonnet pepper, finely chopped ( wear gloves when handling scotch bonnet )
instructions: Place the cheese slices in a small saucer and roll them gently with a rolling pin to make sure the cheese doesn't become soggy. Remove the cheese and press to make sure all of the cheese is squeezed evenly. This will make it easier to handle. The heat from the cheese should melt and melt the soggy bits of soggy cheese. The heat from the grilling will melt any bits of soggy cheese that may still remain or will be stuck to the soggy bits. Place the cheese on small individual microwavable or cookie sheet and heat in microwave until warm all the way through. This mixture will not be very hot in this step but should be hot enough and will melt any bits of soggy bits of soggy cheese hanging out over the side of the skillet. Once all of the butter is melted take it off the microwaving element and set aside. This mixture can be eaten with any sandwich.

title: Blueberry Beef Sirloin Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, top sirloin cut into 1 '' diagonal pieces | 1/4 cup blueberries or 1/4 cup frozen blueberries | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 can anaheim chilies, drained
instructions: Combine blueberries and onion powder in shallow baking dish. Add meat and turn so that the top of the meat and berries are distributed evenly. Cover and chill about 10 minutes. Heat grill pan and heat for 2 minutes on high. Remove sirloin and any juices from marinated steak. Cover and grill 3 - 5 minutes on each side or to desired doneness.

title: Spiced Broccoli Filling for Indian Spices
ingredients: 1/2 lb broccoli floret, washed, trimmed & cut in 1-inch lengths | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid honey or 1 1/2 teaspoons molasses, warmed | 1 1/2 tablespoons flax seeds, ground in a mortar and pestle or 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the broccoli, turmeric, honey & flaxseed mixture. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until the broccoli is tender. Cool completely. Using a blender, puree the mixture until you have a smooth paste. Cool completely before using. Spoon into cold, sterilized jars leaving 1 1/2 inches headspace.

title: Quick and Easy Italian Baked Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages uncooked whole wheat spaghetti, broken into 2 inch pieces | 2 packages sliced pepperoni | 12 ounces shell pasta, broken into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Combine the spaghetti, pepperoni, and cooked shells in a saucepan, and mix well. Top with casserole topping ingredients. Cover the mixture with a lid, and bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Olive and Guacamole Spread With Boursin Cheese Fonduta
ingredients: 1 lb dried kalamata olive | 8 ounces freshly prepared guacamole | 2 ounces boursin cheese, chevre variety ( or other good-quality goat cheese )
instructions: Drain the olives and cut them into chunks in a small bowl. Place the olives in a food processor, along with the cheese, and pulse until all of the cheese has been incorporated before adding the cheese. Spread the mixture into a 1 inch deep, well oiled, buttered metal loaf pan. Serve as you would a sandwich spread. The fonduta can be stored in the refrigerator until served, up to 2 days.

title: Raspberry Truffles
ingredients: 2 jars seedless raspberry jam | 1/4 cup unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa | 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Spread jam evenly on waxed paper. Spread melted butter evenly and sprinkle with cocoa. Roll the mixture into 1 log, wrap in new waxed paper, and refrigerate until firm, at least 1 hour. Slice log into 1/4 slices.

title: Pumpkin & Rhubarb Scones
ingredients: 3 cups grated peeled butternut squash | 2 cups chopped rhubarb ( or frozen ) | 3 scallions, chopped | 1 1/4 teaspoons baking soda | 1 recipe pastry for double crust pie | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( seasoned with salt and black pepper, or cinnamon )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degrees f. Squeeze squash into the bowl of a food processor, or with an immersion blender. Add rhubarb or frozen peas, and pulse to combine. Add scallions and process until squash is chunky. Add baking soda and process until mixture becomes a little sticky. Turn out onto a floured board, and knead in the italian style breadcrumbs. Roll dough into one inch balls, and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Flatten into crescents, and sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until crisp.

title: Beer and Cheese Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups quinoa | 6 -8 pears, cut into wedges ( a few pears left whole will also work ) | 2 cups 1 % fat cottage cheese or 2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 3/4 cup light beer ( or 2/3 cup ale or a mild white beer ) | salt and pepper | 1 pinch dried dill ( optional )
instructions: In a large, shallow oven proof bowl combine quinoa, pears, 1/3 cup fat or cottage cheese and beer. Season to taste with salt, pepper and dill weed. Cover the bowl with a piece of greaseproof paper or a silicone paper towel and tightly pack the contents, in a single layer, in a baking dish. The liquid may be evaporated during the last 10 - 15 minutes of baking if you prefer.

title: Spicy Cucumber Hummus
ingredients: 1 english cucumber | 1/2 cup canned chickpeas ( drained ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Cut cucumber in half and remove seeds & stringy white membrane. Cut in half lengthways, scrape out seeds. Using a paring knife or a vegetable peeler, peel back the green colored inner skin around the cucumber leaving about 1/4 inch of the flesh intact. Place in colander and rinse under cool water. Drain well. In a food processor or blender, combine chickpeas, corn oil & liquid smoke. Blend until smooth. Pile hummus onto a serving platter & serve with cucumber halves sprinkled over the top. Enjoy.

title: Taste for Breakfast
ingredients: 5 slices medium sized eggplant ( about a teaspoon in diameter ) | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: First heat the sesame oil on the pan. Put the eggplant in the pan, and quickly turn with a spatula. Try not to get it to stick to the pan or burn itself. You don't want to burn it as it is cooking. Turn the slices once more until all sides are nicely browned and the eggplant has a nice color.

title: Nepalese Nalese Peppercorn Rice Cookies
ingredients: 350 g cakes flour | 350 g brown rice, well washed and drained | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon fried pecans | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon brown rice, for dusting
instructions: Mix the sifted flour with 1 tablespoons of the cold water and knead into a firm dough using a dough hook. Set aside. Put the rest of the ingredients except nuts in a food processor and pulse briefly until mixed. Add the pecans and mix again. If the dough is to dry add a little water till it holds the form of a firm dough ball. Turn the dough out onto a floured board and cut into small rounds or rectangles using a cookie stamp or a glass. Dust lightly with the reserved rice and serve with fish sauce diluted with the reserved rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken liver,poppy seed,tomato puree,rosemary sprig,beer,tamari,salmon fillet,barbecue sauce
title: BBQ Salmon With a Heart Attack Poppy Seed
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, skin removed | 1 cup tomato puree | 1 1/2 cups hoisin barbecue sauce | 2 jars prepared mustard-flavored poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons barbecued sauce | 1/4 cup maple syrup or 1/4 cup tamari | 1 large rosemary sprig | 2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper to taste. Rinse fish under cold tap water and pat dry, then set aside. Place fish in a large baking dish and brush with beer mixture. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 425 degrees or until the fish flakes easily when tested, though not as thick as you might like. Spoon a dollop of the poppyseed topping down the center of each salmon fillet. Serve with bbq sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,kernel corn,kaffir lime leaf,extra virgin olive oil,bird eye chile,coriander,chicken bouillon cube,red wine vinegar
title: Tunisian Kaffir Lime Chiles and Pistachio Skewers #A1
ingredients: 24 -24 medium frozen whole kernel corn sticks | 1/2 cup pistachios ( raw unsalted pistachios, shelled ) | 4 kaffir lime leaves ( or 6 small mint leaves ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( vegetarian or soy based, use only half a chicken bouillon cube! ) | 1 -2 birds eye chile ( optional ) | 10 fresh bird eye chiles ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your grill to hot. Wash and soak the frozen corn sticks in water. Remove the kernels from the pistachios and soak in water for 20 minutes. Then drain and pat dry. Place the pistachios in a non reactive bowl and pour a little olive oil over them. Cut the lime leaves or mint leaves into 2 inch long strips. Add the pistachios, lime leaves and red wine vinegar to a small bowl and mix well. Now, remove the seeds and membrane from the birds eye chiles or optional chile.

Random Ingredients: olive,chocolate square,chicken stock vegetable,skewer,trout,italian sausage,rice wine
title: Molho With Grilled Trout and Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 2 links johnsonville sausages | 2 ounces smoked sweet italian sausage, cut into thin slices | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock, made from chicken | 2 cups rice wine vinegar or 2 cups red wine vinegar | 4 ounces toblerone semisweet chocolate squares, grated | 1/4 cup sliced olive
instructions: Slice the sausages into thin half moons and lightly flatten them with a mallet or the edge of a glass. Place a smoked sausage in a frying pan and cook over a fairly high heat, turning once, until browned all sides, then remove sausages from the pan and put aside. Scatter the sausage slices evenly over the sausage in the pan, then pour in half the stock. Stir the rice wine vinegar into the stock and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Add the sausage back into the pan and stir, then put the toblerone chocolate in a bowl and stir in a small amount of hot stock. Pour the hot stock over the chocolate and whisk until smooth and glossy. Dot the tops with a few grated, unstotted pecorino romano cheese, then place the trout on top of the cheese until coated. Alternatively, you can simply arrange a sausage layer inside the fish, and serve with the remaining grated cheese.

title: Banana & Raisin Breakfast
ingredients: 2 bananas, peeled & sliced | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 saffron strands | tortilla chips, to sprinkle ( optional )
instructions: Place a little bit of saffron over a piece of toast if using. Place one slice of banana and 3 raisins on top of the saffron and 1 tbsp raisins to cover the whole thing. Top with a second piece of banana & raisins & continue layering until you have used up all the raisins & bananas with no raisins left over. Cover & cook on 180c/350f/gas 6 for 12 - 15 minutes. Sprinkle top with more raisin if desired. Serve with warmed tortillas to dip.

title: English Pea Soup
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking rolled oats | 1 cup water | 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 1 cup dried english pea | 1 head red leaf lettuce
instructions: Place the 2 cups oats and water in a medium saucepan. Cover and stir until oat mixture is well blended. Bring mixture to boil. Lower heat to low and stir occasionally until heated through. Remove from heat. Stir in peas. Cover and refrigerate until cold. Remove the lettuce leaves and place on a serving platter or serving dish. Ladle warm soup into individual heated bowls. Add lettuce leaves to soup. Serve with additional salad dressing.

title: Gorgonzola and Clam Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces pancetta, minced or 1/4-1/2 cup pancetta grease | 1 can italian-style tomatoes, drained, pressed | 2 cans fresh clams, drained, rinsed, and coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 - 1/2 cup crumbled gorgonzola ( more or less according to taste ) | 1/4 cup thinly sliced provolone cheese, plus | 12 slices thinly sliced provolone cheese ( more or less according to taste )
instructions: In a large skillet, saute pancetta over medium heat for a few minutes, just until some excess fat begins to render and pancetta is browned. Add italian tomatoes and stir to combine. Add clam juice, crushed clams, allspice, and gorgonzola cheese. Cook over medium heat for a few minutes to reduce slightly and to thicken. Remove from heat and add provolone slices. This can be made ahead and stored, covered in the refrigerator for up to one week. Spoon most of the sauce in an oven safe casserole. Sprinkle the top with provolone slices and a few slices of provolone cheese to taste. Bake in a 300 degree f oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the cheese browns just a bit.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,grit,chicken breast half,flour tortilla,halloumi cheese,caramel topping
title: Cheesy-Stuffed Chicken Roll-Ups
ingredients: 8 flour tortillas | 4 chicken breast halves | 1 cup shredded plain halloumi cheese | 1/2 cup caramel topping ( or more ) | 1/4 cup grits, oats or 1/4 cup masa harina | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Rinse chicken under cold running water. Slice the chicken into 1in slices, then cut each slice into 4 pieces. Place chicken in a colander, sprinkle generously with sugar and let drain for 10 minutes. Dry each slice on paper towels and set aside. Place 1 tortilla onto a plate. Layer each tortilla with a slice of haloumi, cheese and caramel topping, then roll the tortilla around the filling. Place on a baking sheet in a single layer and bake for 10 minutes, flip and bake 5 minutes more. Repeat with all tortillas and filling. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Fajitas (Portuguese Steak Spice)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground sirloin steak | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Brown both sides of the sirloin steak, add coriander seeds. Place on a baking sheet and bake for about 30 minutes, watch as little as possible, the ground sirloin will toughen very quickly. Serve, with rice and beans. Note, i recommend 2 people grinding the meat with a fork before grinding it for the best results. The oil adds little flavor while cooking.

title: Pesto and Chicken Salad Recipe
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves, chopped or 1 teaspoon dried parsley leaves, 1/4 tsp. dried | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, chopped or 1 teaspoon dried basil, 1/4 tsp. dried
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a serving bowl. Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving. Will store well for up to 2 days refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Beef Stew Au Jus
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck ( or other inexpensive meat ) | 1 beef tenderloin | 1 1/2 cups beef stock with 2 oz.water
instructions: Cut beef into bite size pieces and place in crockpot. Cut beef tenderloin into bite size pieces and place on top of beef. Pour remaining cup of broth over beef and add the beef. Do not stir. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Cashew Mushrooms & Oysters
ingredients: 200 g dry salted peanuts | 4 -5 fresh oysters mushrooms | 1/4 cup chopped cashews | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 1/2 - 3 cups grated low-fat cheese ( ie cheddar, cheddar, swiss )
instructions: Grind nuts to a fine powder. Slice mushrooms thinly. Dry the oysters and char under the grill. Arrange on a tray. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Sprinkle with cashews. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: feta,self rising flour,caper,lime zest,virgin olive oil,cod
title: Cod With Feta Dressing
ingredients: 3 tablespoons drained capers | 1 tablespoon lime zest | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 4 tablespoons self rising flour | 2 lbs cod ( approx 1 and a half pound each ) | finely crumbled feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f in a small bowl, mix together the capers, lime zest, oil, flour and half the feta. Open the fish and, using a sharp knife, cut all around the perimeter of the fish to separate the flesh from the bones. Slide the fish into the flour, margarine or oil/vinegar mixture and stir to coat. Spread this mixture all around the fish. Arrange on a baking sheet, cover and bake for 15 minutes. Turn oven to broil and place fish in oven. Broil until crisp, then move to a serving plate.

Random Ingredients: mace,self rising flour,egg bread,lemon peel,parmesan cheese,beef tenderloin,yellow pepper,chicken bouillon granule
title: Mediterranean Beef Patties With Pepper and Lemon Peel
ingredients: 2 eggs | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 4 slices bread | 1 large yellow pepper, sliced | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 2 lbs beef tenderloin
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In bowl, beat together eggs, chicken bouillon granules, lemon peel, mace and 1/2 cup parmesan cheese. Dip bread slices in egg mixture, then into cheese. Place beef on greased baking sheet, then bake 7 to 8 minutes or until thermometer reaches 160ºf. Place remaining cheese on top of beef, then continue to bake 2 to 4 minutes longer or until beef is cooked through. Remove from oven, cover and slice. Serve with pepper and lemon peels.

Random Ingredients: broth,sausage,pomegranate juice,superfine sugar,colby monterey jack cheese,brown sugar
title: Pomegranate Sausage (Cameroon)
ingredients: 4 links mild or hot sausage, cut in half and cooked | 1 1/2 cups pomegranate juice or 1 1/2 cups orange juice | 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 1/3 cups chicken broth or 1 1/3 cups beef broth, heated | 1/4 cup packed light brown sugar | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese or 2 cups regular cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sausage and pomegranate juice or orange juice. Place the sugar in a small, heavy saucepan over medium heat. Stir often, until the sugar is melted. Stir in the broth and sugar. Cook until the mixture is reduced to about 1 1/2 cups and the sugar just starts to caramelize, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in the brown sugar and cheese.

title: Cheese Fried Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup long grain rice | 1 -2 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 2 -3 drops hot pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 2 -3 drops fish sauce
instructions: Prepare the rice according to the package directions. Place a large skillet over medium heat, and when the skillet is warm, add the gruyere cheese. Saute the cheese until it is completely melted. Add pepper sauce and fish sauce. Stir to mix. Add the cooked rice and stir to coat thoroughly. You may add a bit more hot pepper sauce if the dish is too sour. Serve.

Random Ingredients: mirin,chinese mustard,corn,rice wine,chili garlic sauce,corn tortilla
title: Sweet Corn Chips With Chilli Mustard
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons low-sodium chili garlic sauce | 1 tablespoon minced bottled chili-garlic sauce | 2 teaspoons mirin | 1 1/2 tablespoons light corn or 1 1/2 tablespoons coconut vinegar | 6 -8 corn tortillas, cut into 1-inch strips | 1 teaspoon prepared chinese-style mustard
instructions: In a small bowl, combine sauce ingredients and set aside. In a hot nonstick skillet or fryer basket, sprayed with no stick cooking oil, cook tortilla strips in 2 batches, turning, until crisp and golden, 1 - 2 minutes per side. Transfer to paper towels to drain. Repeat with remaining tortilla strips. Spread remaining sauce over one side of each tortilla and sprinkle with mustard. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: berry,black bean,salad oil,pea,red bean,confectioner ' sugar,pepper flake
title: Red Bean Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons salad oil | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 cup mixed beans ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/2 cup red beans, pre-shredded ( fresh or cooked ) | 1/2 cup frozen peas, cooked | 1 cup mixed berries or 1 cup banana | confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: Boil the red beans and peas in cold water in a large saucepan for 10 - 15 minutes until just tender. Chop or dice the red beans and peas and add to the beans and peas. Place the prepared salad ingredients over the salad. If desired, dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Coconut Mousse
ingredients: 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/2 cup coarsely crushed cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon ground allspice | 6 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Rinse and soak the vanilla bean in a bowl of warm water for 20 minutes, then remove the bean and place it in a microwave safe bowl along with the cracker crumbs and allspice. Microwave on high for 7 minutes, then stir well, then microwave for an additional 6 minutes. Remove the vanilla bean from the microwave, cover with a damp towel, and set aside. Spoon the mousse into a bowl and place in the refrigerator until serving. Garnish with lime wedges.

title: Glazed Pork Loin
ingredients: 1/2 cup rosemary | 1/2 cup chives | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon sage leaves | 2 lbs pork loin | 2 lbs dried fruits
instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºf. Combine rosemary, chives, mustard powder, sage and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.

title: Fettuccines With Cashews
ingredients: 455 g fettuccine | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 500 g roasted cashews | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: First of all, make sure the pasta is dry. Wash the cashews in a little salt and place in a pan. Heat on low heat and mix with the dry pasta. Now, place a frying pan on a medium flame and add about 2 tbsp oil to the pan. Pour the dry pasta into the hot pan. When the pasta is in the pan, mix it lightly with the pasta. It will start looking dry but it’ll continue to cook in about 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato,dark brown sugar,apple cider vinegar,catsup,lemon pepper seasoning,rye flour,genoa salami
title: The Best and Easiest Reuben Filling
ingredients: 2 cans petite diced tomatoes with juice | 2 cans dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons catsup | 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 2 1/2 tablespoons lemon pepper seasoning | 1 package genoa salami | 1/4 cup cold cuts rye flour ( rye gluten )
instructions: Place the tomatoes with their juice, brown sugar, catup, vinegar, lemon pepper, and salami in the crock of the slow cooker. Cook on high 1 to 1 1/2 hours, then remove the lid and mix in the rye flour. Heat in the microwave 1 minute.

title: Roasted Turnips With Ground Turkey
ingredients: 2 turnips ( small and whole ) | 1/4 cup sherry wine ( or other dry white wine ) | 1 lb ground turkey
instructions: Preheat a small ovenproof skillet or roasting pan to medium high. Scrub the turnips well under running water and set aside. Turnip slices in some water. In small cup, mix sherry with ground turkey. Dip the turnips in the turkey mixture, then place in the preheated skillet or roasting pan. Add water to cover the turnips and pan. Cover, bake in the middle of the oven for 1 hour or until turnips are tender and browned. Turnips with the pan juices can be served hot, warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: lobster tail,newman italian salad dressing,bell pepper,albacore tuna
title: Italian Style Shrimp and Lobster Toss
ingredients: 3 tablespoons italian dressing | 1 can albacore tuna, drained | 1 lb shrimp, cooked, small, peeled and deveined | 1 bell pepper, thinly sliced ( any color ) | 1/2 lb lobster tail, cooked
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the dressing and pasta. Toss to combine well. Place shrimp in a decorative dish and top with shrimp. Pour the pasta mixture over all, leaving a 1/2 inch space in the center. Sprinkle the top with pepper. Serve and enjoy.

title: Lazy Jacks in a Blanket
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup dry white breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 8 slices lean white bread | 6 leaves coleslaw mix
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f coat a 9x9 glass or ceramic casserole dish with cooking spray. Combine onion and the bread crumbs in medium bowl. Toss with the mascarpone cheese. Spread one side of one side of 1 slice of bread with about 3 tbls. Of the cheesy stuffing. Top the stuffing with another slice of bread and stuffing side down. Carefully fold over. Press into the sides and top of the casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes. Cover and continue baking for another 30 minutes or until the bread is lightly browned and the topping is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,anchovy,pico de gallo,mizithra cheese,margarine,zucchini,dark soy sauce
title: Zucchini Chips With Anchovies, Anchovies, and Pepitas
ingredients: 2 large zucchini, cut into 1/8-inch rounds | 1 tablespoon margarine | 3 slices zucchini | 1/2 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 3 ounces mizithra cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup anchovy, chopped | 1/4 cup pico de gallo ( salsa fresca )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil and set aside. Place the zucchini on the baking sheet. Brush with the margarine, leaving a 1 inch border of rind attached at all sides. Broil, cut side down, until puffed and browned, about 1 minute. Set aside. Place the zucchini on the prepared baking sheet. Top with the zucchini rounds. In a small bowl, combine the dark soy sauce with the red pepper flakes. Dip the zucchini rounds into the soy sauce mixture to coat. Arrange on the baking sheet. Top with cheese, anchovies, and pico de gallo. Broil until cheese starts to bubble, about 3 minutes.

title: Khao Plow
ingredients: 3 lbs japanese eggplants, peeled and sliced into 1/4 inch rounds | 3 lbs potatoes, peeled and sliced into 1/4 inch rounds | 6 containers of trader joe's japanese rice | 6 tablespoons anise extract | 6 limes | 4 cans risotto rice
instructions: Heat up a deep skillet with 1 tbs water. Once it comes to a boil for 3 minutes add one layer of noodles. When noodles are done drain them and place on paper towels so they don't get too sticky. Next heat up a few tbs water in the skillet until it comes to a boil. Add one layer of noodles in the skillet. Repeat this until all ingredients are cooked. This step is crucial. After step 2 add three jars of japanese rice to the skillet. Add another 15 tbs of anise extract. Keep adding layers. Keep doing this until you reach the top layer with ingredients, ending with layers of noodles, and finally, top with one last bottle of lime juice. I do this with two cans of rice. I do this until it reaches the top layer of noodles in my pan. It should look like a pyramid. Cover and let it cook for about 15 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: margarine,poblano chile,green,soymilk,sherry wine,sugar snap pea,serrano pepper
title: Poblano Chili Verde
ingredients: 1 package sugar snap peas | 1 1/2 lbs chiles or 1 1/2 lbs green chili pods, seeds removed | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and seeds | 3/4 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup sherry wine
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Turn off heat and let stand for 20 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, peel and seed chiles. Discard seeds and stems. Cut into pieces about 1/2 inch long. Remove and discard stems, set aside. Peel and seed whole chilies. Slice into thin rings. In a large nonstick pan add the sugar snap peas and whole chiles. Cook over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes or until snap peas soften. Do not brown. Add butter or margarine. Heat to boiling and cook for 1 minute. Stir in poblano chiles. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 9 to 10 minutes or until chiles are just beginning to color. Pour chile mixture into blender. Strain and set aside.. Strain soymilk into bowl. Stir in sherry and chile. Serve with bread, tortillas, or crackers.

title: Pistachio-Pineapple Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 8 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 can light pineapple juice concentrate, drained ( juice from 1 can ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Wash and chop tomatoes and put in a strainer. Pour all remaining ingredients over them. You may add more juice depending on how thick or moist you want your ingredients. Serve over ice with chips or raw veggies if desired.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,grain rice,san marzano tomato,pea,avocado,hollandaise sauce,fish sauce,wheat bread crumb
title: Rice and Avocado Rissoles
ingredients: 2 cans la maza beans, rinsed well with cold water | 1 can whole flannel beans, rinsed well with cold water | 2 tablespoons medium grain rice or 2 tablespoons bomba rice | 3 tablespoons whole-grain rice, toasted | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 tablespoons flaked sea salt or 4 tablespoons kosher sea salt | 2 tablespoons chopped haollandaise sauce | 2 -4 tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 4 slices whole wheat bread or 4 slices thickly sliced egg bread ( optional )
instructions: Rinse beans and remove their strings.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 package liquid pectin | 1 tablespoon liquid pectin
instructions: Dissolve the pectin in 1 tablespoon of the liquid pectin. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,greek yogurt,flax seed,white flour,bean sprout,irish cream,chili oil,yeast
title: Doughnuts - Bean Sprouts and Gyros
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry yeast | 1 cup white flour | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon guar gumboise or 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 -2 tablespoon dried pimiento | 1 jar baked beans sprouts | 2 tablespoons dried coriander or 2 tablespoons dried arabic herbs | 1 tablespoon flax seed ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in enough warm water to make a thin paste and set aside for 20 minutes. While the yeast is foaming, beat the yeast with flour, greek yogurt and guar gumboise until smooth. Add beans and noodles and mix. Cover with a towel and let rise for about 45 minutes. When risen, punch dough down and turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic. Place in a greased bowl, cover loosely and place in a warm place to rise. When almost double punch down and transfer to a lightly oiled bowl. Allow to rise for 1 1/2 hours. Knead well and turn out onto lightly floured surface. Cover and place in a warm place to rise once more. When almost double punch down and transfer to a lightly floured surface and knead with the palms of your hands until smooth and elastic. Place dough on a lightly floured baking tray and allow to rise until almost doubled. Using a pastry brush, lightly rub the dough with a pinch of olive oil. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Brush the breads with a little egg and sprinkled with some chopped dried herbs. Allow 3 - 5 minutes for the breads to rise. Remove from the oven and place on a baking sheet. Using a sharp knife cut through to within 1/2 inch of the top of the bread to create a hinge. Brush the top with a little egg and sprinkle with a little chopped dried coriander or arabic if desired. Allow breads to stand for 5 minutes. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes or until brown and crispy on the top. Allow breads to cool completely before cutting as desired.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,lemon wedge,green curry paste,beef tenderloin
title: Steamed Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin ( the butcher tenderloin, or round, or two small loin ) | 2 tablespoons green curry paste, mild | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | lemon wedge
instructions: The marinade is ready and can be adjusted to your preference. Cut the beef into serving sized pieces. Pour marinade over meat, rubbing the meat with your hand so the marinade coats the meat evenly. Place the tenderloin in a baking dish. Pour enough water into dish to just cover the meat. Cover tightly and marinate in the refrigerator overnight. The next day, remove the meat from the marinade and place on a rack in a steamer basket and steam until internal temperature reaches 140 degrees, approximately 15 - 20 minutes. Let meat stand in the steamer for 5 to 10 minutes before carving into 1/4 inch medallions or finger sized chunks. Serve with lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,brown rice,date,fryer chicken,cumin seed
title: Dude's Chicken in Date Gravy
ingredients: 16 ounces fryer chickens, cut up | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 1/4 cups cooked brown rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 1 1/2 cups chopped dates
instructions: Place chicken back in the oven on broil setting. Remove it from oven when no longer pink in the middle and no blood seeps out. Let it rest about 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, open the lid, add the can of cream of mushroom soup to the chicken and stir til well mixed. Add 1 cup of rice to the chicken and stir well. Return the chicken to the roaster. Add the cumin seeds, dates. Cover, broil, stirring frequently for 2 minutes.

title: Ajeen Beckford's Honey Mustard
ingredients: 2 teaspoons honey | 1/2 teaspoon vinegar, to cover
instructions: Heat honey and vinegar to about 115 degrees f. Do not boil. Add to dry ingredients, stir well, and enjoy.

title: Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 24 large red fresno chiles or 48 small green chilies | 1/4 - 1/2 cup red wine ( like merlot or a fruity italian wine ) | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano or 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary | 1 cup creme fraiche or 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Cut slit of each fresno chile lengthwise. Remove stem with sharp knife. Remove seeds. Cut chiles lengthwise into 1/8 inch thick slices or strips. Combine chiles, wine and green chiles in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: red onion,lemon peel,american cheese,maraschino cherry,rotini pasta,monterey jack cheese
title: Cheese and Parsley Salad
ingredients: 1 cup rotini pasta, cooked and drained | 2 tablespoons red onions, diced | 2 tablespoons monterey jack cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons white american cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Cover.

title: White Chocolate Chip Ice Cream
ingredients: 395 g low fat sweetened condensed milk ( 14 oz tin ) | 35 g white chocolate chips
instructions: Line the base of an individual 20 x 30 cm /9 x 3 cm baking tin with baking paper. Prick the paper with a fork or pastry knife twice to allow steam to escape. Leave to stand for 10 minutes. Dissolve the condensed milk in a medium heatproof bowl in 1 cup of boiling water for 5 minutes then stir in the white chocolate. Pour into the prepared tin and freeze for 2 hours or until hard and beginning to set around the edge. Invert onto a plate. Let stand for 5 minutes. Turn onto a platter and stand for 10 minutes longer. Grate a small piece of plastic off the edge of the ice cream. Cut into pieces.

Random Ingredients: double cream,creole seasoning,scotch bonnet pepper,nutmeg,pumpkin,palm sugar,cod,ricotta cheese
title: Pumpkin and Ricotta Baked
ingredients: 500 g pumpkin ( weighing 190g ) | 4 tablespoons cream | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning ( not gluten-free ) | 125 g ricotta cheese, drained | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 pinch of freshly grated nutmeg | 1 scotch bonnet pepper | 5 -10 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees centigrade. Cut the pumpkin in half. Using your hands, scoop out and discard the inside of the flesh leaving about 100g of flesh in the pumpkin. Place the pumpkin flesh in a large, non stick roasting tin and cut a long vforate down the centre. Turn the flesh about half way through to ensure that the flesh is coated evenly. Using a sharp knife, gently pound the flesh until it is shaped into large marble sized balls about 1/2 inch in diameter. Place the ricotta, sugar, nutmeg and chilli in a bowl and mix with a fork until creamy and well combined. Spread mixture evenly over the pumpkin, then place the pan into the oven and cook for 1 hour. Remove the borromte from the oven and pour over the cream. Allow to stand before serving.

title: Hard-Boiled Eggs & Vanilla Custard Sundaes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vanilla ice cream, melted ( or 1 cup cream ) | 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped fine
instructions: Mix together in a bowl the icing ingredients. Place chopped eggs in a bowl. Drizzle half the icing onto the egg whites, allowing the excess to run down the sides of the bowl.

Random Ingredients: paprika,garam masala,pickling spice,thyme sprig,orange juice concentrate,feta cheese
title: Souvlaki
ingredients: 3/4 cup orange juice concentrate | 1 1/4 cups feta cheese | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon chopped thyme sprig | 1 dash pickling spice
instructions: Pour orange juice in large resealable bag. Add feta and next four ingredients.

title: Sirloin Tips in Caramelised Peppers
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin tip roast, trimmed of fat | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 6 heads garlic
instructions: Prepare your peppers by peeling off a 1 inch slice from top of the head of garlic, keeping the head intact. Using the whole head of garlic, remove the garlic bulb, keeping the head on the cloves. Rinse the head of garlic with cool water and place in a pan with the head of garlic that has been rinsed and dried and add 2 tablespoons of cold water, placing the larger slice of garlic into the water for extra flavor. Place over low heat and cook slowly until the garlic turns a very light caramel brown when pierced with a fork, which will take about 1 1/2 hours. Pour off excess water into a large saucepan and add a bit more water if necessary. Place roast in the caramelized pan in a single layer, with the caramelized garlic. Add a pinch of cayenne pepper. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and allow to simmer for 3 1/2 to 4 hours stirring occasionally. It should be tender and no visible liquid. Remove the roast from the pan, and place it in a shallow dish that will hold it in a single layer, and cover to prevent drying out, refrigerate for 24 hours. Place the roast into a shallow, non aluminum roasting pan and set aside while preparing the pepper sauce. Reserve marinade mixture, and wipe off any papery residue with clean, dry paper towels. Rub roast with a very small amount of the reserved marinade. Preheat oven to 300°f place the roasting pan into the center of your oven. Place roast into oven and bake for approximately 2 hours, or until the internal temperature of the beef reaches 140 and becomes 155f for medium rare. Do not overbake. If you like your roast more cooked, after 2 hours of cooking, remove the roast to a cutting board and remove the garlic head from the bulb. Remove the cloves of garlic and discard. Place the roast on a serving platter, cover with aluminum foil, and refrigerate until cool to the touch. Slice into large thin slices against the grain. Serve the pepper sauce with the meat. Be careful, the pepper sauce can be eaten hot or cold. The pepper can also be heated under a broiler and served as a condiment, but is equally good at room temperature. Note, cooking time reflects time for roast.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,green olive,sherry,cooking oil,english cucumber
title: Creamy Israeli Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup sherry | 1 english cucumber, unpeeled, chopped | 1/2 cup sliced green olives
instructions: Heat the oil with the soup in a skillet over medium heat, stirring to combine. Add the sherry to the soup while stirring. Add the cucumber and olives. Pour soup mixture into a bowl.

title: Simple, Delicious Pork Carnitas or Chosletas - Crockpot
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, carnitas preferred | 3 cups rice wine vinegar | 3/4 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Put all ingredients in crockpot and stir well. Cook on high for 6 - 7 hours or low for 8 - 9 hours. Serve as is, or you can leave as is as is or shred as well. To freeze for later use, freeze in a freezer bag. To serve as is, defrost completely before proceeding in directions.

title: Cran Coupe Toast
ingredients: 1 -6 slice whole wheat bread ( or other bread ) | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 4 slices canadian bacon, sliced | strawberry ( optional )
instructions: Lay bread on counter and lightly butter each slice. Spread with whipping cream. Top with bacon, strawberries. You can garnish with fresh or outside berries if desired.

Random Ingredients: red onion,lettuce,cardamom pod,lime juice zest,ricotta cheese
title: Spicy Ricotta Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 medium red onion, finely chopped | 1 large lime, juice and zest of | 2 cardamom pods, crushed | lettuce
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and stir gently to blend. Serve at room temperature with lots of lettuce.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,green bell pepper,baking chocolate,italian salad dressing,pea,penne pasta,pork chop,pepper flake
title: Pork Pasta With Asparagus & Peas
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta | 1 lb fresh asparagus or 1 lb green asparagus, cut on the diagonal into 1-inch pieces | 2 green bell peppers, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork chops, cut in strips | 1/2 cup fat-free italian salad dressing ( see directions ) | 2 tablespoons hot pepper flakes | 1 ounce baking chocolate, semisweet, chopped ( or 1 1/4 cups bittersweet chocolate chips ) | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Cook pasta for 10 minutes, and drain. Rinse under cold water, drain. Meanwhile, steam asparagus until just tender crisp, 3 to 6 minutes. Drain, and save cooking water. In a large bowl, combine asparagus, peppers and pork. Add reserved cooking water, salad dressing and pepper flakes, and mix lightly. Add cooked pasta, chocolate and mix well. Serve with grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,danish blue cheese,lamb,apple butter,teriyaki sauce,ginger garlic paste,duck breast half
title: Chicken Cordon Bleu II
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless pork loin, cut into bite size chunks | 2 slices fresh ginger-garlic paste, divided | 1 pound boneless lamb breast halves, cut into bite size chunks | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 1 pound danish blue cheese, crumbled | 1 package apple butter | 2 tablespoons prepared teriyaki sauce
instructions: Season pork with 1 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt and 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper. Coat with half of the ginger garlic paste. In a separate large bowl, toss the pork together with the remaining ginger garlic paste, lamb, and 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce.

title: Beer Glögi
ingredients: 2 lbs dark brown sugar ( packed ) | 1/2 cup nam pla ( fish sauce, sold in packages at most asian markets ) | 1 can premium beer, such as guinness
instructions: Place sugar and nam pla in a heavy 3 - 4 qt iron skillet. Drizzle 1/2 cup beer into skillet. When sugar is melted, raise heat to high and boil vigorously until you have a syrup. Remove from heat. Pour syrup into a 3 - 4 qt heavy duty plastic bag. Add one third of the beer to the warm sugar syrup. Return bag to skillet and gently stir in 1/2 cup beer to melt and caramelize sugar. Cool bag in syrup until mixture is just warm, then refrigerate overnight. Remove bag from mixture and cool.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,pecan,purpose dinner crepe batter,tabasco sauce
title: French Baked Eggs
ingredients: 20 crepes or 20 egg crepes ( homemade or commercial ) | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons dry marsala wine | tabasco sauce | your favorite marinade
instructions: Place crepes on a plate and lightly brush with a little hot marinade. Spread one side of each crepe with the marsala, sprinkle top with some pecan nut slices or any other topping if desired. Place in a heated oven and bake for five minutes or until hot and browned. Slice and serve while warm.

title: Hamburger Helene
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 3/4 cup water
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve over hamburger buns. May be sprinkled with powdered sugar.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,vegetable,red chili powder,cayenne pepper,caraway seed
title: Hot Mexican Potatoes and Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds | 16 small russet potatoes, cut in halves or 1 large yukon gold potato, cut in half | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon red chili powder ( to taste )
instructions: In a large frying pan or skillet add the oil, then the caraway seeds. Let it fry on medium heat for a few seconds, or a few seconds until the sizzles and emits a popping crack and you know you are about to roast these. Immediately add the potato halves, then the cayenne pepper, and mix together until all are coated. Cover and remove from heat. Allow for 5 minutes. You want the potato to marinade for a few minutes. Enjoy you can add the chile powder, or use the asian chili oil to make a chili sauce. It's up to your taste.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Mango & Mango
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs brussels sprouts | 3/4 cup mango, peeled, seeded & chopped
instructions: Steam sprouts & set aside until crisp tender, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, toss with mango & serve.

title: Duck Breasts in Tomato-Pour-Yolk Simmered With a Hint of Turmeric
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons unsalted chicken broth | 10 green cardamom pods, lightly smashed in a mortar | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon zest ( with peeler ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 5 cups chicken broth | 1 1/2 lbs duck breasts, fat trimmed and cut crosswise into 2-inch-long-wide strips | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarse sea salt
instructions: Combine 2 1/2 tablespoons of the broth with the cardamom pods, 1 teaspoon of the zest, and the turmeric in a large, heavy skillet. Place over moderate heat and cook, stirring with a wooden spoon, until the broth bubbles and turns a rich, reddish color, about 5 minutes. Add the duck and a few generous tablespoons of hot broth and simmer over moderate heat until the duck is just cooked through, about 5 minutes. Add the remaining broth and transfer to a food mill fitted with a steel blade. Return the mixture to the skillet and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Season with salt. Put the duck breasts in a shallow bowl and pour the remaining tomato onion broth over. Let stand 5 minutes. Drain, pat dry, and coarsely chop. Spoon the meat from the pan and place on a serving platter. Spoon some of the tomato onion broth over. Makes at least 4 servings.

title: The Great Noodles

instructions: In a small bowl stir together the mayonnaise, chives and parmigianoreese. Drain the noodles and add to the bowl with the mayo mixture. Stir to combine. Serve immediately.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the puff pastry on the prepared baking sheet. Whisk together the honey, soy sauce, and hazelnuts in a small bowl. Brush the pastry with the honey mixture, then spread the hazelnuts on the pastry. title: Cheesy Pear Salad

instructions: Cut pears in half and remove core. Cut into 1/2 inch thick slices. Toss pears in remaining ingredients. Serve.

title: Australian Lamb Exotic

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large container and mix thoroughly with hands. Serve in a shallow ceramic dish filled with marinade. Serve with bread and steamed vegetables.

instructions: Heat your chunky fire roasted diced tomatoes, dark rum and basil leaves in a saucepan over medium heat until simmering.

ingredients: 8 ounces fry chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces | 4 ounces lima beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 egg yolk, beaten | 1/3 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in frying pan and fry chicken until light brown, about 3 - 5 mins each side. Remove chicken from pan. Drain any excess oil. Cook for a further 2 mins, then remove from heat. Serve hot, sprinkled with extra chopped parsley.

title: Green Bean Mash

instructions: Peel the green beans and cut into half inch lengths, or leave whole if necessary. Boil the green beans in a large pan with a splash of water for 5 - 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain. In a small bowl, cream the golden syrup and mix well. Place the green beans in the pan with the golden syrup and toss over a low heat until coated. Serve at once.

title: Nectarine Cordial

instructions: Cut nectarines crosswise into halves lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. In a bowl, mix confectioners' sugar with a fork.
