title: Hungarian Pastry With Poppy Seed Filling and Olives
ingredients: 2 cans pastry shells ( pillsbury crescent dough or ready made ) | 1 package kalamata olives | 1/4 cup poppy seed ( or ground pumpernickel ) | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika | 2 cans rotini pasta | 6 large lime wedges | 3/4 cup kefalotiri or 3/4 cup kalamata olive
instructions: In a large bowl, combine olives, poppy seeds, and 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika. Add pasta, and mix well. Remove one package of the eckes. Use another package of eckes, and press the dough so that it is flat, about 1/4 thick. Repeat process with the two cans of eckes, pressing each one to form a 1 in. Pieces. Place in a large ziplock bag with olive oil. Remove one of the limes, cut 2 into wedges, and squeeze the other half into the bag. Squeeze the other one into the pan. Repeat process with the rest of the eckes. Put olive oil into a 13 x9 baking dish or pan. Turn oven on to 400°f. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown all over. Remove from oven and let cool for about five minutes. Carefully remove pie crust from the oven. Use a 9 x 13 in or 13x9 on the bottom of the dish and let the pastries cool for a few minutes, then remove carefully from the pan. Cut in half and fill each half. To serve, cut each half diagonally so the pies have a diamond pattern and a lemon or orange shape.

title: Jamaican Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 2 lbs eggplants | 3/4 cup pomegranate juice | 2 teaspoons jamaican jerk spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees. Place eggplants and pomegranate juice in an oven safe roasting pan. Sprinkle with jerk seasoning and bake until eggplants are soft and most of the liquid in the pan has been reduced to almost nothing, about about 3 hours. Cut into cubes and stir with hands to combine.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,cream mushroom soup,mint leaf,tomato juice,lime gelatin
title: Spicy Tomato & Lime Dressing
ingredients: 1 packet lime gelatin | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can tomato juice | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup whole leaves mint leaves
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend till well mixed & smooth. Chill before serving.

title: Spanish-Canadian Rack of Pork Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 spanish onion, minced | 14 -16 ounces stew meatballs | 1/2 teaspoon grand marnier | 12 ounces cooked ham, chopped | 12 ounces pork fillets, boneless, skinless, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 8 -10 canned medium squash, drained | cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice the onion in half and place on a rimmed baking sheet or shallow glass baking dish. Sprinkle the onion with salt. Bake for about 50 - 55 minutes, or until the onion is tender and the edges are nicely browned. Put half of the minced onion back in the pan. Slice a piece of ham and cut into small cubes. Arrange the meatballs on top of the onion, breaking them up. Sprinkle the grand marnier all over the meatballs. Place the remaining minced onions on top of the ham and meatballs. Sprinkle the ham with the grand marnier. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until heated through. Turn in the chopped cilantro. Serve with lots of crusty bread.

title: Spanish Lentil Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces green lentils, rinsed and picked over ( about 8 ounces ) | 1/4 cup finely diced spanish onion | 1/4 cup jicama, diced | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs, coarsely chopped ( such as flat-leaf parsley ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Cook lentils and onion in boiling water 1 minute, then drain. Add remaining ingredients and toss to combine.

title: Vegetable Au Gratin
ingredients: 2 cups assorted fresh vegetables, such as carrots, zucchini, onions, mushrooms, and green bell peppers | 1 1/4 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup flour | 2 cans plum tomatoes, drained with juice | 8 slices fresh zucchini ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Butter a 13x9 inch casserole dish. Place vegetable and cream in a large bowl. Sprinkle half of flour over the vegetables. Stir in the tomatoes and zucchini, if using. Turn mixture into prepared dish and cover tightly with foil. Bake 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, remove the foil and bake 35 minutes more. Sprinkle with remaining flour and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Seared Mushrooms with Mexican Chili Powder
ingredients: 2 whole fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon mexican chili powder
instructions: Wash the mushrooms.

title: Pork and Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 medium red onion, cut into thin wedges | 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets | 3 large fresh hash brown potatoes, thinly sliced crosswise | 1 pint chilled champagne | 1 biscuit, split in half ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line 2 1/2 to 3 quart casserole dish with parchment paper. Place pork in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until brown and juices begin to caramelize, about 5 minutes. Transfer pork to a plate. Add onion to the pan and cover.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,chive,pandan leaf,fish sauce,white cabbage,grain rice
title: Orange and Chive Stuffed Cabbage
ingredients: 3 medium heads white cabbage | 2 -3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped | 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 1/4 cup long grain rice | 12 small fresh pandan leaves
instructions: Shred cabbage finely and mix with fish sauce, chives and marmalade. Place in a mixing bowl, cover with plastic wrap and leave to marinate in the refrigerator for 15 minutes. Remove from refrigerator and squeeze out excess liquid. Fill casserole dish with cabbage mixture and place pandan leaves on top. Place rice in a microwave safe bowl and heat in the microwave on high 5 minutes until it steams. Pour rice over cabbage and sprinkle with orange juice. Cover and cook on high for 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Spicy Spanish Tapas

instructions: Place all ingredients in a large, shallow dish. Cover and marinate for 10 mins, turning occasionally. Drain all ingredients when cold. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,egg,water,yellow mustard,chinese mushroom,red bell pepper,cumin powder,red chili pepper
title: Chuanones (Chinese Mushroom Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 20 chinese mushrooms, sliced thin | 1 large egg, beaten | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup water, cold | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 3/4 teaspoon yellow mustard | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh red chili pepper ( i used a hot red pepper )
instructions: In a mixing bowl stir together the egg and next 4 ingredients with a whisk. Add mushrooms. Mix together well. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving. Makes 1 cup serving. Enjoy.

title: Swiss Mushroom and Cheese Side
ingredients: 12 ounces swiss cheese, diced | 4 mushrooms, thinly sliced | 8 ounces button mushrooms | 8 ladyfingers, split | 4 tablespoons horseradish, fresh grated | butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Mix together cheese and sliced mushrooms on a nonstick baking sheet or a cookie sheet. Sprinkle with fresh grated horseradish and bake at 200 degrees for 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted and to your liking.

title: Olive Oil and Spice Brown Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice flour | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Put the flour in a medium sized plastic bowl. Mix in the anise seeds and add the water slowly, with your hands, until all flour is mixed inches put this mixture into a plastic covered bowl and allow batter to rest at room temperature until dough begins to set. Form into a ball and knead it by hand to form a medium soft ball. Cover and let it rest in the refrigerator for approximately 1 - 2 hours. Preheat your oven to 350 fahrenheit. Line a baking tray with a large dish towel and lightly oil it. Take your brown rice flour and sprinkle the mixture into a resealable gallon sized plastic bag or bowl, make a well in the center and squeeze the air out of the bag with your fingers. Pour the batter into the well. Shake the flour around the contents of the bowl until all of the dry flour is used up. If the dough is extremely dry, put the mixture back into the refrigerator for 20 - 25 - 60 minutes. Using your hands shape it into a ball using your hands. If it appears dry, add more water slowly. If not proceed to stretch it out. It will be too sticky and difficult to roll out when finished. When it has been stretched to approximately 1/4 inch, you will notice that it is starting to collapse and the air bubble. This is normal. When it has reached the right consistency and shape then remove from the bowl. Roll out the dough until all of it is rolled into a rectangle on your baking tray with your hands, make a few small indentations in the dough with your fingers and top it with a tablespoon of olive oil. Bake the bread on the middle shelf of the preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes. Remove it from the oven and brush it with some olive oil. Turn it over so it cooks on the other side. Allow to cool on the tray. Store in airtight containers for up to 2 weeks, after which you may store in the freezer. The oil will last for months.

Random Ingredients: orange,cabbage,chicken thigh,rhubarb,beef stew meat,brown sugar,cheese,accent seasoning
title: Rhubarb and Beef Stew

instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Combine the chicken, brown sugar, and accent seasoning in a large bowl. Set aside. Combine the meat and rhubarb in a roasting pan. Remove meat from pan and allow to cool to room temperature before cutting into 1 1/2 inch pieces.

title: Oma's Tomatillo Salsa Verde
ingredients: 12 tomatillos, husked and rinsed | 1/2 cup dry sherry
instructions: Pare off husk from the tomatillos. Place each tomatillo in a blender or food processor. Blend the tomatillos and sherry until smooth.

title: Nadia's Winter Vegetable Loaf
ingredients: 400 g turnips ( peeled, grated ) | 250 g split cranberries ( or raisins ) | 150 g dried cranberries ( or seedless raisins ) | 200 ml nonfat milk ( soy or almond ) | 1/8 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Soak the dried fruits in cold water over night so that they are very soft. Do not skip this step. Drain and discard the water, and place the drained fruit in a large bowl. Turn out of the loaf pan onto a warmed baking tray, and cool thoroughly. Cover with plastic wrap and store at room temperature until required.

instructions: Combine the coconut milk, beef bouillon granules, rice, and chile in a large pot over medium low heat.

instructions: Place the first 3 ingredients in a saucepan to bring to a simmer. Remove from the heat and whisk until dissolved. instructions: Place rutabaga cubes, pistachios, ginger, miso paste, cajun seasoning, chives, and icing sugar in a bowl.

title: Grilled Salmon With Sherry and Sherry
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh smoked salmon, cut into 4 equal portions | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( dry sherry )
instructions: Combine the sherry and a portion of the smoked salmon on a platter. Place another spoonful of sherry on top, and roll and tuck the salmon onto the platter, pressing the sherry into the flesh. Marinate the salmon, chilled, covered with plastic wrap, for 2 hours. Cook the salmon on the grill over moderately high heat, brushing with remaining sherry, until the flesh of the flesh is crisp and the salmon is cooked through. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,plain yogurt,balsamic vinegar,chunky salsa,half,bean sprout
title: Mexican Layered Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup ( or plain ) | 1 cup creamy plain yogurt, plain | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa ( jarred or hot ) | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1 can baked beans sprouts ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups 2 % fat sour cream ( may add some fat-free cream cheese to dip, if desired ) or 1 1/2 cups 2 % low-fat milk ( may add some fat-free cream cheese to dip, if desired )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with tortilla chips or your favorite veggies.

title: Crock Pot  Bush Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 lb liver, sliced thin strips | 1 large tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crock pot and cook on low 8 - 10 hours.

title: Saskatchewan Snow Peas (Saskans)
ingredients: 15 snow peas, trimmed and cut in half lengthwise | 10 ounces feta cheese, cubed
instructions: Arrange snow peas in steaming basket or on wire rack in roaster. Sprinkle with salt and cook in a 450 degree f for 12 minutes or until tender. Top with cheese and toss.

title: Spaghetti Squash Salad from Scratch
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti squash, cut in 3-inch pieces | 1 small shallot, minced | 2 tablespoons juice from canned jalapeno peppers or 2 tablespoons juice from canned jalapeno slices, for garnish
instructions: Place vegetable shredder on cutting board and cut along center using sharp knife. Rinse and pat dry. Bend end end like a swiss roll and then slice about 1/3 inch thick. Sprinkle cut surface generously with salt. In medium nonstick skillet, cook squash over medium high heat until soft and collapsed. Spread out in single layer on cookie sheet. Let cool slightly. Using electric mixer, beat egg white and juice in small bowl until lemon colored. Toss with squash. Garnish with jalapeños.

title: Onion Confit
ingredients: 1 medium spanish sweet onion | icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar )
instructions: Wash and peel onion. Cut into small thin rings. Sprinkle the onion with icing sugar. Store in fridge. Note, if the confit is to be eaten with meat or seafood, make sure that it can be kept in a cool place. Note, these vary in size so follow the directions below if desired.

Random Ingredients: frito corn chip,cream chicken soup,kidney bean,peach
title: Spicy Nachos
ingredients: 1 can baked beans or 1 can kidney beans | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2/3 cup crushed frito corn chips | 4 -6 diced peaches ( optional ) | your favorite toppings ( optional )
instructions: Drain everything but peach slices. Put in casserole dish. If desired sprinkle cheese on top for garnish. Bake, covered, in 300 degree oven for about 1 hour.

title: The Best Cherry Mice - Smoothie
ingredients: 250 ml cherry juice, chilled | 2 ripe kokos ( sweet potato or other orange sweet potato ) | 4 -5 good quality marshmallows | cayenne powder | pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Open the cherry juice and scoop out the seeds and juice from the kokos into the juice. Reserve half the juice, chop half the marshmallows, and add the juice and kokos to the cherry juice. Stir all ingredients to combine and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,corn syrup,apple,green pepper,chorizo sausage,kielbasa,pesto sauce,saffron
title: Kielbasa & Sausages in Tomato Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups tomato sauce | 1/4 cup corn syrup | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 2 links kielbasa, sliced | 8 ounces chorizo sausage, sliced | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 apple, chopped in chunks | 1/8 teaspoon saffron ( optional, optional )
instructions: Combine tomato sauce and corn syrup in saucepan, bring to boil.

title: Strawberry Pho
ingredients: 2 lbs skirt steaks | 1/2 cup nuoc nam ( vietnamese fish sauce ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon sriracha hot sauce | 2 packages frozen strawberries
instructions: Marinate meat with nuoc nam, salt, and hot sauce for 2 hours in the refrigerator. Bring to room temperature. Grill over hot coals or under broiler.

Random Ingredients: black tea,mint sprig,chicken breast half,turnip,filet beef
title: Chicken and Turnip Soup
ingredients: 2 turnips, peeled, cut into 3/4-inch dice | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons sliced fresh mint leaves | 4 cans black tea, chilled | 8 1-pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instructions: Place turnips into a saucepan, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until just tender, about 20 minutes. Transfer turnips to a food processor, and puree until smooth. Set aside. Place chicken breasts into a large pot, and heat to about 1/2 inch. Cook until just cooked through, about 7 minutes per side. An instant read thermometer plunged into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. Remove chicken from the pot, and set aside. Pour in tea to make tea a nice dipping consistency.

title: Mexican Green Kale
ingredients: 1 lb kale, about 3/4-inch head | 3 1/2 tablespoons flour | 4 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons arrowroot ( cornstarch ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin | 1/2 teaspoon instant minced garlic | 1/2 cup shredded romano cheese
instructions: Trim tough center ribs from kale and remove woody stalk. Remove tough stalks from leaves. Cut kale into 1/2 to 3/4 inch pieces. Place flour in a medium bowl, add bread crumbs and arrowroot.

title: Almond Danish Rolls
ingredients: 1 package almond milk containers | 1 egg roll wrap, thawed
instructions: Place thawed egg roll wraps in the freezer for about 15 minutes at least, until the dough is soft enough to roll. Heat milk to boiling in double boiler. Dip rolls in milk to cover the tops and bottoms, and then place them on cookie sheets that have been lightly sprinkled with confectioners' sugar. Place a boarder's knife blade under the danish roll to split the roll. The knife will split the roll quite deeply on every angle, but it should never aim at it. Cut a slit in the roll at 1/4 inch increments, and carefully slide the knife through it. These freeze well, making it easy to roll out.

title: Smokin' Hot Special
ingredients: 1 small french bread ( or italian bread ) or 1 small loaf ( or italian bread ) | 1/2 lb salami, cut into 1-inch squares | 1/2 lb salami, cut into 1-inch squares | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup chopped pine nuts ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons crumbly cracked black peppercorns | 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped
instructions: Slice bread into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange slices on ungreased baking sheet. Toast bread in 350ºf oven for 5 minutes or until toasted but not browned. Place in medium bowl. Arrange salami cubes on toast squares.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,thyme sprig,self raising flour
title: Easy Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | fresh thyme sprig, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, transfer to a shallow ovenproof dish, and bake in a moderate oven until the gravy is thick and bubbling. Serve with steamed or cooked steamed green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,self rising flour,beef chuck,chicken thigh,sauerkraut,rump steak,chilies
title: Dutch Goose Casserole
ingredients: 1 kg extra lean ground beef | 1 kg beef chuck, cut into 2 cm | 2 liters sauerkraut | 10 g self-rising flour | 2 large chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 2 large waxy potatoes, peeled and cut into 3cm cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°c and grease an ovenproof dish. Place your ground beef, chuck and sauerkraut in a large bowl and add the flour to bind the. Shake the bowl to mix the beef, then place in the oven and bake for 2 hours stirring every 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ice water,lukewarm water,salt pepper,green bell pepper,orange peel,red chili pepper flake
title: Lebanese Pepper Halva
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lime peel, finely shredded | 3 cups ice water, divided | 1 cup lukewarm water | 1 orange peel, chopped fine | 1 red chili pepper flakes, finely chopped | salt and pepper
instructions: Combine lime peel, 3 cups ice and 4 cups water in a blender. Cover and blend 2 minutes at high speed or 2 more minutes on high speed. Blend again for 30 seconds, then repeat twice. Strain through a fine mesh sieve. Discard the seeds. Add remaining 1/2 cup ice and orange peel to blender. Cover and blend 1 minute at high speed. Strain through sieve into a bowl and rinse in cold water to remove orange peel. Chop fine. Add chili flakes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve with drinks.

title: Chilie's Crock Pot Lamb Fajitas
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs lamb | 2 packages cream cheese, soften at room temp | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 2 -3 tablespoons dried epazote ( to taste )
instructions: Cut the lamb in 1 1/2 cubes. Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl. Pour over lamb cubes. Cover and refrigerate the lamb for at least one hour or over night. Place on crockpot. Cook on low in crockpot for at least 2 hours or until desired degree of doneness. You may uncover the lamb just to thicken the sauce. Remove lamb when its turned off and allow to stand covered a couple of minutes before slicing.

title: Sweet Couscous With Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped goat cheese ( i used a mild-fat type with no butter. ) | 1 teaspoon anise seed or 1 teaspoon ground anise | 1 2/3 cups couscous or 2 2/3 cups cooked regular couscous
instructions: Cook couscous per instructions on package, adding anise seed to water just enough to cover the bottom. Drain and discard anise seed. Crumble goat cheese using a fork, and add to prepared couscous or couscous. Stir. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Beans (Diabetic)
ingredients: 200 g red beans, organic | 2 teaspoons celery leaves | 4 teaspoons fresh celery leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Cut beans diagonally into 8 pieces and soak in water overnight. Drain and dry beans. Preheat oven to 200c or 360°f. Place the beans in a large oven proof casserole. Mix celery and 1 tsp celery leaves with the rest of the celery leaves, then sprinkle over the mixture. Cover and bake for about 1 hour.

title: Papaya Topping With Avocado(Antigua & Barbuda)
ingredients: 2 medium ripe papayas | 1 medium ripe avocado | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Peel and pit papayas, then cut into fourths. Cut avocado in half, remove pit, and remove peel. Cut papayas into fourths. Cut tops into fourths. Cut a crosswise slit in top of each papaya half, forming a small hole. Combine papaya and avocado. Place thyme sprigs on top of avocado and sprinkle each with a few drops of water. Spoon thawed whipped topping on top. Serve immediately.

title: Lite Honey Tomato Gravy for Pasta
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 4 cubes chicken bouillon
instructions: Mix the condensed tomato soup, honey, marjoram, garlic salt, and chicken bouillon in a bowl and stir well. Store in refrigerator.

title: Faux Tuna Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil | 3/4 cup cooked diced tuna steak
instructions: In medium bowl mix together all ingredients and chill for 20 minutes. Heat a grill pan or large fry pan over medium heat. Spoon tuna marinade into tortillas. Roll and use tooth picks to hold into burritos in a spiral.

title: Ham Terrine
ingredients: 2 lbs ham, cut into chunks | 1/8 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Butter a 12 cup terrine, or a 15 cup loaf pan with sides. Trim excess salt from ham. Coat bottom and sides completely in sugar. Place in a well buttered pan. Place pan in a cold oven and bake about 1 1/2 hours, or until set. If you like a darker terrine, you may line a large roaster with wax paper and set it aside for a few days to allow the juices to be reabsorbed off of the ham. Allow ham to come to room temperature, also, before cutting into squares. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: oriental flavor ramen noodle,ziti pasta,cayenne pepper
title: Ziabatta (French Dish Meal)
ingredients: 1 ziti pasta | 1 package oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles | 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ziti, and return to a boil. Cook the ziti uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 6 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Toss with noodles to coat.

title: Apple Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can baked beans | 6 apples, chopped
instructions: Bake apples in oven until the skin turns brown. Place apple, baked beans into food processor and process until almost smooth. Store in covered container. Serve with crackers.

title: Duck Tacos #R1
ingredients: 1 lb duck | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1/4 cup oatmeal
instructions: Cut the duck into bite size pieces, rinse, pat dry, and place in a zip top bag. Pour 1 jar picante sauce, thyme and olive oil into the bag with the duck at the time of serving. Seal and mix thoroughly. Place bag in refrigerator for approximately an hour. Shake to mix, remove to a medium size plate and serve.

title: Nate's Pecan Candy
ingredients: 250 g unsalted pecans, ground in a food processor | 250 g palm sugar, ground in a food processor
instructions: Put the ground pecans & sugar in a large mixing bowl & mix in the palm sugar until combined. Add the pecan mixture & mix again. Add more palm sugar if necessary to make it the right texture. Press into the sides of an 8 square cake tin lined with a silicone pad or lined with paper. Leave for 1 hour. Break off pieces of the tin & press down slightly, to make sure it is flat all around the outside. Cut into chunks with a knife & leave for a further few minutes to harden. When cool, store in an airtight container & refrigerate until firm.

title: Tropical Fruit Sausages
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 1/2 cup sultanas
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place bacon in an oven safe skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown, turning once. Drain on paper towels. Slice bacon crosswise into 1/4 inch slices.

title: Aunt Sharleen's Indian Beans
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, with liquid | 1 cup mango chutney | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Empty the beans with liquid, mango chutney and poultry seasoning into a sauce pan. Place the saffron in half a teaspoon of saffron. Dissolve the saffron in 2 -3 tablespoons of the bean cooking liquid. Pour into the sauce pan, and place on medium heat until it bubbly. Turn down the heat, and keep stirring while letting the beans simmer until it thickens. It should have a sauce like consistency. Serve warm.

title: Curried Spareribs
ingredients: 1 lb shell-on spareribs | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 4 ounces marshmallows, grated
instructions: Heat a large skillet over moderate heat. Add the spareribs and curry powder and saute 4 minutes, or until the spareribs are browned and cooked through. Remove from heat. Cover the skillet and set aside. Add the vinegar and marshmallows to the skillet and stir fry over moderate heat 2 minutes or until marshmallows are melted. Cool. Spoon half the curry onto each of 4 plates.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,white miso,mexican oregano,garlic paste,topping,spring onion,currant
title: Mexican Sausage With Seasonal Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausage, casings removed ( turkey sausage can be used for less spice, if desired ) | 3 tablespoons dried mexican oregano, divided | 2 tablespoons garlic paste, divided | 1 cup dry white miso or 1 cup white balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mexican oregano | 1 package frozen top round frozen whipped topping | 1/2 cup dried currants, finely chopped or 1/2 cup raisins | 2 finely chopped spring onions, greens only
instructions: In a dutch oven, brown and crumble the italian sausage over medium high heat, breaking up the chunks with a spoon. After about 5 - 7 minutes, stir in 1 teaspoon of oregano and 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic paste and saute 3 - 4 minutes more. Remove sausage with a slotted spoon and set aside. Stir miso, 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano, 1/2 teaspoon garlic paste, and 1/2 teaspoon of oregano into sausage fat and simmer, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes. Stir in miso mixture and 1/2 teaspoon oregano and simmer, stirring often, for 2 - 3 minutes, then remove from heat. Spoon hot sausage mixture into 4 small ramekins, dividing evenly. Top each with 2 tblsps dried dried oregano and 1/4 cup fresh mixed greens. Bake in lower 1/3 of a 350 degree oven. For 20 - 25 minutes, or until hot and bubbly around the edges. Allow to cool a few minutes before removing from ramekins with a spatula and serving. Makes 3 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,french bread,spicy brown mustard,rice wine,mango chutney
title: Indian Bruschetta Bread Bowl
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared spicy brown mustard | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon sweet mango chutney ( major grey is good for this ) | 1 loaf french bread | 1/4 cup prepared mango chutney ( major grey is good )
instructions: Preheat broiler or griddle. In a bowl combine mustard, yogurt, rice wine, mango chutney and mustard mixture. Cut bread into half diagonally and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with a mixture of both glaze incredients. Place bread on the baking sheet and broil for four to five minutes, until toasted. Turn and broil for 4 to 5 minutes longer, until crispy and golden. Transfer to a serving plate and top with sauce.

title: Nutshell Firecracker Barrel Furniture Polish
ingredients: 20 screwpine leaves | 10 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 -2 hot pepper sauce ( kali oelek )
instructions: Wash screwpine thoroughly with a good tap to remove sand and grit. Place one piece of twine on the work space facing you with the point of your pointer finger in the front direction at the head of the twine so as to make a cone. Place a small piece of plastic wrap directly on the twine and use the twine to smooth it toward you on the work space, working in your fingers if necessary, to cover all of the twine. Fill up the cone with water and fold it over into a tight spiral. Repeat with remaining components until all of your wood pile has been used. To vacuum seal your bottles, you need to tighten it slightly. If your vacuum is not filled up, tighten the plastic wrap tighter, and refrigerate it until the bottle can be handled. You can also tighten the bottle for use later, just as airtight if necessary. Apply kali oelek evenly into the brine. It helps to coat both sides of the bottles. Allow brine to reach a temperature of 310 degrees f for approximately 30 minutes so as to harden the plastic once it gets to the correct temperature. The wooden pickle can also be used as the base for meat, fish, seafood, poultry, etc. I find that vacuum sealer works best when refrigerated for use within 2 days.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,paneer,meat stock,lime juice,asafoetida powder,celery salt,beef chuck
title: Beef and Bacon Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup cubed paneer | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 lbs meat, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb thinly sliced beef chuck | 3 tablespoons meat stock
instructions: Combine paneer, lime juice and celery salt in small bowl. Sprinkle over meat.

title: Spaghetti With Sage
ingredients: 2 lbs short thin spaghetti | 1/2 cup chopped fresh sage leaves, leaves
instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to the package directions. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the sage and sage leaves, toss and sprinkle with salt. Add the pasta and toss. Transfer to a serving platter and serve.

title: Homemade Molasses
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh tomato juice or 12 ounces canned tomato juice | 3 ounces molasses ( not molasses )
instructions: Drain tomato juice and put into a glass or crock. Add molasses. Add 2 - 4 cups water to the molasses. Serve warm over ice.

title: Spicy Roast Potatoes (South Africa)
ingredients: 1 lb potato | 1/2 teaspoon hot red chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Peel potatoes, if you wish, and cut into 5 to 6 chunks. Arrange potatoes in two roasting pans. Sprinkle with hot red chili oil. Place in oven and roast for 35 to 45 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,mexican cheese,breadcrumb,hard egg,soy sauce,celery rib,kosher salt
title: Spanish "egg" (No Fuss) Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lbs ground round | 1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 lbs mexican blend cheese ( can put a mixture of mexican blend and cheddar ) | 4 eggs | 4 -6 celery ribs, sliced | 2 ounces romano cheese, grated ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a non stick baking sheet with parchment paper, and combine the ground round, bread crumbs, and cheese. Beat the eggs and lightly. Add the celery, soy sauce, and soy sauce to the meats and stir to combine. Shape the mixture into balls and place on baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and place on a rack to cool thoroughly. I prefer to cool them in a plastic ziplock bag to prevent them from breaking. If you've got enough air to make the meatballs from this, you can skip this step. Store in air tight container. They will keep up to one month.

title: Homemade  Mexican Sour Consommé!
ingredients: 1 cup consomme | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/2 tablespoon oregano leaves, dried | 1/4 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon or 1/8 teaspoon vegetable bouillon
instructions: Combine everything but the consomme. You can use the broth, but i prefer to freeze this for up to 3 months. I make this with frozen corn.

Random Ingredients: jumbo pasta shell,mirin,salt,orange peel,galangal root,coriander powder,dill,dream dessert topping mix
title: Thai Spiced Shellfish With Dilled Green Sauce
ingredients: 250 g jumbo ready to eat pasta shells | 200 g frozen dream dessert topping mix | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 teaspoon dill, powder | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely chopped | 1/3 teaspoon salt
instructions: First drain water in microwave for approximately 20 sec on high, then add your dreamfields and re put. Microwave on high for approximately 15 min or until it starts to boil and becomes translucent. Once it is translucent and the dreamfields are well cooked remove from microwave and place in a glass bowl and microwave for approximately 20 min until the dreamfields absorb the water. In the meantime make the sauce by mixing the ingredients and chill for half an hour. Take a glass bowl and microwave your dreamfields for approximately 20 min on high if no water is absorbed but at least it is still a little moist. It should take no more than 20 min and the microwave should have absorbed the water. Remove from microwave and set aside, covered in plastic wrap. In a microwave safe bowl add the dreamfields, cover with plastic wrap, microwave on high for 1 minute. Uncover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 1 minute, again open faced, remove from microwave and mix well. Transfer to fridge and allow to sit for at least 20 minute. Slice and serve chilled.

ingredients:

 melitzanes | 2 medium eggplants | 4 teaspoons cornflour

Random Ingredients: olive oil,vinegar,shrimp,catsup,tomato green chilies,saffron,chicken thigh,beef stock
title: Spanish Shrimp and Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into chunks or 2 lbs chicken breasts | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 pinch saffron | 1 cup beef stock or 1 cup chicken stock | 1 cup catsup | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 2 3 lbs shrimp or 2 lbs red snapper, cut into 8 pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees fahrenheit. Rub oil into the chicken and fry it in the frypan. Add saffron, beef stock, catsup, vinegar and mix well. Add shrimp pieces and cook over high heat about 5 minutes. Transfer the shrimp & chicken to a baking dish, sprinkle with powdered salt. Cook for about ½ hour or until the shrimp are pink, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,caster sugar,lima bean,worcestershire sauce,pineapple,rigatoni pasta,swiss cheese,yellow pea
title: Spicy Ham and Noodle Bake
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces rotini pasta | 8 ounces swiss cheese or 8 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 8 ounces kielbasa, halved | 1/2 cup cooked lima beans, drained | 6 ounces canned pineapple, drained chopped | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 tablespoons yellow peas ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta as per instructions on packet and drain. Spray non stick frypan lightly with cooking oil cooking spray. Over med high heat add sausage and kielbasa. Cook for 10 minutes, or until sausage meat is browned and kielbasa is cooked. Remove from heat and stir in lima beans, pineapple, worcestershire sauce and sugar. Spoon meat into a casserole dish or baking dish and top with pasta and sauce. Cover and cook in a moderate oven for 25 to 30 mins until pasta is creamy. Serve with salad greens and chopped fresh tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,chicken soup base,chive,hot green chili pepper,creole seasoning
title: Sour Cream Sauce for Steak and Shrimp
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup light cream | 1 teaspoon chicken soup base | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1 -2 tablespoon creole seasoning | 2 -3 jalapenos or 2 -3 hot green chili peppers, seeded and finely sliced
instructions: Combine sour cream and chicken soup base in a small bowl. Place all ingredients in a large heavy saucepan or skillet over medium heat. If you are using the peppers add now, stirring as needed. Bring to a slow boil. Stir sauce to blend. Remove from heat.

title: Beer Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes | 1 lb yellow pepper | 8 ounces chili paste | 2 cups of fresh brewed beer | 1 cup of fresh shredded sage | 1/2 cup dried currant
instructions: Peel potatoes, cut up coarsely and boil until tender. Cut up chilie pepper and potatoes into chunks and toss with chili paste in the pot. Heat beer in a small saucepan and stir in the sage and currants. Add the potatoes.

title: Chipotle Chipotle Glaze for Beef or Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 teaspoon unrefined light corn syrup or 1 teaspoon pure corn syrup | 1 tablespoon pure chipotle chile in adobo | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon pure chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan and warm to near boiling point. Do not boil or boil. Dip meat into glaze. Grill covered grill for 1 minute to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,peanut butter,banana,beef brisket,wheat flour,pumpkin,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Peppered Beef and Bananas
ingredients: 1 medium sweet pumpkin | 1/4 cup unsweetened soy peanut butter | 2 teaspoons wheat flour or 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 beef brisket, fat trimmed | 8 large firm bananas, cut in half crosswise, then crosswise in half across grain | 2 teaspoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Peel 1/4 inch slices off of the bottom of the pumpkin and discard seeds and fibers. Cut pumpkin in half crosswise. Cut each half into 3 or 4 thin slices crosswise. Scoop out pulp, discarding seeds. Wash pumpkin well, pat dry. Stir peanut butter, 1 teaspoon soy flour or cornstarch, and almond extract until well blended and then spread on top of pumpkin slices. Lay brisket down on a rack in a roasting pan or on a wire rack in a preheated 425 degrees f oven. Roast, basting and turning until done for 8 to 10 hours, or cook in a covered roasting pan and bake at 425 degrees f for 45 minutes. Remove brisket from oven. Slice brisket crosswise into thin slices. Place sliced brisket and sliced bananas in serving dish. Combine remaining 1 teaspoon soy or cornstarch and parsley.

title: Pork Skewers
ingredients: 3 lbs pork chops, bone-in, skin removed | 1 jar of chunky salsa, undrained | 1/4 cup ketjap manis | pepper
instructions: Place the pork in an oversized freezer bag, add about half the jar of salsa and half the ketjap manis and shake until well combined. Place the pork pieces on skewers or metal skewers. Coat lightly with the other half of the jar of salsa. Sprinkle the pepper evenly over the pork. Wrap tightly with foil. Freeze for about 2 weeks then remove the meat, place on a metal serving platter or the end of an inverted platter with a bowl underneath for support. Set the meat onto a plate, cover with foil and continue freezing in the fridge for at least 1 week.

Random Ingredients: vodka,shrimp,chicken stock,saffron,sun tomato oil,pork sparerib,granny smith apple,mustard seed
title: Shrimp Stuffed Pork Spareribs and Apples
ingredients: 2 lbs pork spareribs, separated in halves | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup vodka | 8 ounces of chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 3 granny smith apples, unpeeled ( about 8 cups ) | 1/4 cup drained canned shrimp
instructions: Place a steamer insert into large saucepan and scatter some salt over the bottom. Arrange the spareribs over the salt. Pour enough hot water into the steamer just to cover the ribs, about 2 inches deep. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer until the ribs become tender, the meat is pulling away from the bones and the bones, about 1 1/2 hours. Drain the spareribs in a colander to remove some of the liquid. Return the liquid to the pan. In a small bowl, combine the stock, mustard seed, saffron and vodka. Stir this mixture into the shrimp and cook for a few minutes just to heat through. Spoon the sauce over the ribs and serve immediately.

title: Savory Scented Mashed Avocados
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine ( not tub or spread product ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons wheat bran ( see note above ) | 1 avocado ( see note above )
instructions: In a medium sized mixing bowl, mash the margarine together with the garam mass. Add the other dry ingredients as to your taste and mix until the flour reaches the consistency of cake batter. Fry the avocado in a small saute pan or in the same pan used to cook the avocado. Cut in slices from the avocado and serve hot with your preferred accompaniment.

title: Cashews Nut Cream
ingredients: 50 g cashew nuts | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Put the cashew nuts in a clean jar or food processor and grind to a fine paste. Add the vanilla essence, followed by the cashew paste. Sieve through a fine muslin bag or fine mesh sieve and store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: mint,heavy cream,black pepper,spray varnish,plain yogurt,orange peel,ginger root,pea
title: Pea-Garam Masala
ingredients: 2 cups fresh peas | 2 cartons plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 12 strips fresh orange peel | 2 tablespoons cracked black pepper | 4 sprigs fresh mint | 3 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 30 sprite varnishes, or as needed
instructions: Combine peas, yogurt, heavy cream, orange peel, black pepper, mint, ginger, and a splash of Sprite varnish in a blender. Cover, and blend until smooth, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Deep-Fried Shallots
ingredients: 5 pounds shallots, peeled
instructions: Cut off any green tops from the shallots stems and set aside. Cut off and discard the tips from the tips of the shallots. Set the shallots aside. Fill a deep skillet with water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Immediately immerse the shallots in the boiling water for a few seconds.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,dill,nori,sesame oil,parmesan cheese,flat leaf parsley,cherrystone clam
title: Dill Seafood-Linguine
ingredients: 300 g cherrystone or 300 g clam shells | 200 g lasagna noodles | 200 g flat leaf parsley | 2 -3 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh dill ( optional ) | 1 generous handful parmesan cheese or 1 generous romano cheese ( optional ) | 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Steam open the noodles about 20 minutes, depending on size of shellfish/lobster/crawfish. Place the shells in a large frying pan or flat grill. Add the sesame oil and chopped parsley until the parsley starts to turn pale white. Add shrimp, prawns, squid, prawns as well as any other seafood that will be turning dark. Stir shrimp/mussels or squid to mix, then cover and simmer over a low heat for about 3 - 5 minutes until the shells have detached. Remove the lid and turn up heat to medium. Add salt and pepper, to taste. When the shells turn a dark coral colour and the prawns have turned a darker pink, add to the mix. Add 1 - 2 handful of chopped fresh dill and stir. The dish should have the shrimp/mussels/scallop mixture, parsley/cheese on the table. To serve place a sheet of nori in front of you. Top with a mound of mussel/prawn mixture, close the edge to make a sandwich, then carefully start rolling up in the seaweed sheets, then the nori. Serve with plenty of black pepper. You can also eat with fresh bread, or serve with garlic bread as an appetizer.

Random Ingredients: rice krispies,turkey sausage,dark brown sugar,black peppercorn,lemon,udon noodle
title: Rice Krispies Dogs With Lemons, Shiitake and Meat
ingredients: 3/4 lb turkey sausage | 10 ounces rice krispies | 1/2 lemon, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon black peppercorns | 1 package udon noodles ( thin egg noodles )
instructions: Cook turkey sausage until done. Drain excess fat and crumble sausage into hot pan. Add 1/2 the krispies, then add the other 1/2 of the worcestershire sauce and the pepper. Stir and let simmer for 3 to 4 minutes. Set aside. Break udon noodles into small pieces and cook according to package directions. Add meat and 1/2 the sauce, toss well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,mustard powder,cream mushroom soup,coriander powder,red pepper,chicken stock
title: Quick & Easy Mexican Chicken

instructions: Place the soup, stock, pepper, mustard powder and coriander on low until warm. Stir in the guacamole and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,cream mushroom soup,corn kernel,red chili powder,mostaccioli pasta,poblano chile
title: Polish Girlfinger Pasta

instructions: Brown poblano chilies in nonstick skillet in olive oil for 5 minutes or until very tender, remove from skillet and chop. Add cream of mushroom soup to skillet.

title: Baked Penne With Tomato Lime Sauce
ingredients: 7 ounces tomato paste | 3 ounces white bread, cubed | 1 -2 lime | 16 ounces penne pasta
instructions: Combine tomato paste & cubed bread and squeeze a lime wedge all over the top. Spread 1 1/2 cups of the tomato lime sauce over the top, then add the penne pasta. Place a foil parcel on a flat shelf and bake at 350 degrees for about 1 hour 20 minutes or until the bread & pasta are tender. Garnish with a few coriander sprigs. Serve with a squeeze of lime juice.

Random Ingredients: bacon,beef stew meat,white flour,saffron strand,ancho chile powder,wheat flour,ketchup,pork loin roast
title: Smoor (Chinese Sweet Stew)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork loin roast | 2 slices bacon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces, brown on all sides | 6 tablespoons white flour, divided | 6 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 medium pieces of saffron strands | 1/2 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon ground szechuan peppercorn ( optional )
instructions: Cut up and brown meat in a skillet. Remove meat from skillet and set aside. In the same skillet cook bacon till done. Remove bacon from skillet and set aside and set aside. title: Easy Taco Dip

title: Italian Veggies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1 cup white mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup cucumber, chopped | 2 cups yellow squash, chopped | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 package snow peas
instructions: Saute the mushrooms for about 4 minutes. Remove from pan.

title: Panko-Style Italian Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 lb pork butt, cut into very thin 5- to 6-inch pieces | 3 limes, juice and zest of, grated | 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 bunch ladyfinger | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup red wine ( optional ) | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup panko-style breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup non-fat vanilla yogurt

instructions: Combine ingredients and use as a topping for tacos.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,self raising flour,plain nonfat yogurt,active yeast,double cream,lime juice,chipotle chile
title: Puy Penne
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 1/4 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 275 g self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon double cream ( plus extra to mix ) | 1 small red pepper, roughly chopped | 1 chipotle chile, chopped ( seeded if you don't want the heat ) | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 3 dried chipotle chilies, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Mix together the yeast, yogurt and flour. Turn into a large bowl with a piece of the chile and the lime juice. Turn mixture into a greased 20cm x 20cm cake tin. Make slight hollows on the top with the edge of your wooden spoon so it is slightly higher than the rim. Cover with a cloth and leave in a warm, draught free place for 40 minutes until it begins to bubble around the edge. Turn out on to a lightly floured board and then using a bench scraper, make a hole in the centre of the dough that will eventually open up. Shake the dough a few times until there is a hollow. Place the bread tin on your work surface and, with the back of a knife, puncture the bread in several places until the air bubbles have disappeared. Turn the tin out onto the flat board. Slice the dough into 12 equal pieces and divide the pieces, placing about 1 tablespoon of the red pepper, chopped chipotle leaves and a tablespoon of lime juice into a bowl. Place the dough in the bowl and add the remaining red pepper, chipotle, salt and lime juice, then work in the flour to combine thoroughly. Dough should be soft, but not sticky. Cover with a cloth and leave in a warm, draught free place for 20 - 30 minutes until it has doubled in size. Turn out onto a lightly floured board and knead lightly until smooth, then divide into six equal portions. Roll each piece out on a lightly floured surface into a circle, then cut into 3 - 4 rounds. Place onto a greased baking sheet. Cover the pans with a cloth and leave in a warm, draught free place to rise for 30 minutes or until doubled. Preheat the oven to 180°c. After 30 minutes, remove the bread tin with the risen dough, prick the top with a fork and bake for 35 - 40 minutes or until the crust is crisp and golden and the tops are crisp and dark. Allow to cool slightly before removing from the tin.

Random Ingredients: french bread,fennel bulb,puff pastry,dark soy sauce,fish sauce,pineapple juice
title: Thai Bread Puffs (Vegetarian Version)

instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Punch the fennel bulb and remove the tough outer layer, leaving it intact. Cut it into chunks of roughly the same size and length, discarding seeds. Cut 4 equal slices of pastry into 5cm pieces on the top of the fennel and bake on the centre shelf of the oven at 200c for 15 minutes. title: Swiss Berry Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked arborio rice | 1 3/4 cups light white sugar | 2/3 cup orange peel, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 bag frozen blueberries in light syrup | 1 cup arugula, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups small cucumbers, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. When done, cool and refrigerate until cool enough to handle. Place 1 2/3 cups of the cooked rice with sugar, orange peel, cumin, and 1/2 cup of the blueberries in a salad bowl, and toss to combine. Add remaining rice, 1 cup of blueberries, arugula, and cucumber. Serve chilled.

title: Bamboo Kebabs
ingredients: 3/4 cup coconut milk | 1/2 head romaine lettuce, cleaned and chopped ( about 1.5 cups ) | 20 bamboo skewers, soaked
instructions: Combine chicken stock, coconut milk, and lettuce in a small pot.

title: Tamarind Concentrate
ingredients: 3 cups unsweetened tamarind pulp | 2 tablespoons safflower oil | 1 teaspoon argan chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Break tamarind into pieces, and place in a jar with several layers of lid in single layers. Cover with a lid of water and freeze until solid. Drain juice from solids and place water in a small saucepan and add other ingredients. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mixture thickens and tamarind has begun to thicken again. Serve warm.

title: Tommy's Sourdough Gratinee Salad
ingredients: 200 g sourdough starter | 300 -400 g goat cheese | 2 -4 bunches cherry tomatoes, cut horizontally | 300 g gruyere cheese, cut into 2 cm pieces
instructions: Place starter in a large bowl, cover with a clean cloth and leave in a warm, draught free area for 1 hour 1st hour and the remaining dough. In a separate bowl, blend goat cheese with a fork. Cut cherry tomatoes in half and then cut into 3 - 4 crosshatch slices. To assemble the bruschetta, place a serving plate on the plate next to the bottom of the plate. Place the grated cheese in the center of the plate and add the tomatoes. Place a sprinkling of shredded gruyere cheese over each bowl of tomatoes, followed by a drizzle of sourdough starter. Repeat these layers until all the ingredients have been used, finishing with a drizzle of sourdough starter.

title: Giant Beef Burgers
ingredients: 2 thick hamburger meat ( can use top sirloin, or any other type of meat ) | 1 orange sweet bell pepper, sliced ( can use red, or green ) | 1/2 cup grated low cheddar cheese
instructions: If you don't do this in the ingredients listed, you will add another ingredient to your burgers, ie. 2 large sirloin steaks or 2 hamburger fillets, not a small beef burger. If using both types of meat, it is your choice if you prefer. If you want to use the sweet pepper as well, you can add a little finely chopped red pepper during this step. Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Spray with cooking spray. Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook for 6 - 8 minutes, or until the peppers are slightly softened, stirring occasionally. Remove the peppers and onion as they are done and set aside. Place a separate nonstick skillet over medium heat. Dump the meat into the skillet and sprinkle with the cheese. Cook the meat about 2 minutes on each side. Serve with a side of guacamole, salsa etc.

title: Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Place each serving bowl in the oven and broil until bubbling, approximately 40 seconds to 1 minute. Stir sour cream into sour cream slowly.

title: Mexican Steamed Clams
ingredients: 12 medium clams | 10 kalamata olives | 1 cup cooked pasta | 1/2 cup sweet red pepper, roasted and minced | 1/2 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons bottled beer | chopped toasted tortilla ( optional )
instructions: Place clams in steamer. Fill steamer with 1/2 of water.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,vegetable stock,celery,red capsicum,white flour,spanish onion
title: Simmered Curried Onions
ingredients: 6 cups vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 lbs spanish onions, sliced or chopped | 1 1/2 lbs red capsicums, chopped or 1 1/2 lbs green capsicums | 1/4 cup white flour | 1/4 cup chopped celery
instructions: In a heavy saucepan or a large deep heavy pot, combine all ingredients except for flour. Turn on heat to medium. When mixture begins to warm, stir in flour 1 tablespoon at a time until mixture is the consistency of thick paste. Stir in additional teaspoon of garam masala if desired. Cook over very high heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon or a slotted spoon, until mixture becomes very thick. Cook, stirring constantly, for another minute or two. If mixture becomes more dry, add a few tablespoons of vegetable stock. Ladle into warm bowls or warmed soup plates.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,italian bread,quinoa,catsup,penne pasta,orange zest
title: Grilled Sweet Red Pepper, and Penne Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup dry quinoa | 2 red bell peppers | 1/2 orange, zest of, from the orange | 1/3 cup catsup | 2 cups penne pasta | 2 tablespoons italian bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Place quinoa in a bowl and add enough boiling water to cover and let stand 5 minutes, then drain. Place red peppers, orange zest and catsup in a bowl and coat with the crumb mixture. Place penne in a large pot of boiling water, reduce heat to medium, and simmer 2 to 3 minutes, until pasta is al dente. Drain and set aside. Place quinoa in a large bowl and add enough cooking water to cover. Let stand 15 minutes, then drain and rinse quinoa. Place in a large bowl and set aside. Stir in the italian breadcrumbs. Toss pasta and quinoa mixture together.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,ranch salad dressing,sharp cheddar cheese,jalapeno pepper,chicken breast half,iceberg lettuce,milk chocolate,chocolate pudding mix
title: Jalapeno-Cheddar Chicken
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen iceberg lettuce | 3 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese | 2 packages light chocolate instant pork and cheese pudding mix | 1/2 cup evaporated skim milk | 1 cup finely chopped jalapeno pepper ( with or without seeds ) | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 bag mini refrigerated cheese flavored chicken breast halves, thawed
instructions: Boil water in a large pot for the iceberg lettuce to be prepared. Drain and chill in refrigerator. Combine all ingredients except chicken, in the order given, in a bowl. Coat the chicken with the mixture and refrigerate over night. Bake the chicken at 350° overnite then slice and serve.

title: Grilled Pineapple Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 sheet safflower oil filled with 1/2 inch water
instructions: Mix the pineapple juice and asafoetida until foamy. Dip the pineapple rollers into the marinade and let drain for 25 to 30 minutes. Heat a grill pan to very hot. Place the steamer basket with the woody ends directly over the heat, placing the bamboo skewers onto the steamer basket. Allow skewers to steam for about 5 minutes. Do not overcook. Remove the bamboo skewers from the grill. Arrange the pineapple rolls on the platter and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: grapefruit,italian sausage,pork shoulder,potato,asparagus,lemon pepper,peanut butter,chicken wing
title: Sausage and Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 10 chicken wings, sliced | 3 boneless pork shoulder, thinly sliced | 5 italian sausages | 1 lemon pepper | 12 small sweet potatoes, peeled and chopped small | 1 lb fresh asparagus, washed ( or 2 cups frozen asparagus, thawed and cooked to tender crisp, then cut into 1-inch pieces ) or ( 15 ounce ) package frozen asparagus, thawed and cooked to tender crisp, then cut into 1-inch pieces ( or 2 cups frozen asparagus, thawed and cooked to tender crisp, then cut into 1-inch pieces ) | 1 jar grapefruit sections, reserve liquid ( do not drain ) | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter
instructions: Cut the chicken wings, pork shoulder, and sausages into 1 inch segments.

Random Ingredients: veal,napa cabbage,red pepper,oyster sauce,baby spinach,russet potato
title: Veal Burgers, Potato, and Spinach with Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground veal | 1 lb baby spinach ( washed, trimmed, and chopped, about 12 ) | 1 bag russet potatoes, scrubbed, washed and chopped | 8 -10 leaves napa cabbage | 1 -2 tablespoon low sodium oyster sauce | 1 dash sweet red pepper
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Combine meat, spinach, potatoes, cabbage and seasoning. Form into 24 burger patties. Grill patties 5 to 6 minutes per side or until heated through. Serve hot.

title: Pineapple Spice Jam for Ham or Farmer Pie
ingredients: 4 large ripe pineapple chunks | 1 3/4 cups cider vinegar | 4 cups tomato ketchup | 2 1/2 cups hot pickling spices | 1 1/2 cups dried currants | 2 cups lemonade
instructions: Remove the cores and any undesirable pieces from the pineapple. Cut up the pineapple sections into chunks. In a large stew pot combine the vinegar, tomato ketchup, spice and currants. Cook and gently heat, stirring frequently, until the jam reaches 220c /430°f. Stir the sugar into the jam. Do not boil it. Remove from the heat. Make sure it is well chilled before pouring onto your ham or Farmer pie. Let it set until it is completely cool. Put in sterilized pint containers and seal. Store in a cool, dark place. This jam will keep for 2 - 5 years then is refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: plum sauce,spring onion,oregano leaf,mozzarella cheese,moose roast,linguine,banana
title: Quick and Easy Roasted Mozzarella-Stuffed Moose
ingredients:
1/2 cup mango sauce | 1/4 cup spring onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 loaf fresh moose roast | 1 cup fresh basil, torn | 1/3 cup bananas or 1/3 cup honey 
    - 2 cups mixed sliced mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° on a foil lined jelly roll pan, arrange a sheet of foil large enough to line the sides with the foil about 1/2 inch deep. In a bowl stir together first 6 ingredients and sprinkle mixture over moose. Carefully top with basil leaves and banana. Roll up, fold ends tightly. Wrap tightly with foil, place in pan and bake 35 - 45 minutes. Remove foil, slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: ham,prosciutto,white wine vinegar,red fresno chile,seltzer water,pastry crust pie,apple juice,anaheim chilies
title: Pastry Rustica
ingredients: pastry for a double crust pie | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped seeded green anaheim chilies ( seeded and minced ) or 1 tablespoon red fresno chile ( seeded and minced ) | 1/4 cup chopped seeded fresh red fresno chile | 1 tablespoon chopped seeded fresh anneheim chilies ( seeded and minced ) or 1 tablespoon anaheim chile ( seeded and minced ) | 2 tablespoons chopped peeled fresh apples or 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 1 cup unsalted dry-roasted apple juice | 6 ounces finely chopped ham | 1/2 - 3/4 lb salted edam cheese or 1/2-3/4 lb prosciutto, chopped fine
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with a triple crust pie crust.

title: Mexican Chicken and Veggies on Toast
ingredients: leftover roasted chicken | butter-flavored toast | 1 small zucchini | 2 large green chili ( optional ) | 1 recipe pastry for a double crust 9-inch pie
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Slice zucchini and sprinkle with salt. Put oven to cook zucchini in the oven, not letting it get to hot because your oven is heating up. Take the pan's pan out and place in the oven for about 7 minutes. Spread about 1/2 cup of melted butter or margarine on your toast. Spread zucchini and chicken on toast. Serve with sliced green chilies for added flavor.

title: Guacamole-Tunisian Fries
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs new potatoes, unpeeled | 6 tablespoons olive ( preferably extra virgin ) | 4 generous saffron strands | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/8 teaspoon powdered saffron strands, extra
instructions: Boil enough water to cover potato and cook for 5 minutes or until tender but not overcooked. Place potatoes in an 11 x7 nonstick baking pan. Heat remaining 3 tablespoons of oil in a small frying pan. Add saffron strands and stir 1 minute.

title: Turkish Turkey and Dates
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless turkey | 1/2 lb pitted dates, chopped or 1/2 lb raisins soaked in sherry | 1 tablespoon fresh tomato-flavored olive oil ( such as tuna-tomato olive oil or basil )
instructions: Trim fat from turkey. Cut turkey into 1 cubes. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot. Sprinkle turkey well with salt and pepper and add to skillet in a single layer. Cook over medium high heat until browned, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, stir together tomatoes, oil, and dates until lightly browned. Turn turkey over. Place tomatoes around the turkey and sprinkle each piece of turkey with tomato mixture. Cover tightly and reduce heat to low. Simmer until turkey is tender and most of the juices have evaporated, about 1 hour. Remove turkey from skillet.

Random Ingredients: chinese cabbage,frank red hot sauce,purpose flour,baking powder,lima bean
title: Chinese Style Limas and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 package frozen lima beans | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 1 dash frank's red hot sauce
instructions: Drain lima beans thoroughly and put in a large mixing bowl. Use hands to squish the bag of lima beans through a large bag to get all the green bits. Spray cookie sheets with cooking spray. Spread lima beans in one layer on the cookie sheets. Spray the frozen lima beans with cooking spray, or steam them for about one minute. Remove lima beans from cookie sheets. Spray frozen lima beans again with cooking spray and add to bag. Sift flour and baking powder together. Add to bag. Drop contents of bag into steaming pot to within 1/2 an inch of the boiling water. Stir briskly, making sure the contents don't clump together. When water boils again, remove from heat and pour over contents of bag into steaming pot. Cover and let sit for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove bag contents and serve.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,lime,dark sesame oil,grand marnier,nonfat milk,cotija cheese,corn flake,rosemary
title: Broccoli & Lime Pie
ingredients: 16 ounces broccoli florets, frozen | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 cups nonfat milk | 1/2 lime, juiced and seeds removed | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese or feta cheese | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the broccoli florets and rosemary in a microwave safe bowl and cook on high until steaming, about 1 minute. Set aside. Heat the sesame oil in a skillet and cook the soy milk, stirring, until warm and slightly thickened. Stir the lime juice into the pan. Pour hot milk over broccoli, then toss. Pour coconut nectar into the sauce. Add the reserved rosemary. Toss until combined. Spoon broccoli into a small bowl. Dip the corn flakes in the grand marnier then arrange on the broccoli and pineapple mixture. Garnish with extra grand marnier.

title: Limoncello or a Lemon and Cream Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh cream or 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh lemon peel, grated | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Dressing, put everything in a screw top jar, pour the water on top, and shake until well blended, about 30 seconds to 1 minute. Allow dressing to stand at least a few minutes before using to prevent it from crystallizing. Enjoy.

title: The Most Perfect Colcannon Dinner
ingredients: 500 g ground meat | 1/8 red chili pepper | 500 g cabbage | 120 -280 g sharp cheddar cheese ( for topping ) ( optional )
instructions: Wash all your veggies very well, remove stem and cut into pieces. Wash the ground meat and fry until brown. Drain meat well and return to frying pan until meat loses its pink colour. Add chili and mix well, fry until meat is crumbly and the cabbage changes in size. Stir in the cheese, do not mix well, do not boil or else it will become lumps. Stir the mixture well, serve with fried rice.

title: Chocolate Brandy Frosting
ingredients: 500 -700 g cream of tartar | 175 g good dark chocolate | 200 ml brandy
instructions: Beat cream of tartar with electric mixer for 1 minute. Whip chocolate and brandy together. Scoop into cream to lighten it. If its too thick, add sugar or dark chocolate chips.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,celery rib,beef stew meat,sesame oil,oil,cilantro leaf,corn tortilla,onion
title: Mexican-Inspired Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1 lb beef stew meat | 2 large celery ribs, sliced | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro leaf | 1 package corn tortillas, warmed
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat. Pat beef dry and cut into 2 inch strips. Add to skillet. Cook until browned quickly and crumbly. Stir in celery, onion, sesame oil and 3 cups water. Bring to a boil and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Stir in cracker crumbs, cilantro and mix well. Spread mixture evenly in 9x13 inch baking pan and spread evenly with back of spatula. Bake at 350° for 10 - 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Chestnuts with Prunes
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 12 chestnuts | prune
instructions: Combine saffron and sherry in a small bowl. Remove the stems from the chestnuts and cut each chestnut in half lengthwise. Scoop out the flesh and reserve. Trim the hard shell. Trim the trimmings, removing any bones or blemishes left by the chestnuts. Reserve the shells. Arrange the shell halves in a baking dish. Pour 1/4 of the reserved chestnut liquid over the chestnuts then sprinkle with the prunes. Continue to pour the remaining chestnut liquid over the chestnuts and prunes. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes, until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,tarragon,bicarbonate soda,chicken tender,puff pastry,yellow onion,amaretto liqueur
title: Auberge Chicken Wellington

instructions: Place the chicken tenders in an ovenproof dish. Combine the marsala, tarragon, amaretto and bicarbonate of soda. Pour this over the chicken in the dish. Allow to stand. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius. Line a baking sheet with baking paper. Lay the puff pastry over the chicken and brush with a little oil. Cover with the onion slices. Bake for 35 - 45 minutes until the chicken and onions are cooked through and the pastry is golden.

title: Spicy Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 3 tablespoons cajun-style hot sauce or 3 tablespoons other spicy hot pepper sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 1/2 lbs flank steaks
instructions: In a bowl, combine mint leaves with hot sauce and liquid smoke. Combine steak and mint mixture.

title: Easy, Cheap, Crispy French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1/2 cup flour, or as needed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Cut slits in top and bottom of bread to make a criss cross design. Open and spread bread with a thin layer of flour to cover all sides. Sprinkle bread with more flour or sugar to cover. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until browned and crispy.

Random Ingredients: swordfish steak,cream,coriander powder,marmalade,swiss chard,anise seed,danish blue cheese

instructions: Cook marmalade, anise seeds, & coriander in large pot along with 1/2 cups water, swiss chard or spinach & simmer until leaves are tender, 10 minute drain well, reserving liquid. instructions: Mix taco seasoning with vegetable broth in a glass or ceramic bowl. Place bag of rice krispies in a large bowl, and cover with plastic wrap. In microwave, microwave for 2 minutes. title: Tasty Mexican Style Salsa
ingredients: 1 container lettuce, chopped | 3 dashes tabasco sauce ( or other hot pepper sauce )
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and chill.

title: Baked Beef Brisket & Olives
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef brisket ( can also use boston or other inexpensive brisket ) | 1 cup alfredo sauce ( or tomato basil soup mix ) | 3/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 lb black olives, drained and chopped
instructions: Wash brisket well and poke a series of holes in the brisket with a knife. Place brisket in roasting pan. Drizzle top side of brisket with alfredo sauce. Cover and place in oven. Shred and serve with noodles or gravy.

title: Quince Breakfast Roll
ingredients: 3 large ripe quinces | 1 cup feta cheese or 1 cup goat cheese, crumbled | 4 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted | paprika | dried orecchiette, toasted ( or use 2 small round loaf tumblers, such as ritz crackers if you prefer ) | milk chocolate chips ( optional )
instructions: Scrub the quince under cold running water, then cut off the root ends. Cut out the core and seeds. Chop the quinces finely. Place in a large bowl. Top with the remaining cheese mixture, mounding it slightly. Roll the quince around the cheese mixture. Cut roll into 4 equal pieces. Serve immediately. Toast the chocolate, if using, then top with chips.

title: Mimi's Pork and Noodle Kugel (Ww 6 Points)

instructions: Place pork, calamari, self rising flour, cheese, orange zest, and extra flour in a large pot. Pour in the vinegar. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,golden syrup,lime zest,tequila,black eyed pea,garam masala powder
title: Lime Black-Eyed Mexi Tea
ingredients: 1 cup dried black-eyed peas | 2 tablespoons raw sugar | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder ( optional )
instructions: Place the black eyed peas in a medium saucepan, pour in enough hot water to cover, and stir in the sugar, golden syrup, baking soda, and lime zest. Cover, bring to a boil, and cook over low heat until the peas are tender. Remove from heat.

title: Chili and Potato Sprouts
ingredients: 500 g potatoes starch or 500 g sieved potato starch | 1 sprig thyme sprig, plus extra | thyme frais or 1 sprig rosemary, for garnish | 4 large leeks | 1/2 cup evaporated milk or 1/2 cup sweet cream
instructions: Place the potato starch and thyme in a food processor. Pulse until the mixture resembles bread crumbs. Cut the leeks crossways into halves, then cut into 5cm lengths.
