Cut the top off the sprouts and hollow out the centre leaving about 1cm of skin length. Remove the sprouts from the liquid and serve garnished with strips of rosemary.

title: Healthy, Simple and Delicious Refried Bean
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground round | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 packages shredded cheese ( i use cheddar colby jack )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Brown meat and onions. Drain fat. Stir in all spices. Spread on a large baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake for an extra 10 minutes or until cheese is golden brown.

title: Parsley Crusted Salmon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves, finely chopped | 1 green capsicum, deseeded, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh parsley, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon natural egg mixed with 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 4 salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Line a baking tray with non stick baking paper. Combine the chopped parsley, green capsicum, parsley, egg, vanilla and a little of the chopped parsley. Stir in some salt and pepper. Spread half the mixture over the salmon fillets. Coat the salmon fillets with the rest of the chopped parsley mixture. Place baking tray on a baking sheet and bake salmon for 10 minutes or until cooked through. Serve with a fresh salad.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,orange bell pepper,swiss cheese,rice wine,parmesan cheese
title: Orange Pepper Stuffed Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cooked | 1/4 cup orange bell pepper, cut in strips | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon and place on paper towels to absorb excess grease. Set aside. Cook cauliflower in boiling water until al dente. Drain and place in a large bowl. Mix remaining ingredients with bacon and cheese, mix well and stuff cauliflower with mixture. Place cheese in a 9 x13 dish and place on top. Bake in a 350f oven for about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,wild mushroom,grand marnier,red leaf lettuce,tortilla
title: Wild Mushrooms and Apple Wrap
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup sweet red leaf lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces | 1 teaspoon apple juice | 1/8 teaspoon grand marnier | 4 tortillas or 4 large hoisin sauce rollers
instructions: Microwave mushrooms 30 seconds and add apple juice and grand marnier.

title: Slightly Smoked English Muffins
ingredients: 2 english muffins, toasted | 2 teaspoons smoked paprika | kosher salt | 1 bunch kale ( a handful or 2-3 bunches )
instructions: Toast the english muffins. Mix smoked paprika, kosher salt and kale together. Top the english muffins with smoked paprika mix. Serve.

title: Saudi Penne (Sweet) - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1/3 cup cumin seed, roasted | 1 green cardamom | 1 tablespoon sherry or 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Spread cumin seeds on a plate. Add a glass to the pressure cooker, then fill the rest of the glass with the cumin. Pressure on the cumin seeds can be turned down at this point only. Heat pressure cooker over medium heat for 3 whistles, until the cumin seeds start to pop, and when you press the pressure indicator button, the cumin will not crack any further, and there will be no liquid left. Turn off cooker, and let sit for 10 minutes. Turn off the cooker, and let all the solids rest for 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Beef or Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 1 pie crust | 1 can refrigerated pie crusts or ( 8 ounce ) can prepared pie crusts | 1 kg stew meat ( the cheap cheap kind is easiest to shred ) | 1 kg butter | 1 kg peanuts | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven 160°c. In a large oven proof dish pour peanut oil so that it covers the bottom of the dish. Heat fry pan on low in microwave for 4 - 5 minutes. Drain beef or pork from it. Cut it into small pieces. Roll up one pie crust and place on oiled baking tray. Melt a knob of butter in fry pan, then add peanuts and meat. Cook until meat is brown, then add salt and pepper. Pour over meat mixture. Put other piece of pie crust in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes until crust starts to brown and crisp. Serve with mashed potatoes or rice.

Random Ingredients: double cream,chicken bouillon cube,mint leaf,dark chocolate,philadelphia cream cheese,onion,broccoli floret
title: Chopsticks
ingredients: 500 g philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon double cream | 3 tablespoons chopped mint leaves | 1/2 small onion, chopped into rings | 1 1/3 cups hot broccoli florets | 4 ounces dark chocolate, melted
instructions: Place the cream cheese, bouillon cubes, mint & onion in a food processor and blend into a smooth paste. Stir the sauce into the cream cheese mixture and pour onto a lined baking tray. Top with the prepared philly cheese & broccian. Top with dark chocolate. Preheat oven to 200c / gas 5, gas mark 6 & bake for 35 minutes or until the philly is golden & bubbly. Allow to cool & then cut into squares & serve.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,mango chutney,celery salt,tarragon,chorizo sausage,nutmeg
title: Spiced Chorizo Pork
ingredients: 2 chorizo sausage, sliced | 2 pork loin chops, each cut into 2 thick slices | 1 jar mango chutney | 1 pinch ground nutmeg | 1 pinch dried tarragon | 1 pinch celery salt
instructions: Place chorizo and pork in large, deep skillet or wok. Over high heat, combine everything and saute until pork is browned on the outside, about 20 minutes, adding a little water if mixture looks dry. Serve with rice, and serve with other dishes.

title: Fried Onions
ingredients: 3 pounds white onions, sliced into rings | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Fry onions gently in a skillet over medium heat about 15 minutes, reducing heat as needed. Add turmeric, cover, and continue frying 10 minutes, or until onions have a deep golden brown color. Drain. This is good served warm.

title: Pumpkin Rice  With Pecans
ingredients: 2 cups whole milk | 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup long-grain rice, washed, cleaned and cooked | 2 tablespoons oil | 3/4 lb pumpkin or 3/4 lb butternut squash, peeled, cubed slightly | 2 cups green peas, shelled and thawed ( use frozen peas instead ) | 1/2 cup walnut pieces ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Heat the milk, rice & oil in a skillet. When the milk is almost boiling stir in the pumpkin. Cook uncovered until tender.

Random Ingredients: chutney,red wine vinegar,bicarbonate soda,eggplant,graham cracker crumb,whipping cream
title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Spread
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, peeled, deseeded, cut into 2cm cubes | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 3 cups whipping cream | 1 cup sweet chutney | 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Place eggplant in a saucepan of boiling water and boil for approx 15 - 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and place in a bowl, add crumbs and chill for approx 30 minutes. Return eggplant to pan and add vinegar. Combine cream and chutney until smooth, add to eggplant mixture. Gently stir in salt and bicarb soda. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Vegan Spanish Turnips With Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 8 turnips | 12 black olives, sliced in half | 3 tablespoons chili powder | 2 teaspoons freshly grated ginger | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 cup strong coffee, chilled | 1 teaspoon of chopped of fresh mint ( optional ) | pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Cook turnips in hot skillet, turning once, until almost tender, about 8 minutes per turn. Pour off liquid. Using fork and sharp knife, peel turnips into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,romaine lettuce,mexicorn,vegetable stock chicken,rye bread,green pea,self rising flour,banana
title: Chile, Cornmeal and Banana Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 1/2 cup drained green peas | 30 g frozen green pea | 3/4 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed | 1 red chilies, finely chopped | 1/2 cup vegetable stock or 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | 5 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 c or 400°f mix together the first five ingredients and pour into two greased muffin cups. Bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through. Meanwhile, place cornflour in a small saucepan over medium heat and stir in stock and bring to boil, whisking constantly, for 2 mins or until reduced by half. Remove from heat and stir through chillies. Toast bread under a hot grill for 10 - 5 mins turning until golden brown. Spoon warm cornflour mixture over the top of muffins.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,jicama,flat leaf parsley,sambal oelek,chicken meat,vodka,catfish fillet,lemonade
title: Filipino Style Catfish
ingredients: 400 -450 g catfish fillets or 400 -450 g snapper fillets | 50 -50 g vodka | 20 -25 ml crushed jicama | 20 -25 ml vodka | 25 -25 ml thick lemonade ( i like the zevi brand ) | 25 -50 ml sambal oelek ( indonesian ) | cornflour or cornstarch, for dusting ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Breathe the fish with the vodka, slasa or fish liqueur. Place in a baking dish, sprinkle with crushed jicama, vodka and lemonade. Marinate in fridge for 2 - 24 hours depending on how you like your fillets. Preheat oven to 350°f and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork. Add chopped parsley as garnish.

title: Ancho Rub for Fish (Besciamella)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried ancho chiles | 2 tablespoons ground mixed spice ( like cinnamon, cardamom, cayenne, cloves, ground green peppercorns or paprika ) | 10 green olives
instructions: Wash and clean the fish with a dish and blot dry. Remove and discard the stems, seeds and membrane from the ancho chiles. Grind the ground chiles to a fine powder. Add the spices and olives and continue grinding to obtain a paste like consistency. Scoop into a jar and store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,creme fraiche,ginger root,green cabbage
title: Luby's Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 green cabbage, shredded | 1 pint creme fraiche | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. When hot, stir in the shredded cabbage.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,quinoa,dark soy sauce,milk chocolate chip,golden syrup
title: Spicy Chocolate and Dessert Chip Ice-Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 cup evaporated milk chocolate chips | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 cup maraschino cherries or regular cherries, quartered
instructions: Place quinoa and evaporated milk chocolate chips in a blender& blend till smooth. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, stir chocolate mixture with milk to melt& smooth. Pour chocolate mixture into a pan & stir over medium heat till thick. Remove from heat. Stir in golden syrup& cherries. Freeze till solid. Put ice cream in a bowl& freeze it till hard. To serve, invert ice cream in a plate. Pour on remaining sauce. Drizzle chocolate over ice cream.

Random Ingredients: rotel,yellow bell pepper,bread crumb,red wine vinegar
title: Spanish Pepper and Salt Dressing II
ingredients: 1 can rotel | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine rotel and onion in a medium bowl. Mix in bread crumbs and vinegar. Chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,beef bouillon cube,sesame seed oil,prosciutto,black sesame seed,catsup,black mustard seed
title: Chinese Style Sesame Mustard
ingredients: 1 tablespoon black sesame seed, toasted | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds, toasted | 2 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 lb prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1 spring onion, sliced thinly
instructions: Combine sesame seeds and mustard seeds in a shallow glass dish. Set aside. Heat oil in wok or skillet over high heat. Stir fry sesame mixture 3 minutes, or until it turns a golden brown. Stir in catsup. Dissolve bouillon cube in hot water. Add toasted sesame mixture. Add prosciutto and onions. Serve at once.

title: Coconut Mac And Cheese
ingredients: 1 package macaroni | 1 can condensed cream of coconut | 1 packet taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons pine nuts
instructions: Grease a microwave safe dish, or make the mac and cheese as directed on packet. I find that the microwave is much quicker to turn it when adding toppings. Cook mac and cheese according to pkg directions, or until they are browned on the top. Pour cream of coconut over cooked mac and cheese.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Pour the dark soy sauce into a medium saucepan so that the sauce coats the chicken wings thoroughly. Add the wings from the chicken wings. Bake at 375°f until the sauce has reduced somewhat.

title: Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 3 lbs pork spareribs, trimmed | 1/4 cup catsup | 3 tablespoons chopped cilantro | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper
instructions: Place ribs in a large roasting pan. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over pork. Cover and marinate 2 - 24 hours under refrigeration, turning occasionally while cooking. Bake at 350 f for 1 hour. Remove meat, discard marinade and cook 30 minutes longer.

title: Quinoa With Rosemary, Onions & Sunflower Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 1 1/2 cups onions | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: Rinse the quinoa well and drain well. Place the quinoa on a baking tray lined with greaseproof paper and top with 1 - 2 of the onions. Pour a 1 1/2 cup of water over them and leave to soak over night. After about 24hrs, turn on the oven to 375f/180°c. Heat 1/2 cup oil over medium heat in a large ovenproof non reactive saucepan and fry the rosemary for 1 - 2 minutes. Turn the heat up to high, add the quinoa and fry till the quinoa ripples.. Place in a deep roasting pan and bake for 30 mins or until the quinoa looks dry. Serve warm or at room temperature with a crisp side salad. Nb, the more flavour the onions, the more flavour the rosemary.

title: Easy Greek Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram
instructions: Combine in a small bowl, stirring well.

title: Strips
ingredients: 1 green capsicum | 2 whole red chilies
instructions: Firstly cut all the white stalk of the capsicum, and cut on the green with a knife to keep it intact. Slice the capsicum on a diagonal. Grill the chillies in an iron skillet. Once you have this done, put the chillies on the stove on medium flame. Once they start burning, spread one drop of oil on the capsicums and green. Once it does so, sprinkle little water on it to prevent it turning brown on either side. Once the capsicum has been added into the skillet on one side, add the red chillies on the other side. Keep on this side. Cover skillet. Allow to cook on medium flame. Once it's done, let it cool for sometime. Then, serve it chilled or at room temperature.

title: Coconut Soup
ingredients: 1 can sweetened coconut | 1 can chopped green chile peppers, drained | 1 package dry pasta
instructions: Puree the coconut, green chile peppers, and drained pasta in a blender to desired thickness in a large bowl. Add remaining soup ingredients to the bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to flavors develop.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,cherry tomato,lasagna noodle,rye bread
title: Chicken Naan
ingredients: 8 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1-inch cubes | 8 large cherry tomatoes, halved | 3 packages frozen sliced rye bread | 15 sheets uncooked lasagna noodles
instructions: In a 9x13 inch baking dish or deep fryer, stir chicken and tomato pieces together. Lay a sheet of reynolds wrap non stick aluminum foil on an 11 x 7 inch baking dish. Place half of the pieces of bread on top of the chicken. Spoon chicken and tomato mixture into the center of the bread, leaving a 1 inch border around edges. Break up the remaining pieces of bread with a fork. Top bread with the remaining chicken and tomato pieces. Season the mixture to taste with salt and pepper. Wrap the foil around the chicken and tomatoes so no heat escapes during frying. Cover the dish with foil and gently press down on the lasagna to release steam. Heat oven to 400 f degrees f. Bake, uncovered, for 35 - 45 minutes, or until bubbly and crusty.

title: Fiery Kiwi Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 kiwi fruits | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 4 tablespoons iceberg lettuce
instructions: Peel kiwifruit if you want it less spicy. Slice flesh into four large serving size pieces. Tear iceberg lettuce into bite size pieces. Place kiwifruit and iceberg lettuce into large bowl. Mix everything together and serve.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,chipotle chile,saltpeter,cocoa,tahini paste,blueberry,green cardamom pod,ginger
title: Blueberry Chipotle Hummus
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa or 2 1/2 tablespoons low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon saltpeter | 1 whole chipotle chile, seeds removed, finely chopped | 2 green cardamom pods | 3/4 lb fresh blueberries or 3/4 lb frozen blueberries | 3 tablespoons tahini paste | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated | 14 fresh curry leaves, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon peter
instructions: Stir the first 5 ingredients in a medium metal bowl to blend. Season with salt. Add the blueberries.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,lemon juice,noodle,grape,tomato juice,mexican tomato sauce
title: Tijuana Cheesebord (Tijuana Macaroni)
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 3 hard-boiled eggs | 1 jar grape cuts ( or other favorite fruit ) | 1 can mexican-style tomato sauce | 1 lemon juice | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions, and cut eggs in half lengthwise. Remove egg halves once done, leave egg halves in their shells, and set aside. Peel eggs, and set halves aside. Cut grapes into 1/2 slices, and set aside. Rinse a 12 inch skillet with cold water. Drain egg halves under warm running water to cool, then shake off excess. Sauté a few pieces at a time in oil until golden color. Drain on paper towels to remove excess oil. Add diced tomatoes with juices, and grape slices back to skillet. Stir, and simmer for about 10 minutes. When pasta is cooked, drain. Add noodles to tomato sauce and stir again. Top with egg halves. Serve.

title: Vegetarian Cottage Filling for Pakora
ingredients: 1/4 cup textured vegetable protein | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 2 white potatoes, peeled and cubed
instructions: Place tvp and turmeric in a small skillet over low heat, stirring over low heat until melted, about 5 minutes. Add potatoes, and simmer until potatoes are slightly tender, about 5 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,monterey jack pepper cheese,catalina salad dressing,sesame oil,lasagna noodle,saffron thread
title: Cheese, Red Capsicum & Saffron Lasagna
ingredients: 9 sheets lasagna noodles | 300 g monterey jack pepper cheese | 100 g red capsicums, thinly sliced | 375 ml catalina salad dressing | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads ( optional )
instructions: Remove the papery skins from cheese and cut in cubes. Put them in a bowl, lightly crush the cheese with a potato masher or the back of a spoon. Add the peppers, dressing, sesame oil and saffron. Mix well. Spread a spoonful of cheese mixture in the centre of each of the noodles. Top with another tablespoon or so of cheese mixture. Roll the noodles loosely from end to end so that they look as if they were made from a cigar. Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas cook for 20 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Hot Chilli Oil
ingredients: 2 teaspoons hot chili pepper flakes, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried coriander or 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh coriander
instructions: Place in a clean bottle of hot chilli pepper flakes and dry roast in a moderately hot frying pan for 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,basil,greek seasoning,orange bell pepper,romaine lettuce,icing sugar,peanut butter
title: Lettuce Wrapped Asian Oranges
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 teaspoon finely minced orange bell pepper ( if you have it, use 1 teaspoons of bottled hot pepper oil ) | 1 teaspoon fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 12 medium lettuce wraps ( spinach, iceberg, bibb, or other leaf lettuce ) | 8 shiitake mushrooms, sliced
instructions: In a bowl, beat together peanut butter, orange bell pepper oil, basil, and greek seasoning until smooth. Arrange a lettuce wrapper on a work surface. Spoon 1/4 cup peanut butter mixture along one edge of wrapper, and roll up towards the desired size, tucking in the sides as you go. Keep rolling and placing a second roll on top. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling. Serve sliced bamboo shoots, chopped shiitakes or other condiment to make a very different flavour pact dipping for appetizers.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,chili pepper flake,anchovy,navy bean,lemon curd,dark soy sauce,honeydew melon
title: Chinese Chili Dips
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup honeydew melon, cubed | 2 teaspoons anchovy, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 chili, chopped | 1 teaspoon lemon curd | 1 can navy beans, drained
instructions: In bowl, mix soy, and honey. Gently stir in melon cubes, anchovies, chili pepper flakes, and chilli. Add beans. Mix well. Serve at once. Serve with rice, or stir fried pita.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,mint leaf,italian tomato,berry,green cardamom pod,serrano chilies
title: Simple Berbere Salad
ingredients: 2 bunches mixed mixed mixed berries, like chanterelles, raspberries, and strawberries | 4 serrano chilies, finely chopped ( wear gloves to protect your skin ) | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh mint leaves | 2 green cardamom pods, cracked ( optional )
instructions: Wash berries. Place berries and chiles in a bowl. Toss with tomatoes and bean sprouts. Sprinkle with mint and green cardamom pods before serving.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,broccoli floret,seltzer water,mutton,hamburger,maraschino cherry,chicken thigh
title: Yorkshire Steak and Chard Skewers
ingredients: 10 -20 bamboo skewers ( in can ) | 750 g minced beef | 2 teaspoons seltzer water | 1/3 lb cubed hamburger | 2 ounces seltzer water | 1 cup grated cooked mutton | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1 maraschino cherry
instructions: Place meat, in marinade bowl, cover and refrigerate for 2 1/2 hours turning occasionally. Thread on skewers as follows, 4 skewers each about 1/4 thick and 3cm larger than the other. Thread lamb and top with chard, then the stuffing. Wrap well in aluminium foil and refrigerate until used.

title: Melt Your Bones Butter
ingredients: 25 g unsalted butter | fresh thyme sprig, to garnish
instructions: Heat the oven to 200c/180c or gas mark melt the butter without browning it. Gently pour the molten butter into a small, heavy baking sheet. Dust with thyme, and scatter with a couple of handfuls of chopped roasted potato flakes. Bake the butter for about 15 minutes until it smells richly melted, and smells crisp again. Set on a cutting board and cut into chunks as to finish. Allow to cool then refrigerate.

title: Baked Asparagus
ingredients: 1/3 pound fresh asparagus spears, trimmed and snapped into 2 inch pieces | 4 tablespoons margarine | 2 cans fat-free refried beans, heated | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 cup low-fat milk or cream
instructions: Saute asparagus in hot margarine in a covered skillet over medium heat until tender crisp. Spread on an ungreased baking sheet and spread refried beans over. Cover pan with foil. Bake in a preheated 400 degrees f oven until heated through and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes. Spread asparagus with tahini sauce and top with milk. Serve hot.

title: White Bean Baked in White Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 300 g mung beans, soaked in water overnight, then drained | 1 cup fresh white breadcrumb | 2 tablespoons basil leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon hazelnut-flavored liqueur | 2 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs or 2 tablespoons finely chopped almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Place the soaked beans in a baking dish, cover lightly with water and bake for 90 minutes until tender.

title: The Maven's Easy Awesome Marinade for Chicken
ingredients: 1 packet cherry flavored frozen lemonade concentrate | 2 tablespoons miracle whip | 1 teaspoon minced garlic
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium sized container. Mix to blend until mixture becomes paste free. Pour over chicken and leave to marinate in the refrigerator for a few hours.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,table salt,golden raisin,salt black pepper,turmeric,cane sugar,extra virgin olive oil
title: Chinese Golden Raisin and Turmeric Flavoured Raisins
ingredients: 300 g golden raisins, soaked in water for 1 hour & drained | 300 g unsalted cane sugar ( or brown sugar ) | salt | 1/3 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 150 g unpasteurized extra virgin olive oil, plus extra to grease the baking sheet | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 375°f. Put the raisins in a bowl and mash well with the back of a spoon. Put the raisins aside to air dry. Crush the sugar in a bowl with the flat of a cleaver and add to the raisins with salt, turmeric, 5 spice and 75 ml of the oil, stirring with a fork to make an emulsion. Stir in the remaining 1 tbsp oil and the rest of the raisins. Spread the mixture evenly on a baking sheet lined with baking parchment. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes or until dark golden. Leave to cool for 10 minutes and then slice. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,double crust pie,peanut butter,garlic salt,chive,balsamic vinegar,tortilla
title: Grilled Lime Burritos
ingredients: 1 double crust pie crusts, at room temperature | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon chives | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons peanut butter, extra crunchy | tortillas or fresh vegetables, to serve
instructions: Place pastry on the flat of a grill tray or on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Cut the pastry into 3 4cm squares and place one tablespoon of peanut butter in the centre of each square. Sprinkle with garlic salt and chives. Drizzle over balsamic vinegar and a little extra crunchy peanut butter. Grill for 2 mins on each side or until golden. To assemble, place tortillas on the grill tray and sprinkle with the extra crunchy peanut butter. Serve immediately. Cut the pastry squares into wedges.

title: Tomato-Apple Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 can apple juice
instructions: Empty tomato sauce, apple juice, and tomato juice into a large pot. Heat, but do not boil, until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,chili pepper flake,italian sausage,aubergine,horseradish,chili oil,white bread,red wine vinegar
title: Oriental Grilled Meatloaf With Horseradish and Aubergines
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh italian sausage ( hot or sweet ) | 1 lb aubergine ( ends trimmed ) | 1/2 cup aubergine ( diced ) | 1/4 cup tomato limeade concentrate | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 4 slices white bread
instructions: In a large frypan, sprinkle meat with olive oil and toast over low heat about 8 minutes or until golden brown. Turn and brown on other side. Remove meat from pan. In the same pan, add aubergine and cook over medium heat 1 - 2 minutes until tender. Drain juice from aubergine. Add tomatoe juice, limeade concentrate, vinegar, pepper flakes, horseradish and meat. Over medium heat simmer, turning meat frequently about 15 minutes or until meat is done. About 5 - 10 minutes before serving, remove meat from heat. Cut bread in half, top with meat and serve with sauce. Aubergine salad, rinse and peel the aubergines lengthwise. Slice the slices in half and arrange in a serving bowl. Cut the aubergines and add to meat and toss with the tomatoes and juices. Serve with your favorite side dish.

Random Ingredients: currant,green bell pepper,ziti pasta,cream chicken soup,oregano leaf,tamari,rosemary,white pearl onion
title: Ziti With Peppers and Onions
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dried currants | 1 tablespoon dried minced rosemary | 2 tablespoons dried minced white pearl onions | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons tamari or 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin sticks | 1 lb rotisserie-cooked ziti pasta
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, combine currants, rosemary, onions and soup in a large bowl. Season with tamari and soy sauce. Add the bell pepper and pasta and toss to combine. Remove and serve.

Random Ingredients: avocado,tomato green chile pepper,banana,rice flour,red pepper sauce,ladyfinger,sherry,white vinegar
title: Sweet and Savory Baked Bananas
ingredients: 2 bananas | 1 1/2 cups rice flour, or as needed | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons red hot pepper sauce | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1/2 cup chopped fresh avocado ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sherry ( optional ) | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut a slit in the top of each banana. Place the banana slices, cut side down on the parchment paper. Bake in the preheated oven until the bananas are firm, 15 to 20 minutes. Once cool, peel bananas and slice into rounds. Sift rice flour, vinegar, and red hot pepper sauce together in a bowl.

title: Tandoori Chana Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 package chickpeas | 4 cloves fresh gingerroot, chopped | 1 white shallot, chopped | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 3 anaheim chilies, stemmed and chopped | 1 loaf italian bread | 5 pita bread
instructions: Preheat oven to place first five ingredients into a large baking dish. Mix together the garlic, ginger, and chile and pour over the chickpeas. Add the slices of italian bread to the dish. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes on top rack of the oven. Turn the pita bread over after 30 minutes so they brown even more. Serve topped with your choice of condiments. Note, if you like, you can add roasted onion, tomato or a sprinkle of cayenne pepper with this. Also, if you like, you can use anise seed for a hint of anise flavor. I tried it and found it was to be a pleasant addition.

title: Filet of Beef in Garlic Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/8 kg beef, filet of beef | 1 head cauliflower | 1 - 1 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Roast cauliflower and shred it. Put cauliflower on baking tray. Preheat oven to 180°c. Remove beef from package packaging and place on cauliflower. Add cheese and bake for 15 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Fried Eggplants (Eggplant )
ingredients: 4 large eggplants, halved lengthwise and sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 containers coconut | 2 cans ginger ale | 1/2 cup skim-milk powder
instructions: Heat coconut in a saucepan over medium heat, or in the microwave. When it is hot, add ginger ale to coconut. Pour over sliced eggplants, and allow to thaw and set. Sprinkle generously with skim milk powder before serving.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,nonfat milk powder,thai basil,brown sugar,chicken wing
title: Ww 5 Points - Thai Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed | 13 ounces chicken wings or 12 ounces vegetable wings, cut crosswise in half | 1/2 cup thai basil, torn | 8 tortillas ( i use fat free or low-fat )
instructions: Whisk dry milk powder and brown sugar in bowl. Add wings, basil and mix well. Heat in non stick skillet until warm, approximately 1 - 2 minutes. Dip tortillas in hot oil for 45 - 90 seconds or until warm. Transfer coated skillet to plate and cut into 4ths.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,chipotle chile,white bean,asafoetida powder
title: Bean Fritters (Fritters)
ingredients: 20 ounces white beans, prepared | 1 beef bouillon cube | 5 tablespoons asafoetida powder ( fennel seeds, fennel seed, or green cardamon, available in packets ) | 2 dried chipotle chiles, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine the beans and bouillon cube in a blender, and puree until completely smooth. Add a few tablespoons water if necessary, until the mixture is a bit runny. Transfer chiles into a bowl. Place another bowl over high heat.

Random Ingredients: masa harina,thyme sprig,mozzarella cheese,white pepper,sea salt,hummus,orange zest
title: Aussie Style Spiced Quesadillas
ingredients: 12 ounces mozzarella cheese, sliced | 9 ounces mixed masa harina | 3 large fresh thyme sprigs | 1 large orange, zest of | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1 teaspoon couscous mixed with 1 tablespoon hot water
instructions: Place about 2 ounces of the cheese in a small bowl, season with salt and pepper and mash together with a fork. Mix in the rest of the cheese and stir until it has a spreadable consistency. Spread 1 tablespoon of the masa harina evenly all over half the cheese, about 1 tablespoon per side, leaving ¼ inch clear at each edge, then roll the quesadilla in the masa to coat evenly. Heat a nonstick griddle over a fairly high heat and cook the quesadillas for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Cut the quesadillas into 2 or 3 pieces to serve.

title: Spicy Ricotta and Chilli Sushi Roll
ingredients: 8 -10 saffron strand | 12 -15 frozen musrooms | 15 -20 frozen clams | 8 nori | 2 tomatoes ketchup | 250 g ricotta cheese
instructions: Place 5 tspns salt in a frying pan and cook on low heat and stir until the salt dissolves. Do not burn it. Once the salt is a little melted, rinse the musrooms under cold water and put a layer of aluminium foil on your workspace. Keep repeating this process until you have a pile of mussels. Add a little oil in the frying pan and swirl the pan to coat the bottom of the frying pan with oil. This will take a few minutes and you don't want the mussels to darken. Add some garlic and curry powder and mix. Tear the mussels in half lengthways using a spoon. Place on your shiny side of a sheet and cover with foil. Now you can place the mussels, chillies, garlic and curry on your work surface. Take a piece of plastic wrap and place a small piece of plastic wrap on the work surface. Place 1 tbsp of ricotta on the plastic wrap and roll. Take this next step and roll it from each side of the plastic wrap, then into a long roll. Repeat steps 11 - 7 together until all the ingredients are used up. Take half of the mussels on your work surface, cover them with the plastic wrap and put another piece of plastic wrap on top. Take the rolling pin and roll it away from you until you get the rolled tuna like tuna. Now take another piece of plastic wrap and roll it away from you. You want to end up with the mussels. Now you can pull the rolled sushi out onto your work surface, using your hands to make sushi into little shapes. Once the sushi, is out of the roll, roll it into a long roll. Cut the plastic and plastic together and then cut out the tuna like you did for sushi. Repeat this process and you now have a sushi sushi roll. Now you will take the plastic wrap off your tuna and spread half a small amount of ketchup across the tuna. Sprinkle a little tomato ketchup across it. Cut the tuna into little slices the long way. Take 3 - 4 slices of nori and slice them diagonally, lengthways. Take another 3 - 4 slices of nori and slice them diagonally. Take the cling wrap off the sushi rolling pin. Take a second piece of plastic wrap and wrap it over the sushi rolling pin. Once the sushi is rolled, lay it out on the sushi sheet with the plastic wrap on it. Sprinkle with a little ketchup. Put another piece of plastic, wrap it, and then gently squeeze the sushi roll in the middle of the nori. This won't stick and it will roll out once all the sushi is rolled. Place both tuna rolls, wrapped side up, on a baking tray and let set in the freezer for an hour or two. Take the sushi from the freezer and cut it into slices with a sharp knife. Repeat these steps until you have wrapped all of the sushi. These last steps are just for fun and to let guests help themselves to the sushi. title: Apple Green Cabbage
ingredients: 12 small white mushrooms, any variety | 4 cloves garlic powder | 5 small cooking apples, peeled and cut into small cubes | 1 small green cabbage, outer leaves removed, cored and cut into small wedges | 1 -2 fresh chipotle chile
instructions: Cut off tops of cabbage wedges, but leave about 4 inches of the tops of each head. If no leaves, remove the tough outer leaves. Rinse the heads and cut into quarters. Rinse the head, and cut off the bottoms, if desired. Using a mandoline, slice off excess and discard the core. Do the same for the apples. Slice the apples or shred the apples into small pieces. Prepare a medium skillet with cooking spray, such as nonstick, adding the garlic and chopping them into small pieces with the tip of a paring knife or a pastry bag. Sauté the apple slices until the sugar is lightly browned. Transfer to a plate and set aside to catch drippings. Place the mushrooms in a small saucepan with water to cover. Cover the pan, and bring the water to a boil. Boil the mushrooms about 15 minutes, or until just softened. Drain and set aside to drain. Meanwhile, place the cabbage on a plate in a large bowl. When the water boils, place the cabbage in it and cook about 8 - 10 minutes. Drain and set aside, if any water remains. After removing and serving mushrooms, sprinkle salt into the water before adding to the cabbage. Wearing your hands, separate the head from the leaves, and trim off the thick, bitter bottom stem. Reserve any tough parts of the leaves. The leaves will be easier to chew after cooking about 10 minutes, if needed, and they may be more difficult to remove after cooking. This cabbage works best with chipotle peppers, otherwise they can cause bitterness, so add as little as one teaspoon of salt in with the chipotles. The chipotle peppers and vinegar may be added at this point or at the table as needed to keep them from drying out. Add the garlic powder and the chiles, along with any juice from the chipotles, to the water. Drain the water from the cabbage before adding it to the skillet. Heat to boil, then remove from heat and let sit for 10 minutes with lid slightly ajar. If you think liquid is drying out, remove lid and mash up. To serve, place cabbage on it, spooning green cabbage over the top. Serve hot.

instructions: Bring stock to boil in large saucepan. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Spray 2 soup plates with cooking spray. Using a slotted spoon, transfer soup base to plate. Spray skillet with cooking spray. Heat over high heat until it smokes. Add cottage cheese to hot skillet. When cottage cheese is melted, stir in soup base. Sprinkle with smoked paprika. Serve hot with croutons.

title: Korean Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 package frozen cooked meatballs | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Take jerky from package and thaw in the fridge. You don't need to thaw everything if you're using frozen meatballs or if you're using already thawed meatballs. Place jerky in a zip lock bag or place in zip lock bag. You want a nice seal. After the bag has been thawed, remove the meatballs from the bag. Place them in a gallon sized freezer bag or a ziploc bag on the rack. They will be easier to remove when they're cooled completely. Shake bag to mix meatballs and return to refrigerator. If freezing, place in bags for one day, then place in a ziploc bag and return to fridge. Thaw jerky before using for best results.

title: Chicken Salad With Peach in It!
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cabbage | 1 medium peeled peach, seeded and quartered | 1 cup cooked chicken breast, diced | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning | 4 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Cut off the stem of the chinese cabbage. Place the chopped cabbage in a colander over a bowl and toss with the chopped peaches. Toss with the chicken in the accent seasoning. In a frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil, add the chicken cook over medium high heat for 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and add the cabbage salad. Pour the remaining tablespoon of oil over it and stir to coat the salad. Cover with a lid, reduce the heat to very low and cook 10 minutes or until tender.

title: Swiss Chard Salad (Salatah Kiyaar)
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 1/4 cup chopped fresh spearmint | 1 -2 tablespoon freshly grated fresh spearmint
instructions: Trim and discard white stalk and coarse chop leaves. In a large bowl, toss together chard, tomato puree, chopped spearmint and chopped fresh spearmint.

title: Brazilian Pizzas
ingredients: 3 lbs pork, cut in small bite-sized pieces | 1 lb rabbit, cut in small bite-sized pieces | 3 tablespoons adobo seasoning ( a spicy blend with cayenne, hot pepper, garlic, etc. ) | 2 cups yogurt ( plain, non-fat is okay ) | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon granules
instructions: Place all ingredients in a slow cooker and stir well until well combined. Cover & cook on low for 6 - 7 hours, depending on the thickness of your meat.

title: Auld Alliance: America Melted Cheese Spread
ingredients: 5 1/2 ounces american cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric mixer and process on medium to high speed just till all ingredients are finely distributed. If mixture is too thin, stop and blend with an immersion blender or hand held mixer. Taste for seasoning and adjust if necessary. Spread onto toast or top of a slice of cracker.

title: Easy Chilies Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 cups orange juice | 1 can green chilies, chopped | 2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: Combine all ingredients, cover and chill. If a thicker vinaigrette is desired, pour into a jar in a single layer.

title: Mediterranean Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb assorted mixed vegetables | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/2 lb portabella mushroom, chopped | 3/4 cup rice wine
instructions: In a large skillet, stir fry vegetables in rice wine until tender.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,peanut,lime wedge,pork loin,plain yogurt,buckwheat groat,meatball
title: Healthy Grilled Pork Loin With Buckwheat
ingredients: 1 pork loin | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb | 1 carton vegetarian ground meatballs | 3/4 cup buckwheat groats | 1/3 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 3/4 cup chopped unsalted peanuts ( or to taste ) | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Brush the loin with a thin coat of oil, and sprinkle with the italian herbs. Place the loin on the hot grill. Cook for about 7 minutes per side. Remove from grill, and put on a cutting board. Cut in half crosswise. Serve, passing the yogurt at the table. Combine the chickpeas, cornmeal, or peanuts until they are a meal like consistency, and stir in the meatballs. Heat the grill. Serve alongside.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,coconut oil,chicken breast half,cooking oat,mushroom,shallot,white chocolate,turnip
title: Warm Crock Pot Chicken With Vegetables
ingredients: 4 skinless boneless chicken breast halves | 1 package white chocolate | 1 package frozen sliced mushrooms, thawed and drained | 1 package sliced shallots | 1 jar old fashioned oats ( regular style or quick cooking oats may be used ) | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons coconut oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 can sliced mushroom, drained
instructions: Cut each chicken breast into 4 serving size pieces or into strips. Place chicken in bottom of 6 to 8 quart crock pot crock pot. Place chocolate, mushrooms and shallots over chicken. Top with remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on high for 1 1/2 hours or on low for 5 1/2 hours.

title: Herbed Bacon for the Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 500 g streaky bacon, without any rind | 1 teaspoon thyme leave
instructions: Heat the pressure cooker, or pressure cooker pot, on the stove. Wrap in the streaky bacon shavings and sprinkle with the thyme. If there is any remaining bacon shavings, press cancel until ready to serve. For best results, refrigerate after 30 minutes to allow flavours to develop.

title: Easy Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons chopped garlic | 1/8 cup chopped fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons mango chutney
instructions: Stir sauerkraut, mustard seed, garlic, rosemary, and mango chutney together in a bowl until the ingredients are evenly dispersed. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Apple Bean & Corn Chili
ingredients: 1 cup whole kernel corn, fresh | 1 can kidney beans, undrained | 2 medium apples, skinned and finely chopped | tabasco sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Puree corn and beans in blender or processor. Place chopped apples on top. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Microwave for a few seconds to heat through. Serve hot.

title: Mango, Ale & Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 large mango | 1 -2 apple | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 2 tablespoons rolled oats | 2 tablespoons oat syrup
instructions: Peel and chop mango into small pieces. Dice apple into small pieces. In large bowl combine mango, apple & apple juice. Stir in rolled oats. Serve.

title: Swedish Meat
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, cubed | 1 lb ground turkey | 1/2 cup dried walnuts, cut in half | 3 small radishes, sliced finely
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour. Reduce heat to low, cook for 3 hours. Serve with rice, spaetzle or noodles.

title: Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 20 -24 frozen precooked cheese tortellini | chili pepper flakes | 1 sheet phyllo dough
instructions: Cook tortellini in 4 cups boiling salted water for 10 minutes or until tender and drain. Add 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes to taste. Cut tortellini into 1/2 inch strips, and fold to coat. Place about 1 tblsp of filling in center of tortellini, place a strip of phyllo, fold over, and then wrap the entire tortellini up around it, securing with a wooden toothpicks. Place on a greased baking sheet coated with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,chambord raspberry liquor,navy bean,green cardamom pod,chicken
title: Naked White Bean Chambord
ingredients: 1 lb dried navy beans ( navy beans also known as great northern beans may be used ) | 1 whole chicken, about 3 1/2 lbs., washed and cut into 8 pieces | 12 green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon naney vinegar | 2 tablespoons chambord raspberry liquor
instructions: Place beans in a large dutch oven or heavy medium frying pan. Add enough water to cover the beans by at least 3 inches, and bring to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer uncovered, about 1 hour. Add green cardamom pods and naney and boil about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add chicken and cook covered over very low heat until meat is tender, or about 15 minutes longer. Remove pieces of meat and set aside. Skim fat from cooking liquid and add enough strained bean cooking water to make a 2 to 3 cup liquid consistency. Pour chambord into reserved bean cooking liquid and add enough to moisten beans. Simmer uncovered over low heat about 30 minutes or until thickened.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,mexican oregano,molasses,taco seasoning mix,provolone cheese,hot sauce
title: Chi Chi's Mexican Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2 packages phyllo pastry sheets | 1 cup molasses | 2 cups shredded provolone cheese | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | hot sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Sprinkle 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons taco seasoning on each sheet of phyllo sheets. Combine molasses and remaining taco seasoning.

title: Easy, Simple, Tasty Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 can italian stewed tomatoes | 1 medium spanish onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: Drain tomatoes, reserving about 1/2 cup liquid. Blend all ingredients in a blender, except tomato liquid, in a medium bowl until almost smooth. Add tomato liquid.

title: Pineapple-onion Sauce
ingredients: 4 cans crushed pineapple in juice | 1 bunch fresh pineapple in juice | 1/4 cup chopped canned onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons drained capers, drained
instructions: Stir pineapple with juice, onion soup mix and capers together in a large bowl. Refrigerate until flavors blend, at least 1 hour.

title: Quick Fix Thai Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cucumber, washed, peeled, and diced into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup thai red chili pepper, chopped into bite-size pieces | 1/4 cup bay leaf
instructions: Place all ingredients into a bowl. Toss and enjoy.

title: My Special Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dry ramen noodles ( any flavor ) | 4 tablespoons flax seeds
instructions: Break noodles into individual portions and place in a microwavable plastic bag. Microwave on high 1 minute or the package directs. Stir every few minutes. Remove noodles from bag. Toss with flax seeds and keep on a paper towel. Microwave 2 more minutes or until heated through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,mayonnaise,french bread,potato flake,baking potato,bay leaf,sugar,fennel bulb
title: Cauliflower & Fennel Chips
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 1/2 cm thick chips | 1 fennel bulb, trimmed, very thinly sliced and very thinly sliced | 1 large bay leaf | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder ( or try bread and butter ) | 1/4 cup flour | 1 -3 cup mayonnaise ( i used miracle whip ) | 1 teaspoon sugar | 2 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place baking potato wedges on a greased baking tray and set aside. Pour cold water into the microwave to between 2 and 3mm/1/4 in depth so as to be able to submerge the potato pieces. Turn on high and add a few dashes of salt if desired. Cook about 5 minutes or until the potato chips are crispy. Remove from the microwave and transfer to a large mixing bowl. Add fennel, bay leaf and 1/4 tsp of the baking powder to the potatoes. Using a fork or a wooden spoon mix well. If the chips are sticking together, break them up with your hands, so that they soften and become crispy again. Add the flour and mix lightly. Add the mayonnaise, sugar and lime juice and mix until well combined. Add more or less of just the mixture if necessary. The chips can then be stored in an airtight container for up to 2 days. The chips can also be stored for up to 4 weeks in an airtight container. Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. Keeps well for months.

title: Homemade Beef Gravy

instructions: Prepare your favorite recipe, recipe #230316, using 1 gallon water, and using a 4 gallon can of beef consomme and 1 gallon can of beef consomme in the water or beef consume. Bring to a boil. Pour in the tamari, sweet soy sauce, and kosher salt.

title: Raspberry and Meatball
ingredients: 2 cups slivered almonds | 1 package frozen meatballs | 3 cups frozen raspberries in milk | 1/2 cup sliced almonds, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 cups almond milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line an 11x7 inch baking dish with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine 1 cup slivered almonds and frozen meatballs, and mix to combine. Spoon meatballs in the baking dish, and sprinkle with remaining slivered almonds. Bake in preheated oven until almonds are golden and meatballs are cooked through, about 30 minutes. Stir remaining cup slivered almonds into the raspberries, and pour over meatballs. Return to oven, and bake until puffed, lightly browned, and sauce has thickened, about 30 minutes.

title: Cold Beef Tips
ingredients: 1 can beef sirloin, with juice, or | 1 can stewed beef broth | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | tamari ( optional ) or soy sauce, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and let stand at room temperature for at least one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,turkey,pineapple juice,fish,raisin,baby carrot,ancho chile powder,extra tofu
title: Tropical Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 lb extra firm tofu, cut into 1/2 slices | 1 cup unsweetened pineapple juice | 4 tablespoons fish sauce | 6 bone-in skin-on chicken breast halves, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons ancho chile powder | 1/4 lb turkey, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Freeze tofu, if desired, 30 minutes. Slice crosswise into thin slices, then cut into thirds. Place tofu between 2 slices waxed paper or a plate.

title: Easy Spicy BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 1 can green chili peppers, minced | 1/2 cup ketchup
instructions: Combine all in a small saucepan, cook, stirring constantly to prevent scorching until heated to your desired thickness.

title: Spicy Prawns With Papaya Shrimp
ingredients: 400 g smoked papayas ( a medium prawn ) | 1/3 cup chopped fresh coriander ( or 1 1/2 tsp. dried ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh basil sprigs | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh red chili peppers
instructions: Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat. Add the prawn and fry quickly until just opaque. Turn and continue cooking until cooked through, about 2 minutes total, depending on the size of the prawns, and set aside. Add the coriander, basil and chilies and cook for 1 minute, stirring. Slice the papayas in half lengthwise, remove the shells, place the flesh upright in a serving dish. Spoon the sauce over and serve immediately.

title: Amaretto Butter
ingredients: 1 cup ghee or 1 cup other clarified butter | 1/2 cup amaretto ( almond extract ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ghee ( clarified butter )
instructions: Gather all the ingredients and mix well. Cover and shake the mixture until it begins to melt in the ghee and then set it aside and let it cool slightly before using as a butter spread. Enjoy.

title: Coconut Nuts And Romaine
ingredients: 1 bag romaine lettuce, separated into leaves | 1 can light cream of coconut cream ( not the thick, creamy variety. the cream of coconut may be too heavy for crunch. ) | kosher salt, to taste | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, cut in half and in quarters
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and add the romaine and tomatoes. Cover and cook over medium to medium low heat for 10 minutes until tender, then drain. Stir the drained tomatoes, coconut cream, salt and cherries into the salad. Chill 4 hours before serving. Toss well before serving.

title: Sydney Sweet Spice Mix I
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon ground celery seed
instructions: Mix ingredients together, and store in air tight container.

title: Pork Carnitas (Carnitas)
ingredients: 6 lbs pork shoulder | 4 teaspoons black peppercorns ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leave | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 -2 teaspoon dried thyme leave, crushed
instructions: Prepare the pork by removing the strings between the thighs and the ribs. Rub the peppercorns and dried thyme leaves evenly in the meat. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and 1 - 2 teaspoon of crushed dried thyme leaves to the meat. Roll back and forth so it is coated with the oil and seasonings. Wrap the pork in aluminium foil and put tightly in a pan. Heat the oven to 325 degrees. Cook for 3 1/2 4 hours, turning the pork every 20 - 25 minutes. Remove from the oven and discard the foil. Cool completely then slice thinly.

title: Tunisian Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon fesh thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand ( ground into a powder ) | 3 -4 french bread, toasted | oil, to brush
instructions: Place sliced cucumbers in food processor and pulse until finely chopped. Add remaining ingredients and process until desired consistency.

title: Avocado Fusilli
ingredients: 200 g fusilli | 2 avocados ( ripe, very ripe ) | 2 cups bouillon ( or equivalent granules )
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and fry the pasta until it is al dente. Meanwhile cut the avocados into small pieces. Drain the pasta and mix with the avocados and bouillon. Heat for a couple of minutes until it becomes heated through but not boiling. Serves 4 as an accompaniment. Note, for those who like the idea of keeping the calories as low as possible, you can use 1 cup of homemade croutons instead of the bouillon and 1 cup of strained, chopped olive milk. You can add chopped parsley to the avocado mixture if the fusilli has reached your desired taste.

Random Ingredients: coffee,ginger garlic paste,corn,kosher salt black pepper,red wine vinegar,monosodium glutamate,green pea
title: Chinese Style Green Peas and Corn Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces frozen green peas, thawed | 1 tablespoon dried corn | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 cup dry red wine vinegar | 2 ounces ginger-garlic paste | 2 large leaves fresh turkish-style corn, husked and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( msg )
instructions: Place the green peas and dried corn into a medium pot, and add water to cover by at least 2 inches. Bring to a boil over high heat, and then add the red wine vinegar, ginger garlic paste, turkish style corn, and monosodium glutamate. Reduce heat to low, and continue cooking until the peas are tender and creamy, about 90 minutes. If the soup is too thick, you can thin down with water. Let cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: scallop,walnut oil,vanilla essence,romaine lettuce,marjoram,gruyere cheese,cottage cheese
title: Scallops and Cheese in Olive Oil
ingredients: 2 lbs mixed scallops | 12 slices gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 2 tablespoons paprika or 2 tablespoons hot paprika | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 can whole milk cheese | 3 tablespoons cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Oil a jelly roll pan or large shallow baking dish. Remove the crusts from the cheese. Heat a large nonstick skillet. Dry the cheese with a paper towel, then sprinkle evenly with the paprika. Stir the mixture, 1/2 tablespoon each of the oil and cheese, and the marjoram together and pour into the hot skillet. Cook, turning once, until browned, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, drain cheese mixture onto paper towels. Place half the scallops on the cheese, then top with half of the cheese mixture. Repeat, ending with the remaining scallops. Spread the remaining cheese mixture on top of the filling while it's on the top. Bake on the middle rack of the oven for about 25 minutes, or until the surface of the topping is crisp and golden. Serve hot.

title: Spring Rolls Wrapped Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thigh fillets | 1 tablespoon wild rice | 5 spring roll wrappers
instructions: Wash the chicken thights and cut them into 4 equal pieces. Rinse the rice and soak it in water for at least 20 minutes. Spray a large frypan with veggie and oil spray. Fry the chicken until they are browned and cooked inside. The timing will depend on the size of your chicken pieces. Remove the chicken thights and place on a paper towel lined plate. Spray the inside of a spring roll wrapper with veggie oil spray and fill with a teaspoonful of chicken stuffing. Moisten the outside edges of the wrapper with water, then fold to form a log. Repeat with the remaining wrappers.

title: Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, cleaned, dried and torn into pieces | 1 gallon whole milk | 1 cup bread flour | paprika ( per taste )
instructions: In a large pot, put lettuce, milk, bread flour, salt and pepper on high heat. Stir until it bubbles and turn down to medium low heat but don´t let the bubbles scare. The bread will soon absorb the milk. It will eventually absorb all the milk. Once done, remove from heat and allow to cool so it is room temperature so the bread is less likely to stick to your fingers. Put it in a large bowl, put clean hands in each hand and turn over once to coat each side of bread. Cover with a towel and let ferment at room temperature for two to three hours. This step can take up to 24 hours. After it’s incubated, take it out and put the bread in a large bowl and cover with a towel to keep it warm. Refrigerate the bread in an air tight container until all of it’s used and the bread will become dry. Take it out of the refrigerator a few hours prior to serving. Note, prep time does not include 2 hours for fermentation, but the yield can be doubled. Serve bread with fresh fruit or citrus juices.

title: Cranberry Beef Roll-Up
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef chuck or 1/2 lb round roast | 4 flour tortillas, warmed | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the meat. Cut it into 1 pieces. Sprinkle the pieces with salt, if desired. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the dried cranberries over the meat, leaving 1/4 inch at the edges. Roll up each piece.

title: Homemade Yogurt Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt ( unflavored ) | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a heavy duty plastic bowl and stir to blend well. Heat a skllow or frying pan over medium heat. When the ketchup comes to a boil, immediately pour it over the cheese. Let stand for 10 minutes to blend the flavors. Transfer to a small serving plate and serve with crackers, if desired.

Random Ingredients: bacon,orange blossom water,caraway seed,cardamom pod,red onion
title: Ethiopian Bacon Salad
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/4 cup orange blossom water | 1/4 cup red onion, coarsely chopped | 2 whole cardamom pods
instructions: Cook bacon in a small nonstick skillet until crispy. Reserve the drippings. Place the caraway seeds in a small bowl. Place the orange blossom water in a small saucepan. In a medium bowl, pour in the orange blossom water. Add the green onion. When the green onions are tender, pour the orange blossom water over them. When the vegetables are warmed, turn them to coat in the orange blossom water. Let sit for about 10 minutes to soften, stirring occasionally, before serving.

title: Elswet's Mango Linguine Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces linguine | 4 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh mango julienned chili peppers | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning or 1/4 teaspoon mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 2 tablespoons shredded colby-monterey jack cheese blend
instructions: Cook linguine as package directs. Meanwhile, mix sour cream, mango, chili powder, and steak seasoning together in a bowl. Toss linguine with sour cream mixture and add to cheese mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Lime Salt (For Water Bath)
ingredients: lime wedge ( lime wheel size ) | clear honey
instructions: Mix the lime wedge, clear honey and salt together. Apply on your favourite favourite wet/dry rub. Cover if using wet brush with clear honey.

title: French Country Risotto With Fennel, Rice and Sour Cream

instructions: Boil the jasmine rice until tender and drain. Place the tortillas in a microwave safe bowl. Cover with boiling water, microwave on high power for 30 seconds or until pliable. Using a fork, push the tortillas through the chute. Drain the rice and discard extra water. Add the rice to the jasmine rice and spread with flat side of the bowl. Mix tomato soup, fennel, savory and black pepper in a separate bowl and spread evenly over the rice. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside in the warmest oven. Turn on the stove top. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes, or until heated through. Remove plastic wrap and allow to stand for 1 minute. Using a slotted spoon, transfer risotto onto platter. Serve with sour cream and slices of french country bread.

instructions: Combine the onions, sugar and anchovy in a large bowl and coat well. Add the rice and beer and mix gently. Then stir through the chopped baby spinach and eggs. Serve either hot or cold.

title: Spice Island Corn Bread

instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a moderately hot oven 190° c for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Chicken in Strawberry Sauce

instructions: Cover chicken with water.

title: Fried Rice

instructions: Divide rice among 4 small bowl.

title: Artichoke Potato Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen artichoke hearts | 1/4 cup whipping cream ( or you may use 2 tbsp ) | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 1/4 cups frozen hash brown potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Thaw and rinse artichoke hearts. Place on cookie sheet and sprinkle with garlic powder. Bake for 35 minutes or until tender. While artichokes are baking mix together the cheese and sour cream with the hashbrowns, microwave until just warmed through. Pour over baked potatoes and bake, tossing with a spatula, about 30 minutes or until golden brown.

instructions: Preheat broiler. In a large nonstick skillet cook the chorizo and cherries over medium heat, stirring frequently, until the sausage is no longer pink.

instructions: Place the rice, orange juice concentrate, brandy, rice wine, and hot sauce in a pot and bring to a boil over medium heat. Cover and reduce the heat to a simmer. instructions: Wash Duck in cold, salted water. Combine sausage, ham, olives and coriander. Stuff cavity of duck, stuffing stuffing with stuffing and put in a 9 square baking dish. title: Cherry and Orange Olive Cake

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Place all ingredients in a large bowl and beat until well combined. Grease an 8 or 9 inch square cake tin. title: Snow Pea and Lime Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant dry yeast | 1 cup plus 1 tablespoon lukewarm water | 2 cups snow peas, strings removed
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Add 1 cup plus 1 tablespoon of the lime zest.

title: Simple and Easy Guacamole
ingredients: 1 large head red cabbage | 1 lime | 1/4 cup guacamole, for topping
instructions: Wash, core, and shred the cabbage finely. Cut the lime into quarters, squeeze the juice from the other half and cut into quarters again. Transfer the lime slices and guacamole to a medium to large bowl. Add the shredded cabbage and toss to combine. Serve with tortilla chips, if desired.

title: Mandarin Salad III
ingredients: 1 package instant couscous | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 3/4 cup chopped romaine lettuce, or more to taste | 2 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar, or more as needed
instructions: Combine couscous, mandarin oranges, and romaine lettuce together in a bowl. Sprinkle more confectioners' sugar over salad.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,molasses,white cabbage,roast beef
title: Chinese Five-Spice Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 cup packed chinese five spice powder | 1/4 cup molasses or 1/4 cup dark molasses | 8 ounces frozen deli-sliced roast beef slices | 1 bag shredded white cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. Combine and mix all ingredients, refrigerate. Place beef slices in a greased 9x13 pan. Bake, uncovered for about 30 minutes. Top with cabbage and bake for another 15 minutes. Serve as is or with mustard on the side.

title: Ginger Pakodas
ingredients: 2 cups gram flour | 20 -25 drops cornflour | 2 cups refined flour | 200 ml green chilies, slit vertically | 200 g yellow peppers, slit vertically | 1/4 inch ginger paste
instructions: Heat a pan on medium heat. Apply a little water in it. Sieve and make a small hole in the centre of the gram flour. Add cornflour and mix it well with the help of a spoon. Add gramflour to this. Keep stirring to ensure that the batter does not stick to the pan. Add green chillies, yellow peppers and ginger paste. Mix well. Keep aside. Now pour gram flour batter in a deep, curved, thick based pan. Cook on high heat. When the oil comes out, the mixture will fall onto the pan in small circular motions. This takes approximately 10 minutes if mixing with wok, 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Transfer the mixture onto a platter. Serve hot with chappathi or rice. Neeelicious.

title: Cheezy Italian Baked Fingers
ingredients: 8 ounces finely chopped jicama | 2 ounces shredded pepperoni | 2 ounces finely chopped pepperoni | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring ( such as paul prudhomme's ) | 16 -20 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. In a large mixing bowl, combine jicama, pepperoni, pepperoni, liquid smoke and enough hot water to cover the jicama and pepperoni. Mix all ingredients but your ladyfingers, together thoroughly. Place in ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 300 oven for 30 minutes, or until nicely browned. Let cool 5 minutes, and spread to cool on sheet of plastic wrap. Remove the ladyfingers from the pan while still warm, and spread with melted butter. Cut into fingers, and serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,greek feta cheese,collard green,chicken wing,red potato,white onion,champagne
title: Stuffed Collard Greens, and French Fries Too
ingredients: 15 -20 ounces frozen collard greens | 6 small red potatoes, peeled halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons coarsely grated white onion | 2 lbs fresh chicken wings, thawed in cold water and cut in 1/2 | garlic powder ( just grind to a paste ) | 1 bottle of your favourite dry champagne or ( 8 ounce ) bottle dry red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup crumbled greek feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to rinse the collard greens well and place them in a casserole dish or large roasting pan. Slice the potatoes lengthwise in half, and cut around one length. Peel and slice the onions in half, and place them in a bowl. Cut the chicken wings in half and place in a large bowl. Salt and pepper generously, then sprinkle garlic paste all over the chicken and onions. Pour wine over the chicken and onions, and cover. Stir to mix thoroughly, refrigerate at least 1 hour. Remove lid, and return to oven until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are lightly browned at the edges, about 1 - ½ hours. Remove chicken to a plate and drain off all liquid into a colander. Reserve liquid. Sprinkle collard greens with cheese, and place in serving bowl. Serve as much cheese as you like, stirring up each bowl periodically to distribute cheese on the collard greens and potatoes, especially if you plan on presenting this entrée in a large round pita alongside rice and beans as a lunch or appetizer for lunch. You could also place the collard greens and potatoes inside a large round flat dish dish, such as a flatbread or similar, just like you would a flat bread loaf. Bake your french fries according to package directions, and sprinkle with additional cheese while still hot. Serve hot.

title: Strawberry Port Wine (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: fresh rosemary ( to garnish ) | 1 pint fresh strawberries, hulled | 1 jar pimiento ( drained ) | 2 tablespoons dry port wine ( optional )
instructions: Drain and discard the stems of the fresh strawberries. Gently cut or slice the remaining 4 strawberries. Add the sliced strawberries into a nonreactive bowl, add the pimentos. Place the wine on the table, so the guests have a table table to help themselves. Sprinkle the port with fresh rosemary and serve with warm pumpernickel bread, rye bread or crackers.

title: Tropical Leek and Apricot Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb leek, cleaned, trimmed, thickly sliced | 2 ounces dried apricots, sliced | 3 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Add the leeks to a pan of salted boiling water and boil for 5 minutes, just until tender, drain and leave covered. Meanwhile rinse and drain the apricots. Toss the leeks with the apricots, leeks and guacamole and place in a serving bowl.

title: Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 pound sauerkraut | 2 pounds beef tenderloins | 1/4 cup butter | 3 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Place sauerkraut in a large bowl, and toss with enough water to cover. Let soak 15 minutes, drain, and refrigerate. Slice beef into 1/4 inch thick slices, and soak in butter with sauerkraut. Spread the beef onto an unlined platter, and top with sauerkraut slices.

title: A Unique Steak Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 3 slices steak | 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 cup elbow macaroni | 25 lettuce leaves
instructions: Prepare beef according to manufacturers instructions on recipe. Mix sugar and macaroni together. Slightly thicken gravy with 2 teaspoons of water then pour into a small dish to dip lettuce leaves.

title: Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces mushrooms, fresh, chopped | 2 spring onions, sliced
instructions: Place mushrooms and spring onions in a pan and heat gently. Do not boil. Pour soup into small soup bowls and serve.

title: Zucchini Almond Cremoso
ingredients: 6 medium zucchini, about 1 pound, halved lengthwise | 1/4 cup soy sauce, low-sodium | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 2/3 cup almonds, coarsely chopped, about 3/4 cup | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Cook zucchini in a large pot of boiling water just until tender, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and let cool. Press between paper towels until cool. Peel. Cut zucchini crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Transfer to a bowl and toss with soy sauce, lemon zest, coriander, half of the almonds and 1/3 cup cheese. Toss to coat.

title: Chicken in Pernod
ingredients: 3 cups cooked chicken breasts | 1 cup crushed pernod | 2 packets dry yeast, powder ( one teaspoon of each will be enough to bind together for binding together and make it taste good )
instructions: Boil breasts and drain. Mix in pernod if needed and mix well. Allow to cool. Shape the dough into 2 balls and cover with plastic wrap. Let rise until dough has doubled in size. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place on tray and sprinkle top with a bit of salt. Bake for approximately 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,ham hock,cider vinegar,rice wine,white flour,asiago cheese,bulgar wheat,cabbage
title: Linguica's Asiago Cheese Slaw
ingredients: 3 packages white flour, seasoned according to instructions on box | 1 package garlic and herb seasoning seasoning | 1/2 onion powder | 1/2 head cabbage, cut into thin sticks | 1 head asiago cheese, cut into thin strips | 3/4 cup cider vinegar | 3/4 cup rice wine | 3 cups bulgur wheat
instructions: Prepare a large container of salted water, or make your own, and store in the refrigerator for later use.

Random Ingredients: squash,bay leaf,black tea,self rising flour,rigatoni pasta,cheddar cheese,pizza sauce,marsala wine
title: Cheesy Mini Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked rigatoni pasta | 2 quarts pizza sauce | 1 bay leaf | 1 teaspoon black tea | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine | 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1 cup shredded mozzarella-style cheddar cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: tahini,fillet catfish,oil,cream tartar,dill leaf,chili sauce,marsala wine,ladyfinger
title: Spicy Catfish Fillets With Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1/2 cup cream of tartar | 4 fillets catfish | 5 -6 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 1/4 cup grated low-fat italian five cheese or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup chopped dill leaves | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/3 - 1/2 teaspoon oil
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together cream of tartar and 1 tbsp of tahini until well blended. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. In a large bowl, combine catfish fillets and mix well with cream of tahini mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 1 hour. For salsa verde, combine remaining tahini mixture, chili sauce, cheese until creamy. Preheat oven to in another bowl, combine remaining tahini mixture, dill, oil, and hot pepper. Spray a nonstick pan with cooking spray.

title: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1 large head finely shredded cabbage ( approx 6 ounces ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Place cabbage and parsley in a bowl. Sprinkle with salt to taste. Mix well, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serve with pita bread and/or pita chips.

title: English Muffin Melts With Vanilla and Fresh Mozzarella.
ingredients: 12 english muffins, split | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
instructions: Toast muffins and spread each with equal amounts of the vanilla extract. Allow to cool for 3 minutes. Place english muffins on a small serving plate, and spoon a dollop of hot vanilla butter over each. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,cocoa,green chili pepper,mace,bay leaf,chunky salsa,vegetable broth,gouda cheese
title: Chile Con Queso (Spanish Onion Soup)
ingredients: 2 medium onions, chopped | 1/2 cup unsweetened chunky salsa or 1/2 cup picante sauce | 3 cups vegetable broth | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace or 1/4 teaspoon mexican creole seasoning | 1/2 large bay leaf | 1 -2 ounce smoked gouda cheese, cut into 1 in. chunks | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Place onions in a 5 qt pan. In a small bowl, stir together the salsa, broth, onion soup mix, mace, and bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, covered, 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaf. Ladle into bowls.

Random Ingredients: nonfat vanilla yogurt,spaghetti sauce,tortilla,onion soup mix,chili sauce,black forest ham
title: Quick and Easy Spaghetti Barbecue
ingredients: 1 box spaghetti sauce | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 cup shredded nonfat vanilla frozen yogurt | 1 pound fully cooked lean ground beef and ham | 1 package tortillas | 1 jar prepared chili sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread spaghetti sauce evenly on the bottom of a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle unprepared onion soup mix on top of spaghetti sauce. Place the ground meat on top of the soup mix and top with yogurt. Wrap tortillas around the meat. Bake in the preheated oven until meat is browned and crumbly, about 45 minutes.

title: Raspberry & Cheddar Quesadillas
ingredients: 16 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons raspberry syrup | 2 teaspoons rum extract
instructions: Combine remaining ingredients in bowl & set aside. With a large non stick frying pan heat one side of the cooking pan until lightly toasted. Top the quesadilla w/the cheese mixture & cook for 3 - 4 minutes, flipping once. Serve w/swiss cheese sauce.

Random Ingredients: sherry,oyster sauce,cod,red curry paste,baking soda,linguine,lettuce leaf
title: Lettuce and Cod
ingredients: 350 g cod, fillet, cut into 1cm chunks | 2 tablespoons mild red curry paste | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | sherry, extra | 1 teaspoon baking soda | lettuce leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Place cod in a baking dish. Combine curry paste, sherry and oyster sauce. Pour over fish and bake for 15 minutes. Sprinkle baking soda over fish mixture and cook for a further 5 - 10 minutes until fish is cooked to your liking and flakes of fish are all gone. Place lettuce leaves on four serving plates, top with fish and drizzle over extra sherry over. Serve topped with steamed jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,orange zest,italian bread,egg yolk,cider vinegar,green chili pepper
title: Orange Marinated Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef top sirloin, cut into 3/4-inch thick strips | 1 cup sliced mixed green chili pepper, seeds and ribs removed | 1 cup egg yolk | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 2 italian rolls, cut in half lengthwise
