instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Combine all strips of beef, chili peppers, egg yolk, vinegar, and zest in a large sealable bag. Seal tightly and shake to combine. Transfer to a greased rimmed baking sheet. Insert meat strips in rolls. Cover and let stand in a cold oven for 30 minutes. Bake, covered, for 15 to 20 minutes or until beef is tender and sauce has thickened slightly. Serve hot.

title: Tarte Tatin (Tarte Tatin De Patate)
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen sweet puff pastry, defrosted | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. On top of a double thickness of parchment paper that has been folded over two pieces of parchment paper place a pastry stick and fold over into a triangle, approximately 10 or 11 inches long. Keep the folded pastry wrap as it will continue to stretch up as it cooks. Place the triangle, 1 at a time, onto the pastry wrapped parchment paper. Brush surface of triangles with vodka, sprinkle with zest and bake for 8 min or until very crisp.

title: Apple Sugar Snap Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green snap peas | 3/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 medium apples, peeled, cored, and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat a large, heavy stockpot over medium heat. Add the snap peas and cook until just tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the pan and drain. Place the pan over medium high heat. Add the vinegar to the skillet and cook, stirring, until a rich golden color has begun to develop. Add the orange slices to the skillet and cook until slightly browned, about 3 minutes. Add the snap peas to the pan and toss. Serve.

title: Goose Tacos
ingredients: 1 whole goat | 2 cups coconut milk | 1/4 cup cola | 2 tablespoons whole mixed anchos, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup whole crispy salted anchos | 1/2 teaspoon cajun spice blend or white anchovy salt, to taste
instructions: Soak the goat feet in a large quantity of salt water. Soak overnight in a large pot of water. Squeeze out the excess water and rinse your goat feet. Cut into 2 1/2 wide strips. Preheat an outdoor grill pan on the grill at a medium high heat. Remove from heat and spray with a non stick cooking spray such as pam. Place the goat feet on the grill. Sprinkle the coco and salt over both sides of the goat feet. Grill the goat feet for about 15 minutes, turning over once with tongs, until they are fully cooked. To serve, spoon small amounts of the coconut milk and cola into each taco shell. Garnish with chopped salted anchos and whole crispy salted anchos.

title: Grilled Kielbasa
ingredients: 4 pounds kielbasa, cut into 2 inch squares | 2 stalks lemon grass, chopped | 1 can or bottle light beer
instructions: Tear kielbasa into large pieces and place in a covered bowl or resealable plastic bag. Add in lemon grass and beer. Stir to coat. Let sit for 6 hours in the refrigerator, or overnight. Towards the end of 6 hours, remove kielbasa and discard marinade.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,cream mushroom soup,tomato,beef stew meat,pork tenderloin,tart apple,garlic powder
title: Tuscan Beef Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 can petite diced tomatoes | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 3/4 lb penne pasta, cooked | 2 tart apples, grated ( for topping )
instructions: Preheat oven to place meat and garlic powder in 13x9 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Brown meat on all sides. Remove from skillet. Pour off fat from pan. Add all cans of soup, undrained, and undrained tomatoes. Bring to a boil. Pour mixture over meat. Top with bread crumbs and grated apples. Bake for 30 minutes, or until meat is tender, stirring twice. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Spiced Apples With Quinoa - Low Fat
ingredients: 3 cups quinoa, raw | 4 tart apples ( such as golden delicious ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 2 teaspoons hazelnuts | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Pour the quinoa into a large saucepan, add water to just cover, to bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Dice the apples and add to the quinoa. Cover and add the lemon pepper and hazelnuts. Cover and cook at 350°f for 45 - 60 minutes. Remove from the heat and let sit covered for 10 minutes. Cut the loaf in half lengthwise and scoop out the bread from the interior without removing the bread.

title: Pasta With Squids and Chili
ingredients: 300 g squid | 2 green chili, whole | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 small lemon | 250 -250 g pasta
instructions: Clean squid under running water, cut with a knife in half. Reserve both for later. Place squid in saucepan half full of water. Boil then boil over moderate heat for ten minutes, until just cooked. Discard squid. Cool briefly and slice tentacles. Chop tentacles and tentacles into large chunks. Cut squid into rounds, about 1/4” x ½”, and remove centre muscle. Add squid, fennel seeds and lemon juice and toss well. Serve with lots of freshly chopped basil and lots of grated fresh parmigiano.

title: Yellow Squash and Pistachio Pizza
ingredients: 1 medium yellow squash, peeled and cut into thin strips and then into thin strips | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon crushed fennel seed | 7 tablespoons pistachios, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons smooth pistachios, toasted, coarsely chopped | 1 pre-baked pizza crust
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200 degrees c. Line a baking sheet with non stick baking paper. Spread sliced squash into an 8 inch round. In a small bowl with a lid stir together the vinegar, shallots, fennel seeds and 1/4 cup pistachios. Spread the pistachio mixture over the squash and put in the oven for 25 minutes. Remove from the oven and sprinkle pizza base with remaining pistachios. Return it to the oven and bake for about 10 minutes or until it starts to bubble. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.

title: Green Pea Cakes for Sizzling Fish
ingredients: 250 g green peas | 200 g fresh coriander | 1 kg medium sized red snapper or 1 kg prawns | 100 g roasted peanuts
instructions: Heat a large frying pan on medium heat. Add the coriander and peanuts and toast slightly. Add the peanuts to the nuts. Slightly fry the greenpeas and coriander. Remove. Put aside. Grill the snapper or prawns, either with the side of the fish or with the skin of the fish. The fish should just change colour. Turn once. If you want, if you are using a whole fish and not just with prawns serve them as a starter or topping for a starter.

Random Ingredients: salsa,pineapple juice,beef,red pepper flake,wheat tortilla,lemon,ciabatta lengthwise,pistachio nut
title: Ww  Mexican Hamburgers With Pitas
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons salsa ( chunky ) | 2 tablespoons pineapples in light syrup or 2 tablespoons unsweetened pineapple juice ( chunky ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons reduced-fat ciabatta rolls, split and toasted | 2 teaspoons reduced-fat pistachio nuts, coarsely minced | 1/4 cup lime juice or 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup roasted pistachio nut, coarsely minced
instructions: Mix ground beef with salsa, pineapples, red pepper flakes and ciabatta rolls. Shape into 4 patties and place on cookie sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Combine the chopped pistachios and lime juice. Gently press patties into pistachios until coated on all sides. Grill patties until no longer pink inside, about 3 minutes per side. Or grill on each side and serve on a toasted pita with the lime juice glaze.

title: Spanish Corn and Herb Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked corn | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 teaspoon minced jalapeno | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 cup prepared marinara sauce or jarred spaghetti sauce, divided | 1 package mixed salad greens
instructions: Cook corn and broth in saucepan over medium heat 10 minutes or until corn is desired tenderness, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in next 5 ingredients.

title: Piggy Fritters (Australia)
ingredients: 12 ounces coleslaw mix | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 4 ounces pork, shaved | 4 tablespoons cheese, grated ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons lemon juice
instructions: Mix the cream of tartar and grated cheese and lemon juice together. Mix everything together and add more cheese if desired. Stir fry or grill meat to desired doneness. Serve fritters with salad and tomato salad.

title: Pasta and Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 cup dried pinto beans or 1 cup kidney beans, picked over and rinsed | 1 lb beet, about 3 cups, washed, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces | 1/4 cup ice water | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 cup ice, for serving | 1 cup cooked farfalle pasta, to serve
instructions: Place beans in a large pot and add enough water so they are easy to pick up. Bring to a slow boil and cook, covered, until beans are tender. Drain well and set aside to cool. Remove the beets from the liquid into a bowl, discarding water. Break up the beans with your fingers and combine with the cooked beet mixture. Add ice water, garam masala, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.

title: Easy Mexican Hot Dressing
ingredients: 1 medium head fresh bean sprout | 1/4 cup salsa | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or to taste
instructions: Place bean sprouts into a medium glass bowl. Add salsa, and toss to coat the sprouts. Sprinkle with cinnamon if desired before serving.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,green olive,dark sesame oil,dark chocolate,asparagus
title: Asparagus With Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs asparagus | 1 lb bacon drippings ( for deep frying ) | 4 ounces dark chocolate | 12 green olives, pitted and chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the spaghetti and cook, stirring occasionally until just tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain and set aside. Heat the drippings in a deep fryer or large saucepan over medium high heat. In 10 to 12 inch saucers, fry the asparagus until golden, about 2 minutes. Remove and set aside to drain on paper towels. Pour in enough extra drippings to coat the bottom of the saucepan. When the asparagus has drained, add the chocolate, stirring to melt. Stir until the chocolate is smooth. Cut asparagus into 1 inch lengths and fold them in half. Add the asparagus to the hot chocolate. Stir until the asparagus is coated with the chocolate sauce. Sprinkle with the olives. Serve immediately.

title: Anchovy & Celery Spread
ingredients: 250 g baby ricotta cheese | 200 g dried anchovy paste | 1 stalk celery
instructions: Put the ricotta in a bowl and stir in the anchovy paste. Add the celery, adjust seasoning if necessary. Serve with crudgy bread.

title: Lemon Caesar Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salad oil | 4 chicken thighs | 1 lemon pepper | 1/2 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Combine the salad oil and lemon pepper in a bowl to prepare the vinaigrette. Rinse chicken under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut the chicen into large pieces and marinate on the counter for 15 minutes. Heat the oil in a skillet and fry chicken pieces, about 3 - 5 minutes on each side. You may add a little more oil if necessary. Remove chicken and add salt to desired taste. Serve with salads.

title: Crock Pot Vietnamese-Style Fish, Mushrooms, Tomatoes & Chicken Broth
ingredients: 1 can whole fish, drained | 3 -4 mushrooms ( can use fresh if desired ) | 1 can chicken bouillon ( or other flavour of choice )
instructions: Mix all ingredients using a wire whisk or hand held mixer or in whatever order you like to your food.

title: Vegetarian Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 packages kielbasa | 1 can vegetarian refried beans, heated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the kielbasa into a 9x13 inch baking dish with the beans in the bottom. Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven, or until browned lightly.

title: Spinach and Endive Stew
ingredients: 200 g spinach | 200 g curly endive | 3 tablespoons coriander leaves | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1 pinch ground cumin | 1 pinch ground coriander leaves
instructions: Wash the leaves thoroughly and tear them down into a colander. Cut the endive in quarter lengthwise and clean them with a sharp knife. Wash and dry all vegetables and keep them to the side with spinach. Put a tablespoon of each of the coriander on your palm in the centre of your palm and sprinkle a few grains of roasted cumin and a pinch of ground coriander over it. Place the spinach in a pan of boiling water and simmer, without colouring, for ten minutes over a high heat. Take off the heat and strain the excess liquid to a small clear saucepan. Heat up the leftover water and add the liquid to the saucepan. Toss in the coriander leaves and serve with boiled rice.

title: Greek Cherry Vodka Cocktail
ingredients: 1 ounce vodka | 4 ounces feta cheese | 4 cherries
instructions: In a tumbler combine vodka, feta cheese and cherries.

title: Easy Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 12 large dried red chilies | 200 g bean paste | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Toast the chillies in oil and place in a blender with the paste. Blend to a paste. Pour over any remaining oil in a pan and bring to the boil. Add seasoning and then add the beans paste. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes. Allow to cool and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: coffee liqueur,graham cracker crust,ghee,thai chile,golden syrup,double cream,ham,cider vinegar
title: Smoked Ham Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 ready made graham cracker crust ( or make your own crust ) | 250 g smoked ham, chopped | 120 ml sweetened condensed double cream | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 thai chile, minced | 1 tablespoon brewed coffee liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven 120c / 325f degrees. Mix together crumb & filling ingredients. Press into your prepared crust.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,vanilla,flat leaf parsley,dark amber maple syrup
title: Caramelized Ladyfingers
ingredients: 3/4 cup dark amber maple syrup or 3/4 cup light amber maple syrup | 2 packages ladyfingers | 1/2 cup finely chopped and toasted flat-leaf parsley | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: In a small container, stir maple syrup until dissolved, add ladyfingers, spreading in an even layer. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

title: Basic Corn Chips (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 1 liter corn oil | 1/2 tablespoon tarragon | 2 g celery seeds
instructions: Heat oil and let it simmer. Add tarragon. Stir.

title: Canadian Bacon Glaze, 216cals Per Serve
ingredients: 1 cup canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 6 tablespoons cold shortening, cut into small pieces | 6 large radishes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Combine bacon, cornstarch and shortening in large bowl. Toss with radishes.

title: Mexican Green Chili Condiment - Spicy Beef Broth
ingredients: 1/4 cup green chilies, finely chopped | 1/4 cup beef broth | 1/1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Allow to stand 5 minutes before serving. Serve.

title: Baked Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh strawberries | 1 onion | 1 green pepper | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Cut strawberries in half.

title: African Meatballs
ingredients: 4 lbs bone-in skin-on chicken stew meat ( or other white meat ) | 1 -2 small dried red chili
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325°f. Line a roasting pan with foil and put the meat in it. Squeeze the canned chili pods out of the chili pods. Cut the dried chilies into julienne strips 3 - 4 long, or place them in a food processor with a squirt of lime juice. Blend the ingredients until they're a coarse paste. Roll the meat in the spice paste, patting some into the meat. Arrange the meat in the roasting pan. The key is to place the pan with the meat at least 2 inches above the heat source of the burner. Place the roasting pan in the oven and roast the meat, turning the meat occasionally with tongs, until very tender but not mushy, about 3 to 1 1/2 hours. Shake the pan every 40 minutes or so, as the juice from the chilies gets into the juices. If the juice doesn't completely cover the meat, turn on the oven, leave the lid slightly ajar, and turn off the burner but leave the meat covered overnight. The meat will be ready when it separates away easily from the skin and juices. Remove the meat from heat once the oven becomes very hot.

Random Ingredients: thyme,veal,rump steak,lime juice,scotch whisky,cake flour,coriander seed
title: Potted Spiced Sausages With Veal Dumplings
ingredients: 500 g coarse cake flour or 500 g coarse cake flour, plus extra ( or all purpose flour ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, lightly crushed | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme or 2 teaspoons dried thyme, leaves only | 1 kg sirloin steaks or 1 kg pattypan cooked pork sausage, cut into 1/2 inch wide strips | 1 cup scotch whisky or 1 cup water | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons tricolor-flavored vodka, for drizzling
instructions: Combine the flour, coriander and thyme. Dip the steak in the flour mixture and then brown in a lightly hot frying pan for 3 minutes each side. Transfer the sirloin to a board. Stir in the whiskey or water a bit at a time and bring to a boil. Add the sirloin and simmer about 10 - 15 minutes or until the meat is cooked and the sauce is thickened. Strain through a sieve, then stir in the lime juice. Serve with your favourite sausages and boiled potatoes, which can be reheated in the same pan.

title: Real Spanish Spicy  Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1 -2 tablespoon cocoa | 1 pinch sugar | 3/4 - 1 lb ground veal | 1 -2 tablespoon sherry | 1 -2 teaspoon palm sugar | 1 can ortega rotel tomatoes ( or regular rotel ) | 1 -2 slice smoked sausage
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, and cocoa together in a small bowl. Heat a frying pan on stove and add olive oil or butter. Add ground meats and fry until brown meat is browned and crumbly. Remove meat to a bowl. Heat the meat drippings/drippings in pan, add sherry, stir a few times, then add cans of tomatoes. Add brown sugar to taste. Stir well, heat through for 5 minutes. Take off heat, and pour over meat/tomato mixture. Serve warm, with chips or flour tortillas, or rice.

title: Ginger Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup sour cream, balkan | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves, rubbed | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: In a small mixing or serving bowl, add yogurt, cinnamon, honey, dried basil, and orange peel. Sugar will dissolve, but don't let it boil. Chill until the flavors combine or chill in the refrigerator. If desired, use a small amount of olive oil to dress the salad, just before serving, sprinkle with more cinnamon.

title: Sardine With Asparagus
ingredients: 700 g asparagus | 50 g pork fat | 2 teaspoons tamari | salt | 500 g raw sardines
instructions: Slice asparagus into lengths about 3 inches long. Cut meat into pieces. Cook asparagus until tender but not overcooked then set aside. Heat pork fat in pan, then add the tamari. Add asparagus, stirring well. Add salt and cook over low heat until tender. Pour onto a warmed serving dish and keep warm.

title: Low Carb Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup fat-free ricotta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 0.5 container low fat cheese topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Empty container of cheese into mixing bowl. Add garlic salt and cream cheese until mixture is creamy. Add a little more of ricotta cheese to mixture for a smoother texture. Place ricotta mixture into an 11x15 baking dish. Top with topping mixture. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes before cutting into squares. I usually add lots of oregano to the cheese before i slice. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,oat cereal,yellow pepper,cashew,beef broth,sherry,creme de menthe,garam masala
title: Tandoori Beef Bowls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin steak or 2 sirloin tip steaks, cut to 1/4 inch ( 10 to 12 % ) | 1/4 cup old fashioned oats cereal | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats cereal | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon mild sherry | 1 1 teaspoon creme de menthe | 2 cups beef broth | 2 tablespoons cashews ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Combine 1/4 cup old fashioned oats, 1/4 cup old fashioned oats, and 1/2 teaspoon garam masala, to make 2 patties. Place a large nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Add 3 tbls. Beef drippings. Add beef and toss to coat. Remove beef from pan and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Keep pan clean. Place remaining pan over medium high heat. Add 1 tbls. Shaoxing wine. Add beef, stirring frequently. Brown and stir for 5 minutes or until beef is no longer pink. Whisk together 1 cup dijon mustard, 1 cup boiling beef broth, remaining tablespoon sherry, and 1/2 teaspoon garam masala until smooth. Add to beef mixture in pan. Bring to boiling, reduce heat. Add 1 cup dijon mustard, remaining broth, and cashews. Return beef to pan. Transfer to oven. Bake 50 minutes or until heated through. Makes 4 servings.

title: My Favorite Beans
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans | 200 ml of ale | 200 -280 g caster sugar | 200 -280 g soymilk
instructions: Drain the beans, and place in saucepan with the ale. Add sugar and milk. Heat through.

title: Orange Harvest Frites
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes, cut in half | 1 tablespoon orange flower water | 2 tablespoons orange-flavored instant coffee-flavored vegetable oil ( optional )
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot of cold water, and cover. Bring to a boil, and cook 10 minutes. Drain. Preheat the broiler. Line a large baking sheet with foil. With the tip of a paring knife, prick holes in the top of the potatoes, and drop the potatoes into a large pot of cold water. Cover pot, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium, and steam potatoes 15 to 20 minutes, or until a knife inserted into the center of frites comes out clean. With a slotted spoon, transfer the potatoes to a bowl of olive oil. Stir in orange flower water, and set aside. Brush the potatoes with oil, and sprinkle with sugar or maple syrup. Broil in a preheated oven until golden brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,cane syrup,napa cabbage,hungarian paprika,green olive,rye bread,tomato sauce
title: Hungarian "swiss" Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shredded napa cabbage | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped green olives | 1/2 cup sliced dry rye bread | 2 tablespoons light cane syrup | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika, or to taste | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped seeded tomatoes with juice | 1 teaspoon thinly sliced lemon peel
instructions: Place napa cabbage, green olives, rye bread, cane syrup, paprika, tomato juice, and lemon peel into a salad bowl. Toss salad with reserved dressing to taste and serve.

title: Sauerkraut (German Meatloaf With Applesauce and Dill)
ingredients: 1 1 lb ground meat ( lean, brown & such ) | 2 3/4 cups apple cider ( unfiltered apple cider will work too ) | 2 teaspoons dried dill or 2 teaspoons minced fresh dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees c. Line a loaf pan with parchment paper or waxed paper, allowing it to rise evenly. Combine the meat & the cider & mix well. Pour mixture into the loaf pan. Sprinkle the dill on top, cover the pan tightly with foil & place in oven. Bake for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hrs or until loaves reach internal temperature. Remove from oven. Carefully remove the foil & allow to cool for approximately 30 minutes. Slice & serve. The more cuts, the more tender & flavorful you'll taste.

title: Slow Cooker Amporta Electric Skillet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons elbow macaroni | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon ground arm-flavored lamb, or more to taste, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Cook elbow macaroni in a skillet on the stovetop until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain and discard any fat from the skillet. Stir pineapple juice and lamb together in the skillet. Add macaroni, stir, and cover with a lid, cooking the amporta's sandwich on low, about 5 minutes to help keep it fluffy. Sprinkle with corn to serve at once.

title: Easy Low-Fat Cream Butter
ingredients: 1 cup margarine | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a medium bowl, cream margarine and cream until smooth. Stir in whipping cream. Transfer to a medium bowl, cover and refrigerate until firm, at least one hour.

title: Sirloin Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/4 cup allspice | 24 large littleneck lettuce leaves | 1/2 lb sirloin | 10 ladyfingers
instructions: In a large bowl add allspice.

title: Pop 'em Snack #5FIX
ingredients: 1 loaf brioche bread | 1 cup poppy seeds, toasted
instructions: Spread the chopped toasted poppy seeds over the entire top of the bread or spread on a cookie sheet. Spread the pop 'em snack on the bread without sprinkling on the poppy seed. Cut in half and enjoy.

title: Beef and Onions in a Vinegar-Honey Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb rump steak, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups kidney beans, drained | 1/3 cup vinegar, honey | 1 bouillon cube, dissolved in | 2 lukewarm tablespoons water | fresh cracked black pepper | radish, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except steak in crockpot. Cover crockpot and cook on low 7 - 9 hours. Stir or shake to coat meat. Serve with greens of your choice and with potatoes.

title: Focaccia Bread Pizza
ingredients: 3 ounces can tomato paste | 3 ounces fresh italian parsley, minced | 3 ounces focaccia bread, sliced
instructions: Combine tomato paste and parsley in small bowl. Tear foccacia bread into squares and place them in a small baking pan. Dough should be somewhat crumbly but should coat spoon. Spread the tomato paste mixture on the bread. Bake at 450 degrees f for about 35 minutes or until bread is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: haddock fillet,strawberry,lobster tail,parsnip,chicken breast,chicken breast half,ginger paste
title: Chicken Berry Pot
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite-size pieces | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite-size pieces | 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite-size pieces | 1 can lobster tails, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsnips | 1/2 cup diced skinless, boneless chicken breast | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 cup fresh strawberries with stems, washed and minced
instructions: In a slow cooker, toss the chicken, lobster tails, parsnips and chicken breast pieces with the chicken mixture, and mix well. Set the slow cooker to high. Cook, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Season with ginger paste, cover the cooker, and cook 30 minutes longer, or until the chicken and lobster mixture are no longer pink. Spoon the cooked chicken mixture into a bowl to serve, and stir in the strawberries.

title: My Best Cilantro Chutney
ingredients: 10 fresh cilantro leaves | 2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes ( optional )
instructions: Finely mince the cilantro leaves and combine with parsley flakes for a truly moroccan touch. Chill.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,orange,brown rice,sole fillet,bean,italian breadcrumb,cheddar cheese
title: Brodetto
ingredients: 2 medium oranges, juiced | 3 cups cooked pinto beans | 1 lb sole fillet, cut into 3/4 in pieces | 1 1/2 cups mexican-style breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons fat-free refried bean ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon orange juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: In shallow metal roasting pan or other baking dish, combine oranges, beans and fish. Combine bread crumbs, cheese and 1 tbsp. Orange juice. Dip fish into crumb mixture, roll in remaining crumbs.

Random Ingredients: pre pizza dough,deli ham,ice cream,channa dal,yeast,red pepper flake
title: Spicy Indian Calzone Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pre-made pizza dough | 1/2 lb deli ham, chopped | 3 tablespoons channa dal, washed, drained, chopped ( indian gram ) | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 can refrigerated reduced-fat ice cream | 1 teaspoon fresh yeast ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pizza dough and chopped ham. Sprinkle in channa dal, crushed red pepper, ice cream, and yeast.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,vinegar,sea scallop,italian dressing,hot chili powder,leg lamb,rice noodle
title: Lamb Chopa and Pasta Salad (Lengenberg)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh rotini pasta or 1 lb linguine | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 3/4 cup bottled italian dressing | 1 lb boneless leg of lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons hot chili powder | 1 lb sea scallops, trimmed of all visible fat | 1 -2 cup prepared hot chili powder | 2 tablespoons finely cut italian dressing | 1 package crispy rice noodles
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water about 6 quarts, cook rotini until tender but firm and al dente, stirring occasionally, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain well and transfer to large bowl of ice water. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, in a 12 inch skillet coated with cooking spray, cook lamb until lightly browned, stirring to keep browned pieces separate and to cook evenly. Remove meat from skillet and set aside. Drain drippings from skillet. Place reserved drippings in a skillet, over medium high heat and warm. Add chili powder and italian dressing to skillet and cook until warm, about 2 minutes. Add meat and cooked hot chile pieces and toss gently. Serve immediately with noodles to serve as a dipper or over pasta salad. Note, i'm not sure of the name of hot chili powder, but if you want to be less spicy add more.

title: Greek Kielbasa Balls
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 1 inch pieces. Place into cold water and boil for about 3 minutes. Drain and then put them into a well in the center of the kielbasa. Dissolve the flour in a little bit of the hot water, then whisk into the flour mix. Form the mixture into round balls. Place them into a greased baking dish. Sprinkle the oregano over them. Place in an oven of 425°f degrees for 12 - 15 minutes. Turn the heat down to 300°f and cook for about 2 hours. Check occasionally and serve with mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,baking chocolate,green bean,flat leaf parsley,orange juice,lentil,cocoa powder,lamb stew meat
title: Lamb and Chocolate Stew
ingredients: 1 package instant lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 can green beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon coarse seasoning salt | 1 lb cubed lamb stew meat | 1 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 ounce chopped unsweetened baking chocolate
instructions: In a 12 inch nonstick skillet, cook lentils, green beans, cocoa, and seasoned salt over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 5 minutes. Add lamb, reduce temperature to low, and continue cooking 10 minutes, or until lamb is browned. Stir orange juice, lime juice, and chocolate into pan. Cover and simmer 10 minutes, or until chocolate is melted.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,cauliflower,tomato puree,beet,italian sausage,asafoetida powder,chorizo sausage
title: Portuguese Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 pound fresh asafoetida mixed greens | 1 pound chorizo sausage, sliced into 1 inch pieces | 1 pound portuguese sweet sausage, sliced into 1 inch pieces | 1 pound asafoetida powder, masabel | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 2 cans crushed tomatoes in puree | 1 pound frozen cauliflower, cut into 3 inch florets, rinsed
instructions: Bring a few cups of lightly salted water to a boil in a large pot. Add the beets, sausage and asafoetida and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, reserving about 1 cup of the liquid. To the cooled sauerkraut, add the olives and vinegar. In a small bowl, stir together the crushed tomatoes and the reserved beet liquid until mixed thoroughly. Pour the tomato/beet mixture over the beets, and gently toss to combine. Transfer to a bowl, and garnish with the reserved aebel greens, if desired.

title: Spinach and Chocolate
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/4 lbs fresh spinach | 3 1/2 teaspoons cocoa powder | 1/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Cut the spinach in half and put aside. You will have three choices, place each half in a bowl, cover with hot water, and set in sink to drain. Chop the spinach in half and put aside. In a saucepan, combine the cocoa and vinegar, and heat until warm. If you are using a jarred jar and a lid, you will need to add a few drops of oil to cover the bottom of the jar. Add vinegar and cocoa mixture and stir thoroughly to incorporate. Add baby spinach, and cook over a medium heat just until the spinach wilts slightly, but it will still be wet under the water and not too wet. Do not let this get too vigorous. Note, if your lid is too warm, it will tear apart.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,meat stock,mange tout pea,parsnip,large shrimp,jicama,green plantain
title: Jaita Pot Roasted Shrimp With Prawns and Plantains
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw large shrimp | 2 tablespoons green plantains, shelled | 2 small jicama, peeled and cut into small chunks | 1/3 cup mange-tout peas or 1/3 cup sweet peas | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamoms | 3 cups stewed meat stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 300ºf. Spray a large baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine shrimp and vegetables in baking dish. Combine seasonings and mix with shrimp/tomato mixture. Pour soup into dish and roast, uncovered, for 2 hours and 30 minutes, or until shrimp are pink, cooked and the vegetables are tender. Remove from oven and cool to room temperature. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Apple Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 fresh jalapeno chile | 1 fresh pineapple, chunked | 4 fresh tart apples | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 tablespoons snipped parsley | salt
instructions: Cut out the core from the jalapeno chile & discard seeds & membrane removed. Cut the chile into half rings and remove the seeds and membrane then finely chop. Remove the ribs from the apples then cut each half into 6 wedges. Place the unpeeled pineapple in a large, deep skillet with cold water to cover. Heat to boiling over medium high heat then reduce heat to medium low & simmer until the pineapple is tender & the liquid has evaporated, about 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a wok until smoking over high heat. Remove the core from the apple chunks & discard. Dice the apples then set aside. Drain the chile pieces then tear them into pieces with your fingers. Heat the wok/skillet. Add the water chestnuts, pineapple chunks, cornstrap, parsley & salt & stir fry until fragrant, about 4 minutes. Add the apples & stir fry briefly before serving.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,russet potato,orange peel,green olive
title: Cuban Browned Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, scrubbed | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1 can sliced green olives | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated orange peel ( optional )
instructions: Place the potatoes in a medium saucepan and cover with water. Bring water to boil and cook until tender, 25 minutes. Drain and reserve 1 cup cooking liquid, but leave 3/4 cup for sauce. Meanwhile, in large saucepan, stir together soup mix and reserved potato cooking liquid, olives and orange peel. Add potatoes and reserved cooking liquid. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, or until potatoes are heated through.

title: Berbere Powder - South African Spice Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons berbere | 3 tablespoons ginger powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Store in an airtight glass or plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,dark sesame oil,salad dressing
title: Easy Oriental Salad (Easy Microwave)
ingredients: 8 ounces sour cream or 8 ounces light sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Combine sour cream, soup and sesame oil together in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave, covered on 100% power in microwave for 10 minutes or until warm and slightly bubbling. Stir well and continue heating on 100% power for 5 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Coffee
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups brewed tea ( strong, cold ) | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice | 1/4 cup fresh blueberries ( optional, but recommended )
instructions: Mix the tea and pumpkin pie spice. Pour into a mug, pour over the blueberries, and mix lightly. Serve warm.

title: Curried Muffins
ingredients: 2 teaspoons curry paste | 1/3 cup whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 2/3 teaspoon chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon dry english muffins, finely crushed | 2 large eggs, lightly beaten
instructions: Heat oven to 400°. Coat 12 muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray. In small bowl, mix curry paste, flour, ginger, chipotle and dry english muffin crumbs.

title: Caldo Blanco (Kale and Rice)
ingredients: 2 large kale ( about 12 small bunches in total ) | 2 bunches scallions | kale or red leaf lettuce, rinsed well ( 8 cups ) | 3 cups stock ( can use broth ) or 3 cups broth ( can use broth ) | romaine lettuce, if desired
instructions: Chop kale and scallions and mix together in medium bowl. Toss with greens and let stand 10 minutes. Squeeze kale and scallions and add in stock or broth. Chill.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,tomato soup,garlic chive,sage,scallion,yogurt,deli roast beef
title: Easy Yummy Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 3 whole scallions, chopped with some white on | 1 tablespoon garlic chives, chopped | 6 ounces tomato soup | 10 ounces yogurt | 1 slice deli roast beef | 1 slice fresh sage
instructions: Heat grill. Sprinkle coriander, scallions and garlic chives onto a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Cook for about 2 minutes or until fragrant. Sprinkle with tomatoes soup. Place a slice of roast beef, on top of the tomato soup mixture on the parchment. Smear roast with yogurt. Place remaining roast beef on top of roast and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,aubergine,sirloin,french onion soup,white wine vinegar,vegetable broth,cellophane noodle,ice
title: Low Fat French Onion Burger
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 1 can french onion soup | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 can aubergines, sliced | 6 slices good melting chocolate | 8 sheets cellophane noodles | 6 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup ice, shredded
instructions: Mix everything together. Heat over medium heat until hot. Form into patties approximately 3/4 in high. Pan fry and place on a baking tray. Bake on a preheated plate at 425 degrees for 5 minutes, flipping halfway through so it gets a little crispy on both sides. Garnish with shredded crisp chocolate. Serve with steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: prawn,ice,yucca root,graham cracker crumb,soymilk,green chilies,capellini,onion salt
title: Prawn and Yuca Stuffed Shellfish
ingredients: 3 large ripe capellini | 1 large ripe yucca root | 100 g shredded raw prawns | 3 large green chilies, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup soymilk ( i use a light flavourless yoghurt ) | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 cup grated graham cracker crumbs | ice
instructions: Boil shells until they have 'al dente' – about 3 to 5 minutes. Drain upside down onto paper towels and remove hard muscle in each shell and set aside. Remove shellfish tails and fins from the head, leaving the head intact. Chop up the tail and discard. Wash shells and set aside. Chop yuca into 1 inch cubes. Remove yuca from membranes by rolling the meat between 2 sheets of waxed paper in the cupped side with your hands. Set aside. Chop a little off the top of your onion, using a wooden spoon. Mince one chile and the other one finely. Combine all vegetables to a bowl. Add the chile onion mixture to vegetables in bowl. Place shells on sheet of waxed paper and add toppings. Roll in crumbs until completely covered. Chill in fridge for 8 to 24 hours before serving. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Canadian Bacon and Garlic Soup
ingredients: 3 slices smoked canadian bacon | 3 -4 cloves garlic ( depending on taste, i like lots more ) | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Add bacon, garlic, and boullion to crockpot.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Beer Beans
ingredients: 32 ounces black beans | 32 ounces kidney beans | 8 ounces taco seasoning | 3/4 cup dry parsley, chopped | 2 1/2 ounces bouillon granules | 4 ounces beer
instructions: Combine all ingredients in your crock pot. Cover.

title: Salmon and Parsley Matzo Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh salmon fillets, cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks | 1/3 cup toasted pecan breadcrumbs ( toasted pina-parmesan would work too ) or 1/3 cup matzo meal | 1/3 cup pestachi sun-dried tomato | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup chicken broth | 6 matzos meal, about ( matzo meal would work too ) | 1/2 lb linguine, cooked al dente or 1/2 lb other tubular pasta, broken into quarters if you want | 1/4 cup slivered sun-dried tomato ( about 7 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pour 1/3 cup of the sun dried tomatoes into a small bowl. Set aside. Coat salmon chunks with 1/3 cup of the bread crumbs. Shake off excess bread crumbs and set aside. Dot one side of a 13x9 inch baking dish with about 3 tablespoons of the pestachi sun dried tomatoes. Spread matzo meal evenly in the dish. Top with salmon pieces. Spread 1/4 cup of the pestachi sun dried tomatoes over salmon. Pour chicken broth into a shallow bowl. Dip each salmon piece into broth, allowing excess liquid to drip off. Top salmon with matzo meal to form a bed of matzo soaked in broth. Place fish on top of matzo, tomato, parsley, and pestachi sun dried tomatoes. Pour remaining pestachi sun dried tomato mixture around fish. Drizzle with olive oil. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour. Serve.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,oyster sauce,kirby cucumber,beef,romaine lettuce,garlic clove,chili paste
title: Spicy Beef With Curd
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef ( any cuts will do, but i just use top sirloin ) | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet chili paste | 1 garlic clove ( crushed ) | 2 teaspoons kirby cucumbers ( cut in long diagonal slices ) | 1 tablespoon fresh curly lettuce
instructions: Slice beef into thin bite sized strips about 1/4 inch long or as thin as you like. Mix dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, chili paste, garlic, and korean sweet chili sauce in small bowl. Set aside. In another bowl mix beef, cucumber slices, lettuce and just enough of the dark soy sauce to get a consistent coating on and around meat. In a little bowl combine the leftover dark soy sauce, oyster sauce mixture, and chili paste. Set aside. Heat wok or skillet over high heat and add a tbsp of oil to coat. Add the meat. Stir fry beef until just cooked through. Serve with rice and stir fry vegetables.

Random Ingredients: black cumin seed,mustard powder,serrano pepper,cream mushroom soup,spinach leaf
title: Homemade Sour Cream Spinach Dip
ingredients: 20 ounces frozen spinach leaves | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 serrano pepper, chopped well | 1 teaspoon black cumin seed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and process for about one minute or until well mixed. Place mixture in serving dish and cover with plastic wrap, stirring every now and then. Refrigerate until cool. Best served fresh.

title: Roasted Bell Peppers
ingredients: 12 ounces orange bell peppers, halved | hot paprika
instructions: Brush the skin of the bell peppers with hot paprika. Place peppers skin side down on an aluminum foil lined grill. Grill over moderate heat for about 20 minutes, or until the skin chars. Turn frequently and brush more of hot paprika onto the peppers while grilling. Place the roasted peppers on a warmed serving platter and keep warm in a 200 degree oven.

title: Rosemary Rice Vinegar Dip
ingredients: 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 3 tablespoons minced fresh rosemary or 3 tablespoons fresh minced dried rosemary | 2 teaspoons seasoned rice vinegar | 1/2 cup flour, seasoned with salt, pepper, and garlic
instructions: Combine all the ingredients together in a medium bowl and mash together with a fork. Spread into an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use. Slices of sour cream can be served warm or chilled.

title: Magical Caramels
ingredients: 2 lemons, zest of ( a zest of 3 lemons ) | 2 oranges, juice and zest of ( a zest of 3 lemons )
instructions: Pour orange juice and lemon zest into glass bowl. Dip the zest into the orange juice, lemon and orange juice mixture, allowing the mixture to absorb as much of the zest as possible. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,jumbo shrimp,kiwi fruit,kernel corn,cinnamon,self rising flour,black peppercorn,swiss chard
title: Thai Shrimp and Swiss Chard Cobbler
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard | 2 cups uncooked jumbo shrimp | 1/2 cup canned whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 cup pumpkin seeds | 1 cinnamon stick | 1 black peppercorn | 1 tablespoon self-rising flour | 1 large kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut the top off the chard, remove the hard rib ribs and discard. Cut all the leaves from the chard. Discard the stems and remaining leaves. In a large bowl, toss the chard with the shrimp, corn, pumpkin seeds, cinnamon stick, peppercorns and the flour until evenly coated. Arrange the chard mixture in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange the kiwifruit slices over the chard mixture and spoon the remaining shrimp mixture into the dish. Bake in preheated oven, uncovered, 35 to 40 minutes, until the shrimp mixture is bubbling. Serve with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,picante sauce,active yeast,almond extract,pepper sauce
title: Tantalizing Basic White Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups picante sauce | 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/4 teaspoon bottled hot pepper sauce | 1 dash cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried ground almonds ( optional )
instructions: Pour picante sauce into a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,pesto sauce,savoy cabbage,orzo pasta,pineapple juice,vegan cheddar cheese,elbow macaroni,milk
title: Pesto and Pineapple Macaroni & Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni ( or the pasta of your choice ) | 4 1/2 cups basilian wheat-milk | 1 1/2 cups vegan cheddar cheese ( shredded ) | 1 1/2 cups parmesan plain pesto sauce | 1/3 cup pineapples with juice | 1 cup evaporated skim milk | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 lb savoy cabbage ( shredded )
instructions: In a large pot boil 4 cups water with the season salt, add noodles and cook until done. While noodles are still cooking, boil the other 3 cups of water. When the noodles are finished drain well, reserve. In a large bowl mix 1 1/2 cups of the basil & cheese, add pesto & pineapples & set aside. Now combine remaining basil & cheese with parmesan and mix well. Drain cabbage and add to the other bowl, mix well and add to the bowl as well as noodles. Add your shredded cabbage & remaining pesto & cheese mixture & stir well to coat all items well. Transfer into a 9x13 cake pan, cover and refrigerate for at least an hour. Remove cover from the dish while its sitting in the refrigerator. When ready to serve, thaw and preheat oven to 350 degrees. Sprinkle the rest of the cheddar cheese on top of the cheeses. Bake for about 30 minutes.

title: Southern Style Baked Shellfish
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 pound dungeness crabmeat, cut into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the corn in a bowl, and toss with the crabmeat. Place the shellfish in a baking dish, and cover with the crabmeat mixture, being sure to coat well. Bake in the preheated oven until the edges are golden brown, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mirin,vanilla extract,kalamata olive,onion soup mix,sea salt,macaroni
title: Macaroni and Olive
ingredients: 1 package macaroni, cooked al dente and drained well ( like ronzoni ) | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | kalamata olive, cut in half for garnish | 1/3 cup mirin
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the macaroni, onion soup mix, sea salt and vanilla extract. Spoon macaroni mixture into a serving dish. Dot the casserole with pared olives. Pour remaining mirin over the macaroni mixture and sprinkle top with a little kalamata olive. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,ginger garlic paste,salami,italian herb seasoning
title: Antipasto
ingredients: 1 cup salami ( sliced thin ) | 1 cup salami ( sliced thin ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 -5 tablespoons maraschino cherries | 1/2 teaspoon dried mixed italian herbs ( rubbed )
instructions: Cut salami in slivers. Heat wok, add oil, salami and garlic paste. Stir fry on medium heat for 5 - 10 minutes. Add cherries and herbs. Stir till mixed in. Taste and adjust seasoning with pepper and more mixed herbs if needed.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,sherry wine vinegar,anchovy fillet,tomato juice,chicken bouillon granule,golden syrup,lettuce leaf
title: Anchovy Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy fillet, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons golden syrup | 1/2 recipe refrigerated pie crust | 1 1/2 cups lettuce leaves, torn into bite sized pieces
instructions: Heat dressing over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,grain rice,extra virgin olive oil,taco seasoning,oat,ice,garlic salt,green lentil
title: Lentil and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 bag grain rice | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 cup fresh green lentils | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 cups iceberg lettuce | crushed ice
instructions: Cook rice as directed on bag, or cook to directions on bag. Meanwhile, combine olive oil, garlic salt and taco seasoning in medium saucepan. Heat over medium heat. Add drained cooked rice, lentils and vinegar and mix well. Serve warm with lettuce and crunched olives, if desired. May also be served cold.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,white flour tortilla,active yeast,leek,pizza crust,garlic paste
title: Leek Potato Pizza
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 pint yukon gold potatoes, mashed or grated raw potatoes | 6 leeks, finely sliced | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 10 -12 white flour tortillas, to taste, soft | 1 pizza crust, or other homemade crust
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large mixing bowl. Set aside to ferment. In a skillet, melt garlic paste and saute diced potatoes, chopped leeks, and salt until soft. Allow to cool. Pour cooled leeks and potato mash over yeast and flour in the bowl and mix to combine. Work dough gently with hands to develop crust's surface, such as adding dough hooks or kneading hooks. Allow the dough to rise until doubled in size, and punch down. Shape and place onto pizza pan. Roll dough into 24 even sized flat pieces, and spread garlic herb mixture evenly on pizza dough. Sprinkle remaining cheese on pizza. Fold each flattened pizza dough piece around the leeks, leaving a small opening for steam to escape. Gently place on top of the cheese or bread, and press with the bottom of a fork to vent. Let rise on an ungreased baking sheet until double in size. In small baking pans over baking coals, lay the pizza pieces so they make room to bake at 375 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Moroccan Fried Rice With Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long-grain rice, rinsed under cold water ( arborio, basmati ) | 1/3 cup low fat margarine | 2 tablespoons low-fat yoghurt | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1/2 cup cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated, plus more for garnish | 1/3 cup pared, finely chopped parsley or 1/3 cup basil ( optional )
instructions: Drain the rice in strainer over large bowl and transfer to large skillet and melt margarine over medium heat. Stir in raisins, yogurt, turmeric and vinegar and stir constantly until mixture is smooth. Stir in cauliflower, cover and set aside. Melt remaining 1/3 cup of cheese in skillet over medium heat until it's golden, about 3 - 5 minutes. Add cooked rice mixture and stir until rice is coated with oil and begins to turn translucent, about 2 minuts. Sprinkle with cheese and parsley, cover and set aside to set and absorb moisture, 5 - 10 minute remove from heat and sprinkle top with remaining cheese. Cut into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,crabmeat,grain white rice,poblano pepper,italian dressing,macaroni
title: Chef John's Crab and Macaroni Goulash
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 1 box macaroni | 1 cup cooked crabmeat, flaked | 1/2 cup zesty italian dressing | 1 poblano pepper, chopped | 1 cup uncooked wild rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cook and stir white rice in a large pot with enough water to cover, bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer the rice until the rice is tender and has absorbed all of the water, 30 to 50 minutes. Transfer rice to a colander set in the sink and rinse with cool water several times to remove any excess water. In a large pot of boiling water, cook macaroni until tender, drain and place in a large bowl with cooked crab and italian dressing. Mix well, then place 1/2 the uncooked rice into the bowl with the crab and bean mixture.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,red chili pepper,ham,elderflower cordial,ricotta cheese,eggplant,iceberg lettuce
title: Eggplant Beef Roll
ingredients: 1/2 lb thinly sliced lean ham | 2 large eggplants, sliced in rounds, lengthwise | 1 medium red chili pepper, seeded and thinly sliced ( red fresno de arbol if you can get it ) | 1 lb beef stew meat, coarsely grated ( or stew meat of your choice ) | 1/2 cup elderflower cordial | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 3/4 bunch iceberg lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange eggplant slices in a 13 x 9 baking dish. Arrange chile, meat, and elderflower cordial around eggplant slices. Cover with a mixture of cheese, lettuce leaves, and meat mixture. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake in oven uncovered 30 - 35 minutes or until edges are golden brown.

title: Apple Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin roast | 1 package dry cheese roll | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 small tart apple | 1/4 cup yogurt
instructions: Cook pork in dutch oven using 1/4 cup peanut butter until browned. Remove pork to warm platter. Cover with cheese. Top with remaining pork fat. Heat under broiler to melt cheese. Cut cheese in half. Serve on top of meat.

Random Ingredients: channa dal,nonfat plain yogurt,mustard seed,mint,ice water,fruit
title: Channa Dal (Sweet Lentils)
ingredients: 2 cups channa dal or 2 cups brown dal, dry whole | 2 1/2 cups nonfat plain yogurt ( can use low-fat ) | pickled fruit, of your choice ( optional ) or honey-cured cherries ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | ice water, as needed | 1 sprig mint
instructions: Drain lentils and rinse well. Place lentils in a large container and add enough water to cover. Chill lentils, covered, for 3 hours. Drain lentils, reserving soaking liquid. Place lentils in food processor and puree for 15 seconds. Place lentils in a large bowl. Add yogurt, fruit and mustard seeds and stir to combine. Add 3 cups reserved lentil soaking liquid and enough ice water to form a soft, smooth creamy consistency. Taste and add additional salt, if desired. If desired, garnish with mint.

title: Coconut Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked jasmine rice, rinsed, drained | 4 ounces canned coco lopez or 4 ounces light coconut cream | 1/2 - 3/4 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup finely chopped serrano pepper
instructions: Microwave rice on high for 4 minutes. Stir. Heat coconut sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat until hot, about 15 to 20 seconds. Stir in remaining ingredients, except sriracha. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Simmer, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot.

title: Chickpea and Avocado Lovers-Bread Machine Pizza
ingredients: 2/3 cup chickpeas, rinsed well and drained | 1/3 cup cremini mushroom, sliced | 1/2 ripe avocado, chopped | 3 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Place all ingredients in bread pan in order suggested by your bread machine. Select dough cycle. If using oven, remove dough, and start. If using baking stone, preheat oven to 500°.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,rice wine,pesto sauce,lime juice zest,jalapeno chile
title: Pesto Squares
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice wine | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice, zest of | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 cup jalapeno chile, minced | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small to medium sized heavy saucepan.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,egg noodle,ginger powder,red curry paste,chipotle powder,shallot,vermicelli
title: Easy Noodle Curry
ingredients: 1 lb vermicelli, in 1 inch size pieces | 5 large shallots, chopped | 1/4 cup minced fresh ginger powder | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 4 fresh chipotle powder ( canned chipotle can be substituted ) | 3 cups whipping cream | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: Soak noodles in cold water. Drain. Mix noodles, shallots, ginger, curry, chipotle and cream completely. Serve hot or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,rotel tomato chilies,potato
title: Easy Spiced Sweet Red Salsa #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with skins | 2 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Open the can of rotel tomatoes and chilies and drain any liquid off of them. Add 1 tablespoons of five spice powder to the can of tomatoes and chili and stir. Put the jar into the microwave on medium for 2 minutes. Stir the salsa and add to large bowl. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,sherry wine,jalapeno jack cheese,dark raisin,italian sausage crosswise,peach,jasmine rice
title: Mexican Bean Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1/2 pound sweet italian sausage thinly sliced, or more to taste | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 6 jalapeno jack cheese slices, or more to taste | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1/2 cup dark raisins, or more to taste, divided | 1 cup peeled sliced peaches
instructions: Mix 3 cups cooked rice into a large bowl. Stir sherry into cooked rice, and transfer sausage slices into the bowl with the cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,corn,glutinous rice,cumin powder,mango chutney,cold water
title: Green Vegetable and Fragrant Rice
ingredients: 4 cups cooked glutinous rice, chilled ( kai, see directions ) | 2 cups cold water, approximately ( see directions ) | 1 cup shredded fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup torn mixed mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 2 tablespoons sweet mango chutney ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot combine one cup rice and cold water. Over medium heat, bring to a boil. Turn heat to low.

title: Taco Relish
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/2 cup finely shredded cotija cheese | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl and stir to blend. Cover and chill 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,lentil,adobo sauce chipotle pepper,salmon,halibut fillet
title: Chipotle Salmon Platter
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 12 ounces lentils, patted dry ( or any lentils that're been washed, soaked in water for 15 hours ) | 1 can refrigerated chipotle peppers | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce from chipotle peppers | salt and pepper
instructions: Place salmon fillets, then lentils in a casserole dish. Top with chipotle peppers, then adobo sauce. Season with salt and pepper. Bake at 350°f for 20 minutes before removing from oven. Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 14 ounces shrimp, chopped | 1/4 cup black sesame seed | 1/4 cup sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Heat sesame seeds in a 10 nonstick skillet over medium high heat just until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Watch out for tiny bubbles. Add shrimp.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,tahini,oregano leaf,pine nut,triple sec,chicken thigh,oyster sauce,italian seasoning
title: Lacquered Parmesan Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 12 boneless chicken thighs | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons tahini | 3 tablespoons light olive oil | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon triple sec | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian seasoning | 1/4 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 tablespoon sherry or 1/4 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Prepare the marinade, in a large ziploc bag combine the 2 tbs olive oil with the dried italian seasoning. Add the chicken and shake to coat. In a large skillet on high heat add the remaining 3 tbs olive oil. Remove the chicken, add the remaining tsp italian seasoning, triple sec, pine nuts & dried oregano. When the oil is nice and hot add the chicken & turn to sear. Turn down to high heat, cover and cook for 3 minutes. To serve, top with parmesan cheese and drizzle remaining marinade over top. Enjoy.

title: Midori Cocktail
ingredients: 1 ounce midori melon liqueur | 1 ounce cannellini beans
instructions: Blend the Midori and cannellini beans together. Pour into a glass with ice.

title: Dynamite-Bowl Burritos
ingredients: 1 package tortillas | 1/3 cup prepared mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 nori, seaweed sheet
instructions: Place tortillas on a flat surface. Sprinkle lightly with mustard powder and oregano. Roll up and serve in center of bowl with nori and desired amount of spicy hot mustard.

title: Mexican Grilled Lobster With Ham, Shrimp & Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 1/4 lb cooked ham, diced | 2 large plum tomatoes, diced | 1/2 cup strong coffee | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/8 teaspoon salt substitute | 1 pint cooked lobsters | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1/2 lb smoked cooked ham, diced ( or more to taste )
instructions: Place 1 pound of cooked ham, diced tomato, coffee, cumin and salt substitute in a medium bowl and whisk to fully combine. Add the lobsters and salsa. Allow to marinate for at least 15 minutes. Heat gas grill to medium high. Remove lobsters from marinade, and pat dry. Sprinkle with desired amount of chopped ham, if desired. Grill for 5 to 6 minutes, flipping once, until the ham has lightly browned and the shrimp are pink. Serve.

title: Easy Chewy Chicken Dumplings
ingredients: 1 chicken stock cube | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 cup flour
instructions: Place the stock cube in a saucepan with enough cold water to cover the bottom about 1½ 2cm above the cube. Bring to a boil and pour into a bowl. Beat in the margarine. Put flour in a small bowl and use your fingers to break the lumps of flour, until they are the size of clumps of breadcrumbs. Add to the pot. The water should be covering the flour and the stock cube and bring it to the boil. Turn the heat down and simmer for about 10 minutes. It should have a thick sauce consistency. If it doesn't, add a little water or milk. Serve with lots of butter and freshly ground pepper.

Random Ingredients: salsa,brown button mushroom,ginger paste,icing sugar,cauliflower floret,bamboo shoot,rum,ditalini
title: Creamy Cauliflower Bake
ingredients: 4 cups cauliflower florets, washed and dried | 12 ounces brown button mushrooms ( quartered ) | 36 ounces medium ditalini ( or equivalent pasta of your choice ) | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa or 1 tablespoon light rum | 1 -2 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 jar salsa | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon crushed bamboo shoot
instructions: Cook pasta. In saucepan, mix drained mushrooms with ditalini. Stir in rum, ginger paste, and salsa until well blended. Combine 3 tablespoons of icing sugar with the remaining tablespoon of icing sugar. Drain pasta and combine with mushroom mixture. Sprinkle with some crushed bamboo pieces if desired and bake in an oven preheated to 425º for 20 minute cool slightly and ice with icing sugar before serving.

title: Fried Spring Onions - Nigella Lawson
ingredients: 5 spring onions, peeled, green and white parts chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat griddle to its hottest. Mix the onions in a frying pan over a medium heat with a little olive oil. Keep turning the onions over the heat until they start to lightly colour and soften but are not quite burnt about 5 mins. They must not brown. Drain on paper towel and serve immediately with bread of your choice.

Random Ingredients: banana,hard egg,cauliflower floret,almond,black bean,white rice,chicken breast
title: Cauliflower Rice Casserole
ingredients: 4 -5 chicken breasts | 4 cups cauliflower florets | 1 can black beans | 1 can canned white rice | 1 cup slivered almonds | 1 medium banana, chopped | 1 hard-boiled egg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut chicken in ½ inch pieces. Cut cauliflower florets in ¾ inch pieces and layer in bottom of oven container with chicken, cauliflower, beans, rice, sliced bananas and egg. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour, uncover & bake 30 minutes or until casserole is browned.

title: Cauliflower Salad With Pear and Caramelized Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 ripe pear, peeled, cored and finely diced | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a large pot. Add the pear and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer gently for about 6 to 10 minutes or until cauliflower is tender. Drain, reserving the cooking liquid, and stir in the vinegar into the cauliflower. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Cottage Cheese Curry with Mustard
ingredients: 8 ounces cottage cheese | 1/2 cup ground dry mustard | 3 -4 tablespoons green chili peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon red chili pepper, crushed
instructions: Mix cottage cheese together in a large bowl using a fork. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill in your refrigerator for 1/2 hour for better flavor. Enjoy.

title: Cauliflower-Orange Puree
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 3 pieces ripe bananas | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cut cauliflower lengthwise into four pieces. Place cauliflower pieces and bananas in a 9x5 inch baking dish and sprinkle with half of sugar, 1/2 of the grated orange peel and half the other half of the orange peel.

title: Lentils
ingredients: 500 g good quality lamb ( shoulder ) or 500 g other meat ( shoulder ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 1/2 kg lentils, rinsed
instructions: Trim fat and sinew from meat and slice into about 1 cubes. Place in bowl and sprinkle with salt. Fry over low heat until browned. Remove from pan. Fry lentils in pan adding about a quarter cup water to the pan. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 90 minutes. Add meat and heat for about 10 mins stirring occasionally until meat is tender and lentils are dark and sticky.

title: Simple Thai Red Curry Rice
ingredients: 2 cups steamed rice | 1 thai red curry paste ( available at asian markets )
instructions: Prepare steaming hot steamed rice with rice cooker in the microwave or on the stovetop. Steam should cover rice at least half way. Place rice in a wide, shallow serving bowl, place around 1/2 cup of warm steaming hot rice over rice, and cover bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Steak and Bacon-Wrapped in Phyllo
ingredients: 1 beef brisket ( or other meat ) | 6 slices thin hamburger | 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 small cucumber, thinly sliced ( seeds removed if desired ) | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 bottle madeira wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place brisket on a cutting board.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,flour tortilla,brandy,greek feta cheese,leek,tart apple
title: Brickle Apple-Creamy Curried Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brandy | 8 large flour tortillas | 1 small leeks, white part only, sliced thinly on the diagonal | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, divided | 2 large tart apples, cut into 1/2-inch pieces ( about 1 lb. ) | 4 ounces greek feta cheese
instructions: Sprinkle bottom of a heavy medium size skillet with oil, then heat on high. When the pan is very hot, warm one side of one tortilla for a minute or so, then add more tortillas and cook until bubbles form around the tortilla just slightly sticking to the bottom. Remove from heat and set aside. Turn heat back down to medium. Add 1 tablespoon of chopped leek to the pan. Cover the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1 teaspoon chopped parsley, about 2 tablespoons of parsley, and 1/2 teaspoon of curry powder at a minute or so, until you are able to smell the curry. Spread half of the apple mixture on top of a tortilla. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup chopped feta cheese. Spread remaining sliced leeks over the cheese. Fold over and cook until cheese is melted and beginning to brown, about 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat. Repeat with remaining tortillas and leeks. Serve right away.

title: Auntie Theresa's Corn Syrup
ingredients: 1/2 cup white onion, finely minced | 3 tablespoons dark corn syrup
instructions: Grind the onion using a mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Combine the onion, corn syrup and minced red pepper. Store in the refrigerator or use for cooking.

Random Ingredients: lemon thyme,ghee butter,iceberg lettuce,lime wedge,golden delicious apple
title: Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce ( or red leaf lettuce ) | 1 large golden delicious apple, unpeeled ( or another firm one, such as a tart ) | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon thyme ( optional ) | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Wash and dry the lettuce well. Cut off and discard the hard stalk ends. Remove the hard central stem of each leaf. Cut off the bottom layer of leaves, if any, and divide the leaf quarters in half horizontally to create sixths. Arrange and arrange the apple halves. Scatter the thyme over the apple. Drizzle the ghee over the salad. Heat the ghee in a non stick pan over medium low heat, and cook the lettuce for approximately 3 minutes. Remove the herb sprigs from the dish, and scatter over the thyme. Serve right away, or cool to help them crisp up. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Pistachio Sushi Cups
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, shredded | 2 teaspoons vegan margarine, at room temperature | 2 teaspoons sweetened vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh pistachios | 2 teaspoons pineapple juice | 1 sheet nori seaweed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coarsely chop the cauliflower into thin shreds. In a large bowl, combine the chopped cauliflower and margarine. Add the hot sauce and chopped pistachios. Toss to coat evenly and set aside, about 10 minutes. Spread the nori seaweed sheet on a paper towel and lightly oil a baking sheet and line with parchment paper. Sprinkle seaweed lightly with salt, and set aside. Add the cauliflower shreds to the prepared baking sheet. Place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes, without stirring. Remove the nori seaweed, cover with another sheet of parchment, and let cool. While still warm, remove the parchment. Spread the nori seaweed onto a cutting board and with floured hands press into small squares approximately 2x3 1/2 inches.

title: Red Enchilada Bread Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen corn, defrosted | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 cup ketchup | 8 slices whole-grain rye bread, toasted
instructions: Defrost corn and place in a mixing bowl along with enchilada sauce. Add ketchup and mix, then let stand 10 minutes. Cut bread slices in halves in half, then spread toasted soy sourdough slices on 2 plates. Spread 1/2 thick layer of cream cheese spread evenly over the bread and then spread with the other half of the cream cheese spread. Microwave on high 1 minute, or until beginning to soften. Add another teaspoon of cream cheese spread over the cream cheese cream cheese spread.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,cumin seed,pasta,bicarbonate soda,green chile,duck,plain flour,biscuit
title: Chinese Style Bok Choy Dumplings
ingredients: 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1 packet bok choy, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 500 -568 g fresh baby bok choy, cleaned, washed and coarsely chopped | 1 fresh long green chile, sliced thinly | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, lightly crushed | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 300 g canned duck or 300 g vacuum-packed whole duck fat, melted slightly | 300 g biscuit
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200c/375f degrees. Prepare your biscuit by mixing together the bok choy, green chili, cumin and bicarb soda. Combine the pork and cabbage in a microwave safe bowl with 3 tablespoons water, microwave on high, stirring every 10 seconds, until they are soft and softened. Drain the pork and cabbage, add it to the biscuit bowl and mix well. Roll teaspoons of the mixture into balls, then flatten gently to form small circular balls. Place on a greased oven tray and bake 15 minutes/side no longer apart until cooked. Serve in small soup bowls topped with shredded extra duck fat, biscuits and a drizzle of any chinese red chile chutney, and extra chutney. Note, if you are using vacuum packed dumpling biscuits, place them on a tray and heat in the microwave for 1 minute/side no longer. This method ensures that the biscuits do not break and then stays together when removed from the oven.

Random Ingredients: spice,red potato,granny smith apple,melba toast,pearl barley,mint
title: Welsh Corned Wheat and Apple Barley Breakfast
ingredients: 1/2 kg small red potato, such as yukon gold or 1/2 kg small brown potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, such as black | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 4 slices melba toast | 4 granny smith apples, cored, peeled, cut into wedges | 1 tablespoon pearl barley
instructions: Cut the potatoes into quarters and boil them in salted water, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Allow the potato to cool, then peel, halve and discard the potato skins that have floated on to the top. Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and add the barley. Drain most of the water from the potatoes. Meanwhile, coarsely chop the corned wheat into quarters and boil it in the hot water for 5 minutes, then allow it to cool, then remove it from the water with a slotted spoon and drain it. Put the potatoes, mixed spice and dried mint into the pan and add the reserved water, a pinch of black pepper and the apple wedges. Stir everything together until the barley is coated in the spice and herbs. Sprinkle a few grains of lemon or lime powder over the top, then leave to sit for 4 to 5 minutes. Serve with fresh salad leaves and a crisp green salad.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,curry powder,shell pasta,spinach leaf,sushi rice,vegetable protein,chickpea
title: Vegetarian Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 4 cups cooked sushi rice | 1 cup raw spinach leaves | 2 cans cooked chickpeas | 3 cups textured vegetable protein ( tvp ) | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 cups quick-cooking sushi rice ( i used jasmine ) | 3 -5 drops red food coloring
instructions: Mix the raw spinach and all the spices together. Add 2 cups of rice and blend well. Add chickpeas and then add 1 cup of tvp and blend again. Place all in a 9x13 pan in a pan and cover with 2 layers of plastic wrap. Cook in a 350 degree oven for an hour and 15 minutes. Take off all wrap and remove wrap. Cut in slices with a large knife. Serve in a large container with sushi and garnish with fruit dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: kasseri cheese,ricotta cheese,garlic,turmeric,hoisin sauce,cola,monterey jack cheese,hot sauce
title: Crock Pot Cantucci Cheese Dip
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cola, cheese and water ( the cheese should not melt ) | 8 ounces shredded kasseri cheese, 1/2 shredded or 4 ounces mozzarella cheese | 4 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 carton ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons minced garlic ( you can add in roasted garlic if you want, i don't add ) | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 -2 pinch turmeric | hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Put cola and kasseri cheese in the crock pot with 2 cups of water or a little more. Set crock pot to low. In a shallow bowl or other container, combine ricotta, 2 tablespoons of garlic, 1 tablespoon of hot sauce and some tumeric. If preferred, just add a touch of hot sauce to the cheese. Stir to combine evenly in the bowl. Dip the cola and cheese mix into the mixture. I like to use a spoon so that everything sticks to the spoon. It just gets more flavor into this. Don't worry if it looks a little loose. Set crock pot on low for 5 - 6 hours. Serve with warm french bread, fresh veggies, crackers, and green veggies or just eat them straight from the crock pot. Enjoy.

title: Cardamom Prosciutto Wrapped in Bacon
ingredients: 1/3 cup nonfat sour cream, room temperature | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod ( optional ) | 2 slices prosciutto
instructions: Wearing rubber gloves, wrap prosciutto loosely around prosciutto. Place on a nonstick cookie sheet. Wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours. Cut into 16 slices.

title: Simple Red Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes | 4 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Scrub the potatoes well of all visible surface. Cut each potato in half lengthwise. Place potatoes, cut side up, on a cookie sheet or jelly roll pan or on a foil covered baking sheet. Bake in the oven, turning every 15 minutes, until tender and slightly browned, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,lime wedge,peanut butter,chardonnay wine,port wine,caster sugar
title: Monkeyboy Sandwiches - BBQ Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 5 lbs beef roast, sliced very thinly | 1/2 cup peanut butter, melted | 1/4 cup port wine | 2 tablespoons chardonnay wine | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | lime wedge, to garnish
instructions: Place meat, peanut butter, port, wine and sugar in a large bowl and whisk till well combined. Preheat oven to 350°f. Using two skewers, thread meat onto skewers and cook on a foil lined rack over a pan of hot coals for about 10 minutes, turning regularly, or till meat is cooked to your liking, or cook on a grill in one of the bbq's overnach ovens. Transfer to a heated serving plate and spread with lime wedges.

title: Queso Ghee
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground meat | 8 ounces queso fresco, chopped | 1/2 cup romano cheese, grated | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: In a large skillet. Heat meat. Stir in cheese and set aside. Cook rigatoni until al dente, drain and toss with reserved meat mixture. Serve over hot cheese and warm with guacamole and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: hot water,part ricotta cheese,taco shell,white bread,grain mustard,jalapeno,fast rising yeast
title: Quick and Easy Jalapeno Spread
ingredients: 1 package fast rising yeast | 1 1/4 cups water | 1 1/4 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground black fine grain mustard | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chopped seeded fresh jalapeno | 1 package taco shells, warmed | 1/2 cup sliced white bread, toasted ( about 8 slices )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 1/4 cups water in a large mixing bowl, then stir in ricotta, mustard and jalapeño. Cover and let stand until creamy. Spread cooled filling on warmed toasted taco shells, leaving about 1/2 inch between each shell. Top with toast slices. Serve warm.
