Random Ingredients: lettuce,chicken bouillon powder,apple cider vinegar,red chili powder
title: Apple Cider Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar ( or vinegar ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder ( powdered chicken bouillon ) | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | lettuce, to garnish
instructions: In a screw top jar, combine all the ingredients and shake well. Serve over greens like red onion rings, tomatoes, or lettuce.

title: Fillet of Sole With Clam and Rum
ingredients: 18 ounces steaks | 1 cup clam juice | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 2 teaspoons rum ( or to taste ) | 6 tablespoons minced fresh parsley leaves | 6 tablespoons minced kelp ( mochi dumpling )
instructions: Dice the fillets crosswise. Arrange in a glass serving dish.

title: Cuciadine Bread
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls ( about 8-10 rolls ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 maraschino cherries, for garnish
instructions: Unroll one can of rolls, and separate the dough into 3 or 4 equal rectangles. Place the rectangles over the center, and flatten into an oval shape. Sprinkle with marjoram, and sprinkle with cherries to serve.

title: Cheese-Spiced Beef Tenderloin and Beef
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 1 lb thin rib eye steaks ( or tenderloin ) | 1/2 lb gruyere cheese ( we use cabot's cabot's cabot cheese ) | 12 ounces dried thin rice noodles | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 2 teaspoons crushed dry whole cumin | 1 teaspoon crushed dried whole fennel seed
instructions: Trim any fat from the meat. Cut the meat across the grain into 1/2 inch slices, then into 1/2 inch thick slices, each of these cutting slices standing back at least 3 inches of space and overlapping at the ends. Cut the slices in half crosswise. Lay them side by side on a piece of heavy foil, and put two or three sheets of waxed paper between them. Place the meat on the top of these two pieces of waxed paper. Using a meat mallet or rolling pin, pound the cheese to make 8 pieces that are roughly the same diameter as the meat slices. Wrap the meat tightly in the waxed paper, and refrigerate for 4 hours. Remove the string and foil from the wrapped meat. In a dry 12 inch skillet that has a tight fitting lid, roast the fennel and fennel seeds in 4 tablespoons of hot water for 15 to 20 minutes or till lightly browned. Remove from heat and transfer to blender. Add the drained noodles to the skillet, adding the cumin and fennel seeds and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Add the meat and marinade from the refrigerated steaks. Bring mixture to a boil, reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, basting occasionally. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes longer or till meat is desired tenderness. Remove from heat, remove the foil, and let stand for 5 minutes. Cut through the strips, return cheese slices to skillet and heat over moderately high heat until melted. Add meat to skillet and keep warm over low heat. Serve either over noodles and pass the remaining cheese at the table for dipping.

title: Fried Onion and Shallot Fritters (Bistrots Mit Weissweinsauch)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped shallots | 1 tablespoon finely chopped red onion | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh dill ( or 1/4 teaspoon dried ) | 1 1/2 cups unbleached white flour
instructions: Place flour in a large bowl. Gently stir in half of the shallots, onion and dill, or just under the dry mixture. Make a well in the centre. Sprinkle with a little extra flour if needed. Form mixture into a ball and knead briefly. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 5 days. Heat a large nonstick frying pan or a well seasoned cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Using a 1 1/4 inch diameter cookie cutter, cut out circles of dough. Fry fritters in batches for 2 to 3 minutes. Turn fritters over. Sprinkle with more salt and pepper as needed. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cheesecake,date,anchovy fillet,dashi,vanilla essence,balsamic vinegar,pork sausage,chocolate square
title: Pigs out Hot Chocolate and Sausage in Chocolate and Anchovy Crust.
ingredients: 1 liter dashi | 200 g chicken or 200 g pork sausage ( about 1 1/2 oz of sausage ) | 100 g good quality chocolate squares | 2 1/2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar, dark ( or red wine vinegar ) | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3 anchovy fillets, soaked in boiling water for 30 minutes ( leave them for no longer then 30 min, if they are not available ) | 8 dates, chopped | 4 ounces good quality chocolate squares | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | pitted dates, to decorate ( if using dried dates omit this step. )
instructions: If using dry anchovies soak in boiling water for 30 minutes then drain and cut anchovies into small pieces. Using an 8 in square baking tin, line the base evenly with the dates. In a large saucepan over a med flame melt the chocolate, adding a little water if needed to bring the chocolate to a rolling boil. If using canned anchovy fillets, strain them through a sieve or sieve after dipping them in the boiling water. Add the chocolate mixture to the pan and stir over a low heat until all the butter and oil has dissolved. Remove from the heat and add the vanilla essence, balsamic vinegar and chopped anchovy fillets. Taste and adjust the flavour with some salt and freshly ground black pepper, add any of the vanilla flavour and some freshly ground black pepper. Pour over the crème brûlée and decorate with sprigs of dates. Leave to set in the fridge until set then cut into bars and leave to stand for a few hours.

title: Homemade Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Grind all ingredients in spice mill or spice mill. Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: pink food coloring,vanilla bean,grape tomato,puff pastry,marinara sauce,beef tenderloin,coriander seed
title: Mediterranean Beef Pies

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Fill a saucepan with enough water to cover the surface of the saucepan and bring to a boil. Add marinara sauce, vanilla bean, and coriander seed.

title: Chinese Pork and Parsnip Pie
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground lean pork fat | 1 cup parsnip, peeled, sliced and shredded | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs or 1 cup plain breadcrumbs ( i prefer progresso ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream ( may substitute 2 % for fat ) | 2 cups lettuce, shredded ( may use mixed lettuce ) | 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | 3 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Combine pork fat and parsnip. Combine stuffing ingredients and mix well. Place 1 tbsp filling on an upper edge of each phyllo sheet. Fold in the sides and continue folding until a pastry sheet is folded into a crescent. Place on a lightly greased baking dish, brush with some of the melted pork fat. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,salt pork,pizza sauce,dark soy sauce,chicken wing
title: Pesto Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs fresh chicken wings | 1 cup pesto sauce | 1 cup pizza sauce | 3/4 cup dark soy sauce | salt and pork, chopped
instructions: Make two shallow slashes in each wings at the joint of each wing, starting at the tip of the wing and pounding with a knife until the blood vessels separate from the membranes. Let the skin of the wing dry off and discard. Place in a large bowl along with the pesto sauce, pizza sauce, dark soy sauce, salt and pork. Toss to thoroughly coat all of the wings with the sauce and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Line bamboo steamer with heavy duty paper towels. Bring to room temperature. Preheat the broiler. Remove the wings from the marinade and place them in small, deep bowls. Let them dry on a foil covered cookie sheet set at room temperature until ready to use. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Bean and Sour Mushroom Burritos
ingredients: 3 cups vegetarian refried beans | 1 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons minced onions | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | tortillas ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, combine refried beans and sour cream. Stir in onion. Heat on low, then remove from heat. Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours. To serve, spoon mixture into tortillas.

title: Spinach, Orange and Lychee Salad
ingredients: 3 bunches english spinach, washed | 2 bunches fresh coriander, washed | 1 orange bell pepper, washed, de-seeded and chopped | 12 ounces lychees, cooked, chopped small | 1 container marshmallows
instructions: Heat 2 tbsps of oil in a non stick frying pan. Fry the spinach quickly on either side for about 4 mins per side. Remove from pan. Put collards aside. Place the corriander on a large flat plate. Add the peppers and oranges to the same pan with the spinach, and toss well. Cover and cook for 8 mins over a medium heat. Mix in the fried collards and ¾ of marshmallows. Stir to mix and turn off the heat. Place remaining marshmallows on top. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger,cayenne,apple,almond,vanilla extract,beef stew meat,maraschino cherry,coriander seed
title: Apple Ginger Beef Curry (Beef or Pork Roast-Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat or 3 lbs boneless pork shoulder roast | 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 1/4 cup sliced fresh coriander seed | 1 tablespoon cayenne | 1 tablespoon whole coriander seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger, peeled grated | 1/2 cup sliced peeled apple | 1 -28 maraschino cherry, halves ( optional )
instructions: Trim fat from outside of the roast. Cut a slit on one side of the roast, lengthwise. Insert slices of peel from apple into cut, along with a small amount of maraschino cherry halves, if using.

title: Aussie Baked Sausages
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pork loin, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 3/4 lb bulk italian sausage | 3/4 lb boneless beef roast, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup raisins | 3 -4 teaspoons garam masala | 1 1/4 cups greek yogurt | 1 3/4 cups cold water | 1/4 lb sultanas or 1/4 ounce garam masala
instructions: Cut pork into 1/2 inch wide chunks. Cut sausage into 1 inch pieces. Brown sausage in a large skillet until well browned. instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place coconut, carom seeds, vinegar, honey and 2 tablespoons water in a skillet over medium heat and bring to a boil. title: Healthy Sticky Corn and Frozen Veggie Rice(Low Fat)

instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the rice and fry until it has a light golden brown color, 1 to 2 minutes. Add the corn, vegetable and stevia and stir to combine. In a cup or small bowl, stir together the yogurt, coconut, and any other flavorings desired.

title: Steeped Steamed White Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups steamed white rice ( not instant ) | 4 -5 spring onions
instructions: In a big bowl, mix steamed rice, spring onions, and instant coffee together. Cover, and keep in refrigerator for at least 20 minutes to let the flavors blend. Steam the rice in a pressure cooker for about 20 minutes.

title: Roasted Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 3/4 cup black olives, pitted and chopped | 1/2 cup beef bouillon granules
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Stuff the pork roast with the olives and beef bouillon granules.

title: Spicy Thai Dip

instructions: Add mayonnaise or miracle whip to a bowl or serving dish and mix well. Place coriander and lime juice in a mortar and pound to a powder with pestle. Add coriander and lime juice to mayonnaise or miracle whip mixture. Add mirin and mix well.

title: Easy Chiles & Sausage Sandwiches (Lebanese )
ingredients: 1 cup amish friendship bread starter | 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 4 kaffir lime leaves, torn into large pieces | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 can chopped tomatoes and green chilies, drained
instructions: Place the amish starter in a large bowl and add 1 pound of ground beef. Drain the starter and place in the refrigerator. In a food processor, process the shredded beef until finely chopped, about 10 minutes add the remaining ground beef, grated cheese, kaffir lime leaves, and powdered sugar and pulse process until the mixture is well combined but not completely smooth. Transfer the mixture to a shallow pan or pie plate. Spread the mixture into one side of both sides of the bread slices, buttered sides down. Bake the sandwich on a hot baking tray for about fifteen minutes or until the toasted bread edges are golden.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,cilantro leaf,oxo beef cube,corn,portabella mushroom,flat leaf parsley,cream mushroom soup
title: Mexican Beef and Portabella Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 4 ounces finely chopped portabella mushrooms | 2 tablespoons oxtail oxo beef cube, finely chopped ( optional ) | 2 cups drained canned red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can creamed corn
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the cilantro and parsely. Add the portabella mushrooms, oxtail, beans and soup and mix well until well combined. Transfer to an 8 inch square baking dish and top with the cooked cheese mixture. Cover with foil and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 40 minutes. Remove and serve hot with sour cream.

instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange the chutney in a shallow roasting pan. Arrange the sirloin steak slices atop the chutney in a slightly overlapping pattern. Arrange the chips evenly over the sirloin meat.

title: Thai Steak Wraps

instructions: Dry the fish well on paper towels. Heat up your wok, you'll want to make the wraps easier. In mine, place the steaks, seam side down, in there. Sprinkle the sugar, marjoram and garlic. After a few minutes, turn the meat around, until all sides are covered. Keep turning the meat as you go, until all sides are evenly browned. Put on a cutting board. Serve in the wraps.

title: Swiss Cheese with Masala

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Using a pastry brush, coat cheese mixture with mixture, turning to coat on all sides.

title: Namibian Crab Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup rum or 1/4 cup rum, at room temperature | 8 ounces crabmeat, minced | 1 teaspoon oriental sesame oil | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 2 small heads of cabbage ( about 6 cups )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In small bowl combine cream cheese, rum, crabmeat and sesame oil. Slice cabbage crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Put a cabbage leaf on work surface. Spread cream cheese mixture in one layer in middle of leaf, leaving 1/4 inch free at the top and bottom of leaf. Sprinkle lightly with lemon juice. Arrange 1 cup of the crab mixture in a horizontal layer over the cream cheese mixture. Starting at one end of the leaf closest to you, roll up leaf tightly. Place cabbages in a single layer on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake about 25 minutes or until filling is bubbly and cabbage is tender. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,button mushroom,white wine vinegar,chipotle chilies adobo sauce,soy sauce,pecan,seasoning salt,orange bell pepper
title: Mexican Confetti Mushrooms (Appetizer Style)
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh button mushroom | 1 ounce pecans or 1 ounce walnuts ( or more ) | 1/2 cup sweet orange bell pepper ( diced ) | 2 dried chipotle chilies in adobo sauce, crushed | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon maggi seasoning salt ( or other salt substitute ) | mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place the walnuts or pecans in a food processor and process to fine crumbs consistency. In a second bowl, mix all the other ingredients together to make the dressing. Combine the breadcrumbs and the onion. Take the mushrooms out of their shells and chop coarsely. Place the chopped mushrooms in a single layer on a cookie sheet, not touching. Place 1 tsp of dressing over the mushrooms, then top with the crumb topping and finish with the rest of the dressing. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve with minted mint.

title: Aubergine (Eggplant) With Salami, Aubergines, Turnips
ingredients: 450 g aubergines ( eggplant ) | 25 g romano cheese | 50 g hard salami | 1 medium turnip
instructions: Preheat oven on the highest setting on your laptop. Peel the eggplant, cut in 3/4 inch slices and place on a baking tray. Brush lightly with olive oil and bake for 1 hour at 500°f. While the eggplant is baking, roughly chop salami and turnip and toss with the cheese. Slice the eggplant and place on a cutting board and roughly chop. Using a sharp knife, slice diagonally to obtain a large rectangular shape. Brush with oil and toast in the oven for about 10 minutes. The eggplant should be tender and the salami should be warm and slightly crisp. Serve. Note, if the salami is hard and crumbly, break into pieces and mix with the eggplant to get the right texture.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,egg yolk,water,white sugar,sauerkraut,amaretto,beef stew meat
title: Sauerkraut Balls in Amaretto
ingredients: 2 cups sauerkraut | 1 egg yolk | 1 1/4 cups water | 3/4 cup white sugar, or more to taste | 2 cups bread flour | 1/4 pound beef stew meat - thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon amaretto
instructions: In a large bowl, mix sauerkraut, egg yolk, and water until well combined. Gradually mix in sugar. Stir in bread flour until dough is too stiff to work with. Cover and set aside for one hour. Mix stew meat and amaretto in a small bowl until well combined. Roll into small balls. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, about 15 minutes.

title: Healthy Sausage Sandwich

instructions: Put all the ingredients into an oven proof large frying pan and bake in the oven at 220c for about 20 minutes.

title: Thai Phyllo Samosas (Phyllo Triangles)

instructions: Preheat oven. Lay the phyllo out on one of the lids in an over, spraying each layer with pam. If using a fan, lightly grease with olive oil or a nonstick pan, that fits snugly onto your oven. Spread a small cup of the chili in the bottom of a rectangular slice of parchment paper. Lay 2 sheets in front of you, brush with a little more olive or vegetable oil and another small cup of chili in the center and brush with olive oil. Lay 2 more sheets on top of the first, brush the last with olive oil and spread with another small cup of chili or coconut and a bit of dijon. Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have used all the phyllo. When you have layered your pan, layer your layered phyllo into a 13x9 inch pan or similar sized baking dish, placing about 1 1/2 cups of coconut on top, not in the middle. Add the 1/2 cup of white wine and one cup of water and stir to combine well. To serve, pour onto tray and top with a scoop of sweetened coconut, and a dab of dijon. Random Ingredients: vanilla,ginger garlic paste,lime,gruyere cheese,goat cheese,zucchini,cajun seasoning,sea salt pepper
title: Grilled Veggie Rollups
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini | sea salt and pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup freshly grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup freshly grated gruyere cheese | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 2 tablespoons lime, juiced | 1/4 cup freshly grated gruyere cheese | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning, or to taste | 1/3 cup freshly grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan for high heat. Cut zucchini in half lengthwise and cut halves in half crosswise. Lay zucchini halves in a mixing bowl. Spread equal amounts of zucchini on a work surface. Place a strip of zucchini lengthwise along the length of one piece of zucchini, then roll up lengthwise. Slice the roll diagonally into 1/4 inch wide strips. Arrange roll diagonally in a circle on a serving platter. Mound equal amounts of equal amounts of cheese filling along the top and sides of the roll. Garnish rolling top with remaining 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning, 1/3 cup gruyere cheese, 1 teaspoon lime juice, and 1/4 cup gruyere cheese. Allow to chill for at least 10 minutes before using. To make aioli, put a few teaspoons olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Cook until mixture is reduced and starting to brown, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Italian Sausage and Grape Salad II
ingredients: 3 -5 links hot italian sausage | 1 pint grape, seedless type | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed fennel seeds, crushed | 2 teaspoons coriander powder
instructions: Grind all ingredients together except for grape seeds. When you are ready to prepare salad, sprinkle a few grape seeds on top and toss. Pour dressing over salad and enjoy for a complete meal.

title: Quick & Easy Joes
ingredients: 100 g bean sprouts | 1 jalapeno ( or more to taste )
instructions: Cut the seeds from the jalapeno, then clean it finely. Rinse it under cold running water.

title: Baby Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 4 ears baby corn, shucked ( about 1.75 pounds total ) | 3 teaspoons italian bread, crumbs | 1 teaspoon minced garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh mace or 1/8 teaspoon ground turmeric | 3/4 cup cognac ( more may be needed to obtain right flavor ) | 2 tablespoons cake flour, for coating
instructions: Rinse the corn well under running water. Tuck the tips of the corn all around the corn being careful not to get into the meat. Combine the crumbs, garlic salt, mace and cognac together and mix well. Dip the corn into the crumb batter coating thoroughly. Lay the coated corn on a platter and refrigerate for 30 minutes or so. Remove the corn from the refrigerator and shake off any excess crumbs. Grill the corn until lightly browned, turning often, for 15 minutes. Serve warm, with your choice of accompaniments.

title: Tofu Burritos
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package firm tofu | 1 large poblano chile - or more to taste, seeded, and minced | 1 can cherry tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried hot mustard, or to taste | 3/8 cup self-rising flour, or as needed | 1/2 cup chopped celery, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Brush a 10 inch skillet with cooking spray. Drain tofu on a paper towel lined plate until liquid runs clear, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Mama Kupri - Filipino Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1 bunch lemongrass, outer leaves removed, split, and cut into 3 inch pieces | 1 -3 tablespoon sweet sherry | 1/2 cup orange marmalade or 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 small head cauliflower, separated into florets | kosher salt and cracked red chile pepper | 12 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: In a large saute pan, brown chicken lightly in 1 tbs. Sherry on one side. When chicken is mostly browned, add remaining 1/2 cup sherry and the sliced pieces of lemongrass. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Turn chicken over and add marmalade. Cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring frequently. Transfer chicken to a dish. Reduce heat to medium low, cover and cook for 15 minutes. Add cauliflower, cook until cauliflower has softened, about 5 - 7 minutes. Stir in chile and spoon onto plate with chicken and serve.

title: Indian Grape Salad - Houby Ka Dora
ingredients: 2 -3 cups grapes ( i prefer red like california ) | 2 bunches flat leaf parsley, chopped, loosely packed, just before chopping | 1 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup tahini ( sesame, almond may be substituted, just be sure to use sesame only, not the sweet stuff ) | 1 packet fresh curry leaves, optional ( optional ) | 1/2 cup light cornstarch | 1/2 cup thick salsa or 1/2 cup low-sodium tamarind sauce ( i use cholent )
instructions: Cut off the tops of the grapes so the grapes will stand upright and remove any seeds. Rinse and pat dry, then coarsely chop them. Mix together the grapes, parsley, and parsley, then set aside. In a saucepan combine the tahini, curry leaves, cornstarch, and tamarind and hot pepper to taste, and mix well. Stir in the grapes/parsley mixture and heat, stirring over medium heat, until it just turns a little warm. Stir in the salsa, adjust salt to taste, and stir in the parsley and mix well. Serve immediately or chill the salad in the fridge for up to a week. It will keep in the refrigerator well, as long as it stands, but will thicken the sauce a little as it cools.

title: Quick Sausage Gravy
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausage, casings removed | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 2 bunches fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon harissa ( to taste ) | sliced gherkin | top ( optional topping )
instructions: If using a sausage, make sure it is loose enough to remove casing. Trim any remaining fat and break into 3/4 inch pieces with a cleaver. Pierce the asparagus with the end of a sharp knife and pull the strands out with your fingers to the tips of the asparagus. If the meat is exceptionally fatty then it is not necessary to remove much fat or vegetable fat. If your meat is exceptionally fatty then it is not necessary to remove much fat. If you are using a nonstick frying pan, add oil to medium heat and put the asparagus pieces in to fry. In batches, fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until the asparagus is crisp and slightly coloured. They do not need to be cooked completely through. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the asparagus to a food processor. Dice the sausage into half inch lengths, put them in the pan once again and add the garlic and the raw asparagus. Pulse for 5 or 6 or until the asparagus is chopped. Add the harissa and pulse for a couple of seconds. The mixture should be fairly dry so do not over process. Pour the seasoned liquid through a sieve or a medium sized heatproof jug into the pan. Add the asparagus mixture and stir well well to mix well, but do not bring to bubbling. Heat through. Do not boil. If you are using a pressure cooker, add ingredients 1 or 2 at a time to the pan or pressure cooker. Stir and stir occasionally to ensure even cooking. Cook over medium heat, reducing the heat when necessary to prevent the mixture from sticking to the bottom of the pan and burning. Simmer 20 minutes, stirring regularly. When the gravy is thick and creamy, transfer to a warmed serving bowl. Add a slice of gherkin. Ladle the gravy over the sausage meat and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,cumin seed,yellow squash,liquid smoke,worcestershire sauce,chili paste,tart baking apple
title: Spicy Apple Squash
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 6 small tart baking apples - peeled, cored and diced | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon dry chili paste mixed with 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 15 ounces yellow squash, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a shallow baking dish. Mix cumin seeds and 1 tablespoon of the worcestershire sauce together in a small bowl until well blended. Mix in the remaining worcestershire sauce. Mix apples with remaining sauce in a large bowl. Spoon the apple mixture into the prepared baking dish, being careful to get the mixture as close to the edges as possible. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until apples are tender, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,belgian endive,coconut milk,dark sesame oil,picante sauce,guacamole,bay seasoning tm,poblano chile
title: Mexican Endive and Bean Stew With Picante Sauce
ingredients: 7 guajillos chiles | 8 belgian endive, cleaned and chopped | 48 ounces coconut milk | 1/4 cup unsweetened macadamia-flavored picante sauce | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons old bay seasoning tm | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | shredded coconut-flavored guacamole, if desired ( garnish ), if desired ( optional )
instructions: Place a 6 to 8 quart heavy pot over moderate heat until almost smoking. Remove the stems and seeds from the chiles.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,spinach leaf,rosemary leaf,grain white rice,rump steak,chicken,bok choy
title: Beef and Broccoli Rice on Stilts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low sodium chicken fat | 2 1/2 cups uncooked long grain white rice, uncooked | 4 cups chopped leftover cooked roast beef or 4 cups leftover cooked chicken | 1 head bok choy, halved lenghtwise, tips removed and cut into bite sized pieces | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves, stems removed, washed and spun dry | 8 large fresh hot-cooked rosemary leaves | 8 ounces sliced deli swiss cheese over the top of each beet, about 36 pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a medium bowl, combine the chicken fat and the rinsed rice. Add the beef, bok choy, spinach, hot pepper and the cooked rosemary. Cut the steamer insert lengthwise to make 2 1/2 inch long coils. Working with one piece at a time, shape into a nest with the stem end toward you. Repeat with remaining wheat and spinach leaves. Bake, covered, until rice is tender and beginning to brown, about 40 minutes. Remove pan from oven.

Random Ingredients: sauce,fillet,maraschino cherry,seasoning salt,green capsicum,grand marnier,beef stock
title: Baked Beef Roast With Fresh Capsicum
ingredients: 6 small red capsicums | 2 green capsicums | 1 teaspoon steak sauce | 12 ounces beef stock | 2 ounces grand marnier | 3 tablespoons steak sauce | salt | 3 ounces steak sauce | 1 ounce steak sauce | 1 ounce steak sauce | 1 ounce maraschino cherries, washed and left dry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f cut 4 thin slices from the capsicums so that you have a striped shape. Remove the seeds. Cut on the diagonal slashes. Place them in a roasting tin so that they are of uniform thickness. Use the thin strips of capsicum flesh that can be retrieved easily if they have difficulty removing the flesh. Toss the capsicum strips with steak sauce and put into the oven along with the beef cubes. Toss with the grand marnier, steak sauce and maraschino cherries. Put the tray under a preheated broiler, skin side down, until golden and tender and the beef juices have run out, approximately 2½ - 3 hours. Remove and allow to rest, for 15 minutes before carving.

title: Spinach and Garlic Saute
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh spinach | 3 1/2 ounces dry teriyaki sauce | 1 ounce dry-roasted garlic tomato paste | 9 roma tomatoes, sliced | 16 ounces french-fried onions
instructions: To clean spinach, remove hard stems and leaves. Chop leaves, if necessary, and spin them. Place spinach into large pot of boiling water, and cook until just limp, about 6 to 10 minutes. Immediately drain the spinach and squeeze out excess water. In medium bowl, place the teriyaki sauce, garlic tomato paste, and french fried onions. Stir well and allow to sit for 30 minutes. Mixture should be just about the right consistency. Adjust the amount of heated sauce to suit your own taste. Transfer the sauteed spinach to a large saucer shape, and place in a saucer of hot water to prevent steaming. When the spinach is chilled, use a slotted spoon for scooping out the spinach and garlic before turning over. Serve.

title: Green Beans & Rice on the Half Shell (Labaan Bil Zayt'El Kousha)
ingredients: 1 cup dry rice | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups broth ( i use the broth ) | 1 container fat-free yogurt ( optional ) | 1 lemon wedge ( optional ) | 1/2 lb green beans, cut into 2-inch lengths | 1/2 lb red grape, halved ( or other green color grape ) | 5 -6 chopped clams, with juice
instructions: In a pot, bring 2 cups of water to boil, stir in dry rice, and let simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. In a skillet, bring chicken broth to a boil and pour over rice. Cover and cook 20 minutes, until rice is tender and broth is absorbed.. While rice is cooking, stir the yogurt into yogurt along with lemon, if using, and green beans. Remove rice from heat and pour yogurt mixture over hot mixture, tossing gently. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,italian herb,blackberry,pigeon pea,pie shell,half cream,bow tie pasta
title: Bow Ties With Two Fruit Slices
ingredients: 6 cups cooked bow tie pasta | 10 ounces frozen shelled pigeon peas | 1 pint half-and-half cream | 3/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon dried italian herbs | 1/4 ounce blackberry jam or 1/4 ounce other dried fruit jam
instructions: Cook bowties according to package directions, adding peas to pasta during the last 2 minutes of cooking. Drain. Meanwhile combine cream, vanilla and herbs in a medium sauce pan. Heat over low heat until hot but not boiling. Combine warm cream mixture with pasta. Spoon into prepared pie pan. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Spicy asian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 500 g asparagus | 1 red capsicum, roughly sliced | 1 tablespoon of your favourite red curry paste
instructions: Trim the asparagus and cut in long strips.

title: Easy Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf ciabatta | 1 tablespoon minced chives | 1 teaspoon garlic powder or 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: Slice bread into 16 slices and place on baking sheet. Sprinkle with your favorite spices. Bake at 350°f for about 10 to 15 minutes until lightly golden brown on top.

title: Yogurt Cheese
ingredients: 500 g beet, washed but not peeled | 2 tablespoons turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Wash the beets. If they turn out to liquid, rinse. Cook them for about 20 minutes in boiling, salted water. When the beets are tender, put them in a blender and add the other ingredients. Mix and serve on an oven tray. If you want for a treat, mix a piece of butter and oil, mix with bread before eating.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,apple juice,pomegranate molasses,button mushroom,self raising flour
title: Moroccan Mushroom Pancake Recipe
ingredients: 500 g self rising flour | 150 g shredded light button mushrooms | 150 ml apple juice | 100 ml pomegranate molasses | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed, coarsely crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Whisk the flour, pomegranate molasses and cumin seeds together. Place the mushroom, apple and garlic in a microwaveable bowl. Cover and cook in oven for 3 minutes on full power. Remove lid and mix with other ingredients. Spread mixture over the pizza base. Bake for 20 minutes until the underside is golden. Place on a wire rack to cool. Serve sliced toasted.

title: Tasty Buttermilk Samosas
ingredients: 1 liter buttermilk | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons kahlua ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large jug. Shake to mix evenly. The samosas will keep for a minimum of two weeks in a cool, dry and dark place. When ready to use, check the consistency of the soup. Add more salt if necessary. The samosas are tasty, crusty and slightly dry. If needed, you can add more buttermilk.

title: Easy Beef Curry
ingredients: 1 can beef gravy | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 8 slices smoked streaky bacon, chopped & crisp | 500 g frozen spinach | 8 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Heat gravy with curry powder, bacon, spinach & horseradish. Simmer 20 - 25 mins or until warmed through. Serve with rice.

title: Peachy Ziti with Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound dry ziti pasta | 1 can peach slices, drained and chopped | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ziti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still slightly firm, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and cool the pasta under cold water. Drain once cooled. Meanwhile, make the peach peach tomato sauce. Pour 1 can peach slices in a saucepan, and simmer over low heat for about 5 minutes, or until heated through. When the pasta is cool, drain well, and place into a medium bowl. Remove the pips, and place the remaining can of peaches into a bowl, breaking them up into smaller chunks. Mix in the tomato sauce and peach mixture, and stir well to blend. Transfer the pasta mixture to a greased 2 quart baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap, and chill the dish until the flavors combine, about 2 hours. Preheat the oven broiler. Place the chilled pasta dish into the preheated oven. Cook until the top is lightly browned, and the ziti is hot, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,lime leaf,nonfat milk,zucchini,vegetarian beef stock cube,molasses,xanthan gum
title: Low Carb Spicy Veggie Mince Soup
ingredients: 12 fresh lime leaves ( or more if desired ) | 1 zucchini, diced | 4 celery ribs, diced | 2 vegetarian beef stock cubes | 4 ounces molasses ( can use treacle but we prefer molasses, so i use treacle ) | 1 tablespoon lime leaf curd, powder for vegetarian ( or equivalent recipe of your choice ) | 2 cups nonfat milk
instructions: Place 1 lime or more into the bottom of your double boiler over simmering water. Heat on medium, stir to break up any clumps. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of lime and celery and add them to the boiling soup. Add the soy sauce, molasses, stock cube, and lime curd powder to the soup. Cover, and bring to a boil over medium low heat. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 30 minutes, stirring from time to time. You should have a thick, creamy, and soup like consistency. Remove from heat and chill before adding to your cooked meatballs, or let cool at room temperature, and refrigerate for at least an hour before using. Serve with sliced fresh vegetables and crackers.

Random Ingredients: coffee,graham cracker crumb,pizza dough,black tea,brown gravy mix,beef sirloin steak,chicken wing,spinach
title: Easy Crockpot Beef and Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless beef top sirloin steaks ( cut the beef into 4 equal parts, or use whatever size you cut ) | 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach | 3/4 cup brown gravy mix ( i use the zatarains brand ) | 1/2 cup black tea | 1 package instant pizza dough ( 1 1/2-lb ) | 1 ounce instant pizza dough ( i use jiffy brand ) | 1 can pizza sauce with mushrooms, with liquid ( i use hunt's brand ) | 1/4 cup brewed coffee | 1/2 ounce graham cracker crumb
instructions: Cut steak into large bite size pieces, about the same size meat as your spinach. Put spinach in bottom of crockpot. Sprinkle brown gravy mix over spinach, and top with steak pieces evenly sprinkling over marinade mix. In small bowl, combine black tea and pizza dough. Spray a 12 in. Frying pan with cooking spray, and heat over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: lavender,chicken breast half,wakame,golden syrup,black bean,cherry tomato
title: Black Bean and Lavender Chicken Salad
ingredients: 6 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons dried lavender | 1 can chick-peas, drained and rinsed | 4 fresh cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Sprinkle breasts with a little sesame or soy sauce, and set aside. Combine golden syrup and lavender in a saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes, or until fragrant. Strain through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl, and add the chicken. Marinate for 1 hour in the refrigerator. Meanwhile, combine chickpeas, and cherry tomatoes in a nonreactive serving dish, and toss to mix. Heat chicken on grill. Cook chicken 4 - 5 minutes per side, or until chicken is nicely done and the juices run clear. Serve salad with some reserved dressing.

title: Yukon Gold Salmon Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon, cut into bite size pieces | 4 yukon gold potatoes, cut into bite size pieces | tap water
instructions: In a large stew pot or dutch oven, boil potato until tender, about 12 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain potatoes and run under cold water to cool. When potatoes are cool enough to handle, transfer potato to a bowl. Using a slotted spoon, put potato in potato, coating evenly, and shake to remove potato from the pot and place into a bowl. Add salmon to the potato and coat well. Add potato and salmon mixture to the kettle. Add water to just barely covering the salmon. Bring to a boil, stirring frequently and bring soup to a boil again. Simmer over medium heat until thickened, about 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hungarian paprika,sirloin,mini chocolate chip,boboli pizza crust,pea carrot
title: Hungarian Nachos
ingredients: 1 boboli pizza crust | 1/4 cup frozen peas and carrot | 1/4 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon dried mini chocolate chips ( optional ) | 1 lb ground sirloin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Roll out dough thinly as possible. Cut into squares. Place on pie plate covered with parchment paper. Combine vegetables, paprika and chocolate chips, if using. Sprinkle evenly over dough. Cover. Bake 25 minutes. Remove from oven, top with beef, and place under broiler until brown. Serve hot.

title: Creole Mexican Shredded Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork roast | 10 fluid ounces kahlua | 3/4 cup olive, sliced | 6 -8 pitted ripe olives, sliced | 3 tablespoons creole seasoning | 8 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon celery salt
instructions: Cut pork roast in half. Insert a skewer to poke holes through the bottom crust. Brown meat on all sides. Combine kahlua, olives, celery salt, and creole seasoning. Pour over meat. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Remove meat and cool for about 10 minutes. Shred into meat in a large roaster or a crock pot. Add remaining ingredients, except for the meat. Cover roaster or crockpot and cook on low for 7 hours. Add more creole seasoning if desired. To serve, place meat in a shallow dish and cover with plastic wrap. Turn in refrigerator to heat through. Serve with flour or corn tortillas, salsa, cheese, or sour cream.

title: Fresh Pineapple Chunks
ingredients: 16 pineapple chunks, in the shell | fresh basil sprig, for garnish
instructions: Wash the pineapple with a fork.

Random Ingredients: bulk pork sausage,yellow food coloring,beef broth,canola oil,chipotle powder,cinnamon,cream corn
title: Quick and Easy Chipotle Sausage Nests
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 pound bulk pork sausage | 4 cans condensed cream-style corn | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon yellow food coloring
instructions: In a skillet, heat the oil over medium high heat. Cook the pork sausage, stirring occasionally, until evenly browned. Drain the sausage, and return to the skillet. Pour the cream style corn and beef broth into the skillet. Stir in the chipotle powder, cinnamon, and yellow food coloring. Reduce heat to low, cover, and continue cooking for 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside for about 20 minutes. Preheat an oven to 200 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet, and spoon the sausage mixture into the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the biscuits are evenly browned, about 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Broccoli Ribs
ingredients: 2 pounds country style boneless pork ribs | 4 stalks fresh broccoli, washed and trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wrap the ribs in aluminum foil.

title: Couscous With Barley and Black Olives (No Boil) or Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked barley ( arborio ) | 2 1/2 cups uncooked whole wheat couscous
instructions: If using barley, soak it in water overnight, then drain. Bring the rice and barley to a boil in 2 inches of salted, boiling water. Cover the pan, reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed through, 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Fluff with a fork and let stand covered for 10 minutes. Place couscous in a large, shallow bowl, and fluff with a fork. Tip, you may use dried couscous or cook in the microwave in one cup of boiling water.

Random Ingredients: mirin,apple juice,beer,jicama,nutritional yeast,monterey jack cheese,ginger garlic paste
title: Ribollita (Caramelized Japanese Onion Salad)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pickled ginger-garlic paste ( see recipe id # 25375 ) | 2 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 5 tablespoons apple juice | 6 tablespoons lowfat monterey jack cheese ( shredded ) | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 4 jicama ( peeled, julienned ) | 2 cups beer ( i used labatt's famous beer )
instructions: Combine ginger garlic paste with mirin and apple juice. Add cheese, nutritional yeast, jicama and beer and stir to combine. Refill jicama bag or other container with lid and refrigerate until ready to serve, at least 2 hours. Serve on lettuce lined plates.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,chicken bouillon cube,italian breadcrumb,walnut half,vegetable bouillon cube,butter,beef hot dog
title: Papas Con Queso (Tropical Beef Hot Dogs With Coconut-Walnut Stuffing
ingredients: 1 large hot dog ( such as beef hot dogs ) | 3 tablespoons italian seasoned bread crumbs | 1 beef hot dog | 1 can unsweetened coconut cream | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 cup walnut halves, toasted and finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cut the hotdog in half horizontally. Place the hot dog halves on a plate. Sprinkle both sides of the hot dog halves with the italian bread crumbs. Dip them in the bread crumbs, and then roll them in the coconut cream. Set the two coated hot dogs aside. Prepare a large saucepan by adding the vegetable and bouillon cubes. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, and then cook uncovered for 15 minutes. Drain excess water, and then return hot dogs to the pan. Stir in the butter, reduce heat, and cook for another 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, and allow the sauce to cool. Place the walnuts into the refrigerator until thickened, about 2 hours. Serve the hot dogs in shallow bowls. Spoon the hot sauce over warm hot dogs to serve.

Random Ingredients: fruit,vegetable broth,beef bouillon granule,pesto sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Pesto-Stuffed Meatloaf
ingredients: 2 lbs dried mixed fruit, chopped coarsely such as cranberries | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | vegetable oil cooking spray | vegetable broth, for drizzling | 1/2 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Put dried fruit, boullion and 1 tbsp. Pesto into food processor and pulse to combine. Put the remaining pesto and broth into mixing bowl with all remaining ingredients. Tear off a small piece of parchment and cover with italian foil. Place it in the bowl and drizzle with oil and vegetable broth. Towards the end of mixing, use your hands to combine. Line a loaf pan with the foil and spray the top with vegetable oil. Spread meat loaf with pesto mixture. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until meat thermometer reads 185 degrees. Cover loaf with foil and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes before slicing. Note, this could also be prepared as is. The recipe does not call for dried fruits such as dried mango, papaya or mango juice. Some may want to make a double batch to use as they do not make for sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,vegetable oil cooking spray,goat cheese,baby corn,egg white,golden syrup,pesto sauce,chavrie goat cheese
title: Warm Goat Cheese Puffs
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray, for greasing ramekin | 1/2 cup goat cheese, finely crumbled | 1/4 cup golden syrup ( karo works great too ) | 1/4 cup plain yogurt ( whole milk or low-fat ) | 2 -4 ounces goat cheese, shredded | 2 egg whites, lightly beaten | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 1/2 ounces baby corn, cut off the cob ( fresh or frozen ) | 7 ounces goat cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Coat a 10x15 baking dish with non stick spray. In a medium sauce pan, heat goat cheese and golden syrup over low heat, stirring until melted. Remove pan from heat and cool until it is slightly warmer than room temperature. Add yogurt and beat well by hand to incorporate until the yogurt is smooth. Add goat cheese mixture and fold until combined. Spoon dollops of the goat cheese mixture into the prepared dish and smooth the surface with a rubber spatula. Bake at 350°f for 15 to 20 minutes or until the tops are a light golden brown. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Quick Pressing Machine Red Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1 jarred red chili peppers ( or to taste ) | 500 ml pillsbury refrigerated refrigerated stale red pepper jelly | 1 maraschino cherry
instructions: Plug in the knead machine to make simple cuts to the top of jarred peppers. Add the red peppers and process on the dough cycle according to the manufacturers directions. After dough cycle, press the dough button to release the steam from the dough. Let dough rise for 20 minutes before proceeding. To press the dough, place the dough on a non stick skillet or jelly stick. Press out the air bubbles, then place pan over medium high heat and when the dough looks shiny looking, place the dough into it and reduce the heat to medium. Cook on both sides, until just starting to turn light brown. Remove dough from pan, and allow to cool. After 20 minutes, remove jelly from heat, and roll out the dough into a rectangle about 10x9 inches. Slice the dough into about 1/8 inch squares, making a sandwich. Repeat with remaining dough and filling. Place in refrigerator until ready to use. To press jelly, place the dough onto a non stick skillet or jelly stick. Press out the air bubbles, then place on one layer of jelly. Slice the jelly into 24 pieces, making a sandwich. Repeat until jelly/crust mixture is gone. Garnish with a maraschino cherry.

title: Bread Machine Pear Muffins
ingredients: 8 ounces cups milk | 1 teaspoon canola oil ( not olive oil ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 pear, peeled and sliced into thin wedges
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f with a baking stone set in the center of the oven. Place the oven rack on the second highest level in the oven and heat the oven to 400°f in a large mixing bowl, combine the milk, canola oil, baking soda, turmeric and pear pieces together. With a slotted spoon, stir the ingredients into the hot but not boiling baking stone until the mixture is smooth and creamy, about 5 minutes. Insert a round or square skewer along the top of each muffin to release steam. Cook for 12 - 15 minutes, until the muffins are puffy and golden brown.

title: Homemade Coriander Seeds
ingredients: 10 teaspoons coriander leaves | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a mortar and pound with a pestle. They should form a fine paste. Store in a clean jar.

Random Ingredients: cocktail onion,paprika,olive oil,ladyfinger,green cardamom pod,lemon juice zest,wine vinegar
title: Grilled Onion Rings With Chermoula
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil or 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 16 -20 ladyfingers, split lengthwise | 1 tablespoon paprika | 2 2 teaspoons wine vinegar ( about 1/4 cup ) or 2 teaspoons lemon juice ( about 1/4 cup ) | 12 -20 pimento-stuffed green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon olive oil ( or canola oil ) | 1 dash salt | 1 green cardamom pod, split lengthwise
instructions: For the chermoula, combine all ingredients in a small bowl and set aside for flavors to infuse. Arrange 8 - 12 ramekins on each plate. To prepare the onion rings, preheat grill to medium low just below medium high heat. Brush the onion rings with the olive oil. If you like, use a small sprayer and place on each of the ramekins. Place lid on grill and place lid on grill. Let cook for 35 - 40 minutes or until the onions feel plump. Remove the lid and sprinkle with salt. Remove from grill and let rest for 10 minutes. Carefully remove ring ring rings from the grill. Serve hot with sweet chermoula or sesame kulcha.

title: Pasta With Sole and Bacon
ingredients: 16 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1/4 lb bacon, diced | 1/4 cup vinegar | 4 kaffir lime leaves, minced | 1 dash cinnamon | hot sauce | hot sauce
instructions: Cook pasta with hot sauce on stove, to desired doneness on the outside and soft in the middle, then drain. Cook bacon in a skillet over medium high heat, until crispy. Remove from heat and chop into thin strips. Add vinegar and stir until absorbed. Add sausage, bacon and lime leaves to sauce. Stir with bacon and pasta. Serve warm with additional hot sauce on the side.

title: Fried Maple Glaze for Maple Salmon
ingredients: 4 cups pure maple syrup | 3/4 cup canola oil
instructions: Combine all in a bowl, and whisk with a whisk. This glaze can be served warm or chilled.

title: Strawberry Espresso Tortilla Bake
ingredients: 1/2 cup espresso ( or coffee ) | 2 2 tablespoons fajita seasoning mix ( or sub regular fajita seasoning ) | 4 -6 large corn tortillas ( or 4-6 corn tortillas or flour tortillas ) | 1 package fresh strawberries, quartered | 1 bag frozen strawberries, defrosted and halved | 1 pint fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced | 8 fresh apricots, quartered
instructions: Bring espresso and fajita seasoning mix to small boil. Toss chopped tortillas in coffee and let stand for 5 minutes to absorb the coffee. Spread 2 tablespoons espresso mixture evenly over 1 side of 1 tortilla. Top with second tortilla. With the spatula, spread remaining espresso mixture over tortilla, espresso side down, to form a crust. Top crust with sliced tomatoes, fresh strawberries and sliced fruit. Sprinkle sliced apricots on top. Cut stack of tortillas or corn tortillas into 2 - 3 wedges.

title: Yummy and Yummy Pancetta and Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can campbell's tomato soup | 5 slices pancetta, chopped | 1/2 cup low fat natural yogurt
instructions: In a soup pot, heat tomato soup until warm. Stir in pancetta. Cook about 3 minutes or until pancetta is warm and onion is soft. Pour into bowl and sprinkle with yogurt to taste.

title: Vini Brochette
ingredients: lettuce leaf | 1 ounce prosciutto | 1/3 teaspoon white wine ( dry )
instructions: Cut the bacon into thin slices, cut in half lengthwise. Cut a round from the lettuce with scissors. Place the slices on a slice of prosciutto and sprinkle with white wine. Roll up into a bundle and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: thai chile,rice flour,olive oil,yellow lentil,vegetable broth,vanilla bean
title: Rice Noodles With Dhal and Peppers
ingredients: 1 ounce thai chile | 1 1/2 cups yellow lentils | 3 cups vegetable broth | 1 pinch pure vanilla bean | 1/4 cup rice flour | olive oil ( for frying )
instructions: Cut thai chiles into halves lengthwise and scrape out the seeds. Chop roughly and set aside. Rinse lentils, and set aside. Blend lentils, broth, and beans into a stockpot. Add chiles and spices and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15 - 20 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, make the rice flour. Drain the lentils and vegetable broth through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl, discarding solids. Stir rice flour into the stock and return to a simmer. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes or until mixture thickens. Stir in vanilla bean, and allow to cool. Using an ice cream scoop or a coffee mug, carefully place about 1 tablespoon of chilled mixture into each of 8 coffee cups and freeze in small discs until solid, at least 1 hour. Serve.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,dill pickle,pasta shell,fettuccine pasta,molasses
title: Quick Picnic Pasta and Ricotta Spread
ingredients: 1 pound dried fettuccine pasta | 1 package dried miniature pasta shells | 1 cup milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup chopped dill pickle ( optional )
instructions: Cook crumpled pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente. Rinse with cold water and drain. Mix ricotta, molasses and pickles in a small bowl. Layer a 1/2 cup of the pasta mixture in the bottom of a large soup or fondue pot. Sprinkle 1/3 cup of the crumb sauce on top. Repeat layers. Bake in a 400 degree f oven until bubbly and the crumbs are golden brown, about 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Hot Pecans Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup pecan halves | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh chervil | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh garlic salt | 2 tablespoons hot red pepper sauce
instructions: Place the pecan halves, chervil, garlic salt and red pepper sauce in a bowl and set aside. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Stir to blend flavors.

title: Raspberry Salad With Yogurt
ingredients: 2 heads red leaf lettuce, washed, dried, torn in pieces | 2 cups fresh raspberries | 1 cup plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Boil the raspberries with the garlic and a dash of salt for about 10 minutes. When cool and drained and set aside, put the vinegar and 2 tablespoons of corn oil in a blender and add the yogurt, whisking until smooth. Now add the raspberries and toss to combine, then mix all of the lettuce in to the dressing and serve.

title: Thai Turkey Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs ground sirloin | 2 tablespoons fresh minced gingerroot | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon crushed chile pepper | 1 tablespoon hot canned chile pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons crushed cracker
instructions: Mix all except the beef in large bowl. Add beef and mix well. Shape into burgers about 1 inch thick. Chill 3 hours. Grill over hot coals, or over medium high coals setting, brushing frequently with any remaining marinade. To freeze, place cooked burgers in single layer on baking sheet and bake at 450 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes. Gently flip and bake for 10 to 15 minutes longer or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees.

title: Creamy and Fresh Coconut Scallops
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon minced fresh rose water | 2 teaspoons peanut oil or 2 teaspoons flaked coconut oil | 1 lb fresh tilapia fillet | 1 tablespoon shortening | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup sour cream | finely chopped salted peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Combine coconut milk, bouillon cubes, rosewater and oil in a saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until coconut milk is hot. Stir in fish. Cover and continue cooking until fish is just cooked through, about 5 minutes. Drizzle with creme fraiche. Sprinkle with peanuts.

Random Ingredients: carrot,vegetable oil cooking spray,rice,white rice,papaya,jam,corn oil
title: Jambalaya Rice
ingredients: 2 cups white rice or 2 cups brown rice | 1/2 cup jambalaya ( papaya ) | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 2 cups carrots, shredded | 1 teaspoon rice, dry | 1/4 cup jam | vegetable oil cooking spray ( such as pam )
instructions: Rinse the rice in a colander until the water runs clear. Put into pan, add water. Bring to a boil, put lid on, turn stove to low. Cook for 15 minutes, do not stir, cook for an additional 5 minutes. Do not over cook,. Rice is cooked when soft and creamy. Dump everything into a large measuring cup and cover tightly with a lid to stand at room temperature. Turn on oven to 400 degrees. Coat a deep skillet with cooking spray, spread in pan and heat it on medium high. When it's hot, put 1/4 teaspoon of oil into the pan and when it starts to sizzle, pour in the rice. Stir and let it sizzle for about 8 or 10 seconds, then stir. Add carrots, jam and 1/4 cup of water to the pan and bring to a boil and boil for about 2 minutes, stirring often. Turn stove to lowest possible setting. If the rice looks too dry, add water a tablespoon at a time. Add water to the pan to loosen. The amount will vary depending on what rice package you use, but keep an eye on it.

title: Tikka Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 4 pounds pork shoulder, cut into 8 pieces
instructions: Heat a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Cook pork pieces in oil until brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side, about 5 minutes total.

title: Prawn and Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 cup canned bean sprouts | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 60 ml dry sherry or 60 ml vermouth
instructions: Combine together all ingredients in a bowl. Chill. Just before serving, serve with your favourite salad.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,white wine vinegar,black pepper,calvados,rye bread,saltpeter,ouzo,lettuce leaf
title: Rosti Nicoise (Cold French Onion Soup)
ingredients: 10 small marinated artichoke hearts ( cold, cut into 2x1-inch wedges ) | 1 teaspoon coarse salt ( about 1/4 tbs ) | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1/2 cup ouzo | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons calvados ( balsamic vinegar ) | lettuce leaf | 6 slices rye bread, such as thick sourdough bread
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut artichokes in half lengthwise and then crosswise in 1/2 inch slices. Arrange artichokes in a single layer on a foil lined baking sheet cut side up. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Broil, turning occasionally, until just warmed through, about 6 to 7 minutes. Whisk together ouzo, vinegar and calvados in a small bowl until blended. Stir mixture into warmed artichokes. Fill a large bowl with ice water and place bread slices on top and rub with olive oil. Drain artichokes and transfer to ice water. Press out as much moisture as possible and chop coarsely. To freeze, place bread in a freezer bag with a weight. Pipe about 1 1/2 cups of the soup into each ice cube and return to freezer. Return soup to freezer and remove as much air as possible. Transfer soup to a freezer container and return to freezer for 2 to 3 hours. To serve, pour 1 tablespoon of ouzo mixture into a large bowl. Cut bread into quarters and scoop soup into bread slices. Top with reserved croutons and serve immediately.

title: Lite Tuna and Pea Salad
ingredients: 225 g yellow peas, shelled | 115 g tinned pitted olives, drained, finely chopped | 225 g tinned tuna in water, drained, well flaked | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 teaspoon sweet pickle, pickle relish | 1/2 teaspoon bottled horseradish | 3 spring onions, finely sliced
instructions: Boil the peas for a few mins until just tender, then drain. Toss everything together and serve. Horseradish, cucumber relish, pickle & olive flavoured buttercream.

title: Baked Riesling Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/3 cup riesling wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush the sides and bottom of a large baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange the chicken breasts on top of the riesling wine. Bake in the preheated oven for 12 minutes at 400 degrees f. Turn the chicken breasts over, and continue baking 25 minutes, or until juices run clear.

title: Noodles With Salami and Chilies
ingredients: 1 cup vermicelli ( fresh or dry ) | 1 -2 slice genoa salami | 2 -3 small fresh serrano chilies ( depending on size )
instructions: Put the noodles on to boil. When they float, remove with slotted spoon and drain in colander. While they are draining, cut salami into small bite sized pieces. Add salami and chilies to a large skillet. When salami is golden, add cooked noodles. Let simmer while stirring.. Remove salami and chilies with slotted spoon. Serve with crusty bread. Yum.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,fruit,farfalle pasta,grand marnier,currant,lemongrass,plain flour,plum tomato
title: Tomato, Farfalle & Currant Salad
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb bow tie pasta | 8 ounces currants | 1 medium plum tomatoes | 4 ounces fresh parsley sprigs | 3 -5 tablespoons plain flour | 1 lemongrass, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons grand marnier | extra fresh parsley sprigs ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook the farfalle in a large pan of boiling water, uncovered, for 3 - 4 mins or until al dente.

title: Corned Beef & Dried Onions
ingredients: 1 corned beef | margarine
instructions: Put the corned beef in a casserole dish that has been browned lightly. Pour over enough boiling water to cover the corned beef and leave to simmer in a moderate oven until the corned beef is tender. This will take approximately 1 1/2 hours. Drain off the liquid into a measuring jug and skim off any excess. Skim off all but a film of fat. Melt the margarine in a frying pan over medium high heat. When hot, add the onions to the butter and stir well. Pour over the corned beef, cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until the onion is tender. Serve hot, with crusty bread or mashed potato.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,salt black pepper,golden raisin,honey,self rising flour,green chili pepper,grand marnier
title: Golden Jubilee Puffs
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisins, chopped | 1/4 lb feta cheese, finely crumbled | 1 small green chili pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 cup self-rising flour | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Spray an 8 to 9 ounce square baking dish with cooking spray. Stir together the raisins, feta, chili, honey and grand marnier in a large bowl. Gradually stir in the flour, beating in the mixture until all the flour is absorbed. Spoon out the batter into the prepared baking dish and put into the preheated oven. Roast in the lower third of the oven until golden brown and puffed, about 20 minutes. Carefully remove the puffed denguchettes from the baking dish and allow to cool completely on a wire rack. Serve warm.

title: Pineapple Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups canned sliced pineapple | 4 cups cooked basmati rice | 2 cups fresh tomato puree | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar
instructions: Drain the pineapple and rinse under cold water. Place the drained pineapple, rice, tomato puree and vinegar in a large bowl. Add the drained pineapple and mix well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,snow pea,burdock root,fish stock,cream cheese
title: Danish Split Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 lb red lentils | 3 3 cups fish stock | 1 package chopped burdock root | 1 package snow peas, trimmed and halved or 2 cups cut fresh mushrooms | 4 -8 ounces cream cheese, cubed
instructions: Add lentils to 6 cups of hot stock and simmer, covered, for 2 minutes. Drain. Blend in blender and set aside. Add fish bones and burdock to soup. Mix well and simmer 3 minutes. Add snow peas and simmer for another 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add cream cheese and mix well. Chill and serve chilled.

title: Mama Dessi's Famous Beef Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 can jalapenos, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup vodka | 4 tablespoons cocoa | 1 white onion, chopped | 1 french bread, cut into 1 1/2 inch slices | 1 english cucumber, cut into 6 rings | 1/2 lime, juice of
instructions: Prepare barbecue for medium heat, place a wire rack on a foil lined grill surface. Place the beef skewers on the rack, pour the beer over the beef, and grill the beef just long enough to brown the beef. Turn the skewers often if necessary until they are cooked to your liking. Transfer the beef to a cutting board and let cool slightly. Remove the beef from the beer and set aside to cool completely. Cut off the meat strings, cut the meat into cubes or cubes, and set aside. Combine the vodka and cocoa in a small bowl and set aside,. Place the onion, french bread, chile, and vodka sauce in a food processor and process until smooth. Drain the marinade from the beef and combine with the onion mixture. Thread the beef on the skewers, alternating layers with marinade. Serve with spiced lime juice.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,egg noodle,tortilla,vodka,paprika,beef bouillon cube
title: Noodle, Beef, and Vodka Burrito Recipe
ingredients: 1 envelope refrigerated egg noodles | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 cup vodka | 1 - 1 1/2 cup cooked drained hot v20 steak meat or 1 -1 1/2 cup cooked chicken | fresh tortilla, garnish
instructions: Boil the noodles drain and set aside. Combine beef boullion, curry paste, paprika, and vodka in a medium size saucepan and heat until boiling. Add meat and cooked noodles and simmer on medium low heat for 6 - 8 minutes or until heated through. Stir frequently to prevent sticking and cook a few minutes longer. Taste noodles and add any remaining seasoning. Serve with warm tortillas or eat plain.

title: Aussie Beef Curry With Coconut
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef | 250 g unsweetened dried grated coconut | 1 bunch fresh coriander, roots trimmed and finely chopped | 1 1/4 tablespoons cayenne pepper or 1 1/4 tablespoons other ground chile | 500 ml canola or 500 ml light olive oil | freshly cracked black peppercorns ( optional )
instructions: Place beef in a large saucepan or wok, add enough water to cover and bring to the boil over high heat. Skim any foam from surface. Reduce heat to medium. Cover, add coconut and coriander roots and simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Skim any oil that floats to the surface. Stir in cayenne and boil 2 minutes, or until heated through. Lift out from heat and discard coriander roots and coriander roots. Pour curry into 4 warmed serving bowls. Arrange peppercorns on top and serve immediately. Variation, for a more colourful presentation, garnish with grated pineapple, or serve with white wine vinegar or lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,blueberry,mustard powder,red bell pepper,vanilla bean,avocado,ginger garlic paste,active yeast
title: Blueberry Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon ground mustard powder | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 red bell pepper, sliced into thin strips | 1 can beef roast, drained and sliced into strips | 1 package frozen blueberries | 1 can sliced peeled avocado
instructions: In a large bowl, sprinkle yeast with mustard powder and mix well. Add the ginger garlic paste, and stir well. Add the sliced avocado, red bell pepper, beef and blueberries. Add vanilla bean slices and mix thoroughly. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes. Place one slice of bread on a work surface, and spread with the guacamole of your choice. Spoon the beef mixture into the bread. Fold the other slice of bread, and serve as a sandwich using your favourite topping. A dollop of cream cheese or sour cream can be added in to the topping for added kick.

title: Pesto White onion Dip
ingredients: 1 small white onion, finely minced | 2 tablespoons basil pesto ( prepared )
instructions: In a bowl toss all ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend and flavours to blend. Use to dip fettucini or other types of fresh pasta.

title: Creton Filling a Cupboard Muffins
ingredients: 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 10 tablespoons skim milk powder | 10 tablespoons double cream
instructions: In a bowl, combine celery and 2 tablespoons of milk powder. Add 10 tablespoons of milk and beat until smooth. Spoon into a pan and cook over a med low heat for 5 - 10 minutes. Pour onto a paper lined tin. Using a round circular motion, flatten into a circle approximately 5cm thick and 8 20cm in diameter. Allow to cool down completely. Use in place of single cream mixture that you have in the original recipe and fill the cups to the brim. Leave a few gaps in for steam for the filling so your muffins don’t have to fit perfectly. Serve with your favourite ice cream.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,gruyere cheese,apple cider vinegar,red enchilada sauce,fajita seasoning,chili oil,queso fresco
title: Spicy Queso Fresco Enchiladas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chili oil ( or olive oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon fajita seasoning ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dry mexican cheese ( or use a mixture of cheddar and monterey jack ) | 2/3 cup queso fresco ( or use a combination of cheddar and monterey jack ) | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar or 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 -2 teaspoon fajita seasoning ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dry mexican cheese ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 bay leaf
instructions: Heat chili oil or olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Cook until bubbly. Continue to simmer. When ready to serve transfer to a bowl and add a dab more cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,lemon,cream chicken soup,new potato,spinach leaf,bisquick baking mix
title: Spinach Bake
ingredients: 13 ounces frozen spinach leaves | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup marsala wine or 1/2 cup other sweet white wine | 2 cups original bisquick baking mix | 12 1/2 ounces frozen new potatoes, thawed and peeled | 1/2 cup freshly squeezed lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bake spinach in a 9 inch cast iron skillet over medium heat, stirring, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the spinach from the skillet and squeeze as much liquid out of it as possible. Combine rice krispies mix, soup, wine and lemon juice in a bowl. Add spinach, tossing to coat. Spoon mixture into a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Sprinkle with krispies mix and bake for 15 minutes. You may also cover and bake for 40 minutes or until center is hot and top is lightly browned. For a crispy crust top with a drizzle of marmalade and some chopped fresh mint.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,prawn,italian breadcrumb,italian spice,cream cheese,nonstick cooking spray,colby monterey jack cheese,coleslaw mix
title: Peppered Prawn Croquettes
ingredients: 1/4 cup coleslaw mix, finely shredded | 4 tablespoons cream cheese | 1/4 cup coleslaw mix, finely shredded | 1/2 teaspoon ginger root, minced | 1/4 cup italian breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon ground mixed italian spices | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1/3 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1 package frozen cooked prawns, thawed and sliced | 1 cup colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix, cream cheese, coleslaw mix, 1/4 cup of the shredded cheese, ginger and 1/2 teaspoon of the mixed italian spices in a 1 1/2 quart dish.

title: Guiness Irish Orzo with Cabbage and Carrots
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 1 pear - peeled, cored and diced | 2 carrots, peeled and diced | 1 small head cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 can guinness stout, drained | freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the orzo, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat the oven's broiler. Place the orzo in a large saucepan over medium heat, and warm the sauce slightly. Stir the guinness into the hot sauce, bring to a boil, and cook for 2 minutes. Toss the orzo with the cabbage, pear, carrots, and black pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: bulgur,beef bouillon cube,spanish onion,sherry,tamarind paste,pizza crust,vodka,jalapeno pepper
title: Beef and Beer Tostadas
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef bouillon cube | 2 spanish onions | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 dash jalapeno pepper, ground | 1 pizza crusts, such as boboli perfect calzones or ( 12 inch ) pizza dough, such as boboli ( i use pamela's vegan pizza dough ) | 1/2 teaspoon vodka ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon vodka ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar ( optional )
instructions: Meat mixture, brown meat in a large skillet over medium high heat. Drain or season with salt & pepper. Drain excess fat if desired. Slice onions thinly and set aside. Pizza crust, combine sherry, tamarind paste, sherry, and pepper in a small bowl. Spread meat mixture over bottom of pizza crust. Top with onions. Pizza filling, mix together beer & sugar, if desired, and add vodka or vodka to taste. Spread on top of meat mixture. Fold dough over into two halves of two long edges, and seal. Bake at 425°f for 20 minutes, until lightly browned in spots.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Guacamole
ingredients: 4 ripe sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1/2 cup guacamole | 2 tablespoons tomato juice ( from tomatoes packed in oil )
instructions: Drain sun dried tomatoes. Add guacamole and tomato juice to the sun dried tomatoes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Crispy Fajita Seasoning
ingredients: 1 envelope fajita seasoning mix | 1 2/3 cups preserves | fresh mint leaves or coriander leaves
instructions: Prepare the fajita seasoning according to package instructions. When fajita seasoning is ready, spread the mixture evenly on waxed paper lined cookie sheets. Cook the fajita seasoning in a 425 degree oven for 2 - 3 minutes or until the mixture turns dry. Cut the preserves into squares and serve at once as an appetizer. Store any leftover fajita seasoning in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,beef,extra beef,garlic clove,fast rising yeast,cinnamon,cumin seed
title: Shredded Beef Buns
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 3 1/2 cups very thinly sliced good quality beef, from the deli | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 lb lean best-quality lean ground beef | 3 garlic cloves, finely chopped | 1 1/4 teaspoons fast rising yeast
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering, about 4 minutes. Remove the skillet from the heat. Add the cumin and fry, stirring often, for 30 seconds. Add the beef, the ginger and 1/2 teaspoon salt, and stir to blend. Cover, and let stand 25 minutes. Preheat the oven to 300°f. Combine the ground beef, garlic, remaining 1 1/2 teaspoon salt, the yeast and remaining 1 1/4 teaspoon white pepper in a bowl. Knead well. Roll handfuls of the dough at a time into the prepared buns. Place them onto a greased baking sheet, and stretch out as thinly as possible. Bake 25 minutes, or until crisp.

title: Baked Pineapple Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 green capsicum, thinly sliced | 1 can pineapple slices with juice | 3 leaves lettuce leaves
instructions: Remove the top layer of fat from the noodles and put it on a plate to drain the excess water. Toss in all the vegetables except the lettuce. Heat the oil in a frying pan, add the noodles and stir until they turn opaque, about 2 - 3 minutes. Toss, add lettuce and toss again until the lettuce is absorbed. Serve.

title: Italian Sausages and Herbs
ingredients: 24 ounces italian sausage | herbs, of choice
instructions: First, make your fresh mix of herbs. I recommend, 3 - 4 stalks of parsley, 2 medium heads of garlic, 2 small heads of garlic, 1 whole head of garlic, 1 whole bulb of garlic, and 1 whole bulb of garlic. They give you a lot of flavor. Slice off all the other 1/2 of an onion and dice it coarsely. This can be done in advance, refrigerated, but make sure to put into the fridge just before serving. You can save a large head of garlic and the rest of the ingredients for another use. The mixture in this recipe is fairly dry at all times the food processor tends to smell very dry to the touch. As with most bread making. They are meant to be a mixture that tastes vaguely similar to sour cream. My way of putting all ingredients in and out, 1lb of italian sausage, 2oz of italian sausage, 3oz of italian sausage, etc. It is up to you depending on the size of your family. Also the idea is that you can put a layer of sausage and some onion, etc. It will all add out some of that traditional look to the bread. I've found that adding the mixture is a personal preference here. The choice is yours. I don't put it in the bread processor. This step is really important. You have to have a combination of ingredients. You can add up to 2 oz of mixed and 1lb of mixed, etc. At this point if you have any leftover mixture you can pull out of the freezer and give it to your friends. Let them chill in the fridge for 30 minutes. I have left it out for a little bit too. Take a bag of your herbs and put them in the bag with the sausage mixture. Take a sharp knife and cut a slice across the top of each sausage link. This cut will make them into 2 pieces. Then, do the same as above.
