I just pull a slice of the sausage along the side of the link and i cut a pocket in the side that holds the broth. You have two cuts at the bottom of each sausage link that would not penetrate the other. Then, cut the sausage slices crosswise into about a half inch wide, then slice those into a half inch wide ribbons. You will have 6 pieces of sausage. If you have any left over sausage mixture you can put that in a crockpot or pot just let it sit in those juices. Once you complete this layer, you will have 6 layers. Start with your first layer of sausages, then your first layer of sausage, and finally, your 1lb mixture, and finally, your final layer of sausages, and finally, your final layer of sausage, and last layer of sausages on top. If you have any leftover mixture you can toss it through your food mill, or just pour it into your saucepan. I have put this in the crockpot along with just a quick quick stir or two. Cook on low for around 7 hours or on high until the mixture is quite thick. Serve over spaghetti with parmesan cheese.

title: Filipino Fish
ingredients: 6 fillets fish fillets or 6 tilapia fillets | 1/4 cup flour | 1 cup cocoa powder
instructions: Coat fish in flour with cocoa. Fry in pan with olive oil or coconut oil. Serve hot.

title: Arugula and Pine Nut Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch rocket, washed well | 1 1/2 cups arugula, washed well | 1 large mango, cut in thin slice | 300 g roasted pumpkin seeds | 80 ml dark rum
instructions: Place rocket in salad bowl. Top with remaining ingredients except pumpkin seeds and rum.

title: Spicy Italian Sausages (Ceviche)
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 1 cup tortilla chips ( preferably dark or mexican flavor ) | 2 tablespoons chili, minced, to taste | 2 teaspoons allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rub the sausage with a thin coat of cooking oil and then set aside. Coat the entire inside of a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray and heat until shimmering. Add the sausage and cook, breaking it up with a wooden spoon or potato masher to caramelize evenly, until it is evenly browned, approximately 15 minutes. Stir in the chili and allspice and continue cooking until the mixture becomes slightly chunky and even in consistency. Pour mixture into a strainer and rinse. Spread tortilla chips on the bottom of the baking dish, breaking them up with the back of a spoon or potato masher. Pour sausage mixture over the chips and spread evenly. Bake for approximately 45 minutes, or until crisp and slightly browned on top.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,balsamic vinegar,canadian bacon,spaghetti sauce,ranch dressing,buttermilk,bouquet garni
title: Rye and Canadian Bacon Bruschetta
ingredients: 2 loaves rye bread, crusts removed | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 2 cups provolone cheese, shredded | 18 slices canadian bacon | 1/3 cup buttermilk | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 head bouquet garni, outer layer removed | 1 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Slice loaves of bread into 1/4 thick slices using a serrated knife. Place in a large baking dish and line with foil. Bake at 400°f for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and add spaghetti sauce, cheese. Shred with hands and place toasts on foil. Stir the bacon into the cheese and bacon mixture. Whisk in buttermilk, balsamic vinegar and bouquet garni leaves. Drizzle the dressing over toast or bruschetta. Place ontoasts on a warmed serving platter, cover and refrigerate several hours or over night. Re cover and reheat in the microwave oven until heated through.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,beef bouillon cube,orange peel,black cardamom pod,green lentil,coconut rum
title: Sweet Indian Lentils
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 teaspoon ground black cardamom pod, or | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom, or | 1/2 teaspoon ground fennel | 1/2 cup green lentil | 1/4 cup coconut rum | 1 1/2 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in 3/4 cup water
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet or wok over medium high heat. Saute the black cardamom, fennel and white lentils for 2 minutes. Add the coconut rum and beef broth. Cook for 2 more minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,bacon,heavy whipping cream,pumpkin pie spice,wine vinegar,cinnamon
title: Tex-Mex Bacon Pudding
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 cups heavy whipping cream, divided | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 dash cinnamon | 1 dash pumpkin pie spice | 1 dash wine vinegar
instructions: Place the bacon in a microwave safe bowl, and cook in the microwave until no longer crisp, about 15 minutes, turning once. Remove the bacon slices, place them into a bowl of cold water, and let drain. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Pour 1 cup of the cream in a roasting pan, and set aside. Stir in taco seasoning and cinnamon, and stir in bacon pieces. Add the rest of the cream, and stir in the cream. Sprinkle in the pie spice and vinegar, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Bake for about 40 minutes in the pre heated oven, until thickened. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,cilantro leaf,beef broth,yellow cake mix
title: Tortillas Mexicano (Copycat)
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 can beef broth | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 bunch cilantro leaf
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. In medium mixing bowl, stir together cake mix and broth until smooth. Stir in bouillon. Spray 3 cake molds with nonstick cooking spray. Spoon equal amounts of the cake batter into molds. Cover and bake in oven at 400 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Curried Carrots
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs carrots, peeled, sliced and drained | 7 fluid ounces bouillon | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Pour bouillon into a saucepan and bring to the boiling point. Add carrots and mash a lot with a potato masher over moderate heat, stirring with a fork. When carrots seem dissolved, reduce heat to very low and simmer until carrots are soft and well flavored. Turn heat off and stir in sour cream, curry powder and salt and pepper to taste. Let cool until flavors reach the desired texture.

title: Sultana Orange - Brandy Ham - Ham Salad
ingredients: 1 ham or 1 butterham | 50 g sultanas | 50 g orange juice ( about 6 oranges ) | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: If using ham trim away any excess fat. Slice into thin slices. Place in pan with sultanas and orange juice. Sprinkle with brandy. Cook slowly.

title: Artichoke and Shiitake Mushrooms With Philly Cheese Crust
ingredients: 2 cans water-packed artichoke hearts, drained | 1 -2 ounce white shiitake mushroom, sliced | 1 -2 ounce peppercorn | 1 ounce emmenthaler cheese or 1 ounce other swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Put all ingredients in a 3½ quart glass or ceramic bowl and mix with a fork until evenly distributed. Chill at least 1 hour and up to 24 hours. Turn out onto a hot, lightly greased griddle or high grill, spreading evenly. Cook about 3 minutes each side or until slightly golden. Serve immediately, or cool and slice.

title: Cumin Buttermilk
ingredients: 2/3 cup buttermilk | cumin powder, to garnish
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the buttermilk and cumin. Serve over toast, crackers or vegetables.

title: Easy French Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup margarine | 3 tablespoons dry mustard powder | 1/2 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender
instructions: Pour in margarine in a medium sized frypan. Add mustard, chicken base and lavender. Stir in the mixture well. Heat on medium low heat until margarine is melted. Do not let it boil. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: greek vinaigrette,cumin seed,thyme,chicken broth,swiss chard,salmon,shiitake mushroom
title: Albondigas (Chard with Smoked Salmon)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 4 cups chopped swiss chard | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup greek vinaigrette | 1/4 cup smoked salmon, chopped | 2 teaspoons snipped fresh thyme | 1/4 teaspoon harvey's natural ground black pepper
instructions: Place the cumin seeds in a small dutch oven over medium low heat and toast, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Turn off the heat, let cool until cool enough to handle, then grind the seeds in a spice grinder until fine. Place the chard in a large bowl with the chopped chard, chicken broth, greek vinaigrette, smoked salmon, thyme, and pepper. Stir to mix well, cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours, stirring occasionally. To serve, spoon the chard salad into warmed soup or pasta bowls, sprinkle with the cumin seeds, and serve.

title: Anchovy and Madeira Sorbet
ingredients: 2 cups ice water | 12 ounces madeira wine, chilled | 4 ounces fresh anchovies, drained and minced | 12 serrano chile peppers, finely chopped
instructions: Place ice water in a blender or food processor and blend until very coarsely chopped. Add the madeira and anchovies and puree until completely smooth. Return to the blender, cover, and run until smooth and frothy, about 45 seconds. Transfer to a container and freeze until firm, at least 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Transfer to a bowl, cover, and freeze until firm, about 1 1/2 hours. Transfer to a freezer container and freeze for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Linguine With Bok Choy, Noodles and Sherry
ingredients: 2 cups medium-sliced fresh bok choy | 1 lb linguine | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning, divided | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1/4 teaspoon table salt
instructions: Cut bok choy into 1/4 inch thick slices, lengthwise. In a 5 or 6 quart dutch oven or other large heavy nonstick skillet, bring 8 cups water to boil over high heat. Add half of the bok choy and cook, stirring, until it wilts, about 2 minutes. Remove immediately. Repeat with remaining bok choy. When water comes to boil, add linguine, stirring until it is just barely tender but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes per package instructions. Add 1 tablespoon italian seasoning and 1/4 teaspoon table salt. Return to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until it is tender and cooked through, about 12 to 18 minutes. Remove cover, increase heat to high, and cook until liquid is reduced to a thick sauce, about 5 minutes. Toss with cooked linguine. Serve immediately.

title: Grammy's Pea Balls
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons finely chopped scallions | 1 tablespoon minced chives
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs and peas in bowl. Stir in ginger garlic paste and scallions. Blend thoroughly. Shape into 1 inch balls. Roll in additional cracker crumbs. Chill until firm, about 1 hour. Transfer to a tray lined with waxed paper. Chill.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,pine nut,lemon zest,sage leaf,lemon juice,salad oil,watermelon,cherry pie filling
title: Watermelon and Green Chilies Salad
ingredients: 1 can watermelon, rind removed | 6 green chilies, seeded and finely chopped ( mild to hot... leave seeds in ) | 3/4 cup pine nuts | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh sage leaves | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 can cherry pie filling, drained | 1 tablespoon salad oil
instructions: Drain watermelon, reserving liquid. Process remaining liquid in a food processor or blender until smooth. Set aside. Finely chop chilies and place in a bowl, add reserved liquid, pine nuts, zest, sage and lemon juice. Mix well until combined. Stir in cherry pie filling and toss to coat. Serve chilled or at room temperature. For presentation, place salad leaves on a serving platter. Arrange watermelon mixture on top. Serve with salad leaves or plain rice. For vegan use the reserved liquid.

title: Cheese Sticks
ingredients: 2 loaves sharp cheddar cheese, with some grated cheese and a little mint | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Use to coat bread sticks.

title: Chili Puff (Smoked Pork Roast)
ingredients: 24 inches pork loin | 3 lbs sliced smoked pork loin | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1/3 cup watermelon, drained
instructions: Place pork roasting pan in the center of oven and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for one hour or until pork is tender. Remove from oven and reserve the liquid. Cut meat into 1 1/2 inch strips. Layer 1/2 slices of meat and 1/2 of the pine nuts on bottom of the pan. Place 1/2 of the sliced meat and 2/3 of the pine nuts on top of the pine nuts. Continue layering the meat, pine nuts and remaining ingredients in the pan until all is used up. Cover and bake in center of 375 degree oven until meat thermometer reaches 170 degrees. Slice remaining meat and serve on top of the warm liquid.

title: Tortillas
ingredients: 5 medium tortillas ( i use 5 small, flat ones ) | 10 -12 teaspoons caster sugar | chopped savory | cooking oat
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line a baking tray with two silicon kitchen sheets. Wash tortillas and place on the dry paper lined trays. Sprinkle with sugar. Sprinkle savory across tortillas. Sprinkle oat across tortillas. Place baking tray in oven for 12 minutes or until it starts to smoke. Remove from oven and let sit off your oven for 10 minutes or until all your ingredients have been absorbed. Cut into eight slices and serve with salsa. I've had this tortilla the first time i made it, but this is my personal favourite.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,egg yolk,head cauliflower,chuck,button mushroom,egg noodle,shrimp without tail
title: Eggnoodle-Noodle Beef, Shrimp & Veggies!
ingredients: 2 egg yolks | 1/2 cup vanilla ice cream ( optional ) | 2 2/3 lbs chuck ( i use lean stewing cuts ) or 2 2/3 lbs blade steaks ( i use lean stewing cuts ) | 1 cup whole cooked shrimp | 12 ounces medium to large button mushrooms, sliced | 1 medium head cauliflower, cut into florets ( about 3 cups ) | 7 ounces medium shrimp without tail ( i like to use the can of baby shrimp and the can you can buy the large fresh shrimp and'snaps'at the supermarket ) | 8 ounces fresh egg noodles ( i prefer the egg noodles as they are slightly thinner, if you prefer the noodles a little bit thinner, i use that the whole cooking time ) | 1/2 lb fresh mushrooms, washed, stems removed, caps left intact and thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a bowl, whisk yolks and 1/2 c vanilla. Cut the meat into large bite sized pieces. Place in a zip top plastic bag that fits snugly and marinate for 1 hour. Remove and discard the marinade, set aside. Place a large skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and pepper and cook for about 2 - 3 minutes. Add the remaining 1 1/2 c vanilla. Remove from heat and stir in the shrimp without tail. Toss in the noodles and mushrooms. Place in broiler pan and cook for about 10 minutes, until the shrimp is opaque. Serve with additional sliced mushrooms on top, if desired.

title: Creamy Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped celery | 2 tablespoons banana liqueur | 1/2 cup vegetable broth ( i use low fat ) | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Coat the work surface with a thin layer of vegetable cooking spray and set aside. Heat the vegetable broth and brown the celery with the banana liqueur. Add a dash of salt and pepper and remove from the heat. Put the fondue pot in to the freezer and let it return to room temperature. When ready, heat a skillet on high and add enough cheese to make a creamy coat of sauce. When cheese starts to melt add the fondue pot and toss to coat. Serve fondue with your choice of accompaniments and enjoy.

title: Duck Sherry & Mustard Roasted in Sherry
ingredients: 1 duck breast | cooking sherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/400f/gas place the duck breast in a roasting tin/tin that will fit in the centre of the oven, skin side down. Make sure you have the roast going down under the duck and then turn it down to 170c/350f/gas brush the skin with a little sherry, then sprinkle generously with cooking sherry. Wearing oven gloves, carefully place the chicken on top of the duck breast, skin side down. Brush with the remaining sherry and bake in the oven for 45 minutes, basting regularly with the pan juices. Let rest for 10 minutes before carving.

title: Sweet Squash Russian Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked and cubed butternut squash | 1 1/2 tablespoons powdered beef bouillon powder | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons dressing, v8
instructions: Dressing, whisk together all ingredients. Place squash cubes on a platter and drizzle the dressing.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,head cauliflower,peanut oil vegetable,orange flower water,mustard,cauliflower,grand marnier,button mushroom
title: Quick and Easy Asian Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 large heads cauliflower, cut into crescents | 1 head cauliflower, cut into large florets | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 8 ounces button mushrooms, quartered | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon orange flower water | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup other orange-flavored liqueur
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat the oil over medium high. Stir in the cauliflower, mushrooms, mustard and garlic powder. Cook and stir for 5 minutes or until cauliflower is coated with oil and mushrooms are tender crisp. Stir in the orange flower water and grand marnier. Cook for an additional 45 seconds.

title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 250 g thin egg noodles | 100 g cheese, cubes | 1 tablespoon finely chopped pepper | 2 teaspoons finely chopped chili flakes | 2 -3 lettuce leaves
instructions: Boil a large saucepan of water. Meanwhile, cook noodles. Remove the noodles from the heat and drain well. Combine noodles with other ingredients. Top with cheese.

title: Fennel Tea
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, trimmed | 2 tablespoons instant coffee powder or 2 tablespoons ground coffee, cooled
instructions: Cut fennel bulb crosswise into 1 slices, then cut 2 thin slits across the top of each slice. Place tea spoon upright in a steamer fitted with a steaming rack and fill with water to just below the bottom layer of fennel. Cover.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,currant,chocolate chip,panko breadcrumb,cornmeal,pepper flake
title: Chocolate Crunchy Corn Dogs
ingredients: 1 can corned beef or ( 1 1/2 ounce ) can beef broth | 1 1/4 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1/2 cup chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon dried currants or 1 tablespoon raisins, snipped | 1 -2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix corned beef with panko, cornmeal, chocolate chips, bouillon and pepper flakes. Heat on greased cookie sheet until thoroughly heated, about 10 minutes. Serve immediately or cool and freeze for later.

title: The Best Honey Glaze for Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar | honey
instructions: Mix together. Brush over roast. Bake at 350°f.

title: Pressed American Style Sandwich
ingredients: 4 thick slices low-fat ham hamburger buns | paprika or ground mustard powder | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Lay slices of the american style bun open and place 2 tablespoons of your favorite sandwich spice mix in the middle of the bun. Place the ham on top of the mix & sprinkle with your favorite cheese. Place the other 3 - 4 bread slices over the top of the cheese, then place the top of the bread slices over the sandwich. Cook at 375 degrees f until the bread is crispy & warm.

title: Dulce De Leche Bar-B-Queso--Almond Molasses
ingredients: 2 cups molasses, plus 4 tablespoons molasses | 5 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine the molasses, oil and almond extract. Mix until combined. Spoon the mixture into a funnel and carefully into a funnel. You can easily pipe as many dulce de leche bars in as many cups as you want.

Random Ingredients: cooking tapioca,thai red curry paste,gruyere cheese
title: Quick and Easy Tiramisu
ingredients: 9 ounces gruyere cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 teaspoon quick-cooking tapioca | 1/4 cup thai red curry paste
instructions: Mix all ingredients well together and store in refrigerator for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,lebanese cucumber,vanilla sugar,oat,limeade concentrate,dijon mustard,hard egg
title: Easy Low-Fat Citrus Salad With Lime Dressing
ingredients: 1 small lebanese cucumber | 1 1/2 cups low-fat oat or 1 1/2 cups fine grain rice cereal | 4 eggs | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 1 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 3/4 cup low-fat dijon mustard ( try coleslaw for free ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced thinly ( optional )
instructions: In blender, combine all ingredients. Blend until all grain are evenly coated and crumbly. Garnish with sliced egg. Makes 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,monterey jack cheese,hamburger bun,orange zest,bacon dripping,cocoa powder,turnip,goat cheese
title: Chile Colorado
ingredients: 1 cup bacon drippings ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 2 tablespoons goat cheese | 1 loaf of crusty hamburger buns | 1 large peeled turnip, chopped | 1 -2 ounce monterey jack cheese, if desired, grated
instructions: Combine bacon drippings, unsweetened cocoa, garam masala, orange zest and goat cheese in large skillet over medium low heat. Stir until cocoa mixture melts. Add turnip and monterey jack cheese. Serve hot. Keep refrigerated until needed.

Random Ingredients: baby red potato,asafoetida powder,ketchup,yeast,lettuce leaf,coriander seed
title: Shaabra - Baba Gosht
ingredients: 1 kg baby red potatoes ( about 12 medium ) | 500 g plain unrefined fresh yeast | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 6 lettuce leaves ( boston )
instructions: Clean and wash the potatoes. Place in a large mixing bowl. Prepare an electric mixer with the dough hook. Add all the ingredients except the lettuce leaves to the mixer. Mix for 2 minutes on high speed. With the dough hook, gradually incorporate the ketchup. Beat vigorously for 15 - 20 minutes on low speed until the dough is creamy and elastic. Allow the dough to rest for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into 6 balls and flatten each ball on a clean surface to a 7 - 8 cm or larger round on a lightly floured surface. Keep aside for 2 hours. With a rolling pin, roll out each round into a 6 cm or larger round of approximately 8cm or greater thickness. Using a cookie cutter, cut the rounds into the prepared rounds. Spread ½ teaspoon of water in a non stick frying pan and heat on high heat for 40 seconds. Place 4 - 5 slices of potato in the hot pan and cook on one side for 1 minute. Flip the potato over and cook on the other side for 2 minutes. Serve immediately with any remaining potato dip. Alternatively, serve with lettuce, bread, hummus, hummus, etc. If you are serving the shaabra, place the potato rounds and the cooked shaabra over the lettuce leaves and serve immediately.

title: Asparagus With Coconut Rice Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar or 1 tablespoon white balsamic vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon sifted powdered orange zest | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3 asparagus spears, cut into 1 inch lengths ( or equivalent cooked small fresh asparagus )
instructions: Toss the coconut, vinegar, saffron, orange zest, vanilla& asparagus in a serving bowl. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Oven-Baked Ziti With Raisins and Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces ziti pasta or 12 ounces penne | 4 ounces fresh cheese | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons black pepper | 4 tablespoons raisins | 7 teaspoons strong tea ( or more or less )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Cook the pasta until al dente. Combine the cheese with the sugar, black pepper and raisins. Grease the base and sides of an ovenproof dish or tin, pour in the cheese mixture and bake in the oven for about 25 - 30 minutes, until golden. Serve straight away. Variation you can use a 9x13 pan with a few ramekin dishes, instead of baking the ziti.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,cayenne,almond extract,molasses,celery leaf,coriander leaf,maraschino cherry,ghee
title: Indian Almond Crescent Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cups molasses | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander leaves | 1 stalk celery & leaves, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 tablespoons melted ghee | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 4 ounces slivered almonds ( about a 1/4-inch sliver total ) or 4 ounces slivered almonds, coarsely ground ( about a 1/4-inch sliver total )
instructions: Prepare a large food processor with the steel blade in place. Add all but the walnuts, 1 tablespoon of the melted ghee, almond extract, 1 1/2 teaspoon of salt and the ground almonds. Blend until smooth. Add remaining ghee, almond extract and 1 - 2 tablespoons of the chopped walnuts and process to combine. Scoop the dough out with wet hands into walnut sized balls and press between plastic wrap in a 9 by 12 inch rectangle. Use a star shaped cookie cutter to cut out the cookies. Set them aside until cooled. Store in a airtight container between sheets of waxed paper in a cool dry place for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,vanilla bean,chuck roast,chicken wing,guajillo chile pepper,mandarin orange,yellow squash
title: The Real Deal Marinated Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 2 lbs good quality chuck roast | 2 cans mandarin oranges ( can use orange juice ) | 11 ounces canned stewed guajillo chiles, minced ( or any other hot chile pepper you like ) | 3 red pepper flakes | 1 red pepper, roasted, peeled and diced | yellow squash, roasted, peeled and diced | duck wings
instructions: Poke holes in the roast with a fork and set aside. Reserve any leftover or use a meat thermometer to insure that it's always hot enough. Trim excess fat from roast. Slice all the way through the roast to almost through the bone. You should have 2 thin slices of roast. You can also use a meat thermometer of any brand you like, but you need to check that you don't put too much in there. Add enough to cover roast. Slice the beef across the grain into 1/4 inch slices, then slice it into approximately half inch strips. Heat up the marinade then pour over the meat slices in a 9x13 glass or ceramic dish. Add the drained mandarin oranges, stewed guajillo, diced red pepper, and roasted red pepper flakes. If using the stewed guajillo peppers, slice them in half so the guajillo peppers are the same size. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 24 hours. It should marinate at least two days, especially overnight if possible. Preheat over to 300 degrees. Uncover and bake on the middle shelf, checking after 45 minutes to brown the top. Slice the beef across the grain into 1/2 inch pieces. Discard marinate and serve hot or cold. You can use leftover marinade, but it's much more flavorful tasting after sitting, uncovered in a crockpot for 4 hours. You can cook on high for longer if you prefer. Note, if using canned guajillo peppers remove the seeds from the peppers and boil until soft then mash or puree by hand or with the back of a spoon. You may also use a food processor, but be careful not to puree the peppers too long as you will be adding oil in the pot. You will have huge chunks of pepper that will confuse you, and you will have the same taste as a soup.

Random Ingredients: shortcrust pastry,fine semolina,ziti pasta,coriander seed,ginger juice,pepperoni
title: Ziti With Ginger and Pepperoni
ingredients: 455 g ziti pasta | 1 teaspoon coriander seed ( or half a small can of coriander seeds and half a small pinch of cumin ) | 350 g fine semolina ( or coarsely ground unbleached flour ) | 300 g minced ginger with juice | pepperoni ( optional ) | shortcrust pastry, to seal
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190 c or 425 f or gas mark 3 and roll out the pastry so that it is about 8 inches square and 2 inches high. Cut the pastry into 3 - 4 squares and prick lightly with a fork and put a cup of water on the bottom of the oven proof dish and cook the ziti about 40 minutes or until tender. While the ziti is baking mix the other ingredients in a large bowl with the ginger, pepperoni if using and any liquid. Remove the ziti from the oven, sprinkle over the glaze and cook for a further 5 - 10 minutes. Do not over cook. Remove the ziti from the heat and place in the fridge until chilled, then slice into rounds. Top the ziti with the pepperoni slices and serve either hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,fenugreek,amarula cream liqueur,corn syrup,pineapple juice,italian pepper red,thyme leave
title: Spicy Italian Blend
ingredients: 1 ounce amarula cream liqueur | 1 ounce corn syrup | 1/2 cup pineapple juice, divided | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme leaves | 2 heads lettuce, torn cross wise | 2 italian peppers or 2 red peppers, stemmed, seeded and cubed to desired taste
instructions: Shake all the ingredients except the lettuce and peppers with cracked pepper and let sit for 1 hour to mellow. Then add the lettuce and peppers.

title: Kaffir Lime Cream Kisses
ingredients: 24 ladyfingers | 2 teaspoons sugar | 3 kaffir lime leaves, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: Arrange the ladyfingers on a plate. In a medium bowl, mix the sugar, lime leaves and red pepper flakes. Slowly whisk in the vinegar. Use a pastry brush or a brush to drizzle lime mixture over the biscuits. Press the lightly coated biscuit into the sugar. Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Chipotle Relish
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle pepper | 2 cups sweet purple onions, diced
instructions: In a small bowl combine ground chipotle and chopped onions. Store in refrigerator. Shake before use if desired. Use for dipping foods or salad.

title: Ron's Easy Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 16 ounces enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup of shredded spanish onion | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper, minced
instructions: Dip fingers in hot sauce until moist. Add 2/3 cup enchilada sauce. Pour one cup enchilada sauce in medium size casserole dish with sides. Add 1/2 cup of chopped onions, 1 teaspoon of chopped chile.. Dip hands in hot sauce until moist. Pour 3/4 cup enchilada sauce in bottom of casserole dish again. Add 1/2 cup of chopped onions, 1 teaspoon chile. Repeat with 1/2 cup of chopped onions and 1 teaspoon of chopped chile. Pour another 1/2 cup of enchilada sauce on top. Place casserole in oven and turn on to 350. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven.

title: Slow Cooker Pear and Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 boneless sirloin tip roast | 1 small can or bottle light beer | 1 can or bottle dark beer | 1 package frozen bread dough twists ( recommended -- boboli )
instructions: Trim fat from beef. Cut beef in half and remove excess fat. Place beef in a 4 to 6 quart slow cooker. Pour light beer and dark beer over beef. Cover and cook on low for 5 hours. Uncover and uncover to warm, 4 to 6 hours more. If using frozen bread dough twists cut off dough twists and shape into small rounds about 2 thick. To serve, place a slice of beef on center of a bread square, then top with a roll of dough twists. Serve with gravy for dipping.

title: Grilled Squash
ingredients: 2 yellow squash, halved lengthwise and seeded | 12 thick slices hamburger
instructions: Preheat grill for direct medium heat. Place squash halves in a large resealable bag along with the hamburger, squeezing out any extra air. Grill, turning once, until browned, 7 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,picante sauce,mint,chicken tender,boston lettuce leaf,haddock,bean sprout
title: Grilled Mexican Seafood Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup picante sauce, low sodium | 4 -6 boneless skinless chicken tenders | 1 head boston lettuce leaf, cleaned, washed and spun dry | 2 cups fresh bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons cilantro, chopped | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped ( or 2 tsp dried mint ) | 1 package imitation fried smoked haddock
instructions: Preheat grill. Combine picante sauce, chicken tenders, and any juices in bowl and mix well. Spread out lettuce leaves on grill rack so that they are not touching. Place a small pile of the bean sprouts on a cutting board and top with the fish and 1/2 cup of the cilantro/mint salad dressing to serve. Place the fish on the salad and top with remaining salad dressing, remaining half a bunch of cilantro and mint. Serve.

title: Guinness-Peanut Butter Spread
ingredients: 1/3 cup guinness stout | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Blend together in a food processor until smooth. Serve with crackers for dipping.

title: Cambodian Crackers
ingredients: 2 cans drained black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon cognac | 1 -2 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 cup cornmeal | crunchy blueberries
instructions: Combine all ingredients, tossing well. Roll into 1 inch balls and dip into crumbs. Fry in hot pan or in deep fat fryer. Drain well. Serve hot with strawberry preserves and cherry tomato sauce.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
ingredients: 125 g self-raising flour | 100 g oatmeal | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup bread, chopped
instructions: Combine flour, oatmeal through mustard seed and spices.

Random Ingredients: meat chicken,white sugar,cumin seed,vanilla essence,white cooking wine,red pepper,grain bread
title: Egyptian Elvis Elvis Sandwich (Aka Elvis Preserves)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs meat ( chicken, game, beef ) | 6 slices whole grain bread ( best quality ) | 1/2 cup white sugar | 3 tablespoons cumin seeds, roasted | 1 dash vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1 1/2 cups dry white cooking wine
instructions: Remove excess fat from chicken meat. Rinse well. Chop meat of any kind. Mix the two mixtures together, add white sugar if necessary, mix well after each addition. Put into a well buttered baking dish in the shape of a large star or star that is a good size 5 - 7 inches in diameter. Bake in a preheated oven until done, approx. 2 hours at 180°c. Serve with sliced cucumbers, tomatoes, etc.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,coconut milk,cream,salt,ham,creole seasoning,monterey jack pepper cheese,portabella mushroom
title: Hawaiian Portobello Mushroom and Ham
ingredients: 1 can creole seasoning | 1 cup coconut milk | 3 cups portabella mushrooms, diced ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup light cream | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | salt | 1 cup jose old ham, shaved | 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded
instructions: Mix creole seasoning, coconut milk and shrimp marinade and let sit 1 hour. In a baking dish, place 1/2 sliced ham and 1 cup of cheese in the bottom. Cover with 1/2 of the mushroom and then top with 1/3 of the mushroom mixture. Then top with 1/2 pineapple slices on top of each mushroom and pineapple. Add the other 1/2 of cheese and mix well. Poke the pineapple so the ham will fit. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until cheese is brown.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,kaffir lime leaf,green apple
title: Green Apple Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups grated monterey jack cheese | 3 lbs green apples, peeled, cored, and chopped | 1 jar kaffir lime leaves, drain well
instructions: In a bowl, toss together the grated cheese, apples, lime leaves and kaffir lime juice. Chill for a few hours before serving to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,beef brisket,cheese spread,sunflower oil,phyllo pastry,dark sesame oil,extra virgin olive oil,frosting
title: Phyllo-Wrapped Corned Beef With Cheese Topping #RSC
ingredients: 1 teaspoon light sesame oil | 1 beef brisket, trimmed of excess fat | 12 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 2/3 cup light mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 7 ounces cheese spread | 12 toothpick-size cups fresh cheese slices ( thickly sliced ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a small frying pan over medium heat, stir together light sesame oil and dark sesame oil. Add brisket and turn until it is evenly browned all over. Transfer brisket to a heavy duty foil covered cookie sheet. Brush brisket generously with mayonnaise mixture. Fold one third of the phyllo pastry sheet over the brisket on each side. Place beef on half of the second phyllo sheet and wrap tightly. Repeat with remaining phyllo and brisket, placing each on top of the next sheet. Bake until crispy, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Meanwhile, spread light sesame oil evenly on the surface of the cooled brisket and bake for 5 minutes. Transfer brisket to a serving platter and slice diagonally. Top with a slice of cheese. Broil brisket until cheese is just melted and bubbly, about 2 minutes. Pour melted cheese over the brisket and serve.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,shiitake mushroom,chicken broth,cornflour,lemon juice,pineapple ring,salad dressing
title: Smoky Brussels Sprouts Salad, Xia Tzeysha Style
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh brussels sprout, trimmed | 200 ml chicken broth | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 mushroom, cut into thin sticks ( capsicum ) | 1 small pineapple ring, halved ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cornflour, mixed with 1 tablespoon cold water | salad dressing, to taste
instructions: Blanch the brussels sprouts in boiling water for 2 minutes and refresh under cold running water, drain and plunge into cold running water. Place in a bowl, cover with a kitchen towel and let steam for 2 minutes. Remove the sprouts from the pan and allow to cool. Cut a cross in the base of the sprouts.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,butterscotch chip,chili garlic sauce,rhubarb,mustard powder,velveeta cheese,feta cheese,wine vinegar
title: Rhubarb Cheese Spread
ingredients: 250 g rhubarb, cubed | 1/4 cup cream cheese | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons butterscotch chips | 1 pinch chili-garlic sauce ( your choice ) ( optional ) | 1 pinch mustard powder | 1 pinch ground black cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a food processor, puree the rhubarb chunks and cream cheese until smooth. Add all the other ingredients, again, pureeing until smooth. Transfer to an upright glass type mixing bowl and sprinkle with the crumbled feta. Chill in the fridge for at least an hour. Serve on toast slices.

title: Grilled Brussels Sprouts With Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout, peeled and cut into 1-3-inch pieces
instructions: Place brussels sprouts in a large pot of boiling lightly salted water. Cover and cook 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and blot with paper towel to remove excess moisture. Transfer brussels sprouts to a large bowl and toss with enchilada sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,salt,pork roast,asparagus,red snapper,grape tomato,prosciutto,cream mushroom soup
title: Grape Tomato Wrapped Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork roast | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 lb thin asparagus, cut into 3-inch pieces | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 ounces prosciutto, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 pint grape tomatoes | 3 -4 teaspoons dry red snapper, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Place pork roast in a shallow roasting pan. Combine salt and 1/2 cup water.

title: Mexican Red Capsicum (Bell Peppers)
ingredients: 2 red capsicums | 4 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 cup vinegar | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Cut green and red capsicum and remove seeds. Cut capsicums in half lengthways and remove all the white membrane. Place all in a clean dish. Mix all the other ingredients together and pour over the capsicums. Mix well. Cover and leave for at least two hours. Cook on a hot barbecue, turning and basting every 10 minutes until the mixture is crisp and tender.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,beef tenderloin fillet,vegetable oil corn,meat,cranberry,pesto sauce
title: Curious Beef Tenderloin With Pesto
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( corn or canola oil will also work. just the oil will not be needed, just the corn ) | 2 beef tenderloin fillets | 1 cup shredded sirloin steak ( or other steak of your choice ) or 1 cup other beef tenderloin fillet ( or other steak of your choice ) | 1 cup fresh cranberries | 1 cup canned unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Brush your work surface with the olive oil and season with salt. Wash meat and pat dry. Lay fillets on cutting board or heavy duty cookie sheet which is flat. Using your rolling pin, trace an oval shape on the top of each fillet to allow moisture to escape during cooking. Place one fillet onto oiled cookie sheet. Using your other hand, gently stretch meat into an even oval shape. Turn over each fillet to brush both sides with olive oil. Place one almond in a small row on top of the meat. Bake for 40 minutes or until cooked medium or until internal temperature of meat registers 160 degrees when poked with a fork. Cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute. Slice into thin strips, place back onto cookie sheet.

title: Eurasian Beetroot (Eurasian Beetroot)
ingredients: 3 beets | 2 serrano chilies
instructions: Wash the beets, cut off the tops, remove and chop. Bring a large pot full of water to a boil. When boiling, drop in the beetroot, add serrano chiles and cook for about 15 minutes. Cook, stirring occasionally, for another 45 minutes or until the beets are tender. You can also slice the beets when they are cool. Don't overcook the beets serve hot, in soup cups, with bread to dip. Note, chile peppers can be substituted for the serrano chiles.

Random Ingredients: rotel,iceberg lettuce,tomato vegetable juice cocktail,white onion,lime,canola oil,butter,baby spinach
title: Spinach and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup canola oil | 1/4 cup butter ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons canned rotel ( i used mild ) | 1 can tomato and vegetable juice cocktail | 12 ounces fresh baby spinach, washed | 1 medium white onion, cut into strips | 2 limes, quartered ( optional ) | 3/4 cup shredded iceberg lettuce | 2 tablespoons finely chopped white onions
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt the butter and combine with rotel. Stir in the juice cocktail. Add the spinach, onion and lime wedges, if using. Cover and cook over low heat for about 2 minutes, stirring as needed. Transfer to a serving bowl, top with shredded lettuce, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Remove the lettuce and shake excess liquid from spinach.

title: Biscuit Manicotti
ingredients: 8 manicotti, cooked and cooled | 1/3 cup masa harina
instructions: Fill each of 4 paper lined 2 1/2 to 3 quart soups or muffin pans with cooked, cooled manicotti. Stir together the masa harina and the masa harina and mix well. Brush mixture on stuffed manicotti, using a pastry brush dipped in water. Place in a well buttered 9x5x3 loaf pan and bake at 400 degrees f. For 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: dill,large curd cottage cheese,tamari,date,squid,cream chicken soup,stewing beef,flat leaf parsley
title: Fried Beef Squid With Dilled Squid
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 containers large curd cottage cheese | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley | 1 lb yellow squash | 2/3 cup chopped dates | 2 tablespoons dill
instructions: Cut beef into bite sized chunks and set aside. Drain cheese of any excess moisture. Drain cottage cheese of any excess liquid. Combine cottage cheese, soup, tamari, parsley, and pepper together and stir until blended. Heat large skillet and add beef with any remaining marinade. Brown lightly and drain. Add the drained beef and corn mixture into the cheese sauce and stir until combined. Cook over medium heat until all ingredients are heated through. Serve in deep wide soup bowl with toast points for dipping.

Random Ingredients: lime powder,yellow cornmeal,chicken thigh,mushroom liquid,beef stew meat,beef gravy
title: Lime Stew over Cornmeal Crackers
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds cubed cooked chicken thighs | 1 package beef gravy | 1 can sliced mushrooms with liquid | 1 bag yellow cornmeal | 1 teaspoon ground lime powder | 1 cup beef gravy
instructions: Place chicken thighs in a large pot with 1 package beef gravy, sliced mushrooms, and yellow cornmeal. Pour enough water into pot to cover the chicken. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,molasses,red wine vinegar,ginger garlic paste,salmon fillet,cardamom pod
title: Smoked Salmon With Raspberries
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets ( about 1 1/2 pounds, 6 ounces per pound ) | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 cardamom pods ( i've used 1 tsp. cardamom pod powder in place of the ginger ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f rub the top of each salmon fillet with 1/4 cup of molasses, then brush the outside surface w/the other 1/4 cup of molasses. Place the salmon in a roasting pan, and lightly mist both sides with the remaining molasses. Roast in the upper part of the oven for 35 minutes, basting occasionally with the remaining molasses, until the salmon just flakes when pierced with a knife and a skewer comes out dry. While the salmon is baking, put the berries in a medium pan, and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Add the raspberries to the berries during the last five minutes of baking, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,herb,peanut,chicken meat,skirt steak,green bell pepper,coffee
title: Cafe Rio Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 green bell pepper, cut into 1 1/2-inch strips | 3 tablespoons prepared herb ( basil, sage, parsley ) | 1 lb skirt steak | 2 tablespoons brewed coffee | 1 teaspoon hot chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 cup roasted unsalted peanuts
instructions: Punch steak on all sides into a plastic baggie or bowl. Using hands, massage pepper strips well into meat. Soak in the coffee, chili garlic sauce and the peanuts for 10 - 15 minutes, or until meat is well cooked and slightly charred. Transfer to large pot, discarding any remaining bean drippings. Bring liquid to a boil, reduce heat to medium low and simmer until meat is cooked through and the liquid has reduced by one third. Season with salt and pepper if desired. Serve over hot, cooked rice.

title: Tyrokafteri (Lychee Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups lychees | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon dill weed | 1/4 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Finely chop the lychees and cranberries. Mix everything well in a bowl. Chill.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,chicken thigh,red chili pepper,herb,green pepper,water chestnut
title: Chicken and Bell Pepper-Stuffed Chicken Empanadas
ingredients: 12 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 green pepper, minced | 1 red chili pepper, minced | 1 bunch herbs ( chervil, parsley, and or basil, your choice... ) | 2 cans water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1 package refrigerated pie crusts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken thighs in a large skillet.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,beef broth,grain rice,wild rice,broccoli floret
title: Wild Rice Beef Broccoli & Wild Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 lb of diced wild rice | 1 cup chopped broccoli floret | 1 box of diced button mushrooms | 1 can beef broth ( optional ) | 4 cups cooked long grain rice
instructions: Put all ingredients in dutch oven and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and put lid on. Simmer for about 30 minutes. Eat and enjoy.

title: Hominy and Bacalhau
ingredients: 1 pound dried hominy, rinsed and drained | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon dried rubbed sage leaves | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 limes, juiced
instructions: Combine chicken, water to cover and hominy in a large pot. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, about 45 minutes. Drain water from the pot. Cool and reserve 1 cup of the hominy and 1/2 cup liquid. Return the leftover hominy with reserved liquid to the pot. Mix in the reserved water and mustard until blended. Remove 1/2 cup of the liquid. Add the sage and baking soda. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with 1/2 cup of reserved hominy. Squeeze 2 tablespoons juice over the top of the other half of the horchata.

Random Ingredients: chicken,lime wedge,basmati rice,plain yogurt,rice wine,chicken breast half
title: Chicken in Rice Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped cooked chicken | 1 tablespoon rice wine | cooking spray or chicken fat free cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups low-fat chicken breast halves, cut into bite sized pieces | hot cooked basmati rice or cooked other long grain rice
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the yogurt, chicken and rice wine. Set aside for 15 minutes. Spray a non stick 10 to 12 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat over medium high. Add half the chicken and 1/4 cup of the sauce to skillet and stir fry for 1 - 2 minutes or until chicken is completely cooked. Add remaining chicken chicken mixture and remaining sauce and heat through. If desired, sprinkle with more of the rice wine sauce. To serve, sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of rice with additional basil and serve the garnished with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,vegetable stock,salmon fillet,silken tofu,chipotle powder,spaghetti sauce,saffron thread
title: Chipotle Salmon Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 bunch saffron threads | 12 ounces smoked salmon fillet, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 8 cups vegetable stock | 1 1/4 cups spaghetti sauce | 1 package silken tofu, drained and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 package thin egg noodles | 1 teaspoon hot dried chipotle powder
instructions: Place sausage in a saucepan over medium low heat, and cook until browned, then remove from heat and set aside. Bring the stock to a boil in a large pot. Stir in the saffron, and return to a boil. Stir in the salmon, cover, and simmer until the salmon is easily flaked with a fork, about 20 minutes. Stir once, taste for seasoning, and ladle in 1 cup of broth. Stir in the spaghetti sauce, tofu, and chipotle powder. Let simmer until heated through, about 10 minutes.

title: Tamari Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 fluid ounce light cream or 1 fluid ounce half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Put about 1 spoon of cream and 1 tablespoon of tamari in the bottom of a 2 quart baking dish. Warm a 9x9 pan with water until boiling, then pour a small amount of butter or margarine into the bottom of the baking dish. Arrange 3 lasagna noodles down on the cream mixture. Spread about 1/3 cup of cream over the noodles. Sprinkle the remaining cream and tamari evenly over the noodles. Bake at 375 degrees for about 30 minutes, or until the top is slightly browned, and the casserole is bubbling. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting and serving.

title: Tequila Pork Tenderloins With Mascarpone Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin | 1/4 cup aged cheddar cheese, grated ( about 6-8 ounces ) | 1/4 cup cottage cheese, rinsed well | 1/3 cup sweet marsala wine or 1/3 cup dry sherry | kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Arrange meat on rack in shallow roasting pan. Bake until meat thermometer inserted into center of meat registers 150°, about 20 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 325° and continue to roast until temperature reaches 195°, about 3 more hours. Remove from oven and let stand 20 minutes, then cut into 1/2 inch thick slices. While meat is roasting whisk cheeses with 1/3 cup marsala or sherry until blended.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,ice water,turkey breast,creole seasoning,orange zest,oatmeal
title: Tuscan Turkey and Oatcakes
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups uncooked arborio rice | 3 cups ice water | 4 small soft fresh turkey breast, cut into 16 thin slices | 4 pieces orange zest | 1/2 cup quick oats | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning
instructions: In a bowl, combine rice, ice water and orange zest. Place slices into freezer on counter 5 to 10 minutes to freeze for easier slicing. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine oats, creole seasoning and turkey. Spread sliced turkey mixture onto a nonstick baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden and crispy.

Random Ingredients: apple,green chili pepper,pineapple chunk,white wine vinegar,allspice berry
title: Green Apple Chutney
ingredients: 4 large apples, peeled, cored, chopped, and boiled until very slightly tender | 8 ounces pineapple chunks, drained, reserve liquid | 4 ounces canned green chili peppers, drained, reserve liquid | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon allspice berries
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the chutney in a food processor. Blend on high for several minutes. Store in the refrigerator in a clean jar. This chutney can be used immediately, or cold before use.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Stir together ground red pepper flakes, molasses and pepper flakes. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,cumin,annatto seed,green olive,cracker crumb,mustard seed
title: Causa Verde
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1 cup dry cracker crumbs | 1/2 can whole green olives, drained | 1 tablespoon whole cumin | 1 tablespoon mustard seed | 1 tablespoon annatto seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and set aside for 20 minutes. Form into balls. Bake on a greased baking sheet at 400 degrees f for about 10 minutes, just until slightly crisp and browned.

title: Individual Filet Mignon
ingredients: 1 can creamed corn | 20 large fresh or frozen beef tenderloin
instructions: In a 12 straight sided skillet, combine corn and beef and spread onto the surface of the meat. Place the pan in a 325 degree f oven. Bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Remove the pan from the oven. Pour off any excess drippings. Return the pan to the oven.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,hot red chili pepper,harissa,poblano chile,lemon zest,bonito flake
title: Tunisian Harissa Marinade
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried bonito flakes | 1 clove garlic, finely grated | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon hot red chili pepper, minced | 1 lemon, zest of | 1/4 cup harissa, or ( to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a wide shallow dish and stir to mix. Use in all chicken pieces and marinade chicken at least 1 hour. Bring to room temperature before cooking, although chicken will keep refrigerated for up to one day.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,wheat bread flour,green curry paste,pancake mix,fleur de sel
title: Thai Pancake and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole wheat bread flour | 2 tablespoons thai green curry paste, thai kitchen brand if available, divided | 2 packages pancake mix | 1/3 cup egg noodles, fresh, uncooked | 1 tablespoon fleur de sel, finely minced
instructions: Prepare pancake mix according to package directions. Drain and rinse noodles and stir into pancake mix. Place mixture in a 9x13 casserole dish,. Cover and bake 25 minutes 30 for medium. Serve with curry.

title: Oaty Penne Pasta With Cavender's Cavender's Oats
ingredients: 8 ounces dry penne pasta or 8 ounces rotini pasta | cooking oats | fresh dill weed, for garnish
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook penne until al dente. Drain and reserve pasta water. Meanwhile, heat oven to 400 degrees. Using a food processor, coarsely chop the oats and dill together. Add the reserved pasta water to the food processor bowl and mix well, adding more pasta water if necessary, just until pasta is coated with the mixture. Transfer pasta to the large oval or oval baking dish. Sprinkle top with a little breadcrumbs and bake in the oven for 15 minutes or until golden and hot, and the top is crisp and slightly browned.

title: Spicy Snails With Craisins and Feta
ingredients: 4 small birds eye swedes ( or more, depending on the size ) | 2 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon or 1 tablespoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 80 g cranberry beans or 80 g pomegranate beans | 80 g snails | 8 fresh rocket | bread crumb or fresh breadcrumb, to serve | grated feta, to garnish
instructions: Place the birdseye or broad tops of the birds eye in a small saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil, cook for 10 mins, remove from the heat and immediately plunge into cold water. Drain thoroughly and place in a bowl or mould. Set aside. Add the sofrito, ginger and chili paste to the birdseye or broad tops of the birdseye, toss and set aside. Place the cranberry beans or pomegranate beans in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 5 mins, drain and set aside. Add the snails and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 mins or until snails are just cooked through. Drain and then refresh under running water. Drain well and cool slightly then pat dry. Divide the fishmeal among eight serving plates. Top with rocket leaves and breadcrumbs. Place the birdseye or broad tops on top of the snails, drizzle over the crumb topping and serve with fresh breadcrumbs and chopped tomato.

title: Apricot Gravy Recipe
ingredients: 4 dried apricots ( or more to cover ) | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste
instructions: Place apricots in a small saucepan. Cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. When water boils, submerge apricots. Cover and cook about 15 minutes, until tender. Drain and set aside. Chop anchovy paste and place in small skillet. Heat over low heat and stir in anchovy paste. Remove pan from heat. Allow to cool slightly. Strain gravy, reserving 3/4 cup of the broth. Return strained gravy to pan and add apricots. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium. Simmer about 15 minutes until liquid reduces by half. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,pepper,fish sauce,salt black pepper,prosciutto,sage leaf
title: Thai Crispy Saltimbocca
ingredients: 1/2 cup salt-free pepper, coarse | 7 slices prosciutto | 1/8 teaspoon chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon warm fish sauce or 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Bring salt free pepper and 1/8 tsp chili paste to room temp until hot but not boiling. Remove from heat, cover and stand for 30mins. Place prosciutto slice in plastic baggie with 1/8 tsp sriracha, sage, and 1 tbsp fish sauce. Pound till almost smooth, not over process. Add 2 tbsp warm fish and salt and pepper mix well. Roll in other 1/8 tsp sriracha mixed with the warm fish. Put on cookie sheet and let sit until dry and crisp. I usually let stand overnight, then roll out again. I usually refrigerate this for a few hours, then put in ziploc baggie for 24 hrs. Use your hands, and really seal it up.

title: Smoked Turkey and Bean Sprout Parfait
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/4-1 1/4 cups water | 1 package frozen smoked turkey breast, 1/2 inch slices, thawed | 1 1/4 cups freshly cooked bean sprouts, washed
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and stir until well blended. Refrigerate or freeze until ready to serve. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Grilled Salmon with Olives
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 12 small green olives, washed and drained ( you can use pimento stuffed olives if you prefer ) | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh savory
instructions: Cut the salmon in half lengthwise, then crosswise into 1 inch pieces. Place on a greased or parchment lined foil lined rimmed baking sheet. Combine the olives, snipped savory and remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt. Place under broiler and grill for 10 seconds or until lightly toasted. Place salmon on serving platter. Spoon sauce over.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,red table wine,broth,vegetable oil,pork tenderloin
title: Pork Tenderloin in Red Wine
ingredients: 800 g pork tenderloin | vegetable oil | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup red table wine | 1 cup rich stock or 1 cup broth, made with beef bouillon
instructions: Score a cross on fatty tops of the tenderloin and insert a sharp knife into the cross. In a baking dish coated with vegetable oil, lay the tenderloin upright on top. Mix the flour with a little water and spread evenly on the surface of the meat and let sit for 2 hours in the refrigerator. Heat the stock and keep warm. Preheat the oven to 200°c/fan 160°c/gas season salt and pepper to taste. Roll the meat, a few pieces at a time, between your palms into a 1 cm thick slice. Brush each meat slice with oil, and set on a rack in the roasting pan. Put a pan in the preheated oven and lower the temperature to 140°c/fan 200°c/gas cook for 20 minutes, checking for tenderloin is firm and beginning to colour. Turn it onto a rack to cool slightly, then slice. Serve with fresh tomatoes and fresh vegetables.

title: Sugar Snap Peas and Noodles With Coconut Cream
ingredients: 200 g egg noodles | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 400 g sugar snap peas, strings removed, thinly sliced diagonally | 150 ml sour cream
instructions: Cook noodles according to instructions on pack, drain. Heat oil in a large wok or frypan over medium high heat. Stir fry sugar snaps, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes or until tender. Place noodles in a serving bowl. Stir fry sweet peas in oil over medium high heat for 2 minutes or until tender crisp. Pour over noodles. Serve.

title: Indian Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 cups lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken pieces | 1 jar grape tomatoes, quartered | 1 can orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1 serrano ham, chopped
instructions: Place lettuce in a large bowl. Place chicken in a large saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 15 minutes. Remove chicken from saucepan, cool, and shred. Place chicken into a bowl, and stir in the grape tomatoes, orange juice concentrate, mayonnaise, garlic, and serrano ham. Mix dressing well, cover, and refrigerate until chilled, about 6 hours. Serve chilled, or at room temperature.

title: Creamy French Onion Soup (Soupe Au Pommes Et D'ail)
ingredients: 6 large onions, peeled, halved and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 4 cups beef stock | 2 pints heavy cream ( or whipping cream, if desired )
instructions: In a large soup pot over medium heat, stir onion slices into garlic powder. Cook, stirring constantly until onions are very pale yellow and beginning to caramelize, 20 to 30 minutes. Add beef stock. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat to medium low. Cook, partially covered, for 15 minutes to allow flavors to blend. Pour cream into soup and reheat. Puree soup in two batches in a blender or food processor. Return to pan if desired, if desired. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed,extra tofu,pasta,bell pepper,baby spinach,parmesan romano cheese mix
title: Tofu and Spinach Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 200 g dry pasta ( penne, rigatoni etc ) | extra firm tofu | 1 bunch baby spinach ( or 1 handfuls baby spinach and 1 handful or all leaves of spinach ) | 1 bell pepper ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds ( roughly chopped ) | 200 g low-fat parmesan-romano cheese mix
instructions: Heat oil in a non stick pan, fry tofu until crispy/blackened. Add vegetables and toss for about 2 minutes. Remove tofu. Stir fry tofu for about 2 - 3 minutes until hot through. You may need a little more oil or some of the water but don't add too much, it just brings out the flavour. Drain pasta, reserving some pasta water. Place reserved water in a pot with 2 cups of water, salt and bring to boil. Add pasta and stir to cook both the pasta and the water until the pasta is al dente. Add spinach, stir through and return to boil. Remove from heat and stir in chopped tofu and parmesan/romano until the sauce is smooth.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,plain yogurt,corn,hard egg,white breadcrumb,bok choy,shallot,icing sugar
title: Corn and Eggs Stuffed With Shiitake Mushrooms (Niku Jaga )
ingredients: 200 g shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup fresh white breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup chopped fresh shirichime mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 hard-boiled egg | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 shallot, very finely chopped | 2 tablespoons toasted nori ( sushi rice )
instructions: Wash the mushrooms under running water. Halve the caps and remove the stalk. Scoop out the caps and discard. Using a knife, cut around the chest cavity of the mushroom under running water, remove most of the water but save some for later. Put the chopped shiitakes into a colander that has kitchen paper inside to drain water, reserve the liquid and discard the caps. Soak the shiitake caps in warm water for several minutes then drain and put in a bowl. Put the yogurt and breadcrumbs in a bowl and stir until combined. Stuff the shiitake caps with this mixture and use 1 tbsp topping of the egg along the edge of each cup. Spoon some of the sauce mixture onto the upper side of the egg, gather up the sides and roll up each cap. Place in a lightly greased shallow baking dish. In a little pot, dissolve the cornstarch in the sherry and slowly pour this over the caped mushroom caps. Bake in a pre heated oven at 180°c or 400°f for 25 - 30 minutes and serve at once with nori or your choice of vegetables.

title: Chicken on the BBQ
ingredients: 1/2 cup kosher salt | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon chicken breast, finely minced | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Mix salt, garlic paste and chicken breast together. Pour over chicken and refridgerate for a few hours to let flavors mingle while cooking. Grill, covered, over indirect heat for 20 to 30 minutes, until chicken is done.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,yellow pepper,cream mushroom soup,mace,italian breadcrumb
title: Polish Sausage With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package johnsonville mild polish sausages ( 8 to 10 links ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 8 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine sausage, soup and yogurt in a large bowl, and stir well. Arrange sausages in a single layer in a lightly greased 9 inch square baking dish. Mix bread crumbs and ground mace in a small bowl, and sprinkle mixture over sausage. Bake in the preheated oven until crumbs are lightly browned, 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Tunisian Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup pomegranate | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/3 cup pimento-stuffed stuffed olive | 2 tablespoons capers | 2 tablespoons lemon juice and zest, grated | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 3/4 lbs hot pork or 1 3/4 lbs sausage
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender and process until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Tex-Mex Macaroni and Sauce #A1
ingredients: 1 bag macaroni, such as barilla ( no-boil ) | 2 cups bottled picante sauce | 1/4 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons hot sauce
instructions: In 3 1/2 to 4 quart saucepan, cook ca 9 minute or according to package directions.

title: Chill Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes | 4 fluid ounces cointreau liqueur | 4 fluid ounces oil
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut into slices about 1/4” thick. Put them into a pan with just enough water to cover the potatoes. Bring to the boil, then add the cointreau. Let stand 15 minutes and drain. In a deep fryer put the oil and heat. Drain the potatoes and add to the hot oil. Cook under a preheated moderate cooking temperature of 400°f for 20 - 30 minutes, until the skins are golden. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,rump steak,beef stew meat,french baguette,sage leaf,mustard green,balsamic vinegar
title: Balsamic Rosemary Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 loaves dry french baguettes | 1 lb lean boneless rump steak | 1 lb pork sausage | 1/2 lb beef stew meat | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 12 sage leaves | mustard greens
instructions: Trim crusts from bread, if preferred, and form into four 6 ounce long rolls. Cover with a double thickness of plastic wrap and a damp cloth towel. Place on a cookie sheet and chill in refrigerator. Place meat on foil, close top cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Drain meat, discarding marinade. Remove meat from refrigerator about 15 minutes before serving, and discard wrap. Prick meat lightly with a fork, and grill or broil. Let cool, then cut into 6 slices, about 1 inch wide. Cover each slice with 1 to 2 leaves of the sage. Wrap individually in plastic wrap, then return to the refrigerator to chill for 30 minutes. Place meat slices, meat, sausage, and 1 1/2 tablespoons of balsamic vinegar into 2 shallow, heavy plastic containers. Place 1 sage leaf on top of each slice, then add a few leaves of each. Dampen the edge of each bundle with a little water about 1/2 inch. Cover each sandwich loosely with plastic wrap, squeeze out excess air, and seal. Refrigerate for 1 hour. To serve, serve with a selection of condiments such as mustard greens, celery sticks, and horseradish sauce.

title: Cauliflower Crunch
ingredients: 500 g cauliflower | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 pinch cracked pepper
instructions: Boil cauliflower in a large pan of lightly salted water for 8 - 10 minutes until tender. Drain in a colander and mash with a fork until soft. Place cauliflower in a large bowl, stir in flour, mix well. Add tamari and pepper and mix gently. Grease a 19x29cm baking tin with a knob of butter and press topping evenly over the base to cover the top. Bake at c for 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,leek,thyme,gruyere cheese,green pepper,new mexico chile powder
title: Mexican Green Chile Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 green pepper ( seeded and chopped ) | 1/4 leek ( thinly sliced and washed in hot clean water for about 2 minutes ) | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 3 cups gruyere cheese ( or other favorite hard white cheese ) | 1/4 teaspoon new mexico chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Heat large skillet over medium heat. Add 1/2 c of the green pepper, 1/4 of the leek, the thyme and marjoram. Sauté until the pepper and leek are translucent. Transfer to a bowl and let cool.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,ziti pasta,garlic powder,thyme leaf,cherry tomato,thyme sprig,worcestershire sauce
title: Chicken Mediterranean Style
ingredients: 6 ounces chicken breast, fresh, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves | 3 garlic powder ( i have used the mixture of 1/2 tablespoon thyme and 1/2 tablespoon dijon, as i'm sure others would like ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 8 ounces ziti pasta, cooked | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Season chicken with worcestershire sauce, 1/2 tablespoon thyme, 2 minced garlic cloves and 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves. Add ziti pasta and toss together to coat. Place in a large baking pan. Top with tomatoes and remaining 1/2 tablespoon dried thyme. Bake for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,cilantro leaf,bacon,broccoli floret,white button mushroom,jelly crystal
title: Bacon-Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, diced | 1 1/2 cups fresh white button mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 cup fresh broccoli florets, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, with stems | 3 teaspoons jelly crystals | 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled and quartered
instructions: In a skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside. Pour drippings into a medium bowl, leaving 1 - 2 tablespoons drippings in the pan. Add mushrooms to skillet drippings and saute until brown, about 5 - 7 minutes. Add broccoli and 1/2 cup water to skillet. Cover and cook over low heat until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in jelly crystals and remaining 3 tablespoons reserved drippings. Toss salad lightly. Season with salt and pepper. Fill a large bowl with ice cubes.

title: Spicy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons catsup ( tomato based ) | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | hot sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small saucepan and stir to combine. Stir the sauce until the peanut butter melts and the sauce thickens.

title: Marzipan Potatoes
ingredients: 6 small russet potatoes or 4 medium russet potatoes | 1 tablespoon dried marzipan | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 3 tablespoons shortening | 6 romaine lettuce hearts
instructions: Pierce potatoes with a fork to allow steam to escape. Wash well, and fill potatoes with water until they are about 2 inches from the top of the potato skins. Add marzipan, marjoram and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil. Skim off any foam that rises to the top. Cover and simmer on a very low setting, or on a foil lined baking sheet, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until tender.. Allow to cool, and cut into small cubes. To serve, place some of the potato chips on a serving platter and place the remaining potato chips on top of the potato chips. Garnish with lettuce hearts.

title: Goat Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 cups shredded smoked gouda cheese | 1 package dry farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 cup prepared sweet-and-sour mix | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 11x7 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through yet firm to the bite, 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chinese Style Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 kg chicken thigh fillet, thinly sliced | 1 large french roll, sliced
instructions: Heat a large frying pan or wok over a high heat. Spread onion evenly into the pan along with the chicken. Cook, stirring frequently, for 10 minutes, or until chicken is beginning to brown. Spread roll with a little more than 5 tbsp of oil. Place chicken on top of the onion and roll up, then place in a large heatproof bowl. Repeat with the remaining rolls and onion. Combine remaining oil and water in pan, reduce until creamy.

title: Easy Mexican Fettuccini
ingredients: 1 package quinoa or ( 16 ounce ) package fettuccini noodles, uncooked | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 -2 tablespoon bakers cocoa ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon baking cocoa
instructions: Cook pasta in pot of water according to package directions. While pasta is cooking, combine broth and cocoa if desired.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,rosemary,fusilli pasta,lamb,table salt,watercress leaf,pimiento,cayenne pepper
title: Lamb Fusilli With Fusilli
ingredients: 3 cups water | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 6 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil or 6 tablespoons canola oil, divided | 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb | 1 3/4 cups fresh rosemary, leaves coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup pimiento, coarsely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 12 ounces fusilli pasta or 12 ounces other small shape pasta
instructions: First make the fusilli. Place the water, yeast and salt in a large bowl and stir to combine. Set aside until the yeast softens slightly about 30 minutes or until foamy. Add 1/4 cup oil to a large saucepan and heat the oil over medium heat. Add the lamb, rosemary and pimiento and cook, breaking it up, until the lamb is cooked through about 7 minutes. Drain off any fat and season with salt and pepper. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until just tender. Drain and serve the pasta in a large bowl or platter with the cooked lamb mixture on top. To make the sauce, if making the sauce in advance, cover and chill pasta while it is cooking. Bring the fusilli to room temperature, about 20 minutes. To reheat the pasta, bring the pot of water it was cooked inches and cook it until tender. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Mash the pasta with 1 or 2 tablespoons of potato starch, adding enough reserved cooking liquid to make a very thick sauce.

title: Frozen Sun-Dried Tomato Puree (Tapas)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and finely diced ( about ) | 1 cup frozen pure sun-dried tomato packed in oil, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with foil. Add the sun dried tomatoes and puree in the bowl of an electric blender to form a coarse paste. Transfer to a mixing bowl and set aside. Return the sun dried tomato purée to the bowl with the sun dried tomato cream and stir to combine. Transfer to a freezer safe container and let the mixture stand at room temperature until the flavors have melded, about 30 minutes. Transfer the sun dried tomato puree to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and cover the surface with aluminum foil. Place it directly on the upper shelf of the oven and bake until the tart topping is warm and very very dark and crisp, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: almond,corn tortilla,ham,vanilla ice cream,lemon juice,garlic,baby pea
title: Baby Peas and Ham Tacos
ingredients: 1/4 cup almond, slivered | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 3 cloves garlic, smashed | 1/2 pound baby peas, thawed | 36 corn tortillas, warmed | 1/2 cup ham, chopped | 1 cup vanilla ice cream, softened
instructions: Stir almond slivers, lemon juice, garlic and peas in a medium bowl.

title: Homemade Indian Lettuce
ingredients: 3 pounds celery | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Slice the celery lengthwise into two 2 inch thick slices, and leave them intact. Place the slices in a large baking dish. Add a layer of crushed cardamom pods, and cover the dish with a kitchen towel. Allow to sit at room temperature to allow the cardamom to spritz the surface. Remove the dish from the refrigerator. Place the lid tightly on the dish, and place in a cool part of the refrigerator. This can be easily brought to room temperature to maintain crunch.

title: Mock Chocolate Meatless Pies
ingredients: 1 can condensed milk chocolate chips | 1 jar frozen meat, defrosted and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pour condensed milk into a small saucepan on the stove top. Cook and stir over medium heat, until the mixture starts to thicken. Pour the chocolate into a mixing bowl with a slotted spoon, and stir until completely dissolved. Stir in frozen meat until heated through. Spread spoonfuls of chocolate mixture into the bottom half of a muffin tin, and top with another spoonful of chocolate mixture that is thicker and darker in color than the original one. Bake in the preheated oven 20 minutes, or until the tops come out clean.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,vegetable oil cooking spray,pear,banana,apple juice,cardamom seed,corn tortilla
title: Apple Beef Bananas on Taquitos
ingredients: 1 beef chuck, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup apple juice | 8 corn tortillas | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 cup pear, cubed or sliced | 1/2 small banana, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange meat slices on a rack on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: white bread,corn husk,feta,barberry,rotini pasta,cocoa powder,yellow onion
title: Crazy Fruit and Feta Noodle Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces rotini pasta, uncooked | 1/2 small yellow onion, chopped | 200 g feta, crumbled ( or more to taste ) | 1 bunch corn husk, rinsed | 1 package corn on the cob | barberries ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | crushed fesh cocoa powder ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook the rotini according to the package instructions, drain well and set aside. Cook the onion in a little oil until they're clear, then stir in the feta and cook together until they're completely soft and beginning to brown. Add the pasta and stir well to coat all the pasta with the feta and onion. Mix in the corn and bring to a boil.
