Turn down heat and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes, until most of the liquid has been absorbed. Toss in the corn and barley, if using, and continue to simmer for about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 4 tablespoons smoked gouda cheese | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/4 cup sweet salad dressing | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 5 cloves peppercorns | 1 1/4 kg large shrimp, deveined ( tail left on ) | 6 slices prosciutto
instructions: Dice the cheese into 1cm cubes. In a small bowl combine the cheese, mayonnaise, sweet salad dressing, cumin, vanilla sugar and peppercorns. Add the shrimp and marinate for at least four hours and up to overnight. Drain the shrimp. Grill or pan fry the shrimp until cooked, turning once, until cooked through. Cut each slice of proscuitto into 4 pieces. Serve the shrimp with the cheese and prosciutto on a large, warm dinner roll. To serve, place a shrimp on top of each piece of cheese, drizzle with a little maple syrup, and finish with a slice of proscuitto.

title: Minted, Cured and Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 1 lb raw large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Soak shrimp in cold water for 20 minutes. Drain. Cook shrimp in a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat 1 - 3 minutes, or until pink. Remove to a plate. Meanwhile, mix mint with 1/2 cup warm water in a small bowl. Let stand 10 minutes. Toss shrimp with mint mixture until shrimp are coated with mint. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,capicola,pistachio,yukon gold potato,vanilla powder,fennel bulb
title: Tortilla Espanola (Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 small fennel bulb, sliced | 1 large poblano chile, sliced | 100 g chopped poblano chiles | 4 small yukon gold potatoes, quartered | 200 g capicola, in 1-inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla powder
instructions: First, make the sauce, in a pan, heat up the garlic in a sauté pan. Add the fennel and chiles and cook for 2 minutes, stirring every so often, being careful not to burn. Add the potatoes and cook for about 5 minutes or till soft. Remove from heat and add the contents of the pan to the pan. Pour in a little oil. Add the vanilla and mix. Remove from heat and set aside. The tortilla is ready to serve. Heat up a small frying pan and fry the tortillas until they start to turn a pale golden color. Put them on a plate. Add the fennel and chiles to the pan, add the capicola.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,marjoram,beef eye,egg yolk,confectioner sugar,anise extract,yellow squash
title: Gnocchi Con Salsa Di Beppo #5FIX
ingredients: 1/4 cup anise extract | 1/8 teaspoon marjoram | 2 lbs beef eye round | 2 medium yellow squash | 2 eggs, beaten | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 ounces dark chocolate
instructions: Remove meat from freezer. Remove skin and cut into 1 inch pieces. Combine the meat, marjoram and anise. Set aside. Using a vegetable peeler, coarsely grate the zest off the squash. Place in a pot of cold water.

title: Cold Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 boxes whole wheat spaghetti, broken into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 boxes radially broken fresh seaweed | 1/3 cup prepared amaretto liqueur or 1/3 cup other almond-flavored liqueur | 16 small ice cubes | pepper, to taste | 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Fill six 3/4 cup soup bowls with boiling water and bring to a boil. Cook spaghetti as directed on package and drain. Place noodles in a strainer and press to cool. Drain noodles and place in a large shallow dish or salad bowl. In another bowl, place seaweed and stir in amaretto. Add ice cubes to the bowl and mix. Add pasta, seaweed mixture, and pepper. Toss salad to coat well with dressing. Remove from heat.

title: Italian Salmon Skewers With Dill
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, skin removed | 1/2 white onion, cut into 8 wedges | 2 chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 yellow squash, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped | 1 medium ripe tomatoes, roughly chopped | 6 drops parmesan cheese
instructions: Cut the salmon into 5 pieces. Place the salmon and onion in a large dish. Combine the chillies, squash, mint and tomato in a salad bowl. Sprinkle with parmesan. Toss the ingredients for the dressing together. Pour over the salmon and onion.

Random Ingredients: pea,pecorino romano cheese,velveeta cheese,stew meat,bean sprout,poblano chile
title: Rick's Mexican Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs stew meat | 3/4 cup fresh pecorino romano cheese | 2 cans diced poblano chiles, drained | 1 gallon velveeta cheese, cut up | 4 cans small beans with sprouts, drained | 16 ounces frozen peas ( thawed )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot and cook on low for 8 hours. Serve warm over spaghetti, linguine or angel hair pasta.

title: Yummy Quick Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb rice noodles ( uncooked ) | 1 -2 tablespoon tahini | 1 -2 1 -2 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro leaves
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain noodles, rinse with cold water and drain again. Set aside. Mix noodles, tahini, barbecue sauce, oregano, cilantro and hot sauce and serve.

title: Vanilla-Vanilla Frozen Yogurt
ingredients: 1 quart vanilla ice cream | plain flour
instructions: Whip the vanilla ice cream until soft peaks form, then fold in plain flour until mixture thickens. Spread onto 1/2 a 12 hole pie plate. Bake at 160c degrees for 8 - 10 minutes until slightly browned. Allow to cool and set on a plate. Serve with ice cream and fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,ginger garlic paste,meatball,black coffee,seafood,pepper,mango chutney,red chili powder
title: Beef and Mango Burger
ingredients: 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup black coffee | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 dash mixed seafood, chopped | 1 tablespoon meatballs, chopped | 3 quick-cooking meatballs, ground
instructions: Place the meat, sauce, and herbs in a bowl. Place the burgers in a blender and add the chutney.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,onion powder,caribbean jerk seasoning,penne pasta,egg yolk,yogurt,wine vinegar
title: Caribbean Jerk Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta, cooked al dente and drained | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon caribbean jerk seasoning | 1 egg yolk, beaten
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve over hot fettuccine.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,black olive,garlic powder,olive oil cooking spray,red chili,grain rice,seasoning,parsnip
title: Vegetable and Rice
ingredients: 2 large parsnips, peeled cut in wedges | 1 red chili, small diced and seeded ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, sliced | 2 tablespoons black olives, pitted sliced | 1 3/4 cups long grain rice, rinsed | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. In a 9x13 inch glass baking dish, combine parsnips, red chili, basil, olives and rice. Lightly brush oil over the rice mixture and sprinkle garlic powder over top. Bake 20 minutes, until heated throughout, stirring twice.

title: Chocolate Glazed Hoagies
ingredients: 4 hoagie rolls | 4 tablespoons chocolate syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut each hoagie into 4 pieces. Divide each piece between your 2 small sheets of aluminum foil. Place the hoagie pieces on top of each piece of foil in a small roasting pan. Spread chocolate syrup evenly over each hoagie piece while still in the foil. Place roasting pan in the preheated oven and cook until the hoagies are hot and warmed through, about 30 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beer,farfalle pasta,lipton onion soup mix,button mushroom,pasta salad,russet potato
title: Beer Mushroom, Potato, and Farfalle Soup
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 package lipton onion soup mix, divided | 6 ounces beer, divided | 16 ounces sliced dried button mushrooms | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta with marinade and vegetables | 1 package pasta salad
instructions: Place the russet potatoes in a large pot, and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, reserving about 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Transfer the russet potatoes to a bowl, and set aside. Place 1 package of the onion soup mix in a bowl with water to cover, and stir well. Bring the potato water to a boil. Add the chopped mushrooms, and simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 5 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place farfalle pasta in the boiling water. Cook about 6 to 8 minutes, or until al dente. Drain. Bring the farfalle pasta to a boil, and cook until tender, about 5 to 7 minutes. Drain. Place farfalle pasta in a bowl with reserved cooking liquid. Pour the sauteed mushrooms over the cooked farfalle, and toss well. Serve warm with additional bottle of beer, or hot mustard for dipping.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,picante sauce,horseradish,gin,tomato basil garlic oregano,pie crust,mushroom
title: Picante Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 pie crusts, baked | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 can tomato basil garlic & oregano ( divided to 1 1/2 cups ) | 3 tablespoons horseradish | 2 tablespoons gin | 1 lb shaved sirloin steak | 1 fresh mushrooms, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place baked baked crust on a baking sheet lined with foil.

title: Italian Sausage Nibbles
ingredients: 6 ounces bulk sweet italian sausage | 8 teaspoons maple syrup
instructions: Heat grill to high. In a small bowl, combine sausage, maple syrup, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Place sausage in a paper bag fitted with a 1/2 inch round tip. Place sausage in the bag.

Random Ingredients: currant,duck,ham,arugula leaf,fenugreek seed,macaroni cheese,cider vinegar,oregano leaf
title: Macaroni, Ham, and Cheese Salad With Cider Vinaigrette
ingredients: 150 g macaroni ( or pasta of your choice ) | 100 g smoked ham | 100 g currants ( or raisins ) | 100 g dried arugula leaves | 1 bunch fenugreek seeds | 50 g currants | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 100 g freshly cooked chopped ham | 100 ml cider vinegar | 100 g freshly cooked chopped arugula leaves
instructions: Prepare the dressing, in a small bowl stir together the salad vegetables. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and chill until serving time. Bring a large pot of water to boil over high heat. Add half the noodles and stir for 2–3 minutes. Lift out with a slotted spoon and set aside. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Drain and rinse the noodles under cold water. Drain and place on a clean cloth towel. Leave to dry out for 2 – 3 minutes. Rinse with cold water and place on a clean cloth towel. Place a chopping board on top of the pot of boiling water and quickly invert the pot using the handle of wooden spoon. Set aside to drain in a colander for 5 minutes. Drain thoroughly and transfer to a large bowl. Set aside. Place the ham in a large frying pan and set around the edges of the pan. Place a steamer basket inside of the pan. Place the steamer basket on the pan and set to a high heat. Place the ham in the centre of the pan on the steamer basket and place into the pan. Tilt the pan to allow the steam to cook evenly. Cook for 10 minutes or until the ham is cooked throughout. Remove the ham to a warm plate and cover with foil to keep warm while you prepare the salad. Prepare the salad, while the ham is roasting, bring a large pot of water to the boil. Add the 1 teaspoon salt, the arugula, fenugreek, and oregano and stir to mix. Add the 1 teaspoon baking powder and stir to combine. Remove from the heat and let sit for 1–2 minutes. Remove the arugula from the water and pat dry. To serve, place 3 tablespoons of the reserved dressing on a plate. Place the salad on top and drizzle with the remaining dressing.

Random Ingredients: pasta shell,extra virgin olive oil,red chili pepper,rom tomato,pasta,phyllo pastry,mango
title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry ( from phyllo ) | 1 mango, roughly chopped | 4 roma tomatoes, roughly chopped | 7 ounces mangoes | 8 ounces chopped red chili peppers | 3 ounces extra virgin olive oil | 3/4 cup pasta, cooked ( shellfish ) | 8 ounces boiled spaghetti or 8 ounces pasta shells, cooked
instructions: Place the pasta and mango into a large bowl. Toss the chillies, olive oil and tomatoes through the salad. When it suits your fancy arrange the pastries on a platter, drizzle with the salad dressing and scatter over the chilies and tomatoes. Serve immediately.

title: Leek, Shrimp and Shrimp Boil
ingredients: 12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 16 slices leeks
instructions: Preheat broiler and position rack 4 below it. Place shrimp shells on a baking sheet. Place shrimp at one end of a leek slice and cut off the tips around to where the leeks will stand up. Place leeks on a cookie sheet under the broiler and broil a couple minutes to brown. Place shrimp on a plate, cover with foil and set aside to steam 5 minutes so the shrimp will be cooked and the shrimp won’t cook through. Remove the shrimp and leeks from the oven, lift the shrimp and leeks off the dish and arrange on a serving platter.

title: Homemade Portabella Salads
ingredients: 3 anchovy paste, mashed | 1/4 cup picante sauce or 1/4 cup salsa, of your choice
instructions: Cut tops off of salam leaves, remove tough outer skin. Slice lengthwise on bias, then crosswise in 1/2 cross. Mix mashed anchovy paste with picante sauce in small bowl. Brush onto salam leaves. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours for flavors to blend.

title: Mashed Sweet Potato in a Mug
ingredients: 6 medium sweet potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup muscovado sugar
instructions: Put all the ingredients in your mug and stir. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,carrot,chili garlic sauce,feta cheese,half,anaheim chili,chipotle chile adobo,lime wedge
title: Chili Cheese Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 ounces chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 3 ounces chile garlic sauce, from the can | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup grated carrot | 1/4 cup bottled chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 3 lime wedges, to serve
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix together the chile, pepper sauce, half and half, carrot, chili garlic sauce, and chili garlic sauce. Fold in the cheese. To serve, place the cheese on a serving plate and dollop the chipotle mixture on top of it. Garnish with lime wedges.

title: Poblano Chiles
ingredients: 20 poblano chiles, roasted | 1 cup cream of celery soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove chiles from oven and spray with vegetable oil cooking spray. Place chiles in a zip top bag and pour in soup. Cover and place open side down on cookie sheet. Bake one hour, remove cover and bake 20 minutes or until chiles are golden brown, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,heavy cream,plain yogurt,green enchilada sauce,pinto bean,yellow squash
title: Baby Spinach Bean Soup
ingredients: 7 cups torn fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup dried pinto beans | 1 large yellow squash, chopped | 2 cans green enchilada sauce, or to taste | 1 cup plain low fat yogurt | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Place spinach and pinto beans into a large pot.

Random Ingredients: juniper berry,thai red curry paste,grain white rice,white cake mix
title: Quick and Easy Red Curry Rice
ingredients: 1 box long grain white cake mix | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon juniper berries | 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice, drained
instructions: Prepare and heat rice, according to package directions. Dredge rice in curry paste, then add rinsed rice to a serving dish. Sprinkle wine over rice, then pour wine on top.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,green chilies,kitchen bouquet,currant,oregano,champagne,liquid honey,bell pepper
title: Crock Pot Chile Verde
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast, fat side down ( about 6-7 lbs. total weight ) | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1 tablespoon kitchen bouquet | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1 can green chilies, drained, undrained | 1 cup champagne ( i use prosecco, but you can use any inexpensive white wine ) | 1/4 cup dried currant | 2 teaspoons green bell peppers ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons other chopped green bell peppers ( optional )
instructions: Heat honey and kitchen bouquet in skillet with meat until hot. Cover and cook meat on high 5 hours or low 6 - 8 hours for a loeless, meatless dish. Remove meat and strain liquid into a bowl and reserve. Skim fat from cooking liquid. Stir in chiles, wine and honey. Cover and cook on high 3 hours or low 2 - 3 hours. Remove meat and let stand covered 30 minutes. Stir in currants. Serve with rice.

title: Spanish Beef  (Or Pork) Cutlets
ingredients: 12 thick cut bottom round steaks | 1 large spanish onion | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup sherry | 1/4 cup chopped hard-boiled egg ( optional ) | ice
instructions: In a large saucepan, brown steak with onion in a teaspoon oil until cooked but tender. In a small bowl, combine broth, sherry, egg and enough ice to moisten. Pour over meat and simmer till liquid reduces to nearly two thirds of its original quantity, stirring often. Serve with rice and chopped hard boiled eggs.

title: Grape Molasses Yellow Pepper Crumbs
ingredients: 2 pints yellow peppers, sliced | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place peppers in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until skins are shriveled and blistered, 30 to 45 minutes. Transfer peppers to a plate. Place the graham cracker crumbs in a bowl. Spread the crumbs on a plate. Roll the peppers in the graham cracker crumbs to coat completely. Arrange in single layer on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and cracker crumbs are browned, 9 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chile pepper,white vinegar,asafoetida powder,cherry tomato,brown mustard seed
title: Baked Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 large ripe cherry tomatoes | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 2 teaspoons crushed dried chile pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange tomatoes on a cookie sheet lined with tin foil. Blend the vinegar, brown mustard seeds, asafoetida, chile pepper, and salt in a blender or food processor to a paste. Pour liquid over tomatoes, and marinate at least 1 hour, or overnight, stirring from time to time, before using. To bake, line a baking sheet with foil. Place tomatoes on foil lined baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until the tomatoes have dried out, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Spicy Salmon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/2 pound salmon fillets | 1/4 cup pitted kalamata olives | 1/4 cup chopped kalamata olives | 1 sheet nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine 1 tablespoon sugar and brown sugar in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,plum tomato,yellow food coloring,purple onion,green chili pepper,dark sesame oil,walnut half
title: Fresh Plum and Walnut Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs medium plum tomatoes ( about 4 large ) | 1 small purple onion, minced or 1 medium red onions or 1 medium green onion, minced | 2 -3 large fresh hot green chili peppers, minced or 1 tablespoon minced fresh hot green chili pepper, minced ( optional ) | 2 -4 ounces green sweet chili peppers, drained and finely minced | 1/2 cup walnut halves or 1/2 cup pecan halves | 1 large pimiento stuffed green chili pepper, halved lengthwise ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 drops yellow food coloring | additional walnut halves
instructions: Line an 8 inch square of foil with the 1 large tomatoes and top with the onion. Place the remaining tomatoes on top. Lightly grease a broiler pan or griddle. If using garlic or oil, slice the chiles into long lengths about 1/4 inch thick and set aside. In a small bowl, mix together the onions, chilies, salt, and green pepper. Sprinkle in the walnuts or pecans and set aside. Cut off and discard stems of fresh chilies so that only the seeds and ribs remain. Cut the peeled tomatoes into 1/8 inch wide slices. Arrange the tomatoes decoratively over the tomato slices. Drizzle with sesame oil, a few drops of yellow and green food coloring and place a couple or so walnuts on top. Place under the broiler until the top is just beginning to brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,cheese tortellini,arrowroot,pizza dough,beef flavor ramen noodle
title: Tortellini Cheeseburger Helper #RSC
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza dough | 3/4 cup cheese filled tortellini | 1/2 cup beef-flavor ramen noodles ( seasoning packet included ) | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon arrowroot
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425 degrees. Roll out your dough on a lightly floured board. I roll the dough out to 10x15 inch rectangle. Place the dough on a lightly greased cookie sheet. In a small bowl, combine 2 beaten egg yolks, 1 tablespoons of arrowroot starch and 1 tablespoon of water. Using a pastry brush, brush the edges of your dough with egg wash. Sprinkle the dough with a little of the egg mixture. Using your fingers, press into the desired thickness and thickness. If your dough does not hold, simply add a little more flour or a little more water. Place the tortellini on the prepped cookie sheet, brush the top with egg wash and sprinkle with the rest of the egg mixture. You can also use cornstarch flavored rice flour or cornstarch slurry to thicken a little bit. Bake until the tortellini is piping hot and lightly browned on top, about 10 minutes, brushing every 5 minutes. Take out of the oven and immediately transfer the tortellini into a bowl of your favorite cheese creation container. Sprinkle the tortellini with fresh ground black pepper and top with any other toppings you wish. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cream,fajita seasoning mix,pine nut,brandy flavoring,green olive
title: Brandy Flavoured Green Olives
ingredients: 1 can sliced green olives | 1/2 cup light sour cream | 1 package fajita seasoning mix | 1 bottle brandy flavoring | 1/4 cup grated fresh parmesan cheese
instructions: Soak olives for 6 - 7 hours, or overnight. Drain well. Place in a glass dish. In a medium saucepan, stir in sour cream, fajita seasoning, brandy flavoring and grated parmesan cheese. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Cool, stirring occasionally. Pour into a shallow dish. Spread olive on top. Serve hot or chilled. Note, for an added touch, sprinkle top of sliced olives with fresh grated parmesan cheese.

title: Chinese Style Pickled Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds baby bok choy, washed, trimmed and sliced into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons monosodium glutamate ( msg ) | 1 large onion, sliced into thin wedges
instructions: In a stockpot fitted with a steamer basket, combine the bok choy, monosodium glutamate, and onion. Cover, and place over high heat. Steam for 30 minutes, or until vegetables are tender and beginning to crackle.

title: English Taffy
ingredients: 1 english cucumber | 2 green peppers | 2 tablespoons fresh sage, chopped | 2 teaspoons rennet tablets, spice
instructions: Wash hands. Remove stems and seeds from english cucumber and green pepper, cut in half lengthwise and into 1/2 inch strips. Cut strips into 1 inch slices. Mix together the salt, pepper, and spice in a bowl and sprinkle over vegetables. Toss to coat.

title: Pesto Spread
ingredients: 30 ounces basil pesto | 1 medium stalk celery leaves, chopped | 1 clove
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor. Process until well mixed.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,pinto bean,lemon juice zest,zucchini,lamb,bread flour,maraschino cherry
title: Piggy and Pita Burgers
ingredients: 2/3 cup whole meal bread flour | 1/3 cup stone ground bread flour | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, zest of | 350 g ground lamb | 350 g ground goat cheese | 2 medium zucchini, cut into 1cm thick slices | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, halved | 6 slices american cheese
instructions: Put the bread flour in a bowl, add the zest and 1 teaspoon of lemon juice. Mix until combined. Add the lamb and work it into the flour until it resembles breadcrumbs, then add the cheese, zucchini and cherry halves. Knead until smooth. Preheat the grill. Put a large plate on the counter and place the pita onto it. Place small flat metal discs on top of the pita, press each in lightly, place on the grilling surface then flatten slightly. Cook for approximately 5 minutes until cooked through.

title: Coconut & Lychee Pancakes
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons cooking oil or 2 1/2 teaspoons oil | 400 g mixed peel, thinly sliced | 3 parsnips, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup low fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon custard powder | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 cup fat-free plain greek yogurt
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except yogurt and batter in a small bowl. Cover and set aside for 20 minutes or up to 8 hours, or overnight. Heat a small, nonstick frying pan over medium high heat, and spray with oil. Add half of the pancake mixture to pan. Swirl to form a thin pancake. Cook for 2 minutes, then flip pancake, cooking for a few minutes more. Repeat with remaining portions. Serve with a dollop of greek yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,black bean,mango,celery,dark corn syrup,self rising flour,rigatoni pasta,walnut
title: Mango-Vegetable Fritters (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango, chopped | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup | 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon dark corn syrup | 3 cups cooked black beans, drained & rinsed | 1 bunch celery, chopped | 1 cup cooked rigatoni pasta | 1 large ripe mango | 1 package marshmallows | 1/2 cup candied green pea ( optional )
instructions: In large bowl stir together first 5 ingredients, then stir in beans. Cover & chill in refrigerator 20 minutes. Transfer to 4 quart slow cooker & cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, or on high for 3 - 4 hours. Turn control to high & stir in celery. Cover & cook on high for 30 - 40 minutes or until vegetables are tender crisp. Stir in pasta & mango, then mix well. Serve immediately, topped with mango & marshmallows & sprinkles if desired. Note ~ if serving this way, cover & keep in the fridge up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: prune,sea salt,turkey,flour,phyllo pastry,worcestershire sauce,ciabatta,dark soy sauce
title: Swan Spiced Turkey on Brioche
ingredients: 500 g thai red snapper, snapper fillets sliced thinly | 2 large ciabatta, sliced thinly and on diagonal | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 100 g pitted prunes, drained well | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon sea salt, and additional to taste | 1 tablespoon rapeseed oil or 1 tablespoon other neutral tasting oil | 1/2 tablespoon flour
instructions: Rinse out any residual fillets on kitchen paper. Trim off skin from snapper and discard. Slice the fish into thin long slices, then slice thinly on the diagonal to yield 3 - 5 lengths. Put the fish in a glass bowl and add the salt, prunes and worcestershire sauce. Mix well with your hands. If using a mortar and pestle you may want to make a well in the centre. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Heat the oil in a frying pan large enough to give the fish a workable coating, heat the flour. Stir in the contents of the mortar and pestle until well blended. Turn up the heat under the frying pan and add the fish mixture. Stir fry the fish until it just starts to turn golden. Don't overcook. Put the fish on a baking tray and top with another baking tray and a lid to ensure even cooking. Cook in the oven for about 15 minutes. Take the baking tray out, pour in the contents of the cooking pan, give the fish back a good stir and serve immediately.

title: Artichoke Bottoms
ingredients: 2 packages frozen artichoke hearts or boxes frozen artichoke hearts | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Place artichokes in a large saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer 25 minutes. Drain and reserve artichoke hearts. In a medium bowl, stir together orange juice, dried oregano, and 1/2 the artichoke hearts. Pour mixture over the artichokes, and toss lightly. Let stand 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup coconut milk | 1 1/4 lbs chicken, cut into 4 pieces | 1 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: Combine coconut milk with chicken in a 4 quart saucepan. Mix in soy sauce and sauté until chicken is cooked.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 cup mexican cheese | 4 cups orange juice
instructions: Put your cheese in the microwave on high for 15 seconds. Pour the entire contents of the microwave in a fondue pot, and put on the stove on low for 2½ to 3 minutes at a time, stirring after every minute for even melting. Once the cheese has melted, stir in the orange juice, bring to temperature to medium. Cook for up to two minutes for a thicker fondue, then strain into small bowls. Serve warm with chips for dipping.

title: Amaretto  Kielbasa (Cheese-Breaded Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 2 ounces butternut squash, peeled, seeded and grated | 1 teaspoon fresh sage, chopped | ice water | 1/2 teaspoon amaretto | 2 tablespoons italian style white breadcrumbs | 2 ounces lean kielbasa, cut into strips 1/2 inch thick | 1 orange, juice and zest of
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine the chuck, squash, sage and water add the amaretto and bread crumbs and mix. Dip the sausage strips in the juice then in the bread crumbs let the bread crumbs absorb the juice. Heat the oil for a deep fryer to 375 degrees. Using two patties, drop the meat into the hot oil deep fryer and fry until golden brown and cooked through. Use tongs to transfer balls to a platter. Use a slotted spoon to serve the balls on a platter.

title: Crockpot-Sauce With Merguez Baked Cod
ingredients: 1 can chicken or 1 1/2 lbs cod ( cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks ) | 1 -2 ounce sliced green bell pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped ( or 1 sprig dried thyme ) | 1 slice american cheese | 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger ( optional )
instructions: Place fish in a crockpot. Add remaining ingredients and stir or mix to coat well. Cover. Cook in crockpot 6 - 8 hours on high. If sauce is runny, remove cover and cook a few minutes longer if sauce gets too thick, thin with a little water. Serve with steamed french or italian greens.

title: Cheats French Burger
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon miracle whip | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy, finely chopped | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: In a small bowl, combine ground beef, coffee granules, miracle whip, anchovy and garlic powder until thoroughly mixed. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Cut tortillas into 8 smaller wedges. In a large non stick skillet, heat 1/4 inch oil over medium high heat approximately 5 minutes. Carefully place one tortilla wedge into the pan and fry 2 - 3 minutes, until golden on each side. Remove to a plate and repeat with remaining tortillas. Serve burger with desired topping. Dip into your favourite coffee granules.

title: Phyllo Tomato
ingredients: 12 large ripe tomatoes | 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 cup pureed tomato, with juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Wash tomato slices, but not peeled. Take a single sheet and top with tomato. Cover with another short sheet of phyllo pastry and layer with one sheet lengthwise. Place the last one short sheet on top and brush with tomato puree mixture. Place on a baking sheet. Repeat with three remaining four sheets of phyllo, and place in the oven. When phyllo has been golden on top, let cool for 10 minutes. Cut and serve with pita bread you have to play with this bread when it smells amazing.

title: Homemade Swiss Fondue (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 3/4 lb grated havarti cheese ( or substitute gruyere cheese ) | 3/4 lb grated gruyere cheese ( or substitute swiss emmenthal ) | 1/2 cup fish stock ( or mushroom stock ) | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 teaspoon whole grain mustard or 1/4 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: In a stainless steel pot melt oil over low heat. When the oil is almost smoking, whisk in all of the other ingredients except the croutons or the fondue cubes. Heat to bubbling, stirring to keep the fondue smooth, and remove from the heat. When slightly thickened, transfer the fondue to a fondue pot, and warm the hot fondue for about 20 minutes until hot, but not boiling. If desired, dip fondue balls into the hot fondue, and transfer to a warming dish. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,green chili,sherry wine,cream mushroom soup,oyster,italian seasoning,italian sausage link
title: Italian Sausage, Egg & Veggie Thingy Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup sherry wine or 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 package mild italian sausage links ( the milder the better ) | 1 head cabbage, large size cut in half and sliced ( you want to slice it 1/2 inches thick, but not too thick ) | 1 can sliced oysters ( you can also remove them )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sherry, sour cream, italian seasoning, sausage and cabbage. Mix well by hand, trying to avoid breaking meat up too much. It should have a fairly dry mixture but not be runny. Place in a plastic crock or paper bag, close and marinate at least 4 hours or overnight. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees. Open lid, squirt mixture into 3 round pans on a cookie sheet that has been lined with aluminum foil, bake for 40 - 45 minutes or until sausage is cooked through.

title: Fried Spanish Olives
ingredients: 24 large spanish olives | 1 cup self-rising flour, or as needed
instructions: Heat olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Place olives into hot oil, and fry, turning once, until golden brown and soft, about 15 minutes. Remove olives, and drain onto paper towels to rinse. Place flour in a shallow dish. Form the olive mixture into a ball.

title: Toasted Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups slivered celery seeds | 1 cup coarsely chopped toasted pine nuts | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Spread celery seeds evenly over a baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 5 minutes. Cool slightly. Place pine nuts on clean towel to dry. Remove fibers with a slotted spoon. Spread evenly over a tray. Sprinkle top with 1 - 2 teaspoons celery seed, 1 1/2 cups whipped topping, and the remaining 1/2 cup of whipped topping. Serve.

title: Amrasi's Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1 can condensed tomato soup ( with a little tomato juice mixed ) | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon tamari
instructions: Heat the grapeseed oil in a small saucepan over medium heat, and stir in the processed tomatoes and tomato soup. Simmer a few minutes until hot, then remove from heat. Combine the yogurt, grainy mustard, and tamari in a small bowl. Gradually add the milk mixture to the tomato soup mixture, stirring well, and then adjust heat to the lowest possible setting. Serve hot, topped with parmesan cheese.

title: French Onion Confit (For Canning)
ingredients: 4 -5 pounds onions, peeled | 1 packet dry onion soup mix
instructions: Peel and wash onions. Remove root end, then chop finely. Combine onions, salt, ground cloves, and dry onion soup mix in a large stockpot. Stir and bring to a boil. Cover, and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until well softened. Makes about 2 dozen. Note, if you like a thinner paste, stir in 2 tablespoons cornstarch dissolved in 1/4 cup cold water. Canning instructions, place onions in hot sterilized canning canning jars. Close jars, leaving 2/3 inch headspace. Heat canning lids and rings on a gas grill or in a hot oven. Place water in a small pan or dutch oven to make a thin coating. Heat dutch oven over medium low heat. Add 1 cup of onions, and bring to boil, stirring often. Cover, and cook 30 minutes. Transfer about 2/3 of the onions to a large container. Add more onions 1/3 at a time. Pour water into canner, and return to a boil. Cover, and cook 30 minutes. Sterilize jars, and let cool completely. Store in a dark cool place.

title: Spinach Lasagna
ingredients: 350 g lasagna noodles, fresh | 500 g frozen chopped spinach | 1 jar enchilada sauce or ( 28 ounce ) jar mild salsa, warm | 225 g shortcutcrust pastry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Put the spinach into a large saucepan, along with the salsa, bring to the boil and then remove from the heat. Heat a 20cm pie dish on the stove and spray with the oil. Layer the lasagna as follows, in the dish starting with noodles and then pour over the spinach mixture. Repeat the layering, using pasta for all of the dish and topping with the cheese. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until golden.

title: Nam Sod (Peanut Butter Balls)

title: Frozen Cherry Tomato Sundae in Chocolate Sauce

instructions: Place cherry tomatoes on a serving plate. Add corn and drizzle with chocolate syrup and oil. Serve immediately.

title: Pineapple Refrigerator Italian Style

title: Turkish Beef Liver

instructions: In a large, shallow nonreactive saucepan melt the 1 tbls. Of the parsley. Peel, core and chop the apples and place in the pan. Cover and heat the heat over medium heat to a soft temperature.

title: Saffron Nuts (Cognac Filling)

instructions: Wash your herbs and dry them well. Using a food processor or blender with a steel blade, blend your bunch of green leaves and chive heads together until they are finely chopped. title: Blueberry Clam Salad

instructions: Boil clams in salted water for 3 minutes, remove from pan and cut the clams. Mix with remaining ingredients in a bowl. Serve right away.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 minutes, until al dente.

instructions: Sprinkle meat with steak seasoning. Coat with remaining 1 teaspoon of steak seasoning and grill over medium hot coals or on a griddle, 7 - 10 minutes per side.

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and season. Serve.

title: Creamy Green Beans
ingredients: 250 g runner beans, shelled | 300 g low-fat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons watercress, plus extra ( to garnish ) | 1/2 teaspoon of fresh thyme, chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons fine sea salt
instructions: Put the beans, yogurt, watercress, thyme, and salt in a pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 6 - 8 minutes or until thick and creamy.

Random Ingredients: chicken liver,grain mustard,sourdough starter,salt pepper,tomato,dijon mustard,lamb shank,salami
title: Lamb Shank With Mustard and Jam
ingredients: 2 lamb shanks | 1 liter sourdough starter | 8 ounces mixed chopped tomatoes | 8 ounces cooked chicken livers or 8 ounces mushrooms | 8 ounces sourdough pickled ham or 8 ounces pickled swiss chard | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3 -4 teaspoons grain mustard | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut the lamb into 2 cubes each. Place in a large earthenware pot and add the starter and just enough water to cover the lamb. Cover with a lid, and simmer over low heat for 3 - 3 hours. Afterwards, you may skim off any fat, or you can leave the shanks in the pot for up to 2 hours. Check the lamb for tenderness it should be just fall off the bone, which should take about an hour and a half total cooking time.. If you have a pressure cooker, you can set the timer to 15 minutes the meat should be falling off the bone. Serve the lamb with mustard and jam for dipping into it.

title: Stuffed Feta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs round steaks, 1/2 inch thick | 3/4 - 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cut a slit in each steak about 1/2 inch deep by cutting the cut sides at 1 inch intervals. Spray a small piece of plastic wrap or meat tenderizer with cooking spray, or line the sides of a baking sheet. Stuff each steak with cheese and place on the plastic wrap or meat tenderizer, pressing the cheese against the sides of the meat. Repeat, using more plastic wrap or meat. Cover and leave 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bake stuffed steaks for 15 minutes, or until tender. Turn over and bake for 1 - 10 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Chipotle Kiwi Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 chipotle chile | 6 large kiwi fruits | 2 packages dry pectin | 1/4 cup pure vanilla ice cream
instructions: Place kiwifruit in a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Place pectin in a bowl and heat to about 120 degree f. Pour warm pectin over kiwifruit and let sit for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place chipotle in a small saucepan then place over medium heat. Cook, swirling pan often, until the aroma of the chile is reduced to a deep red. Transfer the chile to a metal bowl or plastic bag. Cut kiwifruit into 1/2 inch cubes. Place in a blender along with the puree. Add enough puree to give syrup consistency. Whip the ice cream until thickened, then fold into the chipotle mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,mango,lettuce leaf,garlic,red wine,green chili pepper,green bean
title: Mango Trio Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup mango, cubed | 1 tablespoon chopped garlic | 3 tablespoons green chili peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup red wine | 12 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup fresh green beans, diced | 1/2 cup lettuce leaf, chopped
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients in a bowl. Brush tops of pastry sheets with egg white.

title: Sautéed Parsnips, Fajitas, and Almonds
ingredients: 1 large parsnip, peeled and cut in thin slices | 2 teaspoons fajita-style flour tortillas | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 1/4 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted, lightly toasted
instructions: Place the parsnips, 1 teaspoon of the fajita style flour, and sherry in a skillet and heat briefly with the lemon peel.

Random Ingredients: topping,muenster cheese,scallion,tahini paste,pumpkin puree,dark chocolate,green pepper
title: Vegetable Packed Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup light or dark chocolate ( i use 70 % ) | 1/4 cup tahini paste | 2 scallions, finely chopped | 1 green pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon pumpkin puree, puree | 1/2 cup muenster cheese, shredded ( or 2 t of grated mild italian cheese ) | 10 ounces reduced fat whipped topping, thawed
instructions: In large mixing bowl, melt chocolate on low and gradually add tahini paste, scallions, green pepper, and pumpkin puree, stirring well. Remove from heat. In another small mixing bowl, sprinkle grated cheese over half of cheese mixture, stirring well. Spread half of filling evenly over bottom of baking dish, using a spoon. Top with remaining cheese mixture and spread in a spiral across top of cheese. Bake at 350 degrees, covered with foil, for 1 hour, then uncover and bake for 8 - 10 more minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with whipped topping.

title: Easy Green Chili Peas
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peas or 1 lb frozen peas ( defrosted is best ) | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies ( or use fresh tomatoes ) | 1 -2 tablespoon brown sugar ( to taste ) | 2 whole scallions, chopped fine
instructions: Pour enough water in to the peas to just cover. Boil until just tender, about 5 to 8 minutes. Drain well and transfer peas to a dutch oven or other large nonstick skillet. Pour remaining water over them. Add the tomatoes with their liquid and brown sugar. Boil, stirring frequently, over medium heat until the sauce thickens slightly, about 20 minutes. Stir in the scallions and remove from heat. If using pre cooked peas, let cook for about 5 minutes longer, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,olive,fruit,vodka,eggplant,cilantro stem,aubergine,head romaine lettuce lengthwise
title: Vietnamese Grilled Vegetables
ingredients: 8 medium aubergines, peeled, halved lengthwise, then cut into 1-inch pieces | 8 medium eggplants, cut into 1-inch pieces | 3 medium heads romaine lettuce, halved lengthwise | 8 ounces frozen mixed dried fruit | 2 tablespoons olive oil, divided | 5 ounces vodka | 8 fresh cilantro stems, packed | 4 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Grill eggplant and aubergines, cooking until eggplant are tender and eggplant are browned on all sides, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Remove from grill, brush both sides of eggplant with 2 tablespoons olive oil, and allow to cool completely. In a medium bowl, combine romaine, aubergines, and frozen fruit with a few spoonfuls of vodka and stir to mix. Season with salt. Stuff half of the veggie mixture into a 1 quart glass measuring cup. Place remaining vegetable mixture on top of the vegetables, pressing gently. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour. To make flour, in a bowl, combine 2 cups flour with 5 tablespoons water and knead until smooth. Roll dough into a ball, place on a floured surface, then knead in remaining flour. Place on a floured surface, cover and refrigerate until dough freezes, up to 2 days. Place frozen vegetables one at a time and lightly oil the grates as desired. Grill vegetables until golden and crisp, 1 to 2 minutes per side, then cut each piece into 6 wedges.

title: Quick and Easy Raita
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 can rotel | 1 box instant tea
instructions: In blender on high for 1 minute, then down to 3/4 cup. Mix in all ingredients thoroughly and refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,taco seasoning,chili powder,vanilla ice cream,ham hock,nut,pineapple juice
title: Taco Pizza
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning | 1 cup pineapple juice | 6 -8 grape tomatoes, slices | 2 -3 cooked hocks ( from a roast can ) | 1 package taco-seasoned chili powder | 24 ounces pineapple baked beans ( use your favorite recipe ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts ( do not skimp ) | powdered top ( optional )
instructions: Cook taco seasoning according to package directions. While taco seasoned is cooling, cut the tomatoes into thin slices. Take the meat from the roast and place into a saute pan. Once meat is browned in pan remove from heat and pour off all but 1 tablespoon of excess fat. Add juice from the meat, tomatoes, and spices to the pan with the meat and stir to mix. Pour mixture into a medium bowl and place in the fridge to chill while preparing toppings.. Once taco seasoning mixture is chilled pour over the cooled beans and pineapple. Top with more walnuts if using until you have a nice topping that is easy to drizzle over the pizza.

Random Ingredients: red chili,rhubarb,red snapper fillet,white pearl onion
title: Rhubarb and Poached Red Snapper
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white pearl onions | 1 small red chili, finely chopped | 5 stalks rhubarb, washed, ends trimmed and halved | 8 red snapper fillets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the onion, chilies, and rhubarb in a large mixing bowl and season lightly with salt. Gently toss the fish with the onion mixture, adding more salt and water as needed to keep in mind it will be salted. Place the fillets in an ovenproof baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes. Place the fish on top and bake for 10 minutes or longer.

title: Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 3/4 cup hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup shelled pistachio nut
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, warm the hot pepper sauce. When the hot pepper sauce is hot, stir in the confectioners' sugar and stir until well blended. Stir in the pistachios. Pour the jelly into a greased and floured jelly mold. Cover the mold with a towel and allow it to cool slightly. Unwrap the mold, but keep in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours until the jelly is firm enough to handle. Remove it from the mold and cut into wedges to serve.

title: Roasted Peaches With Dill Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh peaches | 1 small daikon radish, peeled, halved if large | 1/2 lb salt pork, smoked, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon grated horseradish sauce | chopped fresh tarragon ( to garnish, or use fresh parsley ) | fresh tarragon | 1/2 lb queso fresco or 1/2 lb farmer cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Cut 2 deep slashes through the top of each peach, cutting 2 in from the bottom. Place the peaches and radish slice side down on a foil lined cookie sheet. Roast the peaches, in batches, in the oven for 20 minutes, until the skins are blistered. Turn the peaches halfway through roasting. The peaches should be charred all over. Remove the peaches to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Remove the peaches from the oven and cool slightly. Peel the skin off each peach half. With a paring knife, gently push the skins back into the peach, and prick the flesh with a fork. Place the peaches and radish slices in a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let sit at room temperature for about 45 minutes. Rinse the salt pork slices under cold water to remove the salt. Drain. With a pastry brush, spread mustard sauce over the peaches and radish slices. Evenly divide the salt pork, horseradish, and tarragon among the peaches and radishes. Pour 1/2 the peach mixture over the cheese. Cover with foil and return to the oven. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes, until the cheese is starting to brown and the sauce is bubbly on the peaches. Remove from the oven, garnish with fresh tarragon, and serve.

title: Rye's Infamous Marsala Cream Cheese W-Roasted Sherry Barley Pudding
ingredients: 10 tablespoons cream cheese, softened | 2/3 cup honey | 1/2 cup water | 3 cups chopped marsala wine | 2 teaspoons sweet sherry | 1 1/4 cups old fashioned oats
instructions: Put oven over 325 degrees. Have all ingredients already at room temperature, but take out when oven becomes hot and hot. In bowl of mixer or with electric mixer, mix cream cheese, butter and honey until smooth. Add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating on low until incorporated. Add marsala and sherry, beating on low until blended. Pour mixture in ungreased 9x13 pan. Cut oats in half and spread evenly on top of cream cheese mixture. Bake in preheated oven for 45 - 50 minutes until browned on top and bubbly in center.

title: BBQ Lamb
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, leg, thigh and leg bones | 2 cans mixed berries, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup orange juice
instructions: Put lamb in a large saucepan, and cover with water. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook 1 hour and 45 minutes. Combine rest of ingredients in a large bowl, mix well and barbecue in moderate to hot oven for 15 minutes. Serve with lamb.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,lobster tail,lemon juice zest,sausage link,margarine
title: Scotch Eggs With Lobster
ingredients: 20 large lobster tails, cooked | 4 tablespoons margarine | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 2 teaspoons lemon juice ( zest of 3 lemon ) | 2 sausages, cooked
instructions: Cut the lobster tails lenghtwise into four. With a mallet, pound the tails until they are a quarter of an inch thick. Melt the margarine in a skillet over medium heat and cook the lobster tails, until they are soft. Add the walnut oil, lemon juice. Cook until the shrimp is pink and the lobster is heated through. Serve with the sausages.

title: Sizzlin' Lamb and Blueberry Filled Pancakes (Lamb Fritters)
ingredients: 500 g minced lamb ( or other veggie that you would like to form patties ) | 200 g blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons bourbon or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon meatball | 1 lebanese cucumber ( or other mild-sweet cucumber ) | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 tablespoon bourbon ( or apple juice )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f/220c/gas lightly grease a non stick frying pan, or use parchment paper. Mix together the meat, berries, salt, pepper, and spicy pepper sauce. Add the lemon to taste. Stir in the meatballs one at a time. Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions. To make the meatballs, flatten a piece of fleshy, fat free skinless ham/sausages about 1 cm thick. Pile up the mince & fruit into the middle of the ham & veg meat & fold together. Place on the baking tray & cook in the oven for 10 minutes. To make the creme, in a frying pan, mix together the flour & suace until bubbly. Add the bourbon or apple juice and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat & allow to cool for 10 minutes. Working with six pancakes at a time, form 4 'fritters' from the mixture & brush lightly with the bourbon sauce. Place on a tray, sprinkle with shredded cuke or other fruit & serve.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,apple cider vinegar,apple,edible flower,maraschino cherry
title: Apple Salad (A Persian Recipe)
ingredients: 3 large apples, grated ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 fresh pineapple, grated ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 10 maraschino cherries, halved | 1/4 cup chopped candied apple | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine apple, pineapple, cherries, apple cider vinegar, chopped candied apple, and pine nuts.

title: Spicy Lobster Shanghi
ingredients: 3 frozen lobster meat | 3 ounces brandy | 1/2 ounce shaoxing wine | 3 lbs beef tenderloin steaks
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a large freezer bag, and then take it out of the freezer for at least an hour or two prior to using them. When ready to use, thaw the steaks in the fridge, and slice them against grain into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place the steaks in the freezer, then proceed to make the sauces. In a wok that has been coated with a little oil, stir fry the lobster meat for around 3 minutes, or until they are cooked through. Add the sauces to the wok, and turn the heat to high. You want it to bubble and thicken. When the sauce starts to boil, pour the sauce into a clean glass bowl. Dip the frozen steak slices briefly over the surface of the sauce and allow to warm through. Enjoy.

title: Walnut Ice-Cream
ingredients: 200 g walnut halves | 200 g raspberries
instructions: Wash and hull berries. Place berries in a blender, add walnuts and mix at top of a double boiler. Place into the freezer for 15 - 20 minutes. The freezing will help to set the berries. Blend until smooth. Return frozen mixture to freezer and process again until smooth. When finished, place into a container and freeze in the freezer for 20 minutes. The puree will set up and turn translucent. When it is back in the freezer, remove and place the block of ice cream into the freezer. Whip until it is fluffy and soft. Place in an ice cream maker according to manufacturer’s instructions then freeze according to your manufacturer's instructions.

Random Ingredients: greek seasoning,bread,chia seed,american cheese,nutritional yeast,pistachio,onion powder
title: Kroger's Pita
ingredients: 6 slices country bread ( thick ) | 6 ounces american cheese | 1/4 cup chia seeds | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | toasted slivered pistachios, i use cashews, walnuts and pecans are good | grated mexican cheese
instructions: Cut a slit down the center of each bread slice. Spread chia seeds in the loaf and top with american cheese. Combine next seven ingredients. Spoon mixture on top of cheese and cover with grated cheese. Place under broiler until cheese melts. Slice and serve with toasted slivered nuts, toasted cashews and toasted cashews peanuts if desired. Yum.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,italian salad dressing,heavy whipping cream
title: The Best Hot Apple Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup light italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar
instructions: Place cream in a blender or food processor and mix until creamy. Add salad dressing and vinegar and blend until smooth. Refrigerate overnight, then shake well to combine.

title: Baby Blueberry Pork Crescents
ingredients: 2 packages frozen blueberries | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 pound boneless pork roast, cubed | 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls | 1 can tomato puree | 1 can refrigerated flaky hash browns
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cook and stir the blueberries in hot oil in a large covered skillet over medium heat until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Place pork and crescent rolls in a large bowl. Heat tomato puree over medium low heat until heated through, about 5 minutes. Spread the bottom half of each crescent roll with a 1/2 cup puree. Place 6 blueberries, half the hot black pepper sauce, and remaining puree in a saucepan.

title: French Onion & Pistachio Strudel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 french baguette, halved lengthways and cut crossways into 1/4-in slices | 1 tablespoon chopped pistachios | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Place the wine, sour cream, thyme, and 1 tablespoon of the oil into a small bowl. Stir to combine. Toast the baguettes according to the directions on the package. To serve, spread the onion mixture to one side of bread. Sprinkle with pistachios and roll up.

Random Ingredients: currant,cognac,rice noodle,tomato juice,brandy,peanut oil vegetable,vanilla soymilk
title: Cognac Noodles
ingredients: 4 ounces rice noodles | 2 teaspoons peanut oil or 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons cognac | 6 tomatoes with juice, seeded, chopped | 1 1/4 cups light vanilla-flavored soymilk or 1 1/4 cups almond milk | 1 teaspoon brandy ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped dry currant
instructions: Cook noodles in hot oil in a large pot of boiling salted water until soft but not mushy, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Drain noodles and rinse under cold running water to prevent further cooking. Pat noodles with paper towels then set aside while preparing sauce. Add cognac to a small skillet and warm over medium heat until almost smoking. Add tomatoes. Simmer 5 minutes. Remove pan from heat and stir in soymilk, brandy and currants. Add noodles and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Sausage Orzo W-Raspberry Baked Ziti
ingredients: 2 cups raspberries | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1/2 lb linguica sausage, cut in 1 to 2 inch pieces | 2 1/4 lbs ziti pasta or 2 1/4 lbs ziti, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine the raspberries and five spice powder in a bowl.

title: Namagru
ingredients: 2 white onions, finely diced | 1/4 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Heat oil on high in a skillet and fry the onions over a low heat until dark brown and just soft. Stir often to prevent them burning, but do not allow them to brown. Add coconut and stir fry for a further minute. Serve hot or cold.

title: Yummy Bacon and Egg yolks
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tahini | 2 egg yolks | 8 slices canadian bacon, cooked | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: To make yogurt, stir yogurt with fork until creamy. Stir in bacon. Blend egg yolks and tahini and fold into yogurt. Gently fold in egg white. Pour mixture into bowl and freeze until very firm.

title: Homemade Wheat Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons powdered chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon citron peel ( grated )
instructions: Use the 2 tablespoons of chicken bullion to measure 1/2 cup of the flour. Add the 1/4 cup of the flour to the powdered bouillon. Stir together the mixture and reserve the rest. Add the citron peel to the dough, then add 1/2 cup more of flour to form a dough. Knead the flour and flour together and roll the dough into a round ball. Cover with a plate covered with a kitchen towel. Place flour on a dry cloth over a bowl. Place the rest of the flour in the cloth, then roll the dough into a ball. Roll out the wheat dough into a large rectangle about 1/16 inch thick and cut into quarters. Bake at 375 degrees for about 10 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: head iceberg lettuce,red snapper,red chili powder
title: Festa (Fish) Salad
ingredients: 2 red snapper, halibut, cleaned, scales removed | 2 cups head iceberg lettuce or 2 cups romaine lettuce | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Boil water in a large pot. Remove the fish and rinse with cold water. Cut the skin off of the fish and remove the bones. You can leave the head of lettuce whole if desired. Place fish in a large bowl. Pour the remaining sauce over the fish and garnish with chili powder. Serve at once.

title: Choclo
ingredients: 1 leek, sliced | 3 tablespoons butter | 3 tablespoons grapes juice or 3 tablespoons apricot juice | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking rolled oats ( dry ) | 2 tablespoons chocolate frosting
instructions: Mix the chopped leek with the butter, cook slowly, stirring. Add the grape juice, oats and chocolate frosting. Mix well and keep warm. When the oat mixture has absorbed the heat, spread out the batter on a hot greased griddle. When the top turns brown and looks dry, flip until the other side is brown. Cut into pieces or cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,green capsicum,flour tortilla,chicken leg,plain yogurt,veal,black mustard seed
title: Quick 'n' Spicy 'Grilled' Fajitas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 3 teaspoons vegetable oil or 3 teaspoons canola oil, divided | 1 lb chicken leg | 3/4 lb boneless veal, roughly sliced | 4 flour tortillas | 1 cup reduced-fat plain yogurt ( to serve ) | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, roughly chopped ( to serve )
instructions: Place the black mustard seeds in a large dry frying pan set over medium high heat. Quickly stir and allow to dry out for a few seconds. Meanwhile, cut up the chicken legs into chunks, trim off any excess fat etc. Place in a large bowl and add veal, mustard seeds and 1 1/2 tsp of oil. Toss together gently. Heat remaining oil in a pan set over medium. When hot begin taking flour tortillas, one at a time in and place them on a heat proof plate. Place on a plate where they have dried out for about 10 min, turn as needed. Place yogurt, olives and remaining mustard seeds in a bowl and mix well. Using hands, spread chicken mixture out evenly in a tortilla and roll up tightly. Serve and enjoy with your favourite mexican or asian accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,broth,turkey filling,california fig,red kidney bean,celery
title: Jamaican Turkey Coconut Soup
ingredients: 1 can reduced-sodium fat-free coconut milk | 2 cups canned red kidney beans, drained ( or cannellini beans ) | 1 cup fat-free broth | 1 cup thinly sliced celery | 1 can turkey filling ( or 1 1/2 cups turkey breast pieces, crumbled ) | 3 tablespoons sliced california trimmed dried figs, chopped
instructions: In large saucepan, combine coconut milk, kidney beans, broth, celery and turkey. Bring to boil.

title: Crunchy Rice Milk
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice milk | 300 g rocket
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe container. Cook on high for 3 minutes or cover and cook on high for 30 minutes or until rice is soft. Leave to stand 5 minutes on cool setting.

title: Masala Jam a La Imlee
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon crushed tomatoes with juice | 1 teaspoon crushed lemon, juice and rind | 1/2 teaspoon msg | 1 teaspoon soda water | 1 shallot, chopped finely
instructions: Dissolve the asafoetida in the tomta paste, then add the red chilli, lemon juice and the soda. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Add the chopped shallot and cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until the shallots are limp then serve.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,marshmallow,bragg liquid amino,tomato sauce,pepper sauce
title: Quick & Easy Braggs Italiano
ingredients: 4 teaspoons braggs liquid aminos | 3 tablespoons apple juice | 3 teaspoons apple juice | 24 ounces tomato sauce | 8 -18 sweet cookies ( i get these from asian food stores ) | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients and 2 cups water in a saucepan and simmer for 10 minutes. Pour over the soft cookies, toss, and enjoy this makes your mojitos. It should keep refrigerated for at least a month.

title: Leeks, Rhubarb and Amaretto Foil Packets (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 1)
ingredients: 2 leeks | 4 slices preserved leeks | 12 rindy reynolds wrap foil | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 100 ml light amaretto | 1 leaf sage
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, remove outer greyish brown outer layer and slice leeks vertically 1/2 thick. Stack 12 rindy leeks on top of sliced leeks. Cover and overlap 2 rindy slices on top. Spread 3 amaretto on the leeks then layer the whole stack with the sage. Fold each roulide in half and roll tightly around the leeks. Secure with a toothpick.

title: Fig, Jalapeno and Niblets
ingredients: 4 large figs | 2 jalapeno peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut off tops and bottoms of the figs so they will lie flat on a baking sheet. Using a sharp knife, cut a slit from the top of each fig, then carefully hollow out the center. Place figs on the baking sheet, cut side down, then cover with foil. Bake for about 15 minutes until the figs are soft and the juices run clear. Remove from oven and allow them to cool for about 10 minutes. Use a slotted spoon or a metal spoon to remove some of the pulp from the skins. Cut the flesh into small pieces and place in a medium saucepan with the jalapeños. Simmer gently over medium low heat for about 15 minutes. Place the figs on a serving platter and pour the juices over them.

title: Konbu (Paste of Many Kinds of Vinegars)
ingredients: 10 cardamom pods ( or 2-3 pinches ) | 1 -2 cup vinegar
instructions: Place cardamom pods in a tea sock fitted with a large star tube or other fancy container. Add 1/2 cup water to 1 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, then turn heat down to med low and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes. Discard cardamom pods and let cool for five minutes. Then use a coffee filter or strainer to strain out the seeds. Discard the cardamom pods. Strain through a cheesecloth lined sieve into clean jars and allow to cool to room temperature before using.

title: Smoky Prime Rib Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs roast beef ( prime rib roast ) | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure coconut extract | 1/4 cup orange-infused irish cream | filling | couscous | radish, sliced and salted
instructions: Pat roast dry. Sprinkle on brown sugar. Dissolve coconut extract in cream and set aside. Trim excess fat from roast. Place roast on rack in roasting pan. Roast at 375 degrees until internal temperature reaches 120 degrees on an instant reading thermometer inserted in center of meat 125 degrees fahrenheit. Let meat rest 10 minutes before carving.

title: Cauliflower Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 head cabbage ( about 4 inches long ) | 2 medium cauliflower ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1/4 cup wine ( or sweet vermouth )
instructions: Core cabbage and cauliflower with a vegetable knife or a mandolin, then separate or cut into bite size pieces. Place into boiling water. Once tender, drain and place into large soup bowl. While cauliflower is boiling, place onion in saucepan and saute until soft but not browned. Place cauliflower and cabbage in same saucepan. Add wine and stir until boiling. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for about 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender but still separate and can be cut easily with a knife. Serve hot.

title: Lasagna Soup Without Leftovers
ingredients: 8 ounces sweet potatoes ( i cut them in half ) | 8 cups turkey ( i like to use turkey bolognese ) | 8 ounces ground beef consomme | 3 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | salt | 2 cups coarsely chopped spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place sweet potatoes in a 4 quart stockpot or dutch oven. Add water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender. Meanwhile, brown the turkey in a skillet over medium heat, stirring to break up clumps. Add the beef and consommé to the boiling soup. Stir in the chives, and season with salt to taste. Simmer the soup for about 15 minutes. Remove the sweet potatoes from the water and place in a colander. Add the spinach to the soup and puree in batches, or use a stick blender. Return the mixture to the dutch oven. Add a bit more water, if needed, to desired consistency. Bring to a boil and stir in the spinach. Continue to cook for about 3 3/4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: radish,asafoetida powder,soymilk,tomato sauce,sherry wine,parsley sprig,cilantro stem,cognac
title: Radish Simmered With Cognac
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro stems, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 tablespoon cognac or 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 tomatoes, peeled and chopped ( 2 large ) | 1 -2 tablespoon soymilk, for thinning | fresh parsley sprig, for garnish | radish, for garnish
instructions: In a saucepan, combine a little water and a pinch of asafetida powder and simmer over low heat for about 10 seconds, or until the water has been absorbed. Stir in cognac. Place tomatoes in a small skillet and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until thick, about 10 minutes. Drain and set aside. Process the remaining asafoetida in a blender or food processor until smooth, about 30 seconds, taking care not to break the tomatoes. Transfer to a bowl. Add a few tablespoons of the cooking liquid to the tomato mixture, stirring until well blended. Stir the tomato puree back into tomato puree, and stir in soymilk until combined. Divide herb mixture among 2 small serving bowls or soup plates. Top with tomato puree and garnish with parsley sprigs.

title: Mexican Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 lb green cabbage | 2 ounces guajillo chilies, minced | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,fig,arborio rice,salad oil,black bean,red wine vinegar
title: Black Beans and Tomatoes With Red Wine & Figs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salad oil | 3 cups coarsely chopped yellow peppers | 1 cup uncooked arborio rice | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 2/3 cup chopped fig, plump ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the peppers and arborio rice.

title: Quick Sushi Sauce (Sushi)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon chopped jalapeno pepper
instructions: Mix tamari, pickled jalapeno peppers, and minced garlic in a small bowl until well combined. Sushi sauce can also be served as an extra dipping sauce for hot cooked meat or other seafood.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,vegetable oil cooking spray,vanilla,corn kernel,tart apple,sun tomato,farfalle pasta
title: Vegetable Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 3/4 cups soymilk | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla | 5 medium tart apples, peeled and thinly sliced | 6 sun-dried tomatoes, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup frozen corn kernels
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 4 large tomatillos, husked and rinsed | 12 jalapenos, julienned | 1/3 cup lard
instructions: To prepare the tomatillos, remove tops from each tomatillo, leaving about 1 teaspoon of husk on one end and a tail hole on the other. Remove as many husks and ribs as will fit without tearing. Soak tomatillos and jalapenos in cold running water for 10 minutes to make them pliable. Remove remaining husks and ribs. Dice and set aside. Dissolve the lard in a saucepan over medium high heat. Add the tomatillo husks, chiles, and 1/2 c water. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until liquid is reduced to about 1 1/2 cups, 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: date,lemon yogurt,apple juice,italian turkey sausage,broiler fryer chicken,manicotti,pistachio,heavy whipping cream
title: Baked Italian Sausage and Chicken Manicotti with a Touch of PHILADELPHIA
ingredients: 9 uncooked manicotti | 1/2 cup cold heavy whipping cream, divided | 1 tablespoon lemon yogurt | 1 tablespoon italian dried thyme or 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 12 ounces hot italian turkey sausage | 3 broiler-fryer chickens, patted dry | 1 cup chopped dates, divided | 1/3 cup toasted unsalted pistachios, divided
instructions: Cook and rinse manicotti as directed on package and set aside. Cool completely, and drain thoroughly. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir 1/4 cup of the cream with yogurt until well blended. Stir in the thyme and ricotta cheese until well blended. Split and stuff each noodle with 1/8 of the cream mixture, 1 - 2 ounces of the sausage, 1/2 ounce of the chopped dates, 1/4 cup of pistachios, and 2 tbsp of the remaining cream mixture. Put the stuffed manicotti in a large, deep baking dish, and cover with the remaining cream mixture. Bake, covered, 1 hour. Remove from the oven, let stand for 10 minutes, then cut diagonally. Garnish with remaining 1/4 cup of chopped pistachios. Note, i do not use the dates, because the flavor is a matter of personal preference.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,white sugar,italian turkey sausage,vegetable stock,snail,pistachio
title: Italian Sausage and Snails
ingredients: 1/2 cup warm vegetable stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 4 cups warm vegetable stock | 1/2 cup unsalted butter | 1/2 pound sweet italian turkey sausage, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1/2 pound snails, cleaned | 1/2 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped, divided
instructions: Pour 3/4 cup of vegetable stock into a large bowl. Sprinkle the yeast into the mixture, and stir in sugar. Let stand until the yeast forms a creamy layer on top, about 10 minutes, or until the mixture is creamy and creamy. Mix in the 3 additional cups of vegetable and 3/4 cup of vegetable stock. Beat in the butter, 1/2 cup of the chopped pistachios, and 2 tablespoons of the pistachio nutmeg.

title: Lemon Salad
ingredients: 3 lemons, juice and zest of | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/4 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: Put the lemon rind and juice into a bowl and let the lemon juice infuse for 10 minutes. Pour over your chosen greens and toss in any unused dressing before serving. Variation, this will also make a delicious sandwich with tortilla chips, crudites or just eat them immediately.

title: Fig Ice-Cream Cake
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh figs, chopped | 1 vanilla bean, split and scraped | 1 cup light whipped topping | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Finely mince the figs. Discard the outer leaves and pulp, finely chop the vanilla bean. Blend the figs with the vanilla bean pulp with the oyster sauce and some light whipped topping. Spread into a greased and lined 24cm loaf pan. Bake for 50 minutes at 180c/350f degrees. Cool. Freeze 30 minutes more, or until firm. Remove and place on a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Simple and Tasty Vegetable Dip
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas and carrots, thawed and drained | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 package frozen fat-free whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Add carrots, and return to a boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon, until carrots are tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in salt, and remove from heat. Place the frozen whipped topping in a small bowl, and stir in pea carrot mixture until mixed. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oregano,chili powder,nonstick cooking spray,salt substitute,anchovy fillet,icing sugar
title: Low Sodium Oven Baked Chile Verde Chips
ingredients: 10 ounces chili powder | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 1 teaspoon salt substitute | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 anchovy fillet, chopped | 1 nonstick cooking spray, for greasing
instructions: Blend the dry ingredients in a medium bowl in a blender until the mixture is a smooth paste. Place the paste into a glass baking dish. Arrange chips in a single layer in a single layer, sprinkling with oil. Spray the tops with a non stick cooking spray. Let cool, then reseal. Store in an airtight container. The chips will keep for 1 - 6 weeks shaking them every 10 days.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,white mushroom,beef mince,baby spinach
title: Baby Spinach and Mushroom Burgers
ingredients: 400 g beef mince | 150 g small white mushrooms | 200 g baby spinach | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat your bbq to high. Mix all the ingredients together well and form into 4 equal size patties. Once patties have been spaced about 5cm from the coals, heat the grill to medium and cook each side about 8 minutes or until desired taste.

Random Ingredients: spice,red food coloring,tomato,ginger garlic paste,white flour,cardamom,white bean
title: White Bean Jam
ingredients: 1 kg white bean ( dry beans ) | 4 1/2 cups cooked white flour | 4 1/2 cups green king prawns ( or another large sized prawn ) | 4 red food coloring | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 tomatoes, chopped | 2 cardamoms
instructions: Cook white beans with 5 cups water for 8 mins in pressure cooker or pressure cooker with 4 1/2 tsp oil added. Add more water if necessary and cook for 3 mins or keep covered until cold. In a bowl mix flour, ginger garlic paste and tomatoes. Add 3/4 tsp cardamom powder and enough of the remaining water to make sauce. Remove green king prawns from shells and chop into small size pieces. In a frying pan add oil and fry the diced prawn until pink. Add tomato paste. Pour the rest of the water slowly to make a thick paste. Cook for 5 mins or until mixture thickens. Cook for a couple of mins uncovered. Add the sauce to cook slowly until the sauce coats prawns. Add the chopped green king prawns immediately and simmer for 2 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Portuguese Beans
ingredients: 1 can beans, undrained | 3/4 cup white wine | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Drain the beans, reserving most of the liquid. Combine the reserved liquid and white wine in a dutch oven or other large skillet, stir in the beans. Simmer over medium high heat for about 20 minutes, or until the beans are creamy.

title: Mexican Spices
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Blend ingredients and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,cream chicken soup,coffee powder,red cabbage,salt pepper,cannellini bean,chicken,lavender flower
title: Lavender and White Colcannon
ingredients: 5 slices chicken | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 jar cannellini beans | 4 ounces red cabbage, chopped | 2 tablespoons coffee powder | 1 tablespoon chili powder ( hot or medium ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender flowers or 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender | salt & pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Spray a 9x13 cake pan with non stick cooking spray. Arrange chicken pieces in alternate layers in the bottom of the pan. In a large bowl, combine soup, beans, cabbage, coffee powder, chili powder, and lavender. Pour over the chicken. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake 50 minutes, stirring twice. Bake 15 minutes more, until chicken is well cooked. Serve hot or cold.

title: Penne With Chicken, Thyme, and Quinoa
ingredients: 4 slices bacon ( i used thick slices ) or 4 ounces vegetarian bacon, diced ( i used thick slices ) | 12 chicken breast fillets, skin on ( i used thick slices ) | 150 g whole wheat penne | 1 1/2 cups mixed vegetables, of your choice ( i used snow peas, broccoli, cauliflower, zucchini, or baby corn ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 cup quinoa
instructions: Put water on to boil. Add penne. In a frypan, cook bacon or vegetarian bacon, if using. Remove bacon and set aside on kitchen towel, leaving fat in pan.
