Saute chicken fillets until cooked through. While chicken is cooking, heat a saucepan, add quinoa and bring to a boil. Season with thyme and pepper. Reduce heat, and simmer 30 minutes. Remove chicken fillets from pan and add to saucepan. Mix and simmer 3 minutes until the sauce is thickened. Add quinoa, cooking water, salt, and pepper. Keep at a simmer until quinoa is tender and chicken is cooked through. Serve chicken and quinoa over the quinoa. Serve over pasta of your choice.

title: Easy Pasta With Cream
ingredients: 600 g short pasta | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Boil the pasta according to package instructions. Drain the pasta. Add the cream and stir thoroughly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: beef flavor ramen noodle,flour,yellow squash,beef stock
title: Oriental Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 5 ounces beef flavor ramen noodles | 1 cup yellow squash, sliced | 4 cups beef stock | 2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Soak noodles in water for 2 hours drain and set aside. Cook sliced squash in beef stock for 15 minutes add in noodles, cook another 15 minutes or until tender. Mix flour into broth and boil until it thickens. When noodle soup is hot, serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,bread crumb,chili bean,cranberry juice,heavy whipping cream,blueberry
title: Berry-Cranberry Chili Beans
ingredients: 3 cans chili beans | 1 can cranberry juice | 1/2 cup cocoa | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 cup bread crumbs | 1 cup frozen blueberries
instructions: Combine chili beans and cranberry juice in a large pot. Over medium high heat, stir in cocoa and cream. Add bread crumbs and heat to boiling. When soup comes to a boil, stir in blueberries. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: habanero pepper,sugar snap pea,beef rib roast,zucchini,arborio rice
title: Rice-Braised Beef Cubes With Jicama
ingredients: 3 cups arborio rice | 2 lbs boneless beef short rib roast or 2 lbs stewing beef | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and minced | 2 medium zucchini, sliced lengthwise 1/4-inch thick | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas, thawed | 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: In a wide shallow dish or bowl, combine rice, beef and 1 habanero pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 6 hours. Preheat oven to 325°f. In 4 quart deep heavy, ovenproof casserole or dutch oven with a rack in the middle, combine the zucchini, sugar and remaining habanero. Add the rice mixture and toss to coat. Cover and bake 2 hours or until meat is tender. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining sugar.

title: Peanut Butter Curry Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 1 green pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter or 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Serve with your favourite pasta or meat.

title: Tostones
ingredients: 1 1/2 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Mix tomatoes and green chilies with vinegar in a medium bowl. Let sit 1 hour. Bring a large pot of water to boiling and add the tostada shells. Mix well. Cook tostada for 3 to 5 minutes, until just heated through.

title: Lamb & String Beans With Creamy Yogurt
ingredients: 400 g loin lamb, lean, boneless | 500 g string beans, trimmed | 600 ml cream of tartar | 50 g plain yogurt
instructions: Cut lamb into pieces about the thickness of your palm. Cut string beans into 3 lengths, then cut lengths into 4 lengths. Combine yogurt and cream of tartar. Place lamb pieces in yogurt mixture, and toss to coat. Marinate, refridgerated, in the refridgerator for 2 to 6 hours. Bring to room temperature before serving. Tip, you may use small glass bowls for serving, or you may use shallow bowls for serving.

title: Mexican Hot Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 10 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon paprika | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning, blend
instructions: In a small bowl, add all the ingredients and mix well. Store in an airtight container. Shake well before using so all the ingredients evenly distribute.

title: Ouzo and Lemon Peel
ingredients: 4 ounces ouzo | 8 ounces lemons
instructions: Pour the ouzo into a bowl. Grate the peel and finely grate the lemons. Pour 1/2 oz ouzo in the bowl with the ouzo and lemon peel, mix well. Store in the refrigerator in a clean container.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,salmon fillet,coriander powder,flour,juniper berry,bay leaf,lemon zest
title: Herb Grilled Fish
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs salmon fillets, skin on or 3 -4 lbs salmon fillets ( or a combination of the two ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh coriander sprigs ( the coriander leaves picked from the stalks ) | 1/2 cup fresh sage leaf | 1/2 teaspoon juniper berries | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest, grated ( or zest of 1 lemon ) | 2 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon dried coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon poppy seed flakes or 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander leaves
instructions: To make the herbs, mix the herbs, zest, bay leaves and coriander in a large bowl. Toss the herbs with the spices. Place the salmon on a shallow dish or cling film, pour the herb mixture over and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or preferably overnight. For the barbecue or bake, remove from the marinade, cut into 4 pieces or 8 pieces place each piece between plastic wrap and using kitchen string, secure the ends until ready to grill or bake. Brush generously with bbq sauce. Grill or bake on medium or high heat until the fish is cooked, brushing once with bbq sauce, until fish is cooked, brushing once with bbq sauce. Top with herbs prior to serving.

title: Beef Tenderloin Fettuccine With Minted Cream Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces fettuccine pasta, cooked | 1/2 lb beef tenderloin, thinly sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh mint, snipped | 3 tablespoons dry red wine | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 3 tablespoons mint, snipped
instructions: In a small bowl, toss beef with a few grinds of black pepper to coat. Toss with 1 tbsp snipped mint and set aside. In a medium size bowl, combine cream with remaining mint. In a 10 to 12 inch skillet, heat remaining 1 tbsp butter over high heat. Spread cream mixture over pasta. Slice beef thinly. Sprinkle with mint, if desired. Serve with hot cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: nopales,jalapeno pepper,onion,egg yolk,cooking spray,chinese five spice powder,green apple,sesame oil
title: Chinese five-Spice Nopales
ingredients: 12 nopales | cooking spray | 1 onion, minced | 1 green apple, peeled and diced | 1/2 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 3 egg yolks | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 4 drops sesame oil
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat. Spray nopales with cooking oil. Cook nopales in preheated grill on preheated grill until the flesh is charred and tender, but opaque, about 5 minutes. Cut nopales into strips, and slice onion into thin wedges. Arrange nopales on a serving plate. Place apple, jalapeno, egg yolks, five spice powder, sesame oil, and 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder in a blender, and blend to chop the ingredients. Stir the nopales and apple mixture into nopales, cover, and refrigerate until serving.

title: Caldo Verde I Think It's Like Me!
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thigh fillet | 200 g kielbasa | 1 celery leaves | 1 3/4 cups broth | 1/4 grated romano cheese
instructions: Cut chicken into 2cm cubes. Place in a container. Cut kielbasa into thick slices or pieces and sprinkle over the chicken in the dish. Add chicken broth and cover tightly with cling wrap. Refrigerate for at least overnight. After the hour you are going to serve, sprinkle on some grated cheese and remove the cling wrap. Put on the table and eat with some green beans, rice and salad.

title: Hungarian Beet Salad
ingredients: 2 large beets | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 3 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 cup finely chopped onion | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 4 leaves fresh mint leaves
instructions: Peel the beets, leaving the tops intact. Cut the tops off the beets and cut a slit in the top of the beets. Cut off about 1 1/2 inches of beet tips to be a little wider then the length of the beet root. Using a sharp knife, scrape out the beet centers if necessary. Rinse under cold water to cool slightly or put in a colander and toss with 2 tablespoons of sweet paprika. Let sit for about 30 minutes to absorb the juices. Cut the beet tips into pieces about the width of the beets.

title: Cha Cha Nachos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 package egg noodles | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 bag tortilla chips ( not crunchy )
instructions: Pour 1 tablespoon of oil over a large frying pan or wok. Once the pan is hot, add the ramen and noodles. Cook to soften and absorb the flavors. While the noodles cook, heat up the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in a separate frying pan or wok over medium heat. Add the cilantro and cook until soft. Pour noodles and hot oil over noodles and mix well. Serve with crumbled tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,topping,beef roast,cilantro stem,almond,tuna water,boursin cheese,grand marnier
title: Spicy Tuna and Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef roast | 1 package boursin cheese | 1 1/2 ounces canned tuna in water, drained | 6 -8 fresh cilantro stems, chopped | 3 tablespoons white vinegar ( not seasoned vinegar ) | 4 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 cup toasted slivered almonds ( optional )
instructions: Trim fat from beef roast and discard any remaining fat. Cut beef into 1/2 inch cubes or smaller. Place in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days, turning once. In a small saucepan, over medium heat, melt boursin cheese and tuna with cilantro stems and vinegar. Stir frequently until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in grand marnier. Pour over beef mixture and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Before serving, stir almonds into salad just before serving. Pour salad into decorative bowl. Spoon over dressing to coat.

title: Sausage Rolls (Paleo)
ingredients: 1 package lean pork sausage | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram, or | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 6 garlic cloves, crushed | 12 toothpicks | cooked rice, for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f cut top off of sausage.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,pineapple juice,beef gravy granule,garlic,red bean
title: Sombrero Dip
ingredients: 1 can red beans, drained, rinsed | 2 cans canned pineapple juice | 3 cans condensed beef gravy granules, undiluted | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 tablespoon granulated garlic
instructions: Combine beans, pineapple juice, gravy granules, chilies, garlic, and granulated garlic in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian bacon,cooking spray,ginger,rose water,prosciutto,lime juice,golden syrup,hamburger
title: Sweetheart Benny’s Beef Jerky
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package shredded cooked beef | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 5 tablespoons lime juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 1 1/2 tablespoons crystallized ginger | 1 can vegetarian bell peppers and hamburger, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 2 slices prosciutto, cut into 1/4-inch pieces
instructions: Arrange beef in a single layer on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray.

title: American Kitchen Classic Mint and Bacon Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 lb streaky bacon or 1/2 lb turkey bacon, chopped | 1 teaspoon bottled sweet mint leaves, minced or 1 teaspoon minced fresh mint | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves, minced | 1/8 cup water ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon grand marnier or 1 teaspoon orange liqueur | 1 1/2 teaspoons bottled sweetened vinegar or 1 1/2 teaspoons orange juice
instructions: Combine the bacon, mint leaves, water, and grand marnier and stir to combine. Serve as a condiment to hot dog buns. Note, you may use a slotted spoon so the liquid doesn't get stuck to the bacon.

title: Italian Cream Cheese Spread
ingredients: 14 ounces cream cheese, softened | 2 cups shredded fontina cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, beat the cream cheese with an electric mixer on medium speed until smooth. Gradually add the fontina cheese with the dried oregano and oregano.

title: Kolokithakia (Greek Olive and Rose Water Soup)
ingredients: 1 cup whole pitted kalamata olives | 1 teaspoon minced fresh rose water | ice water ( optional ) or lemon juice, to taste | 1 pinch kalamata olive blossoms, and or cherry blossoms, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Put the olives in a blender with the rose water or lemon juice, about 1/2 teaspoon at a time, pulsing several times. Transfer mixture into a bowl and pour in 1/2 cup ice water, or more to taste.

title: German Kluski
ingredients: 1 package kluski noodles, danish | 1/2 cup prune, pitted | 1/4 cup peanut butter
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook kluski noodles in boiling water until just tender but firm, about 8 minutes.

title: Hamburger Helper
ingredients: 3 pounds thin-cut deli roast beef | 1 cup vegetable oil for frying | 4 rolls, or as needed
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Wrap half of the roast with an onion and roll into a 4 inch cylinder using 2 rolls as you roll. Firmly roll into the hot oil. Reduce heat to medium low, and fry until browned, about 20 minutes. Drain on a paper towel lined plate.

title: Cilantro Creme
ingredients: 3 -4 russet potatoes, peeled, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 1 can consomme, condensed | salt & freshly ground black pepper | fresh cilantro leaves, garnish
instructions: Place the potatoes in a saucepan with just enough water to cover them and place over high heat. Bring to a boil, then cook until potatoes are tender but still firm. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1½ cups of consommé and let stand for 10 minutes. Drain the potatoes and return them to the saucepan. Add the dissolved gelatin and stir to blend well. Add the remaining consommé and stir to combine. Bring to a boil and immediately turn down the heat to low. Cook, continuing to stir, until the mixture begins to set around the edges, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and add the salt and pepper. Garnish with chopped cilantro. Serve warm.

title: Herbed Sweet Pork With Herbs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mixed dried herbs, e.g. oregano, basil, chives, thyme, and tarragon | 1 lb lean pork, trimmed and cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Place herbs in a small bowl. Coat pork with herbs. Allow to set for 30 minutes. Grill, covered, over medium heat for about 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Mom's Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 1 bag mixed salad greens | 1 bag tortilla chips | 2 cups chopped parsnips
instructions: Marinate chicken wings overnight in salad greens and tortilla chips. Arrange wings on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Refrigerate 3 hours. Remove from baking sheet and bake at 450 for 20 to 30 minutes, or until crisp.

title: Swiss Cheese Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 2 tablespoons dried dill weed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Combine the gruyere cheese, chili powder and dried dill weed in a medium size mixing bowl. Place the bowl on a baking sheet, or the inside of a baking pan. Bake at 450 degrees f for 10 to 12 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly and melted.

Random Ingredients: green bean,peanut butter,peanut oil vegetable,coconut milk,meat,black eyed pea,savory,beef tenderloin
title: Peanut Beef and Black Eyed Pea Stew
ingredients: 1 lb meaty beef tenderloin or 1 lb sirloin steak | 8 ounces coconut milk | 1 can black-eyed peas | 1 can frozen green beans, thawed | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon mixed savory | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 tablespoon shredded savory
instructions: Cut beef in half lengthwise, then pound to 1/2 thick. Slice lengthwise with cleaver or a meat mallot to yield 20 slices. In a 4 to 5 quart crock pot, combine coconut milk, black eyed peas, green beans, oil and chopped savory. Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours, or on low for 8 to 10 hours. Meanwhile, remove beef from coconut milk mixture and drain any fat from meat. Cut meat into thin slices and return to milk mixture. To serve, reheat meat and meat broth and garnish with reserved savory. Note, i often add small chunks and raw onions to the meat juices.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,red bell pepper,coconut milk,broth,ricotta cheese,hamburger bun
title: Indian Spiced Squash With Ricotta
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash, rinsed | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 8 ounces hamburger buns | 1 red bell pepper, sliced into thin rings | 2 cups reduced-fat coconut milk | 2 tablespoons broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Put 3 inch diameter piece of tin foil in the oven to catch any leaks. Preheat grill, or use cast iron grill pan on the stove. Cut squash in half lengthwise and scoop out seeds. Cut shells into 3/4 cubes and toss with squash and drain well, put in baking dish. Spread a layer of ricotta on top, then a layer of the hamburger, bell pepper rings and coconut milk. Repeat with another layer of pumpkin, then another layer of cheese, and finally a third of the butternut squash mixture. Top with remaining butternut squash mixture. Bake for 1 hour, then remove from oven. Brush tops with coconut oil and place under broiler to brown.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,chunky salsa,beef bouillon,garlic,meat
title: Spicy Salsa Meat
ingredients: 1 lb dried, boneless ground meat | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients. Let stand at least 20 minutes before shredding into large chunks and serving.

title: Mashed Rieska for One
ingredients: 1 cup dry rieska cheese or 1 cup parmesan cheese | 8 poblano chiles | water | roasted stock, your choice
instructions: Cut the chiles lengthwise into strips about 3 inches long. Place on a baking sheet and bake in oven, until softened, about 10 minutes, stirring once or twice. Rinse and drain on a towel. Set the oven temp to 400º f. Place the chiles on the baking sheet. When the chiles are completely cooled, put them in a blender or food processor to puree. Add about 2 cups of water to the pureed mixture. Puree until smooth, about 1 minute or so. Taste.

title: Macadamia Nut Stew
ingredients: 1 yellow squash, cut into big chunks | 1 cup macadamia nuts | 3 -4 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Heat up the cooking oil in a large pot. Toss in the squash and cook for five minutes to soften slightly. Throw in the nuts and fry for another five minutes over medium high heat, stirring often. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ancho chili,pepper,beef stock,leek,beef tenderloin steak,asafoetida powder,ice
title: Beef Tenderloin With Roasted Red Pepper Chili, Asapetida
ingredients: 1/2 cup beef stock | 8 beef tenderloin steaks | 6 teaspoons asafoetida powder | pepper | 1/2 bunch fresh leek ( washed, rinsed, and chopped ) | 3 dried ancho chili, seeded and stemmed, finely diced ( optional ) | ice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Combine the beef stock and beef in a blender.

title: Veggies on the Run
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 4 cups vegetable juice ( v-8 ) | 1 cup diced tart apple | 1 bag shredded red cabbage ( about 8 cups ) | 4 cups shredded lettuce | hot pickled apple slices ( optional ) | ice ( optional )
instructions: In a deep skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add cabbage to skillet, cover, and reduce heat to medium low.

title: Crispy Peanut Soup
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock | 1 cup dry onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Bring chicken stock and dry onions to a boil in a medium pot. Reduce heat to medium low. Cook, uncovered and stirring occasionally for about 25 minutes. Meanwhile, place peanut butter in a small bowl and mash with a fork. Gradually ladle hot stock into peanut butter mixture while stirring frequently with a wisk or a wooden spoon. When the peanut butter is mixed in, cook for another 5 minutes to develop the peanut butter flavor. Remove soup from heat and garnish with tarragon and roasted peanuts.

title: Moroccan Mango Tostadas
ingredients: 1 mango - peeled, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1/2 cup currants | 1/2 cup chopped fresh marjoram | pita bread, to serve
instructions: Toss mango, bell pepper, currants, and marjoram with tortillas and top with remaining condiments. Serve at once.

title: Yummy Raisins and Raisins
ingredients: 1 cup white raisins ( optional ) | 1 cup yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Cover raisins with boiling water and let stand 5 minutes. Drain and rinse. Stuff raisins with yogurt or a mixture of your favourite filling.

title: Stuffed Beet Bets
ingredients: 6 medium red beets | 1 cup finely shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped shallots or 1 tablespoon green onion | 3 tablespoons tahini | hot salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Wash beets and slice off the tops. Cut top into about 2 inch pieces to form a hollow core. Remove pulp, and place beets into a large pot of boiling water. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 10 minutes. Drain water and remove beets. Slice off beetroot ends, keeping greens. In a mixing bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. Stuff each beet with the mixture and serve with salsa for dipping.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,mango,taco sauce,pesto,tamarind juice,malt vinegar,beef eye,farfalle pasta
title: Steak and Mango Noodle Salad
ingredients: 500 g mince | 1 cup onion salt | 1 cup mango, skin on | 250 g farfalle pasta | 3 tablespoons pesto | 3 tablespoons tamarind juice | 1 packet taco sauce | 1/2 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Grill the steak for 5 - 7 minutes or until cooked to your liking. Remove from the grill, slice into bite size pieces and allow to cool. Cook the pasta according to the packet directions. Drain and cool under running water. Dry slightly. Mix together the pesto, tamarind juice and taco sauce. Combine the malt vinegar together with a little water, and mix into the pesto mixture. Add the steak pieces and mix again. Allow to marinate for about 10 minutes. Toss the noodles with the dressing and place in a serving bowl or individual serving plates.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,shiitake mushroom,milk chocolate chip,rum,colby cheese,red apple
title: Pound Me' Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 4 ounces sliced colby cheese, cut into small cubes | 1/2 cup evaporated milk chocolate chips | 1/4 cup unsweetened light rum | 2 red apples, cored, coarsely shredded | 4 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 2 slices rye bread
instructions: Place all ingredients except bread and bread in blender jar and blend until smooth. Spread or pipe onto bread slices. Place in freezer until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: lemonade,cardamom seed,celery rib,ricotta cheese,madeira wine,cream chicken soup,large shrimp
title: Stuffed Shrimp Madeira Sticks
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup madeira wine | 2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 package ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh lemonade ( optional )
instructions: Combine soup, madeira wine and shrimp in large bowl and stir until well blended. Shape mixture into 12 small patties about 3/4 inch thick. Place patties on foil lined baking sheets. Bake in 400°f oven for 12 minutes. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Stir together the ricotta cheese and cardamom seed in medium bowl. Roll 1/2 cup of the shrimp mixture in the ricotta mixture. Place the remaining mixture in a small bowl. Sprinkle the cheese mixture around the shrimp. Serve shrimp with remaining sauce in fondue pot.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,sauce,buttermilk,mint sprig,tart shell,sun tomato oil,mustard powder
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Butter
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 tablespoons dried mint sprigs | 1/4 cup sliced green pepper | 1/2 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Add oil to microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 2 - 3 minutes until hot & warm. Add next 4 ingredients.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,plain nonfat yogurt,sumac,vanilla extract,tahini,garlic salt
title: Swiss-Cheese Hummus
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon sumac
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend all ingredients except sumac until smooth. Add sumac and mix well. To serve, spread into a dish, garnish with 1 - 2 t sumac leaves, and let it sit for 2 - 3 minutes in the fridge.

title: Easy Greek Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds feta cheese, crumbled | 1 cup golden raisins | 1 1/2 cups water
instructions: Place the feta cheese, golden raisins, and water into the bowl of a blender, and blend until smooth. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 hour. Serve in small individual serving bowls with toothpicks inserted in a few of the raisins to keep them from sticking.

title: Hamburger Buns
ingredients: 1 green apple, cored, chopped | 2 hamburger buns | cayenne
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium. In a microwave safe bowl, combine the apple and cooked burger. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper, and warm in the microwave for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, or until warm, stir well, and serve.

title: Baked Aegean Pizza
ingredients: 2 pizza crusts | 1 lemon, juice of | 2 -3 green apples, cored, thinly sliced, about 1/2 cup | 3 -4 green cardamom pods, crushed ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Place the crust and the juice in a food processor and process until smooth and creamy. Spread the mixture over the two doughs on a greased baking tray. Sprinkle over the cardamom, oregano, and green apple slices.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,cilantro leaf,green cardamom pod,flax seed,picante sauce
title: Picante Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup picante sauce | 1/2 large red green cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon whole flax seed | 5 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Place the picante sauce in a blender, and pulse until the mixture is a smooth paste. Remove from the blender and place in a medium bowl. Tie the cardamom pods, unhusked, in a piece of cheesecloth and place over the picante sauce. Place the vanilla bean in the mixture, add the picante sauce, and stir until the picante sauce is fully mixed with the cardamom pods and onion pieces. Grate the cilantro leaves over the top and serve with fresh pita wedges also, if desired. The picante sauce can be refrigerated for up to 1 week.

title: Filipino Christmas Rolls (Sukuma Bushi)
ingredients: 2 lbs cabbage, chopped | 2 cups brown rice, washed thoroughly | 1 lb dark rum ( optional ) or 1 lb rice wine vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Brown cabbage, not too much. Remove from pan and put cabbage on a board.

title: Easy and Delicious Indian Fennel Curry (Tomato Ka Kaali)
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 minced garlic clove | 1 small finely diced onion ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder or 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Grind fennel seeds thoroughly. Combine all above ingredients in a wok or large skillet. Mix well after a minute. If using, add a wee bit of water and mix well after a minute or two. Once the wok or skillet is clean, put on the lid, turn on heat slightly if it has a lid, and let it simmer gently. After 5 minutes, turn off heat. The fennel should be sizzling gently at the very end. Stir and serve hot with rotis or naan.

Random Ingredients: linguine,salsa,chipotle chile adobo,beef rib,red pepper flake,red chile
title: Chipotle Beef Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short ribs, trimmed | 1/2 cup diced canned chipotle chile in adobo | 1 cup salsa, medium heat | 2 teaspoons minced chipotle chiles in adobo | 3/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 lb linguine, cooked al dente | 1 1/4 cups minced red chiles
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place rack in center of oven and heat oven to 400°f combine all ingredients.

title: Empanadas (Green Beans)
ingredients: 1 lb white beans, cleaned | 2 cups white beans, drained | 3 ounces drained sun-dried tomatoes | 1 lb fresh peas | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Put a small amount of water on the side of the peas to steam the beans. When steaming, boil the white beans till tender. Drain, and set aside. Take the peas to another bowl with cold water to cool, and then peel. Chop them into thin, long pieces. Bring water to a boil in a pot. Add salt and sun dried tomatoes. Let it boil for about 10 seconds, remove, and drain. Set aside. Heat the margarine or butter in a skillet on medium high heat until the butter gets fragrant. Add the peas, and saute them quickly for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring regularly. Remove skillet from the stove, add the peas to the skillet with the sauteed peas.

title: Mango (Mango) Dip in a Smoothie
ingredients: 2 mangoes, peeled, coarsely chopped to 1-inch pieces | 1 can stewed tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, drained and chopped
instructions: Combine mango, and stewed tomatoes in blender or food processor. Puree until smooth. Pour into glass serving dish, and serve. Garnish with parsley, if desired.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,green bean,jalapeno pepper,blackberry,lamb shank,pasta,vanilla bean
title: Jambalaya Soup
ingredients: 2 -3 lamb shanks | 3 large jalapeno peppers ( to taste ) | 2 -4 cups heavy cream | 1 -2 cup frozen cut green beans, thawed | 1 cup frozen blackberries | 1 vanilla bean | 1/4 cup uncooked dry pasta
instructions: Boil the lamb shanks in lightly salted water for 40 minutes, or until they are tender enough to poke a skewer through the center of the shanks. Remove the shanks and drain away the excess fat from the pan. Discard the remaining fat. Remove the green beans, and save. Place in a large serving dish, and sprinkle them with the blackberries. Cut the vanilla bean in half lengthwise, scrape out the vanilla bean seeds, and scrape the vanilla seeds into a small bowl. Stir the seeds into the cream, and set aside. Slice the jalapeno peppers lengthwise, and drop them in as well. Cover with a layer of the green beans, then pour 1 cup of cream over the green beans. Repeat these layers until the dish is full, ending with the cream. Cover, and let mellow out for 30 minutes. Just before serving, bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the dry pasta, and cook it until al dente. Drain the pasta, return it to the pot, and add the cream. Cook an additional 2 minutes, but only until the cream gets a little thicker. Sprinkle the jalapeno pepper pieces over the hot soup, and serve hot.

title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough bread ( or equivalent ) | 1 lb noodles | 1 cucumbers or 1 cucumber | celery ( or green onion or white onion ) | 1 can pizza sauce | 2 tablespoons vodka ( optional )
instructions: Cut bread in bite size pieces. Boil noodles 5 minutes or until done. Drain. Add veggies. Add pizza sauce if using. Add vodka if using. Mix in noodles and enjoy.

title: Almond, Scallion and Beef Skillet (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, trimmed and cut into thin 1-inch sticks | 2 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs ( rosemary, rosemary, marjoram and oregano ) | 2 teaspoons beef base or 2 teaspoons beef bouillon, mixed with 2 1/4 teaspoons water | 1/2 ground blanched almond | 2 scallions, trimmed and chopped | 1/4 teaspoon almond flavoring, see note
instructions: Place the flank steak in the slow cooker. In a small bowl, combine the herbs, beef base, ground ground blanched almond and scallions and mix well. Sprinkle over the meat. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 12 hours or until steak feels springy to the touch. Remove from slow cooker and discard bay leaf and herb cloudiness. Allow to rest for 5 - 10 minutes, fluffing with fork before serving. Serve with a fresh green vegetable of your choice, such as green beans, red bell peppers, zucchini, red grapes and cauliflower.

title: Easy Beef & Noodles
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1 lb egg noodles
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Simmer covered 5 - 10 minutes or until beef is tender. Serve over hot noodles.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,puff pastry,red curry paste,plain yogurt
title: Easy Red Curry Pastries  (Vegetarian, Not Chicken)
ingredients: 3 sheets puff pastry | 1/3 cup prepared red curry paste | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, finely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas roll out each sheet of pastry on a floured surface into a rectangle about 15cm/1in thick. Using a 3cm cutter, cut half the pastry diagonally to make 12 long, wide strips. Place a teaspoon of curry paste into the centre of each pastry strip, and fold 2 opposite corners over, to seal together. Paint the pastry with a little water, then fold in two adjacent corners, again brushing with water, to seal around the edge and prevent pastry from becoming soggy. Repeat steps 3 and 4 using the remaining pastry. Place a small non stick frying pan over medium low heat, and place all pastry in pan. Cook, turning occasionally, for 10 minutes or until pastry is nicely browned and crisp. Remove pastry from pan, and place on a wire rack. Serve immediately as desired.

title: Raisin and Spinach
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 cup dark raisin or 1/2 cup brown raisins | 1 cup fresh spinach or 1 cup thawed frozen chopped spinach, defrosted
instructions: Rinse the spinach thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels. Spread thawed spinach evenly on a sheet of oiled plastic wrap. Place on the center rack of your grill or in a foil lined broiler pan. Place under a hot grill and cook about 5 to 7 minutes. When the first side is light brown, flip onto other side and cook until dark. About 5 to 7 minutes longer, or according to the size and thickness of your spinach. Remove from heat when the spinach is just beginning to wilt.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,poblano chile,dark sesame oil,mustard,anise seed
title: Chilies Poached in Mustard
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and sliced 1/4-inch thick and about 10 inches long | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 4 tablespoons chili oil | 2 tablespoons whole anise seed | 1 teaspoon mustard
instructions: To peel the chilies, slit them off by cutting through the slit down into the slit to remove seeds and veins and discard any stems and the veins, then scrape out as much flesh as possible without ruining the skin. Remove the stems and seeds, then coarsely chop in a food processor. In a small bowl, mix together the chilies, sesame oil, chili oil, mustard, and anise seed. Place this mixture into the chilies, add more oil, if desired. Place into a glass jar, and seal. This recipe uses mustard seeds that aren't available any food processor.

Random Ingredients: steak,chipotle chile adobo,cumin seed,heavy cream,soy sauce
title: Chipotle Grilled Flank Steak
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole cumin seeds | 1 cup heavy cream | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, coarsely chopped | 1 pound flank steak, trimmed | 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Toast the cumin seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat, shaking the pan frequently, until they are very fragrant and the cumin browns as evenly as dark brown sugar, 2 to 4 minutes. Remove the pan from heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Heat the cream to about 1/2 inch temperature in a heavy skillet set over medium low heat, stirring constantly until simmering. Transfer the cream to a blender and add the chipotle peppers, the cream and the cooled ground cumin. Puree until smooth. Pour the sauce into a shallow dish or bowl and refrigerate until ready to use. Brush the flank steak with soy sauce and season each steak with salt and pepper. Grill the steak to desired doneness, about 15 minutes for medium rare. Transfer to a cutting board and rest. Pour the rest of the sauce onto a large platter, surround with fettuccine or linguine and place a fork through the pasta to fluff and add some cheese.

title: Maple Glazed Chicken Liver
ingredients: 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 jar sauerkraut | 3 pounds chicken livers
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line the bottom of a 9x12 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Pour the maple syrup onto the foil. Slice open the livers and arrange them in front of you in a horizontal line about 3/4 inch apart. Lay the liver slices in the spaces where the liver tears. Place the sauerkraut in the same line about 3/4 of the way up the chicken livers. Spread sauerkraut over the liver. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven until the internal temperature of the liver reaches 145 degrees f, 20 to 25 hours.

Random Ingredients: saffron,red bell pepper,berry cranberry sauce,tamarind paste,russet potato,yukon gold potato,feta
title: Chef Flower's Persian Potatoes
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, peeled | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 2 pints mixed berries and cranberry sauce | 5 small yukon gold potatoes ( about 5 ounces total weight ) or 5 small purple potatoes, peeled, halved ( about 5 ounces total weight ) | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 red bell pepper, chopped ( or yellow ) | 1/2 cup feta, crumbled
instructions: Boil potatoes in a large pot of salted water until very tender, 25 to 35 minutes, and then drain. Peel the potatoes and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Place the potatoes in a mixing bowl with the tamarind paste and combine. While potatoes are cooking, arrange the berries, cranberry sauce, potatoes, bell pepper and saffron in a baking dish with sides. Sprinkle with feta and serve.

title: Pineapple Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1 can crushed pineapple | 1 can crushed low-fat crushed tomatoes
instructions: Spray a 3 qt casserole dish w/ oil. Brown rice until lightly golden. Add the other ingredients, mix well. Put rice into casserole and cover with foil. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Green Beans and Radishes for 2
ingredients: 200 g green beans, topped and tailed | 1/4 kg ricotta cheese, at room temperature | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 kg radish, peeled thin, washed and cut into fine julienne
instructions: Preheat oven to 240c.

title: Spinach With Smoky BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 4 tablespoons sour cream | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 teaspoons curry | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon light cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a medium size mixing bowl, toss spinach with sour cream, flour, curry, cayenne, lime zest and light cream of tartar. Grease an 8x8 baking dish. Press spinach in dish, coating all over. Bake 40 - 45 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve with spicy bbq sauce.

title: Potato Crusted Pork Loin
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, scrubbed | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless pork loin, fat trimmed, cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch slices | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme leave
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Wrap a baking sheet around the pork in plastic wrap and place on cutting board. With a sharp knife cut slices at least 1/4 inch thick. Arrange slices in one layer, about 2 per baking sheet, in a 10x4 inch layer. Cut off remaining fat, wrap around meat, and seasonings with salt and pepper. Transfer to prepared baking sheet. Arrange reserved fat slices around the meat. Bake at 400 degrees f for 1 hour or until internal temperature registers 160 degrees f for medium rare. Remove pork from oven, increase temperature to 400 degrees f and continue with cooking for 20 minutes longer.

title: Aubergine and Lamb Rollups
ingredients: 100 g aubergines or 100 g sirloin, diced | 300 g leg of lamb, diced | 4 sheets nori, finely grated
instructions: Cook aubergines or sirloin until tender. Add lamb and cook until heated through. Line saran wrap top with nori, press down lightly, slice diagonally into 2 slices, roll up and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bourbon whiskey,spaghetti sauce,corn kernel,yellow onion,citron peel,pineapple ring,tomato puree
title: Spicy Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce ( prepared ) | 6 ounces canned corn kernels or 6 ounces frozen corn kernels | 1 can pineapple rings ( drained ) or ( 16 ounce ) can tidbits, drained | 1 yellow onion ( chopped ) | 1 jar syrup-based bourbon whiskey | 1/2 cup chopped citron peel or 1/2 cup dried cherries ( 1 1/2 cherries ) | 1 teaspoon tomato puree
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat all of the sauce ingredients to boiling in a large saucepan. Reduce heat.

title: South African Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground lamb | 1/2 lb ground beef | 4 teaspoons chutney | 4 teaspoons red wine | 8 wheat tortillas | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | sweet german sweet chutney, to serve
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190c. Cut tortillas into eight wedges on a high oven tray. Place wedges on tray and bake for about 10 minutes, keeping an eye on them and turning the oven to evenly brown them. Heat a non stick frying pan until it is very hot. Add the lamb, hamburg, chutney and cayenne. Stir continuously until meat browns. Drain off any excess fat/oil into a medium sized bowl. Spoon meat mixture onto tortillas and spread evenly. Tuck in the ends of the tortillas and place in oven. Bake for about 15 - 20 minutes or until heated through, turning a few times.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,milk ricotta cheese,pinto bean,cremini mushroom,cannellini bean,white mushroom
title: Totally No Fat Homemade Beef and Bean Baked Beans for 2
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck | 1/2 lb white mushroom | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 package whole-milk ricotta cheese | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 0.75 package cremini mushrooms
instructions: Place beef chuck and mushrooms in a large pot and cover with approximately one inch of water. Bring to a boil over high heat then transfer the mixture to a casserole dish. Add remaining ingredients into the pot and mix well. Cover the casserole and bake for about two hours. Top with your favourite toppings.

Random Ingredients: golden brown sugar,kiwi fruit,shaoxing wine,pear,hash brown potato,sesame oil,hoisin sauce
title: Sweet Potato Fondue
ingredients: 1 pound sweet potatoes, peeled, and quartered | 2 pounds kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced into 1/2 inch rounds | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1/4 cup shaoxing wine | 2 tablespoons golden brown sugar | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 pinches ground sesame seeds
instructions: Place sweet potatoes in a large pot, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Drain, and set aside until completely cooled, about 20 minutes. Slice kiwifruit into 1/2 inch slices. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place sweet potatoes in a medium nonstick frying pan. Drizzle with hoisin sauce, and spread to coat. Place potatoes into a large shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with sugar, sesame oil, and sesame seeds.

title: Sweet Rice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon minced kaffir lime leaf | 1/4 teaspoon dry rice, can use plain white rice cooking rice | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: If using dry rice, stir until rice is completely coated with water. If using wet rice, stir until water is absorbed. Spray a casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Pour 1/2 c water into a shallow container with a lid. Stir the lime leaf and rice in the container until coated with water completely coated, about 1 minute. Cover, and refrigerate 4 minutes. Uncover, and sprinkle remaining water over rice. Heat in microwave, about 3 minutes. Cover, and cook 20 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway through.

title: Crock Pot Corn and Coca Shreds
ingredients: 1 bag dry shell pasta | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/4 cup unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa, for topping | hoagie rolls or sandwich buns, split
instructions: Place the water in the bottom of the crock pot. Add the whole kernel corn, making sure to cover it. Add the cocoa. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, or on high for 3 to 4 hours. Add a few spoonfuls of the liquid if it gets dry. Slice the rolls in half and place on serving plate. Pour the liquid over the bread and serve.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,salad oil,red bell pepper,parsley,puff pastry,roast beef
title: Roast Beef and Roasted Pepper Tartlets
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salad oil | 250 g roast beef, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh parsley | 1 sheet low fat puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Heat oil in a heavy based frying pan over high heat. Add beef, cook stirring until browned. Transfer to a larger bowl. Add red pepper, cardamom pod and parsley. Remove beef mixture from pan. Roll out between two pieces of lightly greased baking paper to approximately 40cm across and 5cm thick. Cut out and discard pastry on pastry with a knife. Place on a lightly greased baking tray. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until lightly golden. Serve warm.

title: Cheese With Paprika
ingredients: 2 -3 slices american cheese | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Sprinkle paprika on cheese. Microwave for 1 minute. Sprinkle with paprika. Microwave on medium for 2 minutes more. Remove from microwave and enjoy your breakfast.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,bulk italian sausage,peanut oil,cream chicken soup
title: Sausage Ramen
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: In a medium pan brown sausage, drain. Add soup. Pour oils in frypan. Heat all together, heat until very well mixed. Add sauteed sausage into soup. Do not add salt until finished add to soup mixture. Cook until hot. Note, i've found a microwave suggestion on making this in a deep fryer, for 1 minute instead of heating it.

title: Mama-Meil's Pisco Sour Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup pisco | 1/4 cup margarine | 3 tablespoons catalina cheese salad dressing | 3 teaspoons baby bok choy, finely chopped | 1/4 cup red pickled napa cheese ( i use cabot brand )
instructions: Combine cider vinegar, pisco, margarine, catina cheese salad dressing, bok choy and napa chille at top of a double boiler. Cook over high heat until hot and bubbly. Remove from heat, cover and refrigerate.

title: Mexican Spice Cigars, Flour, and Batter #5FIX
ingredients: 1 box frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Unroll frozen phyllo sheets in a 13x9 inch pan. Unroll phyllo sheets and cut in half lengthwise. Pierce with a fork in a crisscross pattern. Sprinkle with chili powder and bake 12 to 14 minutes until golden brown.

title: Green Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can chopped green tomatoes | 1 teaspoon chopped coriander ( cilantro )
instructions: Pour tomatoes and chopped coriander into a bowl. Chop until all ingredients are finely chopped and mix well. Serve chilled.

title: Guava Vermicelli in Agrodolce (Brazilian Cauliflower)
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower, trimmed and cut into florets | cooking spray | 1/3 cup icing sugar or 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 cup sour cake flour | 2 teaspoons cake flour | 2 scallions, sliced, white and green parts separated | 1 large ripe guava, halved and pitted | 1 tablespoon ice water | purchased cherry tomatoes, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray. In a medium size bowl, add the cauliflower, icing sugar or confectioner's sugar and sour cake flour. Stir. Add the thinly sliced white parts of the scallions. Spray cooking spray of your choice on the cauliflower mixture. Drain excess water off the cauliflower. Using a pastry knife, spread 1 teaspoon of the floured vegetable mixture on a baking sheet in a thin layer. Sprinkle evenly with 1/4 teaspoon of the flour mixture. Sprinkle evenly with 1 teaspoon of the chopped green part of the scallion. Top with sliced guava halves or canned tomato halves. Dot with an inch or two of water. Cover loosely with foil. Place in preheated oven. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until it is tender and has a very light coating of flour on top of the vegetables. Serve garnished with cherry tomatoes and slices of green olives. Serve with white spanish rice.

Random Ingredients: cherry,tilapia fillet,onion soup mix,bamboo skewer,shell pasta,chicken leg,topping,yellow pepper
title: Easy Jambalaya
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, skin on, cut in half | 12 skewers | 1 package dried small shell pasta | 1 bunch fresh cherries | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 large yellow pepper, cut into strips | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 package frozen large shrimp in syrup, thawed ( with juice )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Grease grill grate. Place chicken on grill. Season with salt and pepper. Grill until chicken is no longer pink in center. Remove chicken and let rest 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook pasta in large pot of boiling water until just tender. Drain. Place drained pasta in large bowl and toss with cherries and onions. Reserve juice. Spoon cooked chicken, cherry tomato juice and topping into each shell. Serve 1/2 cup reserved juice. Serve remaining juice and chopped green peppers over.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,cream mushroom soup,beef tenderloin steak,italian sausage,shallot,grape juice
title: Sausage and Beef Tenderloin With Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 2 links sweet italian sausage | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 shallot, chopped | 1 lb beef tenderloin steak, trimmed | 2 cups grape juice | dried mint leaves ( optional ) or fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves, sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Place sausage in a large nonstick skillet.

title: Lemon Herb Seasoning
ingredients: 3 small lemons | 3/4 cup dried thyme sprig, crumbled
instructions: Grate the zest from 1 lemon. Combine all ingredients, including the rind, cover, and chill in the refrigerator for 8 hours. Store in an airtight jar or jar in the refrigerator for up to six months.

Random Ingredients: pork belly,lamb loin chop,maraschino cherry,tomato puree,palm sugar
title: Lamb Leg Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb loin chops | 1 lb pork belly | 1 can tomato puree ( optional ) or ( 28 ounce ) can tomato puree ( optional ) | 1/3 cup palm sugar or 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1 cup maraschino cherry
instructions: Wash pork chops and put pork in bowl of cold water and soak overnight. In a large pot brown lamb then add tomato juice and sugar if using. Simmer for about one hour, then add cherries and cover. Simmer for a further 45 minutes. Remove bone and discard. Cut into thin slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: corn,heavy whipping cream,chervil,taco shell,red potato,madeira wine,thyme
title: Caramelized Potato With Corn and Madeira
ingredients: 4 small red potatoes or 1 1/2 lbs yellow potatoes | 1 1/8 - 1 1/4 lbs ears fresh corn, shucked, if large, cut away kernels | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup madeira wine ( more if you like a stronger cream ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chervil or 1 -2 tablespoon mint, sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon thyme | 6 taco shells, heated
instructions: Cut the corn off the cob and place in a medium sauce pan. Cover with cold water and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cook the corn until fork tender, about 3 - 4 minutes. Drain corn, rinse under cold water and reserve. In a large skillet over medium high heat, warm the cream. When it comes to a boil, add the madeira, chervil, thyme and corn and cook over medium high heat, stirring, until the cream almost comes to a boil. Add the corn to the cream and cook a few minutes until heated through. Spoon the cream mixture onto the warm taco shells and garnish with mint sprigs.

title: Steamed Belgian Beer With Peanuts (Steeg Salat)
ingredients: 10 ounces light soymilk | 1 vanilla pod, chopped | 4 -6 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 ounce stout beer | 2 -4 teaspoons fresh sage
instructions: In a double thickness of buttered bread or muffin tin, pour in the soymilk. Roughly chop the vanilla pod & reserve. Set aside. Brush the surface and sides of the bread or muffin tin lightly with a little oil. Scatter half of the vanilla into the oiled tin. Then place the stout & rest of the chopped ingredients over the top of the yogurt. Cover & steam over a stove top until quite thick & creamy. Remove from heat & serve.

title: Broccoli and Passion Fruit Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1/2 cup broccoli, finely chopped | 1/2 cup passion fruit | 1/2 cup orange zest, freshly grated ( may substitute 1 medium orange ) | 1 cup fresh sage, coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb phyllo dough | 1 1/2 cups fresh parsley, chopped ( italian, flat leaf )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees, then prepare your sheets by brushing generously with butter or oil. In a small mixing bowl, combine the broccoli, passion fruit, orange zest, sage and phyllo. Set aside. Use 3 sheets of filo, about 1 1/2 inches wide, and 10 inches long. Stack them as the sheets are stacked, top with a second sheet and repeat for the last piece, remembering that the sheets are stacked as you work. Repeat until you have used 1/3 of the sheets. Using a very sharp knife, cut the triangles diagonally across the top layer of phyllo and set aside. Place the phyllo sheets on a baking sheet, with the flat top removed. Brush generously with butter then bake until golden brown, 30 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,milk chocolate chip,baking chocolate square,active yeast,stewing beef,rice vinegar,salmon fillet,mustard
title: Aussie Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 cup milk chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/4 cup sweet mustard, plus | 1 teaspoon sweet pickled garlic relish | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 6 ounces salmon fillets, cut into 4 chunks | 6 ounces cubed semisweet baking chocolate shavings | 8 1/2 ounces smoked salmon fillets, cut across the grain into 1/2 strips
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over 1 cup of warm milk chocolate chips. Let stand 10 minutes. Stir in the vinegar, relish, worcestershire sauce and garlic. Add the 3 oz. Chocolate pieces to the milk chocolate mixture, stirring well to incorporate. Cover and let stand in a warm place until the chocolate is melting. Drain the salmon and reserve the juice. Stir the salmon and reserved liquid into the melted chocolate batter. In a greased 8 inch square, deep baking dish, stir the reserved salmon juice with the 1/4 cup chopped raisins. Scatter the salmon over the batter. Cover and let stand in a warm place until the salmon is set. Sprinkle with the chocolate shavings. Bake 450 degrees for 12 - 14 minutes or until top is lightly browned.

title: Tobleron's Empanadito Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef round | 8 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 4 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the baking powder to make a fine textured paste. Form mixture into ball and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400f for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Roasted Leeks
ingredients: 3 leeks, white and light green parts only, chopped | 2 teaspoons salad oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the leeks in a medium sized roasting pan with a lid or a foil bag. Roast in the preheated oven, stirring once or twice, until tender and starting to brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: turnip,pistachio,chicken broth,dark sesame oil,liquid smoke,hot pepper flake,white peppercorn
title: Smokey Yellow Turnip Soup
ingredients: 6 lbs turnips, peeled and cut into 3-inch pieces | 1 1/2 gallons chicken broth or 1 1/2 gallons homemade stock | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons whole white peppercorns | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 3 teaspoons crushed hot pepper flakes | chopped pistachios or cashews, to garnish
instructions: Cook the turnips in boiling, salted water for about 15 minutes until tender. Remove turnips & cut into 3 to 4 quart lengths, and set aside. Cook the stock in a large pot over medium heat until lightly reduced by half. Dump the turnips, then the dark sesame oil, peppercorns, sesame oil, liquid smoke & hot pepper flakes into the stock, and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Ladle into bowls, and garnish with pistachios or cashews. Note, turnips can be frozen after letting simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour. You can also cook for 45 minutes and add when you bring the soup to a boil to thicken.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,taco sauce,sugar cube,butter,red curry paste
title: Cheesy Red Curry Cheese Cube Topping for Corn Chip Casserole
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated fat free cheese-and-butter blend cheeses | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 packet taco seasoning, with or 3 -4 drops red curry paste ( more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In small saucepan melt the butter over low heat. Combine the taco mix with taco seasoning and hot pepper sauce. Add it to the butter mixture. Pour into a ungreased 13 x 9 baking dish that you coated the entire dish with the melted butter. Add the cheese cubes and blend with the taco sauce, mixing thoroughly. Sprinkle the cheese over top. Bake 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve warm with your favorite chips.

title: Spaghetti With Peas, Mustard, and Anise
ingredients: 6 ounces spaghetti | 2 ounces fresh green peas, shelled | 2 tablespoons grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon anise seed ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional )
instructions: In a large pan, cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water until it is just tender. Drain completely. While the pasta is cooking, in a small bowl, mix together the peas, mustard, and anise. Toss with remaining ingredients. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beer,chip,red wine vinegar,red bell pepper,yeast,dashi,ancho chile powder
title: Authentic Vinaigrette for Antipasti
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 red bell pepper | 0.5 can chipotle beer ( regular, guiness or whatever you have around ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh yeast | 1 cup beer, chilled | 5 cups dashi ( basic japanese-style fish stock ) ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the beer. Put the yeast mixture in a large plastic tub with the beer, bell pepper and chipotle. The beer helps dissolve the yeast. Let it proof in a warm place for about 2 - 3 hours. Strain the beer into a clean container and refrigerate overnight. The next day, bring the dashi to boil, remove from the heat, and mix in the beer with the yeast solution. Let it rest for at least 15 - 20 minutes before using the vinaigrette.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,pepper sauce,tart cherry,broth,basil,alfredo sauce,corn tortilla chip,fryer chicken
title: Easy Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 fryer chickens, cut up | 1 can alfredo sauce | 1 can broth | 1/2 cup corn tortilla chips | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 2 tablespoons dried tart cherries | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat combine chicken andfredo sauce, broth and seasonings. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and shred. Return soup to pot, bring to a boil and add chips, cherries and hot pepper sauce. Lower heat to low and mix in cheese until melted and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,grain white rice,white pepper,lump crabmeat,italian sausage,beef tenderloin,nutmeg,cashew nut
title: Stuffed Sole
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked short-grain white rice | 1 pound italian sausage | 1 pound beef tenderloin with skin | 1 pinch freshly grated nutmeg | 1 pound lump crabmeat, picked over | 1 pound cashew nuts | 6 tablespoons chopped italian parsley | ground white pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread the uncooked rice evenly onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, 25 to 30 minutes. Cook the sausage in a skillet over medium heat until the sausage is browned, about 5 minutes.

title: Nigerian Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 3 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 cup sweet chili sauce | 3 cups cooked rice
instructions: In a medium dish or resealable plastic bag, crush the anise seed with a meat mallet or rolling pin, or use kitchen shears to pound to a thickness of 1/8 inch. Add chicken and coat with spice blend and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, over medium heat, bring chili sauce to a boil, stirring often.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,taco seasoning mix,cherry,baking potato,harissa,egg yolk
title: Chicken Wings With Garlic Cherries, Taco Filling and Harissa Mash
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | 3/4 ounce of taco seasoning mix | 4 large baking potatoes | 6 egg yolks | 1/3 cup harissa | 1 cup dried cherries
instructions: Wash the wings and cut off any excess fat around the joints. Put chicken wings in a large saucepan and pour boiling water on top and leave for 5 - 10 minutes. Remove the chicken from the brine and wash the wings well. Chop the potatoes roughly and put them in a large bowl. Crack an egg into a large frying pan and beat with a fork until the volume quadruples. Add the taco seasoning and mix well. Add the chopped chicken and the potato to the egg along with some of the harissa. Mix everything well. Turn up the heat to medium high and cook for 30 - 40 mins. Toss the potato mixture around until the potatoes are coated evenly. Spread a third of the potato mix in the base of a large ovenproof dish and fill with the chicken wings. Repeat this procedure until the wings are all used up.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,red chili pepper,ramen noodle,ancho chile powder,black olive
title: Red Sauce With Oatmeal (Oamc)
ingredients: 225 g quick-cooking rolled oats or 225 g quick-cooking rolled oats | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 1 dried red chili pepper, seeds removed, finely chopped | 100 g sliced black olives or 100 g black olives | 1 packet top ramen noodles
instructions: Place the oats in a bowl with the chile powder and black olives. Stir to combine well. Scoop the seasoning mixture into shallow bowls and cover with plastic wrap to let the mixture rest for about 20 minutes. Drain the noodles and put in a large microwave safe dish. Pour the water in the microwave so that the noodles are half way submerged. Microwave on high power for 3 minutes.. Remove and stir. Serve. Variation, substitute dried birdseye flakes if ancho chile powder is unavailable.

Random Ingredients: cold water,red wine vinegar,palm oil,whipping cream,spice
title: Mixed Wine Vinegar and Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry red wine vinegar or 1 1/2 cups white wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups cold water | 2 cups granulated sugar | 2 teaspoons mixed spice ( cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves for a variation ) ( optional ) | 1 - 2 1/2 tablespoon whipping cream
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the vinegar and water and bring to a boil over medium heat or until slightly thickened or to your preferred thickness. Stir in the sugar. Add the mixed spice/nutmeg and return to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer until the liquid becomes syrupy, usually 30 - 40 minutes. Add cream to warm slowly and stir well. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: lipton onion soup mix,tahini,red chili paste,red potato,chihuahua cheese,pepper,coleslaw mix
title: Liptauer Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 bag coleslaw mix | 1 large chihuahua cheese | 1 package lipton onion soup mix | 1 red potato | 1/4 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons red chili paste | 1/4 cup red chili paste | pepper ( optional )
instructions: Boil the red potato in salted water until cooked. Drain, cool and dice into bite sized pieces. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the chopped potato and the cheeses. Cook until cheese is melted. Remove from heat. Drain off all the gummy stuff and toss with the onion soup mix. Dice the potato and add to the cheese mixture. Add 1/2 cup red chili paste and 3/4 cup tahini. Pour over the potato mixture and mix with a whisk to help it all get mixed. Chill for at least 30 minutes until it's chilled.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,ham,rye whiskey,coriander powder,broccoli,garam masala,pizza crust,lamb chop
title: Chop of Lamb Chops With Broccoli
ingredients: 600 g ready rolled pizza crusts, from a prepared crust made from your favourite pizza crust is 3cm / 4inch | 12 lamb chops | 5 ounces ham, chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 vanilla beans, split | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds and coriander, chopped | 4 tablespoons rye whiskey | 1 tablespoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c / 375°f / gas prepare the filling, in a small saucepan add poppy seeds, coriander, vanilla beans, whiskey and garam masala.

title: Chileon Crab Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb potato, peeled and diced | 12 ounces sweet potato, peeled and diced | 1 tablespoon dry fenugreek mint leaves | 3 tablespoons crisco | 1 cup chestnuts, cooked and diced | 12 ounces penne pasta | fresh mint leaves
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pan of rapidly boiling water, until al dente. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan. Add the sweet potato, fry for 3 minutes, stirring constantly, then add the mint leaves. Stir fry for 2 minutes, then add the crab and fry for 3 minutes, stirring and breaking up any clumped bits of food with a wooden spoon. Add the cooked pasta and sweet potato to the pan, stir thoroughly. Divide between two warmed serving plates, sprinkle with fresh mint leaves and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,green cabbage,snow pea pod,egg substitute
title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 medium head green cabbage, torn into bite-size pieces | 2 cups egg substitute | 1 1/2 cups italian style breadcrumbs | 1 package snow pea pods, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees, and lightly grease a 9x9 baking dish with cooking spray. Place a layer of cabbage in the baking dish with some water clinging to the leaves. Repeat with another layer of cabbage, then egg substitute, then bread crumbs. Repeat layers until finished dish, trimming off any extra water if necessary. Bake for 50 - 55 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,rom tomato,beef base,italian sausage,graham cracker crust,milk ricotta cheese,rhubarb
title: Ravioli Salmon Calzones
ingredients: 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 2 pounds fresh rutabagas, peeled | 1 pound rhubarb, stems removed, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 pounds salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon beef base | 16 graham crackers, rounds | 8 ounces frozen whole-milk ricotta cheese
instructions: Place sausage in a skillet with enough water to cover. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat, and cook until evenly brown. Drain. Cut rutabagas into 1/2 inch slices and zucchini into 1 inch pieces with a peeler. Set aside. In a large mixing bowl, mix together the rhubarb, rutabagas, rhubarb, and salmon. Season with beef base. Place 1 graham cracker round on each prepared graham cracker. Spread 1/2 ricotta mixture onto graham crackers. Roll the cracker dough around the filling to form crescents. Place onto a baking sheet, and freeze for 1 hour. Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove and cool.

Random Ingredients: white flour,egg noodle,sea salt,scallion,lemon zest,feta cheese,red bell pepper,butternut squash
title: Butternut Squash and Feta Noodles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sea salt or 1 tablespoon kosher salt, plus more as needed | 7 ounces egg noodles | 1 1/2 cups butternut squash, peeled, seeded, cubed | 1 small red bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1 ounce feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 - 3/4 cup scallion, chopped, including green tops | freshly grated lemon zest, to taste | white flour ( optional )
instructions: Cook the salt in a heavy saucepan of boiling water over moderate heat, stirring, until it smells fragrant, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. Stir the salt, egg noodles, squash, pepper, and feta in a large bowl to blend and then toss with salt until well combined. Cover and set aside at room temperature. Just before serving, sprinkle the vegetables with lemon zest and stir just to heat through, about 1 minute. Taste, then season with coarse sea salt and additional sea salt. Dish out the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,rice wine,curry,tilapia fillet,irish cream,bell pepper,cannellini bean,egg white
title: Tilapia Florentine
ingredients: 2 egg whites | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1 1/4 cups irish cream | 3/4 cup rice wine | 2 tablespoons curry | 4 tilapia fillets | 1 whole bell pepper
instructions: In a shallow dish combine egg whites, beans, tomato puree, irish cream, rice wine and curry. Add fish. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. To serve, place whole pepper on a piece of plastic wrap and place fish on it. Roll it up around the fish. Place plastic wrap on plate and garnish with additional bell pepper slices.

title: Super Easy Falafel
ingredients: 250 g chickpea flour | 1 red chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Mix chickpea flour and chilli. Take a bowl and make a depression in the middle of the flour for the filling, put the filling in, and then close the dough. Make sure that all the filling in the bowl is used and that the dough is completely sealed. Take the dough and make it into balls, roll out the balls until they are the size of a ping pong ball, place on a plate, and repeat on all the balls.

title: Simple Smoked Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 600 g smoked kielbasa | 1 can tomato paste | 3 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 jar pizza sauce
instructions: Put everything in a pan. Pour over water in a pan. Cook for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: nonfat plain yogurt,triple sec liqueur,sourdough bread
title: Granita Sourdough Croutons
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough bread | 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 cup triple sec liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Cut a slit in the center of the bread loaf about 1/2 inch deep. Set the loaf in the bowl of a food processor and pulse it until it becomes crumbly, about 15 crumbs. Stir in yogurt and liqueur. Drop in crumbs and toss until evenly coated. Transfer to baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden and crispy.

title: Harry Hildebrand's Chicken Liver (Danish)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken livers | 1 cup apple juice | 1 cup pecans, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Chop livers and place with enough apple juice to cover. In a dutch oven combine livers with any other ingredients. Cover and simmer until the liver is easily removed and there is no liquid left. Serve hot.

title: Frijoles a La Guajillo
ingredients: bouillon cube | 1 lb dried guajillo chile | 1 lb farfalle pasta
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions or until al dente. Drain well and return to hot pot along with the bouillon cube. Cook on low heat until hot all the way through and flavors blend. Taste and then adjust seasonings. Serve hot.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice ( basmati can also be used ) | 2 tablespoons chickpea flour ( or more ) | 2 teaspoons apple sesame seeds, toasted | 1 - 1 1/4 cup broccoli | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning, from the adobo sauce
instructions: Wash and rinse your rice so it's not too watery, then rinse it in cold water. Drain the rice, set it aside, and refrigerate overnight or for 10 minutes maximum. Combine the chickpea flour and apple sesame seeds in small bowl. Toss with your prepared steamed rice in this mixture and marinate overnight. In a large skillet heat up some oil. Toss in 1 - 2 handfuls of the steamed rice and add 1 cup of steamed rice to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until it becomes a nice, golden brown color. Add the broccoli and seasoning to taste and cook, stirring frequently, until it starts to soften. Turn off heat and serve.

title: Hot Chinese Spice Blend Substitute: Pickled Onions
ingredients: 2 onions, sliced super thin | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Heat chinese hot chili oil in a small skillet, add onions and stir. Lower heat and cover for 10 minutes stirring often. Remove from heat and place on baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle with nutmeg, pressing in well and cool. Slice again into thin thin slivers. Store in a screw top jar.

Random Ingredients: bacon,cornstarch,hot red pepper flake,mexican cheese,kalamata olive,oregano leaf,lemon zest
title: Cornstarch Crumbles With Warm Spicy Olives
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, diced | 2 packages mexican blend cheese, shredded ( or your favorite ) | 2 ounces crumbled bacon, cooked and chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest
instructions: Combine cornstarch and hot pepper flakes in a heavy small saucepan. Stir well. Add olives and cheese. Stir well until cheese melts. Mix in bacon, oregano, lemon zest and heat to warm. Do not boil. Serve warm. Note, you can make a larger crumb or even a larger casserole if desired. If this is too small for your liking, use the back of a spoon. Scoop up with a small spoon and serve as desired.

title: Sue's Macaroni Grill Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1 package linguine ( you may need up to 3/4 of a bottle if mac & cheese are salty ) | 8 ounces bulk mild italian sausage | 3/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 1/2 - 3/4 cup buttermilk | 1 pinch saffron ( optional ) | 1 pinch grated nutmeg | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large saucpan, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink. While sausage is cooking, stir together all other ingredients in a large bowl. Add sifted cooked pasta, sausage, and chives to bowl. Mix well. Pour mixed mixture into ungreased 3 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with additional grated cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes.

title: Shrimp and Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1 teaspoon rosemary leaf, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs small raw shrimp ( shelled, deveined and finely chopped ) or 1 1/2 lbs medium raw shrimp ( shelled, deveined and finely chopped ) | 1/2 cup green onion, chopped | 1 can baked beans, drained and rinsed well
instructions: Put the sugar and rosemary in a skillet over medium heat and gently toast for 1 - 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Increase heat to high and cook a further 2 - 3 minutes or until sugar is caramelised. Add the shrimp or shrimp and cook for 1 minute or until lightly coloured. Remove from heat and stir in the green onions. Toss with toasted sugar mixture. Serve warm or cold.

title: Salsa Di Tonno E Alentejana (Mixed Shrimp)
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, cooked, peeled, and halved | 1/3 cup pine nuts, chopped, toasted | 1/2 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 tablespoon sesame mustard | 1/2 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 package tostadas
instructions: In medium bowl combine shrimp, pine nuts, ginger garlic paste, sesame mustard, and vanilla. Toss well. Place 1 to 3 t. Of mixture on shrimp mixture. Roll tightly. Arrange on platter. Sprinkle with tostadas.

Random Ingredients: yeast,fontina cheese,puff pastry,vegetable oil cooking spray,rice,cream,coconut rum
title: Rice Puffs on the Grill
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 envelopes yeast | 1 packet frozen puff pastry, thawed and sliced into 24 pieces | 1/3 cup coconut rum | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese | 2 cups cooked rice
instructions: Heat a griddle or frypan until smoking. Spray pan with veggie oil spray, and place flour on the griddle. Roll out puff pastry rounds, and place them on the oiled griddle. Brown puff pastry on both sides, and remove from grill while preparing the rest of the ingredients. To assemble, place one piece of puff pastry on a cutting board, brush with egg or water, and top with 1/4 cup of rum, and top with 2 tablespoons of sour cream. Repeat with the second piece of puff pastry, and brush with egg, or water, and top with 1 1/4 cups of sour cream, 2 tablespoons of coconut rum, 2 tablespoons of fontina, 1/2 cup of rice, and 1/2 cup of sour cream. Roll up towards the edges, and set aside. Repeat with remaining dough, and freeze for 1 hour or up to 3 months. Place frozen puff pastry rolls onto a baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 400 degree oven for about 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Rudy's Avocado Ginger Vodka Pizza (Copycat)
ingredients: 2 avocados, pitted ( peeled, halved and peeled ) | 2 tablespoons coarse yellow cornmeal | 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh gingerroot ( minced ) | 1 1/2 cups vodka ( chilled )
instructions: In a food processor, process all of the ingredients until smooth, 1 - 2 minutes or until well incorporated. Transfer to a nonstick baking sheet. Refrigerate while preparing your pizza dough. Preheat the oven to 425°f. Form the chilled dough onto a well floured surface. Roll out to fit a pizza sheet. Using a rolling pin, gently press the dough out to the size of your pizza pan's bottom. Brush the entire surface with the vodka. Bake for 14 - 16 minutes. Remove from oven and drizzle a little more vodka over the crust. Let it rest for 3 - 5 minutes before slicing..

title: Quick and Easy Greens
ingredients: 10 ounces mixed greens | 2 teaspoons nonfat dry milk powder
instructions: Wash and drain greens. Add just enough water to just cover the greens. Bring to a boil and immediately remove from heat, but stir just enough to separate greens from water. Drain greens in a colander, allowing liquid to drip through. Rinse with cold running water until all water has drained out. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Prepare a steamer or sauce pan with a lid, set it on steam. Place greens, cut side down, on steamer. Cover and steam 10 minutes, or until greens have wilted to your desired texture and are tender. Mix and serve immediately.

title: Chinese Vanilla Rice Balls (Tao Tome)
ingredients: 1 lb short-grain rice or 1 lb pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 celery rib, cut in 1/4 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean paste
instructions: Soak the rice in cold water for about 2 days. Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and process until a smooth paste forms. Scrape down the sides of the blender as needed. If the rice is moist but slightly sticky, add water a bit at a time. If the rice is too dry, add water a tablespoon at a time until a soft, sticky dough is formed. Refrigerate until cold.

title: Turnip Dal
ingredients: 250 g turnips, peeled and sliced | 250 g red lentils | 1 bunch fresh parsley, finely chopped | 200 g smoked gouda cheese, grated | 250 g cream cheese or 250 g mascarpone cheese | 3 fresh green chili, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Boil the lentils for 15 minutes, or until al dente. Rinse well in a sieve. Mix in the parsley, gouda, and cream cheese, and chill.

title: French Onion Soup II
ingredients: 2 pounds beef top round beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can beef consomme | 2 vanilla beans | 1 loaf brioche bread, with crusts
