instructions: Place the beef, consomme, and vanilla beans in a separate pot over medium heat. Simmer for about 20 minutes. Turn off heat, and allow to cool and set. Cut bread into 1 cubes, and toss in to the soup. Return to heat and serve. This makes a lot of soup, so it will serve a lot.

title: Sriracha Apricot Curry
ingredients: 1/3 cup apricot, finely diced | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 4 maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large zip top plastic bag and let marinate for at least an hour. Heat over medium heat until curry is fragrant, about 3 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: browning sauce,kidney bean,garlic powder,chili paste,beef bouillon granule
title: Homemade Wet Beans
ingredients: 1 package dry kidney beans | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon browning sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: To make the sauce, in a saucepan over medium heat, mix the bouillon granules, chili paste, browning sauce, and garlic powder. Stir in the beans until coated with the sauce. Cover, and simmer 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,horseradish sauce,ginger,apricot,hot italian sausage
title: Cajun Sausages (Stove Top or Crock)
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot italian sausage, cut into 4 pieces | 1/4 cup apricot, chopped | 2 tablespoons horseradish sauce | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, chopped | 2 cups self rising flour
instructions: In a small skillet, combine the sausage, apricots, horseradish sauce and ginger. Bring to a boil, then cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes. Pour into a bowl and cool for 1 - 2 hours or overnight. Stir in the flour to form a firm dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface.. Roll out dough until 1/8 inch thick. Cut out sausage shapes. Reroll scraps and cut out more sausages. Cook on a greased griddle or fryer or fryer in a little fat for about 3 - 5 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Serve with your favourite topping, sauce or vegetables.

title: Kafta
ingredients: 1 kg broad beans | 1 large onion | 1 bunch dill or 1 bunch coriander ( or to taste, we use coriander and not dill and we prefer dill )
instructions: Wash and clean the broad bean or use shelled broad beans. Boil the broad beans in plenty of water. Keep checking to make sure they're cooked, if they look dry add more water. You should not be able to see any blood underneath. When cooked add a pinch of salt to taste. Grate finely the onion. Mix well with the broad beans. Eat with bread and butter.

Random Ingredients: pea,pineapple chunk juice,soya sauce,red curry paste
title: Simple Pineapple Peanut Soup
ingredients: 500 g pineapple chunks in juice | 400 g red curry paste | 150 -180 ml soya sauce | 250 -450 g split peas
instructions: Cut the pineapple chunks into cubes and place in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the red curry paste and bring to a boil. Add the soya sauce and simmer. Add the split peas after 15 minutes.

title: Dhal
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried lentils ( or green lentils ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3 tablespoons toasted ground pecans or 3 tablespoons ground almonds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy pan. Bring to boil. Cover, reduce heat, and let simmer for about half an hour. Remove from heat, and allow to stand about 10 minutes, or until the lentils are cooked.

title: Quick and Easy Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 5 pounds round steak, or more to taste
instructions: Mix dry mustard powder with mustard powder in a shallow metal bowl, stirring to dissolve the powder. Place 1 pound of meat at a time into the powder mixture. Toss to evenly coat. Cover the bowl, and refrigerate the meat in an airtight container for at least 8 hours and up to 1 week before cooking as desired. Set the oven rack 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Arrange the coated meat on a baking sheet. Broil meat with the edges of the meat slightly to the center in the preheated oven. Broil meat 8 minutes per side, until browned and internal temperature is at least 160 degrees f. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees f. Be careful not to overcook as this will cause the meat to become tough. Remove meat from oven, and allow to rest for 5 minutes.

title: Real Spanish Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh sirloin, trimmed of all visible fat
instructions: Cut the steak into 6 portions. Arrange them on a rack or large heavy duty foil. Place foil in refrigerator. Allow to marinate for 12 to 48 hours. To make a rub, rub the surface of the grill with a spice or a shortening and cut the steak lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. This way they stay fresh for a few minutes on each side. When ready, put a plate on the side of the grill so as not to eat them too quickly. Place the slices of steak over the rack and cook indirectly over direct low heat, turning several times, until they are a deep, rich colour all over and very tender, 12 to 15 minutes total. To keep the steak warm, place the foil covered grill under a preheated broiler. Grill 6 to 10 minutes, or just until browned. Brush lightly with the pan juices or with the reserved glaze. Serve immediately. You can eat the sliced steaks warm or at room temperature the way they are usually served, but you can arrange them in a roaster and brush with the pan juices to make a gravy or a bouquet garni. A béchamel sauce made from browning the leftover meat in a pan over medium heat. This makes a lovely gravy that is delicious but can be served chilled and reheated. You can serve it cold, if preferred.

title: Crazy French Bread Salad - Microwave
ingredients: 2 cups french bread, cut in half lenghtwise | 1 cucumber | 1/3 cup light molasses | 1/3 cup fresh chives, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons green onions, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 3 quart microwavable casserole dish. Microwave on high power for 6 minutes. Uncover.

title: Italian Tuna and Quinoa Skillet
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons golden raisins | 14 1/2 ounces tuna in water, drained ( about 6 cans ) | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh italian parsley or 2 tablespoons cilantro, divided ( plus extra for garnish ) | 1 cup hot cooked quinoa, rinsed and drained | 3 cups cooked pinto beans
instructions: In a large skillet or wok, toast the raisins until they begin to jump. Remove from heat and set aside. Pour the tuna into the skillet, scatter the parsley over, then sprinkle the tuna with the raisins. Stir to combine. Top the tuna with the quinoa. Add the pinto beans, the reserved raisin mixture and 1/2 tablespoon salt. Stir to combine and heat through, about 4 minutes. Garnish with cilantro.

title: Chocolate Cucumber Slice for a BBQ
ingredients: 1 cucumber, peeled and cut into 1/2 cm slices | 1/2 cup crisp barbeque sauce ( we used kikkoman ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 teaspoons crisco, melted
instructions: Cut cucumber into thirds and then into 1cm thick slices on a cutting board and then finely grate the cucumber using the fine holes of a grater. Add the barbeque sauce, vanilla essence and crisco and mix together well. Spoon the mixture into the base of a shallow glass ramekin or gratin dish and smooth it out. The mixture can then be frozen or canned for upto 2 months to solidify. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Vanilla Bean Paste
ingredients: 200 g sultanas | 1 - 1 1/2 vanilla bean, scraped
instructions: Put the sultanas into a blender with 150ml water and the vanilla bean scrapings. Pulse until smooth. Transfer to a bowl and stir in the flavourings. Store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,tomato green chilies,chicken stock
title: Simple Crock Pot Carne Guisada
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef stew meat | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock
instructions: Drain excess liquid from stew meat and place in crock pot with diced tomatoes. Drain chicken stock in a gravy pan and add to crock pot. Cook on high for 7 to 8 hours and on low for 6 to 8 hours. Add chicken stock last 15 minutes of cooking.

Random Ingredients: king oyster mushroom,parsley flake,tomato sauce,phyllo pastry,serrano chilies
title: Chile Pepper Samosas
ingredients: 10 serrano chilies or 10 ancho chilies | 15 toothpicks or 10 phyllo pastry sheets, thawed if frozen | 16 ounces tomato sauce | 1 package king oyster mushrooms, sliced | 1/3 cup parsley flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees, wrap chiles in aluminum foil and bake until soft, turning over once halfway through. Remove from oven and wrap the chiles in the reynolds wrap non aluminum foil. Place, seam side up, onto the dehydrator’s rack and dehydrate. After about 30 minutes, remove chiles from oven and unwrap carefully. Using metal spatula, scrape off the black bits from the bottom. Chop coarsely and place into a large bowl. Drain any water from mushrooms and add to bowl with chile mixture and mix well. Stir in tomatoe sauce. On a lightly floured board, place 2 sheets of phyllo and brush with water. Cut remaining sheets with a biscuit cutter. Spread 2/3 cup of tomatoe sauce on dough and cover with 2 sheets of phyllo and lightly brush with water. With dampened fingertips and the back of a glass, lightly rub around the edge to completely cover the phyllo and to prevent it from drying out. Repeat steps 7 - 7 and process 3 five more times. Place onto parchment or wax paper and place in oven for 10–15 minutes. To serve, arrange on platter and drizzle with any of your favourite toppings or a sweet and sour sauce. Can also be served with pita breads, fresh salsa, or whatever else floats your taggy. I have used both of these and really enjoy these great samosas.

title: Oyster Shooters
ingredients: 16 large olives | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce with chipotle peppers ( chipotle seasoning ) | 2 cans oysters, shucked ( or 2 cans other dark beer like corona or tecate )
instructions: Preheat grill to high or preheat broiler. Rinse the olives well with cold water. Cut each olive in half.

title: Fluffy Rice Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups glutinous-rice flour | 1 1/3 cups bread flour | 1 cup glutinous rice flour | 2 cups water ( or if needed more, more ) | 2 tablespoons rosemary or 2 tablespoons sage
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and process until the mixture forms a firm dough. If dough is too wet, add more bread flour, one teaspoon at a time. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for a minute or two. Wrap dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Line a baking sheet and set aside. Cut dough in half, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Remove dough from refrigerator, uncover and shape into a cylinder about 2 inches in diameter. Twist the end at one end to form a ring. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bake pastry for 15 - 20 minutes, until puffed and golden, and tender if desired. While hot, warm through and serve.

title: Low Fat Wasabi Pasta
ingredients: 300 g pasta | 1 tablespoon cornflour or 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons irish cream | 1 tablespoon wasabi powder | 1 cup asiago cheese
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until 'al dente'. Drain and return to pan. Stir the cornflour into the wasabi and add to pasta with the wasabi mixture. Dilute the cheese and add to sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella,tomato paste,asparagus spear,brown sugar,almond extract,herbes de
title: Tomato Asparagus and Fresh Herbs
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh asparagus spear ( or 4-5 spears of cooked asparagus ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon brown sugar, packed | 1/2 teaspoon herbes de provence ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon herbs of your choice ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract or 1/8 teaspoon extract | 1/8 whole almond ( optional )
instructions: Using a large skillet or griddle pan, sear asparagus for 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until desired crispness. To serve, place 3 or 4 asparagus spears on a platter with tomato paste, brown sugar, pepper, herbes de provence, and almond extract. Sprinkle with whole almond. Serve immediately and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,cooking oil,stir fry vegetable,apricot preserve,sunflower seed
title: Quick and Easy Apricot Nuts
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 package frozen stir fry vegetables | 6 sunflower seeds | 1 jar apricot preserves | cooking oil
instructions: Rinse the vegetables well under warm water and pat dry with paper towel. Remove any tough stems and separate the green leaves if desired. Place the vegetable oil in a large skillet with a lid and warm over medium heat. Add in the frozen cook veggies and stir fry for about two minutes. Scatter in the sunflower seeds and allow to cool slightly. Place the apricot preserves in a large mixing bowl and pour the vegetable and sunflower mixture over the fruits. Cover and blend until the sauce is slightly creamy. Serve immediately.

title: Frog Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 eggplant, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can evaporated milk | 2 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: In a medium pot over medium heat, mix together the corn oil, eggplant and evaporated milk. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour, stirring regularly, until eggplant is very tender. Mix constantly so not to let the liquid burn. Stir once or twice. Remove from heat. Mash with a potato masher. Stir in rum. Serve hot.

title: Chinese Cabbage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon savory | 10 cups chinese cabbage
instructions: Preheat the oven for the first 4 ingredients to cook. Cut the cabbage into 2 or 3 inch strips and place in a colander with the catsup, savory and cabbage. Stir to mix in the catsup and cabbage. The cabbage should be thoroughly coated with the sauce. Put this into a roasting pan or pan. Cover with aluminum foil, then bake at 200 or 475 degrees f for 6 to 10 hours, basting occasionally. The cabbage can be served hot or cold.

title: Homemade Cheese or Cheese Filling
ingredients: 1 cup liquid milk powder ( not powdered )
instructions: Place in a pan, or a glass jar container with a well fitting lid or sealable container, and set it aside.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,mango,coriander root,poblano chile,canadian bacon,celery seed,belgian endive,garlic
title: Crocodile (Endive and Canadian Bacon Salad)
ingredients: 3 heads belgian endive, halved | 1/4 cup canadian smoked bacon, finely chopped | 4 stalks celery seeds | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander root | 1/2 package taco seasoning mix | 1 mango, diced | 1 poblano chile, seeded and diced
instructions: Preheat oven broiler. Arrange endive on a baking sheet. Broil 5 to 7 inches from heat source, 1 to 2 minutes, or until beginning to turn tender. Remove from heat and cut into quarters. Cut remaining endive into 2 to 3 wedges, and remove stems. Stir bacon, celery seeds, garlic, coriander root, and taco seasoning mix into endive. Spread salsa evenly onto the broiled endive. Sprinkle mango and poblano chiles around the top of cheese. Place on a rimmed baking sheet. Place under broiler and broil 15 to 20 minutes, until bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Rhubarb and Arugula Salad With Chunky Salsa
ingredients: 500 g rhubarb, tough stalks removed, cut into small pieces | 150 g arugula | 150 g chunky salsa, medium ( your preferred ) | 150 ml double cream | 1 white onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Cook rhubarb in a large saucepan uncovered for 5 minutes, until tender. Meanwhile, place arugula in a large serving bowl. Scatter with salsa and rhubarb and stir well. Heat cream in a small frying pan until just beginning to simmer. Add onion and mustard to cream and gently bring to simmering point without allow to boil. Divide between 4 serving plates and pour over dressing.

title: Pizza-Tomato Polenta
ingredients: 2 cups polenta | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pour the polenta into a 9x13 inch pan. Press polenta into the pan. Pour tomato juice over polenta. Place in the over, and bake for 45 minutes, or until polenta is bubbly.

title: Pizza Sauce (Kway Teow)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 small dried white onion | 2 packages refrigerated pizza dough | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( sambal oelek )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the oil with enough water to make a thin thin paste. Add onions to the water. Let rise for at least 10 minutes. Roll each packet of pizza dough out on floured counter to 5 x 7 inch. Put filling into center of dough and fold dough over it. Turn dough over a few times for even coverage. Roll dough with rolling pin until it's about 1/2 inch thick. Put on oiled baking sheets and place in oven at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 15 minutes. Serve with warm homemade tomato salsa and chutney.

title: Hazelnut Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 lb hazelnuts, roasted and skins removed | 12 slices pepperoni
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut hazelnuts in half, and remove the hard bottom layer. Break up the hazelnuts into pieces, and spread them on a plate to dry out. Cut slices of pepperoni on the diagonal, then set onto a cookie sheet in one layer. Broil until hot and just lightly colored, 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Hotpot
ingredients: 2 large pork legs or 2 large smoked pork legs | bamboo shoot, sliced, in chunks, in pieces
instructions: Slice all into two pieces of equal size parts. You can cut into a rectangle with strips or slices. Add meat onto a greased or parchment lined baking pan. Bake at 200 - 400 degrees, cut into thirds with a mandoline or heavy knife. You can cook in a frying pan over medium high heat, so watch it closely or else they can burn your hands. The meat will start to brown at this point. This allows you to cook the meat more easily. When you see little bubbles on the bottom of the pan, or you see that the meat is drying off, your meat is done. Remove the pan from the heat. When most of the chunks are left of the meat, remove most of them. They may stick to the pan. When the meat is done, you can scrape off the grease or oil using the edge of your spoon or kitchen shears. To serve, serve warm with green salad or fried onions. Serve warm or cold.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 12 large strawberries ( washed, drained and chilled ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1 cup romaine lettuce ( leaf torn )
instructions: Cut the strawberries into 1/4 inch slices. Using a blender or violets, combine the strawberries and vanilla essence. Blend until smooth. Add a few teaspoons ice cold water if needed to help stop the mixture from clumping together. To serve, place a few lettuce leaves over 1/2 cup of the strawberry mixture.

title: Moroccan Spiced Peanuts
ingredients: 250 g dry roasted peanuts, in wholemeal, preferably greek-style skins ( see note below ) | 400 g green olives, pitted | 300 g roasted pistachios, roughly chopped | 1 chipotle pepper | 1 piece dried yeast, sachet dried yeast, see note below | 250 g roasted chilies, roughly chopped | 50 g roasted hazelnuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Dry fry the peanuts in a heavy small frying pan over medium heat, stirring regularly, until light golden brown and crisp. Remove and set aside. If not yet used, toast the black chilies in a dry frying pan over medium heat for about 3 minutes or until they turn pale golden and give off a nutty aroma. Cool slightly, then chop finely. Dissolve the dried yeast in 15 ml of warm water. Using a mortar and pestle or a food processor, grind the chilies and pistachios with the dried yeast. Add them to the peanuts in the frying pan along with the chipotle puree, the hazelnuts and the peanuts. Pour over the hot nuts and stir for 3 – 4 minutes – or until everything is well combined. If the spiced peanut nuts have not become absorbed by the nuts, cover loosely and set aside for about 15 minutes or until they are, ummer and crunchy again, at least, moist but not wet enough. Note 1, if they are used, they should be eaten at room temperature, but not warm or at room temperature and should not be allowed to become rancid. Note 2, if the nuts are eaten while still wet, cool and proceed to make the second spiced peanut recipe as well as the final spiced nuts and the hazelnuts. Notes 3 – for a spiced nut nut, add 1 tbsp of ground cinnamon, the minced or pulverized dried spices, and 1 tbsp of ground cardamom. Note 4, if the nuts are used, place in a bowl and add a good pinch of crushed or ground cloves and/or a little freshly ground black pepper. Note 5, if they can not be eaten, you may use a mild chile like arbol or jalapeno. Note 6, for a hot spicy nut, add 1/8 tsp of ground cumin.

title: Chicory Stuffed Papaya
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and chopped | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon papayas, drained and chopped ( use your discretion, i like it spicier! )
instructions: Using a melon baller or small scoop of the cream cheese, carefully scoop out the pulp from the center. You will also use a small scoop to scoop out the seeds. Use your hands to fill the center of the papaya pulp so that it has an inch or two border around the edges of the papaya. Try to find a clear line through the opening. It may take a little effort, but it will eventually eventually do. Fill the scooped out papaya with the cream cheese and sprinkle with papaya cheese. If desired, sprinkle papaya cheese on top and pop a toothpick through. Slice into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,kosher salt,italian parsley,liquid honey,sirloin steak,rom tomato,almond,new potato
title: Beef Stew With Almonds
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 cup sliced almonds | 1 lb tiny new potato, halved | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 roma tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup sliced pitted salted roasted almonds, halved | 1 tablespoon liquid honey
instructions: Sprinkle steaks with 1/2 tsp salt over beef, then place in slow cooker. Top with remaining ingredients, cover, and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, or until stew is tender. Before serving, stir parsley into stew and drizzle with honey.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,baby carrot,tomato green chilies,beef bouillon cube,walnut,pepitas,cinnamon,soy sauce
title: Mexican-Style Marinated Beef With Green Chilies
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless sirloin steak, trimmed | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, undrained | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 beef bouillon cube, made with 1/2 cup water | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 10 fresh pepitas, halved ( about 12 ounces ) | 2 lbs baby carrots, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 can artichoke hearts, rinsed drained | 3/4 cup fresh walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place beef in medium nonmetal dish. Add remaining ingredients except pepitas, carrots and artichokes. Cover. Let marinate at least 3 hours and up to 24 hours. Preheat grill. Using meat pounder, or very heavy skillet, slice meat diagonally across grain into thin slices about 1/4 inch wide. Thread onto metal skewers about 1 inch apart. Grill over hot coals 4 from heat until meat just starts to turn a rich, evenly browned surface, turning once, about 4 minutes per side.. During last 1 minute of grilling time, sprinkle with walnuts. Serve hot with green salad.

Random Ingredients: english muffin,scallion,broth,cumin seed,hickory barbecue sauce,golden syrup
title: Western Beef Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups hot hickory barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 4 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 lb ground sirloin steak | 1/4 cup scallion, chopped | 1/4 cup broth | 3 english muffins, toasted
instructions: In small bowl, stir together barbecue sauce, and cumin until well blended. Stir in ground sirloin and scallions, and refrigerate at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours. Preheat grill to high. Shape beef mixture into 8 patties with 3 - 4 inch diameter meaty sides on one side. Arrange on grill, close lid, and cook for 7 - 10 minutes or until cooked through. Serve burgers on toasted toasted english muffins.

title: Philly Cheesecake Cracker Mix - Microwave Recipe
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs and pepper in the bowl of a standing mixer and mix on high until combined. Add the black pepper and mix again until moistened, about 1 minutes. Pour in a greased 9x9 cake pan. Microwave on high for 1 minute, stopping to stir halfway through. Let it cool to touch.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,risotto rice,raspberry,oyster sauce,mango chutney,mint,tomato paste,dark sesame oil
title: Steak With Raspberries and Raspberries Stuffed With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin tip roast, about | 2 cups raspberries | 4 tomatoes | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon sweet mango chutney | 2 tablespoons unsalted dry-roasted sun-dried tomatoes | 8 1/2 ounces risotto rice
instructions: Cook the sirloin tip on a rack in a roasting pan or on a rack set over a baking pan. Let cool for 15 minutes. Use a knife to prick the meat all over. Remove from the pan and slice into 1/2 inch slices. Cut the tomato into chunks. Toss together the raspberries, tomatoes and mango chutney in a bowl. Heat the sesame oil and sun dried tomoto paste in a wok or wide, deep skillet over high heat for 30 seconds. Add the seasoned sirloin and fry until medium rare, about 3 minutes. Cut the meat diagonally in pieces 1 inch wide, then add to the tomato mixture and stir fry for a few more seconds. Spread a little pomegranate sauce or mango chutney on each plate and place the meat on top.

title: Herbed Herbed Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves ( optional )
instructions: Cut baguette diagonally into six 1 inch thick slices, allowing at least one side of each slice to stand on one end of the loaf with the loaf at the bottom. Arrange each bread slice on a cookie sheet and top with an airtight container. In an electric blender, combine thyme leaves, if using, or 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, about 1/4 teaspoon of salt.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,canadian bacon,lettuce leaf,pico de gallo,adobo seasoning,self raising flour
title: Vegan Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 1/4 cup canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pickle slices ( canned or fresh ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable substitute ( optional ) | 3/4 cup lettuce leaf | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning ( more or less depending on your taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c. Line a pizza tray with baking paper. Put the flour, canadian bacon, jalapeno pickle slices and veggie if using in a bowl, then stir in the adobo seasoning. Knead until dough is elastic and doesn’t stick to hands. Roll out into a circle big enough to enclose the pickle. Cut into 3 - 4 wedges. Arrange the wedges onto the baking tray. Bake for about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,rice,seasoning mix,arugula leaf,pandan leaf,pepperoni,lemon juice zest
title: Lemon Rice Balls
ingredients: 12 -14 small fresh arugula leaves ( about 20 to 24 large lettuce leaves or 4 large bunches ) | 3/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning mix | 3/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 2 cups cooked rice, chilled, about 1 cup liquid reserved | 2 tablespoons finely shredded fresh nori seaweed rounds or 2 tablespoons other asian-style dry breadcrumbs | 1 ripe banana, peeled, cut lengthwise into 6 slices
instructions: Rinse the spinach and pat dry. Using damp hands, scoop out and discard the thick, tender leaves. Cut the leaves into 1 inch squares. Place the rice in a medium bowl. Gradually stir the bread crumbs, lemon juice, seasoning mix and pepper in a small bowl. Add half of the rice to the bread crumb mixture and toss to lightly moisten. Transfer the rice mixture to a pastry bag fitted with a 1/4 inch oval tip. Add the remaining rice and spread it around the edge of the nori® square to form a 6 inch round. Add the banana slices to the rice circle. Spread the reserved rice mixture on top of the banana slices and press the bread crumbs into the rice mixture to moisten. Sprinkle the top layer with the nori® square and press with the bottom and top crust, making sure the bread crumbs are evenly toasted. Slice the top crust off top crust and press out any remaining bread crumbs. Slice the loaf into 4 - 1 wide strips, leaving 3 inches of breaded bread on each. Serve warm.

title: Cherry and Scallop Kabobs
ingredients: 12 -18 scallops | 9 -10 cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Using your hands or kitchen shears, cut each tomato in half and remove stems. Cut scallops lengthwise in half and arrange on skewers. Place cherry tomatoes on skewers. Sprinkle with ketchup and brown sugar. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or up to 2 days. Broil or grill until scallops are opaque and sauce is bubbling.

title: Pete's Gluten Free Vodka
ingredients: 1 liter vodka | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Pour the vodka into a large glass jar with an airtight lid and mix to dissolve the vodka liqueur. Seal and shake well. Mix the xanthan gum into the vodka. Pour vodka mixture into a clean jar and shake well. Store in a dark, cool place.

title: Watermelon, Chili Sauce, and Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon sesame oil ( optional ) | 4 cups watermelon - cubed | 1/4 cup pastas | 1 large red pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons pasta sauce | 4 cups ketchup, or as needed | 1/4 cup chopped radishes
instructions: Heat chili oil and sesame oil in a large wok over high heat. Cook and stir watermelon cubes in hot oil and sesame oil until flesh is completely opaque, about 2 minutes. Slice watermelon cubes to desired thickness. Drain watermelon, then cut flesh and watermelon meat into cubes. Whisk pasta sauce and ketchup together in a large bowl until ketchup is no longer cloudy. Add watermelon and red pepper to the bowl with pasta mixture.

title: The Best Fajita Melt ever!
ingredients: 1 pita bread, loaf | 1 tablespoon sofrito sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the two pita halves on a foil lined baking sheet. Broil the pita until lightly puffed, about 2 - 3 minutes. In a medium bowl, mix the sofrito with the worcestershire. Spread the hot mixture on the tops of the pita halves to create a 'well'. Return the pita 'bread' to the broiler until lightly browned. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,kosher salt,sauza silver tequila,steak,orange juice,lemonade,purpose flour
title: Zesty Beef Cocktail
ingredients: 2 ounces sauza silver tequila | 1 ounce chicken wings | 1 ounce steak, chopped | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 ounce orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | steak roll, for garnish
instructions: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice. Cover with 1 oz. Of the julienned steak, and add tequila & club soda. Shake and strain into 2 martini glasses. Top with orange juice, kosher salt and remaining steak. Top with a roll, and garnish with a slice of cocktail rye if desired.

Random Ingredients: yellow lentil,dark soy sauce,asafoetida powder,celery seed,herb,beef brisket
title: Asian Sausages
ingredients: 2 teaspoons black mixed herb or 3/4 teaspoon mixed spice | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce ( ketjap manis preferred ) | 2 teaspoons yellow lentils, dry, rinsed | 2 lbs beef brisket
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f in small bowl, combine the rub ingredients. Trim off all of the fat from the meat and rub the meat with the rub. Marinate, covered and chilled, for 6 - 8 hours or overnight. When ready to cook, lay the meat on your work surface.

title: Chinese Pork Tenderloin With Snow Peas and Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 english cucumber, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 parsnips, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package fresh snow peas
instructions: Prepare pork tenderloin according to package directions. Place in a large baking dish, sprinkle with cucumber, parsnips, and snow peas. Toss to coat.

title: Riz Con Leche (Red Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage, sliced crosswise into strips about 2-inch long | 1/4 cup rice wine | 2 whole cloves | 1 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed
instructions: Prepare a steamer basket with 6 1/2 cups of hot water in the bottom.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,button mushroom,olive oil,spring onion,buckwheat flour,tabasco sauce,cardamom seed,cream chicken soup
title: Kesra
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon grated spring onion | 1 teaspoon finely chopped pickled serrano pepper | 1 can whole button mushrooms | 1 can soup ( campbell fair beef free, reduced sod ) | 1/3 cup cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 3 -4 tablespoons buckwheat flour
instructions: Heat oil in large non stick fry pan on medium low. Add onion, peppers, mushrooms, soup, cardamon and sherry. Cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 8 minutes. Stir in flour until mixture is smooth and thick. Heat until soup has thickened. Add stock and tabasco and bring to boil. Cook soup for 1 - 2 minutes. Serve over plain white rice.

title: Smokin' Hot
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Cut bamboo shoots diagonally into 1/8 slices or use 2 paper towels to blot water.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,sun tomato oil,creme fraiche,balsamic vinegar,butter lettuce,pearl barley,green bell pepper,white wine
title: Ranch-Style Barley Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb pearl barley ( about 1 1/2 cups per bag ) | 1 tablespoon butter lettuce, chopped | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained ( not oil packed ) | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, shredded ( or other hard-ripened cheeses ) | 2 tablespoons light creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper or 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Place the barley in a medium sized saucepan, cover with 3 1/2 cups water and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cover and reduce heat to medium low and simmer until barley is tender and liquid is absorbed, 15 to 30 minutes. Drain the barley in a colander, then return to saucepan. Meanwhile, bring 2 1/2 cups of water to a boil with the butter lettuce and sun dried tomatoes and simmer until liquid is almost completely absorbed, about 10 minutes. Remove the saucepan from the heat, drain, then cool the barley mixture completely in the saucepan. When the barley mixture has cooled completely, stir in the gruyère or cheeses. When the barley is cool, place in a large serving bowl. Stir the creme fraiche, wine, vinegar and pepper into the remaining 2 1/2 cups of chilled barley mixture and then gently fold in. Season to taste with salt and pepper, if desired.

Random Ingredients: baby potato,tortilla,orange juice,chicken wing,gorgonzola,tomato sauce,english cucumber
title: Chicken Wings With Spicy Gorgonzola Soup
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings, cut into 8 pieces | 3/4 cup tomato sauce | 1 bag baby potatoes, quartered | 1 english cucumber, sliced | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 4 ounces gorgonzola, crumbled | 2 tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f put chicken wings, tomato sauce, cucumber, orange juice and gorgonzola in roaster, pour water into roaster and cover. Bake for about 45 minutes or until chicken wings are tender. Bake in oven for an additional 15 minutes or until done.

title: Hot Italian Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, cooked | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can minced clams, drained | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an oven safe 9 x 12 inch baking dish. Cover and bake in a 375 degree f. Oven for 50 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,part mozzarella cheese,orange juice,pepperoni,red chilies,malt vinegar
title: Sicilian Baked Antipasti
ingredients: 8 large red chilies | 4 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1 1/2 cups orange juice | sliced pepperoni ( optional ) | 2 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: In an oven proof dish, arrange the chiles around their edge. Place half of the mozzarella cheese on the chile leaving about a half inch around the edge. Arrange the remaining chiles around the mozzarella cheese and cover with mozzarella cheese. Combine the vinegar, orange juice, and pepperoni if using. Pour over the cheese. Bake at 375°f for 15 - 20 minutes or until the cheese is slightly melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: peach,ham,mexican cheese,plum tomato,yellow bell pepper,pepper,basil leaf
title: Mexican Peach Pone
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons shredded italian cheese blend | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow bell pepper ( optional ) | 3/4 lb ham ( or cooked pork, sausage or beef ) | 1 peach, sliced | 6 plums or 6 apricots, halved | pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook basil and cheese in small skillet over medium heat until cheese is melted, stirring constantly. Add bell pepper, ham, and sliced peaches. Simmer until heated through. Place on platter. Drizzle melted cheese mixture over platter.

title: Peking Pork (Or Chicken)
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, finely shredded | maple syrup
instructions: Wash the lettuce thoroughly before shredding it. In a large bowl, mix the lettuce with the maple syrup.

title: Kidney Bean Chili
ingredients: 300 g dry kidney beans | 1 teaspoon cumin, ground | 1 teaspoon white wine | 400 g marshmallows | 1 handful kalamata olive | 1 handful kalamata olive, pitted
instructions: Wash the kidney beans and remove any stones from them. Soak them in a large saucepan with plenty of water for at least an hour. Drain. Boil with the spices for a couple of minutes. Add a splash of white wine. Stir a few times during cooking and add the marshmallows. Simmer slowly for around 20 minutes. Serve with the olives over. Goes well with crusty bread or your favourite crisp bread for dunking this makes some calories depending of how much you eat it.

title: Scotch Shortbread
ingredients: 3/4 cup unsalted butter, cold and cut into pea sized pieces | 1/4 cup unsalted butter | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon dried lemon peel, grated | 1/2 cup white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Line 15/10/1st of a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1 jelly roll pan with parchment or waxed paper and dampen the paper with water. Place butter, worcestershire sauce, lemon peel and wine in a microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: rum extract,mace,coffee,cooking oil,cointreau liqueur,sugar snap pea
title: St. Patrick's Day Party Coffee
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups brewed coffee ( any leftover coffee should do ) | 2 packages sugar snap peas | 4 tablespoons cointreau liqueur ( the real thing ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon rum extract | 2 -3 teaspoons cooking oil | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon mace
instructions: In a large bowl mix the sugar snap peas with the coffee and liquors. The mace should be in the center of the stick. Heat the oil in a medium saucepan. If too hot it will toast the sugar snap peas. They should be dark brown all around the pan if they are not. The sugar snap peas should be crisp and brown in color. If it is too hot and the sugar snaps will burn, it needs to be very hot. Cook on the stove until syrup is a nice golden color, stir a little, lower heat, cover for 1 minute and let cool before breaking into pieces. Serve at once.

title: Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 1 package monterey jack cheese, grated | 16 leaves fresh marjoram
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir together the cheese and marjoram. Roll the cheese mixture into teaspoon sized balls. Arrange on a greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the tops are lightly browned.

title: Italian Cornbread
ingredients: 250 g cake yeast | 625 ml oil, for frying ( for frying the bread, see note ) | 6 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 250 g corn kernels ( i prefer thawed, but frozen ok ) | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Punch down the corn kernels and then cut them up into chunks. Rinse corn kernels in a very little sieve or colander and set aside. Using the dough hooks of your mixer, mix both yeast with 125ml of the oil. Once everything has been mixed in, knead on a floured board till sticky and soft. Place in a large bowl and add the other 125ml of oil. Knead it while still on low until this dough ball becomes elastic and all the bumps start coming off the spoon. You know the dough is ready after it has sat for 30 minutes. Place the dough onto a floured board, and knead until the dough is smooth and elastic. This should take approx 15 minutes knead it for about 30 seconds. This should take roughly 10 - 15 minutes until the dough has turned a very light yellow color. Turn it out onto a floured board and dust it with flour. Roll it into a ball in the palms of your hands so that it is about 2cm thick. Cut the ball into six equal sized pieces. With your hands, stretch each piece of dough into an oblong shape approximately 7 inches long, about an inch in diameter and two inches in diameter. Place each circle on a large greased tray and cover with parchment paper. You can either fry the cornbread in batches or leave to rise in one layer in the oven, as the cornbread will need to be warmed after frying. You can either cook the cornbread by frying it in a little oil to the point where it collapses into the bread, and then place it on paper in a brown paper bag for 10 minutes, or fry it in the frying pan with cornbread. This will make it crispy and brown in colour. When cooked transfer to a paper bag and allow to cool. Store in an airtight container, it will keep for up to three months. Note, if using frozen cornbread, defrost them in the microwave for 2 minutes and then reheat, if using already warmed through, in the microwave until crispy.

title: Melitzanes Temptation
ingredients: 8 eggplants | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Wipe the eggplants clean with a paper towel, removing all the dirt if you wish. Slice lengthways in half. Arrange them in an ovenproof dish. Whip the cream to soften. Pour over the sliced eggplants. Cover with foil, place in the oven and bake for about 1 hour. Remove and serve hot.

title: Broccoli Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef round | 1 can tomato gravy ( or stewed tomatoes ) | 4 cups fresh broccoli ( cut into florets )
instructions: Add beef and gravy to a large pot. Add broccoli then simmer over med heat about 5 min or until beef is cooked. Serve.

title: Banana Crepe with Mussels & Saffron
ingredients: 4 fresh mussels | 1 1/2 lbs pork ( cut in bite sized pieces ) | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream | 1 pinch saffron ( crushed in palm ) | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes ( i use red and green chili flakes ) | 1/2 large small banana, sliced
instructions: Clean the mussels and remove any that are beards from the tops.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,green bell pepper,breadcrumb,broccoli,wheat pita bread,green pea
title: Green Pea Casserole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 4 ounces frozen green pea, thawed | 4 slices breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon chopped green bell pepper | 1/4 cup broccoli, coarsely chopped | 5 whole wheat pita bread, cut in half
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Heat oil in large skillet over high heat. Add frozen peas.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,apple juice,feta cheese,floury potato,plain nonfat yogurt,sun tomato oil,coffee
title: Greek Fondue
ingredients: 1 lb floury potato, thinly sliced | 5 -6 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and finely chopped ( packed in oil ) | 1 lb feta cheese ( packed in oil and cut into 1/2-inch pieces ) | 1 cup greek yogurt ( regular regular or low fat greek ) | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 4 teaspoons instant coffee
instructions: Drain sun dried tomatoes, reserving oil, and set sun dried tomatoes aside. In a medium saucepan, boil the chopped potatoes in enough water to cover them, for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until tender. Transfer potatoes to a food processor fitted with steel blade, and process until very thin. Transfer cooled potatoes to a bowl. Add sundried tomatoes, feta, and greek yogurt.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,chicken,meat,white bread flour,spaghetti,yeast,lamb,chicken bouillon cube
title: Mum's Meatballs
ingredients: 1 kg ground lamb or 1 kg beef | 1 kg ground chicken | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder ( we like it fairly spicy ) | 1 liter bread flour | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 cup cooked leftover meat ( optional ) | spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended. If using a pre cooked shredded meat, drain some of the meat before grinding. Shape the mixture into meatballs with damp hands, about 2inch long, placing them on an oiled tray. Preheat your oven to 180oc/350of/gas mark 4/moderate/200c. Put them on a wire rack so that they don't touch each other and can rise to the top. Bake the meatballs in a pre heated oven for around 120/side, or until they are cooked through. They might try to be slightly underdone by the time they are finished though, but they should still be a bit crispy on the outside and a little moist inside. Enjoy them.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,cheddar cheese,wine vinegar,wine,sea salt,corn,orange juice concentrate
title: Crock Pot Wisconsin Cheesy Dressing
ingredients: 3/4 cup italian salad dressing mix ( kraft kraft zesty italian dressing mix ) | 3/4 cup frozen corn, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons orange juice concentrate ( concentrate in cup ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated ( divided ) | 1/2 cup light corn
instructions: Combine salad dressing mix, corn and wine vingegar. Sprinkle the cheese over corn mixture. Stir to coat all ingredients evenly. Add the remaining 1/2 cup of cheese. Stir to coat. Cover and refrigerate. Before serving place corn mixture in crock with the remaining cheese. If it separates after 1/2 hour add 1/4 cup more of corn. If it separates continue to cook on low.

title: Rigatoni Pasta with Fresh Parsley
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rigatoni, and return to a boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Chili Powder
ingredients: 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon pimentos, chopped ( optional ) | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in an air tight container.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,beef,mccormick seasoning,steak,beef broth,nut,red chili pepper,pork tenderloin
title: Spicy Carnitas (Pulled Beef)
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin ( cut into thin strips ) | 1/2 lb pork tenderloin ( cut into thin strips ) | 1 medium red chili pepper ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup fresh cream of tartar | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 -3 drop crushed red chili pepper, for those brave brave brave folks
instructions: Cook meat in broiler for 3 minutes and remove from broiler and allow to sit until cool enough to handle. In a small bowl combine the meat, sauce, chilli, steak seasoning & cream of tater totether. Mix well. Pour over meat and allow to marinate at least 8 hours minimum. Serve with tortillas, sour cream, or guacamole.

title: Chinese Style Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 7 lbs chicken | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Take the chicken parts out of their packaging, rinse and dry the chicken. Make sure they are completely clean. Place the chicken into a large pan and sprinkle over the red chili powder. Cook over a medium heat, stirring often until the chicken is golden brown, about 35 to 40 minutes, depending on the thickness, but no more than 1/2 or 3/4 of an hour. The chicken will cook more immediately if it does not already cook. While the chicken is cooking cut the bread into 3 inch rounds. Use a slotted spoon to remove the excess fat from the chicken. Put a slice of bread into a bowl and cover with the chicken. Squeeze the rest of the bread to help moisten it up. Put on a cutting board and sprinkle over the chili powder. With your hands, place the two pieces of bread in a large, sturdy plastic bag with the chicken. Place the bag in the refrigerator, put in the fridge overnight. The next day remove the bag from the refrigerator and take off the meat of the chicken that is now in the bag. Throw it away, or save, whatever you like to do with the juice. Return the chicken meat to the fridge and allow to stand for at least 30 minutes before you are ready to eat. Note, if you're eating this on a outdoor grill, leave the chicken out of the bag and save the juice that is there. Slice the meat into strips or chunks and eat it all up by itself.

title: Real English Muffins - Muffin Mix!
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon hing | 1 teaspoon molasses | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Mix ingredients together in a bowl and microwave on high for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally until well mixed.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,crescent dinner,sage leaf,cucumber,red pepper flake,peanut,sherry wine
title: Berry Danish
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 2/3 cup crumbled dry unsalted peanuts or 2/3 cup unsalted dry-roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 2/3 cup diced seedless cucumber | 1/4 cup chopped fresh sage leaf | 1/3 cup sherry wine or 1/3 cup apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons dry unsalted dry roasted peanuts or 2 tablespoons unsalted dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f unroll each crescent dough on a lightly floured surface.

title: Indian Cheese Balls
ingredients: 500 g of soft white indian cheese ( i use `` kool-aid '' ) | 1 pinch of maita's red mill curry leaves
instructions: You will need a non stick frying pan. Cube the cheese into fine pieces the size of an egg. Add all the spices, mix well, and cover it with water. This is important to put the cheese in relatively small pieces, about 1 cm or less, so that it doesn't melt in boiling water. Stir every time you see your water rising to the surface. The water level should be about 3/4 inch above the edges. Cover and sweat the cheese over medium heat to your desired texture. When it is fairly hard, you should begin testing a ball with your pointer finger or the tip of your pointer finger. It should not crack, or have tiny lumps of the cheese floating around the circumference. If that does, remove your pot from the burner and add the cheese in small pieces back into the cheese water. You can use a blender to do this. After 10minutes, check temperature, if it cracks, it is ready to be used in a recipe. If it cracks again, remove it from the heat and pour off any excess water. It should be fairly thick and smooth. Take a handful of cheese balls and roll them around the kool aid until each one starts to crack. You will have balls that are about as big and round as any bagels, but you might need to work fast to get the balls to crack so that the cheese balls crack. When you are ready, remove the balls with a slotted spoon, and set aside in an airtight container. These go rancherized and keep in airtight jars for up to 2 years. At your next party, you will need to pick up a dozen or more colourful cheese pieces or a few smaller ones or simply buy the big ones already on sale. These can be frozen and stored in the freezer for use later. They keep well in the freezer.

title: Scallion Salad
ingredients: 6 -8 scallions, peeled, very finely chopped ( about 3-4 cups ) | salt, to taste
instructions: Place the scallions in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer about 10 minutes, or until soft. Drain and let cool. Combine the scallions and scallions in a bowl. In the same pan, bring the water again to a boil and cook the scallions 2 minutes. Then remove from heat and let cool. Transfer the scallions and scallions to a bowl and stir. Taste and season with salt to serve.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,red chili powder,vanilla,sake,chuck,sea bass fillet,white onion,hamburger bun everywhere
title: Grilled Sea Bass Burger
ingredients: 4 sea bass fillets ( about 15 oz each ) | 8 ounces of any cheap hamburger bun ( it must be one with a good consistency, i use whole wheat buns! ) | 1 white onion ( finely grated ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons sake | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 tablespoons dry sake | 3 -5 drops vanilla | 1/4 - 3/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Boil meat for about 10 minutes on high just so it won't burn to the bone with the onion and the red chili powder stirring a couple of times then drain in a strainer into a medium bowl. Grill the sea bass fillets on a foreman type grill about 5 to 7 minutes on each side. I use an indoor grill that does not have a cooking option but you can pan fry it if you want. Keep going until the sea bass is cooked, but still moist inside. While fish is cooking put out a bowl, sprinkle pine nuts on it. Cut up the fish into serving pieces and pile it onto the toasted pine nuts. If it looks like they aren't in your liking, you can toast them at the crack you'll need them to warm up the pine nuts. Put the sea bass on a cutting board and top it with the toasted pine nuts and the burger. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,cauliflower,orange zest,chocolate,almond extract,mexican tomato sauce,green chili,filet beef
title: Mexican Beef With Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs filet of beef, trimmed of most of the rind | fresh green chili, minced ( i usually only use 1/4 cup ) | 6 ounces smoked sweet butter | 1 tablespoon mexican tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon dried pimiento ( i remove the stem and seeds when i add the pimento ) | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese blend | 3 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts ( roughly chopped ) or 3 tablespoons slivered almonds, coarsely crushed ( roughly chopped )
instructions: Cut the beef into strips. Season generously with 1 3/4 teaspoons salt and pepper. Heat the butter in a large skillet over mediun heat until it melts, then add the beef strips and cook until no longer pink, but not browned, about 3 minutes. Add the sauce ingredients, except for the cheese and almonds, and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer until the beef is just cooked through, about 10 minutes. If the sauce starts bubbling, remove from the heat. The beef should still be warm, and have begun to caramelize slightly. Remove from heat and stir in the cheese until melted. Pour the hot cheese mixture into a large serving bowl. Sprinkle the peanuts on top. Set aside until the beef is cooked through, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,white chocolate chip,kraft italian dressing,elbow macaroni,salt black pepper
title: White Chocolate Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni, cooked according to package directions | 1/4 cup kraft zesty italian dressing | 3 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 package white chocolate chips | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f prepare macaroni according to package directions. Drain thoroughly and toss with zesty italian dressing. Let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile, melt chocolate chips in top of double boiler, stirring constantly, and remove from heat. Stir in macaroni. Transfer to baking dish, cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes, then serve.

title: Iced Lettuce with Creamy Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups low-fat milk | 2 leaves iceberg lettuce ( or iceberg cut in 8 pieces )
instructions: Line two large platter with lettuce leaves, cut into thin strips. Toss lettuce with desired amount of creamy dressing. Refrigerate.

title: Salsa Canola Oil With Anchovies
ingredients: 1 cup canola oil | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 packet anchovies, anchovies packed in oil, drained and crushed | lime wedge
instructions: Place oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. When the oil is warmed, carefully put in the salt and turmeric and saute the mixture for a minute or two. Stir the anchovies into the oil. Turn down the heat to medium and mix. Remove the skillet from the heat and add the drained anchovies, stirring well. Let sit until the anchovies get warmed up.

title: Jicama Mousse
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs jicama, peeled and julienned ( about 1/2 pound jicama ) | 3 tablespoons heavy cream or 3 tablespoons milk, divided | 3 large egg whites, lightly beaten
instructions: Place the juliennes in a colander. Toss with the 2 tablespoons of cream or milk. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours or up to 8 hours. Remove 1 cup to a small sieve placed over a bowl. Press out as much liquid as possible. Transfer to a large bowl. Whisk in the egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold about 1/4 cup of the juliennes into the juliennes. Spoon into four serving dishes. Sprinkle with the remaining juliennes.

title: Cranberry Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked small shell pasta | 3 3/4 cups bottled cranberries | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,mexican oregano,star anise,orange,lemon extract,salt pepper,coffee
title: Quick Caffe Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup baby carrots | 4 ounces orange blossom water or 4 ounces fresh lemon juice | 4 ounces espresso | 1 star anise | 1 lemon, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | smoked salt and pepper
instructions: Blend everything in a blender until a slurry is formed. Scoop out some of the liquid, but not to much, so it'll be smoother in that case. Serve with toasted toast or crackers.

Random Ingredients: harissa,italian parsley,tamari,ramen noodle,part mozzarella cheese,strawberry,salt black pepper
title: Veggies with Ramen Noodle and Fresh Strawberries
ingredients: 4 tablespoons tamari ( japanese fish sauce ) | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, stems removed | 1 cup fat-free roasted ham-strawberry | 1 package ramen noodles | 1 1/2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Pour 1 tablespoon tamari into a saucepan, cover, and bring to a simmer over medium low heat. Add parsley, ham, and noodles, and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in mozzarella cheese, and season with salt and pepper. Spoon ramen noodle mixture into 4 soup bowls.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,havarti cheese,lemon juice zest,green,lime zest
title: Grilled Havarti Cheese With Lime, Lemon and Lime
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh lime juice ( about 2 medium limes ) | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons havarti cheese, grated | 2 lemons, cut into thin half-moons | 1 lemon, cut into thin half-moons
instructions: Whisk the lime juice and zest in a small dish. Spray a grill rack with cooking spray. Pour 1 teaspoon oil into a shallow metal ovenproof dish. Add half of the lime slices. Divide the havarti cheese among the lime slices, leaving a 1/2 inch border. Drizzle 1 tablespoon lime juice over the havarti cheese. Coat the cheese lightly with water, patting it into the surface of the lime slices. Grill over a hot fire or under the broiler until melted and beginning to crisp, about 6 minutes.

title: Triple Chocolate Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs round steaks, well trimmed and cut 3/4-inch thick ( i use the sirloin steak ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 cup shaved semisweet chocolate ( or cocoa chips )
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt 1/2 cup cocoa with 1/2 cup water over low heat. Remove from heat. Add steak.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,parmigiano reggiano cheese,italian green bean
title: Creamy Chorizo With Green Beans and Chorizo
ingredients: 6 links chorizo sausage ( the spicy links can be found in the latin food section ) | 1 1/2 pounds fresh italian cut green beans, trimmed | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cook chorizo slices in a large skillet over medium until crisp, about 4 minutes per side. Slice into 4 pieces.

title: Mexican Chilli Cornbread
ingredients: 1 can of diced green chili | 1 loaf of cornbread ( bread from the store )
instructions: Cut loaf in half, but leave a small space in between the slices. Fill the spaces between the slices with green chilies, making sure they are mostly left in the loaf. Cook in a medium sized nonstick pan for around 20 - 30 minutes, turning at least once or twice while cooking. The more you open the can the chilli and the hotter the chilli will get. Take out of the heat and serve warm.. Variation, you can add the sliced onions or other toppings like shredded lettuce or tomato. The amount of chile and onions is still up to personal preference, but i like lots of veggies.

title: Randy's Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 cup shredded swiss cheese or 1 cup swiss cheese | 0.5 can coconut milk | 2 drops chili flakes ( optional ) | 2/3 cup beer
instructions: Mix everything together. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: tapioca flour,cashew nut,golden raisin,walnut,yukon gold potato
title: Roasted Sweet Potato and Pecan Fritters With Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 3 medium sweet potatoes, peeled, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4 inch slices ( about 2 lbs ) | 3 tablespoons tapioca flour or 3 tablespoons arrowroot | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts ( a combination of nuts and seeds, not in season ) | 2/3 cup raisins | 1/3 cup chopped cashew nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°. Coat a small baking sheet with nonstick spray and set aside. Toss the potatoes with the tapioca flour in a large bowl. Toss in the walnuts, raisins and cashews. Arrange in a single layer on the baking sheet. Roast, stirring every 10 minutes, until the potatoes are slightly soft and lightly browned and the walnuts are fragrant, about 25 - 35 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a large slotted spoon and let cool 15 minutes before transferring to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: liver,red enchilada sauce,cream soup,rice milk,hash brown,salad green,hungarian paprika
title: Hungarian Potato Curd
ingredients: 1 bag shredded hash brown | 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 1 can condensed cream of potato soup | 1 package frozen chopped salad greens | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 jar red enchilada sauce | 1 cup rice milk, chilled
instructions: Put 2 - 4 cups hot water in pot and add package of hashbrowns, mix and place in dutch oven with all other ingredients. Bring to boil and simmer for 45 - 50 minutes, until rice is tender and hashbrowns is soft. I also make a large batch at times and then freeze the rest.

title: Gluten-Free Shrimp
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups gluten, gluten-free ( i use soy wheat ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 2 -4 teaspoons lemon juice ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable oil ( or canola oil )
instructions: Stir everything together and set aside for 15 minute. Saute shrimp in hot oil on each side for 3 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Swiss Chard and White Bean Parfait
ingredients: 4 bunches swiss chard, leaves picked and washed | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 3 ounces semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/4 cup vodka or 1/4 cup kirsch
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange chard leaves in a single layer on a sheet pan and drizzle with just enough olive oil to dampen leaves. Spread leaves in single layer on baking sheet. Roast until crisp, about 8 to 10 minutes. Cut crosswise into thin strips. Combine chard, beans, and chocolate chips in another large bowl. Drizzle generously with oil, then stir in chard mixture until well coated. Pour into a lightly buttered 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until top browns, about 30 minutes.

title: Simple Spanish Pork Ribs
ingredients: 6 -7 lbs pork country-style pork ribs | 2 1/2 teaspoons mixed rosemary, 1/8's worth ( about 2 tbsp. ) | 1/4 cup tamari ( to taste ) | 1 1/4 cups paprika or 1 1/4 cups smoked paprika | 3/4 cup dried apricots, quartered
instructions: Put pork ribs in a large heavy duty zip lock bag. Add all herbs on top of ribs & mix them up. Tightly wrap bag. Chill at least 30 minutes but no more than 36 hours. Remove plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,genoa salami,beef,peanut butter,pork loin,jalapeno pepper,wheat flour,ricotta cheese
title: Spicy Stuffed Pastries
ingredients: 600 g ground beef | 350 g ground pork loin | 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded, finely chopped | 250 g ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 500 g light caster sugar | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup pickled genoa salami, sliced | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 c. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Place beef, pork, chilli, ricotta, peanut butter, sugar, flour, salami and nuts in a food processor and process until smooth. Scoop 1 - 2 tablespoons of meat mixture into each pastry sheet, then roll up towards the centre to enclose filling, tucking in the ends. Place on the prepared trays and bake until golden on top and cooked through, 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 4 slices bread, buttered and torn into bite-sized chunks | 2 cups salad greens, washed, dried, torn into bite-sized chunks | 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 1 large red onion, julienned | 8 ounces romaine lettuce, washed, dried, torn into bite-sized pieces | 1 jar salsa | 1 package frozen pitted dates, chopped
instructions: Put the bread pieces into a large salad bowl and put salad greens, chick peas, red onion and romaine lettuce in a second bowl. Add salsa, dates and chopped tomatoes and toss together. Put everything through your food processor, if you have one. Then, enjoy.

title: Microwave Mochi
ingredients: 1/8 cup mochiko sweet rice flour | 2/3 cup picante sauce ( kikkoman sweet sauce is good for this )
instructions: Place rice flour in a medium bowl. Add picante sauce.

Random Ingredients: apple pie spice,fennel seed,vegetable shortening,butternut squash
title: Easy and Standard Butternut Squash Wedges
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, halved and seeded | 1 tablespoon mixed apple pie spice ( spice for australians ) | 1 1/2 fluid ounces vegetable shortening, melted | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/fan 200c degrees. Place squash on a baking tray and roast in the oven for 1 hour, until the skin starts to crisp up and the squash is tender. Remove from the oven and leave to cool. Slice or chop the squash and set aside in a bowl. Strain the cooking liquid onto a clean tea towel. Add the apple pie spice and vegetable shortening, and stir well until the shortening has melted and it is incorporated evenly. Drain the squash well and mash with your hands until it is smooth and creamy. Pour onto prepared tray and sprinkle with fennel seeds.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,garlic,lettuce green,flat leaf parsley,adobo seasoning,green grape,cashew,banana
title: Cashew Bananas and Grapes
ingredients: 2 cups chicken broth | 1 large stalk flat leaf parsley, leaves picked from stems | 2 medium banana, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 4 green seedless grapes, halved | 1/4 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1 dash adobo seasoning | shredded lettuce greens | chopped cashews
instructions: Stir broth, parsley, bananas, grapes, adobo seasoning and salt and pepper to taste in medium bowl. Let stand 5 minutes. Transfer to slow cooker. Top with greens. Cover.

title: Glorious Hot Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced scallions | 2 tablespoons minced jalapenos ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried currant, soaked for 15 minutes in cold water and chopped | 1 tablespoon minced fresh rosemary leaf | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1/4 cup rum or 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: To make the hot rub, combine all ingredients in a plastic container with a tight fitting lid and shake well. Store in a cool, dry place for up to several months before using. In an airtight jar, the hot rub should be made with just enough hot water to cover the surface of the Rub and not too hot. If the surface seems dry, cover loosely with plastic wrap. This rub is meant to keep the moisture level for shaving, and not to relieve air bubbles. To make, pour half into a shaker. Close and shake well. To use, rub the inside of your clean, dry jar with the remaining hot rub and pour into a shaker. Close and shake until shaker is cold, cold, and liquid has reduced. Pour into a container with a tight fitting lid and keep in air.

title: Easy Pizza Sauce - a Simple No-Cream Meal Meal
ingredients: 1 jar your favorite pizza sauce | 1 pinch white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Heat sauce in saucepan over low heat or in microwave for 1 minute. Add a dash or two of white pepper. Allow sauce to come to a rolling boil.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,red pepper flake,pistachio nut,vegetable stock
title: Pistachio Olive Roasted Peppers
ingredients: 2 red peppers, roasted and cut into 1/4-inch wide strips ( red bell peppers may be used also ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried-packed unsalted pistachio nuts | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Heat the broiler and spread the red peppers on their flat sides. Place the oil in a 12 inch skillet and place over high heat until very hot, about 3 minutes. Quickly toss in the pistachios and blacken the pistachios around the peppers, shaking to spread the pistachios evenly. Set the peppers in the skillet on the rack. Broil for 10 minutes, turning once, then remove the skillet from the oven. Sprinkle with the crushed red pepper flakes. Drizzle the roasted peppers with any leftover oil from the skillet and serve warm or at room temperature. Makes 1 cup.

title: Polenta Baked in Chestnut Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups polenta | 2 ounces fresh chestnuts mushrooms, chopped | 4 ounces hot pepperoni | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly oil an 8x8 inch baking dish. Mix the polenta with 2 cups cold water. Mix in the mushrooms and pepperoni. Pour into the prepared pan. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake for 45 minutes or until the polenta is golden and has risen. Serve warm.

title: Roasted Lamb Shoulder
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb shoulder | 1 bunch fresh coriander seeds
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200c. Place the coriander and the ras el hanout in a shallow baking dish and sprinkle over the meat. Roast in your oven for approx 1hr turning every so often and basting continuously with the juices of the pan. When cooked, remove from the oven, cover with foil and leave to rest for 30minutes. After 30 min remove the meat and shred the meat. Return to your casserole and cook in the oven for 25mins for 2hr, until tender. Add cooked beans, cover and cook for a further 15 - 20 mins until heated through. Note, for a 76kg piece of lamb shoulder this would yield about 20, enough for a double the volume. This should make 1 1/2 kg lamb shoulder.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,pink grapefruit,espresso coffee,chili pepper,beet,egg noodle
title: Beets in Macadamia Nests
ingredients: 4 firm beets | 14 ounces hot brewed espresso or 14 ounces strong coffee | 1 pint tart apple | 1/2 pink grapefruit, sliced | 1 egg noodle | 1 tablespoon chili pepper
instructions: Put the beets in a saucepan with about 2 1/4 cups cold water. Bring to the boiling point, then plunge into cold water. When they are cold, peel them off the skins and cut them in half, lengthways. Set them aside. Place the espresso or strong coffee, apples, grapefruit and egg noodles in a saucepan, bring to the boil, then leave to macadamia nuts to soak for 10 minutes. Heat a couple of tablespoons of oil in a pan, place the beet mixture into it, and gently poach them over a medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes or until they are just tender. Take them out and drain them, then add the chilli. Serve them hot as they are or sprinkled with the chili pepper to serve cold.

title: Baked Eggs and Vegetables
ingredients: 8 hardboiled eggplants | 8 small eggplants ( peeled ) | 16 ounces kidney beans ( rinsed and boiled ) | 2 cups long grain white rice
instructions: Line a 3 quart casserole dish with foil, and preheat the oven to 350°f lightly grease the foil with shortening. Cut 4 eggplants into rounds and arrange them in the dish, then cut another eggplant round into rounds, and finally fill the dish with the beans. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Serve over hot cooked uncooked rice.

title: Spaghetti Burritos With Hamburger and Spaghetti (Spaghetti Burritos de Linguica)
ingredients: 3/4 lb spaghetti | 12 ounces linguine | 3/4 cup thick & chunky salsa | 10 tortillas | 1 1 lb hamburger | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large, nonstick skillet over medium high heat, add 1/2 of the jar of salsa. Break the linguica into 2 pieces, and add to the salsa. Cook, stirring frequently until the linguica is tender. Drain the spaghetti, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Add the cooked spaghetti to the skillet, and heat, stirring constantly, until coated with the sauce. Warm up tortillas according to package directions, and put in a large bowl with just enough spaghetti liquid to coat. Add the meat, and stir well. Place a scoop of spaghetti and meat on each warmed tortilla, and sprinkle with the cardamom. Fold in the sides of the tortilla, and roll up. Eat warm, or wrap in plastic wrap, and warm in the refrigerator until time to serve.

title: Brown Rice & Pea Pudding
ingredients: 4 cups cooked brown rice | 2 tablespoons fast rise yeast | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 2 cans diced tomatoes | 1 package fast rise yeast | 2 1/2 cups canned low-fat pea pieces | 1 egg | 1 loaf ciabatta | 2 tablespoons fat free nutella
instructions: For the spice paste put the spices in a saucepan and put on medium heat. Cook for 1 minute then put on low heat. Add the diced tomatoes and bring to boil. Add the yellow and brown rice and cook on low heat for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the two undissolved yeast package. Place in a large bowl and mix with a fork. Cover and set aside until you're ready to eat. When you're ready to eat, grease the ciabatta pan and place it under medium heat. In a small bowl, place the egg, nutella and two tablespoons of the spice paste. Stir to mix the paste until combined. When the ciabatta is toasting, place 1 cup of the cooked rice mixture in a bowl and let it sit a minute. Spread 2 tablespoons of the spice paste and 1/2 cup of the peas over 1 side of ciabatta.

title: Linguine With Oil & Parsley
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1/4 cup oil | 3 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1 lb lingine, of your choice
instructions: Cook linguine in boiling water with a pinch of salt until al dente, not too soft but firm. Drain and reserve two cups of the cooking water. In a large, deep sauce pan or skillet over a medium flame, warm the oil. Add the parsley and linguine and toss to coat with oil. Add the pasta & toss until heated through, about 2 minutes. Top with reserved clamine water.

title: Caribbean Style Steamed Rice
ingredients: 150 ml single cream | 100 ml gated coconut rum | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh capers | 2 -3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3 3 tablespoons rice or 4 tablespoons jasmine rice, rinsed | fried guacamole | lemon wedge
instructions: Place 2 tablespoons each of the cream and rum in a small jug. Stir over a moderately low heat until the cream begins to thicken. Add another tablespoon of cream if desired and add the caper, flour and rice. Stir, then cover and place in the steamer and steam for about 20 minutes, stirring once or twice during which time the rice should be quite tender. Serve and accompany with fresh coriander or creme fraiche. Garnish with fried guacamole and lemon wedges.

title: Sausage and Potato Rice
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 1 medium white onion, chopped | 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 cup vodka | 1/2 cup cream | 1 jar lemons, rinsed well
instructions: In a large saucepan on medium low heat, cook sausage, breaking into chunks until no longer pink. Add onion. Reduce heat to low.

title: Spudah
ingredients: 1 pita bread | fresh strawberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 200ºc. Wrap pita bread in aluminium foil and place on the oven shelf. Heat for 3 - 5 minutes. Open the pitta bread and toast. Break into segments and serve with strawberries, on one side only.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,brown gravy mix,mint leaf,green apple,italian tomato
title: The Wise and Chilli's Italian Mashed Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages of the wise and chilli's italian tomato | 1 box brown gravy mix | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 package provolone cheese in cheese, sliced finely | 12 mint leaves
instructions: Dice the cheese into pieces 1 1/2 by ½. Set aside. Dice the tomatoes by placing in a food processor or blender with the 2 packages of gravy mix and process until smooth. Spread contents of skillet on the bottom of a lrg oven safe baking dish. Place the potatoes under the hot broiler, and turn frequently until lightly browned, approximately 7 - 10 minutes. Sprinkle on the remaining package b4 serving of gravy mix. Sprinkle with the remaining sliced cheese, and place under the broiler for 2 - 3 minutes until the cheese starts to melted. Spread the top of the potatoes with the diced criollo. Set the dish in a warm oven & cook for 5 - 6 minutes. Remove from oven & stir. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Sausage and Corn
ingredients: 2 pounds sweet italian sausage | 16 ounces whole kernel corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place sausage in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain and rinse pan. While sausage is browning, cut corn kernels from cobs, being careful not to cut into the kernels. Place corn kernels in a bowl with enough cold water to cover. Place corn over medium high heat in a saucepan. Place pan over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Cook corn kernels until tender and slightly wilted, about 5 minutes. Drain and transfer to a blender, or you can use two forks. Add corn to blender with sausage, and blend until well mixed. Stir in diced tomatoes if desired. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and bubbly, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Couscous Salad III
ingredients: 1 can paprika-garlic-chipotle flavored stewed pork butt | 2 1/2 lbs jalapenos | 1 package couscous | 3 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 teaspoon ground chipotle powder
instructions: Roast jalapenos on an open flame or under the broiler. Place them in a plastic bag, with one of the cans of paprika and one of the cans of chipotle, and close bag. Place them in a 350 degree f oven for 30 minutes, turning them over, to redistribute the seeds and the liquid. When cool enough to handle, remove the peel with a large knife and tear it into shreds about 1 1/2 inch square. Remove and discard stem and seeds. Rinse out and discard the hot peppers from heat and chop coarsely. Cook sugar in 3 tablespoons water.

title: Easy and Delicious Irish Broster for 2
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1 can cream of mushroom soup or ( 10 1/2 ounce ) can cream of celery soup | 2 -3 cups steamed broth
