instructions: Brown meat. Add soup, stir to mix, simmer about 20 minutes. Serve over hot egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,lemongrass,mustard seed,kiwi,cabbage,peanut oil,fish sauce
title: Grilled Veggie Chips With a Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 ounce lemongrass, trimmed | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 medium head cabbage, shredded | 8 kiwi, peeled, quartered lengthwise, sliced | 4 ounces graham cracker crumbs, crushed | 1 tablespoon asian fish sauce
instructions: To make lemongrass pesto, chop lemongrass finely. Place in a mini processor and whirl until very fine. Stir in mustard seeds and lemongrass and pulse until finely ground. Put in medium bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let sit on counter for 20 minutes, then squeeze out liquid. Stir in cabbage and kiwi and divide among four dinner plates. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle each with cheese. Serve with peanuts.

title: Cheesy Eggplant Dip
ingredients: 32 ounces green enchilada sauce | 2 -3 medium sized unpeeled eggplants, halved lengthwise, seeded, chopped, seeds removed | 1 large cucumber, halved lengthwise, seeded, sliced | 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Grease two baking sheets. Spread both halves of the eggplant pieces with 1 cup enchilada sauce. Top evenly with remaining ingredients. Bake for about 30 minutes or until hot. Serve warm.

title: Lebanese Pork Wraps
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin, in 4 pieces | 3/4 lb pancetta, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 8 large lettuce | 1 can artichokes, drained, and finely chopped ( optional ) | chili oil, to taste
instructions: Cut a slit down the center side of each piece of pork loin, cutting about 3/4 of the way through the meat. Open out each one carefully and place it in a bowl. Cut the pancetta pieces into 1/4 inch dice and set aside. Sprinkle the flour all over the pork and then toss in the pieces. Tear off a 1 1/4 inch round of reynolds wrap heavy duty aluminum foil and place on a work surface. Add about 3 tablespoons of the pork mixture, spreading each half inch or so with the back of your spoon or similar tool. Place a lettuce leaf between the edges of the wrap tightly and carefully lift the foil so the stuffing can get between the lettuce leaves. Wrap the foil tightly around the stuffing. Then the foil edges and then tie up tight. If you do not have a foil wrapped double fold the foil over the meat and continue wrapping the meat inside the foil, but wrap the meat again inside the foil. If you do not want to wrap the meat well, tie a piece of aluminum foil over the meat.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,chickpea,rice bran oil,chickpea flour,dark ale
title: Gluten Free Chickpea and Beer Battered Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas | 1/3 cup dark ale | 4 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 2 -3 tablespoons rice bran oil ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into a thick patty on a floured board. Use a rolling pin to flatten lightly and cut out shapes to fit the size tortillas.. Heat oil in a pan, medium heat and fry till golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve with salsa and other vegetables.

title: Cumin Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup natural yoghurt | 1/2 cup cumin powder | 2 tablespoons low-fat greek yogurt
instructions: Put everything in a non stick pan. Cook on medium heat for 10 - 15 minute serve with fresh fruit, rice and pita bread.

title: Baked Green Beans a la Bachelorsha
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs green beans, trimmed | 2 oranges, washed, sliced thinly | 8 ounces shelled peas | 8 sage leaves | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: Place beans and orange slices decoratively on a baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees until lightly browned, about 20 - 25 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients in a casserole, cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Garnish with almonds.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,asparagus spear,creamy peanut butter,orange bell pepper,gouda cheese,pesto sauce,fennel seed,green chili pepper
title: Green Peanut Cheese, Asparagus & Peppers
ingredients: 20 medium asparagus spears | 16 ounces gouda cheese, grated | 4 green chili peppers, chopped | 1 jar pesto sauce | 1 can tomato puree | 1 orange bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Snap off thick ends of asparagus and cut into halves or quarters. Place asparagus in a large saucepan, cover with water and boil for 5 - 10 minutes or until tender. Drain and add to cheese with the chopped green chilies, pesto sauce, tomato puree, orange bell pepper, peanut butter and fennel seed. Toss until well combined and pour over the cooked asparagus. Serve.

title: Polish Sausages for Hot Dogs
ingredients: 16 ounces smoked pork sausage | 3 cups water | 4 cups water, or as needed
instructions: Cook and stir sausage in 3 cups water in a large saucepan over medium heat until the water is reduced and sausage is crumbly, 5 to 10 minutes. Cut sausage into 3 inch thick slices. Place sausage in a separate saucepan with 3 cups water.

title: Cheesy Beans
ingredients: 1 package mozzarella cheese, sliced | 1 can red beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 orange
instructions: Arrange mozzarella cheese slices on a plate. Arrange red beans over the cheese, then grate orange zest over the top. Serve immediately.

title: Cheese Stompethakia
ingredients: 1/4 lb velveeta cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes
instructions: In a small frying pan melt the velveeta and stir until it gets hot and starts to brown. Remove the pan from heat. Add the anchovy.

title: Cranberry Basil and Basil Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried cranberries, crushed | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaves or 1/2 cup regular basil, roughly chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium high heat.

title: Fennel and Celery (Mustards)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fennel seeds | 3 tablespoons fennel, crushed | 1 teaspoon celery, finely chopped
instructions: Grind fennel, celery and fenel seeds in a spice grinder. Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: lemon,pizza sauce,chipotle pepper,sharp cheddar cheese,sun tomato oil,goose
title: Tuscany Goose With Chipotle Panini
ingredients: 1 whole goose, 3 to 4 pounds | 1 can pizza sauce | 3 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 1 fresh chipotle pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon grated fresh lemon rind | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Clean the goose and remove silver skin.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,swiss cheese,allspice,broccoli floret,orzo pasta,cardamom pod,danish blue cheese
title: Swiss Broccoli Orzo (Pasta With Orzo)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups orzo pasta or 2 1/2 cups linguine | 20 ounces swiss cheese ( cubed 2 1/2-inch cubes ) | 3 tablespoons tomato paste or 3 tablespoons v 8 vegetable | 3 whole cardamom pods | 5 ounces danish blue cheese, crumbled | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1/4 cup canned broccoli florets
instructions: Cook orzo in salted boiling water as directed on package, stirring occasionally for about 11 minutes.

title: Fennel Burgundy
ingredients: 4 fennel bulbs, trimmed, cut into thin slices | 6 green capsicums, trimmed, cut into thin slices | 1/2 cup burgundy wine, medium quality | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 150 g black olives, sliced
instructions: Put the fennel, capsicums, wine and lemon rind into a roasting dish and stir. Sprinkle with black olives and place into a preheated oven 200c/400f/gas preheating. Place in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes, turning once or twice, until browned and tender. Remove from the oven and leave to rest for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,green chili paste,seasoning salt,virgin olive oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pimento
title: Pimento Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 3 1/2 ounces ) | 3 tablespoons green chili paste ( or pimento paste ) | 2 pimento, slices | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pod, split open | 2 -4 tablespoons seasoning salt ( or regular salt ) | 2 -4 cups virgin olive oil
instructions: Cut cheese into 1/4 inch cubes. Place in a food processor fitted with a steel blade. Add green chili paste or pimento paste, and pulse until mixture begins to form a smooth paste like paste. Add cardamom seeds, seasoning salt, and 1/2 cup olive oil. Process until mixture forms a ball. Add more oil if mixture seems dry. Turn out onto a lightly floured counter and roll into 1 inch balls. Place on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving. Cooks note, parmigiano can be used to sprinkle or flavor salt over cheese during the cooking process. You can also use it to sprinkle on top of your favorite chili.

title: Microwave Poached Sweet Onions
ingredients: 6 yellow onions, peeled, cut in half if you're large | 8 tablespoons dark chocolate | 3 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cut each half onion lengthwise into 8 evenly sized slices. Spread dark chocolate over top of each slice of onion. Cover with foil and microwave on high until softened and beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the grated cheese and return to microwave. Cook on high for an additional 2 minutes, or until cheese is melted and onions are heated through.

title: Sizzling Roasted Pork Chops
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Mix the asafetida with about 1/4 cup cold water.

title: Homemade Mustard
ingredients: 2 cups yellow mustard seeds ( not regular ) | 5 bay leaves
instructions: Soak mustard seeds in water for 5 to 7 days, changing the water every 7 days. The water should soak off the seeds for no more than a day or two. Drain and rinse the soaked seeds until there is no more water visible and dry on a clean cloth. Place in a jar and cover with brine, adding bay leaves. Cover and store in a dark, cool location.

title: Asparagus in Salt
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus spear, steamed until crisp tender ( about 2 3-mins. ) | kosher salt
instructions: Spray large nonstick skillet with vegetable oil spray and heat over medium heat. Add asparagus and a touch of kosher salt. Sauté for 2 - 3 minutes until crisp tender. Spoon hot asparagus onto platter or hot plates. Variation, for a more fiery taste, sprinkle crushed roasted red pepper, minced onion, and chopped fresh cilantro with asparagus spears before cooking.

title: Tajine Ka Salan (Cucumber Curry Paste) from Aloo
ingredients: 1/2 medium cucumber, peeled and quartered | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger paste
instructions: Place the cucumber in a colander and push it through a fine mesh strainer until the juice runs through to the bowl. Squeeze out as much excess liquid as you can, removing any seeds. Transfer the cucumber to a saucepan, fill with warm water, bring to a boil over high heat, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain, reserving 2/3 cup of the water. Chop the cucumber into 1 inch pieces. Drain the cooked cucumber and return to the saucepan. Stir in the ginger and 1/4 cup water, and bring to a boil. Cook for a few minutes until the ginger paste is aromatic and is warm. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine,marjoram,black olive,shrimp,tomato green chile pepper,phyllo pastry,lemon juice
title: Chile Shrimp Fettuccini
ingredients: 1 package dry fettuccine | 8 ounces shrimp - peeled, deveined and chopped | 2 cups chopped fresh tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1/4 cup sliced black olives | 8 ounces frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Boil fettuccini in a large pot of lightly salted water until almost tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and discard any excess water. Combine shrimp, tomatoes, chile peppers, and olives in a large mixing bowl and stir to mix. Unroll pastry on a clean dry surface and cut into 24 squares. Place 1/2 cup shrimp mixture onto each square and bring corners together so they overlap. Fold dough over shrimp mixture to form a half moon. Repeat with remaining pastry and shrimp mixture. Place fettuccini in a lightly buttered baking dish, cover and bake for 20 minutes, until vegetables are heated through. In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice and marjoram. Remove dish from the oven and remove from the oven. Sprinkle top with lemon mixture and serve at once.

title: Chicken and Turnips with Chile Peppers
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, boned | 1/2 pound turnips, peeled and cut into 2-inch sticks | 1 can stewed, diced green chile peppers | 1 pinch dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange chicken thighs in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stick turnips into chicken thighs. Pour chile peppers into the center of chicken, being sure to cover. Top with oregano. Cover dish with aluminum foil, and bake in preheated oven until chicken thighs are tender and easily pierced with a knife, about 1 hour.

title: Almond Naan
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain hot cooked noodles, refrigerated ( long beans ) | 1 cup buttermilk | 3 tablespoons mild paprika, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place the buttermilk in a bowl. Dip the noodles into the buttermilk, and sprinkle with the paprika, garam masala powder, and almond extract.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,extra beef,tamari,hazelnut,hot red chili pepper,plain nonfat yogurt,beef stock,black pepper
title: Beef and Hazelnut Grilled Skewers (Asian Inspired)
ingredients: 12 ounces ground sirloin | 16 ounces ground australian ground beef ( or ground round ) | 16 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup dried hazelnuts ( no subsitution ) | 4 tablespoons tamari | 1 can hot red chili peppers, whole ( or 1 4-oz can of jalapeno chile puree ) | 1 cup beef stock | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 1/2 hour and drain before use. Combine ground sirloin, cooked ground beef and nuts in a mixing bowl. Add tamari, chile puree and beef stock, whisk to combine. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper and taste for seasoning. If the sauce is too thin, mix in up to 2 tablespoons of water until it tastes right. Heat grill pan to medium, or heat flat griddle. Thread beef, about 2 tablespoons per skewer, onto soaked skewers and grill until medium rare, about 3 minutes for the beef and 1 1/2+ minutes for the nut mixture. Serve as is, or chill and serve over jasmine rice.

title: Chinese Sesame Date Balls
ingredients: 200 g dried dates, soaked to soften | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 4 tablespoons five-spice powder
instructions: Using your finger rub the date mixture into the sesame oil. Then sprinkle five spice over the top. Place into your fridge to keep cold. These are best when they are not longer than 20 minutes. Break apart into small pieces when cooled. Enjoy.

title: Tomato Bouhoku from the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 package medium egg noodles | 1/2 cup drambuie | 1 large cup tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon light agave nectar or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 teaspoon dijuie grated fresh lemon peel | 1/3 cup gorgonzola
instructions: Cook egg noodles in a large pot of boiling, salted water until just done, about 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Sticky Beef Tenderloin, Mango Chutney, and Salt and Pepper
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef tenderloin ( or 1 whole tenderloin, cut about 1/2-in thick ) | 12 lasagna noodles ( about 1/3 cup dry noodles ) | 4 cups mango chutney ( see note ) | 4 tablespoons salad dressing, any flavor
instructions: If your tenderloin does not have the desired thickness, cut smaller tenderloin. If it does, cut to fit noodles lengthwise. In a 12x16 baking dish, spread 2 tablespoons of salad dressing on both sides of slices of meat. Arrange 4 noodles lengthwise on top of the meat. Top with 2 cups of the mango chutney and 1 cup of the mango chutney mixture. Repeat layers until beef is all exposed. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator and let stand at room temperature 1 hour or until the beef is completely chilled and begins to dry out. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Bake covered 15 minutes. Remove cover and bake an additional 20 minutes, or until a thermometer reaches 140 degrees. Let stand a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: rum,salad oil,cracker,whipping cream,picante sauce,anchovy fillet,fenugreek leaf,raisin
title: Fried Oysters
ingredients: 1/3 cup salad oil | 1/2 cup rum | crushed fenugreek leaves ( a pinch or two ) | 3 cups whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 18 large crackers | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add rum, crushed fenugreek and cream and heat slowly until thick, but not boiling. Remove from heat and stir in picante sauce. Place crackers and raisins in separate piles on wax paper lined baking sheets. Place about 1/3 cup hot cream mixture on each. Broil or broil until top is bubbly and golden, about 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,peanut,cabbage,tomato green chilies,lukewarm milk,green lentil
title: Easiest Indian Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentil, rinsed and picked over ( i use browned green soybeans ) | 4 cups cubed cabbage | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 - 3/4 cup green lentil, rinsed and rinsed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup peanuts ( optional ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Boil the lentils until cooked through, about 45 to 60 minutes depending on size of lentils.

title: Easy Mexican-Style Chopped Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 medium cucumbers, peeled, cut into julienne strips | 1 anaheim chili, seeded sliced into thin rings
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add the cucumbers, and cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in the chile and cook 3 additional minutes, stirring, until chile is tender crisp. Move vegetables to a large baking sheet lined with foil. Dot with a small amount of the cooking oil, and season with salt and pepper. Bake the vegetables in the preheated oven about 5 minutes, or until lightly browned and the juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,blueberry,cream celery soup,chicken bouillon cube,halibut fillet
title: Holly's Blueberry Halibut
ingredients: 5 bone-in halibut fillets | 3 cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 3 cans condensed cream of celery soup | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place fish in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour pinto beans with liquid into a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Dissolve bouillon cubes in soup, stirring until dissolved. Pour soup mixture over fish. Bake 35 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Top with blueberries during the last 10 minutes of baking. Bake 10 to 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: corn,corn oil,flax seed,almond,sharp cheddar cheese,beef gravy
title: Cottage Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flax seeds | 2 tablespoons flax seeds | 3 tablespoons ground almonds | 2 2/3 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese or 2 2/3 cups swiss cheese | 1 can low fat beef gravy | 1 1/3 cups low-fat stewed corn or 1 1/3 cups frozen corn | corn oil, for deep frying
instructions: Heat 1/2 teaspoon oil in a frying pan. Toast flax and flaxseed in oil for 30 - 45 seconds. Combine 1/3 of flax and flaxseed mixture. Add rest of flaxseed, and stir thoroughly. Stir in the cheese. Spread on a greased and floured pie plate. Press flours evenly over top. Bake at 325 f for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: currant,ra el hanout spice mix,parsley flake,white mushroom,hunt tomato sauce,cucumber,cumin
title: Quick and Easy Tomato Sauce for Shabbat
ingredients: 1 jar tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 3/4 cup seedless cucumber, coarsely diced | 8 -12 large white mushrooms, coarsely diced | 4 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried currant
instructions: Put all ingredients except for currants into a blender. Blend well. Add the currants and blend just until all ingredients are mixed. You may need to pass through a fine mesh strainer to remove all solids.

title: Lettuce Leaf, Restaurant Style
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, minced | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon greek oregano or 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried oregano | 6 large lettuce leaves | 2 cups rice, cooked and cooled | ice cube
instructions: Pour tomato sauce into blender and blend until smooth. Add remaining ingredients, except lettuce, and blend until salsa is thick and smooth. Tear lettuce leaves into bite size pieces. Spoon salsa mixture into a large platter and top with lettuce.

title: Mushroom and Endive Salad
ingredients: 1 cup button mushrooms, sliced | 2 ounces chives, sliced | 1/2 cup vinaigrette dressing
instructions: Mix together mushrooms, chives and salad dressing. Chill.

title: Nnam Pla (Yemenite Bread)
ingredients: 1/2 lb thickly sliced white bread | nam pla ( thai sweet pepper ), to taste
instructions: The nam pla is optional. Soak bread in lukewarm water for 10 minutes. Drain water and squeeze out excess water. Cut bread 1 thickly and lay flat on a work surface. Sprinkle a little nnam pla on top of each bread slice. Fold slice like a flag or you can fold a flag over the top of the bread slices. Heat a skillet over medium heat and fry bread in hot fat until bread is crisp and toasted. Turn the toast over so that the bread slices are evenly coated with some of the nam pla, and continue cooking until heated through. Sprinkle with more nam pla to serve.

title: Italian Beef  Chuck Roast
ingredients: 1 inch fresh ginger, grated ( about 2-1/2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/8 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 4 lbs stewing beef
instructions: In a small bowl, combine ginger and chili flakes and set aside. Sprinkle roast with italian seasoning and rub well with ginger mixture. Let beef sit at room temperature for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Pinch ends of the roast and tie with kitchen twine. Place on rack in roasting pan or baking pan. Pre heat oven to 275 degrees fahrenheit. Cover tightly with aluminum foil or parchment paper and bake for 2 1/2 hours or until meat is fork tender. Turn once during this time. Remove paper and foil and replace with foil over pan. Serve meat warm or cold.

title: Pancetta Appetizer
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red chili paste | 3/4 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons pancetta, chopped ( may substitute bacon ) | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Mix everything together with your hands until you have a really smooth and thick mix. Store in a dry place. If you want to freeze it for later use, just add a bit more orange juice.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,flour tortilla,chili sauce,cauliflower,taco shell,lime
title: Cauliflower Tacos
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, chopped | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 20 taco shells, warmed | 12 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 lime, quartered
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cauliflower in a medium saucepan, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then cook until crisp tender, about 4 minutes. Drain, and place in a bowl. Stir the soup and sweet chili sauce into the cauliflower. Spoon soup mixture into warm taco shells, and arrange in a circle on a cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until warmed through, 5 to 7 minutes. Garnish with avocado slices, chopped tomato, and shredded lettuce leaves. Serve with a sliced lime wedge.

title: Apple Vinegar
ingredients: 2 -3 small tart apples | 1 1/3 cups raw rice vinegar ( may need more ) | 1 cup water
instructions: Peel the apples and slice them in half lengthwise, then slice them in half again to make about four thick slices. Set the slices aside in a large bowl. While the apples are making the vinaigrette.

title: Moroccan Dressing (Qormeh Sabzi)
ingredients: 4 teaspoons caraway seeds ( tahini ) | 2 2/3 cups cooking oil
instructions: Grind the caraway seeds with a mortar and pestle or on the cutting board in a spice or small coffee grinder. If the seeds start to burn before the seeds are ground, they can cause a bitter smell to go into the oil. Add the oil, stirring, until thick and smooth. Stir in the tahini and leave to develop.

title: Cherry Rhubarb Glaze for Mascarpone Cheese
ingredients: 1/3 cup golden syrup | 1/3 cup molasses | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 10 lbs ladyfingers, separated | 2 cups dried, chopped rhubarb | 2 cups maraschino cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine syrup, molasses, half and half and ladyfingers in large bowl. Arrange 1/2 of croissants on large greased baking sheet. In 1 - 2 batches sprinkle ladyfingers with molasses mixture.

title: Homemade Sage and Pepper Rub
ingredients: 1 lb fresh sage leaf | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Cut the sage leaves into large pieces. Place a piece of butter in a mortar with the salt and mortar and pestle and work into the leaves, using a knife, until they become ribbony and slightly soft. Using a mortar and pestle, work the mixed ingredients into a coarse paste. The rubbed sage will keep, covered and refrigerated for up to a month.

title: Acapulco Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice ( risotto rice from the risotto store ) | 2 cups coconut cream | 1/2 cup tequila | 2 cups guacamole | 2 tablespoons rice wine ( or brandy ) | 2 -2 slices peaches ( optional, i don't add these, it is vegetarian, says the chef )
instructions: Place arborio rice and coconut cream in a pot, simmer for approximately 15 - 20 minutes, don't over cook, and add more coconut cream if needed, you don't need to. Stir in tequila, add rice wine if you need it. Stir well and let stand for about 10 minutes on the lowest heat before eating, this will not hold well. To serve, spread guacamole on top of each portion. Sprinkle peaches on top.

title: Coconut Chicken Breast Breast
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast half, pounded to about 1/2 inch thickness | 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 2 cans coconut milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a baking dish or casserole dish. Arrange the chicken breasts in the dish, and pour the mascarpone over them. Top each breast with coconut milk and cover with aluminum foil. Bake for about 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.

title: Walnut Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup walnut pieces | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce
instructions: Dredge meat in flour and saute until browned. Add soy sauce. Turn up heat to high and stir in nuts and cook until nuts are heated through.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,lasagna noodle,enchilada sauce,italian parsley,cognac,white potato
title: French Beef and Potatoes in Marinara
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup cognac | 12 white potatoes, peeled | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 16 lasagna noodles, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place stew meat and enchilada sauce in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cognac. Add potatoes and parsley and toss to coat. Arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish with the overlapping ends of the aluminum foil overlapping the potatoes slightly. Bake at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes. Add cooked noodles and bake 30 minutes longer. Serve and enjoy.

title: Oaxacan Colombian Cheese (Colombian Sausage and Cabbage)
ingredients: 8 slices bread ( thick slices are best ) | 1 head savoy cabbage, about 1 1/2 lbs. shredded ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 limes, cut into wedges ( to serve )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Cut each slice of bread in half. Wear gloves and kitchen gloves and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper about 10 inches or so inches wide. Bake at 350 degrees f, stirring every 5 minutes, until lightly toasted, about 10 to 12 minutes total, but not browned. Remove the bread from the oven and place in a large bowl. Mash the cheese in a bowl with a fork, breaking up any clumps. Add the lime wedges and mix well. Line a large colander with a towel or cheesecloth and place over a saucepan of boiling water. Carefully pour the cheese over half of the toast and toss until evenly distributed and the cheese is just coated. Leave the cheese to drain out of the tap until cool, about 20 minutes. Slice the remaining bread in half and arrange on a platter. Cut the cheese into 1/2 inch slices and arrange on top of the toast.

title: Quick and Easy English Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup cooked chick-peas | 1 cup rye flour
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Drain and rinse chick peas well in a strainer. Place in a medium size bowl. Stir in flour until mixture forms a stiff dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured board. Shape dough into 1 inch rounds. Wrap each round with foil. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,chili pepper flake,tart shell,brown sugar,sugar,cream tartar,rice wine
title: Raspberry and Red Bell Pepper Tart Shells
ingredients: 1 package round tart shells ( shells for a 10 crust, or individual shells for 8 crusts ) | 1 cup sliced red bell peppers or 1 cup other fresh red bell pepper | 3 -4 ounces brown sugar ( or more to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried sweet chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon light cream of tartar | sugar, to taste | whipped cream, to serve
instructions: Arrange the tart shells on a baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees f for about 5 to 10 minutes, until puffed slightly. Remove from oven, remove from baking sheets, and let cool. Arrange the peppers on a platter. Sprinkle with the brown sugar, dried chili flakes, and light cream of tartar. Drizzle the tart shells with a little bit of the cream. Replace the baking sheets with a sheet of foil on top and invert onto the platter. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,dill,sunflower oil,peanut oil,chili sauce,linguine,double cream,arborio rice
title: Tasty Peanut Sauce Linguica
ingredients: 1 cup dry multi-grain rice ( or short grain brown rice ) | 10 tablespoons sunflower oil ( or peanut oil. ) | 1/2 cup vegetable ( frozen ) | 1 3/4 cups double cream | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill or 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 jar sun-roasted mixed vegetables, in jar, in sauce ( thawed, drained ) | 300 g linguica
instructions: Cook the rice according to the package instructions except, use a little water or vegetable stock to loosen the rice.

title: Ginger Wine Paste
ingredients: 3/4 cup ginger paste | 3/4 cup green wine
instructions: Combine these ingredients. To do this, add a teaspoon of this paste to 1 cup of hot water and stir well.

title: Spicy Coriander Soup Broth
ingredients: 3 cans broth | 1/4 cup coriander powder | 1 -3 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 dash pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium cooking pot and heat on med heat until hot. Enjoy.

title: Seared Lettuce Neapolitan Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles or 12 baby mesclun | 2 heads iceberg lettuce or 2 heads cabbage | 4 cups sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat over to 375 degrees. Mix vinegar with 2 tblsps. Water. In 13 x 9 baking dish, spray with nonstick cooking oil. Arrange 4 noodles in single layer. Top with 1 3/4 cups each of lettuce and 1/2 cup of water. Lay noodles out in a single layer. Drizzle with 1st set of vinegar mixture/water mixture. Repeat, layering ingredients as follows, top with 1/4 cup water. Add 1tsp. Water. Top with lasagna, noodles, and remaining 1/4 cups water. Cover with foil and bake til liquid just evaporates. Uncover and bake til top browns.

title: Auberge Espresso Blend
ingredients: 1/2 cup amchresso powder | 1/4 cup dry farina ( farina ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage, or to taste
instructions: Mix amchresso powder, farina, and sage in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until flavors have blended, at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: cream sherry,roasting chicken,red onion,red chile,cilantro,ginger,jicama,pizza crust
title: Moroccan Chicken and Jicama Pizza
ingredients: 2 lbs roasting chickens | 1/2 cup cream sherry | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger | 1 1/2 tablespoons cilantro or 1 1/2 tablespoons parsley | 1 1/2 tablespoons red onion | 1 1/2 tablespoons jicama | 2 red chiles, deseeded | 4 sheets refrigerated pizza crust ( or homemade )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400, or place a cookie sheet on the middle rack of the oven. Cut a slit on the side of the chicken and poke through skin with a skewer. Place chicken in a roasting pan. Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes. Drain chicken and turn over. Toss with sherry, ginger, cilantro, onion, jicama, and chiles. Bake for 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear. Turn chicken over. Remove from oven and spread out the pizza crust, cut sides up, on the baking pan. Arrange chicken and sauce on the crust. Replace oven and bake for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and slice.

title: Sweet and Sour Corned Beans
ingredients: 1 can baked corn with beans | 1 can baked beans | 1 head cabbage, sliced | 3 tablespoons sweet and sour sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, break corn out of the can of beans. Drain the baked beans, and mix them with the hot sauce, making sure all of the corn and beans are covered. In a large pot over medium heat, heat 1 tablespoon of oil, and place a layer of cabbage in the pot. When almost fully cooked, add a layer of sweet and sour bean mixture until complete. Continue to layer the cabbage until all of the ingredients have been used, ending with the sweet and sour sauce on top. Cook for at least 30 minutes, or until the cabbage is cooked and bubbly.

title: Gnocchi Bolognese
ingredients: 2 english cucumbers | 1/2 teaspoon mixed italian herbs | 2 slices pancetta, cut into thin strips | 6 ounces italian-style cheese, grated | 1 1/4 cups bean sprouts
instructions: Slice the cucumbers vertically, and then crosswise into rounds, or cut them in long strips, if your finger tips were visible. Rub the sliced cucumbers with vegetable oil or olive oil.

title: Cheddar Pear and Saffron Dampekins
ingredients: 6 large pears ( about 6-9 pears ) | 2 cans cheddar cheese soup ( can be purchased in most health food stores ) | 1 pinch saffron ( a pinch ) | 6 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Peel, core & cut pear into 6 wedges. Place on cookie sheet, top each with one can of cheddar cheese soup. Bake until heated through & bubbly.. Remove from oven, sprinkle with saffron & fluff gently. Serve immediately with rice or noodles.

title: Simple Microwave Pecans (Or Peanut Cookies)
ingredients: 1 cup pecans | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: In a small bowl, mix pecans and 3 tablespoons of oil. Dip a plate or biscuit cutter into oil and press cookies in into pecans. Cover and let sit 10 minutes on high before drying out on a paper towel.

title: Crispy Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Combine mustard, italian seasoning, and 2 teaspoons water in a shallow bowl. Coat vegetables with spice mixture. Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Place vegetables in a shallow roasting pan. Bake in preheated oven 30 minutes, stirring twice, until vegetables are tender and roasted crisp.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,honey,marshmallow,pineapple,chinese five spice powder,corn tortilla strip,arborio rice,garam masala
title: Pineapple and Marshmallow Rice Pudding
ingredients: 4 slices pineapple, chopped fine | 8 ounces honey ( low sodium ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( fresh ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder ( or mix all 1 spice powder together ) | 2 lbs arborio rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons garam masala | 12 corn tortilla strips | 8 ounces miniature marshmallows ( optional )
instructions: Place pineapple in blender and puree until smooth. Add honey, juice, and five spice powder and mix well. In a large saucepan, steam rice for 5 minutes over medium heat stirring occasionally, or until slightly firm. Add garam masala and stir until melted. Add rice mixture and stir until well combined. Preheat oven to 400°f wrap each tortilla strip around each marshmallow and secure with toothpicks. Place in a baking dish coated with cooking spray. Spray each toothpick liberally with cooking spray and bake for 20 minutes then set aside. When serving warm up the rice pudding in bowls and top with additional marshmallow or papaya.

title: Sesame Seeds for Dining
ingredients: 1 cup sunflower seeds, toasted | 1 -2 cup dark corn syrup or 1 -2 cup molasses
instructions: Place sunflower seeds in a bowl and cover with warm water. Leave to stand 15 or 30 minutes. Drain. Place sunflower seeds and dark corn syrup in a frying pan and boil, stirring constantly, until the syrup has reduced to half or, if using molasses, add the seeds gradually. When it has come to the end of cooling, spoon mixture into sterilized jars. Pour hot syrup into a small pot and boil for 1 minute. Seal with sterilised lids screw on tight.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,orange liqueur,white mushroom,nutmeg,celery rib,red wine vinegar,beer,iceberg lettuce
title: Wild Rice,  Italian Lettuce Salad (Copycat)
ingredients: 12 leaves iceberg lettuce, washed, dried, torn into bite size pieces | 1 small green bell pepper, finely chopped | 8 -10 white mushrooms, sliced | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 1 cup orange liqueur | 1 1/2 cups dry red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups beer, cold ( corona or anneheim ) | nutmeg, to sprinkle
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large serving bowl. Toss lightly to mix. Let set for 3 minutes before serving.

title: Sauerkraut Fish With Carrots, Apples and Jam
ingredients: 6 ounces sauerkraut | 1 tart apple | 1/2 cup sweet sherry wine | 2 -3 ounces white fish fillets | 4 -6 jalapenos or 1/2 cup green chili, minced
instructions: Put sauerkraut, apple, sherry, fish and peppers into a pan, cover and let simmer on low heat for 30 to 40 minutes. When ready, transfer contents from pan to a bowl. Cut fish into small serving pieces, arrange in a spoke fashion on top of sauerkraut, and put under a broiler for 3 to 5 minutes, or until fish is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,golden syrup,green curry paste,red pepper,poppy seed
title: Sweet Red Pepper
ingredients: 20 small red pepper ( red capsicum ) | 1 tablespoon yellow curry paste ( or less depending on taste ) | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Heat wok over a medium high heat, add sesame oil and when oil is beginning to swirl, add the red capsicum and stir fry for a couple of minutes. Remove from heat and stir in all the other ingredients. Chill until serving time.

title: Chilean Black Shells #5FIX
ingredients: 1 tablespoon onion salt | 1 tablespoon ground black olives | 1/2 cup scallion, chopped | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | 1 can tomato paste
instructions: Stir together the salt, olives, scallions and chocolate. Pour over the saute vegetables and serve. Store in the refrigerator and eat within a few hours.

Random Ingredients: tea,self rising flour,red apple,cottage cheese,alfredo sauce
title: Omega's Fruit & Cheese Scones
ingredients: 2 cups wholemeal self-rising flour | 1 package low-fat cottage cheese | 1 can red apple & apple chunky spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon ground tea | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan-reggiano cheese or 1/2 cup romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine all ingredients using a mixer, process until a dough forms. If mixture is dry, add a little water. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and divide into two sections. Roll each section into a circle, top with a heaping tablespoons of the cheese to fit onto each one. Then cut into eight wedges. Repeat with remaining dough, cheese, and apple and roll up like a swiss roll.

title: A Guacamole
ingredients: 3 hass avocadoes | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 3 whole cloves | 1 packet chicken bouillon ( or other brand ) | 2 tablespoons brandy sprinkles ( optional )
instructions: Halve, peel and pit the avocados. Remove pit and discard. Place into a sieve or cheesecloth and squeeze them out of their skins by holding each half with a spoon or clean flat spoon. Squeeze out as much excess liquid as possible and place in the bowl of a food processor. Add the remaining ingredients and blend. Makes about 2 cups.

Random Ingredients: wheat germ,bell pepper,french baguette,egg,dark molasses,cellophane noodle,italian dressing,cardamom pod
title: Quick Bread Rolls
ingredients: 1 jar brown sugar molasses | 1/2 cup dark molasses | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 2 large french baguettes, split | 1 large bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1/2 1/2-inch thick slices | 2 tablespoons italian dressing | 6 whole cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon whole wheat germ | 1 tablespoon cellophane noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the glaze ingredients. Cut the bread diagonally into 1 inch slices, placing 1 slice at a time on waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: chuck,sherry,self raising flour,orange juice,apricot,lime juice zest
title: South American Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 tablespoon lime juice ( zest of, grated fresh lime works well too ) | 1/4 cup apricot, chopped | 3 tablespoons dry sherry or 3 tablespoons red wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Mix together all the ingredients except the sherry. Shape into 24 small balls. Line with foil and put in a roasting pan. Bake for 30 minutes or until cooked through. Serve hot with sautéed potatoes, sausages or fried apple wedges.

Random Ingredients: navel orange,sparkling water,yellow bell pepper,garlic salt
title: Confited Sizzling Citrus Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 4 yellow bell peppers | 2 tablespoons garlic salt | 3/4 cup granulated sugar ( i like the flavor, but if it is not as sweet as you can add ) | 1/4 cup sparkling water
instructions: Slice the peppers lengthwise in half, and remove tough seeds by slicing them in half again at stem. Discard seeds, stems and ribs. Place bell peppers in a medium glass bowl and sprinkle with garlic salt. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 5 minutes. Peel off the plastic wrap and discard. Place peels in a dry saucepan and add enough sparkling water to cover. Simmer until peppers are soft but not mushy. Do not boil. Puree peppers in a blender or food processor until smooth. Transfer to a large, resealable plastic bag and add sugar. Seal bag and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Shake bottles well to remove sugar from mixture.

title: Golden Nugget's Guilt Free Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces gin | 1 lime wedge | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill
instructions: In a cocktail shaker filled with ice, combine the gin, lime juice, turmeric, and dill. Shake vigorously. Strain into a cocktail glass about 2/3 full of ice cubes. Serve immediately. Garnish with an orange slice.

Random Ingredients: red wine,chili pepper,fish sauce,bailey irish cream,catsup,vodka,green
title: Chinese Barbecue Style Beef (Bbq) Sandwiches
ingredients: 500 g thin cut buns | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 tablespoon vodka | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon red wine | 1 tablespoon green sweet chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper, finely chopped ( red or green )
instructions: Heat up the barbecue grill. Combine all ingredients, except buns, in a bowl. Slice buns and place tops on grill. Pour the bbq over the top of the barbeque.

title: Baked Malibu Rotini
ingredients: 500 g rotini pasta | 3/4 cup tomato juice | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1/2 cup malibu rum
instructions: Cook and drain pasta. Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased oven proof dish. Bake at 180 c for 25 minutes.

title: Moroccan Rice Balls
ingredients: 2 cups milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup cooked brown rice | 2 slices fresh fish ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom or 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Combine ricotta crumbles, brown rice, fish, and cardamom in a bowl using your hands. Shape mixture into 1 1/2 inch balls. Place in a greased baking dish and bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes, until slightly browned around the edges.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,rose water,savory,sunflower seed,pearl barley
title: Rose Nests and Dried Peanuts
ingredients: 250 g pearl barley | 100 g golden cherokee rose petals or 100 g sunflower seeds | 300 g graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 2 tablespoons sage
instructions: In a mixing bowl, dissolve cherokee pearl in a little hot water. Drain well. Mix the rice cracker crumbs with graham cracker and sunflower seeds. Drain the pearl and add to the mixture. Add sunflower seeds, sprinkle liberally with sage and mix well. Drop by teaspoons into rapidly boiling water. When they rise, remove from the water using a slotted spoon or a slotted spoon. Sprinkle with more sage.

title: Lebanese Fennel Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pine nuts | 3 fennel bulbs, chopped ( about 1 1/2 lbs. ) | 8 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease 9 x 13 inch baking pan. In large skillet, toast pine nuts over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Remove skillet from heat. Cut fennel into strips using tip of knife, about 1 1/2 inch long, or a mandoline. Arrange strips on cookie sheet, cover with foil, and bake until very tender, about 20 minutes. Remove fennel from oven and cool. In food processor or blender, pulse tomatoes with their juices, and salt until coarsely chopped. Stir in hot skillet mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight for flavors to combine.

title: Southern Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 tablespoons yellow mustard ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro stems, minced | pepper, to taste
instructions: Mix together in a bowl. Note, if the yellow mustard equals 2 tablespoons more of the cilantro than the fresh cilantro.

title: Brown Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 100 g split brown lentils ( pudim ) | 100 g raisins | 4 tablespoons apple juice | 1/2 cup dried cherries ( pimento ) | 1/2 cup dried pears ( pared ) | 150 ml pineapple in juice
instructions: Place lentils, raisins, applesauce, pears and apple in a pan with 300ml of water. Bring to the boil over high heat and remove from the heat when the sauce has just reached the lentils. Cover, place in the refridgerator and set aside to soak for at least 8 hours or up to 2 days. Drain fruit from fruit with a fork, and carefully peel off dark skin from fruit. Chop fruit roughly and place into a bowl. Add lentils, pears and pineapple to fruit and toss until well mixed. Add remaining fruit and toss until everything is well distributed. If salad seems too dry, add oil or apple juice, and mix well.

title: Brussels Sprouts Chips
ingredients: 8 large brussels sprouts, rinsed and dried | 3 tablespoons oil | 1 cup shredded provolone cheese | assorted crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Brush sprouts with oil and spread out in a single layer on the hot baking sheet. Bake until lightly browned on the edges, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and continue baking until cheese melts, about 5 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,lemon zest,tomato paste,vegetable oil,peanut oil vegetable,cubanelle pepper,sumac
title: Homer's Tabouli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/2 zesty vegetable oil | 1 cubanelle pepper, cut into 1/4 in cubes | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest or 1/4 teaspoon grated lime rind | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 3/4 teaspoon ground sumac | 2 tablespoons chopped dry roasted peanuts or 2 tablespoons dry roasted cashews
instructions: In a saucer, toss the cubanelle pepper with 1/4 teaspoon vegetable oil. Toss the pepper pieces with the zest and remaining 2 tablespoons oil, salt, lemon or lime oil and tomato paste, and let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a skillet, heat the ground dry roasted nuts until they begin to colour. Sprinkle with the sumac and add the red pepper mixture while stirring. Add a few spoonfuls of the tabouli. The last ladleful should be a rich brown color.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,spaghetti squash,orzo pasta,pickle juice,marjoram,fontina cheese,date,phyllo pastry
title: Chef John's Macaroni Grill Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package uncooked orzo pasta | 1 spaghetti squash, halved and cut crosswise into 1 inch wide strips | 1 cup shredded fontina cheese | 3 tablespoons pickle juice, divided | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon prepared marjoram, or to taste | 1/4 cup crumbled fontina cheese | 3 sheets frozen chopped, roasted green marinated dates, thawed | 1 sheet frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the orzo, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Meanwhile, place the spaghetti squash on a plate. Cover with a plate and set aside. Cook and stir the fontina cheese in a skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until melted, about 5 minutes. Whisk in 2 tablespoons of pickle juice, vinegar, marjoram and 1/4 cup of the fontina cheese. Stir in the cooked orzo and 1/4 cup of the fontina cheese. Place the whole roasted green marinated dates in the refrigerator for 30 minutes, or until cool to the touch and the mixture can be covered. Once the pasta has cooked, drain, and divide among 4 serving plates. Top with half of the orzo mixture, half of the remaining half of the vegetable zucchini strips, half of the remaining vegetable zucchini strips, half of the remaining 2 tablespoons fontina cheese. Repeat with 1/4 cup fontina cheese, 1/4 cup of the pickle juice, and 1 teaspoon of the roasted green marjoram. Top with remaining orzo mixture, sunflower seed crumbles, olives, and remaining 1/4 cup fontina cheese. Serve.

title: Fish With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 6 cooked catfish fillets or 6 other firm textured fish | 1 cup canned chickpeas, drained | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 1/2 cup mixed berries
instructions: Mix the parsley, 1/4 cup of the chickpeas and 1/4 cup of the pineapple in a bowl. Toss with the fish, cover and marinate in the fridge for 1 hour. Combine the remaining 1/4 cup of chick peas and 1/2 cup of the pineapple mixture. Spoon half onto each of the plates. Spoon half the bean mixture onto the beans.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,bread,herbes de provence,pistachio,chicken breast,cocoa powder,liquid smoke,leek
title: Smokey Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 ounces chicken breasts, skinless, boneless, skinless, diced chicken | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1 ounce pistachios, chopped | 1 wholemeal bread, unsalted, to toast | powdered icing sugar | liquid smoke
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large non stick frying pan, bring to the boil, cover and simmer on low for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Place pan under another burner and turn the heat up very low. Watch for any signs of burning or sticking to the pan. Toast bread. Spoon equal amounts of chicken filling into bread, drizzle with liquid smoke and sprinkle with rawspicebar’s sugar.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,pecan,red onion,yellow bell pepper,grape tomato,malt vinegar,swiss cheese
title: Cottage Cheese and Veggie Saute
ingredients: 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/8 inch strips | 1 red onion, cut into thin wedges | 1/2 cup diced swiss cheese | 1 container grape tomatoes, drained, cut in half | 1/3 cup malt vinegar | 1/3 cup light-colored pecan pieces | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add bell pepper, onion and cheese. Stir to coat. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add tomatoes, vinegar and pecan pieces, if desired. Cover, reduce heat to low and cook for 3 minutes, stirring, until cheese begins to melt.

Random Ingredients: rice,wheat flour,almond extract,part mozzarella cheese,ziti pasta,roast beef
title: Ziti Con Carne with Beef and Rice
ingredients: 1 lb lean deli sliced roast beef | 1 cup rice | 1 can sliced deli sliced ziti pasta | 1 lb shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked rotel tomatoes and green chilies ( mexican style )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. In 10 inch skillet, cook roast beef over medium heat 5 minute or until browned.

Random Ingredients: rose petal,table salt,oil vegetable,baby spinach,italian bread,bacon,half,black bean
title: Low Fat Rose Petal, Black Beans and Spinach Pancake
ingredients: 3 slices cooked bacon, minced | 1/4 teaspoon table salt, more to taste | 3 tablespoons half-and-half | 3 tablespoons oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 8 -10 leaves baby spinach | 1 cup fat-free refried black beans | 1/2 cup fat-free half-and-half | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning, i used mccormick's montreal brand | 1 tablespoon rose petal
instructions: Heat oil in a non stick skillet over medium high heat. Add bacon and salt and pepper to taste. Add the cooked bacon and a few spinach leaves and stir for about 20 seconds to allow the spinach to brighten a bit.

title: Gourmet Roast Beef
ingredients: 6 lbs rump roast or 6 lbs chuck roast | 2 cans sweet whole cashews | 2 -3 habanero peppers, seeds removed ( optional ) | 1 cup dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup soy sauce
instructions: If you cannot find your own habanero chille pepper, substitute with serrano chili flakes, or hot sauce. If your roast is too large, cut through the meat from the tip below. Using a meat mallot, roughly chop the chile pepper pods. If you cannot find them, just use regular whole chile pods in a pinch. Cut the roast in half crosswise, then crosswise. Remove some of the stem, seed bits from the roast and trim excess fat, then combine with the chile mixture in a large, heavy duty zip lock plastic bag. Add the cashews to the bag. Squeeze out air and seal. Remove the strings and seeds from the bag, squeezing out as much air as possible. Reserve the remaining cavity of the roast. In a shallow dish, whisk the bread crumbs with the soy sauce until thoroughly combined. Dredge the roast in the bread crumb mixture. Shake off any excess. Refrigerate for as long as possible, or refrigerate overnight, turning once or twice during that time. To cook, place the roast on a rack in a roasting pan and roast at 300 degrees f for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. If you need a meat thermometer that reaches a temperature of 140 degrees, carefully tent the roast loosely with foil and put in a cold oven. The roast should be thermometer inserted into the center of the roast, not touching the bone. You may need to b check on the degree of doneness, basting periodically with the pan liquids, by removing the foil. Remove from oven and set aside to rest for 20 minutes before slicing.

title: Bread and Cheese Gratinata
ingredients: 2 cups cubed swiss cheese | 4 ounces baguette, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 4 tablespoons part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange rind | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | soft baguette ( optional ) or softened bread stick ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl toss the swiss cheese, baguette slices, mozzarella cheese, orange peel and mace with your hands, until evenly coated. Spread the baguette slices with the melted mozzarella cheese. Arrange in the bottom of a lightly buttered baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and brush with the soft bread stick. Broil or bake for an additional 5 - 7 minutes or until toasted.

title: Pepper Nachos
ingredients: 8 ounces corn chips | 1 tablespoon beef stock | 1 green pepper, finely diced | grated nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Dry the chips with paper towels, then sprinkle with nutmeg. Place in a single layer on a hot, lightly oiled baking sheet. Broil, grill or fry the nachos until the chips get slightly tan around the edges, about 1 minute. Move them to side, then move the green pepper in the last 4 - 5 minutes to heat through. Remove the chips and serve straight away.

title: Tortellini Cheese
ingredients: 2 packages cheese tortellini | freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( enough to lightly coat the tini stuff ) | 3/4 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the tortellini for about 6 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,chili pepper flake,white button mushroom,red wine vinegar,black bean,italian sausage
title: Italian Sausages Skewers With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausage | 3 ounces white button mushrooms, sliced | 2 pinches chili pepper flakes ( optional or add in extra chili pepper flakes, to taste ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs ( coarsely grated ) | black beans, drained
instructions: Slice italian sausage into 1/4 inch slices. Thread italian sausage onto large skewers. Sprinkle the sausage with chili flakes. Mix the vinegar and panko together, add to skewers. Place on skewers. Cover with foil or a piece of plastic wrap or aluminium foil. Wrap aluminum foil over them. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat the grill to medium. Remove from skewers and thread onto metal or soaked wooden skewers. Grill them over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes turning once, until they are cooked to your liking.

title: Crunchy Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat spaghetti | 2 heads bok choy, chopped | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons dry sherry
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, 8 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,red chili pepper,pizza crust,pork
title: Quick Chili Calzones
ingredients: 0.5 package pizza crust ( such as boboli or boboli brand ) | 1 lb ground pork | 1 small dried hot red chili pepper | 4 dried hot red chili peppers
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f and prepare pizza crust,. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Cook ground pork until browned.

title: Apricot and Strawberry Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh apricots, halved, pitted and peeled or 8 ounces canned apricots, drained | 1 tablespoon fennel seed ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons breadcrumbs | fresh ground black pepper | 5 -6 firm ripe strawberries, cleaned of stems
instructions: Preheat grill to high. In large nonreactive dish, add cut up ripe apricots and 1 tbsp of the fennel seeds. Sprinkle with pepper, to taste. Dip strawberries into remaining fennel seeds, shaking off excess. Dredge in breadcrumbs, pressing to adhere. Grill for 3 minutes or until slightly browned and firm. Transfer to board, cut into wedges. Serve on a platter, warm or at room temperature.

title: Pistachio-Chive Polenta - Chaat
ingredients: 1/2 cup semolina ( farina ) | 1/4 cup corn tortillas | 3 tablespoons chives, chopped | 3 tablespoons pistachios, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mixed spice ( see note. chive mixed spice, 1 tsp. ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | 1/4 cup mint, chopped
instructions: If you have a blender, combine all the ingredients except the mint and mix well with a spoon.. Cut tortillas into squares and place on baking sheet. In a small bowl, mix chives and mint and sprinkle onto polenta. Broil until puffed and golden brown, about 2 minutes. Spread the polenta over the top and sprinkle the mint/herb mix on top. Broil for 5 minutes longer or until browned on top and slightly crispy.

title: Real Simple Pea Seasoning for Vegetables
ingredients: 1 package dry peas | white sugar, to taste
instructions: Place peas, sugar and white sugar in a food processor or blender. Blend until evenly mixed. If the peas are too large, you can also add 1 1/2 tablespoons of rice flour to the mixture.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,sherry wine,salt pork,poultry seasoning,breadcrumb,palm sugar
title: Roast Pork (Or Calfs)
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb salt pork | 1/4 cup curry powder | 1 tablespoon salt-free palm sugar ( can leave out ) | 1/2 cup dried breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 cup sherry wine or 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Rinse salt pork under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Score the fat at 1 inch intervals with a sharp knife. Sprinkle all sides with curry powder and palm sugar.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,anise seed,red apple,chicken wing,onion soup mix
title: Spicy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 red apples or 1 fuji apple
instructions: Brown chicken wings in fry pan. While they are cooking dice apple. After they are finished removing them from the pan fry the apple and then remove them from the pan. Place them on the bottom of the crock pot and in it add onion soup mix, cumin, ground aniseed. Place wings on top. Cover with water. Cook on low 3 - 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: beef,granny smith apple,black mustard seed,italian tomato,flour tortilla
title: Chef Flower's Quesadillas
ingredients: 3 lbs ground beef | 3 granny smith apples | 1/2 cup chopped italian tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 6 flour tortillas
instructions: Chop the apples and set aside. In a large skillet, brown ground beef over medium high heat. Add apples to the beef. Cook until the juices are cooked, and the apples are starting to become slightly crisp. Mix in the mustard seeds with a wooden spoon, until they start to pop. Turn the heat down to low and add the tomatoes. Cook over low heat until the tomatoes have softened. Warm your tortillas on a hot griddle, one at a time, and spread a scoop of the beef mixture onto your tortilla, spreading to the edges, about 1/2 inch thick. Close and enjoy with your favorite salsa. This would also be good at room temperature with spinach and olives.

title: Easy Microwave Breakfast (From Best of Bridge)
ingredients: 2 eggs at room temperature | 2 tablespoons basmati rice, to measure consistency | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt, to measure consistency
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Note, i have found that the rice is the best for me because i don't soak it all the way through. When adding rice, the ratio won't be uniform. It will have the texture of cornmeal. Cover and rest in a microwaveable dish. No water, and no lid, microwave on high for 5 - 7 minutes. Or, if rice is to thick, microwave on low for 8 - 10 minutes. If you are using rice with onion salt, omit onion salt, and you will enjoy a much tastier breakfast.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,ancho chile powder,brandy,tomato sauce
title: Ancho Chile Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons ancho chile powder | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil.

title: Spicy Asparagus Wrap
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus, cut into 1 inch pieces | 3 teaspoons ginger-garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 10 corn tortillas ( the small thin, round slices ) | lettuce, cut into small wedges | 1/2 bunch green leaf lettuce or 1/2 bunch green leaf lettuce
instructions: Place thawed asparagus on a plate and crush coarsely with a rolling pin or meat mallet. Stir in ginger garam masala, baking soda and hot chili oil. Heat tortillas on a heavy skillet for a few seconds on each side. Cut tortillas into 1/2 inch strips and serve with asparagus mixture, lettuce, green lettuce and desired accompaniments. Variation, you may wrap these in lettuce leaves after removing the tough ends at the ribs. If you are serving them to guests, remove the hard muscle and center core of the lettuce.

title: Black-Eyed Peas and Prunes
ingredients: 4 ounces dried black-eyed peas | 2 ounces unsalted butter | 20 prunes ( optional )
instructions: Soak the peas overnight. Drain and cook in a pan of boiling water for about 20 minutes or until tender. Drain, but reserve the liquid. Bring the liquid to a boil and add the butter and prunes. Reheat thoroughly. Serve warm.

title: Stir Fry Kiwi Beef
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, thinly sliced | 1 small white onion, cut into thin wedges | 1 package kiwi fruits, sliced into wedges | 2 lbs stewing beef, thinly sliced | 1 large sweet white onion, sliced into thin wedges.
instructions: Cook meat and onion in hot wok on medium heat until tender and browned.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,golden syrup,fine breadcrumb,bicarbonate soda,lemon juice zest,apricot jam,large shrimp,cayenne pepper
title: Lemon Apricot Spiced Baked Shrimp
ingredients: 2 cups plain fine breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon ground cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons apricot jam, cut into chunks | 5 -6 large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. In an ovenproof dish, combine the fine 4 meal, crumbs, cayenne pepper, bicarb, lemon rind and juice, golden syrup and apricot jam. Add shrimp. Spoon breadcrumb mixture into shrimp. Bake in the oven for 1 hour. Serve from the oven.

title: Spinach & Chili Sauce
ingredients: 500 g fresh spinach leaves | 300 g sweet chili sauce | 150 ml brandy
instructions: Wash and de stem the spinach. Chop coarsely, or leave whole if not using right away. Place in a saucepan with 300ml of water. Allow to boil until the spinach has wilted. Immediately drain the spinach in a colander. Place back in pan and add chilli sauce, brandy & chili sauce to spinach. Stir well & enjoy.

title: Ham Steak & Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 ham steak | 14 1/2 ounces plum tomatoes | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 ounce roasted salami, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Warm tomato tin foil in the oven to prevent the foil from cracking while heating. Place ham steaks on the centre of the foil. Slightly overlap each other, fold the edges over once, then place the tin in the oven. Cook for approx 25 mins then remove from oven and take out the foil. Place the tomato tin, salami slice & bacon and sliced smoked ham steaks on top of the cheese, return to oven to warm up.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Fish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 4 thick slices bacon, chopped | 1 medium yellow onion, peeled, halved and thinly sliced | 1 medium bell pepper, seeded, halved, seeded, and thinly sliced | 3/4 cup banana, sliced | 2 large fish fillets | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper, or to taste | 1/4 cup cold catsup, or to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil, and mix in cornstarch to thicken. Cook and stir bacon until evenly browned, about 5 minutes. Drain the bacon on paper towels. Heat the wok over high heat. Stir together the bacon, onion, and bell pepper in the wok.

title: Spicy Roasted Chilli Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roughly chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 1 medium red chile, halved and finely sliced | 7 ounces chinese baby penne | 1 small bunch cilantro stem, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f place the parsley, chilli, pasta and cilantro in a large bowl and add seasoning and black pepper to taste. Scoop into a large roasting tin and roast in the oven for 20 minutes. Serve with any natural accompaniment on the side.

title: Broccoli and Coconut Soup
ingredients: 1 ounce fresh broccoli | 1/2 chicken stock cube | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut cream | icing sugar, for dusting ( i use coconut flavoured sugar )
instructions: Put a steamer on the stove and put plenty of water in there. Put the stock cube in to the hot pot. Leave it for 2 - 3 minutes until the cube floats to the surface, then take it out. If there is any stalk sticking out, take it off and set it aside. Slice the broccoli and boil over medium heat for 2minutes, then drain. Put the cooked broccoli into the pot with the stock cube and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the broccoli is tender. Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the coconut cream. Put the broccoli mixture in a blender or food processor and blend until the soup becomes smooth. You may need to do this in batches. Add more coconut if the soup is too thick. Serve immediately. Dust with icing sugar.

title: A Ramzak (Persian Barley Stew)
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb meat | 4 -5 russet potatoes | 4 -6 large carrots | 2 cups water | 2 teaspoons cardamom powder
instructions: Cut lamb into bite size cubes. Cut the russet potatoes into small squares. Peel and cut carrots into thin slices. Rinse and pare meat. Pour 1 cup of water onto a pot with the meat. Add the potato, carrots, and cardamom. Stir well. Heat on low, while stewing, for 90 minutes to 1 hour. Add water when needed. After stew has cooked for 45 minutes, stir the stew and adjust seasonings as desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,pork loin,pico de gallo,salsa,mexican cheese,cardamom seed,caster sugar
title: Pepi Sour Pork Casserole - Pheasant
ingredients: 4 lbs coarsely ground pork loin | 1/2 cup pico de gallo | 3 tablespoons pico de gallo | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 3 tablespoons of good quality mexican blend cheese ( or a blend of cheeses ) | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 cup medium sized salsa | 1 tablespoon caster sugar or 1 tablespoon raw sugar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine ground pork and ingredients in large bowl or pie dish. Stir well. Bake uncovered/for 40 - 45 min.. Turn off oven and allow to cool for a few minutes. Spread pico de gallo on plate. Sprinkle pico de gallo on top. Top with cheese, salsa and raw, castor sugar. Note, prep time does not include refrigeration.

title: Quick & Easy Chicken
ingredients: 1 -2 lb chicken piece, skin on & off | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325 degrees f. Pour the tomato paste into the pan, then turn the heat up to medium. Brown the chicken well on both sides. Remove the pieces as soon as they've turned a nice golden brown. Add the tomato paste and enough water to come half way up the chicken. Stir to evenly distribute the tomato paste. Return to oven and bake, turning the pieces over every 10 - 15 minutes or so, until the sauce is bubbly & brown & the chicken pieces have a nice dark color & are cooked thru. This also can be made in a crockpot, crockpot, or stovetop. The chicken should be done in about 5 hours on low. It should be falling off the bone tender, so if you desire with it on the side, it will take closer to an hour to cook in a crockpot. Once the tomatoes begin to soften, stir them inches turn heat up to high, place the chicken in the pan & stir in the sauce to coat. Cover the chicken with some foil & cook on low for about an hour, stirring half way through to make sure the chicken has browned. If you do this, this dish reheats very well ~ if not, remove the foil and continue cooking on low for another hour, stirring the pieces to mix & reheating throughout. I serve this with my rice & veggies. You can also serve it over white rice as well. If you don't have a crockpot, you can braise it in a frying pan, or put all of the sauce into a crockpot. Heat the sauce until boiling, then remove from heat & stir to mix well with the chicken. Serve chicken over cooked rice & veggies.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,lemon peel,potato,orange liqueur juice,basil,rye flour,marjoram
title: Irish Potato Bites
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 cups prepared potato sticks ( about 6 or 8 ounces ) | 1/2 cup orange liqueur ( liqueur of choice but no sugar ) | 2 tablespoons grated lemon peel ( white ) | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 4 cups rye flour or 4 cups cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºf. Trim fat from meat. Place meat cubes into a 2 quart roasting pan or dutch oven.

title: Radish Puree
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 4 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 4 radishes, thinly sliced
instructions: Mash the potatoes in a bowl with a fork. Add the peanut butter, sugar, vinegar and radishes and stir until the mixture is combined. Make sure all the ingredients are mixed throughout.

title: Mexican Chocolate Sauce for Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 1 package mexican chocolate, chopped | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine chocolate, marinara sauce and chile.

title: Tamarind Candy (Gobhi)
ingredients: 2 cups tamarind pulp ( soaked 15 minutes or in cold water ) | 1 cup mashed pumpkin seeds ( fenugreek )
instructions: Put tamarind pulp in a large saucepan over low heat. Add the mashed pumpkin seeds and continue cooking gently, stirring often, until mixture is creamy. Transfer the mixture into an airtight container and cool, stirring frequently. Use the pulp anytime mixture becomes very thick. Remove from the heat. Cool completely.

title: Chile De Arroz-Green Pepper Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups red enchilada sauce, canned | 1 large orange bell pepper, roasted | 10 ounces red enchilada sauce, canned
instructions: Mix all ingredients well then spread in large crock pot. Cook on low for 4 hours.

title: Simple Pesto and Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas | 1 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a large skillet. Cut a slit down one side of the tortilla, then place it back into the skillet. You should end up with approximately 20 tortillas. Cook the tortillas for about 1 minute per side. Remove and sprinkle with approximately 2 tablespoons pesto per side. Serve hot with salsa and sour cream.

title: Pork Roast Provencales
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 lb fresh ground pork | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 meyer lemon
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Heat the oil in a large roasting tin on the hob over medium high heat and fry the pork for about 8 10mins each side until browned on all sides. Transfer the pork to a plate. Reduce heat to medium and add the tomato sauce, and cook for about ten mins, stirring, and then return the pork to the pan, adding the lemon zest to taste. Simmer for 10 minutes, then serve.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,half,rutabaga,wide egg noodle,green bean
title: Rødpød - Swedish Noodles & Vegetables
ingredients: 3 cups cooked wild rice or 3 cups cooked puffed rice | 6 ounces sliced green beans | 1 cup grated rutabaga or 1 cup chopped winter squash | 1 tablespoon half-and-half ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Cook rice if using wild rice mix in a small pot and bring to the boil, stir and cover to allow steam to escape. When rice is ready, stir in beans, rutabaga, and half & half, if using. Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix the flour and 1/2 of the saffron threads. Stir this into the rice mixture, and set aside for about 5 minutes to allow the rice to absorb flavor while cooking. Place the remainder of the saffron threads in another bowl or serving dish and lightly crush with a potato masher or wooden spoon. Set aside before serving. When rice is cooked, stir through the flour until it is all mixed together. Then add any additional seasoning if desired.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,maple syrup,heavy whipping cream,cooking sherry,bread crumb,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Maple Breadsticks and Cheese Balls With Optional Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup real maple syrup | 1/4 cup cooking sherry | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | toasted sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: In a medium pot, bring maple syrup to a simmer over medium heat. Whisk in sherry. Stirring occasionally, simmer until volume reduces and syrup coats the back of a metal spoon, about 12 minutes. Stir cream, bread crumbs, cheese, and a few extra drops of sesame oil into warm syrup. Transfer syrup to a bowl and let cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes. Line cookie sheets with wax paper, and dust with more sesame oil. Shape warm syrup into 24 - 1 1/2 inch diameter balls and roll in bread crumbs until coated. If using, place on baking sheets and chill until set, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bake until golden brown and crisp, 6 to 8 minutes. Let cool to room temperature, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a platter and serve warm, warm or room temperature.

title: Beef Steak with Hot Basil
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin ( or tenderloin for a tougher steak, such as top rib roast, or cut of your choice ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Cut the meat into 1/4 slices across the grain. Sprinkle the coarsely chopped basil onto the meat. Set the meat aside. Place the beef slices on a rack over a broiler pan or rack in a shallow dish. Place under the broiler, turning them several times with tongs to brown them, until the surface is bubbling. Broil on a second rack until the meat is done, about 15 to 20 minutes. Remove the beef to a cutting board and let stand for 10 minutes. Slice the meat diagonally about 1/4 inches thick and serve.

title: Farl's Laps of Potatoes
ingredients: 12 -25 medium red potatoes | 3/4 cup fresh parsley flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 480f degrees. Cut potatoes in half crosswise, scoop out all the inside except potatoes and parsley. Place into large mixing bowl and sprinkle over 3 tbsp salt and mix with a fork till combined well. Place on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet and bake in 425f degree oven for about 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Turn over half way, sprinkle with the last tbsp of salt and bake for another 15 minutes or until potatoes are crispy. Take out and serve hot or cold. Note, potatoes should not be too soft and will have a very crispy texture. I usually use approximately 7 - 8 1/2 tbsp of salt. We don't like crispy potatoes so i like to mix up the potato after 10 minutes or so. You can also mash the potatoes with a potato masher, or with a mortar and pestle, and add parsley.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,guajillo chilies,american cheese,baking soda,nutmeg,margarine
title: Queso Seco (Sopa Seco Mexican Cheese Bread)
ingredients: 1/2 lb american cheese ( mexican blend can be replaced by queso ajo blanco ) | 8 -10 tablespoons margarine | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 4 dried guajillo chilies | 4 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained
instructions: Melt the margarine with the baking soda in a saute pan. Add the chilies and let cook at medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Add the sun dried tomatos and let soak for 3 minutes. While still at room temperature, spread the sun dried tomatoes in the center of bread. The chilies should be just covering the tomatoes. Distribute the cheese in a thin layer on the top, then spread the rest of the cheese evenly on the other side. Bake in a 425°f oven until cheese is bubbly and beginning to brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,chili garlic sauce,cherry tomato,mandarin orange,baby pea,celeriac,vermouth
title: Sweet Beef and Rice Salad With Mandarin
