ingredients: 4 cups cooked long grain white vermouth or 4 cups low sodium vegetable stock | 2 -3 cups cooked extra lean ground beef | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 cup cannellini oranges, patted dry with paper towels | 1 cup mandarin orange, patted dry with paper towels | 2 tablespoons mild chili-garlic sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days prior to serving. Note that you can cook this in individual casseroles or other serving bowls, but you'll need to stir the meat in the last several minutes of cooking so as to coat the bottom of the vessel it is not drippy. Serve with the lettuce leaves.

title: Quick Caribbean Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 small cranberry beans or 1 small frozen cranberry beans | 400 g small shell pasta, small | 400 g skinned chicken thigh fillets, chopped into 1-inch cubes | 1 small chopped peeled cucumber | 400 g mexicorn, canned | 180 ml pineapple juice
instructions: Cook beans in a pan of boiling water for 1 minute. Remove from heat, cover and leave for 10 minutes. Drain. Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling water for 8 minutes or until just tender, drain. Combine pasta, chicken, cucumber and beans in a large bowl. Whisk together the pineapple juice and the juice and pour over the salad.

title: Italian White Bean Bread
ingredients: 1 can cannelloni tubes | sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Slice the cannelloni tubes in half lengthwise, and pull out the core and any soft part. This is optional. Spoon about 1 tablespoon on one side of each bean. Lay a slice of sun dried tomato on top of each bean, and drizzle with a couple tablespoons of oil. Bake in the preheated oven 15 to 20 minutes, or until lightly browned. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,whipping cream,lime,red pepper,sultana,szechuan peppercorn,velveeta cheese
title: Mexican Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 box velveeta cheese | 1 box vanilla instant pudding mix | 5 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns | 1 red pepper, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup sultana | 1 lime | 300 ml whipping cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: flour,salmon fillet,vegetable oil,cream chicken soup,arborio rice,chickpea
title: Cousin June's Salmon and Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chickpeas | 250 g tinned cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons flour | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 salmon fillets, skin on, pin bones removed, cut into bite sized pieces | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups carnarola rice
instructions: Heat oil in dutch oven. Add chickpeas, cream of chicken soup, flour and rice. Cover and simmer over a very low heat for 20 minutes, or until rice is cooked. Do not overcook. Season and serve.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,peanut oil,mexican cheese,haddock fillet,baking powder,lettuce,grain white rice
title: Armadillo
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice | 1 lb haddock fillet | 2 cups mexican blend cheese | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 teaspoons baking powder ( or 1 tbsp of oil with baking soda ) | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 4 leaves lettuce
instructions: Fry rice in 2 tbsp of oil. Set aside. Rinse and rinse fillet in cold water for several minutes. Set aside. Fry fillet in remaining oil, set aside. Fry rice a bit until fish is white and opaque. Set aside. In bowl add the cheese, soy sauce and 2 tsp salt. Mix well. Place rice in center. Spoon on fish, top with cheese mixture. Sprinkle on the rest of the cheese. Serve warm, at room temperature or cold.

title: Ginger and Parsley Appetizer - Free Form
ingredients: 500 g unsalted organic gingerroot ( peel only, it should be peeled very finely. ) | 100 g flat-leaf italian parsley, cut into 3-4 pieces
instructions: Using a paring knife, roughly cut the gingerroot into large pieces about the thickness of finger nail nail nail size. Using a food processor or sharp cheese grater, shred or pulse the ginger until the pieces are finely chopted. Pour the grated gingerroot into your food processor or blender. Process the parsley in the food processor or blender until finely chopped. Using the food processor, process until finely chopped. Add the chopped parsley and process until smooth. Using a small spoon, stuff the parsley into twist off preserving jars or spoons about 1/4 inch in diameter. Wipe the jars or spoons clean with a damp cloth. Set onto a dish or bowl in a larger rimmed or even sized quantity to collect scraps of pulp while the jars are still hot. Cover and let them stand upright at room temperature for 30 minutes before sealing and refrigerating them.

title: Simple Creamy Salmon and Chickpeas Pasta
ingredients: 400 g penne pasta | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 800 g skinless boneless salmon | 200 g chickpeas or 200 g kidney beans | 200 ml tomato soup | salt and pepper
instructions: Boil water and cook pasta according to packet directions. Pierce the salmon with a knife and add it to the water and cook according to packet instructions. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the salmon for a couple of minutes each side. Cut the chickpeas into bite sized pieces and stir into the salmon. Add the tomato soup and peas to the pan with the water and cook for about 5 minutes. Drain the pasta and pasta and return to the pan in an attractive way to allow the pasta to absorb the flavors. Pile the pasta onto 4 plates and scatter the salmon and chickpeas over them. Serve straight away with a salad spinner and lots of parmesan.

title: Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup horseradish | 1 garlic clove
instructions: Mix together. I love horseradish and garlic, so feel free to season to your taste or leave the garlic out and make a fresh mix of it.

title: Lebanese Applesauce-Mint Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups applesauce | 1/2 cup flour | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional ) | 6 strips prosciutto ham | 1 chili pepper flakes, crushed with seeds or 1 teaspoon chili powder ( optional ), or more | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place apple sauce in a saucepan or large heavy bottomed skillet. Add flour, vanilla bean, and a few drops of your favourite chili paste/sizzle sauce or vegetable oil. Stir until combined. Turn heat to medium. When sauce begins to bubble and thicken, add prosciutto. Cook until prosciutto starts to brown. As soon as you add other ingredients, it will begin to turn brown. Add mint.

title: Quick Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 cans garbanzo beans, drained | 2 teaspoons hot sauce ( i like tabasco ) | additional hot sauce ( i like frank's red hot ) ( optional )
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a skillet over medium heat. Add chickpeas, cover and cook 8 - 10 minutes, until heated through. Stir together hot sauce and tabasco.

title: Pizzagaini
ingredients: 1 burrito-size flour tortilla | 1 loaf italian bread, sliced
instructions: Toast the bread and cut the bread into small squares. Heat oil in skillet and fry triangle and fry other side. Top with your favourite cheese or serve in a hamburger bun.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,bay scallop,chili sauce,pita bread,vegetable oil cooking spray,italian sausage
title: Seafood Casserole #2
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 lb ground italian sausage | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1 1/2 cups madeira wine | 7 slices pita bread | 1 lb bay scallops or 1 lb littleneck shrimp, cleaned
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Saute sausage until golden and cooked through. Remove from skillet. Add the chili sauce and madeira to skillet and cook until liquid is reduced and syrupy. In a sprayed casserole dish, add ground sausage and chopped shrimp. Add the madeira sauce and scallops and stir to blend. Add pita bread crumbs and stir to coat. Spray the dish with cooking spray. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Uncover, raise temperature to 400 and bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Simple Lettuce Wrap
ingredients: 1 head shredded lettuce | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1 teaspoon fresh garam masala
instructions: Toss together. Spread on flat, flat, flatbread enjoy on a wrap with your favorite greens or on tikkas.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,duck leg,apricot jam,penne pasta,serrano pepper,chili sauce,juice,sherry wine vinegar
title: Creamy Duck and Apricot Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar | 2 duck legs | 250 g penne pasta | 1 bunch fresh apricot jam | 75 ml sweet chili sauce | juice | salt and pepper
instructions: Grill the duck legs on a bbq plate for 2 - 3 minutes on each side then remove from heat. Allow to rest, then cut into 1cm slices. Cook the pasta according to packet instructions then drain and run under cold water. Drain, then cool under cold water. Meanwhile, brush a large griddle pan with a little oil and cook the duck. Turn until browned and cooked then take out with a slotted spoon and set aside. Cook the apricot jam to taste, then stir in the sweet chili sauce. Remove the duck from the grill, and set aside. Brush the duck with a little oil and drain well if it is sticky. Return to the pan, stir through the apricot jam, and sprinkle over the chili sauce and stir. Serve with the pasta and the duck meat.

title: Easy Baklava Kebabs and Feta-Stuffed Bamboo Skewers (Ww Points)
ingredients: 12 bamboo skewers | 2/3 cup fresh shelled pistachios | 2/3 cup feta | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 tablespoons coarsely ground pistachios
instructions: Preheat a grill pan over moderately high heat. Toss the pistachios in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of the sugar, then spread them on the bamboo skewers. Arrange the skewers in a single layer grill over the hot pan until golden and a shade darker around the edges, 10 minutes.

title: Japanese Broccoli Cakes
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, break stems from leaves | 1 egg | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon green capsicum, finely minced | 2 tablespoons mirin or 2 tablespoons cooking wine | 1 tablespoon stock or 1 tablespoon green broth
instructions: Break off the florets from the head of the broccoli. Separate the leaves leaving the stalks on. Cut into 1 inch long pieces. Mix together the egg, onion salt, green capsicum, and mirin until well blended. Add the broccoli and the egg mixture to the wet mixture. Shape into small balls. Cook in oil over medium heat until they are cooked. Serve on lettuce leaves with soy sauce if desired.

title: Herbed Beer Skewers (Gourmet)
ingredients: 4 cans crushed bamboo skewers | 1 cup sour cream ( fat free ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme | hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: If using wooden skewers, soak in salted water for 1 hour before cooking. Combine sour cream, cream of tartar, thyme and salt and pepper in a mixing bowl. Add crushed bamboo and mix thoroughly. Pour mixture into a shallow metal bowl, about 2 inches tall, and shape into a 5 to 6 inch diameter circle. Push skewer through to keep the marinade inside the circle of skewer, then gently place skewers on a cutting board or countertop and form into a 4 inch diameter circle. Place the circle on a baking sheet and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Remove from refrigerator and grill skeers over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side or grill over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, brushing with a little prepared sour cream mixture and turning every 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is browned and crisp. Serve with hot sauce or pickled beets. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces unsweetened cocoa | 1 3/4 cups red chilies, seeded and peeled | salt and pepper
instructions: Heat 4oz unsweetened cocoa in saucepan over low heat, stirring frequently until melted and smooth. Remove from heat. Using a mortar and pestle, crush chilies into a paste. Add chilies to cocoa. Season with salt and pepper. Cool, then store and use within one week.

title: Low Carb Veggie Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 12 ounces bacon, chopped | 4 large frozen mixed vegetables | 1 egg, beaten | 2 tablespoons almond flavoring or 2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons powdered cardamom | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in skillet with a little bit of oil, fry bacon until slightly browned and crisp. Remove bacon from pan with slotted spoon and set aside. In same pan, cook frozen mixed vegetables until defrosted. Stir in rest of ingredients except the bacon. When noodles are done, drain noodles and stir into veggies. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle with bacon on top. Bake for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream and parmesan at the table.

title: Texas Romaine Salad Supreme
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite size pieces | 1 1/2 ounces dark rum, such as rum runner's black | 1/2 ounce taco seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano, crushed
instructions: In a large serving bowl, toss together the romaine lettuce, rum, spice pack and oregano. Chill.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,taco chip,almond,fine breadcrumb,tomato soup,maraschino cherry,gingerroot
title: Mexican Meatball Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 container ricotta cheese | 1 can tomato soup | 1/2 teaspoon minced gingerroot | 1 teaspoon fine dry breadcrumb | 2 cups shredded maraschino cherries | 4 -6 ounces crushed taco chips | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Drain liquid from can of tomato soup into a saucepan. Stir in ricotta cheese and ginger. Add bread crumbs, cherries and taco seasonings. Heat through, stirring occasionally. Spread a thin layer of meat mixture onto a slice of cool bread roll. Sandwich with remaining slices of cool bread roll. Place sandwiches in a foil lined jelly roll pan and press lightly with the bottom of a non stick skillet. This can be done in a hot skillet, too. Melt a thin layer of tomato soup and spread evenly over the top of the sandwiches. Sprinkle with slivered almonds. Broil the sandwiches, 3 - 5 inches from the heat until lightly browned on the top, 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Shiitake (Japanese Daikon radish pickles)
ingredients: 8 medium daikon radishes, peeled and cut diagonally into 2-inch-thick slices | 1/4 cup onion salt | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Cover daikon and onion salt with boiling water and let stand 30 minutes. Drain, shaking off excess salt and slice diagonally across grain into 1/4 inch slices. Transfer to a bowl and toss with taco seasoning. In a large frying pan, melt 1 tbs. Oil over moderate heat. Add onion salt, and radish slices in a single layer. Cook, shaking pan from underneath, about 3 minutes and then turn slices over. Cook 3 minutes and then turn slices again. Cook about 2 minutes, pressing down to make sure all of the daikon slices are slightly browned. Remove daikon and onions to a platter, sprinkle with worcestershire and cover with foil to keep warm. Keep warm until serving time.

Random Ingredients: nut,yellow squash,onion powder,jicama,green chilies,lemon lime beverage,lemon zest
title: Lemon Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup jicama, cut into chunks | 1 yellow squash, cut into chunks | 1/2 medium onion, diced | 2 cans diced mild green chilies | 1/3 cup fresh lemon limeade or 1/3 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup finely chopped dried nuts | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated
instructions: Toss all ingredients. Marinate at least 2 hours before serving. Will keep in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: thai basil,sherry wine,tomato paste,jasmine rice,soymilk,french baguette,spinach,cucumber
title: Sweet Red Pepper Spinach Strata
ingredients: 1 french baguette, cubed | 3 cups chopped fresh spinach | 3 cups jasmine rice | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1 cup sherry wine | 1 1/2 cups peeled seeded chopped tomatoes with their liquid | 2 tablespoons tomato paste, plus more for brushing | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thai basil
instructions: Place the baguette cubes in a 6 x 3 inch baking dish.

Random Ingredients: maple extract,sunflower oil,red currant jelly,garlic crouton,cannellini bean,panela cheese,pork loin roast,caster sugar
title: Pork Loin Bean Au Jus
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sunflower oil ( or olive oil ) | 2 tablespoons pancake maple extract ( or pure maple syrup ) | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 boneless pork loin roast ( about 5oz each, ask for fat or fatty loin roast ) | 1 can cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed and frenched ) | 3/4 cup panela cheese, cut into small cubes ( or other low-fat cheese of choice ) | 1/2 cup red currant jelly ( optional ) | 2 -3 garlic-flavored croutons
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300f°. Heat the oil in a large non stick frying pan. Tip the maple extract into a small bowl and mix with the sugar to dissolve. Tip into the hot frying pan and cook the pork on a medium to high heat until the juices run and the pork is thoroughly cooked. If necessary, add a little more oil to the pan, or to the pan after 5 minutes of cooking. Push the pork to the side of the pan and add the undrained cannellini. Toss once or twice to coat in the flavour. Tip the panela cheese cubes into the pan and cook them over a high heat until the cheese has melted and the cheese is melted. Pile the cooked roast onto a large serving platter or individual ovenproof bowls. Drizzle the panela cheese mixture all over the top to give it that gooey, green, caramelised look and a good sprinkle of the croutons. Serve with boiled rice or new potatoes.

title: Italian Tofu and Beansprouts
ingredients: extra tofu ( from the block in the freezer for about 24 hours ) | 4 cans canned tomatoes with juice | 3 cups baked beansprouts | 1 1/2 tablespoons chervil ( or mint leaves ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Cut tofu into chunks, place in 9x13 pan along with remaining ingredients. Bake, covered, at 350 until heated through, about 1 and 1/2 hours.

title: Baked Fresh Mint Chips
ingredients: 24 fresh mint leaves | 2 limes | 2 -4 teaspoons ground cardamom pods | plain salt or coarse salt
instructions: Using a sharp paring knife, slice the mint leaves very thinly crossways, discarding the stem and all the white peels. Dice the mint leaves finely, and divide each into 4 small mint leaves. Slice the limes, squeeze out their juice, and roughly crush the zest with the ground cardamom. Brush a baking sheet with a little oil and scatter over half the mint powder, making sure the mint leaves are well coated. Pour the lime juice paste over the mint leaves, add the ground cardamom, and sprinkle over salt until well coated. Cover with a clean tea towel, and allow to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. Place the baking sheet in the freezer for 5 minutes to help soften slightly. Remove the mint mint seeds, carefully, and carefully, using paper towels, spread out the mint leaves, then return them to the baking sheet. Turn the oven on to 400°f and cook the mint and mint leaves in the oven until evenly wilted but slightly golden around the edges. Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly, then place in a container and cover tightly. Store in a cool, dry, dry place if possible. Will keep well for a week.

Random Ingredients: caper,ginger paste,besan,tomato juice,curd cottage cheese,pork shoulder,beef bouillon cube,vodka
title: Beef and Baked Vodka
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder | 4 cups beef bouillon cubes ( more if preferred ) | 1 cup besan ( gram flour ) | 1/2 cup ginger paste | 6 tablespoons capers | 4 tablespoons vodka | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese
instructions: In pressure cooker or large pot brown pork shoulder. Remove from pot and drain, pour out fat from the pot and return pot to stove top and add beef, bullion oxo and ginger paste in pot. Pour vodka over all and cook on medium for about an hour. Strain mixture and return to pot. Boil liquid about 1/2 an hour. Add cottage cheese slowly in increments of about 1/2 cup. Cook until it begins to form a thick gravy. Serve with spaetzle, french bread and mashed potato.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,bean,cherry,asafoetida powder,rice wine,red capsicum,purpose flour,rice wine vinegar
title: Sizzling Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 750 g sirloin, cut in strips | 150 g red capsicums, cut into 2 cm dice | 150 g cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 4 -6 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons rice wine | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( or souchong powder ) | 1 cup cooked beans
instructions: In a large jug, mix together flour, rice wine, rice wine vinegar, and asafoetida powder. Add beef. Mix thoroughly, then stir fry. Add capsicum and cherry tomatoes. Stir fry until mixture boils. Mix well before serving. Serve with plain boiled rice.

title: Onion Salad for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 dozen hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Cut hard boiled eggs in half lengthwise and set aside. Mince the eggs and place in a bowl. Mix in red wine vinegar and pour over eggs. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,shiitake mushroom cap,coffee,bacon bit,chili flake,canola oil,vegetable bouillon
title: Mushroom Burritos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 tablespoons bacon bits | 1 ounce shiitake mushroom caps | 1/2 cup instant coffee | 1 dash chili flakes | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( i use lemon zest but any chili flavour will do ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable bouillon
instructions: Heat canola oil in non stick pan, when it is heated add the shiitake mushrooms, stir and fry a few minutes. Add the coffee, chilli flakes and lemon juice in the pan, mix well and remove from heat, mix in the vegetable bouillon. Put a tablespoon of the mixture in middle of half an indentation in the middle of each burrito.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,herb,kalamata olive,cream asparagus soup,egg bread,molasses
title: Easy and Easy Sweet Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of asparagus soup | 1/4 cup molasses | 8 ounces sour cream | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/4 cup kalamata olives, sliced | 2 teaspoons dried mixed herbs ( basil ) or 2 teaspoons parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix soup, molasses, sour cream, salt and cream until well mixed. Combine eggs and cream of tartar until well blended. Place egg mixture into small loaf pan, and place in the oven. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes, or until knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Remove from oven, and top with olives, then garnish with fresh herbs or parsley.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,rosemary leaf,lemon juice,tarragon,fruit peel,hamburger bun,brandy
title: Creamed Garlic-Herb Fondue
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried mixed fruit peel | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 1/2 cup nonfat milk or 1/2 cup egg milk | 3/4 teaspoon dried rosemary leaf | 1 lb hamburger bun
instructions: Drain and coarsely chop the fresh fruit peel, then place back into the bowl and add the tarragon. Let stand. Combine brandy and lemon juice in a small bowl. Slowly whisk in the milk and herb mixture.

title: Chicken and Broth Mix With Topping
ingredients: 2 cups bottled broth | 1/4 cup chopped celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh coarse ground coarse ground pepper | 6 tablespoons fat-free thawed frozen reduced fat-free tops, thawed | 1 3/4 lbs chicken breasts tenders, trimmed and cut into 3/4-inch-thick slices
instructions: Combine broth, celery salt and pepper in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,vanilla pudding,graham cracker crumb,dressing,beef
title: St. James's Red Velvet Meat Pies
ingredients: 1 package instant vanilla pudding | 1 pound ground beef or ground turkey | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2/3 cup dry graham cracker crumbs | 2 cups prepared sweet-and-sour dressing
instructions: Heat the oven in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the ground meat, and cook until evenly browned. Drain meat, and combine with the red wine vinegar, graham cracker crumbs, and instant vanilla pudding. Roll into balls, and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 to 18 minutes, or until evenly browned. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,onion salt,chili oil,olive,crescent dinner,red curry paste
title: Chilli Red Red Rissoni
ingredients: 1 package crescent dinner rolls | 1 can crushed tomatoes with oil | 1/2 cup chopped onion salt | 1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 4 tablespoons olive or 4 tablespoons grapeseed oil
instructions: Heat olive oil in small saucepan on low heat. Add onions and saute until tender. Mix all together and remove from heat. Separate dough into 8 triangles. On a greased cookie sheet, spread the red onion mix evenly over the dough. Bake at 375 till golden brown. Cut along the fold with spatula and brush on some of the oil. Enjoy,.

title: Easy Beef and Chocolate
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 cup apple juice | 3 tablespoons honey | 3 ounces chocolate
instructions: Combine all ingredients together except the chocolate. Add chocolate to mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 2 hours, stirring often.

title: Tamari Drink
ingredients: 1 cup tamari | 1 cup ice water | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Add tamari, water and sherry to blender or food processor. Serve in highball glass with straws or straws for a variation.

title: White Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: 1 lb white chocolate or 1 lb semisweet chocolate | toothpicks
instructions: Break the white chocolate into pieces. Using toothpicks, pick the chocolate into 1/2 inch squares. Dip the chocolates into the chocolate.

title: Al Barley Pudding
ingredients: 3 cups pearl barley | 3 3/4 cups white flour | 1/2 teaspoon powdered saffron | 1/2 teaspoon chopped cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon mace
instructions: Cook barley in 1 3/4 cups water. Combine all other ingredients, and add remaining ingredients. Turn into a greased 8 x 8 pan or a 2 1/2 quart casserole baking dish. Bake in oven at 350 degrees f for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Bean and Lentil Salad
ingredients: 300 g cannellini beans, beans with their liquid | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 3 -4 small dried red chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped | 1/4 cup cashews, roasted
instructions: Cook the beans until tender, roughly 3 - 5 mins, depending on their size. Drain, and put a layer into a pan. Add half the beans, the cumin and chiles with their liquid. Mix everything up, and chill till ready to serve. In the meantime, toast the nuts, stirring up any bits with the nuts as a garnish later.

title: Tasty Basil Cookies
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces cake flour | 1/3 cup thai basil, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Sift flour into mixing bowl and rub in the basil. Blend with an electric hand mixer or your finger tips. Add vinegar and mix well. Refrigerate mixture for at least 30 minutes. Shape dough into balls. Using 2 tablespoons of dough for each, roll into balls. Place on a baking sheet with a baking parchment paper or parchment paper and press out each of the desired shapes with water glass or rolling pin. Bake in the center of the oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly brown, and cooked through and they're the same color as your regular cookie dough they should be slightly crisp toffee color. Enjoy.

title: Mexi-Garlic Chips
ingredients: 10 -12 large bulbs of garlic | 8 cups coarsely crushed tortilla chips | 2 large limes, quartered | 2 tablespoons celery salt | 2 -3 limes, juice of
instructions: Place the drained garlic cloves in a large bowl. Pour lime juice over and then crush the cloves with a garlic press. Place the crushed garlic and crushed tortilla chips in a plastic zipper bag, and crush with a rolling pin or rubber spatula until it begins to mix and sticks together. Add all of the celery salt and lime juice, stirring to thoroughly coat. Place in refrigerator for at least 2 hours, to let flavors infuse before serving.

title: Macaroni and Beef
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni | 1 jar sliced beef broth | 1 -2 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and toss with beef broth. Cool and transfer to a large bowl. Add mayo, stirring to coat. Add beef broth to coat and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,poblano pepper,green peppercorn,pecan,lamb shoulder,gouda cheese
title: Chilean Lamb Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup warm whole milk | 1/3 cup finely shredded gouda cheese | 2 packages active dry yeast | 2 poblano peppers, seeded and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 green peppercorns, finely crushed | 10 whole pecans, toasted
instructions: Heat the milk in a saucepan until slightly reduced, then stir in the cheese and yeast. Remove from the heat when it starts to be foamy, then stir in the rest of the ingredients. Place a piece of aluminum foil over the bottom of a loaf pan, but not touching. Cover and let rise in a warm place until double. To bake the loaf, preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Bake uncovered, for 40 to 50 minutes, or until the center of the loaf is firm to the touch. Let cool on a rack. Cut or remove from the pan.

title: Flaming Volcano Blank (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1 chinese chili, small ( bird chiles or 1/4-1/2 tsp. chilli powder ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup rum | 3 -4 teaspoons sifted dried chipotle chiles
instructions: Cut a slit in the chili lengthwise down the stem. Remove seeds from chili. Remove seeds and cut chili into 3 - 4 pieces. Place all ingredients in blender and blend well. Store in refrigerator or freezer for up to 2 days.

title: Hot Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 2 -10 chicken parts | 2 cans black mushrooms, sliced | 1 jar taco sauce
instructions: Place chicken parts in crockpot. Pour taco sauce over all. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours stirring every hour. Take chicken out of crockpot and leave about 1/2 hour for spices to marinate. Turn chicken to a plate, cover and keep warm.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,marsala wine,green bean,lemon pepper,parmesan cheese,bamboo shoot
title: Stuffed Green Beans
ingredients: 3 cups fresh green beans, cut in half | 1 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoot, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the green beans in a serving bowl. Add 1 1/2 cups water, chickpeas, bamboo shoots, and wine and lemon pepper. Toss.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,chili garlic sauce,tomato puree,swiss cheese,yellow squash,rice noodle,button mushroom
title: Crunchy Swiss Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 2 boxes rice noodles | 1 lb chicken wings or 1 lb turkey wings | 4 ounces fresh button mushrooms | 3 cans tomato puree | 1 dash chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 cup swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil. While water comes to boil, cut chicken wings into 2 inch pieces. Add turkey.

title: Beef Pasta With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 small shallot, finely diced | 1 medium red pepper, seeded and diced | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 cups small shell pasta, e.g. rotelle | 2 cups brussels sprouts
instructions: Put ground beef in a frying pan.

title: Penne With Saffron and Chilli
ingredients: 400 g dry penne pasta | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon saffron thread | 5 -6 small red chilies, seeded and roughly chopped | 1 scallion, finely chopped
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pan of rapidly boiling water until 'al dente'. Meanwhile, put the cumin, saffron and chillies into a small bowl. Pour the warm salted water into a large, shallow ovenproof frying pan. Turn the heat right down to medium and add the saffron mixture and the remaining ingredients. Stir to combine and cook for five minutes over a moderate heat, stirring up from time to time, until the penne is tender. Drain the pasta well, reserving a little of the cooking water, and return it to the pan. Toss the pasta with the sauce and serve straight away with fresh parmesan if desired.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,corn cob,red grape,beef consomme,watercress,thyme leave,pea
title: Cabbage Soup - With Corn
ingredients: 600 g cabbage, cored and thinly sliced | 200 g small corn on the cob, kernels and silk removed | 1 liter beef consomme | 1 bunch fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped | 10 sprigs fresh thyme leaves | 1 package tiny peas, frozen | 1 bunch fresh watercress
instructions: To make cabbage stock, combine cabbage, corn kernels, consomme, parsley, thyme and pea pods in a large saucepan.

title: Sour Bread Dip
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 2 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 3/4 cup low-fat yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly oil an 8 inch glass pie plate or fluted cake pan. Slice a slit in the side of each bread slice. Insert a slice of bread to your finger, taking care not to tear the crust, without breaking the bread. Spread the sweet chili paste evenly into the slice of bread, and top with yogurt. Bake at 400°f for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the yogurt is warm throughout serve with indian curries or fresh vegetables..

title: Lemon and Asparagus Sauté
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa | 1 lb suet | 4 lbs russet potatoes, peeled | 2 lemons, juice of | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon ginger paste
instructions: Cut kielbasa and suet into 1/2 inch squares. Trim remaining ends and peel potatoes and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Cut wedges in half and place on an ungreased large skillet. Cook over moderately high heat, turning and turning in all directions until brown, about 10 minutes. Brown asparagus in batches, transferring asparagus to plate when browned. Place 1/2 of the potato slices and 1/2 of the lemon juice in a large bowl and toss until slightly moistened. Drain kielbasa and sauté with potatoes in remaining lemon juice until heated through and brown and slightly crisp, about 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in basil, mustard and ginger paste and divide among 8 serving plates. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,peanut butter,adobo sauce,chicken bouillon cube,seasoning
title: Copycat Taste of Crock Pot Pepperoncini Sauce
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 1/2 tablespoons seasoning | 1 tablespoon black pepper ( original recipe called for 1 tablespoon ) | 3/4 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce ( original recipe called for 1/4 cup )
instructions: Add the chicken bouillon cube into the crock pot then sprinkle black pepper over the chicken. Place peanut butter, garlic, and 1/2 cup of water in the crock pot and stir. Cover with the lid, cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or until the peanut butter turns creamy.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,hominy,philadelphia cream cheese,hot red pepper,amaretto,lamb,catsup
title: Baked Mexican Lamb & Hominy
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb or 1 lb ground turkey | 12 ounces hominy, cleaned & rinsed | 1 3/4 cups catsup | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon amaretto or 1 tablespoon rum | shredded cheese ( optional ) | hot red pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place meat in a large bowl. Add all other ingredients together & mix well. Pour mixture into a greased 9x13 dish & bake at 375f degrees for 30 minutes. Top with shredded cheese if desired & broil under the broiler for about 6 minutes, or until cheese bubbles & becomes golden. Serve with refried beans or pico de gallo as accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,scallion,white mushroom,sugar,pumpkin pie spice,beef tenderloin,dill weed
title: Mushroom and Beef Wellington
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, sliced | 2 bunches scallions, chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 12 ounces white mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/2 cup sugar | 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice | 2 tablespoons fresh dill weed, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f cut the beef tenderloin into slices, about 2 inches wide, and 1/2 inch long. Place in a shallow, roaster or baking dish. Sprinkle with scallions, mushrooms, mascarpone cheese, sugar, pie spice and dill weed. Dot on top with a thin film of olive oil, and put the dish in the oven. Bake until the beef slices are cooked, and the onions and mushrooms are tender, about 90 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: taco flour tortilla,chickpea,sirloin steak,meatball,rosemary,button mushroom,creamy peanut butter,herb
title: Namoura (Egyptian Meatball Appetizer)
ingredients: 12 fresh taco-size burrito-size flour tortillas or 12 commercially prepared regular-size burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 jar sweet meatballs ( one cup jarred ) | 1 jar pickled button mushrooms | 1 cup sliced meatball ( one large ) | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter ( light or creamy ) | 1/2 cup minced fresh herb ( can use basil, garlic, dried basil, parsley or oregano ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons a combination oil and garlic flavored cooking spray | fresh rosemary
instructions: Combine sweet meatball ingredients together in a small bowl and mix well. Spray a 9×13 metal baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Spread a few tablespoons of the peanut sauce on each tortilla, covering about 1/4 of the tortilla. Place the tortillas, uncovered, on the baking dish in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a medium bowl, lightly mix together the pickled mushrooms, sour cream, lemon juice, and oil. Spoon about 1/3 cup of the meat mixture into each tortilla. Gather the edges of each tortilla, fold them in half, and then gently roll them up. Place rolled tortillas on a baking sheet. Coat them thoroughly with the peanut sauce. Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until warm and crispy. Serve hot or cold.

title: French Green Beans With Brown Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb french style green bean, trimmed if not already trimmed | sea salt
instructions: Remove and discard strings or damaged beans and cut into 1/2 inch lengths.

title: Mexican Meringue Pie
ingredients: 3 ounces milk chocolate | 1 egg white | 2 teaspoons hot water | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 3/4 cups tomato sauce or can crushed tomatoes
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave over boiling water. Separate egg white from yolk, add with melted chocolate and whisk until yolk and chocolate are smooth. Pour into a pie crust with a removable bottom. Combine the rest of the ingredients and pour mixture over the meringue crust. Refrigerate for 1 hour, flip and let set another hour or a so. Preheat oven to pour mixture into a foil pie plate, and bake at 350 until center is firm.

title: Vegetable Rosti
ingredients: 3 cups mixed vegetables, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup semolina | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon ( optional ) | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup fontina cheese, grated | 3 teaspoons margarine or 3 teaspoons butter
instructions: Blend all the dry ingredients. Cook the margarine/butter in a skillet, add the veggies and cook. When the veggies are nearly done, put the veggie mixture in a dish, sprinkle with grated cheese. Serve with rice.

title: Pasta With Green Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb small dried pasta ( spaghetti, linguine, fettuccine or other ) | 1 large green pepper, thinly sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons white flour, as needed
instructions: Cook pasta in lots of rapidly boiling water for a couple of minutes, then drain. In a large skillet, stir fry pepper slices. Drain pasta well and toss with pepper and green pepper mixture. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wrapper,white kidney bean,seltzer water,beef bouillon granule
title: Easy Bolognaise
ingredients: 20 ounces white kidney beans | 2 1/2 cups seltzer water or 2 1/2 cups water | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules or 1 1/2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon granules | 24 wraps, packages
instructions: Soak the white kidney beans overnight in water to cover. Drain in colander and rinse with cold water. Cook kidney beans over medium heat, adding water, bouillon granules, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Boil for about 15 - 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Take off heat and let stand for 10 minutes. Serve in wrappers with desired toppings.

title: Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 4 lean pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 tablespoon splenda brown sugar blend | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs
instructions: Coat a nonstick nonstick heavy skillet with cooking spray. Place skillet over medium high heat and when just starting to smoke, add tenderloins. Using the back of a slotted spoon, spread light brown sugar on the tenderloins and top with thyme. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook 15 to 20 minutes, or until pork is cooked through. Transfer to a cutting board and cover with a towel. Let stand 5 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,onion,herb,eat apricot,pork butt,balsamic vinegar,cheddar cheese,fava bean
title: Pork and Fava Bean Salad (Ensalada De Natalito)
ingredients: 1 lb cooked fava beans | 2 lbs cooked boneless pork butt | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1/4 cup chopped fresh herbs | 1 teaspoon dried mixed herbs, crushed | 1 cup grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Mix all the ingredients. Toss with grated cheese and serve.

title: Korma ( Cod and Chili Fish Stew)
ingredients: 2 lbs cod | 8 ounces anaheim chili | 1 ounce ginger paste | 1/2 cup sherry | 2 teaspoons cardamom | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 3 cans kidney beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pot and cook on medium heat for 5 - 7 hours or until fish is tender.

title: Spiced Caramel Shortbread
ingredients: 2 cups oat | 1 cup soft butter | 2 teaspoons vanilla pod | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 lb vermicelli or 1 lb gluten-free pasta, coarsely broken ( 1 pkg per serving )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Coat 9 x 2 x 2 glass baking dish with cooking spray. Finely grind oat in food processor. Add soft butter, vanilla, five spice powder and nutmeg and blend till smooth. Combine broken and broken pasta and pasta in baking dish. Press mixture evenly over the shortbread mixture. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes or till browned and set. For a crispier crust, bake at 375° for 8 - 10 minutes or til very lightly browned.

title: French Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1 package maple flavored extract | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place the maple flavored extract into a small bowl, and blend until pureed. Season with salt and pepper, and stir until well blended. Let the butter bars marinate at least 1 hour in the refrigerator before serving. My note, i use only orange flavoured essense infused infused liqueur. I then add 1/2 to 3/4 cup cinnamon sugar to the syrup.

title: Pumpkin-Pumpkin Fruit Smoothie
ingredients: 2 cups pumpkin puree | 1 papaya, peeled, seeded, diced
instructions: Combine pumpkin puree and papaya in a blender.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,filet beef,chinese five spice powder,malt vinegar
title: Beef Soft Tacos With Vietnamese Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 lb ground round or 1 lb filet of beef | 6 lettuce leaves, to serve
instructions: Whisk together the vinegar, five spice powder and half the beef in a bowl. Add extra vinegar until the meat is well coated. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Cook the meat until it is cooked to your liking. Divide the meat among the 6 taco shells. Top with lettuce leaves. Drizzle with the dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: walnut,catfish fillet,black bean,stewing beef,gruyere,ginger powder,calvados,ginger ale
title: Caramelized Beef & Black Bean Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef | 2 ounces ginger powder | 10 ounces black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 jar pickled ginger ale ( i use campbell's but any other is fine ) | 1 jar stewing beef ( leftover meat is fine ) | 1 cup gruyere ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted and chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup calvados ( optional )
instructions: Season all meats with ginger and garlic powder, making sure to coat all sides of beef. Brown meat in dutch oven over medium high heat. When meat browns slightly remove from oven and set aside. Pour beer into the same dutch oven and bring to a simmer. Add meat. Cover and cook on med. Heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Stir meat every once in a while and cook until a gravy consistency. Remove meat from pan. Stir cheese and nuts into the gravy until melted and combine. Then mix in black beans and heat through.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,tomato juice,cream mushroom soup,red bell pepper
title: Easy Slow Cooker Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: In slow cooker, combine beef, mushroom soup, vegetables, tomato juice and heat on high setting for 10 minutes.

title: Potato Cheese and Celery Filling for Pierogi
ingredients: 3 whole baking potatoes, peeled | 1 package shredded cheddar cheese | 1 cup grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Cut potatoes in half lengthwise, and remove pulp. Place potato halves in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook for about 20 minutes. Drain, and mash together with cheddar cheese in a bowl. Continue to cook mashed potatoes until mixture is smooth and creamy, about 30 minutes.

title: Muffin Cups
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups corned beef cereal ( or any other brand ) | 1 medium celery rib, diced ( or use 2 teaspoons celery powder in place of the celery ) | 2 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Put corned beef in a small bowl and add 1/2 cup cold water, to moisten and mix well. Set aside and let cool until you can handle it comfortably. Put a small handful of shredded lettuce in the center of a round, slightly flattened round, plate, or muffin tin. Dip the top portion of a lettuce cube into cold water, then drain it and repeat with the remaining corned beef. Spoon 2 tablespoons corned beef mixture into the lettuce cups and top with the other half of the lettuce and a little of or equal amounts of celery powder. Close up the edges of the muffins with your fingers or a toothpick. Serve warm.

title: Sweet & Sour Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup | 3 tablespoons palm sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar & shake vigorously. If desired, refrigerate to allow flavors to develop, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,chili sauce,pork tenderloin,cardamom seed,corn,beef,balsamic vinegar
title: Korean Style Meatloaf
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 2 lbs lean ground beef | 2 1/2 cups sweet corn | 3 cups balsamic vinegar | 1 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons carom seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees fahrenheit. Cut pork tenderloin lengthwise int 1/2 inch slices. Combine ground beef and ground pork with spices and mix thoroughly. Shape into loaf and place in a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Bake at 250f for 2 hours or until done.

title: Brandy Chipped Sweet Snack Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups walnuts, toasted and finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar | 3 1/2 teaspoons lemon pepper seasoning | 4 large semi-sweet chocolate kisses | 3 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Combine nuts, powdered sugar, lemon pepper and brandy then stir thoroughly until well blended. Cover and chill 2 hours or overnight. When ready to dip cookies, dip biscuits one by one in chocolate coating. Dip with remaining chocolate coating. Sprinkle each dipped cookie with granulated sugar.

title: Pasta With Chives and Chive
ingredients: 1 cup farfalle pasta | 1 cup snipped fresh chive
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the farfalle, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well. Mix in the chives and serve.

Random Ingredients: black bean,chipotle pepper,cocoa,manchego cheese,red potato,cream,ranch dressing mix
title: Black Bean and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 6 small red potatoes, cut in to wedges | 8 ounces manchego cheese, cubed | 1 package hidden valley ranch dressing mix | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup roasted chipotle pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a non stick baking pan with pam of spray or brush inside with pam. Mix together beans and potatoes until well blended. Spread bean mixture in prepared pan evenly to around edges. Combine cheese, dressing mix, sour cream and chipotle peppers. Sprinkle evenly over bean mixture. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve hot, or reheat in microwave on low setting, stirring every 2 - 5 minutes until all is melted. Serve with warm tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,cream mushroom soup,sugar cube,skewer,beef brisket
title: Homemade Jerky
ingredients: 24 lbs pork brisket | 4 cans cream of mushroom soup | 4 lbs sugar cube | 2 packets dark soy sauce | 4 -6 skewers
instructions: Cut brisket into 2 feet long by 2 inches wide strips and reserve. Mix soups with soy sauce, dark sauce and sugar cubes. Add brisket to soup mixture, and turn to coat. Marinate overnight, or in refrigerator for 3 days. Preheat broiler. Place skewers in shallow pan or large roasting pan and put in broiler. Broil, turning and basting frequently with soup mixture, until well browned. Pierce with a meat fork several times while broiling. Let cool until you have made all of the jerky. You may have to do this in batches to get a really fine consistency. I use a meat pounder, and it works great. The jerky can be kept overnight or for several weeks in the freezer. Reheat before using.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Relish II
ingredients: 1 red pepper | 3 cups ice water
instructions: Cut the stem end from the pepper, scrape off the seed and core, and cut the stem off the pepper into chunks.. Place the pepper and juice into a sealable plastic jar. Add the ice water.

title: Pea and Sage Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 2 packages yellow peas | 2 tablespoons sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Layer the soup in a 3 quart rectangular baking dish and top with the peas. Sprinkle sage over the peas. Bake in the preheated oven until the peas are tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,corn syrup,caramel,brown button mushroom,lime,chicken stock cube
title: Caramel Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 375 g brown button mushrooms, chopped | 1/4 cup brown chicken stock cubes | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 3 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 pinch lime, juice and zest of ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon instant chicken and carrot bouillon granules ( optional )
instructions: To make soup mix all of the ingredients together in the bottom of a 2 litre saucepan. Bring soup slowly to a boil and then simmer gently. If the soup is too thick or very diluted, add a little boiling water. You don't need to add sugar or salt but i find it's usually perfect in a blender.

title: Broccoli With Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 package cream cheese ( neufchatel ) | 2 tablespoons finely minced fresh broccoli florets
instructions: Mash cream cheese with a fork until smooth. Stir in broccoli. Serve immediately.

title: French Veal Stew
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb piece veal | 4 ounces frozen peas
instructions: Boil 2 cups of water and add veal. Cover and cook over low heat for 2 hours.

title: Chicken Korma Skewers (Chicken Korma)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken parts ( chicken breasts, thighs, drumsticks, wings or whatever is on sale ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander leaves ( chopped, fresh coriander roots, or 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander ) | 2 teaspoons fennel ( chopped finely ) | 8 pieces butter
instructions: Mix coriander and fennel with the chicken and leave to marinade in the fridge overnight. If you want to make your own chicken korma, prepare your own spices, using as much coriander as you like, finely chopped fresh fennel and ground dry fry spice mix. Remove chicken from marinade and soak in warm water for 5 minutes. Melt butter in fry pan. Place chicken in the pan. Cook in batches. Serve with basmati rice.

title: Tahini Dip
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon anchovies | 2 spring onions | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Place all ingredients into a hot jam jar, cover tightly and shake to combine. Serve with freshly cooked pasta or other flat bread. May be served with pita or toasted bagels.

title: Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 2 lbs plum tomatoes, chopped finely | 3 cups creme fraiche
instructions: In a large preserving pot, heat the creme fraiche until it bubbles. Add the chopped tomatoes and stir until it has just come to a boil. Cover and set aside over a low heat for 1 hour stirring occasionally until the tomatoes absorb the liquid. Remove the lid and continue to simmer for a further 30 - 45 minutes until thick and chutney coats the back of spoon and it coats the spoon. Let the liquid reduce to a thick sauce. Remove and discard any tomato skins that have collected on the top. Serve warm or cold and refrigerate overnight. This can be made up to 5 days in advance and reheated.

title: Chinese Salt Airm Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons five-spice powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarse chinese five-spice powder | 1 pint cold water
instructions: Put the five spice powder into a gallon sized plastic bag and use a rolling pin to crush the five spice powder and five spice powder together. Pour in water in a slow steady stream, mixing to completely dissolve the seasoning. It is essential that you do this vigorously so the seasoning and water evenly distribute. The water can be used to moisten the mortar and cheese in later. The flavor of this past has a muddy taste, and the aroma of the spice powder can overpower it easily. To use it, you can use it to stuff the nuts with your favourite dried vegetable or meat mixture.

Random Ingredients: mirin,lard,dijon mustard,liquid smoke,clear vanilla extract,yellow bell pepper
title: Goya Puree
ingredients: 1/2 cup mirin | 1/2 cup dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 4 tablespoons clear vanilla extract | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1-inch squares | 4 tablespoons lard
instructions: Combine mirin and dijon in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and then remove from heat. Stir in liquid smoke, vanilla extract and bell pepper. Stir until all ingredients are well incorporated. Allow to cool then spoon into small serving bowl. Cover with saran wrap and refrigerate approximately 1 hour or until flavors have blended.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,chicken broth,beet,asadero cheese,peach,mandarin orange segment,sage leaf,salmon
title: Chilled Salmon With Asadero Glaze
ingredients: 3/4 cup chicken broth | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves, crushed | 8 large fresh sage leaves | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1 cup chilled smoked salmon, sliced ( about 1 pound ) | 1 can mandarin orange segments | 1 cup shredded asadero cheese ( about 1 1/2 ounces ) | 1 cup drained canned peaches
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup broth into heavy small saucepan. Add sage.

title: Almond Chip Peanut Butter Nests
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon grease | 5 ounces sweet chocolate chips | 1 cup chopped almonds ( not dried ) | 1/2 cup frozen peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine the bacon grease, chocolate chips, and nuts. Using a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2 inch round tip, snip off 24 chard leaves. Place them in a mixing bowl. Wrap each chard in aluminum foil. Place the peanut butter mixture in a small bowl of hot water for about 10 minutes. Using tongs, remove the chard from the water and dry. Stir in one can of the peanut butter mixture for 20 seconds. Ladle chocolate into the bowls. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,cooking oil,tomato basil,vanilla essence,onion white,creamy peanut butter,wheat germ
title: Spinach Salad With Peanut Butter Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup chopped onion white | 1 tablespoon chopped peeled fresh spinach leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes with basil, soaked and skin removed | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 box spinach leaves | 1 teaspoon cooking oil
instructions: Put all ingredients except spinach leaves into a bowl.

title: Lorena Garcia's Goat Cheese Pretzel Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup pretzel, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 6 tablespoons crumbled goat cheese | 3/4 teaspoon freshly cracked black pepper | 1 can no-sugar-needed salad dressing or ( 12 ounce ) can water, chilled | 1 romaine lettuce, shredded | 2 packages ladyfingers
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pretzels, thyme, crumbled goat cheese, and black pepper. Spoon a small amount of the salad dressing or water into the bowl of a pretzel press to moisten. Fill each ladyfinger with the cheese mixture and roll in the jellyroll fashion. Repeat with the remaining ladyfingers. Arrange the wraps on a serving platter and serve.

title: Chinese Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 lb chinese sausage, 1/2 inch thick | 1 can salsa | 1 container non-fat vanilla yogurt
instructions: Fry and drain chinese sausage. Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Spinach Duxelles
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh baby spinach | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram, finely chopped | 5 tablespoons rice wine | 150 ml double cream | fresh basil leaves, torn into small pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Place washed baby spinach in large heatproof casserole. Sprinkle with marjoram and stir to coat leaves evenly. Place over a high heat and pour rice wine around the spinach. Heat until the wine stops steaming, then reduce heat. Whip cream and season with basil, then warm through. Pour into sauce, cover and cook for 5 - 6 minutes until thickened and hot. Serve topped with sliced basil or serve in the traditional style with salad leaves.

title: Cherry Bombs (Tianos de Tomate)
ingredients: 12 cups cherries, pitted and washed | 2 leaves fresh oregano
instructions: To make the cherry filling, put the cherries in a medium bowl. Drizzle some water over them and put the oregano flakes in the water. Let drain until most of the water has returned to the berries, about 30 minutes. When the cherries have drained, put a small plate over the jar of cherry filling, holding the cap down. You may want to make a small pot of water with a drip cup with some water. This will help remove some of the cherry juice that may have settled in the bottom of the jar. Pour some of the cherry juice out of the jar of cherry filling and put the cherry filled cherry on top of the oregano sprigs and the top cap of the cap off. You can put the cherry in a paper bag.

title: Apple Sausage-And-Olives Toasts
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs hot chicken sausage, removed from casing ( can use bulk turkey sausage ) | 7 ounces sliced black olives | 2/3 cup apple juice, such as apple cider, may need up to 14 oz., depending on the amount of apple juice | toasted rye bread ( use bread of choice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Remove sausage meat from casing. Drain. Pat dry with paper towels. Place in a large, deep skillet that is at least 3 inches deep, breaking apart if necessary. Sprinkle with salt. Add enough apple juice to cover. Heat over medium heat until a bead of water evaporates on contact, but the water does not. Increase to medium heat and cook until mixture just begins to bubble. Turn the toast over. Add sausage to skillet and cook, turning occasionally, breaking up sausage as it cooks, until just cooked through, 3 - 5 minutes. Spread a layer of the olives on toasted bread. Spread one third of the sausage mixture over the top of the toasted bread and sprinkle with 2/3 cup chopped onion. Repeat 2 - 3 layers with remaining toast and sausage mixture.

title: Beer and Pepper Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper, or to taste | 12 ounces dark beer | 8 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon pepper, or to taste
instructions: Place the red pepper and black pepper in a blender, add beer and blend until smooth. Place chicken stock and pepper into a slow cooker and add the mixture. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours. Remove from heat, and blend once more.

title: Crispy Potatoes With Chili (Coxinhas)
ingredients: 4 medium floury potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1 dash ground serrano chili | 2 teaspoons grain mustard
instructions: Peel potatoes, then cut in half lengthwise. Place on cutting board and slice into 4 or 5 inch pieces. Sprinkle with onion and chili powder and roll each piece into a cylinder. Put in microwave safe bowl for 10 minutes, turn, cover and microplane 2 - 3 times. Repeat and let rest. Spread each piece with 1 or 2 tbs mustard. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings. I always double this recipe to freeze the rest.

Random Ingredients: french bread,plum tomato,shell pasta,splenda sugar substitute,chili powder,cherry jell o,brown sugar
title: Low-Fat Spiked Tomato Bread and Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread ( or 1 cup other soft bread ) | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute ( or other artificial sweetener of your choice ) | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute ( or other artificial sweetener of your choice ) | freshly grated cherry jell-o ( or other anise-flavored liqueur ) | 1 1 cup cherry jell-o | 2 large plum tomatoes, cut into slices | 8 ounces small shell pasta or 8 ounces small mixed salad greens
instructions: Turn on grill, spray with nonstick cooking spray. Slice bread in half horizontally. Cut bread into 1/8 slices, place on foil lined grill grate. Place tomatoes in single layer, drizzle with splenda and sprinkle with some cherry jello and sprinkle with a bit of splenda. Grill over indirect heat 3 to 5 minutes or until lightly browned. While bread cooks, prepare vegetables. Cook pasta following package directions. Drain pasta. Toss with greens. Serve with additional splenda if desired.

Random Ingredients: pandan leaf,sun tomato oil,peach,ginger root,chinese egg noodle,pork loin,italian sausage
title: Chinese Noodles with Pork and Eggs
ingredients: 8 ounces dried chinese egg noodles | 3 pounds pork loin | 3 1/2-inch slices fresh ginger root | 2 fresh limes, juiced | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, thinly sliced | 2 large, ripe peaches - peeled, pitted and sliced | 2 pounds hot italian sausage
instructions: Place noodles in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain well. Slice loin into 1/2 inch slices. Place mozzarella cheese slices on a plate. Place pork slices on top of mozzarella cheese. Juice limes into a bowl, reserving juice. Heat a skillet over medium low heat, and cook and stir ginger in the hot skillet for 2 minutes. Stir in lime juice, sun dried tomatoes and peach slices. Remove from heat, and sprinkle with sliced mozzarella cheese.

title: Endives and Chiles in Brown Shell Sauce
ingredients: 6 heads belgian endive, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 3 spanish onions, peeled and coarsely chopped | 8 serrano chile peppers, or more to taste
instructions: Mix endive, serrano peppers, and onions in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: head napa cabbage,rump steak,onion flake,ladyfinger,peanut,tomato puree
title: Lolly's Hot Beef Dip
ingredients: 1 lb rump steak, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup onion flakes | 1/4 cup dried shrimp | 1 can tomato puree | 1 medium head napa cabbage | 1/2 cup unsalted peanuts | 1 large sweet onion flakes
instructions: Rinse beef, pat dry, seasonings and brown in small amount of olive oil. Add chopped onion and mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes. Chop cabbage in quarters, shred or finely chop onion and brown in hot skillet. Add tomato puree and simmer for 10 minutes. Place on a platter with bread, chips and salad. Serve with a variety of crackers.

title: My Favourite  French Onion and Garlic Salad (Vegees)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons spring onions, finely sliced | 16 teaspoons red peppers, chopped | 7 teaspoons fresh thyme
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: portobello mushroom cap,green olive,corn niblet,chunky salsa,sun tomato paste,beef
title: Mexican Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 6 small portobello mushroom caps | 3 ounces sun-dried tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried corn niblet | 1 cup chunky salsa ( i use pace medium or your favorite recipe of your choice. i use chi chi brand from owens ) | 24 stuffed green olives
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. In large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, sun dried tomato paste, corn, and salsa. Shape into four patties. Brush with oil. Season with salt and pepper. Grill, uncovered, for 12 - 15 minutes, turning once, until no pink remains. Turn over and cook for 4 minutes. Turn and grill for 5 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,beef broth,basil leaf,stewing beef,taco seasoning mix,rom tomato,french bread
title: Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 lb stewing beef, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 12 slices crusty french bread | 32 ounces beef broth | 1 can stewed tomatoes or 12 roma tomatoes, chopped, undrained | 1 can small diced tomatoes or ( 4 ounce ) can diced tomatoes, undrained | 1/4 cup basil leaves, chopped | 12 pepperoni-sized pepperoni slices
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray 14x10 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine beef, taco seasoning mix, and bread in a large bowl.

title: Mexican Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1 can beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 jar picante sauce | 2/3 cup tomato juice | 1 tablespoon stone ground mustard
instructions: Place baguette slices in a skillet sprayed with cooking spray.

title: Basil Tea Bread
ingredients: 3 cups basil leaves, tightly packed | 1 3/4 cups cinnamon | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place basil and 1/2 cup of cinnamon in a food processor and process until finely minced. Gradually add remaining cinnamon, 1/2 cup of cinnamon, and baking soda. Pour in remaining 1 cup of cinnamon and stir until the tea is well combined. Using a pastry brush or shortening, grease a 10 to 12 inch tube pan. With a teaspoon, pipe 3/4 cup of the mint tea mixture into the pan. Bake in preheated oven until toothpick inserted into the center of a loaf comes out clean, 3 to 5 minutes. Turn out onto a wire rack and cool.

title: Coconut Beef Jerky
ingredients: 5 lbs ground chuck | 4 cans jalapenos | 4 teaspoons coconut extract
instructions: Mix together well and roll in dehydrator wrap, dehydrator 15 to 20 day old in paper towel dry for 3 days.

title: French Onion Bread
ingredients: 1 french baguette, cut in 1-inch slices | 1 medium onion, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon kirsch or 1 tablespoon dark cherry syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place bread slices on a baking sheet with 1/4 to 1/2 inch sides. Insert a knife into the center of each slice. Sprinkle with onion powder and kirsch. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until bread is slightly browned.

title: Faux Red Beans on Tamari
ingredients: 1 can of drained red beans | 2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Place cooked beans in a bowl and stir in tamari. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Wood Polish
ingredients: 1 package of wood polish- polish powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/3 cup olive oil
instructions: Start by getting your wood polish clean. You want to cut a fine strip about 1 - 3 inch long by about 1/4 inch wide from the top of the box to be able to roll into logs without falling off when cutting. When you have all your wood, roll it up about three inches long and about 1/4 inch thick. Turn the ends over and fasten with a tooth pick. It should have tapered or tapered ends. Place the wood on an upside down baking sheet and brush with the olive oil. Apply the oil on the twink every five days for two weeks. It is imperative from day to week, to get a clean, even shine. It should cover about half of the wood. When the wood becomes very white, take it out and drain the excess. Use a fine mesh strainer to pick up or remove the wood with your fingers. You could also use an electric spice grinder to grind your own. You will have to pat your wood dry and sprinkle it with a little additional olive oil every couple of days using kosher salt. You can even sprinkle flour on it now, rubbing it in slowly. It will make your wood chewier. Let it sit at room temperature for about 1 to 1 1/2 weeks to become pliable and pliable.

title: Chickpea Pastries
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry | 6 ounces chickpeas | 3/4 lb escarole | 8 ounces milk chocolate | oil, for frying | sesame oil, for brushing | 2 cups milk chocolate, melted with milk
instructions: Soak chickpeas in plenty of cold water overnight. Rinse, then soak overnight in water to cover, then drain. Place the soaked chickpeas and escarole in boiling salted water in a large pot and cook until the beans are soft. Drain and chop roughly. When the beans are soft, stir in the shredded escarole, then chill in fridge until ready to use. Heat a pan over medium heat. Brush two sheets of phyllo parchment with oil, one sheet should be white and one with a lighter golden film of oil. Use a clean pastry brush to lightly butter and flour the remaining sheets, fold them in half and cut into four large squares. Place a tablespoonful of filling into the center of each square and fold in half over the filling to enclose the filling. Repeat with other two sheets of phyllo, placing each in the shape of a hexagon, brushing each as you go with oil, and finishing with the pieces of phyllo. Using a sharp knife dipped in oil, carefully cut each piece of pastry into six triangles and transfer to a baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and keep in the fridge until ready to use. Melt the chocolate in a bowl, then drizzle or brush over top of the pastry triangles. Place on a baking sheet and leave for 10 minutes to set. Cut into wedges and pass through a sieve onto a serving plate.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,pistachio,basil pesto,cherry tomato,pimento olive,lemon peel
title: Mediterranean Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, sliced | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, grated | 1/3 cup low-fat basil pesto | 1 tablespoons poppy seed | 2 tablespoons pimento stuffed olives, sliced | 1 teaspoon dried parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Lightly spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place tomatoes on the baking dish. Spread sliced olives over tomatoes. In small bowl, combine the lemon peel, pesto, poppy seeds and pimento olives. Sprinkle over olives. Bake in preheated oven 20 minutes or until cherry tomatoes are very soft and lightly browned.

title: Broccoli Wraps With Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 250 g broccoli ( trimmed weight ) | 1 can plum tomatoes ( cut into slices ) | 8 large lettuce leaves | 4 tablespoons pasta sauce ( any flavour ) | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh jalapenos ( to taste )
instructions: Heat large non stick fry pan to medium high. Microwave broccoli, tomatoes and jalapenos with 1 teaspoons of water for 3 - 4 minutes and set aside, keeping warm. Mix the sauces and serve with broccoli mixture, on lettuce leaves and a dollop of warm sauce.

title: Vegtable Green Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 tablespoon blue cheese | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf | 1 slice chicken, with skin
instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a skillet over medium low heat. Add the brandy and cook until reduced, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add the cheese and cilantro. Top with the chicken skin. Place chicken in a baking dish. Bake in a hot oven for 10 minutes or until tender and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: lemon,green cardamom pod,black sesame seed,white wine,egg,dill
title: Gabli - Persian Eggs With Spices
ingredients: 6 hard-cooked eggs, sliced lengthwise into quarters | 1 lemons or 1 lime, juice of or 1 lime, juice of | 200 ml dry white wine | 2 -4 green cardamom pods, bruised or 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 cup black sesame seed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dill, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Arrange eggs in a greased casserole dish or serving dish & sprinkle with the lemon or lime juice & wine or any other liqueur you like. Add the cardamom pods, sesame seeds and dill. Cover & bake in a moderate oven for about 15 - 20 minutes or until the eggs are set. Allow to cool in the liquid, cut into eighths and serve at room temperature, or cold.

title: Pimento Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar pimentos, minced | 2/3 cup catsup
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f. Drain pimentos in colander.

title: Salt Substitute--For Canning
ingredients: 3 tablespoons salt | 2 green onions, minced
instructions: Combine salt and 1/2 cup boiling water in a small bowl. Stir vigorously until the salt reaches the water level without stirring. Transfer the salt mixture to a clean jar. Cover, store in a cool dry place.

title: Peach Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 8 beef top sirloin steaks, about 1-inch thick, 1/2 inch wide | 2 -4 canned sliced peaches, well-drained, reserve liquid | 1 loaf crusty italian bread, cut in half
instructions: Preheat broiler. Beat together the 3 yolks and their juice. Set them aside. Slice steak into 1/4 inch thick slices on a sharp knife, 1/8 inch thick. Dredge the steak with 1 t of the egg mixture. Coat slices generously with the egg mixture. Broil the steak slices, turning over once, until barely cooked through, 3 - 5 minutes total. Serve on a platter or bun with additional peach slices.

title: Paprika Yellow Pepper  Soup
ingredients: 1 whole paprika red bell pepper | 1 1/2 pints vegetable broth ( or can use beef stock or low sodium if preferred )
instructions: Wash the whole pepper well several times so it does not burn. Remove stem, seeds and veins leaving stems intact. Cut into 1 wide strips. In a large saucepan heat the vegetable broth until hot and add peppers. Cover with lid and simmer gently 30 minues, stirring occasionally. The peppers should be blistered all over with black spots. Take off heat and discard the peppers. Place peppers in a bowl and set aside. To serve, mix the broth with 2 tablespoons of the mixture for each serving. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Stilton Cheese and Canadian Bacon
ingredients:
250 g stilton cheese | 200 g canadian bacon ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon fat ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cumin 
    - 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod ( optional )
instructions: Cut the stilton into small cubes, put into a colander over a bowl, sprinkle with the 1/4 teaspoon of cumin and leave to drain in the fridge overnight. This can then be cooked later in a frying pan. If you would like to brown the bacon in the oven, pre heat the bacon fat on low medium or warm in a pan. Add the shredded stilton cubes and stir to combine. Add the canadian bacon fat or canadian bacon fat and stir again. Bring to a simmer while stirring continuously. You can either eat in wedges and crumble some smoked bacon chips on top or you can serve it in a wrap with plenty of warm breads.

title: Homemade Chinese Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups stone ground mustard | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 2 tablespoons dried minced chili, such as dried or thai bird chiles and | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Put the dry mustard into a food processor and add the oil and triple sec. Pulse the mixture until it is the consistency of thick paste. Place into a glass jar with a tight fitting lid and store at room temperature for at least 6 days before using.

title: Nicoise Olive and Tuna Salad
ingredients: crushed ice | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 10 ounces baby lima beans | 1 can tuna, drained and flaked | 1 can diced tomatoes | 1 can black olives, sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.
