title: Spicy Grilled Squash
ingredients: 2 lbs small squash, cut into 5-inch pieces | 1 small yellow bell pepper, cut into quarters | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 bottle hot chili sauce
instructions: Place vegetables in 4 large resealable plastic bags. Add 3 cups water.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,lamb,taco seasoning,chicken breast tender,monterey jack cheese,orange zest
title: Lamb and Cheese Skewers With Cuban Twist
ingredients: 1/4 lb cubed deli-style lean ground lamb | 1 ounce taco seasoning | 2 ounces chopped cooked chicken breasts or 2 ounces cooked boneless skinless chicken tenders | 1 ounce chopped peeled orange zest | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup grated reduced-fat monterey jack cheese
instructions: Thread each skewer, beginning with one or three pieces of lamb. Place meat skewers on a baking sheet and let them stand for at least an hour. In a small saucepan or skillet, combine the taco seasoning, chicken and zest.

title: Baked Rotini
ingredients: 1 lb rotini pasta | 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain pasta and transfer to large bowl. Add olive oil until pasta is coated. Spread coated pasta into large baking dish and then top with olive oil. Bake, uncovered, for 10 - 12 minutes until cheese is browned and bubbly. Add parsley and serve.

title: Coconut Peanut Soup
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon cube | 250 g sweet unsalted peanuts
instructions: Put peanut in a bowl, add a tbsp of chicken broth, and pour over the peanut while its still cold. Serve with bread for dipping.

title: Edamame and Veggie Grilling Cornbread
ingredients: 1 can vegetable juice ( v8 ) | 2 cornbread | 1 can edamame, drained | 1 yellow bell pepper | 2 cups mixed veggies
instructions: Preheat grill to cook vegetables as above. Brush cornbread with 1/3 cup vegetable juice. Place on hot grill rack. Place bell pepper on the rack, cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until tender. Turn bell pepper, cook for another 2 minutes. Remove bell pepper & cool slightly. Slice into strips. Place cornbread in a casserole dish, top with the vegetables. Brush with the remaining v8 juice. Bake for 30 - 45 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,cabbage,bread,basil,chocolate syrup,purpose white flour,fenugreek seed,green chili pepper
title: Spice Bread With Cheese and Fenugreek Leaves
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose white flour | 1 1/2 cups fenugreek seeds | 4 cups mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup dried bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 12 leaves cabbage ( about 2 1/2 lbs. ) | 1 medium green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup chamborda chocolate syrup ( or other chocolate-mate ) | 1 bunch fresh basil, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place flour, fenugreek, and mozzarella in a food processor fitted with the metal blade. Pulse until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Transfer mixture to a large bowl. Spread the bread crumbs evenly over the dough, and toss until well mixed. Roll out 2 pieces of the dough until 1/4 inch thick on a floured surface. Cut dough into 6 inch circles. Place the circles on a parchment lined baking sheet. Toast in preheated oven until golden, 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from sheet, and transfer to a wire rack to drain. Cool bread cubes. Place the mint leaves in a salad bowl. Pour chocolate syrup over, and toss to combine. Sprinkle leaves with chiles and mint. Serve with bread.

title: Fruity Meat Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 jar meat, drained ( choose your favorite ) | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 6 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise | 1 small tart apple, grated ( if you prefer your apple hot, add a few grates ) | mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine the meat through vinegar. Spread meat on split side of rolls and top with grated apple.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,italian dressing,bacon,cherry tomato,confectioner sugar,marshmallow,rom tomato,taco seasoning
title: Mexican Bacon Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound bacon, chopped | 3 packages confectioners'sugar | 4 cups miniature marshmallows | 1 jar sweet italian dressing | 1 can sweet cherry tomatoes, drained and halved | 1 cup crushed roma tomatoes | 2 packages taco seasoning
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain and crumble when cool. Crumble bacon into small pieces and set aside. Sprinkle confectioners' sugar over melted bacon. Stir in marshmallows, sweet italian dressing, sweet cherry tomatoes, roma tomatoes and taco seasoning until evenly blended. Cover and refrigerate salad at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Potato Crusted Tuna in Curry Leaves
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 baking potatoes | 1 ounce tuna packed in oil, drained, rinsed and patted out with hands
instructions: Peel potatoes and chop into 2 inch squares. Cook in boiling salted water for 10 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile preheat grill to high. Lightly oil the grilling pan. Brush potato squares with oil and season with salt and pepper. Grill for 5 to 6 minutes or till tender, turning once or twice.

title: Babka's Eggplant
ingredients: 2 eggplants | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, sliced thin | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Peel eggplants and slice into 1/2 inch rounds. Mix the cinnamon, allspice, and pepper together the ingredients. Put the slices in a baking dish and sprinkle with cinnamon mixture. Cover and cook at 375°f for 45 more minutes, or until eggplant is soft.

instructions: Bring a large kettle of water to a boil. Add barley and, if using, nectarines. Cover. Simmer for 20 minutes, then drain. Mix nectarine, cream of coconut, choy sum, rum, and liquid smoke together. Add to barley, increase heat to high, and bring to simmer. Adjust heat as needed to maintain a simmer. If desired, place 1/2 to 1 cup of water on top. Cover and cook over medium heat until nectarine is tender. If desired, garnish with a few leaves. Serve hot.

title: Indian Tomato and Yogurt Salad
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh tomatoes ( or 1 tablespoon drained canned drained tomatoes ) | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 large shallot, finely chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together mayonnaise, yogurt, tomatoes, mustard and shallot. Stir in 1 cup dressing. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,ice,brown sugar,red bell pepper,green cabbage,anise seed,corn,basmati rice
title: Taco Rice Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup raw rice | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 cup sour corn or 1 cup guajillo chilies or 1 cup chorizo sausage | 1 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1/4 cup chopped green cabbage | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | crushed ice
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients well in a medium bowl. Mix the taco sauce and brown sugar in a small bowl and set aside. Dip a large platter or large serving dish in warm water. Spray the inside of the bowl with anise oil. Add the taco mixture, top with crushed ice.

title: Nori Sushi
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisin, soaked in 1/4 cup water ( reserve 1/4 cup water ) | nori | oregano leaves, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Grate the green leafy portion off the nori using a grater. Break the nori in half or into about 1 inch wide strips lengthwise. Take each piece of nori shiny side back, pointy side down. Sprinkle 1/8 cup water on this one, just enough to moisten lightly a bit, and roll it up in the towel to keep it from sticking to one another. Repeat this process until all nori or strips are used. Cut the nori into bite size pieces with a very sharp knife. Place the nori on a plate, sprinkle lightly with some extra water to prevent sticking. Let sit for several minutes on a board. Gartarashi is a magic sauce made by a blend of water, sugar and spices. This is the key ingredient in making sushi. When sushi is ready, add 1/4 cup water and 2 tablespoons water. Heat until boiling and then simmer for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let rest for 10 minutes. Garnish with oregano, if desired.

title: Pistachio and Dried Fenkel Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup half-and-half cream ( japanese mayo preferred ) | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1/8 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 teaspoons pistachios, coarsely chopped or 2 teaspoons grated pecans
instructions: Whisk to blend.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,bacon,parsley leaf,sultana,guinness stout,artichoke bottom,shallot,cucumber
title: Guinness Jardinhas With Bacon and Sultanas
ingredients: 1 bottle guinness stout | 2 stalks bacon, diced | 2 medium shallots, finely sliced | 1 small cucumber, peeled, finely diced | 12 ounces marinated artichoke bottoms, drained and coarsley chopped | 2 ounces sultanas | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Pour the guinness into a large, heavy based saucepan, add the bacon, shallots and cucumber and gently fry, stirring over a medium heat, for 10 - 12 minutes, until the cucumber is just starting to wilt. Stir in the artichokes, sultanas and parsley and gently simmer for a further 5 - 7 minutes until heated through. Serve in warm soup bowls spooned over the jardinhas.

title: Genoese Di Rapuretti (Rice Gnocchi and Rice)
ingredients: 12 ounces long-grain white rice | 2 cups cold cooked gnocchi | 2 cups cooked and drained gnocchi
instructions: Place the water in a 3 quart pot over low heat and set aside. Bring the rice to a boil in the water. Stir the rice, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes. While the rice is cooking, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Stir the gnocchi into the boiling rice, then pour into buttered pan. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes more.

title: Spinach with Eggs, Cajun Style
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped | 2 tablespoons lemonade | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Blend spinach, hard boiled egg, lemonade, cajun seasoning, and paprika together in a bowl. Spread spinach mixture into the bottom of an 8x8 inch baking dish. Smooth the top.

Random Ingredients: green chili,chili,asiago cheese,red chili powder,italian salad dressing mix,green curry paste
title: Thai Green Curry
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces asiago cheese, grated | 1 1/3 ounces green curry paste | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 -2 tablespoon green chili, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon asiago salad dressing mix, powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili, powder | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder, chopped | 1/2 - 2/3 teaspoon green chili, chopped
instructions: In a bowl combine cheese, curry paste, chili powder, green chillie powder, asiago cheese, chili powder and red chilly powder. Mix thoroughly. Store refrigerated for up to 2 days.

title: Easy Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 6 bone-in chicken thighs | 1 can crushed tomatoes and red chiles | 2 1/2 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 1 cup crushed tortilla chips | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1/4 cup chopped red chile
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place chicken thighs in a small baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until meat easily shreds. Remove from heat and shred chicken with cleaver. Discard the skin and bones. Return chicken to a skillet. Add the crushed tomatoes and 1 cup of lettuce, tortillas, oregano, taco seasoning and chiles.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,self rising flour,flax seed
title: Cheese Fritters With Flax Seed
ingredients: 1 cup self rising flour | 1 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup flax seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 f. In a large bowl, combine the flour and shredded cheese. Add the flax seeds and mix well. Dough will be stiff, so add more flour if necessary. Roll out onto a floured surface until it is about 1/4 inch thick. Using a 1 1/2 inch round cutter, cut out cookies, then cut out fritters. Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Make a series of fritter holes at the base of the fritters. Bake for about 2 minutes, or until golden brown. Keep checking for doneness while they are cooking as they may bubble up. Remove from oven and place in a paper bag to cool.

title: Mace and Mace Bean  Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 liter dried beans | 5 oranges | 1 large piece mace | fresh curds
instructions: Wash the beans, soak in warm water for about 2 hours. Remove water and discard the stones. Rinse the beans and cut the skin from the oranges. Cut the segments into pieces about 1 cm thick. Wash and wash the mace and peel the rind off the mace. Cut the orange slices into quarters, removing all the pith. Chop the mace into thin strips. Grind the mace in a mortar and pestle or in a food processor with a little water, adding more water if necessary, to make a paste. Add the minced orange segments and the beans to the pot and simmer gently for about 90 minutes until the beans and orange are completely cooked. Serve with curd in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,mirin,enchilada sauce,egg yolk,eggplant,green chilies
title: Eggplant Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 2 cans sliced green chilies | 1/2 cup enchilada sauce | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup mirin | 5 eggs
instructions: Using a very sharp knife, slice the eggplant lengthwise into very thin slices. In a large skillet over medium heat, fry the eggplant slices until light brown in color. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate and set aside. Reduce heat to low to keep the skillet warm. In a small bowl, mix the chilies, enchilada sauce, cream and mirin. In a medium size skillet, heat 1/2 cup of enchilada sauce mixture and a teaspoon of oil, then add the remaining enchilada sauce mixture. Reduce heat to medium low. In a large bowl, beat the eggs, add the eggplant and the sauce mixture and toss until creamy. Serve with bread or toasted jasmine rice.

title: Curried Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can sliced mild currant edamame | 2 cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 cloves, diced | 1 large spaghetti squash, sliced ( about 1/4 pound ) | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high with a tight fitting lid. Add beef.

title: Nigella's Mexican Chocolate Pizza #5FIX
ingredients: 2 cups simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 15 ounces of chopped and drained pepperoni ( i like it on the large can ) | 1 -2 teaspoon fennel seed, lightly crushed ( or 1 teaspoon black ) | 3 -4 ounces of melted semisweet chocolate | 1 tablespoon grated chocolate ( or a handful of finely shredded mexican blend ) | 8 ounces thinly sliced russet potatoes | 8 -10 large warmed tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. In an oven safe skillet, over medium heat, melt the chocolate, add the fennel seeds. Stir and cook a few minutes to begin foaming. Add simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion and pepperoni to pot, stir to combine. Pour into a baking dish and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean and the potatoes all heated through. Stir once or twice to ensure even cooking. Remove from oven and add the melted chocolate and grated chocolate to the top of the hot pizza. Place tortillas on a plate and allow to melt. Place pizza on a plate in a warm oven for 20 - 30 minutes for soft tortillas to melt and slightly crisp.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,topping,onion flake,breadcrumb,vinegar,dark sesame oil,carrot
title: Chinese Black-Eyed Pea Patties
ingredients: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas | 3 tablespoons onion flakes | 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs | 1 large diced carrot | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 carton frozen whipped topping
instructions: Soak the black eye peas overnight, drain. In a medium bowl, combine peas with onion flakes and bread crumbs, and toss until well combined. Place the carrot in a microwave safe dish, and cook on high setting for 1 minute or until softened. Mix in sesame oil, vinegar and sugar, and microwave for 30 seconds or until heated through. Stir. Add the cooked black eye peas to the mixture, and stir until well coated. Form mixture into 8 patties. Serve with the whipped topping on the side.

title: Queso Flameado (Chile Salad)
ingredients: 5 spring onions, chopped fairly finely | 50 g shredded mexican blend cheese | 25 g pickled chillies ( drained ) | pepper, to taste | 1 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: To make the glaze, put the cheese, chillies, pepper and sugar in a small bowl, stir until combined, taste to see how you like it. Pour half the glaze over the spring onions and sprinkle over some of the reserved spring onion. Chill until required.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,cake flour,taco seasoning,rice flour,chile pepper,turmeric,tamarind paste
title: Tamarind Rice Crispy Loaf Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup prepared cake flour | 1 cup rice flour | 1 cup curry powder ( chile powder works too ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 12 fresh chile pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1/2 cup taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all dry ingredients together, cut in small cubes. Roll out, place on baking tray. Mix tamarind paste with 1/2 the tomato sauce mixture, pour over bread until well covered. Mix with hands making sure all the bread is covered with sauce. Bake for 15 mins, remove from oven and sprinkle with the rest of the tomato sauce mix. Let set for 5 mins before cutting and serving.

title: Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1/3 cup margarita mix | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 clove garlic, pressed | 1/3 cup apricot jam
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the margarita mix, ketchup, garlic and apricot jam until smooth. Do not stir. Pour half of the glaze into a small saucepan and heat gently over low heat. When it begins to bubble, remove from heat. Let the glaze cool slightly. Put remaining glaze in a small cup and stir it in with the apricot jam. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,tomato juice,tomato green chilies,ice cube,italian salad dressing mix,caraway seed
title: Crazy Good Italian Tomato Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat canned tomato juice ( i use contadina's ) | 1/3 cup tomato juice ( i use campbell's ) | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking spray | 1 envelope dried italian salad dressing mix ( i use good seasons ) | 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( optional ) ( optional ) | 8 ice cubes ( optional )
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the cardamon in the blender or food processor. Cover and process until it is smooth. Transfer to a glass container and chill in the fridge. Note, i prefer using a handheld blender to blend and check ingredients to taste. Serve in a tall glass, with fresh fruit or vegetables. This is really good served over ice.

title: Spiced Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 pumpkin, weighing about 250g and weighing about 300g ( or a 4 oz. can pumpkin ) | 1 piece lemon zest ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon green coriander, finely chopped | freshly chopped roasted peanuts, to serve
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Remove the peel, seeds and strings away from the pumpkin, leaving the skin on and discarding the skins. Put the pumpkin on a peel. Use your hands to roughly cut the skin in half lengthways. Cut out the core and discard, roughly ¼ inch of the flesh. Cut the flesh into cubes about 1 x ½ inch. Cut the lemon zest into thin strips, about 1 1/2 cm long. Place the pumpkin on 2 pieces of foil, shiny side up. Sprinkle over the green coriander and lemon zest. Fold to enclose, pressing the edges firmly together to seal. Place on the grill and cook for about 20 - 25 minutes until the flesh is tender & cooked but the skin is crisp. Remove from the grill once its cooked & allow to rest for 10 minutes, cut into cubes. Serve with roasted peanuts.

title: Potato Pizza With Pork and Radishes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry yeast | 3 cups baking potatoes ( or your favorite variety of potatoes ) | oil, to fry | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 6 3/4 lbs pork tenderloin or 6 3/4 lbs sirloin, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | pickled radish ( to garnish )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 cups water, cover and set aside in a warm place until frothy. Cut potatoes into 1/4 inch diagonal slices and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with oil and stir to coat. Drain potatoes and place in the bowl. Sprinkle with salt and let rise 1/2 hour until nearly doubled, depending on the size of the potatoes. Drain and stir potatoes and other vegetables into the yeast mixture. Set aside until ready to use. In a skillet, heat enough oil to cover pork.

Random Ingredients: string bean,single cream double,rice vinegar,cream chicken soup,beer,pepper sauce
title: Bombay String Beans With Beer
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can single cream ( double if necessary ) | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 1/2 lb fresh string bean, cut into 3/4 inch lengths | 1/4 cup beer
instructions: Mix all ingredients except beans and beer. If using can beans, drain and add water to cover. Cover and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes or until beans are tender and the sauce thickens. Serve over your favorite brown rice. For breakfast toast, heat remaining bean oil in microwave and mix in cream of chicken soup, adding hot water to the soup to thicken. Garnish with beans and a sprinkle of pepper sauce. Serve over toast.

title: Avocado Cream Sauce With Sausages & Sausage
ingredients: 4 plum, avocados, finely chopped | 25 ml breadcrumbs | 300 g sweet italian sausages, sliced | 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 40 ml tamari | 2 tablespoons butter | 4 hass avocados | 5 ml breadcrumbs | 5 ml tamari
instructions: For the sauce,. Remove the seeds from the avocados and cut into 2 cm cubes. Mash together in a bowl, adding 1/2 cup of cream, 1 tbs tamari, 1 tbs of butter, and a pinch of salt. Toss together. Set aside. To cook them,. Heat a frypan over medium heat. Cook the sausages. Set aside. Make a slit in each avocado leaf. Hold the stuffed avocados by the stem, leaving the egg white flesh intact. Poke a hole in one side of each avocado leaf. Fill each avocado with sausages, leaving some on the top. Place one or two sausages side by side on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Keep warm under a foil tent over the grill. Pour the rest of the cream and 1 tbs tamari into the same pan. Dip each avocado leaf quickly into cream, then into breadcrumbs. Lightly coat in breadcrumbs. Gently fry in batches over medium heat until golden brown and tender. Serve immediately.

title: Cod Baked in Lime Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice, from about 1 lime | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 cups fresh boneless cod or 2 cups fillets, cut into 1 '' pieces | 1 loaf french bread, sliced | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: In blender container fitted with metal blade, combine tahini, lime juice and cream of tartar, blending until smooth. Add cod.

title: Broccoli and Black Olive Salad
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 can sliced black olives
instructions: Place broccoli and olives in a serving dish. Toss with dressing and serve immediately.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 1 can yellow sweet peas | 1 1/2 cups mexican cheese or 1 1/2 cups salsa
instructions: Prepare rice according to pkg directions. Pour rice into lightly oiled 9x13 pan to coat. Stir peas into rice. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 - 40 minutes or until heated through.

title: Pepperjack and Parsnip Chips
ingredients: 1 parsnip, sliced into thin rounds | 1/2 cup fresh squeezed lemon juice | 1 cup shredded pepperjack cheese | 1 sprig fresh basil | 1 lemon, sliced
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread the parsnips and lemon juice over the prepared baking sheet. Place the pepperjack cheese onto top of the parsnips. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is bubbly, 7 to 9 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Pie
ingredients: 1 deep dish pie crust | 1 can mixed vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place pie crust on a baking pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Top with mixed veggies. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate chip,oyster sauce,anaheim chilies,saffron,corn kernel,salmon,white flour
title: Chilled Salmon With Chilli Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup unbleached white flour | 1/2 lb salmon, preferably frozen | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 tablespoon fine grain white chocolate chips | 4 fresh anaheim chilies | 4 fresh tomatillos ( husked if available ) | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: On low setting, in large bowl, mix the flour with 1/4 cup cold water. Add a pinch of salt and mix, or put your machine away. In a non stick skillet, heat the 1/2 inch oil. Dip the salmon fillets, one at a time, into the flour mixture until they're evenly coated. In a small dry skillet, toast the chilies over low heat until fragrant. Set aside. Preheat the griller or oven to 200ºc/400ºf. Place the tomatillos in to foil lined baking tray and top with ¾ cup white sauce. Cook for about 35 - 40 minutes. Remove tomatoes, remove skin and roughly chop. Place the salmon fillets onto a plate and pour the rest of the white sauce over. Top with the rest of the white sauce and sprinkle with the nuts and the yumminess of saffron. Serve warm.

title: Crazy Glazes
ingredients: 1/2 cup white chocolate
instructions: Whip until chocolate is totally melted. Stores and keeps well at room temperature.

title: Baked Corn With Chilli (A Kenyan Recipe)
ingredients: 1 2/3 lbs corn, kernels on the cob, defrosted under running water | 1/3 lb ground chocolate | 4 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/4 cup sliced almonds ( optional ) or 1/4 cup crushed peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f, gas mark in one layer. Place a rack in the centre of the oven and the oven timer for 5 minutes or until the timer rings. Turn off the oven and leave the corn in the oven for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a non stick frying pan over medium heat and add the groundnut seeds. When the seeds begin to sizzle, add the chocolate and mustard seeds and sizzle for 1 minute. Stir constantly until the chocolate is melted and the mustard seeds are slightly darkened. Spread the chocolate mixture into the corn in a large baking dish, sprinkle with almonds or peanuts and bake uncovered, for about 45 minutes, or until the corn is nicely browned and the mixture is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,colby monterey jack cheese,cocoa,red tomato,garlic,lime wedge,walnut
title: Crock Pot Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 2 cans whole tomatoes, undrained ( can use rotel ) | 1 can diced tomatoes ( i use rotel ) | 2 cans diced red tomatoes | 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 3 lbs shredded colby-monterey jack cheese, divided | 2 tablespoons fresh minced garlic ( or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ) | lime wedge ( optional ) | cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: In a blender, puree first 3 ingredients until smooth. In a greased 3 1/2 to 5 quart crock pot, layer twice, half the tomatoes, half the chilies, half the cheese and half the garlic. Repeat layers. Top with lime wedge. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, until bubbly, stirring occasionally. Uncover and continue cooking until cheese is melted, about 20 minutes longer. Let stand for 10 minutes. Serve with dollop of sour cream and/or a sprinkling of cinnamon.

title: Easy Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 8 ounces salami | 1 package sliced salami, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Pierce one side of the phyllo pastry sheets with a fork or razor blade. Spray pizza pan with cooking spray. Place phyllo sheets on a large baking sheet. Add salami to the pastry sheets, and top with approximately 1/2 cup salami. Cover with another 10 sheets of phyllo sheets. Cover with remaining salami and 1/2 cup salami. Fold one sheet in half over the salami, then the other. Cut remaining dough into four squares to use as top layer. Poke a few holes into the tops with fork or razor blade. Bake in the preheated oven on the bottom rack until bottom layer is golden, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Creamy Banana Pepper Ice Cream for 2
ingredients: 1 banana pepper, chopped | 1 pint vanilla ice cream, softened
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix banana pepper and vanilla ice cream until smooth. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,garlic,maple syrup,romaine lettuce,red swiss chard,farfalle pasta,thai basil,sesame ginger marinade
title: Seared Chicken Stir Fry With Farfalle Pasta Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta, cooked, drained and cooled | 1/2 cup thinly sliced red swiss chard | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons garlic, minced, bottled, from a jar | 1 teaspoon sesame and ginger marinade, from jar | 1/2 cup romaine lettuce, cut in chiffonade, with 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley and 1/4 cup chopped romaine | 1/4 cup fresh thai basil, torn | 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Note, if all ingredients are not specified, preheat grill. Drain pasta, return to pan. Add swiss chard, maple syrup, garlic and marinade.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,caper,anaheim chilies,chipotle chile adobo,red kidney bean
title: Santa Fe Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 anaheim chilies, seeded and diced ( i used an anaheim pepper ) | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 cups brown rice
instructions: Place beans, chilies, capers, brown rice in a baking dish, and bake in a preheated 375º oven for 30 minutes, or until rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,taco seasoning mix,sea salt,red onion,leek
title: Taco Shrimp Cakes
ingredients: 1 lb small shrimp, cooked, peeled, deveined and chopped fine | 1/2 cup shredded coconut cream | 1 medium red onion, chopped fine | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3 leeks, sliced, drained, stems on
instructions: Preheat oven to in a medium bowl combine shrimp and coconut cream. Combine together onion and taco seasoning.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,coriander,brown sugar,red bell pepper,basil leaf
title: Red Pepper and Basil Stir-Fry Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups packed brown sugar | 1 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1 teaspoon ground coriander, or to taste | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 1/4 cup grand marnier, or as needed
instructions: Combine brown sugar, red bell pepper, coriander, and basil in a saucepan. Stir in grand marnier, or as needed to make the sauce slightly thinner.

Random Ingredients: sumac,white wine vinegar,tomato juice,hummus,onion soup mix,bread
title: Hummus and Sumac Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup dry bread, cut into small cubes ( i like to use rye bread for this ) | 1 cup tomato juice | 1/2 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon ground sumac | 2 tablespoons hummus ( homemade or prepared )
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the onion soup mix, bread cubes, tomato juice, wine vinegar, and sumac. Spoon into a shallow serving dish, and top with hummus. Cover, and refrigerate 1 to 4 hours.

title: Mushies - Microwaved for One
ingredients: 1 jar pimiento, cut into 1/4 inch wide slices | 1 jar jam | 8 slices monterey jack cheese, 1/4 inch thick
instructions: Spread each slice on a non stick cookie sheet with slices of cheese. Microwave the sliced pimientos on high for 3 min or until slightly softened and beginning to char on the edges. Turn over, pour on the jam, spread on another 1/4 inch layer of cheese and repeat on top. Let stand for 5 minute serve hot or warm with your choice of accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,club soda,spring onion,mandarin orange segment,kosher salt black pepper,coconut flake,egg yolk,chorizo sausage
title: Chorizo With Sweet Chilli, Mandarin Oranges and Corn Fritters
ingredients: 4 tablespoons coconut flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 spring onion | 8 egg yolks | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 tablespoon club soda | 8 ounces chorizo sausage | 1 mandarin orange segments
instructions: Toast the coconut and coriander seeds in a dry frying pan over medium heat until browned and aromatic, about 5 minute set aside and allow to cool. Scrape the seeds & extra coriander seeds into the food processor bowl with the coconut, and pulse until finely ground. Finely chop the spring onion and stir into the coconut mixture along with the egg yolks, salt & freshly ground pepper. Chop chorizo and place in separate frying dishes and set aside. Pour the beer into the frying pan and warm over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Gently crack egg yolks into the frying pan, then bring up to temperature stirring constantly until the yolks break down. Return the chorizo to the pan and cook for about 5 minute or until heated through. Transfer the corn fritters onto an oven tray lined with parchment or foil. Allow to cool slightly before topping with your favourite condiments such as sweet chilli, minted cucumber and radish.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,collard green,double cream,vinegar,stout beer,kiwi,ha avocadoes
title: Collard Greens With Guacamole
ingredients: 10 large collard greens ( or any leaf of your choice ) | 4 ripe hass avocadoes ( about 1 pound ) | 2 kiwi ( in chunks ) | 1/2 cup double cream ( heavy ) | 1/3 cup vinegar | 2 ounces goat cheese ( we used nuttee ) | 2 fluid ounces stout beer
instructions: Cut collard leaves and place them in a large pot of boiling water and allow to poach until wilted about 2 minutes. Drain well and allow to cool. Scoop out any damaged portions and remove the tough outer leaves. Meanwhile, make guacamole. Cut the avocados in half and remove the pit by placing between the thumb and forefinger of a knife along the length of the avocado. Using your thumb, pry the avocado in the pan with the kiwi and gently remove as much flesh as possible. Cut avocados into small pieces and place the avocados in a medium bowl. Add cream, vinegar and cheese and allow to sit until the cheese has melted. Add chilled collard greens and the guacamole and mix well to combine. Serve. Guacamole is best made with ripe plantains at the very center of the guacamole and should be eaten immediately.

title: Spinach Salad With Kiwi and Beans
ingredients: 4 kiwi fruits, halved and sliced | 3 cups mixed baby spinach leaves | 1/3 cup bean dip ( i recommend kebabs brand aussie aussie bean dip ) | 4 -8 seasoned croutons
instructions: Lay the kiwifruit and beans on a serving dish and top with a sprinkling of bush fresh toppings. Serve alongside a salad of mixed leaves and croutons.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,curry powder,nonstick cooking spray,red pepper,marinara sauce,mirin,salad green
title: Creamy Indian Spiced Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh salad greens | 1 jar marinara sauce | 4 green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper | 2 pinches green cardamoms pods | nonstick cooking spray | 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Arrange greens on the bottom of a glass salad bowl. Pour 1/2 jar of sauce over greens. Scatter the red pepper, cardamom pods, curry powder, and green cardamom pods over the top. Spoon remaining jar of sauce evenly over the top. Spray the top of the salad with non stick cooking spray and cover the bowl loosely with plastic wrap. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Turn out the salad and serve.

title: Italian Mango Wraps
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 3 mangos - peeled, seeded and diced | 1 slice prosciutto | 1 loaf italian bread, cut into strips
instructions: Place the ground beef in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook until evenly browned, breaking into crumbles as it cooks. Stir in the mangos, and cook until almost all of the liquid has been absorbed. Place the prosciutto slices in a paper towel lined plate, and wrap tightly with toothpicks. Place on a microwave safe dish. Cook in the microwave briefly, or on high for about 1 minute on high, until prosciutto becomes light golden in color. Remove toothpicks, slice in half, and warm on a platter.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,no salt ketchup,mace,sesame seed oil,chipotle chile adobo
title: Nookaties(Indonesian Nuts)
ingredients: 2 cups no-salt-added ketchup | 1/2 small chipotle chile in adobo, diced | 1 sprig curry leaf | curry leaves, for garnish | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seed oil
instructions: Place the ketchup in a small bowl, pour in just enough water to cover the ingredients and allow to chill for 15 minutes. Dice the chipotle and stir into the ketchup. Remove the curry leaf from the sprigs and tear or chop into small pieces. In a small skillet, heat the sesame oil and gently toast the sesame seeds with the curry leaves until golden brown. Keep moving the slices so the oil doesnt burn. Serve the nookaties cold with the curry leaves and sesame seeds on top.

title: Seafood Stuffed Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup imitation crabmeat, chopped | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon grated lemon juice and zest of | 1/4 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 4 - 6 lbs flank steaks or 4 -6 lbs sirloin steaks
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Combine crabmeat, creole seasoning, lemon juice, and greek seasoning to taste and mix well. Cut a slit down the center of each steak lengthwise so they don't form too thickly. Place a tablespoon of mixture into each steak lengthwise and wrap them tightly around it. Seal well with kitchen string. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 45 minutes, or until done. Remove from oven and allow to sit for 10 minutes on wire rack. Serve with sauce or salad.

title: The Best Salsa in the World...
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 head roasted almonds or 1 head slivered almonds | 1 cup distilled white vinegar
instructions: Clean the lettuce, removing all the white or black bits. This usually involves slicing off the stalk, but not cutting all the way through. Dice up the nuts and set aside. Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,turmeric powder,curry powder,chicken broth,sea salt black pepper,flour tortilla,salmon fillet
title: Curried Sausage Wraps
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets ( or other mild or hot seafood ) | 1 1/2 cups cranberries, crushed ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/3 cup flour tortilla, warmed | 1/2 cup fat-free low-sodium chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut each salmon fillet into 4 pieces. Place salmon pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. In a small bowl, stir together cranberries and flour tortillas. Place in oven, and bake for 12 minutes. Carefully lift a piece of salmon onto the tortilla, and carefully flatten it out on another piece of parchment paper. Spread the salmon with the cranberry filling. Top salmon with curry, turmeric, and salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,white corn,avocado,cake flour,cumin seed
title: Avocado Caviar With Black Cumin Seeds
ingredients: 1 1/2 medium avocados, peeled | 1/4 cup cake flour | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted and crushed | 3/4 cup white corn, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut avocado in half and remove stone. Coarsely chop the avocado flesh and place into a blender and blend until smooth. Transfer avocado puree to a medium bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix until blended. Using your hands, add some of the avocado puree to the mix to help break up some of the avocado. Stir in the remainder of the avocado puree. Cover and chill. Serve with french bread.

title: Mexican Dry Rub for Beef
ingredients: 4 ounces coarsely chopped walnuts | 1 whole dried red chile | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place walnuts in a food processor, chopping until coarsely ground.

Random Ingredients: carrot,beef stew meat,corn tortilla,icing sugar,allspice,phyllo dough
title: Bhapa Manse - Beef Tortilla Casserole
ingredients: 21 ounces beef stew meat | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | 4 cups frozen chopped carrots | 1 package corn tortillas ( the frozen kind ) | 3 packages phyllo dough or 2 boxes casseroles
instructions: Brown the meat in a nonstick skillet in olive oil. Add the icing sugar and the spices. Let the meat simmered about 20 minutes. Add the carrots and thaw and simmer for about 15 minutes. Remove from the heat. Spread 1 cup meat on the bottom of a baking dish. Bake covered at 350f for 30 minutes. Remove cover. Add half of the corn tortillas on top of meat. Repeat. Top with remaining 1 cup chopped carrots, and the remaining phyllo dough. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes longer. Serve with hot refried beans.

Random Ingredients: broth,cottage cheese,canola oil,strawberry preserve,bean sprout,apple pie filling,beef stock
title: Tasty Party Appy
ingredients: 1 cup beef stock | 1 can fat-free cottage cheese, drained | 1 can fat-free strawberry preserves | 6 ounces low fat cooked lean ground beef, drained | 1 1/2 cups low-fat home-made low-fat broth | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 can apple pie filling, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray an 8x8 glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a microwave safe bowl, combine the beef stock and cottage cheese.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,lemon juice zest,tomato paste,pork tenderloin,maraschino cherry,black pepper,italian sausage
title: Sausage, Lemon and Italian Sausage Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 2 lbs pork tenderloins, cut in 1/2 | 1 can campbell original tomato paste | 2 cups low sodium vegetable broth or 2 cups chicken broth | 2 lemons, juice and zest of ( grated ) | 2 tablespoons fresh ground black pepper | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, and ( sliced )
instructions: Turn on your crock pot to high. Cut sausage into 1 inch pieces. Add to crock pot and cook on high for about 4 - 5 hours, stirring occassionally, until cooked throughout. Remove from crock pot and set temperature to low and let cool. While the sausage is chilling, cut pork into 1 inch pieces. Combine tomato paste and broth in food processor, process until smooth. Pour contents of sauce in a large bowl, add pork and maraschino leaves, toss to coat well with sauce. Add lemon juice zest and black pepper and season with salt to taste. Serve over penne or rigatoni noodle and top with shredded zest if desired. Also, if preferred, marinate the meat for an additional 2 hours so it can soak up the flavors as it absorbs the flavors. The sausage can be refrigerated up to 2 days in sealed containers. Note, the sauce can be kept in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. Note, this can be frozen, ready to use in future recipes.

Random Ingredients: cream,marinara sauce,apricot jam,chili flake,barley,pork tenderloin,cube steak
title: Spicy Crock Pot Pork and Barley
ingredients: 2 lbs cube steaks, trimmed | 1/2 cup raw barley | 1 jar marinara sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons cream, half and half or 2 -3 tablespoons light cream | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes, to taste | 2 cans pork tenderloin, drained & meat seperated
instructions: Place meat in 4 - 5 qt crockpot. Add barley, marinara sauce, cream, barbecue sauce and chili flakes. Top with seared meat. Cover& cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Remove meat & shred into large chunks, using 2 forks. Strain liquid& pour over the stew. Stir. Serve on toasted bread rolls.

title: Korma
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef roast, trimmed of fat | 8 ounces golden raisins | 2 pints sweetened flaked coconut | 2 -4 cups hot chili oil ( or to taste )
instructions: Place a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 325°f. Soak raisins in warm salted water and drain. Trim surface and excess fat from roast and cut into 5 - 6 x 5 inch chunks. Place the roast in a large roasting pan and set aside. Place coconut into a saucepan and add enough hot water to cover. Bring the water to a boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes. Bring the coconut mixture to a boil and pour over the roast chunks. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Transfer roast and coconut to plates, reserving the coconut water. Heat oil in a small saucepan or deep fryer. Fry the raisins over medium heat for about 4 minutes. Add the coconut water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until raisins soften and coconut is tender, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Cheg's Grilled Smoked Salmon Rice
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups instant rice | 2 cups chopped cooked salmon | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 vanilla bean, split
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine rice and 2 cups water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork. Preheat grill to medium heat. Toast taco seasoning in a dry non stick skillet about 2 minutes or until fragrant. Spread mixture over rice mixture, leaving 1/2 inch of the ridge under the top. Remove rice from grill. Spread rice over hot taco seasoning.

title: Beef Steak and Onion Pan
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs boneless beef round steak | 3 spring onions, trimmed | 2 tablespoons bread flour
instructions: Trim excess fat from the beef steak. Score 1 1/4 inch deep into each piece of meat with a sharp knife. Cut a long piece of kitchen string about 2 by 2 1/2 inches wide. Thread the beef, alternating pieces of beef, onions and string onto the skewers. Toss the bread flour into a small bowl and set aside. Heat a large, nonstick skillet over high heat. Add half of the beef and saute to desired doneness, then remove to a bowl and repeat with the second half. Divide the remaining beef mixture among the beef skewers, arranging them on top. Add the remaining flour to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly with a fork, until the mixture is very dark and fragrant. Serve immediately.

title: Brazilian Pea and Peanut Soup
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peas | 4 corn tortillas, cut into strips | 3 tablespoons french crema de cacao
instructions: Soak the peas in water overnight. The next day, bring the peas, corn, and creme de cacao to a boil in a saucepan, then reduce heat. Simmer until the peas are tender. Serve in small bowls with torn tortilla strips to squeeze over the top.

Random Ingredients: chilies,ginger,vermouth,onion soup mix,rice noodle,black mushroom,cornflour,worcestershire sauce
title: Noodles With Mushroom Catsup
ingredients: 200 g cooked rice noodles | 1 small onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon chopped ginger | 1 teaspoon dry vermouth | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/3 cup chopped canned chilies | black mushrooms
instructions: Put noodles in a pot of boiling water. Boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Put into an oven proof dish. Mix with spices, worcestershire sauce, vermouth, and 2 tablespoons cornflour/vegetable oil to form a paste. Add vermouth/onions to bowl with noodles. Add remaining cornflour/vegetable oil and stir for 2 minutes. Pour over noodles and cover with aluminium foil. Bake in a medium oven for 45 - 50 minutes, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon as the dish browns. I check on it about 15 minutes before it's ready and cook as normal. Serve over cooked black mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: sugar,ginger root,white wine vinegar,garam masala,chicken stock,red raspberry jam
title: Sweet and Sour Red Raspberry Soup
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup raw sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons finely diced red raspberry jam
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine chicken stock, red wine vinegar, sugar, ginger, and garam masala. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Strain into a bowl, and cool. Stir in raspberry jam.

title: Aussie Melon-Mango-Gruyère
ingredients: 1 ounce dried mango or 1 ounce fresh mango, chopped | 2 ounces feta cheese, cubed | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning, divided ( or more, to taste ) | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese | 2 cups shredded toasted creamed mexican dark chocolate or 2 cups chocolir cheese | 1/2 cup alfalfa sprout, chopped | 1 cup sliced creamed radish | 1/2 cup shaved edamame lettuce ( optional ) or 1/2 cup iceberg lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Place the mango, cheese cubes, gruyere, creole seasoning, toasted creamed mexican chocolate in a bowl. Toss very well to combine. Top with toasted mango and sprouts. Cover and refrigerate 1 - 2 hours to allow the flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,napa cabbage,deli roast beef,cod,grand marnier,mirin,plain yogurt,green olive
title: The Great New York Rehors Diner Beef Burgers
ingredients: 24 slices deli roast beef | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled jalapeno peppers | 2 tablespoons sliced green olives | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 3 cups thinly sliced napa cabbage | 4 cooked hamburger buns
instructions: Place the roast beef on a platter and top with yogurt, mirin, jalapenos, olives, and grand marnier. Garnish with napa cabbage and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,green olive,stewing beef,vinegar,chicken bouillon cube,citrus peel,splenda sugar substitute,tuna water
title: Tuna, Beef & Olives in Lemons
ingredients: 4 lbs stewing beef, cubed | 1 cup fresh citrus peel | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1 can mixed green olives, drained | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 2 tablespoons red chili pepper flakes | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Place stew beef in slow cooker. Dice any remaining fruit. Stir together peel, vinegar, tuna, olives, splenda, chili flakes and bouillon. Pour over beef in cooker. Cover and cook on high for six hours. Lift lid and cook for an additional 15 minutes. Discard all solids. Serve over rice if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Greek Pasta Salad
ingredients: 15 ounces farfalle pasta, cooked and drained | 1/3 cup smooth peanut butter | 1/2 cup fat-free feta, crumbled | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 carton small-mixed frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except for the whipped topping. Let chill 15 minutes and serve.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Dutch Oven Roasted Potatoes and Garlic
ingredients: 1 rump roast | 1 whole clove garlic, bulb removed | 1 lb yukon gold potato
instructions: Trim fat from roast and place in 6 quart slow cooker with garlic cloves. Place on top of garlic cloves and set to ‘high’. Cook on low for 5 hours. Slice and serve cold with sauce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,cardamom seed,maple syrup,rice wine,tomato puree,poblano chile
title: Kitchen Kouture Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 lb ripe tomato puree, chopped ( or fresh, seeded ) | 1 medium poblano chile, stemmed and seeded | 1 tablespoon maple syrup, low sodium if possible, divided | 1 tablespoon rice wine, low sodium if possible, divided ( or sake ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 large cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: In a food processor or blender, coarsely chop the tomato puree, poblano chile, 1 tablespoon of the maple syrup and 1/2 teaspoon of the rice wine. Add the cardamom. Add the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of maple syrup, and whirl to combine. Arrange the cucumber slices on a serving platter or serving bowl, drizzle with remaining 1/4 teaspoon of maple syrup and sprinkle evenly with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon rice wine.

title: Creamy Tomatillo Sauce
ingredients: 2 pounds tomatillos, husked and rinsed | 5 cups half-and-half
instructions: Place tomatillos in a stockpot and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,shell pasta,cherry tomato,cooking spray,cauliflower,yogurt,caper,natural peanut butter
title: Cauliflower and Shellfish Kugel
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package large shell-on, large shrimp ( about 3 1/2 pound uncooked ) | 1 clove crushed garlic | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1 can sliced cherry tomatoes, drained | 2 tablespoons natural-style peanut butter | 1/2 cup drained drained fresh cauliflower | 1/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°. Coat a 10x9x2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Cook and stir the shrimp, garlic, and chicken bouillon in a large skillet over medium high heat in the original skillet until shrimp turn pink, about 4 minutes. Add the tomatoes, peanut butter, cauliflower, and yogurt to the skillet. Reduce heat to medium, and simmer until cauliflower is tender, and flavors have blended, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and sprinkle with paprika. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,pecan,vanilla essence,cabbage,carrot,poblano chile pepper,penne rigate
title: Cabbage and Poblanos Penne With Irish Cream
ingredients: 8 ounces penne rigate | 2 cups shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup grated carrot | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1 tablespoon grated chipolte's irish cream ( such as bailey's irish cream ) | 2 -4 poblano chile peppers ( scotch bonnet peppers ) | 1/2 cup light irish cream | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Cook penne rigate according to package directions, or until al dente. Meanwhile, combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Remove from heat while still warm and stir in cream. Drain penne and add to vegetable mixture.

title: Quick Beef and Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 cans navy beans ( drained ) | 2 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Place flank steak in crock pot. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook for 6 - 8 hours. Do not lift lid while cooking. Note, cook on high for 2 hours. To freeze, place ingredients in freezer 1 hour before serving. When ready to serve, thaw completely and place in a 2 quart storage container. Serve over hot cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,log goat cheese,chicken,mayonnaise,pork shoulder
title: Pounded Roasted Pork Stomach
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray ( or butter ) | 1/2 lb boneless pork shoulder | 1/2 lb fresh log goat cheese | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 - 1 cup homemade mayonnaise for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray or brush with vegetable oil just to coat the surface. Wrap meat roast with half of goat cheese, pressing it down firmly into meat. Dip in mayonnaise to cover thoroughly. Place on baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes or until browned. Slice to serve.

title: Farina (Chinese Meatballs)
ingredients: 1 pound ground veal | 1/2 cup dry farina | 1/2 cup blanched slivered almonds | 2 cloves garlic | 1/4 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together veal, farina, almonds, garlic, szechuan peppercorns and almond extract until well blended. The mixture should be wet but not dripping. Shape into 1 inch meatballs. Arrange the meatballs in a steamer set over boiling water and steam over simmering water, partially covered, for 45 to 60 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve with rice, vegetables and sauces.

title: Chicken Fajitas from the Pastor®
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 2 cups tomato sauce | 1 cup dried pimento pepper | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves | 2 lbs medium cooked ground pork
instructions: Place the chicken thighs, tomato sauce, pimento pepper, fenugreek, and ground pork in a bowl. Scoop the mixture into resealable freezer plastic bags, and freeze the mixture for up to 1 week.

title: Chorizo and Sausage With Cherries
ingredients: 1 ounce chorizo sausage, sliced | 4 ounces sweet italian sausage, sliced | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | sour cream or sweet gherkins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place chorizo and sweet Italian sausage in a large roasting tin, add the vinegar and cover with foil. Place in oven and bake for 25 minutes, uncover and bake for a further 5 minutes. Turn the broiler on high. Spoon the caramelised sausage onto a serving dish. Serve immediately and garnish with sour cream or gherkins.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,mexican cheese taco,molasses,scallion,guacamole,chicken bouillon cube,russet potato,pearl barley
title: Tex-Mex Potato and Barley Bake
ingredients: 4 medium russet potatoes ( about 4 pounds ) | 16 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese, divided ( i use reduced fat ) | 1 can green peppers, diced and drained | 32 ounces chicken bouillon cubes, divided ( or 2 cups chicken broth for thicker flavor ) | 2 cups pearl barley ( or 3 cups barley or white rice ) | 2 tablespoons molasses ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions or 2 tablespoons green onions | 1/2 cup guacamole
instructions: Cut potatoes lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/4 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: white onion,flat bread,cream chicken soup,basil,orange juice,lemon juice,fruit,anise seed
title: Quick Bruschetta
ingredients: 12 slices good quality flat bread, 1/2 in. thick | 1 medium white onion, chopped finely | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup flat bread, crumbs & crumbs | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice ( about 8 oranges ) | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped, leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place bread slices on baking sheet, and toast in oven 2 minutes, until slightly browned. Sprinkle bread with salt. In a medium bowl, combine onion, soup, crumbs, anise, orange juice, and lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,flax seed,red wine vinegar,cinnamon raisin bread,cooking oat
title: Cinnamon Cinnamon Cured Raisin Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf cinnamon raisin bread ( or 1 loaf sourdough loaf ) | 2 cups dried quick-cooking oats ( not instant or quick cooking oats ) | 1 cup roasted dried sweet pickle, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup toasted flax seed | red wine vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the torn bread in a large bowl. Add the dried, toasted dill pickles and flax seeds, tossing to combine. Add just enough vinegar and red wine vinegar to moisten all the pieces.

title: Crazy Chick Pea
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 4 ounces korean red pepper paste | 2 tablespoons green onions, finely chopped | 1 anchovy, grated
instructions: Drain the chick peas thoroughly, or rinse and drain completely. Place chick peas in a strainer or strainer and discard all liquid. Press the beans out of the strainer using your fingers if you can, and discard the liquid. You can press the beans again to remove excess liquid. Place the red pepper paste in a bowl. Pour enough korean red pepper paste over the chick peas to cover evenly. Use a fork to mix in the green onions and the grated anchovy. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. The next day, the next day, remove the plastic wrap completely and put in refrigerator. Keep it covered at all times to let air dry out from the steam, stirring occasionally to prevent scorching. Enjoy with rice but my sister never thought to press the paste against the skin. I think she used food grade korean hot pepper powder.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,kosher salt,corn oil,button mushroom,avocado,saffron thread
title: Avocado-Mushroom Salad (Salata De Ajillo)
ingredients: 3 cups grapeseed oil or 3 cups extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads, cracked ( or 1-2 tsp. dried saffron ) | 3 ripe avocados ( or other firm mild flavor ripe citrus with a high acidity ) | 24 medium button mushrooms or 24 large button mushrooms, cut into small chunks | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the oils, vinegar and saffron. Whisk to blend. Adjust the sweetness with a little sugar so that it dissolves. The flavor intensifies after a few minutes to a light sour red color but doesn't burn. Toss mushrooms with the salad and salt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,purpose flour,whipping cream,papaya,sea bass fillet,chicken thigh
title: Coconut Maison (Crazy Fruity Fried Fish)
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless boneless chicken thighs | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons papayas, grated | 3 cups whipping cream | 1 cup grated papaya | 1/2 cup cornmeal
instructions: Remove fat from chicken and discard. Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes.

title: Squid, Ziti and Calamari Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked ziti pasta ( about 2 1/4 cups ) | 3/4 cup clear honey | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 3 medium carrots, sliced | 3/4 lb squid, cleaned | 1/2 cup cornmeal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Cook the ziti according to package directions. Drain, then transfer to a large serving bowl. In a saucepan, combine the honey, vinegar and carrots, and cook just until heated through, about 1 minute. Stir the cooked ziti and the sauce in the bowl with the vegetables. Spoon the mixture inches. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes. Spray a 13x9x2 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine cornmeal and a few tablespoons of the cooking liquid from the cooked pasta. Pour the mixture over the ziti. Bake, covered, for 30 minutes. Remove lid, increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees f, and bake 30 minutes more, or until the ziti is heated through.

title: Mexican Crawfish in Satsuma Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs crawfish tail, in shell | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon satsuma orange rind
instructions: Boil crawfish til they open. Mix 1/2 t cream with chile powder and orange peel mix. Place crawfish on top of orange peel, pour sauce over all. Let it simmer for 10 - 12 minutes. Serve cold.

title: Baked Raspberries
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh raspberries | 2 inches peeled fresh ginger
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Line a 2 to 2 1/2 quart shallow baking dish with parchment paper. Cover the baking dish with parchment paper. Using a sharp knife, cut about a 1/2 inch deep hole in the raspberries. Push the peel of the ginger into the raspberries to release any juice that may have come out of the berries. Arrange the ginger slices in the center of the dish. Place the raspberries in the dish, making sure to collect any juice that may spill out. Pour some boiling water into the pan to come within 1/2 of the rim of the dish. Bake the raspberries until tender, 15 to 25 minutes. When the raspberries are done, remove from heat and pour into a dish to cool. Remove the skin from the ginger. Slice the peeled ginger into thin rounds and arrange them on top of the raspberries. Pour any juice from the raspberries over the ginger slices. Let stand until cool, about 15 minutes. Stir to keep from scorching.

title: Baked Norwegian Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 lb salmon | 1/2 cup dried parsley flakes | 1/8 cup peppercorn
instructions: Mix 1/4 cup parsley flakes, 1/8 cup peppercorns and 1/8 cup of mixed spice according to package instructions.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,tilapia fillet,green chili pepper,chive,olive oil
title: Green Chilli Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs tilapia fillets | 2 cups self raising flour | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 2 -3 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 1 minced green chili pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Trim fillets of excess fat, then wash under cold water. Cut into 8 pieces lengthwise. Cut a slit in the thickest part of each piece to make a pocket in the side of the fish. Combine flour, oil, chives and chili in a shallow dish. Dip each piece of fish in flour mixture and coat both sides. Heat oil in a large non stick frying pan over a high heat. Add fillets and cook until golden brown on both sides. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,white bean,pineapple juice,bourbon,sherry wine,butter lettuce
title: White Beans with Sweet-Sour Sauce
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained | 1/2 cup bourbon | 1/2 cup pineapples in juice | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup fresh butter lettuce or 1/2 cup cilantro, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons bourbon or 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Combine beans with 1/4 cup of bourbon or sherry and mash with a fork. Add the remaining ingredients. Taste and adjust for seasoning. Bake for 15 minutes in a hot oven, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mussel,baby spinach leaf,greek yogurt,tomato jalapeno,sea salt,white sauce,rum,yellow bell pepper
title: Mussels and Peppers in a Tomato Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain goat greek yogurt | 1/2 cup light rum ( recommended -- bacardi ) | 2 lbs fresh mussels, cleaned and debearded | 1 1/2 cups baby spinach or 1 1/2 cups regular baby spinach leaves | 1 large yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 medium tomatoes, seeded and diced | 4 tablespoons light mussel liquor ( bacardi ) | sea salt ( optional ) | white sauce ( optional, for dipping )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the goat cheese, rum and light rum and set aside. Rinse the mussels and pull out the beards if desired. In a large skillet, combine the spinach, yellow bell pepper, tomato and mussel liquor. Season with salt and white sauce. Cook over medium high heat until the vegetables begin to soften. Ladle 1/4 cup of the warm liquid from the pan, being careful not to spill over the veggies. Place a layer of mussels in the bottom of a large serving dish, with each mussel on top. Spoon 1/4 of the cheese mixture over each mussel. Place the remaining mussels in the same manner. Pour the remaining liquid over the mussels. Top with white sauce followed by remaining cheese slices. Serve with a green salad.

title: Irish Cream (Homemade)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | 1 cup molasses | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/3 cup irish cream | 1/2 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl.. Add a sprinkle of almonds to the top of each glass when serving. Great on ice cream as your first nibble.

title: Simple Za'atar Lamb Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs meat, cubes ( leg lamb, ground lamb, ground lamb beef, veal meat, beef ) | 7 teaspoons za'atar spice mix ( za'atar essence mix ) | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lemon grass, chopped ( optional ) | 1 cardamom seed, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Note, i used za'atar mix that comes in a pouch, but in that it's the za'atar mixed with a little water and i couldn't get it workable. If this is your meat, you could add the cardamom seeds, but i didn't like biting into them in particular. Put all the ingredients together in a bowl and knead until they resemble breadcrumbs. Shape the mixture into balls and place on a shallow buttered baking sheet. Press the edges with fork to separate them. Bake at 350f for 25 minutes.

title: Romano Cheese and Watercress Tea
ingredients: 1 tablespoon watercress, finely chopped ( italian or curly leaf ) | 1 tablespoon fresh dates, chopped | 2 tablespoons freshly grated romano cheese ( parrmano can be substituted )
instructions: Sauté a 1/2 teaspoonful of watercress in a pinch of hot water over a low flame until the water is bubbling and it turns bright green. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Once cooled, finely chop the remaining watercress, then stir it into the dates and romano cheese in a small bowl. Serve at once. You may substitute 1 teaspoonful of dried mint leaves for the watercress.

title: Tuna Chutney
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups caster sugar | 310 g cooked canned tuna, drained and flaked | 1 can chopped mild green chiles | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar
instructions: Combine sugar, tuna, chiles and vinegar in pan and cook over a low heat for 3 mins or until sugar dissolves. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,cream cheese,white bread,chocolate pudding mix,grain mustard
title: French Toast Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 3 slices white bread | 1/4 cup fat free cream cheese or 1/4 cup fat free cottage cheese | 1/4 cup semisweet chocolate pudding mix | 2 tablespoons chopped italian tomatoes ( or 1 large ) | 1 teaspoon coarse grain mustard
instructions: Toast bread, but do not brown. Combine cream cheese, pudding mix, and tomatoes.

title: Italian Breadsticks
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped italian parsley | 1 can prepared pizza dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine parsley and pizza dough in a bowl. Form the dough into a log about the size of the size of a large cookie. Place on baking sheets and sprinkle top. Bake for 12 minutes. Remove from oven and brush tops of bread with milk. Let bread stand for 5 minutes. Turn bread over and bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Eggless Grapefruit Pie
ingredients: 1 cup diced seedless grapefruit | 1 1/2 cups white flour | 1 cup brown sugar | 1 quart grapefruit juice | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 cup finely diced crystallized grapefruit
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Line an 11x17 inch baking pan with parchment paper. Toss the grapefruit in the flour and place it in a mixing bowl. Add 1 1/2 cups of the brown sugar. Add in the grapefruit juice and stir to combine with your sugar. Set aside. Brush the inside of the pastry shell and the sides with oil. Cover with the rest of the brown sugar and fold into mixture with a fork, using a pastry brush dipped in water to do this. Pour into the prepared baking pan. Bake for 40 minutes. Top with crystallized fruit, if using.

title: Chile Pepper Bread
ingredients: 1 fresh red chili pepper, chopped | 8 slices firm white bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place chili in a bowl. Add bread, stir and let it toast for a few minutes. The bread has been soaking up all the moisture. Place the bread on a baking sheet or jelly roll pan. If you don't have a baking sheet, put the chili mixture on a plate and wrap each slice up.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,currant,grain rice,kaffir lime leaf,brown rice,dark brown sugar,sesame oil,catsup
title: Indonesian Rice Pudding - Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain rice, washed | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar ( dark palm sugar available at asian food stores ) | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil | 1 tablespoon catsup ( available at asian food stores ) | 1 kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 1/3 cup currants ( optional ) | 1/3 cup heavy cream ( optional )
instructions: Wash rice until it runs clear. Place rice in pan with the water starting at the inside of the pan and set over medium high heat. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until the pan is dry but not watery and the water remains clear. Remove the pan from heat. Add sugar, sesame oil and juice from lime leaf or kaffir lime leaf, if using. Simmer for 2 minutes or until sugar dissolves. Add catsup and mix thoroughly. Pour into bowl with cooked rice. When cold, whip cream and fold into rice mixture. Chill until cold and serve.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate juice,brie cheese,vital wheat gluten,gingerroot,sesame oil,tomato juice
title: Brie-Ginger-Cheddar Dip
ingredients: 1 lb brie cheese | 2/3 cup heinz sesame juice | 1/3 cup pomegranate juice | 2 tablespoons fresh gingerroot | 1 large tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1 3/4 cups vital wheat gluten
instructions: Core the cheese and cut into chunks about 2 x 1x1 and 1/8 wide. Boil the tomato juice and add to the cheese along with the gingerroot, reduce heat to low, and cook for 25 minutes. Drain the cheese, reserving the juice, and allow to cool at room temperature. Combine the juice with the wheat gluten and stir to blend. Cover and chill at least 1 hour. Serve with crackers. Can be doubled.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,heavy cream,salmon,almond paste,fennel seed,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Smoked Salmon Balls
ingredients: 4 ounces unsulfured almond paste ( not almond paste ) | 1 cup heavy cream ( room temperature ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 1/2 lbs fresh salmon, skinned, halved lengthwise and cleaned of bones | 2 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Process or process the almond paste, cream and parsley in food processor until well mixed. Pour into a bowl and stir in the fennel seeds. Stir into the salmon mixture and set aside. Place oven rack on second notch and preheat oven to 325°f roll the mixture into 18 - 1 inch balls and pat into circles 1/3 inch thick on a large baking sheet sprinkled with the breadcrumbs. Bake until the casserole is golden and the salmon is just cooked through, about 12 minutes. Serve with steamed cauliflower florets with a dollop if desired.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,msg,red new mexico chile,corn oil,tuna fish
title: Pescado Guisado (Vietnamese Fish Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups tuna fish, diced | 2 dried red new mexico chiles, stemmed, seeded, and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch-thick slices | 1/4 cup corn oil | 1 tablespoon msg ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil, separated | 12 ounces cooked salmon fillets ( without skin )
instructions: Combine tuna, chiles, and 1/4 cup water in a bowl. In another, bowl, whisk 1/4 cup water, 2 teaspoons corn oil, and msg. In a small bowl, whisk 1 tablespoon water, remaining 1 tablespoon corn oil, and 1 teaspoon water until dressing holds its shape. Drizzle half the dressing over tuna mixture.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,purpose flour,lime wedge,vermicelli,lemon peel,broccoli floret
title: Lemon Pasta & Broccoli
ingredients: 1 package vermicelli ( or fettuccine ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 can tomato soup | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh grated lemon peel | 3 cups broccoli florets | chili flavored heated crushed red pepper flakes or hot sauce
instructions: In a large pot, melt oil. Remove from heat. Add vermicelli and cook until lightly browned, 2 - 3 minutes. Add flour and soup, stirring to blend. Remove from heat. Add lemon peel. To serve, divide pasta among individual plates. Top with the hot chili flavored crushed red peppers or hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,tamarind pulp,turkey sausage,nonfat plain yogurt,orange flower water,balsamic vinegar,taco sauce,pork tenderloin
title: Mexican Style Spicy Stuffed Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp | 1 small orange, zest and juice of | 1 dash orange flower water | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon taco sauce | sliced deli-style smoked turkey sausage | 8 slices focaccia bread, toasted
instructions: For sauce, combine yogurt, tamarind pulp, orange rind, juice, sambal oelek, pepper sauce and vinegar in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 1 minute, stirring. Remove from microwave and add taco sauce and turkey sausage slices. Microwave 3 - 4 additional minutes, or until fully cooked. Spread the turkey mixture on slices of toasted focaccia bread and grill, turning once, until lightly browned. Spoon some sauce over each slice of stuffed bread and serve with a drizzle of remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,red chile,caraway seed,dark chocolate,hard egg
title: Chile Glazed Hard-Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dark chocolate | 5 tablespoons light corn syrup | 5 tablespoons red chile, crushed | 5 tablespoons caraway seeds | 12 hard-boiled eggs, peeled
instructions: Break fresh hard boiled eggs into a bowl and add the dark chocolate, light corn syrup, red chile, and caraway seeds. Using a melon baller scoop out the egg white portion and discard. Add the egg whites and gently stir to coat. Chill in the refrigerator until hardened.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,heavy whipping cream,taco seasoning,mascarpone cheese,walnut oil
title: Taco Spread II
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 cup chopped walnuts packed in oil
instructions: In a medium bowl, whip cream until soft peaks form. Add mascarpone cheese and taco seasoning.

title: Toffee Coconut Balls
ingredients: 20 g toffee, coarsely chopped | 375 ml light coconut milk ( coco rico )
instructions: Place the toffee and coconut milk in a small saucepan. Over a gentle heat, bring to a boil and remove from the heat. Stir to blend then set aside for about 2 hours or until it has absorbed most of the milk. Refreame and serve.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,coriander seed,beef chuck,napa cabbage,orange zest,grain white rice,cornflour,iceberg lettuce
title: Sweet Corn Beef and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup coriander seed ( see note ) | 1/4 cup orange zest | 1 cup orange juice or 1 cup distilled white vinegar | 2 tablespoons whole grain white rice, rinsed, drained and chilled or 2 tablespoons yellow rice, rinsed, drained and chilled or 1 tablespoon brown rice, rinsed, drained and chilled | 800 g beef chuck, trimmed of all visible fat cut of all visible fat and cut into 2. 5 x 1/2cm slices | 1/2 small head napa cabbage, leaves separated, leaves cut into 2. 5 cm ( about 300g ) | 1/2 small head iceberg lettuce, leaves separated, leaves cut into 2. 5 cm ( about 300g ) | 2/3 cup low-fat sour cream or 2/3 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 250 g blueberries
instructions: Note on corriander seeds, refer to my note on orange zest, refer to my note on orange zest, refer to my note on dried orange zest, refer to my note on dried orange zest, refer to my note on dried black soybeans, refer to my note on dried black soybeans, refer to my note on dried black soybeans. In the event of a decline in the quality of the beef, remove the beef from the bones and rinse them well under warm water. This may require two changes of water to get the desired texture. Drain the beef, allow it to rest, covered with new water if necessary, for an hour. Place the coriander seeds in a small small skillet over medium heat and toast, stirring gently for about 15 minutes, or until fragrant. Grind the coriander seeds to a fine powder in a mortar and pestle or spice grinder, or grind them in a spice mill. Grind the black soybeans to a fine powder in mortar and pestle until they are very fragrant or a little more. In a large saucepan, bring the orange/rice vinegar, white rice, the coriander powder and orange zest to a boil. Add the meat, a good pinch of salt and the ground black soybeans. Reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, for about 40 minutes, or until the beef is almost cooked through and the liquid is absorbed. Remove the lid, add the napa cabbage and cook, covered, for about 35 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender and the liquid has absorbed. Cool. Just before serving, stir in the sour cream or yogurt with a pinch of salt and mix well. Transfer the beef and some of the juice to the coriander and bean mixture and mix well. Garnish with the blueberries.

Random Ingredients: pita pocket,taco seasoning,molasses,parsley flake,white bean,large shrimp,graham wafer
title: Molasses Shrimps With White Bean Dip #RSC
ingredients: 1 jar white beans, rinsed | 1 bag graham wafers, finely crunched | 1 cup smoked paprika-flavored molasses | 1 bag large shrimp | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/4 - 1/3 cup dry parsley flakes
instructions: In lg bowl, combine beans and drained sausages.

title: Artichoke and Scallion Skewers
ingredients: 1 small cucumber | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained, liquid reserved | 1 scallion, peeled and minced
instructions: Combine the cucumber, artichoke hearts and scallion in the container of a food processor.

title: Cheese and Vegilicious Mini Meatloaves
