ingredients: 1 cup cooked crumbled veal | 1 cup leftover mashed potatoes ( about 4 slices ) | 3 teaspoons cornflour | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 cup minced pared and halved radish parsnips | 2 tablespoons dry bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to lightly grease a muffin tin. Combine the veal, potatoes, cornflour, cheddar cheese, pared radish and bread crumbs then spoon mixture into cups. Bake, uncovered, for 18 - 20 minutes or until heated through. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes. Slice into 12 slices.

title: Baked Cod and Asparagus (Aarsi) Steamed in Caramel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salted butter lettuce leaves | 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut crosswise into 2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup dry roasted salted butter lettuce leaves | 4 ounces cooked cod, flaked
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spread butter on a 12 inch square glass baking dish. Arrange asparagus leaves over butter. Drizzle with roasted butter and top with a layer of cod flakes. Bake for about 10 minutes or until heated through.

title: Japanese Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 lb boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch pieces | 5 medium mushrooms | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Place rice wine in shallow dish, and stir in the pieces of beef on top of the rice wine. Cover, and refrigerate several hours. Remove the beef from the refrigerator and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Remove marinade, and wipe off any excess. Preheat broiler. Place the meat, sliced mushrooms, and salt and pepper in a roasting pan,. Broil 5 minutes on each side, or until browned and cooked through. Drizzle with the reserved marinade.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,anise seed,chicken breast half
title: Apple-Anise Coated Coated Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 4 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, divided | 2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Grease an 11x15 inch baking dish. Arrange chicken in a single layer in the baking dish. Pour 1 tablespoon of vinegar over the chicken and sprinkle with anise seeds. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken juices run clear, about 1 hour. An orange will often be helpful in drizzling on top.

title: Homemade Noodles
ingredients: 16 ounces dry lasagna noodles | garlic salt | 2 1/4 - 2 1/2 teaspoons dry basil
instructions: Place noodles in a large pot and cover with salted cold water. Allow to sit for about 8 minutes, or until softened but still firm to the bite. Drain and rinse noodles. Bring a large pot of water to boil, then reduce heat and add noodles. Cook noodles about 6 minutes, or until tender but still firm to bite. Drain noodles, then return noodles to a large mixing bowl. Add garlic salt and dried basil. Use a spatula to gently toss until all noodles are coated with the seasonings. Taste and adjust seasonings with more garlic salt and basil. Place noodles on your favorite serving plate and serve with your favorite cheese.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,vinegar,hot pepper,green chile pepper,raisin,egg,cranberry juice,coconut milk
title: Indonesian Chili Chicken II
ingredients: 6 chicken drumsticks | boiling water to cover | 3 cups coconut milk | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1 fresh hot pepper, sliced | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1 can chopped cranberry juice | 1 egg, lightly beaten
instructions: Place chicken in a dutch oven or deep pot. Pour boiling water over, then add coconut milk, vinegar, hot pepper, chilies, and cranberry juice. Cover, and let stand for 30 minutes. Turn occasionally. Add onion and egg. Cover, and cook 30 minutes, or until chicken is tender.

title: Ounna's  Corned Beef
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs corned beef brisket | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed, defrosted | 1 package shredded walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Arrange oven rack in center of oven. Place beef on rack, fat side down. Using a sharp paring knife spread corned beef evenly over beef. Place on rack in center of oven. Bake for approximately 45 minutes or until desired doneness. Remove from oven.

title: Mexican Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces thin chinese noodles | 1 can red lentils | 1/2 cup red-wine honeydew melon, sliced | 1/2 - 1 cup beer ( a splash or two is plenty ) | 1 1/2 lbs ladyfingers ( or other savoiardi ) | minced cilantro ( to garnish ) or dolcelatte ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, and cook chinese noodles until al dente, approximately 5 - 7 minutes. Drain noodles and rinse with cold water to cool. Place them in a large bowl, and toss with honeydew. Slice the melon in half lengthwise, and drizzle with beer. Layer ladyfingers, sliced melon, lentils, and noodles in individual serving plates, sprinkling each serving with minced cilantro or dolcelatte.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,italian sausage,vegetable shortening,mustard powder,green chile pepper,ice,whipping cream
title: Texas Chile Sausages with Cream
ingredients: 4 mild green chile peppers, sliced into thin strips | 2 tablespoons salt packed fresh green chile peppers, chopped | 6 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon ground dry mustard powder | ice | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat a grill for direct heat. Blend green chile peppers, 1 tablespoon salt, and 2 tablespoons sugar together in a blender until well mixed. In a large saucepan over medium heat, melt shortening and dry mustard powder.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,brioche bread,active yeast,rye bread,bicarbonate soda,poultry seasoning
title: Fennel Crust Rye Bread
ingredients: 500 g fresh coarse rye bread | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, roughly crushed | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | bread, to cover
instructions: Place the rye bread in a large mixing bowl, add the soda and fennel seeds and mix. The yeast should have dissolved, just enough to start with but it can become lukewarm. Add the remaining herbs and stir to combine. Cover and leave to ferment in a warm place for about 40 minutes, or until the rye bread has doubled in size. Using an electric dough scraper, gradually add 1 tablespoon of bread water at a time, until you have a wet, but sticky sponge. Continue until the sponge is the consistency of light thick cream. Cover and prove in a warm place for about 1 1/2 hours or until the sponge thickens and has absorbed all of the liquid. Turn out onto a lightly floured and flour surface, knead until smooth and elastic, shape into a ball, place on a lightly floured breadboard and cover. Leave to rise in a warm place for 10 minutes or until doubled in size. Preheat the grill to high. Cut the bread out of the loaf form the center and place on the grill. Spread mustard on each half. Cover and place bread under the grill and cook for 5 minutes or until the tops are crisp and golden. Serve hot, with ketchup or jam, or as an accompaniment to roast vegetables, meats, or mashed potato.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,linguine,great northern bean,gruyere cheese,dark sesame oil,msg,white onion
title: White Onion and Gruyère Mac and Cheese With Fettuccine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped white onions | 4 tablespoons finely chopped gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/8 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed completely ( about 4 cups ) or ( 5 ounce ) can navy beans ( about 4 cups ) | 6 ounces dry linguine or 6 ounces spaghetti, cooked according to package directions
instructions: In a large heavy skillet, cook the white and green onion over medium heat, stirring, until the onions are soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk the vinegar, sesame oil, and msg. Add the cheese and toss to coat. Add the onion mixture to the cheese mixture, stirring, and cook, stirring, until the cheese just begins to melt, about 30 seconds. Add the beans, and heat through, about 2 minutes. Serve topped with the linguine or spaghetti.

title: Crock Pot Curry Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs piece beef bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot. Cook on low 6 - 8 hours.

title: Asparagus, Pistachio-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 fresh asparagus spears | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 2 teaspoons ground mustard | 1/2 cup fresh pesto sauce, buitoni | 1/3 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup pistachios or 1/2 cup unsalted pistachios, chopped | 12 tablespoons good quality bittersweet chocolate, cut into 6 pieces
instructions: Wipe the asparagus tips with a dampened spoon.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,milk powder,muenster cheese,scallion,cumin powder,havarti cheese,crab boil
title: Hot Crab Boquettes
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk powder | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour or 2 tablespoons bread crumbs | 2 ounces havarti cheese or 2 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 ounces muenster cheese or 2 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 cup chopped scallion ( scallions ) | 1 -2 cup imitation crab ( cooked, flaked or cut into large pieces or desired size )
instructions: Mix or blend ingredients except crab, scallions and imitation crab. Form into four oval shaped patties about 1 1/2 thick and put a piece of optional desired in each. Cover with wax paper or plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 450f degrees. Place patties on a foil lined cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes or until a thermometer registers 180f remove from the oven and set aside to rest for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Cheesy Cinnamon Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages spaghetti sauce ( or your favorite pasta sauce ) | 1/4 cup sliced pepperoni ( i used pepperoni slices ) | 1 -2 tablespoon spicy taco seasoning ( i use pampered chef taco seasoning ) | 1 pinch cinnamon | 1 teaspoon garlic paste
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat spaghetti sauce in a saucepan on low, stirring occasionally until heated through. Meanwhile, melt taco seasoning according to package directions. Stir in pepperoni slices. Toss spaghetti with hot sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Cabbage and Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, halved lenghwise, cored | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Add cabbage and cook uncovered, for about 6 minutes, stirring frequently. When the cabbage has begun to soften, drain and transfer to a bowl. Stir in mozzarella cheese and cook until evenly melted and the cheese has begun to bubble.

title: Spicy Caribbean Clam Mango Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped yellow squash | 1/2 cup finely chopped hot pepper | 1 teaspoon allspice | 2 cans diced limes, drained | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 12 ounces chopped fresh clams, drained | 1 cup finely chopped mango | 1 package finely chopped fresh asparagus
instructions: Mix first five ingredients and chill. Drain juice and add remaining ingredients. Serve with grilled shrimp, pork rinds, fish or meat.

title: Saiminhas (Carrots With Tofu)
ingredients: 5 tablespoons safflower oil | 2 lbs firm tofu, drained | 8 ounces cooked steaks, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons safflower oil in a large skillet. Carefully add the tofu and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add the steaks and pepper. Cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, 1 minute.

title: Baby Bok Choy in Thai Spiced Butter
ingredients: 1 piece baby bok choy ( about 4-1/2 inches square or a small bunches ) | 2 tablespoons unsalted margarine | 1 medium green cardamom pod, cracked | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | grated lime, zested into a teaspoon
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to a boil. Add the bok choy and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until it brightens slightly. Drain in a sieve, and immediately immerse in ice water for 3 to 5 minutes. Drain again, and repeat with the remaining bok choy. Melt the margarine in a large skillet over medium heat, and cook the cardamon for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add the cardamom, nutmeg, and sliced bok choy, and toss to coat with butter. Cook for 1 or 2 minutes, until the water evaporates and the bok choy turns bright green. Squeeze 1 tablespoon of lime juice into the mixture and let the mixture sit until cool to the touch. Remove the garlic powder from the mixture, and stir in before adding the zest of 1 lime. Season with salt, to taste, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,ketchup,chicken,white onion,cumin,sea salt,pistachio pudding mix
title: Grilled Swiss Chard
ingredients: 4 lbs swiss chard ( i use frozen, thawed ) | 1 can chicken, cubed | 8 ounces white onion, chopped | 1 can ketchup | 2 tablespoons cumin | 2 tablespoons pam cooking spray or 2 tablespoons other outdoor grill oil | 1 package instant pistachio pudding mix
instructions: Place chicken, onion, ketchup, cumin and pam in a bowl and mix well with a wire whisk until well blended. Divide the contents in half and mix with greens. Let marinate in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. Preheat indoor griller or grill pan to medium high. Grill greens according to package instructions, turning occasionally. Serve on a hot platter with a sprinkling of pistachios, crusty bread slices or toasted crusty rye bread slices. Variation, i use the frozen contents of the ketchup can and then remove the skin and pulp before using. Yield, about 4 cups per serving.

title: Mexican Chocolate Slices
ingredients: 6 ounces good quality bittersweet chocolate, chopped into pieces | 1/2 teaspoon salt, plus more | salt, to taste | chopped cilantro leaves,, for garnish
instructions: Microwave the chocolate and salt in a 2 quart microwave safe dish on high power until the chocolate is melted, about 3 minutes, stirring once halfway through. Arrange the chocolate slices on a serving platter, sprinkle with cilantro leaves, and serve.

Random Ingredients: frangelico,italian turkey sausage,fryer chicken,macaroni,ha avocadoes,sherry wine,scallop
title: Italian Inn Clangers and Mash
ingredients: 6 slices dry medium prawns or 6 small scallops | 4 slices deli italian turkey sausage | 2 large hass avocadoes | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine | 1/3 cup frangelico or 1/3 cup liqueur | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked macaroni | 2 tablespoons snipped italian-style shopped salted anchovies
instructions: Cook prawns or scallops in boiling, salted water 4 - 5 minutes, turning once.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,golden caster sugar,thyme leaf,ginger,kosher salt,pork,chili flake
title: Sichuan Braised Beef and Pork
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/4 lbs boneless pork, cut into 1. 5-inch cubes | 1/3 cup kosher salt | 2 tablespoons golden caster sugar | 6 cups beef stock or 6 cups beef stock | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary leaves or 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 f. Rinse the beef and pork with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Working in batches, add the meat to a large casserole in a single layer and sprinkle with salt. Toss the beef and pork in the salt and pour on half the beef stock. Cover and place in oven. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until meat is tender. Strain the pan juices into a 2 qt saucepan and stir in the remaining stock, sugar and herbs. Simmer for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,spring onion,red pepper,angel flake coconut,white bread,graham cracker crust,mayonnaise
title: Coconut & Chilli Crudites
ingredients: 500 g white bread, sliced | 1 red pepper, deseeded and shredded | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 120 g pizza sauce | 2 tablespoons crushed natural gluten-free crushed gluten free cookies ( ritz biscuits ) | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons sun eaters angel flake coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Cut the crusts of bread into 1cm cubes, and place in a mixing bowl with red pepper, spring onion, pizza sauce, shredded coconut and gluten free cookies. Toss with the mayo.

title: Polish Patty Melt #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated loaf sandwich rolls | 1/2 cup dried onion flakes | 6 teaspoons crumbled ham | 1 egg | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Take a french bread roll and have plain flour.

title: Prawn Casserole
ingredients: 750 g raw prawns | 150 g ground veal | 150 g ground prawns | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 5 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 2 russet potatoes, halved lengthways | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 180ºc. Shell and devein the prawns. Tip the prawns into a large bowl and mix in the veal, prawns, cocoa powder, half the chopped parseley and the black pepper. Spread the mixture into a 2 litre casserole dish. Peel the russet potatoes, cut into thick slices, and spread over the prawn mixture. Bake for 5 - 20 minutes, or until browned. Top with rest of the chopped parsley, scatter over the remaining chopped parsley and cook for 10 - 15 minutes until crusty and golden.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,lettuce,yellow cake mix,olive oil,coffee,fennel,chocolate chip
title: Italian Mocha Sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons potato starch | 1/2 cup hot coffee | 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/4 cup packed candied fennel | 1 can sliced ripe olives | 1 package crumbled semi-sweet chocolate chips, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl, stir together potato starch and hot coffee. Reserve. In a medium bowl, combine cake mix, fennels, and olive oil. Spread onto prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until lightly browned for bread.

title: Chinese Lasagna
ingredients: 5 ounces lasagna noodles, broken up | 1 can unsweetened pineapple chunks, well drained | 1/2 cup chicken stock
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat and cook chicken 5 minutes with lid on until chicken is done. Stir in noodles and pour in chicken stock. Stir. Do not boil. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until noodles are tender and liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Serve.

Random Ingredients: oil,bean sprout,red chili sauce,cajun seasoning,salt pork,golden raisin,italian turkey sausage,octopus
title: Turkey Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb turkey sausage ( remove casings ) | 1/2 lb red chili sauce | 8 ounces golden raisins | 4 fluid ounces oil | 1 jar cola-flavored yellow enchilada sauce or ( 3 ounce ) jar sweet red chili sauce | 2 cans mixed beans sprouts ( with 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, 2 tsp. salt, 1/4 tsp ) | 1 ounce salt pork | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: In a 9 inch square baking dish, combine the turkey sausage with the red chili sauce, raisins, oil, enchilada sauce and beans sprouts. Add 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper and 2 tsp salt. Bake in 350 degree oven for 40 minutes. Sprinkle cajun seasoning over stew while hot. Goes great with cooked rice.

title: Sweet Sour Cherry Apples
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds sweet cherries, pitted and cut into halves or thirds | 1 1/2 cups water | 2 lemons, juiced and zest of | 1/2 tablespoon chili powder | 1/4 cup canning jars with rings, well rinsed and drained | 8 ounces cool whip
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. In a large baking pan, bring the cherries and water to a boil. Cover, and stir in the lemon juice and zest. Remove from heat and add the chili powder. Combine well. Pack cherry mixture around the rims of the jars. Place the rims on a piece of aluminum foil, and pour the canning liquid onto each of the cherry halves. Wrap each jar in foil and store in a cool place. In a saucepan filled with water, bring to a boil. Remove jars from heat and let stand for about 15 minutes. Remove the aluminum foil, and place the canning jars one at a time into cold water. Heat for 5 minutes. Remove jars from the water and place them onto a cloth covered surface. Allow to cool. Once the jars have cooled, place the can with the lids and rings in a plastic bag and snap the tops to fit. Remove the rings and jewelry and pour the liquid in the canning jars. This keeps for up to 5 days.

title: Basic Sponge Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon water
instructions: Preheat oven to mix all ingredients together in a mixing bowl with a mixer. Leave for 10 - 15 minutes covered. Place on lightly greased oven trays and bake for around 75 - 90 minutes, or until cooked through. Allow to cool and slice into 1 /2 inch slices. Serve with butter and/or cream.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,cake flour,pimiento,brown rice,spinach,brown lentil,peanut sauce
title: Easy Lentil and Spinach Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice | 3 cups chopped fresh spinach | 2 chicken legs, skin removed | 100 g chopped pimiento | 2 tablespoons dry brown lentils ( can use white ) | 3/4 cup smooth peanut sauce | 2 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line a 30cm x 20cm loaf tin with baking paper. Combine rice, spinach, chicken legs, pimiento and lentils in a large bowl. Pour over the peanut sauce and mix with a fork. Spoon mixture into the prepared tin. Place in the over and bake for 1 hour. Remove from oven, remove from tin, and cool for 15 minutes. Spread with sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve warm or cold.

title: Crock Pot Thai Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 8 cups sodium-reduced sodium beef broth | 3 tablespoons sambal oelek chili paste or 3 tablespoons sriracha sauce | 1 bunch scallion, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, combine mustard seeds with ginger and then spread over base of crock pot. Add broth to crock pot and set timer to high. Stir in chili sauce blend and simmer on high for 15 minutes. Remove cover and let cook on high for 10 minutes. Stir, then stir in scallions. Let cook a further 5 minutes on high.

title: Couscous Stuffed With Lobster and Ham
ingredients: 1 package frozen cooked lobster, thawed | 1 package grilled ham, cut into strips | 1 package frozen cooked broccoli cuts in cheese mix | 2 cups uncooked rice and wild rice blend | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place thawed lobster in a large casserole dish.

title: Watermelon Salad With Caramelized Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 1 watermelon, cubed | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 10 ounces artichoke hearts, drained and halved | 1/2 cup black sesame seed, toasted | 1 cup miniature marshmallows | 1/4 cup chopped toasted pecans | 1/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Toss watermelon with olive oil. Place artichoke hearts in a small baking dish. Pour artichoke hearts over the hearts. Scatter sesame seed over artichokes. Spoon about 1/4 cup of watermelon atop the sesame seed layer. Chill at least 1 hour.

title: Lazy Canapes
ingredients: 24 fluid ounces cream of chicken soup | 24 -30 brussels sprouts
instructions: Blend all ingredients with ice into one big tub/canning jar. Apply on your favourite snack or just eat it plain.

title: Gran's Crayfish
ingredients: 12 ounces crabmeat | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1/2 cup almond meal
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Arrange crabmeat on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake in the preheated oven until flaked apart and lightly dried, about 15 minutes.

title: Crunchy Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 can apple juice | 3 spring onions, finely chopped | 2 cups frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Place noodles in a large saucepan of boiling water. Cook for 1 minute or until tender.

title: Hot Jalapeno Peppers
ingredients: 4 small fresh jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup non-fat vanilla yogurt
instructions: Grill your peppers under the broiler until blackened all over. Place peppers in a sealed plastic bag let cool. Pour in non dairy yogurt and refrigerate until ready to serve. Note, if you like a touch of heat, make sure the peppers are at room temperature while they are cooling so they don't get dark.

Random Ingredients: citron,soy sauce,cucumber,rigatoni pasta,peanut oil vegetable,chile,macadamia nut,butternut squash
title: Macadamia Nut and Squash Pasta Salad
ingredients: 500 g butternut squash, peeled, deseeded and chopped into chunks | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon crushed dried chile | 200 g cooked rigatoni pasta | 50 g roasted peanuts oil or 50 g vegetable oil | 200 g raw cashew nuts, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 cups macadamia nuts, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup citrus fresh chile, roughly chopped | 1 small cucumber, cut into 5cm strips
instructions: Place the squash on to a medium oven tray and cook for 40 - 45 min until tender. Cool and mash well. Add the soy sauce, chilli and pasta, then mix in the peanuts and oil. Mix through the nuts and chile. Season and serve.

title: Red Curry Frappé
ingredients: 2 ounces red curry paste | 2 1/2 ounces soymilk ( or plain milk, or evaporated milk ) | 1 tablespoon brewed coffee ( or liquid from a cube ) | 1 tablespoon tomato juice ( or tomato puree )
instructions: Place the curry paste and soy milk in a small saucepan and cook over low heat until the liquid is reduced by half. Stir in the coffee and the tomato sauce until the paste has completely dissolved. Pour the sauce into a serving dish and leave at room temp until hot.

title: Hawaiian Bay Fish and Quinoa Pilaf With Sweet Peppers(Jamaican
ingredients: 1 lb cleaned and head-on smoked haddock or 1 lb white fish fillet | 7 ounces quinoa ( jasmine or whole grain ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil ( or canola oil, or just use regular oil ) | 1 small thai scotch bonnet pepper, seeded and finely chopped ( or habanero peppers )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the haddock and cook for 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain, and set aside. Rinse the quinoa in cold water until it runs clear, and transfer to a bowl to drain off and discard excess water. Remove the fish from the cold water, and cut into pieces about 1/2 x 1 1/2 inches. Remove the white and light green parts from the flake with a spatula or knife, and place on a baking sheet. Place the haddock in a small skillet, pour in the oil and chile, and pan fry over medium high heat. Pour the boiling water over the fish, and simmer for 20 minutes. Uncover, and simmer until the quinoa is tender and flakey, about 10 minutes more, stirring occasionally. Taste and check for salt and pepper, and serve warm garnished with the cooked fish pieces.

title: Struffler Beef Filet
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden raisin | 3 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, cut into 2-inch thick slices from a tri-tip steak | 4 leeks, rinsed | 3 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, tied
instructions: Soak the raisins in 3 cups boiling water for 20 minutes.

title: Sicilian Baked Aegean Style Linguine
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1/2 cup unsalted dried unsalted peanuts, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 3/4 cup cake flour | 1/4 lb linguine | 1 egg, well beaten
instructions: Heat oven to 425f degrees. Cut 1 egg into 4 rings, and cut rings into quarters. Crush eggs yolks with nuts and cinnamon, and dredge in flour. Add more flour if flour begins to soggy. Fry the noodles in a large pot of boiling salted water in 10 - 12 minutes or until tender but still firm to the bite. Drain, and set aside. Mix the pasta with some of the egg. Mound into a buttered oven proof dish, and pour over the remaining egg mixture.

title: Red Wine Soymilk Syrup
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed milk | 1/2 cup sweetened soymilk | 1 large lemonade, frozen concentrate | 2 -4 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | red wine, if required | 2 tablespoons sage leaves ( or other herbs ) or 2 tablespoons cilantro, finely chopped ( or other herb )
instructions: Combine the milk, soy milk and frozen concentrate, juice from the lemonade, crush the red pepper flakes and sprinkle over the top. Refrigerate until required. Strain through a fine sieve set over a bowl, discarding solids. Garnish with chopped herbs before serving.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,onion powder,cannellini bean,icing sugar,vegetable oil cooking spray,active yeast
title: Portuguese White Rice
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup warm dry jasmine rice | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon ground onion powder | 0.5 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 3 3/4 cups white bread or 3 3/4 cups enriched white rice, crumbs | 1 tablespoon icing sugar
instructions: In a large bowl stir together yeast, rice and oil. When it foams, add onion power and beans. Stir to combine. Add bread. Sprinkle with icing sugar. Mix together lightly to knead the bread. Divide into 8 equal loaves. Allow to rise until doubled about 45 - 50 minutes. Bake at 350 for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Ragu Alambreros
ingredients: 6 tablespoons milk, or more if needed | 1 1/2 pounds thinly sliced pork loin chops | 5 tablespoons brandy, divided | 1 spanish onion, sliced | 1 1 package dry macaroni
instructions: Mix milk, pork, and 1 tablespoon brandy together in a bowl and marinate chops in the mixture for at least 45 minutes or up to 2 hours. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain. Melt remaining 1 tablespoon brandy in a skillet.

title: Pasta With Couscous and Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/4 cup grapeseed oil ( not extra virgin ) | 1 1/2 cups drained canned chickpeas | 1 small papaya, peeled and diced into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 red jalapeno peppers or 1 serrano pepper, diced | 1 -2 cup dried cranberries | 1 can grapefruits, drained and chopped | 12 ounces farfalle pasta, cooked, drained, and mixed with a little canola oil and herbs
instructions: Put a large pot of boiling water on to boil for pasta. Heat grapeseed oil in a medium sauce pan. Add drained chickpeas, papaya, and chilies. Stir over medium heat until the papaya is cooked through. Remove from heat and add the dried cranberries, mixing well, and let the fruit soak in the sauce for a few minutes. Drain the pasta and chickpeas well and return them to the pot. Stir to coat the pasta with the spice mixture. Pour in half the couscous and stir well. Add the grapes, mix well, and add the rest of the couscous. Mix lightly and stir well. Let flavors meld for 1 minute and serve.

title: Sante Cubano (Sante Cubano) Focaccia
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cubed red potatoes | 1 cup fresh corn, cut off cobs | 3/4 cup tamari | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine | 2 tablespoons minced fresh gingerroot | 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1 teaspoon minced fresh gingerroot
instructions: Wash and dry your hands and put a little water over them to prevent them from sticking. Place the potatoes and corn in a large pot and cover with water by one inch, about ½ inch. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer over medium heat, covered for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the tamari, sherry, and ginger root. Set aside and allow to cool completely. When the potatoes are done, drain and allow to cool completely. Mix potatoes and corn with the spice mixture. Scoop about 1 tablespoon of the potato/corn mixture into a small bowl, or mold. Refrigerate the rest of the mixture until needed, for topping the dough when you fry it. Place the sante in a shallow sided casserole or on a round baking pan. Preheat the oven with the rack just below the highest heat. Place the prepared baking pan into the preheated oven. The water should start to steam when the dough is turned onto a flat surface. Turn on the broiler and immediately slide the sante cube into the water. The cube will float quickly, so carefully remove the cube before it browns too much. The sante cubes will keep well covered and should be turned once or twice in the process. The cube can be served hot or at room temperature. This recipe can also be made in advance and frozen for future use.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,spring wrapper,onion powder,peach,pumpkin pie spice
title: Spooky Funnel Cakes
ingredients: 2 packages spring roll wrappers ( or make your own ) | 1 can sliced peaches, drained ( or canned peaches drained and diced ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Place some spring roll wrappers on a clean counter and sprinkle with some pumpkin pie spice. Dunk your finger into the water and grab the top and be careful of the water clinging to the wrap with your fingers. Once they stick you will need to do 3 or 4 at a time until all 4 wrappers have been used. Once all are used, place in a 9x13 pan and cover with plastic wrap. Place in fridge for up to two hours to set. When your serving, take a knife and carefully take off the wrap from your bowl onto plastic wrap. Place back into bowl that has been inverted. Wipe out pan and put 1/4 of your peanut sauce or sauce sauce on top of bottom of your bowl. Add a few dashes of rice wine vinegar to the peanut sauce or sauce mixture and continue to stir. Remove mixture from bowl and place onto bowl. Repeat until all your peanut sauce is used. Place in fridge until ready to use. I usually just take a bit of the mixture and fill in the corner with a small scoop of filling.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,chinese five spice powder,marshmallow,golden raisin,sugar snap pea,lemongrass,spinach leaf
title: Leyley's Thai Nestle Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 bag fresh spinach leaves | 3/4 cup sugar snap pea | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon chopped lemongrass | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 15 ounces fresh sweet baby carrots, cut in 1 inch chunks | 2 cups miniature marshmallows
instructions: In a salad bowl, combine the spinach, snap peas, cannellini beans and lemongrass. Stir in five spice powder. Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour. Stir in sweet baby carrots. Chill for 1 hours before serving.

title: Black Forest Soup With Pastry
ingredients: pastry, ready to use ( i like basic pie crust for this ) | fresh vegetables, such as dandelions or onions, sliced as desired | sherry wine, to taste | black tea
instructions: Prepare pie crust. In a bowl, mix ingredients. You can put mixture in the top of a double boiler or a crock pot for the first five minutes of cooking. Serve immediately.

title: Chilli Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 5 maraschino cherries
instructions: Mix tomato paste and curry powder until mixed. Add cherries. Slowly add enough water to the tomato gravy and simmer until sauce thickens.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,pomegranate seed,vegetable stock,broth,shrimp,savory,coriander powder,cherry tomato
title: Pomegranate Shrimp
ingredients: 16 shrimp | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 onion soup mix, packet ( mccormick ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon savory | 12 cherry tomatoes | 1/4 cup pomegranate seeds | 1/4 cup broth
instructions: Add pomegranate seeds and broth to a food processor and blend till smooth. Sauce, heat vegetable stock. Stir in soup mix, coriander, savory and shrimp. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,nutmeg,thyme sprig,cream mushroom soup,jumbo shrimp,saffron,ice cream,red enchilada sauce
title: Grilled Norwegian Salmon With Sour Cream Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs thick skinless salmon fillets | 3 medium jumbo shrimp | 8 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 8 ounces red enchilada sauce | 8 ounces saffron | 2/3 cup ice cream | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs | 1 pinch nutmeg
instructions: Preheat grill. If using the frozen seafood, remove heads and tails from shells. Cook on the grill about 10 to 15 minutes or until golden to desired doneness. Remove from grill and let cool slightly. Rinse and peel shrimp. Clean and devein shrimp. Cut into bite sized chunks. Remove prawns from shells. Place shrimp and seafood into a large mixing bowl. Add cream of mushroom soup, enchilada sauce, saffron, salt and freshly ground black pepper. Mix well. Place bowl in refrigerator, cover and chill for at least 30 minutes. Remove the bowl from the refrigerator to retain cool liquid, but leave a thin layer of liquid in the bowl on top of the bowl. In a shallow, non reactive serving dish, place the ice cream, thyme and nutmeg on a dinner plate. Place the bowl containing the sour cream on top of the ice cream and nutmeg. Place salmon on top of the sour cream. Dredge the fish gently in the mixture of the sour cream and seafood. Grill for 8 to 10 minutes on each side, or until cooked through. Serve immediately with jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: oregano,pickle relish,serrano pepper,tea,pico de gallo,cardamom,swiss cheese,salad oil
title: Cuban Party Salad
ingredients: 9 ounces thinly sliced smoked swiss cheese | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1/4 cup pico de gallo | 2 tablespoons lemon pickle relish | 1 teaspoon oregano | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1 serrano pepper, minced
instructions: Cut slabs of swiss cheese crosswise into 1/8-inch slices. On an ungreased cookie sheet, spread 1/4 cup salad oil, 1/4 cup pico de gallo, 2 tablespoons pickle relish, 1 teaspoon oregano, 2 teaspoons ground cardamom, and 1 minced jalapeno pepper.

title: Swedish Meat and Apples
ingredients: 750 375 g steak or 375 g chicken thighs | 1 granny smith apple ( or other firm-tasting apple suitable for grilling ) | 150 g fresh mushrooms | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 1/2 grated gravlava sausage ( a polish sausage or hot pepper-caper paste ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped blanched almond
instructions: Trim fat from beef, if necessary, and cut into serving portions. Finely chop one apple. Mince mushroom. Finely chop dill. Toss meat, apple, mushroom, breadcrumbs, dill, and sausage together in a large bowl. Slightly beat in almonds. Pour into large plastic canning jars, and hold for 1 - 2 days in refrigerator. The more air the can is packed, the more flavorful the meat will be. To serve, let meat sit in liquid for a few minutes before opening the jar. Seal the jar if not used.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,chunky salsa,plum jam,pasta sauce,hot italian sausage,panko breadcrumb
title: Sausage N Pita Pasta Salad
ingredients: 3 english cucumbers, sliced | 2 cups hot italian sausage | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup plum jam, spread with the back of a spoon | 3/4 cup prepared pasta sauce | 1/3 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Cut sausage in half cross wise. Cut cheese in 1/2 inch/2 inch/round pieces. Place slices of sausage and cheese on waxed paper. Spread plum spread on cheese. Spread panko on top of sausage, covering cheese. Roll up and pinch edges to seal or shape pita bread around cheese if needed. Put in refrigerator and chill till needed. Bring to room temperature. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes. Add pasta sauce and salsa. Allow to cool, stirring occasionally. Use as a salad dressing for all or part of your favorite pasta or rice. Or make sandwiches to serve it cold and let guests add salads.

title: Crocodile With Mango and Cod
ingredients: 1 pound asian-style chili paste | 12 ounces cod fish fillets, cut into chunks | 1 mango - peeled, seeded and diced | 1/4 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Combine the chili paste with fish chunks in a bowl. Let stand for 10 minutes at room temperature. Drain and combine with the mango. Mix coconut into the mixture. Serve with plain white rice.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,egg white,egg substitute,bread,american cheese,chicken breast half,syrup
title: Chicken and Cheese Pan Fried Egg Nips
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves, thinly sliced with skin | 8 tablespoons crispy bread | 2 teaspoons horseradish | 1/4 cup egg substitute ( use a little or a little bit of milk ) | 6 tablespoons thousand island dressing ( i used `` newman's own '' ) | 1/4 cup egg whites | 2 tablespoons country cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the pan over medium heat. Stir fry chicken in 2 tablespoons of horseradish for 2 minutes. Stir in bread. Spoon chicken onto a cookie sheet. Pile 2 tablespoons of the cheese on top of chicken, followed by 1 tablespoon of the remaining horseradish. Spoon a little egg over the cheese, followed by 1/4 cup of dressing. Cover with another cookie sheet, and then use a fork to poke holes in the chicken. Broil or broil until crispy and browned. Meanwhile, prepare the rest of the sandwiches, either on the bbq or the pan fried bread. Spoon a little egg and cheese over the top of each sandwich, then top with the remaining horseradish. Serve while still warm.

title: Crispy Broccoli With Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 1 pound fresh broccoli florets | 1 yellow sweet pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons lard
instructions: Place the broccoli in a steamer set over boiling water. Place a bamboo steamer basket over the steamer and cover the basket. Steam the broccoli for 1 hour, or until bright green and tender. Remove the steamer basket, and remove the broccoli to a serving bowl. Keep the steamer set over the simmering water. Sprinkle the sweet pepper slices with hot lard, and serve hot.

title: Bastee's Chocolate Dipping Oil
ingredients: 20 -24 ounces olive oil ( preferably unfiltered ) | 5 ounces unsweetened chocolate ( bittersweet or fine-quality ) | 1 1/2 lbs unsalted olives, pitted ( preferably sicilian olives ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig ( about 1-1/2 tbsp. ) | 1 loaf italian bread, sliced ( such as ciabatta or round )
instructions: For the oil, heat the oil in the bottom of a double boiler until warm to touch but not smoking and place over a very low heat. Melt the chocolate in a large heavy bottomed heavy skillet over low heat, stirring and scraping the bottom to prevent it from getting too hot. While the chocolate melts, place the olives in a sieve with 1/2 tsp of the thyme and stir to combine, let the excess liquid run off, then set the drained olives aside. Using a sharp paring knife, pierce the bread in thick slices and drop them onto the chocolate. Stir and turn until the slices are well coated and begin to stick to the chocolate. Pour the warmed oil over the bread, making sure that all of the bread is soaked by the oil. Let the chocolate cool slightly, then spoon it in at once, packing it lightly against the rim. Scoop up the olives with a spoon or hand with a small dollop of mint or 1 tsp of grated parmigiano. Scoop up the mint or parmigiano and serve at once, while shaking the pan so that the chocolate dries over the bread slices before eating. Note, for a more robust sauce, sprinkle with additional thyme.

Random Ingredients: salmon,phyllo pastry,chicken liver,garlic sauce,dijon mustard,ice water,green cardamom pod,mussel
title: Crispy Glazed Norwegian Salmon With Mussels
ingredients: 1/2 cup ice water | 2 -3 green cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon garlic sauce | 1/2 cup fish sauce ( nahm bpli ) | 8 ounces frozen thawed mussels, thawed | 1/2 lb fresh salmon, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 lb fresh thawed frozen fish fillets | 12 ounces frozen phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Combine first 7 ingredients and set aside. Toast nutmeg in a small dry frypan over medium heat until fragrant, about 10 minutes. Set aside when cool. Set aside. Place mussels in a saucepan with 1/2 cup boiling water.

title: Tunisian Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 20 ounces red wine vinegar ( zwt-8 preferred ) | 1/4 cup red cumin powder
instructions: Combine the red wine vinegar, red cumin, and cayenne pepper in a large dutch oven over medium heat.

title: Lazy Roast in a 309 degree F. Oven
ingredients: 12 -15 lbs lean beef | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 dozen round frozen tart apple | 6 large pimento stuffed green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place all roast ingredients in a baking crock and place in the oven. Cook for 11 - 13 hours. Use a meat thermometer to check for tenderness. This should be between 195f to 170f before internal temperture is reached. Take the roast out of the oven and remove the chilies. Slice into slices, remove skin and most of the seeds. Serve at once, or put in a freezer bag to cool, place in fridge for 30 minutes to freeze. To make in the morning, place in plastic bags, label and freeze. When you want to roast, remove the fat from the roast and heat oven to 300°f. Place the roast in a casserole dish and pour over the roasting juices and juices. I use a crockpot for this, but you can also leave the fat in the roast. Cook, uncovered, in a 325°f oven for 3 hours. Do not stir before serving. This should be served hot and then warmed hot.

title: Pasta Al Fungi
ingredients: 2 -3 large peaches, peeled, pitted and sliced ( depending on size ) | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 teaspoon dried lavender flowers | 3 packages your favorite penne rigate ( we use dreamfields, so have them in the freezer for about 30 minutes before serving! ) | 7 -8 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Prepare your pasta noodles by cooking in the following method, place the peaches in a skillet with 1 cup water, 1 tbls. Gn, lavender and cook for about 5 - 10 minutes, stirring often. Rinse with cold water and drain. Placing lid in the skillet with the liquids, cook on medium low for 5 - 10 minutes until reduced to approximately 1 cup. Stir in the cooked pasta and simmer for another 5 minutes, and set aside to cool. When ready to serve, place some lettuce leaves on top to create a bed that will cover all your dinner. Place some cooked pasta on top of those leaves, then pour the cooled liquid over the top of that, then add some yogurt on top of everything.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,celery seed,coriander powder,green bell pepper,spaghetti sauce,allspice
title: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon ground celery seed | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced red bell peppers | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced green bell peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine spaghetti sauce, celery seed, coriander powder, red bell peppers, green bell peppers and allspice. Stir until thoroughly combined. Bring to a boil over medium high heat and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer uncovered until bell peppers are tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Korean Rice Noodle Soup With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup dried white bean | 1 small turnip, diced | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup rice noodles, soaked ( cellophane noodles )
instructions: Soak beans overnight in 8 cups of cold water. After soaking, drain. Add turnip. Cover with cold water. Bring to a boil. Add rice noodles. Place on the last 3 ingredients.

Random Ingredients: creme de menthe,orange,active yeast,spring wrapper,wide rice noodle
title: Indian Orange Baked Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces dried wide rice noodles | 8 ounces creme de menthe ( or other liqueur, i used orange juice ) | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 pinch salt | 1 orange, zested | 2 spring roll wrappers
instructions: To prepare the noodles and preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a rack in the lowest oven position, and preheat to 200 degrees f and butter a baking sheet. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Drain the noodles, return to the water, and cover. Let stand for 15 minutes. Rinse them under cold water, and then drain on towels. Bring 5 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot. Add the noodles and cook for about 5 minutes, adding a pinch of salt per noodle.

title: Easy Pickled Shallots
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: Toast coriander seeds in dry frypan until they turn to powder in color. Do not burn. This will take about 2 minutes. Cool. Grind coriander seeds and brown sugar together to a fine powder. Pack in clean sterlised jars and seal. Store in a cool dark place. This pick keeps for 30 days. Shake jar and store in a cool dark place.

Random Ingredients: celery leaf,chive,heavy cream,green bell pepper,beef chuck,tarragon
title: Creamy Tarragon Beef Pinwheels
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream, at room temperature | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, minced | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, minced | 2 1/2 teaspoons celery leaves, minced | 1 lb boneless beef chuck or 1 lb sirloin, cut into thin slices | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Combine cream, tarragon, chives and celery in medium bowl. Add beef and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate 12 hours or overnight. Remove beef from cream mixture. Cover and let stand at room temperature 25 minutes. Arrange beef on platter. Sprinkle beef with pepper. Add a little more cream mixture, if desired. Serve.

title: Golden Onions
ingredients: 2 bunches spring onions, trimmed | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 packet taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 240c. Place onions in a large ovenproof dish, pour over the golden syrup and sprinkle with taco seasoning mix, or use a basting spray to coat each layer with. Bake for about an hour for softer onions and about 30 for firm ones.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,green olive,almond extract,panko breadcrumb,spanish onion,phyllo pastry,green bean,red pepper
title: Green Olive, Jalapeno & Green Beans Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 3 tablespoons green olives ( canned or dry pitted ) | 1/3 cup finely minced spanish sweet onion | 1/4 cup jalapeno, minced ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons toasted almonds ( or whole, about 6 whole almonds, finely chopped ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs ( or dry breadcrumbs ) | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper ( or to taste ) | 1 sheet phyllo pastry, thawed if frozen | 1/4 lb green beans, washed ( or yellow or white )
instructions: Combine the olives, onions, jalapenos, almonds, panko, almond extract, and red pepper or toasted almonds. Stir in the green beans, gently mix until coated. Lay one sheet of phyllo pastry on a lightly floured surface. Spread half of the green beans on it, then top with half the olives mixture, then top with remaining green beans. Fold pastry over beans and sprinkle with remaining panko, pressing to adhere. Wrap phyllo, seam side down, in a dampened paper towel, and set aside until the phyllo is full. Brush top of phyllo in a little olive oil and lightly mist with olive oil. Place frozen phyllo sheets on top of the layered green beans, cover loosely with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 6 hours and up to 1 day. Cut phyllo into 4 equal squares. Working with one portion at a time, flash freeze the phyllo triangles on a lightly oiled, lightly floured baking sheet until frozen, about 30 minutes. Transfer to a baking trays lined with parchment paper, brush with a little olive oil, and bake at 400 degrees for 10, 15 or 20 minutes or until golden. Remove and transfer to a rack to cool for 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Giant Balsamic Beef Toss
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup palm sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 lb small shell pasta, cooked and drained | 2 small radishes, sliced
instructions: Arrange beef in a nonreactive dutch oven. Sprinkle beef with sugar and sprinkle with parsley. Pour 2/3 of marinara sauce over the beef. Cover and cook on medium heat 45 minutes. Remove from heat. Spoon remaining sauce over beef, sprinkle with radishes, and stir. Serve over cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,spanish onion,white flour,hot water,sage,parsley sprig,grand marnier,carrot
title: Maggie Beer's Sesame Seed Pasta Sauce(Sesame Pasta)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sesame seeds, lightly toasted | 1/2 cup spanish onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley sprig | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 cup raw carrot, grated | 1/2 cup sweet white flour ( or half whole wheat for a sweeter flavour ) | 1 tablespoon grand marnier ( or other extract or orange juice ) | 10 -12 fresh sage, thinly sliced ( garnish ) | 2 1 cup hot water
instructions: Place the toasted sesame seeds, onions, parsley, grated carrot, and sesame seeds in a food processor or blender. Process to paste, about 30 seconds until well blended. Using a whisk, gradually add the flour. Stir to blend while slowly adding the hot water. Store in a cool dry place or in the fridge for 5 days or more. Just before serving, add the grand marnier and sage. Taste before adding the sugar in as stated, adding a little sugar or a little water. Serve with cooked toasted pasta. Note, to toast the sesame seeds, bake them in a hot frying pan until lightly golden and brown. Seeding may also be used to fry the sesame paste.

Random Ingredients: butter shortening,squash,roast pork,basil pesto,vanilla bean,pinto bean,coconut cream
title: Butterflied Mexican Pork With Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs roast pork, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons oil | 3/4 cup pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil pesto ( see note ) | 3 tablespoons coconut cream ( see note ) | 1 vanilla bean | 1/2 cup butter shortening ( or oil )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine pork, butter or oil, beans, pesto and tomato paste. Place pork in casserole dish and bake 1 hour. Turn pork dish and bake an additional 45 minutes and until meat is nicely browned and tender. Remove meat from pan and set aside. Strain pan juices. Melt shortening or oil in same pan. Add vanilla bean, simmer for 3 minutes. Pour into pan mixture. Stir to mix, cook for 5 minutes till slightly thickened and slightly reduced. Pour meat over warm potatoes and serve.

Random Ingredients: parsley,russet potato,self rising flour,coconut milk,puff pastry,currant,walnut
title: Gran's Scottish Potato and Walnut Pies
ingredients: 1 lb unpeeled russet potato, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup currants | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts, toasted | 3 sheets shredded sweet potato | 1/3 cup grated coconut milk | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed and wrapped in foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium saucepan, cover the potatoes with water and bring to a boil. Cook uncovered until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork, about 15 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a medium bowl, mix the flour and currants until well blended. Stir in the diced potatoes, walnuts, chopped sweet potato, coconut milk and parsley. Let stand until cooled. On a lightly floured work surface, roll out each pastry sheet to 12x15 in rectangle.

title: Visions of Procciutto W-White Beans
ingredients: 200 g single cream | 150 g white beans, drained & washed | 2 teaspoons dry self-rising flour | 3 slices prosciutto | 1 zucchini, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c / 325°f / gas lightly grease a baking tray. Line the tray with baking paper. Combine the cream, beans & flour in a bowl, stir until thick & creamy. Spread half the beans in the prepared tray & place slices of proscuitto on top. Repeat to make 3 more veggie stacks. Bake the veges for about 15 minutes, top with remaining proscuitto, bake & additional 5 - 10 minutes, or until golden & crisp & bubbling.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,snow pea,cottage cheese,ricotta cheese,colby monterey jack cheese,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cheese and Vegetable Stoup for One
ingredients: 750 ml chicken stock cubes | 1 cup fresh snow peas or 1 cup frozen snow pea | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 cup colby-monterey jack cheese or 1 cup mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius or 170 degrees c if fan forced. Heat vegetable stock in a pan over medium heat, add peas. Cook 5 minutes, remove from heat and set aside. Stir ricotta and cottage cheese through soup, season to taste with plenty of black pepper and grated cheese and transfer to an ovenproof casserole dish. Top with half the grated cheese. Cover with rest of cheese, top with remaining cheese and put in oven and bake for 15 - 30 minutes, until golden and bubbling.

title: Sweet and Sour Glazed Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup watermelon, drained, seeded and diced | 1 pear, peeled, cored and diced | 1 cauliflower floret, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 1/4 pounds whole salmon, cut into large chunks
instructions: Place the watermelon, pear, cauliflower, cayenne pepper and salmon chunks into a large resealable food storage plastic bag. Seal, and turn the bag, pressing out as much air as possible. Refrigerate for 4 to 6 hours. Bring to room temperature before stuffing, and serve on a bed of steamed or steamed rice.

title: Asparagus Casserole With Tomato Crumble
ingredients: 6 asparagus spears, peeled and sliced in to 3 rounds ( i use frozen asparagus spears ) | 12 ounces low-fat cheddar cheese, shredded | 32 fluid ounces low-fat half-and-half | 1 large tomatoes, sliced | 1 tablespoon custard powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Butter a 9x9 baking pan. Layer asparagus, cheese, and tomatoes in the baking pan, starting with the stem end, then covering with the rest of the cheese. Add the custard powder over the top, then dot with water. Bake for 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Wild Rice Linguini
ingredients: 3 packages linguine | 1 can french-fried onions | 2 cups guacamole | 1/4 cup golden rum | 1/4 cup chopped fresh wild rice | 1/4 cup fresh snow peas
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions, drain and toss with onions and guacamole. Stir in rum and heat through. Add cooked linguine and snow peas, if desired. Serve and enjoy.

title: Fennel and Orzo
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vinegar | 4 cups orzo pasta, prepared and drained | 5 cups fresh chinese mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon fennel, chopped | 1/4 cup chives, minced
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions. Drain, rinse with cold water, then drain well. Combine vinegar, mushrooms, fennel and chives with cooked orzo. Stir gently. Refrigerate 2 hours. Serve cold or let cool completely.

title: Vodka and Capers Stew
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon vodka | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 2 kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon orange zest ( optional ) | 2 cans mixed vegetables ( or 1 big handful of fresh mixed veggies, chopped ) | crushed elbows or uncooked macaroni, to serve | vegetables, and herbs, for garnish
instructions: In a dutch oven, add vodka and sherry, stirring over medium heat till it begins to bubble. Add the lime leaves, if using. Add the kaffir lime leaves, if using, and zest, if using. Add the mixed veggies. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Add half the pasta and the other half of the pasta. Cook till pasta is just tender. If it doesn't take very long, add the rest of the pasta. Taste and add salt, more lime if needed. Top with fresh parmesan.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,red curry paste,sauce,chili flake,kalamata olive,parmesan cheese,almond extract,lemon juice zest
title: A Taste of West Indies Quinoa - Vegan
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 3/4 - 1 cup light sauce ( to taste ) or 3/4-1 cup chili paste ( to taste ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( to taste ) | 1 cup kalamata olive, sliced | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1/2 - 1 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Sauté the red curry paste with lemon zest in a non stick sauce pan. Add the chili paste. Add the quinoa and any water released by the quinoa. Mix until all the ingredients are mixed throughout. Strain the quinoa while it's still hot and pour it into a nice sized glass or glass bowl. Let cool slightly, then add in the other ingredients, stirring until just warm. Pour the mixture into the chilled glass bowl. Sprinkle the top with the grated parmesan, and refrigerate overnight enjoy.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,fennel seed,beef mince,rice vinegar,cream
title: Chipped Beef Mince Rolls (Tasty Beef Rolls)
ingredients: 750 g beef mince | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs ( rosemary, sage, thyme, sage leaves, mixed dried herbs ) | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: In a shallow dish combine mince, vinegar, mixed dried herbs and fennel seed with hands until combined. Using a sharp knife, roll meat mixture into 18 long rolls. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 200°c. Place rolls on a foil lined tray and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until well browned. Serve with a nice green salad.

Random Ingredients: hot dog,superfine sugar,pinot grigio wine,red onion,cinnamon,cayenne powder,pumpkin seed
title: Hot Dogs
ingredients: 20 large hot dogs | 1 cup fresh pumpkin seeds | 1 medium red onion | 1/2 cup pinot grigio wine | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon cayenne powder
instructions: In a small bowl, toss the hot dogs with the pumpkin seeds and a handful of pumpkin seeds. Place about 1/2 cup of the hot dogs in each of two shallow ovenproof skillets, allowing room for spreading. Arrange the hot dogs in a single layer in two alternating rows about 1 inch thick. Cover the tops of the hot dogs with wax towels and place in the cold oven. Toast the onions, stirring frequently, until light gold, about 6 minutes. Add the pinot grigio, sugar, cinnamon, cayenne powder, sugar and 3/4 cup water to a saucepan over medium high heat and bring to a boil, stirring, until the sugar dissolves. Transfer the hot dogs to a baking dish and cool until warm, about 1 hour. Heat the oven to 425 f and remove the parchment paper and hot dogs from the baking dish. Arrange the hot dogs on a serving platter and top with the onions. Serve warm. Makes 8 servings.

title: English Cheese Fonduta
ingredients: 1 lb coarsely ground white american cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 drop lemon extract
instructions: Add all ingredients into a medium mixing bowl. Refrigerate for several hours until desired consistancy is achieved. Remove from refrigerator about 30 minutes before serving. Enjoy.

title: Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs carrots, finely diced | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 6 ounces canned apricot preserves | chopped almonds ( to garnish)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. In a small saucepan over medium heat bring the apricot preserves to a boil and boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat and pour over the carrots. Combine the cornstarch with a little water and stir into the carrots. Pour into an ovenproof dish and sprinkle with almonds. Bake 45 - 50 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Pine Nut Crackers
ingredients: 1 lb pine nuts | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Put pine nuts in a bowl, and grind to a fine powder. Mix in fennel seeds and worcestershire sauce. Put in a clean dry jar with a tight fitting lid, and store in the sun in a cool dark place for up to a month.

title: Simple Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | 2 cups rice noodles, cooked and drained | 1 can chopped green chilies, undrained | 2/3 cup pesto sauce, any flavour
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the bacon, noodles, chilies, pesto and warm rice. Toss with cooked, drained and crumbled bacon.

title: Tostones (Grammy's Mexican Ome)
ingredients: 2 eggs | 1/2 - 2/3 cup chopped fresh chilies ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Whisk eggs in a bowl. Stir in chopped chilies and cajun seasoning. Using a heaping tablespoon, drop batter by heaping tablespoons onto a cookie sheet or baking dish. Bake in preheated 400 degrees fahrenheit oven for 12 minutes or till they are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,cointreau liqueur,mango chutney,beef sirloin steak,pepper flake,curly leaf parsley,key lime,glutinous rice
title: Mango Burgundy
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, cut 1-inch thick | 12 key limes, cut in half | 1/4 cup cointreau liqueur | 1 tablespoon hot pepper flakes | 3/4 cup chopped fresh curly-leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 2 cups mango chutney | 4 cups hot cooked glutinous rice
instructions: Place steak between 2 sheets of wax paper on a work surface. Using your hands, press and stretch the steak until it looks approximately 1/8 inch thick. Starting at the wide end near the end, carefully roll the steak until it is completely enclosed. Using your hands, press lime halves into the steaks. Arrange steaks in a single layer in a baking dish and refrigerate. Combine key liqueur, salt, pepper and hot pepper flakes in a bowl. Stir in the parsley and sugar. Pour 1/4 of the chutney over the top of the steaks, making sure the meat is completely covered. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes. Add remaining chutney and rice. Serve steaks hot.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,mint leaf,emmenthaler cheese,eggplant,dark soy sauce
title: Pierogi (Eggplant Bread)
ingredients: 500 g eggplants | 200 g emmenthaler cheese ( or similar ) | 5 mint leaves, chopped | 2 cups plain flour | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Peel the eggplant and slice thinly. Slice the cheese into long strips about 1cm thick. Mix the flour and soy sauce together and coat the eggplant slices with the flour mixture. Heat a deep, non stick frying pan. Fry the bread in batches and drain on kitchen paper. Serve with the dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: coconut,tomato green chilies,carrot,sugar snap pea,vanilla sugar
title: Sweet Pea Coconut
ingredients: 5 large tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped | 12 ounces sugar snap peas, trimmed | 1 medium carrot, peeled and sliced | 1/2 cup unsweetened shredded coconut | 1 1/2 nam pla. instant vanilla sugar
instructions: Sprinkle carrots with sugar snaps and coconut on bottom of baking dish. Toss tomato through coconut. Add to baking dish. Drizzle with vanilla sugar. Bake in 350f degrees oven until just heated through, about 40 minutes.

title: Golden Nugget Whiskey Squash - Tyler Florence
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yellow squash ( peeled and sliced lengthwise ) | 1 cup whiskey | 1/2 cup grand marnier ( or other orange-flavored liqueur )
instructions: In a medium size, glass bowl, layer squash, whiskey, and grand marnier, sprinkling liquor, ending with a sprinkling of grand marnier. Cover and refrigerate for 3 days before serving.

title: Mock Tahini
ingredients: 2/3 cup shelled pistachios | 1/3 cup unsalted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Spread pistachios onto baking sheet and toast in oven until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,lemon,sage leaf,dark sesame oil,self raising flour,orange juice
title: Shiitake and Sesame Damper
ingredients: 7 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 5 ounces self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh lemon rind, finely grated | 1 teaspoon orange juice | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the mushrooms in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Let stand 5 minutes at this stage, then drain. Place the flour, sage, lemon rind, orange juice and sesame oil in a food processor or with a metal blade and process until you have a fine dough. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface, knead lightly and divide into 3 pieces. Roll out to about 6 - 8 inches in diameter. Spray a large baking tray with non stick cooking spray, then place half the dough in the tray and spread over the base. Cover with another 1 1/2 inches of greaseproof paper and roll out the remaining dough. Make three slashes into each slab using a sharp knife. Use the tip of the knife to mark the cuts. Cook in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the damper is golden and risen. Remove from the oven and keep warm in a 200f oven. Serve warm.

title: Tandoori Breakfast
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 pinch saffron | 3/4 cup canned frozen limeade concentrate | 1/2 cup curry powder | 5 teaspoons harissa
instructions: Place egg whites in a dry non stick frying pan on medium heat. Crack in an egg, and cook until white is solid but not browned. Sprinkle on saffron and immediately remove from heat. Combine limeade concentrate and curry powder. Sprinkle mixture over egg white, and place in refrigerator. When ready to eat, remove from stove and allow to sit for about 15 - 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,rye bread,head cauliflower,beef eye,lime leaf,salmon
title: Smokey Salmon and Cauliflower on Rye
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 lb salmon, cut in chunks | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar, divided | 1/2 lb smoked beef eye round, coarsely chopped | 2 slices rye bread, thick or 2 slices pumpernickel bread, torn into small pieces | 6 lime leaves
instructions: Cut off stem ends of cauliflower and discard. Break apart into florets. Place salmon over coals of large gas grill. Cover and grill until easily flaked with fork, about 5 - 7 minutes on each side. Remove from grill. While salmon is grilling in food processor, place vinegar in small, nonsticky bowl and mix well. Add tuna chunks and 1/2 cup vinegar and stir to combine. When salmon is done, remove from grill. With slotted spoon, carefully remove all but a small amount of pan juices. Discard remaining juice. Set pan into large bowl and place salmon in pan juices, coating evenly. Cover. Let salmon cool to room temperature. After salmon is cool, add to cauliflower. Reserve remaining juice and slice rye into 1/8 rounds. Place on plate and mound salmon mixture into middle. Surround with rye rounds. Garnish with lime leaves. Enjoy.

title: Fabulous Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons melted margarine or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seed ( or cayenne pepper )
instructions: Heat a cast iron griddle or skillet over medium heat. Turning a few times. When it is very hot, add the oil, cumin and cayenne pepper to the pan. Let the oil smoke for a couple minutes until it turns a reddish brown. Add the margarine, stirring to melt and coat the margarine. Spread the margarine and oil onto one side of the griddle or pan. Quickly, flip the griddle or skillet over and quickly turn the griddle's edges to the other side. Slide the griddle back into the pan and cook the other side. Repeat until all the mixture is used or as needed. You may need to cook the griddle on the stove to ensure that the outside gets crispy. When griddle has finished cooking, cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream for an especially tasty quesadilla.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,yellow pepper,bean sprout,salmon fillet,gruyere cheese,tamari,shiitake mushroom,balsamic vinegar
title: Aussie-Style Steamed Salmon With Mushrooms and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 350 g salmon fillets, cut into 4 slices | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1/4 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 25 g sliced shiitake mushrooms ( about 3 oz total weight ) | 1 yellow sweet pepper, cut into strips | 1 pate grated gruyere cheese | 25 g bean sprouts ( about 2 cups )
instructions: For the fish, in a shallow dish, combine the fish, tamari, honey, vinegar and sambal oliv until well coated. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours. For the salad, in a medium wok, bring 2 cups water to boil. Add the mushrooms and bell pepper. Cover and cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender crisp but firm. Drain well. Arrange the salmon on a platter. Add the mushrooms and goat cheese. Spoon the salad over the salmon. Drizzle the salad with the balsamic glaze. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bean sprouts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,tomato paste,tomato sauce,cornmeal,bell pepper,green bell pepper,garlic salt
title: Tex Mex Momma's Polenta Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 3/4 cup cornmeal | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 can tomato paste | 1 green bell pepper, diced | 1 bell pepper, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together 1 1/2 cups cornmeal, 1 teaspoon garlic salt, tomato sauce and red pepper flakes. Stir in the bell peppers. Transfer mixture into a 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle top with remaining 1/2 cup cornmeal. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 to 50 minutes, or until golden and bubbly.

title: Strawberry Seed Focaccia Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup light bread flour | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | soft bread flour
instructions: Use a mixer fitted with a dough blade to mix together the flour and celery seed in a small bowl. Add the bread flour and mix thoroughly. Shape dough into a ball and refrigerate for at least 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Grease baking sheet. When dough has chilled, knead lightly on a lightly floured board. Shape into a round loaf and poke with a sharp knife 3 or 4 times down the length of. Place loaf on the prepared baking sheet and let loaf rise, covered, about 30 minutes. Using a fork, poke a 1/2 inch deep cross in the top of loaf. Using a teaspoon, spread about 1 teaspoon of soft bread flour over 1 loaf and sprinkle top with 2 tablespoons of flaked semolina or jerry bits. Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned, 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,nonfat milk,red chili pepper,dark brown sugar,nutritional yeast,extra virgin olive oil,lime wedge
title: Apricot and Lime Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 4 medium red chili peppers, halved | 2 tablespoons dried apricot jam | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 medium lime wedge
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat the milk, sugar and yeast over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves. Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Stir in the chilies. Remove from the heat, stir in the jam and warm for a few minutes, stirring to combine well. With a slotted spoon, transfer the sauce to a serving bowl. Drizzle over the melted jam and garnish with the lime wedge.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,extra tofu,almond extract,fenugreek seed,peach,flat bread
title: Udipi
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried sweetened coconut, shredded ( about 2/3 cup ) | 1 tablespoon whole almond extract | 1 large peaches or 1 large nectarines egg | 2 tablespoons unsalted dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped ( see note ) | 1 cup extra firm tofu, drained and cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 6 ounces ) | 1 teaspoon split fenugreek seeds
instructions: Note, you can get away with using the 2/3 cup sweetened coconut if you prefer it sweeter. Preheat the broiler. Coat a cookie sheet with nonstick spray and set aside 5 teaspoons of the adobo sauce, then place the remaining curry powder on a small plate. Place the coconut, almond extract, chopped peaches, chopped peanuts, and remaining adobo sauce in a bowl and toss to combine. Divide the curry mixture among 4 - 4 ounce ramekins, pressing in a few peanut halves to form a round even layer. Broil until fragrant, about 4 minutes, stirring twice. Sprinkle the tofu with the fenugreek seeds. Place the curry on the top of the peanuts and serve immediately. Note, for an extra kick and depth, garnish a tablespoon of additional adobo sauce on the dip by dipping it into a small bowl of very hot tap water until it is softened and pliable. Note, the curry powder can be prepared ahead, refrigerated, and frozen at this point in quantities that are up to 1 day ahead and kept at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

title: Tunisian Ragout
ingredients: 500 g plain flour | 100 g dried german mutton ( ground in a pestle and mortar ) | 100 g baby raspberries ( or a good raspberry jam ) | 100 g shredded carrots | 25 g feta cheese ( soft, cubed ) | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon chipotle powder | 100 g raspberry jam
instructions: Mix the dough ingredients together, knead them until they have a smooth dough. Roll out the dough, cut into 12 squares, spread 1 tsp. Of jam on each square. Add 1 tablespoons of the meat mixture. Sprinkle with more fenugreek seeds and salt. Fold over the top and seal. Bake in a hot oven for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve hot. Enjoy.

title: Beef and Cabbage With Thyme Leaves
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 large head green cabbage, cored and coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook beef in large skillet until lightly browned. Drain most of the fat and discard. Add cabbage and reserved fat. Cook, covered, 10 - 15 minutes. Serve, warm or at room temperature with a salad.

Random Ingredients: bean,ice cream,lettuce leaf,sherry wine,currant,wine,red currant jelly
title: Bean, Wine and Refresher
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sherry wine vinegar or 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 750 g baked beans, drained | 125 ml sherry wine or 125 ml dry sherry | 1/2 cup currant jelly | 1/2 cup fresh rice milk or 1/2 cup ice cream | lettuce leaf
instructions: For the refresher, combine the vinegar, beans and sherry in a bowl. Combine the jelly and rice mil until smooth then mix into the beans mixture. Spoon beans into serving dishes and top with remaining jelly and lettuce leaves. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,tomato sauce,alfredo sauce,meat,lime wedge,pumpernickel bread,curry leaf
title: Yummy Mini Meatballs With Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 4 pumpernickel bread, rounds ( or other crusty bread ) | 3 tablespoons cottage cheese | 3 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1/3 lb ground lean meat | 1/4 teaspoon curry leaf ( or use fresh chopped ) | 1/4 cup alfredo sauce ( warmed ) | pumpernickel bread rounds or other crusty bread, triangles, for dipping
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, grease with butter and set aside. Using a fork or fingers, gently mash the bread rounds with a fork. Mix cottage cheese, tomato sauce and bay leaf in a small bowl. Combine the meat, curry leaf and cottage cheese mixture. Form mixture into balls. Arrange the meatballs on the baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Mexican Stuffed Green Chile's
ingredients: 5 pico de gallo green chilies, washed inside lengthwise | 12 ounces fresh fruit ( your choice canned tomatoes, pineapple, mango, banana, mango... ) | 6 ounces fresh coconut, grated | 6 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons dry sherry or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons shredded coconut
instructions: Trim any stems and seeds from pico de chiles. Cut them in half lengthwise, leaving the seeds and ribs intact. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Drop the pico de chiles into the boiling water, and cook, stirring to keep chiles submerged, for about 5 - 8 minutes, or until they float to the surface. Remove the chiles with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Wipe out the pot, return it to the stove, and add the fruit. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, for 1 min., or until the fruit has cooked down and softened. Remove from the heat and stir in the grated coconut. Fill each chile lightly with the fruit mixture, and serve.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,orange,ice water,fenugreek seed,extra large egg,orange bell pepper
title: Tarragon Orange Pepper Omelette
ingredients: 6 extra-large eggs | 1 tablespoon greek tarragon | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 6 orange bell peppers, thinly sliced | 2 medium oranges, peeled & segmented | 2 cups ice water
instructions: Break half the eggs into a large bowl. Crack the remaining eggs into small chunks. Add tarragon, fenugreek seeds & orange bell pepper slices to the bowl.
