Beat the eggs lightly on high speed with an electric whip. Pour into the pan, swirling to coat all sides. Cover. Place in the freezer for 30 minutes, shaking the pan from time to time. When ready to serve, remove from pan & set on a cutting board. Using a spatula, gently beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form & pare off the surface. Gently fold 1 tbsp of the egg white into the egg mixture, then slowly pour in another of the egg whites to make an omelette shape. Repeat for remaining eggs & egg whites. Return pan to the freezer. Repeat until all eggs is used. Heat your griddle or a small skillet over medium heat until it is quite hot. Brush lightly with oil. When the griddle is very hot, drop 4 - 6 heaping tablespoonfulls into the hot fat. Cook slowly on one side & turn omelettes when all sides are puffed. Do not overcook they will become tough. When done remove from griddle. Leave behind fat & let rest for 5 mins & serve while omelettes are resting. Tip, don't be tempted to use a gas or charcoal grill to remove the fat from your griddle. Leave the fat in the pan, heat the oil & when it is very hot fry the hens for 3 - 5 mins on each side till lightly browned. Note, omelettes may burn very quickly, so move the pan carefully & slowly when they are brown all over.

title: Chuck Wagon's Cabbage Town
ingredients: 3 slices cheddar-style smoked fontina cheese | 3 tablespoons walnuts, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons tahini | 12 ounces country beer ( guinness or other ) | 14 1/2 ounces vegetable broth | 2 ounces prosciutto or 2 ounces ham, thinly sliced | 1 small cabbage
instructions: Arrange the cheese on a platter, sprinkle with nuts and drizzle with the tahini.

title: Shrimp Piroulet
ingredients: 1 pinch dried marjoram | 16 shrimp | 1 teaspoon ground dried shrimp
instructions: Heat a pan over medium heat, sprinkle with marjoram and shrimp. Fry shrimp for about 3 minutes, or until they float. Remove and drain. Serve with basmati rice.

title: Kosher White Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup rice, uncooked | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( optional )
instructions: Boil water, add rice, and let stand 3/4 hour or until rice is soft. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve warm.

title: Ww - African-Style Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken breasts, cut into bite sized pieces | 2 -3 green peppers, seeded and membrane removed ( optional ) | 1 cup tamari | 1 cup soy sauce | 1 cup water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Put all the ingredients in a baking pan. Bake uncovered for about 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.

title: Easy Guacamole Wingers
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons guacamole, smooth and creamy | 1 tablespoon prepared onion-salt dipping sauce, such as kitchen bouquet | 1/8 teaspoon champagne vinegar
instructions: In a small shallow bowl/container, mix together the guacamole, onion salt, and prepared dipping sauce. Dip the wingers in the sauce mixture, flipping to coat. This will keep the ingredients from turning black. Serve at once.

title: Linguine With Chicken, Cherry Tomatoes and Smoked Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 2 lbs chicken thighs | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup butter | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Cook linguine for about 8 minutes then rinse under cold water and drain. Meanwhile, brown chicken in butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Remove from skillet and cover. Add cherry tomatoes with their juices to chicken. Sprinkle with mace and simmer mixture over low heat, stirring occasionally in the meantime. Stir together linguine and tomatoes and serve.

title: Arugula and Snow Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 cup fresh snow pea, washed and torn into bite sized pieces | 8 ounces fresh snow peas, washed and torn into bite sized pieces | 12 ounces beer ( such as guinness ) | 8 large green cardamom pods | 1 bunch arugula, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Combine the snow peas in an 8 in. Pot. Add 1/2 cup warm water and stir, then cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until the snow peas are tender. Turn off heat and allow to steep for 20 minutes. Rinse and drain the peas, then transfer them to a blender or food processor and puree. Heat the beer in a pot over medium high heat. While the beer distributes its droplets to the outside of the pan, throw in the green cardamom pods and cook for 2 minutes, stirring. Pour over the snow peas and puree until smooth.

title: Greek  Dip  for ying the pierogi!!!
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, minced | 1 can olive, drained | 1 package of polish danish rolls ( a good quality pumpernickel or sesame bread )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 degrees f. In a 2 quart casserole dish, dump the onions and the olive flakes. Pour on the olives and stir.. Bake at 375 degrees f for 30 to 45 minutes, stirring every few minutes to check the mixture. Serve with freshly grated parmesan cheese and more good bread on the side. Note, if you like to serve this on the pierogi as an appetizer, assemble the pierogi before your guests. Use the amount of pierogis you want, however small it is. You may have extra when serving this on your own. We like ours with rye bread and fresh herbs on top as well as sour cream on top as well. Also, if you have extra time, just make certain you add 2 containers of kraft grated cheese. When all the pierogi is baked, take off the oven and take the pierogis out of the oven on a plate. Grate the cheese and layer on top of the pierogis. If you don't have any dough on hand, you can roll the pierogis and eat as is. Or you can bake these in a bread pan, slice the rolls and stuff with melted butter or margarine and enjoy with freshly ground pepper for the best end product.

title: Real Indian Quiche
ingredients: 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 hard-boiled egg | 1 serrano chili, sliced thin
instructions: Mix the yogurt and spices in a bowl until well blended. Pour mixture into a pie dish or fluted quiche dish, and fill the dish with the egg slices. Heat a large nonstick fry pan. Fry the quiche until it turns golden brown in color on the bottom 3 - 4 minutes. Turn over, and fry the other side until golden brown. Remove from pan, and serve warm.

title: Tarragon and Pineapple Soup
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks with juice | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 5 dates, seeded | 5 ounces sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: Drain the cans of canned pineapple and juice into a 2 quart pitcher. Sprinkle in the tarragon and dates.

Random Ingredients: prawn,tuna olive oil,butter,chile powder,jam,beef broth,apple pie filling,ketchup
title: Aussie Prawn Casserole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 cup beef broth | 2 tablespoons jam, warmed | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 8 prawns, shelled and deveined | 1 can tuna in olive oil, drained and flaked | 1 apple pie filling, frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c conventional or 400f degrees. Over medium heat, melt butter in saucepan, stir in ketchup, bring to boil, stir in broth, jam and chili powder. Place prawns in baking dish, then pour over sauce, then sprinkle with salt.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,green chili salsa,orzo pasta,peppercorn,watercress
title: Spicy Orzo Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces orzo pasta or 8 ounces linguine, cooked, chilled, and drained | 1 cup chilled green chili salsa, warmed | 1/4 cup watercress | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon sliced peppercorn
instructions: In a large bowl combine the cooked orzo, 1/4 cup hot chile salsa, watercress, soy sauce, and pepper. Toss to combine. Just before serving, garnish with remaining 1/4 cup hot sauce and remaining 1/8 cup sliced peppercorns.

title: Jalapeno-Rend Chiles
ingredients: 3 cups leftover jalapeno jack cheese or 3 cups leftover edam cheese | 4 tablespoons dried currants | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Cut the cheese into squares, and then cut each square diagonally in half. Combine the currants and garlic powder and put in a small bowl. Microwave the squares for 1 to 3 seconds, stir well and then spread evenly over the top of the cubes of cheese. Microwave on high power for 1 minute to melt the cheese then remove the cheese onto a warm plate. This will help with a moist crust on top.

title: Chocolate Phyllo Squares
ingredients: 6 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed if frozen | 1 cup coarsely chopped dried apricot | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon hot rose water
instructions: Drain the apricots in a sieve set over a bowl. Place the parchment sheets on a lightly oiled baking sheet and brush the phyllo sheets with a little bit of the butter. Place 1 sheet, cut side down, on the work surface and brush with a bit more butter. Repeat until you have a stack of 6 sheets that are 9 inches long. Brush 2 more sheets with butter and repeat with the remaining sheets. Cut the stack of phyllo so it is 12 layers. Place 6 sheets of phyllo in front of you about 1/2 inch up from the bottom. Cover with a towel and let rest for 5 minutes. Using your hands, gently pat down the phyllo dough on your work surface, about 3 1/2 inches across and 1 1/2 inches away from you. Uncover and spread half the apricots on top of the sheets at least 1/2 inch away from you. Starting at the bottom of the phyllo sheet, roll up the phyllo toward the end by pressing between sheets, then rolling and tucking underneath the roll. Tuck in any stray sheets of phyllo, but be sure to roll and tuck under before rolling and tucking, and you want to end up with a roll that is about 1 1/2 inches thick and 6 inches long. Fold over and pinch the ends together. You should have 24 sheets of filled, rolled, rolled, rolled logs. Place on a parchment lined baking tray. Bake in a preheated 375°f oven until golden, about 45 minutes. Allow oven to cool and thaw if frozen. Use a serrated knife to cut into 24 squares for a total of about 36 squares.

title: Golden Gate & Bailey's Irish Cream
ingredients: 2 cups ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup malibu rum ( mount gay if preferred ) | 2 tablespoons peach pickle juice | 2 teaspoons tequila or 2 teaspoons raspberry-flavored rum | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 small turnip, peeled & cut into 1/8-inch rounds
instructions: Place ricotta, malibu rum, peach pickle juice, tequila and molasses in medium bowl. Stir to thoroughly coat rims. Transfer to serving bowl & refrigerate at least 2 hours. Serve with round boondini or other round irish coffee flavored snacks. Enjoy.

title: Spiced Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 dried shiitake mushrooms, stemmed | 1/2 orange peel, cut in half about 3 inches long | 10 cardamom pods
instructions: Place the mushrooms on a small plate, and cover with clean water. Bring to a boil.

title: French Blankets
ingredients: 300 g of prepared biscuit dough | 3 teaspoons minced garlic paste | 1 teaspoon salad oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
instructions: Roll dough out on floured cloth and cut rolls 1/2 inch thick by folding one end over to opposite end and rolling up from opposite end. Wrap the ends in kitchen string. Place both ends into pre heated skillet at about 180c for 20 minutes. Cook both sides and remove from skillet. Cut rolls into 4 squares. Arrange on serving dish. Sprinkle with garlic paste, salad oil and pepper. Serve with french bread.

Random Ingredients: plum sauce,ancho chile powder,peanut butter,grain rice,grain white rice,cherry tomato,onion powder
title: Spicy Rice-a-Vent With Sweet Peanut Butter
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups long-grain white rice | 3/4 cup roasted peanuts, diced ( about 5 slices ) | 2 cans plum sauce, your favourite tomato, use the sweet ones | 2 tablespoons low-fat peanut butter | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved, if desired
instructions: Prepare rice while rice is cooking. Drain nuts into a large heavy bottomed pan or wok and set aside to allow a toarather. Drain plum sauce but reserve liquid. Heat peanut butter and reserved plum liquid in a large saucepan over medium heat. Toast until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Stir into the saucepan the peanuts, plum sauce, peanut butter, ancho powder, onion powder and tomatoes. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. After 1 minute, remove immediately from heat and stir in rice nuts and hot bean sauce.

Random Ingredients: nut,ice,chicken breast half,juice,cheddar cheese,cider vinegar,red bell pepper
title: Chicken a la Criolla
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 can or bottle beer | 1/4 cup prepared hot and spicy v8 juice | 4 slices cheddar cheese | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup chopped nuts, or to taste | 1/4 cup crushed ice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken breasts in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and pour in beer. Bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove chicken from the baking dish, and place 2 slices of cheese, 1 red bell pepper, and 1/3 cup of crushed nuts in a separate baking dish. Bake for 5 more minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Sesame Oil
ingredients: 3 teaspoons chili oil | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper seasoning | 8 radishes, sliced
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix hot oil with lemon pepper seasoning, stirring to blend. Stir radishes into oil.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,tabasco sauce,chili sauce,oregano,graham cracker crumb,green pea
title: Spicy Chili Peas
ingredients: 2 cans green peas, rinsed and drained | 1 chipotle pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 tablespoon prepared sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: In a small nonstick frying pan, saute the peas with pepper, chile sauce, oregano, tabasco and seasoning. Spoon into casserole and top with crumbs. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes.

title: Corn and Avocado With Spicy Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1 cup thickly sliced corn kernel | 1/2 cup chopped avocado | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander
instructions: Stir together the soymilk, corn and avocado in a bowl. Add the sour cream and coriander. Mix together. Spray a skillet with oil. Heat over medium heat. Pour spiced topping into corn swirl the mixture until it just starts to bubble. Serve warm.

title: Veal and Cornstrudels
ingredients: 400 g ground veal | 1/2 cup frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and knead well. Roll out the dough on a floured work surface to 3mm thickness. Cut out six 3cm round rounds, and place on a lightly lightly greased griddle. Cook over a moderate heat until lightly browned and cooked through. Allow to cool slightly in the grill. Serve at once.

title: Thai Green Curry Burgers
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon green curry paste ( i use penzey's curry paste ) | 4 hamburger buns, toasted
instructions: Use an electric beater for mixing. Pour enough curry paste into shallow pan to cover the bun but not the burger bun's bottom. Over high heat, heat until the paste starts to bubble. Remove from heat and spread the paste evenly across the buns. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: salmon,baby carrot,couscous,vinegar,chicken stock beef,salad oil,rice noodle
title: Salmon Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 350 g fresh rice noodles ( rice stick, cooked ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup beef bouillon | 1/4 cup salad oil | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 50 g mixed salad leaves, such as lettuce, chard or 50 g mixed salad leaves, large | 350 g salmon, halved, skin removed, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup cooked baby carrots | 75 g salad oil
instructions: To make dressing, place the chicken stock or stock and 3 tablespoons of salad oil in a small pan and bring to the boil. Add the noodles, reduce heat and simmer until the noodles are cooked, stirring occasionally and adding more stock or water as needed. Drain well. In a large bowl, combine the dressing and cooked noodles. Top with the remaining salad, salmon pieces, carrots and salad oil.

title: Luscious Roast Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork roast | 3 tablespoons cognac | 1 chili, minced
instructions: Place roast in a large sauce pan add cognac. Add chili and cook for an hour. Turn off the heat. Cool. Place on clean dishtowels or plastic wrap. Massage. Can be served at room temperature or refrigerate for 2 days.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,savory,bouquet garni,anise seed,flour tortilla,banana pepper
title: Peanut Butter Burritos
ingredients: 24 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 lb banana pepper, sliced | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon savory | 1 tablespoon creamy peanut butter | 1 bouquet garni, thyme, rosemary, garlic oregano and savory, to taste
instructions: Place 2 t. Peanut butter, 1 bouquet garni, 1 tsp. Anise seed, 1 tsp. Garam masala, 1 t. Cayenne pepper and 1/8 t. Salt into a small bowl. Dip each warmed tortilla into the heated peanut butter mixture and place in a warm skillet. Saute for 1 minute on the first side, then flip over and saute for 1 minute more. Repeat with remaining tortillas, peanut butter mixture, anise seed mixture and chevre.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,cheddar cheese,parsley flake,buttermilk,red capsicum,green olive
title: Cheesy Sopaipillas
ingredients: 4 ounces shredded cheddar cheese | 4 ounces shredded mild cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup chopped parsley flakes | 2 small green olives, chopped | 1 tablespoon buttermilk | 4 flour tortillas, heated | 1/2 cup finely chopped red capsicum
instructions: Combine cheeses and parsley in a small bowl and mix well. Spread oil into a non stick pan and heat till smoking, turn down heat slightly and spread evenly. Spread about 1/4 cup of cheese filling over 1 side of each tortilla. Roll up as evenly as possible to enclose filling and press edges together. Serve in pan with remaining cheese mixture, sprinkle with capsicum and remaining parsley. Serve with salsa, guacamole and chips. The recipe can be made up to 2 days in advance and stored in an airtight container. You can add more salt at this stage if required.

title: Quick and Easy Noodle Sauce
ingredients: 300 ml double cream | 1 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth and creamy. Stir over cooked noodles of your choice.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,half,dark soy sauce,corn cob,kalamata olive,anise seed,white flour
title: Grilled Corn and Olives
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white flour | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped fresh or 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 3 tablespoons half-and-half | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon cornmeal or 1 teaspoon cornmeal | 1 cup mushroom, fresh, sliced ( optional ) | 1 small white flour or 1 small bok choy
instructions: Combine flour, kalamata olives or anise seeds and 1 tablespoon of the cream in a bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cut corn off the cob, take out 3 or 4 stalks from remaining cob and place onto coals for 1 1/2 minutes. Flip and cook for an additional 5 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Homemade Brisket or Salt Crust
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried fennel seeds ( or 4 teaspoons crushed fennel seeds ) | 2 cups cold water ( or more ) | 3 1/2 lbs beef brisket, fat trimmed | 2 limes or 2 lemons, split and cut into quarters | 1 teaspoon allspice, ground
instructions: Toast the fennel seeds in 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons of the water until dark brown. Place in a spice grinder and grind until fine. Dissolve the cornstarch in a little cold water. Tie the remaining 1 1/2 cups water in a spice bag and add the brisket. Press out all the air. Place in a large pan and add enough water to come halfway up the sides. Cover and bring to a boil. Place over moderate heat and boil gently, 1 hour or until almost tender. Drain. Allow to cool completely, then refrigerate or freeze until ready to use. To serve, scrape the brisket from the bag, reserving the fat. Discard the fat. Slice the brisket into 4 portions, place and let each person use 2 or 3 slices of brisket for each portion. Place half the sliced brisket in a clean cheese cloth and rub the spice bag over the entire meat and squeeze the seeds from the remaining 1 1/2 cups of water. Stir the contents of the spice bag and water together and pour over the meat. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving. When ready to serve, slice the brisket thinly and arrange over the cooked vegetables at table.

title: Japanese Grilled Fish
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons minced fresh oregano leaves, divided
instructions: Whisk together the rice vinegar, cardamom, and 1 tablespoon of the oregano in a shallow dish. Add the fish and turn to coat, then add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oregano. Set aside for 20 minutes. Cook the salmon on the barbeque grill, turning once, until browned and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Discard used marinade.

title: Slow Cooked Rice With Spicy Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb bulk pork sausage | 1 box basmati rice | 1 1/3 cups skim milk
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet, remove from skillet, drain of fat, crumble and set aside. Wash rice well in hot oil and drain any excess moisture and drain on paper towels. Layer rice, meat mixture and brown sugar in slow cooker, top layer with remaining ingredients, top with cheese. Cover & cook on low for 7 hours.

title: Homemade Corn
ingredients: 2 cups frozen corn, thawed | 1/4 cup beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons of powdered corn, powder
instructions: Place frozen corn and corn bullion cube in a container with a cover and keep on lid for about two hours or until it is defrosted. Mix the above listed dry ingredients and add to blender. Blend for about 20 seconds on low to medium, blend for a few seconds to desired consistency.

title: Egg Salad from Japanese Cooking
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 green pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons grated fresh dashi ( i prefer honchudon ) | 5 cups water | 4 teaspoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Cover, remove from heat and let eggs stand upright, about 20 minutes. Remove from hot water, cool, peel and chop. Place green pepper, eggs and dashi in a large saucepan. Pour in water. Cook over medium low heat, stirring constantly, until eggs are tender and sauce is reduced to about 1 1/2 cups. Remove from heat and stir in rice vinegar or mirin. Season with salt and pepper. Taste and adjust seasoning.

title: Apple Milk Shake
ingredients: 3 cups milk | 1/2 teaspoon peanut oil | 1 medium tart apple, peeled, cored and chopped | 1/4 cup sliced dry-roasted salted peanut oil
instructions: Stir milk and oil together, and set aside to cool slightly. Stir apple into milk shake mixture to coat apple with oil. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,coffee,dove breast,cream tartar,wide egg noodle,mirin
title: Dublin Cappuccino
ingredients: 2 packages canadian bacon | 2 tablespoons coffee | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 24 ounces refrigerated wide egg noodles | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 1 teaspoon mirin
instructions: Place canadian bacon in very large skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Drain bacon and place on paper towels. Pour off the cooking fat. Return skillet to medium heat, add 1 tablespoon cooking oil spray, and lightly cook the canadian bacon until crisp, about 10 minutes. In a large bowl, bring 3 quarts of salted water to boil. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain noodles, and immediately toss with 2 tablespoons coffee, 1 teaspoon ground coffee, and 1 teaspoon mirin. Divide noodles between 2 serving plates, and top with cooked bacon and canadian bacon. Serve with sour cream.

title: Chunky, Fluffy and Creamy Banana Breakfasts
ingredients: 1 large banana | 1/2 cup plain yogurt, plain lowfat is fine | 1/4 cup superfine sugar or 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1/2 cup light marshmallows | fresh lemonade, to serve
instructions: Halve the banana lengthways, scrape out the pulp and cut into thin slices. Combine the yogurt, sugar and marshmallows in a medium bowl, add the banana with a few drops of lemonade, stir well. Spoon over the banana mixture and sprinkle with lemonade to serve.

Random Ingredients: brioche bread,tapioca starch,beef,pork chop,vanilla bean,olive,monterey jack cheese,black olive
title: Pork Chops in a Pear-And-Rice-Pies
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, 1 inch thick | 2 tablespoons tapioca starch ( or instant corn starch ) | 1/2 cup sliced ripe olives, drained | 1/2 cup drained chopped pitted ripe olives ( i substitute with drained pimento-stuffed salad, pimentos or santalons ) | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese | 4 slices brioche bread, cut in 4 pieces | 1/2 cup beef mayonnaise
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in a shallow bowl. Dredge each pork slice 2 - 3 times in tapioca, coating evenly. Arrange pork in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Bake at 400ºf for 25 minutes, turning once. Top with grated cheese. To serve, place bread pieces on a serving platter. Spread beef mayonnaise over bread and surround with bread pieces.

title: Homemade Naan bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 16 cups bread flour ( all purpose or gluten-free flour )
instructions: Stir yeast and turmeric into the warm water in a large mixing bowl. Let stand 5 - 10 minutes until the yeast begins to foam. Add flour and knead until dough is smooth and elastic and you have a pliable dough that clears hands. Cover bowl, cool for 15 minutes. Divide into golf size balls and let rise until almost double. Make 2 slashes across the top to allow steam to escape. Bake on lightly greased baking sheets at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Confetti Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 yellow squash | 2 eggs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place squash on a baking sheet with a lid, and bake about 20 minutes in the preheated oven. While the squash is baking, poke holes in the squash with a fork a few times. Separate the eggs, and beat the yolks with a fork.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,water,cauliflower,lemon pepper,brown basmati rice,chili powder,spiral pasta
title: Chinese Cauliflower and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cut into 4 wedges | 1 head bok choy, sliced | 1/2 bunch cauliflower, broken into florets | 7 ounces uncooked spiral shaped pasta, uncooked | 1/2 cup water | 2 tablespoons brown basmati rice | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Separate cabbage and bok choy pieces. Cook in boiling water 5 minutes, or until just tender. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions, drain and place in large serving bowl. Meanwhile, combine cauliflower, bok choy and cauliflower in a saucepan with water. Simmer 3 - 5 minutes, or until coated.

title: Toast Swiss Bread
ingredients: 4 slices toasted rye bread | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 package grated italian sandwich toasts | 1 bunch celery ribs, finely chopped
instructions: Spread each slice of bread with tomato sauce according to package directions. Arrange 2 toasted italian toasts between wax paper. Cut sandwich toasts in half horizontally. Place grated cheese and celery over bread. Place under broiler 3 to 4 inches from heat until cheese is melted.

title: Baked Eggplant in Cardamom Cream (Uova Raita)
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled, sliced or grated into 1/2-inch cubes | 6 cardamom pods | ginger ( thumb-sized or grater of desired size ) | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 cups whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Note ~ if using raw eggplant remove the skin from the outside then cut the eggplant finely in cubes. Sprinkle the cubes with cardamom pinches and cover with plastic wrap for at least an hour. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine baking powder, cream, ground sage or cinnamon in a bowl. Set aside and leave covered in the fridge for 1 hour, stirring a couple of times. Place the eggplant cubes in a colander and drain the liquid off. Place 2 or 3 eggplant cubes in the bowl and toss to coat. Place on the parchment lined baking sheet. Spread the remaining 3 cubes on top of the cubes. Top with another cookie sheet/platter. Bake in preheated oven for about 20 minutes until lightly browned. Garnish with a sprinkle of chopped sage before serving.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,corn flake,green bell pepper,black tea
title: Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced bamboo shoot, drained of its liquid | 1 cup corn flakes | 1 bunch green bell pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 cups black tea
instructions: Stir fry the bamboo shoots in 1 1/2 tablespoons of the oil until tender crisp, 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Faux Five-Spice-Sea Salt Blend
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon unrefined unbleached cane sugar ( aka nigiri - can be found in health food stores )
instructions: Place three tablespoons of unbleached cane sugar, unrefined unbleached cane sugar, and five spice powder in a mortar. Smash a few times until sugar is mostly melted. Keep crushing and grinding. Store in an airtight jar. Keeps indefinitely.

title: Oven Barbecued Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs sirloin, trimmed and cut into 2 by 6 by 4 inch lengths | 2 teaspoons onion salt | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat broiler and place rack 6 inches from heat. Place ribs in a greased 13 by 9 inch pan or in large ziploc bag. In a small bowl combine the onion salt and baking soda. Sprinkle half of the salt mixture over the ribs. With a skewer poke holes in the salt mixture. Broil ribs about 4 or 5 inches from heat for about 45 minutes, turning 2 or 3 times. Broil ribs about 5 minutes longer or until tender and browned.

title: Chipotle Snack
ingredients: 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 1/4 cup cornflour, to thicken ( optional )
instructions: Mince chilies with the seeds and mustard seeds. Blend or process chilies in a mortar and pestle or with a spice mill. Measure 1/4 cup cornflour and blend or process into a paste with 1/4 cup water or milk. Stir in the ground chilies. Serve with crackers.

title: Mince With Peanut Chips
ingredients: 1 lb mincemeat | 1 teaspoon seasoning ( or mix of your choice with salt and pepper ) | 5 tablespoons chicken broth or 5 tablespoons vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the oil. Mix the oil with the oil until the mixture is all mixed well and then spoon into hot oil. Cook until light brown and crispy on the outside, 3 - 4 minutes.

title: Mushroom Cracker
ingredients: 18 white mushrooms, stems removed | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 3 1/2 cups saltine crackers
instructions: Melt sugar in a 9x13 baking dish.

title: Baked Tuna and Parmesan Cheese
ingredients: 1 can tuna | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Pour the tuna, soy milk, and cheese into a large baking dish. Drain any excess liquid from the tuna and mix with the cheese. Place the dish in a medium oven and bake for 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,orange juice,corn oil,creme de menthe,tarragon,vinegar,hoagie,apple
title: German Roast Potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/3 lbs russet potatoes | 4 cloves garlic, crushed | 2 large apples, cored and cut into 1/2 inch wedges | 1/3 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 cups low-fat creme de menthe | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 hoagie roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until firm, about 25 minutes. Drain and reserve. In a small bowl, combine the garlic and apples and rub onto the inside of the crock. Place the potatoes and apples into a large casserole or baking dish. Combine the orange juice, vinegar, french menthe, corn oil, and tarragon. Pour the marinade over the potatoes and vegetables. Cover with foil, and bake until the potatoes are tender, about 1 hour. Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes. Slice in half and serve immediately.

title: Ham Baked in a Cast Iron Foil
ingredients: 1 lb ham, chopped | 1 tablespoon ghee | 1/4 cup mixed dried fruit | 1/4 cup brown rice | sea salt
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325 degrees f. Line a large cast iron fry pan or a square baking pan with the fried ham. In a medium size mixing bowl, combine the ghee and mixed dried fruit. Add ham and mix well. Sprinkle with sea salt. Place mixture evenly on the pan. Place the pan into a larger pan that the pan has been filled with water. Bake in the oven for 2 hours. If necessary, tent loosely with foil and place on a cooler tray. Allow to cool for at least 15 minutes prior to serving.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,chocolate chip,white pepper,chicken,kosher salt,couscous,tea,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Chocolate Tasty Chicken
ingredients: 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1/3 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons instant tea ( or 2 tsp. powdered instant tea with 1/2 tsp. raw sugar or a real cup of milk ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt ( to taste ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried chicken pieces | 3/4 teaspoon ground white pepper ( to taste ) | couscous | chocolate chips
instructions: In a small bowl, combine jam, yogurt and powdered tea and stir to mix. Place chicken pieces, white pepper and salt in a shallow dish. Pour yogurt mixture over chicken, cover and marinate chicken for at least 2 hours in the fridge. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Coat nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Spread 1 tbsp of marinade into a shallow pie plate. Sprinkle chicken with 2 tsp. Of the white pepper. Arrange chicken pieces in the pan, cover with waxed paper and bake at 400 for 25 minute remove from oven and place a piece of chocolate under each piece, cover with foil, and let rest about 3 - 5 minute. Spoon warm marinade into a serving bowl and spoon over chicken.

title: Kabelsalat -- Greek Bread Dip (Lebanese)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stale bread | 3/4 lb black olives, pitted, chopped | poppy seed ( optional )
instructions: Cut the stale bread into 1/2 inch slices. Put the olives in a bowl and pour over just enough cold water to cover. Drain out the excess water and press the olives through a strainer or with a wooden spoon. Add the poppy seeds if using and mix well. Set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes. Spread the dip on the bread and refrigerate while you prepare the garnishes and serve.

title: Savory Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup chives, finely chopped | 1 cup fresh dill, chopped | 1 cup brandy | black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Serve over your favorite meat and vegetables of your choice.

title: Irish Cream Kiss
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces irish cream | 1 fluid ounce dark rum | prosciutto, slices
instructions: Place the cream, rum and prosciutto slices into a shaker with ice. Shake well and pour into an ice filled 12 oz glass. Top with fresh whipped cream and dust with shaved chocolate and serve.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,banana,range chicken,pinto bean,lite olive oil,onion salt
title: Colcannon, a Yummy Mexican Cabbage Soup!
ingredients: 500 g free-range chicken | 1 small onion | 3 green cabbage | 1/2 cup lite olive oil | 1 liter free-range chicken broth ( or any other flavourful broth you like ) | 1 cup frozen bananas | onion salt
instructions: The night before, trim the heads of the cabbage, separate the leaves, and cut the leaves into shreds. Slice the cabbage into shreds. Chop the onion, if you have it. Heat the oil in a large pan, add the onion, cabbage, and chicken, sauté until the onions are caramelized. Add the chicken broth, salt, and beans, simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Add the bananas, and simmer again for 3 - 5 minutes. Serve hot. I like to serve these hot with fresh crusty bread, or use tostada shells and a nice salad. Enjoy.

title: Fried Beetroot Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 500 g raw beets | 1 2/3 cups bread, stale from bakery ( see note below ) | 1 1/4 tablespoons orange flower water | 2 -3 teaspoons orange flower water
instructions: To make the syrup, wash and soak the beetroots for 30 minutes in plenty of water. Cut off any tough outer layer under the beetroot but leave some on the beetroot. Cut the beetroot into thick slices and place into a large bowl of cold water. Peel off the beetroot skin and cut the beetroot into thick slices. Add to the bowl of cold water and set aside to soak for 20 minutes or so. Drain the beets and gently squeeze out any excess moisture with your hands. Drain all of the liquid from the beetroot bowl and discard. Cut the beetroot slices into thick slices and then place into a large bowl. Squeeze out the excess moisture, and add the breadcrumbs and orange flower water. Mix all the ingredients together with your fingers until everything is well combined. Place the breadcrumb mixture into a bowl and gently mix together with your fingers to ensure that all the breadcrumbs have been moistened. Heat the oil in a large frying pan, and place the mixture on a large plate in the pan. Fry the breadcrumbs for 1 - 2 minutes on each side, remove with a slotted spoon and drain with a slotted spoon. Serve with the beets and orange flower water. Note on breadcrumbs, if breadcrumbs are not stale from soaking the beetroot add a few tablespoons of water if you need to. If you really needed to soak, a little cold water may be added so the consistency stays moist. Note on orange flower water, i've deliberately used orange flower water because it's not available commercially, but if you can get it, you can substitute with a small amount of orange flower water. However, i felt the flavour had not been lacking with the flavour before adding it to the breadcrumbs. Another indication that a change in flavourful flavour is an acidity of 1 - 2 tsp of orange flower water, which is neither good nor unfet nor unfiltered. Note on beetroot bread, if not stale from soaking the beetroot, it should be discarded and the beetroot slices discarded. Also note on breadcrumbs, if not stale from soaking the beetroot, it should be discarded and the beetroot slices discarded.

title: Torta Di Brochette (Mushroom & Banana Sandwiches)
ingredients: 12 slices rye bread | 2 ripe bananas | 12 slices portabella mushrooms ( each 3/4-inch thick ) | 1 1/2 cups brioche mixed salad vegetables ( such as chanterelles, onions, peppers, peas, snow peas, or lettuce ) | 1 cup mixed mushrooms | 1 cup strawberry ( optional )
instructions: Toast the bread slices on both sides in a 400 degree oven. Trim all the crusts. Cut the bananas in half and carefully remove the skin. Turn each half over and, being careful not to cut all the way through, cut on the other side into 1/4 slices. Heat the mushrooms in a non stick skillet. Split the mushrooms in half, open, and separate the halves, discard the stems. Cut the bananas in 4 pieces and arrange them on each slice of bread. Divide the mushrooms among the 6 bread slices. Sprinkle the top with half of the bananas, followed by the mixed vegetables. Place the top of the sandwich on each slice of bread. If using strawberries, mix them inches then cut them into 6 wedges. Spoon strawberries over the sandwich in the centre of the sandwich. Garnish with fresh strawberries, if desired.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,arugula,lemon juice zest,mincemeat,baby spinach
title: Spinach and Meat Salad with Arugula
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1/2 cup chopped baby arugula | 1/4 lb mincemeat, cooked | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, and zest of | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Mix together, spinach and meat in large bowl. Mix in lemon juice and season to taste. Serve at room temperature.

title: Shrimp Croquettes
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated biscuits | 2 packages shrimp paste ( like nam pla ) | 3 cans bamboo shoots
instructions: In an 8x8 or 9x9 pan, or similar sized fry pan, microwave shrimp paste for 20 seconds. Cool, remove shrimp paste and slice into pieces about 3 inches long, about 1/4 inch wide. Put shrimp paste in food processor and slowly add 2 cans of bamboo shoots. Pulse all together until all ingredients are mixed well. Roll dough into 1 balls. Dampen hands and shape into balls slightly smaller than the size of biscuit dough, and flatten on a floured surface to form small oval shapes. Heat oil in fry pan over medium heat and cook the cookies until edges are golden brown, about 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: green onion,chili flake,cayenne,almond,sherry,cream chicken soup,orange peel,white pepper
title: Quick and Easy  Creamy Almond Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, preferably toasted | 1 small bunch green onion | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 pinch dried chili flakes | 1 pinch white pepper | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon orange peel, grated
instructions: Blend soup, almonds, green onion, sherry, chili flakes, white pepper and cayenne with blender until creamy, smooth. Add grated orange peel.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,russet potato,active yeast,raisin,phyllo dough,celery salt,yellow cornmeal,jalapeno pepper
title: Sweet Sour Potatoes
ingredients: 2 cups luke warm orange juice concentrate | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast ( fleischman's or equivalent ) | 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 lb russet potatoes or 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled | 3 -4 jalapeno peppers, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Bring 3 cups water to a boil in a medium bowl. Stir in the cornmeal, cover, and let stand 5 minutes. Mix in the yeast. Mix in half of the flour until the mixture is very thick. Cover and let rest 15 minutes, or until the dough has doubled in volume. Stir in the remaining flour and mix thoroughly. Knead for 2 minutes or until smooth, continuing to knead. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or according to the manufacturers instructions. In a large bowl, place the potatoes, peppers, and raisins. Heat oven to 400°f. Mix potatoes with 1/3 cup cold water 1 at a time until thoroughly mixed. Spread the dough out on a lightly floured surface.

title: Crock Pot Corn on the Cob With Yoghurt and Barley Mash
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen chopped corn, thawed | 7 ounces natural yoghurt | 1 lb pearl barley
instructions: Combine corn, yoghurt and barley in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting for 4 - 5 hours, or until thickened slightly and barley is tender. If using a cooker, stir and serve. Note, cooking time does not include marrowading.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,mustard,parsnip,season salt,beef chuck,green chili pepper,black pepper,whipping cream
title: Carnivian Goulash Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck | 1 lb kielbasa | 3 -4 medium pared parsnips | 2 1/2 cups whipping cream | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili peppers, drained | mustard | 2 teaspoons season-all salt | 1/4 teaspoon fresh coarse ground black pepper
instructions: Cut beef into 1 inch cubes and place in a dutch oven or crockpot. Cook on low heat for 5 to 7 hours or until meat is cooked. When ready to serve, remove all but 1/2 cup of drippings from meat and mix them in a medium bowl with the green chili, cream, mustard, season all, salt and pepper. Stir to combine. Serve hot.

title: Simple Crunchy Nachos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced onion | 1 tablespoon minced shallot | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce, hot sauce to taste | 1/4 cup flaked coconut | 1 bag tortilla chips | 1 head romaine lettuce | 1/4 cup minced fresh cilantro ( or to taste ) or 1/4 cup parsley ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a small bowl, combine minced onion, shallots, hot pepper sauce, and coconut. Mix well, and spread on a piece of foil about 12 inches long and 10 inches long. Place onto baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until mixture starts to lightly brown. Place tortilla chips on top of chopped onion mixture. Fill each tortilla with romaine and cilantro. Serve warm.

title: Baked Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut diagonally into 2-inch strips | 3/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 1/2 cups bread crumbs | 3/4 cup catsup | 6 tablespoons grated fresh gingerroot | 9 inches sliced bread ( i use country bread ) | 1/2 loaf sliced provolone cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Place kielbasa on lightly greased cookie sheet and sprinkle with garlic salt. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, turning once. Allow to cool slightly before removing from pan leaving sausage drippings in pan. Combine bread crumbs, catsup, ginger, and 1/2 cup of water. Mix well. Add kielbasa and coat well in crumb mixture. Arrange on foil lined baking sheet. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Smoky Chili Sauce
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 2 lbs ground beef or 2 lbs pork | 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped
instructions: Roast the poblano chiles as per the directions, turning them over several times during cooking. They should blacken inside and slightly blistered on top of the chile. Place the chilies in a heatproof container or baking pan. Cover with the hot beef or pork and rub the chile inside and out until the meat is completely covered. Place the chiles in a 250° f oven for about 15 minutes or until the chiles are softened. Remove and discard the stems and veins from the chiles and set aside. In a heavy 10 to 12 inch skillet, lightly brown the garlic and ground meat. Drain off any excess fat. Add the chile mixture and simmer over low heat until heated through.

Random Ingredients: lemon,parsnip,alfalfa sprout,chipotle chile adobo,white pepper,coconut,whipping cream
title: Coconut Parsnips, Diced With Nips
ingredients: 4 -5 medium parsnips, unpeeled | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut, shredded | lemon slice | whipping cream | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | white pepper | 1 bunch alfalfa sprout
instructions: Boil the coconut until just barely beginning to soften about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the lemon. Add in the parsnips and coconut and mix thoroughly. Season with salt and white pepper and serve in a bowl with lemon slices. Top with whipping cream and chipotle chili. Note, this recipe tastes even better if chilli is left in for a few hours before serving to let the flavors mingle.

title: Fried Browned Cheese
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, cut crosswise into thin strips | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: In a large skillet or wok, fry the bacon over high heat until crisp, about 2 minutes. Drain the bacon slices on paper towels, retaining excess grease. Stir together the bacon grease, yogurt and gruyere in a small bowl.

title: Italian Potato Salad (Vegan Optional)
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes ( about 2 medium ) | 5 tablespoons flour | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise ( low-fat is fine ) | 1 package italian bread
instructions: Shred potatoes with a potato masher. You should have about 1 1/2 lbs of potatoes mashed with some flour. Place the remaining potatoes in a large bowl. Add mayo and mix. Add the potatoes to the bowl with the mayo and flour stir until ingredients are evenly mixed. Place in refrigerator to chill and set the flavors together. Serve chilled as a salad option or with tortilla chips as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,pepperoni,ear corn,brown lentil,cream mushroom soup,baby corn,white fish
title: Hearty Baked Italian Fish and Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 package firm dry brown lentils | 4 boneless skinless white fish | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can baby corn | 1 can sliced apple cider | 1 jar pepperoni, chopped | 1 can ear corn, drained
instructions: In 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish spread bean mixture. Scatter baby corn & sliced apple over beans. Combine soup, corn, pepperoni, corn & chopped pepperoni in bowl. Pour over fish. Cover & bake at 400ºf for 50 minutes, uncover & bake another 20 minutes or until fish is tender, stirring twice during baking. Serve over brown rice.

title: Saffron-Marinated Chicken wings
ingredients: 1 kg meat, wings from thighs, backs, drumsticks | 500 g dark chocolate | 250 g marshmallows | 500 g chicken wings | 1/2 kg saffron | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/3 cup molasses
instructions: Heat oven to 180c/160cfan/gas put chicken wings in a large roasting pan. Break up chocolate with a fork and add to chicken. Sprinkle with mollymallows and cinnamon and mix well. Allow chicken wings to cool and then turn over in roasting tray to coat the breast. Put the remaining saffron marmalade into a pan and cook for 1 hour, stirring constantly. Random Ingredients: beef brisket,basil leaf,nonstick cooking spray,vinegar,saffron,ginger garlic paste,bread flour,filet beef
title: Filipino Beef Phyllo
ingredients: 1/3 cup low-fat bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed | nonstick cooking spray | 3 cups sliced filet of beef | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Mix bread flour, basil, ginger garlic paste and saffron in large bowl. Place beef in large resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: avocado,cream tartar,japanese soy sauce,green bell pepper,white sugar,pork mince,corn chip
title: Pork & Green Peppers in Chipotle Sour Cream
ingredients: 600 g pork mince | 2 green bell peppers | 100 g white sugar ( or up to 1/2 cup to taste ) | 1 tablespoon japanese soy sauce | 1 teaspoon light sour cream ( or use regular sour cream ) | 1/2 cup corn chips ( to serve ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar ( to serve )
instructions: Put the pork mince in a saucepan and add the bell peppers, sugar and soy sauce. Bring to the boil and cook. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes until the pork is cooked. Remove from heat and leave to cool. While the pork is cooling, put the corn chips in a microwavable dish and microwave for 1 - 2 minutes until chips are warm. Remove the meat from the skillet and roughly chop. Add the corn chips and keep warm. Once all the meat is cool, put the sour cream in a bowl and add the sour cream and cream of tartar. Whisk to mix well. Pour the chip sour cream mixture into a serving bowl or individual serving bowls and decorate with the chopped beef, lettuce and hot peppers.

title: Fiery BBQ Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup bell pepper, medium-ripe chunks seeded ( i prefer a mix of yellow, red, and green bell peppers ) | 1/4 cup ground ginger
instructions: Grill peppers, bell peppers, and ginger on high heat, rotating pepper until peppers are slightly charred, about 5 minutes or so, turning peppers and stirring frequently. Remove peppers from grill and transfer peppers to a bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients and serve immediately.

title: Venison and Saffron Potjoches
ingredients: 400 g venison, cubed | 200 g leg of steak, cubed | 2 tablespoons chili peppers, chopped ( i use jalepeno ) | 1 teaspoon chili pepper, chopped | 1 pinch nutmeg | 2 saffron strands | 1 1/2 cups hot sauce | 500 g potatoes, large cubed
instructions: Mix all ingredients except potatoes together and place in large saucepan. Bring to boil and reduce heat. Simmer covered 1 hour to 2 hours. Add potatoes and heat through. Serve over rice or with noodles.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,co lettuce,caper,pork tenderloin,jumbo shrimp,cream tartar,chuck
title: Bibingka - Japanese Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb thinly sliced fresh ginger-garlic paste ( about 1/8 '' long, not in the can ) | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 6 1/2 ounces cooked boneless pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 lbs jumbo shrimp, shelled | 1 1/2 lbs fresh boneless pork tenderloins, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup drained capers | 4 heads curly shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Toss together ginger garlic paste and cream of tartar. Add pork, shrimp, pork and pork strips, reserving any excess marinade in the pan. Toss to coat. Add capers and lettuce to pan.

title: Chinese Cabbage Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices bread, toasted | chili sauce | 1 large cabbage, shredded
instructions: Lay the toast in toaster. Spread with chili sauce, top with shredded cabbage, broil briefly to warm, serve.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,sage leaf,hickory smoke salt,red curry paste
title: Spicy Blueberry Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup fresh blueberries, washed and chopped | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon hickory smoke salt | 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaves, shredded or finely chopped
instructions: Wash and chop berries. Add remaining ingredients. Serve on toast or bread. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: orange,green chili pepper,pimento pepper,kaffir lime leaf,dinner,cooking oil,cranberry juice
title: Caribbean Sweet and Sour Onigiri, Khao Pod (Sliced Red Onions)
ingredients: 1 dozen dinner roll, with a long sides | 12 kaffir lime leaves, cut into thin crosswise sticks | 2 pimento peppers, chopped | red green chili pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/2 cup sweetened cranberry juice | 3 tablespoons chopped dried orange rind
instructions: In a large saucpan, cook the rolls in hot oil over medium high heat until browned. Remove from skillet except to a small bowl. Place browned rolls on a paper towels to drain. Reduce oven heat to moderate. Add lime leaves and pimento peppers to oil in skillet and cook, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes. Add chili.

title: Beef Rice Ring (Beef Stuffed)
ingredients: 1 box minute quinoa | 3 beef bouillon cubes | ice cube | 1 package poundcake
instructions: Place the rice, bouillon cubes, and box of pound cake in the rice cooker and cook until done but not soft or mushy. Cut pound cake into thin fingers and stuff with rice. Place the foil or toothpicks on the ends of the ring and fold the foil around the ring. Secure with a toothpick to prevent burning.

Random Ingredients: black cumin seed,baking chocolate,wine,broth,sugar snap pea
title: Black Cumin Straw Pea & Chocolate Pudding
ingredients: 400 ml whole grain wine | 400 g sugar snap peas, frozen | 4 medium baking chocolate, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon black cumin seeds | 1 tablespoon stock or 1 tablespoon broth, can use a vegetable stock cube
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 180p. Line a 20x30cm shallow oven proof dish with baking paper to use for the pudding. Heat wine, snap peas, chocolate and cumin seeds in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until chocolate melts and sugar dissolves. Remove from the heat and stir through stock. Pour evenly into the prepared dish and bake for 40 - 45 minutes until set and golden.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,celery salt,chili flake,orzo pasta,coffee,portabella mushroom,italian parsley,egg beater substitute
title: Puff Pasta With Hot-And-Sour Peanut Sauce

instructions: Prepare the pasta as directed until al dente. While pasta is cooking, in a small bowl blend 2 teaspoons instant coffee with 1/4 cup boiling water. Set aside. Drain the pasta well and place back in the hot baking mix. In a small bowl combine the hot and sour peanut sauce and add to the drained pasta. Mix well to combine and evenly distribute the hot and sour peanut mixture over the pasta. Sprinkle celery salt over the top of the pasta and then add the mushroom slices. title: Pasteles E Piselli (Portuguese Garlic Pastry)

Random Ingredients: fajita seasoning,red chile,pear,lime juice,pancetta,orange juice zest
title: Barbecued Pear and Pancetta Salad

When the slices start to soften and turn slightly golden, push to one side and turn back to the other. Continue to cook these slices for a few minutes, or until crisp and light golden. Drain on kitchen paper and keep warm. Combine all ingredients in a bowl, mixing lightly. Pour the dressing over the salad, tossing until coated well. Season, if desired. Serve immediately.

instructions: Place the rice in a bowl and spread out on paper towels. Let steam for 30 minutes. Heat a microwave safe bowl and a lid on the microwave until hot, 2 to 3 minutes. Carefully fold 1/2 the rice and 1/2 teaspoon salt to form a rice crust. Repeat with the remaining rice, salt, and pepper until rice crusts are fully encased. Set crusted rice onto a plate, cover with another microwave safe bowl, and place the oven rack in the center of the oven. Heat the rice in the oven until the crust browns, 3 to 5 minutes. Set a second microwave safe bowl on top of the rice crust and continue cooking until crust is crispy and rice is tender, about 2 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,black pepper,vinegar,horseradish cream,sea salt,ranch dressing mix

instructions: Slightly brown meat in butter and add marsala, wine and saffron. Slightly brown meat in butter again. Pour into casserole dish with greased lid. Cook 1 hour in 325°f oven.

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Unroll pizza dough on lightly floured board and stretch it into a rectangle about 10x14 inches. Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Random Ingredients: beef,herb stuffing mix,club soda,center pork loin chop

instructions: Place lemon peel in a small bowl and sprinkle the lemon peel on top of the lemon peel, if using. Lay the chicken pieces flat in a roasting pan or baking pan. Random Ingredients: coriander powder,salami,garlic powder,bread,vanilla essence,pizza crust,fenugreek leaf

instructions: Preheat fan oven 190 degrees c on fan tray. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Arrange pizza base on tray. Using hands, rub salami/fenugreek leaves through. Sprinkle on flour. Bake in fan oven for 20 - 25 minutes until toppings start to caramelise slightly. Remove from oven and leave for 10 minutes to cool. Cut into pieces.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,grand marnier,vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon zest,yogurt

instructions: Mix together the feta cheese, yogurt, grand marnier, lemon zest, and salt in a bowl. Spray the edges of a large martini glass with cooking spray, and pour in the chilled yogurt mixture. Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Smoky Sweet-Sour Milk Substitute

instructions: Heat the nonfat milk until it just begins to foam on top. Add the liquid smoke and stir well. Serve immediately.

title: Soy-Stir-Fry Sauce for Lamb

instructions: Use an asian style whisk to stir fry the pork. Add the honey and soy sauce. Serve..

instructions: Cook pasta in salted water until pasta is al dente drain then stir in beans& peppers. Cover and refrigerate for 6 hours. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,sponge cake,corn syrup,arborio rice,orange juice,cream mushroom soup

Place dish in a larger pan of boiling water.

title: Beer Balls III

instructions: Pour 1/4 cup beer into container of a blender or food processor. Add dry onion slices and cayenne pepper. Puree until fairly smooth, scraping down sides as needed. title: The Bestest Cheese!
ingredients: 1 lb asiago cheese | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Cut cheese into 1/4 slices and toss with worcestershire sauce. Enjoy.

title: Perfect Sesame Gluten Free Brownies

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease two baking sheets and set aside. In a medium size bowl, whisk both flours together. Arrange one on the prepared baking sheets, pressing to adhere the top of each one to the baking sheets. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes. Take baking sheets off the oven, and wait a few minutes longer. Store in an airtight container.

title: Pecan Toffee

instructions: Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil and coat with cooking spray. In a bowl, blend the pecans with buttermilk and canning salt. Spread in a paper cone shape over foil, covering all of the nuts with the pecan mixture. Place on the cookie sheet and bake in a preheated 300 degree f oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and cool slightly, about 5 minutes.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 9 x 13 inch cake pan with vegetable oil. In a large bowl, mix together the cream cheese and 2 cups cream. Mix in the chocolate cake mix.

instructions: Combine the bell pepper, white onion, orange flower water, and red rose's oregano in a food processor or blender. instructions: Spread beef roast fat side up in slow cooker. Add 2 cups water and the uncooked lasagna noodles to slow cooker.
