title: Peanut-Mango Chutney
ingredients: 5 ounces frozen limeade concentrate, defrosted | 2 tablespoons dried roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons mango chutney
instructions: Thaw the limeade concentrate completely, in the refrigerator. Combine the limeade concentrate, peanuts, and mango chutney using a blender. Process until smooth, stopping frequently to scrape down sides of bowl. Cover and chill in the refrigerator 1 to 4 hours. Serve.

title: Spiced Yoghurt Croutons
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain greek yogurt ( greek is best ) | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. In a large glass bowl, mix up the yoghurt with the fish sauce. Stir in the breadcrumbs last, so the crumbs don't get lumpy. Put onto a baking tray lined with baking paper and bake for 10 - 20 minutes until golden and crispy.

title: Ice Ring (Pago)
ingredients: 6 large ice cubes | 12 -16 spoons oetker oats
instructions: Dip each ice cube in the oats then into a bowl of melted oetker icing sugar.

title: Raspberry and Chutney Balls (R.L.D.A. Express Food)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups raspberries, washed, picked over and stemmed | 1/2 cup chutney, chopped, mild | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar
instructions: Place raspberries and chutney in a medium bowl. Gently stir in bread crumbs. Cover and chill at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Roll chilled raspberries and chutney mixture into 1 inch balls with the back of a fork, a shamrock shaped cookie scoop or an ice cream cone. Place balls about 3 inches apart on parchment paper lined baking sheets.. Bake 25 minutes, until golden. Makes 1 1/2 dozen balls.

title: Brown Rice Crisps
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice flour | 1 cup brown rice flour | 1 pound bamboo skewers, cut in half
instructions: Beat 1/2 cup rice flour together with the ground rice and bamboo skewers together in a bowl. Place 2 tablespoons into a miniature paper muffin tin so the measuring cup goes down to 1/2 inch up the sides. Microwave on medium for 1 minute. Remove and turn onto clean work surface. Cut each piece into 3 equal 3 triangles. Roll up and place on baking sheet with seam side down. Repeat with remaining batter and skewers. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before using so mixture can set up.

Random Ingredients: veal,brandy,red leaf lettuce,celery salt,taco seasoning mix
title: Veggie Tacos
ingredients: 1 package veal, cut into thin slices | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 tablespoons celery salt | 4 leaves red leaf lettuce, shredded into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add the veal and sprinkle with taco seasoning mix.

title: Chocolate Turkish Delight
ingredients: 1 package soy-free instant chocolate frosting | 1 can turkey broth, regular strength will do | 1/4 cup olive kalamata, pitted and roughly chopped | 1/4 cup soy sauce, regular strength will do
instructions: In a bowl combine the chocolate frosting, broth, kalamata olives and soy sauce. Whisk until smooth. Serve sprinkled with additional olive kalamata olives and soy sauce. Enjoy and stay cool.

title: Spicy Yogurt
ingredients: 2 cups low-fat yogurt | 1 teaspoon jalapeno pepper or 1 teaspoon other ground chile, plus more for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the container of a blender. Process until smooth. If you wish to serve this immediately, refrigerate for up to a day. Serve with pita crisps, cucumber sticks or fresh vegetables as an hors d'oeuvre if desired.

Random Ingredients: grapefruit juice,cannellini bean,meatball,turmeric,blueberry,cocoa powder,creamy peanut butter
title: Quick and Easy Mambo and Banana Mambo
ingredients: 250 g frozen sweet meatballs, thawed | 240 g creamy peanut butter | 500 g fresh blueberries | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons grapefruit juice | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 620 g cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Place the meatballs in your meat crock pot and set on medium. Blend the peanut butter, blueberries, cocoa powder, grapefruit juice, turmeric, beans, and half of the peanut butter mixture together and pour over the veggies on the crock pot. Start on low and cook 5 to 6 hours.

title: Cream Filling for Pierogi
ingredients: nonfat sour cream | 1 1/2 cups nonfat sour cream | 9 thin frozen nonfat sour creams
instructions: Mix sour cream and nonfat sour creme together and refrigerate for a minimum of 8 hours to allow flavors to blend. After sauce has been chilling, assemble the pierogi by placing the nonfat sour cream mixture in a mixing bowl, and working with a pastry cutter or a rolling pin. Cut the dough lengthwise and create a cross cut along one end of the dough. Fill the bowl with desired amount of filling and refrigerate. Roll out the dough until it is as thin as you can get it out of the refrigerator. Cut pieces of plastic wrap into 3 inch squares and dip each piece of plastic wrap into a cup or small bowl of the nonfat sour cream mixture to make a glue. Repeat with the remaining circles of plastic wrap, plastic, and sour cream mixture until all of the pierogi mixture is used.

title: Tomato Macaroni Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup ( not condensed ) | 5 cups chicken stock | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 16 ounces whole wheat pasta
instructions: In a large sauce pan combine soup, chicken stock and cardamom seeds. Bring to boil, stirring constantly. Simmer over low heat about 15 minutes. Meanwhile cook pasta according to package directions, drain and reserve pasta water. Ladle soup into a large serving bowl, place pasta and 2 3/4 cup of the reserved pasta water and toss lightly. Serve with additional tomato water and additional tomato juice if desired.

title: Pigs in Puff [puffs]
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh raspberries | 4 slices stale bread or 4 slices country bread, cubed | 8 slices smoked pork sausage | 1 english cucumber, thinly sliced for garnish | 6 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: In a small bowl, mix raspberries with the rye flour until smooth and creamy. Season with salt. Set aside. Place 1 slice of loaf on a pastry board and spread with about 1 teaspoon of pork sausage meat. Layer 1 slice of bread on top. Place 2 more slices of bread on top. Place more than half of the filling in the center. Fold the left and right side over the filling, covering completely. Roll into a long sausage shape and continue to fold in the sides and ends until the pastry leaves the work surface. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Place pastry on a serving platter. Garnish with cucumber slices and serve.

title: Homemade Soft-Boiled Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops | 1 1/2 teaspoons pickling salt | 1 can stewed tomatoes
instructions: Place pork chops, in small plastic bag, and sprinkle with salt. Let sit for 15 minutes, then remove from bag. Rinse bag, and add stewed tomatoes. Shake bag several times to distribute the tomatoes into the pork chops. Let stand, refrigerated, for 2 hours. Heat oven to 325 degrees f. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper. Place pork chops, fat side up, in roasting pan. Cover, and bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from oven, cover, and bake 35 minutes, basting occasionally with pan juices.

title: Wasabi Avocado Couscous
ingredients: 1/2 cup couscous | 1/4 cup light butter or 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste | 1/4 cup white wine, shavings | 1 lemon pepper, seeded, minced | 1 avocado, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Place couscous and butter in a medium mixing bowl. Stir and set aside. Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add wasabi and cook for 2 minutes. Add wine and pepper. Scrape wasabi butter mixture into the couscous. Cover and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. Serve garnished with avocado, if desired.

title: Indian Charred Asparagus & Dates
ingredients: 2 tablespoons masa harina | 1 cup dates, pitted & chopped | 8 fresh asparagus spears ( or 4 - 6 oz frozen spears, thawed and trimmed ) | 2 teaspoons coriander powder
instructions: Place the masa harina in a medium bowl. Stir in the dates.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,white wine vinegar,potato,saffron,bread flour,self raising flour,raisin
title: Nana's Bread & Butter Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup bread flour | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 -2 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 -2 pinch saffron | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) | cooked potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except potatoes. The dough should be of an even, moist consistency. If too dry to hold its shape, add an extra cup of water. Roll out onto a flat surface, about a 3/4 inch thick. Cook in the oven on a greased griddle, or griddle pan, or in a non stick saucepan, until golden on both sides. Serve hot, split and warm, or cold. This recipe will make enough to fill a large, straight sided dish that will go really well with just about any other pudding recipe.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,mozzarella cheese,white wine,rice,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cream mushroom soup,chicken stock,corn
title: Mozzarella Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rice | 1 1/4 cups chicken stock | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 cup corn ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, combine rice, stock and wine. Bring to a boil, stirring to cover. Reduce heat and simmer until stock is absorbed, about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add soup, cheese and corn.

title: Coconut (Bellissimo) - Veg
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley | 1 medium shallot | 1/2 green capsicum ( fresh or seeded if any ) | 400 g coconut, grated ( fresh or desiccated ) | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs, chopped ( or fresh mixed herbs ) | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs, chopped ( or fresh mixed herbs )
instructions: Use a pestle or blunt meat mallet until it makes small, even sized pieces about the size of a small walnut. Wash the shallots and capicum and remove the thick ends. Thoroughly combine all ingredients except coconut and herbs, and put them in a food processor/grinder. Process until smooth. Add coconut and herbs to food processor in a wie motion and blend until they form a smooth paste. Refrigerate for a minimum of 1 - 2 hours so flavors develop.

title: Roasted Parsnips and Parsnips
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut into wedges | 2 teaspoons fennel bulbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Combine yogurt and fennel in large bowl.

title: Hot German Style Apricot Sausages
ingredients: 1/4 cup bacon grease | 1 jar dried apricots, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped jalapeno peppers, or to taste
instructions: Melt the bacon grease in a skillet over medium heat. Add apricots and chilies.

title: Rhubarb and Potato Noodle Timpettine
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups diced peeled potatoes | 3 cups diced rhubarb | 14 1/2 ounces canned crushed tomatoes in puree | 7 ounces instant ramen noodles, crumbled | 2 egg yolks, beaten with | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: In bowl combine potatoes and rhubarb and toss to coat with juice. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Bring to simmer. Add tomatoes and noodle and simmer until rice grains are tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir 1 tbsp of hot mixture into egg mixture, til blended. Spoon into 8 x 8 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining hot mixture. Bake at 350 degrees f. For 20 minutes or until center is set.

title: Mama Zuquinis Oatyri Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces prosciutto, cut into large pieces | 2 quarts beef broth | 1 cup quinoa | 1/2 lime, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon oatmeal
instructions: Soak the prosciutto pieces in hot beef broth, just enough to cover. You can also do this in a saucepan, or fry them on the stovetop. Then place in a food processor along with the quinoa, lime zest and oatmeal. Set aside.

title: Cherry Shrimp With Chocolate and Strawfish
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs jumbo shrimp, in the shell and tails intact | 8 ounces tuna, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 ounces chocolate, broken into pieces | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon oil | 8 ounces fresh crunchfish, cut into chunks
instructions: Boil a small pan of water.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,beer,soymilk,bamboo skewer,baking soda,hoisin sauce,grain rice,tortilla
title: Bean Fried Macadamia Nut Patties
ingredients: 5 ounces soymilk | 1 cup short-grain rice | 1 cup soymilk | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup green enchilada sauce | 4 teaspoons beer or 4 teaspoons water | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 20 bamboo skewers, soaked in water to prevent sticking | 1/2 cup tortillas
instructions: Mix together the soy milk, rice, soymilk and chili sauce. Mix the baking soda in the green envelope sauce. Combine the baking soda and the soymilk mixture in a bowl until blended. Dip the soaked bamboo skewers into the dry milk mixture, drain. Bbq over medium high heat until browned, turning after about 5 minutes. Serve with the crunchy tortillas.

title: Pea and Scallop Tails
ingredients: 4 scallops | 1/4 lb chopped peas
instructions: Spray a grill basket or fry pan with cooking spray. Spray scallops with cooking spray and put into basket. Top with peas and grill. Enjoy.

title: Blueberry Blueberry Dip
ingredients: 1 cup blueberries | 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( or to your taste )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor and mix until smooth. Spoon into serving dish and refrigerate in an airtight jar for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,green cardamom pod,hot green chili pepper,pumpkin,greek yogurt
title: Kabob Pumpkin in Yogurt-Cottage Cheese Gravy With Green Peppers
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pumpkin ( preferably kabocha ) | 2 green bell peppers ( very ripe ) | 2 green chili peppers ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pod, crushed | 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt or 1/4 cup sour cream ( for garnish )
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot on medium heat. Cut the kabocha into small squares, about 2''. Place a piece of kabocha in the oil and fry until puffed up and golden, about 2 minutes. Take out and drain oil. Turn heat down to lowest setting, add red pepper, and saute' about 1 minute. Dice the kabocha and add to the skillet along with green pepper. Fry for a few minutes. Add the cardamom pods and stir with large spoon. Add yogurt, a pinch of crushed green cardamom pods, and a pinch of crushed green cardamom pods. Stir well. Adjust as needed. Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook until the kabocha is tender and the mixture thick, about 15 minutes or so. Enjoy.

title: Yellow Squash With Walnuts
ingredients: 4 lbs yellow squash, peeled | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 teaspoon crushed peppercorn
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthwise, remove seeds and stringy fibers, then cut into 3/4 inch segments. Combine remaining ingredients and place in a heavy large skillet. Cook over medium high heat for 8 to 10 minutes or just until the squash begins to soften.

title: Spicy Polish Sausage & Rice(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 package polish sausage, sliced thick ( i use hillshire farms ) | 2 cups dry white rice | 1 fresh hot red chili pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Cook and stir sausage in a large skillet over medium high heat until evenly browned, then drain. Add rice, sausage and chile and mix thoroughly. Continue to cook and stir until rice is done.

title: Amari Bruschetta (Bread Salad)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari ( see directions ) | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed, ground | 1 french bread, loaf, sliced into french's lengthwise slices
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl, including the bread slices. Toss to coat.

title: Moroccan Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 1 lb sweet chocolate, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/8 teaspoon dried italian spices
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 4 minutes. Note, i put a large lid, a piece of foil on top of it so it doesn't come loose and steam won't escape. If you want to add more of the chocolate it gets the hotter the mix gets so you have to keep your hands on the foil as you go. Leave in in the bowl to cool. It will store for at least 6 months in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,banana,golden rum,green onion,sun tomato,olive,fettuccine,chicken leg
title: Spanish Chicken With Portabella Mushrooms and Fettuccine
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, on the bone with thigh attached | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato | 2 tablespoons golden rum | sliced pitted ripe olives | 1/2 cup portabella mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup green onion, chopped | 12 ounces fettuccine, cooked | chopped green onion ( to garnish )
instructions: Using a sharp knife or kitchen shears, cut slits into the chicken legs.

title: Chicken Baked in Sauce & Stuff
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup margarine | 1 lb chicken pieces | 1 jar marinara sauce, with juice | 1 can chicken nuggets
instructions: Mix butter and half of the marinara in 13x9 dish. Add chicken with remaining marinara sauce, nuggets& toss until coated. Bake@ 350 until cooked about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,jerk seasoning,bacon dripping,mango chutney,couscous,ladyfinger
title: Jerk Couscous
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 jar mango chutney | 1 package crumbled cooked bacon drippings | 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 ounce jerk seasoning, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons jerk seasoning | 1 cup couscous, or as needed
instructions: Prepare a large skillet with oil and heat over medium heat. Stir in mango chutney and bacon drippings. Place ladyfingers in the skillet, and coat with jerk seasoning. Cook and stir until coated with skillet butter. Pour syrup over the ladyfingers, and cook 2 to 3 more minutes. Spread 1/2 teaspoon jerk seasoning, and 1 teaspoon of jerk seasoning over the top. Serve warm.

title: Greek Couscous
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat couscous | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/3 cup kalamata olives, sliced | 2/3 cup shredded celery
instructions: Spread couscous on a baking sheet or in a 9 x 13 inch pan. In a medium bowl, mix soup, olives, and celery until well blended. Pour mixture over couscous and gently toss to coat evenly. Garnish with a sprinkling of fresh mint.

title: Creamy Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 cups dried broad egg noodles | 5 cups cold water | 1 can tomato puree | 8 ounces pimientos, drained
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, bring 4 cups of water to boil. Add the egg noodles and return to heat. Cook and stir until they are tender, about 8 minutes. Stir in the tomato puree, 2 cups of the tomato soup, pimento slices and remaining soup. Heat until heated through and serve.

title: Red Lentil Salad and Tarragon Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup red lentil | 1/2 tablespoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon tarragon | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Rinse lentils in a colander under running water. Combine with vinegar, tarragon and toss with lettuce to combine. Serve with pita chips.

title: Black Slizz Cake Icing for Caramel Shakes (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1/2 lb icing sugar ( superfine icing sugar ) | freshly ground black rossley, to taste ( optional )
instructions: The good news is that when you’re using rossley in a pinch, it will turn out evenly fine, and will stain your clean up.

title: Tropical Potato Cakes With Clementine Slices
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh clementines, grated ( about 1/2 cup ) | 4 ounces red potatoes, peeled and coarsely grated ( about 1 cup, divided ) | 1/4 cup light cream of coconut | 2 large egg yolks, room temperature | 2 cups fresh cream or 2 cups coconut cream
instructions: In large bowl, toss together clementines or potatoes and 3/4 cup grated potatoes. In 4 quart heavy saucepan or 6 oz measuring cup, whisk together cream of coconut and egg yolks until blended. Add cream mixture, stir gently until mixture begins to thicken, do not boil. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened, 2 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: aubergine,almond paste,dark brown sugar,white wine,lemon peel,vodka,chive
title: Dansk Auberge Aubergines
ingredients: 25 aubergines | 500 ml dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup white wine | 125 ml lemon peel | 40 g almond paste | 15 g chives | 375 ml vodka, white or shaker
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Slice aubergines in half lengthways and remove the outer green skin, avoiding the bitter hard centre part. Carefully scoop out the flesh and reserve. Make the rum syrup. Heat the sugar, wine, lemon peel and almond paste in a saucepan. Bring to the boil and stir continuously until thick and syrupy. Add vinegar. Return aubergine flesh to the pot. Fill each cavity with rum syrup and place 2 teaspoon of rum mixture in each cavity, pressing the rum and pulp into the flesh of the aubergine. Place the stuffed aubergines in a pan with hot, lightly toasted coriander and simmer gently together with the lid on until the liquid caramelizes, approximately 25 minutes. Remove from heat and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,chuck roast,cornflour,farfalle pasta,lemon juice,broth,confectioner ' sugar,superfine sugar
title: Pasta Con Champinones
ingredients: 2 kg chuck roast, trimmed of all visible sinew | 100 g superfine sugar | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon cornflour or 1 tablespoon maize cornstarch | 3 fresh red chilies, cut into 1/2 cm slices ( optional ) | 4 cups of your favourite steamed conchigliette ( conchigliette, bow tie ) | 1/4 cup chicken stock or 1/4 cup beef stock | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, for dusting | 400 g farfalle pasta ( bow tie, spaghetti etc ) or 400 g penne pasta, of choice
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c and grease your roasting tin with a little oil. Place roast in roasting tin and coat the outside with a little cornflour or maize cornstarch. Cover and cook in oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until browned all over. To make sauce, place sugar and chillies in a small saucepan and cook slowly, stirring, for 3 to 4 minutes or until softened and golden. Stir through the lemon juice and bring to the boil. Set aside. Boil a pan of water and cook pasta according to package instructions. Meanwhile, put the steamed conchigliette in and cook over very low heat for 6 to 8 minutes or until tender, but firm. Drain well and return pasta to pan. Stir in remaining cornflour or maize cornstarch and stock and allow to simmer slightly. Pour sauce on top and mix very well. Place the roast on top and dust with confectioners' sugar. Serve immediately.

title: Papa Boy's Polish Mojito
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces vanilla flavored vodka | 1 dash cayenne pepper, or to taste | 3 ounces mozzarella balls, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions:

 Run your thumb along the top of the glass to loosen and remove the sticky vodka residue from the rim of the glass. Add cayenne pepper to taste. Sprinkle shredded mozzarella evenly across the top of the cheese and top off with a piece of mozzarella. Serve with straws to dip.

title: Ginger Almond Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 1 1/2 cups fish stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Toast almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside to cool. Place fish stock, ginger garlic paste, and almonds in a medium pot, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, stirring frequently, until mixture is reduced. Pour the mixture into a bowl, and stir in additional fish stock, if desired, to make a thick soup. Serve warm with confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,rice paper,salt pork,cream chicken soup,apple juice,ham hock,ramen noodle,garlic
title: Sliced Ham Hock on Paper
ingredients: 1 ham hock | 1/2 teaspoon salt pork ( or turkey ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup rice paper, cut into 3 x 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 4 -6 rolls, cut in half ( i use a sandwich buns )
instructions: Wash ham hock, remove meat from bones and cut into 3 x 1 inch pieces. Peal and slice the ham into thin 1 inch pieces. Place ham, salt pork, garlic and apple juice in medium skillet. Stir in soup. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 40 - 45 minutes. Remove ham hock to a container. Wrap each roll in a piece of ham and microwave on high about 3 minutes. To serve, arrange on a platter and pour soup over. Place buns around meat and serve. If this is too salty, add a little water to make sure it doesn't dry out.

title: Vanilla Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta, spaghetti, cavata ( preferably with a good quality ) | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 cup canola oil, such as sunflower
instructions: Fill a large pot with water, add the pasta and stir. Place the half vanilla bean in the pot, open it up and scrape the inside. It should be the scent of the vanilla bean. Turn the heat to high. When the water comes to a boil, add the pasta, vanilla bean and the canola oil. Stir as you are cooking the pasta, breaking the pasta as desired. When the water comes to a simmer, stir once, remove the vanilla bean and discard. When the pasta is cooked but still very firm to your liking, drain the pasta, but do not rinse it. Toss the pasta with the sauce. Serve cold, or warm, or at room temperature.

title: Faux-Sunny Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 lb clams, well scrubbed | 2 teaspoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Fill a large saucepan 1/3 full with water, add the clams and enough cold water to cover the clams. Bring to the boil over medium heat, turn down heat and simmer until the clams open up, about 5 - 7 minutes. Discard any clams that do not open. Remove the clams with some of the water that has collected in the saucepan. Discard any unopened clams. Strain the cooking liquid through a fine mesh sieve into a medium saucepan. Discard any remaining clam shells. Combine the sun dried tomatoes and cold water. Bring to the boil over medium heat. Add the cleaned clams and the sun dried tomato oil. Return to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer until the clams open, about 5 minutes. Season and serve immediately. If you can only find clams that do not open, use fresh ones. If not, use canned clams.

title: Beef and Vegetables (With Cremini Mushrooms and Cornflour
ingredients: 2 lbs beef round roast or 2 lbs blade roast | 10 cremini mushrooms, thickly sliced | 1 bag yellow squash, chopped | 1 jar fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped | 1/2 cup flour | 4 cups water
instructions: Trim fat from beef and cut into chunks. Add to crockpot. Add next eight ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Thicken with cornflour mixture. Serve on hoagie rolls.

title: Peppered Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 beef consomme or 1 beef base | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 small yellow pepper, seeded and quartered
instructions: Place the beef in the crock pot. Add the consomme and fish sauce. Add the potatoes, placing the pepper in the center. Cover the crock pot and cook on high for 3 hours. Turn the control to high for 30 - 45 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the beef has cooked to the desired texture.

title: Quick Mexican Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 bag frozen beans | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 3/4 cup marsala wine
instructions: Place bag of frozen beans and tomato soup in crockpot. Mix well, cover and cook on low for 7 - 10 hours. The longer you cook the soup, the better it becomes. Serve over tortillas, rice or pasta.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,button mushroom,crisp bacon,peanut butter,self rising flour,italian parsley,thyme sprig
title: Peanut Butter Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 large button mushrooms | 2 slices crisp bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 5 teaspoons peanut butter, smooth ( i use unsalted ) | 2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove mushroom stems from underside of mushrooms. Remove gills from inside of mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,cottage cheese,bacon,chili pepper flake,red food coloring
title: Cheesy Cottage Cheese Balls
ingredients: 2 lbs cottage cheese | 1 cup bacon, chopped or 1 cup margarine | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes or 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring, if desired
instructions: In large bowl crumble cheese or margarine. Gently mix together with other ingredients. Roll into small balls the size of an egg. Heat frying pan on medium high. Add little oil if necessary. Brown lightly on outside, flip. You will have to cook them one or two at a time so that they do not burn. Drain on paper towels. Can be reheated or frozen. Keep in airtight container for up to 1 week.

title: French Herbed Focaccia
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried grated parmesan cheese | 2 cups shredded lettuce | 1 can sliced green chilies, undrained
instructions: In 4 qt bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,canadian bacon,butter,baby clam,adobo sauce
title: Clams With Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 4 tablespoons salted butter | 1/4 lb canadian bacon | 1 can baby clams | 5 tablespoons chopped pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce, from can of baby clams
instructions: In a heavy skillet melt butter. Add bacon and cook over medium heat until cooked, about 5 minutes. Add clams and romano and bring to a boil. Cook 3 minutes until clam shells open. Pour clam juice into skillet with bacon and stir. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,salt pepper,white vinegar,sourdough bread,pork,asiago cheese,plain flour
title: Mexican Pork Sandwich on a Bed of Sourdough Crust
ingredients: 8 ounces ground pork | 4 teaspoons grated asiago cheese | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon mexican blend cheese | salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar | 8 slices sourdough bread
instructions: Mix the pork, cheese, flour, salt, pepper, cheese and vinegar in a bowl, adding the asiago, if using. Divide the mixture into 8 equal portions and roll each into a sausage shape similar to a bun. Place on a greased baking sheet and bake in a moderately hot oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Italian Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon dried sage ( or 1 teaspoon sage leaves ) | 1 egg white | 1/4 teaspoon italian spices, dried
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Store in a sealed glass jar in the sun, the longer the time it sets the more the flavors will meld.

Random Ingredients: green olive,stewing beef,saffron thread,pepperoni,egg white,italian bread,half,thyme sprig
title: Meatballs Sicilian style
ingredients: 4 lbs lean stewing beef | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 1/2 cup all-purpose greek feta cheese | 1 egg white | 1/2 cup half-and-half | fresh thyme sprig, for garnish | 1/4 cup sliced green olives | 8 pepperoni, slices sliced into 8 pcs
instructions: In a large bowl mix beef with crushed saffron threads, 1/2 teaspoon coarse salt and half and half. Cover bowl and refrigerate for 12 hours. To make the meatballs, in a small bowl beat egg white and egg white in a small dish until foamy. Stir in remaining ingredients. Roll the mixture into 12 meatballs. Place on waxed paper and chill. Refrigerate meatballs in 1 hour. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Grill meatballs for 30 - 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,purpose flour,mango chutney,dark brown sugar,rice noodle,sesame oil,pepper
title: Baked Noodles With a Mango Chutney Corn
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas, cut into 4- 5 inch squares ( fresh, frozen or purchased ) | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 6 ounces rice noodles ( approx. 12 ounces ) | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Place 1 tortilla square on cookie sheet. Combine flour and pepper in a mixing bowl and toss in remaining tortilla squares until coated. Spray an 8x8x2 baking dish with nonstick spray. Place 1/2 noodle squares on baking sheet with wax paper between the wax paper. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup mango chutney. Coat noodles with flour and corn mixture and bake for 8 minutes. Remove from oven and spread with remaining chutney and brown sugar. Return to oven and bake an additional 5 minutes or until bubbly. Cool 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,salt black pepper,margarita mix,spiral pasta
title: Cheater's Easy Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 lb pasta ( or one 10 ounce package or one 8.8-ounce package other dried pasta ) | 1/2 cup margarita mix | 2/3 cup whipping cream ( i use cream frake ) | salt and black pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Bake or boil the pasta as directed on the box. Drain. In a 9 x 13 inch dish or pan mix pasta and margarita mix. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. If desired, stir in a few spoonfuls of whipping cream. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove dish from refrigerator 1 hour before baking.

title: Tabil
ingredients: 2 carrots, peeled and diced into small cubes | 2 cups vegetable juice | 1 cup sweet cooked dates, chopped fine | 1 package roasted red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: Place all ingredients into a slow cooker. Stir well and let simmer on low 4 hours. Add more crushed red peppers if you would like more spice and enjoy. This goes great with steamed jasmine rice.

title: Pesto Chilies
ingredients: 15 -20 small green chilies ( red anaheim, or your choice of jalapeno ) | 2 -3 tablespoons smooth pesto sauce, use fresh | 1 1/2 cups good quality chili sauce ( can use commercial or homemade )
instructions: Peel, devein, and roughly chop the green chilies. In a food processor, combine the pesto and chillies, pour in the chilies. You can stir by hand if needed. Pour the sweet chili sauce over the top just before serving.

title: Chilean Red Beans
ingredients: 1 lb red beans, in | 1 bunch leek, trimmed | 2/3 cup white vinegar
instructions: Trim ends off leeks. Cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch pieces. Steam beans over medium high heat 5 minutes. Add cooked leeks. Cover and steam undisturbed 5 minutes or until beans are bright red and most of the liquid has evaporated.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,kielbasa,chinese vegetable,self raising flour,coffee liqueur
title: Boiled Breakfast Kielbasa
ingredients: 600 g kielbasa, sliced | 1 cup hot chocolate or 1 cup irish breakfast liqueur | 300 g self raising flour | 4 cardamom seeds | 1/2 cup coffee-flavoured liqueur
instructions: Place sliced kielbasa on plate. Cut chillies in half and put slices on top of kielbasa. Mix the coffee and liqueur together in a small saucepan and heat until just warm. Combine sifted flour, cardamom and coffee mix. Pour over the kielbasa, sprinkle with chillies and bake in moderately hot oven for 30 minutes or until cooked and golden on top.

title: Pasta With Avacado and Strawberry (Farfalle Con Avocado)
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons dry yeast | 1 pint fresh tomato passata | 1 pint arugula or 1 pint spinach, washed and well drained | 1 bunch fresh strawberries | 4 ounces tuna, cooked | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 1/4 lb farfalle pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Dry the tomatoes in a frying pan with the oil. Put the passata in a pan with the olives and the dried yeast. Cook the mixture in a little water, stirring often and adding only enough water to prevent the mixture drying out. Drain the arugula and spinach and leave to cool. Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling water. Drain the tuna, mix with the arugula, tomatoes and pasta. Add the orange juice to warm through and divide between plates.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,malt vinegar,pumpkin seed,coriander powder,great northern bean
title: Pumpkin Seed Fritters (Cookies)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried great northern beans, boiled until tender | 3/4 cup pumpkin seeds, raw | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon malt vinegar | 2 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Combine beans and pumpkin seeds in a large bowl. Heat the dry ingredients and vinegar to boiling point. Pour into dry ingredients, stir to combine and knead until smooth and pliable. Add more water if necessary. Roll 1 teaspoonfuls of the mixture into balls and press to flatten slightly. Place on an oiled baking tray, cover and put in a cold oven. Leave to cool completely. These fritters can be frozen.

Random Ingredients: cherry,thyme sprig,chili paste,tomato juice,manchego cheese,miracle whip,fennel seed
title: Chilli Dip
ingredients: 1/4 lb manchego cheese | 4 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste | 1/4 cup miracle whip | 2 tablespoons tomato juice
instructions: Slice the cheese into 1/4 cubes. Place in a medium bowl. Wash and chop the cherry tomatoes. Sauté the fennel seed, thyme and chilli in oil about 2 minutes. Place cherry tomatoes and par boiled tomatoes in a blender or food processor. Blend and then add the remaining ingredients. Cover and chill at least 6 hours or overnight. Serve with crackers for dipping.

Random Ingredients: margarita mix,yukon gold potato,pear,red curry paste,lettuce
title: Curried Lettuce
ingredients: 1/4 cup margarita mix | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled cut into 1/4-inch thick slices | 1 lettuce, washed separated | 1 pear, peeled, cored and sliced thin
instructions: Prepare the margarita spice packet as per package directions, using the curry paste. Arrange potato slices on a foil lined baking sheet. Brush with curry paste and sprinkle with potato slices. Bake in a 425 f oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until the potato slices are tender. Remove from oven and toss with lettuce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,marshmallow,bean,puff pastry,dark sesame oil,chicken bouillon granule,raspberry
title: Black Eyed Peas, Filling and Filling Pie
ingredients: 1/4 cup frozen black-eyed peas | 1/4 cup frozen puff pastry | 1/2 cup marshmallows ( or 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules ( or use 1 tsp. instant chicken broth ) | 1/4 cup thawed frozen raspberries or 1/4 cup strawberry, divided | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules ( or use 1 tsp. ground chicken broth )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. If the peas are thawed and cooled completely, cut them into 1/4 inch dice or coarsely chop them. If using frozen black eyed peas put them in a microwavable bowl with just enough room for them to defrost and defrost. Place the puff pastry in a small baking dish lined with parchment paper. Put the marshmallows, 1 teaspoon of the bouillon granules and 1 teaspoon sesame oil in a small fry pan. Cook over medium heat on a low flame, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the black eyed peas and the raspberries, stir to mix. Remove from the heat and set aside. Spoon the pepper mixture into the pastry, filling almost to the top of the pastry crust. Cover with the remaining pastry pastry crust, and brush liberally with sesame oil. Bake for 40 - 50 minutes until golden brown.

title: Chile-Rolled Beef
ingredients: 1 lb round steaks, 1/2 inch thick | 6 sheets rice paper ( about 5 inches wide ) | 2 cans whole dried chiles, undrained | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Place steaks in a 12 by 13 inch baking dish. Combine chiles and vinegar in a small bowl. Brush both sides of each steak with vinegar mixture then place in dish. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate for at least 3 hours. Preheat oven to 500°. Remove steaks from marinade and place on a metal rack set in a shallow roasting pan. Roast until meat thermometer inserted in center of meat registers 140° about 15 minutes, turning frequently. Transfer steak to serving platter. Skim fat from sauce. Slice meat thinly across the grain. Serve on a platter. Spoon sauce around steak.

title: Cajun-Spiced Cranberry Muesli
ingredients: 3/4 cup oat bran | 4 cups whole milk | 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 3/4 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: In a large heavy bottomed saucepan, combine the oat bran and milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it comes to a boil. Lower heat and simmer, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon, until most of the liquid has evaporated and the liquid is thickened and syrupy, approximately 3 minutes. Stir in the pineapple juice, mint, cajun seasoning and thyme. Turn off the heat. Scoop half of mixture into a well seasoned mini muffin tin. Bake in the 350 degree oven until evenly browned, and no longer sticky inside, about 10 minutes.

title: Penne With Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta, uncooked
instructions: Cook or pasta according to package directions. When pasta is tender, drain, and add fish sauce. Stir to combine over low heat until well mixed and heated through. You can also pour sauce over the pasta as you add it.

title: Crostini
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled | 2 teaspoons butter or margarine, divided | 2 tablespoons brandy, divided | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Grate peeled potato on peeled potato and set aside. Place about 1/4 teaspoon salt onto a plate.

title: Roasted Grilled Peaches and Kale
ingredients: 12 ounces kale, chopped | 2 red bell peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons greek olives | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 medium pear, chopped
instructions: Preheat grill. Combine kale, red pepper, olives, and sweet chili sauce in a large bowl. Toss until well blended. Spoon mixture onto a platter and scatter pear around it. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,thyme leaf,rom tomato,parmesan cheese,monterey jack pepper cheese,cumin powder
title: Chunky White Sauce for Lasagna
ingredients: 100 ml chicken stock cubes or 100 ml vegetable stock | 1 roma tomato, halved | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 40 g parmesan cheese, finely grated | 1 tablespoon freshly grated romano cheese
instructions: Place your stock cubes into a pan with a lid, and bring to the boil. Once you can see the oil sizzling across the bottom of the pan, give it a few stirrings so that there are no more visible pieces of stock. Turn down your heat to a simmer and drop in your tomatoes. Leave for a few minutes stirring occasionally to make sure they are all coated in the stock. Add the cumin, thyme and half of the parmesan. Continue to simmer over a low medium until the tomatoes are really tender and the sauce is thick and creamy, stirring frequently to prevent burning. Take off the heat and stir in the romano cheese. Spoon onto your favourite white meat and top with the rest of the parmesan cheese. This dish can now be frozen and reheated up to 45 min in the microwave, or you can refrigerate for up to 1 week prior to serving the lasagna.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,leaf lettuce,pearl onion,yogurt,red snapper,broth,snow pea,spring onion
title: Quick Red Snapper With Snow Peas (Shui Roka Mushi)
ingredients: 4 dried red snapper, cleaned | 1 -2 cup stock ( i've also used chicken stock for flavor, but i think that will be different ) or 1 -2 cup broth ( i've also added chicken stock for flavor, but that will be different ) | 1 teaspoon dried ancho or 1 teaspoon pure vanilla bean | 6 spring onions, cut into 1 inch segments ( optional ) | 2 cloves peeled garlic, crushed and chopped | 24 snow peas ( optional ) | 1/2 cup plain yogurt ( optional ) | 2 cups shredded spring onions | 1 head coarsely bunches torn romaine lettuce or 1 head green leaf lettuce
instructions: Bring the stock to boil. Place the snapper whole in the pressure cooker. Pour in enough stock to cover the snapper. Add the dried bean, green onion and garlic. Cover and bring to high pressure over high heat. Reduce heat to minimum. Cook for 5 minutes and then remove from stove. Leave fish in the cooker and keep warm. Remove the fish from the cooker and place on a serving platter with the reserved liquid. Make slits in the fish for presentation and serve the fish with the garnishes. Warm the slits before serving, so they don`t burn when reheating.

title: Shrimp and Bean Chili
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 16 ounces can kidney beans, drained | 1 beef brisket | 1/4 cup simple syrup, plus additional | simple syrup
instructions: Trim fat from brisket. Place brisket in large roasting pan. Strain beans into large bowl.

Random Ingredients: port wine,lime,caraway seed,parsley,pizza crust,virgin olive oil,wheat tortilla
title: Pizzas With Port Wine and Lime Wedge
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground caraway seed | 2 tablespoons sliced fresh parsley | 1 -2 teaspoon lime | 1/2 cup port wine, such as sauvignon blanc | 4 whole wheat tortillas, cut into 4 wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees. Remove the crust from the pizza pan. Brush with the olive oil. Sprinkle with the caraway seeds. Top with parsley and sprinkle with the lime. Arrange tortilla wedges around the pizzas. Replace the pan with 1/4 cup of the port wine. Bake 10 - 15 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbling. Cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,pickling salt,msg,roast beef,egg noodle,egg wrapper
title: Hors d'oeuvre
ingredients: 1 pound beef chuck, thinly sliced | 3 quarts beef bones ( bouquet garni ) | 1 package egg noodles | 1 egg roll wrapper | 2 teaspoons hot pickling salt | 1 teaspoon msg
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Heat 1/2 inch oil in a dutch oven. Brown meat in batches, about 10 minutes remove and reserve juices. Add beef juice to dutch oven and add bones and noodles to cover. Cover and bake 5 hours. In a small pot, wrap egg rolls in foil. Seal and heat on 350 degrees f for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,orange marmalade,greek yogurt,kiwi fruit,jumbo shrimp
title: Jamaican Shrimp & Kiwifruit Kabobs With Marmalade Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs jumbo shrimp, peeled deveined | 1 large yellow squash, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices ( halved lengthwise and seeded ) | 1 kiwi fruit, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup plain greek yogurt or 1 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1/2 cup orange marmalade
instructions: Thread shrimp onto skewers, leaving tail and back attached at one end on the shrimp. Set shrimp on lightly oiled rack in broiler pan or large shallow baking dish. Broil in a 400 degree f oven for 10 - 12 minutes until shrimp are opaque in center, turning once to brown evenly. Meanwhile, remove peel and seeds from squash and kiwifruit. Whisk yoghurt and marmalade together in large bowl until well blended. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Brush yogurt sauce on shrimp and top with marmalade and serve.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper sauce,monterey jack pepper cheese,fennel seed,cayenne powder,lime,yellow cake mix
title: Cheese Twirls (South Beach Diet Version)
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 1/2 teaspoons cayenne pepper sauce | 2 teaspoons cayenne powder | 3/4 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon lime | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lime
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Prepare cake mix according to package directions, using 1 tsp of fennel seeds. Spread on parchment or sprayed baking sheets. Sprinkle 1/2 tsp of cayenne pepper sauce over the mixture. Top with monterey jack cheese and stir until just melted, but not melted. Spread lime juice over cheese. Bake 25 minutes. Cool, cut into squares and enjoy. This recipe can be frozen when partially frozen. Allow to thaw in refrigerator overnight and reheat before serving.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,accent seasoning,peri,puff pastry,lemon juice zest
title: Pineapple Accent Tart With Filling from Tasty Tart Pastries!
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning | 4 sheets puff pastry | 3/4 cup pineapple juice, warmed | 1 -2 tablespoon lemon juice ( depending on your taste and personal preference ) | 1 small lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Roll the pastry sheets into rectangles and set aside. Place pineapple juice, lemon peel and juice, and accent seasoning in a small bowl. Beat until blended.. Cut into 4 equal strips. Press one strip into the bottom of a small tartlet tin and lightly prick with a fork. Lightly brush the pastry with the infused pineapple juice and sprinkle with the remaining strips of accent. Bake at 180c for about 30 minutes or until the pastry is golden. Serve warm.

title: Roasted Hazelnuts
ingredients: 4 hazelnuts, toasted and peeled | 6 fluid ounces chicken broth or 6 fluid ounces homemade chicken stock | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Drain the hazelnuts and place in a small, dry ovenproof dish. Combine the stock with the oil. Pour this over the hazelnuts and roast at 350 degrees farenheit for 1 hour or until tender. Cool and then transfer the hazelnuts to a jar and keep refrigerated.

title: Citrus Ribs and Chard
ingredients: 3 lbs country-style pork ribs | 1 cup orange juice or 1 cup lemon juice | 2 cups dried currants
instructions: Wash the ribs and remove any excess fat. Place in a dutch oven or stockpot, cover with 4 cups water and the orange juice. Put the lid on and simmer slowly over medium heat for 1 hour. Drain off any fat remaining in the pan. Meanwhile, toast the currants in a 375 degree oven for 20 minutes. When the ribs are tender, slice into serving sized pieces. Place on a serving platter and cover with the chard leaves. Pour the cooking juices from the dutch oven into a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Then add the currants. Simmer until the chard is just tender. Arrange the ribs between 2 warm plates. If you wish, serve with the cooking juices.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,vital wheat gluten,ice,french baguette,bread,extra virgin olive oil,nonfat cottage cheese,curry paste
title: Indian Bread Pizza With Coconut Flavoured Korma Filling
ingredients: 1 5/8 ounces active dry yeast | 1 cup bread, day old-fashioned | 4 1/2 teaspoons curry paste ( indian curry or indian style ) | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 carton nonfat cottage cheese | 2 cups sliced unpeeled crusty french baguettes | 1 3/4 cups extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/4 cups vital wheat gluten, gluten or 1 1/4 cups arrowroot or 1 1/4 cups gluten ( or use your favourite gluten ) | 1 package ice
instructions: Make sponge in a small bowl, stir in yeast. Let sit till foamy. In a large bowl, mix together bread, curry paste, and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Pour bread mixture into a large, non stick skillet and warm over low heat. Stir bread occasionally and sprinkle flour on top. When the batter comes to a bubble, stir often enough to avoid burning. When it is bubbling vigorously, reduce heat and let stand approx. 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. While batter is cooking, form bread mixture into 12 patties. Coat bread pockets with vegetable or canola oil and lightly flour tops. Place on a baking sheet and bake until patties are golden brown on both sides and cooked through. Let cool. For the korma filling, remove crusts from baguettes. Place both patties on a pizza pan or cookie sheet. Brush with olive oil and bake on high. When patties are brown, brush with remaining olive oil and place toppings in order.

Random Ingredients: white bean,lamb,green olive,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Bean and Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup white beans, drained and rinsed ( about 1 pound ) | 6 ounces ground lamb | 1/4 cup sliced pimento stuffed green olives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 13 x9 x 2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place the beans in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Asparagus Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 8 asparagus spears, trimmed | 2 tablespoons corn oil, or more if needed | 2 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Place a steamer insert into a saucepan and fill with water to just below the bottom of the steamer. Bring water to a boil and immediately remove from heat. Place Asparagus spears into steamer, cover, and steam until tender, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Smoothie
ingredients: 500 g unsalted whole hazelnuts | 50 g unsalted peanuts | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place hazelnuts on baking tray and roast in oven at 200c for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Fettuccine with Tomatoes & Fettuccine Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb firm ripe tomatoes, thinly sliced | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup crumbled fettuccine | 2 teaspoons minced seeded fresh tomato
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Add the tomatoes, and cook, stirring, until heated through, about 3 minutes. Sprinkle with cayenne and fresh tomato. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sake,breadcrumb,hash brown potato,beef tenderloin,egg noodle,coconut extract,chow mein noodle,ice
title: Budget Beef and Potato Kebobs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch chunks | 5 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup light coconut flavored breadcrumbs | 1 lb frozen hash brown potatoes, cooked and drained | 1 bottle chow mein noodles | 4 sheets chow mein noodles | 2 cups rice-style breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine beef, eggs and coconut in large bowl. Toss well. Add potatoes and breadcrumbs.

title: Spinach Noodles With Strawberries, Strawberry and Olive Oil
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb noodle, thin style | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil | 1/3 cup fresh marjoram, minced or 1/3 cup fresh oregano, minced | 2 cups fresh strawberries, sliced or 2 cups thawed frozen strawberries, well drained | 1 -2 cup mixed greens ( i like romaine, spinach, kale, and red cabbage )
instructions: Put a pot of water on to boil over medium heat. Prepare the noodles as per the package directions. Drain well and set aside.. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Place cooked noodles in the skillet and toss to coat well. Season with pepper. Arrangement the noodles, if desired. Pour olive oil over noodles and toss to coat well. Sprinkle with basil and oregano. Top the noodles with strawberries, tossing gently to coat. Remove from heat when the noodles are just tender.

title: Stewed Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg stewing beef | 1 kg roma tomato, quartered
instructions: Cut roma tomatoes in half and scoop out seeds. Remove any excess juice.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,louisiana sauce,mirin,cotija cheese,edible flower,couscous,plum sauce,roasting chicken
title: Crumbled Chicken With Lemon and Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens, quartered | 3 cups mixed frozen salad-colored vegetables, thawed or 1 3/4 cups mixed frozen vegetables | 3/4 cup asiago cheese | 3/4 cup pomodoro cheese | 3 tablespoons mirin | 3 tablespoons light teriyaki sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons emeril's original sauce | 7 1/2 fluid ounces plum sauce or 7 1/2 fluid ounces tomato sauce | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh edible flower, such as rose petal, dasheen or 1/4 cup chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f arrange chicken pieces in a large roasting pan.

title: Crock Pot Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 lbs mushrooms, fresh, sliced, stems removed | 1 cup grated gruyere cheese ( about 2 ounces )
instructions: Spray crock pot with non stick cooking spray. Add mushrooms, cheese and salt to taste. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high 2 to 4 hours. Stir while warm. Spoon mixture into ovenproof bowls and broil, 3 to 4 inches from heat, 4 to 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Indian Redcurrant Jelly
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee | 6 cups red currant jelly | 5 teaspoons fennel seeds
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large pot over medium heat. When the ghee has melted, add the fennel seeds. When the seeds begin to sizzle, stir in the red currant jelly. Reduce heat to simmer and continue to simmer, uncovered, until the jelly has reduced and thickened slightly and is syrupy and reduced to about 1 1/2 cups. Stir occasionally and add extra water as needed.

title: Apricot-Coconut-Hijeradish Custard
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned unsweetened coconut milk or 1 1/2 cups unsweetened coconut milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons apricot jam or 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 1/2 teaspoons jeera powder or 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 large eggs | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried szeera powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Butter a 2 quart casserole dish. Place coconut milk or coconut milk in pan of boiling water. Boil for 2 minutes. Remove pan from heat. Stir in molasses, jam, horseradish, and dissolved salt. Beat eggs in large bowl.

title: Rosti With Arugula
ingredients: 1 cup arugula | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 teaspoon rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Blend the arugula and seasonings in a food processor until well blended. Taste and adjust seasonings.

title: Apple Jack Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 6 -8 medium tart apples | 1 1/2 - 2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese ( to taste ) or 1 1/2-2 cups swiss cheese ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Grease cookie sheets. Using the tips of your fingers or the tip of a paring knife, gently peel the apples from the peel. Discard any thick or small areas, such as the bottom. Cut the apples in half. Place the halves cut side down in a large, shallow but uniform baking dish or pie plate. Sprinkle with pepper jack cheese. Bake until the cheese melts or has melted slightly.

title: Apple Steaks
ingredients: one inch cube ice cream, softened | one inch cube triple-frozen beef tips and freeze | 1 cup chopped apple | 1 tablespoon celery rib, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in freezer.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,artichoke heart,bay leaf,kalamata olive,chili paste
title: Artichoke and Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 2 cans kalamata olives, drained and chopped | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Wash rice noodles in a colander for 1 minute they should not be able to stick together. Place in a bowl of cold water. Set aside. Drain artichoke hearts reserving liquid and pat dry. Place artichoke hearts in a large skillet and add oil, chili paste and olive liquid. Drain excess liquid and lightly fry noodles until done. Add artichoke hearts, and saute approximately 3 minutes. Transfer noodles to a large plate. Top with artichoke mixture and garnish with olives.

title: Black Olive and Snow Pea Tea Bread
ingredients: 8 ounces bread cubes | 7 ounces sliced black olives | 14 ounces sliced black olives | 3/4 cup strong black tea, chilled
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325c. Place bread in the oven. Turn bread after 5 - 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,egg white,mini chocolate chip,hot water,cilantro leaf
title: Pork Empanadas (Pecan Empanadas)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin roast ( about 3 ) | 1 egg white | 1/4 cup hot water | 12 mini semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon minced fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Put pork in a large zipper top bag. Using a fork, prick all over the pork meat. Insert a meat thermometer, cutting off any extra fat. Beat egg white, water, and remaining 1 teaspoon salt with a wire whisk. Pour egg mixture into pork mixture, and press mixture into a ball. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or longer. Preheat oven to 400°f. Drain pork meat, and reserve liquid. Wrap each empanada in foil tightly, fold ends back over, and set on rimmed baking sheet. Using a slotted spoon, transfer meat mixture to a large baking sheet. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until meat thermometer reads 170°f. Meanwhile, melt chocolates in a medium bowl over simmering water. Using a wooden spoon, spread about 1/4 cup chocolese mixture onto each empanada to cover. Sprinkle with cilantro, and serve.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,porcini mushroom,bouillon cube,daikon radish,almond flour,prune
title: Daikon Navidad-Yaki Na'an (Filled Dumplings in Mushroom Sauce)
ingredients: 1 cup apricot preserves | 2 garlic cloves | 1 bouillon cube | 1/4 cup blanched almond flour, sifted | 5 ounces sliced prunes | 1 1/2 cups sliced daikon radishes | 1/2 cup prune
instructions: Melt apricot preserves in a bowl in the microwave. Mince garlic. Add garlic, a bouillon cube and almond flour to marinade and mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover and cook 15 minutes. Take off stove and stir until sauce thickens. Add fruit and stir to combine all. Put sauce on your serving dish and garnish with sesame seeds and hard boiled egg.

title: Quick and Easy Tasty Cucumber and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 cup cucumber, peeled, diced | 1 cup shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon fresh dill weed, chopped
instructions: Pinch off 1/3 inch ragged ragged piece of ziploc. Place cucumber on ziploc and fold in half and squeeze out excess air. Scoop out cucumber using a spoon to remove excess moisture from the shiitake mushrooms. Place cucumber and shiitake mushrooms on cutting board and slice off the dark green part with some white part about 1/8 inch thick. Place mushrooms on cutting board with a spatula and press a soft, dry shiitake mushroom lightly on each piece. Gather up the ragged ragged bits of ziploc, squeeze this onto the mushrooms, sprinkle with dill weed, toss well or just eat it while your guests are enjoying their meal.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash With Parsley Puree
ingredients: 2 large butternut squash, seeded, halved lengthwise, seeded, and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 3 pounds ) | 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup vegan margarine | 1 sprig italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray a 2 inch loaf pan with nonstick spray. Arrange squash in pan. Combine remaining ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth. Pour squash mixture into pan. Bake in middle of oven until squash is tender and center is just beginning to turn golden, about 35 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit 5 minutes. Scoop squash out with a large fork or spoon.

title: Pumpkin Con Brodo
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1 loaf italian bread, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1 bunch fresh cranberries, stems removed | 3 whole cloves
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pinto beans and mash with a potato masher or two fork, until beans are a coarse puree. In a bowl combine cornmeal and bread cubes. Add to soup and stir until cornmeal is melted and bread and soup are combined. Cook until bread and soup are heated through.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,cheese ravioli,red curry paste,greek yogurt,kielbasa
title: Delicious Sausage & Kielbasa Ravioli
ingredients: 1 package frozen cheese ravioli ( or any other type of pasta you like ) | 1 -2 lb kielbasa ( or other spicy sausage ) | 1 container fat free greek yogurt ( or fat free sour cream ) | 2 teaspoons red curry paste ( more to taste ) | 1 -2 cup shredded reduced fat tasty cheese ( or more to taste )
instructions: Boil water, salt generously & add ravioli. Drain, rinse & set out to cool while you do the rest. Slice or shred kielbasa into 1/4 inch wide strips, about 2 inches long. Preparation time, while ravioli is cooking, heat oven to 350f, in a 9x13 casserole dish, pour about 3/4 cup of yogurt into a small bowl & coat the bottom with the red curry paste, set aside. Place a layer of the ravioli in casserole dish, & sprinkle generously with cheese. Place another layer of ravioli and repeat layers of ravioli & cheese till all ingredients have been used, finishing with the cheese over the last layer of ravioli. Dot top of top of casserole with some of the yogurt. I often add extra cheese to my dish & mix that in as well as the rest of the yogurt. Bake covered with foil until puffy, about 40 minutes. Uncover & bake until golden brown, around 15 - 20 minutes,. Remove from oven & let stand 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Curried Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant curry | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( or you can use green onion paste, onion powder ) | 1 small lime, squeezed | 1 dash catsup | 1 teaspoon honey or 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh horseradish
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender. Blend until creamy and light. You may add more or less of the curry as you have to. Add to other salad dressings or chill until serving time.

title: Duck Wraps
ingredients: 1 boneless beef round or ( 1/2 inch ) duck breast | 1 teaspoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 4 small flour tortillas or 4 small corn tortillas | 4 teaspoons fresh minced duck fat or 4 teaspoons oil
instructions: Prepare the meat by seasoning it with salt, pepper and the grated lemon peel. Dry meat on a paper towel. Heat the fat or oil in a heavy skillet just until hot. Cook meat until lightly browned. Spoon one teaspoon of meat onto each tortilla, sprinkle with minced duck or any other flavoring like curry powder, etc. Roll up each tortillas, and fry the tortillas until golden brown. If you use corn tortillas, soak them in hot water briefly, then warm them for a very short time. Remove the roll from the skillet and place on a cutting board, cut in half. Serve with your favorite condiments.

title: Crunchy Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 cups green lentils, rinsed | 3 cups broccoli, steamed cut up | 1/2 head bok choy, chopped | 4 ounces dry breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 4 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons peanuts, chopped | salt, pepper
instructions: Steam the lentils and broccoli in 2 quarts water with 1 teaspoon of salt, for 8 - 10 minutes or until just tender. Cool, then peel and dice into small pieces with your fingers. Boil the remaining 1 tsp salt in a small pan until lightly scorched. Put in a blender with all the salad ingredients except the peanut, and blend on high for 3 - 3 minutes or until mixed. Add the peanut and bread crumbs and blend just until mixed. Toss all the ingredients together in a salad bowl with the dressing. Put in the fridge a couple of hours before serving. Serve cold with crisp crisp french bread and cold milk. Note, the preparation time reflects the time to cook the lentils and broccoli. This salad can be covered and stored overnight or for as long as overnight. It can also be kept in the fridge for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,white mushroom,pork shoulder,tequila,juniper berry,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Fantastic Terrine
ingredients: 6 tablespoons tequila, divided | 1/2 lb white mushroom, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb fresh baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 2 teaspoons oil or 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons juniper berries | 1/2 cup bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°. Prepare terrine by rubbing together 4 tablespoons of the tequila with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil and set aside. In a skillet, fry the mushrooms, in the remaining tequila, stirring frequently, until tender. Add the remaining oil, if using. Sprinkle in the juniper berries and then the bread crumbs and stir until mixture is well mixed. Dredge each piece of terrine in the grated bread crumb mixture, coating them completely. Place on a piece of aluminum foil, covering tightly with foil. Bake terrine for 10 - 20 minutes, until it tests soft to the touch.

Random Ingredients: tea,frying chicken,beef rump roast,rice paper,coriander,rice wine,sun tomato
title: Quick Easy Beef Rolls
ingredients: 3 lbs beef rump roast | 2 packages good quality teacups or ( 3 ounce ) packages pork roasts | 1 1/2 cups rice wine or 1 1/2 cups shao hsing rice wine vinegar | 4 large dried coriander ( or about 8 ) | 3/4 - 1 cup chopped sun-dried tomato | 2 cups very thinly sliced cooking beef round balls or 2 cups sliced deli-style meat, cut into bite-sized pieces about 3 or 4 wide | 5 tablespoons loose-leaf tea
instructions: The easiest way to work around the rice wrapper is to, place the wrapper between two sheets of waxed paper, then flip it over several times, cutting it off and onto another. This helps make it easier to roll. You won't actually notice the wrapper, unless you like. Cut off any remaining wrappers. Lay the meat pieces evenly out on a cutting board. Use a pastry brush to lightly coat each one with the rice wine. Wrap the meat pieces completely with the wrapper to make them stick together. The easiest way to get good seal is to use the moistened fingers to stick the meat. You don't need to completely wrap it but try to make sure it wraps around the meat. You can do this with any meat at this point if you wish. If this is hard, you can use a rolling pin to roll and lightly press the wrap to tighten. Take the wrapper off the waxed paper and with your fingers, pinch the edges a few times over the wrap to tighten it all around, then pull off the top wrapper as evenly as possible until it is at the bottom. You want the wrapper to be tight without being difficult to roll out right now? You can do the same for the pork roll or beef roll. When you have all your prepared ingredients, you can either do all your rolls as directed or just place them in a very large pot, laying them around the wrappers in a way that they don't touch and press together to make sure they are all snug to work with, and just let them hang over the side of the pot. This method makes a super easy, nonstick rolling that keeps the fat from hanging over the outside of the wrapper. It will literally freeze all your stuff, it will take about 1 to 3 1/2 hours and you can just walk along and walk at it. You don't even need to refrigerate for this long, or when you're ready to bake, you can cut the wraps into large, thin strips. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Remove the wrappers from the paper on a baking sheet and brush with the tea and sprinkle with coriander. Bake at 400°f for about 10 minutes, or until the wrapper is a pale gold, and the dried coriander is fragrant and lightly brown. Remove from the oven and brush with more of the tea.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,celery seed,red cabbage,basil,cornstarch,cilantro,nam pla
title: Thai Chicken With Veggies
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon cilantro, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried basil ( can use regular leaves ) | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 cup nam pla | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 3 -4 cups red cabbage, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place chicken in a mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,pineapple juice,cream tartar,great northern bean,anisette
title: Red Beans With Creamy Pineapple
ingredients: 3 cans great northern beans ( rinsed well ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons anisette | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 cup unsweetened pineapple juice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and cook for 20 minutes over medium heat. Ladle bean mixture into serving dishes and serve.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,egg,sauce,italian sausage,orange juice concentrate,pecorino romano cheese,liquid smoke,lamb
title: Aussie Lamb and Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb | 1 lb italian sausage | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup orange juice concentrate | 3 eggs, separated | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: In a lrg skillet over meduim high heat, cook lamb, sausage, pasta & juice concentrate, stirring frequently, until the meat is crumbly. Drain pasta well & return it to skillet, mixing well. Beat the egg yolks in a lrg bowl & set aside. Add orange rind, 2 tbsp of the zaar b & the pepper sauce, & mix well. Cook until it thickens slightly. Reduce heat & add in egg yolks, stirring quickly. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Beat egg whites in a large bowl with the remaining zaar & spoon the filling into pasta. Combine well & transfer the contents of skillet to a shallow baking dish. Bake, uncovered at 300°f for about 40 min or till it is golden brown & bubbling.

title: Lobster and Spinach Rolls (Bundi)
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 2 cups boiling water | 20 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 20 large cooked lobster tails
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup boiling water in a large mixing bowl, stirring until creamy. Stir in spinach and remaining 2 cups boiling water. Let stand 10 minutes or until mixture starts to thicken. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease large baking sheet. Drop lobster halves into spinach mixture and arrange on sheet. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Stir with flat of a heavy knife until lobster is no longer transparent. Cut into 12 pieces and arrange on baking sheet. Brush with remaining 1 cup of warm water, then bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove from baking sheet.

title: Lemongrass Beef & Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 package linguine | 4 ounces velveeta cheese, grated | 12 ounces diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon lemongrass, dried
instructions: Cut beef into thin strips about the size of a pepper. Brown meat with molasses in a skillet in the olive oil. Remove meat. Add 1 package of linguine to skillet containing the meat. Toss well. Remove to oven with the two blocks of velveeta. When cheese is completely melted, stir in diced tomatoes and chopped chilies. Return to oven for about 2 or 3 minutes, until sauce is slightly thickened, stirring frequently. Put in individual serving bowls garnish with fresh thyme slices.

title: Macaroni With Madeira
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 1/2 cup dry white wine, divided | 2 tablespoons madeira wine
instructions: In a medium saucepan of boiling, salted water, cook elbow macaroni 8 to 10 minutes, until al dente. Drain macaroni, then transfer to a 2 quart casserole dish. Pour half the dry white wine into the casserole and then stir in the madeira. Mix well and let sit for 1 minute. Spread the macaroni in the casserole. Cover with remaining dry wine sauce and sprinkle the top with the remaining 1 tablespoon dry white wine.

title: Pan-Fried Pork Chops
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork chop, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 fennel bulb, sliced thin | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, snipped
instructions: Pound pork with the flat side of a meat mallet or cleaver until very thin. Spread 1/4 cup of the mint leaves on the pork. Heat a large nonstick skillet. Add pork and fry just until tender but not dry, about 3 minutes on each side for medium rare. Remove from heat and top with fennel. Sprinkle with remaining mint. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chocolate ice cream,meat,corn tortilla,maraschino cherry,sage,caper,ginger garlic paste,anaheim chilies
title: Gramma's Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground meat | 12 corn tortillas | 3 anaheim chilies, finely chopped into large pieces | 1/2 cup capers, soaked in hot water for 2 hours, drained | 1/2 cup ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup maraschino cherry, cut in half | 1/2 cup sage, shredded | 1/2 cup chocolate ice cream, softened
instructions: Combine meat, tortillas, anaheim chilies, capers, ginger garlic paste, cherry tomatoes, sage and ice cream until it's well blended. Spoon 1/4 cup meat mixture into each tortilla. Roll up each tortilla tightly. Arrange in an 8x8 inch dish coated with nonstick cooking spray, bake at 350 degrees about 20 minutes or until heated through.

title: Lek and Mustard Seeds Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs leeks, white and light green parts only, washed well and trimmed ( or 2 1/2-inch long, white and light green parts ) | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds ( or 2 teaspoons yellow ) | 1 cup hot cooked rice noodles ( or other medium-hot noodle )
instructions: Slice leeks crosswise into 1/4 inch rounds. Sprinkle rounds with salt and toss, separating slices, into a colander. Place leeks evenly in bowl.

title: French Kiss
ingredients: 2 cups freshly brewed strong coffee, cold ( espresso, strong chocolate, or 1 1/2 cups strong coffee and 1 1/2 tsp rum is ok ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup coffee-flavored liqueur | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a coffee cup, and bring to a boil. Pour into a glass, and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,queso fresco,flour,horseradish sauce,heavy cream,half cream
title: Mexican Layered Cream Dessert
ingredients: 3/4 cup prepared horseradish sauce | 3/4 cup half & half cream or 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup grated queso fresco | 4 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons grated swiss and cheddar cheese blend
instructions: In a deep skillet heat sauce ingredients together until well blended. Cook and stir until hot and bubbly. Remove from heat. Place 1 1/2 tablespoons of cream in the bottom of a 9 inch cake pan. Using a spatula, spread to 1/4 inch thickness. Top with half of the sour cream mixture. Repeat layers ending with cream. Sprinkle top with cheese. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,yellow mustard seed,thai red chili pepper,lemon extract,wine,celery seed
title: Spiced Dipping Sauce for Beef or Lamb
ingredients: 1/3 cup wine or 1/3 cup chicken broth | 1/3 cup dry yellow mustard seeds | 1/3 cup finely chopped celery seed | 2 1/2 teaspoons lemon extract | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds | 2 fresh thai red chili peppers, seeded, deveined, thinly sliced
instructions: Stir together wine or chicken stock, mustard and next 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan. Bring to boil over medium high heat. Cook without stirring, until thick and creamy, about 3 minutes. Cool completely. Spoon off seeds from last 4 thai chiles, and finely chop.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,bamboo shoot,chive,feta cheese,yellow squash,onion flake,baby bok choy
title: Vegetable Patties (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 20)
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 ounce dried chives, finely chopped | 1 ounce dried onion flakes | 1 teaspoon dried chives, finely chopped | 140 g baby bok choy, halved | 1/2 small yellow squash, halved lengthways, cut into chunks | 1/2 small yam, peeled and diced | 1/3 cup crumbled reduced-fat feta cheese
instructions: Combine tomatoes & chilies, chives, and onion flakes in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: filet mignon,onion,tortilla chip,lobster tail,asparagus,non vanilla yogurt,salmon steak,green bell pepper
title: Canadian Salmon Steak Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound salmon steaks, cut into strips | 5 lobster tails | 1/2 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 onion, chopped | 1 package tortilla chips | 3/4 cup non-fat vanilla yogurt | 1 cup chopped asparagus | 1 can smoked salmon steaks, chopped
instructions: Cook salmon in nonstick skillet over medium high heat, stirring frequently, just until fish is lightly browned and tender. Drain, and set aside. Cook green pepper and onion in skillet with reserved salmon and seafood, stirring frequently, until onion is softened, about 5 minutes. Set aside. Place tortilla chips on a plate. Break crabmeat meat into bite sized chunks, and combine with green pepper/onions over chips. Drizzle yogurt over salad. Sprinkle asparagus on top, and serve with salmon.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,feta cheese,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Feta Cheese Spread
