ingredients: 1 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded | 8 -10 drops red food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Stir feta cheese, monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, food coloring and red food coloring until evenly blended. Drop mixture into a greased 9x9 pan. Bake for 20 minutes. Cool and refrigerate 3 hours. Store in airtight container.

title: Vegan Labne
ingredients: 4 cups soy or 4 cups almond milk | 1 can ranch style beans, undrained | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Pour the soy or almond milk into a bowl and add the drained beans. Add the turmeric and stir together gently. Let sit in the refridgerator for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve over hot egg noodles.

title: Irish Cowboy Beef Sausage Pie
ingredients: 1 pie crust | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 spanish onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon brewed tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Roll out pastry on a floured counter. Cut out 4 - 6 smaller circles. Warm olive oil in a pan saute onions until transparent. Combine with coriander and stir in mayo. Place the beef mixture in the pie crust, top with tea and bake at 400° for 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Spanish Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon quick oats ( not instant ) | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1/4 cup red bell peppers or 1/4 cup green bell pepper ( 1/4-inch pieces )
instructions: Combine shrimp, oats, cornstarch, and beef bouillon in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 1 minute or until shrimp are just done. Stir well to combine. Microwave for 1 more minute or until shrimp are no longer translucent. Add red bell peppers or green pepper.

title: Russian Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 2 medium red radishes, peeled | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped tomato with basil | 1/4 cup thinly sliced red radish | 1 head lettuce, torn in small pieces
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling salted water, blanch cauliflower 5 minutes, or until tender. Drain.

Random Ingredients: kale,italian bread white,cellophane noodle,salt,cream tartar,spinach leaf,mint leaf
title: Creamy Kale and Romaine Noodles
ingredients: 1 box cellophane noodles | 2 cups packed fresh spinach leaves, washed well, spun dry and chopped | 3/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 teaspoon coarsely salt, or to taste | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced leaves kale | 1 loaf italian bread with pith, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices and toasted
instructions: Fill a large pot with water, and bring to a boil. Add cellophane noodles and cook until al dente, about 5 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain well and set aside. Meanwhile, bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add spinach. Cover and cook until wilted, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain. Stir in mint and season with salt. Transfer to a large serving platter. Layer with noodles. Top with kale. Drizzle with cream and toasted bread slices.

title: Pork and Olive Salad - Mexico
ingredients: 2 large chicken pieces | 2 -3 lbs pork roast | 2 -3 heads romaine lettuce, separated into leaves | 3 jalapeno peppers
instructions: Place meat in a deep pan with enough water to cover by ½ inch. Cover and simmer slowly over low heat for about 2 hours. The end of the cooking time will depend on the size of the meat. The roast should be tender but not falling apart when pierced with a fork. When completely falling apart, remove any excess fat. While meat is cooking, place torn romaine leaves over a salad plate. Slice and de seed the jalapeno peppers into thin slices, remove seeds and veins. Cut meat into ¼ inch cubes and sprinkle over the romaine. Top with finely shredded romano cheese and chopped green onion if desired. Serve over a bed of lettuce.

title: Butternut Squash and Pepper Casserole
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 4 -6 button mushrooms, sliced | 1 bell pepper, diced ( red ( red or green ) | 1 tablespoon ouzo | 1/2 teaspoon habaneros or 2 jalapeno chiles, chopped | 1 teaspoon cumin | pine nuts
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°c. Boil your squash, butternut squash and mushrooms in boiling water for approx 25 minutes. While this is simmering, chop up your peppers and cumin, put them in a baking dish with the ouzo, and cover with tin foil. Put into the oven for 20 more minutes until the squash is tender. Mix everything well and pour this over the squash and then pop it back in the oven. Cook for another 10 minutes or so. Take the pan off the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before turning out onto serving plates. Top with pine nuts and more ouzo, if desired… and any remaining fresh fruit on the side to serve.

title: FestivalBowle Salad
ingredients: 350 g farfalle pasta ( bowtie type ) | 2 green onions, finely chopped | 100 g dried sweet red cherries | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Cook bowley in salted water according to packet instructions and drain. Place the cooked bowley into a large bowl and toss with the chopped green onions and dried cherries. Add the vanilla essence and mix well.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,egg,dark chocolate,breadcrumb,chuck roast,bay leaf,coffee,beef hot dog
title: Chilean Beef Dogs
ingredients: 1 kg chuck roast | 1/4 cup sugar ( optional ) or 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup coffee | 1 bay leaf | 1 egg | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 4 beef hot dogs | 200 g dark chocolate, melted
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well to ensure there are no lumps in the mixture. Add a little water at the end of the grinding. Place the meat into a large bowl, mix and refrigerate for an hour or so to allow the flavours to combine. In the meantime in a small pan, melt the chocolate and set aside until you are ready to cook them. Remove from the heat and mix the melted chocolate into the chocolate so it will dissolve. When you are ready to cook the meat, preheat the grill to its hottest temperature and place the meat side up on the grill. Brush a slice of aluminium foil with some melted chocolate oil to stop it from drying out. Place a piece of meat, with a sharp slice of meat attached to the foil, onto the slice of foil, fold the foil over to encase the meat and to make a packet. When it is ready to be cooked, preheat the grill to its hottest temperature and grill the meat for about two hours. Serve with extra melted chocolate. Note, if the beef has a long stick and is a bit dry, you can add more melted chocolate to the water you used for soaking the meat and drying it. If this is a problem for you, i suggest you remove the foil and continue to cook on your heat until the meat is soft.

title: Caprese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 can capers, drained and broken into pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, mix cheese with capers. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,italian salad dressing mix,coffee,mozzarella cheese
title: Italian Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup instant coffee | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare spaghetti sauce and mix together with instant coffee and italian salad dressing mix. Layer spaghetti with sauce and sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Bring to a boil.

title: Boeuf a la Juèvre
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 2 tablespoons flour | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar or 4 tablespoons lemon juice | sliced scallion ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups mixed berries ( blueberries, red currant, raspberries, etc. )
instructions: Trim fat from meat, place into a large saucepot and add enough water to cover. Add 2 tbsp oil to coat bottom and sides of the pan. Add meat and cook slowly, covered, approximately 30 minutes. Remove from cooking water, drain and reserve liquid. Remove meat from the water. In a small bowl, combine reserved liquid and white wine vinegar. Remove pork from saucepot if desired, and set aside to cool. In a separate bowl, combine flour and a pinch of salt. Add reserved stock and vinegar liquid to the flour and vinegar. Beat until smooth. Place meat back in the saucepot and add enough liquid to cover. Heat gently, then turn off heat and cover for 5 minutes. Reserve 1 cup, and set the rest aside for basting. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove meat from pan with a slotted spoon to a large casserole. Place meat in a small oven safe casserole dish. Spoon in reserved liquid over meat. Add remaining berries, and top with scallions and baste with reserved vinegar. Bake for approximately 40 minutes, or until juices run clear when meat is pierced with a fork.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,shell pasta,pinto bean,asafoetida powder,grand marnier,khoya,curry powder
title: Shahi Kebab
ingredients: 7/8 cup dried pinto beans | 1 1/2 tablespoons granulated bouillon in powder | 5 tablespoons curry powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame tawari or 1 1/2 tablespoons arrowroot | 3/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup uncooked small shell pasta | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place pinto beans in a large bowl and season with granulated bouillon. Cover, and soak overnight. The next day, remove the soaked beans from the soaked beans and place in a blender. Add curry powder, grand marnier, sesame tawari, asafoetida and salt and pepper. Puree until smooth. Meanwhile, cook pasta in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water until al dente. Drain pasta, transfer to a bowl, and toss with the cooked pasta. Cover, and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: tahini,fenugreek seed,sauce,alfredo sauce,parsley leaf,leek,white pepper,almond butter
title: Sauce With Leek and Almonds
ingredients: 4 leeks, white portion only, chopped | 1 cup roasted salted almond butter | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon fresh ground white pepper | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, minced
instructions: Trim leeks. Cut across the tops, cut off each length, and discard. Cut each into 1/8ths, with tough white part beginning at each end and leaving 1/8 inch thick stalks at the root ends, trim the root ends, trim them and discard the hard tough stalk. Stem and core leeks. Trim off any remaining scum from leeks. Place in a medium saucepan and add water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat. Add a pinch of salt, to taste, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, about 15 minutes. Drain leeks. Set aside 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Heat almond butter in a small skillet and stir in cream. Heat over medium heat, stirring often, until cream is reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Set aside. Add tahini sauce, hot sauce, fenugreek seeds, white pepper, and 2 tablespoons cooking liquid to cream mixture and reduce by half, about 5 minutes. Stir in chopped leeks and parsley and warm over low heat until leeks are tender, about 8 minutes.

title: Mushrooms in Peppercorns with Cream and Fideo
ingredients: 1 pound thin slab bacon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 3 cups crushed black peppercorns | 1 package dried cremini mushrooms | 3/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 package uncooked fideo packages
instructions: Cook bacon in a dutch oven over medium high heat until crispy, removing to drain on paper towels. Pour off fat. Saute black peppercorns, cremini mushrooms, allspice, and mushrooms in bacon drippings until mushrooms are tender. Transfer to a bowl. Cook fideo in a large pot of boiling water, stirring to separate, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Crock Pot Rice Krispies Chicken Bake
ingredients: 12 ounces cellophane noodles, cooked ( the type with the noodles, such as rice krispies, or rice krispies ) | 2 cups chicken broth | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 4 cups prepared instant rice krispies
instructions: Place all ingredients except noodles in a crock pot and cook on high 4 hours.

title: Potato Flank Steak
ingredients: 4 lbs beef flank steak, sliced 1/4-inch thick ( or more ) | 6 tablespoons potato starch, separated
instructions: In a large bowl, pour cold water over flank steak, rubbing the starch into the steaks. Dip steaks into the potato starch, thoroughly coating both sides. Transfer to a platter and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours, turning occasionally. Transfer steaks to serving platter with sauce. Serve with vegetables of your choice.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,passata,lemon zest,mandarin orange,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Pesto-Free Delight #57122; Mandarin Oranges and Pistachios
ingredients: 15 ounces mandarin oranges, drained | 1/2 - 1 ounce parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/4 cup corn chips, crushed | 9 ounces passata ( or your favorite tomato dip )
instructions: If using canned mandarin oranges in syrup, drain and rinse in a colander, then place into serving bowl. Place all mandarin orange ingredients except pistachios in a food processor and blend until smooth. Spread 1/2 the pesto blend over 1/4 of the chips. Place another 1/4 of the pesto blend over the pesto blend until smooth. Top with remaining 1/4 of the passata and sprinkle with pistachios if using. Let dry at least 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,wondra flour,tea,corn kernel,honey,orange peel,rice wine,baking powder
title: Corn & Chilli Scones
ingredients: 225 g dried corn kernels | 100 g tea bags | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 5 -6 teaspoons wondra flour, for thickening if necessary
instructions: Place the corn kernels in a large saucepan, cover with water, and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium, cover, and simmer until tender, 45 - 60 minutes, stirring regularly to keep them submerged during this time. Drain and leave the pan uncovered to keep warm. Return the corn kernels to the pan, add the tea, and simmer until the kernels become tender. Drain the vegetables and leave them to cool slightly, then place in a large food processor or electric mixer. Add the remaining ingredients and process until smooth, about 10 - 15 seconds, stopping and scraping down the sides as necessary. Grease and lightly flour a large baking sheet, about 6 - 8 inches across and 2 inches high. Spread the mixture evenly on the baking sheet, then use a spatula to transfer it onto the baking sheet with the flat edge of a knife. Use the flat edge of the knife to carefully score 1/2 3 inch lines across the surface of the scones.. Bake in a 300f oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until crisp and golden. Serve warm with steamed basmati rice. Note, if the quantity of corn is a little over a medium quantity, you can make up to 2 2/3 cups.

title: Fried Prawns - Prawns With Sage
ingredients: 12 large raw prawns ( shelled, unpeeled ) | 1 tablespoon ghee | 10 sage leaves
instructions: Heat a 12 inch frying pan over moderate heat. Brush the prawn with the ghee. Cook the prawn, about 4 minutes. Turn and cook 2 - 3 minutes more or until the prawn are just cooked through. Transfer to a large bowl. Garnish with fresh sage and serve at once.

title: Rice and Ricotta Stuffed Baked Bread Sticks
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice | 2 cups ricotta cheese, drained ( reserve 1/3 cup ) | 2/3 cup dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Stir together the rice and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt in a mixing bowl. Add the ricotta cheese and stir until well combined. Cut a slit in each loaf about 1/4 inch deep and stuff the ricotta and rice mixture into the loaf in a ring. Arrange the loaves on a cookie sheet. Combine the remaining 1/3 cup rioiace with the breadcrumbs. Sprinkle over the loaves. Bake the loaves for 25 - 35 minutes, or until just slightly golden. Cut halfway through baking.

title: Cretz (Red Potato Snack)
ingredients: 3 small red potatoes | 1/4 cup walnut pieces | 1/4 cup pecans | 3/4 cup tempeh, coarsely chopped
instructions: Separate potatoes into wedges then cut into 5 inch long chunks. Cut walnuts in half then set aside. Place raisins with pecans on a baking sheet & roast in a 350 °f oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until lightly toasted. Set aside to cool then cut potatoes into 5/8 inch by 1/8 inch wide cubes. Place into a container with a lid or a cookie sheet with several slits on top. Add the tempeh & walnuts then gently stir to combine. Dump potatoes onto the walnut and mince together with a fork. Sprinkle extra nutmeg over each serving.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,green plantain,cayenne pepper,egg yolk,strawberry jam
title: Plantain and Strawberry Tortilla
ingredients: 1 medium green plantain, cut into 1/4- 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 2 large egg yolks | 1 cup strawberry jam | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Toss all ingredients except jam with a knife. Toss in oil a few times to coat. Place in oven on a hot griddle set over medium heat and cook until the mixture is the consistency of jam. Spread top and sides of tortilla with jam. Cook 10 seconds per side, or until heated through. Serve with assorted fresh fruit.

title: Beans W- Herbs, Green Beans & Herbs(Yogurt Cheese)
ingredients: 2 green beans | 1 tablespoon low-fat yogurt cheese ( plain yogurt )
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°c. Place green beans in a baking dish, bake for about 10 mins until just tender. Wash the beans under cold water before cooking and remove any skins. Drain and place the beans in a large bowl. Mix in the yogurt cheese. Cover and refrigerate for several hours to flavours infuse flavours.

Random Ingredients: mace,fennel seed,onion soup mix,potato,squash baby food carrot,garlic salt,baking soda,lukewarm milk
title: Mom's Polish Potato Squash Soup
ingredients: 5 large potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1/2 cup chopped onion soup mix | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 4 cups water, or as needed | 1 container lekewarm milk
instructions: Place the potatoes, onion soup mix, baking soda, fennel seed, mace, garlic salt, and as much water as needed in a pot. Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,fruit,coconut powder,double cream,barbecue sauce,vegetable oil,tomato sauce
title: Tomato Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 400 g canned tomato sauce | 50 g tomato paste | 250 ml double cream | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut powder | 1 tablespoon coconut powder | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Combine tomato sauce and tomato paste. Combine cream, grated coconut powder, bbq sauce and oil in medium sized saucepan. Bring to boil and stir continuously. Mix in tomato sauce. Cook till it thickens and leaves the sides of the saucepan.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,parsnip,chili sauce,chili garlic sauce,fennel seed
title: Chilli Cod With Parsnips
ingredients: 1 kg cod fish fillet | 1 1/2 cups parsnips, grated | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 1/8 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Combine parsnip, chilli sauce, and fennel seeds. Place fish on baking paper lined roasting tray and spoon parsnip mixture onto fish. Bake in preheated 160c oven for 30 mins or til fish is tender.

Random Ingredients: sambal oelek,self rising flour,water chestnut,green tomato,grain brown rice,espresso coffee,mango
title: Smooth Indian Brown Rice Cake
ingredients: 1 cup rice, unsalted | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon espresso coffee | 2/3 cup cold water chestnut, chopped | 2 green tomatoes, finely chopped ( or canned ) | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek | 1 mango, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. To make the cake, mix the rice with the flour, coffee and water in a bowl, making sure the water is not absorbed. Pour into a greased and floured 9 inch round cake pan. Cut the tomatoes in half and stir into the rice mixture along with the sambal oelek. Bring the mixture well to a boil and carefully pour over the cake. Bake at 350 for 45 to 50 minutes, or until the top is nicely browned and the cake is slightly crisp. Place a cutting board over the cake and with a serrated knife, slice thinly. Put the mango pieces in the pan around the plate until cool. When the cake is cool, cut in squares or quarters. Serve warm. You can store the cake in an airtight tub for up to 2 weeks. Keep in the refrigerator.

title: Indian Pepper Shoot (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 1 can black bamboo shoots, drained | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 4 tablespoons green cardamoms | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Auberge Flavoured Gluten Free Asparagus Bites
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed and washed but not peeled | 1 ounce raisins | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon bakers flour | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Cut off stalk at about 1 inch intervals and roughly chop the stems. Place all ingredients in a plastic bag with the flour and a pinch or two of salt and mix well to combine. Place the mixture into a container and cover and leave for at least 1 hour, stirring from time to time. If you are using gluten free asparagus mix in the dry ingredients above. Pre heat oven to 350°f place the mixture onto a buttered, greased baking tray and bake in oven for 20 - 45 minutes until crisp and golden brown. Serve warm topped with more asparagus tips and sauce.

Random Ingredients: ciabatta,velveeta cheese,vegetable stock may be necessary,plain nonfat yogurt,baby spinach
title: Cheesy Spinach Pesto Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf ciabatta, cut in half | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese, cut in chunks | 1 lb baby spinach | 4 -5 cups vegetable stock ( i use a cube to add extra moisture to the broth of veggies at the end of cooking )
instructions: Preheat oven to place loaf, cut side down in a large roasting pan. Mix other ingredients together in a large bowl. Drizzle entire loaf with a little broth and sprinkle with more of the cheese, if needed. Bake for 50 - 60 minutes stirring halfway through. It should be a creamy brown color and a bit crusty on top.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,grape,kosher salt,red chile pepper,watermelon,mango chutney,cucumber
title: Beef Kebabs with Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 cups watermelon, seeded | 5 cups grape, halved | 1/2 cucumber - peeled, seeded, and cut into 1/4-inch thick slices | 2 red chile peppers, seeded and cut into long strips, or to taste | 3 tablespoons mango chutney, or to taste | 1 teaspoon kosher salt, or to taste | 2 sirloin tip roast
instructions: Place watermelon, grapes, cucumber, red chile peppers, and mango chutney in a bowl. Sprinkle kosher salt over and drizzle with chile pepper dressing.

title: Pasta in Peas & Rice
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta ( or other small shaped pasta ) | 2 cups peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup soy corn syrup | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon rose water
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente, about 7 - 8 minutes or according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat remaining ingredients in saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes, until fragrant. Drain pasta and peas, and return pasta to pan. Add sauce, peas and corn syrup to pan. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Cook, stirring constantly, 5 - 7 minutes or until sauce thickens slightly. Serve.

title: Enchilada Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 6 cans red enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken breasts into a baking dish, and bake for about 35 minutes, until the chicken is tender. Set aside in a container to cool. Mix the enchilada sauce, and chicken broth together in a large bowl, and stir in the enchilada sauce.

title: Dawn's Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1/2 cup chopped turnip | 1/2 cup chopped mango | 1/4 cup mild mexican cheese, shredded | 3 teaspoons corn syrup | 3 teaspoons light cream or 3 teaspoons light yogurt | 2 dried ancho chiles
instructions: Heat oil in a large non stick pan over medium high heat. Stir in turnip and mango.

title: Pesto Lasagna
ingredients: 24 whole fresh lasagna noodles | 1 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage link,plum tomato,cinnamon sugar,red pepper flake,bacon dripping,kosher salt
title: Sweet and Spicy Italian Sausages
ingredients: 3 italian sausages | 2 tablespoons smoked bacon drippings | 1 cup plum tomato, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, cook the sausage until lightly browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer the sausage to a baking pan and drizzle with bacon drippings. Bake the sausage in the preheated oven until well browned, 10 to 12 minutes. Sprinkle tomatoes with cinnamon sugar, red pepper flakes and salt. Continue baking until tomatoes are warm and hot, 5 minutes.

title: Sausage and Sauerkraut With Coconut Cream
ingredients: 3 links pork sausage links, cut into 1 -inch slices | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet over med high heat. Add pork sausage and cook, turning, until brown and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Add sauerkraut and coconut oil and mix well. Place on an oven proof serving dish, spread with sauerkraut mixture. Sprinkle with dill and return to the oven to bake, covered, for 20 - 30 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Peanut Stuffing for Turkey, Pork or Beef
ingredients: 2 cups bread | 1 cup roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | allspice berries, crushed
instructions: Cube bread, and place in large bowl. Add peanuts and spices. Sift through a fine sieve, and mash or grind into a fine paste with a little water. Stuff turkey, meat or vegetable of your choice with this mixture and place onto a greased tray. Bake at 180°c/350°f/gas 4 for approx 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,mango chutney,cashew nut,strawberry,flat leaf parsley
title: Strawberry-Chutney Salad
ingredients: 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced | 1 cup natural mango chutney | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon saffron threads | 1/2 cup raw cashew nuts
instructions: Combine sliced strawberries, chutney, parsley, saffron and cashews in a serving dish. Place salad in microwave safe bowl, cover and microwave on high 7 to 8 minutes, until just warm..

Random Ingredients: coconut,beef,coriander powder,chicken wing,parmigiano reggiano cheese,tamarind pulp
title: Baked Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, split | 2 ounces coconut | 2 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 ounces coriander powder | 2 ounces tamarind pulp ( optional ) | 1 ounce shaved coconut
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and line a baking sheet with foil. Place the chicken wings on the baking sheet and spread them out on the baking sheet. Pour an inch or two of water over the chicken until the wings are about 3/8 inch thick. Bake on the middle rack of the oven, checking for doneness, about 40 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool completely. Turn out onto your baking sheet and let cool for about 10 minutes. Make sure the wings are completely cool before wrapping individually with plastic wrap and refrigerating. When ready to bake, remove the plastic wrap from each portion and rub the entire coating of coating onto the chicken. Set aside. Place the coconut in a bowl, add the grated parmigiano cheese and coriander powder and mix thoroughly. Sprinkle the tamarind pulp over the coconut, pressing in as much pulp as possible. Arrange the pieces of chicken on top of the coconut and scatter the shaved coconut on the top. Place the dish on a sheet tray to catch any spills. Return the baking sheet to the oven.

title: Green Grapes and Sour French Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette | 3 -4 bunches green grapes ( or your favorite type )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f and position rack in center. Cut baguette in half lengthwise and arrange them on greased cookie sheet. Spray bread with non stick spray. Bake approximately 5 mins until puffed and toasted depending on type of bread. Cut grapes in half and remove seeds, if desired. Spread grapes on baguette. Eat immediately. Note, to use the grapes, cut around the edge with a pastry wheel. Be sure to scrape the grapes into a small bowl/container to collect the grapes, or eat this immediately as well.

Random Ingredients: dark jamaican rum,monterey jack cheese,vanilla sugar,cremini mushroom,cream cheese,dill,chow mein noodle,juniper berry
title: Czech Mushrooms in Rum
ingredients: 1 pint light cream cheese ( or creme fraiche ) | 1/2 cup dark jamaican rum or 1/2 cup rum | 20 juniper berries ( i used thai red ) | 2 packages cremini mushrooms ( drained ) | 12 ounces chow mein noodles ( or other type noodles of choice ) or 12 ounces vermicelli ( or other type noodles of choice ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 6 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill
instructions: In a mixing bowl, soften cream cheese at room temperature for 10 minutes until soft. Add rum and continue to mix until blended. Slice mushrooms thinly and add to soft cream cheese. Set cream cheese mixture aside to cool in refrigerator for at least 10 minutes before adding to cream cheese mixture. While cream cheese mixture is cooling, soak noodles in a pot of hot water for 30 minutes and drain. While noodles are cooling, combine noodles with sour cream, vanilla, and dill in a mixing bowl and mix. Reserve 1/2 cup of the cream cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: leek,corn niblets,red bell pepper,beef brisket,tabasco sauce
title: Beef Brisket - Low Sodium Beef Vegetable
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef brisket or 2 -3 lbs pot roast | 4 medium red bell peppers, halved, lengthwise and cut into 3/4-inch slices | 4 medium leeks, washed and cut into 3- to 4 inch pieces | 4 -6 cups corn niblets ( or canned or fresh ) | 2 -3 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Trim fat from brisket. Place brisket in a large, shallow roasting pan. Arrange bell peppers around brisket. Thinly slice leeks crosswise, and sprinkle leeks over beef. Add 1 1/2 cups water to roasting pan or shallow roasting pan. Cover tightly with a kitchen tent, or heavy duty aluminum foil. On medium heat, cover, and steam brisket brisket for 1 1/2 hours. Meanwhile skim fat from surface of broth, scraping with a rubber spatula. Remove brisket from roasting pan. Keep brisket warm in oven at 450 for 30 minutes. Place brisket on a cutting board, discard fat.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,turmeric,chicken breast halve,tamarind paste,green lentil,fenugreek leaf,swiss chard,chicken stock cube
title: Somali Chicken With Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 400 g swiss chard ( or your favourite stalks including tender stalks ) | 1/2 cup green lentil ( or yellow lentils ) | 0.5 chicken stock cube | 200 g long-grain white rice | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 8 chicken breast halves ( about 12 ounces total ) | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves ( optional )
instructions: Cut the leaves of the stalks and stalks into about 8 inch strips. Cut the leaves from 2/3rds of the swiss chard stalks. Rinse the yellow lentils and put them all together in a large bowl. Slice the breasts thinly and mix with the lentils and chard. Dissolve the chicken stock in 1 cup of boiling water. Pour over the contents of the bowl and stir well to combine everything. Add the tamarind paste, turmeric and fenugreek leaves and mix well. Cover, leave overnight, stirring occasionally. The next morning, add the chicken and leave in fridge for at least. 5hrs prior to cooking, heat up the oil of your deep frying pan. Fry each piece of chicken until crisp and golden. Remove chicken and drain on kitchen paper and serve with sauce.

title: Saffron Vegetables in Saffron and Saffron Potato Bake
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks each 8oz by 4oz chunks | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 bay scallop, in thin slices | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar or 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar, coarsely packed | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon saffron threads
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Bring a large pan of water to boil. Add potatoes and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. Coat shallow 2 qt. Casserole with cooking spray. Heat oil over medium heat in a heavy 10 inch skillet. Add scallops and stir fry for 3 minutes. Stir in sugar and saffron. Add enough water to cover the scallops. Increase heat and bring to boil. Add potato and pasta to skillet. Cover and bake until scallops are tender and pasta is slightly crisp, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,mccormick seasoning,cool whip,green enchilada sauce,chocolate,cashew,pork tenderloin,coriander powder
title: Pork and Cashew Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin ( at least 3/4 pound ) | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/4 cup green enchilada sauce | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 16 ounces cool whip ( i like daisy martinez's organic cool whip ) | 14 ounces unsweetened chocolate ( not unsweetened ) | 1/4 teaspoon mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 1 ounce cashews
instructions: Poke holes in pork with a fork to allow steam to escape. Spray bottom and sides of pot with cooking spray. Cover pork with cold water, about 1/2 inch above pork. Bring to boil uncovered on medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,brown rice flour,cider vinegar,vodka,fontina cheese,sultana
title: Curtido's Italian Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice flour | 3 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 cup sultana ( golden raisins ) | 2 -3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 1/2 ounces vodka | 1 1/2 ounces fontina cheese, grated
instructions: Set aside 3 tablespoons brown rice flour. Shred cheese and set aside. Combine remaining brown rice flour, lettuce and raisins in a serving dish. Combine vinegar and vodka in a bowl, add to the sifted brown rice flour mixture and stir to combine. Sprinkle cheese over the top of salad and toss well. Serve with crusty italian bread. This can be served warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,seashell pasta,yellow squash,virgin olive oil,green cardamom
title: Sweet Pasta With Squash and Grated Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 lb green cardamom, split open and crushed | 1 lb yellow squash, peeled, seeded and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb sweet small whole grain seashell pasta | 4 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 5 teaspoons grand marnier
instructions: Cook the green cardamom seeds in hot olive oil until fragrant, add squash and cook over high heat for 10 minutes or until squash is lightly browned. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add the pasta and cook for 3 minutes or until tender. Drain pasta and squash and toss to mix thoroughly. Mix in remaining ingredients and serve.

title: Focaccia Breadsticks
ingredients: 500 g fresh white breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Put bread crumbs in bowl with cheese and cloves. Place in fridge to dry while preparing other ingredients. Roll small mixture about the size of large walnuts. Arrange on tray covered with baking paper. Refrigerate until needed. Dry breadsticks before baking if desired. Bake at 180 degrees fahrenheit for 15 minutes.

title: Tasty Low Fat Pork Chops
ingredients: 12 lean pork tenderloins | 1 banana
instructions: Cut a piece of plastic wrap off the underside of the tenderloins. With a sharp knife, remove as many of the membrane as possible then slice into 3 or 4 pieces, using long thin serrated knife. You will need to slice each piece very thinly. Cut the banana into 4 or 5 pieces. Wrap each piece tightly in the wrap, twisting at the ends.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,beef stew meat,coconut milk,egg,phyllo pastry
title: Beef Coconut Coconut Pie
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 can coconut milk | 1 package phyllo pastry sheet | 2 eggs
instructions: Mix beef with onion salt in a large saucepan over medium high. Add coconut milk.

title: Tacos on the Rocks
ingredients: 2 bananas, cut into chunks | 1/8 cup chopped italian parsley | 1/8 cup chopped italian parsley | 2 tablespoons minced fresh dill | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped pancetta, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon harissa | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Peel banana chunks and mash in a bowl with a fork until smooth. Stir garbanzo mixture, parsley, italian parsley, dill, taco sauce, pancetta, and harissa into mashed bananas until well combined. Line a 9 inch nonreactive baking dish with plastic wrap. Fill baking dish with banana mixture. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs on top of banana mixture. Cut a 1/2 slice from the top of the dish to allow steam to escape. Press crumbs into the top of the banana mixture. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Fresh Currant Soup
ingredients: 1 cup fresh currants, washed | 2 cans vegetable broth
instructions: In a blender combine currants, broth, and 1 teaspoon salt. Puree 1 - 2 minutes, or until very smooth. The soup will be dense and chunky.

title: Quick Mustard
ingredients: 1 -2 cup dry white wine ( or more to taste- i've never used this ) | 1 -2 teaspoon spicy brown mustard
instructions: Basically, just mix in all ingredients. It will keep in the fridge for a long time.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,white bread,egg,chili powder,dill,sunflower oil,fish sauce,arugula
title: Crunchy Snow Peas And Eggs
ingredients: 4 slices white bread, 3/4 inch thick | 4 slices snow peas, thin | 100 g arugula or 100 g baby spinach leaves | 1 large egg | 1 -3 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 -2 teaspoon sunflower oil
instructions: Toast the bread slices in a frying pan until lightly golden brown on both sides. Leave them untoasted. Cut the snow peas into half lengthways and slice into 1 thick lengths. Wash the spinach leaves under cold water and leave until softened. Cut the egg in half on high speed. Place it in a bowl, lightly beaten, with the fish sauce, dill & chili powder. Mix well. Heat oil in wok and stir fry half the fried bread slices in it for 1 minute until they have become pale & golden. Carefully remove from wok & set aside. Repeat with remaining fried bread slices. Spread the peas on a plate & top with rocket leaves and baby spinach leaves. Whisk lightly beaten egg with a pinch of soy sauce. Lightly beat the egg whites in one hand while continually moving the whites in a circular fashion, until stiff, glossy peaks form. Serve the soaked bread and snow peas on the bed of rocket with a sprinkling of chopped dill.

Random Ingredients: barbeque sauce,black olive,feta cheese,spice,salt,olive oil,cashew butter,hamburger bun
title: Sweet-Sour Burgers (Mediterranean Burger)
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun | 1/2 cup baked cashew butter | 1/2 cup feta cheese | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed dried spices ( i like to use a mix of cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice, but the possibilities vary ) | 1/2 cup sliced black olives | 1 - 1 1/2 cup barbeque sauce ( your favorite, i prefer newman's own cabernet sauvignon ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon olive oil | salt
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine the hamburger, cashew butter, feta crumbles, and spices. Add the barbeque sauce and olive oil and mix well to combine. Wipe out the bowl and use your fingers to create an indentation in the burger mix, so the oil doesn't burn. Heat a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Season the oil and add the burgers. Cook for 2 minutes each side, until browned and cooked to your liking. If your burgers are a bit on the dry side, turn up the heat and cook them 2 minutes more. Remove from the pan. Cover with a lid and allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing or hamburgers. Serve burger with a bed of shredded lettuce, sliced olive bruschetta, sour cream and salsa.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,farfalle pasta,gelatin,sea salt pepper,mace,plain yogurt,jalapeno pepper
title: Chutney Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 packages farfalle ( bow tie style ) pasta | 1 pint plain yogurt, low fat | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin, dissolved in | 1 cup bottled mango chutney ( such as major greys ) | sea salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, sliced into rings
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions and drain. Place drained pasta on clean kitchen towels and lightly pat dry with paper towels. In small bowl, stir together yogurt, gelatin, mango chutney, salt, pepper, and mace until well mixed. Set aside. Place jalapeno rings on a plate and sprinkle with sea salt. Dip jalapenos into 1/3 of the yogurt batter and place on a plate with the rings. Cover and refrigerate. When ready to serve, stir in cooked pasta. Top with remaining yogurt mixture and garnish with remaining jalapenos.

title: Olive Oil (Olive Oil)
ingredients: 500 ml oil or 500 ml olive oil | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Pour about a pint of oil in a pan. Heat the oil, being careful not to let it smoke. When it is about 180°c place nutmeg on top. Leave it on low heat to cook through. This will only take 15 - 20 minutes. Remove nutmeg from the heat. Leave it on the heat for a minute before serving.

title: Yummy Low Fat Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: 200 g brown rice | 3 red chilies | 3 whole dried fruit | 8 fluid ounces hot fat | 8 flaked coconut flakes or 8 flaked coconut, to serve ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepan combine brown rice, red chilies and dried fruit. Add hot fat and mix carefully until it is melted together. Cover with tight fitting lid and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes or until water is absorbed. Serve in lettuce leaves with flaked coconut on top or sprinkled with a mixture of your favourite hot spices.

Random Ingredients: toothpick,fruit peel,almond,yellow pepper,superfine sugar,grain dijon mustard,poblano pepper,chicken
title: French Country Chicken with Dried Fruit Pecans and Toasted Almonds
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole blanched almond | 1/2 yellow pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 red pepper, finely chopped | 5 poblano peppers, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon fine grain dijon mustard | 24 ounces diced chicken | 1/3 cup superfine sugar | toothpick
instructions: Cut slits in top of each pepper and remove the seeds. Place almonds in a small bowl and cover with water. Let stand 1 hour until softened. Drain, and rub out excess water. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, place chopped peppers, dijon mustard, sugar. Remove skin from peppers and discard. In a small bowl, combine peanuts and toasted almonds and mash until combined. Roll each pepper with hands in dijon sauce. Arrange pepper in baking dish. Place pepper pieces on top of almonds, and cover with remaining sauce. Bake 25 - 30 minutes, or until the chicken is done.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,apple,greek yogurt,cumin,spring onion,serrano chilies,pineapple juice
title: Tropical Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 4 chicken tenders | 500 g apple | 2 serrano chilies, finely chopped | 60 ml pineapple juice | 2 -3 inches piece ginger-sized cubes, chopped | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt
instructions: Make 3 diagonal slashes in your chicken tenders about 1/2 inch deep. Place a skewer in the freezer for about 5 minutes, so the skewers don't freeze. Combine the ingredients in a small bowl and stir. Put the mixture to the side of your broiler rack, placing about one and a quarter cup on your broiler tray. Take the chicken out of the refrigerator. Thread chicken onto skewers. Cook under the grill just until they are nicely cooked and have turned a deep, golden brown colour and are cooked to your liking don't overcook the chicken. Serve yak kebabs with soy sauce and greek yoghurt sprinkled over the top.

title: Pesto Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground veal | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh pesto | 8 ounces shredded fontina cheese | 2 cans diced green enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook ground veal in a large skillet over medium heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain and discard excess fat. Stir pesto into ground meat. Stir in fontina cheese. Spoon meat mixture into greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread enchilada sauce over top of enchilada mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until topping is browned and cheese is beginning to brown, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,chicken wing,icing sugar,savoy cabbage
title: Polly Welby's Fried Cabbage With Wings
ingredients: 1 bag of savoy cabbage | 1 red bell pepper ( cut in strips ( or cut in strips ) | 1 head savoy cabbage | icing sugar ( optional ) | 2 -4 lbs chicken wings ( depending on size )
instructions: Prepare the cabbage leaves by washing and removing them to a colander or salad bowl. Cut all the green and the purple parts in strips. Set aside. Cut the rest into bite size pieces and set aside. Chop the bird wings in half lengthwise. Set aside. Put oil on medium high heat in a large frying pan. When the oil is very hot drop in all of the pieces of cabbage leaves as it will sputter easily. If it splatters, just shake the pan. Scoop out any remaining green and purple pieces. Turn down heat, and fry all the pieces on each side until golden brown. Keep warm on paper towels until all of your fried cabbage is done.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,fennel bulb,green enchilada sauce,chickpea flour,beef,basmati rice,sugar syrup
title: Indian Fry Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef or 1/2 lb chicken | 1/2 cup chickpea flour, divided | 4 fennel bulbs | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package yellow waxed paper-thin strips of white plastic wrap ( such as those found in the refrigerated section of the store, not the yellow wax. ) | 1/2 cup warmed green enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons water | sugar syrup, for serving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f in a large bowl, stir together ground beef and 1/2 cup of chickpea flour until well combined. Cut off the root ends of the fennel bulbs, then cut each spear in half lengthwise. Slice the fennel bulbs in half vertically. Arrange the sliced fennel in a lightly oiled 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour 1 cup of the soaking liquid into a small bowl. Spray pam in a 9x13x2 inch straight sided saucer or deep fryer. Drain the fennel thoroughly then, with a knife, cut a slit lengthwise down 1/2 inch of each fennel bulb to open up the core of the bulb. The fennel's center will now be exposed. Repeat with remaining fennel. Coat both sides of each fennel with cooking oil. Cook as directed in the description above. If desired lightly salt the broiled fennel on both sides during the last 30 seconds of cooking. When completed, add the water to the fennel to soften it up a bit. Place in a serving bowl. Spray each slice with cooking oil. Arrange fennel on a serving platter. Sprinkle with enchilada sauce, then drizzle green sauce over the top. Yum.

title: Jungle Kidney Beans (Kahab)
ingredients: 1 cup dried kidney beans | 1/4 teaspoon dried kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Soak the kidney beans in a large glass of hot water overnight. Drain. Place the soaked beans in a skillet with enough water to cover the beans by 1 inch around the beans. Boil for 15 minutes, then remove from heat. Heat an iron skillet over medium high heat. Place an inverted metal steamer over the skillet or a cast iron griddle. Heat the beans, covered, for 15 to 20 minutes. If the skillet looks dry, stir in a little water. Remove the beans from the heat and stir to combine with the kaffir lime leaves. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mushroom cap,iceberg lettuce,lime juice zest,sherry wine,pork medallion
title: Pressed Pork Medallions with Wild Rice Vegetables
ingredients: 6 teaspoons sherry wine | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice, zest of | 1 package mushrooms ( caps on, if any, sliced thinly, or leave whole ) | 1/2 cup minced raw pork medallions or ( 6 ounce ) package vegetarian pork medallions | 5 tablespoons iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Mix all the marinade ingredients until combined and pour into a zip top plastic bag.

title: Lori's Italian Cannelloni
ingredients: 2 cups cooked cannelloni or 2 cups savoury cannelloni | 1/3 cup shortening | 12 ladyfingers, split lengthwise | 8 ounces mascarpone cheese | 3/4 cup green olives, sliced | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato, diced | 1/3 cup chopped drained mild roasted red peppers or 1/3 cup cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spread 1/3 cup of the shortening on the bottom of a 12x18 inch baking dish, and set aside. Spread cannelloni over shortening, and roll up tightly jelly roll fashion. Arrange half of the ladyfingers on the shortening, and top with half of the cheese. Repeat with remaining ladyfingers and cheese, ending with a layer of the mozzarella and olives covering the cheese and olives. Cut the cherry ripe olives into wedges, and cover with tomatoes. Sprinkle with a little sun dried tomato. Drizzle with the remaining shortening, and bake for 45 minutes. Remove from oven, and let set for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Linguine with Coco Milk
ingredients: 4 cups coconut milk | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 lb linguine, cooked
instructions: Whisk together coconut milk, chicken bouillon cube, and cayenne pepper in large bowl. Stir in linguine. Serve immediately.

title: Beef, Peas & Gravy from the Freeze Machine
ingredients: 400 g beef chuck, cut into 2cm cubes | 1/4 cup self raising flour | 1/4 cup pea, frozen | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 150 ml milk
instructions: Place the flour, pepper & parsley in the Freezeiser and use the quick release. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Press the mix onto the reamedder and place in a freezer bag. Label the bag. Label, date & freeze. To use, remove one bag, thaw out the extra bag & return to the freezer.

title: Pineapple & Honey Pineapple Toast
ingredients: 2 slices white thick bread | 1 tablespoon honey | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | salt and pepper | 2 1/2 pineapple tidbits | 2 tablespoons kahlua ( optional ) | 1 corn cob, cooked, shredded
instructions: Lightly salt and pepper one side of your bread slices. Cut the slice in half and lightly coat the slices using a brush. You may even just lay the bread on top of a sandwich pan and put it under the grill as the honey will draw out the steam. Sprinkle a little cornstarch on top of the bread and allow to be thoroughly coating. If your bread is not very crisp the toast is too dry and overcooked. Preheat your griddle. When a minute or two of cooking time is almost ready, place a pineapple tidcher or two on the bread. Sprinkle with some kahlua and then top with remaining slice of bread. Repeat on the other side and the cheese is melted as soon as it's finished cooking. You may have to be careful. The bread will still be wet after about 1 to 2 minutes. Serve with a dollop of whip cream or coffee. Great with guacamole.

title: Confetti Salami
ingredients: 20 fresh maraschino cherries | 16 ladyfingers | 1 package fajita seasoning | salt and fresh crushed watercress, to taste | 1 container fresh radicchio, diced | 1 can thousand island dressing
instructions: Heat water in a large skillet over medium heat. Place 4 ladyfingers in a baking dish. Sprinkle about a teaspoon of fajita seasoning on each ladyfinger. Dip the moistened ladyfingers in the batter until coated on all sides, turning as necessary. Place in the skillet in batches and cook until browned on both sides. While still warm, drain off excess grease. Repeat the process until all of the ladyfingers have been baked. Divide remaining fajitas among 4 serving plates. Top with diced radicchio, diced watercress and reserved fajita seasoning. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,pork loin,yogurt,mayonnaise,garlic clove,milk,beef rib,black vinegar
title: Burgundy-Style Ribs With Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin | 2 garlic cloves ( minced ) | 3 tablespoons black vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds ( crushed ) | 4 tablespoons milk | 1 cup yogurt | 1 cup mayonnaise | 2 cups beef rib
instructions: Remove all visible fat from pork loin. Cut all visible fat from beef. Cut pork into slices. In a small bowl, combine the minced garlic with 1 t. Of the black vinegar. Stir in the fenugreek powder. Spread evenly over the pork and marinate in the refrigerator for an hour. Wash meat and remove excess fat. Grill over high heat, turning frequently for about 40 to 50 minutes or until done. Set meat aside. In the meantime, in a blender, combine yogurt, mayonnaise, and minced garlic. Blend mixture until smooth, adding remaining 1 cup of black vinegar gradually. Pour sauce over meat and refrigerate, covered, for several hours or overnight. Serve meat hot.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,baby lima bean,olive oil,pepperoncini pepper,pesto sauce
title: Spicy Asian Lima Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 package baby lima beans, rinsed and drained | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1/4 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium low heat. Add the lima beans, pepperoncini peppers, and curry paste.

title: Miniature Fettuccine With Mexican Chocolate and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces white chocolate, chopped ( at room temperature ) | 1/4 cup masa harina, plus more for dusting | 1 lb fettuccine | 1 package shredded swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons yellow cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 400° & spray a 13 x 5 x 1 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a bowl, combine chocolates & masa harina. Place fettuccine in a bowl & coat with the chocolates. Dip fettuccine in the bowl, then place them in the baking dish. Sprinkle swiss cheese in the baking dish, then pour chocolate mixture over the fettuccine. Sprinkle cornmeal on top & bake 12 - 15 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,beef sausage,vanilla ice cream,pork,ladyfinger,tomato paste,puff pastry,brown sugar
title: Tasty Red Gravy Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs pork, coarsely ground ( i.e. 1-2 lbs total ) | seasoning ( mccormicks montreal brand steak seasoning with pepper ) | 1 cup brown sugar | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 cup vanilla ice cream | 8 ounces soft fresh puff pastry, defrosted | 2 cups ladyfingers
instructions: Make the spicy gravy, preheat oven to 400°f lightly grease a baking sheet. In a large bowl mix sausage, brown sugar, tomato paste and vanilla ice cream until well combined. Transfer the mixture into an ovenproof dish, cover with foil, and keep warm in the oven while making the rolls. Cut the pastry into 3 equal portions and lay on a cutting board with a floured rolling pin. Roll out to rectangles about 10 x 6 and place them on the prepared baking sheet. Using a sharp knife mark 3 circles across and around the rim of the pastry. Spoon 1/2 cup of the spicy gravy onto each pastry circle. Spread the pastry rounds with some of the remaining gravy. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove cover, sprinkle with remaining savory and brown sugar, and continue baking for 5 - 7 more minutes until bubbly and browned. You might have to cook it a bit longer to thicken slightly.

title: Toasted Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb finely ground pine nuts | 1/4 cup ice water | mustard powder
instructions: Heat oven to 250°f. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper. On hot baking sheet, toast pine nuts on sheet 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until golden brown, turning nuts as needed. Place nuts on a waxed paper lined sheet. Sprinkle lightly with mustard powder, pressing through a fine mesh sieve. Cool completely. Break into 1/2 inch pieces. Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,savory,soda water,sesame,jasmine rice,double cream,wheat flour,jicama
title: Cream Crusted Salmon With Jicama and Sesame Rice
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet | 1 pinch dried savory or basil | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame spread | 2 tablespoons rye flour | 5 ounces jicama, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon double cream | 1 tablespoon jiraican rice | 1 teaspoon soda water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/180°f. Place the salmon on the oven tray and bake for 8 - 15 minutes until cooked. Cool the salmon on the salmon when it is cool enough to handle. Trim and remove the fins if you wish. Cut the salmon into 6 - 12 slices. Spray both sides with oil and leave to dry. Place the rye flour, jicama and cream in a small bowl and add the rice, soda and enough water to make a paste. Cover the salmon with the paste and rub it with the paste. Tear off 4 5cm or 5 cm long pieces of salmon and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Wrap them in the rice, pressing in lightly with your fingers, pressing the seeds to help them stick. Transfer the seasoned salmon to an oven proof dish and top with the jicama and sesame seeds. Place in the oven and cook for 40 - 50 minutes until the rice is soft, the salmon cooked. Serve with mustard or sour cream. If liked, serve the rice with a swirl of jam and mustard.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,cocoa,orange juice,curly leaf parsley,chicken bouillon cube,green bell pepper,madras curry powder,french baguette
title: Curly Irish Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf french baguette | 4 cups mixed green and orange slices | 1 medium spanish onion, julienne | 1/2 cup curly leaf parsley | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 4 -6 teaspoons good bourbon or 4 -6 teaspoons madras curry powder | chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Shred french baguette into 1/4 thick slices. Slices should be about 1/2 thick. Trim crusts and ends. Slice onions to about 1/8 thick using a 1/4 cutter or a regular sharp knife. Toss all bread except the baguette slices in bowl with onion, parsley, orange juice and bourbon, stirring. Pour over bread, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or more while bread absorbs marinade. Before serving, garnish with cocoa if desired.

title: Tunisian Bulgar Wheat # 2
ingredients: 3 cups bulgar wheat | 1/2 red onion, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Scoop out a small bowl that covers the bottom of the jar. Place the bulgar into it and break it into smaller chunks so that each chunk has a rounded shape when cooked. Add remaining ingredients to bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate at least 12 hours, but may be up to over night.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,pepper,mozzarella ball,saffron,pine nut,corn oil,red bean
title: Sweet Potato, Great Easy and Simple Succotash
ingredients: 16 ounces red beans, drained | 1/2 teaspoon all purpose flour ( or more ) | 4 ounces frozen mozzarella balls, thawed ( or smaller to fit in to the dish ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 4 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | pepper, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cook whole red beans until they pop, drain well. Heat oil in a large nonstick frying pan, add red beans and brown for five minutes on med high heat. Reduce heat to low and add saffron & 2 - 3 tbsp of water. Cook until mixture is almost a mush. If you need to add any water add it now. Mix well and add cheeses, pepper & pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,tiger prawn,graham cracker crumb,sirloin
title: Roast Pork and Peppers Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs ( regular size ) | 500 g sirloin | 1 red bell pepper | 1 large red bell pepper
instructions: Slice the sirloin into about 5 cm thick discs, about 1 1/2 inches long. Slice the red and red peppers into chunks. Dice the red pepper into 3/8 inch pieces. Mix the pork and peppers into a bowl. Form the crumb mixture into the meat, using some of the crumb mixture. Roll the meat out on a board that has been sprinkled with the remaining crumbs, rolling it around until it is all coated. Place the meat onto a sheet of greaseproof paper, and cover with plastic wrap. Let it sit for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours in the refrigerator. To serve, skewer the meat and bell pepper pieces onto skewers. Place skewers amongst your chosen accompaniments, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,red food coloring,granny smith apple,self raising flour
title: Apple Scones
ingredients: 4 1/4 cups self raising flour | 1 cup tart apple | 1 granny smith apple | 1 tablespoon red food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or 140°c. Peel and core. Cut apples into 6ths. Sprinkle with food coloring. Make a well in the centre. Add flour and apple. Stir with an electric beater until dough forms. Turn out onto a floured board. Roll to a thickness you can then cut with a round cookie cutter. Place on an oven tray. Cook for 20 minutes or until lightly browned.. Cut into wedges with a sharp knife. Serve with jam or icecream.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,picante sauce,turnip,thai fish sauce,mango chutney,saffron thread
title: Spiced Turnips and Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 lb peeled turnip, and sliced on the bias | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread, crumbled | 8 cups sweet picante sauce | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 medium mango chutney | celery rib, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the turnips in a large roasting pan, and coat them with the sausage and crumbled saffron. Make a well for the sauce in the center and add the picante sauce, fish sauce, and mango chutney. Cover the pan and bake until tender, about 45 minutes. Remove the turnips from the oven and toss them in the chutney until well coated and lightly coated.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,vegetable oil cooking spray,dill,bok choy,italian dressing
title: Japanese Bok Choy Salad
ingredients: 6 medium bok choy, sliced | 1/4 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill or 2 tablespoons dried dill | 2 tablespoons shredded italian dressing, divided | 1/2 cup cashew nuts, toasted
instructions: Wash the bok choy, trim stems and then cut into matchsticks. Place in a bowl with the oil and 1/2 tablespoon dill and toss to coat. Cover and keep hot while you prepare the dressing. In a small bowl add remainingd dill and dressing and stir to combine. Add half of the salad vegetables and toss until well coated and heated through. Spray a small non stick frying pan with cooking spray and add the reserved dressing. Heat to smoking and cook vegetables, stirring, just until the greens are bright green, approximately 1 - 2 minutes. Transfer the cooked greens to a serving plate or platter and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 tablespoon dill.

title: Jasmine Brown Rice
ingredients: 4 cups jasmine rice | 1 ounce sliced blanched almond lace swiss cheese
instructions: Place rice, cheese and slivered almonds in a pot. Add enough water to come up to 3/4 of the way over the top. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer for 20 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork and enjoy.

title: Big Ed's Shish Kebabs
ingredients: 1 pound swordfish steaks, cut thinly, across the grain | 1 bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped | 1 package instant orzo pasta | 1/2 cup prepared sweet and sour mix | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Thread 2 or 3 kabobs onto the skewers. Sprinkle with pepper strips and thyme. Cook kabobs in a large skillet over medium high heat for 5 to 7 minutes or until they are firm and grill marks appear. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the orzo in the boiling water, uncovered, stirring occasionally until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain. Mix orzo, sweet and sour mix, and mozzarella cheese together in a medium bowl.

title: Coconut Soup
ingredients: 400 g bok choy, washed, trimmed but not peeled | 1 liter chicken stock | freshly shredded coconut
instructions: Blend the coconut and stock in food processor for 5 to 20 seconds. Pour into a jug and stir in the shredded coconut. Cover and refrigerate until cold.

Random Ingredients: hot noodle,almond paste,sage leaf,cherry,nutritional yeast,brussels sprout,white bean
title: Cherry Brussels Sprouts and White Beans
ingredients: 3 cups brussels sprouts, trimmed | 1/2 cup cherry flavored beans or 1/2 cup other frozen sprouts | 8 ounces prepared brussels sprouts | 1/4 cup almond paste | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 2 tablespoons dried sage leaves | 6 cups prepared hot noodles
instructions: Place brussels sprouts on cookie sheet and bake in 425f oven 15 - 20 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: dark mexican beer,guacamole,tomato sauce,baking powder,cucumber,tomato green chile pepper
title: Texas Cottage Cheese Cone Bread
ingredients: 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers, drained | 12 ounces guacamole | 1 cucumber - peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 cups dark mexican beer | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Drain the tomato sauce from the cans of diced tomato and green chile peppers into a bowl. Add guacamole, diced tomatoes and green chile peppers to the tomato sauce and mix until thoroughly combined. Spread 1/2 the tomato mixture into the hollowed out center of a 9x5 inch loaf pan, and top with about 1/2 the guacamole mixture. Top with the remaining guacamole mixture. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until the top is browned. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,jalapeno pepper,italian seasoning,pecorino romano cheese,beet
title: Baked Beets
ingredients: 2 large ripe beets | 1 teaspoon bottled minced jalapeno pepper | 1 tablespoon minced fresh lemon verbena leaves ( or more ) if fresh or 1 tablespoon oregano leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons shredded pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Cut bottoms off beets and peel. Do not remove tops of beets. Place beets on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake them until tops are golden brown and soft, about 1 hour. Cool beets. Remove tops and discard. Remove beets to a large bowl, add jalepeno, lemon juice, fish sauce, 3/4 of the cheese, and 3/4 of the chopped basil. Mix well. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 of cheese. Spread mixture on the beets, top with remaining basil, and sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Bake, covered, 1 hr and 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,green pepper,lime gelatin,lager beer,corn syrup,russet potato,maraschino cherry
title: Beer and Cabbage Jello
ingredients: 6 cups lager beer, divided | 4 packages lime gelatin ( 2 packages ) | 2 lbs small russet potatoes, about 24 | 1 1/2 lbs small red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1/2 medium green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: Pour 3/4 cup of the beer into a large bowl. Soak the lime gelatin in a small amount of the lager, about 10 minutes. Drain the gelatin, return lime gelatin to the bowl, and beat with a wooden spoon over low heat until the gelatin has dissolved and is smooth. Bring the remaining 2/4 cup of beer to a boil. Cut the potatoes in half lengthwise, and set aside in a bowl of ice water.

title: Apple & Raspberry Tart
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups tart apples ( granny smith, mcintosh or other tart apple ) | 2 tablespoons fresh raspberries | 8 ounces light cream cheese | 1 lime wedge | 3/4 cup sliced red apple
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f and lightly grease tart tins. Core the apples and cut them into thin wedges. Place the apples on a plate or in the bowl of a food processor with the raspberries and cream cheese. Pulse until smooth and well mixed. Carefully stir the apple and raspberry mixture into the tart tins, pressing the fruit gently into the cream cheese. Cut the apple slices into thin shreds, placing them in a single layer on top of the tart along with the red apple slices. Pour the warm tart into the tart tins. Bake about 15 to 18 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the crusts are lightly browned. When tart has cooled, warm a serving platter. Place the tart in the center of a platter, pour the warm tart juices around it and serve.

title: Jicama and Raspberry Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup jicama, peeled and chopped | 1 cup red bell pepper, diced | 1 cup diced tomato ketchup | 1/2 cup passion fruit, finely chopped | 1 cup kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( or a 1.5 oz pkg dried kidney beans ) | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam or 2 tablespoons jelly, flavour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a salad bowl. Cover and chill for 2 hours, or longer. Just before serving, scatter with jam.

title: Budrang Sauce - Thai Style
ingredients: 6 ounces green lentils | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons palm sugar, grated | 4 tablespoons green peppers, minced | 1 teaspoon cocoa | 1 scallion, minced
instructions: Rinse the lentils and boil in very large quantity of water, covered, for 15 minutes or until tender and then drain well. In a bowl, mix the remaining ingredients. Add the cooked lentils to the mixture and mix well, or alternatively, use a hand held blender to puree and add it to the other ingredients. This sauce is a little hard and has weirdly shaped shaped pinches of kokkien or similar at times.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,maraschino cherry,baking soda,coffee,meal flour,dill weed,beef mince
title: Polish Meatballs
ingredients: 600 g ground beef mince | 1 large baking soda | 250 g stone ground bulgar grind flour ( also called bulgur or bulgaric mix ) | 1 tablespoon dried maraschino cherries | 1 tablespoon dill weed | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons instant coffee
instructions: Combine all ingredients with hands. Shape into meatballs and fry in a moderate oven until well browned. Serve with polenta and salad.

title: Hogao a Líoma (Australian Apple Salad)
ingredients: 8 medium aubergines | 4 small brussels sprouts | 1 tablespoon allspice ( optional ) | 4 large red delicious apples | 1 pint grape | 1 pint oyster
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Cook the aubergines for 7 - 10 minutes, depending on their size. Remove and allow to cool. Meanwhile, slice the brussels sprouts into 1 cm slices. Scrub and slice the apples into long thin strips. Heat oil in a large skillet. Cook the brussels sprouts for approximately 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the brussels sprouts are light and tender. Place this mixture in a serving bowl. Slice the aubergines into quarters and add them to the aubergine and sprouts. Sprinkle the allspice on top. Drizzle this with the oyster liquor, cover and serve.

title: Horseradish Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups almond meal | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 4 chicken pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. In a medium bowl combine the almond meal and horseradish. Spread the mixture over the chicken pieces. Place the chicken in a single layer in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 75 minutes, basting frequently with the pan juices.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,chicken breast fillet,cayenne powder,red bell pepper,pecorino romano cheese,clam,maple flavoring
title: Mexican Crockpot Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast fillets | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 750 g chopped clams, reserve juice | 1/2 tablespoon maple flavoring | 1 red bell pepper, cut into strips | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne powder ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken breasts in crockpot. Add rest of ingredients except cheese. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or on high for 1 hour. Stir well.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,barbecue sauce,pickle relish,guacamole,panang curry paste,pork tenderloin,cottage cheese
title: BBQ Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon guacamole | 1 teaspoon green chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon prepared barbecue sauce | 1 ounce panang curry paste | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1 can condensed chipotle mild pickle relish
instructions: Place pork tenderloin between plastic wrap and pound on one side for about 1 minute or until it is just thin enough to slice. Cut a slit in the side of the pork for the pickle, if desired. Reserve leftovers for sauce. To serve, spread guacamole on the pork and garnish with green chiles, barbecue sauce, curry paste and cottage cheese. Spoon relish over. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Ciabatta and Shredded Chicken on French Bread
ingredients: 1/3 cup orange rind, grated | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/3 cup chicken broth | 1 -2 tablespoon red jalapeno, seeded and chopped | 4 ciabatta, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 4 1/2 ounces ham, very thinly sliced | 1 package focaccia bread, split, cut in 12 slices
instructions: Cook orange rind in small saucepan over medium heat, stirring, 1 minute or till pale, stirring often. Combine orange rind and dijon in small bowl. Add chicken broth and jalapeno.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,jalapeno pepper,green chilies,corn,asiago cheese,bourbon,nicoise olive
title: Pork Tenderloins With Green Chile Sau
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 cans green chilies, diced | 3/4 cup nicoise olives, sliced | 1 can sweet corn, drained | 1/3 cup bourbon or 1/3 cup red wine | 2 large jalapeno peppers, diced | 1/4 cup shredded asiago cheese
instructions: Combine green chilies with nicoise olives, corn and bourbon. Reserve 1/2 cup liquid. Lightly moisten pork with reserved liquid, being careful not to marinate. Set aside. Grill pork over medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes per side, or until done. Top with jalapenos. Sprinkle with cheese. Add reserved liquid and return to heat. Serve.

title: Bun-Bun
ingredients: 2 boxes whole wheat couscous | 2 cups pineapple chunks | 4 eggs | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | soy sauce | 1 lemon | 2 bunches fresh nuts ( optional )
instructions: Soak 1 or 2 wooden skewers in water for five minutes prior to making recipe. In the meantime, soak the pineapples. Drain and reserve the juice. In a large bowl add the pineapples and 1 1/2 cups of juice. In a different bowl whisk eggs with nutmeg and 2/3 cup of hot water. Then, pour this into the bowl with the pineapple. Dip the soaked skewer into the egg mixture, coating it evenly. Then, dip the soaked bamboo skewers into this and then coat completely with the egg mixture. Repeat until all ingredients are used up. In a pan add 1/2 cup of soy sauce, 1/4 cup lemon juice and a few nuts, if desired. Boil the buns with 1/2 cup of soy sauce and 1/4 cup lemon juice until golden on both sides. Take out and let cool. Serve.

Random Ingredients: white bread,beef roast,black pepper,queso blanco,chicken breast fillet,english cucumber,cherry brandy
title: Tortas De Queso (Cuban Chicken Sandwich)
ingredients: 1 boneless skinless chicken breast fillet, cut into strips | 1 slice white bread, sliced thin | 1 -2 slice queso blanco | english cucumber, halved crossways | 1 ounce dried cherries or 1 ounce black cherries | 3 ounces dry white wine or 3 ounces balsamic vinegar | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Lay the chicken on the slice of bread. Layer with the cheeses, cucumber, cherries, and pepper.

title: Noodles With Baked Doughnuts - No Boil
ingredients: 1 -2 cup whole wheat flour | salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 3 1/3 cups cooked noodles | 3 -3 cups loosely packed fresh basil leaves, torn in half
instructions: Place flour in a large mixing bowl and seasonings, then gradually stir in the noodles. Dump noodles in boiling water and cook, while stirring until they are tender, about 2 minutes. Divide noodles among six serving bowls, sprinkle with basil and serve.

title: Raspberry Peaches With Avocado
ingredients: 1 large ripe avocado | 1/4 cup raspberry fruit cocktail or 1/4 cup seedless raspberry cocktail | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | fresh cracked pepper, about 30 to 60 ml ( or more )
instructions: Cut the avocado in half lengthwise. Remove the pit and peel, removing the white membrane and seed. Cut each half into 8 wedges. Using your favourite method, arrange the avocado wedge on 4 serving plates. Drizzle the fruit cocktail with a splash of vanilla and sprinkle the pepper over the avocado wedges. Serve.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,vegetable broth,red wine vinegar,ginger,pickling cucumber
title: Japanese Pickled Cucumbers
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup vegetable broth or 1/2 cup bottled vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons pickling cucumbers, finely minced | 1 teaspoon ginger ( optional ) | 1 head boston lettuce, separated into leaves
instructions: Combine the vinegar, broth and cucumber. Cover and let stand for 15 minutes. Toss with the ginger and cool for 15 minutes. Strain the vinegar and discard the excess liquid. Stir in the celery.

title: Vegetarian Mexican Barley Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen mixed vegetables, thawed ( such as spinach, mustard, chard, red bell peppers, broccoli and cauliflower ) | 4 cups vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons barley ( optional )
instructions: Thaw the mixed vegetables if they are fresh not frozen. Combine the vegetables and the vegetables in a large saucepan, add the broth, barley, and pepper. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat.

title: Mexican Style Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb monterey jack cheese | 1/2 vanilla bean
instructions: Toast the vanilla bean in the oven until brown and fragrant. Cut the vanilla bean lengthwise. Cut the cheese into 3 to 4 ounces pieces. In a large frypan or enameled cast iron skillet, heat the oil to 325?f degrees. Add the vanilla bean, cheese and toast until cheese has melted. Serve with warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: coriander,yellow bell pepper,kosher salt,superfine sugar,iceberg lettuce,cornstarch,dungeness crab
title: Sweet and Sour Crab, Lisbon Style Style
ingredients: 1 medium yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 lbs dungeness crab | iceberg lettuce, to serve | 1 -2 sprig coriander ( cilantro )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the crab and lettuce in a large pan. Cook over medium heat until bubbling and lightly browned. Add the crab meat and cook until the crab changes color from translucent to a slightly pink, about 4 - 6 minutes. Place the lettuce leaves in a serving bowl, remove the crab from the pan and place on top. Arrange the crab on top of the lettuce and serve with bread and salsa #81796 and your favourite hot sauce.

title: Taco Mix II
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground pistachios | 1 packet taco seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, mix ground pistachios with taco seasoning.

title: Panko Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Mix the panko, bread crumbs, and salt together in an ovenproof bowl. Place the bread crumbs and bread crumbs in a resealable plastic bag or bowl. Heat the pan over medium high heat for 30 seconds. Add enough water to the pan just to coat the bottom of the pan, and place the bag in the pan. Cover, bring to a boil, and gently lift out the contents with a slotted spoon. Place each diner's bread crumb on their plate.

title: Kartoffelpuffer (German Mixed Vegetables)
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated biscuits | 2 packages frozen mixed vegetables | 3 slices hard-cooked eggs | 1 package small curd cottage cheese
