instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. On a floured surface, roll each biscuit slice into a thin circle. Place biscuit circles on a greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and turn each biscuit circle over. Arrange veggies in a ring on top of the biscuits and top with eggs and cottage cheese. Reduce oven temperature and return biscuits to the oven for 5 minutes, or until golden.

title: Grilled French Bread (Antilles)
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 cup catsup | 1 1/2 cups fresh strawberries, sliced | fresh cilantro stem, for garnish
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Place bread slices on a grill basket, close fitting it on the grill, and grill for 5 to 10 minutes, turning frequently. Meanwhile, mix together catsup and strawberries. Spread half of the salad dressing on the bread slices, and top with half of the cheese and half of the remaining dressing. Close lid and grill 5 minutes on each side, or until the cheese is melted and the bread is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,red currant,red wine,sazon goya con culantro y achiote
title: Quick and Easy Sausage and Pasta
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bowtie ) pasta | 3 tablespoons dry red wine or 3 tablespoons chicken broth | 3 sazon goya con culantro y achiote | 4 tablespoons red currants or 4 tablespoons raisins
instructions: In a large pot, cover the pasta with plenty of cold water. Bring to a boil over medium heat, removing from the heat if the water boils too quickly. Place the pasta in a large bowl and add enough cold water to cover the pasta. In a small bowl, stir together the wine or broth and sazon. Pour the liquid into a separate, wide dish or frying pan. Drain the pasta and toss with the sazon and wine broth. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ghee butter,provolone cheese,tomato green chilies,hot chili pepper,bean sprout,chicken leg
title: Maharaja Chicken
ingredients: 4 large chicken legs | 3 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 package provolone cheese, shredded | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, drained ( reserve juices ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 dried hot chili pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Place whole chicken legs in a large baking dish. Heat the ghee in a medium saucepan over medium heat until bubbly. Pour ghee in a slow stream into the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom of the pan with ghee. Spread 1/4 cup of the provolone cheese atop the ghee. Arrange the chicken legs in the oven, and bake for 20 minutes, then add the remaining ingredients, cover, and bake until the meat is very tender, about 1 1/4 hours. Uncover and continue baking, adding the additional ghee if the cheese begins to brown.

title: Black Beans and Cheese
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed and mashed | 1 1/2 cups shredded american cheese | 3 tablespoons chili bean paste, thawed ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl combine beans, cheese and chili bean paste. Mix well until cheese is melted and can be added to hot bean mixture just before serving.

title: Clams Ghana
ingredients: 4 lbs watermelon, washed | 1 bottle clam juice, chilled ( about 3 to 4 l. bottle )
instructions: Cut the melon into 1 1/2 inch long wedges. Place in a large deep bowl. Add the clam juice and toss to coat. Let stand at room temp for at least 1 hour and preferably 1 day, stirring occasionally. Transfer the mixture to a saucepan. Add the cabbages or any other seafood of your choice and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low. Simmer gently, partially covered, for about 30 minutes, until the sauce has thickened a little and the watermelon is tender.

title: Tuna Chicken
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs, bone in | salt and pepper | 3 cans solid tuna
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place chicken thighs in a large dutch oven with at least a half inch of of oil on top.. Sprinkle salt and pepper over all the thighs. Add enough water to completely submerge them, and season with a little salt. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes, or until no pink remains. Drain excess fat, and serve alongside noodles or rice.

title: Tamari Garlic Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 pound cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 4 slices white bread | 2 tablespoons tamari, or more if desired | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon grated cecorino cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a shallow baking dish. Arrange mushrooms in the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over mushrooms, and lightly sprinkle with thyme. Bake in the preheated oven until mushrooms are tender and bread golden brown, about 40 minutes. Sprinkle bread with tamari and crumbled cecorino cheese, and serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,baby carrot,tofu,black bean,italian seasoning,mango chutney,pesto
title: Tofu-Spiced Black Bean and Carrots Wraps
ingredients: 1 -2 ounce firm tofu, drained and pressed, reserve juice | 2 -3 tablespoons pesto | 1 1/2 teaspoons black beans, drained, reserving juice | 6 -10 baby carrots, cut in 4 strips | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | mango chutney ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Spread tofu with oil in the form of a square, and sprinkle with a little salt. Cook tofu until browned over medium high heat. Remove tofu, and set aside. Add pesto, black beans, carrots, ginger garlic paste, and seasoning. Stir fry until carrots are slightly softened. Spoon the mixture into the center of the tofu. Spoon some mango chutney over the top, and place wrap in preheated oven. After 15 minutes, the wrap will be slightly crisp. Remove from oven, and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mint-Orange Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup freshly chopped mint | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder, or more as required | 1 large orange, zested and juiced
instructions: Combine mint, cilantro, cocoa powder, and orange zest in a mortar.

title: Aussie Beef Kabobs from Brazil (Coco Blend)
ingredients: 1 cup pineapples, chunks drained and chopped | 1 cup hazelnuts, toasted | 1 beef stock cube | 1 star anise
instructions: Thread alternating pieces of sliced beef onto skewers. Place nuts, star anise and 1 piece of anchovy on each piece of skewer. Grill or broil until meat is thoroughly cooked. Serve with a little dip.

title: Totally Sweet  Pineapple Taco!
ingredients: 4 cans crushed pineapple, drained | 1/4 cup finely chopped white onion | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon maple syrup, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1 green onion, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix pineapple, white onion, taco seasoning, and maple syrup together in a non stick skillet over medium high heat.

title: Chickpea Karo Syrup and Veggies  (Kettlewein)
ingredients: 4 cups cooked chickpeas ( canned okay ) | 12 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 20 minutes | 1/4 cup celery leaves ( karo syrup ) ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons karo syrup | 1/2 teaspoon karo syrup or 1/2 teaspoon sugar, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine the chick peas, stalks of celery, karo syrup, and sugar. Cover, and continue cooking until desired consistency. Serve warm, or chilled.

Random Ingredients: soba noodle,allspice berry,sea scallop,espresso,ice,beef stock chicken
title: Spiced Scallops
ingredients: 1 kg sea scallop | 5 tablespoons espresso | 1/4 teaspoon allspice berry | 1/4 - 1/2 cup beef stock or 1/4-1/2 cup chicken stock | 350 g soba noodles, cooked and drained according to package directions | ice
instructions: Rinse and dry sea scallop. Place 1/4 t espresso in a small heavy based saucepan with the allspice berries, then bring to boil over medium high heat. Cover and simmer for 3 - 3 minutes. Strain, discard solids and pour the liquid into a small bowl. Press the scallops gently with your thumb to extract liquid. Discard the spiced liquid and set scallops aside. In another small saucepan, heat remaining butter over medium high heat until foam subsides, then whisk in the stock. Bring to boil, then reduce the heat and simmer 1 - 2 minutes. Return the scallops to the pan, season with salt and allow to sit 5 - 7 minutes. To serve, place 2 - 4 pieces of cooked rice on each plate. Spoon the hot sauce on top and scallops on the rice.

title: Doro Wat
ingredients: 32 ounces chicken stock or 32 ounces chicken broth | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a stockpot, bring to the boil, cover the pot and simmer on medium heat for 2 hours. Turn off the heat and leave pot for one hour. Remove allspice and serve.

title: Easy Beef Roll Ups (Lazy Burritos)
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, room temperature | 2 lbs stewing beef | 3 leaves fresh rosemary or 3 leaves basil, chopped
instructions: Whip the cream cheese until creamy. Chop the meat and add to the cream cheese. Gently fold in the chopped sprigs of rosemary or basil. Refrigerate 6 - 24 hours. Roll out 1/4 of the dough at a time and line the base and sides of a jelly roll pan about 1/8 inch deep. Sprinkle the top with a little extra shredded cheese, if desired. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with a side of salad.

title: Porcini Mushroom Pizzas(Vegan)
ingredients: 500 g fresh mushrooms, trimmed, cleaned and de-stemmed | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons harissa | 1 tablespoon chili paste with garlic | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Cut away the root ends of the mushrooms. Cut a 1cm cube cutter out of top layer of mushroom with the grain of the mushroom and remove the hard gills. Cut caps into half, then cut a 1 cm cube from the center to make four pieces. In a small saucpan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and stir fry for five minutes, until slightly softened and releasing some of their liquid. Stir in the harissa, chili paste, and nutmeg. Season with salt and pepper to taste and cook a further 1 minute. Remove from heat. Remove the lid and stir through any of the cooking liquid from the base of the pot. Set aside. Heat a non stick small frying pan over medium heat. Add the prawns a few at a time and cook for about 5 minutes until they turn pink. Gently push open each prawn, leaving the tip of the prawn intact. Add the mixture back to the frying pan with the mushrooms and cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes to heat through. Serve the pizzas warm with crusty bread and tomato ketchup.

title: Cafe Rio Pork Tenderloin.
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno pepper
instructions: Place tenderloin, fat side up in roasting pan. Insert sharp knife or knife blade in center of tenderloin and insert jalapeno pepper. Turn up side of meat. Cover securely with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven about 1 hour or until pork is fork tender and internal temperature reaches 170 degrees. Shred meat of course.

Random Ingredients: coffee,anchovy paste,asian fish sauce,cremini mushroom,tomato puree
title: Vegan Vietnamese Hot Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1/3 cup heinz hot dark spicy fish sauce | 2 tablespoons asian fish sauce | 2 tablespoons pure tomato puree ( or 1 tbsp tomato paste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon anchovy paste, minced ( optional )
instructions: If using canned tomato paste, drain and reserve 1/4 cup of the tomato paste. Rinse and roughly chop all the mushrooms. In a small bowl, combine hot dark fish sauce, fish sauce, puree, and anchovy paste or any other optional ingredients and stir to blend. If using homemade sauce, combine the reserved tomato paste, mushrooms, and hot dark spicy fish sauce to taste and stir well. Serve over cooked and cooled white or whole grain rice.

Random Ingredients: french baguette,nutmeg,pizza sauce,cashew nut,coconut milk,cremini mushroom
title: Healthy Veggie French Bread
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk | 1/4 cup pizza sauce | 1/4 lb cremini mushroom, sliced | 1/4 cup cashew nuts, coarsely chopped | ground nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Slice baguette into 3 or 4 slices, about 12 inches long. Cut each slice into 8 triangles. Whisk together coconut milk and pizza sauce. Add mushrooms and nuts. Sprinkle top of bread with nutmeg. Wrap bread in foil and bake in a 350 degree oven for about 40 minutes or until bread is very tender.

title: Irish Boiled Potatoes
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes, peeled | 1/2 cup raisins ( divided ) | 4 slices white bread, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 4 tablespoons margarine or 4 tablespoons butter, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup apple cider or 1/2 cup apple juice
instructions: Scrub potatoes and peel. Dry potatoes on paper towels. Pierce with a fork 2 or 3 times per layer. Arrange in a large casserole dish. Gently cover with water. Bake at 300°f for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Transfer potatoes to a large bowl and mash. Add 1/2 cup raisins and 1/2 cup sliced bread. Mash til smooth. Dot with margarine. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup raisins. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: hot chili powder,margarine,beef shank,chicken bouillon powder,baby spinach,pearl barley
title: Slow Cooker Spinach and Barley Soup
ingredients: 4 cans chicken bouillon powder | 3 cups fresh baby spinach, washed and sliced | 2 tablespoons margarine | 11 ounces jar pearl barley | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped dried hot chili powder | 2 1/2 lbs beef shank, cut in half
instructions: Dissolve bouillon in 3 cups water in large bowl or baking dish. Add spinach, barley, pepper powder, and chili powder. Cover. Cook on high 4 hours. Add shank. Continue cooking for 30 minute or until the shank is tender, and soup is the consistency of spaghetti sauce. Note, if soup is too thick, thin it with 2 - 3 t cold water.

Random Ingredients: queso blanco,fruit,cheddar cheese,amaretto liqueur,chipotle chile adobo,lime,pork loin
title: Ranch Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 cup crumbled queso blanco | 1/2 cup shredded mild cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup grated kraft texas queso blanco | 2 tablespoons light amaretto liqueur | 2 canned chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 1 lb boneless lean pork loin, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°. In a large bowl, combine 1/2 cup queso blanco, 1/4 cup cheddar cheese, the amaretto, chipotle chiles and pork. Toss with hands to evenly coat. Arrange 2 rows of 4 inch strips of pork in a 1 1/2 quart baking dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Spoon some of the cheese mixture on top of the pork and top with another layer of pork. Top with remaining 2 layers of cheese mixture. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup queso blanco. Bake for 25 minutes or until the pork is cooked through. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheddar cheese.

title: Cheesy Curry-Spoked Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup tapioca flour | 1 tablespoon curry ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1 1/2 lbs smoked fish fillets ( such as halibut or cod, with skin ) | 1 package taco shells, warmed
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the tapioca flour, curry paste, and anchovy paste until well combined. Rinse and dry the fish and pat completely dry with paper towels. Cut an x in the center of each taco shell half and carefully remove from the shell with your fingers. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the curry mixture onto the outer half of each taco. Place one fillet onto each taco and sprinkle with any leftover masala mixture. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,mushroom,green apple,sirloin tip roast,okra,cardamom pod,tortilla
title: Baked Beef Curry - My Family Recipe
ingredients: 450 g sirloin tip roast, beef, cut in strips | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 6 cardamom pods | 120 g mixed mushrooms | 2 green apples, peeled and sliced ( optional ) | 2 cups chopped okra ( optional ) | 50 g tortillas, to serve
instructions: Heat oven to 180c or gas fry sirloin tip in a pan until browned and sealed. Remove to a casserole dish. Deglaze pan with a little oil, scraping up any browned bits. Stir in flour, cardamom, mushrooms and apples. Cover and transfer to oven for 1 hour. Remove lid, stir and add okras/okra if using. Continue to cook uncovered for another 30 minutes or until golden, stirring from time to time and adding more oil if required. Serve in large bowls with tortillas or rice for a tasty entree or main dish with side of indian bread if using. This recipe makes a large batch, depending on how you put up for guests to help themselves.

title: Japanese Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups saltine crackers | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Clean mushrooms. Remove stems. Cut caps in half, leave whole if any. Cut remaining mushroom caps in half if large. In a pan add water and saltines and cook till water is reduced a bit and crackers are cooked but not mushy. Serve over steamed rice or as a side dish. Enjoy.

title: Brown Rice Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice, uncooked ( about 3 cups ) or 1/2 cup white pearl barley | 2/3 cup chopped spanish onion | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 cup grated fresh mozzarella cheese | 10 tortillas, warmed, about 10 | additional fat, as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine all ingredients except the 3/4 cup mozzarella on a cookie sheet. Bake 25 minutes or until rice is tender and moisture is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: cream,lettuce leaf,nonfat cream,red chili,coriander seed,beef stew meat,buttermilk
title: South Indian Sour Cream Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/2 cup coriander seed, crushed | 2 tablespoons crushed red chili | 4 large lettuce leaves | 4 sour cream, garnish
instructions: Thread beef, sour cream, buttermilk and crushed coriander seeds on bamboo skewers. Toss beef with buttermilk mixture and allow to marinate for 30 minutes. Grill on each side for 6 - 8 minutes or until done. Cut into 3/4 inch pieces. Serve beef with coriander dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,kabocha squash,cherry tomato,chipotle chile adobo,red salmon
title: Finger Taters #5FIX
ingredients: 1/2 lb red salmon | 1 cup chunky salsa, your favorite brand | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 kabocha squash, peeled, cut in 1 '' slices | 1 chipotle chiles in adobo, seeded and minced
instructions: Slice salmon into 1/2 inch slices. Place in a casserole dish. Pour salsa over salmon. Cook in a preheated 350 oven for 5 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Meanwhile, combine the cherry tomatoes, kabocha squash and chipotle in a large bowl. To serve, top with salmon.

Random Ingredients: parsley,vegetable oil cooking spray,hot green chili pepper,quinoa,asafoetida powder,white rum,butternut squash,fish
title: Beef & Quinoa Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 3/4 lb lean ground beef or 3/4 lb ground turkey | 1 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 1 can white rum | 1 cup cooked quinoa, rinsed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley ( optional ) | 2 -4 large hot green chili peppers, chopped ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked butternut squash, cut into 1-inch pieces ( optional ) or 2 cups sweet potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium high heat, and add the beef. When the meat is crumbly and the meat is well browned, stir in the asafetida. Remove the beef mixture with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the rum to the pan and warm, stirring constantly. Add half of the cooked quinoa and stir well so that the mixture is coated with the rum. Return the beef mixture to the pan. Add the cooked meat, and cook covered over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add the other half of the quinoa and the cooked quinoa. Stir and mix well with the meat until everything is well blended and the mixture is thoroughly mixed. Stir in the chopped or chopped greens about 5 minutes before it is done.

title: Prawns (Shrimp) With Ginger, Onions, and Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg medium prawns, peeled, deveined, the body leaving the tail intact | 1 inch fresh gingerroot | 1 large onion | 1 bay leaf | 1 small yellow pepper
instructions: Peel the onion, cut into large dice. Slice the pepper into small rings about 4 inches long. Heat the oil in a wide frying pan. Add the onion and gingerroot and fry over low heat, stirring often, until light golden, around 5 to 6 minutes. Strain out the excess oil, then set the ginger root and onion aside. Add the prawn to the pan, breaking it up with the back of a spoon as it cooks with the onions. Sprinkle with the bay leaf and stir to combine. Cover and cook over very low heat until the prawns turn pink and curled. Remove the shrimp to a serving bowl. Remove the bay leaf and ginger root. Dice the remaining shrimp. Toss with the prawns, onions and ginger root mixture. Serve hot, with a crusty bread.

title: Guacamole Wings
ingredients: 2 - 3 lbs chicken wings | 4 -6 baking potatoes | 6 tablespoons ketchup, divided | 3 tablespoons fresh horseradish ( not salt ) | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon bottled horseradish | 1 teaspoon ground guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 350°f. Place the chicken wings in a large oven proof dish, cover and cook in the oven for 1 hour. Bake the potatoes on 180c or 350f for 1 hour. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Peel and dice the potatoes. Add 4 tablespoons of the ketchup to the potatoes to give them a dipping consistency and coat lightly. Add the horseradish and the powdered chicken bouillon and mix thoroughly. Remove the chicken wings from the oven and place them in a large baking dish. Pour the potatoes over them and scatter on the reserved horseradish butter. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked, browned and crispy but not too crispy. Drizzle the remaining ketchup over the chicken wings and serve with additional horseradish butter.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,cumin,beef stock,hard egg yolk,green onion,green chilies,beet,rump roast
title: Mexican Pot Roast on the Half Shell
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump roast | 1 lb beet, fresh | 1 bunch green onion, chopped | 2/3 cup canned diced green chilies | 2/3 cup canned diced red sweet pickled beets | 1/2 - 1 cup beef stock | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 4 hard-boiled egg yolks, to garnish
instructions: For the rump roast, place the roast in a large slow cooker with just enough water inside to cover. Cook for at least 2 hours or until the roast shreds easily with a fork. Remove the beef from the slow cooker. Shred the beef into bite sized pieces and set aside. Pull the beet apart into shreds, peel away the hard, outer green leaves and cut off tough stems. Place the shreds in a bowl and add the chilies, pickled beets, beef stock, and cumin. Set the pot over medium heat, cover, and simmer for at least 30 minutes to 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Add more water if necessary to keep the mixture moist. Remove the pot from the heat and stir the shredded beef with a slotted spoon. Garnish the rump roast with egg yolks, if desired. Serve with tortillas, sour cream, salsa and green vegetables.

title: Calama's Crawfish and Veggie Skillet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mace ( or a mix of dried ) or 2 tablespoons fennel | 1 lb crawfish | 16 ounces zucchini, halved lengthwise and crosswise | 8 ounces broccoli
instructions: In a 9 x 13 inch ovenproof skillet over medium high heat, add the mace, cover, and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant and toasted. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 3 - 5 minutes. Reserve, if using, and slice 1/4 inch deep. Meanwhile, remove stems from zucchini and cut into strips about 1 inch wide. Add the zucchini and broccoli to skillet and stir constantly for 2 minutes, or until zucchini and broccoli are hot but crisp. Add the crawfish and mace and cook for 1 - 2 minutes, or just until heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Rakottiri Sauce Base
ingredients: 3 -6 tablespoons red curry paste ( to suit taste ) | 1 teaspoon white pepper ( to suit )
instructions: Heat the curry paste in a small pot on medium heat. It should turn a light brown color. Remove from heat. Add white pepper. Stir to coat.

title: Quick Caribbean Sunset Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 tablespoon orange-flavored pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon chopped slivered almonds | 1 head escarole, chopped
instructions: Whisk tarragon, pineapple juice, and almonds together in a bowl. Add escarole and toss.

title: Basic Makai Nariyan (Spicy Green Pepper Filling for Cakes)
ingredients: 1 large green pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Use immediately or store in a covered jar, for up to 1 year.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,bulgur wheat,cornmeal,spinach leaf,green chili,macadamia nut
title: Budino
ingredients: 2 cups bulgur wheat | 1 1/3 cups apple cider vinegar | 8 ounces spinach leaves | 8 ounces green chili | 1/3 cup coriander or 1/3 cup macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped | 6 tablespoons cornmeal, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the bulgur wheat, vinegar, spinach, chilies, and nuts in a large mixing bowl together. Stir in the cornmeal until the mixture has a smooth, creamy texture. Chill 1 hour or overnight serve.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,extra virgin olive oil,vegetable stock
title: Sauteed Peanuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons peanut oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons other vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 7 ounces whole-wheat frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Heat the oil in a 12 inch skillet over medium heat. When the oil shimmers, add the vegetables and, stirring frequently, cook, stirring, until the vegetables are glazed and well coated with oil, about 3 to 5 minutes. Add the peanut oil to the pan and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake the veg mixture, stirring frequently, until the peanut bits are golden, about 25 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Hajar's Hummus
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons minced shallots | 2 tablespoons minced seeded serrano peppers | 2 packages dry yeast
instructions: If the chickpeas are a little dry, add more bread flour or water to compensate. If they're a little wet, cover them with additional bread flour or water if they're a little sticky. Add the shallots, serrano peppers and yeast to the drained chickpeas, mixing well. Let rise to double, about 1 hour. Form 2 small patties out of the dough. Place onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Let rise for an additional 45 minutes to 1 1/4 hours. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the pizzas on a baking rack. Spray the inside of each with cooking spray. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven, until toasted. Remove from the oven when done, and cool on a cookie sheet for a few minutes. Using a knife, split each with the tip of a paring knife to open out the patties. Place on a chopping board, and let cool to room temperature. Place the cooked pizzas onto a serving plate and top with your favorite condiments, such as hummus and shredded lettuce. Yum.

Random Ingredients: cheese,garlic paste,romaine lettuce,celery,green chili pepper,cabbage,golden brown sugar,golden syrup
title: Spicy Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 head of cabbage | 8 ounces sliced cheese ( i use a little less ) | 8 ounces shredded cheese, i use a mix of sharp cheddar and colby jack | 3 packages finely shredded cabbage ( we like to use red cabbage ) | 1/2 green chili pepper ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Shred or cut the cabbage according to any desired size. Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl with a fork. Toss in the flour and refrigerate overnight for best results.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,sirloin tip roast,oriental flavor ramen noodle,chicken wing,dark soy sauce,oregano,parmigiano reggiano cheese,shell pasta
title: Beef Philly
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast, tied | 8 ounces uncooked dried small shell pasta ( linguine, or macaroni ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs american cheese, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 4 ounces chinese-style american cheese, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 cups shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 can chicken wing sauce | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons finely minced fresh oregano | 2 packages oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place roast in ovensafe dutch oven, fat side up. Cook 30 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 140°f. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until tender but firm, about 12 minutes. Drain pasta when done. While pasta is cooking, cut cheese into 1 1/4 inch slices and set aside. Slice sirloin tip roast thinly and set aside. Cook pasta in boiling water until just tender, about 8 minutes. Drain pasta. Spread noodles in a baking dish. Place half of beef slices and a slice of white american cheese next to each noodle. Top with 1 1/2 cups each of the pasta, cheese, and sirloin tip pieces. Continue topping with remaining beef slices. Combine chicken wing sauce, soy sauce, oregano, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a bowl and pour over beef slices. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Uncover and bake 20 - 30 minutes or until hot throughout. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Pepper Strips
ingredients: 2 large yellow peppers | 3 tablespoons cognac
instructions: Wash and coarsely chop peppers. Combine with cognac. Cover and store in refrigerator.

title: Mussels in Garlic
ingredients: 12 fresh mussels, well scrubbed | 1 cup roughly chopped nuts
instructions: Toast nuts in a dry oven until golden brown. Place mussels in a saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes or until mussels open. Discard any or all mussels that do not open. Remove any that do not open. Stir in nutmeg and serve.

title: Flounder Piccata
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup white wine | 2 pounds flounder fillets
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, mix lemon juice, wine, and fillets. Seal bag, and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,onion flake,sauce,lettuce,brown basmati rice,water chestnut,iceberg lettuce,dijon mustard
title: Crunchy Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown basmati rice | 4 cups water chestnuts | 1/2 onion | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped iceberg lettuce | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 - 1/3 cup hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Cook rice over medium heat until barely tender, about 20 minutes, or until watery.. Drain rice, pressing rice to remove excess moisture. Set aside. Chop 1/2 cup onion in food processor. Cook remaining 1/4 cup onion in 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat until soft, about 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except lettuce. Cool to room temperature. Place rice mixture in large bowl and stir to mix. Add the remaining 1/2 cup onion and chopped lettuce.

Random Ingredients: red wine,curry powder,red curry paste,peach,vanilla bean
title: Thai Red Peach Soup
ingredients: 1 large ripe peach, unpeeled and seeded | 2 tablespoons pure red curry paste | 1 teaspoon red curry paste, thai red, can substitute with green | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Puree the peaches and curry paste together. Add remaining ingredients and purée to a smooth soup consistency.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,red chili sauce,sun tomato oil,canola oil,salmon
title: Easy Blushing Smoke Salmon With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil or 1/4 cup any neutral flavored oil | 1 lb salmon, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 6 -8 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and patted dry, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1/4 - 1 tablespoon dry red chili sauce or 1/4-1 tablespoon chili paste | 2 -3 granny smith apples, cored and cut into quarters
instructions: In a 12” heavy nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add salmon and cook and stir until well browned on top. Add sun dried tomatoes, chile sauce, and apples. Cover and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes or until sauce reduces slightly and apples are slightly cooked. Remove from heat. Let sit off the burner for 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,red chili powder,yeast,half cream,cornstarch,lime zest,cauliflower
title: Cauliflower Aspens
ingredients: 250 g cauliflower ( fresh ) | 1/3 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1/4 tablespoon sugar | 1 red chili powder | 2 tablespoons half and half low-fat milk
instructions: Rinse and separate the cauliflower into florets and wash well. Cut a thick slice of the stalk on the bottom of the cauliflower. Cut out the core of the cauliflower with a knife or a sharp knife. The floret will be thicker and thinner when cooked. Slice it into about 5cm or 1/4c squares. Place cauliflower and cornstarch in a mixing bowl and add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well to make a thick but pourable paste. Place the vegetables into an oiled baking pan and mix with a fork. Sprinkle some salt until it sticks. Cover with plastic wrap and put in the fridge for half an hour or until it is completely cooked. Spread about 1tbsp of filling onto each cauliflower square and fold over. Cook under a hot grill for about 3 minutes. Serve warm, with mint and lime wedges.

title: Strawberry-Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary | 2 1/2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 cup condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup whiskey | 1/2 cup shredded fresh strawberries, divided | 1/3 cup low-fat creme fraiche or 1/3 cup sour cream, if you prefer | 1/3 cup yoghurt ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the broiler, setting the rack 6 below the heat. Beat the egg white and rosemary together until stiff. Set aside. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the mushroom soup and whiskey and gently cook until the cream has warmed through, about 5 minutes. Add the strawberries and stir and cook 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the egg white mixture, just until incorporated. Pour into a 2 1/2 cup baking dish. Bake until the cream topping is golden brown and the mushrooms are tender, 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Shrimp Vera Cruz
ingredients: 1 lb fresh baby shrimp | 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cook shrimp in a small amount of boiling water over medium heat, about 2 - 3 minutes. Rinse shrimp in a large bowl of cold water. Immediately transfer shrimp to a plate with lots of room over the shrimp. Drain shrimp and pat dry with paper towels. Place on a platter. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper and serve.

title: Mushroom Amaretto Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 package fresh button mushrooms | 1 1/2 lbs mascarpone cheese | 12 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Wash & trim mushrooms & slice & mince cheese.

Random Ingredients: caper,dark brown sugar,dark sesame oil,vanilla bean,cilantro
title: Sichuan Cilantro-Caper Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon capers | 1/2 vanilla beans, split or 1/2 orange, zested and juiced | 1/4 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro
instructions: Stir the sesame oil, capers, and vanilla bean together in a small skillet over medium low heat until the sugar is dissolved. Remove from the heat and stir in the brown sugar and cilantro. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Quick Beef Goulash
ingredients: 4 pounds boneless beef chuck roast | 1 link kielbasa
instructions: Trim the top 1/2 inch off the roast, leaving the bone in and removing any visible fat. Cut into the short lengths of meat and sprinkle with salt. In a slow cooker, place the meat, sausage pieces and enough water to cover. Cook on high until the mixture boils, reduce the heat to low and cook until the meat is very tender and beginning to fall apart, 7 to 9 hours. Transfer the meat to a cutting board and slice into 1/2 inch thick slices with a very sharp knife. Transfer to a deep serving or serving platter and tent with foil to keep warm and keep warm. Strip off the skin and cut the meat into 1/2 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: wedge lemon,no salt tomato paste,rye bread,sage leaf,ricotta cheese,shirataki noodle
title: Shirataki Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons no-salt-added tomato paste | 8 ounces shirataki noodles, broken into 3/4-inch pieces ( or other firm bread ) | 2 3 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons no-salt-added tomato paste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | 3/4 large wedge lemon, finely shredded | 1 thin rye bread
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet. Add 1 tablespoon of the tomato paste, then stir in the shirataki noodles, breaking them into pieces with your fingers if necessary.

title: Auberge Irish Coffee
ingredients: 2 cups strong coffee | 2 tablespoons mint leaves, fresh, finely chopped | 2 -4 tablespoons passion fruit, fresh, split in half | 8 tablespoons olive, fresh, pitted, chopped | 4 tablespoons craisins | ice water, if needed
instructions: In a large jug, combine the coffee, mint, passion fruit and olives. Pour over the olive oil and stir until well combined. Pour in the water if required, to thin the coffee and leave it frothy. Serve in glasses filled with ice.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,golden brown sugar,flour tortilla,lemon zest,ginger
title: Harry Potter Black Tamer Squares
ingredients: 1 cup golden brown sugar | 3/4 cup flour, plus more for the work surface | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 16 flour tortillas ( about 9x13 in size ) | 16 graham crackers, coarsely crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cream together sugar, flour, lemon zest, and 1/2 teaspoon salt with a mixer on medium speed until smooth. Press 1 heaping teaspoon of the mixture into the bottom of a well buttered 13x9x2 inch baking pan. Sprinkle the crumbs into the mixture. Press the remaining mixture over the top of the crust with your fingertips. Smooth over the crumbs with a rubber spatula or a knife. Spread evenly. Bake until golden brown and bubbly, about 30 minutes, or until firm and the edges are starting to loosen. Cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes. Cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,oyster sauce,corn syrup,lemongrass,bamboo shoot,potato,vegetable broth
title: Sweet Potato, Lemongrass and Beer
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet potato, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch-thick slices ( about 4 medium ) | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1 bunch fresh lemongrass, thinly sliced on the diagonal | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons monterey jack cheese or 2 tablespoons other light cheese, grated | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, heat broth with corn syrup and lemongrass until heated through, about 2 minutes. Add sweet potato and cook, stirring, until just tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add cheese and bamboo slices, stirring well. Top with sweet potato. Heat through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,tomato green chilies,thyme sprig,caster sugar,worcestershire sauce,cumin powder
title: Mexican Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole cumin powder | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprigs | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 4 teaspoons crushed dried chipotle allspice berry | 4 teaspoons mexican chili powder ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons caster sugar, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Put ingredients into a small bowl, cover and leave overnight. Stir well before using. If desired can also be spooned into hot gravy.

title: Dressed Cabbage (Gewurzki)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white cabbage | 2 ounces gelatin ( see note below ) | 1 pinch sugar | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: To make the curing lighlty crisps, wash the cabbage well in a colander and remove the outer leaves leaving them slightly raised in the water. Rinse it from the water thoroughly. Cut the cabbage in 1/4' cubes. Set aside. In a saucepan bring 2 cups water to a boil with the gelatin. Add the sugar, mustard and salt to the boiling water. Let the mixture boil for 3 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat. Dissolve the gelatin in this solution. Pour the boiling liquid over the cabbage. Cool. Pour the curing lighly crisps directly over the cabbage and refrigerate.

title: Skillet Sausage for Can Chicken
ingredients: 2 cans spaghetti sauce | 8 tablespoons chicken bouillon ( can or jar )
instructions: Open spaghetti sauce cans and empty contents into sauce pan. Add bouillon to sauce pan and stir over medium heat until dissolved, approximately 5 minutes.

title: Beef Schnitzels
ingredients: 1/3 cup red ranch dressing ( or your favourite ) | 3 shallots, finely diced | 8 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange the rye bread on two cookie sheets. Spread 1 tablespoon of ranch dressing on one slice of rye bread. Divide the schnitzels between the two slices. Drizzle with the remaining dressing and sprinkle with more crushed crushed shallots. Bake at 350f for 15 to 20 minutes or until schnitzels are bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Fresh Pineapple With Saffron
ingredients: 5 pints fresh pineapple | 5 saffron strands | 1 liter saffron strand
instructions: Peel and core the pineapple and cut it into 5 cm cubes or cubes. Heat half the sugar in a saucepan. Add the pineapple and saffron. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly. The pineapple will release some juice leaving the shells of its own. Add more sugar as needed. When the mixture is quite dry, serve the pineapple from the pineapple, topped with the remaining saffron strands, on a warm dish. Serve cold.

title: Crunchy Spicy Snow Peas
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh snow peas ( or peas cut up from frozen ) | 1 package ladyfingers | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 2 jalapeno chiles | 1/4 cup blanched slivered almond ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 tablespoons glaze ( glaze )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 13 x 9 inch baking dish. With a vegetable peeler, peel snow peas, discarding ends and strings, and cut them into strips. With a pastry cutter, cut slits across top of snow peas on all sides.

title: North African Meatballs (Strikas Kebab)
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise or 1/2 cup salad dressing | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon | 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground pork | 2 small red bell peppers, diced or can diced bell peppers
instructions: Using a food processor, mix together mayonnaise and tarragon. Let stand 10 minutes, or can refrigerate up to 4 hours. Using a food processor, crumble lamb and pork throughly. Add bell peppers. Divide in half. Scoop meat mixture into 2 equally sized patties. Refrigerate unused portions, such as the meat balls and marinade. Grill, broil or barbecue meatballs over hot coals until lightly browned, about 5 - 7 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,corn niblets,tart apple,margarine,pineapple chunk,chicken stock
title: Green Apple Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can corn niblets, drained | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1 cup canned green enchilada sauce, divided | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped tart apples | 1/3 cup margarine | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 2 tablespoons margarine, melted | 2 tablespoons green enchilada sauce, divided
instructions: Drain 1/2 cup of each green enchilada sauce and corn niblets. In medium saucepan, combine remaining 1/4 cup enchilada sauce, remaining 1/4 cup enchilada sauce, apples, 1/3 cup margarine, and pineapple chunks. Heat to boiling. Stir in 1 tbls. Margarine. Stir in green sauce. Spoon enchilada sauce mixture into baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of margarine. Bake in 400°f oven for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring once. Top enchiladas with last 1/4 cup of sauce. Bake for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with additional 1/4 cup of sauce. Top with melted margarine.

title: Cumin Cream Soup
ingredients: 3 cups low sodium chicken broth | 3/4 cup soy milk | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat the chicken broth, soy milk, cream and cumin until smooth, about 10 minutes.

title: Tamarari Marinade for Shrimp
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons coriander, finely chopped
instructions: Whisk tamari and coriander in a bowl. Combine well.

title: Cafe Rio Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 1/2 ouncesresso italian-style cafe au jus sauce or 2 1/2 ounces other coffee-infused coffee | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a medium bowl, stir together graham cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons of the espresso. Press the mixture firmly on the side of each griddle. Place under broiler and blacken the top surface. Remove from oven and spread shaved cheese into the holes. Broil until lightly browned and bubbly, 2 - 3 minutes. Watch cheese carefully. When cheese is cool, drizzle with hot espresso. Spread with remaining espresso.

title: Salsa De Platano
ingredients: 3 -4 plantains ( ripe but firm, peeled and grated ) | 2 packages frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup hot sauce ( or tabasco )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spread grated plantain slices on a baking sheet and bake for 10 to 15 minutes, until the plantains are tender and starting to brown. Cool a bit. Spread the cooked spinach on a large platter, and spread a thin layer of hot sauce on top. Arrange the grated plantains on top. Cover with extra sauce and fresh cilantro to serve.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,currant,heavy cream,spice,leek,white breadcrumb,purple onion
title: Taco Flavored Green Tea Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups strong white breadcrumbs ( i use progresso ) | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 small purple onion, finely chopped | 1 leek, finely chopped | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon mixed spice ( i use mccormick's spice, and basil ) | fresh curly-edged white breadcrumb
instructions: Combine the breadcrumbs and cream in a mixing bowl. Add the onion and leek and mix well. Add the taco seasoning mix and mixed spice. Mix well again. Add the breadcrumb mixture to the mixture and mix well again. Transfer to an oiled or non stick muffin tin and bake in a 375f degree oven for approximately 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Allow to cool to room temperature, break into bite sized pieces and serve with freshly ground black cheese and more freshly ground white breadcrumb.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,turmeric,beef chuck,grape tomato,kielbasa sausage,vanilla extract
title: Slow Cook Spiced Potatoes
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes, cut into bite size pieces | 1 lb lean ground beef chuck | 1/2 lb fresh kielbasa sausage, crumbled | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place potato pieces in bottom of the slow cooker. Place ground beef, sausage, vanilla extract, and turmeric in a large bowl. Mix until well blended. Sprinkle potato pieces with the mixture. Gently mix tomatoes into mixture. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or on high for up to 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,red currant jelly,pancetta bacon,taco seasoning mix
title: Taco Bacon - Home Cooked Version
ingredients: 4 slices pancetta bacon | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon red currant jelly | 1 teaspoon lime juice
instructions: In a small frying pan, fry chopped pancetta till crisp, crisp drain on paper towel. Return frying pan to medium heat add taco seasoning mix, jelly and lime juice. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minute. Place bacon on platter and pour sauce over. Serve over chips.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,almond extract,yukon gold potato,oyster sauce,nori,thai chili sauce,navy bean
title: Spiced Beef and Potato Salad With Oysters
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed well | 1 lb stewing beef | 1 lb navy beans, cooked and drained and rinsed | 1 package nori ( dried seaweed ) | 1/8 cup thai sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Steam potato, covered, in microwave till just tender. While potato is cooking, cut stew beef into very thin strips. Chop nori into very thin strips. Cook beef in skillet over medium high heat stirring till no longer pink, drain well. Combine meat, beans, nori, chili sauce, and oyster sauce in large bowl. Add shredded potato. Cook over high heat 3 - 5 minutes, or till well combined. Add almond extract. Cook another minute or so, stirring. Serve warm.

title: Lemon, Mallow and Cream Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/3 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons marshmallows | lemon wedge, to serve
instructions: Combine sour cream and marshmallows in a small bowl and stir in lemon wedges. Let flavours mingle and serve with crisp bread.

Random Ingredients: brandy,sun tomato,cream tartar,chili powder,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Chili and Sun Dried Tomato Bites
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 8 sun-dried tomatoes, roughly chopped | 4 teaspoons brandy | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: Place oven rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 190c/fan 160c/gas 4, line a baking tray with baking paper. Spray sun dried tomatoes with oil and place on the baking tray and bake for 1 hour or until softened. Remove from oven and immediately place brandy and cream of tartar in a screw top jar. Mix well. Spoon chili mixture into a small heat resistant jug and place in the microwave for 1 minute or until the brandy and cream of tartar have just turned into sour cream. Toss the sour cream with the sun dried tomato mixture until coated. Place in refrigerator for 1 hour to firm up before serving.

title: Rump Steak and Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarse salt | 1 lb rump steak
instructions: Rub the coarse salt over the meat. Place the meat on a rack in a roasting pan.

title: Guava Beef for Two
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 8 pieces bacon | 1 can guava nectar | 1 medium turnip, thinly sliced
instructions: Place the roast in a large pot or dutch oven. Dot the bottom of the pot with one piece bacon. Place the turnip slices in the pot, overlapping slices and sprinkling the top with more bacon. Pour both cans of guava nectar over the turnip slices. Place the pot over medium low heat and simmer for 1 hour, stirring and skimming any impurities that surface. Cover and continue simmering 20 minutes, or until the turnip is tender. Transfer the meat and vegetables to a slow cooker, cutting and shredding the meat as you go to serve.

title: Aunt Dot's Spaghetti and Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 pound dried spaghetti | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or butter | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 1 large brown onion | 6 ounces snow peas | 1 jar apricot preserves, undiluted | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti as directed on package. Reserve some of the cooking water. Meanwhile, heat oil in a large nonstick skillet. Add vegetables and onion.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,italian sausage,green cabbage,pecorino romano cheese,taco seasoning,digestive biscuit
title: Baked Italian Sausage Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 package pillsbury refrigerated digestive biscuits | 1 package shredded green cabbage | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 cup grated pecorino romano cheese ( can use asiago, cheddar or monterey ) | 1 package italian sweet roll ( or make your own )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Remove sausage from casings and finely crumble. Drain all but one tablespoon of the grease from the sausage. Break biscuits on baking sheet and place one biscuit per warm area. Spray each biscuit hole with cooking spray. Bake approximately 8 minutes or until golden brown. Meanwhile, mix cabbage, onion, taco seasoning and cheese. Serve warm. Note, this can be baked on a cookie sheet and can be frozen for later use. Bake as directed and can be reheated for reheating at same time.

title: Swanson Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 can swanson beef and onion broth | 1 veal | fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Heat a saucepan for medium heat. Lightly brown beef and onion. Once browned, remove with a slotted spoon and place in a warm serving bowl. Simmer soup for 2 - 3 minutes. Add beef broth and sliced coriander leaves. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,brown sugar,white sugar,corn oil,apple cider,puff pastry,monterey jack cheese,rye bread
title: Grilled Cheese Pie II
ingredients: 1 pastry for double-crust pie | 1 cup finely grated monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup finely grated reduced fat provolone cheese | 1/4 cup firmly packed light brown sugar | 1/8 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarse grain brown sugar, or more if needed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425°. Prepare the pie crust, place the cheeses into a bowl, and mix in 1/4 cup of brown sugar. In a small bowl, combine the cider, white sugar, and corn oil. When the oven is hot, melt the corn oil on the bottom of a 13 inch diameter pie plate in the oven. Remove pie crust from oven, and pour the cider mixture into the pan. Spoon the cheese mixture over the tart, and poke a few holes in the cheese so that it fills evenly in the pie crust. Return the crust to the oven, and cook for 25 to 30 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and bubbly and filling is slightly jiggly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,egg white,green onion,currant,vegetable oil cooking spray,maple syrup,spice,double cream
title: Cucumbers With Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 cucumber, peeled, thinly sliced | 6 green onions, sliced thin | 12 fluid ounces double cream | 1 egg whites | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon currants
instructions: Place the cucumber and green onions in a medium non metallic bowl. In a medium bowl, whisk the cream, egg whites, maple syrup and mixed spice. Add the cucumber mixture and stir to combine. Transfer to an 8 inch square baking dish coated with vegetable spray. Sprinkle with the currants. Bake in an oven set at 350ºf for 50 - 30 minutes or until set. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Mexican Pesto Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh pine nuts | 1/2 lime, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika ( hungarian sweet style recommended ) | 2 2 1/2 cups olive oil or 2 2 1/2 cups canola oil | 1 tablespoon fresh yeast or 1 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Heat pine nuts on a skillet until golden brown and fragrant. Remove from heat when nuts are cool and place in a blender. In a small bowl, combine the lime zest and sweet paprika and mix until well blended. In the blender jar combine the hot pine nuts, lime juice and oil and blend until fairly smooth. Pour this mixture into a mixing bowl. Stir in yeast and let proof until creamy. Pour 1 cup of the pesto into a small pot and put it on the medium heat. Stir frequently until hot, about 1 minute. Transfer the pesto mixture to a bowl and stir to combine. Let cool to 115 degrees. Use immediately, but do not store.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,cornstarch,beef bouillon cube,vegetable stock,scallion,pecorino romano cheese,fish sauce,lime
title: Cousin Pete's Baked Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks | 1 beef bouillon cube | 4 scallions, chopped | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/3 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Slice the meat as 1 1/2 to 1 thick. Place in a 9x12x2 inch baking dish and top with all of the remaining fixings. Scatter over the pecorino and bake in a 350f oven for 1 1/2 hours, until the meat is tender. Serve over spaghetti or rice.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,beef bouillon cube,mustard seed,hard egg,kale,bay leaf,cider vinegar,italian seasoning
title: Zuppa Del Campinguana
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs | 12 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3 1/2 tablespoons dry mustard seeds | 2 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon cubes or 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | italian seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Remove the eggs from their shells and scoop the yolks out of their shells, reserving the yolks in a cup or small saucepan. Using a slotted spoon, remove the whites from the shells and set aside. Fill a medium size bowl with water, then rinse the shells of the eggs well under cold water. Invert a large plate or strainer over the bowl. Tear 1 egg, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until the following day drain well. Discard the yolks. With a slotted spoon, transfer the yolks to the bowl of a food processor, add the 1 cheese, mustard seeds, bay leaves, and cheese. Process until mixture is fluffy, about 5 seconds, stopping occasionally to scrape down the sides of the bowl. Add the vinegar, worcestershire sauce, and italian seasoning, if using. Pulse the mixture until it is finely chopped and the mixture is well incorporated. The mixture may be used immediately after adding the vinegar, worcestershire, and seasoning. If you are planning on eating the dish immediately, the egg mixture may be mixed and frozen, or left in the freezer for up to 2 weeks.

title: Bean & Cheddar Pizza
ingredients: 1 packet dry yeast | 250 g cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 250 g pinto beans ( rinsed ) | 1/4 cup coriander powder or 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander ( cilantro ) | 3 teaspoons chili paste
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 litre of warm water place in large bowl and sprinkle with salt, and add all other ingredients. Stir and leave in a warm place for 10 - 15 minutes until bubbly and well mixed. Place on a pizza tray, with baking paper on it, and bake in hot oven, 450 f for approx 10 - 12 minutes, until golden on top and firm on the top.

title: Rice Crackers for Sinterkla (Rice)
ingredients: 2 slices rice | 8 allspice berries, ground to powder
instructions: Place the two rices in a large plastic bag. Pour the ground spice on top to prevent breaking. Close bag and shake to mix. Place in the fridge. To cook, put in a pan about ¼ inch above the level of water. Turn to medium/low, turn stove/griddle. It will be fairly hot when water starts bubbling. Cook until steam starts to rise and it starts to darken, watch carefully. Turn croutons about half way after they have turned to darken. Allow to cool and store at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,gouda cheese,poblano chile,chili garlic sauce,cayenne pepper
title: Penne with Poblano Chile and Cheese
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles ( seeded and chopped ) | 1/2 cup chili-garlic sauce ( i like kikkoman sweet chili garlic sauce ) | 1 cup smoked gouda cheese or 1 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 8 ounces penne pasta | 1/4 cup mild cayenne pepper
instructions: Place tomatoes in a blender or food processor& whirl to a coarse puree. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the poblano puree, sauce, cheese& cayenne. Simmer 3 to 5 minutes and pasta. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add penne pasta& cook according to package directions. Drain pasta& transfer to a bowl leaving sauce in it. Toss with cayenne pepper.

title: Pastel De Cremoso (Smoked Fish Noodle Soup)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage ( about 6 cups ) | 2 lbs smoked fish | 2 packages chicken wings | 8 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles | 2 apples, peeled and cut in wedges | 1 lb fresh whole beans | 1/2 lb fresh smoked fish or 1/2 lb salmon
instructions: Cut fish into bite sized pieces and arrange on a platter. Bring to a boil with the wings, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Break up the fish into small portions with your fingers or a fork. Remove fish from bones. Set aside. Cover and cook on low heat for 2 hours. Drain chicken wings and cut into bite sized pieces. Cook the pasta in lightly salted boiling water for about 6 minutes or until the pasta is al dente. Combine the noodles and the fish. Add the apple wedges and return to the boil. Lower heat to very low and cook for 10 minutes. Stir in the soaked beans and the smoked fish. Cook for one minute.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,dark chocolate,mint leaf,large shrimp,baking powder,yellow miso,safflower oil,tomato green chilies
title: Miso Shrimp in Sada Batter
ingredients: 2 lbs unpeeled large shrimp | 1 package yellow miso ( yellow cornmeal ) | 1 package dry taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon safflower oil | 1 can diced tomatoes from the can ( i use muir glen fire-roasted diced tomatoes ) | 2 tablespoons dried lime leaves ( or 1 tablespoon dried lime zest, if you don't have fresh ) or 2 tablespoons lime juice ( or 1 tablespoon dried lime zest, if you don't have fresh ) | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint leaves ( optional ) | 1 ounce dark chocolate, chopped into 1/4 inch dice ( optional )
instructions: If using fresh tomatoes, cut out the seeds and cores and cut tomatoes into chunks, if using canned, they should be chopped into 1 inch chunks. Set aside. If using canned tomatoes, cut out the cores and skin from the tomtoes. Place shrimp in a large dish, sprinkle well with 1 teaspoon of salt and turn to sprinkle on both sides and evenly distribute the shrimp with the tomato chunks. Set aside. Preheat the oven to 350°f generously grease a round 1 1/2 quart baking dish with the safflower oil. Make the miso sauce by placing the miso, taco seasoning, oil, diced tomatoes, chopped mint leaves and lime juice in a food processor and running on medium to high speed, scraping down the sides as necessary, until all of the ingredients are incorporated, about 1 minute. Batter should be runny and not thick. Spoon the sauce evenly into the baking dish, spreading to coat it. Sprinkle the shrimp with the diced cheese mixture, and bake until the shrimp are cooked through, about 40 minutes. Sprinkle with the dark chocolate just before serving.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,peanut oil,tabasco sauce,worcestershire sauce,egg noodle,wheat berry,egg,radish
title: Peanut Brownie Filling for Two
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 6 eggs, beaten | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 tablespoon grated radish | 1 -2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 cup whole wheat berries | 2 -3 tablespoons dried fine breadcrumbs | 8 dashes tabasco sauce | 12 large egg noodles, heated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. In a medium bowl, stir together the oil, eggs, bread crumbs, radish, worcestershire sauce, tabasco sauce, and wheat berries. Soak noodles in hot water for 2 to 3 minutes to remove excess starch. Drain and transfer to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Spoon the egg mixture into the center, then sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of the fine crumbs. Add more crumbs if mixture seems dry. Bake until the egg mixture is set, about 25 to 30 minutes. Serve warm. Make ahead, store bread crumbs in an airtight container for up to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,barley,oregano leaf,pepper sauce,fast rising yeast,paprika,bread,grain rice
title: Quick and Easy Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 cup unconverted long-grain rice ( preferably spanish ) | 1/2 cup barley, washed and drained | 2 teaspoons stone ground fresh parmigina or 2 teaspoons instant quick-rising yeast | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried crushed red pepper flakes | fresh ground pepper | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 3/4 teaspoon fast rising yeast | 2 1/2 - 3 cups bread, crusts removed
instructions: Place the rice in a microwave safe and heat on high for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the grains are just beginning to express a 'blurry' or swell up. Add the barley and microwave, uncovered and on high, undisturbed, for 2 to 4 minutes, or until the grains are very small and very fragrant. Let cool completely. Dissolve the parmigina in the boiling water for 15 seconds, then stir in all of the dry ingredients. Let sit 5 minutes. Dissolve the hot pepper sauce in 2 tablespoons water, then stir into the rice. Transfer to an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled. Stir in the yeast and 3/4 cup water, and cover with plastic wrap. Let rise until doubled, about 2 hours. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Stir once and place in an oiled 2 quart bowl that can be brushed with oil before baking. Cover, let rise until doubled. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Turn out dough onto floured cloth and cut into 1 - ½ inch squares. Put about 5 tablespoons of filling into the center of each square, fold over, pinch edges closed, twist ends together, then place on a parchment lined and floured baking sheet. Cover, allow to rise 25 minutes, then bake until golden, about 25 to 30 minutes, or until puffed and golden. Allow to cool completely before serving. Store for up to 2 weeks in a tightly lidded container.

title: Sooji Kebab
ingredients: 1 pastry | 1 lb ground meat ( meat, vege meat, tofu, or pork ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder or 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon grated oregano leaves | 1/4 cup brandy ( or rum if you prefer )
instructions: Roll out pastry on lightly floured board. Cut into 3 squares. Roll and pierce the outside of one square several times with fork if desired. Place meat and seasoning in a large ziplock. Sprinkle with flour and shake in the bag. Let rest for 20 minutes then gently place the next four squares on top. Wash hands, then press to remove fat from bowl. Using a pastry brush, brush lightly with a little olive oil. Place on baking sheet. Cut a slit in the top of each square. Brush tops with the brandy, or rum, or the mixture of one tablespoon or a bit of olive oil. Bake at 450 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes until crust is crisp.

title: Sweet Roasted Grape Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs seedless red grapes | 1/4 cup fresh thyme leaves or 1/4 cup minced fresh thyme | 1/4 cup celery | 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn | 1/8 teaspoon fresh nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 f. Trim ends from grapes and cut grapes in half. Lay cut grapes on a greased baking sheet. Using a mortar and pestle, pound together thyme, celery, peppercorns, and nutmeg. Sprinkle mixture evenly over grapes, forming a thick salad.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,chili sauce,malt vinegar,golden syrup,red potato,habanero pepper,wheat bran
title: Sweet Potato Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 3 tablespoons whole wheat bran
instructions: Boil potatoes for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked. Drain and cool. Peel and chop the potatoes. Mix all the ingredients except the bran and bran to make the bran mixture. Add bran to potato mixture and chill for one hour.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,kirsch,chestnut,chicken thigh,italian salad dressing,serrano pepper,amaretto liqueur
title: Italian Chicken Hotchino (Chop Suey)
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 2 tablespoons kirsch | 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur or 2 tablespoons marsala | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 2 slices serrano peppers, thin, seeded and minced | 1 can chestnuts, cooked and sliced
instructions: Combine kirsch, amaretto, and salad dressing in a bowl. Add chicken at one time, stirring to coat with dressing. Refrigerate at least an hour, stirring occasionally. Heat oven to bake chicken in oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until just cooked through, stirring chicken halfway through. Transfer to cutting board and let stand for 5 minutes. Cut chicken into about 8 slices, or more if desired, and return to baking pan. Arrange on serving platter. Brush with remaining dressing. Garnish with roasted serrano peppers and chestnuts.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,lemon juice zest,beef chuck roast,blueberry,cumin powder
title: Blueberry Beef Tenderloin With Lemon Pepper and Cumin Juice
ingredients: 1 lemon, juice and zest of or 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons olive oil flavored cooking spray | 8 ounces beef chuck roast, trimmed weight | 1/2 cup frozen blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine lemon juice, zest, and cumin.

Random Ingredients: basil,white onion,grain rice,red bell pepper,malt vinegar,chili powder
title: Yummy Bell Pepper Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 cups brown rice | 1 white onion, diced | 1 red bell pepper, minced | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dry chili powder | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,golden caster sugar,sea salt,gruyere cheese,cardamom,sesame seed,spanish onion
title: Gruyere Sauté
ingredients: 9 tablespoons golden caster sugar, divided | 4 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 600 -700 g gruyere cheese, grated, plus extra to serve | 3 -4 spanish onions, diced fine | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup sour cream | 3 cardamoms, black and, green, sliced
instructions: Place 6 tablespoons of sugar, half the sesame seeds, salt, and 1 tablespoon water in a large saucepan over medium heat. Bring to the boil. Boil rapidly for 5–10 minutes. Add the grated gruyere. When bubbling remove from heat and stir over medium heat to mix the cheese gradually and continuously. Return to the pan and spread into a thin layer about 1cm thick on a greased baking tray. Set in a dry oven at 150c for 30 minutes. Serve with the sliced onions and remaining sesame seeds and extra toasted sesame seeds, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cranberry juice,cheddar cheese,canola oil,coffee,nut sago,ginger puree,arborio rice,orange zest
title: Coffee and Ginger Risotto
ingredients: 2 ounces arborio rice | 1 1/2 ounces canola oil | 2 tablespoons grated ginger puree | 12 fluid ounces coffee | 2 fluid ounces cranberry juice | 2 ounces orange zest, finely grated | 1 ounce cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cook the arborio rice until al dente. Drain and set aside. Heat the oil in a deep casserole type pan – i like a ramekin – and add the ginger puree. Stir and fry for a few seconds, then stir in the rice. Then throw in the coffee and cranberry juice. When it comes to a boil, add half of the orange zest, and cook for another three minutes. Stir in the cheddar and cook for a final two minutes. Serve immediately. This is very good reheated just the last two minutes too.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,walnut oil,chicken stock,beef steak
title: Beef With Ginger and Walnuts
ingredients: 4 beef steak, trimmed | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 cup walnut oil
instructions: Score steak with a sharp knife and rub with ginger garlic paste. Place stock in a saucepan and bring to boil, stirring continuously. Add steak to the pan and reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minute pour into a baking tray. Bake at 160°c for 1 hour remove from oven and let cool completely. Dry off meat, cut into 4 portions and serve with the ginger sauce. Cooking time does not include chilli.

title: Gourmet Tahini Salad Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup shallot, chopped | 1/3 cup tahini, roasted ( unsalted ) | 1 jar pimientos or 2 medium pimientos, drained | 1 jar maraschino cherries ( reserve juice )
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, stir together shallot and tahini until hot. Add pimentos and maraschino, and heat through, approximately 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,arugula leaf,salmon fillet,rutabaga,white rice,jumbo pasta shell
title: Baked Salmon and Rice Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces rutabagas, peeled diced | 1/2 cup bell pepper, diced | 1/4 cup arugula leaf | 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets, skin removed | 1/3 cup cooked white rice | 24 jumbo pasta shells, precooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Sauté rutabaga, bell pepper, and arugula in 1 teaspoon of olive oil until tender, about 5 minutes. Arrange salmon in baking dish and top with mixture. Bake for 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Remove from oven. Serve topped with rice and reserved rutabaga mixture.

title: Irish Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | 2/3 cup irish cream
instructions: Spread pork chops with cream. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes in refrigerator. Preheat grill. Lightly oil grate.

title: Homemade Sour Cream (Taste the Sour Cream at Home for a stronger sauce)
ingredients: 1 pint sour cream | 2 dried red chili peppers, finely chopped | 1 bay leaf | salt
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and chill. Serve cold. The longer it sets, the hotter it gets the soup will get and can be stored in an airtight container. Use as filler for vegetarian dishes.

title: Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 3 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Combine well and shape into loaves that have been flattened to 1/4 thick. Place loaves on baking pan. Bake@ 325 degrees fahrenheit f for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Yummie ( Vegan, Vegan and Diabetic Friendly)
ingredients: 2 cups ice water | 1 teaspoon nutritional yeast ( nutritional yeast can be found in some health food stores )
instructions: Boil water and yeast in a cup until foamy. Pour into a strainer and pour into a glass bottle or jar. Refrigerate for at least 10 days. To serve, fill into a glass with some cool graham cracker. Dip with your favourite sweetner, veggie cheese, or fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,balsamic vinegar,gingerroot,olive oil,green,phyllo dough,pizza crust,cheddar cheese
title: Cheesy-Gingerbread and Balsamic Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried gingerroot, grated | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup frozen mixed greens | 8 sheets phyllo dough | 1/2 prepared pizza crust | 1 medium green slice cheddar cheese, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. In a small bowl, combine olive oil, balsamic vinegar, ginger, shredded cheese, and the frozen mixed greens. Set aside. Unroll the phyllo dough on a work surface and place a few spoonfuls of the greens mixture on the lower right third of the piece of phyllo dough. Add about 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture on top of the greens mixture. Beginning with one sheet of phyllo dough, fold in the edge, then the long way. Place dough in a pizza pan or an oiled 9x13 inch baking dish. Brush the top with more of the olive oil and lightly sprinkle the top with about 1/4 cup of the remaining cheese mixture. Bake for 15 minutes, or until the top is puffed and browned. Cut into quarters and serve.

title: Crock Pot Peach Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 lb baby carrots | 8 ounces baby carrots | 1/3 cup italian cheese blend, shredded | 1 3/4 tablespoons channa dal ( or any chana dal ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 egg, beaten
instructions: In crock pot, combine, baby carrots, baby carrots, italian cheese blend, chana dal/channa dal, baking soda and egg. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.

title: Italian Wedding Cakes With Pecans & Cherry Brandy
ingredients: 1 cup shortening, room temperature | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1 lb maraschino cherry, pitted | 1 1/2 lbs pecans, coarsely chopped | 1 pound pecans, coarsely chopped | kosher salt, for sprinkling ( note -- use a mixture of sea salt and table salt for greater authenticity ) | cooking sherry, for brushing cookie tops
instructions: Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Cream the shortening, then beat in the sherry. Using a tablespoon, drop 1 teaspoonfuls of the filling mixture onto each sheet, spacing them about 1 inches apart. Sprinkle a scant 1/4 teaspoon of coarse salt on 1 side of each cookie. Set cookies side by side on prepared baking sheets. Let stand 15 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place the pecans on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper 2 inches apart. Bake 30 minutes or just until slightly golden. Cool completely. Brush with sherry, while still warm, and sprinkle with pecan halves.

title: Italian Sundae
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 lb snow peas, trimmed | 1 jar marinara sauce ( or any of your choice ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add water, marinara sauce and peas until desired tenderness is reached. Place on large platter, and serve. Add some red wine to individual portions if desired.

Random Ingredients: red wine,baking potato,heavy whipping cream,dark chocolate,mace
title: Irish Potatoes With Whiskey and Chocolate
ingredients: 8 medium baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 2 and 1/2 inch cubes, about 1 pound | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated mace | 6 ounces dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: Place the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven broiler. Cook potatoes in a large pot of boiling water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, then transfer to a baking sheet. Return pot to the stove. Cover with foil and bake potatoes on top of the oven rack until hot and dry around the edges, about 20 minutes. Remove the dish from the oven and set the oven to broil. Meanwhile, cover a 3 quart baking dish with foil. In shallow pan or bowl, stir cream with the wine and mace. Layer potato slices with the cream mixture and sprinkle with grated chocolate. Broil under the preheated broiler 1 minute.

title: African Peaches With Tamari
ingredients: 2 large juicy peaches | 1 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Peel and split the peaches lengthways.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,rosemary sprig,garlic powder,cranberry,napa cabbage,red wine
title: Cranberry Mint Salsa
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces cranberries | 2 cups napa cabbage, chopped | 2 red chilies, sliced into thin strips | 1/3 cup dry red wine | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 rosemary sprig ( optional )
instructions: Combine the cabbages, napa cabbage, chiles, wine, and garlic powder in a bowl. Garnish with rosemary sprigs.

title: Creamy Noodle Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 package dry egg noodles | 2 containers small curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 1/4 cup brandy | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook and stir poblano pepper in a skillet over medium heat until the pepper is beginning to blacken, 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,rice wine,snow pea,spanish onion,stuffing,honey,sirloin
title: Honey Beef With Nuts & Vegetables
ingredients: 1 sirloin, diced | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 10 ounces fresh snow peas, cut in half | 2 cups seasoned stuffing ( store-bought ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 spanish onion, chopped
instructions: Combine honey, rice wine and stock cube in a shallow dish, add beef and turn to coat. Pour marinade into a casserole dish, add onion and cook in a low oven for about 1 hour or until beef is tender and onions are soft. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Tortilla With Asian Meat and Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1/2 cup kirsch ( cherry brandy ) | 1/4 cup asian dressing | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, grated ( or grated fresh gingerroot ) | 2 tablespoons basil | 2 flour tortillas, cut into strips or 2 tortillas, cut into strips | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
