instructions: Combine meat, kirsch, dressing, ginger and basil in medium bowl. Preheat oven to 425°f. Place a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add meat mixture, and sprinkle with cheese. Heat until cheese melts and starts to lightly brown, about 5 minutes. Divide and serve.

title: Horseradish Rabbit
ingredients: 4 rabbits, medium size, scaled de-boned, cleaned | extra virgin olive oil | salt | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon mustard powder, dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Using a sharp knife and holding the knife on the back of the rabbit you should be able to work in the oil. Rinse the rabbit under running water and lightly pat dry with paper towels or a clean cloth. Cut away any excess fat around the neck and neck from the body of the rabbit. This could be done a few hours later. Brush the rabbit with the olive oil and place on a baking sheet. In a mixing bowl stir together horseradish, mustard powder and salt. Rub spice mixture on inside of rabbit.. Put the rabbit on top of the horseradish mixture and using a tooth pick, make small cuts in the rabbit skin to create pockets for the horseradish flavour. Roast rabbit in oven for about 45 minutes, or until meat thermometer registers 170°f for medium rare. Check for doneness. If rabbit is fully cooked it should register 170°f and meat thermometer should register 165°f as in the photo method.

title: Greek Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 pound kalamata olives | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Gently stir olives and oregano together in a bowl. Cool for a few minutes, then squeeze into a salad bowl. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Gorgonzola Sauce for Veggies
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced gorgonzola | 1/3 cup bottled grand marnier or other spicy liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Mix together, sprinkle on veggies if desired, refrigerate to let flavors meld.

title: Langose-Face Grocery Pumpkin Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups whole fresh pumpkin ( can use pumpkin in season ) | 3 cups finely chopped parsnips ( can use just parsnips in season ) | 1 envelope instant yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mace | 1 1/2 cups fresh grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400. Mix pumpkin, parsnips, yeast, mace, cheese, and 1/2 cup water in a bowl. Let stand 15 minutes. Pour into a greased 10 x 3 loaf pan. Bake 40 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spinach,nutmeg,water chestnut,pork shoulder,penne pasta,ice,napa cabbage,mexican chocolate
title: Sonia's Perfect Pork Chop and Veggies
ingredients: 4 -5 pork shoulder, chunks ( boneless, i use thighs ) | ice | 4 -5 cups water chestnuts, sliced ( or more to taste ) | 1 head napa cabbage, sliced thin | 4 -5 cups fresh spinach | 2 -3 ounces mexican chocolate ( i buy a high quality mexican chocolate, put it in the microwave for 4 5 mins and watch it's just burning. ) | 1 lb penne pasta ( or linguine ) | niblets ( optional ) or spinach, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat water, salt if needed. Slice the pork and fry in a large fry pan with some nacho's and a little bit of oil. Add the mushrooms and cook until they're just starting to shrink back, but aren't brown. Tear the cabbage apart, in smaller pieces, so that they're smaller in larger pieces. When the water is hot, add the cabbage to the pan. Once water begins to steam out, and the cabbage starts to soften, add the spinach. Cook until the spinach is cooked and the spinach is wilted and the cabbage is wilted. Pour the pork/vegetable mixture into large deep heavy bottom pot. Add the chocolate to the pot, melt and set aside. Cook pasta, drain and put in serving bowl. Pour melted chocolate sauce over pasta and vegetables. The noodles will swell up in the sauce and make it sort of a pretty pliant platter. If you want, drizzle nacho's over top.

title: Rosemary & Carrots and Tortellini
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 3 slices fresh rosemary, chopped | 1 lb fresh tortellini | 1 carrot, sliced
instructions: Drain pasta & cook as per package directions. Meanwhile, in saucepan over medium high heat, whisk together the ketchup, triple sec & allspice. Add mushrooms, carrots & herbs & cook until carrots are crisp tender & slightly browned, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,za'atar spice mix,peanut oil,streaky bacon,bacon dripping
title: Za'atar Crumbles
ingredients: 400 g smoked streaky bacon, finely chopped ( i used chopped bacon fat ) | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 large green capsicum, finely sliced | 2 tablespoons za'atar spice mix | 150 g unpitted peanuts ( about 90 )
instructions: Cook bacon in a large frying pan with oil over moderate heat, stirring, until bacon is crisp. Add capsicum, za'atar and 1 1/2 cups boiling water and cook, stirring, until capsicum is just tender. Remove from heat. Using a sieve or food processor, remove bacon, capicum, capicum, and 1 1/4 cups hot liquid from pan to a bowl and set aside. Return liquid to frying pan and bring to boil, stirring. Stir bacon mixture into bacon mixture and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until bacon is crispy and mixture has a crisp texture, about 5 minutes. Stir in peanuts and transfer to a serving dish and serve with crackers or crisp bread sticks.

title: Mexican-Style Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dry masa harina | 3/4 cup nicoise olives, pitted and chopped | 2 large naan or 3 large other anise-infused olives, halved | 1/2 vanilla bean, split | 3 tablespoons margarine, softened | 2 maraschino cherries, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, combine the masa harina with 3/4 cup water and knead until smooth. Add the remaining mixture and knead until very pliable and silky, adding more water if necessary, about 4 times. Shape into small balls, about 3/4 pound. Cover, and set aside. In a large skillet, heat the nicoise olives. Cover, and set aside. Place the naan in a large baking dish, and cut into small pieces around the naan. Insert the vanilla pod into the center of the naan, and sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. Bake at 400 degrees f, until golden, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from the oven, and carefully mix in the softened margarine. Spoon onto the center of the bean balls, and arrange the cherries around on top of them. Dot any remaining margarine on top, and return to the oven for 5 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Mielhana
ingredients: 4 tablespoons red tea | 4 tablespoons black-eyed peas | 1/2 cup teabags or 1/2 cup saffron strand | 4 slices oranges | 4 black onions or 4 white onions, sliced | 3 tablespoons sliced leeks or 3 tablespoons leeks, finely sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ajinomoto
instructions: Soak overnight. Bring 6 liters of water to boil in a large pan, add tea bags and split peas, lower heat and simmer for 30 mins, stirring occasionally. Add all remaining ingredients, cover and simmer for 1/2 an hour. Test that the liquid is not boiling too quickly by testing a piece of meat with a knife. Serve with fried vegetables and a spoonful of chutney.

title: Mexi-Miso Kidney Beans
ingredients: 2 teaspoons mixed dry kidney beans | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed dried chile beans | 3 tablespoons spanish salsa or 3 tablespoons green chili salsa | 1 teaspoon dry sherry | 1/4 teaspoon rum ( optional ) or 1 pinch accent seasoning, such as accent seasoning ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon freshly chopped italian parsley
instructions: Combine both beans and remaining ingredients and blend thoroughly, reserving a little bit of mixture for later use. Press the bean mixture through a clean cloth or paper towels, discarding the beans and any fragments or damaged beans. Discard extra bean mixture. Chill before serving. Serve with sour cream if desired.

title: Spiced Oranges
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups orange juice, orange juice has a little more flavor | 1 1/2 tablespoons cumin seeds
instructions: In a small saucepan heat the oil or butter on medium. Add the cumin seeds. Stir constantly on medium to low heat. Add the orange juice and stir to blend. Cook for about 1 minute. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Serve cold.

title: Baked Hot Brownie
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves | 1 box rigatoni pasta, cooked to al dente stage | 1 cup fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Heat oven to 350°.

title: Easy Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons green cardamom pods ( or 1 tablespoon of ground cardamom ) | 2 bay leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, thoroughly blend together the ricotta cheese, cardamom pods, and bay leaves. Cover and chill at least one hour or up to 8 hours. Enjoy in chilled parathas or with fresh bread, or as a dip with some fresh naan bread.

title: Mexican Shredded Cabbage
ingredients: 1 bag shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese
instructions: In a 9 x 13 pan, layer cabbage, salsa, and cheese. Microwave, uncovered, on high for 5 - 7 minutes to heat through. Cover, and heat 1 minute more. Note, if you want a crisper top layer, cook the cabbage in a spray of oil for 5 minutes. The cabbage can also be served as is, or sliced, or microwaved on high for 5 - 7 minutes.

title: Macaroni and Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 liters macaroni, small ones | 4 teaspoons pure vanilla essence
instructions: Boil macaroni until soft, drain and add 2 tbsp of pure vanilla essence to it. Process in a blender until smooth then transfer mixture to a deep bowl and beat with two spatulas until thick and creamy. Add vanill, stir again and then pour into ice cream maker and follow manufacturer's directions. Follow manufacturer's instructions and churn until ice cream is set.

title: Smoked Salmon and Spinach Soup
ingredients: 700 ml chicken stock | 50 g spinach leaves ( fresh ) | 2 salmon fillets ( skinned and finely sliced ) | 150 g mayonnaise
instructions: Bring stock to the boil in a saucepan. Add spinach leaves, remove from heat, cover and poach until tender. In a large mixing bowl, combine salmon, mayonnaise and hot stock just until combined. Pour soup into the soup and heat through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,orange section,golden syrup,anchovy fillet,bay leaf,lentil,tomato green chile pepper
title: Green Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup lentils | 2 bay leaves | 1 can anchovy fillets, drained | 1 can condensed diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, undrained | 2 tablespoons orange sections, juiced | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 cups shredded mexican-style processed cheese, or as needed
instructions: Combine lentils, bay leaves, anchovies, tomatoes, orange juice, and golden syrup in a large bowl. Chill 1 hour. Top salad with mexican processed cheese, and refrigerate until chilled, 6 to 8 hours.

title: Green Beans With Tofu
ingredients: 200 g fresh cut green beans | 1 package firm tofu | 1 can refrigerated biscuits
instructions: Steam the tofu. The oil will separate and you will need a pot with a lid that will hold the tofu. Cut the block of tofu into 3 x 1 pieces and lay it over a bamboo steamer. Cover with water 3 inches above the tofu. Place over high heat and bring water to boil. As water boils, remove the pot and the lid and steam the tofu over medium heat until most of the water has boiled off. If necessary, cook a bit longer or leave slightly steam. Slice the tofu thinly and place it over the bean mixture. Drain the water off the tofu and serve the tofu over the bean mixture.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,anchovy paste,wheat germ,anchovy fillet,hungarian paprika,anise seed,basmati rice,dark brown sugar
title: Rice-Soaked Beef Tenderloins With Anchovy
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | dark brown sugar | anchovy paste | 1/4 cup whole wheat germ | 3/4 cup dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3 anchovy fillets, cut into halves | 4 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, lightly crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Trim both ends from the beef. Place on a rack in a 9 x 13 inch roasting pan and sprinkle beef with the dark brown sugar and sprinkle with the anchovy paste. Place the rack in the middle of the oven. Bake uncovered for 1 hour, testing for doneness with a meat thermometer. Baste periodically with remaining brown sugar, adding more brown sugar if necessary. Remove the meat from the oven and place in a large bowl. Meanwhile, put the wheat germ in a medium bowl, with the remaining brown sugar, 1/4 cup brown sugar, anchovies, paprika, and anise. Whisk until well blended. Ladle the marinade over the top, cover and let stand for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Using two sharp dinner forks, spread the meat on a rack and return to the oven for 1 1/2 hours longer or until a thermometer registers 125°f. Remove the meat from the oven and set aside. Let cool for 10 minutes. Turn the meat on a cutting board and slice thinly.

title: Green Chilies Salsa Verde
ingredients: 3 medium fresh green chilies | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Pierce each chili with a knife blade. Roast the chiles on a rimmed baking sheet under a broiler until charred, turning as necessary. When cool enough to handle, slit the chiles lengthwise. Using the tip of a small, sharp knife cut through the stem in 1/2 inch strips. Discard the chile pods. Place the chiles in a bowl and stir with the parsley. Let stand for 30 minutes, then stir in the green chilies. Serve.

title: Thai Sweet Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet rice, rinsed | 6 kaffir lime leaves, lightly bruised, leaves picked
instructions: Place 1 lb rice in a saucepan with enough water to cover the rice 3 inches above the rice. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 45 minutes or until rice is tender. Remove from heat, cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork and then stir in the lime leaves. Cook 2 minute more.

title: Mixed Vinegar Chicken Wings
ingredients: 300 g chicken wings | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 25 large seedless grapes leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170°c. Line a shallow baking tray with baking paper. Place the chicken wings, sugar and about 1/4 of the grapeseed in a dish and toss to coat. Place remaining grapeseed grapeseed in the dish and toss to combine. Arrange chicken wings in a single layer on the tray. Pour the rest of the grapeseed oil in the same dish and brown the chicken wings on all sides. Spoon the vinegar over them and cook the chicken for 40 minutes. When cooked, remove the chicken and grapeseed from the oven and serve warm with salad leaves or lemon wedges.

title: Tomato Mint Sauce (Tirk La Niirakang)
ingredients: 1 cup fresh mint sprigs | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 2 sprigs of fresh mint ( optional ) | salt
instructions: Place mint in blender, add tomato puree, stir. Pour into small bowl and salt to taste. Note, can be made 2 days ahead and cooled before serving.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,cream celery soup,ladyfinger,pinto bean,pork chop,rice noodle,dark soy sauce,mirin
title: Quick and Easy Vietnamese Pork Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 bag rice noodles | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 4 boneless pork chops, cubed | 1 1/2 cups pinto beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 cans cream of celery soup | 8 ladyfingers | 4 ounces dry sesame noodles or 4 ounces cooked vermicelli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook rice noodles according to instructions on seasoning packet. Drain and rinse in cold water. Meanwhile, in a large plastic bag, mix the dark soy sauce, mirin, and aniseed. Add pork and toss to coat. Place pork in greased 13x9 inch pan. Top with soaked rice noodles and beans. Mix soup and sesame noodles in a blender or food processor. Pour over pork. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes or let stand about 5 minutes before serving. Serve with bean sprouts and a spoonful of sesame noodles.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,lemon verbena leaf,molasses,red bean,baking soda,grain mustard,poppy seed
title: Lemony Frijoles With Red Beans (Red Beans Cooked in Mustard)
ingredients: 1 lb dried red beans | 2 bay leaves or 2 teaspoons dried lemon verbena leaves | 6 teaspoons molasses | 6 teaspoons whole grain mustard | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Sort dried red beans. In a medium saucepan, combine beans and enough water to cover. Cook, covered, over low heat till beans are tender, about 2 hours. Drain. Drain and rinse beans in warm water.

title: Thai Chicken Legs
ingredients: 1/3 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1/3 cup palm sugar | 2 tablespoons light lime juice | 1 lb chicken wings, cut in half crosswise | 1 small yellow squash, cut into 1/3 inch thick slices | 1/2 lb mushroom, sliced
instructions: To make the sauce, cook peanut butter in saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally until it is smooth and heated, about 2 minutes. Stir in sugar and lime juice. Add chicken and squash.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,panko breadcrumb,brown sugar,cream onion soup,green onion,coconut milk,turmeric,green chile
title: Easy Coconut Tortilla Casserole
ingredients: 8 corn tortillas | 2 cans cream of onion soup | 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped green onion | 1 can diced mild green chiles | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs ( japanese bread crumbs ) | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar | 1 tablespoon turmeric
instructions: Combine soup, coconut milk, green onions, chiles, panko, brown sugar and turmeric in a bowl. Arrange 4 tortillas in the bottom of a sprayed 13x9 inch baking dish. Pour soup mixture over tortillas and sprinkle with the top. Cover with foil and bake at 350°f for 40 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with paprika, bake 10 minutes longer. My note, its been sometime i do this with an extra can of cream of onion, since i thought it was in the can. This recipe is awesome you can add a little water or chicken broth if this is to have a creamier sauce. I also add mushrooms for extra flavor, just too flavor per the wild ones.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,chive,russet potato,graham cracker crumb,apricot nectar
title: Apricot-Glazed Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 9 russet potatoes - peeled, halved lengthwise, and unpeeled | 1 cup apricot nectar | 1/4 cup white sugar | chives, chopped | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the potato halves cut side down into the prepared baking dish. In a saucepan, combine the apricot nectar and sugar, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the sugar dissolves and the liquid has a syrupy consistency, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Pour the nectar from the pan into a bowl and reserve. Brush the potato halves with some of the reserved nectar, then sprinkle with the graham cracker crumbs. Arrange the potato halves in a single layer in the prepared dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the potatoes are tender and well colored, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,beef stock,jalapeno pepper,pasta,green bell pepper
title: Southwestern Macadamia Noodles
ingredients: 6 ounces dry pasta | 1 1/4 cups beef stock ( low sodium is ok ) | 1/4 cup canned whole green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup finely chopped green bell pepper | 2 tablespoons minced seeded jalapeno peppers
instructions: Cook pasta to desired doneness as directed on package.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,baby bok choy,tabasco sauce,chicken stock,rosemary sprig,accent seasoning,pineapple tidbit,taco sauce
title: Hot Bok Choy (Aka Boston Variety)
ingredients: 1 small russet potato ( about 3/4-inch squares, or you can use yukon gold if you like your bok choy ) or 2 medium zucchini, cut into 1/2-inch slices ( about 3/4-inch squares, or you can use yukon gold if you like your bok choy ) | 4 cups chicken stock ( or you can use vegetable stock instead ) | 3/4 - 1 lb baby bok choy, rinsed thoroughly and cut into 1/2-inch slices ( about 1 1/2-inch slices ) | 1/8 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1 large canned pineapple tidbits, drained ( reserve 1/4 for garnish ) | chili-garlic sauce, such as tabasco sauce ( see note ) | 4 -6 fresh rosemary sprigs | 4 -6 fresh taco sauce
instructions: Heat a large nonstick wok or skillet over medium heat. Add waterpacked baby bok choy.

title: Coconut Curry Sauce for Pork and Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 cup molasses
instructions: Heat chille oil in small pan over medium heat. Add cayenne pepper and molasses. Mix well. Let simmer until it just starts to thicken, stirring frequently.

title: Indian Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup frozen corn flakes, broken apart | 1 teaspoon dried anise seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 tablespoon ground turmeric | 1/2 cup finely chopped green | 1/2 cup finely chopped butternut squash
instructions: Stir chickpeas, cornflakes, anise seed, oregano, turmeric, green, and squash together in a bowl. Serve with crackers.

title: Sour Ramen
ingredients: 2 cups cooked ramen noodles | 2 plum tomatoes | 1 cup chopped cucumber | 1 teaspoon coriander seed
instructions: Add the noodles to boiling water. Boil until tender and drain. In another bowl combine remaining ingredients. Add to noodles and mix. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Scottish Smoked Sirloin
ingredients: 1/4 lb boneless beef top sirloin | 3 2/3 cups whipping cream or 3 2/3 cups regular whipping cream ( depending on size of meat ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper powder
instructions: Trim meat of gristle and fat and slice across grain into very thin strips. In a medium size skillet, over medium heat, simmer the cream. Add meat and pepper powder, stirring until heated. Serve with gravy.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,beef bouillon cube,strawberry preserve,paprika,asafoetida powder,baby spinach,gold tequila
title: Taqueria Beef Tips With Goya Spinach and Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat | 12 ounces beef bouillon cubes, crumbled | 8 ounces frozen unsweetened spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup dark green strawberry preserves | 1/4 cup gold tequila
instructions: Cut stew meat into bite size chunks and place in crockpot. Add bouillon cubes, spinach, paprika, and asafoetida and stir well to dissolve salt. Cover and cook on low for 12 hrs or on high for 4 - 5 hours. Remove from crockpot, cover and let cool completely. Stir and refrigerate overnight. Shortly before serving, stir together the strawberry preserves and tequila. Use to frost cooled beef tips.

title: Sautéed Chillies(Cookies)
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons red chile, chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh red chile
instructions: Spray a skillet with vegetable oil. Heat the pan over medium high heat. Add the chilli and pepper and stir fry 1 minute, stirring all the time. Transfer to a serving plate. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,vegetable stock,beef gravy,mayonnaise,frying chicken
title: Crock Pot Cheddar Canapes
ingredients: 1 frying chicken ( cut into strips ) | 1 can beef gravy | 1 package sharp cheddar cheese ( slices ) | mayonnaise | vegetable stock
instructions: Place chicken strips between wax paper, using both side of the wax paper touching the chicken strips. Brush with gravy and refrigerate for 1 hour. Roll chicken strip in cheese slices, then coat with mayonnaise, making sure to use more than a few slices. Place in crock pot, cover and cook on low heat for 3 - 4 hours, or until chicken is cooked through, stirring occasionally. Add vegetable stock, and continue cooking. Serve with corn muffins or french rolls.

Random Ingredients: blue curacao,coconut milk,vinegar,yellow pea,chili sauce,chickpea,garlic,lettuce leaf
title: Buffalo Hummus
ingredients: 1 container sweetened coconut milk | 1/4 cup minced garlic | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup yellow split peas | 1/2 cup fresh yellow pea, steamed and shelled ( or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar, for dip or 2 tablespoons lime juice, squeezed into measuring cup for dipping | 1/2 cup prepared bottled chili sauce, and | chickpeas, garnish | lettuce leaf, for garnish
instructions: Warm coconut milk under broiler or in microwave on medium heat. When heated through, stir in minced garlic and chili sauce. While warm, blend in split peas and fresh yellow peas. When serving, garnish with yellow pea sauce and chili sauce or chickpeas. Serve with lettuce leaves.

title: Rhubarb in Anchovy
ingredients: 1 pound rhubarb, tough ends removed, cut into small pieces | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste, or to taste
instructions: Place the rhubarb in a saucepan with a lid with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until rhubarb is soft and almost all of the water is gone, about 20 minutes. Mix in the anchovy paste, then set aside to cool to room temperature. Chill and add to a chilled salad bowl before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,margarine,salmon fillet,black pepper,yogurt,yellow bell pepper,thyme
title: Grilled Salmon with Peppers
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine or 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme | 2 teaspoons ground black pepper | 2 red bell peppers, cut into 1 inch strips | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1 inch strips | 2 chicken tenders | 1 tablespoon reduced-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Prepare grill to medium heat. Combine margarine, thyme and black pepper in small bowl, mixing well. In another small bowl, combine red bell peppers and yellow bell peppers. Brush both sides of each chicken tenders with reserved margarine mixture. Place tenders on oiled grill rack. Grill vegetables for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender and lightly charred. Transfer vegetables to plate.

title: Swiss and Swiss Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter | 1 cup sliced cooked corned beef, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 package shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together butter, corned beef, and swiss cheese. In a greased 2 1/2 quart casserole dish, spread about one third of the corned beef and cheese mixture. Repeat layers. Bake in the preheated oven 25 minutes, until bubbly.

title: Easy Mexican Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 red bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over medium high heat. Increase heat to high.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,self raising flour,head radicchio,chunky salsa
title: Elegant Spanish Sausage and Radicchio Cake
ingredients: 1 large head of radicchio | 30 g self-raising flour | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup alfredo sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Remove any excess moisture from the radicchio and cut off the top stem and base of the leaves. Remove the base and outer leaves from the head with large leaves and discard or trim the outer leaves. Use a small knife to cut out the core and discard the core. Cut the leaves into 4cm lengths and then cut each crossways into 5cm lengths. Place all the salad ingredients into a large mixing bowl and mix lightly together. Spread the alfredo sauce over the top evenly. Use your hand to spread it out evenly. Place the baking dish onto the centre shelf of the oven. Set the timer for 5 minutes. Reduce temperature to 180c and remove the baking dish and baking tray from the oven. Return the baking dish then place on a rack to cool for 5 minutes. Turn onto a wire rack then cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,chicken breast,egg yolk,red curry paste,nigella seed
title: Lobster Cakes Like Mama Used to Make
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 1 package julienned egg yolks | 3 tablespoons minced red curry paste | 8 ounces rice noodles, broken into pieces | nigella seeds
instructions: Slice chicken in thin strips about 1/8 inch wide then pound to 1/4 inch thick. Beat egg yolks with 2 tablespoons warm water in a large bowl just until thick and light colored. Add curry paste and stir until well blended. Stir in the chicken, 1/4 cup water and noodles. Toss until noodles are evenly coated using your fingertips. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Turn a few times to evenly coat all sides with batter. Sprinkle noodles with nigella seeds before serving.

title: French Canadian Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dried navy beans ( soaked overnight ) | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 dash hot sauce ( to taste ) | 1 dash ground cloves
instructions: Drain the beans. Cover with water and soak overnight. In the morning drain. Place beans in a saucepan and pour in enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Remove from heat and skim off excess water. Transfer to bowls and serve with tabasco and mustard.

title: Chacha's (Tabil) Spiced Tea
ingredients: 2 teaspoons turbinado sugar | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek ( roasted chile peppers ) | 1 black cardamom pod, or more to taste
instructions: Pour sugar into a tea ball and lightly crush the sugar with a mortar and pestle. Stir in the sambal oelek. Place cardamom pod in a tea cup and serve. Variation, substitute dried chile peppers for the dried peppers. If using black cardamom pods, lightly toast them first before serving.

title: Simple Cremema
ingredients: 1/2 cup mexican crema
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl or jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake well. Pour into a glass bowl, cover tightly and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,creamy peanut butter,tamarind chutney,balsamic vinegar
title: Tamarind and Peanut Butter Dip
ingredients: 1 jar creamy peanut butter ( i used dr. peanut butter ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons tamarind chutney | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed
instructions: Place the peanut butter in a small microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 15 seconds, stirring occasionally. Add the vinegar, tamarind chutney and lemon juice to the bowl and stir to combine. Cover the bowl tightly and set aside to allow flavours to develop.

title: Pea and Herkin Pickles
ingredients: 4 cups frozen peas and carrot sticks | 4 1/2 fluid ounces molasses | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 16 g pickles, drained and sliced | 1 -2 teaspoon dried tarragon, leaves
instructions: Put the peas and carrots in a pot, add enough boiling water to cover. Bring to boil and cook until vegetables are just tender, about 15 minutes. Drain in a fine mesh strainer into a bowl. Add remaining ingredients, except the pickles, and mix well. Pack the peas and carrots into clean, sterilized jars and top with the pickles. Seal with new lids and rings. Process 10 minutes in a hot oven, 275f until the pickles are bubbly. Serve at once.

title: Austrian Baked Cheese Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces red cabbage, in very small pieces ( about 2 large heads ) | 1/4 cup toasted sliced almonds, with skin | 8 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 8 ounces fresh mussels, debearded | 1/2 teaspoon sweet paprika | 1 lemon, juice of | 6 eggs, well beaten | 1/3 cup chocolate, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, add the first six ingredients. Place a layer of bread in the bottom of a baking dish. Add the top layer of bread. Top the bread layer with the cheese mixture. Whisk the egg yolks with the lemon juice until smooth. Beat the egg whites in a small bowl until stiff but not dry and fold them into the yolks. Fold the egg whites into the cheese mixture. Pour over the cheese layer. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden and bubbly. Let cool, sprinkle with chopped chocolate and serve.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,key lime juice,grape,pork shoulder,onion,mirin,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pork Loin with Grape Mint Sauce
ingredients: 1 package grape, halved | 1 onion, cut into thin wedges | 1/2 cup key lime juice | 1/2 cup mirin ( sweet japanese cooking wine ) | 4 slices boneless pork loin roast | 1/2 cup grated aged pecorino romano cheese | 1 pork shoulder, trimmed of fat
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the grape halves on a small baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the grape skins open and beginning to darken and blister, about 30 minutes. Remove grape skins from the baking sheet and set aside. Return grape halves to the oven, and bake until the skins are puffed up and dark red, about 10 minutes more. Remove the grape skins from the oven, and set aside. Bring the grape juice and onion to a low simmer in a small saucepan until the onion is tender, about about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the key lime juice and mirin. Stir until the mixture is simmering, about 5 minutes. Place the pork into a large, resealable plastic bag. Pour in the grape mixture.

title: Quick and Easy Ramen Noodles
ingredients: 3 ounces ramen noodles | 2 teaspoons whole wheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 clove garlic, pressed | 1 tablespoon chopped pecans, or to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ramen noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Blend 1 teaspoon of flour with 1/4 teaspoon sea salt in a mortar and pestle or spice grinder until evenly blended. Stir rice flour, thyme, garlic powder, and pecans into noodles.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,liquid smoke,schilling italian seasoning
title: Harry's Favorite Italian Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon schilling italian seasoning
instructions: Measure the contents of the liquid smoke, chicken bouillon, and schilling italian seasoning into a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,vanilla sugar,clove,tomato sauce,apple cider vinegar
title: The Best  Spiced Tomato Sauce and Catsup?
ingredients: 1 can crushed tomatoes with juice | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt ( not table salt )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor. Process or process until smooth. Note, you can add a little more vinegar in to taste. You can also add a little salt or paprika to taste. Can also use any tomato sauce you wish.

title: Slow Cooker Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1/2 cup green onion, sliced ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Set your crock pot to warm it up by heating up but not boiling it. Open the jar of alfredo sauce, and spread it over the bottom of your slow cooker. Sprinkle the entire green onions over the sauce, if using. Pour in the ginger garlic paste, then add your sliced green onions. Cover and cook until the onions are very tender, about 11/2 to 2 hours on high.. Stir the sauce occasionally while cooking to keep from burning on the bottom.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,gruyere cheese,cocoa powder,mexican oregano,yellow squash,yellow cornmeal,orange juice,phyllo dough
title: Mexican Squash Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo dough | 1 1/2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 1 cup shredded yellow squash | 1/2 cup shredded mexican oregano | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 3/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 dash mexican oregano ( optional ) | 1 pinch powdered yellow cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Lay 12 sheets of phyllo dough on the baking sheet, and brush with olive oil. Top with a sheet of phyllo dough. Brush generously with olive oil. Repeat with 12 sheets of phyllo dough until you have 12 sheets layered and layered. Spread 1 1/2 cups of gruyere cheese and 1 1/2 cups of sliced yellow squash along the length of your rectangle. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of mexican oregano, 1/2 cup of dark brown sugar, 1/4 cup of cocoa, orange juice, 1 tablespoon of dark brown sugar, and 1 dash of mexican oregano if using. Fold together, and roll up like a jelly roll, jelly roll fashion. Repeat with the remaining 12 sheets. Slice into 1/4 inch thick slices, and place on the hot baking sheet. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown. Allow to cool on sheets for about 5 minutes before removing to cool completely. Dust the rolls with the powdered yellow cornmeal.

title: Lebanese Pepper Dip (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 1 bulb garlic | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | 2 ounces sour cream, chilled
instructions: Remove the top layer of garlic cloves from head and discard remaining garlic cloves. Cut tops off of garlic with sharp knife and discard skins. Put garlic cloves in food processor with pepper flakes and shred finely. Turn process into small container and use on italian bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,raisin,vodka,mayonnaise,tomato sauce,black bean,cooking barley
title: Irish "lump" Barley Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups quick-cooking barley | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup raisins | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 cup prepared mustard flavored vodka | 2 drops liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Mix together the barley, black beans, raisins, mayo, tomato sauce, curing mixture, and vodka. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Japanese Cream Cheese and Pine Nut Dip (Vegan-Friendly)
ingredients: 1 cup breadcrumbs ( plain sweet bread ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/2 - 1 garlic clove | 3 -4 tablespoons mirin | 4 packages cream cheese
instructions: Toast pine nuts. In food processor, process pine nuts till fine. With blender or hand blender, combine pine nuts, garlic and mirin. Add cream cheese and process til smooth. If too dry add more. Add more bread crumbs. Refrigerate 1 - 2 hours. Serve with pita chips to dip, or warm pita bread.

title: Pesto-Stuffed Brats
ingredients: 4 bratwursts | 6 -8 small red potatoes | pesto sauce | bamboo skewers
instructions: Dice the brats into about 3/4 inch pieces. Place on a piece of plastic wrap. Pipe small, slightly flattened pieces of pesto onto the brats, being sure to leave a 1/2 inch border around the brats. Wrap the ends of the plastic wrap around the brats. Refrigerate the brats for up to 4 hours before serving. When serving, lightly steam the potatoes until tender, but not mushy. Remove potatoes from grill, and skewer the brats onto the potatoes. Garnish with pesto, if desired, and serve.

title: Tunisian Tomato Snack
ingredients: 2 large brown onions | 2 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Peel and chop the onions. Place them in a large bowl. Add the sundried tomatoes and paprika, and toss to mix well. Serve at room temperature.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Spinach & Fresh Lemon Grass (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon grass | 2 cups finely shredded coleslaw mix | 36 fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Cut tenderloin in half horizontally. Place onto rack in shallow dish. Sprinkle with lemon grass. Place coleslaw mix over top. Bake in preheated oven for 10 - 12 minutes or until tenderloin is just cooked through. Let stand 5 minutes. Cut thinly across the grain. Serve with spinach. Enjoy.

title: Crunchy, Low-Fat French Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup french dressing | 1/3 cup corn flakes, crushed
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Cover and chill for up to an hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,broccoli floret,scallion,kosher salt,lemon zest,mexicorn,orange,fajita seasoning mix
title: Broccoli With Corn, Oranges and Scallion
ingredients: 1 box frozen broccoli florets | 1/2 cup chopped scallion | 1/2 cup frozen mexicorn ( corn ) | 2 tablespoons grated orange rind | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon fajita seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 1/2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese or 1 1/2 cups colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Boil broccoli and cauliflower according to package direction until almost tender, 2 to 5 minutes. Drain and toss with the scallion. In a small bowl, mix corn with orange rind, lemon juice, fajita seasoning, and salt until blended. Place half of the cheese in a 13 x 9 baking dish. Place broccoli mixture over the cheese and coat with half of the corn mixture. Repeat layers with all of the remaining ingredients. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Cover and bake at 375°f until bubbly and golden brown, 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Creamy Cajun Trampy With Noodles
ingredients: 1 cucumber, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs sweet baby finger rolls, cut in half | 2 packages philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1/3 cup soya sauce | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning
instructions: To make dip, beat cream cheese with an electric mixer until no lumps remain, add remaining ingredients. To assemble, spread one half of each roll with dip and sprinkle with 1/2 tsp cajun seasoning. Roll up tightly and then slice in desired shape,.

title: Dressing With Lemonade
ingredients: 1 package chicken-flavored dry salad mix | 1 package frozen lemonade mix | 3/4 cup jasmine rice, jasmine preferred ( or your favorite recipe in this recipe ) | 1 1/2 cups unsalted chocolate pieces ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the salad, lemonade mix, rice, and unsalted chopped chocolate pieces. Add baking powder if desired. Cover, and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,beef eye,beef,mint leaf,chili sauce,monterey jack cheese,potato starch,italian dressing
title: Kathy's Mint Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef, trimmed of fat and cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices | 2 potatoes ( yukon golds or gold slices are good, too ) | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons beef fat ( or 2 tablespoons rendered beef fat ) | 1 tablespoon dried italian dressing | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 3 tablespoons seasoned potato starch ( potato starch is fine ) | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil, lightly oil the foil, and brush with oil. Grill meat until rare, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove. Remove from grill and let cool. When cool enough to handle, use a fork to poke through all layers of meat and potatoes. Set aside to cool completely. Coarsely chop cooled meat. Combine monterey jack, beef fat, italian dressing, mustard, chili sauce, and potato starch in a small bowl. Spoon meat mixture into bowl and season with italian dressing mixture. Seal well and refrigerate at least 20 minutes before serving. To serve, unfold from bowl and slice into rectangles.

title: Haddock and Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs haddock fillets, cut into serving size portions | 1 medium onion, thickly sliced | 4 cups chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. Cover a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange fish on the parchment sheet, and brush with oil. Bake until fish is cooked and is flaky with flakes, about 25 to 30 minutes, depending on thickness of fish and desired consistency. Remove from oven and top with sliced onion and parsley. Serve with salt and pepper, if desired.

title: Pear and Pesto Omelette (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 1)
ingredients: 1 egg | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( store-bought or homemade ) | 2 pears, peeled thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat 180°c fan forced /350°f/4 5 190°c fan forced ovens /375°f/5 gas mark make sure you have all the ingredients at hand. Place the egg in a shallow, non stick pan. Pour in enough water – to just cover the egg. Scatter over half the pesto and half the pears. Whisk the egg, then put it in the oven. Cook over the fan for 12 minutes or until the omelette is set and golden brown and pears are tender. Let stand 3 - 4 minutes before serving.

title: Nori and Corn on the Barbie
ingredients: 200 g macaroni | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 220 g corn | cooking spray | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium. Cook the macaroni for 4 minutes or until cooked to your liking. Remove from and allow to cool slightly. While this is cooking, steam the corn. Heat the grill pan to medium. Coat with cooking oil and cook the corn for 3 minutes, or until slightly charred, turning regularly. Remove and allow to cool slightly. Warm the barbecue. Take the macaroni from the fridge and run under cold water to cool slightly. While the grill is heating, combine the vinegar and balsamic in a jar with lid and shake to combine. Drain the pasta and place on a tray to cool slightly. Once the grill is ready, preheat it to medium with a medium flameproof lid so that the lid fits in the barbecue. Place macaroni back in the fridge. Brush the grill pan with oil and heat on medium until the grill pan is completely. Dip each nori sheet into the vinegar and balsamic mixture, flipping over for 1 minute per side, or until crisp. Top each nori sheet with a few chunks of corn, and serve.

title: Shredded Beef and Spinach
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes | 2 packages fresh spinach leaves
instructions: In a 2 quart covered saucepan, combine turmeric and 1/2 cup water and bring to a boil. Add meat, cover and simmer at a low simmer for about 1 hour. Add spinach, cover and cook for about 15 minutes longer. Cover and cook for another 5 to 10 minutes longer or until thick and the spinach wilts. Turn off heat and use a slotted spoon to put meat and spinach on serving plates. Serves.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,flour,mandarin orange segment,tomato juice,brown rice,shell pasta,arrowroot
title: Beef & Mandarin
ingredients: 3 tablespoons flour, in | 1 packet brown rice | 8 -12 ounces tomato paste or 8 -12 ounces tomato sauce | 1 medium yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 can mandarin orange segments, drained | 8 -10 small shell pasta, cooked ( shells, etc ) | arrowroot
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions. When cooked, mix in all remaining ingredients except arrowroot. Place in a bowl, top with arrowroot, and sprinkle of sea salt if desired. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti noodle,tapioca starch,broth,double cream,vanilla essence,ancho chile,corn tortilla chip
title: Hot Corn Tortilla-Pasta
ingredients: 250 g spaghetti noodles | 1 cup broth | 3 large corn tortilla chips ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon pure pure ancho chile | 2 -3 tablespoons tapioca starch | vanilla essence
instructions: Put the cornstarch, tapioca starch, & vanilla in a saucepan & heat through. While waiting for it to heat up, boil water & throw in the whole stack of corn tortilla chips. As soon as the tortilla chips are softened, put a tbsp or two of tapioca starch on a plate or tray & sprinkle a little bit of vanilla essence.

title: Caribbean Vegetable Toss
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 cup french's french-fried onions | 1 can bamboo shoots ( drained )
instructions: Place couscous and salt in large bowl. Cover with boiling water and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork and let sit 2 - 3 minutes. Add onions and bamboo and stir.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,cream,bean sprout,vanilla pudding mix,malt vinegar,pita bread,mexicorn,yellow pepper
title: Salmon and Bean Cottage-Stuffed Pitas
ingredients: 1 package mushroom instant vanilla pudding mix | 2 pita bread rounds | 1 cup light sour cream | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 can mixed beans with liquid | 1/2 yellow sweet pepper, sliced | 1/2 small red peppers or 1/2 small green pepper, sliced | 12 ounces salmon fillets, frozen ( about 2 cups )
instructions: Prepare soup mix according to package directions. Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease and flour a large baking dish. Set aside. Split pita bread rounds in half through the middle lengthwise, leaving about 3/4 inch crumbs. Spread the plain side of each pita with about 2 tablespoons sour cream. Sprinkle the pudding mix over the cream.

title: Gramma's Irish Whiskey-Glazed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes | 1 lb brown onion, chopped | 1 pint dark raisin
instructions: Scrub potatoes and poke holes about 1/2 inch deep in potatoes with sharp knife. Spray potatoes with cooking spray and cover potatoes with about 1/2 inch of water. Bake at 400 degrees f. The time the potatoes get almost done, in a medium saucepan cook brown onions and raisins over high heat until the are soft, then add potatoes and mix well. Simmer for about 15 minutes or until potatoes are cooked.

Random Ingredients: ginger,superfine sugar,pimento pepper,poppy seed,rice wine,grain rice
title: Poppy Seed Rice Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup poppy seed | 1/2 cup pimento pepper, finely minced | 3 tablespoons rice wine or 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/4 cup superfine sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar | 3 tablespoons freshly grated ginger | hot cooked short-grain rice, to serve
instructions: Place poppy seeds, pimento, wine, sugar, and ginger in a bowl. Cover and leave for 10 minutes. Transfer to your blender and blend until well mixed, pour through a fine sieve or strain through a sieve, pressing firmly with the back of a spoon. This mixture is very thick and will stain clothing and fat. Add enough hot cooked short or hot rice to make a thin dipping sauce. Store refrigerated for up to 3 weeks.

title: Blueberry Mint and Herb Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 2 cups fresh blueberries ( or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint ( no stems ) | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning, plus more ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon sea salt ( to taste )
instructions: Stir the broth into the blueberries and place them in the pot over medium high heat. Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes and stir in the mint and lemon pepper spice. Simmer for several minutes to heat the mint. Salt to taste.

title: Tomatillo Tomiyaki (Yakisoba Sauce)
ingredients: 5 medium tomatillos | 1 1 cup dashi
instructions: Wash the tomatillos. You can slice them, or slice your own tomatillos. Place the tomatillos on a medium hot grill, and grill them, turning at least once, until they are slightly blackened and crispy. Remove from grill and cool. When cool enough to handle, remove the skin by peeling. Roughly chop the tomatillos. Place the dashi in a small saucepan and bring to a boil, add just enough dashi to cover the tomatillos. Turn down heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, to reduce the liquid. Remove from heat.

title: Fruited Sweet and sour cabbage
ingredients: 1 can sweetened tomato and tomatillos, drained and pureed | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup soymilk | 2 small cabbage, medium size cut into 1/2 to 3/4 inch wedges | 12 ounces green cabbage, halved
instructions: Place tomato and tomatillos, rice vinegar, soymilk, and cabbage in a large bowl. Spoon vegetables over tomato mixture and toss to coat evenly. Let chill in refrigerator 15 minutes, or serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,orange,cinnamon sugar,sharp cheddar cheese,italian bread,canola oil,picante sauce
title: Chili Con Queso
ingredients: 4 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup shredded italian bread ( about 16 ounces ) | 12 ounces canned picante sauce | 1 teaspoon chili flakes, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon orange rind, grated | 1/4 teaspoon canola oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Let stand for at least 20 minutes to allow cheese to absorb flavors. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Lemongrass Glazed Grilled Apples (Kathi)
ingredients: 2 large apples ( red delicious, like anjou ) | 1 teaspoon grated lemongrass | 1/2 tablespoon grated peeled apple or 1 teaspoon grated ginger | 1/2 tablespoon garam masala | 2 drops balsamic vinegar | miracle whip ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler with a light coating of cooking spray. Cut apples lengthwise into very thin slices. Place apple slices on baking sheet and broil 3 - 4 minutes, turning apple slices once, until softened and lightly charred. In small bowl or small metal bowl, mix lemon grass, apple and garam masala with balsamic vinegar. Drizzle dressing over apples and toss to coat. Serve hot, or warm, plain or with miracle whip. Tip, you can prepare a few hours ahead to let flavors blend.

title: Baked Chicken
ingredients: 3 cups skinless chicken pieces ( bone in, boneless or boneless ) | 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Place the chicken pieces in a casserole or roasting pan. Combine the butter and the vanilla, and drizzle over the chicken. Bake, uncovered, for about 1 hour. Season with salt and pepper, and continue to bake uncovered for 20 minutes longer or until no liquid remains. Serve.

title: Curry Paste
ingredients: 3 small serrano chilies, chopped | 3 tablespoons ghee | 2 teaspoons red curry paste
instructions: Heat the ghee in a small skillet over medium heat. Add chiles and cook, stirring constantly, until the chiles are slightly browned and the edges curl, about 5 minutes. Stir in the curry paste. Cook another minute to allow excess oil to run off, then stir to combine.

title: Molded Cheese Spread
ingredients: 3 cups shredded white cheese | 3 cups shredded mild white cheese curds ( not cheese curd ) | 1 tablespoon saffron | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely minced
instructions: Combine cheese, white cheese curd, saffron, and jalapeno in small bowl. Pack into individual baking dishes. Preheat broiler. Broil about 2 minutes on each side, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,chilies,pea carrot,leg lamb,italian bread,stewing beef
title: Lamb Stew - Jamie Oliver
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs australian leg of lamb | 2 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 1 1/2 teaspoons bread flour | 3 lbs frozen peas and carrots | 2 cans chilies | italian bread, cut in 1 inch cubes
instructions: Remove all visible fat from lamb and cut into chunks, approximately 3 lbs each. Place lamb, stewing beef and frozen peas in crockpot. Sprinkle flour over the meat and stir gently to coat. Cover and cook on low for 5 hours or on high for up to 5 hours, depending on the size of your meat. Add chiles and place in fridge until ready to serve or until desired serving temperature. Discard the chile skins and serve with toasted italian bread cubes for dipping.

title: Pressed Beef
ingredients: 1 beef roast | 14 ounces cream-style pesto sauce | 4 thin slices pimiento ( optional ) or 4 strips swiss cheese ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon packed brown sugar | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Remove rind, cut roast in half. Place meat in a large ziplock bag, add 2 cups pesto and seal. Marinate in refrigerator for at least 1 hour or overnight. Remove meat from marinade and dry with paper towels. Combine brown sugar, bread crumbs and remaining 2 cups of pesto in a small bowl. Heat oven to 325 degrees. Remove meat from bag and sprinkle with half of the sugar mixture. Roll meat in mixture, then place on oiled rack in a shallow baking pan. Bake for 2 hours, or until browned and internal temperature reaches 140 degrees. Cut in slices and serve with french bread if desired.

title: Sautéed Spicy Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 ripe mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 lb assorted frozen stewed fruit ( such as raisins, apple chunks, apples, oranges, pears, bananas, applesauce )
instructions: Peel vegetables if they are large, trimming off ends. Cut each in half horizontally and slice the long way, removing the peels, if necessary, to measure two thirds to three quarters. Place sliced vegetables in a bowl with enough boiling water to cover them and let them rest for 20 minutes. Drain well and set aside. Drain all but six of the vegetable quarters and put them in the bowl with the cooked vegetables. Cut the remaining four quarters, then cut them in four and add them, along with raisins and orange or pear chunks. Toss gently. Place salad in a serving platter. Serve topped with fruits.

title: Belgian Endive With Red Chile Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 belgian endive, leaves, stems endy, cut on bias | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 teaspoon red chili, ground | 1 vanilla bean, seeds scraped
instructions: Heat the butter in a small saucepan over medium low heat, until melted. Add endives, and cook until softened, about 2 minutes. Add rice, red chili, and vanilla bean, and saute 3 minutes until aromatic and heated through. Add the butter mixture over medium heat and cook until just warm to the touch. Serve at once.

title: Hot Mexican Covered Lamb
ingredients: 1 boneless leg of lamb | salsa verde, warmed | 2 tablespoons salt | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons diced salami | 2 tablespoons sliced green olives | 20 slices firm tofu, cut into 6 equal pieces
instructions: Slash meat well with sharp knife or tenderizer. Place in a shallow baking dish. Cover meat with warm salsa verde and let marinate at least 20 minutes or longer. Sprinkle with salt, tabasco and all ingredients, including but 3/4 of the olives. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes or until meat is tender and sauce is bubbling. Remove from oven. Spoon remaining salsa over meat. Sprinkle with remaining olives. Can be served on plates topped with other condiments of your choice.

Random Ingredients: white pepper powder,rock salt,red chile,simple syrup,marsala wine,onion salt
title: Simple French Onion Chops
ingredients: 4 large red chile peppers | 1/2 cup simple syrup ( see note ) | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1/4 cup rock salt | 1 teaspoon white pepper powder | 1/8 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Note, chilies can be finely chopped and used as a substitute for the chilies during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Sterilize a grill pan and place the chili peppers on the heating element. Roast the peppers over medium heat until blackened, 3 to 5 minutes. Turn off heat and peel the skins away. Place the chilies in a medium sized bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap or waxed paper. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Wipe the chilies clean with a damp cloth. Place chilies in the food processor. Add all other ingredients, except for chilies, and process to a paste. Pour chile mixture into a heavy duty zip top plastic bag or other container. Seal and marinate chilies for at least 3 days in the refrigerator. Heat a grill pan or a frying pan over medium heat. Remove chilies from marinade and discard marinade. Grill the chilies on grill until just cooked, about 5 minutes total. Do not overcook. Serve immediately on large platter with a sauce.

title: Red Pepper Crumb Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup plain breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Lightly oil an 8 x 8 x 2 inch pan. In a medium bowl combine the red pepper and bread crumbs. Pour bread crumbs into the pan and toss to coat evenly. Cover and bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Place on a serving plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: noodle,green chili pepper,tomato puree,watermelon,shiitake mushroom,red chilies,tarragon,aubergine
title: Chinese Vegetable Noodle Bowls
ingredients: 1 lb medium noodles | 1 medium aubergine ( eggplant- cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks ) | 2 -4 small shiitake mushrooms | 6 ounces canned green chili peppers | 3 -4 sliced fresh red chilies or 3 -4 sliced green chili peppers | 3/4 cup chopped tomato puree ( or a combination of a good variety ) | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 cup watermelon, diced ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Boil noodles in salted water until tender, then drain. Rinse with cold water for a few more seconds, drain, and set aside. Trim the root ends, leaving the stem attached on either side of the leaves. Wash the mushrooms and chilies, if desired, then slice in half lengthwise. Slice the chilies thinly and the tomatoes into 1 1/2 inch chunks or use grape tomatoes. In a small bowl, mix the tomato purée, tarragon, and 1/4 cup water to make a paste. Slice the bell peppers into 1/8 inch slices, and slice them into half inch strips. In a large non stick skillet, heat a few tablespoons of oil over medium heat. When hot, carefully add the diced eggplant and saute until the eggplant is tender. Add mushrooms, sauteed eggplant, sauteed bell peppers, and mushrooms and continue to toss, constantly flipping to ensure that they stay moist, and keep them moving. Add the chilies and tomato purée and cook, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes longer. Add the tarragon paste and mix well. Serve immediately over prepared hot rice.

title: Tuna Florentine Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1 can tuna, drained
instructions: Combine spinach and tuna in a large bowl. Chill in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Beets and Rice
ingredients: 1 can sliced canned beets | 3/4 cup uncooked brown rice | 1/3 cup olive, drained and rinsed
instructions: Spray a saucepan with nonstick cooking spray. Layer the beets and rice in the pan, ending with beets on top. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat, and simmer about 20 minutes. When the beets are tender and the rice is tender, drain the liquid, and stir in the olives.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,monterey jack cheddar cheese,sprite
title: Cheesy Apple Gratin
ingredients: 3 granny smith apples ( about 1.5 pounds ) | 3/4 cup monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | sprite, as required
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Use a 2 1/2 x10 1/2 inch baking sheet. Peel apples and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange in a 2 quart dish. Pour the cheese over the apples, spreading it out evenly, being careful not to spread it out. Sprinkle top with the 1/2 cup of monterey jack cheese. Bake in preheated oven until the cheese lightly browns, about 25 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Couscous Salad
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable juice cocktail ( tomato-flavored, or other veggie like clamato ) | 6 large egg yolks, well beaten ( or 5 large egg whites, if you like the sauce a little thinner ) | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 lb fresh broccoli floret ( about 3 cups ) | 1 cup turnip ( chopped ) | 1 lb fresh tomato ( chopped, i like roma tomatoes in a jar of the garlic and herbs, personal preference )
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package, cool, then cover and chill. Chop broccoli, turnip, and tomatoes if you are using your blender or food processor, i recommend first chopping each ingredient in the blender/food processor before combining everything else. Combine egg yolks, saffron, and vegetables. Combine egg mixture and vegetables in medium bowl. Add more liquid or additional tomato if necessary to moisten mixture slightly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dill,ricotta cheese,cilantro,taco sauce,cooking sherry,lettuce leaf,lamb,black bean
title: Lamb Tostadas (Taco Sandwich)
ingredients: 1 package ground lamb, leftovers | 1/3 cup taco sauce | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | lettuce leaf | 4 lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh dill
instructions: Grill or broil the lamb and add salsa, sherry, cilantro and ricotta cheese. In a small skillet over medium heat, heat the sherry.

title: Miracle Whip Tofu Salad
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu ( use 1 cup of tofu, 1/2-1/2/3 cup ) | 2 tablespoons miracle whip | 1 tablespoon red coriander powder
instructions: Cut tofu into 3/4 inch slices. Cut tofu slices into 3 inch squares with a very sharp knife. Cut each squares into 3 triangles. Combine the dressing ingredients. Brush the tofu on 1 side and sprinkle with the spice mix. Serve.

title: Cuban Chickpea and Meat Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb steak ( skirt steak can be substituted ) | 8 ounces garbanzo beans | 1/2 lb meat ( beef flanken can be replaced with chicken breast breast or shrimp stew meat ) | 2 cups stock | garlic | cilantro leaf ( to garnish ) | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight. Pour stock into a saucepot and bring to a boil. Add 1/2 teaspoon cilantro leaves. Slice meat. Brown meat in a frying pan. Strain the stock. Add chickpeas to the stock mixture and simmer for 1 hour. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoons cilantro leaves and garnish with peanuts.

title: Sliced Baked Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb frozen meatballs, thawed | 2 cups prepared guacamole | 1/2 cup prepared yellow onion, chopped | 1/4 cup shallot, diced | 1/8 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1 cup hot broth | 1/4 cup packed dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place frozen meatballs in a glass baking dish and sprinkle with brown sugar and dark brown sugar. Pour the hot broth over the meat, cover tightly and bake at 375°f for 40 minutes. Remove lid and bake for another 40 - 50 minutes, uncovered until meat is cooked through and juices are a bit browned about 10 minutes. Cut a slice from the crusts of your choice and place on serving plate. Pour broth over the meat and serve. Variation with brown sugar sauce, brown sugar sauce can be mixed into the guacamole instead of the brown sugar.

title: Sweet Italian Apples
ingredients: 5 large green apples or 5 large red apples | 1 bottle italian dressing
instructions: Core apples and cut into chunks. Place them in a large pot of ice, and cook over medium heat 5 - 7 minutes until apples are very soft. Drain, and place in a bowl. Dressing, put ingredients in a jar, and shake well to combine. Toss the apple chunks into dressing.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,thyme,egg noodle,white onion,cake flour,porcini mushroom
title: Soup Pastilla
ingredients: 300 g dried cake flour or 300 g bread flour, all purpose | 150 g fresh porcini mushrooms, thinly sliced | 150 g fresh white onions ( about 2 medium ones ) | 2 eggs | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | basil leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, start to blend all the dry ingredients. Pour in the eggs and stir well, until the mixture has a yellowish paste like consistency. Add mushroom slices, onions and basil leaves, and stir again until they are well blended. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius/450 degrees fahrenheit. Grease or spray a large oven proof baking pan with cooking spray and set aside. Pour the soup mixture and a ladle full of boiling water/broth into the pan, and mix well. Cover the pan with a lid, and place into preheated oven for about 45 minutes. Remove the pan from the oven and allow it to rest for 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

title: Duckling Pasta Salad
ingredients:
6 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 3 packages mixed mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 package smoked duckling or 1 duck 
    - 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 4 cups cooked and cooled pasta ( any shape, such as spaghetti, linguine or ziti )
instructions: In a large mixing bowl toss together 1 cup of the lettuce, mushrooms, duckling, mayonnaise and tartar and let cool. Stir the cooled dressing into the pasta until just incorporated. Stir in the remaining lettuce and serve. Variation, stir in fresh tomatoes before serving.

title: Scotch Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb bulk pork sausage | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup gravy
instructions: Combine the meat, horseradish, and gravy. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pork,spinach,chili flake,accent seasoning,kidney bean,onion powder,ginger paste,chicken liver
title: Liver and Spinach Stuffed Calamari
ingredients: 1 large onion | 1 lb pork or 1 lb sausage | 2 tablespoons chicken liver, minced | 1/2 tablespoon chili flakes ( or more to taste ) | 1 tablespoon instant malted chicken livers, minced | 1/2 tablespoon instant malted dried shrimp or 1/2 tablespoon dried shrimp ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder ( optional ) | 1/2 tablespoon accent seasoning | 1 package frozen spinach, defrosted and squeezed of excess water | 1 pinch a pinch dried chili flakes ( optional )
instructions: In food processor, finely chop onion. In large pot cook pork, onion and spices. Drain excess fat. Add cooked onion and spices and cook until the pork is no longer pink in the middle and breaking up any clumps. Stir in spinach and cook until wilted. Stuff filling into the body of the calamari, leaving a little stuffing in the end. Wrap dough tightly with aluminum foil and place in refrigerator to marinate for about 30 minutes. Unwrap stuffing, discard dough and roll dough evenly. Wrap with more plastic and tie with string so no stuffing escapes during the cooking process. In an iron skillet fry filled calamari in hot oil, about 3 or 4 minutes per side, turning over after 3 - 5 minutes. Serve in deep, warmed bowls with plenty of napkins on the side for dipping if desired.

title: Pimiento Walnut Salad
ingredients: 250 g walnuts, shelled | 1 jar pimiento, drained | 1/2 cup salad oil
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add walnuts and stir for 1 minutes or until golden. Remove walnuts from pan and drain on paper towel. Sprinkle with cold water to stop the cooking process. Mix nuts in a large bowl with pimientos. Add salad oil to loosen and chill.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,sauerkraut,chili powder,graham cracker crumb,baby clam,potato starch,tomato paste,honey
title: Bridies With Coconut Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 2 large potatoes, peeled and grated | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/4 cup coconut cream | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1 package fresh graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray. In a large serving bowl, mix together sauerkraut, garlic, potatoes, chili powder, coconut cream, tomato paste and honey. Mix in potato starch until well blended. Roll the dough into 12 - 12 balls and place on the prepared baking sheet. Press crumbs into outsides of the outsides of the balls. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 to 45 minutes, until crumbs are crisp and golden.

title: Peppered Ribs
ingredients: 2 lbs pork ribs | 1 large yellow pepper, cut into strips
instructions: Soak ribs in cold water for 30 to 40 minutes or until tender, about 2 hours. Drain water from ribs and pat dry with paper towels. Slice ribs crosswise about 3/8 inch thick. Grill or oven broil peppers for 4 to 6 minutes on each side, or until tender. Place ribs on platter and spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the remaining cooking cooking liquid over them. Top with hot peppers. Serve immediately.

title: Smoked Lamb and Mung Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs mung beans | 1 1/2 lbs meatballs ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 lb smoked pork butt ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon peppercorn, crushed | radish ( to garnish )
instructions: Soak the first 5 ingredients for 1 hour. Place meatballs in a large bowl, with 3 cups water and 1/2 teaspoon of the pepper and vinegar. Soak overnight, and cook with the other 1/2 teaspoon of pepper. Drain, and add the drained beans to the pot with the meatballs. Cook on medium heat for two hours, or until beans are very tender. Remove lid, and continue cooking for 30 minutes until meat is cooked through. Serve garnished with radishes.

title: Easy Chicken Gravy
ingredients: 6 chicken bouillon cubes ( or about 1 teaspoon of granulated garlic powder or dried chicken bouillon from a package of chicken bouillon ) | 1 teaspoon ginger paste
instructions: Combine chicken bouillon cubes with the ginger paste according to package instructions. For a thicker gravy, add some water. Makes about 2 cups. You can serve with boiled potatoes, celery, and peas while you are simmering up the gravy. You can also use the crockpot method of making the gravy in a pot. Just mix the ingredients in the pot, then set to low and cook for a couple hours or overnight. You may add any remaining chicken flavor to this recipe to make gravy.

title: Yulekake (Yeast Ziti)
ingredients: 4 cups ziti pasta | 1 1/2 cups sugar, divided | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/3 cup hing
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse lightly with cold water and drain well. Mix together sugar and picante sauce in a bowl and pour into cooked pasta. Heat over low heat until mixture is warm, stirring occasionally.

title: Pizzeria Razzoni
ingredients: 12 raspberries to taste | 1 1/2 ounces pepperoni, shredded | 1 teaspoon vanilla vodka | 1 lemon, zest of | 1/2 teaspoon raspberry vinegar, optional
instructions: Rinse rashes under running water for a full 10 seconds then plunge them into a bowl of ice water so they drain. Set aside 10 to 20 minutes, or until completely cooled, but not wet. Place drained raspberries on a medium size plate, spoon some razzoni onto each ramekin, then top with pepperoni, vodka, lemon zest and raspberry vinegar. Eat immediately.

title: Grilled Sirloin Beef Cubes
ingredients: 5 lbs thinly sliced sirloin | 1/4 cup chili oil, your favorite brand | 1 can mixed fruit, drained thoroughly
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with hands. Heat over indirect heat on broiler rack, not hot or medium high. Grill 7 minutes per side.

title: Scotch Salmon With Blueberry Relish
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 4 tablespoons blueberries, washed and dried | 1 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Place salmon in a lightly coated 9 x 13 inch pan which has been sprayed with cooking spray. Sprinkle berries on top of salmon. Sprinkle with onions salt. Cover pan with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Remove salmon from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,tomato puree,okra,farfalle pasta,marinara sauce
title: Italian Okra and Tomato Farfalle Pasta Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked farfalle ( bowget ) pasta | 1/2 cup canned tomato puree | 1/2 cup finely diced okra | 3 -4 drops red food coloring ( optional ) | prepared marinara sauce
instructions: In large bowl, set aside. In 1 cup pasta water, add okra and tomato puree. When sauce is warm, add a few drops of red food coloring, if desired.

title: Lamb on the Loaf (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 400 g lean ground lamb shoulder | 4 1/2 ounces fast rise yeast | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 100 g veal fat ( preferably fat )
instructions: In your bread machine pan, place ingredients. Select french or italian. Insert a meat thermometer into the meat mixture, and set in the warm oven. When the breadmachine alerts you to loaves in its directions, remove meat from the bread machine and place on a wire rack to cool. Slice meat into thin long slices, using a sharp knife, and serve.

title: Manicotti
ingredients: 1 lb manicotti | 1 cup quick oats ( or molasses )
instructions: Fill a large pot of lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Meanwhile, heat a 9 x 13 inch baking dish to medium heat, spray with cooking spray. When the water comes to a boil, add the manicotti stirring to coat lightly with oil and cook for 3 minutes, remove and drain. Combine the oats with 1/4 cup water and stir until well blended. Fill a large bowl or serving bowl with the oats and pour the oat mixture over. Using a toothpick, toss to coat the pasta. Serve immediately. Note, manicotti may be frozen, then transferred to the resealable freezer bag and frozen for up to 2 months.

title: Linguica Me Melanzane (Saffron Spaghetti and Squash)
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, halved | 1 pinch saffron threads | 1/2 cup white vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray. Place squash halves on roasting pan so that they are at least 1 inch apart and not touching. Rub squash with saffron and pour the vinegar into roasting pan. Roast in preheated oven until squash is tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven and cut squash in half lengthwise. When squash is cool enough to touch, cut squash in half again lengthwise. Remove seeds and ribs from squash with a spoon and place cut side up on a platter. Cover and allow to stand in a warm place until squash is ripe and chilled, about 1 hour. Remove squash and cut lengthwise into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Return mixture to roasting pan and pour vinegar over them. Toss squash with remaining saffron and serve.

title: Ancho Chili Corn Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen whole kernel corn | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons ground ancho chili, or to taste
instructions: Place corn corn in a bowl and mash with a potato masher. Mix bread crumbs, flour, and ancho chiles together in a separate bowl. Combine corn mixture with bread crumb, flour, and chilies.

title: Pierogi With Broad Beans and Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb broad bean, ends snapped | 1/2 lb pepperoni or 1/2 lb bacon, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Put split broad beans in boiling water for no more than 15 minutes. Then drain and rinse again. Cook bacon till crisp. In a hot skillet, add pepperoni and cook until crisp. Add cooled broad beans to the skillet and cook until hot. Then add the pepperoni and bacon to it. Serve at once from an iron skillet or pasta dish. This freezes well.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,onion salt,bread,green chili,mandarin orange,beef bouillon cube,half,beef stock cube
title: Mandarin French Onion Soup
ingredients: 20 ripe mandarin oranges, cut into thin slices | 5 -6 slices of your favorite hard bread, cut into slices | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/2 cup beef stock cube, diluted in | 1 can or bottle beer | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 small fresh green chili, sliced or 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a large pot and cook until the onions are translucent. Add more beer to moisten. Eat while hot.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,beer,poppy seed,rump roast,dijon mustard,mango chutney
title: Roast Poppy-Seeded Pork with Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 boneless shoulder rump roast | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 cup fresh mango chutney ( use any brand you like ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1 tablespoon malt free goat chutney or 1 tablespoon other jam
instructions: Put the roast in a large saucepan and sprinkle the salt all over. Stir in the mango chutney and mustard and then cover and marinate in the fridge for 1/2 hour. Preheat oven to 400°f. Take the roast out of the marinade and pat dry with kitchen paper. Heat the grill to medium heat. Remove roast from the marinade and rub it into the roast for 3 to 5 minutes on each side, or until lightly browned. Place the roast in the oven and bake for 45 minutes to an hour, or until a meat thermometer reads 160°f. Remove the roast to a warm platter and cover loosely with foil to keep warm. Reduce the heat to medium and heat the remaining 1 tablespoon chutney until very warm. Spoon the warm chutney into a roasting pan and grill for 15 minutes, turning and basting with the chutney. Remove from the skillet and transfer to a serving dish. Pour the warm chutney over the meat, sprinkle with poppy seeds and serve with bread and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,onion powder,black eyed pea,oil,bacon,egg white,dark beer
title: Bacon and Egg Nosedse
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated egg whites | 1 packet onion powder | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground black-eyed peas | 1 can dark beer | 1/4 cup oil | 6 slices bacon, chopped
instructions: Line the bottom of an 8 x 8 inch pan with a few layers of paper towels, place the egg whites in a flat dish.
