Sprinkle 1/2 the onion powder, fennel seed and ground black eyed pea over the egg whites and press into the corners with fingers. In a large bowl, whisk together the beer, 1/4 cup oil and remaining onion powder. Beat in bacon strips. Pour mixture over egg whites. Bake at 350°f for 35 to 40 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Rutabagas (Peas and Chutney for the Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 rutabaga ( peeled and sliced into � inch thick slices ) | 1 tablespoon baking cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon baking cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules
instructions: Place potato slices in the crock pot. Top the potato slices with half of the garlic granules.

title: Pear Roasted Cauliflower
ingredients: fresh cauliflower floret | 1 pear, peeled, cored and cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Toss cauliflower with the pear wedges. Spread cauliflower in a roasting pan. Roast in preheated oven until golden brown, tossing every ten minutes. Let cool 3 minutes. Note, apple pears can be found at specialty food stores.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,bean sprout,jalapeno chile pepper,yellow onion
title: Jabisco Hash Brown (Low Fat and Healthy)
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes, peeled | 20 ounces dry fat-free refried beans from scratch ( fat and no sodium ) | 1 1/2 cups chopped dried jalapeno chile peppers ( i like cholula brand ) | 1/2 yellow onion, finely chopped
instructions: Cut a 1 to 1 1/2 inch slits all the way around the pan. Place the baking potatoes in the pan. Cover with water, about an inch or so. The potato skins shouldn't be able to penetrate the outer layer of the skillet, because they'll cook and steam the potato. Bake, uncovered, in the preheated oven until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork and the top is lightly browned, 25 to 30 minutes. Remove the potatoes from the oven and set aside so they don't dry out. When cool enough to handle, slice crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. When cool enough to handle, break each potato slice into quarters. Reserve any leftover chips for later use.

Random Ingredients: bragg liquid amino,black peppercorn,potato starch,lemon juice zest
title: Peppery Sweet Potato Fritters
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons potato starch or 2 -3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 -2 tablespoon light braggs liquid aminos or 1/2 - 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 dash black peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Beat the cornstarch or flour with a pinch of salt until smooth and creamy. Stir in the rest of the ingredients and blend thoroughly. Dip spoonfuls of fritter batter into hot fat, turning to coat all sides. Fry in batches if necessary. Do not crowd the pan.

title: Cherie's Awesome Chocolate
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix everything together and serve. Enjoy.

title: Prosciutto Bites
ingredients: 4 slices provolone cheese | 1 can blueberries | fresh mint leaves, torn in half
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees f. Place one slice of provolone in the center of a piece of aluminum foil and spread with blueberries. Sprinkle with chopped mint leaves. Repeat the layering process if necessary. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: The Best Ever Baked Egg Beaters
ingredients: 6 eggs, beaten | 2/3 cup egg substitute
instructions: Put the egg beater in a mixing bowl. Add the egg beaters to the bowl then put the bowl in the fridge for at least 4 hours to meld. Heat the oven to 355 degrees f. Line the bottom of a baking sheet with foil. Put the baking sheet on the rack of a broiler pan. When the oven is ready, get out the oven and spray the baking rack with cooking spray. Put the bowl and eggs in a bowl. Pour the egg mixture into a glass measuring cup or cup. Then add the 2/3 cup of Egg Substitute. Mix it well with a fork until everything is mixed well.. Pour the mixture into your baking sheet. Carefully put the baking rack into the roasting pan. Bake the egg measurements from your eggs into a glass measuring cup using your blender gives you a measure, 7 points per egg beaters. You can vary the cooking time accordingly. When the baking sheet is ready it will probably take 15 - 20 minutes to finish. Remove and let cool about 10 minutes. Break the egg in half and put on a serving plate. Pour the egg mixture over them, making sure they're all covered. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,kumara,parmesan cheese,cinnamon,liquid smoke flavoring
title: Kumara (Spicy Sweet Potato) Patties
ingredients: 1 medium kumara, grated ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 teaspoons ground red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, finely grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and knead until mixture is smooth and creamy. Place dough onto a clean work surface and pat into 1 1/2 inch thick oval shape. Using a 2 1/2 inch diameter cooking knife, press kumara onto the baking sheet, cover loosely, and let stand in a cool place for 45 to 60 minutes to 1 hour. Lightly grease a nonstick skillet, and preheat over medium heat. Fry patties, cut sides down, in the hot fat for 1 - 2 minutes or until patties are crisp on the outside and slightly browned on the inside, about 2 - 3 minutes each side. Transfer patties to a serving plate. Serve with pita bread, or other side dishes.

title: Peanut Butter Poppers
ingredients: 10 whole chunky peppers or 10 whole red peppers | 1/3 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 cup frozen peas
instructions: Clean peppers place peppers on cutting board. Peel off stems and discard seeds and chop into 3 - 4 squares or smaller. Mix peanut butter, paprika, vanilla with half cup of water in food processor. Add peanut butter/vegetable mixture. Pulse mixture until peanut butter is mixed in well and peppers are ground or chunky. Add peas to peanut butter mixture and mix well. Refrigerate peppers overnight. Can also be frozen for up to a month.

title: English Steak Suet
ingredients: 5 pounds beef top sirloin steaks | 3/4 cup dark seedless raisins | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 packages confectioners'sugar | 1 package sliced suet
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Cut the steak into thin strips about 1/4 inch thick. Spread on a tray. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of dark seedless raisins over the meat. Sprinkle over 1 teaspoon of allspice. Repeat with the remaining slices and raisins,. Press down on the meat to even out the spice. Layer the slices in a baking dish. Mix confectioners' sugar and suet. Spread mixture over the meat. Bake for at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes, or until the cheese on top is light and golden. Serve with a gravy.

title: Chayote With Chocolate Spread
ingredients: 250 g chayote, cut into wedges | 125 g cranberry beans, split in half | 3 ounces unsweetened chocolate chips | 100 g cream cheese | 60 g sour cream ( or yoghurt ) | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 3/4 teaspoon molasses | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1/2 cup chopped ganache ( or mint )
instructions: Place chayote and chayote in a medium saucepan over medium high heat, cover and cook until both are tender, around 5 - 6 minutes. Add kidney beans and simmer for 5 minutes, until heated through. In a small bowl, cream the chocolate, cream cheese, sour cream and minced garlic until well blended. Stir in the dried spices and add to chayote mixture. Allow to cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: raisin,ro tel tomato,italian parsley,white vinegar,purpose flour,red chili pepper
title: Rustic Mexican Tomato Salad
ingredients: 3 large ripe ro-tel tomatoes, thinly sliced ( about 1 lb. ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 red chili pepper, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons shredded fresh italian parsley | 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar or 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice
instructions: Place tomatoes, raisins, pepper and chile in mixing bowl. Sprinkle with flour and toss to coat. Toss the salad again with the vinegar/lemon juice and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,confectioner sugar,thai fish sauce,cocoa powder,veal,mustard powder
title: Dried Beef or Veal Fritters
ingredients: 1 pound dry cured veal, cut into small pieces | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons dutch-processed cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce ( such as three crabs ) | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the meat into a dutch oven, and add the cream of chicken soup, cocoa powder, mustard powder, fish sauce, and confectioners' sugar. Bring to a simmer. Place the pan over medium high heat, and boil for 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender. Serve immediately, or refrigerate overnight for flavors to blend.

title: Stilton Chicken Appetizers
ingredients: 1 cup dried stilton cheese | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 12 pieces eggplants ( about 1 inch length ) | 1/2 cup mashed potatoes or 1/2 cup mashed eggplant | 1/4 cup apple juice or 1/4 cup apple cider ( i sometimes use pineapple juice ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning, blend | 1 lb ground chicken, 93 % fat free, cooked and drained | 3 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: For the topping, combine cheese and baking soda and set aside. Lightly sprinkle both sides of each slice of the eggplant with the flour, then dip in the egg mixture and then press into the cheese bread. Place slices in a 9x13 in pan coated with nonstick cooking spray. For the topping, combine mashed potatoes, apple or cider, italian seasoning and chicken. Blend. Sprinkle over the slices of bread. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes until crisp golden brown.

title: Sweet and Sour Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages dried rice noodles | 1 3/4 cups golden raisins ( about a cup ) | 1/2 cup arrowroot ( if available, i would recommend it ) | 2 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add rice noodles and cook until tender but firm but tender. Drain and rinse under cold water. In a bowl, stir together golden raisins and arrowroot. Drain noodles and add to the raisins and arrowroot mixture. Dry noodles and sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,hard egg,plum tomato,cake flour,rice wine,chunky salsa
title: Soft-Shell Stuffed Eggs
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs | 14 ounces plum tomatoes, in skin, cut in half | 7 ounces loose chunky salsa | 4 tablespoons cake flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom pods, bruised ( can add a pinch if desired ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine ( or dry sherry )
instructions: Shell eggs carefully and put into pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with water and boil slowly until almost done, ca. 30 min... Drain well. Slice off the hard boiled egg's yolks and place into large bowl. Remove the hard boiled egg yolks from water and place in a bowl. With a spoon, scoop out the pulp of the shells from the egg yolks and discard. Fill the bowl with the yolks and place back on heat for 1 min. Stir. Add salsa and mix well. Let cool for 15 min. Add the sugar or cardamon to the egg mixture and mix. Fill the egg white shells with the mixture and place on baking sheet. Sprinkle tops of eel with sherry or brown sugar if using. Bake in 350f degrees oven at about 20 minutes. Remove eels from baking sheets and cool completely. These are best eaten one way or the other.

title: Scottish Scones
ingredients: 6 cups all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon ground mace
instructions: Stir together the flour and mace. Cut in half again, and make a well in the center. Stir in a little at a time. Turn over onto a lightly floured surface, and knead until soft and elastic. Place pieces onto a well oiled cookie sheet or board, and knead or pat out some of the scraps. Cover and chill for an hour, or overnight. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Shape the dough into a circle to fit into a well oiled cookie sheet or baking sheet that has been lightly sprinkled with a little flour. Score into 8 wedges from the center of the circle. Bake on the center oven shelf for 10 minutes, or until pale golden brown.

title: Swedish Rye Bread Machine
ingredients: 8 slices rye flour | 1 tablespoon ground mustard powder | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 3/4 cup mascarpone cheese, softened
instructions: Place flour and mustard powder in a large ziplock bag. Add the cheese, vinegar and yeast mixture.

title: Chili and Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 package fresh or frozen rice noodles | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot chinese chili sauce | 1 tablespoon minced fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the rice noodles and stir to separate. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until al dente. Drain, and set aside. In a large bowl, mix the hot chili sauce, rosemary, and noodles. Sprinkle with the chili sauce mixture, and toss well to mix.

title: Italian Hot Water and Sage-Curry Rub (Use for Rubing Chicken, Fish, or Pork)
ingredients: 6 12 oz pieces poultry or 6 ounces game ( meat, poultry or fish ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried sage leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Note, this recipe is for 1 whole chicken, 1 whole fish, or 1 whole shrimp. Do not use any flavoring of the meat or the dried spices. Rinse the meat and dry well. Rub the seasoning mix into the meat. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Place in the dry rubbed chicken skin side up and sear until well browned, approximately 5 minutes per side. Remove from skillet, remove the skin and set aside. Add in 2 teaspoons tabasco and 1 tablespoon ground sage and stir. Using a slotted spoon, remove the sage leaves from the skillet and place in a bowl. Place the remaining teaspoon of sage in the same skillet. Continue to cook the sausage over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Yogurt Cheeseburgers
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons drained capers | 1 tablespoon minced beef
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup yogurt with capers and minced beef. Form into 6 patties. Let sit at room temperature 15 minutes before using. Grilling, heat a grill pan or pan over medium high heat to medium heat. Cook patties, turning once, until no longer pink in the center, 3 to 5 minutes total for rare.

title: Greek Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/3 cup tomato jam | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted | 1/8 yellow pepper, diced
instructions: In a small bowl combine first 11 ingredients.

title: Frugal Gourmet
ingredients: 10 ounces chicken wings, pieces | 6 ounces tomato juice | 4 ounces sliced almonds | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 ounce powdered dried king's self-soaked dried tomatoes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Heat a large non stick frypan over medium high heat. When hot, add the chicken pieces and fry until golden brown on all sides, remove and place on a baking tray which has been sprayed with pam. Bake in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes, turning over halfway through. Remove from oven and scatter almonds over top. Set aside. Add 1/2 teaspoon sea salt to the tomato juice and set aside. Add 1/2 to 1 cup of water and stir, making sure that the sauce doesn't turn brown. Add the dried king's self-soaked dried tomatoes if using. Stir fry for a few minutes to combine all the flavours. Pour over chicken and serve.

title: Nori Onigiri (Sushi): Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 6 strips fresh nori, seaweed | 3 ounces shiitake mushrooms, sliced thin | 1 star anise pod, chopped, or to taste | 1/2 can enchilada sauce, optional ( optional )
instructions: Place nori on a seaweed sheet. Sprinkle shiitake mushrooms over nori, and sprinkle anise pods and star anise pod over top. Drizzle enchilada sauce over filling. Top with remaining nori, pressing lightly into the sauce. Allow to stand for a few minutes to allow flavors to blend.

title: Soupa Al Pimento
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tomato, diced ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 1/4 cup sauerkraut, drained, rinsed | 2 tablespoons finely diced pepperoni | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Combine cheese, tomato, saurkraut and pepperoni. Mix well. Arrange on a small serving platter and spoon sauce around it.

title: Italian Marinated Antipasto
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups olive oil flavored cooking spray ( i use pam ) | 3 -4 teaspoons whole cloves
instructions: Place oil in a glass jar. Add cloves. Cover with lid. Let sit at room temperate for about 3 - 4 days without breaking up the cloves. The oil will get better with age. The oil will get stronger in time. At the end of the 4 days it should be thick and glossy.

title: Pistachio and Romano Chicken Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs roasting chickens | 1 head iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1 -2 cup grated fresh romano cheese | 1 cup chopped pistachios | 6 teaspoons good quality vinegar
instructions: In a large pan, roast the chicken and cut off any excess fat. It is okay if it leaks over the bone. Shred the chicken with forks, but it is not necessary to shred completely. Place chicken in a large bowl or in a large roaster. Pour the vinegar over the chicken. Shred the romano cheese over the chicken, and sprinkle it on top of the cheese. Top with the chopped pistachios and allow it to marinate in the refrigerator for about 1 hour or till all the cheese has gone. Taste it and adjust the seasoning of what you want with the vinegar. Serve with bread or noodles. Enjoy.

title: Beef Brisket With Apples
ingredients: 3/4 lb lean meat ( cut into 1/2-inch chunks ) | 1 packet active dry yeast | 1/4 cup warm water | 1 beef brisket, preferably flat cut | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 cups apples, peeled, cored, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, toasted and mixed with | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Wash brisket well and pat dry. Place meat on rack in roasting pan. Mix yeast with warm water in small bowl, cover, and let stand 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Heat butter in 5 quart dutch oven over medium high heat. Brown brisket on all sides. Transfer brisket to roasting pan, fat side down.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,whiskey,purpose flour,chuck roast,white bean,poblano chile,flat leaf italian parsley,cream cheese
title: Smoky White Bean and Beef Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck roast, trimmed of all visible fat | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 -2 poblano chile, roasted, seeded, and sliced thin | 1/2 cup fat free greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons natural unsweetened whiskey | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, for garnish
instructions: Place chuck roast and flour in a large plastic bag. Close the bag. Shake to coat.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,beef gravy,red wine,meat,nutmeg,cannellini bean
title: Italian Stew
ingredients: 1 package frozen foodized cooked meat | 0.5 can beef gravy | 3/4 cup red wine | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1 dash nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients, place in crockpot and cook on low for 5 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,chili powder,tomato green chilies
title: Mexican Spinach
ingredients: 1 package sliced fresh spinach leaves | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 3/4 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Mix spinach, tomatoes with green chilies, and chili powder together in a large serving bowl. Cover, and refrigerate at least one hour to blend flavors.

title: Yellow Pepper-currant Relish
ingredients: 1 yellow pepper, cut in 1/4-inch strips | 1 tablespoon dried currants | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon fine salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well. Transfer mixture to a small jar. Seal and store in refrigerator.

title: Aceegyptian Rasam
ingredients: 1 cup red chilies, paste | 4 -5 garlic | 1 cup currants, soaked for 10 minutes and soaked in the water | basil leaves, -to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Chop chili garlic and place with currants inside rice cooker. Add the rest of the ingredients along with the chilli paste onto the cooker. Close the lid and allow to run on the slow medium heat. When cooker is almost done, put the lid back and allow the rice to keep on steam. Once cooked, turn off and remove all excess water inside rice cooker/ cooker. Leave the cooker alone until all the water is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: topping,pineapple juice,fennel seed,olive oil,red lentil,lemon zest,phyllo pastry
title: Spiced Lentil & Pineapple Samosas
ingredients: 1/4 cup red lentils or 1/4 cup green lentil | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 small pineapple with juice, sliced | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil | 8 -10 sheets phyllo pastry | fresh fruit whipped topping, of your choice
instructions: Drain the lentils and wash well. Rinse the lentils under running water. Drain well. Place the lentils in a large bowl and mash them lightly with a fork. Stir in the fennel seeds, chopped pineapple with the juice and zest. Stir in 1 tbsp of olive oil. Preheat the oven to 425 °f. In a saute pan heat 1 tbsp of olive oil. When hot, saute each sheet of phyllo pastry for 1 minute each side until brown and crisp. Drain on kitchen paper. Arrange 5 - 6 pieces of filo on top of each other overlapping slightly. Spoon 1 tablespoon of fruit topping on top. Spoon 1 tablespoon of lentils over lentils. Cover the lentils with the remainder of the pastry. Poke 6 holes in the pastry with a fork and brush the top with melted butter. Place on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 20 - 23 minutes or until golden brown on top. Serve warm with cream.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,maraschino cherry,raisin,orange peel,vanilla pod,caper
title: Maraschino Cherries
ingredients: 6 -8 large maraschino cherries | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup capers, drained | 1 1/4 cups white wine vinegar | 2 oranges, peel of | 1 -2 vanilla pod
instructions: Place cherries and raisins in a saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for about 4 minutes stirring occassionally. Drain cherries. Add remaining ingredients and toss well. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,lamb shoulder,corn tortilla chip,anchovy,za'atar spice mix
title: Lamb With a Za'atar, Anchovies and Crab Chips
ingredients: 1/2 lb lamb shoulder, cut 1-inch thick | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | corn tortilla chips
instructions: Cut off any excess fat from the lamb shoulder and cut into 1-inch dice. In a small bowl, stir together oyster sauce and za'atar. Place lamb pieces in shallow bowl or platter with a lid to keep them refrigerated while you prepare the other ingredients. Cook lamb until browned and crusty, 12 - 15 minutes, turning once. Spoon off excess fat and sprinkle with some za'atar. Garnish with crisp tortillas and serve.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,pork sausage,tomato juice,sun tomato oil,stewing beef,kaiser,sunflower oil,cocoa
title: Chocolate Pizzas
ingredients: 1 lb fresh ground pork sausage ( lean if possible ) | 1 lb stewing beef ( any cut of beef will do, any cut of beef will do ) | 1 lb fresh tomato juice, you can always buy canned | 1 package of good quality cocoa ( or you can buy cocoa powder and mix your own ) | 2 ounces sunflower oil | 1/2 lb sun-dried tomato packed in oil, you can use pakoma | 8 -10 kaiser rolls ( i usually use my own ) | sunflower oil, for frying ( for frying ) | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder ( optional )
instructions: Combine the sausage, beef and beef in a large bowl. Mix the juice with the cocoa powder. Dip the kaiser rolls in oil and fry in a pan with a little sunflower oil if you wish. Spread meat mixture on each slice of meat. Top with tomato sauce. You can also spread the cheese on the pizza. You can either add more toppings or just enjoy.

title: Codfish Balls
ingredients: 1 lb cooked cod, flaked | 4 shallots, minced | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast
instructions: Drain cooked cod, reserving liquid. In a large bowl, toss the cod with minced shallot, turmeric powder, and bread crumbs. Make an indentation on the center of the cod mixture with your finger, and fill with reserved liquid. Dissolve the yeast in the liquid, and add to the dry ingredients, mixing well. Add enough reserved liquid so that the moist crumbs can form in manageable ball sized balls.. Put on an oiled and floured baking sheet, and shape into ball sized balls. Bake in preheated 400°f oven for 35 - 40 minutes, until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,cayenne pepper,cabbage,wonton wrapper,wheat bread,lime juice,serrano pepper
title: South American Pot Sticker Pies
ingredients: 1 cup cooked cabbage | 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup diced cabbage | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 8 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix cabbage, lime juice, serrano pepper, 1/4 tsp white pepper, and 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper. Place a heaping spoonful of filling into each wonton.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,orzo pasta,pesto sauce,peanut oil,yellow mustard,allspice berry,urad dal,soymilk
title: Soggy Vegan Noodle Salad
ingredients: 300 g dried udon dal | 300 g yellow mustard, dry | 300 g ketchup | 500 g soymilk ( lactose-free if wished ) | 300 g peanut oil | 1 teaspoon ground allspice berry | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon mustard powder mixed with 1 tbsp hot german curry paste, for garnish ( indian spicy spice blend is essential in the dish )
instructions: Wash gyoza and dry.

title: Homemade Strawberry-Stuffed Chops
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen strawberries | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard | 1/2 teaspoon fennel | 1/2 teaspoon ground star anise | 1 roma tomato, sliced
instructions: Place frozen strawberries in a large stainless steel bowl. With an electric mixer, combine soup, chickpeas, mustard, fennel, and anise.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,french bread,peanut oil vegetable,pepperoni,nutmeg,sherry wine
title: Soy Baked French Fries
ingredients: 1 kg stew meat | 1 loaf french bread | 1/4 cup peanut oil or 1/4 cup other vegetable oil | 50 -75 g crushed pepperoni | 12 slices grated nutmeg or 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c, 190 degrees, gas mark make sure the meat is thoroughly rinsed of juices and dry with a paper towel. Cut slices or large cubes of bread and place in a single layer, one inch apart, with one inch of water in between, so that they soak up most of the water as the meat cooks. Place a large tray of clingfilm on a baking sheet with the long side out. Place the meat on the tray and brush with half the oil. Sprinkle with pepperoni, nutmeg, sherry, and a little seasoning. Cover and place in the oven for 1 hour. The meat should be cooked when a skewer comes out clean from the middle. It should be soft and moist. Remove the meat and slices to a serving dish, cover with a lid or foil. The steam for the bread will soak into the meat, melt the bread and re warm the meat. Serve this hot and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bodied red wine,bread flour,ketchup,shallot,sake,italian herb seasoning,okra,pimiento
title: Easy Okra French Bread from Food4
ingredients: 1 pound fresh okra, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 3 shallots, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped pimiento, drained | 1/2 cup chopped italian herb seasoning | 1/2 cup whole-grain red wine | 1 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup dry saki-style ketchup | 3 tablespoons sake ( japanese soy sauce ), or more to taste | 7 cups bread flour
instructions: Place okra in a large pot with water to cover by at least 1 inch. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until tender, about 30 minutes. Drain okra, reserving liquid. Allow to cool, remove stems and cut into 1 inch pieces. Place the reserved okra water in a bowl, and mash with a fork until they are a coarse, chunky paste. In a large, heavy skillet, stir the shallots, pimiento, italian seasoning, red wine, ketchup, saki style ketchup, sake, and hot pepper sauce. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until sauce has thickened slightly, 7 to 9 minutes. Grease an 8x8 inch baking dish, spoon half the sauce in the pan, and spread generously. Spoon half the okra mixture over the sauce, spread evenly, and sprinkle with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with remaining okra. Make the remaining french bread in the same way. Arrange french bread on top of the sliced bread, covering the dish with plastic wrap. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake the french bread in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Sushi
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 6 tablespoons rice | 4 tablespoons mixed spice | 3 tomatoes | 3 avocados
instructions: Prepare sushi in refrigerator, place rice and mixed spice into a deep baking pan, heat in a medium oven till it starts to steam. Cut avocados in slices, peel and slice them and mix with tomatoes and avocados, remove the sushi from the oven and place the rice and mixed spice on top, place lettuce and mix together and cut avocado in thin slices. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,vanilla,pearl barley,sharp cheddar cheese,cantaloupe,baby red potato
title: Mexican Stuffed Vegetables
ingredients: 16 baby red potatoes | 4 ounces frozen pearl barley | 2 -3 tablespoons chicken stock, for boiling the potatoes | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 4 ounces cantaloupe, cut in chunks
instructions: Boil the potato's in plenty of water for 15 mins or until they are cooked but quite firm. Drain and cool, then transfer to a mixing bowl and mash with a fork. Add the other ingredients and mix well. Divide the potato mixture into 8 to 10 portions and pat well together with a palm to make an even, flat oval shape. Poke a sharp knife in the top and leave them to cool a little. This helps them keep their shape. Place the potato rounds on a tray, sprinkle generously with salt, cover with clingfilm and place in the fridge and chill for at least 2 hours. Preheat the grill or bbq to medium, with a little oil cooking spray ready. Grilling, start your grill/bboure and when really hot, place your fillings on a wooden or metal skewers. Brush the cut side of the veg with oil and place them on the grill/boure, then cook for 3 or 4 mins each side until they are browned to your liking and the outside has turned dark and crispy.

Random Ingredients: herb,dijon mustard,olive oil,parmesan cheese,green olive,baby spinach
title: Greek Green Olive Salad With Dijon Mustard
ingredients: 150 g baby spinach | 60 g parmesan cheese, fresh grated | 1 tablespoon mixed mushrooms, mixed herbs | 1 tablespoon chopped mixed greens ( such as chard, sorrel, beet, chard or balsamic vinegar ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in serving bowl except olive oil. Add olive oil and mustard and combine. Toss the salad just before serving.

title: Peanut-Apricot-Apricot Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sliced apricot halves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped toasted peanuts | 1 napa cabbage, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange apricots, parsley, and peanuts on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. Remove and cool to room temperature. Layer napa cabbage on the peanuts, and serve.

title: A Perfectly Simple and Delicious Sage Butter
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh sage | caster sugar
instructions: Separate the leaves and stalks from the stalks on either side of the stalks. If all four the leaves are removed, trim the stem leaves and stalks again and cut away the hard stalks, or cut off any damaged leaves. Roughly chop them. Use this mix together with 1/4 of a cup of caster sugar or 1/4 of a regular cup of caster sugar depending on the sugar's sweetness. You can also have to add a small amount of butter at this stage, or if you plan on using some unsweetened bread. Use a wooden spoon to stir the sugar and sage together until it is dissolved and it changes colour to a pale golden colour, but not quite burnt – or stir in some chopped dried savoury leaves such as a sage leaf or sage thyme, if using. Add more sugar if you wish. Use an electric hand held mixer with a whisk to beat the mixture until it is nice and firm, then spoon the mixture into a well buttered or oiled bowl and spread out a tablespoonful of the lovely butter gently on top, then scatter with chopped savoury leaves, sage thyme or rosemary. Use immediately as a spread on meats, cheeses or savoury biscuits, vegetables, soups and pies.

Random Ingredients: ham,chili bean,asafoetida powder,tomato paste,grain white rice,dark soy sauce,vanilla bean
title: Lomo Saltado (Mexican Red Rice)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups short-grain white rice | 2 teaspoons chili bean paste or 1 teaspoon ancho chile paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon scraped vanilla bean | 1/3 cup tomato paste | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in a medium sized pot over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,matzo cake meal,cream,chunky salsa,walnut,cumin seed,cucumber,drambuie
title: Mashed Walnuts
ingredients: 3 matzo cakes meal | 1 can fat-free light cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons chunky salsa ( i like chi chi's ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill | 1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded, chopped ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts ( i like to toast them in a dry skillet over medium low heat until crunchy )
instructions: Place matzo cakes in bowl of food processor. Add cream of mushroom soup. Whirl until smooth. Add salsa, cumin, pepper, dill and cucumbers. Process until mixture forms medium fine crumbs. Turn into greased 1/2 1 cup baking dish. Sprinkle with walnuts. Refrigerate 3 - 4 hours or until cold, turning once. If necessary, stir before using.

title: Broccoli
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel
instructions: Separate stems from broccoli stems. Briefly steam florets until bright green. Stir fry broccoli with orange peel in boiling water for 1 minute or until crisp tender.

title: Cabbage and Ginger Pie
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1 inch fresh gingerroot, peeled and sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons cabbage, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade/400°f cut small slits in the pastry dough with a sharp knife, taking care not to cut into the roll, as this will allow steam to escape. Spoon thinly sliced ginger slices into each pastry slit, top with cabbage and press lightly. Place on a lightly greased oven tray and cook in the preheated oven for 20 - 25 minutes, until cooked through. Serve warm with ketchup if liked.

title: Mirchi Fried Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 teaspoon ginger paste
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat, then add the ginger paste. Allow the ginger to sizzle for a few seconds then toss it in the pan with the burrito sized flour tortillas. Spread the mixture evenly into a flat tortilla cone shape, then continue on. You can fry these in a cast iron skillet for a few minutes over low heat, to get a nice golden color. Remove the burritos from the pan, keeping them warm while you fry the remaining ones. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,apple,english muffin,self raising flour,molasses,farfalle pasta
title: Apple Fritters With Calzone
ingredients: 1 lb apple, shredded ( approx. 2, mcintosh are best ) | 12 ounces self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 8 ounces cooked farfalle pasta ( i think this would work with other pasta but it's up to you ) | 1 english muffin, halved and toasted, if serving with | 2 tablespoons molasses, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f, 400f, gas mark 6, 220c, gas mark 10, 220c you need 2 cookie trays to fit, use a large cupcake tin with a capacity of approx. 1½ inches in diameter. Place the shredded apple in a bowl and stir in the flour, molasses and vinegars. Mix well until well blended, then add the pasta and stir to combine. Add more flour if necessary to produce a sticky dough, but don't overwork the pastry either. Put the mixture in the fridge for 15 minutes and up to 1 hour. Meanwhile, place your extra cookie trays on to baking racks, if yours are already on my shelves. Toast the muffins and set aside, if desired. Divide the pasta between the 3 oven trays, or pile up on your tray. Using a very, very thin skewer, flatten out the fritters a little, then divide equally between the 1 baking trays or muffin trays. To bake, using a very sharp knife, cut the fritters into rounds about ¼ï¿½ ¼ inches in diameter. Place one tip up under the pasta. Bake for approximately 7 - 10 minutes, or until the fritters are golden. Top with extra molasses, if desired.

title: Angel Hair Pasta and Cellophane Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair sweet noodles | 4 packets cellophane noodles | 1 cup lemon peel
instructions: Cook angel hair noodles at home. Drain noodles. Add lemon peels and cellophane noodles. Toss and heat, stirring constantly, until noodles are all coated. Serve.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,bell pepper,beet,rice powder,rice vinegar,raspberry
title: Beef and Raspberries Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck roast | 1 bell pepper, 1/2 inch chunks | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 3/4 cup rice powder | 1 cup raspberries or 1 cup pineapple chunk | hot steamed beet ( optional )
instructions: Brown beef in skillet and all remaining ingredients except steamed beets.

title: Batatas Bravasi (Spicy Potato Crisp)
ingredients: 4 flour tortillas | 4 tablespoons chocolate ( heaped ) | 1 1/2 1 1 1/2 tablespoons harissa or 1 1/2 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 green beans ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Spread the chopped chocolate on the base side of the tortilla with a rolling pin and cook in pan over medium heat, stirring, with a large metal spoon until chocolate is melted. Dip spoon into boiling water and quickly submerge the tortilla into the chocolate while slowly adding the water. Turn tortilla over and heat again for 15 seconds. Remove from pan and peel away the paper. Use a slotted spoon to remove the biscuit from the underside. Dip into the chocolate and repeat process to form four fingers. Place the biscuits on serving plates, pour over any leftover melted chocolate and sprinkle with any sweet chilli sauce or any other seasonings. Dollop with extra chocolate and garnish with the green beans.

title: Blue Cheese Fruit Kebabs
ingredients: 12 ounces blue cheese | 1/4 cup romano cheese | 1/4 cup light brown sugar | 1/4 cup unsalted kerry cherries
instructions: Mix blue cheese, romano cheese, light brown sugar and cherries together.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,vermicelli,basil,caster sugar,teriyaki sauce,bean sauce,coleslaw mix
title: Sauce Fried Vermicelli with Grilled Bean-Chipotle Relish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caster sugar, superfine ( can use brown sugar ) | 8 chipotle chiles in adobo, deseeded and finely chopped | 300 g packaged coleslaw mix ( about 250g ) | 100 g vermicelli, broken into 2cm pieces ( about 250g ) | 4 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 3 tablespoons bottled bean sauce | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh basil
instructions: Place sugar and chiles in a mortar and pound to a paste with pestle and pound well to combine. Set aside for 10 minutes. Drain chiles reserving the sauce. Place coleslaw mix in a bowl and add the chile mixture and vermicelli and toss to coat. Melt teriyaki sauce in a small saucepan over low heat and add bean sauce and basil.

title: Frozen Sesame Spinach (Mandarin)
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach leaves, thawed | 2 teaspoons toasted sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 pinch ground cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 3 tablespoons white tequila | 3 mandarin oranges, cut into thin wedges
instructions: Toss spinach with sesame oil, nutmeg, cardamom, mace and tequila in a medium bowl. Place spinach in the freezer for 8 to 10 minutes to thaw the spinach. Serve with mandarin orange wedges.

title: Creamy Cremini Mushrooms (Or Portobello Mushrooms)
ingredients: 4 large cremini mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed | 2 tablespoons chives, minced
instructions: Using a brush and a small spoon, thoroughly brush each cremini mushroom. Sprinkle with chives. Cover each with plastic wrap and allow to dry at room temperature for an hour or two at room temperature. Serve.

title: Easter Pastry Dough
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 4 egg yolks | 1 cup tomatoes, canned or fresh, chopped ( 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons chopped tomato juice ) | 1 celery rib, chopped finely | 1 vanilla pod
instructions: Combine the flour, yeast and yolks in a large bowl and beat to form a smooth, thick paste – about 5 minutes by hand or with an electric mixer, or beat for a minute or two at first – then mix in about 4 tablespoons of the canned tomato juice, stirring and scraping away any flour residue from the bottom. Mix in the remaining 1 cup of tomato juice, plus ½ cup of a cup more, and mix well. Cover and set aside at room temperature about 20 minutes or so. Place the chopped tomato and celery in a food processor and pulse until evenly chopped, about 10 to 15 pulses. Add the remaining cup of chopped tomato and juice and process briefly, until just mixed but fairly smooth. Put the mixed mixture on a floured board and knead, dusting with a little more flour, until smooth and supple, about 10 minutes, adding more flour if it is dry. Turn out onto an oiled surface and knead for 5 minutes more or so until smooth and supple, elastic, about 5 minutes, adding more flour if it is dry. Place in a well buttered bowl, cover and set aside in a warm place until double in bulk and doubled in bulk. Punch down the dough. Divide into 12 pieces and roll them out on lightly floured surface into circles and cut as desired – i use a large cookie cutter for these – so they will fit as pan as little as possible. Place a heaping tablespoon of the tomato mixture onto half of a circle, cover the rest with a second circle, and cut a small slit in the middle, stopping about 3 inches from the edge. Repeat with the remaining pastry dough and filling until you have four circles. Spoon off as much of the mixture as possible from the center out of each circle, place a spoonful of tomato mixture onto the center and fold it over the filling and seal in the edges – you want to gently push the filling out of each circle. Repeat with the second half of the filling and the tomato mixture – you should have three pies. Cover and leave a little extra filling to sprinkle on top, such as cottage cheese, cream, butter or jelly or jam. Preheat the oven to 325°f. Place a roasting pan on the counter and line with parchment and grease or spray with cooking spray. Place half the pastries onto the pan, overlapping them slightly as you go. Pour boiling water into the roasting pan into a depth of 1½ to 2 inches and heat to just below rolling boil. Reduce heat to 350°f and bake the pastries until nicely browned on top and puffed from the steam, about 50 minutes, checking after 20 minutes. Turn out on a wire rack. Allow to cool completely before removing from pan. Store the pastries in an airtight container. They can be frozen for up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,ham,beef tenderloin,grain white rice,tamari,pepper
title: Pan Seared Beef Tenderloin (Sbd P1) #2
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs whole tenderloin | 4 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons tamari, divided ( or more to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 3 cups cooked short-grain white rice
instructions: Set oven to 400°. Place beef in medium saucepan. Add all remaining ingredients and bring to boil. Cover and transfer to oven to bake for 20 minutes. Add rice and bake until meat thermometer registers 135° on thermometer, 15 to 18 minutes more.

title: Baby Carrots in Coconut
ingredients: 2 teaspoons grated, cooked kara's fresh coconut | 1 can baby corn | 2 tablespoons plain low-fat yogurt ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the coconut, baby corn, and yoghurt. Gently toss to coat evenly and serve.

title: Marmalade Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup lemon marmalade | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Mix marmalade and flour until well blended. Roll into small balls, or roll into small balls with your hands. Store in airtight container.

title: Peas With Apple
ingredients: 1/4 lb fresh peas | 1/4 lb fresh apple | 2 tablespoons margarine | 16 ounces bamboo shoots, cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices or 1 1/4 cups frozen peas, cut crosswise into 1 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut each pepper into about 12 pieces. Place peas in a large shallow baking dish or roasting pan with the apple slice inside. Insert a slice or two of apple onto the peas at an angle. In a small mixing bowl, lightly beat the margarine and enough water to produce buttery liquid that will stick to veggies and apples, but not coat them. Pour liquid over pea mixture. Sprinkle vegetables with salt and pepper. Add enough water to cover. Bake 45 minutes or util vegetables are slightly crisp and browned. Serve hot.

title: Chess Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs prepared bread cubes or 1 1/4 lbs bread sticks | 3 1/2 lbs aged cheese ( such as muir glen type ) | 1 1/8 cups short grain mustard ( see note ) | 1 1/8 cups pickled peel, cut julienne ( see note ) | 12 -12 pitted kalamata olives, preferably with pits, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a small pan, toast the bread chunks over moderate heat, shaking the pan occasionally to toast evenly. The kabobs should be firm but not browned, but not crisp. Cool completely. Cut in half horizontally, and then slice into 1/8 dice or 1/8 strips and set aside. In a 4 - 5 quart slow cooker place the cheese, mustard and pickled peel and add the bread mix. Add a 1/2 cup water and stir to combine. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 3 to 4 hours or on high heat setting for about 2 hours. Serve hot or at room temperature. Note, for a thicker mustard, stir into a 1/2 cup water one tablespoon at a time. Note, if your cheese is too dry when you lift the lid, add 1 1/2 tablespoons warm water, stirring until the cheese is melted.

title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 425 g condensed french onion soup | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Place soup mix, bay leaves and 2 tablespoons of water into a pan or microwave proof jug. Bring to the boil for 20 mins, stir occasionally. Serve hot.

title: Veal With Fontina Cheese (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 8 -9 slices veal | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns, cracked | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( dried sweetened currant fruit ) | 4 ounces fontina cheese, julienned for garnish | cilantro, for garnish
instructions: In a saucepan, marinate the veal in the ketchup, rice wine, peppercorns, and sultanas. Place on medium heat, cover, and cook for 10 minutes. Preheat the grill to high heat. Grill the veal for about 5 minutes on each side, or until a meat thermometer reads 125 degrees f. Top the veal with fontina cheese. Garnish with cilantro.

title: Sailor's Creamy Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened chinese cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons coconut oil, or to taste | 1 1/2 cups broth, divided | 1 chipotle chile, minced | 2 tablespoons irish cream ( optional ) | crackers, for topping
instructions: Steam the cabbage until tender, about 3 to 5 minutes. Set aside. Heat the coconut oil in a pan.

title: Saffron Rice Vinegar
ingredients: 1 tablespoon saffron | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 5 tablespoons single cream, about | 1/2 - 3/4 cup romano cheese
instructions: Wrap saffron in a paper coffee filter. Add 1 tsp water. Heat up saffron and the rice vinegar over medium heat or set aside to let steam subside. Stir with spoon, stir occasionally until absorbed. Add cream a little at a time. Stir with spoon until absorbed. Add romano, stir. Pour into a glass jar, cover, label and refrigerate at least four hours. Stir when ready to serve.

title: Pork Cutlets (Beijing-Style)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, 1 inch slices | 1 egg
instructions: Beat egg and let it stand. Mix pork with egg, add salt if necessary. Dip pork into egg, then coat with egg again. Place on medium hot non fat frying pan or heavy skillet. Brown quickly so that blood lines and pieces are floating. Remove from pan and serve.

Random Ingredients: rice,spring onion,sage leaf,onion powder,white rum,nutmeg,chickpea,salt pepper
title: Hg's Caribbean Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped onions ( may use other onions ) | 1 can chickpeas or ( 16 ounce ) can garbanzo beans ( i like the chickpeas in a bag ) | 1 dash onion powder ( i use onion seasoning mix onion seasoning ( or herb seasoning ) ) | 1 dash nutmeg | salt and pepper, to taste | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon white rum ( optional ) | 3 -4 cups of hot cooked rice ( i use uncle ben's converted rice )
instructions: Defrost the chickpeas and drain them. Place chickpeas in a mixing bowl and add a little bit of sugar, salt, pepper and nutmeg. Mix until combined. If you want a sweeter rice add more sugar, nutmeg, etc. Set aside. Place the rice in another bowl. Add a small bit more sugar, salt, pepper, or nutmeg. Mix until combined. Heat a large frying pan and add a little olive oil. Fry the onion until soft. Add to your rice. Mix and add the chickpeas to frying pan. Mix and add to your rice. Mix and add salt. Mix and add more sugar. Mix and add more water. When rice is cooked, take a tablespoon of rice mixture and place on a plate, sprinkle with a few chopped basil leaves, then add a spoonful of rice mixture. Goes well with salad.

Random Ingredients: lemonade concentrate,chipotle chile,onion,graham cracker crumb,apricot jam,rump roast,cumin powder,liquid smoke
title: Rump Roast With Chipotle Jelly
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs rump roast | 1 jar apricot jam | 2 packages hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing and seasoning mix | 3/4 cup frozen liquid smoke | 3 tablespoons lemonade concentrate | 3 tablespoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon powdered cumin powder | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Spread jam evenly on the roast and allow to marinate for 15 - 20 minutes. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the ranch dressing mix, liquid smoke, lemonade concentrate and chili powder. Place the roast and marinade in a large roasting pan that has been prepared with a lid and add the bag of onion ranch dressing. Shake the bag to coat roast thoroughly, remove from the pan and place it in the oven, uncovered at 300 degree for 2 hours. Do not refrigerate. Once the oven is heated to 300 degrees, remove the roast from the oven and let it rest with the juices that run out the bag. Pour the strained juices into a saucepan and heat through for 1 minute, stir in the cumin powder and cracker crumbs. Slice the roast and serve with the jelly.

title: Easy Saffron Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon saffron | 2 teaspoons orange zest, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 can pinto beans or ( 16 ounce ) can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup liquid honey
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a nonreactive saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are very tender, about 1 hour. Turn off heat. Let stand, covered, 10 minutes. Transfer baked beans to a serving bowl and sprinkle with honey.

title: Cabbage and Lime Marinade
ingredients: 1/2 cup lime juice | 1/4 cup minced garlic | 1 medium head cabbage, cored and shredded
instructions: In a small bowl, mix lime juice, garlic, and cabbage. Place cabbage and lime marinade in a large resealable plastic bag. Shake to coat, and place in refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours. Cook and serve with hot spanish rice.

title: Hot Chilli Seeds
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 1 teaspoon fennel | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon chili
instructions: Heat up dark sesame oil and fry the chillies for three minutes. Mix the seeds with seeds, pour the mixture over the chili, and let stand to dry. Leave to cool, then store in a airtight container.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,mayonnaise,white flour,cream cheese,cinnamon,yellow squash,marinara sauce
title: Yellow Squash With Cream Cheese, Raisins, and Cinnamon
ingredients: 1 small yellow squash, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 2/3 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 8 ounces cream cheese, softened, and room temperature | 6 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 cup marinara sauce, heated | 1/2 cup white flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Place the squash slices in a steaming basket and place over boiling water, just below the boiling point, and cook for 7 minutes. Remove the squash with a slotted spoon and drain. Preheat oven to 350°f. Coare a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place the ricotta and cream cheeses in an electric blender, and blend until smooth. Add the mayonnaise, 3 tablespoons of the heated marinara sauce, flour, and cinnamon and blend until thoroughly mixed. Spread the cheese mixture evenly into the prepared baking dish, and top with the remaining 1 tablespoon of warm marinara sauce. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes, until bubbling and brown on top.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,kosher salt,lettuce leaf,egg yolk,red onion,green chili pepper
title: Churrascai (Savory Egg-Roller)
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 teaspoon green chili pepper, minced | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 4 large lettuce leaves, preferably green leaf | 1/4 cup chopped red onion
instructions: Mix egg yolk, salt, chile, garlic paste. Wash lettuce leaves and separate leaves and spread out on a cutting board. Arrange leaf on the lettuce leaves, overlapping slightly. Sprinkle chopped red onion on top of lettuce. Roll up and tie with a toothpick. Place rolls in a resealable plastic bag. Refrigerate for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.. Remove toothpicks before serving.

Random Ingredients: tuna steak,chocolate,flour tortilla,five spice powder,currant,extra beef,veal
title: Mini Tuna Burritos
ingredients: 200 g reduced-fat pork sausages or 200 g extra lean ground beef | 1/4 - 1/2 cup mixed dried currants | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 100 g tuna steaks or 175 g tuna, drained | 1/4 cup bittersweet chocolate | 2 medium free range flour tortillas or 2 medium corn tortillas, cut into strips
instructions: Heat a medium, non stick frypan over high heat, add oil to coat. Add sausages and fry for 3 minutes or until browned and cooked through. Remove from pan and set aside. Reduce heat under pan to medium with one tablespoon of the oil spray and add the currants and five spice powder and cook for 1 minute stirring to combine. Return sausages to pan and add tuna. Cook for 3 minutes or until the tuna has heated through, stir in chocolate to melt. Serve hot in tortillas with salsa and fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: allspice,mint leaf,fryer chicken,heavy whipping cream,flour tortilla,cotija cheese
title: Grilled Mojito Enchiladas
ingredients: 3 lbs fryer chickens, cut up | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons dried mint leaves, crushed | 2 tablespoons allspice | 10 flour tortillas | 3/4 cup freshly grated cotija cheese
instructions: Coat grill racks with nonstick spray. Place chicken in a dutch oven. Cover and cook over low high heat until tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Roasted Yellow & Pecorino Beef Stovies
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup pepato-free parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped yellow or red peppers, if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Using a 2½ or 1 quart, shallow baking dish or roasting pan, spread the beef evenly on the bottom and up to its depth of 1 - ½ inches. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Sprinkle the cheese over the beef. Arrange the peppers around the meat and set aside. Drizzle the meat with the remaining oil. Place baking dish on middle rack of oven. Roast for 2 hours, basting the meat after 5 hours. The meat starts to caramelize at the edges. When the meat is very moist and crusty, remove from oven and allow to stand for 15 minutes before slicing. You may cut the meat as desired. Serve with roasted vegetables.

title: Quick and Easy Tomato Rice Wine
ingredients: 450 g tomato puree | 1/4 cup rice wine ( preferably shaoxing )
instructions: Put the tomato puree and rice wine in a pan and, when warm, bring to the boil. Stir every 10 seconds or so to prevent mixture from sticking, but keep a close eye on the rice. If the mixture boils over, remove from heat, stir through and return to the boil. Let the pan sit for about 20 minutes before you serve it.

title: Cheddar Baked Linguine
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1 1/4 cups fat-free yoghurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lime zest ( i prefer freshly grated lime ) | 3/4 cup dark rum ( not alcoholic! ) | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup lindott's lindott's lindott's lindudic dark rum
instructions: Cook linguine as per package instructions. Drain, then rinse with cold water to cool under running water. Place the yoghurt in a small mixing bowl. Add the lime zest and stir to combine. Add the rum to the yoghurt and stir to combine. Dot the bottom of an 8 x 8 pan with butter.

title: Pear and Pimento Scrolls Recipe
ingredients: 4 ounces self raising flour | 4 ounces chopped mixed pears | 3 ounces bacon, chopped | 5 ounces lambs lettuce, chopped | 2 ounces balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place the flour in a mixing bowl and stir in the pears, bacon, lettuce and a good splash of balsamic vinegar. Use your hands to mix together quickly, then shape into a rectangle. Slice into 1cm thick strips on either side. Spread the pork and lettuce onto 2 baking sheets, drizzle with oil and bake in a 350f oven for 25 minutes.

title: Lahmi's Easy & Simple Lemony (Lebanese) Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lamb ( cut up ) or 1 lb lamb rib ( cut up ) | 12 ladyfingers
instructions: Take lamb pieces cut off the bones, then remove the excess fat or use whatever meat you have around that you can chop it into bite size pieces. I use a very sharp knife, which is a bit tougher than a knife since it has a smoother texture on it. So you have 6 slices for each serving of meat. Spray your work surface generously with oil or margarine & line it with lady fingers, laying them about 1/3 down the length of the dish. Sprinkle 1/2 of the meat over the lady fingers. Take a slice of the remaining meat & roll it up in a nice thin slice or more, laying out as many as you can. Repeat these steps until you have used up all of your meat. Take a finger and rub a little bit of the excess oil/margarine into the meat until it shows signs of becoming crispy. Then using a pastry brush, coat the rest of your strips with a little bit of the butter. Now lay the lady fingers across the top of the meat. Sprinkle the exposed fingers with a little more of the butter & press down a little bit more to get an even covering, making it look like a large pancake. It is important to leave a small border area of the lady fingers when you are finished rolling them. They should be slightly flattened but not too flat so that they absorb flavor & have a nice sheen. Spread a thin layer of the last of butter over the entire dish using a pastry brush. Place a few lady fingers on top of the butter & spread a nice thin layer of the last layer using the remaining butter. Sprinkle a little more of the butter over the top & let it sit for a few minutes. With a sharp knife, cut several v shaped slits across the top, letting the excess butter drip off. Repeat these steps. Cover the dish tightly with tin foil & let it sit in the refrigerator for 2 - 3 hours. When you are ready to bake the dish or to eat the dish, it is important to fill the spaces between the slices/tables with filling.. Bake your meat slices or serve them directly from the container. If your preferred method of serving the dish, you can choose to bake the meat slices in a shallow baking pan. Or if your preferred method of serving the dish, cover the whole dish with aluminum foil or with a slightly damp napkin & bake in the oven or toaster oven, letting the excess juices run into the pan. If your preferred method, you can bake the meat or the slices on a lightly buttered cookie sheet under a hot grill to lightly brown, then place on a wire rack to finish baking in a preheated oven until crisp. Serve meat slices cut up or eaten as a side dish with a salad & fresh bread.

title: Poblano Flank Steak
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles or 6 any mexican chiles | 1/2 lb sirloin steak
instructions: Grill or roast the chiles cut side up. Grill or broil the chiles until the blisters disappear. Remove from heat. Cut steak into thin strips. Place on serving plate. Spoon sliced chiles on top and serve.

title: Raspberry-Mint Grilled Cheese Pitas
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh raspberries ( not thawed ) | 1 tablespoon low-fat colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon mint, coarsely chopped or 1 tablespoon chopped parsley | 4 pita bread ( about 5 inches diameter )
instructions: To make mint mint relish, bring a pan of water to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, rinse and drain raspberries, pressing them in a mini chopper with a large 1/4 teaspoon of mint. Spread pita bread on a large nonstick griddle. Place 1/4 cup raspberries in a medium bowl. Combine cheese mixture with remaining 2 tablespoons of mint. Spread mixture evenly over pita bread. Grill over high heat, turning once just until cheese is melted and center is hot, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,radish,rice paper,mascarpone,italian sausage,chickpea,chicken soup,red bell pepper
title: Chocolate Birthday Pizza With Sausages and Peppers
ingredients: 1 can condensed chicken soup, undiluted | 8 ounces sweet italian sausage, cut into 4 pieces | 20 rice paper sheets | 2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 red bell pepper, sliced | 4 radishes, thinly sliced | 4 ounces mascarpone | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 tablespoons dry crushed espresso beans
instructions: Combine soup with sausage, rice vermicelli, chickpeas, bell pepper, radishes, mascarpone and cocoa powder in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,salad shrimp,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,cream corn
title: Smoky Chipotle Pork Strip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chipotle-flavored adobo sauce | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 pound boneless pork loin | 2 tablespoons chopped chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, or to taste
instructions: Stir 1 tablespoon chipotle hot sauce and cream style corn together in a bowl until completely combined. Place pork loin in a resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,taco flour tortilla,yellow bell pepper,spaghetti,soymilk,beef roast
title: Mexican Beef Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef roast, very thinly sliced | 1 yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup soymilk | 4 tablespoons taco-flavored flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds, toasted | parsley, minced
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450°f. Mix together the soy milk, flour tortillas and poppy seeds evenly. Put the meat slices in a large nonstick skillet. Pour the soy milk mixture over the meat and vegetables in the skillet. Bake for 25 minutes, stirring once or twice. Braise for an additional 10 minutes on middle rack of oven, until meat is tender and falling apart.

title: Easy Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat beef gravy ( any flavor ) | 1/8 teaspoon browning sauce
instructions: Combine gravy and browning sauce in a small saucepan.

title: Gruyere Cheese Spread With Caramel-Peeled Pecorino
ingredients: 1/4 lb gruyere cheese, grated | 1/2 lb pecorino cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons ketchup ( no salt added )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric blender. Process until thoroughly mixed, stopping occasionally to scrape the sides with a rubber spatula.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,yellow pepper,soy sauce,italian sausage,wheat tortilla,quinoa,great northern bean,broth
title: Italian Sausage With Peppers
ingredients: 3 italian sausages | 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, undrained | 1 can fat-free reduced-sodium broth | 1/2 cup dry quinoa | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 16 whole wheat tortillas, cut in half | 2 medium yellow sweet peppers, cut into 1/2-inch strips
instructions: Place sausage in a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat, cook, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 7 minutes. Drain, crumble and set aside. While sausage browns, combine beans, tomatoes and broth. Bring to a boil, cook, stirring often, until thickened, about 5 minutes. Combine quinoa and soy sauce in a bowl. Remove sausage from skillet and crumble. Heat remaining soup mixture in skillet over medium high heat until heated through, 3 to 5 minutes. Working with one half at a time, place 1 tortilla in a tortilla, top with 1 tablespoons soup mixture, 1/4 cup cooked sausage and 1/4 cup cooked pepper. Roll tortilla up and place, seam side down, in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Repeat process with the rest of the tortillas, soup mixture and vegetables. Bake, uncovered, at 400 degrees f for 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,streaky bacon,garam masala,heavy cream,serrano pepper,fast rising yeast,salt
title: Mexican Style Bacon and Pepper Fondant - (Dry)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 250 g streaky bacon ( or lard ) | 12 serrano peppers, finely sliced | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 teaspoon salt | 220 g heavy cream | 2 packages fast rising yeast
instructions: Heat oven to 190°c degrees. Mix the oil, salt and pepper in a large bowl and add the bacon. Set aside. Put the serrano peppers and 2 teaspoons of garam masala and about two tablespoons of the bacon fat into a large oven proof saucepan then set over a low heat. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring until the fat has absorbed the fat. Add the cream and stir well. Dissolve the yeast in the warm milk then stir into the cream mixture. When the cream begins to bubble and the yeast dissolves, bring to the boil and allow to heat for 1 minute or until it has dissolved. Pour the hot mixture into the bowl containing all the ingredients. Beat well then place in a warm oven and allow to bake for 30 minutes or until the fondant is golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: green pea,head romaine lettuce,coleslaw mix,bean,baking powder,thyme leaf

instructions: Break lettuce into bite size pieces. Add the peas, coleslaw mix and baked beans to the lettuce and mix lightly. Dump in the baked beans and thyme and toss everything together. Add baking powder and toss to mix well, adding more baking powder if desired. Let it sit in the fridge for a few minutes before serving.

instructions: Combine everything in a bowl, but cook until tender. Toss with saran and enjoy.

instructions: Heat oil in a small pan over low heat.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix tuna, vermouth, and haparti applesauce together in a medium bowl. Stir ham hocks into mixture. Cut zucchini into 1/4 inch slices.

title: Collards and Bulgur Wheat

instructions: Cook bulgur with onion, za'atar for 15 minutes. Drain well. Add collards and bulgur wheat.

title: Tropical Heirloom Tomato Dipping Sauce

Cover pan, reduce heat to low, and cook 20 minutes. Stir in the herb blend. Heat the sauce 5 minutes longer. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Chestnut Rice

instructions: Combine rice, anchovy, garlic, chestnuts and marinade in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork and serve.

title: Sweet Onion Condiment

instructions: Finely chop onion and toss lightly with greens.

Random Ingredients: walnut,chicken breast half,dark brown sugar,gingerroot,oyster sauce,cream tartar
title: Steamed Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, peeled and minced | 1 lb skinless boneless chicken breast half | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped crystallized gingerroot
instructions: In a small saucepan whisk together 1 tbls. Olive oil, the cream of tartar, 1 tbls. Brown sugar and the minced gingerroot. Add the chicken and marinade 20 minutes. Stir fry chicken over medium heat with 1 tbls. Olive oil and the 1 tbls. Wine. Add 1/4 cup water and cook until no longer pink in the middle 15 - 20 minutes. Add crystallized ginger and cook 2 minutes longer. Transfer to a platter and garnish with the walnuts. Serve.

title: Pilsie's Grilled Gator Beer
ingredients: 1 lb yellow bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 2 carrots, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 bottle beer
instructions: In a large pot of water, combine all of the vegetables. Add the beer and caraway seeds and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring frequently, until heated through – about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,baking potato,anaheim chili,garam masala,sesame oil,pork rib rack,poppy seed,yellow onion
title: A-Chile Pot Roasted Pork Pasta
ingredients: 1 large red anaheim chili | 3 lbs bone-in country-style pork ribs ( about 3 racks ) | 6 -7 small baking potatoes ( about 1.5 pounds total, cut into 4 6 pieces each ) | 1/4 cup toasted sesame oil | 3 tablespoons finely ground salted poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 medium yellow onion, peeled, halved, cut into eighths | 2 packages bow tie pasta ( about 8 1/2-oz. )
instructions: Position rack in lower third of oven and preheat to 200c. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil.

title: Crunchy Cornbread With Sweet and Crunchy Dipping Sauce

instructions: Open the box of corn muffin mix and unroll the corn muffins. Press the muffins into a greased 9x13 pan or a 9x13 pan. Mix the fish sauce with 1/2 cup water. Add half of the fish sauce to the batter and whisk to mix. Pour into the cornbread batter and place the pan in a 9x13 pan. Place in the oven at 350°f. Cook for 45 - 50 minutes or until golden brown.

instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with a cooking spray. In a medium bowl, stir 1/4 cup turbinado sugar, plum tomatoes, turbinado sugar, yellow pea pods, and 1 pinch turbinado sugar until blended. Season with 1 pinch turbinado sugar.

title: Liang Shanghai-Style Green Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces dried thin-cut green beans | 8 ounces dried thin-cut spiral shaped pasta | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems | 2 chopped fresh garlic chilies | fresh mint ( optional )
instructions: Place beans in a large saucepan filled with cold water just to cover. Bring water to a boil.

title: Spicy Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow onion ( diced ) | 1/2 cup spanish onion ( diced ) | 2 packages yeast | 8 ounces feta ( crumbled or cut up ) | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons powdered egg beater ( to help remove lumps ) or 2 teaspoons yeast ( to help remove lumps ) | 6 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Place onions, cheese, and chocolate in the bowl of a stand mixer and set aside. Add the yeast to the water and allow to dissolve. Let sit until foam rises and frothy. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix at low speed until well blended and smooth. Place 3 phyllo sheets on a flat surface. Cover with foil and allow to rise until doubled in volume, about 30 minutes. Place another phyllo sheet on top of them so they make a flat top. This one works great. After rising, place the dough on a cutting board and place in a sprayed 9x13 baking dish. Cover with a damp cloth and allow to rise at the top of the pan. When dough is risen and the phyllo has reached the top of the pan, place another phyllo sheet on top and add it as before. Spread evenly. Cover with the damp cloth and let rise for 50min. Preheat oven to 375°f while the bread bakes, pre heat the oven to 200oc. Once the bread has risen, place it on top of a piece of foil sprayed with non stick spray and cook for 20 mins. Uncover for the last 15 mins. Serve warm. This is traditionally eaten as part of lunch, but is nice served with a variety of toppings as described above.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,taco sauce,garlic paste,cremini mushroom,portabella mushroom cap,cooking apple,marjoram
title: Lori's Mexican Mushrooms
ingredients: 10 whole cremini mushroom caps | 6 portabella mushroom caps | 4 cups cooked diced cooking apples | 2 tablespoons prepared taco sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon marjoram | 4 tablespoons malt vinegar
instructions: Cook the apples with marjoram and vinegar. In a 13x9 inch glass dish, layer sliced mushrooms, apples, onions and cremini mushrooms. Sprinkle taco sauce, garlic paste, and marjoram on top. In a small bowl, mix the malt vinegar. Sprinkle over mushrooms. Cover dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: plantain,parmesan cheese,celery leaf,maple syrup,butter bean,yellow squash,white sugar
title: Grpa's Sweet Plantain, Yellow Squash and Basil Soup
ingredients: 2 plantains, peeled and cubed | 2 cups diced yellow squash | 3/4 cup white sugar | 1 cup butter beans, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup chopped fresh celery leaves | 1/2 cup pared, thinly sliced fresh basil, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1/3 cup maple syrup
instructions: Place plantains in a pressure cooker, cover, and heat until potatoes are browned, about 20 minutes. While awaiting for pressure to build up, reduce pressure slightly, and simmer until plantains are very tender, approximately 30 minutes. Pour soup into a bowl and add a dash of maple syrup.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,lamb shank,saffron,beef oxtail,red bell pepper
title: Braised Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 2 cups beef oxtails | 4 lamb shanks | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 red bell peppers, seeded and cut into 1 to 2 inch pieces
instructions: Prepare an open flameproof casserole, place the oxtails and shanks in a large flameproof casserole. Sprinkle with saffron and light with a match or hot oil. Pour water around the shanks and cover tightly. Steam over a gentle heat for 1 1/2 hours, or until tender. Skim any fat off the surface and add the cream of tartar. Serve immediately with the red pepper pieces, if using.

title: Mussels & Chips With Onion Soup

instructions: Place tuna in a bowl. Wash mussels and place in ice water and leave to soften. Slice onion thinly. Place 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan and add the onion or golden onion to it. Add the chopped mussels and cook for a further minute. Add another 3/4 cup of olive oil and the pickled onion soup mix and cook for 2 minutes. Turn the heat up very low or to low medium as you can without burning the mussels.

instructions: Mix cabbage shreds, romaine lettuce, ground ancho chiles, wondra flour and fenugreek seeds in a large soup pot. Cook over medium high heat, stirring often, for 5 minutes. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 45 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Fennel and Macaroni English Muffins
ingredients: 200 ml elbow macaroni | 50 g caster sugar, granulated | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Cook macaroni in boiling water for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small pan with 2 tablespoons caster sugar and 1 teaspoon fennel seeds, cook gently for 5 minutes or until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat, drain. Drain macaroni and stir into sugar and spice mix, leaving half the pasta plain. Spoon mixture into muffin pans and sprinkle with remaining teaspoon of fennel seed. Bake for about 25 minutes until golden brown. Leave to stand for five minutes, then remove from pan.

title: Homemade Flour Rounds from Vegetarian Beets
ingredients: 8 ounces self-rising flour, or as needed | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast flakes ( optional )
instructions: The nutritional yeast flakes should be spread onto one side of a 2 pound piece of aluminum foil or parchment paper. Using a fork, lightly prick holes in the aluminum foil. Toast the foil by heating a dry cast iron griddle on top of a burner set to 325 degrees f. Use about one side only. Sprinkle on desired amount of flour flakes. Sprinkle on nutritional yeast flakes if desired. Remove from the grill. Brush remaining flakes over beets and gently press onto beets. Allow to cook until beets are golden brown and tender and crispy, 8 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,spinach,bay leaf,green bean,tomato paste,bread
title: Italian Spinach and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1 can green beans, rinsed | 1 can frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 can tomato paste | 1 loaf crusty bread | 3 bay leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine salad dressing mix and green beans, stirring to blend. Cut a circle from top of bread loaf into 1 inch wide strips. Cover center with half of the spinach, green beans and tomato paste. Place slices of remaining bread on top and spread evenly with salad dressing mixture. Place a bay leaf on top. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Quinoa & Apricot Stuffing

Spoon stewed stewed quinoa into bowls, then serve topped with crackers.

title: Cajun Pork with Lime and Soy milk Sauce

instructions: Sprinkle pork with taco seasoning. Combine soy milk and mustard in a small bowl. Dip pork in soy milk mixture, then brown over medium heat, 3 minutes each side. Transfer to a platter and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand for 5 minutes. Remove excess soy milk and sprinkle with lime peel.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,rom tomato,wasabi paste,poblano chile,white sugar,chili sauce,mozzarella string cheese,guacamole
title: Mexican Pizza Appetizer
ingredients: 16 ounces refrigerated guacamole | 4 ounces mozzarella string cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup wasabi paste | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 4 poblano chiles, minced | 2 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Place cheese on parchment paper lined baking sheet and spread to edges. Spread wasabi paste on top of cheese. Top with sliced chiles, orange peel and tomato slices. Cover with top of parchment paper. Bake in a 400 degrees f oven until golden.

title: Chickpea Dip

instructions: Put all ingredients into a food processor and chop for a minute or two. Serve with pita chips, warm tortillas, and fresh fruit. Store in the fridge for at least an hour.
