ingredients: 1/2 cup sourdough starter | 15 cups hot cooked rigatoni pasta | 2 ripe avocados, mashed | 2 cups apricot preserves | 1 teaspoon orange extract | 1 teaspoon grated orange extract | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 corn tortillas, cut into 1 inch strips
instructions: Dissolve the starter in two quarters cup hot water and set aside. Top with 1 cup of mashed avocados, 1/2 cup of apricot preserves, and 1 teaspoon of orange extract. title: Herbed Spinach

instructions: Wash, steam or microwave the spinach. Put aside and allow to wilt a bit. Add the remaining ingredients. Toss well to combine and serve.

title: Spicy Hot Dogs

instructions: Brown meat in a little oil. Add gravy and chili powder. Cover and cook for 10 - 15 minutes on low heat.

instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor. Process until smooth. Serve with pita chips, falafel, or bread.

instructions: Combine the orange peel and ginger ale in a medium bowl and stir over medium heat until hot but not boiling. Remove from the heat, cover and steep for 15 to 20 minutes. Add the red skinned fruit and bell pepper to the ginger ale mixture, give the glogg a final stir and serve.

title: Yogurt Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound white potatoes - peeled, cubed, and drained | 2 cups plain yogurt | 1/2 inch piece fresh ginger root, peeled and minced
instructions: Place the potato cubes into a large pot and cover with water.

title: Barley Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed and drained | 2 teaspoons minced green peppers | 4 hamburger buns
instructions: Combine barley and green pepper in a bowl and set aside. Cook barbeque meat by your preferred method of using a meat thermometer to check. Grill until desired doneness, breaking up in 1/2 at a time. Serve on buns..

Random Ingredients: red onion,green apple,vanilla essence,coffee,pear,apple cider vinegar,rye bread,ginger powder
title: German Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 green apple, sliced thinly ( or red or any other type ) | 1 pear, peeled, cored and sliced thinly | 1 small red onion, sliced thinly | 3 -4 slices rye bread | 2 -3 tablespoons coffe | 2 -3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Arrange a few pieces of toasted rye bread on the serving plate or platter with the apple and pear slices in a small circle around the edges. In a small bowl, mix the red onion with the toasted rye bread slices, and spoon over the apple and pear mixture. Sprinkle with the coffee. In another small bowl, mix the vinegar, ginger and vanilla essence with a little extra apple cider vinegar depending on the flavor and sweetness of your choice. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until needed.

title: Sauce and Homemade Beef Noodle Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces dry lasagna noodles | 1 cup dry cranberries | 1 cup dry-roasted romano cheese or 1 cup asiago cheese | sea salt, for sprinkling | 2 -3 quarts fat-free chicken stock or 2 -3 quarts duck fat | 1 package frozen cut-up cooked spareribs
instructions: In large pot of boiling, salted water, cook lasagna till just beginning to take shape. Add remaining ingredients except for noodles, and cook 2 - 2 1/2 3 minutes. Serve noodles cool, and separate meat from bones and fat. Drain the pasta, and divide among 4 serving plates. Top with hot sauce, if desired. If desired, combine 1/4 cup reserved noodle cooking liquid with pasta sauce.

title: Cajun Crab Soup
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock or 4 cups chicken stock | 1 can crab crab crabmeat | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 2 teaspoons dried dill | 2/3 cup water
instructions: In a stockpot, combine the stock, crabmeat, limeade concentrate and dill and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in water and remove from heat. Ladle soup into bowls and top with shrimp crab or scallops.

title: Pudim De Pan -  Rice Wine & Coconut Carrot Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 2 cups cooked rice or 2 cups shortgrain rice | 1 cup milk | 1 -2 dash tabasco sauce | 1 cup stock or 1 cup broth
instructions: Heat oil in saucepan and saute rice on medium heat until golden brown. Add milk, tabasco, and stock. Reduce heat and simmer soup slowly 20 minutes. Pour soup through a strainer and chill for 3 or 4 hours before serving.

title: Chinese BBQ Pork Chops
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, cut in pieces
instructions: In a bowl mix together the ketchup, worcestershire sauce and green pepper. Pour over pork chops and refrigerate for 8 to 10 hours, turning occasionally to coat the meat with the sauce. Remove pork chops from the marinade and cook on a greased grill or in your favorite bbq.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 package fresh baby spinach | 1 yellow pepper, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar
instructions: Place spinach in a large salad bowl. Slice the pepper into 1/4 inch wide strips. Add pepper, vinegar, and raspberries to the spinach and toss lightly. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate overnight for best results.

title: Southwest Banana Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons semolina flour | 1 teaspoon seasoning | 1 teaspoon chopped green chile | 1 can canned chipotle-flavored beef broth | 3 bananas, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine the semolina flour, seasoning, and chiles in a small bowl. To make a thinner soup, add more liquid. Bring broth to a boil in a medium saucepan over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,white onion,lime juice,golden raisin,italian parsley,salsa
title: Italian Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons butter | 1 medium white onion, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 jar salsa | 1/4 cup golden raisin, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | fresh thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Heat olive oil or butter in heavy large skillet over moderately high heat until foam subsides, then sauté onion until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Stir into onion. Return to skillet and boil rapidly 5 minutes. Add salsa, raisins and lime juice and boil vigorously, stirring occasionally, 2 minutes. Stir in thyme. Cool.

title: Spicy Thai Fried Bananas
ingredients: 1 -4 banana | 4 -6 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 -4 teaspoons red pepper flakes | 3 -4 teaspoons salt
instructions: Slice very very thinly and then place on paper towels. Take the sliced bananas, pat dry with paper towels and place in a large dish. Mix fish sauce, red pepper flakes and salt and pour over the bananas, rubbing the pieces together lightly. Cover and refrigerate for an hour or more, turning once. Remove banana pieces from the marinade. Use tongs to dip banana pieces into the fish sauce and then into the hot oil. Brown on all sides. Sprinkle with sugar or other sweetener if desired.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,sauce,fettuccine,chicken stock cube,cold water,icing sugar,purpose flour
title: Simple Fettuccine
ingredients: 4 ounces plain flour | 4 ounces all-purpose flour | 2 3/4 cups chicken stock cubes ( or 1 packet chicken flavored soup base or 2 of each ) | 3/4 cup cold water | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons sauce | 8 ounces fettuccine, cooked, drained
instructions: Sift all purpose flour into a mixing bowl and stir in the cubes of stock. Pour in water and mix together so all the flour is mixed in. Stir this into the flour mixture and gradually add in all the icing sugar, making sure the consistency is thick and elastic. Add the sauce and mix. Stir this mixture into the pasta you are going to cook the fettucine in. Put into a lightly oiled bowl that has been covered with the oil and then leave in a warm place for 10 minutes. Drain pasta and mix well before serving.

Random Ingredients: tea,pearl barley,soya sauce,cotija cheese,farfalle pasta,pasta,picante sauce
title: Mexican Pasta and BBQ Meatball With Stout
ingredients: 12 ounces orecchiette or 12 ounces other farfalle pasta | 3/4 lb ground round | 3/4 cup cheap beer or 3/4 cup tequila, plus | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 3/4 cup soya sauce | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 8 ounces uncooked farfalle pasta | 2 tablespoons cotija cheese or 2 tablespoons other mild cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the first six ingredients, except the farfalle pasta and 1/4 cup of the cheese. Stir into the meatball mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Cook the farfalle pasta in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain the pasta, and toss with the cooked farfalle mixture. Sprinkle with the cheese and serve.

title: Rødbrod - Strawberry Rhubarb
ingredients: 1 lb fresh rhubarb | 1/2 lb fresh spinach
instructions: Wash and trim rhubarb. Separate the stem from the stem. Cut the rhubarb crosswise into 4 pieces. Wash and trim spinach. Cut the stems into strips of 2 inches long. Toss the strips with 1/2 cup of water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until just tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer to a serving bowl. Cool. Chill for 1 hour. Drain off any cloudy liquid that forms on top. Remove the cover, add the spinach and rhubarb, and toss to combine before serving.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,cranberry,bell pepper,green bell pepper,vanilla bean,pork rib,beef sirloin tip
title: Cranberry and Beef Sirloin Roll
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork ribs or 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin tips, partially frozen | 1/4 cup cake flour | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef sirloin tip, thinly sliced in 1/2, then thinly sliced in 1/2 | 2 tablespoons frozen bell peppers, thawed, drained, and sliced lengthwise | 6 ounces fresh cranberries, thawed, divided | 1 white green bell pepper, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons frozen pcened cranberries, thawed, divided | 1 -2 vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Sprinkle pork evenly with flour on both sides. Arrange on a parchment lined large cookie sheet or baking sheet and bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Add beef and vegetable to the roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,fire tomato,vegetable oil cooking spray,mascarpone cheese,fish stock
title: Tomato Mascarpone Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup muscat brand mascarpone cheese, softened | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup fish stock | 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder or 1 tablespoon instant coffee powder | 4 tablespoons fire-roasted tomatoes, finely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, mash the mascarpone into the mascarpone.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,fenugreek leaf,grain mustard,sherry,sugar,feta cheese,purpose flour,bean
title: Artichoke & Feta Bean Cakes from the New York Times
ingredients: 2 cups canned baked beans | 1/2 pound chopped fresh artichoke hearts | 1/4 cup chopped feta | 1/4 cup dried small pitted sun-dried tomatoes ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard | 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. In a large bowl, mix beans, artichoke hearts, feta and sun dried tomatoes. Stir in 2 tablespoons mustard and flour. Mix the sugar and sherry into the rest of the mustard in a small bowl. Drop batter by rounded tablespoons onto bean mixture. Spread beans evenly over the top. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown in color.

title: Crispy Corned Beef With Gruyere
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon crushed fresh herb | 8 ounces corned beef, cubed | 1/2 green cabbage, quartered and sliced | 1 teaspoon herbs | 1 teaspoon ground thyme | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add corned beef, cabbage and herbs. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,scotch whisky,shell crab,white pearl onion,cayenne,creme fraiche,pepperoni,mayonnaise
title: Crabbet's Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1 can small white pearl onions, drained | 1 can small white pearl onions, drained | 1 cup imitation pepperoni, cut into small pieces | 2/3 cup light mayonnaise | 2/3 cup creme fraiche | 12 fluid ounces scotch whisky | 7 tablspoon scotch whisky | cayenne | 24 ladyfingers
instructions: Drain and dry the pearl onions. Combine all ingredients and chill for 1 hour. Serve cocktail in small glasses filled with cocktail bread.

title: Poppy Seed Sorbet - No Alcohol or Sugar
ingredients: 32 ounces unsweetened vodka | 32 ounces white poppy seeds, hulled
instructions: Pour vodka into an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions. Mix together the poppy seeds with as much of the seeds as you need, scoop dough into a baking sheet and freeze until solid.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,catsup,buffalo meat,monterey jack cheese,alfalfa sprout,chicken bouillon granule,sausage,chicken thigh fillet
title: Buffalo Sausage Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 package pork sausages | 1 package chicken breast fillets, cut into thin strips | 12 ounces baby alfalfa sprouts | 1 bottle catsup | 9 ounces steak sauce, divided | 3 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, of your choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat the inside of a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. Place the sausages in the baking dish and cook for 20 minutes, turning them frequently. Remove from the oven. Add the chicken, sprouts, 5 oz pkg. Of cream or 1/4 cup chicken bouillon, steak sauce and the second bottle of cream. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is completely covered. Sprinkle the top with the cheddar cheese and bake for 30 minutes. Serve hot with a salad.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,sea salt black pepper,dark rum,mexican rice,double cream,beer,white pepper
title: Rum and Wine Pie
ingredients: 800 g puff pastry ( ready ready-rolled pie crust ) | 150 ml mexican rice | 150 ml dark rum | 1/2 cup beer ( pale ale should be used in place of the light beer ) | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | white pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c or 190c if you can. Line a large, oven tray with greaseproof paper. Roll out the pastry and line with baking parchment. Place the pastry on the paper with the pastry case, and trim the excess around the edge by rolling it out from the center outwards with a swivel bladed knife. Carefully remove the top paper, and place the pie dough on the lined tray. Sprinkle the rice over the pastry and set aside to cool whilst you get the beer. Place the beer, 1 tsp of rum and white pepper in a saucepan with 1 tsp extra rum and place over gentle heat. When the mixture has come to a boil remove from the heat. Strain out the solids and set aside. Pour the warm beer into the pastry case and sprinkle the remaining pinch of rum, white pepper and a pinch of sea salt over it. Arrange the pie on the baking paper and bake in the oven for 20 minutes or until risen, and golden brown. Serve warm with a slice of wine or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,yellow bell pepper,tomato puree,ice,pork belly,chicken breast,watermelon,apricot brandy
title: Chinese Pork & Peppers
ingredients: 1 small watermelon, rind removed and coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork belly, cut crosswise into 1 1/2-inch slices | 2 1/2 lbs tomatoes, halved and seeded | 1/2 cup apricot brandy or 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil, divided | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 2 -3 lbs fresh waxy boiling watermelon | 4 -4 yellow bell peppers, cut into thin strips | ice or red wine vinegar, to serve
instructions: Combine watermelon, pork and tomato puree and set aside. In a colander or sieve, drain the watermelon mixture, reserving juice. Set aside. For the liquid, combine the reserved tomato juice with sugar and set aside. Place the apricot brandy or rice wine vinegar into your wok and set over high heat. To see if the brandy has reached the desired consistency, put a small piece of tomato in a large bowl. Pour water through a strainer into the bowl, pressing the tomato pulp through the strainer. Pour the liquid from the strainer into the wok and stir until just warm and slightly thickened. Taste, adjust the sweetness and sweetness of the liquid accordingly. Arrange the watermelon slices on a platter. Spoon the pork mixture over the slices, placing a bell pepper, and the reserved tomato puree around the pork. Serve with red wine.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,mexican cheese,chicken stock beef,barbecue sauce,yeast,ziti pasta,apricot jam,purpose flour
title: Hot and Chewy Baked Ziti
ingredients: 2 lbs ziti pasta or 2 lbs penne | 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon instant dry yeast | 1/2 cup honey or 1/2 cup other light honey | 1 1/2 cups hot chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce ( i use sweet onion bbq sauce ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dried apricot nuts ( or try almonds )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until a dent is reached, however it will likely not be cooked completely. Drain and reserve. You will have to use a 9x13 inch baking dish lined with parchment paper. Put 1/2 cup warm broth in a measuring cup or cup. Melt the honey then stir in the rest of the broth to make about 1 1/2 cups, adding more broth or water as needed. Add the yeast and stir to combine, set aside. In a bowl, combine the flour, yeast and the 2 teaspoons salt. Pour into the warm broth and stir to combine. Add the milk, apricot jam and the 1/2 cup of broth/milk and stir to combine. When the ziti is finished, drain well and return to the pot. Add the sauce, nuts and the yeast mixture, tossing well to combine. Turn the mixture into a prepared baking dish and spread the pasta evenly. Cover and place in a warm dry place for 10 to 15 minutes so that the sauce can swell. Bake, covered for 45 to 55 minutes in a preheated 450 degree f oven. It will be very slightly crisp and a little dry at this point. Remove lid and bake for an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until the top is browned.

Random Ingredients: coleslaw mix,coffee,broccoli floret,pinto bean,cider,italian seasoning,marsala wine
title: Easy French N Bean Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh mushrooms or can sliced mushrooms | 1 bag frozen broccoli florets | 1 can coleslaw mix | 3 tablespoons brewed coffee | 2 tablespoons dry marsala wine | 1 can pinto beans | 1/2 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Boil a large pot of water. Meanwhile rinse and de stem the mushrooms. Slice and steam the broccoli. In a large saucepan, combine broccoli, mushrooms, coleslaw mix, coffee, marsala and italian seasoning. Bring just to a boil and reduce to a simmer. Cook for 1/2 hour. Add cooked pinto beans and cook an additional 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,dill pickle,chili oil,red chili powder,veal stock,strawberry liqueur
title: Ladies and Thighs
ingredients: 7 -8 chicken legs | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 red lily candies liqueur ( such as baileys ) | 2 containers strawberries liqueur ( such as lady arianna's light rum ) | 1 package dill pickle slices ( fresh in the jar ) | 1/4 cup veal stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Rinse and dry chicken legs with cold water. Place in a shallow roasting pan. Sprinkle with chili powder and cover with foil. Bake in oven 30 minutes turning once. Remove from oven, uncover and set aside in a warm place. Meanwhile, prepare the bain marie to divide between 6 - 8 pieces of foil. Layer on top of each other with the strawberry liqueur, pickle slices and stock. Cover each with a piece of foil and close the foil. Bake on top of the stove until very hot, about 45 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool at least 20 minutes before serving.

title: Turnip and Chive (India Bread)
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1/8 cup fresh turmeric, peeled and coarsely chopped | 4 pieces baguette, thick slices
instructions: Place the turnips in a large saucepan and add enough cold water to cover them, about 2 cups, and bring to a boil. Add the turmeric and remove from the heat. Let sit until a knife can pierce the skin of the turnips, about 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, drain, slip out the parsley, then peel and cut the turnips into 1/4 inch by 2 inch pieces and let cool. In a large skillet, layer the bread with the turnips, sprinkling with the parsley. Repeat the layering until all the ingredients have been used, ending with bread. Slice in half, serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Meat and Sour Cherries in Yoghurt
ingredients: 600 g meatballs, lean | 200 g pear | 100 g sour cherries | 3 -4 red chilies, chopped finely | 100 g plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Cube meat and add to yoghurt. Add vanilla. Chop cherries and add to yoghurt. Add diced red chillies and stir. Serve.

title: White Wine Marinade for Beef
ingredients: 2 cups dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Use for basting or as needed.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,picante sauce,hard egg,lemon peel,lemonade,splenda sugar substitute
title: Tortilla De Queso
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 1/4 cup picante sauce or 1/4 cup picante sauce | 4 tablespoons lemonade | 1 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Place all ingredients, except splenda in a blender.

title: Cranberry Pie
ingredients: 1 9 inches pie shell, unbaked ( your favourite pie crust ) | 1 cup mashed potatoes | 1 cup fresh cranberries | 1/2 cup shelled pistachios, crushed | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 4 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk caramel | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Combine mashed potatoes, cranberries, pistachios, corn syrup, condensed milk caramel and sea salt in a bowl. Sprinkle tart dough evenly on a large baking sheet. Bake 25 - 30 min, or until top is golden all over. Remove from oven and let cool before slicing.

title: Indian Cabbage With Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 lb asparagus | 1 green cardamom pod | 3 cups chinese cabbage
instructions: Clean the asparagus by trimming the tips and slicing it in the thinnest possible pieces. Boil the chinese cabbage for a few minutes until it starts to wilt. Wash the asparagus lightly for a few minutes and plunge it in ice cold water until it is cool, then cut the asparagus into 1/4 inch strips. Place the asparagus and chillies into a microwave safe bowl and cover with just enough boiling water to cover. Microwave on high power for 5 minutes. You will need to stir halfway through the cooking process so as not to overcooked nor overcooked pieces. Serve immediately with your favourite garnish.

Random Ingredients: hot pepper sauce,coffee,nutmeg,chocolate pudding mix,extra beef,halibut fillet,seasoning
title: Grilled Norwegian Fish
ingredients: 2 pounds extra lean ground beef | 1 can hot pepper sauce, divided | 1 1/2 cups hot coffee, divided | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 pinch seasoning | 2 teaspoons ground nutmeg | 8 halibut fillets
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. In a medium bowl, combine the ground beef, 1/2 cup hot coffee, pudding mix, seasoning and ground nutmeg. Cook for approximately 15 minutes, turning once, until meat is cooked to your liking. Serve with boiled potatoes and green vegetables.

title: Nif's Israeli Couscous
ingredients: 2 cups israeli couscous | 1 whole large msg
instructions: Combine dry spices in a large bowl, or pan. Add a little water, and mix well. Stir until the grains of rice are just slightly covered. Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Put a pot of water on boil. Put the lid on the pan, and put the oven rack on the middle rack. When the oven is heated through, put the whole lot in a bowl or a bowl of your choice. If you want to add cheese, put the cheese mixture in as well. It will melt into the cheese. Put the bowls into the oven, and bake for 12 - 15 minutes. When you turn the stove off, pour the cheese mixture over the hot couscous at the table.

title: Paprika and Grilled Calamari on Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg hamburger | 1 bunch squash ( kibrisli - 2 large ones ) or 1 bunch red pepper ( kibrisli - 2 large ones ) | 2 -3 tablespoons of thick olive oil | 8 -12 slices smoked ham or 8 -12 slices cooked ham, sliced thin | 1 cup olive, sliced
instructions: Slice the meat into thin, narrow, even strips. Slice the squash or pepper into thin wedges. Remove the seeds, as per instructions on the packet, and cut into half, vertically or half, depending on the size of the piece of meat. Pour a little olive oil on the grill or bbq. Put the meat on the hot grill, with about a quarter cup of olive oil on the side, for about 3 - 4 minutes, turning once or twice. Serve with the olives. The olive oil gives a better flavour.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya coriander annatto,lemon peel,bulgar wheat,pork shoulder,wheat cracker,cornflour
title: Hogao (Hogao)
ingredients: 4 ounces boneless pork shoulder, cut into strips | 1/2 ounce bulgar wheat | 2 slices lemon peel ( thin strips ) | 4 ounces cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1/2 teaspoon sazon goya with coriander and annatto | 1/4 cup fine bulgur wheat
instructions: Combine the pork, bulgur and peel. Sprinkle with cornflour and sazon and coriander and annatto, mix well. Place mixture in a shallow cake or deep dish, cover lightly and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,chicken thigh,baby portabella mushroom,risotto rice,bean,sesame oil,chicken breast
title: Chicken Cacciatore (Casquin Risotto)

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl, add rice, chicken, pecorino, mushrooms, and sesame oil. Mix well. Add rice and stir to coat with oil. Add chicken to remaining liquid and cook over medium heat until liquid is absorbed about 1 minute. Add bean mixture, stir and cook on a low heat for 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Prawns, Chilli, Sundried Tomato and Green Tuna Wrap
ingredients: 250 g cooked peeled prawns, peeled | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 green capsicum, thinly sliced | 1 orange, juice of | 1 shallot, finely sliced | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts, roughly chopped | 12 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 green sun-dried tomato packed in oil, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine prawns, olive oil and capsicum in a bowl, and toss to coat. Place sun dried tomatoes in a dry frying pan, reserving the oil. title: Aunty Mata's Japanese Grapefruit Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ripe grapefruit juice | 1 cup soya sauce | red onion, chopped finely
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Serve chilled topped with fried red onions, and eat as is or if preferred with steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,strawberry,nutmeg,wheat flour,broad bean,heavy whipping cream,cake flour
title: Gourmet Fresh Strawberries

instructions: Sift the flours into a large bowl, add the sherry, nutmeg and half of the chilled cream and stir together. Using a pastry brush with olive oil, lightly brush the surface of the fruit with the remaining cream. Place under preheated oven. Bake in a preheated 400°f oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until the fruit is tender and slightly browned. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Italian Breaded Lentil and Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground round | 1 can lentils, drained | 1 lb iceberg lettuce, washed and dried & dried | 4 ounces italian blend bread, loafs cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 lb suet or 1/2 lb ricotta cheese | 1/2 lb crumbled unpeeled bocconcini | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | saltine crackers
instructions: Cook the ground round in a pan until browned. Drain. Let cool. Place the lentils in a large pan of boiling water and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until al dentee. Cool and then transfer to a medium bowl. Break up the bread cubes into smaller pieces. In the same pan, place the suet, italian blend cheese, italian bread crumbs, and a bit of water. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until very crumbs are golden brown. Add bread/cheese to the lentil mixture and combine. Spoon into a large bowl. Top with the hard boiled italian bocconcini pieces, cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 6 hours to set. When ready to serve, drain the excess water and allow to dry for about 10 minutes. Garnish with crackers if desired.

title: Torta De Espinaca (Beef Pastries)
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless sirloin tip steaks or 3 lbs sirloin tip steaks | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cornflour | 1/2 lb cottage cheese | 1/8 teaspoon saffron strand
instructions: Trim fat from steak and slice thinly into thin strips. Put cornflour on a plate. Mix cottage cheese with half a teaspoon saffron and a little water and pour over meat in the plate. Fold cheese and meat together. Cover and let stand 15 minutes. Roll in cornflour in flour and put on a baking tray.

title: Crab Stuffed Loch Ness
ingredients: 1 lb crab ( cleaned and cracked ) | 3 tablespoons craisins ( dark rum flavoured sugar ) | 3 tablespoons craisins ( dried cranberries )
instructions: Prepare crabs, either from frozen or from the normal way crab is cleaned. Remove and discard shells. Rinse crab under cool water and remove the cartilage and digestive cord. Rinse with cold water to help remove shells. Rinse the crab inside and out and remove any remaining shells. Combine crab with craisins and craisins and add some crab mixture to each shell. Top each crab with some remaining crab mixture to coat evenly. Refrigerate at least one hour before serving. Note, may be served on the side with a bowl of fresh crackers.

title: Grilled Cretons
ingredients: 4 medium free range chickens ( cut into serving pieces ) | 2/3 cup water | 1 1/2 cups gruyere cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons cointreau liqueur or 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 4 cups puffed rice krispies
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Place chicken in a large bowl.

title: Rice Balls With Cheese and Green Peppers
ingredients: 4 -5 cups arborio rice ( can use medium or short grain as well ) | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 4 tablespoons unsalted peanut butter | 1 can chopped jalapeno peppers, drained | 1/2 teaspoon capers | 1 cup peanuts, chopped | 1/3 cup nutella
instructions: Bring 2 cup of water to a boil and add rice. Cover and turn heat off and let sit for 30 minute. After 30 minutes, fluff rice and turn to drain. Place ricotta, peanut butter, canned jalapenos, capers and nuts into bowl. Mix until thoroughly combined. Stir rice, filling, and pepper mix into creamy sauce set aside for 30 min to cool. Shape rice mixture into 1 inch balls and place on a baking sheet. Cover and keep warm in the oven till all rice is chilled. When all rice balls have chilled, place 2 in each bowl and sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon and additional nuts if desired. Store in the fridge. They will keep up to 2 days if stored in a tightly covered container.

title: Fried Cheese (Fritos De Queso)
ingredients: 2 ounces queso fresco | 3 -4 tablespoons sugar ( optional )
instructions: Cut the cheese in small cubes. Heat the sugar in a cast iron skillet or fryer for 1 - 2 minutes. If desired, sprinkle it with 1 - 2 tablespoons of flour. Fry the cheese cubes over high heat until lightly browned and crispy.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,raisin,chipotle chile pepper,romaine lettuce,purpose flour,raspberry jam
title: Raspberry Chipsotle Romaine Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup raspberry jam | 3/4 cup seedless raisins | 1 chipotle chile pepper, seeded and minced | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon crumbled dried sage leaves | 6 romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, stir the jam with the rasins and chipotle. In another small bowl, stir the flour and sage.

title: Grilled Zucchini and Pineapple Kebabs
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, cut lengthwise into 8 wedges
instructions: Combine zucchini and remaining ingredients in a large resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,taco seasoning mix,lamb,green pepper,chicken leg,pepper jack cheese,tamari,dark chocolate
title: Mexican Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken legs | 12 ounces grilled dark chocolate, diced | 5 cups low-fat vanilla ice cream | 2 teaspoons tamari | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons chopped green peppers | 2 ounces shaved pepper jack cheese | 12 ounces refrigerated dark sweet pepper jack cheese
instructions: Heat grill to medium. Place chicken legs in a 1 quart baking dish. Coat with nonstick cooking spray. Combine chocolate, ice cream, tamari, and taco seasoning mix in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,meat,shrimp paste,vegemite,lemon juice zest,anise seed,vegetarian bean
title: Bunuelos
ingredients: 3 cans vegetarian baked beans, with liquid ( if you like your recipe with pork you can use other beans ) | 1 tablespoon vegetarian chili blend seasoning ( or substitute with other spices ) | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice or 1/3 cup white vinegar, bottled | 1 teaspoon zest, finely grated ( about 4 teaspoons ) or 1 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated ( about 4 teaspoons ) | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed or 1 teaspoon ground sesame seeds ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon shrimp paste ( optional ) | mexican cheese, shredded ( optional )
instructions: Heat beans according to instructions on packaging. Drain the excess liquid. If you like to use the chili sauce, use the bottled liquid to cook the green chilies. Add remaining ingredients except cheese and stir in well. Place in serving dish and top with shredded cheese as desired.

title: Nancy's Spicy Steak
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs round steaks or 4 -6 lbs sirloin steaks | 4 lime wedges
instructions: Place steak in a large shallow dish. Pour lime wedges on meat, turning to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. Preheat grill. Remove steak and let stand 10 - 15 minutes before grilling. Brush with olive oil before grilling or brushing with a little olive oil. Grill or broil steak 8 - 10 minutes per side or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: cherry,parmesan cheese,lime wedge,almond extract,stew meat,broccoli floret
title: Heart Healthy N' Easy Beef and Broccoli Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean stew meat | 1 package frozen broccoli florets or 1 package fresh broccoli florets | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 3/4 cup reduced-fat sweetened parmesan cheese, divided | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the stew meat, and cook until just partially browned, stirring occasionally. Place half of the broccoli into the bottom of a 5 quart casserole dish. Spread the steak slices evenly over the broccoli and arrange them over the broccoli. Sprinkle with half the cherry tomatoes and 1/2 the cheese. Repeat layering until the entire dish is filled. Drain the beef, and add it to the casserole. Stir in the remaining chopped broccoli and remaining cherry tomatoes and top with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Squeeze lime juice over all, and serve.

title: Dark Beer Dip
ingredients: 2 bottles dark beer | 1 pear, peeled and diced | 1 pinch cream of tartar | salt and pepper to taste | 1/2 apple - peeled, cored and diced
instructions: Pour dark beer into a bowl and mix in apple. Season with cream of tartar and salt and pepper. Serve chilled.

title: North African Kielbasa and Zucchini Salad
ingredients: 4 cups zucchini, cut in 1 inch cubes | 1 cup basmati rice, uncooked, white | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water till tender, about 15 minutes, and drain well. Place into a salad bowl, and toss w. Add tahini, vinegar and cumin.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,lemon juice,provolone cheese,dripping,tomato green chilies,ghee butter
title: Spicy Tomato-Ghee Cheese Wedges
ingredients: 100 g butter | 50 g drippings | 3 small tomatoes and green chilies ( can use bottled ) | 30 ml lemon juice | 150 g provolone cheese or 150 g cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry ( optional )
instructions: Melt ghee in large frypan over medium heat. Once melted, add tomatoes and green chillies and stir fry for 5 minutes or until tomatoes have softened. Mix in lemon juice. Turn heat down and stir in the cheese until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in the cherry. Let stand for about 10 minutes or until mixture is cool enough to handle. Cut wedges into wedges and serve.

title: Cranberry Turkey Burgers
ingredients: 1 pound ground turkey | 1 jar pizza sauce | 1 jar salsa | 1 1/3 cups fresh cranberries | 2 quarts apple juice | 1 1/3 cups grape leaves
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat. Place ground turkey in a large bowl.

title: Dill Sauce
ingredients: 1 can frozen chopped pineapple with juice | fresh dill weed
instructions: Drain pineapple, reserving liquid. Blend with reserved cooking liquid until smooth and transfer to a blender. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed before adding more liquid.

title: Beer Sausage
ingredients: 3 lbs ground sausage ( hillshire farms preferred ) | 1 large yellow summer squash, cut into eighths | 1 large yellow summer squash, cut into eighths | 1 can beer ( recommended guinness ) | 2 ounces grenadine | 1 carton frozen whipped topping ( recommended ( jell-o )
instructions: Cut sausage into 1 inch cubes, then brown in frying pan. Drain fat from pan. Saute squash and sausage for 10 minutes over medium heat, adding the beer and grenadine, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in whipped topping and reheat to warm. Serve over fettuccine.

title: Lebanese Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried prawns, shells and deveined | 12 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Cover the prawns with cold water. Bring to a boil then simmer for 6 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Cover with a tea towel and set aside. Mix the prawns with 2 cups cold water in a bowl. Allow to sit for 5 minutes. Drain thoroughly then rinse well. Spread 1 heaping tablespoon of prawn mixture on a lettuce leaf. Cover with another lettuce leaf. Roll up and fasten with toothpicks before serving.

title: Rigatoni With Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried cannellini beans | 1 1/2 cups dry white wine | 2 cups hot cooked rigatoni pasta
instructions: Soak cannellini beans in warm water for 15 minutes. Remove and discard any damaged beans and place in large saucepan. Add wine and bring to a boil. Add pasta and cook over low heat for 8 - 10 minutes until pasta is al dente.

title: Zucchini With Harissa (Zucchini Salad - North Africa)
ingredients: 2 zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut into 3-inch lengths | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon honey or 1 teaspoon agave nectar | 1/2 teaspoon harissa or 1/2 teaspoon sambal oelek ( or other hot pepper sauce ) | 1/4 teaspoon allspice, freshly ground | 1 teaspoon sugar | 2 cups apple cider or 2 cups red wine vinegar
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the vinegar and sugar in a food processor and process until smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Place in a serving bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand at room temperature for 2 hours. Bring to room temperature before serving. This dressing can be used immediately or cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Sausage, Chilli, or Ground Turkey!
ingredients: 1 sausage, any, any kind, with fat or | turkey fat ( or other fat ) | 1 teaspoon red chili powder, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cut sausages into thick slices or into large pieces. Spray or brush sausages with a little olive oil. Broil, watching closely, or cook indirectly on a grill.. Turn often, until both sides are browned. Sprinkle the with chile powder, if using.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,garlic paste,morton nature seasoning,red chile,rice flour,red chilies,pomegranate seed,up soda
title: Rice Flour Tortillas With Pepitas(Spain)
ingredients: 8 cups bomba rice flour | 1 1/4 cups spanish onions, shredded ( about 2 large onions ) | 2 -3 teaspoons morton nature seasons seasoning ( heaping, i add extra, if wanted ) | 2 -3 whole dried red chilies ( pimenton n de la vera ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chile | 12 pomegranate seeds ( toasted ) | garlic paste | 1 teaspoon pepitas ( heaping, can use crushed chiles, but i like pepitas best )
instructions: Soak the chilies in hot water for 30 min to soften. Remove stems and seeds with vegetable blancher. Drain and reserve. Put rice flour in a large bowl. Add 3 1/2 to 4 cups water along with the saffron from seasonings, onion, chilies, pepitas, garlic and the rest of the liquid from soaking the chilies. Stir with a wooden spoon till a dough forms and the dough leaves the sides of the bowl. If mixing, use hands until the dough is manageable and you want it not too hard. If not, add more water. Divide dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each into a smooth ball. On a lightly floured surface, press each one till all excess dough is gone. Using 1 round cutter cut out circles of dough. Repeat with 6 more circles. On each of the circles, lay 4 blanched chilies on each side of each dough circle. Fold each circle in half.. Press edges firmly with a fork. Place on a baking sheets. Using a fork, make a crisscross design over each tortilla on each side. Bake in a shallow preheated oven till edges are light tan in color.. Serve warm. Sprinkle with more pappitas and your favourite mexican meal condiments/salsa fresca on the side. To make a homemade pepitas, substitute a can of fire roasted diced tomatoes, or tomato salsa if you don't have an can of fire roasted tomatos, but my husband loves them for a little heat and added a little garlic, chopped fresh jalapeno peppers, salt, cayenne pepper or onion powder. Also you can use a blend of chilies that are already roasted in a skillet, but i prefer a milder salsa, like jalapeno powder. They also can be made with corn, chick peas or pinto beans, adding a little more seasoning if desired. Note, if you omit this ingredient from recipe #4, i think this would make enough to fill 2 bowls and it would be tasty in a large bowl for 2 or 3 mexican dishes on your side.

Random Ingredients: rib eye,romaine lettuce heart,ginger paste,milk ricotta cheese,red food coloring,dark brown sugar
title: Rib Eye Salads (With the Ginger)
ingredients: 1 package whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons grated ginger paste | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring | 2 -3 pre-shredded romaine lettuce hearts | crushed red food coloring
instructions: In bowl, combine ricotta, ginger paste, sugar, and food color until well blended and fluffy. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend. Place romaine lettuce hearts on a clean towl, or clean tea towel, and spread with 1/4 of the ricotta mixture. Place a few drops of food coloring in a pastry brush, or drizzle over salad. Roll or roll to coat romaine hearts, place on prepared tray, and decorate salad with remaining ricotta mixture.

title: Homemade Pizza Crumbs
ingredients: 2 lbs unbleached all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 12 ounces double cream | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 bay leaf ( optional )
instructions: In large mixing bowl or bowl of food processor with dough hook, mix together flour and yeast until combined. Stir in cream and garlic salt or a little at a time until you have achieved it's consistency of sour cream. If needed, mix in a little more flour. The dough should have the consistency of thick cream dough. When it is a wet, but not sticky, ball add more flour or cream if mixture is too dry. Turn the dough on to a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic. If dough is still too wet after a few minutes, take pieces of dough and pat or roll them into balls. Cover tightly and let stand at room temperature for about an hour or two. Preheat oven to 500 degrees and place a pizza stone on top of the oven rack to heat. Divide the dough into 12 pieces and roll out the dough to desired thickness and thickness. Using a floured fork, press your thumb or your index finger into the top of each ball. Stretch the dough out evenly on the work surface. Make sure it covers the entire pizza stone or you might get some extra dough. Using a floured rolling pin, or a wooden spoon or your hands, roll out the dough until it is all thin. Using a pizza cutter or your hands, roll out desired thickness of the dough, about 1/8 inch thick.. Slice the dough into 1/2 inch wide pieces. Place on cookie sheets, cover tightly with plastic wrap or a cotton towel, and let rise for 20 minutes. After the 20 minutes, bake 10 minutes, lower heat to 500 degrees and bake until crust is light brown and edges begin to crispen, about 8 minutes more. Remove from oven and cool on wire racks. The easiest way to do this is with toothpicks or a hot knife. Store in airtight containers for up to 5 days. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,red wine,yellow bell pepper,snow pea,maraschino cherry,margarine
title: Puerto Rican Polenta (Cajun Style Polenta)
ingredients: 2 cups fine cornmeal | 1 box frozen snow peas, defrosted | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter | 1/2 cup red wine ( i prefer merlot ) | 1/2 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 maraschino cherry, halved and pitted
instructions: Heat margarine in skillet with no stick on, on medium heat. Add wine. Stir with wooden spoon to create a roux and cook slowly about 10 minutes. Add peas, stir a few times. Cover and reduce heat to medium. Cook, stirring often, about 15 to 20 minutes or until peas are tender. Add bell pepper and cherries, cook about 5 minutes.

title: Gramma's Barley Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf white bread, cut into cubes | 3/4 cup pearl barley | 1 cup white flour, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the pieces of bread in a bowl of flour and toss with the barley and flour. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until golden in color.

title: Linguine Salad with Nuts and Apples
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 5 tablespoons walnut oil | 3 tablespoons canned kidney beans | 2 ounces firm-ripe tart apples, like granny smith | 2 ounces baby carrots, peeled and cut into 3-inch lengths | 1/4 cup chopped roasted unsalted peanuts | 8 ounces plain yogurt, to serve

Random Ingredients: yogurt,nonfat yogurt,chili sauce,quinoa,broccoli,red pepper flake,black pepper,shrimp

title: Scallops and Shrimp Over Gamba

title: Pepperoni Onion Fondues

instructions: Heat the oven to 400°f place the sausage and pearl onions in a bowl, pour over just enough boiling water to cover and leave for 20 minutes. Transfer to a clean jam jar. Random Ingredients: sage,chicken breast,corn oil,chicken bouillon granule,olive oil,green cardamom pod

title: Eggstatic Beef Jerky I

instructions: Mix all ingredients well then cut in shortening. Pour egg whites through drip screen onto wax paper and mix well. Press onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until golden on top.

instructions: In a food processor or blender or by hand, blend dijon, red chile, and mustard until smooth. Pour mixture into a glass jar and refrigerate at least 3 hours before using.

instructions: Mix all ingredients in a glass jar. Mix well. Store in refrigerator.

instructions: Preheat over to 325°f. Put the sugar into a heavy bottomed 2 quart saucepan. Add the butter. Add the kahlua. When the butter melts, stir until completely dissolved. Allow to cool. Place into a glass, or mugs. Let cool completely then break up with a spoon and serve.

title: Pumpkin Stew

instructions: Cut stew beef in small cubes, place in the fridge with flour and tomato puree. Let sit for an hour. Boil chicken stock until stew beef is cooked and liquid is reduced. Set aside to cool completely. Meanwhile peel sour apples and cut into very small cubes. Dice the cream cheese dough into bite size pieces and place in the fridge. When stew beef comes to a boil place sour apple chunks into boiling water for no less than five seconds or until they are translucent. Drain and set aside. Put the salmon into boiling water and just let simmer for five minute until it flakes easily. Then mash it with a potato masher. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add a little water if its too thick. title: Easy Nacho Chip Truffles

instructions: In a small bowl, combine olive oil and toss with the celery, horseradish, and apple. Let sit for 5 minutes. instructions: Cook macaroni.

instructions: Spray a large skillet with cooking spray and set over medium high heat. Add potatoes and cook until just tender, stirring occasionally, about 6 minutes. Add beans and rum extract.

instructions: Boil water in a large pot and then add potatoes and cook, uncovered, until potatoes are tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and cool under cold running water. instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place tomato slices on a baking tray. Sprinkle capsicum with zest and basil. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until tender. Serve.

title: Beer & Salmon Smoked Fish, Smoked

instructions: To build a smoky fish, lay a salmon round on the work surface and spoon some beer and/or light beer over the top. Arrange the smoked salmon rounds on top, and season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Potato, Mushroom and Green Enchilada
ingredients: 1 lb white potato ( about 8, peeled and cubed ) | 1 red pepper ( sliced into 8 pieces ) | 1 package button mushrooms, sliced | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 16 bamboo skewers ( or use 6 skewers ) | 1/2 cup chopped pecans ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dried salted peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Cook potatoes. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a skillet and cook red pepper until tender crisp. Add potatoes, mushrooms, and green enchilada sauce and boil until potatoes are tender.
