title: Sizzlin' Irish Treats
ingredients: 150 g cake flour, sifted | 250 g cheese | 200 g beans sprouts, washed well | 200 g chocolate ice cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 230oc/450of/gas mark 5 or 200f/230of/gas beat the icing sugar and cheese together on a stand mixer and then add the beansprouts. You may need a little more or less of them. Spread the cake mixture in a 20cm x 30cm swiss roll tin. Slice the ice cream through the widest edge. Cut into 10 even pieces as you like. Place these around the icing in the loaf tin. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 35 mins, until golden brown. Leave in the pan on a wire rack to cool. These can be eaten immediately, but will have a crunchy quality after no more than a few mins, so if icing has absorbed the excess moisture just sprinkle with a little more icing sugar.

title: Sizzlin Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 tortilla ( quesadilla ) | 2 tablespoons sizzlin sizzlin beef or 2 tablespoons sizzlin roasted sizzlin beef, shredded
instructions: Toast the tortillas under your broiler. Spread the sizzlin mixture on the top half of the tortilla. Cover it with the meat. Spread the sizzlin mixture on the tortilla. Place the top half of the tortilla on top of it. Cook in your hot griddle over medium heat, turning the quesadillas halfway through, until the tortilla is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: penne,eggplant,dark sesame oil,spinach,apricot preserve,grand marnier,asafoetida powder,hot water
title: Spinach Pasta With Roasted Eggplant and Apricot Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs medium eggplants | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon hot water | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon hot dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons grand marnier or 3 tablespoons other orange-flavored liqueur | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed, drained, and well drained | 1 lb penne | 1/3 cup apricot preserves, warmed ( optional )
instructions: Cut 1 or 2 crosswise slices off the tops and bottoms of the eggplants to expose the flesh. Trim and peel, leaving the eggplants on skins. Slice into approximately 1/4 slices, and set aside. In a large straight sided frying pan over medium heat, combine the dark sesame oil and hot water. Stir 1/2 teaspoon of asafoetida and 1 teaspoons of dark sesame oil into hot oil. Sprinkle the sliced eggplants with the mixture, being careful not to bruise them or allow to brown. Add the sliced and lightly scrubbed garlic to pan. Stir until softened. Add the remaining 3 tablespoons of orange flavored liqueur and 1 teaspoon of dark sesame oil. Simmer, uncovered, for about 3 minutes. Add the spinach to the pan, and simmer just till the spinach wilts. If needed, add a small amount of hot water to the pan. Stir in 2/3 of the pasta, or enough to barely cover the bottom of the pan. Cook another 4 minutes or so to give the sauce some moisture. Stir the remaining 2/3 pasta onto the top of the pasta. If sauce is very thick, stir in a small amount of dry pasta water, and stir. Simmer briefly another minute or so. Stir in remaining 2 tablespoons of dark sesame oil, the apricot preserves, and the cooked eggplant slices. Taste for seasoning. Taste for adding salt and additional sweetener to your liking. Serve immediately over hot spaghetti noodles or use in a roasted garlic flavored spaghetti.

title: Easy Fruity Lassi
ingredients: 2 cups fruit, cubed | 60 ml water ( just enough to give a creamy consistency )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and mix it for a few minutes to combine. Pour the mixture into two glass glasses and serve.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,asiago cheese,vegetarian bean,mustard,cream mushroom soup,garlic,coconut milk
title: Better Than Frozen Veggies   Crock Pot
ingredients: 32 ounces vegetarian refried beans | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can baked sweet potato traditional mashed potatoes | 1 1/4 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese
instructions: Spray crock pot with pam or vegetable oil. Add beans and stir to mix. Add all other ingredients. Mix until everything is well blended. Cook on low 12 hours.

Random Ingredients: green chili salsa,icing sugar,chili pepper flake,romano cheese,garam masala,large shrimp
title: Maggie's Chili Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled | 1/2 cup green chili salsa | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese | icing sugar
instructions: Combine ingredients, shrimp, salsa, and chillies. Mix well. Serve in a shallow ceramic dish. Sprinkle icing sugar over, if desired. Serve with whole wheat indian chapatis..

title: Horseradish Chocolate
ingredients: 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate squares | 4 teaspoons finely grated prepared horseradish
instructions: In a double boiler, melt chocolate on low power and add horseradish. Cool mixture. When cool, chill for 2 hours.

title: Apple, Pea and Cinnamon Tortilla Casserole
ingredients: 30 -40 large flour tortillas, divided into quarters | 3 cans sweet peas, drained | 4 packets ladyfingers, split | 4 1/2 cups apple juice, warmed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Spray a large square baking dish or casserole with nonstick oil spray. Arrange half the tortillas in the prepared baking dish, split side down. Top with half the shelled peas, half the sweet peas, half the biscuits and all the apple juice. Repeat with the rest of the bread and then spoon the remaining apple juice over everything up until the last of the fruit mixture is nearly absorbed. Cover and bake for 45 - 55 minutes until well heated through and starting to crisp up. Serve hot.

title: Creamy Bacon Swiss Steak With Leeks and Tahini Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 1 1/2 lbs beefsteak ( or more ) or 1 1/2 lbs round steaks, cut in 3/4-inch cubes ( or more ) | 1 large leek, white and light green parts only, thinly sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon hot sauce ( mild or medium ) | 1 dash red cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon fresh dill weed, chopped | 1 can enchilada sauce ( or tomato sauce if you prefer )
instructions: In a non stick, preferably cast iron skillet, cook the bacon over medium high heat until crisp. Add the steak to the skillet in small batches and continue to cook until browned on the outside and cooked through, about 1 minute per side. Use a slotted spoon to transfer to a plate as it cooks. In the drippings in the pan, add the leek and sliced hot sauce. Cover and cook over medium high heat until softened and beginning to brown, 2 - 3 minutes. Add the tahini and the dill to the sauce and cook until absorbed. Add the browned steak and heat through. Spoon mixture into a warmed bowl and top with enchilada sauce. Serve with fresh green beans and crusty bread, if desired.

title: Chinese Five Spice Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces dried black beans | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 4 ounces chopped dates
instructions: Soak beans in cold water overnight. Drain the soaked beans, and throw away the water. Heat up a fry pan with a bit of oil on a medium. Add the beans and cook them to your liking. Add the rest of the ingredients, except the dates, and cook them until they are warm and the water is gone.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,coriander seed,tea,baby spinach,orange juice,green curry paste,rib eye steak,tomato paste
title: Spinach and Beef Kebobs
ingredients: 3 steaks, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 jar green curry paste | 1 1/4 cups tomato paste | 1 bunch baby spinach | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | 24 ounces fresh tea, steamed and well drained | 2/3 cup orange juice | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine curry paste and tomato paste in small bowl. Coat steak with spice mixture, cover and marinate in refrigerator for 20 minutes. Combine spinach and coriander seeds in microwave safe dish.

title: Peaches in Spiced Meatballs
ingredients: 12 frozen frozen meatballs ( preferably firm, defrosted ) | fresh thyme | 1 -2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 -2 kashmiri chili powder | 1 -2 tablespoon kashmiri chili powder
instructions: In the microwave, put frozen meatballs and microwave on high for 4 minutes. Once frozen, put defrosted meatballs in a bowl. Add thyme, cumin, chili powder, chili powder and mix. Make sure everything is coated properly in the spice mixture. Put meatballs on your table and eat like bread or eat as desired.

Random Ingredients: coffee,beetroot,chicken stock vegetable,jalapeno pepper,cabbage,splenda sugar substitute
title: Spiced Beetroot Soup
ingredients: 1/2 ounce jalapeno peppers or 1/2 ounce serrano pepper, diced | 1/2 ounce canned beets or 1/2 ounce frozen beetroot, diced | 1 ounce shredded cabbage | 1 jalapeno pepper | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute or 1/4 cup sugar | 1/4 cup brewed coffee ( optional )
instructions: Put everything except for the coffee into a large pot. Bring slowly to a full boil over a medium low heat and simmer for 45 minutes. Remove from heat, and cool. Stir in the coffee, if using. Add the cold, blended soup and let rest until the soup is cold enough to handle, usually about an hour depending on how hot your broth is. Ladle hot soup into bowls to serve.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,monterey jack cheese,white flour,yeast,ginger paste,beef bouillon cube,rib eye steak
title: Beef With Chimay Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/4 cup warm beef broth or 1/4 cup warm water | 2 1/2 cups leftover cooked beef, cut in 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons fermented yeast
instructions: Combine flour, ginger paste, bouillon, and warm water.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,serrano pepper,mushroom stem,sun tomato oil,green pepper,bell pepper,chicken bouillon cube
title: Pollo Al Salpicon (Chicken Sausage Rolls)
ingredients: 24 large fresh mushroom stems ( or 8 large rehydrated fresh mushrooms ) | 2 large green peppers, chopped into 1/3 inch cubes | 3 small red peppers or 3 small piquillo peppers, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup finely chopped cilantro leaf | 1/4 cup chopped fresh serrano pepper ( or 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ) | 3/4 cup canned mushroom stems and pieces, drained ( or 1/2 cup drained fresh mushrooms ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( or 1/4 teaspoon chicken flavored bouillon dissolved in 3 tablespoons water ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sun-dried tomato oil
instructions: Make the filling and set aside. Add the mushrooms, peppers, cilantro and chiles to a large bowl. Stir in the chopped garlic and the mushroom filling. Set aside. In a small bowl, mix together the sauce ingredients until heated through. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Fill each mushroom roll with about 1 teaspoon of the stuffing mixture. Dip each roll in the oil and place the wrapped side down on the parchment covered baking sheet. Bake in the middle of the oven for about 25 minutes, turning occasionally, or until heated through. Serve warm.

title: Easy, Quick and Easy Crab Cabbage Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1 lb crabmeat | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/2 lb red cabbage, shredded | taco seasoning
instructions: Heat oil in a pan on medium high heat. Add crab, herbes de provence, cabbage, and salt & pepper to taste. Stir fry for 10 minute. Spoon into bowls and serve with your favorite side dishes.

Random Ingredients: lemon,salami,cinnamon red hot candy,catfish,coconut extract,apricot fruit
title: Grilled Catfish with Sweetened Apricots
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon juice | 2 teaspoons coconut extract | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon stick | 1 package smoked catfish, filets | 1 package salami, slices | 1 package ripe dried apricots in fruit, sliced
instructions: Combine lemon juice, coconut extract, cinnamon stick, catfish filets, salami slices, and apricots in a large resealable plastic bag. Seal bag and turn to coat all sides with marinade. Marinate in refrigerator, turning bag often, 4 hours to overnight. Prepare barbecue for medium high heat, and place grate on grate. Grill catfish, turning once, 7 to 8 minutes for medium, 12 to 14 minutes for medium rare. Brush top grate with 1/4 cup water if desired for added color. Transfer catfish to plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,cream mushroom soup,fontina cheese,beef,cream cheese,hamburger,soymilk
title: Mimi's Cheeseburger Pie With Smoky Swiss Sauce!
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 ounce dried hamburger | 2 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup sifted cream of mushroom soup | 3 spring onions, chopped or 3 green onions | 1 cup shredded fontina cheese | 1/4 cup soymilk or 1/4 cup 1 % low-fat milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Spray a 9 pie dish with cooking spray. In a skillet, brown the ground beef with dried meat and dried onions. Drain off the excess fat. Stir in the cream cheese. In a medium bowl, mix the cream of mushroom soup and soy milk until well blended. Add to the beef mixture in skillet. Mix well. Fill the pie crust with the meat mixture, and sprinkle fontina cheese over it. Bake at 350f degrees for 25 minutes. If desired, you can make a gravy out of the leftover meat mixture and thicken with a bit of cornstarch. Note, if you prefer your crust to be thicker, it can be thickened with water and/or milk.

title: The Best Salsa... Ever!!
ingredients: 2 cans jalapeno peppers ( drained but not chopped ) | 1 cup shredded sweetened coconut
instructions: Finely chop peppers and add to bowl. Add shredded coconut. Mix well. Enjoy i like to bake it just to meld all the flavors together.

title: Tajimi
ingredients: 1 1 lb flank steaks or 1 lb sirloin steak | 1 lb pork or 1 lb beef | 1/2 cup chopped bamboo shoot | 1/2 cup canned dates, cut into thin slices | 2 tablespoons capers | 1/2 cup dates, chopped | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 tablespoon chili paste | cooked rice
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Cut across grain in thin slices. Mix all other ingredients except meat. Marinate meat for up to an hour or more. Arrange meat on serving platter. Spoon some of the marinade along the meat. Serve over hot rice.

title: Spinach With Coconut Aioli
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg fresh baby spinach leaves | 50 g margarine | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Place the coconut aioli and 1/2 cup of water in a large saucepan over a low heat. Cover and cook, stirring now and then but not constantly, for about 10 minutes or until all the water disappears. Add the spinach and cook for a further 3 to 4 minutes or until just tender. Place in a bowl and season with salt if required. Pour the aioli over the spinach just before serving.

title: Capsicum's Cabbage Stew
ingredients: 1 small head of cabbage ( shredded ) | 300 ml chickpea flour | 2 teaspoons tarragon | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) | 1/2 cup white breadcrumbs or 1/2 cup plain breadcrumbs
instructions: Steam in steam basket for 20min at 50 min's, or steam napa cabbage. In food processor or blender, mix all ingredients. The mixture should be quite smooth. You can also use a sieve to do this, but make sure to blend the mixture well and not over blend, or you lose the peppery texture of the cabbage. This tastes even better after making this rather generous quantity. You can also use breadcrumbs or plain breadcrumbs if desired.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,egg beater substitute,american cheese,apple juice,meat chicken
title: Dried Beef Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb dried lean ground meat or 1 lb beef | 1 egg equals 2 egg substitute | vegetable oil cooking spray | all-purpose dried beef hash brown potatoes ( or dumplings for the freezer section of my party ) | 2 slices american cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray baking sheet with veggie oil cooking spray. Combine 2 egg whites and 1st measure of dried beef.

title: Fusion Beans
ingredients: 250 g black-eyed peas | 1 can tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to boil, then reduce heat.

title: Spinach and Shells
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh, chopped spinach | 1/2 cup spanish-style minced onion | 1 package jumbo pasta shells, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Toss together the spinach and onion in a medium baking dish. Cover with noodles and pour spinach mixture over the vegetables. Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the topping is bubbly and the edges of the noodles are tender.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,yam,celery salt,red bliss potato,pie shell
title: Beetroot Potato Potatoes
ingredients: 6 small yams or 6 small white potatoes | walnut oil, for frying | celery salt, for sprinkling or seasoning | 1 pie shell, unbaked
instructions: Heat oil to 375 degrees f. Boil potatoes until just tender, about 20 minutes. Drain on paper towels and place on a cookie sheet/dutch oven. Sprinkle lightly with celery salt and add a small mound of walnut oil. Bake in a 375 degree f oven until deep golden brown, about 15 minutes. Turn potatoes, sprinkle with celery salt and drizzle with a little more virgin olive oil.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,rice wine vinegar,no boil lasagna noodle,hot italian sausage
title: Sausage Ragu
ingredients: 1 box no-boil lasagna noodles | 3/4 lb hot italian sausage | 3 packages cream cheese | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Cook sausage over low heat until it starts to release its liquid. Add cream cheese and vinegar. Cut the sausage into 1x1 pieces and add to mixture. Simmer on low to medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes. In the meantime, cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Remove sausage from heat. Drain noodles and place in the bottom of a 9 x 13 greased pan. In a small bowl, pour a bit of mushroom gravy mix. Spread sauce over the noodles and then top with noodles. Bake in a 300 degree oven for 30 minutes. Allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Baked Honey Marshmallows (Barsi)
ingredients: 1 lb marshmallows | 1/4 cup clear honey ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over low heat, stirring often until marshmallows are melted. Cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,ice cream,accent seasoning,cream mushroom soup,oat
title: Salt Cod Fish
ingredients: 32 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 32 ounces cod fish fillets, rinsed and seasoned | 1 package quick oats | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning | 12 ounces ice cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Arrange fish on baking sheets. Mix the soup with the oats and accent and spread over the fish. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes. Top each fillet with scoop of ice cream, cut into slices, and serve.

title: Tropical Mocktail
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup frozen corn kernels | 1 package firm tofu | 1/3 cup light buttermilk | 1 teaspoon dried marinara sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Combine black eyed peas, corn, and tofu in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours to overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly butternut grill grate. Remove tofu mixture from the cheese sauce and pack it down on skewers. Grill skewers, covered, until hot and cheese is beginning to melt, about 1 minute.

title: Cheats for Kids
ingredients: 2 cups small curds | parmesan cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine curds and parmesan cheese. Use a fork to whisk to mix well. Use fingers to drop pieces of the mixture onto a greased griddle, cook over medium heat for 6 - 8 minutes a side depending on how much moisture your griddle gets.

title: Slow-Cooker Lamb and Snow Pea Rigatoni
ingredients: 2 1/2 kg leg of lamb | 1 1/2 liters snow peas | 2 -3 tablespoons old bay seasoning | 200 g rigatoni pasta
instructions: Trim the fat off the lamb and cut each leg into 2 equal pieces. Cut the snow peas into thick lengths about 4cm long and 2cm wide. Put the lamb and snow peas into a large bowl, sprinkle with old bay and pour over half the water. Cover and chill for 4 hours, or overnight, turning every so often. To cook slowly, put the lamb and snow peas into a large casserole. Top with enough water to just cover meat. Cook in slow cooker for 3 - 4 hours until the meat falls of the bone. Remove the pork from the bones and shred the meat with two forks. Add the meat back to the vegetables and simmer another 12 - 15 minutes. Add the rigatoni and cook for a couple of minutes to heat through. Serve with a mixed salad and plenty more old bay.

Random Ingredients: fish stock,vinegar,italian sausage,kaffir lime leaf,enchilada sauce,oyster,wheat couscous
title: Kaffir-Sausage and Oyster Soup
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1 can oyster | 1 cup whole wheat couscous | 3 -4 cups fish stock, with | fish stock | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Brown sausage and remove from pan. Add the enchilada sauce to sauce pan, and saute the oysters for 3 - 4 minutes. Pour into soup pot along with the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes serve and enjoy.

title: German Mint Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 cup german chocolate, melted | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2 pinches mint ( optional )
instructions: Mix the cornmeal and melted chocolate together, add the vanilla and mint mix well. Pour into lightly greased pie pan. You can put it in a 350 degree oven to bake until top is light brown and the middle is bubbly. You can also spread some whipped cream on top too. Let cool down and enjoy with fresh fruit or chocolate shavings.

title: Easy Sweet Potato & Kiwi Sushi
ingredients: 800 g kiwi, julienned ( or you could use regular kiwi ) | 800 g sweet potatoes, peeled & grated ( just use 1 tin ) | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice
instructions: Steam sweet potato until soft, drain & remove skins. Combine kiwifruit w/sweet potato & pumpkin spice in large bowl. Season with salt & pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: stir fry vegetable,scallop,rose water,fish bouillon,greek yogurt,syrup,provolone cheese,penne pasta
title: Philly Cheese Steak With Scallops
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta | 2/3 cup greek yogurt, plain | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh rose water | 1 pinch fish bouillon | 1/2 lb scallops | 1/2 cup crisp fried vegetables | 12 slices provolone cheese ( thin slices ) | 4 teaspoons syrup
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package. Reserve. In small bowl mix together yogurt, rose water, and bouillon. Set aside. Place scallops on a board. Dredge scallops in yogurt mixture until coated with some of the rose water. Cook on one side. Turn over and repeat until all scallops are coated with yogurt mixture and finished. Divide pasta among 2 plates. Top with swiss cheese slices. Place scallops on top of cheese. Pour yogurt mixture over scallops. Serve.

title: Walnut Dijon Toasted Salsa
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups walnuts ( shelled or raw ) | 5 -7 tablespoons dijon mustard ( depending on how spicy you like it ) | 1 -2 cup sweet salsa
instructions: Preheat oven 450 degrees f. Spread nuts on cookie sheet spread out to toast about 8 - 10 minutes until golden brown. While nuts are toasting, in a small saucepan mix the sweet salsa and dijon mustard together over low heat. Stir constantly stirring until mixture thickens. Toast about 5 - 10 minutes until it begins to bubble up. Remove nuts from pan. Using a slotted spoon, turn nuts over. Spoon hot sauce over nuts. Serve immediately.

title: Eggplant With Ham and Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 3 -4 large eggplants | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 - 3/4 cup raw cashew nuts ( if possible, they must be very chopped ) | 1/2 cup kielbasa ( optional ) | 4 -6 tablespoons butter | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 lb ham meat, thinly sliced
instructions: Preparation. Cut the eggplants lengthwise into approximately 5 inch cubes. Using a vegetable peeler, remove the skin from one side of the eggplant. Using the vegetable peeler, slice off the hard stem sections of the eggplant. With a sharp knife score the eggplant into approximately 3 inch sections. Repeat until all the eggplants are cut into 5 inch pieces. Arrange the pieces in an ovenproof fry pan, preferably nonstick. Cover the baking pan with aluminum foil and bake until light brown and crispy, about 20 minutes. Set oven temperature to 300 degrees f. Cooking. Bake the eggplants, covered with foil for one hour. Turn the oven heat up to 325 degrees f. Add the raisins, cashew nuts, and kielbasa to the eggplants.

Random Ingredients: celery root,chili oil,tomato,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Mexican Inspired Restaurant Dip
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes | 1 small celery root, diced | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 slice monterey jack pepper cheese or 1 slice queso fresco
instructions: Drain the tomatoes and celery root and add to food processor or blender. Add chili oil and blend until smooth. Add cheese in a thin stream until desired thickness. Serve with tortilla chips or with bread.

Random Ingredients: margarine,milk chocolate chip,peach,celery salt,cajun seasoning,asafoetida powder
title: Chilean Peaches With Manchego Churros (Chicken, Peaches and Cream Gravy)
ingredients: 1/4 cup margarine ( becel ) or 1/4 cup butter ( becel ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 cup whole milk chocolate chip | 1 1/4 lbs fresh peaches, peeled, pitted, halved, thinly sliced on the diagonal ( about 12 peach slices )
instructions: Melt the margarine in a small saucepan over medium heat. Remove the pan from the heat. Stir in the asafetida & celery salt & set aside. In a small bowl, mix the coconut with the cheese until creamy. Add the melted chocolate and stir to combine. Place the peach slices in a medium bowl & top with the cheese mixture. Heat oven to place a roasting rack in a shallow roasting pan & set the pan of peaches around the rack. Set the oven to 425 degrees f. Place 2 peach slices under the broiler & broil until the top is puffed & brown. Remove from heat, allow to cool slightly then cut into halves across the length. Drizzle the warmed churros with some of the pan drippings from the roasting pan. Serve immediately.

title: Steak Roll-Ups With Ricotta & Fruit
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless chuck steaks | 4 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons fruit, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons sliced nuts or 2 -3 tablespoons raisins | 1 large bunch fresh broccoli, trimmed and cut into small florets | 1 firm nori, cut into 6 slices
instructions: Pound the marinated steaks between sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap, using a meat mallet or rolling pin, to about 1/4 1/2 in thickness. Set aside. Combine the ricotta and fruit in a small mixing bowl. Chop the broccoli florets, keeping the separate white and green parts. Arrange the white parts on a plate. Spread one side of each steak with half of the ricotta mixture, and sprinkle with nuts or raisins. Starting at the long side, roll up the steak. Tie with kitchen string, then roll in the nori. Repeat with each steak. Chill, covered, for at least 1 hour. To serve, slice the rolls as desired.

title: Taco Truffles (With Brandy)
ingredients: 8 ounces dark chocolate, finely chopped, with a little fat | 4 fluid ounces light cream or 4 fluid ounces cream | 1 fluid ounce light sour cream or 1 fluid ounce light sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1 pinch tahini | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 tablespoon sea salt, extra | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate, finely grated | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: First, make the chocolate filling as follows. Heat a small saucepan over a medium heat and then add the caster sugar and cream, stirring continuously with a wooden spoon. Remove from the heat and add the chocolate and sour cream, stirring continuously to combine. This will take 1 to 2 minutes until very thick. Remove from the heat and add the tahini. Then stir in the sea salt and cocoa. Then gradually add more of the cream, stirring constantly until it starts to thicken. Add the extra cocoa, cocoa and brandy and mix well. Then divide the mixture between 2 small ovenproof dishes and freeze for 6 hours, stirring every so often. To make the truffle filling. Using a sharp knife, slash a hole on the base of each teacup and then insert a heaped teaspoonful of filling into the hole in each. Sprinkle with the grated chocolate.

title: Chef John's Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 2 1/2 cans creamed spinach or ( 10 ounce ) cans mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f, and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the sunflower seeds, xanthan gum, and spinach into a paste. Pour the pesto over the nuts and toss well to combine. Spread onto baking sheet, and bake in preheated oven until thick and darkened, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mexican Steak
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast, trimmed of fat | 3 tablespoons shredded old-fashioned cocoa ( i use hershey's ) | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon shredded cotija cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped italian parsley
instructions: Rub the roast with 1 tablespoon cocoa. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon cocoa. Bake in a 350°f oven for 1 hour. Uncover, sprinkle with cheese, and bake uncovered for an additional 30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,milk,bulk italian sausage,marsala wine,turnip,oyster sauce,tabasco sauce
title: Italian Sausage and Turnips
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 can evaporated milk | 1 can sweetened condensed milk | 1 lb raw small turnip | 1/4 lb fresh egg noodles | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/4 cup marsala wine, cooking wine | 1/3 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 1/3 teaspoon chili sauce
instructions: In saucepan, cook sausage, stirring untill brown, drain. Using a 2 quart cooking pot, add evaporated, condensed milk, turnip and noodles. Add oyster sauce, wine, tabasco or chilli sauce. Cover pot and simmer on low heat for 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup cooked and cubed fresh cod | 1 carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Mix cooked cod, whipped topping, and hot sauce together in large bowl until thoroughly blended.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,leek,silver tequila,plain flour,onion soup mix,capicola,oatmeal
title: Cowherd's Margaritas
ingredients: 2 cups oatmeal | 1 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup silver tequila | 2 tablespoons dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup shaved capicola | 2 leeks, trimmed chopped | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a bowl. Melt margarita sugard by heating oven to 200 degrees celsius. Roll margaritas in oatmeal, place in a dish and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Mix remaining ingredients together, pour over margarita and mix well. Cook until margarita starts to bubble. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,milk,anaheim chilies,rice,cream mushroom soup,cardamom pod,tomato sauce,extra beef
title: Quick Beef and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can evaporated milk | 1 jar chopped pimiento, drained | 2 anaheim chilies, sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 4 cups hot cooked rice, to serve
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Brown the beef and drain excess fat. Add the soup, tomato sauce, evaporated milk, pimento, anaheim chile, ground cardamom. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover, and simmer 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Top with hot rice.

title: Sirloin Fricassee
ingredients: 1 sirloin | cardamom seeds or nutmeg | 1 can beef consomme | salt and pepper

Serve the fricassee over hot rice.

instructions: Preheat oven to 200ºc. Place yoghurt in a small bowl with cardamom pods and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand until mixture is frothy. Remove foil and bake for another 5 minutes, turning the broiler on. Remove from oven and place onto serving plate.

instructions: Place all ingredients in blender container. Cover tightly. Blend until smooth, about 1/2 minute.

instructions: Cut stewing beef into 1 pieces. Prepare noodles according to directions on box. When meat is cooked, dump to stew pot. Add remaining ingredients. If you like your stew thicker use more or less amount you like. Simmer until noodles are tender.

title: Creamy Scallions, Parsley, & Tamari Creme Fraiche

instructions: Using very sharp knife, finely chop scallions, discarding white and green parts of scallions. Drain tamari and tamari well and stir away from any excess moisture. In a large skillet or wok, heat olive oil over medium low heat. Add scallions, stir and fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until scallions lightly turns to translucent. Add tamari, parsley, and cream.

ingredients: 6 baby carrots, quartered lengthwise | 8 ounces can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add carrots and cook 2 - 3 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain well. Add soup and lemon juice and cook until hot.

title: Lamb Shanks

instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Place shanks in a large bowl. Toss with 2 teaspoons pepper and sugar.

title: Rump Steak (Beef Terrine)
ingredients: 4 lbs rump steak | 1/2 cup red wine | 2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin | 1/4 cup dry sherry | plain flour, for dusting
instructions: Slice rump steak into approximately 8 thin slices and set aside. Pour half the wine into a small bowl and sprinkle the gelatin on top. Let sit to soften. Cut the rump steak into approximately 8 pieces. Drain and place in a bowl. Spread the remaining wine and juices in a seperate bowl and pour over the sliced rump steak. Cover and leave in the refrigerator for 5 - 6 hours turning meat twice during this time. Remove meat from the marinade, reserving marinade. Drain meat well and sprinkle with flour. Replace the lid and leave to marinate for one hour. Heat oven to 160c. Remove meat from the refrigerator and arrange in a suitable sized roasting tin. Place roasting tin on oven tray and bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until meat is cooked and dry, basting with the leftover sauce and juices from the bowl from time to time and turning meat over every 5 minutes and adding reserved marinade if needed until meat is cooked and sauce has thickened. Check internal temperature of meat if required. Allow to rest, covered, for 2 - 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: allspice,tamarind pulp,russet potato,madeira wine,cauliflower,lime,wheat pita bread
title: Tamarind Soup With Cauliflower & Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp | 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 1/2 onion, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower, finely chopped | 1/4 cup whole wheat pita bread | 1 pinch allspice | 3 slices limes
instructions: Pour 1/2 tbsp tamarind pulp in medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add 1/2 cup madeira. Heat over low flame. Add onion, cauliflower, pita. Add allspice. Cover with thick cloth. Keep on low flame. Leave for 2 minutes. Remove the cloth. Cut the cabbage into small pieces. Open up the mixture using a spoon. Add it to the soup. Garnish with lime slices.

title: Easy Homemade Yogurt
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl or food processor. Process until smooth. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: aluminum foil,date,dark rum,salt pork,baking powder,celery seed,chorizo sausage,black pepper
title: Caribbean Chile Chorizo Pizzas With Stale
ingredients: 2 chorizo sausage, sliced ( pork, or sausage substitute ) | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons gin ( optional ) | 3 1/2 cups finely ground peeled chorizo sausage | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped celery seed | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon salt | 3 tablespoons coarsely crumbled aluminum foil | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped pitted dates ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Line 3 pizza pans or rimmed baking sheets with the parchment paper. In a nonstick skillet, heat the chorizo over medium heat until well browned, breaking it into 1/4 inch pieces. Remove from heat and allow to cool, then crumble the chorizo. Add the black pepper to the chorizo and stir to combine. Drain off excess fat. Stir in the rum, if using, and set aside. In a medium bowl, mix the chorizo and celery seed with the coarsely ground chorizo mixture and stir to combine. Stir in the baking powder and salt and mix to combine. Spray both sides of 2 pizza pans or 12 standard pizza pans with nonstick cooking spray. Brush each pizza with the chorizo and chorizo mixture, then using tongs, spread the chorizo/chorizo mixture evenly onto the pizza. Place on the prepared baking sheets about 2 inches apart. Brush each pizza with the chorizo and chorizo mixture. Using your hands, spread the remaining chorizo mixture over the top of each pizza. If desired, top with the coarsely chopped dates. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.

title: Fish with Orange Chili Glaze
ingredients: 4 smoked bratwursts | 2 tablespoons lard | 12 cherry rolls | 12 oranges, juice concentrate of | 1/2 liter lard | 200 g canned orange juice concentrate | 1/2 lb halibut fillet | nutmeg
instructions: Fry bratwurst in hot lard until cooked, remove and set aside. Wash and dry the cherries, reserve juice for later. Combine the juice concentrate with the lard and orange juice concentrate, bring to boil and pour over the bratwurst and cherries. Put bratwurst back in sauce and let simmer for 5 minutes. Add the halibut and cook for 5 more minutes. Remove from heat and garnish with chopped nuts.

title: Poached Pears With Feta
ingredients: 3 pears ( a la vasca ) | 1/3 cup dashi | 1/2 cup parsley, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried ginger or 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, minced | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1 1/3 cups ice water | 2/3 cup dashi | 1/4 cup fat-free greek seasoning | 2 cups tart apples or 2 cups other firm apples | 2/3 cup shelled unsalted shelled pignachios
instructions: Cook the pears over medium heat in 2 tablespoons dashi, stirring until they turn a pale golden color. Remove from the heat and reserve. Place the pears in a small saucepan along with the parsley, ginger, and 1 teaspoon greek seasoning. Add the 1/3 cup water, cover and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and add the rest of the dashi, greek seasoning, and 2/3 cup water. Cool the mixture, covered for at least 1 hour. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Working in batches of 6 - 7 pears, place the pears, cut side down, in a large skillet. Cook about 3 minutes, turn, and cook for a few more minutes. Remove and place pears in the skillet. Repeat with remaining pears. Remove the pan from the heat and add the apple slices. Mix thoroughly. To serve, place the pears on a large platter, with the bread on the side. Remove the bread.

title: Sausage and Apricots
ingredients: 8 ounces hot pack sausages ( or any sausage of your choice, i've used turkey too ) | monterey jack cheese or cheddar cheese, grated | 12 apricots, halved and pitted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the sausages in a 9 x13 baking dish. Sprinkle with a bit of cheese. Place 3 apricots on top and sprinkle a little more cheese over that. Cover with a layer of the sausages and repeat with the remaining bread. Cook for about 30 minutes. Let cool slightly and serve.

title: Artichoke, Leek and Arugula
ingredients: 4 artichoke hearts, halved | 2 leeks, white part only, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 2 bay leaves, crumbled | 1/4 cup arugula ( to garnish ) or 1/4 cup iceberg lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut artichoke hearts in half lengthwise, and cut into slices that are 1/4 inch thick. Place in a baking dish and pour on just enough water to cover them completely. Bake for 30 minutes, until tender. Remove from the oven and toss the leeks with all of the lime juice and zest. Put the artichoke heart back in the oven and continue baking for another 10 minutes. When cool enough to handle, slice thinly into quarters and arrange the slices on serving platter or plates. Sprinkle with crumbled bay leaves and garnish with arugula or lettuce.

title: Marinated Feta Salad
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 -6 lettuce, mixed salad greens
instructions: Finely chop the mint and mix together with the minced/chopped feta.

title: Muesli With Grilled Vegetables
ingredients: 2 ounces porridge oats | 2 ounces flour tortillas | 8 ounces yellow squash, sliced | 1 ounce carrot, sliced | 1 cup unsweetened apple juice | 2 tablespoons yoghurt
instructions: Place the oats in a medium size bowl and mix in the flour. Mix in the vegetable of your choice, grated carrot can also be used. Mix the apple juice and yoghurt together and pour over the vegetables. Cover and leave to stand in the marinade for 45 minutes or longer. Place the tortillas on a greased or lined baking sheet and grill them for 8 minutes or until they are browned and crisp, turning once. Serve them with a side of warm muesli.

title: Smoor Kebab
ingredients: 300 g chuck, cut into slices | cooking spray, as needed | 6 cardamom pods | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup quick oatmeal, soaked in water | 125 g chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 egg whites, beaten | 1/4 cup white vermouth | 500 g fish fillets ( fresh or raw )
instructions: Soak the noodles and fish in water at least 15 minutes, and longer if time permits. Taste and adjust the seasoning, and stir in the meat. Preheat the broiler to high.

title: Comforting Leftover Roast Beef and Potato Meal
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb rib of beef | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs leftover cooked white potatoes ( can also use leftover roast beef and onions ) | 2 packages country-style assorted boneless chicken pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Cut leftover roast beef into thin slices about half inch thick. Add slices to a deep roasting pan. Add leftover potatoes to the bottom of the pan. Cover with leftover roast beef and onion mixture. Roast for 40 minutes per pound/rowat times.. Place roast beef and potatoes into a large bowl to serve. Garnish with additional fresh veggies and fresh parsley or dill..

title: Phyllo Beef Rolls
ingredients: 12 ounces beef sirloin steak | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 onions, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thyme | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 1/2 cups bread dough, or as desired | 1 tablespoon onion powder, or more to taste
instructions: Place beef steaks and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt in a stockpot large enough to contain them. Broil the rolls in the preheated oven until golden brown.

instructions: Place the shrimp paste, sherry and about 1 1/2 quarts water in a large, heavy saucepan and bring to a boil over medium low heat. Add the shrimp, reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the shrimp is bright pink and no longer transparent, about 5 minutes.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. In a medium bowl, mix together matzo meal, enchilada sauce, pistachios, and cajun seasoning. Spread onto prepared baking sheet. instructions: Combine wine, prunes, gorgonzola, honey, cinnamon and oil in a serving bowl. Stir well and then refrigerate, covered, at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Remove the bowl from the refrigerator 10 minutes before serving.

instructions: Preheat grill pan. Place each fish in a bowl, add a small piece of fish on top and a wedge of lemon or lime wedge. Add the tomatoes and bring to boil, then reduce to simmer. To serve spoon the tomato mixture into bowls, add prawns, prawns and vegetables and a little warm water if necessary.

instructions: Boil a pot of water and add the butter beans to it, just until softened, but not boiling hot. Drain, and return to the pan. Add in the onion soup mix, spinach and gravy. Heat through. Tip the contents of the pot onto the spinach, so it doesn't burn, add more gravy if you need it.

title: Bali Pepper-Rubbed Beef
ingredients: 1 cup cubanelle peppers or 1 cup bell pepper, cut into cubes | 2 2 lbs beef roast or 2 lbs pork roast, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Place cubed meat and peppers in a large, resealable plastic bag. Toss well.

title: Aniseed Fish
ingredients: 1/2 kg whole fish ( whole gutted ) | 1/2 kg small polish sausage ( or other flavorful sausage ) | 12 small dried herbes ( about 2-3 leaves in dried s ) | 2 tablespoons anise seeds | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Cut the fish up into chunks and soak in plenty of cold water for 1 hour. Boil in plenty of water for 20 minutes, drain and run over scales to remove any brine. Cut the sausage into long narrow strips and slit the vanilla bean length wise. Slightly open up the gutted fish, using a sharp knife, take out the meat and remove any bones. Cut up the sausage. Cut into chunks. Place all the meat in a large bowl. Wash your hands well with water and cut the paste paste very fine you should get 1 1/2 cm pieces of fish with each bite. Sprinkle the paste all over the fish. Add the chopped sausage and any herbs you were using. Add the flavouring and mix well. Pour the mixture into the fish and stir it gently to coat it thoroughly. Cover and leave in a cool place for 1 hour to set. To serve open the fish out and use a small spoon or a plastic bag to pull the flesh apart into smaller bits. Scatter the herbs around and serve with yoghurt or yogurt.

title: Italian Style Pizza Sauce

instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl or storage container. Pour sauce into a freezer safe container, label and freeze. Boil 10 minutes or until reduced to desired consistency.

title: Korean Vegetarian Dipping Sauce(Rimjangjang)

instructions: Combine all ingredients and let stand 15 - 20 minutes or longer.

ingredients: 1 cup fine ground coffee ( good quality coffee, strong tea, hot espresso or lukewarm ) | 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed
instructions: Place the coffee, salt, and cumin seeds together in a heavy pan. Add 4 cups cold water, stir to blend very well. Cover and cook over moderate heat for 3 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and let steep for 20 to 45 minutes more. Strain through a tea strainer into a glass jar or a coffee filter pitcher, and store in a cool dark place for up to 2 weeks.

title: Tortellini Wrapped Pork Chops for Two
ingredients: 8 ounces dried tortellini, cooked as per package directions | 6 ounces pork loin chops or 6 ounces roast pork, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook pork until lightly browned, remove from pan and set aside. Cook tortellini in 3 qts. Pot of boiling water, as directed on package. Meanwhile, sprinkle each side of pork with half a teaspoon of salt & half the freshly ground black pepper. Top with one third of the warm tortellini. Arrange another third of the pork slices, in a overlapping fashion, on top and press gently. Repeat with remaining pork and tortellini. Pour any remaining liquid into the pan. Remove the pan from the heat.

title: Watermelon Rind With Rinsed Rice Vinegar

instructions: Place the rice vinegar in a heat resistant bowl or plate.

instructions: Clean duck, and wash all the way to the edges. Trim off the excess fat, cut into 6 - 8 pieces. Blanch in boiling water for about three minutes. Drain, and set aside. Chop all vegetables and mix with 1/4 of the cocoa powder and 1 package of graham crackers. Place the duck ontop of the cheese, cover with foil and bake in a 350 degree oven for 1 hour.

title: Oatmeal for Kids

instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender in a microwave proof bowl. Cover and heat in microwave on high until the oats are cooked.

instructions: Preheat an oven to 200 degrees f. Lay the ham onto a baking sheet and cover with the bacon slices. Bake in the preheated oven until bacon are browned, 12 to 15 minutes.
