ingredients: 4 bunches swiss chard | 1 package fresh udon noodles, broken into pieces
instructions: Place the chard leaves in a large serving bowl. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the udon until tender but still firm, about 11 minutes. Drain and let cool to room temperature. Rinse the chard and pat dry with paper towels. Toss with the noodles. Garnish with scallion and red pepper flakes.

title: Oaxacan Cheese
ingredients: 500 g feta | 2 -3 tablespoons anchovy paste
instructions: You need enough to generously cover the bottom of a large sized pot. The anchovy paste needs to be packed into the feta, otherwise it will become bitter and unpleasant before you get it out of the pot. Soak out the anchovy paste. Slice the cheese into cubes about 4 5cm x 3 5cm. Boil off any excess water with the anchovy paste. Place on top of a hot tap and let simmer for 15 minutes. Do not overcook the cheese, and do not add any oil or sugar. Remove from heat, let cool, and serve.

title: Kielbasa in the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut in 1/2 inch pieces | 7 -8 uncooked lasagna noodles, uncooked
instructions: Add kielbasa to the slow cooker. Sprinkle with 1/4 to 1/2 the entire amount of kosher salt. Add another 1/8 to 1/2 of kosher salt. Add 7 to 8 uncooked noodles. If it looks dry after 3 - 4 hours, add 1 more cup of water. Cook on low 10 - 15 minutes. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve with cheese, if desired, or any other desired toppings.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,amaretto,leek,parmesan cheese,walnut oil,green peppercorn,yellow potato,sugar
title: Grilled Potato Leek Peppercorn Sweet Pepper Hash
ingredients: 4 medium yellow potatoes | 1 large leek, white part only, white part only, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 1 large green bell pepper, stemmed, halved lengthwise and quartered crosswise | 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 1 teaspoon coarsely ground green peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely ground amaretto | 1/4 teaspoon coarsely chopped green peppercorn | 1/4 teaspoon coarsely chopped kosher salt or 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 3 tablespoons granulated sugar
instructions: Preheat grill for direct heat. Toss potatoes with leek chunks, green pepper halves, oil, green peppercorns, amaretto, green peppercorns and salt and let sit 5 minutes. Place on grate over medium heat and grill 4 minutes, turning once, until vegetables are tender and peppercorns are darkened and fragrant. Taste for seasoning, adding more salt and sugar as needed. Set aside on foil. When ready to serve, mound hash on platter or plate and drizzle with reserved peanut oil and green peppercorns. Serve immediately.

title: Blueberry Zucchini and Courgette Gratin
ingredients: 1 cup blueberries | 3 small courgettes, cut into 1cm chunks | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200c/400°f. Place the blueberries, courgettes and lemon rind in a ceramic pie dish. Add enough boiling water to just cover and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 30 minutes until the fruit is tender and the sauce is syrupy.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,basmati rice,colby monterey jack cheese,sumac,purple yam,butter bud
title: Eating Well
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 1/2 teaspoon salt pork, minced ( optional ) | 1 purple yam, peeled and diced | 1 container butter buds, diced | 1/4 cup grated colby-monterey jack cheese, plus | more colby-monterey jack cheese or provolone cheese
instructions: Wash and rinse the rice well, picking out any stray rice grains. Dry the rice and set aside. If using saute'd pork, brown lightly over medium heat in a small skillet. Add the diced yellowum about 5 minutes or until soft and lightly cooked. Transfer to a large bowl. Add 1/4 cup cheese and 3 tablespoons butter to saute'd pork and mix well. In a separate bowl, mash 1/4 cup of cheese into the saute'd yam and then add to the bowl with the rice. Pour pork/yam mixture over rice and mix well. Transfer mixture to a buttered 9x13 baking dish. Sprinkle top with remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Bake at 475 degrees farenheit for 25 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly and begins to brown in the middle. Cool for 20 minutes before removing from the pan. The mixture should still be wobbly in the middle, but not runny. Slice when ready to eat. Enjoy note, i think this is a very nice vegetable dish for a quick lunch or dinner on the afternoon.

Random Ingredients: salt,bay seasoning,salt black pepper,dill,corn oil,italian seasoning
title: Easy Herb Biscuits for Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh dill | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons salt ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning ( or use similar seasoning ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: To make the biscuit crumbs.

title: Sauce' in Roomsaus
ingredients: 3/4 cup icing sugar | 4 cups half-and-half | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh parsley sprig
instructions: Prepare'simply icing' by mixing sugar, 1/2 cup half and half and chopped fresh parsley in a cup. Stir well with a wooden spoon and pour into hot, sterilized mason jars, wipe top and seal. Refrigerate for at least 2 days before using.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,thyme leaf,coconut oil,vegetable oil cooking spray,vinegar
title: Crispy French Fries (Low Fat)
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup coconut oil | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon vinegar or 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray.

title: Mexico Chorizo (Grilled Potato Chips from the Microwave)
ingredients: 6 potatoes, peeled ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons pickles, minced ( fresh or prepared ) | 4 teaspoons canned green chili peppers, minced ( with seeds ) | pepper, to taste
instructions: Cut the potatoes lengthwise into 8 wedges. In a bowl, mix the pickles, chile pepper, and pepper with half of the oil until everything is well combined. Place 4 wedges of potato on a work surface and pat them flat with a towel. Arrange the wedges on a grill pan. Grill 5 - 10 minutes, or until the chips are browned and crisp on the top. Remove and let stand covered with a sheet of aluminum foil for 5 minutes before eating. If you want to serve the chipas warm, let them sit at room temperature or in the refrigerator for an hour before serving at room temperature. To serve the guacamole, heat the remaining 1 t oil in a skillet over medium heat. When the oil is very hot, add 1/4 of the grated potatoes and let them cook 3 - 4 minutes, or until potatoes start to brown on all sides. The potatoes should be a little crisp on the outside. Remove potatoes from the skillet with a slotted spoon and transfer to a large serving platter. Spread the chipotle guacamole on top and serve. The guacamole can be easily multiplied or you can eat it on the same platter.

title: Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin ( the thinner and slower you cut and the more tenderloin it will be, 1 lb. ) | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( i use this zesty lemon zest, it helps a lot )
instructions: Cut the pork fillets into thick slices about 1 1/2 thick. Soak the fillets in a large bowl with about 1/4 cup water for 10 minutes. Drain water. Pat the fillets dry with paper towels. Coat the fillets with a thin layer of oil. In a small bowl combine the yogurt and lemon juice, stir until blended and set aside. Heat the remaining 3 - 4 t oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle the pork with the zest, place into the skillet and cook, turning once, until both sides of the pork are golden brown and the inside of the pork registers 160 degrees f, 5 to 10 minutes serve.

title: Rigatoni with Poblano, Orange, and Rice
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain rice | 1 small bunch poblano chiles or 1 small other mild hot pepper, chopped | 1 orange, zested, divided | sea salt | 1 1/4 lbs rigatoni pasta, cooked
instructions: Cook the rice, stirring often, until it begins to soften, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, steam the poblano for 6 to 8 minutes, or until it collapses around the knife. Stir the chiles through the rice mixture, stir in 1 orange zest and 1/4 cup of the orange zest. Drain the pasta and toss with remaining 1/2 cup orange zest. Transfer rice to a salad bowl with remaining 1/4 cup orange zest, remaining 1/2 cup orange juice, more sea salt to taste, and pinch of salt, if needed. Let cool completely before cutting.

Random Ingredients: red onion,habanero pepper,golden raisin,egg,sirloin steak,nonfat milk,graham cracker crumb,cooking spray
title: Mildly Sweet Steak and Raisin Burgers
ingredients: 1 package ground sirloin steak | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/3 cup golden raisins, chopped | 1/4 cup grated red onion | 1 small habanero pepper, seeded and chopped | 3 tablespoons nonfat milk | 1 large egg, lightly beaten | cooking spray
instructions: Heat coals in a gas grill or broiler pan set 5 to 7 inches from heat. In a medium bowl, combine sirloin, graham cracker crumbs, raisins, red onion, and habanero. Stir in milk, egg, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Shape into 4 patties. Lightly spray cooking oil on grate. Place burgers on grate and cook for 3 to 5 minutes per side, turning once. Serve warm.

title: Spinach Chapli Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 2 lbs fresh spinach leaves ( or more, about 10 oz. ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon lemon, juice of, freshly squeezed | 8 whole cloves | 8 tablespoons matzo | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine lime juice and all the remaining ingredients and pour over the spinach. Toss well, cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. After 1 hour, toss again and let stand for 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving bowl, sprinkle with cayenne if using and serve hot.

title: Irish Lamb Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 2/3 cup irish whiskey | 2/3 cup rice wine | 1/3 cup irish-style whiskey | 1/2 lb boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: In a large, nonreactive bowl, toss lettuce with whiskey. Stir in whiskey. Add lamb. Toss gently. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 tablespoon guacamole | 1 yellow squash, quartered lengthwise and cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat. Place squash slices on a small baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Let stand 20 minutes. Remove from grill. Brush squash with guacamole and grill 3 to 5 minutes or until tender, turning 2 to 3 times. Serve with sour cream and salsa.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,tomato paste,nicoise olive,maraschino cherry,mustard,olive,ginger garlic paste
title: Pasta With Sassani Olives
ingredients: 1 package maraschino cherries | 2 cups nicoise olives, pitted | 8 ounces tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sliced ripe olives
instructions: Drain the cherries, reserving the cherries. In a small pot, bring enough water to cover the cherries to a boil and cook for 30 seconds to 1 minute. Place the cherries in ice water, drain. Place drained cherries in a sieve or collander and rinse. Chop the pitted olives. Place the remaining ingredients in a saucepan with 1/4 cup of the reserved cherries and the water. Heat on medium heat until the tomato paste and ginger garlic paste are well blended and heated through, about 1 minute. Do not let boil. Do not let it boil, so as to not have a bio hazard for later. When the tomatoes have released their juice, add the cherry tomatoes. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 18 minutes. Stir in the cherries, return to the boil and add the olives. Simmer 2 - 3 minutes more. Serve over pasta and top with the grated parmigiano reggiano cheese.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,black bean,mint,dark chocolate,lobster meat,plain flour,pizza sauce,brown lentil
title: Lobster & Black Bean Casserole
ingredients: 420 g smoked lobster meat, chopped | 250 g soft brown lentils | 125 g dark chocolate, chopped | 200 g plain flour | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 60 g pizza sauce | 400 g pitted black beans, drained | 1 large tortilla, halved and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Spray a 20 hole shallow 2 cup capacity ovenproof dish with cooking spray and line with nonstick baking or parchment paper. Combine the lobster, lentils and chocolate in a large saucepan over low heat, stirring until the chocolate is melted, then remove from the heat. Add the flour and mint and stir to combine. Spoon half of the bean mix into the prepared dish followed by half the lobster, half the black beans, and half the tortilla. Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining bean mix, spreading the pizza sauce on top. Spray a 20 hole shallow 1 cup capacity ovenproof dish with cooking spray, then scatter evenly with the remaining tortilla. Bake for 1 hours until the topping is set and well browned. Serve hot with extra pizza sauce.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,lemon peel,beef shank,beef chuck,sambal oelek,water,rye flour,sherry wine
title: Zweibelkuchen
ingredients: 3 lbs beef shank | 6 slices lemon peel | 1 -2 teaspoon sambal oelek ( to taste ) | 4 -6 lbs beef chuck, of your choice | 1 onion soup mix ( kikkoman ) | 1 1/2 cups sherry wine | 2 tablespoons rau kong kooli japanese curry powder ( do not substitute, use more sauce to your own taste. ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Cut shank into cubes and remove the strings. Cut into chunks and put aside. Mix sambal powder and onion soup mix together. In a large pot or dutch oven arrange the shank chunks and sherry. Pour in the sherry mixture and add the cubes of beef. Cover and bring the liquid to a boil. Simmer with the lid on for about 2 hours. After 2 hours remove the shank, place on a large serving platter and set aside. Pour off as much fat as possible from the pot, removing as much as possible. Place the pot over high heat, add the lemon peel, sambal soup mix, and water. Bring to a boil. When this boils reduce heat. Cover and simmer for another 2 hours over low heat. Remove the lemon peel, sambal powder, and pork and discard the lemon peel. Use a slotted spoon to spoon the juice from the pot through a sieve into a bowl. Discard solids. Return juice to pot. Pour juices into a saucepan and heat over low heat. Cook, uncovered, for 1 hour. Remove as much solids as possible and discard. Reheat the juice and serve over noodles or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,anchovy fillet,pepperoni,natural peanut butter,kalamata olive
title: S'mores Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup natural-style peanut butter | 1 ounce poppy seed | 1 ounce kalamata olives, pitted and rinsed | 2 anchovy fillets, chopped or 2 anchovy fillets, chopped | pepperoni, slices for topping ( optional )
instructions: Spread all ingredients in a small bowl or on pizza crusts in a medium size dish. Cut pizza dough into 4 to 6 pieces. Arrange on tray/stone. Top with toppings. Use as desired. Variation, i have also used bacon pieces and shredded chicken. Try adding shredded cheese on top of these, too.

title: Ricotta and Rosemary Bread
ingredients: 1 large fresh rosemary sprig | 1 container ricotta cheese | 1 loaf frozen bread, thawed
instructions: Finely chop enough rosemary to coat a 9x5x3 inch loaf. Place the remaining 3 rosemary in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the frozen bread on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until well browned, about 10 minutes, and spread the ricotta over the bread. Return to oven and bake until the top is lightly golden, about 10 more minutes.

title: Chinese Beef and Pineapple
ingredients: 10 ounces beef broth | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 1 celery rib
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot. Cover and cook on high for 10 minutes. Turn to low heat and allow to simmer for 2 - 3 hours. Serve over noodles.

title: Mustard Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons good quality mustard | 1 cup raisins | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in jar. Keep refrigerated for up to 2 weeks. This glaze will last several weeks in the U. S. Keeps well.

title: Healthy Apple Pie Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup bulgur wheat | 1 pizza crust ( store bought or homemade, the kind the crust usually comes in ) | 1 apple, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix bulgur, grated apple, and optional ingredients into a smooth dough. Put onto your favourite pizza crust. Add extra toppings if necessary, such as onion rings, basil, cheese, etc. Enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,pork roast,bread,vidalia onion,fennel,snow pea,mango,rice vinegar
title: Mango Pork Stew
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless pork roast, cubed | 1/3 cup seasoned rice vinegar | 1/3 cup mango, chopped ( optional ) | 1/3 cup fennel, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup yellow squash, diced | 1/2 cup yellow squash, cubed | 1/4 cup onion, diced | 4 cups fresh bread, cubed | 1 1/2 cups snow peas, cut into thirds
instructions: Place cubed pork in a large crock. Cover with seasoned rice vinegar. Cover, and refrigerate 2 hours. Bring to a boil and add diced mango, fennel, yellow squash, yellow squash, onion and bread. Cover, and simmer one hour. Stir. Simmer 10 minutes more, and then stir in snow peas.

title: Pasta with Vanilla and Vanilla
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry rigatoni pasta | 2 tablespoons dried vanilla beans
instructions: Cook rigatoni pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine vanilla beans and vanilla pepper flakes in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. When pasta is almost done cooking, drain pasta and blend with vanilla mixture.

title: Cranberry Salsa Mix (Sushi)
ingredients: 1/4 cup canned bamboo shoot | 1/4 cup canned green onion | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 3 tablespoons mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 2 tablespoons green onions, thinly sliced
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender. Cover and blend at high speed until mixed well and smooth. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes to chill. Note, this salsa is excellent served chilled and reheated just right before serving. Pour into shallow serving bowl. Pour salsa over top and garnish with additional chopped green onions. Serve with hot saki or soy or other meat and vegetables to taste.

title: Roasted Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret | 8 -10 hazelnuts, roasted | 1/2 cup mustard oil | 2 lemons, peel of
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut cauliflower into small florets. Toss the cauliflower florets with olive oil, the lemon peel and salt and pepper to taste. Roast in oven for 20 to 30 minutes until they are tender. Serve with lemon wedges and parsley.

title: Tender Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder roast | 3 tablespoons fresh gingerroot | 3 tablespoons dried ripe olives
instructions: Trim fat and cut 4 x 2 inch pieces from the surface of your pork shoulder roast. Sprinkle the roast lightly with ginger and set aside. Spread olives on the underside of the roast. Place 1 piece of pork roast on top of the olives. Roll up the roast.

title: Broccolini With Chiles and Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 lb broccoli floret | 1 poblano chile, halved and seeds removed | 1/2 cup broccolini ( fresh or frozen, each about 3 inches long )
instructions: Remove stems from broccoli stems and cut in 1/2 inch lengths. Boil or steam broccoli until barely tender. Drain. Cut stems into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Combine broccoli with chiles and 1/2 cup of the water used to cook the broccoli in. Mix well. Cover and bring to boil over medium heat, cover. Cook 15 minutes or until done.

title: French Bread with the Croutons
ingredients: 3 cups bread ( multigrain french bread, loaf or normal brioche buns ) | 1 teaspoon white yeast
instructions: You don't need to knead the dough, and it takes several minutes if using a bread machine to do so. When dough is almost doubled in size, place the dough on a clean surface, and lightly stretch with fingers to make it into a 6 - 7 inch diameter loaf. Cover the loaf and let rise at room temperature until doubled in size, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 deg. Mix the ingredients for the croutons together. Dry the croutons by placing them on a baking sheet lined with parchment or lightly oiled. Bake in the lower half of the oven for about 20 minutes, or until bread begins to turn golden.

title: Pepper Steak (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 12 ounces beef steak, cut into 1 1/2 in cubes ( or 6oz each beef ) | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon of your favourite steak spice ( i use mrs. dash beef seasoning spice mix )
instructions: Put the beef into a small pan & add worcestershire & steak spice. Stir to coat beef & allow to sit 5 - 10 minutes. Put everything into your crock pot. Cover & cook on low heat.

Random Ingredients: cashew,flour tortilla,cardamom pod,shaoxing wine,apricot preserve,apricot jam,creme fraiche
title: Dried Apricot Bacon Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 lb crispy bacon ( the kind with most fat and sinew left on it ) or 1 lb pancetta ( the kind with most sinew left on it ) | 1/2 cup crispy fried apricots ( a good one! ) or 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 6 soft 8-inch flour tortillas | 3 tablespoons cashews, crushed | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 2 teaspoons shaoxing wine, for dipping
instructions: In a skillet, cook the bacon until evenly browned and crisp, about 10 minutes each side. Remove the bacon from the pan with a slotted spoon to a plate lined with paper towels. Add the apricots to the drippings in the frying pan, and fry until lightly brown in color and tender, about 5 minutes. Set aside. Pre heat oven to 350°f. Spread 1 tablespoon of cashew crumbs on the center of each tortilla, and roll up the tortillas tightly. Cut each bacon roll up crosswise into 6 - 8 pieces, about 3 - 4 per tortilla. Arrange the rolled bananas, seam side down, in a lightly greased glass baking dish. In a bowl, mix together the creme fraiche, creme friche and red wine. Pour the mixture over the bananas so the cream does not separate. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until crisp and hot through.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,chili powder,garlic clove,chili garlic sauce,crab
title: Chili Crab Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb crab ( preferably imitation lobster ) | 1/2 vanilla bean, split | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Remove shell from crab if preferred. Break crab up into pieces and place in serving bowl. Add all other ingredients and stir well, making sure that each ingredient is mixed well. Cover loosely with lid and chill in fridge. Can be served the next day, it tastes better after refrigerating for a couple of days.

title: Pear Cracker Cookies (Appetizer)
ingredients: 5 pears | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: Cut a large hole in the top of each pear. With a spoon, hollow out the core of the pears and discard. Roughly chop the pears and place in the bowl of the blender. With your hands, press the mixture into 1 1/2 inch rounds or 8 inch squares using about 1 1/2 inch of dough per pear. Roll the pears up into little round sausages about 1 inch thick. Spraying with a little baking soda near the top while they are baking make sure each pears are coated in baking soda and store in the fridge until ready to use.

title: Curried Oat
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking rolled oats | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 dried chilies, seeds removed | 1/4 cup wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f. Put the oats in a large baking dish and toast in the preheated oven for 5 minutes. Heat the mustard seeds in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in curry powder and dried chilies.

title: Green Beans With Dill
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans or 1 lb spinach | 2 lemons, juice of | 1 tablespoon dried dill
instructions: Snap beans into large pieces and boil for 2 minute. Turn off heat, dump into bowl with lemon juice. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hrs. Drain beans, discard salt. Stir in dill. Serve warm.

title: Nigella Lawson Squash and Hazelnut Ragu
ingredients: 600 g squash, peeled cut lengthways into 1/4-inch thick slices ( about 2 1/4 pounds ) | cooking spray or olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder or 1 1/2 tablespoons dark cooking chocolate | 1 1/2 tablespoons cumin seeds, toasted and crushed | 2 1/2 cups rigatoni pasta, such as rotelle or 2 1/2 cups spirals pasta, cooked and well drained
instructions: Combine the squash and enough water, so that the squash is just covered with water, to cover. Bring to the boil. Boil for 10 minutes or until the squash is very tender. Drain and set aside. In a small frying pan, heat the remaining cooking oil. Add the cumin seeds and stir fry for 1 minute or until the cumin is fragrant and the seeds are sizzling. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the seeds to a plate. Melt the chocolate in a small saucepan, then stir in the roasted cumin. Stir the hot chocolate into the squash. To serve, place a tablespoon of ragu in the centre of each plate. Spoon in the squash and stir well. Arrange the ragu around the bowl.

title: Soupe Au Carne
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 1/2 pounds baby carrots
instructions: Heat the stock in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the carrots, season with salt and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Ligurian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups sour cream | 1 bottle cherry
instructions: Cook rigatoni al dente. In mixing bowl, mix sour cream with cold water, add to rigatoni al dente. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Garlicky Ghee
ingredients: 3 ounces serrano peppers, chopped | 5 ounces golden caster sugar, chopped
instructions: Grind the serrano chilies with the sugar in a mortar. Stir in the ghee to make a stiff paste. Store in the refrigerator. Variation, add 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon for each tablespoon of ghee and sugar. Variation, add 1 tablespoon cardamom powder for each tablespoon of ghee and sugar.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,ramen noodle,russet potato,graham cracker crumb,beef chuck,leek,catsup,taco seasoning
title: Lemon Noodle Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs lean ground beef chuck | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup chopped leeks or 1/4 cup onion | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1 package instant ramen noodles, broken in half | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup crushed graham crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In 3 1/2 quart dutch oven cook ground chuck, soup, taco seasoning, and noodles until meat is no longer pink, drain off any excess liquid. Add meat mixture, mix well, remove from heat. In small bowl combine cracker crumbs and crumbs. Spray 13 x 9 inch baking dish with non stick cooking spray, spread crumb mixture evenly in dutch oven. Reserve 1 cup for topping. Ladle meat mixture over cracker mixture and sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Top with reserved crumbs and crushed graham crackers, bake an additional 15 minutes serve.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile pepper,dark chocolate,cooking spray,quince,thyme,yellow bell pepper,honey,peanut butter
title: Chocolate Chipotle Pepper Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 teaspoon minced fresh thyme | 1 teaspoon minced chipotle chile pepper | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking spray | 2 yellow bell peppers, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1 large red bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | 2 teaspoons coarsely chopped unsalted dry-roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Mix peanut butter, honey, thyme, chipotle pepper, and about two teaspoons of the oil at medium speed in a medium bowl until smooth. Fold 1 tablespoon of the peanut butter mixture into the peanut sauce until just combined. Spoon a tablespoon at a time of the peanut butter mixture on a work surface and spread with a spatula. Arrange the yellow pepper strips on top and then arrange the red pepper strips on top, pressing a bit into the pepper strips. Sprinkle the remaining tablespoon peanut butter mixture evenly over the yellow pepper mixture and use the spatula to spread evenly with a spatula. Spread the remaining 2 teaspoons peanut butter mixture evenly over the whole mixture. Using the spatula, transfer the quesadillas to a baking sheet and press lightly with the back of a fork until smooth and lightly golden. Bake for about 6 minutes or until crisp and melted. Transfer to a plate, cut into 4 wedges, drizzle with remaining oil, and sprinkle with peanuts. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,green chili pepper,lamb shoulder,english cucumber,black eyed pea,garlic granule
title: Lamb and Black Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, cubed | 1 english cucumber, halved, seeds removed | 2 cans black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon guacamole | 3 tablespoons chopped canned green chili peppers | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules
instructions: Place lamb in large saucepan. Add water to cover. Bring to boil. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,cornstarch,chunky salsa,parmesan cheese,dill weed,white sugar
title: Mika's Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornstarch | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 package dry dill weed | 2 teaspoons grated parmesan cheese | 2/3 cup chunky salsa | 4 cups shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine cornstarch, sugar, dill weed and parmesan cheese in a large bowl and mix well. Stir in chunky salsa and cheddar cheese until well combined. Store in an airtight container at room temperature in refrigerator up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: pot roast,greek yogurt,bay leaf,tomato soup,thai basil,green pea,italian sausage
title: Easy Italian Sampler
ingredients: 1 bottle plain greek yogurt | 15 ounces greek soup, condensed | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 cup green peas, thawed | 1/2 - 1 lb. hot italian sausage, casings removed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup thawed green and red peppers ( bottled or home made ) or 1/2-3/4 cup yellow peppers ( bottled or home made ) | 1 teaspoon dried basil ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix thoroughly.

title: Prawn Barbecue
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chopped peppercorn | 1 pound prawns, cleaned and peeled | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 4 romaine lettuce leaves for garnish
instructions: Place peppercorns in a mortar and crush with mallet. Mix into a paste with the prawns. Stir in tomato puree, rice vinegar, hot sauce, and coriander. Serve on a bed of lettuce leaves with toothpicks or rice.

title: Namakarnu (Yogurt Sauce for Grilled Fish)
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 1/4 teaspoons fish sauce
instructions: Place the yogurt in a bowl, and stir in the fish sauce, 1 teaspoon of salt, and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper. Cover, and refrigerate until serving. If serving as a side dish, the yogurt may be mixed by steaming, or as a dipping sauce, for a wonderful vegetarian dish.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,swiss cheese,dark raisin,portobello mushroom cap,bacon,virgin olive oil,dark chocolate
title: Mushroom & Cheese Fondues-Sante Style
ingredients: 2 ounces bacon, chopped | 2 portobello mushroom caps, stemmed & sliced | 1/4 cup dark chocolate | 1/8 cup virgin olive oil | 10 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon dark raisin | raspberries or blueberries, to serve
instructions: In a large frying pan, melt the chocolate with the olive oil, stirring until smooth. Add the mushrooms & bacon & saute over high heat for 5 minutes, or until mushrooms just release their juices. Place the cheese on top of the mushroom & bacon, then sprinkle with the raisins. Transfer the mushroom fondue to a fondue pot & heat through for 5 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: celery,ham,kalamata olive,salad green,clam juice,dark sesame oil
title: Mid-Eastern Clam Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup kalamata pitted olive | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1 can minced clams with juice | 1 tablespoon celery, sliced | 1/4 cup salad greens ( i used red leaf lettuce ) | ham, slices ( or bacon bits )
instructions: Place olives, sesame oil, and minced clams from the can into a salad bowl. Cover with remaining ingredients and toss lightly to mix. Serve immediately.

title: Swiss Cheese, Maple Butter and Pecan Applesauce
ingredients: 2 cups plain long grain rice or 2 cups brown rice | 1 cup pecans or 1 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 -2 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1 lb smoked salmon, steak cut into strips | 4 medium tart apples ( use yukon gold if possible ) | 1/4 cup pecan pieces | 1/4 cup blue cheese | 1 pinch cracked peppercorns
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place rice in a colander with a tight lid.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,amaranth flour,alfalfa sprout,superfine sugar,white chocolate chip,red capsicum
title: Spicy Capsicum Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons coriander leaves, finely chopped | 1 cup fage's coriander paste ( recipe for 2.5oz jarred alfalfa sprouts, 1 cup chopped roasted capsicum ) | 1/2 red capsicum, halved, deseeded, diced ( bell pepper ) | 4 ounces white chocolate chips, desiccated ( see note ) | 1/2 cup amaranth flour ( see note ) | freshly steamed asian greens or asian flat asian salad leaves, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Place the sugar and coriander in a mini chopper, add the fage's coriander paste, capsicum, pepper and stir until well mixed. Spread half of this mixture evenly on the baking paper. Toss the cheese mixture with the white chocolate chips. Spread the remaining cheese evenly on, then top the cheese with the cooked capsicum mixture. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the fage's coriander mixture is lightly golden. Serve the crispy capsicum chips warm, drizzled with extra white chocolate if desired.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,beef chuck roast,cheddar cheese,cardamom seed,cooking oat,grain white rice,mint leaf
title: Spice Roast With Brown Rice(Masala Kiyaar)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast ( or beef eye round ) | cooking oats, to make sure it is all the same length of the roast | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 5 cardamom seeds | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons cheddar cheese or 2 tablespoons gouda cheese, grated | 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 1 cup long-grain white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place the roast in a shallow baking pan and coat it evenly with cooking oats. Using a sharp knife, cut down on the meat's length on the bones occassionally, if the bones are deep enough, you may have to bone them first. If the beef is large, it may not have enough space so the oats will absorb the marinade. Using a meat pounder, cut 2 slits in each side of the meat. Insert a cardamom seed into the thickest piece of meat, then place 1 tablespoon of the mint leaves into the holes. Place the roast into the oven, and cook for about 90 minutes, or until a meat thermometer reaches 140°f when inserted in a tear. Add the cheese and stir until melted. Remove roast to a serving plate. Using your hands or a very sharp knife, break apart the meat into smaller chunks, about 1/2 inch long, the meat should be juicy, but not too dry. Season with salt and pepper. Add the asafetida to the pan. Add the cardamom seeds to the pan. When the seeds start to sputter, remove pan from the heat. Stir the spices with a wooden spoon until all are dissolved, then pour off any fat or impurities that have come to the surface. Sprinkle the rice over the top and serve warm.

title: Tuna & Radish Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces firm white tuna, drained | 2 ounces small red hot red chili peppers | 2 tablespoons radishes, thinly sliced
instructions: In a bowl, combine the tuna, peppers, and radishes with 1 tbsp of water. Toss well.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,salmon,hard egg,chili pepper flake,green bell pepper,red chilies,salsa,beef bouillon granule
title: Asian Chilli and Smoked Salmon Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb smoked salmon, sliced thinly | 6 ounces smoked salmon, cut in four | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 -2 green bell pepper, sliced | 2 chili peppers, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili oil | 3 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 1/2 tablespoons mild salsa | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except salsa. Serve on lettuces and add salsa to taste.

title: Rhubarb Pork Salad from Leftover Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder, trimmed and tied with kitchen string | 4 medium -large stalks rhubarb, peeled and cut lengthwise in half | 8 teaspoons cream of tartar | 2/3 cup low-fat low-fat yogurt, whipped
instructions: Trim and trim the meat of fat and connective tissue and place it into a large, heavy pot. Add about 3 inches worth of water to the pot and bring it to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer meat uncovered for about 1 1/2 hours.. When the meat is very tender, remove the meat from the pot and refrigerate. Remove the string of strings and cut the meat into chunks about 1 1/2 inches in size. Taste and correct for salt, and add cream of tartar when it is no longer tart and the juice has thickened slightly. Add the yogurt to the pork and stir thoroughly. Return the pork to the pot or serving platter, and gently toss the salad with a wooden spoon to help it soak up the juices. Chill for at least one hour. The longer this cooks, the more flavor it develops.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,egg yolk,corn oil,baking soda,basmati rice,icing,asiago cheese
title: Rice Cake
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 2 1/4 cups of grated asiago cheese | 2/3 cup icing, any flavor | 2/3 cup corn oil | 2 egg yolks | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 -5 tablespoons icing, any flavour
instructions: Boil the rice. Place in a bowl, sprinkle with the asiago, corn oil, egg yolks, baking soda and cardamom seeds and mix together. Spread mixture into a round cake tin or a loaf tin, and spread rice over the base evenly. Chill until set and then cut into slices. When set sprinkle icing on the top. Cut in slices. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: straw mushroom,beef stew meat,lime wedge,pepperoni,cocoa powder,chili paste,grain rice
title: Spicy Crock Pot Rice Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 7 cups cooked long-grain rice, chilled | 2 lbs beef stew meat, cubed and frozen | 1 cup coarsely diced pepperoni | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 cup sweet chili paste | 2 tablespoons chili paste, for topping | lime wedge, for garnish for garnish
instructions: In a crock pot, combine rice, meat and pepperoni slices.

title: The Famous Roast Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 lbs deli beef or 3 1/2-4 lbs sirloin roast | 2 teaspoons salt | 1/4 cup italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 1/4 cups oil | 1/2 cup unsalted butter or 1/2 cup margarine | 2 habanero peppers, finely chopped, seeded | 4 loaves italian bread, crust trimmed, buttered and cut in half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees to 400 degrees. Place the chuck roast in a large oven roasting pan about 15% full of water. Add the salt, parsley, oil, and butter and drizzle each slice with about 2 tablespoons of the garlic and chile, if desired. The roast should nearly cover the skillet. Bake at 425 degrees until an instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the meat reaches 140 degrees when taken out of the oven. Transfer the roasting pan to a wire rack set in the roasting pan. Place the loaves of bread around the beef, piling them on top of the fat in the pan. Place on the rack beneath the roasting pan, tent with foil, and bake until a thermometer reads 150 degrees when moved with an index finger. Transfer the meat and loaves to a cutting board to cool slightly, approximately 20 minutes. Using a sharp, even knife, slice each loaf approximately 1/8 thick. Slice the loaves crosswise into 1/2 slices, adding one to each slice of bread if desired. Place on a platter and drizzle with remaining garlic and chiles. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,jasmine rice,broccoli floret,prosciutto,garlic salt,triple sec,mozzarella cheese
title: Prosciutto Wrapped Rice With Broccoli
ingredients: 4 ounces prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 4 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1/2 cup triple sec or 1/2 cup other orange flavored liqueur | 2 tablespoons vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons minced fresh garlic | 1 package fresh broccoli florets | freshly cooked shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Set aside 6 slices of prosciutto to use for topping. Cover bottom 1/3 of a double layer baking dish with prosciutto.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,chili pepper flake,goat cheese,coriander seed,peach,worcestershire sauce
title: Smokin' Hot Peaches
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon coriander seed | 2 teaspoons crushed chili pepper flakes | 2/3 cup icing sugar | 1 1/2 cups worcestershire sauce ( or other sweet ) | 4 ripe but firm peaches or 4 firm peach halves, peeled and sliced thin | 1/2 cup goat cheese, melted
instructions: Grind coriander seeds and chili flakes into a fine powder. Combine well and set aside. Beat icing sugar and worcestershire sauce in medium bowl. Add peaches and spice mixture. Stir until evenly coated. Cover and chill 1/2 hour or until thickened slightly. Place in a greased 8 x 10 x 2 inch baking dish. Turn slices over and spread with melted butter. Sprinkle with goat cheese. Place in a 350ºf oven 20 minutes or till top begins to crisp.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,mint,mexican chili powder,jalapeno chile,four cheese mexican,chili pepper flake
title: Cheese Quesadillas or Chili Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon of mint | 1 teaspoon dried mexican chili powder | 3/4 cup four-cheese mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon jalapeno chile, seeded and finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and mix well. Spread mixture evenly on 2 ungreased large or 10 ounce ovenproof serving dishes. Heat in a moderate oven until hot but not smoking and serve immediately.

title: Ginger & Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup sifted italian dressing | 1 teaspoon ginger paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake vigorously to blend ingredients then chill.

title: Pizzas
ingredients: 200 g pizza crust ( see related note ) | 1/4 cup orange juice or 1/4 cup milk | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 large orange | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Pour juice over pizza base without peel on pizza pan. Cut zest from orange and grate zest on zest. Bake for 5 minutes. Combine orange zest and juice into saucepan and heat and mix. Remove from heat and set aside. Using a small spoon remove zest from juice and discard. Squeeze juice from all orange into juice mixture. Cut zest from orange and stir into saucepan. Drain juice into medium bowl. Squeeze juice from all oranges into juice mixture in medium bowl. Cut a slice from inside of the cake onto pizza slice and insert juice mix. Spread all over cake. Add 2 - 3 more slices. Cover pizza with lid and bake for 15 minutes or until pizza turns golden.

title: Clam Chowder
ingredients: 24 finely-chopped clams in juice | 8 fluid ounces bottled clam juice | 3/4 cup finely chopped dry oreo cookies | 1 cup dry-roasted unsalted peanuts | 3/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sugar in saucepan.

title: Grilled Swedish Skausages on the Portabella Mushroom Skewers (Evegetarian)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh portabella mushroom, washed | 8 ounces turkey sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can tuna, drained | 1 jar beets, drained ( reserve liquid )
instructions: Place mushrooms on metal skewers. Set aside. Place a piece of sausage on each mushroom, and place 2 to 3 slices of tuna on each mushroom. Close the lid of the grill. Grill approximately 10 minutes per side, or until sausage meat is cooked through and mushrooms are tender. Note, if using a charcoal grill, prepare for indirect heat. Place 3 to 4 pickled beets in a bowl. Cover with water, and let stand at least 10 minutes while the beets are steeping up. Drain steepers, and skewer the beets with a toothpick, or use 2 skewers per skewer. Brush grill with reserved beet liquid.

title: Feta D'avignon With Herbs
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh herb | 1/4 cup crumbled feta or 1/4 cup soft goat cheese
instructions: Cut the stems off the herbs and separate the leaves. Rinse and dry the leaves. Finely chop the leaves and place in a bowl of cold water for 15 minutes to remove any sand. Drain and dry the herb. Place in your crumbles of choice and toss with the cheese. Toss lightly. Serve at once or cover and let it rest at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours to allow the flavour to mature.

title: Slow Cooker Beef and Cheese Manicotti
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round steaks | 1 jar pineapple tidbits, drained ( reserve 1/2 juice ) | 12 manicotti | 1 package provolone cheese | 12 slices prosciutto ( cut in 1/4 ) | 1 cup sauerkraut | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries or 1/2 cup crushed cranberries
instructions: Remove meat from packaging of pickled brine. Slice steak as desired. Place meat in a 4 to 6 quart slow cooker. Combine reserved liquid from can of tidbits with 1/2 of the pineapple tidbits in a large bowl and pour over steak. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 - 8 hours or on high setting for 4 to 5 hours. Add mushrooms, prosciutto slices and sauerkraut to slow cooker. Turn off cooker and shred with 2 forks or food processor. Place 1/4 cup of cooked meat mixture and half the cranberries in a greased shallow baking dish. Spoon remaining juice from 1/2 pineapple over top of meat. Cover and bake at 300 degrees fahrenheit for about 15 minutes or until bubbly and heated through.

title: French Hot Pepper Mix
ingredients: 4 cups homemade hot mix ( like vh ) | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns ( crushed )
instructions: Pour warm hot mix directly into a container with a lid. Allow to set for 5 days to develop flavours.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,salt cod fish,lemon zest,cavatelli pasta,cocoa powder
title: Lemon-Chocolate Pasta With Salted Cod
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb dried cavatelli pasta or 1 -1 1/2 lb other small macaroni, such as ditalini | 1 lb salt cod fish, drained skin and bones removed | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | fresh ground red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add a generous pinch of salt, according to package directions, and then the pasta. Meanwhile, in a covered saucepan, cover the saucepan of salted water with 2 inches of water. Place over medium heat and bring to a boil. Add the fish and bring back to a boil. Cook according to package directions, or until cooked through. Drain the pasta, toss well with the fish over the top of the fish, mix throughly, then serve. Offer additional cocoa powder, chunky red pepper flakes, or lemon zest for extra color.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato,pistachio nut,vanilla bean,beef broth,paprika,balsamic vinegar
title: Pistachio Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef or 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey | 1 pint beef broth ( low sodium, preferably ) | 1 vanilla bean | 1 cup pistachio nut | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a deep pot, brown the ground meat until well browned. Turn the heat to medium and add the beef broth. Slice the vanilla bean lengthwise, scrap the inside and scrape out the seeds. Scrape the vanilla bean seeds into the broth and bring to heat, scraping any bits of food off of the bottom. Turn down the heat to low and leave to simmer for about 1 1/2 hours or until the meat and spices are cooked through. Remove the vanilla bean from the broth and set aside. Toast one or two pistachio nuts in the bottom of a heavy pot, shaking the pot frequently for a couple of minutes. Turn off the heat and add the roasted pistachio mixture. Puree the mixture. Add the balsamic vinegar and pulse a few times. Place in a blender and puree. This will keep very well in the refrigerator for up to 4 weeks.

title: Green Tea Concentrate
ingredients: 1 green tea, green tea concentrate | 5 kaffir lime leaves, crushed
instructions: Pour concentrate into a small container and refrigerate overnight. Drain the concentrate and store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,coleslaw mix,vanilla essence,spaghetti sauce,cardamom powder,greek yogurt,soymilk

instructions: Mix all ingredients until well combined. Mix in the yogurt. Chill well before serving.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,cream chicken soup,beef brisket,dashi stock,rosemary
title: Faux Onion Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 package dashi stock ( knorr preferred ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup ( campbell soup brand recommended ) | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, thinly sliced | 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and sliced ( see note )
instructions: Note, ketchop® beef in the can is the very thick cut of beef brisket that comes in a small package. It is not necessary, or the beef can break apart easily. Slice it as thinly as possible in a food processor, discarding the ends or any membranes on the meat.

title: Cucumber-Chocolate Barker
ingredients: 18 ounces organic chocolate wafers ( about 20 cookies ) | 2 teaspoons organic cocoa ( for dusting ) | 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded, and cut into 24 chunks
instructions: Line a bar tin with parchment paper.

title: Caribbean-Style Papaya & Pear Salad
ingredients: 2 papayas | 1/4 ripe pear
instructions: Peel the papaya, halve lengthwise, remove stone, and cut into thin slices. Place the slices in a medium bowl with the pear, cilantro and papaya. Toss well. Serve cold or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,new potato,fast rising yeast,ladyfinger,orange peel,lime zest,beer
title: Sweet Potato Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 3/4 cup bread ( white, whole wheat, medium ) | 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 cups baby new potatoes ( about 10-12 medium potatoes ) | 1/4 cup bottled orange peel or 1/4 cup chopped candied orange peel | 1/4 cup bottle light beer | 1 1 tablespoon grated lime zest | 20 ladyfingers, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line 2 large baking sheets with baking parchment. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, combine the yeast, 1/4 cup bread, 1 cup of potatoes, orange peel, beer, zest, and remaining 1/4 cup bread. Beat until smooth. Add the remaining potatoes to the dough and blend well until mixed. Pour the mixture into a greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish and top with the remaining 1/4 cup bread. Place the baking dish on a baking rack set over a baking sheet and allow the bread to rise to the top of the baking dish. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until crust is nicely browned and potatoes are tender.

title: Chocolate Beans
ingredients: 400 g pinto beans, rinsed | 100 g roasted mexican chocolate
instructions: Place the beans in a pan with 300ml water. Place over high heat and bring to the boil. When the water starts to bubble, cover the pan with a lid, reduce to medium, and steam for 30 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the chocolate. Allow chocolate to melt and mix with the beans. Serve hot.

title: Black Beans
ingredients: 3 cans black beans, unseasoned | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 3 -4 lbs boneless chicken legs
instructions: Drain the beans and rinse them under cold running water. Place in bowl, add the broth and vinegar, mix well. Add chicken, mix and refrigerate overnight. The next day, place in a slow cooker, sprinkle with salt, if desired. Cook on low heat on low heat for 5 hours, stir occasionally.

Random Ingredients: scallion,rigatoni pasta,beef brisket,gingerroot,kasseri cheese,lime wedge,nonstick cooking spray
title: Tibet-Style Grilled Corned Beef Dinner
ingredients: 1/2 cup kasseri cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon minced gingerroot | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions | nonstick cooking spray | 1 lb corned beef brisket, trimmed and sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1/2 cup cooked rigatoni pasta | lime wedge
instructions: Combine the cheese, gingerroot and scallions in a small bowl.

instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine spaghetti sauce, peanut butter, peppercorns, mint, cinnamon, and chicken bouillon. Simmer over medium low heat for 3 - 5 minutes until it begins to thicken. Discard mint leaves.

title: Chinese Five-Star Four-Star Four-Spice Pepper
ingredients: 1/2 cup szechwan pepper, cut into 1-inch-thick pieces | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line baking sheets with aluminum foil. Combine szechwan pepper and tabasco in a small bowl. Stir in tabasco. Spread pepper mixture onto baking sheets to within 1 inch of the edges. Bake until mixture is fragrant and beginning to brown around the edges, stirring occasionally, about 12 minutes.

title: Texas Burger Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup hot sauce | 1 tablespoon a.1. original sauce | 2 teaspoons flour | 2 slices iceberg lettuce or 2 slices other hard lettuce
instructions: Combine ingredients except lettuce. Spread on your favorite hamburger bun. Spoon burgers into lettuce leaves and enjoy.

title: Baby carrots in Foil

instructions: Place baby carrots in a non stick pan with the onion. Add enough water to cover carrots and simmer on a medium to high heat for about 15 - 20 minutes until carrots are cooked but still a little crisp on the outside. Stir in dried cherries. Continue cooking until carrots are cooked and most of the liquid has evaporated. Stir in sultanas or raisins if using.

title: Creole Black-Eyed Peas

instructions: Place black eyed peas over medium heat in a pot with a lid. Cook, uncovered, stirring frequently until water evaporates, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green bean,mustard seed,cumin powder,carrot,scotch bonnet pepper,tuna,soymilk
title: Creamy Tuna Salad
ingredients: 125 g canned tuna, drained ( canned ) | 6 -8 green beans, trimmed and broken into two florets ( frozen ) | 2 medium carrots, peeled cut into bite sized pieces | 2 tablespoons soymilk ( or a bit of skim milk ) | 1 -2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 -2 scotch bonnet pepper, crushed lightly ( or chilli pepper flakes to taste ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients except mustard seed in a large bowl and mix well to combine. If you would like to make this vegetarian you can use the meat from the tuna.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,coriander,taco seasoning,green curry paste,chinese rice wine,thai basil,cream chicken soup,water chestnut
title: Spicy Thai Cream of Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup sweet cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon water chestnuts, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon sweet thai basil | 1 teaspoon green curry paste ( or more ) | 1/2 teaspoon trasiinspoon light brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon chinese rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning ( msg )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium sized casserole dish layer soup, water chestnuts, coriander, basil, curry paste and mustard seed. Pour hot wine over all. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until soup is hot and bubbly. Sprinkle top with taco seasoning blend before serving.

title: Linguine with Fennel, Banana Peppers and Apple Juice
ingredients: 2 bananas, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded, and sliced thickly | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup orange juice or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 inch fennel bulb, trimmed and thinly sliced ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 3 dashes hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Bring 4 quarts water to boil with 1 tablespoon salt. Add linguine and boil until tender, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and toss with 1/4 teaspoon salt. To serve, place 1/4 cup of chopped fennel in each of two shallow bowls. Arrange 4 banana slices on top of fennel and top with 1/4 cup apple juice. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt. Top with a dash of pepper sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: white flour,hot salsa,green pea,cumin,chicken stock,bread,tomato soup,maple syrup
title: Mexican Bread and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green peas, canned | 6 cups chicken stock | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 2 teaspoons cumin | 1 cup bread, cut up | 4 1/2 tablespoons white flour | maple syrup ( optional ) | salsa ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a stockpot. Bring to a boil then lower heat and simmer about 25 minutes add bread. Cool soup then puree it until you have a coarse bready texture. Reheat and mix with soup.

title: Spanish Shredded Pork With Ancho Chili Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs country-style pork ribs | 12 small tomatillos | 1 small ancho chile ( dried california chiles ) | 6 arbol chiles, dried ( or more ) | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 medium summer squash
instructions: Remove the hard rinds of the tomatillos, then cut off the top shell without tearing off the fibers. Remove the blackened flesh from the chiles and cut off the stems. Place the chiles and chiles in a large bowl, cover with hot water and let soak for 30 minutes or longer. Remove the chiles from water, rinse with cool water, and remove their seeds and veins.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,white pepper,cream tartar,chicken breast,pine nut,raisin,butter
title: Chicken Fingers with Sour Cream and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup tarragon vinegar | 1/4 cup butter or 1/4 cup margarine | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Place chicken strips between plastic wrap and pound to 1/4 inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Mix together raisins and pine nuts. Place on cookie sheet and bake in 400 degrees f oven for 5 to 10 minutes per side. When done, remove from oven and place raisins in a small sauté pan and pour off excess water. Add tarragon, vinegar then butter or margarine. Heat, stirring occasionally until melted and mixture is hot but not boiling. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cut chicken strips into fingers. Place on serving platter and spoon sour cream over them. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,lebanese cucumber,oregano,coconut milk,german chocolate cake mix,plum
title: Grenadian Chocolate Bundt Cake
ingredients: 1 german chocolate cake mix | 1/2 cup tarragon | 1/2 cup grapeseed oil or 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1 lebanese cucumber | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 4 plum, slices ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven. Mix the prepared ziptop and oil in a bundt cake mold with the cucumber, oregano and spread. Top with plums, if using and bake 30 minutes. Cool, and serve.

title: Fettuccine With Porridge and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 4 ounces whole wheat fettuccine or 4 ounces rotelle | 3 -4 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 egg, slightly beaten | 1/2 cup tomato and basil blend
instructions: Combine mushrooms and barley in a large saucepan and stir in the salt. Stir occasionally until barley is soft. Stir in egg and tomato. Simmer for five minutes and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: salt,fish sauce,anise seed,vegetable stock,yukon gold potato,spanish onion
title: Potato and Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled | 4 large spanish onions or 4 large vidalia onions | 3 tablespoons vegetable stock | 4 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon ground anise seed | salt
instructions: Cut 4 potatoes into 1/2 inch cubes. Peel and thinly slice the onions. Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil, add salt, and boil until potatoes and onions are very tender. Peel and thinly slice the onions. Add the potatoes and onions to a large soup pot. Place the fish sauce, aniseed, and a pinch or two of salt into a separate small bowl. Add this mixture to the soup pot, stir. Lower heat to a simmer, cover, and simmer for 50 minutes. Remove the lid, reduce heat to low, and continue simmering for another 5 minutes. Add the fish sauce and simmer for another 5 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,large shrimp,horseradish,mincemeat,yellow bell pepper,arborio rice,sesame oil
title: Spicy Shrimp over Rice
ingredients: 1/2 lb mincemeat | 1 yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 7 ounces precooked small raw shrimp ( about 8-10 ) | 8 ounces soymilk | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups carnaroli rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish
instructions: If you are using medium shrimp, remove their tails before peeling and deveining them. Rinse shrimp lightly with warm water and drain in a colander and pat dry with paper towels. In a heavy pot brown the shrimp, breaking them apart if necessary so they won't bleed when they boil. You may have to remove the shrimp to turn them over or else the shrimp will not be turned up to its original body temperature. Add the soymilk and stir in the sesame oil. Add the rice and stir well. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and add salt, pepper and horseradish. Cover and cook on low for 30 minutes. Do not stir. After 15 minutes, turn heat up and raise heat, boil until the liquid reduces to 1/4 cup and the rice is cooked. Fluff the rice and serve. If using raw shrimp, remove shells and set aside. If using raw shrimp it will take much longer. Note, you may use baby shrimp to skip the soaking process. It's a matter of taste. Also, the taste can be slightly different if you use shrimp that has gone bad. I prefer the flavor and texture of the shrimp over shrimp.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,macaroni,self rising flour,red potato,lime zest,fish sauce,malibu rum,linguine
title: Linguine With Grilled Sweet Potatoes (Namurri)
ingredients: 2 red potatoes | 2 small red potatoes | 1 inch piece galangal or 1 inch ginger, peeled & grated | 1/4 cup light fish sauce | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 8 macaroni, twists | fresh lime zest | 8 noodles ( linguine )
instructions: Wash and cut potatoes into bite sized pieces and place in a microwave safe bowl. Cover with saran wrap and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Take off wrap. Remove potatoes from microwave and allow to cool. Peel then slice into bite sized pieces and place in a microwave safe bowl. Cover and microwave on high for 30 second intervals, stirring to prevent potato from browning. Set aside. In a bowl, combine the fish sauce, dark soy sauce and dark soy sauce and set aside. Cook pasta over a high heat, drain. Place a towel over the bowl. Remove the bowl from the microwave. Dip each piece of potato in the bowl, turning to coat well. Place in the towel and roll them up in the towel shaking off any stray potato pieces and placing the soaked pieces in one layer on a sheet tray or in individual bowls. Pour the sauce over the potatoes and place under the hot grill, turning until the potato are lightly browned and the sauce has come to a boil. Serve over your favourite pasta.

title: Gluten Free
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups gluten free blend cheese | 1 lime peel
instructions: Place all ingredients in the bowl of a food processor and process, stopping about a minute to scrape the sides and bottom of pan.

title: Italian Crumbed Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts, blanched, skinned, and ground in food processor | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1/3 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup of fresh dill, chopped | vanilla ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Place the hazelnuts in a food processor along with the old bay seasoning, breadcrumbs, dill, and ice cream, if using. Process until all ingredients are mixed and smooth. Put mixture in a glass, plastic, or wax paper lined bag, and put in the fridge until completely cold. Turn over several hours before serving.

title: Hot green chili pepper sauce
ingredients: 2 red capsicums ( or any hot green chili pepper ) | 200 ml heavy cream | 2 -3 finely chopped green chili peppers ( or 1 tsp hot green chili powder ) | crushed ice
instructions: Seed and slice the capsicums, or just slice it and throw in the blender until finely chopped. Mix everything together in a saucepan on a low heat, and bring slowly to the boil, stirring frequently. When it reaches boiling point, lower the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, just long enough to soften the skin. If the sauce has boiled over while you are doing this, it may curdle, so just leave it on a low heat for 1 - 2 minutes. You will have a thick creamy sauce, but it might not be as creamy as a paste like a paste with very little oil. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: anchovy,graham cracker crumb,white onion,corn syrup,cooking oil,superfine sugar,cashew,bulk italian sausage
title: Grandma's Italian Nests
ingredients: 6 anchovies ( optional ) | 2 lbs sweet white onions, peeled | 6 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1/4 cup dark corn syrup | 2 cups chopped cashews or 2 cups peanuts ( optional ) | cooking oil ( for frying ) | 3/4 lb bulk italian sausage | 1/2 lb graham cracker crumbs
instructions: In a small pot, bring 2 quarts lightly salted water to a boil. Drop anchovies by the handful and drop into boiling water. Add the onions and return to boil. Cook to a light brown color. Drain anchovies and set aside. Transfer to a very clean bowl. Remove outer casings from onions and add to bowl with anchovies. In a 3 quart saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup, cashews, and a little water to make a paste. Cook over low to medium heat, stirring frequently, until the mixture just reaches a boil. Turn off heat. Place skillet in a cold oven. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Stir in sausage and crumbs. Pour mixture into a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in oven stirring a few times, until hot, about 1 hour. Turn heat off. Allow to harden in the oven. Store in a tightly covered jar in the refrigerator. Variation, in a small pot, heat 3 tablespoons cooking oil to 350 degrees stirring continuously. Toasted cashews can be added to sausage mixture and cooked to remove excess grease from bowl. Variation, in a small pot on the stovetop, heat 3/4 cup unsalted butter until light brown. Do not darken. Serve in a small serving bowl in a small piece of parchment paper with a crouton dipped into flour.

title: Beef Burritos
ingredients: 2 lbs round steaks | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons flour tortillas | 1 -2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Preheat oven to cut meat into 4 to 6 pieces. Sprinkle with bouillon and marjoram. Place in ungreased casserole. Add water. Cover. Bake 1 hour. Remove meat and drain off liquid. Serve on warmed flour tortillas.

title: Sweet Potato, Bamboo and Garlic Mash (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 18)
ingredients: 4 medium sweet potatoes, scrubbed ( kent potatoes are currently gluten-free ) | 10 bamboo shoots ( kiwi is gluten-free )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/425°f. Scrub and dry sweet potatoes. Place the british potatoes in a shallow ovenproof baking dish, drizzle with some oil and bake, turning the potatoes, for 45 - 50 minutes or until tender and lightly browned. Meanwhile, cut bamboo shoots in half lengthways.

title: Moroccan Caraway Baked Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 6 tablespoons dark chocolate, dark, at room temperature ( bittersweet ) | 1 tablespoon caraway seed, toasted in a dry skillet until fragrant and fragrant and fragrant, about 10 seconds ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place the melted chocolate in a small bowl. Pour the hot chocolate over the chocolate and set aside until cool, at least 1 hour. Stir the caraway seeds and lightly grind the caraway powder and lightly grind the almond, if using. Stir in the almond extract. Shape the cooled chocolate into small, bite sized balls and refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Gravy for Veggies  (Gluten Free!)
ingredients: 2 winter squash, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1 1/4 cups gravymake ( gluten free ) | 1 teaspoon marjoram ( gluten free )
instructions: Boil the squash in water until tender in lots of cold water. Dump all the water out and let drain a bit while the squash cool down a bit and then transfer the squash to a food processor. Add the rest of the ingredients except the parmesan to the food processor and whir for 5 seconds, then pour into a large serving bowl and mix well, coating the dish. Place the parmesan on the top and serve with your favourite vegetables.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,tomato green chilies,baking potato,kernel corn
title: Nacho Potato Snack Mix
ingredients: 5 large baking potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 can tomatoes and green chilies, diced | 1 can sweet whole kernel corn, drained, or more as needed | 1 package corn chips
instructions: Place the potato in a large pot, and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about 20 to 25 minutes. Drain. While the potato is cooking, place tomatoes and green chiles in a large bowl. Stir in the corn, and mash with a potato masher or fork until no lumps remain. Stir the corn mixture into the potatoes with the corn, and season with salt and more corn chips to taste. Cover bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate the potato potato mixture until chilled, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: really bread,bamboo shoot,seitan,chicken thigh,parmigiano reggiano cheese,onion,pinto bean,tomato paste
title: Tasty Minestrone
ingredients: 64 ounces dried pinto beans ( or any other large pinto bean pot ) | 3 ounces chicken thighs | 8 ounces seitan ( chopped fine ) | 1 medium onion ( chopped ) | 1 cup bamboo shoot ( optional ) | 1 medium tomatoes ( chopped fine ) | 2 ounces tomato paste | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( freshly grated )
instructions: Soak the beans in water overnight. Drain the beans in a large pot on the stovetop, and slowly bring to a boil, allowing any water to boil off. Reduce heat to low, and simmer for about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, put the chicken skin on and cut up in small pieces. Put the sopaion in a food processor with a little bit of water, and process until smooth. Add to a large stock pot or soup pot along with the chicken, and cook, stirring often, until thickened. When the soup is well cooked, add the bean mixture and the seitan. Stir until the chicken is well heated through and the onion has softened.. Add the remaining ingredients, stir well and simmer on medium for about 15 minutes to blend flavors and flavors. Note, for variety you may use any type of bean, or a type of onion.

title: Burritos
ingredients: 400 g canned pineapple chunks, drained and juice reserved | 2 teaspoons vegetable broth ( optional ) | 300 g burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 aubergine, sliced
instructions: Preheat half of the pineapple juice in a frying pan over medium heat. Dice the aubergine. Mix the fried aubergine with the drained pineapple chunks and vegetable broth and serve on a plate with a tortilla and a sprinkling of pine nuts.

title: Quick and Easy Satay Sauce
ingredients: 1 can chopped tomato puree | 1 tablespoon smooth tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
instructions: Drain the can of tomato puree and tamarind paste into a saucepan. Cover and allow to simmer for 10 minutes over medium heat. Cool completely. Stir in the peanut or vegetable oil. Serve over the satay on individual satay sticks. If you wish to serve the satay with satay sauce, serve with karash, steamed rice, etc. Also good in a recipe calling for chinese broccoli or zucchini in capsicum rings.

title: Irish Fruit Scones
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes | 1 cup raisin bran cereal ( hemp n bran brand is recommended ) | 1 can cranberry beans, drained ( optional ) | 1/4 cup craisins or 1/4 cup other bran cereal
instructions: Bake potatoes whole until tender, approximately 20 to 30 minutes. Cool on a sheet in a baking dish, and cut into cubes. Spray with nonstick spray. Spread raisin bran down the centre of each potato. Top with cranberries, craisans, and other bran cereal.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,taco sauce,clam juice,italian meatball,baby corn
title: Spanish-Lime Clam Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cans baby corn, drained | 1 can minced clams with juice | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon taco sauce | 1/2 cup taco meat, cooked
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Refrigerate at least 1 hour to allow flavors to marry. Enjoy note, this can be made in advance.

Random Ingredients: grouper fillet,pecorino romano cheese,red food coloring,italian tomato,chili pepper flake,flat leaf italian parsley,onion,apricot jam
title: Grouper With Apricot-Apricot Jam
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes, divided | 1/2 medium sweet onion, minced ( vidalia or spanish or other sweet onion should do ) | 2 medium italian tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped flat-leaf italian parsley, plus additional | parsley, for garnish | 1/2 cup finely grated pecorino romano cheese or 1/2 cup asiago cheese, plus more ( to taste ) | 1 lb grouper fillet ( or any fish ) | 1 cup apricot jam | 1/4 - 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil or 1/4-1/2 cup canola oil
instructions: Mix the 1/4 cup chopped parsley and 1/4 cup canola oil. Set aside. Remove the 1/2 tsp of chili flakes from the pepper flakes. In a food processor or blender, combine the remaining 1/2 tsp chili flakes, onion, tomatoes, and 4 tablespoons of the chopped parsley. Using the chopping blade, cut the puree into small bits about the same size as the parseley, but not pasty. Add the puree to the processor.. Process until smooth. Spread about 1/2 cup of apricot jam on the surface of each fillet. Place the fillet on a plate. Spread with apricot jam. Cover with the remaining 1 cup apricot jam. Press down gently. Spread 1/4 cup of extra virgin olive oil. Dot about 1/2 cup of the chopped parsley on top. Place the fillet on the pan. Cover. Cook in a 400 degree oven for about 10 minutes or until a tester inserted in thickest part of fillet registers 110 degrees on a digital thermometer. Remove the fillet from the oven. Turn the fillet over. Cook, uncovered, until the fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork. Meanwhile, warm the remaining 1/4 cup of chopped parsley in a small saucepan over medium medium heat. When the fillet is done, place on a platter. Spoon the remaining 1/4 cup apricot jam over the top. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of grated cheese and the reserved 1/2 teaspoon pepper flakes. Scatter over the remaining parsley. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,matzo meal,wheat bread,pineapple,mustard powder,pizza crust,raspberry jam,grain mustard
