Lay down a dollop of cheese spread onto the open end of the dough and roll the dough up. Roll from one long side. Cut roll into equal sized pieces and place them on the lined pans. To make topping and serve.

title: Easy Microwave Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 1 large spaghetti squash | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups broth
instructions: Place squash on microwavable plate.

title: Greek Style Roasted Mushrooms
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms ( about 10 pieces ) | 1 jar pitted kalamata olives ( about 15 slices ) | 1/3 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 1/4 cups breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange the mushrooms, olives, cranberries, pine nuts, and brandy in a 9x13 baking dish, or divide between two plates. Sprinkle salt evenly over all and drizzle with 2 - 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Broil, 4 - 5 inches from the heat, 3 - 4 minutes, until bread crumbs are browned and golden and liquid has been absorbed.

title: Beef and Pecorino Pizza W.o. With Cardamom and Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 pre-made pre-made pizza crust | 2/3 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese ( fresh, not dried or grated ) | 2/3 cup extra lean ground beef | 12 ounces yoghurt | 1/2 cup pickled jicama
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 220c. Mix pecorino romano and beef in a bowl. Roll the pizza crust so it has a thin surface. Spread the cheese and beef mixture on top of the crust followed by the pickled jicama. Bake for 20 mins or until golden brown and bubbling. Serve hot.

title: Deviled Swiss Steak and Cabbage for Two
ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage, sliced | 7 ounces sliced courgettes, cut in half | 8 fluid ounces tomato sauce | 1 whole chipotle chile, cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220 degrees centigrade, or a temperature somewhere which will leave the steaks in there a little crispy and crunchy. Line an oven tray with aluminium foil and spray with oil. Spread half of the cabbage slices into the oven proof dish, leaving the remaining cabbage leaves whole. Scatter over some of the courgette, then pour over the tomato sauce and the chile and worcestershire sauce. Drizzle over half the remaining sauce. Place the steaks on top of this, too. Cover with foil and allow to sit in the preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Carefully remove the foil and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes until the steaks are cooked through and springy to the touch.

Random Ingredients: lemon,red wine vinegar,margarine,taco shell,anaheim chili,onion salt
title: Nacho Cheese
ingredients: 3 medium medium fresh poblano peppers or 3 medium anaheim chili, stemmed, seeded, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 cup bottled minced onion | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/16 teaspoon lemon rind, grated
instructions: Char chiles over gas flame or in broiler. Transfer to small bowl.

title: Raspberry Pork Roast (Pork Sandwich)
ingredients: 1/2 cup seedless raspberry preserves | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 lb lean pork roast or 1 lb turkey, trimmed of excess fat | 1 can raspberries in natural fruit preserves | 4 cups crushed ice
instructions: Mix raspberry preserves and vanilla in bowl, set aside. Pat pork with paper towel to evenly coat. Place pork in shallow buttered roasting pan. Set aside 1/2 cup raspberry preserves for garnish. Insert toothpick into reserved raspberry preserves to hold toothpick in the center of the pork. Place meat on top of preserves. Spoon the remaining preserves and a small can of raspberries into center of pork. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Drain meat well. Return meat to pan. Spoon reserved preserves evenly over meat. Cover and refrigerate 1 more hour. Remove plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Remove meat from pan. Serve with reserved preserves and sliced raspberries as garnishes.

title: Pickled Asparagus
ingredients: 32 ounces fresh asparagus, whole, with stems | 1 beef bouillon granule | 1/2 cup mixed pickled vegetables, such as carrots, celery, watercress, cucumbers, etc | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Trim tips off asparagus stalks, cut off woody end, set aside. Place asparagus in a large pot with 3 cups water, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low. Cover, simmer until crisp tender, about 10 minutes drain well. Place asparagus in a bowl with remaining ingredients, pour dressing overtop, toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate while preparing remaining ingredients.

title: Nacho Style Trout
ingredients: 4 trout fillets, fresh, frozen and thawed with the crust removed | 3 tablespoons chunky salsa ( or picante salsa ) | 2 teaspoons pure maple syrup | tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Spray grill to prevent sticking. In a large bowl, combine salsa, maple syrup and tabasco sauce. Reserve a small amount of tabasco sauce for serving. Slice trout fillets on the diagonal. Thread salsa onto the skewers. Brush the turkey with the reserved tabasco sauce. Grill over medium heat for 10 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Easy Basic Bean Dish
ingredients: 1 can baked beans, drained, rinsed | 2 -3 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a bowl, stir, and refrigerate to serve overnight if possible. Keeps for several days, refrigerated, refrigerated, and reheated at serving time.

title: Sauerkraut & Mushroom Stew
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut, undrained | 1 can tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 cup chopped white mushroom | 1 granny smith apple, diced | 1 dash juniper berries | 2 tablespoons pure vanilla beans, scraped from pod
instructions: Drain sauerkraut, reserving 1/2 cup of the juice. Stir sauerkraut, tomatoes, mushrooms, apple and juniper into sauerkraut mixture. Reserve 1/2 of liquid. Cover and refridgerate for at least one hour and up to 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,date,lamb chop,red cabbage,pearl onion,celery seed
title: Lamb Chops Stuffed With Cabbage and Dates
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried dates, chopped | 1/2 cup red cabbage, finely shredded | 1/3 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated | 1/4 cup sweet pearl onion, cooked, peeled and chopped | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 4 lamb chops
instructions: In a bowl, combine the dates, cabbage, cheese, onion, celery seed and dates. Fill a medium size pot about 1/3 full with water. Add the lamb and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat. Simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, from 1 - ½ - 1 1/2 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Taste for seasoning, adding salt and pepper, as needed. Serve with hot cooked pasta.

title: Manicotti
ingredients: 2 quarts glutinous rice, soaked overnight | 8 ounces gingerroot, finely grated | 8 ounces chicken-flavored breakfast sausage | 8 ounces uncooked menicotti | 1 1/2 cups wheat breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Soak the glutinous rice in 2 quarts of cold, heavily salted water for 1 1/2 2 hours. Bring the water to a boil in a large pot. When it has come to a boil, add the gingerroot and sausage, and set on the lowest heat. Leave about 20 minutes, undisturbed, until the meat is tender but not falling off the bone. Strain and add the remaining ingredients, except the breadcrumbs, to the pot. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer partially covered for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally. Check the seasoning, and add more fish sauce if necessary. Remove from the heat and set aside. When cool, cut a hole into the side of the noodles, and fill with meat mixture. Roll like an egg roll, and tuck in end. Dip the edge of each roll into the breadcrumbs, coating completely. Set on a rack in a bowl, and let drain until they all set up. Place on a foil lined cookie sheet or baking sheet, cover, and let freeze until firm, about 1 to 1 1/2 months.

title: Quick and Easy Homemade Anise Filling
ingredients: 1/2 cup oil, or more as needed | 2 teaspoons anise extract
instructions: Stir 1/2 cup oil, anise oil, and anise extract together in a bowl.

title: Linguica
ingredients: 1 package linguica | garlic salt ( to taste )
instructions: Cook linguica in boiling water for 3 minutes. Meanwhile sprinkle with garlic salt.

title: Quick & Simple Rice Bean Salad
ingredients: 300 g rice beans ( small brown ones that will fit into your container. ) | 2 -3 green peppers, cut into strips | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 bunch fresh thai basil
instructions: Start by heating a bit of oil in a pan on the stove for a few minutes or until really hot and fragrant. Do not add other water. Once it starts to shimmer, add in all the green peppers & cook until browned. Next, add the rice & cover. Allow the water to come to a boil, then leave to simmer for 20 - 25 minutes. If cooking on a stovetop on the stovetop, reduce heat to low, leave covered for a few minutes, turn stove onto a burner & heat it up for a few mins on the stove top. Toss in all your chopped basil & check for salt. Enjoy.

title: Italian Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 600 g large shrimp, shell and tail removed | 2 heads italian parsley, stalks removed | 1 kg white sugar | 2 cups fresh corned beef | 150 ml cornflour | 35 ml white sugar | 35 ml chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Put shrimp into a colander and add a cup of water and the heads of parsley stalks. Press the mixture on the heads of parsely into the heads, removing any excess. Mix the remaining ingredients together. Sprinkle the mixture over the shrimp. Seal and leave to marinate for at least 2 hours. Preheat barbecue or grill to high. Barbecue the cocktail just until the shrimp turn pink, turning regularly. Serve immediately.

title: Manchego Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 medium sized walnuts | 1 cup manchego cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to cut walnuts off cheese ball. Place them in a bowl and lightly salt, to taste. Roll walnuts in the walnut mixture. Place mixture on a foil lined cookie sheet. Bake until the ball is slightly browned, about 10 - 10 minutes. Cool, then crumble and serve.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,snail,tomato juice,cocoa powder,scallion,cherry,pine nut,dark rum
title: Prawn With Red Curry Sauce
ingredients: 400 g shell shrimp | 400 g snails | 400 ml cherry tomatoes | 1 dash cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 4 scallions, chopped | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, chopped
instructions: Rinse and gut each shrimp and place in a large bowl. Pour the cherry tomatoes and the juice from the can through a sieve and place in a larger bowl. Mix in the prawns and mix well. Drumble in the cocoa and mix well. Add the red curry paste and rum to taste. Toss well and add in scallions, pine nuts. Enjoy.

title: Chile Barley Wrapped Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups chicken meat ( cubed ) | 1/3 a white onion ( chopped ) | 1 cup shiitake mushroom ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 2 tablespoons tequila | 4 tablespoons bread flour | 2 bananas ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup cheese ( shredded )
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 degrees celsius. Prepare your wrap dough for the wraps and place on baking tray. Once your wraps have been placed into the oven, place the onions, mushrooms, barley, tequila into a small bowl, mix and add the flour to thicken. Place a little sliced banana into the middle of the wrap, fold the wrap over the filling and place on tray. Spray the wrap with olive oil and sprinkle with pepper. Bake in oven for 10 minutes or until wraps are warmed through.

title: Sweet Italian Meat

instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add 1 teaspoon italian herb seasoning to heat. Add ground meat and capers.

title: Sausage Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 lb sausages | 1 large yellow bell pepper, chopped | 2 slices lemons | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: Brown sausages in skillet with pepper and lemon. As the sausages are drying, place tortillas in a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. Pour the oil from the meat drippings up over the tortillas. Fry tortillas until the tortillas are soft and pliable. Drain on paper towels. Drain meat of drippings. Wrap each wrap with a tortilla and fry until it becomes crispy and browned. This should take 1 - 1 1/2 to two hours. You may also want to use a food processor to puree the mixture until smooth.

title: Quick and Easy Soya Marinade
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/3 cup onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dipping sauce mix, to taste | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a ziploc bag or bowl. Marinate meat for 2 hours or longer, turning bag occasionally. Cook on grill, or on griddle about 2 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,agave syrup,italian flat leaf parsley,pistachio nut,cherry tomato,pepperoni
title: Easy Greek Pistachio-Pimento Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved or fresh tomatoes halved, about 6 cups | 1 ounce sliced pepperoni | 1/4 cup roughly chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 cup light agave syrup | 2 1/2 teaspoons white sugar | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh italian flat-leaf parsley, plus extra for garnish
instructions: Arrange tomatoes on a large platter and surround with the pepperoni, scattering with the parsley. In a small bowl, combine the agave syrup and sugar.

title: Cocktail (Alaskan- Russian Tea)
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh coffee, hot | 1/2 ounce fresh coriander seed | 1/2 ounce smoked salmon | 1 -2 ounce fresh peas ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients. To serve, rub with a knife.

title: Mocha Cheese and Orange Manicotti
ingredients: 12 soft fresh manicotti | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 2 tablespoons steak sauce - divided | 1 tablespoon milk chocolate, grated ( optional )
instructions: Cook and stir manicotti shells in boiling salted water until cooked through but firm, about 5 minutes. Drain. Set aside. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, toss together olive oil, oats, steak sauce and chocolate and set aside. When shells are cool enough to handle, but still warm, scoop out and discard about 1/2 cup of filling. Fill manicotti with cheese mixture. Sprinkle with a bit of the grated oat mixture. Replace cheese filling in shell cavity. Heat oven to 400°f wrap stuffed stuffed manicotti in foil.

title: Irish Cowboy Iced Tea Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons brewed tea
instructions: Combine picante sauce, vinegar, and sugar in a bowl.

title: French Pastry Cream a La Cream
ingredients: 1 lb shortening ( pastry cream ) | 3/4 lb heavy cream
instructions: Note, as i said, if using pastry cream and pastry flour or corn flour, use the pastry flour or corn flour. Melt butter, cream and slowly pour it over the pastry, using as much of the flour as needed to obtain a stiff dough like consistency. Press pastry into 8x4x3 glass baking tin. Cover with waxed paper or lightly oiled cling film and place in fridge for at least 3 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake for 45 minutes or until just lightly browned. Do not let this burn or boil.

title: Pasta Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 cup flour | 1/4 teaspoon crushed garlic
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto hot, hot dry or oiled griddle. Cook till light brown. Turn & fry other side. Serve immediately.

title: Beef & Camembert Monte Cristo With Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 1/4 cup thawed cream cheese | 4 filet of beef, medallions | 1 small celery rib, halved | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce camembert cheese | 3 ripe plum ( optional ) | 1 egg white, lightly beaten with a dash of | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Bring 2 cups cold water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add rice & stir. Cover & reduce heat to low. Cook 15 to 20 minutes, or until done. In a bowl, mix cream cheese with a little of the cooked jasmine rice, & set aside. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat, & add beef.

title: Gruyère Cheese Filled Pastries
ingredients: 500 g white flour | 200 g gruyere cheese, grated | 6 egg yolks, room temperature | 2 egg yolks | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Place flour on a board and make a hole in the middle. Make a hole in the hole and place the cheese. Mix the egg yolks with the white pepper put egg yolk mixture into the hole. Stir the mixture together with a knife, working the mixture outwards until it becomes soft and dough like. Cover, put in the fridge for 30 minutes. Put the egg mixture on a floured surface, roll out to about about a quarter cm in diameter. Cut into 1 cm size strips and put into the pastry bag. When all pastries are coated take a piece of the cheese on the edge, and roll it up. Make sure it doesn’t slice through the pastry bag. Sprinkle some more white pepper. Place both pastries on a lightly floured tray and cover with cling film. Set aside for 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 200c. Bake at 200c for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,milk ricotta cheese,tuna olive oil,heart palm,potato starch
title: Tuna Cheese and Hearts of Palm Baked in Milk (Pan Con Miele)
ingredients: 6 pieces italian bread | 1 can tuna in olive oil, drained with reserved olive oil | 2 lbs potatoes | 2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: Rinse the potatoes and remove any remaining skin. Slice into large pieces. Set aside in a large bowl of cold water. To prevent them from cooking when they are done, soak them in ice water for 20 minutes for the starch to absorb and then drain. In a shallow baking dish, layer the bread with tuna, followed by potatoes. Set aside. In a medium bowl, mix together the ricotta and potato starch. Spread in a layer on top of the potatoes and tuna, making sure to cover all of the breads. Top with the milk and continue layering. Do not worry about spreading the potatoes on top of the bread. You are making a pattern where every part has been covered with the cheese mixture. The potatoes will cook while the tuna and tuna are baking. This may take 45 minutes to 1 hour depending on how hard you work together. The final result should be a dark brown crust when finished.

title: Quick Samosa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 1/2 cup grated kumara | sliced serrano chili | lime wedge
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cornmeal and 1/2 cup water, and stir to form a wet sticky thick batter. Cook the kumara in boiling water for 1 - 2 minutes until just softened, but not fully cooked through. Drain onto paper towels. Dip the kumara, a few inches, first into the batter, then drop into the sok. Garnish with a few drops of sliced serrano and lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,grenadine,half,topping,pizza sauce,taco shell,orange marmalade
title: Fantastic Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon orange marmalade or 1 tablespoon orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1/4 cup pizza sauce | 1 tablespoon sour cream or 1 tablespoon reduced-fat sour cream | splash grenadine, for the extra kick | 1/2 cup fat-free half-and-half, non-fat mayonnaise, whipped topping ( optional ) | 30 count miniature taco shells ( optional )
instructions: Prepare your favorite taco seasoning. Serve with a few spoonfuls of yogurt, tomato salsa, etc. Top with lettuce, chopped onion, sliced olives, etc. I prefer to use my own mix of black and white refried beans. Enjoy.

title: Lemon-Chile Chicken
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 lbs chicken parts | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley flakes | 1 1/4 cups fresh lemon verbena or 1 1/4 cups fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: Combine parsley, lemon verbena, lemon juice and salt in a resealable bag. Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: key lime juice,strawberry,lemon juice zest,lime juice,kiwi fruit,macaroni
title: Kiwifruit Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 container macaroni, dry | 4 key limes, juice and zest of ( bottled is ok ) or 1/2 lemons, juice of ( bottled is ok ) | 2 tablespoons key lime juice | 2 -4 tablespoons lemon juice ( optional ) | 2 -4 kiwi fruits, sliced | 8 -10 strawberries, sliced ( or other berries )
instructions: Prepare the macaroni and put the macaroni, zest, key lime juice, lemon juice, lemon juice and kiwis into a large bowl. Add the sliced strawberries or other berries, toss gently and chill. Serve chilled with slices of lime. Variation, add fresh zest, sliced fruit, chopped fresh fruit if desired.

Random Ingredients: lager beer,red pepper flake,catsup,pasta sauce,oyster sauce,bread flour,pepper
title: Oyster Sauce Bread  Dumplings(O Yum-Ya)
ingredients: 4 cups bread flour or 4 cups flour, for dusting | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup catsup ( optional, see note below ) | 1 teaspoon pepper | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 -2 teaspoon light tasting catsup | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | salt | 1 1 cup pasta sauce ( see note below ) | 1 cup oyster sauce | white cheddar cheese or monterey jack cheese ( to sprinkle on top )
instructions: Note on recipe, 1/4 cup of catsup is 1/4 cup of oyster sauce which gives it a lighter color. Note about oyster sauce in jar, combine oyster sauce, 1/2 cup catsup and crushed red pepper flakes. Shake bottle to mix. Place remaining ingredients in the jar, seal tightly and shake vigorously to mix. Note on recipe, 1/4 cup catsup is 1/4 cup of white cheddar cheese which gives the dish a lighter color. Note on pasta sauce, i use 3/4 cup of cornstarch. It seems to be the easiest and tastiest. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil for 7 - 10 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent sticking. Remove from heat.

title: Bunuelos De Gringo
ingredients: 2 lbs raw pork ( not lean ) | 6 tablespoons fresh minced garlic ( a jar is good! ) or 6 tablespoons garlic powder ( a jar is good! ) | 1 lb eggplant, peeled, cut into 1/3 inch slices ( or 2 medium ) | 1 lb ripe plum tomato | 8 ounces fresh strawberries
instructions: Trim fat/skin from sausage and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place all ingredients in a large bowl, including the fat. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or preferably overnight, tossing several times. Cooks note, i put everything in my food processor except the strawberries just before i go to work. After chilling, add strawberries and allow to chill in fridge. This would be really good served in chinchala, coffee or rice. I also serve this with a side of raw beans or rice. This is also good with a bit of a kick to the dip.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chicken stock,asparagus,eggplant,yellow pepper
title: Pepper Eggplant (Aubergine) Soup
ingredients: 3 large eggplants | 2 yellow peppers | 5 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 cup chopped fresh asparagus
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place eggplants, peppers, and stock in a roasting pan. Bake for 40 minutes, or until tender. Cool. Slice eggplants thinly and set aside, reserving the oil. Place peppers, eggplant, and asparagus with reserved stock in a blender and turn on until smooth. Return liquid to a boil and add sauce. Stir and let sauce simmer. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: peach schnapps,rice noodle,soya sauce,red bell pepper,red chili powder,kidney bean,pork,hot chili pepper
title: Pork With Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb pork | hot chili pepper | 1 red bell pepper | 3 ounces sweet soya sauce | 3 ounces peaches schnapps | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 8 ounces rice noodles | hot chili peppers | 1/2 red bell pepper
instructions: Slice pork. Chop 1 red chili pepper, 1 red bell pepper, 1 oz soya sauce. Set aside. Soak soya sauce in hot chili. Shred pork and mix with the soya sauce. In a pot boil water add rice noodles in it. Drain the noodles when cooked.

title: Dressed  Bacalhos (Drunken Vodka Sauce)
ingredients: 200 ml red wine vinegar | 200 ml vodka | 2 teaspoons capers | salt & pepper
instructions: Bring vinegar to a boil & remove from heat. Cover & let stand 10 minutes. Combine with capers & season to taste.

title: Persian Shrimp (Shrimp) Kabobs
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, raw and peeled | 1 cup spiced spices | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread
instructions: Combine the shrimp, spices and saffron in a glass container or bowl.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,red potato,raisin,vanilla essence,water chestnut,coriander seed,sherry,okra
title: Bamia Curried Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg red potatoes, cubed | 1/2 kg okra, cut into bite size pieces | 1/2 onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup raisins | 2 cups boiling water chestnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Drain water in a bowl. Add okra and onion powder and coriander seeds to water in a large mixing bowl. Add potatoes and mix well. Add raisins, sherry and water chestnuts. Mix well and set aside for half an hour. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,chicken stock,watercress,grape leaf,tofu,yellow squash,buttermilk,cardamom pod
title: Cardamom Tofu Soup
ingredients: 200 g short cut buttermilk or 200 g yogurt, plain | watercress or 2 bunches watercress, cut in 12 pieces | 300 g fresh yellow squash, cut in 8 pieces | 1 large pinch red chili pepper flakes | 4 cardamom pods or 1 teaspoon crushed chili pepper flakes | 200 g firm tofu, cut into 2cm cubes | 1 liter chicken stock or 1 liter vegetable stock | 1/3 cup fresh grape leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, watercress or bunches of watercress, squashes, chilli and cardamom pods. Then stir in the tofu, add the soup stock and simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes, until the tofu is just translucent. Remove the cardamom pods, if using chilli flakes you can add it in now. Serve with some crusty bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: chow fun rice noodle,lemon pepper,part ricotta cheese,buttermilk,zucchini,tomato paste,sage leaf,prune
title: Zucchini & Prune Chowder
ingredients: 8 cups zucchini, cut into quarters | 1 cup pitted prunes | 2 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 cups buttermilk | 2 packages chow fun rice noodles | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 3 tablespoons lemon pepper | 12 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Boil the zucchini in salted water until almost done, 7 - 10 minutes. Drain well. Stir in the prunes, ricotta, buttermilk, rice noodles and paste. Heat through, stirring occasionally. Place sage leaves on plates and spoon soup on the leaves. Serve.

Random Ingredients: spinach,extra virgin olive oil,radish,asian chili sauce,cream corn
title: Chinese Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 3 tablespoons light cream-style corn | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon sweet asian chili sauce or 1 tablespoon sriracha hot sauce | 1 radish, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine spinach and corn in a large salad bowl. Toss lightly with dressing and arrange on a serving platter. Sprinkle with radishes.

title: Microwave Mozzarella and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and rinsed | 2 packages frozen snow peas
instructions: Toss all pieces in 1 quart glass measure with 1/2 teaspoons salt. Cover. Microwave on high 3 - 5 minutes or until cheese begins to set around edge. Stir. Stir. Microwave on medium 2 - 4 more minutes or until cheese is light and beginning to brown. Stir in sun dried tomatoes. Microwave on high 2 minutes longer or until cheese begins to melt. Stir. Microwave on high 4 - 4 more minutes or until cheese is light and starting to melt. Stir. Microwave on medium 50% longer, stirring halfway through cooking time.

title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 cups short grain rice ( or other long grain rice ) | 1 tablespoon capers, drained
instructions: Place rice in a bowl and add enough cold water to cover. Let stand in a pan of cold water by 4 - 5 inches of the surface, stirring and squeezing the rice until it forms a firm but watery shape that doubles in volume over its volume. Cover, turn off the heat and leave to stand in the pan of cold water on top until all the water is absorbed. When all the water is absorbed, fluff with a fork. Cover, then leave to stand for about 5 minutes.

title: Grilled Chorizo & Tomato on the Grill
ingredients: 200 g chipolata sausages, finely chopped | 400 g roma tomatoes, chopped | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 150 g guacamole
instructions: Combine the chipolatata, guacamole and chorizo and season with plenty of black pepper. If using a gas grill, heat for 12 - 15 mins turning with tongs.

title: Quick Black Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1 can black bean sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes
instructions: Place both cans in a medium saucepan. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to medium low. Boil and stir 2 minutes. Drain the tomato sauce into the black bean sauce mixture. Serve over your favorite side dish.

title: Ajiaco-Style Guacamole
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles, seeded and diced | 1/4 cup white sugar | 2/3 cup grated guacamole, or as needed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill weed | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Cook poblano peppers in the skillet over medium heat until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in sugar, guacamole, dill, and garam masala. Cook and stir until hot, 5 to 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Crumb Dip
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350&#730.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,shortening,stewing beef,mace,dark sesame oil
title: Beef Ghee (Yemen Dry Rub)
ingredients: 1/4 cup shortening, or more as needed | 1 pound cut stewing beef, cut into bite-sized pieces | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup light brown sesame oil | 1/4 cup ground mace | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: In a small container with a tight lid, mix 1/4 cup shortening, dark sesame oil, light brown sesame oil, mace, and salt and pepper to taste. Dice beef into 1 inch pieces and drop into oil mixture to coat. Stir frequently, and cook until meat is coated.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,ginger,maple syrup,red chilies,chickpea,cream cheese frosting,onion salt
title: Chickpea Hummus Dip
ingredients: 30 ounces chickpeas ( drained and rinsed ) | 8 ounces cream cheese frosting | 3 small red chilies ( chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 3/4 cup maple syrup | 1 lemons, juice and zest of or 3/4 cup orange juice
instructions: Process the chickpeas, cream cheese, chillies, onion salt, ginger and maple syrup in a food processor until well blended. Add lemon juice and zest as desired. Transfer to serving bowl or container and refrigerate for up to 2 days to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,beef stock,red wine,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,canola oil,heavy whipping cream,ladyfinger,vegetable stock
title: Chipotle Dessert Nests
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil, or as needed | 1/2 pound firm tofu, cut into 1 inch squares | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup beef stock | 1 cup red wine | 1/8 teaspoon chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, minced | 1/8 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 package ladyfingers, cut into pieces
instructions: Heat canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook tofu slices in hot oil until lightly browned and crisp, 1 to 2 minutes per side.

title: Cheese and Ramen Lovers' Loaf
ingredients: 4 ounces cheese, kraft meijers recipe, cubed | 6 ounces spaghetti sauce, j.c. noodle cheese flavor, cubed | 1 cup pimento, sliced | 1/2 ounce ramen noodles, flavor package
instructions: Spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray and line with reynolds wrap foil. Spray foil with cooking spray, and place in preheated oven. Bake at 350 until heated through. Remove foil. Spoon on noodles & pimentos, toss. Sprinkle with cheese. Place back in oven for about 5 minutes longer. Cut into slices.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,clam juice,orange peel,chili pepper flake,lemon juice zest,mirin
title: Apricot Glaze Clams
ingredients: 1 ounce apricot jam | 1 teaspoon orange peel, fresh, shaved into 3/4-inch matchsticks | 1/4 fresh chili pepper flakes | 3/4 cup bottled clam juice, reserved from cooking clams | 2 teaspoons lemon juice ( zest of ) | 3 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Arrange apricot, orange peel, chili pepper flakes and reserved clam juice in a glass baking dish. In a small bowl, whisk together remaining clam juice, lemon juice and mirin. Pour glaze over clams, cover, and turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,green apple,beef roast,mushroom,limeade concentrate,pink food coloring,habanero pepper
title: Habanero Hot Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 -2 cup of cubed fully cooked beef roast | 1/2 cup frozen pink food coloring, divided | 1/2 cup mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup green apple, chopped | 1/2 cup green habanero pepper, chopped | 1 can limeade concentrate
instructions: Place all ingredients into crock pot on high. Cook on high setting for a limited time, i cooked it overnight or on low for 7 hours. I have also cooked it with my favorite hot chili condiment and enjoy.

title: White Posole
ingredients: 8 ounces dried white hominy | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 cup slivered almonds, toasted, chopped | 1/3 cup radish, diced
instructions: Put the posole in a large saucepan with water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, 1 hour. Drain off the liquid, cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, skim the fat. Place posole and almonds in a skillet with the remaining liquid and cook, uncovered, over medium heat 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has been thickened and posole is creamy and heated through, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,mace,sun tomato oil,sea bass fillet,red onion,queso fresco,red pepper,chili paste
title: Spanish Sizzling Sea Bass
ingredients: 1 1 lb sea bass fillets | 1 -2 tablespoon chili paste, i use la chin de ajillo pepperjack | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped red onion | 1/2 cup chopped red pepper | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange zest, from 1/4 lime
instructions: Rinse and dry your sea bass. Score top and bottom of the sea bass filets on both sides with a knife. The idea is to slice the entire length of the filets. Lay them in a flat baking dish. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix together chilli paste, sun dried tomatoes, red onion, bell pepper, mace, orange zest and juice and pour over top of the fillets. Bake covered for about 30 minutes until fish is easily flaked with a fork. If the sauce gets too thick, cook uncovered for a 15 minutes. You can make this up to 2 days ahead of time. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: watercress,dijon mustard,limeade,rump roast,italian salad dressing,mint leaf,egg yolk,stewing beef
title: Steak Salad
ingredients: 6 lbs pork loin or 6 lbs rump roast, cut into thin strips | 4 large egg yolks, well beaten | 1 whole egg yolk ( use one whole egg ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh italian salad dressing | 8 leaves watercress | 24 -36 fresh mint leaves | 4 stalks celery or 4 stalks trimmed of tough stems
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine the pork, egg yolks, egg yolk, mustard, salad dressing and watercress. Place two beef roulades in the center of the mixture and pound the meat to 1/4 inch thickened, 2 to 3/4 inches in diameter. Cut the beef strips crosswise into 3/8 inch wide strips. Using 2 forks, pull the meat apart. Place 1/8 of the beef and 1/8 of the watercress leaves in the bottom of a slow cooker. Top with 1/3 of the beef and watercress mixture and 1/3 of the mint leaves. Repeat with the remaining beef and watercress and mint leaves. Cover and cook on high for 6 hours. Turn slow cooker to low and cook for 1 1/2 hours longer or until meat is very tender. Stir the celery or stalks with 1/2 teaspoon salt and the remaining 1/8 of mustard. Serve the salad on a large platter or individual plates. Garnish with the remaining mint, if desired.

Random Ingredients: panko bread crumb,molasses,clear honey,salt black pepper,salsa
title: Salsa Mexicano, an Authentic Brazilian Sweet and Sour Salsa
ingredients: 2 jars salsa ( i like the fire roasted variety ) | 3/4 cup panko bread crumbs ( bread crumbs ) | 1 tablespoon clear honey ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon molasses or 1 teaspoon cornstarch | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place the panko in a bowl and add the honey and molasses. Stir to combine. Stir in salsa. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Adjust seasoning using salt, pepper, or vinegar to taste to your personal tastes. If using corn tortillas you can roll them up and slice into 1 inch strips. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,baby spinach,rice vinegar,lemon wedge,pimento olive,whipping cream
title: Shannon's Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 bag baby carrots | 1 lb of fresh baby spinach | 8 ounces pimento stuffed olives | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 lemon wedge
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cut baby carrots in quarter lengthwise. Add to boiling water and stir. Turn off heat and cool until just slightly cool. You don't want to cook the cabbage at this time. Remove all of the top part of the stems of the green leaves from the leaves, leaving just a bit of the green leaves attached to them. Slice carrots to desired thickness. Drain cabbage leaves into a large bowl and add the sliced carrots. Dressing, combine whipping cream, rice vinegar, and lemon wedges in a separate bowl. Whisk until blended well but not too frothy. Pour dressing over the carrots and mix. Garnish with green leaf stems.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,orange juice concentrate,vanilla sugar,alfredo sauce,italian parsley,lamb shoulder
title: Lamb with Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless lamb shoulder ( about 2 - 3 lbs ) or 4 lbs lamb blade steaks ( about 2 - 3 lbs ) | 1/2 cup freshly squeezed orange juice concentrate | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 3/4 cup freshly squeezed jarred alfredo sauce | 3 tablespoons fresh minced italian parsley | 1/4 cup vanilla ice cream
instructions: Cut lamb or steaks into serving portions and place in freezer for 5 - 6 hours. Combine orange juice concentrate, vanilla sugar, and half of the alfredo sauce in a small pot. Cook over medium heat. Stirring constantly, simmer about 10 minutes until mixture begins to thicken. Remove from heat. Drain any liquid on the lamb or steak. If desired, pour warm alfredo sauce mixture evenly over the top and mix well. Transfer to a dish and cover. Refrigerate up to 2 - 3 days or freeze up to 6 months. To serve, place on serving platter and garnish with remaining alfredo sauce mixture, parsley, and vanilla ice cream.

title: Tripe With Panko (Japanese Beef Strips)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat or 3 lbs cut up pork loin | 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 lbs beef tripe, trimmed of excess fat
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place meat in an oven proof skillet. Combine bread crumbs, bread crumbs, and beef in a bowl. Dip the rims of the beef strips. Toss beef strips with bread crumb/panko mixture evenly and place on top of meat. Place skillet in the oven. Bake for 2 hours, basting frequently with pan juices.

title: Spicy Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted pistachios, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh lemon grass, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh gingerroot, finely chopped | 1/2 cup oriental sesame oil | seasoning salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until well combined. Season with salt, if desired.

Random Ingredients: steak,pepperoni,stewing beef,beef burger,cottage cheese,american cheese,roast pork loin,pear
title: American Beef and Pear Burger
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut up in small cubes | 1 lb boneless steak, cut up in small cubes | 1 lb boneless pork loin, cut up in small cubes | 2 pears, peeled, cored and cut into small cubes | 1 package refrigerated beef and pear refrigerated cocktail cheese rolls | 1 package fat free cottage cheese | 1 slice american cheese | 1 slice jarred deli sliced pepperoni
instructions: Place the cubed beef and pork in a large bowl. Cover with water and soak for at least 1/2 hour. Drain off the water and then add the to the beef and pork. Mix until the meat is well coated. Set aside to marinate. In a large bowl mix 1 package of cocktail cheese with the cottage cheese, beef and pear. Shape into 6 patties or larger. Place them in a large roaster or baking dish. Top with the american cheese slices. Cover with the remaining package of cocktail cheese. Cover the top cheese with pepperoni slices. Cook in the oven at 350 degrees for 30 - 35 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes, covered. Slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,pasta,cod fish fillet,hard egg,ginger garlic paste,honey,ancho chile powder,green bean
title: Ancho Cod With Feta Cheese, Green Beans and Ancho Chile.
ingredients: 12 ounces cod fish fillets | 3/4 lb fresh green beans | 1/4 lb fresh shelled fresh green beans ( or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons chopped crystallized ancho chile chili powder, to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger and garlic paste | 1/4 cup honey | 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, sliced lengthwise into six halves | 4 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Boil water in a saucepan. Boil the green beans until just tender crisp. Drain in a colander. Drain on paper towels. Cut into 1 inch pieces and set aside. Bring a medium saucepan to a simmer. Add the ancho chile, ginger and garlic paste. Cook for about one minute. Reduce heat. Add the honey and cook for about 10 minutes. Stir in the shrimp, green beans, and green beans. Simmer for about 15 minutes until shrimp are pink and just slightly firm.

title: Shave's Italian Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups italian salad dressing | 1 cup butter
instructions: In a medium sauce pan, combine salad dressing and butter. Cook and stir over low heat until butter melts. Remove from heat. Slowly pour hot dressing into butter, stirring continuously until mixture is smooth.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,arborio rice,pineapple chunk,chili powder,worcestershire sauce
title: Thai Pineapple Risotto
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups low sodium beef stock | 1 cup canned pineapple chunk ( reserve juice ) | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | arborio rice or medium grain rice, cooked al dente
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan, mix stock, pineapple juice, worcestershire sauce, chili powder and reserved pineapple juice. Heat just until hot. Pour over rice, stir gently to coat.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,onion powder,corn tortilla chip,vegetable shortening,coconut milk,vanilla extract,rye bread,italian plum tomato
title: Baja Chips
ingredients: 12 corn tortilla chips | 12 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup canola oil | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes, with liquid | 2 cans coconut milk | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning ( can use mrs. dash ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: In a bowl mix all dry ingredient together. Spray a cookie sheet with non stick coating. Sprinkle corn chips over the sheet. In the blender, grind the tomatoes and the coconut milk together until blended.. Set aside. Heat oil in a frying pan on medium high heat. When oil is hot, dip corn chips one at a time into oil, allowing them to soak for 10 seconds on each side. Remove the chips and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake in a pre heated 350°f oven for 10 - 13 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: white hominy,red enchilada sauce,arborio rice,lemon peel,strawberry jell o gelatin dessert,celery rib,liquid smoke
title: Lemon Grass and Strawberry Jell-O Chile Conchiladas
ingredients: 2 packages jell-o gelatin dessert | 1 box frozen white hominy, thawed | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 6 ounces chopped fresh strawberries with jell-o | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke ( optional ) | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | cooked ground rice ( optional )
instructions: Prepare jello per package instructions. Cool to room temperature. Place the thawed jello in a small mixing bowl. Chop the rhubarb, and add to jello. Process until blended.. Drain the thawed hominy. Reserve the 2 cans. Place half the hominy in a microwave safe dish, cover with 2 cups of the enchilada sauce, and microwave on high 20 seconds to soften. Stir mixture, remove from microwave and set aside. Repeat with remaining half the hominy, hominy mixture and sauce. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease 10 inch casserole dish. In a medium bowl combine the thawed hominy strips, chopped celery, liquid smoke and optional garnishes. If desired, stir into the prepared hominy mixture. Divide mixture into three. Place 1 to 2 heaping tablespoons of the jello mixture into each casserole dish. Place in hot oven and bake 25 - 35 minutes, or until bubbly and slightly browned.

title: Mock Nut Crisps
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely crushed corn chips | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 1 cup finely crushed walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together the corn chips, brown sugar and chopped nuts until they are well combined. Roll a teaspoonful of the mixture, into small balls, and place on parchment paper lined baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven for about 12 minutes, or until just lightly browned and crispy. Cool on the baking sheets, and store in an airtight container until serving.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,lemon zest,anise seed,napa cabbage,hot green chili pepper,maraschino cherry
title: Lebanese Kimchee
ingredients: 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, freshly grated | 1 cup napa cabbage, shredded | 1 cup apricot jam | 2 tablespoons hot green chili peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup maraschino cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix the ground anise and lemon zest together in a bowl and set aside. Bring a medium size pot of water to a boil. Add the napa cabbage. Cook until just tender. Drain water and remove any undesirable pieces of cabbage. Add the jam to the cabbage. Mix well, and turn off the heat. When cool, stir in the chopped chiles. Transfer to a glass baking dish lined with parchment paper. Pour the anise and lemon zest mixture over the cabbage, then spread the apricot jam over the top. Scatter the maraschino cherries over the jam. Bake uncovered, until hot and bubbly, about 25 minutes.

title: Szechuan Peppercorn Jam
ingredients: 1 kg ripe grape tomatoes | 2 1/2 kg szechuan peppercorns | 10 cups tamarind juice | 500 g honeydew | 1 cup corn oil | 1 bunch orange rind
instructions: Bring peppercorns, tamarind juice, honey and oil to a boil. Add tomatoes and cook over low heat for 40 - 45 minutes. Add orange peel and peel to jam. Stir, simmer for 5 minutes and strain out seeds and serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,egg,romaine lettuce,puff pastry,taco sauce,peking duck,heavy cream
title: Duck and Chicken Puff Pastry Wrappers
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 12 ounces fresh peking duck | 2 eggs | 1 1/2 cups taco sauce | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the puff pastry sheets onto a clean work surface and place each onto a baking sheet. If possible, place a roasting pan on the top rack of the oven with the hot oven rack positioned on the oven rack. If you like your puffs to be soft and chewy, bake them to desired color. Allow the pastry to come to room temperature before wrapping each patty in pastry, placing it, seam side down, onto the prepared baking sheet. Beat the eggs in a shallow bowl. Dip each patty, one at a time, into the eggs, then coat on all sides with taco sauce. Bake in the preheated oven until the pastries are puffed and crispy, about 25 minutes. Serve with the lettuce and pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,palm sugar,salad oil,onion soup mix,white onion,flat leaf italian parsley,cardamom pod,bacon
title: Bahama Mama's Salad
ingredients: 1 package uncooked rice noodles | 4 slices bacon, sliced into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 small white onion, thinly sliced | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/3 cup palm sugar | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom pods | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1/3 cup salad oil
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add the rice noodles, and cook for about 8 to 10 minutes, until just tender. Drain, and rinse. Set aside. Place bacon in a large, deep skillet, and cook over medium heat until evenly brown. Drain any grease, but leave about 2 tablespoons. Add the white onion, and cook until transparent, but not browned. Stir in the soup mix, palm sugar, cardamom pods, parsley, and salad oil. Heat through, then remove from heat, and cover to keep warm. Toss with warm rice noodles to coat. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,italian bread,red grape,parmesan cheese,salsa,tortilla chip,wide egg noodle
title: Lighter Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 bag wide egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1 bag refrigerated white and light varieties tortilla chips | 2 cups red grapes, cut in half | 1/2 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | kosher salt | shredded italian bread
instructions: In a large bowl mix pasta, tortilla chips, grapes, salsa and cheese. Sprinkle with kosher salt. Chill.

title: Vegan Green Chili Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried ground green chilies | 0.5 can pumpkin puree | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Mix all the dry ingredients together. You can store them in an airtight jar or use on a cookie sheet as a condiment.

title: Banana Lassi
ingredients: 1 fluid ounce banana liqueur | 1 fluid ounce yogurt | 1 teaspoon red curry paste
instructions: Blend all the ingredients together. Add ice cubes. Serve over ice cubes.

title: Sardine (A Portuguese Salad)
ingredients: 4 cans sardines, drained | 4 tablespoons grated cheese ( como is best )
instructions: Drain the sardines well and remove the skin, then cut into fine shreds. Mix with grated cheese and keep in an airtight container. This salad will keep in the refrigerator for months.

title: Barley and Yoghurt Potato Rounds
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato | 3 tablespoons yoghurt or 3 tablespoons sour cream | sour cream, optional, to serve | chopped scallion, to serve | 1 -2 tablespoon pearl barley, cooked, to serve
instructions: Preheat the barbecue grill to medium heat. Line a baking tray with tin foil or non stick baking paper. Slice the potatoes into rounds about 2/3 inch thick. Transfer to the baking tray and brush each half with 1 tbsp of yoghurt or sour cream. Cook on the barbecue for 10 - 15 minutes until golden and crispy.. Serve with the extra sour cream, or with salads of your choice. Serve with spring onions or spring onions. Note, some folks might like to use more yoghurt than stated on the ingredients.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker square,onion,beef brisket,cardamom,mature cheddar cheese,vanilla bean,cauliflower
title: Kosher-Rubbed Beef Brisket (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs corned beef brisket | 1/4 cup graham cracker square | 1/4 cup mature cheddar cheese | 1 medium onion, sliced | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup small cauliflower, halved crosswise | 1 tablespoon vanilla beans, seeds scraped
instructions: Place corned beef and 2 cups water into a 2 quart slow cooker and cover tightly. Cook on low heat setting 6 - 8 hours or until beef is very tender. Allow beef to rest at room temperature 20 minutes. While cooking, prepare remaining toppings. Crush graham cracker squares and place in bottom of a 12 inch heavy duty baking dish with a rim. Sprinkle bread crumbs over crackers. Cover beef with cheese. Sprinkle with spices. Bake in a 325 degree oven uncovered about 20 minutes. Cut and serve.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Toss the sun dried tomato bits with the mayonnaise, mustard seeds and spread on toasted french or italian bread slices.

title: Green Enchilladas
ingredients: 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. In medium bowl, mix enchilada sauce and dijon mustard.

title: Corned Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red cabbage ( shredded or sliced fine ) | 1 lb thin egg noodles ( wheat is fine too ) or ( 16 ounce ) package egg noodles ( wheat is fine too ) | 2/3 cup gruyere cheese ( shredded or sliced ) | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Place noodles in pot of salted boiling water. Bring to boil and cover. Let cook until tender, approx 10 minutes. Meanwhile, saute cabbage in 2 tbls. Oil for approx 8 minutes or till lightly browned and set aside. Drain noodles well and rinse under hot water and drain again making sure noodles are dry. Mix cabbage with other ingredients in a large mixing bowl to combine. Toss with mustard until well coated. Makes enough to serve as a side dish to eat with crusty bread.

title: Tortillas With Wild Rice and Apple
ingredients: 6 tortillas, 8 inch diameter | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 cup wild rice | 2 cups tart apples ( optional )
instructions: Heat a non stick nonstick skillet over high heat. Place 1 tortilla in the hot skillet. Top with 1/4 teaspoon chili sauce and 1/4 teaspoon of the rice mixture. Sprinkle with 1/8 teaspoon of the grated cheese. Repeat and top with remaining tortilla, chili& rice mixture. Wrap the skillet with a large piece of foil and place on a plate in a 350 f oven for 15 minutes or until hot. Cut into 8 wedges and serve.

title: Smoked Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1/5 cup chopped smoked brussels sprouts | 3 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high. Whisk the chili powder into a 1/4 cup of water. Lightly oil the grill grate. Thread 2 brussels sprouts onto each skewer. Arrange on the grill, close the lid, and cook 1 1/2 minutes, or until sprouts are bright green.

title: Oyster Mushroom Potatoes
ingredients: 1 kg baby potatoes | 6 oyster mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons sugar syrup
instructions: Boil whole potato and cook until cooked. Allow to cool. While cooking fry mushrooms until tender.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,taco seasoning,kangaroo fillet,cardamom seed,white wine vinegar,lime wedge,fish,tamari
title: Kangaroo Satay
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons tamari or 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning ( or other mild-flavored seasoning ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons other vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon whole cardamom seed | 4 skinless kangaroo fillets or 4 skinless other white fish, cut into 6 strips | lime wedge, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Combine vinegar, tamari and next 5 ingredients in bowl. Let marinate 30 minutes. Preheat barbecue. Thread meat onto skewers. Grill, uncovered, over medium heat, with lid closed, turning often, about 3 - 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: jerk seasoning,gouda cheese,cream tartar,rice wine,velveeta cheese
title: Gouda & Velveeta Cheesebread
ingredients: 2 ounces sharp smoked gouda cheese ( or other strong cheese ) | 1 ounce velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | sour cream or sour cream, to serve | jerk seasoning, to serve | chunky sweet rice wine, to serve
instructions: Cut cheese in half and place on a serving plate with a drizzle of sour cream.

title: Mexican Street Corn and Artichoke Nests
ingredients: 6 ears mexican corn, shucked | 6 artichoke hearts, trimmed | 2/3 cup green mexican-style corn or 2/3 cup red corn | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1/4 cup blue curacao ( optional ) | tortillas or bread
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Grill the corn until tender, about 6 minutes. Meanwhile, peel the artichokes, then cut into thin slices. Remove the kernels and set aside. Slice the artichokes into thin strips. Toss the corn with the artichokes, if using, and season to taste with cardamom. Divide the corn chips between the 6 nests of corn and artichokes. Drizzle with curacado, if using, and grill until golden and hot, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,corn,celery,yogurt,white wine,cream mushroom soup
title: Swiss Corn Casserole
ingredients: 3 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 jar corn | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 cup finely chopped celery | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Put the corn, soup, yogurt, and celery into a blender. Pour into a 4 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with greek cheese and crumbs. Heat in toaster on stove, or in oven oven until bubbly around edges.

Random Ingredients: shallot,sesame seed,penne pasta,pearl barley,chutney,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Chutney Corn Chutney Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 lb penne pasta, cooked until tender | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 2 tablespoons minced shallots | 1 1/2 cups chili-style chutney
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, stir sesame seeds, barley, pepperjack cheese, shallots and chutney in a skillet over low heat until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,double cream,coriander,clam juice,panir,pork rib,ricotta cheese
title: Creamy Pork and Garlic Coated Crimple Crusted Pork
ingredients: 450 g chopped bacon | 450 g pork ribs, finely chopped | 230 g plain flour | 230 g ricotta cheese | 150 ml bottled clam juice | 1 cup double cream ( not low-fat ) | 1 teaspoon coriander, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Fry bacon until coloured then remove. Add meat and fry until browned, stir in flour and cook for 3 5mins or until mixture starts to develop a paste and then stir in ricotta cheese. Mix well. Gradually stir in clam juice, stirring until combined. Simmer for 10 minutes and allow to cool before using. Pour over the crusted pork and decorate if desired with coriander, if desired.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,pasta,oyster,beef chuck,stewing beef,white bread,ranch dressing mix
title: Beef, Oysters and Wild Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean stewing beef, cut into cubes | 1/2 lb lean stewing beef, cut into cubes | 1 can oysters, drained and rinsed | 1 packet dry ranch dressing mix | 1 envelope active dry yeast | 8 cups cooked wild oats | 1.5 packages soft warm pasta
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in heavy pot on stove top. Cover tightly with oil cover and let rise in warm place to rise for 2 hours. Cook on high heat for an additional 10 minutes or until mixture comes to boil and thickens and reaches desired consistency. Serve over hot pasta.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,dressing,sun tomato oil
title: Fantastic Sun Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 -4 teaspoons good seasons dressing
instructions: Prepare a jar filled with water with some ice cubes. Pour the sun dried tomatoes into a blender or food processor. Blend until tomatoes become very finely diced. Add the olive oil, 1 tablespoon at a time, blending until blended. Pour dressing into bottle or container and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Shake bottle or container periodically to help preserve tomatoes.

title: Shoyu Beef With Portobello (Cambodian-American Restaurant)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs sirloin steaks | 1 -1 1/2 cup cilantro | 1/2 lb portobello mushroom | 3 egg yolks | tamarind juice, to taste
instructions: In a container that is large enough to accomodate the steak, add 2 - 3 cups of water, cilantro and portobello mushrooms. Marinate in the refrigerator for 2 - 3 hours or overnight. In a bowl, mix egg yolks with tamarind juice. Drain steak and slice across grain about 3/8 inch thick. Spread steaks with sauce and sprinkle with tamarind sauce.

Random Ingredients: date,onion soup mix,canadian bacon,red pepper flake,chicken stock,fish sauce
title: Australian Sausage with dates and fresh green vegies (Low Fat)
ingredients: 4 smoked sausage | 1 package onion soup mix | 4 tablespoons fish sauce | 3/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 3/4 cups chicken stock ( i use organic ) | 1/2 cup pitted dates, chopped
instructions: Remove casings from sausage. Cut sausage into 1 inch chunks. Place sausage pieces and remaining ingredients in crockpot. Add chicken stock and stir. Cook on stovetop on high for 30 minutes.

title: Low Fat Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 bottle cranberries | 1 bunch green onion, sliced | 1/2 cup dried chiles | 1 tablespoon dried onion salt | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Add all ingredients to slow cooker. Cover. Cook on low heat 2 hours. Note, i use the quick cooker version of my slow cooker.

title: Plum Tomatoes and Peaches
ingredients: 1 can italian plums, chopped | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 2 tablespoons curry paste, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1/4 cup golden raisins
instructions: Stir plum tomatoes, peaches, curry paste, and raisins together in a bowl. Chill 1 hour.

title: Pepperoni Bread
ingredients: 1 cup dry buttermilk | 1/2 cup low-sodium black pepperoni, minced | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup crouton
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a small bowl, beat together the buttermilk, pepperoni, brown sugar, and asafoetida.

title: Hot Beer (Barley, Orange, and Beer)
ingredients: 2 large oranges, peeled | 4 1/2 cups cold water | 1 bottle barley
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pot.

title: Mandarin Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 cup blackberries | 2 cans mandarin oranges | 1 can condensed beef broth
instructions: Combine the blackberries in a large pot over medium high heat, and bring to a boil. Allow to simmer until berries pop, about 5 minutes, then carefully place the blackberries in a pot of cold water.

title: Saffron Lime Nachos
ingredients: 12 small saffron strands | 20 sprigs fresh cilantro ( leaves only ) or 20 sprigs fresh mint ( leaves only ) | 1 lime wedge | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Place saffron threads in a wide, shallow saucer. Moisten the cilantro leaves with 1 teaspoons water and let set till they are pliable. Transfer to a mortar or food processor. Add lime juice, marjoram, and saffron. Mixture should be moist but not oily. Pound lightly. Scoop into an ungreased baking dish. Sprinkle top with salt, if desired. Chill 30 minutes, or more, until firm and easy to work with. Cut into six wedges with a sharp knife. Let stand 30 minutes. Makes 10 servings. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Tippyshire Clapshot
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled, cut into chunks | 1 cup white flour | 1 cup tamari or 1 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup chopped sweet pickle | 1/2 cup pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepot, cover parsnips with cold salted water and bring to a boil.

title: Basic Makroudo Bread for Samosas and Chicken
ingredients: 1 pita bread | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 -3 kaffir lime leaves or 2 -3 thai lemons
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Wash, dry and tear the pita or bread into pieces roughly the size of a small dinner plate. Lay them on cookie sheet, slightly on the bottom of the oven, if your oven is an oven with lots of room at the bottom. Place pita or bread in the oven. When hot and bubbly around the edges, carefully push the pita or bread with your finger in towards the upper edge of the oven. The bread will immediately start puffed and the pita will quickly puff up. After about 10 - 15 minutes, the bread should be puffed up and firm. Turn bread upside down on the tray and quickly close up the door. Try not to break the bread through the tray. Bake samosas until bread is slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,irish cream,fast rising yeast,curry leaf,part mozzarella cheese,spearmint,pinto bean
title: Creamy Cholent
ingredients: 1 package fast rising yeast | 1 can pinto beans | 10 ounces mushrooms, sliced thin | 3 tablespoons spearmint | 3 -4 fresh curry leaves ( optional ) | 2 -4 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/2 1/2 cup irish cream or 1/2 cup cream cheese mayonnaise
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warmed pinto beans, add sliced mushrooms, spearmint, and curry leaves. Place on greased cookie sheet, and cover with a round of foil. Allow to rise in a warm, not hot, place for 40 - 50 minutes. Once doubled, punch down, and remove the foil. Turn the dough out onto the greased cookie sheet. Cut the top off the dough and sprinkle with shredded mozzarella cheese in small rounds, or into a 1” squares for a tasty vegetarian/veggie loaf. Place 2 cups of hot tap water in a skillet. Heat on high until boiling. Drop in the square of bread and cook, turning once, until golden, 3 - 5 minutes. You can cook it over medium high heat in 2 batches, but it might be tricky to turn them after about 3 - 5 minutes so that they cook evenly. Enjoy.

title: Sweet and Crispy Cabbage (Shakshuka) Rollups
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage, cut in 6 wedges | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted and halved | coarse salt or sea salt | 4 tablespoons shortening | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cabbage wedges in a greased 13 by 9 inch baking pan and rub with salt. Let stand 10 minutes. Cut off ends. Cut in half crosswise. Set 1 wedge aside. Repeat with remaining wedge. Combine the oil, anise, and almond extracts. Spread over cabbage wedges. Place slices upright atop cabbages. Dent remaining wedge with tip of sharp knife. Using a sharp pointed knife, gently press the bread to adhere. Bake until very light brown, about 30 minutes. Cut into squares with a sharp knife. Insert the remaining wedge back into the bread, with crumbled anise seeds. Serve warm.

title: Lettuce Wrapped Okra
ingredients: 1/2 pound frozen okra | 1 pound linguine | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | salt to taste | 1 package frozen miniature phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1/2 pound cooked crumbled cooked bacon and seasoned stuffing
instructions: Defrost the okra, then slice off the hard ends. Cut into 1/8 inch slices if using frozen okra. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add linguine and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Lemon Pepper Fish Tacos (Baja Style)
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked frozen shortening ( or butter ) | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, or to taste | 1 jar chili hot pepper sauce, or to taste | 1 cup corn chips
instructions: Grease a baking sheet with the shortening and sprinkle half of the savory, lemon juice, and hot pepper sauce on top. Roll each piece of fish in the mixture.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,escarole,lipton onion soup mix,greek yogurt,pea,lemon wedge
title: Easy, Healthy and Delicious Escarole Soup
ingredients: 15 ounces frozen peas, thawed | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 envelope lipton onion soup mix | 4 cups packed shredded escarole | 10 ounces greek yogurt | lemon wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Pour peas and limeade into large pot and heat on low heat for about 3 - 5 minutes. Stir soup mix into warm soup, then add escarole. Cook 15 minutes or until soup is heated through. Remove soup and stir in a little yogurt, then serve in soup or place in a large bowl on a serving platter or bowl.

title: Dynamite Beef and Potato
ingredients: 12 red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 can tomato juice | 1 1/2 pounds beef chuck, cut into cubes
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender but still firm, about 15 minutes. Drain, and let cool. Place the beef cubes into a saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until thickened, about 20 minutes. Remove the meat, and drain excess fat. Return the meat to the pan, and stir in tomato juice. Bring to a simmer, and cook 30 minutes.

title: Mile High Ground Beef
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 3 ounces safflower oil or 3 ounces extra virgin olive oil | 1 -2 cup frozen green pea, thawed | 2 -4 teaspoons ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoni ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cook ground sirloin in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, stirring often, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Drain. In separate small bowl, whisk oil into remaining oil. Remove skillet from heat. Return meat to skillet. Add peas, if desired. Combine and cook until heated through, about 3 - 5 minutes. Spoon into serving dish and sprinkle with pepperoni.

title: Baked Dutch Onion Ring
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, peeled and sliced very thinly ( about 12 medium ) | 1 cup dark rum, such as myers's
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Toss onions in a large bowl with rum and coat well. Place in a shallow roasting pan. Bake 30 minutes or until onions are browned and very tender, turning frequently.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,cheddar cheese,italian dressing,monterey jack pepper cheese,pickle relish,pancake syrup
title: French Onion Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup pancake syrup | 1 tablespoon cilantro pickle relish | 2 teaspoons italian dressing | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Spread on warm dough.

title: Fried Tortellini With Chilies
ingredients: 12 ounces large cheese tortellini | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil ( for frying ) | 1 small serrano chilies
instructions: In a medium pot bring water to a boil while working in batches. While oil is heating in a large skillet, peel and dice the chilli. Slice tortellini lengthwise and fry in oil. When browned, drain on paper towels. Reheat the oil in the skillet, add tortellini and fry for 2 minutes on each side. Serve.

title: Fijras (Jordanian Beef Soup)
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup plums, chopped | 2 black cardamom pods | 4 lbs rinsed, dried plums
instructions: Place meat in a 3 1/2 quart or larger skillet, pour in enough water to cover meat. Bring to boil, reduce heat to low and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Skim off fat. Add plums and cardamom pods. Simmer for 1 1/4 hours. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,ginger,orzo pasta,red chile pepper,tuna,whipping cream,vanilla pudding
title: Hot Tuna and Orzo
ingredients: 1 package instant vanilla pudding | 1 can tuna, drained and flaked | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 stalks chopped fresh ginger | 1/4 cup chopped fresh garlic, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thai red chile peppers | 1/4 cup orzo pasta
instructions: Place the instant vanilla pudding in a microwave safe bowl or serving dish and cook in the microwave until warmed, 3 to 5 minutes. Place the tuna in a microwave safe bowl. Heat the cream to just barely simmering on the stove top. Stir in the ginger, garlic, chile peppers, tuna mixture, and orzo.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin,grape leaf,dijon mustard,egg yolk,snow pea,extra large egg
title: Pumpkin and Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 extra large egg yolks | 100 g pumpkin, chopped | 50 g snow peas, chopped | 1 grape leaf | 4 tablespoons extra-large egg yolks | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil or 1 tablespoon extra-large olive oil
instructions: Beat egg yolks in a bowl, add pumpkin, snow peas, and grape leaves. Mix together oil and egg yolks in a small bowl. Pour 1 tbsp egg yolk mixture into the pumpkin mixture and whisk until the egg is dissolved. Place yolk mixture back into bowl and blend it with the pumpkin/egg mixture. Heat a knob of the oil in a large frying pan, cook the egg mixture for 2 minutes, shaking the pan from time to time, until it is set. Transfer to a plate and serve with lettuce leaves.

title: Homemade Romano Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs raspberries in pasta sauce | 28 ounces tomato basil pasta sauce | 1 cup semolina
instructions: Prepare romano pasta according to the package directions and set aside. Cut raspberries in half. Remove seeds with a small spoon and reserve. Place raspberries in a food processor and add 3/4 cup sundried tomato sauce plus 2 tbspns romano pasta sauce. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Pour the romano sauce into a bowl and add the semolina or wheat shapes into a marble sized mound on top, shaping into a marble sized mound. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Preparation time 1 hour and 45 minutes. Let the romano sauce cool before serving with ravioli or ravioli pasta.

title: Pumpkin Pork Stew
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1/3 cup soymilk or 1/3 cup yogurt | 1/3 cup soymilk | 1/2 lb ground pork or 1/2 lb ground turkey | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In a 6 quart kettle with lid heat together the oil, pumpkin. Dissolve 1/3 cup soymilk or yogurt in 1/3 cup milk and pour over the pan.

title: Golden Syrup Crusted Tilapia
ingredients: 1 pound tilapia fillets | 1 can refrigerated crackers | 1/3 cup golden syrup
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place the crackers in a bowl with enough warm water to cover. Toss with fingers for 5 minutes to wet. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Place the tilapia fillets on a baking tray, and spread each with the golden syrup. Bake in the preheated oven until the fish is easily flaked with a fork, about 20 minutes.

title: Tuna and Hot Poppy Seed Salad
ingredients: 6 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 head cabbage, shredded | 1 bunch cabbage, shredded | sugar, to taste | 1 1/2 lbs tuna steaks, cut into chunks
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. When hot, add poppy seeds. Be careful not to burn the seeds, as this is the point that makes the oil in the tuna shine. Sear tuna quickly on both sides. Drain on paper towels. In a large bowl, combine cabbage, poppy seed salt, and 1 1/2 cups cold water. Let sit for 2 minutes and stir. Toss with the tuna chunks. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,beef,saffron,flat leaf parsley,chipotle pepper,baking powder,water chestnut,pearl barley
title: Chipotle Beef and Barley Risotto
ingredients: 3 cups beef, diced | 1 small bunch flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley ( not medium-grain ) | 2 chipotle peppers, chopped | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a medium bowl, stir together the beef, parsley, water chestnuts, barley, chipotle peppers, baking powder and saffron. Spread about 1/3 cup risequing water in the bottom of an 11x7 inch baking dish. Spread the beef mixture over the liquid. Top with remaining risequing water. Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees, about 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, fat trimmed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine vinegar, fenugreek seeds, and 1/4 cup cold water.

title: Welsh Olive Tapenade with Sage
ingredients: 1 cup spanish olives | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried sage leaves
instructions: Place all ingredients in a mortar and pound with a pestle. Let stand 30 minutes. Transfer to a container, pour tapenade over, and refrigerate 2 to 3 days. Serve at once.

title: Spiced Tomato & Pepper Jam
ingredients: 1 jar roma tomatoes, whole ripened, drained | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained | 2 tablespoons turmeric | 1 1/4 cups red wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pot bring to simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, cover. Simmer 4 to 24 hours or until mixture is reduced by 1/, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a heat resistant container and let cool completely. Stir occasionally while setting for an open fire can be purchased in most supermarkets. Seal in a jar in a sealed, hot water bath for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from water bath and store at room temperature for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,active yeast,vanilla bean,creamy peanut butter,tamari
title: Peanut Butter-Stuffed Eggs
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs | 2 lbs creamy peanut butter | 1 cup melted butter | 1 cup tamari | 6 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Peel the eggs and remove the yolks from the white. Cut the whites from the yolks and set aside to make them easier to handle. Beat the whites until light and fluffy. Add the remaining ingredients and mix. Cut the whites into six pieces. Place the pieces in a greased 9x13 inch pyrex dish with lots of space around them and pour in the peanut butter mixture. Sprinkle the top with a little cinnamon. In a preheated oven, bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Let cool a little. Pick out the pieces and serve with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,bacon,sourdough starter,pork butt,chicken breast half,green pepper,plum tomato,puff pastry
title: Pittsburgh Pot Pulled Pork, Chicken and Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 4 1/4 lbs boneless pork butt, shoulder or 4 1/4 lbs boneless shoulder | 1 lb boneless pork butt, shoulder or 1 lb boneless pork butt | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 1/2 cups diced green peppers | 1 2/3 cups canned plum tomatoes, drained, chopped | 1 container frozen sourdough starter, thawed | 4 puff pastry sheets | 4 slices coarse country-style bacon, cooked & chopped
instructions: If using pork shoulder, remove excess fat. Slice crosswise into 1/2 x 1/4 inch slices. If using boneless shoulder, cut into 1/4 inch slices, and cut into 1 1/2 inch slices. If using boneless shoulder, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add pork pieces.

title: Quick and Easy Taco Nite
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 lbs bacon, cooked, drained and broken up | 2 bay leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Prepare the package of taco seasoning according to package directions, using only 1 1/2 cups of water. Set aside. Wrap bacon up in a paper towel and place on paper towels. Place in a roasting pan large enough to fit all four nite cookers in a single layer, in the oven. Roast nite for 20 minutes, turn oven off, and allow nite to sit for 10 - 15 more minutes, depending on oven temperature.

title: Rumi's Famous Cashew Dip
ingredients: 2 cans chunky salsa | 25 raw cashews
instructions: In a blender, mix cashews and salsa. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: salt substitute,cold water,lasagna noodle,hoisin sauce,apricot preserve,cottage cheese
title: Lazy Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle | 6 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 4 tablespoons cold water | 1 teaspoon salt substitute | 2 cups fat-free cottage cheese
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and cool under cold water. In a small bowl, mix 1 tbsp of the hoisin sauce, 1 tbsp of apricot preserves, and 2 tbsp of the cold water. Spread half of the cottage cheese on the bottom of a 13 x 9 pan. Place the lasagna noodles on top of the cottage cheese, then spread a layer of noodles, then spread remaining cottage cheese on top. Spread remaining 1 tbsp of hoisin sauce over the top. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours and up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,center pork chop,lemon juice,red pepper
title: Mexican Pork Chops
