ingredients: 2 cans cream-style corn | 1 medium red pepper, cut into strips | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 4 thick-cut pork chops
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the cream style corn, red pepper, and lemon juice. Spread mixture evenly over pork chops. Refrigerate pork chops for at least 30 minutes.

title: Apple-Cider Chicken and Kale Wrapping
ingredients: 1200 g chicken legs | 100 g porridge oats | 20 g fresh apple cider | 1 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 250 g kale, washed and chopped
instructions: Place the chicken legs into a pan with the water. Bring to the boil and simmer until cooked through. Drain the chicken legs and transfer to a plate. Return the juices to the pan, and add the oats and apple cider. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the liquid is completely absorbed. Cover and leave slightly warm. Preheat the oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Wrap each piece of kale with a handful of the rolled oats and torn kale. Sear in a frying pan and transfer to a tray lined with baking paper. Roast for 8 - 15 minutes until golden.

title: Beef Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chopped frozen round steaks, about 1 1/2 pounds | 1 cup drained canned sweet potatoes or 1 cup frozen small sweet potato hash browns | 1/2 cup crumbled chevre cheese plus 1/3 cup goat cheese, crumbled ( about 2 1/2 oz package ) | 1 can coconut milk | 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut frozen yogurt or 1 1/2 cups fat free sour cream | 1/2 cup beer or 1/2 cup apple juice | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped whole berry ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios or 1/2 cup cashews, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cook the steak and sweet potato in boiling water about 7 minutes or until the meat is tender and fully cooked, turning once. Drain the steak. Stir the chevre and cream cheese into the steak and sweet potato, spooning the mixture over the beef and sweet potato until evenly mixed. Top with the shredded coconut and whole berry. Chill until ready to serve. Garnish with pistachios if using.

title: Pour over Irish Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup irish whiskey ( black ) or 1 cup guinness stout ( black ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | salad dressing ( prepared horseradish dressing to your own tastes, if desired )
instructions: Using a grill pan or non stick pan add the beer and maple syrup into a small saucepan and heat slowly until bubbles begin to form. Remove from heat and set aside. Tear off a large handful or two of italian bread and dip into the honey mustard dressing to generously coat each piece. Serve with the wedges.

title: Pam's Easy Almond-raisin Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup slivered almonds or 1/2 cup slivered almonds, dry roasted | 1 pinch almond extract | pam cooking spray or pam butter
instructions: Combine dry roasted almonds and almond extract. Spread on a cookie tray lined with pam coating or cooking spray, and place on the counter.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,pepper,phyllo dough,pine nut,iceberg lettuce,white pearl onion
title: Crunchy Pearly
ingredients: 2 large white pearl onions | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/2 cup frozen small whole wheat pea cornichons | 3 lbs phyllo dough ( or more to thaw if desired ) | 2 lbs fresh white pearl onions | pepper, to taste | iceberg lettuce, to taste
instructions: Chop the pearl onions and pine nuts very finely. In a sauté pan, cook both the onions and the pine nuts in the olive oil. When they are golden brown, add the frozen small whole wheat pea cornichons and a few pinches of pepper to taste. Cook for about 2 minutes and remove from heat and set aside until ready to use. Unwrap phyllo dough and begin to roll out one sheet at a time. Cut out 1 circles and place approximately 1⁄2 cup of the filling near one edge of the sheet. Fold over the corner and continue to roll out another sheet of dough until its full. Fold and seal and continue as previous sheets until all the filling has been used, laying each sheet on top of one another to keep the pastry from sticking to the edges of the dough. Continue with the remaining sheets of phyllo dough and filling. Bake this in a preheated oven at 350 degrees f for 45 - 50 minutes. Serve hot with iceberg lettuce. Variation, when making the phyllo dough, roll out the phyllo into thin strips and place them near a walled plate to keep warm while preparing the phyllo “loaf”. You will use only approximately 5 sheets of phyllo dough and should have approximately 9 sheets for 2 layers. This is the “loaf” you will be making. You can cut away remaining sheets of phyllo dough to make more loaves if needed.

title: Kidney Beans With Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 5 1/2 ounces baked kidney beans | 4 1/2 ounces provolone cheese, freshly grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons chives, freshly snipped, to garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, thoroughly mix together half the provolone and half the chives. Place the beans in a deep ovenproof dish and top with the remaining provolone and chives. Bake, uncovered, in a 400f degrees oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until heated through and bubbling and cheese is melted.

title: Roasted Eggplants (From Scratch)
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1 can plum tomatoes with liquid | 2 cups italian style breadcrumbs or 2 cups dry breadcrumbs | 3 cups water
instructions: Place the eggplant on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Place in the oven and toast for an hour at 375 degrees or until soft and tender. Let cool slightly and scoop out the flesh. Chop and save the pulp and puree well and place in a food processor or blender along with the tomatoes with 2 c water and puree until smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed. Add salt and pepper. Add breadcrumbs and pulse until well mixed. Transfer to a serving dish.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,asparagus,lemon zest,olive oil cooking spray,prune,apple,chevre cheese cream
title: Harvest Prune and Apples Salad
ingredients: 8 -10 large asparagus, trimmed | 1 large apple, such as a mcintosh, peeled, cored and grated | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, tightly packed, minced | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil ( a good quality olive oil ) | lemon zest | 1/2 cup chevre cheese, preferably french quark or 1/2 cup cream cheese, sliced into 2-inch cubes | 8 pitted prunes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and then add asparagus and apples. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes, or until asparagus is tender but still firm. Drain and set aside. Whisk 2 teaspoons of the olive oil into minced cilantro and a small pinch of the lemon zest. In a salad bowl, toss together the remaining olive oil with the cheese, grated apple, cilantro mixture, drained asparagus and apple pices. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Cut the remaining two tablespoons of chevre into 2/3rds. Arrange the salad in the bottom of a serving platter or on a serving plate. Arrange the prunes on top, then scatter the rest over. Ladle warm broth over asparagus and sprinkle with remaining 1/3rds of chevre.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,taco seasoning mix,flat leaf parsley,lettuce,italian seasoning,triple sec,herb,cream mushroom soup
title: French Dip Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 teaspoon dried herbs | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dried cinnamon | 1 teaspoon triple sec ( optional ) | 8 leaves lettuce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon flat-leaf parsley ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the soup, herbs, taco seasoning, cinnamon, and triple sec until smooth. Stir in the lettuce. Spray a skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. To serve, slice toast into 8 equal pieces and ladle the soup on toast. Garnish with parsley or sour cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,mint sprig,bamboo shoot,italian herb,dark brown sugar,stewing beef,pickle
title: Beef With Vegetables (Crock Pot or Not)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 1 can bamboo shoots ( drained ) | 1/2 cup pickle slice | 1 -2 tablespoon pickle | 1 pinch mixed italian herbs ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients in crockpot/slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 5 hours or on low 8 hours. Serve over rice, pasta, egg noodles, noodles, or mashed potatoes.

title: Sopa Pintua
ingredients: 4 pounds beef chuck, cubed | 12 prawns - peeled and deveined | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 3 tablespoons hot pepper sauce, or to taste | 1 can pinto beans, drained
instructions: Place chuck, prawns, and chicken broth into a large pot, and add hot pepper sauce. Simmer stew over medium heat for 1 hour. Add more hot sauce if needed. Cover and simmer over medium low heat for 1 more hour, or until meat and prawns are cooked through. Add pinto beans, and simmer for 10 minutes, or until beans are hot and soft.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,oregano leaf,spring onion,oyster mushroom,fennel,breadcrumb,black mustard seed,halloumi cheese
title: Halloumi Sticks - Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil | 6 fresh oyster mushrooms, finely chopped ( about 7 ounces or 200 grams ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 5 spring onions, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup fresh grated halloumi cheese
instructions: Stir together oil, 1 tablespoon of sesame oil, mustard seeds, oregano and spring onions. Place all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and whisk until combined. Divide the mixture into 8 equal sections. Working with one piece at a time, dip the ham in the beaten egg, then coat with bread crumbs. Repeat the procedure with the mushrooms, using up to 8 pieces for each piece. Place the mushrooms on a tray lined with tin foil, ensuring they are completely covered, and chill for 15 - 30 minutes or longer. Preheat oven to 180c/350f/gas cut the cheese into 5 wedges and place on baking sheets lined with baking paper. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes until golden and crisp. Slice diagonally on the diagonal and serve.

Random Ingredients: coffee,vanilla essence,coriander,iceberg lettuce,phyllo pastry,russet potato,dijon mustard,crust pizza dough
title: Phyllo and Coffee Cakes (Vegetarian and Non-Vegan)
ingredients: 4 sheets phyllo pastry | 60 ml coffee | 1 small russet potato, cut lengthways in half and thinly sliced | 60 g crust pizza dough | 1/3 cup low-fat crust french haricot vert cheese or 1/3 cup low fat cheese | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated nutmeg | 2 -3 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/4 cup cold strong coffee | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh coriander
instructions: To make the biscuits, slice the potato into sticks about 1/2 inch thick and about 1/2 inch wide. Cook them on a bbq or grill pan or in the oven at a medium high temperature for about 12 - 15 minutes, turning regularly, until light golden and crispy. Allow them to cool and break, and toss in with the leftover cooked potato slices. In a bowl, put the pizza dough, french haricots verts and grated nutmeg. Add the mustard and mustard powder. Mix well. Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius spread the cheese on half of the pastry sheets. Cut the other half of the pastry sheets in half and then cut this half into three, each piece for a total of eight squares or even thinner portions. Repeat with the rest of the phyllo and then brush the pastry squares generously with coffee. Dribble the mustard mixture onto the pastry. Sprinkle the cheese on the top. Sprinkle over the coriander and cut four diagonal cuts around the pastry with a sharp knife. Bake in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes until browned and crisp, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,chili sauce,chicken bouillon,cashew,sirloin,button mushroom,grain brown rice
title: Seared Beef With Mushrooms and Cashews
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, boneless and tips trimmed of fat | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon ( instant granules may be used if no flavor is available ) | 1/2 cup chili sauce ( my bottled recipe calls for jasmine and other flavors, but i prefer kikkoman brand. spicy asian brand is also availabel. ) | 1 1/2 cups long grain brown rice, cooked according to package directions | 3 teaspoons serrano peppers, finely minced or 3 teaspoons jalapeno chiles, crushed | 1/2 cup cashews, coarsely chopped
instructions: Trim as much fat as possible out of beef, cutting it in 1/2 thick slabs. Trim as much excess fat as possible from beef slices. Pound meat very thinly. Dissolve chicken bouillon granules in hot chili sauce to dissolve. Set aside. Coat the bottom of a large, heavy, oven safe skillet with oil, place it over medium high heat. Add meat and sear on all sides. Add cashews and fry, stirring constantly, about 1 - 2 minutes. Add rice and saute, stirring constantly but constantly, just until the rice turns golden brown. Add serrano peppers and serrano chili. Transfer to a platter and serve. Recipe courtesy of piri nuoc nam  by goi jang o ok soho anomicon ”.

title: Pigs in a Blanket or Stuffed Fennel
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, dressed and cut in half | 12 prunes ( or use canned ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves, rubbed | tiny piece fennel bulb ( to garnish ) | 8 tablespoons soft fresh goat cheese or 8 tablespoons feta cheese | 8 tablespoons toasted sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the chicken, prunes and sage on a baking sheet. Bake for about 40 mintues, basting the chicken after 20 mintues total. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with fennel and spread goat cheese on top. Add almonds. Return to the oven and bake for 5 more minutes. Eat with your favorite stuffing. Note, the more pungent you eat, the more flavorful it will be. Variation, replace the goat cheese with feta cheese.

title: Stacked Coconut Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 cup shredded unsweetened coconut | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons creamy roasted sliced provolone cheese
instructions: Spread each slice of bread with ricotta cheese and shredded coconut, and top with provolone.

title: Mexican Beef Steaks
ingredients: 4 chuck steaks, fat trimmed | 50 ml milk | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 3 tablespoons mexican chili powder | 2 tablespoons coarsely ground hazelnuts
instructions: Heat the griddle, brush it well with oil or butter to remove any excess grease. Pat the steaks out on a piece of foil to form a packet. Place all other ingredients on one side of the griddle and pour in 125ml of the milk. Close the foil parcel and cook, in a hot oven, 230c/450f oven for 30 mins or until steaks are very tender and cooked through. Allow to rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Watermelon Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup watermelon, diced | 1 cup old fashioned oats | 3 tablespoons banana-flavored frozen lemonade concentrate | 2 tablespoons sugar | 6 large burrito-size flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Combine chopped watermelon, old fashioned oats, banana juice concentrate, and sugar in a large bowl. Mix well. Place 1 tortilla on a plate. Spread a scoop of filling in center of tortilla. Wrap it with the tortilla.

title: Kaffir Lime Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked brown rice | kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 1 whole clove | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Place rice in a saucepan, and pour in enough boiling water to cover rice. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork and stir in kaffir lime leaf, clove, and dijon mustard. Heat thoroughly in microwave so flavors soak into rice.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,raisin,chicken tender,grain brown rice,vegetable oil,hot italian sausage,chicken breast half
title: Chicken Tasty Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 chicken thigh half | 1 lb hot italian sausage, sliced thin | 1 cup short grain brown rice | 1 lb chicken tenders | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Heat the oil over medium high heat. Sear the chicken well. Slice the sausage into 1/4 inch slices, place in an even layer on the chicken, and cook about 5 minutes or until browned. Add the rice, sausage, and raisins. Cook about 40 seconds over medium heat to heat the rice. Cover the pan tightly, reduce heat, and cook 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Fluff rice with a fork.

title: Mexican Greens
ingredients: 6 cups mixed greens | 4 tablespoons chopped green onions
instructions: Prepare charcoal. Place all ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil.

title: Ziti with Beef
ingredients: 3/4 pound lean ground beef | 1 1/4 cups beef stock | 2 packages ziti pasta | 1 large head green cabbage | 1 tablespoon white sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish or deep dish pie plate with aluminum foil. Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, but don't drain the grease. Drain the meat and set aside. In the same skillet used to cook the ground beef, mix the beef stock and ziti pasta. Divide the ground beef mixture into 9 portions, and place them into a casserole dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the ziti, and cook until tender, about 8 minutes. Drain, and toss with beef mixture and 2 tablespoons of sugar.

Random Ingredients: thai chile,red capsicum,queso fresco,orzo pasta,dijon mustard,taco seasoning mix
title: Capellini Orzo With Beef and Cucumber Chiles in Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups orzo pasta, cooked, rinsed and drained | 1 lb ground beef | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 jar chargrilled red capsicums ( drained if using peppers ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 4 ounces crumbled queso fresco
instructions: In a large non stick frying pan, combine the orzo with the beef and seasoning. Heat until mixture is hot, but do not boil it. Stir through the red capsicum and mustard. Spoon the mixture into a large serving dish and sprinkle with the cheese. Serve.

title: Pasta, Lentils and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 red onion, diced | 1 teaspoon wasabi | 1/2 cup chopped fresh seaweed | 2 belgian endive, ends trimmed and diced | 1 cup lentils, rinsed | 16 snow peas, trimmed | 3 cups dry fresh cheese, grated
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat add onion.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,taco sauce,chili pepper flake,kosher salt,pork rib
title: Mexican Style Pork Ribs
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs country-style pork ribs | 2 cans mexican-style hot salsa ( price chopper recommended ) | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, shredded ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and pat dry ribs and place in a crockpot. Add the salsa, salt, and chili flakes. Cover and cook for 4 hours, or on high for the first 4 hours remove the meat from the crockpot and shred with two forks. Place shredded meat back into the crockpot and stir thoroughly. Top with grated cheese. Serve with sour cream, guacamole, corn bread, or tortillas.

title: Steamed Lobsters With Broccoli and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg small steamed lobsters | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 cup fresh broccoli, roughly chopped | 4 tablespoons good quality sweet chocolate or 4 tablespoons semi-sweet chocolate
instructions: Heat oven to 230c. Place the lobsters on a baking tray and cook in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the lobsters are just cooked. When they are cool enough to handle split them open and remove the meat from the shells. Wash the shells under cold water. Fill and place a small knob of the shaved chocolate onto each lobster shell. Place the lobsters on an oven tray and bake for 5 minutes or until the chocolate has melted and the lobster meat is cooked through. Serve immediately.

title: Smokey Eggplant (Eggplant) Balls
ingredients: 3 medium eggplants | 3 cups dry fine breadcrumbs | 1 package of your favorite pasta
instructions: Cut off the ends of the eggplant if it is a different size. Rinse well in a colander. Cut out the flesh and set aside. Cut a slit in the eggplant using a knife so you have little cubes of eggplant. In a skillet over medium heat, mix the eggs into the bread crumbs. Add the meat to the bread crumbs and mix all together well. Place the eggplant in the skillet over low heat and cook until lightly browned about 10 minutes. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of drippings. Cut the eggplant into 1/2 inch cubes and drop into the skillet. Cook until lightly browned about 10 minutes. Serve on a bed of white or brown rice.

title: Trout And Potato Pasta
ingredients: 200 g pasta ( short like vermicelli or wholemeal pasta ) | 4 medium sized trout fillets | 120 g jicama | 80 g baked beans | 80 ml chocolate syrup | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Boil pasta according to directions. Fish should be firm and cut into 4 parts. To cook, cut the fish in small pieces and deep fry in a little oil. Add potatoes and jicama and continue to fry. For the sauce, melt half of the chocolate syrup. Add other half of dark syrup and turmeric powder. Stir it. Add cooked pasta and mix. Serve warm.

title: Roasted Beef in Brandy
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1 teaspoon savory | 1/4 cup brandy. ( or rum, cognac, or rum ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a large bowl, mix the roast with savory. Place the roast in a shallow roasting pan large enough to fit beef in a single layer. Pour brandy over top of roast. Bake for 1 1/2 3 hours or until meat is tender and easily pierced with a fork.

Random Ingredients: hash brown potato,lemon peel,basil leaf,alfredo sauce,kaffir lime leaf,italian seasoning,tomato sauce,vegetable oil
title: Italian Potato Pastries
ingredients: 2 lbs hash brown potatoes | 2 cups alfredo sauce | 28 ounces tomato sauce | 4 tablespoons lemon peel, grated | 5 fresh kaffir lime leaves, crushed | 4 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 cup basil leaves, fresh & chopped
instructions: In a plastic bowl, mix together the potatoes w/salt + pepper& then place onto plate over potatoes. Heat oil in medium size sauce pan. Drain potatoes and place on a cookie sheet. Cover with foil and place in oven for 20 - 25 minutes. After an hour, uncover, remove foil and continue to cook another 30 - 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender & golden brown. Remove from oven, turn oven off and add tomato sauce, lemon peel, lime leaves, italian seasoning, and vegetable oil. Mix well, taste for seasoning and adjust if necessary. While still hot, remove from pan, add 1 cup of basil, stir and remove from heat. Pour sauce on top of potatoes, and continue to serve potatoes over pasta.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,asafoetida powder,pepper sauce,graham cracker,sage leaf
title: The World's Finest Cheese Ball
ingredients: 5 packages shredded fontina cheese | 1 bunch fresh sage leaves | 1/3 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 dash hot pepper sauce, or to taste | 4 graham cracker rounds
instructions: Shred fontina cheese into 1/4 pieces. Chop sage leaves, and squeeze finely, or pulse in a food processor. Stir chopped ginger and minced garlic into shredded fontina cheese with a pinch of asafoetida and hot sauce. Store in the refrigerator until needed.

title: Candy Ginger Baked Onions
ingredients: 8 large onions, peeled, sliced lengthwise, and cut crosswise into 4 pieces before ricing | 1/2 lb olive, pitted, drained, and minced | 1 tablespoon peeled and minced fresh ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a large cookie sheet with parchment paper or a large baking sheet with foil. Place onions in a layer on the baking sheet, in a single layer, and sprinkle the onions with salt. Let sit 10 minutes. Rinse onions under cold running water. Peel, and slice the onions crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange onions in a single layer on the cookie sheet. Combine the remaining ingredients and pour over the onions. Place baking sheet in preheated oven, and bake until onions just begin to brown, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cheater's Amazing Passover Chocolate Maceroon
ingredients: 1 box matzo meal | 8 ounces dark chocolate | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees and grease a 3 quart casserole dish. In a pot of boiling water, melt the chocolate chips and mix with the cream of chicken soup. Set aside to cool. Once melted, set aside. In a separate bowl, mix the mayonnaise and the matzo meal, making sure it doesn't lump. The amount will vary depending what type of matzo meal is used in the recipe, so i don't recommend making it too thick. Once it's cooled, fold into the chocolate mixture. Pour into prepared casserole dish and bake for 25 minutes. Top with chocolate sauce and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,pita bread,margarine,ginger root,rice wine,peanut oil,stew meat
title: Japanese Shredded Pineapple and Beef
ingredients: 2 pounds stew meat | 1 cup fresh pineapple juice | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1 tablespoon diced pimento-stuffed dried paleson or sun-dried tomatoes | 1 tablespoon finely minced fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon hot, or as desired | 2/3 cup margarine | 4 pita breads, cut into wedges
instructions: Combine stew meat, pineapple juice, rice wine, diced tomatoes, ginger, and hot pepper in a large bowl, stir well. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with foil.

Random Ingredients: butter,baguette,cake flour,red curry paste,raspberry,tahini,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Quick and Easy Thai Chilled Cheese Croutons
ingredients: 1 package baguette, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup light butter | 1 1/2 cups raspberries | 1/3 cup tahini | 3/4 cup light cream or 3/4 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons hot red curry paste | 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Arrange the baguette on a work surface and lightly coat with butter. On each piece, spread 1/4 cup butter on each slice. Divide raspberries among the slices. In a mixing bowl, mix together the tahini, cream and curry paste until smooth. Spread the cream over the raspberries, overlapping as necessary, to coat with cream mixture. Sprinkle top with cheese and top with bread cubes. Serve at room temperature or cover and refrigerate for up to 2 hours before serving.

title: Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 8 ounces fontina cheese | 8 ounces demerara sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Peel and dice the fontina and remove rind and white as you would for Fontina. Mix the fontina and sugar and press in a cookie cutter. Bake in the oven for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown. Serve.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,chicken stock vegetable,vegetable stock,chili paste
title: Basic Hot Chili Sauce (Cambodian Style)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili paste ( such as jalapeno... or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon chicken stock or 1 tablespoon veggie stock | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar ( preferably sweet vinegar or balsamic ) | 1 tablespoon chicken stock or 1 tablespoon vegetable stock
instructions: Heat oil in hot pan and add chilli paste and stir fry 2 minutes. Add stock and stir fry on medium heat until sauce just comes to boil. Reduce heat and stir in vinegar and remove sauce from heat. This sauce can be used as a side dish for pork or chicken.

title: Italian Pepperoni Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 pepperoni, halved and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil leaves | 2 squares semisweet chocolate, melted and divided
instructions: Place pepperoni between plastic wrap and pound in using flat side of meat until even thickness. Sprinkle basil over top and roll meat tightly. Chill for 30 - 60 minutes. Place chocolate on flat baking sheet. Top with remaining pepperoni. Melt chocolate and spread over top. Grill 4 to 8 minutes on each side or until golden.

Random Ingredients: snow pea pod,pork shoulder,white onion,oyster sauce,green olive,tart apple,grand marnier,green chilies
title: Sizzling Pork and Apples
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, lean, skinned ( bone in chops ) | 1 white onion, chopped finely | 2 green chilies, deseeded and chopped | 1 ounce green olives, chopped | 6 ounces snow pea pods, ends trimmed | 4 1/2 fluid ounces oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon grand marnier ( or any liqueur ) | 1 tart apple, peeled, cored, chopped
instructions: The pork leg should be on the bone with fat underneath. If not, use a piece of pork sparerib. Place all the vegetables in a large saucepan or wok with a drizzle of fish sauce and half the grand marnier. Heat through for 1 minute. Then put through a meat blender with the remaining grand marnier. Taste and correct seasoning and divide between 2 clean, dry and warmed serving plates. Cut the pork shoulder into thin strips. Put the pork pieces back into the saucepan and cover with the sauce.

title: Chipotle Crab and Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, cored, sliced thin | 3 tablespoons canned chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 4 ounces lump crabmeat, cut into 1/2-inch pieces ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons lean beefsteak tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 12 ounces medium florets kale, cut lengthwise into 6 wedges
instructions: Using a large skillet, melt half the chipotle in adobo over medium high heat, stirring. Add cabbage.

title: Ouzo
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 2 tablespoons ouzo | 10 stuffed green olives | 2 -3 tablespoons sweet peas, thawed | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, chopped | 1 tablespoon tahini ( optional )
instructions: Cut bread into 1/4 rounds. Mix together the ouzo and olive oil and spread on one side of the loaf. Arrange olives, peas and 1 tablespoon of basil and sprinkle remaining basil on top. Spread ouzo on the other side of the loaf and cut each into 4 squares. Cut into 12 squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: bacon,tomato puree,rom tomato,scotch bonnet pepper,green olive,mirin,green chilies
title: Roast Chilli Barbecue
ingredients: 100 g bacon, rind removed, chopped | 1/4 cup tomato puree, heaped ( heaped ) | 1/2 scotch bonnet pepper, chopped | 2 green chilies, chopped | 1 large roma tomatoes, ripe, halved lengthways, deseeded and roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon green olives, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Preheat the grill to its hottest temperature. Line the barbecue plate with foil, cut the foil into 4 long strips and set this aside. Place the bacon, tomato puree, chilli, roma tomato and olives in a bowl and stir well until well combined. Sprinkle over the bacon mixture and place the barbeque barbeque plate on. Transfer to the grill and cook for 3–4 minutes or until the barbeque is dry. Transfer to a serving plate. Serve immediately.

title: Sarsoon Kaala - Garam Masala Paste
ingredients: 2 ounces garam masala | 3 ounces garlic, pounded very coarsely
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Keep it in a jar in the dark.

title: Easy Shredded Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket | 10 ounces tomatillo salsa
instructions: Place beef in 5 qt slow cooker. Add tomatillo salsa. Cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours until tender. Slice thinly and serve with tortillas with desired toppings.

title: Dill Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 jar mushroom pieces, drained | 1 can hominy, drained and rinsed, about 20 ounces | 2/3 cup apple juice ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dill
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except dill, in a pot. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove dill. Can be served hot or cold.

title: French Sherry or "Sherry-Yermaster"
ingredients: 1/2 cup good quality dry sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Stir to meld thoroughly and store in a cool dark place, away from light. To serve, combine 2 tbsp to 2 tbsp or a tad of warm water and stir to prevent foam forming.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,lemon peel,pork shoulder,ginger paste,egg substitute,white sugar,baguette
title: Chinese Pork Rolls
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, fat trimmed | 20 cups water | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/2 cup lemon peel, shredded | 6 ounces water chestnuts, finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon ginger paste ( optional ) | 1 baguette, sliced | egg substitute, for egg wash
instructions: Rinse the lamb well in cold water. Cut slices into 1/4 inch rounds. Prepare the filling by heating the water with the sugar. When sugar starts to melt, add the lemon peel and water chestnuts. Remove from heat. Using two forks, mash the pork together with the juice of the lemon peel to make a very thick paste. Add the ginger paste and stir in thoroughly. Grease and flour a 10x14 inch baking pan. Place the pork in the prepared pan. Make sure the pork is well coated. If not, cover the pan tightly with foil, and set aside to marinate at room temperature for 12 hours. Preheat oven to 325°f. Remove the pan from the oven and reserve. Drain the pork pieces of excess water and pat dry. With your fingertips, pull skin from inside the meat, being careful not to tear into meat. Discard bones. Place pork slices in a shallow container and pour boiling water over them to cover. Store covered in refrigerator, turning once. Place a small amount of water on the bottom of a dutch oven to prevent the pork from drying out. Place two pieces of pork meat in the bottom of the dutch oven, skin side down, then top with one layer of water chestnuts and one layer of pork meat. Place the remaining two layers of pork, skin side down, atop the water chestnuts and liquid. Add the ginger tomato paste. Place the baguette slices on a baking sheet and brush with egg wash. Bake in preheated oven until browned, about 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot with dipping sauce or dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: mushroom stem,dark sesame oil,meat tenderizer,skewer,orange zest
title: Orange and Mushroom Teriyaki Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon meat tenderizer | 1/4 teaspoon orange zest, minced | 1 jar mushroom stems, drained | 2 skewers, soaked for 30 to 60 seconds
instructions: In a bowl, combine sesame oil, meat tenderizer, orange rind, and mushroom stems. Thread mushroom caps on skewers. Grill skewers over hot coals or a medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes or until tender.

title: Simple Noodle and Ramen Soba
ingredients: 8 ounces ramen noodles | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce, or to taste
instructions: Blend ramen noodles, chili garlic sauce and hot pepper sauce together in a blender until sauce has been fully incorporated, or to taste.

title: Baba Ganouj (Lentils With Eggplant)
ingredients: 5 large eggplants | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 1/2 cups dry whole wheat or 2 cups couscous, cooked | 1 tablespoon saffron, for garnish
instructions: If using a stone, soak the saffron in a cup or 2 cups of warm water until dissolved. Peel and cut the eggplants into large chunks about 1/4 1/2 inch long. Place them on 2 cookie sheets, sprinkle with saffron, and bake at 350 degrees f for about an hour. Cool, and store in an airtight container. Roughly chop the eggs. Heat the olive, ghee, or margarine, or oil, and saute the eggplant until slightly browned and tender. When the meat is cool enough to handle, mash a few of the eggplant chunks into the meat. Transfer some of the eggplant meat to a bowl. When ready to serve, pour the remaining eggplant mixture into the empty saffron water and mix well.

title: Crock Pot Ramen Corn
ingredients: 12 ounces white shoepeg corn, frozen ( defrosted if frozen, thaw if freezer ) | 13 ounces white shoepeg corn, frozen ( defrosted if frozen ) | 13 ounces whole kernel corn, frozen
instructions: Combine 12 ounces of frozen kernels of corn, 6 ounce of frozen corn, 4oz of ramen noodles, and 12 ounces of white shoepeg corn in crock pot. Set to low and cook 4 - 6 hours or high 6 hours.

title: Fennel - Calabrian Fennel
ingredients: 3/4 tablespoon dried fennel seed | 1 large garlic clove | 1/4 teaspoon coarsely crushed walnuts
instructions: In a non metallic frying pan over medium to high heat, dry fry fennel pods in batches, about 3 to 5 minutes per side. Place fennel in a colander to drain. Dry roast and grind the garlic in the same hot pan, about 1 minute. When garlic changes color, stir constantly until browned on all sides and garlic clove is sizziling but not burned. Stir in the nuts and season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

title: Vegan Chocolate Hazelnut French Toast
ingredients: 3/4 cup chocolate syrup ( i used nutella ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1/4 cup shiitake mushrooms | 6 slices bread, toasted | 1/4 cup hershey's original nutella
instructions: Combine chocolate syrup, tomatoes, mushrooms, and nutella in a small bowl. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Place toasted bread slices in the pan, then pour the vegetable mixture evenly over the bread.

Random Ingredients: green onion,french bread,cavatelli,orange juice,mexican tomato,sauce,rice vinegar
title: Quick Mexican Bread Salad
ingredients: 2 cans mexican-style tomatoes, divided | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 1/4 cup hot sauce or 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup finely chopped green onion | 4 cups fettuccine, cooked, drained and warm | 1 loaf french bread, cut in half lengthwise and then each piece about 1 inch thick
instructions: Drain the tomatoes, reserve juice.

title: Easy Enoki
ingredients: 1 cup enoki mushrooms | 1/2 pound lean pork shoulder, sliced | 2 tablespoons prepared sweet-and-sour sauce | 24 fluid ounces medium salsa
instructions: Place enoki mushrooms on a plate and cover with wet paper towels to absorb moisture. Place saute pork in a large skillet and cook over medium high heat until browned, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low and cook enoki mushrooms until they are reduced to 4 tablespoons, about 8 minutes. Place pork into a 2 quart enameled cast iron casserole dish, sprinkle with sweet and sour sauce and cover with salsa. Cover and bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 90 minutes. Uncover, cover, and continue baking, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Uncover and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.

title: Gramma's French Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large yukon gold potatoes | 1/2 cup shortening | 2 tablespoons butter or margarine | 1/3 cup prunes, pitted, chopped
instructions: Scrub potatoes, and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f. Until tender, about 1 hour. While potatoes are still warm, cut in butter with a knife.

title: Mushroom Salad With Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 loaf raspberries ( approx 2 cups ) or 1 loaf french bread | 1 package large button mushrooms | 1/2 lb pepperoni ( thinly sliced ) | 1 package frozen raspberries | 1 package frozen puff cookies | 1 3/4 cups miracle whip
instructions: Slice loaf in half lengthwise and hollow out, and place in a large salad bowl. Add all the other ingredients. Stir well, adding miracle whip to taste, etc. Cover with remaining cheese. Place salad in refrigerator to chill thoroughly before serving. It can be stored overnight in the fridge.

title: Basic Italian Sausage Loaf (Baked)
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed ( may substitute other firm sausage if desired but can be removed if desired ) | 4 cups cake flour ( unbleached all purpose flour will not do )
instructions: Preheat over to 325°f. Grease a 9 x 5 inch loaf pan and line bottom of pan with aluminum foil. Crumble sausages into bowl. Mix flour and sausage together and roll into 1 inch balls. Place balls into greased loaf pan and bake for about 50 minutes, testing occasionally with a toothpick to make sure they do not stick to pan. Cool slightly.

title: Quick Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 lb chinese-style pecan pieces | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce or 1/4 cup dry apple juice | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons grainy mustard
instructions: Lightly toast the pecans in a preheated 400 degrees fahrenheit oven for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring frequently, or until golden brown. Transfer the nuts to a bowl. For the sauce, combine all ingredients in a small saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until warm, about 2 minutes. Pour warm sauce over pecans and serve at once. Enjoy.

title: Fajita Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1 1/2 tablespoons oregano and herbs ( mixed spices ) | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning ( dry fajita seasoning ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine apple juice, tomato puree, oregano, fajita seasoning, oyster sauce, and herb combination in a blender until completely pureed.

title: Chilled Mushrooms With Cream Cheese in Portabella Caps
ingredients: 1/2 cup portabella mushroom | 2 tablespoons cream cheese | 1 tablespoon dry vermouth | 1 tablespoon shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Dry off mushrooms with a paper towel, and reserve stems for another use. Wash cream cheese and dry mushrooms, and slice caps into 1/4 to 1/2 inch thich rounds. Place cream cheese rounds on a cutting board, and flatten with the palm of your hand. Using the end of a large knife, slice rounds on the bias, making you have a large square. Arrange mushroom caps, rounded sides up, on top of the cream cheese. Drizzle the top surface of all mushrooms with vermouth. Spread a thin layer of cream cheese on the mushroom caps. Cut through the mushroom stems with a serrated knife with a cut knife in the mushroom, to create a marinated effect.

title: Mustard Greens
ingredients: 1 lb mustard greens | 1/3 cup finely chopped italian parsley
instructions: Wash greens thoroughly, removing tough center ribs. Blanche in boiling water for 5 seconds, then steam in sink until tender, 2 - 3 minutes. Drain. Mix greens with parsley. Pack into 2 quart casserole.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,tomato sauce,nonstick cooking spray,rice noodle,tabasco sauce,baby clam,sherry wine
title: Cremini Clam Linguini
ingredients: 4 cans baby clams, drained | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/3 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce ( i use tony cachere's hot sauce ) | 3/4 cup cremini mixed mushrooms, sliced | 1 lb cooked rice noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly spray a 9 x 13 baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine the clams, sherry, and tomato sauce. Sprinkle with tabasco sauce. Scatter the mushrooms, garlic, and cajun seasoning in the dish. Drain the noodles, reserving 1/4 cup of the liquid, tossing the noodles to coat evenly. Drop the noodles into the baking dish, then pour the clam mixture evenly over the noodles. Bake, covered, 45 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and the sauce is bubbling. Remove from oven and discard any remaining liquid accumulated on the dish.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya coriander annatto,italian plum tomato,chocolate,sun tomato,potato flake,asparagus
title: Chocolate-Wrapped Italian Green Beans #RSC
ingredients: 1 package of sazon goya with coriander and annatto | 1 1/2 lbs fresh italian plums & tomatoes ( cut in half lengthwise ) | 1 teaspoon sun-dried tomato | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, cut up | 1 cup potato flakes | 20 asparagus, ends trimmed, ends peeled ( cut with fingers into 2 inch pieces )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, make the basting sauce by combining sazon and annatto. In a small saucepan, bring plum tomatoes and sun dried tomatoes to a boil. Blanch until desired doneness. Drain and set aside. Place the tomato halves, cut side down, on a sheet of aluminum foil and spread with basting sauce. Place an asparagus spear on top, and pinch ends of asparagus around them leaving just a little room at one end. Place the basting sauce bundle on top of the spears and asparagus. Starting at the right side, roll up each tomato, and slice into 4 pieces. Pour the remaining basting sauce over tomatoes and asparagus. Fold foil tightly around bundles and continue wrapping bundles. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer for about 10 minutes. You may serve right away, or cover and refrigerate until serving time. Serve on a plate topped with a sprinkle of grated parmesan or romano cheese, if desired.

title: Pineapple Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 425 g pineapple rings | 1/4 cup frozen peas | 1/2 small red capsicum, diced | 1/2 small cucumber, diced | 2 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 180 g chilled fat-free whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Cook pineapple, peas, capsicum and cucumber in a large saucepan of boiling water 2 - 3 minutes or until just tender, drain well. Combine peas, pineapple, capsicum, cucumber and dill in a large bowl. Add whipped topping to pineapple mixture. Cover and chill for one hour.

title: Crock Pot Hot Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons red pepper paste | 1 lb chicken meat | ground pepper | fresh herb ( thyme, sage, rosemary )
instructions: Stir together sherry, red pepper paste, and pepper until combined. Add chicken to crock pot. Cover and cook on low setting 6 to 7 hours or on high setting 4 to 6 hours.

title: Savoury Beef Noodle Casserole (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon extra lean ground beef, finely chopped | 2 cups egg noodles, cooked and drained | 2/3 cup marshmallows | 2 tablespoons green chili, finely chopped | 1/2 cup spinach, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons chives, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a casserole dish. Bake 1 hour at 180 c for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,flat leaf parsley,pink lemonade concentrate
title: Pink Champagne
ingredients: 3/4 cup reduced-sodium pink lemonade concentrate | 3/4 cup apple cider, chilled | 1 cup finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: In a heavy 2 1/2 to 3 quart saucepan, combine the lemonade concentrate and apple cider and bring to a boil. Cook, covered, over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring often.

title: Garnish
ingredients: 1 can fat free greek yogurt, low fat ok to use your favorite yogurt | 1/4 cup dried currants, fine ground fruit is best in this | 1/2 teaspoon dried greek spices, see directions
instructions: Drain yogurt completely, if desired. Place currants in a small bowl, pour yogurt over and stir gently with a fork or a potato masher. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Stir well before using. Garnish with extra currants.

title: Salmon With Bleu Blanco & Pumpkin
ingredients: 16 ounces salmon fillets ( skinless, boneless ) | 1/2 cup fresh broccoli ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup butternut squash ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup sweet bamboo shoot ( sliced ) | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Steam broccoli and squash until tender. Chop salmon into small pieces. Mix together the mushrooms, peas, and salmon. Stir together grand marnier and orange juice and pour into salmon and vegetables. Cook on medium heat until warm. Serve.

title: Ginger-Free Tatin
ingredients: 1 can or bottle dark beer | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin
instructions: Place the dark beer in a small saucepan, and stir in the 1 envelope of unflavored gelatin. Set over medium low heat, and warm to just under the boiling point. Stirring constantly to prevent browning, allow the mixture to boil for one minute, and remove from heat. Pour into a small bowl, and refrigerate until set.

title: Firm Mustard Seed and Honey Spread
ingredients: 4 teaspoons clear honey | 4 teaspoons yellow mustard seeds
instructions: Combine all the ingredients together in a food processor and process until the mixture forms a smooth paste. Store covered in the refrigerator for up to 2 months. Use as required.

title: Sweet Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1/2 cup chopped nuts such as pignoli, cashew nuts, peanuts or walnuts, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Mix sugar and coconut oil in a bowl until well blended. Place nuts in a plate or in a shallow pan and toss with sugar mixture and let them cool. Cut them into fingers or diamonds. Transfer to a decorator bag and refrigerate. When your nuts are chilled, toss again lightly with your fingers or you may place them in a decorating paper cone to help keep your fingers crisp.

title: Cheesy Crab Ramekins
ingredients: 24 imitation crabmeat, picked over for shells and cartilage | 12 ounces monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In a small baking pan, top crab meat with a layer of cheese. Repeat this process with remaining crab meat and cheese. Bake in the oven for approximately 25 minutes, or until cheese is melted and crab meat is hot. Serve with sour cream, green onion and sliced tomato.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,balsamic vinegar,green onion,pineapple juice
title: Sautéed Spinach Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces baby spinach leaves, washed and spun dry | 1 green onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place spinach leaves in bowl of ice water, about 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,poblano pepper,creamy vanilla spread frosting
title: Poblano Pepper Spread
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper | 1 cup creamy vanilla spread ( i used frosting mix ) | 9 ounces vegetable stock ( or you could use beef broth ) | 1 -2 teaspoon cream ( optional )
instructions: Core the poblano pepper and remove the stem and seeds. Cut the poblano pepper in half lengthwise to remove the stems and remove the seeds. Using a sharp knife, slice the pepper halves in half removing the stem and seeds. Remove all of the pepper halves to a bowl, leaving the reserved pepper flesh and coarsely chopped for another use. Then puree the flesh in a food processor, or alternatively process it in a food mill. This can be done with a mortar and pestle. You want it relatively smooth in consistency, and a little chunky. In a food processor, blend the softened spread with the beef broth, cream or the powdered milk. You can add more liquid if you need to. Once the spread is smooth, cover and store in the refrigerator for up to two days or in the refrigerator for up to three days.. If using the cream, you can add additional cream, if you wish along with the chopped pepper for a creamier texture.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo salsa,angel hair pasta,meat,french bean,broth,pecorino romano cheese
title: Tuscan Green Beans and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb frozen french beans | 6 ounces fresh tomatillo salsa | 1 cup beef or 1 cup turkey, cooked and diced | 8 cups chicken broth | chopped meat | 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: In large pot bring a large amount of water to a boil. Add beans and cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until tender but not mushy. Add tomatillos. Cook for another 5 - 8 minutes or until liquid is mostly absorbed. Pour mixture into a large bowl and let cool for about 15 minutes. Then, in the same pot, bring broth to a boil. Drain beans and tomatoes and return to pot. Add meat, cook for 3 - 4 minutes. Pour over bean mixture and stir in cheese just before serving. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve with bread, crusty italian rolls or tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: whiskey,dark sesame oil,salad green,snow pea,ginger garlic paste,egg yolk,cake flour
title: Sesame Snow Peas
ingredients: 4 cups snow peas, cut in half lengthwise ( i prefer manomans yellow peas ) | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 ounces cake flour | 2 whole eggs | 3 tablespoons whiskey | 12 cups cake flour, sifted
instructions: Place snow peas in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, cover, and cook until just tender crisp. Drain and transfer to a large bowl. Meanwhile, in a small bowl mix ginger garlic paste and sesame oil with a fork. Set aside in a small bowl. In a separate bowl or large measuring cup, beat egg and whiskey together to combine. Stir baking soda and 1 cup cake flour into egg mixture, then add remaining flour and mix well. Drain snow peas, reserving liquid, and place in a large bowl. Mix in snow pea liquid mixture. Cover and chill until ready to decorate cake. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. To serve, cut cake into 3 to 4 inch squares. Brush a 12 cup bundt or 12 cup bundt pan lightly with sesame oil. Dust with sesame seeds and decorate with snow pea mixture. Note, you may substitute shrimp with a similar shrimp, added to the mixture at the same time. Note, prep time does not include chilling time.

Random Ingredients: sea salt pepper,bratwurst,basil,fettuccine pasta,chili powder,anchovy fillet,cheese
title: Bratwurst Fettuccine
ingredients: 6 ounces fresh cheese | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon anchovy fillet, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried basil | sea salt and pepper | 1 lb fresh bratwurst, casings removed | 8 ounces dried fettuccine pasta
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente in salted water, drain & set aside. In a food processor, blend cheese, chilli & anchovies with basil, salt & pepper, until smooth. Add bratwurst & toss to mix. To serve place pasta into serving dish.

title: Quick and Easy Creamy Spinach
ingredients: 2 fry chickens, cut into pieces | 12 ounces fresh baby spinach | 2 cans refrigerated buttermilk sweetened beverage sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Cook chicken in a skillet until no longer pink in the center. Remove and set aside to cool. Rinse the pot of spinach under cold water. Pat dry with paper towels. In a saucepan combine spinach and sweetened condensed milk.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,red chili pepper,red curry paste,ha avocadoes,potato flour,pie shell
title: Spicy Red Curry Mashed Potato Wedges
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, unpeeled | 2 teaspoons potato flour | 1 teaspoon red curry paste, more if desired ( i use the thai red curry paste ) | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red hot red chili pepper | 2 small hass avocadoes, halved and pitted
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f peel potatoes and cut in half crosswise until you have 5 - 6 wedges. Place wedges, cut side up, onto a baking sheet and prick with a fork or toothpick several times. Bake wedges until golden brown and slightly crisp, about about 20 minutes. Meanwhile combine curry paste, chili flakes and pepper flakes in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: fennel,green cardamom pod,sun tomato oil,tamarind pulp,oil
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Jam
ingredients: 1 kg sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, chopped | 500 g tamarind pulp ( soaked in warm water for 15 minutes ) | 250 g fresh fennel, chopped | 3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 3 tablespoons oil
instructions: Blanch tomatoes for 2 minutes in hot water. Remove to a bowl of cold water using a slotted spoon, then drain again. Press through a sieve to remove seeds. Roughly crush tomatoes, then put in a bowl. Fry fennel, cardamom pods and sun dried tomatoes in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the tamarind pulp and cook for 10 minutes. Stir in fennel mixture and cook 3 - 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: radish,chicken thigh fillet,hamburger,monterey jack cheese,cajun seasoning,couscous,ramen noodle
title: Chicken and Ham Cassers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 lbs chicken thigh fillets | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 package ramen noodles | 1 package monterey jack cheese, sliced | 1/2 cup cooked diced hamburger | 2 cups couscous, prepared according to packet directions | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 bunch radish, sliced
instructions: Brown hamburger with seasoning in frying pan then drain fat. Add noodles to frying pan and cook until noodles are done, drain. Add hamburger and cheese to noodles and mix. Place mixture in casserole dish. Add remaining ingredients to noodles and meat. Bake uncovered at 350°f about 45 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,red enchilada sauce,mango,red pepper flake,vegetable stock
title: Tropical Coconut Soup With Mango and Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock ( or vegetable stock or water ) | 1 cup mango, diced | 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce, such as pace | 0.5 can red enchilada sauce | 6 ounces cream cheese, cubed | crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: In a medium pan, combine the stock, mango, enchilada sauce and cream cheese. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and reduce by half. Add the diced mango and crushed red pepper flake. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: allspice,olive oil cooking spray,jalapeno pepper,italian seasoning,lamb
title: Lamb on the BBQ
ingredients: 4 pounds lamb, cut into 2-inch chunks | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 tablespoon olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 can diced jalapeno peppers, drained
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Place lamb in a large bowl. Combine italian seasoning, allspice, olive oil and jalapeno peppers. Sprinkle mixture on lamb and coat evenly. Remove from grill and grill for 10 minutes. Turning twice, and basting frequently with marinade until well browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard green,dog bun,rom tomato,five spice powder,worcestershire sauce
title: Steamed Mustard Sauces
ingredients: 8 slices corned beef or 8 slices hot dog buns | 1/2 cup mustard greens, coarsely chopped ( kale, mustard or spinach ) | 1 cup finely chopped roma tomatoes, seeded | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons five-spice powder
instructions: Heat steamer to boiling or gas mark 5/190°f. Place mustard greens and tomatoes on a baking sheet and bake for 4 minutes. Turn tomatoes. Place mustard greens and tops on prepared steamer. Place two sausages on each plate. Heat broiler. Lightly brush top of sausages with mustard mixture. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat for 3 to 5 minutes or until sausages are cooked. Top each with 1 tablespoon of worcestershire sauce. If desired, you may serve with mustard sauce for dipping. Serve at once.

title: Shrimp on Caramelized Lemons
ingredients: 24 shrimp ( peeled and deveined ) | 4 ounces sherry wine
instructions: Arrange shrimp on wax paper in single layer and roast in preheated 300f oven until shrimp are pink and barely starting to turn pink about 3 minutes. Cover with sherry and return to oven. Bake until shrimp are caramelized, about 3 - 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,vegetable drumstick,rump steak,sausage,sun tomato oil,pepperoni,feta cheese,garlic clove
title: Pigs En Escabeche
ingredients: 1 large garlic clove, peeled | 1 tablespoon dried chipolata sausage | 1 chicken tenders, about 13 ounces or 1 chicken thigh, trimmed and slightly flattened | 1 can refrigerated chopped spinach ( about 2 bunches ) or ( 2 lb ) bag fresh baby spinach ( about 2 bunches ) | 1 -2 tablespoon finely chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon chopped crumbled pepperoni | 1 package bacon, cooked and drained rinsed well | roasted deli or italian sausage, for garnish
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Place garlic, chipolata, and chicken tenders in a food processor. Grind until meat is formed into large flat meatballs.

Random Ingredients: campbell golden mushroom soup,blue cheese,veal,margarine,cod fish fillet
title: Campbell's Easy Veal and Blue Cheese Casserole With Smoked Fish
ingredients: 1 can campbell golden mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 lb lean ground veal | 1 medium onion, cut in thin wedges | 12 ounces smoked cod fish fillets | 1/2 cup finely shredded sharp cheddar cheese or 1/2 cup asiago cheese
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. In a 2 quart casserole dish, mix soup, margarine, veal and onion. Add cheddar cheese. Cover and bake for 25 minute remove foil and bake for 10 minuts or until bubbly.

title: Spiced Vinegar
ingredients: 6 cups fresh gingerrootroot, diced | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 4 cups fresh raspberries with juice | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, snipped | 1/2 cup ginger paste, grated
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, mash the ginger root with the almonds and extract. Stir in raspberries with juice. Stir in cilantro and grated ginger.

Random Ingredients: sushi rice,green sprinkle,egg yolk,potato starch,egg,vegetable juice,oyster sauce,red curry paste
title: Steamed Baked Sweet Potato With Green Rice
ingredients: 20 ounces frozen sweet potatoes | 1 egg ( slightly beaten ) | 4 eggs ( slightly beaten ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons potato starch | 1 1/2 - 2 cups sushi rice ( prepared ) | vegetable juice | 2 -4 drops fish sauce or 2 -4 drops anchovy paste | green sprinkles ( optional )
instructions: Place sweet potatoes in a small steamer over boiling water. Cook until defrosted, 30 - 45 minutes. Place frozen sweet potatoes directly in a large strainer and use a fork to mash until smooth. Place mashed sweet potatoes in a large bowl and place over boiling water. Reduce heat until potato is about 1/4 inch thick, stirring frequently. Drain off water. Cool for 15 minutes, then stir in 2 beaten eggs, potato starch, and enough sushi rice to moisten. Pour into a 10x13 inch baking dish. Place pan in a larger pan containing warm water. Cover the pudding and refrigerate until very hot, 30 - 40 minutes. Line a steamer rack with plastic wrap, leaving 1 inch overhang on both ends, and set aside. Remove topping from plastic wrap. Coat both sides of sweet potatoes with potato starch and bake in a steamer rack in a 400f oven for 40 - 60 minutes or until tender, covering with foil halfway through. Prepare sweet potato sauce. Place 2 - 3 cups of sushi rice in a large bowl with enough vinaigrette to moisten. Sprinkle 1 - 2 drops of fish sauce or anchovy paste over seasoned rice. Dip each sweet potato in vinaigrette and place them in a 9x8 rectangular pan. Pour 1 layer of sweet potato sauce onto the sweet potato slices, and sprinkle with green sprinkles. Spread remaining sweet potato sauce over the sweet potato, brushing with sweet potato sauce on and around the sweet potato slices. Place in refrigerator and refrigerate until ready to serve. Remove from refrigerator 10 minutes before serving. Keep refrigerated.

title: Fried Pesto
ingredients: 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 cups oatmeal | 2 tablespoons cream | 1 tablespoon cognac | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons basil pesto
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the parmesan cheese and oatmeal. Add the cream, cognac and garlic salt. Stir in the coconut cream and basil pesto. Chill before serving.

title: Lemon Cream Cheese Steak Dip
ingredients: 2 packages philadelphia cream cheese | 12 ounces sour cream | 1 cup lemonade ( fresh if possible ) | 5 lbs sirloin
instructions: Shred or thinly slice your beef using a cheese grater, shred your beef if preferred. Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix all ingredients together and place in casserole dish to be placed in a cold oven. When cooled, place in freezer, or wait for a longer period before serving.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,broth,oregano,rice vermicelli,brown lentil,garlic paste,great northern bean,orange juice
title: Mediterranean and Brown Lentil Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces small brocolli beans, broken in half lengthwise | 10 ounces brown lentils | 1 1/2 cups frozen great northern beans, cut into 1-inch pieces | 3 cups sodium-reduced chicken broth | 5 tablespoons rice vermicelli | 2 tablespoons fresh squeezed orange juice | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon garlic paste, pressed
instructions: Cook beans and lentils in 1 3/4 cups of chicken broth until beans are tender, about 8 - 10 minutes or until lentils are tender but not mushy. Drain. Cook rice vermicelli, pasta, broth, vermicelli, orange juice, lemon pepper and garlic paste by adding to bean mixture in pan. Bring to a boil, stir.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,parsley flake,ginger garlic paste
title: The Essential Masala Masala
ingredients: 1/4 lb green chili pepper, chopped finely | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon fresh parsley flakes
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a bowl to blend them well. Store in an airtight container.

title: French Vanilla Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place chicken in a resealable bag. Combine vanilla and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Pour over chicken. Seal bag and refrigerate at least 15 minutes, or overnight. Drain chicken. Place chicken in a roasting pan. Cover and roast in a 350 degrees oven until an instant read thermometer reads 165 degrees, 5 to 7 minutes. Brush with a little of the maple flavoring.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,phyllo dough,thyme,macaroni,white sugar,arborio rice
title: Macaroni Arancini
ingredients: 8 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed according to package directions, thawed | 1/2 cup white sugar | 2 cups uncooked arborio rice | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 10 cups hot cooked macaroni | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with a silicone baking mat. Cut phyllo dough in half and cut each half into 3 pieces. Place one piece of phyllo into the baking sheet along with the sugar. Sprinkle half of the sugar on top and half of the arborio rice over the sugar. Repeat with the remaining phyllo, sugar, rice, arborio, thyme, and arborio in 2 more batches. Arrange three sheets of phyllo dough in the middle of baking sheet. Top with more phyllo. Use a knife to cut a 1/2 inch slash around the top of the arborio rice. Cut in the slash with a knife so that the arborio will look like an apple peel. Gently place arborio rice into a bowl, pour hot water over, and soak for 10 minutes. Repeat soaking 3 more times. Slice arancini diagonally into 6 pieces. Heat a large saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: egg white,chicken bouillon cube,garam masala,filling,rose petal,coconut cream
title: Filling for Indian Pancakes-Palak Bapies
ingredients: 2 cups filling | 1 cup coconut cream | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 large egg whites | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 teaspoon rose petal, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Mix all ingredients except the 1st 3 ingredients together. Spread 1/4 of the filling onto a pan. Spread 1/4 of the coconut cream on the filling. Sprinkle 1/8 of the crushed rose petals on the coconut cream. Place on a pizza pan. Bake 12 - 15 minutes for one side and 15 minutes for the other.

title: Raisin Tequila Infused Grape
ingredients: 1 cup dark raisins | 7 ounces gold tequila
instructions: In a small bowl add raisins and 2 tbsp of the tequila. Using a fork, mash into a loose paste. Add the tequila to the raisins, mix and refrigerate for 1 hour,. Strain, serve and enjoy.

title: Koshary Tarkari
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 2 1/2 cups red lentils, washed and drained | 3 tablespoons yoghurt | 4 tablespoons dried arugula leaves, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped hing
instructions: Put the beef into a slow cooker with the lentils and 2 1/2 cups water. Cook on high for 4 1/2 5 hours or low for 10 - 12 hours. You should have a thick soup. The amount of broth you used would depend on the beef used, but you can use more stock or water if needed during the cooking process. Stir in the yoghurt, arugula and horseradish. Adjust the seasoning to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with freshly cooked long grain rice if desired.

title: Mama Zuquinis D'avo (Truffled Vanilla Beans)
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely minced pimiento ( such as jarred hot pimiento ) | 2 -3 tablespoons grated pimiento ( such as jarred hot pimiento ) | 1 dash kosher salt
instructions: Toss pimento, pimiento and salt in a bowl that can easily be mixed. Leave in a cool place at room temperature until serving time. Store in the refrigerator in a jar in the refrigerator 6 months or until serving.

Random Ingredients: flax seed,no boil lasagna noodle,spanish olive,prune,green mung bean,kaiser
title: Mexican Bean Bread
ingredients: 4 kaiser rolls, split | 1 can pitted prunes, drained | 4 ounces green mung beans, drained | 1 jar roasted spanish olives, drained | 1/4 cup whole-wheat flour | 1 teaspoon celt-seed
instructions: Lightly toast split kaiser buns in toaster or toaster oven until lightly browned. Remove from oven and toast prunes and mung beans over low heat until heated through and lightly toasted. Spoon mixture evenly onto rolls. Top with olives and celt seed. Replace the tops and allow to cool completely. Eat warm.

title: Molasses Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked brown rice | 2 2/3 cups white wine vinegar or 2 2/3 cups soy vinegar | 3/4 cup molasses | 5 ounces of grated chocolate
instructions: Combine rice and vinegar in a saucepan. Stir in molasses. Boil and stir over low heat until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, about 15 minutes. Stir chocolate into hot rice mixture.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,walnut oil,asafoetida powder,ice,white rice,coriander powder
title: Asaféchida, Walnut Rice Balls in Oil
ingredients: 1 cup rice, medium grain, washed and drained | 2 cups walnut oil | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 cups ice | 1 pinch ground coriander powder | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat oil on medium heat. Add in the asafoetida stir fry on high flame for about 20 seconds. Add in the rice. Mix well. Once the rice turns pinkish in color, take it off the stove. Add walnut oil, coriander powder and ice to ground walnut oil. Mix once and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,bow tie pasta,bean sprout,double cream
title: Simple Bow Ties With a Proper Blush
ingredients: 350 g bow ties pasta ( multicoloured ) | 110 g mixed salad oil ( from a bottle of oil ) | 300 g bean sprouts | 150 ml double cream
instructions: Boil a pot of water. In a large sauté pan add the oil and put on a high heat and when the oil starts to smoke, add the salted water to cover the pasta in a steady slow stream. Turn down the heat to a slow bubble and do not let the water boil away. This pasta has a tendency to form a golden skin when it is cooked though but does not lose any flavor. Cook the pasta until the pasta has a nice creamy texture and it can be picked up to be cooked and kept in the pan. Meanwhile cut the bean sprouts into thin slices, if using fresh sprouts. When the water has all been absorbed and the pasta is ready, drain the pasta and add this to the frypan with the oil and bean sprouts and gently toss in the dressing. Pour in the cream and combine, it should be a slightly creamy consistency. Serve immediately, with grated parmesan and/or parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Tibetan Potato and Bean Salad
ingredients: 3 medium idaho potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1/3 cup sifted oatmeal | 1 tablespoon shaoxing wine | 1 teaspoon vodka
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot with enough water to cover by 1 inch, and bring to a boil over high heat. Cook until tender when pierced with a knife, about 15 minutes. Drain, and transfer potatoes and cannellini beans to a bowl. Mix in the oatmeal. Set aside. In a small saucepan, combine the sifted quaker, shaoxing wine, and vodka. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Pour warm potato mixture over the bean mixture, and toss until evenly blended. Transfer to a serving bowl, and chill until flavors meld, at least 2 1/2 hours.

title: Guajillo and Cabbage Yogurt(Guajillo Style)
ingredients: 1 lb red cabbage, shredded | 2/3 lb red cabbage, shredded | 4 ounces white mushrooms, thinly sliced and sauteed in olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 2 teaspoons soymilk ( may more )
instructions: Combine and chill to consistency of yogurt.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,green olive,self raising flour,italian seasoning,bouillon cube,red chili powder
title: Aussie Onion Tart - Onion Pizza Bites
ingredients: 3 large onions | 3/4 cup self raising flour | 1/2 cup olive | 6 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1 tablespoon red chili powder
instructions: Peel and slice the onions thinly, then fry in a pan with a little bit of oil or butter. Once they become caramelised in colour, add the onion to the onions and fry till tender and beginning to brown. Once the onions are browned, mix it all together and set aside to cool. Add a good amount of ketchup and mix together well. Spray an 18 x 12 baking tin with cooking spray or place onto a cookie sheet. Spread mix onto the pizza base then top with a layer of the sliced onions. Repeat for the remainder of the pie. Spread the rest of the ketchup over the top then sprinkle over the greek seasoning and chili powder. Bake for 15mins at remove and top with sliced olives or dried beans.

title: Italian Fruit Loaf
ingredients: 2 bananas, peeled and sliced into half moon shapes | 4 ounces salami, sliced | 4 ounces pineapple chunks, drained | 1 1/4 cups bisquick
instructions: Preheat oven to mix banana and salami together. Shape into loaf, place on greased baking sheet. Combine pineapple and bisquick, pour over fruit. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake 30 minutes, basting occasionally.

title: Cheese and Shells
ingredients: 1 lb shell pasta or 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1/2 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. When done, drain and set aside. Topping, melt 1/2 lb of the cheese in a microwaveable bowl, stirring in remaining cheese. Once melted, toss with pasta. Serve at once, or put on a platter and top with a sprinkle of grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,vanilla bean,chili paste,kidney bean,ham,dijon mustard,sun tomato oil,adobo seasoning
title: Smoked Smoky Ham and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup red kidney beans | 1/2 cup smoked ham, thinly sliced, any kind | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, seeded | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/8 teaspoon paprika or 1/8 teaspoon smoked paprika, for sprinkle | chipotle chili paste, for sprinkling | adobo seasoning, for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat grill or broiler. Combine beans, ham, tomato, chiles, chile paste, mustard, paprika and adobo in a bowl. Spoon over your favorite meats or serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ruby red grapefruit juice,beef brisket,tomato chutney,canadian bacon,mint leaf
title: Glazed Corned Beef With Tomatoes & Chutney
ingredients: 3/4 lb corned beef brisket | 2 ounces canadian bacon, minced | 1/3 cup tomato chutney | 1 1/3 cups ruby red grapefruit juice or 1 1/3 cups grapefruit juice | 4 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves, minced
instructions: Brown the brisket on all sides in hot dry non stick skillet for 10 minutes or until darkly browned, remove and leave on a plate. Add the bacon.

title: Pea Salad (Salad)
ingredients: 2 cans frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 2/3 cup lemonade concentrate, thawed | 1/4 cup chopped romaine lettuce
instructions: Mix thawed vegetables with lemonade concentrate. Spoon into a medium sized serving bowl and top with chopped lettuce.

Random Ingredients: fennel,matzo meal,green chili,anchovy,new potato,onion salt,cayenne pepper
title: Spiced Matzo Ball (aka Pita Bread)
ingredients: 1/2 package round matzo meal | 1/3 cup chopped onion ( may sub onion powder ) | 1 teaspoon anchovy, or | 2 teaspoons finely chopped onions | 1/4 teaspoon fennel, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon minced green chili | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 can petite diced new potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a medium bowl, mix together the matzo meal, onion, anchovy, fennel, green chilies, and cayenne pepper. Place a sheet of reynolds wrap aluminum foil on the counter to prevent sticking. Using a small spoon, scoop about a scant 1 1/2 teaspoons amount of the matzo meal mixture onto the sheet. With your fingers, lightly spread the matzo ball in a circular shape, about 3 inches in diameter. Repeat until all matzo ball mixture has been scooped and placed in the container. Sprinkle 1 1/2 tablespoons salt over the matzo mixture and press it lightly into the water. Repeat until all of the matzo mixture has been used. Line a baking sheet with a kitchen towel and coat with cooking spray. Place the potato slices on the towel and press with the palm of the hand to drain any excess moisture. Bake covered with foil for 50 - 60 minutes, until browned on the edges and tender. Serve hot. For dipping, drizzle chips with a little bit of each chile dip recipe and enjoy. Also, if you want to freeze it, dip it first into potato slices and then into matzo mixture, cover and freeze.

title: Tuscany Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 chicken breast, bone in | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 2 teaspoons dried sage | 1 cup apple cider
instructions: In food processor or large bowl, combine chicken, lemon zest, paprika and sage. Toss until chicken is evenly coated. Pour apple cider in slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 5 hours, or on low 10 hours until chicken is cooked and falling off the bone.

Random Ingredients: onion,tomato paste,hot water,margarine,cake flour,lasagna noodle,pepperoni,egg white
title: Pizza Crusts
ingredients: 4 egg whites | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1/3 cup margarine or 1/3 cup melted ghee | 1/2 cup cake flour or 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | hot water | 1 package lasagna noodles, no. 14 | 1 container pepperoni, cut in 8 pieces | 1 medium onion, sliced into thin wedges
instructions: In large bowl, beat egg whites with at least 1/2 teaspoon salt until stiff. Stir in tomato paste. Spread onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 425 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into strips 2 inches wide. Combine margarine or ghee with flour. Dip each strips of strips in butter or ghee to coat.

title: Apple & Basil Cheese Spread
ingredients: 300 g cream cheese | 1 tablespoon brown mustard | 1 can sliced apples, drained ( reserve juice ) | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 250 g cherries
instructions: Beat cream cheese, mustard, apples, dried basil, fennel and cherries in a bowl. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Quick and Easy Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb extra lean ground beef | 11 1/2 ounces chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat. Drain fat from skillet. Return to skillet and add 8 ounces of chicken broth.

title: Possibly the Best Russian Delight
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage | 1 can navy beans | 1 can sauerkraut | 1 container dream whip ( you won't need to put the dream whip into the bowl ) | shrimp | 1/2 cup shredded chocolate ( optional ) | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Boil about 10 minutes, remove from heat and let sit. In the meantime, cut cabbage into squares. Cook until clear in a pot. Remove head and cabbage, reserving cabbage. Break into squares, reserve. Rinse and drain sauerkraut. Pour sauerkraut and water into a large pot. Add in the cabbage. You can drain shrimp if you like or do the shrimp as I do, just use small enough to drain. Add in sauerkraut, refried beans, tomatoes and dream whip. Bring all to a boil, and then reduce to simmer and cook 3 hours, do not cheat on this, i like to eat this at lunch time. Before serving, add shaved chocolate or whatever you choose.

Random Ingredients: green apple,head iceberg lettuce,pork,green cardamom pod
title: Lorba
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground pork | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 green apple - peeled, cored and sliced into thin wedges | 4 green cardamom pods, cracked
instructions: Cook the ground pork with 2 tablespoons water in a large pot over medium low heat until the water is reduced to a thick, moist paste. Stir the lettuce and apple slices into the pork mixture.

Random Ingredients: topping,rosemary,balsamic vinegar,red lentil,ra el hanout spice mix,water,tomatillo
title: Moroccan Lentil Salad
ingredients: 250 g red lentils, washed | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon rosemary or 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 100 g tomatillos, chopped | 1 teaspoon ra el hanout spice mix | 125 ml boiling water
instructions: Soak lentils, ras el hanout, vinegar and rosemary in boiling water for 40 minutes drain and set aside. Put chopped tomatillos, ra el hanout and ra el hanout spice mix in a blender and puree. Put lentils on plate and top with the puree. Pour over water and sprinkle with saffron or other spices. Serve with crusty bread and couscous.
