title: Tandoori Anjeer (Indian Gingerbread)
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon espresso
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Beat the egg white in a large bowl. Then add in asafetida, brown sugar, ginger paste and cook for 10 minutes. Cut into pieces and mix into egg mixture. Bake in a lightly greased 9x12 inch pan for 40 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,lemon juice,kosher salt,arborio rice,chicken thigh,vanilla pudding mix,queso anejo,apple cider
title: Apple Cider Risotto Chicken
ingredients: 6 skinless chicken thighs | 3/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup queso anejo | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 tablespoon dried apple cider | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon kosher salt, divided | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( fresh, if possible )
instructions: Rinse chicken under cold water to remove the excess salt. Pat dry.

title: Quince Spread
ingredients: 6 pounds quinces | 2 cups margarine
instructions: Peel, core, and slice the quinces. Place in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, and cook until they are tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, cool, and chop finely. Stir in the margarine, and mix until creamy.

title: Kadki
ingredients: 1 large baking potato | 1 1/2 teaspoons margarine | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 4 jalapeno chilies
instructions: Wash potato thoroughly and cut off stem. Use a knife to scrape out most of the excess liquid, leaving the potato stuck in your hands. Slice potato in thin slices about 1/2 inch thick. Heat oil, in a large frying pan on medium high until very hot. Add potato to skillet with turmeric and chillies.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,soy sauce,tomato onion garlic,pickling spice,baking powder
title: Balsamic Steak
ingredients: 2 bunches tomatoes or 2 bunches grape tomatoes | 1 quart balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup tomato & onion garlic pickling spices | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 dash soy sauce
instructions: Rinse meat under cold water and pat dry. Mix all ingredients in gallon size zippered plastic bag. Refrigerate overnight. Remove meat and discard the marinade. Let marinate in refrigerator for at least one hour or in refrigerator overnight. Grill over hot coals or gas grill 15 - 20 minutes, depending on desired doneness. Turn. If possible, broil or bake at 400 50% until desired doneness.

title: Stuffed Pork Loins
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 lb coarsely chopped parma ham | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup long grain rice
instructions: Wash the tenderloins then cut a horizontal piece of waxed paper to fit inside your freezer plate. Using your fingers, press holes evenly into the pork. Cut a slit lengthwise down side of the pork but don't cut all the way through. Remove any membrane that may form. Combine the ham, egg, sour cream and rice. Spoon a little of the stuffing evenly over the pork. Close the pork and secure with another piece of waxed paper. Place in a freezer gallon bag with 2 cups ice cubes in it. Freeze at least 4 hours, or overnight. Remove pork from freezer. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. With a slotted spoon, remove meat from the freezer, then slice on the diagonal about 1/2 inch thick, about 1/3 to 1/2 inch thick. Place in a 9x9 inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the pork is 165 degrees f for 20 minutes. Slice and serve.

title: Baked Hawaiian Hot Bread With Tomatoes -- Martha Stewart
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into 3/4-inch-thick slices | 1 can ripe bamboo shoots, drained | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese, divided | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage | 2 cups thinly sliced lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: belgian endive,dark sesame oil,dark soy sauce,kahlua,vanilla essence,dill
title: Doughnuts and Endive in Kahlua
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg belgian endive, about 4 large ones ( or other mild green endive ) | 120 ml kahlua ( or other dark coffee liqueur ) | 200 ml dark soy sauce | 100 ml dark sesame oil | 200 ml baileys irish whiskey or 200 ml kahlua, depending on what strength you are using, or a bit of brandy like malibu rum | grated fresh dill, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c / 400°f/ gas mark score the endives about 3 4cm deep all over. Bring 2 cm / 5°c / water to the boil in a large casserole dish & throw the endives into it.. As soon as the water gets boiling, cover & return to the boil. Stir once only, & leave simmering for half an hour. As soon as this time as the endives are al dente, rinse under cold water & drain well. Discard the water. Put the kahlua, soy, sesame oil and whiskey in a bowl & mix thoroughly with a whisk. Drain the endive leaves in a colander, allowing excess moisture to drip off. Pour the liqueur into the empty bowl & stir to combine. Divide the leaves amongst serving plates & pour kahlua over. Sprinkle with dill & serve immediately.

title: Lasagna Batter
ingredients: 2 cups bisquick | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/2 cup milk ricotta cheese, well drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a medium bowl, combine the biscuit ingredients. Make a well in the center of the mixture and pour in the ricotta. Shake the bowl until smooth. Spray the bottom and sides of a 5 x 14 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place a heaping 2 teaspoons of the mixture into the prepared baking dish, cover with a circle or two of aluminum foil and bake for 15 minutes. Decrease heat to 350°f. After 15 minutes, remove with a long spatula and bake for an additional 15 minutes.

title: Cheese and Egg Rolls II
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds processed american cheese, coarsely grated | 1 can condensed tomato paste | 5 links mild tamarind paste | 1/2 cup dry masa harina | 2 tablespoons chopped roasted cashews | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger paste | 12 whole peeled ripe tomatoes
instructions: Cook processed american cheese and tomato paste in a large pot over medium heat.

title: Hominy II
ingredients: 2 cans hominy, drained | 1 can tomato sauce ( hunts )
instructions: Combine hominy and tomato sauce in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low until the hominy is tender, 8 - 10 hours.

title: Pineapple Fritters (Gosht)
ingredients: 6 fresh pineapple - peeled, cored and cut into wedges | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup self-rising flour, or more as needed | 1/4 cup ghee
instructions: Gently simmer the barley in a bowl of water over medium heat until just tender, 25 to 30 minutes. Drain and set aside until cool, about 5 minutes. In a separate bowl, stir together the flour, sugar and ghee until well blended. Stir into the barley and gently stir until the mixture has a crumb like consistency. Form into small balls, then press lightly between your fingers into desired shape. Place on a tray and refrigerate until set, 1 to 2 hours. Drain and serve.

title: Sweet Potato and Chicken Lasagne
ingredients: 1 lb sweet potato, peeled and cut into chunks | 6 chicken thighs | 1 pint ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 5 bay leaves | 2 cups sliced ripe olives | 1/4 cup vinegar | 4 lasagna sheets
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c gas mark. Mix potato, chicken thighs and ricotta in a large bow on a large baking tray. Sprinkle the flour over, and season with salt and pepper. Arrange in an even layer, over a mixture of olives and a bay leaf. Drizzle vinegar over with the leftover olive oil. Bake for 50 minutes, uncovered, on the middle shelves of the oven.

Random Ingredients: double cream,white sugar,palm sugar,oyster sauce,vanilla bean,sugar
title: Pancake Dessert
ingredients: 3 medium prawns, peeled, deveined | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1 teaspoon powdered sugar | 1/3 cup white sugar | 1/3 cup oyster sauce | 250 ml double cream
instructions: Place the garlic, vanilla and sugar in a small glass dish. Place over a high heat until caramelized, swirling to distribute caramelised sugar. Pour over the prawns and continue to cook. Remove from heat and stir in the oyster and cream. Pour into serving dishes and set aside at room temperature to firm up.

title: Carrot and Rose Hot Drum
ingredients: 1 cup carrot, grated | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 dash angostura bitters | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Combine all ingredients and leave to stand for 2 hours. Use half this for basting and other drumsticks.

title: Pork Tenderloins With Lime Yogurt
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloins | 4 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 can chopped green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, shiny side down. Cut a slit in the center of each pork tenderloins so that the meat will open up like a book. Place the pieces on the baking sheet and place in oven. Bake 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes. Remove foil, bake another 10 minutes, remove meat from oven and serve with lime yogurt.

title: Cajun Kebabs
ingredients: 1 box tortellini | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 3/4 cup marjoram, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 2 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Rinse tortellini well under cold water. Drain. Using a melon baller, scoop out the center of each tortellini ball. Rinse tortellini and pat dry.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,chili bean sauce,red pepper,thai fish sauce,red onion
title: Tamarind Chutney
ingredients: 2 red onions, finely chopped | 1 can tamarind paste ( you can buy it in the liquor aisle of most asian food stores ) | 1 tablespoon bottled minced red pepper ( optional ) | chili bean sauce | thai fish sauce
instructions: Roughly chop all ingredients in food processor. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,pearl barley,green olive,macaroni,lemon,edam cheese,baking potato
title: Barley Edam and Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups raw macaroni, dry | 2 cups shelled edam cheese, roughly grated | 10 ounces medium green olives, pitted and finely chopped | 2 red peppers, deseeded and finely chopped | 3 baby baking potatoes, halved and cooked | 2 lemons, zest of or 1 teaspoon orange zest | pearl barley ( optional )
instructions: Cook the macaroni till tender, drain and rinse under cold water. Place the pasta in a large bowl and mash together with half the cheese and half the olives. Make the dressing by putting the remaining cheese, olives, remaining olives and the zest into a food processor with the potatoes and gradually adding the hot water. Gradually blend in the dressing. Spoon into a serving bowl and leave at room temperature for 1 hour. When ready to serve, sprinkle with barley.

title: Linguica
ingredients: 1 lb linguica, preferably with a strong flavor | 1 dozen mussels
instructions: In a large saute pan, melt a medium to high head of mussels. When the shells start to open, remove from the shells and discard any beards and beards you detect. Wash under cold water until dry. Fill the hot, sterilized pot with water, place the mussels back over them and bring to a boil with 2 - 3 good pinches of salt and 1/4 teaspoon ground pepper. Lower the heat and simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes. While the soup is cooking, clean the mussels and remove any beards or shell fragments. Discard any mussels that have not opened. Scoop the mussels out of the shells and boil them for about 3 minutes to open them. Carefully scoop out the open ones, set them aside. Discard the shells. Toss with the cooked, drained mussels and adjust the seasoning. If the soup is very thick, stir in a tablespoon or two of cornstarch diluted in a tablespoon of water. Serve hot.

title: Alfredo Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 teaspoon garlic
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine all the ingredients, and warm over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool completely then store in an airtight container for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,italian sausage,red capsicum,nutmeg,red cabbage,apple cider vinegar,chocolate syrup,chervil
title: Irish Sausage Mince and Chips
ingredients: 4 large links italian sausage ( or equivalent of links of your favourite sausage ) | 1 red capsicum | 1 small red cabbage | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup | 1 pinch ground nutmeg, to add a bit of tartness ( optional ) | fresh chervil ( optional ) or fresh parsley ( optional ) | chopped fresh chervil ( optional )
instructions: Chop all the vegetables and put them in a pan and cover with the chicken broth, cider vinegar, chocolate syrup, nutmeg and fresh or dried chervil. Simmer very slowly.

Random Ingredients: honey,oyster sauce,polish sausage,lemon wedge,nori sushi,red chilies,basil,chili garlic sauce
title: Smoked Sausage & Chilli Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 12 ounces smoked polish sausage, cut into thin 1-inch chunks | 4 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons sweet chili-garlic sauce | 20 leaves fresh basil | 2 -3 red chilies, halved, deseeded, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sweet chili-garlic sauce | 8 sheets nori sushi sheets | lemon wedge, to serve
instructions: Preheat fan forced oven to 400 degrees. Line baking trays with baking paper. Place sausage in a clean, dry, non metallic bowl and pour over honey and sweet chilli garlic sauce. Stir to combine. Cover and refridgerate, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes or until sausage breaks off thread. Heat a pan of water over high heat, add sushi sausages and and cook, turning often, for 6 minutes. Lift sausages out of water with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add basil, chilli and garlic sauces to the pan and stir over high heat for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Transfer sausages to prepared trays. Spread a third of the basil mixture over each sausage and roll up loosely, using as little basil as possible. Spoon remaining spiced mixture onto centre of roll and top with remaining sausage. Seal rolls with kitchen tongs and place on prepared tray. Bake for 15 minutes or until sausages are cooked through and cooked through, brushing with sweet chilli sauce halfway through. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Beef Stew Served on Whole Wheat Cheats
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 4 ounces steak, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can catsup | 2 -3 tablespoons catsup | 1/4 teaspoon basil leaves | 1 can pitted cherries, drained and juice reserved | 2 tablespoons oleo, or other light oil
instructions: Heat oleo oil in large skillet or large stew pot over medium high heat. Add stew meat and brown on all sides. When meat is well browned, add catsup, catsup, basil, and juice from cherries.

title: Gerry's Sour Cream Dip
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce. ( or other pepper flavour enhancer such as mrs. dash )
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Irish Lace Cookies, (Trinidad & Tobago)
ingredients: 7 ounces self-rising flour | 5 ounces superfine sugar | 5 ounces creme fraiche ( optional )
instructions: Sift the flour and sugar into a bowl, cut in the butter and knead until smooth. Wrap in plastic wrap, then leave to rest for an hour. Divide the dough in half. Roll out one half to a thickness of about 1/8, then cut the dough to fit and use to line six 3 1/2 3 1/2 to 3 - 2 3/2 inch muffin tins or loose-lined cake pans. Bake the tins in a preheated oven for 5 to 10 minutes, or until the tops are pale golden brown. Cool on a wire rack. Top with crème fraîche, if desired.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,green cardamom,tart apple,cardamom seed,pork chop,fruit
title: Cardamom Sausages - Spiced French Pork Chops for 4
ingredients: 4 thick slice peeled tart apples ( about 1/4-inch thick ) | 2 tablespoons flat dried fruit ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped green cardamoms ( or 1 tsp. ground cardamom ) | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom seed | 2 teaspoons finely crushed black cardamom seeds | 4 -5 trimmed boneless pork chops
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat until hot. Place the apples in a single layer in the bottom of the skillet. Sprinkle the apples with the dried fruit.

Random Ingredients: white wine,yellow onion,oatmeal,linseed,spanish onion,plum,lamb shank,black cumin
title: Lamb Shank and Plums With Spesi
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yellow onions, halved lengthwise, then cut into thin wedges | 1/4 cup white wine | 1 1/2 lbs lamb shanks | 4 plum tomatoes, roughly chopped | 3 tablespoons spanish dried oatmeal | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon cracked black cumin | 1 1/2 lbs linseeds from oats ( see note in introduction )
instructions: Place onions in a large pan, add 2 - ½ quarts water and bring to the boil over high heat. Boil, uncovered, for 20 minutes to reduce the liquid slightly. Trim and discard fat from lamb shanks, then place in a heavy pot with the halved onions, 1 - ½ quarts water, and white wine. Simmer, loosely covered, for 1½ hours. Turn out lamb shanks and return liquid to the pan, then stir in the tomatoes and oatmeal, cumin, and black cumin. Cover, adjust heat to medium low and cook for 1 hour. Place the reserved lamb shank on a heated griddle or hot frying pan and cook the lamb, turning, for 10 minutes or so, until cooked through. Skim any fat from cooking liquid. Remove from pan and place on warmed platter. Pour sauce over lamb and serve with fresh parsley sprigs.

title: Fresh Pomegranate Seeds
ingredients: 5 poblano chile peppers | 4 cups plain greek yogurt | 8 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Roast the pomegranate seeds until slightly charred all over, about 30 minutes. Place the pomegranate seeds in a clean tea towel and squeeze all the liquid out. Heat a grill pan over low heat, and broil until the skins are scorched, about 10 minutes. Remove the pomegranate seeds from the grill.

title: Homemade Aromatic Herbed Stock
ingredients: 4 cups homemade unsweetened applesauce | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh chives | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Blend appleauce and chives well in blender or with heavy duty mixer. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into crock or other bowl and refrigerate 3 to 4 days before serving. The mixture can also be stored, tightly covered, in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks.

title: Yellow Spanish Pepper
ingredients: 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into rings | 1 can roasted broth | 1/2 cup quick-cooking wine
instructions: Place bell pepper in a 4 quart covered casserole. In bowl, combine hot peppers, broth, and cooking wine. Stir to combine. Cover and bake at 375° 30 minutes or until tender. Serve hot.

title: Cuban Chili Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb penne or 1 lb ziti pasta | 1 1/2 lbs lean hamburger ( or use ground pork ) | 2 tablespoons lime juice or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a large saucepan with a tight lid, cook the hamburger until fully cooked and no longer pink. Add the uncooked penne or ziti and cook until dry.

title: English Cucumber-Raspberry Slice
ingredients: 1 english cucumber ( about 175 grams x 1 cm or so ) | 500 g frozen raspberries | 150 g chocolate ice cream
instructions: If you don't have a strainer, place a paper cup on the base of a shallow baking tray and sprinkle evenly with raspberries to cover it evenly. Using a potato peeler or a sharp knife, scoop out the large seeds with the cucumber to be able to use in the slice. If you do it really well, the raspberry can suddenly burst through the peel and your slice will be too runny. Line the baking tray with a slice of clingfilm, allowing an excess clingfilm to run over the slice. I like to line my trays with clingfilm to help them all out. Place the scooped out cucumber on the tray and spread evenly with raspberries. Top the cucumber with a second slice of clingfilm, more clingfilm and the remaining raspberries. Press all around with your hands. This helps make all the slices of cucumber adhere to the cling film and prevent them from falling out. Chill for 5 minutes up to 24 hours. Using a sharp knife, cut each slice into 6 slices each. Once chilled, cover the slices with plastic wrap and store for upto 1 week. For even better results, remove the plastic wrap and slice into wedges just prior to serving.

title: Spicy Brown Basmati Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown basmati rice | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate ( or use regular chocolate chips if you wish ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of the chocolate in a small saucepan over low heat stirring constantly until melted.

title: Truffes and Chocolates
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 tablespoon ground paprika | 1/4 cup slivered almonds | chocolate sprinkles
instructions: Pour the pumpkin, paprika, and almonds into the bowl of a food processor, and pulse until chocolates are finely chopped. Add enough sprinkles to form the coating into a thick consistency that adheres to a spoon. Drop cookies into boiling, salted water. Boil for 1 minute, then remove and drain. Makes about 1 cup, or enough to make 1 quart or use to stuff more chocolate balls.

Random Ingredients: skin chicken thigh,button mushroom,cauliflower,coconut oil,green olive
title: Baked Cauliflower Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 tablespoons coconut oil, plus extra for brushing | 1 kg skin-on chicken thigh, cut into 2cm pieces | 750 g cauliflower, cut into florets | 100 g mixed button mushrooms, halved | 100 g green olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Drizzle a third of the coconut oil into a shallow baking dish. Add chicken and set aside. Place cauliflower and mushrooms in a pan, pour over remaining coconut oil. Cover loosely with foil and bake in hot oven for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, brush chicken with remaining coconut oil. Brush with the coconut oil. Bake the cauliflower, mushrooms and olives for a further 15 - 20 minutes to brown and crisp. Serve sprinkled with additional coconut oil and some fresh coriander.

title: Easy Flank Steak Tagine (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 flank steak | 6 cubes chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: Place the flank steak and a bouillon cube in the slow cooker. Sprinkle the cumin on it. Cook on high 2 hours, or low 10 minutes. Use two forks to shred the meat and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,loaf french bread,canola oil,baby spinach,fruit,beef sirloin steak,yam,cranberry
title: Grilled Beef and Yams Salad With Crunchy French Fries
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, about 12 ounces | 1 large yam, peeled, cut lengthwise into 1 1/2-inch-thick slices | 1/2 cup dried fruit, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon peel | 2 loaves crusty french bread, cut diagonally 3/4 inch slices | 1 lb fresh baby spinach, washed and dried
instructions: Trim fat from steak, if desired.

title: Cashew Chicken
ingredients: 1 package sliced button mushrooms | 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 can unsweetened condensed chicken broth | 3/4 cup orange juice | 1 package sliced fresh tortillas | chopped roasted cashews
instructions: Place mushrooms in ungreased 13x9 inch baking dish. Arrange chicken on top of mushrooms. Combine chicken broth and orange juice in a mixing bowl.

title: Brandy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup brandy | garnish ( any amount )
instructions: Pour brandy over the base of an airtight container or plate with a lip. Let it sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Dip your hands in brandy/spice mix to coat liberally, and then gently massage the coated surface with your fingertips to gently squeeze the alcohol from the brandy coating. It may seem like a lot of booze at first but as your hands become coated, it will release some of the alcohol. Use as desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,wheat berry,sandwich bun,hot green chili pepper,edamame,mexican rice,chicken bouillon
title: Easy Mexican Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked mexican rice ( about 8 ozs ) | 1 chicken bouillon | 14 ounces salmon fillets | 1 cup frozen shelled edamame | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup whole wheat berries, hulled and coarsley chopped | hot roll or sandwich bun
instructions: Pour 1/2 c rice in bottom of a greased shallow 2 1/2 4 1/2 qt casserole dish. Sprinkle 1/2 tsp of chicken bouillon over rice. Place fish in dish. Sprinkle 1/2 tsp of chopped frozen edamame over fish. Sprinkle 1/4 c of green chile over green chile. Arrange salmon over rice. Scatter rice evenly over entire surface of salmon. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 c green chile and chopped olives. Cover and bake in 325°f oven 15 minutes or until rice and salmon are tender and fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve over hot brown rice.

title: Green Chile Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans whole green chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, toasted
instructions: Using vegetable peeler, remove long strips of peel from each green chile. Bring remaining water to boil in a medium size, heavy bottomed saucepan. Remove chiles and discard stems. Place peppers in water.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,cilantro,pork,lemon juice,chicken wing,brown lentil,chicken bouillon cube,passion fruit
title: Creamy Lentil Chicken With Prawns and Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 350 g brown lentils | 600 ml nonfat milk | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 10 ounces ground pork or 10 ounces lamb | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons cilantro, chopped | 8 ounces frozen diced passion fruit | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped | chopped cilantro
instructions: Cook the lentils by covering with water. Bring to the boil then simmer for 1 hr until the lentils are soft. Drain the lentils, return to the pan and add the milk and water. Bring to the boil then simmer for 30 minutes until the lentils are soft or 40 mins if using frozen. Dissolve the stock cube in the lemon juice and set aside. Stir fry the minced pork in a frying pan, set aside. Add the fritters, the cilantro and diced passionfruit to the pan and stir fry for 2 mins until the passionfruit is golden. Taste and add salt & pepper if necessary. Drain the lentil and prawns, pour over the pesto sauce and mix well. Place under a preheated grill and grill for 4 - 5 mins until bubbly and golden.

title: Chunky Peanut Butter Pancake Syrup
ingredients: 1/2 cup mild chunky peanut butter | 1/3 cup skim milk
instructions: In a medium size bowl, add peanut butter and milk. Mash until the peanut butter melts into the milk. Slowly mix in some chunky peanut butter until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Super Easy Hummus
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Place all ingredients in an airtight container and shake to combine. Let sit at least 30 minutes for flavours to blend. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,rom tomato,egg noodle,jalapeno pepper cheese,shiitake mushroom,pumpkin puree,leek
title: Pumpkin Veggie Noodle and Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 cups egg noodles, cooked, drained | 2 pints shiitake mushrooms, quartered | 8 ounces roma tomatoes, halved | 4 tablespoons tomato paste | 3 leeks, sliced crosswise | 12 ounces jalapeno pepper cheese, grated ( about 2 cups, i use cabot ) | 1/2 cup pumpkin puree
instructions: Prepare vegetables. Cut rinds from leeks, remove strings, slice thinly, place in a small bowl, and reserve. Cut mushrooms, remove stems, cut in half lengthwise and discard. Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices and then into 1/2 inch slices. Combine tomato paste and reserved rinds, stir well. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Spray jelly roll pan with non stick spray. Stir tomato paste mixture into noodles, stir. Transfer to prepared pan. Sprinkle top with half cheese. Bake for 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Serve sprinkled with remaining cheese. Goes great with salad.

title: Aromatic Currant and Coriander Seeds
ingredients: 200 g currants | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 4 garlic cloves, peeled | 3 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Pound the currants and coriander seeds together in a pestle and mortar with a few cloves of garlic. Put all the ingredients into a deep ovenproof dish, and pour over the sesame oil. Place in a preheated oven and bake in a moderately hot oven for about 40 minutes or until the currants have darkened slightly.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,self rising flour,maple syrup,ginger root,baking potato,raisin,baking soda
title: Potatoes and Raisins
ingredients: 3/4 cup raisins | 1 cup natural maple syrup | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup baking soda | 1 teaspoon ginger root, grated | 1 cup roasted shredded chocolate | 1 tablespoon baking potatoes, peeled and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine raisins in a small bowl and pour in maple syrup. Set aside. In a medium size mixing bowl, sift flour with baking soda, ginger, chocolate, and baking potato. Add raisin mixture and stir until combined. Drop by rounded teaspoons 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheets spaced 3 inches apart. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes and check for doneness, not over browned.

title: Spicy Tempeh Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb tempeh, minced ( can be found at many grocery stores or italian shops ) | 3 ounces tequila ( may be substituted with a good shot of pepsi ) | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/2 tablespoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f/230°c. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. In medium bowl, combine tempeh, tequila, and cream. Mix until mixture is smooth and creamy. Stir in fenugreek. Transfer to shallow pyrex baking dish. Bake about 15 - 20 minutes or until slightly golden.

title: Minted Orzo and Wheat Noodles (Lazy Tong)
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint | 2 ounces whole wheat linguine
instructions: Bring a kettle of water to boil. Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain pasta, return to the kettle. Stir soy sauce, mint, and linguine into pasta with soy sauce and noodles.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,greek yogurt,part mozzarella cheese,rigatoni pasta,mint,red chili pepper,chuck
title: Greek Meat Pasta Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 2 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 2 teaspoons dried mint | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 can fat-free greek yogurt | 1 chopped red chili pepper, seeded ( optional ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, or until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium heat, mix together the ground chuck, mint, chili powder, and yogurt and chili pepper, if using. Drain. Add cooked noodles, and toss until coated well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Before serving, sprinkle cheddar cheese on top of salad and toss. Note, this may also be made with ground beef, pork, and chicken.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,pine nut,caster sugar,shrimp paste,lasagna noodle
title: Shrimp and Pine Nut Lasagna
ingredients: 1 packet lasagna noodles | 2 packets cream of mushroom soup | 300 g cooked shrimp paste | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 50 g pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Grease & line the bottom & sides of an ovenproof dish with aluminium foil add the rice noodles a few at a time into a microwaveable bowl & pour over the soup, then pour the mixture over the noodles. Cover with foil & cook for 20 - 30 mins, then stir in the shrimp paste & sugar. Top with pine nuts & bake in oven for 15 mins or slightly more until the sauce has thickened. Serve hot.

title: Peach
ingredients: 1/4 ounce pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 ounce peach schnapps | 1 dash turmeric ( optional )
instructions: Fill the shaker with ice. Shake well and pour in peach schnapps. Add any optional ingredients. Drink immediately.

title: Aniseed Beer
ingredients: 12 ounces amber beer | kalamata olives, chopped | 4 anise seeds
instructions: Pour the beer into a glass measuring cup and swirl the olive and anise until well combined. Add most of the olives and garnish by adding more. Strain into a glass using ice cubes. Sprinkle with additional aniseeds.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,italian plum tomato,eggplant,cabbage,lime zest,sage,avocado,blue cheese
title: Grilled Eggplant (Aubergine) Rollups
ingredients: 1 ripe italian plum tomato | 3 tablespoons italian speckled green goddess spreadable blue cheese | 2 small red seedless eggplants, cut lengthwise in half | 1 large ripe avocado, sliced crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 tablespoon finely grated lime zest | 1/2 teaspoon minced sage | 1/2 head cabbage, leaves torn into uniform pieces | 8 mandarin oranges, cut in half
instructions: Prepare grill to medium or medium high, and lightly oil the grate. Line the shallow bottom of an 8 x 8 x 2 baking pan with several layers of black pepper to stop the cooking of the vegetables. Place a grapefruit or cherry tomato onto the grate. Cut the tomato into 5 slices. Split the tomato slices lengthwise, and cut crosswise into thin strips. Remove the seeds from the avocado slices. Slice the tomato into 1/4 inch thick slices on the horizontal. On a cutting board with kitchen shears, snip the edges from the cheese and place into a small bowl. Place the blue cheese and eggplant slices onto the prepared grates, and brush with lime zest. Sprinkle 1 to 2 tablespoons italian speckled cheese over the top. Place 1 tomato slice on top of each, and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon minced sage and 1/2 teaspoon minced sage. Starting on the outside bottom of the pan, place several dollops of eggplant and cheese mixture into the center of the tomato slices. Starting in the center, place 3 or 4 mandarin oranges, cut side down, onto each tomato slice and in between the two slices,. Carefully lift out the pan of tomatoes and oranges with a rubber spatula, and place onto the hot grill. Grill the eggplant and cheese stacks until the cheese browns. Flip and turn again, and continue to grill until the tomato is soft, about 4 1/2 minutes longer. When the first side has been grilled, brush the eggplant with lime zest. Transfer to a platter and top with remaining tomato slices and orange slices. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Roasted Corn and fruit pizza
ingredients: 1 package prepared pizza crust | 3 cups cooked corn | 1 1/2 cups dried fruit, chopped ( your fav. ) | 1 teaspoon spices | 2 -3 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes | 3 teaspoons mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to in a bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Place pizza crust on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with mixture, top with any other toppings that are desired. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes, or until crust is browned. Serve with favorite toppings.

Random Ingredients: chili seasoning mix,green enchilada sauce,chicken bouillon cube,cornflour,orange
title: Homemade Enchilada Filling
ingredients: 1 medium red onion, finely chopped | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 envelope chili seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f put all liquid ingredients in a sauce pan and bring to the boil, stirring often. Reduce heat and simmer until slightly thickened and reduced, about a minute or two. Mix cornflour with 2 tbsp water, add and stir until well blended. Put enchilada filling in a bowl and stir well. Add remaining ingredients, blending thoroughly. Pour into a 9 square baking dish and bake at 400f for about 30 - 35 more minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Pistachio Pods
ingredients: 1 package shelled pistachios | 1/2 cup black sesame seeds
instructions: Place sesame seeds and pistachios on a square of aluminum foil, and sprinkle each with 1/4 cup of the sesame seeds. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and leave to cool, then break up and set aside.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,garlic powder,chunky salsa,white bean,milk,mozzarella cheese
title: Easy White Bean (Or Rice) Casserole
ingredients: 5 cans white beans, drained | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1 package sliced mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup shredded coconut or ( 8 ounce ) package monterey jack cheese | garlic powder ( or other seasoning ) | 1 cup milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients, mix well. Place in lightly greased casserole dish and stir to mix. Bake uncovered at 350 - 45 - 60 minutes, stirring twice. Note, you can use fresh beans, but you'll have to bake for a few minutes longer.

title: Easy Cheesy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cheddar cheese soup ( campbell's select gold petite cheese soup ) | 6 vegetarian chicken bouillon cubes ( pillsbury )
instructions: In a medium pot, add cheddar cheese soup, water and bouillon. Boil all together for about ten minutes. Serve sauce over your favourite pasta and enjoy.

title: Roasted Asian Sesame Oil
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup asian aromatic sesame oil | 1 cup unsalted butter ( room temp can be substituted ) or 1 cup margarine ( room temp can be substituted )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake and shake well to blend all ingredients. Pour onto baking sheet coated with oil. Turn as needed. Cover loosely and chill 3 - 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,basil,sharp cheddar cheese,bean curd,dark chocolate,yeast,almond butter
title: Creamy Noodle Buns
ingredients: 350 g spaghetti | 50 g yeast | 400 g refried beans curd | 50 g almonds butter | 150 g sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 100 g dark chocolate or 100 g dark chocolate chips | 1 bunch fresh basil, shredded. to garnish
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in a large saucepan of water until it is soft. Drain in a colander. Grease an ovenproof dish with butter and heat. Sieve the yeast into a large bowl. Sift the sugar into another bowl. Cream the refried bean curd in a separate bowl. Dissolve the yeast into the sugar while stirring so that some of the sugar crystals dissolve into it. Whisk in the softened beans and almonds. Turn the heat to lowest and heat the butter and sugar. Stir the mixture with a wooden spoon. When it comes to a boil, stir in the noodles and let boil for a minute or two. Put the spaghetti in the oven to warm. Grate the cheese into the same bowl you used to soften the soured bean curd. Stir it into the noodles. Pour the noodle mixture into this mixture. Put the bowl onto the oven for a few minutes to warm through. Garnish with the shredded cheese and basil and serve.

title: Easy Beef and Salsa Burritos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef stew meat | 1 1 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Heat large, heavy bottomed pot over medium high heat. Add stew beef and cook for 3 - 4 min., or until no longer pink. Stir in salsa. Heat 5 minute or until bubbly. Serve over burritos.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,caesar salad dressing,chipotle chile adobo,tomato green chilies,cooking oil,red pepper,barbeque sauce,red cabbage
title: Chipotle and Red Cabbage Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon mustard seed | 1 bag chopped red cabbage | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 2 canned diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 tablespoon finely chopped chipotle chili with adobo | 1 teaspoon caesar salad dressing
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the barbecue sauce and mustard seed. Cook and stir until mustard seeds are fragrant, about 1 minute. Mix in the red cabbage, red cabbage, and tomatoes. Stir in chipotle peppers. Mix in the sauteed chili. Cook and stir until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Cheddar Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 4 -6 pieces aged cheddar cheese ( i use a grated blend of cheddar and fontina ) | 1 cup whole blanched almond | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º. Coat cookie sheet with sesame oil and bake cheese slices 7 - 9 minutes or until golden brown. Spread top with the cheddar cheese.

title: Pumpkin-Bourbon Sauce - Vinegar and Red Wine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Combine vinegar and nutmeg in a small non reactive bowl. Place in microwave and cook on high for 30 seconds or until almost completely absorbed. Remove from microwave, stir, and set aside to cool to room temperature until ready to use.

title: Fennel and Sun-Dried Tomato Spread
ingredients: 1 large fennel bulb | 6 ounces shredded velveeta cheese | 7 ounces chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 tablespoons amaretto
instructions: Shred the fennel with your fingers. Saute in olive oil. Mix cheese, sauteed fennel, tomatoes and amaretto together until warm and creamy. Serve with crackers.

title: Roasted Olive Oil - Jamie Oliver.
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh curry powder | 8 ounces roasted sweet olives
instructions: Heat a heavy based saucepan, add the oil and bring to boil, without boiling. Add the curry powder and allow to simmer over a medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes, stirring from time to time. Add the olives and stir well. Turn out onto a serving plate when serving. Serve with french breads and extra yoghurt, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cranberry juice,cake flour,mushroom,self rising flour,clove,red food coloring,soy sauce,chicken leg
title: Chicken Legs
ingredients: 4 chicken legs | 1/2 cup self rising flour | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup cranberry juice | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 2 teaspoons ground cloves | 2 drops red food coloring ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Rinse and dry chicken legs.

title: Kielbasa Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds kielbasa slices | 4 large potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 can or bottle irish stout beer | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh sage | 1 tablespoon knorr chicken bouillon
instructions: Place the kielbasa, potatoes, beer, parsley, sage, and bouillon into a large, heavy pot and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Turn all the ingredients over and continue cooking covered over low heat. Continue cooking until the potatoes are tender and well flavored, about 1 hour more.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,worcestershire sauce,bulk pork sausage,clam,chili powder,cider vinegar,orange
title: Mexican Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk pork sausage | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning ( mild or hot ) | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 orange, peeled and sectioned | 1 lb clams, scrubbed
instructions: In a small saucepan, simmer sausage in water. Stir in remaining ingredients except clams. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until liquid has reduced. Add clams. Cook just until hot, 5 - 7 minutes.

title: Coconut Glaze
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coconut flour, sifted | 2 tablespoons marsala or 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Combine coconut flour and marsala in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: coffee,fish sauce,vermicelli,chicken bouillon,roquefort cheese,triple sec,fruit,water chestnut
title: St. Filip's Delight
ingredients: 2 cups vermicelli ( soaked in water overnight, drained ) | 14 ounces chicken bouillon | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups fish sauce | 2 1/4 cups water chestnuts ( drained ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup instant coffee ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 2 -3 cups roquefort cheese ( optional )
instructions: Boil vermicelli until they float, then transfer vermicelli to colander. Pour boiling boiling water over vermicelli and let drain for about 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Place remaining ingredients and 1 cup cooking liquid and mix well. Place drained vermicelli in a bowl and pour sauce over the it. Mix well and let stand on counter for about 15 minutes for flavors to develop. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Baked Manicotti
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup craisins | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary or 1/1 teaspoon marjoram | 3 tablespoons miniature semisoft dried breadcrumbs | 7 ounces manicotti
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. In a small bowl, thoroughly combine the 1 1/4 cups bread crumbs, craisins, rosemary, mini semisoft dried breadcrumbs and 1/2 teaspoons salt. Stir in the manicotti until well coated with dough. Place the mixture in a sprayed 9 by 13 inch baking dish, and spread evenly. Incorporate the 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese. Spread over the dough, and bake until golden brown at 40 minutes, or until the filling is hot and melted. Remove from the oven, and let stand about 5 minutes before removing from the baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,sesame oil,coriander seed,farfalle pasta,green bean,peanut butter,asparagus,soy sauce
title: Chinese Noodle Salad W- Spicy Beef
ingredients: 1/2 bunch asparagus, cut in 2 inch lengths | 1/2 lb green beans, cut in 2 1/2 inch lengths | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 500 g dried farfalle pasta | 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Soak the asparagus pieces until tender but not mushy. Place into boiling water and then simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. Let cool and then chop into bite size lengths. Cook the diced beef in skillet with asparagus until cooked through. Reserve. Boil the 2 1/2 cups water and add the noodles. Cook according to package directions until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water and drain well. To assemble, place half of noodles on a serving platter and top with 1/4 chopped asparagus, 1/4 chopped green beans and 1/4 of the diced tomatoes. Combine the 2 1/2 cups water and the 2 tablespoons soy sauce and pour over the top.

Random Ingredients: white onion,onion,spinach leaf,beef chuck roast,cardamom powder
title: Beef Stew in Spinach Leaves
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast, about 1 1/2 in. thick | 2 medium sized onions, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 1 white onion, chopped | 1 sprig of fresh mint or 1/4 teaspoon dried mint, as per your preference | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 cups spinach leaves
instructions: In a dutch oven, combine all ingredient. Cover and cook on low heat for 2 to 3 hours, lifting off fat and stirring regularly. Add spinach leaves and cook on low heat until the spinach leaves are done.

title: Island Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups cherry, fresh or frozen | 2 -3 ounces rice flour or 2 -3 ounces japanese-style rice flour | 1/4 cup thousand island dressing | 1 pinch garlic | 1 -2 tablespoonisland-style dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Blend until almost smooth. Add rice and 1/4 cup dressing and combine well. Divide and roll into 18 - 20 rolls. Seal roll by moistening edges of roll completely with warm, damp towel. Roll each one with your hands. Place in but not touching oven until cooked, approximately 25 minutes.

title: Moroccan Kale
ingredients: 600 g winter kale | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 4 teaspoons cinnamon powder ( or use 2 tsp ground cinnamon ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 120 g chopped dried vermicelli | 180 ml whole milk chocolate-covered yogurt | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar ( or 1 tsp. )
instructions: Wash the kale very carefully with boiling water then drain and set aside. Place all the glaze ingredients in a small saucepan then cook over medium low heat until honey is melted and smooth. Pour over the kale in a bowl. Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to 4 hours. After chilling for 10 minutes or overnight, slice the kale thinly. Place the cooked chopped kale on plate, top with a serving of the melted vermicelli then finish with the yogurt or chocolate covered cream cheese. Enjoy.

title: Slab Bacon, Chilli and Pineapple Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun | 1/2 lb lean slab bacon, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon finely shredded lemon peel
instructions: Split the hamburger buns horizontally. Toast the buns and spread each half with the chili sauce. Layer the hamburgers on top of the sauce on each bun top with the thin slices of bacon and a sprinkling of shredded lemon peel.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,angel food cake mix
title: Slow-Cooker Black-Eyed Pea Jellies
ingredients: 16 ounces angel food cake mix | 1 cup fresh black-eyed peas for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Set aside. When cake is done, spread black eyed pea mixture over entire dish, coating evenly and distributing bean evenly. Cook on low setting for approximately 30 minutes, making sure that pudding does not dry out. If using fresh pea pods, place them into a microwave safe bowl with about 1/2 cup water. Place covered bowl on top of sink, or microwave safe serving dish. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until water has evaporated and peas are soft.

Random Ingredients: dark molasses,lemon zest,ice water,cabbage,papaya,chicken stock,italian breadcrumb,balsamic vinegar
title: Cabbage, Sweet Potato and Paya Soup
ingredients: 2 cups fresh italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup fresh sweet potato or 1 cup sweet potato, peeled and diced | 1 can sweetened condensed chicken broth | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 2 tablespoons light-colored molasses | 2 1/2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 4 cups shredded cabbage | ice water, as needed
instructions: Place the bread crumbs in a bowl. Stir in the sweet potato, broth, zest, molasses and vinegar. Pour cabbage and water into the mixture and stir until thoroughly combined. Use just enough ice water to lightly coat a large baking dish. Drop a ladle of soup into the oven and bake soup at 400 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve when soup looks crispy and browned.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean paste,chili powder,triple sec,parmesan cheese,sun tomato
title: Italian Macaroni & Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb large macaroni noodles or 1 lb spaghetti, fresh or dried | 6 tablespoons sun-dried tomato, oil packed | 1/3 cup triple sec or 2 -3 drops chili powder | vanilla bean paste | parmesan cheese, to coat top
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. While pasta is cooking, remove towel from bag of noodles. Coat large skillet with pam, set over medium high heat. When pan is hot, add noodles and oil, stirring constantly until noodles are well coated with oil and slightly browned, about 3 - 5 minutes. Add triple sec. Stir until combined. Add chili powder. Cook for a minute or two, just until it begins to heat up a bit and mix inches. Plate pasta, add sauce and garnish with grated parmesan cheese.

title: Baked Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients: 3 ounces chicken legs, legs and thighs | 7 ounces watermelon, cubed | 1 1/2 ounces soy sauce | 2 ounces baked beans
instructions: Remove skin and excess fat from chicken legs and thighs and cut each into thirds lengthways. Place chicken and skin in casserole dish. Sprinkle soy sauce over and dot with baked beans. Bake in oven at 180°c for 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,mix,self raising flour,green chilies,celery rib,celery,filling
title: Green Chile Grass Rollups(Chile Con Queso)
ingredients: 1 lb green chilies, deseeded and chopped | 1/4 cup celery, finely chopped | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 1/4 cup dried filling | 1 medium lime wedge, squeezed | 2 green chilies, seeded and chopped | 2 celery ribs, chopped | flour, for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f in a mixing bowl, combine the chilies, celery, flour and fILLING, and mix well. Squeeze the lime wedge in the mixture and add to the flour mixture. Using your hands, form the mixture into walnut sized balls. Roll the dough balls in flour and place them on a greased baking tray. Repeat with the remaining dough balls. Cover and cook for 30 minutes. Drain the chilies well and return to the pan. Gently reheat the chilies for 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Remove the celery sticks. Toss the chilies and celery through the onion and season well. Serve at room temperature or warm.

title: Leek and Ricotta Cheese Puree for Two
ingredients: 250 g fresh ricotta cheese | 300 g fresh leeks | 4 tablespoons tequila
instructions: Pre heat grill on high. Wash leeks in a large bowl wash the leeks well place in a microwave safe bowl. Add tequila to the bowl. Combine cheese and leeks with mixer in a food processor. Place bowl over pan of stove to heat up and mix together. When it starts to get sticky take off the stove. Place mixture into food processor, and process until it forms a smooth creamy paste place on a plate. Spread it on your favorite biscuit or toast and enjoy.

title: Spanish Oven-Fried Date and Sweet Potato Fries
ingredients: 1 kg pitted dates | 1 kg sweet potato ( or equivalent egg substitute potato ) | red pepper flakes
instructions: Cut the pits out of the sweet potato using a mandolin. Break up the sweet potato using a rolling pin or other rolling tool, and pound the potato until it is 1 centimetre thick. Cut the date in half, scoop out the pulp, and set the pits into the pits. Slice the potato into wedges about 1 centimetre wide and roughly the same size as the dates using a sharp paring knife. Arrange the wedges in a baking pan lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle all the ingredients around the wedges in the pan. Spray the top with cooking oil. Bake in a 180c oven for about 45 mins to one hour, or until the dates have softened, turning them regularly. Turn off the oven. Remove the papery skin off the wedges using a small strainer and discard, leave only the flesh. You can leave all the skin on, but if you find it, leave some at one time. Slice wedges crossways into thin slices or triangles and serve straight away. I serve them immediately with sweet potato flakes and warm french bread. I'm not sure if they're sold like this, but i'm really a pick up fan of it.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,ladyfinger,chipotle pepper,tomato,ricotta cheese,ham steak,rice wine,monterey jack cheese
title: Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 3 canned chipotle peppers, seeded and diced | 1/2 lb smoked ham steak, diced | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 6 ladyfingers, quartered | 1 cup rice wine ( jerez ) | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Arrange rack in lower third of oven and preheat broiler. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with foil, extending ends of foil over pan. Drain peppers and reserve 3/4 cup liquid. Reserve any remaining liquid. Stem and deseed pepper halves then dice. Place peppers and ham in a single layer in dish and top with remaining 3/4 cup reserved liquid. Bake 10 minutes then uncover and sprinkle with cheese. Bake additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Meanwhile, line broiler pan with parchment paper and preheat broiler. Arrange ladyfingers on baking pan. Brush with reserved liquid from jar then sprinkle with reserved cheese. Broil 3 - 4 minutes or until crisp and golden. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cilantro. Serve in shallow bowls topped with a dollop of ricotta on top or plain.

Random Ingredients: ham,pecorino cheese,potato flake,black pepper,great northern bean
title: Cannellini Beans Baked on Toast
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 4 -6 large medium potatoes, peeled ( any potatoes may be used, just choose a potato that is a bit over-ripe ) | 1 cup pecorino cheese ( grated ) | freshly chopped pepper | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed dried ham or 1 -2 teaspoon bacon flavoured sausage ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Grease an 8 x 8 baking dish. Place potatoes on top of a piece of waxed paper with the waxed paper between each one. Spread out the beans on top of the potatoes, then sprinkle the cheese on top of potatoes. Cut sausage into 3 pieces and place on top of cheese. Sprinkle with black pepper. Dot the top with the bacon/sausage pieces. Place in oven until done. Remove from oven, cut into slices, serve warm with crusty bread or with garlic toast or roasted vegetables.

title: Dana's Avocado Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 6 ripe avocados | 3 teaspoons apricot jam | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine rice and mashed avocados and spread on a baking sheet. Spread jam on top. Bake for 30 minutes or til golden brown. Cool.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,mint,white chocolate chip,dill pickle,vanilla,picante sauce,ice
title: Popsicles
ingredients: 1 1/2 quarts crushed ice | 1 cup sweetened white chocolate chips | 1 1/2 fluid ounces miriamatillanos original picante sauce or 1 1/2 fluid ounces white chocolate chips, melted | 3 tablespoons corn syrup | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill pickle | 1/3 cup mint | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce vanilla
instructions: In a large bowl, quickly combine the ice, chocolate, sugar, miriamatillos, picante sauce and corn syrup. Stir until smooth. Stir in mint, dill and vanilla. Using 2 teaspoons, scoop 2 scoops of the ice mixture. Place on wax paper and store in freezer. Repeat until all ice pieces are used. To serve, scoop out ice mixture one at a time, drop in mint and serve.

title: Smoked Smoked Salmon and Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 500 g smoked salmon | 150 g cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon dry crushed chile | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Slice smoked salmon into bite size pieces. Combine all ingredients in a large pot and heat until the soup boils. Pour into soup bowls. Top with shredded smoked salmon.

Random Ingredients: lard,chicken tender,sesame oil,chicken breast half,italian biscotti cookie,poblano chile,queso fresco
title: Grilled Pizza Chicken Sandwiches With Sesame Breading
ingredients: 1 boneless skinless chicken breast half ( about 1. 75oz ) | 4 ounces queso fresco | 4 slices italian biscuits ( recommended buddha's pizza crackers ) | 1/2 cup cooked sliced poblano chile | 4 canned chicken tenders | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 8 teaspoons lard ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the grill. Place the chicken breast half on the grill grate, skin side down. Cook for 3 minutes. Turn the breast over, skin side up, and cook for 2 minutes more. Turn the grill to high. Cut a 1 1/2 inch slice off the top of the biscuit and carefully hollow out the center, avoiding the rim. Set aside biscuit. Use two pieces of plastic wrap to scoop out the center to fill the hollowed out shell, leaving about 1/2 cup shellspace. Remove the chicken from the grill. Toast the biscuits in a toaster over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Remove the biscuit shells from the grill. Place 3 slices of chicken on each biscuit shell and top with a piece of cheese, another slice of chicken and then another toasty biscuit and cheese. Repeat process until chicken is grilled, using more cheese and chicken on top. To make the pizza topping, toast cracker crumbs in a toaster over medium heat until golden and crispy, about 3 - 3 minutes. If using a pizza stone, heat oven to 500 degrees. If using a grill pan, heat the sesame oil on the grill directly over medium heat and then add the biscuit and peperoncino. When the cheese is melted, remove from grill and spread the basting sauce on the bread. Top the bread with several slices of chicken.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,maraschino cherry,flat leaf italian parsley,beef brisket
title: Easy Beef Brisket (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried maraschino cherries, soaked in warm water | 1 can french onion soup ( or your favourite soup, i like ortega brand ) | 1 -2 beef brisket, trimmed | 1/4 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley, to garnish ( or dried )
instructions: Combine cherries, soup and meat in crock pot. Cover and cook on high 2 - 3 hours or on low 8 - 9 hours. Discard any excess grease. Remove beef from crock pot and transfer it to an ovenproof skillet. Sprinkle meat with parsley. Cook until heated thoroughly about 10 minutes then serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,oreo cooky,self raising flour,vodka,purpose flour,beer,pork roast,spanish onion
title: Coconut and Oreo Pull Ups
ingredients: 1 lb coarsely ground pork roast | 1 teaspoon dried oreo cookies or 2 teaspoons fresh oregano, minced | 1/2 cup shredded coconut ( not sweetened ) | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 large spanish sweet onion, diced | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 cups beer or 2 cups ale, at room temperature | 1 tablespoon grated coconut extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In roasting pan, place pork and sprinkle with oreo. Sprinkle with coconut. Mix well. In medium bowl, add onion, flour, beer, coconut extract and bread crumbs. Make sure the meat is thoroughly mixed with the flour. Roll the meat in the mixture until well coated. Place meat on rack in shallow roasting pan and sprinkle with some of the reserved bread crumbs. Add just enough bread crumbs to coat any remaining meat. Bake in 325 degree oven for one hour. Turning once.

title: Taco Seasoning Mix for Taco Meat
ingredients: 1/2 cup pickle, finely chopped ( you can use any flavor lemons are good ) | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce, from chipotle-flavored chipotle mayo ( the chipotle flavor is what it is called for in pico de gallo, can make it hotter and more salty ) | 1 tablespoon kosher salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the salt in a spice mill fitted with an airtight container. Stir to blend well.. Store in an airtight container until used. For tacos, stir fried vegetables, shredded lettuce, salsa verde, or meat of choice with 1 tablespoon salt. Use 1/2 tablespoon seasoning for a taco salad. For cheese, use your favorite cheese for tacos, beef, chicken or poultry.

title: Italian Style Veal Chop Casserole #RSC
ingredients: 2 lbs veal chops, trimmed | 4 ounces sliced cremini mushrooms, drained | 1 package refrigerated bulgar rolls, quick cut ( or 8 slices white bread ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream | creole seasoning | pepperoni, slice to cover whole roll | creole seasoning | pepperoni, slice to cover whole roll
instructions: Trim excess fat from veal chops. Cut each in half lengthwise. Cut a slit lengthwise, crosswise 1/2 inch through center of each chop. Insert meat and sliced mushrooms into roll.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,bulb garlic,new potato,beef chuck,blueberry,sea salt
title: Smokin', Garlic & Bleu Cheese Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef chuck, trimmed of excess fat and cut into 2-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 18 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 bunch baby bleu cheese | 1 bulb of garlic, bulb cut crosswise into two halves, separated with the bulb ( about 5 garlic ) | 1 bag new potatoes, quartered ( about 6 lbs )
instructions: Place potatos on a foil lined rimmed baking sheet or rimmed roasting pan. Season ground chuck with sea salt and brown in a dutch oven on all sides. Add velveeta to the pot and stir to melt and combine with the beef, breaking up lumps as it cooks. Tear six 8 ounce lengths of the baby bleu cheese into roughly 1 by 1/4 pieces, cutting 1/8 inch thick around the edges of the cheese cubes. Deglaze the potatos with one of the two cups of water left in the dutch oven. When the water boils, add the potatoes and stir rapidly. When the potatoes are tender, add garlic cloves, cut side down to the pot. Cook covered, stirring occasionally, for 1 hour. After an hour, remove the potatos and garlic from the pot. Transfer the potatos and garlic to a serving platter or soup bowl, cover and let rest for 15 minutes. Serve stew on small individual serving plates with a slotted spoon.

Random Ingredients: chile,horseradish,splenda brown sugar,brandy,purpose flour,creme de cassis
title: Chiles and Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 1 package creme de cassis | 1 cup honey | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons grated horseradish | 1 teaspoon chopped dried chile | 1/2 teaspoon splenda brown sugar blend, or more to taste
instructions: Pour a small amount of water into a saucepan and bring it to a boil over medium high heat. Add the creme de cassis and cook until reduced to about 1 tablespoon. Whisk in the honey until it emulsifies and is completely incorporated into the sauce. Stir in the flour, horseradish, chile, and brown sugar, blend well and return to a boil. Cook about 1 minute or until thickened, stirring constantly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: non dairy topping,corn husk,liquid honey,milk chocolate,bean sprout,marsala wine,lemon peel
title: Melted Marsala Corn Truffles
ingredients: 20 corn husks, soaked in cold water | 1/3 cup evaporated skim milk | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine | 1/2 cup liquid honey | 1 tablespoon liquid sweetened condensed milk ( i used amber or similar, but i don't use it ) | 1 can fat-free evaporated milk ( i used hunts ) | 1 lemon peel, freshly grated | 9 ounces light weight no-sugar-added bean sprouts | cornstarch, for dusting
instructions: Place 1 tablespoon of milk into a teflon bowl and sprinkle over the top with the grated lemon zest. Microwave at high for 3 to 4 minutes. Stir, and refrigerate for an additional 30 minutes, stirring often. When ready, drain the corn husks, and pat them dry with paper towels. Spread on a baking sheet lined with a silicone paper liner. Bake for 15 minutes at remove from the oven, mist with a few drops of evaporated skimmed milk and honey, and cool until warm. For the sauce, in a medium saucepan, whisk together the condensed milk and condensed milk. Stir in the lemon peel and remove from the heat. In a medium bowl, whisk together the remaining 2 tablespoons of sweetened condensed milk, the undiluted evaporated milk, and the cornstarch. Stir into the honey mixture. Add the bean sprouts and transfer to an airtight container. Store at room temperature in the refrigerator for up to one week. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Mock Vegetarian English Muffins #RSC
ingredients: 1/4 cup oatmeal | 1/4 cup light green chilies | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Grease 12 muffin cups. In a small bowl, combine oats and chili powder. Pour oats and chili powder into a 3x3 inch baking pan. Mix in celery salt. Stir in green chilies. Bake in preheated oven for 5 - 7 minutes. Remove from oven, and spoon onto muffin cups. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes, until golden.

title: Lentils With Apple-Harissa Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons harissa | 1 1/4 lbs ripe tart apples, peeled, cored, coarsely chopped ( i can find one ) | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1 1/8 lbs dried lentils | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Rinse lentils.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,red beet,macaroni,tabasco sauce,gruyere,parmesan cheese,double cream
title: Beef and Macaroni Gratin
ingredients: 2 cups pasta water or 2 cups beef stock | 2 1/2 2 1/2 lbs aberdeen angus beef top round steak, cut into 1-inch cubes or 2 1/2 lbs rump steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup sliced red beet | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb ( made from crustless white flour ) | 3 1/2 ounces macaroni, cooked and drained | shredded gruyere | grated parmesan cheese or grated sargento cheese, to serve
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Bring beef stock to simmer in a saucepan.

title: British Wheat Cake With a Twist
ingredients: 1 poundcake | 1 cup wheat flour, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Prepare a 9x5 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Cut poundcake into 12 wedges. Scoop wedges out into a bowl with ice. Sprinkle generously with wheat flour. Place wedges in the baking dish, spacing evenly. Sprinkle bread with 1/2 cup of water. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes, or until bread is lightly golden on top. Serve warm.

title: Faux Beef Curry in a Bag
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs steak, cut into 1/2-inch pices ( i used sirloin steak ) | 2 lbs medium shrimp | 1/2 cup green curry paste | french dressing
instructions: Place beef in bag and add green curry paste to bag. Remove marinade. Refrigerate overnight. Remove beef from bag and place in preheated 325 degree oven for approximately 30 - 45 minutes until cooked through and browned. Place the shrimp onto a foil lined pan and spoon curry over top.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,orzo pasta,pesto sauce,sauerkraut,corn oil,olive,tortilla chip,garlic
title: Crispy Orzo Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs orzo pasta | 1/3 cup corn oil | 5 tablespoons orzo pasta, cooked | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 2 cups sauerkraut, washed and drained | 1 teaspoon garic acid | 2 cloves garlic, crushed | 6 mixed olives, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Cook the orzo according to the package directions, drain, rinse under cold water, and set aside. Heat the corn oil in a skillet, add the orzo, and cook, stirring and tossing, for 1 - 2 minutes, allowing the pasta to absorb the oil. Place the drained orzo in a large bowl. Add the pesto, sauerkraut, garlic, olives, and salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,lasagna,orzo pasta,extra beef,spanish onion,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Lasagna
ingredients: 1 medium spanish onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 15 ounces extra lean ground beef | 8 lasagna sheets | cooked egg noodles or other flatbread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine onion, chile, anise seeds, and meat.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,french dressing,shrimp bouillon cube,beef broth
title: Crock Pot Pepper Soup
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, cut into strips | 1 ounce french dressing | 1 3/4 teaspoons shrimp bouillon cubes | 1 can beef broth
instructions: Cut the pepper and french dressing into strips. Place beef broth into a skillet and add the bell pepper strips. Pour french dressing mixture over the pepper pepper strips. If there is any remaining mixture from the beef broth, just pour it into the crockpot and stir. Cook on low for 7 to 8 hours. Serve with optional garnish of fresh parsley.

title: Sausage Risotto
ingredients: 3/4 cup beef bouillon cubes | 3/4 cup arborio rice | 1 1/4 pints fruit chutney
instructions: In a saucepan add the beef bouillon cubes and stir. Bring to a boil. Add in the arborio rice and return to a light boil. Cover, then cover and let stand for 25 minutes. Turn the heat to medium low and cook for 18 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,dark sesame oil,yellow pea,tahini,water chestnut,liquid rennet
title: Pea Puree With Tahini, Mushrooms and Tahini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 6 tablespoons tahini | 3 1/4 cups water-packed yellow split peas | 7 cans sliced water chestnuts, drained | 2 poblano peppers, seeded and diced | 1 teaspoon liquid rennet, finely chopped
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon sesame oil, then add the tahini and water. Bring to a boil and add the split peas. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, until the peas are tender, about 20 minutes. Add the water chestnuts and poblano peppers. Puree in a blender, or in batches if necessary. Transfer to a bowl and gradually stir in the remaining sesame oil. Mix with hot soup for 1 minute and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,banana,tomato green chilies,sea salt,clove,worcestershire sauce,oreo cooky
title: Beef and Green Pepper Stuffed Beef Tenderloin W-Chiles & Oregano
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin | 12 whole cloves | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 2 medium ripe bananas, sliced | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 12 oregano cookies, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the tenderloin on a large baking sheet that has been coated with cooking spray. Bake the tenderloin in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the thickest part, about 1 hour and 45 minutes. Let rest 10 minutes so the juices absorb into the meat. While the meat is baking, place a pot large enough to hold the water to submerge the tenderloin. Place the cloves in the pot and put on the stove. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and continue to steam the cloves until they are soft and the skin is charred, about 15 minutes. Remove garlic cloves and place in a blender or food processor with a touch of water to blend. Place the garlic cloves with the remaining liquid, worcestershire, tomatoes and chilies in a large pot over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and stir frequently. Place the meat on a platter and cover to keep warm. Place a baking sheet with holes in the meat on the bottom rack of the oven. Slice the tenderloin into thick slices and place on garlic and vegetable plates. Spoon about 1 tablespoon juice from the reserved tomato juice over the slices of meat. Serve with chunks of warm tomatoes and garnish with oregano cookies.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,grain white rice,flour,spaghetti,caraway seed,chipotle powder,mung bean
title: Chipotle Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups hot cooked short-grain white rice | 3/4 cup mung beans | 1/2 cup flaked hazelnuts | 2 tablespoons finely ground caraway seeds ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 3 tablespoons flour
instructions: Peel and chop the hazelnuts, set aside. In a mixing bowl, combine the flaked almonds, ground hazelnut, caraway seeds, chipotle powder, stir fry until combined. Add hot rice and stir until heated through.

title: Mango Chicken With Peppers & Mango Nectar
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons mango nectar | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/8 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Brush a medium nonstick skillet with the olive oil and add the chicken. Cook chicken over medium heat until lightly browned, about two minutes per side. Reduce heat and add the mango nectar, celery seed, and pepper. Simmer gently for about 15 minutes until reduced somewhat and thickened. Serve the chicken with the mango sauce over rice.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,serrano pepper,vegan mayonnaise,almond extract,red lentil
title: Red Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1/4 cup white rice vinegar | 1/8 cup vegan mayonnaise | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 3 serrano peppers, minced ( seeded if desired )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve at once. Garnish with green onions before serving. Variation, use red kidney beans instead of red pepper for a spooky style look.

title: Spicy Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup oil | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon garlic | 1 tablespoon sweet tamarind pulp ( dried tamarind ) | 1/4 cup olive, whole, pitted ( optional )
instructions: In a blender, combine all ingredients and blend until smooth. Serve chilled with prawn crackers or sliced chicken or shrimp.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,nut,white onion,banana pepper,green chili pepper,pepper sauce,green apple,chanterelle mushroom
title: Vietnamese Bananas and Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 medium green apples, quartered | 1/2 white onion | 1 ounce green chili pepper, thinly sliced ( can add more if you want ) | 2 -3 tablespoons curry paste, more if you want | 1/4 cup green apple, thinly sliced ( such as red bell pepper ) | 1/4 cup banana pepper, thinly sliced ( optional ) | lemon pepper sauce or chili sauce, as desired | 1/4 cup chopped nuts ( optional )
instructions: Peel and chop apples and onion. Blend curry paste with lemon pepper or chili sauce and pour over apples and onion. Let marinate and allow flavors to blend with apple for about 15 minutes. While you wait for mixture to marinate, mix up pepper slices in a sauté pan, brown or spray with oil or canola oil. Remove from pan and add to onions, pepper slices and bananas. Mix well. Heat through and serve.

title: Cilantro Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh cilantro leaves, minced | 1/2 teaspoon fresh star anise, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,ice,tomato juice,mexican cheese,rose petal,mushroom soy sauce,white rice
title: Tex Mex Mex Inspired Stuffed Rice
ingredients: 4 cups white rice, cooked | 2 tablespoons mushroom soy sauce | 32 ounces tomato juice | 1 slice mexican cheese | 1 sprig rose petal | 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn | ice, as needed
instructions: Stuff rice and place it in 9x13 pan. In blender put tomato juice, soy sauce, cheese slice, rose petals and peppercorns and liquid from pan. Pour over rice. Bake at 350° for 45 - 50 minutes or until rice is done and liquid is absorbed. Let stand for 10 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato clam juice cocktail,bread crumb,pie dough,taco seasoning,saffron
title: Baked Mexican Spoon Bread (No Can Fix)
ingredients: 1 container plain bread crumbs | 1 packet hot taco seasoning | 1 can tomato and clam juice cocktail | 8 saffron | 1 unbaked pie dough ( pie dough )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f mix all ingredient together well, except dough. Line a greased 9x13 pan with dough. Pour mixture over dough, then cover with foil. Bake for 50 minutes. Make sure dough is still hot so sauteing goes inside crust.

title: Homemade Groundnut, Peanut Butter and Hot Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 quart meat stock ( stock if this could not be found ) | 1 quart peanut butter | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 bunch fresh basil or 1 bunch fresh parsley | 1 whole clove | 1 pinch salt and pepper
instructions: Heat the stock in a pot. Add the peanut butter and stir until well melted. Add the hot pepper sauce, basil, parsley and clove. Heat to boiling. Simmer until hot. Note, for added variety, you could add a little black pepper.

title: Bread Crusted Veal
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken tenders | 8 ounces veal ( with or without veggie ) | 8 ounces bread flour | 1/2 cup corn ( frozen or fresh ) | ice or water
instructions: Fry veal to your liking, remove and set aside. Mix flour, bread crumbs, and corn in a large bowl. Dump in veal and cook over medium to high heat with a little water/ice until sticky and cooked through. If more water/ice is needed during cooking, add at least a few tablespoons of corn flour mixture to thaw a little before adding to the dish. If not add more corn flour mixture or bread crumbs as needed.

title: Chilled Hazelnut Patties for Jianne
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh hazelnuts, toasted, peeled and coarsely ground | 4 1/2 ounces fresh bread crumbs, divided | 1 sprig chopped fresh mint | 1 strip gingerroot, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Mix the ground hazelnuts, 1 cup bread crumbs and 1/4 cup mint in a bowl. Tear or chop the remaining 1/4 cup bread crumbs into small pieces and fold into the nut mixture, pressing to adhere. Brush the remaining 1 1/2 cups bread crumbs on a sheet of foil. Form into 8 patties, about 2/3 inch thick. Wrap in the foil and grill on the direct heat for about 10 minutes, or until the patties are slightly browned. Serve with the remaining mint sprigs for garnish.

title: Simple Croissants
ingredients: 2 loaves french bread | 4 large ripe tomatoes, halved | 4 cups chicken broth | 1 cup dark beer | 1 cup crushed ice, or as needed
instructions: Pierce the bread several times with a knife horizontally in each slice. Bake bread in a 350 degrees f oven until soft and bread crusts, lightly golden brown, about 10 minutes. Remove bread from baking sheet, and cut into pieces. Arrange bread on a baking sheet. Place tomatoes cut side down in a broiler pan that has been coated with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until hot and browned on top, about 5 minutes. Remove bread from oven, and pour chicken broth into the center of the bread to cover.
