Return bread to oven, and place under the broiler. Heat until hot and bubbling, then reduce heat to low, and simmer for 1 minute, or until heated through. Pour beer into a small shallow bowl, and dip each croissant into the beer, coating evenly. Place the croissants onto plates, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,mexican cheese,portabella mushroom,rice vinegar,lotus root,basmati rice,virgin olive oil,okra
title: Vegetable & Rice Salad - Neil Perry
ingredients: 1/4 cup seasoned rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1 tablespoon paprika hungarian sweet basil and hungarian sweet basil | 1 cup cooked rice | 1/2 cup baby portabella mushroom, thinly sliced, caps chopped | 1/2 cup frozen lotus root, halved and cut into 1/2 inch | 12 ounces fresh okra, washed, trimmed, and patted dry
instructions: Whisk together vinegar, oil, cheese, and sweet basil in a small bowl. Toss with cooled rice and add mushrooms and okra, tossing to coat. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Tofu Dogs
ingredients: 125 g firm tofu, cut into 4 pieces | chili sauce | 3 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1/2 tablespoon minced red chile
instructions: Slice the tofu crossways into 4 pieces, sprinkle with a pinch or two of salt, mix with your hands and shape into 4 triangles. Heat a frying pan or bbq/griddle. Fry the tofu over a medium heat for 5 - 10 minutes, turning frequently so it browns evenly. Spread the chili sauce on the tofu in the centre and scatter over the chilli flakes. Serve with your favourite accompaniments and dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,vanilla essence,pineapple juice,salad green,milk ricotta cheese,scallion,spaghetti noodle,pancetta
title: Tia Maria's Pizza and Pancetta Napoleons
ingredients: 2 packages spaghetti noodles, for a pizza | 1 1/2 lbs monterey jack cheese ( shredded ) | 15 scallions ( thinly sliced ) | 3 packages pancetta ( thinly sliced ) | 1 lb pineapples in juice ( sliced ) | 1 -2 dash vanilla extract or 1 -2 dash almond essence | 1 carton whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons salad greens ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti noodle according to package directions. Rinse with cool water and drain. Sprinkle both sides of each noodle with salt until all noodles are wet and firm. Place one layer of the cooked spaghetti on a large platter. If desired sprinkle with shredded monterey jack cheese. Sprinkle the scallions, pancetta and pineapples over this layer. Combine the ricotta with the almond essence and pour evenly over and around the pizza. Cover with spaghetti more cheese and then drizzle with any leftover syrup from the pizzas jar. Bake in a preheated 450 degree oven 10 minutes or until bubbly. Allow to cool down for 5 - 10 minutes before topping with salad greens and/or additional syrup, if desired.

title: Roasted Chilies Con Patatas
ingredients: 200 g dried cranberries | 2 -3 red chilies
instructions: Soak chillies for 20 minutes in iced water. Drain well, deseed and chop. Dry roast chillies in microwave, oven etc. When cool, place in a large, dry bowl. Add dried cranberries, stir to coat well. Spray pam or oil in a roasting dish. Place into moderate oven, 190c/350f, about 40 - 45 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Creamy Brazilian Cauliflower and Leek Soup
ingredients: 1 cauliflower | 2 leeks | 1 lb pork shoulder | 1 2/3 cups soymilk or 1 2/3 cups coconut milk | 1/4 lb crumbled cotija cheese
instructions: Clean cauliflower and chop roughly. Slice leeks thick crosswise. Heat large soup pot, add butter.

title: Simple Rice (Easy)
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, already prepared and rinsed | 1 package american cheese, such as velveeta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. In a large casserole dish, layer the uncooked rice and cheese. Dot the top with a little butter or margarine. Sprinkle the top with more cheese.. Set in oven and bake 10 - 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,ice water,new potato,egg noodle,wild mushroom
title: Newfoundland Potato Pancakes
ingredients: 1/2 lb new potato, peeled, boiled and then diced | 1 whole red potatoes | 12 -16 ounces egg noodles ( fresh is best ) | 10 -20 fresh wild mushrooms, sliced or 12 -16 ounces dried mushrooms | 4 -6 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Dice egg noodles and mushrooms, then lightly fry in a large skillet with half cup of ice water for about 3 - 5 minutes. You may find it helpful to add a little salt. Stir in potatoes. They will be done at this point, as they are already browned. To serve, sprinkle on fresh mushrooms. You may also add diced onion and/or diced green peppercorns, or just plain. You may also add a bit of salt, pepper and cayenne, as suggested in description.

Random Ingredients: new york,chive,juniper berry,heavy cream,vegetable stock,pineapple chunk,tomato green chilies,white flour
title: Braised New York Strip Steak With Pineapple Chutney and Fresh Chives
ingredients: 8 new york strip steaks | 12 whole juniper berries | 3 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 cup unsalted vegetable stock | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Rub steaks with juniper berries and place on broiler pan. Broil 2 - 3 minutes, or until to desired level of doneness. Meanwhile, combine tomato juice with reserved juice from diced tomatoes and chilies in a small saucepan and simmer over low heat until reduced to half. Place sauce and sauce into a blender and puree until well blended. Whisk cream and vegetable stock in a small saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture comes to a boil. Cook 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Whisk flour into hot mixture in saucepan. Reduce heat and whisk until thickened and bubbly. Whisk in chives and cook 1 minute longer, remove, add to cream sauce.

title: Grilled Tamarind Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 4 teaspoons caster sugar | 300 g salmon | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves ( coriander )
instructions: Heat grill. Place tamarind paste and sugar in a glass baking dish and mix to combine. Lightly oil and grill salmon for 3 mins on each side or until cooked through. Place on serving bowl, top with coriander leaves. Serve with rice.

title: Yummy Ulster Stew
ingredients: 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 lamb chop | 3 tablespoons applesauce | 2 cups small fresh vegetables
instructions: To make up, mix together the whiskey, mascarpone cheese, ricotta cheese and dill. Cut the chop into 1 chunks and cook in the rum, then add to the stew. Add the applesauce. Bake in a moderate oven. Serve over mashed potatoes, noodles, rice and beans. A nice side dish is saagría or salsa.

title: Chilies Saltados
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 small dried chilies | 12 anchovies or 12 garlic cloves, unpeeled | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon chopped dill pickle | 1 ounce creamed sweetened flaky pastry cream
instructions: Spread mustard seeds on a sheet of cheesecloth lined with parchment or waxed paper. Place chilies on top and cover loosely with tea towel or plastic wrap. Refrigerate for about 8 hours, or overnight. Heat oven to 350°f with the rack in the lower third. Place anchovies in a small bowl and cover with boiling water. Let stand 10 minutes. Drain anchovies and dry on paper toweling. Place anchovies on a flat surface. Stir in mustard seeds and pickle. Divide mixture in half and spread on the tops of the chilies. Bake until tops are crusty or golden brown, about 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: courgette,hot chili pepper,white rice,corn kernel,white bread,loaf bread
title: Grilled Cheese & Vegetable Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 4 large loaf bread, crusts trimmed | 4 slices white bread | 100 g of cubed white bread | 1/2 bunch small cauliflower or 1/2 young cauliflower, leafy centre removed | 2 tablespoons of finely cubed fresh chile flakes ( optional ) | sweet and sour young french mustard rice or cooked white bread, for serving | roasted corn kernels or canned corn kernel
instructions: Brush or spray inside of 4 individual loaf or 1 loaf pan with olive oil. Cut out the base and outer 5 cm rings, if using your bread, and prick the base of each with a fork. Place a slice of bread lightly on the bottom of the pan. Dip the tops of 4 slices of bread into the bread coating well. Press or squeeze the bread in with your fingers so that it fits the base. Place the breads in a preheated oven and cook to desired level of crispness. To make the filling, place the cauliflower in a pan, cover with cold water and boil til just tender. Drain well. Remove the cauliflower from the water and place on a chopping board covered in boiling water. Repeat with the cauliflower. Allow to stand for 1 minute. Drain well and cool slightly. Use a vegetable peeler to remove any remaining cauliflower stalk. Place in a bowl and add all other filling ingredients. Mix well. Add the filling to the breads. Place on 4 individual gratin dishes or individual soup plates. Brush or spray lightly with olive oil. Bake for about 8 to 10 minutes at 190degc / 350°f.

title: Indian Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs kielbasa, cubed | 1 1/2 tablespoons red indian garam masala | 2 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Combine together and simmer for 45 - 60 minutes. Add in the ketchup and continue to simmer for a few minutes or until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Dairy-Free No Salt, Salt-Free Marinated Tomatoes, Dates and Sesame Oil
ingredients: 12 ounces firm dates, chopped into 1/4 inch pieces ( i prefer gorgonzola ) | 1 tablespoon date sesame oil | 1/4 cup no-salt-added tomato and basil pesto ( i recommend dreamfield's healthy harvest no-tomato spread )
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a small frying pan. When hot, add the date and stir continuously until they become golden around the edges. The mixture should look very dry. If it is dry, add a little water, 1 tsp at a time. When ready, add the tomato and basil pesto. Stir to coat well and set. Note, you may also add a little dried oregano for a slightly spicier, sweeter taste. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,chicken thigh,chorizo sausage,lemon curd,rice wine,beef tenderloin
title: Chicken With Portuguese Beef Strips and Chorizo
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch rounds | 3/4 lb chorizo sausage, casings removed | 1 1/2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1 lemon curd, plus lime juice, to squeeze over meat | 1/3 cup rice wine or 1/3 cup port wine | 14 ounces chicken thigh, thawed if frozen, rinsed, patted dry
instructions: Cook pork and chorizo in ungreased heavy large skillet over medium high heat, stirring with wooden spoon occasionally until browned and crisp, about 3 minutes. Using slotted spoon, transfer 1/3 pork mixture to bowl.

title: Curried Pumpkin Yogurt
ingredients: 12 ounces nonfat plain yogurt | 1 packet curry paste | 1/2 cup pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup champagne, chilled
instructions: Blend the yogurt until it has the consistency of a thick paste. Add the curry paste and mix well. Add pumpkin and champagne. Mix well. Serve.

title: Artichokes and Barley
ingredients: 1 package frozen pearl barley, thawed | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
instructions: Combine the cooked barley and artichokes in the bowl of a blender.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,chicken meat,poppy seed,self rising flour,oregano,mustard seed
title: Kleftiko
ingredients: 1/2 pound shredded, cooked chicken meat | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seeds | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 cups self-rising flour | 2 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into matchstick-size pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9 inch round baking dish. On a large plate, stir together the chicken, poppy seeds, mustard seeds, oregano, and self rising flour so that the dough resembles coarse meal. Roll dough out to 11x7 inches. Cut potato pieces lengthwise into half inch slices.

title: Mongolian Snow Pea Cake With Crispy Candies
ingredients: 5 ounces snow peas or 5 ounces green beans, sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons sugar | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups broth | extra maraschino cherry, for garnish
instructions: In a medium frying pan, sauté thawed snow peas in sugar until crisp tender, 7 - 8 minutes. Drain and then transfer to a large bowl. Stir in flour. Pour in stock or broth and stir till dough is just mixed. Transfer to a greased 10 inch round cake pan. Sprinkle with more sugar. Bake at 400f 45 - 50 minutes or until tester inserted comes out with some nice browning.

title: Steep Beef - 5-Qt. Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 4 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 '' strips | 1 green pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 small bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon dry crushed chili peppers ( optional )
instructions: Brown the meat in a skillet that has been coated with cooking spray. Pour out half of the fat. Add the peppers and bay leaf. Add the second half of the fat, meat and vegetables. Lock the lid in place and cook in pressure over high heat for 8 - 10 minutes or until the meat is tender. Add water or stock as needed during cooking if necessary.

title: Polenta Tomato Bake (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 lb polenta, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 jar tomato sauce | 1/2 cup tamari ( dark soy sauce ) | 1/8 teaspoon black salt | 1 lb rotini pasta, cooked and drained ( or other short pasta ) | 1 1/4 cups water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f stir the polenta and tomato sauce in a large bowl. Heat tamari in a dutch oven until it is melted and blended with other ingredients. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 inch pan and bake at 400°f about 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain pasta and return to pot, reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Add reserved pasta liquid to the meat mixture, and stir well to combine with the rest of the ingredients. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: navy bean,lamb,mint leaf,fava bean,panko breadcrumb,szechwan pepper,clam,green cardamom
title: Hummus
ingredients: 400 g frozen fava beans | 400 g frozen navy beans | 250 g frozen minced lamb | 4 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 4 -6 fresh mint leaves | 8 -10 green cardamoms | 8 -10 fresh clams, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons szechwan pepper ( or other chili pepper )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl except the panko and sesame seeds. Toss everything together. Add a few tablespoons of water to help keep its texture. Serve immediately. For a milder hummus add a tablespoon of water. Serve with flatbread, grilled pita bread, crumbled pita chips or rice.

title: Chicken & Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chicken strips, grilled | 1 cup ouzo | 1/2 cup peanuts butter | 1 container light natural plain yogurt | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 cup dried red beans, soaked in water for 15 minutes
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Add crumbled red beans and toss thoroughly. Place in a nice serving bowl.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,chicken stock cube,shrimp,garlic clove,cannellini bean,italian cheese,baking powder,fruit
title: Shrimp & Bean Baked in White Rice
ingredients: 200 g short-grain white rice | 400 g chopped peeled fresh shrimp | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups chicken stock | 1/4 cup chopped mixed dried fruit | 2 garlic cloves, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 italian cheese, grated ( preferably a mild white. such as castagnaccio ) | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Pre heat oven 160°c line a 1/2 cup/1 cup tin with baking paper and spray with oil. Place rice in a large jug and cover with water and allow to soak for 10 minutes. Rinse rice and return to pot. Bring stock to the boil with fruit and garlic. Stir in soaked rice and return to the boil. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired. Stir in grated cheese, if using and cover with a large piece of greaseproof paper. Place in pre heated oven to bake for 15 - 20 minutes until rice is piping hot and golden brown note, the mixture can also be made with the shrimp or other ingredients if you want to.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,chili pepper flake,hard egg,cod,orange
title: Cod Baked in Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange rind, freshly grated | 4 ounces fish, cod ( preferably organic ) | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes | 1 green chili pepper, minced | 1 orange, juice of
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f/200c/gas mark grease a small roasting tin. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, except for the skin. Rub the mixture into the cod. Place the coated fish on the baking tray. Bake in the oven for about 40 mins, brushing twice with the orange/lemon sauce during the last five minutes of cooking.

title: Vegetable and Bean Soup
ingredients: 300 g pumpkin, peeled, seeded, cut into chunks | 2 cups pearl barley | 1 cup sweet onion, chopped | 1/4 cup cream cheese | 1/2 cup rosemary, chopped | 2 cups tea
instructions: Place the pumpkin, barley, onion and cream cheese in a pot and cook until it has thickened. Add rosemary. Pour in the tea and heat, stirring frequently. This soup should only take one cup of boiling. This soup can also be made with celery, squash and other vegetables.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,peanut,apple,tamarind pulp,biscuit count,anchovy fillet,extra sharp cheddar cheese,thyme sprig
title: Cretons with Apples & Pesto
ingredients: 12 biscuit count | 1/3 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup desiccated unblanched peanuts | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp, soaked in 1/4 cup boiling water 20 minutes and drained | 1 anchovy fillet, minced | 1 small tomatoes, diced | kosher salt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place 6 biscuit size rounds in a medium bowl and coat with cooking spray. Add the cheddar, peanuts, and the tamarind pulp and mix well. Spoon half the nut mixture evenly into each biscuit round.

title: Nam Prik Num
ingredients: 1 lb dried kidney beans | 2 stalks lemongrass, chopped | 3 fennel seeds, crushed
instructions: Pick over the kidney beans and wash thoroughly. Place in a bowl and cover with warm water. Bring to a boil and boil for about 25 minutes then drain. Place the beans in a saucepan filled with boiling water. Bring back to a boil and boil for about 15 minutes, making sure the beans are just covered with water. Add the lemongrass and fennel seeds. When all ingredients are well mixed, drain the water from the beans by placing a clean cloth on your finger tips and placing a piece of cloth between your fingers. Tie with twine or toothpicks to produce a steam vent. Place the pot on a trivet or table to catch any drips that might form. Place the kettle on the trivet on the table, cover and cook over low heat for 4 hours, stirring occasionally. This will take 3 hours if your kettle is not covered with water. If your kettle is not covered, remove the lid and boil another 1/2 hour. Take off of the heat and leave overnight. The next day, remove the cloth and toothpicks that were placed alongside the meat and beans and place in a saucepan. Place over low heat and cook over medium heat for 1 hour, stirring regularly. Remove the meat and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,farfalle pasta,coriander powder,cardamom seed,parsnip,rotel tomato chilies
title: Mexican Farfalle With Shredded Chicken
ingredients: 8 -10 cups cooked farfalle ( bow tie pasta ) | 3 cups shredded rotisserie style chicken ( store-bought or of your own choice ) | 1/2 cup dried parsnip, chopped | 3 -4 crushed cardamom seeds, crushed | 4 -5 tablespoons ground coriander powder | 4 -5 teaspoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain, keeping warm in a fondue pot over low heat. Put remaining ingredients into fondue pot, stirring to combine. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red wine,yellow bell pepper,thai basil,baking chocolate
title: Crazy Chocolate Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb baking chocolate | 1 lb yellow bell peppers or 1 lb green bell pepper | 1/2 cup red wine or 1/2 cup water | 8 leaves thai basil ( optional )
instructions: Place the chocolate with the water in a small saucepan and bring to boil over low heat. Stir constantly until the chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Pour into small plastic molds lined with wax paper. Freeze for at least 2 hours and up to 3 days. To serve, heat grill to low. Grill peppers on the grill for about 2 minutes on each side or until slightly charred. Remove to cool, then slice into strips. Sprinkle with remaining basil, if desired. This chocolate may also be eaten hot, drizzled with melted semisweet chocolate or chocolate sauce.

Random Ingredients: hot water,salmon fillet,rice wine vinegar,baking powder,cauliflower,garlic,poblano chile,toor dal
title: Toor Dal Poblano in Hot Water
ingredients: 2 cups toor dal | 1 cauliflower | 1/2 cup raw rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons salt | 2 tablespoons sweet and sour pickled garlic | 2 medium poblano chiles, thinly sliced on a spiral slicer ( or jalapeno ) | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 cups hot water, divided
instructions: Soak the toor dal in water to cover overnight. Drain and rinse dal and place in a medium saucepan. Add the cauliflower, rice wine vinegar, salt, poblano peppers, garlic, and baking powder. Stir to combine. Add 1 cup water, stirring to combine. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer, tightly covered, 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender. Serve warm or refrigerate until cold.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,rice noodle,salt pork,beet,bow tie pasta
title: Beets and Rice Noodles in Chili Oil
ingredients: 6 large beets ( about 3lbs x 3-inch ) | 3/4 cup julienned salt pork | 1 cup julienned dried bow tie pasta ( or any other short pasta ) | vegetable oil | chili oil, to cover 3/4 of the jar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the beet in a saucepan with 1 cup water and the salt pork. Bring to a boil over high heat, add 2 quarts water, and return to a boil. Cook until the beets are tender and have a bit of bite. Drain and plunge into cold water, drain and cut in half. Place on a baking sheet covered with parchment or wax paper, drizzle with a little oil and bake until tender, about 1 1/2 hours. When cool enough to handle, peel and chop. Cook the noodles in boiling salted water following packet instructions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of cooking water. Drain well. In a large serving bowl, toss the noodles with the beets, parsley, salt and drizzle with chili oil. Refrigerate, covered for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,rice wine vinegar,mango chutney,tarragon,bacon,black bean,vanilla
title: Mango Chutney Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained | 1 teaspoon fresh tarragon, chopped or 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 dash of your favourite mango chutney | 1 dash rice wine vinegar | 1 dash asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 dash salt ( to taste ) | 1 dash of your favourite mango chutney ( optional )
instructions: In large bowl add the black beans, the tarragon & chutney seasonings. Mix well. Sprinkle 1/2 a sprinkle of julienned onion on top of the beans, sprinkle with the remaining onion for garnish.

title: Avocado Dip
ingredients: 2 ripe avocados, roughly mashed | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup golden raisin | green food coloring
instructions: Remove white membrane from green habanero peppers or habanero powder and puree the cavities with the avocado with enough panko or bread crumbs to give a somewhat runny consistency. When mixed, add red food coloring and mix. Serve with tortilla chips or veggies.

title: Nachos
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. To make the taco seasoning, combine the taco seasoning mix, soy sauce, and dark soy sauce in a small bowl. Dip the nachos in the taco seasoning mixture, then place them on a baking sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until crisp and golden brown.

title: Spinach Sticks with Fried Icebergs
ingredients: 9 toothpicks | 1 cup nonfat milk | 1 package fresh baby spinach leaves or ( 6 ounce ) package frozen spinach leaves, thawed and well drained | freshly ground pepper ( i use salt )
instructions: Have the freezer bag of meat, frozen spinach, and unopened package of spinach available. If the spinach is large, cut the spinach into 1 inch pieces. If you have the vacuum bag, tear the spinach into sections. Squeeze out the water before cooking. Soak toothpicks in milk about 3 minutes. Place a piece of spinach between the fingers of your thumb and index finger to push out as much milk as possible. Repeat with another piece of spinach. Place 3 to 4 pieces of spinach between your fingers of a finger and the fingers until the meat is about 1/4 inch thick. Do not leave any gaps. Place the toothpicks in the freezer bag until ready to deep fry or deep fry the sticks until golden, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels. To serve, put 1 or 2 icebergs on plates with a little bit of sauce, depending on how much spinach you would like. Drizzle with more sauce.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,hamburger,greek yogurt,irish cream,green enchilada sauce
title: Green Chili Cheese Burgers(Fritos)
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1 1/3 lbs green chilies ( mild, hot, or both ) | 3 cups french yogurt | 1 -2 cup green enchilada sauce ( depending on how thin you want your mixture ) | 4 -6 tablespoons sour cream ( or low fat )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Grease a large oven safe dish or skillet with cooking spray. Combine the chilies and onions in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped. Pour the drained hamburger into food processor and blend briefly until combined. Add all but 1/2 cup of the yogurt to food processor and whiz briefly until smooth, but be careful not to liquify. Add mixture to food processor in a large bowl, mix well, and pulse again until combined. Add 1/2 cup of yogurt and blend thoroughly, but do not overprocess. Spread the remaining paste on the insides of the prepared baking dish and spread it to cover the bottom. Spread remaining 1/2 cup yogurt on top. Sprinkle top with remaining 1/2 cup yogurt. Bake in a 425°f oven for about 15 minutes or until nicely browned and bubbly. Serve with flour or corn tortillas, if desired.

title: Dried Spice Grilled Skirt Steak
ingredients: 4 lbs skirt steaks | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons dried sweet dill | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 3/4 cup coconut cream | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon 'zaar'sumac | 8 ounces sour mix, room temperature
instructions: In one bowl combine dill with the chicken bouillon, stirring until well mixed. Slice steaks diagonally across grain into 1/4 inch wide strips. Lay out strips on paper towel and soak in fridge, covered, for at least 1 hour or overnight. Preheat a grill or outdoor grill and brush with spray oil. Add half the spice mix, stir and coat all the slices evenly. Remove the remaining spice mix from the fridge and spread evenly on the meat. Place the strips on the grill. Cook 7 minutes per side turning often and brushing with more of the reserved spice mix, or until desired doneness.

title: Chicken or Pork Pie
ingredients: 5 cups leftover cooked chicken meat, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen chopped pineapple chunks | 1 pint ice cream ( or cream of choice )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Put the mixture in the freezer for at least 2 hours. When it's cold, put in a dish just big enough to hold it all. Serve with pumpernickel crackers.

title: Awesome Taco Bell Copycat Red Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red onion, finely chopped | 2 3/4 teaspoons taco seasoning
instructions: Add the onion to a non stick pan and cook on medium to high heat, stirring occasionally. Once the onion is a little soft, add the seasoning and stir. Reduce heat to low and let simmer for ten minutes. Serve.

title: Tuna in Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans coconut milk | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 tablespoon red wine | 2 scallions | 4 tuna steaks
instructions: Soften onions in a little water over a low heat, add wine. Add scallions and chilli oil. Chill for the best flavours this will just make the tuna fillets less likely to eat on the day.

Random Ingredients: bay seasoning,picante sauce,file powder,lemon,kaffir lime leaf
title: Quick and Easy Mexican Salsa Made with Kaffir Lime and Filets
ingredients: 2 cups bottled picante sauce | 2 kaffir lime leaves or regular kaffir lime leaves, sliced into thin rounds | 1 lemon, sliced into thin rounds | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 6 lbs filet mignon or 6 lbs skirt steaks | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning
instructions: The kaffir lime leaves should be washed before grilling. Make the salsa as follows in a small saucepan, heat the picante sauce, lime slices, lemon slices to boiling and add the old bay. Reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, for about 10 minutes to make the kaffir lime flavor stronger. Remove the saucepan from the heat and add the filets, stirring so they form a loose bed or net, keeping the kaffir lime slices arranged around the meat, on a platter. Cover and let stand for about 15 minutes. Remove the meat from the saucepan. Cover well and refrigerate until ready to serve. To serve, pour the salsa over the meat and garnish with fresh pinches of old bay seasonings. Serve immediately with chips, rice, tortillas or as is.

title: Apple Harvest Bean Salad With Corn
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained ( can use frozen ) | 420 g canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained ( i like pinto beans ) | 1 cooking apple, cored and cut into 1 cm pieces | 200 g blue cheese, crumbled | 1 cup arugula, chopped
instructions: Place the corn and beans in a bowl. Add the apple. Place the cheese on top. Add the fresh arugula and toss well. Serve.

title: Kale and Octopus in Spice
ingredients: 4 -5 stalks kale, cleaned, cut into 3/4 inch pieces | 4 stalks kale, cleaned | 1/3 cup mixed spice | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 2 lemons, zest of, chopped
instructions: Wash cleaned octopus. Remove as much thick end of tough leaves as possible from stalk. Cut into manageable size chunks. Place into a non corrosive pan or dutch oven. Sprinkle well drained kale over the octopus. Sprinkle with mixed spice. Squeeze zest of 2 lemons over the octopus and kale. Heat on a very low heat for 20 - 30 minutes turning the octopus every five minutes, or to desired doneness. Taste and adjust spices and add lemon zest if desired.

title: Bow Tie Pasta With Roasted Tomatoes and Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup broth, your favorite kind | 1/4 cup canned poblano chile, drained | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 2 tablespoons dried sage | 3 ounces bow tie pasta, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Combine everything except pasta in slow cooker. Cover.

title: Homemade Cheese (For French Baguette Snacks)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain greek yogurt | salt & freshly ground black pepper ( optional-you may want to sub with black pepper or kosher salt )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine all ingredients. With your hands, mix the ingredients well. Dough should still be fairly wet looking.. Cover the bowl and let the mixture sit while you prepare your bread machine for the full french brits. Use your bread machine to prepare the bread. Start the machine to cook the full french brits at the 1 1/2 setting. After that, allow the bread to cool slightly before slicing. Store in the closed container in the refrigerator.

title: Grilled Squash on Garlic Bread (Garlic Raisin Bread)
ingredients: 2 medium yellow squash | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | 2 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons hoagie rolls, halved horizontally | 2 1/2 teaspoons seasoned flour | 1/4 teaspoon coarse salt ( optional )
instructions: Peel squash, leaving peel on, and cut into 12 wedges. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon sage and the remaining 2 teaspoons sage over squash, then rub the herb coating all over. Arrange 1/3 cup squash in centre of each skewer, then fold rolls in half crosswise. Brush both sides of bread with vinegar. Season with salt, if desired, and serve.

title: Italian  Panir and Macaroni Stew
ingredients: 6 cups cooked macaroni | 10 ounces italian turkey sausage ( cut in 1-inches pieces ) | 1/2 cup peas and carrots ( frozen ) | 8 ounces italian turkey sausage ( sliced ) | 6 ounces panir ( grated ) | 2 -3 fresh mint leaves ( chopped )
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling, salted water according to package instructions. Meanwhile, fry your sausages. Remove sausages from pan, and slice into 1 inch slices.. Heat olive oil in a large skillet, add sausage and peas and carrots and saute over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add turkey sausage and mushrooms and saute for about 5 minutes. Add meat and pasta to the skillet and combine. Serve immediately.

title: Beef Salad (Korean Soy Cured Noodles)
ingredients: 1 cup bean thread noodles, uncut ( i prefer la choy brand ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup chinese fermented pickled radishes ( about 2 heads ) | 1 lb boneless chuck steak, sliced thin ( about 3 to 4 slices, i've also used 2-inch thick sirloin steaks ) | iceberg lettuce ( i like to use iceberg, or other green salad ) or other leafy greens ( i like to use iceberg, or other green salad )
instructions: Rinse noodles well, remove the stems, and soak in about 1/3 cup hot water for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside. Rinse chuck steak and trim fat. Slice meat thinly. Toss with bean threads or noodles. Arrange lettuce on a platter, or to your liking. Place noodle on top of lettuce, and pour beef and pickled radish mixture over noodle. Serve.

title: Swiss Chard With Barley
ingredients: 24 ounces swiss chard | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Wash and wash chard well, removing leaves or stems. Cut ribs in 3 pieces length wise. Rinse and drain barley. Bring 2 quarts water to boil in large pot. Add barley and stalks. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered and stirring occasionally for 40 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and cook until greens are tender 2 - 3 hours.

title: Chicken Couscous
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken thighs or 4 boneless turkey breasts ( 4 oz. total ) | 1/2 lb farfalle pasta, cooked according to package instructions | 1 bag snow peas | 1 bag red seedless grapes ( optional )
instructions: Pound chicken, if necessary.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,vanilla bean,limeade concentrate,basmati rice,american cheese,enoki mushroom
title: Chef John's Mojito Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1/4 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 2 white and brown american cheese slices | 1 ounce enoki mushrooms - drained, rinsed, and sliced | 1/8 vanilla beans, seeded and split into halves
instructions: Cook basmati rice in a large pot of boiling water for 15 minutes. Pour limeade concentrate into the pot, and bring to a boil. Simmer until water is absorbed. Stir in ginger paste, white cheese, enoki mushrooms, and vanilla beans.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,sirloin,semolina flour,yogurt,rose water,egg yolk,superfine sugar
title: Basil-Stuffed Beef Schnitzels
ingredients: 6 large boneless sirloin, trimmed | 2 tablespoons semolina flour | 1/4 teaspoon rose water | 2 egg yolks | 1 container plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon basil leaves, drained and chopped
instructions: Place the schnitzels on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Combine the flour and rose water in a bowl. Place the egg yolks and yogurt in a mixing bowl and beat on high speed until thick and creamy. Stir in sugar. Spread a heaping ¼ cup of yogurt mixture on each schnitzel, being careful to not spread it too thin. Use a knife to cut through the top and bottom of the schnitzels. Top each schnitzel with basil. Pour any remaining yogurt mixture over schnitzels. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour or overnight. Preheat the grill to medium. Grill schnitzels on the rack of a grill for about 4 minutes or until the top is slightly charred underneath. Transfer to a cutting board and let sit 5 minutes. Slice into serving portions.

title: Cafe Pacific Glacier Soup
ingredients: 2 quarts celery, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 quarts cabbage, cut into 1-inch pieces ( about 10 cups ) | 1/4 cup instant espresso powder | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 1/4 teaspoon ground espresso powder or 1/4 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Combine celery and cabbage with remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Banana Juice!
ingredients: 2 medium bananas, well-chilled and drained ( just enough to fill blender ) | 2 cups cold water ( i like to add more of my own water to get the right consistency to fill the blender )
instructions: Put all the ingredients through strainer into a clean pot. Keep lid on pot for 5 minutes. Note, it may not seem like enough water, but it’s supposed to be. Strain liquid through a muslin lined sieve. If the liquid is too thick for your taste, then add a little of the boiled liquid.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage link,sirloin,beef tenderloin steak,kosher salt,habanero pepper,thyme leaf
title: Carne Asada
ingredients: 3 1/4 lbs sirloin or 3 1/4 lbs flank steaks, about 2-inch long | kosher salt | 1 lb pork sausage link, cut into 1inch pieces | 1 habanero pepper, seeded, and minced | 1 sprig fresh thyme leaves | 1 lb spanish pork tenderloin or 1 lb flank steaks, trimmed and cut crosswise into thirds
instructions: Trim fat from meat, and season with kosher salt. Cut meat into 3/4 inch by 1½ inch wide strips, and place in zip top plastic bag. Add remaining ingredients and shake to mix. Add half the meat sections in a layer on top of each other. Squeeze out air, sealing bag. Marinate at least 2 hours in refrigerator. To cook, remove meat from bag, reserving marinade, and remove meat from bag. Cook over hot coals or high heat, turning frequently, until very tender, about 6 minutes. Transfer meat to platter and rest. Serve with rice and beans.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,baking potato,scallop,tomato juice,cayenne,prosciutto,italian parsley,cooking spray
title: Scotch Baked Scallops
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 medium skinless scallop, cut into 1-inch thick slices | 2 large baking potatoes, cut into quarters | 4 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate | 1/3 cup tomato juice | 1/16 teaspoon cayenne | 2 teaspoons chopped italian parsley | 2 slices prosciutto, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Coat a 2½ quart baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange scallops in baking dish and cover with sliced potatoes. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of frozen orange juice concentrate over scallops. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup tomato juice and the cayenne. Sprinkle with half the italian parsley. Cover baking dish with foil and bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes. Remove foil and sprinkle with prosciutto and remaining italian parsley. Return to oven and bake uncovered for an additional 8 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes.

title: German Relish
ingredients: 1 lb red beans, canned | 1 large cabbage, shredded | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Rinse red beans.

title: Yak Khadra [Yogurt in Nut Sauce]
ingredients: 1/8 of a cup fine-cut udon noodles or 1/8 rice flour noodle | 2 cups soymilk or 2 cups milk | toasted parsley leaves or dried chives
instructions: Boil noodles until softened about 5 minutes. Drain but do not put off the hot water. Place about 1 cup of noodles in a large bowl and mix with the yogurt. Top with a sprinkling of nuts or dried herbs. Serve and enjoy.

title: Fried Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 chicken breast | 4 ounces chocolate | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 teaspoon fresh ground cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cut the chicken into cubes or bite size pieces. In a small, dry frying pan, melt the chocolate and let it cool. Place all the ingredients except the parsley in a dish and whisk together. Set aside. In a large skillet or wok, heat the oil over high heat for 1 - 2 minutes until hot. Add the chicken and fry it until it turns a rich golden brown and the fat separates, 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the pan and drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with the parmesean spice if using, and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: red pepper oil,apricot preserve,russet potato,lemon juice,apple cider vinegar,thai basil,shiitake mushroom
title: Mushroom and Roasted Red Pepper Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/3 cup lemon juice | 1/3 cup apple cider vinegar | 6 tablespoons red pepper oil ( or other mild oil of choice ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried shrimp ( or other large chunky vegetables ) | 3/4 cup apricot preserves | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs russet potatoes, washed and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 bunch fresh thai basil, leaves picked ( about 1 1/2 oz.. )
instructions: Combine lemon juice, vinegar, and red pepper oil in glass jar with tight fitting lid. Cover, and shake to blend. Remove lid.

title: Baked Japanese-Style Shrimp
ingredients: 1 pound jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking dish with aluminum foil. Arrange shrimp in a single layer in dish. Pour 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds over shrimp. Spread 1 tablespoon tamari in a shallow dish. Repeat layering shrimp with remaining spice mixture and tamari until you have used all of shrimp. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until shrimp are beginning to turn pink.

Random Ingredients: marmalade,yellow pepper,european cucumber,parsley leaf,plantain,pork,vegetable bouillon cube,chicken breast half
title: Caribbean Pork, Vegetable and Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 kg pork, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons marmalade | 150 ounces chicken breasts ( diced ) | 150 ounces vegetable bouillon cubes | 1 yellow pepper, sliced thinly | 1/2 seedless european cucumber, sliced thinly | 2 plantains, peeled and sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Dice pork. Sprinkle with marmalade. Thread with vegetables. Add stock. Cook, covered, 30 minutes. Serve in soup bowls with bread.

title: Molletes De Alondre
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon | 4 1/2 ounces dried cake flour, sifted | 3/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 3 tablespoons instant adobo seasoning, mccormick original | 1 egg, lightly beaten
instructions: Clean and fillet salmon.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,avocado,extra virgin olive oil,goat cheese,scallion,salami,chocolate
title: Mexican Pinto Bean Spread With Goat Cheese and Avocado
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans | 4 ounces salami ( finely diced ) | 4 scallions ( finely chopped ) | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 ounce goat cheese ( crumbled ) | 2 ounces chocolate ( or to taste ) | 4 avocados ( roughly mashed )
instructions: In a crockpot, heat olive oil on medium/low and add the scallions. Cook for approximately 3 minutes. Stir in the beans and chopped salami and cook for a further 5 minutes. Add the goat cheese and chocolate and stir until melted. Once the mixture is creamy and smooth but still slightly lumpy, add the mashed avocados and stir until mixed well through. Serve in warm pita chips or on the side, with a good crusty bread or crackers.

title: Rabraccio (Steamed Green Mussels)
ingredients: 12 fresh whole mussels | 2 -3 bunches spinach leaves | 2 lamb necks ( or a mixture of both ) or 2 beef necks ( or a mixture of both )
instructions: Wash the mussels thoroughly under running water, removing any beards and any barnacles shaped shells. Fill a large steamer with water and bring it to a boil. Wash and dry the spinach. Remove the mussels from the water and set them aside in a bowl of ice water for about 10 minutes. When ready to steam, remove the beards. If the mussels are large and open, remove all of the meat from the shells and discard the shells. If you are using beef neck, it can also be used, but the taste of the meat will be more bland. Fill a steamer with water and bring it to a boil. Discard the shells and discard them. Steam the mussels on a high flame until they open, making sure that the steam is not too vigorous. Discard any remaining shells and allow them to rest for 3 minutes. Remove the mussels and set them aside in a bowl of ice water briefly to cool. Cut and clean the mussels, removing any beards, cut in halves lenghtwise. Remove the eyes and peels from the mussels. Cut each mussel lenghtwise into halves if they are large. Place a mussel on the bottom half of a large plate. Lay some spinach over it and lay 1/3 of the mussels on top. Place the remaining mussels on top. Place the top mussels on the mussels. Sprinkle over 1 t corn oil and roll tightly. Chill until serving time. Slice the rolls into the desired size and serve chilled.

title: Pasta with Crushed Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook rigatoni in lightly salted boiling water until just al dente, then drain. Scoop out and discard any water left in the pan. Add salt and pepper to the rigatoni and set aside. Toss cooked rigatoni with cooked crumbled butter and serve.

title: Spanish Pea-Pepper Avocados
ingredients: 2 avocados, ripe, coarsely chopped | 1 pinch tomato puree ( optional ) | 1 green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon frozen sweet peas pods
instructions: Put frozen peas in a microwave safe dish or bowl. Scramble with a spoon, til cooked through and slightly thawed, about 1 minute. Cool to room temperature then mince using two forks, if using. If using, mix with peas just before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Thai Carpet Appetizer Wedges
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste, or more to taste | 1 toothpick, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Whisk red curry paste, orange marmalade, and toothpick together in a bowl until marmalade is completely smooth with no lumps, 1 to 2 tablespoons.

title: Chinese Style Macaroni and Meat
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked pasta, preferably small or large | 1 lb small white kidney beans, washed ( preferably brown ones ) or 1 lb cannellini beans, washed ( preferably brown ones ) | 1 lb parsnip, peeled and cut into small pieces | 5 tablespoons chinese rice wine ( or sherry ) or 5 tablespoons white wine vinegar ( or sherry )
instructions: Bring a large pot of well salted water to boil. Add pasta and cook to al dente, about 6 minutes. While pasta is cooking, brown the meat in a deep fat frypan. You need to stir frequently. When pasta is al dente, drain and set aside. Add beans to the drained pasta and set aside. Drain parsnips. Return pasta to the pot and add all vegetables and wine or vinegar. Heat through and serve. Note, if you use dried beans that have been soaked before cooking, you will need to add more of the wine/vinegar to moisten, but stir often, so that it doesn't stick to the pot. It can be eaten either hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,parsley,chicken broth,romaine lettuce heart,chicken bouillon cube,onion soup mix,streaky bacon
title: Chicken And Bacon Salad With Vinegar
ingredients: 8 slices streaky bacon | 1 can chicken broth ( not condensed ) | 1 large onion soup mix ( i use onion onion harvest onion harvest onion harvest onion onion soup mix onion harvest onion harvest tomato & basil ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar ( red wine cooking wine vinegar vinegar ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( or equivalent equivalent ) | 1 romaine lettuce heart | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley
instructions: Wrap each slice of bacon around the onion. Place in a saucepan over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, making sure to break up the bacon with the back of a spoon.

title: Sharing Kabobs
ingredients: 4 ounces kelp | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 drops hot pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons low sodium soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/3 teaspoon garam masala | 1/3 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/3 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Soak the kelp in water for about 20 minutes, changing the water 3 times. The longer, the better. Soak the kabobs 4 - 5 minutes on both sides. Slice the kabobs in half and spread lightly with oil. Place kabobs along the grill and broil 2 - 4 minutes or just about the time your kabobs are done. While the kabobs are cooking, combine sauce ingredients in a small bowl, mix well, set aside. When the cooking time is up, brush kabobs with the reserved sauce and broil 2 - 3 minutes or until the glaze turns golden.

title: Egg Salad at Beeda (Baharat)
ingredients: 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried saffron | 1 bunch fresh green chile peppers, finely chopped
instructions: Place the eggs in a medium size saucepan with the saffron and just enough water to cover the eggs. Cover the pan and bring to a boil. The water should not be boiling. Reduce the heat and simmer until the eggs are just cooked. Take the pan from the heat and gently stir until the water is absorbed. When the eggs are cool enough to handle break them up and chop them up. Add the green chiles and the chopped eggs to the beaten egg and mix. Serve immediately before serving.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,bicarbonate soda,lavender,sage,tapioca flour,wheat germ,pineapple chunk,espresso powder
title: Tandoori Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups tapioca flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried sage | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried lavender ( or 1 -2 tsp. fresh lavender flowers if you can get them ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme ( or 1 -2 tsp. dried lavender ) | 1/2 cup brown sugar, lightly packed | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 2 -4 tablespoons espresso powder ( optional ) | 1/2 cup wheat germ, toasted
instructions: Grease and line a 25 cm × 15cm jelly roll pan with parchment. In a large bowl, sift the tapioca flour, bicarb soda, sage, lavender, thyme or lavender and sugar. Toss to combine. Pour pineapple over the flour and stir to combine. Spoon batter over the parchment paper. Sprinkle evenly with wheat germ. Cover loosely and refrigerate overnight or up to 2 days. Heat oven to 180°c. Remove from the fridge about 15 minutes before serving. Variation, use 1 - 2 tbs. Orange juice or 2 1/2 tbs. Sugar and 2 tbs. Hot coffee for a sweeter pudding or 3 tbs. Hot water for a sweeter pudding. Note, you can use vanilla extract or anise extract extract instead of the coffee.

title: Tea Smoked Fish
ingredients: 1 tea bag | 4 pounds of thinnest fillet fish ( fillet, skin on or off ) | 1 lemon, thinly sliced | 2 orange, juice and zest of | 1 packet hidden valley and tarragon dry ranch seasoning mix
instructions: Rinse fillet of all the way of the water, then drain in a colander. Place the bag of fish in a large, deep skillet that has been coated with cooking spray and put over medium heat. When the fish begins to brown to desired brown color, remove fish and set aside. Discard bag of fish. Add lemon slices and orange peel to skillet and cook over medium heat until orange rind is light brown and juice of lemon is starting to boil. Pour contents of skillet into a colander to drain off extra orange/lemon juice. Return contents of skillet to skillet. Stir in 3/4 t. Of the dry ranch seasoning mix. Bring to a boil, then turn down heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often. Serve hot, garnished with any of the suggested garnishes of your choice.

title: Vietnamese Baked Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian turkey sausage | 1 lb fresh bean sprout | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Cut the sausage into small pieces and brown them in oil over high heat. Remove from pan and drain oil. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Fill the baking dish with the drained beans and sprouts. Pour the fish sauce over the top. Bake, covered, in a moderate oven for 50 minutes.

title: Mexican Green Beans
ingredients: 2 cans green beans | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 teaspoon fennel, chopped | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix together picante sauce, fennel, and baking powder in a bowl. Place the green beans in a greased casserole dish. Pour mixture over the beans. Bake in oven for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,lime wedge,yellow onion,red bean,lime,habanero pepper,chili flake
title: Holy Habanero Bean and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 head broccollas or 1 head swiss chard, cleaned, chopped and reserved ( green beans ) | 1 medium yellow onion, coarsely chopped | 2 habanero peppers, seeds and membrane removed, thinly sliced | 3 cans red beans, drained and rinsed ( white kidney beans also work ) | 1 lime, cut into 4 wedges ( for garnish ) | 1/2 lime, quartered ( for garnish ) | salt and chili flakes ( to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: In a 4 to 6 qt crockpot, stir the beans with the reserved Broccoltes, onions, and hot peppers. Add the reserved bean broth or water, if necessary to cover the beans with liquid. Cook on high setting for at least 3 hours, or until the beans are tender but not falling apart. Stir in the lime wedges, bring to serving temperature, and serve garnished with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,yellow bell pepper,rosemary,salmon fillet,corn syrup
title: Rosemary Glaze Salmon
ingredients: 1/4 cup corn syrup | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup light syrup | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, minced | 4 skinless salmon fillets
instructions: Combine the corn syrup, pineapple juice, light syrup, and rosemary in a heavy nonstick skillet over medium heat. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer until the syrup is reduced to about 1/3 cup and the syrup is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, about 15 minutes.

title: Japanese Steamed Enoki Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 large enoki mushrooms | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger
instructions: Steam enoki mushrooms for 5 minutes. Remove from steamer and slice into 2 lengths. Steam ginger in a dry frying pan over low heat for 1 minute or until it turns golden. Sprinkle with a little ginger and serve.

Random Ingredients: savory,hazelnut,dark chocolate chip,salt black pepper,red pepper flake,topping,cornflour
title: Hot Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cornflour | 6 tablespoons dark chocolate chips | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon savory | 1 cup fresh-chopped hazelnuts | 8 ounces fat-free whipped topping
instructions: In a bowl, with a hand mixer, mash cornflour and chocolate until smooth. Add seasonings, pepper flakes and nuts and pulse until well blended. Whip topping ingredients. Pour over fruit salad and toss to coat.

title: Greek Style Pork Tastes
ingredients: 6 lbs pork shoulder | 10 ounces chopped dried apricots | 10 ounces chopped spinach | 10 ounces sliced radishes | 8 ounces crumbled feta | 4 ounces bacon | salad oil | toothpick
instructions: Cut pork into 1 in cubes and place in a plastic and leak dry. Toss with salad oil and salt. Grill til brown on all sides. When meat is tender chop meat in 1 - 2 pieces.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,dark soy sauce,beef,chinese five spice powder,urfa biber,wheat spaghetti,snow pea
title: Chorizo and Noodle Stir-Fry With Sausages
ingredients: 500 g lean ground beef | 200 g chorizo sausages | 100 g snow peas ( or other fresh sprouts ) | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon dark sweet soy sauce | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds ( roasted is best )
instructions: Slice chorizo in half, remove sausage casing and cut into 3cm cubes. Trim broccoli and divide remaining stalks into 2 pieces. Cut snow peas or other sprouts into 2 pieces and set aside. Mix ground meat, chorizo, sweet soy sauce, sesame seeds and chinese five spice powder in a bowl and shape into small patties. Cook over a medium heat until browned and cooked to your liking. Remove from heat and place on a serving plate covered with plastic wrap. Set aside and keep warm. Meanwhile, cook noodles in plenty of boiling, salted water for 4 minutes less than the packet instructions state. Drain and return to the same pan as the meat patties were cooked in adding a little more water. Place noodles on a plate with some paper towel on top to absorb any excess moisture. Toss with the remaining chinese five spice powder. Remove casings from the chorizo patties to serve and place on top of sprouts and meat patties. Serve with hot steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,cream mushroom soup,espresso powder,monterey jack pepper cheese,flat leaf parsley
title: Champignones
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup brewed espresso powder ( instant coffee granules ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 12 large button mushrooms ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 475f, or an oven with a rack in the middle. Butter a baking dish generously. Stir both cans of cream of mushroom soup, espresso powder, and parsley together in a large bowl until well blended. Stir in pepper jack cheese until just melted. Place mushrooms on a baking sheet. Spoon the cheese mixture into the cavity of each mushroom, and then arrange mushrooms in an even layer on top of the filling. Bake for 25 minutes, until the top is browned. Cool and serve.

title: Crock Pot Fresh Mushrooms - Halibut
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets | 14 ounces fresh mushrooms
instructions: Put all ingredients in your crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 7 hours.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,coleslaw mix,lemon juice,chili pepper flake
title: Tortilla Chips With Coleslaw (Mexican Mix
ingredients: 4 cups coleslaw mix ( red, baby greens, cabbage ) | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 cup corn tortilla chips
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and pour in a shallow baking dish. Put chips in rows on top, or in rows on the side if necessary. Bake on 350 degrees fahrenheit for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Beef, Cornmeal and Honey Mustard Melt Sub
ingredients: 12 hoagie rolls, split | 1 lb lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons yellow cornmeal | 2 tablespoons sake or 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. In 12 nonstick skillet brown beef. Drain. Stir in cornmeal and sake, bring to boil. Add honey and mustard seeds and heat through. Arrange sandwiches in a single layer on cookie sheet. Brush tops with some of meat juices. Bake about 5 minutes or until golden brown and heated through.

title: Sweet N' Savoury Caribbean Sausages
ingredients: 200 g turkey sausage | 1 courgette | 1/4 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Cut the sausage into 2cm slices across the body from the stem and cut away the loose, uncooked part of the spiral skin for a total of approx 25 pieces with the sharp knife attached. Using a vegetable peeler, remove the centre rib of the sausage and slice roughly around the base, then cut it into long slices to make around 25 pieces. Cutting the courgette into 4cm pieces can now be substituted for the courgette. Place the meat sections on four foil lined trays. Put the tray in the freezer for approx 15 minutes to firm up slightly. Remove the sausage from the freezer. Remove the meat and place on a chopping board and coarsely grate it using the largest knife you have. Use two forks to shred the meat into the meat. Cut the courgette in half lengthways and slice into wedges. Repeat this process using your hands and cut the courgette wedges into 5cm lengths or smaller. Take the turkey slices and place in a bowl with the courgette and chopped sausage. Add the desiccated coconut and mix it all together with your hands until everything is coated well. Place each parcel onto a foil lined tray and place in the freezer for approx 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from the tray and place on a chopping board and slice around the base and sides of the foil covered tray and place in the freezer for a further 15 minutes. Take the foil off of the tray, remove any excess air and, with a sharp knife, remove all the contents from the tray, placing each one on a foil lined tray. Cut each parcel into 3 equal portions to serve, placing each portion on a serving plate with the sides attached and topped, and serve with a sharp lime or sweet red chile salsa.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,ice cube,kalamata olive,green chile,grape leaf,beef stock,dark chocolate,radish
title: Lucky Mint Hot Chocolate from Walt Disney World Magazine
ingredients: 10 kalamata olives, pitted | 1/2 cup grapeseed oil or 1/2 cup grapeseed oil | 5 ounces dark chocolate | 1/2 cup beef stock | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 3 ounces radish, peeled and sliced | 1 fresh green chile, seeds removed and sliced | 5 cups ice cubes

title: Spareribs

Bake, basting occasionally, 40 - 45 minutes or until well browned and slightly crispy. Remove from oven. Stir in the sherry and set aside. Meanwhile, heat a large, ovenproof skillet over medium high heat, add tuna and onion, and saute 8 - 10 minutes or until the tuna is firm and starting to color. Drain oil from pan. Arrange ribs on a large platter. Spoon reserved sauce over and serve hot with orange sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,ice cube,vanilla essence,thyme sprig,red wine

title: Fukuoka Tofu (Tofu Ball) (Japanese)

title: Sticky Orange-Date Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 oranges, washed, peel on, sliced in half then in half again, to yield 1 cup segments ( the segments ) | 12 large green olives, trimmed, washed, drained and cut in 1/2-inch cubes ( or more ) | 1 cup pitted dates, chopped ( or more ) | 12 maraschino cherries, chopped | 1/3 cup sherry wine, cooking quality, chilled and strained well | 1/2 cup orange blossom honey
instructions: Arrange the orange segments in a large serving bowl. Place the olives, dates and cherries on top. Drizzle with the sherry, mix & match with the honey. Chill to soften the fruits. Note, the preparation of this dish was quite easy & only took the orange skins from the oranges. By mistake, any good orange would look like a different colored fruit, rather than a real fruit in color.. The orange peel can be obtained at specialty food or some supermarkets in the pilsens, it will turn a very pale green & juicy yellow. You can also peel the white skin from the oranges by peeling them first. Using your fingers, peel the orange slices into long thin strips and then cut them crosswise into very thin slices & set aside. Dry the strips slightly and store them on a rimmed baking sheet under a tap towel to make sure they are dry & brittle. You can then carefully remove the thin membrane & any dark pith underneath if you wish. You can leave the peel in or if you prefer, peel the hard skin on. The orange can be stored in an air tight plastic bag in the refrigerator for up to 3 days, or you can just lightly peel them skinned & cut them into ribbons. If you like, remove the membrane only after you have made it & keep it for another use. The orange can be used in small dishes such as a brie cheese cream & mayonnaise based on the amount of prepared orange peel used.

title: Ancho Chili Calabrese
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon kielbasa | 1 pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread a thin layer of enchilada sauce into the bottom of a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Spread bean puree onto the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with kielbasa and ancho chili powder. Arrange the pizza crust in a single layer over the puree. Cover generously with aluminum foil, and bake in preheated oven until the chili is very hot, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sole Meats
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh sole, cleaned, washed and dried well | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 - 1 1/2 cup buttermilk | 4 cups hot stock or 4 cups broth
instructions: Soak the sole in cold water for 3 to 5 minutes, changing the water 2 times. Drain the fish and pat dry with paper towels. Cover with a damp cloth and bring to a boil in the milk and cooking oil. Drain the fish again and cover in clean water. Bring up to a boil and cook slowly for about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to stand, covered, for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat, cover and rest in a warm place for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, remove any bones if desired. Put the fish on serving plates and surround with sauce.

title: Sweet Chilli Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups finely shredded lettuce | 2 tablespoons sweet chili pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store in a cool dry place or in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast meat,beef brisket,chili powder,salmon,peach puree,olive oil,chicken thigh
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil | 8 bone-in chicken thighs, with skin | 1 boneless beef brisket, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can peach puree | 1 cup chicken breast meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 can salmon, drained on a fine mesh cloth
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Brown chicken cubes. Cook brisket, boneless side up, until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove brisket, and reserve. Heat another 1 tablespoon oil in skillet. Stir in peach puree, and return sausage to skillet. Cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Return brisket to skillet, and mix in chicken, peaches, chili powder, and salmon. Cover, and simmer over low heat 30 minutes, until meat is tender.

title: Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: 8 ounces chocolate or 8 ounces semisweet chocolate, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder ( or a combination or two teaspoons dark cocoa with a good pinch of coconut ) | thyme sprig
instructions: Gently melt the choclate and cocoa in a bowl in the microwave. Add the thyme in a steady stream, stirring constantly, until lumps disappear. Keep warm. Using 1 teaspoonful or a tablespoonful for each, roll into balls about the size of walnuts and drop onto a lightly greased tray. Leave to dry at room temperature for 2 or 3 hours. Keep in a tightly closed container in the fridge until required.

title: Chocolate Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped brown onion | 2 teaspoons grated nori or 2 teaspoons sushi toenjado's | 2 teaspoons ground chocolate
instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor/chopper and process until smooth. Refrigerate until completely cool to the touch sprinkle with more grated chocolate and serve.

title: Rye Bread With Pork and Cucumber Salad and Mint
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder or 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 slice rye bread or 1 slice pumpernickel bread | 1 large cucumber | fresh mint sprig
instructions: Rinse and trim the pork of fat and gristle before cutting crosswise into about 1x1 inch thick slices. Rinse the bread slices and cut into about the same size sections of pieces as the pork. Place a slice or two of bread on your work surface or work surface, sprinkle with a little coarse salt and cut with a very sharp knife in small triangles. Flatten the slices slightly and place about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the pork in the middle of the triangles. Pick up the cucumber and use your hands or a fork to push it out into the bread. Dot the bread with slices of the remaining pork fat. Fold a few of the bread triangles in half and roll them around the pork and cucumber, then firmly roll the rest around the pork and cucumber. Cut each roll in half again and cut along the side of the roll to make 8 or 10 fingers. To serve, unwrap the pork and cucumber salad and arrange on a platter. Garnish with the mint sprigs. Serve warm or cool.

title: Mexican Pot of Chicken in Yellow Sauce
ingredients: 9 -10 pieces roasting chickens or 9 -10 pieces other poultry | 7 -8 ounces pasta, of choice | 1 pint grape tomatoes ( not halved ) or ( 11 1/2 ounce ) pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 -3 tablespoons unsalted ghee or 2 -3 tablespoons other clarified butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove the neck and wing cavities, reserving them. Rinse the chicken well. Pat dry with a clean cloth and place on the rack in a shallow roasting pan. Place the oven rack close to the oven and roast just until the skin is starting to crisp on the chicken, approximately 40 minutes. Transfer the chicken out and place a cooling rack in the pan to cool a little bit. Remove the thick glaze from the roasting pan, pour off the liquid and set aside. In a large pot of hot, salted water, bring to a boil the pasta, a few pieces of the chicken or vegetables, half of the sesame oil, and half of the grape tomatoes. Lower the heat to a simmer and cook until the pasta is not quite al dente, approximately 10 minutes depending on how chunky or chunky you like your dish. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan. Toss all the pasta, chicken, vegetables and grape tomatoes with the reserved olive oil and some of the reserved sesame oil. Spread the cooked chicken or vegetables in a single layer over the pasta and sprinkle with the remaining sesame oil. Bake for 30 minutes and serve the chicken and pasta hot.

title: Black Russian Chicken Rub for Grilling
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 1/2 teaspoon coarse black pepper, crushed
instructions: Wrap bacon around each chicken breast to make a pocket. Rub the black pepper into each chicken breast and place onto a lightly oiled grill over low coals, turning once, until crisp and beginning to char at the edges, about 10 minutes per side. Remove from grill and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Yogurt Patties for Two
ingredients: 1 can sliced beefsteak tomatoes ( or italian seasoned ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/4 teaspoon pepperjack cheese ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients and season to taste with salt and pepper. Chill for 20 minutes. Form into 4 oval patties and either broil until browned and patties are cooked through, about 3 minute each side.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,jalapeno,onion soup mix,jalapeno pepper heat,date,vanilla pod,cranberry
title: Homemade Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces dates, dried | 2 jalapenos | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh cranberries | 1 vanilla pod | 1 onion soup mix | 3 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 -2 tablespoon pickled jalapeno pepper, minced
instructions: Preheat oven 375 degrees place dates on a pan of hot water. Boil until soft remove and drain place in a large mixing bowl add jalapenos, cranberries, onion soup mix, and graham cracker crumbs. Mix well until everything is mixed and well mixed. Place mixture in sauce pan and bake for 15 - 20 minutes stir frequently until bubbly remove from oven and enjoy.

title: Prosciutto Canapes
ingredients: cooking spray | 8 slices prosciutto
instructions: Place 1 - 2 slices prosciutto on each of 4 pieces of reynolds wrap non stick cooking spray. Top the prosciutto with 1 - 2 slices of prosciutto and close the package. Bake at 425f for about 10 - 12 min or until the prosciutto is crispy and the topping is golden.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,rice wine,french bread,campbell cheddar cheese soup,cauliflower
title: Campbell's French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can campbell's cheddar cheese soup, undiluted ( with garlic ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup rice wine ( depending on how saucy you use it ) ( optional ) | 6 cups broccoli, cut in small florets | 8 ounces bag cauliflower or 8 ounces broccoli rabe, cut in small florets | breadcrumbs or cornstarch, as needed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot. Cover and cook on low setting 7 hours, or until vegetables are tender. For soup bowls, serve soup with bread crumbs or cornstarch.

title: Chili Powder Paste for Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Beat egg white with oil in a small bowl then add chopped chili oil. Spoon the mixture into tortilla and roll. Serve with refried beans.

Random Ingredients: strawberry ice cream,hot pepper,celery seed,manchego cheese,orange juice
title: Broiled Poached Strawberries With Cheese
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs strawberries ice cream, softened | 8 ounces manchego cheese, cut on the bias ( about 4 slices ) | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 4 hot peppers, sliced | 1/3 cup freshly squeezed orange juice
instructions: Place a double boilerproof bowl on top of a large pot of boiling water. Beat the ice cream, cheese, celery seed, and hot peppers. Dunk each strawberry in the mixture and place in the prepared double boiler. Close the lid and simmer slowly until the cheese is melted and the fruit is just tender, about 15 minutes. Toss with orange juice.

title: Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs raspberries, frozen | 1 tablespoon juniper berries ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine fresh raspberries, juniper berries, and salt. Cover and chill for several hours. Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator up to 1 month.

title: Gorgeous Meatball Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground beef | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 2 slices sourdough bread, crusts removed and torn into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 2 cups red potatoes, thinly sliced ( about 3 medium ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped semisweet chocolate | tortilla
instructions: In large heavy nonstick skillet, heat beef, onion and salt over medium high heat until beef is brown and onion is tender, stirring frequently. Remove beef mixture from heat.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,buttermilk,red wine,rigatoni pasta,red bell pepper
title: Greek Style Rigatoni
ingredients: 16 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 large red bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons dry red wine | 8 pita bread, cut in half, toasted
instructions: Cook rigatoni in large pot of boiling water until al dente. Add tomatoes, bell pepper, buttermilk, and wine. Heat until hot. Place pita halves in a warmed broiler. Spoon pasta mixture onto pita, or use a slotted spoon to place onto a plate.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,superfine sugar,vanilla sugar,palm sugar,white vinegar
title: Sweet-Cane Sorbet
ingredients: 2 cups superfine sugar | 1 cup white vinegar ( not distilled vinegar ) | 1 2/3 cups superfine sugar | 2 lbs golden raisins ( about 3 1/2 cups per cup ) | 2 tablespoons light golden raisins | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar
instructions: Note, to help the sugar and to get the sticky bits off the raisins when you add the syrup, first heat the sugar, vinegar and sugar in a saucepan to about 225 degrees f, or until it dissolves. Do not stir let cool at least 10 - 20 minutes. With a slotted spoon, scrape sugar & vinegar mixture onto ice in an aluminum foil cone fashion, about 1 1/2 inches tall. It should cover the bottom of your pan. Let cool and harden while preparing the sorbet. When it hardens, stir on high until it dissolves. Transfer sorbet to bowl. Add the brown sugar and raisins and mix well. Cover bowl tightly and place in freezer. After the sorbet has chilled, strain out as much liquid as possible before using. Place all ingredients, stirring in the vanilla sugar, into a blender and blend until the consistency is like a thick, jam like syrup. To use, make a mound of the sorbet and roll in a cone or other fancy flat object so that the cone breaks off the far edge of the cone, then roll into the sorbet. Let go on and on shaking the sorbet occasionally.

title: Cherry Onion Kraut
ingredients: 10 unpeeled onions | 1 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1 bunch marshmallows | 2 pounds sauerkraut | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 package halved cherry rolls | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Place the onions, about 1/2 pound per pound of onion, into a slow cooker, and sprinkle the sugar over all. Toss to coat, and set the cooker to low. Cook in the slow cooker on high, setting the lid in place. Stir the marshmallows and sauerkraut into the hot onion juice, and cook for five more minutes, stirring constantly, before removing the lid to prevent scorching. Remove the cover, and stir in the half and half until it has come to a boil. Pour the mixture over the onions, and sprinkle with the cherry roll halves. Set the cooker to high, and cook for 3 hours, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle the top with grated swiss cheese, and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,oregano leaf,bay leaf,water,hot red chili pepper,chuck roast
title: Saucy Beef Stock
ingredients: 5 lbs chuck roast, trimmed if necessary | 1 cup orange juice or 1 cup zest of an orange | 1/2 cup dried oregano leaves, picked | 1 bay leaf | 3 dried hot red chili peppers | 8 cups water
instructions: Put all ingredients, except beef and bay leaf, in a large crock or stockpot. Cover and cook on high for 7 hours. Remove the beef and bay leaf, removing the meat and reserve. Use 2 forks to shred the meat finely and return all meat to the stock.

Random Ingredients: ham,dijon mustard,cumin seed,beef,self rising flour,egg white
title: Moroccan Mini Meat Loafs
ingredients: 1 egg white | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 1/2 pounds ground beef | 1/2 cup finely chopped ham | 2/3 cup plain self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Whisk egg white, dijon mustard, and ground cumin seed in a bowl until they turn pale yellow, about 1 minute. Mix ground beef and ground ham in a separate bowl. Mix flour into the egg mixture.

title: Radish and Watercress Antipasto
ingredients: 3 large watercress or regular arugula leaves | 1 large mushroom | 1 teaspoon dried thyme, softened | 1/2 cup fresh basil or 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 2 bananas, cut into 1/2-inch dice
instructions: In a large bowl, place arugula, mushroom, thyme, basil and water chestnuts. Sprinkle with 1/4 tsp pepper.

title: Easy and Delicious Mexican Corn for the Microwave
ingredients: 12 ounces corn ( canned ) | 1/4 cup picante sauce ( mild ) | 3 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Cook the corn according to package instructions. Drain off 1/2 cup of the corn liquid and add the picante sauce and molasses. Pour the corn back into the microwave proof bowl. Mix well. Cover and set on high for 5 to 10 minutes. When finished, remove from the microwave and let stand for 5 to 10 minutes then fluff with a fork. Serve with your favorite mexican meal. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,mexican cheese,peppercorn,feta cheese,nam pla,beef stock
title: Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup grated mexican cheese | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup crumbly graham cracker crumbs | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon crushed peppercorn | 1 can beef stock | nam pla or sriracha as desired
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine all ingredients with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight or up to 2 days. Bring beef stock in a large saucepan to a rolling boil. Slowly mix in mixture of cheese and cracker crumbs, and continue stirring mixture until mixture thickens slightly and cheese is fully melted. Taste for seasonings, and adjust as necessary, and stir in enough nam pla to achieve the right balance of flavors.

title: Indian Curry Rub for Beef Steak
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: In a small bowl, combine parsley and curry powder. Rub into steak. Allow to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before grilling as desired.

title: Spanish Oven Browned Calzones
ingredients: 8 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped | 2 teaspoons green cardamom pods, cracked | 2 medium zucchini, sliced at a diagonal | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
