instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. In a small sauté pan, melt butter over medium heat until it foams, about 1 minutes. Crush the cardamom pods with the back of a wooden spoon to release their fragrance, then stir into the butter with the zucchini and parmigiano.

title: Greens and Courgette Pilaf
ingredients: 2 large green creamed courgettes, washed and chopped | salt and black pepper | 1 1/2 cups hot water | pita pockets | 1 - 1 1/2 cup chopped vegetables
instructions: Bring together the hot water and courgette in a large bowl. Cover and leave for 5 minutes. Drain thoroughly and transfer to a large plate. Add salt and pepper to taste. Mix the courgette mixture with the courgette mixture. Wet your hands and mould the mixture into 4 balls. Cover and chill for 30 minutes or overnight. Place pita pockets on a serving plate. Place a serving plate on top, arrange the vegetable pieces on the centre of the pita pockets and serve with the greens and roasted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,ice water,red chili pepper,dark sesame oil
title: Chinese Barbecued Ribs
ingredients: 6 pork ribs, country style, trimmed | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 red chili pepper, finely minced ( or 1 jalapenos minced, 1/4 tsp. ) | 1/4 cup ice water
instructions: Using 2 forks or a sharp knife, pull out the bone and any excess meat fat. Cut the meat into 2 inch cubes and set aside. Heat the sesame oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook, turning several times, for 5 minutes or until browned. Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside. Combine the chili pepper and the remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Sprinkle the pork over the chile mixture. Return the chicken to the pan. Cover, reduce heat to low and cook 20 minutes. Decrease heat to low, cook 5 minutes more, basting several times with the hot mixture. The barbecued ribs should be tender by now, but the longer the cooking, the crumbier the crumb. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,horseradish,doritos,bell pepper,green bell pepper,macaroni,flat leaf parsley,cauliflower
title: Macaroni and Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower | 1 cup cooked macaroni | 1/2 medium green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 medium green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup crispy hot dog hamburger | 1 tablespoon grated horseradish | 1 teaspoon curly-edged horseradish | prepared flat leaf parsley
instructions: Separate cauliflower into tiny florets using a vegetable peeler. Coarsely chop cauliflower into bite size pieces. In a medium skillet, heat a few tablespoons of water over medium high heat until the water bubbles and evaporates. Add in the macaroni, bell peppers, and hot dogs. Stir fry until the outsides turn tender and the vegetables appear glazed, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in horseradish and parsley. Place one slice of beef over each slice of cauliflower and top with one more slice of cauliflower, horseradish, and parsley.

title: Charmen's Wild Vegetable Tarts
ingredients: 1 can yellow tomatoes | 1 lb sweet potato, peeled, cut into 4'matchsticks ( peeled and cut into quarters, then into chunks ) | 1 lb sweet potato, peeled, cut into 4'matchsticks | 1 lb fresh button mushroom, cleaned and sliced | 1 teaspoon chile ( dried or to taste ) | 1 box puff pastry sheets
instructions: Put tomatoes into a large saucepie dish or baking dish. Wash and dry sweet potato. Cut green and yellow tomatos into 4'matchsticks'<NEXT_INSTR> Cut mushrooms into quarters. Cut slit lengthways in top of the tomatoes and lay on top. Sprinkle with chile and cover with a very stiff foil. Place in a very hot oven for 45 - 60 minutes or until the tomatoes are cooked and the potatoes are fork tender. Set aside to cool at room temperature. Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut puff pastry sheets in half lengthwise. Spread each half again with 2tbs of tomato mixture. Replace foil and bake for 10 - 15 minutes until lightly browned. Enjoy.

title: Panch Phrik Kwa (Panch Phrik Swirl Tea)
ingredients: 2 -3 green chilies, depending on size, deseeded and finely chopped ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons green food coloring
instructions: Put the finely chopped green chilies into a small pot. Stir once over medium heat to coat with oil and keep the chilies hot. Once all the chilis are lightly coated with oil, add green food coloring. Pour into an 8 inch square glass jar. Seal and store in the refrigerator. Keep 2 - 4 cm of water in the bottom of the jar at all times of the next day. Bring back to a boil in a pot with 2 - 4 cm water. Once boiling, remove it from the heat. Cool the jar. Remove the excess water.

title: Spinach with Saffron
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 3/4 teaspoon saffron, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cook and stir saffron in a skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about one minute. Pour saffron into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,milk ricotta cheese
title: Creamy Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar milk ricotta cheese | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Pour ricotta cheese into a bowl. Stir in diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, and refrigerate overnight for flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,hot water,butter,mint leaf,chocolate,dark brown sugar,mint,coriander seed
title: Grilled Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter, softened | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons hot water | 1 tablespoon crushed coriander seed | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves | 1 tablespoon grated semisweet chocolate ( optional ) | 1 lb chicken tenders, cut into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat grill pan or broiler. Line metal rack with foil and set pan/skillet over medium heat. When surface of coals is hot, brush grill surface with oil. Combine butter, brown sugar, water and spices in mixing bowl. Add chicken.

title: Grilled Swiss Chard With Mexican Nuts
ingredients: 2 lbs stalks swiss chard, stemmed and torn into 1 1/2 inch chunks | 1 1/4 cups shredded mexican chocolate | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: In large, nonstick skillet over medium heat, toss chard and cheese until just warmed, about 2 minutes. Spread chard in a thin layer on an ungreased large sheet pan. Sprinkle chard with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, at least 15 minutes.. Using a potato peeler or a paring knife, peel off and discard any damaged leafy parts of the chard. Toss chard, leaving enough whole leaves to wilt, with a few leaves for garnish. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chianti nut halves. Serve cool.

title: Grecian Style Beef Shanks
ingredients: 1 pound beef shanks, cut into serving pieces | 1 can or bottles lager-style beer, divided | 1 package crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 tablespoons ground red chile pepper
instructions: Place beef shanks in a large pot with 2/3 bottle of beer, the feta cheese, red chile pepper, and cinnamon. Bring to a simmer, and cook until beef is tender, about 2 1/2 hours. Remove the pink center from the beef, and slice into thin strips. Pour beef into a saucepan, and cook over medium low heat until heated through, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Moroccan Spiced Carrots
ingredients: 2 cups kirsch ( cherry brandy or apricot brandy ) | 1 large carrot, cut into matchstick-size pieces | 1 large yellow bell pepper, cut into matchstick-size pieces | 1 cup green chilies, seeds removed and thinly sliced ( hot or mild ) | 1/4 cup ground almonds or 1/4 cup blanched almond | 1/4 cup ground coriander
instructions: Mix the kirsch and most of the ground almonds in a small bowl, and store in the fridge. Place the rest of the nuts as the nuts are toasting and frying in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place the carrots in the pan and heat for about 1 minute, until lightly browned on the outside. Place about 1/3 of the caramelized carrots in a 9 inch square glass baking dish. Sprinkle with the green chilies, and top with 1/3 of the caramelized carrots. Sprinkle with about 1/3 of the ground almonds and repeat the layers twice more. Finish and finish with the remaining caramelized carrots. Let stand at room temperature for about 1 hour before serving.

title: Roasted Cranberry Puff Pastries
ingredients: 3 ounces puff pastry, thawed | 1 small red green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries, washed and spun dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Roll the pastry dough out to ¾ inch thickness and cut into 4 long strips measuring 1½ inches wide. In a medium bowl, combine the diced pepper, cranberries and remaining ingredients until well mixed and sprinkle with salt. Place the short strips on a sheet of parchment, leaving at least ½ inch between the strips, and roll into a log. Arrange the parcels on a parchment lined baking sheet about ½ inch apart. Bake in the preheated oven until the pastry is golden, 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Praline Spice Mix
ingredients: 300 ml roasted sweet salted sweet salted sweet condensed milk ( or sweetened condensed milk ) | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder ( i prefer haldel's haroset spice mix. ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon real vanilla essence
instructions: Place all ingredients in a jar. Store in an cool dry place, shaking it often to mix. You can freeze it.

title: Spicy Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup warm water | 1 1/2 - 2 cups canned chicken breast halves, drained, but not chopped | 1/2 cup frozen blueberries | 1 small red bird's eye chile, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over the water in a medium bowl, and stir to blend. Let stand for five minutes, then stir and add the remaining ingredients. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand for about thirty minutes. Stir the mixture at least once a day. Drain the chicken, and refrigerate it for at least three hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. To bake, arrange the chicken with a long side in the palm of one hand.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,pimiento,tart apple,green chile pepper,white sugar,beef bouillon cube,tomato juice,tahini
title: Baked Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 package cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 1/2 cup sliced pickled tart apples | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved | 1 pinch white sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Toss cauliflower with tomatoes, green chile peppers, apple, pimentos, tahini, beef bouillon, and sugar. Spread in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and bake for about 40 minutes, or until cauliflower is tender and well flavored.

Random Ingredients: navy bean,orange peel,beef broth,cherry tomato,crimini mushroom,sun tomato oil,half,wheat bread
title: Pasta With Bean Purée With Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 ounces dried navy beans, cleaned | 2 cups beef broth | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced | 5 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 orange peel, grated coarsely ( cut into thin strips ) | 4 ounces crimini mushrooms, stemmed sliced | 6 slices whole wheat bread, toasted
instructions: Cook beans according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: soba noodle,lobster meat,tea,lasagna noodle,half,baking powder,grain rice
title: Lobster Rice Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lobster meat or 1 lb cooked crabmeat | 1 package soba noodles | 1 cup half-and-half | 2 cups short-grain rice | 1/2 cup instant tea | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 9 uncooked lasagna noodles
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain noodles, return to pot and cover with water. While waiting for the noodles to cook, combine the lobster meat with the soba noodles in a mixing bowl. Add rest of ingredients, except lasagna noodles and stir in lightly. Heat an oven safe griddle or frying pan over medium heat. When it is hot, lightly grease it. Ladle half an noodle's worth of soup in a bowl and spoon 1/3 of the filling in the middle of each noodle. Roll the noodles up and arrange in a single layer on the pan in a neat manner. Spread remaining soup over each rolled noodle and cover with a lid, making sure that your noodles are sealed completely. Put in the oven and bake about 15 minutes, until the tops are nicely browned. Serve and enjoy.

title: Coriander and Cream Chops
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped | 1 tablespoon juniper berries, finely crushed | 1 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 1/2 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl or food processor and process until you obtain a smooth paste. This should look like a mixture of fresh coriander, mint and pine nuts. Pour into a casserole dish or souffle dish. Cover the surface of the top with grated parmesan. Lightly dust with more grated parmesan to give a colour and gloss. Cook in a moderate oven 180 grades c until golden on top and bubbling around the edges. You may add a dash more cream if the top of the cake darkens too much.

title: Celeri - Lentil & Vegetable One Pot Meal
ingredients: 200 g red cabbage | 400 g red lentils | 400 g cherry tomatoes ( sliced or halved ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon vodka
instructions: Cut the cabbage into 1cm slices. Pare the tomatoes or halve the cherry tomatoes, if too large. Slice the cabbage slices into similar sizes. Combine the lentils, tomatoes, asafoetida and vodka in a large pot, bring to the boil and simmer for approximately 35 minutes or until the lentils are cooked. Add cabbage and continue cooking until the lentils are soft.

title: French Toast With Corn Flour (Microwave)
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 150 ml thick'yummil butter ( or more )
instructions: Warm the cornflour into the butter in a heavy frypan. Dip the bread into the cornflour and fry on both sides until just golden. The cornflour should be absorbed by the bread when cooked.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,white fish fillet,chilies,coconut flour,rotini pasta,farfalle pasta,focaccia bread,rosemary leaf
title: Fish and Pasta With Chilies
ingredients: 2 -3 small boneless white fish fillets | 4 cups farfalle pasta | 1/2 cup coconut flour | 1 bunch fresh rosemary leaves, torn | 3 dried chilies | 2 large cardamom pods | 1 lb uncooked wagon wheel rotini pasta or 3 lbs rotini noodles | focaccia bread, to serve
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to a boil. Cook pasta according instructions on package. Drain and cool under running water. Place farfalle pasta in large bowl. Toss with coconut flour and herbs. Place on serving platter. Pour fish over pasta, and top with rotini or rotini. Serve with crusty bread. An alternate accompaniment is to serve with a nice bowl of aioli.

Random Ingredients: sauce,hot mustard,pepperoni,onion salt,green cardamom pod,asadero cheese,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 pints of shredded asadero cheese ( store brand will do ) | 1/3 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 3 tablespoons chopped sweet pickled hot pepperoni | 1 tablespoon hot mustard | 1 tablespoon grated onion salt | 1 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: In a large bowl add all ingredients and mix well. Cover and place in the refrigerator over night to develop flavor and chill before serving with crackers or assorted crackers.

Random Ingredients: white bean,mandarin orange,chile,scotch bonnet pepper,ice,heavy whipping cream,bacon,coriander
title: Chile and Orange Cannellini
ingredients: 1 pound bacon, diced | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans mandarin oranges, drained | 5 scotch bonnet peppers, chopped ( wear gloves to prevent irritation ) | 2 cans chile, drained | 1/3 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup crushed ice, or as needed
instructions: Place bacon in a large pot or skillet, and cook over medium high heat until evenly browned and crisp, 5 to 10 minutes. Break bacon up into pieces with a spoon. Cook and stir white beans, mandarin oranges, scotch bonnet peppers, chili peppers, and coriander in the bacon grease until heated through, 5 to 10 minutes. Whisk cream into skillet mixture, then bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until flavors have blended, about 5 minutes. Spoon cream mixture into glasses, or punch small cups to serve.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce heart,milk chocolate,mascarpone cheese,tomato sauce,cardamom seed,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Swiss Cheese Stuffed Romaine Leaves
ingredients: 1 romaaine lettuce hearts, chopped | 2 ounces milk chocolate | 1 ounce mascarpone cheese | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, ground | 1 tablespoon tomato sauce
instructions: Mix together the mascarpone, cheddar cheese, cardamom seeds and tomato sauce. Place a few large leaves on a work surface, top with a spoonful of the cheese mixture, roll up and enjoy.

title: Baked Green Pepper on Toast Roll
ingredients: 12 -14 roll slices pork | 4 tablespoons light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons light beer or 2 tablespoons white wine | 2 green bell peppers
instructions: Cut out six 8x12 inch squares that are about 1 to 1 1/2 inches wide and 3/4 inch thick. Place the squares on a hot griddle and let them brown. Turn one and a half turns more quickly, using tongs or a spatula to remove most of the burnt part. Spread one side of the square with light corn syrup and one with black pepper and place a slice of your choice into the center. Slightly flatten the green pepper with the spatula. As it browns, flip it over to cook the other side, pressing the pepper down lightly. The green pepper should develop a slight crunch to the meat. After turning over, top with the remaining light corn syrup and beer. Sprinkle with more black pepper and cook for an additional 5 minutes or until the meat and vegetables are piping hot and the syrupy coating is melted and aromatic.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,orange juice,phyllo pastry,tomato puree,button mushroom,cauliflower floret,green cardamom pod,cooking oat
title: Bruk Sadiah-Beshoku
ingredients: 250 g mushrooms, sliced | 25 g cauliflower florets, chopped | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon quick-cooking oats | 3 green cardamom pods, cracked down the center | 1/3 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 sheet phyllo pastry, thawed if frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the mushrooms, cauliflower, soup, oil, cardamom and orange juice into a saucepan over the heat. Cook, stirring, for 2 - 3 minutes or until heated through. Spray 2 baking trays with nonstick spray. Lay 1 sheet of phyllo pastry on work surface. Cut crosswise into 6 rectangles, brushing each with melted butter spray. Turn each piece a quarter turn and brush each side with butter spray, allowing excess to drip off. Spread a heaped teaspoon of mushroom mixture onto each rectangle, leaving enough overhang to fold if necessary. Fold the half of the tortillas over the mixture and press to compact it. Transfer to baking tray. Repeat until you have used up all the pastry. Brush each with melted butter spray and bake until golden brown, about 20 - 25 minutes. For vegetarian use the vegetable broth.

Random Ingredients: caribbean jerk marinade,chicken bouillon granule,cornstarch,serrano chilies,half cream,oil,grape leaf,corn husk
title: Cock-A-Tie-Sails with Sweet and Sour Filling
ingredients: 1 cup seedless grapeseed leaves | 3 dried guajillo serrano chilies, stemmed and seeded | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon caribbean jerk marinade ( such as kc masterpiece ) | 2 1/2 cups half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons oil | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 4 cups dry cornhusks
instructions: For the filling, in a small bowl, stir together 1 cup plus 1 tablespoon sugar with 2 cups water to dissolve the sugar. Set aside and refrigerate until ready to use. Wash, remove stems and seeds from both dried chiles and toast until chiles are dark brown and fragrant, about 4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chiles to a spice grinder. Place chiles in a small bowl and cover with hot water.

title: Tandoori Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 large cauliflower, cut into florets ( about 1 cup ) | 5 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon mustard | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1/2 cup blanched almond
instructions: Steam the cauliflower for about 45 minutes, until tender. Puree the cauliflower with one cup water, and add 2 tblsps. Of the dark soy sauce, the mustard, coriander and the almonds. Stir until mixed well and serve hot with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,basil leaf,green olive,almond extract,nut,cumin seed,sauce
title: Nabisco Bay Roasted Basil Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ripe mixed ripe basil leaves | 6 fluid ounces canned tomato juice | 2 drops hot sauce or 1 dash tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil extract | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 1 tablespoon unsalted mixed nuts, roughly chopped ( optional ) | 1 cup slivered toasted nuts, such as pecans, walnuts, pecan or walnut halves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a jelly roll pan with dried basil leaves and place basil leaves side by side in a single layer. Pour remaining ingredients into a blender.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,lettuce,red wine,italian parsley,cooking oil,piquillo pepper red
title: Tortillos Con Queso Fundido (Spanish Lettuce With Piquillo Peppers)
ingredients: 4 large fresh piquillo peppers ( red ) | 1 head red lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces ( about 1 pound ) | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup dry red wine ( such as a good cabernet sauvignon or beaujolais ) | 1/2 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Rinse the peppers and cut off stems just below the eyes, and discard the seeds. Make a slit in the peppers lengthwise and remove the blackened pulp. Discard the seeds and membrane and, if necessary, slit the pepper lengthwise twice. Place the peppers in a 13x9 inch baking dish. Bake the peppers, uncovered, for about 20 minutes until they begin to darken and blister and blister slightly. Turn the peppers over. Bake the peppers over for another 7 minutes or until the pepper skins begin to loosen and blister. Remove the peppers from the oven. When cool enough to handle, remove the skins, discard the skins and cut the peppers into wedges. Toss together the peppers with the lettuce, olive oil, wine, parsley, sugar, and cooking oil. Transfer to a bowl and season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Calypso Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 lb of medium noodles | 4 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 teaspoon lime juice, freshly squeezed | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions on package. Drain and rinse with cold water. Set aside. Combine the catsup with the lime juice and vanilla, set aside over low heat just until warm. Add the noodles to a bowl and add the warm catsup mixture. Add the chocolate, mix until melted, and serve.

title: Italian Veggies (For Pizza or Pasta, Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, ends trimmed | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 package dry yeast ( 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 cup italian salad dressing | 1 1/8 cups green peppercorns, coarsely crushed
instructions: Slice zucchini lengthwise into four 6 inch long strips, about half a quarter inch wide. Rinse if you don't want the crunchy tops. In your bread machine pan, combine zucchini, bamboo shoots and yeast in order given. Add salad dressing and green peppercorns. Add more salt if desired. Add the green slices in the order that the bread machine recommends, making sure they are trimmed to fit as evenly into the container as possible. Set to basic or white crust setting. If your machine recommends a light crust, light the crust. Allow the bread to rest in the machine for 5 minutes. If you've refrigerated your bread for at least an hour before using, remove bread from the bread machine, and place on a baking tray to let the bread cool before slicing.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,pinto bean,watercress,wooden skewer,rye flour,savoy cabbage,pepperoni,garlic clove
title: Beef and Cabbage Kebabs
ingredients: 12 wooden skewers, soaked in water for 20 minutes | 600 -700 g ground beef | 3 garlic cloves | 1 bunch fresh savoy cabbage | 1 bunch fresh watercress ( optional ) | 1 can pinto beans | 1 piece pepperoni | 1 tablespoon ritz cracker crumb ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon rye flour ( optional ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh savoy cabbage
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, garlic cloves, savoy cabbage, water, pepperoni, ritz cracker, and optionally chopped savoy cabbage.

title: Mexican Squash and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 medium summer squash, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 cup mild chunky salsa
instructions: Toss squash and mushrooms in a medium bowl with 1/2 cup salsa.

title: The Perfect Garlic Dip
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic, peeled | 2 tablespoons basil, chopped
instructions: Place the cloves of garlic in a small saucepan with a good amount of water and bring to a boil over medium heat. Keep on a gentle boil, then simmer for about 10 minutes, until the water is reduced by half and the garlic is starting to turn a nice golden color. Remove from the heat and add the basil. Let cool and serve this makes about 5 pints. Great for soaking up excess oil, or drizzling over raw vegetables, fish, etc.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,egg,thyme sprig,white miso,kidney bean,farfalle pasta,mung bean sprout
title: Miso and Thyme Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta or 12 ounces bow tie pasta | 2 teaspoons sunflower oil | 6 ounces mung beans ( or other dried white beans ) | 6 sprigs thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 cups cooked kidney beans ( or other dried white bean ) | 4 -6 tablespoons fresh white miso ( i omit this ) | 4 large eggs, beaten to blend
instructions: Cook the farfalle in boiling, salted water until al dente. Meanwhile, cook the mung beans in a pan of boiling water for 5 minutes, or until tender but not mushy. Drain immediately. Drain. Heat the sunflower oil in a large, wide non stick frying pan. Add the bean sprouts and fry over high heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in the beans and thyme and simmer for 1 minute more before adding the pasta. Continue to stir until all the ingredients are mixed and coated with the oil. Fold in the cooked farfalle, adjust seasoning if necessary and stir through the miso. Add the beaten eggs and stir until just mixed through.

title: Guacamole Rye Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 cup packed brown sugar | 1/3 cup water | 12 ounces rye bread, torn into 1 pieces | 2 1/2 cups water | 2 teaspoons dried herbs ( such as oregano, basil or marjoram ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant rice-roasted guacamole | kosher salt
instructions: Combine the brown sugar and the 1/3 cup water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring to dissolve sugar. Add the rye pieces and simmer, tossing occasionally, until golden brown and tender crisp, 15 minutes. Stir in the remaining 3/4 cup water. Remove and discard the rind from the guacamole. Stir in the rice flavored rice oregeno. Top with the remaining guacamole. Sprinkle generously with kosher salt. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,curry powder,meat,eggplant,splenda granular,hot italian sausage,brown mustard seed
title: Samoan-Style Eggplant With Hot Italian Sausage
ingredients: 4 large eggplants | 1/2 lb hot italian sausage | 1/8 teaspoon brown mustard seeds, slightly cracked | 1 1/2 teaspoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon splenda granular, sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice | 2 teaspoons meat or 2 teaspoons chicken stock
instructions: Cut the eggplants lengthwise into 1/4 thick slices. Scoop out flesh from the center of the slices and discard. Rinse slices with cold water, wipe dry thoroughly. Rinse slices with cold water.

title: Oatcakes
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal | 2 shallots | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup masala | 1/2 cup oil
instructions: Mix 1 cup of dry oatmeal with 1/2 cup of cake flour. Mix in the shallots. Heat the oil and pour the batter into the preheated oven at 180°c. Cook for 20 minutes. Cool on a plate. Serve.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,chicken breast half,fire tomato,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chicken meat,celery
title: Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - chopped | 1 teaspoon freshly shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 6 sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 1 can fire-roasted tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1 package rotini pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread chicken breasts with 1 teaspoon cheese onto a large piece of aluminum foil. Sprinkle with chopped celery and sun dried tomatoes. Roll up the sides with the foil and pinch closed. Repeat with other side of the chicken. Arrange slices of chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish and pour sun dried tomatoes over breasts. Cover the dish with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken juices run clear, about 1 hour. Remove from oven and spoon canned tomatoes over the chicken. Pour liquid from can over chicken, cover tightly with aluminum foil, and refrigerate for 1 to 8 hours. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Ravioli With Strawberries
ingredients: 2 loaves round loaves fresh fresh strawberries | 1 package fresh linguine | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 6 tablespoons lemon pepper | 1 bag fresh strawberries | 3/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried lemon pepper
instructions: Cut strawberries in thin slices. Scoop up strawberries and discard the stems. Wash pasta well. Boil until al dente. Drain and set aside. Mix five spice, lemon pepper and lemon juice. Put pasta in a serving bowl, pour cheese mixture over and top with strawberries. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Pastry Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, sifted | 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika
instructions: Add all of the ingredients to your food processor and pulse. Roll the dough out to about 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes with cookie cutters.

Random Ingredients: ghee,spinach leaf,maraschino cherry,white wine,olive,roquefort cheese,chili pepper flake
title: Haricot Verts - Classic Entree!
ingredients: 1 large fresh chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon ghee ( or oil ) | 1 jar marinated olives, sliced | 8 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves ( thawed ) | 2 tablespoons dry white wine ( dry ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons roquefort cheese, crumbled ( or other firm herb grated ) | 8 slices tomatoes ( thick slices )
instructions: Over medium heat, heat the ghee and chili in the oil in a large skillet. Stir in olives and spinach. Cook and stir until spinach wilts and olives are heated through. Stir in wine and re warm to almost boiling. Stir in cheese. Cover and cook for 3 minutes or until cheese is melted. Remove from heat. Place tomato slices on top of each serving. Spoon over sauce before adding toppings. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: peanut sauce,rosemary,orange blossom water,spring onion,onion flake,liquid honey,pasta,kosher salt pepper
title: Olive Garden Sweet Onion Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs sweet onions ( about 6 med-size ) or 1 1/4 lbs sweet onions | 3 tablespoons orange blossom water | 1 packet medium pasta or ( 8 ounce ) packet ziti pasta, cooked al dente following package directions | 3 tablespoons sweet creamy peanut sauce | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons liquid honey | kosher salt and pepper
instructions: Rinse onions and drain well in several changes of water. Slice 1/4 inch thick to make 2 inch squares. Place in bottom of a large serving bowl. Combine 1/4 cup water with orange blossom water in a small bowl or bowl, stir to blend. Pour over onions in bowl and toss to coat. Cover and let sit in fridge until onions soften, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain noodles, remove 1 cup of cooking liquid and cool to touch. Set aside. Place remaining 1/4 cup water, peanut sauce, onion flakes, dried rosemary, honey and salt and pepper to taste in small saucepan. Cook on medium heat until sauce becomes fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add noodles, tossing to coat. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tea,rom tomato,squid,kombu dashi stock,italian salad dressing,cajun seasoning
title: Kombu Soup
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried kombu dashi | 3 packages refrigerated instant ramikataki-style dried squid | 3/4 cup prepared italian-style salad dressing | 1/4 cup teapot flavored tea | 2 cans cut roma tomatoes, drained | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

title: Prawns & Strawberries in Wine & Shrimp Broth
ingredients: 1 can prawns, peeled | 3 tomatoes, small, cut into wedges | 1/2 large red wine, cut in half | 1 package coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup strawberry
instructions: Place prawns and wine in 2 cups of water or wine glass bowl. Bring to boil, then reduce heat.

title: Scotch Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cubed | 1 cup barley | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Place stew beef and barley in a casserole dish, sprinkle with flour. Cover, bake for 1 1/2 hours. Remove and stir. Return to oven and bake for another 1/2 hour or until meat is tender. Place meat on serving dishes and sprinkle with cheese before serving.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,romaine lettuce,pumpkin puree,basil leaf,italian parsley,sage,coriander powder,white bread
title: Tuscan Pumpkin Salad
ingredients: 3 large potatoes, peeled and boiled | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons fresh sage ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander powder | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaves | 4 cups romaine lettuce ( or any soft romaine lettuce ) | 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder
instructions: Cut the potatoes into small cubes. Put into a bowl and sprinkle the golden syrup over them and mix. Finely chop the sage, basil and coriander in a food processor. Add the chopped herbs and process to a fine textured consistency. You can chop and mix all this together before serving, but it is not essential. Taste and adjust seasonings to your preference. Add the potatoes and toss lightly. Taste and adjust seasoning, then sprinkle with the extra syrup if you desire. This can also be served chilled. Variations, the golden syrup makes a nice dipping sauce for a crisp topping.

Random Ingredients: lemon grass,coconut cream,rotini pasta,garlic clove,chunky salsa,tomato ketchup,shrimp,water
title: Tropical Noodles With Shrimp
ingredients: 12 ounces rotini pasta or 12 ounces rotini pasta, uncooked | 2 lbs shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 can tomatoes with ketchup | 2/3 cup thick chunky salsa, plus | 2 tablespoons spicy salsa, plus additional | hot water | 1 stalk lemon grass, chopped | 1 garlic clove, finely shredded | 1/2 cup canned light coconut cream
instructions: Prepare rotini according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, cook shrimp in boiling water for 2 minutes, cut in half lengthwise, remove and set aside. Drain. Transfer shrimp to medium bowl. Add tomato, 4/5 cup of the chunky salsa, water, lemon grass, garlic and the shrimp. Stir well. Let stand 5 minutes or until hotest part of spn. Of garlic is tender. Stir. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes or until shrimp are just heated through.

title: Homemade Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf day old italian bread | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce from chipotle peppers | 1/4 cup vodka, or to taste
instructions: Turn your oven rack in the lowest position, and preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Cut a loaf of bread diagonally into 1 inch thick slices. Place slices in a flat, shallow baking dish and spread with adobo sauce. Turn slices so they evenly cover the bread. Drizzle bread with vodka, or to taste, then sprinkle with additional chips. Let marinate 2 hours in the refrigerator, or overnight. Bake in the preheated oven until nicely browned, about 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,kalamata olive,golden syrup,lemon juice,pork shoulder,tequila,pita bread
title: Chimichurri Pizzas
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | 1 can pimentos, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup tequila | 14 -16 kalamata olives or 14 -16 other brine-cured black olives | 8 pita breads, split in half
instructions: Using sharp scissors, slice the pork crosswise into 1/8in thick slices. Heat 1 tablespoons of the syrup and the lemon juice in a large skillet. Add the pork and cook over medium high heat until a crust forms on the bottom of the pan. Turn the pork slices over and cook until the crust disappears, about 3 - 4 minutes more. Spoon the pork into a baking pan. Spread the pimentos over them and spoon 1/4 cup of the caramelized syrup over. Arrange the olives on top, then top with the pita halves. Spoon reserved caramelized syrup over. Preheat the pizzas, one at a time, under broiler for 1 - 2 minutes, or until the syrup is golden. Serve hot, warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,chicken breast half,chipotle powder,cumin,pine nut,jalapeno
title: The West Chicken
ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 cans chopped mild green chilies | 2 jalapenos, seeded and chopped | 2 cups dry-roasted crushed pineapple nuts | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 2 tablespoons dried chipotle powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Put the chicken in a baking dish and cover with water. Cover with a tight lid and cook in the preheated oven until done, about 1 hour. Remove from dish, and cool slightly. Remove chicken from dish. Reserve heat. In a medium saucepan, combine the chilies, jalapenos, pine nuts, cumin, and chipotle powder. Cook over medium heat until chili is hot and pine nuts are lightly colored. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly. Remove chicken from pan and slice each piece into strips. Set the chicken aside on a plate. Increase the oven temperature to 375 degrees f. Lightly spray a baking dish with cooking spray and place the chicken pieces in it. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is cooked through, about 30 minutes.

title: Fenugreek Chapati
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup dark molasses | 1 tablespoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/4 - 1/3 cup dried apricot, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and grease a baking sheet. Combine all the dry ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Stir in the apricots. Divide dough into half and form into balls. Cover with dry ingredients and press lightly to ensure all the dough is covered. You may also place the dough on parchment paper or aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes. Slice with a pizza cutter on a diagonal and serve immediately.

title: Smoked Salmon Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 800 g skinless smoked salmon | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 cups broccoli florets | 2 cups short-grain rice
instructions: Rinse salmon and dry with absorbent paper for 10 mins. Flake with mallet. Wash rice and soak for 10 mins in cold water. Drain. Place rice, pepper flakes and broccoli in a large pan and heat gently. Place smoked salmon on top, cover and cook at around 175c for 25 mins or until rice is tender and flakes easily. Serve with salad, if desired.

Random Ingredients: gin,ricotta cheese,vanilla powder,pork tenderloin,dark soy sauce,tomato ketchup
title: Chinese Ricard Pork
ingredients: 250 g ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla powder | 400 g canned tomatoes packed in juice | 45 ml gin | 50 ml dark soy sauce | 15 ml tomato ketchup
instructions: Put ricotta and vanilla in a bowl and mix. Add canned tomatoes. Mix well. Add white soy sauce. Mix well. Bake in oven at 160°c. Mix well and let set. Cut into slices. Use any amount of sauce you like. Freeze. When you want it again, take out, place in a storage bag and seal it. It will keep forever.

title: Champagne-Poached Espresso
ingredients: 8 tablespoons espresso coffee ( freshly brewed and hot ) | 1/4 lemon peel, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn-infused decaf or 1/4 teaspoon fresh cracked peppercorn
instructions: Combine cold espresso with lemon peel and ground peppercorns. Pour into tall glasses. Chill well.

Random Ingredients: peanut,garam masala,napa cabbage,chickpea,mango,asafoetida powder,swiss cheese,peach schnapps
title: Spicy Cabbage and  Peaches With Mango Peaches
ingredients: 4 cups shredded napa cabbage | 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 1 can mangoes, drained ( preferably real ripe ) | 1 - 1 1/4 tablespoon peanut butter ( the kind which tastes like cashew spread ) | 4 -5 teaspoons sesame oil or 4 -5 teaspoons peanut oil ( the kind that tastes like peanut oil ) | 4 -6 slices swiss cheese | 4 -6 pinches asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large casserole dish or a large casserole crock. Add sesame oil and mix well. Place wholewheat is best. Cover and bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer for 40 - 45 minutes or until thickened. Sprinkle cheese on top for a light lunch or a side dish. You really can add more mango if you want.

title: Cracker Oil (Shredded Oysters)
ingredients: 12 pieces crackers | cooking oil
instructions: Mix the cracker crumbs and oil together. Place in shaker with about 1/4 teaspoon per shaker. Shake to coat well, shaking the shaker to coat evenly again. Place in a covered tray and refrigerate. Serve with ice cream and a fruit jam glaze. Note if you have any leftovers you can add some to a glass you can just dip the cracker crumbs into as a thick paste after shaking it to coat, or just add the cracker crumbs to a tea ball a couple of tablespoons and dunk into the ice cream. Garnish with a cherry and fresh mint.

title: Spanish Con Queso
ingredients: 2 ounces prosciutto, finely sliced or 2 ounces ham, finely sliced | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon orange zest, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups broth ( chicken or vegetable ) | 5 ounces smoked gouda cheese, shredded ( about 1/1 pound ) | 1/2 cup sliced blanched almond | salt and pepper
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Place the prosciutto and cumin in the skillet and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Add the soup and cook until it boils, about 1 minute. Drain any excess liquid, then season with salt and pepper. Add the gouda to the soup and cook, stirring, over the heat until the gouda is melted, about 1 minute. Turn off the heat and stir in the almonds. Serve.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,tabasco sauce,tahini,cabbage leaf,picante sauce,pork sausage,leg lamb
title: Shrimp Lovers Cocktail with Grilled Lamb, Pork Sausage and Jalapenos
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork sausage, cut into 1/2 inch wide sticks | 5 medium cabbage leaves | 2/3 lb boneless leg of lamb, cut into 3 or 4 pieces | 2 tablespoons tahini | 3 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 cup cooked peeled deveined cooked shrimp
instructions: Grill or broil sausage until fully cooked and crumbly around the edges, 7 to 10 minutes. Allow sausage to cool slightly and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Set aside. Bring 1/2 cup water to a boil in a small, heavy saucepan. Add cabbage and cook until cabbage starts to soften, about 3 minutes. Transfer cabbage to a large serving platter or bowl. Toss pork, cabbage and 1/4 cup tahini until well blended. Spoon mixture over cabbage and stir in hot pepper sauce and picante. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: caper,baking soda,season salt,vegetable oil,taco seasoning mix,yeast
title: Easy Pizza Crust #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages dry yeast | 1 cup vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon yeast | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon garlic salt or 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup capers ( optional ) or 1/2 cup olive ( optional )
instructions: In large pan, mix yeast, oil, seasoning and garlic salt. Sprinkle capers, if using. Add oil, mix and mix well. Let rise until doubled. Bake at 425 for 15 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.

title: Penne with Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3/4 cup penne | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | cayenne pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the penne in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain. Combine the penne and vinaigrette in a large resealable plastic bag, and coat with the cayenne pepper.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,pimiento,horseradish,heavy double cream,beef chuck,cider vinegar
title: Gourmet Hot Dog
ingredients: 4 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1-1/2 inch cubes | 3 lbs pork sausage | 4 teaspoons cider vinegar | 3 quarts heavy double cream | 1/4 cup paprika, paprika must be smoked | 1 jar of drained pimientos | 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish
instructions: Mix together the heavy double cream, paprika with the paprika. Put the beef cubes in large heavy skillet. Place the hotdog over medium high heat, stirring frequently, and let the beef brown, about 10 minutes, then stir in the vinegar. When the cream mixture is simmering, cover the skillet with a lid or a plate. Cook in the oven at 325 degrees for 3 hours, until meat is very tender. Remove the hotdogs from the oven and let them rest for 15 minutes, then add the pimentos. Serve the gourmet gourmet hamburger hotdog on buns.

title: Veal Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cubed | 16 ounces tomato sauce | 1 lemongrass, sliced | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 yellow pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel, candied | tortilla chips
instructions: Combine tomato sauce, lemongrass, cumin, pepper and lemon peel with cubed veal and marinade in a covered container for 2 to 24 hours. Remove meat from marinade and grill over medium heat, turning occasionally for 15 to 20 minutes or until no longer pink in middle and juices run clear. Serve meat over tortilla chips.

title: Penne With Hot-Steamed Pesto and Fresh Peppered Peppered Peppered Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hot water | 4 1/2 cups penne, dried | 1 1/2 cups grated fresh white pepper, from a can | 4 ounces grated fresh peppered cheese
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot. Cook the pasta and italian cheese, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is al dente, about 5 to 6 minutes. Drain pasta in a colander and return to the pot. Toss pasta with the hot water. Add the white pepper to the pasta.

title: Spicy Stuffies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut halves, finely chopped | 2 small cucumbers, finely chopped | 1/2 cup dried small white breadcrumbs, divided | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian sausage, crumbled ( i use mild ) | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 1 can mexicorn, drained ( i use a rotel-canned or mexican-style drained rotel tomatoes with green chilies )
instructions: Add walnuts, cucumbers, bread crumbs, and italian sausage to a bowl and stir to combine.

title: Cuban Black Beans - Vegan
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans, picked over and washed ( may also use brown or white beans ) | 12 slices white bread, cut into 3-4 inch cubes ( see ingredient note ) | 1/4 orange, zest of | 2 tablespoons vegan cheese ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons finely shredded cheese
instructions: Place soaked beans in saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, cover and reduce to low heat. Cook until soft, around 1 1/2 hours, drain beans and reserve cooking liquid. Meanwhile, toast bread cubes in a dry frying pan. Remove and set aside. In a food processor, add beans and zest and puree. Place bread cubes on baking sheets and sprinkle with a tbsp or so of vegan cheese. Cook for a few minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Turn over bread cubes and toast other side. Remove from oven and crumble over a little more vegan cheese. Servings are approximate.

title: Crispy Lids for Shellfish
ingredients: 1 jar plain flour | 2 1/2 ounces lime, rinds removed | 1/2 ounce vinegar
instructions: Combine the flour and lime rind in a large mixing bowl. Add the vinegar and mix quickly to make a soft, dropping dough from spoon into the vinegar. Roll out and cut into about 1½ inch pieces. Heat a griddle, cast iron or other frying pan until it is very hot. Cook the rolls on one side until the bottoms just start to brown, then place one on top of the other. Turn with tongs and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until they are golden brown on both sides, then remove and place on absorbent paper for them to absorb the excess dripping. Serve immediately.

title: Tortilla With Snow Peas
ingredients: 4 large tortillas | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/4 cup sweet white flour | 1/2 teaspoon star anise ( optional ) | 150 g fresh snow peas or 150 g frozen snow pea, defrosted | 3 -6 leaves fresh bean threaders ( optional ) or 3 -6 leaves fresh spinach ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl combine oyster sauce and white flour. Heat a non stick frying pan on a high temperature and coat with oil. Add the star anise and star anise to the pan and heat until bubbling. Turn the heat down to medium. Lightly flour a tortilla and spread evenly with half the sauce. Spread with half the peas. Put a third tortilla on top of the peas and half the bean threads or spinach and spread with the remaining sauce. Fold over the ends and ends of the tortilla and roll to enclose the filling. Cut in half and serve.

title: Homemade Smokies
ingredients: 2 cups tomato bouillon | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper powder ( optional )
instructions: Place bouillon and crushed red pepper in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Stir in the crushed pepper. If using immediately, place on wax paper so that it doesn't stick. Cool, then freeze. To remove this step, store in a covered container or freezer bag.

title: Tarragon Chicken and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 liter chicken or 1 liter vegetable stock | 1 liter long grain rice | 3 teaspoons ground turmeric powder | 300 g white beans, rinsed and drained | 150 g corn, rinsed and drained | 200 g tomatoes, diced | 1 cup mint leaf, loosely packed | 1 teaspoon tarragon, chopped
instructions: Bring the stock to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes or until the stock is reduced by 3/ place the rice in a large bowl pour in the reduced stock and season with half of the turmeric before adding the white beans, corn, corn, tomatoes and half of the mint, tossing to combine. Cover and set aside for 15 minutes to allow the tomatoes to soften. Uncover and mix in the remaining tomatoes. Chill the chicken, cut into bite size pieces and place in a bowl. Spoon the rice onto a separate serving platter, scatter over the mint and scatter over the remaining herbs.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,beef broth,active yeast,pumpkin seed,nuoc nam
title: Pumpkin Seed Bread
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted pumpkin seeds | 3 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups sucan nam ( dark rum ) | 5 tablespoons guoc nam or 5 tablespoons molasses, heated to boiling
instructions: Put the pumpkin seeds in a colander and sprinkle with a little salt to draw out the water, then set aside to drain for about 15 minutes. In a large bowl, mix the flour, yeast and 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons of sugar until well blended. Fold in the seeds, 1 1/2 cups plus 2 tablespoons of the nam and the remaining 3/4 cup plus 1/2 teaspoon of sugar. Turn the dough out onto a work surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes, adding more flour if necessary. Wrap in plastic and let rest for about 30 minutes. Divide dough into 3 pieces and roll each half into an 8 inch long log. Place the rolls on a floured board and cut each in half crosswise to make two 8 or 10 inch long loaves. Place them on greased or parchment covered baking pans and cover with a cloth. Let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk. In a preheated 400°f oven, bake the loaves for 25 to 35 minutes, or until very light golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,shiitake mushroom,bulgur,chow mein noodle,rosemary leaf,veal stock beef,red potato,sea scallop
title: Wildcat's Beef and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean stewing veal or 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin steaks, thinly sliced | cooking spray | 2 1/2 cups thinly sliced shiitake mushrooms ( i leave the stems on, but use whatever the mushrooms are eating, or you can just use regular mushrooms. ) | 2 cups coarsely chopped red potatoes | 1/8 cup sliced roasted garlic-flavored whole mushroom ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary leaves or 2 teaspoons chopped fresh basil | 1 cup bulgar ( cracked wheat or jasmine wheat noodles ) | chow mein noodles, for serving
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.

title: Achovy and Pomegranate Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried pomegranate ( about 30 ) | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 2 cans unsalted anchovies packed in oil, drained | 2 garlic cloves, chopped | red wine ( optional )
instructions: Place dried pomegranates in a small bowl and cover with water. Refrigerate until softened, about 1 hour. Drain. Meanwhile, heat anchovies and garlic in a large saucepan over medium heat until aromatic and just beginning to brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Pour in 2 teaspoons anchovy oil and bring to a boil. Pour in 1 1/2 cups chicken broth. Add the pomegranate juice and pomegranate halves.

title: Artichoke Hearts With Sun-Dried Tomatoes and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 -16 artichoke hearts | 1/4 teaspoon fresh grated nutmeg ( to taste )
instructions: In a medium size heavy skillet, over medium heat, cook, stirring frequently, until hot and brown, about 10 to 12 minutes. Scatter 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg over the hearts of artichokes and set aside while making the sun dried tomatoes the last 2 to 3 minutes of cooking. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cooking onion,vegetable,black pepper,pecorino romano cheese,cream mushroom soup
title: Pizza Appetizer: Little Pizzas
ingredients: 20 small cooked frozen mixed vegetables | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 small cooking onion | grated pecorino romano cheese | black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Place frozen mixed vegetables in a baking dish and pour cream of mushroom soup on top. Bake for 35 minutes or until heated through. Grate pecorino romano cheese and add to pizza. Serve with hot slices of tomato.

title: Swiss-Spiced Twice-Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes, peeled and sliced thin | 1 lb gouda cheese, diced | 1 cup fruit preserves ( kool aid ) or 1 cup preserves ( kool aid ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon or 1 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place sliced potatoes in baking dish. Coat all over with half of the gouda or preserves. Sprinkle with gouda cheese. Heat remaining gouda or preserves in microwave until melted and bubbly. Pour over top and bake in 400°f oven for 30 - 45 minutes or until golden brown and potatoes are crispy.

title: Beilagu
ingredients: 1/4 lb pork or 1/4 lb veal | 1 dozen spaghetti | 1 dozen sprig parsley | 1 dozen pine nuts | 5 ounces cured ham | 10 ounces oil
instructions: Soak spaghetti in water for one hour and boil it rapidly until soft. Cook sausage in a frypan with oil until it is reduced to one piece, then drain and discard oil, and put a little of it away. Cook string of parsley in saucepan with water that had been salted for five minutes. Put sausages and cooked spaghetti into a hot kettle, and cook gently for a few moments, then put on a serving dish and garnish with fried pine nuts. Serve hot.

title: Thai Lemongrass Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup thai sweet & spicy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely minced lemongrass, bottom third only ( about one 1/4-inch piece ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons jalapeno chiles, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh basil leaves
instructions: Heat a small heavy skillet over moderately high heat, swirling skillet occasionally, until just fragrant but not brown, about 3 minutes. Add sweet & spicy sauce, lemon grass and basil and cook, stirring, until sauce returns to a boil, 1 minute longer. Cool to room temperature. Taste for seasoning and adjust if necessary.

title: Tuna Salad With Tahini Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup brown rice syrup | 1/3 cup tahini | 1/2 cup dried mixed fruit | 2 whole ahi tuna, drained
instructions: Stir together rice syrup, tahini, dried fruit and tuna in a saucepan, then heat on low to medium heat. Stir until well blended.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,kidney bean,cheddar cheese,tomato puree,tahini,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese Chicken and Noodle Dip
ingredients: 4 pieces chicken wings | 2 cans kidney beans | 425 g tomato puree | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon chinese five-spice powder | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, grated ( or equivalent. i use a blend of cheeses )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c and line a large, deep baking dish with a lid. Place the chicken wings into the dish and arrange any remaining pieces on top. Mix together the remaining ingredients and pour over the chicken pieces. If it looks like there isn't enough sauce, just a small amount of water and spread all over the chicken, it shouldn't be much. Cover with tin foil and bake for 45 60minutes. Serve with extra cheese and spring onions if desired.

title: Wild Rice, Cucumber and Cucumber Beer
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups wild rice, cooked | 3 cups cucumbers, minced, seeded, peeled and finely dice | 1/3 cup triple sec
instructions: Heat the beer and yeast in a 6 quart stainless steel or glass bowl over medium high heat, stirring and scraping the bottom. When the yeast is foamy, add the rice and mix well. Return the beer to the skillet and add the cucumber. Simmer over low heat until the rice is tender, about 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from the heat, cover and let sit 10 minutes. Stir in the triple sec and serve.

title: Homemade Shiitake Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup yellow mustard seed | 150 g fresh shiitake mushrooms | 3 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: Bring to boil water in a saucepan and boil for 5 minutes or until mushrooms shrink a little. Drain, then dry on a paper towel. Dry mushrooms with your hands over a bowl of cool water. Place mustard seeds into a coffee grinder and grind them into fine powder. Wash and dry mushrooms. Place into a glass jars or other heavy bottom jar. Place mushrooms into jar, cover and seal. Let stand in refrigerator for 2 weeks. Serve cold. Makes about 8 10oz jars.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,canola oil,sugar snap pea,peanut,cheddar cheese,tomato,yogurt,roast beef
title: Beef and Vegetables in Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 450 g sliced roast beef | 400 g low-fat yogurt, plain ( non-fat is okay ) | 1 teaspoon sugar snap pea, finely sliced | 1 tomatoes, peeled and finely chopped | 200 g small sugar snap peas, trimmed | 1/3 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Heat 2 teaspoons of the oil and the canola oil in a large non stick frying pan. Sear the meat for 3 - 4 minutes, or until lightly charred. Remove to a plate. Heat the yogurt and sugar snap peas in a large saucepan over a medium low heat for 7 - 8 minutes or until hot. Add beef and remaining oil, stir and cook for 3 minutes, or until well cooked. Remove to a plate. Add remaining vegetables, remaining yogurt, sugar snap peas and cheese. Stir to combine and heat through just before serving.

title: Red Pepper and Serrano Pepper Puree
ingredients: 3 serrano peppers, or more to taste | 1 red bell pepper, finely diced
instructions: Place serrano peppers, or more to taste, and red bell pepper into a blender.

title: Tasso De Palapa - Poblano Apples
ingredients: 2 large tart cooking apples | 1/2 cup ketchup | poblano chile, seeded and cut into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Wash the tart cooking apples by placing them on a baking sheet and placing them in the oven, and leave them for twenty minutes. Open the tart cooking apples and put them into a large bowl. Combine the ketchup and the 1/2 cup of water. Peel out the outer leaves and slice them in half. In a small bowl, mix the remaining water and the chile strips. Pour the water dressing mixture over the apples and toss. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: catsup,tortilla chip,semolina,red bell pepper,saffron,green chile paste
title: Mexican Fried Rice Nachos (Arrozones Con Queso)
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili paste | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 14 ounces tortilla chips | 3 -6 tablespoons catsup ( your own ) | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1 green chile, seeded and chopped
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add chili paste and saffron to pan. Reduce heat to medium, add tortilla chips and cook until golden, about 3 minute. Add 3 - 4 tbs. Catup, bell pepper strips and remaining ingredients. Heat thoroughly. Serve warm.

title: Chilled Lemon, Tarragon & Almonds Kugel
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( freshly squeezed or fresh squeezed ) | 1/4 teaspoon low-fat powdered imitation dried tarragon or 1/4 teaspoon rosemary, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup slivered almonds | 1/4 cup sweetened salsa, more to taste ( more to taste ) | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted ( see note in description ) | 2 tablespoons cake flour ( or all-purpose flour or cornstarch, see note in description )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Lightly spray baking sheet with cooking spray.

title: Mexican Style Corn in a Snap
ingredients: 1 package frozen whole kernel corn | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to a simmer. Cook until the corn is tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from heat. Serve with crackers.

title: Magrets of India #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato, scrubbed | 7 ounces almond meal | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated limes or 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 ounce grand marnier
instructions: In the microwave, cook the potato with salt until just soft, 15 - 20 minutes. Drain. Rinse and dry potatoes with paper towl and let dry out for 5 minutes. Heat 1/2 tbsp of oil in a sauté pan. Spread half of the potatoes into the hot oil.

title: Baked Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 tablespoon chopped orange zest | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon sherry
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Rinse the bean sprouts under cold water to remove any residual sand. Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add orange zest and remove from heat. In a deep bowl, stir together the rice wine or sherry and sprout juice. Arrange bean sprouts in the oiled baking pan. Bake for 20 minutes, or until crisp and browned.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,vanilla bean,guacamole,heavy whipping cream,sesame seed
title: Guacamole Dessert Aloha
ingredients: 8 tablespoons smooth peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 1/3 cup guacamole
instructions: In a mini chopper combine peanut butter and heavy cream. Add vanilla and bean. Srinkle over sesame seeds. Cover and chill in fridge for at least 1 hour. Serve with guacamole.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,chipotle chile adobo,pasta sauce,confectioner sugar,clear honey,italian parsley
title: Sweet and Sour Chipotle Pasta
ingredients: 4 ounces pasta sauce, any brand is fine, bottled type | 4 ounces clear honey | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 3 tablespoons of chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/2 teaspoon minced chipotle chile in adobo | 1/4 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves, and then bring to the boil, stirring until the sauce thickens and the honey dissolves. Transfer the sauce to a bowl, mix in the confectioner's sugar if using. Cook the pasta in lots of boiling water, following the instructions on the packet. This will remove any residual oil and tenderness from the pasta when finished cooking. Serve immediately. Suggested dippers, mushrooms, baby broccoli, chopped chicken, red capsicum, baby corn, chopped onion and sliced prawns, etc. Also suggested is marinated cucumber, zucchini, green beans and sliced onion. Also suggested cooking fresh tomatoes for added protein. This may also be served with other flavours such as fresh tomatoes and salsa.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,red lentil,rosemary sprig,mayonnaise,roast beef,apricot jam,bean sprout
title: Roast Beef and Bean Sprouts (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low-fat mayonnaise, can also use reduced fat | 1/4 cup dried red lentil | 2 large fresh rosemary sprigs, stems removed, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 lb lean roast beef, thinly sliced | 1 can mixed beans sprouts | 1 1/3 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f spray a 2 qt or larger baking dish with cooking spray. Spread mayonnaise on top of dried red lentils and sprinkle with rosemary. Cut beef diagonally across grain into very thin slices. Lay beef slices atop lentil mixture. Spread jam over beef and top with beansprouts. Mix flour and remaining 1/4°c oil in a shallow bowl. Add flour mixture to beef in batches, tossing well to blend. Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until beef begins to brown on sides. Transfer beef to a cutting board and slice into serving portions. Spoon beef and bean sprouts among beef.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,jalapeno pepper,pistachio,curry leaf,crouton,chicken stock,greek yogurt
title: Curried Yogurt
ingredients: 1/4 cup thick greek yogurt | caster sugar, to taste | 1/2 cup fresh curry leaf, soaked and chopped ( green ) | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon pistachios, chopped | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 2 -4 tablespoons pistachios, for garnish | crouton, for serving
instructions: Mix the yoghurt with the sugar in a bowl. Strain through a fine sieve over a bowl and discard solids. In a small saucepan, combine the curry leaves with the chicken stock and bring to the boil, then simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in the pistachios and simmer until the pistachios are just tender. Pour half of the yoghurt mixture into a serving bowl. Use a slotted spoon to dip the sprout into the hot coconut oil. Then top with the remaining yoghurt mixture and sprinkle with the chopped peanuts and coriander. Serve with fresh bread to mop up the sticky yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: lemon,ladyfinger,bacon dripping,white wine,cream celery soup,salad green,parmesan cheese,dill
title: Danish Style Salisbury Steak
ingredients: 1 teaspoon bacon drippings | 1 pound round steak | 1 teaspoon grated parmesan cheese | 1 package frozen mixed salad greens, thawed | 2 cans condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 lemon, sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rub bacon drippings into steak slices on all sides. Place meat in a large pot and coat with about 1 teaspoon parmesan cheese. Place in preheated oven and bake at 350 degrees f for about 15 minutes. Mix salad greens with cream of celery soup and the remaining 1/2 teaspoon parmesan cheese. Spread a layer of salad greens on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange 2 slices of the steak over the greens, then pour 1/2 of the soup mixture over the steak. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for about 30 minutes, or until steak is cooked and the cheese is melted and bubbly. Sprinkle with fresh dill and parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,russet potato,white onion,angel hair pasta
title: Baked Angel Hair Pasta-Style
ingredients: 4 medium russet potatoes, sliced | 1 small white onion, sliced | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 3/4 cup cooked angel hair pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange potatoes in a single layer in a baking dish. Arrange onion in a single layer over potatoes. In a small bowl, stir together baking powder with enough water to make a batter. Drizzle batter over onions.

title: Spicy Lamb Chops
ingredients: 3 lamb loin chops | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 4 ounces smoked bacon, finely chopped | 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms | 1/3 cup guacamole
instructions: Slice chops in half lengthwise. Drain. Sprinkle chops with 3/4 cup cheese and 1 t. Bacon. Place on a plate. Combine 1/3 cup cheese and 1 t. Bacon. Spread evenly over chops. Place mushrooms over cheese. Spread 1/3 c guacamole over mushrooms. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Heat in 350 f. Oven until bacon is crisp, about 13 minutes.

title: Cashews and Raisins
ingredients: 2 cups raw cashews ( about 4 ounces ) | 1 1/2 cups golden raisins | 1/4 cup margarine, melted
instructions: Spread the cashews on a small baking sheet. Sprinkle with the raisins. Add the margarine and toss till the cashews are evenly coated. Serve warm.

title: Smothered Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 lb boneless round steak, cut in 4 sections ( swiss cut into strips ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili ( i use new mexico style red chili powder ) | 1/4 teaspoon tobasco sauce
instructions: Place steak in a 13x9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle half of the salt over the top of the steak and drizzle with half the chile powder.

Random Ingredients: semolina,passion fruit juice,bibb lettuce leaf,kielbasa,raisin,onion soup mix,cream
title: Schaumaka
ingredients: 1/2 cup semolina | 1/4 cup raisins | 4 bibb lettuce leaves | 2 packages dry onion soup mix | 1 pint cream | 1 tablespoon seedless passion fruit juice | 8 -10 kielbasa, slices - for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat boiler to 300 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine semolina, raisins, and bruschetta in a medium bowl. Cut lettuce off leaves in a flat circular shape by cutting at 1/2 inch intervals, keeping the center of the lettuce covered with a moist cloth. Place half of the bundle of soup mix on top of the semolina layer in a small bowl. Add 2 1/2 cups of the cream and passionfruit juice to the bowl and beat until well blended.. Spread the mixture evenly over the lettuce on the baking sheet. Fold the remaining lettuce in half over the top of the mixture, making sure that the filling is totally closed inside. Pour the remaining cream on top. Sprinkle kielbasa slices over the top. Bake 1 hour, until edges of the mixture are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,kidney bean,mandarin orange,baby spinach,nutritional yeast
title: Mandarin Spinach & Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 5 ounces canned mandarin oranges, drained | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained, but retain juices | 1 cup canned bamboo shoots, drained ( drained weight ) | 1 bag baby spinach
instructions: Make dressing by mixing all ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,black bean,garlic salt,chunky peanut butter,cayenne pepper,cardamom pod,corn
title: African Peanut Chili in a Snap
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans ( i like california beans best ) | 2 red peppers, seeded & roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons corn, roasted | 1 tablespoon jarred roasted cayenne pepper ( add more if you like it hotter ) | 2 tablespoons chunky style peanut butter ( i use peanut oil but you can use creamy peanut butter that has no nitrates ) | 1 tablespoon cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Place beans in large bowl and cover with 2 cups water. Leave at least an hour or more, or even longer. Drain and rinse the beans. Place the black beans and the red peppers in the last minute of soaking. Add the remaining ingredients, stir, cover and simmer for about 1 hour. You could also let this simmer in a crockpot or on low for about 6 hours. The chutney should be fairly thick and the chili a little smoother.

title: Turnip and Sage Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch turnip | 1 bunch fresh sage leaves
instructions: Wash and clean the turnip with a vegetable brush. Rinse and remove any skin that is still attached at the stem. Slice into about 2 inch pieces, and place into a medium bowl. Cut the leaves from the sage and throw away. Put the sage leaves into a small, dry skillet. When golden in color, add the sage leaves and allow them to sweat until they are golden.

title: Ribollita (Italian Vegetable Salad)
ingredients: 2 packages sliced napa cabbage | 1 bag sliced fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 seedless cucumber, diced | 1 jar marmalade | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 romaine lettuce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Shred cabbage and set aside. Place mushrooms in a large bowl, then layer with cabbage, cucumber, and 1 teaspoon marmalade. Top with remaining marmalade, saffron, and 1/4 cup rind from lettuce. Serve immediately, or refrigerate up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: corn niblets,red onion,brown lentil,potato,pine nut,kernel corn,mint,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Lentil & Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown lentils | 1/4 cup sweet potato, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup corn niblets, canned drained | 1/4 cup corn kernel ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped | 2 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Place lentils, sweet potato, corn niblets and corn kernel in a large saucepan of boiling water, reduce heat to low and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes or until soft. Lentils may be prepared and chilled up to 2 days ahead. Drain well and spread on a baking sheet, sprinkle with pine nuts, onion slices and mint, then sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 475 degrees f for about 20 minutes or until bubbly and heated through.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese soup nacho,mace,yellow pea,chambord raspberry liquor,oyster,rosemary leaf,baby carrot
title: Pea-Vegetable Fondue
ingredients: 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup ( or nacho cheese ) | 1 teaspoon chambord raspberry liquor | 1/2 teaspoon fresh rosemary leaves, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 cups yellow split peas | 3 small baby carrots | 1/2 cup chambord frozen miniature oysters, thawed
instructions: In a 2 - 2 1/2 qt saucepan, combine soup with remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: eye roast,tangerine,oil lard,tex mex cheddar cheese,piri,curry powder
title: Roasted Tangerine on the Grill Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 eye of round roast | 1 1/2 tablespoons tex-mex cheddar cheese | 4 -6 small tangerines | 1/2 teaspoon prepared piri-piri | 1/2 teaspoon oil-flavored lard, melted | 1 dash curry powder
instructions: Preheat broiler on both sides and set oven rack about 6 inch up from the broiler element. Remove the eye of round roast from the oven and dry it on two layers of paper towels. Place the roast on a piece of waxed paper and using your hands, squeeze out any excess moisture that may occur. Cut the roast into 2 equal pieces. Cut the tangerines into 1 thick segments. Arrange the tangerines and 1/2 teaspoon piri piri dressing or the melted lard in a shallow dish. Arrange the pieces of roast on top of the tangerine mixture and brush with more dressing. Sprinkle the roast with the remaining piri piri dressing. Place on a rack in a broiler and broil for 25 - 30 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. Slice the sandwich open and serve.

Random Ingredients: deli roast beef,kielbasa,pecan,swiss cheese,baking powder,sirloin,poblano pepper,soy sauce
title: Quick and Easy Swiss Beef and Poblano Sandwiches
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh, sliced sirloin | 3/4 lb sliced deli roast beef | 1 package kielbasa | 2 tablespoons pecan pieces | 3 -4 cups sliced swiss cheese | 3/4 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 poblano pepper, sliced thinly
instructions: Trim all fat from sirloin. Slice into 1/2x4/8 inch strips. Slice into 1/2 inch thick strips. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat 2 minutes. Add beef, meat, kielbasa and pecan pieces. Stir to combine. Stir in the soy sauces. Cover, reduce heat to medium low. Simmer 15 - 20 minutes, until meat is tender. Stir in the poblano. Heat 2 - 3 minutes. Slice diagonally in half. Serve with hoisin sauce, if desired.

title: Cameroon
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 2 -3 dashes garlic paste | 1 package flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups water
instructions: Brown and drain ground chuck. Add garlic, tomato sauce, water or beef broth and simmer until meat and vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,artichoke heart,cheddar cheese,chipotle chile adobo,potato starch,shiitake mushroom,white bread,turnip
title: Chipotle Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 large potato wafer, about 1 quart | 3/4 cup tomato paste | 1 can artichoke hearts, preferably packed in oil, drained, and quartered | 1/2 cup diced turnip | 1/4 cup mushroom ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chipotle chiles in adobo, minced ( i use 1, and 1 or 2, depending on your heat level ) | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons shiitake dried mushrooms | 2 tablespoons clear-floating bread or 2 tablespoons leftovers french bread, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. Cut the potato wafer into 1 inch chunks. Place wafer in a large bowl. Cover with water, and let soak 30 minutes. Drain and pat dry. In a small bowl, blend all marinade ingredients. Drain the potato wedges, and pat lightly with paper towels. Coat with the marinade. Place wedges on a greased baking sheet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes and allow to cool slightly. Top with the artichokes, turnips, and mushrooms. Bake 10 to 15 minutes until edges are crisp and golden. Remove and let cool 2 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter, and sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons of cheddar cheese and dried mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,red chile,chocolate,american cheese,balsamic vinegar,seasoning salt,lemon,plain flour
title: Chile Dogs
ingredients: 200 g plain flour or 200 g gluten-free flour | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated lemon rind | 100 g shaved american cheese ( or gouda cheese ) | 1 red chile, seeded | 1 tablespoon chopped chilie fresh chiles or 1 tablespoon fresh cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons grated lemon rind | 2 teaspoons grated american cheese | 125 g chile, cut into thin strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c or 160°c fan forced. To make the balsamic and chile seasoning combine all the ingredients and mix well. Pour mixture into a large bowl. Using your hands, mix together everything until a slightly sticky dough is formed. Divide dough into 4 equal portions. Knead each portion of dough into a circle approximately 20 cm in diameter and about 1 1/2 cm thick. Place on a lightly floured tray. With a 2cm round cutter, stamp out 4 circles that are about 5cm in diameter. Place 1 tablespoon of the cheese on each circle. Fold the circle to enclose the cheese. Repeat with the remaining circles to create little circles, brushing the dough each with a milk or water brush. Cook in batches. Remove onto the paper to cool. Repeat process for each batch as you finish. To bake the puffs, place the puffs on an oven tray. Bake for 10 minutes meanwhile, brush each with a milk or water brush.
