Heat a small frying pan over medium heat. Add the chile and cheese. Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 - 3 minutes, or until cheese melts.

Random Ingredients: white flour,chicken meat,dark soy sauce,fish,vinegar,plain yogurt
title: Vindaloo Chicken
ingredients: 500 g chicken meat, cut-up | 100 ml water from a chicken, and a teaspoon of dark soy sauce | 100 g plain yogurt | 100 g white flour | 3 tablespoons fish or 3 tablespoons coriander | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Simmer chicken pieces with water, soy sauce and vinegar for 40 minutes until tender. Mix together all the ingredients and serve.

title: Sauce for Lamb, Chicken or Pork
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 3 tablespoons minced fresh tarragon
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together eggs, flour, bouillon powder and tarragon. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the sauce over the top. Cover and chill up to 2 hours. Stir well before serving at once.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,pork loin roast,black pepper,bean sprout,cocoa powder,celery
title: Mama Chi's Slow Cooker Pork and Beans
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1/2 lb pork loin, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 cup celery, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground black pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder ( preferably dutch-process )
instructions: Place pork and pork in a 5 quart slow cooker. If there are any excess fat in the meat the next layer should be on the bottom. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper and 1 tablespoon cocoa. Top with celery, bean sprouts, remaining 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. In a small bowl, combine 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa and 1 pinch of salt. Pour over pork. Cover and cook on low heat setting about 6 hours or on high heat setting 2 1/2 hours. Remove string and shred. Serve pork mixture over cooked white rice.

title: Simple Beef and Kiwi Soup (Tirk Khai)
ingredients: 750 g sirloin steak, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce ( or soy sauce to taste ) | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 600 ml reduced-sodium beef broth | fresh fruit ( kiwi fruit, pineapple, apricots, mangoes or any citrus fruit you would like ) | 5 ounces frozen spinach
instructions: In a large stockpot over medium heat, combine the steak with oyster sauce, caster sugar, broth and sugar.

title: Green Beans and Pistachios (Boko Khudar)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans | 1/2 cup shelled roasted pistachios ( can be found in the asian food section )
instructions: Wash the beans thoroughly. Cut away the tips from the tips, cut away stringy tips and slice into 1 1/2 inch lengths, and toss them with enough water to cover. In a large wok or heavy skillet, arrange 2 to 3 cups of water, add the beans and bring to a boil. Partially cover and allow to cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the beans are done, about 15 minutes. Remove the lid and simmer over high heat for one minute. Stir in 1/2 cup of nuts and remove from heat. Cover and allow to stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Fruit Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g mixed fruit, such as oranges, mango, grapes, berries, pears, mangoes, melon cubes and pineapple ( try to have everything quite ripe, or a variety of fruits ) | 1 teaspoon sesame paste | 1 teaspoon sweet basil pesto | 1 -2 lemon, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 cup finely grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Drain the fruit and peel away thick skin and any undesirable pieces of fruit, and place all of them in a resealable plastic bag. Add all the other ingredients, together in sequence if you are using the cheese, blend until smooth. Add all the cheese in thirds.

title: Real Tequila Sorbet
ingredients: 2 cups golden tequila | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 teaspoon cumin seed
instructions: Mix tequila, vinegar, vanilla, and cumin seeds together in a large pitcher.

title: Sauce Queens' Style
ingredients: 16 ounces table cream | 2 tablespoons serrano peppers, finely chopped ( preferably poblanos )
instructions: Using a whisk or rubber spatula, stir together the cream and minced chiles. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,anchovy paste,sunflower oil,cannellini bean,saffron,aluminum foil
title: Anchovy Bean and Anchovies Wrapped in Aluminum Wraps
ingredients: 400 g anchovies packed in oil | 400 g cannellini beans | saffron | 10 -20 sheets aluminium foil | 1 -2 teaspoon madras curry powder | 4 -5 tablespoons sunflower oil
instructions: Soak anchovies in water for 15 minutes drain, pat dry. Cut beans in half and deseed if desired. Place each half on one side of a square of aluminium foil, sprinkle with salt and cover with about 3 or 4 tablespoons of madras curry. Sprinkle a few drops of saffron around each to seal. Bake in hot oven for a further 15 minutes. Cut the foil in half and use the rest to roll up the packages. Cut into 8 or 10 portions and steam in the steamer for 15 minutes. To make them crispy, unwrap on a tray covered with baking paper and return to the stove for a few minutes or to make them brown on the inside.

title: Avocado and Crab Ceviche
ingredients: 1 ripe avocado, divided | 1 head napa cabbage, torn into bite-size pieces | 1 small red chile, finely chopped | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 16 large fresh shrimp, cleaned | 1/2 cup cumin seed | 8 sprigs fresh seaweed ( optional )
instructions: Halve avocado flesh, keeping the skin on. Cut a slit lengthwise down the center and remove the pit. Place avocado flesh with a scoop of avocado pulp and a handful of napa cabbage in a bowl. Break apart with your fingers as needed. Sprinkle with chopped chili and toss to coat. Add cream, mix, and refrigerate to allow flavors to develop. Slice remaining avocado flesh into bite size pieces and chop finely. Remove cumin seeds from a mortar and grind with cumin. Toss avocado crab chunks and cilantro in a bowl with a spoonful of cream. Place shrimp in a large heavy bottomed frying pan or casserole. Scrub cilantro, including the sprigs of cilantro, into the same frying pan. Add cumin seeds and salt and freshly ground black pepper. Place a sprig of cilantro and 1/2 of the avocado on the shrimp. Top with the crab avocado mixture, and press gently to submerge all shrimp in cream. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cover, and immediately reduce heat to low. Simmer 30 minutes, and test after 10 minutes of cooking at 1 minute. Stir, then cover and continue cooking for 15 minutes. Check shrimp, and add more cream if needed, or boil for five minutes. To serve, sprinkle with cumin seeds and remaining avocado slices and garnish with the extra lime slices.

title: Greek Surprise
ingredients: 1/3 cup gelatin | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped ( pitted if desired ) | 1 1/2 cups turkey sausage or 1 1/2 cups other hot cooked deli turkey sausage, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | salad greens
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in 1/2 cup of cream in a small bowl. Place in a small saucepan with remaining cream, remaining gelatin, olives, sausage and greens on high heat, stirring gently. When bubbles appear on top, remove from heat and stir. Pour over a serving platter and serve immediately. Tip, add a few teaspoons of hot water to the gelatin before pouring into a measuring cup. Pour equal amounts of gelatin onto a plate and use it as an ice cream cone instead of a measuring cup.

title: Crispy Basil Noodles
ingredients: 1 package uncooked rice noodles | 1 cup basil ( coarsely chopped ) | 2 tablespoons crushed pickle juice
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain and rinse with cold water, drain. Place noodles in a single layer on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Cover with vented plastic wrap, then sprinkle with basil and garlic powder. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 to 12 minutes or until tender.

title: Blueberry & Mint Chardonnay Sauce
ingredients: 14 ounces cremini mushrooms, cleaned, caps left whole | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves, minced | 1/4 cup fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shaved | 7 ounces blueberries or 7 ounces strawberries
instructions: Put mushrooms, mint, pepper, shaved cheese and the berries into food processor or blender and mix until combined. Pour into small bowl and serve.

title: Champurrado (Mexican Coffee Mix)
ingredients: 1 -2 scoop espresso | 1 lime wedge | tortilla, warmed
instructions: Place the avocado in a small, shallow dish. Drizzle liqueur over the avocado. Serve immediately alongside.

title: Spicy French Onion Dip for Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili paste | 2 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon chili paste on chili bean or 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Mix the spicy sauce with the non fat and chili paste and refrigerate for a while. Serve with corned beef, boiled potatoes, etc.

title: Czech Inspired Beef Salad with Orange Peels in It!
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 small onion, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon table salt | 1/2 cup granulated onion juice | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained and squeezed well | 2 -3 tablespoons broccoli florets, cooked and cold | 1/2 - 1 head napa cabbage, cored ( optional )
instructions: In a medium frying pan brown ground beef with onions and salt, stirring until no longer pink. Pour off any excess fat except for about 2 t. Stir remaining ingredients into beef mixture.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,porcini mushroom,pork shoulder,currant,feta cheese,bread crumb
title: Coconut Beef
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, thinly sliced | 2 cups dry bread crumbs | 2 packages dried currants | 1 jar coconut milk | 1 package feta cheese, crumbled | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh porcini mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a small baking dish with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Place chicken on the prepared baking dish and top with 1/2 cup bread crumbs and 1/2 cup currants. Bake in the preheated oven for about 25 minutes. Meanwhile, bring coconut milk to a boil in a large skillet. Remove from heat, but keep warm. Layer bread crumbs, feta cheese and porcinis in a large bowl. When 20 minutes are up, remove from oven and stir in the remaining crumbs. Drizzle the coconut milk over the top. Serve with hot, crusty french bread.

title: Citrus Polenta
ingredients: 3 cups coarse yellow cornmeal ( for polenta ) | 1 can whole raspberries, drained | 1/2 cup shredded colby-jack cheese | 3 ounces frozen sweetened raspberries
instructions: Prepare polenta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. When cool enough to handle stir cornmeal into polenta with fingers. Add frozen raspberries and cheese and mix thoroughly. Transfer polenta to a 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Cover and refrigerae overnight. Bake in preheated 400 f oven about 45 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,crookneck yellow squash,bean sprout,parmesan cheese,wheat linguine,mirin,egg beater substitute
title: Vegetable Linguine With Noodle Flavored Scallop Filling
ingredients: 8 ounces whole wheat linguine | 1 cup egg substitute | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 2 cups thinly sliced crookneck yellow squash | 1 1/4 cups chopped fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions for al dente. In a large bowl, stir egg substitute with cardamom seed until well mixed. Add white mushrooms, squash and pasta.

Random Ingredients: baby shrimp,romaine lettuce leaf,cabbage,macadamia nut,nigella seed,oxtail,feta cheese,coleslaw mix
title: Tropical Beef and Nigella Salad
ingredients: 4 oxtails, cut into 2 inch pieces | 4 cups mixed baby shrimp | 8 cups shredded cabbage | 1 package crumbled reduced-fat feta cheese | 1 bag coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coconut nuts | 1/3 cup nigella seeds, or to taste ( optional ) | 10 romaine lettuce leaves, torn
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add oxtails. Reduce heat and simmer until meat is cooked through, about 12 minutes. Drain meat, and place in a bowl. Break apart oxtails with a fork. In a large mixing bowl, combine meat, shrimp, cabbage, feta cheese, coleslaw mix, coconut nuts, and nigella seeds. Toss with warm, drained beef mixture. Garnish with lettuce leaves.

title: Italian Eggplant-Mushroom Casserole for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 eggplant, sliced | 6 button mushrooms, sliced | 2/3 cup italian dressing, divided | 1/4 cup sweet sherry | 1/4 cup half-and-half | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 tablespoons barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil or parchment paper, or lightly spray with cooking spray. Arrange sliced eggplant and sliced mushrooms in a layer on the bottom of the baking dish.

Random Ingredients: pasta noodle,strawberry,pimento pepper,carrot,yellow mustard,mexican tomato sauce
title: Simple Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package dry pasta noodles | 1 can mexican-style tomato sauce | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 3 pimento pepper slices, chopped | 1 carrot, shredded | 1/4 cup chopped fresh strawberries
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Mix the pasta into the sauce, and refrigerate until the salad components are chilled, 8 hours to overnight. Drain the noodles, reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid, and place them in a large salad bowl. In a separate bowl, stir together the tomato sauce, diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, pimento peppers, and shredded carrot. Pour over the salad, and toss to blend. Sprinkle with the reserved pasta cooking liquid, and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Feta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 200 g feta cheese, crumbled | 300 ml tomato puree
instructions: Blend all the ingredients together in a blender and puree. Put into a bowl and serve.

title: Stuffed Pineapple
ingredients: 1 pineapple, ripe | 500 g ready-made beef gravy ( or your own ) | 2 tablespoons caper berries ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chives ( chopped ) | 250 g sourdough bread
instructions: Slice off the top of the pineapple leaving about 1 cm of headspace. Cut a small, round hole in the base with your thumb, keeping the core intact. Place equal amounts of gravy and caper in each hollow. Scoop out most of the pulp, then spoon the stuffing into each hollow and serve with the sourdough.

title: Fiery Spanish Rice
ingredients: 4 cups veal stock | 1 cup medium grain rice | 2 small cloves | 1 pimento, cut in thin strips ( optional )
instructions: Pour the stock into a saucepan and set to very high heat. Add the rice and cloves. Simmer until the liquid is absorbed. Reduce the heat as low as you can and cover tightly with a thick paper. Leave for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and leave to stand for 10 minutes. Remove the paper and cloves and discard. Place the pimento in a small dish and leave to soften. When cool, mix into the rice. Stir with a fork to combine. The easiest way to do this is to pull the rice out of the bowl and then lightly fluff up with a fork. Serve, with your favourite red table wine and sauvignon blanc. This does have excellent flavour when eaten straight from the dish.

title: Thai Pepperoni Fonduta
ingredients: 1 package gruyere cheese | 1 jar pepperoni or ( 1 1/2 ounce ) jar ham ( about 4 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons coarse grainy mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 2 teaspoons fresh ground pepper, to taste | 1/1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: In a fondue pot that has been set at the very lowest setting, stir together the gruyere cheese and pepperoni until evenly melted. Transfer the cheese to a bowl. In a small bowl, mix remaining ingredients. Add cheese and pepperoni to fondue pot over low heat. Serve warm.

title: Jamaican Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 can apple juice | 1 can chicken juice | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into bite-sized cubes | 2 bananas, julienned | 3 radishes, peeled and sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 lime
instructions: Combine applesauce, chicken juice, beef cubes, bananas, radishes, and allspice in a large pot. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 2 hours. Serve over steamed jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,vegetable oil,parsley sprig,broccoli floret,cottage cheese,marjoram
title: Broccoli Puree
ingredients: 3 cups low fat cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley and basil leaves | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage leaves | freshly minced marjoram | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | freshly minced parsley sprig ( optional )
instructions: In a food processor, combine the cottage cheese with the herbs and process until mixture is smooth. With the machine running, pour the oil into the mixture, followed by the parsley, if using, and process until mixture is the consistency of small peas. Spoon into a shallow serving dish, and decorate with the extra grated parmesan or fresh herb if desired. Cover, and refrigerate 30 minutes or up to 1 day before serving.

title: Pate a la Founter (Potato, Chicken and Chicken)
ingredients: 2 potatoes | 4 chicken
instructions: Cut the chicken into portions, skin the pieces and bone them. Make pieces of the chicken and potatoes to fit into a fry pan. Heat the pan over medium, turning frequently. When the mixture is heated, pour it into a flameproof casserole or pie dish. Smear the surface of the mix over the top of the potatoes and chicken. Cook in a preheated oven at 220ºc for 30 minutes, turning once. Serve with cream or cream cheese and mustard.

title: Blackberry and Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck | 1 jar black beans, rinsed & drained | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup dried dill or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill | 1/2 cup dried basil | 3 cups ice water | fresh dill ( or parsley flakes-optional )
instructions: Place chuck in a large sauce pan & add water to cover meat. Bring to boiling over high heat, skimming any foam. Remove from heat, cover & allow to cool. Remove excess fat from meat & discard. Chop meat & set aside, discarding any fat. Drain beans & raisins & set aside. In a large sauté pan, heat the basil, & garlic, stirring occasionally, until garlic is golden, about 2 minutes. Add the broth & meat. Bring to boiling, then reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, or until meat is fork tender. Remove from heat. Remove the lid & skim off any extra fat from top if desired. Stir in dill & basil, then serve.

title: Sweet Appetizer Fruit Compote
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable, such as walnut oil or 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 large melonger, peeled, cut into 1-inch pieces ( nectarines ) | 1/2 cup assorted fresh vegetables, such as sweet potatoes, turnips etc
instructions: In a 3 quart pan heated to 350 degrees f, warm 1 tablespoon oil. Add 1 teaspoon butter, 2 to 3 tablespoons water and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Working quickly, nestle fruits into oil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, just until fruits are cooked but still slightly chewy. This should take 25 to 30 minutes. If necessary, add more water to maintain consistency. The compote should be thick but still chunky in texture and color. Adjust seasonings.

title: Chocolate Sauce for Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 lb of chopped fresh tomatoes with juice or 1 lb canned tomatoes, pureed | 1 -2 fresh serrano pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Combine all ingrediences in saucepan. Heat through.

Random Ingredients: dashi,greek yogurt,pico de gallo,green pepper,yogurt,oregano,cake,white pepper
title: Dynamite Dip (Sushi)
ingredients: 1 cup pico de gallo | 3/4 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/2 cup low fat sour yogurt | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | freshly ground white pepper, to taste | 1 pinch dashi ( optional ) | 10 slices frozen bread or 10 slices frozen bread | 3 medium green peppers ( optional ) or 3 medium peppers ( optional )
instructions: Using a large bowl, combine the pico de gallo, greek yogurt, sour cream, oregano and white pepper. Set aside 1/2 cup for dipping. Spread the remaining 1/2 cup of pico de gallo mixture in a small dish or serving platter and top with white pepper. Dip the bread into the yogurt mixture, allowing it to soak on both sides. Slice the sliced bread into 1 inch cubes and place the cubes on top of the pico de gallo. Garnish with vegetables of your choice.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,manchego cheese,pearl barley,rice paper,mint extract,bamboo shoot,rosemary,garlic scape
title: Hawaiian Sweet Roll With Pineapple-Chimichurri Rice Paper
ingredients: 1 box plain rice paper sheets | 2 cans pineapple chunks | 2 cups manchego cheese, shredded | 6 garlic scapes, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons mint extract | 3 tablespoons dried rosemary | 4 ounces bamboo shoots ( drained and sliced ) | 12 sprigs fresh rosemary, for garnish
instructions: Put pineapples in a bowl and pour boiling water over them, reserving 1/2 cup of water for the fillings. Soak rice papers in a colander in the sink for 10 minutes to remove excess starch. Drain and set aside. Heat a large skillet on medium heat. Lightly spray with oil and add the sliced garlic scapes, mint and 2 tbsp of the pineapple water from pineapple, and set aside. Cut off one side of the rice papers and roll it in a large metal cake pan, jelly roll fashion. Place rice paper onto a plate. Place 2 pineapple wedges inside of the roll. Top off with a slice of manchego cheese. Place the remaining 2 pineapple slices inside the rice paper. Spoon on the cooled spongy orange syrup then garnish with sliced marinated bamboo shoots and fresh rosemary sprigs.

title: Chickpeas in Sweet and Hot
ingredients: 1 kg fresh chickpeas, picked over, rinsed and drained | 8 pitted ripe olives | 1 1/2 cups sweet vermicelli ( see note ) or 1 1/2 cups chickpeas ( see note ) | 1 1/4 cups sweet chutney | 2 vanilla beans, scraped
instructions: If using vermicelli, soak in boiling water with 1/8 to 1/4 cup of water for 20 minutes. Drain in colander, rinse well and drain. Put the chickpeas and olives in a bowl. Add the vermicelli or chickpeas and enough water to cover the chickpeas. Stir to cover them, cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain and chill. To make the sauce, stir the chutney into the chickpeas and olives. If using chickpeas, break up the beans with a fork. Taste and add more pepper if necessary. If desired, spoon over bowls and add a teaspoon of vanilla bean seeds in the middle, or a sprig of basil leaves.

Random Ingredients: extra large egg,coriander powder,salt black pepper,crouton,ice water,chili sauce
title: Baked Eggs and Coriander
ingredients: 12 extra-large eggs | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili sauce ( or more ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | ice water | crouton ( optional ) or other cracker ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Lightly oil an oven proof dish or individual dishes. Peel eggs and place in the dish. Mix 1 tsp coriander powder with 1/2 tsp chilli sauce or more chilli and pour the mixture over the eggs. Sprinkle with a little extra salt & freshly ground pepper. Put in the oven and cook for 50 min or until the eggs are just set.

title: Tandoori Masala
ingredients: 5 teaspoons fenugreek leaves, chopped raw | 2 teaspoons finely grated gingerroot ( peeled ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a dry frying pan over medium heat. Cook, stirring, until fragrant. Remove from the heat. Keep covered for 10 minutes to allow the seeds to sputter. Fluff with a fork and serve immediately on parathas. To serve hot, place the chaat on a warm serving dish, add raita and serve with pudina or yoghurt.

title: Chinese Spaghetti and Cauliflower
ingredients: 450 g spaghetti or 450 g vermicelli, small | 1/2 cauliflower or 1/2 courgette | 1 duck, dressed
instructions: Boil water for spaghetti or vermicelli. Cut cauliflower or courgette into bite size pieces, then separate the pieces into florets. Cut duck into small slices. When pasta is close to being cooked, heat a knob of oil in pan to medium high. Add chopped cauliflower or courgette and duck, and heat thru. Drain spaghetti or vermicelli into pasta pot and add mixed ingredients, mix well. Add more oil if necessary and stir. Eat while hot. Note, if you prefer more sauce, add water as needed.

Random Ingredients: rice bran oil,sage leaf,graham cracker,celery salt,lemon verbena
title: Homemade Sage and Lemon Salt Crackers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham crackers | 4 teaspoons dried lemon verbena | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon rubbed sage leaf, crushed | 1 teaspoon lemon verbena | 1 1/4 tablespoons rice bran oil, cooled and blended with 1/4 teaspoon of lemon salt crystals
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

title: Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 can yellow mustard | 1 cup dark corn syrup | 8 cups drained pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh marjoram | 1 lemon, cut into wedges
instructions: Mix yellow mustard, corn syrup, pinto beans, marjoram, and lemon in saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until hot.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,red thai chile hot,rice,broccoli floret
title: Spicy Thai Stir-Fry
ingredients: 6 ounces cooked stir fry vegetables ( i've also used baby bok choy, but it's up to you! ) | 1/2 cup raw rice ( like mung bean, etc. ) | 2 red thai chiles, sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 3 cups frozen broccoli florets or 3 cups steamed jasmine rice
instructions: Prep your rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet or wok over med low heat. Toss the ingredients until just warm and fragrant. Drain the vegetables and stir them into the skillet or wok. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,plum tomato,brown sugar,baguette,vanilla ice cream
title: Italian Tomato-And-Pomodoria Crostini
ingredients: 1 baguette | vanilla ice cream or vanilla yogurt, to dip | plums tomato, slices to garnish ( optional ) | cocoa powder, to sprinkle over crostini ( optional ) | brown sugar, to sprinkle on crostini ( optional )
instructions: Cut baguette lengthwise, then crosswise into about 1/4 inch thick slices. Using serrated knife, slice about 1/8 inch on a diagonal. Arrange slices in bottom of a lightly greased 12 inch nonstick skillet. Using a vegetable peeler, peel tomato slices on lightly patted surface to yield about 16 slices. Sprinkle lightly with cocoa powder and toss to evenly distribute. Top each crostini with some tomato slices, sliced togther sides, and top with a drizzle of cocoa and brown sugar. Transfer to freezer until ready to serve. Makes about 20 servings. Variation, the crostinis can be refrigerated, or frozen for up to 2 days. To assemble, spread crostinis with a scoop of the vanilla yogurt. Then, if serving frozen, place on individual serving plates, and garnish with plum tomato slices. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil peanut,egg yolk,masa harina,gingerroot,cream tartar,herb,madeira wine
title: Tartes (Sweet Sour Cream Sauce)
ingredients: 1/3 cup cream of tartar | 2 egg yolks | 1/2 ounce fresh gingerroot, peeled and minced | 1/4 ounce dried herbs, soaked in 1/4 cup cold water for 10 minutes and sliced into 1/8 '' rounds ( savory ) | 1/2 cup madeira wine or 1/2 cup merlot | 1/3 cup masa harina | vegetable oil or peanut oil, for frying
instructions: Pour cream of tartar into a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,garlic salt,iceberg lettuce,white rice
title: My Favorite Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked white rice ( or other long grain brown rice ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1/3 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place all ingredients except iceberg lettuce in your rice cooker, and press start on the rice using the quick setting. When all of the rice is added, remove the entire head of lettuce and place on top of the rice. Cover the lid with a lid or a tight fitting lid. Shake the rice a couple of times to remove any rice residue from the rice that may be forming on the top. Set the rice cooker to the light setting. When the light is gone, let it sit for five minutes, turn onto a big platter, and serve.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,black pepper,limeade concentrate,szechwan pepper,pistachio,red chilies
title: Homemade Sichuan Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup shelled pistachios | 8 dried small red chilies | 1/2 cup sweetened limeade concentrate | 2 teaspoons black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon ground szechwan pepper | 1 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Put pistachios into a bowl, and cover with boiling water. Let sit 20 minutes. Drain, and squeeze out excess water. Set nuts aside. Break off stems and seeds from dried chilies, and cut into quarters. Soak chiles in cool water for 30 minutes, then remove stems and seeds. Cut chiles into strips. Mix pistachios with limeade concentrate, peppercorns, szechwan pepper, and black pepper in a bowl until well blended. Pour into a jar with lid, and refrigerate overnight. Makes 1 quart. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,dill weed,gorgonzola,iceberg lettuce,chicken broth,scallion,green olive
title: Lettuce and Gorgonzola Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces gorgonzola, cut into 1-1/2 inch wide sticks | 2 scallions, chopped ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 teaspoon chili paste, or to taste | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup thinly sliced green olives | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | crushed iceburg lettuce
instructions: Place the gorgonzola, black olives, scallions, chili paste, and broth in a blender. Blend until you have a fine textured liquid. Season with dill. Transfer the soup to a soup tureen, filling to the sides. Garnish with lettuce to serve.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,extra virgin olive oil,coconut extract,heavy whipping cream,corn chip,pork tenderloin,butternut squash,hot mustard
title: Butternut Squash Tacos With Creamy Corn-Chip Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash, cut into cubes | 1 -2 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 12 ounces lean pork tenderloin ( cut into 1/2 `` pieces ) | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 cups frozen corn chips | hot mustard
instructions: In large non stick pan heat olive oil. Coat squash with oil, add coconut, and cook for 5 min or until soft. Mix in asafetida and cook for 1 min more. Add pork and sauté for 2 minuets until pork is browned. Remove from heat. In blender, combine corn chips and cream. Blend until smooth. Return mixture to pan, stirring constantly until evenly mixed. Add the tenderloins and heat thru. Spoon onto corn chips and sprinkle with mustard.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,spice cake mix,mint,yeast,baby bok choy,vanilla bean,white flour
title: Spice Cake
ingredients: 1 package spiced cake mix | 4 teaspoons yeast, 1 envelope | 7 cups warm baby bok choy, chopped ( about 6-8 heads packed ) | 1/2 cup white flour | 1 cup white flour | 1/4 cup minced of fresh mint | 1/2 teaspoon saffron or 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f, grease or oil a 10 inch bundt pan. In large bowl, combine spiced cake mix and yeast and stir to dissolve. Add the bok choy and coat generously with flour. Scatter the white flour over top. Add mint, saffron or dried mint and asafoetida. Mix. Beat for about 5 minutes, or until smooth and lemony and thick. Increase the oven temperature to 400°f. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 15 minutes until top springs back when lightly touched. Cool the cake for 45 minutes in the pan. Slice and serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Mexican Turnips
ingredients: 4 turnips, peel, cut into 3/4 pieces | 2 teaspoons ground cilantro | 1 pinch chicken bouillon
instructions: Boil the turnips in boiling water until almost soft. Drain water, and set the shells aside. Sprinkle the turnips with salt and cilantro. Dissolve the chicken bouillon in the hot turnip water. Place into a bowl, and add the turnip halves to the bowl. Cover, and refrigerate overnight for best flavor.

title: Dairy Free and Gluten Free Anzac Biscuits - Goombu
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups caster sugar | 1 cup raw cashew nuts ( salted ) | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricot | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh lemongrass | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil
instructions: Sift the gluten free flour, baking soda, clove and basil into a large bowl. Place the cashew nuts, dried fruit and chopped lemongrass in a food processor or blender. Process until the nuts are well minced and add the nuts to the flour. Mix together until well blended. Add the yeast mixture and mix all together, using a spatula. Leave in the refrigerator for 10 minutes or until doubled in bulk. Grease 4 small baking trays, or line with baking paper. Put the biscuits on the baking sheets lined with greased baking paper. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes at 200c or until lightly golden and firm when gently turn them over. Store at room temperatreen temperature. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cantaloupe,star anise,extra virgin olive oil,turmeric,white pepper
title: Tunisian Melon Fruity Melon & Turmeric Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb cantaloupe, peeled and cut lengthwise into 1/8 inch slices | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 4 star anise | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | white pepper
instructions: Peel the melon slices into long, thin strips or use strips of melon.

title: Japanese Ginger Rolls
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent roll dough | 1/2 cup finely minced gingerroot | 1/3 cup minced onion | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar
instructions: Grease baking sheets. In a mixing bowl combine ginger, onion and sugar and stir until sugar is dissolved. Roll dough out on lightly floured surface to 1/8 inch thickness. Using a 2 1/4 inch round cookie cutter cut circle into 4 inch squares. Place 1 teaspoon of ginger mixture in the center of each square. Fold dough over, pressing lightly to seal. Place on prepared baking sheets. Cover, freeze. Prepare rolls at least 30 minutes before baking. Bake in preheated 375°f oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Cool slightly then brush with cooled melted butter.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,parsley,gruyere,head romaine lettuce,rice vermicelli,hash brown,marjoram
title: Grilled Tilapia Fish Rolls-Potato
ingredients: 1/3 cup minced fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons minced fresh marjoram | 2 tablespoons minced fresh thyme or 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 2 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons minced gruyere | 4 tilapia fillets | 2 packages rice vermicelli | 4 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Mix the parsley, marjoram, and thyme in a small bowl. Place the potato slices in a medium bowl. Toss with the parmesan cheese. Arrange the tilapia fillets in a lightly oiled shallow dish. Gently pour the herb mixture over the fish.

title: Easy Turkey-Asparagus Strata
ingredients: 1 lb turkey breast | 8 small thin asparagus | 1 slice white bread | 1 liter soda water ( approx )
instructions: First slice your bread on the thicker side and cut off some of the 'broiler section' so that the bread can breath. Rinse the bread and cut into 2 - 3 sized sections. Cut the turkey into bite size pieces. If you like you can now slice your asparagus into 2 inch lengths and then use a vegetable peeler, or you can do your best to julienne it. Once you are done this, drain the bread of any water and put on a plate or paper towel to soak the excess water. Once all of the strata ingredients have been prepared, place your strata in a large bowl and lightly coat with a little olive oil. Preheat your oven to 300 degrees celsius. After a minute or so, place the bread pieces on the bread and lightly coat with olive oil. Next, place your turkey pieces on top of the bread. Do this till all of your pieces have been coated with your olive oil. Place the top shelf of your oven on and let it cook for approximately 20 minutes. Watch that it doesn't burn or become browned too fast. The meat should be cooked by the consistency you like. Remove your strata from the oven, and let it sit for about 3 - 5 minutes before serving.

title: German Beans Sprouts Pancake
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 2 cups canned baked beans ( sprouts ) | 1 1/4 cups hot vermouth ( or dry white wine )
instructions: Mix the flour, caraway seeds and noodles together in a bowl. Mix the beans together in a large bowl with the vermouth or rice wine and pour into a greased pancake iron and heat until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,gruyere cheese,tomato sauce,sherry wine,tart apple,chocolate,egg white,rye bread
title: Spanish Rarebit
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 1 tablespoon semisweet chocolate | 2 tablespoons egg whites | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 tablespoon grated swiss gruyere cheese | 1 small tomatoes, sliced | 1 tart apple, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup dry sweetened cranberries
instructions: Lightly toast bread and place on paper towels. Sprinkle chocolate over bread, allow to melt, set aside. In bowl, combine egg whites, sherry, cheese, tomato, apple, and browned bread.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,plain yogurt,brown rice,cream tartar,iceberg lettuce,celery rib,ladyfinger
title: Creamy Rice and Lettuce Salad With a Yogurt Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3/4 cup cooked brown rice | 1/2 cup shredded iceberg lettuce ( about 12 ounces ) | 1/4 cup dried sweetened condensed milk lentils ( about 4 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, melted | freshly shopped celery rib ( about 3 ounces )
instructions: Place the yogurt, cream of tartar, and rice in a large bowl and fold in the lettuce and lentils. Pour the oil over the salad and toss well to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Sizzlin' Chips and Olives
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups green olives or 3 1/2 cups black olives, drained | 2 cups chipotle chiles, chopped ( fresh or canned ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Put all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid and shake well to mix. Pour into a serving dish, sprinkle with additional cinnamon and serve.

title: Homemade Basic Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 12 tablespoons lard | parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Place the lard in your food processor, and process until finely chopped. Add the parmesan cheese, and process to combine. Sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for a week, or you may use immediately.

title: Crispy Sloppy Joes
ingredients: 1 pound ground chuck | 1 package cream cheese, room temperature | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped celery ribs | 3 maraschino cherries, diced
instructions: Preheat the grill for medium low heat. In a medium bowl, mix together the ground chuck, cream cheese, rice vinegar, and celery. Shape the mixture into 12 balls. Place the meatballs onto the grill, and cook 10 minutes, turning until cooked through, and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: pineapple ring,rice wine,bean sprout,beef base,kidney bean,tamarind paste
title: Beef & Bean Sprout Stir Fry
ingredients: 250 g lean sirloin steaks ( thinly sliced ) | 400 g baked beansprouts ( fresh ) or 400 g sprouts ( fresh ) | 2 cans pineapple rings | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste or 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 8 -10 tablespoons rice wine | 1 teaspoon beef base
instructions: Heat a small wok until quite hot. Add beef to wok and cook, stirring frequently, until browned. Add pineapple, tamarind and rice wine. Stir fry over high heat for 3 minutes. Add beansprouts or sprouts. Stir fry for 1 minute until heated through. Add beef mixture, stir in and cook until heated through.

title: Slow Cooker Kebab
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 3 pounds boneless chuck roast | 1 1/2 cups chicken bouillon granules | 1 jar grape | 1/4 cup chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet, and cook over medium high heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain the bacon slices on a paper towel lined plate, reserving bacon grease in the skillet. Crumble bacon and set aside. Stir chuck roast into the bacon grease in the skillet over high heat, and cook until browned, about 5 minutes on each side. Transfer chuck roast to the slow cooker. Dissolve chicken bouillon granules in about 1/4 cup of boiling water, and pour into the slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours, or until meat shreds easily with a fork. Stir grape pieces into the slow cooker. Top with bacon slices. Sprinkle with pistachios, and cook for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: mustard oil,pecorino romano cheese,oatmeal,broccoli floret,onion flake,sea salt
title: Broccoli and Cheese Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oatmeal ( unseasoned ) | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan romano cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried onion flakes ( dried ) | 1/3 teaspoon sea salt | 1/3 teaspoon dry mustard oil | 1/3 cup finely chopped broccoli floret ( about 1 package )
instructions: In small bowl, combine oatmeal, cheese, onion, mustard oil and broccoli. Whisk until blended. Store refrigerated until serving time.

title: Lengenberg Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin | 1 tablespoon red chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f rub the salt and chili powder into the tenderloin. Place the tenderloin in a roasting pan, sprinkle with water and bake for 60 to 90 minutes, basting with pan juices every 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,green peppercorn,brown rice,vanilla yogurt
title: Sanshokuat (Sanshokuat-Yogurt)
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1/4 cup green peppercorns | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste ( optional ) | 1 cup vanilla yogurt
instructions: Place all ingredients into a saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,beef chuck roast,turmeric,almond extract,red enchilada sauce,orange marmalade,walnut
title: Orange Chili Beef With Almond Covered Salted Walnuts
ingredients: 3/4 cup orange marmalade | 3 lbs beef chuck roast, trimmed of excess fat | 3 tablespoons ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped | salt and cracked pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine marmalade, beef, turmeric and chili powder in a large freezer bag. Seal and marinate for 4 hours or overnight. Remove air and bag from roast. Sprinkle roast with salt and cracked pepper, then tie tightly with string. Remove roast and reserve marinade. Saute beef and marinade on medium high heat in dutch oven for 12 minutes for medium rare, 12 minutes for medium. Arrange beef on broiler pan and set rack 6 inches from heat. Roast in centre of preheated oven at 425 for 1 1/2 hours. Transfer meat to platter and cover with foil to keep warm. Combine enchilada sauce with reserved marinade in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, then simmer, uncovered, over moderate heat for 10 minutes then stir in walnuts, then cool.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,maraschino cherry,apricot preserve,mayonnaise,dark brown sugar,red chili pepper flake,red wine,cottage cheese
title: Carnitas on the Stone (Cheese, Not Hot)
ingredients: 2 cups fat-free cottage cheese | 1/2 cup fat free mayonnaise ( or miracle whip ) | 1 tablespoon red wine | 1 tablespoon dried maraschino cherries, halves or 1 teaspoon dried cherries | 2 tablespoons canned diced red chili peppers with liquid | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes ( or more if that's your taste ) | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons sugar substitute, substitute ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a medium bowl that's been prepared with no oil. If you want a really thick and creamy cheese, mix a bit of the cheese with the mayo as well. If you desire a thinner mixture, leave out the brown sugar. Refrigerate it until needed. It can be served with your choice of mexican style hot mexican rice dishes.

title: Black Beans - Great Black Buns
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed | 1 jar whole grain buns | 2 cups milk, for a softer bun
instructions: Soak the black beans in enough hot water that they float to the top. Soak for at least 2 hours, or up to overnight. This can be done quickly. Scoop the beans out of the beans and place them in a mixing bowl. Drain the beans and add them to bowl and mash with a fork. Set them aside. You may need more or less milk to thin to your liking. Split the buns and toast them if it tastes like the insides of the buns. Spread them with butter and top with desired amount of black beans. This can be prepared ahead, and frozen in an airtight container for future use.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,dill pickle,french onion soup,quinoa,onion flake
title: French Onion Quinoa Cones
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, cooked | 3/4 1/3 cup peanut butter or 1/4 cup almond butter | 1/4 cup dry instant minced onion flakes | 2 tablespoons dried dill pickle pieces ( optional ) | 4 3/4 ounces french onion soup
instructions: Boil 1 cup of quinoa plus 1/3 cup of water. While boiling bring remaining quinoa and 1/3 cup peanut butter or almond butter and onions to a boil on med/high heat, turn down heat and simmer until quinoa is done and liquid is absorbed.. Turn off heat and stir in pickle bits until combined. Spread quinoa in an 11x15 baking dish. I use the long spanish fries on the quinoa. I layer the peanut butter on top of the quinoa then spread the onions on top. I use a spoon as an aid in getting the pickle bits on top of quinoa. This recipe can also be made in a crock pot. Cook at on power for 4 - 6 hours stirring every once in a while. I use my crock pot in the evening and let it get real good. We eat it as is, as an appetizer with a bit of the pickle bits sprinkled on top of it.

title: Horseradish Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup finely chopped green olives
instructions: Combine all ingredients except olive. Store tightly covered in refrigerator up to six weeks.

title: Fried Bread (Qij)
ingredients: 1 loaf bread | oil or ghee | 1 tablespoon mustard | ghee ( for frying ) or butter ( for frying )
instructions: Slice the bread into 3 sections. Using a round cookie cutter, cut out a round and 3 round circles from the bread to make 2 bread discs from each section. Make a hole in the middle of the circles with your fingers. Place a small teaspoonful of ghee or butter into the hole of one dough section and place it over the hole. Close the hole of dough with a fork. Fry the bread over hot ghee a few seconds on the first side and turn over. Repeat with remaining dough balls. Drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,pickling spice,anchovy paste,teriyaki sauce,yogurt,black bean
title: Anchovy and Black Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 jar anchovy paste | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup yogurt | 1 tablespoon pickling spices | 1/2 cup anchovy paste | 1 can black beans | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Place the first seven ingredients in a blender or food processor and process until smooth. Pour into a wide wide mouth glass dish. Use for dipping the seafood, meat of your choice, or as hors d'oeuvres in buns, eggs or pickle sticks.

title: Double Potato Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/4 cup red potatoes, finely diced
instructions: Combine egg substitute and potatoes.

title: Sausages With Grilled Tequila & Brown Sugar-Mushroom Cocktail Base
ingredients: 4 sausages | 2 teaspoons reduced fat ketchup | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar ( pref. splenda ) | 2 tablespoons aged celtic sea salt ( pref. kosher ) | 1/2 loaf whole wheat bread
instructions: Soak sausages in cold water for 10 minutes. Cut bread into 1in thick slices.

title: Quick and Easy Taquitos
ingredients: 20 corn tortillas, cut into 1/2 inch size strips | 1/4 cup shredded carrot | 2 teaspoons chopped garlic | 1/4 cup chopped fresh arugula | 1/4 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: In a small bowl, toss together the carrots, garlic and arugula. Spread about 1/4 cup of the carrot mixture onto each tortilla strip. Roll the tortillas up, and place on a foil covered cookie sheet, seam side down. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the taquitos until browned on all sides. In a small bowl, combine the dry mustard powder with 1/2 cup water. Stir in 1 to 2 tablespoons of water, and stir until thoroughly mixed. Pour the dijon mixture over the taquitos, and return to medium heat. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,sirloin,maple syrup,white wine vinegar,yellow onion
title: Sweet Onion Marinated Beef Skewers
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 lbs sirloin or 4 1/2-5 lbs skirt steaks | 1 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup sweet white wine vinegar | 2 large yellow onions | 1/2 cup chili oil
instructions: Soak skewers in water for 30 minutes to an hour. Make sure skewers are clean, cut lengthwise on the diagonal about 1 1/2 inch slices from the beef. Rinse and drain well. Cut onion slices into 1 pieces and then cut into eighths. Rinse the livers and place into a bowl with some marinade. Whisk together all remaining ingredients. Pour over the sirloin and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or as long as overnight. Thread meat onto skewers. Lightly oil a grill surface and grill sausages over medium high heat, turning frequently, for about 2 to 4 minutes on each side or until cooked to your desired level of doneness. Note, the onions will turn slightly golden, so watch closely so the onions don't burn. Note, if the onions are dark, you may not need the onions. Note, after marinating the meat, thread on pieces of string approximately 4 inches long, keeping ends attached. Grill over medium high heat for about 15 minutes, turning frequently, for seared onions and meat to desired doneness.

title: Zanzibar - Zanzibar Shortbread (Zanzibar Jam)
ingredients: 600 g caster sugar | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Melt the sugar & add salt, cook on a low heat to dissolve. Increase heat to medium, stirring so that sugar can melt and caramelise. When mixture starts to foam, add zanzabar kneading until mixture is smooth. Roll into an 18 inch square & place on an ungreased cookie sheet or parchment paper. Mark into small squares & let cool. When set, cut into squares with a sharp knife.

Random Ingredients: black bean,cream tartar,whipping cream,balsamic vinegar,white poppy seed,sherry
title: Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup sherry | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 cup white poppy seeds | 1/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: In large bowl combine beans, sherry, vinegar, cream of tartar and poppyseed. Stir in whipping cream. Season to taste.

Random Ingredients: spice,provolone cheese,white onion,coriander seed,beef stew meat
title: Lori's Beef Patties
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1/2 large white onion | 1/2 tablespoon coriander seed | 1/4 teaspoon spice ( your choice as the brand is what i use ) | 1/2 cup grated provolone cheese ( i like grated )
instructions: I find that using a 4 lb sirloin steak and two pounds of fat in a round, round pan works really well. Cut up the onion into smaller cubes and roughly chop. In a cast iron fry pan, heat 3 lbs of beef stew meat in 3 tbsp flour, about 3 tablespoons. Put over medium heat cook onion until a nice golden brown. Put aside in large bowl. In the same pan, add your coriander powder, 1/4 cup grated cheese, and about 1/4 cup of vegetable oil. Cut remaining meat into 1 cubes. Put into bowl with onion and spice mix. Add to meat and stir together. Turn heat to high. Let mixture cook, stirring every 10 minutes, until meat is well browned, about 3 hours, stirring often. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Kellymagari - Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 12 pieces sourdough bread, cut into chunks | 1 cucumber, peeled, chopped | 1 cup bottled bottled marinara sauce | 1 cup chili sauce ( such as tabasco brand ) | 1 1/4 lbs fresh shell pasta, cooked
instructions: Combine the shrimp, cucumber, marinara sauce and chili sauce in a large bowl. Add the bread crumbs. Toss to coat and serve.

Random Ingredients: fish stock,venison steak,tomato ketchup,blueberry,rice wine,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Smoky Venison Blueberry Rice
ingredients: 4 venison steak, thick ( or any leftover beef ) | 1 cup mixed fresh vegetables ( blueberries, carrots, onion, celery ) | 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup fish and vegetable stock | 1/2 tablespoon tomato ketchup, or to taste | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Score the venison steak in a diamond pattern. Trim off both ends of the diamond shape using a sharp knife. Remove the blade from the steak, and cut across. Place in a bowl, and sprinkle with the wine. Let it marinate at least 30 minutes. Rinse the vegetables and pat dry. Prepare the grill for direct heat using the stove top. Lightly oil the grill grate. Grill the venison, meat side up, for 15 to 20 minutes, or to desired doneness. Slice against the grain, and add the tomato ketchup to each slice. Heat the broiler to high, and spray the inside of the pot with the cooking spray. Place the venison slices in the pan, and move the pieces around a little on the rack. Cook until they start seared, the juices run clear, and the fish and vegetable juices evaporate.

title: Caramelized Carrots With Beans (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 12 baby carrots | 2 cans bean, drained | 1 1/2 cups low-fat whipping cream, half-n-half or 1 1/2 cups nonfat milk | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig, crushed | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries
instructions: Combine carrots and beans.

title: Glamato - Brazilian Sour Punch
ingredients: 2 tablespoons angostura bitters | 8 fresh strawberries
instructions: Pour the bitters into a small wine glass of cold, sunny, sunny water. Place your fresh berries on top of the bitters. Enjoy.

title: Toe-Bag
ingredients: 1 container frozen whipped topping | 1 jar marmalade | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place frozen toges in a large bowl and microwave for about 1 minute or until warm. Dip tops into the marmalade, sprinkle with salt and place on a serving plate.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,spring onion,yellow pepper,peanut butter,acorn squash
title: Peanut Butter & Acorn Squash Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 acorn squash, peeled, seeds removed, thinly sliced | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon reduced fat natural peanut butter | 1 tablespoon chopped green spring onion | 1 tablespoon chopped yellow pepper
instructions: Spray frypan with oil, add squash, stir to coat with oil, cook over medium heat for 5 minutes add remaining ingredients and stir well, cook for 3 minutes.

title: Chipotle Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 -3 canned chipotle chiles, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 -3 dashes tabasco sauce ( tabasco is preferred )
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth.

title: Quick and Easy Yellow Turnips (Shu Mai)
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow turnips | 1/3 cup rice wine ( or sake )
instructions: Wash turnip. Put in a pan with about 2 cups of water. Cover and boil gently for 25 minutes over medium heat. Drain and keep hot. Place into a colander or sieve and sprinkle with a little salt. Place in the refrigerator. Cook the turnip for 30 minutes or until tender. Drain excess water. Set aside to cool a bit, then remove skin and stem. Cut the turnip into smallish chunks. Transfer the turnip chunks and rice wine into a large bowl and mix well to combine. Refrigerate for 2 - 24 hours at room temperature or as long as overnight.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) With Snow Peas and Raspberry
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 100 g raspberries or 100 g blueberries | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 50 g snow peas
instructions: Slice eggplant on the diagonal into 1/4 slices. You should have about 3 cm squares on each slice. Sprinkle eggplant with salt. Place eggplant on a tray and cover with paper towel. Place on your balcony near top of a preheated pan of boiling water with a lid. This will stop the eggplant from floating on the surface of the water. Cook the eggplant until tender when pierced with knife, drain onto paper towel. The water will reduce the liquid and make it slightly syrupy and watery. Place all ingredients in a bowl and sprinkle with fennel seeds. Dip the snow peas into the water and put onto serving platter. Sprinkle the top with sesame seeds and serve with lemon wedges and honey to dip inches.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,guacamole,baking potato,leek,applesauce,tomato basil pasta sauce,apricot jam
title: Lazy New York Potatoes
ingredients: 6 large leeks, washed and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup applesauce | 1 jar apricot jam | 1 package dry potato baking potatoes | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1/2 cup apple and 1 chicken bouillon flavored pasta sauce | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Toss leeks and applesauce in a large pot. Cover. Place on low heat for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare idahoan signature™ russets mashed potatoes according to package instructions. Drain and cool potatoes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut the potatoes into 1/4 inch slices. Place sliced potatoes in a greased 9x13 inch casserole dish. Pour the beef broth and pear mushroom soup mixture over potatoes. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle potatoes with 1/2 cup of the chicken bouillon. Cover and continue baking for 5 to 10 minutes or until the potato slices are slightly crispy on the outside and tender to the tooth. Spread guacamole on the top of the potatoes.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,coconut milk,sugar,pomegranate seed,chili pepper flake,extra virgin olive oil
title: Baked Molasses Candy
ingredients: 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds | 1/2 cup pomegranate oil | 3/4 cup unsweetened coconut milk ( unsweetened ) | 1/2 cup ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 cups sugar ( splenda makes this a sweetener for my tastes ) | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Toast the pomegranate seeds in the oven for about 1 to 2 minutes or until fragrant. Remove and set aside. Place coconut milk and ginger garlic paste in a heavy bottomed saucepan and bring to a boil over moderately high heat. Add the pomegranate seeds, sugar, and chili flakes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring and scraping the bottom of the pan. Remove from heat and stir in the seeds. Pour the molasses mixture into 1 - 2 large, round cookie tins. Smooth the surface and place the tray on the rack of a roasting pan. Smooth the surface and place the tray in the oven and bake about 25 to 35 minutes, or until goldenbrown. Cut into squares with a sharp knife and store for up to a month in an airtight container, cut candy into squares. Variation, instead of sprinkles, you can use slivered almonds. Note, i tried it with fresh ginger garlic paste which came out great. I didn't succeed at any of the above remedial steps as shown in the photos.

title: Apple Polenta Wedges
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ketchup | 3/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 3/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 1/2 cups polenta | 1 tablespoon dried cilantro | 2 teaspoons apple juice | 1 fresh serrano pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine the ketchup, oregano, italian seasoning, seasoned salt, and polenta in a mixing bowl. Stir together the cilantro and apple juice in a small bowl.

title: Yellow Squash Risotto
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon arborio rice | 3 -4 yellow squash, sliced thin and starchy | pepper, to taste
instructions: Put a little olive oil in a frying pan and fry some arborio rice into the pan you are making. When the rice is a pale yellow color, mix the vegetables and stir them around a little so they don't stick to the pan. Add pepper and stir another 5 seconds. Remove from heat. Serve immediately.

title: The Best Roast Chicken Ever!
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 220degc or 400 fahrenheit. Rinse the chicken well inside and out, pat the excess back into place. Score the skin with a sharp knife and prick all over with a fork. Place the chicken in a roasting tin or an ovenproof dish, skin side down. Sprinkle the chopped icing sugar all over the chicken. Drizzle the oil all over the skin. Place the roasting tin or baking dish or roasting tin on the middle shelf of the oven. Bake for 1 hour or until skin is crispy and the juices run clear. You might need to baste with a little more oil from time to time as the pan or chicken browns. Remove the chicken from the oven, take off the skin and leave to rest for 10 minutes before carving to serve.

title: Sour Cream Sauerkraut With Peanuts
ingredients: 300 ml sour cream sherry | 200 g good quality white sesame seeds or 200 g black sesame seeds, and | 2 -6 large spring onions, stalks finely sliced or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried shallots | 50 g roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Pour 1 - 2 tablespoons of the sherry onto a clean tray, spread to coat the surface and set aside in a warm, dry place. Heat a small skillet over medium low heat. Stir in the sesame seeds and cook, stirring, until they turn a light colour, about 15 - 20 seconds or so. Remove from the heat and set aside as soon as they turn a shade darker. Set aside as soon as they turn a darker shade darker. Tip the remaining sherry into the pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer. This should take about 20 minutes or so. Stir occasionally, as mixture will quickly boil up. Stir in the spring onion or shallots. Stir in the peanuts. To serve, spoon the sauerkraut into a warmed serving dish or bowl, pour over the sherry & sprinkle with the fried shallots and peanuts.

Random Ingredients: sao biscuit,red capsicum,thai basil,black olive,duck,jalapeno pepper,honey,gingerroot
title: Spicy Duck and Honey Sticks
ingredients: 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 2 teaspoons roasted sao biscuit, finely crushed | 2/3 cup prepared duck fat ( from cooked duck ) | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/3 cup canned black olives, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup pickled jalapeno pepper, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup red capsicum, finely diced | 1 sprig thai basil, leaves picked from stems
instructions: Combine gingerroot, sao biscuit crumbs, duck fat, honey and black olives in a bowl and mix well. Add peppers, ginger and basil leaves. Divide mixture among 12 paper covered cups. Seal with wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours and up to 2 days. To serve garnish with a fresh sprig of basil.

title: Pickled Red Wine Vins
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs red wine vinegar ( or red oak vinegar ) | white vinegar, for rinsing ( optional )
instructions: Pour 3 1/2 quarts of black vinegar into a large glass jar with the lid. Rinse the vinegar from the jar and place in the sink. Wash the vinegar from the bottle or jug by rubbing with two fingers and squeezing out any excess water. Discard the remaining brine. Shake the vinegar vigorously until it is completely distilled. Seal the jar with a tight fitting lid or a rubber band with tape. Let it stand at room temp until needed. The vinegar may be stored in the refrigerator up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,vanilla ice cream,lima bean,cheese,allspice,red onion
title: Grilled Peppers W-Caramelized Lima Beans
ingredients: 4 red onions, quartered | 2 bell peppers, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 8 ounces cheese | 1 cup vanilla ice cream ( or frozen ) | 1/2 teaspoon allspice ( to taste ) | 1 cup lima beans ( frozen or fresh, thawed ) or 1 cup peas ( frozen or fresh, thawed )
instructions: Combine onions, bell peppers and cheese on a medium sized plate and set aside. Heat up grill. Drizzle veggies with just enough evoo to coat. Grill until veggies are crisp and veggies are tender, stirring to coat in evoo. In small bowl, mix ice cream and allspice. Spread on platter and top evenly with veggies. Enjoy.

title: Chocolate Coconut Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups coconut flakes | 1 tablespoon unsweetened chocolate | 3 cups unsalted butter, at room temperature | 2 cups sour cream | 2 cups tomato puree | 1 1/2 cups water | 6 small radishes, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place coconut flakes in a shallow baking dish. Bake coconut flakes until toasted and fragrant, about 1 hour. Allow to cool. Place coconut flakes, chocolate, and butter in a 2 quart saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until butter is melted and chocolate is melted. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream. Stir to incorporate. Stir in tomato puree and water. Place radishes in a serving bowl and pour the hot chocolate mixture over them. Let stand for 5 minutes, then sprinkle with coconut flakes.

title: Asparagus with Cream
ingredients: 3 cups heavy cream | 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Blend heavy cream with asparagus in a food processor until creamy, about 30 seconds. Chill until serving.

title: Delicious Potato Cheese Wedges
ingredients: 16 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 celery rib, thinly sliced | 3 -4 lbs simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes #5fix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix together cream cheese and potato traditional style until creamy. Gently fold in par boiled celery and serve with wedges on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,creme de cacao,grand marnier,cucumber
title: Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded and cut into chunks | 4 cups chicken stock or 4 cups vegetarian stock | 1 -2 ounce grand marnier | 1 teaspoon creme de cacao
instructions: In a saucepan, dissolve the chicken stock cube in the coucail or creme de cacao. Add the cucumber and cook over a moderate heat until the cucumber starts to wilt and the juice releases from the vegetables. Sieve to get all of the flavour out of the coucail and to blend, combine with the rest of the ingredients and heat through but do not boil, but set aside to cool slightly. Pour into chilled bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,almond,poppy seed,dijon mustard,cream chicken soup,tomato juice
title: Easy Poppy Seed Almond Chili
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 4 medium tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup almonds, blanched and coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: Combine soup, tomatoes with juice, green peppers, almonds, poppy seeds and dijon mustard in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: white cake mix,spanish rice,garlic paste,bow tie pasta,phyllo pastry,red lentil
title: Mediterranean Potato Pastries
ingredients: 1 box bow tie pasta ( small box ) | 1 package white cake mix | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 12 -16 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 2 cans red lentils, drained well | 4 cups cooked spanish rice ( cooked according to package directions )
instructions: Preheat oven to lightly grease 9 x13 baking pan or a 2 quart shallow baking dish. Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a medium bowl. Add the bow tie package and the white cake mix. When water comes to the boil, add the garlic paste, stirring to blend well. Remove from heat and place the phyllo sheets in a large sheet of plastic wrap. Cut 1 sheet of phyllo into 6 - 8 equal squares. Cover the sheets with a damp towel to prevent drying out. Spread a heaping tablespoon of the lentils over the phyllo sheets. Place a sheet on top of the lentils, followed by a sheet of phyllo. Spread the garlic paste on the phyllo sheets, followed by a couple of sprnbles of spanish rice. Place the 5x6 squares of phyllo sheet in the baking pan, making sure the sheets are overlapping as much as possible, using a clean cloth or your fingers as you go to spread the garlic paste evenly over the top of the rice and lentils, leaving a little space between strips. I also used a little extra garlic paste to spread throughout the dough. Cover the baking dish with plastic wrap and place in the middle of the oven. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to rest for at least 15 to 30 minutes before cutting the meal or eat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,eggplant,salmon steak,coconut,chicken stock vegetable,coleslaw mix,chili
title: Salmon Parcels
ingredients: 1 lb salmon steak | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons sweet chili | 1 1/2 cups coleslaw mix ( i use coleslaw for this dish ) | 1/2 cup low sodium chicken stock or 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1 eggplants ( eggplants should be peeled, quartered lengthwise to 1-inch thickness ) | 3 tablespoons desiccated coconut
instructions: Trim excess fat from salmon. In a shallow dish, mix water and oil. Dip salmon steak into oil.

title: Cherry Sangria
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh cherries ( with stems ) | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 2 -4 tablespoons superfine sugar | 10 hearts romaine lettuce or 10 hearts boston lettuce
instructions: Whisk dressing ingredients and chill.

title: Zucchini Vinegar French Dressing
ingredients: 1 zucchini ( 1lb ) | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar
instructions: Cut zucchini through the core, remove the seeds. Cut the zucchini into 1/4 inch slices, discard the core. Combine all ingredients and shake well to blend.

title: Tassie-Mein Lawgales - Salmon with Broccoli
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 cup vodka | 2 tablespoons vanilla extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons allspice | 6 cups fresh broccoli florets | 2 pounds salmon fillets, cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Stir refried beans, vodka, and vanilla extract into a saucepan over medium heat until heated through. Stir broth, and water together in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.

title: Lemon Beurre Sesame Dessert
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter or margarine, softened | 9 tablespoons ice water | 8 lemons, zested | 1 1/2 cups sesame oil | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Blend the water, lemons, oil and grand marnier together in a blender or food processor until blended. Pour into a glass glass bowl and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Chill several hours or overnight before serving. Garnish with mint.

title: Low Fat Caesar Dressing
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon caesar salad dressing ( any flavor, i like kraft's italian salad dressing ) | 1 can refried beans
instructions: Shake the caesar dressing into the hot refried beans. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,self raising flour,green pepper,enchilada sauce,lamb,cooking sherry,active yeast,creole seasoning
title: Lamb and Pepper Bobbat
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning ( for basting ) | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons granulated superfine sugar | 1 lb ground lamb | 1/2 cup cooking sherry | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1/2 cup enchilada sauce
instructions: Mix the first five ingredients together place the lamb, green pepper and enchilada sauce in a large mixing bowl, mixing on a low speed until well incorporated. Place the dough in a greased bowl, turning the dough around until it is evenly coated with the mixture. Cover with a clean cloth and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled in size. Punch down the dough. Cut out 5 inch circles and place on the pizza pans. Cover and let rise for 20 minutes. Heat oven to 425 degrees. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until the bobbat are golden brown.

title: Linguine With Chiles and Chocolate
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine, preferably whole-wheat spaghetti | 1 ounce dark chocolate or 1 ounce milk chocolate, melted | 1 ounce onion soup mix | 1 ounce fresh rock salt
instructions: Place the chocolate, onion soup mix and rock salt in a small pot and heat on low heat until the mixture thickens, stirring occasionally. This may take from 20 minutes depending on how thick the sauce is or how thin you want the noodles to be. Remove from the heat and stir the noodles until smooth. Pour sauce over the noodles and chill completely. Serve in bowls.

title: Horseradish Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces greek yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish
instructions: Place yogurt in mixing bowl. Crumble in 1 teaspoon horseradish. Stir in paprika. Add nutmeg. Chill in refrigerator 1 hour.

title: Cod in White Wine
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod | 1 cup dry white wine
instructions: Wash the cod and dry. Cut into chunks and boil them for 5 - 8 minutes. Drain the water from the cod. Cover it and place it in a baking dish lined with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Turn it over and return a little crusty on the top. Continue baking until it is fork tender. About 15 minutes before the cod is ready, drain the water from the fish. Pour off the liquid but reserve 2 tablespoons. Bring the wine to a boil and add the cod. Reduce heat to low and continue cooking for 15 - 20 minutes or until the cod is cooked, creamy and tender and the sauce thickened.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,pea,heavy duty aluminum foil,green pea
title: Homesick's Easy Mixed-Up Nabe Corn Salad
ingredients: 6 1/2 cups heavy-duty aluminum foil, cut into about 12 squares | 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can frozen green peas, rinsed and drained | 1 package frozen peas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a large baking dish. Place the aluminum foil squares on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Iranian Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings, cut at joints ( drumsticks and thighs ) | 2 1/2 lbs chicken wings, cut at joints | 4 cans chicken wings | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 loaf fresh day old white bread
instructions: Wash both kinds of chicken and cut them into pieces. Place in large pot with 2 1/2 cups water and cover with lid. Let stand in hot water for half an hour. Drain. Place in large pot with 1 can chicken wings from remaining can. Add turmeric. Bring to a boil. Cover.

Random Ingredients: mix,chicken breast,red bell pepper,pork tenderloin,meat,white vinegar,yellow pepper,lemon wedge
title: Pork Tenderloin Slices
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed | lemon wedge | 1 1/2 lbs bone-in frozen pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 red bell pepper, cut into strips | 1/2 yellow pepper, cut into strips | 1/2 cup frozen chopped onion | 3 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 2 tablespoons prepared sweet-and-sour mix, warmed
instructions: In a plastic bag, place a meat tenderloin and a portion of the frozen meat. Place the refrigerated meat and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Prepare grill. Remove meat from refrigerator, drain well. Sprinkle frozen vegetables with salt and pepper. Reserve marinade. Place vegetables on grill rack coated with vegetable oil. Grill until tender, about 8 minutes per side for medium rare, or 8 minutes per side for medium. Remove vegetables from grill. Cut meat into 1 inch slices. Place each slice on a serving plate. Drizzle reserved marinade over each slice. Serve with sweet and sour sour mix.

title: Meatballs My Kids Will Eat
ingredients: 1/2 lb meatballs | 1/2 lb cheese, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Combine above ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake in 350°f oven for 35 minutes. I serve these alone or with a green salad and garlic bread. We sometimes eat them like appetizers over pasta. Enjoy.

title: Vegan Coleslaw
ingredients: 6 cups shredded cabbage | 1 cup shredded carrot | 1/2 lb shredded vegan mozzarella ball | 2 leeks, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 24 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Layer cabbage, carrot, mozzarella cheese and leeks in a large bowl. Sprinkle nutritional yeast and kosher salt over top. Top with rye bread to make a sandwich and enjoy note, to toast bread spread untoasted bread and spread with nonstick cooking spray. Allow them to brown on the bottom, then flip over. Allow to cool before eating.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,sausage,yellow bell pepper,italian salad dressing,baby green,dressing,green onion
title: Sausage Sausage Salad
ingredients: 2 links sausage, casings removed | 2 yellow bell peppers, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 large yellow bell peppers, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 1/4 cups chopped baby greens | 2 green onions, sliced | 1 bottle chunky salsa | 1 bottle italian salad dressing
instructions: Cook sausage in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until no longer pink, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove sausage and slice into bite sized pieces. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add yellow and green bell peppers, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain, cool slightly, and cut into 1 inch pieces. In a large bowl, combine sausage, yellow and green green bell peppers, salad dressing, and salsa.

title: Tomato Plait Toasts
ingredients: 6 plum tomatoes, sliced 1/2-inch thick | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 loaf peasant bread, cut in half
instructions: Heat grill or broiler. Arrange platter in oven proof glass pan or a foil lined baking sheet just large enough to hold slices of tomato. Sprinkle tomatoes with tarragon, pepper and a drizzle of olive oil. Top with bread and grill or broil 3 - 4 inches from heat, turning and rearranging slices, until golden and crisp, about 2 minutes per side.

title: Miso Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mirin ( or soy sauce ) | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 8 bean sprouts
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with a spoon, and serve.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 14 ounces crushed graham cracker crumbs | 2 -3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet and spread all ingredients in the skillet with a spatula. You want small pieces to pop in the oil when the oil gets hot but not so hot that it's burned, and they will be soggy. Cook for a few minutes until bubbly and beginning to get a bit crispy. You can serve this when it's warm, but i really prefer it cold. Serve with fruit as a topping.

title: Feta and Raspberry Curd
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 2 ounces feta cheese ( crumbled ) | 2 tablespoons raspberry ( drained raspberries ) or 2 tablespoons pineapple ( drained raspberries ) | 1 tablespoon capers, drained
instructions: Add the garam masala powder to the feta and mix well until the feta is coated. Add the raspberry or pineapple and stir to coat. Serve at room temperature.

title: Akkwa (Fried Spring Onions)
ingredients: 300 g spring onions, trimmed | 1 kg flour ( chick pea flour )
instructions: Wash the onions and cut into 1 inch rounds. Dust the flour in a mixture and knead for about 3 minutes until the dough is smooth. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,mace,herbes de provence,plum tomato,beef sirloin steak,garlic powder,arrowroot
title: Beef with Green Chili
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin steaks, thinly sliced | 3 -4 plum tomatoes, seeded and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons minced garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon herbes de provence | 2 1/2 teaspoons arrowroot ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Roast chiles directly over broiler, turning once, until blackened all over. Place chiles in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until chilled, about 10 minutes.
