Bring large saucepan of salted water to a boil. Add tomato slices and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Arrange chilies on a platter. Cover with beef and tomato slices. Sprinkle with garlic powder, herbes de provence, and arrowroot if using. Sprinkle with mace. Serve hot.

title: Roasted Pecans and Feta
ingredients: 1 lb shelled pecans | 12 ounces feta | 3/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons accent seasoning
instructions: Spray a shallow baking container with non stick cooking spray. Spread pecans in dish, and sprinkle with salt. Roast in oven until dry, about 20 minutes. Combine all ingredients, and toss. Spread into a resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,catsup,cream mushroom soup,basmati rice
title: Rice Balls
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground red chile pepper
instructions: Place rice and cream of mushroom soup into a saucepan. Heat to boiling over medium high heat.

title: Ginger Chicken in a Jar
ingredients: 1 kg minced ginger-garlic paste ( approx 2-3 tablespoons worth ) | seasoning salt
instructions: Place all the ginger garlic paste in a bowl and add a generous amount of salt, mix well. Allow to sit for about 20 - 30 hours. To cook, heat the oven to 150c/fan 160c/gas put the mixture in an oven safe saucepan and place on the highest shelf for 30 minutes. Open the jar and place on a roasting rack above. Place in the oven at 150c/fan 160c/gas mix until the mixture has expanded. Reduce heat to 150c/fan 180c/gas after 30 minutes, put in oven for another 30 minutes. The mixture should smell wonderful and have a lovely aroma. Serve with any meal as an extra meal. Please note that although these look a lot nicer after sitting for a while, the flavour is compromised and you can use any of your flavouring alternatives such as, a mild/mediterranean/spice blend to a light/spice mix of, citric acid, black pepper etc. I have also used other spices similar to the ginger and garlic, but this taste is entirely based on the taste preferences.

Random Ingredients: white bean,black cardamom pod,kosher salt black pepper,cocoa,ice water,harissa,onion,turmeric
title: White Bean Indian Style
ingredients: 1 lb dried cannellini white beans, washed and picked over and drained | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 6 cups ice water | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa ( or other spicy red curry paste ) | 4 black cardamom pods, cracked in their pod | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne or 1/4-1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Combine the beans, spices and ice in a large pot or dutch oven. Cover, and set over very low heat.

title: Easy Chapati Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups unbleached white flour or 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | sea salt or kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f & begin to make your chapatis dough. Use 3 1/2 cups flour to 1 1/2 cups flour & sieve into a small bowl. Using your fingertips, work the mixture with your fingertips until it pulls together in a large, smooth ball. Knead for 8 - 10 minutes or until all the flour is incorporated & your dough is soft. Roll out into a diameter & shape into a ball. Using a rolling pin or hands, stretch & fold the dough into rounds or shapes & transfer to a parchment lined baking sheet with parchment paper. Using your fingers, roll/shape the dough into a 7 inch circle & place on your baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt all the while & let sit, about 10 minutes. Bake for about 20 minutes or until the top is browned & the chapati are crisp & cooked through. Serve warm with yogurt & fresh tomato sauce.

title: Cheese-Witlof- Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 lb poundcake, at least 1-inch thickness | 1/3 cup fontina cheese and cranberry sandwich spread, grated ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh cranberries, snipped ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, lightly grease or spray the interior of a 9 x 13 inch pyrex pan. Line the sides of the pan with parchment paper. Using an electric mixer on high speed, beat the pound cake rounds on the bottom and up the sides until very pale, 1 - 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Spoon about 1 1/2 tablespoons of fontina cheese into the center of each poundcake round, then drizzle about 1 teaspoons of grated fontina cheese on top. Evenly spread half of the grated fontina cheese over the fontina cheese. Sprinkle the cranberries over the cheese. Spoon the reserved 1 1/2 tablespoons of fontina cheese over the cheesecake. Set aside or refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Bake the cake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown and the cheesecake is bubbly.

title: Swiss Biscuits
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 1 lb bisquick | 1 cup creamy butter or 1 cup margarine, softened
instructions: Preheat oven to 400° f. In medium bowl, mash pecans with fingers. Sprinkle with nuts. Mix bisquick, cream and butter with fingers until well blended. Drop 2 tablespoons biscuits onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve warm.

title: Quick Chocolate Gelato
ingredients: 5 tablespoons soymilk ( or milk ) | 4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Pour soy milk in a strainer. Place strainer over bowl and let stand 10 minutes. Place chocolate in a heavy bottom saucepan and slowly start pouring in the soy milk. Stir until smooth. Stir in cocoa powder until well blended. Pour mixture into bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and set it in the refrigerator. Let sit 10 minutes. Then, press a piece of plastic wrap onto the surface of the mixture. It will harden and become hard. Place in the refrigerator for 3 hours to set.

Random Ingredients: rice,cream tartar,couscous,irish cream,japanese soy sauce,oregano leaf,walnut,cottage cheese
title: Cocktail Balls
ingredients: 1 box couscous | 1 cup cottage cheese | 6 tablespoons irish cream ( or soy yogurt ) | 6 tablespoons sour cream or 6 tablespoons yogurt | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried walnuts | 1 teaspoon rice or 1 teaspoon barley | 1 teaspoon japanese soy sauce
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package directions. Drain and cool completely. Add cottage cheese, spices and sour cream or yogurt. Mix well and then place in refrigerator to chill. Roll into ping pong sized balls and set in a baking pan covered with parchment paper. Bake at 325 degrees for 20 minutes or until golden brown and firm.

title: Avocado and Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 bag rice noodles ( approx ) | 1/2 avocado, sliced ( optional ) | 1 garlic clove, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons cherry tomatoes
instructions: Boil the rice until it is cooked. Drain and leave to cool slightly. In a bowl, mix all the ingredients together. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: panko bread crumb,tomato paste,spanish paprika,brown sugar,poppy seed
title: Poppy Seed Baked French Bread
ingredients: 2 teaspoons brown sugar | 2 teaspoons spanish paprika | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 1 cup panko bread crumbs | 1 can tomato paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x9 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Whisk brown sugar, paprika, poppy seeds, panko, and tomato paste together in a bowl until combined well. Add bread crumbs and mix well. Turn loaf mixture onto the prepared pan. Bake in the preheated oven until a tester inserted into the loaf comes out clean, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red onion,self rising flour,ranch dressing,caper,espresso coffee
title: Cappuccino Scones
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups self-rising flour, or more if needed | 1 1/2 cups hot espresso coffee | 1 red onion, chopped | 1/3 cup capers | 1 tablespoon ranch dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Beat the espresso coffee in a small bowl and pour into the flour. Beat by hand until a doughy ball forms. Flour your hands and knead by hand until the dough gathers into a firm ball. Pat into a circle on the prepared cookie sheet. Cut into 8 pieces and place onto the prepared cookie sheet. Gently press in the onion, then mix in the capers. Brush with the ranch dressing. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Lentils from Quebec and Quebec (Lentil and Corn Soup)
ingredients: 2 cups lentils, washed and picked over | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Rinse the lentils several times in a sieve to remove the sand. Place the lentils and 1 1/2 cups water into a saucepan with a lid, bring to a boil, lower the heat, cover and simmer for 45 minutes, or until lentils are tender. Drain and reserve the liquid. In a medium saucepan, bring 1 3/4 cups water to a boil over moderate heat. Add the salt and the cornstarch, stirring until thickened slightly. Stir in the lentils.

title: Mexican Corn
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 3 -5 serrano chilies, stemmed and chopped ( about 1 1/2 cups )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until thick and flavors have melded, about 30 minutes.

title: Cucumber Patties
ingredients: 1/2 cup bulgur | 1/2 cucumber, very finely sliced | 3 green chilies, finely chopped | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup italian-style breadcrumbs | cooking oil, for frying
instructions: Put bulgur in large bowl. Toss with chopped green chilies, and add flour. Toss until combined. Form mixture into patties about 3/4 to 1 1/2 inch thick. Heat oil to approximately 350 degrees farenheit. Fry patties a few at a time in the oil for 3 minutes on each side. Remove patties from pan and serve with salsa for dipping.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,colby monterey jack cheese,fish sauce,mint leaf,kaffir lime leaf,creme fraiche
title: Spicy Cured Cheese With Mint and Chopped Kalamata
ingredients: 4 ounces colby-jack cheese | 3 tablespoons creme fraiche or 3 tablespoons sour cream | 3 tablespoons grated fresh parmigiana-romano cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon finely chopped kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped pimiento ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Muddle 1 - 2 dashes of salt and pimentos and 1 - 2 dashes of sugar until they melt and turn a slightly tart black color. Remove from pan, and place on paper towels in a bowl so the sand will drain off. Repeat with cheese until the same size. Shave 2 - 3 slices of cheese on a large platter and keep aside. Combine the remaining ingredients, and using a pastry blender, cut the cheese into thin, 1 in x 1 in chunks. Drizzle cheese mixture over cheese, and decorate with mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,chipotle chile,ricotta cheese,tagliatelle pasta noodle,stew vegetable,white fish fillet,brandy
title: Pesto Fish Tagliatelle
ingredients: 2 lbs stew vegetables, such as zucchini, zucchini stems and leaves, trimmed | 2 ounces brandy | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 lb fresh ricotta cheese | 2 chipotle chiles, canned, drained, chopped | 2 lbs firm white fish fillets, cut into 4 pieces | 1 lb tagliatelle pasta noodles, cooked, and kept warm
instructions: Preheat the broiler, setting the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat. Cut the vegetables into 2 inch pieces and place them in a medium saucepan, alternating the vegetables with the brandy. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat, cooking until just tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain off the brandy, and reserve. In a food processor, blend about 1 cup of the hot broth with the basil and 1/2 cup pesto until smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl. Stir in the ricotta. Stir the rest of the broth into the cheese mixture. Spread half of the cheese mixture over the sides of a shallow 12x6x2 inch baking dish. Top with a fish piece, breaking off pieces with the fingers if necessary. Spread half the pesto sauce over the fish. Top with a second fish piece, skin side down. Top with last piece of cheese. Cover and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the fish is cooked. Place the tagliatelle in a serving dish. Pour the warm broth over the fish and garnish with basil. Serve with the remaining pesto sauce. Cook's note, if desired, add fresh tomato sauce to the sour cream sauce. The brandy tastes great in this sauce, as does the brandy and the dried chipotle peppers.

Random Ingredients: half canning ring,arborio rice,picante sauce,tart apple
title: Apple & Orchard Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 quart half-and-half canning ring | 2 medium tart apples, peeled, cored & quartered | 1 package arborio rice or ( 6 ounce ) package carnaroli rice | picante sauce, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring the canning ring to a rolling boil on a stove over medium high heat. Once the canning ring reaches a rolling boil for the first time, quickly set it off. Immediately place the canning ring onto a plate. Place the apple quarters and orchard into the canning ring, and allow the rice to boil until the grains are tender, but still firm to the bite, about 20 to 30 minutes. Pour 2 1/2 cups of hot water into a pot, and bring to a boil. Stir in the rice, and return to a boil. Boil until the orchard and rice are tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Ladle 1/2 cup of the hot water into a bowl. Stir in the remaining hot water until it is absorbed. Stir in the picante sauce or picante sauce to serve.

title: Korean Barbecue Yogurt Sauce for Dipping
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl. Cover and chill 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: mint,italian green bean,ginger root,cocoa powder,icing sugar
title: Chocolate-Mint Frijoles
ingredients: 1 package fresh italian green beans, trimmed | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled and grated | 2 teaspoons cocoa powder, or as needed | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh mint
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil. Boil green beans for about 4 minutes, or until bright green. Cool and cut into 3/4 inch lengths. Place ginger root in a pot with enough water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and immediately remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Strain and discard ginger. Allow ginger to cool. Squeeze ginger and water out of the bean pieces. Place beans in a bowl. Stir in ginger, cocoa powder, icing sugar, and mint. Serve at once or refrigerate for up to several days.

title: Roast Pork With Vegetables and Oregano
ingredients: 200 g pork tenderloin | 1 pinch dried basil | 2 teaspoons crushed dried apple juice | 150 g red capsicums, chopped | 8 sheets lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c. Slice pork in half lengthways. Spread with the combined rub and chopped herbs. Roll in long sheets of foil. Place on a baking tray and bake for 20 minutes until cooked to your liking. Meanwhile cut capsicum into small pieces. Cook lasagne sheets and drain well. Place in a large serving bowl. Add pork and capsicum. Toss salad leaves with oregano & drizzle over pork. Serve with a salad.

title: Hazelnut Biscuits
ingredients: 3 ounces hazelnuts ( or walnut halves if you prefer ) | 1 1/2 ounces red capsicums or 1 1/2 ounces candied ginger, chopped | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped | 10 black peppercorns ( or 2 tsp ground ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 c / 350°f. Put hazelnuts, capsicum, mint and peppercorns into a food processor and pulse until the nuts become coarsely chopped. Add the baking powder and process until it forms a compact biscuit. Take biscuits from the oven and flatten biscuits by pressing them flat on a baking tray. Bake biscuits in the oven for about 10 minutes until they are pale in colour.

title: Quick & Easy Chinese Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh tomatoes ( i use an italian heirloom, but use any type of firm tomatoes ) | 4 cups picante sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh gingerroot, grated | 2 -3 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Preheat a wok or a large skillet. Gently chop the tomatoes into chunks and place them in the wok. Sprinkle the ginger on top of the tomatoes and turn on the heat to high. Cook for about 30 seconds until the ginger is a little caramelized. Remove and discard the gingerroot. Slowly stir in the picante sauce in the wok and heat through but do not boil. Pour the tomato mixture into a serving bowl. Drizzle or pour the sesame oil over the tomato mixture to keep mixture from sticking. Serve.

title: Pear and Swiss Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cups green beans, trimmed | 3 medium pears, peeled, cored, diced | 1 head romaine lettuce, large leaves, torn into bite-sized pieces | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Place the green beans and pears in boiling water and cook 2 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Shake the green beans, pears and lettuce in a large salad bowl. Sprinkle with cayenne and toss to combine. Taste and adjust seasonings.

title: Easy Mexican Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 large cucumbers, peeled and diced | 1 tablespoon fresh jalapeno, minced ( you could use more or less of your choice if you want ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | salt and pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Mix cucumbers, minced jalapenos, salt, and pepper together. Let sit for a couple of hours or refrigerate overnight for best results.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,baby carrot,whipping cream,salt,chili garlic sauce,white bean,hamburger,trout
title: Easy White Bean Chili With Smoked Trout (Beans Rellenos)
ingredients: 2 cans white beans, undrained | 1 lb minced turkey or 1 lb hamburger | 12 ounces smoked trout, chopped, skin removed | 20 baby carrots, peeled | 3 poblano chiles, seeded, finely chopped | 1 cup whipping cream | salt | chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Drain the beans and mash with either a fork or potato masher. Fry the turkey or burger until browned. Add the chilies, and cook over medium heat until they are soft. Add the bean mash, and simmer until flavors are blended well. Drain off any excess fat. Add cream, salt and chili sauce. Mix well. Serve with fresh tortilla chips. Enjoy.

title: Cuban Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1-1/2-inch slices | 3 -4 slices bread ( use cuban-style ) | 3 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Spray a 13x9 inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. Layer pork mixture between bread slices, using the guacamole as a topping. Cover top of bread with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 3 hours or up to 2 days, turning bag over halfway through the preparation of the meal.

Random Ingredients: aubergine,brown onion,head garlic,taco seasoning,chicken bouillon granule
title: Egg and Arugule Oven Roast
ingredients: 7 aubergines | 2 large heads garlic | 1/2 brown onion | 1 cup taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup brown onion, diced | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Remove aubergines and discard. Slice each half lengthwise. Slice crosswise into quarters. Place egg quarters in a baking dish. Cut off root end of garlic and separate the cloves using a paring knife. Place cut sides down on tray with a cookie sheet in oven and roast until tender. Remove from oven and set aside. Place onion and garlic on tray and roast in oven for about 10 minutes. Combine 1/2 cup taco seasoning with 1/4 cup brown onions in a medium mixing bowl. Set aside. Place aubergines in baking pan and roast for about 15 - 20 minutes or until browned. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Meanwhile, mix 1 1/2 cups taco seasoning or your favorite taco and egg seasonings together in a large bowl. Add the cooled onions and garlic and mix well. Add this to the bowl of mixture and mix well until all ingredients are incorporated and mixed into the aubergine mixture. Add seasoning mix to aubergine mixture and combine well. Preheat oven and remove foil from aubergines and spread out evenly. Bake in oven for about 20 minutes or until edges turn crusty and crispy.

Random Ingredients: baby pea,guacamole,vegetable oil,asiago cheese,lemon peel,blueberry,cream chicken soup
title: Baby Peas and Blueberry Dip in a Creamy Guacamole Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 package frozen baby peas, thawed | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2/3 cup guacamole | 2 tablespoons shredded asiago cheese | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated lemon peel | 1 can or bottle light beer | fresh baby peas, thawed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Coat an 11x7 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat, and cook the peas 1 to 2 minutes, stirring constantly until lightly browned and tender. Mix soup, guacamole, asiago cheese, lemon peel, and beer into the peas. Place peas into the prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and bubbly, about 30 minutes.

title: Fried Dates With Tahini
ingredients: 3/4 cup tahini | 1 1/4 lbs dates, sliced ( puffed or pitted )
instructions: Heat the oil to 325 degrees in a 8 or 9 inch frying pan, taking care not to burn the dates. Drop the dates into the hot oil, they will cook quickly, be light tan colored and hard. Turn over, allow some to turn, and they will keep turning a little crispy. The ones still should be a bit crisp. Remove from oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve at room temperature, warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,yellow mustard seed,creme fraiche,trout,strawberry,parsley,cumin seed
title: Smoked trout with strawberry cream sauce
ingredients: 10 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon prepared yellow mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon ground dried parsley | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 8 slices smoked smoked trout, halved horizontally | 6 fresh strawberries, sliced, for garnish
instructions: Combine the creme frache, mustard seed, cumin, parsley, cream of tartar, and 1 tablespoon of parsley in a bowl, and toss to combine. Place 3 tomato halves, cut side up, over the center of each salmon half in the creme frache mixture. Fold the left over side of each tomato over the top, and gently pour over 1/4 cup water. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Cook the trout until just cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Arrange the mushrooms over the salmon in an ovenproof serving platter. Spoon the plum tomato and strawberries over the salmon, and top with 1 tablespoon of parsley, and 1 or 2 tablespoons of cream of tartar.

Random Ingredients: tea,bacon,red chili powder,molasses,coriander,herb,green bell pepper,fava bean
title: Baked Beans With Rice and Bacon (Hukkaido)
ingredients: 2 lbs fava beans, washed and picked over | 3 slices bacon, chopped | 1 red chili powder ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/2 teaspoon chopped mixed herbs | 1/2 teaspoon chopped coriander, mixed herbs | 1/4 cup fresh tea | fresh edible, chopped fresh edible, such as edible flowers such as violets, marjoram, and basil, for garnish | 1 green bell pepper, chopped small
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f, put the fava beans into a casserole dish. Add a good splash of water and cover with a lid. Bake for 1 hour, uncover and bake for a further 30 minutes until the beans are well cooked. Slice the bacon into thin strips. Remove the beans from the oven. Drain the liquid. Mash the beans with a fork, then mix with the bacon, chili powder, molasses, mixed herbs, and coriander. Divide the beans evenly between 4 small ovenproof dishes, sprinkle over the chopped green pepper, top with the crisp bacon, and cover with the tea. Cover and bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes until the breadcrumbs turn golden and the beans are crispy and heated through.

title: Lime Ice Cubes
ingredients: 1 frozen tart shell, crusts removed | 6 fresh lime leaves
instructions: Turn freezer on to hard. Place dough in freezer for about 1/2 hour. When you are ready to serve your ice cubes, remove dough from freezer and cut in half. Using a small ice cream scoop, scoop out the bottom center of each half into long shreds. Place a strip of lime at the bottom of each shell and pull over the edge of shell like a book. Continue like before until all the shell is removed. Place ice cubes in freezer. Place a lime wedge on each ice cube. Garnish with fresh lime leaves. Serve with hard rolls or pita chips.

title: Easy Parsnips and Mango Nests
ingredients: 2 -3 medium parsnips | 3/4 cup thick & chunky salsa ( your favorite ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon mango powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Peel the parsnips and use a vegetable peeler to remove the skin. This will leave most of the visible bit of peel. Slice the parsnips in quarters then cut into smaller pieces. Arrange them in a single layer on a shallow, greased baking sheet and pour boiling water over them. Bake 15 - 20 minutes until tender crisp and browned. Let them steam until they are cool enough to handle but don't let them sit in airtight plastic bags. Combine salsa and mango powder in a small bowl and stir well. Serve them warm.

title: Almond Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin | 1 1/2 cups almond meal | 1 pint half-and-half cream
instructions: Bake or fry beef, if desired. Cut meat into strips, then brown in oil, stirring constantly. Drain fat, remove from skillet. Blend almond meal and cream, stirring until smooth. Add meat to pan, toss to coat. Serve over angel hair pasta& garnish with fresh basil.

title: Mulligatawny Polowka
ingredients: 1/4 lb golden raisin | 3/8 teaspoon ground mace or 3/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Rinse raisins and remove any stones or excess moisture with a fine sieve. Bring water to a simmer, add raisins and cook 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat, cool, cover loosely and refrigerate at least 3 hours. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving, drain and stir well. Serve with melted butter, grated cheese, chopped boiled eggs &/or mashed potatoes.

title: Airloin and Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 sirloin, trimmed of fat | 1 package frozen button mushrooms, thawed | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1 can anchovies, drained and chopped
instructions: Place steak and mushrooms in a nonstick skillet. Heat vinegar and taco seasoning in a bowl or microwave.

title: Braised Beef W- Port Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin | 2 tablespoons butter or margarine | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 cup port wine ( can use dark beer ) | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 4 tomatillos, husked, washed, and drained | crusty bread, wedges | leftover grilled or broiled bread, sliced with pickled ginger if desired
instructions: Cut the beef into small cubes. Heat the butter or margarine and oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the cubes of beef and saute 5 minutes. Add the port, mirin, turmeric, and tomatillos and coat with the dressing.

title: Orange Mayonnaise Rollaties
ingredients: 2/3 cup low-fat mayonnaise | 2/4 cup orange peel, finely grated | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Mix together. Will keep overnight refrigerated.

title: Radish and Pork Adobo
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs pork loin ( i have always used a combination of this and for a lighter meat you can use more for the amount of sauce ) | 1/4 teaspoon arrowroot ( or cornflour ) | 3 -4 leaves basil leaves, finely shredded | 2 scallions, finely chopped plus extra white bulbs and a few chopped greens | 1 -2 radish, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Mix marinade ingredients. Remove any fat and gristle from the pork and cut into slices, or leave in a container and marinate in the refrigerator for 6 - 8 hours. In a bowl, combine the meat with some of the liquid and season with salt and pepper, if using. Serve with fried egg greens, boiled rice, or fresh vegetables.

title: Rose Lime Ice for Summer Entertaining Party
ingredients: 2 cups fresh raspberries ( hulled if frozen ) | 1 tablespoon fresh rose lime juice
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in the freezer for 10 - 20 minutes or until the ice is solid. Remove from the freezer. Serve cold in tall glasses with lots of cracked ice.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,cider vinegar,self raising flour,heavy cream
title: Beef and Caramel Dumplings
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef, cubed | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon heavy cream
instructions: Put the beef and vinegar in a large covered frying pan and stir until the meat is coated in a paste. Add the flour and stir over a medium heat until the mixture comes to the boil. Cover with a lid, return to the boil, and continue to stir until the mixture has thickened and the flour has cooked off. Leave the lid ajar, and put a pot on the heat so it doesn't steam. Add 1 tablespoon of cream in a trickle to the mixture. It will boil up and froth up, but it should not form a paste. This should take about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,grit,feta cheese,miso,chunky peanut butter,wheat tortilla
title: Tyropita (Spanakopita)
ingredients: 8 ounces wheat tortillas ( or your favorite vegan tortillas ) | 1 tablespoon miso ( or soy sauce ) | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1/3 - 3/4 cup feta cheese ( depends on how creamy you like it. i use a heaping 1/3 cup! ) | 1/3 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/4 cup sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Cut tortillas in half lenghwise and spread a few shakes of miso on each. Spray rectangular sheet with pan spray and then put each half in pan, flipping once so that each half is seared on both sides. Spread each half with cream cheese. Next, spread evenly with feta until it is evenly distributed and sticks to the surface. You have a nice crunchy layer that just barely covers the cream cheese and feta. Spread peanut butter on top of the cream cheese and feta as well. Now spread creamy peanut butter on top of this and let it sit for a few minutes. Cut into wedges, or you could just serve this with a bit of hummus and fruit.

title: Lebanese Spice Mix
ingredients: 6 cups lebanese ground nutmeg or 6 cups mace, divided | 1 cup lemon peel, finely grated
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the ground nutmeg and 1 cup of grated lemon peel. Add remaining 2 cups of ground nutmeg. Mix well. With hands, mix in more nutmeg if necessary. Transfer the mixture to a baking tray and bake in one layer at c for one hour or until the spice begins to set. Store in airtight container.

title: Red Bean and Potatoes on the Barbie
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, cut into chunks | 1 can red beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons golden syrup or 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 4 teaspoons vanilla | 1/2 cup chopped red capsicum ( or green )
instructions: Barbecue or fry potato chunks over high heat, brushing with syrup and ketchup before sprinkling with other ingredients. Cook for 2 - 5 minutes or till lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: pastry shell,gruyere cheese,extra virgin olive oil,ladyfinger,lemon juice,olive oil
title: Chef John's Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 pastry shells | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil | 4 teaspoons lemon juice | 1/2 pound cold cuts, cut into thin bite-size pieces | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, coarsely grated | 1 package dry ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush the pastry shell with olive oil and place in the bottom third of a large baking sheet. Toss with lemon juice. Sprinkle cold cuts on top. Sprinkle gruyere cheese on top. Arrange the ladyfingers, with no overlapping sections, on top. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops of the ladyfingers have begun to brown slightly and the cheese has begun to turn deep golden, 10 to 15 minutes. Allow to cool to room temperature. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.

title: Bifte Restaurant Ananas
ingredients: 12 large dried figs ( i prefer golden ones but any golden will do ) | 2 tablespoons grated fresh lemongrass | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 3/4 cup crouton
instructions: Preheat the oven to 120 °c. Wash the figs and quarter them. Combine lemon grass, bicarbonate of soda and croutons. Mix well and add figs. Place the figs in an ovenproof dish and pour the bicarb soda soda mixture into the figs. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes until the figs are soft. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: ditalini pasta,snow pea,beef sirloin,gelatin,vanilla ice cream
title: Beef Filled Pasta With Snow Peas
ingredients: 3 teaspoons unflavored gelatin | 2 cups cubed cooked beef sirloin | 1 package frozen snow peas ( trimmed and thawed ) | 1 pint vanilla ice cream | 2 cups ditalini pasta
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water and set aside. Combine the beef and snow peas in a medium saucepan. Add the gelatin mixture and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until meat and peas are tender, about 10 minutes. Transfer mixture to a large bowl and cool completely. Add ice cream and mix to soften. Stir in drained gelatin mixture. Place ditalini in a large serving bowl and pour beef filling over it. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sweet N' Savoury Foil Wrapped Noodles
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cake flour | 3/4 cup walnuts | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons cognac | 1 lb spaghetti noodles
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. Remove from heat, and drain. Heat the 1 tbl. Of the oil in a large skillet, and add the nuts and the coating mix. Saute this mixture over medium heat until it just begins to brown, stirring frequently. Add the wine vinegar and cognac and continue to cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Return the pasta to the pot, mix, and serve.

title: Lamb Shanks and Scallops a La Sam
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 -2 fresh chili - stalky green chili, stemmed, seeded, minced ( i use a small hot chile ) | 1 1/2 lbs lamb shanks | 1 1/2 lbs sea scallops | 1 1/2 cups canned hominy | 1 jar plum sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In food processor combine the tahini, fish sauce and chili. Process to make a paste. Place the lamb shanks in a baking dish. Pour mixture over, and turn to coat. Cover, and bake at 375°f for 1 1/2 hours, or until the internal temperature of the lamb meat reaches 160 degrees f. Remove lamb shanks, and keep warm. Discard the chili stalk. Add 2/3 cup broth to the pan, and scrape up any browned bits on the bottom. Add 3 tablespoons of the reserved broth, and simmer over medium lowest heat, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes. Add the scallops and hominy. Stir well. Simmer for 10 minutes. Serve over hot rice. Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,dressing,cinnamon,cake,chipotle chile,flour tortilla,beef brisket,cider vinegar
title: Sweet-Sour Corned Beef Brisket Sandwiches (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 jar prepared hot pickled chipotle chiles | 2 tablespoons grated orange peel | 1 tablespoon grated fresh pineapple or 1 tablespoon drained bottled pineapple tidbits | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons flour, divided | 2 tablespoons fat-free dijon-style prepared dressing | 16 crisp-cooked 8 inch-bread rounds ( such as texas toast or sourdough )
instructions: Combine the remaining ingredients except the garnishes in a 4 to 6 quart slow cooker. Add the brisket, then cover and cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 1/2 hours. When the brisket is tender, remove it to a cutting board. Slice across the grain of the brisket in 1/4 inch slices. Place the slices on a serving platter and top with the pickled peppers, drizzled with the dijon dressing, and garnish with the garnishes.

title: Chinese Chicken Burgers
ingredients: 4 lbs hamburger buns, buttered | 2 lbs hamburger chicken wings | 2/3 cup hamburger bun, sandwich style | 1 jar pimientos | 1 dash sesame oil | 1 dash cold water
instructions: Pre heat your grill. Make 4 patties, about 3/4 high. Mix meat up with your hands and poke in the center of each patty a few times with a fork or skewer. Place on a grill, cook on each side until nicely browned. Drain on paper towels and keep warm. If there is any meat left, let the grease drip out if you use it again on the grill. Serve on the bun with your favorite condiments.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,adobo seasoning,baby spinach leaf,grain white rice
title: Mexican Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach & romaine ( about 4 6 cups ) | 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 3 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the orange juice, adobo, and salt. Add the rice and stir until coated. Transfer to a salad bowl and toss salad. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,ginger paste,plum tomato,cream cheese herb
title: Savory Tomato Butter With Ginger Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese with garlic and herbs | 1 -2 tablespoon sesame oil ( or a mix of both ) | 2 -3 -4 tablespoons ginger paste | 28 ounces can plum tomatoes, drained & chopped ( italian is my favorite, but any type will do )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Beat cream cheese, sesame oil, ginger paste & tomatoes. Spread mixture in pie pan i think it will be at least 3/4 full. Cover with foil & bake for 30 minutes. Allow to cool to room temperature. Uncover & refrigerate for at least a day before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,coconut,adobo sauce,almond extract,quinoa,pork chop,vermouth,allspice
title: Chicken Skewers With a Caribbean Twist
ingredients: 250 g chicken breast fillets ( cut into thin strips ) | 250 g pork chops ( cut into thin strips ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice ( or more if you like it less spicy ) | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon dry vermouth | 1/4 cup sweet vermouth | 2 tablespoons crunchy desiccated coconut ( fresh or canned ) | 1 tablespoon grated coconut ( fresh or canned ) | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon quinoa ( or rice )
instructions: Mix chicken, pork, allspice, adobo and vermouth in a bowl. Cover and leave in the fridge for at least 1 hour. Mix marinade and coconut. Heat grill to high. Thread chicken, pork, meat and coconut onto skewers about 3 or 4 at a time. Grill kebabs for about 5 minutes on each side or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: tofu,passion fruit pulp,pork shoulder,beet,granny smith apple,hamburger,mini marshmallow,chinese chili sauce
title: Mock Chops W- Pork and Beetroot Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup passion fruit pulp | 1/3 cup canned chinese sweet chili sauce | 1/4 lb finely chopped hamburger | 1/3 cup diced cooked meat or 1/3 cup ground pork shoulder | 1 granny smith apple, finely chopped | 1 small grated beetroot or 1 small beet, cooked and finely chopped | 1/3 cup mini marshmallows | 4 ounces firm tofu, cut into strips
instructions: Place the passion fruit pulp, sweet chilies and chili sauce in a sauce pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 30 seconds. Lower the sauce into a small saucepan with the meat. Heat for an additional 5 minutes to soften the meat. To assemble the mock chops, place the meat onto wooden skewers approx 1 or 2 cm wide and 8 10cm long. Brush with the passion fruit pulp, then with the soy sauce and bring to the boil, stirring occasionally. Cover tightly and simmer for 10 minutes. Set the granny smith apple and beetroot on top and season with salt and pepper. Place the tofu on top. Grill over a hot heat for 5 to 6 minutes, basting frequently with the passion fruit mixture. Serve with the mango salsa.

title: Turnips 'n' Grapes
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 can peeled turnips, drained | 1 package graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the cubed potatoes and turnips into a saucepan in enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes. Drain the turnips and turnips in a colander to get rid of excess water. Stir the turnip/potato mixture through the graham crackers and return to the oven. Bake until golden brown.

title: Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 8 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f spread some mayonnaise on each tortilla and put a good pinch of chili powder in the middle. Roll tightly and then tie in a wrap shape with kitchen thread to hold together during baking. Bake for 20 minutes, remove the wrap and sprinkle with any remaining mayonnaise.

title: Tunisian Potato and Beet Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grand marnier or 1 tablespoon orange liqueur | 1 tablespoon grand marnier or 1 tablespoon orange liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 1/2 lbs unpeeled russet potatoes, peeled or grated coarsely | 5 medium fresh prawns ( with shells ) or 5 medium beets, peeled and deveined ( with shells ) | 1 medium eggplant, sliced | 2 -3 medium dried figs | 1 package pizza crust
instructions: In a small bowl combine the 1 tbsp of grand marnier or orange liqueur, the turmeric and the 3/4 tsp salt and set aside. In a medium saucepan of boiling salted water, cook the potatoes until just tender, about 12 minutes. Drain and cool slightly. Meanwhile, in a 10 inch nonstick skillet, heat the prawns/beets with the oil over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until they turn bright pink, about 3 minutes. Remove the prawns/beets from the pan, placing them on paper towels. Increase heat to high, add the eggplant slices and cook, stirring frequently, 4 - 5 minutes. Drain the potatoes on paper towels. Sprinkle the figs over the potatoes. Spread the cooked prawn mixture evenly over the prawns/beets. Spoon the potato figs and prawn mixture over the figs and prawns. Sprinkle with 1/4 tsp salt. Preheat the oven to 425°f bake pizza for 15 minutes. Slice the pizza crust into 6 wedges. Serve warm.

title: Mom's Lamb Rolls
ingredients: 1 lamb shoulder ( or other lamb ) | 2 ounces meatballs | 1/2 cup bean sprouts ( fresh or frozen ) | celery rib
instructions: Rinse lamb and make 1/2 inch deep slits along the length of the meat joint. Spread bean sprouts out evenly all over. Starting at 1 short end, roll up the lamb, beginning at the short end. If using frozen lamb, cover all with meatballs and tie up in bundles of 4 inch lengths. Prick meatballs with a knife. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place rolls in a baking dish, with a lid slightly higher. Cover with aluminum foil. Cook until no longer pink, about 45 minutes. Remove from oven. Carefully remove foil. Slice rolls in half lengthwise, and arrange on serving platter. Drain juices from the baking dish, leaving 2 tablespoons in the bottom of each pan. Spoon enough juices in the pan to coat meatballs, then pour over rolls.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,panko breadcrumb,ice,nonstick cooking spray,lettuce leaf,salt black pepper,zucchini
title: Fried Zucchini (Or Broccoli) With Low Fat Lime Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb zucchini, sliced lengthwise | 1/2 cup shredded red cabbage | 1/3 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons nonstick cooking spray | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 cups shredded lettuce leaves | 1 1/4 cups shredded reduced-fat unseasoned panko breadcrumbs | ice
instructions: Place zucchini in a colander. Rinse well, drain and pat dry. Slice crosswise into 1/4 inch wide slices. Spray both sides with nonstick cooking spray. Set aside. Combine bread crumbs with panko and salt in a shallow bowl. Dip both sides of the lettuce leaves in lime dipping sauce. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot. Coat pan with cooking spray, add zucchini and saute 2 minutes on each side or until golden and tender. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,papaya,black olive,salt pepper,pine nut,zucchini,lemon zest,carrot
title: Caribbean Zucchini Salad With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini | 1 medium carrot | 1/4 cup black olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest | 2 large ripe olives | 1/2 cup simple syrup, made using a light honey | 1 teaspoon salt and pepper | papaya ( optional ) or other tropical fruit ( optional )
instructions: Cut ends from zucchini and carrots, cutting into 3/4 in cubes. Steam the zucchini and carrot in a steamer basket over boiling water for about 25 minutes or until completely tender. Strain the zucchini and carrots with a slotted spoon, discarding the outer leaves of the zucchini. Remove the zucchini and carrot with a slotted spoon. Toss with olive paste and allow to cool at room temperature while still somewhat warm. Remove zucchini and carrot from the syrup and gently mix with the lemon zest. Arrange zucchini, carrot, pepper and sliced olives between the layers of the prepared dressing. Serve cold or at room temperature.

title: Egg Noodle Bowl (Lazytown)
ingredients: 10 ounces egg noodles ( uncooked ) | 5 slices bacon, chopped ( lean ) | 1 lb kale, cleaned and chopped | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 3 tablespoons white flour | 1 dash pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: In a stock pot or dutch oven, brown the bacon til just crisp. Drain bacon and set aside and add egg noodles to the pot. Cook noodles till cooked and drain. While the noodles are still hot, sprinkle with the cheese. Mix the flour, pepper, and sugar together in a medium bowl. Add some cold water, as needed to make a paste. Toss the egg noodles into the bowl with the cheese and bacon. Add the chopped kale and pecans. Stir to mix and eat.

Random Ingredients: red chile,season salad dressing mix,stewing beef,olive,white chocolate chip,chickpea,italian sausage
title: Italian Nacho Dip with Beef
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut in bite size pieces | 1 lb hot italian sausage, cooked and crumbled | 10 ounces frozen chickpeas, drained ( garbonzo beans ) | 8 ounces white chocolate chips | 1 cup olive, sliced sliced in half | 2 cans stewed tomatoes and peppers ( ro-tel i get these at my local italian market ) | 1 package dry good seasons salad dressing mix
instructions: Put beef, sausage, chickpeas, and chile in a dutch oven. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese. Mix well. Add all the dressing ingredients except the olives. Heat to just simmer the mixture. Just before serving, top with olives, and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken gravy mix,cream corn,tamarind juice,cherry,chili oil
title: Aussie Corn Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 1 packet chicken gravy mix | 1 packet tamarind juice ( this is a tin of 1 ounce tamarind mixed with 1 cup boiling water ) | chili oil ( for deep frying ) | sliced cherry or chocolate, if desired
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the corn, gravy mix, tamarind and liqueur. Heat a little chili oil in a frying pan and dip the corn chips in the mixture, shaking to cover them. Fry until golden and bubbling. Serve with fresh tomato, avocado, green onion.

title: Tippy Horseradish Dogs
ingredients: 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup grated coconut | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup mild mango chutney | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 2 -3 tablespoons bottled horseradish | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into patties 4 inches across, 1 inch thick. Grill on greased grill 6 - 7 inches from heat for 3 - 4 minutes. For dipping, stir together 2 tbs. Dijonhire sauce or 2 tbs. Horseradish sauce. Note, may be made with chicken in a frying pan.

Random Ingredients: bean,picante sauce,lettuce,maraschino cherry,lime,peanut oil vegetable,quinoa,nonfat milk
title: Mexicana Quinoa Salad With Lime and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa ( i prefer red ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 1/4 cups nonfat milk | 1 medium lime, juice of | 12 8 ounces romaine lettuce or 12 ounces bibb lettuce | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 1/2 cup picante sauce, any flavor and heat up | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts or 1/4 cup cashews
instructions: For quinoa. Rinse the quinoa till the water runs clear. Tear up dry into pieces that are the size of a grain of rice. Cover the rice & leave for 2 hours. For dressing. In a non stick skillet, heat oil. Add the quinoa & stir, making sure the grains are evenly coated. Keep stirring over medium heat till the grains are coated & golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat & keep covered, stirring till quinoa is cool. After about 15 minutes of cooking the quinoa, mix the 1 1/2 cup water, milk & lime juice. Let stand for 15 minutes. Fluff up quinoa & add remaining ingredients, mix well. Serve cold.

title: Rajas Con Potato & Barley -- Scottish Sticky Rice
ingredients: 2 large white potatoes | 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed in | pearl barley, washed and drained | white pearl barley, washed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Peel potatoes.

Random Ingredients: farina,cornmeal,rom tomato,dark sesame oil,parsley flake,onion salt
title: Parsley-Sesame Baked Farina
ingredients: 3 roma tomatoes ( plum ) | 3 tablespoons cornmeal | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley flakes | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup farina
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, combine the tomatoes, cornmeal, onion salt, parsley flakes, and sesame oil. Microwave on high 15 seconds. Turn the heat to low and stir farina into the mixture. Cook on high uncovered for 5 minutes. The mixture should be the consistency of mashed potatoes. If it seems dry, you can add water. Stir to mix. Cook 3 - 5 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,chili pepper,chickpea,corn flake,cardamom pod,scotch whisky,cream
title: Chili, Garlic, Beef or Veg With Carrots
ingredients: 600 g baby carrots, cut into sticks | 300 g canned chickpeas, drained | 1/2 cup light cream ( thick ) or 1/2 cup cream light cream ( heavy ) | 1/3 cup scotch whisky | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 2 teaspoons chilli peppers, dried ( use fresh chillies or fresh chillies if unavailable ) | 1 tablespoon corn flakes, crushed
instructions: Heat a wok or large frying pan over medium heat. Add the carrots, then add the chickpeas. Stir fry for 3 - 3 minutes, until the carrots have softened. Add the cream or liqueur, whisky/cream, cardamom pods and chillies. Turn off the heat, then stir in the crushed cornflakes. Serve warm.

title: Bake Appetizer
ingredients: 6 granny smith apples, cored and sliced | 18 egg roll wraps
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Remove and discard the tips of apples. Place apples in a bowl of water and toss to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour. Unwrap the egg roll wrappers and place them on a clean, dry surface. Place a circle of apple on the wrappers, brush with egg wash or water, and fold in half diagonally with skin side facing toward the middle. Seal the edge with your fingers. Place on a baking sheet, brush with more egg wash or water and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the apples are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,pineapple chunk,beet,brown rice,chinese wine
title: Easy One Pot Chinese Beet Bake
ingredients: 1 package frozen beets, diced small | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 2 tablespoons sweet chinese wine ( i sometimes use chili sauce ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place beets in oven and cook for 25 minutes until tender. Remove from oven and mix with the pineapple. Combine the onion soup mix, brown rice, chinese wine and onion powder. Spread mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish, covering all of the beets. Place beets on mixture and bake for 30 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,plum tomato,pumpkin puree,beef broth,lasagna noodle,white vinegar,balsamic vinegar,ancho chile
title: Smoky Pumpkin Lasagna With Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 10 ounces lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup beef or 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 4 medium plum tomatoes, diced ( one large can is sufficient ) | 1 can pumpkin puree | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile | 1 teaspoon chili powder or 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Boil noodles and drain. Chop tomatoes, pumpkin, vinegar, chilies, chi powder and chilies in a food processor or blender and add to drained noodles. Layer in a 9 x 13 non stick baking dish with dry noodles, spread about 1/2 cup of tomatoes over the noodles. Cover with another 1/2 of noodles and repeat until a layer is used. Top with 1/2 of tomato mixture, another 1/2 of tomato mixture, remaining noodles, remaining tomato mixture, the rest of the tomato mixture and last 1/2 of tomato mixture. Bake in oven for 45 minutes. Top with a little balsamic vinegar if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef,soy sauce,rock shrimp,lemongrass,green pepper,ha avocado,fish sauce
title: Nuoc Cham (Eating Well)
ingredients: 500 g beef ( boneless, cut into small cubes ) or 500 g sea vegetables ( boneless, cut into small cubes ) | 1 lemongrass | fresh ginger | 1 green pepper | sweet soy sauce | fish sauce ( a taste of sipping foods works ) | honey avocado
instructions: Clean the beef, vegetables and the ginger. Cut the lemongrass into thin round slices. Thinly slice the green pepper and ginger. Cut it into strips. Taste and add sweet soy sauce. Bring a pan of water to boil. Take a large bowl and throw in the beef, vegetables and seasonings and mix. Add sweet bean sauce, toss. Serve.

title: Basmati Rice Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice ( washed, then drained and shaken dry ) | 3/4 cup tamari, divided ( or braggs liquid aminos ) | 1 egg roll wrap | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the rice in a bowl and add 1/4 cup water. Leave at least 10 minutes. Rinse the rice until water runs clear. Drain well and set aside. Place a handful of rice in front of you on your work surface and spread it out into a cone shape about 3/4 inch thick. Place a couple of sheets of eggroll wrapper along the length of the rice. Dip your finger into the water a little bit, then roll it in the rice. Lay the rice around the wrapper and roll it all around, tucking the edges in towards the center. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Place the rolls on a baking sheet, brush each with some tamari or braggs. Sprinkle your chopped parsley on top and bake in a moderate oven, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the rice is browned.

title: Italian Sausages
ingredients: 500 g swedes | 40 g dark raisins | 1 1/2 cups italian style breadcrumbs
instructions: Slice swedes in 2 cm slices, sprinkle with salt and leave to drain. Place raisins in a bowl, cover with boiling water and leave to soak for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, coat 2 ramekin dishes with cooking spray. Place a slice of swede in each ramekin, then divide in half. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake at c. For 25 minutes or until cooked and golden brown.

title: Peach Jam Pie Crust
ingredients: 2 cups plain flour | 4 tablespoons peach jam ( or apricot jam ) | 1 1/2 cups chilled tomato juice
instructions: Place flour in a food processor with jam and tomato juice. Blend until smooth and creamy looking. Scrape into a ball and gently knead for a few minutes. Place in buttered 2 cupcake/toast proof dish. Gently press dough around the edges of the dish. Leave in a cool spot for about 20 minutes. Slash with butter. Mark a cross in the centre and bake for 25 - 30 mins.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,cornflour,lasagna noodle,apricot jam,brussels sprout,cilantro,white sesame seed
title: Brussels Sprouts and Apricot Lasagna
ingredients: 400 g brussels sprouts, trimmed | 125 g apricot jam | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 60 g white sesame seeds | 3 teaspoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh cilantro | lasagna noodles, preferably large and wide if available
instructions: Slice the brussels sprouts diagonally into thick rounds. Place in a bowl with the jam, bouillon and sesame seeds and mix. Place a large non stick frying pan on a high heat. Sprinkle with the cornflour and cook for about 2 mins, stirring. Add the brussels sprouts and cook for 30secs or until crisp and tender. Sprinkle with the cilantro and serve with hot plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: white bread,cooking spray,brown sugar,lime wedge,aubergine,amarula cream liqueur,scallion,apricot
title: Grilled aubergines With Apricot Stuffing
ingredients: 25 g apricot, finely chopped | 20 g brown sugar | 7 scallions, finely sliced | 1 aubergine, small, peeled and quartered | cooking spray | 12 slices country bread | 6 tablespoons amarula cream liqueur | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: To make the stuffing, place the apricots, brown sugar, scallions and aubergines in a small dish. Spray with the oil and grill until lightly charred, about 6 minutes. Toast the bread. Remove from the heat and place in a serving bowl. Remove the apricots and fruit from the pan and scatter with marasula cream and lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,half cream,turmeric,chuck roast,raspberry,vanilla essence,wonton wrapper
title: Chile Rellenos With Chutney
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck roast, cut into 1-1/2-inch squares | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 5 tablespoons raspberry preserves or 5 tablespoons strawberry preserves | 24 wonton wrappers
instructions: To make the meat mixture, place a large skillet over high heat. Add the marinated meat and the vanilla, and stir fry for 3 to 5 minutes, or until meat is browned. Transfer to a large bowl. Add the mango chutney, half and half, and raspberries. Mix with a mixer, scraping down the sides occasionally. Place 1 tablespoon of meat mixture near one end of each wonton wrapper, and fold each corner of wrapper over the filling. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filled wrappers. Place a small bowl of water on top at all times, to keep the wraps from drying out. Cook the rugetowns, covered, in a large skillet or grill for 1 to 2 hours, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: vegan margarine,cannellini bean,almond liqueur,vegetarian bean,fish fillet
title: Spinach & Bean Salad
ingredients: 900 g vegetarian refried beans ( vegan white beans # 2 ) | 175 g cannellini beans ( vegan white beans # 2 ) | 175 g vegan fish fillets | 2 tablespoons almond liqueur | 35 g vegan margarine, melted
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix together. Put onto salad plates and serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,water chestnut,romano cheese,chicken bouillon cube
title: Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1 cup water chestnut | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup of grated romano cheese
instructions: Remove mushroom stems from stems, cut caps into 2 - 3 slices. Saute mushrooms, water chestnuts, and bouillon until water chestnuts are soft and mushrooms are soft. Mix all ingredients in a medium casserole dish and bake in a 400 degree oven for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cornmeal, Sour Cream and Cherry Crust
ingredients: 3 cups light sour cream | 1 1/8 cups cornmeal ( coarse ground ) | 10 large sour pints pitted sweet cherry ( red and black ) | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves, chopped into small pieces | 20 bitter or black treacle ( see note )
instructions: Combine sour cream and cornmeal in a bowl. Place two tablespoons of the sour cream mixture in the center of a large round of baking paper on an inverted baking tray lined with the baking paper. Place cherry halves on top. Place baking sheet in oven and turn rack to middle of oven. Bake at 300°f/180°c degrees until sour cream mixture turns light and creamy, about 60 minutes. Remove baking sheet from oven and spread remaining sour cream mixture evenly evenly over hot cherry pieces. Return baking sheet to oven, close lid and continue baking at 300°f/180°c for about 15 minutes. Remove from rack.

title: Linguine With Mushrooms, Tomatoes and Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces linguine ( or the big size if you have the little packet ) | 4 ounces fresh mushrooms, sliced thinly | 8 ounces roasted sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, sliced thinly ( not oil packed ) | 4 ounces freshly grated parmesan and romano cheese blend in a jar, mixed, roughly chopped ( about 1/2 cup of grated cheese ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh grated nutmeg | 2 1/2 cups marinara sauce, warmed ( or 1 can homemade or prepared ) | 1 small lemons or 1 small lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Cook linguine following package directions and drain. Meanwhile, saute mushrooms in a bit of olive oil in a large fry pan until they are soft. Do not over cook. Set aside. As pasta cooks, combine the sun dried tomatoes, cheese, nutmeg, lemon, and prepared marinara sauce in a bowl. When pasta is ready, ladle out 1/2 cup of the cooked pasta water. Drain spaghetti and place in a large bowl. Toss the linguine, mushrooms, tomatoes and sauce mixture with pasta. Garnish with lemon wedges.

title: Spanish Chicken Sandwich
ingredients: 1 frying chickens | 1 loaf french bread | 6 ladyfingers, split | 7 ounces chocolate, cut in 3/4 ozs | 6 slices lemon peel ( thin slices ) | 1 lemon slice ( thin slices )
instructions: Cook chicken and split sides in a pot in boiling salted water until just done, about 25 minutes. Cool slightly. Remove chicken, saving the cooking liquid. Slice chicken, cutting it open, down the length, to yield 3/4 of an inch of breast. Scoop out the stuffing. In the bowl, soak bread in hot chicken cooking liquid for 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,chicken breast half,dark soy sauce
title: Chicken Breasts in Soy Sauce.
ingredients: 4 -6 boneless chicken breast halves | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Place the chicken breasts in a non metallic dish. In a small bowl combine the dry onion soup mix and soy sauce. Pour over the chicken breasts. Cover and marinate over night in the refrigerator. Preheat the oven to 180d c. Bake for 30 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,whiskey,soy sauce,oregano leaf,green bell pepper
title: Goya Pronto
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 1 yellow squash, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3 tablespoons whiskey ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons soy sauce, soy sauce can have a bitter taste | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Combine the peppers, squash and whiskey in a nonreactive bowl, and allow to marinate at least 15 minutes, or over night. Serve chilled.

title: Pork Chop in a Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork, fat trimmed | 1 cup papaya pulp, chopped coarsely | 2 green cardamom pods
instructions: Place pork in a medium heavy saucepan and cover with water. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer until tender, about 30 minutes. Transfer pork to a plate and cover with foil. Skim off any surface residue that rises to the top. Meanwhile, in skillet on medium high heat, add papaya pulp and green cardamom pods, turning with a fork to bruise, about 10 to 12 minutes. Remove cardamom pods before serving.

title: Mexican Green Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice ( or jasmine ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder ( not mexican if it is not available ) | 1/4 cup cilantro or 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, minced | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon brandy ( to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped roasted pistachios or 1 -2 tablespoon cashews, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a medium non stick skillet, saute the rice with the cumin and a pinch of salt until grains are golden and grains are tender. Add the coriander and brandy to the rice.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,cajun seasoning,pickle juice,mushroom soup,soy sauce
title: The Best Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 2 -3 lbs beef tenderloin, fat trimmed | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 can mushroom soup | 1/2 cup pickle juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Rub cajun seasoning onto the meat. Place in roasting pan. Bake at 300 degrees for 2 hours or until internal temperature registers 140 degrees f for rare or 160 degrees f for medium. While the meat is cooking, prepare the mushroom soup. In saucepan, heat soup and pickle juice in microwave until warm. Remove from heat and whisk in the canned mushroom soup. Serve over the roast. Do not marinate. Also if you do have leftover meat from the meat, it will be easier to remove from the gravy when it cools down.

title: Steak & Asparagus Pie
ingredients: 24 ounces sirloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 head fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into thirds | 1 jar pickled mushrooms, any flavor | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 3 teaspoons adobo sauce | 0.5 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450^f. Line the 10 cake pan with foil, making sure it hangs over the sides of the pan. On a wire rack over a baking sheet, toss the asparagus with the honey, chili flakes and adobo, and spread evenly over the prepared pan. Distribute the beef evenly over the top. Cover tightly with foil, and bake in the oven 15 minutes. Turn off oven and open door to remove foil. Set oven to broil. Place puff pastry on a baking sheet and cover with aluminum foil. Broil pastry for 5 minutes, then remove pastry, and cut into 4 squares. Top with the beef and asparagus mixture, and sprinkle with cilantro. Enjoy.

title: Hot Red Chili Oil
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh red chili peppers | 2 lbs vanilla beans | 1 cup canola oil
instructions: Wash chili peppers, remove stems, remove seeds and remove veins. Place in a large skillet with 1 cup water and simmer 10 minutes. Remove pepper skins and seed and set aside. Place vanilla seeds into a small bowl and stir constantly to extract their flavor. Remove seeds from skillet. Heat oil over medium heat, place peppers in oil and fry peppers until light brown, approximately 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Place all hot peppers into a blender or food processor and puree until smooth. Return to skillet, add 1/2 cup water and adjust seasoning. Serve warm over ice cream.

title: Chipotle Con Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 cups cauliflower, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup whiskey | 1/4 cup shredded orange peel | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in cauliflower | Cook until cauliflower is tender and easily florets can be drained, about 5 minutes.

title: Veal With Capers
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, thinly sliced and sprinkled with the capers | 1 ounce jar capers, drained | 4 ounces fat-free cottage cheese
instructions: Mix the cavities with the capers in a nonstick frying pan and heat just until warm. Add the meat and cook, turning, until browned on all sides. Pour over the cottage cheese and serve.

title: Ginger-Hazelnut Bark (Chokladbollar)
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped hazelnuts | 1/2 cup grated fresh ginger root | 1 square unsweetened chocolate, broken into pieces
instructions: Place hazelnuts, ginger root, and chocolate pieces onto a baking sheet.

title: Italian Parsley Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons mayonnaise
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together or serve on salad. Serve with salad greens.

title: Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, like cinnamon | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop into greased muffin tins, about 1/2 cup apart. Bake at 350°f for 10 minutes or until golden on top.

title: Quick Raspberry & Raspberry Crumble
ingredients: 2 cups fresh raspberries | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 cup raspberry jam ( approx ) or 1 cup raspberry jam ( approx )
instructions: Turn oven shelf to 180c. Place raspberries in large baking dish. Sprinkle flour over. Bake until raspberries soften a little. Stir, scraping up any bits that cling to base. Stir. Pour onto raspberries. Stir. Bake for a couple of minutes or until raspberry topping is bubbling around the edges. Place in a bowl. Spoon over jam. Use raspberries if they are not used up. I've had raffles that are also good and sour with a bit of jam.

title: Oymilk (Vegetarian Optional)
ingredients: 1 lb white button mushrooms | 3 tablespoons soymilk ( or almond milk )
instructions: If using your standard method of brewing a mug of soymilk, you may want to make it a bit softer. Wash and clean the mushrooms. Slice the mushrooms, or more if desired, and stir them into the soymilk. If it’s easier for you to get it into the refrigerator, stir every so often so that it mixes evenly with the soymilk. When you can smell the moisture rise to the top of the mushrooms, put the lid on tightly and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. It’s really a matter of how long it’s kept in the freezer, so enjoy note, the soymilk will solidify and become oily. You can substitute soy milk with 1 cup milk if you like. You can skip the soy milk if you like. Also, if you’re using dairy milk, don’t add any dairy milk to the soymilk you may be tempted to use it for other recipes.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,beef bouillon granule,wild mushroom,cumin,tamari,pineapple,curry powder
title: Hawaiian Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 pound dried wild mushrooms | 6 tablespoons tamari | 2 cans crushed pineapple, drained | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 3 tablespoons tamari, divided
instructions: Place dried mushrooms in a bowl with enough water to cover. Set aside, and allow mushrooms to soak overnight. Drain soaking liquid, reserving water, and chop coarsely. Place dried fresh mushrooms in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,garlic salt,italian herb seasoning,rye bread,pizza sauce,thyme sprig,green olive,mirin
title: French Onion Pizza Bread
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast or 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 jar pizza sauce ( your favourite ) | 1/4 cup mirin ( sweet cooking sherry ) | 1/3 cup prepared garlic-flavored barbecue sauce or 1/3 cup hot barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup grated cheese- or 1/4 cup swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig or 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh thyme | 2 2 cups coarsely shredded whole seedless rye bread or 2 cups coarsely shredded other hard round bread | 2 teaspoons garlic salt or 2 teaspoons finely chopped garlic | 1/4 cup finely chopped green olives
instructions: In large mixing bowl of the food processor, place yeast, pizza sauce, mirin, barbecue sauce, cheese, herbs, thyme, bread and garlic salt. Process on high speed of the food processor 1 to 2 minutes or until mixture forms a ball. If dough does not stick to processor, add water bit by bit, until dough forms a ball. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead until well mixed and springy to touch, about 15 minutes. Place in a greased bowl, turning to grease top. Turn dough onto a well floured surface. Coat with oil. Cover with waxed paper or plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Divide dough in half and shape into loaves. Place on lightly floured baking sheet and shape into 6 inch diameter rounds with desired shape. Sprinkle with garlic salt and top with olives. Bake 30 minutes or just until tops begin to brown and tops sound hollow when tapped. Let cool 5 - 10 minutes before removing from baking sheet.

title: Faux Beef Turnovers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fat-free liquid gravy or 1 1/2 cups gravy | 4 packages fat-free frozen whipped topping | 2 lbs corned beef brisket, cooked well and drained
instructions: Heat gravy in microwave in large bowl to boiling, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes. Cover, raise heat to high.

Random Ingredients: celery,pineapple juice,grainy mustard,ketchup,chicken stock vegetable,dark chocolate,kahlua,tabasco sauce
title: Caribbean Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces dark chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 3/4 cup chicken stock or 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 6 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard | 2 -3 drops tabasco sauce | 1/8 cup celery, minced, or to taste | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Pour the chocolate into a heatproof bowl.

title: Cape Verde Sausages
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage | 8 papayas
instructions: Preheat over to 300 degrees f. Remove sausage from casings and rinse with cool water. Pat dry. Place sausage into a 9x12 inch baking dish, making sure each sausage is completely covered. Arrange papayas on top of the sausage. Wrap each sausage into a tight foil packet. Cook on the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until sausages are no longer pink. Remove the foil and papayas before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,jalapeno pepper,vanilla essence,water chestnut,bicarbonate soda
title: Jalapenos, Garlic and Oyster Water Chestnuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon ( or water ) | 3 fluid ounces water chestnut, drained | 4 -6 drops vanilla essence | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda ( optional ) or 1 pinch baking soda ( optional ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, deseeded, deseeded and finely diced
instructions: Place the bouillon, water chestnuts and vanilla in a small frying pan and heat slowly until the bouillon is melted, then simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in a dash of bicarbonate of soda and stir until dissolved. If your kitchen is really cool, refrigerate for a few hours to allow flavours to develop. Serve in small, warm soup bowls with plenty of freshly crushed bread to dip in the flavours. Note, while jalapeno are soaking, make sure to scrape the seeds out of each jalapeno pepper by scraping with a teaspoon or kitchen shears to remove the seeds. To rehydrate, transfer the jalapenos to a clean tea towel and rub the skin with your hand.

title: Enchiladas Verde (Green Enchiladas)
ingredients: 12 large green peppers | 1 can chicken broth | 1 -2 tablespoon white wine vinegar ( red works best ) ( optional ) | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Remove stems, seeds and membranes from the green peppers. Place in a bowl, add the chicken broth, and stir. Add the vinegar if you have it, if you want it. Cover and refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Remove meat from broth and set aside. Remove the peppers from the broth and place in a pot of boiling water. Cook for 8 - 10 minutes. Drain, saving broth. Cook the tortillas until flexible. Drain and put in the bowl with a slotted spoon and holding the tortilla shut, place it in the bowl and mix.

title: Gorditas
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina | 3 lbs beef stock or 3 lbs vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( to taste )
instructions: Heat stock to boiling in saucepan or dutch oven. Add masa harina gradually. Blend until flour is absorbed, stir until dissolved. Boil until mixture thickens and add liquid smoke. Keep warm.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,bacon grease,rotini pasta,almond extract,gingerroot
title: Quick Chinese Baked Rotini
ingredients: 5 cups rotini pasta, uncooked | 1/2 cup bacon grease | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh gingerroot | 2 tablespoons almond extract | 2 cups dry graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, set aside. Brown bacon in skillet. Remove 1/4 cup drippings from skillet, add garlic and ginger. Cook until light golden brown. Add pasta, almonds and almond extract. Stir well and transfer to greased 9x13 casserole dish. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over top and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Penne Pasta With a Yoghurt Sauce
ingredients: 400 g penne pasta | 300 ml balkan yogurt | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 150 g baked beans
instructions: Boil the pasta to al dente, until cooked through and drained. Blend the cooked rice with the yoghurt and soy sauce. In a pan, heat 1 cup of water. Add the beans and boil for about 10 minutes. Drain the pasta and mash until smooth and creamy. Add the rice to the yoghurt sauce and mix to coat. Serve asap with grated parmesan cheese and a small scattering of sliced almonds on top.

title: Pounded Beef Liver with Hot Nuts
ingredients: 1 large beef liver, sliced into 1/4 inch thick rounds | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1 1/2 cups hot paprika, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot hot pepper sauce, divided | 1 can or bottle dark beer
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Arrange the liver rounds in a single layer on a large baking sheet. Top with a bamboo shoot, and 1 tablespoon each of paprika and pepper sauce. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until no longer pink. Drain any remaining paprika on a paper towel covered plate. Top slices with remaining paprika.

title: Chinese Dumplings with Apricots and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package frozen biscuit, cut-up ( biscuits with 1- in | 4- 1/2-inch cubes, use your favorite plain plain bread crumbs or crusty french bread, if preferred ) | 1/2 cup apricot, cut into chunks | 2 ounces fresh chinese mushrooms or 2 ounces baby portabella mushrooms, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons tamari or 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup 1 % low-fat milk ( or 2-3/4 cup cream ) | lemon wedge, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375ºf. Spray a 13x9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Place the biscuits in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: tamari,taco seasoning mix,gruyere cheese,active yeast,beef stock,marjoram,red bell pepper
title: Garlic-Shredded Reuben
ingredients: 1 package dry active yeast | 1/4 cup beef stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari or 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese ( or other similar cheese of your choice ) | 4 large diced red bell peppers ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm beef stock. Combine tamari, marjoram, taco seasoning and cheese. Add to beef mixture, stirring until smooth. Stir in 1 cup of the shredded cheese. Beat until creamy and well mixed, but not doughy. Cover and let rise. Punch down and form into patties. Place on a greased cookie sheet in a single layer. Let rise 1 hour. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Bake 10 minutes. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup of shredded cheese over tops of each.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,yellow pea,pecorino romano cheese
title: Yellow Pea With Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb yellow peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup sliced monterey jack cheese
instructions: Place peas in a pot of boiling water. Heat for 3 minutes or until just tender, but still firm. Drain well. In a skillet over medium heat, combine the cheese and the pecorino romano.

title: Simple Italian Breadsticks
ingredients: 2 - 3 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 white onion, minced ( approx 1-2 tsp ) | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups very warm vinegar ( or white wine ) | 6 tablespoons melted fat | 3 packages frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f combine the crumbs, onion, yeast, and 1 1/2 cups of the melted fat in the bowl of a food processor. Process until well mixed. Add 6 tbls. Of the remaining melted fat and process until well mixed. Stir in 3 cups of the whipped topping and process just until smooth and spreadable, adding more sugar if needed to perk up the creaminess. Place the mixture on greased baking sheets, 3 sheets apart, and lightly sprinkle the top with more sugar, if necessary. Place in oven and bake for about 45 minutes, or until done. Watch carefully and remove from oven when golden brown. It should sound a bit hollow.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,italian dressing,olive,red chilies,orange peel,chicken breast meat,cherry,oat
title: Cherry Orange Chicken Salad
