ingredients: 1 package cherry rolls | 4 slices orange peel | 12 fresh red chilies - chopped | 1/2 cup olive, pitted, chopped | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 package italian dressing | 1 tablespoon crushed dried orange peel | 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cut into bite-size pieces
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the cherry rolls with the orange peel, red chilies, olives, pine nuts, italian dressing and the crushed, orange peel. Place chicken in a large serving dish and pour the marinade over the chicken. Cover and refrigerate for 4 to 4 hours, tossing occasionally.

Random Ingredients: milk,yogurt,baby rocket,oyster,malt vinegar,yellow pepper,black cardamom pod
title: Gobhi Raita (Welsh Salad)
ingredients: 2 large yukon gold oysters, about 1-1/2 pounds, scrubbed, cap on, and cracked into fine slivers | 1 1/2 tablespoons malt vinegar ( or red wine vinegar ) | 1/2 cup warm milk, not warm | 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt or 1/2 cup low fat sour cream | 1/2 cup baby rocket | 1 fresh yellow pepper, sliced thin | 1 black cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Set 4 oysters in a small, nonreactive bowl of cold water. Add 1 tablespoon vinegar and mix well. Let stand for 10 minutes. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the liquid, and coarsely chop the oysters. Return the reserved liquid to the pan and add the remaining yogurt. Bring to a boil over moderately high heat and simmer until reduced by about half, about 45 seconds. Remove from heat and stir in reserved oyster liquid, and cool slightly. Add the reserved oyster liquid. Chill the mixture. Add the rocket and yellow pepper and toss lightly. Add reserved vinegar and season with black pepper. Transfer to a warm serving platter and serve immediately. Garnish with coriander.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,pizza crust,rigatoni pasta,oat,butter,cream tartar,basmati rice
title: Rigatoni With Peking Fried Beef
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter, plus more for buttering the pan | 1 can chow mein noodles | 4 tablespoons quick oats | 24 ounces prepared prepared pre-made quenelle rigatoni pasta | 1 1/2 lbs crusty french-style baked short-grains of sirloin steak ( one steak ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup prepared crispy crusty chow mein noodles | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | fresh basil, shredded or 3 cups loosely packed fresh basil, rinsed and patted dry
instructions: Heat the 1 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet. Add the chow mein noodles, quick oats, and 1/2 cup of the prepared french style biscuits. Spread 1/4 cup of the hot noodles on the underside of the steaks, then layer 2/3 cup of the crispy crustless chow mein on top of the noodles. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Dart your steak with a meat fork, or use your fingers to poke holes in the steak all around the steak. Use two spatulas to poke holes on the meat. Add the remaining 1/2 cup of prepared french style biscuits to the skillet. Cook over high heat, turning the steaks over as they cook, until golden, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Sprinkle the noodles with the cream of tartar. Cook, stirring, for 1 or 2 minutes until the noodles are golden brown around the edges. Scatter basil and remaining toasted doughnuts over the noodles. Serve. Note, recipe can be made up to a day ahead and kept covered, refrigerated and reheated.

title: Anchovy and Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans | 2 anchovies, crushed
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Blend garlic, anchovies and chickpeas, adding more or less to taste, until desired consistency, consistency of mayonnaise.

Random Ingredients: sherry,self raising flour,sirloin,cooking oil,lime leaf,green olive,oregano leaf
title: Lime Onion Beef (Mexican Mince) Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin or 1 1/2 lbs rump steak | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1/2 cup finely chopped green olives | 2 1/2 tablespoons sherry or 2 1/2 tablespoons white wine | 1/2 cup finely chopped lime leaves | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Trim beef of all visible fat and gristle and cut in thin slices. Using a mallet, pound slice into very thin slices. Mix oregano with the flour, mix in the olives. Dip slices into the sherry or wine, then roll in the flour. Pour oil into a large frying pan, heat and fry meat in batches over a moderately high heat, for 3 minutes. Turn meat.

title: Bush (Bush) Loaf
ingredients: 1/3 cup pecans ( lightly crushed and slightly toasted in a dry frying pan for about 5 seconds in the dry frying pan ) | 8 slices pancake mix | 2 cans diced tomatoes, with juice ( i like a little less ) | 100 g patty pan ( with more ) or 100 g similar ready made patty pans ( with more ) | 200 g sliced peaches
instructions: Mix the pecans with ¾ cup of the peanuts. Spread the prepared patty pan with the rest of the nuts on two oven trays and put the tray into the fridge until needed. In a large bowl, combine the pancake crumb mixture with can of diced tomatoes with juice and ¼ cup water until well mixed, then spread the mixture evenly over the base of an oiled 28 x 18 cm loaf tin. Using a knife, slice the peaches in half and remove the pits. Cut slices diagonally into ¾ inch wide slices. Layer the peach slices over the top of the patty pan and spread them evenly. Top with the rest of the pecan crumbs. Cook the patty pan over a very low heat, covered, until quite dry. Turn the patty pan over with the spoon and cook on the other side until dry. Serve at once, with any salad or bread as an accompaniment, or as a side dish with roast pork, duck or beef on the side.

title: Brownie Mix Snack Wrap
ingredients: 1 package brownie mix | 4 whole wheat tortillas or 4 rye flour triangles
instructions: Wet your hands and shape each piece of brownie mix into a circle approximately 3 to 3 1/2 inches in diameter and 5 to 6 inches in diameter and set aside. Cut each circle into 8 pieces or triangles to serve as a snack using just the brownie mix as directed in the package. Allow each person to make his own brownies, however they like their sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: chicken,snow pea,topping,chicken wing,caraway seed,corn oil,chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Garlic Chili Wings
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, sliced | 1 lb fresh snow pea or 1 lb frozen peas, thawed | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 2 cups low-fat frozen whipped topping ( thawed ) | chicken fat, for frying, heated
instructions: Heat corn oil in a wok until hot, about 1 minute.

title: Possibly the Easiest French Dressing
ingredients: 1 can pitted ripe olives | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1/4 - 1/3 cup catsup
instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor and blend until desired consistency. Serve immediately.

title: Korean Ceviche (Vegetarian and Non-Traditional)
ingredients: 3 cups sirloin or 3 cups skirt steak, cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes | 1 package sauerkraut, rinsed and drained | 1 vanilla pod | 2 cups cucumbers, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 avocado, peeled, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | iceberg lettuce, torn into pieces
instructions: Place the pork, sauerkraut, vanilla pod, cucumber, avocado, sesame oil in a bowl with ice water until the water is cloudy. Drain and toss with cabbage, and serve.

title: Choclo and Cup!
ingredients: 400 g chuck, shaved | creme fraiche or passion fruit | chocolate shavings or cocoa, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a pan, and cook very gently for 2 - 3 hours until it begins to bubble. Serve with thick pancakes, and a sprinkling of cocoa.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,liquid honey,dark soy sauce,mint leaf,mackerel,port wine,tart apple
title: Prawns with Port Wine (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 13 )
ingredients: 600 g mackerel, cut into 2 cm florets | 1 tart apple, halved, cored and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1 dash almond extract | 3 tablespoons port wine | 1 sprig mint leaf
instructions: Place mackerel and apple slices in a lightly oiled large pan. Place over medium high heat. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes or until just heated through but still holding its shape with mallet blade. Add honey, soy sauce and almond extract. Reduce heat to medium low and cook for 1 - 2 minutes or until sauce thickens slightly. Pour over cooked mackerel and apple slices and serve with mint sprigs.

title: Zucchini & Quinoa With Lemon
ingredients: 2 zucchini, chopped | 1 cup quinoa
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in two changes of water under cold running water and drain. Bring 2 - 3 cups water to a boil in a large non stick pan over medium high heat. Add zucchini and 2 cups water. Stir well. Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook until zucchini is tender and quinoa is tender, about 15 minutes. Stir in the remaining 2 cups water. Serve with lemons on top.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,chicken broth,pesto,trout,shiitake mushroom,brown onion,veal,velveeta cheese
title: Smoked Trout and Vegetable Soup #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb smoked trout | 1/2 cup diced smoked veal | 1/2 small brown onion | 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1 package pre-shredded fat free velveeta cheese | 6 cups veggie-seasoned chicken broth | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 2 tablespoons pesto
instructions: Cook the smoked trout and ground veal. Finely dice onion and saute in a pan on medium heat. Add mushrooms and saute until the mushrooms soften a little. Season with salt and simmer a few minutes. Add both cans of broth. Add sesame seeds. Cook 10 minutes more. Add toasted sesame seeds and a few more sesame seeds to each bowl. Top with crumbled velveeta cheese. For a thicker soup, puree the soup with an immersion blender or immersion blender as you would an omelette. The soup is ready to serve as is or reheated slowly and with a dab of crouton spoon.

Random Ingredients: dill,chipotle chile adobo,beef tenderloin,lime wedge,cardamom pod,green cardamom pod,ricotta cheese
title: Spiced Provolone Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1/3 cup diced chipotle chile in adobo | 1/3 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon freshly chopped dill | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom pod | 2 green cardamom pods | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place beef in a shallow roasting pan. Roast in the lower half of oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until desired doneness. Remove from pan and let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the chipotle and ricotta cheese in a food processor and process until smooth, about 1 minute or until smooth. Place the dill, cardamom pods, green cardamom pods, and cooled beef on a cutting board. Cut along the grain of the beef, into strips that are 3 to 4 inches long and 6 to 8 inches wide.

title: Fiery Mushroom & Chilies
ingredients: 1 lb white mushroom, cleaned | 8 ounces tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds, crushed
instructions: If using fresh mushrooms, remove the hard stems and cut into smaller ones. If freezing, allow to soften slightly. If using canned mushrooms, add to chilies. Grind coriander and stir into mixture. Freeze for up to 2 weeks, or until firm.

title: Phyllo Egg Noodle Rolls
ingredients: 12 egg noodles | 1 1/2 cups chopped onions | 1 package frozen chopped onion flakes
instructions: In a medium size skillet, combine noodles, onions and onion flakes. Cook and stir over medium heat until noodles are tender. Drain noodles and onion mixture. Place noodles on a greased baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with more chopped onions and bake for 5 more minutes. Allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,barbecue sauce,red apple,flour tortilla,green chili salsa
title: Chili, Spinach and Apple Wraps
ingredients: 16 ounces green chili salsa | 16 ounces baby spinach, rinsed and drained | 6 small red apples, cored and diced | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 12 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Combine salsa, spinach and apples in a bowl. Sprinkle with barbecue sauce. Roll up tortillas burrito style and place on a lightly oiled grill pan. Cook on each side for 3 - 5 minutes, or until golden, and serve with salsa and cheese.

title: Garlic Ginger Mushrooms (Gingered or Not
ingredients: 50 g gingerroot, finely grated | 1 tablespoon garlic paste ( or 1 tsp. roasted garlic ) | 50 g marshmallows ( or regular or chocolate ) | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes
instructions: Soak the mushrooms in water for 10 - 15 minutes. Squeeze out the excess water. Put the garlic and ginger in a small frying pan and fry for 2 minutes. Add the marshmallows or chocolate and sprinkle the parsley flakes on top.

Random Ingredients: beef hot dog,green bell pepper,mint,wild rice,cornstarch,lemon
title: Wild Rice with Hot Dogs
ingredients: 12 small wild rice, uncooked | 8 beef hot dogs | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint | 1/2 red bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped green bell pepper
instructions: Prepare wild rice according to package directions. Reserve 1 cup cooking liquid. Meanwhile, trim all visible fat from hot dogs. Cut 2 of the hot dogs diagonally into 2 halves. Place cut side down in a slow cooker. Sprinkle with cornstarch. Top with reserved cooking liquid. Cover and cook on low 5 hours. Remove from heat and add mint, bell pepper and cooled black bean mixture.

title: Pizza Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups seasoned mix | 1 tablespoon ground jalapeno chile pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Mix the jalapeno pepper with seasoning powder. Brush onto bread, and bake for 7 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until toasted and fragrant.

title: Must Try Paula Deen's Mushroom Gravy, Paula Deen's Simple
ingredients: 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram ( or chopped fresh herb ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped fine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over low medium heat and stir until heated, about 3 - 5 minutes. Note, if serving on italian bread, top it with parmesan cheese or asiago cheese. To toast, preheat oven to 400 degrees. Stir fry bread well for 3 - 4 minutes, until golden brown. Spoon over gravy.

title: Pasta Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 cup macaroni, cooked | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of fat and cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch cubes | 3 teaspoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 cup chopped green pepper | cooked macaroni, to serve
instructions: Combine mace with macaroni and beef in large bowl. Sprinkle evenly with worcestershire sauce and half the pepper. Arrange 1/2 cup of noodles in bottom of 11 x 7 x 2 inch metal dish. Spread with half of beef mixture, then cover with remaining beef mixture, noodles and remaining pepper. Cover with foil. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until noodles are tender and beef and macaroni are cooked. Remove foil, sprinkle with remaining pepper. Serve with remaining macaroni.

title: Rhubarb and Bean Dip With Pecans
ingredients: 400 g great northern beans or 400 g pinto beans, drained | 1 stalk celery, chopped | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise ( not reduced fat ) | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 tablespoon pine nuts | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh parsley, finely chopped | 1 bunch fresh rhubarb, chopped
instructions: Place beans, celery and dressing in a saucepan and cook until just softened. Add nuts and chopped parsley. Serve warm with choped fresh rhubarb.

title: Corned Beef and Potato Rounds
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 4 -6 medium potatoes, peeled and cut up | 2 chicken bouillon cubes, crushed
instructions: Place potato rounds on cutting board and spread with the meat tenderizer, roll and slice to approximately 1/4 1/2 thick. Arrange the brisket on a plate. Place brisket in a slow cooker. Cover with chicken bouillon. Cook on high 6 - 8 hours or until potatoes are tender. Remove brisket and place on a tray to cool. Use 2 forks to pull the meat apart. Put the brisket back into the slow cooker. If the potatoes are large, tear into chunks with fingers. If they are smaller, cut them up. Stir the potatoes into the meat and cook 10 minutes on high. When potatoes are cool, stir the contents of the slow cooker into the brisket. Turn the cooker to low and leave it on high for about 45 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: saffron,peach,cumin seed,gelatin,filet beef,tea,flat leaf italian parsley,guajillo chile
title: Spanish Spiced Beef With Peaches and Guajillo Chiles
ingredients: 24 ounces prepared steaks | 16 ounces guajillo chiles | 1/3 cup flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1/3 teaspoon saffron ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon gelatin | 4 cups hot brewed tea, room temperature | 4 ounces filet of beef, sliced thin
instructions: Place steaks in 13x9x2 inch baking dish and cut in half lengthwise, cutting to fit dish if necessary. Remove stems & seeds from chiles and set seeds aside. Using sharp paring knife, cut chiles lengthwise into halves, crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips, then crosswise into thin strips. Soak chiles in enough hot tea to cover until softened, about 10 minutes. Drain well. Cut steaks into 2 inch lengths and set aside. Arrange chile strips in 3 1/2 by 2 inch glass baking dish, overlapping slightly. Sprinkle with coarsely ground chiles and parsley, cumin, and saffron, if using, and sprinkle with celtic salt to taste. In food processor, combine 1/3 cup chile soaking liquid with gelatin. Cover.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,parmigiano reggiano cheese,salt,white chocolate,romaine lettuce leaf,chicken leg quarter
title: Chicken Parmesan and White Chocolate Rollups
ingredients: 2 sheets white chocolate ( semisweet ) | 1 ounce white chocolate | 2 skinless chicken leg quarters | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, finely grated | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine chocolate, white chocolate, and chicken in medium bowl. Sprinkle with taco seasoning and parmigiano and toss to coat. Spread mixture evenly on both sides of chicken.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,horseradish,orzo pasta,sirloin steak,mayonnaise,tomato sauce,chicken breast half
title: Crock Pot Italian Chicken
ingredients: 6 boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 - 1 1/2 lb uncooked orzo pasta
instructions: Place chicken in crock pot. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over chicken. Cook on high for 2 to 4 hours until chicken is cooked through and tender. Or it could also be frozen in 1 to 1 1/2 qt pan.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,chili powder,pepperjack cheese,chili oil,superfine sugar,orange bell pepper,date
title: Pepperjack Spread
ingredients: 1 package dates, cut into thin strips | 3/4 cup orange bell pepper, minced | 2 ounces pepperjack cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons mild chili powder | 2 teaspoons salt and pepper
instructions: Place dates, bell pepper and 1 ounce cheese in a food processor. Blend until chopped fine. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl and stir well. Pour into a small bowl and mix well.

title: Raspberry Swiss Mascarpone
ingredients: 1 cup raspberries, fresh picked and pitted | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, grated ( about three cups, four ounces ) | 2 tablespoons raspberry flavored ranch dressing | 1/2 cup chickpea flour
instructions: In a bowl combine raspberries and 1 cup cheese and mix well. Add remaining ingredients except for 1 cup of cheese and the flour.

title: Creamy Cauliflower, Bean, and Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower | 1/2 large green beans | 1 teaspoon dry kidney beans, crushed | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/4 teaspoon lemon twists | 1 cup cherry tomatoes or 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Carefully remove outer leaves from cauliflower. Core cauliflower and cut into thin florets. Steam or microwave steaming cut cauliflower until tender crisp, 30 to 45 seconds on each side, keeping cover very loosely as cauliflower can burn easily, but is still firm when cut into pieces. Drain thoroughly. Rinse and dry beans. In a large bowl, stir together beans, cream, and lemon. Add cauliflower and toss to coat. Garnish with tomatoes, if desired.

Random Ingredients: grape leaf,red bell pepper,spanish onion,sardine,chicken broth,ginger powder,dill
title: Sardines and Preserved Yellow Bird
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion | 1 red bell pepper | 2 cans sardines | 2 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 16 grape leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Peel and finely chop the onion and bell pepper. Place the sardines and 1 can of the sardines in a saucepan. Add all of the remaining ingredients and the grape leaves.

title: Classic Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons mustard oil, can be heaping ( preferably non-stick ) | 1 tablespoon celery, minced | 1 tablespoon heavy cream ( whipping cream, if desired )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the sweet pickle relish and mustard oil. Stir in celery. Cover, and place in refrigerator until ready to use. To use, stir in cream just before serving.

title: Macadamia Nuts and Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 1/4 cup cocoa powder | 1 1/2 cups unpeeled macadamia nuts, lightly toasted | 2 -3 scallions, including tender green tops, thinly sliced ( can use green onions ) | 2 1/2 cups tomato juice
instructions: Put the cocoa in a small, heavy saucepan using a metal spoon. Add the nuts. Cook over low heat, shaking the pan, for 2 - 3 minutes until the nuts are dark golden brown. Drain the nuts on paper towels. Spread the nuts on a large piece of aluminum foil with a lip. Drizzle with the tomato juice to moisten. Place on a cookie sheet or in a bowl, cover and refrigerate until cold and pliable about 5 hours. Serve chilled or at room temperature. You can make this right on the grill. The time to make is how long the chutney keeps, so watch the heat.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,coconut extract,apple juice,irish cream,jalapeno chile pepper,fryer chicken
title: The Best Chicken Fingers in the World!!
ingredients: 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 12 ounces frieser chickens, rinsed and patted dry | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup irish cream ( bailey's ) | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 teaspoon jalapeno chile pepper
instructions: Stir beef granules in lemonade mix well. Add chicken. Marinate chicken in spice mixture for 30 minutes. Remove chicken, reserving marinade, grill chicken until done in skillet. Slice chicken and serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,active yeast,white onion,italian herb seasoning,crabmeat
title: Italian Crab Cakes
ingredients: 1 whole small white onion | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 package active dry yeast | 1 pound fresh crabmeat, picked through for cartilage | 1 package dry penne pasta
instructions: Place the onion in a blender or food processor, and process until smooth. Add the italian seasonings, and pulse until the mixture forms small meatballs. Drain and discard the onion and herb seasoning. Cover, and set aside for 1 hour. Place the crab meat into a mixing bowl. Drain the onion mixture well, and mix with the crabmeat and penne. Cover, and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the dough in the boiling water, and cook until the pasta is cooked to your desired dente texture, about 8 minutes. Drain well in a colander, and let cool for a minute or two before refrigerating for at least 30 minutes.

title: Sweet and Sour Napa Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 lb napa cabbage, cored sliced | 2 teaspoons margarine | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 tablespoon half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: In saucepan melt margarine. Add napa cabbage and maple syrup and stir to coat evenly. Cook just 1 minute over medium heat. Add cream, stir until cream comes to a boil. Serve warm.

title: Herbs Confit(Sour Italian)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh basil leaves
instructions: In a small skillet, toast caraway seeds just until fragrant.

title: Mexican Salmon
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet | 1 splash liquid egg substitute | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon mexican oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Rinse salmon and pat dry. Lightly spray inside of baking dish w/ nonstick spray. Place salmon and skin side down on top of bed. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over salmon. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake 15 minutes more or until salmon is easily flaked w/ a fork.

title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 jar sliced pepperoncini peppers, drained | 2/3 cup dried currants
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,greek oregano,fruit,spaghetti sauce,chili oil,chunky salsa
title: Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti sauce ( spaghetti sauce. add more or less depending on how much sauce you have ) | 600 g monterey jack cheese or 600 g swiss cheese, grated | 350 g mixed fruit, drained and chopped | 1/3 cup hot chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon greek oregano ( or other spice ) | chili oil ( to taste )
instructions: Toss chopped fruit in a bowl with a couple tablespoons of good chili oil. In a separate bowl mix spaghetti sauce with other sauce ingredients. Add the cheeses in the last 2 - 3 minutes. Serve with a bowl of cooked pasta and salad bowls.

Random Ingredients: granola cereal,farmer cheese,graham cracker crust,chicken broth,yellow onion,fajita seasoning mix,canadian bacon
title: Protein Slammin' Chicken
ingredients: 1 package fajita seasoning mix | 1 cup sliced yellow onion | 1/2 package granola cereal | 1 1/2 cups farmer cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup sliced canadian bacon | 1 carton fat-free chicken broth | 1 prepared graham cracker crust
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Stir together the fajita seasoning mix, onion, and granola in a bowl or shallow pan. Stir in the farmer cheese and canadian bacon until well blended. Spread 1/4 of the fajita mixture in the bottom of the prepared graham cracker crust. Spread the 1/4 of the cheese mixture over this. Repeat 2 more times, ending with cheese on the top. Bake in the preheated oven until the topping is bubbly and the toppings are crispy, 25 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,nonstick cooking spray,cherry tomato,pineapple chunk,margarine,pine nut,thyme sprig
title: Caramelized Pineapple Slices
ingredients: 4 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 cups dried pineapple chunks, roughly chopped | 1 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 6 tablespoons pine nuts | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f mix all ingredients in a 1 1/2 quart ovenproof dish, breaking up pineapple chunks with a fork. Spray with a little oil spray and scatter with the pine nuts and thyme. Bake for about 20 minutes till heated through.

title: Pesto Skewers--Grilled Mediterranean Skewers
ingredients: 2 cups packed flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 cup purchased pesto sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the parsley and pesto using a fork. Divide the mixture into 16 squares and roll each square into a 10 to 12 inch snake with tapered ends.

title: Kuru Harayet
ingredients: 1/2 kg lamb or 1/2 kg beef | 1 cup light beni shoyu | 1/2 cup light beni cream | 1/4 cup awamori | 1/2 teaspoon pureed pumpkin | 2 tablespoons chives | 1 sprig basil | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla pod ( optional ) | 1 slice vanilla pod ( optional ) | parsley ( to garnish ) or coriander ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut the meat up to bite size pieces. Cut the cream into bite size pieces. Mix the marinade, shoyu, awamori and pumpkin together until well mixed. Place the meat and cream into a freezer bag. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Dry off the excess marinade. Grill the meat on the bbq on a moderate heat, turning it over after 5 minutes. Garnish with herbs and serve hot with fresh, crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,cooking spray,tea,soy sauce,brown rice,chuck,nonfat milk,nutmeg
title: Jalapeno Jack Beef Skillet
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 lb chuck, trimmed | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1/4 cup packed light brown rice | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 1/2 cups nonfat milk | 1 cup jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 1 cup nonfat milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Cut meat into 1/2 inch thick slices. Combine soy sauce, brown rice, nutmeg and black pepper in a large bowl. Add meat, toss to coat. Transfer to a shallow baking dish. Cover dish with foil. Bake until meat is cooked and juices run clear, about 1 hour or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Transfer meat and pan juices to medium saucepan. Whisk together 2 cups soy milk and jalapeno. Set aside 1 cup of mixture in the microwave for about one minute. Pour milk mixture into the saucepan. Heat, stirring constantly and watching closely, until mixture boils and thickens, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Pour mixture over pork and turkey and bake in a preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until pork is thoroughly cooked. To serve, mix remaining 1 cup soy milk with the jalapeno mixture. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,allspice,caper,honeydew melon,pizza crust,cooking spray,sherry wine
title: Cardamom Melon Pizza
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup chopped honeydew melon | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 4 whole allspice | 4 whole cardamom pods, cracked | 2 teaspoons capers, drained | 1 pizza crust, premade
instructions: Line a baking sheet with foil. Heat a griddle over medium heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Place melon in pan. Sprinkle with sherry. Sprinkle with allspice, cardamom pods, capers. Brush pices of paprika over melon mixture. Heat until very hot, about 3 minutes. Turn heat off. Spread on top of pizza crust. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake at 400 degrees f until crust is lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,beef stew meat,brown rice,fish fillet,plantain,dark cherry,herring fillet
title: Severnet Baked Fish and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice | 2 lbs skinless beef stew meat | 2 large eggplants | 2 medium plantains | 16 ounces herring fillets, fillet | 1 dozen dark candied cherries
instructions: Wash and cube the fish fillets. Dice the eggplants and plantains. Heat oven to 350°f. Soak rice, then cook for 20 minutes. Spread 1½ cups of the rice on one side of a greased baking tray, top with the beef, eggplant, plantains and herring. Bake for 1½ hours. Pour half the cherries in onto each piece of fish, sprinkle with remaining cherries and finally top with more rice. Bake for 5 more minutes, remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining cherries.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,kiwi fruit,tamarind paste,bulgur wheat,pork loin chop
title: Kiapagari Polow (Filipino Pork Chops With Grape Tomatoes and Tamarind Sauce)
ingredients: 1 package bulgur wheat | 1 1/4 lbs boneless pork loin chops, 3/4-inch-thick, about 5 ounces each | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes, cut in half | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and cut crosswise in 1 1/2-inch slices ( about 6 ounces ) | 3 teaspoons tamarind paste
instructions: Place bulgar wheat in a bowl and cover with 2 inches warm water.

title: French Country Mussels
ingredients: 1 cup cooked chicken or 1 cup cooked turkey | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained ( two 15-ounce cans ) | 1 can napa cabbage, coarsely chopped ( 2 medium ) | 1 can creamed cornstarch | 1/2 cup chopped chives | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon dry mustard | 2 slices canadian bacon, cut diagonally ( thick slices ) | 10 lbs mussels
instructions: Combine first 11 ingredients in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,olive oil,lemon pepper,feta cheese,pita bread,bean sprout
title: Low Fat Chicken with Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 4 pieces chicken breast halves | 1 package fat-free refried beans with pam cheese | 3 tablespoons fat free feta cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1/4 cup grated low-fat sharp cheddar cheese | 4 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Pound chicken, if necessary, to 1/4 inch thickness.

title: French Faux Trimmy's Mini-Taco Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 lb frozen ladyfinger ( half of the total will be for two mini-truffles ) | 1/4 cup honey | 1 tablespoon tamari ( or any other soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon grand marnier ( or other orange-flavored liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix ( or other soy sauce ) | cooking oil
instructions: Prepare the taco seasoning from the bottle, if you prefer, by putting it in a small zipper type baggie with air pockets. Heat the cooking oil in a skillet/skillet over medium heat. Dip your lady fingers in the oil and set aside for a moment. You will need to keep a close eye on them as they tend to burn. Cook the fingers for a few additional minutes to get them nice and brown on both sides. The idea is to keep them moist, but not turn brown. Turn the heat off if you do this. Place another pan, upside down, on the stove. Dip the ladyfingers briefly in the taco seasoning and let them dry out. Now, grab a bag, and using tongs grab the bag and the lady fingers and dip them first into the taco seasoning, then drain out the water. Repeat until all you have soaked up most of the taco seasoning. The idea is to get the taco seasoning through the bag and have a nice layer of taco/homemade goodness on top. Serve the taco on a platter and sprinkle about one or two tablespoons of the grand marnier/orange juice on top, then top with more of the grand marnier if desired. Serve while still warm with french fries, sour cream, salsa, etc.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,pita bread,irish cream,channa dal,worcestershire sauce
title: Channa Dal
ingredients: 1 cup channa dal, washed and soaked overnight | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons channa dal, washed and soaked overnight | 1 cup irish cream | 1 cup grated cheddar or 1 cup gorgonzola cheese
instructions: Heat oil over medium high heat. Add ginger garlic paste and stir fry until the raw smell is gone. Add the worcestershire sauce and stir fry for another 30 seconds. Add chana dal soaked overnight and soaked channar and mix well. Add dry pita breads that have been washed and drained. Mix well. Sprinkle grated cheeses on top and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,dark brown sugar,lemon grass,rye flour,macadamia nut,soy sauce,molasses,ancho chile powder
title: Macadamia and Rye Crisp
ingredients: 2 cups firm coconut-grated fresh coconut ( from about 3 or 4 oz. box ) | 1 teaspoon macadamia nut, ground | 1 pinch ground ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon light molasses ( or dark molasses ) | 1 tablespoon lemon grass, finely chopped ( about 2 - 2 1/2 stalks ) | 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar ( see note ) | 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 3 1/2 cups rye flour
instructions: Whisk coconut, macadamia nut, ancho pepper, molasses, lemon grass, brown sugar, soy sauce and ground chile together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,molasses,olive,peppercorn,chili pepper flake,spanish onion,honey,chicken tender
title: Spanish Chicken With Honey Mustard Molasses
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive, with | 1 tablespoon olive, with | 1 tablespoon olive, with | 1 tablespoon olive, with | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 pinch peppercorn | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes | 1 whole chicken tender, sliced very thinly | 1/2 spanish onion, peeled and sliced | 4 ounces shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 3 tbls. Of olive oil over medium high heat. Add the dry spices and stir briskly to coat the skillet. Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,rotel tomato,scallion,allspice,curry,cotija cheese,salt,beer
title: Chili Cheese & Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup beer, beer | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 1/2 ounces cotija cheese, crumbled ( about 1/3 cup ) | curry, to taste | salt, to taste | allspice, to taste | scallion, to garnish
instructions: Mix ingredients in a medium sized microwavable bowl. Microwave on high 4 minutes. Add a little water if needed to obtain desired consistency. Chill. Sprinkle with scallions. Enjoy.

title: Perfect Pork Strips (Baked)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 cup crouton ( dry ) | 1 1/4 cups coarse graham flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Cut boned pork shoulder into very fine fine matchsticks.

title: Apple Slurpee
ingredients: 1 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Scoop into jelly roll tins, filling and smoothing out. Bake at 400 degrees f. For 20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Tangerine Infused Basil
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tangerine juice | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves
instructions: Bring basil leaves and tangerine juice to boil in medium saute pan over high heat, swirling constantly. Once boiling, remove from heat, remove from heat, and stir in basil leaves. Let sit for 10 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Pesto and Shellfish Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces shell pasta | 3 ounces pesto | 4 small shallots | 2 teaspoons basil pesto | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Boil the pasta until it’s cooked but still has some bite. Cook the spinach over a gentle heat for 2 mins, until it’s starting to wilt but not runny. Rinse thoroughly and drain. Mix together the pesto, shallots, corn flour and basil and season to taste.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,monterey jack cheese,beef chuck steak
title: Cheesy Beef Steak Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 beef chuck steaks | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1/4 cup monterey jack cheese ( grated )
instructions: Combine all ingredients under broiler. Broil approximately 6 inches from the heat until meat is rare or cooked to desired degree of doneness. Serve.

title: Green Leaf Salad - Chapati Aloo
ingredients: 2 sheets small fresh turkish dried mountain ash | 4 large red sprigs radish | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( sambal olek )
instructions: Remove ash from arabian mountain ash and grind all the ingredients using coarsely ground coffee beans or coarsely ground coarsely ground rice. Keep mixture in airtight airtight tin. Keeps for up to 8 weeks. Enjoy.

title: Ritz Ground Beef for Two
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/3 cup molasses | 2 tablespoons yellow onions, minced | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds
instructions: In a large saucepan, brown ground beef until it's almost cooked through. Drain the beef, reserving 1 t. Drippings that cook off. Add the oats, molasses, chopped onions, and crushed cardamon seeds. Mix well. Add beef and heat through. This makes enough for 16 servings, depending on how thick you like your sauce. This also makes enough to stuff 16 ritz crackers.

title: Chicken Yummy
ingredients: 12 boneless skinless chicken thighs | sultanas, to sprinkle | 1/4 savory or 1/4 nutmeg | 2 tablespoons catsup | lasagna noodle
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place chicken thighs in a large roasting pan with the sultanas and savory. Drizzle with catsup and sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake in a 400°f oven for 50 - 60 minutes or until tender. Serve over noodles. To speed up, leave to cool for 45 minutes before eating.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,pork tenderloin,tart apple,campbell tomato soup,bourbon,taco flour tortilla
title: Bourbon-Apple Pork Tenderloin & Apple Enchiladas
ingredients: 3 pork tenderloin | 4 cans campbell's condensed tomato soup | 3 tablespoons bourbon | 8 fat-free taco-size flour tortillas | 2 small tart apples, diced | 1/4 cup red currant jelly
instructions: Set oven to spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cube tenderloins into strips. Combine soup, bourbon, and cheese, stirring until blended and well combined set aside. Cut tortillas into four long strips. Place one strip of the tortilla diagonally on the bottom of the baking dish, followed by one piece of the apple. Repeat with the remaining slices until all four strips are used. Spread some soup mixture on the tortillas, then top with one can of the soup mixture. Cover with an overlapping top layer of tortillas. Top with remaining soup mixture. Bake uncovered, for 30 minutes. Top with red currant jelly and bake for an additional 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,tortilla chip,monterey jack pepper cheese,vidalia onion,chocolate,ham
title: Mexican Grilled Chorizo
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin roast | 1 large vidalia onion ( coarsely cut in half ) | 4 ounces ham, coarsely chopped | 4 ounces roasted deli-style chocolates | 6 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, coarsely grated | tortilla chips
instructions: Place pork, onion and ham in large nonstick skillet. In an electric mixer, beat together pepperjack cheese and chocolates with mixer at low speed to blend well. Spread pepperjack cheese mixture on meat. Grill meat, turning once or twice, and basting with remaining cheese mixture if necessary until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees f, about 25 minutes total resting time.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,black olive,red bell pepper,bamboo shoot,monterey jack cheese,caster sugar,marshmallow
title: Black Olive Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 red bell peppers, cut into sticks | 1 cup black olives, sliced | 150 g shredded monterey jack cheese | 100 g miniature marshmallows | 50 g bamboo shoots | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1/3 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs
instructions: For the olives roll ups, lightly grease a baking tray. Place the cracker crumbs, red bell peppers, black olives, cheese, marshmallows, bamboo shoots and caster sugar in a bowl. Mix until well combined. Roll out the mixture into rectangles about 22cm x 28cm. Cut each into six 5cm sections. Roll the sections from one end to the other until coated. Place each slice on a baking tray. Sprinkle with crushed gheese. Bake the rolls for 15 minutes. Allow to cool before removing from the tray. Serve with sweet and sour yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,red wine vinegar,mustard,sake,dark red kidney bean,kaiser
title: Japanese Broccoli & Red Beans
ingredients: 3 cups thinly sliced fresh broccoli florets | 2 tablespoons dry mustard | 2 tablespoons dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 4 kaiser rolls ( meat-flavored ) | 1 tablespoon sake | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Trim or scrub the tough outer fronds from the tough stalk end of the broccoli florets. Cut the stalk into 1 inch-wide pieces. Place the broccoli over medium heat in a steamer rack or saucepan and add enough water to cover. Bring water to boil over high heat. In a skillet over high heat, brown the mustard in the mustard and discard the yellow mustard. Stir in the red beans, cover and steam for 2 minutes or until the liquid evaporates, stirring frequently. Remove 1 cup of the beans, leaving the cooking liquid remaining there for later use. Place the remaining reserved bean liquid in a separate saucepan. Bring the water to boil over high heat. Add the reserved cooked beans and the greens. Simmer, uncovered, until the greens are bright green and softened. Meanwhile, toast the rolls under the broiler for 1 to 2 minutes. To serve, break open the rolls and top a slice of toasted nori with the cooled beans and greens. Serve the rolls hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,cornmeal,haddock fillet,salt black pepper,chicken bouillon,black olive
title: Cornmeal Cranky
ingredients: 2 cans chopped black olives | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 cups grated cornmeal | 2 pounds haddock fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Pour black olives, tomato paste, bouillon, and salt, and pepper into a skillet and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, until liquid has been absorbed and flavors have blended, about 1 hour. Remove from heat, and stir in cornmeal until combined. Arrange haddock on a square of aluminum foil large enough to completely wrap up the haddock. Brush the fish with some of the cooking liquid and wrap around the fish. Place on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the haddock is easily flaked with a fork, about 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp in Mustard Browned Dry
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 3/4 cup mustard powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons whole fenugreek seeds
instructions: Cut the shrimp in half lengthwise and remove heads and tails. Remove the heads from the shrimp along with the tails attached. Set shrimp aside. Combine mustard powder, fenugreek, and mustard powder. Coat shrimp with mixture. Marinate in refrigerator for at least 3 hours or up to 3 days before cooking. Remove shrimp from the marinade and grill over direct high heat until done.

title: Spanish Spaghetti Squash With Saffron, Little Saffron-Parmesan Filling and Pink Girl Filling
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs spaghetti squash | 2 pinches saffron | salt | 1 lb ladyfinger | pepper
instructions: Clean spaghetti squash, remove strings & cut off ends. Cut squash in half, then cut on 'thick slices. Prick skin with knife or use a vegetable peeler. Sprinkle salt on the bread, put in a 400 oven until bread is toasted. Spread saffron in the pan & grill till fragrant, take out heat. Put a small amount of cooking oil in a pan, put enough pinches of saffron in it for you taste. Put a tiny bit of cooking oil onto a sheet tray, put in spaghetti squash, make sure it's nice and coated with saffron. Cook for 6 - 8 minutes over med heat, turn a few times just once. Remove from tray, put into a bowl & set on a plate, set as you make the rest in the morning,. Take a small amount of cooking oil from the pan & put it in the microwave for about 45 seconds or till the oil is very hot, make sure that you use a skillet, put it in the microwave for 15 seconds, once its hot put on the ladyfingers & pinches of saffron, put it under the grill until pinches of saffron is golden, put it in a bowl, take a knife and spread it on the table. Put a tiny bit of cooking oil in the pan & put it under the grill for 5 minutes. Remove & put in the bowl, serve in bowls.

Random Ingredients: pork,chicken broth,banana,kidney bean,dark chocolate frosting,new mexico chile powder,herbes de provence
title: Xi-Fan Madam (Chile Colorado)
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork | 2 cups chicken broth | 1 can kidney beans, undrained | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1 tablespoon new mexico chile powder | 1 ounce dark chocolate frosting | 1 banana, sliced
instructions: In a large pot, combine pork, broth, beans, herbes de provence, chile powder, and the dark chocolate frosting. Bring to a boil and simmer, uncovered, for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,soy sauce,tomato green chilies,graham cracker crumb,greek yogurt,oyster sauce
title: Quick and Easy Microwave Rice Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain fat-free greek yogurt | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1/2 cup uncooked long-grain rice | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a covered microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high power for 20 to 30 minutes until hot, stirring once or twice. Stir once or twice while grilling. Serve hot with warm pita chips, or as a topping for a healthier, gluten free, chunky snack.

title: Margarita® Steak in White Tequila Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup fine semolina | 2 sprigs fresh thyme | 1/4 cup chopped fresh sage leaves | 4 fillets, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness | 1/2 cup white tequila
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Combine beef and bread crumbs in a large bowl. Mix in semolina, thyme, sage, and fish. Place the seasoned meat on aluminum foil on a baking sheet or baking stone in a single layer. Pour the tequila into a small saucepan, add the thyme, and bring to a boil. Briefly reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Arrange the fish on the warm baking sheet. Spoon the tequila mixture all over, then bake for 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Rice With Cheese and Jaladi Snacks
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice ( about 4oz ) | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Place the rice in a pan over medium high heat. When it starts to toast a bit, stir with a wooden spoon for about a minute or two. Add the tabasco and stir again for another 30 seconds. Cover and set aside. When the rice is done, remove the cover and stir the rice into the cheese and pepper mixture until melted. Remove from the heat and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,tarragon,natural yoghurt,self raising flour,butterscotch schnapps,meatball,baking soda
title: Butterscotch and Mushroom Loaf
ingredients: 125 g butter | 1/2 cup chopped tarragon or 1/2 cup parsley | 1 1/4 cups mashed natural yoghurt | 1/4 cup natural butterscotch schnapps | 1 1/3 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 3 lbs of assorted meatballs, of your choice | 1 cup button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f / 180c / 375f / gas mark with 1 tablespoon butter/tarragon mix yoghurt with schnapps. To make meatballs stir together all ingredients until well combined. Make the mixture into a greased and lined 24 x 23 baking tin/cookie tins. Scatter meatballs over top. Bake in oven for 30 minutes or until the top has just turned golden brown. Serve in a warm oven. If using mushrooms as a topping, place them in a roasting dish and set aside to warm through.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,caramel ice cream topping,italian tomato,chicken stock cube,chocolate morsel,butter,apricot,white onion
title: Autumn Special
ingredients: 6 chicken stock cubes | 1/4 cup butter | 4 large ripe italian tomatoes, halved | 4 slices white onions | 1/2 cup apricot, chopped | 4 hamburger buns ( toasted if you like ) | butter | sweetened drizzle of caramel ice cream topping
instructions: Add the chicken stock cubes, butter and diced tomatoes into a large pot. Add the chopped onions. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the chopped apricot halves. Keep warm till serving. Toast the buns. Spread with the crushed sweet drizzles of caramel ice cream if desired. Serve with the chopped tomato halves.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,black cumin,lemon juice zest,cranberry,blueberry,chili oil
title: Creamy Cranberry Scented Cranberries
ingredients: 1 pint fresh cranberries, chopped & washed | 1 bag frozen blueberries | 8 fluid ounces whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon black cumin | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 -3 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the cranberries in a dish & cover with water. Bring to a simmer & cook uncovered for 5 minutes. Drain cranberries from cobbler & place in a bowl of ice water. Set aside to cool. Place the cranberries in the bowl of an electric food processor & process until they resemble bread crumbs. Remove the cranberry mixture from the processor & add the cream, orange zest, chilli oil, black cumin, & lemon juice to the cranberry mix. Mix until the mixture is completely combined. Pour into a baking dish lined with parchment paper. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before cutting & serving.

title: Quick "Faux Panna Cotta"
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta or linguine ) | 1 cup water chestnut, sliced | 1/3 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract ( or your favorite flavor )
instructions: Cook farfalle pasta, drain and rinse with cold water. In a non stick frying pan, brown the water chestnuts in the molasses and vanilla. Then sprinkle with the farfalle pasta, and toss to mix. Serve with more vanilla.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,saltpeter,basil pesto,linguine,grand marnier,corn cob,topping,greek feta cheese
title: Linguine With Tomato-Feta Salad and Pesto Topping
ingredients: 1 box linguine ( or linguine ) | 1/4 cup bottled-extra-virgin olive oil-packed pesto | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil pesto | 1 1/4 cups greek feta cheese | 1 cup packed fresh mint leaves | 3/4 teaspoon salt ( optional ) | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | grated fresh basil pesto
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling water until just tender, about 8 minutes. Drain well. Transfer linguine to large bowl. Drizzle with olive oil. Toss with enough pesto to coat. Add remaining pesto to sauce to coat. Sprinkle each serving with feta, mint, and salt. Serve with whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: mango,chili pepper flake,baking soda,tomato,honey,shortcrust pastry,green cardamom pod,green olive
title: Indian Mango Sausages
ingredients: 400 g ready rolled shortcrust pastry | 2 large tomatoes, roughly chopped | 1 large mango, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup chopped green olives | 1 -2 fresh chilli pepper flakes, crushed | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon ground black cardamom pod
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c lightly grease a large shallow baking dish. Line the baking dish with parchment paper or lightly grease a non stick baking paper. Cut 2 large squares of foil, fold over long edges and pinch to seal. Place on centre rack of oven and bake for 20 minutes or until pastry is crisp. Meanwhile, cook tomato, mango and olives in a large bowl in boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes or until the tomatoes are soft and starting to break down. Drain. Spread tomato mixture evenly on two pastry sheets. Mix together chilli, soda, chilli flakes and cardamon and sprinkle over the sausages. Bake for 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,chili,white sugar,tomato soup,onion soup mix,salmon
title: Creamy Fish Cakes
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup dried onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried chilli | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 1/2 lbs firm white fish fillets, cooked and diced
instructions: Sift flour into medium bowl, add dried onion soup mix, chilli, white sugar, 1 can condensed tomato soup and diced fish. Mix well, form into patties, chill if desired, and lightly coat in flour. Makes approximately 8 patties, depending on size of fillets.

title: Herbed Cornbread
ingredients: 12 slices rye bread, preferably crusty | 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 4 tablespoons herbs ( chives, parsley, basil ) | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: Cut bread slices crosswise through to form triangles. Toss together curry paste with herbs, blending well. Spread on 4 slices of bread. Place remaining four slices on top. In a glass measuring cup, dissolve cornstarch. Dip sandwiches in cornstarch. Let stand 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,fast rise yeast,kiwi fruit,pomegranate juice,milk chocolate,mango chutney,worcestershire sauce
title: Mango Mint Madness in the Microwave
ingredients: 1 large kiwi fruit, halved and sliced ( i just don't like kiwi unless you prefer sweet ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons marsala wine or 2 1/2 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup frozen mango chutney | 1 1/2 teaspoons quick-rise yeast | 3 cups milk chocolate, finely chopped | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice
instructions: Place kiwifruit slices in microwave safe bowl and cover with a dry towel. Microwave on high 30 seconds or until slightly softened. Let stand 15 minutes. Place 1/4 cup of chocolate into microwave safe bowl. Heat in microwave on high 20 seconds or until melted and smooth. Stir until smooth. Stir chutney into melted chocolate. Stir in other 1/4 cup chocolate until smooth. Stir in chutney mixture and yeast. Microwave on medium high 40 seconds or until bubbly and heated through. Stir in remaining 1 1/4 cups chocolate and microwave 10 more seconds or until melted and smooth. Stir in remaining 1/4 cup chocolate and pomegranate juice. Microwave on high 25 seconds or until chocolate is melted. Stir and microwave 10 more seconds or until bubbly. Stir and microwave 10 more seconds or until melted and smooth. Serve warm or cool.

title: Cream Cheese-Almond Bread (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 cup blanched almond | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 8 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor and blend until smooth. Pour into a 2 1/2 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on high 4 to 5 hours, or until thick. If the bread is dry, refrigerate and use immediately.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,salad oil,maraschino cherry,icing sugar,chicken breast
title: Chicken Kaffir Lime Parcels
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts, skinless, boneless, 1-inch thick or 2 lbs chicken tenders, cut into portions | 1 cup icing sugar | 1/4 - 1/2 cup salad oil | 1 kaffir lime leaf, zest of, thinly sliced | store bought maraschino cherry, for sprinkling over chicken, if desired
instructions: Cut chicken into 2 1/2 serving size pieces. Place in a large bowl with maraschinos, and icing sugar. Heat oil in a large non stick skillet over medium heat. Fry chicken, turning often, until cooked through.

title: Easy No-Cook Nuts
ingredients: 1 can no-salt-added tomato sauce | 12 large walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup loosely packed fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Pulse nuts in food processor until finely ground, about 20 pulses. Add cilantro and pulse until mixture is just combined. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: corn,tortilla chip,oregano leaf,gouda cheese,peanut,chocolate pudding mix,arrowroot
title: Gouda and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 2 packages instant chocolate pudding mix | 1/2 cup crushed peanuts | 2 tablespoons arrowroot | 1/4 cup minced fresh oregano leaves | 1 cup thinly sliced gouda cheese | 2 cups frozen corn, thawed | 1 1/2 cups coarsely broken tortilla chips
instructions: In 3 1/2 or 4 quart slow cooker, combine chocolate pudding mix, peanuts, and arrowroot. Stir in oregano and cheese. Sprinkle corn over soup.

Random Ingredients: baby shrimp,balsamic vinegar,vanilla bean,barbecue sauce,tortilla,egg noodle,shell pasta
title: Beef & Shrimp Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb baby shrimp, cooked and peeled | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 large eggs noodles | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 3 tortillas, for serving
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, toss the steak, shrimp, & vanilla bean with vinegar until well combined and well coated. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high or medium high heat. Working in batches of 3 or 4, pour half the meat mixture into the skillet & cook, stirring, until browned & cooked through. Remove to paper towels. Repeat cooking process until remaining meat is cooked. Drain any excess oil, then mix into the beef. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add egg noodles & cook for 3 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Transfer noodles to a serving bowl & top with beef & shrimp mixture. Whisk together barbecue sauce & a drizzle of glaze. Pour over salad & serve.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,french dressing,english mustard powder,pear,rice vinegar,vegetable oil
title: Pear Burgers
ingredients: 1 medium ripe pear, peeled, cored and cut into 8 slices | 1/3 cup french dressing | 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dry english mustard powder | 1/2 cup vegetable oil
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the french dressing, yogurt, rice vinegar, mustard powder and vegetable oil. Add remaining ingredients and stir gently until thoroughly mixed.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,triple sec,roast,farfalle pasta,cheese,lemon juice zest,tabasco sauce,coriander
title: Beef and Macaroni Delight
ingredients: 1/2 cup ricotta cheese or 1/2 cup low-fat ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, fresh | 1 tablespoon parmesan pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon coriander | 1/4 teaspoon sweet pepper tabasco sauce | 1 lb thinly sliced rare roast, 1/4 inch wide and cut into 1/8 inch slices | 16 ounces uncooked dried farfalle pasta, cooked
instructions: Combine ricotta, triple sec, lemon juice, parmesan, coriander and sweet pepper. Add meat, toss to coat well. Place in large dish. Cover completely with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally. Drain meat and vegetables. Add pasta and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Garnish with cilantro if desired.

Random Ingredients: chick pea,cake flour,barley,sherry wine,philadelphia cream cheese,heavy cream
title: Chilled Chickpea and Yogurt Cake
ingredients: 100 g philadelphia cream cheese | 3/4 cup miracle whip or 3/4 cup light cream | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 cup dried chick-peas, soaked in some hot water for 30 minutes and drained | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Beat philo and cream cheese until fluffy. Add other ingredients together. Fold in chickpeas. Cover and chill overnight. Spread cake mixture on a greased slice of loaf pan and bake at 180c for 20 - 25 minutes. You can add cooked rice or noodles during the last five minutes of baking.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,mace,za'atar spice mix,anise seed,yellow onion
title: Za'atar(Georgian Spice Mix) Spread
ingredients: 4 tablespoons za'atar spice mix, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine za'atar and mace in a bowl. Mix in onion, salt, and black pepper until mixture is evenly distributed.

title: Chipotle Adobo, the Best Finger Food
ingredients: 2 -3 chipotle chiles in adobo | kitchen bouquet
instructions: Put the chiles, kitchen bouquet, and kitchen bouquet in a heavy bottomed pot or skillet and cook on low for about 60 minutes, or until the chiles open up and smell slightly roasted. The food is very different and needs to be stirred regularly. The food is served warm or it may be turned into a sandwich.

title: Crazy Broccoli on Toast
ingredients: 5 1/4 ounces broccoli florets | 1 ounce cake flour | 1 ounce brandy | 3 ounces french bread | 1 ounce radish, sliced
instructions: Trim the broccoli and remove any tough ends. Cut the stem into large florets. Place into boiling water with the brandy. When the brandy boils, remove from heat and add the broccoli. Allow it to steep for 1 minute and fluff it with a fork before serving, in small stacks on a warm plate.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,romaine lettuce,onion flake,onion,green bell pepper,white bean,flat leaf parsley
title: Spanish White Bean Salad II
ingredients: 2 cans white beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup finely chopped green bell pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 1 teaspoon dried finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons finely chopped onions | 1 tablespoon chopped romaine lettuce
instructions: Drain and rinse beans thoroughly. Let stand for 5 minutes. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and chill. Serve at once.

title: Raspberry Chambord Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/4 cup margarine | 2 tablespoons chambord raspberry liquor | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a pan. Slowly add the butter until melted. Stir in the chambord, followed by the fish sauce. Stir until combined.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 1 pound ground pork
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, combine the frozen vegetables and ground pork. Cook and stir about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard,pickle juice,chive,rice,chili sauce,mix green salad leaf,beef bouillon cube
title: Sliced Meatball
ingredients: 1 tablespoon prepared mustard ( i use french's, but any mustard will do ) | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce, sriracha is a good option | 1 beef bouillon cube, pressed or 1 teaspoon instant minced onion | 1/3 cup rice, white ( uncooked or not ) | 1 - 2 cup mix greens salad leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon sweet pickle juice ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped chives
instructions: Mix mustard, chili sauce, and onion together. Add remaining ingredients except chives. Cover and place in refrigerator. About 1 hour before meatballs are to be served, add the chives. I like to serve this with a whole raw wheat buns or toasted rye bread, but i also like to roll in greens, or just roll to stuff in bun. I like to dip the meatballs into the sauce. The meatballs also freeze. Thaw if frozen.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,beef stew meat,kidney bean,vanilla extract,bulgar wheat,tarragon,simple syrup
title: Minty Beef and Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 package bulgur wheat | 1 lb boneless beef stew meat | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons fresh tarragon or 2 teaspoons oregano leaves, minced | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/3 cup simple syrup
instructions: Soak bulghur in a large bowl of cold water 15 minutes, then drain. In a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker, combine stew meat, beans, vanilla, tarragon, mint and cooled bulghur. Pour in syrup and stir to combine. Cover, and cook on high setting 15 minutes, then reduce heat to low and cook 10 minutes. Cover, and continue cooking 10 minutes, or until sauce is reduced to a glaze.

title: Curried Yogurt Balls
ingredients: 6 cups yogurt | 1/2 cup dry graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons gelatin | 2 teaspoons yeast | 2 teaspoons chiles | 2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Combine yeast and chiles and mix with yogurt. Dissolve yeast and chiles into yogurt mixture. Make balls of about 1 inch in diameter and press into baking pans, let rise for about 20 minutes, then remove from pans and let cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes. Makes about 24 balls.

title: BBQ Oat and Blueberry Porridge
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups porridge oats | 4 tablespoons barbecue sauce, for coating | 1 cup blueberries
instructions: Whisk the oats and bbq sauce together in a bowl. Place the blueberries in a bowl. Divide amongst four serving plates. Divide the oats among the bowls and top with crumbled blueberries. Add a touch more barbecue sauce.
