Random Ingredients: tomato paste,coffee,beef broth,pork tenderloin,white pepper,parmesan cheese,chorizo sausage
title: Pork Chorizo, Chile-Escarole Soup
ingredients: 1 package chorizo sausage, casings removed | 1 pound pork tenderloin, cubed | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 3 cans beef broth | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese, divided
instructions: Cook chorizo in a large skillet over medium high heat until evenly browned, stirring constantly. Drain off the fat and crumble it using a large spoon. Push the chorizo aside into the skillet and add oil to coat. Cook the pork over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add the tomato paste and beef broth. Simmer for about 10 minutes. Season with pepper. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup of the parmesan cheese, and cover. Cook for about 5 minutes until the cheese is melted and the sauce is heated through.

title: Eggy's Egg Salad
ingredients: 2 large eggs | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup chili oil | 1 head lettuce | 1 package of your favorite cooked vegetables | 1 cup of chopped canned jalapeno peppers
instructions: Cook the eggs in boiling water and add salt to eggs. Remove the yolks when they have cooled. Slice the eggs and set aside. Break up the yolks. Add the vinegar and the chili oil and whisk until it's well incorporated. Chop the lettuce leaves in half and rinse them. Place the lettuce in a big bowl. Add the egg and pour over the lettuce. Add the jalapeños and toss. Taste if it's too sour. Add any of the above and toss again. Refrigerate until cold and serve.

title: Easy Ham Cordon Bleu Soup
ingredients: 1 deli ham, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1/3 cup vegetable bouillon | 1/8 teaspoon dill weed, crushed or minced, to your taste
instructions: Brown the ham cubes or if a meat tenderizer if using deli ham. They will not be fully cooked when done, they will be slightly crispy. They will look similar to crispy bacon strips. Add bouillon and dill.

title: Italian Spam and Shrimp
ingredients: 1 package dry spam | 1 jar shrimps, drained cubed | 1 cup uncooked farfalle pasta | 2 cups crushed ice
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the spam, shrimp, and farfalle pasta, and return to a boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and serve hot.

title: Borsht- a Scandinavian Borsht
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork | 1 large beet, peeled and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix first four ingredients thoroughly together and shape into small logs about 1 1/2 inches long. Place on baking sheet and bake for 1/2 to 1 hour, until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. Slice the beets as thinly as possible and sprinkle with salt. Cool and store airtight, until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: bulk pork sausage,lime zest,elbow macaroni,red cabbage,baby carrot,chicken wing,heavy whipping cream
title: Slow Cooker Mexican Pork Sausage
ingredients: 8 links fresh pork sausage | 2 cans chicken wings, rinsed and patted dry | 2 jars baby carrots, coarsely chopped | 12 cups red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 limes, zest of | 1 lb elbow macaroni, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Brown sausages in skillet then remove from skillet and cut into 2 inch sized pieces. Place, along with accumulated juices in slow cooker and add all remaining ingredients except the pasta and cream. Mix together the meat and vegetables until no remnants of fat are seen at all. Place on top of the meat and vegetables and cook on high setting about 4 hours. Stir in pasta just before serving and serve with extra sauce.

Random Ingredients: risotto rice,brie cheese,saltine cracker,cinnamon,balsamic vinegar,iceberg lettuce,cheddar cheese,gouda cheese
title: Sweet Lettuce Risotto Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: iceberg lettuce | shredded cheddar cheese | grated smoked gouda cheese | shredded cheddar cheese | rindless cinnamon rolls | 1/2 cup dry risotto rice | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon saltine crackers | 1/2 cup fat free cheddar cheese
instructions: Wash and pick over lettuce, place in a medium size bowl, cover and set aside. Sprinkle shredded cheeses and cinnamon to lettuce and toss. Sprinkle on rices. Heat a small saucepan over medium low heat, stirring often, add vinegar and crackers. When crackers dissolve in vinegar, remove pan from heat and immediately stir in cheese.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,golden raisin,dark sesame oil,ghee,gherkin,yellow onion,snow pea
title: Gurkensalat (Fruit Salad With Sherkin)
ingredients: 8 fresh gherkins | 8 ounces golden raisins, washed | 1 bunch fresh snow pea | 1/2 yellow onion, halved and thinly sliced | 4 ounces ghee or 4 ounces light olive oil | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 f. Cut a piece of kitchen parchment about 1/2 inch thick and lightly grease inside and out with a 1/2 inch olive oil glaze. Trim the gherkins of string and cut away the root ends. Cut the peel into very thin matchsticks with a vegetable peeler, then cut the peel lengthwise into strips about 3 to 5 inches long. Scrub the snow peas and cut into large pieces.

Random Ingredients: black olive,paprika,prosciutto,lemon zest,tagliatelle pasta noodle,chipotle chile,balsamic vinegar
title: Al Patobrand Tagliatelli All'apricot
ingredients: 400 g tagliatelle pasta noodles | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 400 g smoked ham or 400 g prosciutto, cut into 4cm pieces | 200 g black olives, halved lenghtways, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 4 small chipotle chiles, cushed
instructions: Cook pasta in a large saucepan of boiling water, draining, then transfer to a warm serving dish and set aside. Combine vinegar and remaining ingredients. Whisk well, then season to taste with salt and pepper. Place pasta on a large platter or chopping board. Add the salad ingredients and mix well. Top with zest. Serve garnished with grated cheese and a sprig of fresh thyme.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,chinese sausage,curry paste,feta
title: Spicy Curried Sausages
ingredients: 16 ounces chinese sausage | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1/2 lb feta | 1 tablespoon flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: First, place the chinese sausage in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook for a few minutes. Add curry paste and cook for another minute. Cut cheese in 1/4 inch dice. After about 10 minutes, add cheese to skillet. Cook and toss for a few seconds. Squeeze excess liquid from sausage and add to skillet.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,ketchup,pumpkin puree,herb,porcini mushroom,granny smith apple
title: Crostini (Pork and Apple Tenderloin)
ingredients: 1 whole beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 1 1/4 lbs granny smith apples | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup pumpkin puree | fresh herb ( optional )
instructions: Place tenderloin, porcini mushrooms, apples, and ketchup in a small roaster. Cover and bake in a preheated 250°f oven 30 minutes per pound. Transfer meat to cutting board and slice into thin slices. Meanwhile, cook apple until tender. Cool and peel and slice into thin slices. Spread apple slices over meat.

title: Artichoke and Brandy Dessert
ingredients: 2 jars packed artichoke hearts, drained and quartered ( about 8 ounces ) | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh vegetables or 2 tablespoons purchased jarred brandy ( 2 t. ) | 1/2 cup brandy ( or half and half )
instructions: In a 2 quart or larger bowl, combine the artichokes and ricotta. Add brandy and stir to distribute the brandy throughout the cheese mixture. In a small saucepan, combine the remaining 3/4 cup of cream and a generous pinch of salt. Heat gently, but not to boiling, until the mixture just begins to warm. Pour into the cheese mixture and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,baking apple,vanilla bean,velveeta cheese,anise seed,chicken bouillon,yellow lentil,cream tartar
title: Lennie's Cottage Apple and Lentil Hot Pot
ingredients: 1 cup dried yellow lentils | 1 beef brisket | 1 teaspoon baking anise seeds | 3 cups diced baking apples | 1 cup chopped velveeta cheese | 1/3 cup sour cream or 1/3 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 - 1/2 cup prepared minced onion | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( optional )
instructions: Place lentils in crock pot, along with beef brisket. Add anise seeds, apples, cheese, sour cream, and minced onion. Pour bouillon over the ingredients in the crockpot. Cook on high for 2 1/2 hours or low for 5 to 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,cornmeal,ginger paste,corn syrup,raspberry,allspice,puff pastry,pearl barley
title: Fruit and Rice Tray Pies
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour or 1 cup barley | 1 cup cornmeal | 1/2 cup light corn syrup ( karo ) | 2 tablespoons rice flour or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger paste ( do not use bottled ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 1/2 cups raspberries, fresh or frozen | 7 -10 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | allspice | 1/4 cup cold water
instructions: For the pastry, stir together the ingredients for the base and set aside to dry for 10 - 15 mins until it turns a light, bubbly and has stopped dripping in the bottom. To make the topping, combine the ingredients for the topping in a small saucepan over a medium heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 - 20 mins until thick, stirring often. Cool the topping completely. For the topping, combine the ingredients in a large bowl. Stir to combine.. The dough should be a silky texture but a little sticky. Lightly grease 8 x 8 baking dish. Line each tray with 2 sheets of pastry, overlapping each to make a 4 inch round hole. Spoon a scant 1/4 cup of fruit/cornflour mixture into the dough hole. Using your fingers, press the mixture down gently until the top is covered. Using your fingers, spread more of the filling on top and make sure its all the way to the edge of the dough. Sprinkle the top and sides with the extra cornstarch mixture. Using a sharp knife, score the top until the mixture is about 1/2 inch in diameter. Poke holes in the top with a fork and scatter the berries on top. Bake at 425 for 15 - 20 mins or until the pastry is puffed up and lightly browned. Serve warm with sweet chilli sauce or a yogurt based chutney.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,dark sesame oil,beef broth,parsley sprig,chicken broth,pineapple chunk
title: Hawaiian Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin steaks, cut 1 1/2 inch thick, trimmed of excess fat | 1 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( i like ortega ) | 1/2 cup low sodium beef broth | 1/2 cup crushed pineapple chunk | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice or 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | fresh parsley sprig
instructions: Spray a 4 to 5 quart slow cooker with nonstick spray or line with a few pinches of saran wrap. Place beef on saran wrap.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,colby jack cheese,grain rice,salt pepper
title: Microwave Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain rice | 1 can colby-jack cheese, cubed | 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions using colby Jack cheese, 1/4 cup of italian parsley, salt, and pepper, respectively.

title: Sauerkraut Filled Veal Rolls
ingredients: 3 lbs veal | breadcrumbs
instructions: Put meat in pot, cover with water and bring to boil. Lower heat, let boil 1 hour. Cool, drain. Put bread crumbs in small bowl or ramekin and make sure all bread crumbs are squeezed out. Roll meat, moisten outside and inside with crumbs. Sear in frying pan or oven. Bacon fat is also good. Serve with boiled potatoes or noodles.

Random Ingredients: green chili,farfalle pasta,pistachio nut,rigatoni pasta,green olive,baking powder,steak,dark chocolate
title: Pistachio Beef  Rigatoni With Chiles and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, cut into 3 pieces | 1/3 cup finely chopped green chili, deveined | 1/3 cup shelled green olives | 1/3 cup shelled pistachio nut | 1 1/2 cups farfalle pasta, cooked | 1/8 teaspoon baking powder | 1/3 cup dark chocolate, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons grated dark chocolate, for coating | 1/3 cup halved pistachio nuts
instructions: Cook the flank steak in hot non stick pan, about 4 minutes on each side or until very tender. Remove steak from pan and keep warm. When steak is almost completely cooked, add 1/3 cup of green chiles, olives, pistachios and pistachios, tossing to mix and coat with chiles. Add 2/3 cup of cooked pasta and cook, stirring often, until hot. Add remaining 1/2 cup of cooked pasta and mix again. Add baking powder, mix, toss and coat the beef. Add 3 tablespoons of chocolate and grated chocolate to the meat and mix well. Serve in 4 bowl with the rest of the chile and pistachios on the side.

title: Pesto Roast Turkey
ingredients: 1 large fully cooked turkey | 1 jar red pesto sauce | 8 fluid ounces marinara sauce | pickled roasted red peppers ( optional ) or pickled smoked turkey ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Insert a thermometer in the breast to help keep it from bursting. Place the turkey breast between two pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil and place it on the rack in a roasting pan. Insert the thermometer into the breast, and spread the pesto sauce around the turkey. Place the roasting pan in the center of the preheated oven. Bake in the preheated oven, basting frequently with any pan drippings, until heated through and a thermometer reaches 180 degrees f, 20 to 25 minutes. Transfer turkey breast to a platter and remove the foil.

Random Ingredients: espresso,french baguette,extra tofu,red potato,apricot preserve,balsamic vinegar,pork chop
title: Tofu-Glazed Pork Chops With Red Potatoes and Beans
ingredients: 1 french baguette, halved horizontally and toasted | 1 lb extra firm tofu, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 6 thin pork chops | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon espresso | 1/2 lb red potato, pared and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f with rack in middle. In a single layer, toast bread until crusty and golden, about 3 minutes per side. In a 2 to 3 quart baking dish, scatter tofu, preserves, pork chops and balsamic vinegar evenly. Bake at 325 f for 20 minutes.

title: Turnip Soup
ingredients: 2 turnips | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Peel turnips and slice as thinly as possible with a knife or paring knife. Place in a saucepan, cover with just enough water to cover, and bring up to a boil. Turn off the heat, cover, and set aside at once. When the turnips are soft, drain well, and put the puréed turnip in the blender or food processor. Pour all of the liquid from the pan through a sieve into the pan, and whisk in the sour cream. Pour into soup glasses to serve.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,granny smith apple,coriander,turkey breast,beef sirloin,naan flat bread garlic,curry powder
title: Baked Turkey and Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 ounces lean ground turkey breast | 1/2 lb boneless lean beef sirloin or 1/2 lb turkey breast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons curry powder, divided | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 medium naan flat bread, toasted and cut into 32 slices ( indian or italian flavored ) | 3/4 cup thinly sliced peeled granny smith apple ( about 1 large apple ) | 1 can whole green chilies, drained and chopped
instructions: In 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish, combine first 4 ingredients.

title: Pan Fried Tilapia With Gouda Cheese
ingredients: 1 tilapia fillet ( or 4 tilapia fillet if you prefer ) | 2 slices gouda cheese
instructions: Spread the gouda cheese on each tilapia fillet. Place on griddle or frying pan over med high heat. Fry tilapia tilapia until it is cooked through. Serve with warm home made garlic bread or homemade mashed potatoes.

title: Chipotle Pilaf for Two
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs medium grain rice | 5 large chopped dates or 5 large paprika dried dates | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 -2 teaspoon finely chopped chipotle chile
instructions: Rinse rice thoroughly in a strainer and allow to drain thoroughly. Place all ingredients except the chiles in a large skillet, and fry over medium, stirring until the rice is brown and the oil begins to separate. It may take as little as 5 minutes, just enough heat time to cook the rice. Pour half of the rice into a casserole or large measuring cup and place with the remaining rice on top. Press the chiles through a small piece of cheesecloth, or press through the bread to mix, then set aside. Repeat step two with the second half of the rice and the amount of oil that has accumulated in the casserole. Heat, uncovered, over very low heat until most of the water absorbed, about 40 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Fried Fresh Russet Potatoes With Peaches and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli | 1 medium russet potato | 1 medium peach | 1 teaspoon saffron strand, soaked in warm water for 1 hour and drained | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 tablespoons minced canned peaches or 2 tablespoons chopped canned apricots | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Wash broccoli, trim off ends and cut into bite sized florets and cook in boiling water until bright green and still crisp. Drain and set aside for later. Peel potato and thinly slice lengthwise into long 1/8 inch wide strips. Cut rut into 5 inch lengths, then slice into 1 inch pieces about 1 inch wide. Peel and slice peach into thin wedges, discarding any stone or other tough or hard center of fruit. Stir fry potatoes in a bit of warm water with saffron in small heavy skillet for 5 minutes or until just tender. Combine cooked broccoli, peaches, peach wedges, soy sauce, apricots with 1/4 cup cold water and pepper flakes until boiling. Reduce heat to low and stir in mace.

title: Corn Lasagna Without Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 3 cups frozen whole kernel corn | 1 can cherry tomatoes
instructions: Brown corn and tomatoes. Cook dry noodles until just done and drain. Arrange noodles on a 9x13 glass baking dish. Sprinkle with corn mixture. Top with tomatoes and cheese. Bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,curry,stew meat,white peppercorn,feta cheese,coriander
title: Sticky Belly Backs
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, cut in chunks ( or pork ) | 2 lbs bulk italian sausage ( i use a milder sausage ) | 2 cups feta cheese, crumbled | feta cheese, crumbled ( approx 1 cup ) | 10 -12 large whole coriander | 1 tablespoon white peppercorns, coarsely crushed
instructions: Spray racks of your gas grill or large heavy skillet/skillet grill. Combine all ingredients. Spread mixture thinly inside racks and evenly over grill. Grill over medium heat, turning frequently, for 30 mins or until meat is hot and bubbly. Serve hot or cold.

title: Tangerine Chutney
ingredients: 3 tangerines | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 2 cups fresh bread crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1 teaspoon ground mustard powder | 1 teaspoon instant peel
instructions: Peel the tangerines, cut them in half lengthwise, remove the pulp and seeds, cut away the pulp and skin and cut the flesh into chunks. Combine the chicken, bread crumbs, coriander, mustard and peel, in a bowl. Stir in the tangerines. Let stand for 1 hour. Stir or shake well to prevent sticking. Stuff into sterilized jars and process in a water canner for 8 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,japanese eggplant,chunky salsa,cayenne pepper,almond meal,lime juice,goat cheese,chili pepper flake
title: Eggplant With Goat Cheese and Chile Salsa
ingredients: 4 japanese eggplants | 6 ounces goat cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon lime juice, fresh | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, red, dried, crushed | 3/4 cup chunky salsa, mild
instructions: Preheat broiler. Brush eggplants with olive oil and place skin side down on foil lined cookie sheet. Broil about 6 inches from heat about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,mineral water,chunky salsa,asiago cheese,sunflower oil,linguine,bread flour
title: Linguine With Fresh Strawberries
ingredients: 350 g linguine | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1 cup mineral water | 120 g asiago cheese or 120 g parmesan cheese, shaved | 1 liter fresh strawberries, sliced | 1 cup thick'n chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c, gas mark bring the water and 1 tbsp oil to the boil in a large heat proof jug. Add the pasta and bring back to the boil. Remove from the heat and leave for 5 mins, stir now and then. Meanwhile, place the remaining oil and flour in a large bowl. Toss the asiago/parmesan in the flour until coated. Drain the pasta in a colander, then, in batches, pour the oil into the jug and fry for a minute or two until golden brown. Put the pasta into a large ovenproof serving dish, then top with the drained, boiled water, and the strawberry slices. Pour the salsa over the top and bake in the oven for 20 mins or until warmed through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: oil,lime zest,natural bran,taco seasoning,port wine,plum tomato,kielbasa,raspberry
title: Fruit & Beer Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs plum tomatoes, cut into 1/3-inch slices | 12 ounces kielbasa, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 1 package frozen raspberries | 2 tablespoons orange-flavored zest ( from fresh oranges ) | 1 cup natural bran, divided | 1/4 cup plain dried port wine | 1/4 cup oil | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, to taste
instructions: Toss tomatoes, kielbasa, raspberries, orange zest and 1/1 cup bran in medium bowl. Combine rest of bran, 1 tablespoon bran, zest and 1/2 cup bran in blender or food processor.

title: Swedish Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup wheat germ | 2 teaspoons dry mustard powder | 1/4 cup parsley, minced
instructions: Combine wheat germ, mustard powder and parsley and mix well. Form into flat patties. Broil or bake at 450° 3 - 5 minutes on each side depending on how well done you like the texture and how crisp and slightly brown you like your toast.

title: French Onion Bake
ingredients: 4 -5 medium white onions | 8 ounces shredded swiss cheese | 2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut a deep cross in the top of each white onion. Place an inverted 1/2 cup glass jar or bowl directly on top of the onions.

title: Kielbasa With Lime
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs kielbasa | 12 -16 ounces chicken bones or 12 -16 ounces chicken wings | 1 gallon fresh mozzarella balls | 1 lime, cut in wedges | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1/2 cup grand marnier or 1/2 cup other orange-flavored liqueur
instructions: Boil your kielbasa in water until almost done. Cut your chicken into 1 inch cubes, removing any large pieces of fat or connective tissue. Boil until almost done. Drain and set aside in sink. In hot grill pan, fry kielbasa in sesame oil for 15 to 20 minutes, turning a couple times. Place pork on platter and top with mozzarella cubes. Pour the juices and wine over the top. Serve with fresh lime wedges.

title: Mama's Muffins
ingredients: 4 cups cornmeal ( fine grind ) | 2 cups brown gravy mix | 1/2 teaspoon sage | 1 large white onion ( chopped ) | 2 teaspoons lemon rind ( grated )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl. Add more cornmeal if needed to make a very thick batter. Spoon batter in 6 greased 12 hole muffin pans and spread out evenly. Bake at 350f degrees for 12 – 15 minutes or until nicely browned. Cool in pan for 2 – 3 minutes then remove from pan and let cool completely. Serve plain or with your favourite side dish.

title: Cauliflower in the Sea
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower | 1 1/2 lbs sea bass
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f combine cauliflower with sea bass.

title: Sesame  Caramelised Oranges
ingredients: 1/2 liter whole grain ice cold effervescent place or 1/2 liter store bought caramelised chocolate | 2 vanilla beans | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Wash oranges under cold water and dry them in circa 40 minutes. This is important to achieve a caramel colour. Drain orange over cheesecloth or a paper towel. This will speed up the peel. Once drained, use a skewer to poke through orange with your thumb and make cuts about 1 cm deep across the scored area of the orange. Repeat this process until you have 4 lines with cuts 3 cm apart with thin peel left on each stripe of peel. Place orange in a roasting pan and sprinkle with 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil. Heat oven to 200c/400f/gas mark 6/190°c. Place orange slices in the oven and cook slowly for 5 minutes. Remove from the oven and place the caramelised orange in a dish to cool slightly. It will be hot but not hot. Remove the slices with a slotted spoon to a baking dish and keep them in a cold oven. Reduce the oven temperature to 225c/375f/gas mark 3/120c. Crush the vanilla with a fork and place inside the oven to heat up slightly while you prepare the caramel.. Remove the vanilla pod and slice each over about 5 cm thick. Keep the ice cold to prevent the caramelating. Melt the remaining 2 teaspoons sesame oil over a medium heat in a heavy based frying pan. When hot, pour a large ladle full of ice cold effervescent place into the frying pan and allow it to set very slightly. Add the caramelized or dark sesame oil to the remaining ice cold effervescent place of oil around the outside edges of the orange slice and place in the roasting pan to caramelise. Place the orange slices on top of the caramelized or dark sesame oil, cover and leave in the oven. Heat for about 30 - 35 minutes or until the cream is reduced. Leave the orange slices to drain over a bowl of ice cold effervescent place and allow them to dry out in an oven in 30 - 40 minutes to dry out slightly. When ready to serve, remove the orange slices from the oven. Remove from the oven and keep chilled. Use a small plate as the plate to unmold the cream and pour any caramelised slices into a hot, sterilised or sterilised serving dish. Garnish with caramelised or dark sesame oil, hundreds and thousands and serve.

Random Ingredients: salsa,spice,cream tartar,nutmeg,beef stew meat,coffee,daikon radish,plain flour
title: Famous Burnt Beef Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut in half then into 4 portions | 3 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 3 cups salsa, medium heated | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon instant coffee | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 cups daikon radishes, peeled and chopped
instructions: Place meat in crockpot and stir in the flour on top. Add the mixed spice.

title: Cherry Turnips, Turnips or Shirlips. Authentic Recipe for Turnips.
ingredients: 1 lb turnip, peeled and cut into half inch by 1/4 inch slices ( peeled, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch wedges or chunks ) | 1 1/2 pints maraschino cherries
instructions: Steam turnips or shirlips over medium high heat for 7 - 10 minutes, tossing a few times, until barely tender. Transfer to a serving bowl and add cherries. Pour hot cherry juice mixture over turnips and cherries.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,poblano chile,alfalfa sprout,green chilies,yellow squash,white onion,anaheim chilies,radish
title: Mexican Yellow Squash Salsa
ingredients: 1 large green chilies or 1 large red chili | 1 large white onion | 1 anaheim chilies or 1 yellow chile | 1 poblano chilie ( optional ) | 1/4 cup of sliced and chopped radish | 1 large yellow squash | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | frozen broccoli sprout ( optional ) | sliced and sliced green chilies, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cut vegetables in 1 inch pieces, peel and dice onion and chilies. Wash & destem squash, cut it in 1 1/2 in chunks, blanch all pieces until they float to the surface, drain and place in a large bowl, season to taste with salt. Add mushrooms, soup, chilies, vegetables, sour cream, and chopped onion, to taste. Add chopped radish, green chilies, and sliced green chilies if using.

title: Grilled Coconut Zucchini
ingredients: 4 zucchini, halved lengthwise | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: Combine mustard and coconut. Place cut sides on greased grill over medium heat. Grill zucchini 4 to 5 minutes per side or until lightly charred and tender.

title: Egg Noodles With Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 8 ounces dry egg noodles | 3/4 cup fine dry white breadcrumb | 3 cups cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Boil water for noodles. Cook noodles in hot water for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse. Drain well in collander. Return noodles to pot and add bread crumbs and rice. Stir gently until well combined.

title: Almejas
ingredients: 2 cups white rice | 1 -2 anaheim chili
instructions: Start cooking your rice in a medium size pot. When your rice is finished fluff it a bit so it breaks apart a bit and mix in the peppers and chili. Enjoy.

title: Hot Tofu Salad (Yakitori Koma-Shoga No No Kakuni)
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu or 1 lb extra firm tofu ( 1 1/2 to 2 inches long ) | 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs daikon radishes or 1 1/2 lbs winter squash, about 1 1/4-1 1/2 inches in diameter
instructions: Thoroughly place all ingredients in a colander in a large bowl. Place a towel on top of the bowl, and weigh it down with a heavy object. The weight can be picked out from the sink or a strainer. Leave the tofu for several days to absorb salt. Store in the refrigerator for up to a month before use, or freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Greek Olive Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Combine the olives and marjoram in a bowl, and let chill.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,celery rib,summer savory,red lentil,mirin,coconut cream,baby green,gingerroot
title: Warm Red Lentil and Ginger Salad
ingredients: 1 cup red lentil, rinsed and picked over | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 1 large sweet potato, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1/4 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 2 tablespoons fresh grated gingerroot ( or 1/2 tsp. ginger powder ) | 5 cups mixed baby greens, shredded ( about 3/4 lb. ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/3 cup light coconut cream
instructions: In a saucepan, cover lentils with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water. Set aside. In a bowl, combine celery, sweet potato, mirin and ginger. Toss with lentils, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish with shredded greens, and coconut cream.

title: Horseradish-Toasted Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 tablespoons low-fat soymilk or 2 tablespoons light cream | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3 tablespoons fat-free half-and-half | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh bean
instructions: In a small shallow dish, combine the horseradish, cream, mustard, and half & half. Whisk well. Add the bean and whisk until just coated. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with the remaining horseradish.

title: Sicilian Noodle Cocktail
ingredients: 1 package saline crackers, divided | 2 packages thin slices prosciutto | 1 package ramen noodles
instructions: Preheat broiler. Spread 1 teaspoon cracker on each of the 2 serving plates. Top each cracker with a prosciutto slice. Break 3 ramen into pieces and place 2 ramon shrimp on top of each ramon. Top each ramon with a second slice of prosciutto. Broil until the prosciutto is lightly browned, 5 minutes.

title: Pizzatios - Mexican Grilled Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 1 cup molasses | 4 cups colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded, or more as desired
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil the grate. Stir the yeast and molasses together in a large bowl and cover with a cloth. Allow the yeast mixture to rest at room temperature until it begins to foam, 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in the cheese. Place the oven rack in the center of the oven, and preheat to 500 degrees f. Cut a slit in the top of the dough, and carefully remove the side of the loaf. Brush the loaf with beer, place on the prepared grill, and cook until golden brown on the top, about 5 minutes, working in batches if necessary.

title: Chocolate Crackle (Passover)
ingredients: 250 g cracker crumbs ( i prefer passport brand ) or 250 g graham crackers ( i prefer passport brand ) | 220 -300 g powdered cocoa ( you can use dutch )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a medium size bowl mix the baking soda with the cocoa. Using the back of a large fork take small amounts of the soda and cocoa mixture and add to the baking soda mixture and stir until well mixed. Turn mixture onto a floured, clean pastry cloth. Using the cloth, roll out the larger pieces of dough into even sized croutons. Press down firmly, then roll out again to form crackers. Spray a baking pan with cooking spray and place about 2 cm apart over the baking pan. Place the crackle on the tray and smooth with a spatula. When all the crackle are rolled out, place onto the baking sheet and bake in preheated oven until golden brown on top and dry on the edges. Leave to cool in the pan for 5 - 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Tahini Ziti
ingredients: 5 ounces ziti pasta, uncooked, broken in half | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 small tomatoes and green chilies, cut into 1/2 inch rings | 3/4 cup tahini | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies
instructions: Cook pasta in rapidly boiling salted water until al dente. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, combine cream and 1/2 cup water. Heat over medium heat until mixture simmers. Remove from heat, stir in tahini, and cool for 1 minute. Drain pasta, reserving all of the cooking water. Add pasta to cream sauce, and stir to distribute ingredients. Transfer to buttered baking dish. Sprinkle top of sauce with remaining 1/2 cup of drained pasta water. Sprinkle with tomatoes and chiles.

title: Gouda and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb gouda cheese, cut into 12 slices | 1 lb frozen italian cut green beans
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, brown the cheese. Remove the cheese and discard the accumulated fat and drippings. Add the green beans, and reduce heat to low. Cover and cook until almost tender, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,tomato basil garlic oregano,oyster sauce,active yeast,beef tenderloin,salmon fillet,baking potato
title: Grilled Beef Tenderloin W- Oyster Sauce and Potato Wedges
ingredients: 24 cups baking potatoes, halved and quartered | 1 package dry active yeast | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh tomato basil garlic and oregano, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 lbs salmon fillets, steamed, skinned, and cut into 4 pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the potatoes and dry yeast, stir in the garlic paste, oyster sauce, tomato basil and oregano. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand 10 minutes. Place the tenderloins in a plastic bag and pour the marinade into it, reseal the bag and massage to coat meat. Refrigerate the meat overnight. Drain the potato wedges and pat dry with paper towels. Spray grill rack with pam and preheat to medium. Remove meat from bag and brush all meat with olive oil. Reserve marinade. Cook the meat for 6 - 8 minutes on each side or until browned. Place lamb on grill and grill with lid closed for about 20 minutes or until meat is nice and heated through and internal temperature reaches 170 degrees. Place lamb on a cutting board. Place a piece of meat on the middle of the potato wedge, moisten with leftover marinade and moisten with more marinade. Top with potato wedge.

Random Ingredients: strawberry jam,pecorino romano cheese,italian salad dressing mix,honey,potato starch,steak,maraschino cherry,chickpea flour
title: Chef John's Flank Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 3 tablespoons honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons potato starch | 3 tablespoons peach flour | 1/4 cup chopped pecorino romano cheese | 36 slices maraschino cherries, halved | 2 tablespoons strawberry jam
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat. Place the flank steak on a cutting board and slice it into 4 equal pieces. Cut each piece into 3 strips about 3 inches long. In a large bowl, mix together the italian dressing mix, honey, potato starch, and peach flour. Add the flank steak, and mix together well until completely coated with the dry ingredients. Roll each piece of flank steak into a log about 6 inches long. Arrange the skewered steak in a single layer on a broiling rack. Broil the flank steak slices until the internal temperature reaches 130 degrees f on an instant reading thermometer, 8 to 10 minutes. Turn the steak over, and brush the flank steak with the jam. Continue broiling in the preheated oven until the internal temperature is 210 degrees f, 30 to 40 minutes more. Let the beef stand for 5 minutes before slicing. Slice into 5 thin slices to serve.

title: Herb Beef (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef flank steak | 4 slices fresh galangal ( about 2 inches long ) | 1 teaspoon ground lemon rind | 1 teaspoon dried mixed herbs | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar ( to taste )
instructions: Cut beef into 8 equal slices. Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle beef with lemon or lime rind. Place meat in skillet and brown on both sides and brown evenly. Push meat aside and season with lemon or lime juice and fresh herbs. Pour rice wine vinegar over meat. Cover. Bake 2 to 3 minutes. Turn meat over and continue cooking 2 to 3 minutes longer.

title: Cheese With Pecorino (Swiss Balls, Confiture)
ingredients: 4 ounces pecorino cheese, aged | 4 ounces confectioners'sugar | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pecorino cheese, aged but freshly grated ( optional )
instructions: Mix together the grated pecorino and confectioners' sugar. Add additional cheese if more confectioners' sugar is required. Form into marble size balls. Dip into the cheese/pecorino mix. Chill overnight if too firm. If too soft, dip again before coating again.

instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine sour cream, 1 tablespoon ketchup and 1/4 teaspoon chipotle chiles in a bowl. Gently separate and reserve stems and 1/4 cup adobo sauce from sauce, reserving remaining adobo sauce from recipe. Coat chicken cutlets with 1/3 cup adobo sauce from 1/2 chipotle pepper and reserve 1/4 cup sauce. Drain cutlets and reserve leftover adobo sauce. Arrange cutlets in 2 or 3 large rectangular baking dishes. Add reserved adobo sauce to bowl and stir to combine. Top each with 1/2 cup bread crumbs. Bake chicken on racks in middle of oven until cooked through, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place reserved 1/4 cup adobo sauce, reserved reserved chipotle pepper and reserved adobo sauce in a small saucepan and simmer over low heat about 1 minute or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,vanilla extract,cream cheese,yellow onion,vinegar,brussels sprout
title: Quick Brussels Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 3 packages frozen brussels sprouts | 2 packages cream cheese, softened | 1 cup yellow onion, diced | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Dice the brussels sprouts and place in a medium bowl. In a large bowl, blend the cream cheese, onions, vinegar and vanilla and pour over sprouts, tossing lightly. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or longer. Add the sun dried tomatoes right before serving.

title: Toothpick With Bacon, Capsicum and Chile
ingredients: 6 slices streaky bacon, chopped coarsely | 1 red capsicum, seeded and chopped coarsely | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 lime wedge | 1 small toothpick
instructions: Place streaky bacon, bell pepper and chilli in the base of a large, lightly oiled frying pan and cook over a medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, or until bacon is crisp. Squeeze lime and remove from the pan. Spoon bacon, capsicum and chilli mixture onto the toothpick and place on a serving plate. Garnish with toothpicks.

title: Sausage Sticks
ingredients: 8 ready-made meatballs | 6 pieces provolone cheese | 4 slices provolone cheese | 2 cups self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons mild chile powder | 2 tablespoons coffee
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line baking tray with baking paper. Place meatballs on tray. Cover with cheese. Place in oven to bake for 20 - 25 mins until meat is cooked.

title: Tortellini Wraps from Parma
ingredients: 500 g cheese tortellini | 1/4 cup low-fat cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla pod ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup long-grain white rice ( can use brown rice too )
instructions: Boil your pasta according to the instructions on the packet. Meanwhile, place the tortellini in a large frying pan over a high heat. Scoop about 1 tablespoon of the pasta mixture onto each tortellini wrapper so that they cover the base slightly up the middle of the tortellini. Top with cherry tomatoes and roll the tortellini around the mixture. Arrange them seam side down onto a warm serving tray lined with baking paper to form a flat parcel. Bake at approx 230oc for 30 mins or until golden on top. Serve with more sour cream and/or topping to season.

ingredients: 1 package corn tortilla strips, cut into 12 -14 wedges | 1 cup macaroni ( we like rotelle ) | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 cup apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven set the oven to 400°f. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat. Add sliced tortilla wedges and cook until dark green, about 3 minutes, flipping once. Place on paper towels to absorb excess oil. Put in a casserole dish or other oven proofed baking dish. title: Lentil and Bamboo Shoot Dip
ingredients: 1 can red lentils | 1 ripe bamboo shoot, chopped | 1/4 cup guacamole, store-bought ( i like hass avocado dip )
instructions: Rinse the lentils and rinse. Transfer the lentils to a bowl.

title: Green Chili Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup green chili, finely chopped ( more or less for your liking ) | 1/4 cup honey | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Heat honey, rice vinegar and hazelnuts in a small saucepan until the honey has melted and stir to combine. Cool slightly and add nuts. Serve warm.

title: Beef Tenderloin in a Pear Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, with bone in | 1 jar frozen peas, thawed ( or any other 'fresh'frozen peas ) | 3 tablespoons butter or 3 tablespoons margarine | 14 ounces chicken drummettes, in marinade | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili | 0.5 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place tenderloin on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake 20 minutes or until thermometer inserted in thickest part registers 170 degrees f. Remove from oven.

title: Fettuccine With Yogurt
ingredients: 250 g yoghurt | 1 inch fresh ginger, peeled, washed and sliced | 300 g fresh fettuccine
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to boil. Add yoghurt, ginger and fettuccine and cook for 5 minutes. Stir through and serve.

title: Olive Garden Mac & Cheese With Cellophane Noodles
ingredients: 2 ounces shell pasta | 1 package baby portobello mushrooms, halved or packages button mushrooms, halved or 1 package crimini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup madeira wine or 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup sliced fresh salad greens or 1/4 cup chard, leaves divided | 1/4 cup marmalade ( can also use fruit jelly ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt or 1/4 teaspoon salt substitute
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water 4 to 6 minutes or until just tender. Drain pasta. While pasta water is still boiling, saute mushrooms in olive oil 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in madeira and chicken stock. Drain cooked pasta and return to hot pan. Stir in pesto and toss to coat. Top with 1/4 cup sliced mushrooms and 1/4 cup chopped chard leaves or chard leaves.

title: Auntie Jill's Faux Philly Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package provolone cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 bag fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1 teaspoon chopped onions ( optional ) | 1/8 cup corn chips ( optional )
instructions: In medium skillet cook onion and garlic in hot fat until tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Chicken and Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 bunch fresh seaweed ( rinsed ) | 2 large beets | 2 jars roasted peanuts oil | 1 quart chicken stock | 1 can cream | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons coconut
instructions: Toast the rinsed rinsed rinsed rinsed beets and beets in a 350 degree oven for about 35 - 15 minutes, or until crisp and light brown. Set aside to cool. Meanwhile, wash and dry the lettuce and seaweed. When cool, rinse beets and beet beet tops. When cool enough to handle, cut off the tops and set aside. When cool enough to handle, peel off the outer skin. Cut into large chunks and roughly dice. In the blender, process the peanuts into a very small ball. Next combine with the chicken stock to form the dressing. In a large bowl, stir together the cream, vinegar and coconut. Add the salad greens, beet greens and beets to the dressing and toss to combine. Adjust seasonings with vinegar and coconut to taste.

title: Tasty Daikon Radishes
ingredients: 2 lbs daikon radishes, peeled ( about 3 ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( or use a mix of one packet per daikon ) | 1 bottle dark rum ( such as bacardi real rum )
instructions: Trim the daikon peel or root end and cut off the peel about 1/4 inch wide. Cut in 1/4 inch slices about 1/2 inch wide. Arrange each slice on a parchment lined baking sheet lined with foil, then sprinkle generously with taco seasoning mix. If using a good rum, mix well and pour over the daikon. Place the baking sheet in a 400° oven. Bake until the daikon rings are very light golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes. Drain and serve.

title: Broccolini With Cointreau
ingredients: 2 bunches broccoli florets | 1/4 cup cointreau liqueur
instructions: Steam broccoli under cold water 4 to 5 minutes until tender. Drain, set aside. Combine cointreau and broccoli in a medium bowl, mashing with a fork to dissolve lumps. Serve.

title: Quick Shrimp Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala ( optional ) | 1 lb baby shrimp, well cleaned
instructions: Combine all ingredients except shrimp in a bowl and toss to coat. Thread shrimp onto skewers. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for atleast 3 hours.

title: Macaroni, Spinach & Spinach Strata
ingredients: 500 g arborio rice or 500 g carnaroli rice | 100 millilitre of uncooked macaroni | 1 liter of frozen baby spinach | 50 g fresh italian seasoning ( the mccormick brand is recommended ) | 1 baguette, sliced
instructions: Boil the rice until it is al dente. Meanwhile, heat a large pot of water and add arugula. Slice a baguette in half and spread with olive oil. Layer with bread and then add 2 cups of the fresh baby spinach. Place the raw spinach on top of the bread then add the macaroni and italian seasoning. The baguette should not be cut into big chunks. Toast the baguette until it is brown. You should have a browned crust of bread in it. Remove from the heat. Add 2 cups of the fresh baby spinach and mix. Top with bread crumbs and place in the fridge to set.

title: Baked Crab and Mushroom Gumbo Shells
ingredients: 8 medium crabsmeat | 8 ounces frozen whole straw mushrooms | 3 teaspoons oil | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon parsley, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Combine the crabmeat and mushrooms in a medium bowl. Stir in the remaining stuffing ingredients and mix well. Place the mixture in the hollowed out mini tart shell shells. Bake for 10 minutes, remove and sprinkle with paprika if desired.

title: Italian Pasta and Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1 lb hot italian sausage | 15 ounces cannellini
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Remove sausage from casings. Brown sausage over medium high heat. Drain. Add beans. Add sauce to hot pasta and stir, cooking over medium heat until hot sauce coats pasta. Serve. The great scandinavian bacon cookbook.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,heavy whipping cream,broth,limeade concentrate,ancho chile,green onion,applesauce
title: Authentic Restaurant Quality Red Chile Sauce
ingredients: 1 can unsweetened applesauce ( hunts ) | 1/8 cup rice vinegar | 1/8 cup canned chicken stock or 1/8 cup canned bouillon | 1/8 cup frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 2 tablespoons green onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chiles, crushed ( california chili powder or hot pepper flakes ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender, blending at high speed. Slowly beat in cream. Cover and chill until ready to use. This can be made two ways, for a very simple red chile sauce or other additions, blend 3/4 cup cold water in the cream until dissolved.

title: Coconut Barbecue Fingers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened soya sauce | 30 -35 slices bacon ( cut into 1/2 inch strips ) | 8 tablespoons spicy brown mustard | 2 tablespoons coconut oil ( or peanut oil )
instructions: Using your hands, mix the soya sauce together very well. Then slice the bacon slices lengthwise to 1/2 inch thick, and then cut diagonally in 1 inch lengths, making sure they stick if necessary. Heat the bbq/spice griller then use a long flat, heavy skillet. Sprinkle with the mustard, and then spoon in the thickened soya sauce, and bacon pieces on top of the mustard. Cook the bacon over medium heat for just a minute or two, turning the slices, and scraping and rubbing the pan. The bacon cooks quicker than the bacon, but just keep cooking. Add a couple drops of coconut oil to the pan for a smokey affect. Serve hot with jasmine rice.

title: St. Patrick's Day Pastry Mushroom Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 -14 button mushrooms, stems discarded | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 1/2 cups water | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar or 1/2 cup sugar | 1 teaspoon dried parsley
instructions: Dry mushrooms if you wish. Place flour in a shallow dish, rub in sugar. Add water and mushrooms. Cover and set aside at room temperature about 30 minutes. Put mushrooms on a board and slice off the stem. Slice about 2/3 of the mushrooms into quarters and sprinkle lightly over the mushroom. Roll the mushrooms into walnut sized balls. Repeat with the rest. Let set at room temperature 20 - 25 minutes. Roll the balls in the vanilla sugar or sugar. Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 425°f for 12 - 15 minutes or until light golden in color.

title: Homemade Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 200 g fresh cranberries | 2 green chili peppers | 16 fat free soft ladyfingers, separated | 4 tablespoons dried sweetened dried sweetened cranberries or 4 tablespoons crushed dried sweetened cherries
instructions: Line the base of a non stick pan with plastic wrap. Punch down the cranberries, chop in 4 or 6 pieces and set aside for later use. Chop the green chillies and soak in 2 cups water for 20 minutes. Drain and squeeze out any excess water. Rinse the cranberries and place in a large heavy pan. Add the dried sweetened berries and chillies. Add 2 tablespoon of water, and bring to the boil, stir occasionally. Meanwhile, dampen two ladyfingers with 2 table spoons of water and roll into a 12 inch cylinder. Lay the soaked ladyfingers on a serving platter, shiny side down. Spread 2 tablespoons of the sweetened cranberry mixture all over the ladyfingers then sprinkle with the dried sweetened cranberries. Cut crosswise in half and then cross into 13 pieces. Arrange them in a single layer on a tray. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight before serving. Slice crosswise for garnish and serve in a bowl with a sprinkling of powdered sugar.

title: Moroccan Black Tea Couscous
ingredients: 100 g black tea ( i prefer decaf, but you may use 2 cups if you like ) | 100 g couscous | 1/2 teaspoon dill ( chopped fresh is easiest to measure ) | 1 water chestnut ( chopped or sliced ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Put the tea, dill, water chestnut, cornflour and chill for 15 minutes. Add sugar or water if desired. Stir to combine. Serve.

title: Garlicky Shredded Noodle Chips With Chipotle
ingredients: 24 ounces uncooked angel hair pasta | 2 tablespoons chopped chipotle peppers, plus more for garnish
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions and drain. Return to pot. Add chipotles and 1 tablespoon of chipotle pepper. Toss to coat.

title: Overnight Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup biscuit
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Wrap mushrooms tightly in aluminum foil. Pierce with fork. In a large bowl, mix together biscuit crumbs and mushrooms, and sprinkle evenly on top. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes, and a meat thermometer inserted in the center of a mushrooms has reached 165 degrees f.

title: Polish Sausages
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses ( light brown ) | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 2 small dried chilies | 1 scallion, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro leaves, finely minced | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 16 -24 polish sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees celcius. Prepare your barbeque. Combine molasses, vinegar, molasses and mace. Cut chilies in half and add to mixture with scallion and cilantro. Bring mixture to the boil. Place your sausage on a baking tray and brush liberally with oil. Bake for 15 - 20 mins each side. Add brown sugar to your cooking liquid. Serve with crusty bread on the side.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,beef tenderloin,sun tomato,celery salt,graham cracker crumb,white rice,clove
title: Santa Fe Rice Crumb Beef Rollatini
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 lb velveeta cheese | 2 cans white rice, heated | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup celery salt | 1 whole clove | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Set oven to 325 degrees. Grease a 9x13 baking dish. Place beef slices between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 1/4 inch thickness with a meat mallet or the bottom of a glass until slightly flattened. Repeat until beef is done. Cut velvetta cheese into 1/2 inch cubes. Spread melted velveeta cheese over both sides of each slice of beef. Place browned beef slices over meat. Spread cooked white rice over all of the meat. Spread sun dried tomatoes over sundried tomatoes. Sprinkle celery salt, whole cloves and graham cracker crumbs over tomatoes. Place aluminum foil into dish and bake 45 minutes. Turn dish and bake an additional 15 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees. Remove from oven, uncover and let sit 5 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,brown rice,bouillon cube,green lentil,orange peel,korean chili paste,chicken broth
title: Lentil Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 bouillon cube | 6 cups good quality low sodium chicken broth | 1 1/2 cups green lentils | 3 -4 tablespoons korean chili paste ( gochujang ) | 1 1 cup uncooked instant brown rice ( preferably jasmine ) | 1/2 cup creme fraiche ( optional ) or 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel, for garnish
instructions: Put bouillon into your slow cooker and set on high. When broth begins to simmer, add lentils, bring to boil, reduce heat to low and cook 20 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside. Remove the chicken stock from the slow cooker and set aside. When broth is simmering, cook rice according to instructions on package. Add chili paste to broth and bring to boil. Turn heat to low and simmer 10 minutes. Add rice, stir to coat, and reheat. Add cream or creme fraiche to soup in the last few minutes of cooking. Sprinkle with orange peel and serve.

title: Hot and Spicy Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces hot water | 1/4 teaspoon arabic spice ( baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix ) | 4 ounces hot sauce
instructions: Put the water in a tea ball. Pour 1 tbsp of the hot water into the bowl to dissolve the powder. Add the arabic mixture. Mix and add the hot sauce. For more pronounced heat, add more hot water.

title: Cheddar Cheese Spareump
ingredients: 2 large ripe plantains, peeled | 1 parsnip, peeled and cut into thick chunks | 1/2 cup green curry paste ( i used thai kitchen brand for this ) | 20 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Slice plantains into about 4 by 1/4 inch slices. Place them in a 9 x 13 glass baking dish, and cut a small slit along the bottom. Place the cut side down in a baking dish so that the slices don't stick to the bottom. Using a wooden spatula, toss the pithy part of a paring knife around the vegetables until the slices are evenly coated. Pour curry paste over the slices. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes. Uncover, and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more, until the vegetables are tender and sauce is lightly bubbling. Top with cheese and parsley.

title: Ginger Beer and Coriander Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 can beer | 1/2 cup instant dashi stock | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 fresh coriander sprig, leaves picked
instructions: Blend first 5 ingredients in blender or food processor until smooth. Pour into hot, noncorrosive canning jars, making sure you keep hot in canning.

title: Portuguese Baked Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb prepared spice cake | 2 pinches black peppercorns | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 large ripe manchego cheese, grated | 1 small brown onion, finely minced | 10 miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray cookie sheet with pam and cut the cake in half lengthwise, then in half again to make two 8x8 inch sticks using a sharp, long knife. Put on cookie sheet, drizzle with pam, sprinkle with peppercorns and cumin powder. Bake for about 10 minutes, stirring every so often. The pan will be dry. Turn off heat under pan and put in mounds on a plate to cool. Mince the manchego cheese, mix in with the brown onion and marshmallows. Put a slice of the cake on a serving plate and top with the cheeses and vegetables. Serve warm.

title: Chicken and Potato Patties

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Form into 2 patties. Flatten, grill or deep fry in a large skillet until browned and cooked through. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot from a warmed platter.

title: Spiced Apple & Chutney Rub With Chutney Appetizer

instructions: Coat a small ovenproof dish with cooking spray and then line with waxed paper. Put the chutney, tarragon, lime zest, chile and spice in a medium bowl.

instructions: Sift dry ingredients thoroughly.

instructions: Bring broth to a hard boil. Meanwhile toast sultanas in oven, remove, cool and put in a blender. Add sultanas and nuts and blend until smooth. Whisk in basil pesto. Season to taste with cinnamon and salt. Serve over hot pasta enjoy the extra sauce from my kitchen aide if you wish.

instructions: Brown italian turkey sausage in a skillet. Drain fat. In a separate bowl mix tomato sauce and chili seasoning mix, pour over turkey sausage and mix. Cook on medium heat for 3 minutes. title: Asparagus & Cheese Pizzas

Arrange the pizzas on a baking tray and put under the grill to crisp up the tops. Serve warm or cold, with extra breadcrumbs on top of each serving.

Press edges up, then with hands, to form a crust large enough to enclose the fruit.

instructions: Slice open lobster meat, and remove head. Cut meat into 3 or 4 small chunks. Mix together bread crumbs, salt, and seasoning. title: Sesame Biscuits

instructions: Sieve flour into a large mixing bowl, add chopped spring onion. Rub in with hands till mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Stirring lightly, knead lightly till mixture forms a firm dough. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and roll to about 1/2 inch thickness. Cut into 8 equal shapes. Bake on lightly greased grill.

title: Grilled Mushrooms in Mango Chutney
ingredients: 4 fresh mushrooms, each about 3 ounces each | 1/2 cup fresh mango chutney | 3 teaspoons chopped serrano peppers | 4 tortillas | 1/4 cup dry white wine, divided
instructions: Heat grill to medium high, or preheat broiler. Brush mushrooms with 1/2 teaspoon of the chutney and set aside. Arrange the tortillas on a grill rack and grill, turning once, until charred on both sides and tender when lightly pressed, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Brush the remaining 1/4 cup chutney over the grill and return to the grill. Arrange the mushrooms over the chutney and grill, turning once, until just softened, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter and top with the grilled fruit. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: miso,red chili pepper,garbanzo bean,clam juice,double cream,bottom roast,horseradish
title: Crock Pot Shrimped Garlic and Chilli on Crockpot (Savoury)
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs pot roast ( bone-in ) | 1 small red chili pepper, deseeded and chopped | 6 cloves garlic, roughly chopped | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 6 tablespoons low-fat double cream | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 3 tablespoons miso
instructions: Place the roast in a slow cooker. Add the chilli, garlic and garbanzo beans, mixing well to combine. Pour in 2 tablespoons of boiling water. Cover and cook on high for 6 to 8 hours until tender. Uncover and stir in the cream, miso and 1 tablespoon fresh water. Remove roast from slow cooker and slice across the grain on the diagonal. Serve with warm crusty bread and a salad.

Random Ingredients: white corn,chicken wing,sesame oil,rice wine vinegar,flat leaf parsley,pork stew meat,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Tonggwa (Chinese Barbecued Chicken)  Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, separated, tips removed | 2 lbs pork stew meat, cut into 2-inch chunks | 6 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | 7 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 lb fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 2/3 cups drained, canned white corn
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chicken wings with the pork, rice wine, sesame oil, and 3/4 cup parsley. Mix well. Chill 1 hour in the refrigerator. Drain all but 3 tbls of the stock in a colander, pressing on it to extract as much liquid as possible. Transfer the reserved stock to a large saucepan and bring it to a boil over high heat. Add the corn and heat over high heat, stirring constantly until the corn is just tender and the sauce is slightly thickened. Taste and adjust the seasonings. Remove from the heat and allow the mixture to cool. Pour over the chicken and toss to coat well. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate, stirring once, for at least 30 minutes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: galangal,romaine lettuce,oil,tamarind paste,shrimp,hamburger,godiva chocolate liqueur,soy sauce
title: Hainanese Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 5 -6 leaves romaine lettuce | 1/4 lb shrimp, cooked, shelled and finely chopped | 1 ounce godiva premium chocolate liqueur | 1 dash oil | 1 dash soy sauce | 1 dash sambal oelek soy sauce, sriracha ( sriracha for heat )
instructions: Combine hamburger, tamarind paste and lettuce. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl. Taste and add more seasoning and sugar/pepper in a pinch or less. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Apricot-Soya Jam Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon apricot jam | 2 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together until well blended.

title: Japanese-Style Hand-Pulled Rice Balls
ingredients: 1/4 cup ketjap manis ( sweet soy sauce ) | 1 bag baby spinach, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 3 cups cooked basmati rice ( cold ) | 1 sheet nori, cut into 6 squares ( dried seaweed )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the ketchip manis and 1 cup of the salad dressing. Set aside. In a medium bowl, toss the spinach and sugar with 2 cups of cold cooked rice. Using a rolling pin, roll the rice balls into 1/8 inch thick balls. Heat a small skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle the lightly cooked rice balls with a little more rice. Fry the balls, in batches, for 3 to 5 minutes per side or until golden brown and cooked through. Remove with a slotted spoon, and arrange on a plate. Spread the remaining salad dressing down the center of each. Spoon a little of the rice mixture over each mound. Sprinkle with a little more rice. Roll the rice balls back over the salad dressing and arrange in a single layer on a plate.

title: Baked Indian Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup white sugar | 6 mangos, peeled and cut into small pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rinse lamb under warm water and pat dry with paper towels. Rub or brush lamb with corn oil. Place lamb in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer with diced tomatoes with green chilies, sugar, and mango slices. Cover dish tightly with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour, basting frequently with juices.

title: Honey Tofu Salad
ingredients: 2 packages tofu | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup grape juice | 2 medium romaine lettuce | 1 package grape
instructions: Cut tofu into 1/4 inch slices. Grill tofu over low heat until golden on both sides, then slice into 1/4 inch slices. Put 2 tbsp of honey into a small bowl and add orange juice. Pour dressing over tofu.

title: Nori Rolls
ingredients: 3 sheets nori, toasted on the cut side | 40 g frozen peas | 2/3 bag of bugles flavor snacks | 2 pieces kalamata olives, sliced | 30 g frozen mixed sprouts
instructions: Place frozen peas in saucepan, add 2/3 bag of Bugles flavor snacks, cover and bring to boil on high heat, then simmer on very low heat for 5 minutes. Add remaining bag of snacks, covered, and continue to cook for 5 more mins until all ingredients are heated. Place frozen mixed sprouts on a sheet of nori on a heat resistant plate. Place 1/3 bag of sprouts and 1/3 bag of frozen peas on top, then carefully unfold the nori sheet so that the green parts of the nori begin to float over the top, making sure the sprouts and phyllo dont touch each other. This will help to produce crisp green nori. If you use a microwave safe plate, heat the peanut oil on the stove and gently slide the nori onto the hot oil. It should have a crispy green nori that does not stick to the pan easily. Once all the Nori is crispy remove the nori sheet from the heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Once the nori sheet has cooled completely remove the plastic wrap and cut the nori into 4 slices to resemble a roll. Roll the nori mixture up neatly. Remove the plastic and cut the roll into 2 equal sized squares depending on how big you need your mixture. You may also want to cut a small piece of plastic wrap to make it easier to roll the sandwiches up. Repeat for all of the nori. Once the bags of sprouts have frozen add them to your mixture. Add one piece of nori to each sandwich and gently squeeze the mixture over the nori making sure it is thoroughly combined. Then wrap and place back onto nori sheet. Repeat until you have used all of the nori and fillings. To serve serve, top each of the 4 rolls with the sweet/ sour peanuts, chopped spring onions, or dried apricots to be served immediately.

Random Ingredients: catsup,ginger,green chili,dark soy sauce,key lime juice,stewing beef
title: Korean Beef Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/2 teaspoon ginger | 2 teaspoons key lime juice | 2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 cup chopped green chili
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a plastic plastic bag. Add meat and marinade for 2 to 3 days. Transfer to a glass bowl. Cover.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,sage leaf,cream celery soup,salad dressing,caper
title: Cheesy Baked Celery Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons salad dressing | 4 pints light cream of celery soup | 1 can drained capers | 1/2 cup grated old cheddar cheese | 1 pinch sage leaves ( optional )
instructions: To make the dressing, mix the salad dressing, celery soup, capers, cheese and sage together. Put dressing in a serving bowl or loaf pan and place in the oven until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: cumin,bulk italian sausage,active yeast,italian parsley,el taco seasoning,vegetable stock
title: Crock Pot Sausage Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry active yeast ( or 2 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast-per envelope yeast ) | 5 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup lite old el paso bulk hot italian sausage, casings removed ( or links of italian sausage, casings removed and crumbled ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 3 tablespoons minced fresh italian parsley | 2 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning ( i use old el paso )
instructions: Note, the original recipe called for 1 large onion & 1/2 cup of fresh Italian parsley, but i thought of it as not necessary at all. Combine all ingredients in crock pot and cook on low for 6 hours. Serve with shredded lettuce. If your crock pot does not have a quick method of choosing your hot italian sausage, it can be done as directed in the ingredients list.

title: Madeira Marinade for Beef
ingredients: 3 tablespoons madeira wine | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a glass or ceramic bowl. Place meat in the marinade and cover it with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Drain off excess liquid before serving. Serve with salads and bread.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,salad oil,tomato puree,carrot,basil leaf,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Italian Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 lb american cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 2 medium carrots, peeled, grated and squeezed dry | 3 tablespoons salad oil | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 6 basil leaves | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Place the cubed and grated cheeses in a colander over a bowl and toss to combine well. In a small bowl, mix together the remaining ingredients and spoon over the cheese. Sprinkle the basil over the cheese and toss to coat well.

title: Mushroom-Pepper-Pea Soup
ingredients: 16 ounces sliced mushrooms | 1/2 cup frozen peas
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium heat, add mushrooms and peas. Cook until peas are warmed through, about 10 minutes.

title: Couscous Soup
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, broken into florets | 1 can baby peas, with juice | 8 ounces fresh peas or 8 ounces frozen peas, with juice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan, bring to a boil, cook, stirring occasionally until pasta is tender and vegetables are tender.

title: Chili Chicken Lollipops
ingredients: 3 chicken | 1/2 cup sweet chili powder | 1 lb ladyfingers
instructions: Heat heavy pan over medium high heat. Cut chicken in 1/2 or 3 pieces. Sprinkle with chili powder. Put chicken in pan. Brown for 5 - 15 minutes, turning every few minutes. Put on tray. Put 1/4 of the sweet chili powder on top. Put fingers on top. Sprinkle 1/4 more.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,egg white,parsley,israeli couscous,white onion,roast beef,lime wedge
title: Israeli Couscous & Roast Beef Patties
ingredients: 1 cup israeli couscous ( or any other white israeli-style lentils ) | 2 boneless top round roast beef, cut 1 1/2-inch cubes ( very lean ) | 1 medium white onion, coarsely chopped, about 1/3 cup | 1 tablespoon ground dried parsley | 2 large egg whites, slightly beaten | 1/3 cup fresh parsley, chopped | lime wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Spread the couscous in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Add the beef cubes, onion, parsley, 1 tablespoon of the egg whites and 1/3 cup of the parsley. Using a fork or your hands, toss the ingredients together until they are very well blended about 1 minute. Divide the mixture among four dinner size serving bowls. Set the bowls aside. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Bake the patties in the middle of the oven until the internal tempurature is 160 degrees, about 11 to 14 minutes. Transfer the patties to a cutting board, and let cool.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,ladyfinger,canadian bacon,mozzarella cheese,streaky bacon,margarine,italian spice,red chilies
title: Cheesy Canadian Bacon and Egg Rolls
ingredients: 20 large ladyfingers | 4 slices streaky bacon, chopped finely | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon of minced italian spices | 1/2 lb of cubed mozzarella cheese | 8 tablespoons marinara sauce | 2 whole red chilies ( depending on how hot you want it ; i prefer serrano ) | 8 slices canadian bacon, diced finely
instructions: Melt margarine or butter in skillet, fry on both sides of streaky bacon and italian spices until bacon is cooked. Add mozzarella cheese and stir until melted. Warm marinara sauce in small pan or microwave. Dip one side of each ladyfinger in marinara sauce, place one slice of red chile and some of the bacon on each ladyfinger. Roll up each finger and place seam side down in a greased 13x9 baking dish. Repeat and cook in a 375 degree oven for 15 minutes. Slice and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,white rum,marsala wine,pork loin,sazon goya seasoning,quinoa
title: Acapulco
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin, cut into bite-sized pieces | 1 cup dry marsala wine | 4 -6 sazon goya seasoning | 3 cups quinoa ( or use 1 1/2 cups short grain rice ) | 2 cups dry marsala wine, divided
instructions: Sprinkle the fennel seeds on a baking sheet and toast until slightly brown, about 15 to 20 minutes. Place the peppercorns in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle, process to fine crumbs. Rinse and dry the pork pieces. Put them in a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle them with 2 tbsp. Of the goya seasoning. Pour 1 cup wine around them. Cover and cool. Strain out the pork, saving the liquid. Rinse and dry the quinoa. In a medium saucepan pour 1 cup reserved liquid and 2 1/2 cups wine and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until the liquid is absorbed. Stir in the remaining goya seasoning and set aside. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread the quinoa onto the foil. Pour the reserved pork liquid and wine all over the quinoa. Bake the uncovered at 325 degrees for about 45 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Cooks' note, the goya wine is a good substitute for the marsala wine.

title: Tater Tot Toss
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs tater tots, thawed | 1 1/2 cups brandy | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Place drained tater tots in a large bowl. Whisk together with brandy to taste and pour over the tater tots immediately. Toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour for best results. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Serve as a fresh side dish for grilled chicken, or as a main dish for meat.

title: Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1/4 cup chutney ( sweet or hot ) | 1/4 teaspoon dark rum ( optional ) | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, raw, cut into 4 pieces
instructions: Heat chutney in microwave in 4 cup measuring cup for 1 minute or till hot. Stir in rum and if using add a little boiling water. Pour into hot 4 cup measuring cup. Stir gently. Microwave on high for 1 minute or till hot. Let stand 5 minutes, remove and serve.

title: Artichokes in Wine (Greece)
ingredients: 2 artichoke hearts ( fresh or canned ) | 1 1/2 lbs watermelon | 2 teaspoons white breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut off artichoke bottoms and remove the choke using a sharp paring knife. Peel off outer layer of green tops. Discard artichoke hearts. Cut artichokes in half and remove the choke. Cut the melon using the tip of the knife. Add breadcrumbs to the melon and toss until evenly coated. Place in a serving dish and sprinkle with crumbs.

title: Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenderloins | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 -2 tablespoon cumin powder | 5 pita breads, warmed
instructions: Cut each tenderloin diagonally into pieces 1 x3 x 3 1/2 x 2. Place, skin side down, between 3 sheets of non stick plastic wrap. Pound the plastic wrap into a 6 x 11 rectangle each of the four sides of the tenderloin pieces. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon cumin powder and 1 teaspoons cumin powder over the chicken pieces, then sprinkle with 1 teaspoons cumin powder and 1 teaspoons cumin powder. Roll each tenderloin piece toward the outside edges of the papery plastic wrap. Place on the pita bread, seam side down, in a baking pan. Cover tightly with foil. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. Cook time does not reflect marinating time. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cover tightly with foil and roast until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees about 40 minutes.

title: Ley's  Lentil Gravy for Beef or Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 1 cup brown sugar, cut into pieces ( reserve 1/4 cup of the brown sugar ) | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 8 leaves lovage, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Start the broth in a 2 qt skillet. In a medium bowl add the remaining ingredients and thoroughly mix together the two. Add into the stockpot and heat on a medium flame. Turn often as the gravy thickens. Note when making your own brown sugar beef gravy, you can use 1 packet of brown sugar and 1 tbsp liquid jovies or 1 tablespoons molasses. Note i found the gravy was a bit too sour. I could also add 1 1/4 cup of dried lovage. I was told that the last time i made this, i made a batch of this and it worked out great. It took me at least an hour and ended up being a little mushy. The beef/veg mixture was so thick and complex that the gravy came out incredible. Thanks for sharing.

title: Chermelloni for Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups of fresh roasted herb ( rocket, or rosemary ) | 2 tablespoons fresh grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place all ingredients and mix throughly with your favourite pasta sauce, and serve.

title: Easy Pear Fool
ingredients: 8 pears, peeled & cored | 1 cup whipping cream ( or heavy cream ) | 1/3 teaspoon almond extract ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups white wine
instructions: Place the pears in a pot with the sugar& 1/4 cup water. Cook until the pears are softened and the syrup is syrupy. Remove from the heat& allow to cool. Mix the cream& almond extract into the syrup. Add the wine& adjust the flavour if necessary.

title: Glamato a La Coquilles, Clams in White Wine
ingredients: 1 pint bottled clam juice | 2 quarts cold water | 1/4 cup white wine, such as cabernet sauvignon-burgundy, divided
instructions: Pour clam juice through a fine sieve into a 4 quart saucepan. Add water.

title: Chinese Style Pulled Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 3 -4 1 lb pork roast | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon ginger
instructions: Place the chicken in a large bowl. Add the vinegar, ginger and cocoa. Mix together well using your hands. Pout the marinade over the chicken and leave it to marinade at least 20 minutes. Let the chicken sit at least an hour or two so it can get a little crusty. The longer you marinate, the better it will taste. Grill or grill over medium heat till the juices run clear about 20 minutes.

title: Spicy Apple Cider
