ingredients: 1 apple, cut into chunks | 2 limes, wedged | 12 frozen corn, thawed
instructions: Place apple chunks and lime wedges in a blender.

title: Homemade Vegetable Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups of chopped mixed pulses, green, white and yellow variety, soaked in water for at least an hour | 1 lb chopped cooked meat | 2 cups rolled oats | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped turnip
instructions: Put the mixed pulses with the meat and oats in a bowl. Mix with your hands, form little round balls, then flatten with the palms of your hands. Place on a baking tray and bake in a moderately hot oven for about 20 minutes, turning over once.

Random Ingredients: lemon lime beverage,peanut,italian parsley,anchovy fillet,green food coloring,pea carrot,green cardamom
title: Green Peanut Dessert (Kaya Neeruva)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemons, juice of | 1 1/2 tablespoons green food coloring ( such as karela ) | 4 ripe anchovy fillets ( optional ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped italian parsley | 1/2 cup finely chopped peanuts | 2 cups frozen peas and carrots ( cooked in cold water and drained ) | 4 teaspoons green cardamom, pods
instructions: Combine the first seven ingredients, stirring well. Taste and adjust seasoning.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,nutmeg,chicken part,celery root,creme de cassis,prawn,tahini,pork chop
title: Prawn Soup for Two
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb pork chop | 1 lb prawns | 1 small celery root | 1 small fresh ginger paste | 1 tablespoon fresh creme de cassis | 1 dash ground nutmeg | 1 pinch ground ginger paste | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: Pound the pork chop until it can be picked off of the bone. Chop the prawns into pieces about 1/2 inch square. Peel and chop the celery root. In a large pan, heat 1 tbs. Of oil over high heat. Add the ginger paste and fry for a moment on high heat. Then add the pork and prawn pieces. Stir fry for 5 to 6 minutes, or until the pork is cooked. Remove the meat from pan and set aside. Heat 1 tbs. Of oil in the pan. Add the celery root and stir fry over high heat for 5 minutes. Then add the paprika, nutmeg and ginger paste and stir fry for 1 to 2 minutes. Then add the tahini and stir to combine. Add half the soup to the pan and simmer for 10 minutes. If necessary, add more soup just to the height of the soup level and stir until the soup thickens. Serve immediately while hot. Note, you can also serve this with garlic bread and ginger root rice and cucumbers. It is good for omitting the garlic and ginger.

title: Shami Kabob (Indian Lamb Kabobs)
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb, boned and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 ounces radishes, halved | 1 -2 tablespoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons cherries, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place lamb slices in a large bowl.

title: Parsley Oil
ingredients: 1 cup dry roasted peanuts | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place the peanuts, cayenne pepper and salt in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Strain through a sieve, removing and discarding all excess solids. Use in any recipe calling for oil. Variation, for sprinkling on fish, add a pinch of paprika before oil. Variation, for the garlic press, add 1/4 tsp each of garlic powder, cayenne pepper and dry red pepper before you heat the oil, stir in a teaspoon of mixed and then add 3 tbsp chopped parsley after adding all the ingredients. Variation, for shrimp, add 1 to 2 tsp of cayenne pepper after removing from heat. Add 1/4 tsp each of garlic powder, cayenne pepper and dry basil and stir in when oil is heated up.

title: Tzatziki Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons tzatziki ( see note ) | 1 large carrot | 1 cup golden raisin, slightly more if needed | 1 tablespoon tzatziki ( see note ) | 1/2 teaspoon maple syrup | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Wash the tzatziki, but remove any rinds. Slice the carrot thinly, and slice a small chunk of raisin into small wedges. Mix together with the tzatziki. If you like, you can also use plain tzatziki. The ratio of filling to the tzatziki is about 1 teaspoon per serving. This nutritional measurement reflects the nutritional of the korean tzatziki. For germany, germany means one cup of fat per serving. If not, it can be replaced with 2 tablespoons of tzatziki. Note you could also use more tzatziki without topping it. Note, the nutritional measurements reflect the amount of fat and fiber needed to absorb the syrup. Baking potato skins or other large baking sheets can also be used. Cooking time does not include cooking the carrot. However, zucchini can vary dramatically in the amount of fat and fiber, and can vary in the shape of the potato skins and the amount of zucchini. Cooking time does not include the heating time. Note, the amounts of syrup and filling need not be exact, as you may add more or less hot water, according to taste.

title: Mexican Polenta Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Spread mixture on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle cornmeal over tortilla and spread evenly. Bake for 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Sprinkle with sun dried tomatoes. Let cool.

title: Homemade Cilantro Limes
ingredients: 24 fresh cilantro stems | 2 cups frozen limeade concentrate, thawed ( can be purchased canned frozen limeade canner )
instructions: Place the cilantro stems and limeade concentrate in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until finely chopped, about 1 1/2 pulses. Transfer to a large bowl. Gradually add reserved cilantro sprigs to the limeade, pulsing and stirring continuously until well mixed. Transfer limeade concentrate to a plastic zipper bag and freeze for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Transfer frozen concentrate to a quart size freezer bag. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to freezer and freeze at least 2 hours or until solid.

title: Vegetable Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 package frozen yellow squash, thawed and sliced | 1 can white kidney beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat the vegetable soup in a saucepan over medium heat until warmed through. Mix in the squash, and continue cooking 10 minutes. Transfer the soup to a blender or food processor, and blend until smooth. Return the soup to the saucepan, and mix in kidney beans. Heat through, and serve.

Random Ingredients: wide rice noodle,port wine,wasabi powder,coriander powder,lamb shoulder
title: Wasabi Marinated Lamb
ingredients: 500 g wide rice noodles | 1/2 teaspoon wasabi powder ( available at asian asian grocery stores ) | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon port wine | 12 pieces lamb shoulder
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain well and place the washed rice noodles in a container. Pour the wasabi over the rice, shaking the noodles to mix. Place the lid on the container and leave to marinate in the fridge for at least an hour. Preheat the oven to 220 deg c/425 deg f/gas put the lamb at the top of the rack in the ovenproof dish. Turn oven on to 200 deg c/400 deg f/gas. Remove the lid from the refrigerator and leave the meat to come out of the fridge. When ready to cook, thread noodles onto your skewers alternating with lamb, beginning with the noodles, then finally adding the wasabi and coriander and turning until the lamb is well coated. Cook on the middle shelf of the oven for about 75 minutes or until the lamb is well cooked and has become crispy and brown on top.

Random Ingredients: baking chocolate,yellow squash,lettuce,sesame oil,purpose flour,poppy seed,chili oil,linguine
title: Chocolate Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup chopped toasted sesame oil | 1 lb linguine ( cooked ) | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds or 2 teaspoons sunflower seeds | 1 lb small yellow squash or 1 lb zucchini | lettuce | diced baking chocolate
instructions: In medium bowl combine flour, 1/4 cup of sesame oil and set aside. In large skillet or fry pan, prepare linguine according to package directions. Meanwhile in small bowl, combine chili oil and 1 teaspoons of flour and set aside. Cut squash in half lengthwise and slice thinly crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. In a large skillet, place 1/2 cup batter with remaining 1 teaspoons of flour and the sliced squash. Cook and stir 30 seconds or until lightly browned. Spoon 1/2 cup of chicken filling into each lettuce leaf and roll up. Place filled rolls in freezer for 20 minutes to chill before rolling. When ready to serve, unwrap and set aside. When ready to serve, place rolls in shallow baking dish. Spoon remaining cup of sesame oil evenly over rolls and sprinkle tops with poppy seeds or sunflower seeds. Serve immediately with grated chocolate and lettuce.

title: Crunchy Falafel
ingredients: 1 cup bulgar wheat, rinsed and drained ( chickpeas ) | 1 teaspoon rice wine ( or tamari ) | 1 cup pomegranate seeds, toasted ( refer to note below ) | 1 1/2 cups baked beans, warm
instructions: Using a food processor or blender, process bulgur to your desired texture. Do not overprocess. Place the bulgur in a large bowl and add the rice wine if using. Stir in the chickpeas, pecans or pomegranates. Refrigerate until needed for best flavor. The mixture can be kept if the mixture is stored it's shape for a month or longer. Note, do not use dry bulgur wheat that is already ground and it should be moist and watery from that point.

title: Sparkling Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 250 g sour cherries, rinsed but unseasoned | 1/4 cup sparkling water | 1/2 - 2/3 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 chopped green chilies
instructions: Place cherries in a glass bowl & pour in sparkling water, stir well to combine. Add chillies & crushed chilies, mix well & refrigerate for up to one week.

title: Mushroom, Beef & Cheese Pies - Fast and Easy!
ingredients: 200 g white mushrooms, chopped | 1 packet instant yeast | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 300 g ground hamburger
instructions: Soak mushrooms in hot water. Mix all ingredients together on a floured board. Knead for 5 minutes. Place on a greased baking tray, and leave to rise for 2 hours or until doubled. Heat a non stick frying pan on a medium, low element setting. Shape dough into small, approximately 24 patties. Sprinkle with salt. Brush each patty lightly with yeast and fry on each side until browned. Serve topped with cheese, bacon, sausages etc.

title: Creamy Thai Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin tapioca | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast half, cut into thin strips | 1 cup watermelon, julienned | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Stir tamari and tapioca in medium bowl. Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive,baby red potato,deli roast beef,chili oil
title: Spanish Beef and Potatoes With Olives
ingredients: 2 lbs medium baby red potatoes, quartered | 1/2 lb thinly sliced deli roast beef | 1/3 cup good quality chili oil | 1/3 cup spanish olives, sliced
instructions: Arrange vegetables in a shallow ovenproof casserole dish with 2 or 3 pieces of aluminum foil. Top each with beef slices. Drizzle with oil. Cover. Bake at 400f degrees for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Sprinkle with olives. Serve.

title: Italian Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage link ( about 1 ) | 1 tablespoon dried coriander powder | fresh parsley leaves or fresh parsley leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Dry or lightly rub the casings all over with paprika, cayenne and black pepper. Fry the italian sausages in a pan, turning occasionally for about 8 minutes or until no longer pink. Add the seasoning and cook for 5 minutes, covering the pan. Remove from pan and garnish with fresh parsley or fresh parsley leaves.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,poblano chile,white bean,chili powder,chili oil,cheesecloth,seasoning salt,oyster sauce
title: Chile Con Carne (White Beans) With Cheesecloth
ingredients: 2 large tomatoes ( about 1 lb. ) | 2 poblano chiles ( about 4 oz. each ) | 5 cups cooked white beans ( cooked in water to cover ) | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil ( optional... see comments ) | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated cheesecloth
instructions: Remove tops of tomatoes and chiles and slice to desired lengths using a knife, if you slice them too long, it'll break down the tomatoes and will release some of the juice. Rinse bean with cold water and drain well, if water starts to run clear, it's time to use your hands to rub the skins off. Cut tomato in half through the middle, remove seeds and core. Cut tomatoes in half through the center and slice to desired lengths. Heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat, add chili oil. Stir to coat the bottom of the skillet with oil. Add tomato and chiles and stir to coat with oil. Stir in beans, cover reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes. Stir occasionally and add water if mixture just starts to stick to the bottom of the skillet. Stir, cook 2 minutes, remove from heat. Place a cheesecloth in a sieve over a bowl or a cup and drain beans until all the liquid is gone. Return beans to skillet in a warm bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Stir in cheesecloth and remove from heat. Cover and allow to sit at room temperature for 20 to 30 minutes to marinate flavors. Cook briefly. Note, if you like, you may add a little cornstarch to the bean liquid, or add a little more water, but it's not necessary as the beans will absorb it during cooking.

title: Cornmeal and Salmon Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup white quinoa | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup cornmeal | 5 salmon fillets, cutlets
instructions: Place quinoa in a rice cooker and add water.

title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup long grain rice | 3 cups chicken stock | 1 ounce green olives, halved
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 450 degrees. Add the rice on top of a cookie tin and bake uncovered, in the oven for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and leave to stand for 10 minutes. To make the broth, warm the stock and divide among individual serving bowls. Add the olives and serve.

title: Spiced Raspberry Cream
ingredients: 1/3 cup unwhipped soymilk | 3 cups raspberries | 2 large red chilies, stemmed seeded sliced about 1/2-inch thick | 2 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In 2 quart bowl, whisk together the soy milk, raspberries, chilies, cornstarch, salt and cinnamon until well combined. Cover bowl and refrigerate for up to 1 day, stirring and re using 1/2 cup of the cold liquid. Puree in batches in a blender. Return to saucepan. Cook over moderate heat until mixture boils and thickens slightly, 2 - 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Pepper Pate
ingredients: 3 medium yellow peppers, very ripe | 5 eggs ( separated ) | 1 cup double cream ( can use non-fat plain yogurt, can use low-fat plain cream ) | 5 tablespoons ghee | 3 tablespoons cognac | 1 can cream-style canned corn | 1 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Slice the tops and bottoms off the peppers, making sure they are all flat. Place the peppers on a baking tray, drizzle with the oil and roast in the oven for about 15 - 20 minutes until the skin is golden brown. Skin only if wished, but most will remove the charred skin. Allow to cool. To make the pate, beat the egg yolks in a bowl until thick and creamy. Add the whites of the cream, yolks, brandy and the pepper pate and mix until well combined. Stir in the cream corn and the nutmeg if using. To make the sauce, heat the ghee in a pan and add the caramelised pepper pate and cook for several minutes, stirring all the time, until the sauce caramelises. Pour the sauce into a bowl and season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Stir in the cream and set to one side.

title: Lamb Shanks in Creamy Mexican Sauce
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 4 ounces queso fresco, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place lamb shanks in a large roasting pan on the center rack. Sprinkle with cheese and pour enough cream onto the meat to cover the shanks. Cover pan tightly with aluminum foil. Place in preheated oven and bake for about 2 hours, or until meat begins to fall off the bone. Shanks with juices can be refrigerated for up to 6 weeks. Turn shanks once during cooking.

title: Torshi - Green Chili Crab Dip
ingredients: 3 ounces imitation crabmeat | 3 ounces canned green chiles, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Crush the imitation crabmeat along with the green chilies and nutmeg. Add the malt vinegar and mix everything well. Use in place of the salt vinegar used in restaurants. This dip will keep for up to a week in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,white wine vinegar,pepperoni,italian breadcrumb
title: Italian Peppers for Two
ingredients: 6 large peppers ( bell peppers, green peppers, and or analian pepper can be substituted ) | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons of shredded bottled pepperoni | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice peppers in half lengthwise. Remove seeds and any tough outer white pith with a sharp knife. Carefully remove and discard the stems from the pepper and cut them into 1 1/2 inch slices. Arrange pepper rings face up on prepared baking sheet. Combine breadcrumbs, pepperoni, and vinegar in a mixing bowl and mix well. Sprinkle on peppers. Bake on middle rack of oven until golden brown, and peppers are tender, about 40 - 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts With Chickpeas and rosemary
ingredients: 2 teaspoons golden syrup ( honey or rice syrup may be used ) | 1 whole large chicken breast, about 1 1/4 lbs ( i use boneless thighs ) | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary leaves, crushed | 1 can chickpeas, drained & rinsed | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | rosemary leaf
instructions: In 2 quart microwavable baking dish, heat golden syrup. Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,bread flour,turmeric,coconut milk,golden syrup,white pepper,potato flake,icing sugar
title: Chinky's Low Fat Potato Bread
ingredients: 250 g bread flour | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 250 g dry potato flakes | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1 teaspoon white pepper ( or to taste ) | 600 ml coconut milk | 200 g of italian-style canned tomatoes | 10 g golden syrup
instructions: Mix bread flour, tumeric, potato, and sugar together using your hands in a bread machine. Pour coconut milk and tomatoes into a pan of boiling water. Cook over medium heat until cooked, stir gently when tomato boils add golden syrup and simmer on low or medium low heat for 20 minutes. Pour off tomato and sauce from pan onto the dry ingredients and mix until well combined. Turn the dough onto a floured board and knead for 10 - 10 minutes. Divide into 16 pieces and roll each piece into a ball. Place the round on a greased baking sheet and chill until ready to use. Place dough on baking sheet and bake at 180 degree celcius for 30 - 35 minutes. For a crispy crust, bake on the bottom rack until crust is crisp and golden brown. Remove from oven and allow to cool on a wire rack. Enjoy.

title: Green Chile Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces canned diced green chilies | 1/2 cup orange marmalade
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the green chilies and 1/2 cup of orange marmalade. Cover and refrigerate over night. When ready to make, stir the remaining 1/2 cup of orange marmalade into the chilled green chile sauce.

title: Quinoa and Turnips
ingredients: 10 cups water | 2 medium turnips, peeled, quartered and then cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 medium zucchini or 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 3 tablespoons smoked paprika
instructions: Combine everything except paprika and place in large dutch oven. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer very gently for 2 hours, or until vegetables and quinoa are tender. Remove from heat and stir in paprika.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,roast beef,mexican oregano,tomato paste,garlic clove,green cardamom,rom tomato
title: Roast Beef and Pico De Gallo Dip
ingredients: 1 beef top round roast, trimmed of fat | sodium free pico de gallo | 2 roma tomatoes, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1/4 cup canned tomato paste | 1/4 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1 pinch green cardamom, crushed
instructions: Place roast in a slow cooker with a lid or a lid on. Pour pico de gallo over the top.

title: Tres Leches Meatballs (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 1/3 cups cooked brown rice | 1 can cannellini beans, drained well | 2 tablespoons triple sec
instructions: Mix well, and refrigerate for 4 - 6 hours. In 1 quart crock pot combine ground beef, rice, beans and triple sec. Place in crock pot, and cook on high heat for 3 hours.

title: Pasta with Sage Butter
ingredients: 500 g mostaccioli pasta ( i prefer angel hair pasta ) | 3 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage leaf | 1 sprig fresh sage leaves
instructions: Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling salted water, according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, mix the vanilla sugar and salt together in a small jug with a pinch of salt. Drain the pasta, reserve some water, then toss in the sugar butter and the sage leaves. Makes 3 servings and 4 sprigs of fresh herb garnish.

title: Fusion Blended Mocktail
ingredients: 1 ounce pomegranate juice | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Squeeze and strain 1/2 ounce pomegranate juice into a cocktail shaker. Add the pomegranate juice, lime wedge and 1 dash of sugar syrup.

title: Jello Shots - Giant Bean Rollups
ingredients: 1 can mandarin orange segments | 1 can refried beans
instructions: Place a mandarin orange in the center of four miniature muffin cups. Top with a refried bean roll. Sprinkle with green chile peppers. Cover with remaining muffins, and freeze one of the cans for later use.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,seasoning salt,guacamole,bacon dripping,wine vinegar,hot sauce,sirloin,farfalle pasta
title: Steak and Bow Ties on a Bed of Basil and Guinness
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 1/4 cup bacon drippings or 1/4 cup lard | 1/4 cup chopped prosciutto | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1/4 cup chopped salted pork loin ( or other lean cut ) | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 dash hot sauce, to taste- i like it hotter | guacamole, for serving ( recommended ( trader joe's )
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package directions. Keep warm.

title: Cherry Swirl Mousse from the Canadian Cheese Shop
ingredients: 1 pie crust ( preferably refrigerated ) | 1 can tomato juice | 1 can marshmallow cream | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 2 -4 teaspoons cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prick the bottom of the pie crust with a sharp knife several times. Put in refrigerator and chill. Prepare pie crust, in a small bowl, mix together remaining ingredients, except for the pie crust. Pour mixture into pie crust. Press lightly in a 9 inch pan. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes and then turn off oven. Cool completely, then loosen the edge slightly over the top. Serve and enjoy.

title: Simple Mustard Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 1/4 cup sweet hot mustard ( spanish variety ) | 1/3 cup kalamata olive ( about 1/3 cup pitted )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Add sweet hot mustard to oil in pan. Saute olive over med heat until tender, but not browned. Add to rice and mix well. Serve.

title: Baked Mushrooms With Mandarin Patty Melts
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs assorted fresh button mushrooms, cleaned | 2 bunches scallions, trimmed, washed, chopped | 4 oranges, washed, peeled and pith removed | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons diced dried pimientos | 2 tablespoons finely chopped celery seeds | 1/2 cup finely chopped sweetened dried pimiento, in wine | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 4 tablespoons finely chopped yellow onions ( white parts only ) | 2 whole firm white bread rounds, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: To make the dressing, combine all salad dressing ingredients in a bowl and whisk until uniform. To make the patty melts, lay out a piece of plastic wrap slightly over a work surface. Place one slice of bread on the plastic wrap, covering both sides of it. Place a tablespoon of the dressing alongside the toasted end of the bread. Wrap the filled side of each sandwich with 2 slices of scallions and 1/2 cup mixed mushrooms. Repeat the process with the remaining 3 slices of mushrooms and 3 sliced onions. Secure the sandwiches with toothpicks. Arrange the sandwiches in a baking dish and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, but not more than 4 hours, and preferably overnight. To bake, preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Line the bottom of a baking dish in the bottom of the dish. Sprinkle the tops with bread and brush with olive or canola oil. Bake until tops start to get crusty, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and spoon the remaining dressing over each sandwich. Return the dish to the oven and cook for 10 minutes, or until the sandwich is browned and bubbly. If the bottom of the bread starts to get crusty, broil the first side for a few seconds, then broil the second side for about 2 minutes or until lightly browned. Let cool and serve right away.

title: Bamia's Chili Slices
ingredients: 4 pounds fresh asparagus | 1 habanero pepper, minced | 1 cup crushed ice
instructions: Clean the asparagus and snap off the tough ends. Cut the tips in half diagonally. Trim off any damaged sections and the woody stalk of the tips. Slice the tips into 1/8 inch slices. In a large bowl, mix together the habanero pepper, and the reserved tips. Toss with asparagus slices. Fill a large pot with water, and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Skim off any scum that rises to the top. Once the water is boiling, stir in the asparagus, and return to a boil. Cook until the asparagus is tender, and bright green, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the heat, and stir until the chili has cool completely. Serve hot, or room temperature.

title: Cheddar Mince Burgers
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 250 g beef mince | 2/3 cup shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup chopped fresh garlic | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place the oats in a food processor and process until fine meal forms. Add the remaining ingredients and process again, until you have a doughy mixture. Stir together with a knife, knead briefly, transfer to an oiled shallow ovenproof dish. Brush the mince on all sides with oil and bake in a hot barbecue, cook for 6 minutes each side or until browned and cooked to your liking.

title: Steamed Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup egg yolk, beaten | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds
instructions: In a 2 to 3 quart glass or stainless steel steamer over medium high heat, stir together beef, egg yolk, and mustard, mixing lightly until the egg yolk is smooth. Divide beef mixture among 12 thin slices of waxed paper or plastic wrap. Roll up tightly.

title: Easy Focaccia  (No Bake)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon bread flour or 1 teaspoon salt, for the bread flour or 1 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons coconut milk | 3/4 lb pork shoulder, sliced into thin strips | 1 can sliced black olives, drained
instructions: Prepare the bread flour or salt. Preheat oven to 400°f in a large bowl, mix ¾ cup or 3/4 cup of coconut milk with the bread flour or all purpose flour and stir well. Add the sliced pork, olives, and any juices in a bowl. Sprinkle more cheese if you like, and toss with the bread flour or salt and place onto a buttered baking sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until top is lightly golden brown.

title: The Easiest Brisket of Beef Ever
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 8 ounces good quality dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Rinse the brisket in a sink full of cold water and place it on the rack in a roasting pan. In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the chocolate, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Place brisket in a roasting pan. Insert two tooth picks into the center of the brisket. The meat should be about 6 inches across the bones. Pour the chocolate over it. Bake at 400f for 50 minutes until cooked as desired. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: feta,salt,dark soy sauce,red chili pepper,allspice,ziti pasta
title: Greek Meat Pie
ingredients: 2 lbs ziti pasta | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 16 ounces feta, grated | 2 ounces dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 teaspoon ground red chili pepper
instructions: Cook ziti al dente in a large pot of boiling water. Drain and set aside. Heat remaining ingredients in large skillet, stirring often, until warm. Pour warm marinade over ziti and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Spinach and Raisins With Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 450 g frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 can condensed brown gravy mix | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 -2 teaspoon hot pepper, crushed | 175 g raisins
instructions: Combine all ingredients except raisins in pan, except raisins. Simmer for 1 - 2 hours on low heat. Cover, cook for 1 - 2 minutes longer or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: radish,beef chuck,flat leaf italian parsley,red cabbage,chocolate syrup,chili oil,kidney bean,olive oil
title: Spicy Chocolate-Beef and Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef chuck or 1 lb veal, lean | 1/2 cup good quality dark chocolate syrup | 1/4 cup good-quality chili oil ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 2 small radishes, thinly sliced ( can sub a lot of red ) | 1 small red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 -2 tablespoon flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Cut beef into 3/4 pieces. Place all ingredients in medium bowl. Melt chocolate syrup in microwave on high, stirring every 30 seconds, until just hot, about 1 minute. Add hot chocolate to meat in serving bowl, stirring just until coated, about 3 minutes. Add to remaining ingredients, stir just to combine, heat over very low heat just until mixture is heated through, about 3 minutes.

title: Pan Seared Mussels
ingredients: 2 lbs mussels, scrubbed | 5 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 3 tablespoons coarse grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds, crushed
instructions: Steam mussels in microwave over covered glass or ceramic bowl with lid on, covered, for about 12 to 15 minutes or until tender. While mussels are steaming, mix feta and mustard in large bowl. Remove mussels from microwave.

title: Microwave Packet Fish
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 8 ounces shredded cod | 8 ounces peas ( fresh ok ) | 2 ounces quick-cooking sherry ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 cup ice cube ( optional )
instructions: Spray a 4 - 5 quart microwave safe bowl with cooking spray or line with aluminum foil. In large nonstick skillet, saute fish on high heat 2 minutes per side. Remove fish from skillet and add all other ingredients. Microwave uncovered on high for 2 minutes then turn heat to low and stir. Cook for 7 minutes. Serve from microwave on plate, top with a dollop of sour cream or lettuce and if desired a sliced tomato.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,black bean,cardamom,green onion,edam cheese,pork chop
title: Mexican Pork and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork chop, cubed | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1 can black beans, rinsed, drained, or 3 1/2 cups drained canned black beans, rinsed, drained | 4 green onions, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 2 cups edam cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat a large skillet with a rack in the middle, and preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray the hot skillet with cooking spray, then add pork.

Random Ingredients: sultana raisin,pearl barley,poblano chile,brandy,almond flour,ajwain,seasoning salt
title: Ras El Hanout
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles | 1 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup brandy ( good quality ) or 1/4 cup dry white wine ( good quality ) | 1/2 cup sultana raisin ( also called sultanas ) | 1/2 tablespoon almond flour | 1/2 tablespoon seasoning salt ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ajwain ( optional )
instructions: Remove the seeds from the peppers and rinse them under cold water and put in a bowl with the barley, brandy and sultanas. Toss well and set aside. Mix all the ingredients together in a shallow dish and refrigerate. Preheat the oven to 250°f put the mixture into an ovenproof dish and bake for 1½ - 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Serve warm with chips as an accompaniment.

title: Sweet Saffron Salsa
ingredients: 1 pinch saffron thread | 2 cups sour cream | 1 1/2 pounds fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 3 medium carrots, peeled | 2 cups hot salsa | 2/3 cup chopped fresh cherries
instructions: Toast and grind saffron threads in a mortar or small food processor. Whip sour cream until fluffy and add saffron powder, parsley, carrots, salsa and 1 1/2 cups cold water. Continue to stir the mixture until it's completely blended into a smooth and creamy salsa. Spoon this into a serving dish and top with fresh cherries.

title: Portuguese Style Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 1 kg pork spareribs | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 bunch spring onion, chopped | 1 liter ripe olives, chopped ( kalamata variety ) | 150 g parmesan cheese
instructions: Pre heat oven 350°f. Remove the excess fat from the spareribs, wash, dry and cut into portions. Place over a high heat until the temperature reaches 160f, about 20 minutes. Place in baking tray with some space for the spareribs in the oven. Bake for about 45 - 60 minute, depending on the size of your spareribs. In the meantime mix the sauce with the vegetables, stir until well blended. After cooking 10 minutes add the cheese. Remove from stove and serve with rice or pasta. Note, for a main dish like risotto it serves 2, 3 and 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,pineapple juice,corn tortilla,tortilla,yellow pepper,cauliflower floret,sherry wine
title: Caramelized Red Pepper and Sweet Corn Tortilla Tacos
ingredients: 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, red and green, roasted, peeled and cut into thin strips | 1 medium cauliflower floret, trimmed and steammed | 1 can pineapple juice | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 12 corn tortillas | 12 whole-grain sandwich thin corn tortillas | 4 -8 ounces hamburger, cooked and drained
instructions: Saute peppers, cauliflower and pineapple juice in skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring often. Pour into large bowl. Add sherry and gently warm tortillas. Spoon vegetable mixture into tortillas. Warm sandwich thin tortillas in oven or microwave. Add cooked and drained crumbled burger to tortillas and fold. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white miso,butternut squash,gingerroot,apple juice,bread machine acting active yeast,olive oil,sherry,cheddar cheese
title: Squash, Apple and Noodle Pies
ingredients: 1 lb butternut squash, peeled, seeded and mashed or 1 lb winter squash | 2 tablespoons dried apple juice | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 egg | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, peeled and grated | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, grated and divided ( we like sharp cheddar ) | 1/4 cup white miso ( also sold at health food stores ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons bread machine quick-acting active dry yeast or 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Scrape squash with a spoon into a large bowl. Add apple juice. Add olive oil, egg, ginger, 1/4 cup cheese, and remaining cheese. Stir to combine. Dissolve yeast in 2 tablespoons warm water. Stir to blend. Add yeast water to squash mixture, mixing well with a spoon. Add yeast and 2 tablespoons cheese to bread batter, mixing well but not excessively. If too dry, add more water. Spoon into 12 - 16 1/2 x 8 1/2 inch loaf pans or spray with shortening. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake until top is crusty and lightly browned, about 25 - 30 minutes. When done, remove from oven and top with remaining cheese. Return to oven for about 15 min or until golden brown, melted and crusty in places. For a thicker crust, let stand 15 minutes before attempting to cut.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,taco seasoning mix,chicken breast fillet,coconut,sea scallop
title: Chicken, Scallops and Coconut Tostadas
ingredients: 1 lb whole-grain sea scallops | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 lbs chicken breast fillets | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening ( or margarine ) | 1 can sweetened condensed biscuit biscuits ( or homemade biscuits )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Rinse the scallops under cold, running water, and pat dry with paper towels. Place them on the parchment paper and lightly salt them. Sprinkle the scallops with taco seasoning coating. Bake, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes then turn off the oven. Lightly grease a nonstick 12 by 9 inch or larger baking dish. Heat the shortening in a skillet over medium heat. Dip each shrimp in the condensed biscuit crumbs, place in the skillet and shake off the excess. Cook the shrimp in the shortening until lightly browned and cooked through, about 3 minutes. Transfer to the prepared baking dish, spoon the coconut cream over them and return the dish to the oven. Bake until the coconut cream is melted and bubbling, about 10 minutes. Serve immediately. Note, if you can find biscuits of your choice, these can be baked right away. This recipe doubles to make 2 to 3 servings. You may use fresh biscuits instead of corn biscuits. If you're looking for fresh biscuits, crackers or pretzels can be used as well.

Random Ingredients: cream,amaretto,water chestnut,beef sirloin steak,beef bouillon cube,italian dressing
title: Slow Cooker Swiss Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh beef top sirloin steaks, cut 1 inch thick | 1 cup water chestnuts, sliced | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 1/4 cup amaretto or other almond-pepper flavored liqueur | 1/2 cup italian dressing, or as needed
instructions: Mix the beef, water chestnuts, onion, soup, and bouillon in crock of a slow cooker. Cook on high for 2 hours. Before serving, pour amaretto on top, and cook on low for 2 more hours.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,red chili powder,chili paste,rice wine,onion,tomato basil pasta sauce
title: Tomato Basil and Chilli Sauce - Vegan or Not
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili paste ( the original calls for 2tbsp chili powder. the original called for 2tbsp chili paste. we like ours over a little garlic red pepper blend ) | 500 g tomato and basil pasta sauce ( we use old world brand ) | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1 small onion, diced | 1 medium bell pepper, deseeded & diced | 1 teaspoon red chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a glass pan & stir in. Cover and heat for 15 minutes on the stove till warmed through. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,chocolate,egg noodle,red apple,chicken bouillon,black bean,watermelon,avocado
title: Chicken Noodle Salad (Avocado)
ingredients: 1 bag egg noodles | 2 cups watermelon, cubed | 1 1/2 cups mangoes or 1 1/2 cups papaya, cubed | 2 small red apples, peeled, cored and cubed | 2 garlic cloves, diced ( or more if you like ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon, plus more for sauteing onions and chicken | 4 ounces sweet unsweetened chocolate, chopped | 1/2 avocado, chopped
instructions: Bring a medium size pot of salted water to a boil. Stir in noodles until tender.

title: Buca Di Beppo Penne with Shellfish
ingredients: 7 ounces penne | 12 ounces scallops | 3 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese | 7 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 3 tablespoons bouquet garni, from a bunch sauteed in 1 -3 tbsp. olive oil
instructions: Cook penne as directed on package. While pasta is cooking, peel scallops by placing them in a pan of boiling water. While shells are cooking in a saucepan pour 3 tblsp. Of olive oil into a 6 inch saute pan. Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of the water from cooking the pasta. Drain pasta well. Mix the scallops, cheese, mustard and bouquet garni, plus 1 1/2 cup of pan water, in a large bowl to combine and season the pasta with salt and pepper. Add pasta to the rest of the oil and toss well to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Baked shallots
ingredients: 8 large shallots, sliced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh tomato ketchup | allspice berries ( optional )
instructions: Place shallots in lightly greased ovenproof dish. Combine all remaining ingredients and seasonings in a small bowl. Pour over shallots. Sprinkle with more spices before baking. Bake in a preheated 180 celsius oven until golden, approx 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chili,basil,french bread,rum extract,white potato,meatball,green bean,jasmine rice
title: Sweet-And-sour Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb white potato | 6 slices french bread | 1 pinch dried basil | 1 pinch crushed red chili | 1/2 lb frozen cooked meatballs ( or meat of your choice ) | 1 jar diced sweet red chili ( drained of grease ) | 10 ounces fresh green beans | 6 cups cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Preheat grill or oven to broil. Cook sweet potato on grill or oven until tender. About 20 minutes. Slice, cube and fry bread. Remove and drain on paper towels. Combine all ingredients except salt, pepper and rice. Fill each bread bag with meat and bake for 5 minutes or until heated through. Pour into soup bowls and serve with rice.

title: Tahini Pork
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 4 pounds pork loin roast | 20 baby carrots | 10 fresh curry leaves, or to taste
instructions: Combine tahini and 2 tablespoons water in the container of a blender. Blend until combined on high speed about 45 seconds.

Random Ingredients: parchment paper,american cheese,ice,pork shoulder,soy sauce,gingersnap cooky,italian sausage
title: Bundi
ingredients: 24 ounces boneless pork shoulder | 1/2 lb pork sausage | 8 ounces american cheese | 1 box gingersnap cookies | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/2 cup ice | parchment paper
instructions: Cut the pork shoulder in half. Rub the pork shoulder with soy sauce. Take the rind from gingersnap cookies and grate them into your food processor. Put into a glass pie plate. Wet the edge with a little water and place on the rim of the pie plate. Fill the pie plate with ice. Arrange the pork on the ice and top with the grated cheese. Make sure all the cheese is encorporated in the cheese layer on top of the pork. Bake at 350 degrees farenheit for approximately 1 hour.

title: Ancho Chile Powder
ingredients: 4 dried ancho chile powder | 1 cup white onion, coarsely chopped | 4 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Place chile powder in a mortar. Add onions and rub into the powder. Add enough liquid smoke to give a fine powder. Stir to combine. Store in a sealed container in a cool place.

title: Chutney Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup cooked white rice | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed
instructions: In an 8 inch nonstick frypan, combine rice, chutney spread and oregano. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: cider,tomato green chilies,fenugreek,soy sauce,black mustard seed,salmon fillet
title: Broiled Salmon With Chilli, Tomatoes, Fenugreek and Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets, bone in | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1/3 teaspoon fenugreek, crushed | 1/3 cup cider | 1 green chilies, deseeded and chopped
instructions: Season salmon with salt and pepper, then rub on the mustard seeds. Rub over soy sauce and stir in the fenugreek. Cook under a pre heated grill for 8 minutes. Put mustard seeds in a small fry pan with a little water, heat to simmering, then cook for 1 - 2 minutes to dry out. Brush salmon with mixture, sprinkle with chillies and serve.

title: Italian Sauce for Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste | 2 ounces fresh green onions
instructions: Scoop out the seeds from the tomato paste can and set them aside. Cut the onions into rings. Stir the tomato paste into the onion rings and cook over medium heat just to warm them up slightly.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,cooking spray,spinach leaf,liquid smoke,cream cheese
title: Spinach Spinach Roll-Ups
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1/3 cup ricotta cheese | 2 packages cream cheese, room temperature | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 450 degrees. Lightly coat 2 jelly roll pans with cooking spray. Spread spinach evenly on lined pans.

title: Veal and Lima Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb veal shank | 2 cans baby lima beans, undrained | 3 1/3 cups fish stock, heated
instructions: Place the veal shank in a shallow stockpot. Pour hot water carefully into the pot over the veal and bring to a boil.

title: Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 2 lbs plum tomatoes, chopped finely | 3 cups raisins | 3/4 cup seedless raisin ( i put mine in the food processor with all the other ingredients ) | 1 pinch salt and pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor. Process for a few min until mixture forms a paste. Store in covered container. You can also use canned tomatoes, and raisins instead of raisins.

title: Chinese Sweet 'N' Hot Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sweetened condensed sweetened pineapple chunks, packed into cold water | 1 cup hot water
instructions: Mix sweetened condensed sweetened pineapple juice into cold water in a bowl until completely mixed. Serve hot alongside korean kimchi, dipping sauce, or chile paste for dipping.

title: Fondue (Portuguese Style Fish)
ingredients: 2 lbs fish, sliced in half horizontally, and cut crosswise into 4 | salt pork, sliced thinly into 4 pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Roll the fish pieces into a cylinder shape with the fat from the fish and salt, as needed, and tie with string. Place in a roasting pan and roast for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with borscht and a fried potato.

Random Ingredients: red onion,napa cabbage,red capsicum,red curry paste,potato chip,brown rice
title: Spicy Red Capsicum and Potato Chip Stir-Fry (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( thai red curry paste with regular microwave noodles ) | 2 cups napa cabbage | 1 red capsicum, red bell pepper | 1 cup potato chips ( plain potato sticks ) | 1/4 cup brown rice, steamed | 1 small red onion, sliced thin into rings
instructions: Combine curry paste and microwave steamed rice together, stirring, until rice is well coated in paste. Place napa cabbage, red capsicum and potato chips in a sieve lined with muslin or cheese cloth and secure with tooth picks. Microwave vegetables on high power for 3 minutes or until crisp tender and cooked to desired consistency, swapping bowl half way through cooking. Add rice and stir to combine. Serve with sliced onion, sprinkled with extra thai red curry paste, if desired.

title: Sour Cream Vegetables With Herbs
ingredients: 600 g mixed vegetables, sliced 1 inch thick | 120 g baby spinach | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons low-fat sour cream | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1 teaspoon chopped chives
instructions: Place mixed vegetables in single layer in baking pan. Spoon over sour cream.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,artichoke heart,curry powder,sherry
title: Curried Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and drained | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/2 medium bell pepper, diced
instructions: Spray an 8 square baking dish with vegetable cooking spray. Sprinkle curry powder over artichoke hearts.

title: Grandma's Sauerkraut Guacamole Dip
ingredients: 1 jar sauerkraut | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1 -3 tablespoon cold water | 1 cup prepared guacamole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add more msg if desired. Enjoy with your favorite chips.

Random Ingredients: dill,vanilla pudding,iceberg lettuce,kiwi fruit,red cabbage,beef broth,cocoa powder,toothpick
title: Hot Chocolate and Kiwi Dressing Party Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package vanilla instant pudding | 1 can beef broth | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and chopped | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 leaves red cabbage, cut lengthwise in half | 4 leaves iceberg lettuce, cut into thin strips | 6 toothpicks | 8 toothpicks
instructions: Add the pudding and beef broth to a saucepan, and place over medium high heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened and fragrant, about 10 minutes. Stir in kiwifruit and cocoa powder until well blended. Remove from heat, and refrigerate until chilled, about 15 minutes. Arrange the lettuce, kiwifruit, and toothpicks on plates, and spoon the hot chocolate mixture onto the lettuce.

title: Guacamole Rice Pockets
ingredients: 2 cups plain guacamole | 1 cup triple sec | 1 container sour cream or 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 cups cooked arborio rice | allspice | pita bread
instructions: For the filling, combine rice, sour cream or yogurt& brandy. Spread 1/2 cup of the rice mixture on each pita bread. Fold and press around edges. Serve immediately.

title: Red Cupcakes (Toblerone)
ingredients: 250 g icing sugar | 3 drops cream of tartar | 2 drops red food coloring
instructions: To make the icing by stirring the sugar, cream the cream of tartar, food colouring and cream for 30 seconds. Add the icing to the icing and mix until well combined. Cut into small cakes or fill cupcakes with mixture.

title: Spicy Fried Beans
ingredients: 1 can chili beans | 1 pint mixed beans | 1/2 lb prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon paprika | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs | cherries ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut the beans in half and place in a pan with the remaining ingredients and bring to the boil. Simmer uncovered for about 1 or 2 hours until thick and creamy. Serve over salad and pass a piece of the thin slice of prosciutto. Serve with a little more paprika and chopped fresh herbs.

title: Mexican Style Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese | 12 ounces canned pickled jalapenos | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 1 head cabbage
instructions: Slice velveeta cheese in half and place on counter. Dice jalapeños into chunks and place in food processor. In a mixing bowl combine cheese, jalapeños, cumin and palm sugar. Set aside 1/2 cup cheese mixture for another use. Wet hands and roll other cheese mixture in this small bowl roll cheese mixture into cambodian style pieces. Chop cabbage fine and arrange on top of cheese. Wrap tightly with cellophane and place in a slow cooker. Cook on high for about 4 hours. Serve warm, on sandwich rolls with desired garnishes.

title: Crispy Banana 'n' Wheat Burgers With Lingonberry Pea Syrup
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen peas | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 80 g hamburger | 1/4 teaspoon gingerroot or 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/4 cup orange juice or 1/4 cup milk | powdered sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. In a large pan, combine the peas, flour and raisins and cook over a medium heat for 3 minutes. Add the beef, ginger and vanilla and stir until hot. Remove pan from the heat and transfer the mixture to a lightly oiled pan. Place on a baking tray and bake on the centre shelf of the oven for 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until the mixture starts to bubble.

title: Creamy Coconut Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, unsliced ( sourdough, rye, etc. ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half ( or other cream ) | 1/4 cup shallots or 1/4 cup golden onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 2 cans chopped mixed fruit | 1/8 - 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander or 1/8-1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/4 cup shredded coconut | pepperoni, slices ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Cut bread into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Pour bread into a greased 13x9 pan. In a saucepan, combine the remaining ingredients, except the topping. Pour over bread, spreading evenly. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Turn oven out. Drain fruit, if using, and layer evenly over bread. Bake uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes or until bread is golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,peanut oil,dark soy sauce
title: Peanut Sauce(Chinese Style)
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut oil ( or other neutral oil ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter
instructions: Mix peanut oil and dark soy sauce in a small bowl until well combined, set aside. Put peanut butter in a small bowl and stir in peanut butter until smooth. Enjoy.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans tomato sauce ( i use hunts ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: In a large skillet or slow cooker, pour in the tomato sauce, chicken bouillon, and chopped up vegetables. Add the chicken bouillon. Cover, and cook on low 8 to 10 hours, or on high 4 to 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,red potato,soy sauce,taco seasoning,yellow cake mix,italian tomato
title: Oriental Potato-Chive Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cake mix | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup taco seasoning | 2 small red potatoes, shredded | 2 large yukon gold potatoes, shredded | 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease muffin cups. In a large bowl, mix the yellow cake mix, soy sauce and taco seasoning until well blended. Stir in the potatoes, tomatoes and sour cream. Fill each muffin cup two thirds full. Cover the muffins with a dampened paper towel until ready to bake. Cook in the preheated oven until cooked through, about 3 to 5 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f.

title: Fantastic Sausage and marshmallow Rolls
ingredients: 1 pound bulk italian sausage | 1/2 cup light italian-style marshmallows | 1 can sweetened condensed milk | 5 packages frozen yeast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the sausage in a large skillet over medium high heat, and melt the sausage. Pour the sweetened condensed milk into the skillet, and stir in the yeast. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Remove from heat, and allow to rise in a warm place for about 30 minutes. Stir until a white foam appears on top. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish, and place the dough into the pan, or grease a piece of waxed paper. Cover, and let rise in a warm place for about 15 minutes. Bake in the preheated oven until the top of the crust is golden brown, about 45 minutes. Remove from the baking dish, and spread marshmallows on the crust, and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until marshmallows are golden brown. Allow to cool for a few minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: chili paste garlic,red bell pepper,pineapple ring
title: Super Easy Sweet Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 large red bell peppers | 1 teaspoon chili paste with garlic ( you can add a dash of garlic powder if you like ) | 1 bottle pineapple rings, drained
instructions: Cut bell peppers in halves lengthwise, place upright in a foil lined baking pan. Slice or quarter pineapple rings into 1/2 inch slices, place atop bell peppers. Sprinkle with chili paste. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 400f degrees for 25 - 30 minutes or until peppers are tender. Serve right away.

title: Garam Masala Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 pound baby clams, cleaned
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the ginger, and cook until brown, about 1 minute. Add the garam masala, and stir to blend the spices. Quickly add the clams, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, or until clams open. Remove from heat, and allow to cool. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,jalapeno pepper,sage leaf,cooking apple,rosemary sprig,chicken bouillon cube,pumpkin puree
title: Apple and Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 5 -6 small jalapeno peppers | 2 cans pumpkin puree | 1 can reduced sodium beef broth | 1 cup low-sodium chicken bouillon cube | 3 -5 fresh sage leaves | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary sprig | 3 cooking apples, peeled, cored, and chopped | fresh rosemary sprig, for garnish
instructions: Cut open jalapeno peppers lengthwise, remove seeds and cut into 1 inch pieces. Using a meat mallet or rolling pin, pound into 1 1/2 inch size pieces. Set aside. In a large heavy bottomed saucepan, combine the pumpkin puree, beef broth, and 1 cup water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add jalapeno pieces and sage leaves. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20 - 30 minutes. Add rosemary sprigs and remove from heat. While pumpkin is simmering, heat a medium saucepan of water to boiling and drop the apples into water one at a time. Boil for 1 minute and drain through a colander. Serve hot, garnished with rosemary sprigs.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,garbanzo bean,turmeric powder,cream cheese,cocoa,banana,fish sauce
title: Banana and Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon flaked coconut | 3 tablespoons cream cheese | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 3 slices banana
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Stir together garbanzo beans, coconut, cream cheese, turmeric, and icing sugar, fish sauce, and sliced bananas. Spread mixture into baking dish. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mirin,cooking spray,heavy cream,ginger,hp steak sauce,green onion
title: Ginger Steak Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger, minced | 4 green onions, slice white parts only | 1 tablespoon honey steak sauce ( recommended -- mccormick sweet soy sauce ) | 4 tablespoons heavy cream | cooking spray
instructions: Place ginger, onions, and honey steak sauce in a food processor. Process until garlic is finely chopped. Add cream and process until combined. Coat grill with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. When hot, heat the sauce for 30 to 60 seconds on each side. Serve over steaks.

title: Spicy Chili Con Carne Nuevo
ingredients: 1 cup hot rotel or 1 cup diced tomatoes, your choice | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper
instructions: Heat the rotel and add the chili pepper to taste. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Mexican Cotelette (Cheese Filling)
ingredients: 4 cups grated un-shredded queso cotija cheese | 1 medium fresh lemon, juice of
instructions: Mix the cheese and lemon juice well. Add a good pinch or two extra of cotija. Cover and chill until ready to use.

title: Cilantro Sole
ingredients: 1 sole fillet, about 1 pound | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f remove fish from packaging and slice into 4 slices. Arrange fish onto small cookie sheet, sprinkle with cilantro and bake 10 minutes, or until fish is cooked and fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork.

title: Gluten Free Chocolate Biscotti
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate, chopped roughly | 2/3 cup pecans, roasted, chopped | 100 g pearl barley, chopped roughly | 100 g frozen peas, thawed | 175 g plain flour
instructions: Heat oven to 200c, grease 2 - 18 x 2cm loaf tins with butter, line with baking paper. Place chocolate in a medium heat proof bowl, add the chopped pecans and mix over low heat until melted, stir in the cooked barley. Add the peas and combine. Stir in the flour and combine to make a soft dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead 5 times. Roll out to a ¾ inch thick rectangle and place on the lined tins, pressing up the excess with the back of a knife. Cut a cross 1½ - 2 inches length across the top and brush with milk. Bake for 12 - 15 min until golden. Leave tins to cool on a wire rack for 5 mins before removing. Cut loaf into 15 slices and place on plates.

title: Herbed Beef Loaf
ingredients: 1/4 cup egg substitute | 1/4 cup dried sage leaves, chopped | 1 sandwich bread, loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Combine egg substitute and sage, stir in bread. Turn bread into a loaf pan, bake for 15 minutes. Place on a rack to cool for 5 minutes. Slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: matzo meal,tomato green chilies,italian salad dressing,mace,radish,rum extract,gelatin
title: Italian Blondies
ingredients: 8 squares matzo meal | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 1/4 cup italian-style salad dressing | 1 can canned diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon rum extract
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt gelatin according to package directions. Cool until just barely set. In a 4 to 5 quart slow cooker, mix the matzo meal with cold water, until mixture is crumbly. Mix in gelatin mixture, diced tomatoes with green chilies, italian style salad dressing, diced tomatoes with green chilies, mace and rum extract. Set aside in refrigerator for at least 6 hours before serving to set and blend flavors. Store in refrigerator for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: ginger ale,sharp cheddar cheese,catsup,tortilla chip,snow pea,italian dressing,green chili
title: Baked Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup green chili, chopped | 1/2 cup bottled italian dressing | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 teaspoon instant ginger ale | 8 ounces baked tortilla chips | 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 can sliced snow peas
instructions: Combine first five ingredients. Spoon into baking dish. Sprinkle with tortilla chips. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake@ 350 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Smooth Barley Guacamole (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons barley or 1 1/2 tablespoons chickpeas, uncooked | 1 small tomatoes, chopped or can tomatoes without pulp ( diced ) | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a small bowl. Serve with chips.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,mozzarella cheese,ziti pasta,flour,water chestnut,balsamic vinegar
title: Cheesy Balsamic Calzones
ingredients: 1 box ziti pasta, penne or ( 16 ounce ) box rotini pasta | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1 cup low fat mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 -2 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons flour | 2 -3 tablespoons water
instructions: Brown water chestnuts in oil in a skillet. Add garlic salt to taste and stir for one or two minutes. Add chicken bouillon cube and flour and stir for one or two minutes. Dump in ziti and cheese and stir well. Cook for two minutes then add remaining ingredients except for water. Keep on low heat and cook until it's done. Stir several times. Serve on paper towels.

title: Italian Sausage Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 lb italian sausage, sliced | 12 medium carrots, cut into small sticks
instructions: Cut cauliflower into large florets and steam on a large, heavy pot for about 1 hour. Meanwhile, in a small frying pan, heat the olive oil and add the sausage. Cook for 20 minutes over medium high heat, stirring so that all of the pieces of sausage stick together and brown evenly. Strain the sausage and discard all but 1 tablespoon of the drippings. Remove cauliflower from flame and arrange on a serving dish. Pour 1/4 of the fat from the pan and add the carrots, adding a little water. Cover and cook over medium low heat, stirring often, until the cauliflower begins to soften, about 10 minutes. Transfer carrots to plates and set aside. Pour the vegetables and drippings into the pan and cook another 5 minutes over medium fire, stirring up and dissolving any remaining fat.

title: Chile Hotpot
ingredients: 3/4 lb anaheim chilies | 2 cups vegetable broth or 2 cups chicken broth | 1/2 cup black vinegar | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 1/4 teaspoons onion powder | 1 1/4 teaspoons mixed spice
instructions: In a blender, puree chilies, vegetables broth, vinegar, tarragon, onion powder, and spice. Cover and refrigerate overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,phyllo pastry,cavenders purpose greek seasoning,japanese eggplant,prune,lemon juice zest
title: Potato & Frisee Samosas(Fruity Eggplant Pastries & Preserve!)
ingredients: 250 g russet potatoes, peeled & sliced | 1 kg japanese eggplant, peeled & sliced & then cut into quarters or 1 kg any eggplant, peeled & thinly sliced & then cut into four slices total ( 6 slices ) | 1 kg cavenders purpose greek seasoning | 2 large lemons, juice & zest of or 2 small limes, juice of or 2 scotch bonnet chiles | 300 g pitted prunes, drained & roughly chopped | 12 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: To make the potatoes, put potatoes, eggplant & cavenders/greek seasoning in a saucepan & cover. Bring it to the boil & then simmer, uncovered, for about 20 minutes over a moderate heat & then stir in zest & juice or chiles & continue to simmer until potatoes & eggplant are just tender. The dish should be a little crisp & creamy & the potato juices should have reduced. Cool slightly & set it aside. Spray a 12 x 8 pan or casserole dish with cooking spray & set aside. Pour about 1½ cups of the potato sauce in the bottom of the prepared pan or casserole dish. Spread half the potato slices over the top of the potato sauce, then arrange half the prunes over this & spread the remaining potato slices over this & then arrange the remaining prunes over the prunes. Continue to alternate layers of potato, eggplant & prunes, ending with a layer of potato sauce.

title: Real Simple Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 can chocolate pudding mix | 1 1/2 cups fine dry breadcrumb | 1 3/4 teaspoons crushed szechuan peppercorns
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c/350°f. Mix the dry breadcrumbs and ground szechuan peppercorns together in a small bowl. In 2 deep or square cake tins, grease the top and sides with a light coating of oil. In a large bowl, mix all ingredients except the dry mixture. Sprinkle the reserved crumb over the top of the cake. Bake for 50 - 60 minutes until top just turns firm. Serve warm and enjoy.

title: Tibetan Spaghetti
ingredients: spaghetti | spice | dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Prepare spaghetti according to directions on package. Put in ice cold water to stop it from cooking further and to stop it from sticking to the bottom of your pan. Add a dash of dark rum if you like.

title: Nori Sushi
ingredients: 12 sheets nori | 6 green onions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f or your oven to 400 degrees f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice the sheets into triangles approximately 1 inch wide by 2 inches long. Use a pastry brush to coat each slice of nori evenly with vegetable oil, about 1/4 cup per slice. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of the green onions, with allspice, and 1/8 teaspoon of the salt onto the nori slices. Repeat with the rest of the ingredients. Place the sliced sushi onto the lined baking sheet about 3/4 inch in from the heat. Bake for 5 minutes or until golden. Remove from oven and let sit for a few moments before removing with a spatula.

title: Herbed Italian Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2/3 cup salad dressing ( or use basil to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh basil ( finely chopped )
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together salad dressing and basil. Cover and refrigerate. When ready to serve, stir in salad dressing to taste.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce leaf,active yeast,fire tomato,red potato,mustard,paprika,crabmeat
title: Italian Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 1/4 teaspoons dry active yeast | 1/2 cup red potato, cooked, peeled, quartered, and diced | 1 can crabmeat, drained and chopped | 1 can fire-roasted tomatoes, with liquid | 1 tablespoon dry mustard, to taste | 1 romaine lettuce leaf
instructions: In large bowl, combine flour, yeast, and potatoes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead until dough is smooth and elastic about 10 minutes. Place on lightly floured surface. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to rest in a draft free spot 30 minutes. Roll out into desired rectangle. Lightly flour a large baking sheet. Cut into 4 equal strips. Place 3 rows of 3 strips on each of the 4 baking sheets. Cover and let rise about 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated 350f oven 10 minutes or until browned. Cut each pizza into 12 wedges. Serve hot.

title: Bali Hara Dhoon
ingredients: 1 cup chapati flour | 1 green capsicum, seeded and cubed | 4 packets liquid smoke
instructions: Combine the chapati flour and capsicum in a dry bowl. Stir in liquid smoke. Let stand for 20 minutes. Shape the dough into 10 balls of equal size and flatten into flat balls. Cover with cling film and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Heat a griddle. Cook the dhalles for 3 minutes until slightly crisp and golden brown.

title: Polenta Lasagna
ingredients: 8 large lasagna noodles, cooked | 2 cans sweet corn flakes ( dr. pepper's brand corn ) | 1/3 cup instant polenta | 8 cups canola oil for frying
instructions: Set oven to 300 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Toss noodles with the corn flakes in a bowl using a fork to thoroughly coat. In another bowl, stir together the polenta and canola oil. Brush two 13x9 inch jelly roll pans with the oil, and place half of the uncooked noodles in each pan. Layer noodles beginning at noodles, breaking up any broken pieces as you go. Repeat with another layer of noodle, cornflake mixture, and polenta mixture, ending with a layer of noodles. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes. Remove foil, and bake until top is browned, about 10 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,green cabbage,fettuccine pasta,white bean,fish stock,mozzarella cheese,tomato,ice cube
title: Fettuccini With Cabbage, Beef and White Beans
ingredients: 2 cups cooked fettuccini pasta | 3 cups shredded green cabbage | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 tomato, sliced | 2 cups white beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup fish stock | 1 teaspoon mrs. dash seasoning | 1/4 cup crushed ice cube
instructions: Cook fettuccini according to package directions. Drain. Combine vegetables in a large bowl. Add noodles and all remaining ingredients. Toss to coat. Sprinkle with fresh minced parsley, parmesan cheese and additional salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: grape,bamboo shoot,paprika,orange juice,water,olive oil,vodka,skor english toffee bit
title: Smoky Stove-Top Smoked Paprika Orange Sausage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 8 spiced sausage, such as skor english toffee bits | 1 can canned sliced bamboo shoots, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups orange juice, divided | 1 bottle dry vodka | 1 cup water | 1 cup seedless grapes
instructions: Heat oil in large saute pan over medium heat. Add paprika, stirring until fragrant, about 20 seconds. Add sausage and saute until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Add water, vinegar and 2 tablespoons orange juice. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until sausage is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Pour into serving dish. Top with grapes. Reheat and serve.

title: Armenian Apple Rice and Cilantro Rolls
ingredients: 1 can peeled cored cored apples with juice | 1 cup raw rice | 1 teaspoon anchovy, minced | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 small pie crust, prepared | 1 cup long grain white rice | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f in a deep glass casserole, place apples and their juice and rice and mash thoroughly so that they become a slightly chunky puree. Stir in anchovy, pepper and cilantro. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sausage,kosher salt,marsala wine,dijon mustard,pecan half,confectioner sugar,leek
title: Stroganoff
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced leek | 3/4 cup diced smoked sausage | 3/4 cup marsala wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 pinch kosher salt | 64 more pecan halves, toasted
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, stir together the leeks, sausage and marsala. Cook for about 5 minutes, until sausages are browned on the bottom and leeks are tender. Remove from heat and stir in mustard, confectioner's sugar and salt until well blended. Fill each pecan half with the sausage mixture. Roll in toasted pecan halves.

Random Ingredients: pear,sake,kiwi fruit,extra sharp cheddar cheese,chicken broth,fennel seed,red chile,apricot jam
title: Sapporoos de Ajo Verde (Pear Fondue)
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe pears, firm, not too ripe, in one heap and with a little pear left on | 1 quart reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1/4 cup apricot jam ( or substitute 2 tablespoons jam with 1/4 cup sugar ) | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled, halved and sliced | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 3 -4 inches dried red chiles | 1/2 lb extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Place pears in a saucepot of boiling water. When they come to the surface, remove and place in a bowl of ice water. Let sit until tender, about 5 minutes, drain. Drain and discard pears. Pour into a fondue pot along with the broth and bring to a simmer. Add jam. Stir in the kiwi, fennel seed, chiles, and half the cheese. Cover and return to a simmer, then serve with toasted tortilla slices.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,provolone cheese,serrano pepper,white corn,summer squash,lime juice zest,green cardamom pod
title: Mexican Verde Vegetable-Spinach Salad With Fresh Lime Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 bunches spinach leaves ( about 2-3 bunches or 4 bunches ) | 4 tablespoons lime juice, plus 1-2 limes, use freshly juiced zest of 2 whole limes | 12 small summer squash, cut into 1-inch slices | 2 cups cooked white corn, preferably red ( about 3 ears ) | 4 tablespoons thinly sliced serrano peppers ( from a jar ) | 4 ounces thinly sliced provolone cheese or 4 ounces cheddar cheese, thinly sliced | 2 green cardamom pods, smashed
instructions: Place a colander in a large bowl and let drain the spinach and dry on paper towels for 30 minute set aside in a large bowl, toss with 1 tablespoon of the lime juice. Coarsely grate the zest of 2 limes, then cut into thin slivers add to spinach and toss with the zest and lime juice with the squash and the corn. Grate the cheese over the vegetables and stir in the pepper. Chill for 2 - 3 hours to blend the flavors. Make the vinaigrette, stir 2 tablespoons water, the cardamom pods, and the remaining lime juice in a small bowl until mixed well.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,red chile pepper,monterey jack cheese,feta,rice wine
title: Cod, Chilli and Feta Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds cod fish fillets, cubed | 1 teaspoon chopped red chile pepper | 1/2 cup crumbled feta | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, diced
instructions: In a medium size bowl, mix the cod, chillies, feta and rice wine. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour to allow flavours to develop. When ready to serve, remove from refrigerator and stir well. Serve with crackers or pita chips.

title: Baked Pork Loin With Vinegar and Peppers
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin roast | cooking spray | 4 teaspoons low-sodium worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray the inside of the pork roast with nonstick cooking spray. Place the pork roast in a heavy duty roasting pan. Rub the worcestershire sauce and vinegar mixture over the meat. Reserve the peppercorns. Bake at 350 degrees f for 2 hours or until the internal temperature of the roast registers 145 degrees f on an instant reading thermometer. If using a meat thermometer then reduce the cooking time for longer duration, for a longer cooking time. Transfer the roast to a board and let rest for 20 minutes before slicing. While warm, prepare the sauce by combining the peppercorns, worcestershire sauce and vinegar in a small bowl and using a whisk attachment. Serve with the slices.

Random Ingredients: espresso,orange liqueur,yellow bell pepper,serrano pepper,italian herb
title: Espresso Mousse
ingredients: 1 orange-flavored liqueur ( eg. frangelico ) | 5 -6 teaspoons espresso, warmed or 5 -6 teaspoons hot coffee | 1/4 medium yellow bell pepper, seeded | 1/4 medium serrano pepper, seeded | 1/8 teaspoon mixed italian herbs
instructions: Place all ingredients into a shaker. Cover and shake to thoroughly combine. Chill 1 - 2 hours. Serve in a martini glass.

Random Ingredients: butter,chili,corn tortilla strip,chili paste,oyster sauce,ricotta cheese,egg substitute,broth
title: Chef John's Chili Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili paste | 1/4 cup canned whole-egg substitute | 1 1/4 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1/2 chili ( asian green chili ) | 1 1/2 cups light ricotta cheese | 12 corn tortilla strips or 12 flour tortillas | 1 teaspoon chili, flakes and or 1 teaspoon hot sauce for garnish
instructions: Melt butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add chili paste and cook 1 minute or until fragrant, 1 minute. With a slotted spoon, remove chili. Add broth.

title: Easy Orange Chicken
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts ( or equivalent amount of chicken tenders ) | 1/3 cup orange juice
instructions: Place chicken in freezer while preparing your other ingredients. Remove chicken from freezer and defrost briefly before cooking. Cut chicken breasts into small dice while still chilled. Add orange juice to skillet and simmer a few minutes on medium. Add chicken to sauce and stir in a few pieces of sweet onion if desired. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: coffee granule,red capsicum,curry,baking soda,dark soy sauce,tequila
title: Spice Rub for Beef - Vegan!
ingredients: 6 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules | 1 tablespoon tequila | 1 tablespoon curry | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 red capsicum, diced
instructions: In a large bowl mix together all ingredients. Using a fork mix in the beef. Use your hands if necessary to rub all the mixture into the meat. Store in a dish in the fridge for up to 24 hours. Bring to room temperature before cooking, if using meat or vegetables. Use to store in an airtight container for up to 5 months.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,coffee,pesto sauce,tomato puree,kombu,ancho chilies,raspberry,channa dal
title: Grilled Vietnamese Fish
ingredients: 1 cup channa dal, steamed ( fresh is available in most supermarkets ) | 1/2 cup kombu | 1/2 cup tom puree | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 1 teaspoon ground ancho chilies | 500 -600 g fish fillets | fresh raspberries
instructions: Steam the chana dal, kombu and tom puree together in a separate pan for 20 minutes or until they are cooked, but not too soft. Blend the pesto with the ancho chilies and chilli paste. Spray a hot grill surface with cooking oil and grill the fish until cooked through and the consistency is of jam or custard. Arrange the fish, raspberries and tomato puree on warmed chana dal to serve.

title: Slow Cooker Vegetables
ingredients: 5 baby carrots, peeled and cut in half | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Place carrots in the bottom of a slow cooker. Sprinkle onion powder into the carrots. Set slow cooker to low. Cover and cook 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: tomato,dark corn syrup,amaretti,jalapeno powder,saffron,black bean sauce,chili oil,limoncello
title: Jalapeno Spaghetti Sauce-Homemade and Simple!
