ingredients: 2 cans fire-roasted diced tomatoes ( reserve 1/2 cup of liquid for later use ) | 1 can chili oil ( or equivalent ) | 1/2 lb amaretti | 4 ounces limoncello | 3 tablespoons dark corn syrup | 2 ounces black bean sauce | 1/2 - 2/3 teaspoon saffron | jalapeno powder ( optional ) or chipotle chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Dice 1/2 lb of tomato finely, place in a large pot and add 2 cans of fire roasted diced tomatoes. Add the amaretto and limoncello, and cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer until the amaretti, 1/2 lb of tomato liquid and 1/2 to 3/4 cup of water for 15 minute for amaretti. Remove from heat and add the black bean sauce and saffron powder. Mix well and serve over pasta enjoy.

title: Easy Poppy Seed Eggs
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs | 2 1/2 teaspoons poppy seeds
instructions: Punch the hard boiled eggs out of their shells. Finely chop the hard boiled eggs. In a small frying pan over medium heat, toast poppy seeds for about 5 minutes or until they pop apart. Remove the poppy seeds with a slotted spoon, allowing excess water to drip back into the pan. Set the remaining poppy seeds aside. Lightly brown the poppy seeds in the poppy seeds. Remove from heat. Place the poppy egg shells into hot water, and poach for about 2 minutes, until slightly dry. Remove the poppy egg shells from the water with a slotted spoon. Lift out of the boiling water and place in a mixing bowl. Mash the eggs. Add poppy seeds, stirring to coat each egg. Return the beaten mixture to the pan and stir until well blended and the poppy seeds are melted. Cool. Break shells into 4 pieces each, or shape half of an egg into an egg shape. Cool, and store in the fridge for up to one week.

title: Iraqi Fried Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks, about 2lb | 4 yellow onions, thinly sliced | cornflour | 1 eggplant, thinly sliced
instructions: Place lamb shanks and onions in a large freezer bag or container, pour over cornflour and squeeze out excess air. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain the lamb shanks and place on oiled tray in a shallow baking pan or roasting tin. Sprinkle top of lamb with salt and pepper and add eggplant to each piece and season with salt again. Bake in a moderate oven at 220°c mark 2 for about 1 1/2 hours or until golden brown all over.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,tapioca,butter margarine,ancho chilies,fillet,eggplant,moisture milk mozzarella,orange peel
title: Maggie's Grilled Eggplant - Filipino Style
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter or margarine | 2 tablespoons minced yellow onions | 2 fresh ancho chilies, chopped finely or crushed arbol chilies | 1 teaspoon shredded orange peel or 1 teaspoon freshly chopped zest ( i used lemon zest as i had no citrus ) | 6 large eggsplants, cut into 1/4 inch slices ( globe type ) | 12 large fillets ( or 6 medium firm, stripy fillets ) | 8 slices crusty artisan-style mozzarella or 8 slices monterey jack cheese ( cheeze-stone flavor works best ) | 1/2 cup store-bought tapioca
instructions: Preheat grill. To make filling. Melt butter in a large skillet or saute pan over low heat and add a small pinch of onion. Add chiles and orange peel and cook until chiles are soft. Remove from heat. In a large bowl, add eggplant, one slice of cheese, tapioca, and enough liquid from anchos, to moisten. Add remaining ingredients to taste. Mound filling onto one of the slices of eggplant and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Grill eggplant to desired doneness on each side, or until cheese is melted and a little browned. Serve over hot rice. Note, preparation time is approximate, as the filling can go from very well prepared, refrigerated, overnight, or over night if refrigerated, and baked.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,no salt tomato,gouda cheese,cooking wine,leek,couscous,italian breadcrumb,ancho chile powder
title: Ancho-Gouda Stuffed Whole Tomatoes
ingredients: 11 ounces no-salt-added whole tomatoes, whole | 2 ounces gouda cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1/2 medium leek, white and light green parts only, chopped | 2 tablespoons minced fresh italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons cooking wine, if using it | 2 cups toasted couscous, preferably quick cooking couscous
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Cut off the tops and bottoms of the tomatoes. Reserve the tops, if using whole, and trim the bottom and ends. Place the tomatoes in a medium oven proof dish, and spread the cheese cubes evenly. Bake the tomatoes for about 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted. In a medium bowl, toss the leeks with the italian seasoning, bread crumbs and chile powder. Add the flour and a pinch of salt to create a firm mixture that starts to cling to the tomatoes. Remove the tomatoes from the oven, and add the water. Cover tightly with foil, and cook the tomatoes for about 20 minutes. Remove the foil, and continue cooking the tomatoes for about 2 more minutes. Remove the tomatoes from the oven, and remove the meat. Arrange the tomatoes on a platter, and cool. To serve, put the couscous in a bowl with boiling water. Allow to cool, then drain. Remove the skin from the tomatoes. Spoon the tomatoes onto a serving platter, and top with couscous.

title: Sauce and Duck on Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 duck leg | 2 tablespoons soymilk | 2 tablespoons baby spinach ( or other baby spinach ) | 1/2 lb spaghetti or 1/2 lb linguine | 12 bamboo skewers, soaked in water in a steamer
instructions: Dry roast the almond extract, mace and the duck legs with clean kitchen towels for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to ensure even coating. Place the soymilk and the spinach in a medium saucepan and boil until the sauce thickens. Dip the skewers in soymilk then place skewers in the hot sauce for 10 minutes, turning for approximately 10 minutes. Serve hot over spaghetti along with freshly grated parmesan/romano cheese.

title: Beef Steak Balls
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into chunks | 1 cup icing, sieved | 1/2 cup icing, sieved
instructions: Mix together the sieved icing and icing and roll meat chunks in the mixture. Refrigerate for at least 10 hours. Remove meat from freezer and place in a roasting pan. Bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour. Turn off oven and leave meat in for one hour before removing meat with a slotted spoon. Pour out all but 1 tablespoon of drippings. If desired, return meat, gravy and any liquid to pan. Simmer for a few minutes, and then pour over cooked noodles or rice. Use meat to fill a can of sweetcorn and serve.

title: Strawberry and Goat Cheese Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen mixed strawberries ( or more if desired ) | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 jar sliced water chestnuts, finely chopped | 1/4 lb goat cheese ( room temperature ) | 8 slices white bread
instructions: Thaw the strawberries for a few hours, drain completely, and combine with the golden syrup & water chestnuts. Slice the goat cheese as if you're using italian cheese, cutting 3/4 of it across the middle lengthwise. Soak the bread slices in room temperature water until soft about 10 minutes. Spread the slices with goat cheese, and use a spoon to evenly distribute the cheese between the 4 slices. Replace the tops, slice the bread, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,risotto rice,baking powder,dijon mustard,greek seasoning
title: Kittencal's Greek Flavored Risotto, Rice and Toss
ingredients: 14 ounces risotto rice, washed, drained, rinsed with cold water ( rinsed and drained again ) | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard ( or other strong-flavoured mustard ) | 1 tablespoon flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: To make the risotto, in a large microwave safe bow or large saute pan add all the ingredients and the rice.

title: Creamy Spaghetti Fajitas
ingredients: 1 package flour tortillas | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 cup chunky spaghetti sauce
instructions: Lay your tortillas on a clean, dry frying pan and sprinkle with the margarine. Turn on your heat to high and when the margarine has melted, throw in the tortillas. As soon as they are pliable, flip them into the skillet to make sure both sides are evenly browned. Turn once to ensure both sides are evenly browned. Spread some of your choice of cheeses on the tortillas. Spread your sauce on one side only, and roll up like a burrito. When finished, it should all be covered with sauce. It should not be touching, or the tortillas will split and be difficult to roll. After doing that, put in a plate and dig in.

title: Asian Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup dijon mustard
instructions: Stir dark sesame oil and dijon mustard together in a wide, shallow bowl. Add more or less to taste.

title: Spicy Daikon Radishes
ingredients: 1 lb daikon radish, peeled | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, lightly crushed | 3/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Place radishes in a bowl, crush coriander seeds with a spoon, and season with paprika. Allow radish to marinate in the refrigerator overnight.

title: Raspberry and caster sugar biscuit With Crumble
ingredients: 500 g raspberries ( strawberries, blackberries, raspberries or other berries ) | 1 1/2 cups caster sugar | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Spread raspberries over base of 24 x 18cm slab tin or baking paper. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake in a moderate oven for about 15 minutes or until just beginning to soften. Remove from oven and spread on cracker crumbs. Return to oven for about 15 minutes or until topping is golden and bubbling. Serve with ice cream. Variation.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,salt pepper,flat leaf parsley,tomato,bay leaf,egg beater substitute
title: Tomato Soup With Egg Beaters
ingredients: 2 2 cups dry egg substitute | 6 tablespoons heavy whipping cream ( egg beaters recommended ) | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley ( roughly chopped ) | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley ( roughly chopped ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fat | 1 bay leaf, broken in half ( optional ) | salt and pepper
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water, blanch the eggs and set them aside. Into the boiling water put in the parsley and parsley, parsley, bay leaves and salt and pepper and let them simmer for 10 - 15 minutes. Then, using a hand held blender or food processor, puree the soup in small batches until it is smooth.

Random Ingredients: half,hot red pepper flake,ice,hard egg,phyllo pastry,apple juice,salsa
title: Apple Cheese Samosas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 1 quart half-and-half or 1 quart whipping cream | 12 sheets filo pastry | 8 large whole hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon crushed hot red pepper flakes | hot red pepper salsa | 2 cups chopped cold apple slices
instructions: Combine apple juice and half and half. Dip pastry sheets into apple juice mixture. Working with one at a time, layer pastries into an ungreased 12 x 5 x 1 inch baking dish. Cover with hot tap water. Bake at 450 degrees until browned and puffed, about 10 minutes. Drain. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees. Place apple slices on pastry in a spoke fashion around edges of baking dish. Bake, uncovered about 1 hour or until pastry is puffed and brown but apples aren't cooked through. Sprinkle with hot pepper flakes. Serve with hot salsa and apple slices.

title: Crock Pot Cod and Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: 500 g ground cod, drained | 150 g button mushrooms, finely chopped | 25 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, sliced | 3 slices bread | silken tofu, to serve
instructions: Line crock pot with pizza paper. Put cod and mushrooms in crock pot. Sprinkle over tomatoes, mint leaves and bread. Cover with tofu. Cook on high 40 minutes. Makes 40 servings.

title: Chili Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili, flakes | 2 tablespoons cardamom seeds ( optional )
instructions: Place chili flakes, cardamom pods, and cardamom seeds in a mug.

Random Ingredients: almond milk,pie crust,green olive,ice water,curry powder,butternut squash
title: Indian Quiche
ingredients: 1 box pie crusts ( such as galerie ) | 1/2 cup almond milk | 2 tablespoons ice water | 1 1/2 cups butternut squash, cubed ( about 1 medium ) | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1/3 cup green olives, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Press first pie crust into greased 9 inch pie pan. Cover bottom of pan with squash and sliced olives. Combine almond milk and water in a bowl.

title: Penne With a Kick
ingredients: 1 package dry penne pasta | 1 jalapeno, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the pasta in the boiling water, and cook uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Sweet & Sour Green Chilie Condiment
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups apple cider vinegar | 1/2 cup green chili, finely minced
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all ingredients until well mixed. Cover and chill in the refrigerator several hours before use.

title: Chinese Sweet Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon chili | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 2 tablespoons peanuts butter, unsalted, softened | 2 tablespoons simple syrup
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup water in a small skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Add cumin seed and chili.

title: Paprika Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb roast or 1 lb pork, sliced very thin ( about 4-6 slices ) | kosher salt | 1 box frozen bread ( i like italian rolls, but use something sweet and tart like croissants ) | 1 package firm tofu, cut through the tube to make a 1/4-inch thick slice lengthwise ( about 1 1/2 ounces ) | 2 -4 teaspoons paprika | 1 package phyllo dough, thawed or 1 package fresh puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Slice the roast thin on the bias. Sprinkle the salt evenly on both slices of bread and cut into 4 triangles. Arrange 12 triangles on a baking sheet and let stand 5 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange one cut side of each triangle, about 3 slices per triangle, in a single layer, on a piece of parchment paper to form a 6 inch square. Brush each triangle lightly with water and then sprinkle generously with paprika, pressing the paprika between each triangle. Place the bread slices on a nonstick baking sheet and bake until lightly toasted, about 10 minutes, turning over after 2 - 4 minutes. Remove from the oven. While the bread is toasting, trim the tofu if it has been cut in half, cut it crosswise. Remove 1 slice from the sheet of tofu and arrange it on top of the other slices. Cut the stack into four triangles and transfer to a cutting board. Using a sharp serrated knife, cut each piece of bread in half horizontally. Brush the triangles on all sides with water and sprinkle generously with paprika and lightly with paprika. Return the triangle with the cut side down to the baking sheet and cut the triangles crosswise into 1 or 2 triangles. Arrange the triangles on a baking sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes until golden. Let cool slightly. To serve, stack about 12 triangles on a plate and cover the triangles with some tofu. Sprinkle on lots of more paprika.

title: Cucumber and Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cucumbers | 3/4 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup liquid smoke | 1/4 cup packed fresh-grated cinnamon | 2 lbs chicken thighs | 2 slices white bread
instructions: Combine cucumber, mustard, 1/4 cup of the liquid smoke, and cinnamon in a large resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,chicken broth,summer savory,boboli pizza crust
title: Boboli Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon dried summer savory | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 9 slices boboli pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Pour broth over pizza crust. Sprinkle generously with savory and onion powder. Bake for 5 minutes and then turn temperature to 400f. Return to oven and bake for 30 - 40 minutes, or until golden on top and crust is crisp and golden.

title: Crock Pot Swedish Meatballs & Beans - Dairy Free
ingredients: 1 can white kidney beans | 1/2 red onion, cut into half moons | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 tablespoon arrowroot | 1/2 ounce chocolate, chopped | 3/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot. Cook on high for several hours. You will need to stir every 20 minutes..

Random Ingredients: nut walnut,hoagie,cinnamon,avocado,alfredo sauce,green bell pepper,gorgonzola,caraway seed
title: Vegetarian Baked Hoagie Rollups
ingredients: 4 hoagie rolls | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced | 1 green bell pepper, diced | 1/3 cup finely chopped gorgonzola, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds | 1/2 cup chopped nuts ( walnuts, hazelnuts, cashews, etc. )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f cut each hoagie roll in half lengthwise. Remove the crusts from the rolls and spread each with half the sauce. Layer the avocado, bell pepper, cheese, cinnamon and caraway seeds over top of the sauce. Replace the tops of the rolls and place, on a cookie sheet, on the bottom rack of the oven for 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow to cool until serving.

title: Crostini
ingredients: 1 package frozen round phyllo dough, thawed | 1 tablespoon triple sec or 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 2 teaspoons minced orange peel | 5 teaspoons fresh oregano leaves, chopped or 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray 2 10x6 inch jelly roll pans with vegetable oil or line with parchment paper. Unfold phyllo dough sheets and put on a parchment covered jelly roll pan. Working with one at a time, brush each with a little of the triple sec or grand marnier. Spread 3 teaspoons of orange peel and 1 teaspoon of oregano on phyllo to within 1/2 inch of the edges. Top with 3 more phyllo sheets and brush generously with the triple sec. Repeat with 3 sheets of phyllo, orange and oregano. Bake, switching position of pans and adding 1 tablespoon of oil or water every 10 minutes or so, until phyllo is lightly browned on top and phyllo is puffed and golden brown on bottom, 30 to 35 minutes or until the phyllo is crisp and golden. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,sun tomato oil,curry paste,pecorino romano cheese
title: Crazy Sun Dried Tomato, Spinach & Pecorino Romano Noodle
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, thinly sliced | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon hot curry paste, to taste | 8 -10 ounces fresh baby spinach | 1 tablespoon pecorino romano cheese
instructions: In a medium saucepan add all sun dried tomato in oil, curry paste & bring to a simmer. Cook 8 - 10 minutes until the pasta is completely cooked but still creamy. Add the baby spinach & cook another 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the cheese. Season to taste with salt & pepper if desired. Serve at once, with parmesan on top of each serving.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,cooking oil,white vinegar,chocolate,green chili pepper,tortilla,chicken meat,chicken thigh fillet
title: Chicken, Chocolate and Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 375 g boneless chicken thigh fillets, thinly sliced | 250 g chicken thigh fillets, finely sliced | 100 g white vinegar | 2 -3 green chili peppers, seeds included | 140 g roasted chocolate, chopped | 150 g ready made burrito-size tortillas | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 150 g lasagna noodles ( sheets ) | tortilla, warmed
instructions: Place chicken, chicken and vinegar in a large bowl and mix well to combine. Divide the mixture evenly between the tortillas. Place tortillas on a grilling board and spray with oil. Grill tortillas over medium high heat for about 2 minutes each side or until just coloured. Set aside. To make the filling, place chocolate, chilli and 1 cup hot water in a saucepan. Stir over low heat until chocolate is melted. Spread 1 sixth of the filling on each tortilla and roll up. Place onto a tray. Repeat, ending up with the rest of ingredients. Chill for 1 hour before slicing thinly into wedges. Serve with salsa on the side.

title: Quick Fix Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the maple syrup, chili sauce, horseradish, onion powder and brown sugar until well blended. Store in a covered container.

title: Lebanese-Mediterranean Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon clarified butter | 1 cup brown lentils | 3 large scallions | 3 large bell peppers ( i prefer red, green and yellow peppers ) | 1 cup diced candied cherries
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cut pork up into thin slices and pan fry in margarine until browned on both side. Remove browned pork from pan. Saute scallions and peppers in remaining margarine until the peppers are just tender. Remove the browned pork from the pan and place it in a casserole dish. Add the lentils, cook over low heat, uncovered, turning several times, and adding water, if necessary, to just cover lentils. Cook slowly, covered, about 45 minutes, or until tender. Add the pork and stir to combine and heat thru. Transfer to a platter and top with candied cherries or cilantro. Serve with couscous, salads, and rice. Servings, approximately 2 cups.

title: Portuguese Glazed Legs of Lamb
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 2 lbs leg of lamb or 2 lbs beef, cut into 12 serving portions | 2 red japenese serrano peppers or 2 jalapeno peppers, sliced | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Arrange the meat in the pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Stick slices of peppers into meat. Sprinkle with vanilla. Bake, tightly covered, for 2 hours. Uncover, and bake for 1 1/2 hours more.

title: Apple Macaroni
ingredients: 1 lb small head tart apple | 1 package dry elbow macaroni or ( 16 ounce ) package small shell pasta | garlic powder, to taste
instructions: Cut the apples into 1/2 inch wedges or smaller. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and put into large serving bowl. Make sure the apples are drained of all but the juice. Add half the garlic powder to the juice. Mix well and pour over macaroni. Mix. Sprinkle on remaining garlic powder to taste. Enjoy,.

title: Kofta With Lemon, Chickpeas and Lima
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb, cut into chunks | 1 can chickpeas | 1 medium onion, diced | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1/3 cup chopped italian parsley
instructions: In a skillet, combine lamb, chickpeas, onion, lime juice and chopped italian parsley. Place on medium high heat and cook for 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring occasionally, or until meat and chickpeas are tender.

title: Ancho and Red Pepper Sizzler
ingredients: 10 ancho chile powder ( ancho brand or similar brand ) | 8 red bell peppers, roasted and peeled | 1 can or bottle beverage
instructions: Pour ancho powder into a jar and add roasted red peppers. Shake jar to remove peppers from can. Pour can of beverage into hot, clean glass jar to fill jar to within 1/2 inches of the top of the jar. Cap with a rubber band. Refrigerate at least 3 weeks before serving.

title: Paneer Crab With Spring Greens and Crabs
ingredients: 500 g panir ( or any other firm soft white cheese ) | 100 g fresh crabmeat or 100 g canned crab | 2 spring greens | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Cube the paneer into 5cm pieces the size of the crabmeat. Clean the spring w stalks and cut off the leaves. Trim the stalks and leaves, remove and discard the thick leaves. Slice each spring leaf into 3 4cm wide strips. Chop the crab meat into thin strips. Mix the crab, spring leaves and oregano into the cheese. Place the mixture into a plastic bag and pipe it into 4 clear circles about 2cm in diameter. Chill the bag for 10 minutes. Preheat the grill or oil the grates. Remove the cheese tortilla from the freezer and take one circle in the middle of a large plate. Place a heaped tspful of stuffing on the tortilla and fold in half, then roll again, using the plate as a form to secure it. Repeat with the remaining circle of stuffing and stuffing. If using fresh crabmeat, add now with the crab meat and roll like a soft cigar. Place on a large baking tray covered with aluminium foil and grill or broil until golden and crisp. Serve immediately.

title: Lemon Pepper Macaroni
ingredients: 1 lb potato, peeled, left whole, boiled and peeled to remove excess starch ( about 3 cups ) | 2/3 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fine, dry breadcrumb | lemon pepper ( to taste ) | shell macaroni, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degrees. Place potatoes in a large pot or dutch oven. Add half and half, bread crumbs and lemon pepper to taste. Heat through. Drain potatoes. Place macaroni in a large bowl and add the warmed macaroni mixture. Mix well and toss with your hands. Transfer to a baking sheet or a shallow dish and bake until fork tender, about 25 minutes.

title: Apple Bread and Cheese Filled Coffee Bean Pies
ingredients: 3 1/3 cups fresh breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup biscuit | 1 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 1/2 cup mashed applesauce | 1 can fat-free buttermilk sweetened condensed milk | 1 tablespoon butter beans, drained | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1 medium tart apple, peeled cut into 24 slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine bread crumbs, biscuit, coffee and applesauce in a medium bowl. Stir in the sweetened condensed milk and butter beans.

title: Champagne Jelly Shots
ingredients: 4 button mushrooms, sliced | 1 lb grape juice ( from 15 to 20 grapes )
instructions: In a small saucepan, place mushrooms and grapes and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cover and cook for 10 - 15 minutes until mushrooms release a liquid. Pour into jelly glass molds, cool and freeze until hard. Strain through cheesecloth and use as directed for future salads.

title: Japanese Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh shredded sesame oil | 2 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or the side of a large heavy knife, lightly crush the sesame oil with your hands. Then add salt. Do not over crush. Combine with your hands and press to get all the salt/oil through the bowl. This will produce a fine paste. Use as a seasoning for fish, vegetables and salads. Store in a covered container in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,tomato juice,chicken breast,pea,cardamom powder
title: Djell Makjeder (Baked Chicken With Peas)
ingredients: 1 head chicken breast, skin on | 4 ounces peas, frozen | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can tomato juice | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Place peas, soup, tomatoes and cardamom in a large plastic bag. Cut chicken into cubes. Place chicken in baking dish in microwave for 9 minutes. Mix gravy in pan and pour over meat. Mix gravy with gravy mix. Pour over chicken on top of the peas. Bake at 425 degrees for 30 minutes. You may need to cover the dish with foil for the first 20 minutes of baking you may need to bake it longer. It's done when juices run clear and meat is cooked.

title: Easy Peasy Bamboo Shay Bread
ingredients: 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup sour cream, or to taste | 3 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Place the yeast in a large bowl, and stir in the sliced bamboo shoots and sour cream. Stir the yeast mixture into the flour to desired consistency.

title: Vanilla-Infused Black Pepper Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black pepper | 20 -12 tablespoons pure vanilla | salt & pepper
instructions: Mix pepper with vanilla for 10 - 15 minutes. Add salt, pepper & nutmeg for a smokey spice rub enjoy.

title: Mexican Salsa -- Poblanos Stolen from Home
ingredients: 1/2 poblano pepper | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf
instructions: Cut the poblano pepper crosswise into 1 inch pieces. Place the pepper on a plate or in a small bowl. Put a handful of basil leaves on each poblano pepper piece, and wrap a small piece of the pepper around the basil. Wrap the basil and pepper wrapped pepper around every poblano pepper. Place into a baking dish, inside an open flame, or a grill with a cover. Let it sit for about 15 minutes so the skins can steam. When the skins have become charred, remove the peppers.

title: Coconut Cream Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 can coconut cream, condensed | 3/4 cup low sodium beef broth
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, stir all ingredients together until smooth.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,chuck steak,yellow pea,garlic clove,lime wedge
title: Mandarin Beef
ingredients: 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks, 4 to 6-inch | 12 garlic cloves | 6 yellow pea pods, cut in half | 12 lime wedges, for garnish
instructions: Place mandarin oranges, flank steak and all but a few garlic cloves in a small saucepan. Simmer, partially covered, over low heat for 20 minutes or until steak is very tender. Remove steak from heat. Drain mandarin oranges, reserving their liquid. Cut steak in 2 x 2 inch strips. Drain pea pods and garlic cloves and transfer to a bowl with reserved liquid. Slice steak thinly. Stir steak, pea pods, and garlic into reserved marinade in saucepan. Cover and bring to a simmer. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until peas are tender. Serve sprinkled with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,tomatillo,green bean,garlic powder,spinach leaf,hot water,bottom beef roast
title: Chocolate Chili
ingredients: 1 green beans or 1 yam | 2 tablespoons green beans, chopped | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon dried spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 2 1/2 cups hot water | 2 tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Rinse beans and trim ends. In skillet, saute beans.

title: Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 300 g pasta ( fusilli, small wheel ) | 1/2 cup pesto sauce ( homemade or prepared ) | 400 ml light beer, preferably guinness | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons caster sugar
instructions: Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling water for about 8 minutes, until al dente.

title: St. Brenden's Chardonnay (St. Joseph's Day Chardonnay)
ingredients: 4 large pints strong chardonnay wine vinegar ( about 6 cups total volume ) | 1/2 cup light molasses | 6 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint | 3 lbs turnips, peeled, cut into 1/4 inch slices on the bias and coarsely chopped on the bias
instructions: Pour the vinegar into a large, nonreactive bowl and set aside at room temperature. Whisk the molasses into the vinegar until creamy. Stir in the mint, then add the turnips, and gently toss to coat. Cover, and refrigerate a minimum of 1 hour or more, but preferably overnight. Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce the heat slightly, and simmer until the turnip is soft and tender when pierced with a fork, about 25 minutes. Remove the cover, remove the turnip, transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with the sugar, and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,white rice,scallion,chicken breast half,garlic,vodka,icing sugar
title: Baked Chicken with Apple Slices, Frites and Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup good quality low-sodium instant white rice | 12 small pitted tart apples, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1/4 cup finely chopped small scallion
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place chicken breast halves in a shallow oven proof baking dish.. Combine rice, apples and icing sugar in a medium bowl. Drizzle half of the vodka over chicken breasts, sprinkle with garlic and scallions. Pour remaining vodka over. Roast 20 - 25 minutes. Note, the dish can also be browned on a top rack of the oven, if preferred.

title: Lentils With Mustard, Olives and Mustard!
ingredients: 1 cup split lentils | 2 -3 tablespoons pickling spice | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 4 -6 tablespoons sliced pickling olives | 4 tablespoons sliced green olives
instructions: Boil lentils with pickling spice, salt, pepper, and water until lentils are very soft. Drain well and return to pot. Add mustard seeds and olives. Gently stir to mix. Cover and cook on medium heat until lentils are soft and pickling spice has formed. Remove from heat and taste.

title: Beef Satay with Prosciutto Lettuce
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated rigatoni pasta | 2 tablespoons coriander powder | 1 large lemon, juice of | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 3 large tomatoes | 1/4 cup apple, peeled and sliced thin | 1/4 cup lime, cut into wedges | 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Preheat the grill to high and heat a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat. In a medium bowl, stir together the coriander and the 1/2 cup boiling water. Add the beef, breaking it up so it is crumbly and all the way sliced. Let marinate for 30 minutes about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a nonstick 12 inch frying pan, combine the sliced tomatoes with some of the juice and 1/4 cup water. Cook over low. Stir occasionally so the tomatoes don't burn. Cook until soft, about 15 minutes. Remove and cut in half. Set aside. Remove the beef from the marinade. Reserve the marinade. On a cutting board, cut the beef into 1 inch cubes. Place the chicken portions on the cutting board and mince them, discarding any fat or gristle. Place the meat in the skillet. Add the coriander paste and some of the juice from the olives. Cook over medium high heat until the sauce bubbles. Remove from the heat. In a bowl, mix together the remaining ingredients. Add the sauce and mix well to coat the meat with the sauce. Place half of the marinated beef in a bowl or platter and top with the tomato mixture. Cut the remaining meat into strips, about 1/2 inch wide. Place these on top of the tomatoes, placing all the way around them. Spoon some of the sauce over the meat and sprinkle with more of the grated coriander mixture.

title: Quick Sweet Noodles
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1 serrano pepper, chopped
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the egg noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes.

title: Smoked Salmon Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 40 g smoked salmon fillet, chopped | 40 g smoked salmon fillet, chopped | 1 small yellow squash, halved and seeded | 1 small red cabbage, cored, halved and thinly sliced | 1 large radish, halved and thinly sliced | 1/3 cup macaroni, cooked according to packet directions, drained
instructions: Place the rice and 1/2 cup of cold water in a saucepan, bring to the boil, cover and reduce the heat to medium. Cook, shaking the pan occasionally and turning the rice continuously, for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden and dry. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Arrange half the salmon, and half the cooked vegetables decoratively on the base of a large serving bowl. Repeat with half the rice, then half the smoked salmon and then half the cabbage. Top with the cooled rice, scatter over the radish and season to taste with salt. Cover with the remaining smoked salmon.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Green Seasoning for Salmon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice, or more to taste
instructions: In a small dish or bowl, stir together tarragon, tarragon, cardamom and allspice. To use, rub salmon with herb seasoning, or place in an oven safe nonstick skillet over medium heat, and sear salmon until golden brown.

title: The Perfect Apricot Patties
ingredients: 2 cups dried apricots, finely chopped | 2 cups turnips, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon garlic, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon basil, dried | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon graham crackers, crushed
instructions: Filling, mix all ingredients. Form into small patties. Add to prepared graham cracker crust. Refrigerate 15 minutes prior to cooking. Serve with your favorite salad and garlic bread for dipping party.

title: Hamburger Burritos
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 4 tablespoons green chili peppers, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 12 flour tortillas or 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Brown hamburger and chili peppers in a skillet. Add sugar, stir and cook 5 minutes. Add flour and cook over low heat 15 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve in flour tortillas.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,vanilla bean,angel hair pasta,pearl barley
title: Quick and Easy One-Skillet Barley & Vanilla Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 package angel hair pasta
instructions: In a pot, bring water to a boil then add barley & vanilla bean. Simmer on low for about 30 minutes without removing from heat. Stir continuously in a cup or small bowl while boiling and set aside. When the barley is cooked, stir in cream and simmer for about 5 minutes. Serve over angel hair pasta.

title: Cherry Toast
ingredients: 1 garlic bread, slices with plenty of crusts, cubed | 1/2 cup dried dark sweet cherries
instructions: Place bread in a medium skillet over medium heat. Dump in dried cherries and sprinkle with garlic, pressing into the bread to absorb excess moisture. Cook, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate and cut diagonally to serve.

title: Beef Nachos
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef sirloin tip | tortillas, warmed
instructions: Place each piece of beef on a warmed tortillas. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Wrap up. Bake at 350f or 190c for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,espresso powder,extra virgin olive oil,vegetable stock,worcestershire sauce,guacamole,serrano pepper
title: Cousin June's Espresso Rice
ingredients: 250 ml vegetable stock | 100 ml extra virgin olive oil | 25 g powdered espresso powder ( not instant ) | 3 g worcestershire sauce | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 200 g basmati rice | 2 -4 tablespoons instant espresso and guacamole, to taste ( to taste )
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat stock, olive oil, instant espresso powder, worcestershire sauce and serrano pepper until boiling, then reduce heat to medium and continue to cook for 10 minutes or until almost all the stock is absorbed. While broth is heating, soak basmati rice according to instructions or until it is al dente. Drain well and keep warm. To serve, spoon rice into a serving bowl and top with some bean paste and guacamole.

title: Homemade Flour Samosas
ingredients: 3 cups whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup ground fenugreek leaves
instructions: Sift the flour and fenugreek leaves in a large bowl, stir in the water. Knead the dough to form a pliable ball. Oil a bowl or cookie sheet with oil. Place the dough on the lined sheet and let stand in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour. Roll the dough into 1 1/2 inch sized balls and roll out onto a lightly floured board. If you like to cut into triangles, use a cookie cutter this makes for a better samosas. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons cornstarch on a lightly oiled surface and place the samosas on the stone. Gently flatten the dough out to a thickness of 1/4 and dust lightly with flour. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the samosas on a lightly oiled cookie sheet and bake until light golden brown, 20 to 30 minutes. Transfer to wire racks to cool. Store unused samosas in an airtight container.

title: Creamy Okra for Two
ingredients: 1 lb washed okra, ends trimmed | 6 tablespoons plain fat-free yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 8 -10 dashes of sweet green chili, finely ground | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Place okra in a bowl or deep serving dish and sprinkle over the sugar and toss gently to coat the okra. Marinate in the refrigerator for about 1 hour. Mix yogurt with some salt and pepper until smooth. Sprinkle over okra and garnish with chilies. Sprinkle the thyme or thyme leaves and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,creme de cacao,black peppercorn,natural yoghurt,serrano pepper,vegetable,nectarine,aubergine
title: Chilled Nectarines and Burger
ingredients: 200 g mixed vegetables | 1 medium aubergine, sliced | 1 nectarines or 1 nectar orange | 200 g hamburger | 150 g creme de cacao ( sweetened condensed milk ) | 25 g fresh black peppercorns ( coarsely ground ) | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper ( crushed ) | 1 teaspoon natural yoghurt, to serve
instructions: Place the mixed vegetables on oven tray, sprayed with non stick cooking spray, sprayed with non stick cooking spray and grill, brushing once, until tender and lightly charred, about 5 minutes. Place nectarines and aubergines in a small bowl with the meat and spices. Serve nectarines and burger in shallow bowls with crème de cacao and drizzle with yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: cream onion soup,buttermilk,tea,alfredo sauce,allspice berry,rice noodle
title: Rice Noodle Alfredo
ingredients: 1 bottle alfredo sauce | 7 tablespoons butter | 2 cups buttermilk | 2 teaspoons allspice berries | 8 ounces cream of onion soup, creamed | 8 ounces dried rice noodles, cooked
instructions: Heat oven to 350º f. Spread alfredo sauce in a 13 x 9 inch greased baking dish. In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add buttermilk. Place on low heat, stirring often. Remove from heat.

title: Pineapple and Pepper Salsa
ingredients: 1 pound fresh pineapple slices | 1 green bell pepper, cored and chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender.

title: Chinese Red and Green Radish Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb red radish | 3 green radishes | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted | 4 cups cold water
instructions: Scrub the radishes and the green& pink radishes, then cut into small pieces about 1 - ½ inch square. Cut a slit in the center of each radish, then open the slit, and slice the radishes like you would an open pancake. Place the radishes& the greens in a heavy large soup kettle along with the roasted cashews. Add the 3 cups of cold water. Cook over high heat until the soup begins to boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, or until the radishes are very tender. The soup should be noticeably thicker& darker in color.

Random Ingredients: red onion,ginger root,clear honey,lasagna noodle,italian herb seasoning,anise seed,cremini mushroom,greek yogurt
title: Vegan Creamy Mushroom Lasagna
ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles | 2 teaspoons white cooking spray ( non-stick cooking spray ) | 1 red onion, chopped | 2 1/2 cups cremini mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 2 tablespoons plain greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 2 teaspoons dried italian herb seasoning ( i used newman's own wild mushroom seasoning ) | 3/4 cup clear honey
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Place the lasagna noodles on a rimmed baking sheet and brush with the white cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, spray a large pot with nonstick cooking spray. Add the onion, mushrooms, and ginger.

title: Spritz
ingredients: 2 cups honey | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place honey in a 4 cup jar with a lid and shake until honey is well blended. Stir in almond extract and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,mandarin orange,chili oil,red bell pepper
title: Chinese Mandarin Orange Salad
ingredients: 12 mandarin oranges | 1 red bell pepper | 1 vidalia onion | 2 pinches chili oil
instructions: Cut peel from mandarins and red bell peppers into 2 inch long pieces. Mix peel, peppers, onion and chili oil in bowl, and place in refrigerator for a few hours or overnight until desired texture. Serve cold.

title: Cardamom Cured Rum
ingredients: 1 cup dark rum ( bacardi 151 ) | 4 cardamom pods
instructions: Place the cardamom pods in a heavy saucer and set aside. Rinse the cardamom pods with cold water. In a medium size bowl, add the rum, cardamom pods and the reserved cardamom pods to the rum. Stir to blend. Let sit for 20 minutes, then strain into a clean bottle and serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,black sesame seed,ginger,paprika,brown rice flour
title: Crispy Pancakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice flour ( or white cornmeal ) | 2 tablespoons brown rice flour or 2 tablespoons other grain flour | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon black sesame seed, toasted | 2 tablespoons apple cider, plus more for brushing or 2 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Whisk rice flour and dry ingredients together in a medium bowl. Add apple cider and mix well to form a thick batter. Cover and refrigerate until needed. In a medium nonstick skillet set over medium heat, sprinkle the sesame seeds with a little water and toast until fragrant, about 2 seconds per side. Pour about 2 tablespoons batter per pancake onto the skillet and quickly coat well with the sesame seeds. The pancakes may spill out as they bake. Move the pancakes to a platter and sprinkle with more maple sugar, paprika, ginger, if using.

title: Potato Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter | 2 lbs red potatoes, quartered thick
instructions: Brown ground beef in large skillet, drain off fat. Transfer to casserole dish. In same skillet, combine ground beef, and peanut butter, stirring to combine. Spoon meat mixture over beef, and top with unpeeled potatoes. Bake, covered, in 400f oven about 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until potatoes are tender and meat is hot. Variation, brown in 1 tablespoon butter and 1 cup water, drain potatoes. Add potato mixture to pork and beef, mixing well. Spoon over meat mixture. Heat. Add 1 tablespoon butter and 1/2 cup water or milk before serving.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,catsup,chili flake,salt,button mushroom,red chili pepper,onion powder,beef chuck
title: Hamburger Mushroom (Low Fat)
ingredients: 3 -7 lbs lean beef chuck or 3 -7 lbs sirloin steak, trimmed, cut in half | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided use | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 cups hot sauce ( to your taste ) | 6 large button mushrooms | 1 -2 red chili pepper, stemmed, seeded, sliced, if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 500f degrees. Put beef or steak in large disposable roasting pan, sprinkle on 3 tbss salt, sugar, onion powder and chili flakes. Combine hot sauce, mushrooms, chili and remaining salt. Pour over the meat. Cover and bake in a preheated 500f oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until meat is browned and onions are tender. If there is any liquid remaining in pan, remove the lid during the last 15 minutes or so of baking. When done, serve in large bowls over cooked rice.

title: Roasted Beet & Potato
ingredients: 2 medium beets | 2 tablespoons raw potatoes
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c. Mix raw potatoes with beets and place on an oven proof dish. Sprinkle raw potatoes into beet mixture. Roast in pre heated oven for approximately 35 - 40 minutes/or until golden brown and potato starts to soften.

title: Macadamia Pudding
ingredients: 1 brown onion, chopped | 250 g macadamia nuts, chopped
instructions: Melt the butter or margarine in a frying pan, add the brown onion and chopped macadams, mix well. Cook the mixture in the oven at 190c for 1hr 15min, then allow to cool. Pour into ovenproof bowls or glasses, serve warm with ice cream or sour cream or whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,bean sprout,lard,leek,pasta,romaine lettuce,red chili powder
title: Lebanese Orzo and Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs lard | 3/4 cup orzo pasta | 1/2 cup chard or 1/2 cup parsley, finely chopped | 2 cups rice or 2 cups orzo pasta | 1/2 cup leek | 1/2 tablespoon red chili powder or 4 minced red chiles, to taste | 1 romaita's lettuce or 1 green leaf lettuce
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and add 1/2 the orzo.

title: Vegetable Manicotti
ingredients: 1 lb no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard oil | 1 teaspoon mustard oil | 1 cup rice | 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup liquid smoke or 1/2 cup tabasco sauce | 1 cup kiwi fruits, sliced
instructions: Cook lasagna according to package directions except do not add oil or water.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,asiago cheese,white vinegar,hot water,pico de gallo,cottage cheese,rigatoni pasta,pea
title: Rigatoni With Paneer Cheese and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( or large shells, like penne ) | 2 cups chopped vegetables ( like peas, potatoes, cauliflower, corn, carrots, celery ) | 1/4 cup hot water | 1 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese | 3 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1/3 cup pico de gallo | 2 -4 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente, or 8 minutes. Drain and return to pot or crockpot. Cover pasta with warm water while still warm. In a large bowl, stir together cottage cheese, asiago cheese, vinegar, and pico de gallo. Add hot water and heat just until warm or mixture begins to bubble around the sides. Add hot pasta to the cheese and oil mixture. Toss to coat. Sprinkle with grated cheese and serve.

title: Chinese Peanut Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped raw peanuts | 1/2 cup apple juice
instructions: Place the peanuts and apple juice in the blender and process till very smooth. Store in a clean jar and use as needed.

title: Jenny's Easy Bourbon Salsa
ingredients: 1 bottle bourbon | 2 tablespoons green bell peppers, diced
instructions: Place all of the ingredients into a saucepan over medium heat.

title: Blueberry Vegetable Soup #2 - Slow Cooker
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces diced tomatoes with tomatoes with jalapenos and their juices | 10 ounces frozen blueberries, thawed | 4 ounces frozen small tomatillos or 4 ounces fresh, chopped tomatillos | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon powder | 2 medium yellow peppers, cut into large chunks | 1 medium fresh yellow squash or 1 medium zucchini, sliced | 1/2 cup frozen small cherries
instructions: Spray slow cooker with cooking spray. Place the tomatoes, blueberries and tomatillos in the bottom of the slow cooker. Stir in instant bouillon and yellow pepper chunks. Add squash and cherries. Cover and cook on low setting for 15 minutes. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: french bread,red wine vinegar,chive,tomato juice,hot red pepper flake
title: Tomato and Chive Gratins
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 2 cups tomato juice, divided | 1/4 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes ( or more ) | 8 slices french bread, cut in half | chopped fresh chives ( optional )
instructions: For marinade, stir vinegar and 1 cup of the mixture to blend. Pour juice into a shallow dish for dipping, and let stand for 20 minutes. For bread, if using the bread, soak bread in cool water. Cut 2 slices of bread in half and soak for 10 minutes. Toast each bread half on both sides in a toaster oven. Brush with a few tablespoons of the remaining marinade. Arrange toast on serving platter. Sprinkle bread with chives.

Random Ingredients: couscous,caster sugar,peanut,chicken bouillon,wild rice,onion salt,tomato juice,pepper sauce
title: Wild Brown Rice and Peanut Couscous Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups uncle ben's converted wild rice or 2 cups other long grain rice | 1/2 cup dried mixed wild rice | 3 tablespoons mixed pulses mixed pulses ( roasted wild pulses, such as jasmin-pea, sultanas or black lentils ) | 1 small onion, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 3 tablespoons tomato juice | pepper sauce, to taste ( optional ) ( optional ) | scallion, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Wash the rice in a sieve to remove any excess moisture, then drain in a colander. Place the rice, mixed pulses and chopped onion in a large saucepan and cover with water.

title: Mixed Nut Stuffed Jalapenos
ingredients: 2 large green peppers, halved and seeded | 2 lbs fresh jumbo shrimp, shelled | 1 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts | 4 large baby onions, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Line shallow 2 cookie sheets with foil. On a large, nonstick baking sheet, arrange peppers and shrimp, leaving the tops just a little bit of the skins. Sprinkle the raisins and hazelnuts evenly over the shrimp. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for approx 35 minutes or until shrimp are curled and pink. Remove from oven and set aside. Place 1/4 of the onions in the bottom of a medium size serving bowl. Carefully top with half of the remaining shrimp, leaving a little space at the edges. Top with half of the remaining onions, then half of the green peppers, and finally half of the green peppers. Bake for about 10 minutes until all ingredients are nicely browned.

title: Apple Cider Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt, i prefer greek, but any will do | 1/2 cup coffee powder | 1 teaspoon apple cider
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a cup. Serve cold over your favourite meat, vegetables, or crackers. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,olive oil,sesame seed,cream chicken soup,shortening
title: French Onion Muffins
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup olive oil ( can use less oil ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried active yeast | 3 cups breaded dried sweetened onions ( i use king edward's ) | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, mixed with
instructions: Add dried onions to warm water. Cover and let sit for 1 hour. Drain and allow to cool completely. Dissolve yeast in sour cream or yogurt, stir in the 1/4 cup oil and let stand for 10 minutes. Drain and combine with yeast mixture. Allow to stand in warm place for about 2 hours, or until creamy. Add to greased muffin tins or bread pans that have been greased or sprayed with pam. Bake at 400°f for 15 minutes, or until golden and heated through. Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan. Sprinkle tops with sesame seeds. Serve with butter, milk, fruit, jam, fruit dressing, or anything else you like.

title: Nuts
ingredients: 3/4 ounce tequila | 3/4 ounce dark rum
instructions: Pour 4 ounces into a shot glass. Add your favorite shot of dark rum in for the heat of your party.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,red chile,cornstarch,brie cheese,green cardamom pod,tomato puree,garlic powder
title: Chilli Brie
ingredients: 500 g brie cheese | 3 green cardamom pods | 50 g green chili peppers ( small size ) | 2 chili peppers flakes ( small size ) | 2 teaspoons red chile | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Slice the brie into large pieces. Place the pieces in a dish/pan with 1 cup hot water to cover. Leave to stand overnight. Next day, drain the brie and reserve the water. Wipe the brie pieces with a damp cloth. Discard the liquid from the brie. Discard the pieces of brie that have been left but keeping the pieces of brie. Slice the green and white chilies into small pieces and set aside. Place the chili pepper flakes, garlic powder and cornstarch into a mortar with a pestle and pound with a pestle until smooth. Add the brie and continue pounding until the brie becomes a slightly lumpy consistency. Place the chili peppers in the liquid. Keep mixing it and add the reserved water and mix it into the brie with the green chili peppers. Cover the container and keep in the refrigerator. Chill before serving.

title: Cherry & Sausage Medley
ingredients: 2 lbs bulk italian sausage | 3 tablespoons vodka | 2 cups heavy cream | 4 -8 radishes, thinly sliced | 1/8 cup dried fruit | fresh ground white pepper, to taste | 3 sprigs fresh cherries
instructions: In a pan, cook sliced sausage over medium heat until browned. Drain, remove sausage mix to a bowl. Add vodka, stirring to combine. Add cream, add sliced radishes and dried fruit. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Strain liquid and reserve 1/2 cup for gravy, reheat liquid over medium heat. Return liquid to heat and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until the sauce is hot. Add white pepper to taste and garnish with a fresh whole cherries.

title: Potato-Roasted Vegetable Tart
ingredients: 1 ready-made pie crust | 2/3 cup plum tomatoes | 2/3 cup green capsicum | 1/2 cup chopped new potato
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c prick the piecrust base with a fork, then lightly prick both sides with the fork. Set aside. Place the plums and capsicum in an ovenproof casserole dish. Pour over the tomato mixture, then bake for 15 - 20 mins or until the tomatoes are soft. Slice the tartlet, serve hot.

title: Beer and Noodle Breakfast
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles, cooked ( dry ) | 4 -5 whole new potatoes ( depending on size of potato ) | 8 ounces beer | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar
instructions: Boil potato until fork goes everywhere. Drain and mash potatoes with a fork. Combine mashed potatoes with egg noodles and beer and let sit 5 minute on cookie sheet. Top with cheddar.

title: Tofu Brown Rice
ingredients: 300 g of soft brown rice ( short or medium ) | 3 -4 ounces firm tofu, drained, dried and cubed | 200 ml cold water | grated romano cheese | 1 avocado, sliced | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water for 12 mins, stir and then add tofu and chill in the refrigerator if using longer. Drain rice in a sieve, return it to the pan, pour over the cold water and bring to the boil. Simmer for 12 - 15 mins until rice is tender. Stir in cheese and avocado then top with cream before serving.

title: Tacopita (Spanish Custard)
ingredients: 2 cups unbleached custard powder | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley chopped | 2 ripe plantains, peel removed and cut in half
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine custard powder, lemon pepper, salt, parsley and plantains. Chill overnight.

title: Gravy Spicy Halibut With Fresh Fruit
ingredients: 2 lbs halibut fillets | 1 zucchini, cut into quarters | 1 cup parsley berries, chopped fresh | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 can tomato sauce, plus extra for dipping | 1 lb spaghetti, cook according to package directions with no seasoning added | 4 -6 tortillas | 5 cups fresh raspberry ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with nonstick spray.

Random Ingredients: cod,rice noodle,prosciutto,oregano leaf,self rising flour,cognac,cornmeal,barbecue sauce
title: Portuguese Cod and Rice Noodles
ingredients: 4 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon cornmeal, or as needed | 1 pound cooked cod, shredded | 3 slices prosciutto, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon cognac | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 3 tablespoons rice noodles, or as needed
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Mix self-rising flour and cornmeal in a shallow bowl. Whisk cod, prosciutto, barbeque sauce, cognac, and oregano in a separate bowl. Dip cod into flour mixture to coat.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,green pea,coriander seed,cilantro leaf,guacamole,scallion,genoa salami
title: Mexican Style Peas and Salami Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb frozen green peas, thawed and liquid reserved | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken bouillon ( low sodium preferred but we liked it plain. ) | 2 scallions, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro leaf or 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley | 2 1/2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 8 slices genoa salami, 1-inch thick | 4 -8 leaves guacamole ( i prefer trader joe's )
instructions: Place the peas in a large nonstick skillet with 1 1/2 tablespoons of the broth from the reserved liquid, the bouillon, scallions, and the cilantro. Bring to a boil over high heat. Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove pan from heat and set aside to cool for 5 minutes. Combine the coriander and remaining 1 tablespoon broth in a mortar and pestle or spice mill and grind until you have a fine powder. Add to the pea mixture and stir to coat. Set aside. Brush the tops of the salami slices with a little of the reserved broth then arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet and refrigerate for about 10 to 15 minutes or until they are crispy. Spread the bottom halves of the hot pepperoni with half of the pea mixture and top with half of the salami. Spoon remaining pea mixture and remaining salami on top and top with remaining pepperoni, and finish with a sprinkling of the coriander mixture. Spread guacamole on the side if you wish.

title: Hot Fennel and Pineapple Raspberries
ingredients: 1 pint fresh black raspberry, washed | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 1/2 cup pesto fennel seed | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 green cardamoms, split and opened
instructions: Place the raspberries in a colander or sieve placed over a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside to drain for 4 hours or overnight. In a blender or food processor, process the soaked raspberries in batches until liquified. Measure the liquid. In a saucepan, over medium low heat, stir the raspberry liquid and pesto to reduce the amount of jelly by half. Add the cardamom, onion powder and freshly ground black pepper. Stir well. Cover and simmer over medium low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the bowl from the heat and stir in the cubed green cardamom. Cool completely. Refrigerate, covered, for several hours or overnight.

title: Sweet & Sour Lamb
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 1 bunch herbs and string beans | 1 bunch chervil | 1/2 tablespoon ground hazelnuts | 1/2 tablespoon powdered sugar substitute | 1 tablespoon sour lime juice | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Brown lamb, drain then slice. Cut beans, chervil and string beans, mix with browned lamb. Add powdered sugar, mix well.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,italian seasoning,fettuccine,liquid smoke,plum tomato,szechuan peppercorn,cooking oil,daikon radish
title: Minty Sichuan Noodles (Spicy)
ingredients: 1 lb cooked fettuccine | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning, see note | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns, see note | 2 plum tomatoes, diced ( about 1/4 cup ) | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 -2 teaspoon dried mint leaves, see note | 1 large daikon radish, thinly sliced ( about 1 cup )
instructions: Note, the seasoning used is szechuan peppercorns. Cook the pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in medium bowl, mix tomato with liquid smoke.

title: Red Cabbage and Wine - for the Mashed Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red cabbage ( or other firm green cabbage ) | 5 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 teaspoon fresh salt-free black pepper, grated | 1/2 cup dry white wine | crushed ice
instructions: Core and rinse the cabbage and cut in 2 or 3 inch pieces or strips. Melt the butter in a large, heavy pot over medium heat. Add the cabbage and season with salt& pepper. Add the wine and simmer, covered for 20 minutes until the cabbage is tender. If desired, remove the lid and cook for a few minutes to reduce. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,pork loin roast,chicken breast half,cornstarch,dill pickle,chili paste
title: Slow Cooker Smothered Chicken
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin roast | 4 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 tablespoon dried dill pickles, crushed | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon minced fresh dill pickle
instructions: Place the pork roast in the bottom of a slow cooker. Combine the tomatoes with remaining ingredients. Pour tomato mixture over the pork. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 to 8 hours. Shred using forks, and serve with noodles.

title: Jicama and Yogurt Dip (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 14)
ingredients: 300 g jicama ( peeled, cut into sticks ) | 500 g plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/2 teaspoon low-sodium liquid honey | 1 pinch ground cinnamon | salsa, to serve
instructions: Using a knife, finely dice jicama and combine with drained yogurt. Whisk together oyster sauce, honey, and cinnamon and dip the jicama into the yogurt. Serve with salsa in individual serving bowls.

title: Aubergine Curried Halloumi Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs halloumi cheese | 1 -2 cup vinegar | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1 -2 tablespoon curry powder | 4 dried ancho chilies, ground
instructions: Slice cheese into 6 equal portions. Place cheese pieces on a platter and cover with hot water. Let stand for 5 - 10 minutes. Drain. In a small pot, over medium heat, combine vinegar and onion powder. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until reduced to about 1/2 cup. Stir in curry powder, chilies, and cheese. Return to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve immediately, over rice, pasta, or noodles.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,pineapple juice,italian breadcrumb,italian sausage,pita bread
title: Italian Sausage Sandwiches on Pita (Stove Top)
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, lean, i use hot | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion ( about 1 medium large ) | 1 1/2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs, i use fresh italian bread crumbs | 1/4 cup pineapple juice, reserve 1/4 cup | 16 pita bread, warmed ( or 2 bunches )
instructions: Brown sausage, remove. Pour juices from drained sausage into a skillet, reduce heat to low. Add onion and pork.

title: Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried savoy cabbage | 4 tablespoons sake | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Combine the cabbage and dry seasonings and add to a large frying pan. Over medium high heat, reduce the heat to medium and lightly fry the cabbage, stirring continuously, until the vegetables are tender and the liquid has evaporated. Remove pan from heat and cool thoroughly.

title: Homemade Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables | 3/4 teaspoon minced ginger | 3/4 cup marshmallow | 1/4 cup minced fresh gherkin | 1 pie shell, unbaked ( small or medium size )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Boil the mixed vegetables and drain well. Place in a large bowl with ginger, marshmallows and gherkins. Mix well to combine. Spoon into pie shell. Bake 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,artichoke heart,white pepper powder,rye bread
title: Artichoke Tea Sandwich
ingredients: 3 cups light vegetable cocktail or 3 cups light vegetable cocktail | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground white pepper powder, to taste | 1 fresh thyme sprig, for garnish | 21 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: If using cocktail, heat in microwave on high 45 seconds. Stir in white pepper and thyme. Add sliced rye bread and allow to warm slightly.

Random Ingredients: beef,italian seasoning,chuck,veal,taco bell seasoning mix,spanish onion,spicy mustard
title: Mexican Meatballs With Veal
ingredients: 4 lbs ground chuck | 3 lbs ground lean ground veal | 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 1 can sliced spanish onions | 1 -2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 package taco bell taco seasoning mix | 2 packages spicy mustard
instructions: Combine and mix all ingredients in large bowl thoroughly until well mixed. Mix in 3 lbs of ground meat and 2 packages of spicy mustard. Roll into meatballs about the size of your index finger. Place in baking pan in an oven safe dish.. Top with hot refried bean and cheese.

Random Ingredients: white bread,chicken meat,sultana,chicken bouillon cube,cream tartar,cinnamon sugar,red lentil,shallot
title: Traditional Magyar Sauce of Chicken, Dumplings, Dumplings Etc...
ingredients: 1 cup red lentil | 1 large shallot, peeled and chopped | 6 chicken meat, cut into 1-inch dice | 2 knorr chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons sultanas | 4 -6 slices white bread, toasted ( toast is best )
instructions: Prepare the lentils as instructed on packaging and put aside. Dice the shallots, and mix in some of the oil or cooking spray in a large pot. Add the lentils, shallots and chicken. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally for approximately 10 minutes to allow the lentils and chicken to get a rich brown color. Add the stock cubes and sultanas and continue to cook for 5 minutes.. Check for the thickness and add more salt if needed. Serve with toast or with fresh bread. If you want to make your own chicken stock do so and simmer with 1 tablespoon honey.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,ancho chile powder,red wine vinegar,spice,dark soy sauce,green chilies,egg substitute
title: Thai Red Onion Rice
ingredients: 2 cups white basmati rice | 2 ounces green chilies | 1 ounce dark soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon hot red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ancho chile powder | spice | 1 egg substitute, yolk to brush
instructions: Boil rice until just cooked. Meanwhile, slice onions and chilies thinly. Place 1/2 cup rice and onions in a microwave safe bowl, pour in soy and vinegar and microwave for 15 minutes, or until almost dry. Stir rice to mix well. Sprinkle each serving with a little spice and chilies. Top with yolk. Microwave for additional 1 - 2 minutes until glaze.

Random Ingredients: spinach,beef sirloin steak,new mexico chile,parmigiano reggiano cheese,vegetable stock,cashew nut
title: Beef and Spinach Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground pasilla new mexico chile | 1/2 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 4 cups vegetable stock | 4 tablespoons cashew nuts, chopped | 10 ounces fresh spinach, rinsed, stemmed and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add the cubed steak and cook 1 minute, stirring occasionally. Add the cashews and cook 1 minute. Add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes, stirring to combine. Reduce the heat to a simmer, stir in the cheese and cook 1 minute. Serve immediately.

title: Mexicrisp Parsnips on a Gas Range Grill
ingredients: 1 pastry dough | 1 small parsnip, parsley, parsley is the closest trick to me | 2 tablespoons mexican blend cheese | 1/2 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat the grill. Slice the parsnips and using a paring knife slice thin and then cut into fine thin slices about 3/4 by 1/2. Place in a medium bowl. Add the mexican style cheese and mix. Add the minced parsley and mix well. Take one sheet of pastry, brush the pastry with water, fold the other and brush with water. Roll the pastry out to about an 11/2 circle on a lightly floured surface using a 2 1/2 cutter. Cut out the center. Line the grilling surface with greased foil. Place the grilling sheet on the grill and cook each side until golden brown. You will need to watch it cook until it is puffed and puffed. When you take it out of the grill, brush the top with butter and sprinkle some chopped parsley on the grate. Serve with salsa and sour dill pickle.

title: Quick and Easy White Non-Easiest White Bean Dip!
ingredients: 1 can navy beans, drained | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup dried cranberries, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients, mix well. Refrigerate in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: white cheddar cheese,nutmeg,cheddar cheese soup,kidney bean
title: Hot Kidney Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup | 1 teaspoon finely grated fresh nutmeg | 1 cup shredded white cheddar cheese
instructions: Stir kidney beans, cheddar cheese soup, nutmeg and white cheddar cheese together in a bowl and heat thoroughly. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Rachael Ray's Roasted Stuffed Chiles
ingredients: 4 small poblano chiles, roasted and stems removed | 24 stuffed olives, roughly chopped | 1 cup graham cracker
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Place the chilies on a baking sheet and brush with about 1/2 cup olive oil. Roast for 25 minutes. Cool slightly. In a metal roasting pan place the olives and 1 cup of graham crackers. Stuff 1/4 of the chilies at a time with the olives and crackers then arrange them in a single layer on top of the crackers. Bake in the middle of the oven until the crumbs are golden and the peppers are tender, about 3 to 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,onion soup mix,apricot preserve,cardamom,white fish fillet,green tomato
title: Somali Seppered Fish
ingredients: 4 ounces white fish fillets | 3 tablespoons finely chopped onions ( soup mix ) | 1 tablespoon apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium soup mix | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 2 medium green tomatoes, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons minute steamed basmati rice
instructions: Spray a nonstick skillet or wok with cooking spray. Place over medium high heat. When it is very hot, place fish fillets in the skillet, and brown on both sides. Transfer fish to a plate. Reserve pan drippings then stir in onions, preserves, soup mix, cardamom. Return fish fillets to pan, and reheat. Serve fish fillets over rice.

Random Ingredients: juniper berry,riesling wine,granny smith apple,sambal oelek,tomato green chilies
title: Spicy Salsa Fresca (Salsa Fresca)
ingredients: 1 lb riesling wine-packed tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar | 2 teaspoons sambal oelek | 1/2 teaspoon juniper berries
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl. Chill several hours.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,cream mushroom soup,pink grapefruit juice,cocoa powder,strawberry,black bean,kiwi fruit
title: Black Bean and Kiwi Party
ingredients: 1 box canned black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup kiwi fruit, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons strawberry flavored guacamole ( see note below ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup red grapeseed juice | fresh cilantro, sliced ( to garnish )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the first six ingredients. Mix well. Stir in the grapeseed juice until heated through. Stir in cilantro just before serving. Sprinkle over individual servings of fresh fruit. Serve with fruit to garnish.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,sauce,marjoram,rice vinegar,purpose flour,za'atar spice mix,soya sauce
title: Corn, Zatar & Zatar Fritters(Serve With Rice)
ingredients: 2 -6 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon dried ground za'atar spice mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/3 cup whole kernel corn | 1 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Combine all dipping sauce ingredients. Set aside. Combine corn mixture & flour in a bowl, mix well & set aside. Mix reserved dipping sauce w/cornmeal.

title: Cafe Rio Blend
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red chili powder | 1 tablespoon instant coffee
instructions: Pour instant coffee into your coffee mug, stir well. Take the 1 heaping tblsp of the black coffee powder and pour into mug, stir well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,asparagus spear,egg yolk,lemon peel,serrano chilies,celery,self rising flour
title: Asparagus Gruyere Soufflé
ingredients: 4 serrano chilies | 1 stick celery, chopped | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 4 ounces asparagus spears, cut into 2-inch segments | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the chiles on a sheet pan, drizzle with some olive oil, and sprinkle with the lemon peel. Roast chiles for 10 minutes or until blackened. Transfer to a plastic bag, seal, and let steam for 15 minutes. Peel chiles and chop. Set aside. Melt the gruyere in an ovenproof bowl in the 350 degree f oven until very light brown, stirring frequently. Add the asparagus, lemons, and flour. Stir to coat. Bake for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coconut amino,tomato sauce,stock,streaky bacon,green chili pepper
title: Coco's Hot and Sweet
ingredients: 6 slices streaky bacon | 1 large tomatoes | 1 small green chili pepper | 1 can coconut-stevia tomato sauce | 2 1/2 cups stock ( or stock cubes )
instructions: Place the bacon in a heavy base saucepan, on the stove top. Fry quickly until crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon, leaving the fat in the pan. Dice the tomato and chile, removing the seeds and white spot where you'll put the coconut flakes into the pan. Fry and stir for 1 minute. Add the tomato and chile mix and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in the coconut flakes and stock and bring to the boil. Reduce to a simmer, then reduce to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Simmer 30 minutes to 2 hours or until thick and syrupy.

title: Sourdough Bread & Coconut Soup
ingredients: 500 g sourdough bread | 2 slices bacon | 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil or 1 1/2 cups coconut oil | 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 4 teaspoons vanilla essence | 6 cups home-made tea ( made from strong herbal tea )
instructions: Cut the bread into 3 4cm cubes. Cut one strips of bacon into thin pieces & fry in a non stick pan until golden brown. Add the bread cubes, tomato puree or oil, cornstarch & vanilla essence. Heat to boiling. As soon as the soup comes to the boil, remove from heat & stir in the tea. Serve with croutons or other garnish.

title: Capers and Allspice
ingredients: 12 ounces unsalted bamboo shoots | 1 1/2 tablespoons capers | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice ( optional )
instructions: Cut bamboo shoots into 1/4 inch slices and place in small bowl. Add capers, allspice, and remaining tablespoon of capers. Toss gently until sugar is dissolved.

title: Easy Curried Beef #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package five-grain fajita seasoning blend | 1 jar curry powder ( or use your own favorite curry powder )
instructions: Cook fajita seasoning blend according to package directions in a skillet over medium heat until fragrant. While fajita seasoning is cooking, slice up your steak and coat with curry powder. Set aside and continue cooking steak until desired degree of doneness has been reached, anywhere from 12 - 30 minutes or longer. Enjoy.

title: Porchetta Fajita Bread
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh parsnips, minced | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, zest of | 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, cut into 3/4 inch slices | 3/4 cup canned fat-free refried beans ( such as rosarita )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine parsnip and lemon zest. Add pork slices and mix. Spread about 1/8 of refried bean mixture on bread. Top with remaining bean mixture. Microwave on high 2 minutes until heated through.

title: Polish Poppy Seed Chicken Strips
ingredients: 5 tablespoons poppy seeds | 12 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Add all ingredients together and let stand for 10 minutes, stir well. Pour on dehydrator trays and dehydrate for 10 minutes at 250 ° c. Dehydrated chicken is ready when dark from outside skin and moisture.

title: Crispy Halibut with Grilled Beef
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 1/4 cup thinly slivered rump steak
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Cut salmon fillets into strips about 1/2 inch wide and 1/2 inch wide. Stir salt, pepper, and oil in grates of your choice. Place 1 tablespoon of the steak on the center of each fillet and roll up. Secure with toothpicks. Grill, turning once, until steaks are opaque, 8 to 10 minutes. Slice into quarters and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,bell pepper,apple,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Sauce Jack Cheese With Grilled Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 6 ounces monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, room temperature | 3 ripe bell peppers, sliced, red and green | 3 cups sliced unpeeled apples | 1/2 small bell pepper, chopped ( yellow or red )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 1 hour. Grill peppers and apples on an uncovered grill or a griddle pan over medium heat for 10 minutes or until crisp and tender. Serve with sauce.

title: Pigs & Garlic Toasties
