ingredients: 6 -8 small whole pork loin chops, trimmed of fat | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 cup beef stock | 3/4 cup fish, prepared according to package directions and drained | finely chopped fresh garlic, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cut the chops into 2 thick slices. In a large skillet, brown the chops lightly on all sides over medium high heat, stirring often, until well browned. Remove the chops from skillet. In the skillet, brown the onion, stirring frequently, for about 5 minutes. Place the beef stock and fish in the skillet. Bring to a low simmer, cover and cook for 15 minutes, or until the pork is done. Return chops to skillet. Cook, stirring, until the pork is hot, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,velveeta cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,chipotle powder,swordfish,ginger
title: Spicy Chipped Gherkin & Beef Jerky
ingredients: 3 pounds swordfish, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup velveeta cheese, cut into chunks | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon ginger, minced | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder or can chipotle peppers packed in adobo, drained and chopped
instructions: In a bowl, toss the sword fish lightly with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper. Transfer to a roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,navel orange,corn tortilla chip,gruyere cheese,pearl barley,celery rib
title: Creamy Rice-Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 quart pearl barley | 3/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil, plus more if needed | 3 tablespoons finely chopped celery ribs | 10 ounces gruyere cheese, coarsely grated ( about 1 cup ) | 12 corn tortilla chips, cut into small wedges | navel orange, zest and juice
instructions: Place barley in a large saucepan and add enough water to cover barley by 1 inch. Bring water to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer 30 minutes. Drain. Place in a bowl and let cool to room temperature. Heat broiler. In a small saucepan, heat 1/4 cup of the olive oil over medium high heat. When oil is hot, add celery and season with salt and pepper. Reduce heat and stir until celery is limp, about 1 minute. Set aside to cool. Set a colander in another bowl, pour boiling water over it, and let drain 20 minutes. Drain barley and return to pan. Add cheese and stir until melted. Scrape into a large serving bowl and add salad and dressing. Toss well. Serve immediately.

title: Couscous (With a Twist!)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups couscous | 1 1/2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons asiago cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped asiago cheese
instructions: Combine the couscous with the mustard seeds, asiago and asiago cheese in a large bowl.

title: Cannel
ingredients: 2 pickled pepperoncini peppers, packed in brine | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste
instructions: Put everything in a heavy pan. Bring to a boil. Cover tightly and boil gently for 2 hours, basting occasionally. Pack into jar and store in refrigerator up to 4 weeks. Variation, you can leave brine in brine, remove seeds from pepperoncinis and boil with enough water to cover and then drain, then cook with a little oil in a frying pan.

title: Cardamom and White Bean Paste
ingredients: 2 cups white beans, cooked | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender and whirl to desired consistency, adding a little water as needed.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,rice krispies,baby bok choy,broad bean,yellow onion
title: Beef and Greens
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped yellow onion | 2 -4 ounces beef chuck, cut into 1-to 2-by-1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup canned broad bean, drained and rinsed | 3 cups uncooked rice krispies | 1 bag baby bok choy, cleaned and cut into 12 pieces
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Add onions.

title: Vanilla Polenta Crackers
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour, divided | 1/2 cup polenta | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup dried italian-style bread, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix 1/4 cup flour, polenta, baking soda, black pepper, vanilla, bread cubes, and 2 cups flour. Shape into 1 inch balls, and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly brown, about 25 minutes.

title: A Very Full Proof Spanish Influenced Eggplant
ingredients: 1 2 lbs eggplants | salt ( to your taste ) or olive oil ( to your taste ) | 1 lb meat | 1 -2 spanish onion, chopped | 1 cup milk or 1 cup cream | 1 cup yogurt ( sour cream or sour cream can be subbed ) | 2 cans kidney beans | 1 can sliced almonds
instructions: Slice eggplant. Place on rack in baking pan, drizzle with olive oil and salt or salt to your taste. Roast at 400 degrees f or 200 degrees celsius. Bake for 1 hour. Let cool to room temperature, then slice thinly, about 1/4 rounds. Brown meat with onion until tender, about 30 to 40 minutes. Add salt and beans. Cook 15 minutes longer. Pour over eggplant slices and sprinkle the sliced almonds over each slice. Return to oven until the slices are crisp on the outside. It's easy to cut into pieces and it's easy to cut all the way through.

title: Cabbage With Cranberry Glaze
ingredients: 1 cup cranberries ( or fresh frozen or canned ) | 3/4 cup finely shredded cabbage | 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil
instructions: Rinse, drain, and pat dry cranberries. In a medium skillet over medium heat, warm grapeseed oil. Add cabbage and cranberries. Saute, stirring, 5 minutes. Serve warm.

title: African Spinach Tea
ingredients: 10 cups hot steamed black tea ( indian breakfast or chai tea ) | 6 -8 cups fresh spinach, washed, cleaned, and chopped | 2 vegetable bouillon cubes
instructions: Place tea ball in saucepan, large enough to completely submerge the tea. Add water to reach boiling over high simmering heat. When it starts to boil, stir in spinach. Cook, covered for 3 minutes. Reduce heat and simmer 3 minutes longer. Add bouillon cubes and simmer 5 minutes longer. Stir in the tea to loosen and pour into 1 or 2 small glasses. Serve immediately.

title: Watercress and Buttermilk Soup
ingredients: 6 cups watercress, washed, stemmed and chopped ( about 4 bunches ) | 1/3 cup buttermilk or 1/3 cup low-fat buttermilk
instructions: Put watercress and buttermilk in a food processor and process until fairly smooth. Chill before using. Soup can be made up to 2 days ahead of time and refrigerated for up to 8 days.

title: Asparagus With Cumin
ingredients: 12 ounces asparagus | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds
instructions: Soak the asparagus overnight in plenty of water. Preheat oven to 400&#9702. Place asparagus stalks on greaeproof paper, spread out and brush with a little oil. Sprinkle with sugar& salt. Roast for about 30mins, sprinkle with cumin seeds & continue roasting until asparagus is tender & crisp.

Random Ingredients: korean red pepper powder,greek yogurt,orange juice,buttermilk,egg white,navy bean,vegetable,red chili pepper
title: Nerdle's Big Purple Bean Stew
ingredients: 2 cups buttermilk | 3/4 cup vegetable or beef stock ( not `` soup starter '' ) | 1 -2 teaspoon ground red chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon greek yogurt ( optional, to taste ) | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 large egg white | 1/4 teaspoon korean red pepper powder | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped red chili pepper ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon green part of pickled onion, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Make the starter by combining all the ingredients in a small saucepan. Bring just to a boil then reduce heat.

title: American Veal With Creamy Dressing
ingredients: 4 lbs veal, cut into one inch cubes | 1/2 cup thousand island dressing | 1 -2 cup vegetable broth, heated
instructions: Marinate the veal in thousand island dressing for 20 minutes. Heat oil in a skillet saute the veal for 5 minutes over high heat, add veal. Cover and cook for 10 minutes until tender. Remove cover, stir to deglaze the pan. Add 1/2 cup broth and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve veal over white rice. For additional flavor, add 1 tablespoon of caraway seeds to the dressing for a few minutes after removing from heat.

title: German Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 box german chocolate candy cake mix | 1 can diced green tomatillos | 1 1/2 cups minced clams | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 avocados, halved and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease an 11x9 inch baking dish. Mix chocolate cake mix, chopped green tomatillos, minced clams, salt and mustard powder in a large bowl. Spread mixture into prepared baking dish. Sprinkle sliced avocados on top of cake mix. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Chocolate Chunks
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated swiss cheese | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 6 tablespoons chopped semisweet chocolate
instructions: Combine cheese, onion powder and lime juice. Press into a greased 8 inch square pan. Sprinkle with tomatoes. Combine chocolate and remaining 2 tablespoons cold water. Spread over tomatoes. Bake in 350°f oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Remove chucks from pan and cool. Cut in squares.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,yellow capsicum,jumbo shrimp,bocconcini,chicken breast half,beer,lasagna noodle
title: Crispy Jumbo Shrimp and Chicken Cannelloni
ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - halved and butterflied | 1 cup chopped onion flakes | 1 jar bocconcini | 1 can beer | 1 package jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 6 uncooked lasagna noodles | 1 large yellow capsicum, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rinse chicken, drain and pat dry. Season chicken with onion flakes. Place in 9x12 inch baking dish. Reserve remaining chicken, and arrange on top of chicken. Combine the bocconcini, beer, shrimp, and onion flakes. Pour over chicken and marinate for 15 minutes. Bake chicken in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Arrange shrimp over the top of the cannelloni and bake for 10 minutes, or until shrimp are just cooked through. Bake for 10 more minutes, and remove from oven. Top with yellow capsicum slices, and serve.

title: Yogurt Cheese for Zarda
ingredients: 250 g yoghurt | sea salt and pepper, to taste | 1 -2 teaspoon sweet cherries ( optional )
instructions: To freeze, put yoghurt in a container in the freezer. When ready to serve, put the yoghurt cheese in your freezer bag and freeze it. Just before serving the cheese, put in an appropriate size container at room temperature until it has frozen to your preference. Then put in cherries to be eaten with pita bread as a decoration. It's all to taste. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lobster tail,picante sauce,worcestershire sauce,margarine,cooking spray,peach,olive,thai red curry paste
title: Spicy Caribbean Lobster with Peach Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine, or as needed | cooking spray | 1 pound lobster tails, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 1 ripe peaches - peeled, pitted, and chopped | 1/4 cup sliced ripe olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spread margarine onto a baking tray lined with aluminum foil.

title: Spaetzle II
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cornflour or 2 1/2 cups bread flour | salad oil
instructions: Combine flour and oil in a large bowl and mix with a pastry blender. Knead dough until smooth and pliable. Put dough between two pieces of greaseproof paper and cover with a dry cloth. Let stand on a clean surface for 20 minutes. Roll out thin. Cut into strips or triangles and bake at 220°c/425°f for 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Sizzling Shitake Noodles With Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta or 1 lb linguine | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions. Remove pasta from pot and keep warm. Heat oil in large skillet. Add mushrooms. Sauté, approximately 3 min., add mushrooms and stir. Serve immediately. Serve at once.

title: Peas & Chive Hot Dogs
ingredients: 8 hot pickles ( red pickles preferred ) | 1 tablespoon milk | 7 tablespoons chives | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger | 2 cans chick-peas
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in large pan and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer covered for about 45 minutes or until hot dogs are browned. Serve or keep warm until ready to serve.

title: Chunky Salsa Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 jar chunky salsa | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons snipped fresh thyme leaves | 2 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Stir salsa, tomato sauce, and thyme in medium bowl to blend. Brush split side of each roll with brandy.

title: Chinese Hot Oil
ingredients: 12 scallions, with white and light green parts, finely chopped | 1/4 cup high quality chili oil ( shaoxing )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together, adding more or less hot oil as the mixture is to be served, in a small bowl. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,pecan half,salmon,dill sprig,tortilla chip,red kidney bean
title: Dill and Salmon Soup
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill sprigs | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 2 ounces smoked salmon, cut into cubes ( or other protein of choice ) | tortilla chips ( to garnish )
instructions: Open beans and crush them with a fork. Gently mix in dill and simmer for 8 - 10 minutes to infuse flavours. Add salmon. Stir well, and serve over chips.

title: Sour Potato Salad (German Potato Pancakes)
ingredients: 4 large potatoes ( medium potatoes, about 3 pounds ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup good apple cider or 1/3-1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 egg yolk | 3 tablespoons dry sherry ( optional )
instructions: Clean and pierce potatoes all over with a knife or fork. Arrange potatoes in an earthenware container and fill it with water to cover the potatoes. There will be some water, you can use more, but the potatoes taste done when the potatoes are tender on the inside. Drain and let sit while preparing the rest. Prepare the sourdough mixture, in a large mixing bowl, beat yolk with a fork. Add in vinegar and sherry, if desired. Taste and add salt to taste.. To bake, cut potatoes into 1/2 inch slices. Place on a broiler pan or a large plate. Arrange potato slices on top of the sourdough mixture. Broil for 8 - 10 minutes or until nicely browned. Serve warm or cold.

title: Easy Shrimp Braid
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 2 1/2 pounds raw shrimp paste, or more to taste | 1 pound frozen unpeeled, frozen shrimp scampi, thawed
instructions: Stir yeast and uncooked shrimp paste in a large bowl to blend. Let stand about 5 minutes. Stir scampi into the yeast mix.

title: Melted Mango Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups firm ripe mangoes ( kent mangoes are ideal ) | 1/3 cup light muscat white flour | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Blanch the mangoes, skin side down, in boiling water for 3 minutes. Drain. Peel the mangoes and cut into chunks. Bring the mango chutney to the boil. Turn the heat down and simmer for 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in any brandy. Spoon into buttered ovenproof dish and cook in a moderate oven for 15 - 20 minutes, until set. Serve warm or chilled with whipped cream or cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: bulb fennel,grain white rice,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Fennel Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 whole bulb fennel, trimmed and sliced | 3/4 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | 2 cups hot cooked bulgur ( i prefer whole wheat for this )
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and set the oven rack at about 6 inches from the heat source. Spray a 13x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Heat your vegetable oil in a small skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,white vinegar,portabella mushroom,iceberg lettuce,yeast cake,chinese vegetable,hamburger bun,half cream
title: Asian Style Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round steaks, sliced 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick | 1 package yeast cake | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons chinese vegetables, chopped | 1 lime, zest of | 12 slices iceberg lettuce | 8 slices portabella mushrooms, 1/4inch slices | 4 hamburger buns
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the lukewarm, 1/4 cup of the vinegar. Rinse the steak well and slice across the grain into 1/8 inch thick slices. In a large mixing bowl, stir together the beef, onion, mushroom, and lime zest. Add remaining vinegar. Mix well. Put a slice of the steak on a work surface, top with a layer of the lettuce, followed by a slice of mushroom. Sprinkle with some of the meat mixture. Top with a slice of the buns. Cover and let rise for 30 minutes to 1 hour. To bake in a 400°f oven or toaster oven, heat a 12 inch cast iron skillet until smoking over high heat, add enough beef to cover the bottom of the pan.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,savory,angel hair pasta,baby spinach,greek yogurt,crisp taco shell,mint
title: Crispy Greek Nachos
ingredients: 8 ounces angel hair pasta | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons shredded fresh mint | 2 tablespoons shredded fresh savory | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 12 crisp taco shells | 1 1/2 cups fresh baby spinach
instructions: Bring 9 cups of water to a boil in a large pot. Add pasta and cook for 6 to 8 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed,butter,sugar syrup,clear honey,sparerib,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Honey Spareribs
ingredients: 1 cup sugar-free honey | 1/4 cup butter, whipped | 1/4 cup vegetable oil ( cooking spray in a jar ) | 1 teaspoon clear honey | 1 1/2 lbs spareribs, cut in half lengthwise | 1 cup sunflower seeds
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine sugar free honey with the butter. Spray metal skewers with vegetable oil spray and thread the ribs and sunflower seeds alternately into 4 pieces, alternating sides and touching each in the middle. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or till tender.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,anchovy fillet,egg yolk,mix,beef stew meat,sugar cube,rice bubble,tomato puree
title: Beef Stewed With Tonkatsu Sauce
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef stew meat | 2 -3 tablespoons peanut butter ( not crunchy ) | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 egg yolk | 1/2 cup sugar cube | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup sloppy joe mix | 2 anchovy fillets, roughly chopped or 2 anchovy fillets, finely chopped | rice bubbles, to serve
instructions: Place meat in a flameproof casserole dish and cover with peanut butter. Combine tomato puree, egg yolk, sugar cube, heavy cream and 1/2 cup water in a jug. Pour this over the meat, cover and cook in a preheated oven for 2 - 3 hours or until the meat is tender. Stir from time to time to ensure meat doesn’t burn. Remove meat when there is no water, drain well and reserve liquid. Stir in anchovies and serve with rice bubbles.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,dark rum,mustard,broccoli,safflower oil,chocolate syrup,garlic powder
title: Broiled Chocolate-Mallow Broccoli
ingredients: 20 ounces broccoli | 1/4 cup safflower oil | 1/4 cup dry fine breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup prepared mustard | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 3 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 3 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs
instructions: In a small bowl, mash a bit of the broccoli with a fork. Remove the stalks and florets and set aside. In a saucepan, warm the oil over medium heat. Once hot, add the crumbs. Let sit for a few minutes, then add the mustard and garlic powder. Stir until the mustard is mixed in and the crumbs start to brown nicely. Slowly add the rum, stirring constantly. Pour the sauce over the broccoli and mix. Turn once and coat with fine dry bread crumbs. Grill for 8 - 10 minutes until golden brown.

title: Swiss Roasted Ham and Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces ground pork | 12 ounces deli havarti deli fresh mozzarella cheese | 1 ounce black coffee
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Roll ham and cheese into balls approximately 3 inches long. Put on a foil lined baking sheet. Cook under the broiler for approximately 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from oven and spoon black coffee over ham and cheese. Enjoy.

title: Kombu Stock
ingredients: 8 ounces kombu | 20 -30 ml brandy | pepper | 4 cardamom | 4 teaspoons parsley
instructions: Wash kombu and cut it open. Pour a teaspoon full of brandy over it, and let it slowly boil for 30 - 45 mins. When it starts floating, carefully shake off any excess liquid. Cut kombu open again, and pour a little brandy into it. Add pepper and cardamom to taste. Take off heat. Garnish with parsley.

title: Mexican Baked Cocoa Mix
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. In a bowl, stir cornmeal, cocoa, and pecans together until the cornmeal is wet. Press in an 8 x 8 x 2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle top with additional cocoa, if desired. Bake for 20 minutes, or until puffy and no longer grainy. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan. Chill completely before serving.

Random Ingredients: sea salt black pepper,ginger paste,malt vinegar,mushroom
title: Homemade Port-Ganache
ingredients: 4 mushrooms | 1 inch fresh ginger paste ( i use 1/4 tsp ground ginger ) | 1 pinch sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Wash the mushrooms and remove any excess dirt. Grind them or finely chop them. Heat a skillet over medium heat and add the ginger and pepper. Place the mushrooms over there and cook until liquid from the mushrooms has evaporated. Turn off the heat and stir in the vinegar. This can be served either warm or room temperature. Store in a cool dark place. Use within 3 days.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,maple syrup,red curry paste,brown rice,garbanzo bean,pinto bean,mirin
title: Quick Red Bean and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 package pre-cooked brown rice
instructions: Combine garbanzo beans, pinto beans, maple syrup, and mirin and place in a bowl. Season with red curry paste and salt and pepper.

title: Sparkling Tilapia
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs tilapia | 2 tablespoons garlic salt | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup sparkling water | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh serrano peppers or 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh cayenne pepper
instructions: Preparation, sprinkle tilapia with 2 tablespoons garlic salt. Heat oil in 10 inch heavy skillet over medium heat. Working in batches, add tilapia and cook until just beginning to turn golden. Remove from skillet and season to taste with salt. Transfer to large platter.

title: Apricot-Kale Vodka
ingredients: 1 bottle kale, chilled | 1 1/2 cups apricots, drained | 6 whole cloves | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Place the kale in a large bowl with cold water to cover. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove the kale from the water and allow it to return to the refrigerator. Turn the bottle upside down just long enough to soften the leaves. Place cloves in a small strainer, and fill with water to cover the leaves. Cover the bowl, and let the leaves drain for about 12 hours. Once the leaves are swollen, remove from strainer. Place in a container, and freeze overnight. Remove the kale from the freezer 2 hours so the water can drip off. To serve, remove the cloves from the kale, squeeze the leaves out as much water as you can, and pack a cupful of the liquid through a strainer. Pour vodka over the kale, and gently stir in the leaves.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,chardonnay wine sauvignon blanc,asafoetida powder,coconut,apple juice,yellow onion,maple syrup
title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb yellow onion | 9 large sprigs fresh coconut | 1 cup chardonnay wine or 1 cup sauvignon blanc | 8 quarts apple juice | 1 pinch of asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon toasted desiccated coconut | 1 tablespoon toasted desiccated coconut | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Peel the onions, trim off the ends and cut into thin half rings. If they are a little longer then 3 inches thick, use tongs to do the same. Cut the coconut in half lengthways, place it in a heavy bottomed pan, add just enough water to cover the bottom of the pan. Bring to the boil, turn down to very low, and boil gently for about 30 - 40 minutes. Meanwhile put the chardonnay, apple juice, and asafoetida in a saucepan. Bring to the boil and simmer a few minutes remove from heat, stir in the coconut and red pepper flakes. When the onions are soft, strain the pan, discarding the onions and coconut. Put in the bowl of a food processor and pulse to a purée with just enough water to make it smooth, but not too smooth. Return the liquid back to the pan and reheat. Serve with toasted coconut and toasted coconut, if desired.

title: Marmalade Glazed Lamb
ingredients: 2 kg leg of lamb | 50 g marmalade, powder ( made from sifted icing sugar and water ) | 1 kg parsnip, peeled and halved lengthways | 80 g pistachios, roughly chopped
instructions: Cut lamb in 2cm slices. Place lamb in a lidded baking dish. Spread evenly with marmalade and mix well. Cover and rest for 1 hour. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour. Turn oven down to 180c. Roast for another hour until dry and browned. Place parsnips and pistachios on a serving platter. Spoon glaze over meat.

title: Chili Vinegar Onions
ingredients: 20 medium white onions, thickly sliced ( i use a sharp knife ) | 1 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Wash the onions in cold water. Remove the peel, slice very thinly and place in a bowl that has a tight fitting lid. Sprinkle with the hot pepper flakes and pour vinegar over, tossing well. Leave to marinate for about an hour if using, then place lid on container and refrigerate. If using the balsamic vinegar, drain vinegar from bowl, and drizzle over the onions. You can put this into a screw top jar, put on lid and leave as is or keep in refrigerator up to 3 weeks for a longer storage life.

title: Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 flour tortilla | 2 carrots, peeled, and grated
instructions: Spread a thin layer of olive oil on one side of the tortilla. Place a handful of grated carrots in it, fold sides over and pinch edges to seal in the oil. Roll up tortilla into a spiral.

title: Golden Raisins for Birthday Party
ingredients: 1 cup golden raisin | 3 fresh basil leaves
instructions: Put raisins in a bag with lots of cracked, dry beans. Add basil leaves and shake gently to mix. Let sit in refrigerator for 24 hours. Remove, drain, add fresh basil, and shake again. Store in refrigerator for 2 weeks.

title: Pork and Strawberry Sandwich (No Eggs)
ingredients: 2 pounds pork shoulder | 1 1/2 cups strawberries | 1 1/4 cups oatmeal | 1 teaspoon white pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Slice off top of pork shoulder, leaving about 1/2 inch of the fat on the meat. Place the pork in a large, deep skillet or wok and add a touch of olive oil and some salt and pepper. Cover and cook until well browned on all sides using about 1 minute per side. Remove the pork and keep warm. Add the strawberries to the skillet, cover and simmer until the fruit is cooked down, about 5 minutes. Stir in the oatmeal and white pepper and cook stirring constantly until oatmeal is well blended with the pork and strawberries. Remove from heat and let stand for about 20 minutes, or until the mixture slightly softens.

title: Stove Top Beef Stewing
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | cheesecloth
instructions: The night before you plan on starting this dish, peel and trim meat of all visible fat. Cut away any remaining fat from the outside. Bring a large pan of about 6 inches of water to a boil over high heat, and add salt. Place the whole beef in the water and turn the heat to high. Cook until the liquid in the pan starts to boil. Cover the meat with a clean clean, damp cloth, and place it in the crock of a double racked roasting pan. Pour the boiling liquid over the top of the meat. Place the rack in the roasting pan, and set the crock on the rack so that the excess liquid drains through the rack of the meat. Let stand for 1 to 2 hours. Place the rack in a roasting pan, and bake in a preheated 425 degree f oven for 30 minutes. While the stew is on the oven, place a pan of water onto the rack. Carefully remove the rack that will drain off the excess broth. Place the oven rack in the upper third of the oven. Bake for 45 minutes. The oven should be fairly hot. After 15 minutes, remove the beef from the crock. Cover with foil, tent loosely with foil, and let stand overnight. After the next 1/2 hour, remove meat from the pan, and place on a platter to make slicing easier. Skim as much of the fat off the top as you can. Cut off any hard edges as possible and slice off any fat that has solidified. Return sliced meat to pot, heat until the meat juices have reduced. Serve with your favorite gravy.

title: Strawberry Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces wide egg noodles | 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 8 ounces prawns, uncooked, cleaned ( peeled ) | 1 cup strawberry ( halved ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried rose water | 1/4 teaspoon sweet paprika
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, saute beef and prawns in large nonstick skillet on medium heat for 5 minutes, until beef and prawns are no longer pink. Stir in noodles, strawberries, rose water, paprika and 3/4 cup water. Cook and stir over medium heat for five minutes or until sauce thickens slightly and mixture is hot. Stir in remaining 1/4 cup water and serve.

title: Sweet and Sour Mac N Cheese
ingredients: 3/4 cup coconut milk ( preferably sweetened variety ) | 3 tablespoons neufchatel cheese | 3 tablespoons rice or 3 tablespoons arborio rice | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 lb ziti pasta
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine coconut milk, cheese, rice or 2 tbsp rice, sesame oil and the pasta. Bring to a boil and reduce the heat.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,brown rice,half,red food coloring
title: Bell Pepper and Brown Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper | 1 cup brown rice or 1 cup white rice | 2 cups half-and-half | 2 -6 drops red food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to cut bell pepper in 8 thin slivers. Place strips on lightly greased baking sheet and bake in 375 degree oven until flesh is tender. When cool, remove seeds and finely dice. In a medium size bowl, combine half and half, peppers, rice and desired amount of food coloring. Stir well, cover and chill in refrigerator 2 hours or until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,plum tomato,lime wedge,jeera powder,red wine vinegar
title: Tomato and Coconut Salad
ingredients: 3 ripe plum tomatoes | 1 cup coconut milk | 1 teaspoon dry jeera powder ( or turmeric powder ) | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1 lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Chop the tomatoes in half and remove the skin. Place them in a blender with the coconut milk, dry chilie and turmeric powder. Blend for 5 seconds and taste for acidity. Taste for salt. Pour into a serving dish, garnish with lime wedge and serve.

title: Danish Aussie Bacon Balls
ingredients: 8 ounces bacon, diced | 3/4 cup apricot jam ( soft type ) | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Crumble bacon and drain fat from pan. Over medium high, heat bacon until crispy. Pour jam over bacon and stir until warmed through. Add cream and mustard, stirring until smooth. When mixture starts to thicken, add 2 tbsp. More cream to form a thick paste like consistency for dipping.. Enjoy.

title: Australian Cheese and Date Cake
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1 cup ketchup | 3/4 cup date, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Beat eggs and add remaining ingredients. Pour into greased ovenproof dish. Cover and cook at c for 45 mins to 1 hour until toothpick comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,red chili pepper flake,pecan,red table wine,currant,kalamata olive
title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Kecap
ingredients: 12 ounces red table wine | 8 ounces currants | 2 ounces kaffir lime leaves or 2 ounces lemon leaves ( 3-4 kaffir lime leaves ) | 3 -6 fresh red chili peppers, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 1 ounce walnut pieces | 4 -6 fresh mint leaves or 4 -6 cilantro
instructions: Prepare the table wine and currants either by gently heating them in a medium pan or by stirring with a wooden spoon. Or, if adding a chile slice, simply put a small piece of chile in a small frying pan with 1 tbsp water and put it over high heat. When the chile starts to smoke, give it a couple of stirs, and it must reduce its heat to medium. After a few seconds it should release the fragrance of the chile, but be careful that the chile does not release too much fragrance. Once this happens, immediately stir in the kaffir lime leaves. Turn the heat down to a slow simmer, and simmer gently for 5 - 10 minutes. Strain the chile to remove the chile seeds. If using a fresh chile pepper, take off the stalk and slice off the stem. In a large bowl, stir together the kecap and currants thoroughly and add them. Stir in the olives, mint leaves, and chile seeds. Cover, and refrigerate overnight, at least 2 hours or up to 3 days. Taste and adjust seasonings if desired. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Orange and Olive Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 orange, peeled and diced | 20 pitted kalamata olives, chopped | 1 cup taco sauce
instructions: In a salad bowl, stir together the orange and olives. Stir in the taco sauce. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,spring onion,jalapeno pepper,sun tomato oil,part mozzarella cheese
title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Mozzarella Mushroom Quiche (Baked)
ingredients: 1 prepared 9 inch quiche spring onion, sliced | 10 -12 mushrooms, sliced | 7 -8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons drained sun-dried tomato seeds from sun-dried tomatoes | 1 3/4 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese ( about 2 1/2 cups ) or 1 3/4 cups asiago cheese ( about 2 1/2 cups )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a 9 inch pie plate or a 6 cup springform pan with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange 1/2 the onion slices on the bottom of prepared pie plate. Top with 1/2 the mushrooms, reserving the remaining onions for the topping, then sprinkle with 2/3 of the sun dried tomato paste, sun dried tomatoes, and half the cheese. Repeat the layers ending with cheese on top. Bake 1 hour, or until the cheese is lightly browned. Turn oven temperature up to 400°f after about 10 minutes, place a baking rack over baking dish and place baking dish in oven, on center rack. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Garnish with the remaining onions and a scattering of the remaining sun dried tomato paste. Bake 15 - 20 minutes longer or until bubbly and the edges are golden.

title: Gruyere Gratinate
ingredients: 7 tablespoons gruyere cheese, shredded | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Take 2 tablespoons of gruyere cheese, sprinkle over some pepper and roll into a cylinder shape. Prick all over with a fork. Cook in a frying pan that has been sprayed with oil. When crispy and golden brown, remove from pan and set aside. When reheating your gratin sauce, add a little more oil to the pan. Pile a slice of gruyere onto the warm dish. Repeat with the remaining cheese, pepper and the rest of the cheese.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,onion flake,white bread,scotch bonnet chile pepper
title: Baked Green Chiles and Cheese(Jamaican)
ingredients: 12 fresh scotch bonnet chile peppers, seeds and tender insides removed | 3 slices white bread, 1/2 inch thick slices ( preferably the thick kind ) | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the chilies on a foil lined baking sheet and roast, turning occasionally, until the skin loosens, about 20 minutes. Place chiles in a plastic bag. Cover with a towel and allow chiles to steam until cool enough to handle, about 10 minutes. Cut chilies open and remove the seeds and veins, discarding and saving the liquid. Cut off the tops of the peppers and clean out the skin. Slit the chilies lengthwise with a serrated knife. Stuff the roasted chilies into the white bread slices. Combine the mozzarella cheese and dried onion flakes and sprinkle over the chilies. Place the bread and cheese mixture in a 9x13x2 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes, stirring halfway through, until cheese has melted and bread is lightly toasted.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,basil leaf,monterey jack cheese,orange juice concentrate
title: Orange-Glazed Rice
ingredients: 1 cup cooked brown rice | 1/2 cup orange juice concentrate, thawed ( can use grape juice instead ) | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in small bowl combine remaining ingredients. Drizzle oil over rice mixture and toss to coat. Transfer to ungreased 2 qt. Baking dish. Bake, uncovered, 25 minutes or until golden brown. Let rices stand 5 minutes, then pour glaze over rice. Serve.

title: Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 4 teaspoons coriander seeds, crushed | 2 slices limes
instructions: Combine coriander seeds, chicken and lime juice and place on a baking sheet. Cook in preheated oven on medium heat. Cook for 15–20 minutes turning chicken after 10–15 minutes for a golden brown colour and 50–75 degrees for a crispy skin.

title: Papaya Clotted Cream With Chervil
ingredients: 4 ripe papayas | 1/2 star anise | 1 liter club soda | chopped fresh chervil
instructions: Cut the papayas in half and remove the seeds. Wash the papayas in a sieve. Remove the pips and discard any damaged peels. Pour the club soda evenly into the bottom of a large bowl. Place half the papaya halves on top of the soda and scatter over the chervil. Cover with a tight fitting lid.

title: Mung Beans and Spinach
ingredients: 3 large plum tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1/2 pound mung bean sprouts | 1/4 pound bag baby spinach
instructions: Place tomatoes, mung beans, and spinach in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until wilted, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in spinach.

title: Sweet and Sour Christmas Desserts
ingredients: 4 ounces bacon, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon bacon fat or 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, peeled and minced | 1 ounce dark chocolate | 1/2 teaspoon cajun black cumberland cake ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon whipping cream | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, freshly grated
instructions: Fry the bacon in a non stick frying pan for 5 - 7 mins until crisp, then crumble the bacon fat or margarine over the bacon. Leave to set. To make the christmas pudding, put the chopped ginger in a non stick frying pan. Add the dark chocolate and stir until smooth.

title: Aji
ingredients: 2 pears, peeled, quartered and cored | 12 fluid ounces limoncello | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons szechuan hot bean sauce | 2 teaspoons dill | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 teaspoon lavender | 1 lime, sliced into segments
instructions: Place pear halves and limolcello in a blender, and puree. Heat cream, and sriracha in a saucepan over medium heat just until hot, but not boiling. Stir in bean sauce, dill, coriander, and szechuan pepper.

title: RITZ Push-Cart Italian "Ziti" #RITZ
ingredients: 12 graham crackers, crumbs, finely crushed | 12 plums in light juice or 12 plums in green juice, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs ziti pasta, cooked al dente and drained | 12 ounces v8 vegetable juice cocktail | 36 ounces canned crushed tomatoes | 24 ounces frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and drained ( frozen zuccini, carrots, turnips, tomatoes )
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and mix well. Form into 12 patties. Place in large skillet with a tight fitting lid. Heat on medium heat and cook about 10 minutes per side until no longer pink and juices run clear.

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 2 beef round steak | 2 swordfish steaks | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Score the steak with the cut side of a sharp knife, or cut the steak diagonally and into about 5 pieces. Rub turmeric onto both sides of each piece, and place into the hot oven. Cook for about 40 to 45 minutes. Do not make any more of the fish tests, as you want the steaks to cook evenly.

title: French Bread and Nuts
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 5 cups shredded cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Slice bread lengthwise in half. Cut diagonally in half and spread mustard on both halves spread 1/4 of the cabbage on bottom half, top with more cabbage. Wrap bottom half with a cheese cloth or other towel. Place other half in oven and bake 45 minutes or until slightly brown and crispy. Remove from oven and let sit for five minutes covered with a tent of foil. Serve with your favorite horseradish or worcestershire sauce.

title: Champignon Mushroom and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lite olive oil | 1 cup chopped cucumber | 1 cup chopped fresh poblano chile | 5 cups sliced water-packed chantignon mushrooms | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin | 3 tablespoons amaretto ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat until it shimmers, then saute the cucumber and poblano chilies for 2 to 3 minutes, or until they are just beginning to brown. Add the water and reduce the heat to medium low. Simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the cumin and amaretto and cook another 5 minutes. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Cool at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours. Stir in the cold water just before serving.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,sesame seed,habanero pepper,tabasco sauce,chili pepper flake,orzo pasta
title: Mexican Orzo Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup orzo pasta or 1/2 cup rotini pasta | 2 cups lean hamburger buns, split | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon crushed chili pepper flakes | 1 small fresh whole red peppers or 1 small habanero pepper, sliced
instructions: Cook the orzo according to package directions. Meanwhile, preheat an ungreased nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Meanwhile, in a bowl, toss the beef with the tabasco sauce, sesame seeds, chili peppers and orzo. Divide onto the four quadrants of the buns. Top with the beef mixture. Top with the pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,beef roast,self rising flour,pepper,yellow mustard,avocado
title: Gujarati Onion and Garlic Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef roast ( any type ) | 2 ripe avocados, sliced lengthwise | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 2 teaspoons self-rising flour
instructions: Trim all fat from beef and cut into 1 inch cubes. In a bowl, combine the avocados, mustard, and asafoetida. Add the beef and gently toss to combine. Spread the mixture on one side of each slice of bread. Sprinkle the sliced avocados on the top. Note, you may substitute any other vegetable you may like to use. This recipe can also be baked in the oven, refrigerated, or frozen for later use.

title: Roasted Beet and Cheese Brunchetta
ingredients: 3 small beets, stems trimmed and tops cut off | 8 ounces cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f arrange beets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake them for 30 minutes, or until tender. Remove from the oven and let cool in the oven for 15 minutes. Remove the beets from the oven and set aside to cool completely. Meanwhile, coat the inside of a jelly roll pan with a little olive oil and set aside. Place the cheese on top of the beets, then place the beet mixture on top, then drizzle over the cream. Let the cheese set up slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,extra wide egg noodle,mandarin orange segment,picante sauce,pickling cucumber,lime wedge,basil
title: Tex Mex Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces extra wide egg noodles | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 can mandarin orange segments, drained and chopped | 1 can mandarin orange segments, drained and chopped | 1/2 medium pickling cucumber, seeded and chopped | 1 -2 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1/3 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling salted water according to package directions until al dente. Drain. Heat the salsa in a medium size saucepan over high heat. When warm, toss to combine. Add orange, mandarin oranges, cucumber, and pepper jack cheese. Toss. Add basil and lime, toss well. Top with extra cheese and serve.

title: Grouper and Black Beans
ingredients: 4 grouper | 2 cans black beans, drained | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 8 cups mixed grains basmati rice, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Arrange grouper on a baking sheet. Bake at 425°f 10 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork. Add 1/2 cup water, beans, and raisins. Cover and cook in oven. Bake 30 minutes. Remove from oven and stir rice, covered, until rice is evenly coated with sauce.

title: Roasted Mexican Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar ro-tel tomatoes | 2 -6 cloves garlic
instructions: Place ingredients into a glass jar with a lid in the following fashion. 1 drop the jar into the sun and leave till tomatoes become wrinkled.

title: Fantastic Vegetarian Mousse
ingredients: 1 package frozen or fresh okra, thawed | 12 slices french bread | 2 whole canned beets, rinsed and sliced | 6 tablespoons prepared tamarind pulp | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 3/4 cup matzo meal
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place frozen okra into a baking dish, and bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Meanwhile, arrange the stale slices of bread on a work surface, and cut into bite sized cubes. Place them into a bowl, and cover with plastic wrap. Allow them to cool until easy to handle. Squeeze out the excess water from the okra, and slice them in thirds, lengthwise. Place cut okra onto the bread slices, and sprinkle with tamarind pulp, and taco seasoning. Spread some matzo meal onto the bread cubes, and top with a layer of the okra. Continue layering, ending with a layer of matzo meal and a sprinkling of taco seasoning. Slash an x in the top of the mousse, and place on top. Place baking sheet with the okra onto the middle rack of the oven. Bake for 45 minutes, or until sizzling and golden.

Random Ingredients: black bean,garlic salt,burrito flour tortilla,alfredo sauce,shortcrust pastry,apple
title: Apple Burritos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon shortcrust pastry | 2 tablespoons alfredo sauce | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 cup apple, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup black beans, cooked | 4 burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Put the shortcrust pastry in a pie plate. Add the remaining ingredients in this order, the first cheese spread, then the bean, then the tortillas lastly. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Mexican Avocado & Barley Salad
ingredients: 300 g pearl barley | 1 large avocado, peeled & cut into chunks | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 1/4 cup pickled pearl barley ( or any other small, small barley cubes ) | 2/3 cup peanut oil | 2/3 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Cook barley as per directions on the package but remove the heat prior to the last three minutes of cooking. Drain & let cool before using. Place the pearl barley in a strainer lined with cheese cloth & rinse under cold water till the water runs clear. In an individual bowl, peel and cube the avocado. Add the drained barley & peas & carrots to the avocado & toss. Add the oil & vinegar and mix well. Place in a serving bowl & scatter with the pickled pearl barley bits. Serve warm or cool.

title: Zucchini Raisins With Arugula
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini | 5 ounces dried arugula | 2 tablespoons raisins | 3 tablespoons oil
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise into thin slices, about 1/2 to 3/4 inch wide. Place in a large non reactive bowl. Sprinkle zucchini with salt. In a small bowl, combine the dried arugula with 1/4 cup boiling water.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,pork fillet,brown rice,raspberry,nutmeg,green chile pepper
title: South African Pork Stew
ingredients: 1 pound pork fillets, chopped | 6 curry leaves | 1/2 cup frozen mixed raspberries | 1 green chile pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup brown rice | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Season pork with vegetable seasoning. Place curry leaves in microwave safe bowl. In microwave, cover and cook in 2 minutes on high. Meanwhile, combine raspberries, chile pepper and rice. Cover and cook on high in 2 to 3 minutes. Stir and serve.

title: Whole Wheat French Toast
ingredients: 12 ounces cooked pasta shells | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 teaspoons coarse grain wheat bread
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until just tender, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, mix sugar and bread. Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water. Dry skillet and coat it with cooking spray. Dip a 1/2 cup measure of hot pasta water into remaining cup of hot pasta water and quickly pour into bread mixture. Cook on both sides until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side.

title: Chile Relish
ingredients: 4 ounces orange peel ( peel of about 6-8 oranges ) | 2 lbs stewing beef, trimmed of fat | 4 chilies, minced | 4 ounces mini marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f. Remove peel and cut rind away from 4 oz. Skin from oranges and discard. Cut peel into strips about 2 by 1/3.

title: Rustic Tomato & Blueberry Parfaito
ingredients: 400 g pasta, red spiral | 400 g tomatoes ( roma ) | 400 g canned mixed pulses ( i use red and black or frozen mixed pulses ) | 1 cup nonfat milk | 200 ml orange marmalade | 1 teaspoon passion fruit or 1 teaspoon orange marmalade
instructions: Boil the pasta til al dente. Drain then transfer to a warmed serving bowl. Chop the tomato, add to bowl with the sauted pulses. Add in the milk and marmalade.

title: Kahlua Bombe
ingredients: 1 ounce kahlua, kahlua is the best | 1/3 cup finely chopped lobster meat
instructions: Shake the kahlua with ice and stir in the lobster meat.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,kidney bean,thyme leaf,mace,apple juice,rum extract,savory
title: Applebee's Irish Red Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup rum flavored vodka | 1/2 cup onion, minced | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves, chopped ( or 1/8 teaspoon dry dill ) | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1 can kidney beans or ( 15 ounce ) can other red beans
instructions: Combine apple juice, rum flavored vodka, onion, thyme, mace, and savory in medium sauce pan. Heat to boiling over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in beans. Simmer 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pimento olive,creamy peanut butter,hominy,grand marnier,chicken breast half
title: Southern Peanut Butter Chicken
ingredients: 1 can hominy, rinsed and drained | 1 can pimento stuffed olives, drained | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/3 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/3 cup grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange chicken in a baking dish. Place all remaining ingredients into a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Cover, and reduce heat to low. Cook 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear. To prepare rice, place cooked chicken and hot vegetable mixture in another baking dish, cover, and bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,salt pork,garlic salt,apricot preserve,corn cob
title: Foozy Corn Cakes
ingredients: 1 can corn on the cob | 1 pint apricot preserves | salt, for sprinkling | garlic salt, for sprinkling | 1 package confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Sprinkle corn onto a baking sheet. Spread apricot preserves over the corn, and cut an x in the top of each one with a sharp knife. Sprinkle the sugar evenly over the preserves. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are crisp and golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Dipping Sauce (Nam Prik Ddeok)
ingredients: 1 piece galangal root, chopped ( kaffir lime root ) | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: Peel the ginger root from the kaffir lime root and discard the outer layer. Using a sharp knife, cut down the root until it is as thick as any fresh ginger root you can. Remove the root from the kaffir lime leaves and set aside. Place kaffir lime leaves in a blender and add the ginger root, pineapple juice in the blender, and process until almost smooth. You may need to scrape the sides of the bowl a few times to get the juice out. Transfer to a glass dish or container, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: red chili,plain flour,olive oil,parsley flake,sharp cheddar cheese,oregano leaf,cinnamon
title: Baked Chilli (Or White) Griddle Cheddar
ingredients: 200 g red chili ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c, 400°f and line 2 - 2 baking trays with baking paper. Wash the chillies, remove the stem and seeds, finely dice and put in a mixing bowl with the oil and seasonings. Add the flour and mix well until well combined. Scrape into a shallow baking dish and prick all over with a fork. Sprinkle over the cheese and scatter over the chillies. Bake for 15 - 18 mins, until golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,vegetable broth,white wine vinegar,pinto bean,chili paste,pine nut,dark soy sauce,cider vinegar
title: Bean Dip With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, toasted | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 lb dried pinto bean ( about 3 1/2 cups ) | 1 teaspoon finely chopped of fresh mint leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and stir. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,parsley,apricot nectar,pecorino romano cheese,taco seasoning,pearl barley,rice,shell pasta
title: Barley and Parsley Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces small shell pasta | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 1/3 cup rice, rinsed ( not instant ) | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/3 cup catalina-style dried apricot nectar | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook mac and rice in boiling water until just tender. Meanwhile, combine all ingredients except pasta and cheese. Add to pasta and toss to combine ingredients. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,coleslaw mix,barbecue sauce,tomato,red chilies,dijon mustard,red cabbage
title: BBQ Corn Fritters
ingredients: 12 ounces deli coleslaw mix | 1/2 red cabbage, coarsely chopped, about 4 cups | 2 large red chilies | 4 ounces baked corn tortilla chips | 1 red cabbage, coarsely choppped | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 cup barbecue sauce ( your favorite barbecue sauce )
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix, cabbage, and chilies in a medium bowl. Using a blender chop 1/4 cup of the chilies and process to an even fine grind. Stir into coleslaw mixture. Pour barbecue sauce into another bowl. Cut remaining 1/4 head of cabbage into 1/4 inch slices. Working with 1 slice of cabbage at a time press a corn tortilla into hot barbecue sauce on one side. Turn over and let cook till tortilla softens slightly on the grill. Roll up tightly and slice into 1/2 inch thick slices. Repeat with tortilla wedges. To serve place 3 or 4 pieces of fritter on a plate, top with barbecue sauce and sliced red cabbage.

Random Ingredients: green mango,rice wine vinegar,beet,yellow bell pepper,coriander seed,chicken breast half,ricotta cheese
title: Mango Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 mangoes | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 jar beet, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup canned green mango slices | 1/4 cup fat-free ricotta cheese
instructions: Place the chicken breast halves between 2 sheets of heavy duty paper towels, and pound using the mallet to 1/4 inch thickness. Wrap each breast with a strip of mango and a bell pepper slice from ripened mango, and secure openings with toothpicks. In a medium bowl, stir together the mangoes, corn or red onion, beet, rice wine vinegar, and green mango slices.

title: Molho's Basic Italian Cookies
ingredients: 8 ounces cake flour ( or flour on your mixer ) | 6 ounces dark brown sugar ( or palm sugar ) | 2 -3 garlic cloves, peeled
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl with mixer on medium speed until fluffy. Pour dough onto a clean surface and begin kneading in your hands into a smooth, even ball. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Remove dough from refrigerator, cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove dough from refrigerator and place on a floured board, punch down and knead for 1 - 2 minutes. Place on a floured baking tray. Cut dough in four by 3 inch strips, shape each piece into a ball, dust with flour. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Using a small bladed knife, pierce each cookie with a skewer 2 - 3 times, then carefully cut each cookie into 1 - 2 inch cookies. Place cookies on baking sheets, place on middle rack and bake for 8 - 9 minutes. Turn off oven. Invert cookies onto a platter and store in an airtight container.

title: Homemade Sourdough Crumbs
ingredients: 3 lbs sourdough bread | 3 cups coriander seeds | 1 1/4 lbs ciabatta, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Pour the bread cubes into a large bowl and add the coriander and ciabatta cubes. Mix thoroughly with a fork, making sure the dry spices are evenly distributed. Grease a cookie sheet. Spread onto the sheets in 3 batches and place on a cookie sheet. Bake in the oven for 10 - 12 minutes, or until the bread has absorbed the juices in the bowl. Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: spinach,rice vinegar,green chile,onion soup mix,garlic salt,goat cheese
title: Chilorio Spinach Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1 package dried whole spinach, thawed drained and squeezed dry | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 green chile, chopped | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh goat cheese | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Combine the spinach and onion soup mix in a large microwave safe bowl or bowl. Cover and microwave on high for 4 minutes or until the spinach is hot and beginning to wilt, stirring once. Stir in the chile, rice vinegar and goat cheese. Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Stir to combine and microwave on high for 2 minutes. Serve chilled.

title: Beer Stew Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chickens, cut up | 8 baby potatoes, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 package string beans, cut in 1-inch pieces | 1 can corn syrup | 1 cup beer | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon ground dried onion | reserve 2 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Spray a large, wide frying pan with cooking spray. Place chicken pieces in frying pan. In a large bowl, combine the potatoes, string beans and corn syrup, and pour in beer, corn syrup, salt, onion and raisins.

title: Herbed Red Cabbage and Herb Salad
ingredients: 1 medium head red cabbage | 1 bunch fresh herbs, such as parsley, dill, and mint ( if using dill only chop finely ) | 5 1/2 ounces red cabbage leaves ( or similar amount of mixed herbs )
instructions: Thinly slice the cabbage into thin slices. Place all the ingredients into a large, pretty serving bowl and toss gently to coat with the dressing. Adjust seasoning if necessary. Enjoy serve immediately.

title: Polish Style Bistro Basting Vegetarian  Chickpeas (Pavlova Polevka)
ingredients: 250 g canned chickpeas ( dr. pea's chickpeas ) | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 12 12 pieces metal skewers or 12 pieces bamboo skewers ( soaked in water for 10 minutes then drained )
instructions: Place peas into a food processor bowl, add soda and process for 1 – 2 minutes until smooth. Heat a small amount of oil in a wok, add the soaked bamboo pieces and fry over high heat until dark in color. Add the peas to a bowl and add the kabobs. Stir fry for 1 – 2 minutes until they are browned. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Fried Garlic
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh garlic ( minced ) | 1 cup firmly packed brown sugar | 4 eggs | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1 tablespoon garlic ( minced ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Put chopped garlic in bowl and use a fork to mash with sugar. Add eggs, orange zest and garlic. Mix well. Heat a frying pan to medium high heat. Pour oil, pour mixture into pan. Place garlic mixture in pan and fry garlic until lightly brown on both sides, turn over when golden and continue to fry. Remove and drain on paper towels or a cookie sheet lined with plastic wrap to absorb excess oil grease.

title: Roast Chicken and Cauliflower Tarts
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens ( weighing about 2kg or 6oz ) | 1 cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 pork, ground | 1/2 lb cooked chickpeas, drained | 3 ounces roasted garlic stuffed peas, drained | 1 large deep dish pie shell
instructions: Preheat the oven. Place the bird in a large, deep roasting pan, fat side up, with the cauliflower and ground pork. Cook slowly until the cauliflower starts to soften. Pour into a bowl and add the chickpeas and roasted garlic and cook for another minute. Tip the filling into the pan along with the stock and season and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes until the sauce is creamy and thick. Remove from the heat. Fill each pie shell with the filling and serve right away. Nice cold biscuits that can be eaten with salads for lunch too. I can't list the number of servings it will likely take.

title: Salsa Burgers
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 -2 teaspoon salsa | 1 small zucchini, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint or 1 teaspoon dried mint | 4 hamburger buns
instructions: Grind cornflour, salsa, zucchini, and mint in a food processor until smooth. Shape into four burgers and lightly flour. Grill burgers over hot coals 15 - 20 minutes, turning once or twice, until cooked through.

title: Spicy Cranberry Spiced Fish
ingredients: 400 g diced firm fish | 1 tablespoon korma curry paste | 1 teaspoon hot spice ( or allspice, allspice ) | 100 g fresh cranberries ( optional ) | cooking oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Mix the curry paste or paste with 2 tbsp water. Add fish. Mix well. Heat oil in a deep pan, put the fish in and gently fry on high heat for 3 - 4 minutes remove fish from the pan and place in a bowl. Add sauce to the pan and cook for 5 mins. Add the cobbys, mix thoroughly and serve hot with rice, salad, or rice and vegetables.

title: Tacos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks or 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 8 corn tortillas
instructions: Cut steak diagonally into 4 or 6 servings. Stack steaks, fat side up, on a cutting board. Using a sharp, heavy knife, slice 1 1/2 through each steak so it is 4 slices. Push steaks through a food mill, leaving the fat in the steak. Push tortillas through a large metal or glass bowl so that the tortillas are easy to roll as you go. Tightly roll the tortillas so they are tightly packed together and secure with toothpicks. Heat a heavy skillet, about 3/4 to 1 inch high, over medium high heat. When hot, place tortillas in the skillet. Cook until edges are a golden brown and crisp. With a slotted spoon, transfer to a rack in an unlit oven or on a plate lined with paper towels to drain. Discard all but about 2 tablespoons of pan drippings. To serve, place tortillas, cut side down, in a large heavy skillet or skillet for 1 minute. Turn over and place 2 or 3 toothpicks over steak. Cook for a minute more. Turn steak over and repeat with tortillas. Serve accompanied by your choice of accompaniments, such as refried beans and sour cream.

title: Easy Fruity Baked Potato Wedges
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, halved | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup icing sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the almond extract and the icing sugar together in a bowl. Cut each potato piece up into four wedges, and pat to coat well. Place wedges on a baking sheet, and sprinkle with the almond mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, until golden brown and crispy. Cool for 5 minutes, and then serve.

title: Homemade English Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons scallions, finely chopped, including tops
instructions: Combine mustard, vinegar, and scallions in small bowl.

title: Spanish Escoutte
ingredients: 8 beef caps, trimmed and frenched ( rinsed if necessary, or trimmed of excess fat ) | 16 fresh cilantro stems ( or 2/3 cup dried cilantro leaves, plus a few for garnish ) | 1/4 cup fruity dry sherry | 1/2 cup finely minced fresh italian parsley
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil with salt at the highest temperature. Line two rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper or heavy duty aluminum foil and set aside. Place a rack in the oven and preheat the broiler. Working with one per plate at a time, slit each cap lengthwise into 2 thin cap slices, keeping the slices attached. Arrange the cap slices in a single layer on each baking sheet. Broil the cap slices about 4 inches from the heat until the tops are well browned and the tops have a matte dull surface, about 6 minutes. Be careful not to burn them. Turn them over, then brush the tops of the cap slices with the sherry. Cover and broil the cap slices for about 5 minutes, or until beginning to caramelize at the edges. Remove the foil and continue to turn the cap slices over until no liquid remains. Garnish with the parsley. These may be frozen for up to 2 months.

title: Lime and Sage Slices
ingredients: 1 cup dried mixed fruit, soaked overnight in water and drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage | 1/2 cup fresh lime wedges
instructions: Gently pat dry fruit. If using dried fruit, gently pound together with sage. Mix lime wedges and juice and pour over fruit. Let stand several hours or preferably overnight before serving.

title: Crispy Potato Nests
ingredients: 24 slices ciabatta corn chips, crumbled | 1 teaspoon coriander | 6 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped | 1 cup guacamole
instructions: Spread about 1 tablespoon of the ciabatta crumbs onto a clean surface of a clean plate. Toss the remaining ciabatta crumbs together with the coriander, parsley and mint. Use a spoon to spread some of the guacamole over one side of each crumb. Arrange the potato nests on a clean plate. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: black olive,peanut oil vegetable,egg yolk,mayonnaise,vanilla bean
title: Vanille Kipferl
ingredients: 3 ounces black olives, very finely chopped | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 cups mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons light vanilla bean, scrapings ( seeds scrapings will work ) | 2 large egg yolks
instructions: Soak olives in enough hot water to cover for 30 minutes or until softened. Drain and squeeze dry and place in food processor. Add oil and puree until smooth. In separate bowl whisk together yolks, mayonnaise and vanilla bean until thick and fluffy. Add to olives and mix well. Place in a serving dish. Using metal spatula, transfer dip from bowl to plate. Garnish with parsley or mint leaves and serve.

title: Strawberry Crescent (Using a Hint of Twisted Directions)
ingredients: 1 lb strawberry preserves | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the strawberry preserves and confectioners' sugar. Cover, and refrigerate until serving time. Use a small round cookie scoop to scoop out about 1 tablespoonful of dough onto a cookie sheet, then spread it out into a 12 inch circle. Repeat process to make 10 more crescents. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Sprinkle with the confectioners' sugar. Bake in the preheated oven until the crescents are golden brown and crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from the oven, and cool on the cookie sheet for 5 minutes. Remove the cookie sheet from the oven, and transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Serve with your favorite sweets. Store airtight.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,maple syrup,cherry,spinach,red chili powder,lettuce,chunky salsa,cornflour
title: Spinach and Cherry Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 3/4 cup thick & chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 kg spinach, washed and picked over | 250 g cherry tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Mix cornflour with 1/4 cup of the sweet & chunky salsa and stir to make a smooth paste. Dissolve cornflour in remaining salsa and set aside. Combine chili powder with the remaining 2 tbsp sweet sauce and set aside. Tear spinach into small portions and toss in 1/4 cup of the cherry tomatoes. Toss to coat. In a microwave safe bowl combine remaining salsa with the cornflour mixture. Microwave till boiling. Remove from microwave and stir into salsa mixture. Cook for 1 minute or until heated through. Add spinach and cherry tomatoes and mix well. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Focaccia
ingredients: 2 cups self raising flour ( +/- 0.5oz/170g for a thinner crust if you don� t like the taste ) | 1 vegetable bouillon cube ( optional ) | 9 ounces cold cooked pasta ( eg fettucini )
instructions: Mix the flour and bouillon cube in a small bowl. Add 1 cup cold pasta water. Use a spoon to make the dough into small discs. Flour your hands and press 1cm/ 1/4 of the pasta around the base of the baking dish. Sprinkle with about 1 1/2 teaspoons dried spices. Repeat until all the pasta/focaccia is used up. Sprinkle 1/4 more dried spices over the dough just before cooking. Cook in a 350 degree f oven 1 hour or until golden.

title: Scotch Seasoning
ingredients: 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together sugar and mace. Store, covered, in a cool dark place.

Random Ingredients: green,cucumber,chili flake,red pepper,rice noodle,mustard powder,almond butter
title: Cold Sliced Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked rice noodles | 3/4 cup fresh cucumber, grated | 1/2 cup red pepper, finely chopped | 1/3 cup sliced almonds, toasted ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons green chili flakes, minced ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 3 tablespoons chili butter ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles to desired tenderness, drain and rinse. In a large bowl, combine cucumber, red pepper, almonds, green chili flakes and mustard powder. When cold, stir in butter. Stir in cooled noodles and mix well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,red chile,salt pork,coconut milk,hazelnut,pecan,baby back rib
title: Chile Crusted Ribs
ingredients: 2 pounds baby back ribs | salt to taste | 1 cup coconut milk | 1 can dark coconut milk | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup ground hazelnuts | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Season the ribs with salt and place them into a slow cooker. Pour 1 cup of coconut milk, dark coconut milk, vanilla, hazelnuts, and ground hazelnuts onto the ribs. Reserve remaining coconut milk for another use. Set for 5 hours on high. Remove strings and sprinkle with coarse sugar.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,saffron thread,spinach leaf,cake flour,flat rice noodle,half
title: Saffron Cream Pies
ingredients: 2 pints cream half-and-half | 1 lb cake flour or 1 lb all-purpose flour | saffron threads or 1 -2 tablespoon saffron | 4 sheets saffron-infused cake or 4 sheets saffron-infused cake, cut into 6 pieces | 14 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and drained thoroughly | 10 ounces fresh flat rice noodles ( or other white rice noodles ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream or 1/2 cup half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Heat cream until it just begins to boil, stirring frequently. Meanwhile, place flour in a large resealable plastic bag and add saffron to cream.

Random Ingredients: couscous,vanilla essence,broccoli floret,challah,spring onion,green chili pepper
title: Challah and Vegetable Couscous
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups couscous | 1 bunch spring onions | 1 small green chili pepper or 1 small yellow chili pepper | 4 ounces shredded broccoli florets | 1/2 ounce of chopped fresh green chili pepper or 1/2 ounce cayenne pepper | 2 teaspoons of pure vanilla essence
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a ceramic bowl or large dish and set aside in the fridge for 30 minutes to allow flavours to mingle. When ready to serve, steam or microwave your chosen veggies and serve hot straight away on the side.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,file powder,spinach,italian salad dressing mix,red potato,asparagus,kosher salt
title: Salad of Curried Beef, Asparagus and Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large red potatoes, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 4 bunches fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix, such as good seasons | 1/4 cup red curry paste, such as patak's | 1 pound fresh spinach, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 2 teaspoons coarsely ground file powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange potatoes in a roasting pan and sprinkle with salt. Roast in the preheated oven until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer potatoes to a plate and allow to cool to the touch. Remove asparagus from oven and set aside. Place in a small saucepan with enough water to cover the bottom and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Simmer until tender, 20 to 30 minutes. Place cut potatoes in a shallow baking dish. Arrange asparagus and asparagus pieces on top of potatoes and coat with salad dressing mix. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and potatoes are heated through, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat, season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: ha avocadoes,bacon,masa harina,black mustard seed,plain yogurt,kielbasa,banana
title: Churros in Banana Skins
ingredients: 6 bolero-style kielbasa ( turkey kielbasa, cut in half lengthwise then in half again, then crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick slices ) | 1/4 cup finely minced bacon | 1/8 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 cup diced ripe banana | 4 hass avocadoes | 1/3 cup masa harina
instructions: Prepare grill with indirect heat. Arrange kielbasa on hot grill. Cover grill and cook until lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Set a large plate in the pan, and set aside. In a skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until browned but not crisp, breaking with a wooden spoon if necessary, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and drain off all but 1 tablespoon fat in skillet. Stir mustard seeds into bacon fat.

Random Ingredients: cod,amaretto,serrano pepper,shallot,dark corn syrup,hot water,jalapeno pepper,egg white
title: Codfish in Spicy Whiskey Sauce
ingredients: 6 cod, cleaned and scaled ( approx 3 pounds ) | 1/4 cup dark corn syrup | 5 large egg whites, slightly beaten | 3/4 cup hot water | 1/2 cup minced shallot | 1/2 cup minced pickled jalapeno peppers | 3/4 cup amaretto, warmed | serrano pepper, seeds removed, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Place fish in a baking dish with a lid and bake until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove cover and continue to bake for 15 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove fish, but do not let them get too brown. While still hot, carefully remove the fish from the pan and refrigerate, covered in the juices. When all the juices have been removed from the baking dish, combine the corn syrup and egg whites in a bowl and beat with a fork, until soft peaks form. Gently fold in the hot water. Dip each slice of fish one at a time, coating both sides evenly with this batter. Arrange fish in an oblong roasting pan lined with aluminum foil. Spoon a little of the warmed amaretto into the bottom of the pan. Place a small piece of the fish into the center of the foil. Spread some of the reserved juices on top of it. Place the pickled jalapeños in on top of this. Place half of the sliced fish onto the jalapeño mixture. Place the remaining sliced fish on top of this. Pour the remaining amaretto over the fish and juices. Top with the remaining sliced fish, again topping with the amaretto. Place the roasting pan in preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes. Serve sauce with boiled potatoes, a vegetable with a dipping sauce like salsa, or as an appetizer for dinner.

Random Ingredients: kale,lemon juice zest,wheat germ,oregano leaf,white vinegar
title: Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1 lb kale, washed and torn into bite size pieces | 1/4 cup dry whole wheat germ | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, fresh squeezed | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Place the beans in a pan with just enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Boil about two minutes. Drain the greens, cool slightly and slice the greens into bite sized chunks. Place in a medium sized bowl. Make the sauce by whisking the mustard, lemon juice, oregano and vinegar until blended. Pour over the greens and toss to combine. Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes.

title: Stir Fried Bean Sprouts & Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice ( not long grain ) | 2 cups bean sprouts | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Start steaming your rice till it is 1/4 inch or less done. Set aside until ready to use. Rinse sprouts under running water until water runs clear. Set aside. Drain excess water from rice then place in bowl. Cover with saran wrap and set aside on plate for 10 minutes while you prepare your other ingredients. Remove sprouts from saran wrap and rinse well, pat dry with paper towel then place in bowl with rice. Mix soy sauce and sherry together. Toss the rice with soy sauce mixture. Spoon rice over sprouts and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dark cherry,white cheddar cheese,baking soda,hoisin sauce,red chili powder,kernel corn,chili pepper,artichoke heart
title: Chinese Artichoke-Cherry Snack
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups frozen whole kernel corn | 1 1/2 cups fresh sweet chili peppers, halved lengthwise ( jalapenos, scotch bonnet peppers or chilis ) | 1 lb frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and dried | 1 jar dark sweet sweet cherries | 1/3 cup hoisin sauce | 1/4 cup white cheddar cheese, grated ( or as needed ) | chili powder, for sprinkling ( optional ) | red chili powder, to sprinkle on top ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Mix corn, chili peppers, artichoke hearts, cherries, hoisin sauce, cheese and chili powder in a 2 quart baking dish. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle top with additional cheddar if desired.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,vanilla bean,anise seed,black cumin,chicken bouillon granule
title: Mexican Green Chile Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons pure anise seed | 5 whole green chile peppers, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla bean, scraped | 1/4 teaspoon ground white or black cumin
