instructions: Heat aniseed and green chiles in a skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly after about 1 minute or until aromatic. Transfer to a blender, add the bouillon granules, vanilla bean, and cumin.

Random Ingredients: green bean,steak,vegan cheddar cheese,vegetable stock,romano cheese,cardamom seed,french baguette,rice wine
title: Kleftiko (Vietnamese Bread Soup)
ingredients: 1/2 loaf french baguette | vegan cheddar cheese or cheddar cheese ( amount desired ) | 1/4 cup vegetarian cheddar cheese | 3 -4 cups vegetable stock ( low fat is best ) | 2 teaspoons rice wine | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, crushed | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed | steak ( optional )
instructions: Cut bread in half lengthwise, then cut a lengthwise cut slit in top half to make 4 pieces. Set loaf on cutting board. Place cheese on top of loaf and cut sides into 1/4 slices. Cut ends from bread, making sure cheese does not stick to bread. Place bread slices in steamer basket and place over boiling water. When bubbles form, add ricewine, cover and cook until bread is warm but not mushy. When ready, drain, add green beans and cooked bread slices to soup. Continue steaming soup until bread is warmed through.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,strawberry,garlic powder,ginger powder,yeast cake,button mushroom,cocoa powder,cake
title: Crusty Strawberry and Mushroom Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 package yeast cakes ( not instant yeast, no lite ) | 1 pinch ginger powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/3 cup cake, sponge cakes, softened ( like you can make traditional sponge ) | 1 pinch garlic powder ( optional ) | 8 large button mushrooms | 1 quart fresh strawberries, sliced ( or frozen ) | sliced fresh raspberries ( optional ) or frozen strawberries
instructions: For the crust, in a large mixing bowl, place the yeast cakes, ginger and cocoa and mix well to make the sponge. Add a cup of warm water, about 3 tablespoons, stir well and then add the remaining ingredients and combine.. Put in a 9x12 baking dish, or individual dishes and put into a 400 degree f oven for about 20 minutes, or until the crust starts to crisp.

title: Pork and Chile Saag
ingredients: 2 lbs pork sausage | 2 serrano peppers | 1/4 cup serrano pepper, chopped and seeded | 2 inches asafoetida powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in a large mixing bowl. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator overnight, turning once. Cook slowly in a 350f oven for 45 minutes, stirring once.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,chicken bouillon granule,white flour,seasoning,tomato sauce,cauliflower,chocolate square
title: Santa Fe Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 300 g white flour | 1 package mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon tomato sauce | 1 cup fresh cauliflower, chopped | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1 semi-sweet chocolate square, grated
instructions: In a large pot, combine flour, steak seasoning, bouillon, tomato sauce, and cauliflower. Bring mixture to a boil, stirring. Simmer, covered until cauliflower is tender, approximately 5 minutes. Ladle into soup bowls and sprinkle with salsa and grated chocolate. Note, if you find it too thin, you can add an additional 1/2 tsp chicken broth.

title: Potato Oven French Fries
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes | 1 orange jell-o
instructions: Clean and peel potatoes. Cut fries into 3 x 2 x 1 inch sticks, then into sticks of equal length with 1/2 inch of ends through. Arrange about 6 inch fries in a 5 by 2 inch baking dish. Cut orange jell o into 4 pieces, then into 1 sticks of equal length along sticks of potato. Sprinkle the orange jell o mixture and cover with plastic wrap. Place a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat, then add the potatoes. Cover, and cook until the fries are soft, about 15 minutes on each side. Serve with ketchup, french fries, or horseradish sauce.

title: Double Skin Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 -9 ounces pork tenderloins | 4 ounces white chocolate chips ( use dark )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place a sheet pan in oven for 15 minutes. Take off the oven and turn a few times. The temperature should almost reach 450f. Cut the pork tenderloins into long thin slices lengthwise. Arrange on the same sheet pan as the chocolate chips and bake for 20 minutes in a preheated oven until the meat is tender and cooked through, about 20 minutes longer. Remove the meat from the oven and allow to rest for about 20 minutes before slicing thinly.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,italian parsley,milk ricotta cheese,cream cheese,great northern bean,sauce
title: Creamy Salmon With White Beans
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1/2 can great northern beans with liquid | 1/2 cup reduced-fat sour cream cheese | 1/2 cup reduced-fat milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup chopped italian parsley | 1 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Place salmon fillets in a 12 in. X 7 in. X 2 in. Baking dish coated with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine beans, sour cream, ricotta, parsley and hot sauce. Spoon bean mixture over fish. Cover and chill at least 1 hour turning over several times. Bake, uncovered, in a 375°f degree oven about 20 minutes or till fish is just cooked through.

title: Baked Garlic and Parmesan Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grenadine | cooking spray | 1 ounce parmigiano-reggiano cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a nonstick ovenproof skillet with cooking spray. Combine the grenadine and parmigiano reggiano in a small bowl. Drop about 2 tablespoons of the grated parmesan cheese into the skillet.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,okra,italian tomato,pecorino romano cheese,ham,flat leaf italian parsley,confectioner ' sugar,grain white rice
title: Lighter Grilled Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup milk chocolate | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate, melted | 1/2 cup diced fully cooked ham | 1/2 cup diced firm fresh italian fresh tomatoes ( about 3/4 pound total ) or 1/2 cup canned italian tomatoes, drained and chopped ( about 3/4 pound total ) | 2 cups shredded whole grain white rice or 2 cups brown rice | 1/3 cup finely grated pecorino romano cheese | chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, for garnish
instructions: Whisk together the milk chocolate and 3 t. Butter in a small bowl. Gradually whisk in the confectioners' sugar, until smooth and creamy. Divide the mixture among 2 or 3 small baking dishes. Top each with the ham and tomatoes. In a small bowl, mix the rice, cheese and 1/2 cup water until well combined. Pour into the baking dishes. Cover the dish and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or up to 3 days. Remove the dish from the refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. Preheat the grill to medium high heat. Brush the grill with oil. Remove the dish from the refrigerator and grill for 20 minutes. Turn the polenta onto a rack set in a rimmed baking sheet and grill for 15 to 20 minutes, or until a golden brown crust forms, turning often. Remove from the grill and let stand for 3 to 5 minutes before serving. Garnish polenta with a sprinkling of fresh chopped parsley and serve.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,enchilada sauce,rye bread,tomato green chilies,lemon zest,lime wedge,aubergine
title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Fries
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, cut into strips 3/4 to 1/2 to 1-1 inch wide | 1 can ro-tel diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 2 poblano peppers, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons chopped lemons, zest of | 1 can enchilada sauce, mild | 6 slices crusty rye bread, toasted | lemon wedge, for garnish
instructions: Slice eggplant into rounds 1/4 inch thick. Place on paper towel lined baking sheet with parchment paper and blot dry. Arrange on top rack of a broiler pan. Broil 4 minutes or until browned, stirring twice. Transfer eggplant to bowl of ice water to cool slightly. Slice lengthwise in half. Scoop out the pulp. Transfer pulp into food processor, along with next 3 ingredients. Process until smooth, stopping occasionally. Spoon mixture into an oven safe 1 1/2 to 2 quart casserole dish, cover and bake in a 325 degree oven until tender, about 1 hour. Remove lid and bake 20 minutes longer. Cut into strips. Garnish with lemon wedges.

title: Sauerkraut, Raude and Lemon (Bars)
ingredients: 100 g sauerkraut | 3/4 cup caster sugar | club soda
instructions: Wash the rinsed sauerkraut under running water. Drain well and squeeze out the water. Cut sauerkraut into 4 large size pieces. Boil in plenty of water, until a thick syrup is formed. Mix well the sauerkraut and sugar in a pan and simmer for 5 minutes. Pour into hot buttered glasses and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rocket,turnip,white sugar,margarine,marinara sauce,cream celery soup,red pepper
title: Katherine's Farmhouse Salad
ingredients: 1 jar marinara sauce | 2 stalks celery soup with turnips | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 10 ounces rocket, washed, dried and torn into chunks | 1 cup mixed salad green | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Drain most of the liquid from the marinara and combine with the celery soup and margarine in a large bowl. Add the chopped salad and mix through the red pepper. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Grilled Veg-goat Cheese (Veg*n) With Leeks
ingredients: 2 leeks | 4 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Trim the green parts of the leeks and cut them in half lengthways. Cut the halves in half at both ends. Grill the leeks, cut side down, from a height of 5cm or so, over medium heat, for 10 minutes or until soft and beginning to change colour. Cut into 2cm slices using a pair of serrated knife or a vegetable peeler. Put a piece of cheese in each of the two leeks. Serve at once.

title: Spaghetti With Mango and Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 mango | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon mixed spice, spice | 3 lbs spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: In blender or food processor, blend mango, molasses and 1 tbsp cooking juices until smooth. Add yogurt. Mix well and add spice. Mix well. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve. Add in spaghetti just before serving.

title: Italian Tuna, Carrots and Tuna
ingredients: 4 tuna steaks, frozen or canned, with juices | 2 tablespoons butter | 4 baby carrots, sliced
instructions: Bake or fry the steaks for 5 to 7 minutes on each side, depending on the thickness of the tuna. Meanwhile, drain all the vegetables and reserve the juices. Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the carrots and just before the steaks are cooking, add the vegetables and the juices. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sage,jellied cranberry sauce,cheddar cheese soup,bacon dripping,sourdough starter,marsala wine,vanilla extract,navy bean
title: Cheesy White Bean Bread
ingredients: 4 -5 cups cooked navy beans | 1 2/3 cups dried sourdough starter ( see note below ) | 1 1/4 cups cheddar cheese soup | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 1 teaspoon sage | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup crushed jellied cranberry sauce
instructions: Note, this recipe can be made 3 months ahead, then refrigerated. In large bowl, combine beans, 1/3 cup cheese soup, bacon drippings or olive oil, marsala, sage, vanilla, and cheese soup.

Random Ingredients: bulgur,honey,nonfat plain yogurt,bamboo skewer,rotel,hoisin sauce,mace,dill pickle
title: Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur | 3 cups nonfat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1/4 cup chopped dill pickles | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro or 1/4 cup mint | 1 pinch of freshly grated mace | 3 fresh bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 1 hour
instructions: Heat grill pan to medium high. Prepare 1 quart bowl with cooking spray. Soak bulgur in 2 cups boiling water 30 minutes. Drain off any excess water. Combine bulgur and remaining ingredients well. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Toss with hands. Transfer to a 4 - 5 quart bowl. Serve.

title: White Vinegar and Emmental Cheese Spread
ingredients: 3 cups gruyere cheese, finely grated | 1 cup emmenthaler cheese, finely grated | 3/4 cup apricot preserves | 2 teaspoons white vinegar, unfiltered
instructions: Add all ingredients into food processor and process until mixture is smooth. If necessary add more vinegar to get a spreading consistency. Serve chilled with crackers or as a topping for pretzel crackers. Variation can be made by adding 1/2 cup parmesan cheese to cheese mixture when you add 1/2 cup grated white or brown sugar and 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch.

title: Brandy Sprouted Chickpea  Flour Hummus
ingredients: 250 g honey hummus, plain | 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon sherry | 150 g mixed sprouts | 2 tablespoons shaved marshmallows
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,chickpea,button mushroom,milk,curry powder,rice noodle,chicken bouillon cube
title: Quick and Easy Curry Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1/3 cup cooked rice noodles | 1 1/2 cups chopped button mushrooms | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( dissolved in a little water ) | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 cups cooked chickpeas, divided ( canned ) | 1 can evaporated milk, divided
instructions: Stir together buttermilk, rice noodles, mushrooms, and chicken bouillon cube in large bowl. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Remove from refrigerator. Combine remaining ingredients except milk.

title: Lebanese Beef and Pitas
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 12 lasagna noodles, broken in half ( or 24 to 26 per package package ) | 1 jar pita pockets, cut into halves | 3 tablespoons ice rios, crushed
instructions: Cook beef in medium skillet for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until no longer pink.

title: Cranberry Beef Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb rump steak | 1/2 lb smoked ham | 1/2 green bell pepper | 1/2 turnip | 1/2 red sweet potato | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 325'f. Place beef, ham, pepper, and turnip on a wire rack over a baking sheet that has been sprayed with pam. Bake 45 minutes. Remove from oven and turn meat and continue baking for 25 minutes. Add flour, sage and remaining spices and continue to bake for 15 minutes until meat is cooked through.

title: Italian Cauliflower Cauliflower Wraps
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 1/2 lb deli ham | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 3 italian rolls or 3 rolls, split, toasted
instructions: Boil the cauliflower until tender in salted water until slightly fluffled. Place a small slice of ham on each warmed roll and sprinkle with the parmesan cheese. Wrap and enjoy.

title: Simple Fried Beer
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs medium beer | 1 chicken stock cube, dissolved in | 3 tablespoons rice wine | salt ( optional )
instructions: Add the beer to the pot add the chicken stock cube, rice wine and salt. Stir and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes or until the stock has reduced to 1/2 cup note you can also use canned chicken stock for extra flavour, and add a pinch of garlic powder or dried thyme before serving. If you add the oil after 30 minutes, the oil will be released from the beer, but after 10 you could add more beer.

title: Baked Ziti
ingredients: 1 cup ziti pasta, rinsed well | 1 medium courgette, sliced | 3 medium ziti pasta, rinsed well | 1 medium cauliflower, sliced | 2 stalks scallions, sliced | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds, lightly toasted | seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf and spray a 1 1/2 quart baking pan with nonstick spray. Combine first five ingredients and mix well. Spread half of mixture evenly on the baking pan. Sprinkle with half each of the seeds and the remaining seeds. Repeat layers, ending with seeds and seeds. Bake for 70 minutes, then uncover and bake for additional 15 minutes, or until pasta is done to your liking. Top with remaining toasted seeds and fresh greens to serve.

title: Turnip, Snow Pea, and Nuts
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds snow peas, trimmed | 4 turnips, scrubbed and thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons cashews, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dry roasted pistachio nuts | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add snow peas and turnip. Cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Transfer snow peas and peas to a bowl and mash. Add turnips, cashews, pistachios, worcestershire sauce, and 1/2 the water. Place remaining 1/2 water into a small bowl.

title: Gruyere Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 24 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 2 yellow bell peppers, seeded and sliced thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place cheese in fondue pot or crockpot. Add oil and peppers to pot. Place pot on the top of the stove over a medium flame until everything is bubbling. Remove and set aside on a flat plate. When the fondue is bubbling again, keep stirring in a circular motion to make sure mixture does not burn on the bottom. Keep dipping spoonfulls of fondue into the fondue so each fondue has a certain amount of oil on it and helps melt the cheese. Keep dipping fondue with fondue forks and stirring and letting the cheese melt into the fondue. Eat them hot, or leave the fondue as is, they are wonderful reheated in a skillet if reheated in the oven, then keep in the crockpot in the oven for 2 days in a crockpot it will have better flavor.

title: Smoky & Crazy Canadian Bacon Spread
ingredients: 1 package canadian bacon, broken up | 1 can mild enchilada sauce | 1/8 teaspoon savory, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the canadian bacon in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook, stirring, until evenly browned. Drain the bacon in a colander. Remove the slices to a medium bowl. Stir the enchilada sauce, and savory into the drained bacon. Cover, and spread the mixture over the prepared baking sheet. Return to the oven for 10 minutes, then spread the cheese on top. Continue cooking and stirring until cheese is melted. Slice the roll into pieces, and serve with crackers.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maple syrup ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons light cream or 2 tablespoons whipping cream flavoring | pepper, freshly grilled flavor ( to taste ) | 10 -12 tortillas
instructions: Place a small dish on your table, you'll need to have 3 bowls. I find that it's about 3, 3, 2 or 3 big tortillas, depending on what type of tortillas you're using. First, spread the cream or whipping cream over the tortillas, add pepper to taste and then cover with the maple syrup. Wrap up and eat now. Repeat for a second dish or up to 3 other servings.

Random Ingredients: salt tomato sauce,veal,mahi fillet,chicken breast half,onion salt,olive
title: Chicken Breasts Stuffed With Smoked Mahi Mahi
ingredients: 4 boneless mahi mahi fillets | 4 tablespoons smoked smoked olive | salt and tomato sauce | onion salt | 3/4 lb smoked veal, sliced thin | 1/2 cup chopped onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees, and grease two cookie sheets. Slice mahi mahi into four thick slices, and place slices on cookie sheets. Top each piece with 2 tablespoons of smoked olive. Sprinkle with onion salt to taste. Cover with a layer of sliced smoked veal slices, and top with 1/2 cup chopped onion. Top with a layer of smoked smoked smoked pork sausage. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until fish is easily flaked with fork.

title: Macaroni and Pork
ingredients: sliced macaroni cheese | 1 lb ground pork butt | 2 teaspoons flour | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Brown pork.

title: Nuclear Banana Soup
ingredients: 4 banana, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon roasted sazon goya seasoning | 1 quart buttermilk | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Cut bananas into chunks, and put in a sauce pan with the tamarind paste. Add enough buttermilk to cover the bananas, and bring to a boil. Add the sazon goya seasoning, cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Then stir in the dried cranberries and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Cajun Seasoned Scallops
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 -2 teaspoon cajun seasoning, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat over high heat for 2 minutes. Place scallops, one at a time, into the skillet. Sprinkle with seasoning, and cook 2 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: thyme honey,tarragon,chicken bouillon cube,margarine,coriander leaf,ice water,avocado
title: Avocado and Coriander Soup (Avacodo Bogotano)
ingredients: 2 small avocados | 1 teaspoon tarragon | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme honey | 4 cups ice water | 2 -4 cloves crushed chicken bouillon cube | 1 -2 teaspoon dried coriander leaves | 1 -2 sprigs fresh tarragon
instructions: Mash the avocados with the tarragon and honey. Put in a bowl and add the water, bouillon, coriander, and tarragon. Serve, add a sprinkling of black pepper, if you wish.

title: Crispy Cucumber Sandwiches
ingredients: 8 slices canadian bacon | 1 large cucumber, peeled and sliced into 8 slices | 1 teaspoon seasoning ( to taste )
instructions: Wrap each slice of the canadian bacon around a half a cucumber slice, securing with a toothpick if necessary. Prepare the grill. When ready to use, lightly oil the grill grate. To eat, place a piece of bread on the grates, lightly toast the bread. If desired, spread 2 - 3 teaspoons of seasoned crumbs into the bread. Sprinkle each piece of toast the cucumber slice with the seasoned crumbs.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,chicken bouillon cube,sea salt,arborio rice,coconut milk,tahini,buttermilk
title: Mexican Style Rice - Arrachera
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 2 chicken bouillon cubes, preferably homemade and not commercially prepared | 1 cup canadian buttermilk | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | sea salt, to taste ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 cups arborio rice, uncooked ( i use the kind with wheat gluten in it which is far superior to rice ) | 2 -3 cups coconut milk
instructions: In a large saucepan, over medium heat, combine tahini, bouillon, buttermilk, italian seasoning, salt and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 2 hours. Meanwhile, cook arborio rice in 4 cups of water in 2 - 4 quart saucepan with about a tsp of salt. Pour rice into a colander, rinse under cold water and drain well.

Random Ingredients: meat,arborio rice,puff pastry,suet,peppercorn,szechuan peppercorn,green bean,vanilla sugar
title: Chinese Steamed Rice Balls With Meat (Pa You Sichuan)
ingredients: 200 g ground meat | 100 g shredded suet | 1 tablespoon roasted szechuan peppercorns | 50 g arborio rice or 50 g carnaroli rice, with about 2 cups of water | 50 g shredded green beans | 50 g frozen puff pastry, thawed ( half a block ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns, for sprinkling
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and make into small balls using your hands and rolling pin. Steam for about 30 minutes or until cooked through. Stir through a little vanilla sugar before serve for festive or afternoon tea. The meat should be fully cooked before serving, otherwise, add a little more peppercorns in their liquid.

title: Spicy Beef With Chilled White Beans
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, trimmed of all visible fat, and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup canned navy beans, rinsed, drained | 1 bottle low-fat plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for 2 hours, or overnight, to allow flavors to mesh. Thread beef onto metal skewers. Grill or broil over medium coals for 5 to 7 minutes, or until desired doneness.

title: Homemade Indian Sweet Fingers
ingredients: 1 cup ghee ( clarified butter ) or 1 cup vegetable oil | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Melt the butter or oil in a heavy skillet over high heat. When the foam subsides and the pan begins to smell fragrant, reduce heat to low and drop the ghee into the pan by the heaping tablespoonful. Shake the pan to make sure that all the ghee has seeped into the butter. When the ghee is a bit brown, about 45 seconds, toss in the salt and pepper. Remove from heat and keep warm in a closed container in a cool dark place.

title: Lemongrass Roll-Ups
ingredients: 4 cups shredded fat-free ricotta cheese | 12 slices deli ham, thin slices ( about 1/2-1/4 x 2 1/2-inches ) | 1 -2 tablespoon light onion powder | 2 teaspoons fresh lemongrass | 1 1/2 cups cooked spiral shaped pasta
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend ricotta into 1 1/2 cups chunky puree. Add ham, onion powder, and lemongrass and blend to mixture well.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,nigella seed,graham cracker crumb,fennel seed
title: Mexican Chiles Pie
ingredients: 10 ounces nigella seeds | 5 ounces fennel seeds | 8 ounces tomatoes and green chilies | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Dry off the nigella. Remove the outer dark skin from the nigella and place the nigella in the oven. While the oven is heating up, toast the fennel and fennel seed in a dry fry pan or fryer for 5 - 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Take the nigella out of the oven. While the fennel seeds are being toasting, place the tomatoes and chilies in a blender and process them. Spread a thin layer of oil and heat over low heat.

Random Ingredients: white bread,beef brisket,granny smith apple,vegetable,mustard powder,cider vinegar
title: Apple Corned Beef Brisket
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs fat free brisket | 1/2 lb raw vegetables | 4 slices white bread | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 4 granny smith apples, chopped
instructions: Cut brisket across the grain into about two equal pieces.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,nonfat plain yogurt,crookneck yellow squash,pork shoulder,coriander seed,confectioner ' sugar,chili pepper,italian seasoning
title: Moroccan Style Roast Pork With Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed, toasted | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/8 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon chili pepper, red seeded and minced | 2 teaspoons cornish flakes or 2 teaspoons crushed crookneck yellow squash | 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of fat | confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl stir together the soya sauce and coriander seeds. Toss the soy mixture with the yogurt, chilies, and seasonings. Place the pork in a roasting pan or on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Roast in the oven for 45 - 50 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 180 degrees f. Transfer the pork to a cutting board and cover loosely with foil to keep warm. Strain the juices through a fine mesh sieve and set aside. Add the reserved juices to the sauce and let sit until reduced. Meanwhile, place the crookneck squash in a roasting pan and top with the pork. Dust with confectioners' sugar. Bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 170 degrees f. Slice the pork crosswise on the diagonal and serve with the sauce.

title: American Lasagna With Beef
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs ground chuck | 1/2 lb part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Spray a 10 x 7 x 2 pan with cooking spray. Place beef in a medium size skillet. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper. Spray a large non stick frying pan with cooking spray. Add hamburger.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,sage leaf,dark brown sugar,italian herb seasoning,basmati rice
title: Jalapeno and Sweet Basil Rice
ingredients: 2 cups dry white basmati rice | 2 tablespoons packed dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | 8 fresh sage leaves, or more to taste | 1 fresh jalapeno chile, finely chopped, or to taste | 6 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian herb seasoning, or more to taste
instructions: Place rice and 2 - 3 tablespoons brown sugar in a large skillet. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons italian herb seasoning over the rice.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,rom tomato,pancetta,pecorino romano cheese,andouille sausage,american cheese,ramen noodle
title: Andouille Sausage Noodle Salad Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 ounces andouille sausages, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons light mayonnaise, divided | 2 ounces pancetta, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup shredded american cheese or 1/4 cup gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup shredded romano cheese | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chopped roma tomato ( optional ) | 12 english muffins, split in half | toasted pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Heat grill to medium high, using indirect heat. If using a gas grill, lightly spray grate with cooking spray. If using charcoal, turn off heat just before fire is ready. Prepare grill for direct heat cooking, on direct medium heat. Place sausages on grill rack.

title: Tomato Noodle Salad II
ingredients: 2 cans stewed tomatoes with juice | 4 ounces orange peel, drained | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 lb egg noodles | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente. Drain. Mix all ingredients. You may also add 1 - 2 tablespoons of cornstarch dissolved in 1/4 cup of juice depending on desired consistency and flavor preference or store covered in refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Chilled Fava Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs dried fava beans ( may substitute chickpeas ) | 1 green pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 3 teaspoons maggi seasoning ( may substitute other brands ) | 3 -4 teaspoons marsala wine ( to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large resealable plastic bag. Seal. Chill several hours, then remove the mixture from the refrigerator in 2 - 3 hours. Remove the top of the bag after chilling overnight. Remove all the air pockets before grilling.

title: Roast Beef and Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 australian beef sirloin steak | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh rosemary ( optional ) | 1 -2 ounce pumpkin, sliced into 3/4 or 1 -2 ounce winter squash, halved and deseeded and cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Trim excess fat from steak steak. Trim steak as required. Cut into 3/4 cubes. Combine remaining ingredients in roasting tin. Toss steak and vegetables with dressing. Season with salt and pepper to taste, if desired, and transfer to oven or to your own oven to heat oven. Bake for about 5 minutes or until cooked to desired liking.

title: Italian Parsley Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup italian-style dressing
instructions: Combine the parsley and dressing. Chill 1 - 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust pie,corn chip,tamarind pulp,rice wine,harissa
title: Tamarind Rice Crumb Dip (Tamarind Pie)
ingredients: 1 package pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie, thawed | 1 cup tamarind pulp | 1 tablespoon finely mined harissa ( or more or less to taste ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 pinch tamarind pulp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine the tamarind pulp, harissa, 1 tbsp rice wine, and a pinch of tamarind pulp in a food processor and mix until well blended. Press the rice mixture onto the bottom of the pie pan and top with the prepared crust. Sprinkle with a pinch each of salt. Bake at 350°f for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the juices evaporate clear.

title: Pork Sausage and Parsnips Jugo
ingredients: 12 large parsnips, peeled and halved lengthwise | 1 lb pork sausage | 2 cans canned whole green apples | pam cooking spray or lard
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut sausage lengthwise into four pieces. Spread out slices of pork sausage and parsnip on a greased baking sheet. Spray with pam or lard. Bake until all are lightly browned. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. After about 10 minutes, cut off and discard parsnips. Spray sausages with pam or lard spray. Place over low heat in a skillet. When it start to sizzle, remove from heat. Add apples, sausages, and apples to the skillet. Cook until apples begin to carmelize, about 8 minutes. This should take a few minutes over high heat. Fill jugo wrappers with meat mixture. Fold both sides and ends over meat mixture and pinch together with a fork. Place in a baking dish and bake for 10 minutes. Watch carefully. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: salt,apple juice,baking apple,grand marnier,bow tie pasta,oil,garbanzo bean,white wine
title: Beans and Baked Apples
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 8 cups sliced, peeled baking apples | 1 1/2 cups dry white wine | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional ) | 4 cups garbanzo beans | 6 cups apple juice, divided | 2 tablespoons salt | 1 pound bow tie pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush a 9x13 inch baking dish with oil.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,mustard powder,yellow bell pepper,margarine,beer,tomato green chilies,egg
title: Beef and Pepper Rings III
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground round | 1/2 cup chopped yellow bell peppers | 4 teaspoons prepared mustard powder | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can beer | 1 egg
instructions: In a large skillet, cook beef over medium heat until well browned. Add bell pepper, mustard and horseradish sauce.

title: Crispy Orange & Feta Quesadilla
ingredients: 4 tortillas | 1/2 small red capsicum, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons orange juice | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons parmesan, shredded
instructions: Tear tortillas into smaller pieces. Place in a small microwavable dish. Add capsicum and orange juice, mix thoroughly and microwave for about 2 minutes or until the capsicum is soft. Spread the mix evenly over the top and around the quesadilla base in a circle. Sprinkle feta over the top. Microwave for about one minute or until the feta is melted. Sprinkle with parmesan and serve hot.

title: Mint Puffs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence, vanilla flavoured ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes
instructions: Mix the cornstarch, vanilla, and parsley together until they are the texture of a light meal. Roll a tablespoon of the mixture into a small ball and coat the dough with the cornstarch. Repeat with remaining balls. Heat a non stick wok of nonstick frying oil until a drop of water sizzles on contact. Fry the balls, one at a time, until they are browned. Sprinkle on a little extra cinnamon, if desired. Allow to cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,cooking oil,beef mince,cajun seasoning,chocolate,asafoetida powder,picante sauce
title: Mini Risotto
ingredients: 300 g chinese beef mince | 1 1/2 tablespoons baking chocolate, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | 1 pinch asafoetida powder, to taste | 1 cup arborio rice | 2 teaspoons maggi seasoning or 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 300 ml picante sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/180f. Coat muffin tin with nonstick spray. Heat ghee in a frying pan over medium heat. Add beef and stir until it loses its pink colour. Add asafoetida and stir until beef changes colour. Add uncooked rice, stir in 2 tbsp of the maggi seasoning, pour mixture into a muffin tin and bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and pour picante on top of the risotto. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Curry Flavoured Oysters for Grilling and Steaming
ingredients: 8 oysters in oyster sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder, to taste
instructions: Place the oysters on a foil lined baking sheet and sprinkle over the curry powder. Leave to mature for 15 - 20 minutes or upto 12 hours. The curry powder can be stored for upto 2 days before use, but it is not meant to last longer than 2 weeks.

title: Baked-Stuffed (Mush) Tagine
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 200 g ground apple ( optional ) | 2 ripe bananas, peeled and coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sweet dried apricot jam ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 cup sunflower seeds, roasted | 1/2 cup apple juice, from the tin ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400f / 200c / gas. Place the eggplant on a baking tray, and prick with a fork twice, just to soften it. Turn it over halfway through to give the skin some colour. You want it slightly black, but not burned, and put it in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until the skins start to friat around the eggplant. This will be very important once you take it out of the oven. Remove the eggplant from the oven and cut it into cubes about 1 - ½ inch square across. Spread a tablespoon of apple jelly across the bottom of the tin, place half of the banana pieces, and half of the eggplant cubes on top. Sprinkle 1/4 of the cinnamon over all the slices. Put in the remaining banana and eggplant and the rest of the spices. Add the apple juice and stir to combine all the flavours, you should have a very sticky pulp.. Pour into an ovenproof dish, scatter with half of the roasted sunflower seeds and bake for 30 minutes at 400f / 220c / gas. This would be amazing with yoghurt on the side, as it was delicious as is, or with other low fat dips like yoghurt or low fat sour cream.

Random Ingredients: miso,mexican cheese,palm sugar,cabbage,seasoning mix,banana leaf,spring onion
title: Vegetable Samosas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons miso, paste with a little milk | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 1 lb ground round | 1/2 head cabbage, finely chopped | 4 spring onions, finely chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 24 banana leaves, torn out and dampted
instructions: For the filling, mix together miso paste with the palm sugar in a small bowl. Fry ground beef and cabbage, stirring continuously, for 2 minutes or until meat is no longer pink, breaking it up as it cooks. Cook in a non stick pan over medium heat for another 2 minutes, then stir through the spring onions. Stir in the miso paste and sugar mixture, season to taste and serve warm.

title: Spiced Orange Pepper (Nigerian)
ingredients: 2 large oranges bell peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil. Halve the orange bell peppers lengthwise and remove seeds. Cut each pepper lengthwise into 1/4 inch strips, and place pepper strips in foil lined glass baking dish. Bake peppers in preheated oven just until peppers are crisp, 4 to 5 minutes. Turn peppers several times as the tomatoes lose their shape. Remove foil, and continue to broil until peppers are crisp and slightly charred, 5 to 7 minutes. Sprinkle peppers with the turmeric and cumin. Place peppers on a serving plate, and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Spicy Cabbage kimchi
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups coarsely chopped cabbage kimchi, or more to taste | 2 1/4 cups coarsely chopped, leftover cooked turkey sausage | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 teaspoon instant coffee
instructions: Toss cabbage kimchi, turkey sausage, ketchup, cilantro, and instant coffee together in a bowl.

title: Tamagoyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 1 teaspoon dried onion powder | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 3 cardamom pods | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 1/2 teaspoons sherry
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well and add to sour cream until well blended.

title: Smoked Tempeh (Lebanese or Emirati)
ingredients: 1/2 lb smoked tempeh, diced | 1/2 lb smoked tempeh, diced | 1 tablespoon ground anise seed | 3 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 1/2 cup brown rice
instructions: Saute both together in small amount of oil. Add a few tablespoons of warm water if to salty level. Add rice and fry at high until bottom is dry, then lower heat and let simmer about ten minutes. Watch carefully after 10 minutes and don't burn it. It tastes bitter, salty, and bitter the longer i cook it to the right color for the taste, the softer the final product will be. Stir frequently throughout cooking.

Random Ingredients: juniper berry,red chile,mint leaf,tomato sauce,gruyere cheese,cod
title: Fried Cod With Chili Mint Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked cod ( or fish of your choice ) | 4 large fresh red chiles | 10 whole juniper berries | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint leaves | 1 jar tomato sauce | 1/2 lb gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Cut the chiles in half lengthwise and remove the stems and seeds. Slice chiles crosswise into rings. Cut a slit lengthwise into the center of each ring and stuff with half each of the chiles, the juniper berries, mint leaves, and tomato sauce. Grate the cheese over all the fish. Heat 2/3 water in a large saucepan and boil for a few minutes.

title: Baked Gyros
ingredients: 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 teaspoons tamari soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 english cucumber, cut into very thin strips
instructions: Preheat oven to in small bowl, mix ketchup and tamari. Rinse cucumber strips and pat dry. Arrange cucumber slices in a single layer in a glass 9x13 or 9x9 inch baking dish, sprinkle with ketchup mixture. Bake uncovered about 35 minutes or until cucumbers are lightly browned and tender.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,sea bass fillet,curd cottage cheese,beef brisket,tapioca starch,italian herb seasoning
title: Sea Bass and Corn Ceviche
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 package corned beef brisket, cut into 1-inch chunks | water to cover | 1 package small curd cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons tapioca starch | 6 lime wedges
instructions: Combine the italian herb seasoning and corned beef in a large saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer on the lowest setting until the corned beef is tender, about 45 minutes. Set the brisket to the side. Pour 1 cup of the hot water into a blender.

title: Cheaters Scottish Currant Quinoa Cake
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | 3 cups cooked quinoa | 1 can buttercotch schnapps | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1/2 - 3/4 cup currants | crackers ( optional ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup masala
instructions: Place dry cake mix in a bundt pan. Place quinoa in sauce pan with 1 1/2 cup of stock and the buttercotch schnapps and mix well. Add to your prepared cake mix and mix well,. Mix in currants and mix well. Preheat oven to 300°f. Grease a 9 inch springform pan. Pour mixture into pan and bake for one hour. Cool for 10 minutes.

title: Greek Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cubed | 2 tablespoons realemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place chicken in a large resealable plastic bag. Sprinkle with lemon juice, and top with allspice. Seal, and shake to coat. Refrigerate at least 1 hour, or overnight, to marinate. Skewer meat onto skewers. Grill on the preheated grill, basting as needed, 10 to 15 minutes, or to desired doneness.

title: Greek Yogurt and Spinach Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb pizza dough | 6 tablespoons greek yogurt ( plain yogurt not greek )
instructions: Heat your oven to 450 degrees f. Stretch the dough to fit any size pizza pan or pizza cutter. Bake for 10 minutes. Mix together the yogurt and spinach and divide among the 8 pizza crusts. Return pizza to oven for 3 - 5 minutes or until crust is well browned and cheese melted, and topping is crisp and golden brown.

title: Lemongrass Beer
ingredients: 2 stalks fresh lemongrass | 2 bottles belgian beer
instructions: Trim and thinly slice lemongrass. Pour beer into small pot and bring to boil. Add shredded lemongrass. Cover and remove from heat. Let brew overnight. The next day, punch down lemongrass and discard. Refrigerate 5 days, remove lemongrass. Pour beer into container, then refrigerate for 2 days.

title: Corn Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lean rump steak | 1 can sweet kernel corn | 1 large parsnip ( optional ) | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/2 cup calvados ( optional ) | 1/4 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Thaw out frozen chopped vegetables and cut meat into 1 inch cubes. Boil until tender, drain well. Toss vegetables with meat. Thaw whip topping & add to stew. Put in refrigerator to thaw for 2 - 3 hours. Mix 1/8 cup crumbled coconut with 2/3 cup of sour cream, if using, and pour over stew mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,celery salt,cooking oil,taco seasoning mix,dill weed,yucca root
title: Lily Kwantski's Tri-Colored Yucca Sweet-N-Hell Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 8 pieces uyucca root, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces ( japanese green turnip ) | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 1 tablespoon ground celery salt | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 8 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed according to package directions, lightly brushed with olive oil | 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add uyucca and cook uncovered until tender but still firm, about 1 minute. Drain in a colander and transfer to a bowl. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lime juice and uyucca to boiling water. Cook until tender but still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add celery salt, dill weed, and taco seasoning.

Random Ingredients: black pepper boursin cheese,garlic salt,baby bok choy,grape leaf,rice noodle
title: Garlic-Crusted Grap Leaves With Bok Choy (Noodle Salad)
ingredients: 1 bunch bok choy ( baby bok choy ) | 2 cups rice noodles ( i use whole wheat ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon cracked black pepper ( i use seasoned ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped grape leaves
instructions: Wash the bok choy under running water, drain and chop the leaves roughly into 1 1/2 cubes. Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Dip and wash the rice noodles until they are soft and drain any starch from the noodles using a fine mesh sieve. Place the noodles into a large bowl and combine with the bok choy, chopped bok choy and 1 teaspoon of the garlic salt. Stir to combine. Arrange the grape leaves over the top, then drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon of garlic salt. Cover and let sit for at least 10 minutes.

title: Sweet Raisin Wine
ingredients: 2 cups light raisins | 1 cup dark sweet white wine or 1 cup vermouth | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 -2 tablespoon currants
instructions: Combine raisins, wine, sugar and chili oil in a noncorrosive or glass bowl, cover, and set aside for at least 1 hour.

title: Pepperjack Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cups apricot preserves | 3 medium ripe pears, peeled, cored and cut into slices | 1 cup chunky salsa, or to taste
instructions: Preheat a baking sheet with a rack in the middle of the oven. Spread apricot preserves over the bottom of a 9x9 inch baking dish. Top with pears. Place baking dish on the oven rack. Pour 1 cup chunky salsa over pears. Return to oven and cook until pears are tender, about 20 minutes, adding more chunky salsa as needed.

title: Spicy Chocolate Stashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 box pasta ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/3 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a pot of boiling water, boil potatoes, stirring occasionally, until just tender. Drain potatoes and return to pot. Set aside to cool slightly. Then peel potatoes and cut into 1/2 inch slices. In a large skillet, heat coconut oil over medium heat and stir in potatoes and potato starch. Cook and stir 3 minutes, or until slightly thickened. Place potatoes in a buttered 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Dot potatoes with chocolate pieces. Heat 1 minute or until chocolate is melted and chocolate is slightly hot and bubbly. Pour hot chocolate over potatoes and top with remaining 1/2 to 1 tablespoon of chocolate. Bake 1 to 1 - ¾ hours.

title: Cherry Smash
ingredients: 1/4 cup cilantro, chopped | 5 teaspoons cherry or 5 teaspoons grape tomatoes, halved | 4 1/4 teaspoons lime wedges
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Keep refrigerated.

title: Mango and Swiss Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 3 mangoes ( ripe mangoes can be use ) | 1 banana, thinly sliced ( banana should ben't be sweet ) | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 6 ice cubes, crushed | 1 pinch saffron | 4 tablespoons pure chocolate-covered espresso beans or 4 tablespoons milk | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 pinch grated swiss cheese ( optional )
instructions: Peel and cut mangoes into chunks. Slice banana thinly then place into fondue pot or fondue pot. Add chopped mangoes and chopped onion to pot and continue cooking on low heat until mangoes are very tender. Add crushed ice cubes to mix. Stir in saffron. When cheese melts. Transfer mixture to fondue pot and stir well. Add pure chocolate covered espresso beans or milk. Turn heat on fondue pot and bring to medium simmer. When warm, ladle immediately into bowls. Sprinkle grated swiss cheese on top.

title: Noodle Pakoda
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1/2 teaspoon smoked turmeric | 1 teaspoon minced thyme leaves or 1 teaspoon dill ( coriander ) | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 -2 tablespoon plain flour | 100 g noodles ( optional )
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients, and roll the pakoda mixture into golf balls. Fry them in a little oil until golden brown.

title: Artichoke-Turnip Soup
ingredients: 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and drained | 5 turnips, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Place thawed artichoke hearts into a saucepan, and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside to cool. Drain all of the liquid from the can, but be careful to retain about 2 cups. Place the thawed turnip chunks in your vegetable broth, and cook for an hour, or until tender. Ladle the broth over the hot turnip cubes.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,sesame seed,canola oil,habanero pepper,cake flour,cheddar cheese
title: Habanero Sesame Bites
ingredients: 2/3 cup cake flour | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 habanero pepper, minced | 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese, grated | 1 1/2 cups rice wine | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat broiler on high. Oil a cookie sheet. Sift flour into a large bowl. Add canola oil and minced habanero and mix to combine. Add rice wine and mix well. Add half of mixture to the bowl and blend until it's all incorporated. Add half of the cheese and mix thoroughly. Repeat with the rest of the mixture. Form the bites into the size patties you would like. If you are making the glaze, add some cornflake crumbs to the cookie sheet to prevent sticking. Cook in preheated oven on broil until golden brown on the edges, about 8 - 9 minutes.

title: Aussie Yogurt With Berry Stuffing
ingredients: 5 ripe blackberries | 250 g rolled oats | 2 large chipotle chile peppers, chopped | 3 tablespoons freshly squeezed orange juice | 50 g hazelnuts
instructions: Place the blackberries, oats, and chipotle pepper in a food processor and pulse until the oats are well mixed and broken up into a ball of fine breadcrumbs. Stir the orange and hazelnuts through the bowl and serve.

title: English Sticky Date Cookies and Shallots
ingredients: 225 g plain flour | 225 g dates, stoned and finely chopped | 150 shallots, peeled and finely chopped
instructions: Sticky dates, stoned and finely chopped place flour and shallots in a mixing bowl. Add dates, mix thoroughly to combine. Add enough water to produce a soft dough, about 250ml/1 1 3/4 cups. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead to achieve a smooth, elastic consistency. Divide dough into walnut sized balls and roll into flat discs. Cut discs into quarters and place on lightly greased oven trays. Bake in oven, about 10 minutes, until crisp and golden on top. Remove from oven and allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,green,kahlua,chili oil,chipotle pepper,french onion soup,cornflour
title: Mexican Green Salad - Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 cup kalamata olives, chopped | 1/4 cup green, chopped green olives | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon kahlua ( or to taste ) ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Drain the condensed soup. Combine the chopped green olives, olives, hot sauce, kahlua and cornflour together in a bowl. Just combine thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. This is to make a very creamy green dressing and to dip the vegetables into as a main dish.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,sauce,beef chuck,hot pepper,yellow onion,asparagus spear
title: Slow Cooker Pepper Jack Sandwich
ingredients: 1 pound lean boneless beef chuck, trimmed of fat and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups sliced yellow onions | 5 cups chicken broth, warmed | 1 tablespoon steak sauce ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | 1 package fresh asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Cook beef, onions, chicken broth, and steak sauce until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain any accumulated juices. Stir in hot pepper sauce until heat through. Serve over hot cooked asparagus.

title: Quick and Easy Spicy Beef and Pasta
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash | 1/2 lb boneless sirloin, cut bite sized
instructions: Wash spaghetti and squash. Slice beef 1/2 inch long, 1 1/2 inches wide. Place on foil lined sheet pan and cook over low heat about 10 minutes, or until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Scallops in a Creamy, Cold Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb large scallops or 1 lb other large scallops | 1 cup cold water | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: In a bowl, mix together, scallops, salt, and 1 cup cold water. In a large skillet, heat 1/2 the olive oil.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,chili powder,beef tenderloin,vermicelli,cumin powder,flour,pizza dough,phyllo pastry
title: Beef Fillet Parcels
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup flour | 1/4 cup vermicelli, broken in pieces | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground chili powder | 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 6 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut tenderloin into 1/4 slices. Place flour on plate in a zigzag pattern. Season beef with salt, cumin and chili powder. Place beef on flour coated surface, pressing in flour.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,wild rice,basil leaf,passion fruit pulp,mexican cheese,blade steak,curry powder,poultry seasoning
title: Mixed Round Steak With Warm Corn Dip
ingredients: 4 round steaks | 1 can sweet whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can sweet whole kernel corn, drained | 1/3 cup fresh passion fruit pulp, drained and chopped | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/3 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 cup fresh wild rice, cooked according to package directions
instructions: In a 12 inch skillet, or individual ramekins, combine corn, passion fruit pulp, curry powder, and 1/4 teaspoons curry powder. Heat on high 3 - 4 minutes, until hot and bubbly. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,egg beater substitute,cumin powder,mustard powder
title: Egg Beaters Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 -2 teaspoon dried mustard powder | 1 can button mushrooms
instructions: Place all ingredients in the bowl of a food processor and whir until well mixed. Add more or less mustard and cumin if required. If you add too much, the egg whites will become frothy. Place mushrooms on top and stir to coat with seasonings. Enjoy.

title: Le Nicoise Potato Salad
ingredients: 12 large potatoes, unpeeled | 1/2 lemon pepper | 4 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 small heads boston lettuce, torn into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut potatoes lengthwise into quarters.

title: Wasabi Cabbage and Fried Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 heads cabbage, cored | 1 head cabbage, cored | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste, or to taste | 2 cups frozen cauliflower, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Stir the head of cabbage, cored and sliced, into the boiling water.

title: Pineapple Turnips
ingredients: 2 pounds small turnips, peeled and sliced into thin half moons | 3 cups water | 1 cup pineapple juice | 2 fresh kaffir lime leaves, torn | 1/2 fresh ginger root, sliced | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Place the turnips and water in a skillet, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Stir in the pineapple juice, lime leaves, ginger, and turmeric.

title: Adzuki Beans with Tomatoes and Salami (Adzuki Beans Con Salami)
ingredients: 1 lb adzuki beans, soaked overnight and drained | 1/2 lb salami, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Cook the adzuki beans in boiling water until they are tender, about 45 mins or so. Drain and transfer to a large saucepan. Add the salami and thyme, stir well. Cover the saucepan and cook over medium heat until the salami is hot, about 10 minutes. Remove the cover, increase heat to high and boil rapidly for 2 minutes. Transfer the adzuki beans and salami to a serving dish and serve immediately.

title: Szechuan Pork and Noodle With Sherry Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups low-fat plain yogurt | 3/4 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 lb lean pork, cubed | 7 tablespoons sherry wine ( optional )
instructions: In a serving bowl, combine 3/4 cup plain yogurt, 3/4 cup of nonfat plain yogurt and pork. Season with sherry, if desired. Serve over cooked egg noodles.

title: Cornflake Crisp
ingredients: 1 pint corn flakes | 1 tablespoon curry | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 cup dates ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pack in wax paper lined 9x13 pan, waxed paper covered with foil. Bake at 350f 15 - 20 minutes or until crisp and golden.

title: Mashed Potatoes With Habanero Peppers
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, peeled and cut in half | 1 habanero pepper, halved lengthwise
instructions: Line a baking sheet with foil. Place the potato halves cut side down. Spray with cooking spray. Cover with plastic wrap and cut into chunks. Wrap the whole pepper inside the potatoes.

title: Sea Scallops With Dijon Honey Mustard Mango Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup mango | 1/2 cup vegetable stock or 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 tablespoon fresh sage, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh ground pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 ounces sea scallops
instructions: Boil or steam salted water for 2 minutes. Drain and keep warm. Combine the rest of the ingredients except the scallops. Sauté on high heat for 2 minutes, stirring. Dip the scallops in the horseradish and arrange on top of salad. Serve with the mango gravy.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,beef chuck,enchilada sauce,cheddar monterey jack cheese,baking soda,plum tomato
title: Kiwi Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of fat ( or sirlion ) | 4 medium tomatoes, chopped ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 cup sweet baking soda | 2 kiwi fruits | 2 tablespoons instant enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup grated low-fat cheddar and monterey jack cheese blend
instructions: Place the beef chuck in a large plastic zip top bag and sprinkle with the baking soda. Toss to coat and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. In a large dutch oven, combine the tomatoes, sweet potato and kiwi. Cover and cook over medium heat for 45 minutes or until the kiwis are tender. Stir in the enchilada sauce and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the cheese.

title: Cashew Sweet
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground cashews | 1 cup chilled coffee | 1 cup dried fruits
instructions: Grind cashews and coffee together in a food processor or spice grinder. If desired, add candied fruits to spice grinding in a small bowl. If using a coffee grinder, add mixture in small increments, processing after each addition until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Grilled Peppers Stacks
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, diced | 4 large yellow peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded ( preferably a mixture of red and green peppers )
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat, cook the bacon until browned and crisp, about 10 minutes. Remove to paper towel lined plate, drain.

Random Ingredients: pecan,sultana,baby red potato,garbanzo bean,adobo sauce,canadian bacon,szechuan peppercorn
title: Potato and Canela Salad
ingredients: 4 lbs baby red potatoes, peeled and quartered | 4 cans garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup sichuan peppercorns | 4 slices canadian bacon ( or canadian bacon bits ) | 2 tablespoons pecan pieces | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce ( or chipotle sauce )
instructions: Combine potatoes, beans, peppercorns, pecan pieces, and bacon bits in a large bowl. Pour over salad dressing and toss well. Serve cool.

title: Easy French Bread
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white beans | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 loaf frozen bread ( i use my bread tender holiday bread )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut frozen bread into bite sized pieces and put them into a bowl. Toast bread in oven for about 12 minutes then drain any oil. This can be heated to 180 165°f. Add the beans to the bread bits and toss until combined. Then add the garlic salt and mix. Bake for 15 minutes or until crispy. Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,lime zest,cooking sherry,great northern bean,apple juice,cooking oil
title: Chili Beans With Apple (Baraonda Pazuelas)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/2 cup chopped peeled apple ( about 1 cup ) | 1 tablespoon minced red chili pepper | 2 cans great northern beans, drained and rinsed ( or kidney beans ) | 2 tablespoons lime zest, finely grated | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/3 cup apple juice, from canned beans
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 2 1/2 quart heavy pot, except the cooking oil, and bring to a boil over moderate heat. Simmer until the beans are just tender, about 25 minutes. Pour off any excess bean liquid and stir in the cooking oil. Sprinkle with the zest and serve with warm bread.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,pimiento,black pepper,chicken bouillon cube,horseradish,cake flour,half
title: Hungarian Goulash
ingredients: 1 lb cake flour, and bread crumbs mix | 1 tablespoon horseradish, grated | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 2 teaspoons allspice berry | 1 teaspoon chopped pimiento | 1 teaspoon cracked black pepper | 1 -2 chicken bouillon cube, depending on size jar jar, and water used
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Mix well until a soft, moist ball forms. If you have leftovers, they will last in cool place.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,crescent dinner,baby spinach,shallot,black olive,channa dal
title: Indian Spinach Calzones
ingredients: 1 italian scissor-o dried dal | 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 2 cans baby spinach, drained and squeezed dry | 2 ounces sliced black olives, drained | 1/2 cup chopped shallot | 1/2 cup chopped italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place dal in a large baking dish with water to cover. Bake dal in the preheated oven until lentils are tender, about 40 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and mash dal to a thick paste with a fork. Lay crescents on a baking sheet. Separate dough into 6 flat triangles. Place 1/6 of the spinach, olives and shallots in the center of each triangle and top with about 1 tablespoon of the lentils mixture. Gently fold corners of dough in half to seal. Fold in remaining dough.

title: Barbecue Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 1 rack of lamb, with bone | 1 1/4 cups prepared yellow mustard | 1 cup hot sauce
instructions: Trim excess fat from lamb. Place lamb rack skin side up, in a shallow glass dish.

title: Creamy Rice With Serrano Peppers
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 2/3 cup whipping cream or 2/3 cup sour cream, chilled
instructions: Place rice in a sieve and wash under running water, separating grains with a sieve. Return to a saucepan and add pepper and cream. Cover and cook over medium heat until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, about 25 minutes.

title: Nestle's Chile Pepper Enclose
ingredients: 6 chile peppers, finely chopped | 1 cup minced anaheim chile pepper
instructions: Place chile peppers into a sealable plastic bag and set aside at room temperature for 24 hours. In a medium size bowl, stir together the anaheim chile peppers, minced chile peppers and minced chile pepper. Remove the sealable plastic bag from the refrigerator and rub mixture into the chile pepper mixture all over and away from the peppers and allow to dry in the refrigerator approximately 12 hours, shaking the bag occasionally to coat the peppers with the mixture.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,maple syrup,chinese five spice powder,teriyaki sauce,cheese,pumpkin puree
title: Crock Pot Teriyaki Beef
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steaks ( sliced into thin strips ) or 1 lb sirloin steak ( sliced into thin strips ) | 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Put sliced sirloin in bottom of crock pot. Then add 1/2 cup beef stock and the rest of the beef ingredients to crock pot. Set for 4 hours or on high for about 8 hours.. Serve over rice and enjoy.

title: Potato Pizza Dip and Chips
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 4 cups mashed potato flakes ( about 24 small ) | 4 cups shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Spread the tomato sauce into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread potato flakes evenly over the surface of the tomato sauce. Place baking dish into the oven and roast until the potato flakes are golden, about 20 minutes. Spread the shredded cheese over the potato flakes and spread until the cheese is melted. Serve the pizza hot from the baking dish.

title: Tropical Sushi
ingredients: topping : | 1 nori, toenji ( seaweed ), cut into strips | 1/2 cup dried coconut flakes | 1/4 teaspoon dried maraschino cherries | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | confectioners'sugar : | 1 orange, thinly sliced, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Soak the nori strips in a large pot of warm water, about 2 minutes, then drain. Cut strips into 2 inch strips. Mix the nori and coconut flakes together in a bowl and stir in the cherries, tarragon, and orange slices.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,chili powder,snow pea,black olive,phyllo pastry
title: Veggie Phyllo Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh snow pea or 1 lb thawed frozen peas | 1/4 lb phyllo pastry sheet | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped black olives | 2 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place thawed peas in a colander and remove as much liquid as possible. Drain, then cook or steam until crisp tender. Drain well. Slice phyllo sheets crosswise into quarters, then cut diagonally into thirds. Spread each piece with 1 t melted butter or margarine, then sprinkle with 1 t of the soy sauce, black olives and chili powder. Top with 1/2 t of the snow peas and 1 t each of the soy sauce, black olives and chili powder. Layer remaining phyllo sheets onto a baking sheet or parchment paper, then top with butter and more soy sauce. Bake, covered, for 15 minutes or until crisp and golden.

title: Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings | 4 garlic cloves, crushed
instructions: Place wings in pan, cover with water. Bring to simmer over medium heat and cook until chicken is tender. Place in slow cooker. Add 6 cloves whole garlic cloves to slow cooker. Simmer on low for at least 1 hour.

title: Semolina Prawns
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 1 tablespoon semolina flour ( besan ) | 1/2 teaspoon bottled hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place the rice into a colander and rinse it well until the water runs clear. Cover with water and leave to soak 15 minutes. Rinse in a bowl and drain. Place the semolina flour in a bowl. Dredge 4 prawns in this and set aside. Bring some water to a slow boil. In a separate pan, heat 1 tbsps. Of oil. Drop prawns into the hot mixture and cook, turning quickly until done. Serve with a dipping sauce such as ketchup.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,parmesan cheese,green cardamom,cinnamon,tomato green chilies,cider vinegar,kielbasa,icing sugar
title: Sausage and Broccoli
ingredients: 4 teaspoons icing sugar | 1 3/4 kg sausage ( kielbasa, can use more if you're fond of it ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons chopped canned tomatoes with green chilies | 125 g broccoli, cut into florets | 5 green cardamoms ( optional ) | grated parmesan cheese, to serve
instructions: Cut sausage up into 1cm pieces and sprinkle with icing sugar. Heat a large, heavy based wok over medium high heat. Cook until golden brown, stirring often. Stir in the cinnamon and transfer to a bowl. In the same wok, warm vinegar, tomatoes and chilies. Add sausage and stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes. Add broccoli.

title: Easy Orange Peel and Cocoa
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon orange peel, finely grated peel | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Cover with a film of oil, sealing it tight. Store in a cool, dark place for 3 days. Use as a facial scrub, charm for a coffee cup, as a facial scrub, or as an ice cream. It will keep forever to age.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,phyllo pastry,pasta shell,tortilla,sharp cheddar cheese,nut,vanilla bean,rice noodle
title: Phyllo-Wrapped Noodle Casserole With Chili-Noodles
ingredients: 2 jars chili sauce | 8 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed ( approx. 20 sheets ) | 12 ounces medium pasta shells, cooked | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup cooked rice noodles ( or other'vegetable/noodle ', your choice! ) | 1/2 cup chopped nuts ( optional ) | 1/4 cup vanilla bean, split lengthwise and scraped ( optional ) | 2 -3 cups crispy tortillas, cut into strips and toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Prepare chili sauce by whisking together chili sauce, seafood seasoning, and vanilla bean in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Simmer, uncovered, for about 40 minutes or until thickened. Remove from heat and set aside. Remove phyllo from refrigerator and defrost in refrigerator for 10 minutes. Heat oven to 425°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Unroll phyllo dough and transfer to parchment paper lined baking sheet. Cut sheets into 13 x 9 inch sheets. Using your 3x9 inch baking sheet, stack 5 sheets individually until all sheets are used. Place 2 sheets of phyllo on top of each other. Repeat with the remaining five sheets and 7 sheets of phyllo. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of shredded cheddar cheese on top of phyllo sheets. Sprinkle cooked noodles or rice noodles on top of cheddar cheese. Lay the remaining phyllo sheets on top of noodles and sprinkle with nuts if using. Pour chili sauce over noodles. Bake in center of oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until phyllo is puffy and lightly golden. Let it go a few minutes before slicing. Variation, instead of noodles, use noodles with meat and vegetables, or you can use rice noodles after adding the chili sauce. Variation, alternatively, you may use cooked egg noodles or rice noodles, or you can use cooked chicken breast breasts, or or any other seafood.

Random Ingredients: pea,hot sauce,buttermilk,red chili powder,mint leaf,corn tortilla chip,plain yogurt
title: Guilt-Free, Low-Fat, Low Cal
ingredients: 4 cups frozen peas ( defrosted ) | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt ( use only fat free, greek or non-fat or non-fat ) | 1/3 cup buttermilk | 1 pinch red chili powder | 2 teaspoons dried mint leaves, crushed | 8 low-fat corn tortilla chips | hot sauce
instructions: Toss the peas with the yoghurt, buttermilk, chili powder and mint leaves. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight for flavours to develop. Drain the peas. Toss with the corn and then top with the chips and a few drops of hot sauce.

title: Fruit Slice
ingredients: 6 cups rhubarb, diced | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup coarsely crushed cornflakes cereal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 9x9 inch baking dish with a damp cloth towel. Place the rhubarb, yellow bell pepper, and cornflakes in a large bowl along with the prepared pan. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and toss to evenly distribute.

Random Ingredients: carrot,pimiento,soy sauce,orange juice concentrate,chicken wing,beef tenderloin,yam
title: Beef Kabobs from the Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 3 medium carrots ( peeled ) | 2 medium yams | 1 can orange juice concentrate | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 jar sliced pimientos, well drained
instructions: Trim fat from beef and cut into chunks. Cut carrots in thin matchstick strips, lengthwise. Cut yams into large chunks. Cut up beef into chunks. Cut up shish kabobs. Mix all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,avocado,orange zest,button mushroom,cayenne,cumin powder,apple,chicken stock cube
title: Champinones Al Ajillo  (Stuffed Mushrooms)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 3 tablespoons orange zest | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 6 button mushrooms | 1 small red chili pepper ( small ) | 2 chicken stock cubes | 2 large avocados | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper ( small ) | 3 teaspoons apple cider
instructions: Clean and devein the mushrooms, removing the stems. Remove the seeds from the chilis, cut them in quarters and remove the membranes with a spoon. Slice into 1/4 inch pieces. Melt half the butter in a large frying pan. Stir in the chilis, stir fry for 2 minutes. Turn off the heat. Make a slit down the centre of the mushroom. Stuff with the chili slices and place in a serving dish. Peel the avocados, split them in half and carefully remove the stone in the middle. Place on top of the mushrooms and sprinkle with chili. Sprinkle with the cayenne. Add the remaining butter, the apple cider and mix well, then drizzle over the onions. Serve over roast chicken or pasta.

title: Italian Salsa
ingredients: 4 cups hot corn | 4 pepperoncini peppers
instructions: Chop pepperoncini peppers to desired size, place in food processor and pulse until finely chopped. Mix peppers, onion and corn in large bowl. Stir in other ingredients. Refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,strawberry,lime peel,walnut,hing,russet potato,superfine sugar,cumin seed
title: Fruity Strawberry Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, boiled peeled and cut into small dice | 3/4 cup dried strawberries | 3/4 cup chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 lime peel, grated | 1 tablespoon chopped crystallized ginger
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the potatoes and strawberries. Combine all of the remaining ingredients and toss.

title: Aunt Sharleen's Easy Blueberry Porridge-Pudding for the Microwave
ingredients: 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats or 1/4 cup regular oats | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cup frozen blueberries ( or other berries )
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl or glass bowl, combine the oats, cornstarch and blueberries. Add the cornstarch mixture. Mix well and microwave on high power for 1 minute. Using an inverted bowl or glass bowl, mix once more to combine. The porridge should get a little crispy. Turn the porridge onto a plate. Serve warm.

title: Banana Fruit Fizz
ingredients: 8 bananas, peeled and sliced | 4 kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced | 4 -6 tablespoons fruit juice ( kahratissa or sweet cooking sherry are nice in this )
instructions: Take the banana into a small bowl. Slice the kiwifruit in half lengthways, then slice each half into half again. Take out the centre part of the fruit, but leave the long ribs of the kiwifruit intact. Cut the fruit into small cubes. Stir in 1 tablespoon fruit juice, then coat each slice of banana with the glaze. Leave for about 10 minutes, or until the glaze sets and the banana has become tender. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: consomme,lemon juice,pumpkin puree,cranberry,amarula cream liqueur,cream chicken soup,ice,active yeast
title: Creamy Apricot Cranberry Pull-Apart Coffee Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 ounce active dry yeast | 1 can of condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 can pumpkin puree, undiluted | 1 envelope consomme, granular | 1 1/2 cups sour cream | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 1 package arula cream liqueur ( to taste ) | 1 cup canned cranberries, drained ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over 1 l. Soup can of undiluted soup and stir to blend. Stir in pumpkin puree, consommé, sour cream, lemon juice, liqeur and cranberries. Beat well. Pour into 2 quart flat bottomed casserole dish or a sprayed 8x8 pan. Cover tightly and allow to rise in a warm place for 20 minutes. To serve, allow to stand 10 minutes or until slightly risen. Slice to serve. Serve with lots of napkins.

title: Grated Jalapeno Chips (Use Pepper Jelly)
ingredients: 12 ounces jalapenos, finely chopped | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Spray the inside of a large nonstick skillet with nonstick vegetable spray. Combine the diced peppers and the dry crushed spices. Heat over medium heat until the peppers begin to caramelize, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and coat the bottom of the skillet with the cooking spray. When the skillet is coated with fat, quickly pour the mixture into the skillet. As soon as it is hot and bubbling hot, remove from heat and place in a serving dish. Using a spatula, cut or shred the hot dip into pieces.

title: Irish Mocha Mix
ingredients: 3/4 liter orange juice ( preferably organic ) or 3/4 liter lime juice ( preferably organic ) | 4 packets instant espresso powder | 2 tablespoons irish cream ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon cream ( optional ) | 1 ml msg, optional ( optional )
instructions: In a large jug, whisk together the orange juice, espresso powder powder and liqueur. Pour the powder mixture over the orange juice, stirring thoroughly. Place the lid on and store in a cool place for 3 - 4 days. Stir. Leave the mix in the dark place for up to 4 weeks.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,red chilies,bay seasoning,poblano chile,kitchen bouquet
title: Homemade Poblanos
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 1/2 cup kitchen bouquet | 2 fresh red chilies | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 2 -4 drops liquid smoke
instructions: Roast peppers on a grill pan under the broiler. Place peppers on a paper towel to cool completely. Remove ribs and seeds. Remove stem end and peel the blackened skin from the peppers. Slit the flesh lengthwise and remove the ribs and seeds. Cut poblanos lengthwise in half vertically and remove the ribs and seeds. Cut open and peel chiles, removing any seeds that are loose. Place the chiles in a dish until ready to use for cooking. Add the kitchen bouquet, red chilies, old bay seasoning and liquid smoke and stir. Refrigerate the poblanos for several hours or overnight. Heat oil in a large skillet. When hot, use an ice cream scoop to scoop the mixture into the hot poblano oil making sure to scrape off as much of the chiles as possible and to leave a small amount of the flesh at the bottom. Shake skillet occasionally to check that the poblanos are frying evenly, but not too often as they can burn very quickly. Cook until the poblanos are golden brown, a few minutes. Once brown, remove from skillet and allow to cool completely. Enjoy with salsa or with tortillas.

title: French Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup dried tarragon, crushed
