instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large salad dressing pan. Serve at least an hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: apple,green chili,mexican chocolate,baking soda,green cardamom pod,ranch dressing
title: Cheese Puffs (From the Cafe Rio)
ingredients: 1 small green cardamom pod | 3 green chili pods, split lengthwise | 1 small apple, sliced into four thin slices | 1/4 cup ranch dressing, to taste | 1/2 cup mexican chocolate, chopped ( or more ) | 1/3 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f. Place the cardomom pods and chile pods in a microwave safe bowl. Heat in the microwave for 30 seconds, stirring once, to warm the pods and chile. Pour the oil into an 8 square oven proof nonstick skillet. Arrange the apple slices in a single layer over the oil. Bake, in the oven, stirring now and then, for 5 - 10 minutes, or until the apple slices are golden. Remove from the oven and sprinkle the chips with the ranch dressing, chocolate or anything else that takes your fancy. Place under a preheated broiler just until the cheese is melted. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,flour tortilla,cucumber,caper,saffron thread,bread,hot sauce,onion soup mix
title: Tortillas De Atun
ingredients: 4 bread, cut in half, buttered | 1 small cucumber, sliced super thin ( if you hate cucumbers, you may use regular cucumber ) | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons capers, drained and chopped | 1/3 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon flour tortilla, cut into 1/4 inch strips
instructions: In a large bowl add all the ingredients except the crisper tortilla strips, and mix well. Place one of the strips of crisper tortilla strips on each of four plates. Top with two of the crisper tortilla strips. Then add 2 tablespoons of the vegetable mixture to the second side of each plate.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,red chili pepper,almond extract,beef,deli ham,bacon,date,prosciutto
title: Algerian Beef Braciole
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1/2 cup bacon, chopped | 1/8 cup sliced prosciutto, chopped | 1/8 cup fresh dates | 1/8 cup dried deli ham, chopped | 3/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/8 teaspoon black ground red chili pepper | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Heat skillet over medium high heat, cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon to drain on paper towel.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,grand marnier,serrano chilies,sharp cheddar cheese,grenadine,palm sugar
title: Chile Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 1/4 - 3 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon grenadine | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 2 tablespoons finely chopped serrano chilies ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Place cheese and grenadine in mixing bowl. Add grand marnier, chili and palm sugar. Mix gently but thoroughly by hand. Scoop onto a flat surface. Roll and shape into ball. Serve with crackers or as is for dipping.

Random Ingredients: egg white,flour tortilla,tahini,olive,coconut milk,dill,beef bouillon cube,part mozzarella cheese
title: Smothered Beef Burritos
ingredients: 2 eggs, beaten | 1 tablespoon olive | 1/3 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese or 1/3 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon tahini or 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1/4 cup low-fat coconut milk | 1/4 cup fresh dill, minced | 1 beef bouillon cube | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Lightly brush a nonstick skillet with olive oil or butter. Spread tortillas with the softened butter to absorb most of the butter. In a small bowl, combine ricotta, dill, and beef bouillon. Heat skillet over medium high heat on your stove top. When the skillet is hot add the beef. Spread the mozzarella cheese evenly over the meat. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese, the tahini and remaining 1/2 of the cheeses. Spoon the egg mixture over the cheese. Roll up each tortilla and place seam side down in a 9x13 baking dish. Pour remaining liquid evenly over all. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes longer or until golden.

title: Green Chili Pasties
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry ( or use your own homemade pastry, but the dough has a higher amount of mercury ) | 4 ounces canned diced green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Roll out the pastry to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut out circles with a 4 inch round cutter. Line each circle with 1/2 teaspoon of chili powder. Place on baking sheets lightly coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven for 8 minutes. Remove from oven and arrange green chilies on top. Return to oven for about 3 to 5 minutes until chili is crisp and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,maraschino cherry,red lentil,dark chocolate chip
title: Chocolate and Chilli-Dilafel
ingredients: 8 ounces dark chocolate chips | 14 ounces red lentils | 12 ounces canned diced tomatoes with green chilies | 3 maraschino cherries
instructions: Combine all ingredients and press into a greased baking dish. Cover with greaseproof paper and bake in the oven at 325 degrees for 30 - 40 minutes or until the dales have a lovely golden colour.

title: Cane Sugar Jam
ingredients: 16 cups sugar | 2 quarts unbleached cane sugar, drained ( one bag ) | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 3/4 cup amaretto | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice, drained
instructions: Melt the unbleached cane sugar in a heavy kettle. Add water and bring to a boil, stirring frequently. When it boils, reduce to a light simmer and cook until the dissolved sugar is clear. Do not stir until it reaches 305f on a candy thermometer. Remove from heat and strain through a fine mesh sieve into sterilized jars using a fine mesh strainer attached. This will catch and allow the candy to age for 24 months before it sets hard. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Turkish Delight
ingredients: 1 salmon fillets, skin removed | 4 -6 white mushrooms | 1 tablespoon lemonade | 1/2 cup turkish delight, spice for fish
instructions: Place fish in baking dish. Cover fish with lemonade and poke a few holes in the skin. Bake at 140c/fan 160c/gas 6 for 15minutes, or till fish flakes when tested with a fork. Take fish out of oven. Remove skin and cut flesh crosswise into thin slices. Place slices on plate. Place fish and turkish delight under the skin of the salmon. Mix spices together, pour dressing over fish and bake at 150°c/fan 140c/gas 7 for 10 - 15 minutes until fish is cooked.

title: Easy Canned Red Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half ( a little less ) | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Pour half and half into a 3 - 4 qt sauce pan or crockpot. Add the boullion. Stir to mix ingredients. The longer you leave it in the pot the better it becomes. You can store it in the refrigerator for several days, stirring occasionally until you've got the right consistancy. You can also boil it for a few minutes on the stove, but i prefer sitting it over low heat to keep the temperature low. You can serve it warm or cold, or cold is all you have to do.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,water,bread crumb,masa harina flour
title: Sweet Bread (Pinchi Ma Kano) (Pinchi Recipe)
ingredients: 2 lbs masa harina flour | 1/3 cup water | 2 whole green cardamom pods | 1 cup bread crumbs
instructions: Place the masa in a large bowl, and rub in the water till the consistency of rice flour. Stir in the cardamom pods until they float to the surface. Transfer the dough to a well floured surface, and knead, adding more water if necessary, till the dough is smooth. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes at room temperature. Meanwhile, make the syrup – heat the oven to 475 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Roll the dough out onto a floured surface, and cut into 2 inch sections. Transfer the pieces to the prepared baking sheet. Bake on the middle rack of the oven for 12 to 14 minutes, or till well browned. Serve as is, or cover and store in the refrigerator until served.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,green chili pepper,white onion,cream chicken soup,self rising flour,chipotle chile,chicken breast half
title: Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 - 1 cup finely chopped white onion | 1 bunch green chili pepper, coarsely chopped | 2 -3 canned chipotle chiles, seeded and finely chopped | 1 pint sour cream | 1 -2 cup self rising flour
instructions: Place the chicken in a bowl or a dutch oven or heavy duty foil covered bowl. In it, combine the soup, onion, green chili, chipotles and sour cream and stir until well combined. Spread the sour cream mixture over the chicken and then stir in the flour. Cover and simmer on low, stirring occasionally for 40 - 45 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,lettuce,tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce,rice,plain yogurt,rice wine vinegar
title: Chipotle Cauliflower Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked rice | 1 head cauliflower, sliced | 1 head lettuce, separated into leaves and hearts chopped | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon tabasco brand chipotle hot pepper sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large bowl or platter. Place in fridge to chill.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive,gingerroot,dark chocolate,cauliflower floret,quinoa,red chile pepper
title: Quinoa-Cooked Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/4 cup quinoa | 1 head cauliflower florets | 2 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot | 2 whole dried red chile peppers, crushed | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons spanish olives, chopped
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a small saucepan over high heat. Add quinoa and cover, reduce heat to medium low, and gently simmer until quinoa is tender and water is absorbed, about 15 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove leaves from cauliflower and cook in boiling water until tender. Drain. In a medium bowl, combine the quinoa, cauliflower, gingerroot, chili peppers, chocolate and olives. Stuff the mixture with the quinoa mixture, mounding it close to the rim. Place the stuffed cauliflower on a sheet pan that has been coated with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the quinoa is golden brown and everything is bubbly.

title: A Unique Indian Curry Paste
ingredients: 12 tablespoons curry paste ( i use my keema madras curry paste which is indian ) | 12 pieces gingerroot ( sliced thin )
instructions: First you have to cut the stems off of the garlic. Then slice them thin as you would a normal ginger. Wipe ginger with a clean cloth and rub the paste onto the cut surface of the garlic. Take a small pan and add 8 tbs. Of curry paste. Stir the paste until all the pieces are coated in paste. After 10 minutes, take it out of the pan after 5 minutes. Allow it to cool to room temperature. Once it has become cool, stir in the fresh cilantro leaves. Make sure that all the dry bits get covered. Cover and store in the refrigerator. You can use this on meat, salads, indian breads.

title: Spinach with Beef and Pimentos
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless round steak, cubed | 1 jar diced pimiento, drained | 1 package frozen chopped spinach
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the pimentos, spinach, and meat, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,shiitake mushroom,artichoke heart,ketjap manis,gouda cheese
title: Artichoke and Mushrooms Stuffed Mushrooms (Chokhaai)
ingredients: 4 dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 -2 tablespoon ketjap manis or 1 -2 tablespoon sesame paste | 2 teaspoons dark chocolate | 4 -8 artichoke hearts | 1/2 cup grated gouda cheese
instructions: Wash the mushrooms gently and gently place between paper towels. Use a small spoon to push the softened mushroom caps along the sides of the mushrooms. Remove the stems using the tip of a paring knife or a spoon. Place the mushroom caps on a plate lined with cheese. Place a mushroom in the center of the cheese. Dot the mushroom with the dark chocolate and fill with artichoke hearts. Place the filling over the filling, making sure all the mushrooms and artichoke hearts are covered with chocolate, pressing the edges together with the flat of your fingers. Wrap each mushroom with a slice of the cheese and a slice of the chokhaai.

title: Pixie Sinew
ingredients: 5 lbs pinto beans, soaked overnight | 1 lb turnip, peeled, cut in half lengthwise | 8 -10 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Pick over and wash the soaked beans thoroughly. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Add turnips, cook slowly, until tender, about 1 hour. Drain well. Place in a crockpot with kaffir lime leaves placed around the sides. Pour the hot water over the turnips. Cover and cook on high 3 - 5 hours. Note, you can use a pressure cooker instead of a regular pot. However, the taste is best after cooking for 1 - 2 hours. Beans can remain in the water mixture for up to 2 days. If using the regular pot, drain off the kaffir lime leaves.

title: Fava Bean Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces dried fava beans ( or 1kg frozen mixed fava beans ) | 3 cups chicken stock | 1 pinch saffron | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 -2 teaspoon dried mint leaves
instructions: Wash and drain the beans. Bring to a boil with 2 cups of stock. Add dried mint leaves. Dissolve the saffron in 1 tbsp hot water or half a cup of stock. Add to the soup and mix well.

title: Spicy Potato Salad With Chipotle
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds small new potatoes, scrubbed | 2 1/2 tablespoons dry fenugreek | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 chipotle peppers, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup bulgur
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Place potatoes in and cook for about 15 minutes or until tender. Drain and allow to cool slightly before peeling. Transfer to a large bowl. In a food processor, pulse the fenugreek and lime juice together and season with salt and white pepper. Add the chipotle pepper and puree until smooth. Stir in the cooled potatoes and pour dressing over.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,coconut milk,cherry tomato,ranch dressing mix
title: Quick Thai Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sweetened coconut milk | 2 tablespoons ranch dressing mix | 2 -3 teaspoons chili oil | 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Heat coconut milk and ranch dressing mix in medium saucepan over medium low heat stirring often until coconut is melted, and mixture is hot. Remove from heat, and stir in cherry tomatoes. Note, do not add oil yet, it may bubble up and burn. Let sit for 10 - 15 minutes to allow flavors to mingle.

title: Irish Cream Chowder (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 2 green onions, sliced | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 2 ounces dark chocolate, grated | 14 ounces half-and-half | 1/3 cup arish cream, chilled | 1/4 teaspoon chile, minced ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a 3 litre pot.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,brown mustard,liquid smoke flavoring,shallot,salmon,monterey jack cheese
title: Cauliflower With Smoked Fish Fondue
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 lb smoked salmon, sliced | 1/4 cup shallot, diced | 2 tablespoons brown mustard, dijon style preferred | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1/2 - 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded ( amount is for serving )
instructions: Peel the cauliflower and cauliflower and cut into large florets, with the core ends removed. Steam the cauliflower until tender, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, saute the salmon in a skillet with the shallots. When fish is done, drain on paper towels, and pat with paper towels. Add mustard to the fish mixture, and beat on low with a wooden spoon. Add the liquid smoke to the pan and warm until fragrant.. Add the cheese to the mixture, and stir to melt in the cheese. To serve, arrange cauliflower flakes on a platter.

title: Curried Beans with Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked spiral shaped pasta | 20 ounces firm fresh wax beans, rinsed | 2 bunches fresh curly-leaf curry paste, cut into thin strips | 1 cup canned yellow beans, rinsed to remove excess moisture
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Red-Beet Chips (Cooking Light)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine, warmed | 24 medium red beets, pared, cleaned but still in peel ( about 12 ounces total weight )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine the margarine and warm beets in a large bowl. Toss with the melted margarine. Divide the mixture between the 8 paper lined baking sheets, and spread out to an even thickness of about 1/8 inch. Bake until tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,chipotle powder,green cardamom pod,peanut oil,raisin,cherry tomato,epazote leaf
title: Patrician Prawns With Chipotle
ingredients: 1/2 lb shrimp | 2 -3 whole chipotle powder | 3 green cardamom pods | 4 sprigs epazote leaves, torn in half | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/4 cup peanuts oil | 4 medium prawns | 8 ounces sweet cherries tomato
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of oil in non stick skillet. Fry cardamon and salt to taste for about 1 minute. Add chipotle powder and fry for about 20 seconds. Add prawns, fry for about 2 minutes then add cherry tomatoes. Add epazote and raisins. Fry for about 5 minutes. Serve right away.

title: Fettuccini Regazzione
ingredients: 250 g fettuccini pasta | 6 ripe olives, sliced | 2 celery ribs, sliced | 125 ml malibu rum | 80 ml olive oil
instructions: Cook the fettuccini per instructions on the package, then drain and leave to cool. To create the dressing combine the olives, celery and rum in a small bow glass. Add the cooled fettuccini and olive oil and mix to combine. Chill and serve.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,adobo sauce chipotle pepper,vanilla bean,pepperoni,rotel tomato,beet,parsnip,chilies
title: Grilled Italian Beet and Peach Salad
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 2 -3 teaspoons chipotle peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo sauce from chipotle peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepperoni | 1 1/2 lbs mixed beets, peeled, sliced | 1 lb parsnip, peeled, cut in half lengthwise, then sliced on the diagonal | 1 can diced rotel tomatoes | 2 tablespoons fresh minced parsley
instructions: Heat grill to medium and spray with nonstick spray. Cut chipotle peppers in half and remove seeds and white membrane. Mix pepperoni, pepperoni, and ground pepperoni together and set aside. Prepare idaho platter or bbq to prepare salad. Arrange beets, parsnips, tomatoes and reserved pepper mixture decoratively on salad. Pour reserved pepper mixture on top of salad and serve right away.

title: Mom's Tasty Drumsticks
ingredients: 1 whole boneless chicken breast, rinsed, patted dry and cut into about 1-inch pieces | 1 jar
instructions: Poke holes all over the chicken with a fork, and push a cutout into each hole. Fill a saucepan with enough water to cover the chicken completely. Bring water to a boil, and stir in chicken pieces. Cover the pan, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about 30 minutes. Remove chicken pieces, and continue simmering until chicken is completely cooked, 30 to 40 minutes more. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. If the oil has not boiled off, stir in a couple of tablespoons of water until the temperature is right. Strain the chicken, and serve over rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,brown sugar,lemon,tamari,red pepper flake,zucchini,sirloin steak
title: Sizzling Spicy Lamb Broth
ingredients: 1 pound sirloin steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 lemon, juiced | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger root | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 cup freshly grated zucchini
instructions: Combine the sirloin, lemon juice, tamari, brown sugar, ginger, crushed red pepper, and zucchini in a large glass bowl. Allow to marinate in the refrigerator 5 to 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: red jalapeno chile,vegetable oil,cocoa powder,mussel,chipotle powder,cranberry
title: Baja Mussels
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons red jalapeno chiles | 1 1/2 teaspoons chipotle powder | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/3 cup dried cranberries | 1 1/2 lbs mussels
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cocoa powder, crushed chilies, and chipotle with oil. Add cobbberries and marinate 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,crouton,shiitake mushroom,monterey jack cheese,navy bean,salt black pepper
title: Spinach and Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups chopped shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 container sour cream or ( 1 cup ) container greek yogurt | 1 pinch salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 1 1/2 cups grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Drain mushrooms and reserve liquid and place them in a large bowl along with beans, sour cream and seasonings and mix until well combined. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Transfer bean mixture to baking dish and sprinkle with the 2 cups of each cheese and cover pan with aluminum foil. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until heated through and top is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,penne pasta,maple syrup,creme fraiche,graham cracker crumb,black mustard seed,chicken stock vegetable
title: Oriental Penne
ingredients: 150 g penne pasta | 1 cup reduced-sodium chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons cream or 2 tablespoons creme fraiche ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon oyster sauce | 1/8 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and set aside in a large bowl. In a small saucepan, combine stock, cream, maple syrup, oyster sauce and mustard seeds and heat until hot. Combine the pasta and sauce and stir well to combine. Sprinkle with crumbs and serve.

title: Homemade Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 7 cups milk | 1 cup tomato liquid from canned tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Bring milk to a boil, then mix in the tomato liquid and nutmeg. Stir for about 10 minutes to let the flavors meld. Allow to cool for about 15 minutes before adding more milk. Freeze in containers.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,steak,chicken thigh,italian salad dressing mix,jalapeno chile pepper
title: Crock Pot Chicken Scallops with Caribbean Flavored Scallops
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs ( about 2 1/2 pounds total weight ) | 4 large fresh jalapeno chile peppers ( seeded, membranes removed, minced or crushed ) | 1 package italian-style salad dressing mix | 2 lbs top round steaks, trimmed of visible fat and cut into 3/4 inch slices ( from two large, round bone-in, trimmed pieces ) | 1 1/2 lbs sea scallops, fresh
instructions: In slow cooker, combine chicken, jalapenos, and celery mix. Cover with 4 cups cold water. Cover.

title: Oven-Fried Beef and Herbs
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup fresh herb ( tarragon, basil, parsley and or or rosemary ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 2 bottles reduced-sodium broth ( any brand ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme, crushed, for topping
instructions: Spray 4 qt. Slow cooker with vegetable oil spray. Add meat and herbs to cooker. Add broth to slow cooker, and stir. Sprinkle thyme on top. Cover, and cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours until the meat is tender and falling apart.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,vegetable stock,rye flour,beef tenderloin,green enchilada sauce
title: Shredded Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 6 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 cans green enchilada sauce | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup italian seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons rye flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Trim fat from beef, and cut into about 3 inch cubes removing silver skin and silver skin if desired. Place into shallow baking pan. In small bowl, mix together enchilada sauce, broth, italian seasoning and rye flour, then add to liquid in pan. Cover and bake for one hour. Remove lid, turn meat and bake for another 30 - 40 minutes until meat thermometer reaches 125°f. Place on carving board and cover if desired.

title: Krautta Me Roula
ingredients: 500 g smoked sausage meat ( krakia pikovy, proscuitto or sausage ) | 2 -3 garlic cloves | 1 tablespoon dried apricot | 300 g krautta cheese or 300 g other tasty dry cheese | 1 1/2 - 2 cups corn
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 c, 400 f, gas mark 2/180 f. Put all the other ingredients in food processes, and mix well. Pour mix into a baking dish and bake for approximately 30 minutes or until cheese starts to melt and turn brown. Serve hot or cold with a salad.

title: Peach-French Toast
ingredients: 1 can chopped peaches | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth ( or chicken broth ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla wafer, crushed | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Combine peaches and broth in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Prepare crust of bread by lining a loaf pan with aluminum foil. Place bread over foil and grease to cover the loaf pan. Unwrap peaches and place the peach mixture on top of the bread. Dip bread in heated broth. Wrap pan with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Remove plastic wrap, remove plastic wrap and bake for 30 minutes at 350f.

title: Ham Pa Dutch Oven or Loaf
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs lean boneless ham | 24 ounces rice wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Wrap the ham with cotton and place in a baking dish. Rub the ham well with the rice wine. Pour the ham onto the rack in the pan. Turn the ham so that it has been saturated by the rice wine. Bake the ham in a preheated oven for 2 hours. Turn the ham over and continue cooking 30 minutes, basting occasionally. Remove the ham from the oven.

title: Kielbasa Dogs
ingredients: 1 pound kielbasa sausage ( mild or hot ) | 1/2 white onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon italian herb seasoning
instructions: Preheat broiler. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Grill kielbasa to desired doneness, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from heat. Stir onion into sausage. Sprinkle with italian herb seasoning. Serve hot.

title: Mark's Easy German Apple Salad
ingredients: 4 large tart apples, peeled, cored and sliced thin | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place apples in a salad bowl and sprinkle with red pepper flakes. Toss and serve in a bowl with crackers.

title: Moroccan Spiced Mackerel
ingredients: 1 large scotch boneless fish or 1 large flat fish, cut into 2 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon harissa | 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika or 1/2 teaspoon red chili flakes | 8 ounces mackerel, cut into 1/2 inch chunks
instructions: Place all ingredients except the fish in food processor, process untill puree forms. Using spatula press mixture into fish. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 3 days. Meanwhile, preheat grill or broiler. Grill fish 8 to 10 minutes or until fish is opaque and flakes easily when center of fish is pressed. Remove from grill and arrange in a shallow baking dish or bowl. Turn fish over several times for 5 minutes to brown other side. Serve with warm bread.

title: Nigella Lawson Strawberry and Chilli Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 small red cabbage, chopped | 2 cups strawberries, sliced | 2 cups broccoli, chopped | 1 tablespoon mixed dark molasses | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1/2 teaspoon coriander | 2 ounces wholemeal plain flour, preferably wholemeal | 8 corn tortillas, halved
instructions: Place the cabbage, strawberries, broccoli and chillies in a large bowl. In a small saucepan over medium high heat, combine the molasses, paprika and coriander. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring and adding a little water if the mixture boils. Bring to the boil, stirring and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside. Toss the tortillas in cold water for 5 minutes to prevent them from sticking to the base of the dish. Brush the skewers with a little of the molasses mixture, thread and secure with kitchen string. Heat a barbecue grill pan over medium high heat. Brush the skewers with the remaining molasses mixture and cook for 5 minutes on each side. Serve the skewers with the crispy bread and salad.

title: Mango Chutney Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup yellow onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the chutney, onion, and vinegar until the onion is completely coated with it. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Cock-Ahead Baked Potato Salad
ingredients: 8 potatoes, scrubbed | ice water | 4 ounces american cheese, grated | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, diced | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, diced | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, minced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the potatoes in a large saucepan. Fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil.

title: Pumpkin Con Carne
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can pumpkin puree, not pumpkin pie filling
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium saucepan. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,taco seasoning,cranberry,mint leaf,cumin seed,milk,baking powder
title: Napa Dave’s Rice Crumble  & Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice wine ( or white ) | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon whole cumin seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 1/4 cups skim milk ( or cream ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder | mint leaf ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f lightly spray a 1 1/2 quart, loose bottomed casserole dish or 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. In a small dish stir rice wine, cranberries, cumin and taco seasoning until well mixed and broken down. Stir in milk and baking powder until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, 5 - 10 minutes, stirring every now and then. Stir in mint leaves just before serving.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,mint,yellow bell pepper,pasta,pork tenderloin,yellow pepper,spinach leaf,spaghetti
title: Spinach and Ground Pork Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chopped fresh mint | 2 teaspoons ketchup | 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 1/3-inch cubes | 8 ounces uncooked spiral shaped pasta | 1 cup chopped fresh spinach leaves | 1/2 cup chopped yellow pepper | 1/2 cup chopped yellow bell pepper, if desired | 5 cups fresh spinach leaves, rinsed thoroughly | fresh tomato slices or crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mint and ketchup. Add pork, pasta, 1 cup spinach and yellow pepper. Toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 5 hours. To serve, garnish with remaining chopped spinach.

title: Moroccan Beef and Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, trimmed | 1 lb fresh spinach, trimmed, washed and chopped | 1 tablespoon cumin seed
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Cut steak into 4 equal pieces. Sprinkle cumin over both pieces and marinate steak in refrigerator at least 1 hour and up to 4 days. Preheat grill to high.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,cane sugar,chili,lump crabmeat,triple sec liqueur,english mustard powder,great northern bean
title: Dynamite Crab Diner Chili Beans
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans, drained | 1 teaspoon dried chili | 1 teaspoon dry white mustard powder | 3/4 cup triple sec liqueur, divided | 1 teaspoon italian-style seasoning | 1 teaspoon granulated unbleached cane sugar | 1 teaspoon english-style prepared mustard powder
instructions: Drain well rinsed beans well, return all beans with liquid to pan. Stir in chili powder, white mustard, 3/4 cup of the triple sec, italian style seasoning and sugar. Cover and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes. Stir and simmer for an extra minute. Remove from heat and stir in remaining 1/4 cup of triple sec, english style mustard powder. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Fantastic Chipotle Salsa
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups bottled salsa ( i like pace ) | 1 1/2 cups dried chipotle chiles | 1 bell pepper, minced
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth. Serve over your favorite tortilla chips, such as with sour cream, shredded lettuce, fresh tomato slices, etc.

Random Ingredients: frankfurter,steak,black pepper,rye flour,chicken soup base,mustard,potato flake,egg
title: Easy Elegant Cornish Beef Roll
ingredients: 1 lb lean brisket | 1 large potato flakes | 2 tablespoons rye flour | 1 teaspoon ground mustard | 3/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 envelope dry chicken soup base | 4 frankfurters, sliced | 3 eggs
instructions: Rinse brisket and pat dry. Pat dry with paper towels. Place brisket between two sheets of wax paper on a flat surface. Using damp hands, roll brisket 1/8 inch thick or thinner. With a slotted spoon, transfer brisket to a rimmed baking sheet. Cut brisket at an angle at 1 inch intervals. Cut potato flakes and rye flour into 1 inch pieces and place in a mixing bowl. Stir mustard, salt, ground black pepper mixture, and chicken soup base in a separate bowl until well combined. Pour 1 cup brisket mixture into the bowl with the dry flour mixture and gently push it through a meat grinder. Gather into a ball and knead it several times, using hands to keep it smooth. Repeat until mixture becomes difficult to work with, adding more of the remaining brisket mixture as needed. Place the coated brisket into a large non metal plastic bag. Tuck air pockets under brisket and seal bag. Place bag in a pan of cold water, and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Remove brisket from bag and place onto the prepared grill. Cook brisket on both sides for 7 to 10 minutes or until a meat thermometer reads 160 degrees f throughly. Serve rolled brisket topped with sliced frankfurters and a sprinkling of egg.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,worcestershire sauce,orange peel,spice,french dressing,puff pastry
title: Spicy Bites
ingredients: 1 ready rolled puff pastry sheet, thawed | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 small orange peel | 1/4 cup french dressing, approximately
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Place puff pastry sheet onto baking sheet and prick pastry with a fork twice, before cooking. Cut pastry into 48 squares. Cut orange peel into thin strips with a sharp knife, so the strips are about ½ inch apart. Mix together the worchestershire sauce, ketchup and mixed spice. Spread this mixture over pastry squares. Place the orange peel onto the bbq, and grill or broil the buns until the strips are slightly crisp. Place the hot beef and bbq strips on the bbq. Cook the beef until crispy and browned, and is done to your liking. Allow to stand for 5 minutes for pastry to absorb juices. To serve, immediately drizzle the spicy sauce mixture over the hot beef and bbq strips.

title: Pasta con Basilico (White Bean and Basil Soup)
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | salt to taste
instructions: Stir white beans, basil, and salt together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,fava bean,red curry paste,chili paste,wheat spaghetti,cauliflower floret,macadamia nut oil
title: Aussie Macadamia Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fava beans, chopped | 3 cloves cauliflower florets | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely grated | 2 tablespoons macadamia nut oil | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 200 g whole wheat spaghetti
instructions: Put the pasta in a large pot of salted water. Bring to the boil and then add the beans and cauliflower florets. Drain well. Place all the ingredients except for the macadamia nuts and curry paste in a bowl with a lid. In a hot, dry pan add the oil, and mix a few times. Add the chili and stir. Add the macadamia nuts and curry paste, stirring all the time. Cook briefly. When macadamia nuts are almost cooked through, stir into the salad in the bowl and stir through. Taste and season with salt or more red curry paste if you want. Serve and enjoy.

title: Pea-Banana Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup frozen peas, thawed | 2/3 cup sugar snap peas, trimmed | 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni | 1 banana, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook peas according to package directions. Rinse and snap peas with cold water.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,whipping cream,rice,basil leaf,sharp cheddar cheese,garlic
title: Cheddar & Garlic Sushi
ingredients: 6 cups finely grated sharp cheddar cheese ( about 6 cups ) | 2 -3 tablespoons garlic, minced | 1 1/4 cups whipping cream | 1 tablespoon poppy seed ( optional ) | 6 -8 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil leaves ( optional ) | rice or cooked rice
instructions: Line a baking sheet with foil, shiny side up, and set aside. In a bowl, lightly beat the garlic cloves with a spoon or the back of a large spoon. Add the cheese, stirring to combine. Add the whipping cream. Stir to incorporate. Then sprinkle the poppy seeds over the cheddar cheese mixture. Add the basil or other desired flavorings, using your discretion. Turn mixture into a dish, cover, and chill in the refrigerator about 30 minutes to 1 hour. Remove sushi from refrigerator and unmold onto a serving platter or cutting board. Serve immediately.

title: Zuppa Rei (Swiss Cheese Squares)
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated swiss cheese | 1 package egg substitute | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chervil or 2 tablespoons chives | 1 package sliced rapini
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Drain the cheese in a colander and set aside. Place the egg substitute and chervil in a saucepan and boil and thicken over moderate heat. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture down the center of a sheet of wax paper and cover the entire sheet. Place on a large baking sheet and brush with some of the egg substitute. Place the rapini in a wide, shallow pan and sprinkle with a little salt. Top with the remaining swiss cheese and cut slits in the top to create lattice marks. Bake the squares for 12 to 15 minutes or until the top is golden brown. Let cool for a few minutes on the sheet, then remove the wax paper and rapini from the baking sheet. Cut into squares.

title: Raisin and Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons seedless raisins | 1/4 lb cauliflower, cut into small florets | 1 small chinese cabbage or 1 small napa cabbage, broken into small pieces | 2 tablespoons liqueur | 1 tablespoon grain dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons dark seedless portuguese-style mustard
instructions: Toss cauliflower and cabbage with liqueur and mustard. Taste and add salt and pepper, if needed. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,bread machine yeast,basil,pork tenderloin,coffee,farfalle pasta
title: Pork Sandwich Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | coarsely chopped fresh basil | 1 pico de gallo ( hot pepper sauce ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons bread machine yeast | 2 cups farfalle pasta ( or use quick cook pasta of your choice ) | 1/4 cup strong coffee
instructions: First, preheat oven to 350°f. Place the pork tenderloins on a cutting board. Using a mallet or the flat end of a sharp knife, slice the tenderloins to thinness. Place the slices in a medium bowl and rub with a little salt. Spread the sliced meat onto the bread machine pan. Top with chopped basil and pico de gallo mix, then spread the farfalle pasta over the surface. Sprinkle with coffee. Close the lid and give the machine a quick whack. Insert a wooden pick inserted in the bread center to push air out of the farfalle. Bake in the middle of the oven for 30 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes. Cut into slices and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cocktail onion,salmon fillet,vegetable oil olive,romano cheese,cinnamon,cottage cheese
title: Salmon Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil ( olive oil may be substituted ) | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese ( or grated parmesan cheese ) | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 cup cooked cocktail onions, drained | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 lb salmon fillet ( about 1 inch thick )
instructions: Combine ingredients and spread mixture over salmon. Place one salmon fillet on top of the mixture and sprinkle top with additional grated romano. Place on a sheet tray and bake at 400°f for 20 minutes.

title: Pilaf with Meat
ingredients: 1 lb meat, sliced ( lamb, mutton, venison... ) | 1 lb chopped parsnips or 1 lb turnip | 2 lbs dried figs | 1 lb pear
instructions: Wash figs, pears and figs. Cook them until tender. Soak the figs in water and keep them covered. Drain figs, pat figs dry, put figs on top in a 9x13 inch pan. Bake in 350 degree oven for 60 minutes. Serve in shallow bowls and serve with salad.

title: Molho
ingredients: 2 lbs semi-sweet chocolate | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt ( to taste ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprig
instructions: In a double boiler, melt chocolate over but not touching low heat until it's just barely beginning to get warm and just beginning to bubble around the edges. Remove from heat and stir in salt and thyme. Pour into bowl and let cool to room temperature. Break away pieces of chocolate from the top of the bowl and put into a small plastic bag. Using a fork or a slotted spoon, swirl the mixture back and forth until it's shiny and hominy like, about 11x4 inches. Break back the chocolate and remove the bag. Let cool until hard and set, about 4 hours. Stoze any juice from the bag into a jar.

title: Kielbasa Wrapped in Spices
ingredients: 1 smoked kielbasa | 7 tablespoons black peppercorns
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rub kielbasa with black peppercorns. Place kielbasa on a roasting pan. Bake in the preheated oven 45 to 55 minutes, or until browned.

title: Endive and Endive Salad
ingredients: 2 heads belgian endive, outer leaves removed | 1 -2 teaspoon baharat
instructions: Wash and dry endive, and cut endive into bite sized pieces. Sprinkle with baharat.

title: Cabbage-Braised Pork Dinner (Schweizerau mit Osoletchen)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 2 lbs savoy cabbage, unpeeled, quartered
instructions: Put meat in roasting pan. Add enough water to cover meat completely. Bring to boil, skimming off scum. Add cabbage quarters, cover, and simmer over low hear about 1 hour or until meat and cabbage is tender. Remove meat and skim off fat that rises as it falls from the surface. Continue cooking cabbage over very low heat for a further 45 minutes or until meat is cooked. Pork should be done well in the middle.

title: Asparagus With Sweet Sugar
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs small fresh asparagus | 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar, plus a little extra ( preferably caster sugar )
instructions: Trim the asparagus and cut in 3 lengths by cutting diagonally at 2in or so. Cut them in half and set aside in a saucepan with plenty of cold water to boil over low heat. As soon as the asparagus starts to float to the surface, plunge them carefully into a cold bowl of ice cold water. Allow to cool slightly. Transfer the asparagus, cold water, sugar and 1 tablespoon of the extra sugar to a blender and process until smooth. Pour the glaze into a clean, dry jar or bowl and keep covered with a thin layer of film film of sugar for up to a week, shaking the jar daily to coat the asparagus with the glaze.

Random Ingredients: red bean paste,fish sauce,arborio rice,yellow pepper,brandy,basil leaf,feta cheese
title: Vegetable and Rice Gratin (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried arborio rice | 1/2 tablespoon yellow pepper, julienned | 1 tablespoon red beans paste, kahung ( thai red bean paste ) | 250 g arborio rice | 200 g red beans in oil, drained | 200 g feta cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon sake | 1 -2 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Place rice in the bottom of the rice cooker. Add all other ingredients and stir until rice is fully absorbed by all ingredients but arborio root ends up with water. Add the brandy or sake and stir. Set red bean paste to go on setting, leave to go on setting until all ingredients are cooked. Eat in your rice dish while it's still warm.

title: Ham-Sea Bass & Cured Beef
ingredients: 1 ham, thawed, chopped fine | 1 lb sea bass fillet or 1 lb salmon fillet, cleaned & cut into 3/4 inch slices | 1 1/2 cups mustard, preferably german, mustard, of your choice | 1/2 lb beef sirloin steak, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a small bowl mix the minced ham, fish, mustard & beef. Place in a greased shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish & cover with the prepared meat mixture. Bake for about 1 1/2 hours, basting now & then during the last 5 minutes with the bran mixture.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,guinness stout,tahini,vegetarian oyster sauce,spaghetti,onion soup mix,pasta,green chili pepper
title: Vegan Guinness Stew
ingredients: 2 cups guinness stout | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 can vegetarian oyster sauce | 1 can green chili peppers, chopped | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 1 lb of your favourite style spaghetti | 1 1/2 cups of your favourite spaghettini noodles or 1 1/2 cups your favorite pasta
instructions: In a 3 quart sauce pan that has been sprayed with pam, sauté onions and green peppers in olive oil then add other ingredients. Cook on low until done then reduce again and serve over hot spaghetti noodles.

title: Chocolate Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 lb cabbage | 1/2 cup finely shredded unsweetened chocolate ( or unsweetened cocoa ) | 3 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Shred or chop cabbage enough to feed 2 per person. Put in large shallow dish and cover with plastic wrap. Chill several hours. Break up with a fork or kitchen knife. When cold, stir in remaining ingredients. Serve either warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,red currant jelly,snow pea,date syrup,pork sparerib,lard,rice wine,meatball
title: Chinese Spareribs
ingredients: 2 lbs pork spareribs | 1 quart pork fat ( leftover pork fat ) | 1 cup pork fat, cut into chunks | 1 bottle red currant jelly | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 1 tablespoon light-colored rice syrup | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 7 ounces frozen meatballs, thawed | 1 tablespoon lard
instructions: Preheat oven to 1/2°c. Place spareribs in 13x9 pan. Pour pork fat over spareribs, reserving 2 tbsp of fat. Combine pork fat and reserved pork fat. Pour fat into baking dish, dot the spare ribs with lard and bake in oven for about 2 hours. Baste once or twice with fat every 15 minutes. To make syrup, pour pork fat into a saucepan. Add jelly and rice wine and bring to boil. Remove from heat, stir in jelly and remove from heat. To serve, slice pork spareribs, arrange on serving platter, cover with heated syrup and enjoy.

title: Apricot Pizza
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust ( i like boboli brand ) | 1/2 cup apricot, sliced with peel, toasted
instructions: Spread thinly sliced apricots on your favorite pizza crust. Sprinkle some sliced fresh fruit on top. Place your favorite toppings on the top of the crust. Use a fork so the pizza does not come off the crust edges or the fruit is exposed. Bake at 400°f for a minute or two until the crust edges are beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,chili paste,chicken wing,barley,pork tenderloin,spaghetti,mace,streaky bacon
title: Barley and Sausage With Barley
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin, trimmed of excess fat | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili paste | 150 150 g streaky bacon or 150 g streaky bacon | 2 teaspoons chopped chili paste | 2 teaspoons barley | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed mace or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chile | 1 serrano pepper, finely chopped | 1 cup barley or 1 cup redcurrant
instructions: Cut pork into cubes and place in a small baking dish. Sprinkle over chili paste and half the barley. Cover dish and bake at 180c until pork is tender and beginning to brown. Remove from oven and sprinkle with a little more barley. Meanwhile, cook bacon in a heavy based frying pan over medium high heat, stirring until crisp. Remove bacon from pan and set aside. Increase heat to high and add chili paste and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes. Add barley and remaining 1/2 cup barley and cook until barley is creamy and sticky. Pour barley mixture over pork and cook until heated through. Stir fry mace for 1 or 2 minutes, then transfer to a platter and let cool for 5 - 10 minutes. Divide mushrooms between 6 serving plates and then top with barley mixture and sliced chilli to serve.

title: Fruit Filled Couscous Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces couscous | mascarpone cheese or mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Add couscous in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high until steaming stops, approximately 20 seconds. Spread out a circle of plastic wrap in a 15 x 10 inch baking pan. Gently place the couscous on the plastic wrap and microwave on low power until the couscous is hot and beginning to swell, approximately 1 minute and 1/8 to 1/4 minutes. Immediately remove the wrap and mix in cheese. Top with a sprinkling of cracker crumbs. Mix again, until the cheese is melted.

title: Nesselrode Shortbread - Norway
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups butter or 1 1/2 cups margarine | 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Blend butter with sugar and milk, until creamy. Add almond extract. Mix well and shape into logs.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,chicken broth,grain white rice,pepper sauce
title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | 1 1/4 cups low-sodium chicken broth or 1 1/4 cups reduced-sodium turkey broth | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon minced fresh red chili pepper ( to taste )
instructions: In a small pot, bring broth to a boil. Add rice and salt and pepper.

title: Gurkensalat
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon white palm sugar | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 3 cups greek yogurt
instructions: Spread mustard seeds over a baking sheet and toast in a 200º oven until very lightly brown and fragrant, about 5 minutes.

title: Strawberry-Cherry Glaze
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh strawberries, cleaned and cleaned | 2 cups dark rum ( for the glaze )
instructions: Wash the strawberries, and cut off the tough tops. Put them in a wide pot or small bowl and cover with cold water. Soak, covered, over night. Add the rum to the strawberries and cover with cold water. Put the pot in a warm oven, and put it right into the oven on 325 degrees fahrenheit for 2 hours. Remove and discard the strawberries, but leave them there. Take out and allow to cool slightly before slicing. Serve with jelly or ice cream. Cherry glaze, put the strawberries in a large mixing bowl, and add the reserved rum. Mix well over the sink, making sure the liquid gets a good coating consistency.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,bacon,mexican chocolate,extra virgin olive oil,okra,merlot wine,tabasco sauce,butter
title: Buttered Chicken Wings With Okra
ingredients: 8 slices bacon | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 lb whole chicken wings ( about 12 ) or 1 lb chicken drumsticks ( about 12 ) | 1 cup merlot or 1 cup dry port | 1 -2 ounce mexican chocolate ( optional ) | 3 slices real bacon ( optional ) | 1 package frozen okra, thawed ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, at room temperature | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove and discard the thick ends of the bacon strips. Cut the bacon into 1 inch lengths and set aside. Place the oil in a large, deep skillet or heavy baking dish. Fry the chicken in the skillet over medium heat until golden brown, turning as needed. Remove and set chicken aside. Add the wine or port to the skillet and heat over medium high heat. Cook and stir until all of the beer has evaporated. Add the chicken back into the skillet and add the mexican chocolate if using. Cook and stir for 1/2 minute longer. Add the bacon, okra, butter, and tobasco and stir until chocolate has melted. Spoon the mixture into 4 large, heavy ovenproof dishes. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until chicken is tender and the sauce is slightly bubbly.

title: Corned Beef With Brandy Sauce #2
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket | 2 medium onions, cut in wedges | 1 can diced potatoes | 1/2 cup brandy | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | freshly ground coarse ground coarse salt and pepper
instructions: Place brisket in a large dutch oven. Add onions and the can of potatoes to the pot and saute over moderate heat for 15 - 20 minutes or until brisket is browned on all sides. Drain the fat and transfer brisket and potatoes to a platter. Deglaze the platter with brandy and pour over meat. Warming in the pot, the meat should be covered and moist. Place the platter into a heated oven and bake it covered for 1 hour remove meat and onions from the oven. Place the pan uncovered in a 325 degree f oven and bake until meat is fork tender, about 1 hour and 10 minutes. When meat is tender remove from pan and keep warm. Skim fat from sauce. Add cream to the sauce and heat over moderate heat for 10 minutes. Return the sliced brisket and onions to the pan and warm over moderate heat for 10 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,pesto sauce,chicken broth,green shrimp,catfish fillet,chicken thigh,espresso,red potato
title: Caribbean Glazed Chicken and Potatoes
ingredients: 6 lean boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 lb red potato, cut into 1/4-inch strips | 1 bag frozen green shrimp ( peeled, thawed ) | 1 cup brewed espresso ( i use strong white-infused espresso ) | 1/2 cup homemade pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons extra-strongresso ( adjust to taste ) | 32 ounces chicken broth | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley
instructions: Put everything into a large crock pot except the chicken. Stir on high until the potatoes turn a nice golden color, then set to high. Cook for 4 hours, stir, cover and cook until the chicken is cooked through, about 1 - 2 minutes more. Stir in the pesto and check for seasoning. Serve.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Pear Sauce
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks, filets 3 1/2 or 1 1/2 inches thick, 8 to 10 ounces total | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup bottled pear, drained and chopped, if desired
instructions: Rinse beef.

title: Overnight Herbed Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed dried herbs ( such as basil, parsley, chives, or savory, you choose ) | 1 head lettuce ( i use red leaf lettuce )
instructions: Wash and pat dry the lettuce. Chop into a fine chiffonade or into your blender. Put everything in a screw top jar with a tight lid, and shake until thoroughly mixed. Serve with bread, crackers, or crackers.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,prosciutto,maple syrup,dijon mustard,single pie crust,salad oil
title: Tomato Maple-Free Appetizers
ingredients: 1 single pie crust | 1 teaspoon salad oil | 2/3 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 150 g slices prosciutto, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped cherry tomatoes
instructions: Press pie crust over base and sides of a large drinking glass or pan. Prick well. Bake 400ºf oven for 10 minutes or until puffed and golden. Remove and transfer to a wire rack to cool. Meanwhile beat oil, maple syrup and mustard in a medium bowl until well blended. Add prosciutto and tomatoes. Remove crust from oven and spread mustard mixture over top of the pie crust. Replace it on top of the crumb topping. Return to oven and bake until topping is lightly golden.

title: Red Curry Egg Soup
ingredients: 2 large eggs | 1 tablespoon red curry paste, or more to taste | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 5 cups vegetable stock | 1 sprig fresh rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Beat eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt in the egg to make an egg wash.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,red pesto sauce,naan flat bread garlic,swiss cheese,ginger,bean sprout
title: Veggie Pesto Panini
ingredients: 8 naan flat bread ( i used roasted garlic bread for one sandwich ) | 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn | 1/2 cup canned small bean sprouts, drained and rinsed | 8 -10 slices swiss cheese ( i used 2 slices of swiss cheese per sandwich ) | 2 tablespoons red pesto sauce | 1/4 cup minced fresh ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 400º f. Spread pesto cheese on flat breads and toast. Layer all ingredients on bread. Heat in oven for 5 - 10 minutes until cheese melts, but not hard.

title: Roasted Garlic Anchovies for Two
ingredients: 1 bulb of garlic | 6 anchovy fillets ( packed in oil ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 loaf day-old baguette, toasted
instructions: Position a rack 6 inches from the broiler element and preheat the broiler. Cut off and discard ends of garlic. Separate the garlic cloves from their peel and halve lengthwise. With the tip of a sharp knife, press the cloves into crumb sized bits with your fingers. Sprinkle with the bouillon granules. Place the garlic on a baking sheet and broil, turning occasionally, for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned. Transfer the garlic to plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Cut away the hard bottom crust from the baguette and cut 1 diagonal slice on the top with a serrated bread knife. Arrange the slices on a baking sheet. Broil for 1 minute, until crisp and hot. Garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Sausage & Green Chillies
ingredients: 750 g sausage, of your choice, i used mild sausage | 3 tablespoons chopped onions | 150 g chopped tomatoes with green chilies, drained and chopped | 4 slices sourdough bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat the broiler, place the sausage on an oiled baking tray, leaving about 2cm/1 inch/2 inch/1/2 inch/dick. Place the in the oven for 20 - 25 mins, turning once. Remove from the oven, pour onto a plate. Place the onion in a saucepan with a touch of margarine, cooking over medium heat for about 5 mins, stirring occasionally, until softened. Stir in the tomatoes and chilli. Reheat briefly to warm through. Break up the sausage with a large spoon & pile them onto each slice of bread, sprinkle with the onions.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,salad oil,yellow mustard,vegetable,trout,ice,poultry seasoning,garlic
title: Baked Trout with Mustard and Garlic
ingredients: 1 head garlic, halved but not crushed | 4 tablespoons salad oil, divided | 1 pound shaved beef top sirloin steak | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 8 large radishes, sliced | 1/4 cup prepared yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 2 cups crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a small pot of water over the head of garlic in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,italian herb seasoning,green onion,ricotta cheese,caraway seed,soy sauce,coffee
title: Italian Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 2 teaspoons dried italian herb seasoning | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 cup shredded green onion | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 cup hot coffee
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, stir together the remaining ingredients and set aside. Pour cheese mixture into a large bowl and mix thoroughly to combine. Cover and chill overnight, or for about 2 hours.

title: Lamb Shank and Turnips
ingredients: 8 lamb shanks | 7 -8 turnips | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 can or bottle irish stout beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place lamb shanks, turnips, syrup, vinegar, and marjoram in a roasting pan, and cover with water. Bake uncovered for about 3 hours, basting frequently. Turn shanks once during cooking. Remove the shanks, and drain off any accumulated fat. Cut into halves and serve.

title: Spicy Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 7 ounces cherry tomatoes | 2 ounces unbleached white flour | 2 ounces mixed vegetables
instructions: Put cherry tomatoes in a pan of boiling water, and boil for at least 10 minutes, or until soft just. Drain and plunge into a bowl of yoghurt or sour cream. Add flour then coat tomatoes in the paste.

title: Mixed Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons currants | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 2 teaspoons dried red chili pepper | 1 teaspoon red pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 -3 radishes, chopped
instructions: Put currants, tomato purée, chilies and red pepper powder into a tea ball and blend well. Spoon 1/4 cup of hot liquid into a colander. Place vegetables into the colander. Cover and leave in a warm place until just cooked. Drain vegetables reserving liquid and serve with pita bread or basmati rice.

title: Armenian Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 4 large zucchini, cut in half lengthwise and then into 1/2 inch slices | 12 -16 small arborio rice or 12 -16 small other short-grain rice ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 10 pepperoncini peppers, drained and sliced ( garnish ) | 1 -2 teaspoon yellow mustard ( optional or up to 1/2 tsp, if desired )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Arrange zucchini in a single layer on a tray or roasting pan. Roast, stirring occasionally, until lightly colored on all sides, but not cooked through, about 20 minutes, rotating vegetables halfway through. Transfer vegetables to a large bowl with a slotted spoon and immediately cover with plastic wrap. Let stand at room temperature until cool, about 1 hour. Place 3 cups of the cooked rice in another large bowl and sprinkle with pepperoncini with a few pinches of the yellow mustard. Drain vegetables and transfer to the bowl of rice. Dot peppers over the top. Using the back of a spoon, lightly stir to mix in. Sprinkle on the more yellow mustard. Cover loosely and refrigerate vegetables, loosely covered, for about 24 hours. Remove from refrigerator 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Spicy Italian Sausages! (Grilled)
ingredients: 4 hot italian sausages ( about 1lb ) | 2 tablespoons dried chili flakes | mint, to garnish, fresh ( i use lots )
instructions: Toast sausages under a preheated grill or broiler. When done remove from oil and allow to cool slightly. Pat sausages dry with a clean cloth. Combine dried chili flakes and hot italian sausage liquid and brush or spread mixture evenly over entire sausage. Place on grill, and cook for about 15 - 25 minutes or until cooked through. Garnish with mint, if desired, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rice paper,picante sauce,beef stock,curry paste,lime zest,asparagus,garlic paste
title: Aussie Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 package sliced asparagus, trimmed | 1 tablespoon lime zest | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 2 cups picante sauce | 3/4 cup beef stock | 1 package rice paper sheets | 1 tablespoon curry paste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place the sliced asparagus on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with zest, garlic paste, picante sauce, and beef stock. Roast in the preheated oven until tender, about 30 minutes. Fill a skillet with water and bring to a boil. Add the rice paper.

title: Besan Polenta
ingredients: 500 g cornmeal, with a pinch of baking soda | 1 inch ginger paste | 8 green cardamom pods | 4 cardamom pods, slit open ( black ) | 4 black cardamom pods | 100 g blanched hazelnuts in powdered milk | 1 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Bring a large pan of well salted water to a boil, add the cornmeal. When foaming is heard, remove from heat. Beat with a wooden spoon. In a bowl, mix together the ginger, cardamom, cinnamons, and black cardamom pods. Add the ginger mixture to the cornmeal, stir to blend well. Gently fold in the hazelnuts. Transfer mixture to a well seasoned baking tray lined with baking parchment. Sprinkle on ground coriander. Refrigerate for at least half an hour. Preheat oven to 180c / fan 160c / 295f / gas cook for approximately 40 - 45 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve with lemon wedges and/or yoghurt, or as desired.

title: Lennie's Chicken in the Instant Pot
ingredients: 3 green cardamom pods | 2 cans cream of chicken soup
instructions: Put all ingredients into the instant pot and add about 1 tablespoon of cream of chicken soup onto each piece of chicken. Stir thoroughly. Turn the instant pot on to the dry setting and let it cook for about 10 minutes. Stir before using as desired.

title: Lima Bean Hummus
ingredients: 350 g dried lima beans | 10 -12 cloves, to taste
instructions: Pick over peas and stones and rinse in water until the water runs clear before adding beans. Cover and let macerate for 30 mins or overnight. Remove cover and bring to simmer and cook until beans are very tender. Drain and stir through lima beans. Cook for 5 mins more or until slightly thickened. Turn off heat and stir through the sunflower oil until it is just combined. Serve immediately with pita bread.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 1 package fresh salad greens, washed | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 ounce tamarind pulp | 3 cans oysters
instructions: In a deep skillet, mix all ingredients except for the oysters. Place over medium high heat until mixture begins to bubble. Reduce heat and simmer about 20 minutes. Place oysters in individual serving bowls. Ladle hot sauce over oysters and serve.

title: Apple Kombu Applesauce
ingredients: cooking apples, peeled ( i used a combination of rome, granny smith and mackintosh ) | 1 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender and process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,cream sherry,rigatoni pasta,pinto bean,biscuit,avocado,leek,vanilla yogurt
title: Sour Cream, Avocado & Pinto Bean Rød
ingredients: 250 -280 g rigatoni pasta or 250 -280 g penne | 2 cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 leeks or 1 green onion, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon sour cream | 1 carton frozen yogurt | 2 avocados, peeled, pitted and chopped | 1 cup carrot, shredded
instructions: Cook rigatoni or penne in lots of boiling water, or according to instructions on the box. Drain and set aside. Rinse pinto beans with cold water and set aside. Dry fry caraway seeds in oil over high heat until fragrant. Add leeks or green onions and cook 1 - 2 minutes. Add beans and cook for about 5 minutes. Stir in sour cream and yogurt. Heat until heated through. Toss with hot cooked pasta, adding extra avocado to bowl just before serving. Garnish with chopped avocado.

title: Dairy Free Irish Cream Mix
ingredients: 1/3 cup pearl barley | 2 tablespoons coffee, mixed with | bay leaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a liquidiser and blend until smooth. Store in a container with a lid or sealable container.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,fennel seed,guacamole,purpose flour,peanut oil,tomato sauce,stilton cheese
title: Stilton Cheese and Peppers
ingredients: 1 -2 ounce guacamole | 1 -2 ounce tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 1/8 cup peanut oil ( for cooking ) | 4 -5 tablespoons stilton cheese, crumbled ( or similar cheese )
instructions: Spread guacamole on top of peanut oil on the inside of a nonstick pan. Place on medium heat. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and fennel seeds. When they turn a deep green, add the flour. Heat until bubbly. Quickly stir in the cheese, one at a time to make sure all is melted. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: stone mustard,puff pastry,polenta,sherry wine vinegar,white mushroom,tomato puree,cocoa powder,breadcrumb bread
title: Polenta, Tomato and Mushroom Pie for Valentine's Day
ingredients: 230 g polenta, coarsely ground | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 tablespoons stone ground mustard | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 125 g white mushrooms, sliced | 220 g tomato puree | 1 tablespoon instant breadcrumbs or 1 tablespoon dried breadcrumbs, to sprinkle | 1 sheet puff pastry, halved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160c/300f/gas line a baking tray with baking paper. Place the polenta, cocoa and mustard in a food processor and process to form a smooth paste. Add the vinegar and process again until thoroughly combined. Transfer the paste to an 18cm/8in/3in fluted pie tin and gently press the sliced mushrooms into the paste and bake for 20 minutes or until just beginning to brown. Meanwhile, pour 150ml water into a small saucepan and gently boil for a minute or so. Remove from the heat and set aside, covered, to cool. Whisk the tomato puree in a bowl with the breadcrumbs and set aside. Take the cooled polenta and spoon it into the cake tin. Top with the mushroom mixture and sprinkle breadcrumb/breadcrumb topping over the pie. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the pastry is well risen and the top is golden. Stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Calypso Salad for Two
ingredients: 5 sheets nori | 1 can sliced mushrooms, rinsed and drained | 1 package frozen mixed sprouts | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh sage leaf | dijon mustard | freshly crushed peanuts
instructions: Heat a skillet or wok over medium heat. Coat the sides of a sheet of nori with cooking spray and place a single sheet of nori in the skillet. Place the mushrooms on the sheet with the nori. Combine the frozen mixed sprouts, sage and peanuts in a bowl, and stir in the dijon. Spread the dressing over the salad, and sprinkle with the sage flavored peanuts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken,ear corn,green cardamom pod,vanilla bean,pork,cream mushroom soup,celery salt,pita bread
title: Elegant Roast Pork Pitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs roast pork ( or more ) | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/3 1/3 cup celery salt ( or less ) | 1 1/3 cups dry pita bread, torn into pieces ( or whole wheat bread ) | 1/4 cup minced fresh green cardamom pods ( optional ) | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 can chicken, drained, patted dry | 1 ear of corn, cooked, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f, gas mark 4. Line a roasting pan with foil and grease with pats. If using whole wheat pita bread pieces, cut off one quarter. Open the bread and tear into small pieces, and set aside. Place the roast or leftover roast in a roasting pan with the soup, celery salt, cardamom pods, and vanilla bean. Spread the bread mixture inside the pan. Roast for 30 - 45 minutes, until center of the meat thermometer reads 350 degrees f. When meat thermometer reaches 160 degrees f remove from oven, cover, and let stand 15 minutes. Place chopped veggies in a serving dish. If using fresh corn, sprinkle over the meat and serve with bread. Slice remaining piece of meat into thin strips about 2x3 inches. Shred meat in 1/4 inch pieces. To eat, wrap a strip of meat in a tortilla, add some veggies and a pinch or two of cheese.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,pepper sesame oil,jasmine rice,butterscotch pudding mix
title: Chinese Butterscotch Rice Bowls
ingredients: 3/4 cup jasmine rice | 1 package butterscotch pudding mix ( or any flavor pudding ) | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 teaspoon pepper sesame oil
instructions: Prepare the jasmine rice, and cook it along with other ingredients on stovetop until rice is light brown. Serve in bowls, drizzled with a bit of melted butter, and top with any other seasonings you like.

Random Ingredients: date,pizza crust,teriyaki sauce,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Cran-Date Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 2 tablespoons pizza dough ( made with the following ) | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup ra el hanout spice mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Roll out the crust onto a floured work surface and lightly brush with a little teriyaki. Score into the circles to make circles. Bake the circles on a pizza stone or cookie sheet for 5 - 8 minutes, or until crust is dry but not burnished. While the dough is toasting, in a small saucepan over medium heat, stir together the other 1/2 cup of teriyaki sauce with the 1/2 cup of ra el hanout. When the pastries become tender, remove from heat and stir in the dry spice mixture. When all the dough is baked, brush some sauce on the tops of the pizzas to finish them from soft to crispy. Top the baked pastries with the sauce and finish with the remaining sauce on the top.

title: Raspberry Quinoa Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed | 8 slices mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup diced poblano chile | 4 raspberries ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/4 cup lime juice
instructions: Boil/saute quinoa. Once quinoa is tender and cool enough to handle, dice it. Place quinoa in bowl and add 1/2 teaspoon lime juice. Mix well and then refrigerate until ready to serve. Preheat oven to 300°f. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil and lightly spray with cooking spray. Divide quinoa between 4 small bowl and then evenly divide mozzarella among half the bowls. Add poblano to top of cheese and sprinkle with raspberries to top of cheese. Cover loosely with aluminium foil and bake 25 - 30 minutes, or until cheese is melted and hot. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Sliceless Crock Pot Beef Tips
ingredients: 4 lbs stew meat, i use top round, can use beef tenderized | 2 packages lipton onion soup mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients in crock pot, cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. When ready to serve, combine beef tips with sauce or gravy. Serve on rolls or tortillas.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,barley,rice wine vinegar,pearl tapioca,extra virgin olive oil,tomato ketchup
title: Quick French Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces condensed french onion soup | 1 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup pearl tapioca | 1/4 cup instant rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking barley
instructions: Place all ingredients over medium heat in the top of a double boiler. Slowly stir until all ingredients are thoroughly mixed. Let simmer for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,lettuce leaf,garlic paste,yellow mustard,fine breadcrumb
title: Garlic Naan (The French Quarter)
ingredients: 1 cup fine breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon finely chopped garlic paste | 2 tablespoons finely chopped spring onions | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 4 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 20 -30 small lettuce leaves
instructions: Stir together the garlic paste, bread crumbs, ground spring onion, mustard & bread crumbs in a bowl. Season with salt & pepper. Add 2 tbsp olive oil & 1 tbsp of water if necessary to moisten the mixture slightly. Divide between the 4 naans & press lightly to flatten slightly. Sprinkle with fine dry breadcrumbs and bake at 180c for around 8 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm along with your favourite veggie fillings.

Random Ingredients: semolina,spinach,achiote powder,marsala wine,sirloin,cocoa powder,sherry wine vinegar,poblano pepper
title: Cinderella's Mexican Sirloin & Spinach With a Mole
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin | 1 cup cocoa powder, for dusting | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 -3 poblano peppers | 1/4 cup semolina | 2 tablespoons semolina, for dusting | 3 teaspoons sazon goya ( the mexican version ; if you can't find it use 1 teaspoon of anise extract from the mexican ) | 1 teaspoon achiote powder ( substitute with 1/4 tsp. cardamom )
instructions: For the meat,. In a large ziploc combine the meat, cocoa powder, vinegar, sherry, and achiote. Mix well to coat the meat evenly.. Allow it to marinate overnight for 2 - 24 hours. Grill over indirect medium heat. Cook for about 5 - 4 minutes per side. Serve in a gravy or roasted potatoes, and top with sliced fresh tomatoes, salsa, and chopped onions. For the filling,. In a food processor combine the semolina, sherry, 1 tsp. Of the sazon, and the remaining 1/4 tsp. Achiote powder. Grind until fine, about 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chocolate hazelnut nutella,pesto sauce,cream celery soup,balsamic vinegar,pinto bean
title: German Hot Chocolate Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/4 cups cream of celery soup | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate hazelnut spread | 1 dash balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a food processor, puree 1 cup of the pinto beans, soup, pesto and hazelnuts. With motor running, add remaining liquid and blend well, adding more soup or hazelnut if desired. Transfer to a large serving bowl and garnish with remaining crumbs.

Random Ingredients: harissa,spring onion,garam masala powder,self raising flour,white cheddar cheese,ricotta cheese,golden syrup,allspice berry
title: Focaccia
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 1 cup shredded white cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup minced spring onion | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 2 teaspoons allspice berry | 1 teaspoon harissa ( an indian spice blend ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed golden syrup | 3 teaspoons self-raising flour
instructions: Mash the ricotta and white cheddar cheese together in a large bowl. Add the onions, garam masala powder, allspice berries, harissa, golden syrup and flour, and mix well. Preheat oven or grill to high. Grease a large baking sheet with some low fat cooking oil spray. Stir the mixture until it is thoroughly blended. Drop small heaped teaspoonfuls of mixture onto the prepared baking sheet. Cook for about 3 - 5 minutes, and then turn the foccacia out onto a heat proof plate. The edges will be a little crisp. It is easier to eat when the focaccia remains cool. Serve as is or, wrap in aluminium foil after unwrapping and reheating in the microwave for about 20 seconds.

title: Spaghetti Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 can spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup orange marmalade | 8 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 mango, chopped | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, or to taste | 1 package fresh mushrooms, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix spaghetti sauce, marmalade, cherry tomatoes, mango, and lemon juice together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,red curry paste,chocolate syrup,hazelnut,water,orange zest,vanilla essence
title: Maurice's Temptation to Go With a Temptation Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 tart apple, cored ( about 320g/4oz ) | 3 tablespoons red curry paste ( or use plain ) | 1 tablespoon orange zest, finely grated | 100 g chocolate syrup | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 220 g ground hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon water | 125 g bittersweet chocolate syrup
instructions: Place apple in a pan, cover and cook gently for 15 - 20 minutes, or until tender. Using a food processor, blitz up all the ingredients until smooth. Set aside to cool. Using a small, shallow dish, mix together the chocolate syrup and water. Drain apple, reserving any juices. Press apple chunks into chocolate syrup, then return to pan and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until golden.. Transfer to a bowl and use to pour over sauce.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,pasta,bay leaf,green chili pepper,pumpkin,belgian endive,water chestnut
title: Pumpkin Pasta With Endives and Snow Peas
ingredients: 200 g pumpkin, cut into 1 inch chunks ( yellow squash ) | 4 tablespoons sweet green chili peppers, minced | 1 large bay leaf | 100 g water chestnuts, chopped | 100 g belgian endive, cut into 3cm lengths | 4 tablespoons pasta, uncooked | 150 g snow peas
instructions: Peel the pumpkin and cut in half. Using a paring knife or melon baller, gently press and stretch the skins of the pumpkin to a disc shape. Discard the skins. Place the pumpkin, chilies, bay leaf and water chestnuts in a large pan. Cover the pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 15 minutes. Toss the pasta with the pumpkin and vegetables in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Remove from the refrigerator and stir through the snow peas. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: peanut,simple syrup,serrano chilies,cardamom seed,baking powder,kosher salt,serrano ham,dijon mustard
title: Rajma-Traditional Yemeni Spiced Peanuts
