ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs dried unsalted peanuts, shelled | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1/2 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup kosher salt | 1/4 cup granulated fresh-ground peppercorns or 1/4 cup roasted peanuts, in oil ( optional ) | 6 serrano chilies, stems and seeds removed ( to taste ) | 6 cardamom seeds ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Rinse peanuts with cold water. Pat dry with paper towels. Place peanuts in a bowl, cover with 2 cups cold water, and let soak for 3 to 5 days. Drain peanuts and place in a heavy saucepan with 4 1/2 cups water. Bring to a boil, lower heat, and simmer until the peanuts soften about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and place in a bowl covered with cold water and let sit until cool enough to handle. Using a slotted spoon, remove peanuts from water and coarsely chop. Meanwhile, in a small bowl combine the mustard, salt, peppercorns, chiles, cardamom, and baking powder. Set aside. Working in batches, drain peanuts in a colander and coarsely grind the peanuts. In a 12 inch heavy pot, heat the remaining olive oil and fry the peanuts until golden and beginning to darken, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel lined tray while you fry the rest. Store in an airtight container at room temperature and reheat when reheating, adding more oil if necessary.

title: Pierogi Margherita - 6 Margheritas!
ingredients: 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 -8 drops tabasco sauce | 3/4 cup liguero-style beer
instructions: In a cocktail shaker, add 1/2 cup romano and tabasco. Pour 1/4 cup of lager over top. Add ice and blend well. Shake vigorously and strain into a high ball glass. Top with remaining romano. Shake again and serve in an oversized cocktail glass.

title: Broccoli & Swiss Steak Rounds #5FIX
ingredients: 3/4 lb top sirloin | 1/3 cup polenta | 1 spring onion | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Thoroughly pound top sirloin slices to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut polenta into 3 slices.

Random Ingredients: french bread,cooking spray,grain white rice,chicken bouillon granule,saffron,red beet
title: Spanish-Styled Red Beet and Rice Casserole
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 french bread, halved lengthwise and sliced 1/2-inch thick | 1 pinch saffron | 1 3/4 cups chopped red beets | 2 1/2 teaspoons low-sodium instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 cups instant white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange the bread slices in a single layer on the baking sheet. Sprinkle with saffron, and sprinkle with beets. In a small bowl, stir together chicken broth, bouillon, and white rice until smooth. Pour evenly over the bread. Let stand 10 minutes, then cut into 12 squares. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,shortening,cottage cheese,white onion,double cream,tabasco sauce
title: Cottage Cheese and Onion Pudding
ingredients: 6 tablespoons margarine ( i like butter ) or 6 tablespoons clarified butter ( i like butter ) | 1 small white onion, finely chopped ( i like onion ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 3 cups cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | double cream or milk
instructions: Heat 6tablespoon butter or dripping in a saucepan and fry onion and sugar over low heat until onions are tender and golden. Mix in tabasco sauce, stir well and simmer very slowly, stirring, until cottage cheese is thoroughly melted. Pour into a bowl and beat with a whisk or fork or beater very quickly and thoroughly. Pour into ovenproof serving dish with a lid. Make sure it is not quite to overflowing the lid, and place lid on dish. Bake in a 350f degrees oven for 30 mins, stirring every 5 - 10 mins. Turn pudding out onto a platter and pour a spoonful of cream or milk on top. Serve very slowly or reheat very quickly, but be careful not to allow pudding to boil. Serves 5 and i have made double cream to double the sauce, and the results have been incredible.

title: Farfalle II
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta | filling ( optional ) | 1 package croutons
instructions: Cook pasta in rapidly boiling water until al dente. Drain. Add croutons to warm croutons. Mix sauce with cooked pasta and serve.

Random Ingredients: fine egg noodle,onion powder,vegetable broth,beet,barley,cane sugar,vegetable,white rum
title: Beet Noodle Soup With Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced dry onions or 1/4 cup dry onion flakes | 6 ounces shredded raw sweet potato | 8 ounces frozen mixed vegetables ( thawed if frozen ) | 1 can condensed vegetable broth | 1 cup dry fine egg noodles | 2 tablespoons dry white rum | 1/4 cup finely chopped dehydrated cane sugar | 1/2 teaspoon fine egg noodle ( i like liptons )
instructions: Combine first 13 ingredients in dutch oven, bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in noodles, remove cover, and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in sugar and noodles, and sprinkle with additional sugar. Serve hot. Note, to make a smaller serving quantity, divide mixture for individual servings between 6 bowls.

title: Turnip Rice with Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups orange juice or 2 cups water | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg ( or more ) | 1 yellow turnip, peeled and chopped | 2 cups flat rice noodles, cut in 2-inch lengths | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped or 2 teaspoons dried dill, crushed
instructions: Bring the orange juice and nutmeg to a boil in a large dutch oven or pot. Add the turnip and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon to stick the turnip, until almost tender, about 8 minutes with a wooden spoon. Stir in the noodles and cook 4 minutes for yellow turnip and 5 minutes for browned turnip. Stir in the dill and remove the pot from the heat. Spoon into serving bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,clam,red kidney bean,english mustard,salsa,greek olive,dark brown sugar
title: Mexican Red Beans and Clams in Spiced Rum
ingredients: 2 cans red kidney beans or ( 16 ounce ) cans great northern beans, drained | 2 cans chopped clams, drained | 1 scotch bonnet pepper, chopped | 1 - 2 1/2 cup good quality spanish dark brown sugar, packed | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds or 1 tablespoon coarse sea salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared english mustard | 1 cup good quality salsa ( good quality ) or 1 cup hot pepper sauce ( good quality )
instructions: Drain 1 can of drained beans and reserve 1 cup of the sauce. Place liquid and reserved beans, chopped clams, chile and brown sugar in a pan. Heat up about 1 minute. Stir constantly for one minute while sauce cooks. Turn down to low heat. Add sesame seeds and mustard and let cook for about 5 minutes more. Add salsa, mix well and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Add reserved bean liquid and stir briefly until heated through. Cover and let soak for two hours overnite to allow flavors to develop. Serve over rice cooked over a bed of steamed white rice with warm corn bread.

title: Sausage With Baby Potatoes and Sherry Vinegar
ingredients: 1/2 lb sausage, thinly cut ( about 3 links ) | salt | 2 pounds baby potatoes, halved if large | 4 sprigs coriander, roots left on | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over high heat. Add the sausage and reduce the heat to high. Cook, turning with tongs, until golden on all sides, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Add the potatoes and coriander roots to the skillet.

title: Pinchi (Tarragon Pickles)
ingredients: 1 lb of small red hot chili pepper, seeds and stems removed ( such as jalapenos ) | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 36 medium raw pinchi ( japanese ok ) leaves ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a small sealable plastic bag. Add the whole pickle to the bag & squish the bag to thoroughly coat everything. Refrigerate the pickles for an hour. Unwrap, rinse, and let pickles cool completely before serving in a clear glass jars. Note for vegetarians, omit chicken bouillon or the red chilli flakes.

Random Ingredients: green bean,pizza crust,cornmeal,mushroom,purpose flour,pork loin,pork chop
title: Pizzaria
ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1 can green beans, drained | 3/4 cup shredded pork loin | 1/2 pound thinly sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 boneless pork chops | 1 pizza crust, refrigerated for at least 15 minutes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix flour, cornmeal and green beans. Stir in pork, mushrooms and pork chops.

Random Ingredients: sultana,cool whip,onion,white wine vinegar,kaffir lime leaf
title: Nam Sod (Portuguese Salad Dressing)
ingredients: 1 cup cool whip | 1/4 cup sultana | 1 tablespoon chopped onion | 4 -5 kaffir lime leaves, thinly sliced ( optional ) | white wine vinegar
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together. Chill in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,herring fillet,andouille sausage,pork belly,peanut,dark brown sugar
title: Anuille and Peanut-And-And-Sausage Wrapped Pork Tails
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 package mild herring fillets | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb fresh andouille sausage, sliced | 12 corn tortillas | 24 slices pork belly, lardons
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Coat a large nonreactive baking pan with cooking spray. Bring a medium saucepan of water to a simmer. Add the sugar and herring fillets and cook until they start to soften, about 3 minutes. While the herring and herring are cooking stir together the peanuts, sausage, chopped andouille and warm them for 2 - 3 minutes. When the herring is cool enough to handle slice the tail section into about 20 slices to make 2 1/2 inch wide strips. Place a tablespoonful of the mixture along the short side of each corn tortilla, roll it up, and place seam side down on top of the filled tortillas. Dab the ends of the the wraps with wet fingers. If you are not using a wrap with a lid, wrap the entire side with the folded sides.

title: Herbed Tostada Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced italian parsley | 1 package refrigerated tostadas, crumbled without salt and but heated
instructions: Stir herbs and crumbled tortillas in a large bowl. Brush the tops of the chips with butter and then sprinkle with chips. Bake at 375f for about 7 minutes or until slightly golden and crisp.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,potato,cake flour,white bread,curry powder,basmati rice,salad oil
title: Curried Sweet Potato Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup warm potato oil | 3/4 cup salad oil | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 cups cake flour, divided | 5 teaspoons dry instant mashed sweet potatoes | 2 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil in a 5 quart saucepan. Remove from the heat, stir and let sit 5 minutes. Stir in the yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes. Mix 1 cup of the flour with the sweet potatoes and rice and stir into the yeast mixture. Beat well. Gradually add the remaining flour 1/2 cup at a time, beating after each addition. Stir in the remaining 3/4 cup of flour 1/2 cup at a time, beating after each addition. Turn into a greased 10 inch x 5 inch loaf pan, cover with a towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake the bread until golden brown and crispy, about 40 minutes. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Grpa Dolci Impanesca from the Antilles
ingredients: 12 black olives, pitted ( not cured ) | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/4 cup fresh basil, finely chopped
instructions: Slice almonds into 1/4 inch thick slabs and sprinkle generously with salt. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Rinse with cold water and drain on paper towels. Heat oven to 400°f. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper. Add olives in rough small pile on cookie sheet. Brush lightly with oil. Sprinkle with saffron. Sprinkle with basil. Bake at 400°f until light brown, about 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fine semolina,spinach,club soda,avocado,white corn syrup,lime wedge,tea,miracle whip
title: Mamacita's Avocado and Spinach Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 tea bags | 1/2 cup white corn syrup | 12 tablespoons lime juice ( about 6 limes ) | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 12 thin avocados | ice cream or other good flavored ice cream | 1/4 cup miracle whip ( optional ) | fine semolina ( optional )
instructions: Place tea bags in a large pitcher. Add corn syrup, lime juice and chopped spinach. Beat until smooth. Divide among the 4 tea bags. Chill until ready to serve. Top each with ice cream and/or miracle whip, if desired.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,sesame oil,liquid smoke,mayonnaise,penne pasta,chinese vegetable,brown rice,half
title: Maggie's Chinese Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 3 cups cooked brown rice | sliced chinese vegetables | 3 cups cooked penne pasta | 2 heads baby chinese-style vegetables, cooked and quartered lengthwise | sour cream or mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons light mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar ( preferably heinz ) | 1 pinch liquid smoke
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, prepare the chicken and vegetables. When rice is done, drain, and add all ingredients except sour cream, mayonnaise and vinegar to cooked rice in large bowl. Stir well. Spread mixture on grated cheese and top with sour cream. I recommend topping with more of each, according to taste. Garnish, of course, with a little grated cheese and sesame seeds.

title: Ancho Chili Powder
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck ( or shoulder ) | 4 cups hot ancho chile powder | corn oil
instructions: Wash the shoulder well, trim off the rind, then, using your fingers, scrape off any browned bits that float to the top. Cut the meat into 1/4 inch cubes and transfer to a bowl, cover with cold water and set aside. Wash the bowl of water and bring it to a boil. Stir in the chili powder and return to a boil. Add the ground chuck or shoulder and stir until well mixed and colored. Keep stirring and allow to boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl, cover and set aside. To serve, reheat the chili over moderate heat until hot but not boiling. Spoon over your preferred meat and serve.

title: Spicy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried lavender | 1 tablespoon seasoning mix, or as needed ( such as kitchen bouquet or similar herb flavor ) | 1/2 cup prepared chicken wings | 1 large turnip, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 medium portabella mushroom, washed, ends trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine cajun seasoning, lavender, seasoning mix, and chicken wings in a large baking dish or roasting pan. Bake 15 minutes until chicken wings are golden brown, basting with liquid as necessary. Pour mushrooms over chicken.

title: Cheese in the Sun
ingredients: 100 g swiss cheese | 20 g caerphilly cheese ( grated )
instructions: Cut cheese into 20 squares. Place in an ovenproof dish. Pour cheese over the top of the cheese. Sprinkle with garlic and dried parsley. Place under the grill until the cheese is golden.

title: Tequila-Chipotle Jalapeño Quesadillas
ingredients: 10 ounces sour cream or 10 ounces neufchatel cheese ( 8-10 oz ) | 1 large chipotle chile | 1 sheet puff pastry
instructions: Combine the sour cream/ neufchatel cheese, chile, and adobo chile in a food processor and process until smooth. Spread 1/4 cup of the mixture on a piece of plastic wrap, about 1 1/2 inches in thickness. Roll tortillas tightly, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter wrap, and place on a plate or tray. Brush with a little oil and sprinkle with salt. Chill for 20 minutes. Remove the plastic wrap and cut the tortillas into 1 x 1/2 wedges. Arrange the wedges over 3/4 cup of hot water in a steamer basket. Cover and steam over boiling water for 2 minutes or until the tortillas are crispy and the filling is hot, turning and pressing the tortilla with your hands. Serve warm. Enjoy.

title: Tuna Crunch for Bonbons
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1 cup chilled tuna in water | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 2 -4 tablespoons ice, ice crystals optional.
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Using two teaspoon, make small patties out of the mix. Bake in preheated oven at 160 degrees celciusfor 20 minutes or until golden brown and well cooked. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: icing,iceberg lettuce,shortcrust pastry,tomato green chilies,pink grapefruit juice,yukon gold potato,russet potato
title: Potato Pizza With Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 small russet potatoes | 1 large ripe pink grapefruit, juice of | 500 g thinly sliced pickled ginger-free green chilies, such as thai or jalapeno, finely chopped | icing | 2 -3 cups frozen shortcrust pastry | iceberg lettuce ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 210°c. Cut the potatoes in half lengthways and bake in oven for about 30 minutes or until just tender. Cool slightly, scoop out the core and dice them.

Random Ingredients: half cream,vegetable oil cooking spray,sunflower oil,cremini mushroom
title: Mushroom and Sunflower Gratin
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups cremini mushrooms, sliced | 2 cups half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup sunflower oil ( a few drops )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f in a large skillet over low heat, cook mushrooms until soft, about 4 - 5 minutes. Set aside to cool for 5 - 10 minutes. Strain mushrooms into a medium bowl and set aside. In blender, combine cream and oil. Whisking frequently, pour oil mixture into blender. Blend until smooth and thick, about 1 minute. Season to taste with salt. Stir a few times in between blending. Spread mushroom mixture evenly into a round baking dish that's been lightly oiled and covered with parchment paper. Place in oven and bake 10 minutes, then remove from oven while still slightly warm. Invert pan and transfer skillet into a large serving dish that's sitting in center of large gratin dish. Garnish gratin with a few zest slices of sunflower halves after removing parchment. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,habanero pepper,hot red pepper flake,coconut milk
title: Sweet Red Pepper Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pure indian yellow pepper or 1 tablespoon jalapeno chili pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1 can coconut milk | 1 small habanero pepper
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender container and puree. Heat in a small saucepan on low until hot but not boiling.

title: Lengenberg's Head Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head small white cabbage, cut into 3 inch pieces | 1/2 cup dried currants
instructions: Place cabbage in a large, deep skillet. Cover tightly with water, and heat to boiling, covering pan. Let cook until cabbage is tender, 30 to 45 minutes. Drain, and allow to cool. Stir currants into cabbage. Serve immediately.

title: Orange Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup orange juice
instructions: Combine rice and orange juice in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook 18 minutes, until grains are just tender.

title: Spanish Chicken Wings or Buffalo
ingredients: 5 lbs chicken wings, split, tips left on | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons paprika | 8 scallions, finely chopped | 1 lb rice noodles, cooked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper or grease lightly. Cut the wings into thirds, and cut the wings lengthwise down their center. Remove the wings from each section. Roll each piece of wings in bread crumbs and place on the parchment baking sheet. In a medium bowl, stir the paprika and the scallions with the crumbs. Brush the tops with oil and sprinkle with salt. Bake the wings 1 hour or until browned and crisp.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,onion,serrano pepper,chili pepper flake
title: Aji
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs onions | 2 serrano peppers | 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes ( optional but recommended ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Peel and discard the outer peel of the onions. Place them into a large pot of cold, salted water and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from flame once the water returns to a boil and set aside. Drain the salted water from the onions under cold water. Discard the onions. Drain thoroughly and set aside. Cut the peppers and onions into very thin slices. Using a very sharp knife, finely dice the pepper and onion mixture. Place the contents of the pot into a colander and wash under cold running water. The easiest way to do this is to hold the colander in the sink and run it over it until the onion is completely peeled off the inside of the pot and the pepper and onion mixture is well drained. Add salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: spiral pasta,olive oil,chicken broth,kielbasa,stewing beef,pickling spice,cornmeal,orange zest
title: Crock Pot Pulled Beef With Rice and Sausage (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil | 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 tablespoons pickling spices | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 2 cans low sodium chicken broth | 1/2 lb kielbasa, cut in 1-inch slices | 7 ounces uncooked multicolored rotelle or seven ounces curly rotini, cut into 2 inch pieces ( 1 1/2 cups ) | cornmeal
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Brown beef, sprinkle with seasoning mix, and transfer to crock pot. Add broth and zest. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours. In a 3 3/4 cup measure, combine sausage and rotelle/rotini. Cover and cook on high 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until trivet. With rubber spatula, loosen sides of mixture. Serve with cornmeal.

title: Vegan Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce ( homemade and low sodium ) | 1/4 cup cold water | 1/2 tablespoon mirin | 1/4 teaspoon mori mixed spice
instructions: To use 1/4 cup cold water, add one half cup of the sauce.

Random Ingredients: scallion,romano cheese,chicken thigh,cheese,mexican cheese,egg wrap,dill weed
title: Mexican Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mexican cheese, cut into 1 inch pieces | 6 scallions, minced | 7 -8 pieces chicken thighs, cooked | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 large egg roll wrap | cheese, shredded | shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Place the mexican cheese in a small bowl. Saute the scallions in the eggroll wrapper in a skillet until soft. Set aside. Place all remaining ingredients except the cheese in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Turn the heat down simmer, cover, and simmer. Remove the lid and simmer for 10 mins, until most of the liquid is absorbed by the eggroll wrapper. Add the cheese and stir until melted and well incorporated. Add scallions and cook another few minutes. Cool slightly. Wrap the rolls in cheese or serve with a few tortilla chips and salsa.

title: Broccoli Toblerone Bark
ingredients: 1 toblerone chocolate bar, finely chopped | 1/4 cup blue cheese, crumbled ( about 18 pieces ) | 4 cups fresh broccoli florets
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with wax paper and place the toblerone chocolate piece in the center. Arrange the broccoli over the chocolate. Sprinkle the blue cheese over the broccoli. Broil for 3 to 4 minutes, or until the cheese is lightly browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,rum,italian breadcrumb,pinto bean,red jalapeno chile,rigatoni pasta,soy sauce
title: Crock Pot Indonesian Rigatoni "chicken" Beans
ingredients: 3 cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons rum | 2 red jalapeno chiles, minced | 2 -3 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta
instructions: In a 2 1/2 or 3 - 3 quart slow cooker combine the pinto beans and remaining ingredients, except bread crumbs, and mix thoroughly. Cover and cook on low 7 hours or on high 2 hours. Turn off the slow cooker, stir in the crumbs, cover and let stand for 15 minutes, stirring well before serving. Tastes best if served right away, and flavors can blend together.

Random Ingredients: tomato,adobo sauce,vidalia onion,deli ham,anise seed,cumin,sage leaf,coffee
title: Cuban-Style Breakfast Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 lb thinly sliced deli ham | 1/4 vidalia onion, thinly sliced | 2 1/2 slices deli ham | 14 ounces diced tomatoes | 1 tablespoon freshly ground anise seed | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce ( aji amarillo ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon ground sage leaf
instructions: On a heavy duty baking sheet, arrange half the ham, half the onion and half the ham slice in a single layer. Top half with remaining ham, onion and onion and top with remaining ham slices and remaining onion and ham slice. In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients for the chimichurri sauce. Use as a dip for the sandwiches.

title: North African Hot Pepper Sauce II
ingredients: 4 habanero peppers | 1 teaspoon sweet paprika
instructions: Slit tops off habanero peppers. Score top of habanero pepper and remove seeds. Cut a slit from stem to habanero pepper creating an opening to remove more seeds. Rub seeds into pepper. You may want to use a mortar and pestle, as it can be bitter. Combine the peppers and paprika and store in an airtight container.

title: Grilled Sausages With a Kick
ingredients: 8 medium jalapenos, deseeded and cut into small pieces | 8 medium sliced olives, pitted | 8 medium sliced apricots | 2 teaspoons ground mace | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 2 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Place sausages on a baking tray, spray grill rack with cooking or oil spray, then grill sausages for 10 - 15 minutes until brown and crisp. Turn sausages over, sprinkle with olives, apricots, mace and lime juice, then grill for 3 - 5 minutes over hot coals, turning and basting with molasses every so often, or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: paprika,hamburger bun,head iceberg lettuce,thai red curry paste,strawberry,breadcrumb,blue cheese
title: Quick and Easy Thai Curry Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup crumbled blue cheese ( like feta ) | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1/2 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1 1/4 lbs ground round | 12 hamburger buns | 12 thick slices fresh strawberries, to serve
instructions: Preheat grill to medium or medium high. In a small bowl, stir together cheese, curry paste, bread crumbs, and ground beef. Form beef mixture into 8 patties. Grill patties for 5 minutes per side or until outside is golden brown, and center is no longer pink, brushing with remaining curry paste mixture after turning. Arrange lettuce leaves on a toasted buns, and top with toasted burger patties.

title: Indian Cheese Puffs(Khachapuri)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs gruyere cheese or 1 1/2 lbs emmenthaler cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons raisins | 1 yellow onion, finely chopped | 4 fresh curry leaves, crumbled | tabasco sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, mix cheese, raisins, onion and curry leaves with tabasco and combine.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,french green bean,pepper,yellow squash,water,cheddar cheese
title: French Baked Vegetables & Rice
ingredients: 3 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained ( or brown rice ) | 1 cup frozen french style green beans, thawed | 6 yellow squash, cut into 1/2 inch slices ( about 2-3 inches long ) | 1/3 cup water | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to mix all ingredients in a 8x8 inch baking dish or greased 2 qt casserole. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake until vegetables are tender, about 30 - 35 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese before serving.

title: Hotjalapeno
ingredients: 3 large dried jalapeno peppers | 1 tablespoon fennel seed
instructions: Slit or break stem ends off of peppers. Place on a foil lined baking sheet. Sprinkle the fennel seeds on top. Bake at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes stirring every 5 minutes or so.

title: Cassic Rice
ingredients: 350 g brown rice ( basmati works great ) | 200 g sunflower oil | sage ( optional ) or thyme ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice as per instructions. If using sunflower oil then mix sage/thyme and sage into the rice and add your oil. When rice is cooked let rice cool. Cut rice into small squares.

title: Kona Krakowski -- Rye Rice Balls (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 can coconut flakes, flaked | 1 cup rye flour | 1 cup long grain white rice
instructions: Stovetop, combine coconut and rye flour in the bread machine, making sure each is broken down into a large ball. Place flaked coconut and rye flour balls on a flat surface and roll into a ball. Place balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.. You can use a rolling pin or other manual to roll the dough in the coconut flakes. Bake in a preheated oven for 20 - 30 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve warm, room temperature, or the oven is not ideal for this step in my area, so don't over bake.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,cilantro,vegetable oil cooking spray,mirin,tea,salad dressing,chicken
title: Tako Donburi (Japanese Chicken Salad)
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain store bought salad dressing | 1/4 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken meat, cut into 1-inch pieces | vegetable oil cooking spray, for serving | chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: To make the dressing, combine the salad dressing, mirin, sugar, and chicken in a small bowl, and stir to combine. Let marinate in fridge for at least 1 hour. Heat a griddle or large, heavy skillet over medium high heat. Spray grill with vegetable oil cooking oil. Cook chicken, turning once, until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork, about 8 minutes per side.

title: Garlicky Citrus Oranges
ingredients: 3 oranges, zested and juiced | 1 jar jar pimento stuffed olives | 1/4 cup orange marmalade, or more to taste
instructions: Place orange zest, juice, olives, marmalade, and pimento stuffed olives into an airtight container.

title: Hot Potatoes, Pepperoncinis, and Griottes
ingredients: 6 small new potatoes | 8 teaspoons pepperoncini peppers, sliced | 2 tablespoons sliced pepperoncini pepper, thinly sliced | 8 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Place potatoes in a single layer on a large baking sheet. Place under the broiler and broil about 10 minutes. Turning once, broil until tender and lightly golden. Cut in half and scoop out some of the centers, then place on a serving platter. Add the pepperoncinis, pepperoncini, and margarine to the potatoes and drizzle with the remaining ingredients. Serve warm with french bread.

title: Chilled Indian Pot Roast Beef and Chickpeas
ingredients: 4 ounces filet of beef | 1 can chickpeas | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 1/2 ounces sweet-and-sour mix
instructions: Trim fat from the beef.

title: Homemade Tamari Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups tamari | 1 teaspoon pickling salt | 1 cup apple juice | 1 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: To make tamari, combine the tamari, pickling salt, apple juice, sweet chili sauce, and salt together in a saucepan over medium high heat. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,asiago cheese,parmigiano reggiano cheese,sesame oil,penne
title: Baked Asiago Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces penne | 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil to fry the fettuccine | 2 tablespoons asiago cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons asiago cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Put asiago cheese in a small saute pan and set over medium heat.

title: Ham Ham & Carrots
ingredients: 1 ham bone | 1 kg waxy carrot
instructions: Trim the fatty part of the ham bone and cut it into pieces roughly the same size as the carrots. Place in a large pan with water about 2/3 cm deep. Cover and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 2 hours, checking frequently to make sure that the water doesn't boil off. While the ham is cooking, make the gravy using 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with a little water until it is of a paste. When the ham is almost done, remove it from the pan and cut into slices. Place in a heated deep oven to brown. Don't let it get very brown. Serve with boiled or mashed potato, if desired.

Random Ingredients: dill,fennel seed,nectarine,vegetable stock,bamboo shoot,lime juice,sirloin steak
title: Zesty Steak With Nectarines, Peaches and Dilled Onions
ingredients: 1 ounce fennel seed ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons vegetable stock | 4 sirloin steaks | lime juice | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 nectarines, halved and stoned | 2 large ripe sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill, plus extra for garnish | 1 1/4 cups vegetable stock, plus extra as desired | dill, to garnish ( optional ) | 0.5 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained, drained on paper towels and coarsely chopped, to serve
instructions: First prepare the steaks, add the fennel seeds and stock in a small fry pan and bring to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat and simmer for 4 minutes or until the meat is cooked through. Strain the stock and keep hot. Heat a frying pan. Brush both sides of the steaks with the lime juice and season well with salt, then cook over moderately high heat for 2 minutes each side to seal in a rich smoke. Tip the steak into a warmed ovenproof dish, add the sliced nectarines, sirloin steaks, sliced bamboo shoots and fresh dill to the sirloin steaks and place in a preheated 400fº oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the steak is cooked through. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Grilled Mediterranean Tostadas
ingredients: 1 can sweet corn tortillas | 1 package baby spinach | 1 small zucchini, cubed | 12 ounces whole-milk greek yogurt or 12 ounces sour cream | 1 anchovy | 1 teaspoon coconut extract, optional
instructions: Place tortillas on a wire sheet. Brush evenly, then with some of the yogurt, and press into a 9x13 baking dish. Cut spinach into thin strips.

title: Steamed Kale
ingredients: 600 g kale, cleaned and cut into bite-size pieces | 600 g sirloin steaks, trimmed | 1 liter steamer
instructions: Put all ingredients in a wok and bring to the boil. Cover and bring back to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer gently for 15 minutes or until cooked to your liking. Steam over hot wok as required.

title: Mexi-Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 2 1/2 tablespoons beef base instant bouillon ( or more, to make 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 cup green enchilada sauce
instructions: In a skillet, heat the chopped pistachios over medium low heat until lightly browned. In a bowl, mix ground pistachios with beef base. Add the blackened pistachios to the heated meat. Mix well and pour into a greased 9x13 pan. Cover and warm in a 350 degree oven until the cheese bubbles, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and spread the enchilada sauce over the tortilla.

title: Pesto Pudding
ingredients: 3 1/2 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups icing sugar | 1/3 cup pesto sauce ( or to taste )
instructions: Stir together the cream, icing sugar, and pesto sauce until smooth. Spoon into a buttered 8 cup loaf pan. Place into a pan of water, a little bit at a time, so the pudding doesn't curdle. Cover and place in fridge for 2 - 4 hours. Bake in a moderate oven for 20 minutes, then set aside to cool and cool completely. Cut into chunks and serve warm or chilled. You can also bake for 8 - 10 minutes at 180°c.

title: Chutney Gravy for Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili-garlic chutney | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup broth
instructions: Toss the chutney with the flour and place it in a 2 quart microwave safe bowl and cook on high for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, until clear and bubbly. Let cool to room temperature, then stir in broth. Serve.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,half,parsley flake,green chili pepper,taco seasoning mix,white breadcrumb,mayonnaise
title: Green Chile & Herb Dip
ingredients: 5 tablespoons fat-free half-and-half | 2 green chili peppers, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix or 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons white breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon reduced-fat mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon orange juice or 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Place half and half, chilies, parsley, taco seasoning, bread crumbs & mayonnaise in a food processor and process until smooth, adding more half and half if desired.

title: Potato and Tamarind Potatis (Kadai Ka Rayi)
ingredients: 10 cups yellow split peas | 2 1/2 cups peeled and grated raw potatoes | 2 1/2 cups grated yucca ( pumpkin squash ) | 1 quart fresh tamarind paste | 2 teaspoons powdered dried yeast | 3 cups plain yogurt | 7 cups mashed potatoes, or more as desired
instructions: Place the split peas, potatoes, yucca, and tamarind paste in a large pot over medium heat, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are softened and the liquid has thickened, about 15 minutes. Add 1 cup water and the yeast, and continue cooking until the liquid has nearly completely absorbed. Set aside to cool to room temperature before proceeding with the recipe. Place 3 cups of the mashed potato in a large mixing bowl, and stir in 2 teaspoons of salt, until the mixture is well combined. Knead in more of the potato water if the mixture seems dry. If the dough is too dry, add more yogurt or cream a little at a time. Place the dough into a large, round baking pan or baking pan that has been sprayed with non stick cooking spray. Cover the baking pan with a cloth or aluminum foil, and place it in a warm, draft free place to rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Grease the baking pan with the cooking spray, and spread the bottom and sides of the baking pan with some of the cooking spray. Spread the top of the dough with about 1/2 cup of the mashed potato, spreading it out evenly to cover the bottom. Spread out the remaining mashed potatoes, about 3/4 cup per potato, leaving the top of the dough bare. Top the dough with the mashed potatoes, starting at the outer edge farthest from you. Sprinkle the top of the dough with 1/2 cup of the tamarind paste. Bake the kadai in the preheated oven until the potato mixture is browned and the edges are crisp, about 30 minutes, and the top has turned golden brown and crisped, about 30 minutes more. Turn the pan over with a spatula, and place the baking sheet in the oven. Allow to bake until the kadai is hot and bubbling, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk baking mix,cumin powder,french bread,red pepper,mango,flat leaf parsley,oyster sauce,fenugreek
title: Furik Keema
ingredients: 1/2 lb french bread, cut into small cubes | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk baking mix, to coat bread | 2 ripe mangoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon fenugreek | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper | 1/2 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place all ingredients, except the bread, in an electric blender. Pulse until desired consistency is achieved. Spray a large baking dish with cooking spray. In a separate bowl, coat the bread cubes in bread batter and toss to coat completely. Transfer bread to baking dish. Drizzle bread with oyster sauce. Bake until bread are golden brown and crisp, about 20 - 25 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Pasta With Jelly and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 lb pasta ( i prefer rigatoni or penne, but use what you have or what you fancy ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon shortening | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons raspberry jelly or 2 tablespoons jelly jelly
instructions: Boil a large pot of water and cook the pasta until al dente. Drain pasta, reserve 1/2 cup of cooking water and set aside. In a blender or food processor, puree hazelnuts until finely chopped. Add shortening to a large pan.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,kosher salt,cumin,purpose flour,parmesan cheese,white wine,romano cheese
title: Cabbage Blintze
ingredients: 2 cups peeled and shredded red cabbage | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1/3 cup dry white wine ( optional ) or 1/3 cup water ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the cheese, flour, salt, cumin and wine or water. Mix until crumbly. Add cabbage and toss until evenly coated. Turn into a greased medium bowl or a rimmed baking sheet. Refrigerate at least 2 hours, or as long as a week. Spread topping on as much of the surface as possible without breaking the cabbage up so much.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,cooking oil,sesame seed oil,garlic powder,kielbasa sausage,yellow onion
title: Kielbasa and Sausage
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 lb kielbasa sausage | 1/2 medium yellow onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 1/3 cup cooking oil | 1 teaspoon fresh garlic powder
instructions: Slice sausage in 4 lengths. Heat oil in heavy dutch oven over medium high heat. Saute sausage until well browned, about 5 to 7 minutes. Add onions, sausage, garlic powder and cook over medium high heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Add sesame seed oil, simmer for about 10 minutes. Add stewed beef and simmer for about 10 minutes, or until beef is tender.

title: Green Olivosa
ingredients: 1 bunch green olives, with rinsed ends removed | 1/2 of a lime
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Spread the olives onto a baking sheet covered with parchment paper, and poke some holes into them with the tip of a long finger. Sprinkle the olive with the zest of 1 lime. Bake in the preheated oven 20 to 30 minutes, until puffed and lightly browned. Let cool a few minutes, then cut through the scored peel with a cut knife. Serve immediately. Store in an airtight container.

title: Pickled Onions
ingredients: 2 lbs white pearl onions | 1/2 cup cayenne pepper
instructions: Put the pearl onions in a 5 to 6 quart enameled or stainless steel steamer basket. Add the cayenne pepper and about 1/4 cup water. Cover the pan and steam over hot ashes or in a slow oven, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon, about 6 hours. If the liquid in the kettle seems thick, cook it down a bit. Uncover the pan and continue cooking, shaking the pan occasionally, until the onions are very soft, about 1½ to 2 hours more. The liquid should be reduced to the point that it loses the shape of gravy, about half the onions should be finely chopped, and the rest reserved. Pack into hot sterilized jars, leaving 1/2 inch of space at the top of each. Heat a dry nonstick pan over high heat until a bead of water dropped onto it evaporates just enough to color it. Remove the pan from the heat. Run the hot lid all around the wall with your fingers, lifting up and tapping it a few times to press any stray bits from the bottom of the pan. The water should drip off of the lid, forming a dome. Remove the jar and cool for 15 to 30 minutes. The onions should still be liquid with no signs of burnt or cracked crust. Pack the cooked drained onions back into the hot sterilized jars, seal, and seal again. Store in a cool dark place for up to a year.

Random Ingredients: oat,yellow bell pepper,salami,feta cheese,olive,coconut milk,bay scallop,baking potato
title: Mediterranean Seafood Pie
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, halved | 12 ounces salami, cut into 24 slices | 1/2 cup sliced yellow bell pepper | 1 cup sliced ripe olives, halved | 2 cups cubed cooked flaked feta cheese | 1 quart light coconut milk | 1/2 lb bay scallop | 6 ounces chopped dry flakes oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a 15 x 10 x 1 inch baking pan with foil. Place the potato slices on the foil and bake for approximately 20 minutes until tender, turning once. Meanwhile, prepare the toppings. Place the salami and bell pepper slices on a cookie sheet, sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle with cheese, then top with olives. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Remove from oven and spread coconut over the top. Return to oven and bake just a minute or two longer or until cheese is melted. Scoop into shallow bowls or an 8 x 8 inch dish. Top with scallops, crumble flakes and return to oven for another 5 minutes to heat through. Serve at once.

title: Kale Salad With Mortadella (Tomato, Corn and Cheese)
ingredients: 5 cups lacinato kale, shredded, or more to taste | 1 bunch swiss kale, or more to taste | 2 cups diced roma tomatoes, or more to taste | 1/2 cup drained capers, or to taste | 1/4 pound sliced mortadella | 3 tablespoons minced fresh sage ( optional ) | salt and black pepper to taste | 1/2 pound gruyere, or to taste, cut in strips
instructions: Toss kale, swiss kale, tomatoes, capers, and mortadella together in a large bowl. Sprinkle with sage, and season with salt and pepper. Refrigerate any juices remaining in the bowl, about 30 minutes.

title: Cauliflower in ketchup
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Bring a big pot of water to a boil. Add cauliflower and cook for about 8 minutes. Drain and serve.

title: Veal, Avocado and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces egg noodles | 1/2 lb veal, ground | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 avocado, diced | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/3 cup cheese, shredded
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions on package. Drain and set aside. Cut veal into thin strips and brown in a non stick pan with the mustard, stirring to release the flavour. Add avocado and tamarind. Return veal and noodles to the pan and stir. Place in serving bowl. Top with cheese and stir. This is better reheated in a pan when using cooked noodles.

title: Simple Baked Beans - Zubito's Style
ingredients: 1 lb fresh pinto beans, rinsed and picked over | 1 bell pepper, sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons peanuts, chopped
instructions: Place the beans in a baking dish and add enough water to cover. Bake at 350f for 1 hour and 45 minutes. Drain the beans well. Stir fry the pepper slices until slightly softened, and remove from the pan. Put the peanuts in a small bowl, and stir in some of the liquid from the baking dish until it looks like a creamy coating. Add to the peanuts, and stir to coat,. Serve with spanish rice and refried beans.

title: Barbecue Steamed With Rump
ingredients: 4 red chilies or 1/2 cup fresh red chilimoya chilies | 4 tablespoons barbecued pork fat | 4 rump steak, about 3/4 inch thick, trimmed
instructions: Pour hot barbecued pork fat into small pan and melt over medium high heat about 20 seconds. Place chilies on board, cover, and let steam for about 8 minutes or until tender. Cut steak lengthways into thirds, then into 1/2 inch strips. Thread onto soaked metal skewers and place on lightly oiled griddle pan. Cook over medium heat for a few minutes, turning, until brown and cooked through, about 4 minutes, turning often. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: seasoning mix,beef bouillon,cream tartar,brown rice flour
title: Savory Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice flour ( like bisquick ) | 1/2 cup prepared seasoning mix ( mccormick beef bouillon ) | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 1/2 teaspoons brown rice flour ( like bisquick )
instructions: Combine brown rice flour, unprepared beef bouillon, cream of tartar, and brown rice flour and mix well. Form into a ball and knead quickly, using a rolling pin. Pat into a rectangle on a cookie sheet. Repeat until all the dough is used up. Score with a sharp knife on a regular angle to allow for spreading and drying. Bake at 375 for 45 - 50 minutes or until nice and bubbly. Allow the crust to cool then cut into strips or other shapes.

title: Miso Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces miso | 5 ounces green peppers
instructions: Miso should be green and white parts not quite green, cut into pieces about the size of a pencil. Put miso in a shaker with boiling water and let sit for 5 minutes until it looks soft not mushy. Take out the miso and put on a serving plate. Take a hot saute pan.

title: Crock Pot Blueberry Steak for Two
ingredients: 1 whole steak | 1 bottle fresh blueberries
instructions: Place both crusty crocks into the crock. Open the bottle of blueberries and lay it flat on a cutting board with the fatty blade of a knife inserted into the cuts. Cut the steak into 6 serving size pieces. Pour blueberries from the cup into the crock and submerge one piece in the blueberry with the fatty blade of the knife. Cook in crock pot on high for four hours but check after 4 hours, adding more blueberries if necessary. You should be able to insert a fork into the meat to separate the pieces from the blueberries, if desired.

Random Ingredients: french onion,basil leaf,cooking spray,alfredo sauce,gorgonzola,rice,cashew,chicken breast
title: Chicken & Cashews with Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts | cooking spray | 12 ounces alfredo sauce | 1 1/2 cups cooked rice | 3 ounces gorgonzola, crumbled | 2 tablespoons basil leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup cashews, ground | fresh french onion, sliced
instructions: Place chicken to simmering water in saucepan. Cover and simmer over medium low heat for 15 minutes. While chicken is simmering set cashews and onions. Cook rice according to package directions in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Remove chicken from simmering sauce and shred. Set aside. When rice has finished cooking in saucepan, spray large heavy skillet to coat. Add sauce and bring to boil. Add shredded chicken, cashews and gorgonzola and stir to combine. Continue cooking for 15 minutes. Serve with sauteed green onions.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,quinoa,strawberry jam,buttermilk,marsala,bibb lettuce,chicken breast half,adobo sauce
title: Southwestern Bibb With Lettuce, Tomato Salad and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 3 cups leftover cooked quinoa | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved ( or 2 tsp. vegetable bouillon ) | 2 tablespoons beef gravy or 2 tablespoons homemade gravy | 1 can diced tomatoes and chiles, drained ( mexican brand or hunts ) | 1/2 cup shredded lettuce | 1/3 cup chopped fresh strawberries with dried apricots or 1/3 cup thawed unsweetened frozen strawberries | 1 tablespoon dry marsala or 1 tablespoon apple jelly, to serve
instructions: Pour the buttermilk into a measuring cup, then pour into a saucepan. Add the quinoa and bouillon cube to the buttermilk. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to medium low, cover and simmer until the liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes. When the quinoa is finished, remove the quinoa and liquid and put aside. Toss the cooked quinoa with the tomato salad, lettuce, tomatoes, chile and lettuce. Pour the quinoa mixture into 2 individual plates. Drizzle with the jelly. If desired, serve with additional jam.

title: Nutty Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese spread, room temperature | 1 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: In small bowl, beat cream cheese until mixture is smooth. Stir in walnuts. Spread in a medium size bowl or a decorative serving plate. Cover with plastic wrap. Chill until firm. Spread mixture over crackers or fresh fruit.

title: Mexican Rutabaga Pie
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds rutabagas, peeled and shredded | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1 can corn, drained ( optional ) | 1 package pastry dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix rutabaga, enchilada sauce, corn and half of the fried rutabaga until well blended.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,red onion,chicken breast half,vegetable juice,cheddar cheese,fenugreek leaf
title: Indian Spiced Chicken
ingredients: 8 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 2 inch squares | 1/2 red onion, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 1/2 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves, or to taste | 1 can vegetable juice | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Place 4 chicken breasts in a saucepan over medium heat and add red onion, ginger, fenugreek and vegetable juice. Cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Spoon chicken mixture into a baking dish and sprinkle top with cheddar cheese. Return to low heat. Broil about 3 minutes until cheese is bubbly.

title: Shrimp Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 can white hominy | 0.5 can large shrimp, drained | 2 cans white hominy | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 2 tablespoons crushed miniature marshmallows | 1/2 tablespoon salt | 1 lb fettuccine | 1/3 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Combine the 1st 10 ingredients in a large pot. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 15 minutes. While this simmers, cook pasta as stated on the packet, in large pot of boiling water, cook pasta. To serve, place small amount of pasta on plates, top with shrimp mixture, and top with kahlua.

title: Wild Rice Grilled Indian Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns, crushed and lightly crushed | 1 1/2 lbs flounder
instructions: Rinse the wild rice to remove any water. Cover lightly with clean water and allow to soak for 1 hour. Remove the wild rice and rinse in cold water to rinse away all sand. Pat dry, put in a nonreactive pan and add water to cover. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for 45 to 50 minutes, until tender. Remove from the heat and allow to stand until cool enough to handle, about 10 minutes. Trim fins and flake into serving pieces. When cool, flake up and serve.

title: Scallops on Crusty Scottish Crust
ingredients: 8 large scallops | 200 g onion soup mix
instructions: Preheat a baking tray or frypan to about 200c. Line your scallops with waxed paper. Place all these in one layer over the base of the pan. Sprinkle the soup mix over them. Bake for about 10 - 15 minutes or until scallops are well cooked and golden. Remove scallops from pan, serve with steamed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,curry powder,castor sugar,limeade concentrate,rump steak,coriander powder,swiss cheese
title: Tandoori Beef Bake
ingredients: 1 roast beef, filet ( trimmed of fat and fat ) | 1/2 lb swiss cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup coriander powder | 1/2 cup castor sugar | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1/8 ounce limeade concentrate | 2 1/2 lbs rump steak
instructions: Rub the beef with coriander powder. Coat the meat with the castor sugar then place it on a paper towel and pat lightly to wet it. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skilled and sear the meat on both sides for 1 minutes until caramelized. Transfer the meat to a large baking dish and cover with the cheese. Sprinkle with the ground coriander. Drizzle with limeade and cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving. When ready to make, bring to room temperature before serving. If using fresh coriander root, peel and thinly slice it and stir into the casserole dish. Note, prep time does not include marinating time above.

title: Tequila Cashew Margaritas
ingredients: 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 8 ounces cashews, coarsely chopped | 3 cups gold tequila
instructions: Place sugar, dill, cashews, and tequila in blender.

Random Ingredients: sugar,sage leaf,marsala wine,beef brisket,squash,garam masala powder,salami,shallot
title: Baked Beef Cubes
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 tablespoon salt | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried sage leaves | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/4 cup shallot, minced | 1 1/2 lbs squash, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Combine beef, marsala, salt, sugar, sage, masala and ginger in heavy plastic bag. Seal and turn bag to coat meat. Marinate in refrigerator 6 - 8 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Remove meat from bag. Place on rack in roasting pan. Roast in preheated oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: scallion,plain yogurt,ginger garlic paste,apple,egg white,beef tenderloin
title: Beef Tenderloin With Apples
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb beef tenderloin | 2 medium apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup scallion, chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 large egg white
instructions: Cut tenderloin into 1/4 inch slices. Set aside. In large mixing bowl combine apples, yogurt, scallion, ginger garlic paste, egg white. Blend well. Coat meat with mixture. Marinate for about 3 hours or overnight, turning occasionally. Remove meat. Let rest.

Random Ingredients: cashew,beef bouillon cube,black eyed pea,vegetable,catsup,italian dressing
title: Sweet and Spicy Cashew Beef Soup (Oamc)
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen mixed vegetables | 16 ounces frozen black-eyed peas | 1 can macaroni beans, drained and rinsed | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 3/4 cup catsup ( or to taste ) | 1 bottle italian dressing
instructions: Put everything except the dressing in a blender and process until creamy. Pour mixture in a soup pot with a lid and heat to boiling then reduce heat immediately to low. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat to cool, refrigerate overnight. Bring to a boil and stir well. Stir again before serving.

title: Simple Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 cups fresh baby spinach leaves | 6 slices lean bacon, crisped and chopped | 1 tablespoon catsup | 4 teaspoons basmati rice, to serve
instructions: Place the spinach leaves in a medium pan, drizzle with 1 teaspoons of catsup, toss to coat leaves and place on a serving plate.

Random Ingredients: tamari,chili pepper flake,plain yogurt,ricotta cheese,hot italian sausage,beet,ice,breadcrumb
title: Italian Sausage Meatballs (Ciliegine Romana)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ground breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1 1 lb hot italian sausage, crumbled | 15 ounces ricotta cheese ( i use plain yogurt and a little extra ) | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 cup plain yogurt | ice ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Mix together the bread crumbs, chili, and italian sausage in a large bowl. Form the meat mixture into meatballs, each about 2 or 3 inches in diameter, and place onto a rack in a baking dish, skin side down. Bake for about 30 minutes, until well browned and cooked through. While meatballs are baking, mix together the ricotta cheese, plain yogurt, and tamari. Serve with the meatballs and the ice if desired.

title: Spicy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili flakes ( vietnamese chili is best ) | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon dried red chilies | chopped chutney, to serve
instructions: Stir all ingredients together and serve chilled.

title: Lentils With Coconut and Beer
ingredients: 4 cups brown lentils | 1 piece kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Place the lentils in a wide, nonreactive pan. Cover generously with cold water and cover tightly with lid. Stick the saffir lime leaf into the top layer of water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 40 minutes. Uncover and cook 30 minutes more, or until lentils are soft. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 15 minutes. Remove lime leaf before serving.

title: Easy Creamy alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces alfredo sauce ( or homemade made in jar ) | 1 tablespoon red wine, divided ( red burgundy is ideal ) | 1 teaspoon orange zest, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Put in blender jar and mix until smooth or use your immersion blender. Add remaining ingredients and blend. Add to your favourite pasta and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,cream mushroom soup,pork loin roast,corn flake crumb,apple,vinegar,vanilla essence,soya sauce
title: Low Fat Pork Loin Roast with Apples
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast | 2/3 - 1 cup corn flakes crumbs | 3/4 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can apple slices, slices | 1 -3 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 3 -5 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Mix the dry bread crumbs and the confectioners' sugar in a shallow dish. Take the pork roast out of the oven and poke with a fork all over. Spoon the stuffing onto the pork and roll it up securing with tooth picks. Bake in a foil pan or in the oven at 300 degrees f. For about 1/2 hour, or until very well browned. Mix the cream of mushroom soup, apples and soya sauce in a mixing bowl. Slice the loin roast into 1 inch pieces and pour the soup mixture over the top. Cover pan tightly. Cook for 30 minutes after removing tooth picks. Mix the vinegar and vanilla essence. Remove from heat immediately and pour over the loin roast. Sprinkle the confectioners' sugar over the roast and serve.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,pork tenderloin,caster sugar,chili oil,wheat flour,peanut butter,lasagna noodle,lobster meat
title: Lobster Cannelloni
ingredients: 400 g smoked pork tenderloin, sliced into 24 squares | 400 g lobster meat, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/4 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 100 g whole wheat flour | 12 lasagna noodles
instructions: Heat a non stick pan over a medium heat. Stir fry the pork in the pan for 10 minutes stirring all the time until it is coated with the pan base. Add the lobster meat to the pan and cook for 5 minutes. In a small bowl combine the peanut butter, chilli oil, sugar and olive oil. Add the flour and stir until combined. Stir into the pork mixture. Cook for 1 minute stirring all the time. Meanwhile cook lasagna noodles according to the packet directions. Drain and rinse with cold water and drain well. Layer a large serving plate with 1/4 of the noodles, then add 1/2 of the cannelloni mixture. Repeat with another 1/2 of the noodles, the remaining 1/2 of the noodle mixture and the remaining cannelloni. Serve with pesto sauce.

Random Ingredients: water,angel hair pasta,iceberg lettuce,salsa,portabella mushroom cap,baking potato,balsamic vinegar
title: Roasted Sweet Potato With Lettuce, Mushrooms, & Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 2/3 lb baking potato, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 head iceberg lettuce, separated into leaves and torn into bite-size pieces | 1 cup sliced portabella mushroom cap | 1/2 cup salsa | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 4 teaspoons water | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place the potato slices on a baking sheet, cover with foil, and roast until tender, 15 to 20 minutes, flipping once halfway through. Transfer potatoes to a medium bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let the potatoes steam for 15 minutes. Remove foil from the potatoes, and set aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to boiling over high heat. Add lettuce and cook until tender, about 4 minutes for fresh, 6 to 8 minutes for the crisp tender. Drain the lettuce, and set aside. Meanwhile, transfer the mushrooms to a small bowl, and drizzle with 1/2 cup salsa. Toss to coat them. Season with a pinch of salt. Spread the mushroom mixture on a plate, and top with the roasted sweet potato slices and sweet potato slices. Drizzle with remaining 1/2 cup salsa, and add 2 teaspoons water. Toss and sprinkle with parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Cherry Onion and Pork Pie (Pastry Recipe)
ingredients: 1 small white onion, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons oil | 600 g chuck or 600 g blade steaks, cut to desired size pieces | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon polenta or 1 tablespoon oat flour | 1/2 cup cherry brandy or 1/2 cup vodka ( i use just shake out a few drops of the alcohol )
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan and then add the meat. Let it brown quickly and add the onion slices. Stir the meat around until it is cooked and the onion flavour is released. Add the vanilla. Dissolve in the brandy or vodka. Add your desired quantity of pastry. Roll out your dough to desired size and place it on your baking sheet. Poke holes in the pastry with a fork to allow steam to escape during baking. Allow it to rest for a few minutes before putting your pie on your oven rack. Turn on your broiler and place your pie in the oven. Turn off the heat. Allow to rest for a few minutes. Cut and cut in slices. Serve with your favourite condiments.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,vinegar,shrimp paste,white pepper,bulb garlic,grenadine,pepperoni sausage,greek olive
title: Grecian Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef tenderloin, cut into 1-1/2 inch slices | 1 dash pepperoni sausage, or as needed | 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni sausage, or as needed | 1 teaspoon shrimp paste, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon vinegar, or as needed | 1 tablespoon gummi d'aloupe greek olive spread, or as needed | 1/8 teaspoon vinegar, or as needed | 1 pinch white pepper | 1 bulb garlic
instructions: Arrange beef slices in an even layer atop a work surface. Spread pepperoni or sausage atop beef slices. Wrap pepperoni with a slice of pepperoni. Fold pepperoni slices over pepperoni. Wrap a toothpick through all slices to secure.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,phyllo pastry,asafoetida powder,prosciutto,grain rice,gruyere cheese
title: Pinchi Triangles or Cheese Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups short grain rice | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder or 1/4 teaspoon other thickener | 1/2 lb thinly sliced prosciutto | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and minced | 1/2 lb fresh grated gruyere cheese | 8 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Combine rice and asafetida in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered, covered, for 20 minutes, until the rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Add the prosciutto, chilli, and gruyere cheese and stir well to combine.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,flat leaf italian parsley,phyllo dough,fudge topping,egg white,vegetable oil cooking spray,cranberry
title: Fudge Baklava
ingredients: 16 sheets phyllo dough | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups peanut butter, creamy | 3/4 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fudge topping ( i use nutella ) | 2 eggs whites, hard-cooked & chopped | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with veggie spray. Cut a piece of parchment or wax paper to fit over the top of baking sheet. Set aside. On a piece of parchment, lay out 8 sheets of phyllo sheet and spray with vegetable oil spray. Place another piece of parchment on top of the phyllo sheet, spraying it with vegetable oil spray. Continue layering till all sheets have been used and have been used. Set aside. Whisk your eggs together in a bowl. Make sure your peanut butter is creamy, then whip in your crumbled fudge topping. Spray a pan with vegetable oil spray and put a few sheets in the pan. Spread about 2/3 of the peanut butter mixture over the phyllo in a thin layer. Then top that with another layer of phyllo, this time brushing with the peanut butter mixture after the fudge mixture is spread over. Repeat with the remaining phyllo, peanut butter layer and fudge mixture. Then top with cranberries, pecans and parsley. Bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Tart Apples Stuffed With Lamb
ingredients: 700 g lamb or 700 g chicken ( 1/3 pound ) | 1 small tart apple | 100 g fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Wash the meat, then prick the lamb with a fork. Place a small piece of onion, or some finely chopped onions, in the centre of each piece of meat. Place each piece of meat on top of the onion. Cover with a piece of apple. Spread some spinach leaves on top. Bake in a moderate oven for 1½ hours,. If you like your meat crispy and brown, cover loosely with foil after ½ hour of cooking. Leave to rest for 20 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,pesto sauce,purpose flour,cauliflower,caster sugar,eggplant,half,bell pepper
title: A Very Healthy Mixture with Cauliflower - Low Fat!
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1 medium bell pepper | 1 large cauliflower | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1/3 cup basil pesto sauce | 2 ounces romano cheese | 3/4 cup fat-free half-and-half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c. Cut out the very centre of the eggplant and slice it into 1cm thick rounds. Put in a heavy pan with a lid or on top of a baking paper. Bake for 15 minutes or until slightly charred on the edges, then flip over to bake. Set aside on an oven tray and roast for a further 10 minutes or until blackened on the first side and charred. Turn the oven down to 180c, remove the lid and roast for a further 10 minutes or until charred on the second side and charred. Set aside on an oven tray and cook the cauliflower for 10 minutes, peel and cut into 1cm slices. Put aside. Put the flour in a bowl. Add sugar, pesto and half and half. Beat until smooth. Add the eggplant and the peppers to the eggplant, mix through and then transfer to a baking tray. Bake for 20 minutes or until well cooked and bubbling. Serve with a fresh salad and crisp bread.

title: Aussie Xanthan Glaze for Ham Roll Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup sugar substitute | 1/2 cup cognac | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 cup shredded deli ham ( from the deli ) | 1 teaspoon shredded orange peel
instructions: Combine sugar substitute, cognac, xanthan gum, ham, orange peel, and 2 1/2 tbsp water.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,fish sauce,cooking onion,asparagus,apple jelly,green chili,green bell pepper
title: Sweet and Sour Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 bag trimmed asparagus ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 0.5 package trimmed green peas ( about 8 cups ) | 3/4 lb green bell pepper ( about 1 large ) | 1/4 cup apple jelly | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1/2 cup quick-cooking onion, peeled ( such as vidalia ) | 1 tablespoon fresh green chili, sliced ( such as thai ) | cooked basmati rice or steamed jasmine rice
instructions: In a large, nonstick skillet or wok, add asparagus and green peas. Cook until asparagus is just crisp tender, about 2 minutes or less. Add sweetener mixture, chilies, and onion.

title: Cornflour Nests
ingredients: 300 g cornflour ( corn starch ) | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 1/3 cup green onion, finely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Combine cornflour and sugar in a bowl and set aside. Add sunflower seeds and green onion and mix well. Measure 1/4 cup of flour mixture and gently stir in with fingers until it is well combined and the mixture starts to stick together. Drop heaped tbsp onto a greased oven tray. Bake for around 15 minutes until golden.

title: Sirloin With Fennel and Honey
ingredients: 750 g sirloin | 4 tablespoons honey | 1/2 bunch fresh fennel bulb | 1 tablespoon dried chives | 1 tablespoon ground flax seed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 deg celsius. Use a sharp knife in your slicing blade. Slice the meat lengthways into thin strips. Place on a baking tray. Place in the oven for 30minutes and then turn and check every 10 mins to make sure it's cooked all the way through. You might want to slice the meat after 30 min for the meat to brown on it's own but remove it at around 80 - 60 degrees if you think it's needed. Serve straight away with plain boiled rice or pasta and a green salad.

title: Mexican Brandy
ingredients: 3/4 cup granulated sugar | 1 cup salsa verde, drained | 15 -20 ladyfingers
instructions: In saucepan, combine the sugar, salsa verde, and ladyfingers. Bring to a simmer and cook until hot. Remove from heat and cool slightly. In a shallow dish, carefully dip lady fingers into sugar mixture. Arrange coated finger fingers in single layer in a single layer and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. Store covered at room temperature.

title: Strawberry Macaroni
ingredients: 1 small fresh chili pepper, chopped | 1 quart fresh strawberries, hulled | 1 pint fresh hulled strawberries | 1/3 cup almond liqueur | 1 package uncooked elbow macaroni
instructions: In a large slow cooker, combine the chili, strawberries, hulled strawberries, and almond liqueur. Cook on high, setting timer for one hour. Serve macaroni in a bowl with slotted spoon.

title: Pancake With a Hot Berry Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, roasted peeled | 1/2 lb strawberry liqueur | 1 -2 small red chilies, seeded and minced | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon thyme | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1/2 cup brandy or 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Coat or lightly grease a 9 inch pie plate. Spread hazelnuts on the bottom and up the sides of the prepared pie plate. In a small bowl stir together cream, chilies, and remaining ingredients. Spoon into the nut crust and bake on the middle rack of the oven, basting several times, for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool to room temperature.

title: Nasi Lemak (Kurdish Cottage Candy)
ingredients: 1 lb half-and-half cream | 6 ounces fresh cashews | 1/2 cup galangal, shredded ( ginger can be substituted ) | 2 tablespoons corn chips or 2 tablespoons flour
instructions: In a saucepan or skillet over low heat, combine cashews, galangal, and half and half. Stir frequently to combine, then remove from heat. Add cashews to cashew mixture, and stir until thoroughly mixed. Add corn chips or flour, stirring until all pieces are coated. Add remaining cashew mixture. Spread on waxed paper to cool.

title: Guinness Swiss Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup guiness soy sauce | 1/4 cup canned guinness stout | 6 thick slices swiss cheese | 4 fresh cilantro stems, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce and guinness. Place a slice of cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,green cardamom pod,rum,lemongrass,nigella seed,baking potato
title: Malaysian Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 stalk lemongrass, cleaned and cut diagonally into 2 inch lengths | 1 teaspoon nigella seeds | 2 whole green cardamom pods | 3 tablespoons rum ( optional ) | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Cover the potato slices with water in a large pot, and bring to a boil. Boil until tender but firm, about 15 minutes. Drain, and allow to cool before removing the potatoes. Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Arrange the potatoes on a broiler pan, and broil. Arrange lemongrass, nigella seeds, cardamom pods, and rum over the potatoes. Season with salt and pepper. Reduce heat to medium low, and place a cover on the pan. Cook 5 minutes in the preheated oven, until the bread crisps and is lightly toasted.

Random Ingredients: artichoke,sesame oil,lemon peel,chocolate,sea salt,meat,parsley sprig,black peppercorn
title: BBQ Salmon on Skewers
ingredients: 1 whole fresh salmon | 1 can artichokes, drained and chopped | 1 cup raw peanuts or 1 cup raw cashews | 4 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate | sea salt | freshly cracked black peppercorns | freshly grated lemon peel | fresh parsley sprig
instructions: For the marinade, mix all the marinade ingredients and refrigerate for 2 days. Remove salmon from marinade and dry thoroughly on paper towel. Cut into slices and skewer salmon. Grill on high heat or broil until cooked to your liking, about 5 minutes on each side. Cut into slices and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: sauce,green olive,self rising flour,splenda brown sugar
title: Potted Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon splenda brown sugar blend | 1/3 cup chopped green olives | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Lightly grease a shallow 2 lb. Baking sheet with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil spray. Combine flour and sugar in a medium bowl, stir in olives and hot sauce to taste. Pour into a pastry bag fitted with the 1/2 inch round tip. Press each tip into the flour. Cut a round off your flat knife with a sharp knife or razor blade. Place 2 inch apart on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes. Turn oven off and leave potted bread in the oven with a potted spoon in the oven. Leave door slightly ajar to allow steam to escape during cooking. Allow to cool, then enjoy.

title: Grandma's Sauce for French Bread
ingredients: 4 cups dry sherry wine vinegar | 4 cups palm sugar | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 cups cake flour
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the vinegar, palm sugar, worcestershire sauce and cake flour. Place the mixture into a jar and let stand overnight for flavors to blend. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bring to room temperature, then stir the mixture until it will coat the back of a spoon.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,black sesame seed,spaghetti sauce,green chile,cacao,pesto sauce
title: Pesto Lasagna Rollups With Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, cooked, cooled | 2 cans spaghetti sauce ( i prefer newman's own ) | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 2 cans chopped canned green chiles | 2 cups shredded fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to generously spray a 13 x 9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Blanch the lasagna noodles by placing them in a bowl of cold water and letting them stand for 10 minutes until al dente. Drain immediately, place in a bowl, and toss with spaghetti sauce. Mix the pesto, chilies, parmigiano cheese, and black sesame seeds. Spread half the mixture evenly within the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Spread out the noodles, breaking them up to fit. Spread the second layer of pesto mixture. Arrange the noodles, slightly overlapping, in a spoke pattern over the pesto spread. Spread 1/3 of the chile mixture over the noodles. Spread 1/3 of the pesto mixture over the noodles. Spread the remaining pesto mixture over the noodles, and continue to spread. Sprinkle with remaining grated cheese. Bake at 375ëš f for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly around the edges.

Random Ingredients: green pea,tamarind paste,cumin seed,cumin,green onion,rigatoni pasta,pepperoni
title: Moroccan Pesto Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 cup green peas | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped | 1 jar sliced pepperoni | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.

title: The Great Canadian Chili Dip
ingredients: 15 fluid ounces bottled clam juice | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/4 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1/8 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Pour clam juice and oil into a blender. Add chile powder and feta cheese.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,tomatillo,nonfat milk,butter bean,corn tortilla chip,turmeric powder,beef,lamb
title: Moroccan Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs ground lamb | 1/2 lb ground tart apple | 1 can tomatillos, chopped | 1 can nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons butter beans, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 whole corn tortilla chips, coarsely crushed | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In a large saucepan, brown ground lamb until no longer pink. Drain fat. Add chopped tatillos, nonfat milk, turmeric and tamari. Simmer until tender. Drain excess fat from saucepan. Spray 2 qt slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray. Add half of the tortilla chips. Top with remaining tortilla, meat mixture and browned chips. Cover and cook on low heat for 7 to 8 hours. Garnish with green onions and/or sour cream if desired. Serve with sour cream.

title: Chocolate-Crusted Rigatoni (Casarello Pasta)
ingredients: 3 ounces unsalted butter | 7 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 3 ounces dark chocolate or 3 ounces semisweet chocolate | 1 cup light margarita mix ( store-bought or home-made ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Prepare the rigatoni according to package directions and reserve. Meanwhile, melt the butter in a heavy medium sized skillet over medium high heat. Add the pasta and bring to boil, stirring occasionally until they are tender, but firm to the bite and the sauce is beginning to thicken. Add the dark chocolate, margarita mix and oyster sauce and turn off the heat. Serve immediately, garnishing with the chopped nuts if desired.
