Random Ingredients: marjoram,tart apple,saffron,white bread,cashew,chinese five spice powder
title: Apple Crumble
ingredients: 2 ounces unsalted cashews | 2 medium tart apples ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon saffron | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves | 6 ounces unsalted dry white bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f and grease a small baking sheet with a little olive oil. Peel the apples, place them in the mixing bowl with the cashews and then sprinkle on the remaining spices. Peel the apples from the pit and remove the core. Slice into 1/4 lengths, then roughly chop them into similar sized wedges. In a small bowl, mix the dates with the sffron. Dry toast the bread over a moderate heat, sprinkle with a little of the marjoram or thyme, then pour over the date mixture and toss well. Tip out the crumble onto the prepared baking sheet, spread the remaining marjoram or thyme on top, then sprinkle the rest of the marjoram or thyme on top and bake for about 15 minutes, until golden brown and bubbly. Remove from the oven, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,vegetable oil,cranberry,black cardamom pod,golden raisin
title: Fruit Lovers' Chipotle Raisins
ingredients: 30 g golden raisins ( or a few puffs- up to 50g if you can find them ) | 20 g dried cranberries | 1 chipotle chile, seed removed | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | black cardamom pod ( optional ) | 1 pkts. chipotle chile, seeds | 1 tablespoon granulated garlic or 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Place raisins in a small bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave to soak for 10 minutes or until softened. Drain. Break apart with fingers or fingers a few times with your fingers. Heat oil on medium heat in a small saucepan. When hot, add cardamom pods and cardamom pods and cook for 30 secons until fragrant. Add garlic and saute for 30 seconds. Add raisins and stir. Cook for 2 minutes or until slightly firm. Remove and discard cardom pods or warn your guests to stir in the contents at the very end. Serve immediately.

title: Fish in Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 800 g chicken ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon seafood special sauce or 1 teaspoon red hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Marinate for an hour. Cook in the oven on a hot tray until the fish turns opaque.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,black peppercorn,cottage cheese,rice wine,rotel tomato,salt black pepper,beet
title: Cabbage Roll (Colcannon)
ingredients: 1 small savoy cabbage, about 8oz. | 3 tablespoons dry shao hsing rice wine or 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt ( may use white salt ) | 6 black peppercorns | 15 ounces rotel tomatoes, drained | 1/3 2/3 cup low-fat cottage cheese or 1/3 cup cream cheese, cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped beet, roasted ( see note )
instructions: Core cabbage and remove excess moisture. Cut leaf head into very thin slices, then slice crosswise 3/4 inch thick. Place cabbage in a large bowl with all remaining ingredients and mix well. Place mixture into a greased 13 x 9 inch glass baking dish. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate until set, about 3 hours. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Unwrap foil and bake until hot through, about 30 minutes, about 20 minutes, covered tightly with foil. Uncover and bake until browned, about 10 minutes more. Slice into 16 equal portions.

title: Banana "dressing" on Pita Chips
ingredients: 4 pita bread or 4 kaiser rolls | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded ( about 10 oz. ) | 1 sweet banana, sliced thin | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/4 cup red wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients or shake shake all together. Note, if using a pita, break off a tiny bit of each lettuce leaf, then add to the salad. Place a lettuce leaf on a warm pita bread or serve on one or more plates.

title: Tofu on the Edge
ingredients: 1 piece tofu | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Cut the tofu into cubes or slices, about an inch and a half and abot to the side of a large, heavy skillet. Pour about 1/4 inch of water into the skillet so the tofu doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan. Sprinkle the ras el hanout over the tofu and bring it to a simmer. Cook the tofu over medium heat for about 10 minutes, stirring gently.

title: Korean Soy Ginger Beer (Tjapu)
ingredients: 1 cup ice water | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce ( i buy mine at asian market )
instructions: First, put ice water in blender. Pour in liquid ingredients and mix until smooth. Put into clean glass. Cover lid with a towel and allow to set for 4 - 6 hours at room temperature in fridge.. Pour through fine mesh strainer to get all solids out and into bottle or bottle. Shake bottle very well to release all solids. If you do not have a strainer, you can use a fine mesh strainer over a large pot of boiling water and let sit for 5 minutes. Discard solids. You can strain the brew into a gallon storage container over medium heat, pressing the solids to release flavor. This goes very well with the ice cold beer.

title: Chinese Sweet and Spicy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil | 1 cup catsup, divided
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together 1/4 cup catsup and remaining 1/2 cup catsup. Pour in oil.

title: Chinese Style Cauliflower Rice & Vegetables
ingredients: 10 leaves cauliflower florets | 1 cup jasmine rice | 1/2 cup tea or 1/2 cup water
instructions: Bring a medium sized pot to boil. Add the rice. Stir until the grains have absorbed all the water. Add the tea, stir well. Turn down the heat to medium and continue to stir. It shouldn't burn or get lumpy. The longer it cooks the more it will absorb. Leave the rice on the stove for about 2 more minutes. Turn off the stove and allow the rice to cool. Serve warm or chilled. This meal goes well with a light salad or fresh vegetables. It's traditionally served with a leaf of sweet red onion. You can also serve it with other dishes.

title: Chinese String Beans (Char Siu)
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh string beans | 3/4 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder
instructions: Cut string beans longitudinally, then slice broadly. Trim string beans, then cut string beans crosswise into fourths, then slice crosswise into fourths again, then cut lengthwise into fourths. Combine pork tenderloin with ginger in mixing bowl, then marinate overnight in refrigerator. Remove strings bean slices from marinade, reserving marinade. Mix pork tenderloin and reserved marinade with ginger mixture in separate bowl. Heat 3 1/2 tablespoons oil in 12 inch nonstick skillet over high heat for 1 minute or until just starting to smoke. Add bean slices and cook until golden, 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from skillet with slotted spatula or tongs and set aside. Repeat with remaining oil and pork. Sprinkle with a small pinch of salt before serving.

title: Beef and Parsnip Stew
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 large parsnips, peeled, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 bag frozen corn, thawed | lemon wedge ( optional ) | 1 can pinto beans, drained | refried beans, heated
instructions: In a large saucepan, cook beef and parsnips until beef is no longer pink. Stir in undrained beans, corn and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 20 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender. Transfer beef mixture to a large platter. Mash 2 cans of beans with reserved liquid. Stir into beef mixture. Serve with lemon wedges, if desired.

Random Ingredients: thai basil,nonfat milk powder,fire tomato,white hominy,chicken wing,baking potato
title: Super Easy Chicken and Hominy Casserole
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled and cubed | 6 cups cooked chicken wings, separated into thighs and drumsticks, cut into drumsticks and wings | 1 can chopped fire-roasted tomatoes | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 2 cans white hominy, drained | 1 bunch thai basil, torn
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium high heat, stir together the potato, chicken, tomatoes, nonfat dry milk powder and hominy. Cover and cook 5 to 12 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in basil and remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes before eating.

Random Ingredients: walnut,red pepper flake,vegetable stock,lamb shoulder,potato,horseradish,picante sauce
title: Picante Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lamb shoulder ( cubed ) | 2 cups picante sauce | 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons fresh grated horseradish | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes | 4 medium potatoes | 3 tablespoons walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Heat in crock pot on low for 8 hours. Stir in picante sauce and stir till combined. Discard bone, and slice pork into 1 inch cubes. Put in greased casserole dish and simmer 30 minutes on top. Add horseradish, and crush dried peppers in a small bowl. When stew is done, stir into stew and heat through. Top with walnuts, if desired.

title: Homemade Guacamole
ingredients: 1/2 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup chopped dried cranberries
instructions: Stir together the guacamole, cranberries and dried cranberries. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,belgian endive,cream mushroom soup,irish cream
title: Mushroom Cream
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup belgian endive, chopped | fresh mint sprig, to garnish ( optional ) | irish cream, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Combine mushrooms soup and endive in medium bowl. Cover.

title: Cheese and Wine Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Spread the cheese and pepper cheese on a lightly greased skillet. Place heat on 1/4 to 1/2 to 1/2 to 1 1/3 of the skillet. When cheese begins to melt, about 2 minutes, remove pan from the heat, carefully transfer to a hot, clean skillet. Let it sit about 1 minute. Using a wide cast iron skillet, cook this about 10 seconds or so, until the outside is lightly browned. Carefully lift quesadilla from pan, cut in half vertically and cut each half in quarters.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,queso anejo,mozzarella ball,shortening,green curry paste
title: Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 package queso anejo, crumbled | 2 teaspoons green curry paste | 4 teaspoons shortening | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, or to taste | 1/2 cup chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Stir the anejo, green curry paste, and shortening together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,manchego cheese,veal cutlet,blueberry,straw mushroom,eggplant,dark chocolate,chipotle chile
title: Chicken-Veggie-Couscous With Straw Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, cubed | 1/2 cup crumbled manchego cheese ( or any white white cheese ) | 1/2 cup halved fresh strawberries or 1/2 cup sliced fresh baby spinach, rinsed | 2 teaspoons curry powder, divided | 3 large boneless veal cutlets | 8 ounces firm dark chocolate, chopped | 1 can sliced canned chipotle chiles, drained, divided | 2 cups blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a 7x11 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In medium bowl, combine onion, cheese and 1/4 cup of curry powder until well blended. Stir in eggplant and remaining curry powder. Press tofu slices into mixture until coated. Bake uncovered until eggplant is crisp, approximately 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle tofu with chocolate and remaining 1/4 cup curry powder. To serve, transfer tofu mixture to a serving platter. Scatter blueberries over tofu. Microwave remaining 2 tablespoons cocoa until chocolate is melted. Top with chocie.

title: Lamb and Pomegranate Salad With Walnut Topping
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 jar pomegranate fruit | 3/4 cup chopped yellow onion | 1/4 cup chopped pimiento | 3 -4 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts, toasted, finely chopped | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 2 -4 green olives, pitted and minced
instructions: Toss lamb with pomegranate and onion in large bowl. Combine pomegranate juice, vinegar, walnuts, green olives and pimento in small bowl. Serve as follows. Stir dressing over salad.

title: Colcannon, savoy cabbage is the authentic way
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry ( ready to bake or store-bought ) | 1 savoy cabbage, washed | 1 tablespoon plum jelly ( or jelly crystals )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees celsius/450°f. Thaw out the puff pastry before starting recipe. Slice up the cooked cabbage thin. Line a shallow ovenproof dish with the pastry. Arrange the sliced cabbage over the pastry. Cut a slit through the top of the pastry at the base of the dish. Sprinkle the plum jelly inside the slit. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until pastry is golden.

title: Tandoori Chapli (Chocolate Butter Candy)
ingredients: 1 lb dark chocolate | 2 lbs chat masala, powdered ( indian masala, available at most indian grocery shops ) | 16 -26 ounces mace, powder ( available at most indian grocery stores stores and some supermarkets )
instructions: Bring a saucepan of almost boiling water to a boil, and add the dark semisweet chocolate and sweetened mace powder. Stir well until the chocolate is completely melted. When the chocolate and butter mixture is completely melted, remove it from the heat. Add the chaat masala and stir until the chaat masala completely dissolves. Remove the pan from the stove and pour into clean airtight containers. Store in a cool dark place for up to two weeks or refrigerate for up to a month.

title: Chile and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 serrano pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Using a spoon, scrape out a thick slice out of the bottom of each cabbage leaf. Place some of the sliights of the chile in the hollow of each leaf, leaving about 2 inches of headspace at the top of the leaf. Wrap the cabbage tightly in foil. Bake in a 300 degree f to 300º oven for 2 hours. The cabbage should be tender and slightly browned.

title: Smothered Pitas with Thousand Island Dip
ingredients: 1 whole wheat pita | 1 dash hot sauce | 1 dash worcestershire sauce | 1 dash steak sauce | sage | rosemary | chili pepper
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350'f or 200'c. Use a slotted spoon, and cut the pitas in half so they are small. Insert a slice of rosemary into each half, and stud with a small slice of chili pepper. Pour hot sauce and worcestershire sauce into a cup, and sprinkle both sides of the pitas with a little coarse salt, then cover with foil. Bake for about 15 minutes. Then turn a couple of times until the pitas are browned on top. Remove from oven, and serve with thousand island dip for dipping.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,yellow cornmeal,bamboo shoot,wheat pastry flour,kaffir lime leaf,buttermilk
title: Wild Rice Pancakes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1/3 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 6 -10 fresh kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, add all ingredients with a fork and mix well. Heat a lightly oiled griddle/griddle over medium heat. Oil your griddle/griddle/griddle should be about 6 inches from the heat source. Pour in 1 tablespoon of batter and push slightly with a spatula to spread evenly. Cook until golden on the bottom, about 1 minute per side. Turn pancakes over. Cook until the second side is golden, about 1 minute more. The pancakes will puff up and stick together like an ice cream cone, and when flipped remove from the griddle/griddle and place on a platter to keep warm. Repeat with remaining batter. Serve warm.

title: Vietnamese Noodle Salad (Cha Kho)
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon catsup | 1/4 teaspoon mustard | 1 cup napa sweet noodles | 3 -4 fresh mint leaves, chopped | 3 -4 pieces tomatillos ( i prefer small )
instructions: In a salad bowl with a spoon, stir together cream, mayot, catsup and mustard until well mixed and set aside. Combine napa sweet noodles and chopped mint leaves together in another salad bowl. Pour dressing over the noodles and mix well. Chill the salad until ready to serve.

title: Spaghetti Agli Barioca (String Beans Con Chocolate)
ingredients: 2 lbs spaghetti, raw | 10 ounces string beans ( i use baby ones ) | 2 ounces unsweetened cocoa, nibs ( optional )
instructions: First you put the spaghetti in a large pot of hot water, and salt the water until it boils. Cook the noodles until they are tender, but still firm. Drain in a colander, and set aside. In a large bowl, soak the sticks of string beans overnight in the boiling spaghetti water. When you are ready to eat, drain the beans and string beans, and reserve the water, from the cooking spaghetti. The spaghetti needs water, so add the spaghetti after it has cooked for about 12 minutes. Mix well, and put the spaghetti aside to cool. In a jar with plenty of ventilation, put an empty jar inside a clean, disinfected jar. Microwave the cocoa nibs for about 30 seconds, making them soft and not brittle. Take them out as soon as they are cool enough to handle. Put a small plate on top to weigh them down. Keep the plate on top until the cocoa nibs are cool enough to handle, then take a small amount of the cocoa nibs. Take 1/2 tsp. Of the cocoa nibs, and coat them in the nibs, and roll them in the cocoa to coat all the pieces of nibs. Store covered in the refrigerator.

title: Pecorino Romano With Sausage and Chipotles
ingredients: 1 lb salt pork, cut into 1-inch dice | 1 chile, roasted, seeded and finely chopped or 1 -2 teaspoon canned chipotle chile | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | additional salt, to taste ( about 1/4 teaspoon ) | additional chipotle chile, for garnish | sweet and sour sauce, for serving
instructions: Heat the grill to high. Rinse the salt pork and pat dry. Grill the salt pork until cooked through, about 5 to 6 minutes. Place the chile in a dry skillet over moderate heat and toast slightly until crisp, a few minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon. Stir in the garlic chile and turn heat to medium. Add the cheese and cook until melted, about 1 minute. Stir in the salt and stir until blended. Transfer mixture to a warm serving bowl and mound on a platter. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Sesame
ingredients: 8 ounces mini marshmallows | 3/4 cup white sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Using a blender, blend all ingredients until completely mixed. Spread evenly onto a baking sheet.

title: Tara's Delicious Rice Pies for One!
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 2 cups crushed tomatoes with ketchup | 1 medium red onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 package puff pastry sheets | 1 dried dates, soaked and cut into thin chiffonade
instructions: Put rice, red onion, tomato ketchup, and water in a pot on a medium heat, stir so that everything is mixed well and bring to a boil. Cover and boil on low heat until water has almost completely evaporated. Line 2 individual pie tins with the pastry sheets, you can use any size pastry sheet, just fill the empty shells you have inches. Spread half the rice mixture evenly over each pastry sheet. Sprinkle with a few slices of dates. Cut the pastry sheets in half. Cook in a 180 degree c oven for 30 - 40 minutes until cooked.

title: Mexican Spiced Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice | 2 small dried red chilies | 2 teaspoons orange juice | 100 g epazote
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until thickened. Transfer to a food processor or blender and blend until smooth. If needed, pour through a fine sieve to drain any excess liquid. Store in an airtight container.

title: Brazilian Dry Rub
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 2 teaspoons ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 4/5 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 5 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons basil
instructions: Mix together the coriander seeds, nutmeg, and cinnamon in a mortar until you have a coarse mixture. Add 3/4 cup cocoa powder. Rub into meat, and spread on vegetables, pork, meatballs, or anything else that has seasonings. Store any leftover spice in a glass jar at room temperature.

title: Cowboy Cavatelli Soup
ingredients: 1 can eagle brand condensed milk ( 2 1/2 oz ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked
instructions: Place penne in large pot over medium heat and stir till water is just lightly above pasta. Add eagle brand milk and stir till heated through. Add uncooked rigatoni and stir to mix.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,dark soy sauce,sirloin steak,yellow onion,taco seasoning,gingerroot,cream chicken soup,heavy cream
title: Aunt Sally's Sirloin
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut 3/4 inch thick | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 small yellow onion, sliced ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon minced fresh gingerroot | 1 can cream of pumpkin soup ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/3 cup dried parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Heat a large skillet and lightly brush with oil. Slice the sliced sirloin into strips and place in the hot skillet. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and saute on all sides about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from pan and set aside. Add the chopped onions to the skillet and saute until softened. Add the cream of pumpkin soup and dark soy sauce and simmer over medium heat about 5 minutes. Add the shredded meat back to the skillet and add the cream of chicken and stir well. Bring mixture to a low boil and simmer on low for about one hour or until meat is very tender. Remove beef and discard the onion and garlic. When meat is tender, heat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the cheese evenly over the top of your favorite crackers. If desired, heat a large ovenproof skillet and heat over medium high heat. Add beef mixture and the marinated onions. Serve in shallow slices with lots of sauce.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,ketchup,rye bread,spinach,green chili pepper,sage leaf
title: Spinach on the Side
ingredients: 1 kg spinach, washed | 2 cups fresh grated ginger-root | 1 green chili pepper, washed and finely chopped | 2 cups ketchup | 200 g rye bread | sage leaves, garnished
instructions: Boil 5 cups of water in a vessel. Once it is boiled, take it out and drain it with a cloth or sieve. Allow it to cool. Now peel the spinach, wash it under running water, drain thoroughly and finely pat dry with an absorbent paper. Keep aside. Keep aside. In a bowl, mix together the ginger, chopped green chilli, ketchup and ginger garlic paste. Add the squeezed spinach. Now, shape the mixture into round, rectangular shaped patties and keep aside. Heat oil in a wok. Once its hot, add the patties, allow to fry on high heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Turn them over. Allow to cook on the same heat and when they are golden on the underside, flip them again. Allow them to cook for an additional 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Keep aside. To serve, place a slice of rye bread on the side of each plate. Place a spinach pattie on each slice of rye bread and garnish with a piece of sage leaf. Likewise, place a spinach patie on each piece of rye bread and garnish with a piece of fresh mint leaves. Serve.

title: Linguine With Spice-Lime Linguine
ingredients: 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice | 12 ounces linguine
instructions: Combine all ingredients except linguine.

title: Sausages and Rice
ingredients: 12 pieces smoked sausage, such as johnsonville | 2 cups prepared rice | 2 large pieces prosciutto | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: In a medium skillet, heat oil over medium/high. Working in two batches, fry sausage until browned and crisp, about 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer sausage to plate and sprinkle with salt. Keep warm. In same skillet, heat vinegar and tabasco in microwave on high for 30 seconds. Pour in vinegar mixture. Reduce heat to medium and stir in meat. Cover and cook for 2 minutes, stirring often. Serve over rice.

title: Peanut Oil Oil (Sambusa)
ingredients: 1 cup peanut oil | 1 tablespoon whole dried basil
instructions: The oil should be at room temperature. Stir in the basil, and heat until it turns a darker brown.

title: Spicy Asparagus
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh asparagus | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place tips of asparagus on a small piece of heavy duty plastic wrap, and sprinkle with red pepper flakes. Using a sharp knife, cut lengthways at the stem part of the asparagus. Seal the tips, if necessary, with some cold water to keep the tips from forming too tough.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,beef,parsnip,bailey irish cream,fettuccine pasta,vegetable juice,crepe,chili
title: Crock Pot Fettuccine Nests
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 8 ounces frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 can sliced crepes | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream | cooked fettuccine pasta | parsnip, if desired
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, chili and taco seasoning mix. Place mixed vegetables and fettuccine in crock pot. Cover and cook on low heat setting 3 to 4 hours. Sprinkle with irish cream. Serve over noodles. Garnish with parsnips.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,caper,chili sauce,grain rice,rice vinegar,basmati rice,cilantro stem
title: Quick Cilantro Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked long-grain rice | 2 cups onions, halved and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro stems, chopped | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Coat a 1 quart nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Bring 4 cups water to a boil. Cover and cook rice over high heat until all but 1/4 cup of the liquid remains, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes. Stir in onions, cilantro, capers, chili sauce, rice vinegar and chili powder. Cover and reduce heat to low.

title: Rosemary and Choclo
ingredients: 120 g swedes, peeled | 1/4 cup swede, chopped | 200 g dark chocolate, chopped | 3 sprigs rosemary
instructions: Cook the chopped swedes in boiling water until tender. Drain, return to pan, and mash with an electric mixer until smooth. Heat chocolate until melted, then add to swedes.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,serrano pepper,miracle whip,chai tea,honey,malt vinegar
title: Jamaican Style Chili Tea
ingredients: 2 cups boiling water | 4 ounces tomato puree | 4 sprigs mint tea | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 serrano pepper, finely diced | 1 packet instant chai-style tea
instructions: Stir water, tomato puree, mint tea, honey, serrano pepper, and chai style tea together in a pot until combined. Cook over medium low heat for 5 minutes. Pour tea and sauce into a pitcher and serve.

title: Easy Yellow Squash Fajitas
ingredients: 2 medium yellow squash ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/4 cup guacamole, with or without chiles
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Remove the yellow squash from the refrigerator, place on a foil lined, rimmed baking sheet, and drizzle with the oil. Grill the squash, turning once, until tender, about 40 minutes.. Split the grilled squash in half lengthwise with a serrated knife and cut each half into 1/4 thick wedges. Add to the fajitas.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,cardamom powder,kaffir lime leaf,cream chicken soup
title: The Indian Crock Pot Soup!
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread ( or 2 slices sourdough bread of your choice ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 kaffir lime leaves, optional ( optional )
instructions: Cut loaf of bread into 1 inch cubes. Place in bottom of crock pot and add cream of chicken soup, cardamom powder and lime leaves. Turn crock pot on low, then turn on oven to low and cook for 2 hours. If you like a thicker soup, mix 1 cup of water with 2 teaspoons rice flour. This is your soup base and you have to stir regularly to avoid clumping. Enjoy with biscuits or toasted bagels, sliced onion, green onions, salsa, etc.

title: Curry Spiced Beef Mince
ingredients: 600 g beef mince | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger paste | 1 bag baby spinach
instructions: Coat the large fry pan with oil or pam. Add the diced beef and cook breaking the cubes of beef until they are browned evenly all over. Reduce the heat to a slow simmer. Add the ginger paste and spinach and cook gently for about 10 minutes, until the spinach is tender but not tough.. Serve hot with plain rice, raita, chapatis or pitta bread.

Random Ingredients: black olive,pepper ring,ciabatta,coconut,ancho chile powder,blueberry,cider vinegar,sirloin
title: Ancho-Crusted Beef Fondue Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/4 cup dried ancho chile powder | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced black olives | 1 1/4 lbs sirloin, trimmed of all excess fat | 1 1/2 cups blueberries, washed well and patted dry | 8 ciabatta or 8 focaccia rolls, halved and toasted | 4 pepper rings, cut to serve
instructions: Combine the coconut, ancho, vinegar, olives, and 1/2 tablespoon of the salt in a food processor and process until the mixture forms a paste. Cut the beef into 1 1/2 inch cubes and mix with the paste to coat. Spread half the crumb mixture over the bottom half of each roll. Cover with the remaining crumb mixture. Arrange evenly with the blueberries and top with pepper rings.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,stew meat,hamburger,mustard seed,cake flour,egg white,kalamata olive
title: Spanish Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds lean pork loin | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted and chopped | 1/2 cup mustard seeds | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 cup cubed hamburger | 1 hard-cooked egg, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place pork loin on a piece of aluminum foil that is large enough to cover the meat. Layer the olives, and spread the mustard seeds on the pork. Add the egg white. Roll up the pork, and secure with toothpicks. Place on a baking sheet. Mix together the flour and a bit of water to form bread crumbs. Sprinkle it over the pork. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 1 hour. While the pork is baking, place the hamburger and egg in a large skillet. Cook over medium heat until the eggs are completely set. Place the fried eggs on top of the pork. The hamburger mixture should cover the meat.

title: Italian Style Dry Rub
ingredients: 4 teaspoons dried mustard powder | 4 teaspoons dried garlic
instructions: Place the dried mustard powder, dried garlic, and dry mustard powder into a spice grinder or food processor. Place the mixture into a small jar with a lid, and process for several minutes or so until all of the dry mustard has been absorbed. Rub the dry mustard mixture onto vegetables, and allow to dry for at least 2 days, or if freezing, a few months.

title: Spicy Spanish Cabbage
ingredients: 2 cups shredded green cabbage ( about 2 medium to large heads ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 large egg white | 6 skewers, soaked in water for 20 minutes | 1 teaspoon tomato basil
instructions: In a bowl, toss cabbage and the jalapeno pepper until coated with the egg white. Place the skewers on a greased grill over medium coals. Grill for 10 to 15 minutes, turning regularly, until firm. Scoop cabbage mixture from skewers onto a platter and sprinkle with the tomato basil. Serve with salsa and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,flour,marjoram,buttery cracker,corn tortilla chip,flat leaf parsley,cooking oil,yellow pepper
title: Fried Nachos
ingredients: corn tortilla chips, room temperature | 6 -8 roasted yellow peppers, drained | 6 -8 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( or more, to taste ) | 2 lbs unsalted butterflied flour ( or more, to taste ) | cooking oil ( or any oil ) | store bought cayenne ( or more, to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Prepare everything. To remove excess fat, fry the nachos, set aside and cover. To make cayenne, toast the cayenne in a large heavy skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Watch carefully and add a touch more as the oil rises to the surface. When all the bits of cayenne are lightly toasted and fragrant, add the butter. When melted, remove from heat and slowly add the cayenne pepper. When all the butter is melted, check for seasoning and add more cayenne if needed. Place chips on plates and spread with cayenne butter. Sprinkle parsley and marjoram over chips and garnish with cayenne flakes.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,button mushroom,spice,beef ribeye steak,green curry paste,sesame oil,curry,chorizo sausage
title: Wicklewood's Yummy Curried Beef Rib Eye Steaks With Mushrooms & Chori
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh chorizo sausage, sliced ( or other sweet sausage such as korma or chorizo ) | 2 teaspoons green curry paste ( i prefer tasty red curry paste ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 600 g beef rib eye steaks, 3 to 4 mm thick ( or other steak of your choice ) | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry | 6 large button mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup roquefort cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to gas mark 4/180c or 200°c if you have a fan forced oven then put in a roasting tin, lined with baking paper. For the beef steak, in a large mixing bowl, combine chorizo, curry paste, sesame oil and half a tsp of mixed spice, stir well. Trim any excess fat off the steak and rub the mixture into each steak. Slice the steak into finger sized chunks and place into the tin. Scatter the mushrooms, Roquefort and remaining spice over, then pour over enough water to come roughly halfway up the steak's side of the steaks. Cover with foil and put in the centre of the oven for about 1 1/2 hours, depending on how hot your oven is.

title: Jungle Slaw
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, washed, dried and shredded | 125 g shredded swiss cheese | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Divide the cabbage between 2 large serving bowls. Put half the swiss cheese on top of the cabbage, sprinkle on the rest of the cheese. Add a squeeze of juice and half a lime wedge. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,red chili pepper flake,baby spinach,gingerroot,vanilla ice cream
title: Spinach Ice Cream With Red Chile-Almond Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 packages frozen spinach ( or 3 1/2 cups fresh baby spinach ) | 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot or 3/4 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla ice cream ( or coconut ice cream ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour into ungreased 2 quart baking dish.. Cover and freeze overnight.. Remove from freezer 5 minutes before serving. Serve at once or store in freezer for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,napa cabbage,fontina cheese,dark rum,wonton wrapper,chili oil
title: Smolano
ingredients: 16 wonton wrappers, each about 3 x 1/4-inch ( regular is best ) | 2 cups shredded napa cabbage | 1 cup shredded fontina cheese | 1 head romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped, about 4 cups | 1/3 cup white rum | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a won ton wrapper on a work surface. Place about 1 teaspoon or so of the napa cabbage, fontina cheese, romaine lettuce and a few dabs of rum in the center of the won ton wrapper. Fold over the sides, and press down the center and the edges with fingers to seal. Place a heaping teaspoon of the leftover filling on top of each won ton wrapper. Fold over the won ton wrappers and press with fingers to seal. Repeat with remaining filling and wontons. Place a baking sheet in the oven and reduce temperature to 300 degrees f. Bake the pastries about 20 minutes, or until golden brown on the outside but still a little moist inside.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,asafoetida powder,tomato green chile pepper,head cabbage,tomato sauce,bacon,breadcrumb
title: Gramma's Stuffed Cabbage Leaves (Savoury)
ingredients: 2 slices bacon | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried tarragon | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 small head cabbage, cored and finely chopped
instructions: Place bacon and bread crumbs in a deep skillet. Cook over medium heat until lightly browned. Remove bacon.

title: Holiday Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | salt and pepper to taste | 1/2 cup chopped walnut halves | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro | 2 fresh lime leaves
instructions: Cut salmon into 1 inch wide strips. Place salmon on a broiler pan. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, walnuts, cilantro and lime leaves. Broil fish about 4 inches from heat until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,swiss cheese,thai eggplant,chicken broth,cumin seed,halibut fillet,veal
title: Steamed Fish With Eggplant and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 4 large halibut fillets ( can use other firm white fish ) | 2 large veal, steaks cut into thin slices | 3 large swiss cheese slices | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons cumin seeds or 1 1/2-2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 can sliced ripe tomatoes, undrained | 1 cup fat-free low-sodium chicken broth | 1 3/4 cups mixed vegetables
instructions: Place steamer inside a large dutch oven. Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper and place over boiling water. Cover and steam 10 minutes. Remove cover, remove veal and cover with steamer rack. Add undrained tomatoes, broth and seeds to pan. Cover and steam 5 minutes. Remove fish and sprinkle with cheese slices just to melt cheese. Serve on dinner plates and ladle tomato onion sauce over fish.

Random Ingredients: spice,currant,yellow bell pepper,jamaican jerk spice,red kidney bean
title: Jamaican Red Beans (Or Rice) With Yellow Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red kidney beans | 1 yellow bell pepper | jamaican jerk spice | 1 -2 tablespoon jamaican mixed spice | 1 -2 tablespoon currants
instructions: Rinse the beans, drain. Set aside. Preheat the oven to cut bell pepper. Dice into ¾ inch squares. Stem into small sticks. Put into a bowl with the jamaican mixed spice. Add ½ cup water, then ¾ cup water. Mix in your peas and peppers. Spread the vegetables into the bottom of an 8x8 pan. Spread the beans evenly over the top. Cover with the remaining ¾ cup water. Bake until all the liquid is absorbed. Beans will be quite soupy, so remove from the oven and add water so they don’t stick together. Let stand for 10 minutes. Sprinkle the top with ¼ cup sugar.

title: Potato Starch Dumplings
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb potato starch | wonton wrapper ( for dipping )
instructions: Mix potato starch with water in a large bowl. Place a small heaping tablespoon of potato starch on your center of a wonton wrapper, fold wrapper over to form a triangle. Place dumplings on a lightly oiled tray, repeat with the rest of the wrappers and place dumplings on baking sheets, they should be about 2 inches tall. Allow a few dumplings to touch each other so they don't stick together. Bake in a pre heated 400 degree oven, let them cook about 10 minutes or until they turn a golden brown.

title: Mexican Honey Glazed Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves, packed | 1 -2 cup honey | 12 ounces roasted boneless chicken and beef or 12 ounces other leftover cooked vegetables, cut into 2 equal size serving pieces
instructions: In a glass dish or other flat dish, combine all the ingredients. Heat to boiling, cover and cook 15 - 17 minutes or until meat and vegetables are tender. Variation, add sliced boiled potatoes or white potatoes during the final 10 minutes of cooking.

title: Veal Stock
ingredients: 900 g veal stock | 6 limes ( juice of )
instructions: Pound the veal and squeeze the fresh juice. Put the stock and lime juice in a saucepan and bring mixture to the boil. Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until veal is tender. Serve hot.

title: Dried Salad
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout | 1 lb fresh chard leaves | 1 lb mushroom | 1 lb canned chickpeas | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons chopped apricot jam | 2 tablespoons mortadella
instructions: Preparation and garnish directions, place brussels sprouts, chard leaves and mushrooms in a large salad bowl and chill them overnight. Drain and rinse the fresh vegetables then remove the stalks and any tough parts. Slice the vegetables very thinly, divide them among individual serving bowls. Add the apricot jam to a saucepan with a tspful of water and heat until it begins to bubble. Add the mushrooms and cook on a low heat for a few minutes. Take off the heat. Mix the chickpeas with half a tspful of warm water and stir in thoroughly. Put into each bowl and top with pesto or fresh thyme leaves. Note, it is not necessary to chill. It is just to draw out the flavours. It is eaten warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,jalapeno pepper,baking soda,bread,american cheese
title: Famous American Cheese and Pepper Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf day old bread | 1/4 cup diced american cheese ( optional ) | 1/2 cup diced jalapeno peppers ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | salt & freshly ground black pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Slice bread into 1 inch slices, and then arrange slices in a single layer on baking sheet. Preheat oven 350 degrees. Place broiler pan on stove to heat. Mix together cheese, jalapeños, and baking soda until well blended and well mixed. Sprinkle over bread slices, and season generously with salt and pepper. Place bread slices on baking sheet. Broil until bubbly and cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,yellow bell pepper,amaretto liqueur,pork shoulder
title: Easy Caribbean Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur | 1 red enchilada sauce | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1 pound pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the amaretto and red enchilada sauce. Place the diced yellow bell pepper into the bowl, and coat with the sauce. Place the pork into the bowl, and coat with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,enoki mushroom,chive,chickpea flour,rice noodle,hot green chili pepper
title: Simple Fried Rice Noodles
ingredients: 6 dried hot green chili peppers | 4 ounces enoki mushrooms | 1 cup frozen chinese sweet bean flour ( mee ploy ) | 1/2 cup sweet rice noodles, preferably whole baby vermicelli | hot dry green chili pepper, slices ( to garnish ) | 1/4 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed, to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives, to garnish
instructions: Put the green chiles and enoki mushrooms in a saucepan, and pour boiling water over to cover. Cover, and cook over high heat until the green chiles are soft and beginning to blister. Remove from heat, and transfer to a bowl. Place the bean flour in a small bowl and stir in hot water until dough forms a ball. Place the dough in a small, warm skillet, or wok. Dust it with enough bean flour to make it the consistency of mayonnaise, then place over medium high heat. Place a chile in the center of the rice noodles. Top with a third of the mushroom mixture, and sprinkle with a few minced chili peppers to taste. Fold in the noodles, and press into a round shape with your fingers. Repeat with the remaining ingredients, adding more bean flour to make the other ingredients stick together. Dip the rice sticks in the orange juice, then fry in hot oil until crisp and golden. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Garnish with chives.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,coffee,liquid smoke,cooking oil,cornbread mix,cider vinegar
title: Grilled Peppered Capsicum and Condiment
ingredients: 250 g cornbread mix | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 green capsicum, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Combine corn bread mix, liquid smoke, vinegar, coffee and liquid smoke in a bowl.

title: Whip Cream With Sea Salt and Caramel (Gorgonzola) Halva
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon coarse sea salt
instructions: In a bowl, combine the whipping cream and the sea salt. Stir to combine. Using a fine mesh sieve, strain the cream and salt away excess liquid. Bring cream back to a simmer. Remove from heat and add the gorgonzola. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve in martini glasses with a sprinkling of caramel or toasted shredded parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: prawn,demerara sugar,plum tomato,icing sugar,clear honey,beef sirloin steak
title: Crispy Baked Temptation
ingredients: 800 g plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 1 beef sirloin steak, sliced | 2 tablespoons demerara sugar | 75 g icing sugar | 375 g prawns, peeled and deveined
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c. Place tomatoes in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Drain and place in a bowl. Add honey and icing sugar to tomatoes and stir to combine. Place sirloin in an ovenproof dish. Brush with olive oil and roast in the oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and place prawns in a medium saucepan. Pour over tomato mixture and cook for 20 minutes or until hot through. Serve warm with biscuits and fresh green salad.

Random Ingredients: white rice,chicken bouillon cube,tarragon vinegar,italian tomato
title: Easy Italian Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon tarragon vinegar
instructions: Add all ingredients into rice cooker. Close lid and wait until rice is done.

Random Ingredients: peach,double cream,apple juice,onion soup mix,cider vinegar
title: Elegant Peach Applesauce
ingredients: 4 medium apples | 1 packet onion soup mix | 4 tablespoons cider vinegar | 4 tablespoons unsweetened apple juice | 2 cups double cream
instructions: Peel, core and cut the apples into quarters. Mix together the onion soup mix and vinegar. Brush over the apples and place in a saucepan and cook slowly for about 10 minutes until they are soft. Pour over the apple mixture and cream stir. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours before serving chilled.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing,collard green,dark rum,sherry wine,tart apple,carrot,pea
title: Carrots & Collards
ingredients: 1 medium tart apple, peeled, cored, diced | 1 large carrot, peeled, diced | 1/2 cup frozen split peas | 1 bag frozen collard greens, thawed | 3 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 ounce hidden valley original ranch dressing, or to taste
instructions: Place the diced apple and carrot in a colander. Scoop out the excess liquid. Place the apples and carrot into a large bowl. Toss with the peas, collard greens, rum, and sherry. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours to blend the flavors. Stir the dressing well before serving.

Random Ingredients: green onion,beef stew meat,bratwurst,heavy whipping cream,hamburger bun,porcini mushroom
title: Oven Beef Burgers
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried porcini mushrooms | 1 1/2 pounds beef stew meat | 8 ounces fresh bratwursts, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup chopped green onion | 8 hamburger buns, split | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Spread porcini mushrooms over a rimmed baking sheet.

title: Lemon Salmon with Cranberry & Ginger
ingredients: 350 g skinless salmon fillets ( approx 4-6 large ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/3 cup fresh cranberries ( or rocket ) | 1/3 cup white onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon unflavored gelatin ( or 1 packet of ginko gelatin ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Place the salmon fillets in a lightly greased ceramic dish, or alternatively, if using boneless, skinless fish like tilapia fillets, skin on. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Sprinkle with dried cranberries or rocket and onion. Sprinkle the gelatine over and leave to soften and set in a medium size bowl. Bring a small saucepan of water to the boil and pour over the gelatin. Cover with a piece of heavy foil and place on the stove top over a medium heat. Just long enough to have the gelatin and water bubbling gently remove from the heat and set aside for about 8 minutes. Stir to combine. Remove the salmon fillets from the bowl and place them on top of the cranberry mixture. Cover & chill in the refrigerator until needed.. To serve, spoon the salmon mixture onto serving plates and spoon over the gingo flavoured gelatine.

title: Homemade Phyllo Trips
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh basil | 1/2 cup honey | 1/4 lb pecorino romano cheese, grated ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried hot pepper flakes
instructions: Combine basil, honey and pepper flakes. Tightly wrap dough into 8 inch pices, each about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Heat 3 to 4 inches of water in 5 quart pot to boiling over high heat. Drop 1 teaspoon of mixture into water one by one. When the mixture begins to bubble, remove from saucepan. Repeat with remaining water, one teaspoon at a time, until mixture is all absorbed. Pour into an 8 or 9 inch square baking dish. Cool 5 minutes. Remove dough and pat with a spatula to remove excess liquid. Sprinkle on the grated pecorino. Let cool completely, then break into pieces. Refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,chili pepper flake,purpose flour,apricot preserve
title: Salsa Di Pomodoro Di Pomodoro
ingredients: 10 cups all-purpose flour | 1 quart hot chili pepper flakes | 2 packages apricot preserves | 1 can plum tomatoes ( in water )
instructions: Mix in food processor until it forms a ball. Let dough rest 45 minutes. Knead dough on floured board or countertop. Roll out as above. Make into desired shape on floured board, about 8 inch diameter. Fold in each end, make a circle of dough with about 8 inch circle from one end to the other. Spread with preserves. Starting at one end, roll up into desired shape, starting at the ends. Seal with a little water. Repeat process with second batch. Heat a large heavy frypan over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking, about 12 minutes. Place rolls in frypan, cook, turning once, until golden brown. Transfer rolls to a baking sheet. Bake in lower third of 325° oven until golden about 20 minutes. Serve hot from frypan with dipping sauce of choice.

title: Mexican Pizzelles
ingredients: 1 cup shredded chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons chopped candied citron | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Preheat the griddle. Line baking sheets with paper towels. Place chocolate chips and candied citron in a medium bowl.

title: Green Beans Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans | oil ( for frying ) | 3/4 cup ketchup | 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 6 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Clean beans. Trim ends and place the beans in large saucepan of water. Bring to boil and then reduce heat. Simmer until tender, about 5 minutes. Remove beans with slotted spoon and plunge into ice water until ready to use. Drain. Set aside. Heat oil in a deep fryer to 375°f. Test for readiness by dropping a piece of bread into the oil and flattening it out with a spoon. If bubbles come up but the bread does not flake before the end of frying, don’t worry. Remove croutons with slotted spoon. Drain thoroughly and sprinkle with panko. For fritters, deep fry in batches. Lift out and drain well on paper towels. Sprinkle hot fritters with additional panko and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,sage,wheat bran,lemon juice zest,cilantro leaf,lobster tail,rhubarb
title: Lobster Trout
ingredients: 24 ounces lobster tails, cooked | 4 cups chopped rhubarb | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon sage | 1/2 teaspoon cilantro leaf, chopped | wheat germ or bran
instructions: Cut the lobster into strips. Chop the rhubarb and place in a bowl. Mix to a paste with the cottage cheese, lemon zest and juice, sage and cilantro. Stir in the lobster strips and let sit for 10 - 15 minutes. Stir once or twice during the sitting time. Serve in a bowl topped with the wheat germ or bran or bran on the side.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,hash brown potato,serrano pepper,red pepper,scallion,wondra flour,flour tortilla
title: Churros and Potato Wedges #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 7 red peppers, cored & sliced | 1/2 cup sour dough roll dough ( i used wondra flour tortillas ) | serrano pepper ( optional ) | 1 lb frozen hash brown potatoes | 2 tablespoons flour or 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 4 scallions, chopped
instructions: Cook potatoes in salted water until tender. Meanwhile, in a frypan, saute scallions in liquid smoke for one minute or until dark golden. Remove potatoes from boiling water& stir in flour/cornstarch. Fold potato& liquid smoke mixture& spread onto flour tortillas. Top burritos with scallions& ground pepper.

title: Mock Beef Tamarind and Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon tamarind paste | 5 -10 ounces coleslaw blend | 1 -3 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 -3 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Combine ingredients and let marinate for an hour to allow flavors to develop. Serve.

Random Ingredients: wooden skewer,garlic clove,dill,white wheat flour,rice,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Aka Sourdough Crackers With Rice
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dill or 2 teaspoons chives, chopped | 4 -8 garlic cloves, minced | 1 cup raw rice ( not instant ) | 3/4 cup white whole wheat flour | 2/3 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 12 -18 wooden skewers
instructions: Mix the dill, garlic, rice, flour, and ½ cup cheese. Dredge the meat using your fingers and form into a ball. Shred with the other ¾ cup cheese. Roll the ball in the meat, coat the outside with the melted cheese and place on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Freeze for up to 3 days. When ready to serve, remove the meat from the freezer about 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Smoked Trout
ingredients: 1 trout fillet | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 -2 tablespoon taco sauce | 2 tablespoons mirin or 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Heat grill pan or outdoor grill for 3 - 5 minutes or until very hot. Rinse trout under cold water.

title: Agnolotti (Bread pudding)
ingredients: 12 slices day-old white bread | 8 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup fresh celery leaves
instructions: Butter a 2 quart baking dish. Lay slices of bread out on a work surface and cut an x across them, forming a criss cross pattern, making an x pattern in the bread, as if it were a flower design. Spread about 2 tablespoons of cream over the bread, leaving a 2 inch margin on one side. Sprinkle on a little more cream. Dampen the slice with more cream. Starting at the narrow end of the bread, roll one slice of roll into a cylinder shape. Place roll, seam sides down in baking dish. Pour remaining cream over loaf until it reachs about 1/2 inch of water in the dish. Sprinkle with celery leaves. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and place in the freezer for 1 hour. Bring water to a boil for the berry water. Carefully remove the ice from the water and place a plate under the loaf and invert the loaf onto a cutting board. Cut into 8 pieces and serve.

title: BBQ or Baked Ham
ingredients: 2 lbs ham | 6 fluid ounces lime juice or 6 fluid ounces lemon juice | drizzle with oil or fat ( for basting )
instructions: The oven must be gas mark 3/170 degres. Baste and add the ham as mentioned above. It should be lightly golden brown. If it doesn't, the ham needs more time. If you are using a bbq/bbq grill / roasting tray, you may want to use it under a hot grill after turning, as if you were using a cast iron/heavy duty roasting tray. Spray or brush the tray liberally with oil and bake the ham until just browned on top. Let it rest on a baking rack, then you can serve it or slice it thinly. It will keep for a week or two, then freeze in a ziploc bag. You can also cook it in a cast iron /heavy duty oven, for about 10 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove, peel away the gating paper and slice thinly, drizzle with the oil or fat, and place on a hot grill /broiler tray, brush it lightly with oil or fat, and grill the ham until brown on all sides. Serve with boiled rice /avocado salsa /tostadas /lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,celery,cherry tomato,fontina cheese,red bell pepper,dill weed,tart apple
title: Pasta with Apple Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 3 tart apples - peeled, cored and finely chopped | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup diced celery | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh dill weed | 1/4 cup diced pickled tart apples
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Combine cooled pasta, chopped apples, red pepper, celery, fontina cheese, dill weed, and diced tart apples in a large bowl. Pour dressing over vegetable mixture, and toss to coat.

title: Grilled Peach With Curry Peaches
ingredients: 1 fresh pablano green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/3 cup chopped dried peaches ( from about 15 medium firm peaches ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 teaspoon lemon wedges
instructions: In medium nonstick skillet, toast dried peaches over medium coals, turning frequently, about 2 to 3 minutes or until fragrant. Transfer to bowl and stir in finely chopped chili, nuts, cardamom powder and lemon wedges. Let cool to room temperature. Spoon mixture onto grilled peaches and serve.

Random Ingredients: apple brandy,salmon,chocolate chip,grain wild rice,bouquet garni,meat
title: Olive Garden Brown Rice & Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup grain wild rice, uncooked | 2 cups apple brandy | 1 lb smoked meat ( i use smoked salmon ) | 2 teaspoons bouquet garni | 1/4 cup chocolaty chocolate chips
instructions: Cook rice according to instructions on package, meanwhile, heat brandy in a large skillet over low heat. Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes, until mixture is tender and flavors are well blended. Serve.

title: Spinach with Jalapeno and White Sugar
ingredients: 1 pound baby spinach | 2 jalapeno peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach. Place in a large pot, and cover with water.

title: Lebanese Carom Seeds
ingredients: 25 -40 carom seeds | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan on medium heat, add the carom seeds stirring frequently. When they begin to pop and crackle, add the soymilk. Leave for 5 minutes, then stir. Let sit 2 minutes. Enjoy the smell and the carom flavor develop.

title: Shrimp on a Stick With Chocolate Ice Cream and Chocolate
ingredients: 1/2 pint chocolate ice cream | 1/2 pint large shrimp
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp. Mix ice cream and shrimp together and put on a platter. Decorate with the chocolate ice cream and serve.

Random Ingredients: baby pea,olive,baking potato,peppercorn,dark sesame oil,large shrimp
title: Shrimp, Peas and Potatoes Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 8 baby peas, cut in half | 4 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut in half | 1 tablespoon olive, halved | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup mixed peppercorn, crushed | 1 can sliced olives, drained
instructions: Place the shrimp in a large, deep frying pan. Cover and cook over medium heat until the shrimp are just cooked through, shaking the pan occasionally. In a separate pan, place the baby peas on high heat until tender crisp, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and drain in a colander. Cook the potatoes in boiling water for about 5 minutes or until tender. Drain, pat dry and cut into quarters. In a large fry pan over high heat, heat the sesame oil and the olive, about 1 minute. Add the peas and toss lightly. Add the shrimp and toss until all shrimp are coated with oil. Stir in the crushed peppercorns and salt to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: 6 ounces chocolate chips | 6 ounces double cream | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 2 ounces white cheddar cheese, finely grated
instructions: Mix the chocolate chips and cream together with the cayenne. Place the mixture on a piece of foil and roll into a log shape. Wrap tightly in the foil to keep the mixture soft and easy to work with. Chill for 15 - 20 minutes preheat the oven to 375°f place the log on a lightly greased baking sheet that has been lined 2 - 3 /4 wide with baking paper. Mark the truffle into 6 equal portions and sprinkle with the cheese. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until the cheese has melted and becomes glossy.

title: Chilli Fettuccine With Mango Mango Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango, diced | 1/2 cup chilies, chopped | 1 package fettuccine, fresh ( optional )
instructions: Saute chilies in oil for 5 minutes. Add mango to saute and saute to warm through. Meanwhile, cook fettuccine noodles. Drain noodles and toss with sauce. Toss until coated, adding more chilies if desired.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin, center cut | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/4 cup chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f and place the beef tenderloin on a piece of foil.

title: Lentil Soup
ingredients: 1 lb dried lentils | 3 cups ice water | 2 slices prosciutto | 1 large turnip, peeled, cut in julienne | 1 star anise, whole | 4 basil leaves
instructions: Place the lentils and ice water in a large bowl and soak for 8 hours. Next day, slice the prosciutto into slices. Shred or cube the turnip and add to the lentils. Add the star anise and basil for garnish.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,chestnut,pork tenderloin,tomato green chile,steak,wild salmon fillet
title: Smoked Wild and Salty Pork Tenderloin Enchiladas
ingredients: 9 ounces turkey steak ( one whole steak ) | 9 ounces pork tenderloins ( one whole pork roast ) | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 can stewed tomatoes with green chiles | 1 can del monte sweet chestnuts ( canned ) | 1 package smoked wild salmon fillets
instructions: Place the turkey steaks in a shallow casserole dish. Place the pork and tenderloins among the steaks. In a medium bowl, mash together the enchilada sauce and tomatoes. Pour over steaks. Gently press the chestnuts into the cheese and sauce mixture and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and add the ro tel tomatoes. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: turnip,ancho chile powder,baking soda,orange zest,penne,cardamom,cake flour
title: Spicy Roasted Turnips and Pasta (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 3 small turnips, peeled | 2 teaspoons ground ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange zest | 4 cups cake flour | 1 medium red-skinned long-grain penne
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place turnips, ancho chili powder, baking soda, cardamom, orange zest, and 1 1/2 cups cake flour in large bowl. Mix with fork. Add the remaining 2 - 3 cups flour and mix well. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured board. Knead briefly, adding enough flour to keep dough from sticking. Pat dough into a 8 inch disk. Spoon mixture onto dough, and use floured hands to shape into a tight cylinder. Wrap tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Using a sharp knife, cut pasta into 3 inch pieces. Arrange the pasta in a well buttered 13x9 inch baking dish. Cut dough into 4 equal pieces. Brush with oil. Bake until pasta is soft and tender and golden, about 40 minutes. Don't overcook.

title: Marzipan Balls
ingredients: 8 ounces marzipan | 3 ounces chocolate squares | 1/2 cup ghee
instructions: Pulverize 1 chocolate square, then cut into small blocks. Place the ghee in a large pan add the chocolate and cook at low heat stirring all the time until chocolate is melted. Remove from heat place marzipan in a large freezer bag and pound them with a rolling pin until it is 1/4 inch thick. Cut the dough into small cube size pieces and roll into balls. Dip the balls into melted ghee and fry until golden on both sides. Remove from pan and serve.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,egg yolk,guacamole,turmeric,red chili pepper flake,amaretto,golden raisin,bell pepper
title: The Perfect Aussie Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal, preferably freshly ground | 3 egg yolks | 1 1/4 cups gold raisins, rinsed and dried | 8 red chili peppers, seeded and minced | 4 tablespoons amaretto ( almond liqueur ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon ground red chili pepper flakes | 1 bell pepper, sliced
instructions: Heat a 9x9 inch baking pan on the stove. Combine oatmeal, egg yolks, raisins, red chiles, amaretto, turmeric and chili flakes in a large bowl. Mix thoroughly. Spread mixture into pan. Place bell pepper slices in the mixture and bake 30 - 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Coriander and Pistachios
ingredients: 4 cups coriander, chopped | 4 star anise | 2 cloves garlic | 2 tablespoons lemon zest, finely grated | 1 teaspoon rosemary leaf, finely chopped | 3/4 cup pistachios
instructions: Blend the coriander, star anise, garlic, lemon rind and rosemary, using half the pistachios to form a rough paste. Toss the remaining pistachios, pistachios and paste in a bowl. Cover and leave in the refridgerator overnight, stirring occasionally.

title: Beef-soymilk Soup
ingredients: 500 g sirloin, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup soymilk | 2 teaspoons fresh mint leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon garlic granules
instructions: Place beef in a bowl. Mix together soy milk, mint and garlic.

title: Vegan Pinto Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans ( drained and rinsed with cold water ) | 1 medium head iceberg lettuce or 1 medium vidalia onion, chopped in bite size pieces ( use both hands ) | 1/2 cup mexican style lentils ( not the dried pinto beans that you purchase and soak in water for 1/2 to 2 hours ) | diced apple ( optional ) | 1/4 cup piloncillo ( a dry brown sugar, piloncillo or an italian ) | dried marmite ( optional ) or honey ( optional )
instructions: Cook dry beans and lentils in a large pot with just enough water to cover and turn up heat to just below medium heat. Simmer, covered with lid, until beans are tender and lentils are very soft. When beans are fully cooked and lentils just a little softer, remove from heat and set aside. While beans are cooking, make salad dressing. If you are using honey, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and gently stir. Remove from heat. Add diced apple and piloncillo. When beans are cooled, transfer the beans to a bowl and stir in dressing. To serve, put small scoop of beans in the center of each plate. Spread some beans on the bean. Add a few dollops of salad dressing on top. Top with more lettuce and dollops of dressing at a time.

Random Ingredients: tuna steak,grain rice,grain white rice,oil,peach,chili powder,green enchilada sauce,peanut butter
title: Enchilada Rice Bowls
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice | 2 green enchilada sauce ( i used bottled red enchilada sauce ) | 1/2 lb medium firm tuna steak | 1/8 cup peanut butter | 3 teaspoons chili powder | 1 can tuna in water | 1 can sliced peaches,, drained | 2 cups cooked long grain white rice
instructions: Preheat grill to medium low. Wash the rice in a strainer for at least 5 - 10 minutes to loosen grit. Drain completely. Cut into 2 inch long pieces. Combine enchilada sauce and a little bit of the peanut butter in a small bowl. Spoon about a cup of the sauce over rice and stir lightly until blended. Pour remaining sauce into a small 2 cup measure and stir in chili powder. Set aside. When ready to cook, remove tuna from water with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add tuna and salt and pepper to taste to the rice and combine. Divide rice among 6 - 8 bowls. Top evenly with tuna, sauce and the peach slices. Serve with additional sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: shallot,thai chili sauce,red bell pepper,beef roast,orange bell pepper,coconut milk,sun tomato oil,half
title: Asian Beef with Peppers
ingredients: 1 beef roast, trimmed, or cut into 12 slices | 8 ounces coconut milk, can | half or half cream | 1 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped red bell pepper | 2 tablespoons chopped orange bell peppers | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained
instructions: Place the roast in a large slow cooker. Pour coconut milk over roast, stirring to blend thoroughly. Cover and cook on low for 10 - 12 hours or until the beef is very tender and cooked to taste. Before serving, stir through the sweet chili sauce and add red pepper and orange pepper. Cook for a few minutes to rewarm the sauce. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,cilantro leaf,tuna olive oil,chocolate square,basil,white wine vinegar
title: Spicy Sweet Belly Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 8 ounces fresh tuna in olive oil | fresh basil or oregano leaves | fresh cilantro leaves | 6 ounces bittersweet chocolate squares
instructions: Combine vinegar and rice wine vinegar in small saucepan.

title: Buffalo Blue Crab - Copycat
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat montreal steak sauce or 1/2 cup commercial blue crab sauce | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup queso fresco, coarsely crumbled
instructions: Blend steak sauce, salsa and cheese. Pour equal amounts over crab, if using blue crab.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,sherry,cottage cheese,kielbasa,salt black pepper,green bean
title: Green Bean Salad With Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, trimmed | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 can white beans, drained, rinsed | 1 1/2 cups small tub cottage cheese | 1/4 cup dry sherry, divided | 1 red chili pepper, seeded, deveined and coarsley chopped
instructions: Cut kielbasa into bite size pieces. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Let stand at room temperature until ready to serve. Stir white beans, cottage cheese, 1/4 cup sherry, chile, and white bean mixture together in a medium serving bowl. Heat remaining 1/4 cup sherry in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring. Add remaining 1/4 cup sherry.

Random Ingredients: half,mexican cheese,olive oil,baguette,alfalfa sprout,kiwi fruit,cinnamon bark
title: Kiwi-Fruit French Toast
ingredients: 8 slices baguette | 5 cups shredded mexican cheese blend | 10 sauteed fresh kiwi fruits | 1/2 cup olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon bark | 6 cups alfalfa sprouts | 1/2 cup half-and-half
instructions: Spray a medium pan with cooking spray, and heat it on medium. Slice the baguette into six equal pieces, and spread them on a plate or cookie sheet. Place equal amounts of both cheeses on each piece of bread, and top evenly with kiwi, distributing evenly. Place one teaspoon of cinnamon bark in the centre of each piece of toast. Place a handful of sprouts into the middle of each piece of toast, and top with another handful of sprouts. Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Place one piece of toast in the pan, and cook for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, or until lightly browned. Serve, topped with your favourite accompaniments, such as salsa, guacamole, or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,molasses,allspice,chili paste,vanilla bean,cherry tomato,basil leaf
title: Pumpkin Candy (Canned Version)
ingredients: 4 cups pumpkin puree | 2 cups cherry tomatoes ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup sweet chili paste | 3 cloves pinches allspice | 1/4 cup dried basil leaves | 1/4 cup dried cherries in hot water
instructions: Place the pumpkin and tomatoes in a large heat proof bowl and set aside. Heat the remaining ingredients in a saucepan on medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Remove the chili paste and discard. Pour a little hot mixture over the pumpkin mixture, stirring. Pour hot mixture over the pumpkin mixture and stir until all ingredients are combined. Chill until hardened. Place in a clean and sterile jar. Keeps indefinitely.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,rigatoni pasta,sunflower oil,pork shoulder,baking soda
title: Spiedies Pesto Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 2 1/2 cups packaged store bought pesto or 2 1/2 cups sunflower oil | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 3/4 cup sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 lbs rigatoni pasta or 2 lbs chapati
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a large frypan or deep fryer. Season the pork with salt and pepper and add to the pan. Cook on a low heat, turning occasionally, for about 20 hours or until well browned on all sides. Remove the pork from the pan and put to one side and drain off all the fat in the pan. Discard all the fat and any excess fat from the pan. Strain off excess fat from the pan and deglaze with the reserved heat. Pour over the pork and add the lime juice, zest and pesto. Cook for about 1 hour on a medium heat, stirring constantly. While the pork is cooking, cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling, salted water for 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain pasta then gently toss the pasta together with the pork and pesto mixture. Taste and add salt and pepper if necessary bearing in mind, to taste. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: butterscotch schnapps,flat leaf italian parsley,walnut oil
title: Butterscotch Walnut Oil for Meat and Chips
ingredients: 1 cup walnut oil, or as needed | 2 tablespoons butterscotch schnapps | 1 cup finely shredded flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Pour walnut oil into a saucepan set over low heat. Stir in butterscotch schnapps until well blended, about 2 minutes. Pour in parsley until coated well. Keep warm over low heat.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage link,green bean,vodka,sriracha sauce,clear honey
title: Italian Sausage and Green Beans - Vodka Podlets (Guilt Free)
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage links, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 4 teaspoons clear honey | 1/2 1/2 lb fresh green beans or 1/2 lb frozen green beans | 2 tablespoons vodka ( i love kirsch but other brand would be okay ) | sriracha sauce
instructions: Cook the sausage, cut the sausage into 1/4 by 1/2 by 1/2 inch slices. Add the honey to a small frying pan, on medium low, melt the honey. Add the green beans to the cooking oil with the sausage and cook, stirring until the green beans begin to soften, about 15 minutes or so. Add the vodka to the pan and stir until the alcohol cooks off, about 5 minutes more. Serve right away, or refrigerate until ready to serve.. Guilt free, the longer the sauce sits in the pan, the more flavor the guilt free will form.

title: Shiitake-Mushroom Enchiladas
ingredients: 10 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 lb spaghetti | 2 tablespoons flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons sweet red pepper sauce or 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Chop mushroom coarsley. Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water until barely tender. Drain and rinse in cold water. Drain and pat dry with towel. Combine cooked spaghetti, mushrooms, and 1/2 tsp. Salt in a bowl. Spoon about 2 tbsp. Water lengthwise into center of a tortilla. Roll up and place seam side down in a lightly oiled skillet. Cover and cook over fairly high heat over high heat for 6 - 6 minutes, turning once. Remove tortillas from skillet. Fill tortillas with filling and roll up. Pour any excess oil from skillet into pan and fry enchiladas in it, turning often, until golden and crisp on all sides, adding a little more oil as it crisps. Pour remaining sauce in a bowl and add remaining ingredients.

title: Sicilian Style Scotch Brochettes
ingredients: 24 large scallops | 24 large ripe pears ( approx 6 c ) | 5 red apples ( approx 8 c ) | 1/4 lb spicy salami ( approx 1/2 a cup ( approx 1/8 c ) | 1 prime rib roast
instructions: Scallops, remove the cores from the scallops, remove the peel and seeds from each pear. Slice crossways into 1/4 inch slivers. Peel the apples and pears. Cut into 4 wedges each. Chop the salami. Slice the sausage into long strips across the grain. Place your scallops on an oiled large tray and generously brush the scallops with oil. Put the scallops onto the tray. Pears, core the pears, peel and slice into wedges. Lay these out on the tray. Cut the salami into 1/2 inch thick diagonal slices, approximately 1/4 1/2 c each. Place the salami on top of the pears. Brochettes, pour boiling water over them, enough to cover to the bottom of the pan. Add your prime rib. Place your scallops on top of the salami. Cover and place in a preheated oven at 170c for 35 - 40 minutes at 80c. Check the meat and make sure it falls of its bone. When the meat begins to fall of its bone, take it out and take the scallops out. Remove the scallops from the boiling water and take off the heat. Carefully drain off the water. Serve the boiled scallops over a bed of cooked pasta. Note, if you eat them on the rare side they will be tasty on top..

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,rosemary sprig,fenugreek leaf,salt black pepper
title: Kebobs (Georgian Fresh Herb Rub)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried fenugreek leaves, crushed | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary sprigs ( optional ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/4 teaspoons cayenne powder ( to taste ) or 1 1/4 teaspoons coarse salt
instructions: Combine fenugreek and rosemary leaves, salt and pepper.

title: Spinach With Almonds and Chilli
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 2 cups pearl barley ( cooked ) | 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cook barley according to directions. While barley is cooking, cut up the spinach to fit the ziti/zo pasta dish. Drain spinach and set aside in a large bowl. Set aside. Place the chilli in a dry frying pan. Place over medium heat and fry until a light brown, stirring often. Add the barley. Stir to coat. Add the chili flakes. Add the spinach. Stir, then cover on a medium low heat for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with almond extract. You can also drain the chilli before serving.

title: Cuban Con Queso (Cuban Baked Beans) #RSC
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 2 lbs reynolds wrap foil | 1 loaf breadcrumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a small baking tray with reynolds wrap foil. Open can of refried beans and put into bowl. Add enough bread crumbs to make a dip for beans and bread crumbs, set aside. Remove foil from beans and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes until bread crumbs are golden brown. Put beans on a serving platter.

title: Broccoli California Fire-Roasted
ingredients: 2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 teaspoons minced green chiles | 1 lb broccoli, broken into small flowerets | 1 cup wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Combine onion powder, chiles and pepper in a small bowl.

title: Maurice Salad (Indian Dressing)
ingredients: 1 cup radish, with tops very thinly sliced | 1/4 cup pears, diced | 1/4 cup peeled seeded and diced dried ancho chile | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | celery rib, finely chopped for garnish
instructions: In a small bowl, gently toss the arghul with the radishes, pears, chili, garam masala and celery and serve.

title: Rhubarb and Treacle
ingredients: 500 250 g rhubarb or 500 g butternut squash, cut into cubes | 2 tablespoons wheat gluten or 2 tablespoons cracked wheat gluten | 60 ml worcestershire sauce | 50 ml golden syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 140c/gas put the rhubarb into a roasting tin. Toss together with the rest of the ingredients and place in the oven. Roast for 2 hours turning the rhubarb every 30 minutes until the rhubarb is cooked and tender.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,mango,pork shoulder,curry paste,vanilla ice cream,gruyere cheese,cayenne pepper
title: Tropical Grilled Pork Breasts
