ingredients: 4 -5 boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of any fat | 2 tablespoons mild curry paste | 1 tablespoon fresh chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla icing or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 4 slices gruyere cheese ( depending on how much cheese you like ) | vanilla ice cream, to serve
instructions: Brush meat with curry paste, chili pepper flakes, vanilla icing, and cayenne pepper. Place meat onto a baking tray lined with parchment paper, leaving a 1/4 thickness around each side. Sprinkle cheese slices evenly over meat, then cover with the top and side of the baking tray with the baking tray and meat. Bake in a moderate oven for 30 - 40 mins, or until meat is cooked though. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Chili Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup slivered blanched almonds, toasted | 1 cup good quality semisweet chocolate ( not unsweetened ) | 3/4 cup good quality sweet chili sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon hing | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon finely chopped green chiles | 1/2 teaspoon pure chiles | 1/2 teaspoon finely diced candied chime
instructions: Finely chop chocolate.

title: Char Siu
ingredients: 250 g spareribs | 2 tablespoons gingeradish | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 green capsicums, sliced 1 inch long | 1 bombay saffron strand, crushed ( approx 1/2 inch strands ) | 1 radish, shredded
instructions: Cut the ribs into 3/4 inch cubes. Put the marinade ingredients into a bowl and mix well. Add the meat and cover and let stand for 30 minutes in a cool place. Put the saffron threads into a dry glass bowl and stir. Add the meat and stir till the meat is coated with the marinade. Cook the meat slowly in a large pan of boiling water for 10 minutes or till tender. When the meat is cooked, strain the cooking liquid into the bowl. Reserve the marinade. Return the meat to the pan with the saffron and the radish. Turn up heat and bring to the boil then simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Coconut Curry Noodles
ingredients: 300 g spaghetti | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 8 tablespoons marmalade | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 300 ml water
instructions: Cook the spaghetti until tender.

title: Poached Pears in Red Curry Seasoning
ingredients: 8 ounces sliced peeled pears | 2 tablespoons harissa ( to taste ) | 2 1/4 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small saucepan and stir. Cover and bring just to boiling. Reduce to simmer and cook for 7 - 8 minutes. Cover and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until pear slices are tender.

title: Italian Inspired Hot Water
ingredients: 1 can evaporated milk | 1/2 cup sliced green peppers or 1/2 cup red pepper | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon vanilla flavored vodka
instructions: Combine milk, sugar, pepper, and red pepper flakes in a medium saucepan. Heat over medium.

title: Sopa De Arroz (Arroz Con Pibil)
ingredients: 1 -2 lb pork shoulder ( or other shoulder ) | 6 tablespoons semolina ( or cassava ) | 8 ounces arborio rice | 3/4 - 1 cup roasted chopped pepsi, drained ( or other vegetable ) | 3 -4 teaspoons finely diced canned chipotle chiles in adobo or 1 -2 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste ) | 5 whole dried banana or 2 medium red bananas ( optional )
instructions: Wash meat and make sure you remove excessive fat. Cube meat. Set aside in a bowl. In the same bowl soak the semolina for a few minutes in cold water. Drain the seeds and make sure there is no blood or lumps. Set aside. If you are using regular rice the water should just about cover rice. Add water to a deep, heavy bottomed pot with a tight lid and bring to a boil over high heat. After a moment it should be boiling again. Lower the heat, cover, and simmer for 40 - 45 minutes, until meat is tender.. After about 20 minutes turn out and slice into thin slices. Scoop out some of the cooking liquid into a measuring cup or pan and boil for about a minute to get the liquid to a boil and then set aside.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,garbanzo bean,salmon,potato starch,sun tomato,palm sugar,natural peanut butter,accent seasoning
title: Crispy Hummus
ingredients: 400 g mashed potatoes with a pinch salt | 8 tablespoons natural-style peanut butter | 1 1/2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon garbanzo beans, deseeded, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon astafafrican accent seasoning | 3/4 teaspoon palm sugar | shredded sharp cheddar cheese (, or use a combination of both ) or mozzarella cheese (, or a combination of both ) | salmon
instructions: Mix everything together well. Scoop out a tbsp of the mix then mix with your hands. Place on a floured board, and allow to sit 5 minutes. Scoop up a tbsp of the mix, and form into a ball around the palm of your hand. Using your hands, shape balls into round balls the size of a quarter. Place on a greased baking tray, then sprinkle each with some shredded cheddar cheese or mozzarella cheese. Bake in a preheated oven at 220°c for around 20 minutes or until golden all over. Cool for a few minutes before eating, as they will crisp up.

title: Hot Dogs with Mangoes (Sausages)
ingredients: 1 pound sweet and sour sausage | 1 can mango nectar | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Preheat the grill for high heat. Place the sausage in a large skillet, and place it over medium high heat. Cook and stir until evenly browned and cooked through. Drain. Rinse out the skillet. Place the mango nectar in the skillet, and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,italian seasoning,yellow pea,pear,mango chutney,endive,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Pear and Mango Salad
ingredients: 400 g frozen yellow peas, thawed | 400 g canned sliced pears, chopped | 3/4 cup australian mixed salad leaves, mix | 3/4 cup grated monterey jack pepper cheese | 3/4 cup australian style shredded parmesan cheese or 3/4 cup tasty young shredded parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 3/4 cup dry mango chutney ( or major grey chutney )
instructions: Cook peas according to directions on the pack, adding 1/4 cup of water if mixture seems too dry. Drain well and combine with pears and cheeses in a large bowl. Add italian seasoning and mix well. Add chutney and mix well. Serve.

title: Quick and Easy Coleslaw Blend
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder
instructions: Mix together in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef brain,tabasco sauce,mexican cheese,molasses,chive,pastry crust pie
title: Easy Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 pastry for a double crust pie, baked and cooled | 10 -11 ounces beef brains, ground and cooled | 1 1/2 ounces mexican blend cheese, shredded ( or other mexican cheese ) | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or more if desired ) | mild molasses | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Poke holes in the bottom crust of the ball and place on pizza screen that has been sprayed lightly with nonstick oil spray. Spray with nonstick spray. Place cooled beef brains in the crust, then sprinkle with mexican cheese/cheese blend. Bake in oven for about 10 to 12 minutes or until cheese is melted. While it is baking. To serve, mix remaining ingredients in bowl. Drizzle over the hot beef brains. Serve immediately. Makes two large or 4 small servings. You may need to place a piece of plastic wrap directly on top of the dough, otherwise the cheese will burn and be difficult to handle when finished.

title: Cheddar & Pepper Scones
ingredients: 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup cake flour, sifted | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 450ºf. Mix all ingredients together. On a lightly floured surface, press and shape 1 - 2 tsp into a 6” thick round. Use a fork to cut a 3” slits through middle of the biscuit. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until cooked.

title: Coconut Tempura Pastry
ingredients: 150 g plain flour | 150 g white flour ( white gluten or wholemeal is fine ) | 50 g coconut milk ( cold ) | 100 g brandy ( to taste )
instructions: Sift the flours into a bowl, and whisk with a wooden spoon. Add the coconut milk, brandy and coconut milk. Work in the white flour until well blended. Cover with plastic wrap, and keep in the fridge while you work with it. When ready to use, knead the dough with your hands and roll out into thin, rectangular shapes using a pastry cutter or drinking glass dipped into flour. You may want to dust the pastry with flour if it is too sticky. Heat a medium cooking pan until a knob of butter has just started to smoke from it. Add a little oil to the pan, and then turn the temperature up to medium. Roll the pastry balls in the hot pan at low heat to make sure they don't overcrowd, or they will bubble up and become difficult to work with. When the bottom side of the pastry has turned golden brown, flip it over and cook evenly. Turn a second time, and cook until both sides are lightly browned all over. Remove from the heat. You may need to turn the temperature down for extra frying. Serve theTempura with ice cream, cream, coconut and green beans.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,rice,fish sauce,rosemary,white bean,yellow onion,salad oil
title: Quick Vietnamese Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 large yellow onion, sliced | 1 lb cooked white beans | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 4 drops fish sauce | crushed rice, to serve ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: Shred lettuce and onions as desired. Rinse and drain white beans. Chop herbs and add to the lettuce toss. Place romaine mixture in large bowl. Dipping sauce, in a small bowl, combine salad oil, fish sauce and a few drops of fish sauce.

title: Vietnamese Cucumber Cheese Balls
ingredients: cucumber, peel & chopped in to small pieces | 1/2 cup tequila ( i have found the best flavor is made with pisco. ) | 8 ounces cheese, grated
instructions: Roll the cucumber into 1 balls, then press them gently down in your palm making sure you don't get any of the cucumber's seeds. Put in a plastic freezer bag and freeze them for 1/2 hours.. Take them out of the bag, and press in your cheese. If you are freezing the cheese balls, i usually use a teaspoon and spoon it over each one to have the cheese on top. These are amazing made with leftovers, but it's not for me.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,green chili pepper,macadamia nut,chard leaf,single cream
title: Chard and Macadamia Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces chard leaves | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon small fresh green chili pepper, finely sliced | 1/4 cup single cream | 1 teaspoon caster balsamic vinegar | 1 1 ounce macadamia nuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Place the chard leaves in a deep large saucepan with 2 cups water. Bring to the boil, then, once simmering, add the leaves. Cover the pan, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 5 - 6 minutes, or until the leaves are wilted. You may serve with the single cream, as is, or leave on the heat for a couple of minutes to infuse it with the essence. Add the chard, vinegar and nuts and stir to combine. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pork,liquid smoke,macadamia nut,iceberg lettuce,mint,curry paste,french bread
title: Easy Pork and Macadamia Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons good quality curry paste ( i use penzey's curry paste ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 bunch of thin cut iceberg lettuce | 1/2 - 2/3 lb lean pork or 1/2-2/3 lb bacon | 1/2 cup raw macadamia nuts | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 3 slices crusty french bread, cut diagonally lengthwise and cut in half | 1/2 - 1 cup of a good quality french bread blend
instructions: First, make the dressing. In a small cup, stir together the curry paste and liquid smoke and set aside,. Assemble the salad by placing all of the lettuce, pork or bacon together on a plate. Toss with desired amount of sauce. Top with nuts and mint. Serve with crusty french bread slices. If desired, a piece of bread can be served alongside the salad.

title: Roasted Oranges with Thyme
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme or 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 2 cups peeled but firm navel oranges | 2 large russet potatoes, cut into small wedges
instructions: Mix sour cream, thyme& almond extract in small bowl. Add oranges & toss to mix. Arrange mixture on lightly buttered cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until oranges are tender and starting to turn golden. Meanwhile, lightly spray rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine potatoes and remaining sour cream mixture in shallow bowl. Drizzle with oil. Sprinkle with sesame seeds, if desired. Bake for about 25 - 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Cheesy Chocolate Broccoli With Corn Sauce #5FIX
ingredients: 1 box frozen broccoli, thawed and stems removed | 2 jars marinara sauce ( i use kraft's zesty zesty italian zesty salsa-marinara sauce for this ) | 1/2 cup ketchup or 1/2 cup chili sauce | 3/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed | 1/3 cup grated semisweet chocolate morsel
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Boil broccoli stems for 6 - 8 minutes, and drain immediately. In a 2 quart casserole, mix together the marinara sauce, ketchup, fennel seeds, corn, and chocolate morsels. Mix well, and pour into the prepared casserole. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes, or until the broccoli is bubbly and the sauce is hot.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,rom tomato,oat,chicken breast fillet,gingerroot,wheat pastry flour,black pepper,yve meat substitution
title: Tunisian Meatless Wedge Cakes
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, halved | 1 teaspoon extra-virgin olive oil | 1 onion, peeled and chopped | 2 ounces peeled grated fresh gingerroot ( about 5 tablespoons ) | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 2 ounces oat, plain or 2 ounces plain flour ( 1 3/4 cups ) | 2/3 lb boneless skinless chicken breast fillet, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch strips | 1/4 - 1/2 cup organic plain yogurt or 1/4-1/2 cup reduced-fat greek yogurt
instructions: Cook potatoes in large pot of boiling salted water until barely tender.

title: Italian Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb italian cheese, coarsely shredded | 1 jar pickles, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.

title: Polenta-Cottage Cheese Spread
ingredients: 350 g low fat cottage cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons polenta | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon coriander
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate until required.

title: Corned Beef, Provolone or Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 teaspoon flour ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 2 bay leaves | 8 slices provolone cheese ( or swiss or provolone cheese )
instructions: Pierce the meat with a sharp fork several times in a small, thin slice. Place in a large pot and cover it with water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 45 to 50 minutes. Meanwhile, remove the bay leaves and cut the cheese into 1/4 inch slices. When the meat is done, remove it from the pot, and drain off any fat. Return the meat to the pot, and pour in the sesame seeds, sesame seeds and flour. Stir until well mixed, and cook an additional 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Cumin Flavored Red Pepper Seasoning Mix for Beef or Pork
ingredients: 1 cup minced celery
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in a tighly covered container with a rim. Note, i use 4 - 4 1/2 tsp as i feel the flavor improves on overnight cooking in a sauce pan.

title: Mexican Quinoa with Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 teaspoon red chile powder | 2 cups broccoli florets | 2 button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the quinoa, red chile powder, and mushrooms. Bring liquid to a boil, and add broccoli and cooked quinoa. Reduce heat, and cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Apple and Saffron Fish Cakes (Cooking Light)
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg cod, skin on ( or 1 whole fillet of any white fish ) | 2 tablespoons apple pie spice ( or one packet of apple pie spice ) | 200 g low-fat mayonnaise ( low-fat or low fat ) | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a big bowl. Coat the fish with the mixture well. Refrigerate for about an hour or more to allow the flavours to infuse. Cut pieces into long strips about 1 inch wide and about 3 inches long. Thread onto skewers. Preheat the grill. If the skewers are long, leave them on for about 10 - 15 minutes so the fish can absorb the flavors. Place on the grill and cook on both sides, using 3 - 4 minutes per side of each. Keep on low grill until all the fish is cooked. These can be cooked on the grill, basting regularly with the apple mixture until it starts turning golden and flaky.

title: Camembert Poached Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate ( finely chopped ) or 2 ounces semisweet chocolate ( finely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, finely chopped | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 pinch triple sec | 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 2 tablespoons camembert cheese or 2 tablespoons emmenthaler cheese, grated | 1 pinch kosher salt ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler setting. Coat a large baking sheet lightly with cooking spray. Put the chocolate, lemon grass, pinch of cayenne, triple sec, chiles and mushrooms into a dry, heavy saucepan.

title: Thai Cauliflower
ingredients: 6 large cauliflower ( small florets ) | 1 leek | 1 large rosemary sprig ( or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary ) | 1 teaspoon sambal oelek | 2 -4 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: If using a casserole, steam the cauliflower in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Turn the cauliflower over and steam until both florets separate from the cauliflower, 2 1/2 3 minutes. Set aside to cool completely. Quarter and deseed the leek. Slice into very thin rings. Remove the stems from the rosemary sprig or remove stalks and leaves. If using dried rosemary, chop or pound together finely. If using fresh rosemary, grind together the dried rosemary and salt in a mortar and pestle. Set aside. When cool, toss with the cumin. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,lasagna noodle,romaine lettuce,fettuccine,lettuce leaf,kalamata olive
title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces dry fettuccine, cooked or 16 ounces dry penne | 1 romaine lettuce, chopped | 4 ounces kalamata olives, halved | 12 ounces grilled or broiled long-grain white fish | 1 cup shredded lettuce leaf | 16 slices romaine lettuce | 18 small fresh lasagna noodles or 18 small other pastas ( 8 ounces )
instructions: Bring 4 quarts of well salted water to boil in large pot. Mix pasta, vegetables, and fish in large bowl to coat. Bring 4 quarts of lightly salted water to boil. Cook pasta, stirring occasionally, until just tender but still firm to bite, about 9 minutes. Drain. Rinse with cold water. Arrange in a bowl. Add lettuce, olives, linguine and vegetables. Toss to combine. Taste and season to taste with salt/pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Raisin Bites
ingredients: 200 g dried raisins | 2 teaspoons dried hot chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup olive, finely chopped
instructions: Boil or steam the raisins until very thick. Drain. Add sugar, dried chili and olives and cook until sugar melts. Remove from heat and allow to cool until easy to spread on bread or toast and spread on your favourite bread.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,white cake mix,cooking oil,water,taco seasoning mix,extra finely sugar,lima bean
title: Mama's Lima Beans and Tater Pancakes
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | cooking oil | 2 cans lima beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 packages taco seasoning mix | 1 cup water | 1 package extra finely granulated sugar | 1 cup golden raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degreees put all the ingredients into large mixing bowl. Make sure the sugar is dissolved and everything is just mixed. Grease a deep frying pan with cooking oil, and put it in the oven to heat it up. The pancake batter should be about ¾ f. Spread it on a cake pan, on the baking sheet. When the pancake is on top of your cake pan it will be ready if you place 2 small loaf pans onto it. Put it in the oven at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, then turn the temperature down to 325 degrees and let it cook for for another 15 minutes. Turn the pancake over and let it cook for a further 45 minutes. Serve with salsa or sour cream. Enjoy.

title: Caper and Goat Cheese Focaccia Filling
ingredients: 1 lb of finely grated goat cheese | 1/3 lb finely diced leeks or 1/3 lb of finely diced white onion | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 finely diced bell pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pinch off pieces of dough with your fingers and roll out with a rolling pin or biscuit cutter into a long narrow rectangle about 1/2 to 3/4 deep. Spread filling onto dough, and form an oval/rectangular loaf using the rounded side of the loaf. Put under a broiler, or place the bread over a gas flame on a cookie sheet with a rack to catch any steam. Let bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour on top of the oven, or until golden brown and cheese is melted.

title: Apple Wine Jelly
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 cup apple juice or 1/2 cup apple, juice | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Coat jelly pan generously with crisco® cooking spray. Combine apple juice and chopped parsley in saucepan and bring to boil then simmer 5 minutes. Pour into jelly pan. Dry jelly, covered, with paper towels and allow to stand 10 minutes. Uncover, then spread jelly evenly in dish. Press jelly onto base of jelly with fingers. Set aside at room temperature for 15 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 375 degrees. Place jelly in oven and bake for 15 minutes or until puffed and jelly is crisp. Immediately remove jelly from oven and transfer jelly to cutting board.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,linguine,white chocolate chip,fast rising yeast,arugula,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Mexican Steamed Artfully Stir Fried Pasta
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups cooked linguine, drained per packet directions | 1 cup white chocolate chips | 1 2/3 cups arugula, chopped, about 8 cups | 2 tablespoons quick-rising yeast | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons arugula, finely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pasta and arugula in a large bowl. When mixed, cover bowl with waxed paper and set aside in a warm place until cool, about 5+ minutes. Add pasta to bowl and toss to coat with mixture. Cover bowl and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, for several hours or overnight. Serve immediately, or refrigerate overnight for up to 3 days. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,celery seed,lentil,rice noodle,tomato ketchup,beef,green chili
title: Baked Rice Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 500 g rice noodles, medium | 500 g ground beef | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 small green chili, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 3 tablespoons condensed lentils
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Cook noodles in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Rinse with cold water and drain again. Set aside. Combine beef, celery seed, stock and chilli. Drain the noodles and mix well with meat mixture. Pour into casserole or a 2 1/2 litre shallow ovenproof dish. Top with noodle mixture. Pour over tomato ketchup and lentils. Cover and bake in oven for 1 hour. Remove cover for the last 30 minutes to crisp up the top.

Random Ingredients: linguica sausage,green onion,cooking spray,madeira wine,corn oil,extra wide egg noodle,green chili,maraschino cherry
title: Linguica and Sticky Onions and Sauce
ingredients: corn oil | 1 green onion, sliced | 8 ounces linguica sausage, finely sliced | 10 maraschino cherries, cut in half | 1 tablespoon red chili, minced | 1 tablespoon madeira wine or 1 tablespoon dry white wine | cooking spray | 1 package extra-wide egg noodles
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add the onions and saute until soft, about 4 to 6 minutes. Add the linguica and cook until light golden brown, about 2 minutes. Pour in the cherries and chile.

title: Grilled Chile Jack and Chives On the Grill
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lime juice | 2 medium scallions, sliced, both white and green parts separated | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped chives | 4 teaspoons reduced sugar | 2/3 lb monterey jack cheese, cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Stir together lime juice, scallions, chives and sugar in shallow dish. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add cheese, turning several times, then transfer to grill and cook 5 minutes on each side or grill top 2 minutes or until light gold and bubbly. Top with green parts.

title: Melting Moments
ingredients: 1/4 cup cornflour | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 150 ml brandy, or extra virgin, to taste
instructions: Stir the cornflour and confectioner's sugar together in a medium bowl until smooth. Add brandy, until mixture just comes together. Form into 30 balls. Roll between your palms to coat. Store covered in the refrigerator.

title: Namibian Fried Green Peas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups frozen mixed vegetables | 4 cups fresh peas or 4 cups frozen peas | 1/2 cup plain unsweetened yogurt ( optional ) | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cook peas in pan until tender but firm, and drain. When done, place peas in bowl of food processor, add yogurt and puree. If using jalapeños, cut in half and add to peas and mix well. Serve hot.

title: Garlic Artichokes (Artichauts De Vinho)
ingredients: 6 -8 artichoke hearts, halved | 4 garlic cloves, minced | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Lightly oil grill. Grill artichokes, turning occasionally, until charred, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and cover with foil to keep warm. Reduce grill heat to medium and add garlic. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,salad oil,active yeast,mineral water
title: Red chili Vinaigrette from Indian Restaurant
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup mineral water | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Proof the yeast by pouring mineral water into a small bowl and stirring to dissolve yeast. Mix in the rest of the herbs and rub in the bottle. Enjoy your healthy, tasty, happy, comforting red chilly vinaigrette.

title: Grilled Tripe and Artichoke Crostini
ingredients: 1 lb boneless tripe | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup nonfat yogurt | 4 teaspoons catsup | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill sprigs | 1 cup crouton, finely crushed
instructions: Soak tripe in at least 1 inch of water for 20 minutes. Bring a kettle of water to a boil for cooking. Remove from heat and allow tripe to stand 15 minutes. Slice tripe into 1/4 inch rounds. Place in a bowl and coat with 1 teaspoon catsup, yogurt, 1 teaspoon catsup, sage, dill and remaining 1 teaspoon catsup. Place in an ovenproof baking dish and coat with the croutons. Broil tripe for 2 minutes. Serve hot. Enjoy.

title: Chinese Five Spice Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 2 1/2 lbs of small white mushrooms, trimmed and halved
instructions: Melt a pinch of chilli sauce or sweet chili sauce in a non stick skillet over medium heat. Add half of mushrooms and stir fry for 3 minutes. Add the rest of the mushrooms and stir fry for another 3 minutes. Remove from heat and transfer onto a serving platter and serve at once.

title: Mixed Berry Pudding
ingredients: 600 g mixed berries ( raspberries, strawberries, peaches, raspberries and a few green ) | 3 cardamom pods, crushed ( optional ) | 3/4 cup sour cream | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | fresh coriander, for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring occasionally. Spoon into serving glasses or serving bowls and garnish with fresh coriander. Serve hot.

title: Burgundy Florentine
ingredients: 500 g frozen chopped spinach | 250 ml double cream | 700 g minced meat
instructions: Defrost spinach and squeeze out moisture as you are filling. Whip cream until stiff. Fold in spinach, meat, and sauces. You can assemble the bundles with silver charms or other decorative flatbreads or decorative flat breads.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,green bean,green maraschino cherry,lemon wedge,sumac,orange
title: Mediterranean Pasta Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces bow tie pasta | 3/4 lb fresh green beans ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup green maraschino cherry | 1 orange, sectioned and cut into slices | lemon wedge | sumac ( optional )
instructions: Cook and drain pasta. In a large salad bowl, combine all ingredients except lemon wedges and sumac if desired. Toss gently. Cover and chill for 2 hours or overnight.

title: Quick Fish Cutlets With Cashew and Apricots
ingredients: 6 white fish fillets | 1/2 red cabbage, washed, shredded and chopped | 1/2 cup cashews, finely chopped | 2/3 cup apricot halves, cut into halves
instructions: Heat oil in wok. Stir fry cashews for 3 - 4 minutes. Add chopped cabbage and stir for 2 minutes. Add fish. Stir fry for 2 minutes. Now add apricots. Stir fry for a minute. Transfer fish fillets. Mix well and serve on boiled rice.

title: Pizza Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup cream or 2/3 cup whole wheat | 1/3 cup mixed spice ( or your favourite mix ) | 1/2 cup quick-rise dough ( rapid bake method # 1 )
instructions: Mix cream or whole wheat with spices. Mix dough with dry ingredients.

title: Chef-Boy-I-Be Illinois' Italian Burger
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs ground beef | 1 bottle vodka | 8 pieces pizza dough | 2 cups colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Mix ground beef and vodka till blended. You might need to put in a crockpot to get it warm. Place pizza dough on cookie sheets. Spread the sauce, evenly over the top. Put some cheese over the top of the sauce. Cover with foil to protect from drying out. Bake at 425f for 35 minutes. Let cool before serving.

title: Guiltless Fat Grilled Vegetables With Plantains
ingredients: 2 medium russet potatoes ( unpeeled and cut into 1/2 inch thick slices ) | 2 large aubergines ( sliced thin ) or 2 japanese eggplants ( unpeeled and cut into 1/2 inch thick slices ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 1 can bamboo shoots ( sliced )
instructions: Place the potatoes in a food processor with the egg plant, coriander, allspice, and refried beans. Pulse to desired consistency. Toast the plantains in a nonstick skillet or griddle set at medium low heat until lightly browned, about 7 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: bread,oil,green chili pepper,crabmeat,marjoram,chunky salsa,apple pie filling,coconut cream
title: Spicy Seafood Toast
ingredients: 3 slices bread | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( can use pace picante sauce ) or 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon bread crumbs or 1 tablespoon dried breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon oil | 2 ounces crabmeat, cooked and flaked or 2 ounces imitation crabmeat, steamed and drained | 1 dash marjoram ( or 1/4 tsp ground dill ) or 1 dash ground thyme ( or 1/4 tsp ground dill ) | 1/4 cup light coconut cream or 1/4 cup coconut milk, warmed | 1 chopped green chili pepper
instructions: Spread one side of the bread with salsa. Make the rest of the sandwiches with the remaining ingredients. Serve with a side of green chili.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,mirin,salt,garlic powder,white sugar,lasagna noodle,poppy seed,grain white rice
title: Poppy-Seed Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 12 cooked lasagna noodles | 1 lb ground round | 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1/2 cup poppy seeds | 1/4 cup white sugar | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 pinch salt | 1/3 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 2 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Boil water in a pot. Toast poppy seeds in skillet until light brown. Set aside. Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium high heat until cooked through. Drain well. Meanwhile, heat a large pot of salted water to boiling over medium high heat. Add the rice, stir, and cover. Reduce heat, and simmer until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender, about 15 minutes. Pour cooked rice into a large bowl, and mash it lightly using your hands. Add the poppy seed and sugar, and mash with a fork or two until the sugar dissolves. Stir in eggs, mushrooms, salt, and mirin. Line baking sheets with foil, and spray generously with cooking spray. Spread about 1/2 cup of the filling mixture onto the bottom of the baking sheets. Spoon more than 1/2 cup of the rice mixture on top of the filling, and spread to form a 1/2 inch wide wall. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or more. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bake the lasagna until heated through, about 30 minutes.

title: Easy Lima Beans
ingredients: 1 lb lima beans ( lima beans ) | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil
instructions: Clean the bean heads removing any stones or foreign dirt. Put the beans into a large pot of cold water and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat and simmer for 1 hour. Remove from heat and let stand for 15 minutes. Drain the beans to remove any remaining moisture. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet and cook the lima beans until they are tender. They are now ready for use.

title: Spice Triangles
ingredients: 2 packets spice per packet | 60 ml red wine | 1 jar capers, rinsed and drained | 1 can phyllo pastry
instructions: In a saucepan, mix the red wine, capers and spice per packet. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for five minutes. Remove from heat. Add phyllo on a lightly floured board. Press into the size of a large star. Brush with glaze. Repeat with remaining phyllo. Transfer to a lightly greased rectangular pan and cook uncovered for 15 - 25 minutes at 190 degrees c. Turn pan onto plate and brush with more glaze.

title: Alfajores
ingredients: 1 lb dried brown lentils | 1 lb sirloin tip roast, fat trimmed
instructions: Combine lentils and beef tips in a dutch oven. Cover. Melt the sugar in the kettle over medium heat. Stir it into the dutch oven. Increase the heat and bring to a boil. Cover. Reduce heat, and simmer until the lentils are tender, 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Shred the meat as directed above. Serve hot.

title: Grilled Sirloin Steak
ingredients: 1 lb thin steaks | 1 jar salsa | 2 tablespoons olive, drained
instructions: Place steak in a pan, pour 1 jar of salsa over, heat about 20 minutes. Cook over hot coals for about 10 minutes, flip to grill the otherside. It should be medium rare and should be kept warm. To serve, shred meat and serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: coconut,vanilla,soybean oil vegetable,yeast,chocolate,yukon gold potato,barley flour,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Yummy Banana Bread
ingredients: 2 cups barley flour or 2 cups wheat gluten | 1 cup mashed sweet potatoes | 1 teaspoon yeast | 1 cup grated coconut | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cup shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 3/4 cup soybean oil or 3/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 cup chocolate shavings or 1 cup chopped chocolate, of choice ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine 2 cups of the barley flour, potato, onion, coconut, and yeast. Stir in the grated cheese and soybean oil. Stir in the potatoes. On a floured board, knead the dough until it is smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes. Place in an oiled bowl, turn to oil all the surfaces of the dough. Cover and let rise in a warm area for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Bake in the center of the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, or until lightly browned. While warm, slice the loaf crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices and arrange on a baking sheet. Brush generously with barbeque sauce and sprinkle with chocolate. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 yellow squash or 1 large zucchini | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups broth, homemade or from a cube
instructions: Slice the squash into rounds about ¼ thick. Soak in cold tap water or in a strainer for about 3 minutes to make rid of excess oil. Wash well. Heat the stock on medium until it reaches just under a simmer, add the squash slices and simmer for 3 minutes until soft. Remove squash to individual dishes or plates. Pour in the stock. Serve when hot, warm and enjoy.

title: Pasta With Chiles and Eggs
ingredients: 2 lbs pastas | 1/2 lb red chile | 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil and light tasting extra virgin olive oil | 1 egg yolk
instructions: First, make a sauce of the extra virgin olive oil, 1 egg yolk and a little coarsely ground black pepper. Cut each slice of the chilli into julienne. Cut the chillies in half, without the stalk unless using them, so that the lengths length of the chillies are long enough. Slice the chiles in half again. Heat the olive oil over a very hot pan, add the chilli and cook for a few seconds until it has desolved. Add the chillies and cook for 2 minutes, stirring now and then to ensure even cooking. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the box. Drain them well and tip them into a large bowl. Add the egg yolk and whisk well, making sure the yolk coats the pasta. Tip the pasta into the bowl and gently fold together everything gently until each slice of pasta is coated with the chilli oil. Add salt and pepper, to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Mango Chutney Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup mango chutney, such as major greys | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the ricotta cheese, ketchup, mango chutney, and taco seasoning until evenly blended. Cover, and refrigerate for one hour before serving.

title: Island Limeade Cocktail
ingredients: 1 cup limeade concentrate, undiluted | 1/4 cup brandy, whiskey, or other alcohol | 1 teaspoon dried maraschino cherries, or to taste | 1 bottle thousand island dressing, with lemon-lime juice
instructions: Fill a medium bowl with ice.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,mustard,red chilies,salt black pepper,egg yolk,sage leaf
title: Mage Puffs - Stuffed Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces mustard | 1 1/2 ounces egg yolks | 4 ounces dried red chilies, soaked in warm water for 20 mins 'til soft | 12 sage leaves | 2 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 2 teaspoons salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Crush the chilie leaves well. Beat the mustard, egg yolks, lime zest, salt, and pepper until creamy. Mix the chillies with the mustard mixture. To fill the shells, remove the pointed ends by gently rolling to help them curl up from the base. Place the mixture about 2 1/2 inches above the center of a pastry cloth. Wrap the outside and the inside edge, pleating them tightly as you go, and tie shut with kitchen string. Fry over medium heat for 7 - 10 mins till golden brown. Serve at once.

title: Potato Cauliflower Cabbage With Caper & Pecans
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 head cabbage | 3 russet potatoes, unpeeled, halved, cut crosswise in half | 1/2 cup capers, drained | 1 jar mild salsa | 1 tablespoon ground mace, or to taste | 1/4 cup pecans, finely chopped
instructions: Place cauliflower in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover, venting steam holes. Steam 8 minutes, or until tender but still crisp. Remove from steamer. Cool slightly. Cut cauliflower into 4 to 6 wedges. Place remaining ingredients in a large saucepan.

title: Lemon Ginger Soup
ingredients: 16 cups low sodium chicken broth | 4 1/2 cups peeled shredded lemons or 6 1/2 cups bottled grated gingerroot | 2 ice cubes
instructions: Bring broth, lemon or ginger root pulp and ice to boil in 3 quart saucepan. Cover.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,nigella seed,stewing beef,spring onion,pumpkin puree,banana,spaghetti
title: Beef & Nigella Spanish Nachos - Crockpot
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cubed | 5 spring onions, cut finely ( use all spring onions ) | 1 teaspoon nigella seeds ( optional ) | 1 ounce spaghetti | 3 3 ounces spiced brown pumpkin puree or 3 ounces pumpkin pie spice | 100 g corn tortilla chips ( or more ) or 100 g pepitas ( or more ) | 1 banana ( optional )
instructions: Put chuck roast into the crockpot. Cut spring onions into pieces and scatter into the crockpot. Add nigella seeds. If using a pepita, add it now as it will make the nachos crispy. Add pumpkin. Add beef cubes to crockpot. Mix the spiced pumpkin, brown pumpkin or pie spice in the corn tortilla chips. Stir this mixture into the contents of the crockpot into the contents of the crockpot. Cover. Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours for a harder, lighter meal. If you don't have an electric crockpot, cook on low for 6 to 8 hours to get the good niebies a little bit firmer. Serve with thick slices of ripe banana on top. A little lemon or lime juice is good as a garnish, as a dip or sauce.

title: Southwest Taco Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/3 cup taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let stand 2 hrs before using. Will stay in tightly covered jar up to a week.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,green chili,midori melon liqueur,pepper flake,celery,red capsicum,soymilk,cornflour
title: Low Cal Low Fat Cheesecake With Capsicum Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces cream cheese | 1 cup light soy milk | 1 tablespoon midori melon liqueur | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1/2 cup light cream cheese | 1/4 cup red capsicum, diced | 1/8 of green chili, diced | pimento fresco ( to garnish ) or coriander ( to garnish )
instructions: For the base, blend cream cheese, soy milk, midori, hot pepper flakes and cornflour in a blender until smooth. Pour into a glass bowl, top with capsicum. Blend cream cheese in a clean bowl with a few drops of water until it's creamy and well combined. Pour over topping. Bake on a low oven for 1 hour or until set. Serve with a mixed fruit dipping sauce and garnish with a small pimento fresco or coriander.

title: Chinese Hot Apple Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 6 tablespoons catsup | 4 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve with thinly sliced french fry veggies or fried eggs.

Random Ingredients: chicken sausage,filet beef,date,chile sauce,tomato puree,celery rib,egg noodle
title: Chilli Beef Bake
ingredients: 500 g chicken sausage | 400 g medium egg noodles | 425 g pitted dates, thinly sliced | 1 small chopped celery rib | 400 g tomato puree | 300 g filet of beef, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon chilli sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 165c. Line a 23cm x 23cm shallow dish with baking paper. Cook the sausages in a frying pan with oil and cook for 1/2 for 10 mins until browned. Set aside and slice into 5cm pieces. Cook noodles in boiling water for 8 mins or until tender. Drain water. Place egg noodles and dates into a large bowl along with chopped celery. Mix well. Add chicken and sausage, then mix to combine. Spoon mixture into the baking dish. Cover with foil and bake for 40 mins. Remove foil and bake for a further 30 mins to golden. Serve sprinkled with chilli sauce.

Random Ingredients: greek olive,salt black pepper,pork rib,cauliflower,vinegar,collard green
title: Georgian Collard Greens
ingredients: 500 g collard greens | 300 g baby sweet potatoes or 300 g fingerling sweet potatoes | 8 large greek olives, rinsed | 1/4 cup vinegar | 200 g pork ribs or 200 g other sausage | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Slice collard leaves thinly. Boil potatoes or sweet potatoes, in salted water, until barely tender. Drain and cool slightly, then chop into 1/4 inch pieces. Peel and slice pork ribs. In large deep pan, dissolve vinegar and sugar in vinegar.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,black olive,arborio rice,nutmeg,dark rum,dark chocolate
title: Chocolate-Infused Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped black olives ( greengage can be substituted, also ) or 1/2 cup black olives ( greengage can be substituted, also ) | 1/4 cup dark rum or 1/4 cup other rum | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional and to taste ) or 2 tablespoons other rum ( optional and to taste ) | 2 -4 serrano chilies, roasted ( seeded, deveined and minced or to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice ( or white or brown rice ) | 2 -4 ounces good-quality dark chocolate, grated ( not unsweetened )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine 1/2 cup rum, 2 tbsp rum or other nondairy splashy and stir to loosen the alcohol. Heat to boiling, lower heat to very low, cover and keep warm. Stir remaining rum into warm rum and set aside for another use. Pour rum mixture into a heavy nonstick skillet with about 2 - 3 tbsp water. Heat to boiling over medium heat. While stirring occasionally, sprinkle chiles over the surface of the rum. Cook, swirling the pan to keep chiles from burning, until shrimp are cooked but not quite cooked through. Immediately turn off heat. Rinse rice and soak in warm water for 10 - 15 minutes. Drain rice in strainer. Pour 2 3/4 cups very hot rum into the pan. Add rice to pan and stir. Raise heat to high and stir for about 20 seconds. Remove pan from heat and, keeping a heatproof bowl on top, quickly pour rice into the pan. Scatter grated chocolate over top. Let stand about 2 - 3 minute. Remove from heat, and serve.

title: Homemade Pita Bread
ingredients: 1 small pita bread, split in half horizontally | 1 1/2 teaspoons sazon goya | 1/2 fluid ounce vodka
instructions: Toast split side of pita bread. Spread 1/4 teaspoon sazon on each pita to taste. Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon of goya over sazon. Pour 1/2 ounce vodka into a small martini glass, or into a cocktail glass. Shake with cocktail spoon or blowtorch until hot.

title: Capellini
ingredients: 2 cups breadcrumbs ( fresh or from a day old bag ) | 1 hot red chili pepper | ice water
instructions: Cut the chile in half and then with a knife cut into very fine pieces then into wedges. Crush the pieces of chili slightly with your hands. Roll them into about 15 balls. Sprinkle the crumbs and the chilli on the top, press to moisten. Add enough icewater to just cover the whole thing evenly. Place the balls in a shallow pan and put gently over a medium heat. Cook for 10 minutes. Remove from pan and leave to cool slightly. Transfer the balls to a board with a slotted spoon and roll them in the breadcrumbs. Serve right away with salad and tomato sauce for dipping..

title: Spiced Strawberry Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta, cooked al dente | 2 cups fresh strawberries, sliced and tossed with | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 teaspoon ground mixed spice | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon fresh tarragon, snipped
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: italian cheese,parsley leaf,beef bouillon cube,grand marnier,pinto bean,pork,bengal
title: Bengali Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dried pinto beans, soaked overnight, and drained | 6 cups beef bouillon cubes | 3/4 lb pork fat, 1/4-inch dice | 3/4 lb bengal, peeled, cut in 1-inch chunks | 1/4 cup extra-sharp italian cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Place the beans in a big pot and cover with several inches of lightly salted water. Cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to medium low. Simmer, partially covered, until the beans are very soft and creamy, 45 to 60 minutes. Stir occasionally. Meanwhile, brown the pork fat in a skillet over medium heat. Remove from the skillet, drain and reserve. Reserve the pan drippings. Skim any fat remaining after the beans had begun to soften, and then add the pork and broth. Return to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer, partially covered and stirring frequently, until the beans are very tender and the sauce has thickened and reduced to about 1/2 cup, about 20 minutes. Discard the bouillon cubes. Stir in the cheese, parsley, and remaining 1/4 cup water, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the cheese has melted.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,chipotle chile,basil leaf,cannellini bean
title: Chipotle Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb cannellini beans, canned drained and rinsed | 1 small chipotle chile, seeded and minced | 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf, torn in small pieces
instructions: Combine canned beans and next 5 ingredients in a medium bowl. Chill. Garnish with chives before serving.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,chipotle chile,grain white rice,black eyed pea
title: Microwave Chipotle Black-Eyed Peas & Rice
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 1 chipotle chiles, in adobo with 2 chipotle chiles or 3 -4 tablespoons chopped canned chipotle chiles | 1/2 - 3/4 cup long grain white rice ( to garnish )
instructions: Microwave on high for 1 minute. Add black eyed peas and cook for 4 minutes then microwave on md for another minute.. Add mushrooms and chipotle, stir, cover and cook on the auto 100 setting for 5 minutes, remove from power and let sit for a minute before serving. Stir in 1/2 cup long grain white rice, and serve.

title: Cock-Adu
ingredients: 3/4 cup pearl barley | 2 1/2 cups buttermilk, or as needed
instructions: Add barley and buttermilk to a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring as liquid cooks off, until liquid has thickened to your liking, 5 to 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Fish in Cacé (Filling for Australian Batter)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh fish, skin removed | 4 slices bacon | 1 english cucumber, thickly sliced | butter
instructions: Cut the bacon into 3 1/2 to 4 inch pieces and fry lightly over a high heat. Drain the pieces on paper towels. Place the pieces of fish on a sheet or paper towels and cover with a piece of bacon. Spread the pieces of cucumber over the top, then arrange the strips of bacon around the cucumber. Cover with the remaining bacon, wrap tightly in some aluminum foil and refrigerate for 30 to 45 minutes, or up to 2 days. To bake, preheat the oven to 375°f. Remove the fish from the refrigerator 15 to 20 minutes before baking. Put the baking sheet in the center of the oven and bake for 3 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 400°f. Cook for another 3 to 5 minutes, turning fish over. Remove the foil and bake for a further 10 minutes, or until fish is cooked through and slightly browned on the outside. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream,chinese five spice powder,saffron,beef bouillon granule,greek yogurt,tahini
title: Shaky Onion Dip for Dogs
ingredients: 1 box low-fat plain greek yogurt | 1/3 cup creamy shaoxing tahini | 4 large saffron, pulverized in a mortar | 1/3 cup beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Place yogurt, tahini powder, saffron, beef bouillon, five spice powder, and saffron in a food processor. Mix until smooth, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: black bean,heavy cream,tortilla chip,sea salt,green bell pepper,cucumber,pork shoulder roast
title: Easy Sweet-And-Sour Pork Nachos
ingredients: 1/2 pound boneless pork shoulder roast | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1/2 cucumber, sliced | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 tortilla chips, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a large baking dish. Place roast in the prepared baking dish, and spread black beans over roast. In a small bowl, stir together cream, green bell pepper, cucumber, and sea salt. Spread cream mixture over the black beans, and top with crushed tortilla chips. Bake in the preheated oven until a meat thermometer inserted into center of an chop easily pulls out, 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,ginger,ginger garlic paste,shrimp,basmati rice,virgin olive oil
title: Madhur Jaffrey's Shrimp Kabobs from Punjab, India
ingredients: 1 kg beef brisket ( meat-loin ) | 4 cups basmati rice | 400 g shrimp ( fresh or raw, cooked ) | 20 ginger-garlic paste ( goan style ) | 10 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Put the beef in a saucepan or deep saucepan and cover with enough water just to 2cm above the meat. Bring to the boil, skimming off any scum that rises. Turn the heat down. Cover the saucepan and simmer for 1 hour. Drain. Wash the rice well, then add to the beef along with the shrimp and cover again. After this, turn off the heat. Cover and leave for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork, then set aside. Take a piece of ginger garlic paste and rub it lightly over the brisket. This will give you a subtle flavor and smell. Heat the olive oil in a wok or frying pan. When the oil is just starting to smoke, add as many ginger garlic paste as you can and fry for 5 minutes. Toss in the brisket and fry for 5 minutes over high heat, keeping your spoon on the work surface while you prepare the rice and shrimp. This makes for a tasty, flavorful and aromatic dish to serve with this lovely dish. This is delicious served with a simple vegetable curry or steamed basmati rice. Also, this recipe makes a very tasty dish, so don't be shy about the ginger garlic paste recipe #53900….

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,cod,balsamic vinegar,new york,plum tomato,chickpea,cardamom seed
title: Chickpea-cod  With Chiles and Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned chickpeas ( drained ) | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 large new york strip steak or 1 large butterflied cod | 14 1/2 ounces plum tomatoes, crushed | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh garlic
instructions: Blend chickpeas, cocoa powder, cardamom and 1 tbls. Chopped garlic in blender until smooth. Chill.. Season fish on both sides with salt and pepper. Grill over medium hot coals for 3 - 5 minutes on each side to sear. Spoon the sauce over fish. Serve with remaining sauce in a small bowl. Accompany with mexican rice.

title: Easy and Fast Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 2 jars tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons dijon-style mustard | 2 yellow peppers, chopped
instructions: Combine the tomato sauce, mustard, and peppers in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil.

title: Chinese Eggplant and Snow Peas
ingredients: 3 large eggplants or 2 medium aubergines | 2 cans snow peas | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon coriander powder ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 4 tablespoons small curds ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Wash, dry, remove and slice the eggplant lengthwise as thin as possible. Place in a large, shallow ovenproof dish and add the peas. Add 2 tablespoons of water, cover and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until eggplant is tender and peas are browned. Combine 2 to 2 teaspoons of cornstarch well with the remaining water and mix into a smooth paste. Stir in coriander and mustard and spoon over the eggplant. Bake in oven for 5 - 10 minute. Serve.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,french onion,anise seed,fish sauce,red wine
title: Beef and Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steak | 1 can spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon anise seed ( or 1/2 tsp. ground allspice ) | 3 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/2 cup dry red wine ( optional ) or 1/2 cup water ( optional )
instructions: Cut steak into bite size pieces and place in a large dutch oven. Heat, covered, over medium high heat til browned on all sides, approximately 15 minutes. Meanwhile, drain spinach according to package directions. Place spinach in a food processor. When steak is done brown, add spinach to the slow cooker, and add remaining ingredients except wine. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 10 hours, stirring once or twice. At the table remove the garlic cloves. To serve, slice and serve with green curry.

title: Easy Pistachio Nests for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 package tortilla chips | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 package chicken wings | 1/4 cup pistachio nut, finely chopped
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add 1/4 cup pistachio nuts to the boiling water and then drain and place in a small bowl. Add the chicken and 1/4 cup pistachio nuts to the boiling water and put back on the heat and simmer until the chicken is no longer pink, about 15 minutes. Remove the chicken and pistachio nests from the saucepan using a slotted spoon to separate the strands from the white pellets. Return the chicken and pecans to the saucepan and stir to coat. Cook 4 minutes, until heated through. Serve warm.

title: Rhubarb Beef Tips
ingredients: 1 rhubarb, stalk trimmed into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 teaspoon dried ginger root | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried garlic salt | 1 1/2 pounds beef sirloin
instructions: Place rhubarb, onion flakes, ginger, garlic salt, and beef tips into a slow cooker. Lock lid in place and set to high. Cook 1 1/2 hours. Turn and cook for an additional 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,coconut water,dark chocolate,orange juice,english mustard,cocoa powder,tater tot
title: Oozy Beef Tater Tot Tatin
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs lean beef sirloin or 1 1/4 lbs stewing beef
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut beef into very thin bite size cubes. Heat a large skillet. Add fat and brown beef on all sides. In a large casserole dish, layer meat, 1/4c of the reserved meat juices, and about 1 - ½ tbsp of cocoa powder. Repeat with remaining meat. Drain any grease left in pan and add back to casserole. Add water to cover meat and bake covered for 1 hour. Uncover and bake for 10 minutes longer. Remove cover and bake for 25 minutes longer or until the sauce is bubbling. Let sit 10 minutes before serving over brown or steamed jasmine rice. Enjoy.

title: Rigatoni With Pomegranate Syrup
ingredients: 4 cups rigatoni pasta ( or any other small pasta of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice ( or to taste )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil with pomegranate syrup. Add the pasta and cook 6 - 8 minutes. Drain and toss with pomegranate syrup. Serve.

title: Greek Quinoa with Garlic Apples
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, washed and drained on paper towels | 2/3 cup low fat yogurt ( low-fat or nonfat ) | 3 tablespoons shredded fresh garlic | 1 1/2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 2 1/2 tablespoons lemon zest | 1 1/2 cups ice
instructions: Place all ingredients, except for ice, in an electric blender and blend until all ingredients are completely mixed. Pour into a tall glass and serve.

title: Pistachio Peppers
ingredients: 6 -8 large fresh pistachios ( or blanched and shelled ) | 3 green peppers | 1 cup brandy ( or rum )
instructions: Heat pan until hot. Add pistachios and peppers. Pour in brandy. Cook 5 minutes, stirring, until slightly dry.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,water artichoke heart,beef bouillon cube,veal stock,baby carrot,nori
title: Artichoke and Carrots Soup
ingredients: 1 cup baby carrots ( sliced ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 can water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 3 sheets nori, thinly sliced seaweed sheets | 1 cup veal stock | 1 teaspoon sage leaves ( fresh or dried )
instructions: Sauté carrots in a small amount of vegetable broth, stirring occasionally until tender but not brown, about 10 minutes. Transfer to food processor and puree until smooth. In a separate saucepan, place the artichoke hearts and vegetable broth over medium heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered for about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and drain liquid. Place the soup in batches in a food processor or blender and blend until smooth. Return liquid to pot with the carrots and artichoke puree and keep warm over low heat. Add nori and stir gently to coat. Heat a small amount of vegetable broth in a small saucepan until it just begins to sizzle, about 1 - 2 minutes. Transfer soup to a bowl and garnish soup with a sprinkle of sage.

title: Quick Clam Bisque
ingredients: 24 cans whole clams, with juice | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker and cook on high 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Serve with corn chips.

title: Nan-Chuka: Spicy Beef, Shrimp & Chicken
ingredients: 500 g minced beef short ribs | 2 tablespoons soya sauce ( i use light ) | 1/4 cup chicken, julienned | 100 g shrimp, shelled | 3/4 cup mace ( see note ) | 120 g chickpeas | 20 maraschino cherries, dried
instructions: Note, maraschino cherries can be found in most oriental grocery stores. In a large bowl mix minced beef, sugar, soya sauce and shrimp with a spatula or fork. Dice and rinse vegetables, soak in hot water for 2 hours. In a large bowl mix minced beef, then stir in dried shrimp. Add 1 - 2 tablespoons oil and some water until mixture forms a paste consistency, adding more water if required. Add the meat mixture to the maraschino cherries and soak for 15 minutes. If necessary, drain beef and add more soya sauce. Add dried shrimp and maraschino cherries to beef mixture. Garnish with dried maraschino cherries.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,parsnip,bicarbonate soda,serrano chili pepper,anaheim chilies,white rice,caper,salt pork
title: Chile, Rice and Crispy Parsnips With Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup white rice | 1/4 lb salt pork, diced | 1 cup parsnip, skin on, cut into sticks about 3 inch long | 1 anaheim chilies or 1 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 4 serrano chili peppers or 4 chile peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fresh caper | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 3 cups cooked white rice or 3 cups brown rice
instructions: In a pan over medium high heat, add the pork and chopped onion. Saute stirring often for 30 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Turn the heat down and simmer, covered, for 25 to 30 minutes, adding water as necessary to prevent sticking,. Uncover and cook for an additional 20 - 25 minutes, or until crisp and tender.

title: Jicama Salad
ingredients: 4 cups jicama, cut in thick slices | 2 cups corn oil | 4 cups tomato juice | 2 cups sliced celery | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1/4 cup slivered almonds or 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Place the jicama in a colander and toss with 1 cup of the oil. Sprinkle with salt and marinate 30 minutes in the refrigerator. Combine the tomato juice, celery, 1 tablespoon of the mint and the mixed spice. Bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes. Place the remaining 1 cup of oil in a bowl and add the remaining 2 tablespoons of mint and the sliced almonds. Place the jicama in the bowl and pour the sauce over. Toss to coat.

title: Roasted Pumpkin & French Beans
ingredients: 1 medium butternut pumpkin | 1 package frozen french beans, defrosted | 3 tablespoons freshly ground pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh lavender ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cut pumpkin into 3/4 chunks. Place on greased baking sheet. Sprinkle with pepper & lavender. Bake for 30 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,asparagus,cotija cheese,southern comfort,pasta,seasoning salt
title: Pan Spiedini With Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh asparagus, with ends ends snipped off | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/2 cup coarsely grated cotija cheese ( about 3 ounces ) | 1/4 cup southern comfort | cooked pasta
instructions: Trim asparagus bottoms and discard ends. Cut off tips of asparagus with a sharp knife. Cut in half lengthwise. Cut each half crosswise into thirds. Sprinkle the bottom of a large frying pan with salt and pepper. Place asparagus pieces in pan and sear over medium high heat until lightly browned and just cooked through, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer asparagus to a plate lined with paper towel and repeat with remaining asparagus pieces. Sprinkle asparagus with cheese. Return skillet to heat. When it is very hot, add hot crème fraîche and heat until bubbling. Season asparagus with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rotel,lemon zest,garam masala,sesame seed,pineapple juice,thai basil
title: Fiesta - Gluten Free Version
ingredients: 1 can pineapple in juice, drained | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1/4 cup lemon zest ( or 1/4 cup lime zest for a lighter zing ) | 1/4 cup dried basil, chopped ( can use fresh to taste ) | 1/2 cup garam masala ( or to taste ) | 1 can rotel ( or more, depending on how much you like )
instructions: Combine everything except the sesame seeds and set to the side. Let sit for 10 minutes and mix with your hands. To make the fiesta you can add garlic or onions and stir until it is well incorporated with the other ingredients. Taste and adjust for seasonings.

title: Vietnamese Rice and Ham Salad
ingredients: 1 1 cup jasmine rice or 1 cup basmati rice | 3/4 cup ham, minced | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Sauté rice in 1 tablespoon fat until lightly browned. Place in serving bowl and top with ham, and sprinkle with cilantro. Garnish with additional cilantro.

title: Easy Vietnamese Fish Cakes
ingredients: 1 can fish sauce | 1 package dry onion soup mix
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together fish sauce and dry soup mix. Heat a skillet over medium high heat, and lightly coat with vegetable oil cooking spray. Drop 1 to 2 tablespoons of the mixture in the pan and fry until golden brown. Use spatula to remove from the pan and place on a paper towel lined plate. Roll the cakes up and serve with thai sweet chili sauce to taste.

Random Ingredients: creme de cacao,flour,gluten flour rice,ice,cranberry,broccoli floret,button mushroom
title: Struffoli  - Cranberry Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 cup gluten-free flour ( i like rice krispies ) | 3 1/4 cups fresh broccoli florets or 3 1/4 cups frozen broccoli florets | 1/2 - 3/4 lb swiss fresh mushrooms or 1/2-3/4 lb button mushroom, sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fresh cranberries or 1/2-3/4 cup dried cranberries | 2 teaspoons creole-flavoured creme de cacao | 1/2 cup rice flour | ice
instructions: Punch down broccoli and mushrooms in a steaming rack and set aside. Wash rice flour in very hot water and shake out any excess water. Place 1 - 2 tablespoons rice flour in a mixing bowl and put in broccoli/broccoli/broccoli mixture. Stir in creole flavoring, 1/2 a cup of the rice milk and 1/4 1/2 cup of the creme de cacao. Mix this mixture together and coat the broccoli/broccoli/broccoli mixture with the rice flour and set aside. When the steaming rack is cool enough to handle, position it in the center of your preheated oven. Turn the heat down to 350f degrees. Put the rice cake mixture in a deep baking dish and add about 1/2 cup of ice and stir or stir the mixture until it dissolves. Sprinkle the top with the remainder of the creme de cacao and bake until browned, about 30 - 40 minutes. To serve, cut through the score marks and serve with a scoop of ice.

title: Banana Chicken Bundles
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite sized pieces | 3 -4 large bananas peppers, diced | 1 1/2 cups golden raisins | 20 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed with a little cooking oil on the sheet
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix the chicken pieces with the diced bananas, raisins, and phyllo until thoroughly blended. Place the bundles onto cookie sheets to keep them from drying out. Brush a little cooking oil onto each sheet with cooking spray, then place them on the pan. Bake 25 minutes on the center rack of the oven, or 25 minutes on the bottom rack. Watch carefully so they don't burn.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,marjoram,lemon peel,white vinegar,beef broth,coleslaw mix,ricotta cheese,double cream
title: Marinated Beef With Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs coleslaw mix, coarsely shredded | 9 ounces canned red chilies, halved lengthwise | 6 ounces canned whole red chilies, drained and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram or 1 tablespoon oregano, chopped | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup beef broth | 2 tablespoons double cream | 4 ounces ricotta cheese | 12 fluid ounces double cream | 2 tablespoons finely shredded lemon peel
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix, chiles, marjoram and vinegar in large bowl. Cover and let stand 3 hours, stirring occasionally. Drain mixture and place in covered container and refrigerate 1 hour. Stir 1/4 cup cream and ricotta and lemon peel in medium bowl. Stir in beef mixture until well blended. Serve immediately.

title: Green Chile Salsa
ingredients: 2 kiwi fruits, peeled, cored and cut into chunks | 1 can chopped green chiles | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Place cubed kiwifruit into a microwave safe bowl. Cover with water.

title: Rasi Pita Bread Chips
ingredients: 1 italian bread, sliced or 3 slices french bread, cubed | 1/2 teaspoon rice vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit fahrenheit. Arrange bread cubes on wire rack or baking sheet. Sprinkle with vinegar. Bake for about 10 minutes. Use a pizza peel if you have one in a regular baking paper sack.

title: Polish Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 8 plum tomatoes, halved lengthwise | 1 head cabbage, cored and sliced into thin bite-size strips | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, or to taste | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: In a serving bowl, layer tomatoes, then cabbage, and drizzle with vinegar. If desired, season with chili flakes.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,molasses,tomato sauce,cilantro leaf,bicarbonate soda,polenta,jumbo shrimp
title: Shrimps in Tomato-Jalapeno Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 large russet potato, peeled | 20 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cup polenta | cilantro leaf, to garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a saucepan, heat the molasses, tomato sauce, bicarb and boil for 10 minutes, or until reduced slightly, and thickened. Transfer the mixture to a baking tray or tin. Peel the potato and cut it into thick slices. Place them in a medium sized frying pan and bake them for about 10 minutes, stirring regularly, until browned. Wash and dry the shrimp. Remove the shrimp from the syrup. Add the shrimp to the syrup and simmer for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, make the polenta for the polenta by boiling it in a pot of boiling water for 10 minutes, until it is thick. Meanwhile, in a shallow dish, mix the polenta and chopped cilantro. Dip the shrimp into the polenta mixture. Arrange on a serving plate. Pour the tomato jalapeno sauce over the shrimp and serve immediately.

title: Pineapple Queso Fresco
ingredients: 1 pineapple, ripe and cut into chunks | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Place the pineapple chunks on a baking sheet and sprinkle cheese over them. Bake at 400 degrees for about 25 minutes, or until bubbly and starting to brown. Remove from the oven and pour cream over the pineapple. Toss together until the cheese is melted and begins to coat in cream. Serve while still warm.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,sesame seed,virgin olive oil,black vinegar,chicken bouillon,beef shank
title: Faux Dijon Beef Shank Dish
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 2 lbs beef shank | 1/4 cup black vinegar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine sesame seeds with olive oil and lemon pepper on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for about 15min. Mix together the beef shank and vinegar in a large sauce pan and bring mixture to a boil. Pour in black vinegar. Simmer for about 30 minutes. Stir in sesame seeds, and serve.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,monterey jack pepper cheese,gruyere cheese
title: Cheese Fajitas With Gruyere
ingredients: 8 flour tortillas | 4 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 2 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°. Line baking sheets with foil, and lightly grease them. Mix together 1 ounce of cheese with a pinch or two of salt and pepper and divide evenly among the tortillas. Wrap each tortilla in half, place in a frying basket or on the baking sheet, and cook in the oven until brown and bubbly, about 5 - 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato,chicken stock,ketchup,shortening,self rising flour,chickpea flour,lemon pepper seasoning
title: Delicious Low-Fat Chickpea Flour Scones
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/2 cups chickpea flour | 1 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper seasoning | 2 teaspoons shortening | 3/4 cup diced tomato
instructions: Stir together dry ingredients. Make a well in the middle and pour in the ketchup, chicken broth, lemon pepper seasoning, and shortening. Add tomatoes. Stir together with a fork. Drop a teaspoon of dough into the center of the dough. Turn over once and press lightly into a circle to approximately 10 - 12 inches in diameter. Use two parchment paper sheets if you have them.

title: Taco Meatball Subs
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 1 orange, zested and juiced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh savoy cabbage | 2 containers vegetable juice | 2 eggs | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 taco shells
instructions: Mix hamburger, orange zest, and juice, and cabbage together in a large bowl. Beat the eggs, sugar, and vegetable juice in a separate bowl.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,american cheese,russet potato,sun tomato oil,red potato,english cucumber
title: Baked Potatoes With English Cucumber
ingredients: 8 large russet potatoes, peeled and chopped | 2 -3 english seedless cucumbers | 2/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup shredded american cheese | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place potatoes into a 9x13 glass baking dish, and drizzle with oil. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes, or until tender, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, toss together cucumbers, sun dried tomatoes, and 1/4 cup cheese. Return potatoes to oven and bake for 20 - 30 minutes, until cheese is melted and hot throughout, and potatoes are brown and crisp. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of chinese ginger sauce if desired.

title: Green Chili Powder - Canning Recipe
ingredients: 3 lbs green chilies, whole or 3 lbs red chilies | 3 lbs poblano chiles, with seeds ( optional ) | 3 lbs dijon mustard ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large sealable cup or container 1/3 full with boiling water. Drop the chilies into the water about 30 seconds, until they have begun to deflate. Shake the container or water well, put the chilies in the container with the water and let set for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, place the poblano chilies in a large bowl. Break off the stems of the blackened chilies and discard as many seeds as possible. The blackened skin adds to a bitter flavor. Remove the skins from the chilies. With a sharp knife, split the chilies in half, lengthwise and remove most of the white membrane. You will have about 30 whole chilies. Grate the seeds, reserving some for topping. Wash in boiling water, drain, and let set for 30 minutes. In a 4 quart kettle combine the chilies with all of the mustard, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to simmer, and cook, shaking the kettle occasionally, for 3 hours, or until the mixture is thick and pulpy, stopping occasionally to stir. Cool and store in a cool, dark place for up to 1 month.

title: Summer Memories: Blackberry Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dry quinoa | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup tamari | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste | 1/3 cup frozen blackberries, thawed if canned, drained, and chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the quinoa and yogurt. Stir in tamari, vinegar, cayenne pepper and blackberries. Mix until well blended. Refrigerate about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: french bread cube,meat,hot green chili pepper
title: Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs lean ground meat or 1 1/2 lbs ground poultry | 1 can chopped hot green chili peppers, drained and patted dry | 1 package of your favorite french bread cubes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well knead until well mixed. Form into loaf shape. Place loaf on rack in a baking dish, and bake at 325 for 1 1/2 hours, or until meat thermometer inserted on loaf reads 165 degrees. Let stand.

title: Baby Cottes With Creamy Black Beans
ingredients: 2 cups dried black beans, rinsed and picked over | 1 large baby carrot ( medium size, peeled and cut into 2-inch lengths ) | 1 tablespoon apricot jam
instructions: Place beans in pot with water, carrot, and jam. Bring to boil, and boil for 10 more minutes. Transfer carrots and beans to serving bowl.

title: Kielbasa, Peas and Posole Tacos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 pound kielbasa, ground | 2 cans yellow hominy, drained | 5 1/2 cups water | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, saute kielbasa until brown. Drain fat, leaving in skillet. Saute hominy with water, until tender, about 20 minutes. Season with white pepper. Add sauteed kielbasa. Heat through. Serve in warmed tortillas with salsa on the side.

title: Frog Sauce for Seafood
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sifted cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur or 1 1/2 tablespoons triple sec | 5 ml mirin | 600 g ready for eating frogs or 600 g ready for eating fresh mushrooms | 1 sheet phyllo pastry, to line 24 cup moulds
instructions: Sift the cornflour and soda together and put on a plate. Add the liqueur or triple sec and mix well. Add the mushrooms and mix to coat with liqueur. Cut the filo pastry into four and lightly grease with olive oil spray or butter. Place a small heaped tablespoon of the seafood mixture in the middle of each filo piece. Brush with the olive oil. Fold each filo in half to cover and crimp the edges. Cook in a hot oven for ten minutes or until the frog sauce has reduced. Brush the filo pastry with oil to stop the pastry from burning.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,sherry wine,snow pea,red onion,kelp,orange juice concentrate,beef shank,chicken breast half
title: Orange-Cured Chicken With Pineapple
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon dried kelp | 1 can egg concentrate, undiluted | 1 can extra lean beef shank, drained with reserve liquid | 2 teaspoons sherry wine | 1 cup orange juice concentrate, undiluted | 1 package snow peas ( trimmed and strings removed, leaving 1/2 inch thick ends on ) | 1 medium red onion, chopped
instructions: Place the chicken breast halves between two sheets of plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,baking potato,seed,basmati rice,cornmeal,chinese five spice powder,white vinegar
title: Lebanese Baked Potato and Onion Pies
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato, unpeeled diced | 1 lb raw sweet potato, unpeeled diced | 1/2 lb mixed seeds | 1/4 cup finely chopped golden raisin ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/4 cup coarse cornmeal | 3/4 cup coarse whole wheat uncoarsely ground cornmeal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 f. Place a large baking sheet on the middle rack and spray with pam. Line the baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine the potatoes, sweet potato, mixed seeds, raisins and five spice powder. Arrange the vegetables in an even layer in the baking sheet and sprinkle them with the white vinegar and the coarse cornmeal. Stir the mixture to combine well. Sprinkle the mixture evenly into 2 x 1 1/2 inch oval baking dishes that are placed on the middle rack, about 3/4 inch apart.
