Bake the sweet potato pies until the tops are puffed and lightly browned, about 45 minutes. Remove the oven and let the pies cool on the baking sheet. Remove the parchment and cool the mousses on the baking sheet until cool enough to handle. Remove the bowls from the oven and carefully slide them out of the paper. Set them onto individual platters and let steam cool. Cut into fingers that are about 1/2 inch thick.

title: Baked Turkey Nuggets
ingredients: 1 whole turkey | 2 spring onions, trimmed and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Using your fingers pierce the neck of the bird, being careful not to pierce the skin, taking care not to pierce the membrane or the meat. Place the bird, breast up, in a large ovenproof dish with the breast side facing you. Pour the juice over the bird. Place the halved onions in the bird cavity, then sprinkle generously with sea salt. Place the baking dish on top of the stove and bake for 40 minutes or until the bird is cooked.

title: Capellini with White Rice
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup red onion, cut into very fine wedges and separated | 3 cups cooked white rice, kept hot | 1/4 cup lard, heated and slightly salted | spaghetti, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Mix the ricotta cheese with the onion slices, and set aside. Drain the rice when ready to serve, and keep warm over low heat. Heat the lard, then set aside. Place the hot cooked spaghetti in the skillet over medium low heat, and cook, stirring with a spatula, until light brown on all sides. Pour the rice into a serving bowl, then add the cheese mixture and the hot cooked spaghetti. Toss and serve immediately.

title: Garlic Crusted Salmon and Asparagus
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet, cut into 2 thick pieces | 1/2 pound fresh asparagus spears, trimmed and cut diagonally into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 bottle garlic flavored black vinegar-based relish | 4 cloves garlic, crushed, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine salmon, asparagus, garlic flavored relish, and garlic flavored black vinegar flavored olive oil in a glass baking dish. Cover dish with plastic wrap and place baking dish with salmon in preheated oven. Bake at 325 degrees f for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

title: Tex-Mex Pot Roast
ingredients: 4 lbs venison roast | 1 package lawry's flavor peppery seasoning ( the one that came with the roast ) | 1 bottle picante sauce ( use your favorite brand )
instructions: Mix the flank steak and marinade, lawrys seasoning and picante sauce and marinate in the refrigerator overnight. Take the meat out on the foil and remove any marinade left inside. Bake at 300 degrees for about 3 hours until the internal temperature reaches 190 degrees. Slice the meat very thin, serve and enjoy with chips.

title: Muhammara Burger
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 1/2 loaf bread | oil or nonfat sour cream | 1/2 - 3/4 cup tahini | 3 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 cup peanuts, chopped | 5 slices fat free, crispy-fry type bread | tortilla
instructions: Heat a few tablespoons of oil into a grill pan, or fry pan. Scoop out the hamburger into a bowl, make a hole in the middle and break the hamburger into small chunks. Add garlic paste and let sit for five minutes, or if you don't have much fat.. Wash your bread to get an even crust. Slice one slice of bread, about 5 inches thick, into 1 1/2 squares. Spread a couple tablespoons of tahini onto each slice of bread. Sprinkle with peanuts. On a frying pan, you can spread a small amount of oil and a little bit of yogurt for authenticity. Put a couple slices of bread in the oil, and fry on both sides. Remove, and fry the other slice. It shouldn't be too crunchy. Toppings can be placed on tortillas, or laid on toasted tortillas, or fried in a pan over a low heat briefly before flipping. If you can, serve with lettuce, salsa, tomato, or other things. Variant, add onions, meat, cheese, etc. After flipping, place the burger on a piece of the toasted bread, topped, and sprinkled with a bit of tahini, or lettuce, then top with a little bit of yogurt mixed with a little garlic.

Random Ingredients: tomato basil,ancho chile powder,amaretto,broccoli floret,cake flour,shrimp
title: Spicy Shrimp in a Hurry
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried ancho chile powder, or to taste | 2 teaspoons cake flour | 1 pound medium shrimp - peeled, deveined, and tails left on | 1 1/2 tablespoons light amaretto, or more to taste | 1 cup baby broccoli florets | 1 cup chopped tomato with basil, or more to taste
instructions: Place ancho chile powder into a small bowl, and mix with the cake flour and shrimp powder. Mix amaretto and shrimp in a small bowl, and stir until evenly mixed. Cook broccoli in a pot of boiling water until crisp tender but still firm, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salad green,pork shoulder,cilantro leaf,romaine lettuce,ham hock,cauliflower,black pepper,sauerkraut
title: Baja Pork Sausages
ingredients: 12 fresh pork shoulder | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1 lb smoked ham hock | 1 romaine lettuce, washed and torn into bite-size pieces | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, washed and torn | 1/4 lb raw cauliflower, cut in florets | 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper | 2 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Place shoulder and sauté pan on burner, add water to cover. Bring to boil, and skim. Lower heat to simmer, and cook for 30 minutes. Remove meat from roaster, discard solids. Break any remaining meat into small pieces. Remove hocks from roaster, add to pan, cover, and continue cooking for 30 minutes. Shred pork into 2 inch pieces, and add to sauerkraut, ham hock, romaine, cilantro, cauliflower, and pepper. Continue cooking for 20 - 30 minutes. Add 2 1/2 cups of salad greens to mixture, and mix to blend. Cover and cook for approximately half an hour. Serve with rice and kraut on side.

title: Corned Beef and Pork Calzones
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry ( thawed ) | 1 lb beef brisket | 1 lb corned beef brisket | 1 lb deli-sliced roast beef | 1/2 cup chopped parmesan cheese | 3 tablespoons coarse tamari
instructions: Line baking sheet with parchment paper or waxed paper. Cut out 18 circles from pastry using a 4x4 inch cookie cutter. Place one circle, cut side down on the parchment paper. Place 8 remaining circles on parchment. Bake at 425°f for 20 - 25 minutes until lightly browned and puffed. While pastry is baking, slice the corned beef into 1/8 inch thick slices. Place beef slices over the bottom of each pastry circle on a cutting board. Fold the pastry over the beef slices and tuck the edges under. Tie the edges with kitchen string. Combine the corned beef with the remaining ingredients except the parmesan and roll between your palms into a 1 inch thick roll. Place on prepared baking sheet. When done to bake, remove string, sprinkle with parmesan. Top with a second baking sheet that has been brushed with the tamari. Bake at 425°f for 18 - 25 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,chicken liver,zucchini,greek yogurt,ketchup,flat leaf parsley,salsa
title: Liver-Liver-Zucchini Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 cups zucchini, peeled and grated ( i used a mix of yellow and zucchini ) | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 6 tablespoons greek yogurt ( any fat-free greek yogurt will do ) | 4 teaspoons ketchup ( or tomato ketchup ) | 4 egg yolks | 2 cans chicken livers, drained | salsa ( to garnish )
instructions: Mix the grated zucchini, parsley, yogurt, ketchup and egg yolks in a bowl. Add the drained livers, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring with a fork. It’s not necessary to fully blend mixture. Garnish with salsa.

title: Shiitake Spaghetti
ingredients: 600 g spaghetti | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 3 ounces sliced shiitake mushrooms | 3 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Cook spaghetti with cardamon powder and bicarb soda for 10 minutes or till tender. Meanwhile fry up shitake mushrooms in sauce. Add the soy sauce. Drain pasta and mix with mushrooms and dressing.

title: Grilled Radishes With Chipotle Chile (Pfeffernusse Mit Nussen)
ingredients: 6 radishes | 1 cup caster sugar or 1 cup superfine sugar | 5 -6 teaspoons chopped chipotle chiles
instructions: Remove the root end of the radish and slice the root into 4 or 5 thin sticks. Place the sticks under the grill and cook for 5 minutes until slightly charred but still firm. Leave until only slightly charred. Drain the juice and keep warm in a pan. Pour over the chips once cooked, cover the rings with foil and set the rings aside while preparing the rest of the ingredients. Heat the sugar over a gentle flame until it begins to make caramelised glaze. Stir in the chiles, keep warm, serve on the radishes.

title: Sirloin Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, thinly sliced | 1 container cherry tomatoes | 1 cucumber | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 5 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 cup raspberry | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, minced
instructions: Dice cucumber. Marinate steak with cherries and lemon until ready to assemble rolls. Remove steak from marinade, discard marinade. Broil until desired doneness, turning once. Mash cherry tomatoes. Stir in peanut butter, tomato paste and raspberry sauce. Sprinkle with minced lemon peel.

Random Ingredients: meat,ginger ale,mozzarella cheese,white bean,head cauliflower,monterey jack pepper cheese,green capsicum
title: Beans' Cauliflower Bake
ingredients: 3 medium heads cauliflower, cut on the florets | 2 cans white beans, drained | 1 jar meat, any type you like ( i like to use turkey but any will do ) | 8 slices fresh ginger ale or 8 slices beer | 1 green capsicum, chopped | 1 cup mozzarella cheese | 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c, or a fan forced oven. Combine the cauliflower, drained white beans, ginger ale, grated cheese into a large casserole dish. Cover with the chopped capsicum. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes, or until the cauliflower is tender, crisp and golden and the cheese is golden. Eat warm.

Random Ingredients: wishbone italian salad dressing,cumin,orange,granny smith apple,butterscotch pudding mix
title: Terrific Party Apples
ingredients: 1 package wishbone italian salad dressing | 1 box butterscotch pudding mix | 2 granny smith apples | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup juice from orange can | 2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Make italian salad dressing as directed on the box until well blended. Cut the apples open and remove the stem. Using a spoon hollow out the core for the apples. Use a spoon to scoop out the insides of the apples using a grapefruit spoon, the scooped out stuffing from inside of each apple to use in the topping. This is delicious using the dressing you prepared earlier. Stir the pineapple into the prepared dressing. Pour the prepared dressing onto the apples and stir to coat with dressing. Add the orange juice, cumin, and desired amount of Wishbone italian dressing. Mix well and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,harissa,worcestershire sauce,lime juice,fenugreek seed,red pepper flake
title: Moroccan Style Marinade for Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon harissa | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1 pinch dried lime juice | 1 chicken stock cube, kneaded
instructions: Combine crushed peppers and worcestershire sauce in a bowl, add harissa, fenugreek seeds, lime juice and chicken broth cube knead thoroughly. Pour marinade over meat, cover and marinate for 3 to 4 hours, turning chicken once during marinating time. Remove meat, drain any excess marinade from pan, place remaining marinade in saucepan and bring to boil. Simmer for 5 minutes. Serve with grilled or roast chicken pieces.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust pie,oyster sauce,boursin spreadable cheese herb,tamarind pulp,chili sauce
title: Tamarind Tartlets
ingredients: pastry for a double crust pie | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 4 tablespoons boursin spreadable cheese with garlic and herbs | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce
instructions: Use two 9 inch tart pans or half an inch pie plates for this recipe. The crust for the pie shells can also be used for other fillings like tofu filling.

Random Ingredients: masala,orange juice concentrate,dark soy sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Aunt Martha's Masala Fried Fish
ingredients: 1 lb masala ( to taste ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup frozen orange juice concentrate | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Place masala in a large dish or plastic bag. Pour 1/2 cup of frozen orange juice concentrate evenly over masala and stir to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours. Heat remaining 1/4 cup of frozen orange concentrate in an 8 x 8 inch pan on medium heat for five minutes, stirring to prevent burning. Add the dark soy sauce and mix very well. Remove from heat. Spray fish with oil and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of marjoram's marjoram's marjoram's salt. Let stand 5 minutes. Serve immediately with the warm marinated fish.

Random Ingredients: penne,turmeric powder,bread flour,pineapple,cheddar cheese curd,apricot jam
title: Apricot Curd Pasta
ingredients: 750 g penne | 150 g cheddar cheese curds | 1 cup pineapple, chopped | 1 cup apricot jam | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup bread flour, plus extra bread flour for dusting
instructions: Heat cooking oil. Add all ingredients except flour and mix well. Cook on low heat. Cook pasta according to directions. Remove sauce from stove and combine in pan with sauce and cook on low heat for several minutes. If the sauce is too thick to coat the pasta then add more bread flour. Serve hot.

title: Pecan Mock-a-Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 4 tablespoons skim milk
instructions: Peel and grate the squash. Put the squash, skim milk and butter in a casserole dish. Put in a low oven oven till the pumpkin is soft.

title: Homemade Sausages (Bangers)
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk pork sausage | 1 cup white flour
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, sausage and the flour. Divide the mixture into 24 portions and pat each portion into a flattened patty shape around the edge of a greased baking sheet. Bake in a preheated oven at 400°f for about 25 minutes, or until lightly browned on top. Serve hot with fruit and nuts.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,brown rice,coriander powder,cream chicken soup,corn
title: Easy and Tasty Thai Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup light brown rice | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup light corn | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to in a baking pan spread half the rice on the bottom. Carefully pour soup into pan tilting it as you go. Scatter rice on top. With a rubber spatula or your hands, spread rice on top of soup. Bake in preheated oven, about 40 - 45 minutes, till rice is thoroughly heated. Meanwhile, in a microwave safe bowl, stir together corn and coriander powder. Microwave on high in 2 minutes, do not stir. Place in microwave. With fork to fluff, stir to combine. To serve, spoon rice back into baking pan around rice. Sprinkle with coriander and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: corn,italian parsley,butter,grape tomato,red kidney bean,french bread,kielbasa
title: Italian Sausage & Kidney Bean Sausage Bake
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1-inch thick slices | 1/4 lb kielbasa or 1/4 lb spicy italian sausage, thinly sliced | 1 can red kidney beans | 1 can fat-free baby corn, drained | 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter or 2 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place bread slices on cookie sheet and bake 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp and golden. Remove to a wire rack to cool slightly. Meanwhile, cook sausage and kidney beans in a 6 quart dutch oven over medium hear, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about minutes. Remove sausage, beans, corn and tomatoes from heat. Stir parsley into beans and mash with a potato masher, scraping up all the browned bits from the pan. Divide sausage mixture among bread slices. Top with butter.

Random Ingredients: beef,chili sauce,korean red pepper paste,cocoa powder,chicken drumstick
title: Chopsticks Korean Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 kg beef, cut into medium size pieces | 3 1/2 tablespoons korean red pepper paste ( gochujang ) | 2 tablespoons chinese hot prepared chili sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons chicken drumsticks
instructions: Marinate beef in gochujang for 30 minute. Remove meat in bowl. Heat oil to smoking in iron skillet. Add meat and cook over medium heat until brown on all sides. Remove to plate. Add remaining ingredients to skillet and cook over low for 10 min until the broth is reduced, turning meat a few times to heat through. Slice meat across the grain.

title: Asian Style Short Ribs
ingredients: 1 large white onion | 4 pounds short rib of beef | 2 tablespoons chili paste, or to taste
instructions: Cut off ends of onion, and cut in half lengthwise. Rinse the onion with cold water.

title: Spiral Chocolate Oil
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups pure unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/4 cups virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat oil in a 2 cup pot over a moderate flame until nearly smoking. Take care that the oil doesn’t splatter. When the oil turns very deep amber, pour the hot oil into a fine sieve to drain for an hour or more. Cool the oil and store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,coconut milk,celery salt,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Roti Canapes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup chili sauce ( or more as you like it ) | 1/8 teaspoon celery salt | 1 cup coconut milk
instructions: Stir yogurt, chili sauce, celery salt and coconut milk together. Spread onto a well oiled surface or roll up into a rectangle. Let sit 15 minutes. Cut each roll into 1 pieces.

Random Ingredients: coconut,cooking oil,pork loin chop,chicken meat,pesto sauce,english muffin
title: Pesto Pork Loin Melt  -  a Tampa, Florida, North Beach Diet, Recipe
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 3 boneless pork loin chops, 3/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 8 large english muffins, split | 1/3 cup dried shredded coconut | 1 package refrigerated low-fat shredded fat greek yogurt or 3/4 cup low-fat sour cream, stirred
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the cooking oil in a broiler proof skillet. Cook the chops over medium heat, turning once, until the surface is lightly browned, about 3 minutes per side. Add the pesto sauce and cook an additional 30 seconds. Transfer the chops to a baking sheet or baking dish, and sprinkle with coconut. Broil the chops 5 to 7 minutes on each side until slightly browned and bubbly. Remove the chops from the oven, and top with yogurt, if desired. Place the muffins on a serving platter and top with the chops, dividing equally. Serve immediately.

title: Pasta With Clam Sauce
ingredients: 250 g thin pasta | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 cups bottled clam juice | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water, then drain and keep hot until done. Pour out excess pasta water and set aside. Toss clam juice into hot pesto. Heat up the hot pasta in the boiling pan with clam juice, bay leaf and pesto, then serve immediately with croutons and parmesan cheese to serve.

title: Pasta in Peppered Sauce (Penne) With Pepper
ingredients: 12 ounces dry penne pasta | 1 green pepper, julienned | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the pasta until al dente. Drain and return to the pot. Meanwhile, in small skillet, fry the peppers in a little hot oil until tender crisp. Add the pepper mixture to the cooked pasta and toss. Serve hot.

title: Pistachio Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups finely chopped pistachios | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Combine the pistachios and lemon juice and combine. Best eaten immediately.

title: Low Fat Russet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons skim sodium broth | 1 tablespoon coconut or 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 2 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch dice | 3/4 cup fat-free low-sodium broth ( from cooking the potatoes ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup island-style dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and place over medium heat. Cook, uncovered, until thickened. Bring to a simmer and cook until potatoes are fork tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in dressing.

title: Easy Zucchini Vegetable Feijoada
ingredients: 2 cups frozen zucchini, zucchini defrosted ( or regular zucchini ) | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Puncture squash with fork in 3 places and place on baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned, 1 to 1 1/2 hours. While squash crisps, place black beans and 1/2 tablespoon each salt and pepper in a microwave safe bowl and cook on high power, uncovered, in microwave for 2 to 3 minutes, until hot and pliable. Transfer squash to a platter and serve immediately with beans.

title: Lamb and Red Potato Roast
ingredients: 500 g leg of lamb, boned | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 150 g carrots, thickly sliced | 1/2 cup mango, cubed | 2 roasted red potatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat a 200 degrees c oven to 160 degrees celsius. Place the lamb in a mixing bowl with the tomato puree, the carrots and mango. Toss to coat with tomato mixture. Spread mixture into a roasting tin and bake for 40 – 45 minutes, or until cooked through. Increase temperature to 180 degrees and spread lamb with potatoes.

Random Ingredients: date,chicken sausage,onion powder,plum tomato,pork tenderloin,tabasco sauce,wine
title: Pork and Sausage Stuffed Vine Leaves
ingredients: 32 large pickled plum tomatoes | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 cups sliced onions | 1 cup chicken sausage | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup wine
instructions: Place tomatoes on a plate. Remove seeds and coarsely chop. Remove and discard rind from sausage. Cut into 2 1/2 inch slices, and coarsely chop. Cut lengthwise into thin slices. Combine sausage in a large nonstick skillet, adding 1/2 cup water, onion powder, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,spanish onion,fennel seed,coleman mustard,chinese five spice powder,pine nut
title: Spiced Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon french's mustard | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon pine nuts
instructions: Place onion in large sauce pan and drizzle with oil or margarine. Season with mustard, fennel, five spice and saute until onion has caramelised. Add water to thin, if necessary. Simmer until reduced to half. Puree soup in blender or food processor with a few drops of cold water until smooth. Return to pan and reheat, if boiling, then season to taste. Divide between serving bowls.

title: Spiced Roasted Pumpkin Seeds Roll
ingredients: pumpkin seeds or pumpkin seeds, for dusting | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 bunch english pumpkin | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | toasted nori, triangles for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f and line a tray with baking paper. Bash the pumpkin seeds in a baking dish. Roast the pumpkin about 40 min or until soft, and just a little softer. Remove and let cool for 15 minutes before gricing. Cut away the stem from the pumpkin and slice the flesh into thin strips about 2'' long. Roughly chop the nori and arrange them on a plate, with a few triangles to roll. Sprinkle the nori with a little cumin seeds, then roll up the pumpkin seeds, like a swiss roll, to create long roll shaped sandwiches. Toast the nuts in the oven about 20 minutes, until golden brown, stirring after 3 - 5 minutes, and turning over before adding more butter.

title: Jamaican Jerk Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked brown basmati rice | 1/2 cup jamaican jerk spice ( mccormick's brand )
instructions: Place the rice in the microwave and cover with lid. Microwave at high power for 5 minutes, or until completely hot. Remove from microwave. Mix in the jerk spice. Garnish with cilantro and/or sprigs of parsley.

title: Sweet Spicy Crab and Sausage Salad
ingredients: 400 -500 g fresh crab | 4 plum tomatoes, chopped | 4 tablespoons minced garlic or 4 tablespoons minced garlic | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel | 3 tablespoons curry | 1 packet spaghetti
instructions: Cook sausage in a pan with the orange peel until cooked. Cut crab in small pieces. Add to cooked sausage, tomatoes and spices. Mix well. Cook spaghetti for half and half or whatever method of you like on high heat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coriander,garlic clove,ice cube,shiitake mushroom,cabbage leaf,lavender,orange zest
title: Bircher Hase  (Warm Mushroom Salad)
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon dried lavender | 1 tablespoon crushed fresh garlic cloves | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander | 2 cups fresh cabbage leaves | ice cube
instructions: Clean and slice mushrooms. Boil the mushrooms until softened, about 5 minutes. Drain the mushrooms and chop finely. Place all ingredients except the cabbage leaves into a salad bowl.

Random Ingredients: sushi rice,vanilla essence,macaroni,escarole,ginger garlic paste,cranberry,asafoetida powder,egg noodle
title: Escarole With Macaroni & Sushi Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons raw cashews or 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice ( about 3.5 ounces ) or 1 1/2 cups short-grain sushi rice, rinsed | 1 1/4 cups prepared sushi rice ( see note below ) | 1 lb escarole | 1 tablespoon grated vanilla essence | 1 small egg noodle | 3/4 cup cranberries ( optional )
instructions: Note, i like to soak the dried cranberries, then rinse them in a sieve, and spread them on a baking sheet to dry, about 15 minutes. Dry the arborio rice a few minutes longer until they turn a nice golden color. The dried cranberries require about 45 min until soft, the kind that melts when cooled. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a heavy large frying pan over med high, melt the cashews, ginger garlic paste and asafoetida. Pour in the contents of the sieving pan, stirring occasionally. Stir until cashews and spices are well browned, about 3 - 4 minutes. Add rice and cook for about 3 minutes. Add enough water to come up about 2/3rds of the way up the side of your pan. Note, if rice is used, it should be covered and set over very low heat. Turn off heat and let sit for 3 - 5 minutes, then add the rest of the water. Transfer rice to a greased shallow baking dish or roasting pan. Set baking dish or pan in the oven, but leave oven on. Bake until all the water is absorbed and the rice is fully cooked. Remove from oven and let sit for about five minutes so the rice can absorb the rest of the water. Meanwhile, put 4 - 6 quarts of water with the 1 tbs. Of vanilla essence in a small sauce pan. Bring to boil and add radish leaves and a tablespoon of salt. Place the rice in a large bowl, cover with hot water and then cool the rice completely under running water. Do not allow the water to completely cool, or the rice to become mushy. Drain the rice well and discard water from the rice bowls. Wash and dry the escarole. Cut the head lengthwise in half, then cut the root end and core into 2 inch chunks. Set aside. Dissolve salt in boiling water. Drain the rice in a colander and let drain for 20 minutes. Rinse with cold water and drain again. Divide the rice evenly among 6 shallow bowls or plates. Divide the escarole among the 1 bowls. Divide the rice among the bowls evenly over the escarole. Place 1/4 c of the grated fennel on top of the rice. Top with the nuts evenly over the rice with a grinding of black pepper. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,cheddar cheese,celery,vanilla ice cream,onion salt,green bean
title: Cheese and Green Bean Ice Cream With Cheddar Frosting
ingredients: 1 box vanilla ice cream | 2 packages celery, chopped | 1 can green beans, drained | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract | 3/4 teaspoon onion salt | 2/3 cup low-fat cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 8 x 8 inch baking dish. Put first 3 ingredients in a blender. Cover blender and blend for 20 seconds. Strain mixture through a sieve and transfer to baking dish. Top with cheese. Cover tightly with foil and bake about 40 minutes or until knife comes out clean. Freeze any leftovers for longer later. To serve, turn over onto serving platter and drizzle with a thin layer of cheddar frosting.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,chicken fillet,cooking spray,mustard,tart shell,chicken breast
title: Chicken & Temptation Mini-Slices
ingredients: 2 teaspoons prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 2 chicken fillets, boneless, skinless | cooking spray | 3 medium chicken fillets, boneless, skinless | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard | 1 cup cake flour | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard | 12 quick-cooking tarts shell
instructions: Heat oven to 220 degrees centigrade. Place mustard, flour, & chicken in medium bowl. Spray cooking oil into another medium sized bowl. Dip one chicken fillet into mustard & sprinkle with half the mustard mixture and half the fritters. Repeat layers using remaining ingredients & place on prepared trays lined with baking paper. Bake chicken in oven in batches for 15 minutes or until cooked through. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,mustard powder,chinese pea pod,grapeseed oil
title: Chinese Pea Pods
ingredients: 400 g chinese pea pods | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Heat the oil in a non stick frying pan. Add the peas and fry over a medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes stirring constantly. Add the lime juice and mustard powder and fry for 5 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 1 cup red wine, such as marsclun | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | kitchen bouquet
instructions: Mix wine, vinegar, and kitchen bouquet in a non reactive bowl. Do not add water, as this would allow bitterness of sweet vinegar to develop. Cover, and refrigerate 6 hours to develop flavor before serving. Serve with meats and fish for dipping.

title: French Fry (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 3)
ingredients: 1/4 cup light muscovado sugar | 50 g water chestnuts | 60 g rye bread, bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in shallow dish and stir until sugar has dissolved. Heat frypan until hot and drop a heaped tsp at a time of mixture onto pan and cook until lightly browned on underside.

title: Vegan Feijoada - Eggs Benedict
ingredients: 200 g vegetarian baked beans | 2 egg yolks | 2 teaspoons veggie crumbles or 2 teaspoons of a real bacon fat
instructions: Place the baked beans into a frying pan and add just enough water to cover the beans. Bring to a boil, and continue boiling until the beans are tender. Meanwhile, use a blender and combine the yolks with the veg crumbles. The mixture will thicken and look a bit like a paste. Turn off the heat and stir in the egg mixture. Serve hot warm.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,sugar,swiss cheese,adobo sauce,jalapeno chile pepper,cauliflower floret,syrup,red bell pepper
title: Spicy Swiss Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cubed swiss cheese | 1/2 pound cauliflower florets | 1 jar hot adobo sauce | 3 tablespoons adobo sauce | 1/4 red bell pepper, sliced | 10 ounces diced jalapeno chiles | 1/2 teaspoon chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Toss together the cubed swiss cheese, cauliflower florets, hot adobo sauce, spicy jalapeno peppers, red bell pepper, jalapeno chile powder, ground ancho chile powder, and sugar in a large bowl. Cover, and refrigerate for an hour or more to allow flavors to blend. Cover and refrigerate for up to 1 day.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,goat cheese,grape leaf,oat,red curry paste,shortcrust pastry,vanilla extract,half
title: Spicy Banana Leaves Wrapped in Tasty Vegetables (France -- Vegan
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( or to taste, or a bit of curry powder dissolved in plain soy sauce ) | 1 grape tomatoes, sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh grape leaves ( or 3/4 cup baby mixed sprouts ) or 1 tablespoon fresh baby mixed sprouts | 2 tablespoons snipped goat cheese | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1/2 cup rolled oats | 1 -2 tablespoon rolled oats | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 small thawed frozen shortcrust pastry, thawed if refrigerated for 1 hour and chilled if reheating later
instructions: Thaw pastry for 1 hour in refrigerator. Thaw pastry bag | Preheat oven to 425 f. Cut off one piece of dough, then roll out dough and place on a floured board. Knead the dough a few times until its soft and elastic. Cover with plastic wrap, and let rest for about 15 minutes before starting to cook. Slice the rested pastry, and wrap into a sausage shape or sausage length wise onto the pastry string. This will also help with the folding and folding during cooking. Brush the edges lightly with water. Place the wrapped pastry on a cookie sheet, and bake at 450f for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden. Slice, and place on serving plates with goat cheese, mixed sprouts and tomatoes. Cover each with rolled oats which have been sprinkled with vanilla. Serve with a dollop of vanilla yoghurt.

title: Courgettes Despina
ingredients: 12 medium courgettes or 1 kg courgettes | 4 cups broth | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon finely diced serrano pepper
instructions: Cut a slit in the side of each courvete to form a pocket. Bring the courgettes to the boil in 4 cups hot broth. Lower heat and simmer until the courgettes are tender and the broth has reduced, about 30 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to skim off any froth. Stir in the chilies and season. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Chocolate Kielbasa
ingredients: 12 ounces kielbasa or 12 ounces american-style sausage, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 2 -4 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese ( about 2 cups ) or 2 -4 cups monterey jack cheese ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup cocoa powder, divided | 2 -4 cups warm honey, divided ( about, see directions ) | 2 tablespoons active dry yeast | toothpick ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease a 9 x 13 baking dish. Arrange sausage slices in the bottom of the loaf pan. Sprinkle the kielbasa with 2/3 cup of the cheese and the cocoa powder. Pour warmed honey in the microwave or stir well. Put the remaining cheese in a bowl, melt in the microwave and mix, then add yeast, stirring well, so that the yeast is dissolved. Stir into remaining cheese/kielbasa mixture. Cut the kielbasa slices in half lengthwise, then into 1 inch slices. Arrange the meat slices in a single layer in the prepared pan. Cover and leave in a warm place until the dough is doubled in size, about 1 hour and 45 minutes to 1 hour. Stir the dough well and then turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Poke holes through the crust with the fingers and brush top with remaining butter. Sprinkle top with remaining cocoa. Bake for 30 minutes, or until lightly browned and crispy. Serve warm, or room temperature.

title: Fish Tacos (Tacitos)
ingredients: 3 white fish fillets, boned | 16 corn tortillas, whole grain, warmed | corn vinegar ( or lemon juice ) | 0.5 can diced rotel
instructions: Cut fish into very thin slices. Set aside. Wash corn tortillas and line a large platter with corn tortillas. Remove as many slices as possible so they stay on their sides and produce better crisp tortillas. Place sliced fish in tortillas. Spread 1/2 can of rotel over fish. Sprinkle with 1/2 can of diced rotel and more of any or all of the above. Enjoy,.

title: Fish Kebabs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 lb tilapia fillet
instructions: Grind cumin seeds to a fine powder. Mix in chili paste and set aside. Soak 8 skewers in water for at least 30 minutes. Using a knife, cut 3 or 4 skewers lengthwise. Place fish on skewers and rub spice mixture evenly over fish. Grill on coals with hood closed 2 to 3 minutes or just until fish flakes easily with fork.

title: Rutabaga and Bacon Kebabs
ingredients: 2 medium rutabagas | 1 red capsicum, halved and deseeded | 12 large spinach leaves | 150 g thickly sliced streaky bacon | 8 slices stale soft matzo | 8 large eggs | 6 thin slices rye bread
instructions: Cut rutabaga into 5cm chunks. Place rutabaga, capsicum, spinach and bacon in a large bowl. Place matzo in separate bowls. Break eggs into a large pan. Break one egg into another and gently cook with a fork at a 90 second intervals. When the eggs are set to your liking leave in a large sieve for 2 - 3 minutes to stand. Place soaked matzo, egg mixture and bread onto a large tray and press the bread slices onto the kabobs. Bake in a preheated moderately hot oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,urad dal,stone dijon mustard,orange peel,dijon mustard,caster sugar,arugula,garlic clove
title: Swiss Chard With Tomato-Dijon Sauce
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs swiss chard or 3 -4 lbs arugula | 2 tablespoons stone ground dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 garlic clove | 1 piece orange peel, grated, peel left on a side and cut into 1 cm slices | 4 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 tablespoons natural urad dal or 2 tablespoons split urad dal breadcrumbs
instructions: Bring a large pan of well salted water to the boil. Trim the chard of stalks, stalks, leaves and greens and cut into large bite size pieces. Separate ribs from the greens, wash well and remove the hard leaves.

title: Low Fat Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons spicy brown mustard | 200 g frozen chopped spinach, thawed and finely chopped | 1 green bell pepper, julienned | 1 chili pepper flakes | 1 dash crushed mixed spices | 1 tablespoon spicy brown mustard | 1 teaspoon spicy brown mustard | 1/4 cup low fat natural yoghurt ( optional )
instructions: In a small glass bowl, stir together the 2 egg whites and 1 tbsp of the spicy brown mustard. Spread the mixture on the chicken and bake in a moderate oven for 20 - 25 mins, brushing every 5 mins with the thick glaze. Serve with remaining spicy brown mustard sauce & sliced red potatoes.

title: Crock Pot Sweet and Sour Crock Pot With Corned Beef and Cashews
ingredients: 1 large beef brisket or 1 large corned beef brisket | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken tenders | 1 1/2 cups whole raw raw cashews | 1 cup sliced corned beef | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 whole star anise | 1/4 cup lager beer, such as indonesia lager | 1 tablespoon salt
instructions: Using 5 1/2 to 7 qt slow cooker, transfer the brisket to an 8 cup glass or ceramic baking dish.

title: Broccoli Fritters With Blue Curacao
ingredients: 100 g broccoli florets or 100 g broccoli florets | 2 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 100 g matzo meal | 100 g self raising flour | 1 tablespoon soft blue curacao
instructions: Clean, cut and boil the broccoli in 5 liters of boiling water for 40 - 50 minutes or until tender. Drain and cool. Mix the cornflour with matzoh meal. Add to the broccoli. Add the curacao. Form into 4 cakes depending on the desired level of fritters you want them to be able to fry quickly. Drain any remaining liquid and place on heated plates. Garnish with green garnish.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package superfine sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spray large cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray. Whisk sugar in a mixing bowl until completely dissolved. Transfer sugar mixture to a resealable plastic bag and snip off bag. With fingers, coat each cookie with sugar. Spray each with cooking spray. Sprinkle with additional sugar, if desired.

title: Georgian Pomegranate Salad
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses | 1 jar picante sauce, or to taste
instructions: Fill a bowl with ice.

title: Danish Pasties (Kefse Patensalat) (Aka Green Salad)
ingredients: 200 g ground veal | 200 g beans sprouts | 200 g mixed sprouts ( or other mixed sprouts ) | 1 green pepper, roasted | 1 medium lemon pepper | 1/2 cup currants ( or dates ) | 1/4 cup whole wheat dried beans ( or other green tea ) | 2 tablespoons cardamom seeds | lettuce, chopped ( i prefer leaf lettuce )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl. Chill for ½ hour. Roll into balls about twice sized. Arrange on a large plate and chill for a few hours. Arrange a lettuce leaf on each plate, place one or two balls on top of the lettuce. Garnish with parsley. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mirin,wheat flour,ginger garlic paste,chicken bouillon cube
title: Golden Chicken Gravy
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 4 tablespoons wheat flour | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Combine chicken bouillon cubes with mirin. Add flour to chicken and gradually stir. Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes or until thickened.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,plain flour,chicken bouillon granule,lettuce leaf,salmon fillet,kale,sprite
title: Low Fat Fish in Lettuce Cups
ingredients: 350 g salmon fillet | 6 bunches kale | 1 medium zucchini | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 6 lettuce leaves | 2 leaves sprite
instructions: Place the salmon with the zucchini and kale in a bowl with some cold water to cover. Heat a frying pan with a tbsp of butter at med high. Sprinkle flour over and stir for 3 mins, till they start to bubble, but dont let it darken. Remove and add chicken and vegetable granules. Keep stirring for 3 mins, or until the vegetables brown. Put a lettuce leaf on each plate and pile on salmon mixture, then drizzle over a little sprite in the centre. Serve immediately.

title: Lentil and Yoghurt Salad With Sage
ingredients: 1 lb red lentil | 5 ounces blackberries ( frozen or fresh ) | 2 ounces olive | 2 ounces ham, chopped ( canadian bacon or salami works too ) | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1 small bunch sage, chopped ( can use rosemary ) | plain nonfat yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Cook the lentils according to the direction of pack, but drain when cooked, or alternatively cook them in a pressure cooker for 30 minutes. Drain, but reserve a little of the pan juices. Place in another pan, add the blackberries and allow to cook until soft. Drain off any excess water. Chop the olives and ham, and then combine with the lentils, onion, sage and olives. Place in a serving bowl and top with some plain yogurt, if desired. You can substitute any other salad dressing you want. Can also place wholemeal bread in an oven set at 350°f serve and serve.

Random Ingredients: beet,picante sauce,asparagus,vegetable oil cooking spray,kosher salt black pepper,chocolate,red pepper flake
title: Tangy Antojitos for Chips and Grilled Asparagus
ingredients: 2 cups raw medium asparagus, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1/8 inch slices | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 pinch red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons unsweetened chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup grated parmiggiano-reggiano cheese or 1/4 cup pecorino cheese
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Coat the asparagus with vegetable oil spray and season with salt and pepper. Grill the asparagus over direct medium high heat only until just starting to turn bright green. Don't overcook it. Remove from the grill and transfer to a plate. Sprinkle the asparagus with a pinch of red pepper flakes. Sprinkle on the chocolate, and cook just until melted. Let set. To assemble, place 3 asparagus spears on each of 4 dinner plates. Spoon the chipotle chunky topping over and around the asparagus, then top with grated cheese. Serve with your favourite dipping chip for dipping.

title: Tostones for a Rainy Day Supper
ingredients: 300 g hamburger, finely minced | 4 tablespoons hot paprika | 4 -6 slices ham hocks
instructions: Combine the meat and seasoning, add to a large freezer bag. Add your hands. Seal the bag. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 230°c take out the bag. Take out the meat and discard the marinade. Lightly pat the meat dry. Cut into strips on oven tins, about 3 to 4 cm long. Heat in oven until crispy, about 5 minute serve with soup and salad greens.

title: Puerto Rican Style Chili Ice-Ice
ingredients: 2 cups single cream | 1/2 cup red chile pepper, or to taste | 2 slices fresh nutmeg ( a pinch ) | 2 packages frozen dinner rolls, thawed and cut into 1 inch squares
instructions: Set oven rack 6 inches below the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment paper. Lightly grease a metal pan with cooking spray, and set aside. Pour single cream in a large, heavy saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until thick enough to coat the back of a metal spoon, about 5 minutes. Spread chile peppers over cream and stir until tender, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and pour 1 inch of cream mixture into each dinner roll square. Brush each with cream and let cool. Repeat process with remaining cream mixture, filling each roll to the desired thickness. Cut each roll into 16 slices. Place the cut rolls cut side down onto the prepared baking sheet. Cut a slit in the top of each roll, in the center, then cut a slit halfway down the length of each, forming a slit in the curve of a serrano chili skin. Gently press slit to seal. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until rolls are lightly browned. Allow to cool slightly before removing the slice from the baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,corn tortilla,chili flake,shrimp paste,peanut butter,ricotta cheese,green cardamom pod
title: Spicy Shrimp Cheesecake With Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 15 corn tortillas | 6 ounces ricotta cheese, room temperature | 10 ounces cooked shrimp paste | 1/4 cup green cardamom pod, cracked | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried oregano leaves | 2/3 teaspoon spicy chili flakes | 2 tablespoons peanut butter ( not fat free )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9 x 13 inch baking pan with parchment paper. Cut tortillas into 1 inch squares. In a large bowl, mix together ricotta and shrimp paste. Using a large spoon, spread ricotta mixture over tortillas in a thin layer. Sprinkle with cardamom, oregano, chili flakes and peanut butter.

title: Quick Chocolate Rice Wine Lasagna (Copycat)
ingredients: 1 box of jello instant chocolate pudding mix ( no pudding in the mix ) | 1 cup rice wine | 5 uncooked lasagna noodles
instructions: Pre cook, cook the noodles according to package directions. Combine the pudding mix with the rice wine in a bowl and set aside. Boil the noodles in water until they are half cooked. Drain the noodles and rinse well with cold water. Place all ingredients in the bowl with the pudding mix and stir, set aside. Place noodles in a lightly greased 9x13 square pan. Spoon the reserved mixture over the noodles and cover with foil. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Seeds (Bissap)
ingredients: 150 g pumpkin seeds, raw ( fresh or dried ) | 1 kg self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150 deg c. Spread the pumpkin seeds in a large baking tray and bake in the oven for 15 minutes. Remove and cool for a few minutes. Mix the flour into the pumpkin seeds and mix to a firm dough. Return to the oven and bake for a further 40 minutes until the mixture is just beginning to turn brown and crisp. Cool for 25 minutes or so and break into pieces. Serve sprinkled generously with butter and jam or just as is.

title: Polenta With Fresh Blueberries
ingredients: 3 cups heavy cream | 1/3 cup superfine sugar | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 2 1/2 cups crema ( or milk ok cream or cream ) or 2 1/2 cups ok cream ( or cream ) | 1 cup fresh blueberries or 1 cup frozen blueberries
instructions: Combine the cream, sugar and salt in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to medium low and add the crema or milk. Cook until heated through and stir for 30 seconds. Remove from heat. Stir the hot mixture into the creamed mixture. Stir in the frozen blueberries. Cover and chill well. Store in refrigerator up to 3 days. Serve cold with a dollop of whipped cream.

title: Stove Pot Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 jars farmer cheese | 2 jars sliced pepperoni | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to melt farmer cheese. Stir in pepperoni. Stir in half and half and maple syrup until cheese is melted. Spread on bread slices. Bake at 350 degrees c for 15 - 20 minutes covered, or until golden brown.

title: Molasses Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1/2 cup dark molasses
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the black beans, sundried tomatoes, and molasses. Cover, and refridgerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Lentil Orange Blossom
ingredients: 2 oranges, blossom water for the lentils | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar | 4 1/4 cups brown lentils, white | 2 egg whites | 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Place orange blossom water in a small saucepan and add some water.

title: Spanish Seven-Ginger Peppers
ingredients: 500 g yellow sweet peppers | 25 g unsalted butter | 1/2 cup almond meal
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Line a 5 cup oven dish with foil paper and rub inside with butter. Wash peppers and cut into 8 lenghtwise rounds. Place peppers in dish and sprinkle evenly with almond meal. Bake at 200 degrees c on middle rack for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,horseradish,chinese five spice powder,dark brown sugar,grenadine
title: Ginger Glaze
ingredients: 100 g dark brown sugar ( i use splenda ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-flavoured horseradish | 3 -4 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 dash grenadine | 1 dash chinese five spice powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly together in a bowl. Use as a glaze for steamed vegetables, meats or rice..

title: Mountain Hot Pot
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground dried maraschino cherry | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried tarragon ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 6 cups baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 3 lbs lean ground lean pork | 2 lbs mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 cup cider vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together cherries, spices, and 3 cups water. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender but still firm, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, brown ground pork and mushrooms for 5 minutes. Remove and discard stems from mushrooms. Stir meat into potatoes. Add vinegar and 1 cup water. Heat through. Serve hot.

title: Lebanese-Style Pasta With Olives, Sun Dried Tomatoes, and Jalapeno
ingredients: 1 package shells pasta, preferably small pasta shells, such as rotini ( about 24 ounces ) | 1 cup thinly sliced jalapeno, rinsed and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/4 cup sliced black olives, drained drained ( i use oil packed ) | 2 tablespoons amaretto ( to taste ) or 2 tablespoons rum ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Note, i prefer medium or small pieces for this one. Toss with dressing. Sprinkle with fresh mint and serve.

title: Irish Carrot and Potatoes in Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 lb carrot, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/4 - 1/2 cup heavy cream, approximately | 1/4 cup long grain white rice
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

title: Apple and Angel Hair Pasta
ingredients: 1 box angel hair pasta | 3 medium tart apples, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain thoroughly and combine with apple. Pour sauce into a greased casserole dish and cover with foil. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 minutes or until bubbly. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Spiced Mangango Spring Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour or 2 tablespoons plain flour | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 garlic clove, halved | 1 star anise | 1/2 green pepper, cut into 1cm slices | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1cm slices | 180 g phyllo dough | 1 tablespoon mango chutney, extra
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c spray baking sheets with cooking spray and lightly flour or paper. Combine cornflour, mango chutney, garlic, star anise and peppers in a bowl, add the phyllo and stir to combine. Place a spoonful of mixture onto the workbench and roll out and use for brushing with extra chutney or extra mint. Repeat until all mixture has been used. Serve.

title: Lorilyn's Famous Green Pea and Radish Saute
ingredients: 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, divided | 5/8 cup spanish onion, diced | 6 -7 large green peas, frozen or fresh | 1 lb radish, sliced | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lime juice | 2 scallions, green parts only
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, melt one tablespoon of butter. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 2 minutes, just until it starts to soften. Add peas and stir until heated all the way through, about 3 minutes. Stir in green onions and cook until greens wilt. Stir in triple sec, lime juice and scallions.

title: Homemade Coriander and Potato Biscuits (Using Bread Machine)
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes | 1 bunch fresh coriander ( stems and spines removed )
instructions: With your bread machine on it, make sure the potato is clean and dry. Place the potatoes into your bread machine and select the baking setting according to your machine's instructions. The oven temperature should be 120 degrees f but check after 6 to 8 minutes. This will depend on your oven, oven, and appliance.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,pine nut,romaine lettuce,black pepper,pecorino romano cheese
title: Tricia's Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, outer leaves removed | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 12 pieces dried italian-style cheese slices | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 tablespoons freshly grated pecorino-romano cheese | freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place lettuce leaves in a large salad bowl and drizzle with olive oil. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 2 hours. Lightly toast the pine nuts in a dry skillet over medium low heat, about 5 minutes, or until golden brown and fragrant. Grind the pine nuts in a spice grinder to a fine powder. Add the oregano and pecorino romano cheese to the grated pine nuts, mixing lightly. Add pepper to taste. Allow the salad to sit, covered, in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Toss the salad and serve.

title: Chipotle Corn Chips
ingredients: 24 corn chips | 1 can chipotle chiles | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce chipotle chile, adobo sauce
instructions: Rinse corn chips, run cold water over chiles to loosen skins. Wash in cold water until all water has drained off. Place chips into a baking dish and cover with plastic wrap. Place in refrigerator over night. When chips are almost ready. Preheat oven rack in center of oven. Turn over chips and bake for about 10 minutes, or until chips are golden and crisp.

title: Linguine With Mussels and Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 cup green plantain, cut in 1/4-inch-thick rounds ( about 1 1/2 ) | 1 lb fresh mussels, scrubbed, debearded, and beards removed ( about 4 1/2 lbs ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Pierce potatoes with a fork several times. Place on baking sheet and set in oven, 350°f. Roast just until tender, about 30 minutes. Cut into quarters and cut into bite size pieces.

title: Roasted Peppers and Chipoltles
ingredients: 2 yellow peppers | 1 teaspoon snipped chipotle chile | 1/2 cup fish stock
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut tops of peppers lengthwise down and under. Insert an even amount of snipped chipotle into each pepper. Broil 1 to 2 minutes, until skins are puffed and charred. Remove peppers. Stir fish stock into peppers. Reheat for 30 seconds. Spoon hot pepper mixture into plastic sack.

title: Quinoa and Banana Liqueur Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa, rinsed | 2 bananas ( peeled and sliced ) | 3/4 cup olive oil | 1/4 cup banana liqueur
instructions: Cook quinoa to directions. Drain and place on serving platter. Toss with banana slices. Drizzle liqueur over it all.

title: Smokey Mexican Burger
ingredients: 3 lbs hamburger | 3 ounces taco seasoning | 4 ounces black peppercorns, roughly chopped | 4 ounces baileys irish cream
instructions: In a large bowl mix first 3 ingredients. Shape into 4 patties. Spray an oven tray with non stick coating and bake at 200c for 5 minutes. Add bailey's and bake for another 5 minutes or until cooked through. Serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Fennel Cheese & Capsicum Dip
ingredients: 500 g velveeta cheese, cubed | 1 green capsicum, diced | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon white wine ( white is traditional but dry )
instructions: Finely dice the cheese then mix all together with a hand held blender. Stir in the dry fennel seeds & white wine. Mixture will resemble a thin, coarse paste. Keep refrigerated until ready to use.

title: Quick and Easy Indian Cuisine
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon palm sugar ( or to taste )
instructions: Take the yogurt and put it into the bowl of your food processor. Pulse until the yogurt has been roughly ground to your desired texture. Stir in the palm sugar to taste, add a dash of water and whiz briefly to combine. Enjoy note, this recipe is especially tasty when it is served in a bowl with a sprinkling of sesame seeds and caraffia.

title: Spinach and Nuts With Tahini Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups fresh spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons tahini sauce | 1 tablespoon lard | 3/4 cup sesame bread, crumbs ( i used gluten-free bread crumbs ) | 1 dash cayenne, to taste | 1 lime, juiced | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut flakes
instructions: Boil water in food processor for spinach and nuts. Drain when water becomes clear. Add tahini sauce and butter, stir. Add cayenne, add bread crumbs, stir. Add spinach and toss. Garnish with lime juice before serving. Serve warm with pita bread, or bread of your choice.

title: Chili Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole roasting chickens | 8 dried hot chilies | 8 ounces sliced black olives | 8 ounces maple syrup or 8 ounces light maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees fahrenheit. Remove the neck bone and the loose skin from the chicken. Rinse the chicken inside and out. Remove the loose giblets and rinse under cold running water. Cut out the neckbone. Using a sharp knife cut a shallow slash in the meaty center of the breastbone, cutting three 4 inch lengths. Stuff the chicken with the chili and place in a rack over a shallow roasting pan. Pour in enough hot water to barely cover the chicken. Bake for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, bring the maple syrup to a boil in a small saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes. Strain off the fat. Set the chicken aside for 20 minutes to cool slightly. Place the black olives and the maple syrup into a small pan with a drizzle or two of maple syrup. Cook over medium heat, stirring until all the liquid has been reduced and the chilies have melted and the mixture is hot. The syrup should be thin enough to coat the back of a spoon. Set aside for about 10 minutes to cool the olives. Pull the chicken out of the oven, and place on a carving board. Pour the syrup over the meat and serve. The great scandinavian baking book. title: Mango Chutney
ingredients: 4 ounces mango chutney, pure | 1 -2 tablespoon whipped cream of tartar | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | red chili peppers, deseeded and finely chopped to serve
instructions: Place all of the ingredients into a small saucepan and mix well until well combined. Heat gently for 5 minutes until smooth and hot.
