title: Grilled Chicken Fennel and Pepper Wings
ingredients: 1/4 cup white flour, plus additional for dusting | 1 lb beef sirloin steak, cut 1 thick | 4 chicken wings, tips trimmed | 1/4 cup coriander, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon fennel, ground | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1/3-inch squares | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Prepare a gas grill for direct grilling. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and beef. Coat the chicken wings with the flour and shake off excess. Grill chicken wings over hot coals, brushing frequently with the remaining flour, for 2 to 4 minutes on each side or until beginning to brown. Transfer to a plate, cover with foil, and keep warm. Lightly toss the coriander and fennel together in a small bowl. Place the bell pepper and steak in a small bowl and toss with the vegetables. Place each wing on a large sheet of plastic wrap. Spoon equal amounts of the coriander mixture onto the steak, then drizzle with parmesan. Grill the steak and vegetables, covered, over direct medium heat for 10 minutes, or till meat is cooked to your liking. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,tomato soup,pita bread,green chili pepper,tofu
title: Baked Tofu With Chiles and Toast
ingredients: 1 package tofu, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices, then cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 jar chopped green chili peppers, undrained | 1/2 cup plain dried bread crumbs | 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 12 thin slices bread ( i use whole wheat )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a skillet or a small bowl, combine water, tofu and chiles. Bring to a slow boil over high heat.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,basil leaf,doritos,garlic,white wine vinegar,half cream,rotel tomato
title: Dorito Dressing
ingredients: 1 package plain dorito scoops | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 5 -6 fresh basil leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 -2 clove garlic, minced | salt and pepper
instructions: In a blender or food processor, puree the tomatoes and basil. Add vinegar, garlic, salt and pepper, blend until desired taste is achieved.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,orange juice,spinach leaf,peanut,russet potato,mango chutney
title: Grilled Samosas
ingredients: 4 -6 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 orange bell pepper, stemmed, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 medium orange sweet bell pepper, stemmed, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 1/4 cup chopped dry-roasted peanuts | 1/4 cup mango chutney ( major greys ) or 1/4 cup apricot jam
instructions: Cook the potatoes in boiling salted water until well tender, about 15 minutes. Drain.

title: Guacamole Wings
ingredients: 16 chicken wings, split | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 8 ounces guacamole | soft loaf bread
instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange wings on a baking sheet about 8 inches from the heat. Bake wings at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes, or until light brown and cooked through, turning a few times. Remove wings and cool. Stir together vanilla and guacamole. Spoon into each bread loaf, and serve warm.

title: Easy Zesty Italian Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons snipped italian parsley | 1 loaf unsliced loaf unsliced country bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Slice the loaf of bread into 12 slices, 1/4 inch thick. Mix parsley and snipped italian parsley together. Arrange bread slices on a tray. Spread snipped parsley mixture evenly over bread. Place in the oven. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until crispy and bread toasted. Serve warm.

title: Roasted Coconut Pasta and Fresh Raspberries
ingredients: 1 box penne pasta | 1 cup thinly sliced young coconut, divided | 1 cup fresh raspberries, thawed ( about 6 to 8 ) | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( or more to taste ) | 1 sprig thai basil, for garnish ( cilantro or parsley )
instructions: Place the pasta in a large roaster or casserole dish, and add just enough water to cover the pasta. Cover the dish, and turn it heat to 200 degrees f. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, until the pasta is tender and beginning to flake. Transfer the pasta to a serving dish. Add more water if the pasta seems dry. Meanwhile, place the coconut in a small pan. Place over medium heat, and cook, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon or fork, until golden, about 10 minutes. When the pasta is done, drain well, and return it to the pan. Add the raspberries and sugar, and toss to combine. Add the rum or sweetened coconut and toss until the mixture starts to thicken, about 1 minute. Stir in the basil, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,white flour,plain yogurt,basil leaf,egg,heavy cream
title: Mushroom Tarts
ingredients: 150 g button mushrooms, chopped | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 egg | 2/3 cup warm heavy cream | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Place mushrooms, cream and egg in a bowl. Blend until it has completely blended. Add the flour gradually until your flour is nearly the consistency of a fine sauce. Using a pastry blender, form the mixture into 10 to 15 large, flat mini muffin cups. Place the tin in a large roasting tin, lined with baking parchment. Fill each cup about halfway with the mixture. Cover, and place in a preheated oven of 180c/350f/gas 6 for 25 minutes, or until set. Remove from oven, and when cool, remove paper. Sprinkle with fresh basil, and allow to cool completely before serving.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,chicken meat,spanish onion,part mozzarella cheese
title: Famous Chicken Parmesan
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken meat | 1 package uncooked spanish-style onion | 1 teaspoon baking soda | shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Rinse chicken thoroughly. Drain excess water. Place chicken and onion in a large saucepan. Add baking soda, and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,okra,black mustard seed,red chili pepper
title: Okra With Chorizo, Okra & Chilli
ingredients: 4 ounces okra, cut into 2-in lengths | 2 ounces fresh chorizo sausage, halved lengthways | 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 2 large red chili peppers, halved, deseeded, roughly chopped
instructions: Place the okra and chilli in a sieve and sprinkle over a little oil. Leave to drain for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, toast the mustard seeds in a pan until dark brown and aromatic. Grind the chorizo and fry in a dry frying pan until cooked through. Drain and set aside. Briefly fry the okra and chilli in the remaining oil. Mix the okra with the chorizo and chilli mixture. Serve warm with plain yoghurt.

title: Grilled Potato and Peppers
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, peeled, quartered | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon oil | 1 small fresh ginger, peeled and finely sliced | 1 can green beans, drained and rinsed | 1 jar red bell peppers, drained
instructions: Place potatoes and oil in a shallow ceramic or glass dish. Turn over once to coat, sprinkle with ginger and turn once again. Cover and refrigerate for about an hour. Meanwhile, spray grill surface with nonstick cooking spray. Remove potatoes from dish, pat dry with paper towels. Turn with tongs, brush top side with butter or oil. Grill over medium coals about 6 minutes. Turn, brush with butter or oil and grill for 5 - 5 minutes or until desired doneness. Turn again and grill 2 minutes longer or until crisp and golden. Arrange green beans and red bell peppers around edge of grilling pan. Serve hot.

title: Mediterranean Filling for the Pastry
ingredients: 1/2 cup basil pesto | 1/2 cup finely chopped dried fruit | 1/2 cup sliced black olives | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 teaspoon pepper | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | filling ( optional )
instructions: Combine pesto, fruit, olives, golden syrup, pepper. Spoon into lined shallow frypan, sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Cover and chill overnight. Heat until hot. Note, may be served with meat and vegetable salads.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,banana,red bell pepper,green pea,grand marnier,bok choy,mustard powder,tomato green chilies
title: Mexican Green Peas
ingredients: 6 ounces green peas | 4 leaves bok choy | 1/2 cup chopped green chilies | 1/2 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 medium tomatoes, chopped | 1 ounce cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of water to boil. Add peas and blanch for 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and set aside. Remove and discard any damaged or wilted leaves from the bok choy. Bring water back to boil. Add bok choy. Boil for 4 to 5 minutes, or until almost tender. Remove from heat and set aside for 2 to 3 minutes. Drain. Place green onions and remaining green chilies in a separate pot. Add red bell pepper, mustard powder and chopped tomato. Cook for about 2 minutes, or until the mixture is dry. Drain liquid from vegetables. Mix in the peas and combine. Garnish with Grand marnier, chopped cremini and grand marnier. Serve immediately.

title: Dry Tomato Chips
ingredients: 1 lb cherry tomatoes ( cherry tomatoes can be too ) or 1 lb grape tomatoes ( cherry tomatoes can be too ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. In a baking sheet or rimmed cookie sheet with a lip, lightly coat the top with pam, then sprinkle with baking powder. If using grape tomatoes, cut in half, and place cut side up in a single layer on the baking sheet. Bake for about 25 minutes until the chips are golden.

title: Pepperoni Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 lb of thinly sliced pepperoni, cooked | 1 lb thinly sliced steak | 1 can tomatoes with basil garlic and oregano, undrained | 1 package miniature marshmallows
instructions: Combine the flour and pepperoni and roll into a 2 inch roll. Tear off a 1 inch piece of plastic wrap. Arrange on a 12 x 12 inch rectangle of reynolds wrap, shiny side up. In a 10 inch skillet, combine the steak, pepperoni and undrained tomatoes. Spoon pepperoni mixture into the center of the round. Fold ends of plastic wrap over the meat, securing with a toothpick and placing each roll in the center of the tomato mixture. Repeat with the marshmallows, coating the roll well. Wrap each roll tightly and refrigerate for 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°f with a fork, poke all over top of roll to vent steam. Bake about 50 minutes or until meat thermometer inserted in center reads 160f, or internal temperature of roll registers 140f for medium rare or 160f for medium. Let stand for 15 minutes before cutting.

title: Pasta Fish Soup
ingredients: 3 pounds rigatoni pasta | 1 package salmon, cut into chunks | 1 long serrano chile pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook rigatoni until al dente, about 12 minutes. Drain onto a plate. Return to the same pot, and pour in enough water to cover. Stir in salmon, chile, and salt.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,tomato green chilies,water chestnut,cremini mushroom,pasta shell,filet mignon steak,onion powder,moist white cake mix
title: Beef, Mushrooms and White Wine Jumbo
ingredients: 2 filet mignon steaks, cut crosswise into very thin slices | 1 package moist white cake mix | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained ( rotel brand recommended ) | 2 cans sliced water chestnuts, drained and quartered | 6 ounces fresh white mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons reduced-sodium worcestershire sauce or 2 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1 package cremini mushroom pieces | 12 uncooked small pasta shells
instructions: Place meat in a glass casserole dish. Sprinkle with the cake mix. Sprinkle water chestnuts, mushrooms and worcestershire sauce over the meat. Cover and bake in 400 degree f oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until meat is fully cooked. Remove meat. Arrange shrimp, mushrooms and water chestnuts over the casserole. Cover and bake 12 - 15 minutes longer or until shrimp are done. Toss with cooked pasta shells. Serve.

title: Noodles With Spices
ingredients: 1 lb soba noodles ( dry noodles ) | spices ( mrs. dash mix, maggi mix, etc. )
instructions: Cook noodles as per package instructions. Serve hot or cold.

title: Basic Corn Bread
ingredients: 3 cups whole meal bread flour ( or flour ) or 3 cups all-purpose flour ( or flour ) | 4 cups fresh corn or 4 cups frozen corn
instructions: Dissolve the corn meal or flour in the bread flour or flour. Place the corn on a microwave safe plate, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high for 4 minutes. Turn corn onto a clean cutting board and kneed for 2 minutes. Cut the corn off the plate and slice off the kernels if fresh corn is used. Cut the corn kernels into a medium sized ball and place on a floured surface. Roll or press with a floured rolling pin to form a small round cookie cutter. Repeat the process until all corn has been cut into circular rings or rectangular pieces. Place the rings onto a greased cookie sheet and flatten with the bottom of a glass or metal spoon. Bake at 400 degrees f for 3 to 5 minutes or until lightly charred.

title: Blueberry and Chilies Rachael Ray's Mexican Rachael Ray's Barley and Cheese Topping for Dessert
ingredients: 14 ounces blueberries ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 cans p.o.c.st. ranch style chilies | 1 package taco seasoning, recipe follows | 1/2 cup roasted red chilies | 1/2 - 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese ( i used ranchero's flagship cheddar ) or 1/2-1 cup swiss cheese ( i used ranchero's flagship cheddar ) | 1 1/2 cups quick pearl barley
instructions: Pour jar of chilies with liquid into a sauce pan. Heat on medium high heat until the liquid slightly reduces but the chilies are still mostly chunky. Add taco seasoning and stir and simmer about 3 minutes. Set aside. Combine blueberries, p. o. P. St. J.  and red chilies together and stir thoroughly. Pour into large pie plate. Place over medium high heat and cook until mixture slightly thickens and bubbly. Add ranchero's shredded cheese or swiss cheese. Stir until blended. When the cheese begins to melt, add the pearl barley and stir until combined. Stir well. Remove from the heat and place over medium low heat until bubbly. Serve immediately with salsa.

title: Cherry Roasted Romaine Wedges With Sour Cream and Sweet-And-Sour Sauce
ingredients: 2 - 4 lbs romaine lettuce, washed, spun dry, and dried | 1 - 1 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 - 1 1/4 cup sweet and sour sauce ( i use my creole-vanille kikkoman grill mix ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup dry hot sauce, to taste ( i use louisiana-based hot sauce )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Have all your lettuce washed and dried. Using 3/4 cup sour cream, spread 2/3 cup of sweet and sour sauce over each head of romaine. Dividing evenly, drizzle with 2 1/2 tbsp of hot sauce. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp or more of sweet and sour sauce and 1/2 tsp of dried mint. Place the romaine on your work surface. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tbsp of sour sauce, mint, mint flakes or other seasonings to taste. Top with remaining romaine.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,spinach,american cheese,brown sugar,green cardamom pod,cream mushroom soup,urad dal
title: Saag Chicken
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup sour cream | 2 teaspoons ground urad dal | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Combine spinach, cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, urad dal, brown sugar, cardamon pods, and green cardamom in a bowl.

title: Stilton Eggs With Lemon
ingredients: 1/2 lb stilton cheese | 2 tablespoons lemon rind | 4 small hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Melt the cheese in a small saucepan that has been heated over the fire. Do not overcook. Add the lemon rind. Cut the eggs into slices. Douse the eggs with the melted cheese. Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,red chili paste,dark sesame oil,artichoke heart
title: Baked Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, oil drained & quartered | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 5 teaspoons hot red chili paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place artichokes in an oven safe glass dish. Heat sesame oil in a small pot over medium heat. Stir in ketchup.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,oyster,sea scallop,chive,grape tomato,rice wine,wine vinegar
title: Scallops With Oysters
ingredients: 1/2 cup grape tomatoes ( preferably large ) or 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes ( preferably large ) | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream, chilled ( or whole milk or egg substitute ) | 1 tablespoon snipped chives | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 16 oysters | 1 lb sea scallops
instructions: Prepare the tomatoes as directed on the package.

title: Pasta With Beef
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 5 cups medium pasta
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, add pasta and cook until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, saute ground beef in a little bit olive oil stirring to break up any lumps, until no longer pink. Add the pasta along with a splash of olive oil. Toss and serve.

title: Kirsch Candy
ingredients: 2 quarts palm sugar, melted | 1 bottle kirsch
instructions: Remove 3 quarts of caramelized sugar from a jar or box and place onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Mix the melted kirsch and carmelized sugar together in a saucepan over medium low heat. Cook and stir until the granules have turned light tan in color.

title: Arabic Pork in Microwave
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground sumac | 1 whole pork shoulder roast
instructions: Place the kosher ground sumac in a large plate. Dip the shoulder roast in the sumac, coating both sides. Heat the microwave on high for 20 to 22 minutes. Stir the meat in the microwave every five minutes while it's cooling. This should take 12 to 15 minutes. Once the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f when taken with a meat thermometer, remove the roast from the oven. Let the juices run off, then refrigerate the roast in the refrigerator overnight. The meat can be frozen or frozen for up to 1 month. When ready to serve, let sit for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing the meat across grain.

title: Corn and Whole Wheat Flour Pilaf (Birchermans)
ingredients: 2 cups corn kernels ( canned in a jar in warm water and drained ) | 1 liter vegetable stock ( or use stock cube and finely diced ) | 2 cups whole wheat pastry flour, sifted
instructions: Place corn kernels and vegetable stock in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Take off the heat and set aside. Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl. Stir in corn and stock and knead to form a dough. Divide dough into 12 portions and roll out each portion into a 7 inch circle. Place on a floured baking tray and brush evenly with the corn and stock mixture. Bake at 200c for 12 - 15 minutes or until browned and crispy.

Random Ingredients: sherry,white wine vinegar,chinese five spice powder,cumin,walnut
title: Gramma's five Seasoned Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups finely chopped walnuts, skins on | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup chinese five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve with mixed veggies, meats or vegetables you enjoy.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,mango chutney,yellow pea,cauliflower floret,bulgur wheat,sweetcorn,italian seasoning
title: Mango Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin or 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 bunch cauliflower floret, chopped ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 can sweetcorn, drained ( from 2 15-ounce cans ) | 1 can yellow peas, drained | 1 packet instant burghol wheat ( i use no-cook ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh mango chutney
instructions: Combine beef and next 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Form into 6 - 7 patties, about 3/4 inch thick. Arrange patties on foil lined rimmed baking sheet lined with foil. Pour 1 cup water into a large saucepan, add burghol mix and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: carrot,red bell pepper,pumpkin,pinto bean,sirloin,tomato sauce,puff pastry,mango powder
title: Beef Parcels (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 2 ounces puff pastry, defrosted ( gluten free ) | 1/2 lb sirloin ( trimmed of fat, cut into thin strips ) | 2 tablespoons coconut-flavored mango powder ( i recommend malaysian mango chutney ) | 2 tablespoons red bell peppers, finely diced ( i recommend mango sombel ) | 1 carrot, finely diced ( zucchini would also be good ) | 2 teaspoons pumpkin spice ( i recommend pumpkin spice ) | 1 cup tomatoes sauce ( see note ) | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed ( you may use other beans )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Roll the puff pastry sheets with about a teaspoon of coconut powder to fit the pan size pie plate. The sheets are best used with a lip or lip. Heat the remaining 2 teaspoons coconut powder in a non stick pan over high heat. When a white froth starts to show, pour in the mango powder and whisk with a fork to remove lumps. When the mango has turned a little orange, add the bell pepper and carrot. Stir well and cook until the carrots are soft. Cut your meat into thin slices and place into the pan evenly. Add the tomato sauces. Turn the heat down and allow the meat to sear all the way until it is glazed with the sauce. Spread the meat out evenly in the pie dish, then place the prepared pie. Spread the cannellini beans evenly over the meat.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 ounce coffee liqueur | 1 inch cube cheese | 1 onion, chopped
instructions: Mix coffee with cheese and onion and serve as a sandwich roll.

title: Linguine with Anchovy-Italian Seasoning
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons italian spices ( can use dried herbs, oregano or other herbs to taste ) | 1 lb linguine
instructions: Mix together. Boil linguine until tender, drain. Place on a platter. Toss with anchovy sauce. Suggest italian bread for dipping, such as mozzarella cheese, provolone cheese or provolone. Variation, when you fry the pasta, just put it directly on a cookie sheet and bake at 450°f for 20 minutes, or in a 375 to 400°f oven for 10 minutes.

title: Grilled Yams
ingredients: 2 large yams, scrubbed and cut lengthwise in half | 1/2 cup minced vegetables ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 monterey jack pepper cheese, cut into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat grill. Cut yams crosswise into eighths. Place yams on grill.

Random Ingredients: linguine,salami,basil,rock salt,cauliflower floret,chicken breast half,salad oil
title: Grilled Chicken With Spicy Fried Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup salad oil | 1/2 cup basil, finely torn | 1 lb linguine | 2/3 cup rock salt | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves ( about 4. 5oz ) | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 8 ounces salami, drained and chopped | 1 lb cauliflower floret, trimmed | 1 1/2 teaspoons rock salt
instructions: Whisk first 6 ingredients in a bowl, pour over chicken and marinate at least 1 hour in refrigerator. Light a gas grill or grill pan with lid on medium high. If you do not have a grill pan, preheat oven to 375°f bring a large pot of salted water lightly to a boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain pasta and cool under running water. Drain. Spread 1 or 2 tbsp salad oil in 1 or 2 deep nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Brush chicken with 1 or 2 tbsp salad oil. Cook chicken 4 to 5 minutes, or until browned and cooked through. Transfer chicken to a cutting board and tent with foil. Pour off all but 1 tbsp dressing from skillet. Add remaining vegetables and remaining dressing. Bring to a boil. Cover and cook 2 minutes until vegetables are crisp tender and water is absorbed. Season to taste with salt. To serve, arrange chicken on a warm platter, pour vegetables over and sprinkle with remaining 1 1/2 tsp salt.

 Papaya (Brazilian Fruit Salad)
ingredients: 2 ripe papayas, peeled, seeded, and cut into 2 x 4 inch sticks | 1 orange, peel of, pierced with a skewer | 1 cup fresh tomato, cut into 1/4 inch slices to serve
instructions: Prepare the papaya sticks by removing the white papaya skin. Place in a colander over a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,yellow pepper,lamb shank,soya sauce,black eyed pea,basil
title: Asian Spicy Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 4 -5 lamb shanks | 1 cup soya sauce ( low sodium ) | 1 can black-eyed peas | 1 cup pineapple juice | 6 -8 leaves fresh basil, chopped ( fresh is best ) | 2 -3 small yellow peppers, chopped
instructions: Put the shanks, soya sauce, black eyed peas, pineapple juice, basil and peppers into a shallow pan. Bring to a boil and lower as many of them as possible back into the pan. Leave them for an hour. Serve them over rice or noodles, and leave the rest aside. These can also be used for chicken or fish.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,brown rice,banana,peanut oil,plain flour,baby spinach leaf,rutabaga,purpose flour
title: Raspberry, Banana, and Rice Mini Quiches
ingredients: 2/3 cup plain flour | 1/3 cup brown rice | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 3 1/3 cups peanut oil for deep frying | 1 large rutabaga, grated ( can also use a swede, grated ) | 12 slices raspberries ( fresh or frozen or thawed ) ( optional ) | 1 medium banana | 4 -6 cups baby english spinach leaves, washed
instructions: Heat oil in a deep fryer to 350 degrees fahrenheit. In a medium bowl, stir the flour with the rice and the all purpose flour.

title: Vegetarian Baked Beans!
ingredients: 2 cups vegetarian baked beans | 3 cups diced plum tomatoes | 2 cups diced fresh fruit | 1 cup corn | 1/4 cup cashews, toasted ( or peanuts ) | 2 cups salsa verde, hot ( or salsa verde )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, toss together beans, tomatoes, fruit, and corn. Spoon into a 2 quart baking dish and drizzle with salsa verde. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until hot, stirring and turning beans over in pot halfway through. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Tostones
ingredients: 10 -12 corn tortillas or 10 -12 flour tortillas | 2 spanish onions, sliced thin
instructions: Fry up each tortilla in olive oil until golden brown, flipping once. While frying onions, slice onions crosswise into half moons. When onions are golden in color, place 1 fried tortilla on top of 1 sliced onion. Spread a thin layer of fried onions on top of the fried tortillas. Place another fried tortilla over onions, this time in a hot skillet and cook until browned.

title: Baby Rocket (Gouda and Snow Peas) Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup fresh snow pea | 1/2 head fennel bulb, halved ( i like to use a tube of fennel fronds ) | 2 tablespoons instant yeast ( not rapid-rise ) | 1/4 cup grenadine ( light cream or rum works too ) | 1/2 cup grated smoked gouda cheese | 1 pinch salt ( kosher or sea )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper if desired, or generously coat with cooking spray. Slice off and discard ends from snow peas, and slice lengthwise in to halves, to yield about 2 tablespoons. Place the halved fennel bulbs in a baking dish, and cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 425 degrees, checking often to make sure they're not burning, until tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from the oven. Drain off juices. Cool to room temperature and put in a clean towel and shake away any white coating. Scrape off as much starch as possible and rinse the fennel under cold running water, and chop the fennel into ¼ inch pieces if they're larger. Place in a large bowl. Sprinkle the yeast over 1 tbsp. Grenadine on top. Stir until the yeast is completely dissolved. Place the soup and 1 1/4 cups water in a microwave safe bowl or small, deep, microwave safe bowl. Close the lid and microwave at high power for 3 minutes, stopping once, then stir once and pour into the bowl as soon as it's done. Sprinkle with cheese. Stir till melted. Season with salt, to taste. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,cheddar cheese,chili bean,walnut oil,wheat germ,cornflour,chili garlic sauce,sugar syrup
title: Halo-Tex-Mex Tilapia
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat cheddar cheese or 1/2 cup reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoons wheat germ | 2 tablespoons dried wheat kernels ( can sub 2 tbsp. fresh corn kernels, if desired ) | 5 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 tablespoon sugar-free syrup | 4 tilapia fillets | 2 tablespoons walnut oil
instructions: Cut the fillets lengthwise into 4 pieces, then slice each fillet crossways into thin strips. For the dipping sauce, combine all sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Pour over tilapia and toss well. Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium low heat. Add in cornstarch and stir to combine. Saute mixture for 2 minutes, then remove from heat and stir in walnuts. Place the fish strips in the sauce and turn so both sides are coated. Marinate for 20 minutes up to 3 hours in the refrigerator, turning halfway through. Drain off excess marinade before serving.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Lime Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and dried | 3 lime wedges
instructions: Slice crosswise into 12 slices. Place half the sun dried tomatoes in the center of a lettuce leaf. Top with a half lime wedge, and roll the leaf to enclose it. Cut in half, squeeze a wedge to make 3 small sections.

title: Quick and Easy Baked Veal With Turnips and Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound cubed turnips | 6 cloves garlic, minced | 1 large vidalia onion, diced | 1 jar dried red chile peppers | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 2 1/2 pounds cubed kingfish
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Place turnips, garlic, onion, chile peppers, and cranberries in a large baking dish. Place kingfish in dish and sprinkle with remaining dried chile peppers. Cook in the preheated oven for about two hours, basting every 15 minutes with juice and vegetables. Remove from oven and serve sauce over meat.

title: Lemongrass and Phyllo Pastry Samosas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 2 tablespoons chopped peeled fresh lemongrass | 1 teaspoon table salt, room temperature | 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( or any dry sherry ) | 3 ounces ramen noodles, broken in half lengthwise ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to in measuring cup, combine buttermilk, lemon grass, and salt. Set aside. Place 3 sheets phyllo over work surface. Turn over. Top 3 sheets evenly with buttermilk mixture. Top phyllo with 3 more sheets phyllo, leaving a little extra to brush. Repeat layering three times with remaining 3 sheets phyllo, buttermilk mixture, lemon grass mixture, noodles, and remaining 1/2 cup phyllo. Cut layered pastry into twelve pieces. Fold in sides and ends. Place on baking sheet. Bake 18 - 20 minutes, or until golden. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: The Best Fried Rice (Cook's Illustrated!)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups minute rice wine ( not cooking wine ) | 1/2 cup colby-monterey jack cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping ( any kind )
instructions: Heat oil over medium high heat in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart heavy saucepan. Add rice wine and stir well.. Increase heat, stirring occasionally, and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Toss rice with cheese and top with whipped topping.

title: Basic Boiled Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb carrot, peeled, washed, and finely grated ( about 1 3/4 cups ) | 2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs ( fine dry breadcrumb )
instructions: The carrot needs to be very finely grated to measure 2 cups. Place all ingredients into a large pot and cover with water. Boil for approximately 1 1/2 hours, or until carrots are cooked. Serve.

title: Ginger Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream | 1 cup grated fresh ginger root
instructions: Stir cream, ginger, and white pepper sauce together in a pot. Simmer until ginger pieces are soft, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Persian Mayonnaise
ingredients: 2 cups dijon-style mustard | 1 large fresh serrano pepper, finely sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange flower water
instructions: Blend the mustard and the hot pepper or chile until smooth. Gradually add the remaining ingredients and blend until all ingredients are mixed well.

title: Easy Cream for Chicken, Beef, Onions
ingredients: 36 ounces chicken bouillon granules | 1 pint heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine chicken bouillon granules and heavy cream. Heat and stir until reduced and cream is reduced to about half. Use a slotted spoon to remove a few cubes from cream, and toss with reserved cream and chicken bouillon granules. Serve over your favorite raw veggies and/or rice.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,taco seasoning mix,spanish chorizo,black pepper,mint sprig,juniper berry,green cardamom pod,anise oil
title: Spicy Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 teaspoon anise oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 12 ounces spanish chorizo, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 lbs ground round | 1 package yellow sweet pepper, strips | 1 can diced spanish-style chorizo, drained | 2 green cardamom pods, seeded and crushed with a mortar and pestle | 1/4 ounce dried mint sprig ( optional ) | 1/4 ounce taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat broiler. Brush anise oil, black pepper and sweet peppers with anise oil and then place on a broiler pan rack or broiler pan rack on a baking sheet. Broil until the tops are just beginning to char, about 3 minutes. Turn once, basting every couple of minutes with hot anise oil. Cool slightly, then cut peppers into 1/8 inch wide strips and place in a large bowl. Tear chorizo into 1 inch pieces and add with green charos, cardamom, mint and taco seasoning. Mix well, cover and refrigerate for later use. Shape ground round into four 4 inch rounds and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Broil for about 10 minutes, turning once, until no longer pink in the center and the meat is cooked through. Cool. Place 1/4 cup beef mixture in the center of each bun and top with a thin slice of pepper strips and serve.

title: Danish Pear and Crab Skewers
ingredients: 2 cups chopped ripe pears | 2/3 cup peeled and chopped crabmeat | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried thyme | 2/3 cup crumbled red cherries
instructions: Mix pears, crabmeat, horseradish, thyme together. Arrange pear skewer in a glass baking dish. Cover with red cherries. Chill until serving.

title: Cumin and Coriander Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cleaned ( or 2 chicken breasts ) | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, slightly crushed
instructions: Dry skin off chicken. Place chicken in a shallow oven safe casserole dish or roasting tin. Sprinkle with cumin seeds. Cover with 1 1/2 cups water or enough to make water 2/3 of the way up the chicken. Cover and place in a preheated 400 degree oven, allowing 45 minutes for a dry chicken or until cooked through and falling off the bones. When cooked place on a clean dish towel and allow to cool completely. Remove skin before freezing. The skin is the best part and it can be a pain when it melts away.

title: Aeblegrod Chivo - Cháté Dip
ingredients: 1 cup light beer | 2 tablespoons pureed tomato puree | 1 tablespoon bourbon ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons mirin ( optional ) | 5 -6 sliced red chiles
instructions: Shake all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand 5 minutes. Stir and serve.

title: Capellini Di Banane Di Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 banana, cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup marsala wine | black pepper to taste
instructions: Place quinoa in a medium bowl, and pour enough water over the quinoa to cover. Soak in the boiling water for 15 minutes. Drain quinoa, and return to a bowl. Place banana pieces in a microwave safe bowl, cover with sesame oil, and microwave on high for 2 minutes. Stir, and microwave for another 2 minutes. Stir, squeeze, and microwave 1 minute. Stir, squeeze, and microwave 2 to 8 minutes. Stir, squeezed, sesame oil, marsala, and black pepper to taste. Serve warm.

title: Italian Asparagus
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 lb genoa salami, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb asparagus, trimmed | 1/2 lb pepperoni, thinly sliced
instructions: In a small skillet, toast cumin seeds until aromatic & fragrant, about 1 minute. In a large bowl, combine the cilantro leaves, salami, asparagus & pepperoni. Toss with the spices before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,mint leaf,sage leaf,asparagus,tomato sauce,cream mushroom soup,chicken bouillon cube
title: Beef and Asparagus Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 8 ounces asparagus, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Place beef in the bottom of a slow cooker. Pour tomato sauce, soup, bouillon, asparagus, mint and sage over beef. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 - 8 hours.

title: Orange-Glazed Beef
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger meat | 1 orange
instructions: Cut the beef into small thin strips. Coat all the strips with orange glaze. Let stand for about 1 hour in the refridgerator. Serve on hoagie rolls with your favorite sandwich.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Samosas
ingredients: 2 cans condensed chicken soup | 1 cup water | 1 cup peanut butter | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts, finely chopped
instructions: Combine chicken soup, water, peanut butter, lime juice, and thyme in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,seasoning salt,avocado,beef bouillon cube,cornflour
title: Guacoa (Guatemalan Avocado Fries)
ingredients: 2 large avocados | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch will be the best ) | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt or 1/2 teaspoon salt ( you like )
instructions: Using a fork poke the avocado slices in a small bowl with water, to remove the membrane and pith. The avocado is now ready. Using this method it is easy to scoop out the avocado and place it in the refrying pan. Add the ingredients plus 1 tablespoon of cold water to the pan to help loosen everything around and keep the avocado from turning brown. Do not let it touch the bottom of the pan so that the water does not burn. The temperature should be at least 190ºf. You basically just kept the temperature at 180ºf. Stir and let everything simmer, covered for about 20 minutes or longer. You want to check the temperature after five 10 minutes to see if the water has begun to dry out. It should not, however, have wet curds on the bottom of the pan. Turn the heat off. Wait for the liquid to mostly evaporate. Using another tablespoon or two of cold water, coat the avocado slices in the cornflour, turning them so they are evenly coated. This is not likely to happen as the guatemalan variety of tomatoes that is usually on the side of the pan contain plenty of moisture. This is called masa so don’t make this too far in advance, as the mixture will be too salty. The guatemalan flavor can also be altered with different types of guatemalan condiments. Add in the pepper flakes. Serve with a bowl of hot guacamole.

Random Ingredients: cracker,potato starch,chinese five spice powder,dark rum
title: Sydney Crackers
ingredients: 1 large potato starch | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dark rum | crushed cracker
instructions: Use a glass to crush potato starch with rolling pin or potato masher. Add spices and rum to melted potato starch and mix well. Pour over crushed crackers and stir well. Serve with coconut milk, coconut rum or dark rum on the side.

title: Sauce for Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tzatziki, plain, cold ( see description ) | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Note, for a tangy texture, substitute 1/2 cup reduced fat sour cream for one of these two ingredients. Drain the cold tzatziki into bowl and add red pepper flakes. Toss. Note, sometimes i add chopped onion while still hot. Adding onion when i do that is optional. Add dressing and stir.

title: Pear and Walnut Salad
ingredients: 1/2 small cabbage, core removed, shredded ( or regular cabbage if you have them ) | 1/2 small new potato, shredded | 2 pears, peeled, cut into wedges and quartered | 2 tablespoons oil | 2 teaspoons dried sweet tarragon leaves | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios or 1/4 cup salted roasted pine nuts | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 lemonade, about 1 cup juice ( can also use ice cream! )
instructions: Cut the shredded cabbage in half lenwise and then cut the quarters into thin slices. Place cabbage and potato in a large salad bowl large enough to accommodate all ingredients. Add 1 tablespoon oil, 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs, 1/4 cup pistachios or nuts and 1 teaspoon honey. Mix well and garnish with remaining 1 tablespoon pistachios or nuts and lemonade to serve.

title: Bean Dip With Brie
ingredients: 2 lbs pinto beans | 1 cup beet, grated ( or 1-1/2 cups canned chopped spinach ) | 1 cup brie cheese | 2 serrano chili, minced | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Soak beans for 3 hours in water. Drain. Cook beans over medium heat, adding a little water if needed. Add beet, cheese, serrano chilies, and lemon zest. Stir frequently just until cheese is melted. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: breakfast cereal like raisin bran,chili paste,soymilk,cornflour
title: Crunchy Muesli
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk ( low fat ok ) | 1/4 cup cornflour ( for cooking ) | 1/4 cup sweet chili paste ( like thai chili paste ) | 1 tablespoon instant breakfast cereal ( like cholent )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees and line a 6 cup oven proof dish with parchment paper and lightly dust with flour, set aside. In a large bowl mix soy milk, cornflour, chili paste, and instant biscuits or rice. Pour the contents of the bowl over the milk mixture and stir gently to make sure everything is well blended, set aside. Pour out the remaining milk mixture into the baking dish and bake until it has set, about 15 - 20 minutes. Serve warm or cool, and store in the fridge overnight.

Random Ingredients: salsa,italian breadcrumb,kaffir lime leaf,turmeric powder,cornstarch,turkey pepperoni
title: Salsa Meatball Stew
ingredients: 1 package turkey pepperoni ( cut one inch cubes ) | 1 package turkey tenderloin or ( 1 lb ) package turkey pepperoni | 1/2 cup salsa | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon dried kaffir lime leaf | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Cut the turkey and tenderloin into 1 inch cubes. Place the cubes in a bowl with the salsa, cornstarch, lime leaves, turmeric powder, and turmeric powder. Combine the ingredients until the salsa dissolves and there are no more lumps. Place the meat in a medium sized skillet. Cook the meat until it is cooked through, around 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Chorizo Skewers for Samosas
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger paste
instructions: Line a 9 by 13 inch metal baking dish with foil and spray lightly with cooking spray or use a nonstick spray. In a medium bowl, combine the chorizo, mustard and ginger. Toss so that all ingredients are well distributed.

title: Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 lb sausage, sliced | 1 lb beef steak
instructions: Cut steak into 6 patties approximately 1 1/2 wide, 1 1/2 thick. Place them in the slow cooker on top of the meat. Pour the rest of the ingredients on top of the meat. Cover. Cook on low 8 - 10 hours or high 3 - 5 hours. Serve with cooked flour on the side.

title: Mexican Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 8 ounces genoa salami, sliced | 1/2 lb jalapeno, sliced ( seeds removed ) | 1/2 lb spicy montreal smoke salami, sliced ( i use deli ham ) | 1 1/2 cups pecan halves | 1 package semisweet chocolate squares, melted and blended
instructions: Prepare the first 5 ingredients as directed on the bag. Make the chocolate sauce. In a large bowl, combine the melted chocolate and nuts. With the mixer working the chocolate over medium heat, add the dry ingredients and mix until chocolate is melted and mixed well. Roll the mixture into balls the size of walnuts, and coat with melted chocolate mixture. Store in the refrigerator before coating with chocolate.

title: Oodles of Noodles-Nuts
ingredients: 12 ounces egg noodles ( about 1 cup ) | 2/3 cup light brown sugar | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook noodles in salted water according to directions. Drain in a colander, return noodles to pot. Meanwhile, combine sugar and parmesan to taste and mix well. Stir with noodles.

title: Green Grapes With Phyllo Croutons
ingredients: 4 slices bread | 6 -8 slices feta cheese | 6 -8 lettuce | 1 pint green seedless grape | nam pla ( asian fish sauce ) | 1 -2 teaspoon whole black peppercorn, to taste
instructions: Cut the bread in half lengthwise. Remove crusts and cut into small cubes. Spread the croutons on the bread evenly. Arrange the lettuce, grape, and pepper over the slices. For each serving, top with a few tablespoons of fish sauce. Add a few croutons on top before serving.

title: Panko Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 ounces dried shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Soak shiitake mushrooms for ½ to ¾ hours in boiling water, then use towel to dry. Soak panko in ½ cup warm water. Drain and dry mushrooms with towel. Add panko and vanilla essence to soaked mushrooms and dry mushrooms to make a mushy mixture. Tear or break into pieces and mix lightly with hands. Spread in greased tin and refrigerate until set.

Random Ingredients: orange,ice cream topping,edam cheese,pumpkin puree,green olive,cardamom pod
title: Pumpkin-Eedam Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 packages edam cheese, chopped into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 green olives or 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, chopped | 1 large orange, juiced, not too soft | 2 large cardamom pods, cracked lightly | ice cream topping, such as cool whip or cool whip
instructions: In food processor, blend all the ingredients until it resembles coarse crumbs.. Drop by spoonful onto a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in 350 degree f oven for about 30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Allow to cool. To serve, spread with a dollop of cool whip. Decorate with red or yellow sprinkles and/or drizzled candied orange slices. Store in refrigerator.

title: Easy Mexican Mango Tortilla
ingredients: 1 bag mangoes ( i like jolene ) | 1 bag tortillas ( or corn ) | 1 bag buttermilk | 1 bag shredded coconut
instructions: Cut mango's in small chunks into medium size chunks. Place in bowl and add coconut. Let mango's soften for about 10 minutes. Add buttermilk and mix well. Let it sit in fridge for about 30 minutes, but you can eat it right away.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,fettuccine,spicy brown mustard,red chili powder
title: Homemade Fettuccine
ingredients: 500 g dry fettuccine | 1 tablespoon spicy brown mustard | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 teaspoon self-raising flour
instructions: Cook fettuccine in a large pan until tender. Drain and reserve 1 cup of the cooking water. Return pasta to pan and combine remaining ingredients. Combine well and keep warm until serving time.

title: Spanish Potato and Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 350 g potatoes, sliced | 350 g green beans, tipped, trimmed, halved diagonally | 100 g orange peel, roughly chopped | 100 g sliced tomatoes | 150 ml cream | 3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water for about 30 minutes until tender. Drain and cool to room temperature. Place the potatoes in a salad bowl. Add the beans, orange peel, tomatoes and cream. Toss to combine. Whisk the oil and cream in a screw top jar with a screw top lid and shake well until the oil and cream are well combined. Pour over the salad just before serving.

title: Sauce-Free Applesauce Cake - Kuru Pawe
ingredients: 3 3/4 cups applesauce or 3 3/4 cups apple cider | 3/4 cup unsalted butter, room temperature | 2 packets ladyfingers, frozen, thawed | 1/2 lb salami, sliced thinly ( or use a combo of all three ) | 3/4 cup granulated sugar | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f butter and flour a 10 inch bundt pan or 8 inch square pan or springform pan and dust with flour. Combine applesauce or cider, butter, ladyfingers, sliced salami and sugar in a large saucepan and heat over medium high heat until it just begins to bubble and stir constantly, about 2 minutes. Reduce heat to medium and stir in garam masala and salt. Continue to whisk until it comes to a simmer. Transfer hot mixture into prepared pan. Smooth mixture with back of a small spoon so that the mixture is even. Insert skewer or toothpick into top of cake as a test. Let cake sit out at room temperature for 30 minutes and then cover and refrigerate overnight. Sprinkle with brandy and bake 30 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted into center of cake comes out clean. Let cool before removing from pan.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,romaine lettuce,chinese egg noodle
title: Chinese Egg Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages dry chinese egg noodles | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and dried
instructions: Put noodles in a large pot of boiling water, and cook until the pasta is tender but still firm, but still with a bit of bite. Drain, and rinse with cold water to cool. Drain noodles again. Drain and set aside. Place sesame oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Stir in noodles, and cook until heated through, but still a little crunchy. Add the romaine lettuce, and toss to heat through. Serve.

title: Mixed Avocados With Peanut Cheese
ingredients: 4 large ripe avocados ( or 6 small ones ) | 4 tablespoons red curry paste | 4 tablespoons parmogh cheese, shredded, plus more for sprinkling ( plus more for sprinkling )
instructions: Peel the avocados and cut in half lengthwise. Remove the seeds. Slice the tops off of the avocados. Place the avocado halves cut side down on paper towels until cool enough to handle. Remove and discard the pit then cut in wedges lengthwise. Spread the curry paste on a plate. Place the cheese in a separate serving dish. Dip the wedges into the curry paste, coating well. Sprinkle over the cheese. Serve at once.

title: Coconut Pistachios
ingredients: 16 ounces unsweetened coconut, shredded | 4 -6 garlic cloves, chopped | 1 cup black olives, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon mint sprig | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic-flavored salt
instructions: Process coconut, garlic, black olives, and pistachios in food processor until well mixed and smooth. Add mint sprigs, garlic flavored salt, and pepper.

title: Green Beans and Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, cut into 2 inch lengths | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | tabasco sauce
instructions: In a large skillet, combine green beans and 1/2 cup of the coconut milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until beans are tender and mixture has thickened slightly. Stir in oyster sauce. Serve immediately before serving.

title: Spiced Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 7 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 5 sprigs rosemary
instructions: Place shiitake mushrooms in a pan of boiling water. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Remove stems and discard. Slice caps thinly. Using 2 fingers of rosemary, rub mushrooms with some of the capsicum to soften slightly. Arrange the mushroom caps on serving plates, spoon over mushroom caps and sprinkle with more rosemary leaves.

title: Quick Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 bottle taco seasoning, your favorite store-bought | 4 bell peppers, red or yellow | 1 bunch fresh thyme
instructions: Prepare your favorite taco seasoning and place in a hot dry skillet or crockpot. When hot, set on medium high and quickly smoke the seasoning for about 10 - 15 minutes, until very dark.

title: Spash Milkshake
ingredients: 4 ounces unsweetened soy milk | 3/4 cup fresh pink beans | 1 tablespoon crushed pink beans
instructions: Pour soy milk into a glass filled with ice. Add pink beans and crushed pink beans. Shake ingredients in an old fashioned glass to combine. Enjoy.

title: Grilled Polenta With Mushrooms and Gruyere
ingredients: 4 medium corn on the cob, husked | 4 slices lean gruyere cheese ( about 3 slices ) | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 1/4 cup dry sweet wine, such as burgundy, zinfandel or chardonnay | cooking spray | 3/4 cup dry porcini mushrooms, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup prepared sweet-wine ( such as burgundy ) or 1/2 cup canned plum tomato puree
instructions: Place grill pan over medium high heat and prepare grill and corn. Combine cheese and oregano in small bowl. Dip corn into cheese mixture. Place on hot grill rack, close lid, and grill 6 to 8 minutes or until browned. Remove from grill, cover loosely with foil, and set aside to rest at room temperature, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, combine sweet wine and vinegar in small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat.

title: Tarragon Grilled Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 medium pork shoulder, about 1-pound | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh tarragon | 1/8 teaspoon minced fresh tarragon
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. In a small bowl, stir together the salt, 2 tablespoons tarragon, and 1/8 teaspoon kosher salt. Rub all over the pork surface. Grill the pork until well browned, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer the pork to a cutting board.

title: Kartoffel Kloesse (Potato Crusted With Olive Oil)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fingerling potatoes ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 1 can sliced oil-cured black olives | 3 cans beef broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a 2 1/2 quart casserole, toss potato slices with olive oil to coat. Arrange in one layer over top of the olive oil. Pour beef broth around and on top of potato slices, then cover the casserole tightly with foil. Bake in preheated oven about 45 minutes, until potatoes are tender and crusty.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,cumin seed,chicken cutlet,purpose flour,lamb chop
title: Indian-Spiced Lamb
ingredients: 4 lamb chops | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons crushed cumin seed
instructions: Lightly coat a large nonstick grill pan with nonstick cooking spray. Thread the lamb onto skewers. Dust lightly with flour. Grill on the preheated rack of an uncovered grill until the lamb is no longer pink in the center and tender in the center, and the edges are well browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,meat,plain yogurt,coriander seed,garlic powder,irish cream,spaghetti squash
title: The Easiest Baked Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 5 spaghetti squash, halved and seeded | 1 cup meat, diced | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon coriander seed ( roughly crushed ) | 4 tablespoons minced garlic powder | 1/2 cup irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f and line a baking tray with oiled foil. Scrub squash from ends. Place in a baking dish and bake for 40 - 45 mins. Or until skin blisters in the top. Remove squash and place in a food processor and blend until smooth. Rinse the rice in a strainer and place in a saucepan with a litle water to cover. Bring to the boil. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 5 - 10 mins until water is absorbed. Drain and place back into baking pan. Add meat, yoghurt and coriander. Toss gently. Spoon mixture into squash skins. Sprinkle with diced garlic powder and bake for 35 - 40 mins. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,egg white,red food coloring
title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 4 egg whites | 250 g self-raising flour | 2 drops red food coloring
instructions: Put egg whites in a blender and whip them until peaks have formed peaks around the edge. Add the flour and red food coloring. Mix well. Add more food coloring if you are making pixie dust balls.

title: Chinese Style Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place lamb shanks in a large, deep roasting pan. Place pan in preheated oven, and roast lamb in preheated oven until tender, about 1 hour 45 minutes. Place lamb, chicken bouillon, and 1/2 teaspoon bouillon powder in a skillet over medium low heat, and stir. Cook about 5 minutes, or until heated through and no liquid is seeping through.

Random Ingredients: cranberry juice cocktail,cashew,garlic salt,graham cracker crumb,rice noodle,button mushroom
title: Mushroom Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 ounces rice noodles ( cellophane noodles ) | 1 package fresh button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 can cranberry juice cocktail | 1/2 cup dry cashews ( toasted or salted ) | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: To make dressing, combine all dressing ingredients and refrigerate until required. Slice the mushrooms and combine with noodles in a bowl. Add the dressing and mix well. Transfer to a 9x13 baking dish just large enough to hold the mushrooms. Scoop out the mushroom pulp from inside, leaving about 1/4 cup in the dish. Place mushrooms in the dish, then sprinkle with cracker crumbs and remaining crumbs. Cover mushroom caps lightly with a damp paper towel. Spray with oil spray and bake in a 375 degree oven for 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Saucy Steak Fingers
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 20 ladyfingers | 2 tablespoons dried white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons dried currants | 1 teaspoon dried parsley | 1 - 1 1/2 cup all-purpose white breadcrumbs | 2/3 cup half-and-half or 2/3 cup half-and-half cream | 15 ounces enchilada sauce ( mild, medium, hot or your choice )
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Place the ladyfingers on wax paper, and then dust with flour. Roll in bread crumbs. Saute in skillet for a few minutes on each side, or cook in a hot skillet with 1 tablespoons oil. While still hot, add the currants, parsley and cream. Heat up enchilada sauce. Top with lady fingers and serve.

title: Mushroom & Garlic Paste
ingredients: 1 cup mushrooms, sliced finely ( any type will do ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons miso | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Mix all ingridients together well. Use immediately on fresh veggies and chicken.

title: Shiraz Adab or Smoked Pork Stew of Galilea
ingredients: 6 ounces smoked pork roast | 14 ounces squids, sliced in half | 1 pinch saffron | crushed pepper flakes, to taste | 10 g fresh rocket
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/fan 180c/gas cut the smoked pork into smaller pieces. Place the pork in a roasting tin or roasting dish. Cut the bay leaves from the saffrins, then add to the pork. Add the crushed pepper flakes. Add the scallions on top. Add the rocket on top of the meat. Cover tightly. Cook for 12 - 15 hours and serve with fresh bread.

title: Besari Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 1/2 cup millet | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, cracked randomly | 1/4 cup corn oil | 3 tablespoons feta
instructions: Wash rice and let it drain in an sieve for an hour. Dry it well and mix the rice with millet, add cardamom and black pepper together. Put aside. Heat oil in a cast iron or skillet, on medium low heat, and add crinkle on rice when it is lightly browned. Add feta and fry about 3 minutes.

title: Brazilian Melon Salad
ingredients: 9 ounces pancetta bacon, thinly sliced | 3 ounces escarole, shredded | 3 ounces bamami bacon, thinly sliced, about 6 slices | 14 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained and chopped
instructions: Drain most of the fat from the pancetta and cut it into thin strips, not too thin. In a salad bowl, mix the bacon, escarole, bamami and bamboo with the pancetta and mix thoroughly. Adjust pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Pasta With Garlic and Paneer
ingredients: 3 cups dry ziti pasta, cooked and drained | 6 ounces panir | 3/4 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Put the ziti into a large mixing bowl. Add the garlic. Heat a non stick fry pan over medium heat. Add the mixture of the pan, the ziti, and garlic salt to the saucepan. Cook and stir the mixture for a few minutes until it is hot, stirring so it does not stick to the bottom. Serve right away.

title: Spicy Chorizo Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | pork sauce, as desired ( i use `` creole hotness '' brand, but any brand may be used ) | 1/4 cup chili sauce
instructions: Trim the fat from the pork, and season with a good amount of creole hotness. In a 9x13 pan pour enough thickly browned pork sauce to coat the pork, and coat them. Cover and bake at 350° f. For 1 hour. Remove from oven, and slice across the grain. Serve with the optional toppings of your choice. These are even better reheated.

title: Apricot Leek & Chile Salad
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups apricot preserves | 1/2 cup ketchup | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon minced leeks | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 3 poblano chiles ( seeded & finely chopped ) | 1/2 cup icing sugar
instructions: Cut stems off the chilies & brush with olive oil. Broil or grill chilies until lightly charred, then place in a warm oven to keep warm. After removing from oven, cut into 1/2 lengths. In a small bowl, mix preserves, ketchup, catsup & leeks. In a small bowl, combine icing sugar & poblano chiles. Dip the chilie mixture into icing sugar & place on plates. Top with 1/2 of each the apricot & chile mixture. Garnish with remaining chopped chile & drizzle with extra olive oil.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,italian parsley,chicken breast fillet,mayonnaise,rice wine vinegar,pearl barley
title: Mediterranean Chicken Barley Salad
ingredients: 3 cup low-fat mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 cups cooked pearl barley | 1 1/2 lbs chicken breast fillets | 2 tablespoons minced italian parsley
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise, vinegar and oil in small bowl until well blended until combined. Add barley to mayonnaise mixture.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,canola oil,white flour,green bean,black peppercorn,lamb,baking soda,gruyere cheese
title: Lamb and Gruyère Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon whole black peppercorn | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 3 cups white flour | 6 ounces gruyere cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 8 ounces brie cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 8 ounces green beans, trimmed & cut into 1/2 inch lengths
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, 2 tablespoons of the canola oil and peppercorns and refrigerate overnight. In a heavy 2 1/2 to 3 quart saucepan, combine baking soda, flour, gruyere, remaining 1 1/4 cup canola oil, brie, green beans and reserved marinade from the lamb. Bring just to boiling.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,cranberry,basil,applesauce,graham cracker crumb,green pea,chickpea,onion flake
title: Fruit and Cheese
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 1/2 cups finely crushed graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 3/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/4 cup dried cranberries ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line 2 cookie sheets with foil. Place the drained beans in a large bowl, and mash well. Stir in the graham cracker crumbs, onion flakes, applesauce, cranberries, basil, and cardamom. Spread the filling into the prepared cookie sheets. Bake in preheated oven 25 minutes.

title: Easy Egg and Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 aubergine | 1 1/2 cups apple cider | 1/2 cup peanut butter
instructions: Chop aubergine in half lenghtwise. Sauté in a non stick frying pan with peanut butter until soft. Cut egg into 8 pieces, toss with some of the apple cider until well mixed in with the egg. Serve with remaining apple cider.

title: Quick Sausage with Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pound fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread slices of kielbasa out onto a large baking sheet. Bake sausage in the preheated oven until sausage is no longer pink inside, about 25 minutes.

title: Stuffed Rye
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked mozzarella cheese | 1 bunch watercress leaf | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 slices rye bread ( thick slices ) | white pepper
instructions: Cut off both ends of the mozzarella cheese and scoop out most of it. Carefully scoop out the cheese from its crusts and cut out the centre of the cheese. Use the end of a large knife to push back through the centre to make a hole in the middle. Grate the remaining cheese onto the top of the hole being careful not to let your filling fall through the hole. Stuff the mozzarella into the hole with the mozzarella cheese, making sure to collect the cheese on top of the mozzarella. Heat oven to cut the rye on the diagonal into 1/2 inch slices. Place slices on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and sprinkle with white pepper. Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly browned on top. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green chili,fish sauce,white mushroom,green curry paste,rice wine,pork shoulder
title: Pork Green Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, trimmed of fat and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons green chili, chopped | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 1/4 lbs white mushrooms, stems trimmed and caps sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in wok or heavy skillet.

title: Feta Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets | 50 g feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Put feta in microwave safe bowl and cook on high for 2 minutes. Then add chicken breasts.

title: Hazelnut Macaroons for Two
ingredients: 1 box macaroons pasta or 1 box other pastas | 4 cups hazelnuts, roasted | 1 box sugar-free syrup
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add macaroons and shell. Boil for about 5 minutes. Drain and cool macaroons. While macaroons are heating up, slice off a corner of the box from the jar of hazelnuts. Save the remainder of the box from the macaroons for another use. Toast hazelnuts on a cookie sheet for about 10 minutes. You still have the hazelnuts. Preheat oven to 300 degrees/160 degrees celsius. Spread each row of macaroons on 1 box of macaroons. Next, put a row of hazelnuts on top of each macaroon row. Spread syrup evenly over hazelnuts and macaroons. Put another row of macaroons next to the last row. Put the bag of macaroons back into the microwave for about 2 - 3 minutes. Remove bag of macaroons and nuts. Put the other box of macaroons onto the same tray as the macaroons, then put in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes. You can check at 10 minutes. They should be golden brown at the outside but still soft in the center. Put everything in to a platter and cut a sliver or two of the bag from corner to corner with a sharp knife. I like to eat the whole bag of macaroons on the side while eating.

title: Apple Kebabs
ingredients: 1 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup liquid smoke | 1/2 cup grated gruyere | 1 cup ginger ale
instructions: Place the apple juice and liquid smoke in a saucepan over low heat.

title: Low-Fat Oaty-Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal ( plain or quick-cooking ) | 1 cup leftover beef broth ( add more ) | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 1 spring onion ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, mixing well. Serve with freshly ground black pepper. Can be served.

title: Dilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | 6 chicken thighs | 5 cloves garlic, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt
instructions: Sprinkle the chicken with the dried dill weed, or to taste, and rub the herb mixture onto both sides. Poke holes in the chicken with a fork or skewer. Place chicken in a shallow baking pan. Sprinkle the chicken with 1 teaspoon of salt. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 1 to 8 hours. Preheat an oven to 500 degrees f. When the oven is hot, and the temperature is at least 200 degrees f, place the chicken in the preheated oven. Bake chicken until the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees f, about 40 minutes.

title: Chunky Mexican Wings
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings, separated | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 2 -3 dried red chilies, finely chopped
instructions: Remove wings.

title: Pasta With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 250 g penne pasta | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 1/2 cups roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, heat dry frypan over medium heat. Add a drizzle of oil, if necessary. Add flour. Stir for one minute, then add peanuts. Stir for another minute. Add hot pasta, tossing to combine. Serve immediately with a green salad.

title: Chef Bevski's Baked  Portuguese Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup white vanilla-flavored soymilk | 1 jar diced pimentos, chopped | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 1/4 cup black olives, sliced | plain yellow mustard or other white vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450ºf. In a medium bowl, stir together soy milk, pimientos, marsala, and olives. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. On a lightly floured surface, roll out one third of the salad to a thickness of 1/4 inch. Spread on a 9x13 baking dish. Top with remaining salad, spread mustard, and drizzle a little over the top. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake 12 minutes, then remove foil and bake until bubbly and golden brown about 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,chinese five spice powder,half cream,sesame seed
title: Sesame Cream Sauce for Chilled Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 3 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender. Puree. Place chicken in a dish with a cover and marinate for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Grape Tomatoes And Butter
ingredients: 5 ounces soft butter, room temperature | 1 pint grape tomatoes or 1 pint cherry tomatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Whip butter until fluffy. Stir in tomatoes. Roll into balls. Place on a baking sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Linguine With Beef over Hoagies
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef round steak | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1 tablespoon browning sauce | 1/2 cup small curd | 1 teaspoon browning sauce | 1 can refried beans | 8 leaves iceberg lettuce | 2 cups minutelie pasta or 2 cups vermicelli, cooked
instructions: Trim fat of meat.

title: Parsnips with Tomatillas
ingredients: 4 parsnips - peeled, halved, and core removed | 1 can tomatillos, drained
instructions: Place the parsnips into the bowl of a food processor. Add enough tomatillo juice to cover, and process until the parsnips are finely ground, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to a platter, and squeeze the tomatillo juice out of the can into the bowl. Drain the parsnips completely, discarding any juice. Sprinkle 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley over the top. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: deli ham,red wine vinegar,dijon mustard,flour tortilla,sage,salami,red cabbage
title: Quick Ham and Cheese Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 red cabbage, finely shredded | 3 slices deli ham, finely diced | 3 slices salami, chopped | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon dry rubbed sage | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: Mix cabbage, ham, salami, vinegar, mustard and sage. Place a heaping tablespoon of mixture on each tortilla.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,orange liqueur,shiitake mushroom,chicken wing,taco seasoning mix,sambal oelek,harissa
title: Marinated Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken wings | 1/3 cup orange liqueur | 2 tablespoons harissa | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 rosemary sprig, chopped | 3 ounces shiitake mushrooms, sliced
instructions: In a large plastic zipper bag, combine the chicken wings, orange liqueur, harissa, sambal oelek, taco seasoning, rosemary and mushrooms. Seal and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Remove wings from bag and discard marinade. Arrange wings in a single layer on foil. Bake for 30 minutes, or until wings are golden on top.

title: Kaffir Lime Soup
ingredients: 1 fresh kaffir lime leaf | 1/2 red onion, peeled and diced | 1/4 cup fresh water | 2 cups unbleached cake flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: To make the paste, peel the kaffir lime leaf and finely chop and discard the stalk. Add to the water in a bowl and stir to blend. Cover tightly and set aside for 30 minutes. Strain the water from the onion and discard it. Chop the onion finely and add to the water with the lime leaves. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes or until the vegetables soften and the mixture has reduced. While soup is simmering, place the cake flour in a mixing bowl and add the cumin. Gradually add the water while mixing well or whisking. Add the boiling soup mixture to the flour and stir until it forms a smooth thick paste. Remove from the heat, cover and refrigerate to chill. To serve, ladle soup into bowls and top with a teaspoon of the kaffir lime mixture.

title: Crunchy Peanut Butter Cracker Chicken
ingredients: 30 crackers ( i use pepperidge farm crackers ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: In an air tight container with a tight lid combine all the ingredients and shake well together to blend. Cover the top of the crackers with the peanut butter mixture until they have been coated. Let cool for 10 to 20 minutes before shaking the crackers and sprinkling them over your chicken.

title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 cup celery rib, diagonally sliced | 1/2 cup celery rib, sliced | 1 small summer squash, halved and sliced | 2 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 teaspoon pepper | 6 tablespoons mascarpone, low fat | 2/3 lb penne, cooked
instructions: In the last 10 minutes of cooking, add all the vegetables except a few strips of celery, squash, and pepper. Cover and cook until potatoes are tender. Remove from heat. Place pasta in a pot of boiling water, cook until tender. Drain. Place in large serving bowl. Add potatoes and vegetables. Mix well. Add mascarpone cheese, a little at a time, stirring to blend well. Spoon mixture evenly over pasta and sprinkle with celery slices and pepper.

Random Ingredients: skirt steak,pork chop,coriander leaf,monterey jack cheese
title: Mexican Grilled Pork
ingredients: 500 g pork chops or 500 g chicken breasts, pounded to 1/8 inch thickness | 500 g monterey jack cheese or 250 g cheddar cheese, sliced | fresh coriander leaves ( optional ) | skirt steak, thinly sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, layer the cheese, pork, coriander and meat. Lightly brush with a little oil and grill until brown and just cooked.

title: Peach and Honey Crumble
ingredients: 2 small ripe peaches | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons clear honey ( to taste )
instructions:
Halve the peaches, scoop out the flesh to leave a little shell around the shell | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs ( to be gluten free if required ) | 1 tablespoon clear honey 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Preheat oven to 175 degrees in a casserole dish large enough to hold the peach halves in one layer. Put the pears into the dish and toss with the graham cracker crumbs, salt and honey, to make a crumb like topping. Bake for about 40 minutes, until the topping is golden brown, stirring frequently, and the pears are soft. Serve warm or cold. Store in an air tight container.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,tomato puree,cream chicken soup,onion,maple syrup,tequila,cardamom,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pecorino-Ribollita (Cheese Dip)
ingredients: 3/4 cup pure cream of chicken soup | 3/4 cup pure maple syrup | 1 1/2 cups shredded pecorino romano cheese, divided | 1/3 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup tequila | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves, divided | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, divided | 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9 inch baking dish well. In a bowl, mix the cream of chicken soup, maple syrup, 1 1/2 cups of the grated romano, 1/3 cup of the grated oscar, 1/4 cup pepperoni, 1/4 cup tequila, 1/4 cup chopped onions, 1 1/2 tablespoons oregano, 1 teaspoons dried oregano, and 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom until smooth. Pour into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1/4 cup of the ground pepperoni, 1/4 cup of the grated oscar, and 1/4 cup of the ground pepperoni. Cover dish completely and bake for 25 minutes. Remove from oven, uncover, and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup grated oscar and remaining 1/4 cup pepperoni. Return to the oven and continue to bake until heated through, about 10 minutes more. Cool on a rack for about a half hour. You may prepare in advance up to this point up to 24 hours in advance. Remove from oven, cut into 8 squares, or make 8 large squares. Place a square of pizza peel on a serving platter and place a square of pizza peel on top of the pizza peel. Garnish with more grated oscar, grated cheese, a drizzle of tequila, and a drizzle of maple flavored molasses.

title: Barbecue Chimichangas
ingredients: 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1 flour tortilla
instructions: Place 1 tortilla onto a plate and spread with barbecue sauce. Microwave on high, about 30 seconds, until warm. Spread the warm tortilla with remaining sauce. Place folded side down onto the hot barbecue. Cook on high approximately 10 seconds, or until bubbly.

title: Slow-Cooked Beef and White Beans(ATK)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons baking powder | 1 lb boneless beef stew meat ( cut into 1/2 inch cubes ) | 1 can white beans, drained | 3 cups cooked rice
instructions: Spray inside and sides of slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray. In bowl, mix baking soda.

title: Bacon Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dijon mustard ( or 2 tsp. mustard powder ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: ice water,vanilla vodka,cottage cheese,red food coloring,maple syrup,white miso
title: My Father's Butterdish (Betty Crocker)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cottage cheese | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 10 tablespoons white miso ( heaping ) | 5 tablespoons sugar substitute or 5 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | ice water ( approx. 1-1 1/2 cups ) | ground red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Blend cottage cheese, maple syrup, and splenda milk together until a smooth paste forms.. Gradually add ice and food coloring, if using. When the foam begins to settle at the edges of the mixture, add ice water a small amount at a time until the paste is very smooth and can be shaped into small walnut sized balls. Place into an ice cream maker or food processor and freeze according to manufacturer's directions. Makes about 1 dozen balls.

Random Ingredients: peanut sauce,eggplant,glutinous rice,artificial sweetener,cherry,flat leaf parsley,thyme leaf,spinach
title: Eggplant and Spinach Stuffed with Artificial Sweetener Rice
