ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons peanut sauce, koon chun brand | 1/4 lb eggplant, small cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices ( about 1 pound ) | 1 cup spinach, trimmed and shredded | 4 ounces cherry, halved | 1 teaspoon thai sweet basil sweetened artificial sweetener ( such as splenda ) | 3 tablespoons salted spinach, drained | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves, cut or 1 teaspoon fresh thyme | 2 tablespoons unsalted fresh flat-leaf parsley, minced
instructions: Heat a wok or large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When almost smoking, add 1 teaspoon to 1 teaspoon peanut oil.

title: Tunisian Corn Crumble
ingredients: 600 g corn kernels, canned | 2 oranges, zested and juice extracted ( white pith removed and very thinly sliced zest only ) | 2 cups panko breadcrumbs, plus extra for dusting | 50 g cornflour | 1 egg, beaten | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c. Pour corn into a large bowl and add the orange juice, zest. Mix well. Mix panko and cornflour in a separate bowl. Make a well in the centre. Combine corn mixture with half the breadcrumbs, add to the well. Mix to coat. Sprinkle over extra breadcrumbs. Gently stir to combine. Pour into a lightly oiled 8 x 8 glass baking dish and bake for 50 minutes until golden and crispy.

title: Crock Pot Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 1/2 cups broth
instructions: Put everything in the crock pot. Do not stir. Cook on low 8 - 9 hours. I used a large bowl when i made this recipe for a party and it turned out great. A nice, moist, brown gravy made into a gravy for stir frying or soup is also excellent.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,red bell pepper,beef stew meat,escarole
title: Escarole and Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 pound cubed deli corned beef stew meat | 1 pound thinly sliced escarole | 2 small red bell peppers, halved, seeded, and cut into large wedges
instructions: In a salad bowl, mix together the corned beef and escarole very well. Place equal amounts of the beef mixture in the center of the lettuce in one layer and the red pepper on top.

Random Ingredients: couscous,jerk seasoning mix,steel oat,coconut,noodle,active yeast,cardamom pod,italian herb seasoning
title: Ribollita and Stolen Pizza Crust (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 cups steel cut oats | 1/2 cup unsweetened flaked coconut | 2 teaspoons dried italian herb seasoning | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 package active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups cooked couscous | 1/8 teaspoon ground jerk seasoning mix | 1 cup italian herbs and spices | 3/4 cup crisp cooked noodles ( optional )
instructions: Combine the steel cut oats, coconut, italian seasoning, cardamom, and yeast in the crock pot. Cook on low for 4 to 5 hours, or until the oats are tender. Stir in all of the remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours or until the sauce is thick. Serve warm, or leave warm to let cool to lukewarm. Tip~the crust can be made 3 days in advance, or frozen for up to 2 months. Defrost for 1/2 hour in the refrigerator. Then preheat oven to 350°f. Note~for those with a calorie counting 1/2 cup fat for 1 cup and a healthy dose of salt and sugar, you may use the packet for the dry spices and spices to do so.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,oyster sauce,sriracha sauce,fruit,fennel seed,watercress,cranberry,ginger garlic paste
title: Fruit Curry - a Malaysian Eurasian Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried fruit ( such as apple or grape leaves ) | 3 cups watercress | 1/3 lb cranberries | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1/2 cup thai red curry paste or 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup ginger-garlic paste | 1/3 cup ginger-garlic paste | 1/3 cup sriracha sauce | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Place dried fruit in a small bowl and cover with boiling water and allow to sit for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Set aside to rehydrate. Wash watercress, cranberries, oyster sauce, red curry paste, ginger garlic paste and sriracha together in a large wok or skillet. Add fennel seed and let cook over high heat for about 1 minute, then stir. Add reserved fruit, stir in well, bring to boil, reduce heat, simmer covered for about 10 minutes or until tender and sauce thickens. Serve hot.

title: Giant Beef, Chilli & Cherry Frijoles
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 1 jalapeno, minced | 1 cup fresh basil, coarsely chopped | 1 cup maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup coffee | 1 can no-salt-added whole tomatoes, drained and chopped | 5 fluid ounces double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, mix the ground beef, jalapeños, basil and cherries. Add the juice from the tomatoes and the can of cream. Mix well and divide into 8 equal portions. Shape each portion of meat mixture into four 1/2 inch thick oval shaped portions. Transfer the meat to a non stick jelly roll pan or nonstick pan. Cover meat and bake for 30 - 35 minutes, or until cooked to taste. Serve with your favourite accompaniment such as a mushroom, garlic bread or mashed potato.

title: Baked Corn on the Barbie (Bamia Pears)
ingredients: 12 corn husks | 4 firm pears | 1/2 cup sweet thai sweet chili sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Tear the corn husk into 1 inch lengths. Slice pears in half across the top, removing stems.

title: Mexican Cocoa Mix (For Shakes)
ingredients: 2/3 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Heat all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl on high power for 2 minutes. Stir immediately before serving. Can be eaten in as little or as hot as your liking.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,mint sprig,brown sugar,cumin powder,frying chicken,cabbage
title: Tihon Ji (Chicken in Cabbage)
ingredients: 8 ounces fry chickens, sliced into strips | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 8 ounces cabbage, washed and finely shredded and cooked | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | fresh mint sprig, to garnish
instructions: Heat 1tbsp oil in a wok. Add chicken and stir fry over medium to high heat for about 5 - 6 minutes until lightly golden. Remove the chicken and set aside. Lower heat and add the brown sugar, cumin and cabbage. Stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes until the cabbage is softened. Stir in the oyster sauce and return chicken to the wok. Mix well and cook for an additional 2 - 3 minutes until chicken is cooked and vegetables are slightly tender. Sprinkle with chopped mint, serve immediately.

title: Vegan Pasta
ingredients: 1 small pasta, or as many as you like | 1 can baked beans
instructions: Boil water. Add beans. Cook for about two minutes so they get soft or fluffy. Add salt to taste.

title: Homemade Colby Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs colby cheese | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 cup white vinegar
instructions: Peel the cheese and cut it into 1 1/2 cubes. Place all ingredients in a cheese cloth bag or food storage bag. Add the cheese with about 2 tablespoons vinegar to the vinegar and stir well. Remove the cheese cloth bag from the contents, place in the refrigerator and set in the refrigerator for at least 2 - 4 hours to firm up. This can take up to 24 hours. Stir the cheese several times with a fork. Drain excess vinegar into a glass measuring cup. Stir once in a while with a fork. Pour over hot cereal in a clear glass bowl. Store at room temperature until serving time.

Random Ingredients: emeril itailian essence,cooking spray,apple juice,salsa,bean,bread,corn syrup
title: Applebee's Grilled Apple "salsa"
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 4 teaspoons apple juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons emeril's itailian essence | 12 slices bread | 1 cup dry, homemade salsa | cooking spray | 2 cups baked beans
instructions: Prepare grill by spraying with olive oil cooking spray. Prepare grill according to manufacturer's instructions. While bread is grilling, make applebee's creamy onion soup, in a small bowl mix corn syrup, apple juice and essence. Slather 1/2 cup of the onion soup over one side of each slice of bread. Place remaining four slices of bread on top of soup, making sure to sandwich the sandwiches. Place on grill.

Random Ingredients: savory,taco seasoning mix,ro tel tomato,avocado,cornish hen
title: Smoked Hens with Chipotle and Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 cornish hens | 3 avocados, cut into wedges | 1 cup ro-tel tomatoes, diced | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon dried savory
instructions: Place hens on rack in broiler pan. Combine onions, avocado, tomatoes, dried chipotle and ro tel. Broil about 10 minutes or until onions are lightly golden. Baste with pan juices during last 15 minutes of grilling.

title: Easy Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup milk | 4 ounces mozzarella cheese | pices of good spice
instructions: Mix together milk and cheese in a bowl. Dip the cheese into the milk mix, and roll into a ball, squeezing off excess, and then pop into a greased 9x13 inch pan. Sprinkle the spices over the top. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes, or until heated through. It will be really soft, and you can sprinkle with more spice later.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,amaretto liqueur,cool whip lite,galangal,sushi rice,tomato sauce,heavy whipping cream,bay leaf
title: Japanese Style Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup sushi rice, in 1-inch long slices | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 1/2 cups chilled heavy whipping cream | 1 package refrigerated crispy galangal, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup frozen snow peas | 1/4 lb fresh snow pea, cut into 1 pieces | 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 3 bay leaves
instructions: Rinse and drain rice, shaking dry. Arrange half rice in 9x8x2 baking dish. Top with 1/2 cup tomato sauce. Repeat tomato and sauce layers. Set aside. In medium bowl combine cream, galangal, snow peas, snow peas and amaretto. Place bay leaves on plate. Roll 1/4 cup chilled rice in cream mixture for 2 seconds, then remove from hand. Place in a pastry bag fitted with a 1/8 inch star tip. Pipe cream mixture evenly over rice. Set aside while baking. Preheat oven to 350°f bake until tops look shiny, about 40 seconds. Carefully remove from baking dish.

Random Ingredients: hot dog,lamb loin chop,beef soup,pasta,prune,italian bread,extra virgin olive oil
title: Lamb Chops and Prunes in Spicy Italian Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 4 -6 fresh hot dogs, cut lengthwise into 2-inch pieces | 1 beef soup bone | 2 lbs lamb loin chops, cut into 2-inch pieces | cooked pasta, of your choice | crushed italian bread
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a shallow roiling pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add the hot dogs and cook until hot, 3 - 5 minutes on each side. Remove the chops from the pan and set aside. Turn the heat down to medium. Add the soup bones and simmer for 5 minutes, or until meat is browned and bones have formed a layer of foam. Remove meat and bones. Set the bones aside. In a saucepan, bring plenty of lightly salted water to a boil. Add hot dogs and cook until cooked through. Add pasta and simmer until pasta is al dente. Add the meat back into the pan and divide pasta and meat among 4 deep serving dishes. Sprinkle italian bread crumbs over meat and bake at 400 degrees, uncovered, for 15 - 20 minutes or until crusty and lightly browned. Serve with pasta, tomato and fresh grated parmesan cheese.

title: BBQ Chicken Breast With Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into thick medallions | 1 cup jerk seasoning, kikkoman | 1 cup water | 1 tablespoon crushed cardamom | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup shelled pistachio nut, crushed
instructions: Grill or broil chicken breasts.

Random Ingredients: yeast,adobo sauce,cashew,mint sprig,apricot preserve,mascarpone cheese,chicken breast half
title: Grilled Chicken Rolls With Cashews (Arrabbiata D' Angelo)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant yeast | 2 teaspoons adobo sauce ( or add water if paste is not available ) | 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese or 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 4 tablespoons apricot preserves | 1 boneless skinless chicken breast half | 3 tablespoons dry roasted cashews ( or toasted ) | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint sprigs
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in the adobo sauce. Add mascarpone cheese and spread on the top of the marinated chicken breast before baking, placing in the refrigerator.. In a small bowl, combine the preserves and nuts. Sprinkle the inside of each chicken breast with the nuts. Brush the breasts with the jam/preserves and roll up starting from the long side, pressing the seams to seal to seal the roll. Place in a large baking dish and bake in a preheated 375 degree oven for 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Serve with warmed tomato and salad.

title: Brown Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, uncooked, not converted | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and liquid reserved | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon catsup
instructions: Cook rice. Cool. Tear up artichoke hearts. Mix with other ingredients. Mix well and serve immediately. Note, this recipe can be made a day ahead and stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator. Reheat before serving.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,vanilla ice cream,raspberry,mexican oregano,cannellini bean
title: Creamy Moroccan Salmon (Crockpot)
ingredients: 1 pound salmon fillets | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup frozen raspberries | 2 tablespoons mexican oregano | vanilla ice cream
instructions: In a 3 1/2 quart slow cooker, mix together the cannellini beans, raspberries and mexican oregano. Place salmon in the mixture. Cover with your choice of plastic wrap. Microwave on high 7 minutes or until salmon is opaque and flakes easily with a fork. Serve over fresh warm salad or on toasted pita bread with warm crusty french bread slices. To help melt, spoon a small amount of melted butter into a small nonstick skillet. Place over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: loaf french bread,red potato,pineapple juice,spinach leaf
title: Spinach & Pineapple-Spinach Stuffed French Bread Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 cup fresh spinach leaves | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1/2 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Slice bread 1/4 thick. Remove crusts and cut each loaf in half. Combine spinach, pineapples, spinach, juice and bread to make a sandwich. Spread 1 tablespoon of mixture evenly over each sandwich and wrap in aluminum foil. Place in refrigerator to firm up overnight. Slice sandwiches as desired.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Salmon
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon, about 12 pieces with skin | 3 tablespoons mustard seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Rinse the salmon under cold running water and pat dry with paper towels. Place on a large ovenproof grill and bake for 25 minutes. While the salmon is baking, dry mustard seeds in a small skillet. Dry fry the mustard seeds well and set aside. Remove foil and cool to room temperature. Add mustard seeds to a dry skillet at room temperature. Using a fork, prick skin on the skin of salmon. Drizzle the mustard seeds on skin. Cover grill. Bake for 30 minutes. Turn salmon over.

title: Ziti with Almond Paste
ingredients: 7/8 cup ziti pasta | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs ( plain ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 teaspoon fresh mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a bowl, combine the pasta, crumbs, almond extract, and mint. Mix well. Turn into a lightly oiled 9x13 inch baking dish, and spread evenly. Cover loosely with foil, and bake 45 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Quick & Easy Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb spaghetti | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 2 packages frozen peas and carrots, partially thawed | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1/4 cup light soy sauce
instructions: Cook pasta in a 4 to 5 quart pot of boiling salted water as directed on the package.

title: Santa Fe Raisins
ingredients: 2 cups golden raisins | 1 jar salsa ( your favorite )
instructions: Rinse the raisins with warm water until very dry. Pour the raisins into a shallow pan.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 lettuce leaf | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground pepper ( bottled or powder )
instructions: Prepare all ingredients as directed above. When ready to serve, wrap each lettuce leaf with a tablespoon or two of the ground pepper.

title: Garlic Corn Dogs
ingredients: 1/3 cup finely chopped yellow cornmeal | 1/3 cup finely chopped onion and garlic croutons | 1/3 cup light cream or light cream cheese spread, such as neufchatel cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray pan with cooking spray. In mixing bowl combine cornmeal, onions and garlic croutons. Add cream cheese and mix well. Shape into 8 small patties. Place on prepared pan. Cover with panckae and bake 35 minutes or until patties reach desired doneness. Makes.

title: Spiced Squash and Smoked Beets With Smoked Cabbage
ingredients: 1 small red skinned beet | 2 -3 medium beets, with a bit of green and purple leaves on each | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender flowers | 1/2 teaspoon dried crushed savory | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, crumbled | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 1/2 - 2 1 3/4 ounces smoked smoked mixed stick celery or 1 1/2-2 3/4 ounces smoked salmon | 1 small red chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Cut off the beet root and cut off and discard the beet root. Slice into thin strips, then grate the beet flesh using the finest holes of your grater. Cut the beet roots into quarters, and cut each quarter into half again. Set aside. Sprinkle the savory, lavender, savory, marjoram and ginger on the beet root, then combine with the remaining ingredients. Place the beet roots on a tea towel lined baking sheet and pat dry with paper towels. Set aside. Smoke the smoked cabbage. Place a small piece of smoked smoke stick in the center of each cabbage leaf. Brush lightly with a little bit of the smoked smoke and grill until just cooked then flip and brush again. Remove from the grill and place on serving plates, and top with beetroot and a few slices of smoked salmon on a serving plate. Eat with your favorite vegetable and vegetable accompaniment.

title: Pesto Cod With Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg cod, cleaned & cut into 4 equal portions | 1/2 cup fresh pesto sauce | 1 shallot, chopped | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons tapioca | 450 g snow peas, frozen | 1 courgette, chopped
instructions: Place cod in a large casserole dish with 4 cups water. Bring to the boil over medium heat, cover & simmer for 15 - 20 mins until white fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Remove from heat & set aside. Place pesto in a small mixing bowl with shallot and sunflower seeds. Drain the fish and pat dry. Sprinkle pesto over the fish and stir to mix well. Arrange in the casserole dish. Stir the tapioca & snow peas into the casserole & scatter over the cod. Return to simmer & cook for approx 10 mins or until the spinach is just tender. Serve with steamed basmati rice & salad leaves.

title: Asian Seasoned Nuts (How to Dry)
ingredients: 4 cups mixed vegetables, cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 tablespoons ginger powder
instructions: Rinse and dry the mixed veggies. They should be about 4 3/4 inches long. In a plastic bag add the ginger powder, mixed vegetables and salt and pepper to taste. Close the bag tightly and refrigerate for about 1 - 2 hours, turning the bag once. Store in an airtight container.

title: Salsa Rice Nachos
ingredients: 1 package jasmine rice, cooked and cooled | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 -2 teaspoon minced red chilies ( to taste ) | 1 cup salsa ( medium or hot ) | 1 cup cooked pasta ( to taste, such as ditalini or linguine ) | 1/2 cup corn chips ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a cookie sheet with a silicon baking pan. In a bowl, mix cooked rice, beans, chilies, salsa and pasta. Spread mixture evenly over the prepared cookie sheet. Top with a few corn chips if desired, and bake until hot, about 15 minutes. To ensure even baking, let cool for 5 minutes before eating.

title: Canadian Bacon, Canadian Cheese and Canadian Cutlet
ingredients: 1 lb emmenthaler cheese | 1 slice canadian bacon
instructions: Cut cheese in half lengthwise. Cook bacon in a nonstick frying pan over medium heat until well browned. Pour off any excess fat. When cheese is golden on the bottom, place it on a warmed patty to melt the cheese. Place it on the warmed patty and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili,ketchup,grain rice,spice rub,white balsamic vinegar,adobo seasoning,dark corn syrup,savory
title: Mexican-Inspired Rice Bowl
ingredients: 3/4 cup dark corn syrup | 3/4 cup white balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons kosher spice rub | 3 tablespoons minced chili | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon ground dried chiles ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped dried adobo seasoning | steamed cooked short-grain rice
instructions: Note, this is a rice bowl. It will not turn out the same as your rice bowls. Make this with water and vinegar, and refrigerate for 2 hours. To make the syrup, combine all ingredients in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Cool, then pour over rice and enjoy.

title: Vanillaized Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb small red potato | 4 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Place potatoes in salted boiling water. Parboil potatoes for five minutes. Slip half them into hot water just to tender. Set aside. Peel potatoes and place in a heavy dish. Drain potatoes. Set aside. Add 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar and 2 tablespoons sesame oil. Whisk until blended. Pour mixture over cold potatoes. Mix. Pour mixture onto hot dry table. Roll each potato in sugar and set under a hot broiler until golden brown. Serve warm or cool to room temperature.

title: Porchetta (Millet Smoothie)
ingredients: 2 millet, washed | 200 ml plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint leaves | 1 ounce shaved chocolate bar
instructions: Place millet in a bowl, making sure it is completely dry. Place yogurt, parsley, allspice, mint and shaved grated chocolate in a blender and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,artichoke bottom,lime juice zest,onion,onion powder,lasagna noodle
title: Pizza Lettuce and Artichoke Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked lasagna noodles, cut into quarters | 2/3 cup onion, diced | 2/3 cup sliced canned artichoke bottoms | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 lime, juice and zest of, finely grated ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Bake lasagna noodles in hot oven until barely beginning to turn golden, about 8 minutes. Drain noodles and rinse with cool water. Drain. Set aside. In a large bowl, combine onion, artichoke bottoms, lime juice, onion powder, and onion powder. Add noodles and artichokes. Mix well. Place 1 tablespoon of noodles on the bottom of a sprayed 11 x 7 greased baking sheet and spread evenly. Top with 1/3 of the mixture.

title: Taco Filling
ingredients: 1/2 cup instant taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup dried parsley flakes | 2 teaspoons instant dried parsley flakes, for garnish
instructions: Mix the taco seasoning mix, parsley, and dried parsley flakes in a small bowl or plastic storage bag. Store in a tightly sealed container at room temperature for up to 8 days. Use in tacos, burritos, enchiladas, pico de gallo, etc.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,anise,horseradish,bread crumb,head garlic,flour tortilla,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Italian Grilled Deviled Garlic
ingredients: 1 jar roasted garlic, drained | 4 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 3 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon grated orange blossom water | 1 tablespoon freshly grated anise | 1 tablespoon white dry bread crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise | 3/4 cup dry bread crumbs for coating | 12 flour tortillas, or as needed
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Stir 3 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon horseradish, 3 tablespoons parmigiano reggiano, orange blossom water, anise, 1 tablespoon bread crumbs, and 1/4 teaspoon ground anise together in a bowl. Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon bread crumbs onto the prepared grill. Brush 2 to 6 flour tortillas with olive oil, and sprinkle on 1/4 teaspoon bread crumbs. Place 2 tortillas on the grilling surface, and cook for about 3 minutes per side. Repeat to make remaining tortillas. Repeat with remaining oil and flour tortillas. Repeat with remaining tortillas and grilling time. Cut each grilled grilled garlic into 6 wedges, and serve each wedge with a sprig of fresh flavored horseradish.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,garlic salt,garam masala,rye bread,white cheddar cheese,carrot,sesame oil,red chili pepper
title: Garlic Sesame Bread
ingredients: 1 english cucumber, cut into matchsticks | 1 carrot, sliced into matchsticks | 1 red chili pepper, diced | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 loaf rye bread | 1/2 cup shredded white cheddar cheese
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the cucumber, carrot, chili, garlic salt, garam masala and sesame oil. Seal and shake to mix. Place the rye bread onto a microwave safe plate and pour in the cucumber mixture and cheese.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,marshmallow creme,coriander,red pepper flake,caster sugar,cointreau liqueur,lime wedge,cream cheese
title: Creamy Coriander Mallow Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 125 g fresh cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 100 g marshmallow creme | 1/2 cup coriander | 1/3 cup sour cream ( low fat is fine ) | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon cointreau liqueur | cushed red pepper flakes ( to garnish )
instructions: Blend together the cream cheese, malt, marshmallow creme, coriander and sour cream until well combined. Add in the sugar, liqueur and crushed red pepper flakes. Stir well and refrigerate until required. Keep refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,parmigiano reggiano cheese,farfalle pasta,mango,artichoke heart,ra el hanout spice mix,saffron,egg
title: Farfalle and Pasquaise Salad With Mangoes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 4 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 12 ounces artichoke hearts, quartered | 1 large mango, cut into quarters | 1 -2 tablespoon saffron | 2 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 -3 eggs, hard boiled and peeled ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add pasta and cook for 15 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,browning sauce,rosemary,self rising flour,cranberry,dark soy sauce,lamb chop
title: Rosemary and Cranberry Lamb Chops
ingredients: 125 g self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon browning sauce | 1 tablespoon browning sauce | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 large spanish onion, finely chopped | 200 g cranberries, chopped coarsely | 800 g lamb chops
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180c. Place flour, browning sauce, dark soy sauce and dried rosemary in a bowl. Add onion to bowl and stir until coated in a little flour mix in marinated onion. Place lamb chops into a shallow glass or ceramic baking dish. Spoon seasoned onion mixture over chops. Bake uncovered for 40 - 45 minutes, turning occasionally until golden brown. Transfer to a stand, pour remaining marinade over and scatter with coarsely chopped cranberries before serving.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,tart apple,coriander powder,navy bean,cream celery soup,cumin,strawberry
title: Swiss Style Chard Casserole
ingredients: cooking spray | 12 ounces dry navy beans, rinsed well | 1 cup fresh strawberries or 1 cup frozen strawberries | 1 can cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon coriander powder | chopped fresh coriander leaves ( optional )
instructions: Coat a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray. Spread beans around the bottom of the dish. Slice strawberries in half and arrange around the beans. In a small bowl mix together the soup, cumin, and coriander. Add this mixture to the beans and strawberries and stir lightly. Add the remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,lipton onion soup mix,beef steak,oat,white wine,swiss chard
title: Baked Beef With Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 lb beef steak, cut in 2-inch cubes | 2 lbs swiss chard ( leaves, stems removed, chopped or chopped ) | 1 envelope lipton onion soup mix | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup quick-cooking rolled oats | 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Cook and stir beef and green onions in skillet until meat is browned and onion is clear. Stir in chard stems, onion soup mix, wine, oats and curry powder and stir well. Pour into 2 quart casserole. Cover tightly and bake at 350f for 1 - 2 hours or until tender.

Random Ingredients: red wine,catsup,cilantro,dark sesame oil,cocoa powder,lemon juice,adobo seasoning
title: Spanish Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons red wine | 1/4 cup cilantro | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: In blender place catsup, wine, cilantro, sesame oil, lemon juice, cocoa and adobo seasoning. Cover and blend on high for 1 minute. Pour into a jar with a tight lid. Keep refrigerated.

title: Pastel De Calabaza (Cauliflower and Nacho Cheese Taquitos)
ingredients: 1/2 large cauliflower, cooked and diced | 1 jicama, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 lb four cheese mexican, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb tortillas | 1/2 cup brandy
instructions: Cut all ingredients except for tortillas into 1 1/2 inch chunks and toss to coat evenly in a bowl. Set aside. Heat a large skillet on medium high heat. When it's hot, add four queso fresco and brown it for about 3 minutes. Take off the heat and set aside. Sprinkle entire bottom of a glass baking dish with a light coating of olive oil. Place one tortilla on the bottom of the dish, then add 1/3 of the cauliflower into the middle of the tortilla. Place one cheese cube over the top. Repeat with another tortilla, remaining cauliflower, and remaining cheese cubes. Pour brandy over all and heat for one minute or until cheese is completely melted, and pour over all. Set aside to rest for a few minutes, then cut into small pieces for garnish. Serve or refrigerate overnight to set.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,veal,baby carrot,self raising flour,red pepper,peanut oil,salmon fillet
title: Tarragon and Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 250 g boneless veal | 200 g baby carrots | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour | 1 small red pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon salted peanuts or 1 tablespoon cashews
instructions: Rinse the meat under the tap water. Cut into 4 3cm cubes and place the beef, carrots, oil & herbs in a large bowl. Toss lightly until well coated. Thread meat onto skewers using the beef and carrots. Brush skewers with oil. Cover and leave to marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Thread meat onto skewers reserving marinade. Grill or bbq skewers for 6 - 8 minutes per side. Serve.

title: Spicy Sushi
ingredients: 1 naan bread, cut into 3 inch squares | 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Preheat an oven to 475 degrees f. Mix the feta cheese, cajun seasoning, fenugreek seeds, and cayenne pepper together in a small bowl. Place 3 squares of bread onto a microwave safe plate.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,panko breadcrumb,active yeast,pomegranate molasses,pork sparerib,fava bean,sugar
title: Foul Mudammas (Fava Bean Bread)
ingredients: 2 2 lbs fava beans ( small green beans ) or 2 lbs dried pinto beans | 2 lbs country-style boneless pork spareribs, cut into 1 1/2-inch-wide strips | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons pomegranate molasses ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Place the beans in a large bowl and cover with cold water by 2 inches.

title: Ed's Spanish Rice Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup rice krispies | 1/2 cup diced red onion ( optional ) | 3/4 cup green olives | 1/4 cup finely chopped cilantro ( optional ) | 12 toothpicks | 1 cup red wine | 1/2 cup beer
instructions: Microwave all ingredients on high 1 minute or until they are thoroughly mixed. Toss the rice krispies, onion, olives and cilantro in a large bowl with the dry ingredients till coated with the marinating ingredients.

title: Cream Cheese-Filled Quesadillas
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, at room temp | cinnamon | cumin powder
instructions: In a mixing bowl, beat your cream cheese until smooth, then beat in a few teaspoons of ground cumin, cinnamon, and cumin until well blended. Heat a nonstick fry pan, or griddle over medium heat. Oil or spray the pan lightly, and generously coat your griddle with cooking spray. Using a 2 teaspoon biscuit scoop, fill each tortilla with about 1 teaspoon of the cream cheese mixture, top with a second tortilla, and lightly press the quesadillas into the bottom of the pan. When the quesadillas become golden brown on each side, flip them over for about 30 seconds. Remove quesadillas from pan and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,paprika,hard salami,lemon zest,grain mustard,onion,basil leaf
title: Mustard Bread
ingredients: 100 g self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons paprika, plus extra | paprika, for coating | 1 large onion, finely chopped | 12 hard salami, slices or 12 slices salami, slices thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf | 1/3 cup coarse grain mustard | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c or 200c if fan forced. Oil a 20cm x 30cm baking tin, lightly line base and side with baking parchment. Sift flour into large bowl, add 1 teaspoon paprika and toss to combine. Add half the onion, 2 slices thinly and half the salami or anchovies with remaining onions. Season well. Place flour, 1 tablespoon paprika and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a large bowl. Stir to combine. Add remaining onions, salami or anchovies and remaining paprika. Mix lightly until combined. Divide dough and ingredients among prepared tin. Bake for 40 minutes or until golden. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Serve warm or cool and freeze for up to 2 months.

title: Mixed Hot Chocolate (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles | 5 tablespoons soy sauce ( ketjap manis ) | 3 bananas, sliced ( optional ) | 10 ounces broccolini, chopped small | 6 whole red chilies | 1 tablespoon instant coffee, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon coffee, diluted with | 2 tablespoons soy sauce, diluted with
instructions: Boil water in a pot, and cook lasagna noodles for 3 to 3 1/2 minutes, or until soft. Rinse noodles with warm water and drain. Place in a bowl with 5 tbsp soy sauce, a few drops of ketjap manis, sliced bananas, broccolini, chiles and instant coffee dissolved in water. Mash together for about a minute. Pour into a plate. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp soy sauce if using it.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,crouton,leek,pesto sauce,canola oil,tomato juice,wheat bread crumb,ginger paste
title: Pesto-Stuffed French Onion Croûtons
ingredients: 1 large leek | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1/2 cup fresh bread crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Split leek lengthwise and trim ends. Wash leek thoroughly under running water and then slice into 1/3 inch thick rings. Heat canola oil in a 2 quart saucepan over medium low to medium heat. Add leek and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until very tender and soft. Turn heat down to low and stir cream of chicken soup, ginger paste and pesto into leek mixture. Simmer for 5 minutes. Stir tomato juice and stir into soup. Pour soup mixture into a 1 quart casserole. Arrange bread crumbs on top of soup mixture. Dot with additional bread crumbs. Pour liquid mixture over crumbs. Sprinkle with parsley and bake in preheated oven 35 to 40 minutes, until bread crumbs are browned and bubbly and soup is bubbling.

title: Wild Rice With Almonds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 cup wild rice | 1/2 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Prepare wild rice and stir to coat. Spray oil in a medium sauce pan, and place over medium high heat. Add the rice, and stir. Heat the rice until the rice has darkened color, then stir in the almonds. Remove from heat, cover, and let stand for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage link,vegetable oil cooking spray,sugar
title: Zesty Italian Turkey Sausage and Sweet Home Sweet
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian turkey sausage link ( removed from casing and crumbled or sliced ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Mix together the sausage meat with 1/2 teaspoons sugar in a bowl and form into a loaf. Lay out on a baking pan. Spray with vegetable oil. Bake at 400 degrees for about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and turn it out onto a serving platter. Heat the remaining 1/2 teaspoons sugar just until it caramelizes and the sugar begins to take on a caramel color. Slice the sausage as desired. Serve immediately. Tip. Try to caramelize the sugar in a skillet with the sliced sausages.

title: Peach Salsa
ingredients: 2 large ripe peaches | 2 cans frozen chopped spinach, thawed ( not drained ) | 10 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Place peaches, spinach, and ketchup in food processor or blender and puree to desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,sharp cheddar cheese,thai red curry paste,green creme de menthe,orange zest,ginger
title: Quick Thai Red Curry Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon fresh green creme de menthe | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange zest ( or lemon ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated fresh ginger ( or 1/4 tsp ground ginger ) | 1 cup shredded lettuce | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine, in a medium bowl, the curry paste, creme de menthe, orange zest, and ginger in a small bowl. Toss to coat. Place over medium heat in microwave safe bowl or serving dish. Microwave for 3 – 4 minutes. Toss well to coat. Remove bowl from microwave, place greens on an individual salad plate. Top with green salad. Sprinkle with cheese. Drizzle with curry sauce. Serve with hot chutney or sweet pickle slices. Variation, substitute dried fruits for curry base. Instead of grated cheese, you may use 1 cup grated carrot for a different flavor variation.

Random Ingredients: za'atar spice mix,lemon pepper seasoning,yeast,parmigiano reggiano cheese,herb
title: Za'atar Bread
ingredients: 1 envelope dried yeast | 1/4 cup fresh herbs, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried lemon pepper seasoning | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup za'atar spice mix
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in a cup of warm water. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well until smooth. Transfer the dough to a lightly greased bowl, and press into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350 degrees f for 60 minutes, or until a nice golden brown.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,salmon,soya sauce,lemon,cumin seed,fennel bulb,cardamom powder,avocado
title: Dum Ka Halwa
ingredients: 1 kg salmon ( skinless and boned, about 1 1/2 kg total weight ) | 1 fennel bulb | 1 lemon ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( or just cooking spray ie olive ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed ( or a little less ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder ( optional ) | 1 avocado
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into florets about 1/4 cup length. Slice the fronds from the lemon. Cut the fronds from the orange. Trim florets into about 1cm lengths. Cut the salmon crossways into small chunks of about 1cm. Toss the salmon chunks and fennel pieces together with lemon wedges in a large bowl.. Mix all other khalas ingredients together and pour over the salad. Refrigerate for a few hours. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Lebanese Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 bag shredded red cabbage | lemon wedge
instructions: Shave cabbage to remove excess water. Place in zipper bag. Add a lemon wedge.

title: Baileys Eggplant
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1/2 cup guacamole, to taste | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce, as needed to taste | 1 lemon leaf
instructions: Cut eggplant into cubes about 1 inch by 1/4 inch. Bake on a baking sheet with a brush of olive oil on both sides on low or medium high.

title: Homemade Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Combine chicken broth with marinara sauce in a large stockpot or dutch oven. Heat until chicken is floating. Add more marinara sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: mango,coconut,cooking spray,nonstick cooking spray,vegetable oil cooking spray,plum tomato
title: Quick Mango Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coconut, flaked coconut flakes | 3 tablespoons finely chopped seeded plum tomatoes | 1/2 large ripe mango, peeled, stoned, cut into long thin spears | cooking spray | nonstick cooking spray | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil, divided
instructions: Combine coconut, tomatoes, mango and 2 tbsp water in medium bowl. Toss gently to combine. Heat 1 t vegetable oil in non stick skillet. Cook about 2 minutes or until lightly browned. Add mango mixture.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,asparagus,lettuce leaf,seltzer water,prosciutto,green ginger,purpose flour
title: Faux Lettuce Wraps (Gourmet Magazine)
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, woody ends removed | 3 tablespoons unbleached all-purpose flour | 12 lettuce leaves ( or lettuce leaves ) | 12 slices thinly sliced prosciutto | 12 drops seltzer water | 1 ounce firm dark rum | 1/4 cup chopped green ginger
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Toss the asparagus with the flour to coat. Spread the sliced spears on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake for five to eight minutes or until crisp tender. Transfer the asparagus to a bowl and set aside. Place the lettuce leaves on a large serving platter. Top with the chopped prosciutto. Spoon the chopped asparagus onto the prosciutto, piling it onto the lettuce. Stir the dark rum, then drizzle over the guacamole. Sprinkle the ginger over the garnish. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: camembert cheese,milk chocolate chip,panko breadcrumb,apple,white flour
title: Breakfast Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk chocolate chips | 100 g camembert cheese, chopped | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons finely chopped apples
instructions: Prehat oven to 180°c put the chocolate chips in a bowl and mash. Put the cheese and flour in another bowl and beat with a fork, then add in the panko a little at a time. Add in the apple and stir until all it's in bits and pats are all mixed well. Make balls with your hands, about 5cm in diameter, then place on an oven tray. Cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until beginning to turn light tan in colour. Allow to cool. Cut into fingers using a plain knife.

title: Quick and Easy Chocolate Fondant
ingredients: 8 ounces unsweetened cocoa powder | 8 spring onions
instructions: Take a small pot that has a lid or two on the stovetop and start making up to two weeks ahead and set aside. In the pot place cocoa and onions in a heatproof bowl or bowl. If the cocoa is too hot you can substitute some of the cocoa with about two tablespoons of hot water. Pour mixture into the bowl with the cocoa and onions and stir in the rest. The mixture should have the thickness of real maple syrup. Serve immediately on your choice of foods. Store leftovers in the fridge for at least a couple of weeks. You may need to add a splash of cocoa to loosen after freezing.

title: Spaghetti Al Patate
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti squash | 1 tilapia fillet | 1 eggplant
instructions: Slice lengthwise. Scoop out pulp and discard skin. Boil spaghetti squash until fork tender. Remove from heat and drain. Meanwhile, combine fish through eggplant and mix well. Spoon 1/2 of mixture onto each noodle and serve.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,portabella mushroom,garlic powder,cilantro leaf,salt black pepper
title: Portabella Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1 lb portabella mushroom, sliced ( or other medium sized mushroom ) | 4 -5 leaves fresh cilantro leaves ( from 1/2 the cilantro stems ) | 1/2 cup mushroom-flavored pesto sauce ( or may use homemade pesto ) | 8 teaspoons distilled garlic powder ( or to taste ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In large bowl, toss together mushrooms, cilantro leaves, pesto sauce, garlic powder and salt and pepper to taste. Chill in refrigerator for a few hours before serving. My note, for a little kick add 1/2 to 1 tbls of red wine vinegar.

title: Scotch Chips
ingredients: 1 cup macaroni ( or plain flour ) | 1/8 cup plain flour, extra
instructions: Place macaroni dough and flour in a large mixing bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and leave in the fridge for 30 minutes. Place dough on your floured board, lightly flour your rolling pin, and roll to about 1/8 inch think. Cut each into 4 segments and press each piece into a chip shape. Heat a char grill over medium high heat until hot. Place the chips on the barbecue and bake for about 5 minutes or until golden. You may need to turn the chips over at half way through to cook through, depending on your oven.

title: German Green Grapes
ingredients: 4 bunches italian parsley | 1 bag green seedless grape
instructions: Rinse parsley well and trim off hard end. If they are large, cut small enough to be rolled. Put in large saucepan. Cover with water.

title: Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 beef roast ( about 7 pounds ) | 1 quart dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f place roast in oven and cook for 3 hours. Discard juice. Cool meat and cut it into 1/2 slices. Heat sherry over high heat, bring to boil and boil 1 minute. Add caraway and pour over the meat in a gravy boat. Wrap tightly with foil and place in refrigerator to marinate for four hours, turning every so often. To serve, drain off any excess fat before serving.

title: Crazy Mexican Corn
ingredients: 1 package frozen baby corn | 1 1/2 teaspoons bouillon | 6 whole dried green cardamom pods | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 cup salsa | 1/2 cup brandy
instructions: Place frozen, un thawed baby corn, bouillon, green cardamom pods, and creole seasoning in a saucepan. Cover, and simmer over medium low heat until heated though and flavors have melded, about 20 minutes. Heat salsa and brandy together in a skillet over medium low heat.

title: Easy Avocado Rice With Savory Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 1/4 cups vegetable broth or 1 1/4 cups chicken broth | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 small avocado, peeled, pitted, and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place rice, broth, soy sauce, and avocado in a roasting pan. Cover pan with foil, and bake 25 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: black bean,sultana,tomato soup mix,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pecan,bok choy,tea,white bean
title: Atole's Super Vegetarian Feijoada
ingredients: 1 can white beans | 1 can black beans | 1 can white beans | 1 can light tomato soup mix | 1 tablespoon sultana ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon pecans or 1 tablespoon walnuts, toasted ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated ( optional ) | 1 bunch bok choy, finely chopped, leaves sliced
instructions: Empty canned beans and canned beans into mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix to combine. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Basil Olives and Peppers
ingredients: 4 tablespoons green olives | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, washed, well, and ripped into thin strips | 1 large bell peppers or 2 large yellow bell peppers
instructions: Toast olives in your broiler. Spread on a large platter with a flat knife. Sprinkle all with garlic and parsley. Place bell peppers on top and broil for approximately 2 to 3 minutes. Sprinkle with salt and serve straight away.

title: Green Beans, Corn and Poblano Pepper Chicken
ingredients: 500 g cornflour | 600 g smoked chicken, chopped | 8 poblano chiles | 1 bunch green beans, trimmed
instructions: In food processor, blend half of cornflour with a little water and the chicken. Set aside. In a heavy fry pan, fry the poblano peppers over medium heat until they're tender. With slotted spoon, transfer to paper towels. Fry the beans in the same fry pan with the remaining cornflour. Add back in the green beans, lower heat and simmer about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,liquid smoke,onion soup mix,sunflower oil,bread crumb,coconut milk,lamb shoulder,popped popcorn
title: Creamy Italian Bonfire Roast
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 3 cups hot cooked aubergine ( cut in half lengthwise ) or 3 cups leftover aubergine ( cut in half lengthwise ) | 16 ounces low-fat coconut milk | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 3 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed of fat ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 2 1/2 cups bread crumbs ( or bread ) | 6 packages pepperoni, sliced about 3-inch thick
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat oil in frying pan. Sprinkle onion soup mix over the oil.

title: Spanish Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken thighs or 4 -6 chicken breasts | 1 1/2 cups white raisins or 1 1/2 cups golden raisins | 1/2 cup corn syrup, for caramelize ( i use light brown sugar ) | 1/2 cup instant espresso or 1/2 cup instant coffee | 1 tablespoon powdered espresso, liquer or 1 tablespoon instant coffee liqueur
instructions: Place the chicken, raisins, corn syrup and powdered coffee into a zip lock plastic bag and close. Refrigerate overnight. Remove the chicken from the bag and pat dry with absorbent paper. Place in your marinating dish or a heavy duty freezer bag and refrigerate for about 1/2 hour. Preheat your grill to high. Remove the chicken from the bag, place it between sheets of paper towels and pat dry. Sprinkle a touch of cinnamon and sugar on cut side of the chicken, and grill for about 8 to 10 minutes on each side. Toast sugar mixture and serve. Note, if you want to add some hot coffee to this, just take the rest from the pan, pour slowly in and mix to a paste.

title: Thai Egg-Lettuce Tarkari
ingredients: 3/4 ounce tamarind pulp | 1/2 ounce jumbo egg | 300 g mixed baby portugese mushrooms | 4 button mushrooms
instructions: Remove the stalks from the mushrooms and chop the caps into quarters about 2 or 3 inches long. Bring 2 cups of water to a boil and add the tamarind pulp and allow to brew to remove the husks and impurities. This could take several minutes or until softened then strain through a fine sieve, discarding the solids and pressing on the solids through a coarse sieve into a mixing bowl. Add the jumbo egg and mushrooms and stir well before adding them to the tamarind pulp. Refrigerate for at least an hour, best for a couple of hours and up to a day. When ready to serve, place four large lettuce cups on a flat surface that has turned upside down and lay a couple of the mushroom caps on it. Fill the cups with the filling and serve.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,egg yolk,hazelnut,pork shoulder,pea,italian bread
title: The Real Italian Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1-1/2 inch cubes | 2 eggs | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, ground toasted | 2 scotch bonnet peppers or 2 jalapeno peppers, finely diced | 3 tablespoons dry unsalted butter | 1 can sweet peas | 1/2 - 1 loaf italian bread, cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Season the pork well with salt and pepper. Beat the eggs with the ground hazelnuts, chilies and butter in a large bowl. Drain the pork well, and add all ingredients to bowl with eggs and hazelnuts and mix to moisten. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 325 and bake the pork for about two hours, or until the meat is falling off of the bones. When ready to serve, remove the pork pieces from the pan. Discard the bones or other unwanted pieces of meat. Remove meat from pan juices. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to simmer, and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 3 hours or more, until the meat is very tender and very thick. Turn off the heat. Cover the pan with a piece of aluminum foil to keep it warm. Serve over fresh bread cubes. Variation, substitute thinly sliced green onions or scallions for scallions in step for the chilies.

Random Ingredients: garlic bread,broth,tomato ketchup,corn oil,chuck,greek yogurt,couscous,red pepper
title: Mama Leone's Couscous With Beef & Yoghurt
ingredients: 1/2 kg chuck, sliced into thin round pieces ( or other steak ) | 2 tablespoons chopped roasted red peppers | 1 -2 slice garlic bread, cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 200 g greek yogurt ( or you can use lowfat, it is not gluten-free ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon tomato ketchup ( or salt free ) | chickpea broth | couscous, to serve
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, then quickly fry the chourico and red pepper until the chourico changes colour slightly. Remove the chourico from the pan and set aside to cool slightly. Tip into a bowl then add the yoghurt or yoghurt and mix thoroughly. Put back on the heat and add the cooked chourico mixture and stir until mixed well. Tip in the chillies, and continue to cook just long enough to heat through and soften up. Serve with steamed couscous, and a small bowl of hot water to soak the couscous.

title: Garden Bread
ingredients: 2 loaves sweet bread | 1/2 lb red onion, diced
instructions: Slice loaf of bread in 1/4 inch slices. Place sliced bread onto cookie sheets. Sprinkle onion slices on top of bread slices. Place 1/4 pound of diced red onion on top of onion slices. Bake in oven for approximately 20 minutes or until bread is brown. Cool on wire rack. Serve with your favourite vegetable toppings, such as, lettuce, tomato, hot sauce, etc.

title: Kale and Bread Pumpernickel Bake
ingredients: 2 large pumpernickel bread, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 cup fresh kale, washed and shredded | 1 1/2 cups 2 % low-fat milk | 3 tablespoons light-colored sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed ( optional )
instructions: Put bread slices in a greased 15 in. X 10 in. Microwave safe baking dish. Cover with kale. Coat with sesame oil. Microwave on high power level until bread is heated through, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: vodka,beer,european cucumber,watercress,basmati rice,bow tie pasta,active yeast
title: Beer and Cucumber Rissoni
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups beer | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm water | 1/2 cup uncooked basmati rice | 3 1/2 cups warm water | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 cup seedless seedless european cucumber, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 12 cups bow tie pasta, such as arugula, washed | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh basil
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine beer, yeast, and 1/2 cup warm water, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, let cool until lukewarm, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, bring remaining water to a boil. Stir in rice. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside. In a large bowl, stir together the yeast mixture, remaining 1/2 cup water, and vodka. Stir in cucumber, and let stand until yeast is foamy, about 5 minutes. Pour yeast mixture into the beer mixture, bring to a boil, and stir in basil. In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook bow ties until tender yet firm to the bite, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain. Pour cooked rice into a large bowl of boiling water. Stir in noodle mixture, toss, and serve.

title: Fish Dish
ingredients: 1/4 lb cod, cut into 4 serving pieces | 1 cup chopped peeled cabbage | 1 cup chopped pimento peppers | 1/2 cup sliced spring onion | 1/4 cup whipping cream, heated | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Marinate fish in remaining ingredients. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes. Serve with a dollop of butter.

title: Breadcrumb Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups rigatoni pasta or 2 cups ziti pasta ( about 9 ounces uncooked pasta ) | 4 cups fresh bread, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook rigatoni in very hot water until just underdone.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,dill,apple,cabbage leaf,vegetable protein,marjoram,dark soy sauce,yukon gold potato
title: Cabbage Rolls With Apples & Potatoes
ingredients: 1 medium russet potato | 1 medium yukon gold potato | 2 cups cabbage leaves | 2 cups mixed vegetables, washed and shredded ( such as parsnips, cauliflower, carrots, potatoes, broccoli or zucchini, or mix of any desired ) | 3 tablespoons dried marjoram | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 -3 teaspoons vegetable protein powder ( optional )
instructions: To prepare the dough recipe, peel and cut the potato into 1/4 inch rounds. Slice the potato into 1/4 inch thick slices on the horizontal. Cut the yukon gold potato in half, scoop out the center using a spoon or fork and chop into 1/4 inch cubes. Slice the cabbage leaves on the horizontal. Place all the vegetables in a large dutch oven that has been sprayed with pam. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Place the potatoes in the pan and cook over medium high heat for 15 - 20 minutes, covered, until just tender, stirring occasionally. Drain water and allow potatoes to cool. Place potato, yukon gold potato, cabbage leaves, marjoram and dill in a large bowl. Make a small slit in the top of each cabbage leaf to allow steam to escape. Fill in the centre with mashed potatoes and sprinkle with some soy sauce. Fold in the sides, then roll up tightly and pinch closed. Repeat with remaining rolls to make another package.

title: Quick and Easy White Beans and Fruit Dip
ingredients: 1 cup white beans, cooked | 1/2 cup cream of tartar | 1 banana, sliced
instructions: Combine the cooked beans with the cream of tartar and sliced banana and mix well.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,dark chocolate,white wine,penne pasta,pepper sauce,soy sauce,lemonade,irish cream
title: Cousin June's Irish Cream Penne Pasta
ingredients: 500 g dry penne pasta | 300 ml reduced-sodium soy sauce | 2 tablespoons orange juice or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 dash hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | 100 g dark chocolate | 1/2 cup sliced pimiento | 1/2 cup irish cream or 1/2 cup chocolate shavings ( optional )
instructions: Brown noodles in a large pot and drain. Heat wok or heavy pan, add soy sauce, orange juice and spices and stir fry 2 - 3 minutes until fragrant. Add chocolate and pimento into pan and add noodles. Sprinkle with shavings.

title: Mexicorn Lamb or Pork Coastal Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb ( cut into smaller portions, can be smaller, shoulder or chops ) | 1 can mexicorn | 1 packet adobo seasoning | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules ( or 1 small package ) | chopped pecans ( optional for garnish ) or walnuts ( optional for garnish )
instructions: In a dutch oven, layer the following, lamb, mexican, corn, seasonings/dripping, pecans, meat, and sauce. Cover and cook on medium low heat until lamb is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,romaine lettuce,chili oil,half,basmati rice,hoisin sauce,snow pea,manchego cheese
title: Chinese Rice Pudding Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1 cup hoisin sauce | 2/3 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 4 ounces manchego cheese, shredded | 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and dried | 1/2 lb fresh snow pea ( optional )
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Dressing, whisk hoisin sauce, half and half, and chile oil in a small bowl until blended. Cool. Just before serving, drizzle rice with a bit of dressing. Next, stir bread crumbs into rice until mixture turns a pale yellow color. Toss rice with monchego cheese and set aside. Line a 1 gallon casserole dish with a double layer of saran wrap secured with kitchen string. Rinse and drain lettuce and pea pods, and arrange on top of the casserole. Arrange manchego cheese in a circle in a circle around casserole dish, slightly overlapping, on top of lettuce. Scatter lettuce mixture over manchego cheese. Dinner, drizzle rice with a bit more dressing, and layer over manchego cheese. Cover with saran wrap, and refrigerate overnight.

title: Tropical Okra Casserole
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra, thawed | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 2 packages frozen pineapple chunks, thawed and drained | 3 packages instant espresso or 3 3/4 ounces strongly brewed tea | 2 packages crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup coarsely chopped pecorino cheese or 1 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Place okra in a buttered 13 in. X 9 in. X 2 in. Baking dish coated with cooking spray. Cover with water.

title: Grilled Chicken Burgers
ingredients: 8 hamburger buns | 2 1/2 cups chicken broth
instructions: If desired, you may slice some raw chicken meat and then combine all ingredients. Grill or broil to your liking. I prefer mine done.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,hot water,red pepper flake,graham cracker crumb,sirloin steak,white button mushroom,red chile
title: Sara's Cholent
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless sirloin steak, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices | 1 lb white button mushrooms, thinly sliced | 2 red chile, minced | 1/2 cup hot water | 1/4 cup fresh hot chicken stock or 1/4 cup hot chicken stock | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 cups crushed graham cracker crumbs | 1/3 cup finely chopped red pepper flakes
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the chicken, mushrooms, red chilies, hot water and stock. Mix well, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to 24 hours. Preheat the broiler. Remove the meat and vegetable mixture from the remaining marinade, reserving the liquid. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and add the crushed red pepper. Cook just until the fragrance of the crushed red pepper has been released. Add the crumbs and stir continuously until well combined. Dip each slice of meat in the seasoned crumbs and deep fry in a shallow pan for 2 to 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Seafood in the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 4 pounds shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 pounds kielbasa ( polish smoked sausage ), sliced | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 1/2 pounds sole fillets
instructions: Place shrimp, kielbasa, garlic salt, and shrimp in the bottom of a slow cooker. Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 12 to 14 hours.

title: Easy Beef Croquettes
ingredients: 1 package dry egg noodles | 2 eggs ( or as called for by your package ) | 6 tablespoons cornstarch ( i use arrowroot ) | 26 ounces vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick spray. Cook noodles until al dente, and cook to your liking. Drain noodles, and set aside. In a large bowl, beat eggs well, then stir in cornstarch until smooth. Add vodka to egg mixture, and mix well. Add drained noodles to egg mixture, and stir until well coated and noodles are coated with the sauce. Place noodles on baking sheet, and bake at 450°f for 10 - 15 minutes. You should have a thick, bubbling broth.

title: Mandarin Salsa
ingredients: 4 mandarin oranges, peeled halved and cut in half | 4 radishes, washed and thinly sliced | 1 carton mandarin orange carbonated lemon-lime beverage | 1/4 cup olive, sliced | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and chill in the refrigerator for an hour. Serve chilled in pita wedges.

title: Chicken With Leeks
ingredients: 1 large shallot ( or half a large ) | 1 frying chicken ( or half a large ) | 1 leek, washed washed, trimmed and sliced thickly | 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( or salad dressing ) | 1 container plain yogurt
instructions: Cut chicken into 5 or 6 pieces. Make sure to remove skin and bones as desired. Place chicken in microwaveable bowl, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high 4 or 5 minutes until chicken is done and no longer pink. While chicken is microwaving, wash the leek slice thinly with a vegetable peeler or use scissors to slice it on the diagnol. Remove the white part of the onion and finely chop it. When the breasts are done, chop them into small pieces. Set aside. Place a slice of leeks on the cutting board, slice off the green stalk, cut off any remaining green parts, and slice them thinly on the diagnol. The strips can be mixed together with mayonnaise and yogurt until desired consistency. Add mayonnaise and yogurt mixture to chicken in microwave and stir and turn on high for 30 seconds. If the mixture seems too thick, add water to mix. If it seems too thin, add water, and then turn off the cook and let mixture sit for about 5 or 10 minutes. Spoon on top of sliced chicken, or spread over salad or with a french bread. Let sit for about 15 to 20 minutes. You can serve this with vegetables, rice, or fried potatoes.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,lettuce,tuna water,basil leaf,grape tomato,balsamic vinegar
title: Tuna Salad II
ingredients: 16 grape tomatoes | 4 large basil leaves, chopped | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/8 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 can tuna in water, drained and flaked | 48 leaves lettuce
instructions: In an 8 x 8 inch baking dish, toss together tomatoes, basil, rum, vinegar and tuna. Arrange a few tomato slices over the top and serve.

title: Rollo Borracha (Drunken Rum Chicken)
ingredients: 5 lbs chicken thighs or 5 lbs chicken breasts | 1 lb frozen cut rhubarb | 4 cups dark rum | 2 1/2 tablespoons achiote paste | 2 tablespoons fenugreek seeds
instructions: Combine rum, achiote & fenugreek seeds in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and place in a food mill. Grind into a paste. Sprinkle over chicken pieces and marinate in remaining rum mixture overnight. Remove chicken pieces and keep warm. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with nonstick spray. Remove drumsticks from marinade, reserving marinade. Strip excess drumsticks from chicken and discard. Arrange chicken pieces on the prepared baking sheet. Bake the chicken 45 to 50 minutes or until no longer pink at the bone and the juices run clear when the thighs are pierced with a knife. Rest for 10 to 15 minutes before removing from the tray. Pour rum cooking juice around the chicken for a thicker sauce.

title: Jolian's Jalapeno Grilled Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 4 jalapeno peppers | 4 ounces capers | 4 skin-on salmon fillets
instructions: Cut the caps off the jalapeno peppers. Wash the salmon fillets well in cold water to clean the surface. Wash the jalapenos well in cold water to remove all of the sand and dirt. Lightly dry all around the outside of the salmon fillets by dropping them into a large resealable plastic bag. Squeeze the excess water out of the jalapeno pepper using your hands. Cut the peppers into large chunks, place them into a medium sized bowl along with the capers. Place the bowl with the jalapenos over medium heat in the microwave for about 2 minutes in an uncovered grill, until the jalapenos are a bit softened. The peppers will become juicy and the juice will begin to run clear. Pour the juice over the salmon fillets, allowing some moisture to drip off, then remove to a serving platter or platter and cover with plastic wrap. Let them marinate in the refrigerator for about 1/2 to 3/4 hour. Place the platter over a grill or wood burner on medium high heat. Place the salmon fillets on the grill and cook for about 5 minutes per side for medium rare, or about 7 minutes per side for well done. Allow time for the fish to rest before serving. Serve over cooked white rice.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,linguine,tabasco sauce,chicken bouillon cube,vermouth,lasagna noodle,oregano leaf
title: Pasta with Lemons & Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine or 8 ounces other short pasta | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup dry vermouth or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 3/4 cups clear honey | 1/2 cup chicken flavored clear honey ( such as ener-g ) | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 2 teaspoons other hot chili oil
instructions: In a large saucepan, boil the pasta until they are al dente. Drain them well and transfer to a large bowl. Dissolve the bouillon cube in the vermouth or white wine. Pour this over the pasta and toss to coat. Let stand another 5 minutes while you preheat the oven to 350°f toss some of the oregano into the pasta. In a small bowl, combine the honey with the tabasco sauce. When the pasta is ready, drain them well and toss them with the honey sauce. Spread the pasta in a 13x9 baking dish. Spoon the lemon onion garlic sauce over the pasta and smooth it with a spatula or small spoon. Sprinkle the oregano over the pasta and cover with the remaining sauce. Bake uncovered for 40 - 45 minutes or until the sauce is bubbling. Remove from oven and let stand covered for 10 minutes before serving..

title: Spinach and Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach leaves | 3/4 cup rice | 2 3/4 cups yogurt ( lactose free if desired ) | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur or 2 tablespoons orange-flavored liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon garlic granules ( or other herb ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Place spinach and rice into a colander in sink and remove all excess water. Toss well with remaining ingredients and serve.

title: Pasta with Cauliflower and Prunes
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1/3 cup oil | 10 ounces cauliflower, cut into small florets | 2 ounces reduced-fat feta cheese, crumbled | 2 1/2 ounces prunes, with pimentos, pitted and chopped | 2 teaspoons saffron threads
instructions: Cook linguine following the package directions, drain. Meanwhile heat 1/3 cup oil in a large nonstick skillet over moderate heat. Add cauliflower, sprinkle with salt, toss to coat, then saute until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Add 1/3 cup oil to skillet, then cook prune, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 1 - 3 minutes. Add saffron to oil, stir until fragrant, then add remaining oil, bring to a boil. Drain linguine. Add to skillet and toss to coat. Divide pasta among 8 dinner plates and spoon cauliflower mixture over.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,cumin powder,yellow pepper,streaky bacon,garlic clove,stew meat,red bean
title: Bean & Bacon Tagine
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red beans ( soaked overnight ) | 1 lb stew meat | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 6 slices streaky bacon, finely chopped | 2 cups golden raisins | 1 yellow pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients into a casserole or heavy bottomed saucepan. Cook gently 2 - 3 hours in a 325 degrees oven, until meat is tender.

title: Stir-Fried Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fresh asparagus | 1/2 green bell pepper | 1/3 cup golden raisins | 1/4 cup tamarind paste, or to taste
instructions: Trim the tips from asparagus stems. Slice the tips from 2 of the shrimp's worth.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,cool whip topping,water,gelatin powder,cardamom seed
title: Cardamom Pepper Cream
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups boiling water | 1 package unflavored gelatin powder | 1 container cool whip topping, thawed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place boiling water in a medium bowl. Sprinkle gelatin over cool whip, stirring until dissolved. Cool for 5 minutes. Stir in cardamom, red pepper flakes and cool whip mixture until well mixed. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Macaroni and Cheese With Parsley and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni ( preferably small tubular pasta ) | 1/2 lb macaroni ( or other tubular pasta ) | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add macaroni and stir to separate. Cook about 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Tortilla Triangles (Vegetarian Times)
ingredients: 100 g basmati rice | 1 large aubergine ( small ) | 1/4 bunch scallion | 60 g phyllo pastry ( see notes )
instructions: Clean and peel the aubergine, cut in half lengthways and thinly slice crossways. Soak the rice until it is soft with a little water, put aside and then crush it with the scallions. Preheat oven to 200c / 400f / gas lightly grease the trays and then lay out the strips of phyllo neatly across the trays so they overlap over the base and sides of the dish slightly. Cover with a damp tarp or greaseproof paper or clingfilm and put on the stove over a high heat so it starts to sizzle. It should soon come to the boil with a little water underneath. Take the phyllo, cut it into 3 - 6 strips and place one in the centre of each of the four short strips of phyllo. Fold the bottom right corner up over the x on the long side of the pastry to enclose it and then fold the next one in on top. Repeat until the pastry is gone. Then lay one piece on a work surface with the long strips, laying it in a horizontal line over the base and then using the tarp to make sure the strip is well covered. Fold the strips in half and lay them again in the same way, but on the long side. Fold the left and right strips over the long side and then the pastry. Do this to all four shorter strips, laying them just long enough to make sure the sides are covered with the pastry. Place the trays on top, cut a few slits in each sheet, brush the top layer lightly with a little water and then place the trays on top. Cook in the preheated oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden. Use a fork to pick up the strips and serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,tahini,beef,almond extract,red chile pepper,lamb,parsley leaf
title: Kofte Baidha (Sizzler)
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds lean ground lamb | 1 pound lean ground beef | 1/4 cup finely chopped dried red chile pepper | 1/2 cup very finely chopped parsley leaves | 3/4 cup tahini | 1 pinch saffron strand ( optional ) | 1 pinch instant dried lemon extract | 2 tablespoons freshly chopped almonds
instructions: Mix ground lamb through saffron strand, and refrigerate for 20 minutes. In a small bowl, stir together the tahini with a pinch of saffron powder and lemon extract. Fold in the ground beef and refrigerate for another 20 minutes. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Drop in the beef and cook for 10 minutes. Drain, and immediately toss in some of the cooked beef. Transfer to a serving plate, sprinkle with remaining almonds, and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Egg & Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic powder | 1 cup long grain rice | 1 cup diced cucumber ( fresh or canned will work just fine )
instructions: In a bowl, mix together egg substitute, rice, cucumber, garlic powder & salt and pepper to taste. Pour half of the mixture over the rice & cucumber & gently toss. Taste & adjust seasoning before serving.

title: Heirloom Tomato Bake
ingredients: 10 russet potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 cup soymilk | 1 - 1 1/2 cup diced russet potato | 1 - 1 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a 9 x 11 baking dish with cooking spray. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl until well combined. Pour into pan. Sprinkle with grated cheddar cheese. Bake 45 - 55 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,chinese wine,greek olive,sea scallop,onion powder,sherry wine vinegar,chicken breast fillet
title: Scallop and Chicken
ingredients: 300 g chicken breast fillets | 100 g good quality beef broth | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon chinese wine | 1 tablespoon olive | 4 greek olives, split in half
instructions: Cut the chicken into one inch size pieces. Mix all the ingredients together in a glass bowl, add the chicken pieces, mix well, cover and set aside for about 10 minutes. Put the olives on to skewers and broil until golden. Remove from the broiler and take off the charred skin, cut the chicken into two inch chunks and serve with the olive halves on top.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,baby onion,chili paste,stewing beef,raisin,artichoke heart
title: Beef With Artichokes
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, trimmed | 10 artichoke hearts, cooked | 1 can sliced raisins ( drained ) | 1 bunch baby onions, sliced | 2 -3 canned chipotle chiles, chipotles in adobo and chiles in adobo, drained and chopped finely | 1 tablespoon bottled chili paste with garlic | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled ginger
instructions: In large skillet over high heat, brown beef in oil.. Remove meat. Pour off fat. Add onion. Mix together, chiles, and garlic. Saute briefly, stir in onion mixture and chopped chilis. Stir. Return meat. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until meat is tender, approximately 1 hour. Stir in pickled ginger during the last 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,fruit,egg yolk,moisture part mozzarella cheese,flat leaf parsley
title: Stuffed Meatloaf
ingredients: 2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, minced | 2 ounces dried fruits, minced ( strawberries, cherries, peaches, peaches etc. ) | 1/2 lb shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f combine first 4 ingredients, adding salt& pepper. In a bowl mix meat with yolk. Shape meat into a loaf. Place loaf on a greased cookie sheet. Insert small toothpicks into top of loaf. Cover with foil and bake for 40 - 50 minutes depending on your oven. When done, remove toothpicks and top with cheese.

Random Ingredients: chile pepper,white truffle oil,vegetable oil,chicken,ice,ice water,phyllo pastry,chickpea
title: Spicy Chicken Samosas
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen white truffle oil or other oil-cured vegetable oil | 1/8 cup ice water | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 4 sheets frozen miniature phyllo pastry | 4 cups chicken, cooked, cut into slices to fit | 4 tablespoons white truffle oil or 4 tablespoons other oil | 1 cup fresh chile peppers ( seeded, deveined, and chopped ) or 1 cup minced red chilies ( seeded, deveined, and chopped ) | 1 cup fresh unsalted chicken fat or 1 cup fresh vegetable oil
instructions: Drain the frozen frozen white truffle oil/vegetable oil over high heat in a heavy saucepan, stirring frequently until it forms a golden brown liquid, about 8 minutes. Add ice water, bring to a full boil, and immediately reduce heat to medium. Stir in the drained chickpeas and 4 sheets of phyllo, coating the sheets. Set aside. Place 1 large piece of plastic wrap over the top of a small saucepan and place over medium heat. When the first phyllo sheet begins to puff, slide it with a palette knife. Sprinkle half the chilies with some sea salt and the second phyllo sheet. Sprinkle with salt and chilies. Place 1/16 th of the chicken in the center of the phyllo or plastic wrap covered phyllo sheet, leaving a 1/2 inch margin at edges. Add 1/4th of the chilies. Add 1/16th of the chickpea/chicken pieces, followed by more chilies. Dot the sheet with a scant 1 tablespoon of truffle oil. Layer another 1/16th of the chilies over the chickpea/chicken. Repeat layering with another 1/16th of the chickpea/chicken pieces, chilies, truffle oil, and finally, about 1 teaspoon vegetable oil. Cover the samosas with parchment paper and plastic wrap. Place the samosas on a wire rack placed over a rimmed baking sheet or pizza pan and let stand at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours. For the last 15 minutes, preheat oven to 425°f spread 1 tablespoon white truffle oil over samosas. Cook samosas 45 to 50 minutes, until golden brown and crisp on top. Remove from oven. Cut in half and serve warm.
