Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,chili pepper,butter,saffron strand,salad oil
title: Sweet, Sour & Nutty Black-Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 500 ml black-eyed peas, soaked overnight | 60 g butter | 5 saffron strands, soaked in | 60 ml salad oil | 1 tablespoon mild chili pepper, finely chopped ( or other chilli of your choice )
instructions: Place the soaked black eyed peas in a large bowl. Melt the butter in a small pan, add all the other ingredients and mix over low heat until butter is melted and mixture is smooth. Sprinkle over the saffron mixture & mix well. Let stand for 5 minutes to allow flavours to settle. Serve warm or at room temperature with crusty bread, or as the accompaniment to a meal.

title: Chicken Parmesan
ingredients: 1 cup fresh italian style breadcrumbs | 1 lb chicken, cut into 4 thick slices | 2 cans cheese of choice, grated | 1/4 cup finely chopped green capsicum
instructions: In shallow dish, combine all ingredients. Place chicken pieces on lightly greased pan. Stir to coat. Bake 425f for 15 - 18 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Serve with salad or pasta of your choice. Variation, use 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese for both cheeses and a slice of garlic herb bread instead of chicken.

Random Ingredients: chutney,rye bread,brown rice flour,mix,peanut,spinach leaf,angel hair pasta
title: Spinach and Rice Pancake (Firday Special)
ingredients: 500 g spinach leaves | 1/2 kg fresh spinach leaves ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons peanut | 1 tablespoon brown rice flour | 125 g rye bread ( thin slices ) | 3 tablespoons sweetened chutney | 90 g spreadable mix
instructions: Saute the chopped spinach, chopped chillies, and brown rice flour on medium heat in a frying pan. Add the bread slices on the pan and fry until just crispy. Spread the spreadable mix on the warm pancake. Place the whole thing on a plate. Top with the fresh spinach leaves and sweetened chutney.

title: Italian Plum Tomato & Potato Chips Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes, scrubbed and drained ( yukon gold ) | 1/4 cup sesame oil ( to taste ) | 1 1/4 lbs italian plum tomatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes into large pieces. Parboil potatoes until tender, in salted water, then drain. Dry potatoes completely to remove excess moisture. Toss potatoes with oil to coat, then chill until firm. Slice tomatoes into wedges, and toss with chilled tahini. Serve chilled.

title: Greek Carrots and Baby Carrots
ingredients: 3 lbs baby carrots | 1/4 - 1/3 cup olive oil | 1/4 - 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon greek oregano
instructions: Peel carrots, cutting in half or to a long diagonal. Using a very sharp knife, shave the carrot into strips about 8 inches long and 1/4 inch thick, producing nice thin strips about 4 inches long and 3 inches wide across. Heat oil and greek oregano together in a wide shallow skillet over medium high heat. When it starts smoking for about a minute or two, add carrots, tossing, and tossing lightly until carrots begin to brown lightly, about 2 - 3 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cooking wine,white pepper,active yeast,cooking tapioca,white hominy,maple syrup
title: White Posole
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups water or 4 1/2 cups beer | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/3 cup quick-cooking tapioca | 1/2 cup quick-cooking tapioca | 1/4 cup quick-cooking wine | 2 tablespoons maple syrup ( i use karo brand ) | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 can white hominy, drained and rinsed ( drained canned )
instructions: Dissolve yeast with 1/3 cup of the water in a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle tapioca, maple syrup, white pepper and white pepper over the yeast mixture. Stir until well combined and add remaining 3/4 cup of water. Cover bowl and let proof for 10 minutes. Pour into a large bowl with a lid, stir and let rise for 30 - 60 minutes, until very bubbly. Stir in drained canned hominy. Beat with electric mixer on low speed for a couple of minutes or until foamy.

title: Meringue Sauce
ingredients: 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 large egg yolk | 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 1/4 teaspoon rice vinegar
instructions: Chop the chili and jalapeno using a food processor or food chopper. Place all ingredients together in a small bowl and pulse until the mixture is smooth.

title: Quick and Easy Spicy Beans
ingredients: 1 bag frozen cooked cannellini beans | 1 jar sweet and spicy taco sauce | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( chili-pepper ) | shredded mexican blend cheese ( optional )
instructions: Boil canellini beans, drain & reserve the water. Toss the beans with the taco sauce, chili paste & cheese. Place a large non stick skillet over medium high heat, add the beans & simmer for 5 minutes turning occassionally. Serve hot.

title: Shir Sewain
ingredients: 1 package frozen flat rice noodles | 3/4 cup light flavored vodka | 1/2 cup brandy | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 1 tablespoon blanched almonds, toasted | 1 tablespoon dried pickled beetroots or 2 tablespoons chard
instructions: Place the noodles on a large plate. Place 3/4 cup vodka, brandy and capers in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil and reduce until very thin. Quickly stir in the blanched almonds. Place hot noodles in large bowl of ice. Pour hot vodka mixture over rice. Immediately, stir, taste and adjust the seasoning. Sprinkle on the beetroot and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: liver sausage,heavy whipping cream,cashew,mustard seed,chunky salsa,pear,cotija cheese
title: Creamy Chunky Sausage and Pear Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb liver sausage, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 lb fresh pear, peeled, cored, and cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1/3 cup cashews | 1/3 cup cotija cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 7 ounces chunky salsa ( homemade preferred... mexican if preferred ) or 7 ounces ranch dressing ( homemade preferred... mexican if preferred )
instructions: Cook sausage until brown. Add pear and cashews and cook until slightly browned. Remove sausage mixture from pan. In a blender or food processor, blend the cashews and cheese until finely chopped. Add the mustard seeds and cream. Blend. Add sausage mixture and salsa or ranch dressing. Blend for 1 minute. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. You might want to add 1 - 2 t. Water at the first time.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,pumpkin,pineapple chunk,cayenne,lamb stew meat,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Pumpkin Lamb Stew With Pineapple
ingredients: 1 lb lean lamb stew meat, cubed | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 lb pumpkin or 1 lb winter squash, peeled and cubed
instructions: In a large casserole, combine the lamb, tomato sauce, pineapple chunks, cheddar cheese, and cayenne. Cover and bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour. Add squash and cook for an additional 15 minutes in order to heat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,cayenne,cherry,strawberry,red wine,red chili,cherry tomato,roasting chicken
title: Cherry Chicken With Hot Strawberries
ingredients: 4 -5 boneless skinless roasting chickens | 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1 pint cherry tomatoes ( any size and they tend to be huge, depending on size ) or 1 pint berry ( any size and tend to be huge, depending on size ) | 1/2 pint red bell pepper ( or any white pepper, or any green pepper ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 red chili, chopped | 1 tablespoon crushed dried cherries | 1 teaspoon coarsely ground cayenne
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the chicken. Wash the cayenne pepper in boiling water, put it in a mortar with crushed red chile, and pound it to grind it a little coarse. Put the chicken in the fridge for about an hour to marinade. You might want to salt it for a while, so the seeds will blend in with the peppers. Put the cherry tomatoes, and tomatoes into a food processor or chopper fitted with a metal blade. I really like it a little chunky, so you can choose a size for you. You can also put it on your food processor, it lets the juices out evenly. You can chop it and mix it in a way you like it. Heat chicken up with juices in a heavy skillet.. If your family isn't big enough, you might want to cover the bottom of the pan with foil or some paper towels to blot them off. It helps keep them moist. Put a large skillet over medium and add the chicken, brown it for 15 to 20 minutes, and let it rest. While it's browning, start the sauce, stir everything up together. Add the cherries in with the juice, the wine, chili, and the cayenne. Simmer for about 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Place chicken back into pan, cover, and turn heat to low. Simmer the chicken until it's fall off the bone tender about 30 minutes. Check and stir the sauce every 15 or 20 minutes, stir a few times to make sure it doesn't stick to the bottom. There's lots of sauce at the end of the cooking process. I know people swear by that, but you just let it get a little thick.

title: Coconut Ham
ingredients: 1 pound lean ham, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup finely diced fresh jalapeno chile peppers | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk | 1 teaspoon prepared grainy mustard
instructions: Simmer the ham, jalapeno peppers, and coconut milk in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring often, for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to low while ham simmers, and blend in mustard to thicken. Continue to simmer until ham and vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pecan,sun tomato,taco sauce,garbanzo bean,white rice,iceberg lettuce,milk,paprika
title: Mexican Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cooked white rice | 2 cups milk | 3/4 cup finely chopped pecans | 1/2 cup finely chopped sun-dried tomato | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 5 tablespoons shredded iceberg lettuce | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh italian dressing ( i use kraft house italian blend ) | paprika
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Let cool slightly. In a large bowl, combine rice, milk, pecans, sun dried tomatos, taco sauce and lettuce. Toss well. Serve immediately.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 12 ounces beef tenderloin steaks | 8 ounces dried prune pieces | 3 teaspoons soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon ground nut
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the tenderloin steaks between two sheets of waxed paper and pound with a mallet to 1/4 thickness.

title: Gyu's Portuguese Potato Patties
ingredients: 1 teaspoon rice flour | 1 eggplant | 2 cans tuna, drained | 1 cup shredded pork or 1 cup chicken | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 3 dashes guacamole | green olives
instructions: Cut the eggplant in half and, using a spoon, scoop out the inner pulp. Place pulp in a large bowl. Break up the pulp and throw it all at once. Add tuna, green olives and worcestershire sauce. Mix together well to mix. Add the 1/2 cup of water you used to extract the pulp. Add the rice flour and mix well. Shape the mixture into 20 small patties 1 1/2 2 inches in diameter. Pan fry in a skillet or large fryer over medium heat until nicely browned on both sides. Serve hot.

title: Beef and Chestnut Toasts
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 1/4 lbs boneless beef sirloin, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 16 ounces chestnuts, drained | 5 slices rye bread, crusts removed | 1/2 cup finely chopped roasted peanuts, lightly toasted
instructions: In a large skillet, heat canola oil. Working in batches, add beef, chestnuts and bread.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,soy sauce,adobo sauce,lime,plain flour,black vinegar
title: Sweet and Sour Yellow Pickle
ingredients: 175 g plain flour | 75 g madras curry powder ( or use regular curry powder which has a very distinctive flavor ) | 60 -75 ml soy sauce | 60 -75 ml lime juice | 60 -75 ml freshly-squeezed adobo sauce ( or any other hot sauce ) | 1 teaspoon black vinegar
instructions: Start by combining the flour, curry and seasoning in a food processor and whiz to a crumb consistency. Add the liquid ingredients, or just the juice from half a lime. You should have a mixture that resembles breadcrumbs, but is quite dry. Turn onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic. Use immediately if you cannot find the sticky papery type of pickle. You may also use an electric mixer to do this. Allow to rest 30 minutes before use. For the pickle, place the pickle dough inside the bowl of your supermarket free of salt and margarine. If you cannot find, make a paste of this by grinding together a teaspoon full of margarine or butter, one teaspoon of mixed spices, or a few drops of sambal olek or hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,marinara sauce,shortcrust pastry,great northern bean,monterey jack cheddar cheese,red curry paste,red potato,part mozzarella cheese
title: Bean and Cheese Mini Pot Pies
ingredients: 2 red potatoes, cut in half | 1 can great northern beans, drained | 1/4 cup red curry paste | 2 tablespoons cotija cheese, crumbled | 1 large piece monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, finely shredded | 1 teaspoon shortcrust pastry | 2 tablespoons monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded | 2 tablespoons part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 1 ounce monterey jack and cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook potatoes in boiling water til tender. Drain. Remove from heat and mash with a potato masher. Stir in beans, curry paste, cheeses, and coconut to taste. Divide mixture among mini muffin cups. Spoon about 1/8 teaspoon marinara sauce in each cup. Bake about 30 min or until filling is hot and bubbling. Top each mini pie with mozzarella cheese. Makes 12 mini pot pies.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,nutmeg,monterey jack cheese,sauce,lamb shank,sesame oil,couscous
title: Lamb Shanks With Couscous
ingredients: 2 lamb shanks | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/2 cup couscous | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place prepared lamb shanks in an oven proof skillet. In small bowl, combine taco seasoning and ground nutmeg. Coat lamb shanks with taco seasoning mixture, then sprinkle with sesame oil. Bake in oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until cooked through. When chops are done, place couscous on a plate, and cover with boiling water. Fluff, cover and allow to steam for 5 minutes, then fluff by pouring hot water over couscous and fluffing well. Remove skillet from oven and sprinkle with shredded cheese. Serve over couscous.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,green lentil,crouton,jalapeno pepper,green olive,chili paste,bay leaf
title: Sambalaya Beans (Green Lentils)
ingredients: 1 cup dried puy green lentils | 1 can of drained green olives, halved | 1 jalapeno pepper, minced ( or a squirt of canned jalapeno pepper ) | 1/2 cup chopped onion ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 bay leaf | chili paste, to taste ( or cayenne pepper ) | freshly buttered crouton, to serve
instructions: Soak the lentils in 4 cups of cold water and soak for one hour. Soak the olives overnight. Drain the lentils, reserving just the water but keeping the liquid. Strain the liquid through a colander, removing any excess moisture. Put the lentils into a large pan and add the reserved soaking liquid. Add all remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes. Serve with toasted croutons.

title: Bolognese Meatball & Lentil Pasta
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 6 cherry tomatoes | 1 cup red lentil | 3 tablespoons capers ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil & brown the meatballs in batches. Add the lentils & cook over a moderate heat for approx 20 minutes. Add the capers & cook for a further 5 - 10 minutes or until well coated with fat. Serve over your favourite pasta.

title: The Best White Beans!
ingredients: 2 teaspoons pineapple preserves | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 2 cans white beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup mango chutney
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat, combine pineapple preserves with instant coffee powder. Cover and heat until heated through. Stir in the beans. Heat gently, about 3 minutes. Stir in mango chutney, and serve.

title: Beef and Sheep Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck sirloin steaks | 1 1/4 cups beef sirloin steak spice mixture
instructions: Make certain that the chuck is covered in spice and refrigerate it for at least 1 hour prior to cooking. Heat the grill to high, then place the meat on the grill and allow to cook until internal temperature reads 140 f about 5 - 8 minutes per side for medium rare. Remove meat from grill and allow to rest for 5 minutes, then slice across the grain into very thin slices, about 1/2 inch thick and 2 to 3 inches long. Serve over jasmine rice or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,turmeric powder,green chile serranos,onion,chicken breast meat,juniper berry,sea salt,sausage
title: Fawlty Towers of Kebabs
ingredients: 1 onion, finely chopped | 4 ounces smoked sausage, finely chopped | 1 green chile serrano, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves | 1 sprig fresh juniper berries | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 3 chicken breast meat, trimmed and coarsely cubed
instructions: In large bowl, gently stir together onion, sausage, chile, mint, juniper berries, turmeric and sea salt. Mix in chicken. Set aside for 15 minutes to allow flavors to blend.

title: Chole (A.K.a. Rice and Almonds) and Barley.
ingredients: 200 g pearl barley ( raw, not instant ) | 200 g masoor dal | 100 g rolled oats | 50 g slivered almonds
instructions: Wash, boil, dry and grind barley. Mix the oats in boiling water in a vessel, add barley. Mix the dal in a bowl. Drain the soaked barley. Fry until the water stops making lumps. Add oats, almonds, and 2 teaspoon milk mix to mix. Add barley mix to boiling water. Keep on stirring until the liquid is reduced and the mixture is thick like porridge.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,french bread,pepper flake,lite olive oil,coconut milk,green olive,red chile pepper
title: Coconut Chicken French Bread
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas | 4 pieces french bread | 1 cup coconut milk | 1 1/8 cups grated coconut-flavored cheese with dessicated coconut and chive | 1 tablespoon hot pepper flakes or 1 tablespoon salt | 1/2 cup minced fresh red chile pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place tortillas directly on oven rack in a single layer. Bake for 10 minutes, turn over, and bake for another 10 minutes. Remove from oven and spread each tortilla with about 3 tablespoons coconut milk. Sprinkle about 1/2 cup cheese over tortillas. Sprinkle with chives and hot pepper, if desired. Repeat process with another tortilla, a total of 10 slices cheese and paprika. Bake until cheese is melted and hot, about 2 to 3 minutes. Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sunflower-Asafetida Dip
ingredients: 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 14 bamboo skewers
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a small bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, cocoa powder, and asafoetida until smooth. Brush oil onto the bamboo skewers, and thread onto skewers. Broil until beginning to brown, and serve hot.

title: Tahini Cookies
ingredients: 3/4 cup tahini | 2/3 cup coarsely sifted all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir tahini into flour until well blended and dough is smooth. Transfer the dough to a floured surface. Knead lightly for about 10 minutes. Shape the dough into balls and press them flat with a floured teaspoon onto lightly oiled cookie sheets. Bake for 12 minutes, or until just barely beginning to colour.

title: Oysters With Portobello Sauce
ingredients: 1 can of medium oysters in ketchup, undrained | 1/2 cup tomato ketchup | 1 tart shell, such as a mini shell, such as a mini pie shell
instructions: Stir the oysters with the ketchup and tomato ketchup in a saucepan. Heat and serve with the mini shell.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,green tomato,cumin seed,pork shoulder,fire tomato
title: Mexican Pork
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder, lean | 1 1/2 lbs fresh green tomatoes | 4 ounces fire-roasted tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 32 ounces can mexican-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: Slice pork crosswise into pieces about 1/2 thick. Place in pot, add water to cover, bring to boil. Skim foam from top. Cover.

Random Ingredients: gingersnap,onion powder,cocoa,black bean,sage,simple syrup,balsamic vinegar,green olive
title: Black Bean and Ginger Dip
ingredients: 2 boxes gingersnaps, crushed | 2 cups onions, chopped | 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup cocoa | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Place the gingersnaps in a large, deep frying pan and place over medium high heat. The cookies will spread so watch and mix with fingers or a metal spoon until they release a bead of liquid on them. When they have cooled slightly, stir in the onions, beans, cocoa, vinegar, syrup, ginger and sage. Mix well and store in refrigerator. You can also just eat them plain or serve them with dumplings or toast.

title: Mushroom-Olive Toasties
ingredients: 100 g mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon spring onion, chopped | 125 g pitted green olives, halved | 1/4 cup mixed fresh herbs, chopped ( e.g. parsley, thyme, savory ) | 4 hoagie rolls, open
instructions: Preheat panini grill or grill pan. Toss mushrooms, spring onion and olives with herbs. Spread mushrooms mixture over rolls and toast for 2 - 3 mins. Turn and toast other side. Cut into 1 pieces.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,italian parsley,polenta,celery salt,lettuce leaf,spinach leaf
title: Polenta Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup coarsely grated dark chocolate | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/4 cup chopped fresh celery salt | 1 cup packed fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup packed shredded lettuce leaves | 1 1/2 cups instant polenta
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the chocolate, parsley, celery salt, spinach and shredded lettuce until well combined. Transfer to a 1 1/2 quart glass baking dish. Spread the polenta out into an even layer, and bake for one hour, stirring occasionally, until golden. Cool, then store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,lipton onion soup mix,sherry wine,swiss cheese,cream mushroom soup
title: Swiss Cheese and Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages egg noodles, cooked and drained | 3/4 cup swiss cheese, grated | 2 packets lipton onion soup mix | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon sherry wine, divided
instructions: Stir together the egg noodles, grated swiss cheese, and lipton soup mix. Stir in soup and 1/2 the sherry. Pour mixture into a 9 x 12 baking dish. Cover with foil and bake at 350°f for 45 to 55 minutes. Remove foil, sprinkle with remaining sherry and serve.

title: Delicious Rice Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1 head cauliflower, cut into small florets | 2 cups uncooked fluted whole-rice | 1 clove garlic, pressed | 3 lemons, sliced | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: To make the salad dressing, mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Toss with rice. Cover and refrigerate until chilled.

Random Ingredients: natural yoghurt,red wine,chili,apple cider,white bean,chicken breast half
title: BBQ Chicken White Bean Chili
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves ( bone-in or boneless ) | 2 cans white beans ( white beans ) | 1 medium chili | 2 tablespoons natural yoghurt | 2/3 cup red wine | 1 tablespoon apple cider
instructions: Mix up the chicken breast halves into a crockpot. Empty two cans of white beans in that a small piece of apple cider is placed on top. If your crockpot is low on your burner, you'll probably not need to add much water. Cover the crockpot and let it cook for at least 8 - 10 hours. After you're going low on the beans and chicken, remove the chicken from the crockpot and shred the chicken into whatever size chunks you have access. Use this to cook your chili in if necessary. Mix yoghurt, red wine, chili, and apple cider all together in a bowl. Once shredded chicken is finished, mix it all back into the pot and turn on high until you see the chili bubble. Turn down the heat to low and let it cook for 2 - 4 hours or until chicken shreds easily. Serve over white rice with a side of your favorite fresh vegetables.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 16 lime wedges
instructions: In a small bowl, mix oil, bouillon and marjoram. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat until it shimmers, then stir in lime juice. Pour in bouillon mixture and simmer, stirring frequently, 15 minutes. Add enough to coat the chicken well and cook, turning once, approximately 15 minutes more.

title: Slow-Cooked Polish Baguels
ingredients: 24 small bagels | 1/2 cup finely shredded red cabbage | 15 -20 soft ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups fat-free liquid smoke | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place bagels in bottom of slow cooker. Cover with cabbage.

title: Faux Pearl Japanese Lentil Rings
ingredients: 2 large egg whites | 1 1/2 cups dried lentils | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 chicken bouillon cubes or 1 1/2 chicken broth cubes | 3/4 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine or mirin ) | 1/3 cup currants or 1/3 cup raisins ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the lentils, following the package directions, in a pot cover with water. If using bouillon add to the pot at about 10 minutes before the end of simmering time. When the lentils are close to being done drain and run under cold running water. Drain and put through a strainer, using the back of a table spoon, then beat the egg whites until very stiff. Set aside to dry. Add the flour, stock, and miso paste to the egg whites, whisking constantly. Place a large serving platter in the center of the platter or invert over the platter. Spoon the batter over the platter or invert into a plate. Garnish with currants or raisins, if using, and serve. Variation, this recipe can also be halved and sprinkled with sliced carrot. Note,. Prep for frying will take a while for the lentils and sauce to set as a sauce. Also, instead of the flour you can use corn starch, baking powder, etc.

title: Heirloom Tomato Heirloom Tomato Salad
ingredients: 3 heirloom tomatoes, sliced thin lengthwise | 2 tablespoons greek oregano, dried
instructions: Arrange slices of tomato in a nonstick, shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with oregano. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes, or until hot.

title: Cheese Tart Without Oil
ingredients: 4 teaspoons pure orange zest | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1/4 teaspoon gruyere cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons walnuts, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f using a pastry brush, lightly brush edges of tart shells. In a small bowl, combine the orange zest, cayenne, gruyere and walnuts. Using a rubber spatula, spread 1 tablespoon of the zest mixture on each tart shell. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until puffed and fragrant. Serve warm.

title: Jalapeno Whole Wheat  Cheese Batter for Pasta
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons feta cheese | 1 jalapeno | 1/3 cup cheese, chopped, i use a combination of cheddar and monterey jack, depending on how much cheese you like
instructions: Preheat oven to mix all ingredients together in food processor, pulsing several times. Scoop into a medium baking dish, sprinkle top with jalapeno seeds. Bake at 375 for 12 minutes, or until tops are golden brown, slightly crispy.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,wine,lamb,pizza crust,currant,green olive,red onion,salt black pepper
title: Greek Lamb Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup dry red onion, chopped | 1 cup canned pizza dough, unbaked | 2 -3 lbs ground lamb | 1 cup fresh currants or 1 cup raisins | 1 cup fresh roma tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup green olives, sliced | 2 1/2 cups wine ( or tomato juice ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Add the onion to a small skillet and sauté until tender. Drain and add to the ground lamb along with currents, tomatoes and olives. Cook over medium heat, breaking up the currants and roma tomatoes. Cook 20 minutes. Turn the mixture into a 9 x 13 pan that has been lined with parchment or lightly oiled. Cut two slits in the top of the crust and brush with the butter. Cover with pizza topping. Bake at 375°f 50 - 60 minutes or until top is browned and crust is crisp.

title: Zucchini & Honey Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 bunch ear corn ( i use about 3-4 ears of corn in my shaker ) | 4 whole zucchini | 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: If you have large ears of corn, cut off the top and discard. Wash the corn then rinse under cold water until the water runs clear. Slice the corn lengthwise. Cut off the cob and tear the kernels off the cob. Using a sharp knife cut the kernels from the cob into fine julienne. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil then remove from the heat. Add the corn and the zucchini and cook 1 - 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain. Warm a non stick frying pan over a high heat for about 30 seconds then add the chili oil. When the oil is hot, add the honey to coat. Take the corn mixture off the heat then stir in the corn. Cover the frying pan and leave to come to a boil. Stir every now and then. Keep stirring until the zucchini is cooked all the way through. Tip, if not using corn, you may also just sprinkle water over this if the corn is cold. Taste test from time to time and add some salt if necessary.

title: Spicy Corn Side Dish
ingredients: 1 can corn | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons serrano chilies
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f drain corn, reserving liquid. Place corn in greased 2 1/2 or 3qt. Shallow baking dish with enough liquid from the can to coat the bottom. Sprinkle vinegar over corn. Heat chilies without cleaning, over medium heat untill hot browned. Scatter with reserved corn liquid. Bake uncovered 35 - 40 minutes or until liquid has thickened and corn is hot. Serve warm or chilled. Note, to prevent scorching, remove from oven. In small saucepan, heat reserved liquid, stirring over medium low heat 2 minutes. Pour over corn and serve warm, garnish with a few pieces of chiles for garnish.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,red cabbage,spring onion,pecan,turmeric powder,parsnip,yellow onion,anchovy fillet
title: Czech Cabbage and Parsnip Salad
ingredients: 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 2 parsnips, chopped | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 5 anchovy fillets, minced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh horseradish | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 12 finely sliced spring onions | 1/3 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Mix togther and chill. Place the cucumbers, parsnips, onion, anchovies and horseradish in a salad bowl. Combine well. Just before serving, mix together the ground turmeric, spring onions and pecans, tossing well. Serve immediately.

title: Cheese Stuffed Beans
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup cheese food | 2 tablespoons passives fruit | 2 tablespoons celery, finely chopped | 8 -10 slices pepperoni, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Combine beans, cheese, pestles and passion fruit in a bowl. Cut edge from side of each cannellini bean and gently spoon into bean hollow. Sprinkle inside with pepperoni and return to oven for about 30 minutes or until heated through. Serve with toast.

title: Sweet and Sour Eggplant (Aubergine) and Parsnip Kugel
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1 parsnip | 1 small red chili pepper | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | 4 tablespoons channa dal | 2 sheets rice noodles
instructions: Cut eggplant and parsnip into 5mm slices. Slice the chili finely. Wash the channa dal. Put it in a microwave in a bowl with 2 cups water. Sprinkle 2 tsp of red chili pepper on it. Cover with cling film and microwave in high for 6 - 6 minutes. Mix eggplant and parsnip into a large bowl with the channa dal, the chilli and salt to taste. Arrange eggplant mixture on a serving platter. Serve with rice noodles.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,parmesan cheese,chili pepper flake,lamb,ra el hanout spice mix,cardamom seed,onion soup mix,onion
title: Lamb Kebabs in Creamy Rasam(Shami Kabab)
ingredients: 1 medium onion, finely minced | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 -2 tablespoon onion soup mix ( not korma ) | 2/3 cup heavy cream, lightly warmed | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground numero chili pepper and fresh chili pepper flakes ( to taste, not tabasco ) | 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese, finely grated ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed
instructions: Combine the onions, ras el hanout, onion soup mix, cream, chili peppers, pepper flakes and parmesan cheese in a large zip top bag. Shake to mix well. Place in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Preheat your broiler or grill. Thread onto skewers, alternating with a small amount of onions, or as desired. Place skewers on a plate, cover them with plastic wrap, and place in the freezer for 30 minutes or longer to solidify. To make rasam sauce, heat a small non stick frying pan over medium heat.

title: Vegetarian Faux Pimento and Peanuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup green lentils or 1/2 cup green brown lentils | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup sliced almonds or 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 1/4 cup chopped pimento stuffed olive | pimento stuffed olive, sliced thinly ( optional ) | slivered almonds, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pimentos and olives in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low, setting just below low setting for 8 hours. Stir in pimentos and olives. Let stand 10 minutes before serving, or serve right away, stirring in almonds at the table.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,chicken bouillon cube,white bean,white mushroom,italian bread,sharp white cheddar cheese,mutton,chicken stock
title: American Loaded Rissoles (Aussie Style)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons low-sodium instant chicken bouillon cubes | 1 lb ground mutton | 1/2 cup cooked rice noodles | 2 cups white beans, canned or 2 cups brown beans, drained | 1 cup leftover cooked white mushroom, cleaned and sliced | 3 cups chicken stock | 2 cups of grated sharp white cheddar cheese | 3 slices of crusty italian bread
instructions: In a medium pot, dissolve the instant chicken bouillon in 2 cups water. Add the mutton and cook until browned. Then drain. In a large bowl, add the drained beans, drained white mushrooms and the chicken stock. Mix together well, add the cooked mutton mixture and mix well. Set aside 20 minutes. Divide the mixture into six equal parts and shape into patties. Place on a pan in one layer and place under a low heat. After 10 minutes, add the parmesan cheese, stir well and continue cooking until the cheese is melted. Meanwhile, pre heat the grill to medium. Remove the patties from the pan with a slotted spoon, and set aside. Add a little smoke to the pan and when the cheese is slightly melted throw in the patties. Cook for a minute or two on each side. Remove and set aside. Add the rest of the pan on the heat and brown the rissoles, coating each side with the hot sauce.

title: Nana's Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and cut in halves | 1 packet dry dry onion soup mix
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the egg halves on a cookie sheet or baking pan. Sprinkle the soup mix over all of the eggs and then cover with foil. Bake for 45 minutes, turn and bake another 15 minutes, or until the tops are puffed up and browned. Cool and slice in pieces.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,wine,pork rib,half,apple juice,tomato green chilies
title: Braised Pork Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs pork ribs, with bone and extra fat on bottom of the pan | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can tomato and apple juice, with juices | 1 cup beef stock or 1 cup wine | 1 3/4 cups half-and-half or 1 3/4 cups milk | 2 teaspoons low sodium soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f cut several slits in the rind and stuff the slits with the tomatoes. Insert a small piece of meat thermometer so they reach between the bone and bone 1 1/2 inches below the bone. Place the fat side up in the roasting pan. If there are any spaces between the meat and fat, insert slits. Pour the liquid ingredients into the roasting pan. Place the pan in the oven and roast until the fat turns dark brown or a thermometer inserted in the center reads 160 f. About 1 1/4 hours. Remove pan from oven. Transfer ribs to a warm platter and let stand at room temperature for about 30 minutes. Pour off fat from pan. Skimming off fat. If remaining juices do not cover the meat, cover pan tightly and return to oven. Bring liquid to a boil, stirring to scrape up any browned bits. Pour over ribs and let stand 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,lime wedge,grain white rice,golden syrup,beef
title: Dee's® Famous Steakhouse-Style Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 package long grain white rice ( not instant ) | 1 corned beef sirloin steak cut into 4 strips | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 bottle 100 % lime wedges | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt, or to taste
instructions: Place the rice into a bowl with enough water to cover, and soak, for at least 1 hour. Wash the corned beef slices in a colander if necessary. Set aside. Heat the golden syrup in a large skillet over medium heat, and set aside. Cut the meat into small slices using a knife or cleaver. Place in the hot syrup, and continue cooking to brown meat on each side. When the rice has soaked, add the shredded corned beef. Drain excess juice. Stir in the seasoned salt, mix thoroughly, and continue cooking over low heat until heated through.

title: Oven Sherried Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 shoulder lamb chops ( about 3-1/2-3 inches thick ) | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Spray a 12 inch ovenproof skillet with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl, toss the lamb chops with the grand marnier. Transfer the lamb to the prepared pan and bake in the preheated oven until a meat thermometer registers 145 degrees f for medium rare, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,sandwich bun hamburger,beef chuck,pie crust,squash
title: Beef-On-A-Thin Burgers With Sweet-Sour
ingredients: 1/2 cup water-packed chestnuts or 1/2 cup canned chestnuts, drained | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced fresh sweet sopress or 2 tablespoons scallion tops | 2 tablespoons finely shredded beef chuck | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced squash | 1 package refrigerated pie crusts, partially thawed | 6 sandwich buns, each beef, pepper jack, cheddar or other hot and spicy hamburger bun
instructions: Drain chestnuts or chestnuts in a large bowl, pressing in the can of water to get all the liquid out. Slice each slice into six thin rounds, and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients except 1 crust. Spray a large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray over medium heat. Add prepared meat and cook, stirring often, until browned. Spoon into prebaked pie crusts. Sprinkle with reserved chestnut mixture. Cover, and bake at 400° for 40 minutes, or until golden. Uncover and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until crusts are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,corn kernel,pork fillet,sea scallop,beef stock,polenta,dark rum,mustard seed
title: Scotch Polenta (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 10)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 750 g pork fillets, cut into thin strips | 600 g corn kernels, cut into 3 cm lengths | 1 cup reduced beef stock | 4 tablespoons dark rum | 1 1/2 cups polenta | 4 mint leaves, extra | 1 1/4 cups shaved polenta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°c toast the mustard seeds in a dry frying pan, until fragrant, 1 - 2 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon, and place in a bowl. Add the pork strips, corn, and stock to the pan.

title: Mushroom Toast
ingredients: 12 -15 white mushrooms, cleaned | 1/2 cup almond milk | 4 slices bread
instructions: Poke holes all over the surface of the mushrooms with a fork. Mix the almond milk with a little water in a shallow dish for the sauce. Heat a pan with butter in it. Put the mushroom on half the slices of bread and cover it with the other half of the bread. Cook it on medium low heat for 8 - 10 minutes. Serve it with a dollop of cream.

title: Sauerkraut and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 package capellini | 10 shucked black mushrooms | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon grated fresh lemon zest | 3 tablespoons minced roasted peanuts | 8 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 8 sauerkraut - drained
instructions: Cook pasta according to pkg. Directions. Meanwhile, heat honey, lemon zest, lemon zest, black pepper and mushrooms. In a separate shallow dish, arrange the prosciutto so that it hangs over one edge of the dish, then place the bacon on the bacon and fry until crisp. Drain pasta. Place drained pasta, sauerkraut and peanuts on a platter.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,onion,white miso,active yeast,yellow cornmeal,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cheddar cheese
title: Indian Street Cheese Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal, coarsely chopped | 1 ounce active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups white miso | 1/2 cup grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese, such as cheddar, plus more for topping | 1 large onion, sliced thin | 10 fresh curry leaves
instructions: Sprinkle the cornmeal on the counter and in a large bowl mix the cornmeal, yeast and miso with the grated cheese. Add the onion slices. In a separate large pot, bring water to a boil and add the curry leaves, a pinch of salt and about 2 tbsp of the cornmeal mixture. Remove the cornmeal mixture from the heat. Gradually stir the warm water into the cornmeal mixture, whisking continuously with a wooden spoon until thick and creamy. Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth, about 4 minutes. Place the dough into an oiled, floured bowl and turn the top over to grease the top. Cover with a tea towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1/2 hour. Punch down and knead briefly. Form into 2 loaves that are about 2½ inches in diameter. Place on a sprayed, rimmed baking sheet and place in a large, warm room. Brush the tops with olive oil and sprinkle with cheese. Place the baking sheet in a 425f degree oven and bake until well browned, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic,taco sauce,golden syrup,yellow bell pepper,onion salt,pico de gallo,lemon zest,puff pastry
title: Mexican Pepper Pie
ingredients: 1 puff pastry sheets ( frozen or thawed ) | paprika or cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons garlic, minced | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon onion salt | 1/2 tablespoon taco sauce | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 lemon, zest of
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray an 8 inch pie pan with nonstick spray and set aside. Toss the garlic with the pinch of paprika or cayenne and cook in a nonstick skillet for 2 minutes to flavor. Add the pepper and onion salt and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until peppers have released their liquid and begin to soften. Add taco sauce and mix well. Remove from heat and cool until warm but not hot, about 5 minutes or so. Stir in the zest in and divide evenly among pastry sheets. Roll the pastries out on a lightly floured work surface until about 1/4 inch thick. Prick the bottom of the pie several times with a fork and bake in the centre of preheated oven for about 10 minutes, or until pastry is puffed and golden. Transfer to a rack to cool. Cut into wedges.

title: Apple Spiced Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 2 lbs apples, peeled, cored and cut into 1/2-inch-thick chunks | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/2 teaspoon apple pie spice, blend ( or other spice mix in powder ) | 1/4 cup applesauce or 1/4 cup apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment. Place apples, anchovy paste, and apple pie spice blend in bowl of a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl and stir in apple or apple juice until thoroughly combined. Spread apple mixture evenly over dish to within 2 inches of top. Bake for 55 minutes or according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,feta cheese,taco sauce,rice,butter margarine,tea,lettuce,sun tomato oil
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups leftover cooked rice ( leftover leftover from recipe # 2 to make rice and serve as directed in the recipe, 2 cups leftover leftover cooked rice from recipe # 2 to make rice burritos or 2 to serve as directed in the recipe ) | 1 tablespoon butter or margarine | 1/2 cup mushroom ( optional ) | 1/2 can bamboo shoots, drained ( optional ) or ( 5 ounce ) can red bell peppers, drained and chopped ( optional ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups shredded or diced hot dogs ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded feta cheese | 24 small taco sauce, warmed ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | shredded lettuce, for garnish
instructions: Place 1/2 cup leftover rice or leftover cooked rice, melted butter, mushroom, and optional ingredients of choice in a bowl. Stir to mix. Place 1 - 2 tbsp taco sauce on a platter. Place 1 - 3 cup rice on the platter and top with 1 - 2 tbsp of taco sauce. Repeat with remaining ingredients and garnish with shredded lettuce.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,coriander seed,champagne,tomato paste,olive oil,cooking oil
title: Mushrooms, Tomato and Olive Oil Marinade for Burgers or Chicken
ingredients: 300 g shiitake mushrooms, cleaned, caps intact, sliced | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | cooking oil | 1 cup dry champagne
instructions: Place mussels or mussels in a large heatproof bowl. Add enough cooking oil to just cover the top of the mushrooms. Sprinkle with seasoning and crush coriander seeds using mortar and pestle. Pour over mushrooms and stir to coat. Cover and marinate in the fridge for 1 hour or overnight. Remove the mussels or mussels from the marinade. Pat dry. Cook mussels or mussels in a dry pan for 1 minute, shaking the pan, shaking the mussels or mussels for about 1 minute or until golden and the shells are open. Place mussels or mussels aside, uncovered, for 5 minutes or until they open slightly. Turn them over, then cook each side for about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. To serve, lift out of pan and place on serving plate. Place remaining oil in a frying pan, add mushroom caps and brown for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in tomato paste.

title: Beef and Linguine
ingredients: 1 package uncooked linguine | beef bouillon, for seasoning
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the linguine, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Toss the pasta with enough beef bouillon to moisten pasta.

title: Agua De Quingo
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup epazote | 4 cups hot coffee or 4 cups hot water | 3 green tea leaves or 2 teaspoons instant coffee crystals
instructions: Thoroughly wash the epazote with cold water. Place in large bowl and sprinkle with the coffee and some of the epazote. Cover and let set for 2 hours. Remove from refrigerator and let set for a few minutes. To serve, stir and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,cider vinegar,cod,red wine vinegar,cinnamon,yellow pea,italian seasoning
title: Mediterranean Cod (Or Broiled) Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs red snapper or 2 lbs cod, cubed | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 cup yellow split peas | 1 head cauliflower, cut into pieces ( approx., steamed or boiled )
instructions: Mix together all of the ingredients except the steamed or boiled cauliflower. Serve on romaine lettuce lined platters.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,margarine,currant,lemon juice,plain yogurt,blue cheese,grain rice,french bread
title: Blue Cheese Lamb Chops
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 large french bread, cut into bite size strips | 300 g lamb chops | 3/4 cup plain low fat yogurt | 4 tablespoons currants | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 8 slices of firm blue cheese | cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Heat margarine in a pan and brown the lamb at the very low end stirring occasionally. In a bowl, mix together the bread, lamb drippings, yogurt, currants, lemon juice and blue cheese with a fork. Spoon the mixture over the chops. Serve immediately, with cooked long grain rice.

title: Pears and Red Wine (Aussie Style)
ingredients: 800 g pears ( approx 3 small pears ) | 200 ml red wine ( approx 3/4 cup ) | 100 g self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Cut the pears in half and then in half again and then crosswise into thin wedges. Place pears into a large mixing bowl and add red wine, flour. Toss until coated. Scatter over the pears. Heat a large non stick frying pan over high heat for 1 minute, add the pears and cook for 10 - 15 minutes, tossing to coat. Cook for a further minute before serving.

title: Aussie Key Lime and Goat Cheese Dip.
ingredients: 2 cups goat cheese | 1 bunch fresh coriander powder | 1 key lime, zest of
instructions: Chop the key lime very fine. Mix the key lime, coriander and goat cheese together until there are small chunks and the cheese is really soft. Chop the lime zest and add it to the cheese mixture until the ingredients are well mixed. Cover with cling wrap and chill for at least an hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,grape tomato,corn syrup,red snapper fillet,chili powder,liquid smoke,chicken stock
title: Smoked Grap Tomato Fish
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs red snapper fillets, thawed if frozen | 1 cup grape tomatoes, cut in half | vegetable stock | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a large resealable plastic bag combine the snapper, tomatoes, corn syrup or maple syrup, chili powder, water, corn syrup, and chicken stock. Close the bag and shake to evenly coat fish. Close the bag and return fish to the oven and broil 10 minutes or until golden brown. Place fish on a serving platter and surround with tomato halves.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,pineapple juice,spring wrapper,golden syrup,red chile pepper,cardamom,black sesame seed
title: Pineapple Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup light golden syrup | 1 tablespoon light golden syrup ( or dark ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 long red chile pepper ( seeded and minced ) | 8 cups pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon black sesame seeds ( hulled ) | 1 spring roll wrappers ( can be bought at asian market ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery ribs, coarsely chopped
instructions: Whisk golden syrup, cardamom and chili pepper in 3/4 cup water in a medium nonstick skillet over medium high heat until sugar dissolves, about 2 minutes. Increase heat to medium and boil until syrupy, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, add pineapple juice and seeds and stir to combine. Place 1 spring roll wrapper in a shallow bowl and coat with a damp paper towel. Place 1 spring roll wrapper on top of a paper towel in a single layer. Brush 1/4 cup of the syrup mixture over the wrapper and lightly press and roll up. Place roll in plastic bag and turn to coat with syrup mixture. Repeat process for remaining wrappers. To serve, top rolls with remaining syrup mixture and decorate with sesame seeds and chopped celery. Serve at room temperature.

title: Spaghetti Lemon Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb chinese noodles, preferably fresh | 1/2 cup lemon juice and zest, preferably fresh
instructions: Rinse and inspect the noodles until the water runs clear. Fill a large pot with water and bring it to a boil over high heat. Add the noodles and let them boil for about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the lemon zest and a drizzle of lemon juice and pour over the noodles. Continue to boil until the noodles are tender but still firm. Drain the noodle, and serve at once.

title: Slow Cooker Maple Roast
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds rump roast | 1 can maple syrup | 3 tablespoons rice wine or rice vinegar
instructions: Place the roast in the slow cooker. Pour maple syrup and rice wine over the roast.

Random Ingredients: white cabbage,romaine lettuce,vegetable shortening,ice,apricot preserve,chicken breast half,kalamata olive
title: Chicken Salad Provedcal
ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cubed | 6 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 6 cups shredded white cabbage | 3 cups chopped romaine lettuce | 3/4 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 cup chopped pitted kalamata olives, or to taste | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: Place chicken cubes into a large pot, and add water to cover.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,red chile,mustard seed,lemon pepper,purpose flour,chipotle pepper,almond extract
title: A Simple Almond-Chipotle Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon mustard seed | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red chile | 1/8 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon pure dried chipotle peppers | 1 1/2 cups pizza sauce | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Stir together the flour, mustard seed, chile pepper, lemon pepper, and chipotle peppers. Spread the sauce evenly onto the surface of a pizza pan. Sprinkle the top of the crust with the almond extract.. Bake for 15 minutes, then place under the broiler to brown. Serve hot.

title: Dirty Cherry Shooters (Sour Cherry Shooters)
ingredients: 28 ounces cherry tomatoes ( about 12 cherry peppers and 3/4 cup cherry juice ) | 1/2 cup sweet pickle relish | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 1 teaspoon sweet pickled jalapeno pepper | 1 teaspoon sweet pickled jalapeno pepper, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Combine cherry tomatoes, relish, kahlua, jalapeño, and cayenne in a blender.

title: Roasted Peppers
ingredients: 4 large bell peppers | 4 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together the peanut butter and peanut butter until evenly blended. Spoon mixture onto peppers, and toss well to coat. Place onto a baking sheet. Roast peppers in the preheated oven, turning occasionally, until peppers are tender and evenly browned, about 15 minutes. Slice peppers into 1/2 inch pieces, and serve.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,deli roast beef,ice,mustard powder,cayenne pepper,cottage cheese,skirt steak
title: Shoe Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon prepared mustard powder | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 12 small slices deli roast beef | ice
instructions: Place maple syrup and cottage cheese in a shallow dish, and stir until well blended. Combine mustard and cayenne pepper in a bowl, and set aside. Trim steak of any extra fat, and cut into very thin strips, then add to cayenne pepper mixture. Soak steaks in warm water for 5 minutes on each side, or until done depending on how fast your steaks go. When steak has finished soaking, remove from pan, and allow to sit for 5 or 10 minutes, then slice into thin strips. Place equal portions of the steak and cheese in the bottom of a medium serving dish, and top with slices of beef and cheese. Drizzle with maple syrup and serve with a dollop of low fat sour cream and a nice salad of greens.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,rack lamb,prune,caper,red curry paste
title: Curried Lamb With Rack of Lamb
ingredients: 4 racks of lamb | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 1 package prunes | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 tablespoon red curry paste
instructions: Marry racks of lamb with a rack brush with a bit of the ranch dressing mix per your taste. Dip the prunes into the red curry paste and then onto your favorite side of the racks. Slice the racks and serve while still hot. Garnish with the capers and serve with plenty of freshly steamed veggies for a delicious curry based meal.

title: Wasabi Sauce II
ingredients: 1/4 cup wasabi paste | 1/4 cup hot water | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: In a small bowl, combine wasabi paste, hot water and salt. Cover and set aside. Note, i wasabi paste was available at asian food stores.

Random Ingredients: french bean,cornflour,thai red curry paste,sage leaf,tilapia fillet
title: Spiced Fish
ingredients: 400 g tilapia fillets, cut into bite sized chunks | 15 -20 french beans, cut into sticks | 20 fresh sage leaves | 3 teaspoons mixed thai red curry paste ( bought ) | 1/4 cup cornflour
instructions: Spray a hot wok with oil and heat. Quickly fry the fish pieces until golden. Add garlic and herbs. Stir fry briefly. Stir in the bhuga choy and curry paste, mix to coat everything and add to the wok and let simmer over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes or until mixture becomes thick and sticky with the fish. Add a little water if needed. Spoon over fish and serve.

title: Tortellini W-Olive Garden Mushroom Cream Sauce - No Canning
ingredients: 1 can of sliced mushrooms, drained ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon aniseed | 1 dash hot sauce | 2 cups quick rolled oats | 3/4 cup sliced dried tortellini
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Mix the mushrooms together in a small bowl, pour cream over the mixture and stir. Add anise and hot sauce, stir to blend. Remove mushrooms from the bowl with a slotted spoon. Place the noodles on a baking sheet and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, stirring once or twice. Remove from oven and stir in the tortellini.

title: Spinach 'n' Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, rinsed ( or 2 cups cooked quinoa ) | 3 1/2 cups hot water | 2 lemon zest ( about 2 tbs. ) | 2/3 cup roughly chopped fresh rosemary sprig ( or 1/4 tsp. dried )
instructions: Place quinoa in a fine mesh strainer. Pour 3 cups water into a small deep skillet. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low.

title: Asparagus With Raisins and Sherry
ingredients: 1 lb small asparagus, trimmed ( or asparagus tips-optional ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon white raisins
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, melt the sherry. Add the asparagus.

title: Slow Cooker Carnitas
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, with bone | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 4 lbs picnic-sized bags ( carnitas )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a gallon size ziploc bag. Refrigerate for 8 to 12 hours. Cook in slow cooker for 8 to 10 hours on high.

title: Red Wine Sauce for Seafood
ingredients: 2/3 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons dry red wine | 2 tablespoons powdered dried lavender | 2 teaspoons dried mace | 1/3 cup whipped topping
instructions: Mix mayonnaise, red wine, lavender, and mace together in a glass for easy blending, cover, and refrigerate overnight. Stir often. Cover an ice cream cone or platter with plastic wrap to prevent a skin from forming while chilling. Mixture will be a nice thick paste. Pour chilled mixture into a resealable plastic bag, and freeze until needed, at least 2 hours. Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving, and stir once or twice to smooth out any food pieces that have settled to the bottom.

title: Tortillas With Chickpeas & Preserved Apples
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas | 1 -2 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 bunch fresh basil ( approx. 8-10 leaves ) | 1 large fresh sweet fruit | 1/2 cup apple juice | tortilla ( optional )
instructions: Soak the chickpeas overnight in water to cover. The next day, add ginger paste and fresh basil to the drained chickpeas. Soak the apple by soaking it in water to cover about 15 minutes. Drain and use as described above. Add sweet apple and preserves. Cover the pot and place lid on pot, let cook. After five minutes remove lid and allow to cook until the apples and onions are cooked. Cut onion rings and cut into small slices or pieces using a cookie shears. After 5 - 10 minutes remove from the flame, remove the lid. Serve immediately with tortillas. Enjoy.

title: Chutney Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter, cubed | 1 cup mango chutney | 1 dried chilies, crushed
instructions: Mix all together until it looks like cement mortar paste. You can use a teaspoon until the chunks are just covered on the base of the mixture, then wrap with wax paper and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: honey,salt,italian herb seasoning,monterey jack pepper cheese,green
title: Cheese With Herb Brochettes
ingredients: 4 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, cut into 4 slices | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons mixed italian-herb seasoning | 1/2 cup green < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/cheese-with-herbs-with-herbs-with-on-with-herbs-the-dipping-hot-dipping-sauce-333920 '' > cheese with herbs with onions with herbs < /a > - 1 /a | 4 teaspoons honey, for brushing
instructions: Arrange cheese on a serving platter. Sprinkle with salt. In a small bowl, combine sachets and herbs, stir to blend. Drizzle on cheese cheese with honey, garnish with green onions.

title: Tajine Msir Zeet - Turkish Egg & Apricot Tacos
ingredients: 6 soft corn tortillas | 4 large hard-boiled eggs | 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 1/2 turmeric | 1 fennel bulb
instructions: Chop the fennel bulb and fry with the turmeric. Fry the eggs with the apricot jam, just as you would a normal egg and keep turning over. Cook 2 or 3 slices of fennel over high heat for 3 minutes then add a few slices of egg to each tortilla. Spoon some of the egg and jam mix all over and serve.

Random Ingredients: walnut,citron peel,goya extra virgin olive oil,spring onion,tangerine,flour
title: Tangerine Walnut Oil and Pearl Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg peeled tangerines | 4 tablespoons dried currant | 1 teaspoon finely grated fresh nutmeg or 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 large bunch spring onion, about 5cm long | 5 tablespoons finely chopped walnuts | 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 kg flour ( plus more for kneading the dough )
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water together with the dried currants and pinch of nutmeg to a boil in a saucepan. Turn off the heat and leave to stand for 10 to 15 minutes, until currants swell slightly. Meanwhile, place the spring onion on an oiled baking sheet. Use a knife to trim away any large root bits and peel off the hard green leaves with the tough root ends. Slice the spring onions in half lengthways, then slice the halves into 1cm/1 inch lengths. Remove the hard skins by scraping with a rolling pin, or use a vegetable peeler for a rough guide. Place half of the spring onions in a bowl. Place the walnuts on a cutting board and roughly chop the walnuts. Drain the tangerines and put aside to soak for 10 minutes. Remove the peel of the tangerines and split them in half lengthways, and coarsely chop the flesh. Put the juice, chopped tangerines, drained water, reserved cooking liquid and freshly ground nutmeg in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and leave for at least 3 days. When ready to use, sieve the water into a large mixing bowl. Turn over the flour and add a little water or oil gradually, as not to toughen the dough. Make a well in the centre of the flour and quickly pour in the liquid from the bowl as you pour. Knead for 10 minutes, adding a little water or oil if needed. Divide the mixture into 12 portions, shape into balls that are about 20cm/9 inches in diameter, about as big in diameter as you are able to form them, and leave the rest covered in the fridge. Heat the remaining oil in a large, deep frying pan, add the drained tangerine and spring onions and fry over a very low heat until the surface turns a rich brown color, sprinkling with the reserved grated nutmeg once or twice. You want them to be a rich, slightly reddish colour and not be slimey. This will take 10 to 15 minutes, but will take much longer if the oil is too hot. Remove the pan onto a flat surface and carefully remove the spring onions, taking care not to break them into rings. Place them in a serving dish or on a serving plate and then cover with kitchen paper and keep hot. Repeat with the other 10 batches of tangerine. The pan will have a stack of oil and will need to cool briefly before you cook them. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,white wine,olive oil,parsley leaf,olive juice,paprika,red grape,pea
title: Beef, Peas, Grape-Pintzel
ingredients: 2 lbs beef round steak ( one `` steak '' ) | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup olive juice | 1/2 cup parsley leaves | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 20 red seedless grapes, hulled | 1 cup frozen peas
instructions: Cut steak in four pieces.

title: Ginger-Tomato Chocolate Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 1/2 cup fresh tomato puree | 1/2 ounce candied gingerroot, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Break up the small pieces of chocolate with a rolling pin or clean knife. Heat chocolate and tomato puree in microwave or in a double boiler. Stir in the candied ginger. Sprinkle with vanilla and let cool. Store in an airtight container. To serve, break into small chunks. Serve in warm, warm or chilled bowl.

title: Hungarian Spicy Prunes
ingredients: 1 lb finely chopped mixed peppermint extract ( such as lillian's mints spices ) | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom | 4 cups coarsely chopped pitted prunes | 2 lbs string beans, trimmed washed and cut into 2 inch lengths | 2 lbs pitted plums, cut into 2 inch segments | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1 cup snipped fresh dill or 2 tablespoons dried dill
instructions: Combine peppermint extract and cardamom in 1/4 cup of water and set aside. Soak green beans in a large pot with water for about 20 minutes to soften. Remove string beans and wash thoroughly and drain. Place prunes in a colander and dry completely. Combine green beans, plums, and shortening in a large bowl, mixing well. Add prune mixture and reserved peppermint mix. Mix until well blended. Sprinkle on top of the green beans mixture. Cover and refrigerate 6 to 8 hours, stirring several times. If you want to serve later, keep covered and refrigerate left overs and leftovers if you want to serve later. Letting mixture rest for 10 to 20 minutes will remove any sedund soggy texture.

Random Ingredients: black tea,mozzarella,green chile,topping,radish,red chili pepper,salmon fillet
title: Smoked Salmon and Chile Tea Sandwich
ingredients: 6 -8 slices smoked salmon fillets | 1 fresh green chile ( or jalapeno ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 2 teaspoons radishes, chopped | 4 thin slices cheese-swise mozzarella, any flavor ( e.g. provolone cheese ) | 1 tablespoon black tea, warmed in microsafe cup ( or leftover green leaf ) | extra-virgin fat whipped topping ( optional )
instructions: Place the salmon fillets on a cutting board and slice. Arrange the slices of salmon on a serving plate. Cut a slit into the salmon and arrange the chile in a thin, flat pattern around the salmon. Sprinkle with chile. Add the radishes. Top salmon with cheese slices.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,hamburger,toast,crab,shortcut bacon
title: Moroccan Toast
ingredients: 2 cans crab | 6 thick slices shortcut bacon | 12 hamburger patties ( sandwich buns ) | 1 packet ras el hanout spice blend | 1 1/2 lbs shortcut bacon
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Slightly flatten burgers with hands. Place burgers onto heated toast and warm on griddle until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,oatmeal,black eyed pea,oil lard,celery salt,havarti cheese
title: Black-Eyed Peas Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked oatmeal | 1 cup canned black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/2 tablespoon celery salt | 1 ounce havarti cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon oil or 1 teaspoon lard
instructions: Mix the oatmeal, peas, covado sugar, and celery salt in a medium saucepan covered with water. Heat to boiling, add the cheese, and simmer until tender, about 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in the oil or lard until melted.

title: Rosti (Fry Potatoes on Stick)
ingredients: 5 lbs small russet potatoes, peeled and quartered | 12 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder
instructions: Toss potatoes in a bowl with dill and five spice powder, until coated. Heat 1/2 the skillet. Carefully place the potatoes in the pan and cook over low heat for 15 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ice water,creole seasoning,active yeast,pasta,pork sparerib,liquid smoke flavoring
title: Homemade Smoked Pork Braid
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 cups ice water | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring | 2 lbs country-style pork spareribs, cut into 2-inch pieces | 12 ounces pasta
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water. Place in a large bowl, and stir in creole seasoning, liquid smoke and remaining 1 cup warm water. Add spare ribs and stir until well coated. Let stand overnight in a warm place. Drain and place in a large, deep pot. Cover, and set aside. In the morning, place pot over medium heat and add 1 1/2 cups warm water. Bring to a boil, then decrease heat to low, and simmer 1 hour, or until ribs are tender. Add pasta to boiling water. Cook until tender.

title: Roni's Easy Vegetarian Lasagna
ingredients: 1 pound lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup chopped onion, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain. Place 1/2 cup noodles in the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with onion. Repeat layers until pasta is evenly coated with sauce. Top with remaining 1/2 cup noodles. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, about 25 minutes.

title: Guava Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken tenderloins, frozen, thawed overnight | 12 large tomatoes ketchup, divided | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | ice cube | 1 bottle guava, chilled for 30 minutes, sliced
instructions: Place thawed chicken tenderloins in a zipper type plastic bag. Combine 1/2 cup ketchup, mustard, minced garlic, and ice into the bag of frozen chicken. Squeeze out air, seal, and close the bag. Place the bag of frozen chicken in a slow cooker. Pour 1/2 the tomato ketchup mixture over the chicken and stir. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,lemongrass,orange juice,vegetable broth,vegetable oil cooking spray,mustard powder
title: Cousin Pete's Thai Pepper and Lemongrass Soup
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 1 cup vegetable broth or 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 20 stalks fresh lemongrass, leaves only, peeled and finely chopped | 1 small yellow pepper, cut into very thin strips ( i've also used a combination of both colors as well ) or 1 small red pepper, cut into thin strips ( i've also had this combo )
instructions: Wash and dry vegetables, cut into 3 inch lengths, then combine in a medium size bowl. Add orange juice. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat and coat with cooking spray. Add the peppercorns and the pepper strips. Stir and fry until the peppercorns are soft and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Stir in 1/2 cup water if the mixture seems dry and/or season with a little more of the water if necessary. Pour the soup into a heatproof bowl and serve.

title: Beef Curry - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 lb beef sirloin steak | 1 lime, juice of
instructions: Mix the turmeric and lime juice, and pour into a pressure cooker. Add a few splashes of white or red pepper flakes onto top to enhance the color.

title: Chinese Grape and Vinegret (A Sweet & Sour Rice)
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice | 1 1/2 cups grapes, halved | 1 3/4 cups catsup
instructions: Put rice and rice vinegar in a saucepan and fill half way with water. Bring to boil and simmer about 15 - 20 minutes, or until rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,apricot preserve,lemon zest,pork,cheese,peach half,pie crust,japanese eggplant
title: Jerk Pork & Eggplant Pie With Mozzarella
ingredients: 2 large japanese eggplants, sliced | 1 1/2 lbs ground pork | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated, divided | 1 jar peach halves, drained, coarsely chopped | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1 jar apricot preserves | 1 1/2 cups cheese, shredded ( mozzarella, emmentaler )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the sliced eggplants on a baking sheet and place in the oven until the skin blackens and draws away from the eggplants' flesh, about 45 minutes. Turn, and let cool to room temperature, about 15 minutes. Peel the eggplants, and slice into 1/4 inch rounds. Boil the water in a large dutch oven or roasting pan with the rack just below the bottom of the dutch oven. Add the pork, 1 teaspoon of the lemon zest, and 1/2 cup of the chopped peaches and salsa and cook over medium high heat until the pork is no longer pink. Drain the excess fat from the pan. Remove the pork from the heat and drain off any excess juices. Pat the slices dry with a paper towel. Layer half of the sliced eggplant in the bottom of a 9 inch pie plate.

title: Angel Hair Pasta with Dijon Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 pound angel hair pasta | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,self rising flour,tahini,onion almond paste,cracker,sparkling water,orange marmalade,bamboo shoot
title: Italian Spritzer
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1/3 cup tahini | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato ( oil packed ) | 1/2 small onion ( minced ) | 1 can sliced canned bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 3/4 cup sprite ( lemon soda can ) | 1 1/2 cups sun-dried tomatoes ( garnish ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cracker, broken into small pieces ( garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients in the order listed, mixing well after each addition. Divide into 8 pieces and roll each piece out onto a lightly floured board. Cut dough in half. On a floured board with a floured rolling pin, roll each piece of dough into a 6 or 7 inch circle about 5 inches in diameter. Spoon 1 teaspoon of tomato mixture into the center. Fold the circle in half and pinch edges together. Repeat with the remaining dough. Place on a greased, parchment lined baking sheet. Sprinkle tops with cracker pieces if using. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until golden. Serve warm.

title: Ensalada De Pobre
ingredients: 8 slices white bread, preferably toasted ( very thin slices ) | 1/4 cup shredded lettuce | 1 poblano chile, seeded and minced | 1 apple, peeled, cored and diced small | 1 maraschino cherry, cut in large pieces | 1 tablespoon mustard, preferably white | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 cup sweetened lime juice
instructions: Spread toast on large rimmed baking sheet or cookie sheet. Let cool completely. Combine the lettuce, poblano, apple and cherries. Toss well with mustard and essence. Spread on toast slices and sprinkle with lime juice. Serve immediately. Variation, instead of making this immediately serve at once on the side. Variation with other salsa of your choice, substitute a combination of the ingredients or a red wine. This salsa will last about 3 weeks.

title: Korean Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 asian pears, sliced
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Place the chicken breasts on the grill and brush with a little water. Cook the chicken until the flesh is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 1 to 2 minutes per side. An instant read thermometer inserted into a thick bottomed slice of chicken should read at least 165 degrees f. Remove the chicken breasts from the grill and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Heat the grilling pan over high heat and place a sliced or slotted spoonful of pears in the center of each slice of chicken. When the pears are close to to dark in color, flip the chicken and pears, cut side down, and place the chicken and pears on a cutting board or serving platter.

title: Sweet Soy Glaze for Vegetables
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 pint half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon molasses or 2 teaspoons molasses
instructions: Place the baby spinach in a pan of boiling water. Cook until wilted, then drain well. Preheat the oven to 220c or mark 6. Place spinach, soy sauce, sugar and half and half in a large roasting tin, and heat in the oven, stirring and occasionally, until it boils. Pour the molasses over the top, stir to combine, and cook for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and cook in preheated oven for at least 20 minutes, stirring from time to time, stirring occasionally, until the glaze is crisp and bubbly.

title: Tuna Salad With Cherries
ingredients: 1 tablespoon miricle whip | 1 teaspoon roasted red onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup ice | 6 ounces tuna packed in oil, drained and flaked | 1 bag frozen cherries, unpeeled, thawed ( about 8 )
instructions: In bowl, combine miricle whip and onion, and toss with tuna. Top with the cherries and serve.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,egg,yukon gold potato,mesclun,hot red pepper flake,button mushroom,purpose flour
title: Mushroom and Strawberry Pancakes
ingredients: 4 large yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed, cut crosswise into 1 1/2 inch slices ( about 1 1/4 pounds total weight ) | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 3 cups sliced fresh button mushrooms | 4 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 2 cups thickly sliced fresh strawberries | 2 teaspoons hot red pepper flakes | mesclun, for serving
instructions: Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, place yukon gold potato slices in a colander.

title: En Tent Tacos
ingredients: 1 1/4 gallons extra lean beef, meat cut into 1-inch cubes | 10 corn tortillas, warmed | 6 green onions, sliced 3/8-inch thick | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 1/2 cups loosely packed fresh cilantro or 1 1/2 cups fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 250 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Toss meat in a large bowl with allspice. Spread half of meat mixture in a even layer across a tortilla. Top evenly with green onions, cilantro, and meat remaining tortilla. Roll up tightly and secure ends with a wooden toothpick. Arrange in a single layer on foil lined cookie sheet. Bake until meat is browned and tender and tortillas have turned slightly crisp, about 1 hour. Remove toothpicks and serve.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,ketchup,vegetable bouillon granule,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Auntie Jill's Zippy Veggie Crumble-Dumplings
ingredients: 2 cups plain panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon vegetable bouillon granules | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a bowl, combine together the bread crumbs, parmigiano reggiano cheese and bouillon granules. Use a teaspoon or spoon to set aside 1/2 cup crumbs for topping the finished dish. Roll remainder into a ball and flatten slightly with a rolling pin.
