Place the mixture in a 9 x 11 inch baking dish and bake in a 450f oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown and starting to crackle. Don't over bake it, just let the crumbs cool a bit. To serve transfer crumbs from the baking dish to a plate and serve sprinkled with the reserved crumbs.

title: Malaysian Creamy Ginger-Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup fresh whipping cream ( not sweetened ) | 3 -5 whole cloves | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger paste
instructions: Whisk cream and cloves in a bowl that will accomodate a metal ring in the bottom. Set aside.. Heat large skillet over medium low heat. Add oil to hot skillet and swirl to coat pan. When oil is hot, add ginger and cook, stirring, till light golden brown. About 3 mintues, or 45 seconds. Whisk cream, ginger and cloves in large bowl until blended. Add cream mixture to hot skillet over low heat and heat till sauce forms bubbles. Takes about 5 - 10 minutes, depending on the type of cream you use. Serve over hot rice.

title: Strawberry Ceviche With Coconut and Capers
ingredients: 3 cups strawberries, washed ( or green grape ) | 3 teaspoons capers | 3 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 cup coconut
instructions: In a non reactive bowl, blend the strawberry, capers and splenda well. Serve warm garnished with coconut and a pinch of cinnamon if desired.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,chickpea flour,molasses,pita bread,rice wine,salad oil,gingerroot
title: Nif's Moroccan Pita Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup chickpea flour | 1 tablespoon ground gingerroot | 3 tablespoons light molasses | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons rice wine | pita bread
instructions: Combine rice wine and soya sauce set aside. Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl. Add liquids. You can put it in until all dry ingredients are moistened. Add more wine or soya if needed. Heat frying pan and dip pita bread into the batter, one at a time, so they absorb the batter completely. Fry on both sides until crispy on the outside and light tan in color. You can also make rice pancakes by dropping a spoonful of batter in the pan and frying it. It's not necessary to check it, unless it fries before bottom is golden, it's ready.

title: Easy Nacho Dip!
ingredients: 15 ounces kidney beans | 2 -3 canned chopped jalapenos
instructions: Drain and rinse your kidney beans, and put them in the blender. Add in the chopped jalapenos. Blend into your desired thickness, i use at least one/4 cup to make it smooth.

title: Baked Eggplant With Sour Cream and Coriander
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 cup light sour cream ( or plain yogurt ) | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f and line a baking dish with parchment paper. Slice eggplant into 1/2 inch thick wedges. Place eggplants in a single layer on paper towel lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt. Roast on baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes or until tender. Remove and let rest for 5 - 10 minutes. Combine sour cream, broth and coriander. Spoon sour cream mixture over warm eggplant and serve.

title: Beef Cubes, Italian style
ingredients: 1 kg lean beef roast | 200 g thinly cut salami | 2 packages yeast ( 2 x 1. 5cm/1cm ) | 7 tablespoons dark rum | 1 egg noodles | 3 eggs, beaten
instructions: Mix 3kg rinds with yeast and 2 tablespoons of rum. Add the beef, mix well, and marinate overnight. Turn once or twice to get a good marinade. Cover the loaf pan with plastic wrap and leave to prove overnight. The next morning, remove the bag of rinds from the loaf pan and discard, discarding any excess rinds. Stuff with the beef cubes and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Put all the other ingredients in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Simmer for about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat, cover and set aside for at least one hour or overnight. Pour out the contents on paper towel and dry the loaf pan. Remove the garlic gloves and shred the rinds with scissors. Serve with boiled potatoes and the soured cream.

title: Apple Miska® Passover Skillet
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups apple juice concentrate or 1 1/3 cups apple juice, concentrate | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon season salt | 1/4 teaspoon skewer ( i used meatballs ) | 2 tablespoons matzo, toasted
instructions: For marinade, stir together all ingredients except the matzo in small bowl. For vegetable, soak matzo in warm water for 15 - 20 minutes to soften. Dip meatballs in the marinade, then roll in matzo. Heat a few inches of oil in a skillet over high heat until just smoking. Cook chicken rolls in small batches until seared on both sides and cooked through, about 5 minutes per batch. Serve with any remaining marinade.

Random Ingredients: white onion,mexican oregano,black olive,lamb shoulder,turmeric powder,cocoa powder,orange zest
title: Lamb Tagine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried mexican oregano | 1 tablespoon ground turmeric powder | 1 lb lamb shoulder, fat trimmed | 3 ounces white onions, chopped | 1 ounce unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 2 tablespoons black olives, sliced
instructions: Cut the lamb into cubes. Place in a saucepan over low heat, cover and cook for 5 hours or until the meat has become tender and soft. Remove the stock to a container and pour through a foodiser. Discard solids and reserve. In the cooking pan, add 2 tablespoons of the reserved stock and the dried oregano and turmeric powder. Drain lamb well and return stock to the pan. Add onions, cocoa powder, orange zest and black olives. Cover and cook over a low heat for 30 minutes. Stir into the pan juices the last 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,chicken wing,nopales,turnip,flour tortilla,muscovado sugar,fenugreek seed,whipping cream
title: Ensemble Nopales
ingredients: 3 cups chicken wings, tips discarded | 1 lb ladyfinger, sliced | 15 small dried porcini mushrooms, soaked in water 15 minutes and drained | 1 lb turnip, peeled and thickly sliced | 2 tablespoons nopales, prepared fresh chopped and drained | 1 cup whipping cream or 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 -3 tablespoons flour tortillas or 2 -3 tablespoons corn tortillas | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds ( also called 'javita'or cilantro )
instructions: In a large saucepan fry the chicken wings or mushrooms in 1/4 cup of oil until crisp tender.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,herring fillet,garlic pepper seasoning
title: Herring Steamed in Clay Cooker
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs herring fillets | 1/2 tablespoon garlic pepper seasoning | 1/2 tablespoon coarse salt or 1/2 tablespoon coarse salt | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: In a large saucepan, place the herring fillets in the water. They will float, so just let them hang out and get cold. Dip them into salt, then coat with pepper. Place the fish in the slow cooker. Pour the boullion over the fish and stir. Cook on low for 5 - 7 hours. Fish will easily flake with a fork.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,red food coloring,black bean,lime wedge,beef broth,picante sauce,tomato juice
title: Picante Black Beans
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 cup tomato juice | 1/2 cup low sodium beef broth | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Cook beef and onion in large skillet with taco seasoning until cooked through and drain. Stir together picante sauce, black beans, tomato juice, broth, and onion powder.

title: Easy Filipino Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 guacamole blend ( pina colada ) | 1 - 1 1/2 lb ground pork and pork | 2 cups chicken broth or 2 cups beef broth | 1 -2 green cardamoms ( optional ) | chinese-style vinegar | white vinegar | 1/4 - 1/2 head savoy cabbage ( shredded )
instructions: First, make the meat filling. Start by mashing the meat and pork. Then start by adding the broth or beef broth and let simmer on low heat for at least 2 hours so the flavors develop. For the garnish, add the cardamom pods and remove from heat. For the cabbage, in a large pot, put the cabbage and cook until softened, drain any excess liquid. When finished, the cabbage should not get bitter and mushy, it should not be so sweet that you get a sour taste. Just add enough of the broth or beef broth to cover the cabbage, it should be liquid enough, not too moist and runny. Next, add the meat filling and let cook on medium heat until the flavors are well blended, about 20 - 30 minutes. If you want to be really decadent, add more vinegar and/or sugar and serve as a side dish with the meat and cabbage. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with hot steamed rice.

title: German Sourdough Bread
ingredients: 8 ounces sourdough starter | 1 teaspoon instant dried yeast
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve the dried yeast in 1 cup warm water and allow to proof. Add sourdough starter to a large bowl and begin to dissolve the yeast. When mixture is a soft, smooth paste, cover and allow to ferment at least 2 hours or up to 3 days. Pour into a 2 quart container and refrigerate in a sealed container for 6 weeks before usage. Use in bread stores and for breads.

title: Honeydew and Melon Soup (Brioche)
ingredients: 500 g hulled honeydew melon | 350 g rigatoni pasta | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( baking soda )
instructions: Peel and dice melon. Boil in water until just soft, drain and cool. Remove husk, rinse under cold running water and drain well. Cut melon into 1cm cubes and boil in water until just soft, drain. Add honeydew and cook over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until heated through. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to pack directions, drain. Bring in remaining water and soda to boil, remove from heat and let stand until liquid is reduced. Stir through melon and serve.

title: Smoked Salmon and Ricotta Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 pint fresh spinach | 3 slices smoked salmon, thinly sliced into half moons | 7 ounces pinto beans, drained | 14 ounces smoked salmon, chopped into chunks | 2 ounces hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 lemon, zest and juice | 2 tablespoons green olives, roughly chopped
instructions: Get a large mixing bowl, roughly chop the spinach and toss it in until all the other ingredients are combined. Add the spinach and season. Tear the smoked salmon into chunks and combine with the other ingredients. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,white chocolate,rice noodle,mexican oregano,grainy mustard,caster sugar,red wine vinegar,cream chicken soup
title: Creamy German Noodles (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 bag fresh rice noodles ( about 7 oz ) | 5 ounces sauerkraut | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup grainy mustard | 1 red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 12 ounces white chocolate
instructions: Cook noodles to packet directions, drain, reserving some of the cooking water. Mix together sauerkraut with 1/4 cup of red wine vinegar, grainy mustard and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Add 1/2 teaspoon of oregano. Mix together and keep warm. Heat remaining 1/4 cup of red wine vinegar with remaining 1/4 cup of sugar in a small saucepan, stirring. Heat until sugar is dissolved. Add cream of chicken soup and remaining 1/4 teaspoon of oregano. Whisk vigorously until warm. Add hot white chocolate and mix gently until hot. Drain noodles and add to sauce. Toss to coat and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,tart apple,onion soup mix,no salt tomato
title: Apple Dijon
ingredients: 1 tart apple | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 can no-salt-added diced tomatoes | 1/4 cup lemon zest
instructions: Peel, core, and chop apple into 1/2 inch pieces. In a glass bowl, combine the onion soup mix, diced tomatoes, and lemon zest. Arrange the apples into an 11x7x2 inch baking dish. Pour the soup mixture over the apples.. Cover, and refrigerate 1 hour, or overnight, turning once. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake in preheated oven until bubbly and beginning to brown, about 1 hour 30 minutes.

title: Mango Lace
ingredients: 5 1/2 - 6 ounces mangoes, skinned and sliced | 3 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Preheat electric griddle. Mix mango with cornflour until coated. Place mango on griddle and spread out. Cook on low heat for 5 - 10 minutes until edges are firm and starting to turn lightly brown. Turn again and brown lightly on other side. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,cream tartar,kaffir lime leaf,active yeast
title: Baked Pearl Barley (Kaffir Lime) Bread
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 3 1/4 cups pearl barley ( i use brown, white and paleo ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon kaffir lime leaves ( optional, i don't add it )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 1 1/2 cups warm water. Stir in remaining ingredients. Add more water, if necessary, to make the mixture a little creamier than soft dough. Turn out onto a floured surface. Knead into a ball. Place in a well oiled bowl, or oil an 8x8 square pan. Cover loosely or, if you're using a greased loaf pan, transfer to a pan of hot, not hot, water, so it doesn't form a film on the top. Place in a warm, draft free place until the bread has doubled in size, about 1 hour. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 50 mintues. Allow to cool until it's warm, but not hard or mushy, in the pan. Store in a airtight container, it will keep for 1 - 2 days.

title: Baked Mexican Chili Snacks
ingredients: 5 chilies, canned | 8 fluid ounces premium tequila
instructions: Place chilies in a microwave safe bowl and drizzle 1 tablespoon of the tequila over them. Let sit for 90 seconds to steam, then fluff with a fork. Transfer chilies to a baking sheet and bake at 350f 25 to thirty minutes. Fill individual chili molds with chili, then drizzle with remaining tequila. Broil at least two inches from the heat on the stove top for 2 to 4 minutes, or until chili is hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red paprika,whipping cream,lamb,allspice berry,italian seasoning mix,hash brown,chipotle powder,genoa salami
title: Crock Pot German Potato Casserole
ingredients: 8 potatoes, unpeeled | 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb | 3 slices genoa salami, 1/3-inch thick, cut into 1/2 -inch sticks | 1 -2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 -2 tablespoon whipping cream | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning mix ( or 1 tablespoon instant italian seasoning ) | 1 teaspoon allspice berry | 1 teaspoon red paprika
instructions: In a 3 1/2 to 4 quart crock pot combine potatoes, ground lamb, salami, chili powder, cream, italian seasoning blend, allspice and paprika. Stir to mix. Cover and cook on high setting for 6 to 8 hours or low setting for 9 to 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,pickle relish,raspberry,chicken bouillon granule
title: Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen raspberries | 1/2 cup sweet pickle relish ( miracle whip will do ) | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning
instructions: Drain raspberries and discard liquid. In blender blend all ingredients until smooth. Pour into a 2 cup measuring cup and enjoy.

title: Pumpkin Linguine
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen linguine ( approx ) | 1 can pumpkin puree | 4 tablespoons guinness stout
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions adding the guinness when done. Rinse pasta with cold water and drain well. Add pumpkin and cooked pasta to the pot and stir well. Cook on medium heat stirring often until pasta is cooked. Add the cooked pasta to the pot and stir to mix thoroughly. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,cream mushroom soup,cauliflower,molasses,brown basmati rice,yellow mustard,green onion,almond
title: Smoky Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown basmati rice | 1/3 cup molasses or 1/3 cup cornstarch | 1 package cream mushroom soup | 1/8 cup green onion, chopped | 1/3 cup slivered almonds | 2 tablespoons brown basmati rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 1 head lettuce leaf ( red leaf preferred ) | 2 ounces sliced almonds, for garnish
instructions: Combine rice, molasses or cornstarch, soup, green onions and half of the sliced almonds in a large bowl. Toss thoroughly to coat and set aside. Boil remaining sliced almonds as directed on the package, stirring once. Remove from heat. Add rice mixture and mix until mixed well, then set aside until ready to serve, at least 1 hour or up to 2 days. To serve, divide the lettuce among individual salad plates. Sprinkle the top with the rest of the sliced almonds and garnish with the remaining basil.

title: Spicy papaya (mangalorean soy sauce)
ingredients: 4 red chiles | 4 caraway seeds | 1 1/2 cups sweet papayas, grated
instructions: Rinse the celties under cold water. Split them lengthwise and remove the seeds. Cut out the core and then core from each chile. Place the chiles, seeds, and caraway seeds in a bowl or large zip lock bag. Place the papaya and marinade in the jar. Cover. Chill in the refrigerator and marinate up to 2 days. The longer the marinating time, the less rich the flavor will be.

title: Aioli Bites
ingredients: 1 cup fresh breadcrumb | canola oil ( for frying )
instructions: In a large bowl mix the crumbs and bread crumbs. Drop teaspoons onto a paper towel lined cookie sheet. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Bake in the oven for 10 - 12 minutes. Cool on a cookie tray for at least 10 minutes. Carefully transfer the bites to a wire rack to cool before serving.

title: Chilli Yogurt Rice Ball
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1 1/2 cups plain fat-free yogurt | 8 teaspoons chili oil | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: In a large bowl, gently combine yogurt, chili oil and cayenne. Stir in rice and gently toss to coat.

title: Baked Stuffed Strawberries
ingredients: 2 cups fresh strawberries | 3 lbs chuck, ground ( or ground sirloin ) | 3 -4 cups cooked kidney beans | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( or more to taste, i use `` accent '' msg... the more msg the better )
instructions: Put the first 3 ingredients into a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Turn into a 6 or 8 x 8 or 9 inch baking dish. Spoon the meat into the center of the fruit then sprinkle with the msg. Cover tightly with plastic wrap or foil. Let it sit out there in the sun for 20 to 30 minutes. Or, preheat oven to 350°f bake for 3 to 4 hours or until the bread is tender.

title: Lima Bean & Chickpea Sprouts
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 1 can lima beans ( drain )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 45 minutes or until desired consistency is reached.

title: Split Irish Breakfast (Vegan)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons salad dressing or 4 tablespoons vegan mayonnaise | 4 tablespoons keilbasa ( vegetarian ) or 4 tablespoons vegetarian sausage, finely sliced ( vegetarian ) | 1 dash rosemary leaf | 1 tablespoon mixed peel | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean | 4 slices turkey
instructions: Spread salad dressing or vegan mayonnaise on a dinner plate or in a bowl of a blender and add turkey, rosemary, mixed peel and vanilla beans. Blend to combine and spread mixture on top of meat mixture. Top with cheese slices and eat warm with crackers.

title: Honey Coated Japanese Lemon Baked Chicken
ingredients: 100 g chicken stock | 2 teaspoons sake | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c. Place chicken in an oven proof dish, pour in stock and bake for 45 - 50 minutes until cooked.

title: Spanish Poached Green Beans
ingredients: 2 ounces chorizo sausage, finely chopped ( about 6, if you don't own a chorizo ) | 1 pinch ground cinnamon | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 19 ounces yellow hominy, drained | 8 ounces baby spinach | 1/4 cup slivered toasted blanched almond, or
instructions: In 10 inch skillet, cook chorizo over medium high heat until browned, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle cinnamon over half of chorizo and stir to coat. Remove chorizo with slotted spoon and cook until browned, about 3 minutes. Pour vinegar over chorizo, raise heat to medium and cook, stirring until vinegar evaporates, about 2 minutes. Stir in drained and rinsed hominy and baby spinach. Cook until spinach is wilted, about 2 minutes. Stir in slivered toasted almonds, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: kale,lettuce,self raising flour,vegetable stock chicken,garlic infused olive oil,sumac,kalamata olive,beef consomme
title: Beef and Kale Soup
ingredients: 4 teaspoons garlic-infused olive oil | 400 g lean ground beef or 400 g ground lamb | 500 g kale, washed and torn into small pieces | 1 can vegetable stock or ( 400ml ) can chicken broth | 1 can beef consomme, heated | 1 tablespoon sumac | 5 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted and chopped ( optional ) | lettuce, shredded, to serve
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add beef and fry for 3 to 5 minutes. Add kale and stock and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Using a stick blender, combine soup, sumac and flour. Blend until smooth. Return to heat, reheat and cook for a further 10 minutes.

title: Berry Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 bag frozen mixed berries | 1/2 cup quick-cooking spray | 1 container frozen whipped topping or 3 cups cool whip free
instructions: Mix frozen berries with cool whip. Place ice cream mixture in a 9 x 13 pan. Cover with foil. Freeze until firm. When serving cold, remove from freezer. Remove cheese from mixture and blend with a food processor or a hand held mixer until smooth until smooth. Refrigerate until needed. To serve, remove pan from freezer and spoon mixture into bowls. Sprinkle top with a little sugar or artificial sweetener.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,grape tomato,apple,ancho chile powder,halibut fillet
title: Ancho Smoked Halibut
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets | 1 whole onion | 1 can halved grape tomatoes | 1 can chipotle pepper sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Place halibut fillets on the unheated rack of a broiler pan. Place under a preheated broiler and broil until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Turn fish over. Slice onion into thin wedges and place in a large bowl. Add halibut.

title: Homemade Butter  With Optional Brown Sugar
ingredients: 1/3 cup raw brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla
instructions: In a heavy, shallow pan over medium heat, combine the brown sugar and the vanilla. Stir the sugar with a wooden spoon, continuously stirring until the sugar has dissolved. When the mixture is foamy, remove the pan from the heat and add the hot unsalted butter with a pouring spout. Stir rapidly until the butter is very smooth and fluffy. Cool the mixture completely before transferring it to a tightly covered container. Store at room temperature in a cool, dry place until the desired color has been achieved or until you are ready to use them.

title: Radicchio and Crab (Mixed Herb)
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces fresh coriander or 3 1/2 ounces fresh cilantro, leaves | 1 1/2 ounces golden syrup or 1 1/2 ounces water | 1 1/2 ounces smoked oyster mushroom, soaked for 30 minutes in | fish stock, warm ( optional ) | 1 small radicchio, preferably large | 2 ounces small wafer cookies or 2 ounces miniature marshmallows
instructions: To prevent the radicchio from bleeding, line a bowl with a double thickness of cheesecloth or cheesecloth, place on top of a large table and add cold water until the water is about 1 inch below the rim of the bowl and the cheesecloth is completely at the top of the cheesecloth. Add the herbs and drizzle on the golden syrup. Cover the bowl and allow it to soak in a cool water bath for at least 6 hours. The basil should start to wilt and wilt. It will be wilted and limp, with a lot of liquid left in the bowl and the herbs will give off a very thin, stringy paste. You might need to add more water. Remove the herb paste and reserve in a separate container. This will keep well in the refridgerator for up to 1 week. If desired, you can keep for up to 2 weeks in the refridgerator. To serve, place 1 to 2 teaspoons of the herb paste in the center of each radicchio leaf and then sprinkle about 3 or 4 small wafer cookies around the radicchio. Serve immediately. Garnish as a garnish, drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and sweetened crushed red pepper flakes. This recipe is lovely when served with fish, steamed white beans, or rice.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,anise seed,bulgur,green tea,chili oil,splenda granular
title: Chili Tea Granola
ingredients: 2 cups green tea, loose | 2 cups bulgur or 2 cups wheat flakes, coarse ground | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger root | 3/4 teaspoon splenda granular
instructions: Place all of the dry ingredients in a medium sized glass or ceramic bowl, or microwave safe container. Heat the oil and anise in a small saucepan over medium low heat until the oil is fragrant. Pour over the dry ingredients and mix well. Cover tightly and let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. Stir again before using or storing.

title: Radish and Barley Salad for One
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed ( or barley of your choice ) | 4 cups radishes, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon splenda granular | 3 tablespoons shallots, minced
instructions: Cook barley according to package directions. Rinse and drain barley, but reserve 1/2 cup of the liquid. Toss all ingredients in a large bowl, adding reserved liquid. Sprinkle with sugar and toss to coat. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Sesame Tempura
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Prepare your work surface with cold water. When it reaches a rolling pin, roll the flour into a cylinder, about 2 tablespoons. Seal the cylinder by pressing it down with the palms of the hand. Place on a floured work surface and continue rolling the dough into 8 inch long cylinder. Cut into 5 cylinders 2 inches long and about 1 inch in diameter, and continue rolling each cylinder until it reaches the end of a rolling pin. Cut each cylinder into thirds, making 3 pieces. Heat a wok over medium high heat. When it's hot, stir in the sesame oil. When the oil is very hot but it doesn't smoke, carefully place 4 cylinder pieces into the oil. Immediately place the fryer basket into the hot wok, and let each piece return to the frying basket. Do not lift the basket while frying.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,flat leaf italian parsley,beef chuck,english mustard,tomato green chilies,pam cooking spray,filling,ice cream
title: Italian Beef Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of all but 1/2 inch of the fat | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, undrained, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons pimento, pieces | 1 tablespoon ground dry mustard | 2 tablespoons minced flat-leaf italian parsley | filling ( optional ) | curry sauce ( optional and to taste ) or mexican chili sauce ( optional and to taste ) | ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f with a rack so it doesn't burn, spray the bottom and sides of a 9 inch pie plate with cooking spray. Cut the meat into 1 inch cubes. Place the meat in the pie plate with the juices in the can and toss. Sprinkle the top evenly with chilies, pimento and mustard. Bake 1 hour or until meat is very tender. Remove from oven and let stand for 5 - 10 minutes. Sprinkle parsley on top. Remove from oven and allow to sit about 5 minutes while preparing gravy. For gravy, stir in the chile sauce and heat to boiling. Remove from heat once hot to serve with pie, adding ice cream if desired.

title: Easy and Delicious French Silk Chocolate
ingredients: 300 g dark chocolate | 150 g soymilk ( or milk & dairy ) | corn oil
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a coffee/lillet until it is semi soft, but not melted. Remove from heat & stir in the soy milk slowly. Add more soy milk or milk if necessary. Pour into bowl & refrigerate until set.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,bok choy,milk,yellow onion,cayenne pepper,beef stew meat,mango nectar,triple sec
title: Jambalaya
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cubed | 1 large yellow onion, chopped | 1 cup bok choy, chopped | 4 tablespoons plain fat-free yogurt | 1/4 cup mango nectar or 1/4 cup canned mango nectar | 3/4 cup milk | 1/4 cup triple sec or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 pinch ground cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot. Cook on low 3 - 4 hours.

title: Beer-Battered Strawberries and Green Onions
ingredients: 8 strawberries, hulled and split ( about 5 pounds ) | 1 cup green onion, sliced | 1 cup light mayonnaise | 1 cup beer | green onion, to serve
instructions: Place strawberries, green onions and mayonnaise in a bowl and toss. Put the beer in a skillet, heat to boiling over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer sauce for 10 to 15 minutes. Pour syrup over strawberries and green onions.

title: Champagne Brûlée
ingredients: 1 thick slice white bread | 1 slice pork ribs | 1 tablespoon champagne
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack at about 4 inches from the heat source. Arrange the bread slices on a baking sheet, cut side down. On one slice, sandwich together the pork ribs and champagne. Pick up the other slice of bread, and lay it alongside the sandwich. Wrap a kitchen towel around the sandwich, and place under the broiler. Broil until the bread is golden brown, about 5 minutes. Serve hot, cut side up.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,chili bean,knorr chicken bouillon,egg substitute,cooking oil,white vinegar,chicken thigh
title: Ethiopian Egg Nog
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 cups egg substitute, prepared ( you can use 3 eggs instead of 1 ) | 1 cup uncooked chili beans | 6 -8 cardamom pods | chicken thigh | 3 tablespoons minced white vinegar ( i used the one from my indonesian cookbook ) | 2 teaspoons knorr instant chicken bouillon ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add the chicken, and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Add vinegar to the pan and cook, stirring until mixed and hot. Pour in the noodles and cook until tender.

title: Italian Bread Salad for Summer Salads
ingredients: 2 slices italian bread | 1 celery rib
instructions: Wash and dry the bread slices. Cut each slice into 3 or 4 squares. You need the bread squares to be about an inch square. If you have two pans of varying thickness, place each loaf square on a plate. Cut the celery stalk into 3 or 4 long pieces. Put the bread squares on top of each other to ensure they are completely covered. The celery can be very pretty decorative. Place the celery pieces on top of the bread squares, or slice into strips and serve.

title: Swiss Cheese Grilled Apples
ingredients: 3 medium apples | 1 cup shaved swiss cheese | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon whiskey | 2 tablespoons oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Slice apples thinly and set aside. Add shrimp, meat, cheese and sauce to a large bowl and mix well. Set aside to marinate for 5 minutes. To serve, place apples on a large platter and spoon 1 ounce cheese mixture on top.

title: Le Mouti (Tahini Sauce) for Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 1 hard-boiled egg, crushed | 2 cans whole rotelle tomatoes | 3 ounces grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Break in a food processor the hard boiled egg. Add to the food processor the whole jar of tomatoes. Process until the mixture is fairly smooth. It can be processed into a sauce for thinning, even if it is thicker than you would normally. Chill before using.

title: Pork 'n' Cheese Triangles
ingredients: 30 sheets phyllo pastry | 3/4 lb ground pork | 6 tablespoons onion soup mix | 14 ounces coconut cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Brown pork in a large skillet for 5 minutes and then stir in the onion soup mix and coconut cream. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly and until heated through. Remove from heat and keep warm. Lay 3 sheets of phyllo on a clean surface and brush with some extra virgin olive oil. Cut sheets into 3 equal squares. Place 2 tablespoon of pork filling on each square and fold diagonally, pressing slightly to seal the triangles. Place the triangles on a baking tray and bake for 35 - 45 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Lobscouse
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes, crushed | 1/2 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Mix together the corn flakes and malt vinegar. Coat the surface of a wooden board with the mixture and roll out until a very thin sheet is formed. Cut into squares and serve either hot or cold as an appetizer.

Random Ingredients: seafood seasoning,soymilk,cocoa powder,taco seasoning mix,jasmine rice,extra large egg
title: Jalapeno's Nacho Flan
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs extra-large eggs | 2 cups plain soymilk | 1 cup cocoa powder | 1 cup jasmine rice | 6 ounces taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Pour the beaten eggs into a blender. Set aside 5 tbsp. Of cocoa powder to coat the bottom of a flan tin. In a blender add the soy milk, cocoa and jalapenos to the eggs and blend for approximately 1 minute. In another bowl add the cooked noodles, rice, taco mix, cocoa powder and cocoa powder to the scrambled egg mixture and mix well. Pour into the flan tin and bake for 20 minutes. Allow to cool for 15 minutes before serving. The refrigerated jalapeno's will last for a long time.

title: Swiss Chard and Chard
ingredients: 4 bunches swiss chard, stems removed and leaves washed | 8 -10 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: Wash the chard leaves thoroughly. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Meanwhile, coarsely chop the leaves. When the water is boiling, stir the chard leaves into the boiling water. When they sink to the bottom, remove with a slotted spoon. Drain again. Transfer the chard leaves to a heavy platter. Pour the half and half over the chard leaves. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Lamb Chops With Creamy Cashew and Fresh Rosemary.
ingredients: 4 lamb rib chops, approx. 1 to 1-1/4 inches thick | 1/2 cup cashews ( roasted, lightly salted ) | 1/3 cup dried rosemary | 1/4 1/4 cup buttermilk or 1/4 cup milk
instructions: Spread the butter evenly over the chops to prevent them drying out. Place chops on an ungreased broiler pan or foil. Broil 3 from heat for approximately 5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking. If the chops are too thick, you can also make a paste with the same amount of butter. Remove from broiler and stir in the remaining ingredients, coating chops. Serve with a side to serve with pasta, rice, or potatoes. Great with fresh green beans or cauliflower.

Random Ingredients: sugar syrup,lemon grass root,fish sauce,red cabbage
title: Thai Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 small red cabbage | 3 large fresh lemon grass root, chopped | 3 tablespoons sugar syrup | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh lemon grass root
instructions: Wash cabbage thoroughly in several changes of water.

title: Macaroni and Coconut
ingredients: 250 g macaroni | 125 g coconut cream | 1 teaspoon fennel powder
instructions: Boil macaroni for 10 minutes add coconut cream and fennel powder. When noodles are cooked remove from heat and add macaroni mix well.

Random Ingredients: lamb,saltine cracker,glutinous rice,creamy peanut butter,orange bell pepper,corn,liquid smoke
title: Lamb and Peanut Stewed Rice
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous rice | 1 lb ground lamb or 1 lb ground beef | 4 ounces creamy peanut butter | 1 cup cream ( for cooking ) | 6 ounces corn or 6 ounces potatoes | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | coarse saltines ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Soak rice in 2 to 3 cups of hot water. Drain and rinse with cold water and set aside. In a large skillet, cook ground meat or beef, stirring occasionally for 5 to 10 minutes, until browned. Drain off any excess. Stir in peanut butter. Add rice and cream or potato. Dissolve liquid smoke in this, then toss with meat and vegetables. Season to taste with salt. Garnish with fresh coarse saltines, if desired. Cover and simmer for about 25 minutes, until rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,sherry wine,thai red curry paste,creamy peanut butter,baking soda,seasoning salt
title: Peanut Butter and Thai Red Curry Flavoring Cookies (Cookies)
ingredients: 3/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 tablespoon vegetable or canola oil | 1 teaspoon dried thai red curry paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon baking soda, rounded | 1 1/4 cups miniature dried vegetables, such as cauliflower, tomatoes, red chard and watercress ( about 1 lb. )
instructions: Place peanut butter, sherry wine, vegetable or canola oil, curry paste, seasoned salt, and baking soda in a food processor. Process or blend just until ingredients are mixed. Add vegetables and process until dough forms small, evenly sized balls. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Roll dough balls slightly in powdered sugar to coat lightly. Store the coated peanuts in an airtight, nonaluminum container at room temperature for up to one week.

title: Cafe Rio Ramen
ingredients: 1 bag of japanese short noodles ( rice vermicelli ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 cup jarred cheese spread ( such as nam sodito )
instructions: First add all ingredients in to a skillet and cook over medium heat until all ingredients are hot. While cooking, reserve 1/4 cup of the noodles water. Drain contents of skillet and slice into strips, set aside. Cook noodles in 2 - 3 tablespoons of canola drippings until tender, drain noodles and rinse under running water. Drain noodles again. Serve noodles on warm plates and top with cheese spread,.

Random Ingredients: spinach,elbow macaroni,farfalle pasta,mint jelly,brown rice flour
title: Elegant Spinach and Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni ( small seashells ) | 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice flour | 12 1/2 ounces refrigerated reduced-fat white & light sour cream or 12 1/2 ounces reduced fat greek yogurt | 1/2 cup mint jelly
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Spray or spray a 5 1/2 cup deep dish pie plate and 2 inch deep with cooking spray. In a large mixing bowl, combine the frozen chopped spinach and macaroni.

title: Aussie Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 lb macaroni | 1 medium cucumber, seeded and sliced 1/8 inch thick | 2 mandarin oranges, cut in half lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1/4 cup dark rum | 2 tablespoons dried mint leaves or 2 tablespoons mixed fresh mint leaves | purchased dark rum
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add macaroni and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water. Meanwhile, trim the ends off cucumber. Remove the seeds, if any, from the oranges. Cut them crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Coat a 10 inch fluted quiche plate with nonstick cooking spray. Over high heat, pour about 1/4 lb. Of the rum, plus one tbsp. Add oranges. Stir fry for 2 to 3 minutes until aromatic. Add cucumber slices and stir fry for another 2 to 3 minutes until cucumber just begins to soften. Spoon macaroni into the prepared pan. Add mandarin oranges and gently toss until well coated. Stir in the remaining rum. Sprinkle with mint leaves. Note, may be served warm or room temp, but it improves when chilled, and will stay crisp for about 2 hours. Enjoy.

title: Eggplant Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 1/3 cup coffee, strong | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Lay slices of eggplant on a flat surface and coat both sides with half and half cream and set aside. Melt remaining half and half in a pot over medium heat. Add dried oregano and coffee and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add yogurt and the 2 eggplant slices, stirring to coat on all sides. Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: irish whiskey,cool whip,deli turkey,lemon extract,watercress,lettuce leaf,green bean
title: Irish Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 cup watercress, chopped | 1 cup green beans, sliced on the diagonal | 1 cup sweet onion, slivered | 1 jar deli turkey, sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons imitation lemon extract | 1 package small lettuce leaves | 1 cup cool whip, thawed
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine watercress, green beans and onion.

title: Lebanese Bread Crumb Cookies
ingredients: 4 cups italian breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup raspberry jam ( jelly )
instructions: Heat the oven to 375 degrees f or 190 degrees celsius. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Put bread crumbs and jam in a large bowl. Stir with a large fork until mixture forms a stiff dough. Put dough on a floured pastry cloth. Roll or press it out into a circle. Cut or roll dough into 10 or 12 rounds. Put rounds on greased oven trays and brush tops with a little melted butter. Bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes. Cool in the pan. These cookies keep for 4 days or freeze for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,cooking spray,rigatoni pasta,parmigiano reggiano cheese,romaine lettuce,jalapeno pepper
title: Rigatoni With Beef and Peppers
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces penne, cooked | 1 cup sliced jalapeno pepper, canned | cooking spray | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 4 cups shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,onion flake,turkey meatball,dill seed
title: Papa Bear's Favourite Meatballs
ingredients: 1 package turkey meatballs | 1/4 cup dried dill seed | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup dried onion flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Mix curing mixture well and form into 12 small meatballs. Arrange them in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f for 45 to 60 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees f. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,pumpkin pie spice,cold water,ricotta salata,green apple
title: Italian Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces ricotta salata, shredded ( low fat ricotta salata ) | 5 ounces low-fat ricotta salata, shredded | 1 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 diced green apple
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the ricotta and the salata and stir in the water and pumpkin pie spice. Add the apple and stir well to mix. Do not over mix. Cover and refrigerate over night before using, to blend flavors.

title: Grilled Mexican-Style Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 32 ounces mexican-style corn, cooked | 3 packages cooked ham, cut into 1-inch squares | 3 packages frozen corn kernels, thawed, drained
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. In an empty metal or copper clad mixing bowl, mix corn, ham and corn kernels. Place on grill. Cook for 5 to 8 minutes or until heated through and crisp.

title: Tomato Salad with Cointreau and Cognac
ingredients: 4 large roma tomatoes, chopped | 3 1/3 cups diced peeled fresh apples ( granny smith is the recipe ) | 4 tablespoons minced shallots | 1/3 cup cointreau liqueur or 1/3 cup triple sec | 4 tablespoons mirin | 1/4 cup apple cider
instructions: Mix half the shallots and the diced tomatoes with the apple juice. Cover and chill. Combine remaining shallots and tomatoes with the cointreau, mirin, brandy and apple cider. To serve, toss salad with reserved apple juice.

title: Simple Creamy Onion Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 onion, finely diced | 1 pinch chili flakes | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons tomato paste
instructions: Heat your butter in a small pan over medium heat. Add the onion, chilli, mustard and tomato paste. Saute until heated through and soft, but not browned.

title: Mandarin Salad
ingredients: 5 -6 mandarin oranges | 1 package margarita mix | 1 can sliced ripe olives | 1 package strawberry | 1 can mandarin oranges
instructions: Chill a small head of mandarins. Cut and peel off each one separately, cutting across the length a few times to make a thinner slice. Slice mandarins into four pieces.

Random Ingredients: pork,italian seasoning,epazote,green bell pepper,stock cube,coconut oil,bourbon
title: Carnisos Carnitas (Pork Carnitas)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 cup pork, ground into small cubes | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried epazote | 1 teaspoon dried epazote | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 tablespoon sweet bourbon, white or 1 tablespoon dark rum ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning or 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Heat half the coconut oil in a medium pan. Add the pork and the rest of the coconut oil. Cook until the pork is no longer pink and the oil seperates from the meat. Take off the heat and set aside. Wash the epazote, cayenne pepper and thyme. Slice all the way around the pork so that it will absorb the seasonings. Set aside. In a separate pan, heat the remaining olive oil, add the green bell pepper and cook until crisp and golden. Take off the heat and set aside. In a food processor, blitz the epazote, cinnamon, lemon grass or cassia. Remove the peels and membrane from the pork and add to the processor. Puree until well mixed and the oil separates out of the meat. Add this mixture, along with the wine, and the rest of the coconut oil to the pork mixture. Mix well. Cover the pan and simmer for 90 minutes. After 90 minutes, stir in the bourbon, and return to a low oven until the pork is cooked through. Serve with tortillas to soak up the juices.

title: Soy Vodka Corn
ingredients: 3 cups frozen sweet corn ( or more if desired ) | 3 shallots, chopped | 3 tablespoons vodka ( optional ) | 3 teaspoons soy sauce
instructions: Heat the vodka and soy sauce in a pot for a few minutes to blend. Add corn and shallots and bring to a boil. Then reduce heat to medium low and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring often to avoid burning. Serve in a shallow dish, with a good amount of crusty bread.

title: Ceviche
ingredients: 1 lb jicama, peeled ( about 3 cups ) | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread ( about 6 threads ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron, mixed with | 1 tablespoon chopped chives | 2 cups imitation crabmeat, drained, picked over and flaked
instructions: Slice jicama crosswise about ¼ inch thick, cutting off any excess. Sprinkle with baking soda. Place in a colander and sprinkle with salt and let drain 10 minutes, then press out excess liquid. Place jicama slices in a large bowl and toss with remaining soda. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes or overnight. In a small bowl, combine yogurt, saffron and 2 teaspoons salt. Place in refrigerator. Stirring until yogurt is moistened and mixture coats jicama and curds. Place jicama slices in a colander and press out any excess liquid. Return to strainer. In a shallow dish, place crabmeat and 1/4 cup yogurt mixture. Add 1/8 cup yogurt mixture and cover. Let stand in refrigerator 30 minutes. Drain off liquid. Serve with remaining yogurt mixture.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,yellow bell pepper,celery,caraway seed,ham
title: Guilt-Free Caribbean Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 lime, juice and zest of | 1 small yellow bell pepper ( chopped ) | 1 medium stalk celery ( chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 lb ham, cooked and chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and toss. Cover and chill 2 - 24 hours to develop flavors.

title: Ethiopian Vomkurimjana
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 4 cups seltzer water ( see note in recipe description ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom
instructions: In a deep baking dish, combine all ingredients and stir well to dissolve baking soda. Sprinkle with sugar to sweeten. Turn upside down baking dish upside down on kitchen towel while preparing other dishes. Cover dish and cloth towels with a damp cloth. Put dish in a kettle and bring to boil over high heat, then reduce heat to simmer. Cook 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until thick. If baking powder forms on top, add just enough semolina to the semolina.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,red pepper flake,red chili paste,curry powder,hazelnut
title: Hazelnut Curry
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts, peeled | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried red peppers flakes | 2 -3 tablespoons roasted red chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Boil water in a pan. Grind hazelnuts and add to water. Add red peppers and all ingredients and keep boiling for 10 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: My Favorite Ham & Cheese Pasta Salad (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh softshell pasta ( such as dumbo shells or fettuccine ) | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 package cooked ham, cut in half ( about 4 slices )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain, and rinse with cold water to cool slightly. When cool, drain completely and transfer to a large bowl. With a mixer, blend cheeses until combined. Stir in pasta and cooked ham until thoroughly mixed. You may sprinkle more cheese over the salad if desired.

title: Mounds of Moist Marsala Wine Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: 1 cup marsala wine ( one cup, up to 1 cup, sweet or chilled ) | 12 squares semisweet chocolate
instructions: Boil the marsala for 5 to 7 minutes, or until the alcohol is completely gone. Place a sheet of plastic wrap on a work surface with a silvet at the top of the bowl. Place a chocolate square on top, pressing it firmly into the chocolate. Carefully slip the chocolate square onto your working surface and smooth the surface with the spatula. Turn the candy onto the plastic wrap. Roll the chocolate into the size of a dinner plate. Cut the chocolate into 8 equal pieces and press each piece into a 3 1/2 or 4 inch diameter crisscrossing the chocolate square. Refrigerate the truffles wrapped in plastic wrap for at least 20 minutes before serving.

title: Spanish Spinach
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach, washed and drained | 2 spanish onions, chopped ( about 2.5 cups )
instructions: Place the spinach in a large pot of boiling salted water. Cover and steam over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until the spinach has released most of its liquid. Transfer the spinach to a colander and squeeze out excess water. Cook the onions in a nonstick skillet over medium heat until they are deep golden brown. Transfer the onions with a slotted spoon to paper towels to drain.

title: Berry and Mint Chowder
ingredients: 1 pint blackberry, freshly picked | 1 pint fresh white wine | 1 pound pearl barley | ice water, or as needed
instructions: Place the berries into a blender.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,vinegar,chicken stock,egg noodle,salsa,beef brisket,garlic salt
title: Easy Chipotle Loco
ingredients: 1 egg noodle, cut in four | 1/2 cup beef brisket | 1/4 cup vinegar ( i use white vinegar ) | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 4 cloves garlic salt | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. In a roasting pan put some water on the broiler tray. Arrange the noodle on the tray, they should be about 3 1/2 inches from each other. Broil for 8 minutes or until brown. Rinse with cool water and set aside. Slice brisket across the grain into thin slices and place on hot broiler tray. Place the slice of brisket on top of the strips, sprinkle with the garlic salt and pour the vinegar around the slices and beef. Broil brisket, covered, for about 8 - 10 minutes or until the meat is cooked to your liking. For rare, 3 - 4 minutes. For medium well, 1 - 2 minutes. Slice across the grain into strips and serve with the salsa.

title: Apricot Crusted Beef
ingredients: 1 lb lean trimmed cut beef | 3 tablespoons chopped dried apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon light olive oil
instructions: In a small bowl mix first 2 ingredients. In a large skillet brown meat on all sides. Transfer meat to a shallow baking dish. Pour preserve mixture over meat and cover tightly. Bake at 300°f for 1 1/2 hours basting and stirring the mixture every 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand for at least 20 minutes. Cut into 1/2 inch strips and serve.

title: Chiles and Garlic
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh garlic ( garlic bulb ) | 4 serrano peppers, halved lengthwise
instructions: Place the garlic, peppers, and seeds in a medium saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat and boil for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat, let cool, and remove and discard the garlic skin. Chop with a knife. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the garlic and remaining 1 1/2 cups water. Cover tightly and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,russet potato,hot water,chicken thigh,chipotle chile
title: Grilled Lemony Chicken and Chipsotle Stove Top
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 8 wedges | 12 boneless skinless chicken thighs ( about 3 pounds total ) | 2 chipotle chiles | 3 tablespoons hot water | 1 tablespoon smooth chili paste
instructions: Place the potato wedges in a large bowl, cover and set aside. Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot. Add the chicken thighs and chiles. Reduce the heat and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes with the potatoes. Drain off any excess liquid and season to taste with salt and pepper. Spread the chipsotle chiles onto a cutting board and pat into a 3/4 inch thick patty. Arrange the chicken and potato mixture on a grill pan over medium heat. Cook, turning once, until the mixture is well browned.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,dark rum,bragg liquid amino,nonstick cooking spray,taco seasoning
title: Baked Mexican Salmon
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 4 salmon fillets | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon braggs liquid aminos | 1 packet taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange salmon fillets in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. In a medium bowl, combine rum, aminos and taco seasoning. Brush one side of each salmon fillet with rum sauce mixture. Spray a little nonstick spray on the outside of the each fillet. Bake in preheated oven for 12 to 14 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,salmon,asafoetida powder,russet potato,white wine vinegar
title: Bengali Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes | 1/4 lb asafoetida powder ( or 1/4-1/2 teaspoon sugar ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 lb salmon ( or other favorite meat )
instructions: Wash and peel the sweet potato, rinse in cool water, then cut into 1/4 inch slices. Cut salmon into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. Heat a heavy frypan on medium high for 1 minute. Lightly saute the asafoetida with 1/2 tsp of the white wine vinegar and add the remainder of the white wine vinegar. Add the sweet potatoes and cook until tender. This may take anywhere from 3 to 8 minutes. Stir carefully as not to overcook as the flavors can change as potato and sweet potato flavors are absorbed by the potatoes. Add diced salmon and cook about 2 more minutes. Add sesame oil and salt and pepper to taste. Serve warm.

title: Korean Yellow Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 small yellow onion | 1 teaspoon poppy seed
instructions: Peel the onion and finely slice. Peel onion and finely slice. Combine the ground ingredients in a small dish and mix well. Serve with yellow potatoes, white rice, egg noodles, or as a filling for kimchi balls.

title: Cheese Filled Chicken
ingredients: 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 quarts peanut butter, softened | 1 pound fresh, chopped cooked chicken meat | 8 ounces provolone cheese, cut into 24 squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix together asafetida powder and the peanut butter in a bowl. Spread the filling inside the chicken pieces, and wrap each piece of chicken in a piece of provolone cheese. Secure with toothpicks. Arrange in a baking dish that is lined with a double layer of aluminum foil. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the cheese is toasted and crispy.

title: Pita (Aka Beef Burger)
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 3/4 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 6 leaves fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 1 cup cherry, cut in half | 1 can green beans in water, drained and rinsed | 1 cup alfredo sauce | 1 envelope instant espresso ( coffee-flavored ) | 2 cucumbers, sliced thin
instructions: In a heavy duty 12 skillet, heat the beef cubes over medium high heat. Coat evenly with the green beans and add to the skillet. Cook, stirring continuously, for 7 minutes. Add the spinach and cook, stirring, 1 - 2 minutes. Add the cherry and green beans. Transfer to the center of a large, heavy, lightly oiled dinner plate. Spread the alfredo sauce on top. Surround the plate with the cucumber slices. Scatter with shaved arugula.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,brown rice,caper,tortilla,egg yolk,lime,poblano chile,tamari
title: Spicy Fried Chicken With Tortilla
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 3 egg yolks | 1 poblano chile | 3 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 cup brown rice, cooked ( optional ) | 1/2 cup capers, drained ( optional ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons lime juice ( optional ) | 6 tortillas, parchment ( optional )
instructions: Cut the chicken into thin strips, and set aside. Pre heat a heavy skillet over medium heat. Chop the poblano and place in a food processor. Add the tamari to the drippings in the skillet. Turn stove to high, and cook until the poblano is limp. In a bowl, combine egg yolks, and the poblano mixture. Stir over high heat for a minute, until the egg yolks turn white. Turn off heat. Stir in the cooked rice and capers. In a small frying pan, fry the tortillas in the oil for 3 minutes on each side. Assemble the pieces of chicken, put in a serving dish and sprinkle with poblano mixture from the pan. Serve with hot tortillas.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,carrot,yellow pepper,horseradish root,plain nonfat yogurt,kosher salt,pita bread,water chestnut
title: Spicy Tofu Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish root, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish-oil flavored taco seasoning | 1 cup carrot, peeled and grated ( about 2 medium ) | 1 medium yellow pepper, cut into strips 2 inches long | 8 ounces water chestnuts, rinsed and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 cup water | 6 pita breads, warmed
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together yogurt, horseradish root paste and taco seasoning. Cover, and chill 1 hour. Arrange carrot, yellow pepper strips and water chestnuts on 6 salad plates. Combine yogurt mixture with vegetables. Sprinkle with salt. Refrigerate 30 minutes, or until flavors blend. Arrange remaining salad ingredients on salad plates.

title: Creamy Baked Cod and Gravy
ingredients: 1 pound thick salt cod fish, cut into chunks | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the cod chunks on the baking sheet, and brush with cream of mushroom soup. Bake in the preheated oven until the cod pieces are lightly browned, and sauce reduced, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,mint,cornstarch,ketchup,white onion,sun tomato oil,asparagus,chunky salsa
title: Asparagus Jellangoon
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh asparagus | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup white onion | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 4 -6 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 -2 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 1 -2 lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus and discard. Cut the asparagus diagonally into 1 inch pieces with scissors. Cut the sun dried tomatoes in half and put them aside. Dice the onion and put it aside in a small bowl. Wash asparagus diagonally. Put the sun dried tomatoes in a food processor. Add the chopped sun dried onion and ketchup and blend to a smooth puree. Mix the cornstarch into 1 tablespoon of warm water and add to the skillet. Stir over low/medium heat and mix until everything is dissolved. When all ingredients are blended, stir in the chopped mint and kaffir lime leaves. Serve over your favorite greens such as cauliflower or asparagus.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,mint,chicken bouillon,herbes de provence,onion salt,kernel corn
title: Pasta Fazool
ingredients: 12 ounces whole kernel corn | 1 cup farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence, or to taste | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 2 cubes chicken bouillon, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon onion salt, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook farfalle pasta in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook and stir corn, farfalle, herbes de provence, mint, and chicken bouillon cubes in the boiling water until heated through, about 5 minutes. Drain farfalle pasta, and mix with farfalle mixture until evenly blended. Pour pasta into the prepared salad bowls, and serve immediately.

title: Tunisian Harissa
ingredients: 1 cup raw or toasted ground nuts | 2 large egg whites | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Using a large metal spoon, stir together the nut and raw or toasted ground nuts. Place the egg whites in a large bowl, and whisk on high speed with vanilla until egg whites are frothy. Lower the mixer speed to medium and drizzle in egg white mixture. Mix until the mixture is dry but not dry. Fold in nutmeg. Transfer the batter to the prepared baking sheet, and sprinkle generously with additional nutmeg. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, until the tunisian tops are browned and crispy.

title: Chipotle Pepper Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast | 2 -3 canned chipotle chiles, chopped | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 cup feta, crumbled | 2 tablespoons chili
instructions: Place in the refrigerator to marinate for at least 1 hour. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. Slice the rump roast in half and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Place the beef in a roasting tin and sprinkle with the chipotles. Put in your oven on the middle shelf and leave to cook for 15 minutes. Turn the oven down to 140c and leave to cook for another hour.

title: Linguine With Cauliflower
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 12 ounces cauliflower flakes | 5 ounces screwwiz beer ( or other beer ) | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon rock salt ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. While pasta is cooking, combine cauliflower and remaining ingredients except for the salt into a pot. Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook 3 - 4 minutes or until the cauliflower is completely tender. Drain and serve with noodles.

title: Lebanese Oven Vegetables
ingredients: 6 small new potatoes | 2 turnips | 2 sprigs fresh mint leaves | 2 1/2 ounces fresh corn, boiled and kernels roasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c gas mark 6/190°c prick the skin of the potato with a fork and bake until tender about 30 mins or until cooked tender. Meanwhile peel and slice the turnips and potatoes into 1/2 inch dice. Scatter into a baking tray and bake for 10 - 12 mins or untill tender but not mushy. Meanwhile dry roast the mint in a dry frying pan. When just starting to burn, add the corn and cook on low for 2 mins toss occasionally. When ready to serve, heap the vegetables onto plates and drizzle generously with the mint and serve.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,italian seasoning,lime juice,red onion,plain white flour,chicken bouillon cube,thai fish sauce
title: Creamy Ricotta With Coconut Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain white flour, sifted | 1/4 cup skim milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 1/2 cups skim milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cubes | 1/4 small red onion, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh lime juice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl, whisk thoroughly until smooth. Add enough water to mixture to make a smooth, pliable batter. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 200c. Line a baking tray with baking paper, place in the oven and bake the batter for 15 minutes or until it is golden. Serve immediately with the coconut gravy on the side. Store leftover gravy in an airtight container in the fridge.

title: Peaches and Chocolates
ingredients: 6 fresh peaches - peeled, pitted and sliced | 1/3 cup white sugar
instructions: Combine the peaches, sugar, and peach liqueur in a microwave safe bowl. Cover the bowl with a damp towel, and microwave on high 7 minutes, or until the peaches have tenderized and the sugar is melted and a thickened paste has formed, stirring after 2 minutes to prevent burning. Cool completely before slicing into 1/2 inch rounds using a serrated knife.

title: Warm Fondue
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salted walnut oil | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 4 fresh white mushrooms, sliced | 6 fresh orange slices | 2 bay leaves | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 8 toasted dinner rolls | chopped fresh dill, for serving
instructions: In a saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Cook mushrooms with the zest, salt, and orange zest until tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in the orange slices, bay leaves, and horseradish. Ladle hot fondue into a fondue pot or crockpot set to medium. Float the rolls on top.

title: Nabalese Chayote Curry - Spicy Fried Chayote!
ingredients: 2 lbs large chayote | 2/3 cup ghee ( clarified butter ) | 4 tablespoons chili powder | 4 dried ancho chilies
instructions: Wash chayote well several times and put in a large saucepan. Scrape the peel off a large piece of skin from the chayote with your hands. Cut in half or thirds, crossways. In a medium sized frying pan, heat the ghee on medium heat. When hot, add the chayote and stir. Add the chili powder and stir until they become a dark brown colour. Add a few drops of water to keep them from sticking together. Continue to stir constantly. Turn the heat to medium. When the chayote is a little golden on the bottom, add a few drops of water, one or two drops of water if needed, just to moisten the chayote lightly. If the water is too low to give it a depth of one or two inches, turn the heat down a bit. When the chayote is done, it can be eaten immediately. The chayote keeps well for 2 - 3 days in the fridge.

title: Sizzlin' Sujoy
ingredients: 1/4 cup oil | 1 cup seedless bamboo shoot, sliced in thin strips | 1/3 cup raisins
instructions: Heat oil in a non stick skillet over medium heat. Once oil is very hot, add the sliced bamboo and saute until the bamboo is crisp and beginning to soften. Once it is crisp add the raisins and keep on stirring. Serve with fried rice.

title: Halibut and Roasted Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 1 package uncooked fettuccine | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1/3 cup diced drained canned plum tomato | 12 frozen cut halibut fillets | 3 frozen small pitted ripe olives with liquid, sliced | 2 frankfurters, sliced | 1 jar sliced pimiento slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Tiny Fudge (Caramelized)
ingredients: 6 ounces cornmeal | 6 ounces salt ( coarsely ground maize corn ) | 3 drops vanilla essence, approx. 3 tbsp | 1 pinch of salt
instructions: First of all, it's very important to dissolve all salt in hot water. Soak cornmeal and cornmeal in it for around 30 mins in a very warm and dry place. Then put on the heat to keep continuously stirring and keep adding your dry ingredients to avoid sticking and burning. I keep this warm while you use milk. It becomes more difficult to stir but, after the 15 mins/100 deg/1 hr/3 cups it's okay. After that, if the mixture becomes too thick, you can add more cornmeal. Once the cornmeal is firm and creamy, transfer to buttered pan and spread the cooled mixture. If it becomes too dry, you could add more liquid. Cool completely and then set it on a flat surface. When cool, cut the mixture into about 1 squares.

title: Pignoli
ingredients: 2 ounces pine nuts | 5 tablespoons anise, finely grated
instructions: Pour the pine nuts into a dish and sprinkle with the anise seed.

Random Ingredients: beef,greek yogurt,beef rump roast,flour tortilla,corn flake,chunky salsa,garam masala,emmenthaler cheese
title: Yum Yum Meat Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 beef rump roast | 2 ounces shredded emmenthaler cheese or 2 ounces provolone cheese | 1/2 cup chunky salsa or 1/2 cup taco sauce, if desired | 1 tablespoon flour ( for dredging meat ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 large flour tortillas | 1/3 cup greek yogurt or 1/3 cup plain greek yogurt, if desired | 8 corn flakes
instructions: Wash meat and cut into thin strips. Season meat with salt and pepper between your fingers. Place meat in a ziplock bag. Sprinkle with half of the cheese. Close bag and shake to coat meat well, but not get it mushy. Remove meat from bag and drain excess marinade. Place meat in the centre of a tortilla. Sprinkle with remaining cheese, salsa and flour. Fold the tortilla over the meat, tucking in the excess. Cook on a hot ungreased griddle. Brown on both sides. Wrap in plastic and keep warm in a 200f oven. Repeat with second tortilla. Serve with the yogurt and some corn flakes, if desired. Note, if making your own hummus, add 1/3 cup yogurt, 3/4 cup sour cream or sour cream, 1 cup of salsa and 4 cornflakes, to the meat. To freeze, heat on the grill.

title: Manicotti with Taco Seasonings
ingredients: 4 manicotti | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in manicotti and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

title: Sambhar (Cheese Dip)
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons sambhar | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Mix sambhar & asafoetida. Let it marinade for around 2 days. Serve with your favourite bread bread.

Random Ingredients: oat bran,biscotti,caster sugar,irish moss,plain flour,spring onion,maple syrup,butter
title: An Irish Snack Loaf
ingredients: 500 g plain flour | 1/2 cup oats bran | 1/2 cup oat bran | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 1/3 cups mixed plain flour | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 1/2 cups irish moss | 12 tablespoons unsalted butter, cubed | 1 bunch spring onion, roughly chopped, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c line two baking trays with baking paper, then lightly grease with a tablespoon of olive oil. Whisk flour, oats, oat bran, sugar and half the mixed plain flour into two large bowl. Make a well in centre and add half the maple syrup plus the moss and the other half of the maple syrup. Whisk until combined then gently mix in the butter until well combined. Stir in the spring onions and turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Divide dough between your lined baking trays, pressing into 5cm / 1/2 thicknesses. Brush top and sides of loaf with half the butter. Bake blind for 20 minutes until golden brown and cooked. To serve, cut loaf crosswise into 5 slices. Arrange on a plate and scatter over remaining butter and chopped spring onions.

Random Ingredients: carrot,sugar,superfine sugar,blackberry,nicoise olive,black coffee,beef chuck roast,cornmeal
title: Caribbean Beef Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs beef chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups sliced nicoise olives | 2 cups grated fresh carrots | 1 can blackberries, rinsed and drained | 2 cups freshly brewed strong black coffee | 6 tablespoons superfine sugar | cornmeal | 1/2 cup granulated sugar | 10 teaspoons unsalted black cracked blackberries
instructions: Place all ingredients except blackberries in a 3 1/2 or 4 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on high setting 3 1/2 to 4 hours, rearranging potatoes halfway through cooking. Stir berries into stew and cook, uncovered, 15 minutes. Remove beef and vegetables from slow cooker and place on platter. Pour juices over the meat. Serve with blackberries.

title: Chutney Chutney Appetizer
ingredients: 200 g chutney | 200 g ice cubes or 200 g ice cubes, crushed | 3 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a food processor and puree until smooth. Mash the mixture until it thickens. Add more chutney to your taste.

Random Ingredients: mirin,avocado,turmeric powder,lime wedge,onion powder,sea salt black pepper,mint leaf,creme de cacao
title: Chile Con Queso (Onion-Avocado Fritters)
ingredients: 2 avocados, halved and pitted | creme de cacao ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons dried mint leaves or 2 teaspoons fresh mint ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt & freshly ground black pepper ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon cumin ( to taste ) | lime wedge ( to garnish ) | vietnamese mint & mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Using a fork, mash the avocado and cèiqueur together. Place in a bowl and mix well. Season with salt, pepper, cumin and mint. Serve on top of chilled crème de cacao and garnish with lime wedges.

title: French Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 4 cans ready-to-use tomatoes seasoned with garlic and herbs, undrained | 1 can tomato sauce, undiluted
instructions: Drain off excess liquid from tomato cans. Place ingredients in a 3 to 4 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours.

title: French Bread
ingredients: 500 g strong white flour | 1 packet dry yeast
instructions: Heat your oven. Mix the yeast with your flour and enough lukewarm water to make a thick sponge and put in a bowl. Stir in the remaining water and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour. Heat the oven to 230c put the dough on a floured board, knead and shape into two round loafs the length of the loaf. Put on a baking tray and cover as it will rise, or lightly brush with oil. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,tea,yogurt,macadamia nut,mustard powder,prosciutto di parma
title: Smoked Macadamia Macadamia Nut and Prosciutto Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb prosciutto di parma, thinly sliced and cut di parma strips into 1/4-inch sticks ( about 3 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup chopped roasted macadamia nuts | 1/2 cup chopped red cabbage | 1/2 cup fat-free natural brewed tea | 3/4 cup lowfat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon mustard powder
instructions: In a large bowl, combine prosciutto strips, macadamia nuts, cabbage and tea and toss to mix. In a small bowl, combine yogurt and mustard and stir until smooth, about 2 minutes. Drizzle yogurts and dressing over salad and toss until salad is coated. Cover and chill 2 hours. Makes 2 servings.

Random Ingredients: onion,greek yogurt,tamarind pod,baby red potato,cilantro,yukon gold potato
title: Tamarind Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds baby red potatoes | 2 yukon gold potatoes | 1 container plain greek-style yogurt | 1/4 onion, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup tamarind pods, finely chopped
instructions: Place the potatoes in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 30 minutes. Remove potatoes from the broth, cool to room temperature, then chop the potatoes. Place the yukon gold potatoes into a saucepan, and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, cool, and chop. To make the yogurt dressing, whisk together everything except the cilantro in a medium bowl. When the fries are cool, stir in the cilantro, yogurt, and diced potatoes. Cover, and refrigerate until serving.

title: Honey-Tamari Sauce for Beef Steaks
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander powder ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Combine tamari or soy sauce and honey. Place all of the ingredients in a glass dish and refrigerate until ready to use. Trim all excess fat or connective tissue from the steak. Cut steak into 1 pieces and pour sauce over steak.

title: Onion Whip with Cream for a Crowd
ingredients: 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon dried onion flakes
instructions: Whisk the cream, onion powder, and dried onion flakes together in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Pizza Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rutabagas, grated | 1/2 cup shredded sweet pepperoni | 1/4 cup grapeseed oil or 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 3/4 cup shredded pecans | 3 medium granny smith apples, peeled, cored and cut into thin wedges | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 tablespoon miracle whip | 1 fresh thyme sprig | 1 -2 teaspoon light muscovado wine ( or to taste )
instructions: Mix together grated rutabagas, pecans, apples, sherry, miracle whip, nutmeg, and thyme. Sour cream to serve. Serve with additional sherry if desired.

title: Aussie Burger Mix
ingredients: 3 fluid ounces unsweetened applesauce | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum | 2 tablespoons dried curry powder | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/4 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Bell Pepper and Carrots
ingredients: 5 baby carrots or 15 small frozen carrots | 1 yellow bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: Trim top of the carrots with a vegetable peeler and remove the stem. Slice carrots in half widthwise and slice thinly along the length. If using fresh carrots place them whole in a large pot or baking dish,. Cover carrots with cold water, add the lid and bring to an almost rolling boil. Cook over low heat, covered, about 30 minutes or until the carrots are tender to the tooth.. Drain the carrots well and return to pot. If using frozen carrots, cover with cold water by about 1/ cup and bring to rolling boil. Cook over high heat, covered until carrots are tender, about 30 minutes. Toss them slightly and check for salt.

title: Homestyle Bacon Shashlyk
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 1/4 cups yoghurt | 1 1/4 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon whole cumin seed
instructions: Heat the bacon drippings in a fry pan on medium. Add the yoghurt. Mix well and then add the spices. Mix well and continue to heat the liquid until the liquid reduces to a gravy. You may need to add a little water while cooking, or even up to 1 cup. Serve with bread, or a vegetable/chicken dish.

title: Channa Dal With Turnips and Black Olives
ingredients: 1 cup rasd dal | 12 ounces seltzer water | 1 large turnip, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 6 black olives | 2 tablespoons chopped chipotle powder | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a stockpot, add rasd dal, turnip, olives and chipotle powder. Boil for five minutes, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until turnip is tender. Drain. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with raisins.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,chili oil,shallot,basil leaf,mozzarella cheese,chicken stock,dark chocolate
title: Basil Chicken Burgers (Churros With Chocolate)
