ingredients: 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1 2/3 cups basil leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, grated | 400 g boneless skinless chicken breasts, chopped | 2 slices shallots | 50 g mozzarella cheese, thinly sliced | 4 hamburger buns, toasted
instructions: Combine stock and basil in small saucepan, bring to boil. Remove from heat, stir in chocolate, keep warm. Heat oven to 200°c. Place chicken in shallow bowl, cover with a mixture of shallots and sauce, pour over chicken. Spoon mixture onto rolls, top with cheese. Serve with rolls.

title: Turkey and Yellow Squash Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs turkey breast, cubed | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 large yellow squash, cut into 2 slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f place turkey in ovenproof skillet.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,pearl barley,romaine lettuce,kraft mexican cheese,thyme leaf,chickpea,shrimp paste
title: Chunky Barley Bean & Beef Fingers
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 lb uncooked medium raw shrimp paste | 2 cups drained canned chickpeas | 1 1/2 cups kraft mexican style cheese with herb | 1 packet frozen pearl barley | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leaves | 2 heads romaine lettuce, cleaned
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f in small bowl, stir together flour and thyme. Using fork, cut shrimp paste into 1 inch pieces. Add shrimp paste and chile, toss to coat. Place in ungreased shallow baking sheet. Combine chickpeas, cheese with herb and 1 tsp thyme in bowl of food processor. Process until dough forms. Press half of dough mixture evenly over each square of dough, then top with another half of dough mixture. Press top seams of dough together. Cut top crusts from each square of dough. Using pastry cutter, cut a slit in each dough square. Bake 25 min or until golden, top of dough is puffed and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,pearl onion,grain white rice,sesame oil,clam juice,liquid honey,golden syrup,red chilies
title: Chile Congee (Mexican Style White Rice)
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl onions | 2 cups quick-cooking long-grain white rice | 2 cups bottled clam juice ( reserved from cooking onions, not the bottled stuff ) | 1/2 cup sesame oil | 1 small dried red chilies | 1/2 cup golden syrup ( or brown sugar ) | 2 teaspoons liquid honey | finely shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Rinse the rice well under running water, drain, and set aside. Cut the frozen onions slices in half and place into a food processor with 1 cup of the lukewarm water. Turn on and slowly add the rice, 1/2 cup of the reserved clam juice, and the sesame oil. Turn on and slowly add the remaining clam juice if necessary. Continue to process, pulsing and scraping until the rice is finely chopped but not entirely smooth yet. Turn off and set in a large warmed serving bowl. Meanwhile, clean the chilies, dry and cut off the ends with scissors and slice the long green ones in half lengthwise and place into a small bowl. Heat the sesame oil in a small saucepan and add the chiles and golden syrup. Cook over low heat until the chiles are softened and the syrup smells aromatic, about 5 minutes. Stir in the honey and remove from heat. When serving, ladle a large scoop of the congee into the center of the soup bowl and swirl with a fork to lightly coat the sides of the bowl. Top with the chile and onion mixture and garnish with a generous sprinkling of the shredded cheese.

title: Turnip Filling for Oven Pancake
ingredients: 4 turnips | 3 aubergines
instructions: Peel and dice turnips. Cut diagonally into thin slices. Bake in preheated oven 450f for 45 minutes or until they are soft. Turn fry off. Sprinkle turnip generously with salt. When cool enough to handle but still warm, roll the turnip slices round and place in an ovenproof pan. Scatter the aubergines around the turnip until the slices are covered. Bake 1 - 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,honey mustard,green chile pepper,brown lentil,beef chuck,black bean,lime wedge,american cheese
title: Texas-Style Mashed Chili
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground beef chuck | 1 cup dry brown lentils | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves, or to taste | 2 tablespoons honey mustard | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp white american cheese, divided | 4 lime wedges, or as desired
instructions: Place ground chuck in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until ground chuck is no longer pink in the center, about 15 minutes. Drain off any excess grease. Once cooked, crumble ground chuck into the pot along with the lentils, black beans, green chile peppers, oregano, and mustard. Transfer to an electric slow cooker, cover, and simmer on low until heated through, about 25 minutes. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place 1 cup cheese in a small baking dish and set aside in the oven to melt. Remove the crusts from the cheese, then cut into small chunks. Spoon cooked mince mixture into a container and place in the oven to keep warm. Serve hot with grated cheese and lime wedges.

title: Lemongrass Pouro
ingredients: 2 cups beef broth ( or 1 1/2 cups beef broth with water ) | 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 teaspoons palm sugar | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, chopped | 2 ounces dried pears, sliced | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon creme de cassis
instructions: Whisk broth and ketchup together with 1 teaspoon sugar, add lemongrass, pears and cranberries simmer for 10 minutes or until liquid is absorbed, serve over your choice of meat.

title: Pasta With Red Pepper and Raisins
ingredients: 3 cups cooked rigatoni pasta | 1 large red bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil. Add pasta.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,prosciutto,yellow mustard seed,peanut oil vegetable,beef brisket,coconut oil,red potato,bay seasoning
title: Amanda's Beef Brisket Stew-Coconut Pot With Noodles (Crock Pot or Oven)
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed and cut into 10 pieces | 3 lbs medium red potatoes, cut into 10 pieces | 2 tablespoons paprika for stew ( can be 2 tbsp ) | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 4 thin slices prosciutto | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning ( or other seasoning ) | 3/4 cup sweetened flaked coconut oil ( plus additional oil for greasing the crock pot, for dredging the dish )
instructions: If you have a crock pot, set your crock pot on low and add the beef, potatoes, and 3/4 teaspoon black pepper to your crock pot. Do no pre heat your oil in the pot while the beef and potatoes are cooking. If needed, turn on your oven to 400 degrees f. Add the mustard seeds and the old bay seasoning to your oil and whisk for a minute. Once the liquid from the beef and potatoes has been thoroughly mixed with the spices, add the remaining 2/3 cup of sweetened flaked coconut oil and mix. You can use fresh coconut oil not as expensive here. Pour contents of the blender into your crock pot, and mix well, and add the beef/pot. Cook about seven hours on low, or 8 hours on high. Serve with white rice, or noodles, and enjoy.

title: Prawn and Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground beef | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 large yellow squash | 1 cup sliced shiitake mushroom | 1 cup chopped red peppers or 1 cup green pepper | 1 cup radish, sliced | 1 cup shelled pumpkin seeds | 8 ounces linguine, cooked and drained
instructions: Brown ground beef in frying pan until crumbly. Slice squash and squash in half. Remove seeds from pepper if desired. Slice peppers into slivers. Remove excess moisture from mushrooms if desired. Slice mushrooms into thin strips. Stir fry mushrooms and peppers in oil until peppers begin to soften. Add peppers and squash. Mix well. Remove from heat, mix in meat and add remaining ingredients. Heat through. Serve over warm linguine.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,red pepper,sherry wine,pita chip
title: Greek Pita Chips and Roasted Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 large red peppers, cut in half lengthwise, seeds removed ( about 6-7 ounces ) | 1/2 cup pita chips ( greek style ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: On a large plate, arrange peppers cut side up and sprinkle with a little salt.

title: Macaroni for ABM (Abm)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs macaroni | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Put the macaroni in the bowl of a 2 to 3 pound food processor, fitted with the metal chopping blade. Sprinkle the yeast over the top, and set aside. Scatter a few drops of water into a bowl that is large enough to contain the dough, and stir enough of the water to make a batter. Let sit for 30 minutes. Add a bit more water to the mixture, if it seems dry. Mix together the yeast, dough, and water, then begin to mix in flour a little at a time until the dough is stiff enough to knead. Knead until smooth and elastic, adding more flour if necessary. Place in a greased bowl, cover with a towel, and let rise in a warm place until double. Punch it down to rise, and divide into 3 or 4 equal portions, placing each piece on a floured baking or parchment lined baking sheet. Let rise until doubled, 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or however long it should take for your oven to rise. Bake the bread at 450 degrees fahrenheit or center for 20 seconds, or until the bottoms feel dry. Note, the 2 pound package of yeast used in this dish may be difficult to find.

Random Ingredients: vital wheat gluten,golden mushroom soup,chicken breast,salad oil
title: Easy Chicken in a Bowl of Hoosier
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salad oil | 2 chicken breasts, about 2 lb, skinless | 4 cups mixed salad greens ( italian's best mixed ) or 4 cups mixed salad greens | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet or dutch oven over medium high heat about 3 - 5 minutes. Add chicken and cook 7 - 10 minutes, turning once. Add salad greens and soup, reduce heat to low for 6 - 8 minutes or until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Arepas (Mexican Wedding Candy)
ingredients: 1 can almond milk | 1 jar medium salsa | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: In medium bowl, mix all ingredients. Chill for 30 minutes to set the texture. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper lined cookie sheets. When they are cool, roll them in coconut or pistachios.

title: Lentil Cake
ingredients: 400 g green lentils | 1 small cooking onion, chopped | 4 -5 g icing sugar | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 papayas, chopped or 1 mango, chopped
instructions: Wash the lentils very well. Take a little of the lentils water from the pan, drain the lentils. Heat a pan over high flame, add one half tsp of icing sugar, then cook one minute, stirring, until the sugar begins to melt, then stir in the chopped onion. Spread out into the middle of a greased 20cm cake or 25cm spring form tin. Sprinkle over half the icing sugar then scatter over the papaya or mango. Seal with the remaining icing sugar and bake in oven for about 30 minutes or until firm in the centre. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,beer,cream mushroom soup,arrowroot,garlic powder,chickpea flour,salt pepper,sugar
title: Chickpea Burgers
ingredients: 3 cans chickpea flour | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 3/4 cup beer | 1 tablespoon arrowroot, dissolved in
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add soup, beer and yeast. Mix very well. Divide mixture into six patties. Fry on each side until done.

title: Ethiopian Cardamom Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar beef broth | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the beef broth and cardamom seeds. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly. Skim and discard any foam that forms on the surface. Pour the sauce into a medium bowl, and whisk in the cardamom. Serve hot.

title: Bastur Yakh (Anchovy and Cardamom Roast Chicken)
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens, quartered | 2 pods green cardamoms, cracked | 2 whole anchovies, crushed
instructions: Place the cardamom pods, cardamom pods, and anchovies into a small bowl. Stuff the chicken with the cardamom mixture, and tie the legs under the chicken to absorb any juices. Arrange the chicken on a rack set in a roasting pan, and cover loosely with aluminum foil. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place the whole chicken in the oven, and roast the chicken until the internal juices run clear, about 35 to 45 minutes. Allow the chicken to rest for 10 to 15 minutes before removing it from the pan. Pour out all but 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid, and reduce the leftover cooking liquid. Pour the reduced roasting liquid back into the roasting pan, and scrape into a blender/jar to blend the mixture. Return the roasting pan to the oven, and roast until the chicken is browned, about 30 to 40 minutes, basting occasionally.

title: Pineapple, Beef and Port Sauce
ingredients: 1 quart half-and-half cream | 3/4 cup kefalotiri | 4 tablespoons port wine or 4 tablespoons marsala | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 lb stew meat, cut in bite-size chunks | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Combine half and half, kroepte cheese and 1 tbsp paprika. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add port and pineapple juice. When it starts to bubble, return to boil. Add meat and 1/4 cup water. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered for 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Serve over cooked elbow noodles.

Random Ingredients: beef eye,allspice,american cheese,confectioner ' sugar,romano cheese,pork belly
title: Mama's Famous Roast Pork and Welsh Style Cheese
ingredients: 4 lbs beef eye round ( or sirloin ) | 2 lbs pork belly ( or shoulder, or a combination ) | 6 -8 english cheese | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon allspice | 2 romano cheese, grated | confectioners'sugar, to dust
instructions: Slice roast thin to the thickness you desire. Place all meat in an oven safe pan or casserole. Top with cheese over meat and sprinkle with confectioner's sugar and allspice. Let dry for a few hours. Sprinkle grated romano over cheese bake uncovered in a 325 degree oven for 15 – 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly. Let cool for 5 – 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pasta with Shallots, Mushrooms and Portabella
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cake flour, plus more for dusting | 2 ounces dried rigatoni pasta ( about 1 cup ) | 1 ounce dried portabella mushrooms, soaked in water until softened, and then cut into strips | 6 shallots, peeled and coarsely chopped ( about 1 to 1 1/4 cups )
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and 1/2 teaspoon sugar until it forms a loose, moist paste. Stir in mushrooms until coated and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat.

Random Ingredients: chick pea,yellow onion,italian tomato,flour tortilla,stone wheat flour,jumbo pasta shell
title: Chef John's Birthday Tomatoes & Chickpeas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons stone ground whole wheat flour, or as needed | 1 can peeled italian-style tomatoes, chopped, no water added, drained, chopped, or liquid reserved | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 2 cans chick-peas, drained | 1 package jumbo pasta shells, jumbo cooked | 4 large flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Mix stone ground flour, tomatoes, onion, and chickpeas together in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,self raising flour,rice wine,canadian bacon
title: Bacon and Great Northern Friands
ingredients: 2 cups self raising flour | 4 pieces canadian bacon, chopped small | 5 tablespoons rice wine | 2 cans great northern beans, undrained
instructions: Combine flour, canadian bacon and rice wine mix gently, then add beans. Form into 2 balls. Place on greased oven trays and flatten slightly to 3/4 inch thick. Cook at 375f for 35 - 40 minutes or until browned and crispy.

title: Braised Cabbage with Chilies and Dill
ingredients: 150 g red cabbage, shredded | 1 chicken stock cube | 4 -5 large chilies, deseeded if available | 1/4 cup dill sprigs, to garnish ( fresh dill )
instructions: Put the cabbage in a large saucepan. Add the chicken stock cube and bring to the boil over a high heat. Reduce the heat slightly and simmer uncovered for 12 - 15 minutes until the cabbage has softened up dramatically. Meanwhile, preheat your oven to 180c, gas mk remove the chillies from the stalks. Roughly chop the chillies and add them to the simmering cabbage along with the dill. Spoon the cabbage mixture back into the pan. Place in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes. When ready to serve, remove the chillies from the pan and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with the grated cheddar or other tasty cheese just before serving.

title: Ragi's Special "Lasagna"
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mixed vegetables, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 1 quart whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 lb white chocolate, finely chopped | 2 cups rigatoni pasta | pepper
instructions: Heat oven to in bowl mix all ingredients together, place in a 9x13 or other suitable baking dish and bake for 15 - 20 minutes at 400 degrees.

Random Ingredients: asparagus tip,flat leaf parsley,romaine lettuce,marshmallow,catsup,rosemary leaf,white flour
title: Lettuce and Asparagus Appetizer (Low Fat)
ingredients: 12 small asparagus tips ( about 1 lb/625g ) | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups fresh flat-leaf parsley ( or basil leaves, or basil ) or 1 1/2 cups basil leaves, sliced thickly ( or basil leaves, or basil leaves, or basil leaves, or basil leaves, or basil leaves, or basil leaves ) | 12 large romaine lettuce, heads washed and patted dry ( or other curly lettuce ) | 1/2 cup low-fat catsup or 1/2 cup heinz ketchup | 1/2 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves, crushed
instructions: Remove stalk from asparagus spears and discard and discard remainder of asparagus tips and heads. Slice off tips of stalks, then coarsely chop. Arrange asparagus on large platter or tray and sprinkle evenly with coarse salt, or to taste. Sprinkle lightly with coarse sugar. Prepare sauce while the asparagus is cooking or when it is about 45 minutes before you want to serve, remove asparagus tips from sauce. When time is up, remove asparagus pieces, cut into 1 lengths, then cut each strip diagonally into 3 or 4 lengths. Arrange on platter and cover. Prepare sauce while salad is cooking, mix ketchup, wine vinegar, rosemary ingredients in small bowl with 1/2 cup water until mixture is smooth and creamy. When salad is done, arrange 1 lettuce leaf on the bottom of a small serving dish. Pour 1/4 cup sauce over lettuce. Lay remaining lettuce leaves on top of the asparagus, then spoon on remaining sauce. Sprinkle asparagus with coarse sugar. Serve with extra sauce on side.

title: Molho Con Carrot (Carrots and Carrots)
ingredients: 2 carrots, peeled and cut into about four | 200 g olives
instructions: Cook the carrots in boiling water for five minutes, then drain well. Sprinkle with a little salt before serving.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,hoisin sauce,table salt,cream,egg yolk,onion flake,curry powder
title: Curried Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup granulated sugar | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 3 tablespoons hot curry powder | 2/3 cup regular sour cream | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce
instructions: Beat egg yolks and sugar until pale, creamy and doubled in volume. Remove from heat. Add curry, sour cream, onion flakes and hoisin sauce.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,vanilla ice cream,green chile pepper lengthwise,olive,knorr chicken bouillon,pimiento,sun tomato oil
title: Creamy Tomato-Pimento Soup
ingredients: 1 liter of your favourite tomato sauce | 1 can chopped green chile peppers, undrained | 1 jar of your favourite pimientos ( drained in olive oil, drained ) | 1 package knorr chicken bouillon ( chicken flavored ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/2 cup pitted ripe olives, sliced lengthwise | vanilla ice cream
instructions: In a large soup pot, mix all the ingredients, except for the vanilla so that all the ingredients have a nice consistency. Pour entire contents of the tomatoes and pimentos over the mixture. Cook under low medium heat for about 20 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Ethiopian Spicy Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb skinless boneless pork shoulder | 3 -4 tablespoons shredded pork fat | 1 teaspoon saffron strand | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Cut pork into thin chunks. Wrap saffron in cheesecloth. Place meat in slow cooker. Add saffron, sugar, celery seeds and beans and stir. Cover, cook on low for 6 and 7 hours. Remove meat, discard cheesecloth and put meat, cheesecloth back on top.

title: Cactus Bite
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt or 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped peach | 2 tablespoons crumbled cotija cheese | grated lemon peel | 2 cups soda water or 2 cups sparkling mineral water
instructions: Blend thoroughly the first 5 ingredients. Pour soda or mineral water evenly over the blend and stir gently. Serve at once.

title: Mexican Meatball Dip
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 2 cans tomato sauce | 14 ounces black olives, drained ( use a good quality olive ) | plain yogurt ( use low fat, i've tried with yogurt here )
instructions: Heat stock to boiling point. Remove from heat. Add tomato sauce & olives. Cover & leave to stand 1 hour. Tip, i've not deliberately suggested this, as i love it fresh & hearty, but you want it to have the texture of a paste. Tip, for texture i prefer a smooth consistency of mashed potatoes & perhaps a milder one, i use a little hot olive oil. For the dip i find that this is always a little on the dry side when i use a food processor, but it improves without this gratification. The oil from the olives is also delicious the next day. The olive pieces are a great addition after a day or two in other dishes as well.

Random Ingredients: sugar,ranch bean,vanilla essence,monterey jack cheese,pork shoulder,maple syrup,cocoa powder
title: Mexican Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can ranch style beans, drained | 2 tablespoons cornbread-flavored cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons sugar | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: In medium skillet, melt the cornbread cornbread mix and set aside until ready to use. Spray crockpot with nonstick cooking spray and add pork in 2 batches. Brown evenly on all sides. Remove to crockpot with a slotted spoon. Stir the beans and other half of the ingredients together. Pour onto pork in crockpot. Cook on lo heat for 6 - 10 hours or on hi heat for 4 - 5 hours until pork is tender and beans are hot about 1 hour. Using slotted spoon, remove pork and place on large platter. Pour pork fondue from crockpot onto platter. Garnish with shredded cheese.

title: Beef Tenderloin for Two (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 12 ounces beef tenderloins | 4 cups fresh spinach, stemmed, washed and drained | 1 can chickpea flour | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1 2/3 cups filet of beef, trimmed of excess fat
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker except the beef. Cover and cook on high setting for 3 to 4 hours, or low setting for 10 to 12 hours. Turn the beef after 2 to 3 hours and allow to set for 1 hour. Slice and serve.

title: Wild Rice and Celery Root  Filling for Pierogi
ingredients: 1 lb wild rice, washed | 1 -2 stick celery root, peeled | celery seed, crushed by rubbing
instructions: Boil rice for about half an hour until it is tender. Remove and let cool. Peel off any stalks of the celery root, wash well. Chop into large pieces and set aside. Rinse and drain cooked rice in a colander. Cut the celery roots into 2 inch pieces and stir in about 4 cups of water. Sprinkle celery root mixture with celery seeds. Mix well and put into bread mold that has been lightly buttered with butter. Refrigerate until required.

title: Cheese Cantaloupe
ingredients: 1 cantaloupe, peeled and seeded | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 3 drops ginger ale | 2 teaspoons pickles, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest, finely chopped
instructions: Cut cantaloupe in half seed the halves. Spread flesh side of the halves with cheese. Poke cantaloupe with a fork and sprinkle with ginger ale. Sprinkle pickles over all and bake at 350f for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Ricotta Cheese Bread Pizzas
ingredients: 3 cups ricotta cheese | 3 slices whole wheat pita bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine the ricotta, pita bread, and 1 1/2 tablespoons melted butter. Spread the dough into 3 pizza pans. Bake pizza in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,onion,shiitake mushroom,espresso powder,tortilla,italian seasoning,masa harina,french bread
title: A Mighty Finey Burritos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant coffee powder | 1 tablespoon instant masa harina | 1 packet frozen chopped onions, thawed | 1 1/2 cups uncooked instant beef-and-mushroom mix ( such as jiffy ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 10 12 tortillas | 2 cups hot cooked rice or 2 cups instant white rice | 1 cup shaved french bread
instructions: In a small heat proof bowl, combine instant coffee, masa harina, onions and italian seasoning. Place tortillas on baking sheet and toast in 450 degree oven for 7 - 8 minutes, or until lightly browned. Spoon beef and mushroom mix into tortillas and sprinkle with shaved bread. Roll up and eat.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,tuna water,sherry wine,salt black pepper,brandy,lobster tail
title: Lobster Toss
ingredients: 1/2 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons brandy | 3 pounds fresh lobster tail, with shell, divided | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour, divided | 2 cups beef bouillon, divided
instructions: Stir sherry, brandy, and 2 lobster shells together in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour. Season lobster halves on one side with salt and pepper. Dust with flour, place on a cutting board, and slice into 1/2 inch thick pieces. Heat half of curry sauce seasoning in a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Dried Potato With Greek Olives from the Freeze Freeze Freeze Freeze
ingredients: 1 kg potato flakes ( or more ) | 1 kg greek olive, sliced
instructions: Take your potato flakes and boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Add 4 1/2 cups of water to the baking potatoes and stir. Pour to your freezer. Leave and cook until the mixture is solid. Use in your favourite cake recipe.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 packages dry chicken noodle mix | 3 stalks celery, diced | 2 dill pickles with rings, chopped | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the chicken noodles, celery, pickle, and vinegar. Cover, and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,chili pepper flake,salsa,mozzarella cheese,sev,watermelon,hot red chilies
title: Basque Steamed Watermelon Dip
ingredients: 1 melon, halved and stone cut away | 5 cups water | 2 cups salsa | 3 -6 red hot chilies, deseeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 4 tablespoons mozzarella cheese, grated | 2 -4 sprigs rosemary, garnish
instructions: Place melon halves cut side down on a flat surface. Cover with a plate pressing down hard on the surface with your fingers to release some juice. Turn over and sprinkle with salt. Repeat to assemble the remaining melons. Leave the meat in the original plate. Place 2 cups of water over medium high heat in a 12 cup saucepan. Add salsa, red chillies, chili flakes, and 1 tbsp each of the cheese and rosemary. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and cover. Place a small plate under the melon so it can stand upright. Carefully slip an ice cube into the water before turning out onto the plate. Serve with a slice of melon on the side.

title: Almond Feta Pita Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 cup crouton ( french bread ) | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup slivered almonds, or to taste | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground thyme | 2 teaspoons white flour | 1 tablespoon crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon white flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground thyme | 2 tablespoons white flour | 2 teaspoons ground almonds | 3 pita bread rounds, split
instructions: Place 1 cup croutons and 1 cup feta cheese in a bowl, toss to blend. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon almond extract, 1/2 teaspoon ground thyme, 2 teaspoons white flour, 1 tablespoon ground almonds, 1 teaspoon white flour, and 2 teaspoons ground almonds into crouton mixture. Shape croutons into 2 inch patties. Lightly grease a grill. Grill patties 5 minutes on each side or until golden brown. To make guacamole spread 1 tablespoon olive oil onto cut edge of cut sides of pita bread. Arrange 1/4 of the crumbled feta cheese evenly on the cut side of the pita bread.

title: Mashed Potato Balls
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Peel and cut the potatoes into small chunks. Place potatoes in a bowl and cover with cold water. Let stand until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain well and transfer to a bowl. Beat potatoes into softened buttery mashed potatoes. While potatoes are still warm, sprinkle with cocoa powder. Stir until smooth. Pour coconut milk into a separate deep pan and boil until the liquid reduces completely. Stirring frequently and waiting for liquid to reduce completely, about 5 minutes. Place in a bowl and roll mixture in the coconut milk to coat. Chill for 1 hour.

title: California Gazpacho
ingredients: 1 lb fresh white-flavored bread | 1 lb cucumber, halved lengthwise | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 inch fresh gingerroot, peeled and grated | 1/2 cup white vinegar
instructions: Cut bread into 1 inch cubes. Place on baking sheet, and bake at 350 degrees f. For 15 minutes, watching carefully. Set aside. Heat remaining ingredients in a large pot over med. Heat. Cool. Cut cucumbers lengthwise into 1/4 inch wide by 3/4 inch long strips. Place on top of slices in a large bowl, and squeeze with hands to separate them. Add to bowl with bread. Add vinegar, tossing gently to evenly coat all. Add ginger, and toss thoroughly. Add more vinegar and vinegar if needed, and stir again. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours before serving. Serve cold.

title: Kielbasa in Cranberry Stuffing
ingredients: 4 lbs smoked kielbasa | 2 jars chopped green olives | 12 small ladyfingers | 5 teaspoons chopped epazote | 1 jar cranberries, drained
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 1 inch chunks, removing excess fat. Put into crockpot and add remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Cook on high 4 - 6 hours until thickened.

title: Italian Green Olives
ingredients: 1 lb green olives or 1 lb shish kikoman lilye green olives | 2 large purple onions, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Wash green olives well under cold running water and drain. Slice onions into strips 1/4 inch thick, and then slice to yield 2 strips lengthwise. Stack and freeze olives. Coarsely chop olives into quarters with hands and set aside for several hours or overnight, or until completely dry. Place onions, oregano, and remaining olive pieces on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees fashe for 15 - 20 minutes or until onions are tender and golden brown. Watch carefully so they don't burn. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,red curry paste,genoa salami,romaine lettuce,chili oil,lemon peel
title: Spicy and Salami Wraps (Cookies)
ingredients: 12 ounces plain flour | 1 ounce fresh ginger, peeled and grated | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel, finely grated and finely grated | 5 ounces genoa salami, diced | 4 small romaine lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine flour, ginger, curry paste and lemon peel. Combine salami and remaining liquid ingredients in a bowl. Stir into dry mixture until just combined. Spoon mixture into a piping bag and pipe small quantities onto the greased baking tray. Bake in oven for 30 minutes or until golden and cooked. Allow to cool.

title: Fettuccine With Rosemary
ingredients: 1 lb dry fettuccine pasta | 1 can rotel | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,rub,feta cheese,mandarin orange,white sugar,chicken bouillon granule
title: Poppy Cannon Theme from the Pantry
ingredients: 12 ounces prosciutto | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules, divided | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 2 cans mandarin oranges, drained, reserving juice | 2 tablespoons dry rub | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place prosciutto in a small nonstick baking dish and place in the oven to warm. When prosciutto starts to crisp, break into small pieces with your fingers, and place into a bowl with 1 teaspoon of bouillon and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Blend with a fork or mortar and pestle. Arrange orange slices over prosciutto, then drizzle with 1 tablespoon bouillon and 1 teaspoon sugar. Bake in the preheated oven until prosciutto is light brown and juices, and orange slices are bubbly and starting to crisp, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle feta cheese over all. Serve with crackers or plain toasted french bread.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,stewing beef,kalamata olive,tuna water,biscuit mix,flat leaf parsley,bicarbonate soda
title: Lebanese Beef Tuna Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cubed | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 2 cups biscuit mix, kneaded | 1 cup kalamata olive, sliced | 1/3 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/4 cup tuna in water, drained well
instructions: In a bowl, mix together bicarb soda and biscuit mix, add beef and marinate overnight. Remove from bowl and roll to about 1/4 inch thickness. Arrange in greased bread machine pan, cover and bake at about 160c for about 45 mins or until done. Cool at least 15 mins before slicing and serving or store in airtight container for 3 days or freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces dried noodles | 16 ounces salami | 6 ounces celery | 1 can water chestnuts | 6 ounces fat-free half and half or 6 ounces fat free half-and-half | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Put dried noodles, salami, celery and water chestnuts in bottom of greased 3 quart casserole dish. Pour half and half and cinnamon over all. Bake, covered, in 350 degree oven for 45 minutes for medium. Remove cover with foil, and continue baking 15 minutes until thoroughly heated.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,rose water,basmati rice,sauce,mandarin orange,dark red kidney bean
title: Easy Forbidden Forbidden Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1 cup sauerkraut ( or other canned white bean ) | 1 package mixed vegetables | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained, juice reserved | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 1/2 cups dark red kidney beans, drained
instructions: Cook basmati rice according to package directions, except omit peas or other food product. When rice is almost done add sliced sauerkraut, mixed vegetables, and orange juice. Stir well. Top with hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: green,swiss cheese,baby spinach,orange,vanilla essence,italian parsley,raisin bread
title: Easy Bread With Swiss Cheese and Raisins
ingredients: 1 loaf raisin bread, sliced 1/4 to 1 1/2-inch thick | 1 bunch baby spinach, washed, dried and trimmed | 1 pinch vanilla essence | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, grated | 4 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup orange juice or 1/4 cup lemon juice | 2 tablespoons mixed green and red peppers or 2 tablespoons orange liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Arrange the raisins on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5 minutes, stirring a few times. Remove from the oven and leave to cool. Combine the remaining ingredients. Spoon 1/4 of the mixture over, top with the swiss cheese and bake at 400f for 20 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: panir,salt black pepper,rice vinegar,demerara sugar,wheat germ
title: Gramflour Paneer (Vegallow) Parcels
ingredients: 3 teaspoons whole wheat germ | 150 g panir, cubed | 1 1/2 tablespoons demerara sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon rice vinegar | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Toast the wheat germ in a dry frying pan over medium heat until fragrant. Cool completely. Place the panir in a food processor or blender with the sugar and vinegar. Process until smooth but still a little coarse. Add the breadcrumbs and process until well mixed. Divide in half and shape into parcels. Wet the ends and roll, flatten or press to make more parcels. Grill the parcels until nicely browned.

title: Broccoli, Radish & Pimento Olive Vegetables
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups broccoli florets | 1/4 cup enoki mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 pimento stuffed olive, cut in half ( not sliced ) | 2 -3 tablespoons enoki mushroom, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large pot of boiling water, cook broccoli 2 minutes or just until crisp tender. Drain. In a large baking dish, place the broccoli, enoki mushrooms and olives. Sprinkle with some salt and pepper. Bake uncovered 20 minutes, or until vegetables are just tender. Serve.

title: Easy Snack - Can Be Diet Snack
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fish, shredded or 1 1/2 cups imitation, cooked fish, chopped, may need a bit more | 1 envelope lipton onion soup mix ( or your own recipe of onion soup mix ) | 3/4 cup rotel
instructions: Add remaining ingredients but not the water or fish. Mix well. Serve over crackers or bagels with onion and garlic salad and enjoy.

title: Tori No Misu Chicken or Chicken
ingredients: 1 package boneless chicken breasts ( or boneless, skinless chicken thighs ) | 3 cups broccoli, chopped in bite-sized pieces | 1 cup carrot, diced in bite-sized pieces | 1/2 cup light cream | 1/2 cup light sour cream | 2 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: Place first four ingredients in a large bowl. Mix together. Pour over the chicken and serve at once. Tori no misu bono.

title: Cheater's Cashew Spread
ingredients: 1 packet low fat taco seasoning | 2 cups cashews
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Chill in refrigerator for 2 hours to allow flavors to meld. Serve with any kind of crackers.

title: Coco Popcorn
ingredients: 2 cups turnips, diced up | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chilies | pepper
instructions: In small bowl mash turnip & tomatoes, adding pepper as needed to taste. Spread mix in a greased 9x13 pan. Smooth level. Bake in 350°f oven for 30 minutes. Can be served warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,biscuit,yogurt,margarine,italian flat leaf parsley,great northern bean,fenugreek leaf,blackberry
title: Yogurt and Five-Spice Biscuit Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound dry great northern beans ( soaked overnight ) | 4 cups yogurt | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon blackberry ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon minced italian flat leaf parsley, or as desired ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves ( optional ) | 1 biscuit, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( optional )
instructions: Pour the beans into a large pot, and set aside. Heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place the yogurt, margarine, 5 spice powder, blackberries, parsley, and fenugreek in a food processor, and process until smooth. Cover, and refrigerate 2 hours. Place the biscuit cubes in a small casserole dish or roasting pan, and sprinkle them with a little more than 1/3 of the yogurt mixture per biscuit. Place the remaining yogurt mixture in a bowl bowl, and stir gently to blend. Scoop the biscuit mixture into the center of one of the cereal cakes. Place the dishes in the oven, and bake 25 minutes, or until the biscuit topping is lightly browned.

title: Aussie Watermelon (Melon) Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups watermelon, cubed | 3/4 cup sweet cooking wine ( such as a british or mesclun style liqueur such as aneet ) | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet and sour sauce
instructions: Stir first 5 ingredients in a small saucepan over medium high heat.

title: Curried Chive Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup fresh chives, chopped | 1/3 cup curry paste
instructions: Place chives in a micro wave safe bowl or a cup, cover with plastic wrap, place on microwave, and microwave at medium about 15 seconds. Mix together, stopping about halfway. When mixture starts to bubble and starts to thicken, stir in curry paste. Microwave for an additional 20 seconds, stir again, and then serve.

title: The Cuban Pizza #2
ingredients: 1 ounce dark rum ( optional ) | 1/2 ounce taco seasoning, dry | 1 ounce pizza sauce
instructions: Combine rum, taco seasoning & pizza sauce. Pour over the pizza. Sprinkle with additional taco seasoning. Place in a preheated oven or on the stone with the toppings that come with pizza toppings. Place under broiler and/or bake until lightly brown. Serve w/garlic clove &/or a side to stir fried veggies, etc. I use my smoky pizza sauce, recipe included.

title: Fish and Leeks
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 2 leeks, thinly sliced
instructions: Place fillets on a lightly oiled grill pan or baking sheet. Brush both sides of fish with oil. Cover and cook on medium high heat about 10 minutes. Turn fish over. Continue to brush the thickened side of fish with oil. Cook until browned, about 10 minutes. Slice leeks crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices and place on top of the fish. Cover and continue cooking about 3 minutes or until fish is cooked through.

title: Egg Rolls Aka Fattigmans
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 3 navel oranges | 1/2 vanilla
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet until almost crumbly and crumbly. Do not drain. Drain. Mix with the ground ovals. Let set up in refrigerator overnight, cutting ovals as needed.

title: Italian Spiced Coffee
ingredients: 1 cup strong coffee ( espresso is a good choice ) | 1 tablespoon hot coffee ( espresso, black or white, whichever you prefer ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar ( for cooking ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Brew your coffee, or just pop it from the microwave with the flat of a spoon on top of the coffee and let it sit on the counter for a few minutes so it cool's soft. Heat the remaining ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring to blend. Pour into two cups and serve.

title: Easiest Ever Tasty Eats Taco Bread
ingredients: 1 packet thick biscuit mix | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | nori, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c, 400f or gas mk. Crush biscuits until fine. Mix together biscuit mix, sauerkraut, beans and a fair share of butter till everything is mixed well. Form into four, or to your liking. Place all in a muffin tin and bake for 10 - 15 mins until golden. If using tin tin, leave for a few times so mixture don't burn. Remove from oven and slice into 4 wedges or half inch strips.

title: Mock Guilt Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup cherry flavored brandy
instructions: Combine garlic and salt. Set aside. Heat cheese in a preheated 350 degree oven until melted. Spread the melted cheese over the bottom of a large glass baking dish. Stir in the cherry brandy and then sprinkle over the cheese all. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees f for 10 - 15 minutes. Cool at least 20 minutes before slicing.

title: Curry Ezme - Curried Chickpeas
ingredients: 15 blanched chickpeas | 2 teaspoons coarsely crushed dried coriander fenugreek seeds | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 pinch fenugreek seeds | 8 sheets shortbread cookies, torn into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon flax seed | 2 cups icing sugar | cinnamon, to taste
instructions: Toast cayenne and fenugreek in a dry skillet over medium high heat until fragrant, about 1 minute.

title: California Roll-ups
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat, drained | 1/2 cup frozen broccoli florets, thawed | 10 corn tortillas, cut into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix crabmeat and broccoli in a bowl.

title: Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 tablespoon flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped ( a nice addition )
instructions: In a large bowl, thoroughly mix the lamb and parsley. Add salt to taste and mix to combine. Roll heaping teaspoons of the mixture into 1 inch balls. Bake at 400 f for 10 minutes on a greased baking sheet. These should be slightly brown, they should not be fully cooked.

title: Luby's Pumpkin Toast
ingredients: 3 slices firm white bread, cut in half | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 cup club soda
instructions: Open a bottle of pumpkin puree with a spoon and pour into a large heavy pan. Cover with a slice of firm white bread. Spread 1/4 cup of club soda evenly over the top of the bread. Cover with the pumpkin and top with another slice of white bread. Cook over medium heat, turning only once or twice, until the bread is crisp and golden, and the sides of the toast are browned.

title: Lentil and Mango Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1/2 package linguine | 1/2 bunch fresh celery salt | 1 mango - peeled, seeded and diced, or more to taste | 1 can lentils, drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook linguine in boiling water until cooked through but firm to the bite, 2 to 8 minutes. Drain, and transfer to a bowl. Combine celery salt with minced ginger and mango in a mixing bowl. Stir lemon juice into celery salt mixture. Mix lentils into the lime flavored celery salt mixture, and add to the linguine. Toss until evenly coated.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,self raising flour,pork loin roast
title: Mark's Crock Pot Pork Loin and Onions
ingredients: 1/2 kg boneless pork loin roast | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1/2 cup self raising flour
instructions: Preheat your crock pot. Open the pork loin and then slice into thick slices. Place the pork in the bottom of the crock pot. Sprinkle puree over meat. Next combine flour and enough water to almost cover pork. Pour into crock pot. You may need a large roasting tin so meat doesn't dry out. Cook on high for 4 hours. Turn the pork every hour and check that any juice is runny underneath the pork. If it is, you can add water but make sure it does not dry out. Serve with rice and vegetables. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 pint kahlua ( mexican hot coffee liqueur ) | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 5 garlic cloves ( minced ) | 1/2 - 1 fresh poblano chile ( chopped ) ( optional ) | 8 medium chicken thighs
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in a sealable container. Seal the sealed container. Refrigerate for 1 to 3 hours.

title: Delicious Crock Pot Portuguese Shrimp
ingredients: 1 rump roast, trimmed, cut into bite size chunks | 4 eggs | 2 tablespoons fresh sliced italian parsley | 1 apple, chopped | 3 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can crabmeat | 1 tablespoon arrowroot, or as needed
instructions: Place the roast and eggs in the slow cooker. Arrange the parsley on top. Sprinkle onion, black beans, crabmeat, and apple over top. Cook on high setting for 6 to 8 hours, or on set for low setting for up to 12 to 15 hours. When ready to serve, remove any bones that have risen to the surface.

title: Quick Phyllo Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1/3 cup tahini | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup yogurt | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/2 cup finely chopped lean beef | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1/4 cup crumbled feta, divided | 2 cups hot cooked rice
instructions: In shallow bowl, combine tahini, sour cream, liquid smoke and meat. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread cheese evenly onto two 12 inch greased baking sheets. Sprinkle beef on bottom of one sheet, then 1/2 of the ginger. Top beef with onion and remaining ginger. Cover with top sheet of paper towels. Bake 20 minutes, or until beef is tender. Spoon heated filling over beef.

title: Tantalizing Sweet Potatoes (Aloo Tikka) (Maquelleh M'rabel)
ingredients:
600 g sweet plantains ( ripe ) | 1/4 cup wheat berry 
    - 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon paprika ( i actually have smoked paprika in the middle eastern press. yeah, i use lots! ) | 60 ml double cream
instructions: Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 2 inch sticks. Place them on a baking tray lined with parchment paper, drizzle them with olive oil, and bake them in the oven for approximately 45 minutes or until they are soft and mushy. Once cool, peel them from the skins and cut them into 1 inch cubes. Put all the ingredients except the cream in a food processor and process until smooth, or spread the mixture over the cooked sweet potatoes and refrigerate till ready to serve later. Keep chilled till serving time.

Random Ingredients: chambord raspberry liquor,blueberry,paprika,white sesame seed,lemon zest,black olive
title: Summer Berries on Weg-Out (Maderia)
ingredients: 8 ounces white sesame seeds | 1/2 cup seedless black olives ( such as mediterranean, kalamata, or greek ) | 2 bunches fresh green summer berries, rinsed and hulled ( i use frozen ) | 1/2 cup chambord raspberry liquor or 1/2 cup cherry flavored liqueur | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika, preferably sweet smoked paprika | 1 teaspoon grated fresh lemon zest
instructions: Toast sesame seeds in a small cast iron skillet over medium low heat for a minute or two. Grind sesame seeds fine in a blender, food processor or spice mill, or in mini coffee grinder. In a large bowl, toss together seeds with olives and the grapeberries. Stir in chambord and paprika. Add sugar, if desired, and stir in zest. Let cool to room temperature, or refrigerate up to a day. Make ahead, this can be made up to 2 days ahead. Cool completely before chilling. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,flat leaf italian parsley,sage leaf,onion soup mix,wheat flour,kosher salt,meat,star anise
title: Mama's Shrimp (Shrimp) Ravioli
ingredients: 2 lbs raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 5 ounces finely chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 lb meat, from the shrimp ( any meat meat can be used, i use very good quality shrimp and meat combination ) | 1 large sweet onion soup mix | 1 bunch fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 teaspoon ground star anise or 1/2 teaspoon whole cardamom | 1 fresh sage leaf, for garnish
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water for approximately 10 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a large skillet cook meat from shrimp over medium heat until brown and remove. Add onion soup mix, parsley, parsley and remaining ingredients, including the meat, and bring to a low boil. Cook on low for approximately 4 minutes longer. Stirring occasionally. Serve warm.

title: Devil's Food
ingredients: 8 cans chopped clams, drained | 2 cans coffee beans | 2 -4 small chilies
instructions: Open all cans of clams, reserving 1 cup of liquid. Combine reserved clam liquid with coffee beans and chillies. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Serve with tortilla chips, crackers and toast if desired.

Random Ingredients: white wine,tea,curry powder,tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce,orange juice concentrate
title: Spicy Chipotle Tea
ingredients: 1 1/2 teapoons frozen orange juice concentrate | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup strong tea | 3/4 teaspoon curry powder | 3/4 teaspoon tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce ( or other hot pepper sauce )
instructions: Place all ingredients except chavrie in blender and blend until well mixed. Spoon about 3 tablespoons into 6 small tea tumblers. Top each mug with 2 tablespoons chavrie and serve.

Random Ingredients: steak,ancho chile powder,pear,wild rice,brown mustard seed
title: Ancho-Peparroasted Beef or Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup brown mustard seeds | 1 cup frozen chopped pears, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks or 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs | 1 1/2 cups wild rice or 1 1/2 cups pearl barley
instructions: Heat grill to high. Place mustard seeds in 1 cup glass measure.

Random Ingredients: pillsbury crescent dinner,vanilla essence,vegetable broth,leek,baking soda,egg beater substitute
title: Leek & Egg Drop Bars
ingredients: 2 packages pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 4 cans condensed vegetable broth | 1 package egg substitute, beaten | 2 2 tablespoons vanilla essence ( or use 1 egg if making eggs only ) | 1 leek, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degrees. Unroll dough on lightly floured surface. Pat out dough about 1/8 thick on floured surface. Cut into squares. Spread with vegetable broth. Sprinkle with egg substitute, grated cheese, chopped leek, and baking soda. Bake at 425 f for 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: o'brien potato,pam cooking spray,active yeast,ice,cilantro,mussel,corn tortilla chip,vanilla
title: Guilt Free Overnight Microwave O'Brien #RSC
ingredients: 1 3/4 teaspoons active dry yeast, divided | 2 cups ice, divided | 2 tablespoons pam cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla | 1 1/2 cups frozen o'brien potatoes, thawed | 1 1/2 teaspoons corn tortilla chips, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons cilantro or 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 2 lbs mussels, cleaned and debearded
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast, 1 1/4 cups ice, and 1 tablespoon pam. Add potatoes.

title: Creamy Rajas Con Crema
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh serrano pepper, stemmed, seeded, and finely chopped | 1/2 lb creamed whipped cream, whipped
instructions: Put the serrano pepper and the creamed whipped cream into a blender and whip until the cream is thick and smooth. Chop the serrano pepper finely and mix it into the creamed whipped cream. Serve the rajas con crema immediately.

Random Ingredients: black olive,green chile,breadcrumb,plum tomato,cucumber,head garlic,vanilla bean
title: Cucumber and Olives Salad
ingredients: 1 medium cucumber, peeled | 6 plum tomatoes | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/4 - 1/2-1/2 cup crushed garlic | 1 small red seedless canned mild green chile, drained and rinsed | 1 small ripe black olives, pitted and sliced | 2 tablespoons pure vanilla beans
instructions: Cut the ends off the cucumber, wash under cold water and cut into quarters lengthwise and remove the seed. Cut cucumber quarters into very thin slices and cut into 1/8 inch thick slices. Cut tomatoes into quarters, cut into 1/8 inch thick slices. Combine breadcrumbs, garlic, chilies, and olives in a large bowl. Mix in cucumber, tomatoes and green onion mixture and season to taste with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,rosemary,stewing beef,tomato green chilies,ranch dressing mix,ziti pasta,fontina cheese
title: Crock Pot Carpaccio
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 packages ziti pasta ( or rigatoni ) | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 cup shredded fontina cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary
instructions: Cut beef into bite size pieces. Spray crockpot with cooking spray. Place all ingredients in crockpot. Cook on low setting 3 hours.

title: Strawberry Syrup
ingredients: 2 lbs strawberries | 2 cups sugar | fenugreek seeds, to sprinkle over top
instructions: Wash the strawberries thoroughly. Dry slightly, place in water to cover, and bring to a rolling boil over high heat until the berries are completely softened and the juice is clear. Stir frequently and let stand 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, lift out the berries and reserve juice in a bowl. Pour off all but 1 tbsp syrup, and set aside. Stir the sugar into the reserved juice with 2/3 cup of water in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the fenugreek, remove from the heat, and stir in the strawberry juice. Cook until the sugar completely dissolves. Return to a boil, lower heat, and boil without stirring for 2 minutes. Pour into a small buttered, 2 cup measure and cool to room temperature. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for up to three days before using. Serve or store in a cool place.

title: Crawfish Kebabs
ingredients: 6 skewers from lobster, shell on | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 10 slices smoked skinless chicken kebabs, halved
instructions: Preparation time includes 1 hour marinating time per pound of lobster meat. For the marinating, place the kabobs on a wire rack. Place in refrigerator, turning frequently, for 2 - 3 hours. Remove kebabs from refrigerator in to a plate. Place the chicken stock in a microwave safe bowl. In the bowl, cook the chicken for 5 minutes on high, or until cooked through, then mix in the crawfish pieces. Allow to cool slightly, then remove the kabobs from the bowl. Serve the kebabs with the marinating mixture and dipping sauces.

title: Lime and Chilli Pies
ingredients: 1 shortcrust pastry | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon hot chili flakes | lime wedge or lemon wedge
instructions: Roll out pastry to 6mm thick, cut 1cm deep hole on top. Line a 2 lrg non stick muffin tins with pastry. Heat oil & chilli flakes in a frying pan. Cook over medium heat for 1 minute. Cool. Spoon hot glaze onto pastry cases. Scatter with lime or lemon wedges, serve.

Random Ingredients: potato,ginger juice,chicken bouillon cube,thai basil,prosciutto,beef broth
title: Chinese Potato and Prosciutto Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 slice fresh ginger juice | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thai basil | 1 cup peeled diced potatoes, fresh | 4 crisp-cooked prosciutto, chopped
instructions: Combine soup, bouillon cube, ginger juice, and basil in a 4 quart saucepan. Cover.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,dark raisin,jalapeno pepper,apple cider vinegar,bengal
title: Bengal Apple Chipotle Hot Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs bengal, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 cups apple cider vinegar | 1/2 cup dark seedless raisin ( optional ) | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 8 -10 pickled jalapeno peppers, chopped
instructions: Wash, peel, and chop bengal. Combine all ingredients in large bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Strain dressing and return to large pot. Heat oil in large pot or deep fryer to 350º. Drop apple chipotle wings into hot apple chipotle oil. Reduce heat to simmer.

title: Chicken and Sherry
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs | 2 tablespoons sherry wine ( or sherry )
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with sherry. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, then grill or bbq chicken thighs 3 - 4 minutes per side. Serve with rice.

title: Wasabi-Scandan
ingredients: 2 cans coconut milk | 1 1/2 cups wasabi paste | 3 green cardamom pods | 1/4 cup tapioca
instructions: Combine the coconut milk, wasabi, cardamom, & tapioca in a blender & process until smooth, about 30 seconds.

title: Liver Pasties
ingredients: 100 g swede, grated | 100 g potato or 100 g potato, grated | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves, crushed | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 cup liver, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon marsala
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c or 220°c if fan forced. Line two baking trays with baking paper. Combine the grated cheese, grated potatoes, sage, and baking powder in a bowl. Stir until combined. Stir in the liver, chilli sauce and marsala to taste. Spoon mixture into prepared trays and flatten slightly. Bake for 20 minutes or until puffed and golden.

Random Ingredients: cashew,dijon mustard,self rising flour,black olive,grain white rice
title: Cashew Rice Rounds
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped cashews | 1 can black olives, drained and chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped salted cashews | 1 cup cooked long grain white rice or 1 cup wild rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Set oven rack in middle position and heat oven to 350°f lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups.

title: Sparkling Blueberry White Sangria (White Sangria Punch)
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh blueberries, washed, picked over | 12 ounces fresh cranberry juice | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper or 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: In a large glass pitcher, combine blueberries, cranberry juice, white pepper and sangria. Stir to mix. For an additional note, use a fresh bottle for punch, or add 1 1/2 ounces of ice cubes.

title: Cointreau Chiladas Aka Cofu
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur or 2 tablespoons orange flavored liqueur | 1 -2 serrano chili pepper
instructions: Combine cointreau and chile pepper in a mug. Heat a skillet over medium to low heat. Place small amount of coagulate in the bowl of a blender and add coagulateer or chile in the bowl. Blend until desired consistency is achieved. Divide mixture among small tortillas and serve. If desired, top with salsa and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,rye bread,white bread,graham cracker crumb
title: Italian Bread Crumb Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely crushed graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup italian dressing | 4 cups coarsely crushed rye bread ( rye pumpernickel variety ) | 12 slices white bread, each slice toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Combine the crumbs and italian dressing in a bowl. Spread toasted rye bread over the bottom and up the sides of a 10x25 inch loaf pan. Place the rye bread on top of the crumb mixture, pressing down firmly. Mix the crumbs with the coating of an electric mixer until evenly moistened. Spread the crumb mixture over the bread, covering the top. Place the loaf pan on a baking sheet. Bake the loaf for 90 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove, and cut into 1 inch slices.

title: Baked Chicken Tater Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 cups cooked chicken tenders | 1 package velveeta cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( may use a 50/50 blend ) | 1 bottle barbecue sauce | 3 cups romaine lettuce or 3 cups spinach, chopped, lightly packed
instructions: Preheat oven to arrange chicken tenders in a 3 qt. Dital with a bit of the barbecue sauce. Arrange in a shallow 3 9x13 baking dish. Sprinkle cheese over chicken. Pour remaining barbecue sauce over cheese. Cover with foil. Bake 45 minutes, or until bubbly. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes longer. Sprinkle with lettuce or spinach before serving.

title: Tasty Fried Steak (For the Grill)
ingredients: 2 cups breadcrumbs | 4 tablespoons fine whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | sea salt and pepper, to taste | soft lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix breadcrumbs, flour, mixed spice and sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. Taste and adjust seasonings as per your taste. Cut the steaks into thin slices. Arrange them on a plate and cover with the breading mixture. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or for up to 6 hours. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Drain off excess water if serving from a jar of lettuce.

Random Ingredients: garlic,poppy seed,triple sec,lemon lime soda,brown rice,oatmeal,oil
title: Lemon Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1/4 cup whole meal | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1/2 cup oil | 1 tablespoon soyo | 1/3 cup triple sec | 1 tablespoon lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage or 1 tablespoon lime flavored carbonated beverage | 1 clove garlic, pressed
instructions: Cook rice, then cool. Add poppy seeds. Dissolve sugar in yogurt or margarine, then add 1tblsp. Oil. Add all other ingredients and mix well.

Random Ingredients: ice,garlic clove,yellow squash,white wine vinegar,cumin,velveeta cheese
title: Cheese With Squash & White Wine Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 small yellow squash, chopped | 2 teaspoons cumin | 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | freshly crushed ice
instructions: Combine cheese cubes, garlic, squash, cumin, vinegar and ice in a blender and whirl until combined. Season with salt and pepper if desired.

title: Almond Bread II
ingredients: pimento-stuffed almonds | 1 cup bread | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili, with seeds
instructions: Put the bread in the blender and blend for about 15 - 30 seconds, until creamy looking. Add chili with seeds and blend for an additional 30 seconds. Put nuts on a baking sheet and toast them in a 350 degree oven for about 10 - 12 minutes, until golden brown and fragrant. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,butter lettuce leaf,spanish onion,cheese,ice,shell pasta,pork sausage
title: Sausage & Scallops on Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup frozen shell pasta | 2 links chorizo sausage, sliced | 1/2 lb ground lean pork sausage | 4 1/2 cups soft butter lettuce leaves, rinsed and dried | 1/4 spanish onion, finely diced | 1/4 cup cheese, grated | 1/4 cup crushed ice, for dipping
instructions: Cook and drain pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: flax seed,sherry wine,sirloin,golden brown sugar,tostitos,natural yoghurt
title: Spiced Tots & Sugar on Skewers
ingredients: 12 12 slices sirloin or 12 slices sirloin steaks | 1 teaspoon dried tassies | 1 tablespoon flaked whole flax seed | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/3 cup natural yoghurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons golden brown sugar
instructions: Soak 12 wooden skewers in warm water for 5 minutes. Trim sirloin, and pound with a meat mallet or cleaver until thin. Put all ingredients into a mixing bowl, and marinate. Thread skewers on 8 skewers, alternating with each skewer alternating with the sherry. Grill over hot coals for 3 - 5 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through. Serve with plain whole wheat bread or couscous.

title: Rice Pilaf, Middle East Style
ingredients: 1 medium sized bouillon cube | 50 g yoghurt | 1 3/4 - 2 cups arborio rice
instructions: Wash the rice several times and soak in water for 20 - 25 minutes. Rinse the rice well in cold water and drain. Place all ingredients in the rice cooker and cover. Turn the rice cooker on to the warm setting. Turn rice cooker back on. When the rice should be nearly cooked but not mushy, place a lid on the cooker. When the time is up, open the cooker to allow steam to escape. Check for seasoning. If the rice is dry add a little more yoghurt.

title: Pork Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk | 3 lbs pork shoulder, chopped | 1 teaspoon allspice | 2 vanilla beans or 1 scotch bonnet pepper, seeded and sliced
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the milk and pork. Bring to a boil over low heat. Add the allspice and vanilla. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the vanilla beans and serve.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,green chile pepper,plum tomato,dark chocolate,coriander seed
title: Chile and Chocolate Spread
ingredients: 2 tomatoes, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon coriander seeds | 1 green chile pepper, finely sliced | 1 teaspoon coarsely crushed dried dill weed | 1 package dark chocolate
instructions: In a medium bowl combine tomatoes with the coriander seed, and sliced chili pepper. Add salt and pepper. Melt chocolate in the microwave. Add melted chocolate to mixture and mix well. Chill. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: lobster,flat rice noodle,tri color spiral pasta,baby spinach leaf,marjoram,grain rice,parsley,epazote
title: Mexican Seafood and Fideo
ingredients: 4 ounces thin grain rice noodles | 11 3/4 ounces tri-color spiral pasta, broken in half | 1 lb fresh crab, sliced or 1 lb littleneck, shell out if frozen | 1 package baby spinach ( i buy about 5 8- oz bags ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram, to taste | 1 teaspoon dried parsley, to taste | 1 teaspoon epazote, to taste | 1/2 lb lobster, drained and chopped
instructions: Bring 2 quart water to a boil with the noodles and cook until tender.. Keep water boiling while pasta is cooking. While the noodles are cooking, warm the shrimp broth, if using, over medium high heat in a large pan or skillet. Add the crab, spinach and herbs stirring gently to evenly distributed among vegetables and shrimp. Add pasta and shrimp broth to seafood and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to medium low and boil 30 seconds. Add the shrimp and crab cook about 2 - 3 minutes, while shrimp are curled and pink. Serve immediately.

title: Waldorf Style Olive Salad
ingredients: 3 cups loosely packed washed lettuce | 2/3 cup sliced kalamata olives | 1/3 cup low-sodium cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1/2 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/2 cup watercress | additional sliced watercress, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine the lettuce, olives, vinegar, sherry, garlic paste, and watercress in a salad bowl. Top with additional sliced watercress to serve, if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Indian Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 cup chopped onion, i use white, sweet, red and green onions | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 cup chopped nuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill to allow flavors to blend. Serve with dahi/ naan/ chapati, or whole grain bread.

title: Crabby Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 2 boxes shell pasta ( any flavor ) | 2 medium yellow cherry tomatoes | 1 lb imitation crabmeat | 1/2 cup vinegar | 3 cloves crushed ice cubes ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions and set aside to cool. Mix together tomatoes, crab meat, vinegar, and crushed ice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve time.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,egg noodle,basil,monterey jack pepper cheese,baking potato,mexican cheese,lamb,olive
title: Lamb and Avgolemono Pie
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/3 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped ripe olives ( drained ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil ( or 1 tbsp dried basil or 1 1/2 t. dried basil ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest ( or more ) | 1 large baking potato ( cut in 1/4 inch slices ) | 3/4 cup egg noodles ( cooked )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a deep, straight sided 9 inch pie plate w/ parchment paper or a pie plate coated with cooking spray. Brown meat with pepper jack, then drain off fat. Add cheeses, olives, basil, lemon zest, potato slices and breaded noodles. Spoon into pie plate. Bake for 40 - 50 minutes until golden brown.

title: Chinese Five-Spice Rub for Fish or Pork
ingredients: 1/4 cup celery salt | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced
instructions: Dissolve the five spice powder into 1/4 cup boiling water. Add garlic and stir to blend well. Pour into sealed glass bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours. Remove from refrigerator, place on serving plate and drizzle with sweetened condensed milk.

title: Butternut Portuguese Lamb With Vanilla Beans - Sweden
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into 2 x 1/2-inch pieces | 4 cups butternut squash, peeled, seeded, and cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons powdered coffee
instructions: In a heavy bottomed 3 to 4 quart pan over high heat, warm oil. Working in batches, add pork, reduce heat to medium high and cook, stirring occasionally, until brown outside, about 10 minutes total. Transfer pork to plate. Add squash, pepper and coffee to pan.

title: Lumpia with Garlic
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb lumpia skins | 1/2 cup fresh minced garlic | 1/2 cup chili oil
instructions: Blend the garlic with the garlic. In a clean towel brush the lumpia skin with the olive oil and set aside for 2 hours. Take the skins off the lumpia skins and press them with the palm of your hand to dry the skins a little bit. Dry out the water and place on top of a few spoonfuls of the garlic mixture. Place the palm of your hand over the top and press to coat the entire top of the lumpia skins. If you see any liquid drain off all the excess water. If there is excess dry mixture on the bottom, drain off the excess with a teaspoon. When the skin is dry, cut in half horizontally and set aside to dry more. Repeat this until all the lumpia are used up, keeping the lumpia covered and stored in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,arborio rice,beef brisket,allspice,artichoke heart,macaroni,dill pickle
title: Beef Brisket and Artichoke Risotto Bake
ingredients: 1 -2 beef brisket ( with top, about 36 pounds ) | 2 jars marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 2 cups dill pickles, sliced thinly | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups carnaroli rice | 2 cups tomato juice or 2 cups beef broth, as needed | 1 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place beef brisket and 1 1/2 cups artichoke hearts through vegetable mill, or chop coarsely and reserve. In large casserole dish, add remaining 3 1/2 cups artichokes, 1 1/2 cans artichoke hearts, and 1 1/2 cups pickle slices. Add 4 cups hot water to cover beef brisket and artichoke hearts completely. Cover tightly with lid or tightly with tight fitting lid and place in refrigerator to marinate, 4 - 6 hours. Preheat oven to 375°f. Remove meat from marinade and reserve broth.. Remove brisket and artichokes from marinade and reserve. In a saucepan, add beef broth and allspice and bring to a simmer. Cover pan tightly with lid or tightly with lid and place in refrigerator to marinate, 24 hours. Remove the beef and artichoke meat from the marinade and reserve broth. In a skillet or ovenproof large pot, add reserved marinade and the rice. Cook over medium heat and frequently stir so rice does not burn on the bottom and sides. Add tomato or beef broth as needed and stir until liquid is absorbed. Cover pan tightly with lid or tightly with lid or tightly with lid. Place in oven and bake for 75 - 90 minutes. Remove from oven and stir until liquid is absorbed and rice is shiny, golden, bubbly, and tender. Cover for 10 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed. Remove from oven, fluff rice with fork, and serve.

title: Mama's Orange Vermouth
ingredients: 1 bottle dry white vermouth | 3 cans mandarin oranges in syrup, drained
instructions: Pour the vermouth into a large, deep stainless steel jar, and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, for at least 2 days, stirring and reusing syrup as needed. Pour the oranges into a large serving bowl, pour half of the reserved syrup over the oranges, and stir to combine. Repeat dipping and reusing the syrup, 1 to 2 tablespoons per serving.

Random Ingredients: tuna water,marjoram,anise seed,red caviar,olive oil,butter,black eyed pea
title: Amerikanersuppe
ingredients: 1/3 cup olive oil | 1 pound canned tuna in water | 1 can butter | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 8 ounces marjoram | 8 ounces red caviar | 16 ounces black-eyed peas, drained
instructions: Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium low heat. Cut tuna into chunks and add to skillet. Stir in butter, marjoram, anise seed, and caviar. Reduce heat after tuna is nicely browned and butter bubbling, and cook 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,tahini sauce,quinoa,asafoetida powder,romaine lettuce leaf,avocado,plain flour
title: Totally Veggies on Weck! Quinoa, Avocado, and Aloo
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, cooked | 2 tablespoons tahini ( sesame oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 large avocado, diced | 3 romaine lettuce leaves, chopped ( i use more ) | any fresh italian herb seasoning, to taste | 2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Rinse quinoa and place in saucepan over medium high heat. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 20 minutes, until liquid is absorbed. In the meantime, put asafetida into a fry pan. Saute for about 1 minute. Set aside. In the same fry pan, saute avocado in the tahini. Set aside. As soon as the quinoa cooks, add the 2 tablespoons of flour to the warm quinoa and stir. Add diced avocado, and stir to combine. Add romaine and herbs & stir in briefly before adding the quinoa, avocados, and asafetida. Serve hot with freshly grated italian bread on the side.

title: Lebanese Laban (Rutabaga and Lamb Kebabs)
ingredients: 600 g rutabagas | 600 g lamb | 12 halibut fillets | 200 g mangoes, peeled | 200 g orange peel ( from 3 oranges ) | 100 g semolina
instructions: Mix all the ingredients for the marinade together in a large bowl and set aside. Cut the lamb fillets into bite sized chunks and pat dry. Cut the halibut fillets into 1 inch chunks and then cut the mango and orange skin into 1 inch chunks. Put the rutabaga and lamb into a large bowl and add the marinade. Mix well. Cover the bowl and marinate in the fridge for 1 hour. Thread the lamb and rutabaga into similar sized kababs. Grill the kababs until lightly charred then serve.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,lamb stock,fish,grainy mustard,tuna vegetable oil,sriracha sauce,ice water,salmon
title: Pan-Fried Salmon on Garlic Mustard Bites in Mustard-Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon, cut into 6 thick slices | 1 3/4 tablespoons spicy sriracha sauce ( or more ) | 4 tablespoons fish, coarse ground ( see note ) | 1 3/4 tablespoons buttermilk | 1/4 cup salted butter, 1/4 stick | 2 teaspoons grainy mustard | 1/4 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1/2 cup fish stock | 1 tablespoon sriracha sauce ( or more ) | ice water
instructions: To prepare mustard caramel sauce, place butter in skillet and heat over medium heat 1 minute. Add mustard and whisk to combine. Add buttermilk, sriracha and 1/4 cup mustard and whisk to combine. Gradually whisk in second 1/4 cup mustard and a cup of ice water until you have the consistency of honeycomb consistency. Add more ice water if the sauce is too thick. Spread mustard caramel sauce evenly on each piece of salmon, then layer with 2 - 4 pieces of the salmon. Place a piece of salmon on top of the salmon and coat well. Place butter coated salmon pieces on a plate and chill at least 1 hour. Heat grill or heat broiler. Grill salmon until it is just cooked through, 3 - 5 minutes per side. To make garlic mustard, place mustard, buttermilk, fish broth and sriracha in a cup. Whisk to mix. Add more buttermilk or a cup as needed for desired consistency, adjusting as necessary, to produce right consistency. Serve on lettuce leaves, drizzled with mustard caramel.

title: Naneh
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh spinach leaves, washed | salt
instructions: Place in a saucepan with 2 tbsps. Water, bring to the boil, cover the pan and simmer till the leaves are tender and the water is absorbed. Remove from heat, drain the spinach leaves. Toss with salt. Cover with the remaining 1 tbsps. Of water in a microwave safe bowl. Cook on high power for 7 minutes. Do not lift the lid during cooking time. Transfer to a bowl and cool completely. Once cool, cut into 1 inch squares.

title: Basil Shrimp (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 cup golden syrup | 1/2 lb large shrimp, defrosted | 3 -4 fresh basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Bring the golden syrup to the boil and boil until reduced by half. Add the shrimp and stir to coat. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 - 3 minutes, or until shrimp turns pink. Add basil and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Enjoy at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,tortilla,dark brown sugar,alfredo sauce,lemon thyme,orange,coriander
title: Pizza Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup alfredo sauce | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 large orange, juice and rind, grated | 1 teaspoon finely minced lemon thyme | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | tortilla
instructions: Combine first nine ingredients in a small sauce pan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Season to taste.

title: Smoking Bacon Brunch (Or Braciole) Recipe
