ingredients: 20 -40 slices smoked sausage | 1/2 cup canadian bacon | 3 tablespoons fresh citrus basil | 1 tablespoon lemon grass | 1 tablespoon chinese wine ( sherry or rice vinegar ) | 1 tablespoon orange marmalade
instructions: Heat a wok until it just starts smoking. Lay the sausage out on a cutting board and slice the sausage diagonally across the grain, making random pieces with the long edge facing up. Spread half of each of the basil leaves on the cut sides of the slice of sausage. Lay the sausage on top of the basil leaves and put the sliced bacon back on top of the basil and maple bacon slices. Top with the other half of the basil and maple bacon. Place your wok on smoking dry surface and smoke for about 15 minutes or until cooked and bacon is starting to crisp.. Remove from heat and stir in the orange marmalade. Pour the smoke over the sausage and bacon, garnish with some fresh basil and serve.

title: Homemade Wood Furniture Polish
ingredients: 20 -35 leaves five-spice powder ( available in specialty food stores ) | 6 cups vegetable oil
instructions: Wash hands well and use these to wipe dry your kitchen polish. Apply a lot of clean cloth over your clean furniture so as to make the furniture smell good. You want to do this so the polish becomes nice and clean. When making your polish, first wipe the furniture with lots of soap and wipe it in the usual way for the smell of the sand, smell of the sand from the furniture, smell of the sand. Do not wipe the furniture with soap and wipe it in the same way. You want a smooth residue that can be wiped off with a wet cloth and reused by washing and drying the cloth. Use the remianing soap every time you wipe the furniture so that the residue will not be visible between your fingers. Apply the residue with wet cloth on the furniture. If any residue has left of the sand, it should be discarded. Place the polish into a plastic bag with a good zip lock type seal, with the residue. Close the bag and place in the fridge for about 2 - 4 hours, preferably 3 - 4 hours depending on how moist and dry your bag is. It will harden up, so make sure a tight seal is achieved. When you can use this polish as desired, brush on some of remaining remianing soap and dust on additional remianing soap while brushing on your clean furniture. Allow the polish to rest for about 15 - 20 minutes prior to working, but do not leave it dry.

title: Spices of Heaven - the Real Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sweet paprika or 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in airtight jars in a cool, dry place.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,mint sprig,green curry paste,string bean,asafoetida powder,coconut milk,green bean,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Green Beans and Tomatoes In Coconut Raita
ingredients: 1 lb fresh string bean, trimmed or 1 lb frozen string beans, trimmed | 1/2 lb fresh green beans, trimmed ( about 2 bunches ) | 10 3/4 fluid ounces unsweetened coconut milk | 5 3/4 fluid ounces fresh coconut milk | 3 tablespoons green curry paste or 3 tablespoons minced cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | fresh mint sprig, for garnish
instructions: Cut stringsless beans lengthwise into 1/2 inch wide pieces. Bring 1 cup water to boil in a medium saucepan. Place 3/4 cup of the coconut and 1 1/2 cups water in another saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat until liquid is reduced to about 3/4 cup, about 15 minutes. Add beans. Cook until just tender but still crisp, about 9 minutes. Remove pan from heat. Add coconut milk, curry paste, and parsley. Cover and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until beans are very tender and flavors have blended, 20 to 25 minutes. Off heat, stir in asafetida if using and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: idaho potato,breadcrumb,iceberg lettuce,turnip,tortilla,spaghetti sauce,corn flake,picante sauce
title: Potato Tacos
ingredients: 1 medium idaho potato, peeled and chopped | 4 medium turnips, peeled and chopped | 1 can sliced pimento stuffed olives with capers, rinsed and drained | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 lb tortilla ( soft, round, white, multicolored or corn ) | 4 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded | 4 teaspoons corn flakes, crushed, divided
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender, about 15 minutes, drain. Cool slightly. Chop fine and set aside. Cook turnips in boiling water for 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain and cool. Drain and cool completely. Mix in olives with capers. Sauce, in medium bowl mix bread crumbs with cooked potatoes and cornflakes. Place mixture in lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish and spread out evenly. Top with shredded lettuce. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture and more salsa if desired. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef consomme,white wine vinegar,italian sausage,bean,graham cracker crumb,basil leaf,coriander,potato starch
title: Italian Sausage Balls
ingredients: 1 package johnsonville sweet italian sausage | 1 package baked beans | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 8 slices fresh basil leaves, torn | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1 cup beef consomme | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the crackers and crumbs into a frying pan and cook over medium heat until they are cooked through. Drain the grease from pan and set aside in the refrigerator until cool. Roll the mixture into 1 1/2 inch diameter balls. Roll balls in crushed graham crackers, coating evenly. Place balls on a greased cookie sheet. Allow cookies to harden in the oven while cooking.

title: Sweet and Sour Shrimp
ingredients: 20 jumbo shrimp | 7 tablespoons yoghurt, plain yogurt or 7 tablespoons sour cream | chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Wash the shrimp first. Make sure they are bright pink and the tail is clear, then slice them. Put in a bowl with some chili oil and a little yoghurt. Mix well and leave to marinate for two hours or longer. Put some oil in a frying pan and cook the shrimp until pink and sticky. Arrange on plates and serve with lots of yoghurt on top.

title: Mousaka
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 serrano pepper, stemmed and seeded | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 lb strawberry
instructions: Dry fry the beef with the serrano for about 10 - 15 minutes. The more time is allowed for the beef to absorb the flavors, the more tender the meat will be. This will increase the flavor. Drain the beef and cut it into slices. Add the mixed spice to the meat and cook until the sourness is reduced a little and the flavors are blended. While still warm, slice the strawberries lengthwise. To serve, take a slice of beef and a slice of strawberries and arrange them on a platter. Garnish with a stem of whipped cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: lard,thyme,olive oil,white onion,chicken breast,panko breadcrumb,monosodium glutamate
title: Fried Chicken (Kebab)
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1/3 cup panko breadcrumbs | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 white onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 tablespoons lard, melted | 1/4 teaspoon monosodium glutamate, msg ( msg )
instructions: Place chopped onion in a large bowl, and add 3 cups of cold water, enough to cover. Set aside. Add chicken pieces to water in bowl, drain and dry thoroughly. Coat each piece of chicken with panko. Place on greased cookie sheet and press lightly to shape. Fry until dark and lightly crisp about 10, about 20 minutes. Drain on paper towels. In large frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add onions, thyme, and 1 tablespoon of the melted lard. Cook until onions are beginning to brown, stir in 1/4 teaspoon of monosodium glutamate and add chicken pieces. Mix well and cover. Cook 15 - 20 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Spinach in Olive Oil
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: Wash and steam the fresh spinach until the water is almost evaporated. Remove washed and chopped spinach from heat. Using a strainer, squeeze out excess liquid. Tear the leaves into small bits and transfer to a blender or food processor. Mix the spinach in the blender or food processor with reserved water. Pour in olive oil to make a smoother consistency.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,vegetable oil cooking spray,spinach,beer,black mustard seed,tomato,mirin,pork sausage
title: Pork and Spinach Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb fresh spinach | 2 tablespoons red mirin ( sweet rice wine ) or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon prepared black mustard seeds ( or yellow mustard) | 1/2 cup beer, your preference | 1/4 cup tomato, grated, skin and fat removed ( or a combination of your favorite )
instructions: Place pork and vegetable in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. When the pork looks halfway cooked, add the spinach. Remove from heat and add the mirin, apple juice and mustard seeds. Stir to coat the spinach. Place the lid on the skillet and cook, stirring every so often and adding the beer, until most of the liquid is absorbed. Pour the vegetable mixture over the meat and stir just until combined.

title: Italian Vodka Peppered Cheese Spread
ingredients: 6 ounces italian-seasoned vodka | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese | 1 teaspoon peppercorn
instructions: Shake vodka, mayonnaise, cheese, peppercorns, and hot pepper sauce in a large bowl and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: red snapper,potato flour,coffee,lemon juice,italian sausage,linguine,honey,white vinegar
title: Sausage, Sweet Potato & Red Snapper Linguine
ingredients: 3 cups dry linguine | 3 sweet potatoes flour | 2 tablespoons honey | 6 teaspoons lemon juice | 4 teaspoons white vinegar | 2 pounds red snapper, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 can sweet potatoes seasoned with coffee, vinegar and lemon juice
instructions: In a large pot, combine the linguine, sweet potatoes, flour, honey and 4 teaspoons of lemon juice. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring and cooking until mixture thickens and forms a luscious caramel, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in red snapper. Transfer to a serving bowl, drizzle with remaining lime juice and keep warm. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the linguine and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,coriander seed,red chile,basil leaf,grill seasoning
title: Pebre
ingredients: 200 g ground red chiles | 200 g grilling seasoning | 200 g basil leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, coarsely crushed | 150 g chocolate syrup
instructions: Combine chilli, seasoning, basil and coriander in bowl. Form into small ball. Roll in chocolate syrup. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Tarragon Lettuce Chips
ingredients: 1 iceberg lettuce | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander powder | 2 tablespoons buttermilk | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Rinse lettuce dry. Break apart into even sized pieces. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl, taste and adjust seasoning. Add the lettuce and toss to coat, remove from the bowl and set aside.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,cumin powder,baby spinach leaf,fennel bulb,peanut oil,kale,brown lentil
title: Mexican Greens, Lentils & Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 medium fennel bulb | 1 lb brown lentils | 1/8 cup mexican cheese | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 1/2 cups kale
instructions: Heat the oil in a large non stick skillet over medium high heat. Trim the fennel fronds to 3 inches from the stem and discard. Cut the fronds in half horizontally and slice 1/6 thick on the diagonal. Place the fennel in the skillet and cook, stirring often, until it is browned at the edges, about 3 minutes. Stir in the lentils and 1/8 celsius cheese and raise the heat to high. Stir in the fennel fronds and reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook until the lentils are tender, about 25 minutes. Uncover and cook until the lentils are just tender, about 5 minutes longer. Stir the spinach into the lentils and the cumin. Cover and cook until the greens are tender, about 4 minutes longer. Season with more salt and pepper and the remaining 1/4celsius cheese.

Random Ingredients: campbell golden mushroom soup,ha avocadoes,lime,thai basil,chinese five spice powder,chestnut,shin beef
title: Quick Beef & Avocados
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup ( campbell's golden mushroom soup base ) | 2 sweet asian's 5 spice powder | 2 lbs chestnuts ( peeled and chopped ) | 1 1/2 lbs shin beef ( trimmed and chopped ) | 1/8 cup lime ( cut in wedges ) | 2 tablespoons basil ( fresh or dried ) | 1 can chinese five spice powder
instructions: In a large pan bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Add the soup, chestnuts, and shin beef. Stir well and reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 40 minutes until meat is tender. Stir occasionally during cooking. Add the lime wedges while it is still hot. Stir in basil and five spice powder for garnish. Serve over noodles, rice or cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: black olive,mango chutney,red wine,plain nonfat yogurt,meat,red bell pepper,salad green
title: Mango Salad
ingredients: 30 g salad greens | 1 small meat, prawns ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 large mango chutney | 1 red bell pepper ( small diced ) | 1/4 cup black olives ( sliced ) | 1/4 cup red wine | plain nonfat yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Prepare meat prawns. Steam the onion to soften slightly. Combine the onion with the meat prawns in a bowl and chill for 3 to 4 minutes. In a small pan, combine the mango chutney with the bell pepper and olives. Fry over a moderate heat for 5 minutes. Add to the meat mixture, then add the red wine. Serve with low fat plain nonfat yogurt for dipping.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,golden raisin,caster sugar,onion,mandarin orange,farfalle pasta,coconut milk,honey
title: Prawn & Raisin Farfalle
ingredients: 600 g large raw prawns, peeled | 250 g farfalle pasta | 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 400 g light coconut milk | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon honey | 125 g ricotta cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 140c. Place the prawns in a medium saucepan. Add enough water to cover and a small pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then simmer for a few minutes until just cooked through. Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a shallow ovenproof dish. Add the sliced onion, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 - 10 mins until softened. Add the raisins, sugar and coconut milk to the prawns and simmer gently for 5 more mins until the mixture becomes syrupy. Drain the prawns and return them to the pan. Mix well. Transfer the prawns and onion mixtures into a large ovenproof pan. Cover with the farfalle pasta and pour over the sauce. Cover and bake the farfalle for 25 - 30 mins until the sauce is bubbling and the ingredients are piping hot, and the prawns are cooked through. Serve with a good knob of fresh cream and crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: rhubarb,beef stew meat,active yeast,flour,green cardamom pod
title: Rhubarb Beef-Dry Braised Onions-Sauer in Bier
ingredients: 1/3 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 cups peeled chopped rhubarb | 2 cups green cardamom pods, smashed lightly in a mortar | 1/4 ounce active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm water | 1/4 cup white flour
instructions: In a dutch oven or other heavy skillet that is over high heat, warm the beef cubes until they are brown and crisp on all sides, about 5 minutes. Do not crowd them. Remove them from the pan.

title: Puff Shells
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Sift both flours together in a bowl. Mix well into a dough that's come together quickly. If you have a kitchenaid mixer, mix a rolling pin with a table salt or a little of the flour mixture. Roll into a ball and keep on one side until ready to cook your puff shakers. Heat a large pot of water to a boil. Have a plate on top of your pot. When the water comes to a boil, remove from heat and drop your dough into the boiling water. Try to aim for an inch or so deep, so the dough is just right in the center. The doughnuts can be left to float as they finish cooking. When they float float, transfer them immediately into the pot of water. Try to leave about 1 1/2 to 2 inches between each. Do this for at least one batch. As soon as they rise to the top, drain them on paper towels. To serve, place 1/2 cup of cooked puffed shannonnuts on top of your favorite crackers and serve immediately.

title: Cottage Cheese Tofu Balls
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1 package silken tofu ( about 25 pieces ) | 1/2 teaspoon rubbed sage leaves
instructions: Combine cottage cheese, tofu, and sage in a medium bowl. Mash cottage cheese mixture to combine. Form mixture into 1 1/2 ounce balls. Set aside at room temperature until firm, 3 to 4 hours. Serve in a shallow serving bowl with a sprinkling of paprika sprinkled on top.

title: Indonesian Chicken (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, skin on | 3 tablespoons coconut flour | 2 -3 tablespoons pepper
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a slow cooker. Sprinkle the coconut flour over the chicken. Sprinkle the pepper over the chicken, evenly. Bake on low setting for 8 - 10 hrs, or on high setting for 4 - 5 hours. Turn slow cooker for cooking 1 - 2 hrs if desired.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,cauliflower floret,whipping cream,yellow bell pepper,red chile
title: Spicy Cauliflower Curry
ingredients: 400 g cauliflower florets, cut into small pieces | 400 g yellow bell peppers, deseeded and cut into small pieces | 1 red chile, deseeded and finely chopped | 100 ml whipping cream | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste, paste | 1 small red chile, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a saucepan, cover, and bring to the boil. Lower the heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until the cauliflower is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,zucchini,cherry,basil leaf,black tea,coffee,green lentil,mace
title: Tea-Lentil Grilled Zucchini With Lemon-Mace
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 zucchini, cut diagonally 1/4 inch slices | coarse sea salt & fresh cracked pepper ( to taste ) | 4 sprigs fresh basil leaves | 2 teaspoons brewed coffee, cooled | 4 sprigs fresh basil leaves | 1/4 cup green lentil | 1/3 cup strong black tea | 1 teaspoon ground dried basil leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Coat a 12 cup gratin dish with cooking spray and arrange the zucchini over the dish and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the zucchini to a plate with a slotted spoon. Place the basil leaves in a small bowl. Add the brewed coffee to a tea kettle and just bring it to a boil over medium heat. Remove from the heat and pour the tea inches add the roasted zucchini, basil, beans and tea to tea kettle. Cover and cook the zucchini over moderate heat until just tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to rest. Meanwhile, combine the beans and tea and heat the mixture until hot, about 2 minutes. Place the basil leaves on 4 dinner plates. Drizzle the hot bean mixture on top of the zucchini. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: grain brown rice,shrimp,mint leaf,beef,penne pasta,chunky salsa,beef broth
title: Mexican Shrimp over Penne
ingredients: 2 cups beef broth ( low sodium canned broth ) | 1 cup long grain brown rice | 1 lb medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 12 ounces penne pasta, fresh or dried | 1/3 lb beef, diced | 0.5 jar chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in saucepan. Add rice. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes until rice is tender. Uncover and let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile, bring shrimp to a boil in a large skillet. Remove from heat and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Drain shrimp. Preheat broiler. In 3 quart baking dish, combine shrimp, beef, salsa and 1 1/2 cups broth. Cover and broil 15 - 20 minutes or until shrimp are pink and cooked. Serve over linguine.

title: Linguine With Pomegranate-Pomegranate Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1/4 cup pomegranate juice | 3 tablespoons baking powder
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain and then toss with pomegranate juice and baking powder until coated. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: beef tip steak,carrot,italian sausage link,barley,mexican oregano,romano cheese,basmati rice,peach
title: Italian Sausage Rolls II
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage link, casings removed | 1 cup shredded carrot | 2 tablespoons barley | 1 tablespoon dried italian spices | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 cup instant mashed potatoes ( prepared ) | 1 cup shredded peaches ( canned ) | 1 cup romano cheese
instructions: Heat skillet on medium high. Brush sausage with oil and brown both sides. Remove sausage from skillet and keep warm. Stir together sausage, carrot, barley, 1 t italian seasoning, basil and oregano in bowl. In an 8 x10 baking dish, spread 1/4 cup potato mixtue mixture over sausage mixture and sprinkle with 1/2 c cheese. Spoon sausage mixture over potato mixture. Repeat process with potato mixture and cheese. Top with remaining potatoes and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake, uncovered in 350 degree oven for about 45 minute. Remove and allow to stand 10 minute before serving.

title: Melange Fruit Cake
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour, sifted | 2 teaspoons chocolate powder | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 cup cantaloupes, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Mix all ingredients together and roll into small balls. Place on a greased tray. Bake in a medium oven until golden and cooked through, about 20 minutes.

title: Lemon Pepper Cream Dessert
ingredients: 25 g rosemary, chopped finely | 4 teaspoons lemon pepper | 500 ml double cream
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c. Put chopped rosemary into a medium pan. Pour lemon pepper onto pan. Add cream and mix with spoon. Place in an oven proof ramekin. Cook for 10 mins until mixture bubbles on top and has turned golden brown.

title: Pesto Roast Parsnips
ingredients: 1/2 lb parsnip, peeled and cut into 2 inch chunks | salt and pepper, to taste | 16 ounces pesto sauce ( fresh if possible ) | 8 hoagie rolls
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Mix all together and put them in a loaf pan or roasting pan. Slash into 3 inch long slits top to bottom to release the steam during baking. Bake for about 20 - 25 minutes or until the parsnips are tender and very tender, brushing them with the warmed pesto mixture every 5 minutes.

title: Cilantro Sun Dried Tomato Sauce for Fish, Chicken   Etc...
ingredients: 3 cups fresh cilantro, stems removed ( approx. 1/4 c. ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, slivered ( i used 1/2 of each )
instructions: Blend all ingredients together with care to check the correct amount of salt. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. It should be firm but not watery.

title: Sizzlin' Spicy Fried Clam
ingredients: 1 can minced clams | 1 can vegetable oil | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon molasses | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning
instructions: Add all ingredients to large frying pan. Heat to boiling at medium heat. Reduce heat, cover and simmer about 10 minutes.

title: Creamy Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1 large head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1/2 cup celery root, chopped | 2 cans reduced-fat sour cream | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Drain and rinse the rice. Add celery root and rice to the cauliflower. Place in a buttered 3 1/2 quart casserole and stir in the sour cream and add the half and half.

title: Crispy Fish Tacos with Chilli-Cinnamon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 500 g fresh fish, cut into 3 inch strips | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour, plus extra for coating | 1 cup canned broth or 1 cup stock | 4 -12 small fresh red chile peppers ( optional ) | 8 -10 large flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Lightly spoon the cornflour into a bowl, add chilli paste and cinnamon and mix together. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Place the fish in a separate bowl and add the cornflour mix. Use a large wooden spoon to mix them together, then add the extra cornflour mix and mix until they are well combined. Heat half a teaspoon of oil in a large frying pan and over a medium heat fry a few pieces of fish until dark brown. Transfer to a plate. Pour in the rest of the oil and fry the chillies for a few seconds until softened. Add the fish mixture into the pan and stir until coated with the chilli mixture. Season to taste. Spoon the fish mixture onto the warmed tortillas and top with a little more cornflour mix. Serve with extra cornflour.

title: Crabby Bake
ingredients: 300 g imitation crabmeat, flaked | 1 small red capsicum, halved and deseeded | 1 container part-skim ricotta cheese | 60 g unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Combine crabmeat, capicum and ricotta. Spoon into an 8x8x3 1/3 cup ovenproof dish. Top with cocoa. Cover with foil and bake in a moderate oven for 35 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: blackberry,currant,apple cider,red pepper sauce,canola oil,sandwich bread
title: Blackberry Sausages
ingredients: 4 cups thinly sliced apples ( i used pippin ) | 2 cups chopped fresh blueberries | 1 can blackberries, rinsed well | 2 tablespoons canola oil, or as needed | 2 tablespoons currants ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon red pepper sauce
instructions: Combine apple, blueberries, and blackberries in a 1 1/2 quart slow cooker. In a small bowl, combine oil, currants, and red pepper sauce. Pour over top. Cover, and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. Turn off cooker after 3 hours, and allow to rest until cool enough to handle. Break or tear into pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,chili flake,extra sharp cheddar cheese,vanilla,yellow onion,breadcrumb,rye bread
title: Mexican Stuffed Rye Bread Crunchers
ingredients: 4 crusty rye bread | 1 lb extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup yellow onion, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f and place eight oven safe disposable foil wrapped bread pans in the oven on the second rack. Place cheddar in a medium bowl, and sprinkle the onions, chili flakes, ancho chili powder, and vanilla over top. Combine crumbs and bread crumbs, and mix thoroughly with hands to get the mixture as crumb as your fingers will be able to work with. Roll the bread into an even log, and place seam side down, on ungreased cookie sheet about 3 inches apart. Bake for 18 minutes, rotating baking pans halfway through. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and slice into 1/8 slices.

title: John's Festive Microwave Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 medium fresh mushrooms | 4 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, cut into 4 pieces | 3 tablespoons chives, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons savory | salt, pepper and cayenne if desired
instructions: Microwave mushrooms on high for about 3 minutes. Remove from microwave, remove mushrooms and add cheese. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Remove from microwave and sprinkle with chives and savory. Microwave on high for 2 - 3 minutes until the cheese has melted. Remove from microwave and let cool for a few minutes. Serve and enjoy.

title: Sauce for Fish or Meat
ingredients: 1 cup urad dal or 1 cup brown lentils, washed and drained | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 1 cardamom pod
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add the urad dal and hot sauce. Boil for 3 - 4 minutes. Add cardamon pods for a minute. Remove the vessel from the heat. Cover for a minute or two, then remove the cardamom pods using a slotted spoon. Serve warm with rice.

title: Simple Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup simple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. For a thicker syrup pour into a glass.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,egg wrapper,self rising flour,spaghetti squash,water,porcini mushroom
title: Yummy Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash | 1/4 pound mushrooms, chopped | 4 fluid ounces water | 2 tablespoons red chile peppers, or more to taste | 35 egg wrappers | 1/4 cup self-rising flour, or more as needed
instructions: Pierce squash all over with a fork.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,zucchini,cottage cheese,romano cheese
title: Yummy Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 package zucchini | 1 container cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 cup romano cheese
instructions: Slice zucchini into about 1 1/2 inch pieces. Boil zucchini for about 10 minutes, or until soft. Remove zucchini and set aside, and continue heating the cottage cheese. Spread cottage cheese onto the zucchini. Layer the zucchini onto cottage cheese, pepper jack cheese, romano cheese, salt, and cayenne pepper to taste. Place back on the stove. Place into oven on 375 for about 30 minutes or until golden.

ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice | 8 tablespoons brandy | 8 tablespoons green chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons chile paste | 4 tablespoons coconut, grated | 1 1/4 cups beef broth | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except flour and coconut. Then combine flour and coconut. Add to rice mixture. Using your hands, form a small well in rice mixture. Drop from teaspoon onto hot oil. Fry until pale gold. Serve immediately.

title: Beef  With Potato  Stew...easy and Good
ingredients: 3 lbs beef bouillon cubes | 3 -4 tablespoons flour | 2 tablespoons garlic salt | 3 cups frozen stir fry vegetables, thawed | 1 cup mashed potatoes | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 cups instant noodles or 2 cups small shell cooked pasta
instructions: Combine flour, bouillon, and salt in 3 quart baking dish. Dry veggies. Add dry veggies to flour mixture. Cover with foil. Bake at 425 degrees for 35 - 40 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cook pasta as described on package. Drain, rinse with cold water and add to veggies. Serve with croutons or a green salad.

title: Smoked Salmon and Shrimp Fennel Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 8 ounces smoked salmon | 24 ounces salmon fillets | 2 cans diced canned salmon | 6 -8 fennel bulbs, cut in half | 2 tablespoons spice, all purpose
instructions: Chop potatoes into 1 pieces. Slice smoked salmon into thin slices. Heat in a pan over medium high heat. Drain shrimps and dice. Place in a bowl, and pour over desired amount of seasoning. Dice fennel bulbs into 1/2 inch pieces. Add to bowl. Dice smoked salmon. Add to bowl. Add 1 packet of spice and mix. Set to the side. Let sit for a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,peach,lime juice zest,beef chuck roast,phyllo pastry
title: Peach-Beef Baklava
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 2 tablespoons lime juice, zest of | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1 container phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f degrees. Lay beef onto foil.

title: Rice Pilaf for Stove Top Sheets
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Rinse well to remove remaining water. Cover and let stand in a warm place for 30 minutes. Rinse rice under running water. Drain well. Rinse thoroughly with cold water. Combine rice, oregano and salt in large bowl. Place 1 tablespoon of rice mixture in center of greased 12x7 inch glass baking dish. Top with 1/4 inch water. Cover tightly and place in a larger pan 1 1/2 inches larger than the remaining dish. Place in refrigerator for 4 hours, or overnight. Remove from refrigerator, cool and serve in a small pate style container.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,kosher salt,beef bouillon cube,sun tomato,summer squash,vanilla
title: Korean Spiced Beef
ingredients: 1 boneless beef bouillon cube | 6 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons light tasting sun-dried tomato ( not oil packed ) | 2 tablespoons sweetened soy sauce or 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground summer squash ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon zucchini, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a zip top plastic bag, mix together all ingredients except optional squash. Add beef to bag.

title: Oaty Milky Pie Crust #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats
instructions: Defrost phyllo sheets in refrigerator. Preheat oven to 325 degrees on a greased cookie sheet. Roll dough out into a 16 x 10 rectangle. Combine kahlua and quick cooking oats. Spread over phyllo dough. Sprinkle with 1/4 oats. Fold bottom edge toward the middle. Roll edges up toward the middle into a cylinder. Repeat until remaining phyllo and rolled out dough goes from the cookie sheet, making a total of 18 rolls. Sprinkle with remaining oats to cover rolled out dough. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes or until golden.

title: Steamed Baked Potatoes With Hatersweet Chili Peeps
ingredients: 1 teaspoon canola oil, plus | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 12 ounces new potatoes | 2 ounces fresh tea | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 5 ounces salted frozen peas | 1 large pizza crust | 1 head lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºf and put a pot of water on to boil, for the pizza crust. Bring another pot of water to boil, add the potatoes and boil until tender about 15 minutes. Rinse the potatoes with cold water and drain. Transfer the potatoes to a large bowl. Add the tea and kahlua and toss to combine. Add the meat and stir until evenly browned breaking up the meat with your hands. Drain the potatoes and place on a paper towel lined baking sheet, place in the oven for 10 minutes to get a crispy crust and to help the potatoes become fluffy. Meanwhile, spray a very large nonstick pan with cooking spray, lay the baking pan on the stove and place it over medium heat. Squeeze off any excess moisture from the peas and place them in a small bowl. Spread out all of the potatoes evenly on the baking pan and top with the peas, then lay the top potatoes on the peas and meat and top with the lettuce. Cover with foil and cook for 20 minutes until the crust is crisp and the peas are warmed through. Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Horseradish and Lettuce Cups With Lettuce
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 6 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 4 cups prepared sweet-and-sour mix
instructions: Separate the lettuce leaves from each other into large lettuce cups. In large bowl, combine horseradish and sour cream. Spoon a rounded 1/2 rounded tablespoon of the horseradish, sour cream and lettuce mix into a cavity. Gently fill each cup with some of the hot lettuce mixture.

title: Apple Cider
ingredients: 1 large apple, cored | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds
instructions: Cut top off an apple and put apple into a bowl. Sprinkle cumin over and stir. Set apple into a glass jar with lid. Pour cider over the apple.

title: Slow Cooker Beef on the BBQ - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 can chicken | 1 cup carrot | 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaf or 1 tablespoon dried rubbed sage | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf or 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1 lb fillet, cut into 2 to 3 inch squares
instructions: Place the meat, vegetables and herbs in the bottom of your slow cooker. Place meat in single layer in a single layer on top. Spray the cooking grate with cooking spray. Place the steak on top of all and place it on the rack in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 6 hours or on low for 1 hour or until the meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: peel,vinegar,plain flour,vanilla extract,wheat pastry flour,rye bread,sirloin,halibut fillet
title: German Hamburg Open Fleshed Fish
ingredients: 12 slices whole wheat pastry flour | 1 ounce sirloin, shaved and skinned | 12 slices sirloin, coarsely sliced | 12 slices steamed rye bread or 12 slices bread, thickly sliced | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1/2 lb cooked or cooked halibut fillet | 1/4 ounce plain flour
instructions: Mix pastry flour with salt and pepper to taste. Stir in steak, bread, vanilla and vinegar. Tear sirloin slices into strips and place on top of beef mixture. Roll each slice of bread into a 3 inch square and pinch the edges of the bread to secure. Place 1/8 of the meat mixture in the centre of each piece of bread and top with a slice of fish. Fold the edges towards the centre and bring the top pieces of bread up towards the centre. Press to seal. Wrap well and freeze overnight. For each frozen fish, remove from freezer and thaw. Remove from freezer, defrost and cut diagonally into 6 slices. Arrange on a baking tray and bake at 425 degrees fahrenheit for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with yoghurt, sour cream, honey and a salad dressing or dressing of your choice.

title: Hot Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice or 1/4 cup water | 1 tablespoon minced fresh oregano | 1/2 package dried shiitake mushrooms, stems discarded | 1 -2 tablespoon chili sauce ( ketchup- or sriracha style )
instructions: Bring all ingredients to simmer under medium heat over low heat in saucepan. When the liquid boils, stir often, cover, and continue cooking for about 5 minutes or until the liquid has reduced considerably, stirring often. Remove from burner to cool. This sauce is great for beef, chicken, and other chicken.

title: Agua Fresca de Leche
ingredients: 3/4 cup ice cold water | 3 tablespoons lemon curds
instructions: Pour the water into a cocktail shaker. Add the lemon curds and shake until smooth. Strain into a chilled hurricane glass and serve.

title: Cafe Pacific Steak Burger
ingredients: 12 ounces flank steaks | 12 tablespoons malibu rum | 12 scallions, thinly sliced | 4 lettuce leaves | 3 cups shredded lettuce leaf | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese
instructions: Marinate the steak on the hottest grill for at least half an hour. Brush a baking sheet with a little olive oil or butter on it and grill the steak at top of the range for about 5 minutes per side or until it reaches your desired doneness. Keep in mind that this recipe is based on your grill. Wash the lettuce leaves and cut away the bitter green inside the leaves so they remain crunchy. Mix the lettuce and cheese together and pile the lettuce onto the steaks. Roll the burgers up and serve with the reserved juices from the steaks on the side.

title: Spicy Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/2 lb gouda cheese, cut into strips | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepperoni, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon garlic, finely minced | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes, more if desired ( or cayenne pepper to taste )
instructions: In a noncorrosive 2 quart pan, cook aniseed seeds until they begin to pop and smell nutty. Add cheese.

title: Brine and Adobo
ingredients: 1 kg fatty meat ( shoulder meat, beef bone, beef shoulder or pig intestines ) | 1 kg thick steak | 1 kg beef belly | 2 allspice berries
instructions: Cut the fatty meat into large chunks. The meat is cut into cubes. Put them in a non stick bowl, then add the allspice berries and pour over water. Place in the fridge. Cook overnight. When its time to eat, remove the allspice berries. Place the meat, fat and allspice berries in a large pot and boil for 90 minutes. Slice meat, and return to pot. Heat, and remove allspice berries from the bones and discard. Serve with rice and other grain.

Random Ingredients: red chile,chili paste,mexican oregano,caper,sage leaf,large mushroom
title: Azerbaijane (Spicy Mushrooms)
ingredients: 2 lbs white button mushrooms | 1/8 cup chili paste | 2 tablespoons pureed garlic and herb paste | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 12 fresh sage leaves, finely chopped | 1 small dried red chile, seeded and crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large ceramic bowl and set aside for 2 hours in the refrigerator. Bring mushrooms to room temperature and broil, turning regularly and brushing with marinade 3 or 4 times, until heated through and browned at the edges and tender inside.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,breadcrumb,turmeric powder,black bean sauce,cardamom seed,apple cider
title: Baked Black Beans
ingredients: 3 roma tomatoes | 3 cans black beans in tomato sauce | 4 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed ( optional ) | 1/2 cup apple cider
instructions: Wash black beans throughly and separate into two half cans. Place in a casserole dish and sprinkle over the breadcrumbs. Add the tumeric, cardamom and apple cider. Bake at 350°f for 1 hour. Serve warm/coloured.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,maple syrup,celery,poblano pepper,vanilla essence,beef brisket,beef cube
title: Crock Pot Stampede Brisket
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 poblano peppers ( sliced in rounds, don't be too tall ) | 1/4 cup thai fish sauce ( kikkoman ) | 1 cup maple syrup ( unsweetened ) | 1 stalk celery
instructions: Place sliced beef brisket, poblano peppers, and mustard seed pepers at bottom of crock pot. Top with other ingredients. Cook on low for 7 to 10 hours, stirring often. Serve with cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: french bread,rice,serrano chilies,orzo pasta,pork,dark sesame oil,plum,orange juice concentrate
title: Pork and Orzo Stew
ingredients: 1 small onion, finely chopped | 4 serrano chilies, minced, to taste | 1/2 lb pork ( shoulder, shoulder or leg also work ) | 1/2 cup frozen orange juice concentrate ( or 2-3 tablespoons lime juice ) | 6 slices french bread, thinly sliced | 6 tablespoons rice | 6 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 - 2/3 cup plum, roasted, seeded, and minced fresh ( such as muscat, cantaloupe, or calamata )
instructions: Cook onions, chiles, and pork in oil in a 2 to 3 quart pan and add orange juice concentrate or lime juice, if using, and cook until meat is tender. Add bread slices and continue cooking about 5 minutes. Stir in rice, sesame oil and minced plum. Serve warm accompanied with chunks of french bread and green beans.

title: Chipotle Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 2 chipotle peppers | 1/4 cup olive oil | 12 raw jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Prepare orange juice by combining with all ingredients except shrimp in saucepan and bring to a simmer for 4 - 5 minutes or until mixture becomes thick. Drain shrimp and set aside in a serving bowl while preparing chipotle shrimp. Combine marinated shrimp in a skillet over low heat, cooking until shrimp are bright pink and cooked throughout. Add shrimp to reserved orange juice and stir well.

title: Tasty Blender Flaky Pastry
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry ( thawed if frozen ) | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Prepare pastry by rolling between paper towels and using 2 fingers lightly spread it with cream of tartar. Slather with pastry brush or oil for a fancy edge or glaze. Cut into three parts and cut a small slit into each section. Brush with cream and sprinkle with the tartar mixture. Bake in 400 degree oven for 16 - 20 minutes or until pastry is puffed up and deep golden.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,tamari,rom tomato,coffee,self rising flour,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Hot Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles ( not the short skinny tube ) | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 large roma tomato, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup instant coffee | 1/2 cup tamari ( dark sesame seed ) | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Boil the noodles until al dente.

Random Ingredients: thyme,cider vinegar,golden syrup,chicken bouillon granule,salt pepper
title: Golden Syrup for Chicken
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons honey or 4 -5 tablespoons agave syrup | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules or 1 tablespoon chicken flavored bouillon granule | thyme | salt and pepper
instructions: In a non reactive pan, mix together the honey/agave syrup, golden syrup, chicken base etc. Pour mixture over the chicken. Sprinkle with thyme.. Cook over medium heat until well heated, 30 to 45 minutes. Serve warm. Note, if you are adding brown rice, mix in 2 tablespoons water and cook until tender.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,quinoa,radish,italian plum tomato,herb,almond paste,basil,shell pasta
title: Pasta With Red Quinoa and Herbs
ingredients: 4 cups cooked quinoa | 1 cup mixed chopped italian plum tomatoes ( or canned tomatoes ) | 4 cups torn basil leaves | 3 tablespoons herb, marinade or 3 tablespoons fresh basil | 2 tablespoons mixed minced fresh italian plum tomatoes ( or canned tomatoes ) | 2 tablespoons almond paste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil with leaves | 4 small radishes, sliced thin and cut into rings | sliced slivered almonds
instructions: Cook 1st 5 minutes of cooking time, remove from heat. Set aside. In a 2 - ½ to 3 quart, covered, heavy nonreactive saucepan, combine quinoa, chopped tomatoes, basil, herb marinade and mixed fresh tomatoes. Cover and simmer until quinoa is tender and the flavors have blended, about 20 minutes. Let quinoa cool at room temperature to room temperature. Meanwhile, cover and refrigerate remaining cooking liquid. Cook pasta according to package instructions and drain. Stir cooked quinoa into pasta. Season with salt and pepper. Toast almonds on baking sheet in middle of oven, stirring once or twice, until golden brown and fragrant, about 10 minutes. To serve, spread pasta on warm serving platter. Sprinkle with slivered almonds.

title: Capellini II
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 cup finely crushed pecorino cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together oil and savory. Sprinkle pecorino cheese over the entire capicola.

title: Fenugreek Stock
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus | 1 lb ground meat ( i use beef in nz, but any meats will do ) | 1 teaspoon fenugreek leaves
instructions: Cook asparagus for 8 - 10 minutes until they are tender but firm. Leave whole, or cut pieces into 1 cm lengths. Grind fenugreek leaves with a mortar and pestle. Put asparagus pieces in a pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. Cook 3 - 4 minutes. Drain, then add fenugreek mixture and simmer 5 minutes. Serve with bread, toast or toast sticks. The stock freezes well.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate seed,tuna water,mexican cheese,cardamom seed,chicken breast,rigatoni pasta
title: Pasta with a Nuts and Pomegranate Chicken
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 can pomegranate seeds | 2 cups of shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1 chicken breast, cut in bite sized chunks | 2 cardamom seeds
instructions: Set italian sauce up to warm. While sauce is warming mix pomegranate seeds and tuna juice in separate bowl for dipping. Set aside. Boil rigatoni pasta as directed on package. Drain and rinse with ice. Put aside. Add tuna to hot saucepan and crumble. Set aside. In a deep baking dish combine half of the cheese. Season with cardamom and salt and pepper to taste. Layer half of the rigatoni over the cheese evenly. Place the tomato chunks evenly over that and top the tomato with tuna and half of the pomegranate mixture. Layer remaining rigatoni over tuna and tomato. Cover with remaining cheese. Set dish aside and cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350 for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,whipping cream,brown mustard seed,green bean,thai seasoning,beef mince
title: Mince & Green Beans
ingredients: 400 g beef mince | 100 g green beans, cut into 2cm lengths | 125 ml whipping cream | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon all purpose brown mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon guacamole ( to serve )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Stir fry mince over medium high heat until lightly browned and cooked through. Stir in beans, cream, mustard seeds, guacamole and chill to serve.

title: Pea Puffs
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen peas or 12 ounces frozen peas, thawed | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Place peas in a medium saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium and stir to mix the peas. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a small bowl, mix the corn flour with enough cold water to make a paste. In a small bowl, combine the ginger and ginger mixture. Stir the corn flour mixture into the peas. Drop equal amounts of the mixture into boiling water, then cook until they float to the top, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Roasted Plantains
ingredients: 3 plantains | vegetable suet
instructions: Heat oven to 230c/fan 170c/gas 3/4s of the vegetables should be placed unpeeled and cut into 1/2 slices. Place each slice on a square of heavy aluminium foil, sprinkle with suet, fold and seal all edges tightly. Place on a baking tray. Bake for approx 20 minutes. Watch carefully so they do not burn.

title: Pumpkin and Pear Tart
ingredients: 1 pear | 1 can pumpkin puree | 2 tablespoons light soymilk | 1 lemon | 5 tablespoons double cream | 1 can canned pumpkin puree
instructions: Shred the rind off of the pear and put it into a small bowl with a few squeezes of lemon juice add the pumpkin and soya milk and stir until smooth. Peel and seed your lemon and cut it into small wedges. Mix the cream in a small bowl if you have one leave it until it's time to serve as you'll want to be using it in the tart. Put the pear and the lemon rind into the bottom of the tart. Whip the cream then spread on the tart. Serve with a can of pumpkin and pear ice cream and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,cream mushroom soup,tomatillo salsa,calorie margarine
title: Slow Cooker Tomatillo Apple Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can reduced-calorie margarine, softened | 1 can reduced-fat cream of mushroom soup | 1 bag tomatillo salsa, divided | 3 tart apples, peeled, peeled and sliced
instructions: In saucepan over medium low heat, melt margarine, cooking for 5 minutes. Spread 1/2 of the cream of mushroom soup in the bottom of 3 - 4 qt slow cooker. Top with 1/2 of the sliced apples and 1/2 of the salsa. Repeat layering. Cover and cook about 8 minutes on high or 3 hours on low. Let cool slightly before serving.

title: Vegan French Onion Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1 1/2 cups vegan margarine ( i like earth balance or earth balance ) | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup dry currants | 1/4 cup vegemite
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Spread your vegan margarine in the oven proof pizza crust. Layer with the rest of the ingredients. Bake for 15 minutes in a preheated oven. Serve.

title: Guisado De Bordeaux or Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg beater to equals 2 egg whites | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Beat egg whites, slowly til they're like thin, but rather stiff, peaks. Lower the oven to 300 degrees f. Fold whites into egg yolks. Stir in the dry white wine. Spoon the batter into a dish lined with waxed paper, or lightly floured. Cover with waxed paper or an upturned lid. Refrigerate for at least a few hours. Slice into serving sized portions. Store in a tightly closed container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,ice,lemon juice,cream mushroom soup,banana,tuna steak,chuck
title: Baja Style Tuna Steak
ingredients: 4 frozen tuna steaks | 4 slices of your favorite banana | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 lemon juice | 2 tablespoons minced red serrano chili | ice, as needed | shredded banana, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Cut each tuna steak into bite sized pieces or strips. In a small bowl, combine mushroom soup, lemon juice and minced chilies, stir. Pour over tuna pieces, marinate for several hours, and refrigerate overnight. Drain tuna steaks and serve with soup mixture. Garnish with shredded banana slices, if desired.

title: Moroccan Apricot and Oregano Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tortillas | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 425 g apricots, rinsed drained and sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Place your tortillas on baking tray. Spread a little oregano on the tortillas and spread each with a little oregano. Scatter the apricots on top. Bake for about 5 minutes or until slightly crisp. Serve warm.

title: Spinach Cantaloupe
ingredients: 4 cups bread flour | 4 tablespoons cadostura bittersweet chocolate chips | 5 ounces frozen spinach | 1 cup cantaloupe, cubed
instructions: Cut off tips of melaloupe and devein. Rinse and dry spinach using a paper towel. Bake at 300 degrees fahrenheit for 8 - 10 minutes, until tender. Remove from oven and drain liquid out of melaloupe. Place flour in a large bowl, add chopped spinach, cheese, bittersweet chocolate and bittersweet chocolate. Mix dough with hands. Cover and refrigerate overnight to set the dough. Divide dough into 16 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and place on a covered cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. On top of each ball, spread spinach with cantaloupe strips. Place dough under spinach on cantaloupe strips, close lid and let rise until doubled, approximately 1 hour. Heat oven to 400 degrees f and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until top is starting to lightly browned.

title: Kai Yee  (Chicken Noodle Soup)
ingredients: 1 whole chicken thigh, cut in half crosswise | 9 cups cold water | 1 package uncooked rice noodles | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place chicken into a large saucepan, and cover with water. Add cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 30 minutes. Remove chicken, and shred with two forks. Place the rice noodles into a colander, and carefully tear into pieces. Rinse with cold water, drain, and bring back to a boil. Place soup into bowls, and top with chicken and noodles. Sprinkle with salt and pepper, if desired.

title: Chipotle Sunrise
ingredients: 1 3/4 ounces amaretto | 1 3/4 ounces triple sec ( mexican brand is my fa ) | 2 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles or 2 teaspoons fresh chile, minced
instructions: Combine ingredients in a shaker. Pour evenly into martini glasses. If desired, garnish with an additional fresh chipotle chile.

title: Quinoa-Garam Masala
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 2 cans french bread, cubed | 2 tablespoons grenadine | 1 red onion, chopped
instructions: Cook 2 cups of quinoa in salted water until done. Drain and cool. Drain. Set aside. In a separate pan, put in 5 1/2 cups of quinoa, the drained green beans, red onion and a little grenadine.

title: Baked Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 1 cup sour artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup thinly sliced prosciutto | 3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 4 slices provolone cheese, halved ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange artichoke hearts, prosciutto, and eggs in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle provolone cheese on top, and return to oven until cheese is melted.

title: My Version of Chicken in Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 5 cups spinach | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Put chicken in pot that has a lid on and cook on low for at least 12 - 18 hours. When cooked, debone and shred into pieces. Place back on pot and add your spinach and celery seed. Cook in a covered skillet for about 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Chinese Barbeque Oatmeal
ingredients: 2 cups quick cooking oats | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons chinese wine | 4 1/2 tablespoons barbeque sauce, warmed
instructions: Preheat a grill pan to high. Coat pan with cooking spray. Using a potato masher or a wood pilon, combine the oats, sesame oil, chinese wine, and barbeque sauce in a bowl.

title: Pigs in a Blanket
ingredients: 12 ounces thick whole wheat penne | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup dark rum ( optional ) | 1 bottle barbecue sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place pasta in a large baking dish. Cover with spaghetti sauce. Combine rum and bbq sauce. Pour over pasta. Bake for 30 minutes. Turn off oven. Let sit 10 minutes before serving.

title: Fenugreek Leaves (Yogurt Leaves)
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 2 tablespoons romano lettuce | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Clean and drain any excess water from the dried cranberries. Place in a clean container. Keep aside. In another container place the dried fenugreek leaves and grind it using coarse. Be careful not to use too much salt. To do so, heat the bottom of a deep skillet until hot. Add the fenugreek leaves to the skillet. Toss lightly with a spoon to coat the kernels of the leaves. Turn the leaves over. Cover and cook over low heat for 3 minutes. Turn off. Place in a serving bowl and garnish with the romano leaves. Store at room temperature for upto half an hour.

title: Pasta Bows
ingredients: 2 bunches green olives, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 package bow tie pasta
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the bow tie pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and spread onto a large platter to cool. Mix olives with asafoetida powder in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,bow tie pasta,filling,graham cracker crumb
title: Cumin Crumb Filled Noodles
ingredients: filling : | 2 jars graham cracker crumbs, or as needed | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons dry gourmet gourmet gourmet grah filling : | 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Stir graham cracker crumbs, cumin seeds, and cheese food stuffing mix together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: spinach,onion soup mix,great northern bean,veal,white bean,flax seed,cocoa,coriander powder
title: Spinach Balls With Meat
ingredients: 1 box frozen chopped spinach | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 package dry dry dry fax seeds | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 can veal, loin style ( cut about 3/4 thick ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Defrost spinach, remove all water in a large skillet or dutch oven, and allow to thaw overnight. Place spinach in large bowl, and stir with a wooden spoon. Remove 1 cup of the frozen chopped spinach and spinach, and set aside. Place all remaining ingredients in a slow cooker, and stir to combine. Cover, and cook on low for 7 - 9 hours, or on high for 5 - 8 hours. After 7 hours, remove from heat, stir in the drained spinach, and season to taste with more coriander powder.

title: Yummy Chocolate and Guzzle Barbeques
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 8 ounces bittersweet chocolate, melted | 1/4 cup beer | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup dry white bread, diced
instructions: Place tomato paste, hoisin sauce, bittersweet chocolate, beer, sugar in blender. Process until smooth. Pour in confectioner's sugar to make a thick cream sauce. Refrigerate until ready to use. To serve, divide guzzle barbeque sauce between four small glasses. Top each with dollop of cream cheese.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,bread,pear,salsa,extra virgin olive oil,arugula leaf,portabella mushroom
title: Bread, Mushroom and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf bread | 2 cups cooked kidney beans | 1 jar salsa | 1 pear, diced | 2 portabella mushrooms, sliced thin | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 bag arugula leaves
instructions: Cut bread lengthwise in half and hollow out the centre. Scoop out bread leaving a hollow centre if desired. Combine beans, salsa and pear. Place filling inside bread halves. Heat oil in fry pan over medium heat and fry cheese, mushrooms and arugula for approximately 3 minutes or until arugula is just wilted. Drain cheese and arrange on top of bread with arugula to serve.

title: Ravioli II
ingredients: 2 cups tomato sauce | 2 cups tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 3 cups broccoli florets, chopped | 8 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup pepperoni, chopped | 1 carton plain yogurt
instructions: Combine tomato sauce, tomato sauce, vanilla, vodka, and cardamom in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes. Add broccoli, and continue to simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in pepperoni. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place 1 sheet of phyllo on a clean dry surface. Brush 2 sheets with melted butter, and cut with a sharp knife until they are about 1/4 thick. Repeat until all sheets are used. Cover phyllo with another sheet of phyllo, and cut until the sheets are 1/4 thick. Place 1/2 cup of the broccoli mixture in the center of the pastry. Fold the pastry over the filling, and brush the tops with butter. Repeat with the remaining phyllo and filling until the mixture is gone. Place ravioli in a baking dish, and cover with 2 more sheets of phyllo.

title: Swedish Cutlets
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 cup italian style breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine veal and bread crumbs, mixing well to ensure that the crumbs are evenly distributed. Shape into patties approximately 1 1/2 inches thick. Fry in a light coating of a light brown or a few drops of maple syrup. Drain on paper towels. Serve immediately when they are almost completely cool.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,pecan,beef chuck roast,green chilies,vegetable oil cooking spray,cooking sherry,fettuccine
title: Crock Pot Beef Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat | 1 package refrigerated fettuccine, cooked & drained | 2 cans chopped green chilies, undrained | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1/3 cup vegetable oil or 1/3 cup cooking sherry | 1 bay leaf | vegetable oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Preheat crock pot to high. Place fettuccine in crock pot and top with meat, chilies, and pecans. Spray top of dish with cooking spray. Cook on medium for 3 hours or on low for 6 or more hours depending on size of meat. Remove bay leaf. Discard bay leaf.

title: Sommers' Green Beans & Vegetables
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 can of cut string beans | 1 can tomato juice | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight for best results. This can be served with french fries, but also with lettuce and tomato salad.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,cumin,baking soda,sea salt,vodka,basmati rice,swiss chard leaf,vanilla pudding mix
title: Crazy Swiss Chard
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1 can fat-free evaporated milk | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 tablespoon dried fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 4 bunches swiss chard leaves or 2 bunches kale, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a 2 or 3 quart saucepan of boiling, salted water, cook rice until just tender and tender. Drain. Heat the milk in a 2 to 3 quart saucepan over low heat until just boiling, but not boiling. Remove from heat and stir in the pudding mix, fennel seeds, baking soda, cumin and salt. Transfer to a large bowl and chill until cool. Cut each chard leaf into a 12 inch square or 12 by 10 inch strip. Place chard into a 3 quart glass baking dish. Pour the milk mixture over the chard leaves. Cover and chill until beginning to julienne. Place rice in a colander over a large bowl. Drain excess water. Sprinkle chard greens with the remaining spices and toss to evenly coat. Cover and chill until serving time.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,peanut oil,tabasco sauce,vegetable broth,lamb stew meat
title: Hummus With Lamb
ingredients: 2/3 lb lamb stew meat or 2/3 lb beef stew meat | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Heat oil in large heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add meat and saute 3 to 4 minutes or until browned. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Remove meat and set aside. Pour broth into pan. Sprinkle with yogurt and tabasco. Cover and simmer 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Sausage and Spinach Pie (Pork or Chicken)
ingredients: 12 ounces italian sausage, casings removed | 1/2 cup almonds, blanched, chopped | 1/2 cup mixed spinach, coarse stems trimmed | 2 pears, pared, cut into wedges | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 9 ounces double cream, whipped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f degrees. Place sausage links on lightly oiled rimmed baking sheet. Bake 8 - 10 minutes at 450f degrees. Set sausages aside to cool. Heat oven to 350f degrees or place sasages in skillet and brown. Drain if necessary. Place spinach in colander. Toss with almonds to coat. Transfer to plate. Drain any excess liquid from skillet, pressing nuts into spinach. Arrange spinach on plate on top. Arrange pears and sausages evenly over greens. Bake for 15 minutes or until spinach is tender and pears are caramelized. Stir in spinach and almond extract. Pour cream over sausage and tomatoes and bake 10 minutes longer or until mixture is creamy and hot. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: banana,white wine vinegar,sesame oil,mayonnaise,cream tartar,prawn,green bell pepper,rom tomato
title: Australian Salad Topped With Smoked Dribs
ingredients: 300 g large raw prawns | 1/3 cup sour cream, preferably with a tartness level, light mayonnaise, or light sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated green bell pepper | 1/4 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 125 g roma tomatoes, halved lengthways | 1 banana, peeled, halved lengthways
instructions: Break the prawns up into bite sized clawed bits with a mallet then mix with the sour cream, peppers, sesame oil, vinegar, and cream of tartar. Leave it to sit for 10 minutes. Cut the tomato in half and slice across, then slice across again lengthways into thin strips. To serve, line a large serving platter with the tomato, banana leaf, and prawn mixture.

title: Mexican Spiced Smoothie
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup mango ( cut in chunks ) | 2 -3 ancho chilies | 2 tablespoons peanuts, roasted and chopped
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and blend on low until smooth. Serve on pita or crackers.

title: Soozpla
ingredients: 2 cups chicken cutlets | 1 cup polenta | 1 teaspoon white flour | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder
instructions: Place cutlets in a plastic bag with the flour and make a hole on the sides of the bag. Add apple juice and asafoetida to the hole and let juice run back into the bag. Pour over the cutlets. Let rest for at least 30 minutes in refrigerator. In a pot heat water to boiling and add polenta. Cook 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Cover and cook at a medium temperature 15 minutes or until tender. Serve with salad and steamed green vegetables.

title: The Most Perfect Pasta and Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 lb of your favorite italian bread | 2 -3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, finely chopped
instructions: Slice bread into 1/4 slices, and place in the freezer until completely frozen, about 45 minutes. Take out and slice bread into 2 or 3 pieces, and place in a blender or food processor. Pulse until finely chopped, add sun dried tomatoes and pulse until fine, adding only as much of the remaining frozen tomato broth as you need to make a very fine puree. Add more broth if desired for a thinner sauce. Transfer all the pasta and sauce into a medium pot over low heat. Add salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: pear,sea salt black pepper,fettuccine pasta,tortilla chip,red pepper flake,orange juice

instructions: Fill a bowl with ice cold water, and stir in pears until slightly softened, about 1 minute. Remove pears with a slotted spoon, and transfer to a bowl of ice cold water. Drain, and immediately toss with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Set aside to cool. Fettuccine pasta should be rinsed and drained. Place fettuccine pasta in a large pot, and pour boiling water over it. Cover, and cook over medium high heat until tender and slightly firm, about 8 minutes. Drain, and toss again with orange juice. Garnish with tortilla chips, if desired.

title: Clam Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces cooked ham | 1/2 lb fresh baby clams, shelled | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1/4 cup mint | 1/4 cup dry white wine | pepper | 5 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Wash and remove any stringy or hard shell blemishes from the salad greens, if desired. Drain the ham and arrange around the top of the mixed greens. Combine the remaining ingredients, except the salad greens, in a bow and mix thoroughly. Pour over the salad and toss until well mixed, just before serving.

title: Angel Hair Pasta with Chilies
ingredients: 14 ounces angel hair pasta | 1 fresh anaheim chilies or 2 jalapeno chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh coriander, roughly chopped
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente according to package directions. While the pasta cooks, heat a non stick skillet over medium high heat for 1 minute. Add chilies and coriander. Saute 2 minutes, add pasta and toss well to mix. Serve immediately.

title: Pot-Roasted Chickpeas and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dry rice | 1 can chickpeas, drained, rinsed | 3 slices canadian bacon | lemon peel
instructions: Place the rice and chickpeas in a 2 quart casserole dish. Add the canadian bacon. Sprinkle the lemon peel on top. Cover and bake at 300°f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the rice is fluffy. Variation, substitute a 1/2 cup of water, add the bacon strips, and heat slowly until the bacon is done.

Random Ingredients: tamarind juice,flat leaf parsley,lemon peel,mango,frosting,mint sprig
title: Mango Salad - Kafta Krob
ingredients: 1 ripe mango, peeled, pitted and diced | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh mint sprig, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon tamarind juice | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon peel, finely grated | 3 tablespoons frosting ( optional ) | fresh flat-leaf parsley ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except frosting in a medium bowl, and toss to combine. Season to taste with freshly ground black pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with finely chopped flat leaf parsley just before serving, if desired, or serve immediately with pita chips, as a topping for sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,button mushroom,cabbage,dark soy sauce,cream mushroom soup,vodka marinara sauce,phyllo dough
title: Baja Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb chuck roast | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can button mushrooms | 1 large cabbage, shredded | 1 bottle kraft baja vodka marinara sauce ( good quality ) | 1 teaspoon vodka marinara sauce | 16 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Brown roast in a frying pan and drain. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer for about 1 hour. Take off heat and let it cool a little while the sauce in the pan goes through the phyllo dough. Using a heart shaped cookie cutter, cut the rolls as you would for your own rolls. You will need about 12 pieces per roll this is about making a large quantity. title: Easy Beef Steak
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs boneless beef top loin steaks | coarse sea salt or kosher salt | 6 cups ice water
instructions: Combine salt to 6 cups ice water. Sprinkle over both sides of steak. Heat a heavy kettle to medium heat. Add 1 inch of water to coat the bottom of the pan. Place steaks in the kettle and turn heat down. Steam for 30 - 40 minutes, or until meat is tender. Use a meat thermometer to ensure the internal temperature reaches 160f to rare. Take it out of the oven and allow to sit for 5 minutes. Slice steak on the diagonal. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,bull eye barbecue sauce,vanilla extract,red chili pepper,sriracha hot sauce,margarine,italian wo n't hurt,plum
title: Sweet Spicy BBQ Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup margarine | 1 tablespoon red curry paste with curry paste | 1 cup sweet plums or 1 cup apricot, halved | 2 teaspoons red chili peppers, minced finely | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup bulls eye barbecue sauce | sriracha hot sauce
instructions: Heat kabobs to preferred high heat,. While your kabobs are heating up,. In skillet melt together 2 tbs. Of the margarine, the red curry paste, peppers, and vanilla in a sauce pan over a medium heat. Stirring constantly.

title: Hot and Spicy Chinese Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb unsmoked american cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes ( see description ) | 1 teaspoon red curry paste ( see description for curry paste ) | 2 teaspoons honey ( see note below if you have not tried this, the taste will be different ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ( see note below )
instructions: Using a heavy bottomed skillet over medium heat, brown the cheese until lightly browned. Add curry paste and cook until dark gold. Stir in honey and vanilla. Stir for 1 minute. Transfer contents of skillet to warm serving dish.

title: Vegetarian Artichoke Stuffed Sundae

instructions: Cook leek in nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, 1 to 2 minutes or until tender. Spoon artichoke mixture evenly over. Top with one more lettuce leaf. Sprinkle each with one more ounce of semisweet chocolate chips. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,oregano leaf,lime peel,bamboo shoot,topping,tomato paste,bread flour
title: Bruschetta With Bamboo Shoots

instructions: Mix all ingredients very well. Form into 8 patties. Coat the top with bread flour. Cook in a nonstick skillet, turning once, just until browned. Serve with marinara sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: green bean,basil pesto,sage,sun tomato oil,celery rib,fettuccine
title: Green Beans With Fettuccine and Sun Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, cut on the diagonal into 1-inch pieces ( or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 4 ounces fettuccine | 1 celery rib, diced | 3 tablespoons basil pesto | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: In a skillet add the sun dried tomato oil and cook until tender crisp. Stir frequently. Cook pasta in large pot of boiling water for approx 7 minutes, drain. Toss cooked pasta with pesto, celery and sage and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Yellow Bell Pepper and Chile Powder
ingredients: 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 12 whole black cardamom pods | 1 can or bottle cola-flavored rotel, chilled ( recommended ( san diego-style )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 3 1/2 to 5 quart nonreactive slow cooker. Cover cooker.

instructions: Brush the pork chops with oil and sprinkle with cornflour. Cook in hot cast iron frying pan, turning once, until golden on both sides and cooked through. Serve with the sweet guacamole and spring onions.

title: Wasabi Cod

instructions: Place cod in a large pot and cover with water. Heat until water just covers the cod. Bring to a boil. Stir the yogurt and wasabi together until it has been absorbed. Add the cod, bell pepper and cheese and stir to coat. Place in a serving bowl and serve, or refrigerate to meld flavors.

title: Macaroni and Vermicelli - Vermicelli & Sauce

instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water according to package directions, drain and set aside. Meanwhile, heat chili sauce in small saucepan on low heat till hot but not boiling. Add cooked pasta, stirring and allowing pasta to warm through. Toss with sauce.

title: Grilled Mushrooms With Gruyère-Anchovy Dip and Apples

Spread the mushrooms on a grilling pan and grill over high heat until they begin to soften, about 1 minute. Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,silken tofu,lettuce leaf,banana,pecorino romano cheese

instructions: Rinse tofu under cold water.

title: Moroccan Flavoured Rose Petals

instructions: In a food processor, chop the butter beans very fine. Add capers, parsley, scallions, rice vinegar, cider vinegar and butter and pulse until smooth, about 15 - 20 times. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,beef broth,confectioner ' sugar,tomato juice,beef stock

title: Molasses and Quesadilla (Blueberry Pudding)

instructions: Put rice milk, molasses, and cheese in a blender. Mix until combined and put into a warm bowl. Add prawns to mixture and mix well. Random Ingredients: grain white rice,salad green,red wine,lemon peel

title: Beef and Lemongrass (Gorki) Noodles

instructions: Cut steak into thin slices and place in a glass dish. Whisk together rice wine, klemongrass, cayenne and scallion puree. ingredients: 2 lbs cauliflower, cut into small florets | 8 -10 green cardamom pods | 2 whole thai peppers, broken into large chunks | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Place cauliflower in large pot with enough water to just cover. Add green cardamom pods, thai peppers, and chiles. Bring to boil, and cook for 5 minutes. Add rigatoni and cook for about 15 minutes, stir, and serve.

title: Tasty Apple Tea

instructions: Mix apples, mix spice and cheese. Add black tea, mix and enjoy.

instructions: Combine frozen peas and favas in a large microwave safe bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high until peas are hot, about 1 minute. Drain vegetables and keep warm. title: Warm Taco Dip

instructions: Beat cream cheese and buttermilk in a bowl with an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Scoop mixture into a bowl, and stir in taco seasoning. Refrigerate until cold, about 30 minutes, before serving.

instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil, add the pasta and cook for 3 - 4 minutes, until al dente. title: French Cauliflower Omelet (Diabetic)

instructions: Break the cauliflower in a large bowl. Grate a little bit of cauliflower to a fine paste using a food processor. Mix in the egg substitute. Place an ovenproof omlette skillet or omelette pan into the hot pan over medium high heat. If using a nonstick pan, cook until the bottom of the omelette is almost dry, about a minute or two.

title: Chiles Rellenos for Two
ingredients: 20 chilies ( can sub 1/2 can diced green chilies and can sub 1/2 can milder chilies, seeded and chopped ) | 1 box elbow macaroni | 1 container crumbled mexican blend cheese
instructions: Prepare and cook pasta as per package directions. Set aside. Meanwhile, heat oven to 350°f. In large skillet combine chiles, cheese and cooked macaroni. When noodles are done, toss with cooked and drained chile mixture.

instructions: In a small bowl, mix the cocoa powder and swiss cheese in a microwave oven. instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees centigrade. Place the lamb in a large mixing bowl. Add the red peppers, sage, honey and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
