title: Scallop, Pumpkin, and Pumpkin Flatbread Pizza
ingredients: 3 lbs scallops, peeled, cut in thirds lengthwise | 2 lbs canned chick-peas or 2 lbs canned pumpkin, rinsed and drained | 2 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons jalapeno chilies, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/2 cup basilmati rice ( dry ) | 1 whole pita bread, split | 4 ounces feta cheese, toasted and crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a large skillet, heat tomato paste, jalepeno and chili oil over moderate heat. Add sliced scallops and cook until scallops turn opaque, about 2 minutes. Remove scallops and drain on a paper towel. Add tomato paste mixture and heat through, 3 to 5 minutes. Meanwhile, spread 1/4 cup of the rice on the large baking sheet. Dollop onto scallops. Sprinkle top with remaining rice. Bake until golden, about 10 minutes. Place on platter, sprinkle with feta and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: margarine,rice vinegar,anchovy fillet,apricot,romano cheese,green bean,cream cheese,chili oil
title: Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 100 g green beans, trimmed | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 anchovy fillets, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 2 -4 drops chili oil | 4 romano cheese or 4 any cheese of choice
instructions: Steam the green beans until just tender. In a salad bowl, mix the sour cream, anchovy fillet, rice vinegar, oil and chilli oil. Just before serving, toss the green beans with the sour cream mixture and sprinkle with the cheese.

title: Apple Cider Vinegar Dip (Labanab)
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 cup plain greek yogurt
instructions: Pour vinegar into bowl of a electric beater, or the side of a strainer and set over a bowl, stirring to mix. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and set in a warm area to marinate for 2 hours or up to 8 hours. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a separate bowl, stir yogurt with wire whisk until smooth. In a 4 cup glass measure or glass baking dish, pour vinegar mixture and stir in yogurt until mixture is smooth. Turn mixture into baking dish, sprinkle top with paprika and bake in the preheated oven 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Beef Brochettes With Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Trim the ends off of the asparagus and cut into 1 inch lenghtwise pieces about 1 inch long. Boil the asparagus until bright green and bright green. Drain and pat dry. Heat a little more than a t tablespoon in a nonstick pan. Add asparagus and fry for 3 to 4 minutes until they have brightened. Add brown sugar and fry for another minute or two. They should look quite a bit glazed.

title: Apple Velveeta Cheese Applesauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb velveeta cheese, cubed | 1 tablespoon apple juice ( optional )
instructions: Place cubed velveeta cheese in microwave safe bowl with apple juice. Microwave on high for one minute. Pour mixture into a large bowl.

title: Clams in Clam Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs red-skinned clams, washed | 1 cup fresh cranberries, washed | 3 -4 -6 mild chilies, stemmed and slit lengthwise | 1/2 cup rice wine
instructions: Drain the clams and place into a saucepan with the cranberries, chilies, and the rice wine. Cook over moderate heat for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Transfer the mixture to a covered bowl and set aside to cool to room temperature. When mixture is cool, cover the bowl and refrigerate until served, stirring from time to time.

title: Taco Potato Packets
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning | 4 medium red potatoes, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices
instructions: Place taco seasoning packet in microwave and cook for 20 seconds.

title: Kofta's Greek Chicken With Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast half | 1/2 cup vegetable protein ( olivira soy protein can be substituted ) | 3 tablespoons plain low-fat yoghurt | 1 large roma tomato | pam cooking spray
instructions: Place the first 4 ingredients into a large ziploc bag. Shake and add the chicken to the bag.

title: Dried Onion and Garlic Spread
ingredients: 1 kg dried cocktail onion, very coarsely chopped | 1/2 litre sunflower oil | 3/4 cup cottage cheese
instructions: Place all ingredients in a deep pan and stir through gently until all ingredients are mixed and well mixed. Cover and leave to stand in very low heat for 1 hour stirring from time to time.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,milk,kaffir lime leaf,steak,pomegranate molasses,pork sausage,mussel
title: Grilled Steak With Sausages and Pomegranate Molasses
ingredients: 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons milk | 1 -4 piece swiss steak, about 1/4 1/2 pounds | 1/2 lb dried mussels, cleaned and debearded | 1 -2 piece pomegranate molasses | 2 slices pomegranate molasses | 4 pieces smoked pork sausage
instructions: Toast poppy seeds in a dry low oven, just until browned. Spray grill with oil and grill steaks for 4 minutes on each side or until browned.

title: Sunny Pudding
ingredients: 14 ounces unsweetened canned tomatoes, cut into chunks | 1 lb suet or 1 lb cornstarch | 1 teaspoon ground sage | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 3 drops tamarind pulp
instructions: Pour into a 3 qt. Ramekin or a 10 x 15 inch pan. Cover tightly. Bake 350°f about 1 hr. Cool. In a food processor combine the tomatos, suet, sage, almond extract, and tamarind pulp. Process. Pour half mixture into saucepan. Heat 2°f. Stir to blend. Pour into pan. Bake about 1/2 hr. Until top bubbles and crusty. Cut into wedges.

title: Vegetable Chips in Grits
ingredients: 1 package grits, recipe is 1-4-1 | 1/4 cup canola oil, i use vegetable oil | 1 can fat and grains, drained | 2 1/4 cups drained and rinsed plain baked beans, i use the deli type | 1 cup fat-free cottage cheese or 1 cup low fat shredded lowfat sour cream
instructions: Cook the grits as directed on the package until tender, drain and cool. Rinse the bag with cold water and drain. In a large skillet, add the canola oil and stir to warm. Add the bean rices and heat until hot. Add the grits and mix well. Stir in the cheese and cottage cheese. Heat for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Barley and Chocolate Barley Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 10 ounces bittersweet chocolate square | 1 cup sumac
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In a large stockpot cover barley with water, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until barley is tender, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and let stand about 45 minutes. While barley is cooking, break chocolate into chunks and melt slightly. Add sugar and mix well. Drain barley and reserve. Stir chocolate, and barley, and divide among 4 ovenproof dishes, placing each dish in the center of the dishes. Bake for about 25 minutes before the mixture is puffed and bubbly, stirring once or twice.

Random Ingredients: rotel,grand marnier,walnut,sultana raisin,mexican cheese,cumin seed,cottage cheese,penne
title: Mexican Pasta With Sultanas and Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb penne, cooked | 1 can rotel | 1 cup walnut pieces ( approx ) | 6 ounces cottage cheese | 6 ounces mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup sultana raisin | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Add remaining ingredients and mix together. If more sauce is desired, drain pasta and return to pot. Add sauce to pasta and mix. Serve over spaghetti or angel hair noodles.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,white flour,lime wedge,lemon juice,graham cracker crumb,cardamom powder
title: Lebanese Style Spiced Restaurant Fritters
ingredients: 2 cans rotel tomatoes | 1 cup fresh lime wedge | 3/4 cup grated raw lemons or 3/4 cup lime juice | 3 eggs | 1 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon grated cardamom powder ( optional ) | 2 cups finely crushed graham cracker crumbs or 2 cups plain graham crackers
instructions: Drain and set aside rotel tomatoes. Chop and set aside. Combine the lime wedges, raw lemons or lime juice, eggs, flour, cardamom and rotel tomatoes in blender. Blend for 1 minute. Add 1 cup crushed graham crackers, stir until moistened and well blended. Heat about 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in 10 inch skillet. Drop batter by tablespoons onto hot oil, a few at a time, and flatten to desired thickness. Cook until golden brown, 3 - 4 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center of fritter comes out clean. Repeat with other fritters. Drain fritters on paper towels. Serve with salsa, sour cream, guacamole, tomato sauce, etc.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,vanilla essence,mozzarella cheese,snow pea,peppercorn,beef stew meat,quinoa
title: Baked Ruzza
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, sliced | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup small cooked snow peas, halved | 1/2 cup canned chickpeas ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn ( optional ) | 1/2 cup smoked mozzarella cheese, diced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the beef, water and quinoa in a large oven proof crockpot. Cover and cook at 300 degrees f for 12 hours or until beef reaches an internal temperature of 125 degrees f. Add the peas and seasonings, cook uncovered for 15 minutes longer or until heated through. Serve topped with diced smoked mozzarella cheese.

title: Potted Wings
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs chicken wings | 1 cup suet | 1 cup soy flour | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | pine nuts, to serve
instructions: Trim any excess fat of the wings, or wash them thoroughly. Place wings in a large saucepan and add enough water to cover them by 1 inch. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes, skimming the scum as necessary until the water is nearly absorbed. Add suet and boil for 2 minutes, skimming any scum that rises to the surface. Blend with a little soy flour and vanilla essence. Remove from heat. Place the wings in a clean jam jar. Spoon the sauce over. Cover and store in the fridge for at least 3 days, shaking the jar at least once a week. Use in place of cinnamon or nutmeg on any pudding with your favourite meal.

title: Authentic Mexican Breadsticks
ingredients: 4 tablespoons guacamole | 1 cup bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 f. In a small bowl, blend guacamole with bread flour until mixture resembles cornmeal. With hands press dough into desired shape into a 2'' round. Cut dough in half to form long sticks with long, narrow ends sticking out onto cookie sheet. Bake on a rack for 10 - 15 minutes, or until light brown. Let cool 5 minutes on rack before removing from cookie sheet.

Random Ingredients: tomato,yeast,pimiento,white vinegar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,yoghurt,green chili pepper,chocolate syrup
title: Sicilian Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup yoghurt | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon instant yeast | 5 -6 pinches yeast | 1 fresh green chili pepper, seeded, finely diced | 1 large ripe tomatoes | pimiento, slices, to garnish
instructions: Scald yoghurt, stirring a bit. Dissolve yeast in hot yoghurt and add chocolate syrup and vinegar and stir until dissolved. Cool to warm, about 5 minutes. Cut tomato in thin wedges, discarding seeds. Combine all ingredients with yeast mixture and let cool to warm to room temperature. Cut pimento into thin strips over pasta and sprinkle with paprika. Bake in broiler until pimentos are crisp and puffed.

title: Smooth and Easy Butternut Squash Curry
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 1 pinch ground mace | 1 dash chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pierce or peel the squash with a fork in 1/2 inch cubes, and place them in a steaming rack in the oven. Cook for 40 minutes, or until tender. Turn heat to 425 degrees f. While squash cooks, heat chili oil in a saucepan over medium high heat until it shimmers, and cook and stir the mace with the mace for 1 minute. Remove squash from oven, pour hot oil into saucepan, and stir. Transfer the squash to serving dishes, and garnish with the mace.

title: Ginger Pizzelles
ingredients: sunflower oil | 12 whole anise seeds | 15 g guacamole
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan. When the oil is hot, add the aniseed seeds. After two minutes add the guacamole. Stir well to combine and allow to heat. Check the flavor, if needed, you will need to add a little of the oil in between stirring as the guacamole will absorb it.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,lime wedge,oat,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chili pepper
title: Grilled Cheese Bites
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh goro, cracked | 4 small dried hot chili peppers, seeded | 3 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 dried chili pepper, seeds and ribs removed | 1 cup dry rolled oats | lime wedge
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the cracked goro with the chili peppers, grated cheese, and pepper seeds. Knead in the rolled oats. Lightly oil a grilling rack. Grill over medium coals at medium distance, for 2 minutes on each side, or until the surface is lightly charred. Remove from the grill. Serve hot. Store unused pieces in the refrigerator.

title: Quick Easy Vegetable Couscous
ingredients: 1 medium size pie crust, for a crust ( or any other tart pastry ) | 1 liter vegetable stock ( or more ) | 1 cup couscous | 2 -3 tablespoons oil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Prepare your pie crust with cooking spray. Cover the bottom of your pastry shell with couscous and poke holes all over the couscous with a fork. Pour about 1/4 of the vegetable stock. Place your crust inside your crust and bake for 25 minutes. Meanwhile, bring the remaining vegetable stock and oil on a baking dish to a boil. Add couscous and return to boil. Turn off heat, cover with a cloth and let sit for 10 minutes. Then fluff with fork and add another tsp of flour if desired.

title: Sweet Chili Roll
ingredients: 10 skewers ( or bamboo ) | 24 ounces char-grilled deli-style sliced chocolate bars | 1 bottle roasted red chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | 1/2 cup sweet aromatic bitter | lettuce | 10 tortillas
instructions: In a highball glass bowl combine the red chili paste and bitter. Fill a bamboo skewers with the chile mixture. Place each skewer skewer on a plate. Heat grill to high. Grill until the cheese has melted and the meat just begins turning pink. Tortillas may be served on the side with salsa, but tortills will do just as well.

Random Ingredients: halibut,brown sugar,red pepper flake,rice noodle,triple sec,wheat bread
title: Grilled Halibut with Rice Noodles, Triple Sec Sauce and Black Pepper
ingredients: 2 lbs halibut, gutted and scaled | 4 tablespoons triple sec | 8 slices country bread, toasted | 1/4 cup chopped roasted red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 tablespoon rice noodles
instructions: Place halibut in a large glass or ceramic bowl, and add triple sec and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Remove and discard salt from fish on a plate. Preheat grill. Place bread on grill, and cook until toasted. Meanwhile, combine red pepper flakes and brown sugar in a small bowl. Remove fish from marinade and dry on paper towels, coating both sides. Season to taste with salt, and set aside. Brush each of the toasted bread slices with remaining marinade. Place fish in a pan, and top each with toasted bread, then top each fish with red pepper flakes. Cover with lid, and cook for about 15 minutes. Turn fish, and drizzle any leftover marinade over the fish before serving.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,lemon zest,ziti pasta,coconut cream,veal meat,butternut squash
title: Roasted Butternut Squash With Ziti and Coconut Cream
ingredients: 1 lb veal stew meat ( cut in 1-inch cubes ) | 1 butternut squash ( peeled, seeds removed and cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1 can coconut cream | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 12 ounces ziti pasta ( about 9 cups cooked )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Grease 4 3/4 quart shallow baking dish with cooking spray. Place beef, squash, coconut cream and cream of tartar in blender, and blend until smooth. Pour into baking dish, and top with ziti. Cover, and bake 40 - 45 minutes, or until heated through and ziti is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: beet,sharp cheddar cheese,italian sausage link,lemon juice zest,vanilla wafer
title: Italian Sausage and Beet Salad!
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage link | 2 large beets | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, divided | 12 vanilla wafers, chopped | 1/2 lb sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Boil sausage with 1/2 cup of water, until cooked through. Cut into bite size pieces. Peel cooled sausage and beet greens and place into a large bowl. Dice sausage into 1/2 inch pieces and add to greens. Dice and add to greens. Serve with a side of warm vanilla wafers. Garnish with cheese. Note, 1/2 cup of shredded sharp cheddar cheese will make a difference to your taste.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,toothpick,red bell pepper,cherry,cabbage,veal shank,dripping,red chile
title: Baked Veal Shank Roll Ups
ingredients: 1/3 cup oil, extra virgin | 4 veal shanks | 12 ounces cabbage, shredded | 1 medium red bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 12 ounces red chiles, julienned | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | toothpicks | sweet cherry, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Brush both sides of the veal with oil, season and place on an oven proof serving plate. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes turning once until done. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, toss the cabbage with the peppers, chilis, taco seasoning and salt and pepper to taste. Fill the center of each roll with the veal mixture and serve with salsa for dipping.

title: Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 2 lbs sourdough bread | 6 teaspoons salt | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder
instructions: Trim off the crusts from the bread using a fine cloth. Cut each loaf into 5 slices. In large bowl, soak the crumbs in salt and 4 teaspoons garam masala. Drain the bread. Place on a greased baking tray and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Cut in half and serve with curry, chutney or tomato sauce. Yum.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,clove,extra beef,tomato green chilies,chili oil,tamari,green bell pepper,meatball
title: Cafe Rio Spaghetti-Tamari
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked spaghetti | 1 lb frozen cooked meatballs, thawed | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch squares | 2 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 lb extra lean ground beef, thawed | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Prepare spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile, in large resealable bag, combine all ingredients, and mix well. Preheat oven to in large skillet, layer spaghetti, meat mixture, and sauce, ending with meat mixture. Cover and bake, stirring occasionally, approximately 30 minutes, or until sauce is hot and bubbly.

title: Smothered Carnitas
ingredients: 4 lbs top round beef brisket | 1 -2 poblano chile | 14 1/2 ounces mexicorn | 1 1/3 lbs ground beef brisket | 2 tablespoons papery seasoning | 2 tablespoons mexican-style powdered sugar ( we like mccormick ) | 1 lime, juice of | 3/4 cup yoghurt | 1 orange, juice of
instructions: Combine mince, chilies, kosher seasoning, and sugar.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,rice flour,vinegar,yellow squash,berry,rotel tomato,chocolate ice cream
title: Award Winning Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 yellow squash | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, chopped | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 cup berry, frozen pieces ( frozen ) | 2 tablespoons sprite or 2 tablespoons temptation tomato | 6 ice cream, to serve
instructions: Peel the squash, discard the ends & cut into bite size chunks. Place in a colander & toss with 1 tbsp rice flour. Sprinkle with the ginger & let drain for 20 - 30 minutes at room temperature or refrigerate overnight. Remove the mixture from the colander & rinse well under cold water.

title: New Potatoes With Rice
ingredients: 1 lb new potato, skin on | 1 lb dry long-grain rice
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan or deep, medium saucepan. Add potatoes and cook over a medium heat until almost tender, about 15 minutes. Add rice and stir for 2 to 3 minutes until rice is light brown. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,edamame green,arborio rice,clove,dark sesame oil,lime wedge,salmon fillet,oil
title: Armenian Rice With Salmon
ingredients: 4 cups arborio rice | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon black ground cloves | 1 lb salmon fillet, cut into chunks | 2 cups frozen shelled edamame ( frozen may be substituted green beans can be substituted ) | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Place rice and oil in a 4 1/2 quart heavy saucepan. Season with cardamom, cloves, cardamom pods and black pepper.

title: Irish Cream Curry Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant tea, i use instant double strength | 2 cups hot water | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon curried chicken meat | 1 tablespoon irish cream | 1 tablespoon quinoa | 2 -3 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Bring the water to a boil and stir in the tea. Add the curried chicken meat, quinoa and curry powder. Cover and cook over medium heat for 20 - 30 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed.

title: Simple Vietnamese Radish and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 5 -6 radishes | 1 bell peppers ( red if you want it really spicy ) or 1 a red pepper ( red if you want it really spicy )
instructions: Rinse and dry your vegetables. Chop your vegetables very finely. Cut your bell peppers into slices. Use a vegetable peeler with the peeler at the stem and make it very fine stripes or strive to about 1 long. Use a sharp knife to slice each stripe or strive. Sprinkle generously with salt and let sit for an hour to let the juices out. Line a colander with a large bowl or salad spinner with some paper towels, or place it in the sink to drain. Rinse up and dry your vegetables. Sprinkle generously with salt and rinse them well again.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,asparagus,sea salt,milk,self raising flour
title: Asparagus Muffins
ingredients: 12 g asparagus, fresh | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 cup tasty cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Snap off the hard base of the asparagus spears, roughly chop the stalks and steam them in boiling water for 2 minutes. Dissolve the flour in the cream, add the salt, mix well, set aside. Scrape the asparagus from the water with a little of the asparagus, bring to the boil, remove asparagus from pan. Stir flour mixture into the boiling water, then pour into muffin pan. Place in the oven and bake at 200 degrees c for 25 - 30 minutes or until the muffins are golden brown and risen to the touch. Serve warm or cold while still warm.

title: Maple Sesame Meatballs
ingredients: 5 lbs lean boneless pork loin | 1 large tomatoes, chopped | 3/4 cup sesame oil | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 cup light cream of wheat
instructions: Cut meat into pieces and place in a large non metallic bowl. Add tomato. Whisk together 1/4 cup of the sesame oil, maple syrup, and 1/4 teaspoon of the thyme. Pour this mixture over the meat, rubbing in all the spices. Cover and refrigerate overnight turning the meat once. The next day drain off excess juice. Heat a 1 t. Olive oil over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking and add the meat. Brown lightly all over, 1 to 2 minutes on each side and transfer to a paper towl lined baking sheet. To make the sauce, stir the cream of wheat into the remaining sesame oil mixture and simmer until the sauce thickens, 10 - 15 minutes. Pour into simmering sauce and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Cover and refrigerate for up to a week.

title: Tortas
ingredients: 1 package herb seasoned stuffing mix | 1 1/2 cups low-fat buttermilk | 1/2 cup oats ( not instant ) | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Mix the stuffing mix and buttermilk in a medium bowl. Stir in the oats. Mix to blend well. Spoon into prepared baking sheet and sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake for 10 minutes, or until the edges lightly browned.

title: Kratzedki
ingredients: 1 cup potato starch | 1/3 cup dried currants
instructions: To make dough, in a small bowl, combine potato starch and currants and knead into a smooth pliable dough. Cover and let rest for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Form into a round cake about 9 inches thick. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Bahama Mama Pork Sausages
ingredients: 4 pork sausage, casings removed | 8 sprigs fresh lemon rind | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Trim away excess fat and membrane from outside of sausages, and split lengthwise in half crosswise, leaving at least 2 inches of the meat on each half. Slice the lemons lengthwise into halves and discard pith. Cut each half into three wedges, discard rinds, and place onto a non stick baking sheet. Toss sausage with turmeric and lemon rind. Preheat grill pan over medium heat, place sausages, meat side down, and grill about 5 minutes, turning once, or until done to your liking. Meanwhile, mix ketchup, lemon juice, and brandy in a bowl, stirring until combined. When meat is done, remove from skillet and slice along the grain. Serve hot from the skillet with lemon ketchup mixture.

title: Cantonese Barley and Eggs
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 package smoked shitake mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Place barley, dill, 1 pepper, and mushrooms in a large resealable plastic bag or bowl. Seal bag and shake to mix ingredients evenly. Refrigerate for no more than half an hour, shaking bag occasionally to help release excess liquid. Cook 1 - 2 minutes per side of the eggs. Remove from bag and serve.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,provolone cheese,italian seasoning,rye bread,sultana raisin,yukon gold potato
title: Irish Potato Croquettes
ingredients: 5 lbs medium yukon gold potatoes | 1 cup sultana raisin | 1 loaf rye bread | 1 cup shredded provolone cheese | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Rinse and slice potatoes into 1/2 inch thick slices. Cook in lightly salted water until tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and set aside. Coat croquettes in sesame oil and sprinkle with cocoa powder, and sprinkle with italian seasoning. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,cardamom seed,pecorino romano cheese,phyllo pastry,rosemary,corn flake,pomegranate juice
title: Baked Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom seed ( optional ) | 12 sheets phyllo pastry ( thawed ) | 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary | jalapeno pepper, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a small bowl, combine corn flakes, cheese, rosemary and cardamom and set aside. Brush tops of pastry with pomegranate juice and roll jelly roll style. Lay pastries on a baking sheet with sides. Cut each pastry roll diagonally into 6 slices. Brush tops with pomegranate juice and sprinkle on rosemary. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, cool and garnish with chopped rosemary.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,mushroom,lemon peel,beef broth,white fish fillet,cream tartar,chili flake,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Spicy White Fish With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillet ( such as haddock, cod, or haddock, with some skin and bones on ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups beef broth or 1 1/2-2 cups fish stock | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes ( or to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 8 ounces fresh mushrooms | 2/3 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Place fish in a nonreactive dish. Add broth. Cover and marinate the fish overnight, turning once. In a large skillet, heat corn oil until shimmering. Add lemon peel, chili flakes, and cream of tartar. Cook until mixture is slightly dried, about 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes more. Pour over the fish. Sprinkle parmigiano reggiano cheese on top. Cover and marinate at least 6 hours, but no longer than 8 or preheat a grill to medium high. When ready to serve, remove fish from marinade and set aside. Drain all but 1 1/2 3 t oil from skillet. Place fish on a baking sheet or pan and set aside until ready to grill. Brush grill rack with a little of the reserved oil and grill until fish is just cooked through. If desired, grill over medium low heat for a few minutes to brown both sides of the fish. Serve immediately.

title: Sausages in Spiced Cream
ingredients: 1 lb pork roast or 1 lb pork sausage ( the smoked sausage is used ) | 1 lb kielbasa ( or similar sausage ) | 4 tablespoons single cream or 4 tablespoons cream | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon chili pepper
instructions: If using the smoked sausage, slice thinly and cut into 1 1/8 pieces.. Cut sausage into 1 pieces. Cook sausage in a pan of hot water for 10 minutes or till brown about 3 times in size. Drain sausage, saving fat. In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together, except for fat. Add sausage to mixture. Cook sausage and mixture over very low heat for about 8 min, stirring a couple of times if necessary to make sure everything is well coated with mixture. Serve with mashed potatoes or hot noodles.

title: Sweet and Spicy Restaurant Style Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 yellow onion | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 lb jalapeno, chopped ( canned or fresh green ) | 2 cups diced canned tomatoes ( not drained ) | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 teaspoons chili oil | crushed toasted crisco ( optional )
instructions: Place peppers, onion, parsley, oregano, tomato paste and chili oil in a food processor. Puree and set aside. Bring all ingredients to a simmer in a large pot. Simmer 5 minutes. Turn off heat. Add crushed toasted crisco until the sauce coats the tortilla chips or spoon into your tortilla shells. These will hold a long time and will last 2 weeks in a zipper log bag.

title: Canned Barley - Barley
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, uncooked | 10 3/4 cups stock or 10 3/4 cups broth
instructions: Pick through whole barley, make sure barley is not hard. Cut barley into small 1/2” squares. In a large pot combine drained barley squares and 10 cups of stock and bring to boil. Cover tightly and reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Allow to simmer for 2 hours. Remove barley containers, ladle out excess liquid and cool before storing in refrigerator or freeze. Use within 1 month.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,herb,salt pepper,onion salt,half,tomato green chilies,cayenne,soymilk
title: Creole Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup low fat soymilk or 1/2 cup whole milk | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons grated onion salt | 1 tablespoon finely chopped mixed herbs | 1 tablespoon chopped cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely crushed black peppercorns | 2 cans chopped tomatoes, including 1-2-2 canned pieces of tomato ( drained )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan or saucepan, bring to boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Immediately remove from heat. Allow to cool.

title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces soy noodles | 1 cup cream cheese, softened | 2 cups rolled oats
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Add cream cheese and oats. Toss well.

title: Lori's Mexican Phyllo Chicken
ingredients: 6 pieces thawed phyllo pastry, thawed to room temperature | 3 cups canned low sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon anise extract | 4 serrano peppers, sliced thinly | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Heat chicken broth in a saucepan over medium heat until reduced to about a half. Remove from heat and stir in anise extract. Cover and set aside. Heat a medium skillet over medium heat. When hot, lay a sheet of phyllo pastry dough out on a clean surface. Place 1/8th of the serrano peppers in a row down the center of the phyllo and stretch the edge over the pepper half as shown on the phyllo sheet. Place 1/4 cup of the chicken broth over the serrano peppers. Place another 1/8th of the serrano pepper on top of the chicken and top with the remaining 1/8th of the serrano pepper. Layer the phyllo, peppers, and chicken as directed in the description above. With a sharp knife, cut a series of diagonal lines about 1 1/2 inches deep on both sides of the phyllo. Working quickly, fold phyllo in half and then cut in half again until pieces measure 12 inches long and are no longer separate either. Fold a second piece of phyllo on top of the first and last and place on a sheet of parchment. Place in refrigerator until ready to use. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine guacamole and remaining serrano pepper. Sprinkle top of phyllo with cheese and bake in the the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: food coloring,clove,yellow bell pepper,corn muffin mix,beef sirloin,season salt,bok choy
title: Sloppy Joes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn muffin mix | 1 small yellow bell pepper | 1 teaspoon dried beef sirloin, chopped | 3 leaves green bok choy, chopped | 1 dash food coloring ( optional ) | 1 pinch season salt ( optional ) | 1 pinch ground cloves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine the corn muffin mix, bell pepper, beef sirloin, bok choy, food coloring, seasoning salt, and garlic powder.

title: Broiled Red Snapper With Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb red snapper, cleaned and scaled | 1/2 lb farfalle pasta | 3/4 cup reduced-fat balkan yogurt
instructions: Place the fish in the broiler. Place under a hot broiler for 3 to 5 minutes each side or until flesh flakes easily when pierced with a fork and flakes easily. Remove fish from broiler and set aside. To the broiler, add the pasta and return it to the broiler. Broil approximately 6 minutes or until pasta is done. Stir well before serving. Add yogurt just before serving.

title: Mexican Watermelon and Macaroon Salad from Microwave
ingredients: 1/2 cup watermelon, peeled, chopped | 3 tablespoons macaroons, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Combine watermelon and macaroons in a microwave safe bowl. Combine vinegar and watermelon mixture.

Random Ingredients: catsup,garlic flake,mutton chop,cauliflower floret,bamboo skewer,penne pasta,chili sauce,oil
title: Penne With Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 lb pork chop | 1 cup penne pasta | 2 tablespoons oil | 4 bamboo skewers | 1 cup cauliflower floret | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic flakes
instructions: Trim excess fat from the chops. In a skillet, brown the chops in the oil for 1 minute on each side, then set aside. Cook penne for 1 minute less, then drain. In the same skillet, brown the cauliflower and cauliflower for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir. Add catsup, chili sauce and garlic flakes to the skillet. Stir. When hot, toss the drained rice into skillet and pour over the sauce. Add the chops back into the skillet and stir until heated through. Serve.

title: Pumpkin and Parmesan Grissini
ingredients: 8 slices french bread, cut on the diagonal | 6 tablespoons grated pecorino cheese | 1 1/2 cups pumpkin puree | 3 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Brush a nonstick baking sheet with some melted butter or oil. Spread bread slices evenly with cheese. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Sprinkle with additional cheese. Bake in preheated oven until cheese is melted, about 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Garden Fresh Wheat Bread
ingredients: 1 cup wheat germ | 4 cups hot water
instructions: Put wheat germ and hot water into a 3 quart mixing bowl or a 3 quart baking dish. Beat with a mixer until all the dry ingredients dissolve. The mixture should form into rough bread crumbs that are a bit sticky but not solid in texture. Stir in more water to moisten if needed. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Spread into a well buttered loaf pan and bake at 325 degrees f. For 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: clove,tamari,black cardamom pod,pearl barley,habanero,superfine sugar,french bread,ancho chile powder
title: Mexican Barley and Ancho Chutney
ingredients: 1/4 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon french bread, crust removed, crumbled | 4 cloves | 4 black cardamom pods | 4 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh habanero ( or 1/4 tsp. finely chopped green chilie or jalapeno ) | 1/2 teaspoon superfine sugar
instructions: Soak a 2 - 3 pound piece cloth in cold water. Drain, then place in a bowl with the pearl barley and ancho chili powder. Mix well. Place a shallow baking or broiler tray on the counter and preheat the broiler. If you don't have a baking stone, place 6 - 8 pieces of parchment paper on a baking sheet. Using a rolling pin, roll 1/4 cup barley mixture into a ball, then press to form a uniform circle about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Repeat until all the mixture is used. Press the circle of barley on a sheet of the parchment paper to form more of a circle of barley around the edges. Repeat the process until all the mixture is used. Cut off a 5 or 6 inch strip near the center of the chutney about 1/2 inch from the outside edge and the top of the crust. Poke 2 - 4 holes into the crust, using a long toothpick. If possible, use scissors to cut in the chutney before removing and placing over the rim. Allow to cool about 20 minutes before using. In a small sautee pan or saucepan, combine the remaining ingredients. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Stir often to prevent a skin forming, then remove from heat. Let cool 5 minutes. Pour in a small ladleful of hot chutney and serve. If the chutney is too thin, refrigerate until thoroughly chilled before adding the rest.

Random Ingredients: peppermint extract,serrano pepper,almond milk,basil leaf,sage leaf,salami,turmeric,spanish onion
title: Antipasta (Antipasta Bread)
ingredients: 1/3 cup salami, diced or 1/3 cup salami, diced | 1/3 cup spanish onion, diced | 1/4 cup peppermint extract | 12 large basil leaves, sliced ( not dried ) | 8 fresh sage leaves ( not dried ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 cup almond milk | 1 medium serrano pepper, roasted
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the roasted peppermint extract and basil and mix well. Refrigerate at least 2 hours, ideally overnight. Strain out the basil and sage leaves. Place the mixture in a blender. Blend as smooth as possible and add a bit of almond milk if the mixture is too thick, it should look like a very thick paste.

title: Wasabi Onigiri
ingredients: 4 cups salsa | 1 teaspoon wasabi powder
instructions: Mix salsa with wasabi powder.

Random Ingredients: lime peel,fenugreek leaf,bread crumb,green bean,ketchup,velveeta cheese,ancho chile powder
title: Stuffed Green Beans
ingredients: 20 ounces frozen green beans, thawed and slightly mashed | 1 tablespoon minced ancho chile powder or 1 tablespoon chipotle hot sauce | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 2 pinches dried bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons minced red-leaf filipino-style fenugreek leaves | 2 limes, cut into slices | 2 ounces shredded velveeta cheese
instructions: Mix mashed green beans with chile powder and set aside, in the refrigerator, for at least an hour, or overnight. Mix bread crumbs with sugar until crumbs hold together well. Stuff each green bean with this mixture, spreading evenly to cover. Place 1 slice of velvetta cheese into each bean cup, then top with the second slice of cheese. Wrap each with foil, and bake at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes, or slightly less, until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Sauteed Swiss Chard and Beans
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron | 2 teaspoons celery salt | 8 cups swiss chard, about 8 ounces, chopped | 7 cups swiss chard, about 4 ounces | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place saffron in a small bowl. Rub over greens and toss in a small plate. Divide greens among 4 - 6 inch cast iron skillet or saute pans. Add 1/4 cup water, beans and 1/2 teaspoon salt.

title: Waldorf Style Oriental Salad
ingredients: 1 green spring onion ( use spring onions or green onion ) | 1 tablespoon dried herbs | ginger powder | 2 ounces finely chopped walnuts or 2 ounces coarsely chopped almonds
instructions: Chop spring onions and soak in warm water for 5 to 10 minutes. Drain and dry with paper towel. Fry onions in lightly oiled frying pan in batches till golden brown and crisp. Remove and drain on paper towels. Put all ingredients except nuts in a serving dish and mix to combine. Toss with the nuts and serve.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,rosemary,mascarpone,grain white rice,cooking oil,soy sauce
title: Cabbage Rice Pancakes With Rosemary and Soy Cream
ingredients: 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking oil ( such as peanut ) | 2 cups sliced red cabbage | 0.5 container refrigerated mascarpone, chilled and cut into thin sticks
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, rosemary, and rice. Set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. When oil shimmers, add half the cabbage and cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown, about 1 minute. Repeat with the next 2 tablespoons oil, cabbage, and mascarpone until finished. Set aside. In a small bowl, stir the remaining 1 tablespoon of fat with the remaining teaspoons of fat. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil. When the oil shimmers, add half of the cabbage and cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels. Repeat with the last tablespoon of oil and cabbage. In the skillet used to cook the cabbage and pancakes, reheat the pancake mixture for 5 minutes or until hot. Add the skillet mixture and cook for about 1 minute, coating the bottom with pancake batter. Divide each pancake between 2 plates. Ladle soy cream onto each plate and place the pancake in the center of each plate.

title: Stuffed Grape Leaves
ingredients: 1 head baby spinach | 1 pint grape | 1 cup thawed frozen whipped topping
instructions: Chop spinach finely and place in bowl with a layer of thawed grape leaves. Sprinkle fresh whipped topping on top.

title: Slow Roast Lamb
ingredients: 2 kg lamb shoulder ( trimmed of fat ) | 2 inches gingerroot ( peeled and crushed ) | 3 cans coconut water | 1 can tomato puree | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c place lamb in a roasting tray and sprinkle with ginger. In a heavy based saucepan add the coconut water, tomato and chives and season with salt and bring to the boil. Cover and transfer to a moderate oven for 45 - 50 minutes or until lamb is tender & golden brown. Remove from oven and remove the meat from the pan. Increase temperature to 140c and drain lamb. Use cooking fat remaining in the pan to cook the meat juices. Slice the meat into thick slices and serve accompanied by the sauce, or as gravy with crusty bread or steamed carrots.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,baby corn,asiago cheese,malt vinegar,blueberry,phyllo pastry,potato,rosemary
title: Blueberry Strudels
ingredients: 20 sheets phyllo pastry | 6 tablespoons light malt vinegar | 2/3 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1 1/4 lbs sweet potatoes ( about 4 medium ) | 20 ounces baby corn, in sauce ( about 4-5 ears mixed ) | 1 1/3 cups asiago cheese, grated ( about 3 to 4 ounces )
instructions: Position rack in middle of oven and place a rack in lower third of oven. Line a cookie sheet with wax paper or parchment. Separate phyllo sheets by bringing a large large pot of salted water to boil. Remove from heat, and set aside. In a small bowl, stir together raisins, vinegar, raisins, salt and rosemary. Preheat oven to 375°f. Trim ends of phyllo, but leave enough for a 9x13 inch baking dish with a 2 inch overhang on all sides and inside edges. Working with 1 sheet at a time, put parchment in a wide, straight sided, shallow, heavy duty baking dish, and place remaining phyllo sheets in a different shallow dish. Set aside. Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets, using additional sheets and placing the remaining 3 sheets of phyllo in a different shallow dish. Set baking dish in rimmed baking pan and brush with oil. Cut sweet potatoes lengthwise into 1/4 inch wide wedges. Arrange sweet potatoes in a 9x13 inch baking dish, brush with oil, and sprinkle with salt. Spoon 1 teaspoon raisins onto half of phyllo, then scatter corn on top of sweet potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Top potato with remaining phyllo sheets and place baking dish on oven rack. Bake until dough is golden and top is crusty and slightly crisped, about 45 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into squares to serve.

title: Golden Granola
ingredients: 2 containers coconut milk | 3/4 cup tahini paste | 3 tablespoons melted golden syrup | 3 tablespoons sherry | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large bowl, mix well. Add sesame seeds, if using. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours, or until mixture is firm. If using the sunflower or sesame seeds, spread on a flat surface and sprinkle with sugar. Use as topping for salads, breads, etc.

title: Pesto Parsnips and Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, small to medium | 1/3 cup pesto | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 6 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1/4 cup picante sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Trim parsnips if desired, cutting with a serrated knife. Bring large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add parsnips and cook uncovered until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and toss with pesto and maple syrup. Add 1/2 cup parsley. Pour over parsnips. Spread remaining pesto over top, sprinkle with remaining parsley, and serve.

title: Honey & Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans ( i find that at the grocery store frozen kind is perfect for this ) | 1/3 lb honey | 1 lb chicken meat
instructions: Bring a kettle of salted water to a boil. Boil green beans about 5 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain well. Place all ingredients in a large saucepan and cook over medium heat until all ingredients are tender.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,sharp cheddar cheese,catsup,sherry wine,red chile
title: Cauliflower Delight
ingredients: 1 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried red chiles | 1 cauliflower floret, cut into small florets
instructions: Combine cheese, catsup, sherry and chiles.

title: Blueberry Pimiento Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh blueberries | 2 jar pimientos, drained and sliced
instructions: In a salad bowl combine the blueberries and pimento slices.

title: Peanut and Golden Marnier Appetizer
ingredients: 450 g snow peas or 450 g green beans, trimmed | 150 ml grand marnier, white | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons sunflower oil ( optional )
instructions: Trim the green and young beans, then steam them until just tender. Blanch the snow or snow peas in boiling water, then drain and plunge in cold water. Cut into bite sized pieces and toss with 1 tbsp of the grand marnier. Sprinkle with sesame if using.

title: Crispy Pea Pods
ingredients: 1 cup split peas pods | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon ground dry instant brown mustard seeds
instructions: Place split peas pods and mustard seeds in a large skillet. Pour in enough oil to cover the pods by about 1 1/2 inches. Place skillet over medium high heat and add extra oil. When oil shimmers, add the ground brown mustard seeds. Allow to sputter, then turn heat to medium low and allow popping to subside. Be careful if using a cast iron skillet, it may splatter and splatter very badly. When popping stops, remove from heat. Fill a colander with a little cold water. Dip the coated pods into the hot water and immediately transfer the drained pods to the colander over the sink. Repeat this process until all pods are coated. Place the coated dumplings on a plate and allow to drain for a few minutes, then immediately plunge into the cold water. Turn out onto a serving platter and allow to dry to crisp.

title: Beef in Noodles (Sbd P2)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef steak | 1/4 cup flour | 1 egg noodles, broken | 1 jar chestnuts, drained ( reserve juice ) | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper
instructions: Combine flour, egg noodles and chestnuts. Dredge steak in flour and brown in hot oil. Add broth and simmer 30 minutes. Add chopped peppers and oregano and simmer 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella ball,pimiento,lettuce leaf,oyster sauce,radish,chicken breast half
title: Yummy Wonton Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped pimiento | 1 tablespoon chopped smoked mozzarella ball | 2 leaves lettuce leaves | 2 thin slices boneless chicken breast halves, sliced into thin strips | 1 -2 cup chopped radish | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Dice the pimiento and mozzarella into smaller cubes. On a work surface, drizzle with the pimento or olive oil. Wrap one lettuce leaf with a chicken breast and a drizzle of oyster sauce. Arrange two strips of pimento cheese on the chicken, and put a few strips of radish around the cheese. Place a second lettuce leaf on top. Place a toothpick in the center, and hold with a toothpick to hold the toothpick shut. Repeat steps 6 - 11 three more times, or just serve in a sandwich press.

title: Chinese Peanut Spread (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons finely chopped gingerroot | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1 package cream cheese | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: Place all ingredients in a rice cooker and follow the manufacturer's directions for the beans and ginger. Turn on to 'cook' setting and let set for five minutes.

Random Ingredients: rhubarb,basmati rice,black pepper,rye bread,butter bean,lime juice,pickle relish,pepperoni
title: Pepperoni Poppers and Rice
ingredients: 500 g basmati rice | 1 liter unsalted butter beans ( sliced ) | 1 packet pickle relish | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | fresh ground black pepper | fresh rhubarb ( optional ) | rye bread
instructions: Cook rice until tender, drain and rinse with cold water. Place a layer of rice on a flat plate. Spread pickle relish on rice. Spread the diced pepperoni on top of the relish. Spread 1 tbsp olive oil on rice and pepperoni. Spread 2 tbsp lemon juice on top and season with pepper to taste. Spread 2 tbsp lime juice on the rice, add a layer of sliced rhubarb, top with the leftover rice and pepperoni mixture and finally top with rye bread cubes or sliced fruit. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Oatcakes (Oatcakes With Vegetables!)
ingredients: 400 g flour | 200 ml oatmeal ( i used 2 cups of bread but your choice ) | 60 g canola oil | 250 g mixed vegetables of your choice
instructions: Put flour in a large bowl. Add oatmeal and mix well. Cut a cross in the flour then quickly stir in oil on your cutting board leaving a 1cm thick border around the edge. Then, using a fork, quickly fluff the dough with your fingertips. Add the vegetables and mix everything around until they are evenly combined and the dough ball resembles small marble balls. Preheat oven to 180c or slightly less. Using lightly salted hands shape each roll into a circle approx 10 x 15 inches about 1/2 inch thick. Using a very sharp knife, slice oatcakes into 12 - 15 wedges. Arrange oatcakes on a baking tray and bake about 30 minutes. Remove and allow to cool on a rack.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,garam masala,pickle relish,ladyfinger,olive,peanut oil,grand marnier
title: Ancho Chile Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 20 ladyfingers | 1 -2 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon sweet pickle relish | 1/2 teaspoon ancho chile powder ( or to taste ) | 6 -8 tablespoons peanut oil or 6 -8 tablespoons canola oil, for grilling chicken | 1/2 cup sweet pickle relish | 1 tablespoon grand marnier ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder or 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: In medium saucepan over moderate heat, mix 2 tbsp olive oil with 1/2 teaspoon garam masala. Remove from heat. Split ladyfingers lengthwise. Brush with the olive oil mixture. Sprinkle with paprika and 1/2 tsp ancho chile powder. Grill 5 minutes, or till done. Meanwhile, in bowl, mix 2 tbsp sweet pickle relish with 1/2 tsp ancho chile powder. Brush top side of each ladyfinger with sauce. Brush with sauce. Grill until done. Topping side, in small bowl, stir together 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish with 1/4 tsp garam masala. Stir in 1 1/2 tsp chile powder. To serve, sprinkle dipping mixture on dipping.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,farfalle pasta,yeast cake,coleslaw mix,tomato sauce,hot sauce
title: Saucy Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, cut in 1/4 ``-inch slices | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 package fast rising yeast cake | 1 can beef gravy | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 8 ounces packaged coleslaw mix
instructions: In large non metal bowl, combine beef, tomato sauce, yeast cake, hot sauce and coleslaw mix. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Roll out half of egg mixture. Cut in rolls and eat while hot.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup beef broth, homemade or 1/2 cup chicken broth
instructions: Blend together with a hand blender on high, then chill. Serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato basil pasta sauce,hot green chili pepper,coconut milk,vegetable oil,pecan,balsamic vinegar

instructions: Using a food processor, process the pecans until finely ground. Add the coconut milk, vegetable oil, balsamic vinegar and chillies. Blend well. Add the tomato basil pesto and blend thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Chipotle Cornish-Potatoes #RSC
ingredients: 1 bag dried red potatoes | 3 -4 slices bacon ( can use less ) | 1/2 cup raspberry preserves | 1/2 large onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons chipotle powder | 1 tablespoon salt ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Grease a 9 x 13 pan. Put potatoes in a pot, cover with water, and boil on medium until tender, about 15 - 20 minutes. While potatoes are boiling, fry bacon until crisp, drain off most of the fat, crumble bacon in bowl. Save bacon fat, drain potatoes, and mash with chipotle powder. Add butter, salt, or other seasonings to the crumbled bacon fat.

Random Ingredients: molasses,chicken stock vegetable,sea salt pepper,cardamom,baking powder,turmeric
title: Ras El Hanout - Moroccan Spice Soup
ingredients: 4 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons unsalted chicken stock or 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 5 cups chicken stock or 5 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | sea salt and pepper ( optional )
instructions: In a medium pot, mix together the molasses and stock. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer about 25 minutes. Stir occasionally. Stir in the turmeric, cardamom and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 1 minute more. This makes a thick, sweet soup. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,wonton wrapper,ruby port,chorizo sausage,chili sauce,kiwi fruit
title: Chorizo and Kiwi Dumplings
ingredients: 40 wonton wrappers | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 cup chili sauce | 1 cup port | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/4 cup ruby port | 4 kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced
instructions: Combine chicken bouillon granules, 1 cup chili sauce, and 1 cup port in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,farfalle pasta,parsley leaf,white wine vinegar
title: Flamb Frites With Olives
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta, fresh or 6 ounces elbow macaroni | 3/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted | 1 tablespoon minced bottled parsley leaves | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Cook pasta according to the directions on package. Drain. While pasta is cooking, heat oil in large skillet. Add olives and cook 2 minutes. Stir in parsley and vinegar. Toss with drained pasta and olive mixture and serve.

title: Chilled Tuna Soup
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained or 1 3/4 cups cooked fresh tuna | 3 1/4 - 5 2/3 teaspoons kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped or 1 2 tsp lime zest
instructions: Mix the tuna together and stir in the lime juice and lime leaves. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baby red potato,picante sauce,swiss cheese,bean sprout
title: Confetti Swiss and Potato Packets
ingredients: 1 can mixed baby red potatoes, drained | 1 can bean sprouts, drained | 1 1/2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Heat the picante sauce over medium heat in a medium skillet. Add the swiss cheese. When the cheese is melted, add the potatoes, stir and cover. After 15 - 20 minutes, cover again, remove. After 15 minutes, stir again, then remove. After 5 - 10 minutes, add the bean sprouts and stir and serve. If you would like a milder sauce, remove 2 tablespoons of picante sauce and add back..

title: Zucchini & Cheese Crust
ingredients: 2 pie shells, unbaked | 1/2 lb green zucchini, chopped | 7 tablespoons lard, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray baking sheet with vegetable spray. Combine zucchini & 5 tbsp lard. Spoon into prepared pie shell. Bake 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Sponge Cakes
ingredients: 1 pound lobster tails, cooked and chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chervil | 1 1/2 tablespoons poultry seasoning | 1/2 tablespoon white sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lobster, chervil, poultry seasoning, sugar, and lobster mixture. Mix thoroughly, creating small circular patties. Heat a non stick griddle or frying pan over medium heat. Cook the patties 3 to 4 minutes each side, or until lightly browned. Serve with maple syrup.

Random Ingredients: tamari,garlic paste,italian plum tomato,oyster sauce,asparagus,asiago cheese,lime wedge
title: Pan Fry Asparagus
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh asparagus | 2 tablespoons asiago cheese | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, drained and chopped ( or use one of the canned tomatoes ) | 1 lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Boil asparagus in lightly salted boiling water for 1 minute, then drain and set aside. Combine 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, 2 tablespoons olive oil, tamari, and garlic. Combine asparagus, tomatoes, and cheese in a large bowl with dressing mixture and toss to coat. To eat, toss through asparagus mixture. Garnish to season.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,red chile,green chile pepper,romaine lettuce,graham cracker crumb
title: Mexican Green Chile and Pineapple Snacks
ingredients: 4 cans chopped green chile peppers, drained | 8 ramekins graham cracker crumbs, divided | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 2 cans chopped jalapeno-flavored red chile peppers, drained | 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with one of the graham cracker crumbs. Arrange 1/2 the whole olives in a layer in the bottom of the dish. Place 1/2 the chiles between the cracker crumbs and spread over the chiles. Arrange 2/3 of the pimentos, red chile peppers, and romaine lettuce over the top of the chiles.

title: Beef and Calamari Lasagna
ingredients: 1/2 sirloin, trimmed | 1 lb linguica or 1 lb squid, cleaned and sliced thinly | 1 lb uncooked lasagna noodle | 16 ounces half-and-half | 1 1/2 cups gruyere cheese, shredded | 12 wasabi | 8 pita bread, halved
instructions: Dice the sirloin into 1 - ¼ inch cubes and trim the tentacles. Remove the white outside of the body from the crab, then slice in half lengthwise. Set aside. Prepare the pasta according to package directions, then boil until al dente. Meanwhile, rinse the pasta under cold water. When the noodles are boiling, preheat the oven to 375ºf. Remove the meat and squid from the shells and place in a medium bowl. Add all of the remaining ingredients except the pita bread and parrose. Mix well and pour in to a 9 x13 inch baking dish. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 40 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 15 minutes or until bubbly. Uncover and sprinkle with cheese. Remove from oven and top with the toasted pita bread. Heat for 5 minutes, being careful not to burn.

title: Homemade Applesauce
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups applesauce | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 c cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Mix applesauce, worcestershire sauce.

title: Pasta and Pasta
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1 pound farfalle ( bow-tie ) pasta, or other small pasta of your choice
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the farfalle pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,prosciutto ham,chili oil,kirsch,red wine vinegar,cremini mushroom,melon liqueur,espresso powder
title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup dry red vermouth or 1/4 cup liqueur | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 teaspoon spicy chili oil | 1 lb cremini mushroom, cleaned with ends trimmed | 4 slices prosciutto ham, thin-sliced, 1/4-inch dice | 1/4 cup melon liqueur | 4 tablespoons kirsch | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder
instructions: Combine red wine vinegar, vermouth, bouillon cubes, chili oil, and mushrooms in a small bowl. Cover, and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes, stirring once. Preheat oven to 425°f. Fill each mushroom with 2 tbsp of the mushroom soaking mixture. Place mushrooms in a baking dish.

title: French Beans With Mace and Bounster Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb french style green bean, frozen | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Snap ends off green beans. Rinse and trim beans and cut diagonally in the diagonal. Pour 1½ cups water into a medium cooking pot, add beans and bouillon, place over medium high heat and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to medium low and simmer 5 minutes. Turn off the heat. Cover and let sit an additional 5 minutes before removing from heat. Allow the beans to steam for about 3 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ice,lime juice,romaine lettuce heart,vegetable oil cooking spray,thai red curry paste,coconut
title: Thai Style Coconut Salad With Lime & Chili
ingredients: canola oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 1 1/2 teaspoons cooking oil | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1 cup sweetened flaked coconut, toasted | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh lime juice | 1 romaine lettuce hearts or 1 other similar lettuce, shredded ( 3 cups )
instructions: Spray baking sheet with vegetable cooking spray. In medium bowl, combine oil and curry paste.

Random Ingredients: bulk pork sausage,shrimp,daikon radish,butternut squash,crescent dough
title: Shrimp Summer Roll
ingredients: 1 package crescent roll dough | 1 pound bulk pork sausage | 1 small daikon radish, chopped | 1 small butternut squash - peeled, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 1/2 pounds peeled and deveined medium shrimp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface in an approximately 9x13 inch rectangle. Cut dough into 3 inch squares using a 2 inch round cutter. Place 1/2 sausage and 1/2 chopped radish in the center of each square. Bring corners of squares together to form a seal, and press corners with your fingers to seal the edges. Place the rolls close together in a large baking pan, seam side down. Cover pan with foil, and bake in the preheated oven until dough is golden brown and sausage is cooked through, about 20 minutes. While pan is baking, toss shrimp on a paper towel lined baking sheet with more oil, and place 3 to 4 shrimp on top of each roll. Return to oven, and continue baking until shrimp are heated through, and tops are golden brown, 15 to 20 more minutes.

title: Chili-Glazed Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, trimmed | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 cup basmati rice, rinsed | mexican-style cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place corned beef in roasting pan with enough water to cover. Bake in preheated oven until liquid is absorbed, about 1 1/2 hours. While corned beef is cooking, melt margarine with chili oil in a skillet over medium heat. Mix in the rice, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Spread rice mixture over corned beef, and then pour hot chili butter over beef. Cover, and transfer to the preheated oven. Bake in preheated oven 35 minutes, until rice is tender and crusty.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,cornmeal,stout beer,red pepper flake,table salt,yoghurt,tomato paste
title: Beef With Sticky Bombay Bread
ingredients: 1 cup stone ground cornmeal | 4 tablespoons tomato paste | 3 lbs lean ground sirloin or 3 lbs round steaks | 1 large red pepper, sliced thinly | 2 -4 serrano peppers, seeded and diced | 3 tablespoons coarse table salt | 2 1/2 ounces yoghurt, plain, greek-style preferred
instructions: Place cornmeal in a large bowl and slowly whisk in tomato paste until dissolved. Cut meat into 1/2 cubes, about 1 3/4 cubes, and add to tomato mixture. Stir and let stand 20 minutes, then whisk again. Add remaining ingredients except yoghurt and bring to a boil. Cover and remove from heat. Let sit, stirring occasionally, 1 - 2 hours or longer. Stir in yoghurt just before serving, and chill 1 hour. Serve with fresh bread.

title: Spiced Porcini Mushrooms
ingredients: 10 large porcini mushrooms, stems removed | 1 cup coarsely chopped porcini mushrooms
instructions: Lightly oil a 1 1/2 quart microwave safe baking dish. Place mushrooms in dish, spreading out and sprinkling with coarsely chopped porcini mushrooms. Cover and microwave on high 3 - 4 minutes or until softened, rearranging the dish after 2 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,brown lentil,rom tomato,cherry,oil,tart apple,apricot
title: Mint and Apricot Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 1 tart apple, finely diced | 1 tart roma tomato, diced | 2 tart apricots, diced | 1/4 cup oil | 10 -12 cherryries, halved | angel hair pasta noodles
instructions: Wash and drain the lentils. In a large skillet, dry them with 1/4 cup of extra virgin olive oil then add the lentils. Mix well. Add the tomatoes, apricots, cherries. Season with salt and pepper. Toss gently with some more of the olive oil. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to the boil and add the angel hair pasta. Cook the pasta, stirring frequently, until it is al dente. Drain, stir it into the lentils and toss. Serve warm.

title: Stove Top Veal Chops
ingredients: 4 tablespoons mustard, dijon type, dijon is ok | 4 tablespoons chicken broth | 6 boneless veal, chops | 8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon msg | 4 tablespoons crumbled dried dates, i just add to taste
instructions: Pour the mustard and chicken broth into a large, shallow nonstick dish. Add the veal chops, cover with plastic wrap, and marinate at least 30 minutes and up to 8 hours. Place on the counter top, sprinkle with the sun dried tomatoes, and marinate for up to 3 hours.

title: Voodoo Horses (Avocados) With Mango Syrup
ingredients: 8 ripe avocados ( ripe, ripe & at least 1/4 'd seed the avocados ) | 1/2 cup palm sugar, grated | 2 tablespoons seltzer water or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | sweet or hot sauce ( any sweet or hot ) | watercress, for garnishing ( optional ) | 1 -2 ripe mango chutney, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Make the syrup by placing all the ingredients except the mango chutney in a blender or food processor & buzzing until all ingredients are combined. Add water, & blend until completely smooth, a few chunks showing. Remove the mango chutney from blender & add the fruit mixture to it, fold in immediately & gently. Put the mixture into a clear glass bowl lined with cling film or another well fitting surface. Place the bowl in the freezer for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Cut the avocados into ¾ inch pieces, remove the pits, & serve a portion of them with the mango syrup, sweet or hot, garnished with watercress or mango chutney if desired.

title: Simply Green Chile® Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 pounds ground beef round | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 can beef broth | 1 package polenta, cut into 16 pieces | 1 can evaporated milk
instructions: Cook ground beef in a large skillet over medium high heat until crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink. Drain and pour off any excess grease. Spread beef on a plate, and press it into a bowl with the enchilada sauce, beef broth, polenta, and evaporated milk. Roll each piece of meat, then place in a baking dish. Pour enchilada sauce into a saucepan, and place over medium high heat. Bring to a simmer, and cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is thickened, the cornmeal has blended with the milk, and the sauce has turned amber in color. Use a spoon to mix in more enchilada sauce as needed to attain desired consistency.

title: Mild Spaghetti Sauce - Barilla Eclair
ingredients: 16 ounces spaghetti sauce mix ( e.g. barilla ) | 12 ounces medium firm tofu | 16 ounces half-and-half | 6 ounces sweetened fruit ( such as raisins, sultanas or dates ) | 1 teaspoon spicy grainy mustard | salt
instructions: Combine spaghetti sauce mix, tofu and half and half in a saucepan and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes, or until sauce is thick and smooth. Remove from heat, mix in seasonings and cool to room temperature. Note, for a thicker sauce, add 2 tbsp whipping cream.

title: Potato, Ham, and Feta Salad
ingredients: 1 cup white beans | 2 -4 small potatoes, scrubbed and peeled | 1 cup seedless watermelon, sliced | 8 teaspoons basil pesto | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup honey
instructions: Place beans in pot with cold water. Bring to boil, cover and simmer 10 - 15 mins till tender. Meanwhile in large bowl, mash potato and watermelon. Add pesto, raisins and honey to the mashed potato and let sit at least 5 mins to dry.

title: Orzo With Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb orzo pasta | 1 1/2 cups fat-free cottage cheese
instructions: Cook orzo in boiling water with a pinch of salt until al dente, according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water to cool a little. Combine orzo and cottage cheese in a large mixing bowl.

title: Baked Beef Ribs With Apples
ingredients: 2 lbs beef short rib, meat cubed | 2 jars brussels sprouts, sliced | 11 ounces cherry tomatoes, drained | 1 1/2 ounces grated fresh gingerroot | 5 dried apples, peeled, chopped | 4 teaspoons mustard | 1/2 teaspoon horseradish | 2/3 cup dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Boil brussels sprouts for 10 minutes drain. Set aside. Combine drained brussels sprouts, cherry tomatoes, gingerroot, and apples. Place mustard and horseradish in a baggie and add beef ribs. Shake and rub to spread mustard mix over beef ribs. Bake, uncovered for 2 hours or until temperature registers 125 degrees. Remove ribs to serving dish. Remove mustard mixture from oven. Pour hot rum over ribs and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,pea,yellow bell pepper,ginger root,mexican oregano
title: Easy Pea-Lick Potstickers
ingredients: 1 pound fresh peas, trimmed and snapped into 1 inch pieces | 3 yellow bell peppers, sliced into bite-size pieces | 1/4 cup lemon peel | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow oregano | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger root | 8 cubes ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano ( optional )
instructions: Place the peas into the bottom of a pot, cover, and bring to a boil. Cook peas to al dente, about 5 minutes. Cook peppers in a skillet of boiling water until they're tender but still firm, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and set aside. Place the lemon peel, oregano, and ginger into a bowl and combine with the peas. Add peas and vegetable mixture to the bowl with the lemon peel mixture.

title: Sicilian Coconut Balls
ingredients: 1 can coconut cream | 1 tablespoon lemon zest
instructions: Put the coconut cream in a bowl and add lemon zest. Mash well with a fork. Put in the refrigerator until you are ready to serve. Form the mixture into small balls and either fry, barbeque or bake.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,white flour,horseradish,garam masala powder,natural greek yogurt,pecorino romano cheese
title: Homemade Italian Yogurt for People Who Thought They Hacked A Gram (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup dry orzo pasta | 2 cups plain greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons fresh grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh minced horseradish | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 4 teaspoons white flour ( optional )
instructions: Put the yogurt, cheese, horseradish, garam masala powder and and flour in the rice cooker with the 2 cup water on the high setting, and press start. When done, the rice cooker will start leaving a distinct steam smell, and the rice cooker will be clean. Turn up the rice cooker to high, close the cover, and let the yogurt mixture steam for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve hot. If you want to crush the gum with your hands, you can do so by pulsing the ingredients in the food processor until it forms small balls and you can squeeze out all of the air before adding the liquids.

title: Niter Kebab (Niter Kebabs)
ingredients: 500 -568 gms fresh thyme leaves, chopped ( about 3.7tsp ) | 3 g ghee or 3 g butter
instructions: Mix the chopped thyme into the butter or margarine. Add the chopped chives. Let it sit in the fridge overnight. The next morning it should be well mixed with the butter and chives. The niter kebab can be made several hours in advance. It's stored in a tin.

Random Ingredients: spelt,cardamom seed,lasagna noodle,cooking spray,turkey kielbasa,black bean,okra,seasoning mix
title: Spelt Lasagna
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 packages frozen chopped okra | 2 packages sliced fully cooked turkey kielbasa | 1 jar whole-kernel beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 package lasagna noodles | 2 tablespoons dried spices, divided | 1 dash ground cardamom seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cover a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray and place okra meat on top. Cut the kielbasa into chunks and place slices between okra and meat. In a small bowl, stir together the black beans, lima beans and half of the seasoning mix. Arrange half of the noodles on bottom of prepared baking dish. Spread about half of the meat mixture over the noodles. Pour beans over meat. Place next half of noodles over the beans. Spread blackened okra mixture all over this. Top with blackened okra mixture all over this. Cover and bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with remaining seasonings. Return to oven 5 minutes, watching carefully so as not to burn. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serve.

title: Asparagus Wrapped Hens with Fettuccini Noodles
ingredients: 4 cornish hens, quartered | 4 slices prosciutto ham | 4 teaspoons seasoned rice vinegar | 3 teaspoons cornish hens, seasoned with sesame | 16 ounces fettuccini noodles, cooked
instructions: Place 3 prosciutto ham slices in each cavity of an asparagus. Drain excess water from the birds. Arrange on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Wrap a long strip of plastic wrap around each birds nest to keep them from drying out. Place the bird's cavity onto each hoagie and wrap 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar into each bird nest. Secure with toothpicks. Cook in a 375º oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked through. Meanwhile, place the fettuccini noodles in a pot of boiling water. Cook until al dente, about 3 minutes. Drain. Serve the wrapped hens with the fettuccini noodles.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,black pepper,basil,oriental sesame oil,chicken fillet,italian sausage link,pecan
title: Italian Sausage and Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup chunky salsa ( mild ( mild ( hot is not to your liking ) | 1 teaspoon oriental sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 4 chicken fillets, skin removed | 600 g fresh italian sausage links | 1/4 cup pecans, toasted and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients except chicken, pecans and basil in a shallow baking dish and marinate chicken overnight or for 8 to 10 hours. Preheat oven to 180°c. Remove chicken from the marinade and sprinkle lightly with salt. Arrange chicken on the broiler tray. Place in the center of the oven and cook for 35 - 40 minutes or until chicken is tender. Turn over and baste with marinade while cooking. Serve with crusty bread. Note, pecans have been known to cook in a frying pan over medium heat and have turned into a paste and served as a spread to dip into vegetables when making sausage. You can substitute this with regular dried chilies, cayenne pepper powder and a little hot sauce from the sausage marinade.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,bamboo shoot,part mozzarella cheese
title: Bamboo Shoots in Tom Yum Sauce
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots ( drained ) | 2 packages part-skim mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Mash 2 cans of bamboo shoots with fork. Cut cheese into 1 inch cubes. Slice remaining 2 cans of bamboo shoots into strips 1 inch long. Add to sauce, mix well and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve over hot cooked hot rice.

title: Blueberry Scented Chai
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh blueberries | 5 tablespoons light cornflour | 1 1/2 tablespoons palm sugar, grated fine | 5 tablespoons marsala wine, fruity | 1 small serrano pepper, halved lengthways and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Place the blueberries in a food processor and pulse to combine. Mix the cornflour and palm sugar together in a third bowl. Stir in the marsala and half of the chai. Place the chai mixture into the blueberry mixture and process until smooth, using an electric blender or standard blender. Taste to adjust the sweetness. Spoon into six serving bowls and top with the remaining chai. Serve.

title: Quick and Easy Flank Steak Wrapped in Salt
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs round steaks, preferably the flap steak, trimmed | 4 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 tablespoon finely grated gingerroot | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon mixed fresh herbs | 1/2 teaspoon harissa | 8 tortillas
instructions: Cut each steak lengthwise into about 8 wedges, and then cut each wedge lengthwise into 8 equal pieces, pressing lightly and evenly between the pieces so they are well saturated. Lay each piece of steak on a piece of buttered aluminum foil.

title: Eggs & Lasagna Shells
ingredients: 1/2 lb lasagna noodle | 1 hard-boiled egg | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Cut the yolks from the egg and beat the egg whites until thick and light, but not dry. Coarsely grate the hard boiled egg and mix with the vinegar and sesame oil. Put a layer of lasagna shell on the bottom of a covered casserole, cover with half of egg mixture, and add the rest of the egg mixture. Cover with the remaining sliced egg.
