Sprinkle with a little freshly ground black pepper. Cover the top layer with foil and bake in a 400 degree oven for 25 minutes. Allow to bake for another 10 minutes, then turn the oven down to 350 degrees. Bake for 30 minutes, then remove foil and bake for an additional 20 minutes, until brown.

Random Ingredients: chili bean paste,pecan,bay scallop,fennel bulb,beef bouillon granule,brownie mix
title: Beef Scallop and Bean Bake
ingredients: 1 package brownie mix | 1 can sliced pecans | 3 lbs large bay scallops | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 7 ounces chili bean paste | 1 fennel bulb, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried minced parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 10 x 4 inch baking dish. Set aside brownies mix and pecans in a large bowl. With a slotted spoon, remove the bay scallops from bowl and set aside. Place a large skillet over high heat. Add beef mixture and stir to coat scallops evenly with spice mixture.

title: Easy, No Bake, No Bake Pita Pockets
ingredients: 1 1 cup dry buttermilk | 1 cup plain fat-free greek yogurt | 1/2 lb chopped tomato and green chilies, drained | 1/3 cup chopped dry roasted peanuts | 2 large pita breads, halved
instructions: In medium bowl, combine and mix the first 5 ingredients. Spread mixture evenly onto pita breads. Sprinkle with peanuts and serve immediately.

title: Tocados (Mexican Nut Wedges)
ingredients: 3/4 cup chopped walnuts | 2 boxes margarita mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f line a baking sheet with foil. Mix margarita mix and nuts in a bowl.

title: Chambord Raspberry French Toast
ingredients: 1/2 cup chambord raspberry liquor | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 3 tablespoons bread cubes, soaked in bread, dry
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan.

title: Italian Mint Beer
ingredients: ice | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves | chili-garlic infused liquid smoke
instructions: Fill a pint glass the amount of ice is the exact quantity. Add everything except liquid smoke. Shake to mix. Pour into a tall, high ball glass and enjoy.

title: Sauce à L'oignon Grillepe (Grilled Round Steak With Celery)
ingredients: 2 lbs skirt steaks, trimmed of excess fat | 1 1/2 cups bread, toasted and cut into cubes | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery salt
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Place steaks on grill, brush with a small amount of canola oil and coat with bread crumbs. Cook 15 minutes or until medium rare on the outside and just firm tender on the inside. Transfer steaks to a platter and warm broiler. Serve with celery sticks.

title: Smoked Eggs in Spicy Tomato Sauce - Sookha Batata
ingredients: 36 spicy fresh tomatoes | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 5 tablespoons vegetable stock or 5 tablespoons chicken stock | 6 toothpicks | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar
instructions: Remove the seeds from the tomatoes with the tip of a sharp knife or scissors. Use a small bowl to help loosen the skin from the stalk. Peel the skin with a vegetable peeler, or if you prefer, a potato peeler if desired. Slice crossways and put into a bowl. Squeeze out all of the juice from the tomatoes with a knife into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: hot water,brown lentil,red bell pepper,sultana,fruit,self raising flour,tapioca flour,lettuce
title: Sweet Lentil and Sweet Potato Grunt
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown lentils | 1 cup brown lentils | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 1 cup mixed candied fruit | 2 cups self-raising flour | 2 cups tapioca flour | 1 1/2 cups sultanas | 2 cups lettuce
instructions: Simmer lentils and bell pepper in water until tender. Puree lentils, bell pepper, mixed fruit, self raising flour and tapioca in a food processor. Add sultanas and pulse until mixture is fairly smooth. Mix through lettuce and chill for 1 hour. Roll dough into 12 patties, about 2 to 3 cm thick. Heat a large non stick frying pan. Fry the patties over medium heat for about 2 minutes on each side or until golden, turning once. Serve warm with tea or salad.

title: Chocolate-Raisin Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 package uncooked lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 cup brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the lasagna noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Once cooked, drain well in a colander set in the sink, stirring occasionally, and set aside. Place 1 tablespoon of the brandy in a small glass jar. Add another tablespoon of brandy, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 tablespoon pepper, and shake for 1 minute. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. When the lasagna noodles are cool enough to handle, dip the ends of the noodles into the remaining brandy, and shake off excess. Arrange noodles in a single layer in a lightly oiled 9x13 inch baking dish. Evenly spread 1/2 teaspoon of the grated cocoa over the noodles and top with 1/2 cup of the brandy. Finally, coat the top of the cannelloni with half the grated cocoa. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown, about 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: ro tel tomato,white onion,tahini,mirin,caster sugar,pecorino romano cheese,cumin powder
title: Tahini Onion Dip (For Crock Pot and Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 large white onions | 4 cans whole ro-tel tomatoes | 1/4 cup beetroot-mirin | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 3 tablespoons mirin | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, extra virgin | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Slice onions & place in pan with 1/2 of water, cover & cook on low heat for 15 - 20 minutes or until soft.

title: Homemade Indian Spice
ingredients: 13 green cardamom pods | 3/4 teaspoon season-all salt
instructions: Grind all together in a spice mill or a mortar and pestle. Use immediately or store in an airtight container.. Note, this is a recipe that should yield 3/4 to 1 cup.

title: Rosemary-Tortilla Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix
instructions: Cut the cross grain into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Chef John's Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 pound minced sirloin | 1/2 pound imitation crabmeat, minced | 2 cans crushed ice | 1/4 cup achiote paste ( optional ) | 5 teaspoons white sugar | 5 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon achiote powder | 1 yellow pepper, diced
instructions: Mix the sirloin, crabmeat, ice, achiote paste, sugar, chili powder and achiote together in the bowl of a stand mixer. Pour into 2 tall glasses and top with yellow pepper. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,chili paste,spice,egg noodle,red pepper flake
title: Chinese Egg Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1/2 onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add egg noodles and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,black pepper,oregano,chipotle chile adobo,cucumber,caster sugar
title: South American Cucumber Salad (Or Use Chipotles)
ingredients: 1 medium onion ( sliced finely ) | 1 medium cucumber ( roughly halved, or grated ) | 1 chipotle chile in adobo ( chopped finely ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Toss all the above together in a bowl. Chill for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,chili oil,sharp cheddar cheese,parmesan cheese,shallot,savoy cabbage
title: Irish Coleslaw
ingredients: 3 cups savoy cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 3 tablespoons grated sharp cheddar cheese | 6 cardamom pods | 4 shallots, cut into slivers | 3 tablespoons finely grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Arrange the vegetables in a pan and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to the boil and simmer over a moderate heat for 20 minutes, or until tender. Drain well and cool slightly. Blend the remaining ingredients in a food processor until smooth. Toss together with the Coleslaw. Serve immediately.

title: Salsa Cubes
ingredients: 2 cups water chestnuts | 1 jar thick & chunky salsa
instructions: Slice the water chestnuts place water chestnuts and salsa in the microwave on high heat cover and cook for about 1 minute or until heated through stir.

title: Bread of Mushroom & Fruit Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 1/2 cups chopped mushrooms | 1 1/4 cups broccoli, chopped | 1 cup guava jelly ( or other jelly ) | 2 tablespoons yeast, dissolved in | 2 cups hot stock or 2 cups broth | 1 cup diced ripe olives or 1 cup kalamata olive | 1 cup diced fresh strawberries
instructions: Soak rice for 20 minutes, remove the stems, leave the rice to soak in hot water, drain, and squeeze out as much water as possible. In a large bowl mix together 1 1/2 cups of arborio rice with the vegetables, beans, jelly, yeast and liquid. Stir in the olives and strawberries, and knead well until the mixture is smooth.

title: Tasty Sausages With Carrots and Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb smoked sausage or 1/2 lb beef sausage, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 small carrot, thinly sliced on the diagonal | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried cooking tapioca | 1/4 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Mix ingredients for a marinade, adding cheese to taste. Put sausage over a plate or in a shallow baking dish and mix thoroughly with carrot. Sprinkle with pecorino romano cheese and toss to coat. Put in a hot oven, and bake 10 to 12 minutes or until sausage is browned and vegetables are crisp.

title: Microwave Chestnuts on Creamy Cornbread Topping
ingredients: 5 chestnut mushrooms | 1 cup creamed corn flakes | 2 - 2 1/2 cups cheddar cheese
instructions: Clean and cut mushrooms in half with kitchen scissors or kitchen scissors into small sticks. Mix all ingredients together, put on tray and put in fridge to rest for an hour to allow flavours to mingle. Enjoy with a crunchy fresh vegetable.

title: Pasta and Chips - Ziti
ingredients: 4 cups ziti pasta, cooked al dente | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Cook ziti in boiling salted water over medium heat, stirring occasionally until tender but firm. Drain and toss with ziti mixture to coat. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste.

title: Garlic Pasta Salad With Dried Cherry Tomatoes and Chiles
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1 pint grape tomatoes or grape tomatoes, halved | 3/4 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 4 ounces pitted dates, chopped | 2 ounces roasted peanuts, chopped | 8 ounces salad leaves | 3 tablespoons sugar, granulated
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water, according to package directions, until just tender. Drain and place in large serving bowl. Add garlic, tomatoes, dates, nuts, and salad leaves. Add sugar and toss. Enjoy.

title: Yummo (A Ramen Delight)
ingredients: 8 lean hamburger | 8 meatballs ( or any meat, beef, chicken, prawn or even pork ) | 2 pinches sesame oil | 12 large fresh mint leaves
instructions: Brown hamburger and prawns with sesame oil then add meatballs and meat. Add water and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

title: A Simple Sauerkraut and Rice Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 4 teaspoons rice wine
instructions: Combine the buttermilk, rice wine or dry molasses and whisk.

title: Italian Lettuce Tea Linguine
ingredients: 6 ounces linguine | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 2/3 cups romaine lettuce, shredded | 8 leaves romaine lettuce, dried and torn
instructions: Cook linguine at the table as per package directions. Drain, and stir in vinegar and pepper. Put onto a serving platter, and top with shredded romaine. Variation, substitute 1 cup of cooked pasta for the romaine.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,nonstick cooking spray,yellow bell pepper,chili oil,dark brown sugar,ginger ale,phyllo dough,almond extract
title: Pepper Jack & Gingered Peach Strudel
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili oil ( such as lite or mild ) | 2 tablespoons packed dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger ale | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 pinch chili oil or 1 pinch ground ginger | 1 jar frozen sliced peaches, thawed | 1 package phyllo dough, thawed and drained
instructions: To make ginger ale sauce, in a small stainless steel saucepan, combine chili oil, brown sugar, ginger ale, vinegar, almond extract, and chili oil. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Cook for 10 minutes. Stir in peach slices.

Random Ingredients: white cabbage,gruyere cheese,halibut fillet,sake,garam masala,rice flour,peach,ice cube
title: Halibut With Peach Curry
ingredients: 4 tablespoons rice flour ( or plain rice flour ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 4 firm halibut fillets or ( 6 ounce ) other firm halibut fillets, on the bone | ice cube ( optional ) | 1/4 cup stone-ground sake | 1 ripe peach, peeled and sliced | 1 ounce gruyere cheese, grated | 1 lb white cabbage, shredded ( about 3/4 head )
instructions: Heat 1/2 a small amount of vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium high heat. Sprinkle rice flour over fish, shaking off excess. Working with one piece at a time, press fish with fingers to release excess flour and brown it on both sides, about 5 - 8 minutes total. Add remaining oil 1 tablespoon at a time, stirring constantly. Remove fish, season with water, and place on baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake uncovered, in center of oven. Cook until fish is lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven, and place on serving plate. Place remaining ingredients in saucepan and cover with lid or foil. Bring to boil, then reduce heat, then simmer 10 - 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender and fish flakes easily with fork, shaking pan occasionally. Serve fish hot, with potatoes and sauce from the pan on the side.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,milk ricotta cheese,vegetable oil peanut,garlic powder,bacon bit
title: Southern Style Loaded Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 large vidalia onion | 1 1/2 ounces bacon bits | 1/2 teaspoon crushed garlic powder or 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Cube the ricotta cheese into 1 inch bits using a cheese grater. Finely chop the onion and slice into 1/4 inch slices. In a large bowl, mix together the ricotta bits, onions, bacon bits, garlic powder and vegetable oil until well combined. Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions. Working with one portion at a time, roll it into a ball, then place on a plate until ready to continue with the other portion of the mixture. The cheese balls will be slightly flattened, but not completely shaped. You can roll a ball in a handful of ice cubes if desired. Refrigerate the filled ricotta balls overnight, or freeze until you need to roll them in the cheese and set out the next day. Heat a deep fryer to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Place the ricotta balls into the fryer a few at a time as they float and start separating. Do not crowd them. Use more or less oil for frying if desired.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,olive,cottage cheese,mint,ginger paste,bagoong,yellow mustard seed
title: Rice With Cheese, Aromatic Herb and Fresh Olive Juice
ingredients: 250 g basmati rice | 200 g cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon olive, dried | 2/3 tablespoon bagoong, fresh leaves, washed | 1/2 tablespoon mint, dried or 1/2 tablespoon coriander, fresh, leaves, dry | 2 teaspoons yellow mustard seeds, dry | 1 teaspoon ginger paste, ginger-garlic paste ( or 1 teaspoon ginger powder and 1 -2 tsp of aniseeds or 1/2 -2 tsp allspice )
instructions: Wash the rice and soak in water for 40 minutes. Drain and set aside. Heat oil in a pan and add yellow mustard seeds, ginger garlic paste and ground nuts, as indicated on the ingredients list. Fry until the mustard starts crackling and the raw smell of ginger and nut is gone. Add water and bring to boil. After 15 - 20 minutes lower the heat and add rice and bagoong leaves and stir. Add the mint and continue cooking until all the liquid has been absorbed. Add 1/4 cup of water. Stir, cover and cook 15 - 30 minutes until the rice mixture looks dry.

title: Quick Chinese Chilli Chicken
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken breast halves ( skinless, boneless, cubed ) | 1/2 can pumpkin ( drained ) | 4 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger juice, fresh | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: In a small bowl, add all ingredients and toss to mix to coat chicken. In a large saute pan, add chicken, stir fry 4 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and no longer pink inside. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Chipotle Bar Almonds
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/2 chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 40 blanched almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the applesauce, chipotle and almonds in a microwave safe bowl. Cover, and microwave on high until the nuts are evenly toasted, about 3 minutes. Remove from microwave, and stir to combine. Serve warm.

title: Baked Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 pinch coarse sea salt | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 lbs corned beef brisket, trimmed of most of the fat
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. In a medium bowl, stir together the butter and salt. Rub the mixture evenly onto the brisket. Place the brisket in a shallow roasting pan, fat side down. Roast the brisket 1 hour, shaking the pan once. Spread the outside of the brisket with the vinegar, place in the oven, and bake 15 minutes. Reduce the temperature to 325f and continue baking until tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Transfer the brisket to a carving board, tent with foil, and let rest for 10 minutes. Cut into thin slices, arrange on a serving platter, and serve hot.

title: Roasted Butternut & Pea Puree
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb butternut squash | 1 cup fresh peas or 1 cup frozen peas | 1 teaspoon harissa ( or more to taste, or adjust according to taste ) | 1 large loaf blueberry, cut into 4 squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Coat a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Cut squash in half lengthwise and place halves cut side down on the baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes, or until soft. Remove and discard skin and seeds from squash. Chop squash into bite sized chunks. Place 1/2 cup shelled dry shelled peas in a microwave safe bowl, add harissa or a bit of water and microwave on high power for about 15 seconds to thicken. If using a quick stir, microwave on the medium power for another 20 to 30 seconds, or until peas are warm. Remove and discard bowl. Spoon into a 4 cup casserole dish. Place blueberries between sheets of plastic wrap and flatten slightly with hands. Place squash cubes and cooked peas on top of peas and puree in a blender, or food processor. Add enough remaining shelled butter or butter or butter to make a slightly thick paste. Add harissa and blend just long enough to mix. Cover and chill up to 2 hours or overnight. Place on a serving dish and top with the remaining butternut squash. This is perfect with thick crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed oil,pasta,red pepper flake,beef sirloin steak,red onion,tomato juice,cilantro leaf
title: Pasta and Sesame Beef
ingredients: 1/4 lb beef sirloin steak, sliced thin | 1/4 cup red onion, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 12 ounces small dry wok pasta, cooked al dente | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice, undrained | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place beef in a bag with onion, sesame seed oil, and red pepper flakes. Press out as much air as possible. Spray a broiler pan with cooking spray. Place a small amount of the seasoned beef over each of the beef slices, spreading it into an almost circle around the beef. Set beef aside. Cook pasta according to package directions, until it is al dente, drain, and place in a large mixing bowl. Pour beef juices over the pasta, and gently toss with a spoon to coat pasta with the sauce. Garnish with the cilantro optional, if desired.

title: Danish-Style Dessert Caramelized Peanuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot jam ( apricot flavour ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1/2 teaspoon crushed anise seed | 1 vanilla bean | 1/4 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: In the bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade, combine apricot jam, oil, anise and vanilla bean. Process the machine, pressing the seeds off the beans and keeping it running, slowly drizzle the jam as it drips, processing until all of the jam has been used. Scrape the vanilla bean mixture into a medium bowl. Scrape the bean mixture back into the bowl, pressing slightly with the back of the spoon. Cover and chill the mixture in the fridge for at least an hour and up to 3 days. Preheat the oven to 325°f. Place the caramelized peanuts onto a sheet of aluminum foil in a single layer. Top with a layer of mini marshmallows, pressing the marshmallows into the peanuts. Bake them for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to cool for 5 minutes before removing to a cutting board.

title: Tropical Beef With Coco And Bacon
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless sirloin, trimmed & cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 slices bacon drippings | 2 tablespoons beef drippings | 2 cans coco salted & hot ( cream of coconut ) | 1 lime, zest of, grated | 1 cup dried cherries | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: In a large skillet, brown bacon in dripping. Remove from skillet and drain fat. Brown beef in drippings. Transfer beef to crockpot and add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours.

title: Spiced Tabouli Bulgur
ingredients: 2 cups bulgur | 1/3 cup shortening | 2 cups white pepper | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons allspice | 1/4 cup chopped maraschino cherry | 3 egg yolks | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Soak bulgur in large bowl of cold water 8 to 10 hours, or overnight. Drain and squeeze out excess water. Meanwhile, cut shortening. In small saucepan cook peppers and vinegar over low heat until peppers are soft. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook until thick. Cool. Add pepper mixture to bulgur and stir to combine. Serve warm with basil.

title: Apricot Hummus
ingredients: 2 packages frozen apricots, sliced | 1 tablespoon olive, or as needed | 2 sprigs fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheets with aluminum foil. Place apricots into a large bowl. Pour olive oil onto top, and toss to coat. Spread apricots on foil, and top with cilantro sprigs. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,spinach leaf,clove,poultry seasoning,salt,teriyaki sauce,brandy,cooking barley
title: Easy and Quick Barley-Stuffed Pork
ingredients: 1 teaspoon salt | 1 cup quick-cooking barley | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 4 whole cloves | 2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch chunks | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 tablespoon dried minced onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine salt, barley, poultry seasoning, and cloves in a large bowl. Place pork chunks in a large roasting pan.

title: Okra and Sweet Pot Pie With Cashel-Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 lb okra, chopped into 2-inch strips | 1/2 lb chopped pork | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 4 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 tablespoon soybeans sprouts | 1/4 cup guacamole | 2 dill pickles, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook okra over medium heat, stirring often, for 5 - 7 minutes or until slightly tender. Drain and set aside. Cook pork over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 3 - 5 minutes or until cooked through and fat is evaporated. Set aside on paper towels to drain. In a medium bowl, combine okra, pork, molasses, and turmeric. Wrap each phyllo sheet in a damp towel and place on cookie sheet with a side at least 3 inches from each other. Place about 1/2 tablespoon of the pork mixture in the middle of phyllo sheet. Roll dough around the filling. Seal edges and cut a slit to make a small opening on the top. To serve, place rolls on a serving platter and top with guacamole and pickles.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,thyme leave,bell pepper,beef broth,green bell pepper,chocolate,ginger,vanilla
title: Soup Potato-Ginger Hot Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 1 teaspoon dried whole ginger | 1 green bell pepper, red, and green, chopped | 1/2 red bell pepper, orange and yellow, chopped | 1 teaspoon maple syrup or 1 teaspoon soy margarine, butter flavor | 2 cups low sodium beef broth | 1/4 cup bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water.

title: Tarragon Hamurgers
ingredients: 2 -3 teaspoons tarragon | 2 tablespoons parsley | 250 g hamburger | 4 slices breadcrumbs
instructions: Place the meat in another bowl. Mix all the herbs together in a third bowl. Add half of the herbs, half of the breadcrumbs and half of the tarragon mix to bind the meat. Melt the remaining butter in a frying pan. Dip the mix into the melted butter and then roll into hamburgers. Drain excess butter from the pan, reserving for a few moments on the grill. Grill or broil until lightly browned, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: potato,new potato,simple syrup,chicken breast,vanilla essence,cognac,caster sugar,garam masala
title: Low Fat Chicken Curry (From Eastenders.com)
ingredients: 600 g new potatoes | 500 g desiree boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 600 g desiree boneless new potatoes, cut into strips lengthwise | 1/2 cup cognac or 1/2 cup brandy | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons caster sugar, extra
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water until tender and drain. Place chicken or potatoes into a large saucepan, add cognac, simple syrup, vanilla essence and garam masala and toss until chicken is cooked through. Add sugar and toss through a few times. Serve over cooked basmatis or naan bread, and serve with fresh steamed green beans. To further customize with new or browning to your liking.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,cannellini bean,chickpea,kimchi,yogurt,extra virgin olive oil,orange,cream celery soup
title: Curried Bean Hummus
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 can cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 can yummurt | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 small orange, zested | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Mix the chickpeas, cannellini beans, cream of celery soup, yummurt, 1 teaspoon kosher salt, and 1 pinch black pepper together in a bowl. Garnish with orange zest and olive oil to serve.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,brown sugar,baby green,celery salt
title: Brined Greens
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds baby greens | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 dash celery salt
instructions: Mix the cold vinegar and sugar in a bowl. Stir until the sugar is dissolved. Toss with greens and place in large sterile jars.

title: Cajun Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb whole chestnuts mushroom | 1 onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon cajun spices | 1 pinch chili flakes
instructions: Wash mushrooms and pat dry. Combine onions, mushrooms and spices. Put into fry pan with lid under medium heat. Stir mushrooms. Cover. Cook for 5 - 7 minutes, check after 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: onion,pineapple chunk,coriander seed,napa cabbage,beef stew meat,yellow squash,yoghurt,sugar
title: Caribbean Beef Stew (Caribbean Style)
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in cubes | 3 tablespoons coriander seeds ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon yellow squash, cut in strips | 1 onion, chopped | 1/2 cup tomatoes or 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon sugar ( optional ) | 3 cups shredded napa cabbage | 1 cup pineapple chunk, drained
instructions: Spray a large skillet with cooking spray or coat with the cooking spray. Place the coriander in a bowl and crush with a rolling pin. Stir in the squash and onion and continue to saute until the vegetables are tender. Stir in the beef and cook until the beef is browned. Stir in the can of tomatoes and simmer for about 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and stir in sugar and coriander. Ladle into bowls and top with cabbage. Garnish each bowl with pineapple.

title: Tajine's Tournedel
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds tempeh bacon | 1 medium green bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fennel | 1 package dried fruit, cut up | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon ground fennel | 1 pound shredded meat
instructions: Place tempeh in a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Aguadito De Huancaina (Huancaina)
ingredients: 3 large ripe guayayas ( about a pound and a half ) | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped epazote ( found at latin markets ) | fresh lime wedge, to serve optional
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Rinse guayas well under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut them lenghtwise into 1 inch wide pieces. Spread 1 teaspoon paprika over each and place several tablespoons of epazote in center of guayas. Wrap 1 teaspoon of paprika around epazote to form a taco shell. Wrap a lime wedge in each guayas shell and set on the hot grate. Grill for 2 - 3 minutes or until chewy and lightly charred underneath. Remove from grill, let rest for 5 minutes and serve.

title: Balsamic and Parmesan Dipping Sauce for Shrimp, Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, finely grated | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and stir well. Serve with shrimp, chicken or vegetables.

title: Pineapple And Cheese
ingredients: 4 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: In a 9x13 inch baking dish, spread the mozzarella cheese, pineapple and ginger garlic paste evenly over the cheese. Bake in a preheated 350°f oven for 30 minutes.

title: Chili Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili beans paste | 1 can tomato paste
instructions: Combine chili bean paste and tomato paste in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,liquid smoke,liquid honey,chunky salsa,cilantro,baking powder
title: Honey-Glazed Salsa (Appetizer)
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups bottled chunky salsa | 2 1/4 cups picante sauce | 3/4 cup honey-flavored liquid smoke | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke, such as canola or beef drippings | 1 1/4 teaspoons baking powder | 3/4 bunch cilantro, roughly chopped
instructions: Bring salsa and picante sauce to boil. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, combine honey and liquid smoke and whisk. Pour into salsa. Stir to combine. Sprinkle with baking powder and cilantro. Place in a sealed jar. Allow salsa to marinate at least 2 hours or up to 3 days. Use at least 1/2 heaping teaspoon per serving. Enjoy.

title: Seeded Yellow Squash
ingredients: 4 lbs yellow squash, sliced | 1 large onion, halved and thinly sliced | 2 packages dry onion soup mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil with heavy duty paper towels. Insert 1 onion slice into the bottom of each squash slice, and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon dry soup mix. Add half of each slice of yellow squash on top of the onion, then top with another onion slice. Top with the second onion slice. Sprinkle the last teaspoon dry soup mix on top. Wrap one edge of the foil tightly around the squash. Place on a cookie sheet, and place in oven. Bake for about 30 minutes or until tender. Note, for a change, i added 1/4 c of dried onion soup mix and 1/4 c of yellow squash mix. Both tasted great.

title: Cauliflower Gumbo
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 1/2 head cauliflower | 2 cans tomato soup | 1 cup seedless grapeseed grapeseed leaves ( not sure on condition ) | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno chile, finely chopped
instructions: Cut out the core and break the base from the large cauliflower head. Do the same to the large head, cutting away the thick stem part. Slice the larger head of cauliflower into bite sized pieces. In a large pot, fry the bacon until the pieces are light brown, about 3 minutes. Remove the bacon from the pot, and drain of the fat. Add the remaining ingredients to the bacon grease. Stir well and let simmer for 30 minutes while the cauliflower is frying. Add 1/2 can of water if the cauliflower starts to dry out right away. Turn the heat down, and let simmer for about 25 minutes, until the cauliflower is tender, stirring occasionally. This should take about 25 more minutes. Serve hot.

title: Lebanese Style Eggs
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, halved and yolks removed | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons corn, kernels or 3 tablespoons peas, drained
instructions: In a large glass or enamelled frying pan over low heat, combine eggs, chili garlic sauce and yoghurt. Stir constantly until the eggs are just set, about 2 minutes. Scoop egg mixture into a bowl with a slotted spoon, leaving any fluid behind for pouring. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: egg white,queso blanco,orange zest,italian bread,rice,cheddar cheese,italian cheese,pork tenderloin
title: Torta Rustica (Cheese-Stuffed Pork Tenderloins)
ingredients: 3 cups cooked rice | 1 cup shredded italian cheese blend | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 cup crumbled italian cheese blend | 2 1/2 teaspoons shredded queso blanco | 12 egg whites ( about 6 egg whites per pound ) | 6 pork tenderloins | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook rice in a large saucepan for 5 minutes, then remove from heat and allow to cool. Mix 1 cup of the shredded italian cheese blend and the orange zest in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Add 1 cup of the shredded italian mix to the cooled rice, add the cheese and mix well. Spoon rice mixture onto the center of a piece of plastic wrap placed on your work surface. Starting with the side nearest you, roll the tortilla into a cigar shape. Repeat until all rice mixture has been used. Cut ends off of cylinder and place rolled tortillas on sheet pan. Brush lightly with beaten egg whites and sprinkle lightly with the the remaining 1 - 2 cups cheese. Bake for 30 minutes or until tender. Serve with italian cheese sauce. To prepare the pork, heat a large heavy skillet over medium high heat. While skillet is cooking, place the remaining 1 cup of italian cheese blend in a small saucepan, add the remaining 2 cups of shredded italian cheese blend and the orange zest. Simmer on low heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until desired texture is achieved. Pierce each pork tenderloin several time with a fork and dip in cheese sauce. Place meat on a platter and pour the cheese sauce over top. Serve with italian cheese sauce.

title: Spinach With Ponzu Sauce
ingredients: 1 small fresh tomato, finely diced | 1/2 small fresh orange peel, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 package spinach, stems, leaves chopped | 4 ounces ponzu sauce | 4 ounces vodka ( optional )
instructions: In a frying pan set over medium heat, add the oil. Once it's just starting to smoke, add the tomato, orange peel, and cumin. Turn heat down to medium and cook, stirring often, until orange peel is very soft. Stir in the tomato, then stir in the greens. Pour in the ponzu sauce. If you want it a bit thinner, stir in the vodka.

Random Ingredients: potato flour,baking chocolate,chocolate chip,mozzarella cheese,red potato,cranberry
title: Irish Muffins
ingredients: 6 1/2 medium red potatoes | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate | 1/4 cup potato flour | 2 ounces cranberries, drained | 2 ounces baking chips | 1/2 cup grated mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease a 12 cup muffin tin.

title: Moroccan Lentils and Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup lentils | 1 yellow squash, diced | 1 medium red chile, chopped | 1/2 cup apple juice or 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon ouzo ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon currants | 4 -5 tablespoons vegetarian refried beans
instructions: Rinse lentils and then place in saucepan with enough lightly salted water to almost cover the lentils. Bring to boil, turn down heat and simmer for 30 - 40 min or until lentils are tender. Drain, then mash with a potato masher. In a large bowl add all remaining ingredients and mash until mostly smooth. Taste and adjust seasonings if needed. Serve warm or refrigerate to allow flavors to blend.

title: Jalapeno Salad With Bacon
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander leaves | 1 jalapeno, finely chopped | 1/3 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1/2 splenda sugar substitutes
instructions: Wrap bacon in paper towels, cook in a skillet until crisp, about 5 - 6 minutes. Remove bacon from skillet.

title: Red Cabbage and Pineapple Soup
ingredients: 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 red cabbage, rinsed | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Add juice, cabbage and stock.

title: Pimiento Jelly
ingredients: 1 jar pimiento, drained | freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Remove and discard rind from your pimento jar. Place pimiento in food processor and pulse until very fine. With motor running, add pepper to the pimento. Continue to process until well blended. Pour in jelly bag.

title: Italian Baked Beans (Pioneer Woman)
ingredients: 8 ounces crabmeat | 8 ounces basil leaves | 1 vanilla bean, halved
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Put all ingredients into an oven safe casserole dish. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Aromatic Vegetable Fries
ingredients: green plantain | yellow bell pepper | yellow pepper ( optional ) | mango ( optional )
instructions: Peel green plantains. Grill plantains until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side. Cut plantains into 1/4 inch slices about 1/4 inch thick. Slice green peppers. Slice mangoes, if desired, into 1/4 inch slices. Place all vegetables on a rack in the broiler and broil for about 4 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Gambas(Spicy Marinated Beef Casserole)
ingredients: 1 kg chuck or 1 kg blade roast | 2 kg stewing beef or 2 kg blade roast | 1 kg squid rings ( or 2 large squid ) | 2 quarts water | 1 cinnamon stick | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon spices
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 deg c.. Grease oven proof casserole dish. Combine meat, squid and water. Marinade for 7 to 8 hours. Remove meat from marinade and arrange in one layer over meat. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat. Arrange in the casserole dish, starting from the top. Cover with lid or aluminium foil and bake for 1½ - 1 - ½ hours. Serve with noodles.

title: Tandoori Gorgonzola Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces gorgonzola ( or other blue cheese ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon fennel | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce tandoori spice mix
instructions: Crush the gorgonzola or blue cheese in a food processor or with a mixer, using the tandoori. Blend until smooth. Mix in fennel and blend again, blending well. Transfer to a bowl and sprinkle on additional fennel.

title: Vegetable Patties
ingredients: 1 lb fresh bamboo shoot, sliced in half and seeded | 3 green onions, thinly sliced | 3 scallions, chopped | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into 1 inch balls. Brown in deep nonstick skillet over medium high heat, 3 - 4 minutes per side. Turn and brown other side. Serve.

title: Green Enchilada Appetizer
ingredients: 15 ladyfingers | 1 jar green enchilada sauce | 1 gallon green enchilada sauce
instructions: Mix well. Cut green sauce into strips. Prepare the lady fingers as directed and roll them in green sauce, then roll those in green sauce. Boil the green sauce in a sauce pan. Once the green sauce is cooked and the lady fingers are done, place them in the green sauce in a 9x13 pan. Pour the green enchilada sauce over the lady fingers. Top with green sauce on top of the green sauce. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.

title: Creamed Beef & Sour Cream Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 carton sour cream or ( 8 ounce ) carton plain yogurt
instructions: Brown meat in large skillet or dutch oven stir in sour cream or yogurt, simmer until heated through do not boil mixture. Serve with assorted vegetables and bread. Enjoy.

title: Dirty Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs small grape tomatoes | 2 lbs lean beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh ground pepper | 1/4 cup old grain oatmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place a large baking pan or wok over medium high heat. When pan is hot add beef and cook stirring until no pink remains on outside of meat. Remove from heat. Add vinegar and pepper and whisk briskly in oatmeal. Return to heat. Add tomatoes tossing well until well coated. Transfer to oven for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: linguine,anise seed,baby onion,fontina cheese,ice,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Linguine With Spinach, Artichokes & Fontina
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 3 cups shredded fontina cheese | 3/4 cup chopped fresh spinach | 1 can sliced anise seed | 5 tablespoons crispy real italian cheese blend | 10 tablespoons philadelphia sour cream & cream cheese, cut into pieces
instructions: In large saucepan, heat 3 cups of water with anise seeds to boiling. Cook linguine and drain. While pasta is boiling, spread 1 tablespoon butter on cookie sheet and put in a 350 degree oven to toast for five minutes. While still hot, toss pasta with 2 tablespoons of the soured cream cheese. Set aside. Add spinach to the rest of the soured cream cheese and in a blender, pour over cooked pasta until heated. Mix in the sour cream and adjust seasoining for taste. If pasta is a little stiff to the touch, put back onto a cutting board before slicing. Pour pasta into a shallow baking dish, top with the spinach mixture, sprinkle with the other 2 tablespoons of the soured cream cheese. Add a little more dressing and bake at 350of for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,black mustard seed,white bean,tomato green chilies,burrito flour tortilla,pear
title: Chile Burritos
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained - divided | 3 teaspoons ground black mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano | 3 burrito-size flour tortillas, or more as needed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh pear | 3/4 cup small white beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Combine the tomatoes and ground black mustard seed in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir until the mustard seeds begin to pop.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,bailey irish cream,oat,grape tomato,hominy,pepper,asafoetida powder,salami
title: Irish Roll
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 lb asafoetida powder or 1/2 lb onion powder | 2 cups heavy whipping cream or 2 cups whipping cream | 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 3/4 teaspoon pepper ( or more ) | 6 ounces sliced salami ( sliced into long, thin strips ) | 6 ounces sliced provolone cheese ( sliced into 1/2 inch slices ) or 6 ounces sliced mozzarella cheese ( sliced into 1/2 inch slices ) | 1 1/2 cups quick oatcakes or 1 1/2 cups quick oats | 3 tablespoons baileys irish cream
instructions: Sprinkle asafoetida on a board or paper towel. Cover surface with another board and roll up, jelly roll style. Sprinkle with more of the asafoetida during rolling. Wrap entire roll in plastic wrap. Refrigerate at least 3 days. Drain tomatoes and reserve juice. Wash asafoetida and line a large jelly roll pan with plastic. Remove roll from marinade and discard marinade. Cut roll into 3/4 inch pieces. Place on the plastic. Refrigerate, covered, at least 1 hour and up to 3 days. To make cream filling, mix all ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Bring a skillet of water to a boil. Add asafetida, cover and boil 10 minutes. Uncover and cook 2 more minutes. Turn off the heat and let soak 10 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and place in a colander lined with paper towels. Rinse with cold water and squeeze out excess water. Heat oven to 300 degrees, place 1/2 cup of filling onto a doughnut shaped cookie sheet. Brush roll with cream. Place rolled doughnut into oven and bake 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,cardamom seed,artichoke heart,crouton,ginger root,splenda sugar substitute,egg yolk
title: Yummy Low Fat Delicious Fruit Croutons
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 2 cups croutons | 8 ounces mango chutney | 3 egg yolks | 2 teaspoons ginger root, minced | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1/3 cup splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix all ingredients together. Roll into crescents. Bake in a well greased 1 quart baking dish for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salsa,dark sesame oil,spinach leaf,rosemary,kosher salt black pepper,egg,vegemite
title: Spinach Cakes With Spicy Sesame & Fresh Herbs  (Vegan)
ingredients: 3 cups spinach leaves, washed, spun dry | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 4 large eggs | 2 tablespoons veganspite | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 cup hot salsa
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Place spinach and rosemary in a blender jar and process until finely chopped. Add salt and pepper to taste and set aside. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, veganspite and dark sesame oil. Add spinach mixture and mix until just combined. Season with salt and pepper. Shape into 12 - 8 patties. Brush with oil and sprinkle evenly with salsa. Bake on middle rack for 20 minutes or until beginning to turn golden brown.

Random Ingredients: lemon,rosemary,vegetable oil cooking spray,beef roast,italian sausage,corn kernel,chocolate
title: Italian Sausage and  Corn
ingredients: 6 italian sausages ( about 6 oz ) | 2 lbs beef roast | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3/4 cup light corn kernel | 3/4 cup sliced unsweetened chocolate | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon rind, finely chopped
instructions: Pat beef dry with paper towels. Cut crosswise into 3/4 inch slices, and place in a shallow 1 inch deep baking dish coated with cooking spray. Pour juice from pan into a bowl, discarding solids. Arrange beef, corn, chocolate and rosemary on top of beef slices. Sprinkle with lemon peel. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to 24 hours. Preheat oven to 350°. Heat an ungreased 10 inch skillet over medium high heat until hot, 2 - 3 minutes. Add 1/2 tablespoons margarine.

title: Peanut Butter Smoked Ham
ingredients: 1/2 lb smoked ham | 2 cans green chilies | 1/4 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1/4 cup oregano leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 300°. Brown ham. Cut ham in wedges and place on sheet pan that has been sprayed with pam. Cover with foil and bake about 1 hour or till ham is hot& bubbly. Mix together with chilies, peanut butter& oregano. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Green and Yellow Tartlets
ingredients: 4 tablespoons butter, cut into small pieces | 500 g green and yellow squash ( cut into quarters ) | 4 refrigerated pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. In a frying pan, melt the butter over a low heat. Add the green and yellow squash. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cook for a couple of minutes and remove from the heat. Unfold pie dough and cut each piece into 5 smaller wedges.. Fill out the dough. Place wedges in the tart tin. Using a pastry brush, lightly coat the pieces of tart with the melted butter. Sprinkle with a little additional cheese if desired. Bake for 15 minutes or until the base is golden brown and the green and yellow squash are tender. Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,dog bun bratwurst,water chestnut,pasta,dark brown sugar,oregano
title: Frank Giuseppes
ingredients: 4 hot dog buns, cut in half | 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup hot dog buns or 1/4 cup bratwurst, crumbled | 3 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 6 hot dog buns, split
instructions: Preheat grill. Combine first five ingredients in medium bowl. Arrange ingredients on cut sides of buns. Sprinkle with oregano and oregano. Top with split buns.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,garlic salt,raspberry,black,chuck,chili pepper,white bean
title: Charmie Chorizo
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 1/2 cup canned white beans, drained | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup red pepper flakes | 1/8 cup black pepper | 1/2 cup chopped chili peppers or 1/2 cup other hot chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cook ground chuck in skillet until browned. Drain. Stir into skillet remaining ingredients. Simmer, uncovered, about 5 minutes or until slightly thickened.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,cashew,broccoli floret,parsley,rice noodle,cheddar cheese,lemon pepper,leek
title: Cheesy Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rice noodles | 1 cup broccoli floret | 2 leeks, white and pale green parts only, thinly sliced, washed well and drained | 1/3 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup shredded low-fat cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons roasted cashews, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Cook noodles in a large saucepan of boiling water until tender when pierced with a knife, about 5 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. In a large bowl, stir together the broccoli, leeks, and 1/2 cup of the cheeses. Add noodles, vegetables, and herbs, and toss to combine. In a small bowl, mix the remaining 1/2 cup of cheeses together with the remaining nuts, and add to the salad. Serve immediately, or let chill for up to 1 week.

title: Tomato Cheddar Cheese Spread
ingredients: 3 cans diced italian tomatoes | 1 bunch shredded cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1/4 cup diced red bell peppers
instructions: Place the tomatoes in a bowl, and stir in the shredded cheese. Stir in the tahini and red pepper.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,yellow squash,kielbasa sausage,vanilla essence,island dressing,pepperoni,pearl barley,head cabbage
title: Italian Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 cans pearl barley | 1 1/2 pounds kielbasa sausage, cubed | 1 cup reduced-sodium island dressing, divided | 3 cups yellow squash, chopped, about 4 medium | 4 medium head cabbage, chopped | 1/2 cup packed fresh basil leaves | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium vanilla essence | pepperoni, slices, sliced, for garnish
instructions: Cook pearl barley and 1 1/2 cups water or broth as directed on package. Drain, rinse with cool water and cut in to 3/4 inch pieces. Bring to a boil and stir in kielbasa, 1/2 cup dressing, yellow squash, cabbage, basil, 1/4 cup dressing and pepperoni for 2 - 3 minutes. Pour back into to 2/3 cup size clear plastic containers to chill and allow flavors to combine.

Random Ingredients: sourdough starter,potato starch,fettuccine,lime juice,asafoetida powder,lettuce leaf
title: Fettuccine With Sourdough Starter
ingredients: 2 cups sourdough starter | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 3/4 lb fettuccine | 1 1/2 cups potatoes starch | 1 cup lettuce leaf
instructions: Place starter in a large bowl, stir in lime juice and asafoetida. Mix well, cover and refrigerate overnight. Boil a large pot of water. Add potato starch and cook until starch has completely melted. Remove from heat. Add sweetened potato starch and bring to a low boil stirring constantly until soup has a creamy consistency. Serve immediately and top with lettuce.

title: Fresh Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped mixed berries | 12 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven according to package directions. Prepare frozen berries first by thawing in refrigerator. When berries are defrosted, mix berries with phyllo sheets according to package directions. Place on a baking dish, or in a bowl, and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Take out of the oven and immediately roll up phyllo dough, jelly roll style. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,bacardi limon,shiitake mushroom,chili paste,vanilla,orzo pasta,raisin,egg white
title: Chile-Orzo-Mushroom Quiche
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups orzo pasta | 1 cup chopped fresh shiitake mushrooms | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon raisins, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1/3 cup bacardi limon | 2 egg whites | 1 splash vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9 inch springform pan. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook orzo in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain. Remove half the liquid. Cool to room temperature. Mix mushrooms, poblano peppers, raisins, and chili paste together in a bowl. Pour into prepared pan. Sprinkle top with remaining 1 tablespoon raisins and 1/3 cup limon. Beat egg whites with an electric mixer in a large bowl just until soft peaks form. Fold cream into egg whites.

title: Ranch Beef Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1/2 packet taco seasoning mix | 12 -14 slices cheesecloth | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 jar apricot preserves | breadcrumbs | arugula or rocket
instructions: Heat frying pan to medium heat, stir fry hamburger. Drain off fat. Pour off fat. Sprinkle 1/2 packet of taco seasoning mix over hamburger and mix well. Wrap cheesecloth in cheesecloth. Wrap tightly in foil. Cook till meat is heated through. Put meat mixture on an oven proof dish, top it with preserves and bread crumbs. Place under broiler to get bubbly and a bit brown.

title: Shrikhand Ka Halwa
ingredients: 10 -12 ounces cheese, grated | 5 tablespoons ghee, cut in 1/2 | 100 -200 g crumbled kefalotiri or 2 ounces gouda cheese
instructions: Grate cheese and stir in grated cheese. Form into marble sized balls. Heat ghee in a flat pan over a moderate flame or until smoking hot. Drop marble balls into ghee by the tablespoonful. Brown on all sides. Remove and place on kitchen paper. Spread kefalotiri on top and allow to set. Serve. You can freeze this, and it will keep in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Quick and Easy Spicy Polish Pasta
ingredients: 3 whole-wheat spaghetti squash, halved and seeded | 3 links kielbasa | 1 container part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 can cremini mushrooms, drained
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the spaghetti squash, and return to a boil. Cook the spaghetti uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm, about 10 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Place the kielbasa in a skillet, and cook over medium high heat until browned and crumbly, about 3 minutes. Drain excess grease, and slice the sausage into 1 inch pieces. Mix the spaghetti squash, sausage, ricotta cheese, mushrooms, and sausage, and cannelloni cheese with the reserved sauce, and serve.

title: Lemon Hummus
ingredients: 2 cups cashews | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Roast cashews in oven, or grill. Cool, then press with fingers or a metal spoon into a bowl of a food processor to break into smaller pieces. Add remaining ingredients and process until they form a creamy smooth paste. Store in refrigerator.

title: Jamaican Yucca (Filipino Potato Cake)
ingredients: 1 lb yucca root, peeled, cut into 2 inch length | 3/4 - 1 cup dark molasses | 3 1/2 - 4 cups flour tortillas
instructions: Rinse root well and drain thoroughly. Discard outer layer. Peel skin from root using a vegetable peeler and cut crosswise into 2 inch pieces. Place peeled pieces in a colander, cover with hot water, and allow to drain for 30 minutes. Pat root dry and set aside. In a very low oven, mix dark molasses, 1 3/4 cups of water, and 1 teaspoon of salt. Place potatoes in the middle of a greased 9x13 baking dish. Fill with molasses mixture over the potatoes, spreading evenly with a knife. Bake in preheated oven for about 1 hour, remove baking dish from oven and carefully remove toothpicks and potatoes as it comes out of the oven. Turn the oven back on to broil high and broil for a few minutes, or until slightly brown on top. Slice potato cake into 1/2 inch slices, drizzle with remaining molasses and serve immediately with toppings.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,salmon fillet,matzo meal,baking soda
title: Smoked Salmon Muffins
ingredients: 4 medium salmon fillets | 2 cups matzo meal | 4 teaspoons baking soda | 1 large yellow bell pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 12 cup muffin tin with paper liners, and spoon 1 cup matzo meal into each. Sprinkle salmon with baking soda, and top with bell pepper strips. Bake in the preheated oven 20 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Adfajita-Style Lentils
ingredients: 500 g lentils ( black or red ) | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, roughly chopped | 4 black cardamom pods, ground | 3 cloves | 1/4 cup basil, chopped | 1/4 cup rolled oats ( or rice or chapati )
instructions: Combine lentils, cilantro, cloves, basil& ground cardamom in a bowl. Sprinkle with oats. Mix everything well and let stand until dinner time or your guests arrive arrive arrive arrive. Eat with plain boiled or steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,kale,star anise pod,pepperoni sausage,hash brown,taco shell
title: Sausage and Beef Tacos
ingredients: 2 pounds ground chuck round | 2 cans refrigerated crispy hash browns | 4 taco shells | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/4 cup pickled pepperoni sausage, sliced | 2 star anise pods, crushed
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir the ground chuck and hash browns in the hot skillet until the hash browns are evenly browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: caper,pork loin roast,tamari,red onion,vegetable,onion salt,celery rib,red curry paste
title: Tasty Pork Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs pork loin roast, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup fresh diced onion | 1/4 cup fresh diced celery rib | 1 1/4 - 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( or more ) | 3/4 cup mixed vegetables, such as peas | 3 tablespoons tamari ( or more ) | 1/4 cup fresh capers | 1 -2 tablespoon onion salt
instructions: In a dutch oven or large stew pot, combine pork with onion, celery, curry paste, mixed vegetables, tamari, capers and onion salt. Stir well to coat the pork with the curry paste mixture. Cover and cook over medium heat until pork is no longer pink, about 1 hour, stirring often.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,red pepper,corn kernel,flat leaf parsley
title: Spicy Corn
ingredients: 3 cups of the fresh corn kernels | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1/2 red pepper, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Wash, dry and remove the corn kernels. Place them in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to boiling point on high heat and cook for a few minutes, stirring all the time, until they reduce to a pulp. Remove from heat and mix in the sugar, red pepper and parsley. Return to medium heat, stirring until all the sugar has dissolved. Simmer gently for 5 minutes.

title: Russian Mojito Burger
ingredients: 4 frozen burger patties, thawed | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1 container fat free greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon tomato ketchup | 1/8 teaspoon dill | 1 tablespoon masa harina or 1 tablespoon cornmeal
instructions: Place the frozen burger patties in the freezer for 15 - 20 minutes, or until frozen. When ready to cook, preheat grill/broiler. Brush a small non stick frying pan with some tomato ketchup. Brush pan with the remaining tomato ketchup. Add the frozen burger patties. Heat over medium heat until patties are slightly pink on the outside, 2 - 3 minutes. Spoon equal amounts of the greek yogurt on each side of the burger patties. Sprinkle with the spices. Serve with salsa, avocado, lettuce, tomatoes, or green onions.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,chipotle chile adobo,ranch dressing mix,lukewarm water
title: Chipotle Flavoured Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons lukewarm water | 4 teaspoons ranch dressing mix | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon minced canned chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: In a small bowl with a pinch of salt, mix the rest of the ingredients. Pour over your desired salad or mix.

title: Lime and Canadian Bacon Steak Skewers (Grilled)
ingredients: 6 scallions | 6 limes | 8 slices canadian bacon ( can used country style, such as cheddar ) | 12 ounces thinly sliced trimmed sirloin
instructions: Remove scallions from root ends and cut in half lengthwise. Reserve root ends. Slice scallions crosswise into very thin rounds. Cut canadian bacon into very thin slivers. Using 1/2 lime, squeeze juice over canadian bacon and add slices to scallions. Place one slice of beef on top of the lime mixture and sprinkle lightly with salt, if desired. Set aside 10 - 12 slices of bacon and place on skewers. Grill on bbq until internal temp reaches 160 degrees about 7 - 8 minutes per side. The skewers may also be pan fired or roasted by placing a baking rack on the rack. Serve on a platter with a lime wedge.

title: Caribbean Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 2 cups dried black-eyed peas | 3 slices bacon, chopped | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 lemon, zest of, chopped | 2 teaspoons dried dill weed | 1/4 teaspoon salt ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Soak the peas overnight or at least 12 hours, or let them stand a few hours up to 24 hours in a large pot. Rinse the peas if needed and add to a large pot, and add just enough water to cover the peas by at least 1 inch. Bring to boil and then let simmer, covered, on low heat for 1 1/2 hours. Rinse well and return peas to pot and allow to cook for a full 1/2 hour. Add the remaining ingredients, including lemon zest, to the pot and simmer on medium heat for a few more minutes, to blend and develop flavors. Serve with pita bread as an accompaniment to rice.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,poppy seed,red cabbage,belgian endive,italian tomato,stock
title: Polish Borscht
ingredients: 3 heads red cabbage | 4 italian tomatoes, coarsely chopped ( with stem attached ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 1 1/2 cups hot stock ( or more ) | 3 tablespoons wine vinegar | chopped belgian endive
instructions: In a large pot, combine cabbage, tomatoes, poppy seeds, and stock. Mix well and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes or until cabbage is soft. Sprinkle each serving with chopped endive. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Sweet Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 3 tablespoons caster sugar
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a small, heavy based saucepan. Bring to the boil, then simmer, stirring often with a wooden spoon for 3 - 5 minutes, or until the sugar dissolves. Pour into a shallow container, cover and keep in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks before using.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno seed,mushroom,curry powder,cajun seasoning,mexican cheese,yellow squash,chicken cutlet,chive
title: Indian Style Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken cutlets, about 1 lb | 1 large yellow squash, peeled and cubed | 1 cup sliced mushrooms | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 tablespoons of chopped fresh chives | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon jalapeno seeds | 1 cup mexican cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine curry tog. And cajun spice tog. Mix well. Lightly spray a large roasting pan with nonstick spray and add chicken.

Random Ingredients: salmon,sun tomato oil,pork,cream chicken soup,black bean
title: Creamy Salmon and Beans
ingredients: 3/4 lb salmon | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 package black beans, canned drained | 1 can sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, undrained | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs cooked pork, cubed
instructions: Remove salmon bones to separate and cut salmon into bite sized pieces. Combine soup and black beans with the salmon, beans, tomatoes and pork in crockpot. Stir well. Cover and heat on low setting 3 - 4 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Mexican Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1 box couscous | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate or ( 10 ounce ) can limeade | 1 can sambal oelek | 1 bottle taco sauce | 1 package frozen apricots, cut into wedges | 2 -4 cups hot ice
instructions: Drain juice from the can of limeade concentrate in a 2 quart saucepan. Dissolve the bouillon in one can of sambal oelek, if using. Add to a large bowl and add taco sauce and couscous. Mix well. Stir in the frozen apricots. Add the rest of the limeade concentrate. Serve right away.

title: Quinoa Soup
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 2 dried eye chiles | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Place quinoa and chiles in a large container. Cover with several inches of cool water.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,corn tortilla,hoagie,cream tartar,white onion,phyllo dough,herb seasoning mix
title: Homemade Tri-Colored Tri-Colored Taco Rolls
ingredients: 12 large corn tortillas, 6 inch | 12 tablespoons mixed herbs seasoning mix ( i use mrs. dash's tricolored taco seasoning mix, 2 tbsp. ) | 18 ounces sour cream, 2 % or 18 ounces greek yogurt ( i use greek yogurt ) | 12 sheets phyllo dough, thawed ( this quantity works best when refrigerated overnight ) | 1 white onion, chopped ( white or yellow ) | 12 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise ( i recommend trader joe's )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line an 11x17 inch baking dish with parchment paper and spray with non stick cooking spray. Layer 1 corn tortilla on large plate, spreading evenly to cover the tortilla. Spread 1 tablespoon herb seasoning on the tortilla. Evenly arrange half of the sour cream, 1 tablespoon chopped red onion, and a third of the yoghurt on top. Top with 1 tablespoon of the tortilla mixture, and spread to cover. Repeat layers, ending with a sour cream layer and another 1 tablespoon of chopped red onion. Transfer to 9x13 inch dish. Bake, uncovered, for 25 - 30 minutes or until rolls are lightly browned and the sour cream is heated through. Cut diagonally on a diagonal. Serve.

title: Papas Con Queso (Tortillas With Salsa and Brown Sugar)
ingredients: 1 cup breadcrumbs, coarse ( can use cornmeal ) | 3/4 cup salsa, warmed | 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed | 3 -6 fresh thyme sprigs, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons pan dripping ( can use a little more ) | 1/4 cup tortillas, room temperature, cut into wedges ( optional )
instructions: Put the breadcrumbs, salsa, sugar and thyme in a bowl, toss to coat. Set a 10 inch cast iron or other fry pan coated very well with cooking spray over medium heat and warm the oil. Pour in half the batter and spread to the edges. Top with the tortillas, pressing firmly with your fingers. Fry them until puffy, golden brown and cooked through, about 3 minutes on each side. Serve immediately with a side salad of lettuce and tomato slices.

title: Russian Mixed Sprouts
ingredients: 3 cups fresh brussels sprouts, rinsed and trimmed | 1 yellow squash, sliced
instructions: Place brussels sprouts and squash slices in a steamer basket and cover. Scoop the sprouts from the steamer basket into a bowl. Discard any sprouts that are not fully cooked. Place the vegetables on a plate and serve.

title: Simple Cider Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1/4 cup broth, or as needed | 1/2 cup sliced radishes
instructions: Whisk vinegar, broth, and radish together in a bowl. Let dressing sit 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: polenta,vegetable oil cooking spray,white bread,garlic,self raising flour
title: Garlic & Garlic Polenta Rounds
ingredients: 1 cup polenta | 1/3 cup self-raising flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon dry crushed garlic | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 slices toasted white bread, crusts removed & buttered
instructions: Combine the polenta, flour & garlic in a bowl & knead till crumbly. Add the oil or oil & beat till combined. Add crumbs & mix til combined. Using a round bladed knife cut rounds from each slice of the bread. Place on a tray & bake at 190c covered with foil for 20 minutes or till golden & crisp. Allow to cool & eat with butter & sugar or any other seasonings you like.

Random Ingredients: champagne vinegar,olive oil,ginger root,beef brisket,lamb loin chop,italian bread,mint leaf
title: Minty Ginger-Mustard-Lamb Loin Chops
ingredients: 6 lamb loin chops | 2 tablespoons crushed fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger root | 4 teaspoons crushed dried mint leaves | 1 jar dry champagne vinegar | 1 lamb shoulder-loin chop
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease a casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place chops side by side on the bottom of the dish. Toss with the crushed mint, olive oil, ginger, and dried mint leaves. Place chops in the prepared casserole dish. Reserve the top rack of the oven. Bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature has reached 145 degrees f, 20 to 30 minutes. Turn off oven, and cover the lamb chops with aluminum foil. Allow the casserole to rest about 15 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 300 degrees f, and continue baking in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the chops has reached 145 degrees f, 45 to 50 minutes. Turn the chops over, and allow to rest until easily pierced with a fork, as needed. Serve with a gravy spooned over.

title: Gramma's Hot Peanut butter Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground ham hock | 2 teaspoons peanut butter | 3 shallots, peeled and finely chopped | 2 cups cauliflower, broken into florets
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the peanut butter over medium heat. Saute the shallots until translucent, about 3 minutes. Add the ham hocks and brown well on all sides, about 5 minutes. Add cauliflower and brown, another 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Bengal and Raisins
ingredients: 1 package bacon | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup sweet bengal ( or a mix of both ) & garlic chutney | 3/4 cup raisins
instructions: Cook bacon in large pan until crisp, remove and drain on paper towels. Reserve grease. Crumble bacon and set aside in a bowl. Mix in soup and chutney until well blended. Add sour cream and raisins.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,romaine lettuce,gingerroot,red wine vinegar,cornflour,chicken breast,kosher salt black pepper,dark brown sugar
title: Glazed Beef Tenderloin With Soyy Oranges
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin steak, about 8 ounces per steak | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, grated | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | fresh romaine lettuce, washed and dried | 2 dark brown sugar or 4 regular-colored sugar | 1/4 small fresh gingerroot, peeled, coarsely grated and finely grated ( peel if you wish ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | crushed red pepper flakes ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Place the beef tenderloin steak on a rack in a baking dish about 1 1/2 inches thick and drizzle with the olive oil. Season with salt and pepper, and scatter over the corn flour. Bake for about 20 minutes, then turn off the oven and leave the meat in the oven for another 20 - 30 minutes. Meanwhile, make the oranges. Place the ginger and brown sugar in a small saucepan and stir. Add the vinegar. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat, then simmer until the mixture is syrupy and reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, and allow to cool until thick enough to handle. Taste and season with more salt and pepper, if required.. Meanwhile, remove and discard the steak's tenderloin steak from the oven. Slice into long thin strips, about 1/4 inch wide. Add some of the orange sauce and toss and season with the crushed red pepper flakes if desired. Arrange the trimmings of lettuce on a serving plate. Place the meat on top and drizzle with the reserved orange/brown sugar sauce. Garnish with the sweet red sauce and serve.

title: Parsnips With Hot Sauce or Smoked Fish (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 7)
ingredients: 50 g parsnips, cut into four thin diagonal slices | 4 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: Heat a barbecue grill or griddle pan on high heat. Cook the parsnips for 2 minutes on each side or until crisp.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,tilapia fillet,garlic salt,green pepper,purpose flour
title: Grilled Tilapia
ingredients: 4 medium green peppers | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 tilapia fillets
instructions: In a food processor, coarsely grind the green peppers. Mix in the flour, mustard seeds and garlic salt. Coat each fillet with the seasoned pepper mixture on both sides. Allow the fillets to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Preheat grill for high heat. Grill the fillets 4 to 6 minutes per side.

title: Rum Shrimp With Ham (Cuba -- Caribbean)
ingredients: 14 ounces cooked shrimp ( i use shrimp in shells or shrimp, fresh or frozen ) | 1/3 cup finely chopped ham | 4 -6 tablespoons unsweetened baking cocoa | fresh salsa ( your fav. brand ; we don't use this ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dark rum | 1 pinch cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray 12 inch skillet with pam. Melt butter in skillet, add ham and shrimp and stir over medium heat until shrimp are pink and shrimp are cooked. In small bowl, combine cocoa, rum and cream of tartar. Stir mixture into shrimp mixture until mixed well. Transfer shrimp mixture into prepared pan. Bake, uncovered, for about 25 minutes or until shrimp are tender and sauce is bubbly..

title: Tortilla and Pimiento Dip
ingredients: 1 tortilla | 4 -6 ounces pimientos
instructions: Place the tortilla on a flat surface, top it with the pimientos, close the lid and roll it up like a burrito. Heat for approximately 5 minutes, or until the tortilla is crisp and warm. Variation, this is good as a side dish along with grilled chicken or seafood.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,whipping cream,red chile pepper,cream chicken soup,coriander,icing sugar,plum,white vinegar
title: Plum Chilli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar of armour indian plum sauce, in jars | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh red chile pepper | 1/2 cup whipping cream, whipped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander
instructions: Drain plum chilli sauce into a large saucepan.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,fava bean,gold tequila,cocoa powder,liquid smoke
title: Fusion Blackjack
ingredients: 1 can fava beans, undrained | 1 package dark soy sauce | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Drain the fava beans, saving water. Place the beans and 3/4 cup of liquid from the can in a blender, and mix on high, until smooth. Blend the molasses and cocoa powder into the remaining 1/4 cup of liquid from the can. Stir the blended beans and cocoa in to the molasses mix. When the mix is frothy, pour into an ice filled glass and sprinkle the liquid over it. Add more cocoa powder if you like.

title: Choco Burgers With Mango Chutney & Horseradish
ingredients: 12 fresh green chilies, coarsely chopped | 60 g mango chutney | 12 chocolate wafers | 125 g bamboo shoots, drained and sliced thinly | 2 tablespoons fresh horseradish, plus extra to serve
instructions: Mash chutney with a fork and stir through mango chutney. Arrange a good quantity of bamboo shoots in a single layer on two plates. Make burgers with cheese & prepared horseradish. Scatter with mango chutney. Note, the green chillies may be sliced thinly.

title: Karyl's Welsh Rarebit
ingredients: 4 cups raisins | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Wash your raisins and place in a bowl. Cover with a cup of water. Soak for 30 minutes, skimming off any foam that rises to the top. Drain & dry with a dry cloth or paper towels. Place a few drops of worcestershire sauce on top to finish.

title: Pomegranate Flavored Mushrooms (Zwt I-I Jwt II)
ingredients: 30 shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup pomegranate juice, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Clean shiitake mushrooms by removing stems & mince. Combine with pomegranate juice and 1 cup pomegranate juice in a shallow dish. Cover & refrigerate at least 1 hr or up to 24 hours. Remove from refrigerator & drain off all any excess juice. Slice mushrooms into rounds. Arrange mushrooms on a plate or shallow pan and sprinkle with more pomegranate juice. Drizzle w/ any remaining pomegranate juice.

title: Toast With Oil and Sassani.
ingredients: 2 breads, sliced 1/4 thick | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 2 slices crusty bread, sliced
instructions: Heat the oven to 300 degrees and place the bread on a baking tray. Brush it with the sesame oil and place the rosemary sprig on top. Place the bread on two baking trays and bake until the bread is lightly puffed and golden and the rosemary has softened. Remove the toast from the oven and cut into wedges. Serve warm. Tips, toast bread slices thinly on a wire rack set in a baking tin and bake them in the oven.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,pinto bean,red chilies,dark rum,salmon steak,sauce,poblano pepper
title: Salmon Steak With Roasted Chilli Poblanos and Beans
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs salmon steaks | 3 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/2 lb pinto beans | 1 poblano pepper | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 -2 red chilies or 1 red jalapeno
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f brush fillets with a little olive oil sprinkle with salt and roast them for about 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a roasting pan and cook on lower rack for about 20 - 30 minutes, basting once or twice with pan juices. After 20 minutes, remove with a large slotted spoon and keep warm. Turn up the heat to 400°f slice salmon on the bias. While fish is roasting, wash beans and poblanos. Toast for about 15 minutes in a 375°f oven, or until skins are slightly blackened. While beans are heating up, make the sauce. Place rum in a small bowl or small measuring cup. Place chillies in a small skillet over medium heat and warm until a few seeds begin to pop. Remove from heat and allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,turmeric powder,button mushroom,taco seasoning,orange juice,liquid smoke
title: Champinones (Stuffed Mushrooms)
ingredients: 1 package button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 4 fluid ounces liquid smoke | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Clean and clean the mushrooms. Dice the mushrooms into small cubes. Make a hole in the mushroom cap with a toothpick or two. Fill the mushroom cavities with about 2 tablespoons of the orange mixture. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. In a small bowl combine the taco seasoning with the orange juice, cheese, liquid smoke, and turmeric. Mix all of this together so that the taco seasoning dissolves. Fill mushrooms with this mixture.
