Place the mushroom caps on a lightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 20 minutes. Serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,currant,chicken breast half,yogurt,vanilla extract,picante sauce,honey,elbow macaroni
title: Spicy Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 pound boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2 in cubes | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 1/2 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into cubes | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 carton natural yogurt | 1/4 cup currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the beef, and honey in a large glass baking dish. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes. Cook the macaroni in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, about 7 minutes. Drain, and set aside. When the beef has simmered for 10 minutes, stir, and set aside. Place the picante sauce in a separate small dish. In two 6x8 inch baking dishes, layer the chicken, and top with cooked macaroni, and spoon about half of the picante sauce on top. Mix together the chicken, pasta, and the remaining picante sauce, and sprinkle with the vanilla. Bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes. Drizzle with yogurt, and top with currants, and bake another 5 minutes.

title: Cheese Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 pound rice noodles | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar | 4 1/2 tablespoons mori mixed spice | 1/4 cup crushed chile pepper, or more to taste | 1/4 cup dried fennel | 1 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice noodles and return to a boil. Cook the rice uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease 2 baking sheets. Stir sugar and mori spice blend into noodles until evenly distributed. Spread a portion of noodles onto the prepared baking sheets, then spread about 2 teaspoons of oregano/garlic mixture onto each noodle. Layer with chile pepper, fennel, and ricotta cheese. Repeat layers, and spread more oregano/garlic mixture on top. Bake in preheated oven until bubbly, about 15 minutes.

title: Gran's Easy Chili
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 can tomato puree | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Pour beans in a medium saucepan and fill with enough water to cover 1/2 of the beans. Bring to a boil, and stir in tomato puree. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Stir graham cracker crumbs into the chili. Allow to cool, then serve.

title: Japanese Style Tomato Soup
ingredients: 3 cups tomato soup ( soya brand ) | 2 inches piece ginger root, cut into long strips
instructions: Heat soup pot on stove to medium heat. Add one inch piece of piece gingerroot and stir for 1 minute. Add one spoonful of soup mix. After soup mix has formed a layer, boil 3 - 4 minutes. Remove ginger and discard. Sprinkle ginger slices over top of soup.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,ginger paste,sausage,apple cider,tamari,arborio rice,tequila,ginger ale
title: Kebabs in Tasty Apple Wine Dip
ingredients: 1/2 ounce dried sausages | 3 teaspoons ginger ale | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 10 ounces cooked arborio rice | sherry wine or tamari, to taste ( optional ) | chinese ginger ale or tamari, to taste ( optional ) | 4 ounces tequila | salad oil, plus extra, see instructions
instructions: Place sausages on a foil lined baking tray and bake in oven at 300°f/180°c, turning regularly, for about 15 minutes or until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Cut sausages into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place into a medium bowl. Add ground ginger, cooked rice, and tamari, if using, and mix until well combined. Divide among 4 serving glasses. Add sugar or honey to taste and accompany with extra oil.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,tomato juice,wild mushroom,chunky salsa,sherry wine,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Wild Mushatoes in a Spanish Salsa
ingredients: 4 fresh wild mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 1 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.

title: French Cream Substitute
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup maple syrup
instructions: Combine the half and half cream and maple syrup in a medium size bowl and whip thoroughly for 3 or 5 minutes until well combined and smooth. Place the cream mixture in a glass bowl. When the cream is completely incorporated, pour it into the bowl and stir to blend. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,asiago cheese,heavy cream,brown sugar,kalamata olive,chicken stock
title: Sloppy Giuseppeno Ala Milanese
ingredients: 12 kalamata olives | 32 ounces chicken stock | 20 ounces beef bouillon cubes | 6 ounces heavy cream | 1/4 cup brown sugar ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons fresh grated asiago cheese or 2 tablespoons swiss cheese
instructions: Rinse the olives under water and dry them on paper towels with a clean cloth. Pour 6 ounces of the broth and the bouillon cubes into a 2 - 3 quart pan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Stir in the cream, olives and brown sugar and simmer, covered, until the olives are very tender, stirring several times you should not need to stir. To serve, spoon sauce on toasted french bread or bagels and spread out toasts with a fork or pastry brush. Sprinkle the grated asiago on top.

title: Cheese With Herbs
ingredients: 2 cups asiago cheese, shaved ( about 1 pound ) | 1/4 cup fresh basil, minced | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Mix together the asiago cheese, basil, and tarragon. Serve in cheese mugs.

title: Chinese Fishball Appetizers
ingredients: 1 cup vermicelli, broken into pieces | 1 egg, beaten | 2 salmon fillets, rinsed and patted dry | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 bunches baby bok choy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange vermicelli pieces, and egg in a single layer on baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until cooked through and golden brown, about 10 minutes. Place salmon fillets on a serving platter. Top with vermicelli.

title: Homemade Dijon Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup dried cherries, divided | 1/2 cup dijon mustard | 1/2 cup pernod
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine 1/2 cup of the dried cherries, mustard and pernod. Blend well.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,chuck,brown sugar,mint leaf,lemon juice,white wine
title: English Beef Stew (Pork Stew)
ingredients: 1 lb chuck ( i know it sounds bland but the stew is just what i had in the fridge ) | 1/4 cup plain flour ( seasoned flour works fine too ) | 3/4 cup white wine | 1/2 preserved lemon, thinly sliced ( about 1 tablespoon ) | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( optional ) | mint leaf, to garnish
instructions: Cube meat and place in a dutch oven over medium low heat. Sprinkle the flour over the meat and brown meat in the flour. Add the wine and cook over medium for about 20 minutes, until meat is brown and crusty in texture. Add the preserved lemon slices, combine and allow to cook for a few minutes. In a small bowl, combine the brown sugar and lemon juice and then spread this all over the stew, garnish with mint leaves and serve this with your favourite vegetables such as spinach, potato wedges and green vegetable sticks. The meat is now ready to serve on its own. Variation, if you like your stew a bit thicker or thicker, in place of the plain flour put plain flour in a sieve and put it over a strainer. Mix this flour with no liquid until you have a firm mass. If you like it thinner, then you can use a bit of cold water.

title: Peachy  Peach Pecan  Gratin
ingredients: 12 medium fresh peaches, ripe | 1 orange | 1/2 cup pecan halves, toasted | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid honey
instructions: Cut the peach peel lengthwise in half vertically. Slice the orange and scrape out all excess juices. Using a vegetable peeler, peel 1 1/2 long strip of peel and slice crosswise into thin rings, 1 1/2 wide. Lay the pecan halves on a work surface. Cut the orange into thin strips. Arrange the peach slices in a well buttered 13 by 9 baking dish. Cut 1 1/2 strips of peel into 1 strips of pecans. Cut 1 1/2 strips of peel into 1 strips of pecan strips, and arrange over peaches. Sprinkle with honey. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 350 degree oven for about 35 to 40 minutes or until puffed and brown. Serve with ice cream.

Random Ingredients: single cream,picante sauce,bread flour,angel hair pasta,serrano chili,cream tartar
title: Mexican-Style Tomato and Cream Tartar
ingredients: 2 cups plain bread flour | 5 tablespoons single cream or 5 tablespoons cream | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 10 ounces canned diced tomatoes, drained | 2 serrano chili, chopped and seeded | 2 cans angel hair pasta, drained, rinsed and drained
instructions: In large bowl, combine flour, cream of tartar, cream of tartar, water, tomatoes, chilies and saute' chilies and set aside. In medium size nonmetal frying pan, shape flour mixture into a smooth ball, kneading with hands. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400°f in a 10 inch cast iron skillet, cook tortelloni on all sides until golden brown about 10 minutes, transferring to a baking sheet lined with foil. Repeat with remaining tortelloni and remove from skillet and place in paper towel. Add pasta to fat remaining in skillet, cook, covered, over medium heat until sizzling and creamy, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes. Add sauce to skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and place in shallow serving bowl. Serve with bread.

title: Onions and Ouzo
ingredients: 4 lettuce leaves | 1 tablespoon ouzo | 1/8 teaspoon mace
instructions: Heat grill. Place lettuce on hot grates. Brush with ouzo on top. Sprinkle with mace.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,green,mexican cheese,chipotle chile adobo,lemon juice zest,chili sauce,wonton wrapper,half
title: Mexican Cheesecake Cups
ingredients: 1 container plain mexican-style cheese blend, like mozzarella | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 -2 canned chipotle chile in adobo, chopped fine | 1 green, or | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 12 wonton wrappers, about | 1 -2 tablespoon green salsa or 1 -2 tablespoon chili sauce, i like mine hot
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, lightly mix the cheese together with the lemon juice, and spread on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Pour about 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture on top of cheese, and level it out on the top. Bake in the preheated oven for about 15 - 18 minutes, or until golden brown. When done, take the pan out and cut into bite size squares. Serve the next day with your favorite mexican entree dish.

title: Confections 'n' Twists
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 14 sheets aluminum foil | 1/2 cup pine nuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a piece of aluminum foil on your counter. Using an ice cream scoop, tear up several pieces of the aluminum foil into two 4 squares each and place them on top of the other. Combine confectioner's sugar, pine nuts, and corn oil in a small bowl. Place 1/2 of the pine nut mixture on each square. Place each square on the foil and roll up like a cigar. Wrap each strip in the foil and tuck into a loose knot with some water hanging out of the ends. Repeat to make two more knots. Place the knots on a cookie sheet. Bake until light gold, about 30 minutes. Cool to room temperature, about 15 minutes. Remove the knots from the foil and drizzle with the icing. Store the knots in your covered container for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,mozzarella cheese,spanish onion,green cardamom pod,basil,dark sesame oil
title: Indian Salad to be served at the table
ingredients: 1 green cardamom pod | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 tablespoons basil, finely chopped | 1 large romaine lettuce, outer leaves removed, washed and very well dried | 1 medium spanish onion, halved cut into 1/4-inch wedges | 2 -4 slices mozzarella cheese
instructions: Using a fork, poke around the edges of a cardamom pod to crack open. Heat the sesame oil in a 10 inch non stick pan.

title: Lemon Basil
ingredients: 1 cup basil leaves, torn into small fragments | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated
instructions: Sprinkle the basil over your finger tips. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour until ready to serve. Drain the basil, discard the basil and zest. To serve, add your desired amount to an individual bowl. Sprinkle chopped basil over the basil.

Random Ingredients: red onion,red curry paste,saffron,black olive,sun tomato
title: Simple Thai Saffron Roasted Olive & Red Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 jar pitted black olives ( reserve juice ) | 1/2 jar sun-dried tomatoes, in oil, drained | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 red onion, thinly vertically sliced and cut into thin slice | 1 pinch saffron ( see notes ) ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and toss lightly. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving to allow flavors to meld. Note, saffron will dissolve as absorbed by the olives but this tastes fine over heat.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,vanilla wafer,pesto sauce,heavy cream,cayenne pepper,stevia,gingerroot
title: Lighter Pesto Soufflés
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 8 ounces frozen vanilla wafers | 10 -12 ounces prepared reduced-fat heavy cream or 10 -12 ounces prepared prepared vanilla yogurt ( 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup low-fat pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, freshly grated | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper or 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon stevia ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f place frozen vanilla wafers in large bowl. Cover wafers with plastic wrap and microwave on high 5 - 7 minutes or until warmed. Remove from microwave and let cool 5 - 10 minutes, then stir to separate. Place remaining ingredients in blender and mix on high one minute, stopping occasionally to scrape sides of blender container and blending all the while. Transfer 1/4 cup of this liquid to another bowl and set aside. Add remaining liquid to blender and combine thoroughly. Spray a large bowl with veggie spray and place vanilla wafer mixture, overlapping slightly, into 4 - 8 ramekins or small dishes. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 tsp of grated ginger and 1 tsp of cayenne pepper or red pepper flakes. Place in a large roasting pan and cover with foil. Bake for 30 minutes, then remove foil and bake for an additional 10 - 15 minutes or until golden on top.

title: Gruyere Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup cocoa | 6 slices day old bread, cubed | 1/4 cup coarsely grated gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon sliced black sesame seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a shallow 3 1/2 quart baking dish. Rub the entire tenderloin with 1/4 cup cocoa. Press bread cubes into the top of the tenderloin. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes per side. Place the gruyere on top.

title: Sweet Chilli Burgers
ingredients: 4 hamburger buns | 125 g sweet chili sauce from canned jalapenos ( such as ketchup ) | 1 pinch caster sugar
instructions: Use a sharp knife or grater to shred the chilli. Put them all in the blender bowl and whizz on high until you have a fine mince. Put mixture back into the pan you chopped them inches and heat very gently. Use a small heatproof plate or small tray to dip the hamburger mixture into. Try to leave a lot of space between them. Turn heat down to low, then leave to simmer. Cook until the meat is cooked through but not too dry, about 10 - 15 minutes. Dish up your burger with a large spoon and eat like a condiment.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,seasoning,baby carrot,ranch dressing mix,apricot,sake,vanilla essence,pearl barley
title: Chickpea Barley Salad
ingredients: 50 g pearl barley | 50 g baby carrots | 50 g canned chickpeas ( drained ) | 1 package frozen petit fours ( drained ) | 3 cups ranch dressing mix | 2 tablespoons sake | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 -2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Cook barley, carrots and chickpeas in a pan until soft, drain and cool. Put all ingredients in a large bowl with 1 cup ranch mix and mix the rest of the dressing until you have a dressing that you can coat all over the chickpeas. Enjoy.

title: Guacamole Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons guacamole ( found at asian markets )
instructions: In a small bowl stir together soy sauce and guacamole. To make teriyaki sauce, in a small sauce frying pan heat the dark soy sauce over medium high heat. Stir constantly until the mixture reaches your desired thickness and color. You may stir quickly in 1 - 2 minutes to dissolve the soy sauce.

title: Chocolate-Peanut Butter Sweet Spread
ingredients: 1/2 ounce creme de cassis | 1/2 ounce chunky peanut butter ( not lite ) | 1/8 ounce tea, whipped ( optional )
instructions: Blend and drizzle into small glasses, with an ice & sprinkle with mint. You can also use a raspberry ice cream, like vanilla ice cream, or a raspberry syrup if you like.

title: Pistil Tri Color
ingredients: 1 package spinach leaves, washed, trimmed, and chopped | 8 large egg whites | pistachios, roasted or salted, to garnish
instructions: Lightly grease a baking pan with vegetable spray. Place spinach in a large bowl.

title: Mint Wine Riesling
ingredients: 6 1/4 cups brown onions, finely chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup riesling wine or 1/2-3/4 cup other white wine | 2/3 cup of fresh mint, coarsley chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, lower heat, and simmer for 4 - 5 minutes, being very careful the wine may pop out of the jar. Let cool down. Transfer wine into a serving mug. Top with a generous sprinkling of fresh mint. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: filet mignon steak,arborio rice,extra virgin olive oil
title: Risotto Alla Shitake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 16 ounces filet mignon steaks, rinsed and patted dry | 1/4 cup arborio rice
instructions: Heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Sear the rissotto steaks 3 to 5 minutes per side. Transfer the steaks to a plate. Cook and stir the rice with the pan drippings until the rice is translucent, about 2 minutes. Pour in the cooked rice and stir to mix thoroughly. Bring to a simmer and cook 5 minutes, until the rice is creamy and the steaks are lightly browned. Serve immediately.

title: Pork Normandy
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed of visible fat | 1 bag miniature marshmallows | 2 cans cannellini beans, rinsed | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/3 cup key lime juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lay pork tenderloin on the rack in the roasting pan. Insert toothpicks into the pork to help hold in shape. In a small bowl, combine marshmallows, beans, molasses, and lime juice. Spread the marshmallow mixture over the pork loin. Bake for 2 hours. Remove toothpicks from roast and let sit for 15 minutes before removing from pan. Serve with pan drippings and pan drippings drippings.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,beef gravy,mccormick seasoning,dutch cocoa,fenugreek seed,triple sec,almond,caster sugar
title: Indian Spiced Mincemeat
ingredients: 500 g ground beef ( mincemeat ) or 500 g chicken meat and 250 g turkey meat | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1 tablespoon all purpose dutch cocoa | 3 teaspoons mccormick spice | 3 dried fenugreek seeds | 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon chopped green chilies
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a large bowl. Mince meat mixture with hands until well mixed.. Shape into large balls and brown on all sides.. Serve with boiled rice, beans, chili and tomato chutney.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,marinara sauce,agave nectar,barbecue sauce,red chili pepper flake,pork,clove,snow pea
title: Baked Maple Spice Pork on the Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork, cut into 2 in. squares | 1 cup marinara sauce | 1 cup barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon agave nectar | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 -2 clove | 1/2 cup fresh snow pea
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Arrange pork in a baking dish. Set aside. In a bowl, whisk together marinara sauce, barbecue sauce, agave nectar, chile, red pepper flakes, and cloves. Pour mixture over pork in baking dish. Roast for 45 to 55 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 160°f. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes. Using a fork, pull apart snow peas in pieces. Serve pork on top of snow peas.

title: Portabella Mushrooms With Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 8 portabella mushrooms | taco seasoning | mint leaf
instructions: Wash mushroom caps. Place on a plate. Top with taco seasoning. Put on a mint leaf and enjoy.

title: Cracker Nips
ingredients: 2 cups parsnips, peeled, halved lengthways | 2 spring onions, sliced | 140 g tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon coriander | 60 g crackers, coarsely crushed
instructions: Cook parsnips in boiling water for 4 mins or until tender but still firm. Drain and cool. Transfer to a large mixing bowl. Add all remaining ingredients except crackers. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Mix well. Add crackers and mix again. Spoon into a small ovenproof dish. Bake in the oven at c for 10 mins or until golden and heated through and hot.

title: Veal Fajitas
ingredients: 1/2 lb veal | 8 fluid ounces vegetable and green beans | 1 package tortillas, burrito size
instructions: Cook veal in frying pan and then add veal juice, beans and warm tortillas over low heat until warm thru, about 10 - 15 minute serve as is or wrap burritos and place in a warmed platter.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,spaghetti sauce,kirsch liqueur,pita bread,cooking spray,pistachio
title: Pita Nests
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/4 cup kirsch liqueur | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 cup chopped pistachios | 4 pita breads, cut into 1-inch wedges ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Coat 4 large ramekins with cooking spray.

title: Italian Pork Patties
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 0.5 package good seasonings | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, mix together the pork, Good Seasonings and oil. On a lightly floured surface, roll out dough into the size and thickness of a large egg to form large round patties. Be sure to oil the top of the patties first, and not make them too thin. Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat, and lightly brown the patties on both sides about 3 - 5 minutes per side. Serve immediately and let each diner make his own.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,chili flake,catsup,chinese cabbage,ham steak,flour,olive oil cooking spray
title: Cabbage, Lamb and Crispy Croutons
ingredients: 1 lb chinese cabbage | 1/4 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili flakes, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 4 ham steaks
instructions: Core cabbage and shred into coarse strips. Place cabbage and catsup in plastic food bag, add in remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat with spray of olive oil. Brush tops of ham steaks with marinade, cook 3 - 4 minutes per side or until cooked. Remove from pan and serve.

Random Ingredients: greek seasoning,rice wine vinegar,salt,chicken bouillon powder
title: Easy Vietnamese Recipes
ingredients: 4 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 tablespoon greek seasoning | 1 teaspoon salt, or to taste
instructions: Combine rice vinegar, chicken bouillon, greek seasoning, and salt in a jar with a tight fitting lid and shake well until all ingredients are well incorporated. Cover with lid, and shake well to mix. Serve over jasmine rice.

title: Apricot Sesame Dipping Sauce for Pork or Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb finely chopped apricot ( do not use dried ) | 3/4 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: In a bowl mix all ingredients.

title: Pecan Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 chuck, trimmed and cut into 24 1 inch slices | 12 stuffed green olives | 3 dates, stoned | 1 cup grated pecans | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cornflour | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | lettuce, shredded | 12 whole pimento stuffed green olives
instructions: Combine the beef, olives, dates, pecans and cornflour in a bowl and roll the meat mixture in the cornflour mixture. Cut the roll with a sharp knife in half, making sure the bread doesn't touch the inside. Place on a greased oven tray and bake in a moderate oven for 2 hours turning every 15 minutes. Serve on rolls with salad and some cheese.

title: Easy Italian Style Salami Slice
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked salami | 1/2 cup half & half cream | 2 tablespoons demi-glace | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, pour over slice and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to set properly. Slice and serve with marmalade if desired. Also good for an afternoon snack with some cold coffee.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,orange,chicken thigh,bailey irish cream,white wine
title: Orange Chicken, Orange and Chardonnay (Modified)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken thighs, bone in | 4 tablespoons grated orange rind | 1 bottle of bombay white wine | 3/4 cup baileys irish cream | 2 cups basmati rice
instructions: Heat oil in large non stick skillet. Brown chicken in batches in hot oil turning until golden brown and cooked through. Remove chicken and add white wine to pan and heat through. Add bailey's stirring, until combined and add to pan. Add the rice to the chicken mixture and stir until combined. Cover, turn to high and cook for 5 minutes, or until rice is heated through.

title: Sardinian Rice and Vegetable Ragout
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked short pasta | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 3 large rhubarb, cut into 3/4 inch pieces | 1/2 cup crumbled dried apricot | 1 cup bulgur, soaked
instructions: Cook pasta in plenty of boiling, salted water until just tender and drain. Combine ginger paste and 2/3 cup water in a frying pan. Bring to a simmer, then stir in rhubarb. Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove cover and stir in apricots and bulgur. Cook 5 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed.

title: Lamb and Bagna
ingredients: 2 lbs ground lamb | 2 ounces margarita mix | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/3 cup dried breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon agave nectar
instructions: Combine ground lamb, margarita mix, bread crumbs, and agave nectar in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Roll chilled mixture into 18 meatballs.

title: Spicy Thyme
ingredients: 1/2 dried onion flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs
instructions: Mix well and store in your refrigerator up to three months.

title: Creamy Blackberry and Mushroom Meatballs
ingredients: 10 fresh blackberries | 1 2/3 lbs chicken drumsticks | 3 tablespoons dried mushrooms, soaked in water for 15 minutes | 3/4 cup light coconut milk | 1/4 cup beer | 1 teaspoon allspice berry | 10 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Place blackberries and 1/4 cup water into large bowl. Cover with a sieve and let stand for 10 minutes. Remove blackberries from sieve.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,extra virgin olive oil,double cream,red curry paste,tomatillo salsa,lemon juice zest,ice cube
title: Tomato and Red Curry Oven Baked Tomatillo
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 14 ounces tomatillo salsa | 10 ounces double cream | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, zest of | 2 cups fresh italian bread, cut into cubes | steamed lemon slices or red onion, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c, heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add curry paste and cook, stirring or shaking pan to loosen browned bits, for 1 minute. Add tomatoes and heat through. Transfer to ovenproof casserole dish. Combine the cream and lemon zest in a bowl. Add half the bread cubes to cream mixture. Pour over tomatillo mixture. Arrange in layers over casserole, top with remaining bread and brush with oil. Bake for 45 minutes, or until top is golden.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,reynolds wrap foil,chicken liver,part mozzarella cheese,five spice powder,pistachio,spring onion,green bell pepper
title: Pollo Formaggio - Chicken Livers, Green Pepper & Pistachios on Wrapped Foil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 1/2 lbs chicken livers, trimmed | 2 green bell peppers, roasted | 2 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped pistachios | 2 spring onions, thinly sliced, diagonally | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 lb part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Grill or broil chicken livers until done. Slice green peppers into thin strips. Spread roasted peppers with oil then place in a shallow dish. Sprinkle with shrimp season with salt and freshly ground pepper, oregano and paprika. Heat 1/3 cup oil in a skillet over medium heat, add the parma and shrimp and saute for approximately 4 minutes or until the shrimp are just pink and caramelized. Remove from heat, set aside and keep warm. Divide between the two tortillas. Top with the white part of the spring onions and the pistachios. Sprinkle the mozzarella on top.

title: Curry-Glazed Beef With Corn
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed, cut into strips | 4 large egg whites | 2 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 can sweetcorn, drained | 1 package frozen sweetcorn, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. Mix beef with egg whites and curry powder in a 3 - ½ qt casserole dish.

title: Easy Meat Sauce
ingredients: 20 lbs frozen meat | 3 lbs frozen thin 'cream'whipped topping, thawed | 1 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1 cup fat-free liquid honey
instructions: Thaw frozen meat and thaw thoroughly. To thaw the frozen meat, place the meat in a colander and sprinkle with salt. Cover lightly and squeeze out as much water as possible. Pat thawed meat dry. Sprinkle on salt and use a rolling pin to roll the meat into a uniform cylinder shape about 36 inches long by 6 inches wide. Place the rolled meat in a crock. Top loosely with thawed whipped topping. Roll 'cream' into a ball and set in the refrigerator to chill overnight if no longer cold. Add 1 minute in the refrigerator if using. Serve with other sauces.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,mace,green cardamom pod,garlic,kaffir lime leaf,kosher salt
title: Mangrel Curry
ingredients: 1 whole dried kaffir lime leaf | kosher salt | 3 green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons minced garlic
instructions: Place the kaffir lime leaf in a coffee filter basket, close to the vent of the coffee, and leave it for 20 to 30 minutes to soften. Pour the softened kaffir lime leaves into a blender, add 1/2 teaspoon salt and blend until pureed, about 1 minute. Pour the pureed kaffir lime leaves into a serving dish, and add the cardamom pods, red pepper flakes, mace, and garlic. Stir to combine. Taste to adjust the salt and pepper, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,tahini,water,beef flavor ramen noodle,chinese pea pod,poblano chile,ginger ale
title: Chinese Fire & Ice Meat Ramen
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 12 ounces of premium chinese pea pods, trimmed | 1/2 lb premium fresh ground beef flavor ramen noodles | 4 tablespoons tahini | 4 cans ginger ale | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 dash cayenne, ground
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a rack 4 - 5 inches from the heat until high heat, and place a metal pan on top of it for easy extraction. In a large skillet place chiles and pea pods, and sear them on both sides until they are soft, black spots appear on the pea pods. Place chiles and pea pods in a bowl, and set aside in the refrigerator. In a second skillet heat one can of tahini, and three cans of ginger ale on medium high heat. Add the ground ramen noodles. Cook noodles in the liquid until tender, about 4 - 5 minutes, or according to their directions. Reserve half for later. Place ramen noodles in a casserole dish, and add the water, and mix in the cayenne and the cayenne pepper. Drain half the water out of the ramen noodles, and add to the skillet. Stir, cover, and bake for 30 minutes, or until the water has mostly evaporated. Remove the casserole from the oven, and stir the ramen meat and reserved water into the skillet over medium heat until hot and bubbling.

title: Sausage Tortillas with Nectarine and Green Zucchini
ingredients: 12 tortillas | 1/2 lb smoked pork sausage, sliced to 1/4-inch slice on the diagonal | 1 lb green zucchini, diced in small cubes | 1 cup broccoli floret, chopped | 2 garlic cloves, finely chopped | 1 nectarines or 1 plums, halved, seeded and chopped
instructions: Place 1/2 tortilla in a large nonstick skillet. Layer sausage evenly over the tortilla. Top with zucchini, green zucchini, broccoli, garlic and napkins. Cook over medium high heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until vegetables are lightly browned and zucchini is crisp tender.

title: Mango Beef
ingredients: 1 boneless sirloin steak, trimmed | 2 mangoes, peeled and sliced
instructions: Cut steak into serving sized pieces. Place in a bowl with mango. Marinate at least one hour, or let stand 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,poppy seed,oat bran,pork baby back rib,plum,tequila,garlic salt,raisin
title: Taco Dogs With Plum Chutney
ingredients: 2 lbs pork baby back ribs | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup dried plums | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese | 6 tablespoons tequila | 12 tablespoons rolled oats bran | 3 teaspoons garlic salt | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Place ribs in saucepan.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,graham cracker crumb,chicken stock vegetable,milk ricotta cheese,penne,angel hair pasta,cremini mushroom,sponge cake
title: Angel Hair Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 7 ounces penne | 5 ounces angel hair pasta ( spaghetti ) | 4 ounces fresh cremini mushrooms | 12 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 12 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 8 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup chicken stock or 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: In a pot of salted boiling water, cook penne for 8 to 10 minutes or until just tender. Drain pasta, reserving 1 1/2 cups of the cooking liquid. In a large bowl, with a mixer, beat together angel hair pasta, 2 tbsp of the ricotta cheese, 1/4 cup of ricotta cheese and 1/4 cup of the chicken or vegetable stock.

title: Stuffed Rigatoni With Yogurt
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon paprika | 2 ounces pimientos, drained | 3/4 cup sliced marshmallows | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro | 1/4 cup milk
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to directions. Drain and cool. Blend ricotta, yogurt, paprika and pimientos. Fold in marshmallows and cilantro. Toss with rigatoni. Serve.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,plain yogurt,oat,cardamom,self rising flour,tomato paste
title: Yoghurt Potato Pie - Microwave
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, quartered | 1 ounce tomato paste | 1 teaspoon cardamom | 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 1/3 cup self rising flour | 1/3 cup oats
instructions: Cook potatoes in microwave, 1 1/2 cups of water and tomato paste for 4 - 5 minutes on high, or until soft. Stir in cardamia nut, yogurt and flour. Cook for 5 minutes, stir, leave for further 1 minute. Pour into a greased pie plate and cover with foil. Microwave on high for 10 minutes, or until cooked through. Turn onto a cooling rack. Leave to stand a few minutes, remove foil and cool further. When cool, cut into 16 wedges. Place on a plate and drizzle with a little olive oil. Serve.

title: Pesto Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups half and half | 1/2 cup fresh basil | 1/4 cup refrigerated pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 5 tablespoons honey
instructions: In a medium sauce pan over medium heat, blend half and half with pesto, ginger paste and honey. Let simmer for 10 minutes. Pour sauce over chicken as desired.

title: Arabi
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 1 cup warm water. Mix in the fenugreek seeds. Use as desired.

title: Hurry Paste III
ingredients: 4 slices bacon drippings | 1 1/2 cups chili-garlic sauce
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, stir bacon drippings and chili garlic sauce together until simmering, about 10 minutes. Bring bacon mixture to boil.

title: Savory Steak Creole
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, sliced thin | 1 large onion, sliced thin | 1 large yellow squash, sliced thin, and cut into 1/4 strips | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 package frozen green peas, thawed | 1 bag frozen mussels
instructions: Preheat over to 350 degrees. Place sliced steak in 13x9x2 inch glass casserole dish. Sprinkle with onions. Sprinkle with squash. Cover with enchilada sauce, then green peas. Cover with mussels, cover, and bake 15 minutes. Uncover and continue baking 15 more minutes.

title: Beer and Spice Drink Mix for Dry Ginger Beer
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 can or bottle dark beer, full of beer
instructions: Mix together well. Make 3 slabs of ginger beer and 3 slabs of dark beer. Strain through meat grinder and store in airtight container until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: pork sirloin roast,cremini mushroom,corn tortilla chip,pie shell
title: Lazy Cottage Cheese and Beef Tacos with Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork sirloin roast, 1/4-inch trimmed to fit corn tortilla chips | 8 cremini mushrooms | 1 package refrigerated pie shells | 1 1/2 cups crushed corn tortilla chips
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Dry roast on paper towels. Place in large plastic bag, along with beef, and toss to coat. Wipe out large skillet with paper towels, sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, and preheat over medium heat. Place mushrooms, remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt in skillet. Cook, stirring, until mushroom are tender. Add beef and beef mixture. Cook, stirring constantly with wooden spoon, 7 - 10 minutes, or until hot. Stir in tortilla chips. Transfer to shallow baking dish. Bake on middle rack of oven, stirring occasionally, until hot and melted, about 10 minutes.

title: Plantains (Peeled Tomatoes)
ingredients: 2 lbs firm plantains ( ripe ) | 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 3 4 ounces oats or 5 ounces barley
instructions: Wash plantains and cut in slices. Heat up olive or canola oil in frying pan. Fry on both sides till lightly browned. Cool. In a bowl place tomatoes, drained plantain slices, and a tsp of oat or barley. Toss together. Serve with fresh sliced tomato or any other garnish. You can serve just on the side to use, or you can serve as is or with a tomato sauce. Some folks such as to add some fresh herbs instead of oregano.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,chickpea,white sesame seed,green capsicum,tofu,dark brown sugar
title: Vegan Tofu Filled With Tofu
ingredients: 4 tablespoons white sesame seeds | 150 g firm tofu ( tofu ) | 75 g firm tofu ( vegan ) | 2 cans chickpeas, drained well | 1/2 small green capsicum, deseeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( from 2 lemons ) | 1/4 teaspoon dark brown sugar
instructions: In a small frying pan, heat the oils and fry the sesame seeds for 1 to 2 minutes. Tip into a bowl and set aside. In a medium sized pot heat the sesame seeds over a moderate heat until golden brown, adding the tofu about halfway through the cooking. Using a slotted spoon, drain the tofu on paper towels and cut in half. Lay the tofu over a baking paper lined tray and pat it dry with kitchen paper. Spread half of the sesame seeds on one side of the bean halves. Place the sesame seeds on top. Place the chickpeas in a sieve over a bowl and run a knife round each of the halves. Drain the chickpeas and place them on top of the sesame seeds. Top the bean layers with the sesame seeds. Add the capsicum, lemon juice, sugar and remaining sesame seeds. Sprinkle over extra sesame seeds and leave to cool whilst you make the filling, preheat the oven to 200c. To make the filling, place the tofu, chickpeas and green capsicum in a roasting tray which has been lined with baking paper. Combine all the filling ingredients in a medium bowl. Place in the freezer and freeze until ready to use. To bake, heat the oven to 210c. Place the tofu on a baking paper lined tray and bake for 20 minutes or until firm.

title: Baked Pumpkin and Peppers
ingredients: 4 -5 cups cooked pumpkin | green pepper ( any colors )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Wash the peices and place on a baking cookie sheet. Cut the pepper into strips, place 1 or 2 strips in each pepper. Bake in preheated oven for about 30 minutes, until the pepper is slightly crisp.

title: Tunisian Grilled Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds sirloin, cut into thin slices | 1 can sliced green chile peppers, drained | 3 tablespoons capers | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the steak, chilies, capers and vinegar. Marinate for 1 to 2 hours in the refrigerator. Light grill. Remove meat from marinade and arrange on the grate over hot coals. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes, basting with remaining marinade.

title: Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 6 cups fresh corn | 4 egg whites | corn ( optional ) or cornstarch, for thickening ( optional )
instructions: Remove the husks from the corn and discard. Cut the corn kernels off of the cob, and wash the corn in a food mill or blender. Mix corn with the egg whites until fluffy and then shape into small patties. Cook over medium heat or in a wok until browned, about 7 minutes. Turn once, and sprinkle with a little cornstarch to thicken it.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,rosemary,chocolate baking square,butter margarine,self raising flour,cilantro leaf
title: Lamb and Rosemary Scones
ingredients: 2 ounces butter or margarine | 1 ounce self-raising flour | 1 ounce chopped fresh rosemary | 1 small fresh rosemary tied with kitchen string | 1 ounce grated semisweet chocolate, to sprinkle | 2 ounces unsalted butter or 2 ounces unsalted margarine | fresh cilantro leaves, to garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f/200°c/gas mark butter 4 sandwich tins. Dust the scones with flour. Melt the butter or margarine with the rosemary. In a medium bowl sift the flour with the chocolate. Rub the melted butter in with the rosemary milk mixture, add a little extra flour if necessary, blending all the flour with the rosemary. Mix well. Turn heaped tablespoons of the dough into the tins and sprinkle the crumb topping mixture on top. Bake for about 25 minutes or until the topping is lightly browned and the scone is cooked through.

title: Slow Cooker Roast Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-sodium beef broth | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained | 1 pound sirloin, trimmed of fat
instructions: Put the beef broth, roasted red peppers, and roasted red pepper pieces into a slow cooker crock. Set crock pot on high and cook for 6 hours. Remove beef from crock pot and slice into 1/2 inch thick strips. Return beef to crock pot and keep warm until serving.

Random Ingredients: leek,white meat chicken,white onion,picante sauce,lima bean,peach
title: Eleanor's Chicken Soup
ingredients: 10 white meat chicken pieces, skinned ( i had them ) | 2 white onions, sliced | 4 leeks, thoroughly sliced | 2 cans peaches, sliced ( i 'd like more ) | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 package frozen lima beans ( also need some for topping )
instructions: Place all ingredients in soup pot. Bring to boil, then reduce to simmer until chicken is done. Remove chicken from pot, let cool and place in freezer bag with juice. I like to squeeze juice from bag out of bag but you can also use broth if you want to save calories. Throw out bags of juice and use what remains in the bag for a soup when it cools down. You can store any leftover juice in the fridge so you may have leftovers.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard,yellow bell pepper,korean red pepper powder,puff pastry,tortilla chip
title: Spicy Totsy Rolls
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 2 tablespoons korean red pepper powder | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 1/4 cup crushed tortilla chips | white sweet bell peppers, cut into rings
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spray a 9x5 inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray. Roll each sheet of pastry into a 17 inch square on a clean, parchment paper lined work surface. Press each square into the prepared pan, pressing lightly to level. Smooth any cracks. To make a crust, cut each dough square into three triangles. Arrange triangles over the dough in a single layer. In another layer, mix yellow mustard, korean red pepper powder, and yellow mustard, and sprinkle evenly over the pastry and edges of the triangles. Sprinkle crushed tortilla chips over the mixture and press gently. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: coriander root,peach nectar,cilantro leaf,arborio rice,nonfat milk,teriyaki sauce
title: Peachy Peaches, Pistachio & Coriander Risotto
ingredients: 50 g coriander roots, chopped fresh | 15 g peanut peanuts or 15 g cashews | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 2 1/2 cups nonfat milk | 15 g arborio rice | fresh cilantro leaves, to serve
instructions: Using a food processor, process the coriander roots, peanuts and teriyaki sauce with the milk until creamy. Set aside. Wash the rice in a sieve, then place in a saucepan with 2 tablespoons water and bring to the boil. Add 2/3 of the coriander mixture and leave covered. Add the rice and cook over moderate heat for 5 minutes, stirring. When the rice is cooked, remove from the heat and stir in 1/3 of the peanut/cashew mixture and serve, sprinkling with coriander and remaining coriander and some cilantro leaves for garnish.

title: Italian Beans De Saumon
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans with curd ( see basic french beans and dressing in yellow shell ) | 2 tablespoons fish bouillon ( can use more ) | 1 medium yellow onion, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons bottled minced italian parsley | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: Drain the beans and discard the liquid. Place in the bottom of your food processor or blender. Add the onion, parsley, amaretto and vinegar. Process to desired consistency. Taste and adjust seasoning. Note, you can also use fresh minced ham instead of the amaretto and/or ham depending on your tastes.

title: Gruyere Spread
ingredients: 2 cups gruyere cheese ( finely grated or grated ) | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Put all ingredients into a bowl and mix. Cover and chill for 1 - 2 hours.

title: Mexican Edamame Pie
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated flaky tofu with liquid | 8 sprigs fresh cilantro or 2 tablespoons coriander | 1 jalapeno pepper, minced | 1 package frozen shelled edamame, thawed | 2 cups tomato juice | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: Combine the tofu, cilantro, and jalapeno in a bowl. Drain water from the tofu mixture. Cut the tofu into 1 inch chunks and place in a saucepan.

title: Grilled Zucchini and Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 medium zucchini, trimmed | 2 plum tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons chili powder, or to taste | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil, or as needed
instructions: Place zucchini and tomatoes on a wire rack, and grill, turning with tongs to evenly grill, until tomatoes have begun to split and squash are soft. Heat oil in a skillet or saucepan over medium heat. Stir in chili powder, and season sauce with cayenne. Serve topped with zucchini.

title: German Ham & Bacon
ingredients: 1 package back bacon | 1 package deli ham, finely shredded | 2 teaspoons ghee | 1/2 cup plain dry bread crumbs | 1/3 cup chopped celery
instructions: In a small saute pan over medium low heat, cook bacon until crisp, but not crisp. Cool on paper towels. Pour off drippings to make about 20 drippings. Break bacon into 1 1/2 pieces and set aside. Place ham on greased cookie sheet and flatten slightly. Melt ghee in a small skillet over medium low heat and add ham. Spread crumbs on ham. Place ham on crumbs, pressing crumbs down firmly. Sprinkle with celery. Bake in a 350 degree f oven 45 minutes.

title: Queso Fresco With Kiwi Fruit
ingredients: 5 kiwi fruits, peeled | 1/3 lb queso fresco
instructions: Cut kiwifruit in half and carefully remove the seeds. Cut half of kiwifruit into 8 slices of about 1/2´´´´´´´´´. Wear gloves to protect yourself, and to prevent wasting time. Put kiwifruit and queso fresco into a large bowl. Sprinkle cheese on top of kiwifruit. Cover and refrigerate until the cheese has completely melted through. Serve with crackers or bread.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,vanilla sugar,cranberry,raspberry,wheat bread crumb,almond flavoring
title: Berry-Cranberry Crumble
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped mixed dried berries ( i like to use strawberries ) | 1 1/3 cups whole wheat bread crumbs ( dry ) | 1/3 cup light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/4 teaspoon almond flavoring | 1/3 cup cranberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the berries, bread crumbs, brown sugar, vanilla sugar, and almond flavoring. Put the mixture in a greased 8 inch square pan. Spoon berries over the crumb mixture and bake at 400f for 30 minutes. Cover crumble with foil if it begins to brown too quickly. Let bake for 10 - 15 minutes more to crisp the crust.

title: Cardamom Jelly
ingredients: 4 tablespoons grated fresh lemon juice or 4 tablespoons orange juice | 1 green cardamom pod, bruised
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric coffee grinder.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,yogurt,penne pasta,cream mushroom soup,couscous,parsley flake,buttermilk,spring onion
title: Curried Penne With Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1 box penne pasta | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 container sour cream | 1/2 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley flakes | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 cup plain yogurt | 3 spring onions, sliced thinly | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Prepare the penne and set aside. Mix together the first eight ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Prepare the mushroom sauce by combining yogurt and spring onions. Then, add the mushroom sauce to the yogurt and stir well. Add the pasta and mix well. Pour the sauce over hot pasta and toss to coat in the sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: flour,olive oil,taco flour tortilla,tomato soup,dark rum,italian salad dressing mix
title: Tortillas with Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 package italian salad dressing mix ( i make my own ) | 1 cup dark rum ( optional ) | 1 flour tortilla, cut into 1-inch thick wedges | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1 package taco-size flour tortillas, cut into 1-inch strips, for topping
instructions: In a 2 quart bowl, stir together the soup, salad dressing mix, rum, and oil as directed on package of italian dressing mix. Add tortilla wedges, and toss to coat. Place the tortilla chips on a plate and cover with plastic wrap until ready to use. Preheat the broiler. Grease a medium size baking dish. Using a fork, poke holes in the prepared tortilla squares to vent steam. Place the tortilla chips on a baking sheet, cover, and broil 6 minutes or until the centers begin to brown, stirring occasionally. Ladle soup into prepared dish. Sprinkle top with taco sauce, and serve hot.

title: Mascarpone Di Arancia (Super Easy and Simple Tiramisu - Really Easy!!!!!!)
ingredients: 1 package ladyfinger | 2 -3 serrano peppers, stemmed, seeded and sliced
instructions: Separate each ladyfinger in half. Place half of the pepper slices in a ziploc bag. Add 1 tablespoon of the serrano pepper into the bag and shake vigoursly to coat them. After a few minutes, place the remaining pepper slices into the ziploc bag and shake around the bag to coat them well and ensure they're all coated. Repeat the process with the other half of the pepper slices until all of the pepper and peppers are coated. Lay on paper towels covered or a clean, dry towel. Let them sit for 20 minutes so they can soften slightly. Pre heat the oven to 325°f. Line a cookie sheet or jelly roll pan with parchment paper or lightly grease with olive oil. Place the ladyfingers on the cookie sheet and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, brushing them with olive oil as needed. When they're golden, remove the baking sheet from the oven and remove the papery pepper slices from the bag and stir them into the mascarpone mixture. Spoon the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers and serve at room temperature.

title: Rice With Dates and Lime
ingredients: 400 g jasmine rice | 3 dates ( large-sized, stoned ) | 2 limes ( zest of and 1-inch of lime juice ) | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Wash and drain your rice, put in a large bowl, add some cold water and mix through gently. When the water starts to clear, pour the mustard and juice evenly over the rice and leave to stand for 15 minutes while the rice is still slightly hot. Fluff with a fork and serve. Nice side toppings are fresh corriander and a little pomegranate seeds.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,arborio rice,ra el hanout spice mix,tarragon
title: Azerbaijani's Black Pepper Arborio Rice
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice blend
instructions: Wash and dry rice with a clean tea towel. Place rice in the rice cooker and add black pepper. Add Ras El Hanout or any other seasoning of your choice. Lock on tight cover and walk away. After about 30 mins, press the button. When the rice has finished restart the cooker after 20 mins, remove lid and wait another 5 minutes. It is done immediately and must be eaten hot, or cold.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,baby spinach,butternut squash,rigatoni pasta,greek yogurt,shrimp paste,heavy cream,greek olive
title: Butternut Squash and Shrimp Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon shrimp paste | 1 teaspoon roasted artichoke, pureed ( see recipe below ) | 2 tablespoons tzatziki-style greek olives | 1 small butternut squash ( peeled, seeded and cut into 1/2 inch cubes ) | 9 ounces rigatoni pasta | 2 cups baby spinach
instructions: In a saucepan, bring cream, yogurt and the shrimp paste to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and stir in the olives and squash. Cook until squash is tender, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, cook rigatoni according to package directions using a large pot of boiling water, about 10 minutes. Drain and gently toss with spinach. Serve mixture over rigatoni and sprinkle with the paprika. Variation, instead of the shrimp paste, you can cook shrimp with a little olive oil on top just before adding shrimp, then toss, and serve.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,lamb chop,jalapeno chile,splenda sugar substitute,tortilla
title: Lamb Chops Wrapped in Tortillas
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lamb chops, about 1 inch thick | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute or 1/2 cup sugar | 3 tablespoons splenda sugar blend | 1 jalapeno chile, finely chopped ( optional ) | 4 cups uncooked medium grain white rice
instructions: Trim fat from chops. Cut each chop lengthwise into 4 pieces. Combine 2 tbsp of splenda and jalapeno, if using. Sprinkle over chops. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or up to 2 days. Preheat broiler. Sprinkle rice with extra 1 tbsp of splenda. Place chops on rack of broiler pan. Broil 4 to 5 minutes on each side, or until browned and slightly crispy.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,raspberry liqueur,beef chuck roast,pea,serrano pepper,green bell pepper
title: Beef With Peas
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 5 ounces raspberries-flavored liqueur | 1 can sliced green bell peppers or 1 cup canned peppers | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and diced | 1/4 cup frozen peas | 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine the raspberries, green bell peppers, and serrano pepper in the container of a food processor fitted with the metal blade. Process until smooth. Place all ingredients into a heavy duty crock or other large nonreactive pot with a lid. Cook on low 8 hours or on high 4 hours. Remove the roast and cut it into 1/2 inch pieces. Return the meat to the pot, stir it, and let it reheat slightly.

title: Dashi Noodle
ingredients: 6 ounces rice noodles | 3 cups apple juice | 4 carrots, shredded
instructions: Break noodles into 2 inch lengths. Place into a large, shallow serving dish and cover with apple juice. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. About 2 hours before serving, steam shredded carrots until crisp tender. Drain noodles and stir. Spoon noodle mixture into a bowl, or serve plain to serve.

Random Ingredients: bulgur,icing sugar,tart apple,pinto bean,self raising flour,vinegar,mango chutney,tomato green chilies
title: Apple-And-Barney Salsa
ingredients: 450 g self-raising flour | 1 1/4 cups icing sugar | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 410 g pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 410 g chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 410 g chopped mango chutney | 150 g chopped tart apples | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts or 1/4 cup roasted pine nuts, if desired
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, icing sugar and vinegar and mix until well blended. Mix in pinto beans, tomatoes, mango chutney, apples and nuts. Pour into a well buttered 11 x 7 baking dish, and bake in a moderately hot oven for 50 minues or until golden and cooked through. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Parsley Baked Chips
ingredients: 1 bell pepper | 1/2 cup crouton | 2 bay leaves | 1/2 teaspoon vodka or 1/2 teaspoon cognac
instructions: Remove seeds from bell pepper. Slice into thin strips, then arrange on foil lined baking sheet. Spray with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 425°f. Mix all ingredients together with fingers to make a dry crusty coating. Pour over chips. Bake 20 minutes, until crisp.

title: Cumin Stuffed Dates
ingredients: 1/4 cup walnut oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 cup chopped dates | 1 box dry pasta shells
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, heat the walnut oil. Add the cumin seeds and allow to crackle for about 1 minute. Stir in the dates. Cook the mixture for 20 to 25 minutes or until the dates have a golden, slightly sticky consistency. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to package directions. Rinse to drain, and cool until warm. Fill the shells with the walnut mixture. Place on a cookie sheet that has been coated with cooking spray. Cover with a tea towel and allow to dry at room temperature for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,pepper flake,sirloin tip roast,red lentil,fish sauce,mango chutney,grape tomato
title: Lentil and Steak Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentil | 1 jar grape tomatoes | 1/2 lb sirloin tip roast | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon peanut-flavored mango chutney | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Soak lentils in a bowl of warm water for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, coarsely chop tomatoes in food process or blender. Cut steaks into 1 inch cubes. Combine meat, tomatoes, chili sauce and seasonings in a large, glass, metal or ceramic bowl. Toss with lentils.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,lemon zest,okra,hot red chili pepper
title: Sweet-And-Sour Okra
ingredients: 1 lb okra, thawed if frozen | 1/4 cup orange marmalade or 1/4 cup apricot marmalade | 3 fresh hot red chili peppers, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Place okra in a bowl. Make a paste by combining the marmalade, chili peppers, and grated lemon zest. Pour over the okra and toss to coat evenly.

title: Grilled Goat Cheese With Chili and Rose Water
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces goat cheese ( or other flavorful goat cheese ) | 7 -10 fresh chile salsa ( see note ) | 5 tablespoons rose water | 2 -3 tablespoons vanilla beans, seeds removed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine goat cheese, 1/4 cup chili salsa and 2 t of rose water, and stir until smooth, adding more salsa or rose water as needed to incorporate. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. When ready to grill, remove from refrigerator and brush off excess oil from goat cheese mixture. Brush top of goat cheese with a little bit of the chili salsa mixture onto the exposed surface and grill for about 5 minutes, or until lightly golden brown. Remove goat cheese from grill and place on plate, spoon remaining chili sauce on top and top with a dollop of goat cheese. Serve with warmed or fried plantains, fruit, lettuce or fresh fruit as optional garnishes.

title: Bake Tilapia With Beetroot, Breading, and Garlic Croutons
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 3 slices bread | 3 beets | 1 clove crushed garlic | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush both sides of each tilapia fillet with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange on baking sheet. Roast in upper third of oven for 12 minutes. Meanwhile, cut off tops of the beets and trim leaves and root ends. Cut tops into thick slices. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Add beets and garlic.

title: Polenta Manchego
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups polenta, coarsely ground | 4 eggs, divided | 1 jar pimientos, drained and finely chopped, juice reserved | 1/2 cup grated mature cheddar cheese | 2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 3 large bowl with hands in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until all the liquid is absorbed and mixture is creamy and slightly thickened, about 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Beef Rolls
ingredients: 350 g stewing beef | 1 can crescent dinner rolls | 1/4 cup couscous | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cardamom pods
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 degrees celsius cut meat into pieces. Open packet of the crescent roll packages and place on a large oven tray lined with baking paper. Combine spices in a bowl. Roll meat into nut sized balls and cook in a non stick frying pan until browned and cooked through. Roll balls in spices until all of the meat is coated. Place in the oven on a foil lined tray. Bake in oven for approximately 12 - 15 minutes until cooked through. Serve with couscous or yoghurt.

title: Strawberry Cornbread
ingredients: 1 large strawberry | 1 jar campari | 1 cup stone-ground cornmeal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Slice the strawberry in half, and scoop out most of the white sections. Stem the pulp into a bowl, and squeeze in a handful of the pulp. Reserve the rest of the pulp. Reserve the remainder for another use. Bring the reserved pulp to a boil in a saucepan. Remove from heat, and stir in campari. In a bowl, stir together the cornmeal and the reserved pulp. Transfer the cornbread mixture to a lightly oiled or floured 9x5x3 inch square baking dish. Sprinkle the top with the reserved strawberry pulp, and carefully smooth the top. Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven, then broil until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: sponge cake,wheat pasta,ricotta cheese,green chili pepper,potato starch
title: Creamy Potato Cake Salad
ingredients: 1 lb potato starch or 1 lb flour | 1 1/2 pints ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup green chili peppers or 1/2 red chili pepper | 1/2 sponge cake | 1/2 tablespoon mixed potato starch
instructions: Boil 6 cups of salted water. Add 3/4 pkg. Ricotta to the water, bring back to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes. When cooked, drain off the water. In a bowl, mix the potato starch and 1/2 pkg. Ricotta to thicken it up a bit. Add the chili & green chili. Cut the sponge cake into even chunks and, if using chunks, cut them into 1 inch pieces and then just add to the potato ricotta mixture. Add the mix to the potatoes & stir until all ingredients are coated well. Garnish with remaining 1/2 pkg. Ricotta.

title: Raspberry Basil Salad
ingredients: 3 cups fresh raspberries ( about 2 punnets ) or 3 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 4 ounces walnut halves, toasted | 1/2 cup dried roasted salted peanuts | 1/4 cup tamari or 1/4 cup soy lite tamari | 12 leaves fresh basil
instructions: Combine the raspberry preserves, walnuts, peanuts, tamari and basil in a bowl and chill 3 - 4 hours.

title: Gramma's African-Spiced Chickpea Dip
ingredients: 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables ( peas, corn, green beans ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 1/8 teaspoon cajun seasoning ( more if taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon garlic and black pepper blend | 2 whole jalapeno peppers, seeded and chopped | ground coriander, to taste | fresh ground pepper, to taste
instructions: Place the peas in a pot with just enough water to cover them by 2 inches. Cover and place over medium heat. When the peas come to a boil, remove the lid and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes or until they are crisp tender. Remove from heat and reserve about 1 cup of the peas cooking liquid. Puree the peas in a food processor or blender to your desired consistency. Put the chopped jalapeños in a small bowl with the reserved cooking liquid. Heat the honey in a small, heavy nonstick skillet over medium heat. Once hot, add the cajun seasoning and mix well. Add the jalapeños and cook about 4 minutes. Add the peas to the pan and cook until warmed through, adding more oil if necessary. If the mixture is too thick, add a few tablespoons of the reserved cooking liquid.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,sausage,fajita seasoning mix,chicken breast half
title: Fajitas Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 pound skinless, boneless smoked sausage, cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Place the chicken between two sheets of aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,russet potato,fennel,key lime juice,grain bread,vegetable stock,cornflour,rom tomato
title: Sopa De Fuba -- Cuban Potato and Fennel Soup
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup russet potato, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon ground fennel | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon fresh key lime juice | 4 slices whole grain bread
instructions: In a pot, bring the stock and potatoes to boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 15 minutes, uncovered. Stir in the leaves, fennel and cornflour. Simmer 5 minutes. Ladle into bowls, and top with fresh lime juice. Serve with bread to soak up the juices.

Random Ingredients: spice,bay leaf,xanthan gum,grape tomato,lemon zest,parmesan cheese
title: Parmesan Cheese Grape Tomatoes With Grapes
ingredients: 3 pounds grape tomatoes | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 2 bay leaves | 1 cup parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons mixed spice
instructions: Wash, and core tomatoes and cut off the ends. Discard the outer papery husks and stems. Slice the tops off, and carefully remove the center. Slice each tomato into 3/4 slices. Place cut side up into a mixing bowl, and place the zest, bay leaves, parmesan cheese, xanthan gum, and mixed spice in, working together. Stir to blend. Divide into 3/4 portions and store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,celery leaf,currant,mustard powder,blueberry,garam masala,rigatoni pasta
title: Rigatoni Con Bleu Cheese,  Not Quite!
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/4 cup crumbled blueberry ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup fresh currants | 1 teaspoon ground roasted mustard powder | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 3 celery leaves | 2 cups rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except pasta and mix well. Put pasta in a large serving bowl and cover with cheese mixture. Serve with warm bread to serve.

title: Homemade Irish Whiskey Broth
ingredients: 6 quarts chicken broth | 3/4 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Pour the chicken broth into a large stainless steel bowl and place over medium heat, making sure to scrape the bottom to loosen the browned bits of food from the bottom. Stir in the irish whiskey and boil 3 to 5 minutes, then remove from the heat and cool to room temperature. Discard any solids left in the bowl. Serve at once.

title: Red Pear & Chive Soup
ingredients: 2 large red pears, peeled, cored and shredded | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1 1/2 liters reduced-fat broth
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Heat till soup is simmering, but do not boil.

Random Ingredients: pecan nut,yellow bell pepper,cayenne pepper,mozzarella cheese
title: Easy English Peppers
ingredients: 1 yellow bell pepper, halved lengthwise and seeded ( or red bell pepper ) | 3/4 lb fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced fairly thinly ( about 8 slices ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup toasted pecan nuts
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place whole pepper halves on an ungreased baking sheet. Broil, turning with tongs, until charred in spots, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand 15 minutes or until slightly softened and cool.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,potato starch,raspberry,vanilla essence,cream tartar,white pepper,dark rum,fish fillet
title: Fricassée à La Niçoise
ingredients: 20 large frozen fish fillets, such as trout, monk fish, cod | 3 kg potato starch | 3 tablespoons cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 2 cups sweet potatoes, ritz or 2 cups malibu rum | 1 1/2 cups dark rum | 1 lb raspberries | 2 -3 saffron strands or 2 -3 saffron pieces | 4 -6 tablespoons rum or 4 -6 tablespoons brandy
instructions: First of all, bring 4 litre water and 4 tbs. Of the potato starch to the boil, add fish fillets and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes. Remove fish, cool and skin and cut into cubes about 4 5. Transfer to a flan dish. Add all remaining ingredients into the pan and fry for about 10 minutes, stirring all the time to prevent sticking. Pour over fish. Bake in oven on top shelf for about 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Serve cold with white wine and warmed jam.

Random Ingredients: orange liqueur,cocoa powder,stevia,chinese five spice powder,eggplant,margarine,green chilies
title: Eggplant Chocolate Chip Cookies (Coxin Nuts)
ingredients: 400 g eggplants, peeled and washed, sliced as thinly as possible | 1 large chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon soybean margarine | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder ( use 1 teaspoons xanthan gum if you can't find this ) | 2 teaspoons orange liqueur or 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 3 green chilies, cut in thin slices | 375 g unsalted margarine, softened | 200 g unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons stevia
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c. Put eggplant slices in a microwave safe bowl and cover. Microwave on high for 3 minutes until very tender, then turn slices over. Microwave for a further 2 minutes on high until the eggplant is softened slightly. Set aside on a paper towel to dry for 2 hours. While the eggplant is cooking, combine the chocolate chips, liqueur or balsamic vinegar and chilies in a large bowl. Using a rubber spatula, melt the margarine in a small saucepan. Put in the 5 spice powder and continue to stir until you see streaks of color at the edges. Turn off heat and add the melted margarine mixture. Use a spoon to stir the chocolate mixture until smooth, adding a little more margarine if necessary to make an emulsified mixture. To form the cookies, press a flat rectangular piece of wax paper onto an oven tray. Smooth out the surface with your finger to form a hole on the middle. Fill the hole with a heaped tablespoon of the chocolate mixtuer mixture. Repeat process with the remaining mixtuer mixture. Dip half of the eggplant slices in the melted chocolate until they are completely covered. Arrange the coated eggplant on the baking tray and bake for 12 - 15 minutes, until eggplant has turned a beautiful golden brown and has a crisp exterior. Take the tray out, remove from oven and leave to sit for 5 minutes. Remove the eggplant to a large plate, cut into cubes, and roll each piece into the chocolate chip biscuit.

title: Penny's Easy Microwave  (Crock Pot) for Microwave
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 package instant vanilla pudding | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 teaspoons green peppers ( optional )
instructions: Combine chicken stock, pudding mix, mace and pepper, if using. Add green pepper, if using. Cook on high 6 minutes.

title: Breadcrumb Crumbs Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup chopped limesade concentrate or 1/4 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1/4 cup semolina
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Add more breadcrumbs if too crumbly. Place on baking sheet and use a brush to coat well. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes stirring after 5 minutes as biscuits should be crisped lightly and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: okra,minestrone soup,hot red pepper flake,ancho chile powder,nutmeg,raspberry preserve,yellow pea
title: Guilt Free Green Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 7 ounces fresh okra or 7 ounces frozen okra | 10 1/2 ounces pre-made minestrone soup | 4 ounces yellow split peas | 8 ounces raspberries in light syrup | 1/4 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 1 pinch ground nutmeg | 2 drops hot red pepper flakes, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Slice the okra or thawed frozen okra into 1 1/2 inch pieces and boil 10 minutes over medium heat until thawed and beginning to soften. Drain and rinse okra, adding to soup along with about half the frozen peas. Dissolve ancho chili powder in 1/4 cup water, add to soup and heat to a boil. Puree the mixture in batches in food processor or blender until smooth. Add remaining frozen peas, raspberries and spices to the soup and heat to a boil. Ladle into soup bowls, garnish with additional frozen okra pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,fine breadcrumb,beef brisket,jalapeno pepper,liquid honey
title: Spicy Onion and Garlic Brisket
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 12 large slices jalapeno peppers ( thick slices ) | 8 large slabs beef brisket, well trimmed | liquid honey ( for brushing )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 13x9 inch glass baking dish with the top crust and butter a few slices of the jalapeno slices in a single layer. Pour half of the soup evenly over the top of the jalapenos and breadcrumbs, trying not to dislodge any of the cheese mixture. Evenly spread the beef brisket with the remaining soup. Sprinkle beef with breadcrumbs, pressing any crumbs into the meat and juices. Spread the slices with honey. Reserve remaining soup for another use. Cover baking dish tightly and refrigerate overnight. Bake beef in oven for 2 hours. Do not uncover pan.

title: Greek-Style Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 6 lbs chicken | 1/2 vanilla bean ( or 2 tablespoons vanilla extract )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325f but not to 350f, and position the rack on the middle shelf in the oven. Place the chicken in a large roasting pan. Insert a paring knife into the thigh section of the thigh from the breast and thigh joint. Tie it with kitchen twine to keep the wings and wings together. Stuff with the vanilla beans. Cover evenly and roast for 3 hours, basting every 15 minutes with the pan juices. The chicken should be golden and crispy. Remove the chicken and roast at 400f for 1 hour. Skim off any fat that rises to the surface. Slice into thick pieces and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Mexican Garden Vegetable Juice
ingredients: 2 zucchini, halved lengthwise | 2 medium tomatoes, halved | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 can vegetable juice cocktail | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup molasses
instructions: Place zucchini halves and tomatoes on a large rimmed baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 400 degrees f oven until tomatoes are soft and tomatoes have begun to soften, about 15 minutes. Transfer zucchini to a blender. Add all vegetables and cocktail juice.

title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 2 cups fat-free beef broth | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 ounce mexican chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: In a medium pan saute garlic in beef broth for 2 to 3 minutes. Add coriander and half and cream. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until reduced by a half. Add mexican chocolate and stir until melted.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,celery seed,egg white,date,carrot,elbow macaroni,fennel seed
title: Chinese New Year Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1/2 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 carrot, sliced | 1/2 cup dry dates, sliced | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: In a wok, combine shrimp, celery seed, fennel seed and carrot slices. Add 1/2 cup water and stir until shrimp are just cooked. Remove shrimp mixture from wok. Add oyster sauce and cook until carrots are tender crisp. Toss in macaroni and let stand 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Baked Veal Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vodka | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 2 tablespoons chocolate squares, finely chopped | 2 lbs beef stew meat
instructions: Place vodka, tomato puree and chocolate in a shallow bowl or roaster. Add meat in ziplock bag. Marinate in refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight. Remove meat from bag and discard marinade. Place in a dutch oven and cover with cold water. Heat to boiling. Reduce head size. Cover and simmer gently for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until meat is done.

title: Melting Melts in Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups diced unpeeled cantaloupe | 16 ounces ditalini
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place melted melters in a 9x13 inch baking dish or deep baking dish and toss with pasta. Cover with foil. Bake for 40 minutes in preheated oven. Remove from oven and let sit for 10 minutes. Stir pasta and melted melsters to mix. Cover with more pasta if desired.

title: Easy Salsa
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon dried fennel seed | 1 tablespoon chipotle salsa ( mild or hot | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, ground fine
instructions: Heat oven to mix all ingredients. Spread on toast. Use immediately, store in an airtight container. To prepare, crush lightly. Use as a condiment to dip chips.

title: Easy Pizza
ingredients: bread, sliced and toasted | ketchup | tomato sauce | 2 slices baguette
instructions: Spread a small amount of ketchup on each slice of baguette. Top with tomato sauce, and a little bit of bread. Top with remaining bread slices, and enjoy.

title: Rose Petals (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 2 corn tortillas | 1 rose petal ( or other fresh, finely chopped rosemary ) | ice
instructions: Take your rose petals and put them on a large platter. Brush with some a healthy amount of olive oil, and sprinkle some with the rose salt. Wrap a piece of plastic wrap around each rose petal and serve.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,red wine,coriander,chocolate chip,green chili pepper
title: Spicy Chile Brownies
