ingredients: 200 g sweetened chocolate chips | 1/3 cup coriander ( finely chopped, aka cilantro ) | 1/4 cup green chili pepper, finely chopped ( or use a green jalapeno ) | 2 teaspoons soya sauce | 2 teaspoons red wine
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°c or 300°f. Place melted chocolate, coriander, chilli pepper and soya sauce in a bowl. Mix together well using a spoon or finger. Mixture should be fairly liquid. Roll chilled mixture into balls or small triangles. Place on a non stick baking tray and bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to cool slightly in fridge. Cut brownies into quarters and store in an airtight container.

title: Balsamic Glaze for Salami
ingredients: 4 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 6 thick slices bacon, cut diagonally into 3 pieces
instructions: Put the bacon pieces into a skillet over medium heat, and cook until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Drain the bacon slices on a paper towel lined plate. Preheat the broiler, or set the oven temperature to broil. Brush the slices generously with the balsamic vinegar, then transfer to a baking sheet. Broil, cut sides up, for just a few minutes, until browned. Allow to cool slightly before slicing into squares.

title: Spinach and Pimento Casserole
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped, divided | 1 can mexicorn, drained
instructions: Combine spinach, pimientos and 1/2 can of the pimento sauce. Spread spinach mixture into 2 quart baking dish. Top with remaining pimento sauce. Bake 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Quickie Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup semolina flour | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 package wide egg noodles
instructions: Heat a large, deep skillet over medium high heat. Gradually whisk semolina flour into hot skillet, and stir with a wooden spoon until the mixture just begins to bubble and turn a light golden color. Cook and stir 1 minute, and discard any lumps. Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes more, and remove from heat. Pour cooked pasta into a bowl, and set aside. Meanwhile, mix together onion powder and onion powder in a bowl, and set aside 3 tablespoons of this mixture for later use. Sprinkle remaining mixture over pasta, and toss to coat. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until flavors are blended, and serve with croutons or fresh fruit.

title: Pork and Cashew (Indian Breakfast)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons light unsalted cashew butter, melted | 1 lb lean boneless lean pork, cut into strips | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, shredded ( or other favorite cheese ) | 1 apple, halved, cored and thinly sliced
instructions: Sauté meat in cashew butter until lightly browned. Add asafoetida, cook until well browned, stir to keep meat from sticking to the bottom of pan. Add cheese, stirring until cheese is melted and bubbly. Arrange sliced apple on top, serve.

Random Ingredients: beer,beef bouillon powder,rice,dark rum,salsa verde,fenugreek seed,soy sauce
title: Korean Beef Bowl
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark rum | 3 1/2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons fresh fenugreek seeds ( kochi seeds ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons boronzu seasoning 1/2 cups beer | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon powder, dissolved in 1/2 cup water ( or 1 tsp. sugar ) | 3 cups cooked rice | 2 cups prepared salsa verde | 1/4 cup minced fresh fenugreek seeds ( kochi seeds )
instructions: Combine rum, soy sauce, fenugreek, beer, and bouillon in a medium bowl and set aside. In a hot nonstick skillet, toast kochi seeds until lightly browned, about 1 minute. Stir constantly until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add rum mixture and cook for 1 minute. Stir through cooked rice and pour into bowls.

Random Ingredients: lemon,rye bread,cherry,red wine,onion powder,milk greek yogurt,tamari,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Saurannah's French Onion Bake
ingredients: 1 bag rye bread | 12 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded ( about 3 cups ) | 1 pint cherry or 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved | 1 cup sweet red wine | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, grated | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon tamari | 1 cup low-fat milk greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly spray 9 x 13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Mix bread together in a medium bowl, sprinkle with half each of the cheese until well coated. Spread bread mixture over the bottom of the dish and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until the cheese is lightly brown and bubbly. Meanwhile, combine grape tomatoes, wine, lemon rind, onion powder, and tamari in a bowl and set aside. Stir the warm tomato mixture and milk mixture into the bread mixture. Sprinkle yogurt down the the sides of the dish. Bake another 30 min or until the mixture is slightly crisp on the top.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,halibut fillet,spinach leaf,saffron thread,sage,sesame oil
title: Fish Stuffed With Saffron and Fresh Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups short-grain white rice, rinsed | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads, crushed | 8 saffron threads, softened in 1 tablespoon of the lard | 8 tablespoons minced fresh sage, divided | 2 lbs halibut fillets, with skin on, pin bones removed | 3 cups fresh spinach leaves, stems removed | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Rinse the rice until the water is no longer cloudy. Transfer the rice to a medium size bowl. Add 1/4 teaspoon of the salt and the saffron threads, toss to combine, and let sit for 15 minutes. Rinse the fish under cold water and pat dry. In a small bowl, combine the softened saffron and 3 tablespoons of the sage. Season the fish generously with the remaining 1 tablespoon salt. Pat the fish dry and set aside. Using a large spoon, carefully transfer the rice to a large, wide platter. Using the spoon, nestle the fish in the rice and mound the spinach in the center. Spread the saffron mixture evenly over the fish. Drape the remaining 2 tablespoons of sage over the spinach. Warr the platter in a large kitchen cabinet with a tight fitting lid and set over a bowl in an east direction of the plate. Place a dinner plate on the platter and set aside. Gently transfer the platter to the rice to collect excess liquid around it. In another large skillet, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of the sage over moderate heat until just black. Pour 2 tablespoons of the oil from the plate and set it over medium heat. Add the fish and cook until golden brown and flaky on one side, about 3 minutes. Turn the fish over and repeat, using a slotted spoon to transfer it to the platter. Scatter the spinach over the fish and serve at once. Note, this fish will also be served with any other cooked vegetable. Saffron flavored rice recipe variation, replace the saffron threads with 2 tablespoons of hot pepper sauce and 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,ricotta cheese,lump crabmeat,bean sprout
title: Dieter's Cannelloni
ingredients: 10 ounces canned great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 15 ounces canned lump crabmeat or 15 ounces surimi | 1 package whole-milk ricotta cheese | 2 bags bean sprouts
instructions: Rinse beans and crab meat well, if necessary, and add to bean sprouts. In a 9x13 inch, oven proof casserole dish, spread ricotta to cover surface. Drop bean sprouts into beans, and sprinkle with salt to taste. Add a layer of crab meat over the ricotta, and top with bean sprouts. Bake at 400 degrees f for 40 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage link,cauliflower floret,roasting chicken,steak,malt vinegar,mirin
title: Chicken Adobaki (Porizo-Style Cauliflower)
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower floret, cut into 6 wedges | 1/2 pound sweet italian sausage links, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1/2 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 2 teaspoons crumbled dried steak seasoning ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons pickled cauliflower flakes, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange cauliflower in a steamer basket over boiling water.

Random Ingredients: chive onion cream cheese,spice,cellophane noodle,lime peel,limeade concentrate
title: Chili Lime Noodles and Peanut Butter
ingredients: 2 packages cellophane noodles | 1 container chive & onion cream cheese | 1 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1 teaspoon lime peel, finely shredded | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain, and rinse with cold water. Combine cream cheese, limeade concentrate, and lime peel in bowl, blending with a mixer until smooth. Add noodles and mix well. Serve with dipping sauces.

title: Toucan Potatoes & Parsnips
ingredients: 1 baking potato, peeled & chunked | 3 parsnips, peeled and chunked | 1 can mixed vegetables, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 farenheit. Put potatoes, carrots, parsnips & vegetables in a 9x13 casserole dish. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove vegetables to a plate, drizzle with more oil & sprinkle with salt to taste. Enjoy.

title: Zesty Dip With Lime
ingredients: 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 2 teaspoons lime juice ( zest of 1 lime ) | 3/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients. To make dip,. Put in small glass bowl, or toaster oven to warm oven to 375f degrees, about 30 to 35 minutes. Do not stir until completely room temperature.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,serrano chili,spanish onion,ginger,cotija cheese,double cream,jalapeno,wheat flour
title: Homemade Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 spanish onion | 1 1/2 serrano chili | 4 cups whole wheat flour | 2 -3 tablespoons double cream | 8 ounces canned enchilada sauce | 6 -8 ounces diced canned jalapenos | 1 ounce grated cotija cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Place everything into food processor. Pulse in batches until fairly smooth, and chill for a few hours before using. If freezing, wait until the ingredients come out very cold and chill for 4 - 6 hours. You can also just use an immersion blender with the onion, chilli, flour and cream and pulse on low for 10 - 12 minutes, pulsing at 10 - 20 times. The sauce should be thinner than cream, but thinner and hotter as opposed to chili. If serving the next day, leave out or refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,chili bean,chicken bouillon cube,salmon steak,cider vinegar
title: Thai Chili Salmon
ingredients: 1/4 cup reduced-fat peanut butter | 1/4 cup chopped canned chili beans | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 lbs salmon steaks
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the peanut butter, water and chili bean mix. Place the fish in a baking dish and pour peanut butter mixture over.

title: Irish Beef and Potato Stromas
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 can crescent dinner rolls | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 potatoes, peeled and chopped
instructions: Brown meat. Add fennel seed and potatoes. Pinch seams. Cook til golden brown.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,hot chili sauce,peanut butter,italian sausage,parmesan cheese,raisin,garlic,kosher salt
title: Korean Inspired Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 lb hot italian sausage, removed from casings | 4 tablespoons korean chili sauce ( gochujang ) | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 4 tablespoons raisins ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons garlic, minced | kosher salt | 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: In a bowl place all ingredients except for the beef and cheese. Add beef and mix well. Taste the broth and add more of any of the ingredients to your liking.

title: Greek Marshmallow Appetizer
ingredients: 2 packages greek marshmallows | 4 cups plain greek yogurt | 1 1/4 cups orange marmalade | 1/4 cup macadamia nuts, finely chopped, toasted
instructions: Line an ungreased 1 1/2 quart baking dish with greased foil, leaving about a 1 1/2 inch overhang. With a sharp knife, evenly spread 1 pkg. M marshmallows over the foil in a thin layer. Repeat with remaining marshmallows. Place in the center of the prepared baking dish. Whisk together yoghurt and marmalade in a small bowl and pour over marshmallow mixture. Cover with plastic wrap, pressing the plastic wrap directly onto the marshmallow. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or up to 3 days. When ready to serve, remove the marshmallow and keep in an airtight container at room temperature uncovered for up to 1 day.

title: Fakhitha Bel Laban (Yogurt With Glazed Salmon)
ingredients: saffron, crushed | 4 lbs fresh salmon fillets | 2 yellow onions, finely diced | 2 cups plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary, plus more | rosemary, for garnishing ( optional ) | 1 medium cucumbers or 1 medium english cucumber ( 1/2 to 1/4 inch slices ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place the saffron in a mortar, add a handful of cold water, and pound to a pestle with a grinding attachment. Arrange the salmon fillets, skin side down, in a roasting pan. In a small bowl, mix 1/2 of the onion and the yoghurt together and rub it onto the fish. Sprinkle the salmon with chopped rosemary, and sprinkle with saffron and 1/2 cup of the reserved onion and yogurt mixture. Roast in a 400° oven for 20 minutes, or until very tender. Garnish with sliced cucumbers and extra sprigs of rosemary or fresh thyme. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,apple cider vinegar,taco seasoning,red capsicum,sage
title: Red Capsicum Dip
ingredients: 1 red capsicum | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Peel and dice red bell pepper. Mix all together in bowl. Cover and chill, covered. Serve with other suggested accompaniments. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,sea salt black pepper,bell pepper,white pepper,tap water,hungarian paprika,saffron,rice flour
title: Spanish Pepper and Gruyère Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tap water | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon hungarian sweet paprika | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 pinch powdered saffron, or to taste | 1/4 cup white pepper | 1 cup gruyere cheese, grated | freshly grated parmesan cheese to taste | sea salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Lightly grease an 8 inch round or other oval casserole dish with some of the saffron oil. Bring 1 1/2 cup tap water, 1/2 teaspoon saffron, gilepimenton, white pepper, and 1 1/4 cup white pepper to a boil in a small saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat, stir in remaining white pepper with some saffron oil drippings, white pepper, and gruyère, and season with a pinch of sea salt and pepper. Pour contents of bubbling tap water into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven until top is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into center of the cake comes out dry, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tahini,golden caster sugar,cilantro,salsa,black bean,tomato soup,sea scallop
title: Mexican Spicy Scallops - Go for it!
ingredients: 1 jar salsa | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/3 cup golden caster sugar | 1 tablespoon tahini | 2 1/2 lbs sea scallops | 1/2 cup finely chopped cilantro, plus extra for garnish | 1/2 cup bottled chopped cilantro
instructions: Place the tomatoes, sugar, tahini, sambal and 1/3 c of the cilantro into a saucepan. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 6 - 8 minutes or until thick and syrupy. Preheat the grill to high. Cook the scallops on the hot grill, cut side down, for 3 - 4 minutes. Lift the scallops out of the saucepan and place them on a warmed serving platter. Spoon over the sauce, sprinkle with the remaining 1/3 c c of cilantro and serve hot.

title: Linguine with Veal and White Wine
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1 can v8 vegetable juice | 1 teaspoon white wine | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling water until al dente.

title: Chickpea and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 400 g chickpeas, rinsed and well drained | 1 english cucumber | 1 celery rib, chopped
instructions: Halve cucumber lengthways and scoop out seeds with a teaspoon. Rinse and drain chickpeas then place into a serving bowl. Cut cucumber in half and squeeze out excess liquid. Cut chickpeas into slices, place on top of eggplant and scatter celery over. Drizzle dressing over salad and toss gently.

title: Aromatic Herbed Arborio Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup arborio rice | 3/4 cup mixed fresh herbs
instructions: Rinse the rice under running water until the water runs clear. In a large bowl, combine the rice and herbs, using 3/4 cup water as needed to moisten. Place the rice onto a plate, cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Cheryl's Mushrooms With Goat's Cheese and Mint
ingredients: 12 tablespoons goat's cheese | 24 medium mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms thoroughly. Clean your hands and cut them in half. Take a small piece of goat's cheese and spread it thinly on the mushrooms. Wash your hands, and cut them in long, narrow sections. Take a teaspoon or a tablespoon of goat's cheese and spread it lightly over the mushroom. Put a small piece of mushroom onto the goat's cheese and repeat steps 3 and 4 to make 4 smaller mushrooms. Arrange the mushrooms on a serving plate and sprinkle a little mint powder over the mushrooms. Serve warm.

title: Steamed Whole Halibut With Mushrooms and Shiitake
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/4 lb shiitake mushrooms | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 zucchini, sliced to about 1/4 inch | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 1/2 lbs halibut fillets, cut into serving portions
instructions: Slice shiitake mushrooms. Brown hamburger in a wok and cook mushrooms in oil until dark. Add zucchini and mushroom mixture. Add bouillon, lower heat. Cover and let simmer for 15 minutes. Uncover and cook for an additional 3 - 4 minutes to thicken the sauce. Serve the halibut on a large plate with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: french bread,provolone cheese,monosodium glutamate,fish,green capsicum,skirt steak
title: Baked Fish for Two
ingredients: 1 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( msg ) | 2 teaspoons fish or 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 kg piece caribou snails | 4 pieces swiss cheese or 4 pieces cheese cheese sticks | 3 -4 thick slices french bread | 3 -5 pieces green capsicum
instructions: Pre heat oven to moderate. Place a large oven dish in oven for about 10 minutes to warm up. Place fish in dish and sprinkle with msg and oil. Place 4 pieces of cheese on each piece of cheese and place the piece of cheese on top. Spread about 2 - 3 tbsp of water around fish to moisten and coat. Take pieces of bread and lay on baking sheet with the bread. Sprinkle with a little salt and bake for about 10 to 15 minutes or until toasted and golden brown. Place green capsicum on top of fish and serve. Serve with mashed potatoes or green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate juice,balsamic vinegar,cannellini bean,green bell pepper,curry powder
title: Moroccan-Style White Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 5 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 large green bell pepper, julienned | 1 tablespoon pomegranate juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small saucepan and simmer on medium heat, stirring occasionally, 5 - 10 minutes or until vegetables are soft and sauce begins to thicken slightly. Discard green bell pepper.

title: Carla's Easy Roast Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs stewing beef | 1 celery rib, with leaves | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Tast like you would do for a roast. Let stand an hour in refrigerator before slicing.

title: Fiesta-Orange Spread
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 orange, zested
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Mix together the taco seasoning mix with orange zest. Spread about 1/3 of the orange zest over the aluminum foil. Spread about 1/3 of the taco seasoning mix over the orange zest. Then spread 1/3 of the orange zest over the taco seasoning mix. Repeat layers twice more, and continue to spread the taco seasoning mix over and around the edges with your fingers. Wrap aluminum foil loosely around the aluminum and place on the baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until the orange sections begin to soften, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Grilled Chicken (Gebhardt Roti)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet sherry wine or 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 4 tablespoons hot red pepper paste, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients and pour over chicken. Marinate for 6 hours, turning chicken over once or twice to coat. Grill or broil chicken until desired doneness and topping is browned and crusty.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,mozzarella cheese,garlic,dripping,plain nonfat yogurt,stewing beef,asadero cheese,parsley
title: Rick's Beef Cheese Baked in Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cubed or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cubed | 3 tablespoons drippings | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 2 teaspoons minced parsley | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 pint plain nonfat yogurt | 1 vanilla bean | 1/4 cup drippings | 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic | 2 teaspoons minced parsley | 1 teaspoon minced parsley
instructions: In a medium size pot saute the meat with the drippings until browned. Add the chopped garlic, parsley, cheese, and half the parsley. Cover and cook over low heat for 3 hours. Drain beef and cheese mixture well. In a medium size bowl add, yoghurt, vanilla bean and drippings, garlic, and other parsley. Mix well. Pour mixture into oven proof crock pot or baking dish. Preheat oven to 325°f. Place remaining parsley on top. Place into oven and bake for 30 minutes, basting oxtail several times throughout baking.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,grain rice,red kidney bean,asafoetida powder,white flour,broccoli
title: Rice Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet red kidney beans ( also called black kidney beans ) | 1/2 cup broccoli | 1/4 cup whole grain rice | 1 cup corn flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 pinch white flour ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Place all of the above ingredients into a saucepan and cook for half an hour. You should have the vegetables soft and liquidy.. Place mixture into a colander and cool. You can add sugar, spices if desired to taste, or salt to taste. You can also add a fresh curry or ketchup.

title: Shahi Mowr (Indian Rice - Simple Version)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green peas | 2 tablespoons cherry peppers or 2 tablespoons cayenne pepper, crushed | 2 tablespoons canned tomatoes, roughly chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked rice | 1 red chile, coarsely sliced
instructions: Place the peas in a saucepan.

title: Linguini With Pistachios and Chicken Wings
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | 12 tablespoons pistachios | black pepper | 3 packages linguine
instructions: Cook pasta per instruction on the package. Remove wings from the pouch, reserving 1/2 cup of the sauce. Rinse chicken from pouch, discard pouch, and pat dry with paper towels. Rinse and dry pistachios with paper towels. Sprinkle both sides of the chicken wings with salt and pepper. Grill the chicken 5 minutes on each side. Turn the wings and close the lid. Grill another 5 minutes or until done. Remove from heat. While chicken is grilling, place pistachios on a cutting board, and roll them into small sticks. Place on a serving plate and use as directed on package for the noodle.

title: Green Beans II
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fresh green beans, rinsed and trimmed | 1 tablespoon cornstarch or milk
instructions: Place beans in a saucepan along with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer until tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain and set aside. Dissolve cornstarch in milk with just enough water to make a smooth paste. When ready to serve, return green beans and cornstarch mixture to pan, and cook until heated through.

title: Chinese Snow Pea Soup (Chaw Gung)
ingredients: 1 lb snow peas | 8 ounces kielbasa, cut into bite-size slices | 1/2 cup canned broth | 12 ounces superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: To make the soup, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add snow peas and cook until just crisp tender, about 2 to 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and immediately transfer to a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking process. Pour soup into a medium bowl and set aside. Place the kielbasa into a large skillet over medium high heat and cook, stirring constantly until browned and cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer the kielbasa to the bowl with the soup and stir to combine. Add the snow peas with their juices, broth, sugar and soy sauce to the soup. Cook, stirring and cooking until the soup comes to a boil and is heated through, about 5 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Avokado Aka Avocodo Beans
ingredients: 2 cans low sodium bertolli beans ( in light syrup with garlic and sugar ) | 2 plum tomatoes | 12 spears asparagus ( about 4-10 spears ) | 10 spears arugula | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise or 2 tablespoons miracle whip | 2 tablespoons vodka | 2 sprigs coriander | 1 head asparagus, ends trimmed
instructions: Drain the beans and transfer to serving bowl. Cut the tomatoes in half, remove the seeds, and cut into about 2 wedges. Remove the flesh from the asparagus, and cut into about 2 triangles. Remove and discard the asparagus tips. Rinse and dry the asparagus. Add the asparagus to the bean mix. Whisk up the mayo/miracle whip with the vodka, and pour over the asparagus. Mix up the coriander, then add salt and pepper to taste. Serve asap.

title: Blueberry French Toast
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 12 slices rye bread | 1 cup fresh blueberries
instructions: Pour milk into a bowl and stir in the rye bread and blueberries. Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to bake make sure your oven is preheated to 350 degrees and remove the cover and continue to bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown and sourdough bread is warmed through. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Mushroom Caps in Caramelized Carrots
ingredients: 8 button mushroom caps, trimmed | 4 carrots, peeled and sliced into ribbons 1/2-inch thick | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme sprig
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place mushrooms in a 9x9 inch baking dish. Add carrots to mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: mineral water,white onion,sauce,icing sugar,red potato,zucchini,miso,cumin seed
title: Zucchini Salad
ingredients: 12 small red potatoes | 2 white onions | 6 small zucchini | 3 cloves unpeeled sweet italian sweet sausage | 1/4 cup mixed salad oil or 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 tablespoons miso | 2/3 cup mineral water | 2 tablespoons icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Boil the potatoes in lightly salted water until tender, about 15 minutes, then drain and cool. Dice the onions. Peel the zucchini, onions and sweet italian sweet sausage, then slice diagonally into about 5 mm/3 inches/8 inch slices. Combine all the salad ingredients in a large bowl or ziploc bag and mix well. In a small jar or cup, add the sauerkraut, miso paste, mineral water and the sugar. Shake well, then shake again so the dressing is combined. Pour the dressing over the salad and stir gently to combine. Cover the bowl or bag and store in the refrigerator a few hours or overnight. To serve, shake the salad and place on a serving platter. Sprinkle with the icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: banana,collard green,apricot,yellow squash,marinara sauce,lemon wedge,red chili pepper,fish fillet
title: Quick-Fix Fish Portocino
ingredients: 500 g fish fillets, cut into chunks | 4 cups prepared marinara sauce | 1 1/2 cups banana slices | 1 large yellow squash, cut into slices | 1 small red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 cup collard greens, trimmed and coarsely torn | lemon wedge, to serve
instructions: Put the fish chunks in a large bowl and put a couple of pats of olive oil in the middle of the fish. Sprinkle with a little salt and pepper and turn over to coat both sides. Leave to marinate for at least 20 minutes. Meanwhile, stir together the marinated fish and the marinara sauce in a large saucepan and bring to the boil. Transfer the fish to a large heavy based frying pan with the banana, squash and chile and cook gently for 7 - 8 minutes or until the bananas are just tender, tossing and adjusting the seasoning if necessary. Stir in the collards and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Simple Microwave Rice - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | 2 1/2 cups water
instructions: Combine rice and water in a microwave safe bowl. Turn on the microwave, cover and microwave on high, until the rice is tender, about 50 minutes. Let cool.

title: Chinese Watermelon and Orange Sambal
ingredients: 2 cups seedless watermelon, chopped | 2 bunches green chili, cut into 2 inch segments | 1/3 cup szechuan peppercorns, cracked | 1 orange, peeled, sectioned and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 4 tablespoons baking soda
instructions: Place sliced watermelon in a glass bowl. Arrange the chiles on top of the watermelon. Sprinkle with pepper and press sesame seeds slightly into the surface of the chilies and chillies. Stir in orange slices and pour about 1 1/2 cups of water in the bottom of a saucepan. Sprinkle baking soda over fruit, bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer, tightly covered, until tender, 25 to 30 minutes. The watermelon can also be served as an accompaniment for roasted pork or other meat dishes.

title: Sweet Potato Ketchup
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 container ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 cup shredded yukon gold potatoes
instructions: Place the pineapple with its juice, ketchup, ricotta cheese, and cinnamon into a medium stock pot. Mix in the yukon gold potatoes, and mix and heat the mixture to a simmer.

Random Ingredients: sambal oelek,cooking spray,plain nonfat yogurt,thai red chili pepper,shoulder lamb chop,nutmeg,apple,red chili powder
title: Shoulder Lamb Chops (Chops) on White Flour
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sambal oelek ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons grated fresh nutmeg | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 large fresh red thai red chili pepper | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 lb shoulder lamb chop, cut into 1-inch wide strips | 1 large apple, peeled, cored, quartered, and thinly sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, combine sambal oelek and nutmeg. Combine yogurt and chile pepper in a small bowl. Spray a heavy nonstick skillet with cooking spray, add lamb and stir fry until a golden brown color.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,fennel seed,rotini noodle,dark chocolate chip,beer,daikon radish,poblano pepper,coffee
title: Fennel Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark chocolate chips | 3 tablespoons brewed coffee | 12 ounces beer | 1 teaspoon crushed fennel seed, divided | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 -2 tablespoon freshly grated daikon radish | 1 small poblano pepper, quartered ( fresh or canned, or roasted, diced ) | 1 package rotini noodles
instructions: Melt dark chocolate chips, stir in 1 t tea mixture and 2 t coffee. Set aside. Combine 1 tsp cardamom, 2/3 t coffee, 1tsp fennel seeds, and 1/4 c japanese radish in a 2 qt saucepan. Place over high heat, cook 1 minute. Add poblano and remaining cardamom. Cook 1 minute, stir in remaining 1/2 cup teh coffee. Add hot chocolate mixture and stir. Stir in noodles. Place over medium low heat, cook 30 seconds. Immediately cover, remove lid and let stand, 5 - 10 minutes, until noodles are soft. Turn off heat, stir, and leave covered for 5 more minutes.

title: Avocado Eggplant (Aubergine) Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 lb linguine, broken into 1/2 in. boil and drained | 1 medium eggplant, sliced to the 1/4 in. thickness, then thinly sliced crosswise 3/4 in. thick | 1 fennel bulb, thinly sliced | 2 avocados, cut int 1/4 inch slices ( optional ) | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Sirloin
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs sirloin | 1 1/2 lbs potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 lb prosciutto | 3 -4 pears, diced in medium dice ( depends on how much juice you like ) | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons rosemary ( crushed ) | 2 1/2 cups uncooked long-grain white rice ( or long grain sushi rice ) | 1 1/2 cups pear juice or 1 1/2 cups reduced-sodium canned pears
instructions: Trim the meat of any visible fat and any excess fat. Stack them and slice 3/8 inch thick. Cut the prosciutto into 1 inch strips. Cut the potatoes into 1 1/2 x 1 1/2 inch slices and divide among 4 dinner plates. Slice the pears into 1/4 inch thick strips and evenly scatter over the vegetables. Heat the sesame oil in a pot over high heat until a bead of water sizzles. Add the sesame seeds and rosemary. Toss in the meat, making sure it is well coated. Brown the meat on all sides on both sides, stirring occasionally. Arrange the meat on top of the potato, proscuitto, and pears, then cover with the rice. Add the pear juice or juice from the drained can.

title: Spaghetti Squash with Serrano Sauce
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, halved and seeded | 3 serrano peppers, seeded and minced
instructions: Fill a large pot with water, and bring to a boil. Stir in the spaghetti squash, reduce heat, and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and place in a large bowl. Toss with serrano peppers. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,pork sparerib,mustard powder,brown sugar,swiss cheese,self rising flour,plain yogurt,flat leaf parsley
title: Cheesy Brown Sugar Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup natural yogurt ( or sour cream ) | 1/2 cup soft brown sugar | 2 lbs country-style pork spareribs | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Combine flour, yogurt, brown sugar and mustard paste. Place all ingredients through sieve into large, shallow, heavy sided bowl. Coat spareribs with rub.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,coriander seed,thyme sprig,pepperoni,honey mustard,lettuce,grape tomato
title: Grape Tomato Salad & Pepperoni Dip
ingredients: 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved | 1/3 cup finely chopped salami or 1/3 cup pepperoni | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh coriander seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 jar grape tomatoes, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon water chestnut, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon honey mustard | 1/4 cup finely chopped lettuce
instructions: Combine all the ingredients, except the salad, in a large salad bowl. Cover and chill at least 2 hours or overnight. Uncover and gently fold in the lettuce. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: strawberry preserve,nori,espresso powder,crescent dinner,snow pea,balsamic vinegar,pine nut
title: Balsamic and Strawberry Empanadas
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1/2 cup melted nori | 2 packages frozen miniature snow peas | 2/3 cup strawberry preserves | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2/3 cup brewed espresso powder | 2/3 cup finely chopped toasted pine nuts
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove 1 can biscuit dough from pouch, seal pouch tightly, and place in a small pan. Combine remaining biscuit dough, melted nori, frozen peas, strawberry preserves, and balsamic vinegar in a small bowl and place on a cookie sheet. Bake approximately 10 to 12 minutes, until golden and crisp. Spoon a scant 1/2 tablespoon of jam into center of each cookie. Place 1 biscuit dough in center of each cookie. Bake an additional 5 minutes, until golden.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese,asafoetida powder,cheese,chicken thigh,horseradish,cornstarch,pepper
title: Cheese Crusted Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs | 2 tablespoons horseradish ( i used creole ) | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons yellow onions, diced | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine butter, horseradish, and grated cheese and mash together thoroughly to form a paste. Sprinkle diced onions over a cookie sheet and set aside. Place chicken thighs in a small single layer on cookie sheet, skin side down. Sprinkle chicken pieces with flour and a pinch of asafoetida and pepper. Spread the horseradish butter mixture evenly on the thighs and place in oven. Bake for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: malibu rum,confectioner ' sugar,breadcrumb,taco sauce,bulk pork sausage
title: Southern Style Italian Sausage
ingredients: 2 links bulk pork sausage | 2 teaspoons instant malibu rum | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a large, heavy skillet, cook the sausage, breaking it up with a fork, until no longer pink, 8 - 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Pour off most of the fat. Sprinkle with rum, then stir in bread crumbs and taco sauce. Using a wooden spoon, stir until coated. Let sit 1 minute. Sprinkle with sugar.

title: Pasta Shells With Mexican Cheese and Coconut
ingredients: 6 large pasta shells | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese, divided and divided | 1/4 cup grated coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees in a baking dish with a lid, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add half of the shellfish to the boiling water. Continue boiling for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the shells are cooked fully. Drain and set aside. Place the remaining shellfish into the boiling water. When the shells are cold and the fish flakes with a fork, remove the shellfish to a large bowl. Add half of the cheese, half of the coconut, half of the remaining cheese and half of the cooked and drained shellfish. Mix all together and coat well with the remaining cheese. Place in the oven and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the topping is lightly browned. Note, if the top layer is not sufficiently browned, you may need to sprinkle a little more cheese on top of the cheese to give it a golden brown color.

title: Tasty Mushroom and Pepper Parcels
ingredients: 4 -6 mushroom caps | 5 ounces oats | 3/4 cup strong tea | 5 1/2 ounces garlic paste | parsley, for spinkling
instructions: Soak 8 - 12 hole parcels in hot water for 5 mins or until tender, then drain and set aside. Dip mushrooms in tea and put back into the steamer with the other two, and continue to steam until tender. Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to the boil. Taste for seasoning, adjust if necessary and serve on a plate with lots of parsley sprinkled over the top.

title: Crushed Corn Balls
ingredients: 300 g corn flakes | 500 g brandy or 500 g sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 200 g unsweetened cocoa ( preferably dutch-processed )
instructions: Line baking tray with greaseproof paper and preheat oven to 220ºc/450ºf. Put the corn flakes in a small bowl, cover and leave until the corn appears dry. Rinse and dry the corn flakes. If using sherry, bring to a boil without stirring. Cover and reduce the temperature to a slow simmer. Keep stirring for about 3 - 5 minutes, until the sherry evaporates and the sugar dissolves. In a small bowl, mix the mustard and cocoa. Using a teaspoon, scoop out as many of the corn flake mixture as you can. Add to the sherry mixture and mix, then divide between 1 serving bowls or ice trays and use to roll up a little. Place the cones on prepared sheets and put the tray in the oven and cook for about 15 minutes or until very lightly set and crisp.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,pork shoulder,sauerkraut,soya sauce,wheat germ,parsley,italian breadcrumb
title: Crock Pot Jjasmine Pork & Sauerkraut Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 4 or 6 thin diagonal slices | 12 tablespoons sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 tablespoon jasmine rice or 1 tablespoon arborio rice, uncooked | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
instructions: Place pork in crock pot, and add sauerkraut, bread crumbs, soy sauce, rice, and 2 tbls. Of the parsley. Mix well, making sure pork is well blended. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours, or on high 4 - 5 hours. Sprinkle remaining 1 tbsp. Peanut butter or cashews on meat during last hour of cooking to moisten. Serve on buns as an entree or topping with potatoes, vegetables, or bread. Can also make in advance, reheat in oven, covered and heated through at 350 degrees or in crock pot 30 minutes at keep warm in oven until needed. This recipe is great served over cooked rye bread or french bread with parmesan cheese on top. Serve with rye bread.

title: Spaghetti With Hazelnuts and Pesto, Low Fat
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry, defrosted | 1 1/2 cups low fat roasted hazelnuts | 1 lb spaghetti | 1 tablespoon grapefruit juice | 1/3 cup low fat pesto sauce | 1 1/2 cups shredded lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut pastry dough in half, then roll out each half of dough to 5 inches across on an ungreased cookie sheet or pizza pan. Spread the pastry with 1 1/2 cups hazelnuts. Bake in preheated oven for 5 minutes, then remove from oven and allow to cool. Boil the pasta following the package directions, drain. Combine grapefruit juice and pesto in a small bowl. Set aside 2 tablespoons of this simple dressing and stir in the hazelnuts. Add more to taste. Pour the pasta into a mixing bowl and mix with pesto. Add lettuce, tossing well. Spoon pasta into lined pastry case and cover with hazelnut dressing. Press lightly with the bottom of a glass, if using a pizza pan. Bake on center rack of oven for 10 minutes, then lower heat to 400f and bake an additional 5 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Garlic Chicken and Broccoli Stew
ingredients: 1 frying chickens, cut-up | 24 whole fresh baby shrimp, halved ( can substitute with other seafood shrimp ) | 1 bag frozen broccoli, defrosted | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 fresh tomatoes, sliced | 1 bag frozen cut bertolli beans, thawed | crusty bread, for dipping | sprinkle ( optional ) | sprinkle ( optional )
instructions: Arrange chicken in the bottom of a crockpot. Cover with shrimp, and sprinkle with chopped vegetables. Cover with beans, tomatoes, and bertolli. Cook on low until chicken is very tender, 5 to 8 hours.

title: Saurza's Spicy Shrimp
ingredients: 2 pounds uncooked large shrimp, peeled | 1 serrano pepper, sliced thin, or more as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place shrimp onto a baking sheet, season with salt, and lightly coat with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until shrimp are browned, about 10 minutes, then remove from heat and split the shrimp diagonally into halves. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat until lightly browned. Cook and stir serrano pepper slices in the hot skillet until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Toss shrimp with serrano chile pepper half.

title: Creamy Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 large cabbage | butter | 1/4 cup raspberry syrup ( or syrup of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 4 small teaspoons cocoa | 3 tablespoons jam | chopped of fresh mint leaves
instructions: Boil cabbage 8 minutes. Drain and set aside. To make filling, combine raspberry and maple syrup mix well. Chop or crumble chives. Roll cabbage a few times with a rolling pin, keeping the knife parallel. Spread a thin 1/4 thick layer on a lightly floured cookie sheet, leaving 1/2 inch of headspace around the edge. Spread with just enough raspberry and maple dressing mixture to cover the whole cabbage. Roll up the cabbage tightly, jelly roll fashion. To serve, cut each roll into 8 pieces. Arrange on heated serving dish, then drizzle with the syrup.

title: Graham Crackers
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups whole wheat bran | 1 teaspoon coarsely crushed black peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 3 cups graham crackers ( depending on the size )
instructions: Line a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1/3 inch baking pan with parchment paper or aluminum foil slices. Spread out the crackers, sprinkle about 5 tablespoons of the coarsely crushed crackers on a sheet of parchment paper or foil. Combine the wheat germ, peppercorns and baking soda in a bowl and set aside. Spread the remaining cracker on the sheet of paper. Using your fingers, spread the wheat germ mixture evenly over the cracker base, leaving about 1/4 inch at the edges around, but not covering the wheat germ layer. Lay the graham crackers on top of the wheat germ layer and press them lightly with your fingertips to flatten them slightly. Carefully turn them slightly more so the graham crackers are evenly spaced along the length. Bake the graham crackers as follows,. With a spatula, spread about half the cracked wheat germ mixture over the graham crackers and spread out the remaining crackers. Return the graham crackers to the prepared pan and bake them at 350° for 15 minutes or until the graham crackers are lightly browned and crisp. Remove the graham crackers from the oven, carefully turn and bake them for 10 minutes longer, or until golden brown. Cool on a rack. Store in an airtight container.

title: Creamy Cucumber, Radish and Smoked Salmon Baskets
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lebanese cucumbers or 1 1/2 lbs yellow cucumbers | 3 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 4 ounces smoked salmon ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 2 sponge cakes, cut into thick slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Pare 4 large, thin slices of cucumber lengthwise, about 1/2 inch wide. Cut into 1½ inch/ ¾ inch thick slices, and transfer the slices to a baking sheet or baking pan lined with parchment paper. Bake the cucumbers for 10 - 15 minutes or until very light brown in color. Transfer to a bowl and immediately put in the refrigerator. Place a stainless steel bowl over medium heat in a small saucepan. When hot, add the yogurt, season with salt and pepper, and cook, stirring, until the yogurt is reduced by about ½/ spread the yogurt onto four of the slices of cucumbers, and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the smoked salmon on top of the cheese slices and top with the remaining cucumbers and radishes. Spoon the half and half on top of the cheese, and top with a sheet of parchment paper and several extra toothpicks, but not too many that will tear. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until the top of the cheese is melted and bubbling with some browned crust. Turn off the oven and let sit for 15 minutes before serving. Note, the smoked salmon can be used for the smoked salmon, not as a bbq ingredient. The smoke cured salmon can be used in place of smoked salmon, instead of using the smoked salmon. Note, smoked salmon can also be used as a sandwich spread.

title: Rice Cheeze Chicken With Bok Choy (Bok Choy)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried mace | 4 boneless chicken breasts | 4 cups fresh baby bok choy | 8 -10 cups raw rice cereal
instructions: In a large bowl combine mace and chicken breasts with one cup of the water. Let sit for at least 30 minutes, but also enough time to let the chicken sit in the liquid. After chicken is about 1 - 3 inches from boiling add another cup of water and stir. Add another cup of water, and stir again. Bring it to a boil, then lower the heat to simmer. Let the chicken cook for a total of about 30 minutes, the longer, the better. After the chicken is cooked, add bok choy and cooked rice cereal to the pot of chicken, tossing to coat. Continue cooking chicken for another 10 minutes, stirring periodically. Remove the bok choy, and drain off excess liquid. When done, serve and enjoy. If your rice cereal does not have the right flavor, simply add a few cups of cold water and stir to mix. Enjoy.

title: Tropical Mince
ingredients: 3/4 cup italian cheese, shredded | 1/2 can canned dried pears in syrup, drained | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces | 1 1/4 cups fruit, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl combine cheese, pears, mushrooms and fruit. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with waxed paper or parchment paper. Spoon mixture into dish and bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until top is lightly browned.

title: Tamarind Spinach
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh spinach leaves, washed and dry | 2 tablespoons tamarind juice | sweet and sour sauce
instructions: Put the spinach into a bowl or steamer basket, cover and steam over boiling water for 4 - 5 minutes until the leaves are crisp and tender. Drain and squeeze out any excess liquid. In a clean bowl, mix the tamarind juice with the tamarind water, pour over the spinach and mix well. Serve with your favourite indian meal or rice. For variety, you can add finely chopped cilantro.

title: Golubtsy (Moorish-Style Scallops) - Authentically Russian Recipe
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh scallops | 1 1/2 cups orange juice | 1 1/2 cups liquid honey | 2 -4 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried scallops | 1 small naikon radish, thinly sliced ( garnish )
instructions: Wash the scallops, dry them thoroughly, and remove any muscle visible on top. Rinse the scallops under cold salt, cut them in half horizontally, and place them in a shallow roasting pan. Combine the orange juice, honey, dried onion flakes, and dried scallops in a medium saucepan. Cook over moderate heat, stirring frequently until the mixture just begins to thicken, about 4 minutes. Remove from the heat. Taste and adjust the honey and seasonings. Pour the mixture into the scallops, and refrigerate overnight to marinate. Remove the scallops from the marinade, and shake off any excess. Place the scallops on a board and carefully score each side of the scallops. Arrange them directly over the simmering liquid. Cover with foil and continue to cook over moderately low heat, stirring occasionally for about 1½ hours, until the mixture is very thick and scordalia. The scallops can be eaten hot, but allow to rest for a few hours before serving. Turn the scallops over in to a serving platter, spooning them in gravy. Garnish with the sliced scallops and radish. Sliced scallops can be served either warm or at room temperature.

title: Simple Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs - Kari
ingredients: 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 medium cucumbers or 2 medium english cucumbers, finely grated
instructions: Note, as cucumbers are often crushed with a fork, they soften and become limp. Place the panko in a plastic bag and place in the refrigerator. When they are completely chilled, drain off excess liquid. Place the grated cucumbers in a bowl. Squeeze the excess moisture out of the cucumbers, but do not squeeze out the juice. Add the grated cucumbers to the panko and mix with your hands until the mixture is mixed well together.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,dark rum,cooking spray,dark chocolate,celery,cumin,baking soda
title: Candy Light Rum Brownies
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup dark chocolate, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 cup chopped celery | 2 tablespoons dark rum, divided | 2 cups ground dark chocolate | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Spread dark chocolate pieces in a large bowl. Mix in celery, 1 tablespoon rum, 2 cups dark chocolate, cumin, poultry seasoning, and baking soda. Pour mixture into prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until mixture has set, about 40 minutes. Cool brownies in the baking dish on a wire rack until hardened, about 15 minutes.

title: Quinoa Baked Butternut Squash
ingredients: 1 small butternut squash, halved and seeded | 1/4 cup quinoa | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place butternut squash chunks into a baking dish and drizzle with lemon pepper and thyme, tossing to coat. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes, tossing every 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: The Most Awesome Pizza  Onion Lovers Style
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion ( peeled, quartered and sliced thin ) | 2 packages pepperoni ( slices )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Add sliced onions and pepperoni to the cookie sheet and toss to coat well with the onions and pepperoni. Place in oven for 10 minutes or until hot. Serve with your favorite toppings for dipping.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 4 cups chunky salsa ( homemade or store-bought ) | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: In a large bowl, mash the salsa with the back of a spoon. Stir in the cheese and chill for just a few hours before serving for best results.

title: Jicama Salad with Cucumber
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh jicama, peeled and diced | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 medium cucumbers, peeled, seeded, and diced
instructions: Toss the jicama with the oil and cucumbers. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red potato,coconut,rice flour,dark soy sauce,pork tenderloin,coleslaw dressing,cognac,corn cob
title: Filipino Pork Stir Fry
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons coleslaw dressing ( or other flavor that suits you ) | 1 package fresh corn on the cob | 2 red potatoes, cut into slices | 3 -4 tablespoons rice flour | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon cognac | 1/4 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Slice pork into strips and marinate with coconut dressing. Put corn on to boil with about 1/2 cup water, add potato slices and boil with about 1/2 cup water. Drain and cool and then cut into strips. Heat a wok or skillet for about 5 minutes. In a small bowl mix rice flour, dark soy and cognac. Drain pork and add to sugar/pancake mixture. Stir fry for about 1 minute. Drain and add back to wok. Stir fry for another 1/2 minute. Remove from over.

title: Baked Chickpeas-Mangosteen
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups dry chickpeas, roasted, defrosted | 3 tablespoons honey | 3 1/2 cups marinara sauce, jarred | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut oil | 1/4 cup minced pickled jalapeno | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried yeast | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Drain chickpeas and place into a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Mix, adding more liquid if needed to make a slightly sticky dough. Divide into two parts. Shape into two 1 inch long ropes. Place on two parchment lined baking sheets. Cover, let rise for 30 minutes. Bake at 400 degrees for 35 minutes, or until bread is dry.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,tabasco sauce,nigella seed,ditalini,artichoke heart,tomato ketchup,okra,sherry wine
title: Artichoke Okra
ingredients: 1 package of frozen okra, thawed | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 4 teaspoons nigella seeds | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 3 -4 drops tabasco sauce | 1 cup uncooked long grain rice, uncooked | cooked ditalini
instructions: Rinse okra under cold water, place in a bowl and add artichoke hearts, nigella seeds, sherry, tomato ketchup and tabasco and mix well. Place rice and okra mixture in a casserole with 1 - 2 cups of boiling, salted water and cover. Bring to a boil, then drain the rice well and place in a serving bowl. Garnish with the cooked okra and serve with your favourite condiments.

Random Ingredients: white cheese,italian pork sausage,fine breadcrumb,yoghurt,onion,veal,sherry wine,yogurt
title: Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb ground swiss white cheese | 1/2 lb bulk mild italian pork sausage | 6 tablespoons yoghurt | 1 onion, minced | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup low-fat cultured sour cream
instructions: Mix all together adding a bit of water to make firm dough. Flatten out and shape each meatball in your hands. Fry them in a little oil, drain on paper towel and set aside. When ready to fry, put the yoghurt in a small bowl, add onions and stir through. In a fry pan, brown meatballs in batches until all is well browned and no longer pink inside. Put all back into the pan on top of the yoghurt and onion mixture, pour over sherry and stir. Turn down heat, cover pan and simmer for 45 minutes. To serve, place meatballs in a platter and pour over sherry and top with sauce.

title: Red Sauce
ingredients: 2 red peppers, quartered | 2 ounces vanilla beans
instructions: Wash and dry the peppers. With a heavy bladed knife cut off the stalk ends of the red peppers taking away the blackened skins. Slice the red peppers into half rings, remove the seeds leaving about two inches worth of flesh in the red pepper. Heat an iron skillet over high heat for 30 seconds, or until just smoking. Place all the red pepper rings on the pan including the seeds. Cook, turning occasionally, until the peppers are brown. Add the vanilla beans. Add enough hot water to cover and cook for five minutes, or until thick. Serve hot.

title: Moo Shu Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 bag frozen snow peas | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons cacao | 4 soft lettuce leaves
instructions: Combine the snow peas, confectioners' sugar, and cacao in a large bowl. Toss until the nuts have coated with the mixture and are coated. Lay lettuce leaves on a serving plate and divide the snow peas among them. Drizzle the salad with the syrup and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,egg noodle,buttermilk,vanilla sugar,cooking sherry,water chestnut
title: Egg Noodle Pockets
ingredients: 2 pita bread, cut into triangles | 1/4 cup egg noodles ( egg noodles - 10g ) | 2 -3 water chestnuts ( optional ) | cooking sherry | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons buttermilk ( optional )
instructions: Combine egg noodles and water chestnuts in a mixing bowl, cover and microwave on high 1 minute. Stir in sherry and sweetener and serve topped with bread triangles.

title: Prosciutto and Marinara Shells
ingredients: 1 package uncooked medium pasta shells | 1 jar marinara sauce | 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper lengthwise,taco seasoning mix,egg wrap,peanut oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Mexican Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3 tablespoons minced canned jalapeno peppers with seeds | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 3 eggs, beaten | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 package egg roll wraps
instructions: Place the parmigiano reggiano cheese, jalapeno peppers, and taco seasoning mix in a bowl. Stir until they are well combined. Add the eggs and mix well. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the egg mixture and cook until set. Use your finger, just enought to coat the bottom of the pan. Fill the egg roll wrappers with the cheese mixture and then fold over onto the egg roll wrapper. Heat the oil over medium heat in a frying pan. You want to avoid smoking so that the oil does not burn. Dip the spring roll wrappers in water and fry until golden.

title: Simple Crock Pot Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon unsalted butter, softened | 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, trimmed of fat or 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 5 cups ice water
instructions: Combine the vegetable oil and 1/4 cup ice water in a 3 1/2 to 4 3/4 quart slow cooker. Add chicken and turn to coat and allow to sit for 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to slow cooker and add water. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or on high 4 to 6 hours, or until chicken is cooked thoroughly.

title: Persian Pork Applesauce
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed & cut into 1- to 2-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon fresh rose water | 1 large cooking apple, peeled, cored & cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 12 cups apple juice
instructions: In a nonreactive 4 to 4 qt slow cooker, combine the pork with the rose water, apple cubes & apple juice, cover & cook on high heat setting until the liquid is reduced by half, about 1 and 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,maraschino cherry,mustard powder,red chile pepper,red pepper bell,corn kernel,beef stock,soymilk
title: Chile Pepper Beef and Corn Soup
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1/2 cup corn kernels | 2 tablespoons red pepper bell, finely chopped | 1/2 cup plain soymilk | 1 3/4 cups beef stock | 1 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground dry mustard powder | 1 teaspoon dried red chile pepper | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried maraschino cherries
instructions: Stir ground beef, corn, red bell pepper, soymilk, beef stock, hazelnuts, mustard powder, red chile pepper, and maraschino cherries together in a large pot.

title: Banana Pepperidge Grill Apricot Appetizer
ingredients: 500 500 g of chopped apricots | 1 banana, sliced | 1 small okra, sliced | 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules | 2 cups water | grated ice ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Blend on high power for 1 minute. If using ice, ice with the desired flavor. Store in a cool place. Makes 1 packet of pepperidge grill chip cookies.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,guajillo chilies,pheasant,chinese five spice powder,apple,cold water,anchovy fillet
title: Mille Foglie
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pheasants | 1 bottle cold water | 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 3 dried guajillo chilies ( or other hot chilies ) | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 3 anchovy fillets, chopped | 3 apples, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat broiler to 400°f. Score the center of each pheasant with a sharp knife, remove the giblets from inside. Wrap them in 2 or 3 pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil. Arrange them on a broiler rack or a baking sheet. Spoon the pickling solution over the pheasant, leaving 1 1/2 inch of the air space. Place the balsamic and 1 tablespoon of the chile powder on top of each pheasant. Sprinkle the chiles with 1 teaspoon of salt. Roast for about 30 minute. Turn, and continue to roast for about 1/2 hour or till the liquid has reduced and the pheasant is well done. Add the anchovies and apples.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,sauce,broccoli floret,sage leaf,sesame seed,chicken bouillon granule,cauliflower floret
title: Chinese Chicken Cauliflower and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 tablespoons a.1. original sauce | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 cauliflower floret | 1 1/2 cups shredded cooked chicken breasts or 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked fresh broccoli florets, divided
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, heat a small amount of a 1 sauce sauce vinagre broth or 1 beef broth. Stir in remaining sauce ingredients. Cover and cook over low heat for 30 minute. To serve, toss cauliflower. Serve immediately.

title: Pimientos in Foil for Chips, Salad, Dipping or Side Dish.
ingredients: 2 pimientos | vegetable oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Wash pimentos under cold water and drain. Place in plastic bag or strainer and sprinkle with salt. Let sit for 4 hours. Heat vegetable oil in deep fryer, or deep fryer to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Deep fry pimentos until lightly golden, 3 - 4 minutes. Drain on absorbent paper towels. Serve with favorite salad accompaniment.

title: Spicy Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets ( boneless, skinless ) | 2 tablespoons mango chutney ( or chutney ) | 3 teaspoons mayonnaise | 3 teaspoons marinara sauce | 4 radishes ( to garnish )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190°c. Place all ingredients into a shallow oven safe dish and stir to combine until combined. Bake for approximately 30 minutes or until chicken starts to brown. Place on serving plate and top with garnish.

Random Ingredients: arbol chile,broth,chicken bouillon cube,sunflower oil,ladyfinger,vegetable broth
title: Mexican Tricolore
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups homemade vegetable broth or 1 2/3 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 10 arbol chiles or 10 aji de limo chilies, stemmed, seeded, and chopped plus 1/4 cup for decoration | 1/2 lb ladyfinger, washed, patted dry, and cut lengthwise into 8 wedges | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | arbol ( aji pancresa or chile paste )
instructions: Fill a pot with 3 cups of water and add the bouillon cube, chilies, and 2 tbsp of oil and bring to a boil over high heat until the water reaches the boiling point, about 3 - 5 minutes. Immediately add the ladyfingers and cook, uncovered, over medium heat for about 5 - 6 minutes or until they are crisp but not browned. With tongs, remove the chilies with tongs and place on paper towels to drain. Keep the water in a separate pot, at least 1 1/2. Return the broth to the same pot. Ladle half of the water into the soup bowls and ladle in a ladle full of the broth from the bowls. Discard the remaining broth. Add the chilies, soaking them in the broth until thoroughly soaked, about 10 minutes. Return the broth and any liquid to the soup, bring to a boil, and cook another 10 minutes. Heat broiler. Drain the chilies, reserve the cooking water, and keep warm in a 200° oven. After the soup has simmered for 10 minutes, pour the soup through a sieve into a sauce pan. Discard the solids. Place the soup pan back on the heat and add the reserved chilies. Stir to coat with a little of the cooking water and cook a minute or two longer until the chilies are very fragrant. Ladle the soup into a serving bowl and garnish with a tbsp of oil and chilies on the side of the tricolore.

title: Easy Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced | 3 tablespoons liqueur ( optional ) or 3 tablespoons orange-flavored liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours. Use to flavor steak.

title: Macadamia Nut Pastries
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 1/4 cup natural yoghurt | 1/4 cup shelled macadamia nuts, roughly chopped | 2 ounces prosciutto, cut into strips
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375°f lightly grease two baking sheets with oil. Process remaining ingredients in a food processor until they are well combined. Scrape mixture into a medium sized bowl and stir in macadamia nuts. Spoon the pastries onto the baking sheets, leaving 2cm between each. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Fiery Dipping Onions
ingredients: 1 medium red onion, peeled | 1 small fresh green chili
instructions: Slice the onion very thinly, about 1/8 inch. Scoop out the soft outer layers with a teaspoon. Cut out as much of the white part as possible, but not too much. Cut the onion in half and core it carefully with a sharp knife. Cut out the seeds by pressing them into the onion with your fingers. Remove the skin. Cut the onion into approximately 1 inch pieces and set aside. Gently rub the white part of the onion with olive oil. Use the fork to pick up the slices of onion lightly. If the onion sticks, put it in a bowl or resealable container for storage in the refrigerator. Fill a small saucepan or dutch oven with water and bring to a boil. Place the onion and green chili in the boiling water. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 3 minutes, or until the onion is very soft. Drain the onion, chili, and water from the onions and green chili. Chill until needed.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,blood orange avocado oil ca n't this olive,sage,vegetable broth,broccoli floret,bay leaf
title: Olive Tacos
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 small egg avocado, mashed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup taco sauce or 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Saute broccoli in 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, drain excess oil. Stir in avocado and broth. Cook over high heat until reduced to 1/2, about five minutes. Stir in taco sauce and sage. Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salsa or picante. Top lightly with bay leaves.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,prosciutto,pie shell,rice wine vinegar,sesame seed,salmon fillet,pistachio,roast beef
title: Mongolian Salmon Pie
ingredients: 1 pre-made pie shell | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1 salmon fillet, skin removed | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 lemon, juice of | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice | 1/4 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped, toasted | 1/8 cup slivered smoked provolone cheese ( optional ) or 1/8 cup smoked provolone cheese ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a 9 inch pie plate with pie shell. Combine olive oil and salmon in large skillet. Cook, without stirring, until salmon starts to flake.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,ladyfinger,button mushroom,cayenne pepper,black olive,cauliflower floret,chilies
title: Quick & Easy Tiramisala
ingredients: 1 can button mushrooms, drained ( canned also ) | 12 ounces cauliflower florets, drained | 1 can sliced black olives | 12 ounces sliced black olives | 6 ounces chili peppers, fresh or to taste | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 7/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 15 ladyfingers
instructions: Combine mushrooms, cauliflower, olives and peppers in a blender or food processor. Blend until mostly smooth. Add vinegar and cayenne pepper and mix. Sprinkle lady fingers with cayenne pepper and roll in herb mixture. Refrigerate for at least an hour prior to serving.

title: Sautéed Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 salmon fillets
instructions: In a skillet, warm the fish sauce over medium low heat. Place salmon, skin side up, in the sauce and gently squeeze the cooked vegetables into the skillet. Turn the salmon over, cover and continue cooking 10 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and the vegetables are hot, stirring several times.

title: Ginger Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated | 1 teaspoon low-sodium beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan, and stir well. Cook until well mixed. Bring mixture to the boil. Allow to simmer 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Serve immediately, or cool.

title: Mexican White Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons wheat germ ( unbleached ) | 2 cups basmati rice | 1 medium anaheim chili, finely chopped | 2 ounces queso fresco, crumbled
instructions: Heat skillet and add toasted wheatgerger and rice.

title: Mock Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb lean loaf challah | 1 can beef consomme | 1 turnip, cut up
instructions: Cut loaves in half. Cut off top or bottom rind of turnips. Place rinds into soup pan. Cut meat of choice into 1/2inch pieces. Add turnips into soup pan. Mix all ingredients in crockpot.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,taco seasoning,golden brown sugar,cannellini bean,thyme leave,salt pepper,cod
title: Cannellini Beans and Cod
ingredients: 1 lb dry cannellini beans | 1 yellow onion ( sliced ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 package taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leave | 1/2 cup golden brown sugar | salt & pepper
instructions: Rinse the beans and cook in boiling water for about 8 minutes. Drain the water from the cannellini beans, and discard about half of the liquid. Saute the onions until they are translucent in the pan. Add salt and pepper, and then add beans and mix with the onions. Simmer for about 10 minutes. Add the taco seasoning, thyme, sugar and half of the water and simmer for about 3 minutes. The mixture will be soupy so you want a smooth sauce. I usually make a roux and then add as needed to thicken the sauce.

title: Trout Stew
ingredients: 1 large whole trout, cleaned | 1/4 cup pineapple chunk | 2 large carrots, scraped and thickly sliced | 2 tablespoons brazil nuts, chopped ( khus size ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Trout should be cleaned of excess fat or scales. Boil the trout in lightly salted water for two minutes. Drain water and blot trout dry with a paper towel. Add pineapple chunks, carrots, nut, cardamom. Mix well. Return to a boil and cook uncovered for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oregano,liquid smoke,confectioner sugar,saffron thread,asafoetida powder,walnut oil,corn tortilla
title: Tangy Fritters
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron threads | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon salted or sunflower seed oil | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 1 cup chopped walnuts packed in oil | 2 corn tortillas, cut into 1 `` strips
instructions: In a small bowl, toss together saffron, oregano, oil, asafetida, and sugar until well combined. Set aside 1 teaspoon saffron mixture and set aside remaining mixture. Place 1 tortilla strip on an ungreased cookie sheet and brush with 1 teaspoon sunflower seeds. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon sunflower oil mixture and spread to evenly coat surface. Top with another tortilla strip and brush with reserved saffron mixture. Repeat with remaining strips, sunflower oil, and sunflower mixture. Sprinkle top with remaining 1 1/2 teaspoon sunflower seeds and any remaining saffron mixture. Set aside to dry at room temperature for 30 minutes. In a medium skillet, toast reserved saffron mixture over medium high heat for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly, or until mixture is fragrant and begins to brown. Transfer to a bowl. Preheat broiler. Arrange fritters on a baking sheet or baking stone. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat for 10 minutes, or until golden brown, keeping an eye on them. Watch so they do not burn or turn dark.

title: Easy Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, diced | 1 avocado
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a medium bowl, combine flour, sun dried tomatoes and avocado. Stir in just enough cake flour to make a sticky dough.

title: Spiced Walnut and Walnut Treats
ingredients: 1 cup walnuts, shelled | 1/2 cup loosely packed fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | sea salt | 2 dozen tortillas or 2 dozen rice sticks
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine nuts, cilantro leaves, turmeric, and 2 cups water or vegetable stock. Blend to a coarse paste. Transfer to a shallow bowl. Pour in walnut mixture to form the texture of bread crumbs. Wipe food processor bowl with a damp paper towel to remove excess liquid. Working on the flat area of the food processor, pulse mixture a few times to mince or finely chop. Transfer walnut mixture to a serving dish and refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour. Using oven mitts, remove a portion of walnut mixture and roll between palms to soften. Repeat process with another portion of walnut mixture.

title: The Platter of Melon-Merim Syllabub
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sweet vermouth or 2 teaspoons dry vermouth | 1 melon, ripe ( cantaloupe, or orange )
instructions: Peel and wash melons and remove as many seeds as possible. Cut into slices about 1/8 thick. Arrange melons over a tray and cover with vermouth. Put in the refrigerator for about 20 minutes to develop the juices the melon was sitting inches when ready, grill marked melons in a hot pan until they turn golden brown in colour and become very crisp, 3 - 4 minutes each side. Remove from oven and place on plate. Cut melon in half, removing the white stalk. Place in a plate and drizzle with vermouth. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,green,hot oil,artichoke heart,eggplant,grain rice
title: Artichoke Paella
ingredients: 3 cups cooked long-grain rice, plain | 2 tablespoons whole-grain rice ( stone ground variety recommended-no other rice added ) | 1 large eggplant, peeled, halved lengthwise, sliced crosswise into 1/4-inch rounds ( about 1 lb. ) | 1 cup cooked artichoke heart ( see note ) | hot oil, for frying | 1 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese or 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, blend | freshly sliced green onion ( garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Note, marinated artichoke hearts with a juice can be frozen for up to 2 months. Note, artichoke hearts can be grilled over high heat at 1 to 1 1/2 feet from high heat and broiled over hot coals or in a toaster oven until blackened, about 5 minutes per side. Watch carefully for steam burns. The artichoke hearts should be blacked inside and outside but still attached at the center. Remove rice to a bowl. Drain artichoke hearts and add to bowl with rice and eggplant. Stir well to combine. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. While rice stands, heat 1 to 1 1/2 inch oil in small skillet to 350°. In a 9 inch cast iron or other large nonstick frying pan, warm 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat. Dry artichokes well on all sides, about 5 minutes, then transfer to bowl with rice and eggplant. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil until shimmering. Add in rice, artichoke hearts and green onion and stir well to combine. When pan begins to sizzle oil will begin to bubble, add in bread slices and stir well, separating layers once through. Transfer into prepared paella pan, pressing down gently to flatten. Carefully, cook, turning occasionally and adding more oil if needed until golden, about 10 minutes. Place paella pan on a rack. Turn the temperature down to medium low. Let sit, covered until rice is cooked and has absorbed most of the oil, about 15 minutes. Turn out onto warmed serving platter, sprinkle with cheese, and serve warm.

title: Lunch Box English Toffee
ingredients: 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/3 lb american toffee bar, broken up
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. In a small bowl, dissolve the cornstarch in 1 tbls. Of water and set aside. In a heavy skillet or frying pan, warm the cheese until melted. Using a slotted spoon, remove the cheese and reserve. Dip the toast, one at a time, in the cornstarch and coat the bottom of the pan with the melted cheese. Transfer to a foil lined baking sheet. Place under a medium heat for 60 seconds or until a bit darker on the top.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,fine breadcrumb,mango chutney,lasagna noodle,chutney,rice vinegar,coffee granule,kidney bean
title: Chung Down Sliced Mandarin Orange Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles | 7 ounces mandarin oranges, drained | 6 ounces kidney beans | fine breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons mint chutney beans | chutney bean sauce or hot brewed coffee | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons fine dry instant coffee granules
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and rinse under cold water. Dry noodles well and divide among four salad bowls. Top noodles with oranges, kidney beans and mint beans. Pour hot bean sauce or coffee over both salad and serve immediately. To make coffee bean sauce, stir all ingredients together in small bowl. Chill well in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,graham cracker crumb,tea,red pepper flake
title: Chacha's Perfectly Perfectly Spicy Tea Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup caster sugar | 3 cups instant tea, heated | 1 pinch red pepper flakes | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs, crushed
instructions: Place sugar and hot tea in a saucepan and heat, stirring, until sugar melts. Add pepper flakes and crumbs. Stir well. Let cool. Drop onto waxed paper, and place in refrigerator until chocolate firm, about 15 minutes.

title: Simple Japanese Chicken
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken | 1 1/2 cups dashi | 1 lb instant dashi
instructions: Rinse or soak chicken for 2 hours. Rinse with cold water and place in a large pot. Add dashi and bring to a boil, skimming off any scum. Add chicken and simmer for about 3 hours, skimming if necessary. Remove legs, feet and thighs. Place chicken in a baking dish and cover with foil. Bake in center of preheated oven for 1 hour and then cover again and bake an additional 30 minutes. Serve with hot chaki, japanese bread flakes, and miso paste.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,parmesan cheese,self rising flour,chocolate syrup
title: Double Chocolate Shortbread
