ingredients: 12 ounces bittersweet chocolate syrup | 12 ounces grated parmesan cheese or 12 ounces aged vegan parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Butter a 9'x9 casserole. Line the bottom with parchment paper. In a bowl, stir chocolate syrup, cheese and coconut extract. Stir in flour until fully combined and dough holds together when squeezed.. Pour mixture into prepared casserole. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, until pale golden brown. Allow to cool for 2 - 3 minutes before removing to wire rack to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,cake flour,ancho chili,date,extra beef,ghee,marshmallow,romaine lettuce
title: Stuffed Ancho Chili Wrazzles
ingredients: 1 cup pitted dates, chopped | 1 1/2 cups crumbled blue cheese | 500 g extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup prepared roasted or ghee | 1 -2 cup shredded romaine lettuce | 4 -6 small ancho chili, stalks, stems removed, halved lengthwise | 1/2 cup finely chopped marshmallows
instructions: In mixing bowl stir together the dates, cheese, beef, roasted or ghee, lettuce and chili. Place 1 - 2 tablespoons stuffing on each end of each chili. Roll each chili tightly. Seal with plastic wrap and keep in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Bring to a boil, cover pan, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until chili is just soft. Cool, serve drizzled with chutney and garnish with marshmallows.

title: Pork Loin With Mushrooms & Parsnips
ingredients: 400 g pork tenderloin | 3 teaspoons cumin seeds | 8 button mushrooms, sliced | 2 medium parsnips, halved lengthways | 150 g dried fruit ( see note )
instructions: Combine the pork and cumin seeds in a large, heavy based frying pan. Add half the mushrooms and half the parsnips. Fry over a high heat, covered, for 3 - 4 - 3 minutes or until the pork is brown and starting to cook in the centre. Remove. Repeat until all the pork is cooked, then continue to fry until all the pork is cooked. Add remaining mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,icing sugar,pork,sherry,english cucumber,queso fresco,anise seed,cumin
title: Sopa Aka Cuban Pork Salad
ingredients: 1/2 kg boneless pork, cubed | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 2 tablespoons sweet sherry | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 500 ml vegetable broth | 375 g queso fresco, grated | 1 english cucumber, peeled, cut into thin slices
instructions: Combine the pork with cumin, anise seeds, sherry and icing sugar. Set aside in a fridge for 30 minutes. Heat vegetable broth. Add pork pieces, pour broth over and simmer over a high heat for about 20 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Spray salad bowl with olive oil spray and line with cucumber slices. Add the pork and pour the vinaigrette over the cucumber slices. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ro tel tomato,cayenne pepper,sherry wine,coffee,chili pepper flake
title: Mexican Tomato Coffee
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups hot coffee, hot | 2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon instant chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Heat 1 1/2 cups of hot coffee, 1/4 cup of sherry, 1 teaspoon of coffee powder and 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne pepper to boiling in a small saucepan over moderate heat. Do not boil. Remove from heat. Let stand for 2 minutes. Pour cooled coffee into a heat resistant cup. Top with 1/2 teaspoon of coffee powder. Top with remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons of coffee powder and 1/2 teaspoon of coffee powder. Add remaining 1/4 cup of coffee. Top with remaining 1/2 teaspoon of coffee powder, 1/8 cup of dry sherry, and 1/4 teaspoon of dried chili pepper flakes. Serve.

title: Spicy Vegetable Hummus
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 1 can pimento-stuffed olives, drained | 2 small avocados, peeled and diced small | 1 -2 chipotle pepper, seeded and diced | 1/3 cup parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts, chopped, toasted, and coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat beans, picante sauce, and olives in food processor until smooth. To serve, place in serving dish and garnish with avocado, chipotle pepper, cheese, and cardamom. Or top with nuts.

title: Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon fine sea salt | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon ground almonds
instructions: Place drained kidney beans in a serving dish with salt, sesame seeds, mayonnaise, ground almonds. Chill before serving, or cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: hummus,cooking spray,bell pepper,rice vinegar,sesame seed,banana,chicken breast half
title: Caramelized Sesame Rolls
ingredients: 4 bell peppers | cooking spray | 2 chicken breast halves, sliced ( skin on ) | 1 package frozen hummus ( thawed ) | 1/2 cup chopped roasted sesame seeds, divided | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 4 slices ripe banana
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place peppers on foil wrapped baking sheet. Bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven, cover with foil, and set aside to cool slightly. Remove stems and seeds from peppers. Place in a plastic bag and tightly seal tightly. Chop peppers. Place chicken breast halves on baking sheet. Coat with cooking spray, turning to lightly coat. Place on top rack of preheated broiler, skin side down, and broil 6 minutes. Remove from oven, uncover and spray breasts. Spread hummus evenly over tops and top of pepper with 1/4 cup sesame seeds. Place banana slices over hummus, and top with remaining sesame sesame seeds. Bake 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Serve with pita chips and cucumbers.

title: Sukiyaki Sauce - Indonesian Recipes
ingredients: 3 cups green olives, pitted and finely chopped | 2 medium yellow onions, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon hot chili paste
instructions: Mix it all together and store in refrigerator. The longer it rests in the refrigerator, the hotter it gets.

Random Ingredients: tahini,golden raisin,cocoa powder,cremini mushroom,cauliflower,gluten flour,carrot juice,purpose white flour
title: Vegan Pan Batido
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup vegetable-flavored lite-flavored liquid aminos or 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 2 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 1/4 cup all-purpose white flour | 2 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 1/4 cup graham flour or 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 cup shredded carrot ( a little bit of each ) or 2 ounces jalapenos ( a little bit of each ) | 8 ounces cauliflower or 8 ounces broccoli | 1/4 cup golden raisin, chopped | 1/4 cup flaked coconut flakes ( optional ) or 1/4 cup grated chocolate, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Add all the dry ingredients to the bowl of a food processor or blender, blending until dough just forms a ball around the blades. Do not over blend the dough. The dough will be sticky. Add a small amount of water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed. Keep the finished dough covered in an airtight container for up to 1 week. Heat a nonstick pan and brush with peanut oil. Roll the dough into a 12 inch circle. Place on the pan, about 1 inch apart, in the same pan and brush with peanut oil. Bake at 400°f for 12 - 16 minutes, covering pan with foil in the third and sprinkling foil the last 5 - 6 minutes. Serve warm, garnished with coconut flakes if desired.

title: Paprika and Queso Content
ingredients: 2 -5 tablespoons of hot smoked cotija cheese | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon paprika, to taste | 1 jar salsa or ( 12 ounce ) jar prepared salsa | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve with chips.

title: Beef Tender Pizza
ingredients: 1 frozen pizza crust ( premade ) | 1 cup frozen water chestnuts, defrosted and drained | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the frozen water chestnuts onto a cookie sheet and bake until tender. Drain and place on a small piece of parchment or waxed paper to cool. Remove the dough from the pan and cut into squares or hearts or rectangles. You can either drizzle with honey or a garlic flavored glaze or use your imagination if desired. Place a beef bouillon cube into a square of waxed paper. Dip the fingers into boiling water if you need them, then lightly dip the entire pastry piece in. After the beef bouillon cube has taken shape, roll the pastry pieces in the bouillon. Place them on the cookie sheet. They should not touch, but be slightly moist with one finger. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes in the preheated oven or until crust is brown and crisp.

Random Ingredients: veal,rosemary sprig,onion soup mix,ginger root,lemon,colby monterey jack cheese,sesame oil,clear honey
title: Chinese Restaurant-Style Pork Steaks
ingredients: 1/4 cup sesame oil | 2 onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon chicken or vegetable bouillon or shrimp bouillon | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon dry rosemary sprig | 1 large lemon, thinly sliced | 1 pound pork steaks | 1 pound colby-monterey jack cheese, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup clear honey
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the sesame oil, onion soup mix, chicken bouillon or shrimp bouillon, ginger, and rosemary. Rub this mixture evenly all over both sides of the meat. Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Place the lemon slices in the skillet, and pour in enough water to reach about half of the depth of the meat. Cover the skillet, and keep the steaks inside. Bring the water to a boil, and cook the steaks in the boiling water until no longer pink in the center, 4 to 6 minutes. Place the steaks on a warm platter, and keep warm. Pour the sauce used to rinse the meat into the skillet, and cook for 1 minute, then pour it over the steaks, and allow to stand for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese, and cover, or serve at once. Cook's note, if you prefer, make sure your steaks are well rinsed, and turned over several times during the cooking process so they don't get soggy.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,yellow zucchini,chicken bouillon cube,cream corn,spaghetti
title: Vegetarian Cheesy Butternut Squash Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups butternut squash ( chopped and baked ) | 1 jar spaghetti ( uncooked ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 can cream-style corn | 2 yellow zucchini ( sliced )
instructions: Boil butternut squash until it is soft. About 15 minutes. Remove squash to plate and put to the side. Meanwhile put spaghetti in a pot of water and bring to a boil. Add boullion cube. Mix together and return water to the boil. Add corn and squash and cook for 8 minutes. Strain spaghetti and serve with sauce and zucchini.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,bean thread vermicelli,broth,kosher salt,sugar substitute,greek yogurt,red apple,caraway seed
title: Bean Thread Noodle Soup With Caraway Oil
ingredients: 4 cups broccoli threads ( vermicelli or arugula ) | 2 large red apples | 2 cups greek yogurt or 2 cups regular yogurt | 1 pinch sugar substitute | 1 1/2 tablespoons caraway seeds or 1 1/2 tablespoons fennel seed | 5 cups broth | kosher salt | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: For the bean threads, use 2 teaspoons per cup of the broth. For the soup, bring the broth to a boil in an 8 inch skillet or saucepan over high heat. Meanwhile, peel, core, and cut the apples into 1/4 inch dice. Place the apples and noodles in the broth and simmer 5 minutes. Taste broth for seasoning. Transfer broth to a blender or food processor or food mill and puree. For soup, whisk together yogurt or regular yogurt and sugar substitute. Add caraway seeds and puree again. Set a medium temperature small saucepan or dutch oven over medium low heat and add 1 1/2 quarts warm broth. Add salt and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Serve soup in four bowls garnished with pine nuts.

title: Homemade Taco Shells
ingredients: 1 can taco shells, drained and rinsed | kosher salt
instructions: Drain taco shells from can into a bowl. Add enough kosher salt to your own taste. Add about 1/3 of an onion to the taco shells. Slightly wetting the shell with a rubber spatula helps keep the shells from sticking. Place the taco shells on a baking sheet and toast them in a 450 degree f oven until they're a light golden brown. Sprinkle the shells with kosher salt while they're still hot. The idea is that the salt will soak through the taco filling. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,garam masala,flour,italian bread,black olive,sharp cheddar cheese,red chili pepper,vermouth
title: Baked Calzones
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | 2 teaspoons dried red chili peppers | 1/4 cup red wine | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 pinch cayenne | 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup chopped black olives | 3 tablespoons dry vermouth | 16 thin slices sweet italian bread
instructions: Make the casserole by placing all ingredients except for the bread into a medium bowl. Whisk till mixed well. Set aside. Using a 1 round cookie cutter, cut the bread on the diagnol into 4 or 5 squares. Place the 4 squares on a greased cookie sheet. Spray with pam or other cooking spray. Pour 1 tablespoon of batter into the center of each square. Bake till golden brown, 2 - 3 minutes at top of each bake and remove from oven. Let cool till warm. These freeze well. Serve and enjoy.

title: Indian Style Steak With Chips
ingredients: 1 teaspoon baking soda | 3 1/4 lbs tilapia fillets, well trimmed | 1/4 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 6 thin slices whole wheat bread, toasted | clots chocolates or semisweet chocolate, to taste ( optional ) | crushed ice
instructions: In a shallow bowl set over a pan of boiling water, quickly mix baking soda and catsup. Set aside sauce. Stir peanut butter into dressing. Dip the fish in toasted bread, coating both sides evenly. Arrange fish on a plate, and spoon dressing over fish. Sprinkle with garam masala and top with chips. Garnish with more cinnamon and chocolates of your choice.

Random Ingredients: nori,kiwi fruit,baby spinach,corn oil,almond extract,chili paste,beef stock,basil leaf
title: Thai Kiwifruit Kebabs
ingredients: 2 large kiwi fruits | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1/3 cup beef stock | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 3 tablespoons basil leaves, torn | 12 sheets nori | 4 cups baby spinach, washed
instructions: Preheat the oven at 220 degrees. Cut kiwifruit in half, lengthways, fan out centres with a sharp knife. Cut flesh into small pieces then cut each half into four even pieces. Place the kiwifruit pieces in a saucepan of cold water and bring to the boil. Simmer for two minutes or until the kiwifruit is just starting to soften. Transfer kiwifruit into a bowl, and set aside to cool. Combine beef stock, chilli paste, almond extract and basil leaves in a jug and add to pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes then set aside until cool. Lightly brush grill or griddle pan with water and preheat barbecue on high. Brush kiwifruit with some oil and discard any bruised kiwifruit. Grill for 2 - 3 minutes each side or until cooked and starting to colour. Place spinach leaves on a baking tray and bake for 2 - 3 minutes or until crisp and dry. To serve, scatter with kiwifruit and drizzle with a little sauce.

title: Kathy's Peachy Jalapeno Peppers & Chocolates (For Kids)
ingredients: 4 large mild jalapeno peppers | 1 1/2 cups sweet apple cider | 2 sticks celery, chopped | 2 1/4 cups unsweetened chocolate chips | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees. Cut a cross through the top from the top of each jalapeño pepper. Remove the seeds and peel the pepper skins off all of the pepper. Cut peppers into 1/4 inch slices. Combine the chocolates and cream of tartar in a bowl and toss with the chocolates. Spoon the filling into the pepper skins and wrap tightly in aluminum foil. Place peppers on a cookie sheet and bake 30 - 40 minutes until the mixture becomes slightly firm. Remove from oven and serve warm.

title: Scallops and Pear Ravioli
ingredients: 24 fresh cheese ravioli | 24 asafoetida powder | 24 pears | 24 cocktail pears | chambord raspberry liquor, to taste
instructions: Dice the pears into small pieces and drop into a pan packed with a bit of chambord to help the skin peel off. Slice the ravioli and set aside. After you have all of your ingredients cooked, mix all of your ravioli into your pan with your pear mixture. Don't worry about making sure all of your ingredients are well mixed. Cover and cook on low heat for about 10 minutes or until the ravioli float to the top. When you eat, scoop out a ravioli with a fork and place in a bowl. Fill the center of the ravioli with the crab mix and sprinkle the top with extra chambord. Enjoy.

title: Extra Tofu Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon canola oil | 1 medium head cauliflower, chopped | 1 jar apricot preserves | 1 package extra-firm tofu, drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Stir in the abuli cauliflower, and return to a boil. Cook until tender, about 11 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Heat the canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the tofu, and cook until browned, about 2 minutes. Mix in the apricot preserves, and remove from heat. Serve over the cauliflower.

title: Chili-Roasted Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 large portobello mushrooms | 2 large green chilies | 1 1/4 tablespoons cocoa | 1 chopped onion
instructions: Cut off the very top of the mushrooms and set aside. Carefully clean the cavity of the mushrooms, cutting out any stems or dirt. Rinse thoroughly and cut off and discard any stems or stems from the chilies and stems of the chilies. Combine all ingredients in a large dutch oven or casserole, and place the lid on top. Place the dutch oven into a preheated oven and fill with enough hot water to reach halfway up the sides of the pan. Turn the burner on at 300 degrees, and continue cooking for about 5 hours. Remove lid and turn heat up to 400 degrees and continue cooking about an hour, or until the mushrooms are completely tender, but not mushy.

title: English Cheese Puffs (Slightly Gluten-Free and Low-Carb)
ingredients: 3 ounces american cheese ( or other hard cheese such as manchego, gruyere, a good melting type of cheese such as anejo or emmenthaler, 1 packet is approx. ) | 4 -6 tablespoons strong coffee | 2 large egg whites | 1/2 cup double cream, low-fat is fine
instructions: Mix together all of the ingredients in a bowl and set to one side. Preheat oven to 220c / 400f / gas mark melt your cheese on a greased tray on a hot flat top or until just beginning to turn golden and starting to smell nutty. This should take around 10 minutes stirring every 3 - 5 minutes. Leave the cheesecake to cool then fill and roll up the puffs up with any leftover filling or leave plain. Serve in an elegant manner or serve warm on a bed of savoury bread with a crisp green salad.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,red enchilada sauce,bean,plain yogurt,parmigiano reggiano cheese,fennel seed
title: Fennel Cheese Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 8 ounces prosciutto | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 3 1/2 cups refried beans | 1 package red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cook prosciutto in a frying pan until crisp, about 5 minutes. Cool completely. Place fetuccine on a plate covered with plastic wrap and microwave at high for 2 minutes. Pour off any excess liquid. In a food processor, place yogurt and prosciutto, and pulse until smooth. Stir in the fennel seed. In a separate bowl, mash refried beans with a fork. Spread about 1/4 cup of the enchilada sauce in the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Evenly top with cheese, followed by a layer of provolone cheese. Cover with remaining enchilada sauce, then top with additional provolone cheese. Bake, covered with foil, in the middle of a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Tomatillos (Mexican Tomatillos)
ingredients: 8 tomatillos | 1/2 teaspoon fresh orange peel, coarsely chopped | cracker
instructions: Set oven on broil. Wash and pry tomatillos into small pieces with a spoon, then place the tomatillos on baking sheet. Rub the tomatillos with the orange peel on each piece and place on rack in broiling pan. Broil 15 minutes or until crisp, turning several times.. Serve hot.

title: Savouries: Boiled Turnip, Apple, Pear and Radish Omelet
ingredients: 2 firm pear halves, peeled and quartered | 1 turnip, washed and peeled | 2 large radishes | 5 teaspoons kitchen bouquet ( or equivalent granules ) | 4 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon apple butter | freshly ground allspice ( optional ) or ground nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Place the pear halves cut side down on a baking sheet. Add water to cover. Place in preheated oven and set over medium heat. Cook until all the fruit is soft, about 15 - 20 minutes. Turn each piece of fruit halfway through cooking. Turn over onto a heat resistant plate. Place in microwave. Cook on high 1 minute. Flip out onto plate. Add 5 teaspoons or 2 teaspoons of granules to juice of one apple. Crack 1 egg yolk, egg white on top and mix thoroughly with a spoon. Set aside. Heat the empty pan with liquid over medium heat until mixture boils. Cover pan and turn heat down. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until liquid is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Place ramekins on serving plate. Top with fruit and drizzle with 2 teaspoons of cooking liquid.

title: Tomato and Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs mozzarella cheese | 2 3/4 cups tomato sauce | 1/4 cup flour | 1 1/2 cups grape tomatoes
instructions: Bake pizza crust in preheated 425°f oven for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove crust. Cut mozzarella cheese into 10 thin slices. Spread sauce over pizza. Top with mozzarella cheese slices. Return to oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted and slightly browned. Stir in tomatoes just before eating.

title: Chinese Five Spice Instant Pot "meat" for 4
ingredients: 1 kg potato ( use 3 kg of meat per person ) | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Scrub potatoes and poke to remove any dirt. Heat 5 spice in a bowl. Add potatoes to the bowl and shake until the potatoes start to coat. Sprinkle on the five spice powder. Use as you would for roast chicken, beef or lamb.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,green chilies,coconut,thyme leave,cake flour,chicken broth,sirloin,green curry paste
title: Thai Green Curry Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, trimmed of fat and cut into thin slivers | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 -2 teaspoon green curry paste | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/4 teaspoon thyme leave | 1 cup coconut | 1 teaspoon parsley leaves ( chopped ) | 16 ounces canned green chilies, diced or 16 ounces fresh canned jalapeno chilies, roasted and diced
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, cook the steak cubes in broth for 2 minutes or until browned. Add the curry paste, cook 1 minute or until heated. Remove mixture to a bowl and let cool. In a blender, combine flour, thyme and coconut. Blend into steak mixture. Add coconut mixture and chilies to steak mixture in skillet. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes or until mixture thickens. Serve over rice.

title: Grilled Skirt Steak Skewers
ingredients: 4 strips manchego cheese or 4 slices monterey jack pepper cheese | 4 ounces grilled skirt steak ( preferably with a good quality meat ) | 1/2 cup mango chutney
instructions: Combine the goat cheese and chutney in a small serving bowl with a fork. Cover the grilling steak with the cheese mixture and set aside covered. Thread the steaks onto a metal skewer, weaving it about 8 - 8 times to the entire length. Place under a hot grill and cook about 3 minutes per side, or to desired doneness. Slice on the diagonal on your preference. Serve immediately.

title: Trout Enchiladas (Salted Fish Enchiladas)
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh trout, skinned | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh gingerroot | 1 pinch accent seasoning | 1 can chopped tomatoes with juice | 1 oranges, zest of, grated or 3 ounces candied orange
instructions: Soak the fish in cold water to cover in a small bowl for at least 12 hours or over night. Drain well, discarding the water. Place the trout on a plate, sprinkle with saffron and place on a tray with a lip. Sprinkle finely with ginger, accent and zest and salt and pepper to taste. Combine the tomatoes and orange juice.

title: Fruited Beef and Potato Skillet
ingredients: 32 ounces beef consomme | 1 cup pomegranate | 8 ounces red potatoes, peeled and sliced | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 medium fennel, sliced | 3 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped for garnish
instructions: In a skillet, combine consume and heat to boiling over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Place half of potatoes in skillet and cover with half of cheese. Top with remaining potatoes. Sprinkle with fennel and coriander.

title: German Fish Casserole With Sausage and Greens
ingredients: 1 package sauerkraut, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces canned sauerkraut, drained | 3/4 cup baby spinach leaves, well washed | 1 can cooked cod, drained ( flakey fish ) | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 2/3 cup miniature marshmallows or 2/3 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine sauerkraut, spinach, fish, cheese and marshmallows and pour into ungreased 9x13 baking dish. Stir to blend, then press into pan in an even layer. Bake uncovered for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coffee,head napa cabbage,baby spinach,caster sugar,pumpkin seed
title: Pumpkin Nuts and Spinach
ingredients: 3 baby spinach, trimmed | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 1/2 medium head napa cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup strong coffee | 3/4 cup caster sugar ( superfine sugar )
instructions: Steam the spinach until wilted, about 10 minutes, and drain well. Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1 minute, stirring frequently. Cool slightly. Toast the cabbage in a dry frying pan and set aside. Wash, dry, and break up any large pieces. Bring the coffee to the boil in a small pan with the sugar. Pour the hot coffee over the spinach, mix well, and allow to stand until cool. Serve the cooked napa cabbage on a plate. Stir the spinach mixture into it, sprinkle with the roasted seeds, and serve.

Random Ingredients: zwieback toast crumb,pearl barley,okra,farfalle pasta,guinness stout,tart apple,chili oil
title: Baked Irish Okra (Tourteis County)
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh okra, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 tart apples, unpeeled, cored, and core removed ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/8 cup pearl barley | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 12 ounces quarts guinness stout | 1 lb farfalle pasta, cooked ( elbow macaroni, or fettuccine ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons wondra or 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 1 teaspoon water
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place the okra and apples in a large baking dish. Drizzle with the oil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Arrange the barley in a layer over the okra. Dollop on the guinness, and top with the farfalle pasta. Bake at 375f for 45 minutes, until hot. To make your sauce, warm a small pot over medium low heat, and stir in the cornstarch. Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the water. Add the sauce and stir until hot again.

title: Artichokes
ingredients: 3 small corn, shucked | 2 medium emmentaler cheese | 1 small green peas or 1 small yellow peas, washed and cut crosswise | 5 slices oranges, thin with peel
instructions: Cut the cheese into four pieces. Set them all together and cut the peel in fine thin slices about 1/4 thick. With the point of a knife, cut all around the cheese, stopping about 1 inch from the top of the shucked corn. Insert the peels onto the strips, and arrange the cheese strips evenly over the top. Pour a scant 1/2 inch of water into a 12 inch cast iron skillet. Place in the skillet and cook over low heat until it has evaporated to about half its original amount. About 5 minutes. Turn the heat off. Using a slotted spoon, lift out the cheese and place into a bowl. Using a wide metal spoon, remove the corn strips from the skillet and set aside. Use two forks, pull the meat out of the shell, discarding the corn. Stir the meat back inches and place back on the stovetop. Scatter the peas over the cheese. Cover with the cheese strips and cook over low heat until the cheese has softened, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the corn strips from the skillet and arrange them on top of the cheese strips. Use a wide metal spoon to remove any remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,spanish onion,curry powder,french bread,filling,stock,double cream
title: Curry Soup
ingredients: 6 slices french bread, toasted | 2 tablespoons stock | 1 onion, finely chopped | filling : | 1 pint beef stock | 20 g curry powder | 30 ml double cream
instructions: Cook and stir onion in a large saucepan over low heat until translucent. Add remaining ingredients and simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour. Allow to cool slightly. Transfer cooled soup to moulds, or individual moulds. Serve cold.

title: Lori's Little Italy Ladyfinger (Lori's Version)
ingredients: 40 -50 ladyfingers, washed | 1/2 cup romano cheese | 7 tablespoons asiago cheese, grated
instructions: Combine grated cheese with asiago cheese spread onto ladyfinger fingers. Roll up each ladyfinger and enjoy this simple, easy, and tasty one.

title: Thai Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb savory or 1 lb chile garlic spinach, chopped | 2 cups fresh spinach or 2 cups frozen spinach, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 bunch watercress, chopped ( garnish )
instructions: Clean the spinach and remove the hard stems and outer leaves in the curly leaves. In a salad bowl, combine the herbs and fish sauce. Toss with green dressing. Place greens on plates, top with salad and serve immediately.

title: Sausage Enchilada Rollups
ingredients: 1 package pork sausage, shredded | 1 package corn tortillas | 2/3 cup catsup
instructions: Combine sausage, tortillas, and catsup.

Random Ingredients: dark corn syrup,egg white,brie cheese,anise seed,lemon juice,kalamata olive
title: Anise Infused Brie Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 ounces brie cheese | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 lb fresh brie cheese | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 3 large egg whites | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 cup of finely diced kalamata olive
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 farenheit. Slice brie into very thin slices 1/8 inch thick. Lightly coat a 9 x13 dish with cooking spray. Place brie slices into the prepared pan over lowest heat and cook until just beginning to soften, about 2 minutes. Remove brie from heat and stir in lemon juice. When ready to fill the cheesecake, lightly butter a 1 1/2 quart round glass or ceramic dish. Place the prepared dish and cheesecake into the dish and tap it gently on the counter. In a large bowl, beat egg whites lightly with anise seeds. Add the finely chopped olives. Stir in 1/2 of the hot mixture into the yolk mixture, then stir in remaining hot mixture until blended. Pour egg mixture into the lined dish. Place pan in larger pan of hot water and bake for about 50 - 60 minutes until golden and puffed. Remove cheesecake to cooling rack and run it under warm water briefly until all excess water has drained off and cheesecake is glazed. Remove cheesecake and allow to cool completely. Once all of the cheesecake has cooled completely, transfer it carefully and evenly onto a serving plate. Spoon glaze over the top, sprinkle top with sesame seeds and serve at once, with warm bread.

title: Hot Chinese Cabbage
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1 1/2 lbs chopped ham
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small skillet over high heat. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,fish fillet,red chili pepper flake,pearl onion,garlic,greek yogurt,beef bouillon cube,vanilla sugar
title: Tunisian Beef Kofta Croquettes
ingredients: 500 g beef bouillon cubes | 250 g greek yogurt | 1/2 glass cornmeal | 1 large garlic ( whole ) | 1 red chili pepper ( long and very very finely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | pearl onions | 5 tablespoons parsley, chopped
instructions: Place the beef in a colander and pour boiling water over to cover. Place the colander in a large bowl and leave to drain for 15 minutes. Place remaining ingredients into a blender with 3/4 cup of yoghurt and whiz to a thick paste. Add to the croquette. Mix well so all ingredients are combined. Spoon 1 tablespoon of mixture onto a square of baking paper to form a 6 inch oval shape. Fold both sides of the oval in half diagonally and firmly pressing to seal. Repeat for other kofta. Preheat the oven to 150°c. Heat a little water and wrap koftas in the baking paper and seal with a lid. Place on a baking tray on a high heat in oven for about 20 mins, turning once. Serve with salads, salad, tomatoes, cucumbers or anything else.

Random Ingredients: red potato,monterey jack cheese,greek yogurt,pepper,sea salt,raspberry,leg lamb,grain white rice
title: Raspberry and Lamb Gratin
ingredients: 12 raspberries ( fresh, not frozen ) | 2 tablespoons whole grain white rice | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 3/4 lb boneless leg of lamb ( or thighs ) | 2 ounces monterey jack cheese, sliced into 24 1 1/2 inch chunks | 2 red potatoes ( about 8 small, halved and thin sliced ) | 1 cup fat free greek yogurt | pepper, to taste
instructions: Place raspberries in a food processor.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,chili paste,shrimp stock chicken,orange juice,bicarbonate soda,heavy whipping cream
title: Quick and Easy Spicy Orange Shrimp Soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 100 g shrimp stock or 100 g chicken stock | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Blend or process the chilli paste, cardamom powder and shrimp stock in a blender until smooth. Add bicarb and cream. Heat gently and gently for 5 minutes. Stir in orange juice. Add salt to taste.

title: Tortellini Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Place tomato sauce and chili paste into a saucepan and heat over medium low heat, until sauce is thickened. Stir together the italian seasoning with the chili paste.

Random Ingredients: oil black olive,white mushroom,tomato juice,corn oil,jumbo shrimp
title: Tomato and Mushroom Shrimp Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 14 -16 jumbo shrimp, cleaned | 1 -3 tablespoon oil from stewed tomatoes ( i use seasoned olive oil ) | 2 cans sliced white mushrooms | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Put in a large pot, add 2 cups water, stewed tomatoes, olive oil, corn oil, mushrooms and tomato juice. Bring to a boil and let boil for 20 minutes or so. Add shrimp. Cover and steam for 30 minutes. Variation, when this is done, you can add the tomato sauce and shrimp. Note, the flavor of this dish improves with 1 - 2 cans of tomatoes and then serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,cider vinegar,beef shank,red onion,bay leaf,pine nut
title: Slow-Cooker Shank for the BBQ
ingredients: 2 beef shank, trimmed | 2 bay leaves | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 cup chopped red onion | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Rinse shanks well. If beef shanks have sinew, remove bones and excess fat, but cut into 2 inch lengths. Place bay leaves in bottom of slow cooker. Place beef shanks, pinched sides down, on top of bay leaves. Place a large plate or roasting pan over beef shanks. Add vinegar to cooker. Cover and cook on low setting 4 to 5 hours or on high setting 3 to 4 hours. Remove bay leaves, slice meat, and arrange on platter. Top with onions and cilantro.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,green olive,vanilla bean,green chile,pine nut,lipton onion soup mix,soymilk
title: Creamy Mexican Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soymilk | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean | 1 tablespoon sliced green olives | 1 tablespoon chopped smoked green chile | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1 packet lipton onion soup mix
instructions: In a blender or food processor combine the soymilk, vanilla bean, olives and chiles. Cover and blend on high 30 seconds to blend thoroughly. Pour the mixture into a medium jar and add the cream, stirring well to dissolve the milk. Cover and chill until serving.

title: Marinated Fish
ingredients: 1 red pepper paste ( or less to suit you ) | 1 small fish ( such as rockfish, snapper, hake, turbot mahi, or cod ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato | 1/4 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Rinse and dry the fish thoroughly. Mix all of the above ingredients and add fish. Marinate the fish in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Serve as is or use to mix together. Note, use as listed below.

title: Date Nips
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips, cut into thin wedges | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce ( such as heinz ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons dates, chopped
instructions: Cook parsnips and sweet chile sauce in large skillet over medium heat, stirring with chopsticks, until tender, about 10 minutes. Stir garam masala and dates into parsnips. Serve and enjoy.

title: Gorgonzola Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 ounces gorgonzola | 2 large shallots, peeled chopped | 8 ounces pomegranate syrup | 2 1/2 cups milk powder | 2 ounces brandy, such as cognac
instructions: Place the gorgonzola, shallots, pomegranate syrup and milk powder in a pan over low heat. Cook until the flavors have mingled and the gorgonzola and sauce has thickened. Pour into an ice cream maker and process until it reaches your desired texture. Store in the freezer until ready to use. Serve in a bowl with pomegranate sprinkled over the top.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,pita bread,baking powder,cornstarch,red chili pepper flake,chicken stock,balsamic vinegar
title: Spicy Fennel-Hot Bread
ingredients: 1 whole fennel bulb, sliced ( can use a combination ) | 2 slices pita bread | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon hot red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Heat a griddle over medium heat, add fennel. Cook until the fennel is golden on the outside. Let cool. Slice fennel about 1/4 thick and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium heat in a sauce pan, add pita bread and bake until crisp. Put bread on a plate. Spoon fennel and 1 tablespoon of stock into a saucepan, stir in remaining liquid, cornstarch, vinegar, baking powder, and hot pepper flakes. Bring to a boil and let thicken. Add fennel and any accumulated juices. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pigeon pea,garlic powder,parsnip,button mushroom,spinach,chinese rice wine,olive oil,black pepper
title: Pearls of Heaven
ingredients: 15 brussels sprouts or 14 large parsnips | 15 sweet papery pickled herms | 10 pigeon pea, frozen ( canned ) | 15 button mushrooms | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 3 tablespoons parsley, chopped fresh | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1 tablespoon chinese rice wine
instructions: Cut brinjal diagonally at 2&#8260.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,vanilla sugar,parsley leaf,meat beef,shallot,black bean,leek
title: Sara's Beans, Leeks and Meat
ingredients: 1 lb dried meat ( beef, poultry, goat, scallop for example ) | 1/2 lb dried porcini mushrooms | 1 medium leek | 1 shallot | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed ( cannellini, white bean will work too ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar ( or any other sweetener desired ) | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Combine the black beans, cheese, and parsley in a large pot. Mix in the meat, mushrooms, leek and shallot. Add 1 can of beans and half of water. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes over low heat. Add sugar or vanilla and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until meat is completely cooked and vegetables are softened. Serve with prawns, scallops, bread, crackers or pita chips. Note, this dish freezes well.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,parsnip,oregano leaf,tofu,liquid honey,peanut butter,linguine pasta,chicken leg
title: Garlic Herb Pasta
ingredients: 1 package linguine-style pasta | 3 small chicken legs ( about 2 pounds total ) | 10 -12 ounces firm tofu, drained of its excess liquid and grated | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves ( or 1 tbsp fresh minced ) | 1 1/2 cups low-fat ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1 tablespoon peanut butter, unsalted | fresh parsley or parsley, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of about 1/2 salted water to a boil. Add linguine pasta and chicken. Cook 10 minutes or until pasta is al dente.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,spanish onion,collard green,italian sausage,breadcrumb,pineapple juice,vanilla
title: Stuffed Collard Greens
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs collard greens, washed | 1 lb italian sausage, casings removed and crumbled | 1 large spanish onion, chopped ( or other white onion of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons pineapples in juice, finely chopped ( or applesauce ) | 2 tablespoons light tasting oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon breadcrumbs
instructions: Wash and cut collard greens into 1/2 inch pieces. Bring 1 - ½ quarts of salted water to a boil and blanch collards for 1 minute. Drain and plunge collards into cold water, swishing them as you add them to the boiling water. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, cook sausage, breaking it up into small pieces, in a large deep frying pot over medium high heat. When sausage is cooked through, add chopped onions. Cook until onions are translucent, then remove from heat. Drain liquid from sausage and sausage. Discard all but 1 - ½ cups. Wash collards and slice them in half lengthwise. Place them into a large bowl of cold water, and squeeze any excess moisture. When sausage mixture is cool enough to handle, mix in collard greens, onion and pineapple in juice, oyster sauce and vanilla. Gently fold in breadcrumbs. Cover, and refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving, stirring once. Tastes best the next day. A note from the article, you could also use regular bacon bits, minced, sausages, chopped onions, sliced or diced mushrooms, green peppers, tomatoes, ham, mushrooms or other fillings, etc. For a special flavor try with chipotle chorizo, cheddar cheese or as desired a combination of these.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,pimiento,red chili pepper,salt,wheat flour,nori,flour
title: Faux Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups long grain white rice | 1 1/2 cups water | 1/2 cup pimiento, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1 pinch salt ( to taste ) | 3/4 cup flour | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Combine rice water, pimiento, salt and chili pepper. Heat until boiling. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 45 - 60 minutes. In bowl, combine flour and nori. When rice is finished cooking, drain and place it in the bowl and mix well. Heat a lightly greased nonstick pan under medium level heat and fry seaweed 2 - 3 minutes on each side. Serve hot over a rice dish. Serve extra crispy rice on the side.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,streaky bacon,pork butt,pork fillet,red potato,lemon pepper,bean sprout,sea salt
title: Pork & Potato Baked in Garlic Lemon & Thyme
ingredients: 1 pork leg with plenty of fat, about 1 3/4 pound in weight | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1 lb small red potatoes, washed cut into bite size pieces ( unpeeled ) | sea salt | 500 g streaky bacon, with rind, cut into chunks | pork fillet | 2 cans bean sprouts | 2 lemons, juice of
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190ºc or mark 6, 190ºc if using a fan forced oven. Score the skin on the pork leg with two thick slits. Sprinkle over the crushed red pepper and place into an oiled oven dish. Make diagonal slashes on the pork rind about 2cm deep, making sure not to cut all the way through the meat. Place the potatoes on top as you go, in a single layer. Season with salt and toss gently in the oil. When the pork has been thrown, sprinkle on the breadcrumbs and mix with your hands. Place the chops on top of the potatoes with a layer of salt. Cut the bacon into 3/4 inch lengths and place on top of the bacon. Place in the oven and cook for 45 minutes, turning the meat and potatoes halfway through. Squeeze 2 of the lemons over the meat. Sprinkle the juice over everything and leave for at least 15 minutes. Serve with a lemon wedge and salad.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,extra virgin olive oil,cinnamon sugar,oregano
title: Pork Sausages With Cinnamon Sugar
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage ( you will need one ) | 2 teaspoons cinnamon sugar ( or to taste. i like more ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Slice the pork sausage into small pieces about 2 x 1/4 and place on parchment lined tray. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and oregano. Brush pork sausage with olive oil. Bake 15 to 20 minutes on middle rack of oven until golden brown.

title: Venezuelan Stuffed Rice Balls
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain white rice | 1 cup prepared chili sauce | 1/3 cup soft mild goat cheese | 6 slices prosciutto | 2 ounces crumbled goat cheese
instructions: Cook rice in enough boiling water to cover for 20 minutes. Rinse, drain, and set aside. Cover rice with chili sauce, and then sprinkle on 3 slices of prosciutto and 3 slices of goat cheese. Roll up.

title: Pasta With Black Beans, Garlic, Garlic & Rosemary
ingredients: 450 g pasta | 300 ml double cream | 50 g rosemary | 2 tablespoons finely chopped sage | 1 large scotch bonnet pepper, chopped | 175 g black beans | 150 ml double cream
instructions: Cook pasta in lots of boiling, salted water.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,xanthan gum,italian bread,peel,green chili pepper,cream soup,cider vinegar,fish sauce
title: Thai Chili Cheese Ball (Vegan)
ingredients: 8 ounces cream of potato soup | 8 ounces olive oil, divided | 1 large green chili pepper, minced ( or 2 or 3 seeded jalapeno peppers ) | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon red chili paste or 1 teaspoon chile paste | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1 envelope xanthan gum | 1 teaspoon dried mixed peel | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons minced italian bread
instructions: Combine cream of potato soup and 3/4 cup water in a microwave safe measuring cup, on high power setting, until boiling. Lower heat and simmer on high for five minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, or until thickened and creamy. Add chili pepper and 1 tsp of olive oil, and stir. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Heat remaining olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add paste and the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil. Stir to form a paste.

title: Geeeyehees Rice Chaat (Rice Wine Snack)
ingredients: 2 cups rice wine | 1/4 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: In a large non stick frying pan, bring the rice wine and cumin powder to a boil. Pour wine into a 1 gallon ziplock bag and add the bag. After 10 minutes, remove the bag from the bag and snip off the green stuff that appears on the outside of the bag. Discard the wine bag. Return the bag to the stove on medium heat and cook for 5 minutes, or until the sauce looks dry on top. Add a teaspoon of water if needed to help the wine evaporate at a certain point. Let the alcohol cook off on the alcohol. Remove from heat and enjoy.

title: Mexican Mac & Beef
ingredients: 12 ounces elbow macaroni, uncooked | 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 1 can old el paso mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 1/2 cups oatmeal | 1 turnip, peeled, halved, and diced | 1 small hass avocado, peeled, seeded, and diced
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions on package, drain, and set aside. Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Stir in ground sirloin until browned.

title: Apricot-Peanut Butter Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried apricot jam | 1 tablespoon lemon rind ( grated ) | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon dried onion flakes
instructions: Heat jam and lemon rind throughly in a small saucepan over low heat. Whisk peanut butter and onion in a small bowl until smooth. Fold into jam mixture until well combined. Transfer to glass container that has been coated with a nonstick spray or a nonstick cooking spray.

title: Peanut-Bean-Stuffed Roast Pork Loaf
ingredients: 4 tablespoons coarsely chopped salted peanuts | 2 lbs rump roast, trimmed | 12 ounces mixed beans sprouts, rinsed and drained | 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Using the back of a spoon, spread the coarsely chopped peanuts slightly over the surface of the pork. Sprinkle the bottom of a 9 by 5 by 3 loaf pan with 2 teaspoons of the cheese. Roll the meat lengthwise in the remaining 1 tablespoon of cheese and set aside. Insert a toothpick into the roast and tuck the meat up around the toothpick. Insert the remaining cheese in the opening at the 2 inch mark. Spread the bean sprouts over the top. Bake, uncovered, for 50 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 300°f. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the internal temperature of the pork is 140 degrees f for medium rare, or 170 degrees f for medium well.

title: Italian Spinach (Oamc) 2
ingredients: 1 box frozen spinach, thawed and drained well | 2 teaspoons grated fresh lemon juice | 4 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup shredded romano cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine spinach with lemon juice. Cover, set aside. Microwave brandy in a small saucepan for 2 minutes. Stir to dissolve. Stir, then microwave for 30 seconds. Stir in barbecue sauce. Pour mixture into an 8x8 inch baking dish, spreading evenly. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, uncovered, in a 300 degree f oven for 50 minutes or until heated through. Serve warm.

title: Lemon Peanut Butter Leek Spread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/2 lb leeks, sliced | 8 ounces peanut butter | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Soak leeks in cold water until softened, but not mushy. Drain. Combine all ingredients in food processor, process until well mixed, pour into large bowl, cover, refrigerate for at least 2 hours for flavours to blend. Serve with crackers.

title: Moroccan Tangy Orange Spiced Spiced Mocha
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon dried tamarind pulp | 3/4 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons brewed espresso
instructions: Toast fennel seeds in a dry skillet over medium high heat, shaking pan often, until fragrant and reddish in color, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a mortar and pestle, adding more oil if necessary. Add tamarind and 1/4 cup of orange juice and mash with a fork or with a pestle until mixture is smooth. Stir in espresso and continue grinding until liquid is reduced and slightly thickened, about 2 minutes. Stir in fennel seeds, then refrigerate the mocha mixture, covered, for 1 to 2 hours to develop flavors. If using a mortar and pestle, make sure mocha mixture does not stick to the mortar and pestle. Alternatively, you can also use the pestle/spice mixture to flavor ice cream.

title: Crostini D' Angelo
ingredients: parmesan cheese, for topping | superfine sugar, for topping
instructions: Toast parmesan over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often. Transfer to a serving bowl. Drizzle generously with superfine sugar. Enjoy.

title: Naked Olives
ingredients: 24 olives | breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut a slice of olives in half. Place one olive in each piece of bread. Sprinkle a little breadcrumbs onto olives, then sprinkle generously with breadcrumbs. Roll and secure with wooden toothpicks. Place in a pan, drizzle with olive oil or milk, and place in the oven at 220c/350f degrees, or until golden brown..

Random Ingredients: water,pecorino romano cheese,half,habanero pepper,celery rib,beef brisket,kalamata olive,whipping cream
title: Pecorino Al Salvia - Brisket of Beef on Olive Nests
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed | 24 ounces half-and-half | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | water ( optional ) | kalamata olive, sliced ( optional ) | shredded pecorino romano cheese ( optional ) | 3 medium celery ribs, sliced julienne | 3 habanero peppers, stemmed, seeded and minced | 10 kalamata olives, quartered, pitted and chopped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 ººf. Place brisket in roasting pan. Add half&half, flour and water to pan. If mixture is too thick, stir in water by 1/4 cupfuls or until mixture will not stick. Cover and bake until meat easily pulls away from sides of pan, about 2 hours. Turn meat over and cook until meat thermometer registers 140ºf, about 30 minutes longer. Remove brisket from oven and pour off any accumulated juices in roasting pan. Cover and let stand for 15 minutes. Spoon olives and/or pecorino cheese into a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Drain brisket. Place beef on serving platter, loosely cover and refrigerate until firm, at least 3 hours and up to 6 days. Pour off drippings from roasting pan. Place oven rack in upper third of oven. Place 5 halved onions on rack. Place an olive in each onion and top with 1 tablespoons of pecorino.

Random Ingredients: bacon bit,milk raisin,brown breadcrumb,blue cheese,egg yolk,mayonnaise,prune,caper
title: Blue Cheese French Toast
ingredients: 8 slices light brown bread, crusts removed | 1/4 - 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 egg yolk ( optional ) | 2/3 cup milk-raisin blend | 1/2 cup crispy bacon bits | 4 ounces blue cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 1/4 - 1/2 cup prune, pitted
instructions: Whisk together mayonnaise and egg yolks. Whisk in milk raisins. Set aside. Spray griddle with cooking spray. Spray a 9 x 13 pan with cooking spray. Dip bread slices into egg mixture. Set aside. Grate cheese and sprinkle on top of dipped bread. Spread remaining mayonnaise mix on top. Sprinkle with capers and prunes. Bake at 350°f for 40 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Hazelnut Pepper Damper
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts or 1 cup blanched almond | 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped green pepper | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 degrees c. Spread hazelnuts on a baking tray and bake for about 10 minutes, or until toasted and nuts are golden brown. Remove from oven and cool nuts. Mix all ingredients, except for nuts, into bowl and shape into a loaf. Bake for about 1 hour, or until crusty.

title: Yummilicious Easy No Time To Cook Eggs
ingredients: 7 large egg yolks | 2 tablespoons miso ( i use lite and it works well but i like the taste of the lime ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | avocado, slices for garnish
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk egg yolks with miso. Mix well. Then add can of rotel tomatoes and chilies. Mix well. Pour mixture into a 9 inch square pan lined with aluminum foil and put in the freezer. Do not stir. Let it sit for about 20 to 30 minutes. Remove pan from freezer and top with avocado slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,almond extract,cheesecloth,coriander,penne rigate,maple syrup,white onion,cumin seed
title: Baked Penne With Onion, Almonds, and Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 lb penne rigate ( rigate is available at specialty grocery stores and some supermarkets ) | 1 large vidalia onion, diced | 6 tablespoons finely diced white onions | 2 tablespoons white onions, finely diced | 4 tablespoons oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon cumin seed, toasted and ground | 2 tablespoons ground coriander | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 1/2 tablespoons alamatic extract | 2 cups cheesecloth
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 1 gallon sized baking pan with some cooking spray. In a bowl, mix the onions, and spices with about half of your cheese cloth's dried spices. Stir the olive oil into your mixture. Toss the rigate and onions so mixture is evenly coated. Then place into the baking pan. Bake in your pre heated oven for about 35 - 45 minutes, or until the rigate is lightly browned and cooked through. Remove from the oven, and let sit 5 minutes. Then place on a plate. Place a large serving plate alongside the rigate, and carefully remove the cheese cloth's. This will serve to your great guests.

Random Ingredients: potato flake,herb stuffing mix,red onion,monterey jack cheddar cheese,cheddar cheese,italian salad dressing,green olive,ice water
title: Potato Cheese & Cheese Stuffed Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 package potato flakes ( about 24 potato ) | 1/4 cup minced red onion | 1 package shredded low-fat cheddar cheese | 1 package shredded low-fat monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend cheese blend | 1 package herb stuffing mix | ice water | 2 tablespoons melted low-fat italian salad dressing | 1/4 cup chopped green olives ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Lightly grease a 10x3 inch baking dish. In a mixing bowl, using a fork, combine the potato flakes, red onion, cheeses, stuffing mix, and water. Mix well until the mixture is very well coated with potatoes. Using a spoon, make 1 inch sized indentations in the dry stuffing mix with your fingers. Fill the hollowed out the dough with about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture. Gently roll the dough around the cheese until well coated. Place the bread on a plate, and refrigerate until firm, about 20 minutes. Brush olive or lemon dressing on top. Bake for about 30 mins. Remove from the oven and cut into quarters or bite sized pieces. Top with green olives if using, and return to the oven for about 15 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve warm.

title: Italian Nuts
ingredients: 3 ounces cheddar cheese, grated | 2 medium oranges | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: Cut the zest from the two oranges and drop them into boiling water. As soon as they turn bright green and curl, drain them under cold water and drop them immediately into the drained oranges. Immediately peel the zest with a vegetable peeler, then, using a pastry brush, apply the zest to the cheddar in small, thin, pieces. Arrange on a serving platter and sprinkle with pistachios. Nuts can also be served chilled, but they are more attractive when cooled completely.

title: Peanut (Prawns from Yemen)
ingredients: 1 lb raw prawns ( prawns of calamari ) | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Place the prawns on a plate, sprinkle with lemon peel, and chill in the refrigerator. The prawns will be ready to cook.

title: Crispy Italian Sausage and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 link mild italian sausage | 2 1/2 lbs snow peas or 2 1/2 lbs green beans, trimmed and cut into 2-inch lengths | 1 cup fresh basil or 1 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, torn or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil | 3 cups fresh arugula or 3 cups curly parsley, for garnish
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Cook sausage on grill about 5 minutes per side, until cooked through.

title: Apple Chutney
ingredients: 600 g yoghurt, plain | 450 g tart apples ( peeled, cored and chopped )
instructions: Combine yoghurt, apples and seasoning in bowl or jug. Cover and refridgerate overnight.

title: Spicy Chili Oil
ingredients: 2 red chile peppers, cut into 1/3 inch pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Grind the chile peppers with a mortar and pestle or a blender until finely ground. Add the oil in small pieces to a clean jar and shake vigorously to mix. Use to make any spicy food.

title: Italian Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb chuck steak, sliced thin | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 roma tomato, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons fresh dill weed, chopped ( optional ) | 10 -12 crusty italian rolls, split, toasted
instructions: In skillet, over high heat, brown beef slices for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, cut rolls in half and add to skillet with remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: rice,monterey jack cheddar cheese,double cream,kahlua,semolina flour,butter,mustard powder,yellow pepper
title: Molten Yellow Pepper Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yellow peppers | 1/3 cup shahlua | 6 cups cooked rice | 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | sifted confectioners'sugar | 1 cup double cream, whipped | 1 cup semolina flour, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f with rack in middle. Arrange peppers and shahlua in 1 - ½ quart baking dish.

title: Broccoli and Date Casserole
ingredients: 6 ounces frozen broccoli | 1 lb ground beef bouillon cube ( i use one bag of mccormick's brand steak seasoning with garlic ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 small handful fresh dates, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper
instructions: Cut the broccoli in half and steam in an open steamer until firm. Let cool and shred the larger pieces if they are large. Place the ground beef in a medium saucepan with the cream and chopped dates. Add the broccoli and cook over medium heat until it begins to get hot, stirring frequently. Add the crushed pepper and stir to blend. Cook for 2 - 3 minutes, or until broccoli is steamed and mixture is warmed through. Taste and add more seasonings if desired. Remove the beef and season to taste and toss with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,green bean,cooking oil,thyme sprig,water,dill pickle
title: French Green Beans With Dill Pickle
ingredients: 2 cups thinly sliced green beans ( or french style baby string beans ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh dill pickle ( or small dice ) | 4 cups water | 1 medium red fresh thyme sprig ( optional ) | cooking oil or vegetable oil ( for deep frying ) | serrano pepper, stemmed
instructions: Place the green beans, dill pickles, and water into a deep saucepan or medium size pot that has a cover. Bring to a boil and cover. Reduce heat, medium/low, and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, or until beans are tender. Meanwhile, in a small skillet, heat the thyme and cooking oil over medium heat. Cut the pickle into thin slices and add them to the hot oil. When the pickle starts to sizzle, add the pickle slices. Cover and cook another 5 - 7 minutes until the pickle slices are to your desired thickness. You may not need to drain the water from the pickle. You should still have some sauce left. Serve hot as an appetizer with crackers. Note, if you make this dish for lunch, you can prepare the recipe right away, but the taste of the pickle and pickle will be different. The hot mustard will make the pickle and pickle taste a little bit spicier, so don't substitute with white vinegar or water.

Random Ingredients: white tequila,yellow cornmeal,thai red chili pepper,oyster sauce,lettuce,oregano,couscous,rom tomato
title: Tex-Mex Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups prepared couscous | 1/4 cup white tequila ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon thai red chili pepper ( optional or to taste ) | 1 head lettuce | 4 roma tomatoes | 1/3 cup yellow cornmeal
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package directions. When ready to serve, whisk the sauce ingredients together and set aside. Tear and quarter tomatoes. Arrange rice on a large platter. Tear and quarter lettuce into bite size pieces and arrange in an overlapping spiral around the couscous. Top with a generous portion of tomato, and a drizzle of sauce. Sprinkle cornmeal on top, if desired.

Random Ingredients: fruit,peach,white pepper,dill weed,half cream,black peppercorn,salad green,rice
title: Garden Peaches
ingredients: 4 peach slices | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 lb fresh mixed salad greens | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns | 12 all-grain converted rice | 6 fresh dill sprigs ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 dash mixed spice ( optional ) | fresh fruit, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: Arrange the peaches in an even layer in a shallow baking dish just large enough to hold them. Cover with the cream. Sprinkle with the fresh herbs, then cover with the rice, pepper and the spice mix, if using. Cover, and chill for at least one hour. Just before serving garnish with fresh fruit.

title: Chicken & Cream in a Dutch Oven
ingredients: chicken breast meat ( from the deli rotisserie is fine ) | 1 pint whipping cream
instructions: Remove breasts from refrigerator and wash for a couple of minutes under warm running water. Pat dry with paper towels or blot with paper towels. Lay breasts flat on large sheet on low in hot dutch oven. Sprinkle cream lightly on top. Place lid on top and bake in 350 degree oven for 40 minutes or until cream is reduced by one third and chicken is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,tomato paste,cheese ravioli,black bean,lamb stew meat,plain yogurt,phyllo pastry
title: Vegetarian Lasagne
ingredients: 2 ounces dried cheese ravioli | 1 lb lean lamb stew meat, diced ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup chopped porcini mushrooms ( about 1/2 small onion ) | 1 can tomato paste | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package frozen cheese ravioli | 1/2 cup plain yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees f. Place ravioli in a large bowl, or shallow bowls. Cover with very hot tap water and soak for about 20 minutes, or until al dente. Remove from water and set aside. Meanwhile, in a dutch oven or other large oven safe casserole dish, saute lamb over medium high heat, stirring, until meat is browned and liquid has evaporated. Add mushrooms and cook 3 to 4 minutes, or until mushrooms are softened and liquid has evaporated. Stir in tomato paste and black beans. Spoon a small amount of sauce into the bottom of a 2 quart baking dish. Place 2 layers of ravioli over sauce, overlapping and sprinkling sauce between layers. Top with half of the remaining sauce. Cover with half of the ravioli, then top with remaining pasta and remaining sauce. Top with remaining sauce. Cover with plastic wrap and a lid. Bake 30 to 35 minutes, or until noodles are tender and sauce is warmed through. Top with crumbled feta cheese to serve.

Random Ingredients: mexican corn,curry powder,confectioner ' sugar,couscous,head iceberg lettuce
title: Curried Couscous with Corn and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 package couscous | 1 head iceberg lettuce, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can mexican-style corn, drained | 1 package confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Stir in couscous, remove from heat, and cover for 2 minutes. Place lettuce in a large bowl. Drain and rinse with cool water. Add drained corn to lettuce. Mix couscous, cabbages with onion, and confectioners' sugar together in a large bowl. Pour hot couscous mixture over lettuce mixture and toss to combine. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,confectioner sugar,bacon,beef stew meat,tamarind paste,jalapeno pepper,cilantro stem,garlic
title: Beef Stew (Sinengalu Manjuu)
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into cubes | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 4 slices bacon | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno pepper | 2 teaspoons caraway seed | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems | 2 teaspoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Drain the water from the tamarind and soak the strips in it for at least 15 minutes. Place the bacon in a skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the garlic, jalapeno, caraway seeds and cilantro and season with salt. Place the lamb in the skillet and brown on all sides. Drain off excess fat. Place the onions and jalapeno into the skillet with the meat. Blend the remaining tamarind juice and the water in the skillet and pour over the meat. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is very tender and the sauce has thickened. Remove the lamb and onions to a serving bowl and let cool to room temperature.

title: Spaghetti With Almonds, Cauliflower and Cauliflower
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti noodles, broken in half | 1/3 cup vegetable oil ( butter or margarine ) | 1 cup cauliflower, chopped | 2 whole cloves | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling water until al dente, drain. Meanwhile, heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add onion and saute 15 minutes. Stir in cauliflower and cook til just tender, and cauliflower is crisp tender. Stir in the cloves and almonds. Put into a warm bowl just before serving.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,bamboo skewer,ginger garlic paste,white wine vinegar,maraschino cherry
title: Chilled Vinegar Ramen
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh ginger garlic paste | 4 bamboo skewers, soaked in cold water for 1 hour | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 jar maraschino cherries, in juice and vinegar separated
instructions: Line a chilled bowl with plastic wrap.

title: Fettucine With Chicken and Tahini (Nati Babhi Yiahsi)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tahini or 3 tablespoons sesame paste | 2 1/2 lbs cooked meat, chopped | 1 lb small dried fettuccine pasta | fine sea salt
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the tahini and meat, adding a little pasta cooking water if the recipe suggests a thinner sauce. Fold in the pasta, season with sea salt and toss. Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for a minimum of 1 hour before serving.

title: Celery & Tomato Crusted Scallops on Country Rolls
ingredients: 24 large scallops | 1/2 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/2 tablespoon ground herb or 2 tablespoons mixed herbs | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 teaspoon dried mixed herbs ( or 2 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs ) | 1 1/2 cups packaged coleslaw mix ( red or runner beans ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh herb or 1 tablespoon fresh mixed herb ( or 1 tablespoon chopped fresh herbs )
instructions: Prepare scallops in preheated oven, 375°f. Combine tomato paste, herbs, flour, cream, wine and mixed herbs in shallow dish. Place 2 tablespoons of the mixture between the scallops and roll up scallops tightly. Secure both ends of the rolled scallops with toothpicks. Dry roll with paper towel. Bake 25 - 30 minutes covered with foil. Serve with cooked seasonal vegetables for a meal.

title: Greek Margaritas
ingredients: 1/2 cup tequila | 1 orange, zest of
instructions: Muddle orange in the bottom of a cocktail shaker. Add the tequila. Shake and strain into a salt rimmed glass. Enjoy.

title: Fiesta Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, pared and cubed | 3 lbs green cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 cup green chilies, chopped ( canned ) | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 cup raisins ( can use sultanas )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours. Drain and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,knockwurst hebrew national kosher,parsley,hot paprika,haddock fillet
title: Baked Haddock Gourmet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hot smoked paprika, divided ( we like penzeys traditional greek style ) | 2 tablespoons finely grated lemon zest ( about 1 teaspoon ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh parsley | 2 lbs flounder, whole fish fillets ( such as halibut or haddock ) or 2 lbs haddock fillets ( such as halibut or haddock ) | 6 polish rock salt-parsley branches ( about 8 inches in diameter ) or other decorative candied salt, for garnish ( about 8 inches in diameter )
instructions: Sprinkle 1 1/2 teaspoons of the chile powder and the zest and parsley evenly over the fish fillets. Arrange fillets in a shallow baking dish and pour 3 tablespoons hot paprika over them. Let stand at room temp to marinate at least 10 minutes or up to 3 hours. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Bake the fish covered with foil in a preheated 350°f oven for about 40 minutes. Meanwhile, place 1 wood chip in the oven and turn the heat up to 450°f. Break apart and place in a small decorative bowl or jar and coat with olive oil. Bake the fish for a further 25 to 30 minutes, or until cooked through. Remove fish and chips from oven and spoon the gourmet sauce over the fish. Garnish with additional fresh parsley and a wedge of polish rock salt before serving.

title: Spinach With Farro
ingredients: 1 box frozen spinach | 1 package veggie instant granules | 1 cube vegetable bouillon granules
instructions: Wash the spinach. When you get to the point where there is about 1/3 of water in the microwave, put a vegetable fryer or large skimmer or a soup pot into it for about a minute to defrost it. You want to just hit on the heat at about 1/2 teaspoon of pressure. This allows the water to boil off, then it will steam in the microwave if it gets too hot. If you didn't have frozen spinach, just chop a few big bunches of spinach. It will all just hit you. Heat the veg. In the microwave or microwave safe bowl with the water and bullion in it, cook it on medium, stirring twice, until it gets hot. Stir into the pot. Do not stir again. Simmer for about 5 minutes or so longer to thaw the spinach just enough to use up all the liquid. If you're done, put on a sieve and drain the water off. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,raspberry,iceberg lettuce,green pepper,edible flower,pesto sauce,almond
title: Italian Style Salad Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 heads iceberg lettuce | 1 cup green pepper, chopped ( i use red ) | 1 cup edible flower | 8 ounces low-fat provolone cheese, diced | 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh raspberry jam ( optional ) | 1 jar commercial roasted sweetened pesto sauce
instructions: Cut lettuce into wedges. Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl and toss lightly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,tarragon leaf,swiss chard,coriander powder,pork stew meat,apple,sun tomato
title: Moroccan Pork and Swiss Chard Lovers
ingredients: 4 cups thinly sliced swiss chard | 2/3 cup peeled, and chopped fresh apple | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon leaves | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 cup warm water
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the chard, sun dried tomatoes, tarragon, yeast, and coriander in the warm water. Let rise, covered, in a draft free place until the yeast softens and begins to form a creamy foam on top, about 45 minutes. Stir in the chard mixture and place in a large, shallow baking dish. Cover and refrigerate until the chard has expanded and is bubbly around the edges, about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Uncover the chard mixture.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella string cheese,beef bouillon cube,dark chocolate,mustard,water chestnut
title: Beef, Water Chestnut & Chocolate Gratin
ingredients: 12 slices lean beef ( the top is always under the griller! ) | 6 slices mozzarella string cheese | 1 cup coarsely chopped water chestnut | 1 prepared mustard | 2 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: Melt the beef and string cheese in the microwave. Spread each slice of string cheese on one side of the grilled beef and then spread on the rest of the string cheese. Wrap in the beef and string cheese. Place the gratin in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours to set up. After the beef is set, slice into thin slices when ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: salt,picante sauce,queso blanco,irish whiskey,chicken bouillon,gouda cheese,button mushroom
title: Queso Blanco Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup queso blanco | 1 cup grated smoked gouda cheese | 1/2 cup sliced button mushrooms, or to taste | salt to taste | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon irish flavored whiskey | salt to taste
instructions: Pour queso blanco, gouda cheese, and button mushrooms into the pan used to cook the cheese. Season with salt, as desired. Pour in the chicken bouillon, and ignite. When the cheese is melted, stir in the whiskey, and serve at once.

title: Moroccan Mango and Mandarin Oranges
ingredients: 1 cup chopped peeled mangoes or 1 cup chopped mixed dried fruit | 1 tablespoon dried mandarin orange | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 green onions | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease 9 inch square baking dish. Combine mango, orange peel, turmeric and coriander in a large bowl. Stir in green onions. Cut each pastry sheet in half.

title: Sweet Potato, Egg and Beef Brisket

instructions: Place salt pork in a large dutch oven.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,chicken bouillon cube,white sugar,chicken thigh
title: Pa's Favorite Easy Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 chicken bouillon cube, crumbled | 6 skinless, boneless chicken thighs | 1 package uncooked rice noodles
instructions: Combine the sugar and the bouillon cube in a saucepan over medium high heat. Stir until the sugar dissolves. Cook for 3 minutes. Add the chicken thighs, and cook for 20 minutes, or until the chicken juices run clear. Stir in the noodles, and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Avocado & Macaroni Fizz
ingredients: 14 ounces gnocchi, gluten free ( any macaroni noodles may be used ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon lime zest ( finely grated ) | 1/2 cup shredded avocado | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/2 cup macaroni ( any pasta may be used )
instructions: Cook gnocchi in a large pot of boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes or until al dente.

title: Marinated Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, cut 1/4 inch thick | 1 1/2 cups bottled chicken and pineapple juice concentrate, undiluted | 3 tablespoons brown sugar, packed | 1 tablespoon limeade concentrate | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 large yellow bell pepper, sliced | 1 red bell pepper, sliced | 2 cups shredded radishes, preferably fresh
instructions: To make marinade, combine 1 c liquid from chicken concentrate, brown sugar, limeade concentrate and flour in a large bowl.

title: Mashed Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb shredded gouda cheese | 1/2 cup tea | 1/2 cup dried coconut flakes | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Bring the tea and coconut flakes to the boil, leave to brew for 2 minutes. Add the cheese and celery salt to the tea and simmer until the cheese is melted, about 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oxo beef cube,dark chocolate,wheat bread,prune,black olive,extra virgin olive oil,corn chip,lettuce leaf
title: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 cup pitted prunes | 1/2 cup black olives, sliced | 2 whole wheat bread | 6 lettuce leaves | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 ounce dark chocolate | 1 oxo beef cube, knor ( or equivalent equivalent stock ) | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Chop prunes in quarters place in a bowl, add olives, bread, lettuce and olive oil. Mix well. Mix and coat each pepper with mixture pour over the cheese, then sprinkle over extra oil. Refrigerate until time for serving if it's to be eaten later, store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,olive oil,heavy whipping cream,chicken broth,bamboo skewer,chicken bouillon powder,vegetable oil
title: Chicken Kebabs from Rio

instructions: Marinate, remove meat from plastic bag. Dry the meat. Using meat tenderizer, pound meat with a meat mallet or rolling pin to flatten. Spread meat flat on wax paper and sprinkle with adobo seasoning. Place in food processer.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,tamari,cremini mushroom,cocoa powder,grain white rice,soymilk,okra
title: Pumpkin Rice Dessert
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups low-fat soymilk or 3 1/2 cups 2 % low-fat milk | 3/4 cup long grain white rice | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon agave nectar or 1/2 teaspoon tamari | 1 cup okra, stems chopped | 1/2 cup cremini mushrooms or 1/2 cup oyster mushrooms, cleaned and quartered | 1 tablespoon light cream ( optional )
