instructions: In a small saucepan, combine soymilk, rice, cocoa powder and agave nectar. Bring mixture to a boil,. Reduce heat, and simmer rice mixture until all liquid is absorbed about 20 minutes. Stir in okra and mushrooms. Cover and refrigerate the mixture for at least 1 hour. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,green bell pepper,zucchini,ketchup,vegetable oil cooking spray,bacon
title: Noodle Skillet
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 1 1/2 cups zucchini, sliced | 1 1/2 cups green bell peppers, sliced | 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 cups egg noodles, uncooked
instructions: Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Cook bacon, zucchini and pher of pepper until meat starts to brown, about 6 minutes. Stir in ketchup and pour into skillet, covering, cooking until zucchini is crisp tender and peppers are tender, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions.

title: Thai Green Rice With Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups short-grain rice | 1/2 cup cilantro, finely chopped
instructions: Pick over rice. Rinse and drain well. Place rice in a bowl and cover with hot water. Let stand 10 minutes, then drain. Place in a 2 quart casserole. Cover tightly and bake in a preheated 300f oven about 1 hour or until rice is tender and creamy and liquid is absorbed. Add cilantro and toss gently. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Namoura (Thai Fish Sauce)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fish fillets or 1 1/2 cups other firm white flesh fish | 1 tablespoon nam pla ( thai fish sauce ) or 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon dried fennel | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix
instructions: Place fish in a mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,shell pasta,beef,yellow squash,dill weed,natural peanut butter
title: Soy Sauce Beef and Pasta
ingredients: 1 package uncooked wide egg noodles | 1 pound lean ground beef | 1 yellow squash - peeled, seeded, and diced | 1 cup natural-style peanut butter | 12 leaves fresh dill weed, chopped | 1 jar wide egg noodles, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Butter a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the egg noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Cook and stir the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat until crumbly, evenly browned, and crumbly.

title: Jicama and Okra Salad (Jama Mango Chutney)
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 3 lbs okra, ends trimmed, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon salt substitute | 1 teaspoon fennel seed ( or crushed ) | 1/3 cup crushed pistachios ( may use cashews ) | 1 yellow 1/2-inch jicama, peeled if desired
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cover shrimp with water and boil for 1 minute. Cool, remove and pat dry. Combine shrimp and vinegar in a large bowl and marinate for 1 hour. Stir shrimp and dressing mixture into shrimp mixture and then chill for 20 minutes. For salad, add okra and pistachios to remaining dressing mixture and mix. Divide mixture between four salad plates, mound shrimp mixture on top each and serve.

Random Ingredients: shortening,italian seasoning,chocolate chip,chocolate syrup,chicken thigh fillet,thai basil
title: Sicilian Chocolate Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup thai basil | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 4 chicken thigh fillets, skin on | 1/2 cup chocolate syrup | 2 chipits ( i prefer bittersweet ) | 2 tablespoons shortening
instructions: Place basil and italian seasoning in small bowl. Sprinkle over chicken and mix well. Chill for 20 minutes. Dip each side of the chicken in terasian chocolate syrup, coating completely. Heat shortening and chocolate over low heat, just heat until chocolate melts. Spread half of the melted chocolate on each side of the chicken, and place coated chicken in a glass baking dish. Place in a oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked and the chocolate is bubbly. Serve with steamed basmati rice.

title: Homemade Liverwurst for Liver Paste
ingredients: 1 lb guar gum | 1 teaspoon guar gum ( if available ) | 1 cucumber, preferably seeded and sliced 1/8-inch thick
instructions: Mix the guar gum and guar gum together using a fork until there are no lumps of guar gum or one solid clump. Slice the cucumber thinly and slice into about 4 pieces. Place in a mixing bowl and add the liver. Spray with a little olive oil and turn to coat, then refrigerate for 30 minutes. Stir well before serving.

title: BBQ Grilled Cheese Rounds
ingredients: 6 8 inch square slices processed cheese | 1 cup of your favourite barbecue sauce, i like to use kraft ( not low fat ) | 1 package dried italian salad dressing mix | 1 sprig rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Open bbq sauce jars and place on bbq. Spread each slice with bbq sauce. Sprinkle with rosemary. Place the cheese slices on top and cook on medium heat to melt the cheese. Cut open the top of the bbq to take out cheese and rosemary if desired when cheese is melted serve.

title: Pepperoni-Planked Plantains
ingredients: 2 firm ripe plantains | 2 tablespoons pepperoni, minced | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Wash plantains and slice in half diagonally to make 1/4 inch thick slices. Make a slit, through the top of each sliced banana, then cut into thirds. Prepare grill.

title: Steamed Irish Champagne
ingredients: 300 ml beer | 1 fresh star anise | 3 lemons, juice and zest of | 3 1/2 ounces saltine or 3 1/2 ounces lemons, juice only | freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place the beer in a saucepan and add the star anise, zest, lemon juice and pepper. Bring this to the boil, then simmer for 10 minutes. Allow to cool. Place 1/4 of the chilli tea in a tea ball or jug, put a piece of the lemon in the centre of the teacups and cover with the remaining tea mixture. Cover and chill in the fridge for 2 hours to mature the flavour and aroma the tea. Then strain from the tea into the cup, adding the remaining chilli tea and lemon juice. Serve.

title: Liangban Huong Banana Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground red curry paste ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 900 ml vegetable stock or 900 ml chicken stock | 1 teaspoon vegetable stock or 1 teaspoon chicken stock | 1 -2 tablespoon crushed red curry paste
instructions: If using dried soup bones and/or red curry paste add to pan along with 500 ml of vegetable or chicken stock and stir for 2 to 3 minutes until heated through.

title: Beet Borscht
ingredients: 4 cups beefsteak tomatoes | 1/3 cup beets, sliced | lemon zest
instructions: In a large pot with water to cover, bring it to a boil over high heat. Cut off stems and discard. Add tomatoes and beet slices. Reduce heat and simmer 1 - 2 hours, or until beets are tender and beet liquid is reduced to a thick paste. Remove beet slices and lemon zest. If desired, serve with sour cream, pita, or pumpernickel bread for garnish.

title: Cabbage Lasagne
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 6 large lasagna noodles | 500 g jar sliced button mushrooms | 3 large eggs, beaten | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup cognac | 1 large head of cabbage, cut into thin wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius. Lightly grease lasagne dish. Place half the coriander and half the mushrooms on the bottom of the dish. Place half the eggs on top of mushrooms. Layer the cabbage on top. Repeat layers. Pour brandy over and top with coriander and remaining mushrooms. Cover with aluminium foil. Cook in oven 45 mintes. If your oven has a convection bake setting put it in the centre of the oven for 45 minutes then turn up the heat to 180 degrees celcius. This should result in crispy cooked, creamy vegetables. Remove, cover and leave to stand about 15 minutes prior serving to allow flavours to develop.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,english cucumber,lentil,almond extract,gruyere cheese,lemon pepper,pepper
title: Fried Lentils With Cheese and Almonds
ingredients: 2 cups dry lentils, washed and drained | 1 english cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pods, whole | 1/2 teaspoon lemon-pepper flavored pepper ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 6 ounces gruyere cheese, grated ( about 3/4 cup )
instructions: In a large bowl, stir lentils and cucumber with lemon pepper, cardamom, and almond extract until thoroughly combined. Add gruyere cheese and mix until cheese is melted. Let set at room temperature for 2 - 4 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Country Ribs - for Crock Pot
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb country-style pork rib, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/2 lb kielbasa ( polish sausage ) | 1/2 lb deli style diced kielbasa | 1 large red chile | 1/2 cup sliced almonds, toasted
instructions: Dry off sausage, cut into long diagonal pieces, 2 1/2 to 3 inches long, the long way. Arrange one rib piece on bottom of baking dish, and two more ribs next to it. Repeat with other two ribs and kielbasa. Arrange pepper rings around sausage. Sprinkle with chilies. Top with toasted almonds. Cover and place in crock pot. Cook on high for 2 to 4 hours, or crock pot on low for 2 to 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,chile powder,ice water,doritos,serrano chilies,chicken breast fillet
title: Mexican Chicken Dorito
ingredients: 12 ounces chicken breast fillets, cut into thick strips, then shredded with a fork | 12 ounces frozen chopped chilies | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon hot chile powder | 1 teaspoon coarsely ground chile powder | 1 tablespoon uncoarsely crushed uncoarsely crushed dorito's chips ( about 10 chips ) | ice water, as needed
instructions: Place chicken, chilies, chili powder, hot chile powder and coarsely crushed dorito's chips in a bag. Shake to combine. Refrigerate for 1 or 2 hours. Heat a dutch oven over high heat until smoking.

title: Easy, No-Cook, French Apple Penne
ingredients: 6 tart apples, peeled and sliced | 4 packets dry penne pasta | 1 cup marsala
instructions: Spray a large skillet with non stick spray. Cook apples over medium heat until apples begin to soften. While still warm, add 1 cup of marsala and stir to coat and scrape the bottom of the pan. While the marsala is cooking, cook the penne according to package directions. Drain pasta and apples then add to pan and stir to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Peanut Butter & Creamy Peanut Covered Peanuts-Sof-Mushroom
ingredients: 1 1/2 2 cans cream of mushroom soup ( condensed ) | 3/4 cup peanuts ( skinned and chopped ) | 1 -4 tablespoon olive oil ( or butter )
instructions: Heat olive oil in a medium skillet. Add the chopped peanuts. Cook in oil, stirring regularly, until they brown a bit. Remove from heat. Add the condensed soup and mushroom soup to the nuts and mix well. Serve over hot cooked rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: oyster,garlic salt,green bell pepper,green tomato,cream mushroom soup
title: Mom's Oyster Dip
ingredients: 1 jar dry oysters | 8 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 4 green bell peppers | 2 green tomatoes | garlic salt
instructions: Shake oysters in the jar with the soup and green peppers and tomatoes. Season with garlic salt. You may wish to add a dash of olive oil to help thicken if you prefer.. This dip does not keep well in the fridge after it has had four days in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,chicken breast,macadamia nut,green onion,english cucumber,dark beer,digestive biscuit,spring onion
title: Chicken Bites & Cucumber Logs
ingredients: 500 g chicken breasts, cut into 4 chunks | 3 tablespoons greek yogurt, to serve | 2 tablespoons dark beer, to serve | 2 green onions, sliced | 2 spring onions, shredded | 2 teaspoons toasted macadamia nuts ( optional ) | 80 ml low fat plain greek yogurt | 2 packets digestive biscuits, crushed into crumbs | 2 english cucumbers, halved lengthways, halved, sliced thinly
instructions: Place chicken in a shallow bowl, pour over half the yogurt, but keep stirring so as to not soak all the yogurt. Leave to marinate for 15 minutes. Pour over remaining yogurt and beer and stir in spring onion shreds, macadamia nuts, yoghurt and remaining spring onions to taste. Place biscuits into large shallow ceramic or glass bowl, pour remaining yogurt over and gently press down until all the biscuits are covered. Put cucumber slices on top of biscuits and press down gently so they form a log like shape. Chill until ready to serve, but no longer. Preheat grill to high. Place chicken on grill in a single layer and spray with cooking spray. Cook until golden and cooked through. Remove from heat and put in a large bowl lined with absorbent paper to rest. Squeeze as much yoghurt as possible out of bag, sprinkle with some chopped spring onions and serve on top of the chicken. Garnish with toasted macadamias and extra cucumber slices, and serve with warm green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,cheddar cheese,kiwi fruit,dark rum,sun tomato oil,white flour,suet,cocoa
title: Saughovar Grassie ( Kiwi Griss )
ingredients: 1 large suet | 4 kiwi fruits ( peeled ) | 225 g strong cheddar cheese, grated, strong and sharp | 225 g white flour | 3 tablespoons cocoa | 1 teaspoon cocoa | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional ) | fresh sun-dried tomato oil
instructions: First of all cut the suet thickly with a vegetable peeler on a grater. Slice your kiwi into rounds and then cut your slices into fine julienne sticks. Grate your cheddar and mix both cheeses together put the flour, cocoa, cocoa and rum in a bowl and mix well gradually add the flour mixture to the suet, mix well, then gradually add the grand marnier and sundried tomatoes adding the sun dried tomatoes last. Cover and place in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight. Prehat the oven to 220c/425f/gas place the grated suet on a baking tray and brush with sun dried tomato oil. Bake for about 10 to 15 minutes until the suet is golden brown and crispy.

title: Frozen Swiss Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 1 package refrigerated swiss cheese ( room temperature ) | 2 cans passion fruit pulp or ( 15 ounce ) cans fruit preserves, with pulp | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 3 tablespoons shortening
instructions: Place margarine or butter in a saucepan over low heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until melted and mixture is foamy. Remove from heat. Place the 1 teaspoon grated ginger in fondue pot. Add 1 package cheese and the passion fruit pulp or preserves with pulp, juice and grated ginger. Stir well. Re heat with lid on until hot but not boiling. Pour into 2 small dishes, freeze. To serve, dip the fondue pot into hot ice water until the desired serving temperature is reached. Remove from water with a slotted spoon and place on a towel. Serve.

title: Halibut with Sweet Chili Sauce (Halibut Adobo)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dashi stock | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 4 bone-in halibut fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine dashi and sweet chili sauce in a bowl. Stir until well blended. Place fish in a large baking dish. Pour mixture onto fish. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,gruyere cheese,red cherry,lemon pepper,brown rice,chicken part
title: Mediterranean Chicken and Rice Bake for One...
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken parts | 4 tablespoons gruyere cheese, grated | 8 ounces plain yogurt | 1/3 cup green cherries or 1/3 cup red cherries | 1 1/4 cups jasmine rice or 1 1/4 cups basmati rice, cooked | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Mix the rice, cherries, lemon pepper and yogurt together to form a dressing. Set aside in the refrigerator. Preheat the oven to broil, lightly oil the bottom and sides of a 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Arrange the chicken in rows in the baking dish, skin side down. Sprinkle evenly with gruyere on top of the chicken. Bake at about 350 degrees for about 35 minutes or until chicken is done and juices run clear and chicken is cooked through. Serve.

title: Sauce for Beef (For Crock Pot and Other Oven Style Meat)
ingredients: 1 can green chili peppers ( or jalapeno ) | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Slice the chilis and pick the seeds as you want them. Place the peppers in a bowl. Then add vinegar, worcestershire sauce and worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Put meat into crock pot. Cover and cook on high 30 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beet,raisin,salt black pepper,yogurt,maple syrup,coconut,green bell pepper
title: Beet, Raab and Maple Salad
ingredients: 1 can sliced beets, drained | 1 green bell pepper, cored, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup raisins, or more to taste | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 3 tablespoons grated coconut ( optional )
instructions: In a serving bowl, toss beets with green bell pepper, raisins, salt, and black pepper until the canning is cold, 2 to 5 minutes. Place yogurt in the bowl of a blender, and puree until completely smooth. Pour in maple syrup and coconut, and pulse until the yogurt is smoothly incorporated. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Peperonos Roca a la Feu
ingredients: 2 lbs new potatoes | 1 medium parsnip ( optional ) | 3 -4 hot new red chili peppers ( or ajicito ) | 2 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese or 2 tablespoons montasio cheese
instructions: Bring the potatoes to a boil and cook until just tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and set aside for 15 minutes or so. Cut the parsnip and the jalapeños in small pieces. Mash the potatoes, parsnip and jalapeños together. Add salt to taste until your exact tastes are well mixed. Toss everything together by hand. Sprinkle the gruyere over the top. Put in the preheated oven on the middle rack, and immediately lower, or place on the table below it. The finished product should be crusty and slightly crisped out. You can serve it warm or cold.

title: Wild Mushroom Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds fresh wild mushrooms, stems removed and caps diced | 1 can condensed tomato juice | 1/4 cup catsup
instructions: Place wild mushrooms in a large bowl and pour tomato juice over the top. Sprinkle with catsup. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator 1 to 8 hours before serving.

title: Chinese Fruit With Ginger
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 4 ounces fresh ginger | 1 red pepper | 1 kiwi ( peeled, and seeded, if using zucchini ) | 2 tablespoons fresh green peas | 1 tablespoon fresh sweet corn | 1 teaspoon ice water
instructions: Cut baguette into six 1''x4'' slices, and place on a cookie sheet. Coat slices with cooking spray, and place in oven. Bake 20 - 25 minutes at 350 degrees f. Peel ginger, cut in half diagonally and slice very thin. Cut squash in half diagonally and cut into 1'' chunks. Chop green peas in half if using zucchini. Combine ginger, pepper, kiwi, sweet corn and ice water in a bowl. Place bread into mixture and turn to coat both sides. Allow to soak 5 mintues in the bread, for an extra flavor. Slice into slices and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: onion,chicken bouillon,pecorino romano cheese,sun tomato oil,pork tenderloin,ketchup,coriander powder,kidney bean
title: Italian Sweet and Savory Bean Pork
ingredients: 6 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 3 teaspoons dried coriander powder | 2 teaspoons granulated onion | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried minced onion | 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup chopped pecorino romano cheese, plus more reserved for topping
instructions: In large resealable plastic bag, combine pork, coriander, 1 teaspoon of the granulated onion, ketchup, 1 tablespoon of the instant chicken bouillon, sun dried tomatoes and 1/4 cup of the beans with their soaking liquid. Seal and shake to coat. Marinate in refrigerator 4 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 375°f. Remove pork from bag and discard marinade. Place pork under broiler and bake for 30 to 40 minutes, turning once until done to your liking. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of granulated onion and 1/8 teaspoon of the granulated onion.

title: Pistachio Crusted Chicken With Seitan
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts | 2 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs | 1 lb mussels | 2 tablespoons pistachios or 2 tablespoons almonds, chopped | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons seitan ( gebhardt )
instructions: Cut a slit in the top of each chicken breast and remove the bone. Using a spoon or potato peeler, remove the skin and any visible blood from the chicken breasts, leaving the breast attached at the thickest part. Cut open the chicken breast and pull out the attached bone. Rinse and clean the mussels and snap off the hard shell inside. Discard the beards, scrape out any meat that may be attached, and discard any mussels that did not open. In a medium sized bowl, combine 2 tablespoons of the graham cracker crumbs, the nuts or sliced almonds, salt, and seitan. Sprinkle this mixture over the chicken breasts, then stir in the meat. Turn the chicken breast in the crumbs mixture so that both sides of the breast are coated with crumbs. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, add the chicken pieces, and fry for 1 minute, flipping once. They should be browned. Remove the chicken, and place in a 9x13x2 inch baking dish, cover with foil, and bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes, until the chicken is cooked. Note, serve the seitan with the chicken and a side dish of fresh vegetables. Serving suggestion, you can make the chicken breast in advance and cook it for the first time you make it.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,broccoli floret,nutmeg,kosher salt,nacho cheese,graham cracker,greek yogurt
title: Salty Broccoli Dip
ingredients: 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed and drained | 1 package greek yogurt | 1/2 cup plain fat free greek yogurt | 4 ounces grated nacho cheese ( about 1/4 of a 1-ounce package ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | kosher salt, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place thawed broccoli florets and yogurt in a strainer or strainer and drain excess liquid until creamy. Stir mixture well to combine. Stir in cheese and nutmeg until melted. Garnish with pepper and salt if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Breaded Frozen Pea Pudding with Panko Crumbs
ingredients: 1 lb yellow split peas | to taste rock salt | 3 cups cold panko breadcrumbs | to taste cool whip
instructions: Place peas in a large saucepan. Add 1 tsp salt. Cover with water, bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 2 hours. Remove from heat and let stand 10 minutes. Drain through a fine sieve or cheesecloth, reserving the liquid. Chop peas into large chunks and place in a large bowl. Stir in bread crumbs. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 hours. Bring to the boil slowly, stirring frequently, until mixture thickens slightly, stirring frequently. Remove from heat, let cool slightly then chill in refrigerator 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,dark sesame oil,maraschino cherry,green onion
title: Madagascar Green Curry Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green curry paste ( thai or asian style style ) | 4 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 sweet green onion, finely chopped | 12 maraschino cherries, chopped
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except cherries, pour into small freezer bag and add the cherries. Seal bag or seal bag and turn over occasionally for 2 hours. Remove cherry mixture from bag and serve.

Random Ingredients: radish,red cabbage,pineapple chunk,black eyed pea,green bell pepper,olive,butter lettuce
title: Hawaiian Hotpot
ingredients: 1 teaspoon butter lettuce | 1 yellow green bell pepper, chopped | 1 large red cabbage, shredded | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained | 1/2 cup canned black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup canned pineapple tidbits, drained and chopped
instructions: In a 2 to 3 quart saucepan, melt the butter or margarine over medium heat, add the green pepper and cabbage and toss. Reduce the heat to low and add the olives, bean and pineapple tidbits. Cover and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Serve warm.

title: Mango-Cheese Stuffed French Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf crusty bread | 1 jar mango chutney | 1 lb swiss cheese | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Cut a slit into each bread loaf in half lengthwise, making sure you have a pocket to stuff the filling. Set bread halves open length wise and stuff with about half the chutney. Place bread in a baking dish at medium heat. Cover with a dish towel and place under a preheated broiler for 2 minutes. Turn over and cover the other side. Turn the oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the swiss cheese into thin triangles and place on top of the bread in the baking dish. Brush the cheese with the chutney. Cover the dish and place under the broiler for 3 minutes. Remove cheeses from the oven, cover and allow to stand for a few minutes before serving.

title: Easy Beef Goulash
ingredients: 2 cups elbow macaroni | 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Cook the macaroni in just enough lightly salted water to cover for about 5 minutes. Drain and return to hot pot. Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat and brown the beef. Stir and cook only until meat is slightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,kielbasa,vinegar,basil,garam masala,celery leaf,milk,tomato juice
title: Indian Joes (A Taste of Home)
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain fat-free evaporated milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon basil | 1 teaspoon kielbasa, diced | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 tablespoon fresh celery leaves, chopped | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, diced and divided
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine water, evaporated milk, vinegar, garam masala, basil, kielbasa and tomato juice. Bring to boil, reduce heat. Cook covered, 2 - 3 minutes. Add 2 tbsp of celery, stir. Remove lid and simmer, stirring occasionally for 1/2 hr or until vegetables are tender and mixture thickens. Add 1/2 cup shredded cheese.

title: Vegan Spanish Inspired Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb button mushroom | 2 tablespoons saffron spanish onions | 1 cup raisins
instructions: Clean mushrooms. Pierce with a knife or fork a few times. Place in shallow pan. Sprinkle with onion seeds, raisins. Pour water around mushrooms and stir. Let stand about 15 minutes. Steam or heat until mushrooms are limp.

title: Couscous "Cous Kids
ingredients: 6 ounces couscous | 1 cup green cabbage, finely chopped | 1/3 cup great northern bean, canned, drained and rinsed | 1 medium avocado, diced | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | cocoa, for dusting
instructions: Place the couscous and water in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and cover the pan with a lid. Set aside for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine the cabbage, bean, avocado, breadcrumbs and cayenne. To serve, place some of the cabbage mixture in the bottom of a deep bowl. Then top with some of the couscous and some of the avocado.

title: Pepperoncini Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers | 4 tablespoons cornflour | 4 tablespoons kirsch | 1/2 cup amaretto
instructions: In sauce pan brown sausage. Drain fat. Add other ingredients stir till blended to form sauce. Simmer covered for 45 minutes. Sauce should not be too runny.

Random Ingredients: french bread,alfalfa sprout,flat leaf parsley,chicken bouillon cube,double cream,butternut squash
title: Warm Butternut Squash Soup With Cream Croutons
ingredients: 1 butternut squash ( about 250g ) | 300 ml double cream | 400 g butternut squash ( or pumpkin, if you don't like butternut squash ) | 3 cups french style bread, crusts removed | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Peel and cut the butternut squash. Cut into 6 cubes, cut the pieces in half so they are roughly the same size. Put the squash cubes into a roasting tin and add a little water. Sprinkle with salt. Roast at 200°c for 30 minutes then gently squeeze and mash everything together with a potato masher. The soup can be made a few hours in advance and reheated in a larger pan. When dinner is ready, mix in the cream, croutons, stock cubes and parsley. Serve hot in warmed soup bowls, with crusty bread for scooping.

title: Spaghetti Toss with Tortellini and Tortellini Cheese
ingredients: 500 ml oil | 1 piece frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 2 teaspoons aniseed | 4 slices pecorino romano cheese | 140 g ground tortellini | 1/4 cup chopped coriander ( cilantro )
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet on medium high heat. Add frozen phyllo pieces and aniseed and allow pieces to puff up without touching. Place the tortellini in a bowl and add 1/4 cup of freshly ground coriander and mix. Place a piece of tortellini on top of the phyllo piece. Sprinkle pistachios and grated cheese over the tortellini. Cut stack in half lengthwise and place on the sheet pan with the second layer. Top stack with second pile of tortellini and cheese. Place under a hot grill to brown bottom. Cut stack into 4 pieces and serve with more ground coriander in the center and more pecorino on the side.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,turbinado sugar,linguine,celery seed,mozzarella cheese,lasagna noodle
title: Lighter Lettuce Lasagna
ingredients: 1 container fresh lasagna noodles | 2 cups reduced-fat mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 cup light soy sauce | 8 teaspoons turbinado sugar | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped low sodium soy sauce | 2 tablespoons shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a 9x5 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil, cook lasagna in boiling water until al dente, about 6 minutes. Transfer cooked noodles to a large bowl of ice water, then rinse with cold water until cold. Drain well. Meanwhile, in a bowl, stir together mozzarella cheese, 2 teaspoons soy sauce, turbinado sugar, celery seed and 2 tablespoons soy sauce until well combined.

title: Quick and Easy Gorgonzola-Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons asiago cheese, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon fresh grated mexican cheese | 1/4 cup fresh tomato puree | 2 tablespoons crumbled gorgonzola
instructions: Add all ingredients to a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high power, uncovered, for 1 minute. Stir to combine cheese mixture and ingredients. Microwave on high power 2 to 3 minutes more, stirring after every minute. Serve.

title: Hot Citrus Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup dry mustard seeds | 1/4 cup red pepper, chopped | 1 lemon, juice of, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and blend on high for 2 minutes.

title: Mexican Apple-Coffee Gluten-Free  Peach-Chile-Kinda
ingredients: 1 small cooking apple ( such as the mcintosh brand, which has 2 cups of dried apple, 3 cups of dried pear, or 1 cup dried peach, chopped ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup light brewed espresso | 4 -6 small dried red chiles, depending on the size of your chiles | 3 -4 cups quick-cooking tapioca flour or 3 -4 cups cornmeal | 1/4 - 1/3 cup tapioca flour or 1/4-1/3 cup quick-cooking tapioca flour | 1 lb fresh ripe peach, peeled, cored, and cut into 8 wedges ( or use frozen, peaches ) | 1/2 cup dark raisin
instructions: To prepare the fruit, put the dried apples in a saucepan with the light brewed espresso and chiles. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to as low as you can and keep the hot. Using a sieve or slotted spoon, transfer the chiles to a bowl and add 1 cup water. Let soak for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the tapioca flour with 1 cup water in a bowl and using a whisk or fork, blend with a fork until dough starts to form a ball. If necessary, add a little more water, a little at a time, until dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl. Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead briefly. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and set aside for at least 20 minutes.. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Place the pitted chiles in a strainer and toss with some of their soaking liquid. Place the chiles on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes. Remove the chiles from the oven and turn on the broiler. Grease an 11 x 7 inch baking dish. In a bowl, combine 1 cup of the fruit mixture with the tapioca flour and mix. Stir to blend the liquids, and pour this into the baking dish. Add the remaining fruit mixture and the raisins and toss to combine. Spread the fruit mixture evenly in the greased pan. Sprinkle the top with the chile kinda and bake until heated through and golden. Cut into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: cake yeast,beef stew meat,green chili pepper,bean,espresso,asafoetida powder,jicama,vanilla
title: Jicama Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 package cake yeast | 1 tablespoon espresso, instant | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 5 cans baked beans | 2 -3 green chili pepper, diced | 1/2 cup jicama, diced
instructions: In a deep glass bowl, soak cake yeast in some water. In a wok or dutch oven, add the beef stew meat. Cut up the beef into smaller bite size chunks. Sprinkle the outside of the beef with salt and pepper. In the bottom of the wok or dutch oven add the espresso powder and add the 1 tsp of vanilla and the asafoetida powder. Fry the beef on high heat, just until browned, about 5 - 7 minutes add the beans, green chile, and jicama. Cook 1 - 2 more minutes. Pour the coffee over the beef and put a lid on. Put a very large pan to cook the roast, and add some hot water to the pan. Cover and simmer for 60 - 90 minutes. Remove lid and cook 5 - 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,madeira wine,herbes de provence,yellow pea,applesauce,black peppercorn,pasta
title: Wild Nests
ingredients: 3 cups dry pasta ( any type will work, or make sure they are big! ) | 1/2 yellow split peas ( a few small ones, or any frozen peas ) | 1/2 tablespoon black peppercorns, crushed | 3 cups mixed applesauce ( i use amber bbq applesauce for this ) | 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 -2 teaspoon madeira wine ( optional ) | 6 -8 large flour tortillas
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on package of noodles. Drain. Meanwhile, boil peas for 25 minutes. Remove peas with a slotted spoon and put aside for later use. Cook applesauce until heated through, remove from heat. In medium bowl, combine the cooked pasta with the cooled applesauce, green/white sauce, and herbes de provence. Divide between tortilla cups serving equally. Sprinkle with peas/spices of choice.

title: Appetizing Hot Dogs
ingredients: 3 3 tablespoons ham or 3 tablespoons ham fat, mixed with | 3 slices fuji apples ( kabocha ) | 2 small dried red chili peppers
instructions: Put ham fat and kabocha on a flat surface. Place a slice of kabocha on top of the ham fat. Sprinkle with dried red chilies.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,tortilla,seasoning salt,deli roast beef,yellow squash,irish cream,italian parsley,onion
title: Tortilla Beef With Snow Peas and Peas
ingredients: 1 lb shaved deli roast beef | 1 teaspoon dried italian parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/2 lb snow peas ( green beans are good ) | 2 yellow squash, halved halved | 1/4 cup minced onion | 4 ounces thinly sliced french's original ranch dips with noodles | 1/3 cup irish cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Cover, refrigerate, and marinate beef overnight. Drain beef and discard marinade. Cook snow peas and squash for about 10 minutes on a skillet. Add beef and vegetable and cook until heated through about 2 minutes. Turn off heat and add french's® ranch dip and sour cream.

title: Berry Potato Crumb Topping
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes | 1 package cinnamon graham crackers | 1 package frozen mixed green beans ( thawed ) | 1 cup blackberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Heat over to 400 degrees. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise so that you get 8 wedges. Place wedges in a large bowl and sprinkle with graham crackers. Spread blackberries on top of graham crackers. Bake 30 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes with side of spatula and serve.

Random Ingredients: walnut,sherry wine,soymilk,coriander seed,tuna water,asafoetida powder,liquid honey
title: Raw Tuna Kulfi
ingredients: 1/4 cup walnut pieces | 250 g canned tuna in water, drained weight and cut in half | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/8 teaspoon sherry wine or 1/8 teaspoon tamari ( to taste ) | 100 ml plain unsweetened soymilk | 1/4 cup liquid honey ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seeds ( optional )
instructions: Heat a kulfi mold with 4 tbsp butter in a pot over medium to low heat. Saute the asafetida, walnuts and tuna until the tuna is heated through and the nuts are slightly browned. Stir in the sherry, soy milk, honey and coriander seeds and boil a few minutes until the mixture comes to a boil. Pour into the prepared kulfi mold and let cool for 1 - 2 hours. Chill for approximately 2 hours at room temperature and serve.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,cooking spray,pisco,egg noodle,red cabbage,oyster sauce
title: Easy and Quick Fried Noodles
ingredients: cooking spray | 8 ounces egg noodles | 1 roasting chicken, cooked and shredded | 1 red cabbage, shredded | 2 tablespoons sweet rice cooking wine ( or 2 tablespoons pisco-pisco-style vinegar ) | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat over to 450°f. Warm a large nonstick frying pan on medium high heat. Add the egg noodles. Stir a few times and fry until just lightly golden brown, about 2 minutes. Remove from pan and set aside. Heat a medium size nonstick frying pan on high heat. Add the shredded chicken. Turn the heat to medium high. Sprinkle with the rice wine, and stir a few times to blend. Add chicken to the pan. Sprinkle with oyster sauce. Stir until chicken is cooked throughout, 2 to 3 minutes. Toss the noodle mixture with the chicken and noodles. Serve.

title: Sweet and Savoury Pineapple Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 3/4 cup fish stock | 2 tablespoons sugar | 2 tablespoons pineapple rings, chopped ( or crushed pineapple ) | 3 tablespoons nuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon red pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon sweet roasted crushed hazelnuts | 4 lettuce wraps, small | shredded lettuce or shredded romaine lettuce, to serve
instructions: Dissolve the bicarb soda in the stock and stir in the sugar. Combine the pineapple, nuts, red pepper and hazelnuts. Pour the dressing over and mix well. Lay out a lettuce leaf on each lettuce leaf. Sprinkle with the dressing and garnish with the nuts.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,black eyed pea,pesto sauce,thai chile,chili paste
title: Salsa Pesto Hummus
ingredients: 3 cups commercial pesto sauce ( see note ) | 7 ounces canned black-eyed peas, drained | 1 thai chiles, seeded and minced or 2 red jalapeno chiles, seeded and minced | 2 teaspoons hot chili paste | 3/4 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Place the pesto sauce and peas in the bowl of a blender. Add the chilies and hot chili paste and process until smooth. Add the cranberries and process until just chopped.

title: Ancho Chile Paste
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile | 2 dried pasilla chiles | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/8 teaspoon ground turmeric or 1/8 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,sushi rice,herb,ginger garlic paste,tomato paste,soy sauce
title: Japanese Tomato Rice
ingredients: 1 cup sushi rice, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/4 cup soy sauce, to taste | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over low heat. Add the ginger garlic paste and stir fry about 20 seconds. Push the garlic paste to one side of the skillet and add the rice, tomato paste, soy sauce, and vegetable mixture. Cover with a lid and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 15 - 20 minutes. Check often, stirring rice, to ensure it does not stick to the skillet and burn. You may need to stir in a little water if the rice seems dry. Add dried herbs and stir to mix.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,vegetable broth,black tea,turmeric,cilantro,salmon,ricotta cheese,sage leaf
title: Curried Salmon With Sage
ingredients: 2 salmon, about 1 1/2 pounds ( skin on, flaked or boneless ) | 1 cup vegetable broth, low sodium ( or low fat ) | 1 small onion, diced | 1/2 cup light ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon ground ginger or 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, grated | 1 dash dried cilantro, to taste | 1 dash turmeric, to taste | 1/2 cup black tea, cooled
instructions: Place salmon on foil on a large shallow pan or baking sheet and arrange in two layers in one layer. Bake at 325°f for 20 - 30 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily when tested with a fork. Drain off most of the liquid in pan, leaving about 1 tablespoon in pan. Place onion in a medium saucepan and cover with 1/2 cup water. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until the onions are soft and transparent, about 10 minutes. Add the broth, ginger, cilantro and turmeric and bring to a boil over high heat. Stir in the cooked salmon and bring to a boil again. Remove from heat and allow to sit, covered, for 10 - 15 minutes. Strain the liquid, discard solids, and set the liquid aside. Remove the salmon from the pan and place on a platter and cover. Increase heat to high and boil the liquid until reduced by about half. This may take another 10 minutes or so, depending on thickness. When the salmon is cool enough to handle, skin and bone it, leaving a small amount of flesh on top. Dislodge any bones you have and serve with a few spoonfuls of the gravy on the side for dipping the salmon.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,adobo sauce,self rising flour,pork chop,noodle,farfalle pasta,lemon,potato
title: Pork and Noodle Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup self rising flour | 4 ounces potatoes, peeled and cut into matchsticks | 6 ounces lean pork chops, thinly sliced | 1 lemon, zested and juiced | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 8 ounces dried farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/2 cup shredded smoked sweet potato, mixed with | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Place the flour, potatoes, pork and lemon zest in a food processor or blender and pulse until almost a dough forms. Combine cream of chicken soup and adobo sauce and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,sunflower oil,beef broth,splenda sugar substitute,basil leaf
title: Creamy Basil Limeade
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 12 ounces cans condensed beef broth | 2 3/4 ounces frozen limeade concentrate, thawed ( 7/8 cup ) | 2 -3 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 4 -5 fresh basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Heat oil in 3 quart saucepan over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Mix together beef broth and limeade concentrate.

Random Ingredients: egg,polenta,reynolds wrap foil,ancho chile powder,sharp cheddar cheese,red wine
title: Tex-Mex Polenta and Cheese Fingers #RSC
ingredients: 6 large eggs | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, cut into 18 chunks ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 3/4 cup dry red wine or 3/4 cup beer ( i like to reduce this by half ) | 1 tablespoon yellow polenta or 1 tablespoon cornmeal, for dusting the griddle
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Pour one cup of beer into a frying pan over medium heat and swirl to coat pan. When bubbles break the surface, reduce heat to medium low and cook until bubbles appear around the edge, stirring constantly, about 12 minutes. Immediately remove from heat and set aside. Place eggs in a large mixing bowl and beat until thick and lemon colored. Add the cheese chunks and reintroduce to bowl with eggs. Using same mixing bowl as before, add 1 t. Ancho chili powder and the remaining ancho chili powder and stir until it dissolves into liquid. Turn into a large baking sheet and spread evenly. Make sure the pan is large enough to allow the fingers to spread out. Sprinkle top of fingers lightly with additional cheddar cheese, if desired, and then with a sharp cheddar slice if using. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to cutting board and let cool until room temperature. Dust with cornmeal if desired. Store in an airtight container for up to 1 day.

title: Tuscan Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow onions | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Rinse and root onions. Cut the tops off onions and place them in boiling water to cook for 30 min. Peel the onions and slice them into thin wedges, discarding any tough or damaged tops. Sprinkle the onions with salt and place in a bowl of cold water to soak. Cover the onions with cold water and let them stand for 15 minutes drain. Pat the onions dry. In a large skillet, heat the maple syrup over medium heat until it is a rich brown color. Reduce the syrup by half. When it is only a few tablespoons, add the onions and toss to coat them thoroughly. Transfer the onions to a serving bowl and drizzle with the grated cheese. Toss to melt the cheese.

title: Polenta-Wrapped Parfait With Fresh Grapefruit Slices
ingredients: 2 boxes polenta ( preferably prepared with high-glutinous cornmeal added in a steady stream ) | 6 -7 tablespoons finely chopped fresh peperoni | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary sprigs | 3 drops sesame oil | 1 tablespoon finely chopped epazote | fresh rosemary sprigs ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c. Wrap the polenta in clingfilm and place it in a deep, heavy bottomed baking dish. Add enough water to come to a depth of 1/4 inch around the rim of the dish and the baking dish, a tablespoonful at a time, to give a total of 1 1/4 cup capacity. Carefully add the peperoni, rosemary, sesame oil and epazote to the water – the mixture should cover the entire surface of the polenta completely. Dot the top with sesame oil and scatter the thinly sliced peperoni around the polenta. Bake the bread until the water is absorbed and the bread is golden brown, about 18 - 25 minutes. Remove the bread from the oven. Cut the polenta into slices and serve warm or room temperature and garnished with rosemary sprigs.

Random Ingredients: clementine,spanish rice,bean thread noodle,chili pepper,serrano chili,red capsicum
title: Spanish Rice With Crispy Beans, Caramelized Clementines and Chillies
ingredients: 2 ounces bean thread noodles | 40 g pickled chili peppers ( small chillies ) | 2 cups spanish rice | 1/2 small red capsicum, sliced thinly | 1 small serrano chili, chopped ( jalapeno or other bird chile ) | 4 1/2 ounces clementines, unpeeled, halved lengthways
instructions: Cook the beans according to package direction, until soft. Meanwhile, heat the oven to 325°f, put the rice, capsicum, chilli and 2tbsp cold water in a saucepan and stir over high heat for 3 minutes or until the water is absorbed. Add this to the rice and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes or until it is heated through. Divide among four oven proof dishes, spooning 1tsp of the reserved bean sprouts onto each dish. Place under the hot grill for 10 mins or until the rice is crisp and golden. Meanwhile, using a slotted spoon, lift the clementines from the baking pan and place on a baking tray with their tails. Stand the cassery, cut side down, on 2 serving plates. Spoon more bean sprouts on the sides and the rest of the sprouts alongside. Season well with pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,rhubarb,chicken wing,green olive,red chilies,jalapeno pepper,cardamom pod,savory
title: Rhubarb Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup rhubarb | 1 chicken wings, cut up | 8 green olives | 2 jalapeno peppers | 8 red chilies | 1 -2 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 dash ground cardamom pod
instructions: Remove woody stalk and cut rhubarb into bite size pieces, and set aside. Wash green olives, cut in half lengthwise and chop into bite size pieces, and set aside. Slice jalapenos crosswise in half down their length and finely chop. Heat 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil in a fry pan over medium heat. Add chicken pieces and saute on all sides. Remove chicken, turn heat to medium. Add sliced olives to fry pan and cook slowly for 5 minutes or so, just until slightly browned. Add pepper, saute 1 minute, turn heat up to medium high and add contents of 1 beef bouillon cube,savory, cardamom, chili pods, jalapenos, green olives, and browned chicken back inches. Put lid on pan and cook about 5 minutes. Serve with rice or as a dipping sauce for chicken.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,guacamole,thyme leaf,dijon mustard,dill pickle,beef tenderloin,milk ricotta cheese
title: Miniature Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon fresh dill pickle slices, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 8 ounces cooked beef tenderloin, sliced | 1 tablespoon milk-free mayonnaise
instructions: Combine yogurt, mayonnaise, mustard, pickles, and thyme in a small bowl. Place beef between 2 sheets waxed paper on a lightly floured surface.

Random Ingredients: club soda,plain yogurt,mustard powder,sea salt,milk chocolate
title: Aussie Style Chocolate Fondue (for the Grill)
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups milk chocolate, chopped | 2 cups plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 8 1/2 ounces fleischmann's mint-flavoured plain yogurt, chilled to room temperature
instructions: Line a medium metal fondue pot with waxed paper. Set over low heat and warm until the chocolate melts. With a wooden spoon, stir in the milk chocolate. Mix in the yogurt and mustard powder until smooth and creamy, about 3 minutes. Set aside. Ladle the fondue into the preheated fondue pot. Let cool. Do not let it set up too quickly. Transfer the fondue to a serving plate. Garnish with mint flavoured plain yogurt.

title: Barbecued Asparagus With Crunchy Oranges
ingredients: 4 thick sliced asparagus | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/2 small finely grated orange rind | 2 tablespoons butter beans or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon fish sauce | fresh herb ( garnish ) | 4 sheets nori ( toasted )
instructions: Place the asparagus on foil lined baking tray and sprinkle over the mustard powder and grated zest. Mix the ketchup with the orange rind in separate bowl and brush over the asparagus. Leave for about 5 minutes. Place a knob of butter or canola oil onto the asparagus. Cut each slice to the size of the nori sheet and sprinkle over the mustard. Cut the slices into the asparagus and stack with the crisp orange leaves over.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,parma ham,half,basil,anaheim chile pepper,mango,mint leaf,red chilies
title: Mango Chiles Rellenos Wraps (Mango Subs)
ingredients: 4 large fresh mangoes | 1 cup half-and-half | 3 large fresh red chilies | 1 large fresh basil, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 fresh parma ham, minced | 12 flour tortillas | 2 fresh red chilies, finely chopped | 1/4 cup half-and-half
instructions: Slice mangoes and place in a food processor or blender. Add half and half and pulse. Place 2 chopped chiles on a sheet of wax paper, and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 2 minutes. Remove chiles and wrap in the wax paper. Microwave another 2 minutes. Set aside. Slice grilled chiles lengthwise in half. Toast chiles in a dry nonstick skillet over medium high heat, flipping occasionally, until lightly charred and blistered. Remove from skillet. Wrap each chile in a tortilla. Fill with mango mixture, adding 2 tablespoons chopped red chiles. Wrap in foil and refrigerate at least 2 hours. To make salsa, place minced red chiles in a bowl with mint and remaining chopped mint and toss to mix. To serve, place a teaspoon of mango salsa in the center of each wrap, garnish with chopped basil and drizzle with half and half. Top with slices of crispy parm bread.

title: Coffee-Tart Coffee Ring
ingredients: 1 package crescent dinner rolls, each cut in 6 slices | 2 tablespoons brewed coffee | 2 tablespoons powdered coffee, for coating
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange crescent rolls, cut side up on a large baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: white flour,wasabi powder,horseradish,halibut fillet,goat cheese,tomato green chilies
title: Fish for Two
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise or 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1/2 cup grated fresh goat cheese | 8 ounces halibut fillets or 8 ounces cod fillets, cut into 1/2 in chunks | 1 small tomatoes and green chilies, thinly sliced | wasabi powder, for drizzle ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish
instructions: Combine mayonnaise or miracle whip and 3/4 c goat cheese in a small bowl, stir well with a fork. Season with a small amount of wasabi powder if desired. Place fish in a greased shallow dish. Spoon over the mayonnaise mixture. Sprinkle with tomato and chilies. Dot with remaining goat cheese. Dot with horseradish or soy sauce if desired. Bake uncovered 375 for 30 minutes or until fish tests done.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,beef flavor ramen noodle
title: Beefy Ramen
ingredients: 1 package beef-flavor ramen noodles, dry | 1 can small curd cottage cheese
instructions: Prepare ramen noodles as directed on the package. Cool. Drain cottage cheese to remove excess liquid, about 1/4 cup. While noodles are still hot, stir drained cottage cheese into cooled noodles mixture. Cover and refrigerate several hours until well chilled. Serve in plastic or copper mugs.

title: Red Pepper Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained and chopped | 4 ounces gyoza wrapper ( japanese dumplings, found in the oriental aisle of most major supermarkets ) | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 pinch red pepper, for color ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven, 350 degrees. Line baking tray with foil if you have one. Mix red peppers, gyoza wrappers, bread crumbs, and red pepper in small bowl. Spray pan with non stick spray and pour half the mixture onto pan. Bake in oven 15 minutes or until edges are crispy, bubbly and browned. Cool for 3 - 5 minutes. Serve with sweet french fries or tostitos.

title: Spanish Drunken Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb sausages | 4 teaspoons lime rind, grated | 4 teaspoons grated lemon juice | 4 teaspoons hot barbecue sauce | 2 teaspoons spice | 2 cans mandarin oranges, drained | 1 cup prepared medium-grain basmati rice | 4 teaspoons tequila
instructions: Cut sausages in half lengthwise and then crosswise, using a 1” knife. Rub the rind of the two sausages around the sausages. Combine remaining ingredients, except salt and pepper, in a large saucepan. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes or until meat is cooked. Stir in salt and pepper to taste. Serve with rice.

title: Enchiladas Verde Style
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken, cooked and shredded | 1 quart red enchilada sauce, bottled and warmed | 1 cup wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 6 ounces marc chianti wine or 6 ounces marsala
instructions: Combine all ingredients except wine vinegar and hot sauce in a non metal bowl, stirring at high speed until well combined. Do not boil. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the sauce in a piping bag with about ½ ounce of marcocain marinade into an enchilada enchilada sauce cup. Pipe or dunk 1 to 2 tbsp into the enchilada sauce. Repeat with remaining maricolds to make a total of 12 enchiladas. Place enchiladas in a single layer in a roasting pan. Pour about ½ cup of enchilada sauce around enchiladas and bake in preheated oven at 400 degrees f, basting every 10 minutes or so with remaining hot sauce on top, until sauce bubbling, about 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Sage and Watercress Soup
ingredients: 3 bunches watercress | 1 can vegetable broth ( soup stock ) | 3 tablespoons soymilk
instructions: Cut rind off of watercress and discard. Chop rind finely. Bring vegetable broth and soy milk to boil in 3 quart saucepan.

title: Vegetable and Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mixed sprouts | 1 can baked beans with molasses | 1 cup sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a shallow salad bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving. Serve chilled.

title: Away from Home Beer
ingredients: 1 cup beer ( corona is my favorite, just not an american beer ) | soy yogurt or yogurt ( for the brave )
instructions: Slightly thicken the beer with 2 oz. Of soy yogurt, or just a handful of plain yogurt.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,enchilada sauce,caper,irish cream,red pepper,penne pasta,chunky salsa,kosher salt black pepper
title: Spicy Penne W-Cream
ingredients: 1 box penne pasta | 1 teaspoon kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 can drained chickpeas ( garbanzo beans ), rinsed and drained | 1 jar mild chunky salsa, divided ( or less ) | 1 can enchilada sauce | 2 cups thick & chunky salsa, divided | 1/4 cup drained capers | fresh salsa | freshly grated irish cream ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook penne pasta according to package directions, but do not overcook. Meanwhile, bring a pot of lightly salted water to boil. Meanwhile, remove 1/2 cup of the salsa, save it to use in topping when serving, and heat it just until hot, stirring occasionally. Drain the noodles, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Add the rest of the salsa and drained chickpeas to the drained pasta & stir to combine. To serve, divide the pasta among 4 dinner sized serving bowls, spooning some salsa mixture down the middle, and top with 1/2 portions of the enchilada sauce, 1/2 portion of the remaining 1/2 cup of salsa, 1/2 cup of the reserved drained penne pasta water, 1 tablespoon of the drained capers and 1 tablespoon of the shredded cheese. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon shredded cheese, and top with 1/2 portion of the enchilada sauce and 1/4 cup of salsa.

title: Methi's Lactose Free Fried Noodles
ingredients: roti cani pasta meal : | 1 cup dried fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 cups unsweetened coconut milk | filling : | 2 tablespoons peanut oil, or as needed | 4 cups drained rotini pasta
instructions: Rinse fenugreek seeds and place in a mortar and pestle or spice mill. Grind fenugreek seeds in mortar and pestle until they are smooth. Pour coconut milk through a strainer over bowl, and set aside. Place fenugreek seeds in another bowl. Grind coconut and peanuts to a fine powder, and set aside. Heat peanut oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Mix together the fenugreek flavored coconut milk and fenugreek mixture. Reduce heat to low, and simmer for about 40 minutes to blend flavors. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Cook rotini pasta in boiling water until just al dente, or 8 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,alfalfa sprout,red chili pepper,cayenne,pork rib,nutritional yeast,feta cheese
title: My Mom's Feta Fried Beef Burger Recipe
ingredients: 4 lbs pork ribs, cooked till almost falling off | 1 can fat-free refried beansprouts | 1 1/2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 red chili pepper ( diced ) | 2 tablespoons cayenne | 0.5 container crumbled reduced-fat feta cheese | 1 cup corn oil
instructions: Preparation,. Cut your ribs at least an inch thick. Remove the meat that has been grated and set aside, leaving a bit of the fat in the pan.. Place your grated meat in a small bowl and mix it with all the rest of your remaining ingredients, except your crumbled feta cheese. In a small frying pan, toast your bread. Once it has crusted on a golden brown side and a bit crispy on the outside, remove from heat and spread on toasted bread then sprinkle feta cheese over it. Enjoy your burger.

title: Orange Peppers
ingredients: 12 large orange bell peppers | 1 1/2 cups white flour | pepper
instructions: Slit tops off of all peppers and scoop out some of the 'larger' portion of the white bulb to use as a capsicum. Rinse. Tear off the tops of the peppers and then place on a cloth over a bowl. Use your fingers or a vegetable brush to brush all the skin with a little olive oil. Slice the tops off of any remaining peppers. Cut the peppers into large bite sized pieces. Pre heat oven to 220°c or 190°c if using a fan forced oven. Place the peppers and flour in a large mixing bowl and gradually add enough boiling water to cover to make a smooth, rather thick batter. Add pepper pieces and coat well. Heat a large fry pan and spray with oil. Pour the batter into the pan and quickly spread over the peppers. Cook the peppers for 3 - 5 minutes, until golden and the top is crispy and brown. Serve with plain boiled or toasted bread and salad.

title: Beef and Bean Roundup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons arrowroot | 2 teaspoons low sodium soy milk | 1/2 cup dried beans, soaked overnight and rinsed | 1 lb hamburger buns | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup chopped deli ham, any cut of your choice
instructions: Drain all but 3 tbsp of the soaking liquid. Place the arrowroot in a small bowl with the soy milk and beans. Stir to combine, then set aside. Soak the hamburger bites in water for 1 hour. Drain, and pat dry with paper towels. Dissolve cornstarch in 3 tbsp of the soaking liquid and set aside. Heat up grill. Place the soaked and drained hamburger, bean curd mixture and egg in a food processor or blender, process until smooth. Spread mixture onto the hamburger bites and sprinkle with the chopped ham. Spray 2 baking sheets with cooking spray. Broil in oven, until the top is browned and bubbly and the toppings are starting to melt, 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Sweet Pot Pulled Pork
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs lean pork shoulder, cubed | 15 ounces refrigerated pizza dough | parmesan cheese, grated, for sprinkling | 8 ounces cantaloupe, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray a 13x9x2 inch baking pan with nonstick spray. Place the pork in the bottom of the dish, about 3/4 inch deep. Sprinkle the remaining ingredients on top of pork, placing the chopped cantaloupe between the pork and the pizza dough. Dot with butter. Bake for about 45 1hr or until crust is golden brown, turning dish after 5 minutes to brown evenly.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,italian parsley,provolone cheese,gouda cheese,chicken fillet,monterey jack cheese,greek yogurt,turmeric powder
title: Grilled Indian Yogurt Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken fillets | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 green chile pepper, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup shredded gouda cheese | 1/4 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Lightly coat grill pan with cooking spray. Heat, and grill chicken on both sides until cooked through, about 8 to 10 minutes per side. In a small bowl combine yogurt and 2 tablespoons parsley. Mix well. Place chicken on grill pan, and cook until grill marks appear, approximately 3 minutes per side. Spread gouda cheese evenly over fillets, sprinkle evenly with green chilie, and top with monterey jack cheese and gouda cheese. Place grill pan under grill until cheese is melted. Spread remaining 1/4 cup parsley on a plate. Place cooked chicken on plate and garnish with remaining parsley. Serve gouda and provolone cheeses with a side of roasted tomato and a salad. Leftover roasted tomato and roasted red pepper can be mixed together in a blender with 1/4 cup shredded jalapeno cheese. Leftover roasted red pepper can be used on top of grilled chicken.

title: Spicy Sizzlin Bread
ingredients: 1 red chile | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 3 1/4 ounces ciabatta, chopped into 1 1/4-inch cubes
instructions: Cut the chilli over the face of the bread and leave to stand for 10 minutes. Remove the deseeded chilli, and slice open to expose the fleshy section of the chilli. Tie with kitchen twine, and whack all the spices into the bread with your fingers. Heat the grill to its hottest and cook the bread until the bread is crisp and golden. Serve in small bowls and drizzle over a little extra olive oil if desired.

title: Chilled Cranberry-Hazelnut Pesto
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried cranberries ( parma-parma ) | 2 tablespoons toasted hazelnuts | 3 tablespoons burgundy wine or 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves, for garnish ( or 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley )
instructions: Remove the seeds from the cranberries by dropping a teaspoon in boiling water to jump start the cooking process. Drain. Place the cranberries in a bowl, cover tightly with a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out excess water. Place all ingredients except mint and hazelnuts in the bowl containing the cranberries and toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce leaf,rustic bread,kernel corn,shallot,lime juice
title: Romaine with Corn and Lime Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup crumbled rustic bread, divided | 1/2 cup sliced romaine lettuce | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained and liquid reserved | 1/3 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons chopped shallots
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup bread crumbs, romaine lettuce, corn, lime juice, and shallots in a small bowl. Drizzle dressing over salad.

title: Chinese Steak Cake Mix
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1/4 cup soya sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Prepare cake according to directions on box and spread out on pan. Cut steak into thin slices and brush with oil or melted soy sauce. Sprinkle with soya sauce. Bake for 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Pepperjack Steak
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs flank steaks | 1/3 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place all ingredients in a shallow roasting pan or roasting pan large enough to hold the meat.. Add enough water to cover meat. Cover, and roast 1 1/2 hours in the preheated oven, just until meat is tender and easily shreds easily with a fork.

title: Quick and Easy Mexican Burger
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning ( or your favourite brand ) | 1/2 cup olive | 1 can sliced olives | 2 -3 whole wheat hamburger buns | olive oil
instructions: Spray a skillet with cooking spray. Dump in the taco seasoning, spreading evenly all over the surface of the meat. Heat for a few minutes, or until brown. Put the olives in a small, oiled or glass bowl or paper towel and microwave for about another minute or so to soften. Put hamburger buns onto a plate and spray with cooking spray, or use a large bun press. Spread the meat mixture on each of the buns. Serve with taco sauce or sour cream.

title: Peppered Parsnips
ingredients: 1 kg parsnip ( approx ) | 1 1/2 kg golden raisins or 1 1/2 kg sultanas | 1 celery rib, chopped
instructions: Cook parsnips in boiling water for 15 minutes they are tender when pierced with point of sharp knife. Drain well. Pre heat oven to 220 c or 450°f. Toss together raisins with celery. Place in a large buttered ovenproof dish. Add parsnips and place in oven. Cook uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring once or twice, until parsnips are brown.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,enchilada sauce,garlic salt,corn oil,tamarind paste,marjoram,leek,red onion
title: Tamarind-Marinated Sweet Corn
ingredients: 1 medium red onion | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 large leek | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 2 teaspoons red onion, coursely chopped | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Cut the onion in half lengthwise, remove the ends then slice 1/2 thick. Wash and separate the halves. Slice the leek in thin 3/4 inch slices, rinse well. Place in a bowl with the other ingredients. Mix well with hands. Cover and refrigerate the mixture for at least 2 hours or overnight. Taste to adjust seasoning, and serve on tortillas that have been fried in corn oil. Or, serve plain or garnished with fresh mint and/or jalapeno slices.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,brown mustard seed,rock salt,cherry,black vinegar,cauliflower,pineapple chunk,caraway seed
title: Pineapple Swiss Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons black vinegar or 3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 8 teaspoons rock salt | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 14 ounces pineapple chunks, drained | 1 cup baby cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 medium sweet cherries, halved with the halved cherries intact | 3 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Grind the mustard seeds in a spice / coffee or mortar / pestle with the vinegar, salt and caraway seeds until very fine. Toss the pineapple chunks, cauliflower, cherries and cheese with the mustard seed salad. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,sirloin tip roast,bamboo skewer,red chili pepper,walnut
title: Chinese Roast Beef Kebabs -- Kebab Style
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast | 1 cup dry fresh breadcrumb | 1 tablespoon ground walnuts | 1 teaspoon ground red chili pepper | 7 bamboo skewers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Trim excess fat from roast. Score a pocket in roast center of roast into 1/2 inch slices. Combine bread crumbs and ground walnuts. Place bread crumb mixture into pocket in roast, then press bread crumb mixture in firmly. Wrap roast in foil, place on a plate, and refrigerate overnight. Remove roast from refrigerator about 30 minutes before cooking. Preheat grill to high. Place beef on grill, discard foil, and cook, about 10 minutes on center rack of the grill. Turn, and grill about 5 minutes on each side for medium.

Random Ingredients: mussel,pearl barley,tahini,borage leaf,cardamom seed,vanilla essence,shell pasta
title: Moroccan Shellfish and Barley
ingredients: 2 liters shell-on shrimp | 250 g pearl barley ( approx. 5 oz ) | 1 liter mussels, cleaned and debearded | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 100 ml tahini | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed ( optional ) | chopped fresh coriander leaves ( to garnish ) or parsley, to garnish ( to garnish )
instructions: Put the pearl barley in a large saucepan with the mussels and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil and then reduce to a simmer for 25 minutes, covered. Add the shrimp and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes, until the shells open. Turn off the heat and leave to stand. Meanwhile, in a bowl, stir the vanilla in the tahini until smooth and creamy. Add the cardamom seeds and gently fold into the warm shrimp mixture. Take the shellfish and add them to the sauce then chill for 5 minutes, if time permits. To serve, arrange the shellfish onto a serving dish and spoon over the warm soup, garnish with chopped coriander or parsley sprigs, if using and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,brandy,dark jamaican rum,tortilla,baking potato,hash brown,scallop,orange juice concentrate
title: Baked Haitian Escapillas
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 1 tablespoon orange juice concentrate | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup rum | 1/2 cup dark jamaican rum | 8 boneless skinless chicken drumsticks | 1 1/2 cups sliced scallops | 10 large tortillas | 1 bag frozen hash browns
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large bowl. In a small bowl, mix together the orange juice concentrate, brandy, and rum. Pour over potatoes, cover, and refrigerate for 15 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange drumsticks in a 2 quart baking dish, then arrange the scallops in a single layer on top. Distribute potato mixture evenly over meat. Bake for 30 minutes. Reduce heat to 350 degrees f. Bake for another 30 minutes. Stir in frozen hash browns. Bake uncovered for an additional 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Panna Cotta
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin | 2 tablespoons coffee
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the cayenne pepper, nutmeg, and unflavored gelatin. Place a clean cloth over a plate and sprinkle a few 2 tablespoons of water over the top. Pour a cup or two of ice cold water into the bottom of the bowl, just until the water starts getting watery. Dissolve the gelatin in the hot water. Add the coffee. Pour the gelatin mixture over the water in the bowl. Stir until all the liquid in the bowl and the gelatin is dissolved. Chill until set.

title: Homemade Tomato Jam
ingredients: 12 lbs plum tomatoes, about 1 pound per pound ( plum tomatoes ) | 3 cups pickling spices
instructions: Wash and cut whole tomatoes and tomatoes into 1 1/2 inch slices. Arrange in a very large bowl, adding pickling spices. Place large, heavy plastic wrap directly on tomatoes.

title: Cauliflower Au Jus
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into bite size pieces | 2 turnips, peeled and chopped | 2 egg whites, beaten | 1 1/2 cups catsup, sauce | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1/4 cup irish cream
instructions: Combine tomato sauce with harissa and bring to a simmer over fairly low heat. Add cauliflower and turnips and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in cream in a steady stream and cook for an extra 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Bramley Crumpets (Pudding)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Sift the flour into a bowl and rub in the nutmeg. Add the warm water and beat with a whisk. Using an electric mixer on slow speed, add about a 2/3 cup of the hot mixture and beat until the mixture forms a creamy paste. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Heat the griddle and brush the top with oil. Pipe 3 teaspoon tablespoons of the crumb mixture onto the griddle and cook until golden brown on both sides. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,corn oil,chicken,sirloin tip roast,spanish onion,red curry paste,soya sauce
title: Rabo's Chicken and Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin tip roast bone in ( or other lean meat of your choice such as pork, beef, etc. ) | salt and black pepper, to taste | oil, for frying | 2 tablespoons corn oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 large spanish onion, sliced & separated into rings | 1 1/2 teaspoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons soya sauce
instructions: Trim the fat from the beef and ask the butcher to cut it into 1 inch sized squares. Cut a piece of kitchen twine or kitchen twine across the meat so that it would sit flat on the cutting surface and pull of any loose bits. Cut the beef into thin slices, about 1/8 x 1/4 strips. Season the beef strips lightly with salt and pepper. In a wok, heat the oil to medium low heat. Add the beef strips and stir fry quickly until they're cooked through and are starting to brown. Stir in the thinly sliced onion rings, mix well, reduce heat to medium. Pour in the red curry paste. Stir fry for a few minutes, stirring regularly until the curry has slightly reduced. Add the soya sauce. Stir fry for another 30 seconds. Serve with rice. This is also good served over brown rice.

title: Tilapia Fillets Chocolate With Chocolate
ingredients: 1 tilapia fillet | 1/4 cup chocolate ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Wipe any scales from the fish with a damp paper towel and spread a thin layer of chocolate in the center of each fillet. Wrap each fillet in a piece of waxed paper, folding the whole thing like a packet. Place the wrapped fillets on a rack in a baking pan or directly on the rack. Bake for 15 minutes, then turn down heat to 300. Continue baking another 15 - 20 minutes and check on them every five minutes and check for tenderness with tooth pick. The fish is done when the fish flakes easily with a fork, when the internal temperature reaches 165 140° on the smallest part. When the fish is done place the pan or on the grill that has been turned on. Serve hot, with fresh fruit.

title: Quick Tuna Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pasta ( whole-wheat or elbow macaroni ) | 4 extra-large tuna steaks
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water for 5 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Scampi & Cucumber Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cucumber ( peeled, seeded and roughly chopped ) | 1 tablespoon scampi ( dried or fresh ) | 200 g whipped topping ( thawed, see notes )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Line baking tray with baking paper. In small jug combine cucumber, scampi and whipped topping & stir until combined. Spoon mixture into lined tray, smoothing the top. Bake for 15 - 25 minutes or until crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,dark chocolate chip,garlic,orange peel,red food coloring
title: Chocolate Chip Rigatoni Pasta
ingredients: 1 quart rigatoni pasta | 1 cup roasted crushed dark chocolate chips | 2 teaspoons finely chopped garlic | 1 - 1 1/2 cup thinly shaved orange peel | 2 -3 drops of orange food coloring
instructions: Cook rigatoni as package directs. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain again. In a microwave safe bowl, melt chips, garlic, orange peel and optional food color on high for 3 minutes. Drain rigatoni and add to chocolate mixture.

title: Smoked Salmon and Lentil Tartlets
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 2 cups cooked white rice | 500 g smoked salmon fillet | 1/4 cup mascarpone | 1 packet puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius. Place the lentils and rice in a saucepan and cover with 5 cups cold water. Place over medium heat and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes until the rice is softened. Place the salmon in a baking dish, and spread with 2/3 cup of the yoghurt. Drain the rice mixture and divide between two 4 cup capacity oven proof ramekins, filling each ramekin almost full. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until the salmon begins to flake. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool. When cool, remove and discard the fish bones. Mash the fish with a fork and divide between the ramekin bases. Top each tart with the mascarpone and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,garlic powder,yellow mustard,avocado,dark soy sauce,cod
title: Brazilian Fish Soup
ingredients: 1 head garlic powder | 1/4 cup yellow mustard | 2 cans chicken broth | 2 lbs small boneless cod | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 ripe avocado
instructions: Rinse the fish, remove all bones and cut into small chunks, removing the tail if it is larger than 1/2 inch. Cut up the crab, discarding any white veins. Place in a pot with the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Add the mustard, garlic powder and half the avocado and return to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes, until all fish is tender. Add the remaining avocado and remove the pot from the heat. Serve immediately.

title: Sizzling French Beans
ingredients: 1 lb frozen french beans | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 lb corn tortillas or 1/4 lb pita bread
instructions: Rinse french beans, removing any strings or damaged beans, and place in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover and steam over boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes or until beans are tender crisp. Cool, remove the strings and puree in food processor until smooth. Return pureed mixture to saucepan. Add chili flakes and bring to a boil, uncovered over moderate heat. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring often for 5 minutes or until sauce thickens slightly. Serve at once with tortillas.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,sage,pepperoni,grain rice,spring onion,yogurt,heavy whipping cream
