title: Gnocchi di Riso (Stuffed Rice Balls With Fresh Sage, Bacon, Rose Water and Yogurt)
ingredients: 8 ounces sliced pepperoni ( optional ) | 2 ounces low-fat swiss cheese | 1 -2 spring onion ( very finely chopped ) | 3 tablespoons long grain rice ( uncooked ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/8 teaspoon pepperoni | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh minced sage
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f spray cookie sheets with cooking spray, or line with parchment paper. To cook the rice, heat a large skillet on medium heat. Add the pepperoni and cook until it just begins to soften and the pepperoni begins to crisp up, about 1 - 2 minute. Remove the pepperoni and set aside. Cook the white rice and set aside. Cut all of the remaining slices of pepperoni into small cubes. In the same skillet as stated but with the bacon, quickly cook the chopped spring onions in a drizzle of olive oil until tender and translucent. Remove the pancake from the skillet and place on a plate until needed. To stuff the rice, take 1 tablespoon of rice, add about 1 - 2 tablespoons of cheese and a sprinkling of chopped fresh sage. With your hands, work the rice with your palms, making sure the rice is not very sticky, and you won't have a dough that sticks to your fingers. If the rice is not sticky, add about 3 to 4 - 3 tablespoons butter, about 3 tablespoons oil or even more oil. If not sticky, add an additional tablespoon of flour. Place the rice in a bowl and gently mix it with your hands, making sure it isn't sticking to your hands. Add the onion/cheese mixture and mix very gently. The mixture should be moist. The rice should have a loose, satiny texture. When the rice is cooked, it should be fairly sticky. Place the rice ball in a shallow dish and gently pat it down. Cover with parchment or wax paper. Repeat with the peppers and rice. Place the dish on a cookie sheet or oven rack set at about 150°f. Carefully remove the rice ball from the dish and carefully using a fork, gently and gently pull the rice ball in the center of the plate. Make sure it is not sticking. Repeat with all of the rice. Use the spatula to flatten the rice ball slightly, then take the parchment or wax paper and cut the rice ball into small balls using a sharp knife, working as needed. Repeat for all of the rice balls. Garnish with rose water, fresh minced sage, and minced fresh pepperoni if you like.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,bicarbonate soda,maple syrup,double cream,ginger garlic paste,spaghetti,chicken broth
title: Spicy Sausage and Pasta With Ginger Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1/2 cup chicken broth or 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 pint double cream | 12 ounces spaghetti
instructions: Sausage,. Remove sausage casings from casings. Cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Place in a large saucepan. Add the chicken broth or tomato juice, maple syrup, ginger garlic paste, and bicarb of soda. Bring to boil. Add sausage and reduce heat to medium. Simmer, stirring occasionaly. For pasta and sauce,. Cook pasta,. Drain pasta and rinse with cold water. Transfer to large bowl. Add cream in a slow stream. Mix throughly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: oil,cardamom seed,mustard seed,ice,dark rum,banana,prosciutto di parma
title: Vainilla Chips
ingredients: 4 whole cardamom seeds, finely powdered | 1 -2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 4 tablespoons oil | 4 sheets prosciutto di parma | 4 bananas, peeled | 1/3 cup dark rum or 1/3 cup rum vermouth | crushed ice
instructions: In a small bowl place 1 tsp of the powdered cardamom seeds, 2 tbsp of the mustard seeds and 4 tbsp of the oil and whisk together. Cut 2 slices of prosciutto di parma di parma onto each cookie sheet. With a toothpick, carefully and evenly sprinkle the 3 tbsp of crushed garlic on each slice. Pour the rum over the top of the bread. Lightly shake the cookie sheet every 20 seconds or so. Put 1/4 of the rum/mustard oil in the skillet over medium high heat. As soon as the oil is warm to the touch, add the other tsp of cardamom. After a minute or so, add one piece of prosciutto di parma to the oil and toast for 30 - 60 seconds. Take the slices from the pan, add with a few tbsp of rum, turn over, place on individual plate.

title: Auntie Lori's Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain white rice | 1 egg | 1/4 cup fresh grape | 4 teaspoons vodka
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions. When done, drain and cool. In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the egg, grape and vodka. Stir the rice into egg mixture and stir to blend. Heat a non stick, large skillet over medium heat. Spoon some rice into the pan, enough to make a nice circle about 1 1/4 inches in diameter. Carefully slide the rice circle into the hot skillet. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, just until it starts to wilt. Do not overcook. Repeat until all the rice is cooked. The rice is done when it is translucent. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,thyme sprig,halibut fillet,lamb shank,cake flour
title: Lamb Shank and Halibut Risotto With Crust
ingredients: 12 1/2 ounces lamb shank | 12 ounces arborio rice | 12 ounces lamb shanks | 2 ounces cake flour, plus extra for the pan | 6 -8 fresh thyme sprigs, for decoration | 2 ounces cake flour, for decoration
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f lightly oil a large roasting tin and line the base with 2 layers of tin foil, then cover with a double thickness of tin foil. Bake the shank in the oven for approximately 1 hour. When the meat is ready, remove it from the oven and allow to cool. Wash and dry the shanks, removing any excess fat. Cut the lamb into slices about 1/4 inch thick. Cut the lamb meat into cubes about 2 inches in size and place in a mixing bowl. Measure in the prepared rice and lamb shanks, cover with plastic film and cover with a cloth and set aside. Put the flour in a food processor and finely cube the thyme. Toss these well together and gradually mix in enough cake flour to make a soft but firm dough. Divide the dough into 24 balls and roll out on a floured surface until about 3/4 inch in diameter. Arrange the pieces of lamb around the base of the pan, cover with the rice and lay the pieces of dough over it. Top with thyme and dot with the reserved flour. Brush the top with oil and the paper with oil. Cover with a double thickness of tin foil and bake for 1 hour. Remove the foil and bake for another 30 minutes or until the rice is just tender and the liquid has been absorbed. Turn off the oven and leave the door slightly ajar to allow steam to escape. Allow 4 servings if eaten immediately.

title: Quinoa and Fish
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 2 cups nonfat milk | 1 can salmon, thawed drained and flaked | 1 cup cheese, of your choice
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Meanwhile, stir together the milk and salmon in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and cook for about 20 minutes. Add the quinoa and cook for an additional 10 minutes, until a creamy consistency is achieved. If the quinoa looks dry, stir in a little water. Top with cheese, if desired and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: potato flake,pimiento,yogurt,red chilies,salt pepper,kosher salt,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pecorino Rosti (Pork and Parmesan)
ingredients: 1/3 cup dry instant potato flakes | 1/3 cup grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 4 oz ) | 1 can minced red chilies, drained | 1 jar pimientos, drained | kosher salt | 6 tablespoons plain low-fat yogurt | salt and pepper
instructions: Heat a grill pan or a dutch oven over medium heat. Mix the potato flakes, 1/3 cup of the cheese and chiles, and 1/2 cup of the pimentos and 1 - ½ tsp of the salt together in a small bowl and place the mixture on the grill pan. Cook until the cheese just begins to melt, about 3 - 4 minutes. Stir the mixture as necessary, so that there are no clumps. Stir in the yogurt and season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Spinach Pasta
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 1 garlic cloves, minced or pressed | 1 jar red hot pepper sauce | 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Fennel Crumb Topping
ingredients: 2 cups breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together and transfer to a lightly greased or non stick tray. Refrigerate and slice.

title: Pineapple Daiquiri
ingredients: 3/4 cup ice water ( or as directed in the ingredients list ) | 1 fresh pineapple - peeled, cored and cut into thin slices | 2 fluid ounces vodka, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour the ice water into a tall glass to about 2/3 full. Quickly mix in the pineapple slices, then pour in the vodka. Stir gently to coat the pineapple slices.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,onion soup mix,rhubarb,kielbasa sausage,golden syrup,pepper sauce,casing
title: Rhubarb, Sausage, and Kielbasa Stuffed
ingredients: 1 pound kielbasa sausage, casings removed and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 package frozen rhubarb, thawed, drained and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 1/4 cups taco sauce | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 package coating for stuffing
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange the kielbasa sausage slices around the inside of the pan, leaving one of the slices on the edge of the pan bottom. Combine the rhubarb, onion soup mix, and golden syrup in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,chicken stock powder,vanilla wafer,salt pepper,avocado
title: Avocado Soup
ingredients: 2 cups of mashed avocados | 750 ml chicken stock powder | 4 beef ribs | 2 tablespoons vanilla wafers | salt and pepper, to taste ( optional )
instructions: First make the avocado soup by combining all ingredients in a separate pot over a medium low flame. Bring to a boil, whisking constantly until it turns a smooth liquid. Add more chicken or vegetable stock for thinning if you prefer.

Random Ingredients: white peppercorn,milk,orange peel,chocolate,purpose flour,tomatillo,bean thread noodle,tex mex cheese
title: Noodle-Stuffed Tomatillo Balls (Puff Pastry for the Crock Pot)
ingredients: 12 tomatillos, husked, rinsed and patted dry | 6 tablespoons white peppercorns, coarsely ground | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 lb fresh tomatillo, rinsed and patted dry | 6 tablespoons white peppercorns, coarsely ground | 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate, finely chopped | 7 ounces tex-mex cheese, shredded | 4 1/2 cups whole plain all-purpose flour | 3/4 lb bean thread noodles | orange peel ( optional )
instructions: Put the tomatillos in the crock pot, and sprinkle them with 1 tablespoon each of the white and coarsely ground peppercorns and 2 tablespoons of both of the coarsely ground white peppercorns. Place over medium heat, and cook until they are very soft, about 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon or slotted grapefruit spoon, transfer the tomatillos to a separate bowl. Cool slightly, then mash with the 6 tablespoons of white peppercorns and 1/2 cup of flour. Stir in the chopped chiles. Put the remaining 1/4 cup plus 3 tablespoons of white peppercorns and the chocolate into a medium saucepan, and cook over medium low heat, stirring constantly, until the chocolate melts and the mixture is smooth. Set aside and cool completely. Meanwhile, mix the remaining 1/4 cup white peppercorns and 1/2 cup flour in a large bowl. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and pour in enough hot water to make a soft dough. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, knead it briefly, and form into a ball. Tear off 1 tablespoon of the dough, and roll it into a ball, tipping it slightly off the side of the bowl. Using your hands or a teaspoon, scoop out some of the dough. Flatten it slightly, and set it aside for a while to firm up a bit. Roll out the remaining dough, place it on a rimmed baking sheet, and set it aside. Wash and dry the bean thread noodles. Put the noodles in a large bowl and cover with boiling water. Let them soak until tender, about 18 minutes. Drain, and immediately tip them into a colander. Squeeze any excess water out of the noodles, and place them in another bowl. Toss with 2 tablespoons of white peppercorns, 1/2 cup flour and 1/4 cup of the melted chocolate. Set aside. Roll out the remaining dough to make a 10 by 15 inch rectangle. Cut into 4 rounds with a cookie cutter. Cut a well in the center of each dough round. Divide the noodles among the rounds. Toss lightly and spread the tomatillo mixture along the top of the dough. Sprinkle with cheese. Fold the dough over the filling and roll it up to enclose it.

title: Black-Eyed Peas With Cardamom
ingredients: 1 cup black-eyed peas | 1 black cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: Wash the black eyed peas and drain them. Cover them with water and leave to soak overnight. The next day, when ready to cook, bring water to boil. Add the black eyed peas and cook for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the cardamom seeds and lower the fire. Cook, covered, for 15 - 20 minutes or until black eyed peas are fully cooked.

title: My Dad's Lemon Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs pasta, your favorite brand will do | 1/2 lb lemonade, fresh | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 -2 cup water | 2 tablespoons lard
instructions: In a large pot, mix together the ingredients. Cook over medium heat until desired thickness. Pour over the hot pasta. Serve chilled.

title: Japanese Cheddar Fries (Nasu No Kiri)
ingredients: 3 1/2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Peel the ginger and grate on the grater to yield approximately 1/4 pound of grated ginger. Stir in the white pepper. Transfer the resulting paste to an airtight container and store at room temperature for up to 2 months.

title: Poppy Seed French Toast
ingredients: 12 puffs poppy seeds | 2 eggs | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup creme fraiche
instructions: In a small bowl, combine eggs, milk, worcestershire sauce and creme fraiche. Add poppy seeds and mix until well blended. Pour into a sprayed 9x13 baking dish and press puffs onto it to cover evenly. Bake at 350 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Quick and Easy Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 hoagie rolls | 1/4 cup romano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat your oven to broil. Open the hoagie rolls, and spread a thin layer of grated cheese on each slice. Place a small piece of roast beef on each piece of hoagie roll, just to top the roast beef. Broil for about 2 - 4 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,apple cider,apricot preserve,vegetable,goya sofrito sauce,guacamole,dark red kidney bean
title: Goya-Style Italian Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1 cup mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup guacamole | 1 tablespoon goya sofrito sauce | 1/8 cup grated parmesan cheese | 4 ounces chopped dried apricots in sweet butter, soaked in water and drained | 1 cup apple cider, chilled
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until veggies are tender. Serve with bread rolls if desired.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,turmeric,flat leaf parsley,green chili salsa,heavy whipping cream,grain white rice,garlic powder
title: Spanish Rice Ala Chuva or Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice, uncooked | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 can green chili salsa ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Put rice in a medium saucepan, cover and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes or until almost dry. Remove from heat, and let sit, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork, and stir in garlic powder. While still covered, stir in green chile salsa and oil. Let stand for another 5 minutes. Stir in cream, parsley and turmeric. Taste and add salt if needed. Spoon into a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onion.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,dark brown sugar,green,oatmeal,double cream,key lime juice
title: Oatmeal Ginger Creme
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups oatmeal | 3 green cardamom pods or 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 6 allspice berries | 6 tablespoons double cream | 6 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons fresh key limes, juice of
instructions: Place the oatmeal and cardamom pods in a double thick, heavy based pan and toast over a low medium heat stirring often until they are fragrant, about 3 minutes. Add the allspice and toast for 1 minute more, stirring often. Place the cream in a small frying pan and add the sugar, stirring to dissolve it, and then add the limes and bring to boil, stirring until the liquid is syrupy and coats the back of a metal spoon. Pour into the oatmeal mixture and stir to combine. Cook on a moderately low heat stirring occasionally until the consistency is syrupy and thickened and the syrup has reduced to a jam like consistency. When ready to serve, stir in the grated ginger, if using and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Transfer to a warmed serving dish and pour in any remaining syrup. Serve with fresh bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,seasoning salt,cheese,peach,tuna steak,mustard powder,icing sugar,okra
title: Tasty Tuna and Vegetable Tray with Grated Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg fresh tuna steaks | 1 kg okra, ends trimmed, cut into bite-sized pieces | 150 g red capsicums or 150 g other long green capsicums | 1 kg icing sugar | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | fresh peach, juice of | 1 cup tasty cheese, grated
instructions: Place the tuna steaks in the freezer for an hour and take them out and ready for grill or to barbecue. Meanwhile, put the okra into a pot, cover with cold water, and bring to the boil. Cook, uncovered, for around 5 minutes until tender and soft. Drain and plunge into cold water until ready to use. Place the chopped tomatoes in the fridge until ready to serve, at least 20 minutes but ideally more. Meanwhile combine the icing sugar, season and mustard in a bowl. Stir in the peaches and then fold through the tuna and tomato mixture with a large metal spoon. Spread the tuna mixture into an ovenproof dish, top with grated cheese, then pour over enough ice water until just covering the tuna. Bake in a moderate oven for around 20 minutes, just until the tuna is just firm to the touch and the cheese has melted.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,oyster sauce,seasoning salt,cider vinegar,red pepper flake,italian seasoning
title: Hot Indian Style Pickled Eggs I
ingredients: 8 large fresh oysters or 8 large canned oysters | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar ( i use red wine vinegar ) | 1 tablespoon maggi seasoning salt, plus extra for seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning ( i use mccormick's tuscan-style seasoning ) | 1 dash crushed red pepper flakes, to taste | 1 teaspoon dried coriander leaves, for serving
instructions: Heat a nonstick wok or skillet large enough to hold all of the ingredients over high heat for 7 minutes or until very hot but not smoking. Add the oil, swirling to coat the surface. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the oysters to a warmed plate and put them on top of a bed of chopped lettuce. Top with chopped lettuce. Heat the remaining oil and add the seasoning salt, italian seasoning, red pepper flakes and coriander. Make sure the seasoning is mixed well before adding the liquid. Place the fried oysters on top of lettuce. Serve hot.

instructions: In a large saucepan, heat soup, broth, and macadamia nuts. Heat for 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Spicy Noodle-Veggie Casserole (Vegan)

instructions: First, mix pineapple chunks with juice, 1 tablespoon dried chives, italian salad dressing. Repeat previous three layers of bread until you have a total of three layers of bread. Cut kabobs from a block of pineapple with a peeler, cut pineapple cubes to fit in your freezer, cut the block about 1/2 inch thick. Place pineapple skewers 2 inches apart on baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Spray kabobs with cooking spray, and bake in preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until lightly browned and bubbly. You can also place these in a bag of marinated for one and bake while they are cooking. These can also be cooked on a grill if you are using the oven right away, then wrap in freezer bags. Let them sit out for a couple of hours before using, or you can leave the kabobs in the freezer for as long as you like. When using oven, this is tricky. The kabobs need to be at least frozen, so do not skip this step. But make sure you have a disposable plastic container, and preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. This is a recipe that requires a baking sheet with a lid. If using a cookie sheet, line the bottom of your baking dish with parchment paper. Place the kabobs on the baking sheet, brush liberally with cooking spray, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until browned on top. After turning the kabobs over, brush with cooking spray, and place in your baking dish, again, lightly browning on both sides. Once you have your crust on the bottom of your dish, pour pineapple salad and kabobs over the top. If you used a pizza maker, adjust the oven as needed and bake as directed.

instructions: Combine noodles, meat, egg yolks and capers in large bowl. Place on platter with capers and sliced rinds of parsnips. Sprinkle with jerk seasoning.

title: Sweet Sausage

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prick sausages all over with a fork. Combine all ingredients together in a dutch oven. Cover the pan. Bake at 350f for 2 hours. Remove from oven and add a few ice cubes to help release juices. Cut in thick slices and serve. The amount of meat served will depend on how thick or thin your sausage is.

title: Korean Bento Roll
ingredients: 1/4 bunch fresh flat bread, crusts removed | 1 ounce plain flour | 1/4 lb bok choy, trimmed, leaves torn into 4 | sliced dry tomato paste | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground nori, plus a good amount extra, for garnishing | crumbs, for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Put everything into a food processor, leaving plenty of white sesame seeds scattered over the top. Process until it forms a ball, adding more flour gradually, until you have a thick, smooth, well blended consistency. Roll out flatbread on a floured surface to 6'' in diameter. Dust with dried flakes, and stretch or roll into log shapes about the thickness of a swiss roll. Cut into 1 1/2'' pieces and leave on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Place the sheet, cut side down, in the oven. Bake in the center of the oven until the bottoms are lightly golden, 30 to 35 minutes. Check with a toothpick after 10 minutes and put on a board lightly dusted with flakes, and to remove excess fat. Wrap in a cloth and store at room temperature for up to 3 days. Garnish with a little crushed ice if you like a stronger flavour.

title: Breaded Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 - 3 1/2 lbs chicken wings ( per person ) | 1 tablespoon coarse salt | 2 cups fine dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f with a rolling pin or cleaver, cut the chicken wing tips vertically down between the joints. The joints should be very thinly and evenly separated. Toss the tips with the salt. Roll wings in the bread crumbs to coat. Place on a cookie sheet in a single layer. Place the baking sheet in oven and bake until the wings are very tender and the crumbs are browned, about 1 hour. Turn the wings over and bake for an additional 15 - 20 minutes, or until the crumbs are browned and bubbly.

title: Dolly Oven Cherry Fritters
ingredients: 125 -200 g mixed dried cherries | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 220c/170c fan/gas lightly grease or line baking sheets. Take off the gizzards tray and place the dried cherries onto the baking paper. Brush the cherries lightly so that the dried cherries will be turned around in the hot oven. Turn the cherries over so the dried cherries get an even coating of glaze on them. Bake in the middle of the oven for about 20 minutes or until the dried cherries are a pale golden colour. To ensure that they won't burn, put the tray on a warmed board and while still warm roll and dry. You can also roll and dry the cherry while they are still warm if you wish. Enjoy.

instructions: Cover and refrigerate overnight for flavor to develop. Drain beef and discard marinade. Place beef in a roasting pan that will hold the fat. Place the roasting pan on a rack in a 350 degree oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven and lower temperature slightly. ingredients: 3 slices white bread ( or your choice of bread ) | 3 tablespoons ketchup or 3 tablespoons tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons parsley | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( or more to taste ) | 4 -8 garlic cloves, minced ( depending on taste ) | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder ( optional ) | 2 -3 teaspoons ketchup ( optional ) | tortilla or corn chips
instructions: Wash out a bit of the bread to dry up. Cut slices of bread very thin and lay out on a table top to dry out the excess moisture. Combine the rest of the ingredients and put some filling on one side of one of the slices of bread. Top the filling with the other slice of bread. Place in a baking tray or on a cookie sheet lined with tin foil on the lowest rack of your oven and cook in the oven at 80% for about 20 minutes. You might have to give it a stir halfway through it as it soaks up the extra sauce.

title: Parmesan-Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 pounds pork tenderloin, cubed | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In large, heavy resealable plastic bag, combine pork, parmesan cheese, and seasoned salt. Shake to coat. Place on parchment paper lined baking sheet that has been liberally sprayed with cooking spray. Bake in preheated oven 30 minutes per pound at 350 degrees f. Remove from oven and immediately spoon juices evenly onto the warm baking sheet.

title: Easy Beef Broth
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into cubes | salt and pepper
instructions: Add water to a large soup pot. Add the meat. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 3 hours. Add seasoning while cooking.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,bean,bean sprout,jumbo shrimp,taco sauce,garlic paste
title: Shrimp Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup bean sprouts, packed | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until shrimp turn pink. Serve with corn chips or salad. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,dark chocolate,yellow bell pepper,watermelon,cream tartar,puff pastry,bacon
title: Creamy Steamed Watermelon Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 6 ounces thick-cut bacon | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 large firm white flesh fish, such as halibut ( such as halibut, sole or a firm white fish ) | 1/2 cup cream of tartar | 3 tablespoons water | 1 package sliced fresh watermelon ( about 20g each ) | 2 ounces dark chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Fill a large pot with rapidly boiling water. Add pasta and stir to separate. Set aside. In a large skillet, cook bacon over medium high heat, stirring, until crisp. Remove bacon and drain bacon on paper towels, leaving about 1 tablespoon drippings in the pan. Add bell pepper to drippings.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,poppy seed,bread machine yeast,ramen noodle,pasta,linguine,liquid smoke
title: Pasta With "meat" Balls
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups dry bread machine yeast or 1 3/4 cups bread flour, divided | 2 cups bread ( or flour ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 2 tablespoons dry liquid smoke | 12 ounces dry linguine | 24 ounces of chopped meat ( optional ) | 13 ounces frozen and ready to eat ramen noodles or 3/4 cup cooked noodles | 1/4 cup poppy seed
instructions: Add 2 cups of the bread flour to the bowl of the machine. Add the dry creole seasoning, liquid smoke and the remaining 3 cups of flour. Run the machine on the dough setting or the dough cycle, as needed. Add the linguine to the dough while the machine is on it's baking mode and knead for 4 - 5 minutes. Return the dough to the mixing bowl, cover with plastic and let rise.. In a large skillet, add the meat if using and heat. Drain the linguine and return to pan. Add the meat mixture and ramen noodles and mix well. When the dough rises to the top of the skillet, punch down the dough. Divide the meat, noodles and meat into 12 balls and place on a parchment lined cookie sheet. Set aside. Make a hole in the middle of each ball of dough and fill it with half the meat mixture. Sprinkle the remaining 2 cups of bread flour on top. Pour water into the center of the hole, forming a cup. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes or until the tops of the balls have browned. Put the pan on the table during the last 5 minutes to add the juices. Remove the hot loaf on to a serving plate. Serve with sauteed greens.

title: Melon Juice
ingredients: 2 lbs watermelon | 8 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 cups water | 1 cup ground cranberries | 1 teaspoon ground roasted hazelnuts | 1 teaspoon ground roasted ground mustard or 1 teaspoon msg
instructions: Put water melon in a saucepan and cover with water.

title: Chop Chipped Turnips and Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turnips, peeled, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup hot tapenade | 8 flour tortillas or 8 corn tortillas, 6 inches in diameter, cut in half | vegetable oil, for deep frying
instructions: Place turnips in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then cook over low heat, covered, for 1 hour, or until tender. Drain. Set aside to drain for 20 minutes. Mash and reserve. Coarsely chop 2 tablespoons of the turnip. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine onion, cocoa, cardamom and cayenne. Melt remaining 1/4 cup tbs of the taco sauce in a double boiler over very low heat. Add the mashed turnips and cook for 15 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the butter and margarine and cook, stirring constantly, for an additional 2 or 3 minutes. Spread about 1/4 cup of the chpped turnip mixture on half of a tortilla. Fold the tortilla in half, then roll up like a jelly roll and place seam side down in a baking dish. Repeat with remaining tortillas. Pour about 1/4 inch vegetable oil in a large skillet to a depth of 1 inch. Heat over low flame until it is hot but not smoking. Fry 10 to 12 quesadillas at a time, covered, until a golden brown crust has formed over the tortillas, shaking the pan occasionally, about 3 minutes. Turn off the heat and allow the quesadillas to cool in the oil for 10 seconds, until the bottom is crispy. Remove a few at a time with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Repeat with remaining turnip mixture. Serve warm. Note, i had some frustration at home frustration after eating these because they quickly turned brown and crispy.

title: Easy Thai Pork Loin Patties
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/2 cup thai basil | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 cup pork loin
instructions: In a glass or plastic container over medium heat, mix together the egg substitute, thai basil, coriander, and 1/2 of the pork. Place the remaining 1/2 of pork into the mixture and mix lightly with your hand to ensure a uniform consistency. Heat cooking oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Dip the pork in the mixture lightly and cook until cooked and lightly browned on both sides, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Remove to a platter and spread the remaining mixture evenly over the top.

title: Horseradish
ingredients: 125 ml prepared horseradish, chilled | 2 red chiles, deseeded and roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons habanero peppers, finely chopped
instructions: To make the horseradish dressing, mix all of the ingredients together and refrigerate until required. To serve, spread the horseradish over two small bunches of bread or toast.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,italian seasoning,sparerib,salt pepper,chile,worcestershire sauce,baby spinach,orange
title: Spareribs Au Gratin
ingredients: 4 lbs spareribs or 4 lbs goose, cut into 8 serving pieces about 3 pounds | 1 1/2 cups packed baby spinach | 1 pinch dried chile | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon grated orange rind | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar or 1 teaspoon granular | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large skillet. Spray with cooking oil spray. Place the ribs in the skillet, cook, turning once, until browned, browned on all sides. Remove the ribs from the skillet, reserving any liquid. In the same skillet, add the remaining ingredients. Cover and cook for 1 hour. Remove from heat, remove and discard any bones. Ladle the sauce into a bowl and add the ribs back to the sauce. Serve over prepared pasta.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,sultana,cauliflower floret,chocolate baking square,catsup,pineapple juice,pear
title: Hannah's Easy Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup heinz german sweet potato chips | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 2 teaspoons tomato juice | 1/2 pear, diced | 1 cauliflower floret, sliced in small pieces
instructions: Mix the catsup, pineapple juice, chinese sweet potato chips, sultanas, tomato juice and pear together and stir. Place the cauliflower in a salad bowl and pour the sauce over it. Gently mix them, but careful not to smash them. Enjoy.

title: Champagne Gateaux
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon champagne, white | 12 phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 6 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 1 ounce apple juice
instructions: Melt chocolate over hot water or microwave in saucepan. Brush over phyllo sheets. Place 1 tbsp of mince mixture on bottom of phyllo. Roll up to enclose filling. Place on waxed paper lined cookie sheet and sprinkle with the remaining chocolate. Bake at 350 f for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,ginger paste,salmon fillet,eggplant,self rising flour,rice,dijon mustard
title: Crispy Ginger and Eggplant Fried With Mustard
ingredients: 4 eggplants | 6 cups self rising flour | 1 teaspoon ground ginger paste | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 3 lbs top quality salmon fillets, cut into serving portions | cooked rice, to serve
instructions: Place eggplants on a roasting tray in a 400°f oven and roast until tender when pierced with a toothpick or pierced with a skewer, 40 to 50 minutes. Allow to cool, then chop coarsely. Place flour, ginger, white pepper and dijon into a large bowl and stir in eggplant. Place salmon on a lightly floured surface and knead quickly to remove any air pockets. Place oil in a large frying pan over high heat. When oil is shimmering, shallow fry salmon until golden brown and flake easily with a fork. Drain on absorbent paper. Transfer to absorbent paper. Serve with rice.

title: Wash the Rice
ingredients: 8 cups water, or more as needed | 4 cups long grain white rice
instructions: Bring 4 cups water and 4 cups rice to a boil in a large pot. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until all water is absorbed, 30 to 45 minutes. Remove from heat and keep covered 15 minutes. Drain any excess water. Stir rice with a fork and return to a boil. Cover and cook over medium low heat until rice is tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Korean Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 lbs ground round | 8 ounces barbeque sauce | watercress ( i use 1 bunch for the finished product ) | red pepper flakes ( optional ) | raisins ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients, store in airtight container overnight, then re freeze. Remove from freezer and re mix the top with just enough water to cover all the meat. Let sit for at least 1/2 an hour so the meat doesn't brown.

title: Pepperoni Poppy Seed Cabbage
ingredients: 12 slices kielbasa, cut in half | 12 ounces fresh sliced mozzarella balls | 3 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1/3 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Cook the sliced kielbasa in a skillet over medium heat until lightly browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the kielbasa to a plate. Increase heat to medium high and sprinkle with the poppy seeds. Cook for 1 minute. Spread the mozzarella slices on top of the poppy seeds. Top the mozzarella with the hot pepperoni slices. Sprinkle on the grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,nutmeg,port wine,hoisin sauce,green bean,chicken meat
title: Spicy Chicken With Green Beans
ingredients: 1 can chicken meat, drained | 1 can green beans, drained | 1 can whole kernel corn or ( 9 ounce ) can corn drained | 1/4 cup port wine | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 dash nutmeg
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine chicken, undrained green beans, corn or corn, wine, hoisin sauce, nutmeg and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spinach, Beans and Meat Salad
ingredients: 350 g breadsticks | 400 g frozen meat | 450 g frozen spinach | 150 g dried cherries | 1/2 bunch chives | 1 cup red beans | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Prepare the spinach according to the directions on the bag. Chop the cherries and chives. To make the salad, put the red beans in a pan with water, bring to the boil and then cover and cook till just tender. When the meat is cooked, remove it and cut it into small chunks. Drain the red beans and chop into smaller pieces. Drain the frozen spinach and then put it in a large bowl with 2 tablespoons of ice cold water to stop it drying out. Break the breadsticks in 2cm pieces and put them in the pan with the mixed meat. Cook them over a medium heat stirring continuously about 5 - 6 minutes until they are golden and crispy. Cut the breadsticks into 5cm squares, and put them in a bowl with the spinach. Add the cherries and chillies and stir to combine. Add the red beans and stir to combine. Add the sugar and stir. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Serve as an appetiser or as a main course on a bed of plain toasted breadsticks.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,vanilla essence,black mustard seed,olive oil,italian bread,merlot
title: Italian Bread Salad
ingredients: 12 slices italian bread, toasted ( such as sourdough ) | 1/2 cup prepared ranch dressing mix | 3/4 cup merlot, chilled and strained ( or any other sparkling white wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon olive oil
instructions: Place toasted bread in a mixing bowl and stir in the ranch dressing mix, wine, mustard seed, vanilla essence and oil. Toss until well coated and spoon onto a serving plate. Sprinkle with remaining toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,kaffir lime leaf,vanilla ice cream,chicken thigh,lentil
title: Lentil and Pineapple Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 1 cup dried lentils | 4 chicken thighs, skinned and cut into 2 - 3 chunks | 1 can pineapple slices in juice, drained | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 2 scoops vanilla ice cream
instructions: Put lentils in large bowl and cover with water. Let soak for 1 hour. Drain and put in large food processor, add chicken. Add pineapple and lime leaves, puree. Add scoops of ice cream. Process until smooth. If to thick, add a little water as needed and add 1 tbsp more at a time.

title: Kiss Rolls (Kisshoops)
ingredients: 2 sheets kiwi fruits, cut crosswise into eight | 2 tablespoons mochiko sweet rice flour | 2 teaspoons premium vodka | 5 lettuce leaves
instructions: In a large piece of cheesecloth or saran wrap, place one sheet of kiwi fruit and top with one sheet of mochiko rice flour. Bring the sides together, and twist the center tightly to seal. Massage the kiwi fruit onto the rice flour in a circular motion until well mixed. Repeat with the remaining sheets of kiwi fruit and rice flour. Sprinkle lightly with sambal, and leave to rise in a warm place for 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, set the buns on a plate or baking sheet, and brush the tops of the buns with the vodka. Cut kisshoops into 1/2 inch thick slices to serve.

title: Mimi's "Pasta Primavera"
ingredients: 16 ounces gemelli pasta | 1 jar sliced pimiento, drained ( optional )
instructions: Cook gemelli according to directions. Drain, and rinse with cold running water to stop the cooking, drain well. Add the pasta, and stir in pimentos if desired. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: radish,asparagus,cumin,red bliss potato,pork shoulder,feta cheese,pork tenderloin,vermicelli
title: Pork Vermicelli With Asparagi and Potato Crispy Feta
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless pork tenderloin | 1/4 lb asparagus, trimmed ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 teaspoon cumin, freshly ground | 1/2 lb red bliss potato, halved | 12 ounces pork shoulder, trimmed of fat, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 8 ounces pork vermicelli ( about 2 cups ) | 1/3 cup fresh mint, finely chopped | 2 ounces feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Make vinaigrette, in a blender or food processor, puree 1/4 cup of the asparagus with the cumin. Set aside. Rinse asparagus, cook in a 6 - 8 qt pot until just tender. Remove to a colander set over a bowl and let cool. Cut asparagus into 2 inch segments, removing asparagus tips and coarse ends. Transfer asparagus to a bowl and add 1/3 cup of the vinaigrette.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,italian parsley,poblano chile,confectioner sugar,meatball
title: Tortilla de Campagna (Chile Mashedmeat Sandwich)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried poblano chiles, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried italian parsley ( optional ) | 1 pound frozen cooked meatballs, thawed | 12 thin-sliced monterey jack cheese or other cheese, grated | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cover dried poblano chiles with hot water and let soften, about 20 minutes. Drain and discard water. Place chiles in a bowl along with parsley.

title: Spanish Cashew Nuts for Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1 package spanish rice mix, spanish or dry | 2 tablespoons cashews | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon dry fried garlic leaves ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place on a plate on the table, so everybody can help themselves. Enjoy.

title: Capsicum Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can chopped green chilies, drained | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and finely chopped | 3 ounces cheddar cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 1/4 fluid ounces bottled clam juice
instructions: Drain chilies reserving 1 tbsp of the juice in the can. Combine all ingredients. Serve with crackers or flat bread.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,cheese,pork butt roast,cumin powder,sesame seed,chili sauce
title: Chili Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork butt roast | 3 tablespoons cumin powder | 1/4 cup mild chili sauce | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 8 ounces shredded monterey jack pepper cheese or 8 ounces cheddar cheese | 1/2 - 3/4 cup grated monterrey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Brown roast on all sides. Combine cumin with chili sauce and spread evenly over the meat. Sprinkle top with monterey jack or cheddar. Roast at 375 degrees for 1 hour turning once. Serve with boiled yellow rice and chopped green onions.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,chicken bouillon cube,tomato green chilies,lettuce,soy sauce,sauce
title: Famous Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce ( i use tabasco ) | 1 tomatoes and green chilies | lettuce
instructions: In a small bowl add the soy sauce, bouillon cube, vanilla sugar, hot sauce, and tomato/green chilies. Stir to blend, and set aside. Cut lettuce into thin pieces and arrange around edge of plate. Place plate in microwave and place in microwave and heat for approximately 1 minute so the lettuce can get hot. Spread some of the sauce mixture inside and around the plate. Place lettuce around the edge of plate. Place the remaining sauce mixture around the edges of the plate. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: The Best Pork Carnitas Ever
ingredients: 8 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into large cubes | 3 stalks celery, sliced | 3 quarts brandy | 4 pounds queso fresco or crumbled farmer cheese
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the pork. Heat a large dutch oven or large pot over medium high heat. Sprinkle the pork with salt. Add half of the pork, and cook until brown on all sides. Remove from the pot, and repeat with rest of the pork. Stir in celery, and cook until tender. Return pork, and reduce heat to medium. Add brandy. Simmer, covered, for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally for even coloring. Season the pork with monterrey salt. Serve hot.

title: Tikka Masala Soup
ingredients: 6 cups vegetable broth or 6 cups chicken broth | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the chicken broth, yogurt, and cayenne. Heat over medium heat until warm, but do not boil. Gently stir in the soup just until heated through.

title: Vanilla Bean Hacked Cream
ingredients: 2/3 cup heavy cream | 10 vanilla beans, split lengthwise
instructions: Split the vanilla beans and scrape out the seeds, collecting their juices. Place the cream in a small saucepan. Scrape the softened vanilla bean paste into the pan to scrape out the flavorful pieces of vanilla pod and set the cream pan aside. To serve, place a scoop of vanilla cream onto a plate or serving dish. Pour cream into the cream cup and swirl the surface under the cream. Garnish with a dash of dark rum or a pinch of ground nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,serrano chilies,rotini pasta,pepperoni,peanut butter,beef broth
title: Antojitos (Mexican Pasta Salad)
ingredients: 1 lb rotini pasta or 1 lb ziti pasta | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 1 -2 serrano chilies ( optional ) | 1/2 lb pepperoni | 1 cup peanut butter ( or a combo of peanut and cottage cheese ) | 1 jar maraschino cherries ( or other citrus fruit )
instructions: Start your garlic breading by heating a little olive oil in a pan on the stove. Cut peppers and meat into small pieces. Cut pepperoni into small pieces and fry until crisp. Combine in a large bowl the broth and peppers, if using stir fry sauce. Pour in the peanut butter and mix well to coat. Slice baguette into bite size pieces and then throw in the bowl with peppers. Add the meat to bowl and coat well. Add the maraschino cherries last. Drain pasta and peppers and combine. Pour the marinara sauce mixture over the salad and stir to combine. Can be served chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cream,fine bread crumb,ziti pasta,heavy whipping cream,green pepper
title: Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup fine dry bread crumbs | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 package ziti pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package penne rigati | 1 medium green pepper, sliced | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine the bread crumbs and cream. Cut the ziti into 1/4 inch wide slabs and cut them into strips. Place the ziti in boiling water and return to a boil. Cook pasta until al dente, 4 - 5 minutes. Drain and toss in a large mixing bowl, add the green pepper. In a small saucepan, heat the sour cream. Add the sour cream to the hot pasta mixture and stir well. Pour sour cream mixture over the ziti and green pepper and toss to coat. In a glass or baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray, lay out the pasta and bean mixture. Pour sour cream mixture over the pasta and vegetables. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: saltine cracker,tortilla,confectioner sugar,longhorn cheese,extra virgin olive oil,mint sprig,ghee,tomato ketchup
title: Mexican Nachos
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | saltine crackers | 1 dozen tortilla | ghee ( for frying ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped tomatoes with ketchup | mint sprig ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together oil, confectioner's sugar, ketchup and saltine crackers until well blended. Spread a thin layer of mixture on one side of a tortilla, and spread it with a spatula until it is completely covered. Repeat making more nachos. Heat 1 teaspoon of ghee over medium heat. Fry nachos in one layer, turning once, until golden brown on both sides, about 2 minutes per side. Cut in half, garnish with chopped mint, if desired.

title: Apple Tiramisu
ingredients: 2 large apples, grated ( about 2 1/2 pounds ) | nonfat yogurt ( optional ) | capers ( optional ) | yellow food coloring ( optional ) | dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Place the grated apple in a medium bowl. Drizzle with yogurt & sprinkle with small caper. You may also sprinkle small amount of yellow food coloring to taste. Top with extra dark rum.

title: Pigs in Bacon Gravy (Bacon Canapes)
ingredients: 100 g bacon drippings | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 3 tablespoons tea
instructions: Heat the dripping in a frying pan, and when it is hot, add the bacon bits, and fry slowly until golden brown all over. Add the cornflour diluted in two tablespoons of tea to thicken and stir well. Remove from the heat and serve immediately.

title: Bacon, Egg & Olive Custard Pies
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, diced | 3 cups reduced-fat half-and-half | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f cook bacon in large saucepan over medium heat just until crisp, then drain on paper towels. Stir half and half and bacon together in medium bowl until smooth and creamy, 1 - 6 minutes. Stir in pastry until well blended. Spoon into 9 inch pie plate or casserole dish coated with cooking spray. Top with remaining pastry. Dot with remaining bacon. Bake in preheated oven until filling feels set and golden, about 45 - 50 minutes.

title: Spicy N' Fancy N' Hot Sauce!!
ingredients: 1 jar maraschino cherries | 1 bottle parmesan cheese | 1 - 1 1/2 cup tabasco sauce
instructions: In a large saucepan, you should have a nice, tight glass jar full of parmesan cheese. If not, break a little or smaller chunks of kernals or cherries. Fill the jar this way. You do not want to break the cherries. Fill the jar this way with hot mustard or spicy jalapeno sauce from the jar. Heat over high heat just until bubbling. Don't allow to boil because the hot mustard or jalapenos will stain the rims of the jar. It will bubble up and spit. Immediately, add the hot sauce and stir till it reaches the desired texture. It should be hot enough to get your mouth lol. Serve immediately. The longer you eat this, the hotter the flavor it will get. Will keep refrigerated in fridge for a month or so. It has a million calories and you don't have to worry about fat.

Random Ingredients: mint,great northern bean,fettuccine pasta,french onion,fava bean,hard egg,prosciutto,cilantro leaf
title: Egg Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fava beans, drained | 1 1/2 cups great northern beans, drained | 1 1/2 cups fettuccine pasta, cooked and drained | 3 tablespoons french-fried onions | 1 package prosciutto, chopped | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate about 30 minutes prior to serving.

title: Homemade Mustard
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard | 1 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Toast the mustard with the cayenne. It must be a light brown color.

title: Fried Asparagus (Indian Flatbread)
ingredients: 225 g thin asparagus spears | 150 g hamburger | 1 -2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 1 -2 grape tomatoes, cut in half
instructions: Clean and cut the tips off asparagus, keeping 1 piece of asparagus at a time. Wash well with cold water and drain well. Cut the tips off the rest of the asparagus. Cut the tips off the asparagus spears. In a large pot, heat up enough water to cover the asparagus. Place the asparagus pieces in the pot and add about 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder. Bring the water to a boil and then slowly lower the asparagus pieces into the water. Let the water come to a boil again, reduce the heat and simmer on low until the asparagus is tender and cooked, approximately 40 minutes. In a separate bowl, mix the hamburger with the remaining ground coriander powder. In a separate serving bowl, pour the cooked asparagus tips and set aside. Take the hamburger from the pot and set aside. Add 1/2 teaspoon of asafoetida powder to frying pan on medium, brown the hamburger. Once the hamburger is browned, add the meat back into the pot. Add tomatoes, a few drops of olive oil, some salt, and about 1 teaspoon of ground coriander powder. Cook the tomatoes until the oil starts floating and the tomatoes look cooked.

title: Scallops With Baked Potato & Beans
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans, drained, rinsed | 1/4 cup mustard | 1/2 teaspoon sea scallops | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 large potato, coarsely grated ( about 2 cups )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f place the potatoes in a 9x13 baking dish. Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a small, heavy sauce pan. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and 3/4 teaspoon ginger and heat the water to boiling. Using tongs, transfer the potatoes to the water and drain. Place the mustard and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small bowl. Split each scallop in half lengthwise and spread them out on a plate. Sprinkle the scallops with 1/2 teaspoon of the mustard.

title: Thai Fish Cakes
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry sheets | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Combine phyllo pastry sheets and garlic salt in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,angel food cake,spinach leaf,prosciutto,meat,broccoli,clam juice,cauliflower
title: Baked Cannelloni With Prosciutto, Spinach and Clam Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen baby spinach & spinach leaves, thawed and drained | 12 ounces angel food cake, cut into 18 slices | 4 ounces frozen clams in juice, thawed | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, torn | 4 slices prosciutto | 1 large cauliflower, separated into florets | 3 1/2 ounces frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained | 1 package smoked meat, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f lightly grease a 9x13 inch cake pan. Place the spinach, cake, clams, basil, prosciutto, and cauliflower in a large, deep baking dish.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,marshmallow,green pea,tomato olive oil,cocktail sauce,beef sirloin steak,pepper
title: Pea, Chicken, and Faux  Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | marshmallows | 1 ripe tomatoes and olive oil | 1 jar cocktail sauce ( i prefer `` flying goose '' brand ) | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Cut a pocket in the top of the steak, with the tip of a sharp knife, into the centre of the meat. Dip the steak in a mixture of the canola and salmallows. Place the steak in a non reactive bowl, pour over the cocktail sauce, cover and refrigerate overnight. Turn the meat in the marinade occasionally. Cook the chicken the day before, turning once or twice. Drain, slice thinly and serve with the steak.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,swiss chard,salt black pepper,cajun seasoning,beef
title: Grilled Swiss Chard with Cheese and Cajun Hors D'oeuvres
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh swiss chard, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 pound ground beef | 2/3 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat a grilling pan with cooking spray to 350 degrees f. Spread swiss chard coarsely on a plate.

title: Cauliflower Cheese Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, sliced | 8 ounces grated swiss cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon
instructions: Combine all ingredients, toss to coat. Cook in a large frypan in hot lightly salted water for 3 - 5 minutes or until cauliflower is heated through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,jalapeno pepper,dark sesame oil,pepper,sun tomato oil,watercress,white wine vinegar
title: Hot & Spicy Thai Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar, or more to taste | 1/2 small jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon palm sugar ( can reduce the liquid by more to taste, if desired ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper, or more to taste | watercress, for garnish
instructions: Put sun dried tomatoes and white wine vinegar into a blender or food processor. Season to taste with ground pepper. Add jalapeno pepper, sesame oil, palm sugar and black pepper.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,red bell pepper,pork tenderloin,white creme de cacao,milk ricotta cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,stilton cheese
title: Stilton Pork & Roasted Red Pepper Bites
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup cooking spray | 1 -2 lb pork tenderloin, fat trimmed of fat & cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs, crushed | 1/2 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup stilton cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup chopped roasted red bell pepper ( about 2 ) | 1/4 cup white creme de cacao ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray 24 miniature muffin cups with veggie oil spray and set aside. Place pork in a plastic bag.

title: Slow-Cooker Hearty Beef With Vegetables
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs prime rib roast | 1 can coconut, shredded | 1 can corn, drained | 4 cups rotini pasta | 4 ounces dried currants ( optional ) or 4 ounces raisins ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place roast in the crock of a 4 - 6 quart slow cooker stir in coconut, corn and pasta. If using raisins, add them now. Cover cooker and cook on low setting for 6 - 8 hours. Remove from cooker and shred meat with 2 forks. Skim fat from juices. You may want to skim off any fat that floats out or can be lumpy. Stir meat throughly. You can eat the meat as is, but it is delicious on salads and it is delicious with a nice fresh salad, couscous or rice.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,milk,lasagna noodle,white vinegar,ricotta cheese,red curry paste,napa cabbage
title: Spinach Cheese Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 6 cups shredded napa cabbage | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 2 cups milk | 24 lasagna noodles, cut lengthwise in half
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine ricotta cheese, vinegar, curry paste, parsley, and milk. Bring to boiling.

title: Quick and Easy Swiss Frites
ingredients: 5 large pears ( about 1 1/4 pounds total ) | 1 1/2 cups corn oil | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( if using a lower flame, add less )
instructions: Halve the pears and remove the core of each half. Using a spoon or melon baller, make finger length slits in the top of the pears so that the frites will be less prevalent. Pour the corn oil into a large saucer. Heat the griddle over medium heat, adding about 1/2 teaspoon of the cayenne pepper if using, until hot. Place the frites on the hot griddle and turn frequently until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 3 minutes. Transfer the frites onto a warm baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Drizzle the hot oil over the frites and lightly sprinkle with the remaining cayenne pepper. Let cool to room temperature. Serve with apple wedges, or as a main course with chilled saucernes or chilled pickle slices. Makes about 2 servings.

title: Filling Triangles
ingredients: filling : | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry | filling :
instructions: Combine phyllo pastry sheets, frozen phyllo pastry, and filling ingredients in a mixing bowl until dough forms a ball. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and roll out to ¾ inch thickness. Cut into squares using a 2 1/2-inch round cutter. Cut each square into 4 triangles. Place triangles on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 450 degrees f oven until golden, 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer triangles to a rack to cool.

title: Strawberry and Italian Sausage Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate | 2 teaspoons mixed juniper berries | 3 teaspoons golden syrup | 3 teaspoons sifted powdered anouille sausage | 300 g frozen strawberries
instructions: Break chocolate into pieces and boil for 3 minutes until it melts, remove from oven, leave it for 2 minutes and stir. Return to oven and bake for approx 7 minutes or until it starts to turn golden. Cool. In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients, except the strawberries. Add this to the hot chocolate, stir well and garnish with strawberries. Serve with a slice of warm bread.

title: Thai Shredded Vegetables
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs new baby carrots or 2 1/2 lbs baby turnips | 4 habanero peppers, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large baking dish, and toss lightly to coat vegetables evenly. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: tarragon leaf,caraway seed,green pepper,extra virgin olive oil,red bell pepper,avocado,pepperoni
title: Easy Guacamole
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 green pepper, chopped | 1/2 red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 lb pepperoni, finely chopped | tarragon leaf | 1 ripe avocado, seeded and sliced
instructions: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients and toss to coat. Cover and chill 10 minutes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: tamari,oriental flavor ramen noodle,garlic powder,monterey jack cheese,rye flour,chili pepper
title: Asian Crunchy Cheese Dip #RSC
ingredients: 1 package oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese, your choice | 1 cup rye flour or 1 cup cornmeal | 2 tablespoons tamari ( dark soy sauce ) | 2 cloves garlic powder | 1 chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare a 9 inch pie plate by spraying with cooking spray. Rinse the seasoning packet from one ramen noodle and place in a large bowl. Add 1/2 cup of the cheese and blend well. Drain 2 tablespoons of the seasoning packet from the other noodle and place in the bowl. Take your two ramen bell peppers and cut each pepper into strips that are about 1/2 inch wide. Set aside. Coat large baking sheet with cooking spray. Add noodles, cheese, and remaining seasoning packet from the other noodle and stir. Spread mixture evenly in the prepared pie plate, being sure to top it with the cheese mixture. Sprinkle with the chili. Bake 25 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Butternut Mango Pork Dhal With Fresh Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 butternut pumpkin | 1/2 lb ground lean pork | 6 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 mango, ripe, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Using 1/2 cup water, bring to boil the pumpkin, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large bowl combine the pork, yogurt and ¼ cup water. Add the ground pork mixture and add half the mango. Mix well. Place in a roasting tin and top with remaining mango and pour 1/2 cup warm water in the hollow of the roasting tin. Bake in 400f oven, basting every 20 minutes for 4 hours or until cooked through. Serve with remaining mango chutney on the side.

title: Red Roasted Prosciutto (Serves Many Heart-Style Recipe)
ingredients: 4 prosciutto, cut into 1 by 1 1/4 inch slices | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil | 2 1/2 teaspoons red food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Arrange prosciutto slices on baking sheets. Mix basil and food coloring in a small bowl. Spread basil and food coloring in 1 small dish or cup. Spread basil mixture over prosciutto slices and let cool. Store in a sealed container for up to 3 months.

title: Rigatoni Ice Cream with Yogurt
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta | 1 pint yogurt | 1 pint vanilla ice cream
instructions: Boil the rigatoni in salted water for 10 minutes. Drain. Boil the yogurt. Cool the yogurt by adding the vanilla ice cream, stirring until well chilled. Put the rigatoni in a bowl and mix with yogurt. Chill the ice cream in the fridge until set. Top with the ice cream.

title: Lebanese Baked Garlic Bread
ingredients: 2 lbs loaf french bread or 2 lbs other crusty bread | 20 cloves garlic | 1 tablespoon allspice | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika | 5 teaspoons dried dill or 3 teaspoons chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Cut loaf of bread lengthwise in half and discard crusts. Place in a bowl with water to cover to soak, and let soak for 15 minutes. Drain water from soaked bread and rub off any browned garlic, garlic and spices. Set bread halves in a large well greased baking dish, and roast in oven for 50 - 55 minutes, until light toasted and brown.

Random Ingredients: sake,apple cider,sage leaf,green curry paste,salt pepper,oil vegetable,self raising flour
title: Curried Green Curry Cake
ingredients: 7 ounces self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh sage leaf | 5 -6 teaspoons hot green curry paste | 1 -2 tablespoon oil ( vegetable or canola ) | salt and pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons sake ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons apple cider or 2 tablespoons red wine
instructions: Mix together the flour, sage and curry paste to a very fine crumble. Add enough water to moisten a spoon and mix into the dry ingredients.. Knead and press into a greased springform cake tin and bake in a moderate oven about 65 - 75 minutes or until the centre is firm and golden. Turn out onto a wire rack and leave to cool a little before cutting into squares.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,red chilies,ice cube,sugar,barley,hazelnut,cardamom pod
title: Khandi
ingredients: 1/2 cup barley, soaked in | 1 liter cold water for about 10/2 hours | 2 tablespoons sugar | 2 red chilies, sliced | 2 cardamom pods | 4 -5 tablespoons hazelnuts | ice cube
instructions: Soak the barley for about 5 - 12 hours and then drain. Place all the ingredients in a pan. Cook until the barley is tender. Note, cook times can vary depending on the type of soaked barley you soak. When done, drain the barley, add the hazelnuts. Add salt if required or allow 3/4 cup of water to be added to the rest of the water to make a smooth paste. Allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,cannellini bean,white bread flour,chunky salsa,jalapeno pepper,beef consomme,corn oil,pork shoulder
title: Easy Mexican Chili
ingredients: 4 slices white bread, such as challah or 4 slices sourdough, crusts removed | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained ( preferably with no salt added, though the salsa is really, really thick, and worth checking the consistency ) | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper, deseeded and finely diced | 1/2 small serrano pepper, seeded and finely diced | 1 large jalapeno pepper, deseeded and diced | 1/2 small serrano pepper, deseeded and finely diced | 1 whole pork shoulder, cut into bite-sized pieces | corn oil | 4 1/2 ounces thick & chunky salsa
instructions: If bread is crusty, cut back on the crust a little to make more crusty.

title: Lemongrass Mole
ingredients: 12 poblano chiles | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh herb, such as dill | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh zest from 3 lemongrass, plus extra | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh herb, such as dill | 1 teaspoon finely chopped peeled-and-ground black pepper | 7 -8 ounces bittersweet semisweet chocolate, roughly chopped
instructions: Set oven rack in middle of oven. Line rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut chiles lengthwise into long, thin strips. Lay chiles on baking sheet. Bake until crisp and beginning to blacken in spots, about 5 minutes, turning occasionally. Transfer chiles to a kitchen towel and tightly roll. Heat oil in a medium nonreactive skillet over medium high heat. Add chiles and 2 or 3 minced scallions. Sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add zest, 3 minced scallions and 1 teaspoon chopped fresh herb. Sauté 1 minute, stirring frequently. Add blackened chiles, 3 scallions, 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh herbs, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper and continue to sauté until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Place chocolate in a microwave safe bowl, add half of remaining liquid and microwave on high 3 to 4 minutes, stirring after 1 to 2 minutes. Stir until chocolate is melted. Spread chocolate over chiles and let stand until cooled to lukewarm, about 2 hours.

title: Spicy Korean Chili-Liver Kabobs #5FIX
ingredients: 8 ounces liver, cut into 2 - 3 sections | 2 fennel bulbs, cleaned, cut into 1/4 1/4-inch pieces | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon light soy sauce | 1 scallion, chopped
instructions: Preheat grill / broiler to high. Lightly spray metal skewers with nonstick cooking spray. Thread beef onto skewers using 2 pieces of the fennel, 2 pieces of liver, 3 pieces of fennel bulb.

title: Cafe Rio Mashed Sweet Peas
ingredients: 1 can green peas, drained | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds or 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 -2 ounce unsweetened chocolate, chopped
instructions: Boil green peas 2 minutes. Remove peas from heat and mash coarsely. Combine remaining ingredients and stir until blended and hot. Serve immediately.

title: Pecan Lamb Chops (Australian)
ingredients: 6 lamb loin chops | 3/4 cup pecan halves | 3/4 cup sweet rice wine
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Place chops on a foil lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake 40 minutes until just cooked through. Serve with sweet rice wine.

Random Ingredients: shrimp paste,spring onion,green chili pepper,oyster sauce,macaroni,herbes de provence,shrimp,grand marnier
title: Shrimp Macaroni
ingredients: 5 cups cooked macaroni | 8 ounces raw shrimp, shelled and thawed if frozen | 4 spring onions, washed thinly | 4 ounces shrimp paste | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon crushed herbes de provence | 500 ml freshly made sweet and sour sauce | 1 small green chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Place the macaroni in a bowl, add cold water and stir in. Nestle the shrimp, finely chopped spring onions and shrimp paste in to the macaroni in a single layer. Mix well and set aside. Mix oyster sauce, herb de provence, sweet and sour sauce together. Pour the sauce over the macaroni, toss well to coat and then place in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours to allow the flavours to develop. Serve with steamed white rice.

title: Tasty Roasted Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely ground smoked salmon | 1/4 cup ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the salmon and ras el hanout. Spoon salmon onto the prepared sheet. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Roast in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350 degrees f and continue roasting until the fish is flaky and cooked through, about 20 to 25 more minutes. Let rest for 10 minutes.

title: Thyme Harissa Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili paste | 3 fresh thyme sprigs, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs, chopped
instructions: Combine chili paste and thyme in a mortar or small glass bowl. Toss to mix. Add chopped thyme leaves.

title: Asparagus, Mandarin Orange and Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 12 asparagus | 1 tablespoon plain white flour | 1 tablespoon sugar | 80 g mandarin orange segments ( drained ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 c, 220 c if using an oven fan forced oven and 190 c if using an oven fan forced oven. Peel and cut asparagus into 2cm lengths. Place flour and sugar in a large bowl and stir until combined. Add asparagus to flour mixture and toss to coat. Place orange segments in a microwave safe bowl with plastic wrap. Cover and microwave on high for 30 seconds. Using tongs, place orange segments on oven tray. Bake in oven for 6 - 7 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven, place on a wire rack to cool. Once cool, cut the asparagus into 2cm lengths. Serve on top of the orange segments.

title: Lima Beans Cookies
ingredients: 2 packets chocolate baking squares, melted | 2 eggs | 1 can lima beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix melted chocolate and eggs together in a medium bowl. Add beans and mix until well combined. Drop a tablespoon of mixture onto parchment paper. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 10 minutes.

title: Roast Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 12 tablespoons cream cheese, softened | 1 cup ice water | 4 lbs leg of lamb
instructions: Place one leg of lamb at a time between sheets of plastic wrap and pound out each with a flat mallet or rolling pin until 3/8 inch thick. Cut into 6 slices. Spread about one third of the cream cheese on each piece of meat and roll up each piece starting at the long side. Repeat with remaining lamb. Line the rolls with wax paper.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,ginger root,cucumber,plain flour,vanilla ice cream
title: Spice-Baked Cucumber & Ginger Ice Cream
ingredients: 450 g plain flour | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root | 150 g cucumber, peeled, seeded & finely chopped | 1 celery rib, peeled, finely chopped | 4 scoops vanilla ice cream
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, ginger and vanilla. Stir to combine. Fold in the cucumber, celery and season. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper and brush lightly with oil. Spread half of the mixture evenly over the baking sheets. Using a fork, prick holes in any cracks. Cover & freeze overnight. Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Bake in batches for 15 to 20 minutes or until puffed & golden. Remove from oven & leave to cool.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,vanilla bean,thai chili sauce,port wine,tarragon,beef steak fillet,sage
title: Fisherman's Pate
ingredients: 600 g beef steaks or 600 g beef fillets | 500 g white fish fillets, such as mince | 6 slices good port wine | 6 whole dried tarragon | 1 vanilla bean, halved | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 2 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 1 little sea salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Place all the ingredients for the pate, apart from the salt in a food processor and process until smooth. Spoon into a sterilised jar and store on the countertop until ready to use. Note, if using steaks or fish fillets it is best to make this in advance of being cooked, if not refrigerated all the water from the fish can be used at this stage.

title: Homemade Phyllo Sauce
ingredients: 4 serrano peppers | 1/4 cup of fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Grind the chiles with 1/4 cup of fresh mint. Blend until they become a smooth paste. Add more or less mint until desired texture is reached. Let sit for a hour or two before using. Keep refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,heavy whipping cream,green grape,broccoli floret,black pepper
title: Italian Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 cup broccoli floret, chopped | 1/2 cup green grape, halved | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained and rinsed | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: In a medium bowl, whip cream to stiff peaks. Place broccoli, grapes, undrained oranges and pepper in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,basmati rice,chipotle chile,serrano chilies,bamboo shoot
title: Chipotle Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup bamboo shoot | 1/2 cup serrano chilies | 2 -3 chipotle chiles | 1 tablespoon chopped jalapeno pepper | 1 1/2 cup basmati rice
instructions: Put rice in a pot, bring to a boil, turn heat to low. While rice is cooking, dice chilies and peppers. Slice serrano peppers into thin strips. Put rice in bowl, add chopped chili pepper peppers, chopped chilies, and jalepeno peppers. Add chipotles in adobo sauce. Serve warm.

title: Red Pepper Paste
ingredients: 1 red pepper, finely sliced | 1 cup ice, crushed | crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Cut the pepper in half vertically, then slice it into thin rounds and place in a food processor. Add the ice and crushed red pepper to the pepper and blend until the paste is creamy. Store in the freezer or in the refrigerator up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: crispix cereal,chicken broth,red chili powder,lobster tail,kumquat,irish cream,veal,filet beef
title: Irish Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 lb filet of beef, lean | 1 lb crabmeat lobster tail, raw | 1 lb smoked sausage, cut in 2-inch pieces | 1/2 lb veal, cut in 2 inch pieces | 1 cup chicken broth | 2 tablespoons irish cream | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 2 cups crispix cereal
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In large bowl combine the meat and any marinade ingredients and mix well. Place meat in the center of a rack in a roasting pan and place in the oven and roast at 375°f. Insert a thermometer into the center near the center of the meat. When the thermometer reaches 120º, remove meat from the oven and allow to rest for 20 minutes before carving.

title: The Best Salsa-Cheese!
ingredients: 3 large ripe tomatoes | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1/4 cup safflower oil
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Cut each tomato into 8 equal slices. Using a vegetable peeler, remove the seeds and most of the membrane from each tomato so it can have a uniform thickness. Then peel the tomato from the skin and cut in half. Remove the seeds and membrane then cut across into thin strips. Combine the mayonnaise and salsa in an appropriately sized bowl. Pour 1/4 cup of safflower oil into a small frying pan and warm on high heat until hot enough to make a drop of water sizzle but not burn/brown in your hand. Drain the tomato strips and pat dry with paper towels. Place one tomato slice in the bowl of the dressing and spread it evenly on top of the dressing. Place the remaining tomato slice around the edge of the dressing. Place a small dollop of mayonnaise on top, followed by a few drops of salsa. You will be able to place another tomato slice next to the top so it looks pretty and is not necessary. It will make enough for a double or triple amount of people.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,gingerroot,whipping cream,mint sprig,rose water,chili pepper flake,chipotle chile adobo,fennel bulb
title: Creamy Chipotle Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1 cup fresh mint leaves | 1 -2 teaspoon dried mint sprig, to garnish | 2 -4 canned chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 -2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | fresh rose water or fresh lime juice, to taste
instructions: Soak chilies in 1/4 of the water for 20 minutes. Drain. Chop and finely dice chilies. Combine all ingredients, including the reserved water or more to taste, in a blender.

title: Kettle - Polish Sausage
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs pork tenderloins, cut into 2-3 inch pieces | 4 -6 tablespoons tapioca | 1/2 cup crushed blackberries or 1/2 cup raspberry | 2 1/2 tablespoons fresh minced oregano leaves, crushed | 1 bottle vodka
instructions: Place pork in crockpot. Add tapioca, blackberries, and oregano into crockpot. Pour vodka onto pork. Top with lid or rubber cover. Cook on high for 4 - 6 hours, stirring occasionally. After 4 - 6 hours, remove pork and crush with two forks. Return to pot and reheat. Serve over hot polish rye bread. Great served over mashed potatoes.

title: Spanish Bean Salad
ingredients: 3 cans cannellini beans, drained | 1 jar diced pimientos | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 1 tablespoon crushed hot pepper ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and chill for 1 - 2 hours. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,seasoning salt,chili paste,szechuan peppercorn,orange zest,tortilla,italian breadcrumb
title: Szechuan Oil Roll-Em-Ups
