ingredients: 1 cup szechuan peppercorns | 2 tablespoons dried italian breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | 1 tablespoon freshly ground orange zest | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 4 teaspoons szechuan preserved ginger snaps
instructions: Grind the peppercorns with the mortar and pestle in a spice or coffee grinder until fine. Add the bread crumbs, chile, orange zest salt and rosemary and pulse until they form fine crumbs all around. Shape the crumbs into four balls. Sprinkle the balls lightly with szechuan peppercorns, then press them flat into the oil using your hand. Cover and set aside for about 30 minutes. Use a fork to flatten each ball into a 2 inch round. Turn the balls over, then turn each one again so the oil covers the top. After the 30 minutes have passed, carefully pull out the excess oil. Roll the balls in the sichuan peppercorn oil. Garnish with a preserved ginger snaps and serve with rice, noodles or guacamole.

title: Fried Green Peas
ingredients: 1/2 loaf stale bread | 1 cup frozen green peas, thawed
instructions: Wash the bread under running water until the water runs clear.

title: Vegan Strawberry Crisp
ingredients: 500 g cake ( frozen, sliced and crushed ) | 1 can frozen broccoli stems ( fresh and chopped ) | 6 graham cracker | vegan margarine
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except crackers and pop into a greased 15 x 10 pan. Place in freezer for an hour or so to set up.

title: Pound Cake Gravy Recipe
ingredients: vegetable oil, for deep frying | 1 1/2 cups prepared pound cake flour | 1 cup chicken stock
instructions: Make sure the flour is sifted after measuring the flour. In a large frying pan heat oil and when oil is about 1/2 inch deep fry the pound cake at half a minute. Turn only once, fry only. Remove from oil and drain on paper towels. When all the cake has been fried, mix the flour with the chicken stock to make a smooth liquid. Add to the fried pound cake in an oven proof bowl, add the french fried carrots and stir well to blend.

title: The Easiest Corn Dip
ingredients: 250 g cream-style corn | 1 jar sweet red peppers | 1 tablespoon whiskey
instructions: Drain the sweet red peppers and peppers. Pour boiling water over the red peppers and mix. Add whiskey and mix. Serve chilled with bread. Yum.

title: Baked Calamari and Octopus
ingredients: 200 g squid or 200 g baby octopus, small. cut into 2. 5cm | 2 rock peaches, sliced into 2. 5cm rounds | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup basil leaves | 1 cup vinegar | 1 jumbo shrimp ( optional ) or 1 shrimp free range fryer ( optional )
instructions: Boil squid for 4 minutes. Remove squid with a slotted spoon and set aside to cool. Cut squid into 5cm squares and leave aside. Cut peaches in half and carefully remove stone. Remove seeds from peaches by using a teaspoon or knife. Place squid squares in a baking dish or oven tray and place in pre heated oven. Add pepper and basil leaves to squid and set aside. In a jar place bouillon cube and shake a little. In a large bowl place squid, peaches, squid, basil leaves, vinegar and shrimp if using. Add pepper and basil leaves to marinated squid mixture. Place squid mixture in baking dish or oven tray. Bake until squid is cooked and serve with white rice.

title: Spinach & Banana Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chopped red onions | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 4 ounces frozen chopped spinach | 1/4 cup diced jalapeno chile | 1 ripe banana, sliced
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl. Place spinach and jalapenos in a small bowl. Add banana. Toss to combine. Let stand for 2 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,pork tenderloin,tarragon,vanilla essence,palm sugar,bread,onion powder,wheat flour
title: Tarragon Pork Nachos
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon bread flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 500 g pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 45 g light palm sugar, grated | 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips, to serve
instructions: Combine the flours and spices in a shallow dish. Toss the pork with the mixture, then press into the lightly coated, dry breadcrumbs. Leave to stand for 5 minutes. Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius. Place the reserved mixture in a baking tray and bake for 25 minutes, turning every 10 minutes, until crisp and golden. Serve topped with remaining crumbs, sugar and crushed tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,poblano chile,white fish fillet
title: Whitefish With Poblano Chile and Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded and cut into 1/4-inch rings | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 4 lbs white fish fillets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place the poblano chiles on a baking sheet, brush them with the vinegar and place in the oven. Roast chiles until softened, about 15 minutes, depending on the size of the chiles. Set aside and season with salt. Cut the fish into 2 inch by 1/2 inch pieces and spread them in an oiled roasting pan with a small pat of the roasted poblano pepper. Bake until the fish is cooked through and lightly browned and tender but not crisp, about 15 minutes. Serve the fish on a bed of warm rice accompanied by the chilies and their sauce.

title: Cawfish With Rum and Corn
ingredients: 1 lb crawfish tail | 1/2 lb green peas | 1/2 lb sweet corn | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: In a large pan toss together the crawfish tail, peas, corn, rum and sweet and sour sauce and raisins. Simmer for 10 minutes or until the sauce is hot. Serve over hot steamed rice.

title: Grilled French Fries #5FIX
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes | cooking spray | 1/4 cup whole meal bread, crumbs or 1/4 cup other breadcrumb
instructions: Trim ends. Cut potatoes into thin slices and place in a mixing bowl. Add 1 cup water to potatoes, cover and refrigerate. Combine bread crumbs and remaining 1 cup water in a bowl. Add bread crumbs mixture to potatoes and mash together until well blended and texture is uniform. Preheat grill to medium high heat. Lightly coat a gas grill with cooking spray. Place potatoes on grill and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes or until browned all over.

title: Mexican Haystacks
ingredients: 3 leeks, white and light green parts, chopped | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 package frozen corn kernels, thawed | 1 tablespoon finely chopped leek, tops for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place leeks and bell pepper in a 9 inch pie pan. Mix corn kernels, leeks and green pepper. Sprinkle evenly over leeks. Bake until vegetables are hot and beginning to crisp, stirring occasionally, about 40 minutes.

title: Italian Spinach
ingredients: 1 package frozen spinach | 1 small white onion
instructions: Thaw the spinach and separate the leaves. Bring the spinach to a boil with onions and simmer for 2 minutes, or until the onions are transparent. Drain the spinach. Return to pot and add spinach mixture. Stir and serve.

title: Dirty Beans - Espresso Flavored Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hot red pepper paste | 2/3 cup espresso powder | 1 teaspoon fleischmann's coffee-flavored espresso powder
instructions: Mix red pepper paste and the 2/3 cup espresso powder until smooth.

title: Peach Preserves
ingredients: 2 lbs mixed ripe peaches, peeled | 10 ounces frozen petit halve, thawed | 20 cloves crushed garlic | 10 ounces golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Cut the peaches into quarters, remove any stones except for one and all of the petit halve pieces. Remove the pits from the peaches and cut both into quarters. Place the peaches in a pan with a tablespoon of water and the 10 - 8 cloves of garlic. Add the water to cover the peaches. Add the sugar, syrup and saffron. Cover and boil gently for 20 minutes or until the peaches are very tender. Ladle off 3/4 cup of the peaches cooking liquid from the pan and reserve it for later use. Discard the remaining liquid and serve the peaches in sterilized jar with the reserved liquid. Use for sandwiches, toast, or eat plain to serve with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,dark sesame oil,plain yogurt,salt,green chili
title: Mock Dahi Hummus
ingredients: 6 ounces kidney beans | 16 ounces plain yogurt | 1/2 green chili, minced | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1 -2 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Strain the beans, and rinse them well in cold water, pressing down on them to get rid of as much salt as possible. Put them back in the pot, and add enough cold water so that they are just covered. Bring to a boil, and cook for about 8 minutes, just until the beans start to soften. It is important to stir occasionally as the beans will become very mushy. Take them off the heat, but leave them in the pot. When they are cool, put them back in the pot, and mix them in a large bowl. Mix in yogurt, chiles, salt and sesame oil. You can serve with pita chips, pitas, lettuce or corn chips, or as a sandwich spread with crackers, hummus or with lettuce.

title: Aceitun (Herbed Indian Mix)
ingredients: 2 packages dry mix, such as pinto ( about 7 cups in bulk ) | 2 tablespoons mint, chopped, plus 2 tablespoons leaves for garnish | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, ground | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a plastic storage bag. Close bag and shake. Store contents of bag and contents to blend. Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. To serve, heat a small skillet over medium heat.

title: Oude Wyf Webb Cookies (Scottish)
ingredients: 1 lb icing sugar ( scottish or an english 'whipping cream ', softened ) | freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat the oven to 300 degrees celcius or 190 degrees f. Grease a baking tray or line with parchment paper. Combine the icing sugar and black pepper with a wooden spoon. Using a rubber spatula mix the mixture by hand until it becomes a rather stiff dough. Roll it into small balls about 2 tablespoons. Roll a ball again and press the edges of the balls lightly. Bake on the lowest shelf for approx 15 - 20 minutes or until almost dry. Remove the baking tray from the oven and leave the cookies in a cool place until they are cold. Store in an airtight container.

title: Sweet Salsa Tart
ingredients: 1 cup prepared homemade mayonnaise | 1/4 cup chopped fresh lemongrass | 1 tablespoon minced onion powder | 1 tablespoon grated asiago cheese | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh lemongrass | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup packed chopped cabbage | 1 mango - peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 red onion, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together mayonnaise, lemon grass, onion powder, asiago cheese and lemongrass in a small bowl. Press mixture into the bottom and up the sides of a 9 inch pie plate and refrigerate until chilled. In a small bowl, mix together mayonnaise, cabbage, mango and onion slices. Spread on cooled crust and return to refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Rhubarb Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice ( or medium grain rice ) | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 - 1 1/2 lb rhubarb ( or more ) | 1 cup low fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast
instructions: Begin cooking your rice and rinse it according to pkg directions. Mix the rice with onion soup mix and rhubarb. Put in strainer and let sit for 10 minutes so the liquid has a chance to drain. Mix in yogurt and nutritional yeast. Serve warm.

title: Mushroom Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 button mushrooms | 1 cup cooked crabmeat | 4 tablespoons tamarind paste | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 3 1/2 - 4 cups bread flour, divided
instructions: In a frying pan, add mushroom and crabmeat, and mix until heated through. Add tamarind paste and vinegar, and stir until combined. Add 1 c of bread flour and mix in, and continue to add remaining flour until dough begins to form a ball. Remove from heat, and knead with hands until very elastic, and no longer sticky. Place in a large, greased bowl. Cover, and rest for 40 minutes. Grease a 5 x 9 inch pan with butter or a similar product. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stretch dough to 1/4 inch thickness between plastic wrap. Place in prepared pan. Cover, and rest for 30 minutes. Divide filling among mushroom pockets. Roll up like a swiss roll, and place seam side down onto parchment paper covered cookie sheet. Cover and rest for 15 - 20 minutes longer. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Faux Keftes (Quick Beef and Mango Flatbread)
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 2 medium mangoes | 4 ounces rye flour
instructions: Mix sirloin and mango together. Add rye flour into mixture and mix well together. Knead for 5 - 6 minutes. Place on pizza dough or other flat bread and bake at 400f for about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white wine,cottage cheese,chunky salsa,lasagna noodle,mace,chili sauce,sumac,grenadine
title: Salsa Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 1 cup spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 pint cottage cheese ( or ricotta ) | 1 tablespoon grenadine | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 2 teaspoons ground sumac
instructions: First, get your lasagna noodles cleaned, dried out and pre-made so as to ensure they don’t get too soggy. Then, rinse well and dry them. Set aside. Mix the chili sauce, wine, cottage cheese, grenadine, mace, and sumac until smooth in a bowl and then set aside. In a 9x13 pan, lay out a few sheets of foil so the lasagna will be able to absorb the sauce. Lay out four sheets of the lasagna, layering them as you go. Keep the sheets covered with plastic wrap so it is easy for them to work with. Spread the cottage cheese mixture evenly evenly in the pan. Lay out four more sheets of lasagna, layering them as you go. Spread the remaining 3/4 of cottage cheese mixture evenly in the pan. Lay another four sheets of lasagna, layering them as you go. Spread the remaining cottage cheese mixture evenly in the pan. Lay the four lasagna sheets flat until completely flat in the pan. Spread the remaining sauce over the noodles in the pan. Lay out two more sheets of lasagna, but keep the lasagna covered with plastic wrap. Bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, then uncover to brown the top and a little bit more nutmeg on top.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,chili oil,canadian bacon,bacon,dill pickle,cider vinegar
title: Canadian Bacon Salad With Hot Glazed Mustard Butter
ingredients: 1/3 lb canadian bacon, diced | 1/3 lb bacon, diced ( or bacon bits ) | 1/4 lb canadian bacon, cut into 1/8 inch slices | 4 -5 dill pickles, sliced | 1/4 cup whole milk red pepper flakes, if using hot hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup sweet chili oil
instructions: Cook dice and bacon until bacon is limp. You don't want the crisp bacon pieces in the salad. Remove to a bowl. Add canadian bacon, bacon bits & pickles. Stir till coated & adding hot pepper sauce. Whisk vinegar into dressing & let sit at room temp, or refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Pour over salad just before serving. Garnish top with minced parsley.

title: Seared Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 5 lbs beef tenderloin | buttermilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread the tenderloin with buttermilk. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees for about 15 minutes. Serve with mashed potatoes and fresh greens.

title: Beef Tongue With Sweet and Sour Cashews
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tongues, split | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 4 cups brewed coffee | 1 large green pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons canned chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1/4 cup unsalted cashews ( or toasted ) | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, chopped
instructions: Rinse lamb tongues completely and cut into pieces as close to 1/4 inch thick as possible. Place meat in a shallow roasting pan and cover with cold water. Marinate at least 4 hours or overnight. Soak cashewnuts in warm water 10 minutes. Drain and coarsely chop. Preheat oven to 325°. Roast tongues 2 to 3 hours, or until done. Serve immediately. If using a double layer foil, make sure to wrap securely around legs. Wrap in foil and place in the refrigerator. Bake in a preheated oven for 10 minutes. Strain juices and set aside, reserving any liquid. Return liquid to roasting pan and bring to a boil. Add chili peppers and chopped apricots. Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Divide mixture among serving plates.

title: Escarole, Tomato and Egg Sauce - OAMC
ingredients: 1 head escarole, chopped and rinsed several times | 4 large egg whites | 1 can tomato puree | 4 cups sour cream
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Line with foil large enough to seal over the surface. Place a rack in the center or lower rack of the oven. Place the escarole in a roasting pan. Combine the egg whites and a large spoonful of water in a bowl and whisk well to combine. Brush eggwhite mixture to sides of baking dish and spread evenly in roasting pan. Using a spatula or slotted metal spoon, transfer the escarole to a single layer and place in the pan. Pour enough boiling water into pan to reach halfway up the side of the escarole. Cover tightly and bake 30 - 45 minutes or until the escarole is just tender. Uncover the pan and let it rest 5 minutes. Transfer the escarole to a platter. Using a slotted spoon, remove the cooked pieces onto individual plates. Add the tomato puree to the tomato sauce and stir. Place the dish under the broiler. While tomato sauce is bubbling, scrape any bits of tomato into a saucepan and heat over medium heat until hot and bubbly. When tomatoes are just about ready, arrange them on a serving platter, pour tomato sauce over, and let stand 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer to bowls or small platters and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: shallot,thai fish sauce,marinade,canola oil,watercress,coriander seed,arborio rice
title: Thai Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked arborio rice, rinsed | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 3 cups watercress, coarsely chopped | 1 shallot, minced | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon water, more if needed
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.

title: Mexican Red Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 package corn | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1 bag tortilla chips, crushed
instructions: Add all ingredients, except tortilla chips, in blender.

title: Persian Dumplings (Lebanese)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white flour or 1 tablespoon cornflour ( for dusting ) | 1 cup lentils, washed | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Drain the lentils but do not rinse them. Put flour in a big bowl and mix it gradually with the lentils. Sprinkle some white pepper to taste. Make golf ball sized dumplings the size required and roll each one a little with the flour, dusting off any excess flour. Fry them at a medium hot griddle until they are golden brown and done.

title: Date Syrup & Rote Grilled Cheese Sandwich(21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 18)
ingredients: 1/2 small red date, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons currants, for sprinkling ( optional ) | 8 slices rye bread | 3 ounces reduced-fat mayonnaise | 3 ounces low-fat swiss cheese, grated ( or other mild cheese )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except swiss cheese in a small bowl, stirring to combine. Brush the tops with oil and sprinkle over the cheese. Place on a grill rack over medium heat, and cook for 3 - 4 minutes, or until the cheese is just melted.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,garlic clove,nori,monterey jack pepper cheese,dark sesame oil,spice,yellow onion,sirloin
title: Beef Kebab (Aubergine) Steak and Onions (Gebhardt Assahi)
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 large yellow onion, minced | 12 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon ground mixed spice | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 12 sheets nori, cut diagnon into 4 pieces each ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Cut steak lengthwise in half. Using 1 tablespoon sesame oil, rub on both sides of steak and place into a dish.

title: Antojitos Con Papas Rellenas-Charosetas (Antojitos Con Papas)
ingredients: 1 can low-sodium tomato soup | 1/2 cup dried apricot, chopped | 4 tablespoons chopped crystallized ginger | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce, from can of rosar, or to taste | fresh strawberries, for garnish | fresh lemon slices for garnish
instructions: Place the tomato soup, apricots, crystallized ginger, vanilla extract, adobo sauce, and chopped cherries in a blender. Blend on high until the cherries become finely chopped and incorporated. Chill in the refrigerator for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve the rellenas in small ramekins on individual salad plates. Garnish with fresh lemon slices. Variation, in addition to the tomato soup, you can also add 1 1/2 to 2 cups of cherry juice and 1 tablespoon of cornstarch. Add a generous pinch of salt to the tomato soup, as well as 1 1/2 teaspoons of turmeric and 1 teaspoon of ground ginger.

title: Mushroom-canola Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 4 white mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Slice the mushrooms thinly and fry in oil. Remove from pan and set aside. Heat oil in deep skillet. Add mushrooms.

title: Faux Confit Pork Loin
ingredients: 8 lbs whole pork loin, preferably belly fat | white peppercorns
instructions: Trim off all fat or membrane from the pork. Trim any membrane of fat outside the meat as much as possible. Cover with a large double layer of foil, and put in the freezer for about 3 - ½ hours. Remove from freezer and prepare the fat. Heat oven to 300°f. Remove foil and let it get very hot. Place meat onto the foil and sprinkle with white peppercorns, place in oven for 2  3 hours, basting several times. Let meat rest about 5 minutes before carving.

title: Sour Cream Caramelized Leeks
ingredients: 2 leeks, trimmed, washed, and sliced | 1/3 cup dry sherry wine | 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice, from 2 lemons | 3 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place sliced leeks, sherry, lemon juice, and irish cream into a large skillet and bring to a boil. Cover and braise in the preheated oven for 40 minutes. Test for doneness by inserting a knife into the center of the dish and see if it should feel firm. Remove from heat and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,maple syrup,salmon fillet,beef broth
title: Maple Salmon Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets | 3 cans low sodium beef broth | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 3 lbs thick white fish fillets
instructions: In 3 - 5 qt nonstick skillet, cook salmon over medium high heat, stirring until flakes with fork. Drain. Add broth and maple syrup. Return to boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour. Add fish. Simmer for 10 more minutes. Serve immediately with bread.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,chunky salsa,hamburger,taco seasoning mix,mexican sauce,orange marmalade
title: Mexican Chicken Burger With Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon orange marmalade | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup mexican style hot sauce | 1/2 cup spicy taco seasoning mix | 1 lb hamburger
instructions: Combine salsa, marmalade, bouillon powder, hot sauce, and taco seasoning. Refrigerate. Heat grill to high. Grill burgers. Brush with remaining marmalade dressing. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,olive oil,lettuce,green pepper,shrimp stock,jalapeno pepper,pepper,wheat pastry flour
title: Cheddar & Shrimp Empanadas
ingredients: 1 packet whole wheat pastry flour | 1 tablespoon cracked pepper | 1 1/2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese | 3/4 cup shrimp stock | 1 jalapeno pepper ( seeded & finely chopped ) | 1/2 cup green pepper ( chopped ) | 2 cups shredded lettuce | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: To make the dough, place the flour, pepper & parmesan in a food processor and process until combined. Add 1/4 cup of cheese & process until combined. Add shrimp stock& process again until it just comes together. Remove dough from processor & knead until just starts to form a ball. Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface into a circle approximately 12in in thick & cut into 8 wedges. Place wedges on a lightly greased baking tray lined with parchment paper. Brush the edges of each pastry with olive oil, then bake at c for 15 min & serve.

title: Rigatoni With Sausage and Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb cassava ( starchy white winter squash ) | 2 lbs rigatoni pasta
instructions: Clean the cassava and remove the outer shell. Cut into small pieces. Heat a large pot over medium low heat add enough oil to cover. Put the cassava pieces in the oil, and fry until brown on all sides. Drain the oil, take off heat, leave cassava in the pot. Cut the cassava pieces into bite sized chunks, and put it into a medium pot with some good water to cover. Salt to taste. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium. Cover and simmer until tender, about 30 minutes. When the cassava is tender, add some olive oil to keep the cassava from sticking. The idea is not to overcook it, but to release its flavor. Serve with parisniki and a good loaf of fresh french bread.

title: Spiced Chicken With Linguine
ingredients: 1 frying chicken ( cleaned ) | 1/3 cup strong coffee | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 spaghetti cake ( sliced in 1/2 rounds, thin-thick slices ) | 1 packet of linguine ( cooked )
instructions: Place chicken in roasting pan. Combine coffee and chili paste. Dip chicken in coffee mixture and arrange over chicken. Cover with plastic wrap and put in refrigerator for 6 - 8 hours, turning occasionally. Remove from refrigerator 10 minutes before cooking. Preheat oven to 375°f. Unfold the spaghetti cake rounds and arrange a single layer on a lightly oiled cookie sheet. Bake 10 - 12 minutes. Meanwhile, cook and drain linguine according to package directions. Remove chicken from pan and spread linguine over cake rounds. Return chicken to roasting pan. Add sauce and sprinkle with fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,apple juice,black pepper,lettuce leaf,sesame seed
title: Apple and Cheese Slaw
ingredients: 4 thick lettuce leaves, washed and dried | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 2 -4 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted | black pepper, freshly ground | 1 -2 tablespoon sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150c/gas put the lettuce leaves and apple juice into a bowl. Season with salt and pepper and mix. Transfer to a baking tray and scatter with the sesame seeds. Sprinkle over the grated cheese, then bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Cock-Ahead Baps
ingredients: 1 kg self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons anchovies | 3 onions
instructions: Break 1 kg flour into a large mixing bowl. Dip the anchovies in the flour then make a small hole into the flour. Break the eggs into the hot, salted anchovies and roll the pieces gently into the flour to coat, then set aside. Slice 3 onions and fry in a non stick pan until slightly coloured and then remove from the pan with a slotted spoon and cool. Remove the anchovies from the pan with a slotted spoon to drain. Heat the oven to 230°c tip or mould into ovenproof dish. Add a third of the caramelized onions and spread out. Place a third of the caramelized onions on top of the onions and spread with the remaining caramelized onions. Place the remaining caramelized onions back into the pan and add some sunflower oil. Drain the anchovies and onions and place them evenly over the onion and caramelized onion mixture. Cut into 2 smaller pieces. The more caramelized onions the lower the temperature setting to 300°f. Add the remaining caramelized onions to the baking dish and dot in the hot caramelized onions. Dot with a knob of butter. Place the baking dish on a flat shelf in the oven and bake for 5 hours until golden brown and risen. Turn a baking rack on to a plate and invert it onto the rack to cool.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,strawberry,wasabi paste,turmeric,chuck roast,ice cream,vanilla sugar,sausage
title: Sausage and Strawberries (Mika’s Ultimate Mushi)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground sirloin steak | 8 ounces hot sausage, finely ground | 8 ounces fresh strawberries ( no subs! ) | 8 ounces fresh strawberries, finely chopped | 3/4 cup real wasabi paste | 1 cup vanilla sugar | ice cream ( to be served at table )
instructions: Wash all the strawberries until the color changes. Soak them in cold water until the water is clear. Put the fish, wasabi paste and vanilla sugar in a blender and blend till mixed well. Mix in the ground sirloin, sausage, whipped straws and a sprinkling of sea salt and ground black pepper and mix till all well combined. Cover and chill in the fridge for 1 hour. To serve, line the mushi mat with plastic wrap, and place the mixture in the center, then with the mat on the exposed side, and put the mat in the freezer to chill the mat longer. When cold, remove the mat with your hands, then use them to pull some of the plastic out. Unwrap the meat mixture and place it on the plastic wrap. Use your hands to cut off a portion of the dough and use a spoon to put about 2 tablespoons of the meat mixture on 1 side of the mat. Flip the meat over and use the rest to make you a pouch. Tie the ends with a piece of aluminum foil to keep it closed at the sushi shop. Wrap the mat around the mussles and place it on the bamboo sushi roller mat or other bamboo mat. Roll them together tightly until all the sushi is used. Gently slide the mat off the mat onto a plate with the meat mixture, placing it inside the rice mat. Serve right away with a spoonful of wasabi cream or wasabi flavored ice cream on the side.

title: Almond Spread
ingredients: 4 tablespoons creamy roasted peanuts | 2 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 2/3 cups ground almonds
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor until well combined and smooth for 2 - 3 minutes. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,mexican tomato jalapeno pepper,fenugreek leaf,red curry paste,rice wine vinegar,navy bean,celery,white balsamic vinegar
title: Lighter Fusion Chili
ingredients: 1 lb navy beans or 1 lb red kidney beans, soaked overnight and drained | 3 stalks celery, sliced thin in 1/2-inch pieces | 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste | 3 -4 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes with jalapeno pepper | 1/4 cup fenugreek leaves, chopped very fine
instructions: Place beans in a saucepan. Add enough water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to boil over medium heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Skim water. Remove from heat. Let stand until beans cool. In a bowl, combine rest of ingredients and mix. Add beans and stir well to coat. Cover and chill before serving. Garnish with chopped fenugreek leaves.

title: Chinese Bean Sprout Salad
ingredients: 7 ounces mixed salad oil | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 cup bean sprouts, fresh | 1/2 cup yellow bell peppers or 1/2 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup dried currant
instructions: Mix together the oil, mustard and hot sauce. Dissolve cornstarch in a cup of water, and gradually stir into oil mixture. Add bean sprouts. Chop bell pepper and stir into bean sprouts.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,cider vinegar,tomato sauce,pie shell,tortilla,meat,bouillon cube
title: Tortilla Enchiladas (Meat & Cheese)
ingredients: 3 quarts tomatoes with basil, garlic, oregano, cilantro, parsley | 1 cup vegetable oil or 1 cup cooking oil | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 4 vegetarian instant bouillon cubes, dissolved in | 1/4 cup hot tomato sauce | 1 unbaked pie shell | 12 large tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f and grease the pie plate or shallow baking dish. In a large bowl combine tomatoes, 2/3 cup oil, vinegar, and chicken broth or other liquid. Blend well with a fork, then stir in bouillon or bouillon liquid. Spoon 1/3 of tomato mixture into the pie plate. Cover with 1/3 of meat mixture and 1/3 of sauce. Repeat layers. Top with remaining tomato mixture, cover with foil, and bake 25 - 30 minutes. Garnish with green salsa and serve with tortillas before eating. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread flour,parsnip,korean red pepper paste,yellow pepper
title: Korean Rice Kraprimi (Vegetable Bread Dumplings)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parsnips or 1 1/2 lbs summer squash | 2 yellow sweet peppers | 1 tablespoon korean red pepper paste ( gochujang ) | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat bread flour
instructions: Wash and peel the parsnips, then cut them in chunks or strips. Cut each chile into thin slices. Dissolve the red pepper paste in about 2 tablespoons water in a small bowl.

title: Chinese Baby Greens
ingredients: 32 ounces mixed baby greens | 1/3 cup tahini | 1/3 cup honey | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 3 tablespoons sugar | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 green pepper, julienned lengthwise | 1/4 cup dried cranberries ( optional )
instructions: Place all of the salad dressing ingredients in a sauce pan and bring to boil. Reduce to low, add honey and stir. Cut baby greens into bite sized pieces and arrange on plates. Drizzle with warm dressing, if desired, and sprinkle with green pepper and cranberries if using.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,jalapeno pepper,brown rice,liquid smoke,chocolate chip,grenadine
title: Spicy Spanish Rice (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 cup tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup barbecue-flavored liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, minced ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons light brown soy sauce ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon grenadine
instructions: Measure all ingredients into rice cooker bowl, and stir to combine. Set rice cooker on low. Cook for 10 minutes, then turn off. Let sit another 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sauce Mousse for Salmon or Chicken
ingredients: 4 salmon, steaks cooked ( optional but recommended ) | 1 tablespoon cream sherry | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes
instructions: Arrange salmon on serving dish. Combine sherry with cream sherry and pour over salmon or chicken.

Random Ingredients: coconut flour,spinach,chili paste,cream mushroom soup,bacon dripping,milk ricotta cheese
title: Spinach with Ricotta and Bacon
ingredients: 3 tablespoons bacon drippings | 2 pounds spinach, rinsed and chopped | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 can condensed milk ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 cup shredded coconut flakes
instructions: In a large skillet, heat bacon drippings over medium heat. Stir in the spinach and saute until tender. Mix in cream of mushroom soup, ricotta cheese, and chili paste. Mix in shredded coconut until well blended. Return to medium low heat.

title: Beef and Potato Stuffed Potatoes

instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c line a large oven tray with baking paper. Using meat mallet, pound steak slices to about 5cm thick. title: Cornmeal and Fava Bean Scrolls
ingredients: 1 cup fava beans or 1 cup frozen fava beans | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup cornmeal ( aka coarse ground or stone ground polenta ) | 1/4 cup sun dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, finely grated | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely grated | 1/4 cup unsalted butter, softened | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. In a large bowl, combine fava beans or frozen fava beans and combine in processor with rest of ingredients. Blend until smooth, stopping to scrape sides occasionally. Place mixture in a large greased and lined baking tray. Lightly grease hands with butter and pat dry with your hands. Random Ingredients: coriander powder,chili powder,mexican chili powder,stewing beef,sea salt,mustard seed,part mozzarella cheese
title: Mexican Pot-Bowl Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg stewing beef, cut into small cubes | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon dry mexican chili powder | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Place all ingredients in a big mixing bowl. Add half the cheese and whisk to combine. Add the rest. Cover and place back in the fridge overnight to marinate. Heat a large frying pan and sear the beef over a high heat. Do not over crowd the pan. When the meat is sealed and brown, pour the contents of the meat into the pot. Add the rest of the cheese on top of the meat. Cover and cook till the cheese melts.. Serve with plain rice or a side dish.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,honey,adobo sauce,broth,beef tenderloin,seasoning salt,cream mushroom soup,ziti pasta
title: Beef Medallions
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 1 x 1/2 x 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup chopped honey | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup broth, canned | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce ( from canned chipotle chiles in adobo sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 package ziti pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package rotini pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: In a large nonstick frypan sprayed with cooking spray, add meat and brown, then add honey, mushroom soup, broth, adobo sauce, mustard powder and seasoning salt. Heat to boiling.

title: Ginger Milk (Ice Cream Free)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon gingerroot, grated | 400 ml half-and-half cream
instructions: Combine the grated ginger root and half and half in a bowl. Beat the mixture with a spoon or whisk until smooth and creamy. Fold in the grated ginger. Freeze in an ice cream maker until fully frozen.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,kosher salt,chive,horseradish,water,mango chutney,green bell pepper,italian pork sausage
title: American Kitchen Classic Mango Chutney and Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, cut into chunks | 1/2 ounce dry horseradish, minced | 2 ounces fresh chives, chopped | 2 ounces sweet italian pork sausage | kosher salt, to taste | 1/2 ounce water | 1/2 ounce sweet mango chutney | 1/2 ounce marshmallows, chopped
instructions: Preheat the broiler, or a barbeque to ensure your oven is hot enough for the pan's heating. Place the bell pepper, horseradish, chives, and sausage in the bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade. Mash the mixture with a fork until it begins to form small crumbles. Season with salt. Pour in the water and blend until a paste forms. Pour into a small bowl. Stir in the chutney. Gently stir in the marshmallows. Spoon into a baking dish. Sprinkle any remaining crumbs over. Broil for 6 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,tea,kernel corn,catsup,green pepper,dill pickle,garlic paste
title: Crunchy Potato Salad
ingredients: 12 cups peeled and cubed potatoes | 1 1/3 cups diced green peppers | 1 1/3 cups diagonally chopped dill pickles ( red ) | 2 cups diagonally chopped sweet whole kernel corn | 1/4 cup catsup | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon garlic paste
instructions: Place potatoes, peppers and pickles into a large colander. In a small bowl, combine the catsup, vinegar, garlic and balsamic. Pour liquid over mixture and toss to coat evenly. Add salt to taste. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Easy Mexican Citrus Cream Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vegetable shortening ( to taste ) | 1 dash cayenne pepper ( to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: In a deep pot full of very hot water, cook pasta as directed. When pasta is al dente, drain. Add lime zest, lime juice and zest, juice and shortening.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,penne pasta,coleslaw mix,cardamom seed,chinese mustard green,red enchilada sauce,sake,poblano chile
title: Pepa Poblano
ingredients: 1 pound dry penne pasta | 2 poblano chiles, sliced crosswise into rings | 1 cup coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/2 cup prepared sauteed english-style mustard greens | 1/4 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 2 teaspoons sake
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the penne and return to a boil. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Nif's Jalousie Pasta Shells
ingredients: 1 package jumbo pasta shells | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/4 cup kalamata olives, sliced | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling water until al dente, following package directions. Drain, reserving about 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Place the cooked pasta into a large serving bowl, and stir in triple sec and olives. Serve immediately with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: kaiser,urad dal,cold water,brown mustard seed,simple syrup
title: Homemade Kebabs (Ma'aboon Ma'aroon)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry brown mustard seeds | 1 3/4 cups cold water | 4 kaiser rolls or 4 hoagie rolls, sliced into half, toasted | 2/3 cup simple syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons seedless urad dal ( or split black gram )
instructions: Mix the mustard seeds and water in a medium saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring often to prevent sticking. Place the rolls in the pan and pour over the mustard and water mixture. Bring the sandwiches to a simmer. Cook until the liquid reduces by half or until thickened, about 15 minutes. Place the sandwiches in the oven and continue to cook until golden and the edges curl a little, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove the sandwiches from the oven and spread the urad dal on top. Spoon yogurt on the urad dal and serve.

title: Easy Baked Cream Cheese Triangles
ingredients: 1 box frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 8 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, sifted | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Thaw phyllo pastry sheets according to package directions. In a bowl, combine cream cheese, flour, and dill. Place one sheet of phyllo on a lightly floured work surface.

title: Spicy Limeade and Almond Pies
ingredients: 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate | 1 can sliced almonds, drained | 1/2 lime, juice of | 3 tablespoons plain flour | 6 anchovy fillets, chopped | lime juice
instructions: Mix limeade concentrate, almonds, lime juice, flour and anchovies in a saucepan. Cook until heated through. Pour hot mix into 24 greased 8x8 inch pan. Smooth topping evenly over mixture. Bake in a moderate oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Beef Pasta and Snow Peas with Parsley (Macaroni Grill)
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 lb pork fillet | 1 lb snow peas | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley | 8 ounces macaroni noodles or 8 ounces rotini pasta
instructions: Put the pasta in a large pot of boiling water. Meanwhile, season the beef with salt and pepper, and cut into 1 inch cubes. Put the snow peas in a pot of water with about 1 1/2 inches of water, and boil the snow peas for 4 - 5 minutes, or until crisp tender. Drain and rinse under cold running water. Drain again, and dry on paper towels. Bring the meat, pork, pork fillet, and snow peas to a boil, and return to the boil. Lower the heat, cover, and simmer for 35 - 45 minutes. When the pasta is done, drain, and add the pasta to the sauce. Toss well with the parsley.

title: Blackened Halibut With Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless skinless salmon fillets, cut into 3 inch chunks | 1 cup smoked salmon fillet, chopped | 1/2 cup prepared taco sauce, such as jake & amos ( or other barbecue sauce ) | 1/2 cup vodka | 3 cups mixed salad greens, such as spinach, frisee, mesclun
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Spray 13x9 glass baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange salmon chunks on top of foil. With a wooden spoon, gently push foil up on salmon. Divide fish evenly among chicken. Spoon taco sauce over fish.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian beef,peanut,sherry wine,fennel seed,blue curacao,green cardamom,vinegar
title: Cambodian Beef
ingredients: 1 lb ground vegetarian beef | 5 green cardamoms ( crushed with the tips of a knife ) | 5 large flat dried blue curacao | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine or 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons ground fennel seed | 1 tablespoon vinegar | sliced peanuts
instructions: Heat the vegetarian beef over medium heat with the cardamons, until it is cooked through, breaking into pieces with a wooden spoon, about 4 to 6 minutes. When fully cooked, remove the meat with the cardamons to an oven safe dish. Add the curacao, sherry, fennel seeds and vinegar to the meat, stir well. Pour sauce over meat and sprinkle with peanuts.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile,crabmeat,red wine vinegar,mirin,chili flake
title: Hot and Creamy Smoked Crab Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb crabmeat, picked over | 6 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons mirin | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes
instructions: Combine the fish, vinegar, mirin, chili flakes and chilli. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,dijon mustard,tapioca flour,self rising flour,bun,kosher salt black pepper,italian tomato
title: Curried Tomato Plop
ingredients: 8 large italian tomatoes | 2 bunches fresh curry leaves ( the stem and ribs ) | 4 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup plain tapioca flour | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 1 1/2 cups canola or duck fat, melted
instructions: Place tomatoes on a medium bowl. Set aside. Place curry leaves and 1 cup of sour cream in a kitchen or spice grinder. Cover, and pulse until coarsely ground. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove tomatoes from bowl, squeezing out excess liquid. Combine garlic cloves, 1/2 cup sour cream and 1/2 cup of the canola or duck fat in a bowl, or in a blender, and blend until smooth. Stir 1/2 cup of the canola or duck fat into mashed garlic and sour cream. Add mustard and curry leaves. Mix well. Stir in the tomatoes, 1 cup of the soured cream, salt and pepper. Turn out dough onto floured work surface, and knead until smooth. Roll dough out into a rectangle about 1 inch thick. Cut into strips about 4 inches long, about 3/4 inch wide and 3/4 inch wide. Reroll scraps, and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Greek Lemons and Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 ounces shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 12 ounces fresh whole wheat sugar snap peas, trimmed | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh ginger, peeled and minced
instructions: Place the mushrooms and snap peas in a 2 quart microwave safe glass casserole dish with the ginger. Cover and microwave on high 1 minute. Stir. Cover and microwave until snap peas and shiitake mushrooms are tender, 10 - 12 minutes. Remove and discard the ginger. Serve immediately.

title: Tasty Beetroot & Portabella Caps
ingredients: 3 medium portabella mushroom caps | 1 1/4 cups walnuts | cinnamon sugar
instructions: Peel off the skin on the mushrooms and cut them away from the stem. Place the mushrooms on kitchen paper and place in microwave. Cook the caps in water to cover for 2 minutes, stirring twice. Remove caps for 2 minutes and squeeze out the water. Cut caps into bite sized pieces. Cut walnuts into small chunks. Place in a bowl. Add a few pinches of ground cinnamon into the walnuts, mixing until they are well combined. Season as per your taste. Add mushrooms and walnuts to walnuts & walnuts, mixing to mix. Cook in microwave for 3 - 5 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,ham hock,garlic paste,vegetable oil cooking spray,beef stew meat,beef chuck,salt water,fish sauce
title: Thai Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil, divided | 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 package beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 can beef bouillon or 3/4 cup fish sauce | 2 1/2 cups coarse salt water, divided | 1 medium napa cabbage, cored and shredded | 2 packages napa cabbage, cored and shredded ( about 8 cups )
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a 5 to 6 quart heavy pot over high heat until hot but not smoking, about 15 seconds. Add half of meat and cook, stirring constantly, until browned in several areas about 2 minutes. Using two slotted spoons, remove meat, leaving liquid in pot. Place remaining oil, beef, and garlic paste into pot.

title: Pear Clove and Canadian Bacon Muesli With Broth (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 2 )
ingredients: 4 slices canadian bacon, chopped | 2 green onions, sliced | 4 slices fresh peaches, sliced | 1 ounce old fashioned oats | 1 1/8 cups canadian fat-free cooking broth or 1 1/8 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Heat broiler. Place bacon and onions in a large saucepan. Cover with water and bring to boiling. Reduce heat and cook for 5 mins or until onion is tender. Drain bacon and drain onions. Place in a large bowl. Add peaches, oats and broth. Bring to boil, cover, and transfer to a warm oven. Preheat broiler to high. Place 1/4 cup of muesli into a shallow baking or roasting pan. Cover with foil, and broil until golden and bubbly, 12 - 14 minutes. Turn off heat, remove foil and pour off any excess moisture. Spread remaining muesli over the top of the hot broth and serve immediately.

title: Barbecued Asparagus
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed | 1 green pepper, cut in 1 cm pieces | 14 ounces tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 teaspoon orange juice | 1 pinch crushed red pepper
instructions: Brush the asparagus with oil if necessary to prevent burning. Thread the asparagus on 4 skewers. Combine tomato sauce, capers, orange juice, and crushed red pepper into sauce. Place asparagus on skewers and cook under high heat for 4 - 5 minutes each side. Serve straight from skewers.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,red bird eye chilies,hot italian sausage link,gingerroot,kielbasa
title: Hot Chocolate (Or Polish Sausage) Dogs
ingredients: 1/4 3/4 lb kielbasa | 2 hot italian sausage links | 1 teaspoon garlic gingerroot ( fresh from asian delights ) | 4 red bird's eye chilies ( or chinese chili powder ) | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder
instructions: Put everything in a small pot.

title: Canadian Bacon & Zucchini Rounds
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, sliced crosswise 1/4 inch thick | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 2 slices canadian bacon, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup thinly sliced blanched almond ( optional ) | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f degrees. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Place zucchini on baking sheets and sprinkle with pepper. Bake until golden, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, wrap in paper, and let stand 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat canadian bacon in a skillet over medium heat until beginning to brown, 4 to 10 minutes. Stir in almonds.

title: Pineapple Peanut Soup
ingredients: 400 g button mushrooms | 1 birds eye chile, chopped | 1 tablespoon peanuts ( or use cashew nuts ) | 400 ml pineapple juice | salt | 1/2 cup light yogurt
instructions: Cook the mushrooms, chilli and nuts in water for 5 mins on high and salt in a separate pan. Add the pineapple juice and simmer for 5 mins. Add the cream and serve.

title: Chipotle Adobo Snack
ingredients: 1 chipotle chile in adobo, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds
instructions: Smoke the chile with the adobo for 1 to 2 hours in a grill, or in a cast iron skillet. Stem the chile, remove the seeds with a spoon and add the pomegranate seeds. Allow to cool for 10 minutes.

title: Baked Beets With Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 24 large beets, scrubbed | mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning, for grilling | 1 cup sliced sun-dried tomato | 2 tablespoons crumbled corn tortilla chips | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Place beets in a large roasting pan coated with a thick layer of cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,salmon,green chili pepper,cake flour,cayenne pepper,parsley leaf,plum tomato,swiss cheese
title: Swiss Smoked Salmon Pie
ingredients: 4 slices smoked salmon | 3 plums tomatoes | 3 slices swiss cheese | 3/4 cup fresh parsley leaves | 1/4 cup pizza crusts | 1 can pizza sauce ( or use homemade ) | cayenne pepper ( optional ) | green chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spread pizza crust evenly with tomato slices, then top with cheese, salmon and parsley. Pour 1/2 of the pizza sauce over and top with smoked salmon. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper and/or green chili peppers if using them. Bake in 400f oven for 20 - 30 minutes, until bubbly around the edges. Let sit 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Ricotta Dressing (Ronzoni No Forno Seciti)
ingredients: 15 ounces ricotta, drained and pressed ( or cottage based ) | 1 tablespoon sake
instructions: Combine drained ricotta with pinch of salt in medium sized bowl. Add sake.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,bacon bit,rice noodle,kirby cucumber,taco sauce,seasoning salt,green chili,lettuce
title: Chilie's Rice Noodles and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rice noodles | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 cup mild green chili, chopped | 1 tablespoon low-sodium taco sauce | 1 kirby cucumber, chopped | 1 teaspoon bacon bits | 1 cup lettuce, shredded
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water until just slightly tender, about 3 minutes. Drain. Combine flour and seasoning salt. Place noodles in a large serving bowl. Add chilies, taco sauce, cucumber and bacon bits. Combine thoroughly. Toss well. Scatter on top of noodles. Sprinkle with lettuce.

title: Lite Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut | 2 tablespoons olive | 1/2 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1/4 cup chopped green chili
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Open the can of sauerkraut and empty contents into a glass baking dish. Drain excess liquid from the can onto the sauerkraut. Cover the dish with aluminum foil and heat in the oven for 20 minutes. Shake sauerkraut to mix sauerkraut with the juices. Meanwhile, heat olive in a small skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until sizzling. Stir in parsley, green chili, and green chilis.

title: Roast Duck
ingredients: 2 ducks | catsup ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease the inside of a roasting dish. Cover the bottom of the dish with heavy duty aluminum foil. Place duck on top of foil and poke the edges with a fork. Roast 30 to 35 minutes or until the internal temperature of the duck reaches 170 degrees f when taken with a meat thermometer. Serve with a good quality pork roast or beef roast and sweet sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,star anise,sourdough bread,mozzarella cheese,italian seasoning
title: Sourdough Mozzarella & Rice Noodles Bake
ingredients: 8 slices sourdough bread | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 star anise | 4 -6 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 lb fresh rice noodles
instructions: Place cooked noodles in crockpot and coat with italian seasoning. Next, layer the remaining ingredients in this order, bread, cheese, noodles, and last of all, ending with cheese. Turn crockpot on high for about 3 - 5 hours, turn cooker to low and cook for about 2 hours. Serve with italian bread and garlic bread.

Random Ingredients: banana,rice,kosher salt black pepper,horseradish,loaf french bread,pea carrot,ginger
title: Lobster (French Bread and Cheese) Sandwich
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb loaf french bread, sliced ( french bread has a tendency to stick to the bottom of the loaf,, and needs to be cut in half ) | 4 -6 large frozen peas and carrots, thawed ( fresh or frozen ) | 6 ounces baguette, sliced 1/4 inch thick ( french bread has a tendency to stick to the bottom, and needs to be cut in half ) | 2 -3 ripe bananas ( depending on how much of the sugar you eat with it ) | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish, drained ( more or less to taste ) | 1 inch fresh ginger, grated | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f / 220°c. To prepare a sandwich, place bread on cookie sheet and top with a slice of bread that is toasted. Place frozen peas and carrots on the other side of the toasted bread. Arrange banana slices on top, then top with prepared bread slice, then drizzle with horseradish. Sprinkle with grated ginger and season with salt and pepper. Place cookie sheet in the oven in the heated oven until bread just starts to get brown, then remove and let rest for about 10 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: green olive,yeast extract,extra virgin olive oil
title: Fougasse
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups water | 1 package dry yeast extract | 6 -7 ounces of hard green olives | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Add the yeast extract to the water and warm for 5 - 10 minutes, making sure that the water is incorporated. Add the olives, and place the mixture in a large bowl with plenty of freshly ground black pepper and salt. Mix well. Cover with a clean cloth and leave to rise in a warm place for at least 20 to 24 hours, or over night if you can. After the dough has doubled in size, punch down and knead it for at least 10 minutes. Place on a floured surface, shape into a loaf and put in a large pan for 40 - 50 minutes or until the dough has doubled in size. Let cool on a rack to allow it to ripen, then slice at an angle. Place slices onto a foil lined baking sheet, cover with a damp towel and leave to rise over a cool place. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes or until they have turned a golden color.

Random Ingredients: pepper jack cheese,ricotta cheese,egg white,red pepper flake,red onion
title: Mini Cheese Frittatas
ingredients: 4 pinches crushed red pepper flakes | 1 cup shredded ricotta cheese | 2 egg whites | 1 small red onion, diced | 4 slices pepper jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Line a muffin tin with paper liners. In a glass bowl, mix ricotta with half the crushed red pepper flakes. In a frying pan over medium heat, toss the onion while whisking until soft and golden. Dip one slice of cheese into the egg whites, then into the crumbs. Place the cheese side by side on the prepared muffin tin. Repeat with the remaining slices of cheese. Evenly coat a slice of cheese with the crumb mixture. Pour the remaining egg mixture into the pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until frittatas turn a golden color. Top with the other slice of cheese to serve.

Random Ingredients: saffron,dark brown sugar,champagne,shiitake mushroom,poblano pepper,vanilla,flour,cremini mushroom
title: Champagne Mushrooms With Poblano Melon Mushrooms
ingredients: 40 cremini mushrooms | 4 poblano peppers | 1/4 cup flour | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla | 2 1/2 cups chilled inexpensive champagne or 2 1/2 cups canned low-sodium canned low-sodium chicken broth | 12 shiitake mushrooms, stems removed
instructions: Rinse and de stem mushrooms.

title: Pear Rice Berry Salad
ingredients: 1 ripe pear, peeled | 1 cup uncooked brown rice | 1 cup fresh strawberries, hulled and hulled
instructions: Core pear with a knife and cut in half from top to bottom. Cut in half again from top to bottom. Repeat with remaining pears. In a saucepan, bring enough water to cover rice with water. Bring to boil over high heat.

title: Chourico and Banana Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb chourico sausage | 4 bananas
instructions: Slice chourico lengthwise into 1/2 in rounds. Place on foil lined pan, fat side up. Bake uncovered at 425°f for about 15 min or till no sign of pink remains. Watch carefully. Remove from oven, cut side of chourico slices. When cool, peel off the skins.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,green chili,daikon radish,italian parsley,pimiento,heavy whipping cream
title: Napa Dave's Daikon Radish Salad
ingredients: 1 red hot green chili | 1 lb daikon radish, very thinly sliced | 1 package pimientos | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons minced italian parsley
instructions: Cut green chili in half, remove seeds, then cut into slices. Slice daikon into 1/4 inch thick strips. In skillet, saute in peanut butter 1 minute or until softened. Add daikon and green chilies.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,mint leaf,taco sauce,texas cheese toast,white fish fillet,part ricotta cheese,pumpkin puree,biscuit mix
title: Tasty Fish Tacos With Shrimp and Cannelloni Romaine Hearts
ingredients: 4 ounces white fish fillets ( shrimp or prawns may be substituted if desired ) | 1 cup biscuit mix ( store-bought or homemade, see instructions ) | 1 cup canned cannelloni ( drained whole-wheat beans or kidney beans may also be used ) | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese ( about 1 container ) | 1/2 cup pumpkin puree ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 2 teaspoons fresh mint leaves, minced | 8 slices texas flavored cheese toast ( toasted or your favorite sandwich bread )
instructions: To make the cannelloni, toast the bread slices and spread them out in a single layer on a wire rack set over a plate or baking sheet. When hot spread out the bean biscuits on the rack and toast them in a 400 degree f oven for 3 to 5 minutes, turning once, until golden, being careful not to burn them. Spread the ricotta cheese evenly on top of the toast slices, sprinkle with the pumpkin puree, and drizzle the taco sauce over the cannelloni. Sprinkle the minced mint over the taco, and top with the fish fillets and the wholemeal biscuit mix. Return to the oven until the cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

title: Mexican Fish
ingredients: 1 lb hake fillet | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup cumin powder | 3 cups shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Rub a roasting pan generously with vegetable oil. Pat the fish dry with parchment paper. Brush with some vegetable oil. Place the fish on the pan. Cover with the remaining vegetables. Pour the vinegar over, cover the pan, and place in the oven for 45 minutes. Uncover the pan, and bake for 15 minutes for browned pieces and 15 minutes for firm fleshed fish to fish.

title: Wilted Spinach With Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 bunch spinach, washed and stemmed | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 2 serrano chili, minced | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, roasted
instructions: Put spinach in a large bowl. Cover with enough water to cover spinach. Set aside for 3 hours. Drain the water from the spinach. Cook spinach in a large saucepan over medium high heat in 2 tablespoons water until wilted. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside. Transfer spinach to a food processor or blender and add tarragon and chilies. Process until smooth. Return spinach to pan and cover. Simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes until liquid has slightly reduced. Remove from heat and stir in hazelnuts,. Stir into spinach mixture. Cover and chill for 2 hours.

title: Wild Willie's Seasoned Scalloped Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon dried summer savory | 1/8 teaspoon crushed ground cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the sour cream with mushrooms soup and savory. Spread onto an ungreased 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with the ground cloves. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven.

title: Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1 pound jicama, peeled and diced | 2 tablespoons celery seed
instructions: Place jicama in a large salad bowl. Sprinkle celery seed over the jicama, and toss until thoroughly coated. Cover salad to keep warm, and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 3 large egg whites, beaten | 1 large yellow bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Blend egg whites and yellow bell pepper until frothy. Add egg white mixture. On a well floured surface, roll out 4 sheets. Cut into strips 4 to 6 inches long. Arrange half of a strip of phyllo on the baking sheet, brush with egg whites and egg yolk mixture. Arrange remaining strips over the top, brush each strip with egg whites and egg yolk mixture, and sprinkle with a little more egg whites if desired. Repeat with each sheet of phyllo, but only using 2 sheets of phyllo. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Beef Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb dry yeast | 1 lb bread flour | 6 tablespoons brewed coffee | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon ground sage leaf | 3/4 cup unsweetened baking cocoa | 1 lb pineapple, peeled, cored, and cut into 3/4-inch wedges | 16 ounces ground round
instructions: Stir yeast into lukewarm water. Set aside. Mix bread flour and all the other ingredients in a large bowl. Dissolve yeast in water and pour into the bowl.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,seasoning salt,butter bean,star anise,cottage cheese
title: Butter Noodle and Bean Nests
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 2 cups cottage cheese | 2 star anise | seasoning salt | 1/3 cup butter beans or 1/3 cup olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to in a medium pot of boiling salted water, cook egg noodles until al dente and drain well. Set aside. In a small bowl, mix together cheese and anise slices. Set aside. Sprinkle seasoning salt on noodles and mix well. In a large casserole dish layer noodles and cheese mixture. Repeat layering until all ingredients are used. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake, 1 hour and 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,pistachio nut,fish fillet,leg lamb,soymilk,cremini mushroom
title: Pistachio and Lamb Schnitzel
ingredients: 2 lbs leg of lamb, boned and butterflied | 6 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 6 ounces small bell peppers, sliced | 7 ounces soymilk | 4 ounces pistachio nuts | 1 can fish fillets
instructions: Put the butterflied leg of lamb in a large, shallow frying pan with medium high sides or a roasting pan with a lid. Brown all over until well browned. Add the mushrooms, peppers, soymilk and pistachios. Stir well. Cook on a low heat for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes or so. Cook until lamb is cooked through and vegetables are tender. Remove from heat, and leave to rest before serving.

title: Mexican  Strawberry  Artichoke Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/2 cup artichoke heart | 1 can green chilies | 4 eggs, beaten | 4 cups fresh strawberries, cut in halves | 8 ounces corn syrup | 6 -8 flour tortillas
instructions: Heat grill to medium. Pour corn syrup in shallow pan.

title: Greek Restaurant Yogurt Dip - Easy!
ingredients: 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1 chopped onion, small | 3 stalks chopped apples ( optional )
instructions: Mix yogurt, chopped onions, and apples in mixing bowl. Stir until well combined. Cover and refrigerate several hours before serving. Use right away or refrigerate for longer storage.

Random Ingredients: chocolate curl,red wine vinegar,saffron thread,basmati rice,egg white,kidney bean
title: Basmati Rice with Saffron
ingredients: 1 box instant rice | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads | 12 ounces kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup chocolate curls | 1 egg white
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a saucepan, bring water to boil. Add rice, and remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 20 minutes. In a large bowl, mix vinegar, saffron, and kidney beans. Fold in rice. In a small bowl, sprinkle about 1 teaspoon of chocolate curls per serving. Stir egg white into rice mixture. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Do not bake until golden brown.

title: Red-Cooked Mexican Pork With Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 600 g country-style pork ribs | 200 g yellow peppers, deseeded deseeded and chopped | 1 roasting chickens, fat removed and chopped | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons sunflower seeds ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c and line a tray with baking paper. Combine the pork and all remaining ingredients together, except seeds. Place in a large roasting tin and bake for 25 minutes. Remove and place in a bowl and stir through the roasted vegetables and serve.

title: Quick Beef Salad
ingredients: 4 beef tip steaks | 2 bags mixed salad greens | 1 bunch basil, finely chopped
instructions: Season the steaks with kosher salt. Grill the steak over high heat on top rack of grill, about 20 seconds on each side or according to your desired degree of doneness, depending on how thinly sliced your steak is. Cool, slice into strips, and sprinkle with basil. This is also good at room temperature on a plate with a piece of lettuce on the side.

title: Vegan-Friendly Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel bulb, chopped | 1 cup raw cashews | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: In a large skillet or saute pan cook fennel until tender crisp, remove from heat and toss with peanuts or cashews.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,quinoa,kaffir lime leaf,lemon zest,italian tomato,lentil
title: Spicy Mexican Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cups lentils, soaked overnight in | 1 can italian stewed tomatoes, drained & rinsed | 1/4 cup uncooked quinoa, rinsed and well drained | 1 lemon, zest & juice of, grated on the smallest holes of the box | 1 -3 fresh kaffir lime leaf, torn | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Cook lentils, tomatoes, quinoa, zest & juice in boiling water over medium heat, uncovered, for 25 - 30 minutes until lentils and tomatoes are cooked to your liking... Remove from heat, stir in sesame oil, allow to cool to room temperature before serving, or chill the quinoa as directed below. Serve with a nice green salad & lots of crusty bread pieces.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,fish sauce,grain white rice,black tea,white rice
title: Sydong Bulb Plia (Sydong Bulb Gai Pan Pil-Fried Rice)
ingredients: 1 package short-grain white rice | 1 lb white rice | 1 garlic clove, minced | 4 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons black tea ( i use decaf )
instructions: Clean the rice well or else the grains will not be suitable. In a large pot combine all ingredients except rice and bring to a boil. Cover with a lid and cook over high heat for 15 minutes, stirring once or twice. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Cherry Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup picante sauce | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 cans sweet pitted cherries | 0.75 bag frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Stir together picante sauce and vanilla sugar. Spread 2 tablespoons picante sauce mixture at bottom of a glass baking dish. Cover the sauce mixture with the cherries, and roll the bottom and sides of the pastry up. Place the roll in the baking dish.

title: Italian Sausage with ice cubes (Karela)
ingredients: 1 pound sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 4 cups ice cubes
instructions: Slice sausage into 2 inch wide strips. Cut shortening into flour until it resembles coarse crumbs. In a large skillet, cook sausage over medium high heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain. Add drained sausage to cooking pan. Cook about 5 minutes until no longer pink, stirring constantly. Serve in warm bowls or a covered bowl. Serve chilled.

title: Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 8 ounces corn chips | 6 ounces mixed vegetables, drained | 3 tablespoons parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the corn chips in a bowl and mix well with the vegetables. Toss in the parsley. Spread the vegetables into a baking tray and bake in the oven until just tender, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,parsnip,chili sauce,chicken stock powder,baking soda,white wine vinegar
title: Chilli Parsnips
ingredients: 3 lbs parsnips | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/2 cup chicken stock powder or 1/2 cup vegetarian stock powder
instructions: Peel, core and cut parsnips into 1 chunks. Place in a large pot of boiling salted water for 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain and cool. Transfer cooked parsnips to a bowl. To the bowl add all remaining ingredients including the wine. Stir to combine. Add to parsnips the mixture will look crumby. Cover and store in the fridge.

title: Beets on the Half Shells (Kari)
ingredients: 2 medium beets, scrubbed and sliced in half through the stem | 2 1/2 cups mirin
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees farenheit.

title: Fruit, Macadamia and Corn Salad (Salad Yum)
ingredients: 400 g canned mixed fruit | 3/4 cup macadamia nuts, chopped | 1 cup corn kernels, frozen ( or fresh )
instructions: Mix together the macadamia nuts and mixed fruit. Set aside for a couple of minutes or so to allow flavours to meld. Dress with a good quality olive oil or other flavours. If toasted, toast over a few minutes, shaking the pan gently to make sure nuts are golden and crisp. Allow to cool slightly before pouring over your favourite salad.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,bean,red cabbage,white bread,green chile pepper,dark brown sugar
title: Texas-Style Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 white bread, cut into 12 slices | 1 pound boneless beef stew meat, cut into thin strips | 2 cans mild pickled red cabbage, drained and pressed dry | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 can refried beans
instructions: Place a piece of bread on a flat work surface. Place a beef slice on top, and spread pickled red cabbage and green chile peppers over the beef slice. Sprinkle about 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar over the beans, then sprinkle about 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar over the top of the green chili peppers. Place the meat on top. Starting with a finger, roll up and slice into 12 slices. Repeat with other bread slices and meat and vegetables until the remaining sandwiches are arranged in a large roasting pan. Pour the refried beans into the pan, then add enough water just to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until meat is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly, about 1 1/2 hours. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Homemade Sauteed Lemongrass
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lemongrass, washed ( about 1 1/2 inches long ) | 2 cups apple juice ( or enough to cover lemongrass in 1 cup apple juice, 3/4 cup ) | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons safflower oil ( or cooking oil ) | 2 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Wash lemongrass, remove base, trim and discard tough outer leaves, cut off any bruised portion, remove stalk, cut into 2 inch lengths, trim ends but leave intact. Place meat, apple, water, tomato paste and safflower oil in a large, heavy bottomed casserole dish. Cover and cook over moderate heat until meat is cooked, stirring occasionally, about 1 hour. When cooked, remove and discard lemon grass, stir and serve.

title: Lamb Shoulder With Watermelon and Pear
ingredients: 3 tablespoons paprika | 1 1/2 tablespoons thyme | 1 1/2 tablespoons onion powder | 4 lbs lamb shoulder or 4 lbs goat meat, cut into 2 inch cubes | 2 pears, peeled and sliced | watermelon, seeded and cut into thin wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine paprika, thyme, and onion powder in a large bowl. Add lamb, stirring to coat all sides. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Line a roasting pan with foil and transfer lamb to pan. Arrange pears around lamb. Roast, basting often with juices, approximately 45 - 55 minutes or until browned and tender, basting every 15 - 25 minutes with a few tablespoons of the pan juices. Serve with the watermelon wedges.

title: Tostones
ingredients: 2 cans white hominy ( i've even used corn mixed with a little tomato ) | 3 ounces crab boil | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese
instructions: The can be eaten plain, or you can serve them in a warmed tortilla with cheese and your favorite salad dressing. Enjoy.

title: Coconut Cream Cheese Creamy Roll
ingredients: 2 bags refrigerated cream cheese | 3/4 cup light cream | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut | 2 bunches fresh nori, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. In a bowl, cover cream cheese with cold water, and let sit out overnight. When the oven's broiler is ready, line the baking sheet with nori. Place cream cheese in a large bowl, and beat in light cream until mixture is smooth and creamy and creamy. Toss shredded coconut into cream cheese mixture. Gently fold in nori, then spread mixture into greased 9x13 inch pan. Allow to set slightly before cutting into 16 squares.

title: Beef Kale With Quinoa, Eggplant and Kale
ingredients: 1 tablespoon beef bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 cup quinoa, uncooked | 4 cups cold cooked kale, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup eggplant, sliced peeled and cut into 1/2-inch dice ( about 1/2 pound ) | 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt ( low fat okay ) | 1/2 2 ounces pineapples, unsalted | 1/8 cup radicchio or 1/4 cup spinach, shredded
instructions: In a large saucepan, saute beef bouillon in lukewarm water until dissolved, about 1 minute. Stir in quinoa and chili powder and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Stir quinoa mixture, kale, eggplant, yogurt and 1/3 cup water into the beef stew. Reduce to simmering and cover. Simmer until all of the liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Stir in pineapple and radicchio.

title: Leek and Coriander (Zingy) Pickles
ingredients: 6 large leeks ( white and light green parts only ) | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | fresh lemon juice and zest, to taste
instructions: Wash the leeks and cut thinly from the root end to expose the white stalk. Wash the leeks thoroughly and cut in half lengthwise, making sure the stem is well washed. Place the pieces of peeled leek in a large bowl and sprinkle all over with the cumin, coriander and freshly squeezed lemon rind. Toss lightly and allow to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. Cover and chill the pickles for up to three days.

title: Roasted Pumpkin With Olives and Asiago
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs whole pumpkin, such as hubbard squash or 2 -3 lbs yellow pumpkin, such as pumpkin di parma | 1/2 cup kosher salt | 6 ounces asiago cheese, shaved | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted and halved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Cut the pumpkin halves in half and scoop out all of the peel. Place the halves cut side up on a cookie sheet lined with foil or parchment paper. Using a sharp knife or a peeler or paring knife, trim the core from the skin of the pumpkin. Cut into 1/2 inch thick slices. Place the slices on the foil or parchment paper in a roasting pan. Rub the skins off of the tomatoes with your hands and sprinkle them on top of the pumpkin, spreading them as thinly as you can. Drizzle them with some olive oil and sprinkle both sides of the pumpkin with salt. Sprinkle the shredded cheese on top and dot the remaining olive over the top. Bake the pumpkin until the cheese and pumpkin are tender and the skin is crisp and browned, about 3 hours. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Polish Kielbasa
ingredients: 18 lbs kielbasa | 2 1/2 cups barley, unbleached, quick cooking | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream, sweetened | 6 whole cloves of minced garlic
instructions: Heat oven to 325ëš f & grease rack of a 2 qt. Dutch ovenproof dutch oven or other shallow heavy pot. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and bake in preheated oven until the kielbasa is very tender & slightly browned, about 2  3 hours..

title: Chinese Beef Soup With Chicken Apples
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 1/2 lbs of sliced beef shank ( not round bones ) | 1 whole star anise or 1 tablespoon other large green cardoon | 1 lb chicken or 1 lb turkey | 5 lbs apples ( preferably granny smiths ) | water or whole cane, rinsed ( optional ) | 1 orange, juice of ( i like lots of fresh squeezed )
instructions: The first step is to clean the shank and season it all with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large saucepan and fry the shank for approximately 5 minutes on each side until dark green and crusty.
