Remove the shank and add the remaining ingredients to the pan and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer covered for 1 hour or till the meat and the meat is tender. Remove the beef from the stock and shred and discard the fat from the stock. Place stock back in the saucepan and heat through. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,romaine lettuce leaf,greek yogurt,pimiento,tomato green chile pepper
title: Garden Salsa
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 can vegetable stock | 1 package shredded romaine lettuce leaves | 1 jar chopped pimiento, drained | 2 cups greek-style yogurt
instructions: In a bowl, gently toss together the tomatoes, vegetable stock, romaine lettuce, pimento, and greek yogurt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili paste garlic,vinegar,napa cabbage,tamarind nectar,green olive
title: Tamarind Green Salad
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 cup green olives, pitted and sliced | 1/2 cup tamarind nectar | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 2 teaspoons hot chili paste with garlic
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill.

Random Ingredients: red hot sauce,italian breadcrumb,yellow squash,fine sea salt,dark sesame oil,chicken breast half,cream,fillet
title: Seared Chicken Fingers with Sweet Italian Garlic
ingredients: 4 fillets, trimmed of visible fat | 1 1/2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon red hot hot sauce ( or to taste ) | 4 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 medium yellow squash, thinly cut lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1-inch sticks | 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled cut crosswise into 1-inch sticks | 1 cup light sour cream | 2 tablespoons fine sea salt
instructions: Lay out fillets on a cutting board and sprinkle each with 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil. Using a knife, lightly drench both sides of the fillets in the salt and sesame oil then set the fillets flat, 1/2 inch thick. Lightly press the salt on both sides of the fillets. Wrap each fillet tightly in foil and refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to 8 hours. Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix 2 cups bread crumbs, 1 cup squash sticks, sweet potatoes, sour cream,. 2 tablespoons sea salt and remaining 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil. Working over a large, 12 inch cast iron skillet, arrange the fillets on top of each other. In a large skillet, heat the remaining 4 tablespoons sesame oil over medium high heat. Working in batches, add the fish to the pan and cook until golden, about 3 - 4 minutes per side. Using a spatula, transfer to a deep platter and let rest for 3 - 4 minutes. Drizzle with the sour cream mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,kidney bean,lingonberry preserve,crabmeat,brussels sprout,pork shoulder,orange,adobo sauce
title: Carnitas (New Year's Eve Salad)
ingredients: 1/4 lb fresh brussels sprout | 1/4 lb fresh lobster tail | 1 small boneless pork shoulder ( optional ) | kosher salt | 1/2 lb frozen cooked lima beans | 3 tablespoons adobo sauce | 3 -5 tablespoons frozen cranberry preserves ( optional ) | 6 slices orange rind ( optional )
instructions: Trim the ends from the brussels sprouts and cut off the ends. Cut into 1 inch rounds. Cut the tail of lobster into 1 inch chunks using scissors. Place the bean into a small bowl. Slice the pork shoulder into small chunks using scissors or kitchen shears and toss with 1 tbsp salad oil. Season the pork with kosher salt and add it to a bowl with a few handfuls of cheese. Toss the bean mixture until the pork is well coated. Dump the bean mixture into the bowl with the pork and gently toss to blend. Arrange the orange rind slices over the top of the salad for added presentation. Tear or dice the reserved brussels sprouts into bite size pieces. Assemble the salad in the following order,. The first orange rind strip. The second orange rind strip. Then the bean mixture. Bend or roll the entire top of the salad until the bag is well stuffed. You can place the bag in the refrigerator in one small plastic bag or a large bowl and serve the salad after all your family and friends are having a nap.

title: Oregano Spread
ingredients: 1 medium fresh anaheim chilies or 2 -3 large anaheim chilies, seeded, minced ( use mild green chilies or hot green chilies ) | 1/4 cup unseasoned breadcrumbs ( or to taste ) | 3 -4 tablespoons grated cheese ( optional, we prefer cheese of your choice, but i've found that it adds a little bit of the flavor of any cheese. ) | 1 teaspoon greek oregano or 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 5 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Remove stems from chilies leaving the seeds. Chop into small cubes. Peel outer skin from chiles and remove seeds. Chop pods into small hunks and set aside. In a medium saucepan melt garlic, bread crumbs and oregano together. Add hot stock to the bread crumb mixture and whisk until smooth. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 more minutes. Spoon into sterilized jars leaving 2/3 of the headspace. Process in water bath canner. Refridgerate 2 days. Seal. Store in a cool dark place.

title: Kalamata Olive Pizzas
ingredients: 2 kalamata olives | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon peel | 20 kalamata olives, pitted | 3 tablespoons ground pistachios | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( more to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f. Spread kalamata olives evenly on baking sheet. Roast until fragrant and beginning to blacken, 10 minutes. Remove from the oven. Stir the juice, lemon peel, olives, and pistachios in a bowl to blend. Drop the pizzas onto the baking sheet and bake for 1 - 3 minutes or until the crust is golden and the flavors meld. Serve immediately, or store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,black bean,vodka,fennel seed,splenda sugar substitute,bibb lettuce
title: Black Beans With Romaine
ingredients: 32 ounces black beans, drained and rinsed | 8 cups lightly packed arborio rice | 1 1/2 ounces splenda sugar substitute | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 teaspoons vodka | 1 head small bibb lettuce
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat and strain into a bowl. Add the lettuce and toss to coat. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,peppercorn,mushroom soup,green onion,mustard powder,fast rise yeast,vanilla extract
title: Bread Machine Swedish Mushroom Sausages
ingredients: 2 packages fast rise yeast | 1 can mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 teaspoons ground peppercorns | 1 cup green onion, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except green onions in bread machine. Set on regular green/white crust. Press start.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,beef tenderloin,black mustard seed
title: Dry-Grilled Beef Filets
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 36 green cardamom pods | 12 ounces beef tenderloin
instructions: Place the mustard seeds, cardamom pods, and beef tenderloin in a shallow glass bowl or baking dish and coat with the prepared mustard mixture before chilling in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Grill the beef until the desired doneness, using the recommended amount of each color. If desired, allow a few minutes for medium grilling time.

title: Pub
ingredients: 1/2 cup cubed smoked sweet potato | 1/2 cup cubed cooked sausage or 1/2 cup sausage, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 slices rye bread, toasted | 4 fluid ounces light dark beer | 1/2 cup hot tap water | 1/2 cup cooked shrimp | 1 orange, sliced into thin rings
instructions: Combine potato, sausage and bread. Pour beer over potato mixture.

title: Corn, Turkey & Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 ounces smoked turkey sausage, skinned, boned, crumbled | 3 ounces queso fresco, crumbled | 1 bunch green onion, finely chopped | 1 can creamed corn | 1/4 cup light molasses or 1/4 cup light corn syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, combine all ingredients except tortillas and cover with tinfoil or parchment paper. Place pan in oven and bake for 30 minutes. Remove the tinfoil or parchment from the oven. To make cheese tamale sauce, in a small saucepan, combine sour cream, grated cheese, tamale sauce and sugar. Heat gently until cheese is melted and tamale flavor is blended. Place a tortilla on a serving plate and spread with cheese sauce. Spoon sauce evenly around tortilla and serve.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,tomato green chilies,kaffir lime leaf,white pepper,fruit,monterey jack cheese,black pepper,red cabbage
title: Spicy Vegetable Rounds
ingredients: 2 teaspoons white pepper, divided | 2 cans mixed vegetables, like zucchini, bell peppers, broccoli, cauliflower, and red cabbage, rinsed and drained | 8 kaffir lime leaves | 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese, divided | 8 canned diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place 1 teaspoon pepper in a small baking dish, and sprinkle on the vegetables. Bake about 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until vegetables are hot and bubbling. Remove from skillet with a spatula, and spread the remaining pepper mixture on the top. Remove from heat and spread the remaining cheese over the cooked vegetables. Layer with the kaffir lime leaves, tomato slices, green chilies, hot pepper sauce, and black pepper. Bake about 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted and vegetables are hot.

title: Quick Banana Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 2 bananas
instructions: Preheat oven to slice the bread into two thick slices. Wrap each slice of bread in foil. Put in the oven and turn heat to 325 degrees f. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until crisp and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,yellow cake mix,orange bell pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese,green chile pepper,clove
title: Parmesan Sesame Tea Preserves
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 orange bell pepper, roasted peeled, thinly sliced into coins | 1 green chile pepper, thinly sliced into coins | 4 whole cloves, plus more for garnish | 1 box yellow cake mix with pectin | 6 tablespoons sesame oil, or more for drizzling | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Make 1 1/2 inch deep slashes on top of each green chile pepper strip, then place them in a bowl of ice water to loosen the skins. Peel off the skins, and chop them into fine pieces. Place the pepper strips, orange bell pepper strips, green chile peppers, and cloves into a bowl. Stir in the cake mix and sesame oil until combined. Pack into paper or plastic cups. Store in the refrigerator. Heat a few tablespoons olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Quick Chocolate Glaze
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups gluten flour | 7 tablespoons chocolate syrup
instructions: Combine flour and chocolate syrup in a bowl.

title: Walnut Macaroni With Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 medium yam peeled and diced ( can use 2 small yellow squash ) | 1 medium banana pepper, chopped and seeded | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, minced | 4 -5 ounces macaroni, uncooked | chopped walnuts | soy sauce
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water until tender, but firm. Drain, keep warm on low. While macaroni is cooking, add pepper, gingerroot and vegan margarine. Meahwhile, microwave squash until tender. Drain and add, stirring, soya sauce and nuts. Stir until mixed well.

title: Quinoa and Beans on Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 pinch sugar | 0.5 package puff pastry sheets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place quinoa in a large bowl and pour enough hot water over so it just covers. Let stand 30 minutes, then drain well. Bring remaining water and bean liquid to a simmer in a skillet. Stir quinoa into water, stir in sugar, cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cut pastry sheets in half to make 24 - 1 x 2 inch rectangles. With floured hands, press rectangles out of quinoa. Arrange 1 1/2 cups bean mixture at the center of each pastry strip. Working from the short side, place 1 piece of filling in the center of each rectangle, fold the pastry over filling, and pinch the edges of the triangles together. Cut triangles into wedges for easy eating.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,sugar,white wine,kielbasa,blueberry,chicken broth,chipotle pepper
title: Blueberry Kielbasa
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless kielbasa, cubed | 1 can chicken broth | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 small chipotle pepper, minced | 12 kaffir lime leaves, torn into pieces | 5 cups fresh blueberries | 2 cups sugar
instructions: Heat a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the kielbasa in boiling water until no longer pink, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain. Arrange cooked kielbasa in the bottom of a slow cooker. Stir chicken broth, white wine, chipotle pepper, lime leaves, and blueberries in a slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low for 5 hours, then serve.

Random Ingredients: half,alfredo sauce,gruyere cheese,peanut oil,cayenne pepper,active yeast
title: Cheese Focaccia
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 cup warm half-and-half | 3 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 1 cup alfredo sauce
instructions: Place the yeast in a small bowl and sprinkle it with 1/2 cup of water. Let stand a few minutes until the yeast begins to foam, about 5 minutes. Pour the half and half into the bowl. Beat the mixture with a whisk into the yeast. When the yeast begins to foam, stir in the cheese, 1 tablespoon at a time, and stir in the cayenne pepper. Let rest 15 minutes in a warm place, at least 90 degrees f. Beat vigorously with a wooden spoon. Transfer the dough to a well oiled bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let rise at room temperature until doubled in volume, about 2 hours. Lightly grease a medium baking sheet. Punch down the dough, and divide it in half. Pat each piece into a 12x18 inch rectangle. Spread the filling on one half, cover the filling, and seal the edges with a wet fork. Place the focaccia on the prepared baking sheet. If you have any remaining filling, spread the top with it. Cover the loaf, and let rise until 1 to 1 1/2 hours have risen, about 40 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Slide the focaccia onto a clean, dry surface. Slide the pizza cutter knife around the edge of the dough. Punch the dough down. Cut the focaccia into 4 wedges. Bake in the preheated oven until the topping is golden brown and the loaf is hot, about 15 to 20 minutes. Allow the bread to cool for a few minutes before popping on a plate.

Random Ingredients: lemonade concentrate,pecan,chicken breast half,egg white,ginger paste,egg noodle,beef steak,kahlua
title: Beef Kebabs with Pecan Noodles
ingredients: 20 ounces egg noodles | 3 egg whites | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 1/4 cup lemonade concentrate, thawed ( no substitutes ) | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut lengthwise into strips | 12 pieces kebabs | 1/2 cup pecans or 1/2 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside. For the marinade, combine all the ingredients in a small bowl. Add the cooked noodles, chicken, and nuts. Arrange kebabs on skewers alternating the chicken and noodles, placing each skewer skewer on the first skewer. Grill kebabs about 5 minutes over medium hot coals, turning kebabs over and basting with the marinade mixture at least twice while cooking.

Random Ingredients: cachaca,chinese five spice powder,egg,beef tenderloin,ramen noodle,jicama,phyllo pastry,ricotta cheese
title: Phyllo Wraps (Antigoldos)
ingredients: 3 cups shredded beef tenderloin | 2 packages ramen noodles ( without flavor packets ) or ( 5 ounce ) packages oriental flavoured ramen noodles | 1 1/2 cups chinese five spice powder or 1 1/2 cups regular five spice powder | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 package frozen chopped cachaca | 1 large egg, slightly beaten | 1/2 cup miniature phyllo pastry sheets | 0.5 package jicama, julienned if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Thaw ramen noodles according to package directions. Soak frozen cachaca in hot water for 20 minutes. Drain. Cut beef into 1 inch cubes or thin slices. Heat a large non stick skillet over medium high heat for 30 seconds. Place beef, ramen, and the oriental spice powder in the skillet. Bring to a boil and then simmer, covered, for 8 minutes, or until meat is almost cooked through. Remove from heat and set aside. Remove the phyllo pastry sheets from package. Spread 1 package of phyllo on parchment paper lined baking sheets. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Top two sheets with 1/3 of the cachaca and 1/3 of the cheese mixture. Place another tortilla in the other skillet, and repeat layering with 1/3 of the cachaca, 1/3 of the cheese mixture, 1/3 of the beef, remaining phyllo, and cheese mixture. Place 3 or 4 toothpicks through the top to allow a steam to escape. Bake on tops of the oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted. Serve immediately with julienned jicama for garnish.

title: Quick and Easy Sweet Spicy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 8 bamboo shoots, with skin on | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar
instructions: Place bamboo shoots into cold water until they're thoroughly softened. This will take no longer than 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,vegetable broth,liquid smoke,baby lettuce spring green,leek,amchoor mango powder,beef rib,baking powder
title: Easy Microwaved Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 6 -7 lbs beef short ribs | 7 ounces leeks, halved lengthwise ( white part only ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 3 1/2 teaspoons amchoor ( mango powder ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 quart vegetable broth | 4 leaves baby lettuces and spring greens | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Wash and dry beef ribs. Place on absorbent paper in 2 microwave safe dishes. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper on both sides. Place dishes on a microwave safe plate and cook on high power about 8 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 135f on an instant read thermometer. Remove beef from the microwave or stand and allow to cool to room temperature under running cold water, 5 minutes more. Meanwhile, place lemon halves on a microwave safe bowl and cover with a damp kitchen towel. Microwave on high power about 1 minute or until tender. Set aside. Place lamb on a microwave safe plate and cover with moist kitchen towel. Microwave on high power about 1 minute to 90°f. Remove lamb from the microwave, remove paper towel, and spread leeks out evenly on a plate. Sprinkle with remaining coriander seeds, amchoor powder, baking powder, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt. Press meat into the lemon juice with a meat tenderizer, wet finger, or wooden spoon to make some of the lemon juice as compact as possible. Grill over high heat just to bruise the meat slightly, or until desired degree of doneness. Place the cooked lamb onto a cutting board, cut into thin slices across the grain. Arrange the cooked lamb, cut side down and cut across the grain about 1/3 inch thick. To serve, place lettuce leaves on serving plates and top with meat slices. Top with lemon wedges and drizzle with a dash of liquid smoke.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,white peppercorn,salad green,jicama,dill,cornmeal,italian bread,elbow macaroni
title: Pasta with Italian Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup white peppercorns, cracked | 2 1/2 cups italian bread, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 package jicama, peeled and cut into 3/4 inch rounds | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 8 ounces salad greens | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1/3 cup cornmeal | 1 loaf round italian bread, cut into 8 slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place peppercorns in a large, deep skillet. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 5 minutes. Remove peppercorns from the hot mixture, and crush the cracker crumbs with a meat mallet to make a coarse crumb. Place bread chunks in a bowl, mix with jicama, cans of tomatoes with green chiles, and dill, and spoon into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with cracker crumbs. Cover with plastic wrap, and bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove plastic wrap, and continue to bake 10 minutes more, or until lightly browned. Cut into slices, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,lemon extract,cooking spray,red chili,corn oil
title: Grilled Red Chili Onions
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 teaspoons red chili, minced | 3/4 teaspoon lemon extract | 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 4 large raw peeled fresh sweet corn oil or 4 large sesame seedless sun-dried tomatoes
instructions: Toast the cumin seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring, until golden brown. Using a spice mill or small coffee grinder, coarsely grind the cumin seeds. Transfer to a small bowl. Add the chili, lemon extract and about 1/2 cup warm water. Beat the mixture with a fork or a wooden spoon until smooth. Heat a nonstick skillet over high heat. Coat with cooking spray. Add corn oil or tomatoes. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes are tender and oil has been absorbed, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer the tomatoes to a serving dish.

title: Rice Noodles with Spicy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 120 g rice noodles | 150 ml double cream | 20 g peanuts | 1 dash guacamole
instructions: Place noodles in large pot of boiling water, cover with a tightly fitting lid and cook over medium heat for 8 - 10 minutes until tender. Drain in a sieve and rinse under cold water until cool. Drain noodles well in a sieve and dry with kitchen paper. Place noodles in a bowl and add cream and half the peanuts. Stir to combine. Spoon the peanut sauce over the noodles and sprinkle with remaining peanuts. Serve immediately.

title: Pasta With Capers and Linguine
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 6 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons capers, drained
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions for al dente. While the pasta is cooking, combine the sugar and capers in a small saucepan over low heat and mix with the capers and stir. Remove from heat and set the caper caper capere sauce in a separate bowl. Drain the pasta and toss the drained pasta around the sauce. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,white cabbage,chicken bouillon cube,sultana,romano cheese,white mushroom,dill pickle,hamburger
title: Crock Pot Norwegian Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 head white cabbage ( about 12-inch long ) | 1 lb hamburger | 1 lb white mushroom | 1/2 cup sultana | 1/2 cup shredded romano cheese | 1 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons hot peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 small romano cheese, chopped for topping
instructions: Quarter the cabbage lengthwise. Cut out the core so the rest can stay together. Set aside until needed. In a large bowl, mix half of the hamburger, mushrooms, sultanas, salt and pepper. Fill the center of the cabbage half full of the meat. Roll up the sides of the cabbage in the hamburger mixture. Place the cabbage seam side down in a large lightly greased crock pot. In a small bowl, mix the bouillon and water, stir well or just mix until moistened. Pour the bouillon and water over the cabbage, then top the rolls with romano cheese. Cover and cook on low for 5 - 6 hours, or on high for 1 - ½ - 2 hours. Serve hot.

title: Beetroot Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/2 pound sirloin tip roast, chopped | 1 jar pitted dates, coarsely chopped | 1 jar beets, drained and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Brown the sirloin tip and dates in a large skillet. Drain the meat, reserving the cooking liquid. Stir all of the ingredients into the meat and mix well. Shape into two 1 inch slices. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 24 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Unwrap the roll ups onto a lightly oiled rack set in a roasting pan. Bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes, turning once, until a meat thermometer registers 160 degrees f. Remove from oven and slice crosswise for a thicker roll.

title: Spaghetti with Molasses and Saffron
ingredients: 1 pound spaghetti | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 pinch saffron | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain and reserve 1/2 cup cooking water. Pour molasses into a skillet over medium heat, and stir frequently.

title: Auberge Espresso Gravy
ingredients: 1 cube vegetable broth | 1/4 teaspoon espresso powder
instructions: Place all ingredients into a coffee mug or a cup with a lid and cook 1 minute. Stir once or twice until heated through.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,lemon peel,italian sausage,heavy cream,wheat flour,poblano chile
title: Italian Smoked Sandwiches (Chiles Rellenos Con Smoker)
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 1 cup italian sausage | 1/2 cup hamburger | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1 tablespoon heavy cream | 2 teaspoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Cut a slit lengthwise in each poblano with a serrated knife so that the seeds show off what is inside. Scoop seeds from poblanos with a vegetable peeler into a bowl. Add sausage, rind and enough cream to bind. Mix flour and lemon peel in a small bowl. Spread cream mixture onto poblanos, patting the poblanos with a spatula to cover. Wrap each poblano in a piece of plastic wrap and heat in a microwave for a couple of minutes per side, being carefull when flipping. Take poblanos out and serve.

title: Broiled Red Snapper
ingredients: 4 large red snapper, each about 6 inches long | 1 medium white onion, halved and thinly sliced
instructions: Spray broiler pan with nonstick spray. Arrange snapper, skin side up, on broiler pan. Sprinkle with onion slices. Broil until well heated and beginning to turn golden.

Random Ingredients: red jalapeno chile,onion powder,scallion,self rising flour,speck,young okra pod,cabbage
title: Okra-Speck Wraps With Coriander, Red Jalapeno and Onion
ingredients: 1 lb young okra pods, washed and trimmed | 4 ounces red jalapeno chiles, washed, stemmed and slit into 1/8-inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 scallions, trimmed, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh speck, finely chopped | 1/2 cup onion power, such as sodium-reduced jalapeno seeds | 3 cups finely shredded cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place okra, jalapeno, onion power, scallions, and speck in a large bowl. Add the cabbage and toss to evenly coat. Transfer to the prepared baking sheet. Bake until okra is crisp and tender, about 15 minutes. Transfer okra to a paper towel lined plate and let stand 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer okra to a cutting board and thinly slice. Transfer to a cutting board and slice into 1/4 x 1/2 inch pieces. Return okra to baking sheet and bake until okra and all the moisture has evaporated, about 5 minutes longer. Transfer to a serving platter and serve at once with warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: vodka,yellow pepper,self rising flour,cream tartar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,white sugar
title: Italian Pepper Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup vodka, divided | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon self-rising flour | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano reggiano cheese | 2 sweet yellow peppers, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine 1/2 cup vodka, white sugar, cream of tartar, and self rising flour in a mixing bowl. Stir in parmigiano reggiano, yellow pepper, and remaining 1/2 cup vodka until well mixed. Drop cookie dough by heaping tablespoons 2 inches apart onto an unprepared cookie sheet. Flatten them with a fork. Bake in the preheated oven until slightly browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: udon noodle,spice,self rising flour,tamarind pulp,green bean,russet potato,pistachio
title: Tamarind Noodle Pakodas(Pistachio Noodle Pancakes)
ingredients: 3/4 lb green beans, halved lengthwise, tips trimmed and cut into 1-inch lengths | 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch lengths | coarse salt | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/4 cup shelled pistachios, ground
instructions: Cut 1/2 pound green beans crosswise into 1 inch wide strips on the diagonal. Cut potatoes lengthwise into 1 inch pieces. Heat 3 quarts water to boiling in large skillet over medium high heat. Add green beans and potatoes. Season with salt. Cook 10 minutes or until fork tender. Remove from heat. Drain in sink. Stir tamarind pulp in food processor with flour and mixed spice until smooth. Stir in pistachios. Spread potato mixture and green beans over 1/2 of each pancake, and roll in pistachios to make pakoras. Fry in batches over medium high heat until bottoms are golden then flip. Transfer to a serving plate and serve immediately. Variation, for an extra kick of flavor, add 1/2 to 1 tablespoon of sriracha asian spice. For a spicy pakoras, stir in 2/3 cup julienned hot sauce and 1 tablespoon sriracha asian sauce.

Random Ingredients: onion,greek yogurt,corn flake,pork loin roast,yellow bean paste,coriander powder,baby spinach,lemon juice zest
title: Bunuelos De Chata Mexicano
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yellow bean paste ( chunky paste ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, shredded | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 3 tablespoons onion, chopped | 2 lbs lean pork loin roast, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 lb baby spinach | 1 -2 tablespoon corn flakes | 1/4 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Combine chunky paste, lemon juice and zest, coriander, and onion in a bag. Add pork and marinate several hours or overnight. If you're planning on steaming, steam the meat in an open gril or pot at medium heat for about 45 minutes. Sauté spinach in a little oil and water over moderate heat until just wilted. Serve meat in chunky greens, adding cornflakes and greek yogurt.

title: Granny's Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: Combine the fennel seed and thyme in a small coffee grinder to form a fine powder. Stir in the black pepper.

title: Scotch Mustard
ingredients: 1 lb scallop | 1 lb pork sausage, halved | 1 3/4 teaspoons coarse grain white rice | 1 1/4 cups beef stock
instructions: In a small pot cover scallops and sausage with water and bring to boil.

title: Breakfast on a Bias
ingredients: 2 slices white rice | 1 slice whole wheat bread | 1/2 - 3/4 pickled jalapeno chili
instructions: Start boiling water and put in rice. Add sliced chiles on bread. When rice is done, add remaining ingredients and put on a plate. Eat and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,french bread,ginger root,riesling wine,coconut milk,dill,raspberry
title: Raspberry Riesling Bread
ingredients: 1 cup raspberry riesling wine | 2 cups coconut milk | 1/2 tablespoon ground ginger root | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup fresh raspberries
instructions: Combine raspberry riesling, coconut milk, ginger, dill, and chili powder in a microwave safe dish.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,rosemary sprig,rump steak,egg white,rice noodle,flat leaf italian parsley,halibut fillet
title: Giant Beef Risotto
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg halibut fillets | 700 g short rice noodles | 1 1/2 kg rump steak | 200 g flat leaf italian parsley coarsely chopped | 1 1/4 liters eggs white | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 5 kaffir lime leaves | 3 fresh long rosemary sprigs
instructions: The beef should be sliced very thin. Cut the meat into thin strips of equal pieces if possible. If possible, cut the strips into thin lengths of approximately 3cm/1 in size. Place the noodles in a wide pan with some fresh water and a good pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat to a simmer. Leave for about five minutes or until tender, stirring regularly to ensure that the noodles are only just cooked. Drain, and set aside. Add a little more water to the pan if necessary to make a thin stock. Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Place one keffir lime leaf into the water for each batch of noodles and boil them for about 2 minutes. The water will have been absorbed. Remove lime leaves. Place half the eggs into a separate bowl with 1 teaspoon of salt. Using a fork, beat egg whites until white peaks form. Set aside. Place remaining keffir lime leaves, parsley and the remaining egg into a food processor with 5 teaspoons salt. Add remaining salt. Cut steak into slices about 1 1/2 inches thick. Place beef slices into the egg mixture. Dip each slice of steak into the egg whites, then press into meat. Place steak onto a greased or lined oven tray. Repeat until all meat is coated. Pour remaining egg mixture over fillets, and bake, uncovered, in a pre heated oven at 220c for 20 minutes. Put rosemary sprigs into simmering broth. Cover and cook for 25 minutes. Remove rosemary branches from broth, remove and discard. Allow to boil for 10 minutes. To serve, pour hot broth into a deep serving bowl, and arrange the cooked noodles around the surface to serve.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,purple onion,thyme leaf,green bell pepper,wheat germ
title: Sweet Onion Peppers
ingredients: 4 green bell peppers | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon wheat germ | 1 tablespoon purple onion, finely diced
instructions: Set oven to broil. Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds and membrane. Brush peppers with oil.

title: Thai Tofu
ingredients: 12 ounces firm tofu, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices | 1 can creamed corn | 2 teaspoons dry rubbed sage | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon red curry paste
instructions: Combine tofu, creamed corn, sage, oil, hot sauce, maple syrup, and curry paste in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Cook tofu mixture for 5 minutes, turning. Top with sauce.

title: Cheesy Feta Soup
ingredients: 300 ml dark beer | 1 liter vegetable stock ( i think chicken stock would be especially good ) | 300 g feta cheese, crumbled | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Pour the beer into a large pot with the vegetable stock and bring to a simmer. Add in the feta and parsley and leave for 5 minutes. Serve with grated parmesan if you like.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,xanthan gum,garlic powder,pepper flake,pine nut,chili paste,herb,parsnip
title: Grilled Sweet Potato Kielbasa
ingredients: 400 -500 g sweet potatoes ( the ones weighing around 4 cups ( or your large kielbasa family likes them more ) | 1 small parsnip | 3 teaspoons chili paste ( or cayenne pepper and a couple of drops of garlic powder ) | 200 g kielbasa | 1 teaspoon thyme or 1 teaspoon rosemary | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum ( optional ) | pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Quarter, peel and dice the sweet potato into large chunks about one quarter inch x 3 inch. Boil in salted water until they can be pierced with a toothpick or fork, drain. Meanwhile, prick the kielbasa in a couple of lots with a toothpick several times then grill each side until browned. When cool enough, slice and place into freezer to speed up the freezing process. Slice and place into a cold dish to marinate. Preheat an outdoor grill to medium heat on the coals of your gas grill or medium heat on the stove top on the stove top if using charcoal. Grill the sausage to desired doneness, about 5 minutes per side for a well done sausage. Cut the kielbasa in half if it is wider than the kielbasa. Meanwhile, cut the parsnip into 3/4 inch slices. You should have about 3 cups of cooked and sliced up sweet potato. Slice the kielbasa into 5 to 6 centimeter rounds using a very sharp knife and put into a large bowl. Combine all the ingredients for the topping in a small bowl and mix well. When the sausage is finished the time to serve, drain the kielbasa and place back in the pan. Add the topping ingredients, mix well and serve with warm bread and/or vegetables.

title: Indian Spiced Yogurt Recipe (No Nuts)
ingredients: 1 cup of whole milk yogurt ( can use greek for an extra kick ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 teaspoon of fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Blend the garam masala powder and mint leaves together. Stir in your yogurt and mix well. Keep refrigerated for at least 6 hours or over night before serving. Serve over fresh vegetables. Also wonderful with indian flat bread.

title: Grilled Eggs With Sultanas and Brandy
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, each slice cut lengthwise in half, lengthwise | 2 tablespoons light corn oil | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar or 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons whole cardamom seeds, crushed or 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 2 -3 teaspoons sultanas
instructions: To serve remove the yolks with a slotted spoon and chop the egg, placing in a wide bowl of ice cold water. Drain any excess water and toss egg with a small amount of the oil. Using the back of a spoon or a slotted spoon, press the yolk mixture around the egg halves and then into the oil. Combine the remaining oil with the vinegar and cardamom seeds and drizzle over the eggs. Sprinkle with sultanas and serve. These are great made just before serving, as the eggs can dry out quickly. However, i like to serve them the weekend, or the next day for breakfast just make sure you have plenty of bread in your house.

title: Pasta and Chicken Soup With Phyllo Pastry
ingredients: 100 g chicken stock | 50 g linguine | 1 -2 tablespoon phyllo pastry
instructions: Boil chicken stock in medium saucepan until reduced. Add linguine in small pieces and cook for 2 - 3 mins, add a little water if pasta becomes too dry. Add cooked linguine and boil another 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add a little of the soup stock to thicken. Lay phyllo on countertop and cover with a damp tea towel to prevent drying off until needed. On cutting board cut through with 2 or 3 diagonal to the bottom and place 2 pieces of filo diagonally on top of the phyllo and then cut through the top layer in a further 9x12 inch square space with kitchen scissors. Repeat until filling and phyllo is used up. Place pastries into large soup pot along with another 1 - 2 tbsp of soup stock and bring to a boil for 7 - 10 mins. Remove from soup pot and cut through the scored pastries before serving.

title: Chickpeas, Cinnamon, and Barley Pudding
ingredients: 3 cups split chickpeas | 1/4 cup barley flour | 1 cup flour | 1 cup salsa | 1/8 teaspoon crushed chili ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Place 1 cup chick peas in a large bowl and cover with water. Soak overnight or for 5 hours. If using 3 cups chick peas cut off skins and rinse. Cook with barley flour, chili, and cinnamon. When done place them in a casserole or roasting pan and place them in a pre heated oven. For 60 minutes at 350 degrees. Remove from oven and stir before adding remaining ingredients. Return to oven and bake for another 30 - 45 minutes.

title: Italian Sausage and Corn
ingredients: 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 1 bunch fresh corn kernels | 3 cans light cream of chicken soup | 1 cup half and half | 1 small habanero pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir sausage in the hot skillet until evenly browned and crumbly, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir corn kernels, light cream of chicken soup, and habanero pepper into the sausage.

title: Rice Pilaf from Chiang Mai Country Cookers
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes | 1 cup brown rice | 6 ounces fresh raspberries | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 2 tablespoons finely diced banana | 1 teaspoon finely chopped jalapeno pepper
instructions: In a medium sauce pan over medium high heat, stir in tomatoes, brown rice, raspberries, chili flakes, ginger, banana, and chopped jalapenos. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 20 minutes, or until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,white mushroom,walnut,lettuce leaf,scallion,ice,dark rum
title: Mushroom Lettuce Roll
ingredients: 2 large lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup walnuts | 2/3 cup diced white mushrooms | 3 small scallions, chopped | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup light dark rum | 4 cups ice, crushed, or as needed
instructions: Cut 2 leaf lettuce into quarters. Line 2 baking sheets with aluminum foil. Cut a 1/2 across piece of heavy duty aluminum foil about 24 inches long and about 12 inches wide at ends. Place 2 walnut halves and 2 scallions in a medium bowl of ice and set aside. Place mushrooms, 2 scallions, 1/4 cup parmigiano reggiano cheese, and 2 tablespoons rum in a bowl of salted ice.

title: Red Wine Dijon
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1 cup dry red wine | 1 loaf italian bread
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Prepare a 2 quart baking dish by lining with parchment paper. Spray your loaf with nonstick coating and set aside. Whisk together 1/3 cup dry red wine and 1/4 cup wine in bowl. Cut a 5 x 4 inch length of the bread crosswise in half. Take each half cut out of its top but leaving a 1/2 inch shell of bread. Place the halves cut side down on baking sheet. Brush all surfaces of the halves with 2/3 cup wine. The wine should be about 1/4 inch deep. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes, lower oven temperature and bake 5 - 10 minutes, or until it has slightly puffed up and is golden brown.

title: Broiled Chipotle Beef
ingredients: 1/2 lb rib eye beef fat, trimmed | 1/4 lb fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 2 firm ripe chipotle chiles, roasted, seeded, and cut into 1-inch chunks ( wear rubber gloves when buying the chipolta ) | 8 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 cup brandy ( good quality )
instructions: Preheat the grill to high and oil the grate. Combine the beef fat with the broiled broiled vegetables in a medium bowl. Divide the beef generously and arrange on the broiling grate. Broil the beef until the vegetables are browned and the beef reaches an internal temperature of 140°f, about 3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the beef to warmed plates and let stand 5 minutes before slicing. Sprinkle with the cheese and drizzle with the brandy.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,granny smith apple,french bread,spaghetti noodle,clove,broccoli floret,egg substitute
title: Low Fat Spaghetti and Granny Smith Apples
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked small shell pasta | 10 ounces fresh broccoli florets | 3 cups cubed french bread | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 2 granny smith apples, peeled cored and quartered | 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti noodles | 4 whole cloves | 8 ounces low fat french bread, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat and add the broccoli. Cook and stir until the broccoli is slightly crisp on the bottom, 8 to 10 minutes. Add the bread and cook for an additional 2 minutes. Spray a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Add the bread to the hot skillet and cook until lightly toasted, stirring constantly. Remove the bread from the skillet and crumble. Layer the pasta, broccoli and bread evenly in the prepared pan. Sprinkle the apple, breaking it in large chunks into smaller pieces while it cooks. Combine the egg substitute and cloves and pour over the french bread mixture. Mix well and bake at 350 degrees f for 30 to 35 minutes covered or until the top is lightly browned around the edges. Serve and cut in wedges.

title: Oysters and Rice
ingredients: 1 can corn, drained | 1 pound fresh oysters, shelled, and minced | 1/2 cup chopped pepperoni | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried sage | cooked brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the corn in a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with the oysters, pepperoni, italian seasoning, sage, bacon and rice. Cover and bake 1 hour in the preheated oven, until rice is tender.

title: Spinach Noodles With Tamari
ingredients: 1 package cellophane noodles | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 box frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. While waiting for the water to boil, place your wok over medium heat. Place the cellophane noodles in the hot water and stir frequently until the noodles are just slightly tender. Remove noodles with tongs and place on a paper towel to absorb any excess water. Drain the noodles. Add water to the wok and bring to a boil. Add the tamari and spinach to the wok and stir to combine. Remove and discard the cooking water from the wok. Add in your drained noodles and vanilla extract and stir to combine. Allow to sit for a few minutes to allow the noodles to heat slightly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,red pepper flake,turkey,hickory smoke salt
title: My Standard Beef (Turkey) Gyros
ingredients: 2 ounces hahickory smoke salt | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 1 ounce of the hickory smoke salt with the red pepper flakes. Add the ground turkey, making sure to thoroughly mix. The turkey should be thoroughly mixed with the seasonings and seasonings. Divide and evenly distribute the mix into 4 portions and form each into a ball. Wrap in a damp towel and place in the refrigerator. Let sit for about 20 minutes. Preheat grill to high. Place an empty metal or glass baking dish underneath the drippings, so they're not directly directly directly on the grate, and place the meatballs on the grate. Oil the grill grate. Cook on high for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to low and simmer. Cook for about 35 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 170 degrees f. Remove from heat and let rest about 10 minutes.

title: Sweet-And-Sour Bar
ingredients: 6 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 5 teaspoons anise seed | 3/4 cup light corn syrup
instructions: Place all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake all ingredients well over a bowl to blend. Chill for at least 1 hour, but no longer than 8 hours. Shake well before serving.

title: Red Apple Strata
ingredients: 6 -8 red apples, peeled, cored, quartered, and thinly sliced | 3 slices loaves french bread, toasted ( thick slices )
instructions: Arrange slices of bread on a serving platter. Sprinkle thinly sliced apples evenly over bread. Spoon apples and their juices over the top and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: beef base,part mozzarella cheese,greek olive,liquid smoke,topping,almond milk,green apple,sherry wine
title: Apple-And-Cheese Skillet
ingredients: 1 tablespoon prepared liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( or dry red wine ) | 1 package frozen mixed pieces, thawed ( two 3-pound packages ) | 1 carton frozen chopped green apples, thawed, peeled if using fresh | 1/2 cup reduced-fat beef base | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, lightly toasted, if desired ( optional ) | 4 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese or 4 cups swiss cheese, divided | 3/4 cup full fat alpine low-fat milk or 3/4 cup 2 % low-fat milk
instructions: Spray a 12 nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. Add liquid smoke and sherry.

Random Ingredients: milk,pepper sauce,meatball,tomato sauce,banana,cayenne pepper sauce,flour,cayenne pepper
title: Crock Pot Smothered Meatballs
ingredients: 3 lbs frozen meatballs | 1 can tomato sauce | 20 bananas, peeled and sliced | cayenne pepper sauce ( i use tabasco ) | pepper sauce ( i use tabasco ) | salt ( to taste ) | flour ( to coat ) | cayenne pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Place frozen meatballs into crock pot. Add tomato sauce followed by sliced bananas and pepper sauce. Add cayenne pepper sauce, if desired. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or on high for 4 - 5 hours. Remove meatballs. Take meatballs out and tear apart using your hands until they are bite sized. Return to crock pot or casserole dish and coat with flour and cayenne. Cook on high again until sauce thickens. Serve with noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,dark rum,lime juice zest,chili paste,nonfat milk,paprika,whipping cream,currant
title: Acapulco Creamy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup dried currants | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1/2 tablespoon chili paste ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon lime juice, zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: For the dipping sauce, in medium bowl, stir together cheese curds and milk. Add dry ingredients. Stir in sour cream. Use immediately. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 can beet, drained | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine, melted | 4 teaspoons nonfat plain yogurt | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained
instructions: Combine first 12 ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and chill 2 hours until serving time. Can be made ahead of time and stored in refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,raspberry,teriyaki sauce,mushroom stem,garlic powder,apple
title: Garlicky Citrus Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange blossom water | 1 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste | 3 dried mushrooms stems | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce, or to taste | 1 tablespoon frozen raspberries, or to taste
instructions: Mix orange blossom water, garlic powder, dried mushrooms, and dried mushrooms in a bowl.

title: Cream Cheese in Cream Sauce (Made by an Italian Recipe)
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese ( neufchatel cheese or full fat cream cheese ) | 1/4 cup brandy ( optional but highly recommended )
instructions: Blend the cream cheese and brandy until combined. Makes one can cream cheese cream cheese sauce if you want this to be one of your cups. Pour cream cheese into a bowl. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Pineapple and Sweet Meatballs in Cream and Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 800 g sweet meat, minced ( platito, or other white meat meat ) | 400 g pineapple rings ( tin ) | 4 tablespoons cornmeal | 250 ml whipping cream ( low-fat is fine ) | 1/2 cup flaked coconut | 1/4 cup fresh mushrooms ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large pan, add half the coconut and cook the meat, using the same pan that the meat was cooked on, until the meat is brown. If using pineapple rings, use only 2 slices of pineapple and 1 slice of sweet potato to make a sandwich. If using canned pineapple, skip this step and go to step. To make sauce, cook the pineapple slices, in a pan for 2 minutes. Pour the cream over and stir until the cream starts to thicken. Add the remaining coconut and mix well. Bring to the boil. Stir in the mushroom, and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve either on top of a warm bread or alongside the meatballs and pour the sauce over.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,rum,shortening,pinto bean,pork shoulder,banana pepper,beef consomme,yam
title: Caribbean Style Sausage
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 can hot pinto beans | 1 can beef consomme | 1 can dark beer | 1 tablespoon rum | 2 yams, peeled and cubed | 1 banana pepper, sliced
instructions: Place pork shoulder in a large deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly browned. Drain pork and reserve. Increase heat to high and stir in shortening. Cook and stir beans with pork, consomme, beer and rum. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove pork from skillet and stir in yams and banana pepper. Place sausage in an ungreased 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover loosely with foil. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until yams are tender. Serve hot.

title: Scottish Sausage (Kryta)
ingredients: 1 pound ground pork butt | 2 pounds raspberries | 2 packages sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the pork butt and raspberries. Mix in the cheddar cheese. Shape dough into sausage shapes. Place on a baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly and browned.

title: Vanilla Pie
ingredients: 120 g whole wheat flour | 100 g soft bittersweet chocolate or 100 g natural chocolate | 2 hard-boiled eggs ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Grease an ovenproof dish with cooking spray. Sift dry ingredients together. Using a fork or finger, beat chocolate into dry ingredients with a fork until mixture is smooth. Add eggs beat until well combined. Spoon mixture into dish. Sprinkle with essence. Place dish in a pan of hot water and bake for 2 hours or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: sultana,thai red curry paste,dill sprig,zucchini,tart apple,mango,lime juice zest,strawberry
title: Mango Kebabs
ingredients: 450 g strawberries ( australian strawberries are very ripe ) | 450 g zucchini ( kent type ) | 450 g tart apples | 225 g mangoes ( australian strawberries are very ripe ) | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 2 teaspoons lime juice and zest of | 1 sprig fresh dill sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut 1 cup berries into pieces, cut the rest in half. Cut the zucchini in half. Peel and slice the apple into thick chunks. Slice the mango into chunks. Place all ingredients into a bowl and toss to combine. Heat a barbecue grill or chargrill to about moderately high. When the grill is ready, place all the ingredients onto the grill and grill for about 4 minutes on each side for pink colour and crisp bite. Serve with the remaining berries garnished with dill.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,phyllo pastry,spinach,wheat bread flour,chilies,graham cracker crumb,chuck roast
title: Linda's Shredded Beef and Spinach Samosas
ingredients: 1 lb chuck roast, cut into small pieces | 2 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs | 1 can chopped chilies | 2 tablespoons thawed frozen spinach | 1 jar panko breadcrumbs | 2 packages phyllo pastry sheets | additional spinach, if needed
instructions: Brown beef in a skillet with a bit of water over medium high heat. Drain on paper towels. In large bowl, mix crumbs with the chilies and spinach. Stir crumb mixture into skillet. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium. Simmer about 5 minutes, until mixture thickens. Spread 1/4 cup filling onto the phyllo sheets with the front edge. Fold up the one corner. Roll pastry and cut in half, brushing with remaining melted butter. Place in 9x13 pan. Cover with plastic wrap and frozen spinach. Cook at 375 degrees for 45 to 55 minutes, until phyllo is slightly puffed and golden and filling looks creamy. Remove from pan and let cool slightly before cutting in squares and serving.

title: Sausage with Beans
ingredients: 1 pound thick-cut sweet italian sausage meat | 1 can kidney beans, lightly drained | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 loaf italian bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place sausage in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain, and set aside. Place kidney beans and lemon juice into a medium bowl, and stir in the sausage. Cut bread into pieces, and tear into chunks. Place the pieces in the baking dish, and pour the sausage mixture evenly over the bread. Bake in the preheated oven until the topping is golden and bubbly, about 30 minutes.

title: Fish with Spices
ingredients: 1 pint green mussels, cleaned and shelled | spices
instructions: Fill a pot with water and bring to a boil. Place 1 lb. Of mussels and their liquid into the boiling water.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,corn oil,mustard seed,sharp cheddar cheese,part mozzarella cheese
title: Cheddar Cheese Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 package shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup crumbled part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 6 tablespoons corn oil, divided | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Stir the cheddar cheese and mozzarella cheese together in a bowl. Stir the bread crumbs into the cheese mixture. Spread the corn oil evenly over the mixture to coat. Dry the mustard seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat until browned. Stir in the mustard seeds.

title: Ham Filled French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf sweet bread ( with a touch of smoked ham ) | 1 cup light cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Pour some cream into a shallow pan large enough to place the bread in a single layer. Break up the bread a few times with a fork and place on top. Add pepper or salt if needed. Bake in oven for about 20 minutes, depending on how soft the bread is, until golden brown and crispy on top.

Random Ingredients: stock cube,pork,tomato paste,steak,molasses,beef broth,bay leaf powder
title: Homemade Braciole
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks, cubed | 1/4 cup molasses | 4 ounces tomato paste | 10 fluid ounces beef broth | 1 3/4 cubes stock cube | 1 tablespoon bay leaf powder
instructions: Put the sugar in a big nonstick pan and brown the flank steak. Add the molasses and tomato paste, stirring to coat the short meat with sugar. Add all the broth cubes and bay leaf. Stir to mix all the ingredients. Let the meat simmer covered over low heat for 6 to 8 minutes for medium. Transfer meat to a big container and pour sugar mixture over it, allowing some of the liquid to run through the meat. Let cool in fridge. When your ready to cook, remove meat from the fridge. Serve cold. Note, i prefer to use good quality homemade beef broth rather than the nonstick method.

Random Ingredients: red cayenne pepper,walnut,yellow squash,whipping cream,vegetable oil,glace cherry,channa dal,salad oil
title: Sesame Seeds and Golden Dried Squash Salad (Yakhshaloosha Chhaar)
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped walnuts | 1 small yellow squash, seeds removed and finely chopped | 1 stalk roasted channa dal | 1 cup cold whipping cream | 7 tablespoons salad oil | vegetable oil, for the grill | 1 pinch red cayenne pepper or 1 pinch white pepper
instructions: Toast the walnuts in a dry skillet over moderate heat, stirring, until golden. Let cool. Grind the walnuts with a food processor and a blender until the mixture is sandy. Combine with the squash. To serve, combine the cream with 2 tablespoons of the cold whipping cream and the sugar or salt and add just enough to coat. Pour over the salad and stir with a fork. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: wine,beef broth,yellow squash,rum,chicken bouillon cube,rice noodle
title: Spanish Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 2 -3 lbs yellow squash ( depending on size ) | 3 cans beef broth | 1 cup white wine or 1 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons rum ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Brown both sides of the package of noodles in a medium pot. Add all ingredients except the rice noodles. Bring to a boil and then simmer with lid slightly ajar for 1 hour. Add the rice noodles and simmer for an additional hour or until most of the water is absorbed. Add salt according to taste. Serve when served with a green salad or garlic bread enjoy.

title: The Dagwood Hotel Cuban French Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs cured, fully cured ham hocks or 1 1/4 lbs cured cured ham, any combination | 3 tablespoons salad oil | 1 1/4 fluid ounces vodka | 1 loaf french bread, halved lengthwise and toasted
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 350°f remove the hocks from the curing mixture and place on the flat tops of two broiler proof loaves. Drizzle the curing mixture into the upper halves of the loaves and place atop the hocks. Bake for 25 - 40 minutes, until they are crisp. Cool, slice and serve with cocktail rye or other chilled beverage.

title: Korean Bacon
ingredients: 500 g bacon, sliced into thin strips | 50 ml cornstarch, plus extra for dusting | 50 ml sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon anchovy, finely chopped | 125 ml corn oil | lemon peel, shredded ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine the cornstarch, sesame seeds and sugar in a large bowl. Add the anchovy, drizzle with the oil, season and mix well. Add the bacon strips to the cornstarch mixture and toss to coat. Cover and leave to sit in the fridge for 30 minutes. Preheat the grill to high. Lift the bacon onto a baking tray and bake for 10 minutes, until crisp and brown. To serve, scatter the bacon strips over a plate and drizzle with the syrup.

title: Spicy Spiced Black Beans
ingredients: 2 cans russet potatoes, drained | 14 hot fat-free pepper-flavored mushroom caps | 1 jar black beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Place potatoes in a large bowl and add remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,cream cheese,white sugar,tamarind chutney,velveeta cheese,baby spinach leaf,orzo pasta,marshmallow
title: Spinach and Chutney Appetizers
ingredients: 1 lb orzo pasta ( uncooked ) | 2 boxes velveeta cheese, cut in chunks | 2 cups diced unpeeled granny smith apples | 2 cups chopped fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 jar marshmallows | 1/4 cup white sugar | 2 cups cream cheese, room temperature | 1/2 cup tamarind chutney or 1/2 cup sriracha chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f with rack at the middle of the oven. Cook orzo per package instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Combine all ingredients in large bowl.

title: Pistachio Shortbread (No Bread Machine Needed)
ingredients: 250 g plain flour | 50 g ground pistachios
instructions: Heat oven to 180c/350°f sift flour into a bowl, add pistachios, and mix until you have a workable dough. Add a little more flour if necessary until all the dry ingredients are moistened. Knead for 5 minutes. Turn on to a lightly floured surface, and knead until you have a smooth dough. Roll the mix into a rectangle about 20cm x 10cm. Place in a well buttered loaf pan. You might not use all the dough depending on your machine, though bake for 45 - 50 minutes until very lightly browned and cooked through. Remove from the tin, slice and serve warm or cold.

title: Tomato and Mushroom Jelly
ingredients: 4 plums or 4 golden plums | 300 g white mushrooms, trimmed, washed and sliced | 1 tablespoon kirsch
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Heat a non stick ovenproof non stick frying pan over medium high heat. Add the plums and mushrooms to the pan. Cook, stirring often, for 1 minute then add the kirsch to taste. Transfer to a heatproof bowl. Leave to rest for 10 minutes or until softened. Serve with hot custard.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,chili paste,queso fresco,green mushroom,romaine lettuce,kalamata olive,corn flake
title: Beef on a Stick With Green Stuffing
ingredients: 1/2 small beef chuck roast, about 3 pounds | 3 tablespoons chili paste | 2 ounces queso fresco, crumbled | 1/3 cup sliced fresh kalamata olives | 1 teaspoon corn flakes | 3 romaine lettuce, chopped | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 ounces sliced green mushrooms
instructions: Trim the fat from the roast and discard. Cut the cross into 1/4 inch slices and rub each slice with 2 tablespoons of chili paste. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a dutch oven over medium high heat until shimmering. Brown the meat well on one side, turn, and sear on other side for a couple of minutes until dark brown. Turn, brown and repeat with the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil. Spread the cheese on the meat. Cover tightly and brown on high in the dutch oven for 5 to 6 minutes. When cheese is melted and evenly browned, add olives. Sprinkle with corn flakes. Cover tightly, turn heat to low and cook for an hour, turning the meat occasionally, until it is fork tender. Uncover, adjust salt, and cook for another hour, turning the meat twice, until it is tender. Garnish with chopped lettuce, chili paste, mushrooms, if using, and serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,hungarian paprika,chili pepper,orange juice,worcestershire sauce,sirloin tip roast,flat leaf parsley,oregano
title: Chili Beef
ingredients: 1/3 cup sweet hungarian paprika | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 2 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 8 ounces dark coconut milk, unsweetened | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 1 -2 lb boneless sirloin tip roast, trimmed of excess fat | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in a 2 quart slow cooker. Add beef.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,beef tenderloin,fine breadcrumb,new york,spanish onion,icing sugar,white truffle oil
title: Shroves of Seared New York Strip Steak
ingredients: 1 cup fine breadcrumbs, fine breadcrumbs | 8 ounces beef tenderloin, very thinly sliced ( about 3-4 ounces ) | 8 ounces new york strip steaks, very thin sliced ( we buy the whole thing, very thin, 1/4-inch thick ) | 4 teaspoons white truffle oil ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons icing sugar, sifted ( optional ) | 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | fine dry breadcrumb, for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix crumbs and 1/2 cup of breadcrumbs. Pat evenly over both sides of steak. Dump remaining crumbs on a plate, and coat both sides of steaks with crumbs with remaining crumbs. Heat 2 teaspoons of truffle oil in a shallow baking dish or roasting pan until just smoking. Pan fry steaks until golden brown on both sides, 4 - 5 minutes per side. While steaks cook, prepare onion strips. Place onion and remaining truffle oil in medium skillet. Saute about 2 minutes. Remove onion and reserve 2 tablespoons, then add onion mixture and sugar to skillet. Cook till liquid is reduced by half, about 3 minutes. Place steak on a hot platter, and sprinkle with bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,onion powder,jalapeno pepper,pork roast,cumin seed,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Garlicky Poached Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb jalapeno pepper, chopped with seeds | 1 tablespoon cumin seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 3 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated | 2 lbs salmon fillets, about 3 to 4 inches thick | 1/2 lb pork roast, boneless, skinless
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cover 1 cup of water with the jalapeno and 1/2 teaspoon of the cumin seeds with 2 tbs. Of salt. Bring to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Drain and cool, then coarsely chop the peppers and place them in a mixing bowl. Add the onion powder and cheese and set aside. Place the salmon in a dutch oven or other non stick pan large enough to accommodate both salmon fillets in a single layer and add 1 or 2 tbs. Of olive oil. Place the pan over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the salmon and cook on both sides until brown and just cooked through, about 6 minutes per side. Transfer the fish to plates. Add the pepper mixture into the pan and cook over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until peppers are tender and onion is translucent. Serve with the remaining pepper mixture on the side.

title: Guiness Mango Daiquiri
ingredients: 1/2 cup guinness stout | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 10 mangoes ( ripe mangoes prefer guiness ) | ice water
instructions: Combine ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth. If using fresh mango's, remove seeds and pith. Pour into tall glass, garnish with a mango slice or sliced cherry on top, serve immediately.

title: Tamari Rollups
ingredients: 4 tablespoons gelatin | 1/2 cup tepid tamari | 200 g ricotta cheese or 200 g cottage cheese | 4 flour tortillas
instructions: Sprinkle the gelatin over the tamari in a jug and allow to soften. Add the cheese and beat well until smooth. Spread 1 teaspoon of the tamari mixture into each tortilla and roll up. Wrap each roll with cling wrap and place on a plate. Repeat steps 7 and 8 with the remaining tortillas.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,german mustard,hibiscus,ranch fiesta dip mix
title: Bacon Wrapped Pork Tenderloin (Pork Tenderloin)
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 3/4 cup hibiscus flowers ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons prepared ranch fiesta dip mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons german mustard
instructions: Trim away most of the rind and membrane from the tenderloins. Combine the hibiscus flowers and dip mix and spread generously on the pork tenderloins. Spread the mustard on all sides of the tenderloins. Place the tenderloins on the rack in a baking pan. Bake at 325° f for 3 to 5 hours, basting occasionally with the honey from the pan when the temperature returns to 170°f. The internal temperature of the tenderloins should be 190°f. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: French Pork Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, cut 1 1/2 inch thick | 6 large plain croissants
instructions: Preheat an oven to 450 degrees f. Wrap the tenderloin in foil, and place on a wire rack in a baking dish. Cover with a sheet of aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from the oven, and set aside. Remove the plastic from the foil, and gently squeeze the tenderloins out of the skin. Cut the tenderloins into 1/2 inch thick slices. Set aside. Boil the croissants in water until they float, and drain. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange the croissants in the baking dish, and place the tenderloins on top. Cover with another sheet of aluminum foil, and place on top of the croissants. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,kosher salt,chicken tender,egg yolk,lime wedge,ruby port,beef broth
title: Grilled Turkey Kebabs
ingredients: 1 egg yolk, lightly beaten | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 cup plain dried bread crumbs | 4 cups chicken tenders | 1 1/2 cups ruby port | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 1 container greek yogurt
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together egg yolk with salt. Stir bread crumbs into egg mixture.

title: Zucchini Puree
ingredients: 2 zucchini, grated | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 3 slices prosciutto
instructions: Mix zucchini with cream of tartar in a bowl. Roll cheese into small cylinders about 2 inches long each. Place the cheese cylinders on a plate. Heat a small skillet over medium low heat. Place about 1 teaspoon of the zucchini puree in the center of each cheese cylinder. Garnish with a slice of prosciutto.

title: Collard Greens
ingredients: 1 bunch collard greens ( about 8-12 bunches ) | 1 package lipton dry onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs ( optional )
instructions: Trim green parts from stalks using a veggie peeler. Cut off and discard the tough parts of the stalks with a sharp knife. Rinse the stems and bottoms of the leaves and cut out any tough center end. Cut the greens into bite size lengths, or put in a bowl of water and let sit 20 minutes. Drain the greens and rinse under cool water until cool enough to handle and pat with paper towels to drain. Place in a large bowl or baking pan and add 2 - 3 tbsps. Water. Add the onion soup mix and herbs and toss to mix well. Add the collards and toss well. Transfer salad to a serving dish or plate and serve.

title: Award-Winning Chili
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 30 almonds, toasted and finely chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes | 4 ounces anaheim chile peppers | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | dipping sauce : | 3 tablespoons mirin | 3 tablespoons ground almonds, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Set up 1 day of party style chili starter recipe in advance. To make starter, in a large skillet over medium high heat, fry ground beef until evenly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in toasted almonds, diced tomatoes, anaheim chiles, kidney beans, and dipping sauce. Stir until hot, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Garnish with additional ground almonds to serve.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,shrimp,parmesan cheese,icing sugar,double cream,monterey jack cheese,porcini mushroom,green chili pepper
title: Chilli-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 medium green chili peppers, roasted peeled seeded peeled seeded cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 4 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese, divided | 8 large porcini mushrooms, sliced, stalks removed | 25 g shredded monterey jack cheese | 85 g grated parmesan cheese | 1 pinch onion powder | 250 ml double cream
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the chopped chili and sugar, stirring well. Spoon a little of the mixture into the base of a baking dish, allowing it to coat the base. Sprinkle evenly with 1 tbs of the parmesan, then divide the mushroom slices among the mushrooms, arranging them evenly. Sprinkle the top with the remaining parmesan and the onion powder. Beat the cream until it's just combined. Drizzle over the top of the mushrooms and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake in a medium oven about 40 minutes or until the tops are just beginning to turn light golden.

title: Greek Shrimp Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 cup cooked medium shrimp, peeled, deveined and finely minced | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Combine ingredients. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Greek Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup fat free half-and-half | 1/4 cup mint schnapps | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 1/2 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Place yogurt and half and half into the blender. Mix in remaining ingredients.

title: Roasted Teriyaki Veggies
ingredients: 1 bunch courgette | 1 green tea sprig
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees celsius/450 degrees fahrenheit. Grease an oven tray with a little bit of oil. Slice the courgettes in thin diagonal lines. Arrange on the oiled tray a little bit in a single layer. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the courgettes are cooked and starting to brown a little.

title: Bilubian Bulgur Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bulgur | 1 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1/4 cup vegetable broth
instructions: Cook bulgur according to instructions on the package. When the bulgur is about 110 degrees f, place the broth, orange zest, and vegetable broth in a blender and puree until smooth. Add liquid to bulgur and stir until absorbed. Serve topped with fresh fruit or season to taste.

Random Ingredients: sambal oelek,cilantro,green pepper,pizza crust,red bell pepper,rice wine,cardamom,corn tortilla chip
title: Sambal Onion Nachos
ingredients: 12 small corn tortilla chips | 1 can prepared pizza crust ( such as boboli ) | 1/2 cup thinly sliced green pepper | 1/2 cup thinly sliced red bell pepper | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro | 3 tablespoons rice wine ( or vermicelli or sherry ) | 3 tablespoons sambal oelek ( or your favorite hot sauce ) | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place tortilla chips on parchment paper sprayed with cooking spray and spread out in a single layer on a large cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until chips are browned and crispy, about 8 minutes. Using a spatula, transfer chips to a wire rack to cool completely, about 15 minutes. Place tortilla chips on a work surface and cover with plastic wrap. Set aside. Whisk together remaining ingredients and set aside. When oven is warm, fill each tortilla chip with half of the onion mixture and roll up. Secure with a toothpick if desired. Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet with tortilla chips on 2 baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until the top layer has browned and caramelized, about 5 to 10 minutes. Allow to cool for 5 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Torshi-Wrapped in Vodka
ingredients: 25 ounces vodka, good quality, chilled | 3 ounces dried purple onions | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon crushed black peppercorns | 1/4 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1/4 teaspoon crushed purple onion flakes | 10 -15 small dehydrated beans, cleaned and cut into 2-inch pieces ( optional )
instructions: Place onions in a small bowl, add boiling water over the onions, cover and chill in fridge until ready to serve. Onions should be completely submerged in the vingegar, but not so wet that the onions turn to mush, like a liquid after soak. If you prefer, remove skins about 3/4 of the way off the onions. Mix all the ingredients in an iron pan, making sure the oil doesn't move in any way, and place onions on the bottom of preheated heavy duty dehydrator trays. When onions become very soft, they may begin to stick to each other.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,quinoa,italian herb,green olive,lime juice
title: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad With Grilled Spring Onions
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 bunch baby bok choy, cut in half lengthwise | 2 small green olives, chopped | 1 bunch fresh italian herbs, chopped | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add quinoa and stir. Reduce heat to low and cover. Let sit for 5 minutes or until all residual water is absorbed. Meanwhile, place bok choy, olives, and herbs in a medium bowl. Toss with 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice. Transfer to a serving plate and mound greens on top of the greens. Serve warm.

title: Flounder With Tamari
ingredients: 4 flounder fillets ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 -3 drop tamari
instructions: Lightly coat a heavy large skillet with cooking spray. Place fish fillets in skillet. Sprinkle fish with tamari. Cover, reduce heat, and cook about 10 minutes or until fish is white outside and flaky in center.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,filet mignon,cooking oil,lime,vegetable stock,clam,pepper sauce,beef bouillon cube
title: Lime-Garlic Beef Soup
ingredients: 16 ounces uncooked filet mignon | 1 can cut clams, well drained | 1 can whole kernel corn, well drained | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 beef bouillon cube, crumbled | 2 tablespoons crushed lime | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 4 teaspoons crushed lime pieces ( optional )
instructions: Place filets on a plate. Combine clams and corn, and set aside. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium high heat. Add beef in batches, and cook, stirring to separate meat. When all meat is browned, add clams and corn mixture, and all remaining ingredients except lime pieces. Bring to boil.

title: Artichoke Chips
ingredients: 24 maraschino cherries | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 20 maraschino cherries
instructions: Dry cherry on paper towels. Cover with oil. Place on grill. Cook 15 minutes, turning twice. Add 4 cherry pieces. Mix fish sauce together.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,poultry seasoning,espresso coffee,apple cider,tater tot
title: Apple Tater Tot Hot Dogs (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 pound tater tots, diced | 1 tablespoon instant espresso coffee | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 onion, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Coat a medium baking sheet with cooking spray. In a medium size bowl, stir together the tater tots, espresso coffee, poultry seasoning and onion powder. Add the diced onion.

title: Thai Basil and Mint Mole
ingredients: 1 cup thai basil or 1 cup regular basil | 2 cups unsweetened strong coffee ( i used decaf ) | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Thai basil and mint have a lot of liquid in them, so i usually add about 2 tbls. Of coffee into each mug of boiling water. When water begins to boil, add the cocoa, if using. Stir. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,iceberg lettuce,broccoli,penne pasta,tarragon vinegar,cream cheese,olive
title: Broccoli and Cheese Pasta Salad
