ingredients: 1 package broccoli, cut in bite size pieces | 1 can sliced ripe olives or 1 1/2 cups fresh olives in juice, drained | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon vinegar | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 box penne pasta, rinsed | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Combine broccoli, olives, sour cream, tarragon vinegar and cracker crumbs in a large bowl. Place pasta in a large pot or dutch oven. Add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water. Remove from heat. Drain and divide into three equal portions. Mix the first portion with the pasta then divide evenly between 8 dinner plates. Top with cheese and lettuce.

title: Miso Panir With Roasted Turnips & Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons miso | 2 lbs turnips, cut into 2-inch segments or 2 lbs other firm white-skinned turnips, scrubbed | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 medium hot chili peppers or 1 hot red chili pepper, minced finely | 1 package dry shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and quartered | 4 ounces paneler cheese, drained and cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 2 - 2 1/2 ounces panir or 2 -2 1/2 ounces monterey jack cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | cooked rice
instructions: Place the miso in a small shallow dish and mix well. Add the turnips.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,hamburger bun,icing sugar,meat tenderizer,crisco,vegetarian bean,garlic paste,beef broth
title: Budget Burger
ingredients: 1/3 cup vegetarian baked beans | 1 can beef broth | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon meat tenderizer | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons icing sugar, sifted | 2 cups crispy hamburger buns | 1 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Fry your burger, then mix everything together. Enjoy.

title: Cucumber and Turnip Pasta Salad
ingredients: 300 g turnips ( kumara ) | 150 g cucumbers ( peel, cut into halves ) | 125 g penne pasta
instructions: Cook the pakottis in a pot of boiling water until tender, about 15 - 20 minutes. Drain. When cool, peel and cut into 1cm cubes. Put the veg in the microwave to make up 5 minutes, or until tender. Drain. Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling water until al dente. Drain. Add the cucumber and turnip cubes and dressing, along with 1 tbsp of drained pasta water, and toss well.

title: Fold-Over Easy Spanish Sofrito
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1 jar roasted sweet red peppers
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray 12 nonstick frying pan with nonstick cooking spray. Using kitchen tongs, remove peppers and place in hot frying pan. Add enough water to pan to measure 2 tablespoons.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,vanilla essence,spaghetti sauce,corn tortilla,tomato paste,tamari soy sauce
title: Simple Vegan Mexican Tortilla Nests
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti | 1 can tomato paste | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 2 corn tortillas | 1 dash vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 4 tablespoons crispy baked tofu, chopped into small pieces.
instructions: Boil water, cook spaghetti according to directions. Drain and spread a thin layer of sauce in a large frying pan to cover the base of your pan. Put in tortillas & spread to completely cover the base of pan. Put on lid, bring pan to a boil then turn down to simmer for 3 - 4 minutes or until tortillas are crisp & soft. Allow to cool. When done, put tomato paste & spaghetti sauce in a bowl & stir until there is no paste stuck to the bottom of the pan. Mix in corn tortillas, vanilla & tamari. Pour half over the tortillas. Cover & chill until ready to use. Sprinkle 1 tbsp dried sugar over the top & scatter with 1 tbsp grated coconut. Let nanta serve warm.

title: Cashew Nut Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 lbs spaghetti | 1 can diced tomatoes with jalapenos | 1 package roasted cashew nuts | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: Boil spaghetti to cook, drain, and set aside. Heat a skillet on medium high to high heat until hot. Pour in diced tomatoes and cashews and heat until hot, but not mushy. Remove skillet from heat, and mix in turmeric. Add cooked spaghetti and mix well. Serve warm or at room temperature.

ingredients: 2 cups broccoli | 1 can spaghetti sauce | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons green hot salsa | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | hot salsa | crusty french bread or cracker, to serve
instructions: Place the broccoli in a large saucepan with 2 - 3 inches of water. Simmer, covered, for 5 minutes, or until just tender. Place drained broccoli in a large bowl. Drain.

title: Mustard Pork (Or Baked Chicken) and Applesauce
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork shoulder or 1 lb lean ground chicken | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 4 whole bay leaves | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons paprika | 16 slices white bread, crust removed | 12 apricot jam
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Mix ground pork with mustard seeds, bay leaves, mustard seeds and paprika. Using hands, rub mixture evenly on bread slices. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush tops with jam, if desired. Bake 15 minutes, or until light brown and bubbly. Serve with applesauce.

title: Quick and Easy Fish in Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fish fat | 3 plum tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Heat the fat in a deep frying pan. Add the tomatoes. Cook over medium heat for 2 until the tomatoes are soft and the fat is starting to seperate. Serve hot.

title: Cheesy Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 1 package dry papette pasta | 2 cups half-and-half, heated | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 can mexicorn, drained | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1 yellow mustard
instructions: Cook pasta according to pkg directions.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,orange zest,farfalle pasta,rice wine vinegar
title: Farfalle With Egg (Dairy Free)
ingredients: 7 ounces farfalle pasta | 3 hard-boiled eggs | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 orange, zest of, grated
instructions: Cook farfalle in a pot of boiling salted water, uncovered till tender. Drain and place in a large bowl. Peel the eggs and dice the slices into bite sized pieces. Dice the orange zest and toss into the farfalle. Add the vinegar and stir to combine. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: catfish fillet,cream cheese,five spice powder,mint,napa cabbage,elbow macaroni,grain white rice
title: Catfish With Mizkan Noodles and Rice
ingredients: 8 ounces dry elbow macaroni | 2 catfish fillets | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 bunch basil leaves, chopped | 1 cup medium-grain white rice | 1/2 cup chopped of fresh mint | 7 ounces fresh cream cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Meanwhile, sprinkle catfish fillets with five spice powder. Place in a large, shallow skillet. Sprinkle with five spice powder. Cook over medium high heat for 2 minutes each side, or until fish is just opaque in center. Meanwhile, combine cream cheese, 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese and 1/4 cup chopped mint in a small bowl, stirring until melted and combined. To serve, place rice, basil, and 3/4 cup of water in a large pot. Cover, bring to a boil, and reduce heat. Simmer 20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat.

title: Filled Fish (Salmon) With Avgolemeno and Tahini
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 1/2 cups fish fat ( for deep frying ) or 3 1/2-4 1/2 cups solid white fish fillets ( for frying ) | 2 packages active dry yeast | 3 cups tahini ( sesame butter ) | 6 -8 cups cooked rice ( i use jasmine ) | 2 jars red salmon ( in small pouches ) | 4 scotch bonnet peppers, very finely minced ( i use habanero in my area ) | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | filling ( see recipe below ) | tahini, for garnish
instructions: If using fish fat, submerge fish in oil in a deep pan, about 4 1/2 pounds. Heat oil until nearly smoking and gently place fish in. Turn when the fish is golden brown, about 45 seconds per side. Drain on paper towels, remove skin and any scales. Keep fish warm in a 250 degrees oven. Bread dough instructions, mix 3 1/2 cups of tahini, 3/4 cup of rice and yeast in a large bowl. Beat until smooth. Stir in enough remaining stock to make a stiff dough. Cover with a towel or plastic wrap and let rest about 30 minutes. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. On a lightly floured surface, roll or stretch dough to 1 1/2 to 12 inch rope. Place on baking sheet. Let stand at room temperature about 1 hour, until it reaches the right consistency. Cut dough in half lengthwise. Cut each half into 12, 2 to 4 inch pieces. Working with one piece of dough at a time, roll out 1 piece, cut hole with 2 scissors into two 8 inch long strips or strips. Put 1 tablespoon of salt inside each piece of fish. Wrap each piece of dough around each wrapped fish. Place fish on prepared baking sheet. Let rise in a warm place, loosely covered, 2 hours, until puffy. Cooking directions, arrange fish pieces in shallow baking pans about 13/4 inch apart, not touching each other. Bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven about 30 minutes, until well cooked and browned. They bake best until they are deep golden brown and the dorsal fin can be picked off by the tip of a sharp knife. Remove from oven and arrange on a platter. Keep warm in a 250 degree f oven. Vanilla yogurt filling,. In a food processor or blender, combine salmon, 4 scotch bonnet peppers, vermouth and remaining 1 cup tahini.

title: Saffron Sugar
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white sugar | 2 pounds saffron, cracked
instructions: Heat a large saucepan over medium heat. Stir sugar and saffron in the hot sugar. Cook and stir until the sugar has melted into a brittle, grainy syrup. Continue cooking. Continue cooking and stirring until it turns tan in color, about 10 minutes. Transfer the saffron to a jar to cool. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,red capsicum,white vinegar,graham cracker crumb,marsala wine,seasoning salt,irish whiskey
title: Halibut Fingers With Marsala and Irish Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 600 g halibut fillets | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | seasoning salt | 1/2 cup coarsely crushed graham cracker crumbs | 60 ml marsala wine | 60 ml sweetened condensed milk of choice mixed with chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey ( can be bought from any alcohol free supermarket )
instructions: Put the halibut filets into a shallow, non stick tray or baking dish with the skin side down. Add the vinegar. Season with salt and bake at 220c for about 40 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the thickest part of the fillet comes out mostly clean. Turn the halibut filets from the oven, and stand them upright. When the fish is about half cooked through, put the oven on, but leave the halibut in there. Put the oven on again, and bring the liquid in the roasting tin to the boil. Meanwhile, put the rice, biscuit crumbs mixed with the marsala wine and condensed milk, into a small bowl and add the whisky. Stir the mixture until it is well combined then add it to the sauce mixture. Serve straight away, or let cool completely and transfer to the freezer to chill. Serve with the dipping sauce.

title: Gruyere and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium white cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup gruyere, cut into narrow strips | 3/4 cup half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with a silpat or parchment paper. Place cabbage slices on lined baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until the crust is golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes. Set aside in a large bowl. Mix gruyere together in a small mixing bowl. Stir half and half into gruyere and pour into cabbage mixture. Stir and toss until thoroughly mixed. Place cabbage strips on baking sheet and place on top of cheese mixture, then bake until hot and bubbling, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Curried Nuts
ingredients: fresh cranberries, about 2 1/4 lbs | 12 curry leaves ( optional )
instructions: If your curry leaves are dried, add about 6 tablespoons water to the curry leaves. Place the dried leaves in a small skillet and cover with 3 tablespoons of water, just to cover and bring water to a boil. Cook over low heat until tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat, drain in a colander and pat dry. Cool, then stir into cooked dal or pak chana. Store tightly covered at room temperature.

title: Quick and Easy Sweet Potato Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup bacon, diced | 1 cup yellow turnip, diced | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1 medium green chilies or 1 medium red pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 pillsbury pie shells | 1 -2 teaspoon sour cream, to taste
instructions: In large skillet, sauté bacon add turnips until tender. Then add squash and sauté until tender. Chop chilies and add to turnip mixture. Add cream and combine and mix. Add sour cream. Cook on low, stirring often until all mixture is slightly thickened, approximately 5 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Rice Wine Shortening
ingredients: 1 cup shortening ( like crisco ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Heat shortening in a medium skillet over medium high heat. Stir in rice wine. Boil for 1 minute, stirring continuously. Remove from heat. Pour into paper cupcake liners lined with paper liners. Cool completely. Remove paper liners.

title: Auberge Riggies
ingredients: 150 g rigatoni pasta | 150 g water chestnuts, trimmed | 250 g natural yoghurt | 300 g rocket or 300 g rocket | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves, warmed
instructions: Cook rigatoni in boiling water for 8 minutes, or until just tender. Drain, then place in a large bowl. Place the water chestnuts and yoghurt in a bowl, then stir in the rigatoni. Spoon the riggies into bowls on serving plates and drizzle on over warm apricot preserves.

Random Ingredients: pork butt,farfalle pasta,bean sprout,spaghettini,icing sugar,salad oil,broccoli floret
title: Tender Pork and Bean Nests
ingredients: 2 lbs pork butt | 14 ounces beans sprouts | 1 ounce dried farfalle pasta | 1 ounce dried salted mixed sprouts | 8 ounces small bowtie pasta | 4 tablespoons salad oil | 2 tablespoons icing sugar
instructions: Cut pork rind into 2 x 1 inch strips. Place in non reactive roasting pan with beansprouts in single layer and cover with warm water. Bring to boil and simmer for 1 hour. Remove from heat. Drain and rinse pork with cold water and dry with towel. Remove any excess fat, gristle. Return pork to roasting pan and add sprouts and farfalle pasta. Cover roasting pan on low heat and leave for 25 minutes then add salted mixed sprouts. Cover with simmering hot water and leave for 5 more minutes. Divide pork mixture among egg roll wraps and drizzle liberally with salad oil. Sprinkle liberally with icing sugar and bake in 425f oven for 20 minutes or until golden. Meanwhile, cook the bowtie pasta according to package directions. Drain and toss with salad oil. Spoon noodles onto a serving plate and top with pork mixture and sprouts. Note, this goes for other pasta like cannellini, zucchini, spinach or macaroni.

Random Ingredients: ale,cream cheese,peanut oil,port wine,bamboo skewer,white onion,fish stock
title: Prawns With Ale and White Onions
ingredients: 300 g king prawns, peeled and deveined with tails left on | 150 g oyster stock | 150 ml good beer ( not buds but beer, the brand name will be just right ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 75 g white onions, peeled and thinly sliced | 120 g pickled beurre manis liqueur or 120 g ale | 100 g cream cheese | peanut oil ( for frying )
instructions: Combine prawns with the beer and stock in a large mixing bowl. Soak for 30 minutes. Heat a little peanut oil in a frying pan over a medium to high heat. Add onions and sauté until soft, adding a little more oil if needed. Set aside and keep warm. Heat a little peanut oil in a skillet over a medium to high heat, add the prawns and brown them quickly on each side. Place the prawns on warmed plate and cover with a plate. Add a little more oil to pan and sauté the onions until tender or brown. Arrange the prawns onto four soup plates and pour the onions over them. Top with a tablespoon or two of amarillo.

title: Spinach and Citrus Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh baby spinach, washed, stemmed | 5 cups iceberg lettuce, washed and cut into small pieces | 1/4 lb very fresh double-triple sec | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, preferably fresh
instructions: Place 1 1/2 cups fresh baby lettuces in a large salad bowl. Toss the spinach with the remaining ingredients. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Cardamom Maple Glazed Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 chicken fillet | 3/4 cup maple syrup or 3/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a nonstick frying pan. Cover and cook for approximately 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and glazes slightly and the maple syrupy mixture is well mixed with the chicken.

title: Kielbasa and Kielbasa on Crock Pot
ingredients: 8 links kielbasa, cut into 2 inch lengths | cooking spray
instructions: Trim meat of excess fat and cut into 2 inch lengths. Spray a slow cooker with cooking spray. Arrange 4 keielbasa lengthwise through edges of 3 pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil. Cut ends to create an open space. Add 5 - 6 slices of kielbasa to each foil section. Cover with remaining foil. If using casserole, pour enough water into the slow cooker to reach 1 1/2 inches above kielbasa. Cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours. Remove foil. Serve immediately.

title: Lentil Baked With Spicy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces brown lentils | 1 1/2 cups broth | 2 cups bread machine yeast | 6 scallions, chopped | 1 cup maraschino cherry, cut in halves
instructions: Place all ingredients into bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Set to dough setting. After the roll out, place onto a greased baking sheet, cover with a towel, and allow to rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Divide dough into 14 equal pieces and place them on baking sheet. Cover with a towel and allow to rise. Bake at 425 degrees for 25 minutes, or until dough is lightly browned. Remove from baking sheet and serve hot with dipping sauce.

title: Apple Soup - Dutch Apple Soup
ingredients: 1 quart vegetable stock | 1 small tart apple
instructions: Put the stock in a large, heavy saucepan. Slice the apple and drop it into the stock. Cover and simmer very slowly for 30 minutes or until it is very tender and the apple is translucent. Serve. This soup may be kept, covered for 2 days in the refrigerator, although it must become thicker with time. Soup may have reheated but will continue to thicken as it cools.

title: K-Jon's Savory Sate Coasted With Smoked Beef Ribs
ingredients: 8 beef short loin roast | 2 cups apricot nectar | 2 pounds beef short ribs | 18 ladyfingers | 1 head cabbage, cored and sliced ( optional ) | 1 can guava nectar
instructions: Slice the short ribs into 3 inch long pieces and set aside. Combine apricot nectar and beef short ribs in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Place a cover on the pan, turn the heat down to low, cover and simmer until the meat is tender and easy to handle, about 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Line a large bamboo grill with foil and line it with the ladyfingers. Remove short ribs from the grill and cut into 3 inch long pieces. Wrap a slice of the short ribs around each ladyfinger and wrap a few pieces of the short ribs around the ladyfingers. Place stuffed ladyfingers onto the foil in a steamer and steam them for 20 to 30 minutes until slightly crispy on the outside.

title: Pasteli
ingredients: 1/2 cup semolina flour | 1/2 cup cake flour, sifted before measuring | 2 tablespoons rosemary, finely chopped | 2 small pears, peeled, cored and quartered | 1 small green bell pepper, cored and seeded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Mix the semolina, cake flour and rosemary thoroughly in a bowl. Remove from the oven. Remove the cover and bake until pears are soft, another hour or more. Remove the pears and set aside to cool slightly. Serve warm or cool completely and store in an airtight container.

title: Vietnamese Aussie Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup curry powder
instructions: Place lettuce on a large serving plate and toss with curry. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,jumbo shrimp,lime zest,bow tie pasta,balsamic vinegar,egg substitute,cranberry juice concentrate,yellow onion
title: Bow Tie Pasta with Shrimp and Cranberry Relish

title: Sausage & Vegetable Pies

instructions: Brown sausage meat& drain. Add taco seasoning and vegetable stock. Mix well. Roll out your pastry and cut out 4 squares. Add to your base of greased muffin tins. Bake until golden. Serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Chambord Raspberry Sauce

title: Easy Low Calorie Fish Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 large red cabbage | 1 small red cabbage | 1 package low sodium chicken bouillon cubes | 1 -2 scallion, chopped | 2 tablespoons vanilla extract ( or other flavor ) ( optional ) | 1 can diced salmon ( or any kind of seafood ) | 1 teaspoon ground cloves ( optional ) | 1 dash cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Cut the base from the red cabbage. Remove the rind and slice the green cabbage lengthwise. Remove the white parts of the scallions when soft as possible. Take about 3/4 of each section and place 1/2 of the chopped cabbage around the base of the core. Mix all ingredients together and leave about 1 inch around the edge. Roll the cabbage up into a tight ball and put on a plate to rest until needed. Place the rest of the cabbage on top, and roll the ball so the cabbage will be cooked evenly. In a large frying pan, spray a tablespoon of olive oil and heat over med high. Roll the cabbage into thin cigar shaped leaves. Cook the cabbage rolls in the pan until cooked thoroughly and they have the crispness they liked. Add enough water to the frying pan to cover the bottom. This is ok if some of the water evaporates during cooking process. If you need to add more, add water so that it covers the cabbage. Drain and serve with low fat yogurt or sour cream for dipping. Enjoy.

title: Chipotle Cream
ingredients: 4 chipotle chiles | 1 1/2 cups double cream
instructions: Cut the stems off the chipots and slit them open vertically with a knife. The slit should be 1/2 inch from the tip of the chile. Wearing rubber gloves, place the chiles on a plate, cut side down. Cover and chill in the refrigerator until ready to make the cream, about 5 minutes. Heat a heavy bottom saucepan over low heat until hot. Using a mortar and pestle or a rubber spatula, mash the chiles into a paste with the cream. When the cream starts to thicken, increase the heat to medium. When the cream begins to boil, add the chopped chiles and mix to coat. Reduce heat to low.

title: Orange Juice for Swedish Fish or Steak

instructions: Mix well. Pour into a glass bottle or jar with tight fitting lid. Seal and refridgerate for 3 days or longer. You can store this in the freezer for up to a month. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,vanilla ice cream,cooking sherry,apple,horseradish,matzo meal

instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Butter a 9 inch loose bottomed cake pan. Combine the matzo meal, 1 1/2 cups of sherry, apples, horseradish, and 1 1/2 cups of cheese in a large bowl. Whisk in the remaining 1/3 cup of sherry and set aside. Spread the tortilla wedges evenly in the prepared cake pan.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,spring onion,cod,italian parsley,sesame oil,pork shoulder,broccoli stem

instructions: Cut pork into 1cm cubes. Heat sesame oil in a heavy pan. Add broccoli & pork and toss for 3 - 4 minutes or until browned. Remove from heat and add sesame oil. Combine remaining ingredients and toss through pork and broccoli mixture. Serve on italian rolls.

instructions: Soak bread in water for 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly and heat for 1 hour. Serve with croutons.

instructions: Squeeze lemon wedge from bag into serving bowl. Melt cream cheese in large bowl of electric mixer on high speed. When creamy, gradually add spinach. Add torn cabbages and stir. Reduce speed to very low, add salt and lemon to taste. Mix. Serve on lettuce leaf with crackers and salad.

instructions: In a small saucepan heat refried beans with 3/4 cup water until warm, stir in fajita seasoning and corn niblets. On 4 slices, spread a heaping tablespoon of tortilla with fajita mixture.

title: Pounded Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder | 1 pork loin chops | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1/2 cup vinegar, white wine
instructions: Rinse pork and chops. Place in large skillet, add enough water to cover.

title: Mango Ice Cream

instructions: Line an 8 ounce pie tin or cake tin with foil. Place mango slices on the foil, skin side down. Whip egg yolks, and use to fold over the rest of the mango slices. Pour the yolk mixture over the top of the mango. Bake at 180c for 1 hour. Turn oven down to 160c.

instructions: Place the salmon and curry paste in a ceramic casserole dish with 2 cups of water. Peel and finely chop the shallot and put into the water. Cover the casserole with plastic wrap and leave for 3 to 4 hours or leave in the fridge 24 hours take the salmon and place in an ice cube tray. Using a fork remove the salmon from the marinade and dip it into the cornflakes. Place fish on the cornflakes and put back into the fridge.

title: Beef Satay
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 pound beef tenderloin, thinly sliced
instructions: Whisk soy sauce and mirin together in a large resealable bag. Add the beef.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,tomato green chilies,cream,tempura batter frying mix,glutinous rice,fajita seasoning,green chili,italian salad dressing mix
title: Italian Rice Wedges

instructions: Heat oven to in 11 x 7 inch baking dish spread chilled rice evenly. Top with green chilies. Sprinkle evenly with fajita seasoning packet. Serve with salad dressing or as desired.

instructions: Preferably a large bowl. Sift the flour, cumin powder, aniseed, and fennel seeds and then add sugar and combine. Knead and form into a dough. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes. instructions: Mix all ingredients in bread machine. Bake on french bread machine or white bread setting. Makes app 10 to 12 servings. Enjoy.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread cornmeal in a 2 quart baking dish. Whisk cornmeal, pesto sauce, malt vinegar, 1/4 cup liquid smoke, and ancho chiles in a bowl.

instructions: Cook ziti in large pot of rapidly boiling, salted water until just tender but firm to bite. Drain. Return pasta to pan. Stir in celery slices. Sprinkle cashews over top.

title: Cauliflower, Mustard, and Sausage Skewers

instructions: Put the cauliflower into a bowl, pour boiling water over it, and let sit until softened, at least 15 minutes. Drain, and squeeze out excess water to remove the excess liquid. title: Pistachio and Beef Jerky - V2pk
ingredients: 1 package beef stew meat, trimmed of fat and cut into 8 squares ( v8 ) | 4 cups ground almonds or 4 cups pistachios, grated | 2 large heads belgian endive, cored and cut into large pieces, with greens attached | 2 teaspoons finely chopped coriander | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 1 -2 cup fine sea salt | 10 ounces mixed fresh chopped vegetables ( such as baby carrots, broccoli, celery, pearl onion )
instructions: For jerky, process all ingredients in a food processor until very finely ground, stopping to scrape down sides with a rubber spatula occasionally. Store in tightly covered container at room temperature for up to six weeks.

title: Cashew Lettuce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil | 2 -3 lettuce leaves, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon roasted cashews, chopped
instructions: Combine soup, tomatoes and cashews and mix well. Spoon mixture into a lettuce leaf and roll up. Serve immediately or refrigerate for several hours. Garnish with extra cashews, if desired.

title: Roasted Sesame Cabbage With Poblano Chile
ingredients: 2 heads red cabbage, cut into 2 inch-pieces | 1 large poblano chile, seeded, trimmed, seeded, and cut into 1 inch strips | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Remove and coarse green outer leaves from cabbage, if desired. Set cabbage aside. Pierce cabbage stem end on all sides with fork. Place cabbage in a dutch oven, or other large, heavy skillet. Pour water to cover. Add poblanos. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium low. Simmer until cabbage is very soft, about 2 1/2 hours. Remove lid, increase heat to high, and boil until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes. Stir frequently during cooking to prevent scorching. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Drain cabbage, then place in a serving bowl and pour dressing over. Garnish with poblano chile strips.

title: Pico de Gallo
ingredients: 3 cups water ( or more ) | 1 cup oil for frying | 1/2 cup pico de gallo, pico de gallo paste ( pico de gallo is available at many mexican grocery stores and some supermarkets )
instructions: Heat the water in a saucepan to boiling. Meanwhile, in a shallow bowl, mix the oil, pico de gallo and hot water. Pour the oil mixture into the boiling water. Stir in the green chilies, adjust seasoning, cover the pot and lower the heat. Simmer for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,yellow cornmeal,red chile,dark rum,almond,margarita mix
title: Homemade Rum-Glazed Cornmeal
ingredients: 3 cups yellow cornmeal ( also known as `` cornmeal '' ) | 1/2 cup margarita mix | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/3 cup ground almonds | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 6 -8 whole red chiles, halved | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, for garnish
instructions: Combine cornmeal, margarita mixes, rum and ground almonds in large bowl. Sprinkle mustard powder on top. Add chiles and toss evenly. Turn into greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish or 1 11x 7 1/2 inch baking sheet. Dot with whole almonds. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, or until center is firm with top slightly wiggly and lightly browned.

title: Italian Herb Seasoning Mix for Lamb or Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning ( mccormick recommended ) | 1 tablespoon lemon zest ( grated fresh lemon peel )
instructions: Coat meat or poultry with herb seasoning. Place on wire rack and sprinkle with lemon zest. Store in airtight container.

title: Mini French Bites
ingredients: 3 packages cream cheese, softened | 1 baguette ( round, unsliced ) | 1/2 bunch green onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Line a muffin tin with a silicone baking mat or a piece of parchment paper. Cut the baguette into 1/2 inch cubes. Place the cream cheese in a medium size mixing bowl. Cut green onions into 1 inch lengths. Add nutmeg. Pour the cream cheese mixture into the prepared baking mat or the parchment paper. Stir gently until well combined. Bake for 12 minutes or until bubbly around the edges. Allow to cool completely. Cut in half and scoop out the centers of half the cookies. Allow to cool on a plate. Serve with your favorite garnishes.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,yeast,streaky bacon,plum tomato,chicken breast half,wheat berry,dark chocolate,picante sauce
title: Mexican Chocolate Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/8 cups whole wheat berries, picked over and washed | 2 1/4 cups plum tomatoes, chopped | 6 ounces smoked streaky bacon, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh yeast | 3 -4 poblano chiles, roasted, skinned and chopped | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 jar picante sauce | 12 ounces dark bittersweet chocolate, chopped ( for garnish ) | 3 ounces picante sauce ( for garnish )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 7 cups of boiling water. Place the berries, tomatoes, bacon, chiles, and chicken in the bowl and add 5 cups of water and 2 tablespoons of water to cover. Cover and let stand in a warm place for 2 hours or until the chicken is cooked through. Place the remaining 1 1/3 cups of water in a large pot and add the yeast. Cook, stirring as needed, until the mixture begins to foam and is smooth. Remove from the heat. Scoop some of the warm mixture into a large bowl. Dry the chicken breasts and reserve. Drain the chicken, reserving the liquid. In a small bowl, combine the remaining cup of broth with the remaining 5 cups of water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Add 1/2 cup of chocolate. Cut the reserved chicken breasts into 4 pieces and set aside. In an ovenproof 12 skillet or casserole dish, layer the chicken, pork or ham, and 1/4 of the chocolate sauce. Cover with the rest of the chocolate sauce and remaining toppings. Bake, covered, in a 375°f oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake until sauce is bubbling around the edges.

Random Ingredients: salmon,glaze,golden delicious apple,broad bean,tea,sherry wine vinegar,head cauliflower,tortilla
title: Sherry Vinegar and Smoked Salmon Wraps
ingredients: 500 g smoked salmon, skin removed and cut into 2cm chunks | 1 medium head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 golden delicious apple, peeled, cored and cut into cubes | 200 g frozen broad beans, thawed | 150 ml tea | 40 g light golden delicious apple liqueur or 40 g sherry wine vinegar | 25 g smooth smooth cheese and herb-flavored jam or 25 g similar creamy cheese | 1 tortilla, torn
instructions: Mix all the ingredients, except for the jam, together in a large bowl. For each wrap, divide the ingredients between 4 wraps, wrapping each completely and scoring the edges using a sharp knife. Serve at once. Variation, place a small bun of cooked salmon on a wrap then add a small handful of smoked salmon, and roll it up and secure with a toothpick.

title: Minty and Coriander-Minty Rub
ingredients: 1/2 bunch coriander, leaves picked from stems and washed | 1/2 bunch mint leaves, washed
instructions: Mix well, making sure you have a fine blend all the ingredients. Rub on your favourite foods. Store in an airtight container.

title: Texas Steak
ingredients: 2 pounds cube steak | 1 can or bottle favorite picante sauce | 1/2 white onion, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place steaks into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour enough picante sauce over to cover completely. Sprinkle onion and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes, or to desired doneness. Remove steaks to a serving platter, cover loosely, and keep warm. Place remaining picante sauce and white onion in a saucepan.

title: Tripe Quinoa Braid #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb tripe, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 1/2 tablespoons raspberries | 1 tablespoon capers | 24 ounces quinoa | 1 tablespoon pie pastry dough ( phyllo dough ) | 4 ounces frozen raspberries
instructions: Place the tripe in a pot with just enough water to cover it. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes. Meanwhile, place a pot of cold water on heat. Add the raspberries and capers. Boil until berries are tender and skins begin to peel off, about 5 - 7 minutes. Remove the tripe from the pot and set aside. Bring the 2 quarts of water to a boil over medium heat. Add the tripe, raspberries and phyllo dough. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. When done, remove from heat and let cool for a few minutes. Cut diagonally in half at the center of each half, then cut the halves in half diagonally on the diagonal.

title: Root Beer and Corn
ingredients: 1 lb fresh corn, shucked | 1/2 cup scallion, chopped | 1/2 cup root beer, any brand | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Shred corn and set aside. Cut scallions into thin rings. Heat oven to 375°f. Grease a baking sheet. Place corn and scallions on baking sheet, forming 1/2 inch thick rounds to resemble casseroles. Top with root beer. Dot with margarine or canola oil. Place under oven on middle rack. Bake until corn is tender and lightly browned, about 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Southern Style Roast Lamb
ingredients: 3 lbs whole leg of lamb | salt and black pepper
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300f degrees. Lightly grease a large roasting tin or dutch oven. Season the lamb and rub with salt and pepper. Bake 20 minutes, then turn down heat to 300f degrees and continue roasting for 3 hours. When done, slice and serve at once.

title: Irish Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 medium leek ( white and pale green parts only, finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons rum | 1/2 cup double cream ( or milk if you like ) | icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Rinse and dry quinoa. Place in a medium sized pan with a lid and add cold water. Bring to the boil over a high heat and reduce the heat to a simmer. Meanwhile, chop the leek and place in a large salad bowl. Add the capers, sugar, rum and cream and mix until well combined. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground white pepper. Pour dressing over the quinoa and toss to combine. Garnish salad with icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,pork belly,quinoa,greek feta cheese,glutinous rice,stewing chicken
title: Ww 4 Points - Stretching Fried Chicken & Pork
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely diced stewing chicken | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro | 1/2 lb boneless pork belly | 1 tablespoon rice | 1/4 cup quinoa | 1/4 cup greek feta cheese
instructions: Slice the breast and legs of the pork belly into thin slices. Chop the cilantro and then coarsely. Rinse and drain the pork. Dice the pork into thin half moon slices. Heat a non stick pan over high heat until a bead of water dropped into it sizzles immediately. Add meat, then rice, then quinoa. It only takes a few seconds to start popping. Toss the mixture quickly in the pan, then toss the peanut residue over the chicken and pork slices. Serve with salad greens.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,white wine vinegar,mustard green,water chestnut,sauce,bread
title: Danish Greens Bread Salad
ingredients: 3 cups self rising flour | 20 cups boiling water ( about ) | 20 cups mustard greens ( leaves, preferably wild or red ) | 6 ounces cooked crispbread | 1 -2 tablespoon hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained ( optional )
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients together in a large bowl. Cut the slices of bread into quarters and place on top of the dry ingredients. Use 2 - 3 tablespoons of hot sauce for extra flavor and to add flavor. Toss to combine. Sprinkle with green or red hot sauce if desired. If the greens are very large, you can cut them in half or thirds to fit the desired size. Toss to mix. Place 1 - 2 tbsp of mixture onto each piece of bread, roll and slice the bread about 1/4 inch thick. Place salad on plates and serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: pecan,monosodium glutamate,monterey jack cheese,spaghetti,american cheese,salt,sea bass fillet
title: Sea Bass and Cheese Burritos
ingredients: 2 lbs sea bass fillets ( skinless ) | 1 tablespoon monosodium glutamate, monosodium glutamate ( optional or to taste ) | 1/2 cup finely shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup finely shredded cheddar or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/2 lb white american cheese, sliced small and divided | 1/2 cup chopped pecans or 1/2 cup walnuts | salt, kosher powder
instructions: Heat up the monosodium glutamate. In a small bowl, combine salt, pepper and monosodium glutamate. Sprinkle both sides of both sides of the fillets with monosodium glutamate mixture. Place fillets in a dish and coat each side with monosodium glutamate mixture. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Coat a 9x13 inch or 13x9 inch baking dish with a coating of extra virgin olive oil. Cover tightly with foil and set aside. Unwrap the cheese from the block of american cheese and cut it into 1/2 inch cubes. Cut the white american cheese slices up by placing them on a plate or in a large bowl of cold water to prevent the cheese from breaking. Then drain the water from cheese and cut it into small bits. Coat a sauté pan with olive oil then place over medium high heat for a few minutes after the oil is warm add 1/2 cup of chopped pecans or walnuts and toast them until they start to darken a bit. Take out and allow to cool for a few minutes, stirring continuously. Heat up the white american cheese slices up until the slices have turned a nice golden brown color. Spread the white american cheese pieces evenly over the base of the baking dish. Lay the fillets down on the white American cheese slices with some of the browned white american cheese on top. Add the rest of the chopped, chopped pecans or walnuts on top of the fillets. Cover the baking dish with foil. Place in a 350°f oven and allow to bake for 30 - 45 minutes. Remove the oven and add a sprinkle of the monosodium glutamate to the top of the whole baking dish. Let sit for 10 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: baking chocolate,white flour,crab boil,cumin seed,white corn,lemon juice
title: Corn and Crab Cakes
ingredients: 1 cup white corn | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 2/3 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon baking chocolate | 1 1/3 cups crab boil | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add corn and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Easy Veggie Toss (Lazy Vegetables -- Veggies
ingredients: 5 cups fresh green beans, ends trimmed, cut 1-inch pieces ( i cut the larger ones in half ) | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon thinly sliced eggplant | 1/2 lb fresh broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Cook green beans and eggplant slices on non stick pan sprayed with cooking spray on medium heat until lightly browned. Serve over hot cooked rice or at room temperature. You can also mix them together in a salad bowl to make a meal with lettuce, mustard greens and tomatoes.

title: Croustades
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 12 mussels
instructions: Place all ingredients into a pan and simmer for 15 minutes. Roll the fillets in crumpled mussel meat to coat them and serve at once. Enjoy.

title: Apple and Cabbage Bake
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg courgettes, cut into thick wedges | 1 large tart apple, peeled, cut into bite-sized hunks | 1 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken stock | 350 g fresh lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c or 400f degrees. Grease a 8 cup capacity ovenproof dish and put it in the oven, to warm, for 10 minutes. Tip the courgettes, apple and vinegar into a large roasting tin and toss to coat. Add enough stock to just cover. Cover with foil and cook in the oven for 45 minutes. Cook the lasagne for 6 minutes by placing them in a pan of boiling water and immediately removing them from the heat. Drain the hot pasta and add it to the base of the oven. Increase the oven temperature to 200c, 375f or gas mark 6 and bake for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, bring 2 cups of hot water to the boil and stir in the salt. Drain the pasta and toss with the courgette and apple. Spoon the vegetables into a large warm bowl and serve in individual bowls with croutons and parsnips.

Random Ingredients: sage,green cardamom pod,curry paste,artichoke heart,mayonnaise,mustard powder,coffee,cranberry
title: Curried Artichokes
ingredients: 4 artichoke hearts | 1/3 cup low-fat mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard powder | 2 teaspoons curry paste | 1/8 teaspoon rubbed sage | 1 green cardamom pod | 2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except cranberries, and stir well. Place artichokes in a baking dish or pita. Sprinkle with cilantro. Bake at 375 degrees f. For 10 minutes.

title: Marsala Glaze
ingredients: 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon marsala
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a saucepan and heat gently. Pour into a small cup and set aside.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,five spice powder,lemon gelatin
title: Easy Citrus Dessert
ingredients: 1 packet five-spice powder | 1 lemon gelatin ( or similar ) | 1 fresh lemon, juice and zest of, grated
instructions: Sprinkle the 5 spice powder over the gelatine and mix well. Stir in the lemon zest and juice. Chill and use as desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken,vegan margarine,dark soy sauce,apricot jam,cooking oil,thyme
title: Dry & Gluten Free Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, cut into 8 pieces | 2 tablespoons vegan margarine | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 cup apricot jam | dark soy sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Heat oil and margarine in wok over medium high heat. Add chicken and brown on all sides. Stir in thyme.

title: Chicken and Macaroni Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour tortillas, whole grain not corn tortillas | 1 cup shredded cooked chicken | 1 cup of uncooked macaroni
instructions: Fry tortillas in butter or cooking oil until crisp and golden brown. Combine shredded chicken and half of the cooked macaroni. Top hot tortillas with the remaining ingredients and fold to mix. Serve with salsa or guacamole.

title: Spinach Ale
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried spinach leaves, packed in water ( reserve a few leaves ) | 1/4 small onion, finely chopped | kalamata olives ( optional ) or pimento stuffed olive, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chocolate chips ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f and put parchment or waxed paper in a roasting pan, so it just covers the pan. Mix oil and wine together in a small pot. On low heat, cook the spinach, onion and olives until they look wilted, stirring often. Remove from heat and stir in the chocolate chips. Spoon mixture into prepared pan and spread out evenly, or pat dry with paper towels. Cover the pan and bake until it has puffed up and is beginning to caramelize about 15 to 25 minutes. Let cool completely and cut into squares.

title: Grisons Bread Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb pitted prune | 1 teaspoon savory | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Mince prunes with savory and vinegar. Cut in 4 sections and thread onto skewers. Grill on hot grill for 10 minutes, turn and cook 10 minutes longer or until golden brown and prunes are tender.

title: Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 500 g cabbage ( coleslaw ) | 100 g cashews | 100 g crushed peanuts | 3 -4 stalks lemongrass ( optional ) | 1/2 cup caster sugar ( superfine ) | 25 -35 g low-fat cheddar soup | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( diced tomatoes with tomato and other green chili peppers ), drained
instructions: Remove leaves from cabbage, slice thinly and blanch in boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes, drain and allow to cool. Wash cabbage leaves and chill thoroughly, drain nuts and mix together with cabbage, cashew nuts, crushed peanuts and lemongrass. Make the dressing by mixing all ingredients into the cabbage mixture, then chill until required.

title: Tofu and Rice Vinegar Pilaf Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package soft tofu | 2 tablespoons seasoned rice vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 14 pita breads
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare the tofu, in a large baking dish, arrange tofu in an even layer. Drizzle with rice vinegar. Sprinkle with cinnamon and drizzle with water. Bake in the preheated oven until the tofu is bubbly and the edges brown, 40 to 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white rice,tempura shrimp,white onion,red curry paste,cannellini bean
title: Easy, Simple Seafood Red Curry White Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 small white onion, chopped | 2 -4 tablespoons red curry paste, depending on how spicy your dish is | 1 frozen cooked tempura shrimp, thawed and patted dry
instructions: Cook white rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, cook your other vegetables as directed. Add drained cannellini beans to pan after rice is finished cooking. If you are using frozen shrimp, add to pan. Remove from heat and stir in curry paste.

title: Mexican Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 cup beef broth | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup skim milk | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/3 cup light soymilk | 1 package taco sauce
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine broth, catsup, skim milk, thyme, cardamom, and soy milk. Bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in taco sauce, and cook 5 minutes or until hot.

title: Pan Bag
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder | 2 pieces bibb lettuce
instructions: The day before, remove the meat and ask the butcher to do it for you. Open his bag. Rinse the bag with cold water then squeeze out the contents. Place the bag in your refrigerator. Day one, take your butcher to the table. Using two pieces of meat in a bag, remove the air pockets and the strings on the outside of the bag. Place them in a steamer or an appropriate sized pan. Bring the bag to room temperature on the top of the stove. Place the pan on the stove and turn it on all the while making sure both sides are covered with steam. The bag should be on low medium heat when you lift the bag. Place in the refrigerator. When you're ready to serve, remove the bag.

title: Artichoke and Chicken Penne
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless beef chuck, cut into 2 inch cubes | 3 cups chicken thigh, cut into chunks | 3 teaspoons garlic salt | 14 canned artichoke | 7 ounces chocolate | 7 pounds penne, cooked
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm. Drain well. In a large bowl, mix together the meat, garlic salt, artichoke hearts and chocolate. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Strain the marinade into a saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil until reduced by half and pour over the pasta. Mix well.

title: Toasted Oat Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 lb oat ( plain or in a large bag ) | 1/2 lb pine nuts
instructions: First, soak the oat in water in a small pot for approximately three hours. Take it out of the water and then mix the oats and pine nuts together. Using your hands, make small balls of the mixture and roll them in the oats. Allow to stand for five to six minutes, then roll the oat balls in the nuts and serve.

title: Icing for Snowed Sweetcorn
ingredients: 2 cups icing sugar | 1 1/2 cups cornstarch | 2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: Stir the icing sugar, cornstarch, and baking soda in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,cake flour,celery leaf,nutmeg,cashew nut,oxtail,sherry wine,white rice
title: Oxtail Soup (Oxtail Stew)
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice | 3 -4 lbs oxtails | 3 1/2 quarts hot red wine ( rieslings ) | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup salad greens or 1/2 cup roasted cashews, chopped | 8 tablespoons cake flour | 3 teaspoons celery leaves
instructions: Place oxtails in a large pot and cook over high heat, adding hot red wine and cover pot. Bring to a boil, and then reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Skim fat off top. Remove bones. Remove bones and any meat remaining in pot, reserve stock. Skim fat from soup, discard. In a large bowl, with a wooden spoon, mix together flour, celery leaves, nutmeg and salt. Dredge the oxtails in the mixture, shaking off any excess. Brown oxtails in the soup, then add to soup and stir. Add the reserved cooking wine and sherry. Cover and simmer 2 - 3 hours, stirring occasionally, or until meat is fork tender. Add cashews during last 15 minutes of cooking. Serve with cooked or poached yam, rice, or fried potatoes on the side.

title: Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 750 ml tomato juice ( from canned tomato or fresh tomatoes, pureed ) | 250 g cheese spread | 300 ml olive, halved | 1/4 cup olive, sliced ( or sliced pimento stuffed olives )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan over medium heat. Stirring occasionally.

title: Mexican Chicken and Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large boneless chicken breasts, cut into 3/4 inch pieces | 1 lb dried pinto bean, soak overnight | 1 large vidalia onion, cut into wedges | 8 ounces asparagus, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 lb turnip, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 bunch lettuce, washed and separated | 1 tablespoon shallot, chopped
instructions: Fill a large dutch oven 3/4 full with cold water and bring to a boil. Add chicken pieces and let simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove the chicken and drain the bones. Add water to cover the chicken. Add the beans, onion, asparagus, turnip, lettuce and shallots to the pot. Boil, covered, for 1 hour until the vegetables are tender crisp. Uncover and let cook for 10 minutes more. Sprinkle with cheese before serving.

title: Spiced Yoghurt with the Famous Pepperoni and Almonds (Curri Ka Halva)
ingredients: 250 ml soymilk | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chat masala | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice ( kaorma ) | pepperoni ( optional ) | 1/2 cup currants ( optional ) | almonds ( or peanuts, to garnish )
instructions: In a blender or food processor combine the yoghurt, spices, pepperoni and currants. Process until well mixed then chill for a minimum of 5 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,rotel tomato,fennel seed,curry powder,tuna steak,pistachio,cooking oil
title: Spicy Tuna Wraps-Coco-Papas
ingredients: 12 ounces tuna steaks | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 14 ounces rotel tomatoes ( hot tomatoes or tomato and chili tomatoes ) | 8 -10 mint leaves | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons sweet curry powder | 12 -16 lettuce leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pistachios ( optional ) or 1/2 cup almonds ( optional )
instructions: Cut steak very fine. Heat oil in small frying pan. Put in the tuna cut side down and turn over quickly. Fry quickly until cooked.

Random Ingredients: potato,bulk italian sausage,miracle whip,tzatziki,quinoa,golden raisin,white raisin
title: Italian Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup cooked quinoa | 2 tablespoons miracle whip | 1/2 cup chopped white raisins | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 pound bulk italian sausage | 1 cup diced potato | 1/2 cup chopped black greek yogurt or greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Coat a rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine quinoa with miracle whip, raisins, and golden raisins. Crumble sausage into skillet. Add quinoa mixture, potatoes, and greek yogurt. Mix until evenly mixed. Drop batter by 1/2 tablespoonfuls onto lined baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,wheat germ,heavy whipping cream,chicken bouillon,spanish onion,beef eye
title: Spanish Style Eye Roulades
ingredients: 2 slices spanish onions | 1 1/2 lbs smoked beef eye round ( sliced thin ) | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon wheat germ | 1/2 head lettuce, rinsed, dried well, and torn into large bite-sized pieces
instructions: In a nonstick skillet over medium high heat, saute the onion in 1 teaspoon of the butter, pressing the onions against the side of the pan, until pale golden, about 3 minutes. Transfer the onion to a plate. Place the beef in the skillet and brown on all sides, 4 to 4 minutes total. Pour off any excess fat. Stir in the cream and add the bouillon and remaining tablespoon of butter. Cook until the cream comes to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Add a small handful of the lettuce and stir gently to coat. Cook until the lettuce is wilted, about 2 more minutes. Remove from the heat and let stand until slightly cooled.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,beef roast,crepe,turmeric,green bell pepper,red curry paste,white,mushroom
title: Beef Crepes With Curry and Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 small crepes | 1 1/2 cups cooked beef roast, chopped | 1/2 cup sliced fresh mushrooms | 1/2 cup sliced green bell pepper | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 10 teaspoons prepared yellow curry powder
instructions: Combine the beef, mushrooms, green bell pepper, marinara sauce, red curry paste, and turmeric in a bowl. Coat the crepes with the curry paste and place on a sheet pan covered with waxed paper. Cook in a preheated oven at 375°f until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Serve with the curry mixture.

Random Ingredients: ginger,red food coloring,sauce,green curry paste,yellow pea,cream mushroom soup,lettuce leaf
title: Quick and Easy Green Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups yellow split peas | 1 small bunch of fresh green curry paste | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 teaspoon bottled hot sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger | 4 medium lettuce leaves ( optional ) | red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Place peas in saucepan and cover with water to 3 inches above peas in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart saucepan. Bring to boiling.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,brown lentil,frangelico,pea,lima bean,panko breadcrumb
title: Beef & Lentil Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1 cup dried split peas | 1/2 cup french dressing ( or mayo, see note ) | 1 can lima beans or ( 16 ounce ) can green beans | 1/2 cup frangelico ( or mayo mayo )
instructions: Trim excess fat from beef. Combine panko and bread crumbs. Toss beef cubes and split peas in panko. Place beef cubes and split peas in a 2 quart casserole dish. Pour french dressing over beef and peas.

title: Italian Meat Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 4 teaspoons italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 teaspoons garlic cloves, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dry vermouth
instructions: Pound all ingredients together with a mortar and pestle. Store refrigerated for up to 1 year. Use to season roast slices and roast ribs after grilling, or other use as a tenderizer for grilling, broiling or baking.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,kaffir lime leaf,curry powder,green chile pepper,pork,tabasco sauce,baby portabella mushroom
title: Spicy Pork Salad
ingredients: 1 small green chile pepper - seeded and diced | 3 baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 pound ground pork | 3 small leaves lettuce | 1/2 cup finely shredded lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Place green chili pepper, mushrooms, and tobasco sauce into a food processor, pulse a few times to mix, add curry powder and pulse. Add pork and pulse until well mixed. Tear 1/2 bundle of lettuce and place on a serving dish.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,coconut sugar,fennel,beef gravy
title: Quick Beef Curry
ingredients: 1 lb beef gravy | 3/4 cup coconut sugar | 3/4 cup fennel | 1/2 hot red chili pepper, crushed
instructions: Combine ingredients and set aside for 1 hour. Boil until mixture thickens. Serve over fresh bread, or stir fried carrots, celery, potatoes, or noodles.

title: Chinese Style Easy Tomato Oil
ingredients: 4 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 2 cans tomato sauce
instructions: On a baking tray, combine the peppercorns and 1 cup of water. Smear the mixture on the tray to evenly disperse it. Cook in a preheated oven at 325 degrees f for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes to cool slightly as the peppercorns can cause bacteria to form. In a blender or mortar, combine the remaining 1 cup of water and the tomato sauce. Blend until the tomato mixture is smooth and thick. Pour over cooked pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,potato flour,mustard powder,amaretto,grape,curry powder
title: Potato Flour Dumplings
ingredients: 1 lb cooked potato flour | 1/4 cup mustard powder | 3/4 cup thai sweet curry powder ( or any other curry powder ) | 6 tablespoons amaretto ( or other almond-flavored liqueur ) | 1/8 cup curry powder ( or any other curry powder ) | 1/2 - 1 cup seedless grapes or 1/2-1 cup crimson grapes
instructions: Add all ingredients to a bowl except grapes. Mix well. Divide into 12 balls.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,pepperoncini pepper,za'atar spice mix
title: Za'atar Peppers
ingredients: 1 package za'atar frozen peppers and onions | 1 can green enchilada sauce, heated | 2 tablespoons dried hot pepperoncini peppers ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with foil. Mix remaining ingredients together. Spread a layer of mixture over the baking dish. Cover with foil. Bake in 325°f oven for about 1 hour. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

title: Crunchy Bacon Stuffing
ingredients: 1/4 lb bacon grease or 1/4 lb margarine | 1 1/2 cups fresh breadcrumbs
instructions: Brown in skillet. Drain off fat. Stir in bread crumbs. Add 2 tbsp warm water if necessary to make mixture moist and not hard. Let cool slightly, then spoon into baking dish. Sprinkle lightly with bacon crumbles or other bacon bits. Bake at 300f for 15 minutes, then remove from oven. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white flour,oatmeal,cashew,red pepper,lime zest,bell pepper,lime juice
title: Sweet Chilli Pies
ingredients: 100 g ground cashews | 150 g white flour | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper | 1/4 teaspoon lime juice ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried lime zest ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons grated lime zest ( to taste ) | 2 bell peppers ( sweet orange or red ) | 3 tablespoons rolled oats ( or as i like pepitas )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients. Refrigerate until firm. Shape into walnut sized patties, place in fridge until required. Heat a little oil in a frying pan. Fry each patty in batches for 2 mins on each side, remove and place on a wire rack to cool. Repeat with remaining patty and oil. I usually keep the pan on a low heat so i add the rolls a few at a time. Once i have put the patties in to a plastic bag, i remove the bag and tip out a little of the oil, then i fry the patties in batches in the oil as you fry them until nicely browned and crispy. These will take about 10 minutes, depending on your grill or ovens. As always, keep an eye on them. If they brown too quickly, place them in a plastic bag and store in the fridge to prevent burning. Once your cooked, remove from the bag and place on a paper towel covered plate to dry. You want to be as close to room temp as possible, while the temperature goes. Use a large plate such as a cookie sheet as a non stick one that goes in the oven on a slow heat. If you have a stove top grill such as my unit, remove it when your ready to add the patties. Keep doing this until you have put everything together and put everything in the oven on a medium. Keep on keeping turning the patties, as the oven does the trick. Add the sweet chilli's to the pan that the patties were cooked in and keep frying on a very slow heat until they are lightly golden, about 10 mins each side.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,fennel bulb,white onion,chocolate,salt pork,chicken bouillon granule,milk,vanilla ice cream
title: Chef Julian's Chocolate Pate
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin or 2 lbs top round roast | 1 jar sweet white onions, undrained ( vidalia onions or spanish onions work best ) | 3/4 cup milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt pork ( i use seasoned salt ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon vanilla ice cream, crushed | 1 fennel bulb, with fronds ( remove stems if they appear dried, they can be bruised with a mortar and pestle ) | 12 ounces bittersweet chocolate ( optional, i don't know about the size ) or 12 ounces semisweet chocolate ( optional, i don't know about the size ), chopped | 1/4 teaspoon salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Cut up the pork into 1 1/2 inch cubes. If you plan on using a blender, place the cubed meat in a bowl. Place the milk and onion in a saucepan and bring to a simmer. Combine the salt pork with the bouillon granules and vanilla. Dip each cube of meat first into the seasoned milk mix, submerge the pork in the milk, then allow to sit for 20 - 30 minutes. Place the pan in an oven set at 300 degrees f. Cook for 1 1/2 2 hours or till meat is tender and the cubes look nice and brown. While roast is cooking, chop fennel bulb. When the pork is almost done, cut the strips into pieces and put them in a food processor with 1/4 1/2 inch of water. Blend until a smooth paste is formed. To make pate, melt chocolate or semisweet chocolate, if using. When meat is almost done, add the chocolate and cook until creamy, about 5 minutes longer. Add in the fennel fronds and blend. This should take about 5 minutes to cook and thicken the sauce. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,chicken wing,broccoli floret,yellow bell pepper,sugar strawberry jam
title: Sweet & Tangy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 cups fresh broccoli florets, chopped | 1/2 yellow bell peppers or 1/2 orange bell pepper ( red if you can find it ) | 1/3 cup powdered sugar-free strawberry jam | 4 lbs chicken wings
instructions: In a deep skillet with a lid, cook broccoli, peppers and jam in cream soup over medium heat until thick, about 10 minutes. Put mixture in a large crock pot. Add the chicken wings and stir. Cover and simmer for about an hour. Uncover, stir, and serve.

title: Pancetta With Ginger & Ginger.  (The Bahamas)
ingredients: 12 ounces pancetta or 12 ounces bacon, rind removed, cut into 1/8 inch wide cubes | pancetta or bacon fat
instructions: Fry chopped pancetta or bacon in fat in a skillet.

title: Maurice's Spanish Green Peppers
ingredients: 36 large green peppers
instructions: Wash and dry the peppers. Wash out a large sink and put the peppers inside a saucepan of boiling water. Boil the water to boiling point, lower heat to simmer and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, until the skins of the peppers look very clean. Remove the peppers and carefully remove all the skin. Place the peppers inside a colander, or a towel for a minute or two to drain. Let drain for 5 minutes. Remove the skins again and either place the skins in a jar away from direct heat or put them in the refrigerator. The peppers can be frozen, or simply put them into a rigid freezer bag, with a tight seal, add the oil and then place in the fridge. The oil will separate from the oil, so be careful.

title: Gruyere Cheese With Brown Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely grated gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons packed light brown sugar
instructions: Combine the sugar and the cheese in a small, heavy skillet or pot. Cook over low heat, stirring, until the cheese is melted. Add a handful of the hot cheese and stir well. Repeat with the rest of the hot cheese, stirring constantly to blend. When all the cheese is melted, spread the mixture out on a serving platter or platter and sprinkle the cheese with the browned brown sugar.

title: Steamed Green Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs large green beans, stems trimmed | 1 bottle `` honey '' thousand island dressing ( `` louisiana honey '' )
instructions: Steam beans for 5 to 7 minutes. Rinse in cool water. Remove all strings and slice about 2 1/2 inch pieces. To steam beans, run a knife around the knife blade of the knife and gently loosen each piece of cooked green beans.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,quinoa,yellow bell pepper,tilapia fillet,half cream,walnut,apple cider
title: Faux Phad Thai
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half cream | 2 kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dried quinoa, rinsed | 1 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 1/2 cup chopped applesauce packed sweetened with cilantro ( optional ) | 4 tilapia fillets | 1/3 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat grill. In a medium bowl mix half and half and kaffir lime leaves.

title: Diane's Smoked Beef Burgers
ingredients: 500 g smoked roast beef | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 200 g prunes ( dried weight-poices ) | 150 g cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon pepper | 100 g mushrooms
instructions: Preheat your grill with a medium high heat and put it on to medium heat. Slice your roast beef into burgers and coat with a small amount of tomato puree. When the grill becomes hot again, place the meat on the grill and cook on both sides. Once your cooked meat is cooked, spread the cottage cheese on the cooked meat, and place the mushrooms on top of that. Place a large saucer on top of the cheese, and place both the burger under it and the mushroom on top. Once the cheese is melted and the top griller has reached the required temperature, place it back under the grill. Once the top griller has reached required temperature, close the lid and let the inside of the grill become slightly crispy, and golden brown to your liking. Cut as required.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,italian turkey sausage,red chili,oregano
title: Italian Turkey Sausage and Beef Tenderloin Steaks
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin steaks | 2 italian turkey sausage | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped red chili
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high using indirect method. On a sheet of foil place the sausages. Sprinkle with oregano, chiles and roast under grill on low for 15 - 20 minutes or until thermometer reads 160 degrees. Allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with remaining sauce.

title: Ww    Fried  French Fries
ingredients: 6 pieces tortillas, whole wheat ( or toasted if possible ) | 2 -3 tablespoons sweet peas ( can use canned or frozen )
instructions: Wrap the entire piece of baggies in aluminum foil with the ends of the baggie being 2 inches long. Pour a little oil over them and let them dry out for 20 - 30 minutes in the fridge. Wrap the baggies in the foil, twisting the foil slightly to hold on the food inside. Cook on medium heat until they are all brown and very crisp approx 5 - 6 minutes on the first side and about 6 minutes on the second side.. Keep turning the baggies, as they get crisp add a little water a tablespoon at a time if they get dry, drain off any excess juice. Sprinkle with frozen peas..

title: Peach and Shrimp Calzones
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza dough, at room temperature | 1/2 lb bacon, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 pint sliced peaches | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 1 can refrigerated pizza dough, at room temperature | 2 cloves garlic, peeled | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f grease a large baking sheet. Lay the pizza dough flat on a cutting board.

title: Crock Pot Spaghetti and Fudge
ingredients: 15 ounces spaghetti sauce, hunts ( meat or chicken flavour ) | 10 ounces corn kernels ( canned or frozen ) | 2 cups nuts ( optional ) | 1 cup cool whip ( light or fat free )
instructions: Place sauce and corn in crock pot and set in low for 7 - 8 hours. Before serving stir in nuts. Remove corn from crockpot, put in medium size, shallow bowl and sprinkle with cool whip. Top with fresh fruit if desired and enjoy.

title: Cheese Tart With Orange Zest
ingredients: 1 cup fontina cheese, cut into cubes | 1 cup roma tomato, diced | 1/2 cup fresh dates, diced ( or red dates ) | 1 large egg yolk, beaten | 1 small orange, zest of
instructions: Combine cheeses, tomatoes, dates, and zest in a medium bowl and mix thoroughly. Using a fork, beat egg white until stiff peaks form. Gently add egg yolk to cheese mixture and blend well. Spoon mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a 3/4 inch rimless round tip. Pipe mixture into tart shells and freeze until firm about 20 minutes. Remove tart from freezer about 10 minutes prior to serving.

Random Ingredients: peach,orange juice zest,venison,vanilla sugar,picante sauce,parsnip,graham cracker crumb,black bean
title: Holiday Venison and Black Bean Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs venison, chuck or 1 1/2-2 lbs other lean roast | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs or 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 large prickly pear | 1 medium parsnip | 1/4 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 12 ounces black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice, fresh squeezed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cube meat to a chunky size and place in bowl with crust, and set aside. Use 1/2 the cracker crumbs or graham cracker crumbs to coat and lightly dust venison. Set aside. Peel and wash prickly pear and parsnip and cut into a large dice. Place into food processor or chopper and pulse until small, not exact. Add 1/4 cup orange juice and process to a chunky consistency. Place into large bowl. Drain and rinse black beans and add to bowl. In food processor or chopper add 1/2 cup of picante sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, and about 1/2 cup of the orange juice to bowl of black beans and stir until well combined. Add to bowl and set aside. Taste meat and adjust seasoning. Spread black bean mixture in the bottom of a 10 inch pie dish. Place cubed venison over black bean mixture. Layer with the rest of the crumb mixture and top with cranberries or sprinkles. Place in oven and bake until browned, about 35 minutes. Note, if your meat is not very juicy, you may use a meat tenderiser such as the villaware brand or the vegetable peeler and chop the meat finely before slicing to a chunk size consistency. You don't want to saturate the meat with the juice of the fruit. If you're on the latter, use a small piece of aluminum foil to wrap around it. This allows for easy handling and will be excellent either way. If you make a lot of meat out of mixture you may need to bake it a bit longer depending on whether you make a good chunk or if there is any excess, or whether you want to slice it longer. Let pie cool slightly then slice.

title: Papaya Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens, quartered | 1 cinnamon stick | 1 jar mild ale with papaya | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 papaya, peeled, seeded and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange chicken pieces skin side up in a small baking dish. Place cinnamon stick in a piece of cheesecloth or paper bag fitted with the tip of a knife. Dip chicken pieces into ale a few at a time, letting excess drip back into dish, then arrange the chicken pieces skin side down in baking dish, skin side down. Combine the papaya, yogurt and 1/2 the cinnamon in a small bowl, and spread over chicken. Add remaining cinnamon stick to garnish.

Random Ingredients: tomato,caster sugar,breadcrumb,yoghurt,black pepper,white wine vinegar,taco seasoning mix,horseradish
title: Honey Mustard Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon horseradish, rind of | 1/4 cup tomato, flesh removed from shell, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 125 g breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon hot black pepper, crushed | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup yoghurt or 1/4 cup low-fat yoghurt
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a small blender and blend briefly. Sauce should have the texture of a thick tomato sauce. Spoon a portion of sauce into a small dish. Dip the bowl in cold water and cover with another portion of the sauce, and repeat until all the sauce is used. This takes about 15 minutes to achieve. If you are using plain yoghurt, mix into the dipping sauce until smooth. Serve immediately. It can be made ahead and frozen for up to two months. Reheat when needed.

title: Mexican Hot Apricot Jam for Ham
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces dried apricot jam | 2 fluid ounces sweet chili oil ( recommended -- heinz chili oil ) | 1 lime, juice of | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat a small saucepan or heavy frypan over a low heat until the water is just a small amount of the jam at a time. Pour the jam into the pan and stir with a wooden spoon until jam is completely dissolved and jam has heated through. Pour in the chili oil, stirring until warmed through. Squeeze the juice of the lime into the jam/chili oil and season to taste with salt and pepper. The chili oil will keep warm in a dark oven for about 5 minutes on the very lowest heat, or up to 2 hours on the lowest. To serve, remove the chili oil from the heat and place the ham ham on a warmed serving dish.

title: Chef Flower's Baked Basmati and Pecans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, rinsed | 12 anchovies, drained | 1 cup turbinado sugar | 4 tablespoons grated pecans | 1 tablespoon ground lemon pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarsely ground anchovies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f grease a 2 quart baking dish with butter or oil. In a bowl, combine the rice and anchovies and toss to coat with the mixture. In a saucepan, mix the sugar, pecans, lemon pepper and anchovies. Bring to a boil, stirring to dissolve the sugar. Cook over low heat until thickened. Pour over rice mixture in the baking dish and bake, uncovered, for 50 minutes or until golden and bubbly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,grain white rice,cilantro,basil leaf,french bread,beef stew meat
title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 can white mushrooms, drained | 3/4 cup cooked long-grain white rice | 1 1/2 pounds cubed beef stew meat | 12 fresh basil leaves | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro | 3 cups toasted french bread, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix mushrooms, rice, beef, basil, and cilantro together in a bowl. Form mushroom mixture into 1 inch balls. Arrange mushrooms on a baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until heated through, about 20 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Morel & Apple Cakes
ingredients: 500 g morels | 150 g sweet potatoes ( not super-sweet ) | 100 g pitted dried apricots | 600 g grated tart apples
instructions: Boil the morels, then drain. Dice the sweet potatoes, apricots, and apples. Mash them together. Mix the mashed potatoes with the morels, apples, apricots, apples, and sweet potatoes until well combined. If not too dry, add water a tablespoon at a time, just to get everything wet. Form into small patty shapes, about the size of an egg. Heat a small frying pan, adding a little oil. Fry the cakes at once, until nicely browned, about 2 to 3 minutes per side.

title: Tortilla Shrimp Casserole
ingredients: 8 medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 package fresh spinach leaves | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1/4 teaspoon thyme leaves | 6 tortillas
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray 11x7 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Place shrimp in dish, and evenly sprinkle with spinach, cinnamon, pumpkin pie spice and thyme. Bake 30 minutes. Meanwhile, wrap tortillas in foil and warm in the oven for 5 minutes. Remove from oven, and cut into pieces. Spoon shrimp over the top of the casserole, and return to the oven for 5 to 10 minutes or until shrimp are tender. Serve with sour cream, guacamole, or salsa.

title: Hibachi Barbecued Shrimp(Camarao Wa Lahina)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw large shrimp ( shelled if desired ) | 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 lb shrimp ( shelled if desired ) | 4 cloves garlic, finely minced | 2 teaspoons finely chopped red chili | 2/3 cup good cognac | 2/3 cup soy milk
instructions: Toss all ingredients except cognac and cover with plastic wrap or plastic wrap. Refrigerate for an hour to marinate. Drain marinade from meat and add to marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or preferably overnight. Remove from marinade and grill over hot coals or bbq. Cook for about 10 minutes or until shrimp turns pink. Serve with rice and refried beans and rice. Enjoy.

title: Aarti-Style Seaweed With Tuna and Green Onions
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs unpeeled medium soft-shelled tuna | 2 bunches green onions, 2 large, each cut in 2 inch lengths | 1 can corn kernels, drained | 1/4 cup grated lemon zest
instructions: Cut tuna lengthwise into 6 equal pieces. Using a 6 nonstick frypan, toss tuna to coat with the zest and green onions. Add the corn.

title: Spicy Ginger Fish
ingredients: 12 ounces tilapia fillets | 1 inch fresh gingerroot, peeled and very thinly slivered
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Arrange fish on cookie sheet. Arrange ginger slices on top. Drizzle fish with remaining marinade. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until fish flakes easily with fork.

title: Potato and Bacon Tart
