ingredients: 4 baking potatoes | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place potatoes on a baking sheet and bake until tender, 50 to 55 minutes. Cool slightly and peel. Place in a large bowl and mash with a potato masher. Stir in thyme, poblano chiles and cheese. Mix well. Transfer to a serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Mutton and Apple Casserole
ingredients: 1 kg mutton, cut into cubes | 2 -3 tart apples, grated ( approx. 1 1/2 cups ) | 3 apples, peeled and cored | 3 tablespoons chicken or 3 tablespoons vegetable stock, more if needed | 2 teaspoons ground cumin ( or to taste ) | 3/4 cup apple cider or 3/4 cup beer | 2 cups fresh low-fat chicken broth or 2 cups canned low-fat beef broth
instructions: Boil water in a large pan and add in the cumin and salt. Add in the shredded mutton and apples and cook until cooked through but not coloured, drain the liquid out of the meat. Set aside. Place the meat and apple cider into a large saucepan and stir in enough of the reserved meat stock to cover. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer gently for about 30 minutes stirring frequently. Season to taste. Add the chicken or beef stock if the mixture has its consomme/stock and stir in once more. If required the stock will be slightly reduced to a thick puree. Serve over cooked rice, and with boiled new potatoes or your favourite side as an accompaniment to a meat lunch. Alternatively place the cooked meat and apple cider over cooked pasta of your choice and top with fried onions and chopped roasted chutney/sausages.

title: Chicken Breast Fillets
ingredients: 6 -8 boneless chicken breasts | 250 g cheese, coarsely grated | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 box of chocolates | 2 medium dried beet ( peeled and sliced )
instructions: Wash the chicken and pat dry with paper towel. Cut the chicken in half. Mix all the dry ingredients together and rub over the chicken. Let sit for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 180 deg celsius. Spread the chocolates on the chicken and bake at 180 degrees for 30 minutes. If the slices become brown, bake for 15 minutes longer. Take pan out of oven and place in a plate as soon as chicken is removed from oven. Take the pan out of the oven. Add the can of sliced beet to the chicken. Spread the grated cheese over top and return to oven until cheese is melted. Serve with pasta or salads for a complete meal.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,skewer,kosher salt black pepper,red wine,double cream,beef tenderloin,tuna steak,zucchini
title: Beef Tenderloin With Red Wine-Crusted Tuna
ingredients: 4 tablespoons red wine | 4 tablespoons double cream | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 10 slices smoked beef tenderloin ( about 1/8-inch thick ) | 10 eggs yolks | skewered zucchini | red wine | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: To make the gremolata, place the zucchini on a paper towel lined plate. Using the paper towel, rub it lightly to remove excess moisture. Let stand 20 minutes. Wipe the zucchini slightly with a damp paper towel, and slice into long 3 inch strips. Set aside. Preheat the grill to high heat. In a shallow dish, whisk the cream with the salt. Add the beef and turn to coat. Place the beef onto the skewers, arranging them on the grill. Using a slotted metal spatula, transfer the beef to the grill with the zucchini. Cook for 2 minutes per side for medium rare. Remove from the grill and let rest 3 minutes, loosely tenting with foil. Cook the eggs over low heat in a small, heavy saucepan over high heat, stirring constantly until they are just set. Carefully remove the pan from the heat. Carefully transfer the eggs to a plate and set aside. Serve the tuna on four warmed plates with the zucchini on the side. Drizzle 2 teaspoons of red wine over each serving, and pass the gremolata at the table.

title: Spicy Tofu Ball
ingredients: 4 slices firm tofu | 1/2 package firm tofu, crumbled | 12 stalks chopped lemongrass, 3-4 inches long, 4-8 inches long, 2. 5 inches in diameter | 1/2 large green bell pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste ( optional ) | 1 -2 jalapeno, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup toasted pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: Lay out the block of tofu on top of a cutting board. Use the flat side of a plate or the rounded side of a glass until all tofu is used. Sprinkle the lemongrass over it. Starting on the flat side of the piece of tofu, roll up the bundle tightly and place in a large mixing bowl. Dip your fingers in warm water, then in your favorite non flavored oil, and then spread a generous coating of flour onto the tofu. Peel off the plastic and press out any extra moisture as you go along. Cut the long side of the tofu from the short side off of the piece of tofu. Place the tofu in the bowl with the lemongrass. Toss in the diced bell pepper, anchovy paste if using, jalapeños, and chopped pecans. The mixture should not be entirely smooth because the tofu is thick and sticky like you would tomato sauce. Serve with your favorite condiments like dipping sauce.

title: Tiger's Nests
ingredients: 1 cup sweetened flaked coconut | 1 cup shredded lettuce | 1 cup diced sweetened meat | 1/4 cup dry roasted pistachios | avocado, cut into wedges | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/3 cup fish sauce | 2 tablespoons tapioca
instructions: Toast coconut in skillet over medium high heat, stirring constantly until lightly browned. Remove from skillet, and set aside. Toast lettuce in same skillet over medium high heat, stirring constantly until lightly browned. Dice sweetened meat. Toast pistachios in same skillet, stirring constantly, until lightly browned. Remove from skillet and set aside, reserving any pistachios. Toast bay leaf in same skillet, stirring. In a small bowl, combine golden syrup, fish sauce and tapioca, stirring until smooth. Add toasted coconut and remaining ingredients. Stir to mix lightly. Arrange nests in bowls. Sprinkle with chopped pistachios. Enjoy note, carnivies can substitute other meats, fish, or vegetables.

title: Beef Rolls (Japanese) With Lettuce and Cream
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon | 2 cups mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon molasses | 2 tablespoons buttermilk or 2 tablespoons milk | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 nori | lettuce | nori ( optional )
instructions: Place two spoonfuls of the rice mix into your hand and make your filling into a small oval shape. Roll the top piece of nori to seal the roll into a tight roll. In a small bowl, mix together 1/2 cup of the mayonnaise with the molasses and vanilla. Spread a tablespoon of the cream onto one end of the roll followed by a couple of nori strips, if using. Take a roll from the roll and then roll it up to make a cigar shape. Repeat until all the rolls are rolled. In a pan, melt the sugar over medium heat. Drip the roll of nori into the sugar, place it in the sugared dish and drizzle the melted sugar over it, and turn it until all the coating is covered and the rolls are cooked. Allow to cool and serve, if using lettuce, cut the roll in half and serve, garnished with nori.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,breadcrumb,wild mushroom,garlic salt,marsala wine,broccoli
title: Beef Stew II
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 box fresh broccoli, cut up | 1 cup breadcrumbs, unseasoned | 1 jar of wild mushrooms, drained chopped | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine | garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, combine the first three ingredients. Dip the meat first in the crumbs and then in the wine, coating the meat evenly. Bring a large pot of water to boil. When water comes to boil, add meat and cook till meat is cooked through. Remove from heat. Drain meat and vegetables. Place in casserole. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meat and vegetables. Bake, uncovered, for 3 hours.

title: Grits with Herbs & Dates
ingredients: 6 cups vegetable broth or 6 cups bouillon | 1 cup pitted dates | 1 tablespoon dill weed | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig | 1 package dry grits
instructions: In a 3 quart saucepan combine broth, dates, dill, thyme and grits.

title: Coconut Sherbet
ingredients: 2 cups desiccated coconut | 1 cup dry sherry
instructions: Place coconut in a bowl and add the sherry. Stir to mash well. Leave to set for 5 minutes, then stir again. Add extra sherry to taste.

title: Aussie Mango and Cheese Strudel
ingredients: 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1 large green mango | 1/2 cube country bread | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke or 1/2 teaspoon white cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon cumin, ground | 230 g frozen reduced-fat baked sweet corn oil, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c or a convection oven. Cut the mango into 1cm cubes. Cut the bread in half lengthways. Cut each piece into 1cm thick slices. Place the mango in a bowl with the bread, liquid smoke, cumin and 1/4 teaspoon of the salt and toss to combine. Spread half of the bread over the base of two 7 x 21cm or 18x18x2cm loaf tins. Divide the mango mixture between the bread and top with the baked bread and crumbs. Cover and place in the oven for 35 - 45 minutes, or until the bread has puffed up and the mango has softened.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,salt pepper,tamari,hamburger patty,farfalle pasta,pineapple ring
title: Farfalle Patties With Pineapple Sauce
ingredients: 2 packages hamburger patty | 8 ounces cooked hot italian beef or 8 ounces cooked turkey | 1 can crushed pineapple rings over top, in own juices | 1/4 cup tamari ( dark soy sauce may be used in place of the tamari ) | salt and pepper | 1 package farfalle pasta, in skillet | 2 1/2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Patties preheat oven to 400°f. Brown hamburger patty patty in large skillet. Remove browned patties to a greased baking dish. Slice liverpate in half lengthwise, leaving just 1/4 thick patties. Put patties into a bowl and add 1/4 cup each of the pineapple juice and tamari. Spoon over patties. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with pineapples and the cheese. Bake for about 25 - 30 minutes until hot and bubbly inside and just starting to brown on top.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,butterscotch chip,pear,white sugar
title: Tasty Red & White Curry Pear Dip
ingredients: 1 package frozen pears, thawed | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted | 1 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Place pears into a large saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until reduced to 1 cup, about 20 minutes. Preheat oven broiler. Place red pear halves into a baking dish, and drizzle with curry paste. Sprinkle with butter and sugar, and broil in the preheated oven until the pears are tender and the dip is bubbly, 5 to 10 minutes. Serve with sliced french bread or crackers.

title: Turkey Breast With Cream
ingredients: 3 turkey breast, skinless | 250 fluid ounces double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line a large baking tray with foil. Lay the turkey pieces skin side down onto the prepared baking tray. Roast for 10 - 15 minutes until nicely browned at the sides, and then turn over. Roast for another 8 minutes until the breasts are well browned and a knife goes through them easily. Remove from oven and cut into slices. Lay them back onto the baking tray. Brush top with cream and bake for a further 15 minutes until cooked through and golden. Serve with mashed potatoes and seasonal vegetables.

Random Ingredients: breadfruit,parsnip,red bell pepper,chinese five spice powder
title: Crunchy Parsnips on French Toast
ingredients: 2 cups parsnips, peeled and shredded | 1/2 red bell pepper, seeded and diced into strips | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | crusty breadfruit ( optional )
instructions: Place everything into a nonstick skillet or griddle. Cook on low for about 5 to 8 minutes, flipping the parsnips halfway through.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,pimiento,fine breadcrumb,egg noodle,red pepper,green chili pepper,rice vinegar,cauliflower
title: Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 3/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 4 large eggs noodles | 1/3 cup chopped pimiento | 4 small red peppers, roasted, skinned, seeded and chopped | 4 cups shredded cauliflower | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 small green chili pepper, sliced thinly | 1 jar chopped pimientos
instructions: Set oven to broil. Place beef, bread crumbs, eggs noodles and pimentos on a sheet of waxed paper, making sure the sides are even. Divide beef mixture among beef rolls. Top each roll with vegetables. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, then add salt. Add noodles and cook for 4 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: jicama,parmesan cheese,zucchini,bay leaf,red wine vinegar,lemon zest,italian parsley,bicarbonate soda
title: Zucchini Fritters
ingredients: 120 g zucchini, finely grated | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, finely grated | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon italian parsley, chopped | 1 bay leaf | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 cups red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl. Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more parsley, if necessary. Heat the oil in a deep, medium sized frying pan. For each fritter, drop spoonfuls of the mixture into the oil. Fry, turning once, until golden, about 2 - 3 minutes, depending on how you like your fritters crisp and brown. Drain on kitchen paper. Serve topped with your favourite vegetable accompaniment, with a scattering of grated parmesan cheese.

title: Spicy Mexican Soup
ingredients: 3 cans white hominy, drained | 1 package shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Heat the soup pot over medium heat until it begins to simmer. Place the hominy in a large bowl, and mash it to extract liquid. Stir in the cheddar cheese to make a thick gravy. Bring the soup to a boil then reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,plain flour,walnut oil,black olive,curry powder,coriander powder,lemon wedge
title: Spiced Black Olives With Coriander
ingredients: 1 teaspoon black olives, whole ( or canned anchovies ) | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, crushed | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 125 g plain flour | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | fresh coriander wedge
instructions: Mash olives with red chilli powder, curry powder, flour, salt and oil in a bowl. Serve warm with coriander and a wedge of fresh toasted italian bread.

Random Ingredients: meat,red bean,tamarind paste,lime,pie shell,arborio rice,corn oil
title: Simple Tamarind Meat Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crushed cooked meat, and your favourite filling and topping | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 3 cups arborio rice | 1 tablespoon red bean, drained and rinsed | 1 cup canned sweet corn kernels or 1 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed | 1 lime, cut into 4 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 2 1/2 or 3 quart casserole dish with parchment paper. Combine stuffing ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Stir in filling. Dot with a spoon. Cover with greased aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until heated through. Serve with wedges of lime. You can also place the pie on a rack in a baking dish and bake at 375 degrees f for 30 to 35 minutes or until heated through and browned.

title: Thai Veal Cutlets With Banana (Vietnamese Style)
ingredients: 4 cutlets | 1/2 lb lean pork or 1/2 lb beef round steak | 1 banana | 1/2 lb veal cutlet | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon sambal oelek | apricot ( for garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Make sure your cutlets are flat, not very thin but not too thick, and cut into serving sized pieces. In a ziploc bag, combine the meat with the bullion cube, and marinade for 30 minutes. After the meat has marinated, place the meat on a rack in your roasting pan then roast for 15 - 20 minutes, turning once, until cooked thoroughly. Allow to rest for about 10 minutes before removing to serving dish if desired. While meat is resting, scrape off any burned bits from the bottom of the pan. Slice bananas into wedges to serve along side the cooked meat. Pour warm meat juices into a frying pan and heat slowly over low heat, pouring off excess fat from the pan as it simmers. You will need to stir this mixture every 5 - 10 minutes or so, especially if the pan becomes very dry. You may want to begin adding a bit of water. Slice meat across the grain if you wish. Remove meat from pan from heat and pour juices over the vegetables. Top veggies with chopped apricots. Serve with sticky rice.

title: Cashew and Balsamic Salad
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sugar cube | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and stir to mix. Serve sprinkled with walnuts if desired.

title: Pineapple Fried Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 6 pints fresh pineapple chunks | 2 teaspoons cooking oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Pour the oil into a roasting dish large enough to fit the sweet potatoes into a single layer. Insert your butter poke holes all over the surface of the sweet potatoes, pour the sweet potatoes in and spread them out into the roasting dish. Cook 20 to 30 minutes, until sweet potatoes are golden brown around the edges. Slice and serve warm.

title: Ponche De Casa (Spanish-Style Cured Cod and Scallops)
ingredients: 2/3 cup prune | 1/2 cup light coconut milk | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds ( or 1-2 tsp. cayenne, to taste ) ( optional ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs scallops | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 cups cooked chicken, chopped ( about 4 1/2 oz. ) | 1 cup polenta
instructions: Remove pits from prunes and set aside. Slice prunes lengthwise to yield approximately 1/4 cup segments. Bring coconut milk, catsup, and cumin seeds to boil in a medium saucepan. Add scallops.

title: Swiss Bacon Cake
ingredients: 8 ounces bacon drippings or 8 ounces butter, at room temp | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup chopped green onion ( optional ) | green onion
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the bacon grease and add the cake flour, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Cook the cake this way until it is a golden brown color and the flour coats the bottom of the skillet and is starting to form little mountains/bubbles. Watch it don't burn stir in the green onions and cook 2 - 3 minutes more or until the scottish cream is absorbed. Transfer the cake to a cake dish, smooth out on the crumbs from the pan.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,veal,beef broth,canadian bacon,spaghetti sauce,cilantro leaf,poblano chile
title: Smoky Hot Veal Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 2 slices canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro leaves | 1/3 cup beef broth | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 1 can condensed low-sodium chicken broth | 1 package spaghetti sauce
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium high heat, stir together ground veal, bacon, and cilantro. Pour in the beef broth, cover, and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Stir in the cream, chicken broth, and spaghetti sauce.

title: Danish Watercress With Cornflour
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 bunch fresh watercress leaves, washed lightly
instructions: Mix together the cornflour with 1 tbsp cold water to form a sticky paste. Place watercress leaves in a bowl and stir fry for 5 minutes or until crisp and translucent. Remove from the heat and toss in the cornflour paste. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,sauerkraut,head cabbage,cream,orange peel,lettuce,granny smith apple,pizza sauce
title: German Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 head of cabbage, shredded into bite size pieces ( about 5 quarts ) | 1 cup sliced cauliflower floret | 1 large granny smith apple, diced | 1 small head of cabbage, shredded | 1 bottle pizza sauce, your favorite ( use the `` heat '' version ) | 8 ounces sour cream, well drained ( optional ) | 1 orange peel, grated ( optional ) | lettuce, shredded ( optional )
instructions: In large bowl, combine the cabbage, cauliflower and apple. Add a bit of the pizza sauce, stir. Add remaining pizza sauce, sour cream, orange peel and optional garnishes of your choice.

Random Ingredients: vanilla wafer,italian salad dressing,beef brisket,four cheese mexican,mayonnaise
title: Mexican Brisket
ingredients: 1 lb beef brisket, trimmed | 1 bottle zesty italian salad dressing | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon vanilla wafer, crushed | 8 ounces four-cheese mexican blend cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine beef, zesty italian dressing, mayonnaise and crushed wafer on waxed paper.

title: Orange Beer
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces yeast, 1/4 ounce | 8 1/2 fluid ounces madeira wine or 8 1/2 fluid ounces red wine | 1 1/2 fluid ounces lemon juice | 1 1/2 cups chopped orange rind ( about 10 whole oranges ) | 1/2 cup bonito flakes, to taste
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the madeira. Mix the lemon juice, orange rind, bonito flakes, and orange juice well, then use this to dilute the yeast into the mixture. Place the batter in a greased 8 x 8 cake pan and bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 40 - 45 minutes. Let cool before removing from cake pan. Also wonderful when served warm, cold, room temperature, and the smell of the orange beer is gone.

title: Jicama Sticks (French Canadian Food and Sausages)
ingredients: 5 lbs jicama | 1/2 cup salt pork, chopped | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons egg whites
instructions: Peel off the ends of the jicama and make each jicama stick about 3 inches long and one inch wide. They will look slightly more uniform after the slices soak. Rinse the jicama with cold water and pat dry with paper towels, making sure the jicama sticks are not sticky or any spots may come out dry. Place jicama sticks on the racks of a grill, and cook until they are crisp on top, about 4 minutes or so on each side. Transfer to a plate and set aside. Place an oven safe pan on the upper shelf of your oven, and preheat to 250 degrees f. Remove the parchment paper from the sausage racks and set aside. Place a piece of cheesecloth or moistened cheesecloth in a small piece of cheesecloth and tie tightly, just so that the cheese will keep its shape during baking. Place in the fridge until the cheese has become saturated but not hard, as this will make it easier to remove from the sausage. When you are ready to bake, preheat the oven to 200 degrees f. Coat the outside of a baking sheet with a very thin coating of cooking spray. Place the sausage sticks on the prepared baking sheet, brush each with some of the beaten egg whites, and sprinkle liberally with seasoning salt. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is golden, about 25 to 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: apple,broccoli floret,blueberry,poblano chile,sirloin steak,penne pasta,baby shrimp,portabella mushroom cap
title: Broccoli Beef and Penne With Poblano Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, trimmed | 1 can poblano chiles, drained | 1 portabella mushroom cap, sliced | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1 cup halved green frontera baby shrimp | 1/3 cup chopped apple | 1/3 cup low-fat penne pasta, uncooked
instructions: Spray skillet to burn. Heat skillet/wok over high heat 3 minutes. Brown steak, 2 - 3 minutes per side on medium high heat. Remove steak and set aside. Add chiles, mushrooms and broccoli and stir fry 2 minutes. Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes more. Transfer steak and vegetables to a platter. Degrease pan in a 2 to 3 minutes. Return pan to high heat. Add tomato paste to pan and cook 1 minute. Stir in pasta, 3/4 cup pasta water and broccoli. Heat through. Serve sauce over cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,shallot,sauerkraut,chili pepper,fillet rainbow trout,chicken wing,pork loin
title: Chicken With Beer and Beer Can Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast fillet, cut into four pieces | 2 pork loin, cut into four pieces | 1/4 cup finely chopped shallot | 1/4 cup finely chopped chili pepper | 2 cups sauerkraut, rinsed, well drained | 2 cups bottled chicken wings or 2 cups frozen chicken wings | 1/4 cup beer ( optional )
instructions: Combine the ingredients in the order listed.

title: Asparagus and Mushroom Couscous
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 2 cups shredded kraft old cheddar cheese or 2 cups gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 tablespoons shiitake mushrooms | 1 lb fresh asparagus, ends trimmed | 4 ounces sliced asparagus tips for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine 1/2 cup water and the couscous.

Random Ingredients: kale,white pepper,korma paste,tomato soup,chicken stock,cardamom pod
title: Kari
ingredients: 2 pieces korma paste ( chicken or beef ) | 500 ml chicken stock | 1 1/2 liters tomatoes soup | 1 white hot pepper ( optional ) | 2 cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cut the korma paste into pieces about 1 cm and 1 cm and about 1 cm thick, and place in a large saucepan over low heat. Cook slowly stirring often over low heat for about 20 minutes. Add the chicken stock and simmer over low heat for a further 20 minutes. Stir in the tomato soup, pepper, optional cardamom pods, ground cardamom and some salt and pepper. Bring it to the boil and serve with rice.

title: French Fried Won Tons
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1/3 cup vegetable shortening
instructions: Pour condensed soup into a bowl and set aside. Lay one won ton wrapper on your work surface and place 2 tablespoons of the soup mixture along the center of the wrapper. Moisten the center of the won ton wrapper with water, use your finger and index finger to seal up the hole. You will have the soup filling at the top of the won ton wrapper which is going to be used to fill up your left over stuffing. Fold it over the filled won tons and press the edges together, to seal the won tons and make them into a little triangle like shapes using the back of a knife. Repeat until all won tons are filled. Heat a skillet on medium high heat. Coat with vegetable shortening, add won tons and fry until golden brown. Serve with sour cream.

title: Glamorgan (Glamorgan)
ingredients: 1 liter of freshly picked glamorgan flowers ( or gherkin ) | 1 -2 cup of lukewarm mascarpone cheese
instructions: Place the glamorgan flowers in a deep pot. Cover with boiling water and bring to the boil. Once the glamorgan flowers have grown to a very thick syrup, remove them and place into a bowl of cold water. When the flowers have become tender, drain them well and place in your fridge to set. Now, take a serving dish suitable to have a lid and place the mascarpone in one corner. Put the cooked glamorgan flowers on top. Take half of the remaining cheese and spread over the top of the glamorgan gherkin. Carefully lift the cheese from the surface and carefully squeeze out the excess moisture. Spread the remaining cheese on the cheese until it is entirely covered. Use the lid to keep cheese from sticking to your dishes, as the cheese will melt easily.

title: My Favorite Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans green chili peppers, chopped | 16 ounces tomato sauce | 1 can green chilies | 32 ounces can green chili peppers, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients, and heat on medium for 15 minutes.

title: Beef, Yoghurt and Cornflour Beef in Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients: 600 g beef chuck roast, cut into strips | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 300 ml light sour cream | 300 g shredded cheddar cheese | 300 g low-fat low-fat yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 210 degrees celsius. Dredge meat in cornflour and shake off excess. Place meat in a casserole dish. Cover with 2cm/2 tbsp sour cream. Cover the meat with 2 tbsp of the yogurt. Cover and bake in the oven for 2 hours. Serve with vegetables and steamed baby carrots.

title: Chilled Turkey Salad With Ginger Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 small red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon ginger juice | 1 teaspoon hot ginger juice | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 lb thinly sliced lean deli-sliced turkey | 2 radishes, very thinly sliced
instructions: Combine red wine vinegar, ginger juice and hot pepper juice in large glass or stainless steel bowl. Add turkey and stir to coat. Cover and chill in refrigerator 30 minutes, turning once. Remove turkey from marinade.

Random Ingredients: currant,pearl barley,hot italian sausage,pear,spice,cocoa powder,pastry shell
title: English Sausage & Pear Pie (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot italian sausage or 1/2 lb mild italian sausage | 2 tablespoons dried currants, slightly more if needed | 100 g pearl barley | 1 jar chopped pears, well drained | 8 sheets ready-made pastry shells ( see notes ) | 2 tablespoons dark unsweetened cocoa powder, preferably dutch process ( see notes ) | 1 teaspoon mixed spice ( see notes )
instructions: Pour boiling water over the italian sausage in pressure cooker and then place lid on cooker. Set onto medium high and bring to high pressure, then down to 2cm above level. Cook with quick release method, 45 minutes, then remove from heat and leave to allow to depressurize naturally. Remove lid and leave to cool and harden further. Meanwhile, make the pie shell by mixing all the ingredients together until fully incorporated. Using your fingers, separate and remove the firm pears, peels and all soft centres. Remove the meat and add the pear mixture and sausage to the shell. If the filling does not completely fill the shell, leave it there on the lid as per the cooking instructions.

title: Mexican Quinoa Cake Salad
ingredients: 120 g dry quinoa | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon honey, plus extra ( or honey ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence, plus extra ( or pure vanilla extract ) | 250 g semi-sweet chocolate syrup | 3/4 cup salsa | 200 g of good quality grape slices | 2 tablespoons tamari ( vegan sugar-free ) or 2 tablespoons braggs liquid aminos
instructions: Start by soaking the quinoa in a pot until it starts to swell, then remove from heat and allow to sit until soft. Drain and place the quinoa in a blender or food processor and then process until the mixture is quite smooth. This should take about 2 minutes – the quinoa will have a finer texture then if it’s still too thick it needs a little water to get smooth but thick. This doesn’t really matter if it’s not as thick about a bit of a paste, as it should be a bit thinner. While this is soaking, mix the cream, honey and vanilla in a small pan and bring to a simmer over a medium heat, stirring intermittently until the cream has reduced a little and then remove from the heat. Remove from the heat and fold in the quinoa. Spread half of the quinoa mixture evenly over a round, well buttered cake tin. Cover the quinoa with the cream mixture, then top with half of the salsa, half of the grape slices and finally with half of the tamari. Fold the other half of the quinoa mixture over the top, then wrap in the pan with foil and place on the middle rack of the oven at 170°c or 320°f for 90 minutes. Remove the foil and decorate with extra sliced grape slices and chocolate syrup.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,yellow onion,sesame oil,walnut half,curd cottage cheese,rye bread,garlic clove,basil leaf
title: Kellymac
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion, diced | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 3/4 cup dry curd cottage cheese | 1 can rotel tomatoes, drained ( or use a bit of tomato juice ) | 1/4 cup walnut halves | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 6 pieces rye bread, toasted
instructions: Cook onion in oil until softened. Add garlic, and cook another minute, stirring to release the flavors. Add rotel tomatoes, and raisins, stirring to just coat the tomatoes. Cover and simmer 20 minutes over low medium heat. Add walnuts and basil, and let sit for a few minutes. Split through a strainer, removing any seeds. Serve in mugs or bowls with toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: pear,vegetable oil cooking spray,peanut,vanilla essence,caraway seed,white cheddar cheese,filet mignon
title: Steamed Baked Beef
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray, for greasing | 300 g raw lean fillets ( steak-cut about 2 ounces each ) or 300 g filet of steak ( steamed about 2 ounces each ) | 1 -2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts | 2 slices white cheddar cheese | 1 small pear, peeled, cored and sliced ( or 2 cups canned low-fat frozen pears, drained ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c. Arrange 2 slices of the steamed beef on two baking trays. Brush half of the caraway seeds on each piece of beef. Place the crushed peanuts, cheese, pear, vanilla and remaining oil in an 8x8cm ovenproof dish and mix. Spoon the pear over the beef, top with the remaining slices of beef and then scatter with the remaining caraway seeds. Dribble the peper on top and drizzle with the vanilla. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until the beef is cooked to your liking.

title: Awesome Garam Masala Chips
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat, and cook the bamboo shoots until no longer bright green, about 5 minutes. Place the bamboo shoots in a paper bag, and shake until all of the vegetables have been eaten. Sprinkle the garam masala over the top.

title: Nua-Nu-Glace
ingredients: 1 kg medium raw shrimp ( shelled, deveined and shelled if possible ) | 2 bay leaves | 1 liter peshaw pistachios ( shelled ) | 100 -150 g vanilla sugar, to taste | 6 teaspoons arrowroot
instructions: Rinse shrimp or leave in the fridge. Shell and devein, and set aside. Boil water in a large saucepan and add bay leaves. Add prawns or prawns, and boil for 2 to 5 minutes, or until shrimp are cooked. Add vanilla sugar and arrowroot powder. Continue to boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Taste for sweetness and add more sugar or arrowroot to taste if desired. Sprinkle with pistachios, adjust as desired.

Random Ingredients: white bread,avocado,pork tenderloin,sun tomato,butternut squash,broccoli floret,lemon juice
title: Tasty Breakfast Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 onion, thinly sliced | 400 g butternut squash, cubed | 1/2 egg roll, sliced diagonally ( any bread slice will do ) | 1/2 loaf white bread, sliced diagonally | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup broccoli floret, sliced | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 4 slices pork tenderloin
instructions: In a large glass bowl, layer onion, butternut squash, egg roll, bread, tomatoes, broccoli and lemon juice. Grill or broil the sandwiches for about 1 - 2 minutes until edges are golden.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,irish cream,balsamic vinegar,bread crumb,manchego cheese,tea,golden syrup
title: Breaded Beef Teabags
ingredients: 4 loaves of good quality crusty bread ( about 5 x 3-inch, or 1 1/2 large loaves of bread ) | 1 cup freshly grated aged manchego cheese | 1 cup irish cream ( regular or irish ) | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 4 tablespoons chopped italian parsley ( fresh or dried ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons brewed tea
instructions: Trim excess crusty bread from the bread. Place bread on greased cookie sheets. Brush with the 1/2 cup of the balsamic and golden syrup, then sprinkle with the 1 1/2 tablespoon of the parsley. Bake at 350 for about 55 minutes or until golden and crisp. Remove from oven and let cool completely. Cut bread into 24 squares, each about 1 x 3 inches. Place in a dish and refrigerate until ready to use. Heat the remaining 1/2 cup of balsamic and golden syrup over low heat in a small saucepan and stir until the mixture is completely dissolved. Transfer the warm syrup to a small bowl and set aside. Place the baguettes on a baking sheet. Brush each with the melted balsamic syrup and sprinkle with the remaining parsley. Serve immediately or chill for 3 or 4 hours to help the bread absorb the flavors.

title: Swiss Pineapple Mousse Filling
ingredients: 6 egg whites | 1 jar pineapple rings | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1/3 cup heavy cream
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Beat in garlic and cream. Fold egg whites into the pineapple mixture. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,cod,chicken bouillon cube,sweetcorn,purpose flour,pork rib
title: Easy Crock Pot Pulled Pork and Corn Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 6 cups chicken broth or 6 cups water | 1 pork rib | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 2 cans ortega corn with chilies, undrained | 1 package frozen sweetcorn
instructions: Cut pork into small pieces. Place in 6 quart slow cooker. Stir in flour, then stir in broth or water. Cook for 6 hours on high. Add corn and stir in diced chilies. Cook for 2 more hours then serve. Remove pork to plate and pour stock into a small casserole, stirring in the corn chilies and sweetcorn. Reheat over low heat until hot.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,green cardamom pod,saffron thread,vegetable,carrot,new mexico chile powder,italian parsley
title: Spicy Fried Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 lb new mexico chile powder | 1 pinch saffron thread | 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 large carrot ( cut into thin strips or strips, like leeks or other vegetables ) | 1 small bag frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 2 -4 green cardamom pods, crushed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup snipped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Grind chilli powder with the saffron in a spice grinder. Heat the vegetable oil in a wide, deep frying pan at medium high. In the hot oil, stir fry the carrot strips for several minutes on each side, or until crisp tender. Remove from the pan with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel lined plate. When the carrots are cool enough to handle, drain oil, then return to the pan. Re warm the oil in the pan. Fry the mixed vegetables for 3 to 4 minutes over medium high heat. Remove the vegetables and stir them in until nicely browned. Add the crushed cardamom pods and parsley to the mixture. Stir fry for 1 minute, stirring rapidly to avoid burning, then add the chilli powder mixture. Add a little water if needed to thicken, making sure the vegetables aren't sticking. Sprinkle the top with paprika, garnish with fresh parsley or a sprinkling of black pepper, before serving.

Random Ingredients: veal,extra virgin olive oil,apricot jam,romaine lettuce,salt pepper,sugar vanilla pudding mix,chicken wing
title: Easy Balsamic Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lbs whole chickens wings, tips removed | 1 package sugar-free vanilla pudding mix | 2 cans chicken wings, with meat | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon salt & pepper, to taste | 1/2 cup apricot jam | romaine lettuce or iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place chicken wings in a 4 qt saucepan. Cover with water and bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,french bread,egg noodle,chocolate,limeade concentrate,red leaf lettuce
title: Easy Low Fat Chocolate Noodles
ingredients: 1 french bread | 1 cup egg noodles | 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 cup reduced fat low-fat chocolate, melted | 1 cup red leaf lettuce | vinegar, to coat
instructions: Cut crust from bread and cut bread slices into small cubes into a large bowl. Coarsely chop 1/2 c. Limeade concentrate and set aside. Wrap the 4 corners of the plastic wrap tightly around each bread cube so that there are no stray bits of meatloaf. Secure the wrap with the back of a large spoon, keeping the plastic inside the bag. Place bread in bowl with limeade concentrate and stir until thoroughly coated. Set aside. Prepare the noodles according to package instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water so as to remove all the excess water. In an 8 quart microwavable bowl, combine noodles, limeade concentrate, hot pepper sauce and chocolate. Cover and microwave on high power about 3 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes or so, until chocolate is melted and creamy, stirring occasionally. Add lettuce and toss to combine. Top with a sprinkling of vinegar. Cover and microwave 1 minute, stirring every 2 minutes until hot. This will help to crisp the noodles. Allow to stand for about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Roasted Noodle Salad With Dipping Ingredients
ingredients: 1 cup shelled hazelnuts, toasted salted | 1 cup blanched peanuts | 1 1/2 lbs napa's spaghetti, dried weight, cooked and drained | 1 cup diagonally cut daikon radish | 3 medium dashes of each creamed sea salt ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cumin seed, toasted lightly ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mrs. dash seasoning salt ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. In large baking dish, mix all salad ingredients evenly. Sprinkle with toasted cumin seeds. If using, sprinkle top with mrs. Dash. Bake, basting often and sprinkling with dresing. Bake until golden and hot and crispy, about 10 minutes. Serve hot or warm. Note, mrs. Dash is the dried seasoning that can be found at health food stores and in health food stores. Nutritional values per pound of nuts, 1 cup.

title: Gordita de Jamon (Pimiento, Apricot & Apricot Appetizer)
ingredients: 1 cup chopped jarle cooked apricot | 10 tablespoons chopped pimiento | 2 cups finely crushed ice
instructions: Heat apricots and pimentote in small pan. Remove apricots and pimentote from pan and combine with other ingredients. Chill for a few hours to allow flavors to blend.

title: Salmon and Spinach Skewers with Vodka Ribbons
ingredients: 1/4 cup vodka | 1/3 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 2 lbs skinless salmon | 1 container frozen chopped spinach | coarse salt | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Whisk together the vodka, mirin and salt and pepper to taste in a small bowl. Pour over the salmon, cover and let marinate 2 - 3 hours at room temperature or up to two days, or cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Thread the salmon on 4 skewers. Grill the skewer over medium coals for 4 - 5 minutes or to desired doneness. Serve immediately over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,heavy whipping cream,lime juice zest,ziti pasta
title: Ziti Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 box uncooked wide egg noodles | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon grated lime zest | 1 can or bottle light beer ( any brand )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f or a convection oven in a large mixing bowl, toss the noodles with 1/4 cup of cream and the lime zest. Spread them out in one layer in the bottom of a large lasagna pan or other deep baking dish. Layer them with 1/4 of the noodles, then drizzle with 1/4 cup cream mixture over them, then spread the remaining noodles on top. Layer the ziti mixture, with the remaining 1/4 cream mixture, over the noodles and drizzle with remaining cream mixture. Cover tightly with a sheet of aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes. Remove from the oven, uncover and bake for 15 to 20 minutes longer. Remove the foil, turn the heat down to 325°f or a convection roaster and bake for 30 minutes longer.

title: French Onion Spread
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 1/2 cups water | onion salt
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix cream cheese, maple syrup, and water. Stir until thoroughly combined. Cover, and refrigerate 3 hours. Transfer to an 8x8 dish, and sprinkle with onion salt.

title: Lazy-Day Lasagne
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles, broken in half according to package directions | 1 pound beef tenderloin, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 can pumpkin, drained | 1 medium head chinese cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas, defrosted | 2 cups shredded carrots | toppings :
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook lasagna noodles in large saucepan of boiling salted water just until tender, about 3 minutes.

title: Asian Barbecued Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 kg chicken | 500 g pickled chinese pickled soy sauce ( kikkoman inspirations ) | 1/2 cup sweet mild chili sauce ( such as sriracha )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and puree until very smooth. Trim chicken of excess fat. Using a sharp knife slice the chicken in half lengthways and then cut them in thick slices. Arrange chicken in a dish and rub with the marinade. Leave to marinate overnight on the bbq. Cook on the bbq plate for 10 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: fast rising yeast,red onion,cognac,swiss cheese,wheat flour,cranberry sauce,lemon juice,pumpkin pie spice
title: Spiced Swiss Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shredded swiss cheese ( can be bought at costco ) | 1/2 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1/4 cup cognac | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 3/4 cup dried cranberry sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly sqeezed | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl with a mixer. Cover and chill in refrigerator for about 6 hours. Bake in a 2 quart oven at 225f for 1 hour and 30 minutes, or according to your baking time. You may need to sprinkle a little more of the cheese on top when done.

title: Camarones
ingredients: 6 tablespoons dry picante sauce | 2 cups small shrimp, cleaned | 1 jar pimientos, drained
instructions: Rinse the shrimp under cold water and place in a medium size saucepan with picante sauce and pimentos. Let simmer over medium high heat, about 10 minutes. Add shrimp and simmer for a few minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,green bean,red capsicum,gnocchi,white flour,cream chicken soup
title: Gnocchi Creams
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons unbleached white flour | 1/2 cup cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 3/4 cup thinly sliced red capsicum, diced | 1 1/2 cups fresh green beans, trimmed | 16 ounces gnocchi, cooked if using fresh gnocchi
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the flour and cream of chicken soup. Using 1 1/2 tablespoons of cream, stir in the soup, cream, capsicum and cream beans and mix well. Add gnocchi and toss to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Carrots With Kirsch
ingredients: 2 lbs baby carrots, washed | 2 cups kirsch ( or more to taste, use more to taste ) | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup simple syrup ( i use libby's ) | confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. While water is coming to a boil, peel, peel and cut baby carrots lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices, removing any yellow parts. Put carrots in pot and bring to a boil. Let boil for about 1 minute, then turn down slightly. Cook carrots 2 minutes, then turn off heat. Mix kirsch and sugar in a small bowl. Stir about 1/2 cup of water into kirsch mixture into the kirsch mixture until smooth. Taste and adjust sweetness to your liking. The kirsch will thicken as it gets into the carrots. Stir in carrots and let sit 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving dish. Dust generously with confectioners' sugar, and eat warm.

title: Raspberry and Rice Toast
ingredients: 1 raspberries, quartered ( about 1/3 cup ) | 2 slices french bread, 1 inch thick | ice | crusty rice
instructions: Combine raspberries and sliced french bread. Sprinkle with crumbs and serve with ice and creme fraiche or creme fraiche sauce, if using.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,ladyfinger,italian parsley,chili pepper flake,double cream
title: Spicy Italian Brandy Cream Sauce
ingredients: 500 ml double cream | 1 cup beef stock | 4 -6 fresh chili pepper flakes | 500 ml ladyfingers | 1 ounce fresh italian parsley
instructions: In a large pot melt the cream, add the beef stock and chili flakes, and bring to boil. Meanwhile remove 1 tbsp of the cream from the base of the pan, then pour cream in over the cream. Leave the sauce warm. Brush a little melted butter in a saucer or shallow dish and dip the ladyfingers in it. Place dipped biscuits in the cream sauce and cook for about 5 minutes on each side until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,ra el hanout spice mix,sunflower oil,fenugreek seed,mandarin orange
title: Mandarin Orange Puree(Moroccan)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mandarin oranges ( peeled and segmented ) | 1/3 cup yellow bell pepper ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/4 teaspoon all purpose fenugreek seeds ( ground ) | 1/4 teaspoon shahtar extra dry spice mix
instructions: Drain, reserving the syrup. Place mandarin orange segments, yellow bell pepper, sunflower oil, fenugreek, and shahtar in a blender or food processor, and process until smooth. You may not need all of the mandarin orange liquid to add a smooth puree to your sauce. Pour the puree back into the pan, and simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring often. Serve warm, or cool completely to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,urad dal,black cardamom pod,chicken stock
title: Amhari Korma
ingredients: 1 cup urad dal, washed and overnight if possible | 4 1/2 cups of chicken stock | 1 inch black cardamom pod | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place the urad dal in a deep pot in the morning and cover with hot water. Cook for about 3 - 4 hours or until the water is absorbed. The urad dal is done with the inside dark and soft. Take the urad dal and grind in a blender to make a smooth paste. Bring the chicken stock to a boil in another pot. Crush the cardamom and add them to the broth. Lower the heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes or until the broth thickens. Add the parmesan cheese.

title: Chocolate Stuffed Strawberries
ingredients: 1 lb strawberry | 1 lb shrimp | 10 ounces dark chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Clean and clean the strawberries and remove the peel. Break the leaves apart, leave the heads and place the pieces together in a medium sized bowl. Dip each shrimp in water, shake off any excess water, sprinkle each with more sugar and coat evenly. Chop the chocolate and mix it with a little water. Pour over the strawberries. Place on a tray in the refrigerator until the chocolate has set. Put the strawberries onto skewers and grill them over medium coals until the strawberries have begun to curl up around the fruit. Note, this can also be served on a bbq or stove top grill.

title: Chinese Tea
ingredients: 3 cups tea ( i used 5c or 7-8 ounce ) | 1 teaspoon coarsely cracked peppercorn ( i sprinkled mine with a little pepper ) | peanutbean paste ( i used tasty peanut sauce ) | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( optional )
instructions: Warm the tea and pour into 4 heat resistant 4 oz. Ramekins. Sprinkle each with some cracked peppercorns and a little chinese bean paste. Pour the hot tea into the ramekins in a steady steam. Cover with lid and leave to chill for 30 minutes. Unmold the ramekins on to a serving plate and leave to cool. Serve or store refrigerated.

title: Easy Vegetable Juice and Dipping Sauce (For Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 large sultana ( or 2 tablespoons raisins ) | 3 tablespoons grated lemon peel | 5 teaspoons ice water, or as needed | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add the cauliflower and stir to flake into a small bowl. Remove and discard the core and coarse outer leaves from the cauliflower and set aside to cool. Coarsely chop the cauliflower in a food processor or blender. Stir in the sultanas, if using, and 3 teaspoons of water, or as needed.

title: Lamb and Garlic Wrapped in Rice Flour
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 2 garlic cloves, peeled and pressed | 6 cups rice flour
instructions: Mix together the minced garlic and ground lamb. Add rice flour to make a stiff dough, knead with palms. Divide dough into two balls. Roll each into a ball. Using two balls, dip top of each ball into sea salt mixed with olive oil and salt. Then place into a large oven proof pan. Repeat process until all loaves have been rolled inches. Cook at 400 for 40 minutes. While still hot, remove from oven and leave on one side for 5 minutes. Remove again and turn over.

title: Balsamic Glaze Fish
ingredients: 1 -1 1/2 lb fish fillet or 1 -1 1/2 lb cod | 2/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 4 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Boil water, remove fish from water and place in a shallow pyrex dish. Place the fish on top of the water and pour the vinegar over. Sprinkle with fennel seeds, and cover with foil. Place in 350 degree oven for about 1 hour, until fish flakes easily.

title: Raita
ingredients: 2 cups grape leaves | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1/4 cup chopped tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Rinse and drain the leaves in a bowl. Fill a medium saucepan with water and bring to a boil, then add the grape leaves. Cover and remove from the heat. Let sit for about 20 minutes. Drain. Place the leaves in a serving dish. Add the curry powder and chopped tomatoes. Toss to coat and serve.

Random Ingredients: hunt tomato sauce,flat leaf parsley,fine breadcrumb,italian seasoning,red chili pepper,yeast,chicken thigh
title: Easy Barilla Breadsticks (With Sauce!)
ingredients: 18 ounces hunts tomato sauce | 10 ounces frozen breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper, minced | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant yeast | 2 lbs chicken thighs, cooked
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except chicken, mixing well. Add chicken and mix until coated. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Drain chicken, reserving 1/2 cup of the grease, and pat chicken dry. Form into 1 inch balls. Place chicken on an oiled baking sheet and flatten slightly. Bake at 400°f for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: herb,dark chocolate,pickle relish,bacon dripping,yellow squash,strawberry,espresso powder,pizza dough
title: Chocolate and Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef round | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs | 2 medium yellow squash | 2 tablespoons chocolate, shaved | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish | 4 ounces shaved dark chocolate
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a large bowl. In a microwave proof skillet, cook beef mixture over low heat, stirring frequently as it cooks, until beef mixture is thickened. Transfer beef mixture to a small plate and set aside. Cut squash lengthwise into 12 wedges. Place on a baking sheet and press each wedge into a rectangle measuring 13x9 inches. Set aside. Melt chocolate and relish together in a small bowl. Top each of 1 burger w/the chocolate and relish mixture. Melt remaining 1 teaspoon bacon drippings in a skillet over medium heat and stir in the pumpkin wedges. Cook 5 to 10 minutes until heated through. Cut buns in half, and spread each with melted chocolate mixture.

title: The Simplest Beef Ever
ingredients: 1/2 ounce good seasonings mix | 2 ounces sherry wine
instructions: Mix the Good Seasonings with the sherry and eat while the meat is still hot.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,za'atar spice mix,vanilla,mint,chicken breast half
title: Moroccan-Spiced Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup fresh mint, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons za'atar spice mix | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 4 chicken breast halves, 1-inch cubes
instructions: Place kiwifruit, mint, za'atar and vanilla in a mortar with a pinch of salt. Grind into a smooth paste. Place the chicken cubes in a serving bowl and add the kiwifruit mixture. Squeeze the kiwifruit mixture into the chicken and mint mixture. Marinate in the refrigerator for 10 minutes, or overnight.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,malibu rum,anise seed,salsa,kidney bean,serrano pepper,pepperoni,stevia
title: Caribbean Strega
ingredients: 32 ounces kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 6 ounces sea scallops, thawed | 1 dash pepperoni, chopped | 1 can salsa, hot and spicy | 1 teaspoon caribbean stevia ( or if you like a bit kick add 1 tsp. stevia ) | 2 tablespoons anise seeds | 3 slices pepperoni
instructions: Place the kidney beans and sea scallops in a 4 qt. Casserole. Cover with pepperoni, salsa, and anise powder, making sure pepperoni is added now if your using a lot of peppers. Top with pepperoni slices and a few slices of pepperoni.

title: Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 slices plain yogurt | 4 teaspoons fresh lemon juice, to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 12 slices sandwich ( bread, such as dijon or ciabatta ) | french bread, such as dijon-style | 4 thick-sliced sirloin, slices thinly sliced
instructions: Heat your broiler. In a small bowl, stir together the yogurt, lemon juice and zest, and set aside. On a large, round metal or glass baking dish or platter, lay out slices of bread and lay them out, about 3 inches apart, on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or waxed paper. Place bread slices and sirloin on top of the buttered bread slices, and brush with about 1/4 teaspoon each of lemon juice. Broil sandwich until sirloin is cooked through and toasted, about 3 to 5 minutes, then cut in half and remove from heat. Serve hot.

title: Tapioca Wrapped in Romaine (Rachael Ray) - Italian Chocolate Lettuce Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 lb unsweetened chocolate, finely chopped | 1 cup whole-grain tapioca starch | 1 lb romaine lettuce leaf
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Pour in the tapioca starch and whisk vigorously. Add the chopped chocolate, mix well and cook for about 1 minute or until the chocolate is melted and the mixture is smooth. Remove from heat and stir in the tapioca. Meanwhile, slice the rind off the romaine lettuce leaves. Brush each leaf with a tablespoon of tapioca mixture and wrap in cellophane. Let set 2 - 3 minutes. Slice in half for the romaine lettuce.

Random Ingredients: french bread,grape leaf,red pepper,sugar syrup,watermelon,mustard powder,orange peel
title: Watermelon, Red Pepper & French Bread Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange peel slices, finely cut | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 can watermelon, flesh, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup seedless grapeseed oil packed in syrup | 1/4 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper | 1 loaf french bread, cut in 8 equal wedges | powdered sugar syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In small bowl, combine the orange peel, mustard powder, watermelon chunks, grapeseed oil, crushed red peppers and dry crushed red pepper, stirring gently but lightly. Lay bread wedges vertically in a shallow round baking pan. Spoon the watermelon mixture evenly into each of the bread wedges, then spoon remaining mixture over bread, making sure it is evenly distributed. Sprinkle top of dipping with powdered sugar. Bake until hot and bubbling around the edges, about 10 - 20 minutes, then serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hungarian paprika,cream tartar,roasting chicken,ice water,self raising flour,plain yogurt,half cream
title: Crowdie Savoyard's Chicken Paprikash
ingredients: 250 g self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons hungarian paprika | 2 tablespoons cream of tartar | 175 ml ice water ( approx ) | 150 ml half-and-half cream ( approx ) | 350 g roasting chickens | plain yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Note, i took 2 - 3 tbsp of sour cream, so that it was a bit on the low side. Rub together the flour and paprika in a bowl with your fingers. Add the remaining ingredients and beat well with a large hand. Add the sour cream, mix well and knead the mixture so that it is no longer sticky. Put the dough into the container with the sour cream and use to knead it with your hands until it is soft and smooth. If you are using sour cream, put into containers with a little vanilla ice in it and beat until creamy. Pre heat your oven to 180 degrees celsius. Use your hands to mix it in the bottom of a large baking tin. Place the dough on it and roll out to about 6 cm thick. Spread the mixture over the base of the baking tin and bake on your oven for about 45 - 50 minutes or until cooked through. Allow this to cool and set up. Enjoy the smell of the sour cream.

title: Spicy Baked Steak
ingredients: 1 lb round steak ( about 5 to 6 ounces ) | 1 jar marinated small yukon gold potatoes or ( 16 ounce ) jar sweet potato pieces | 1 jalapeno pepper ( about 1 teaspoon, seeded ) | 3/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 can red beans, drained
instructions: Combine the steaks, potatoes, pepper and dried marjoram. Place on a greased rack in a shallow baking pan. Bake at 375 degrees, uncovered, about 40 minutes or until browned.

Random Ingredients: chinese noodle,new mexico chile powder,white mushroom,white pepper,tart apple
title: Chinese Apple Noodle Mix
ingredients: 8 ounces dried chinese noodles ( rice vermicelli ) | 2 tart apples, peeled, cored and diced | 1 teaspoon chinese black chile powder, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 package fresh white mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook the noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm, about 8 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl.

title: Salmon Croquettes
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces salmon | 8 ounces whole wheat bread crumbs
instructions: If using whole wheat bread crumbs, preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Cut salmon into 5 slices, and place in a single layer on a baking sheet. Lightly coat salmon with flour. Pour crumbs on top, then lightly press salmon with a spoon. Bake for 15 – 18 minutes, or until lightly browned and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,fast rising yeast,pimiento,rice,provolone cheese,whiskey,chipotle powder,spicy brown mustard
title: Tantalizing Irish Bread
ingredients: 1 packet fast rising yeast | 1 cup unsalted whiskey or 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup spicy brown mustard | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon pimiento pieces ( optional ) | 12 ounces provolone cheese ( cut into 1/4-inch cubes ) | 12 fresh asparagus spears, trimmed and cut across the grain into 1/2-inch pieces | cooked rice ( optional )
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast, whiskey or sour cream, mustard powder, chipotle powder, pimientos, and cheese.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,bean thread noodle,elbow macaroni,lemonade,spinach leaf,cinnamon,bean
title: Beans Pasties
ingredients: 4 macaroni, hardshell, preferably whole wheat variety | 1/3 cup elbow macaroni, medium, boiled and drained | 1 can refried beans, mixed sweet and sour | 3/4 cup fresh spinach leaves, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon lemonade
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water to stop the cooking process. Place macaroni in a large bowl, add refried beans, spinach, cinnamon, parsley and lemonade.

title: Ganache
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 3/4 cup pure vanilla ( not unsweetened )
instructions: Pour the gelatine into a small glass bowl and spread it over the surface of the gelatine. Sprinkle gelatin evenly over water in the bowl. Cover bowl and refridgerate for 2 - 6 hours. Strain to remove all excess water. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,rhubarb,cannellini bean,brandy,salt pepper,maraschino cherry,habanero pepper,celery rib
title: Rhubarb and Sprouted Bean Soup
ingredients: 500 g rhubarb, ends trimmed, cut into 1 cm cubes ( about 100-200 grams ) | 3 celery ribs, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon pickled jalapenos or 1 teaspoon habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon harissa ( harina de maiz or masala ) or 1 teaspoon brandy ( harina de maiz ) | 1 small pinch salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons parsley or 2 tablespoons chives, fresh ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh maraschino cherry, garnish | 400 g cannellini beans | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan rind or 2 tablespoons grana padano, to garnish
instructions: Cook the rhubarb in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally or until tender. Drain and set aside. Put all the remaining ingredients except the bean and rind into a pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the beans and rind and simmer until the liquid is reduced slightly by around 50%. Transfer to a warm serving dish or to four soup bowls. Sprinkle with the grated parmesan rind, garnish and serve with a dollop of sour cream if using.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,self raising flour,cheddar cheese,kidney bean,honey,green pepper
title: Easy Bake
ingredients: 3 cups swiss chard ( chopped ) | 1 cup kidney bean ( drained ) | 1 cup cheddar cheese ( shredded ) | 3 green peppers ( chopped ) | 1 cup self-raising flour | 5 teaspoons honey
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a baking dish. Bake in a moderate oven, 180 degrees celsius for 30 mins.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,green cardamom pod,pesto sauce,rye flour,cranberry,skirt steak
title: Broiled Skirt Steak With Pesto Swirls
ingredients: 16 ounces skirt steak | 1 1/2 cups pesto sauce for dressing, store-bought | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/4 cup frozen green cardamom pods, smashed | 15 anaheim chilies, stemmed, seeded and chopped ( about 1 3/4 cups total ) | 3 ounces dried cranberries
instructions: Place the skirt steaks in a glass dish, pour in about 1 cup of the pesto, and turn once to coat both sides with pesto. Let stand for 20 minutes, then brush steaks with the remaining pesto. Refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours, turning once or twice. While the steaks are chilling, prepare the garnish, place half the chiles and half the cranberries in a blender. Add 1 cup water, 1/4 cup pesto, and 1/4 cup finely chopped green cardamom to blender.

title: Leprechaun's Kelp Balls
ingredients: 600 g plain gluten free crumbs | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 600 g kelp, rinsed | 500 g pasta sauce
instructions: Combine the crumbs, soda, and klp in the bowl of a food processor and process until the mixture is the texture of breadcrumbs. Add a little milk to stop the mixture sticking together. Add a little pasta sauce if your hands form a paste. Roll into balls about the size of a ping pong ball and roll between your palms to coat evenly. Leave at least 40 minutes to rest. Cook the balls in boiling water for 15 minutes until slightly soft, drain. Place the remaining sauce in a pan, add them and simmer gently for 10 minutes or until thick. Add the balls to the sauce and serve.

title: Italian Bread Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can baked beans | 1 package mixed vegetables | 1/4 cup fresh or frozen mixed herbs | 1/4 cup bottled salsa | 1/4 cup bottled salsa | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon seafood seasoning or 1 teaspoon maggi seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon seasoned salt
instructions: Put all ingredients in mixing bowl and stir to mix. Refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour or overnight. Serve on whole wheat bread bread with fruit and/or indian flatbreads.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,topping,kielbasa,apple cider vinegar,black pepper,ranch dressing
title: Toasted Jus
ingredients: 1 jar prepared ranch dressing | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chinese five-spice powder | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/2 pound kielbasa, cut into 1-inch slices | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine the ranch dressing, apple cider vinegar, and chinese five spice powder. Layer half the the kielbasa slices over the ranch dressing. Fold the remaining kielbasa slices in half, and sprinkle with the black pepper. Arrange on a large baking sheet, and spread to cover the kielbasa. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until kielbasa is tender and bubbly. Cool to room temperature, and store in refrigerator.

title: Dahl (Split Lentils) With Bacon
ingredients: 400 g brown lentils ( green lentils ) | 200 g bacon, sliced or 8 -10 slices bacon | 2 green olives, chopped | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno, chopped ( or 2 jalapenos )
instructions: Wash the lentils. Boil water & boil lentils for about 3 - 5 minutes. Cut bacon into small pieces & place in a bowl with salt & pepper. Mix the lentils and fry in the bacon. When almost cooked, add in all the green olives & chillies. Drain half of the bacon & mix it through the lentils. Serve with rice or with other indian breads.

Random Ingredients: coriander,chicken stock,white flour,coconut milk,chipotle pepper,greek yogurt,sriracha sauce
title: Chipotle Chipotle Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup coconut milk | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/3 cup white flour | 1 chipotle pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup thick greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon sriracha sauce
instructions: Heat the coconut milk, chicken stock, coriander and pepper over low heat in a small saucepan for 15 minutes.

title: Macaroni and Shells for Sosaties (Chosaties)
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 1 dash salt ( optional ) | 3 1/2 cups macaroni, uncooked | 1 can no-salt-added stewed tomatoes, undrained ( or 1 14 oz. can stewed tomatoes & water ) | 1/2 cup barley, fine textured ( aka choclo, short-grain white barley )
instructions: To make the shell macaroni, bring a pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile, make the tomato sauce by combining the egg yolk, sugar & salt in a saucepan & simmering until the sugar dissolves. Stir in the macaroni & set aside. To serve, preheat the broiler to high & set to scoop out 1 cup of the macaroni from the casings, then toss it into the sauce. Place 1 macaroni shell on a baking tray & place a small spoonful of the reserved tomato sauce around the shell.

title: Easy Mustard Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can red beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup chopped green onions | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine beans, green onion, and mustard seed. Spoon into a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 35 to 45 minutes, until bubbly and browned.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange segment,curry powder,barley flour,white sugar
title: Orange Muffin Seasoning
ingredients: 1 cup barley flour | 1 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 4 cans mandarin orange segments, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 1 1/2 gallon muffin tin with paper liners. Whisk flour, sugar, and curry powder together in a bowl.

title: Tarragon Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh tarragon
instructions: Combine all ingredients, cover with plastic and store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,monterey jack pepper cheese,salad oil,baking potato,anise seed,tomato juice
title: Pommes De Tomate (Tomato-Anise Baked Potatoes)
ingredients: 1/4 cup salad oil | 1/2 tablespoon instant yeast ( see rapid-rise note in description ) | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 3 -4 large baking potatoes | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Heat the oil, add the yeast and anise seed and stir to dissolve. Cut each potato lenghtwise into 2 wedges then cut a cross in the center of each wedge. Brush the potatoes with the oil and season with salt and freshly ground pepper. Arrange the wedges on a baking sheet. Bake in a 400 degree f oven 1 hour, until barely golden brown. Top with the cheese and cut a slit on one side of each to serve.

title: Smokedcamembert and Red Potato Bake
ingredients: 1 large red potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges | 1 - 1 1/2 lb smoked camembert cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f or 180°c. Line a 20 x 30cm baking dish with foil. Place potatoes in a non stick frying pan and sprinkle with salt. Cook over high heat, stirring, for 10 - 15 minutes or until tender and lightly golden. Drain potatoes, then put on the baking dish. Pile the smoked camembert on top of the potatoes, covering the sausage. Place in the oven and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, until golden.

title: Gratin De Brisee - Leek and Turbinado Sugar Pastry With Rum
ingredients: 600 g leeks ( white and light green parts only, sliced finely ) | 100 g sultanas ( golden raisins, about 3 handfuls, or 200g raisins for a more interesting taste ) | 100 g turbinado sugar | orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon rum extract | 2 tablespoons shortening ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 celsius lightly oil a baking tray. Wash and slice the leeks, removing all the dark and tender green parts. Slice them finely if they are exceptionally large. Put the leeks and sultanas into a small pan and add 100g of turbinado sugar, about 1/3 measure, and a few orange zest. Season with rum extract, to taste, or you may want to add another 1/2 cup of sugar. Simmer gently over the lowest possible heat for 5 to 10 minutes, and take off of the heat. Grease a 10 inch crepe pan with a little shortening, or spray with oil if you like, and heat it gently until very hot. Pour the leek mixture in a circle in the centre of the pan, and spread evenly, leaving a small circle of around 1/8 of an inch around the edge. Cook over low heat for 45 to 60 minutes, until the top is set and dark, and the leek mixture caramelises somewhat. Turn out onto a warm plate, and leave to cool. When completely cool, cut into wedges, and serve with rum, cinnamon sugar or ice cream. This is really good topped off with a little whipped cream if you like. Variation if you like, you can also add sliced hard boiled eggs or sliced hard boiled eggs in stead of grated yolks, as well as a few sultanas for presentation.

title: Mexican Coffee
ingredients: 4 teaspoons ground cumin ( ancho powder ) | 16 teaspoons hot coffee
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Cabbage and Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cabbage | 1 cup shelled pistachio nut | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 cup irish cream, such as bailey's | 3 -4 fresh thyme sprigs | 8 large large lettuce leaves
instructions: In large bowl, combine cabbage, pistachios, thyme and irish cream liqueur. Refrigerate 8 to 10 hours. Just before serving, dress lettuce leaves with syrup.

title: Taco Seasoned Okra
ingredients: 1 package frozen cut okra | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1 bottle cheap teabags ( or other flavor enhancer ) | 0.10 can guacamole
instructions: Saute garlic in oil. Add okra, salt, and garlic. Cook over medium heat until tender, about 15 minutes. Add teabags to taste, stirring and breaking up pieces from edge. Add 1/2 can of guacamole. Mix well. Serve over your favorite meal.

title: Rosti With Fruit
ingredients: 14 ounces sauerkraut | 1 cup broth | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon dates, chopped | 1 - 1 1/4 lb swiss cheese, coarsely grated | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon prepared mustard
instructions: Simmer sauerkraut in broth and pineapple juice for at least 15 minutes before serving. Remove from heat. Stir in chopped date, 1 1/4 pound swiss cheese and mustard. Serve immediately. This also excellent cold on sandwich buns.

Random Ingredients: extra shrimp,almond extract,pork shoulder,polish sausage,cilantro leaf
title: Spanish Sausage and Shrimp Boil
ingredients: 1 lb linguica sausage | 2 lbs extra large shrimp, peeled deveined | 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut diagnol in 3 sections | powdered extra-fine shelled pistel salt and coarsely ground pepper | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Remove casings from sausage. Remove all excess fat and neck fat from shrimp. Cut sausage into 1 or 2 pieces and set aside. Cut shrimp into 1 by 1 1/2 lengths. Cut shoulder into thin 2 inch strips and set aside. Rinse shrimp, remove shell and devein using paper towel. If sausage and shrimp are large, remove casings. Bring large pot of water to a boil. Add sausage and shrimp and cook 12 to 15 minutes. Drain the shrimp thoroughly. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 300 degrees. Dry sausage and shrimp in paper towel. Remove shrimp from pan and place in large shallow baking pan. Top shrimp with sausage and shrimp. Add 1 teaspoon nutmeg and 1/2 teaspoon almond extract and mix well. Bake at 300 degrees for 75 to 90 minutes or until shrimp are pink and sausage is golden brown.

title: Colombian Charred Date Cream Truffles
ingredients: 1 lb of firm dates, rinsed and dried | 2 jalapeno chiles, seeded and coarsely chopped ( to taste ) | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place dates and chilies in a pan and cover with water. Bring to the boil, skimming any scum that rises to the surface. Boil for 4 - 5 minutes, skimming once during cooking and adding more water to cover if necessary. Drain dates and chilies thoroughly and return to pan. Return to full heat and stir until mixture is very thick and smooth. Stir in cream and vanilla until well mixed. Pour mixture onto a buttered surface, spreading with fingers. Chill in the refrigerator until firm. Using a slotted spoon, transfer mixture to a piping bag fitted with a plain tip. Trush outside of truffle with milk, then with a fork, prick the top of the crusted truffle all over. Place in a bowl and sprinkle with icing sugar. Allow cream to harden.

title: Italian Sausage Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb italian sausage | 1 pint sour cream
instructions: Remove casings from sausage. Cut off any excess fat. Place sausage in large pan of boiling salted water. Cover and boil 5 minutes or until just done. Drain. Return to pan. Stir to coat well. Add sour cream. Heat to just boiling, stirring constantly until desired consistency. Pour into crockpot or warm bowl to serve.

title: Mum's Ham and Gingersnap Biscuits
ingredients: 750 g finely minced ham | 1/2 cup grated gingernap | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 10 g dried oregano leaves
instructions: Mix the following ingredients in a bowl. Add your dry ingredients to the dry and thoroughly mix together all the ingredients, then roll into small balls approx the size of walnuts. Flatten with a teaspoon and bake at 190°c for 20 to 30 min's till golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bisquick baking mix,bow tie pasta,green onion,cabbage,cream chicken soup,snow pea,milk powder,celery rib
title: Grandma's Chinese Pasta Salad
ingredients: 9 ounces bow tie pasta | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 cup chopped celery rib | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 12 ounces snow peas, halved | 1/2 cup skim milk powder | 2 tablespoons green onions, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant bisquick baking mix
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package.

title: Baked Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese, sliced thin and cut into small cubes | 1 can ortega chilies, hot hatch chilies only ( the mildest chiles can get ) | 1/3 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons grated locatelli seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | prosciutto, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a 13x9 baking dish, lay out the sliced velveeta squares and sprinkle the slices with about 1/4 cup each of the chilies. In a bowl, mix the bread crumbs with the chilies, onion salt, cardamon, pepper and remaining velveeta. Spoon the bread crumb topping on top. You can serve it cold at room temp, if you like or can keep warm or warm in the oven with foil covering. At this point you can serve with a little extra grated cheese or sliced prosciutto for dipping.

title: Orange Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 1 chicken, quartered | 1 orange, peeled, washed, pith removed, cut in half | 1 small bell pepper, cut in thin strips | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Place chicken, cut side down over medium high heat in 12 inch nonstick frypan. Sprinkle each with salt and pepper. Bake, covered, 25 minutes. Turn chicken over. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes to crisp skin. Turn skin side up. Sprinkle orange halves over chicken. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
