Stir orange halves, bell pepper and whipped topping into pan juices. Cook and stir 5 minutes or until hot.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,pinto bean,onion flake,turkey broth,purpose flour,vanilla vodka,italian dressing
title: Frozen Italian Pork in Beans
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless shoulder steak, cut into 1/2-inch dice about three cups | 1 can condensed italian dressing, undiluted | 1/2 cup dried onion flakes ( or minced onion ) | 1 teaspoon dried italian dressing ( or 1 tsp. crushed saffron ) | 1 dash cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon dried italian spices ( or 1 tablespoon each crushed dried onion, celery, garlic and oregano ) | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed, divided ( or fresh beans ) | 2 tablespoons unbleached all-purpose flour
instructions: Heat skillet over medium. Add steak.

title: Crockpot Mexican Dip - No Egg
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef or 1/2 lb bulk sausage | 5 1/4 ounces chunky salsa | 1/4 cup canned beef broth | 1/4 cup anchovy, drained and chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot. Cook on low about 7 hours. Serve warm with tortilla chips or use for sandwiches.

title: Bleu Cheese Salad With Chili
ingredients: 1/2 lb blue cheese ( not crumbly ) | 1/4 cup almonds | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons white vinegar
instructions: Combine blue cheese and nuts and refrigerate for 2 hours to let flavors blend. Combine mace, pepper flakes, vinegar and chill.

Random Ingredients: port wine,maple syrup,date,irish whiskey,catsup,green enchilada sauce,shortening,pineapple
title: The McCuddy's Dragon's Eye
ingredients: 8 dates, pitted | 1/4 cup chopped green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup unsweetened catsup | 1/8 cup smoked canadian whiskey, chopped | 1/8 cup port wine | 1/8 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon shortening | 2 teaspoons irish whiskey
instructions: Slit a fresh date in the center of the date. Stuff the date with an arabic touch, securing with a toothpick. Sprinkle green enchilada sauce, catsup, maple syrup, shortening and 1 teaspoons of whiskey over the dates. Marinate with extra whiskey, if desired, while the dates marinate, for 30 minutes before frying.

title: Seedless Black Beans and Oats
ingredients: 1 cup steel cut oats, cracked wheat | 1/4 lb butter | 12 cardamom pods | 2 cups black beans, soaked overnight | 1 tablespoon dried tomatillo
instructions: Soak the steel cut oats overnight. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Place cracked wheat in the pot, and cook for 5 minutes, skimming off any scum. Drain the water and rinse the oat and put to one side. In a frying pan, melt the butter over medium heat, and fry the cardamom pods, stirring frequently for about 2 minutes, or until fragrant. Pour 1/2 cup of the butter onto the cracked wheat. Stirring frequently, fry the oats over low heat for 10 minutes. Add the beans to the wheat. Stir and stir until heated well. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer about 20 to 25 minutes, or until the beans are soft.

title: Chicken Nibbles
ingredients: 6 lbs chicken wings, drumsticks, tips discarded | 2 italian pears, cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks | 1 1/2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large bowl, combine the chicken, pear chunks and bread crumbs. Dip chicken breats in breadcrumbs until coated. Place in a single layer on a rack set in a shallow roasting pan. Bake at 350ºf for about 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through and browned.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,peach,bacon dripping,nutmeg,milk ricotta cheese,portabella mushroom,pizza dough,chicken bouillon cube
title: Roasted Chicken and Sun-Dried Tomato Calzones
ingredients: 2 teaspoons bacon drippings | 1 cup capacola mushrooms or 1 cup other red capsicum, diced | 1 portabella mushroom, sliced | 6 sun-dried tomatoes | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon pine nuts ( optional ) | 1/4 cup skim milk ricotta cheese or 1/4 cup light ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup shredded low fat italian cheese blend | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg, freshly grated | 18 refrigerated pizza crusts ( see related recipe ) or 18 pie crusts ( see related recipe )
instructions: Heat saute pan on medium low heat. Add the bacon drippings and mushrooms. Cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until the mushrooms are softened. Add sun dried tomatoes, crumbled bouillon cube, pine nuts or both and cover the pan. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the tomatoes soften slightly. Remove the sauce from the stove, cool, and stir in the ricotta or light ricotta cheese. Season with the nutmeg. Spoon the sauce onto a greased baking sheet and refrigerate until needed. While the pizza dough is chilling, preheat the oven to 400°f. Spray the tops with cooking spray. Slit each pizza shell about 7 times through the shell to create calzones. Spray both sides with cooking spray and arrange on a baking tray. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until just golden and heated through. To serve, place four calzones on a small plate and put the filling on top. If serving as parties, serve with salsa and guacamole on the side.

title: Pear and Cheese Dessert
ingredients: 1 pear, peeled and finely grated | 3 drops grand marnier | 200 g grated tasty cheese
instructions: Sprinkle the grated cheese over the top of the grated pear and then put the lid on top of the bowl. Allow to stand until the cheese has melted. Serve with biscuits or crusty french bread, crackers or breads.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,broccoli,button mushroom,sage leaf,white wine vinegar,tomato basil oregano garlic
title: Wild Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, chopped | 1 large head broccoli, broken into florets | 1 cup button mushroom or 1 cup asparagus | 4 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage leaves, or | 2 teaspoons dried sage, soaked in | 1/3 cup light sherry vinegar ( white cooking wine vinegar ) | 1 teaspoon chopped tomato basil and oregano in garlic, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place cabbage, broccoli and mushrooms in a roasting pan, arrange in a single layer, and sprinkle with 2 teaspoons vinegar, half of the sage and half of the remaining 1/3 cup vinegar. Roast in oven for 15 minutes, then stir in the chopped remaining sage and 1/3 chopped basil and cook additional 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Add cooked vegetables to sauce and heat through. To serve, divide vegetables between plates and spoon sauce atop.

Random Ingredients: chinese cabbage,green pepper,carrot,vegetable broth,beef bouillon cube,rice
title: Chinese Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet red peppers or 1 1/2 lbs green peppers, sliced in thin strips | 1 cup carrot, cut into thin strips | 1 small head chinese cabbage, cut in quarters | 4 cups vegetable broth, canned | 2 beef bouillon cubes | rice
instructions: Bring soup of any desired strength to a boil.

Random Ingredients: cashew,orange juice zest,black peppercorn,green olive,monterey jack pepper cheese,eggplant,ginger powder,dark brown sugar
title: Eggplant in Spicy Cashew Sauce
ingredients: 3 medium eggplants | 1/2 cup orange juice and zest, grated plus 1 extra zest | 2 cups finely sliced monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 tablespoon black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon ginger powder | 1/2 cup whole cashews | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 - 1/3 cup chopped salted cashews
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Rinse the eggplants and remove the membrane using a melon baller or a melon baller. Place the eggplants on a large platter and toss with the orange zest, grated cheese, peppercorns, ginger, cashews, brown sugar, and chopped salted cashews. Let flavors meld for approximately 10 minutes. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until soft and beginning to caramelize. Enjoy a note, this recipe also goes well with other dishes or as a side dish. Note #2, i sometimes add a little dried ginger and garlic to the marinade to give it a bit of a kick for the color. I prefer this marinade with raw peanuts, which is an expensive spice blend that we often use.

title: Italian Sausage With Amaretti Crust
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 package amaretti cookies
instructions: Pre heat your oven to in a large heavy frypan brown the sausage. In a 9x13 dish, place the amaretti cookies. Take a slice of the sausage and press in the cookies. Continue until the slices are all in the pan. Put mixture in the casserole dish. Bake in oven 10 minutes. Let cool. Refrigerate leftovers.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,corn kernel,quinoa,beef brisket,taco seasoning,chipotle chile adobo
title: Cattleman's Market Style Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 sweet ground beef brisket | 1 package taco seasoning | 10 -12 ounces diced canned chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 1 packet dried quinoa | 1 -2 jalapeno, sliced ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons corn kernels, drained ( optional )
instructions: Brown the brisket in a dutch oven or large pot over medium high heat, until well done, and slightly browned. Reduce heat to medium.

title: Rajas Con Coco E Sal, Puerto Rico (Salmon)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb salmon, skinned and gutted | 2 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven 375f degrees. Pierce salmon several times with a fork or skewer, it should be flaked off. Place salmon on parchment paper lined or lightly greased broiler pan. Sprinkle with cheese. Cook about 10 - 15 min, or until fish is slightly flaky.

title: Cottage Cheese Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1 cup cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons chicken stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Cut 4 slices of beef tenderloin diagonally. Cut each slice in half lengthwise, then crosswise, then use a knife to carefully cut crosswise along one side of each piece to form a pocket. Spread cottage cheese over one side of one beef slice. Place on baking sheet. Bake 20 minutes. Brush with chicken stock. Continue to bake covered for 35 more minutes, or until beef is tender.

title: Homemade Spaghetti, Sweet and Savory-Spittetti
ingredients: 3 cups dry spaghetti | 2 cans sweetened condensed half and half cream | 3/4 jar sweetened sweet red pepper, sliced | 1 jar marshmallows | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the spaghetti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Stir half and half with the red pepper, marshmallows, and maraschino cherries into the hot spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,garlic powder,pecorino romano cheese,dijon mustard,corn tortilla chip
title: Creamy Faux Cheese Fajita Chips (Copycat)
ingredients: 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 cup plain yogurt, nonfat ( artificially sweetened ) | 2 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup corn tortilla chips, crumpled
instructions: Place yogurt in a medium bowl and beat with a fork until smooth, about 1 minute. Stir in cheese, mustard and garlic powder. Spread about 1/2 cup of yogurt mixture on each of the tortilla chips and roll up. Wrap each roll securing with a tooth pick if desired. Repeat steps 2 - 5 with remaining chips and yogurt mixture. Spray frying pan with cooking spray and heat. Add fajitas and cook until golden brown on each side, about 2 minutes per side.

title: Chocolate & Pistachio Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock | 3 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled ( about 20 to 25 ) | 3 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 12 slices bacon, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa | parchment paper, warmed ( or parchment paper )
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a small saucepan. In a blender, puree chiles and puree half of the chiles. In a small skillet, melt chocolate, stir in pistachios and remaining chiles. Reserve 2 tablespoons pistachios. Fry bacon 5 to 7 minutes, until crisp, crumble and add to blender, stir until smooth. Return chile mixture to pan, simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Strain through a fine wire mesh sieve into a bowl, pressing seeds with the back of a spoon. Return chile mixture to pan, add cocoa and mix. Place chiles on parchment paper, sprinkle with remaining pistachios. Cool. Cut into strips and serve.

title: Crispy Baked Flounder
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 3 pieces | 2 pounds flounder fillets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the steaks in a glass baking dish and cover each piece with the stew meat. Cover the dish and bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove cover, and bake for another 15 minutes, or until the pieces have turned white. Meanwhile, place a pot of water on the stove and bring to a boil. Rinse fish with cold water. Rinse with cold water.

title: Easy Marinated Beef
ingredients: 5 lbs beef stew meat, boneless and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 package spanish onion, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 4 -6 cups water ( i use beef broth ) | 5 teaspoons oregano | 2 teaspoons cardamom | 2 cans beer or ( 330 ml ) cans non-alcoholic beer
instructions: Combine all ingredients except beer. Cover and let sit 48 - 48 hours. Drain off the brine and reserve broth. Place beef in slow cooker pan and cover with reserved broth. Cover and cook on high for 9 - 10 hours. Remove beef. Place on platter with a slotted spoon. Stir enough reserved broth to make gravy. Pour gravy over top. Serve in shallow soup dishes or bowls.

Random Ingredients: meat,triple sec,savoy cabbage,plain flour,cheddar cheese,active yeast,haddock,plum tomato
title: Beef Slider #4
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups plain flour, plus | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 200 g mincemeat | 2 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 savoy cabbage or 1 savoy cabbage, sliced | 150 g cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon double sec | 1 1/2 cups treacle ( treacle is preferred but i use molasses ) or 1 1/2 cups molasses ( treacle is preferred but i use molasses )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in ½ cup warm water. In a large bowl, mix flour and salt. Make a well in the centre then add yeast mixture. Stir in mince, tomato, cabbage, and cheese. Mix together with spoon and knead until soft dough forms. Place on lightly oiled baking sheets and rise in a warm place for 30 mins, or until dough is about double in size. Turn the oven down to 200 degrees celsius. Roll dough out to a thickness of about 12 x 10, then place on baking sheets, about ¼ inch thick. Using a fork mark a cross about ¼ of the slider into the top of the slider. Cover, and let rise until double 40 mins. Turn oven down to 150 degrees celsius and bake for 15 - 30 mins until crust is crisp.

title: Easy Curry Powder
ingredients: 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Toast the garam masala with salt. Use as per your preferences on the package.

title: Roasted Tuna, Beef & Penne
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked penne pasta | 1 1/4 lbs fresh tuna steaks | 1/3 cup brandy or 1/3 cup cooking sherry | 3/4 cup canned small white tuna with capers, drained
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, remove tuna from bones and slice into 1/2 inch pieces. Combine pasta, tuna, brandy or sherry and toss well. Serve.

title: Spicy Grilled Harissa-Spiced Lettuce (Gari)
ingredients: 1 head lettuce ( baby cos leaves ) | 1 tablespoon finely diced hot red chili | 1 tablespoon finely diced habanero pepper ( fresh ) | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Lightly oil and line baking sheet with foil or parchment paper. Arrange lettuce leaves in a single layer on pan. In a small bowl, combine chilli, habanero and cream. Spread cream mixture onto each leaf and sprinkle with chilli mixture.

title: Chutney Dippies
ingredients: 2 cups mango chutney, chopped | 2 eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together mango chutney and eggs. Drop the mixture by rounded tablespoonsfuls into the boiling chutney. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the dippers are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,baking powder,vegetable,lemon peel,dark rum,maraschino cherry,chicken tender,cauliflower
title: Mexican Chicken Tenders With Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, cut into 2 inches florets | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel | 1 lb chicken tenders, cut in to 2-inch pieces | vegetables, of choice | 3 tablespoons dijon-style prepared dark rum | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f degrees. In a large nonstick skillet sprayed with nonstick spray, cook each piece of chicken over medium heat for 3 minutes per side, or until golden brown. Remove chicken to casserole dish and cover with foil to keep warm. Boil the cauliflower in salted water for about 10 minutes, or until just tender. Drain and set aside. In a small skillet on medium high heat, heat 2 tablespoons of the rum until very warm. Add chipotle pepper and lemon peel. Toast for 30 seconds or until fragrant. Remove skillet from heat and add toasted mushroom mixture. Add the chicken, stirring to coat well. Serve the chicken over your choice of steamed green salad and garnish with maraschino cherries.

Random Ingredients: yellow curry paste,dark chocolate,belgian endive,egg wrap,buttermilk,chicken broth
title: Endive and Chocolate Wrapped Belgian Endive (Ww 5 Points)
ingredients: 3 belgian endives, leaves only | 1 1/3 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon yellow curry paste, divided | 1/4 cup buttermilk or 1/4 cup sour milk | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, grated | egg roll wrap
instructions: Cut endives in half lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place on baking sheet and brush with 2 tablespoons of the curry paste and 1/2 cup of the buttermilk, stirring until paste dissolves. Bake, uncovered at 450° f for 10 to 12 minutes or until browned. Melt remaining 1 tablespoon of curry paste with the milk and 1 tablespoon of the grated chocolate in a small saucepan over low heat. Cook, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes or until chocolate is smooth. Cool. Spread curry paste mixture onto endives slices in a single layer, leaving about 1 1/2 inch border around the edge. Brush with remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons of curry paste. Spoon chocolate mixture over filling. Fold ends of endives around filling.

title: Lighter Antipasto
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon cognac | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 3 tomatoes, diced | 1 ounce pimiento, minced | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped or torn | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.

title: Spanish Oat Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lb hamburger | 3 tablespoons finely chopped candied lemon peel | 1/4 cup old fashioned oats ( old fashioned ) | 1 tablespoon mustard oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 1/2 cup currants
instructions: Divide meat among 4 - 5 individual molds or 1 quart heavy duty freezer dish. Heat remaining ingredients except currants, in a medium skillet, stirring to blend, until sugar is dissolved. Cook over medium high heat for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, then remove pan from heat. Divide meat among molds or dish and press currants over meat. Cover tightly and freeze until solid, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove from freezer and uncover. Turn off temperature and place in freezer 6 - 8 hours or overnight, turning several times during preparation.

Random Ingredients: star anise pod,stir fry sauce,hard egg,chicken wing
title: Stir Fry Glazed Wings
ingredients: 24 large chicken wings | 2 tablespoons stir-fry sauce | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 2 star anise pods, crushed
instructions: Remove tips and wings from heads, rinse and dry. Thread wings separately onto metal skewers. Preheat broiler. Place chicken on broiler rack, broil 3 to 5 minutes on each side, until browned and cooked through, turning occasionally. Meanwhile, cover with aluminum foil and keep door closed. Stir fry sauce and eggs together in a small skillet, until eggs are set, stir in anise pods, heat through. Spoon heated glaze over wings.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,blackstrap molasses,red chili pepper,rice,rose water
title: Mahogany Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup rice, washed, soaked in water for 20 minutes and drained again | 1 lb pork tenderloin or 1 lb other pork roast | 2 teaspoons rose water | 1 teaspoon blackstrap molasses | 1 red chili pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the rice, pork, rose water, molasses and chili and mix thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,chicken bouillon cube,peanut oil,icing sugar
title: Cardamom Chicken
ingredients: 6 medium cardamom pods | 8 chicken bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons icing sugar, sifted | 3 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Remove cardamom pods, reserving pods and discard. Place them in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle and crush. Place 1 cube of powdered cardamom in small bowl and use a mortar and pestle to crush the same. Gradually stir cardamom into oil in a heavy base skillet or skillet and heat over medium low heat. When mixture boils, discard cardamom pods before adding to frying. Add the chicken and fry for about 45 seconds or until chicken is browned. Add sifted icing sugar and cardamom pods. Stir and fry another 30 seconds or until the oil is hot. Serve with rice.

title: Drew's Brown Rice Blend Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice flour | 1 1/2 pinches ground cardamom | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons truffle oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients into your dry ingredients and mix well. Store in a ziplock bag, then refrigerate for up to one week for best results.

title: Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 3 chicken thighs, skinless ( with bone in if you don't like to ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinate for a minimum of two hours.

title: Gingerroot and Leek Poppers
ingredients: 1 cup dried gingersawed gingerroot | 1/2 lb leek, ends trimmed ( about 12 medium ) | 2 lbs unbleached all-purpose white flour | 3 ounces queso fresco, crumbled | 16 toothpicks
instructions: Cut off and remove any grit from leeks. Cut leeks into 1 lengthwise slices, then crosswise into 1 slices. Transfer to a bowl of cold water, rinse in cold water, drain. Stir together the gingerroot, leek and flour. Toss with cheese until well coated. Place strips of cheese on the workbench, and shape into patties. Roll each patty over to coat with lemon grass dough, and place on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400, for 10 - 12 minutes or until dry. Serve hot or room temperature. Note, to lightly toast the pisto, heat cast iron frying pan over medium heat. When hot, turn once.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,double cream,poultry seasoning,chili flake,corn flake,navy bean
title: Chilli & Creamy White Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 cup canned navy beans | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon lemon juice and zest | 1 pinch poultry seasoning | 1 tablespoon corn flakes | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Cook beans until tender then drain. Combine all ingredients and stir till well mixed. Do not over mix. Chill overnight.

Random Ingredients: caper,lime zest,cinnamon sugar,vegetable stock,hot italian sausage,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Sausage With a Kick
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, sliced, 1/4-inch thick ( sweet with prawns if you can find them. ) | 1 tablespoon veggie stock | 2 teaspoons fresh lime zest | cinnamon sugar | 30 canned artichoke hearts, drained and chopped ( reserve juice ) | 1/2 cup capers
instructions: Preheat oven to 325. Season sausages with a pinch salt and pepper and rub off excess. Pour vegetable stock over sausage in a 13x9 baking dish. Spread zest around sausage. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar, then add artichoke hearts. Pour reserved juice around sausage and artichoke hearts, then cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 30 minutes. Place pan on a platter and serve with fresh bread or fresh bread cubes for a complete meal, such as pasta.

title: Cherry Streusel
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cherries, pitted | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup capers
instructions: Toss cherries with flour in baking pan at least 15 minutes. Cover with capers and bake in 325 degree oven til flour and capers are lightly browned. Cool to room temperature.

title: Kittencal's 5 Point Breakfast Muesli
ingredients: 1 container whole wheat cereal ( i used 2 % fat, 1/2 tsp 1 tsp cornstarch, 1/2 tsp. salt & 3/4 tsp. ground cinnamon ) | 1/2 lb fat free mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to spread half of the cereal on a large plate. Sprinkle half of the cheese on the cereal. Dip the mozzarella cheese into the remaining cereal & cheese. Place on large baking sheet & bake for about 25 minutes or until the edges of the cheese are starting to turn golden. Remove from oven & cut into 2 equal pieces.

title: Enchilada Rice
ingredients: 1 jar enchilada sauce | 1 dash saffron threads | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Line a 13x9 inches baking dish with foil. Stir enchilada sauce and saffron in large bowl to blend. Spoon half of the enchilada sauce into the bottom of baking dish. Spread half of the swiss cheese over the sauce. Cover with remaining sauce and sprinkle with remaining swiss cheese. Cook uncovered about 25 minutes, or until cheese is lightly browned and bubbly. Serve with green salad or tortilla chips.

title: Velvetta
ingredients: 8 ounces velveeta cheese | 12 ounces frozen limeade concentrate | 6 ounces snow peas | 4 -6 ounces cucumbers ( sliced )
instructions: Place cheese, limeade concentrate, snow peas and cucumbers in crock pot. Heat on low for at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,mint leaf,thyme,heavy whipping cream,cherry tomato
title: Tomato & Sage Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 4 cups packed fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup packed fresh sage leaf | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, chopped | 15 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: In a medium size heavy sauté pan, combine the cream, mint, sage, thyme and tomatoes. Cook over medium heat until mint is tender and it reduces to 1 1/2 cups, about 8 minutes. Do not burn the tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,flat bread,extra virgin olive oil,amaretto,puff pastry
title: Cheesy Pizza With Amaretto and Yogurt
ingredients: 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 12 ounces puff pastry | 1 1/2 cups plain greek yogurt | 1/2 cup amaretto ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons amaretti ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons of olive oil in a skillet. Remove the cooked pizza from the oven and place it on a cookie sheet. Cut the puff pastry into 8 squares. Place 1/4 cup of yogurt onto four of the squares, and drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Spoon some amaretti onto the yogurt, and arrange the other four squares on top. Bake for 20 minutes, until nicely browned on the top.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,grape leaf,dark beer,chickpea flour,russet potato,cinnamon,red tomato,sesame oil
title: Chickpea Burgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 16 grape leaves | 4 medium russet potatoes, peeled, cut in half lengthwise and halved | 1 can red plum tomatoes, quartered and seeded | 1/4 cup dark beer | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons pumpkin seed flour
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Place the grape leaves in the pan, and cook for a few seconds, so they soften. Remove from heat, and set aside. Cut the potatoes in half lengthwise, then into 4 crosswise slices. Pierce the tomatoes with a fork several times, and place them cut side down on the grape leaves. Pour the can of tomatoes into a large resealable plastic bag, add the beer, cinnamon, and anchovy paste, and carefully toss the ingredients together until the batter is evenly coated and the tomatoes are coated with the marinade. Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium low heat. Place approximately 2 tablespoons of the potato mixture in a criss cross pattern into the hot oil. Fry the patties in the hot oil until lightly browned on the bottom, about 5 minutes, then flip the patties over and fry for a few more minutes. The cooked burgers should have the consistency of a medium burger.

Random Ingredients: nectarine,carnation milk,oriental flavor ramen noodle,sirloin tip roast,kale,tomato green chilies
title: Kelly's Kale Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast, partially frozen | 1 can carnation evaporated milk | 2 tablespoons dried italian-flavor instant ramen noodles | 2 cans tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 4 cups coarsely chopped kale | 1/2 cup shredded kale or 1/2 cup torn kale leaves
instructions: Using a 6 - 5 ounce crock pot liner, place frozen roast on the bottom. Drain fat from the roast and arrange in a slow cooker. Stir in remaining ingredients and stir to mix well. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours or until hot and the liquid is reduced to 3 cups.

title: Cranberry-Raisin Soup
ingredients: 10 ounces cranberries | 1 ounce dried thyme ( or other herb mix ) | 1 -2 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Rinse cranberries and thyme. Put all ingredients in crock pot. Cook on low for 8 hours. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,pecorino romano cheese,italian parsley,fish sauce,dill,chili pepper flake,canola oil
title: Nam Prik Num
ingredients: canola oil or canola oil | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1 -2 pinch chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese, or more to taste | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh dill | fine sea salt
instructions: Heat the canola oil over medium heat. Add the fish sauce and chili flakes.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,pear,dark chili powder,mustard,lamb,red bell pepper,chickpea,cilantro stem
title: Curried Lamb With Chickpeas, Red Bell Pepper & Almonds
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb, cut in 2 inch cubes | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 red bell peppers, cored, seeded and finely diced | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dark chili powder | 3/4 teaspoon almond extract | fresh cilantro stem | 1/4 cup dark-chili peppers or 1/4 cup cayenne powder
instructions: Place lamb and chickpeas in a 5 quart slow cooker. Stir in the peppers, mustard, chili powder and ground almond extract.

title: Tasty Chipotle Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 red capsicums | 1 ounce apple, fresh chopped | 1/2 ounce mint leaf | 1 chipotle chile, fresh chopped | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon low-fat tea, strong
instructions: Peel and remove seeds from capsicums under running water. Cut into chunks. In a food processor pulse all ingredients except raisins or nuts until finely chopped. Pour into a small non metallic bowl with raisins or nuts. Cover with foil and refrigerate to marinate for 30 minutes. Serve in a hollowed green leafy bun with salsa fresca and other dip accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,sazon goya seasoning,saltine cracker,plum tomato,red pepper flake,salt pepper
title: Sazon Tomatoes With Cracker Crackers
ingredients: 2 lbs plum tomatoes | 4 teaspoons adobo sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sazon goya seasoning | 1 pinch salt & pepper | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes | 2 cups saltine crackers
instructions: Cut each tomato horizontally through its equator. Using a spoon, scoop out pulp and seeds and discard. Wash well. Cut pulp into pieces about 1&1/2 inches square, 2&#8260.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,cayenne pepper,white sugar,rosemary,mochi rice,parmesan cheese,parsnip,herbes de provence
title: Maccheroni
ingredients: parmesan cheese, freshly grated | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1 dash ground white pepper | 1 dash cayenne pepper with herbs | 1 pinch dried rosemary | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 lb mochi rice | 1 medium parsnip, peeled and cut into small pieces
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the parsnips. Put in medium sized casserole dish. Bake in preheated oven at 375 degrees f. For about an hour or until rice is tender and dry. Stir before serving. Sprinkle with fresh parsley before serving.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,vegetable,saffron thread,baby carrot,brown sugar,worcestershire sauce,cheese,rosemary leaf
title: Cheese Veggies in Saffron Sauce
ingredients: 1 -2 cup mixed vegetables, cooked | 1 cup baby carrots | 1 teaspoon crushed saffron thread | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 3 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1 dash hot tabasco sauce | 3/4 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Spray crockpot with nonstick spray or lightly spray with cooking spray. In large bowl, add all the veggies, saffron, sugar, worcestershire sauce rosemary, tabasco sauce and hot sauce. Stir until well coated. Turn on crockpot on high for 3 - 4 hours or low for 6 - 8 hours. Add cheese and stir well. Pour into serving dish and allow to cool to room temperature serve with pita bread.

title: Avocado Salad
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes, skinned and mashed with fork | 1/2 cup pimiento, chopped | 3 tablespoons brandy | 1/4 cup molasses | 3 tablespoons chopped italian seasoning or 3 tablespoons cajun seasoning, with basil and oregano ( optional ) | 2 cups torn iceberg lettuce | iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Cut the avocados in half and remove the pit. Place the halves, cut side down, on two or four plates. Cut the tops into halves. Mix the pimento, pisco and molasses in a small bowl and pour over the avocados. Sprinkle with the italian seasoning or cajun seasoning. Let set at least 30 minutes or so, if possible. Garnish with the torn iceberg lettuce. Serve cold.

title: Nana's "Bis for Breakfast"
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups half-and-half ( or milk and cream ) | 2 cups hot water | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve on a hot buttered platter for breakfast or cold brunch.

title: Vegetarian Gyoza
ingredients: 11 lasagna noodles | 1 can pumpkin puree | 3 cups fresh baby peas or fresh as needed | 3 ounces canned apricots, sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic, peeled | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger root
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place noodles in a medium bowl, and cover with about 1/2 cup water. Let stand about 10 minutes. Rinse to remove any excess water. Combine pumpkin, peas, apricots, garlic, salt, and ginger in a large pot over low heat. Cook, stirring occasionally until heated through. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna noodles and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: black olive,lemon zest,chinese five spice powder,green apple
title: Five-Spice Apple Chutney
ingredients: 3 lbs green apples ( about 2.75 ) or 3 lbs red delicious apples, such as the fuji ( about 2.75 ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 12 cups pitted black olives, very coarsely chopped ( about 2.5 pounds ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated
instructions: Peel, core and dice apples. Place apples in a 4 to 6 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle five spice powder over top. Pour remaining ingredients into cooker through food mill or force through a fine mesh sieve. Cover and cook on high setting 4 to 5 hours. Serve warm or chilled, with any chutney topping of your choosing or as an accompaniment to savoyard scones.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,oyster sauce,apricot,bulk italian sausage,bean black,polish sausage
title: Polish Sausages or Tails With Beans (An Sausages for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage or 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | 1/2 lb bulk italian sausage | 1/3 cup chopped dried ancho or 1/3 cup dried apricot | 3/4 cup dried sweet potato flakes or 3/4 cup instant hot bean sprouts | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 3 tablespoons tamarind pulp, soaked in | 2 tablespoons hot tap water
instructions: Make the sausage filling. If you don't have an ancho or apricots, crush the ingredients together and mix into the casings. If it is too hard, you can mix in a bit more tamarind juice. If the filling is too soft, add more sweetner oyster sauce. Pour the boiling water over the sausage or sausages. Cook sausage over medium to medium high heat to make a browned crust. Drain. Add the cooked sausage, the onions or the sweet potatoes, sausage filling and the sauces. Cook for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. If necessary, reduce the heat and steam only until the sausage appears to separate from the vegetables. Serve with mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,corn tortilla chip,pizza sauce,beetroot,double cream,black peppercorn,maraschino cherry,chili sauce
title: Beetroot & Chilli Cream Dip
ingredients: 4 beetroots, peeled, halved, quartered, and cut into 1cm cubes ( about 200g ) | 4 -5 teaspoons black peppercorns, deseeded, lightly crushed | 4 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1 -2 fluid ounce sweet chili sauce | 100 ml pizza sauce | 250 ml double cream | 2 -3 tablespoons maraschino cherries ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | crushed corn tortilla chips or baked potato chips, to serve ( optional ) | purchased prepared pizza sauce, to serve
instructions: Pierce the beetroot with a fork, and place on a plate, sprinkle with pepper and pour over the vinegar. Leave to soak in the vinegar for 20 minutes, or until the beets become very tender but still holding its shape. Drain, and set aside to cool. Blend the chilli sauce, pizza sauce, cream and cherries together, until smooth. Use a spoon to scrape the beetroot, chilli, and pepper mixture from the root. Toss the mixture through the prepared dip, then chill until the dip is set. Serve with crushed tortilla or potato chips or your favourite crumb topping.

title: Awesome Cannelloni
ingredients: 5 cans crushed pineapple, drained | 10 lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine the drained pineapple, lasagna noodles, and crushed pineapple in a large baking dish. Cover, and bake in the preheated oven 30 to 40 minutes, or until the noodles are cooked through and the filling is hot.

title: Quickie Queso Fundido
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden syrup ( or use maple syrup ) | 1 bag mexican blend cheese, softened | 1/2 cup chopped roasted poblano pepper | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mushrooms
instructions: Heat the golden syrup in a small saucepan over low heat until bubbling, but do not boil as the syrup should still be warm, about 5 - 10 minutes. Stir in the cheese until melted and blended. Stir in the poblano peppers and mushrooms. To store, put each one in a tightly closed container. Use within 3 months if using.

title: Persian Green Olives
ingredients: 1 pound green olives | 1 tablespoon ground ginger | 12 walnuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 320 degrees f. Place olives, ginger, and walnuts onto baking sheets. Bake in a preheated oven for 1 hour.

title: Roasted Pine Nut Mushrooms
ingredients: cooking spray | 3 pounds mixed fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange mushrooms on the baking sheet. Spray tops of mushrooms with cooking spray. Roast in the preheated oven until the mushrooms are darkly and tender, about 45 minutes. Heat pine nuts in a large skillet over medium heat until well flavored, about 5 minutes. Stir the cayenne pepper into the pine nuts.

title: Buttermilk Meatball Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 slices nori | 8 large leafy lettuce leaves or 8 large green leafy lettuce | 6 whole cardamom pods | 3 tablespoons low-fat buttermilk | 3 tablespoons cold water chestnuts, minced | 1/2 cup matzo meal | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Cut 5 slices of nori into 4 even slices. Place on a hot griddle until lightly toasted, turn and cook until blackened, about 10 to 15 seconds. Transfer to a plate. Wipe out grill. Place nori on grill, sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder. Grill until lightly browned, turning often and placing blackened nori slices near the cooked side, about 4 to 5 minutes for medium rare to medium rare.

title: Spanish Sausage and Peas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yellow split peas | 2 links hot italian sausage, cut in 1/4 inch slices | 12 ounces guacamole | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 2 tablespoons hot paprika
instructions: Place split peas in a small bowl & pour enough boiling water over to cover. Let sit 15 minutes or just until tender. Drain well & set aside. Meanwhile, season sausage slices with a mixture of the dried marjoram and paprika. Heat skillet to high. Saute sausage slices, turning occasionally, about 5 minutes.

title: Italian Tomato Relish
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup shredded coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil, crushed
instructions: In a small container, blend tomato sauce and coleslaw mix. Sprinkle onion and basil over relish and stir. Chill, covered, at least 1 hour. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Fennel Infused Tomato Paste for Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup pure olive oil | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 can crushed tomatoes with paste | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Once oil is hot, stir in the vanilla sugar. Pour the contents of the can into the pan, and boil rapidly until the syrup reaches 220 degrees f on an instant reading thermometer. Stir frequently while the syrup caramelizes. Once syrup reaches 220 degrees f, pour oil into a bowl, and add the fennel seeds, stir, and set aside. Pour tomato sauce into the sugar syrup, and simmer over medium heat for about 1 minute, stirring frequently, until the sauce is thick. Cool thoroughly. This will keep in frig for a couple of weeks.

title: Meatloaf With Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mixed minced meat | 2 cups mixed fresh fruit | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 egg white | 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup fresh peas | 2/3 cup mozzarella cheese
instructions: Mix together meat, fruit, sesame oil, egg white, mayonnaise, and peas. Spread the mixture into a 9x9x2 inch loaf pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Bake in preheated 375°f oven for 45 minutes or until center is no longer pink and top is lightly browned. Cut into wedges and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: dill,turmeric,chili powder,macaroni,cannellini bean,yogurt,coriander powder,graham cracker crumb
title: Macaroni & Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup low fat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 2 pinches chili powder ( or more to your taste ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 -2 tablespoon dill ( can use a teaspoon dried dill ) | 1 3/4 cups macaroni | 2 pinches coriander powder ( can use a teaspoon dried coriander ) | 1 1/2 cups crushed graham crackers ( about )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Prepare a 9 x 13 glass backing dish and coat with cooking spray. Bake in oven for about 35 minutes, until the edges begin to brown at the edges. This can be done as before, by pre heating the baking dish first and then turning out before the next step. Drain the canned canellini beans and set aside. While the oven is preheating, mix the yogurt and spices together in a bowl. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil over high heat. Add the pasta to the boiling water. Cook until tender but firm to the bite, stirring frequently. Drain pasta well. Layer the cooked drained pasta into the bottom of prepared dish, followed by a layer of chopped onion, beans, and last of pasta. Spread with the yogurt mixture. Sprinkle the crushed graham cracker crumbs on top. Cover with foil and bake for 25 - 30 minutes, until heated thru and the topping is nicely browned.

title: Enchiladas Verdes
ingredients: 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 3 ounces stilton cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f in a small saucepan combine the cheese and enchilada sauce. Cook for 20 minutes. Place cheese mixture in a bowl, and stir 1/2 of the enchilada sauce into the cheese. Spoon cheese mixture into small, 2 1/2 x 1 1/2 inch casseroles that have been lightly lightly coated with cooking spray. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon raisin bread,extra sharp cheddar cheese,black pepper,chicken breast half,icing sugar,sage,swiss cheese,cumin powder
title: Grilled Chicken Breasts With Sage and Swiss Cheese Topping
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, about 1-inch thick | 1 1/2 cups of shredded extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1 1/2 cups cinnamon raisin bread, toasted and cubed | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( fresh would be better ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage | 1 1/2 tablespoons icing sugar ( powdered sugar )
instructions: Toast the raisin bread in a frying pan, but not to burn. Rub the chicken inside and outside with the toasted bread. Place the chicken on large plates and top with cheddar, swiss, cinnamon raisin bread and sage cheese topping mixture.

Random Ingredients: chicken,taco seasoning mix,apricot nectar,venison stew meat,dijon mustard,rump steak,potato starch,alfalfa sprout
title: Mexican Beef, Potatoes and Roasted Venison Casserole #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 4 -5 lbs lean ground venison or 4 -5 lbs lean ground beef | 24 ounces apricot nectar | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 8 ounces refrigerated fully cooked lean deli-style ground round or 8 ounces lean deli-style turkey | 2 packages hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing | 1 bag whole alfalfa sprouts
instructions: Combine diced potatoes, venison/beef, nectar, taco seasoning mix and mustard in large bowl. Refrigerate 30 minutes, stirring every 45 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread half the meat mix into an 11 x 7 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the top with olives. Spread alfalfa sprouts over meat. Repeat layers. Cover, bake 40 - 50 minutes, or until potatoes are browned and meat is cooked. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer, then remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining 1 package of ranch dressing.

title: Mexican-Style Corn
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Heat and stir corn, tomato juice, and water in a saucepan over medium low heat until heated through, 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,baking potato,cremini mushroom,green chilies
title: Easy Mexican Potatoes
ingredients: 2 medium baking potatoes | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 8 -10 cremini mushrooms, sliced thin | 2 -4 fresh green chilies, sliced thin ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Remove a 2 inch piece of parchment paper or wax paper from large, heavy duty aluminum foil. Spray foil with nonstick cooking spray. Place potatoes on baking sheet. Cover with a few pats of water. Bake potatoes 20 minutes or until tender when pierced with fork. Meanwhile, in a bowl, cook mushrooms with green chiles in a couple of tablespoons water until tender. Transfer the cooked mushrooms to a bowl using a slotted spoon and set aside. Stir mushrooms into potatoes and set aside. To serve, remove the potatoes from the oven. Place potato on a platter. Spoon mushroom mixture over them and serve. Garnish with cilantro, if desired.

Random Ingredients: white onion,chili oil,tilapia fillet,cayenne pepper,gherkin,date,guinness stout,pistachio
title: Lipturitas with Guinness Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 white onion, minced | 1 green shallot, minced | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 2 cans guinness stout, chilled | 1/4 cup pistachios, chopped | 1/4 cup dates, chopped | 1 sprig fresh gherkin | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Mix onions and green shallot in a soup pot using a whisk. Heat chili oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook and stir onion mixture until it is softened and transparent. Stir guinness and pistachios into the onion mixture.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,red beet,tomato green chilies,vanilla,puff pastry,french green bean,russet potato,cider vinegar
title: Spanish Vegetarian Pie
ingredients: 2 medium russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 medium red beet, peeled and diced | 1 medium french style green bean, diced | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed ( i used pepperidge farm brand ) | 3/4 cup cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons dry french-fried green olives ( optional ) or 3 tablespoons drained stuffed green olives, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water until tender.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,beef tenderloin,chocolate ice cream,hard egg
title: Phyllo Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain chocolate ice cream | 1 1/4 lbs beef tenderloin ( trimmed ) | 2 hard-boiled eggs ( peeled, cut crosswise into 4 slices ) | 2 packages phyllo dough, defrosted if frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix together 1/2 cup of the ice cream and 1/4 cup of the beef tenderloin cheese. Lightly spray 2 or more baking sheets with cooking spray. Cut meat slices into 18 1/4 wide strips. Place about 1 tablespoon of the cheese mixture in each phyllo square. Top with a slice of egg and a few mint leaves. Fold meat strips over. Then fold the sides and bottoms over, making sure the beef is securely enclosed. Lightly brush the outside of phyllo rolls with water. Spray phyllo dough with cooking spray and place seam side down on baking sheets. Repeat with remaining pastry and beef slices. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mushroom-Tomatillo Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles, broken into 2 to 3 inch pieces | 2 cups boiling water, or as directed on the package ( optional ) | 1 1/2 pounds fresh fresh tomatillos, husks removed | 1 can diced jalapeno peppers | 1 bunch fresh basil, leaves picked and tightly packed | 1 tablespoon dried epazote leaves | 3/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring water to a boil in a saucepan. Cook lasagna noodles in the boiling water until al dente, 2 to 4 minutes. Rinse and gently squeeze dry with a paper towel. Combine tomatillos, jalapeno peppers, basil, and epazote in a bowl. Place 1/2 cup tomato mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with another 1/2 cup tomato mixture. Repeat layering, ending with tomato mixture. Sprinkle basil and epazote mixture over top of tomato mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until top is starting to brown, 30 to 40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,orange,bean sprout,fruit peel,rump steak,plain flour,hash brown potato,lemon juice
title: Crispy Beef and Bean Sprout Hash-Potato Bake (Cook's Illust
ingredients: 2 lbs rump steak, cut into 1-inch squares | 2 lemons, juice of | 3 1/2 ounces orange rind, finely grated ( or 1/4 tsp orange extract ) | 1 ounce lemon juice | 2 1/2 ounces mixed dried fruit peel | 1 3/4 cups plain flour | 1/2 lb fresh mixed sprouts | 1 1/4 lbs mixed dried fruit sprouts | 1/2 lb russet potato, peeled, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except flour, beans sprouts and potato in a large ovenproof dish, tossing lightly to combine. Cover with foil and bake at 220°c for 1 hour, toss and bake an further 40 minutes, stirring now and then. Remove from oven and stir in any leftover ingredients. Leave in the tin for 15 minutes, or until the potatoes are cooked. Serve with custard and some fresh green herbs.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,coriander,kielbasa,gruyere cheese,chili sauce,flat leaf parsley,chicken breast
title: Chicken Kielbasa With Gruyere and Green Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb kale | 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 tablespoon grated fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1 green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 lb gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Remove the leaves from the heads of the kale and separate the leaves into leaves. Rinse the leaves and cut them crosswise into 2/3 inch wide strips with a sharp knife. Rinse the chicken completely and pat dry. Combine the chicken with the chili sauce, chopped fresh parsley, coriander and the green chile. Place into a glass baking dish in single layer. Sprinkle with the cheese and cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until chicken is cooked through, and vegetables are browned. Allow to rest 5 minutes, before slicing into pieces. Serve warm.

title: Mellow Heirloom Tomato Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces heirloom tomatoes, sliced | 4 ounces coarsely chopped peanuts, such as walnuts | 1/2 cup good-quality vodka
instructions: Thoroughly combine the tomatoes, roasted peanuts, and about 2 tablespoons vodka in a bowl. Taste and add additional vodka if desired, to perk up the flavors. Serve.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,dijon mustard,creme de cassis,chicken breast meat,ricotta cheese,stir fry vegetable,red pepper flake,extra virgin olive oil
title: Baked Chicken with Mushrooms and Swiss Chard
ingredients: 4 slices swiss chard | 1 package hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dijon dressing | 8 ounces ricotta cheese, lowfat okay | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon creme de cassis | 2 boneless skinless chicken breast meat, about 1 pound | 1/4 - 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 cup frozen stir-fry vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Tear swiss chard leaves into strips and place in a small bowl. Toss with 1/4 cup of extra virgin olive oil and 2 tablespoons of dijon mustard. Spread about 1/4 cup of dressing onto chard and top with chard. Bake until just tender, about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of dijon french dressing, creme de cassis and red pepper flakes. Let stand 5 minutes so the flavors can combine. Serve immediately. For the veggie chicken, drizzle additional virgin olive oil onto a baking sheet, about 15 and place on middle rack of the broiler. Bake until just tender. Serve over the veggie chicken if desired.

title: Green Beans With Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, ends trimmed | 1/4 - 1/3 lb ham, diced | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 12 cardamom pods, cracked ( optional ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped | 1 tablespoon freshly sliced pear ( optional )
instructions: Trim ends from fresh green beans and snap off ends if fresh. Rinse beans and snap off string if large. Cook green beans, ham, garlic and cardamom in rapidly boiling salted water until beans are tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Add basil and continue to boil 2 minutes until basil is wilted. Stir in green beans and pour on about 1/3 cup of sauce. Cook 2 minutes or until heated through.

title: Homemade Basic Stock for Salisbury Steak (Durkee)
ingredients: 4 gallons oil for frying | 8 bay leaves
instructions: Heat 1 gallon of oil for frying at 300 degrees f. Combine the bay leaves before using in a bowl. Once oil is hot enough with bay leaves in, dip floured finger into oil to cover, then into bay leaves to cover.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,lamb shoulder,caster sugar,head cabbage,pecan,beef chuck steak,dill pickle
title: Beef and Cabbage Kål Kål (Wurst Meat in Cabbage)
ingredients: 6 beef chuck steaks ( approximately 80 � x 4 � in across. ) | 500 g lean lamb shoulder | 1 large head of cabbage ( approx 18 cups ) or ( 500 ml ) head of kale, washed and shredded ( approximately 18 cups ) | 3 large dill pickles, sliced thinly ( about 6 ounces ) | 1 cup toasted pecans | 3/4 cup caster sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill pickle
instructions: Prepare the meat and set it aside. Place another large pan over high heat for 1½ - 2 minutes, to make a rich deep fat fry pan. Dry roast the meat until browned all over in the hot fat. Remove from the pan, and set aside. Return the pan to a medium heat and, using a slotted spoon, return the meat to the pan. Drain any residual fat. Cook the lamb, turning it over and basting with the fat for 3 - 4 minutes or until browned all over. Return the meat to the pan. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat from the pan and return pan to medium heat. Add the pickles and cabbage. Stirring lightly all the time, add the meat and all of the liquid from the pickles. Cover the pan and bring to the simmer. Turn down the heat as low as possible and simmer gently for 1 hour to 2 hours and 15 minutes or until the meat is very tender. Remove from the heat and set aside. Remove the beef and pickles from the pan and coarsely shred it. Return the meat to the pan, return the pan to the heat and stir in the pecans and sugar. Cook, stirring constantly for 5 minutes, or until the nuts are well coated. Remove from the heat and stir in the pickle, taking care it does not burn.

Random Ingredients: honey,cumin,salt black pepper,basil,chili oil,tamari,spanish onion,extra virgin olive oil
title: Spicy Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings | 1 tablespoon honey ( or agave syrup ) | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 tablespoon chopped fresh basil ( dried basil, if using dry ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a bowl, toss onions with olive oil, tamari, sesame oil, cumin, and basil. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Prawns Poached in White Gravy
ingredients: 1 pint fish roe | 2/3 cup white flour | 2/3 cup dried fruit ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons mustard ( sweet ) | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 1/4 tablespoons pistachios ( optional. toasted, chopped )
instructions: Place the fish roe in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, cover pot and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and set aside for 10 minutes. Drain the fish roe carefully and allow to cool slightly. Mix flour with dijon mustard, chile powder and pistachios. Dredge the prawns carefully in the mixture and deep fry in batches for 3 - 5 minutes, turning once. Drain carefully and serve warm.

title: Asparagus With Hazelnuts and Chilies
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus, trimmed and cut on a diagonal into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice or 1/2 cup lime juice, not the bottled stuff | 1 freshly grated cinnamon | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon zest
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil, add the asparagus and cook until tender crisp, about 2 to 4 minutes. In a small bowl, combine the hazelnuts and chilies. Add to the asparagus and toss gently to coat. Stir in the juice and cinnamon, season to taste and transfer to a serving bowl. Sprinkle with the lemon zest and serve warm..

title: Cherry and anise Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons anise seed | 1 1/2 cups sour cherry, pitted | salt and black pepper to taste | 1 dash ground nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Heat anise seeds in a skillet over medium heat, stirring often to release their fragrance, approximately 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir cherry slices into the ground star anise. Slowly whisk sour cherry juice into sour cherry mixture until sour cherry juice is completely incorporated, about 10 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer to a serving dish, and garnish with ground nutmeg if desired.

title: Pork Adobo from Costa Verde
ingredients: 5 lbs lean pork, with fat | 5 ounces white wine vinegar | 1 ounce caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 1 anaheim chili, seeded, deveined and de-seeded
instructions: Preheat over to 300°f. Cut the meat into slices about 2 inches thick and place in a large roasting tray. Make a marinade with half of the vinegar and half of the sugar using a jug. Brush this over the meat and roast the meat for two hours, turning occasionally and turning regularly. Alternatively cook the meat slowly in its own juices. Remove the meat from the oven, then remove fat and cut into slices about 2 inches wide and 1/4 thick. Place the slices into a bowl or shallow basin, drizzle with marinade and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day remove meat from the marinade, remove the fat and shred meat into smaller pieces. Return the meat to the roasting tray and place in a preheated oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until all the juices have been reduced and all the meat is browned and crisp. Serve hot with a chinese rice, steamed greens or rice noodles.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,mexican cheese,irish cream liqueur,nutmeg,masa harina,mint sprig
title: Irish Snow Pea and Cheese Tamales
ingredients: 6 cups shredded mexican blend cheese ( cheddar also makes a tasty substitute ) | 6 cups snow peas, ends trimmed | 1/2 cup bailey original irish cream liqueur | 1/2 cup freshly grated nutmeg ( or more- please note- i omit this ) | 1/2 1/2 cup masa harina or 1/2 cup cornmeal | finely chopped fresh mint sprig ( to garnish, optional )
instructions: Prepare masa harina, mix first four ingredients together in bowl. Mix in frozen peas, pressing gently with back of spoon to press. Cover & chill for 1 - 2 hours. Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet with lid on medium high. Add masa harina. If using a blender, pulse ingredients to a coarse meal. Remove lid, increase heat to medium high & cook for 15 - 30 seconds. Carefully, using tongs, transfer masa harina mixture in pan to a cutting board. Tightly spread out the masa disk. When it's cooked & still hot, roll out about 1/8 thick & cut into 8 equal squares, then transfer to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Repeat with the remaining disks. Set aside. Remove the filling from refrigerator & reheat using tongs. When heated, pour about 1/3 cup of filling evenly over each tamale. Garnish with chopped mint, if desired.

Random Ingredients: pickle juice,phyllo pastry,guajillo chilies,cherry tomato,beef tenderloin,graham cracker crumb,lemon zest,toothpick
title: Chef John's Pepper Steak
ingredients: dried guajillo chilies : | 12 ounces fresh guajillo chilies, halved lengthwise and seeds scraped | 2 pounds beef tenderloin, thinly sliced | phyllo pastry : | 18 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | toothpicks : | 16 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup chopped pickle juice | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest
instructions: Place the chiles in a skillet over medium low heat.

title: Linguine With Italian Cabbage and Cabbage
ingredients: 3 cups italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 lb linguine
instructions: Cook linguine al dente according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine salad dressing mix and turmeric in large bowl. Add linguine and stir fry about 5 minutes, or until linguine is done.

title: Mushrooms in Brandy
ingredients: 16 fresh shiitake mushroom caps | 1 teaspoon brandy ( optional )
instructions: Trim the mushroom stems, and remove the caps and any tough stalks. Cut off and discard the tough stems of the mushrooms. Cut the mushroom caps into 1/2 to 1 inch size pieces or smaller. If using a mortar and pestle, grind the mushroom pieces until fine. Add a small amount of brandy if you are using immediately, and stir or stir gently to mix. Fill a non reactive frying pan with just enough water to cover the mushrooms. Let it come to a boil. Drop the mushroom pieces in as many small pieces as will fit into the steamer. Cook until the mushrooms float to the surface, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain, and serve.

title: Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1 cup apricot, minced | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Remove apricots from jar and chop very finely. Add honey and vinegar. Heat on stove till honey is melted. Pour over hot fruit. Let cool and use.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,lasagna noodle,creole seasoning,golden raisin,semolina,nonfat yogurt,dark chocolate,egg yolk
title: Easy Raita Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 250 g lasagna noodles | 500 g nonfat yogurt | 4 egg yolks | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 200 g golden raisins | 3 red capsicums | 200 g dark chocolate | semolina, to coat | sliced dark chocolate, to decorate
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Brush a baking dish with a little oish water. Add pasta and cook according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix egg yolks and creole seasoning. Add the yoghurt and egg mixture in a steady stream for 4 - 5 minutes or until just combined. Add raisins, peppers, and chocolate. Stir until melted. Pour sauce over pasta and mix together lightly. Coat the baking dish with semolina on both sides and set aside. Remove baking dish and top with pasta and sauce. Bake for about 40 - 50 minutes until crust is lightly browned. Remove from grill and set aside to cool for a few minutes. Cut into squares and serve with a drizzle of melted dark chocolate for a festive touch.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,lamb meat,avocado,salad green,whipping cream
title: Davatelli for Two
ingredients: 1 avocado - peeled, pitted, and diced | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 pound boneless lamb meat, cut into cubes | 2 teaspoons hot red pepper flakes | 1 bag mixed salad greens, chilled
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the cubed avocado with the whipping cream and hot red pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,green chile ranchero sauce,asafoetida powder,rigatoni pasta,green capsicum
title: Spicy Indian Rigatoni
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 1 red asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 1 can green chile ranchero sauce | 1 green capsicum | 2 teaspoons mild curry powder
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to directions on pack. Meanwhile heat oil in skillet. Add hing and feng and cook for a minute or two. Add chillies to hing and feng and cook on low for a further 5 minutes. Add curry powder and cook for 2 minutes. Add rigatoni and bring to boil. Add capsicum and cook on low for 5 minutes. Serve hot with rice or chapatis.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,curry paste,tamarind paste,italian breadcrumb,green pepper,active yeast
title: Currant Patties
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 1/4 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons peanut sauce red currant jelly | 2 tablespoons mild curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon mild curry paste | 1 large green pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Combine the bread crumbs, tamarind paste & 1 - ¾ cups water in a large bowl. Stir until mixture is smooth. Add the remaining ingredients & mix well with a spoon or a spatula.

Random Ingredients: grouper fillet,italian salad dressing mix,oregano leaf,cinnamon

instructions: Heat a grill pan for high heat. Lightly oil grill pan. Brush fish fillets with salad dressing and sprinkle with oregano, cinnamon, and ground black pepper. Grill fillets 7 to 10 minutes, or until fish flakes easily, basting with dressing mixture during cooking.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,flour tortilla,green pepper,vinegar,sun tomato oil,curry leaf

Random Ingredients: baking soda,mozzarella cheese,seasoning,caster sugar,fajita seasoning mix,cranberry,cooking wine,vegetable
title: Quick & Easy Fajita Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 1/2 ounces vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons fajita seasoning ( mccormick fajita seasoning mix ) | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup cooking wine | 1 cup chopped fresh cranberries | 4 leaves fresh mozzarella ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir vigorously to combine. Toss over warm salad greens.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,vanilla pudding mix,jalapeno pepper,mustard powder,red curry paste,cauliflower,onion soup mix
title: Red Curry Spicy Cauliflower

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,black bean,onion,mexican cheese,lager beer,mustard,ancho chilies

title: Wasabi Veggies Wraps
ingredients: 12 spinach, fresh | 2 yellow squash, green | 14 ounces tortillas | 1 bag pecan halves | 2 teaspoons wasabi powder | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill sprigs
instructions: Wash, scrub, and slice the spinach. Slice into about 4 or 5 pieces and place on a serving tray. Cut the ends off the squash then slice into about 4 or 5 pieces and place on the same tray. Cut the tortillas in half and cut into 1 squares. Place in a microwaveable bowl. Microwave for about 1 minute on medium power then stir. Spoon 1 tablespoon of wasabi on top and sprinkle with chives and dill. Roll up then press in the pecan halves to fill the wraps. Serve with wasabi cheese or mustard or anything else you like. Enjoy your favorite wasabi.

title: Tikka Paste

instructions: In a small bowl, mash pawpaw with a fork, but no more than necessary, until all pieces are evenly ground. Add currants. Cover, and refrigerate in an airtight container until using, at least 30 minutes.

instructions: Arrange corned beef on rack of broiler pan, fat side up. Sprinkle with grated coriander. Stir together vinegar and remaining ingredients.

instructions: Brown the dripping in a skillet, add the drained currants or other dried fruit and cook to thicken slightly, a few minutes. Serve with toasted pita bread or with toasted buns.

title: Lazy Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rice, such as uncle ben's | 1/2 cup cubed cooked beef or 1/2 cup turkey | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/2 cup fat-free low-sodium condensed beef broth | 1 dash half-and-half | 1 teaspoon minced garlic
instructions: Cook rice as directed on package. If you have any remaining leftover rice, just skip this step. Add cooked meat, dill, beef broth and half and half. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low. Let simmer about 15 minutes, or until rice is tender. Remove from heat. Taste and adjust seasonings. Serve.

title: Aussie Feijoada Salad
ingredients: 2 cans fava beans ( or fresh peas, shelled ) | 2 -3 spring onions ( green tops only ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup half-and-half | ham ( optional ) or bacon, slices ( optional )
instructions: Combine the beans and peas in a large bowl. Slice onions on the bias and arrange evenly over the beans/pea mix. Beat together the half and half and pour over the vegetables. Garnish with smoked bacon, or whatever you fancy. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,part mozzarella cheese,mozzarella cheese
title: Light Italian Cheese Rolls With a Twist
ingredients: 1 lb part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup light brown soy sauce | 1/4 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place shredded mozzarella cheese on cutting board, and use a rolling pin to roll the mozzarella until it reaches an even thickness about 1/8 inch. Combine the light brown soy sauce and shredded part skim mozzarella cheese and pour a small amount onto the dough. Wrap each portion of the cheese with a piece of string, and place on a cookie sheet lined with wax paper. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until cheese and bread are bubbly, and the edges are slightly browned.

title: Fasoo Chawal (Carrots With Saffron)
ingredients: 2 cups carrot sticks | 1 cup frozen corn | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand
instructions: Steam the carrot sticks until just done. Keep them aside for garnishing. Microwave the frozen corn in the bag in a little oil. Drain the corn and add to the pan. Mix and continue to microwave until the carrots are done. Add saffron and mix well. You may garnish it with grated cardamom and serve hot.

title: Coconut Macaroons
ingredients: 2 cans almond paste | 1 -2 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Dip nuts in condensed milk and then coat with coconut extract. Makes 2 large macaroons.

title: Homemade Scones
ingredients: 1 cup self raising flour | chives, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven. Put flour in bowl and sift in chives. Dough will be a rough texture. Sprinkle with extra flour if desired. Using your hands pat dough into circle about 6 inches in diameter. Cut into wedges either on baking tray, or on top of wax paper or parchment paper making a cross in centre about 2 deep. Bake on middle rack of oven 15 to 18 minutes or until golden in colour. Remove from oven and turn onto a wire rack to cool. These can be frozen. If frozen, they are much easier to cut and eat.

Random Ingredients: sausage,monterey jack pepper cheese,natural peanut butter,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pecorino romano cheese,italian seasoning,worcestershire sauce
title: Southern Peanut-Bun
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk sausages | 1/2 lb monterey jack pepper cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning ( mccormick seasoning mix ) | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 cup natural-style peanut butter | 4 teaspoons fresh pecorino romano cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add sausage and brown for about 10 minutes, breaking it up into small pieces with back of fork. Reduce heat to medium low and cover. Simmer stirring occassionally for 20 minutes. Add the pcorino cheese. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,lime juice,savory,white sugar,penne,icing sugar,vanilla bean
title: Penne With Coconut-Mojito Ice

instructions: Boil water for the pasta. Cook it in the boiling water. As soon as it starts to boil, turn off the heat immediately. Drain the pasta in a colander, and run cold water over it and mix with enough lime juice into the glass with the two tablespoons of icing sugar to make a smooth icing. Place the ice in the fridge overnight to set. When ready to serve, mix the sauce ingredients in a freezer proof bowl, or dish, and serve the ice alongside of it.

title: Melt Down Lamb Mole

instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill until ready to use. This can be served as burgers, tacos, quesadillas, and or enchiladas, as well as on the side.

title: Scottish Beef Stew (Irish)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 loaf fresh bread, cut into 1-inch slices | 2 parsley sprigs
instructions: Spray stewing beef with a nonstick coating of cooking spray. Place in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on high setting 5 hours or on low setting 7 hours. In a large sauté pan set over medium heat, toast bread slices for about 30 to 60 seconds on each side, or until golden brown. Fill bread slices with stewing beef and top with parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Basic Tomato Soup
ingredients: 3 large firm italian tomatoes, cored | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves, crushed
instructions: Press the dried fenugreek and crushed fenugreek leaves into the tomatoes. Fill a large saucepan with water, bring to the boil, and stir in the tomato puree. Reduce heat and simmer 35 - 40 minutes, until thickened. Serve hot.

title: Pane Ghanouj in Gavay
ingredients: 5 cups grated manchego cheese ( chevre ) | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1/2 cup white wine
instructions: Place cheese, caraway seed, and wine in 3 or 4 quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until heated through. Pour into hot 1 1/2 quart mold. Cool completely and serve.

title: Danish Potatoes and Sauerkraut With Potatoes
ingredients: 2 quarts sauerkraut juice | 2 medium potatoes, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 bunch fresh rosemary, torn | 2 garlic cloves, smashed | 1 1/2 tablespoons pickling spices | 5 black grapes, cut in 4 pieces
instructions: Pour the sauerkraut into a large crockpot. Add potatoes and rosemary. Cook on high 5 hours until potatoes are tender and sauerkraut is bubbly. Drain off any fat and season to taste with spices.

Random Ingredients: san marzano tomato,velveeta cheese,self raising flour,curd cottage cheese,white flour
title: White Cottage Cheese & Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 4 ounces self raising flour | 2 ounces white flour | 4 ounces curd cottage cheese | 4 ounces velveeta cheese | 1 can san marzano tomatoes, juice drained, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking pan with parchment paper or a greased baking sheet, approx 7 x 11, and grease the pan with a little non stick spray. Put the dry ingredients into a large bowl, then mix in the cheese, add the canned tomatoes, pour into greased pan, and stir to combine. Transfer to oven, lower heat and bake for 20 minutes, stirring after 10 - 15 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes, then serve.

title: The Best Ever Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chickens, cut up | 5 ounces plain yogurt | toothpick | white pepper | cayenne pepper | 12 whole pecan pieces ( the kind i bought from costco ) | 6 slices whole wheat baguettes ( thick cut )
instructions: In a shallow dish, place chicken, yogurt, pepper, cayenne pepper and cayenne pepper. Shake well until all of the ingredients are mixed together. Let marinate at least 20 minutes. Heat up a frying pan to medium high, then fry the chicken till golden brown. Remove chicken and set aside. Heat up more frying pan and fry bread until golden brown on both sides. You can also use pita chips or pita chips. Fill each bread slice with the chicken and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,arborio rice,extra virgin olive oil,garlic salt,red pepper paste,irish whiskey,alfalfa sprout,red wine
title: Smoked Irish Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked arborio rice | 3/4 cup good quality extra virgin olive oil or 3/4 cup other oil | 2 -3 tablespoons red wine ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced smoked irish luscious red peppers or 1 1/2 cups hot sauce | 1 large sweet green bell pepper, thinly sliced ( or orange ) | 1 cup prepared alfalfa sprout ( optional ) | 1 -2 clove garlic salt, coarsely mined | fresh ground red pepper paste ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Stir red wine into hot oil.

title: Microwave Chocolate Chippers in Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup raw white rice ( not instant ) | 4 small squares good quality unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Place rice in a small bowl.

title: Mushroom Toss With Lentils
ingredients: 6 large cremini mushrooms, sliced thinly | 1 1/2 lbs medium sized fresh mushrooms, sliced | 2 cups red lentils, rinsed | 8 ounces self rising flour | 1 lb feta or 1 lb chevre cheese, diced | 1 -3 cup mussels or 1 -3 cup canned lentils, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Toss lentils and mushrooms lightly in large bowl. Place in lightly oiled 9x13 inch bread pan that has been lightly sprayed evenly with cooking spray. Coat mushrooms with cooking spray. Sprinkle mushrooms with salt. Place pan in oven and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until mushrooms are tender. Combine all ingredients in an electric blender and process until smooth. Transfer to bowl and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Pickled Japanese Eggplant, Avgolemono, Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants or 2 japanese eggplants | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste or 2 tablespoons sambal olek ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( to taste ) | 1 white radish, chopped fine, peeled, seeded, and coarsely chopped
instructions: Wash the eggplants, cut in half lengthwise on a horizontal cutting surface.

title: Peel-Pickled Horseradish - Norway
ingredients: 5 quarts sterilized jars | 2 1/2 lbs jarred horseradish | 12 whole green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon coarsely crushed mixed candied peel
instructions: The basic way of making horseradish involves dipping a toothpick or long handled spoon into a jar with a puddle of lemon peel and crushed candied peel mixed with kosher salt, to moisten the peel.
