Random Ingredients: olive,lamb shank,walnut oil,wine vinegar,dark brown sugar,pecorino romano cheese,egg beater substitute
title: Lamb Shanks With Walnut Oil and Pecorino Romano
ingredients: 1 - 2 1/2 lb lamb shank | 1/2 cup walnut oil, heated | 1 1/2 ounces dry wine vinegar | 3/4 cup egg substitute, such as egg beaters egg substitute preferred | 3/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, finely shaved | 1/2 cup mixed coarsely chopped walnuts | 1/3 cup light olive, pitted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Trim excess fat from lamb and place lamb at bottom of a roasting pan. Place lamb at bottom, fat side up. If necessary, cut meat crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Combine walnut oil with vinegars in a small saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Add pecorino romano, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low and simmer until cheese is smooth, about 10 minutes. Pour sauce over lamb, and toss to coat evenly. Cover and marinate in refrigerator at least 4 hours and up to 1 day. Remove lamb from refrigerator and sprinkle with walnuts and olive.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,green leaf lettuce,chicken thigh,russet potato
title: Grilled Mexican Chicken W- Potatoes and Lettuce
ingredients: 2 medium russet potatoes, cut into 1-inch rounds | 1 large green leaf lettuce, such as oak or savoy, leaves separated | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lime juice, plus more | lemon juice, to taste | 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: In a medium nonstick grill pan, cook potatoes over medium high heat until beginning to crisp, about 8 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the potatoes to a plate. Cool slightly, then transfer to a small bowl and let cool 10 minutes. Transfer the cooled potatoes to a small bowl. Cut the cooled potato slices in half crosswise, then slice each piece crosswise into 1/8 inch wide strips. In a large bowl, toss the lettuce with half the lime juice. Add the chicken and toss to coat, then season with salt and pepper. Add the chicken and potatoes to the lettuce. Add the remaining lime juice, stirring to coat, then serve at once.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,corn oil,coconut cream,sharp cheddar cheese,feta cheese
title: Baked Cheese With Honey Mustard, Coconut and Feta-Cream
ingredients: 10 ounces soft light tasting cheese ( such as sharp cheddar or monterey jack ) | 3 1/2 ounces feta cheese ( about 1/2 cup, crumbled ) | 1/2 cup fresh coconut cream | 1 teaspoon baking soda | corn oil, for frying
instructions: Mix together the cheese, feta, coconut and baking soda. Heat the corn, oil and coconut cream until the oil is smoking. When a few drops of the mixture float on the surface of the oil, you are ready for the cheese to melt. Drain the cheese mixture on a paper towel lined plate. You can spread it into a log with tapered ends if desired. It will keep for several days in the refrigerator. It is best to let the cheese soften initially to make sure it is completely soft but not soft. When completely soft, spoon onto a plate, sprinkle with a little more feta cheese, nuts and some honey mustard.

title: Dressing Mix for Pasta, Chicken, Dipping Sauces and Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 package dry dressing mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons white flour | 2 -3 tablespoons grated lime zest
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and use as directed on dry salad or grilled chicken pieces before grilling or broiling.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,cotija cheese,pineapple chunk,romaine lettuce heart,sun tomato oil,fennel seed
title: Pineapple Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 1/4 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 1 large romaine lettuce hearts, chopped | 1 cup fresh pineapple chunks, packed in water, drained | 2 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 teaspoon fennel seeds | 1/3 cup crumbled cotija cheese
instructions: In medium saucepan, bring 1 cup water to boil. Add rice.

title: Linguine With Clam Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces linguine | 1 can minced clams | 8 ounces onions rings, chopped | 1 -2 chipotle chile, minced | 1 2/3 cups dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 8 ounces dried apricots ( diced )
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on package.

title: Cumin Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons red miso | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 package marie biscuits, crushed into crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, blend together cream of mushroom soup, miso, and cumin. Place biscuit crumbs in a separate small bowl. Dip each mushroom into the miso mixture to coat. Place mushrooms on a parchment lined jelly roll pan. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Rice and Dipping Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 2 cups rice | 2 1/2 cups icing sugar | 7 ounces good-quality bittersweet chocolate, chopped | 3/4 cup toasted pecans | 3/4 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Line 2 baking sheets with kitchen twine. Bring 2 1/2 cups water to a boil in a 2 to 3 quart saucepan. Stir in rice and return to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 35 to 40 minutes or until quite tender. Stir in 3/4 cup of the icing sugar and heat, uncovered, over low heat, stirring often. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate until melted. Stir in nuts and remaining icing sugar. Roll into about 20 small balls. Place on the lined baking sheets. Keep in a cool dry place until firm, about 1 day or overnight. Variation, after removing from pan, make the icing by combining 1 1/4 cups of the icing sugar with 1 cup of hot water in a small saucepan. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until it is a smooth thick cream about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add the remaining icing sugar, a tablespoon at a time, stirring well after each addition. Beat until it is pale and thick. Spread over rice balls and chill until well chilled.

Random Ingredients: chick pea,ramen noodle,farfalle pasta,soy sauce,zucchini,cream chicken soup,tahini,orange zest
title: Easy Noodle Primavera
ingredients: 6 cups cooked farfalle pasta | 1 zucchini | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 small zucchini | 2 tablespoons dried shaoxing wine or 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1 package dry ramen noodles | 3 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1/2 tablespoon orange zest
instructions: Cook the farfalle pasta according to the package directions. Cut all the vegetables into small wedges. Mix the soup, zucchini, pasta, shaoxing, seasoning mix and tamari in a large bowl. In a separate bowl, combine the noodles with soy sauce and the orange zest. Drain the noodles and add them to the soup and vegetables. Mix well and set aside. Heat oil and fry vegetables until crisp and soft. Serve with sesame and ginger sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,red cabbage,semolina flour,blue curacao,brown rice,kalamata olive,apricot jam,fontina cheese
title: Brown Rice Crisp With Smoked Elegant Cabbage
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 250 g red cabbage, shredded | 3 tablespoons light brown rice syrup ( or 3 teaspoons honey, mixed together according to desired sweetness ) or 3 tablespoons apricot jam ( or 3 teaspoons honey ) | 1 tablespoon kalamata olive, sliced | kosher salt & cracked pepper | 3/4 cup fontina cheese, shredded | 3/4 cup reduced-fat smoked mascarpone cheese ( or more ) | 2 teaspoons red curacao ( optional ) | lemon juice and zest
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degreesc or a fan oven. Combine all the ingredients in a shallow microwave proof dish, cover and cook in the microwave on hi for 3 minutes, stirring, until smooth. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,bell pepper,cilantro leaf,lasagna noodle,white bread,almond extract,phyllo pastry,cooking oat
title: Roasted Pepper and Garlic Quiche
ingredients: 10 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed and cut into 4-inch squares | 9 ounces lasagna noodles, broken in half | 1 1/2 cups roasted bell peppers, sliced into 1/4-inch strips | 1/2 cup toasted sliced almonds ( slivered or chopped ) | 4 cups lettuce leaves, finely shredded | 3/4 cup minced fresh cilantro leaves | cooking spray or 9 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Arrange phyllo pastry squares on a baking sheet. Place in oven and bake for 10 minutes or until golden. Meanwhile, cook noodles in a large pot of boiling water until barely tender. Drain.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,coconut cream,anaheim chilies,vegetable stock,chicken breast half,panko breadcrumb
title: Panko Chicken
ingredients: 1 egg roll wraps or 1 panko breadcrumb cookie | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 4 chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 2 an anaheim chilies ( seeded and thickly sliced ) | 200 g coconut cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or 190°c if using a fan forced oven, fan bake or grill your wraps until lightly browned and cooked through. Remove wraps and set aside. Place egg roll wraps on a baking tray and cook in oven until lightly browned and crisp, about 8 minutes. Beat the icing sugar into the panko until smooth. Slice the chicken breasts in half lengthways and season with salt and pepper. Heat vegetable stock and chilies in a pan. Dip the chicken, one at a time, into the egg coating, then into the panko. Arrange chicken pieces in a single layer in a baking tray and bake at 200°c/190°c for 15 to 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear. Scatter with coconut cream and serve with naan breads and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: molasses,pork loin chop,tomato paste,double cream,green chilies,caster sugar
title: Creamy Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained thoroughly | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: Mix the sugar, chillies, molasses and tomato paste together. Coat the pork chops in the mixture. Heat a large nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Cook the pork in the hot pan until browned and sticky. Remove from pan and keep warm. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat in the hot frying pan. Add the cream and sugar mixture, and bring to a boil. Boil until the sauce has thickened slightly, about 2 minutes. Spoon pork onto plates and serve topped with sauce.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,penne,kidney bean,balsamic vinegar,red chili pepper,cremini mushroom,vermicelli,allspice berry
title: Penne With Red Pepper, Shiitake Mushrooms and Shiitake Beans
ingredients: 2 packages frozen cremini-mushroom caps | 1 cup red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup red chili pepper, chopped | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon allspice berry | 1 package penne ( about 1 pound ) | 1 package frozen kidney beans | 1 lb dried vermicelli, broken into 3/4 inch pieces
instructions: Prepare all of the sauce ingredients and set aside. Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil in a large, heavy pot. Add the cremini mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,cayenne pepper,white cheddar cheese,romaine lettuce,bailey irish cream,red onion,bread flour,ginger garlic paste
title: Golden Five Cheese Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 cup white cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons shiitake mushrooms | 1 red onion | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup bread flour | 1 tablespoon black greshbaiao cayenne pepper ( korean roux ) | 1 cup romaine lettuce ( optional ) | 1 cup roasted shiitake mushrooms, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°.

title: Maple Broiled Oysters
ingredients: 1 cup shiitake mushrooms | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 12 shiitake cups shucked oysters, rinsed | 1 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes
instructions: Place the shiitake mushrooms in a bowl and pour boiling water overtop the mushrooms. Leave for 10 minutes then drain them, pat dry with paper towels and slice them finely. Place the maple syrup in a small bowl over low heat. Lightly brush the oysters with this syrup then add the red pepper flakes to the pan.

title: Roasted Asafetida(Udad Dal)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried whole-wheat wrap | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Rinse the asafetida well in a strainer. Transfer the asafetida in a heavy skillet along with 2 tsp salt. Stir occasionally to distribute the salt through the asafetida and salt. Spread the asafetida over medium high heat for 15 minutes. Turn and bake for another 15 minutes. Spread the remaining 2 tsp salt over the pan and pour in any remaining liquid as needed for a drier crust. Turn the pan over gently and allow it to dry out. The bread can be stored for up to 1 week in an air tight container.

title: Black Olive Sago
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons cake flour | 25 olives
instructions: Put flour in a bowl. Add the olive and mix. Pour the mixture over warm water. Mix with your hands. Leave to rest for 15 - 20 minutes. Roll out dough in a thin purle. Make a circle as thin as you can. Place on a lightly greased and floured baking sheet. Spread the black olives and roll it up. Prick the top with a fork. Bake in a moderate oven at 230 degrees celsius for about 40 minutes. Serve as a side dish. To prevent burning, heat in a frying pan. If the liquid is boiling, turn down to the lowest heat, leave the pan in there and leave to simmer over low heat for 5 - 10 minutes, then pour off all of the liquid that is in the pot.

Random Ingredients: sherry,quinoa,ladyfinger,thai chili sauce,pea,egg white,green bean,broccoli floret
title: Thai Shaking Veggie Pancake
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup green beans, chopped | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon thai sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 cup ladyfingers ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a small baking dish, cover quinoa with 1 cup boiling water, and bake 12 - 15 minutes, until water is absorbed. Remove from oven and remove foil. Allow to cool 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. To prepare pancakes, combine green beans, broccoli, peas and egg white in a small bowl. Stir in the thai sweet chili sauce. Stir in sherry. Spoon about 1/2 cup onto each serving plate, and spread to edges. Top with lady fingers, if desired.

title: Camarones Borrachos al Aspasas (Chocolate Shrimp)
ingredients: 1 lb peeled and deveined shrimp | 1 lb asparagus | 8 ounces frozen raspberries | 32 ounces lukewarm milk | 2 ounces dark chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp. Cut asparagus into halves or thirds and blend. In a large skillet, melt chocolate and 2 tablespoons of the milk in it until melted. Add asparagus and raspberries and cook over low heat until thawed and heated. Heat another 2 tablespoons of the milk with the remaining 1/4 cup milk. When heated, add shrimp and cook 2 minutes. Stir half of them into the hot chocolate mixture. Repeat until all shrimp are coated and heated thoroughly. Serve warm, garnished with shavings of dark chocolate and/or fruit. Camarones can last up to 2 days in the refrigerator.

title: Korean Noodle & Mango Sorbet
ingredients: 3 cups white cabbage, shredded | 6 cups fresh mango juice | 4 cups unsweetened apple juice | 2 jars pistachios, coarsely chopped ( kikomas ) | 3 cups ice water | 16 ounces soba noodles, cooked in boiling water for 8 minutes
instructions: Place the cabbage and mango juice in a blender.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,baking potato,orange peel,daikon radish,red apple,saffron thread,flat leaf parsley
title: Pot Roast With Apples, Irish Root Vegetables and Saffron
ingredients: 1/2 cup saffron thread | 2 lbs baking potatoes, unpeeled ( about 3 large, each about 2 lb. ) | 2 -3 lbs pork roast | 1 teaspoon minced fresh flat-leaf parsley or 1 teaspoon dried parsley | 1 tablespoon finely minced orange peel | 4 medium medium red apples, such as rome beautys | 1 large daikon radish, halved and scored into four crosswise wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Put the saffron in a small, heavy saucepan with a lid. Place the pot over medium heat, shaking the pan constantly, and heat until it starts to foam and foam. Turn off the heat. Pour 1/3 cup of the hot saffron liquid over the saffron. Let the saffron steep, covered, until the saffron is softened and the liquid has reduced slightly, about 5 minutes. Turn off the heat. If the saffron does not soften, you may moisten the pot with 2 - 3 tablespoons of the hot liquid. Meanwhile, put the potatoes in a large saucepan and just cover with very cold water. Bring the water to a boil and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the potatoes to a large bowl of cold water and let the potatoes drain in the water for 5 minutes. Transfer the drained potatoes to a rimmed baking sheet, place the baking sheet in the preheated oven and roast the potatoes until golden brown, about 45 minutes. Drain the potatoes on a rack. Turn them over and roast them until golden brown, about 45 minutes. Turn off the oven. Drain the potatoes well and, using tongs or a slotted spoon, transfer them to a baking sheet and cool. Make the apples, by peeling the apples and cutting off their cores. Cut them in half crosswise and, using a slotted spoon, scrape out any blackened bits in the bottom of the pan. Cut the remaining peel in slivers. Remove the seeds from the apple halves and cut each half into 1/2 inch slices. Add the apple halves and sliced peel to the potatoes and toss. Spread the apples and stuffing inside a roasting pan or baking pan large enough to hold the roast. Smash the saffron with a fork in a mortar or pestle and add it to the potatoes. Mix well. Spread the apples and potato mixture evenly on top of the roast. Roast the roast until the apples and potato mixture are very tender and beginning to blacken, about 1 hour. Check the potatoes for doneness, if they can crackle on the tops or cook on their own on top, continue roasting until tender for another 35 to 45 minutes. Remove the pan from the oven. Let the roast stand until it is cool enough to handle, cut the roast into 8 slices, and arrange it on a serving platter. Garnish with parsley, orange sections, or radish slices.

title: Chili Pepper Parcels
ingredients: 4 fresh red chili peppers | 100 g phyllo pastry | vegetable oil, for brushing
instructions: Finely chop the chillies and place in a heavy based frying pan. Wrap around 15cm x 20cm sheets of filo pastry around two peppers leaving plenty on edges for folding. Fold the pastry in half lengthways. Brush the outside edge of the pastry with a little oil and roll out the remaining sheets of pastry to a thickness of 5cm. Cut out 4 - 6 x 4 cm squares of pastry. Place 1 teaspoon of chilli mixture on the centre of each square. Fold the pastry around the filling, pressing firmly. Brush with oil and cut into 3 smaller squares. Repeat with the 6 remaining sheets of pastry. Arrange on a baking tray and brush with oil. Bake at 180c for about 30 minutes or until golden.

title: French Toast
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat pastry flour | 6 slices rye bread | 1/2 lb buttermilk ( approx. ) | 2 slices bread
instructions: Put the flour in a bowl. Put the buttermilk into another bowl, and with a fork or wire whisk, mix it with the soured milk until thoroughly combined. Turn off the heat. Put the rye bread in to another bowl with the buttermilk. Dip both sides of each piece of bread in the buttermilk, coating both sides. Heat a large nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Sear the first piece of bread, 3 - 4 minutes on each side, keeping a close eye on it. Serve hot. Keep the bread warm.

title: Baked Fish with Barley and Smoked Mozzarella
ingredients: 3/4 cup pearl barley, uncooked | 1 whole red snapper fillet, about 5 pounds | 12 large croutons | 1 1/2 cups shredded smoked mozzarella cheese
instructions: Prepare barley, and rinse and drain barley. Rinse and drain, and pat dry with paper towels. Trim skin and bones from fish. Place fish on plate, and scatter with barley. Cover, and refrigerate 12 hours. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place croutons on baking sheet, and bake in preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until toasted. Remove from oven, and spread cheese on top. Place fish on top of croutons. Return to oven for 5 minutes, or until flakey and cheese is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: broth,green onion,pizza crust,beef stew meat,veal,parmesan cheese,taco sauce enchilada,beef bouillon powder
title: Taco Ring
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch strips | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 cup broth | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon powder | 1 tablespoon taco sauce or 1 tablespoon enchilada sauce | sliced green onion | shredded cheese such as monterey jack or mild cheddar cheese | parmesan cheese or queso fresco
instructions: Add all ingredients to crock pot and cook on low 8 to 10 hours. Shred up any remaining meat into smaller bits about 1 cup or more, and mix with shredded cheese and/or parmesan cheese. Top with sliced onions. The secret to spreading is to spread some of the meat on the bottom of a warmed tortilla, top with some cheese and/or cheese. Repeat the process 2 more times until all is used up. Serve with warm tortilla or corn bread.

title: EASY Mediterranean Olives
ingredients: 8 ounces pitted kalamata olives | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the olives in a microwave safe bowl. Place plastic wrap directly on top of the olives, but keep punching down so that the plastic wrap doesn't get wrapped up and sticking to the olives. Sprinkle generously with confectioners sugar and toss to coat. Microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes, or as recommended by your kalamata nuts box, stirring once per minute or so. Note~ if you use the oil from the kalamata olives, do not add the sugar to this or it will make the nuts watery. You can simply add the soy sauce to the oil when mixing for a minute or two or two to help keep it from sticking once cooked. Also, don't add a little water to the oil so as to keep in a liquid.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,wasabi paste,star anise,basmati rice,cider vinegar,honey
title: Sweet Balsamic Honey Rice - Microwave
ingredients: 2 cups steamed basmati rice | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 1/2 cups honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons wasabi paste | 1 star anise, crushed | 2 tablespoons wasabi vinegar | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe container. Microwave on high for 3 minutes, until rice is hot. Stir well, cover and set aside to keep warm, about 5 minutes. Remove star anise before serving.

title: Mexican Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 1 large zucchini, thinly sliced | 1 cup corn tortilla chips or 1 cup cobbler chips | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chili ( or to taste )
instructions: Microwave zucchini in 1/4 cup water 15 seconds. Drain. Microwave 1 minute on high, stir. Microwave 1 minute longer if using zucchini. Stir in tortilla chips. Cook and stir 3 to 4 minutes or until heated through. Top with chili.

title: Feta Dip
ingredients: 1 feta, small ball | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce
instructions: Mix the adobo sauce with the feta. I just usually serve this with a baked potato dish.

title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons olive, halved | 1 package curd cottage cheese, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place artichoke hearts in a bowl, and mash with a fork until almost completely mixed. In a medium glass baking dish, stir together the artichoke mixture, the olives, cottage cheese, and baking soda. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Easy Italian Tomato Burgers
ingredients: 1 teaspoon canola becel margarine | 1 beefsteak tomato, seeded and diced | 1 slice american cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup pecan halves
instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon canola becel margarine in a skillet over medium high heat. Add tomato and sprinkle with american cheese and pecans. Mix together and cook until cheese begins to melt and tomatoes are heated through.

title: The Best Papaya and Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 big papaya ( papaya, or kaya ) | 1 yellow onion | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1/4 cup natural bran ( not organic ) | 1/4 cup romano cheese ( not organic )
instructions: Cut papaya into cubes, cut onion into small squares and grate romano cheese. In a big pot, add vegetable stock. Add papaya, onion, the grated romano cheese and the bran. Turn down heat to low and let soup simmer for at least 30 45mins or until all the liquid has gone away. Remove from heat and let soup rest. Remove the papaya from pot using a slotted spoon and put on a plate. Put back on the stove, bring out the soup and reheat soup. Note, i like my soup with a little thickened balsamic and chopped fresh basil and a drop of red pepper flakes. You can add fresh parsley for a zesty taste if desired.

title: Thai Shrimp Soup
ingredients: 2 cans water-packed shrimp - peeled, deveined, and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain white rice
instructions: Combine shrimp, tomato paste, and fish sauce in a 4 quart pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low. Cook, covered, until shrimp are cooked through, about 8 minutes. Add rice, and cook, covered, until rice is tender, and flavors have blended, about 5 minutes.

title: Easy & Easy Italian Dip for Bread Dogs
ingredients: 2 cups neufchatel cheese | 2 teaspoons ketchup | 2 teaspoons basil pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon paprika, or to taste | 3 cups crushed ice
instructions: In a large glass bowl, stir together the neufchatel cheese and 2 tablespoons ketchup until combined.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,white bread,sherry wine,chicken stock powder,ghee,yellow bell pepper
title: Kielbasa
ingredients: 500 g ground sausage | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 1/2 teaspoon chicken stock powder | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1 slice white bread, crusts removed | 1 tablespoon ghee
instructions: Saute pepper in ghee until golden brown in oil. Add sausages and stir well until evenly browned. Reduce heat slightly to keep pan covered. Add sherry to the pan and cook over moderate heat for 1 minute. Add the bread and let it sizzle stirring for 1 minute then turn the heat off. Add ghee to warm up and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,yukon gold potato,garlic salt,oil,seasoning salt,catsup,egg noodle,vanilla bean
title: Egg Noodle "filling for Ramen"
ingredients: 1 small yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 cup oil | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( lawry's seasoning salt for ramen dishes ) | 1/2 garlic salt ( optional ) | 1/3 cup catsup | 5 eggs | 1 1/2 cups oil ( for deep frying ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 lb yukon gold potato, scrubbed and cut in 2-inch chunks ( peroshka, for japanese fries ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt ( peroshka, available at asian grocery shops ) | 1/2 cup of chopped italian parsley | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Place all ingredients except the potatoes, oil, seasoning salt, and garlic salt in a pot. Heat oil to 375 degrees f in a deep frying pan or deep saucepan, and add potatoes. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until fork tender. Drain on paper towels and let cool slightly. Peel the potatoes and slice in quarters. Using a slotted spoon, transfer potatoes to a bowl, cover with water, and refrigerate until cold. Strain the liquid through a colander lined with cheese cloth and reserve. Place a cup in each person's large ramekin. Place a potato piece in the ramekin. Break eggs in a medium saucepan, and heat to a simmer. Heat oil in a deep frying pan or deep saute pan to 400 degrees f. Dip potato chunks into batter and fry until golden brown on all sides. Drain on paper towels and season lightly with salt. Serve hot with a drizzle of catsup. Note, to make a sauce with the potatoes, heat 2 cups oil in a deep fry pan or saute pan to 350 degrees f. Cook potatoes for about 10 minutes, or until fork tender. Drain on paper towels and season lightly with seasoned salt. Heat 2 cups oil in a deep fry pan or saute pan to 350 degrees f. Drop 3 to 4 potato chunks into hot oil with a slotted spoon and flatten to a 1/4 inch thickness. Cook until golden on all sides. Remove from heat and drain on paper towels. Place a potato piece on top of each ramekin, then garnish each with a tablespoon of chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,broccoli,stilton cheese,feta cheese,sherry wine,chive,cinnamon,pomegranate juice
title: Broccoli in Spiced Cheese Sauce With Crisp Mornay's Cheese
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 4 -5 ounces stilton cheese | 2 pomegranate juice | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 dash sherry wine | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped
instructions: Core broccoli, slice into 1/4” lengths and steam over simmering water for 5 – 10 minutes until almost cooked. Drain and set aside. Place chopped fresh chives in a small bowl. Toss with oil and season to taste. Stir together the cottage cheese, pomegranate juice, cinnamon, and sherry. Place broccoli in blender and blend until smooth, about a minute. Season to taste with salt. Pour into a serving bowl and spread out evenly over the top of the cheese mixture. Top with the cheeses.

title: Chicken and Apricots Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can chicken legs, drained ( about 3.5kg ) | 125 g green dried apricots | 2 cm piece fresh galangal root, chopped and peeled | 125 g corn tortillas, cut into squares | 1 tablespoon golden syrup ( dark )
instructions: Combine chicken, apricots, galangal and corn tortilla squares in a large bowl. Spoon equal amounts of chicken mixture into the centre of the tortilla. Roll each burrito up and place seam side down into a large pan. Add water to cover. Place over high heat and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer until chicken is cooked through and the liquid is reduced by half. Stir in golden syrup, then serve, warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,gruyere cheese,garlic clove,ham,ginger garlic paste,italian cheese,lasagna noodle,ketchup
title: Hamburger and Ginger Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can sloppy joe noodles | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/4 lb ground ham | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 garlic clove | 1 lb gruyere cheese | 12 slices fresh lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine crushed garlic, ginger and ketchup and set aside. Combine cornstarch and noodle. Dunk hamburger and noodles into ketchup mixture then dip in cornstarch mix. Arrange in layers on a lightly greased or sprayed baking sheet and top with garlic mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes until hot and bubbly. Serve with spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,rye bread,liquid smoke,butterscotch chip,cream tartar,coriander
title: Butter-Smoked Rye Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter, melted ( margarine tastes better ) | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 5 slices rye bread or 5 slices sourdough bread, 1-inch thick | 2 tablespoons cream of tartar ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon ground coriander ( optional ) | 1/4 cup butterscotch chips
instructions: To make the spread, combine the 1 teaspoon cream of tartar with the 1 teaspoon ground coriander. Spread on the sliced rye bread, to within an inch of the edges. Sprinkle the 1 teaspoon cream of tartar on the rye bread. Using a large spoon spread the melted butter on the rye bread. Smear on any remaining butter and spread the sour cream on top of the sour cream. Sprinkle on the ground coriander, or to taste. Top with coriander nuts. Serve warm or leave as is. Serve with ice cream or cream.

title: Arborio Rice
ingredients: rice | scotro cooking oil | 1/2 cup rolled oats | 2 tablespoons arborio rice
instructions: Wash and dry your arborio rice. Mix together the oats, arborio rice, and crisco cooking oil in a large pan. Heat to boiling, then turn down to a simmer, cover and cook for 15 minutes, or until all the liquid has been absorbed.

title: Tomatoes & Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 500 g cream cheese, at room temp | 2 pints halved cherry tomatoes
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate covered for a minimum of 2 hours before serving or for up to 3 days.

title: Easy 'Cousin Pete's Pumpkin-Pumpkin Salsa
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice ( or 1 tbsp pumpkin pie spice ) | 1 teaspoon peppercorn, cracked | 3 cups good quality salsa | 1 can pumpkin pie spice
instructions: Finely chop the pumpkin in a food processor, along with 1/2 cup of masa harina and 1/4 cup of water. Pulse until just combined. You will need to stop the processor if you wish to add the masa harina, but leave the remaining bowl of masa out. Heat an extra 1/4 cup of salsa. Sprinkle the pumpkin mixture into the salsa, then roll the masa mixture into sausage shapes, adding more salsa if it will not roll easily. Place the rolled masa balls, seam side down, on an attractive platter and pour the remaining salsa and remaining 1 1/4 cup salsa over the top, and garnish with a few peppercorns. You should now have a thick and delicious salsa filled up with pumpkin. Store in the refrigerator, until ready to use.

title: Caramelized Peppers(Or Peel)
ingredients: 2 medium sized yellow peppers or 2 medium sized sweet peppers ( capsicum, bell pepper and or or or or chile ) | 6 tablespoons light palm sugar or 6 tablespoons dark brown sugar | powdered peppercorns, for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c. Cut the tops off the peppers, being careful to leave all the membranes protruding. Place the peppers in a roasting tin and cook in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes. While the peppers are cooking, place all ingredients in a pan and stir well. Leave the pan until the peppers are quite cool. Take the pan off the heat and transfer the roasted peppers to a food processor. Process to a fine paste. Remove and discard the skins, seeds and membrane and transfer the peanut paste to a bowl. Add the sugar and season well with pepper and dust with peppercorns. Cover with a clean cloth and leave to cool completely. Store the peanut paste in the fridge in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks or freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Tea With Sweetened Beef Stock (Kettle Gavuld)
ingredients: 1/2 cup teabags ( cellophane, each 6 to 8 ounces, and 2 tablespoons of each )
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil in a 4 quart saucepan. Put the cellophane in the water and bring it back to a boil. When it sputters, remove it with a slotted spoon or slotted spoon and place it into the boiling water immediately. When it becomes transparent and floats to the surface, remove it with a slotted spoon. Hold it over the boiling water and remove any foam that rises to the surface. The boiling water should cover the teabags about 1/2 below the teabags. Boil it 2 to 2 1/2 minutes, or until the water turns orangeish in color and has been reduced to one half. Put the tea bags out, let them cool to room temperature, and strain the drink through a tea filter, pressing out any loose tea bags. You can store in the refrigerator as is. It will keep 6 to 10 days.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Anzac Baked Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice, uncooked | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup mango chutney ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick spray. Measure 4 cups of rice and place in a bowl. Pour cream of tartar evenly all over rice. Stir in anchovy paste and vanilla extract. Spread rice onto baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until top has turned golden brown, about 20 minutes. Cut into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature. Can be served warm, room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,spinach leaf,garam masala,fenugreek seed,tomato paste,brandy
title: Indian Butter Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garam masala | 3 tablespoons brandy | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds, crushed | 1/2 lb chicken breast, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 10 ounces spinach leaves ( fresh, cleaned, or frozen, washed, drained well ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste, diluted with 1/2 cup water
instructions: Mix the garam masala, brandy, fenugreek, and garlic. Add chicken, and marinade 1 - 4 hours or until tender. Add spinach, and tomato paste gradually, stirring well, until spinach wilts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: reynolds wrap foil,new mexico chile powder,celery salt,pork,cream chicken soup
title: Crock Pot Chilli and Pork #RSC
ingredients: 12 ounces pork fat ( about half a large pork ) | 8 ounces new mexico chile powder | 8 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Add pork fat to crock pot or dutch oven and saute. Add chili powder, cream soup, and celery salt and saute to incorporate. Cook on high until pork is cooked through and well sealed, 4 to 6 hours.

title: Baguette
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef sausage, casings removed | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Put the sausage in a shallow, flat dish. Sprinkle with the cheese, then drizzle with vegetable oil or butter, mixing just until the meat is coated with oil or butter. Slice the baguette into 3 pieces, then in half and place on baking sheets. Bake until hot and bubbly, about 10 minutes.

title: Roasted Mexican O'Brien #5FIX
ingredients: 6 frozen o'brien potatoes | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place frozen potatoes in a microwave safe bowl and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,leek,garlic chive,fennel seed,plain yogurt,potato starch,purple cabbage,bean sprout
title: Fried Cabbage and Bean Sprouts in Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon plain low-fat greek yogurt or 1 tablespoon sour cream | 3 tablespoons purple cabbage, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons leeks or 2 teaspoons spring onions, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon garlic chives, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon italian parsley, freshly chopped | 1/4 teaspoon potato starch, dissolved in 1/4 cup water | 1 cup bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and mix well for a bit of a kick, especially yogurt. For the bean sprouts, heat oil in pan over medium high heat. Add celery, fennel and parsley, then cabbage or bean sprouts. Stir fry for a couple of seconds until the cabbage starts to wilt from the heat. Add yogurt and mix well, cooking for 2 minutes at the most.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Feijoada
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin fillet | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Place steak on plate on top of beans and drizzle with olive oil.

title: French Bread Chips  -  a Quick and Easy Tart
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons french dressing | 4 slices very thin french fries | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon ( or 1 tarragon & 1 tarragon & 1 tsp dried savory )
instructions: Preheat a large skillet, on the stove top, over medium heat. Cut the french fries in half and toast them until crispy, being careful when turning them. Place the crisp fries on a plate and drizzle the french dressing over them. Sprinkle with the chopped tarragon and toss well. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

title: Chickpea Flour Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed of visible fat | 2 1/2 cups chickpea flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wearing rubber gloves, combine chickpea flour and 1 cup water in large bowl to form paste. Add beef and toss until coated all over. Transfer beef to a roasting pan. Add remaining cup water to pan. Cover and bake for 2 hours or until meat is tender. Transfer meat to a platter and keep warm. Skim fat from cooking liquid, remove solids from roasting pan. Heat broiler. Spoon chickpea flour mixture over meat. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,meat,seasoning,baby carrot,corn,lemon juice zest,self raising flour
title: Meat, Veggies and Corn Fritters
ingredients: 375 g minced meat | 2 cans baby carrots, drained | 2 lemons, juice and zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons fresh grated fat free beef stock | seasoning | 1/2 cup frozen corn, thawed | 3 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Combine all ingridients in a large bowl, making sure everything is mixed.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,basil leaf,chili pepper flake,rice,peanut oil,green chili pepper,sauce,irish whiskey
title: Smoky Sauce and Pepper Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice ( arborio ) | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 4 dried chili peppers ( optional - i prefer dried red chili flakes ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( i use tabasco or other brand ) | 1 - 1 1/2 ounce irish whiskey | 1 - 1 1/2 ounce fresh green chili pepper, sliced | 1/2 - 1 cup fresh basil leaf, shredded
instructions: Combine the rice and 1 - 2 tsp sauce in a bowl and stir to combine. Set aside for 15 minutes. While rice is draining, heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add cumin seeds and chili peppers. Stir fry for 3 - 5 minutes or until fragrant. Add remaining 1 - 2 tsp of srauce and whiskey and let sizzle for 2 - 3 minutes. Add basil and toss. Pour mixture over the rice and cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until heated through. Turn off heat, cover and place in toaster oven to keep warm for an additional 5 - 6 minutes or until rice is tender and syrup has been absorbed. Let rest for a minute before serving. You can also add a touch of sugar if desired.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,french onion soup,stew meat,chicken bouillon powder,hot pepper
title: Crock Pot French Onion OAMC Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 2/3 cups quinoa | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 2 -3 hot peppers, chopped and seeded
instructions: Brown meat and onions in crock pot. Put quinoa, soup and hot peppers in the bottom. Mix boullion and water. Pour mixture over meat and place in crockpot. Cook on low 4 - 6 hours if using crock pot for 1 - 2 hours or longer on high.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,asafoetida powder,oregano,red cabbage,peanut oil,cream tartar,egg white,beef stew meat
title: Beef and Cabbage Stew, Asian Style(Bangladesh)
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut in 1 inch cubes | 20 green bell peppers, cut in half lengthwise and cut into 3/4 inch thick rings | 1/2 pound red cabbage, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 5 egg whites | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Heat peanut oil in a large skillet over medium high heat, and cook beef, bell pepper, and red cabbage 3 or 4 minutes, stirring often, until just tender. Remove from heat, and allow to cool. Coarsely chop the meat, and place in a large mixing bowl. Heat remaining peanut oil on medium high, and stir fry the asafetida at least 10 minutes, or to desired tenderness. To make a marinade, whisk together egg whites and cream of tartar. Slowly whisk in oregano to mixture, stirring constantly until desired thickness is achieved. When thick, fold mixture in cooled meat and pepper mixture. Allow to stand at room temperature for 20 to 30 minutes, or as long as the refrigerator can stand to cool, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,pork roast,flour,pea,maple syrup,tart apple,black bean sauce,seasoning salt
title: Pork and Apple Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless pork roast | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 can black bean sauce | 3 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 can diced tart apples or 1 1/2 lbs fresh apples | 2 cans diced tomatoes and juice | 2 cups frozen peas | warm maple syrup
instructions: Slice the pork into 1 inch to 3 inch squares. Place in 4 quart casserole dish and coat with flour covering completely. Drain any excess flour. Combine the beans, seasoning salt, diced apples and diced tomatoes with juice. Pour over pork pieces, pressing in if necessary. Cover tightly with foil. Bake in 350 degree oven for 3 hours or until tender and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,apricot preserve,phyllo pastry,pizza sauce,parsley,limeade concentrate,soymilk
title: Pizza Calzones With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 1/2 cups apricot preserves | 1/4 cup low-fat soy milk | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup pizza sauce | 1 teaspoon limeade concentrate
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. On a baking sheet lined with parchment paper bake phyllo sheets in the preheated oven, turning once, until lightly golden, 12 to 15 minutes. Transfer sheet to a plate. Spread apricot preserves over phyllo pastry in a thin layer. Briefly mix soy milk and parsley over apricot preserves. Sprinkle swiss cheese over top. Spoon over the pizza sauce in a 3 or 4 inch layer. Top with pizza sauce and shredded ginger if desired.

title: My Italian Sausage and Chorizo Saute
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian spices
instructions: Cut chorizo into 1/2 inch pieces, rinse and then saute in a large saute pan until nicely browned. Drain, and rinse out pan. Stir in basil and spices. Heat through, about 8 minutes.

title: Baked Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 kg pork tenderloin | 1/4 cup turmeric powder | 100 g green beans | 1/4 cup green mountain hamburger | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Cook the tenderloin with the marjoram on the stove with the turmeric and salt and cook for 30 minutes. Dice the meat, cut the stringy ends off the french bread and cut the slices into 4 pieces. Remove the fat from the frying pan with the pork, add the pork and green beans and let them cook till meat is cooked. In a large oven dish add all the ingredients and let them cook for 8 minutes, add the french bread. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baby carrots | 1 lb red potatoes, quartered | 4 ounces button mushrooms | 1/2 loaf italian bread, cut lengthwise into 1 1/2 inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to broil. Place carrots in a glass baking dish and top with other ingredients.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,turnip,cream,pepper sauce,wheat hamburger bun,jicama,pecorino cheese
title: Turnip Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb turnip | 1/2 lb jicama, peeled and cut into 1/8 inch rounds | 1/2 cup reduced-fat sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 5 whole wheat hamburger buns, split
instructions: Slice turnip and jicama lengthwise in half. In a small bowl, mix together sour cream and turmeric and pepper sauce. Brush cut sides of buns with sour cream mixture. Place 1/4 turnip in middle of each half. Divide sliced turnip between each buns and spoon equal portions of sour cream mixture on top. Sprinkle with cheese. Broil 5 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Scottish Shortbread
ingredients: 1 lb white flour | 1 cup cream
instructions: First, place the flour in a large mixing bowl and mix in the cream with a fork. Once combined, add a little more cream. Work with your hands until it starts to form a ball that pulls away from the sides of the bowl. Turn out onto a board and knead until elastic. Grease a cookie sheet or tin and place dough in the middle. Roll out dough until it is quite thick and about 1/3 inch thick. Cut out 3 inch squares with cookie cutters. Place on parchment or greased tray. With the tip of a teaspoon or your finger, spread the centre of each square with a generous tablespoon of the cream. The cream will almost immediately fill into the edges of the dough. Let stand, covered, in a cool place for 20 minutes or longer until the cream has risen slightly. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Grease a baking sheet or tin. With the tip of a teaspoon, mark out the circles of dough with small circular cuts about 1/2 inch deep. Place on the baking sheet or tin and bake about 15 minutes, or until pale golden brown. Cool then store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,kiwi fruit,baking soda,serrano pepper,mayonnaise,turkey sausage,hot paprika
title: Hot Dogs for Two

instructions: Place sausage in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain, removing sausage and any drippings. Place warm pork slices, kiwis, mayonnaise, serrano peppers, ginger garlic paste, hot paprika, and baking soda in a blender and puree until it forms a smooth sauce. Heat sausage mixture to boiling in a small saucepan, reduce heat. Simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until hot, about 5 minutes. Serve with hot dogs.

title: Fava Beans with Ketchup
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces rotini pasta | 2 ounces fava beans | 1 1/2 ounces ketchup | 1 ounce cream | 1 ounce channa dal ( chana dal ) | 2 black peppercorns
instructions: Soak the fava beans overnight. In the morning, put them in a pot, cover with water and simmer for 1 hour. Drain the fava beans, add to ketchup, cream, chana dal and chillies. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: basil,onion soup mix,garlic,beef broth,chicken stock,alfredo sauce
title: Easy Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 can beef broth | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1 cup prepared alfredo sauce | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl whisk together the onion soup mix, garlic, and beef broth. Pour in the beef broth and alfredo sauce, and blend well. Cover, and microwave on high for 2 to 8 minutes, stirring every 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in the basil, and let sit for about 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,brown rice,turmeric powder
title: Turmeric Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups brown rice
instructions: Heat the oil on medium high in a frying pan. Add turmeric, rice and cook until the edges are puffed to golden brown. Turn heat down to simmer. Cover and cook for 25 minutes, checking if the rice is tender. The rice is ready when you can flick from side of the pan. Serve hot.

title: Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 3 medium tortilla chips ( the soft kind not too coarse, they're perfect for this ) or ( 8 ounce ) bag semi-sweet tortilla chips ( the soft kind not too coarse, they're perfect for this ) | 2 quarts vegetable stock ( a decent supply ) | 1/4 cup red wine ( the good stuff, if you use the cheap stuff, then i've never used white wine ) | salt
instructions: Boil vegetable stock in a heavy pot until just barely boiling. While you're waiting for the stock to boil, chop the tortilla chips into small cubes with no larger chunks. When the stock is ready, drop the chips in the boiling broth for a few seconds or less, stirring until the chips are soft in texture. Add the wine to the soup, stir, add salt, and serve.

Random Ingredients: broth,cardamom,japanese soy sauce,malibu rum,chicken stock,white flour
title: Malibu and Coconut Spritz (SMS)!
ingredients: 1/2 cup stock | 1/2 cup white flour | 1 1/2 - 2 cups ginger-flavoured broth | 1/2 cup japanese sweet soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( koreris is gf ) | 1/3 cup malibu rum
instructions: Combine stock, flour, ginger and sweet soy sauce in a sauce pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and keep stirring for 2 minutes. Keep whisking constantly and add in cardamom. Add the malibu and stir to combine. Heat for one more minute. Pour into your individual glasses. Serve.

title: Chinese Milk Dessert
ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix, plus more for crust | 1 cup nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons hot chili paste ( thai red chili paste hot sauce )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Stir yellow cake mix, nonfat milk, and chili paste together until smooth. Spoon batter onto prepared baking sheets. Bake in preheated oven until puffed and lightly browned, about 25 minutes. Cool for ten minutes. Cut into small squares. Serve warm.

title: Delicious White Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen mixed vegetables ( like a potato, corn, and green beans ) | 7 cups chicken broth | 1 package processed cheese, cubed ( like velveeta ) | 4 cans cream of chicken soup | diced white onion, onion gravy mix ( optional )
instructions: Combine soup, veggies and cheese in slow cooker. Stir in onion gravy mix. Cover and cook on high until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,brown rice,rice paper,anise seed,white cheese
title: Rice Paper Rolls
ingredients: 1 slice brown rice paper sheet | 1/3 cup white cheese | 3 egg yolks, lightly beaten | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 2 tablespoons rice vermicelli or 2 tablespoons thin pancake-type rice noodles
instructions: Wet your hands and spread the rice paste on the rice paper, leaving enough to cover the entire bottom of the wrapper. Bring the water to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until rice becomes tender and a pliable ball has formed, about 15 to 20 minutes. Remove rice wrapper from water, cut it into 2 equal pieces, and serve.

title: Chat masala

title: Curried Sausages With Mango Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk pork sausage | 3 tablespoons flour | 3 medium ripe mangoes, peeled and finely diced | 1/2 cup diced mixed dried fruit | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 3/4 cup tomato juice | 1/4 cup chopped green onion
instructions: Remove casings from sausage and cut into 1/4 inch chunks. Coat a large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Cook sausage over medium high heat until browned and lightly crisp. Sprinkle with flour. Cook mango, fennel seeds, and mixed dried fruit until the mixture begins to soften. Add vanilla and tomato juice. Lower heat to medium.

title: Matzo Puffs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups matzo meal | 1 1/2 cups poppy seeds
instructions: To make poppy seeds. Put in a bowl and mix. Then just add poppy seeds and mix. Let cool and store in an airtight cookie container.

title: French Bread Salad II
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 red chili, seeded and chopped | 1 green pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Cut a round from each loaf of french bread and place on a cookie sheet with sides touching. Spray with cooking spray. Bake in a 375 degree f oven for 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Lasagna
ingredients: 12 -15 lasagna noodles | 2 1/2 cm piece pumpkin, peeled and cut into 2. 5cm squares | 2 red chilies, seeds removed | 4 -6 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 small dried red chili pepper, seeds removed
instructions: Place some water into a large, deep frying pan and bring to the boil. Meanwhile, peel the pumpkin and cut into 2 - 1 cm cubes using a mandolin or a sharp knife. Rinse and dry the pan with sherry. Heat the pan over a medium heat, add the pumpkin, chillies and dried red chili. Stir for a few minutes or until heated through. title: Turmeric Martini
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces amarelletto liqueur, chilled | 1 1/2 ounces creme de cassis, chilled or 1 1/2 ounces cognac, chilled | fresh turmeric, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Pour amaretto, creme de cassis, or cognac into a cocktail shaker. Cover with a spout of fresh turmeric if using.

title: Roasted Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 3 lbs aged provolone cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | saffron strands | 3 -4 saffron strands | 1/3 cup chopped fresh basil leaf, loosely packed | 1/3 cup golden raisin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. In a large bowl, stir together all ingredients and sprinkle with the raisins. Place cheese in center of a shallow roasting pan and pat into a 10x13 inch rectangle, pressing down with the back of a spoon to compress. Roast in a preheated 400° oven for 30 - 40 minutes, or until golden brown. Cut into thin slices.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,sage,black bean,colby monterey jack cheese,ice,elbow macaroni,salt herring fillet,greek yogurt
title: Baked Greek-Style Halusas
ingredients: 1/4 pound large colby-monterey jack cheese | 2 cups cooked elbow macaroni | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon minced fresh sage | 1/2 teaspoon salt, or to taste | 1 can sliced black beans, drained | 1 can old el paso herring fillets, drained
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking dish with aluminum foil. Finely grate the cheese into the prepared baking dish, and place on top of the bottom of the baking dish. In a bowl, combine the colby monterey jack cheese, elbow macaroni, greek yogurt, ginger root, sage, salt, black beans, and herring.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,date,philadelphia cream cheese,nonfat plain yogurt,turkey pepperoni,grit
title: Spicy Mexican Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 2 cups grits, or as needed | 1 cup chopped cooked turkey pepperoni | 1/2 cup crumbled cotija cheese | 8 dates, pitted and chopped, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Blend yogurt and cream cheese together in a bowl with an electric mixer until smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Beat in grits. Combine turkey, pepperoni, and cheese in a large bowl with grits.

title: Herbal Oil (For Elegant Fish)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 clove dried chives
instructions: Mix salt into a smooth paste with oil. Trim the chives, and finely chop the stems. Pour the oil into a heavy frying pan over medium heat.

title: Coconut Brie
ingredients: 1 package cellophane noodles | 1 lb brie cheese | 2/3 cup coconut flakes | 1/4 cup pistachios or 1/4 cup walnuts
instructions: Cook cellophane according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cool running water. Cut brie cheese into 1/2 inch thick slices. Lay slices out lengthwise on a baking sheet. Sprinkle coconut over cheese slices. Top with pistachios or nuts. Bake at 475° on sheets for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and golden.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,apple juice,salt pepper,balsamic vinegar,dark sesame oil
title: Feta Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine all ingredients and process until combined. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to develop flavors.

title: Spicy Japanese Salad
ingredients: 9 -10 napa cabbage | 4 -5 baby carrots | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, minced | 2 teaspoons peppermint extract | 1 sheet nori, cut into thin strips
instructions: Cut out the core of the cabbage. Slice into 1/8 inch thick slices. Slice the napa and carrots into thin julienne strips 3 inches long.
