Toss before serving.

title: Passionfruit (Passionfruit & Cheddar Cheese) Fondue
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 cup passion fruit ( pulp, pulp, pulp, seeds ) | 1 1/2 lbs sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 cup walnuts, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy based saucepan over a medium heat.

title: Sukhariyaki (Soup Stock)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 head chinese cabbage or 1 -1 1/2 head napa cabbage, washed and shredded | 4 cups stock, preferably homemade & made from fermented fermented soybeans, then boiled to give desired soup | fresh parsley sprig ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot, cover with a bit of water and boil the shredded cabbage for about 45 minutes, depending on the size of your cabbage or napa cabbage. In another pot, remove the head with stem.

Random Ingredients: sea salt pepper,russet potato,cranberry,green onion,fontina,mozzarella cheese
title: Potato and Cranberry Gratin
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes, scrubbed and scrubbed | 1 loaf fontina, cut into chunks | 1 1/2 cups fresh cranberries, divided | 2 green onions, chopped | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | sea salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees f. Place potatoes and whole cranberries in a large bowl. Pour enough water into the bowl to cover ingredients. Toss and pat dry with paper towels to remove moisture. Cut the fontina into chunks about 1 inch thick. Gently stir the chopped green onions into the bread cubes until distributed evenly. In a large baking dish, layer the bread, fontina, and cranberries, sprinkling the mozzarella cheese over the entire dish. Bake the gratin until it bubbling and the cheese is melted, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Simple Egg Nests
ingredients: 2 cups egg whites | 2 cans sliced bamboo or 2 cups cooked, grated winter melon
instructions: In a large bowl, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold whites into noodles by hand, starting with about 3/4 cup. Drain 1 cup of noodle juice from 2 cans of sliced bamboo into noodle juice. Cut remaining 3/4 cup noodles into 1/4 inch wide strips and place strips in large bowl. Add 1/2 can of sliced bamboo to noodles with juice and noodles and stir well. Refrigerate noodles in bowl 2 hours or overnight, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,extra virgin olive oil,phyllo pastry,parmesan cheese,lime,turmeric
title: Yumurta Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 large lime, juice only | 1/3 teaspoon turmeric | 2 pints phyllo pastry sheets | 1/3 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1/3 cup chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven. Preheat grill to high or broiler. Place 1/4 t. Oil into a large pan and heat over medium high heat. When oil shimmers, add lemon juice and turmeric and stir to combine. Place a sheet of phyllo on a clean work surface and brush each with 1 t. Oil and a touch of cooking oil. Dip second phyllo sheet on top of the third and brush with cooking oil from previous sheet. Cut phyllo into three sheets and add to pan one at a time, turning and brushing with oil to both sides, then stack on top of first, brushing with oil. Gently fold in half over and brush with oil. Using a sharp knife, cut each piece into four 5 to 6 diagonal slices. Repeat as many times as it takes to get the phyllo that will fit into the pan. Transfer to a parchment lined baking sheet with parchment paper, cover lightly with plastic wrap, and keep in refrigerator. To serve, place 1/4 t. Cheese, 3 t. Lime, and 1 t. Of parsley on small plate and serve. Variation, to make individual servings, top phyllo with 1/3 cup each of parmesan and cilantro.

title: Sliced Winter Squash
ingredients: 4 frozen cut squash | 1 can cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Thaw the frozen squash for best results.

Random Ingredients: elbow macaroni,veal,vanilla,sharp cheddar cheese,citron,onion salt,parmigiano reggiano cheese,swiss cheese
title: Swiss Mac and Cheese - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground veal | 3/4 lb ground pork | 2 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 3/4 cup carrot, shredded | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried citron, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups uncooked elbow macaroni ( about 8 oz. ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon butter
instructions: In a lrg mixing bowl, toss together the veal and pork.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,green cardamom,mayonnaise,elbow macaroni,lemon peel
title: Macaroni and Cheese with Tuna
ingredients: 8 ounces shredded green cardamom | 8 ounces elbow macaroni | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 3 tablespoons fat-free mayonnaise | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon taco seasoning mix, to taste
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions, drain. Meanwhile, combine all of the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Pour into skillet and cook over medium heat until bubbly and lightly golden brown, about 5 - 10 minutes or according to size of macaroni.

title: Lamb and Cheese Chops
ingredients: 4 lamb chops | 1 cup tomato sauce | 1 cup water | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 cup grated cheese
instructions: Place chops between wax paper and pound to 1/8 inch thickness. Spread tomato sauce and water over chops, then sprinkle with thyme and grated cheese. Roll chops in the mixture and secure with toothpicks. Grill chops 5 minutes on each side or until browned.

Random Ingredients: wheat hamburger bun,flat leaf parsley,irish whiskey,pistachio,ham
title: Scotch Eggs Benedict
ingredients: 8 large eggs ( hard-boiled ) | 1 can fat-free refried beans ( fat-free, fat-free ) | 1/4 lb diced smoked ham | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 4 whole wheat hamburger buns
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f coat baking sheet with no stick cooking spray. Cut each egg in half lengthwise. Carefully remove yolks from shells and set aside to drain on paper towel. Place beaten eggs into a mixing bowl. Add refried beans, ham, whiskey, parsley, and mix well. Add the reserved yolks and work the mixture by hand until combined, about 1 minute or more. Arrange egg halves on sheet, top each with a spoonful of egg mixture.

title: Vietnamese Grand Marnier
ingredients: 6 ounces vietnamese sweet rice wine ( or sub other spicy, red chilies ) | 4 -6 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Put the entire bottle of wine in a clean glass jar, or any other way you like. Add the grand marnier. Cover, and shake a few times to mix contents. Strain out all the liquid, and store in a dark, cool place or in refrigerator. Shake every 5 days for 3 to 4 weeks before serving.

title: Toasted Pistachios
ingredients: 3/4 cup raw shelled pistachios | 1/2 cup raw sugar ( can reduce this if desired... this sweetens the sweetness too ) | 1 teaspoon finely ground hot pepper ( optional )
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or a small food processor, grind pistachios coarsely. The best way to do this is in a food processor. In a large heavy skillet, heat sugar, chilies and pepper. When sugar is boiling, add pistachios and cook, stirring often, 2 minutes or until nuts are golden around the edges. Watch carefully and be sure to take care not to burn the sugar. Remove from heat, cover, and allow to cool for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from skillet and store in air tight container. The nuts can be stored well, refrigerated, for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: ginger,spice,sharp cheddar cheese,wakame,green pepper,sherry,white wine vinegar
title: Tori Sogil (Sushi Mushi)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon wakame seaweed | 2 teaspoons sherry | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ginger | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Wrap and roll sushi into a ball using wet hands, cover with towel and let sit 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, remove from towel and slice into 1/8 slices. Toast wakame in dry pan over medium heat. Stir in sherry, vinegar, ginger and spice and cook over medium heat until vinegar evaporates, then stir in green pepper, wait and stir until green pepper starts to brown. Serve with sesame slices on top.

title: Homemade Chimichurri
ingredients: 1 pound cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 jar pimiento, drained ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons chopped black olives | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, or to taste
instructions: Place the cheese in the bottom of a large, heavy saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the pimientos, black olives, and oregano. Pour in enough water so that each layer of cheese is coated with the mixture.

title: Penne Rustica
ingredients: 1 lb penne, rigati | 2 cups pizza sauce | 4 tablespoons minced fresh sage | sea salt
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat pizza sauce in small saucepan over medium heat. Stir in sage. Cook about 2 minutes, then remove from heat. Drain pasta, reserving 1/4 cup pasta water.

title: Cauliflower and Green Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, thinly sliced | 2 bunches green onions, diced
instructions: Place cauliflower in a large bowl. Scatter green onions over cauliflower. Toss gently. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Stir before serving.

title: Curried Potato Wedges
ingredients: 3 cups red potatoes, cut into wedges | 3 cups canola oil for frying | 2 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Fill a wok 3/4 full with oil. Heat oil on high until smoking. Arrange potatoes in a single layer in hot oil. Cook potatoes without stirring until soft, about 5 minutes. Turn potatoes over, and continue frying until other side is browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer fried potatoes to paper towels to drain in a colander. Sprinkle potatoes with curry powder.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,plain nonfat yogurt,cream tartar,canola oil,grey poupon dijon mustard,fava bean,port wine
title: Foolproof Refresher
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups light sour cream or 1 1/4 cups low-fat nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons heavy cream ( whipping cream ) | 2 teaspoons grey poupon dijon mustard ( or other spicy mustard ) | 2 tablespoons port wine | 1 teaspoon canola oil or 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 can fava beans ( drained, rinsed, and mashed with fork ) | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Whisk together yogurt, cream, mustard, port, and oil. Stir in fava beans, and heat through. If using sour cream, stir into mixture. Transfer to a serving platter. Garnish with a sprinkling of cream of tartar before serving.

title: Broccoli on Balsamic and Garlic
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs broccoli | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Cut the tops off the broccoli, scoop out the stems, and separate the leaves. Cut each floret into 1 inch florets. Put 3 3/4 cups water into a 5 quart pot. Add the broccoli stalks and 1/4 cup of vinegar.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,grand marnier,skirt steak,cream mushroom soup,kosher salt,orange juice,white vinegar,grape juice
title: Grilled Skirt Steak With Creamy Orange Sauce
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs skirt steaks | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup orange juice ( freshly squeezed is best ) | 1/2 cup grand marnier or 1/2 cup other balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh red chilies | 1 tablespoon kosher salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients except steaks in a large crock pot.

title: Spiced Coffee Nibbles
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2/3 cup brewed espresso coffee | 1 teaspoon hummus ( optional )
instructions: Combine the cardamom, coriander and turmeric in a small bowl, and set aside. In a small bowl, stir together the coffee and a small amount of the teh spice mix. Set aside. In a small cup, stir together the tea and hummus. Drop a tablespoon of the coffee mixture into the center of each noodle, and roll it up tightly. Serve the coffee Nibbles warm.

Random Ingredients: spring wrapper wei chan brand,cilantro leaf,cider vinegar,crabmeat,phyllo pastry,salad green
title: Chili Crab Rolls (Karin Jias)
ingredients: 20 spring roll wrappers ( we have found those online that use the wrappers rather than the usual wonton wrapper we had ) | 4 ounces crabmeat, finely chopped ( i have found that most of them aren't too soft ) | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf, chopped | 4 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup bottled salad greens
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Lay the spring roll wrappers on a clean surface. Using a pastry brush, brush the outside edges of the wrappers with more of the vinegar. On each wrapper place equal amounts of the crab, chopped cilantro leaves and the spring roll wrappers. Dredge each wrapper in the vinegar and place them on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake the rolls for 20 minutes. Make the dipping sauce. Mix the dipping sauce ingredients together and set aside. Assemble the rolls, place one sheet of filo on a dinner plate and place the rolls in the center of the plate. Continue this procedure until you have 2 sheets of filo around the fish, crabmeat and cilantro leaves, ending with the cream sauce between each, and then drizzle with remaining sauce. Serve warm. Note, you can either use the spring roll wrapper we had laying around the other people in the book or you can make as many as you want.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,white peppercorn,mozzarella cheese,center tenderloin,thyme,white vinegar,red food coloring
title: Italian-Style Peppercorn Roast Tenderloin
ingredients: 3/4 cup fat-free vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns | 1 teaspoon vegetable broth | 2 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme | 2 cans solid white peppercorns packed in brine, drained | 5 1/1 pound center-cut tenderloin | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 5 1/2 ounces shredded low-fat mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Open and de brine the beef tenderloin, and place on a metal rack or a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle the meat with any remaining juices, and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of white peppercorns, vegetable broth, thyme, and 2 - 3 1/2 teaspoons of white peppercorns. Set aside for one hour, turning once or twice. Remove the beef to a clean work surface, and slice off 3/4 inch thin slices with a sharp knife. Place the 3 slices on a broiler pan lined with foil. Broil, turning once, until slightly charred, 4 to 6 minutes on tops and 1 to 2 minutes on the bottom, and 1 to 2 minutes on the top. Slice the tenderloin into 1 inch pieces and tent with foil. Place in a shallow baking pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Remove from the oven, brush with remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons of white peppercorns, and bake for 20 to 25 minutes longer, or until a thermometer inserted into the center of the meat registers 140 degrees f. Turn on the oven's broiler, and spread the peppercorns over the top. Remove the beef with a tent of foil, and spread shredded mozzarella cheese over the top. Broil until the cheese is bubbling, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from the oven. Set aside until dinner or dinner guests arrive.

title: Chinese Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 pinch white pepper
instructions: Combine the cornstarch and white pepper.

title: Cashew Crumble (Vegan)
ingredients: 8 slices french bread, crusts removed | 50 g baked beans, drained | 8 ounces firm tofu, drained | 2 tart apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 3 tablespoons fresh shavings mirin ( sweet cooking wine ) | 2 tablespoons irish cream ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons cashews, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Preheat griller to high. Arrange bread on a baking tray. Combine beans, tofu, apple, and shavings or mirin, if using, in a processor and process until creamy. Spoon over bread, pressing on to ensure it covers the entire surface. Sprinkle with cashews, if using.

title: Quick Spanish Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 ripe navel oranges, peeled, quartered and juice reserved | 4 cans bean, drained | 4 cups chicken stock | pepper sauce
instructions: Combine reserved orange juice with the other ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Feta Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked spaghetti | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1/2 cup molasses | 3 teaspoons dried italian parsley | 1 tablespoon molasses, optional | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili flakes, optional | 1 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup semolina flour
instructions: Cook spaghetti as package directs. Meanwhile, stir together buttermilk, molasses, parsley, molasses, chili flakes, and cheese. To finish, drain spaghetti and cool. Stir in feta cheese. Serve pizzas topped with crumbled feta cheese.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,canadian bacon,macaroni cheese mix,black vinegar,horseradish,ra el hanout spice mix,radish,xanthan gum
title: Macaroni and Canadian Bacon With Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked macaroni, dry | cooking spray | 3 cups canadian bacon, chopped into chunks | 1 1/2 cups radishes, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 tablespoon black vinegar, unfiltered | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package instructions. Drain. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Cook canadian bacon and radishes over medium heat until light brown. Sprinkle each with 1 teaspoon of the tahini, and toss to coat. Stir in macaroni, cheese, and remaining 1 teaspoon of tahini. Mix together the vinegar, horseradish, and remaining teaspoon of tahini. Pour over macaroni, and toss to combine. Serve.

title: Hot Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot chili pepper | 1 lime
instructions: Cut the chilli in half and discard the stalk. Rinse the flesh and peel off the outer skin. Cut into thin slices. Place these in individual bowls. Squeeze the juice of the lime into the empty chile skin and add the chili pepper, flesh and juice from the pepper. Fill each bowl with hot sauce, cover with plastic wrap and allow to stand for 30 minutes.

title: Easy and Good Mini Eggs
ingredients: 2 cans tomato puree | 1 large vidalia onion, chopped | 2 large hard-boiled eggs | 1 loaf baguette
instructions: Open empty cans into bowl, cover with water and add enough tomato puree to make sure it is liquid. Refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve cold, place peeled egg halves on ungreased cookie sheet and place under broiler. Cook for about 4 - 5 minutes, or until lightly browned and egg whites are firm to the touch. Slice baguette on the diagonal and arrange on serving tray. Place eggs on top of bread and bake at 500 degrees for about 10 - 15 minutes, depending on the thickness of your slices..

title: Pistachio Nuts With Pistachios
ingredients: 15 g roasted pistachio nuts | 80 g ground roasted pimento
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius make the nuts into sticks about 1cm x 2cm. Mix together the pistachios and ground red pepper in a bowl. Take a sharp knife and cut the sticks into a small amount of finger shape sticks. Spread a small amount of oil over a baking tray. Brush the sticks with oil and sprinkle generously with pistachios. Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, shaking the tray halfway through. Serve. Variation, use cashews instead of pistachios or pistachios and brown lightly in a dry pan. Variation, sprinkle pistachios with ground black pepper in the pan drizzle on some of the remaining oil and place in a roasting dish. Spread the pistachios around the pistachios and roast under the grill for 1 - 2 minutes or until the pistachios are starting to turn brown. Serve with lemon wedges or pita chips.

title: Caldillo
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced chorizo sausage | 2 lbs beef short rib | 1 lb beef short rib | 1 lb beef short rib, sliced into 1/2 inch slices | 1 lb chorizo sausage, cut in half | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f with rack in middle. Line a jelly roll pan with parchment paper. Remove meat from casings.

title: Asparagus With Spicy Peanut Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts | 1/4 cup lime juice | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 4 tablespoons asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Place the peanuts, lime juice, sugar and 2 tablespoons of water in a bowl and stir lightly until the sugar dissolves. Add the asparagus and mix until heated through.

title: Escarole, Cannelloni-Style Roll
ingredients: 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 egg | 1 pound beef tenderloin, thinly sliced | 2 packages frozen chopped escarole, thawed and drained | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1/4 cup grated pepperoni | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 1 hard-cooked egg, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease cookie sheets. In a large bowl, lightly beat together confectioners' sugar, and egg. Toss slices of beef with sugar then roll in the egg on the outside, being careful not to overstuff. Arrange the coated beef roll slices in a single layer on the prepared cookie sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the meat registers 140 degrees f on an instant reading thermometer, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from oven and wrap each slice in a slice of escarole.

title: Gnocchi Di Melanzane E Fagioli
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, trimmed, bulbs cut lengthwise | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Pour boiling water over fennel to cover.

Random Ingredients: brown onion,jalapeno pepper,chicken stock cube,brown sugar,kielbasa,soymilk,raspberry,ketjap manis
title: Prawns With Raspberry Sausage (Cookzies)
ingredients: 600 g kielbasa, cubed | 2 teaspoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon ketjap manis ( asian sweet potato sauce ) | 1/4 cup light soymilk | 1/4 cup chicken stock cube | 1 piece jalapeno pepper, sliced finely | 250 g raspberries, punted | 1 tablespoon brown sugar, for coating | 1 tablespoon brown sugar, for flavouring kielbasa
instructions: Cookzies, mix together first 6 ingredients in a large bowl. Place all raspberries in the bag, add the seasoning and toss well. Set aside. Prawns, place kielbasa on a nonstick grill plate. Pour on kikkasauce, cook on medium heat until kielbasa is cooked through. Serve kielbasa on top of raspberries with sauce.

title: Roasted Sweet Salmon
ingredients: 2 kg fresh salmon, boned and skinned | 2 cups caster sugar | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 140°c. Place fish on rack in oven and roast for 15 minutes until just opaque. Remove fish from roasting pan and allow to cool. Remove skin and bones from fish, then roughly chop flesh, place in a mixing bowl. Mix in sugar. Add adobo seasoning and mix. Place salmon on a large baking tray, skin side down and bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: dark molasses,taco seasoning,pepperjack cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,spanish chorizo,phyllo pastry
title: Spicy Mexican Cheese Triangles
ingredients: 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 pound spicy spanish chorizo, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dark molasses | 7 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 medium spanish chorizo, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups shredded pepperjack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease 2 baking sheets. Unroll phyllo sheets, and roll between your palms into an 8x8 inch rectangle about 1/8 inch thick. Cover with a damp cloth, and set aside. Place chorizo in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until lightly browned. Sprinkle with taco seasoning and bring to a boil. Simmer for 1 minute, then stir in molasses until blended. Remove from heat, and set aside. Place 1 phyllo sheet on a work surface. Spread 1 tablespoon of cheddar cheese and 1 pinch of chorizo mixture in the center of each phyllo sheet, and top with 1/3 remaining cheddar cheese, remaining 2 phyllo sheets, and all of the chorizo mixture. Fold up sides from bottom, and pinch to make a half moon shaped pocket in the center of each triangle. Fold in sides from bottom, press, and pinch to seal. Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets, cheddar cheese, chorizo mixture, and pepperjack cheese. Arrange on prepared baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, and tops and edges are golden brown, about 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Pepper Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1/4 cup celery, minced | 1/4 cup vegetable, granules
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in air tight container.

Random Ingredients: sandwich bread,oyster sauce,coriander seed,fennel,corn syrup,pomegranate juice,golden syrup
title: Pomegranate French Toast
ingredients: 1/2 lb sandwich bread, sliced into 4 thick diagonal slices | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed ( i use crushed and ground ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon corn syrup | 1 teaspoon pomegranate juice, from crushed pomegranate can ( optional )
instructions: Pour pomegranate juice into a non reactive bowl and soak in golden syrup and coriander for at least 10 minutes. Preheat a skillet. If using the corn syrup, stir it through the pomegranate mayo. Spread the slices of bread with pomegranate juice and cover with a very thin layer of pomegranate syrup. Cook the toast by layering the french toast with oyster sauce, golden syrup and coriander. Keep adding the bread slices and finishing with a layer of bread. Cook until the slices are golden brown on top and a toothpick comes out clean. Serve.

title: Herbed Herb Stock
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh basil | 1 bunch fresh dill
instructions: Pick the leaves off the hard stems of the herbs such as dandelions, sorrel and savory. Rinse well. Place on a serving platter and cover with a few sprigs of fresh herb.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,urad dal,applesauce,almond,pork leg,bicarbonate soda,cardamom,salt pepper
title: Lubeah
ingredients: 1 liter urad dal | 400 g whole kernel corn | 150 g ground pork legs | 1 pinch salt and pepper | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 1 pinch ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon apple leaves or 1 teaspoon almonds, ground | 2 pinches salt and pepper | 1 pinch garam masala
instructions: Soak the urad dal overnight in plenty of water. Drain and place it in a pressure cooker. Add 100 ml water. When it simmers, add the corn, ground pork legs, salt and pepper. Mix all together until well combined. Sprinkle some of the ground spices on your palms and knead well. Put aside for 20 minutes. Take a large non stick pan and place over a medium high heat. Add 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda. When the bicarbonate is bubbling, put in as many pats of salt. Once it reaches about 400 f it is ready to eat. When you take the skillet out, put it back down under the same heat. Pour the contents of the skillet into the pan, and mix once and then cover the pan tightly. Once the cooker starts whistle, remove from heat and allow to sit for 45 minutes. Open the lid, add the cardamom, and mix once again. Serve with paratha, roti, bread or chapati, anything required.

Random Ingredients: fruit,puff pastry,green peppercorn,mexican corn,vegetable broth,celery rib,irish cream
title: Creamy Irish Corn Puff Pastry Pricks
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable broth | 2 packages frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 1/2 lbs assorted dried fruit, such as apples, pears, and apricots, cut into strips ( or a mixture of fresh and frozen fruit ) | 1 can mexican-style corn, drained ( with liquid ) | 2 -4 green peppercorns, bruised ( optional ) | 1/2 cup irish cream ( or half-and-half, or other creamy dessert creme fraiche ) | 1 medium celery rib, cut diagonally into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f generously butter a 12 inch nonstick skillet or 8 inch square baking dish and set aside. Place flour in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Working in batches, sift flour into bowl. Dredge fruit in seasoned flour and transfer to a pastry bag with a star tip.

title: Italian Sausage Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 4 lbs potatoes
instructions: In a large, deep skillet, brown the sausage.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 12 -12 pieces thai chiles | 12 -12 cubes processed cheese food | seasoning, if desired
instructions: Using very sharp knife, make sure the slice in the middle of your thai chili and the slice inside the thai chili can be any thickness. Using cheese food is optional, but helps assure that cheese does not go black. Cut in 1 pieces. Store in refrigerator.

title: Baked Squash
ingredients: 2 medium summer squash | 1 bay leaf | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Combine all ingredients in a baking dish. Cover dish with lid or aluminum foil tightly. Bake approximately 30 minutes or until squash is tender and beginning to brown.

title: Beef Shortbread
ingredients: 4 medium beef round steak, cut 1 inch thick | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder ( hershey's ) | 6 tablespoons cornmeal | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard | 3 teaspoons grated orange peel | 3 teaspoons cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Remove top layer of foil and coat with cornmeal. Place beef on foil, leaving 1 inch between each beef steak. Mix remaining ingredients in large bowl and pour over beef. Wrap foil securely around meat. Place in large bowl and refrigerate until very cold, at least 2 hours, but up to 5 days. To bake, place foil packet on baking sheet and place in oven and bake 3 to 5 minutes, or until meat has cooked and internal temperature reaches 130 degrees f. Remove meat from oven and let meat rest 10 minutes. Slice with serrated knife and serve.

title: Homemade Fresh Vegetables in a Salt Crust
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs fresh mixed vegetables, trimmed | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Mix vegetables and salt in bowl and mix thoroughly. Let stand at room temperature until salad is completely cold. Transfer to small bowl. Use as directed for vegetables.

Random Ingredients: hot water,ginger garlic paste,beef sirloin steak,romano cheese,oriental sesame oil,bay leaf,soba noodle,cremini mushroom
title: Oriental Beef With Spicy Noodles (Kalter N Nød, Nødssuppe, Nachosetna)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, 1-inch thick | 2 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 1 1/2 lbs cremini mushrooms | 5 romano cheese, freshly grated | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste ( khaeng ) | 1 bay leaf | 2 lbs dried soba noodles, 1-inch wide and 2-inch long | water
instructions: Trim fat from beef and slice crosswise into thin slices and then into 1/4 inch wide strips. Pour about 2 tablespoons oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. When oil is hot, add beef and cook for 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Remove beef to a paper towel and drain. Set aside. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in skillet. Add mushrooms and cook until browned. Remove mushrooms from pan. Reduce heat to medium low. Return beef to skillet with 1½ cups water. Add ginger garlic paste, bay leaf, and noodles. Cook, covered, for about 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Return beef and 4 tablespoons water to pan. Cover and simmer for about 20 to 25 minutes, or until noodles are tender and meat is cooked through. Serve noodles with sauce.

Random Ingredients: nori sushi,baby spinach,streaky bacon,sherry wine,black bean,chili
title: Barbecue Salad
ingredients: 2 sheets nori sushi | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 4 -6 tablespoons cooked black beans | 4 -6 slices streaky bacon, chopped or 4 -6 slices other bacon, cut into small pieces | 1 hot pepper, halved, deseeded, finely chopped | 100 -150 g baby spinach
instructions: Use a bamboo sushi roller with a rolling pin, lightly grease the rolling pin. Place 2 sheets of sushi on each sheet and set aside. Put 2 tbsp of sherry into a bowl and add 4tbsp of cooked black beans, 1 tbsp chopped bacon and 1/4 cup of cooked black beans, 1 tbsp of chopped roasted garlic and half a pepper strip. Mix lightly but thoroughly before adding the rest of your ingredients. To serve, slice your chosen salad greens, sprinkle with nori or nori powder. If you don't have nori you can sprinkle with extra seasoning and serve with a good quality plain boiled yucca or white grapefruit salad.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,yellow squash,red cabbage,beef,pesto sauce,mustard seed
title: Curried Cabbage and Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef | 1/2 cup shredded yellow squash | 1/2 cup shredded red cabbage | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In a large skillet, brown ground beef, add squash and cabbage. Cook for 5 minutes. Remove mixture to a bowl and set aside. In the same skillet brown mustard seeds in mustard oil for 2 minutes. Add pesto, turmeric and spice and combine well. Add the beef mixture to peppers and onions and cook for about 5 more minutes or until vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: nori,feta cheese,orange,garlic salt,red chile powder,red bell pepper,baking potato,buttermilk biscuit
title: Chile Feta Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk biscuits, crushed | 10 ounces feta cheese | 2 medium baking potatoes, shredded | 1/2 red bell pepper, diced | 1/4 orange ( zested and juiced ) | 1/2 garlic salt | 1 teaspoon dried red chile powder | 1 teaspoon baking potato flakes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Grease each 12 cup muffin pan. In a bowl, stir together the buttermilk biscuits and feta cheese. Stir in potatoes, red bell pepper, orange zest, and garlic salt. Stir in chile powder. Spoon mixture into muffin cups. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes. Top with baking potato flakes during the last 10 minutes of baking if using.

title: Korean Style Beef Satay
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin steaks | 1/3 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 20 maraschino cherries ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the ground ginger and ketchup. Pour over the beef and marinate at least 3 hours, or overnight. Slice beef thinly into 1/2 inch pieces, and arrange on skewers. Thread the skewers onto metal skewers, alternating them, beginning with the beef and ending with the cherries. Brush with glaze while cooking. Cook on medium low, covered, at a low temperature about 15 minutes, or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,green pepper,vodka,rice vermicelli,white wine,red curry paste
title: Vodka Nuoc Cham (Vodka Noodle Salad)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 -2 teaspoon red curry paste ( depends on taste ) | 6 raman noodles, medium sized | 3 ounces white wine | 2 ounces vodka | 1 lb rice vermicelli
instructions: Boil water, add raman noodles. Rinse noodles with cold water until tender. Drain. In a large mixing bowl, add red curry paste, curry paste, and raman noodles. Add vodka. Cut white wine in 3 ozs, add to bowl with noodle mixture. Add vermicelli, mix. Add small sauce bottle to cover noodles and sauce on top, refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight.

title: Bircher Lechon
ingredients: 2 cups apple juice | 1/4 cup ground hazelnuts
instructions: Pour apple juice in a large bowl or glass measuring cup, cover and refrigerate overnight to develop flavor. The longer the fermentation period, the stronger the flavor. Line a tea kettle with several layers of cheesecloth, and place into a bowl of cold water. Bring apple juice and hazelnuts to a boil in the boiling water for 3 minutes, or until hazelnuts become very fragrant. Ladle hot hazelnut brew into mugs, and allow guests to pour hot lemon flavored juice into mugs.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,rice noodle,brandy,candy sprinkle,red cabbage
title: Thai Red Cabbage and Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles | 1 1/2 lbs ground red cabbage | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup braggs liquid aminos | 1/4 cup brandy | 8 cups red cabbage ( shredded ) | 2 cups bow tie pasta
instructions: Place noodles in a large bowl and cover with warm water. Set aside to let water return to a boil. Drain and set aside. In a large frying pan, cook ground red cabbage for about 10 minutes or until soft. Add brandy and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in noodles and cook until hot. Transfer to large bowl and set aside, covered, to keep warm. Stir cabbage and drained pasta into noodles and add remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. To serve, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto ham,rye bread,italian parsley,collard green,romano cheese,tomato puree,ice,chipotle powder
