Random Ingredients: wheat bread,daikon radish,bread flour,red curry paste,kaffir lime leaf
title: Grilled Daikon Radishes With Indian Spices
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( to taste ) | 2 slices bread, cubed | 4 whole radishes ( about 1 inch in diameter ) | 2 tablespoons bread flour ( or cornstarch ) | 6 kaffir lime leaves ( thai )
instructions: Prepare the curry paste. In a mixing bowl, combine the curry paste and the bread. Cut the radishes in half, slice into 1/4 inch thick slices and add the radish slices to the masala paste. Let this marinate 3 to 4 hours in a sealed container. Thread the radish strips onto metal skewers, alternating them with the red curry paste. Grill the skewers 4 to 5 minutes on each side. Make the masala. In a mixing bowl, combine rice flour and kaffir lime leaves. Add the bread mixture and keep stirring until mixture becomes sticky and clumps disappear. Turn off the heat and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Store in your refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,onion powder,dark brown sugar,lamb shank,kalamata olive
title: Grilled Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks, trimmed | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon kalamata olives, drained | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Season the lamb shanks liberally with onion powder and then divide the olive among the shanks. Set the lamb shanks in a preheated grill, close the lid, and cook for 1 hour. Remove the lamb from the grill and turn the shanks over, close the lid, and cook 1 hour more to brown the outside and to thaw the inside. To steam, place the oven rack on the center rack.

title: Spicy Mexican Fish #RSC
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs fish | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace or 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | reynolds wrap foil | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup mexican cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Place fish in a shallow roasting pan. Sprinkle mace over fish and roast in 350 degree oven for about 20 min or until fish flakes easily with fork.

Random Ingredients: cornbread,fish sauce,rotel tomato,lemon peel,zucchini,baking soda,red cabbage
title: Sweet Cornbread and Zucchini Grilled Vegetarian Packets
ingredients: 6 ounces canned corned fish sauce | 3 ounces canned rotel tomatoes, with juice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 small zucchini, cut into matchsticks | 1/2 head red cabbage, cored thinly sliced | 1 piece lemon peel, peeled, washed and cut into matchsticks | 12 cornbread | 2 tablespoons fish sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat grill. Dividing ingredients into eight parts, place each piece on its side in a flat dish or on a bamboo rolling mat. Spread each piece with 2 tablespoonfuls of the fish sauce.

title: Grilled Italian Cutlets
ingredients: 4 veal cutlets | 1 lb sliced fresh turkey breast | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, well drained | 3 tablespoons whole grain mustard
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients and place in resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,chili bean,chili garlic sauce,rotel,asiago cheese,red pepper,dill weed,garbanzo bean
title: Chili Beans With Garbanzos and Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained ( or a couple cups of cooked beans ) | 1 can chili beans ( in jar ) | 1 cup red pepper, chopped | 1/2 bunch fresh dill weed ( about 2-3 leaves ) | 2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons asiago cheese, grated
instructions: Boil and de press the garlic, chili beans, onion, red pepper, dill, and hot sauce. When the vegetables are tender, mash the garlic with the fork or potato masher to make your own sauce. If you're adding the asiago, grate some and mix with the sauce. Stir in the asiago cheese. Serve with white rice. Enjoy.

title: Parmesan Oil
ingredients: 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Pulse the parmesan cheese and corn oil together in a food processor to mix. Transfer the mixture to a clean dish towel and spread over the top of the oiled food in a slow motion with a rolling pin, rotating it to spread it evenly.

title: Turnip With Vermicelli ( Vermicelli )
ingredients: 1/2 lb vermicelli, broken into 4 pieces ( or you can use 1/2 lb of vermicelli and you may use a mix if desired ) | 1/2 lb turnip, washed and cut in cubes | 1 baguette | 2 cups single cream
instructions: Drain the vermicelli and turnip well and set aside. Cut the baguette into 1/4 inch thick slices. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Drop the baguette slices in boiling water for 1 minute. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain again. Set aside. Dip the vermicelli into the hot hot water, drain, and set aside. Drain the turnip well and set aside. Peel and cut the turnips into bite size pieces. In a bowl, lightly beat the cream. Add the sour cream mixture to the turnip and turnip and gently cook until warm. Serve as a main course with pita bread.

title: Wild Rice With Faraway
ingredients: 1 lb fresh wild rice | 2 tablespoons melted butter
instructions: Drain wild rice and steam for 10 minutes. Rinse faraway with cold water, add water to cover and steam for another 10 - 15 minutes until tender. Stir in rice, season and serve.

title: Tia's Coppa
ingredients: 1 pint littleneck clams with shell | 3/4 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup coffee flavored liqueur
instructions: Place the clams in a 9x13 inch baking dish.

Random Ingredients: lamb,sage,gorgonzola,red curry paste,balsamic vinegar,plain flour,cardamom seed,arborio rice
title: Lamb and Gorgonzola Risotto With Red Curry
ingredients: 750 g lamb, cut into bite size peices | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups carnaroli rice | 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 glasses balsamic vinegar | 100 g gorgonzola
instructions: Make the red curry paste, mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl and set aside in the refrigerator. In a wok heat the red curry paste and fry until it becomes nice and fragrant. Add the lamb and mix well. Add the rice and stir well. Cover and cook on the stove for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring continuously. The rice will have absorbed most of the oil. When just mixed in, stir well to ensure all the rice gets mixed into the meat. Serve immediately, sprinkled with black pepper and garnished with fresh basil.

title: Angel Hair Pasta with Pecans and Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine, uncooked | 2 teaspoons dry sherry | 1 1/2 cups drained canned tomato sauce ( or plum tomatoes with basil or oregano, undrained ) | 1 cup shredded apple ( optional ) | 1 package of pre-shredded angel hair pasta | 1/4 cup chopped pecans ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Flemish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground meat | 1 cup sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix all ingredients using your hands. Roll into 1 inch balls approx. 8 inch in diameter. Place on parchment lined cookie sheets. Bake 30 - 45 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: egg white,red shallot,white wine,coconut milk,elbow macaroni
title: Creamy Macaroni and Eggs
ingredients: 1 cup dry elbow macaroni | 4 large egg whites | 1/3 cup shredded coconut ( unsweetened ) | 1 small red shallot, minced | 1/4 cup dry white wine or 1/4 cup vermouth
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package instructions, then drain. Mix macaroni, egg whites, coconut and shallots in large bowl. Add macaroni mixture to egg whites mixture and mix well with a fork. Pour into buttered 2 qt. Baking dish.

Random Ingredients: sambal oelek,snow pea,cayenne,green enchilada sauce,green pepper,plain flour,corn tortilla,white rice
title: Chinese Snow Pea Wraps(No Eggs)
ingredients: 1 green enchilada sauce | 150 g snow peas, trimmed | 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with water | 200 g plain flour | 1 cup white rice | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | sambal oelek, to taste ( optional ) | 1/4 green chili pepper, finely chopped | 20 soft corn tortillas, soft
instructions: Melt the sauce. Heat grill. Rinse and dry the snow peas on a baking tray. Grill for 3 minutes. Toss with the cornstarch mix and cook for 2 minutes over medium low heat. Whisk the rice and cayenne until well combined and heated through, about 1 - 2 minutes. Lightly toast the soft tortillas, sprinkle some chilli, sliced chilies and green onion over the base. Spoon half of the rice mixture onto each soft tortilla, top with 1 tbsp of the snow peas. Fold the left and right sides of the tortillas, rolling as tightly as possible, over the filling, secure with a wooden toothpick if necessary. Repeat with remaining tortillas, pressing slightly to help the tortillas roll as tightly as possible. Lay out on a paper towels to drain off any excess moisture. Fold the left and right sides together and roll the wraps, securing with toothpicks if desired. Place seam side down in a warm oven until all are ready to fill and heat through, about 15 - 20 minutes. Serve immediately. Alternatively, wrap everything as tightly as possible in soft tortillas, wrap in aluminium foil and keep in a warm oven for 20 - 25 minutes to firm. Unwrap and serve with tamarind sauce.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,sirloin,cheese,vanilla ice cream,winter squash,vegetable oil
title: Stove Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb sirloin, very thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 1/2 - 3/4 cup frozen mixed vegetables, such as aubergines, sliced tomatoes | 3 -4 cups cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup vanilla ice cream or 1/2 cup cream ( optional )
instructions: Wipe the steak thoroughly with a damp paper towel. Remove all visible fat from the steak. Cut the meat into thin slices about ¼ inch wide. Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet. Sprinkle the beef with a bit of salt and cook, over medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Turn the beef over and brown the other side. Once browned, drain on paper towels or kitchen paper towels. Turn the stove onto low. Place beef in the fondue pot. Stir in the vanilla, vegetables and half the cheese. Simmer gently for two hours. Top with remaining cheese. Serve over noodles, rice or whatever is on hand. Note, for a little more bite, add ¼ to ¼ cup of cornstarch mixed with a tbsp water to a hot pan of hot water before adding the cornstarch to the hot pan of water.

title: Mustard Seeds With Ginger
ingredients: 5 lbs mustard seeds | 1 cup gingerroot, grated | 1 cup corn oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Mix mustard seeds and grated ginger thoroughly. Mix corn oil with cold water and add to the dry ingredients. Mix to form a thick paste. Place teaspoonfuls of mustard mixture on a flat plate. Heat mustard mixture in the oven for 20 minutes. Spread hot mustard on every 2 minutes and return for 5 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,self raising flour,corn tortilla chip,pistachio,meatball,beef brisket,cucumber,raspberry
title: Meatball and Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 1 lb corned beef brisket | 8 ounces small frozen meatballs | 1/2 cup pistachios ( chopped ) | 1/3 cup cucumber ( chopped ) | 1/3 cup seedless raspberry ( cut in halves ) | 1/2 cup red chilies ( sliced ) | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | corn tortilla chips
instructions: Rinse and drain corned beef brisket thoroughly. Chop the corned beef brisket into strips and roll into balls. Place in a crock pot with enough water to cover the meat. Cook in the crockpot for 6 - 8 hours. Remove brisket from pot and let cool. Drain meatballs and place in a large bowl. Add spices and nuts. Mix well. Combine flour and salt in a bowl and use to dust meatballs. Shred meat and combine in salad bowls. Serve with corn chips.

Random Ingredients: baking chocolate,vegetable oil cooking spray,basil pesto,white flour,simple syrup,sesame oil
title: Simple and Delicious Pesto Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil ( can use cooking spray ) | 1 ounce semisweet chocolate, chopped ( dark chocolate is good ) | 2 cups unbleached white flour, plus extra for dusting | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 4 -6 tablespoons simple syrup | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Place the oven rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 400°f. Dust a baking sheet with flour. Use the cooking spray to grease an 11 x 7 x 2 inch baking baking sheet. In a medium pot, melt the chocolate over medium low heat and stir often. Remove from heat. Stir the chocolate until smooth. Set aside. In a large bowl, sift the flour and measure in the baking powder. Pour in the chocolate and butter mixture. Using two fingers, work all of the flour, a bit at a time, into the chocolate until it forms a dough. On a lightly floured surface, work the dough out into a rectangle about 1/8 inch thick and 1 1/2 inches wide. Cut into three diagonal slices. On a lightly floured surface, use a floured rolling pin to flatten each slice to a 12 inch square. Cut each square diagonally into 12 half inch slices. Using the flat side of your knife, make twelve 12 inch sticks. Place one baking sheet on the baking sheet, allowing the stick bread to rest about 5 minutes. Transfer the breadstick sticks to the baking sheet. With a spatula, gently tap the stick pieces on the sheet to remove and discard as many stick pieces as possible. Lightly cover with aluminum foil or a light coating of cooking spray. Prick all the stick bread in several places with a skewer blade. Place the breadsticks on the baking sheet and bake until the lightly browned, about 12 to 15 minutes. Let cool on a rack.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,pasta,cumin powder,penne,red bell pepper,red pepper
title: Pasta With Roasted Red Pepper & Honey
ingredients: 600 g penne, about 2 1/2 inches in diameter | 3 tablespoons clear honey or 3 tablespoons agave nectar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 red bell pepper, roasted and cut into strips | 1 red bell pepper, roasted and cut into strips | 200 g roasted red peppers, cut into strips
instructions: In a non stick frying pan, gently toss the penne in the honey. Then add the ground cumin. Cover the pan with a lid and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer over a medium heat for 8 minutes or until the pasta is al dente. Toss in the roasted red peppers. Serve straight away.

title: Kielbasa
ingredients: 10 ounces kielbasa sausage, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 10 red potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice sausage in half. Arrange slices in a single layer in a single layer on the baking sheet, and sprinkle with potato slices. Bake 8 to 10 minutes, or until top darkens in color, and potatoes are tender.

title: Basic Passover Chips
ingredients: 1 3/8 cups matzo meal | 1 1/2 cups dry breadcrumbs ( or dry bread crumbs of your choice ) | 1/2 cup vanilla | 2 cups breadcrumbs | 12 medium-sized tortillas
instructions: Prepare 1 13x11 inch pan by lightly spraying with a vegetable spray. Line the pan with a non stick foil or parchment paper. Make the basic Passover snacks, place 2 cup dry bread crumbs in bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade. Add vanilla. Begin pulsing until bread crumbs are uniformly moist and dough just begins to stick to your machine. Do not overprocess, as if you were making bread crumbs and spread out on the back of a spoon. Sprinkle 2 cups of bread crumbs on tray in food processor. Place in processor bowl. Add 6 medium sized tortillas. Peel off the excess casing from the 4 tortillas by soaking it in cold water for 5 minutes while squeezing the husks to remove as much water as possible. Cut tortillas into 6 strips. Place in food processor. Pulse, then process until chips are formed, about 1 minute per tortilla. Place 1 teaspoonful of crushed chips in center of each tortilla strip and pinch edges together and place on baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Continue doing this until all are covered and chilled throughout, about 20 minutes. Spray both sides of each chip with vegetable spray and top with 1 teaspoonful of crumbs. Bake in 400°f oven for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, just until the tops are lightly browned. Allow to cool completely on rack. Store in airtight container.

title: Quick Kids' Favorite Pizza Crumbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup minced fresh italian parsley | 4 teaspoons minced fresh parsley | 8 teaspoons minced fresh italian parsley | 1/4 cup pam cooking spray or 1/4 cup pam cooking oil, for pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f/155°c. In a medium bowl, mix the graham cracker crumbs, 4 teaspoons parsley, 4 teaspoons dried parsley, and 2 teaspoons dried parsley. Spray a nonstick or 12 x 14 inch baking pan with pam cooking oil. Pat the crust batter into the pan. Sprinkle the crust with the crumb mixture. Bake the pizza crust for 13 minutes or until the topping is browned and crisp on the edges. Serve.

title: Tandoori Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning, & | freshly-grated pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients, mix, taste, and let sit for an hour or so before eating to let the flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: soda water,pork loin roast,salt beef,lettuce,mace,pork tenderloin,brown rice
title: Soda Pork and Rice Dinner
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb pork tenderloin ( trimmed of fat ) | 3 boneless pork loin roast | 1/8 teaspoon mace | salt and pepper | 2 cups cooked brown rice | 1 container plain soda water | 1 -2 cup lettuce ( torn )
instructions: Trim of all visible fat from the pork. Cut into 1 inch cubes. Sprinkle with mace and salt and pepper. Place, meat side down in a roasting pan and roast at 350°f degrees for 1 hour. Shred the meat with a fork. Place rice in a large bowl, along with 1/2 cup soda water. Toss to mix thoroughly. Remove pork from oven and discard remaining juices and place on top of rice along with 1 - 2 tbsp. Of the pork meat and lettuce. Stir gently. Serve in a shallow bowl garnished with a sprinkle of a little ground pepper.

title: Grilled Halibut With Chocolate-Cherry Glaze #1
ingredients: 2 lbs halibut fillets, 1-1/4 to 1 1/2 inches thick ( see note ) | 1/2 cup dark chocolate or 1/2 cup good cooking chocolate | 4 large potatoes | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate or 2 tablespoons good cooking chocolate | 1/4 cup sweet cherry, halved | 1 teaspoon dark chocolate | 3 drops liquid smoke
instructions: Note, specifically, cherry halved. If using dark sweet chocolate, remove it before measuring. Remove halibut fillets from packaging and place on a cookie sheet. Lightly coat one side of fillet with glaze. Wrap with wax paper or plastic wrap and refrigerate at least six hours or overnight. Note, if using dark chocolate, cut into 1/4 inch slices and place on wax paper or plastic wrap for a second time.. Preheat grill. Place potatoes on a lightly oiled grill rack over medium heat. Close grill lid and grill, turning occasionally with tongs or a fork, until tender, about 15 minutes total.. Drain potatoes on paper towels. Cut into 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick slices and place on a lightly oiled grill rack over medium heat. Close grill lid and grill, turning occasionally with tongs or a fork, until tender, about 15 minutes total. Mash potatoes with sweetened chocolate, cherry halved and liquid smoke in a bowl set over a saucepan of simmering water until smooth. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp. Chocolate shavings. Remove fillet from grill, drizzle with glaze and sprinkle with more chocolate shavings, if desired. Turn once and close grill lid and allow to continue to cook until fish is cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes more. Note, cherry may also be sprinkled on fish before removing from grill, if desired. Note, halibut may be cooked according to package instructions.

Random Ingredients: yellow food coloring,szechuan peppercorn,italian salad dressing mix,marjoram,lobster,pecorino cheese,orange,red pepper
title: Linda's Lobster Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh lobsters, unpeeled | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh marjoram | 1 teaspoon sichuan peppercorns | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried orange peel | red pepper to taste | 1 jar shaved pecorino cheese | yellow food coloring
instructions: Dry the lobsters thoroughly on paper towels. Use clean scissors to cut the meat from the tail and claws, discarding the claws and shells. Rinse the lobsters well and pat dry. Place the lobster meat in a large mixing bowl. In a small bowl, combine the salad dressing mix, marjoram, peppercorns, orange peel, red pepper, pecorino cheese, yellow food coloring, and 1/2 cup of water. Stir together just until ingredients are incorporated. Spoon the mixture over the lobster meat and toss gently to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 6 hours. Before serving, refrigerate overnight and stir before serving.

title: Penne Pasta With Parsley and Fresh Parsley
ingredients: 455 g hot penne pasta | 1 bunch fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil, add the pasta and cook according to packet instructions. Meanwhile, dry fry the fresh parsley leaves, then tear them into bite size pieces with scissors tip, or squeeze between fingers and squeeze out the excess water. Drain the hot pasta, then toss in the parsley to serve. Serve straight away.

title: Homemade Sourdough Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup chopped onion | 2 tablespoons dried marjoram | 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease 2 or 3 loaf pans. Mix together the dried onion, marjoram, and 1 cup of flour until thoroughly combined. Place mixture in prepared loaf pans. Bake for 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until a toothpick inserted into bread comes out clean.

title: Crock Pot Vinegar Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs tenderized sirloin steaks | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Cut steaks into quarters and remove strings. Place on wax paper and lay them flat in crock pot. Combine all ingredients in a bowl, cover and cook on high for 2 1/2 hours. Serve over boiled white rice.

Random Ingredients: portobello mushroom,cream chicken soup,ginger garlic paste,green pea,garlic,corn oil,egg white,beef
title: Sizzlin' Gobi Cheeze
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 1/4 cups green peas | 1 small portobello mushroom, thinly sliced | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons garlic, minced | 1 egg white, beaten | 1/4 cup corn oil
instructions: Place ground beef in a skillet with peas, mushrooms and soup, stirring until cooked through. Stir in ginger garlic paste, garlic and egg white. Heat until sauce begins to thicken. Pour onto a serving dish and serve over hot cooked egg noodles.

title: Indian "cauliflower Cut" Focaccia
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into 8 pieces | 2 loaf focaccia bread | cumin powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 and prepare a pan with no stick spray. In a large bowl place the cauliflower, bread and cumin. Add 1/2 cup water and mix well. Spray pan with vegetable spray and put mix on pan to form a layer. Bake for 40 minutes, turning halfway through.

title: Spicy Dark Chocolate Ganache for Christmas
ingredients: 300 g dark chocolate | 120 g ghee
instructions: Break up the chocolate using a mortar and pestle, leave it for 1 - 2 hours in a bowl until you can remove it from the bowl. Once it has become smooth, mix in 50g of ghee. When it has become creamy add another 50g of ghee. Keep in mind that ganache will be more or less oily. It is now ready to serve in its own container for christmas.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,self rising flour,thyme sprig,chicken breast,cheese mexican,watercress,lamb
title: Spanish Lamb & Cranberry Shepherd's Pie
ingredients: 250 g boneless skinless lamb ( cut into 25cm cubes ) | 1/4 cup self rising flour ( or all purpose flour, and 3tsp baking mix ) | 1 bunch watercress ( or spinach leaves ) | 3/4 cup tasty cheese ( shredded, cheddar, swiss or any other tasty cheese ) | 1 sprig thyme sprig, plus extra sprigs for garnish | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 12 -14 small fresh steamed broccoli or 12 -14 small baby bok choy, halved, including just the tender stalk | 1 medium free range egg poacher or 1 medium free-range eggs ( for this dish ) or 1 medium free-range egg replacer ( for this dish )
instructions: Combine lamb, flour, and water in a large bowl, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Heat a large non stick frying pan over a medium or high heat. Add half the lamb mixture to the pan, and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes. Repeat with remaining lamb mixture, arranging ingredients down the length of the pan. Transfer the lamb and vegetables to a large ovenproof dish. Spread the cheese over the top, and put the lid on with tin foil. Cook for 30 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally. Carefully remove foil, and bake the mrm mrm sauce for 20 - 30 minutes, or until heated through and cheese melts. Garnish with thyme, cranberries and steamed broccoli or baby bok choy and serve immediately.

title: Cherry and Marsala Salad
ingredients: 6 tablespoons marsala wine | 6 tablespoons ground almonds | 6 tablespoons dried apricots | 1/3 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a medium bowl. Toss.

title: Chicken & Sausage Empanaditas
ingredients: 6 chicken | 1 sausage meat ( sweet or hot depending on your taste ) | 1 pie crust pastry
instructions: Use your favorite sausage meat. I like to use a turkey roast. Cook over medium heat so it gets crispy on each side, then cut into 1 inch pieces or chunks. I slice them about an inch wide. Line 2 pie plates with pastry, then place the chicken on top on top of the pastry. Cut the sausage meat into 1 inch strips. Take the sausage meat out of the casing and place it in the hot pan, then brown on all sides, removing each piece when done. You can also add the meat from your sausage in a bowl or through a strainer, i just like to make sure it’s cooked long enough so your juices don’t overpower the sausage.

title: Aromatic Beef Sandwich Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup shredded asiago cheese | 4 rib eye steaks, pounded thin | 4 romaine lettuce
instructions: Over medium heat, bring the stock to a simmer. Place one rib eye steak in a skillet and cover.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,chicken broth,red chilies,russet potato,coconut cream,bulgar wheat,cremini mushroom,vanilla
title: Beef Curry With Red Curry, Mushrooms and Potato-Pepper Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large russet potato, peeled | 1 -2 red chilies, seeded and minced | 3 -4 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 tablespoons coconut cream | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 3 cups cooked bulgar wheat or 3 cups whole wheat flour, to coat the beef
instructions: Cut the potato vertically in half.

title: Crazy Crayfish
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked imitation crabmeat | 1 ripe mango, peeled and cut into thin slices | 2 tablespoons crushed pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the crabmeat and mango in a baking dish. Sprinkle with pistachios. Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes. Uncover dish, turn over, cover and bake for an additional 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,red bean,dark brown sugar,chili paste garlic,parsley
title: Red Beans and Chilli (Beans)
ingredients: cooking spray ( no pam ) | 500 g red beans, washed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons sweet chili paste with garlic | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped
instructions: Heat an ovenproof pan over medium heat. Add the cooking spray. When the spray starts foaming, add the beans and stir to combine. Cook for 10 mins or until tender. Stir in the brown sugar, sweet chilli paste and parsley. Serve in shallow soup plates with crusty bread for dipping.

title: Spiced Eggplant with Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 medium eggplant | 1 jar aged cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon mixed spice paste ( of your choice ) | 1 medium biscuit, crushed
instructions: Cut ends off of eggplant and slice into chunks. In a dutch oven, place drained eggplant, cottage cheese, salt and spice paste. Pour in enough water to cover, cover and allow to simmer for at least 1 hour. Invert onto a plate, remove and serve.

title: Beef on a Stick (Steak or Chicken)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, cut into bite size pieces | 1/4 cup flour tortilla, heated | 1/4 cup bamboo shoots sliced or julienned bell peppers | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh bok choy ( optional )
instructions: Spray skillet or fry pan with non stick cooking spray or lightly oil the pan. Brown meat on all sides in the skillet. Remove meat and skillet add the sauce. Reduce heat and simmer sauce on low until meat is tender. Slice meat to desired serving size and place on a platter. Sprinkle each serving with chopped bok choy if desired.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,berbere,puff pastry,cheddar cheese,egg noodle,madras curry powder,cool whip
title: Bermre Modek
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry, thawed | 14 ounces egg noodles ( red or white ) | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 teaspoons madras curry powder | 1 teaspoon ginger paste ( the paste i used was not prepared ) | 1 carton cool whip | 1/2 teaspoon berbere or 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees. Place puff pastry on a baking sheet and cut into 20 strips. Divide noodles among 8 serving bowls, top with cheddar. In a bowl, combine curry powder, ginger paste and cool whip, mix well. Spread over noodles. Top with berbere/cayenne pepper blend. Bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,ham,cottage cheese,beef stew meat,green onion,lettuce leaf,sage,mace
title: Fantastic Beef and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lamb chop | 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 lb cottage cheese ( i like a mix of dairy and milk ) or 1 lb ricotta cheese ( i like a mix of dairy and milk ) | 1 teaspoon ground mace, to taste | 8 small salad leaves | 2 bunches green onions, cut into 1-inch pieces | diced cooked ham
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the meat if using lamb chop or beef stew meat and place in a large saucepan. Add a small amount of water to help the meat soak up the water during the cooking process. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat then reduce heat to low and partially cover, stirring occasionally, and simmering for 1 hour. Drain off any accumulated fat if the meat is partially submerged and allow the lamb and beef to cool until easier to handle. Add the cottage cheese, mace, and any remaining broth or water to the meat, reduce heat to low and refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve, place the salad leaves on four plates and arrange the green onion and ham on top. Spoon the meat and cottage cheese mixture over the greens and sprinkle with any remaining green onions.

title: Basmati Rice Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 3 slices bacon
instructions: Cook the rice according to the pack instructions. Drain the rice and spread it onto a baking tray with the back of the spoon. Smear the rice evenly over the rice. Break or crumble the bacon lardons over the rice. Keep stirring until the bacon is crispy and the rice crispy and crispy on the edges.

title: Rosemary Rosemary Beer
ingredients: 1/3 cup honey | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup lime juice | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 6 beer rolls
instructions: In a small bowl stir together honey, vinegar, lime juice and rosemary. Slice rolls into 1/2 inch thick slices. Fill each slice with 1/2 cup rosemary sauce. Serve with remaining sauce.

title: Roasted Cranberries (Or Filled)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh cranberries, halved | 2/3 cup olive, pitted | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Roast the 1 lb. Fresh cranberries in 1 quart glass or ceramic baking dish, about 25 minutes, tossing occasionally, until fragrant and lightly browned. Cool to room temperature. Coarsely chop the remaining 1 lb. Cranberries. Pour 1/4 cup olive oil into a small bowl. Sprinkle the 1/4 cup of olive over cranberries and toss to coat. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover loosely with foil and keep at room temperature until ready to serve. Note, you can use pomegranate flavored juice from canning, it seems to work just as nicely. The juice keeps for 1 week, but the olives are really good.

title: Quick Sprouts
ingredients: 2 pounds brussels sprouts | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Blanch brussels sprouts for 3 to 5 minutes, or until bright green. Drain and place in a bowl. Stir in five-spice powder.

title: Rice Pancakes With Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, minced | 4 ounces plain yogurt | filling ( see all purpose fillings, 1/3-dough ) | 7 ounces basmati rice or 7 ounces rice, washed and soaked in warm water | dates or dried dates
instructions: Remove papery skin from mushrooms. Wash mushrooms under warm running water, then slice them in 1/4 inch thick pieces. Soak the mushrooms in warm water for 8 minutes, then drain. In a bowl, mix together yogurt, mint and prepared filling. Drain the soaked rice and keep aside. Prepare the rice as per instructions on the package. Make small flat circular cups to use for the filling and to help keep the fillings out. Fill one at a time with the prepared rice. Close the circles and secure them with a toothpick. Steam the circles for about 10 - 15 minutes, turning the balls after 5 minutes. Serve with mint chutney and/or yogurt. Note, you could also fill each pancake with stuffing that has been soaked in warm water before making the pancakes. You can also fill a mound of rice while the filling is forming and keep the mixture inside the circle. It is very important to ensure that the filling does not fall in the filling during cooking.

title: Homemade Fresh Strawberry and Chilli Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup yoghurt | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 fresh red chili pepper | 2 ounces dried berry | 2 small red hot chili peppers | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Blend the yoghurt, chili, catsup, berry, red chili and salt in a blender until the mixture becomes a thick puree. Cover the mixture in an airtight container and allow it to mature for 8 hours, stirring occasionally. Use as needed in biryani style biryani, salads, bread, bread sandwiches or just eat it to bring new strength and flavors to the table.

title: Mozzarella Calzone (Stacked Mozzarella Calzones)
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh mozzarella cheese | 8 -10 slices canned whole milk mozzarella | 8 vanilla beans, split
instructions: Place the mozzarella in a 9 x 13 glass pan and cover with slices of whole milk mozzarella. Dollop the top with the vanilla bean slices that you have cut a slit down the inside to open it like dirt. Set this in a warm oven until the mozzarella begins to float, about 20 minutes. You may want to cover the surface of the dish during this process with a disscussion of your stove top if you have one. When it is time to eat, let it cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,corn oil,oregano leaf,sake,new mexico chile,lime juice
title: Chipotle Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin seed | 3/4 cup minced fresh oregano leaves or 3/4 cup fresh italian oregano leaf, packed | 2 tablespoons sake | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice wine ( mirin ) | 1 can new mexican chiles, drained and coarsley chopped
instructions: In a heavy skillet, heat the oil until fragrant. Add the oregano, sake and lime juice. When the water boils, add the chilies and lower the heat. Simmer, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes, or until the chiles have softened and the flavors are blended.

title: Konaf (Sourdough Croutons)
ingredients: 4 slices sourdough bread | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Place 3 slices of bread on cookie sheet. Mix lemon juice and juice. Brush on the bread slices. Broil on both sides until very lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: chicken,ginger garlic paste,asiago cheese,pesto sauce,chicken breast half,yeast,italian breadcrumb
title: Italian Breaded Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon yeast ( not rapid rise ) | 1/2 cup dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup fresh grated ginger-garlic paste | 4 skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 12 slices asiago cheese | 1 ounce asiago cheese, grated
instructions: Sprinkle the 1 tsp dry yeast over 1 cups warm water and let stand for 10 - 15 minutes. Dissolve the 1/2 cup bread crumbs in the 3/4 cup grated ginger/garlic paste. Place the chicken in a large bowl and add the breading mixture and the pesto. Toss well to coat. Cover and place in a large bowl. Allow to sit for 2 hours or until it is doubled in size. Preheat oven to 450 degrees and spread 1 tbsp of the asiago cheese on each chicken cutlet. Roll the chicken up to form a long roll and place in a lightly oiled baking dish. Continue until the chicken is painted with the asiago and 3 tbsp of the pesto mixture. Place the baking dish in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 160 degrees. Remove from oven and brush with the remaining melted asiago cheese. Return to the oven and bake until browned and the asiago cheese melts.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,sage,chili powder,italian seasoning,brown lentil,greek olive
title: My Favorite Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 3 cups cooked egg noodles | 1/4 cup brown lentils or 1/4 cup green lentils | 1/4 cup chopped greek olives or 1/4 cup mixed dried fruit | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon zesty italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon sage
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and allow to cool for about 15 - 20 minutes. Shape into 4 patties. Place patties on a lightly sprayed baking pan and bake at 350 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes, or until done through. Serve.

title: Indian Omelet
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red onion, finely minced | 4 eggs, beaten | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 romaine lettuce, washed, patted dry and minced ( a handfull )
instructions: Combine onion and eggs together in a medium bowl, add turmeric, and mix very well. Fold the romaine leaves into the egg mixture. Add more spices if desired. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,orange flower water,horseradish sauce,swiss cheese
title: Swiss Cheese Orange Peel
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg swiss cheese | 600 g grated fresh horseradish sauce ( or 2 to 3 tablespoons horseradish paste ) | 1 1/2 cups caster sugar | 500 g orange flower water ( or lemon juice )
instructions: Cut cheese into large chunks and toss with horseradish paste and caster sugar until the cheese has fully softened. Stir in the orange flower water. Spread the mixture evenly over the cheese and sprinkle grated cheese over. Wrap it in wax paper which has been lightly rubbed to remove any air bubbles.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,pork shoulder,red chile pepper,mini chocolate chip,golden raisin,cream cheese,pie crust
title: Rice With Sweet Red Chile Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisins | 1/4 cup mini chocolate chips | 2 cups basmati rice | 2 large red chile peppers | 5 ounces fat free cream cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 8 large pie crusts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. To prepare, mix raisins with chocolate chips in a medium bowl. Set aside. Using oven mitts remove 2 crusts from each pie, and lightly brush pie mitts with oil. Place rims on rimmed baking sheets. Combine rice with chiles, cream cheese and raisin mixture. Cut remaining 2 crusts almost in half, and place half of crust halves on each crust half. Add reserved chocolate chip mixture to remaining 1/2 cup rinsed rice mixture, and place on top of chile slices. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, or until crust is golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Simple and Delicious Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 box rice wine | 1 lb small shell pasta or 1 lb fettuccine
instructions: In a large pot heat pasta according to package directions. Add rice wine to pot and slowly bring to boil while stirring. Add pasta, cook over a low heat 4 - 5 minutes depending on your heat. Serve piping hot.

title: Low Fat Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups spaghetti sauce | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1/3 small amount roasted pumpkin seeds | 1/4 cup dry roasted salted peanut, for dipping
instructions: Soak the peanuts in water. Place in a microwavable bowl or pan, and cover. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Drain in a towel. Place the spaghetti sauce in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the chicken bouillon cubes and pumpkin seeds. Cook about 5 minutes, stirring often, until vegetables are tender. Stir the peanut mixture into the sauce. Keep warm over low heat.

title: Irish Oven Turnips - Home Fries
ingredients: 3 small turnips | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Wash and cut turnips into fries. Place in a large baking dish. Sprinkle with the seasoned salt, and cover with a sheet of greaseproof paper. Bake at 375 for approximately 1 1/2 hours, or until fork tender.

Random Ingredients: green bean,baby carrot,star anise,spanish rice mix,rosemary,corn,head cabbage
title: Vegetable Pho
ingredients: 1 package baby carrots | 1 whole head of coleslaw mix | 1 small head of cabbage ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup frozen sweet corn | 3 star anise | 3 sprigs fresh rosemary | 5 ounces spanish rice mix or 5 ounces brown rice mix, such as jasmine or basmati
instructions: Drain carrots well. Boil carrots and corn 15 minutes. In 3 - 4 quart saucepan combine all of the vegetables. Cover and simmer 5 to 6 minutes. Remove the cover. Stir and cook over medium high heat 1 minute. Uncover, stir well, and cook for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes and then fluff with fork. The pho may be prepared up to this point and refrigerated for up to 2 days or frozen for up to a month. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,tarragon,brown rice,american cheese,cauliflower floret
title: Baked American (French) Cheese and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cauliflower floret | 1/4 cup light brown rice | 3 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1/3 cup shredded american cheese | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven on broiler rack. Wash florets in a strainer, and slice crosswise into small pieces. Place rice in a baking dish, and cover with boiling water. Place florets on top of water, and bake for 40 - 50 minutes, stirring halfway through. To bake american cheese, in a small, nonstick pan over medium high heat, melt the cheese and dried tarragon over a low heat. When the cheese is melted, remove from heat and stir in the tarragon. Remove and cool the florets, then spread on a large serving plate. Spoon on the cheese, and place under the broiler to crisp up the cheese. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,almond meal,beef sirloin steak,cake flour,chicken bouillon,ginger paste,white wine
title: Gingery Beef With Almonds
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond meal | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 4 beef top sirloin steaks | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon | mint sprig ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: In a shallow dish or plate, combine the almond meal, ginger paste and beef cubes. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. When ready to cook, preheat the oven to 425° and bring 3/4 cup water to boil. Remove beef cubes from marinade and place in marinade, in a single layer. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and discard and reserve the marinade. Place meat on a rack in a roasting pan and bake the meat for 20 minutes, turning the meat every 3 minutes. Pour off any excess fat, then place the roasting pan over medium high heat and add the white wine, stirring to scrape up any browned bits stuck to the pan. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until reduced by half, syrupy and well glazed. Add cake flour and bouillon and continue simmering for 5 minutes. Transfer steaks to a serving dish, pour the sauce over them and garnish with mint sprigs if desired. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,kosher salt,chili pepper flake,half,beet,coleslaw mix,ketchup
title: Korean Style Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil ( or more ) | 1 lb coleslaw mix | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon hot chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 -2 tablespoon coleslaw mix ( i like to use miracle whip brand, so i use kraft brand ) ( optional )
instructions: In large skillet heat oil. Add cabbage mix, stir in half& half, salt, and chili flakes. Mix in ketchup, stir until cabbage is coated evenly with ketchup and chilli. Let simmer 5 - 10 minutes longer until cabbage is slightly wilted and creamy. Turn heat off, pour ketchup mixture over veggies and toss lightly. Refrigerate at least 20 minutes or the longer the better.

title: Raspberry & Almond Salad With Saffron Rice
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups mixed dried fruit ( raspberries, blackberries, strawberries ) | 1 tablespoon powdered saffron threads or 1 tablespoon ground turmeric | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 3/4 cup semolina ( farina ) | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon agave mayonnaise | 4 cups mixed dried fruit ( raspberries, blackberries, strawberries ) | 1 tablespoon saffron threads or 1 tablespoon turmeric | 1 ounce raisins
instructions: For the rice, mix all the ingredients together in a mixing bowl and refrigerate for an hour or two. Place the seeds from the raspberries through a sieve. Mix in the mayonnaise. Serve topped with the saffron rice and garnish with the raisins.

title: Ww 3 Points - Spicy Chicken and Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 3/4 cup dried shrimp-poked cured chicken breast | 1/2 teaspoon hot mixed spice | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger root, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mint, crushed | 1 1/4 pounds bone-in country-style spareribs, trimmed
instructions: Mix the yogurt, shrimp, chicken, spicy spice, ginger, and dried mint together in a bowl. Place the spareribs in a large pot over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,madeira wine,picante sauce,dark brown sugar,shallot,cream coconut,basil,basmati rice
title: Spicy Coconut Basmati Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon shallot, chopped | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon basil | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, washed in | 1/2 cup light cream of coconut | 3/4 cup madeira wine | 1/2 cup picante sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar, shallot, fish sauce, and basil. Place rice in a large bowl, and add the shall mixture and cream of coconut. Mix well, then place in refrigerator until needed. Turn rice onto a serving dish, and pour over the coconut mixture. In a small saucepan over medium heat, stir together wine and picante sauce. Bring to a boil, then pour over rice.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,almond,mustard powder,mussel,beef bouillon granule,buttercream frosting
title: English Steamed Mussels
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh mussels or 2 lbs frozen mussels | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1/2 cup softened buttercream frosting | 1/3 cup caster sugar | 1/3 cup chopped blanched almond
instructions: Place all the above ingredients in a large stockpot. Scrub and clean the mussels and add to the pan. Cover and simmer for 1 hour, shaking the pan every 15 minutes. Cool and store in the refrigerator overnight. Serve with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,onion powder,swiss cheese,white cheese,virgin olive oil
title: Swiss Parsnip Dip
ingredients: 1 parsnip, grated ( medium or small ) | 1 lb swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 cup white cheese, grated | 1 cup virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon onion powder ( onion powder is the secret ingredient )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in an oven proof crockpot. Serve hot for dipping.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,yellow pepper,sun tomato oil,spaghetti,hamburger,parmigiano reggiano cheese,onion powder,lime juice zest
title: Spaghetti With Smoky Beef
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean hamburger | 3 -4 tablespoons minced sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow peppers | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons lime juice and zest | 1 teaspoon dried onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 package spaghetti
instructions: In a large frypan on medium heat cook hamburger breaking up with a wooden spoon until no longer pink.

title: Swiss Cheese Bread Dip
ingredients: 3 cups kruste bread, finely crumbled | 2 tablespoons olive oil, warmed | 2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 0.5 package artificial sweetener | 1/2 cup dashi | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup canned artesian artificial sweetener
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly spray a medium baking sheet with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, toss together kruste, olive oil, swiss cheese, 1/2 the dashi, cumin, and remaining dashi. Transfer to baking sheet. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Make diagonal slits in top of dip with a knife. Bake in the preheated oven about 15 minutes, until cheese is caramelized and sour cream topping is melty. Remove from oven. Spread warm sour cream over dip. This may not be ready until the morning, but it will take a few hours to prepare before serving.

title: Spiced Pistachios
ingredients: 2 cups shelled pistachio | 1 packet ketjap manis | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Combine the ketjap manis, turmeric powder and pistachios in a bowl and mix together. Store in an airtight container.

title: My Favourite Steak
ingredients: 16 ounces lean lean ground beef | 3 tablespoons plain fat-free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup purchased pesto sauce | 1 cup cooked white rice
instructions: Crumble ground beef into a bowl and add plain yogurt. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Mix well. Divide mixture into 10 portions. Wrap each portion with a toothpick. Broil in a preheated oven for 5 minutes or until cooked through and browned.

title: Easy Low Fat French Baguettes
ingredients: 1 lb all-purpose flour | 1/2 lb rolled oats ( or a little less | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Place the flour in a bowl. Add the water slowly and knead until it becomes like soft dough. Shape into small, but firm enough patties to hold at least 3 inches in diameter. Fry in a little fat until brown, about 5 to 8 minutes. Drain on paper towels, sprinkle, and serve while still warm.

Random Ingredients: szechuan peppercorn,flat leaf parsley,walnut,okra,beef stock,hamburger,linguine,apple cider vinegar
title: Spiced Okra With Linguine and Beef
ingredients: 2 ounces thin-cut ham or 2 ounces very lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, fresh chopped | 2 slices apple cider vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons beef stock | 1 tablespoon sesameuan peppercorns | 1 lb fresh okra, trimmed, ends removed, quartered | 4 ounces linguine | 1/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a hot nonstick skillet over moderately high heat the szechuan peppercorns, stirring to toast them, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Turn the heat to moderately low and stir in the parsley. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: chutney,parmigiano reggiano cheese,bok choy,mango,cider vinegar,black eyed pea,penne pasta,dark rum
title: Penne With Bok Choy, Black-Eyed Peas, and Prawns
ingredients: 1 package uncooked penne pasta | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1 jar prepared mango slices | 6 bunches bok choy, chopped | 1/4 cup dark rum | 2 tablespoons apple vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced fresh garlic | 1 teaspoon freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a large pot of lightly salted boiling water, cook penne until al dente, about 11 minutes. Drain pasta. Pour off 1 cup of pasta cooking liquid, reserving 1/2 cup. Rinse remaining 2/3 cup of cooked pasta with cold water and drain again. Toss pasta and reserved cooking liquid in a large bowl. Mix in drained, cooked pasta with liquid, reserved liquid, 1/2 cup rum, mango slices, bok choy, dark rum, vinegars, parmigiano reggiano cheese, and black eyed peas. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours, and serve cold. My notes, prep time includes refrigeration overnight.
