Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,italian sausage,chinese egg noodle,green chilies,tortilla chip,crouton,cream cheese
title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb italian sausage | 5 -6 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese | 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 teaspoon minced green chilies ( optional ) | crouton | chinese egg noodles
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sausage, cheese, cream cheese, green chilies, and chilies. Pour into an oven proof dish. Bake in a preheated 350 oven 30 minutes or until bubbly. Serve over noodles.

title: The Best Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 12 ounces tomato juice | 12 ounces cider vinegar | 4 1/2 ounces cooking oil | 4 1/2 ounces whole wheat flour, or as needed
instructions: Combine tomato juice, cider vinegar, and oil in a saucepan.

title: Broccoli With Parsley and Herbs
ingredients: 2 lbs broccoli | 1 bunch flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Break up the head of broccoli into florets with a fork. Drop one cup of water into the pot and boil 5 minutes, or until the broccoli becomes bright green. Drain the broccoli and reserve. In a salad bowl, toss the remaining 1 cup of water with the broccoli heads, parsley and salt. Cover and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,green,lemon juice zest,broccoli,russet potato,bisquick baking mix
title: Lemon & Broccoli Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup bisquick baking mix | 3/4 cup unsweetened grated reg. original bisquick baking mix | 1 cup thinly sliced green, white and light green parts of broccoli | 1 cup julienned julienned russet potato ( about 3 ) | 1 cup chopped, cooked broccoli | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin lemon juice and zest | icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Stir 2 cups biscuit mix and grated reg. Olli in another bowl. Add green parts of broccoli, potato, 3/4 cup reg. Olli mixture, and lemon/zest. Stir lightly with a flat bladed knife or fork, then spoon mixture evenly into muffin cups. Bake in the preheated oven until golden and top springs back when lightly pressed, about 14 minutes. Allow muffins to cool in pan on a wire rack. Turn out on serving plates and dust with icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,fruit,bamboo shoot,spaghetti,chili oil,courgette,purpose flour,white bread
title: Pasta and Vegetables
ingredients: 400 -500 g ripe firm fresh fruit ( any combination, such as papayas, bananas, melon balls and apples ) | 1 medium courgette ( zucchini, zucchini stalks, black beans, green beans and corn ) | 1 teaspoon dried chili oil, to taste | 2 tablespoons dried sweet bread, cut into cubes | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 ounces bamboo shoots, chopped ( canned is ok ) | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf
instructions: Cut the fruit into bite sized chunks. Cut the courgettes into rounds. Cut the zucchini into slices of about 4 - 5 in thickness. Put the chili oil in a large frying pan or wok and fry the dried bread cubes with the flour. Remove from the pan and stir in the fruits. When the mixture is hot stir in the hot bread mixture. Cover and cook until the vegetables are tender. Stir in the bamboo shoots and cook for about 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve with freshly cooked pasta and rice.

title: Cheese and Pepper Tumble
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces quick-rising stone ground mustard | 1 pinch saffron | 1 1/2 ounces pecans, finely chopped | 7 tablespoons finely grated sharp cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons wholemeal breadcrumbs ( optional ) | 1 lb mirliton, skinned green
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp mustard, 2 tsp saffron, 2 tbsp pecans and 3 tbsp cheese in a non stick fry pan until the nut has melted, shaking the pan occasionally. Add 1lb mirliton skinned mirliton. Cook over a medium heat until most of the water has evaporated. Take off heat and stir in remainder of cheese. Put in 4 serving dishes, sprinkle with remaining spices and a sprinkling of breadcrumbs and serve warm or warm.

Random Ingredients: red pepper paste sauce,cabbage leaf,kosher salt pepper,salt pepper,green onion,mushroom
title: Spicy Fried Cabbage
ingredients: 3/4 lb cabbage leaf | 3 green onions, sliced | 8 medium mushrooms ( sliced or chopped ) | 2 teaspoons hot red pepper paste | 3 tablespoons finely chopped green onions | 1 pinch salt and pepper
instructions: Using a sharp knife or mandolin cut out the core and the ribs from the cabbage leaves. Wash and gently squeeze out any excess water from the cabbage leaves, removing all the coarse leaves or ribbons from the leaves with the blade of a knife. Set aside at room temperature for approximately 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large pan set at least 1/4 inch of hot coals, sauté the green onions in a little oil about 3 minutes. Remove the onions with a strainer from the pan, add them to the skillet, and sauté them for another minute. Add the hot pepper paste, mushrooms, salt and pepper. When everything is mixed well, cook until all the liquid has evaporated and the sauce begins to thicken, about 7 minutes. Toss with the cabbage leaves to serve.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,green pepper,date,red wine vinegar,black mustard seed,pate,wonton wrapper
title: Rice and Pepper Sambalas
ingredients: 1 package round wonton wrappers, frozen | 1 cup cooked arborio rice | 1/2 cup green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup date, chopped | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 1 cup prepared pate
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients but won't set wraps apart, and place a teaspoonful onto the center of a wonton wrapper. Brush edges with water. Sprinkle each with a pinch or two of mustard seeds. Place samblas on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes, until golden. Let cool slightly, then roll to enjoy.

title: Scotch Sausage or Hot Dogs
ingredients: 12 large polish sausage | 1/2 red bell pepper | 1 teaspoon tomato ketchup
instructions: Cut sausage in half leaving the last half still on. Sauté in butter. Spread with tomato ketchup. Cut with a serrated knife and fry in hot fat until browned.

title: Gran's Easy Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cans condensed tomato soup | 2 -3 tablespoons rice wine ( optional ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Place all ingredients into soup pot and bring to boil. This only needs to be simmering before ready to serve as this soup should have thickened slightly as not to be too thin.

title: Roasted Crescent Apples With Yogurt and Cranberries
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 cups cranberries | 1 tablespoon shortening or 1 tablespoon ghee | 1 cup mashed avocado
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f combine apple juice, lemon pepper, garam masala and 1/2 cup of the cranberries. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Melt shortening in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave 1 cup of the cranberries for 3 minutes or until softened. Reserve the liquid. Blend the cranberry mixture and the cranberry mixture with a blender or food processor until smooth. Pour half the yogurt in a shallow baking dish. Cut each circle in half using a serated knife. Spoon the curds into the centre of the circle, fold sides over the curds. Press the edges together with a spatula. Spoon the remaining yogurt mix onto the crescents evenly. Sprinkle with the reserved cranberries. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until browned.

title: Ginger Tempura
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon red jalapeno chile, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ginger, minced | 1 teaspoon radish, chopped | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients. You can either use a wisk or a whisk, and whisk until batter is slightly thick. This makes a lot of batter, so you may have to add more cornstarch as you go. Heat a frying pan over medium heat. When it is quite hot, but not smoking, pour batter into the pan. Cook until bubbles form on top of the pan, then remove from heat. Allow to cool for a few minutes before removing to a plate. You can either serve immediately or it can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two weeks.

title: Brunede's Famous Swiss Oven Rock Sal
ingredients: 3 lbs swiss rolled rock salt | 2 heads cabbage | 200 g mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 lbs scallops or 1 1/2 lbs lumpfish | 1/2 cup raisins or 1/2 cup dried mixed fruit
instructions: Roll the rock salt sheets into a large rectangle about 10 x 25 inches. Turn them every so often so that the salt and seaweed sheets will evenly spread. Cover with saran wrap. Place in a large roasting pan and fill with enough water to come up about 1/4 inch above the salt sheets. Turn onto the counter or table. Cover with saran wrap and a piece of cheesecloth and weigh down with something you can handle. Let sit in a warm place for about 36 hours, then rinse under cold running water. The weight of salt should just drop off. Discard the salt. Preheat the oven to 200 c/400f. Remove the cheesecloth cover and the saran wrap that covered the meat. Cut off the greens and set aside. Take the hard side of your cabbage and peel the outer leaves.

title: Tuscan White Beans
ingredients: 6 ounces fresh cooked cannellini beans, drained | 3 cups fresh spinach leaves | 2 cups peeled, seeded and chopped cucumbers
instructions: In a large skillet, combine beans and spinach. Cook, stirring often, until spinach is wilted. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: honey,red chile pepper,carrot,peanut oil,topping,dijon mustard,fennel seed,marinara sauce
title: Honey Glazed Carrots
ingredients: 2 cups sliced carrots, 1 cup cut diagonally in half | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon fennel seeds | 5 dried red chile peppers | 1 can low-fat marinara sauce ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet, heat peanut oil over medium heat. Add carrots and stir occasionally until golden brown and crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in honey and mustard. Stir fennel and chile peppers into carrot mixture. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until carrots are fork tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: potato cheddar pierogies,banana,orange peel,couscous,cream mushroom soup,green onion,noodle,red wine vinegar
title: Pierogie Pies
ingredients: 4 cups cubed potato and cheddar pierogies | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can sliced nuggets ( or clamato stuffed olives ) | 1 -2 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup sliced green onion | 1/2 cup sliced banana | 1/2 cup finely grated orange peel | hot cooked noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place potato pierogies in a pot with enough lightly salted water to cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and allow pierogies to steam for about 5 minutes. Drain, and cut in half lengthwise. Place cut side down on a baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until tender. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together soup and canola gravy mix. Place noodles in a serving dish, and drizzle with soup mixture. Garnish with orange peel slices, green onions, avocado slices and/or sliced bananas. Serve plain or with hot cooked noodles.

title: Wattleseed and Black Olive Dip
ingredients: 1 cup black olives | 1 cup spring onion, chopped | 3 tablespoons dried wattle seed | tortilla chips
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a food processor and mix well until finely blended. Transfer to a serving dish and top with tortilla chips.

title: Italian Snow Peas, Tomatoes & Tomatoes in Oats
ingredients: 1 lb frozen snow peas | 1 pint plum tomato, sliced | 1 pint italian-style stewed tomatoes | cooking spray or 1 lb olive oil, to coat pan | lime, juice of
instructions: Place the pan in the freezer, and cook peas as per package directions. Meanwhile, spray a large cooking pan with cooking spray or olive oil. When peas are frozen, drain the water from the tomatoes and tomatoes. Dice the tomatoes. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange snow peas on a baking sheet. Place them one at a time, in a single layer, in one layer. Spray the tops of the snow peas with cooking spray or olive oil. Bake for 5 - 8 minutes until crisp and fragrant. Remove from the oven. Pour tomatoes and peas over the snow peas. Sprinkle evenly with minced lime juice to taste. If desired, serve warm.

title: Fruit and Yogurt Pudding
ingredients: 3 large sprigs fresh sage | 1/2 - 1/2-1 teaspoon minced fresh gingerroot | 1/4 cup minced bermuda onion | 3 large egg whites ( lightly beaten ) | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 tablespoon cornflour, cornstarch or 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1 can blackberries or ( 4 ounce ) can peach schnapps
instructions: Chop sage and sprinkle over top of fruit. In a small bowl combine mustard and cornflour or potato starch. Stir egg whites until foamy. With a large spoon gently stir egg whites into fruit mixture. Pour into pie pan. Put in refrigerator. Remove pie pan from refrigerator. Place a large platter over the top for the pudding. Sprinkle top with chopped sage. Place platter on a cookie sheet and put under oven broiler for 10 to 12 minutes until slightly brown on top and just starting to brown.

title: Vegan Yum Yum Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup soy protein or 1 cup texturized chicken stock | 1 cup orange juice | 2 chopped celery
instructions: Combine yum yum sauce and stock together in a sauce pan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in orange juice. Continue to mix the sauce in the pan until desired consistency is achieved. Enjoy the nutrition facts for vegetarian omit the soy protein. This is not free freekewing the vegetarian option. You can use the vegetarian broth, soy protein, tofu, or other protein.

title: Penne with Creamy Italian Dressing
ingredients: 3/4 lb penne or 3/4 lb rotini pasta | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream, heated
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta well, reserving pasta water. Return to pot.

title: Fish on the Run
ingredients: 3 -4 ounces fish fillets, any kind will do | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon wine
instructions: Preheat grill place the fish fillets on the grill. Sprinkle with creole seasoning and wine. Cook until fish is cooked and flakes easily with a fork.

title: Cauliflower And Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 1 1/2 cups baked beans | 1 pinch green cardamom pod ( optional ) | 8 whole dried limes | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/4 lb feta cheese | 2 -3 small carrots
instructions: Chop cauliflower and carrots if desired.

title: Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken thigh fillets, cut into thirds | 1 1/2 cups peas, frozen | 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed | 2 parmesan cheese
instructions: Place chicken in an ovenproof dish. Sprinkle over the brown sugar and bake in a moderate oven, about 20 minutes or until browned. Serve in soup bowls with peas and parmesan cheese.

title: Olive Garden Quinoa and Rigatoni in a Bowl
ingredients: 8 ounces quinoa, rinsed, drained | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta, broken into 1-inch pieces | 8 slices green cardamom pods, toasted | 4 ounces green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Place uncooked quinoa, broken quinoa, rigatoni, and green cardamom pods in bowls. Pour hot water to cover.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,cooking sherry,sea scallop,farfalle pasta,cilantro,yeast,cardamom,spanish onion
title: Scallops and Onions with Spicy Indian Sherry
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons warm-tasting spanish onion ( dijon or walla walla is suitable ) | 1 1/2 lbs unpeeled sea scallops | 1 tablespoon dry-cooking sherry | kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked farfalle pasta, hot or 1 cup bowtie pasta | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 small sprig fresh cilantro ( for garnish )
instructions: Soak onion in warm water to cover 2 minutes. Drain and cool. Cut into 1/2 inch slices. Set aside. Drain scallops. Cut crosswise 1 inch wide at one of the long sides of each. Place scallops in a bowl. Sprinkle scallops with salt and toss with onion slices. Let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, warm sherry in a small, heavy skillet. Brush top side of scallops with sherry. Turn and sprinkle with cardamom. Cook scallops in hot sherry until just done. Remove scallops and turn. Drain on paper towels. Keep scallops warm. Combine farfalle and cooking sherry in a saucepan. Remove from heat. Put cooked farfalle in a bowl. Add scallops and onions. Pour sauteed sherry over the mixture. Stir to mix. Divide farfalle among serving plates. Garnish with cilantro leaves and cilantro.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,french bread,hazelnut oil,beef tenderloin steak,beef brisket,dinner,cannellini bean,chicken thigh
title: Easy Crockpot Hearty Beef-And-Beef Tenderloin Sandwiches
ingredients: 8 beef tenderloin steaks | 4 chicken thighs | 4 beef briskets | 1 can cannellini beans ( drained ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 loaf french bread, baguette | hazelnut oil | hazelnut oil
instructions: Cut french loaf lengthwise into 4 thick slices. Place french bread baguette slices on broiler pan. Bake under preheated broiler for 5 minutes, until golden. Remove from oven, and top with hazelnut oil. Boil cannellini beans, broth, and bouillon. In a separate skillet, brown tenderloin steaks in hazelnut oil.. Remove steaks from pan, and place on a plate. Add 1 beef pound of beef to skillet, then brown evenly. Do not crowd pan. Place a piece of bread onto a serving plate. Cover with a slice of beef, and place one beef slice onto the bread. Repeat with all pieces and beef. If you'd like to eat the full party, place one beef slice on a slice of bread and serve a roast chicken or beef brisket with toothpicks and a drizzle of hazelnut oil. This is easy to do for a party, just cook the meat until a bit crusty. Place meat on a warmed dinner plate. Top with cannellinni beans, chicken thigh, and two beef slices.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,ham,red chile pepper,plain flour,lemon juice
title: Spicy Apples With Ham
ingredients: 4 large peeled granny smith apples, such as fuji | 1 teaspoon plain flour | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 red chile pepper, chopped | 12 thick slices ham
instructions: Cut out the core of each apple, leaving the apple and stem intact. Slice each lenghtwise into strips, and set aside. Stir the plain flour into the lemon juice. Roll each slice of ham in flour, then carefully remove stuffing from each slice. Scoop out and discard cores and juices. Place each apple on top of one slice of ham. Gently roll ham back up.

title: Quick Noodle Soup
ingredients: 5 ounces soba noodles ( thin noodles ) | 4 ounces fresh spinach, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup coconut cream ( not sweetened )
instructions: Boil or steam the noodles. Cook till tender. Put in casserole dish. Add spinach and coconut cream. Stir until blended. Enjoy.

title: Peppered Prunes
ingredients: 1 lb pitted prunes | 2 yellow peppers | 6 tablespoons heavy cream
instructions: Place all ingredients in skillet and warm through. Drain off excess liquid.

title: Nuts and Crisp Apples
ingredients: 2 apples, peeled, cored and finely chopped | 2/3 cup golden caster sugar, firmly packed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Line a baking tray with grease proof paper. Put the apples and sugar into a large bowl, sprinkle in the sugar. Toss to combine. Tip a little water on the mix to soften it, then transfer it to a gratin dish that is big enough to fit the apples and sprinkle on the remaining sugar. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until the apples are tender and the sugar has caramelised and crunch. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Broccoli Rabe
ingredients: 350 g broccoli ( about 4-ounces in weight ) | 300 g gruyere cheese | 300 ml white flour
instructions: Wash the broccoli and cut into 4 florets. Steam the broccoli in a large pan of boiling water for about 5 minutes, or until just tender. When they are cool enough to handle, chop them into a small ball. Peel and grate the cheese. Drain and mix with the flour. Add a little milk if needed to form a thick but rather liquid, to make firm dough. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Shape the dough to about 2 cm in diameter. Grease a large non stick, deep, shallow oven dish. Press the broccoli into the dough, turning so it is coated. Bake in the oven for approx 20 minutes, or until the dough is puffed and golden.

title: Garlic Rice Cake
ingredients: 2 boxes yellow rice | 1 -2 cup double cream | 2 -3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped ( optional ) | 1 -4 shallots, chopped or 1/2 teaspoon finely minced red onion | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( depending on taste ) | 1/2 - 1 cup dry breadcrumbs
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients. Dip rice cake into mixture and place in a greased and floured 12x9 pan, making sure it is evenly distributed throughout the pan. Bake at 350f degrees for 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Moroccan Lentil and Orange Soup
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 200 g oranges, quartered
instructions: Wash lentils in cold water until the water runs clear. Place lentils in a bowl. Cover with cold water. Bring to the boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low. Cover, and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until lentils are tender but not mushy. Stir occassionally. Remove cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add oranges and serve with couscous or your favourite meal, if desired.

title: Wasabi and Chil Suey
ingredients: 4 teaspoons wasabi powder | 3 teaspoons fresh lemon zest ( or lemon juice ) | 1 teaspoon tarragon ( i use dried... i like it with our own. i use more. ) | 500 g meat ( of your choice ) | 3 tablespoons peanut oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 small mushrooms, sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup roasted red peppers or 1/2 cup roasted jalapeno slice ( optional )
instructions: Mix wasabi to a paste and mix in the lemon zest or juice. Add the meat. Chill a few hours to marinate. Heat oil a wok over high heat and add meat. Stir fry until just cooked all the way through. Remove from heat. Add mushrooms, if using. Stir fry just until they are heated through.

Random Ingredients: bourbon,chili bean sauce,lemon verbena leaf,chicken,catsup,cardamom seed
title: BBQ Chicken With Borage
ingredients: 1 whole chickens | 1 cup chili bean sauce | 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup bourbon | 5 cardamom seeds | 5 dried lemon verbena leaves
instructions: Wash and pat dry chicken. Truss legs with string. Rub chicken with 1/2 cup of chili bean sauce, coat with catsup and 1/2 cup of bourbon. Place chicken in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with cardamom seeds. Cover pan with foil and bake for 1 hour at 350°f. Uncover and bake a further 30 minutes.

title: Steak and Shrimp in Spicy Tamari
ingredients: 3 lbs steak | 1/2 lb jumbo shrimp | 4 ounces water chestnuts, sliced | 2 tablespoons tamari | cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Cut steak into 1x2'' cubes. Cut shrimp in half lengthwise. Marinade, combine all ingredients and mix well. Thread 1 piece of beef onto 6 metal skewers, alternating with the shrimp. Broil or grill, brushing often with sauce, over medium heat turning as needed, for 10 - 15 minutes until done.

title: Greek Oxtail Soup
ingredients: 4 lbs oxtails | 1/2 cup greek yogurt, not flavored-canning type | 3 tablespoons kikkoman soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place oxtails in oven for 30 minutes. Turn oxtails once. Bake for about 45 - 60 minutes to an hour. Pull oxtail off oxtail bone if it’s pink in the center or you have an overlty moist meat that easily escapes during cooking, but oxtails will be tender when they are done. Take a piece of meat from the oven, put it in the bowl of a blender with greek yogurt and 3 tbsp of kikkoman soy sauce and puree until smooth. You may need to put the meat back into the roasting pot to re introduce the liquid. Remove the meat from the oven at the end of 30 minutes. Pull oxtails out from the pot and put them back in the oven at 400°f. Take all meat off of the bones and slice meat into thin strips. Serve with a greek salad for dipping.

title: Mango Chutney Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, cooked | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons mango chutney, finely diced | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Heat the rice and 2 cups of water in a saucepan, on the stove top, over medium heat to a boil. When rice is just about to boil, remove from heat immediately. Stir in egg white, mango chutney and mirin and stir for the liquid to be absorbed. Transfer rice to a serving bowl, garnish with green onion tops. For vegan use only the vegan option as it can reduce the nutritional content of the rice.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,shrimp,cumin,creamy peanut butter,colby monterey jack cheese,red chilies
title: Camarones Del Norte
ingredients: 2 cups sour cream | 1 cup creamy peanut butter | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 2 1/2 cups shrimp, cooked, shelled and deveined | 8 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 8 ounces mild red chilies, chopped ( jalapeno or serrano )
instructions: Prepare grill to high. Combine sour cream, peanut butter and cream cumin in pan. Cook over low heat until very thick. Add shrimp. Top with colby monterey jack and chiles. Grill until melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,bean dip,celery salt,green bell pepper,ice,vanilla
title: Chili-Dip Surprise!
ingredients: 2 cans bean dip | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup chopped celery salt | 2 teaspoons chili powder, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 5 tablespoons imitation bean dip, or as needed
instructions: Blend 1 can bean dip, green pepper, celery salt, chili powder, and vanilla together in a blender until smooth. Pour into a serving bowl. Drizzle 1 tablespoon bean dip on top.

title: Roasted Chiles With Italian Sausage
ingredients: 6 chiles poblano chiles | 1/4 lb italian sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Pulse chile peppers until small pieces. Remove stems and seeds from pepper pods. Place 1 tablespoon sausage in a 12 inch by 8 inch baking pan and sprinkle with chile mixture. Roast chile mixture for 20 minutes. Serve with tomato salsa recipe.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,bread,basmati rice,golden raisin,apricot,tomato paste
title: Zanzibari Polow
ingredients: 3 cups black-eyed peas, washed and drained | 1 cup basmati rice | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 large bunch bread | 3 -4 raisins | 1 - 1 1/2 cup dried apricot, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the black eyed peas in a large sauce pan, stir in 2 cups salted water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Turn off the heat and let stand, covered, about an hour. Meanwhile bring a large pot of water to the boil. Add 1 cup salt and rice to the boiling water, stir and remove from heat. Cover and let stand, covered, about 1 hour. Meanwhile toast bread until crusty. Remove from the oven, cut into 1/2 inch cubes and set aside. Drain the black eyed peas and place in a large mixing bowl, add the cooked black eyed peas, tomato paste, bread crumbs, raisins, apricots, if using, and enough stock to cover. Cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes before serving to allow flavors to blend.

title: Caramelised Redcurrant Jelly
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 600 ml red currant jelly
instructions: Place sugar in a pan. Stir over medium heat until it begins to brown, or slightly melt. Stir in jelly. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat to a slow simmer and cook for 20 - 30 minutes or until jam is thickened. Pour into lined jelly moulds and cool.

Random Ingredients: halibut,sage leaf,garlic clove,tortilla,chicken bouillon cube,chipotle chile,fish sauce
title: Chipotle Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb halibut, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 chicken bouillon cube | 3 dried chipotle chiles | 1/4 teaspoon crushed garlic clove | 2 teaspoons salt | 1/8 cup fish sauce | tortillas or flour
instructions: Remove rind from fish.

title: Hot Chile Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet green chili peppers | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh chipotle chile, finely chopped | 1/4 cup honey | 3/4 cup ice water | 1 -2 teaspoon pickled green chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Puree the green chilies and chipotle chiles in a blender or food processor. In a small saucepan, combine the pureed chilies and the honey. Add 3/4°c water and bring to the boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until the mixture is thick. Cool, then stir in the black pepper. Let sit to cool.

title: Kaffir Lime Fries (Patates Patates)
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled and cut into strips | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 5 kaffir lime leaves, crushed
instructions: Place potato strips in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer 10 minutes. Drain, and set aside to cool. Mix beef seasoning and black pepper together. Place lime leaves in a shallow dish, and place the fries between the papers to coat with seasonings. Spray a large, nonstick frying pan with cooking spray, or line with parchment paper. Heat over medium heat until a drop of water sizzles. Place fries in the hot skillet, and cook 3 to 4 minutes on each side, or until nicely browned on the outside. Serve hot or cold.

title: Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 3 cups cooked diced meat | 1 package frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 1 small fresh poblano chile, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary ( or more if desired ) | 12 uncooked lasagna noodles ( about 12 oz. per package )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray a 12x15 inch baking dish or a 12x18 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a medium bowl toss together the meat, corn, poblano chile and rosemary. Arrange half of the noodles in the prepared dish. Spread the meat mixture over the noodles. Cover the meat and corn mixture with the remaining noodles. Cover the lasagna with the remaining sauce, covering completely. Bake in the oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned on top. Serve with sour cream and additional chopped cilantro.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,chicken tender,ice water,phyllo pastry,pineapple chunk,egg noodle
title: Egg Noodle Hawaiian Spinach Pie
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons baking powder | 1 cup chilled chopped pineapple chunks | 2 packages refrigerated egg noodles | 4 cups ice water | 10 sheets frozen pastry dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix the spinach, eggs, baking powder, pineapple, and noodles in a large bowl until well blended. Place the egg noodles in a large shallow baking dish. Cut four 3 inch long strips from each frozen piece of pastry at least 12 inches long and two inches wide. Bring water to a boil in a large pot. Dip one side of the pieces of pastry at a time into the water, allowing excess water to drain. Lay in the boiling water and cook until slightly puffed and firm, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,rosemary,walnut,black eyed pea,stewing beef,soymilk,dark chocolate
title: Black-Eyed Pea Dip in Chocolate
ingredients: 500 g stewing beef, cut into small cubes ( i've used beef from my mary blend ) | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/3 cup ground walnuts | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped dried sweet red chilies ( i like a hotter chilli but use what you like best )
instructions: Pour the chunky salsa in to a small saucepan, stir in the soymilk, chocolate, rosemary, ground walnuts, ground chiles and the meat. Taste mixture and you can use seasonings if you need to. Heat through over low heat, stirring.

title: Simple Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons low sodium dark soy sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Combine in a small bowl. Serve over your favourite pasta or pizza slices.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,cottage cheese,rump roast,green cardamom pod
title: Rump Roast Noodle Krautsalat (Yemiser Rheinischer)
ingredients: 1/2 cup small cottage cheese | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed | 5 1/2 lbs rump roast | 15 -20 ounces egg noodles
instructions: Brown the roast in a heavy skillet with 2 - 3 tbsp of butter, add ½ cup of milk, scrape up any browned bits on the bottom. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer gently for about 60 min to 1 hour, skimming as needed. You can also cook it in a crockpot or oven.

title: Salsa Cruda
ingredients: 1 cup fresh salsa | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 3 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine salsa, oregano, sugar, and bread in a bowl. Spoon salsa mixture onto prepared baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 8 minutes.

title: Easy Spongecakes
ingredients: 2 eggs, beaten | 2 cups self raising flour
instructions: Mix eggs together in a large bowl. Add sifted flour and stir well until evenly mixed. Lightly grease and pour into two well greased and floured cakes. You should have a mixture of the following,. 1 cup self raising flour. 2 tablespoons milk or 2 tablespoons cream. 3 tablespoons sugar. Mix all together to make a smooth batter. Heat a well oiled pan or griddle. Brush lightly with oil. Bake the cakes on one side only. Do not turn the cakes over. Place a cake on a lightly greased tray and bake until pale golden brown, about 10 - 15 minutes remove. Serve hot. These are great with jam, custard and butter.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,beef bouillon,ginger garlic paste,cheddar cheese,balsamic vinegar
title: Easy Cheddar Stove  ( Beef Au Jus)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Brown meat and add balsamic vinegar and ginger garlic paste. Sprinkle with cajun seasoning. Top with shredded cheese and cook on low over low heat for 10 - 15 minutes, or until done.

title: Thai Onion Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grated yellow onions | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 jar taco sauce, or as needed
instructions: Stir onion with coriander until coriander becomes fragrant and starts to turn a little brown, 5 to 10 minutes. Fill a tea or hot water, about 1/2 cup, about half way up the tea bag. Fill bag with hot taco sauce, and squeeze out as much air as possible. Open bag. Place shredded onion in bottom half of mug, and squeeze more sauce into mug. Repeat process to make 2 more servings.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,tequila,beef stew meat,onion soup mix,grand marnier,mustard,brown sugar,cilantro leaf
title: Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons grated mexican blend cheese or 3 tablespoons monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon minced fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons minced sweet onions or 2 tablespoons minced fresh chives | 1 tablespoon packed packed brown sugar | 1/2 cup tequila or 1/2 cup bourbon | 1/2 cup grand marnier or 1/2 cup triple sec
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours. Turn to high and cook for an additional 30 to 45 minutes. To serve, warm through. Serve with tortillas, mexican rice and sliced ripe olives.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,spanish onion,agave syrup,lime juice,panko breadcrumb,sesame seed oil,onion,spring onion
title: Shredded Beef With Sesame Seed Crumbs
ingredients: 3/4 lb beef chuck roast | 1 medium spanish onion, cut into 12 wedges | 6 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 1 large onion, sliced thinly | 1 cup of slivered spring onion | 1/2 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons agave syrup | 1/2 cup sesame seed oil | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, sprinkled with more
instructions: Set oven to 275 degrees. Have a large baking sheet ready and dusted with tahini. Rinse beef under cold running water. Pat dry with paper towels. Dry off fat with paper towels. Transfer it to the large baking sheet drizzle 1 tablespoon of hteaetida onto the roast. Using a rolling pin roll the roast around the htida until it reaches an even thickness about 1/8 inch thick.

title: Braised Italian Capsicum-Red Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1/4 red capsicum, cored seeded and cut into thin strips | 2 cups italian-style stewed tomatoes, cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Arrange capsicum strips on a large oven proof dish and sprinkle over 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes. Roast capsicum in oven for 25 - 30 minutes or until lightly golden and softened.

title: Mexican Pinto Beans, and Fresh Veggies.
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb dried pinto bean | 1 head lettuce | 6 -8 tablespoons marinara sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac
instructions: Soak pinto beans for at least four hours. Cook until tender, then rinse well and place in sink. Let rise til water can be squeezed out of beans. You will need about 1/2 cup of the cooked liquid. Drain in a colander then rinse again. Add remaining ingredients to beans and mix well. It might not seem like enough moisture, but it just makes your beans taste delicious. Refrigerate for at least three hours or overnight and serve with bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,chickpea,bean sprout,rom tomato,part mozzarella cheese,coconut milk,mango chutney
title: Spaghetti With Chickpeas, Chickpeas & Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat coconut milk | 1/2 cup can fat-free chickpeas | 1 cup spaghetti, uncooked | 1 roma tomato, chopped | 1/3 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 0.25 package uncooked spaghetti, ends separated | 1/2 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Combine coconut milk, chickpeas and spaghetti in 2 quart saucepan over high heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture comes to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer until spaghetti is just tender and chickpeas are heated through, about 4 minutes. Stir in tomato, chutney and 1/2 t. Lime juice from lime. Meanwhile, cook pasta as directed on package, and drain. Stir shredded cheese into drained spaghetti. Sprinkle with remaining lime juice. Drain spaghetti, reserving 1 cup of spaghetti cooking liquid. Place spaghetti in an 8 or 9 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Spoon 1/3 of the spaghetti over the noodles, followed by 1/3 of the remaining bean sprouts. Spoon 1/3 of remaining spaghetti over sprouts. Top with remaining bean sprouts. Drizzle with remaining mango chutney. Cover dish with plastic wrap.

title: Spinach Salad with Poached Eggs and Roasted Chiles
ingredients: 1 pint fresh baby spinach, washed and spun dry ( about 12 ounces total weight ) | 2 large dried guajillo chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place a wire rack in a medium baking pan and set aside. Place the chiles on the rack. Roast in the oven, turning once, until the skins blacken and blistered, 20 to 25 minutes, switching the position of the chiles halfway through. Transfer chiles to a plastic bag and let them steam until cool enough to handle, about 10 minutes total. Place chiles in a bowl and cover with water. Let stand 30 minutes, then drain. Remove the stems and seeds from the chiles and tear the pieces into chunks with your hands. Place the spinach in a salad bowl and toss with the chiles. Serve.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,salmon fillet,curry powder,pesto sauce,sauce,flax seed,halibut,yeast
title: Fish with Pesto Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 1 cup warm water | 2 teaspoons granulated yeast | 1 cup strong dark rum | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 tablespoons hot sauce ( or to taste ) | 6 ounces smoked salmon fillet ( about 1 1/2-ounce ) | 1 tablespoon ground flax seed
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over warm water and let sit for 5 minutes or until the yeast foams, then stir with sugar and 1/2 teaspoon each of salt. Stir in the rum and curry powder, then pour over the remaining ingredients except salmon. Leave the fish in the bowl, cover with plastic wrap and set aside in a warm place until very bubbly. Turn the fish out onto a board and pat it up until it is well and evenly sized. Preheat the oven to 450°f spread the hot glaze over the fish. Place on a baking sheet and baste with the leftover glaze. Bake until cooked through, about 15 minutes. While the fish is in the oven, sprinkle flax seeds over a small salad of vegetables.

Random Ingredients: salami,red curry paste,mozzarella cheese,mustard seed,brandy,vegetable,tortilla,liquid smoke
title: Quick & Easy Salad Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mixed vegetables, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 -2 cup mozzarella cheese | 1 lb salami, thinly sliced | 1 container light sour cream or 1 container plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 4 -5 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 can deli-style chopped tomatoes | 10 sheets frozen tortillas, thawed and softened
instructions: In a 9 or 10x12 or larger rectangular baking dish, spread mixed vegetables thinly and evenly to cover the entire bottom of the dish. Sprinkle mozzarella on top of vegetables. Spread cream or yogurt on top of mozzarella cheese. Spread curry paste over creamy cheese. Top with sliced salami. Spread mustard seeds evenly over salami until evenly distributed. Cover with sliced tomatoes. Using a sharp knife, score each wrap into three or four pieces by inserting a sharp knife through center of a wrap. Place wraps onto a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate 6 - 24 hours or overnight. To unmold, remove wrap and place rolled wraps on baking sheet, or wrap completely in foil. Freeze any remaining wrap. To serve, remove wrap.

title: Kuwaiti Recipes
ingredients: 14 ounces ketjap manis molasses or 14 ounces molasses | 7 ounces green cardamom pods | 14 ounces tomato ketchup ( kurdish brand )
instructions: Heat up the kurdish ketchup until thick and bubbly. Add molasses and cardamoms fry for about 5 minutes. Pour mixture in large pan and pour in water to about a half inch below the level. Put in the cover, simmer for 10 minutes. Uncover and allow to simmer for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,black treacle,vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon
title: Wild Mushroom and Treacle Preserves
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 6 shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons black treacle ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons treacle ( optional ) | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan, add the shiitake and fry over a medium heat for about 3 minutes until browned. Add the black treacle. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in the lemon juice. Cool completely before eating or store in a plastic bag for up to 1 year or freeze for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: red grape,red curry paste,dark raisin,black bean
title: Chinese Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh black beans | 2 cans dark raisins | 14 ounces red grapes | 1 tablespoon red curry paste
instructions: Drain beans and put in bowl with raisins. Add red curry paste. Chill for at least 1 hour.

title: Irish Boiled Zucchini Salad
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini | 3 -4 medium romaines or 3 -4 medium yellow zucchini | 1 cup black peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander or 4 tablespoons parsley
instructions: Remove the stem from the zucchini by cutting off the root end at the top and removing the hard stalk end. Slice the zucchini lengthwise into 1 half moons then slice the zucchini into 1/2 thick rounds and place the slices on a large serving dish. Combine the peppercorns, the ground coriander and the whiskey in a bowl. Add the zucchini to the mixture, stirring to evenly coat them. Sprinkle the top with the chopped fresh coriander or parsley. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: saffron,mushroom soup,chili sauce,cake flour,tomato puree,pita bread,baguette,corn syrup
title: Vegetable Toast
ingredients: 2 large slices baguette (, preferably lebanese ) or 2 large bread (, preferably french ) | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 -2 tablespoon hot peppers or 1 -2 hot sauce | 1 1/2 ounces mushrooms soup ( mushroom creamer ) or 1 1/2 ounces creamed corn | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce ( ketjap manis ) or 1 tablespoon sriracha hot sauce ( ketjap manis ) | 1 pinch saffron, preferably smoked or 1 -2 fresh saffron strand | 3 -4 tablespoons cake flour or 3 -4 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f place baguette slices on several baking sheets. Combine tomato puree, corn syrup, hot pepper sauce, and mushroom or creamer in a large mixing bowl. Using a pastry cutter, cut baguette slices into 1 thick fingers. Spread the fingers in a flat layer on the baking sheets. Mix the dry ingredients together, in a medium bowl, or in a food processor. Sprinkle with a little paprika if mixture is too dry, mix in more warm water. Brush the fingers with olive oil and sprinkle mixture over each bead of bread. Place sandwiches on large, rimmed baking sheets. Bake until lightly golden, about 15 minutes. Cut remaining bread into 1/2 slices. Arrange them on a serving platter with the toast on the side. Serve with your favourite condiments.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,fruit,bay leaf,icing sugar,whipping cream,red pepper
title: English Cream Mushrooms With Sweet Wine (Mizeria Con Lecheritos)
ingredients: 3 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 3/4 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 200 ml whipping cream ( whipping cream in a glass jar, one large tub ) | 1/2 bunch fresh fruit ( such as peaches, strawberries, grape tomatoes, peaches, apples ) | 2 bay leaves | 1 whole red peppers ( such as any hot pepper you like ) or 2 green peppers ( such as any hot pepper you like )
instructions: Wipe the mushrooms with damp towels, remove the hard stems, chop half the caps finely and reserve for topping. Cut the rest of the caps into very fine slices. Place the icing sugar in a bowl, whisk lightly until the sugar is smooth, then add 100ml of the cream, mix to the sugar mixture. Add the sliced caps and mix thoroughly. Set aside to cool. Once it is cool, whip the rest of the cream in a thick bottomed bowl until soft peaks form. Fold through the mushroom mixture and the diced pepper, and place into a plastic bag. Once the mushroom mixture has turned stiff, wrap the bag in a piece of wax paper and bash it with a rolling pin to form a disc about 5cm larger in diameter than the mushroom disc.. Wipe the sides and bottom of the bag with kitchen paper and put the plastic bag in the mushroom disc and bash all over again. Turn over onto a well floured surface and repeat until all the mushrooms have been crushed. To serve, place the mushrooms on top of a mound of freshly made white bread and top with grated red pepper or red onion.

title: Portuguese Pork and Bean Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup dried pinto beans | 1 cup dried pinto beans or 1 cup romano beans | 12 baby carrots, diced | 1 free-range egg, beaten | 1 small portuguese chourico, halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons strong coffee | 4 slices country-style smoked pork
instructions: Cover the dried pinto beans with water by 2 inches in a 4 cup measure.

title: Simple Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, drained ( or 1 16oz can of kidney beans and 2/3 cup cooked pasta such as rotel ) | 2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small deep frying pan over medium heat.

title: Simple Mexican Chocolate Nachos
ingredients: 6 tablespoons chocolate chips | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco sauce
instructions: Microwave chocolate chips in 30 second intervals, stirring after each, until melted. Spread 1/2 tablespoon chocolate on an ungreased baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,baking potato,serrano pepper,beef bouillon cube,sesame oil,chicken,shoyu
title: Chicken Tsouka
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken pieces | 4 large baking potatoes, coarsely chopped | 2 serrano peppers, coarsely chopped ( jicama ) | 1/2 lb cottage cheese | 1/4 cup shoyu | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Boil chicken with garlic, salt, and pepper. Put in a big bowl. Set aside to cool. Meanwhile, put a layer of cabbage in a microwave safe bowl big enough for the chicken to be covered. Squeeze out excess water from the cucumber. Put cucumber on top of the cabbage. Sprinkle on soy sauce, bouillon cube, and sesame oil. Repeat steps 3 and 4 until all ingredients are used. Heat a large skillet. Add olive oil. Brown chicken in hot oil. Put in large bowl with cabbage on top. Cover tightly and simmer over low heat for 25 minutes. Serve with a side of rice and a side of cucumber salad.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,sharp cheddar cheese,cubanelle pepper,macaroni,tomatillo,self raising flour,beef brisket
title: Macaroni and Beef Brisket Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb corned beef brisket | 6 ounces macaroni | 2 tablespoons unbleached self-raising flour | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 4 fresh tomatillos, cut into wedges | 1/2 cup chopped pitta bread | 1/2 medium cubanelle pepper ( optional )
instructions: Trim corned beef of all visible fat and sinew and rub with flour. Place in slow cooker and top with onion, cover and cook on high setting for 6 - 7 hours. Allow to cool to room temperature. While the beef is cooling cut around the edges with a sharp knife and cut out and discard the core, discard any visible fat. Once corned beef is cold slice into pieces approximately 1/2 x 1/4 so you have a little chunkier casserole and can assemble neatly across the table. Place the tomato wedges, pitta bread and sliced corned beef into a bowl and toss together adding the cheese. Place a layer of corned beef over the top of the cheese mixture and top with the pitta bread mix. Repeat layers with corned beef, pitta bread, and sliced corned beef and cheese mixture finishing with cheese mixture. Place in hot oven at 160°c 200°c or 200°c if your casserole has a convection oven so nothing goes wrong with this recipe.

title: Blueberry, Apple and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable ghee or 1 tablespoon butter, softened | 1/2 cup blueberries | 1 medium apple, peeled, cored and finely diced | 1/4 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine ghee and blueberries. Saute in oil for several minutes until blueberries begin to wilt. Stir in apple, ginger and mint. Drain off excess liquid. Layer the cheese and fruit in the dish in a decorative manner. Garnish with parsley flakes.

Random Ingredients: ginger beer,cilantro leaf,turmeric powder,fruit preserve,american cheese,focaccia bread,canola oil
title: Mellow Grilled Cheese Bread (Paleo Style)
ingredients: 1 loaf country-style focaccia bread | 3 cups canola oil | 4 ounces fresh american cheese, sliced ( or your favorite melting cheese. you can use cheddar or swiss ) | 1 cup mixed fruit preserves ( i used my fav. preserves ) | 1/4 cup ginger beer | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf, chopped
instructions: Slice bread 1/4 thick, diagonally, and cut out the top 3 slices to make an oval shaped bread. Cut loaf diagonally again, and remove bread from the bottom of the loaf to make a 1/4 inch thick sandwich. Coat bottom of loaf with canola oil, then generously with american cheese. Spread fruit preserves onto the bread. Add turmeric and cilantro leaves into the middle of the cheese. Place sandwiches on grill, turn once and spray with a nonstick pam cooking spray on both sides. Grill sandwiches at medium high heat 6 - 10 minutes, turning once, or until bread is nicely browned and cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,apricot jam,pineapple ring,vinegar,vegetable stock,garam masala,chunky salsa
title: Apricot Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 1 jar apricot jam | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | pineapple rings
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill in refrigerator for several hours. Serve with pineapple rings.

Random Ingredients: peach,bean sprout,serrano chilies,pecorino romano cheese,peanut,lettuce leaf,hamburger
title: Hamburger-Peach Salad
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 1 cup bean sprouts ( approx. ) | 1 small pecorino romano cheese | 1 can sliced canned peaches | 1 tablespoon peanuts | 1 teaspoon serrano chilies or 1 teaspoon chili powder | lettuce leaf
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Set aside. To sprout, place the chopped pecorino romano cheese in a small ziploc bag. Cover with peanuts and chile powder. title: Soya Beef and Spinach Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stew meat, cubed and seasoned with salt and pepper | 1 medium onion, chopped | 8 ounces frozen mixed vegetables ( i had a couple of small packages of frozen mixed vegetables for this soup and had them in the freezer ) | 4 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and patted dry | 14 ounces canned light buttermilk ( light cream may be substituted ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried onion flakes ( kochoga ) | 2 cans medium sized tomatoes with chiles, undrained ( i used fire roasted if you can find them )
instructions: In a large stock pot, saute stew meat in 3 tablespoons oil until lightly browned on all sides. If stew meat is not thoroughly browned, return it to the pot. In a separate pot, combine the onions and vegetables and saute until tender crisp. Return stew meat to the soup pot. Add the buttermilk, tomatoes and 1 1/2 teaspoons dried onion flakes. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat.

title: Mom's Vegetable Care
ingredients: 3 small button mushrooms | 1/2 small celery root, peeled, halved | 1 carton frozen cut celery root, defrosted if frozen
instructions: Warm 1/2 cup of lukewarm water in a sauce pan large enough to hold mushrooms in one layer.

title: Fried Farfalle (Bow Ties)
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 3/4 cup water | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook bow tie pasta in boiling water until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

title: Easy Crock Pot Refried Beans
ingredients: 4 cups dried pinto beans or 4 cups pinto beans | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped or 1 -2 cup diced tomato | 1/3 cup catsup ( optional )
instructions: Place beans in crockpot. Add remaining ingredients. Stir and cook on low 6 - 8 hours or on high 3 - 4 hours..

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,serrano chili pepper,celery rib,pecan half
title: Mexican Fiesta Squares
ingredients: 1 lb pecan halves | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 1 can fat-free sweet and sour salsa | 1 serrano chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Cut pecans in half. Coarsely chop. Place pecans on a cookie sheet and toast until lightly toasted. In a separate small bowl, stir together celery and chile. Spoon celery mixture and salsa into the pecan halves and sprinkle with pecans. Press mixture into a greased loaf pan. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 3 hours, overnight if possible.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,single cream,cocoa,peach,chicken bouillon,lemon juice,red lentil
title: Lebanese Chicken and Peach Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces red lentils | 6 ounces split red lentils | 6 ounces chicken thighs | one 8 ounce chicken piece free range eggplant | one ounce coconut | 3 medium sized peach slices | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 tablespoon instant malted cocoa or 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Rinse the lentils, place in a saucepan, pour in 4 fluid oz of water and bring slowly to the boil, then reduce the heat, partially cover the pan, and simmer for 15 minutes. title: Macaroni Surprise
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with tomato paste | 1 lb ground beef | 1 package uncooked macaroni | 8 ounces milk chocolate, cut into chips | 1 bunch celery ribs, chopped | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Prepare the macaroni and set aside in the crockpot. In a large skillet, brown ground beef and celery until the beef is cooked. Drain excess fat and fat and return to the skillet. Add the canned tomatoes with their juice and tomato paste to the skillet. Simmer for five minutes to combine. While sauce is simmering, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add macaroni and cook until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Tasty Roast Beef Toast
ingredients: 1 round steak | 500 g feta cheese, crumbled | 3 tablespoons white bread, coarsely grated | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence
instructions: Remove the membrane and sinew from a steak. Mix crumbled feta cheese with the bread and vanilla essence. Heat frying pan on medium. Dip the steak in the mixture and fry until cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: head garlic,head romaine lettuce,white chocolate,liquid honey,red wine vinegar,cashew
title: Roasted Garlic head with romaine and white chocolate
ingredients: 1 head garlic | 1 head garlic | 1 head romaine lettuce | 1/2 cup roasted cashews | 1/2 cup white chocolate | 2 teaspoons liquid honey | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the whole head of garlic and the head of garlic together with the romaine lettuce. In a small saucepan, melt 1/2 cup of chocolate with the honey and vinegar. Stir frequently until smooth and hot, about 10 minutes. Spoon over the romaine/garlic head.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,beef bouillon cube,self rising cornmeal,frog leg,chicken stock,apple cider vinegar,jalapeno,beef chuck
title: Dees Buffalo Frog Legs With Apple and Curry Dip
ingredients: 8 frog's legs, split | 1 cup self-rising cornmeal | 2 ounces beef chuck, ground | 1/3 cup beef broth | 2 1/2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 1/2 teaspoons madras curry powder | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 3 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place frog legs on an oiled baking sheet and brush with olive oil. Pour 1/4 cup water into a bowl and sprinkle with cornmeal. Bake for 30 minutes, turning occasionally, or until light golden brown. Remove from the oven and spread on a small baking sheet to cool. In a large bowl, mix together the ground beef, remaining frog legs, 2 1/2 tablespoons curry powder, 2 1/2 teaspoons madras curry powder, and beef bouillon cube. In a small bowl, mix together the apple cider vinegar and 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno.

title: Pine Nuts Stuffed With Shrimps
ingredients: 12 jumbo shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 medium celery rib | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Remove the head of the shrimp and, using a small spoon, make a pocket in the shell in the shrimp using a teaspoon. Insert a clove of celery in the shell along with the stuffing.

title: Japenese Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs dried chili beans, soaked overnight and drained
instructions: Prepare the beans according to the directions on the package. When they've soaked overnight, drain them and place in a saucepan. Add sufficient water to come one third below the top of the beans. Let them come to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until cooked completely. Be careful with the amount of water you boil. This should take about 30 minutes.

title: Roasted Chilli Meat
ingredients: 500 g frozen meat | 2 teaspoons chili flakes | 1 pinch dried chili flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c/fan 190°c/gas remove any fat or fibre from the frozen meat and cut into pieces about 1 cm wide and 1 cm thick. Pour into a bowl along with the chili flakes. Add enough water to cover, toss, and leave to stand for 30 minutes. Place the meat in the oven, and cook for 25 minutes, tossing every 15 minutes, until the meat is firm and cooked through. Serve with vegetables.

title: Tropical Golden Rice Paper Rolls
ingredients: 1 package rice paper sheets | 1 cup unsweetened shredded coconut | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1 teaspoon peanut oil
instructions: Prepare rice paper sheets according to package directions using a nonstick cooking spray. Dip rice paper into large bowl with a thin coating of cooking spray. Quickly place it on a clean, dry surface. Place one sheet of rice paper in a pile on the paper so rice paper is flat. Spread equal amounts of shredded coconut onto the rice paper, leaving a 1 inch border. Sprinkle ground coriander and half of peanut oil on mixture. Roll tightly, starting from short side, and sealing with the tooth pick. Place rolled sheets on a clean, dry surface. Repeat process until all sheets are used. Preheat a nonstick skillet or wok over medium high heat. Add the peanut oil. When hot, carefully place the rolls in the oil. Fry on all sides for about 2 minutes, or until golden and crisp. Remove rolls from the pan, and drain on paper towels.

title: Caribbean Coconut Gravy
ingredients: 1 can coconut cream | 1/4 cup catsup
instructions: Whisk together the coconut cream, catsup, and hot sauce in a bowl. Serve over chicken, pork, or vegetables.

title: Soprano's Mushrooms and Beef and Wine
ingredients: 4 -5 large fresh white mushrooms | 1 can beef consume ( or one large can of beef stewed beef ) | 4 ounces tea, strong white | 1 can sliced mushrooms ( or two large cans )
instructions: Cut mushrooms in halves or quarters, and cut meat in to bite size pieces. Pour beef consume into a nonstick pan, and heat to boiling. When it begins to thicken, stir in rest of the ingredients and let simmer for 20 minutes. Serve over rice or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: belgian endive,chili oil,berry,white onion,lemon zest,stewing beef
title: Braised Belgian Endive With Beef, Beans & Berry Relish
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs assorted belgian endive | 2 lbs stewing beef, cut in 1 inch chunks | 1 white onion, medium, julienned | 1/2 cup chili oil | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, freshly grated | 1 1/2 cups mixed berry halves, washed and dried
instructions: In a large dutch oven over medium high heat, add the endive sections and cook, shaking the pan frequently until beginning to soften, about 5 minutes. Add beef, onion, and chili oil. Cover and cook until beef is cooked through, 3 - 4 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until endive is very tender and beginning to soften, about 30 minutes longer. Stir in the lemon zest and berry halves. Cover and cook until berries are softened, about 10 minutes longer. Serve.

title: Peasant Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs fat-trimmed boneless beef chuck roast | 1 cup quince
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Pierce the meat numerous times with a fork in a shallow roasting pan. Combine the 3 quinces with about 3/4 cup of water. Set them in the pan. Cover, and cook the meat for 3 1/2 to 4 hours in the 325 degrees f oven, or until a thermometer inserted into the thickest part reads 155 degrees.. Remove to a carving board, and let stand for about 20 minutes. Pull the meat from the pan and place it on a serving platter. Pour off enough of the cooking juices to make the drippings, then bring to a boil over high heat. Boil for 3 to 5 minutes, or until syrupy. Pour the hot drippings over the meat, and serve it hot.

title: Mexicorn Dip
ingredients: 2 cans mexicorn, drained well | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Place mexicorn and parsley in a food processor and puree. Pour into crock, cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve chilled.

title: Port Beef Roast With Apple and Green Apple

instructions: Brush a heavy bottomed non reactive cooking pan with oil. Spray with the cooking spray. Place the beef roast in the pan. Sprinkle with the golden syrup. Place in a 325 preheated oven for 1 hour. Baste every 15 - 30 minutes during the last 10 minutes of cooking, add the port and cook for 25 - 30 more minutes or until the meat is tender. Remove the roast from the pan onto a carving board. Place the apple slices over the roast. Combine the apple juice and port in a small saucepan and boil to reduce the mixture of apple juice. Pour over the meat and vegetables before serving. Add the cheese to the liquid mixture before serving. Serves that is.

title: Cambodian Herb and Coconut Tiramisu
ingredients: 8 ladyfingers | 6 tablespoons dry shredded coconut milk | 1 cup canned unsweetened coconut milk | 1 tablespoon watercress leaf | 1 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom | parmesan cheese
instructions: Split the ladyfingers in half lengthwise and dip them into a strainer until all of the ladyfingers are moistened. Place the ladyfingers in a greased 13x9 baking dish. In a saucepan, stir together the coconut milk, coconut milk and watercress until blended. Add the cardamom and heat through over low heat, stirring to mix it and the coconut milk mixture frequently. Pour into the prepared baking dish and sprinkle with the parmesan cheese. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,button mushroom,lettuce leaf,bamboo shoot,rice wine vinegar,white chocolate,salmon fillet
title: Chile Wrapped Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 fresh button mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 4 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 200 g cooked sushi-style salmon fillets | 1 cup cooked barbecued bamboo shoots, drained | 4 cups lettuce leaves
instructions: Divide the sliced mushrooms between two lettuce leaves. Spoon over vanilla essence. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Fried Shrimp

instructions: Cut shrimp lengthwise into 3 strips, lengthwise. Beat egg yolks lightly, in medium bowl, until blended. Add orange blossom water, chocolate, oil, splenda, marjoram, and red pepper paste. Combine well.

title: Mandarin Orange Soup

instructions: In a saucepan, combine stock, pepper, onions, chilli and egg yolks boil, stir over medium heat for 5 minutes or until soup thickens. Add cardamom and stir through. Bring to boil, add oranges and simmer 5 minutes or until egg yolks are cooked. Pour into hot bowls, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,beef stock cube,bean,brewer yeast,banana pepper
title: Banana Pepper & Bean Soup With Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1/2 ounce brewer's yeast | 1 1/2 pints beef stock cubes | 1/2 pints baked beans, with liquid | 1 ripe banana pepper | maple syrup
instructions: Boil the stock cubes in a pan with the bananas and let simmer for half an hour. Remove the bananas and add the beans while still in the pan stir. Add the yeast and taste to see if dissolved. Add milk to make a creamy soup.

Random Ingredients: cracker meal,orange peel,milk ricotta cheese,orange liqueur,bread crumb,garam masala,garlic,white pepper
title: Orange Ricotta and Pepper Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bread crumbs | 1 package whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup orange liqueur | 1/4 cup milk or 1/4 cup light cream | 1/4 cup grated orange peel | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, combine the bread crumbs and the ricotta cheese. In a small bowl, add the olive oil or butter, liqueur, cream, orange peel and garlic.

Random Ingredients: taco flour tortilla,garam masala,chili sauce,cream,cranberry,white chocolate,white wine
title: White Chocolate Cranberry Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 -5 soft taco-size flour tortillas | 7 ounces white chocolate, chopped | 1 cup fresh sour cream | 1/2 cup chinese chili sauce | 1/3 cup white wine | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/4 cup dried cranberries ( optional ) or 1/4 cup dried cherries ( optional )
instructions: Spray rectangular casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Mix the sour cream, chili sauce, wine, and garam masala. Coat a clean surface with cooking spray. Roll up, starting with the side closest to you, and place in casserole dish seam side down. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and mixture. Pour the white sauce over enchiladas. Sprinkle cranberries into the sauce. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Serve with warm bread, salsa, or sour cream. Or, if desired, serve with jasmine rice.

title: Duck N' Gravy.
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs boneless beef chuck ( or stew meat or brisket ) | 3/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 lb lowfat shredded low fat cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Cut half of the chuck roast into 1/4 inch slices. Place slices, cut side up, on the rack about 3 inches below the broiler rack.
