You can keep the gravy warm on the stove or in the microwave. If you're serving it warm, heat the meat over medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve the gravy as a sauce over hot cooked pasta, or serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,active yeast,white onion,black peppercorn,ziti pasta
title: Scallops Bertolli
ingredients: 8 cups ziti pasta, uncooked | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons whole black peppercorns ( or more ) | 1/2 large white onion, minced | 1 1/2 lbs sea scallops, shelled & deveined
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large pot. Bring to a boil& then lower heat as low as possible, simmering for about 45 minutes to an hour. Remove scallops from sauce& serve.

title: Swiss Cheese and Turnip Soup (Dees)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into about 1 inch cubes | 3 large onions, cut into half circles | 1/2 cup dried currants | 2 quarts swiss cheese, shredded | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon thyme | generous onion powder
instructions: Place pork in a large pot and pour in enough water to come 3/4 of the way up the side of the meat. Bring to a boil on medium low and simmer, covered for 1 hour. Once the water is at a full boil and the meat is very tender, skim off any fat floating to the surface and add more water as needed to keep the meat covered. Drain the meat and reserve the liquid. Stir onion into the meat juices and simmer until the onions turn golden brown, about 5 minutes. Stir currants and thyme into the meat juice. Cover and continue simmering on medium low for about 1 hour. Taste and adjust seasoning. The idea is that our family does not eat lots of italian cheese, so if they like ours a bit more creamy, stir some of the currants and thyme into the soup to warm it up. Serve with lots of crusty bread and cheese.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,rice wine,date,calf liver,white fish fillet
title: Chinese Whitefish and Dates With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb small white fish fillet, skinned | 4 large dates, cut diagonally into thin strips | 1/4 lb calf liver or 1/4 lb other firm white fish fillet | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Place fish in a dish and cover with water, about 1 inch above fish. Soak at least 4 hours, turning halfway through soaking process. Drain fish and let cool completely. Cut fish into bite size pieces, adding dates. Drain off water and reserve. Poke holes in fish with a fork. Dry fish with a paper towel or brown paper, or sprinkle with flour. Heat 1 t vegetable oil in wok or large non stick skillet. Add fish and dates and fry for a few seconds. Add 5 t water and fish sauce. Simmer fish, covered, for about 2 minutes. Serve with rice and salad greens.

Random Ingredients: sugar syrup,hard egg,hazelnut,kielbasa,self rising flour,basil,orange juice concentrate,brown sugar
title: The Russian Tea Room Super-Duper Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa ( remove casings ) | 2/3 cup sugar-free syrup ( i've used honey in a pinch ) | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 1 cup self rising flour ( i used half all the whole wheat and half whole wheat ) | 1 large orange, juice and freshly squeezed zest of, divided | 2 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 12 -14 leaves fresh basil, finely chopped ( or 1/2 cup dried basil ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Line a jelly roll pan with parchment paper. Cut slits about an inch deep across the kielbasa, and place in a saute pan. In a small saucepan, combine the sugar free syrup, brown sugar and 1 tablespoon orange juice and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring briskly to prevent burning. Remove from the heat, add the zest and set aside to cool completely. Add the eggs, basil, nuts and cooled syrup mixture to the cheese coated kielbasa and stir to blend then pour the mixture into the greased and floured jelly roll pan. Bake until a cake tester or toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean or has spring or blade attached remove from pan and allow to cool completely. Slice and serve warm.

title: Cantaloupe-Wrapped Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground cannamoupe | 12 -20 green cardamom pods | 6 slices bacon | 4 ounces lean pork loin, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons mascarpone | 1/2 cup flaked coconut | 2 spring onions, shredded
instructions: Place the ground cannomopom pods in a mortar with the cardamom pods. Cook over a gentle heat for 1 minute or until the pods are fragrant. Transfer the pods to a plate. Cut the bacon into 1 inch pieces and fry in a frying pan over medium heat until crisp.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,lemon juice,green cardamom pod,miso,pork shoulder,applesauce,elbow macaroni,midori melon liqueur
title: Midori Chicken Salad With Lemon-Miso and Macaroni
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni | 3 tablespoons miso ( dark ) | 1 1/2 cups applesauce or 1 1/2 cups sweet red wine | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/3 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup midori melon liqueur | 1 garlic clove, chopped | 3 green cardamom pods, slightly crushed | 2 cups lettuce, chopped | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: For salad, cook pasta until tender but firm, drain. Mix miso, applesauce, lemon juice and midori. Gently mix together macaroni, miso mixture and pasta. Serve immediately and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,nonfat milk powder,english cucumber,broiler fryer chicken
title: Cucumber Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, cut up | 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 english cucumber, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Place chicken in a baking dish. In a small bowl, mix 1/4 cup dry milk powder and marjoram. Sprinkle over chicken. Cover tightly with foil and bake for about 45 minutes, or until tender. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder with 1/2 cup water. Remove chicken from oven and place on a serving platter. Pour 1/3 cup dry milk mixture over chicken.

title: Baked Fish
ingredients: 500 g fish, fillets | 1 teaspoon coffee crystals | 1 tablespoon tea | 1 tablespoon baileys irish cream | 1 cup vegetable stock | 3 large potatoes, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200c/180c/gas line a baking tray with baking paper. Place fish in a single layer in a baking dish. Pour over the coffee crystals and soak for 15 - 20 minutes. Mix the baileys and stock together in a bowl and pour over the fish. Cook uncovered for 40 - 45 minutes, turning fish a few times. Add potatoes to the baking tray and cook for a further 15 minutes or until fish is just cooked through and potatoes are warmed through. Tip into serving plates and drizzle with coffee.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,sauce,cream celery soup,scotch bonnet pepper,pork,vanilla extract,salmon fillet
title: Sue's Stuffed Fish
ingredients: 1 pound pork fillets | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1/2 can salmon fillets, cubed | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla extract | 1 scotch bonnet peppers, seeded and minced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the pork fillets in a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil. Bake the fish for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the internal temperature is 175 degrees f. Remove the foil, and allow the fish to cool in the foil for 10 minutes. Remove the meat from the bones, and set aside. Mix the cream of celery soup, bread crumbs, salmon, hot sauce, and vanilla extract in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,pie shell,pearl barley,green chilies,maraschino cherry,orange,kahlua,coconut
title: Barley Quiche
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 can condensed green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1/3 cup coconut, flaked | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder | 1/4 cup maraschino cherries or 1/4 cup lime juice | 1 unbaked pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Line bottom and side of 10 inch glass pie plate with crust, sealing edges well. Combine barley, chilies, kahlua, coconut, orange juice, curry powder, and cherries in a medium bowl, mix well. Pour over crust ingredients. Bake @ 375f for 40 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red leaf lettuce,pork shoulder,tahini,red wine,cheddar cheese,vinegar,pork tenderloin,bean
title: Bali Style Pork Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, cut to fit of pork | 1/4 cup red wine | 1/3 cup tahini | 1/4 cup vinegar | 2 tablespoons dry red leaf lettuce, dried | 1/2 cup fresh baked beans | 1/4 cup canned pork fat, drained and chopped | 4 tablespoons shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine all dressing ingredients, refrigerate. Cut tenderloins lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices and line salad plates with cheese evenly on top of each. Combine lettuce on bottom half of salad bowls, arrange pork slices over lettuce, then top with baked beans, then top with shredded beef and cheese. Drizzle the tahini dressing over all, before slicing into quarters.

title: Quick and Easy Pizza Crust
ingredients: 2 cups rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 cup water | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained
instructions: In a shallow bowl, stir together the flour, salt and water until combined. Gradually whisk in the pineapple chunks. Turn dough out onto a clean, dry work surface. Knead dough until ball forms. Roll out dough to the desired size and thickness. Cut into 6 squares and sprinkle pizza stones with corn meal or cookie dough dough. Place dough onto stone and bake about 8 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon,italian salad dressing,carrot,sherry wine vinegar,whipping cream,scallion
title: Zippy Carrots
ingredients: 2 lbs medium carrots | 1/3 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon, rind of, grated | 1/4 cup sour cream | 4 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 -2 scallion, finely chopped
instructions: Wash and cut carrots diagonally into 1/2 inch slices. Slice 3/16 inch thick. In an 8 qt saucepan add vinegar, lemon peel, sour cream and whipping cream and heat gently until the sour cream is slightly thickened. Add carrots and simmer for 10 minutes. Drain carrots and add to a serving dish. Sprinkle with scallions.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,cheddar cheese,farfalle pasta,hamburger,pasta,dark brown sugar,milk chocolate,lamb shoulder
title: Hamburger and Goat Cheese Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 16 ounces goat cheese or 16 ounces cream cheese, softened ( neufchatel ) | 8 ounces farfalle pasta or 8 ounces bow-tie pasta | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate, melted ( i like german's best ) | 1 jar spaghetti sauce with meat ( i don't use the ghirardelli brand ) | 1 bunch cheddar cheese, grated ( or other favorite toppings ) | 1 lb cooked hamburger shoulder, cut into thin slices ( or use 4-5 slices from cooked deli to make vegetarian version )
instructions: Brown meat. Add meat to a bowl with all other ingredients except cheese and pasta. Mix. Drain pasta, add to bowl with meat. Add cheese blend and mix, adding spaghetti sauce as required to absorb cheese into pasta. Add meat mixture to pasta, stir and enjoy.

title: Chicken Fritters
ingredients: 500 g chicken | 1/2 cup spring onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place a little on each chicken piece. Drop two heaped tablespoonfuls of mix together on each chicken piece. Grill.

title: Filled Brussels Sprouts W-Nuts
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dashi | 1 tablespoon rice, japanese ( not japanese rice cake mix-or instant pudding if you use instant ) | 1 package frozen brussels sprouts, defrosted | 1 package instant vanilla pudding | 2 jars sliced wams, drained | 6 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 4 slices aged stilton cheese
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a small saucepan. Add dashi and noodles stir to mix, cook for 2 minutes or until noodles are al dente. Transfer to a bowl and refrigerate until needed, about 15 minutes. Heat a 12 inch skillet over medium high heat, add sprouts and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp tender, about 2 minutes. Transfer sprouts to a bowl of ice water, drain. Return pan to medium high heat, add 5 tbs. Of worcestershire sauce, and cook for 30 seconds. Add the noodles, wams, sprouts and 1 1/2 tbs. Of remaining worcestershire sauce and cook, stirring occassionally, for 2 - 3 minutes or until heated through. Place a slice of aged stilton on top of each sprout and serve.

title: Herbs Chopped Salad
ingredients: 8 romaine lettuce, washed and torn | 1 tablespoon vidalia onion, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary, chopped ( or 1/2 tsp. dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Toss salad ingredients together. Add mustard, mix well. Serve.

title: Cauliflower With Olives (Italy)
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs cauliflower, trimmed | 4 cups packed fresh basil, stems removed | black olives ( to garnish )
instructions: In a 4 quart covered saucepan, steam the cauliflower, covered, 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in basil leaf. Cover and let stand 20 minutes. Spoon into a serving bowl. Sprinkle with olives and toss. Cover and let stand 15 minutes at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: lime,self rising flour,liquid smoke,horseradish,pineapple juice,orange juice
title: Pineapple Horseradish Beer Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon soft horseradish ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1/2 lime ( zested and juiced ) | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 4 cups self rising flour
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, mix together the horseradish, pineapple juice, orange juice, lime zest and juice, liquid smoke and flour until well blended. Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350 for 55 minutes.

title: Swiss Chard and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard, woody stems removed | 3 cloves | 1 -2 cup macaroni ( or other tubular pasta ) | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Wash the chard leaves well. Place in a large pot of boiling water and cook until just tender. Drain and set aside. Cut chard into 1 inch pieces. Cut the cloves in half and sauté in a good amount of extra virgin olive oil for 2 - 3 minutes on medium heat until it is tender. Stir in the swiss chard, 2 cups macaroni or other tubular pasta, pine nuts and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil and then simmer for 15 minutes. Serve hot. Note, i served this over black beans we had a green salad we would have used and cooked over chicken.

title: Ancho Chile Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ancho chile powder | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 cup water chestnuts, chopped | 3 bananas, peeled and chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, mash one can cannellini beans with a fork until mixture is smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl. Stir in one can of cannellini beans with liquid. Stir in the remaining can of beans with liquid. Mash until mixture is smooth, adding water between each addition until mixture is well incorporated. Place on a platter and garnish with chopped green onion.

title: Quick and Easy Flank Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 slices rye bread, toasted | 1/2 cup margarine | 2 pounds top round steak, pounded thin
instructions: Spread the rye bread evenly with butter and top with beef. Wrap each sandwich tightly with butcher's string. Melt margarine in a large skillet over medium high heat. Fry sandwiches until the outside is golden brown, and the meat is hot.

title: Mustard Dipping Sauce for Pasta Chips
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons sugar | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl until sugar dissolves. Store in the refrigerator. Makes about 8 cups.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,mustard seed,chicken soup base,guacamole,dill pickle spear
title: Protein Slammin' - Homemade
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon dill pickle spears, chopped | 1/4 cup canned condensed chicken soup base | 3/4 cup guacamole, purchased
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except the guacamole, in the order listed and put in the crock of a large slow cooker. Cook on low 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,beef,pearl barley,black cumin,cilantro stem,pineapple chunk,spice rub,sun tomato
title: Capellabub Soup (Mamool)
ingredients: 7 tablespoons pineapples ( canned ) | 6 ounces cooked corned beef, chopped ( optional ) | 8 ounces baby russet potatoes or 8 ounces other small cubes ( 4.5 oz ) | 1/2 cup canned pineapple chunk, cut in small chunks ( 3oz ) | 4 1/2 cups reduced-sodium beef broth or 4 1/2 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 4 1/2 teaspoons dried cumin, sifted | 1 teaspoon spiced spice rub ( such as bob's red mill spice mix ) | fresh dried cilantro stem ( optional )
instructions: To make soup, combine all ingredients except for soup in a large heavy saucepan or pot. Cook over moderate heat, stirring often, until potatoes are tender with no color, about 25 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in soup. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve hot or cold. Garnish individual dessert servings with fresh cilantro stems.

title: Bourbon Steak With Feta
ingredients: 12 ounces dry high-fiber farfalle pasta | 2 lbs flank steaks | 1 tablespoon baking powder | vegetables | 1/2 cup bourbon | 1/2 cup crumbled feta
instructions: In a large pot with boiling water, cook pasta acording to package directions or al dente.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,cake flour,garlic,red chile,green chile pepper,broccoli,bacon grease
title: Jamaican Style Fried Broccoli
ingredients: 10 heads broccoli, chopped | 1 green chile pepper, shredded | 4 slices prosciutto, sliced | 3 slices sliced red chile | 2 tablespoons bacon grease | 4 cups cake flour
instructions: Heat the bacon grease in a large cast iron skillet. Sprinkle the tops with the jamacita green chile, red chile and prosciutto slices. Place the broccoli into the hot frying oil, and fry until just crisp. Remove and place on a plate lined with paper towel to drain. Place the fried broccoli and green chile peppers on a serving platter, and drizzle with the bacon grease. Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,extra virgin olive oil,red pepper sauce,pepper sauce,pizza crust
title: My Italian Pizza
ingredients: 1 puff pastry sheet | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 2 dashes red hot pepper sauce | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 1 dash red hot pepper sauce | 1 dash extra virgin olive oil | 1 dash extra virgin olive oil | 1 dash pepper sauce | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 1 dash extra virgin olive oil | 1 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: Roll out dough into a circle about 24 inches in diameter. Remove about 1/2 cup of dough and place on a baking sheet. Heat oven to 425°f. Mix 2 tbsp olive oil with 1 dash of hot pepper sauce. Spread on one side of the dough. Layer with 1 - 2 dashes of hot pepper sauce, 1 - 2 dashes of hot sauce, 1 - 2 dashes of hot sauce, 1 - 2 dashes of hot sauce, 1 - 2 dashes of hot sauce, 1 - 2 dashes of hot sauce, and 1 - 2 dashes of black pepper sauce, 1 - 2 dashes of black pepper sauce, 1 - 2 dashes of hot sauce, and 1 - 2 dashes of black pepper sauce. Roll out dough into a circle about 24 inches in diameter. Remove about 1/2 cup of dough and roll out onto a baking sheet. Brush the edges with olive oil. Repeat with the second 1/2 cup of dough and the second half lb of dough. Brush the edges with olive oil. Cut the dough into 6 equal pieces, each with the cut side facing you. Bake for about 15 minutes, until crust is golden brown. Brush the last 1/2 cup of dough with olive oil and place on top of the hot oven. Bake until the dough is bubbly. The crust is done when the crust has puffed and has deep browned. Remove from oven and brush with olive oil. Remove from oven, spread remaining hot pepper sauce all over it. Return to oven and bake 2 - 5 minutes or until brown and bubbly. Remove from oven and brush with olive oil. Return to oven and bake for 5 minutes or until golden brown. Take out of oven and brush with olive oil. Remove from oven and brush each cut side with olive oil. Set on a plate. Serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: soy yogurt,peanut oil,date,taco seasoning mix,corn chip,plum tomato,tarragon
title: Creamy Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup smooth soy yogurt | 1 -2 plum tomatoes or 1 -2 cherry tomatoes, cut in wedges | 1/3 cup corn chips | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 pints peanut oil ( for frying ) | 1/3 cup crushed dried corn chips | 1/3 cup soy yogurt
instructions: Prepare taco seasoning using following pkg directions. Dice tomato into large bite size wedges.

title: Gnocchi Al Olive (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 bunches red and green bell peppers ( about 1-1/2 pounds ) | 4 cups vegetable broth, or as needed | 1/2 pound firm black olives, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, or to taste, freshly ground | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1 can corn, drained and rinsed | hollandaise guacamole, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Slice bell peppers in half lengthwise, leaving the stem on.

title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup onion flakes | 1/2 cup dried onion flakes | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/4 cup dried macadamias ( if not available, use cashews )
instructions: Stir together cream cheese and dried onion. Stir in 1/4 cup of the sherry. Stir in macadamia nuts. Cover and refridgerate 30 minutes or overnight. The longer it keeps, the more enhanced the flavor.

title: Green Chile Gratinate
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry marsala wine | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese
instructions: Combine marsala with chiles and cheese in a small bowl or skillet. Heat, over medium heat, until cheese melts.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,wine vinegar,romano cheese,ghee,white sugar,scotch bonnet pepper,beef bouillon cube,monterey jack cheese
title: Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, about 1 1/4 lb | 1/2 cup wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons grated monterey jack cheese | 3 tablespoons grated romano cheese | 1 small scotch bonnet peppers or 1 small habanero pepper, seeded and chopped ( i use 2 serrano chilies whole, or half a habanero pepper if not found ) | 2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Place the chicken in a large, flat dish, sprinkle chicken with sugar, and turn several times to coat. In a medium bowl, whisk vinegar and bouillon together. Pour into a small bowl, and add the cheeses, scotch bonnet or fresh habanero chile and the vinegar mixture. Stir to combine, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Drain the chicken, reserving marinade, and roll or cut into 1 inch cubes. Melt the ghee in a skillet, and place the chicken into the skillet. Cook, stirring and turning, until browned on all sides and no longer pink inside. Remove chicken from skillet and place on a baking pan. Bake until tender, about 35 minutes.

title: Momma's Chocolate Topping With Mocha Crumbs for Dipping
ingredients: 2 tablespoons melted chocolate or 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon white breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons light mayonnaise | 1 cup whipped topping ( of your choice )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Mix the chocolate or cocoa with your bread crumbs. Mix until very smooth. Add the mayonnaise and fold well. Fold in the whipped topping. Spoon into a greased tin, or tin lined with clingfilm. If the topping is too thick, drizzle a little more over the top of the toffee or chocolate mixture when serving.

title: Fruitcakes
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 - 190 degrees celcius. Mix 1 cup of the flour with the cranberries. Roll 1 cup of flour into 12 x 8 rectangle. Cut the rectangle in half making sure all sides are covered with flour. Roll each half rectangle into a thin cake. Spread dried red fruit mixture on each half of the loaf. Place the remaining half of the loaf on top. Using a metal spatula, place the loaf onto an oven tray. Bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cheese tortellini,russet potato,mace,red jalapeno chile,yellow onion,dark rum,cake flour,spring onion
title: New Orleans Garlic Tortellini (Tortellini) Pastries
ingredients: 6 spring onions or 6 green onions, trimmed | 2 red jalapeno chiles, seeded | 2 large russet potatoes, diced | 3/4 cup dark rum | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons cake flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 bag frozen cheese tortellini
instructions: Slice the onions into rings.

title: Stir Fry Bell Pepper and Sherry
ingredients: 1 small bell pepper ( red is good ) | 1 tablespoon dry sherry or 1 tablespoon dry vermouth | 1 dash ground red pepper
instructions: Slice the bell pepper in half lengthwise and core it. Rinse the bell pepper and cut it into 1/8 dice. Place the bell pepper in a wide and shallow bowl with about 1/2 teaspoon of the salt and the red pepper. Add the sherry or vermouth and toss to coat. Serve at once while the bell pepper is still warm.

title: Creamy Green Bean and Asparagus Linguine
ingredients: 32 ounces linguine ( about 1 box ) | 1 can pork & beans ( drained meat ) | 1 bunch fresh asparagus, cut in 1-inch lengths | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon chopped peeled fresh ginger | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger, divided
instructions: Cook linguine acc to package directions. Rinse with hot water and drain well. In a large, resealable plastic bag, combine pork and beans with asparagus, cream, 1 teaspoon ginger and 1 teaspoon fresh ginger. Close and turn to blend. Seal bag and place in freezer. At least 1 1/2 hours before serving, prepare linguine according to package directions, using 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger, 1 teaspoon garlic, salt and remaining 3/4 teaspoon ginger. Drain linguine and divide among four dinner casseroles. Pour remaining 1/2 teaspoon ginger and 1/2 teaspoon garlic and cream sauce over pasta. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 teaspoon ginger.

Random Ingredients: white onion,phyllo pastry,thyme sprig,hard salami,black peppercorn,mung bean noodle,swiss cheese
title: Noodle Phyllo Pie
ingredients: 18 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/4 pound fresh hunk ham, coarsely chopped | 1/4 pound swiss cheese, coarsely grated | 1/4 pound black peppercorns | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 9 whole black peppercorns | 8 ounces fresh mung bean noodles | fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 pound white onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook bean noodles according to package directions. Drain, and stir in 2 tspn of thyme and 1/4 pound of white onions. Meanwhile, heat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. To assemble, place two sheets of phyllo on wax paper. Spread with about 1/4 cup of the ham and 1/4 pound of swiss cheese, black peppercorns, and a little thyme. Cover with 1/2 third of bean noodles. Top with a third of the remaining ham and then a half of onion slices then another third of the ham and onion slices. Repeat layers. Top with remaining 2 sheets of phyllo, then spread with remaining ham and cheese. Press plastic wrap down on top and sides of crust. Cut steam vents and brush top with water. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until crust is golden.

Random Ingredients: green bean,whipping cream,horseradish,yogurt,kosher salt,white cranberry juice,italian bread,buttermilk
title: Green Beans & Cranberry Dip (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 3 )
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs fresh green beans, trimmed ends snapped into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup fresh white cranberry juice | 1/4 cup old fashioned light yogurt | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup low-fat buttermilk | 3 tablespoons fresh horseradish ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups low-fat sour cream or 1 1/2 cups low fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons drained italian bread or 2 tablespoons rye bread, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425°f bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the green beans and cook until crisp tender, stirring occasionally, about 2 minutes. Drain, and transfer to a bowl. Add the cranberry juice, yoghurt, honey, and salt to the green beans, tossing to coat. Spoon into shallow baking pan. Cover and bake for 30 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Meanwhile, stir together the buttermilk, horseradish, and sour cream in a small bowl until well blended. Serve the dip warm with the toasted sour cream.

title: Rice Bread (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons yeast | 3 cups cooked lentils ( white or brown in a skillet, use your favourite amount ) | 1/2 cup vegetable ( i used my favourite, but plain white rice for those of us would not come out as good ) | 1 1/2 cups white basmati rice ( i used jasmine, long cooking rice which is gluten free, but you can use brown rice for any sweet potato that doesn't want to be gluten )
instructions: Dissolve yeast for 10 minutes in 1 1/4 cups of water. Add 1 1/2 cups cooked lentils, 1/2 cup rice and 1/4 cup remaining ingredients except rice. Program bread machine according to owner's manual.

title: Hamburgers With Sultanas
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger meat | 4 tablespoons sherry | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon sultana | pesto sauce
instructions: Cook meat until brown. Cool and blend until smooth. Add sherry, mustard, sultanas and pesto. Serve on hamburger bun with lettuce, tomatoes, grated cheese and parsley.

title: Spanish Black Beans
ingredients: 10 cups cooked black beans | 1 can pitted prunes | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a crock pot and cook on high for 1 hour.

title: Covered Almond Chilies
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup safflower oil | 1/4 teaspoon asian seasoning | 2 -3 hot dried chilies, stemmed, deseeded and torn ( wear gloves, or use dried chiles that have been soaked in hot water ), to taste ( wear gloves ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1 dash red chili powder | 1 teaspoon chopped slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Combine molasses, oil, asian seasoning and chiles in a medium sauce pan and bring to a boil. Let cook for a couple of minutes, then remove from heat and allow to sit for 10 minutes. Place chili mixture in a small bowl and stir in basil and chili powder. Add toasted almonds and toss well, serve warm or cold.

title: Blueberry Blueberry Rugelach
ingredients: 1 package fresh blueberries, thawed | 1 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a glass baking dish with parchment paper. Spread the fresh berries onto the parchment paper, or place any that are still slightly warm in a microwave safe bowl, and microwave on high for 5 minutes, stirring every minute or so, until softened. Stir the walnuts and parmesan cheese together in a bowl and set aside. Drain the blueberries thoroughly, pressing down on them gently with your hands to break them up slightly. Gently stir the soaked berries into remaining parmesan cheese. Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish and spread evenly. Cover the dish with foil and refrigerate overnight. The next 9 hours, remove the foil and bake until the topping is brown and crispy and the berries are bubbling, about 30 to 40 minutes. Allow to cool at room temperature for 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,gherkin,mini chocolate chip,broccoli,sea salt,tequila,ice water
title: Chocolate Chips Broccoli Tapas With Tequila
ingredients: 1 head fresh broccoli | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 cup coarse sea salt | 1 1/2 cups tequila ( patron iced, tapatio or al jente are best in this ) | 3 tablespoons ice water | 12 teaspoons mini chocolate chips | pickled gherkin ( garnish )
instructions: Break the stem part off the broccoli using a vegetable peeler. Cut the stem from the stem and cut the floret crosswise into 1 inch pieces. Slice the rest of the stem into 1 inch lengths and set aside. Fill a small bowl with ice water and let sit for 5 minutes. Using two spoons, scoop out the florets at room temperature. Cut the stalks into 1/2 inch strips and set aside with the broccoli. Season the broccoli with salt and freshly ground black pepper and set aside. In a small bowl, combine tequila, water and mini chips. Stir to mix and set aside. When all the water is drained, add the tequila mixture and set aside in a small saucer. Stir the ice water into the tapas so it is absorbed and slowly begin shaking the tapas with a rubber spatula or wooden spoon. You want the tapas dissolved so the ice is clear of the tequila and it will not stick to the pot. When the mixture has become very smooth and creamy transfer it to a serving bowl. Using a tooth pick, or a wooden spoon, break the broccoli into medium bite sized pieces and add to the tequila. Toss with the tapas in the bowl. Garnish with the sliced gherkin.

title: Tarragon Catsup (Paprika Paste)
ingredients: 2 ounces tarragon ( or fresh herbs ifn't available, or mix with the tarragon of your choice ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 large pinch smoked paprika
instructions: Blend the paprika and asafoetida. If you are using smoked paprika and not using smoked paprika, you may use the same method. Add more as needed, or mix all ingredients. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,irish cream,sun tomato oil,pineapple chunk,chickpea flour,spicy brown mustard
title: Chickpea Flour Dip
ingredients: 400 g chickpea flour, all purpose | 100 g spicy brown mustard | 1 tablespoon pineapple chunk, chopped | 10 -12 fluid ounces sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon irish cream
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium sized saucepan. Add the mustard and chillies and cook on low medium heat stirring frequently for 2 - 3 minutes. Reduce the heat to low and add all the other ingredients. Stir to combine and leave to simmer for 20 minute serve with assorted fresh fruit, crackers or chopped vegetables.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,corn kernel,white sesame seed
title: Corn and Sesame Seed Soup
ingredients: 1 cup corn kernel | 1 -2 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon white sesame seeds, for color
instructions: Wash and drain corn kernels, and put them in a pan with a teaspoon of oil or butter, and keep on medium low heat. Once they are all in the pan, add about 20 minutes before the end of the cooking time, mix them with the corn and pour into a bowl over the ice cubes when serving.

title: Aromatic Turkey Salad With Snowy Potatoes and Wakame
ingredients: 1 whole turkey, rinsed | 1 cup yukon gold potato, thinly sliced, halved, quartered ( or use 1 cup baby yukon gold frozen potatoes, thawed ) | 1 cup fresh strawberry, diced | 2 tablespoons walnut-stuffed wakame, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the turkey on the baking sheet, and season it with the salt and pepper. Roast in the oven for 20 minutes. Let cool. Remove the neck and giblets, and pull the meat off the bone. Discard the neck, giblets and any remaining skin and bones. Cut it into 1 1/2 to 2 inch chunks. Place the potato in a bowl, and add the walnuts, and toss gently to coat. Place the turkey in a large bowl. Add the wakame and the salad. Toss to coat and allow the salad to rest for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Spinach and Asiago Rounds
ingredients: 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup shredded asiago cheese | 2 bunches fresh spinach leaves | 2 cloves, or more to taste
instructions: Mix baking powder and asiago cheese together in a bowl.

title: Hot Mexican Red Chili Sauce (Copycat)
ingredients: 1 large sweet onion flakes | 1 cup roasted red chili peppers ( from the jars ) | 1 cup hot dark chili powder or 1 cup chili powder, for extra spiced flavor
instructions: Mix all together. Store in cool off dry container in back of fridge.

title: Garlic Confit (Italian Pimento Snack)
ingredients: 1 pimiento | 1/2 teaspoon aniseed
instructions: Finely dice the pimiento and aniseed and mix them in with the other ingredients. Refrigerate in an airtight container for 1 month before use.

title: Soft and Crusty Semolina and Corn Tortillas
ingredients: 1 - 2 1/4 lb white corn ( or 4 cups of frozen corn ) | 10 1/2 ounces purchased pizza sauce | 5 3/4 ounces purchased semolina flour
instructions: To defrost corn, take out all of the water and place into pot. Sprinkle corn with salt, bring to a boil then immediately reduce heat to a simmer. Simmer, covered, turning to get all the liquid off the corn when cooked. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease baking sheet. Using a slotted spoon, transfer corn to bowl of electric mixer. Pour pizza sauce into bowl and stir with wire whip until smooth. Add semolina and beat well. Add corn, mix well. Turn onto greased baking sheet, sprinkle with salt. Bake tortillas 10 - 15 minutes until lightly browned. Remove and slice into wedges. Serve with crusty bread and tomato sauce.

title: Bean and Beet Biscuit Bites #2
ingredients: 1 red beet | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon soy sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 cup whole wheat biscuits ( or your favourite biscuits )
instructions: Drain the beet and grate by pressing out seeds and bits on the inside of a food processor. Squeeze out the excess liquid with your hands. Put the grated beet in a bowl and with your hands mix in the remaining ingredients. Spray a frying pan with cooking spray. Heat the pan and stir fry each side for 2 - 3 minutes. Cool and store in the fridge.

title: Brown Rice, Farfalle and Farfalle Pasta
ingredients: 1 box farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 cups brown rice, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine farfalle and rice. Transfer to the preheated oven. Bake, stirring once, about one hour, or until farfalle mixture is browned and rice is tender. Serve immediately.

title: Smoked Salmon Barbecue
ingredients: 4 lbs smoked hamburger or 4 lbs top round beef | 4 tablespoons tomato paste ( use ketchup if you do not have tomato paste ) | 1/2 lb cured hamburger | 1/2 lb dates, pitted and sliced
instructions: Preheat your smoker. Place hamburger on the greased grill. Brush with tomato paste, then season with salt and pepper. Smoke for 20 to 30 minutes, or until brown. Meanwhile, toast your dates for a few minutes and remove from the stove. Spread a tablespoon of tomato paste on the hamburger, then roll it up. Secure with a toothpick if you need to. Serve topped with ham and sliced dates.

title: Bitter Orange Tequila
ingredients: 1/2 cup tequila | 1/2 cup orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon lemon
instructions: Pour 1/2 a cup of tequila, 1/2 a teaspoon of orange zest, the cayenne pepper, and 1 teaspoon of lemon zest into a glass pitcher with a lid. Shake vigorously and store in the refrigerator. When ready to serve, place 1/4 cup of tequila into a 1 teaspoon of orange zest, 1/4 a teaspoon of orange zest, 1/2 a teaspoon of cayenne pepper, and 1 teaspoon of lemon zest into a glass with a lid.

title: Vietnamese Noodle and Bean Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup cold pressed coffee, strong | 1 tablespoon chili bean, sweetened, drained | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: Dissolve coffee in hot coffee. Set aside. Cook noodles. Serve on warmed bread, topped with bean mixture.

title: The Best Garlic
ingredients: 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 clove garlic, minced
instructions: Heat the canola oil in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Oriental Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup corn oil
instructions: In a bowl, stir canola and corn oils together. Remove the oil from the bowl, and slowly whisk in the oil. Dip cold potatoes into the oil mix, coating evenly. Place on a plate, cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Turn to coat generously with the oil, and store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,cannellini bean,red cabbage,broth,blackberry,poultry seasoning
title: Spicy Cranberry and Blackberry Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup chopped red cabbage, or more to taste | 2 cups cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 3/4 cup low-sodium broth | 2 cups cubed red cabbage, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Combine black beans, red cabbage, cannellini beans, broth, 1/2 cup of shredded red cabbage, and poultry seasoning in a pot over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: baguette,ginger garlic paste,green lentil,ice cube,lemon juice,biscuit baking mix,oregano leaf
title: Lebanese Lentil Bread
ingredients: 1 kg finely-mixed green lentils | 400 g biscuits ( baking mix ) | ice cube | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste ( bottled or frozen ) | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 cup ice cube
instructions: Put the lentils into a big saucepan with 6 cups water. Bring to the boil, skimming any foam that rises to the surface during the cooking process, then turn down the heat, cover and simmer gently until the lentils are tender, about 40 - 45 minutes. Add the ginger garlic paste and oregano while the lentils are simmering. Remove from the heat and leave to cool slightly. Put the biscuits on to a tray and put them in a pan of hot water to soak. Drain the bread then crush them as little as possible and transfer to a bowl. Add the lemon juice, ice and lemon juice. Mix well until evenly blended. If it is too wet add more biscuit baking mix, then mix well again. Put the dough into a bowl and add the remaining dressing. Mix all well, cover and set aside for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into serving portions. Shape into rounds or triangles and put on a baking sheet. Bake in the oven at 220c for about 10 minutes then loosen them with a knife if they are browning too quickly. Remove from the oven and leave to cool as you eat them.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Strawberry Sauce & Strawberry Seeds
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin | 1 tablespoon dried strawberries
instructions: Preheat the broiler on your highest setting. Rub one side of each beef tenderloin with dried strawberries. Place the tenderloin on a broiler pan. Broil for 15 minutes or until a thermometer reads 120 degrees or meat thermometer registers 125 degrees. Meanwhile, make the sauce. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Place the tenderloins onto a cutting board and slice across grain into 1/4 inch slices. Serve with the strawberry sauce and serve.

title: Chakal (Spinach and Bulgur Wheat)
ingredients: 1 cup bulgar wheat ( cracked wheat ) | 1 carrot, washed
instructions: Soak bulgur wheat for a minimum of 8 hours.

title: Chunky Red Lentils With Chunky Tomato Soup
ingredients: 4 lbs beefsteak tomatoes | 1/2 cup red lentil | 1/2 cup wine
instructions: Wash the tomatoes and slice them vertically into thin wedges. Place them in a saucepan, add water to cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat. Heat a large, deep skillet over high heat. Add the tomatoes and stir with a spoon or tongs to get rid of any large chunks. Cook for 8 minutes or until they give off a sourness to them, remove and discard the tomato juices. When cool enough to handle, remove the skins with your fingers. Slice into wedges. Return the tomatoes and sauce to a slow cooker pan, add the lentils and the wine and simmer about 45 minutes in a slow cooker or to your pressure cooker's natural release function, or the longer it simmers, the more tender the stew will be. Serve. This can also be done on the stove top, but the results are better.

title: Nana Soup
ingredients: 1 large banana, peeled and sliced | 6 cups chicken stock
instructions: Slice the banana thinly. Combine the banana and the stock in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, and simmer 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard,lipton onion mushroom soup mix,pickle relish,dark chocolate,chestnut puree,green pepper,beef brisket
title: Lennie & Donna's Corned Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs fresh corned beef brisket | 2 cans chestnut puree | 2 cans condensed mustard | 1 package lipton onion and mushroom soup mix | 1 packet sweet pickle relish | 2 ounces dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Combine chestnut puree with mustard, onion soup mix and relish in skillet. Simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes, or until thickened. Place beef on a shallow roasting pan and coat with remaining mixture. Broil, covered, over indirect heat about 20 minutes, turning once, until desired level of doneness. Remove from oven, cut into thick slices and serve.

title: Wild Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups whole grain brown rice | 1 small eggplant | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom | 1/2 cup diced sweet potato or 1/2 cup peeled cubed carrot
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Peel and cube eggplant, wash thoroughly and drain any excess water. Slice eggplant crosswise into 1/4 inch disks. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes. Transfer to a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. Spread rice in a strainer and press around the edges to remove excess moisture. Set aside to drain for 5 minutes. Place rice in a bowl and mash well. Stir in eggplant, margarine and mushrooms. In the remaining half of a teaspoon or so of margarine melt the remaining margarine and stir in sweet potato or peeled carrot. Place a layer of rice in a deep serving dish or a baking dish about 9 inches deep, coated with margarine. Spoon rice mixture evenly over the rice. Place the remaining layers of rice on top. Cover dish and bake until rice is tender and brown, about 50 - 60 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oil,zucchini,cooking oat,cream cheese,navy bean,sun tomato oil
title: Italian Zucchini With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 zucchini, sliced lengthwise lengthwise | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and sliced | 2 tablespoons cooking oats | 1/4 cup oil ( optional )
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and next 5 ingredients. Spread over zucchini slices. Bake 375' for 15min.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,brown sugar,ladyfinger,cumin powder,turmeric powder,corn oil,hamburger bun,yellow squash
title: Eggless Mexican Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage ( you can buy it already chorizo or make your own ) | 1 large yellow squash, sliced | 8 hamburger buns | ladyfinger | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 2 tablespoons corn oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: In a medium sized skillet, brown chorizo. Don't overhandle the chorizo, though, it adds great flavour to this recipe. When chorizo is cooked and crumbly, drain it, saving the drippings. Cut up the squash. Once chorizo is done, add it to the mixture for 5 minutes or so. Add your cooked chorizo, squash and cover. Cook until squash is nice and tender, but still firm. It will get soft, so be careful if you don't get mushy. Prepare your burgers by heating corn oil in a skillet, flipping on each side. I like to put a spoonful of sauce along the inside of the burger, but you can put more on top if desired. I have found the buns are nice to toast on the grill, but you have to be careful because they burn easily. You can top with cumin. Add chopped chorizo, squash, brown sugar and any remaining sauce that's on the table for guests to put their own. This is really good, so easy and soooo yummy. Good with cheese, hummus, sour cream, etc.

title: Almond Roasted Pepper Heroes
ingredients: cooking spray | 12 ounces bottled roasted del monte sweet peppers or 12 ounces bottled roasted red peppers, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 1 lb small yellow sweet pepper or 1 lb small red sweet pepper | 6 tablespoons lardons, finely diced ( such as crisco ) | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 8 -12 hoagie rolls, split | green pepper ( optional ) | radish ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange peppers on tray, cut side down. Bake for 10 minutes, basting every 3 - 4 minutes with the jar of sweet peppers. Heat remaining ingredients. Serve on hoagies or rolls.

title: Asparagus Re
ingredients: 24 fresh asparagus | 8 -12 slices swiss cheese | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | dipping sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Wash and trim asparagus and separate them into individual pieces depending on size. Steam asparagus in a steamer basket until just starting to soften in 2 turns so as not to cook the asparagus too fast. Dip desired amount of cheese into dipping sauce and add to the asparagus. Enjoy.

title: White Chilli Cream Cheese Sausages
ingredients: 1 navel orange | 250 g soft fresh goat cheese | 3 red green chilies | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Cut the orange in thin slices. Remove and discard the central membrane on the orange and discard along with the skin and membrane pith. Cut the rind from the orange and set the rind aside. Cut the cheese into small cubes and set aside. Cut the chillies into small pieces and set aside. In a large pan bring the half and half just to the boiling point. In a pan of boiling water blanch the cheese until it is just soft enough to stir. Remove the cheese with a slotted spoon and set aside. Place the orange rind into a colander and use a spoon to press out any excess water and the bitter white pith that has floated to the surface. Place the orange rind back into the pan and gently pour the hot half and half over the cheese and stir gently. The mix should be smooth and creamy. Season with salt if necessary. Let stand for 30 minutes. Put the cheese mixture into an ovenproof dish and put on the hot sausages. Dot with the cheese cubes and return the pan to the stove. Bake at 160c for 10 - 15 minutes or until browned and hot, and serve with sweet red chili sauce.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,guacamole,vegetable,french bread,barbecue sauce,white wine vinegar,alfredo sauce
title: Barbecue Grill Bread Bowls
ingredients: 3 cups dry white basmati rice ( about 12-16 ounces ) or 3 cups brown rice ( about 12-16 ounces ) | 1 jar barbeque sauce, such as valentina | 1 bottle alfredo sauce | 6 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 cup french bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | roasted vegetables, such as red bell pepper, broccoli sprouts, yellow bell pepper, sliced green bell pepper, etc | guacamole, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice as directed on package and cool to room temperature. While rice is cooling, mix barbeque sauce, alfredo sauce, vinegar, bread and vegetables in a large bowl. To make the bowls, spoon rice into 4 bowls and top with desired filling.

title: Chipotle Bruschetta
ingredients: 3 cups fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 2 canned chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 20 slices french bread, toasted | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, halved | 1/4 cup canned chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | shredded lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Toss strawberries, 1/4 cup basil, 1 chipotle chile, bread slices, 1/4 cup basil, cherries, 1/4 cup chile, and 1/2 cup adobo in a bowl.

title: Green Asparagus With Spinach & Asparagus
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh asparagus | 1/2 cup skim milk | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup fresh spinach leaves, trimmed, washed & chopped into pieces | 1/2 cup low-fat milk | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 small fresh rocket, washed
instructions: Snap off tough ends of asparagus stalks& cut into 4 equal pieces set aside. In a medium saucepan, heat milk& a little more than half of the cumin. When it boils, stir in asparargus& spinach& stir to coat in asonagam. Cover& simmer over low heat for 4 minutes or until asparagus is cooked through. Season if necessary. Serve topped with 1/4 cup skimmed milk& a sprinkling of cumin. Sprinkle with rocket leaves.

title: Linda's Italian Shrimp & Pepperoni Linguini
ingredients: 1/2 lb linguine | 2 tablespoons quick oats | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 lb shrimp, peeled, deveined | 1 teaspoon celery seed ( or to taste ) | 8 slices white bread | fresh ground pepperoni ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. In blender, combine oats, cocoa and shrimp, cover and blend until smooth. Set aside. Place sliced bread on paper towels, season with pepperoni if desired, place on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper and toast under broiler, until slightly browned. Spread onto cookie sheet with waxed paper and let dry on counter. Drain shrimp/peppers, reserving liquid, retaining liquid. Melt 1 tbls. Oil in 13x9 pan over medium heat. Sprinkle on shrimp mixture, stir to coat. Increase heat to high, add shrimp mixture, reduce heat to medium, and cook 3 minutes or until shrimp have turned pink and are no longer opaque. Top with shredded parmean, if using, and return to heat until heated thru, 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Majadra (Almond Paste Sauce)
ingredients: 16 ounces almond paste | 1 can tomato sauce | garlic salt
instructions: Blend ingredients in a blender. Makes about 6oz. Variations, for a twist or for a more pronounced flavor, blend the sauce first. For a richer sauce, add a bit of sifted powdered instant coffee powder. Or, for a thicker paste, blend the sauce until smooth and the almond paste changes form a paste. Adjust the flavor to your preference. If using whole canned tomatoes, you may need to add 1 teaspoon of ground coffee powder. Adjust the flavor to taste.

title: Lemongrass Alfredo
ingredients: 4 slices bacon drippings | 5 stalks lemongrass | 2 jars alfredo sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place bacon drippings in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Wrap and twist lemongrass stalks with toothpicks. Brush evenly with bacon drippings. Bake in preheated oven until tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Pasta With Asparagus and Asparagus (Pasta Con Asparagi E Menta
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh asparagus | 12 ounces pasta, of your choice
instructions: Snap off asparagus stems and cut into bite size pieces. Toss together with 2 cups of the pasta water just to coat. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Meanwhile, snap off the tips of the asparagus and cut the remaining tips into thin slices. When the water comes to a boil, add the asparagus pieces and cook for 2 minutes until al dente. Drain and set aside. Add the pasta to the boiling water and cook until al dente. Drain and immediately transfer to a large bowl. Toss with the asparagus mixture. Add more pasta water if you feel it needs it to be as creamy as you want the pasta to look. Sprinkle over the reserved asparagus pieces and serve.

title: Apple Nuts and Feta  Powder
ingredients: 3/4 cup finely chopped fennel seed | 2 tablespoons ground anise | 2 medium tart apples, peeled, cored, coarsely grated ( i use granny smith apples ) | 1 tablespoon orange zest, finely grated ( optional ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons almond paste, finely grated ( optional ) | 1 3/4 cups crumbled feta
instructions: In a medium skillet place the fennel, anise and grated apples. Sprinkle the orange zest and almond paste on top of the apples. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the apples are lightly toasted and the anise are a bit more toasted and aromatic, about 1 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and serve.

title: Simple Fettuccine I
ingredients: 455 g fettuccine pasta | 4 cups beef stock | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Bring the stock to the boil in a large pan. Add the chicken bouillon, allspice, and fettuccine and stir to combine. Cover and cook for 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Sausage and Oat Balls (For one)
ingredients: 450 g ground beef ( i use middle eastern beef ) | 150 g italian sausage ( mild italian sausage ) | 1 liter beef stock | 1 teaspoon guacamole | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: First, make your oats, make your beef stock. Add the guacamole. Then add the vanilla essence. First, mix the oats and beef stock to form the mixture into a sticky paste. Add a little bit of sugar to your mixture if you like it sweeter. Add a few drops of vanilla essence to this mixture. Then form the mixture into small balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 180 degrees centigrade for 20 minutes, until brown. Allow to cool. Serve. Note, you can also stuff the balls with any combination of things, you can also roll them into small balls, but you can always take out when they are cool and put in frig for an hour or so to firm up. These are very rich and so easy to do so. Also, you can store these in the freezer in a zip lock bag for up to six months.

title: Beef and Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 1/4 cup flour | 1/2 teaspoon orange rind, grated | 1/3 cup cream-style cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons orange rind, grated | 3/4 cup flour | 1 package frozen puff pastry
instructions: Brown meat, stirring, until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,seasoning salt,chicken breast half,cilantro,hamburger,taco seasoning,meat
title: Cilantro Chicken
ingredients: 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro | 1 cup bread flour | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 lbs skinless boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 lb hamburger | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese | 1 envelope taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Toss chicken with cilantro and reserve for basting during the last 10 minutes, or roast on a grill. Brown chicken in non stick skillet. When chicken is done, set aside and keep warm. When chicken is done, remove from pan. Heat skillet until hot enough to sizzle a meat thermometer. Add hamburger and cook, stirring until it crumbles. Add cheddar cheese. To make taco seasoning, mix a 1/4 teaspoon of taco seasoning with 1/4 cup water. Put remaining ingredients in small bowl, then add to hamburgurger mixture. Heat thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: green,stevia powder,white sugar,mini pepper,white wine,chocolate,baby spinach
title: Stevia Stir-Fry (Stove-Fry)
ingredients: 2 ounces semidry mini sweet peppers | 1 ounce baby spinach | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 teaspoon stevia powder | 1/8 cup white sugar | 1 ounce semisweet chocolate, chopped
instructions: Prepare mini sweet peppers and baby spinach according to package directions. In a small bowl, microwave chocolate, wine, stevia, and sugar until chocolate is melted and mixture is slightly thickened, about 30 seconds. Stir hot chocolate mixture into chocolate mixture.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,celery,french bread,tomato ketchup,pectin,oregano leaf,turmeric,red wine vinegar
title: Tomato and Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf day old french bread | 3 ounces tomato ketchup | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon grated celery | 1/2 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon concentrated tomato ketchup
instructions: Cut the top off the french loaf and hollow out the centre leaving a hollow on top of the loaf for later use. Wash inside well. Split loaf in half lengthwise and hollow out one end so you have 8 slices. Set the bread aside. Mix all the remaining ingredients together in a bowl, apart from the reserved bread, making sure the mixture is dry. Slice and arrange bread slices upright on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush bread with glaze. Bake at 180c/350f/gas 4 for 40 minutes turning once or twice. Serve hot or at room temp, keeping leftover bread warm covered with foil or foil and placing on plates.

title: Chili Pepper Beef Steak
ingredients: 750 g chuck, tops trimmed | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate soda | 1 teaspoon ground chile pequins | 1 large yellow pepper, roughly chopped
instructions: Mix together all the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Pour over the beef and massage all over. Cover and leave in a cool place for 3 hours or overnight, turning occasionally. Preheat the oven shelf to 190°c or gas mark 4 and grill all sides. Serve with mashed potato and steamed vegetables.

title: Baked Creamed Apricots With Apricot Cream
ingredients: 6 ounces dried apricots | 3/4 cup hot chicken broth | 2 large egg whites ( about 4 large ) | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Wash apricots and cut into bite sized pieces. Place apricots and broth in saucepan and bring to a boil. Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Remove apricots and broth from heat. Beat egg whites until foamy in a large bowl. Slowly beat in 1/2 tsp onion salt. Gradually beat in cream. Transfer to 2 quart baking dish. Add apricots to cream mixture. Using a fork, scrape cream mixture into cream. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 tsp onion salt. Bake at 300 degrees f, loosely covered, until set, about 45 minutes. Spoon cream mixture over warm apricots.

Random Ingredients: salad green,orange bell pepper,head cauliflower,rye bread,tomato puree
title: Roasted Vegetable Fajitas on Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 orange sweet bell pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 can tomato puree | 2 tablespoons salad greens | 2 tablespoons toasted rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place cauliflower, orange pepper, tomato puree, 1 tablespoon salad greens, and rye bread slices on a foil lined baking sheet and drizzle with remaining tablespoon of olive oil. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, until vegetables are tender and the bread has absorbed the fat. Allow to cool and serve.

title: Lebanese-Styled Pork Filling
ingredients: 2 lbs pork fillets | 2 cans bamboo shoots, drained and chopped finely | 2 stalks lemongrass, minced | 20 large filling, rolls, to your taste | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and refrigerate until ready to use. Note, for the pork, when adding meat as an appetizer, it may help to flatten the meat slightly with your fingers before removing it from the bowl. The meat stays intact. This recipe is for pork, pork sausage, or kielbasa, not turkey sausage. Add your choice of meat.

title: Cranberry Chiles Poppy Seeds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons poppy seeds, toasted | 3 ounces dried cranberries | 4 ounces fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 -2 chipotle chile
instructions: Toast poppy seeds in a preheated 400 degree oven until golden. Place poppy seeds in small serving bowl, cover with cold water. Drain all but 1 tablespoon of the water. Place cranberries, cheese, and chilies in same, oven safe bowl with poppy seeds. Stir to combine, cover and let sit for 20 minutes, or until cranberries have softened and liquid has been absorbed. Strain liquid from bowl, discard pulp and seeds. Cool for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally. Serve with crackers. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sea salt black pepper,chicken bouillon,chive blossom,chicken,corn muffin mix,dill pickle,plain yogurt,vinegar
title: Chicken Dilly With Chive Poached Dill
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon chives blossoms ( see directions for recipe ) | 3 -4 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1 cup chicken, cooked and diced | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon distilled vinegar | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh dill pickle | sea salt and black pepper | 24 corn muffin mix, prepared according to package directions
instructions: Dressing, mix the yogurt, chives, bouillon, chicken, vinegar and dill pickle. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
