Broil in the oven until the tops are golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes and the bottoms are brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast cheat chunk,caster sugar,broth,yogurt,allspice,pine nut,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Chicken Parcels With Yoghurt and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 3 chicken breast cheat chunks | 1 glass yoghurt | 300 g roasted pine nuts | 4 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 cup broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or 190°c fan forced. Place the chicken cheat chunks in the bottom of a rectangular baking dish. Pour yoghurt over chicken. Sprinkle over the pine nuts and chopped parsley. Sprinkle over sugar. Bake at 200c/fan forced for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and place the broth in a pan over high heat. When liquid almost comes to the boil, pour over the chicken. Return to the oven for a further 35 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and sauce is thick, glazed and hot. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with warmed breads and a crisp green salad.

Random Ingredients: carrot,vanilla extract,poppy seed,dill leaf,pimiento,fennel seed,water chestnut
title: Dill Poppy Seed and Carrot Salad
ingredients: 1 lb carrot, peeled. cut into 1/2 `` pieces | 1/4 cup water chestnut, cut into thin strips or 1/4 cup canned diced ham | 1/4 can water chestnuts, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons poppy seeds, finely chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped dill leaves | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped canned pimiento | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh vanilla extract
instructions: In a large bowl, combine carrots, water chestnuts, poppy seeds, dill, pimiento, and vanilla. Stir to blend well. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight, stirring occasionally to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,cream,extra virgin olive oil,grand marnier
title: Easy Chiles Con Chile Cream
ingredients: 4 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup grand marnier ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Put the tomatoes with green chile peppers into a bowl. Pour the sour cream into the bowl with the tomatoes and chiles. Stir gently to combine. Pour the grand marnier over the mixture, stir until completely absorbed, and serve.

title: Pesto
ingredients: 1 cup loosely packed fresh parsley | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a blender, blend 1 cup parsley until chopped, then set aside. In a small bowl, stir together 1 cup grated parmigiano reggiano cheese and remaining 1/2 cup grated parmigiano reggiano cheese. Add remaining 1 1/2 cups chopped parsley to cheese mixture.

title: Irish Mince
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1/2 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill at least 3 hours and serve.

Random Ingredients: egg,guinness stout,parmigiano reggiano cheese,triple sec,provolone cheese,chicken bouillon
title: Guinness-Spooned Omelets
ingredients: 6 ounces provolone cheese, sliced very thin | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 6 tablespoons extra stout beer | 2 eggs | 2 ounces fresh guinness stout | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line the bottom of an extra large baking dish with half of the provolone, 1/4 of the parmigiano, and cheese slices. Combine the remaining three ingredients in a bowl. Beat the eggs with an electric mixer on high speed until frothy. Slowly add the guinness while whisking. Strain the resulting mixture into a bowl, discarding the cheese, and set aside. Using a spoon, spread 1/4 of the guinness into the prepared dish, just large enough to cover the bottom of the dish. Arrange 6 to 8 coated omelets in a single layer in the pan. Repeat with 6 to 8 remaining omelets. Place the top of the omelets over the filled pan, and drizzle evenly with more guinness. Bake approximately 25 to 30 minutes, until the top is golden brown and the omelets are set. Remove from oven, and let cool for 5 minutes before cutting into 6 slices.

title: Pineapple Limoncero Barbecue
ingredients: 1/4 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon coarse-ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons grated fresh parsley leaves | 1/2 cup chilled gin | 1/4 cup chilled limoncello | 1 can cut pineapple chunks, drained ( reserve juice )
instructions: Mix flour and pepper for crusty bread in a bowl. Mix parsley and gin together in a small bowl. Stir the orange juice and limoncello into the flour mixture. Spread bread crumbs on a baking sheet, and flatten with the back of a spoon. Cut pineapple chunks into 1/4 inch thick wedges. Arrange pineapple wedges on the crust, and brush with the orange dressing. Let stand for at least 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: prawn,cashew,tomato green chilies,bread flour,currant,onion soup mix,pasta,catfish fillet
title: Creamy Nutty Catalfish Pasta Chips
ingredients: 300 g capellini dried pasta or 300 g shell pasta | 1 kg catfish fillet, rinsed and dried, flesh included | 1 cup bread flour | 1 small onion soup mix | 300 g minced tomatoes with green chilies | 125 g pineapples | 125 g cashews
instructions: Cook the capellini or shell pasta according to packet instructions. Mix flour and soup mix in another bowl. Drain the pasta & mix well. Place macaroni in a pan with cold water making sure it covers evenly. Bring to boil and then simmer for 3 minutes. Drain, then toss with tomato mix. Toss nuts through the catfish then drain. Add to the tomato mix. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve at once, with some fresh chopped mixed green chillies. You can add a pinch of dried chilli seeds for a more milder flavour.

Random Ingredients: goya chicken bouillon,pierogies,artichoke heart,red cabbage,chicken thigh
title: Chicken and Dumplings-Poulet Au Carne
ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage, cored and sliced thin | 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 2 cans artichoke hearts ( refrigerated ) | 2 -3 tablespoons goya chicken bouillon | 12 frozen pierogies ( see note )
instructions: Cook cabbage in boiling water with chicken thighs until tender, 30 to 45 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove chicken and set aside. Bring remaining cup of chicken stock to boil and add artichoke slices and cabbage. Boil, uncovered for about 5 minutes. Stir in bouillon and add the pierogies.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,colby monterey jack cheese,pancetta,half,red onion,canola oil,corn
title: Rice With Cheese and Crispy Pancetta
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked brown rice | 3/4 cup chopped red onion | 1/4 lb pancetta, sliced ( about 3 slices ) | 1 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese, with other 4 cheese shredded blend ( optional ) | 2 cans corn, drained | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Cook rice according to its directions on the package or until almost all of the water is absorbed, but the rice is still firm. While rice is cooking, make cheese sauce. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When pan is hot, add 2 t. Of oil. Add pancetta and then 1/2 of the chopped onion and cook until pancetta is light brown, about 5 minutes. Add remaining onion and cook until onions are soft and transparent. Add 1/4 cup of cheese and corn, mixing well. Add half and half and then bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook, while stirring frequently, until sauce thickens slightly, about 10 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Steamed Green Curry Blend with Broccoli
ingredients: 2 lbs green broccoli ( small ) | 2 cups coconut milk | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 teaspoon crushed dried onion, divided | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon clove ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon savory ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed ( optional )
instructions: Cut the florets from the green beans. Cut the broccoli in half and remove the thick stems from the base and outer leaves. Wash and drain thoroughly. Steam the green beans in a steamer basket over simmering water about 10 minutes or until barely tender. Set aside. Wrap the peeled and chopped broccoli in aluminum foil and steam in the microwave using your usual method for steaming. Steam the beans until the steaming stops, about 3 minutes. Cut the steaming veggies into chunks as follows. Place the curry in a rice cooker and let it steam for about 5 minutes. While it is steaming, put the coconut milk and 1 tbs of tamari and heat on medium high heat. When the coconut milk is warmed, add 1 tablespoon of minced onion, 1/2 teaspoons cocoa, and the cinnamon, clove, and savory. Stir well to coat all ingredients thoroughly. After the rice cooker steams, turn the heat off and let it sit undisturbed for about 10 minutes. Fluff up the rice and serve hot.

title: Greek Yogurt Chicken Wings
ingredients: 15 chicken wings, whole | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | fat free greek yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to bake chicken on rack at 400 degrees for 40 to 45 minutes, or if desired, you can bake them whole from the freezer, before adding other ingredients. Serve hot with a drizzle of fat free Greek yogurt. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,ladyfinger,serrano pepper,apple cider,chicken breast half,shrimp
title: Apple Cider Chicken
ingredients: 1 package dried littleneck shrimp | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite-size pieces | 1 bunch chopped fresh serrano peppers | 1 bottle light apple cider | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 pound shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Place the shrimp in a shallow dish, and cover with fresh water. Soak for 30 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Place the chicken breast chunks into a large casserole dish, and cover with half of the chopped serrano peppers. Dice the remaining serrano peppers, and add into the casserole dish. Pour wine over the chicken, and stir to combine. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. Drain shrimp, reserving shrimp juice. Drain, and set aside. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine the shrimp and remaining chopped serrano peppers. Cover and refrigerate. After about 10 minutes, place shrimp mixture into a large baking dish. Cover, and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine the cooked chicken, chopped serrano peppers, and chopped apple cider. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Place 1 shrimp/chili mixture onto the cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until shrimp are pink and firm. Remove from oven. To serve, top each plate with a dollop of cheddar cheese, and place the stuffed shrimp onto the cheese. Place 1 or 2 shrimp/chili mixture on top, and serve with the remaining cheese on the side.

Random Ingredients: ouzo,green pepper,green food coloring,fava bean,pea,fish sauce,scallop
title: Thai Seafood Pudding
ingredients: 300 g scallops | 100 g peas | 300 g fresh fava beans | 3 green peppers, sliced | 1/3 cup ouzo | 1/2 tablespoon of minced fish sauce | 3 drops green food coloring
instructions: Cook scallops, peas and beans in boiling salted water. Mix ouzo, food coloring and chooves in small bowl and stir. Drain and add to seafood in serving bowl, mix well and serve.

title: Simple, Healthy Salmon and Peppers
ingredients: 1 salmon, skin removed and cut into 3 pieces | 1 yellow bell peppers or 1 red bell pepper, sliced ( 2 cups ) | 4 -6 slices fresh whole wheat or 4 -6 slices other raw vegetables
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a covered deep nonreactive saucepan. Add salmon pieces and pepper slices. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until fish is easily flaked with a fork. Drain vegetables and place on plates. Ladle salmon mixture over vegetables and enjoy.

title: Indian Style Parsnips With Black Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled and washed | 2 fennel bulbs, cleaned and sliced | 1 1/2 cups tamari ( for authenticity ) | 1/2 cup honey | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 can black beans
instructions: Steam the fennel bulbs till they are black. Drain water. Heat oil in a pan and add black beans. Saute till they are a beautiful color and the color becomes almost translucent. Add parsnips and fennel with 1/2 cup of tamari. Season with cumin powder and cover the pan till it's completely cooked. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: clove,chinese five spice powder,almond extract,pork tenderloin,bucatini pasta
title: Czech Spiced Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin | 1 ounce bucatini pasta or 1 ounce ziti pasta, uncooked | 3/4 cup whole peeled almonds, toasted | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/8 teaspoon clove
instructions: Rinse pork, prick numerous small holes in both sides with a fork. Place pork in skillet and cover. Cook over medium high heat for about 15 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. Cool slightly. Meanwhile, in a saucepan of boiling water, cook bucatini until tender, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Transfer to a serving bowl and toss with drained bucatini. Stir in almonds, five spice powder, and clove and set aside for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Fig Salad
ingredients: 12 -15 medium fresh figs, stems left on | 2 medium fresh red peppers | 1/3 cup salsa | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning
instructions: Cut open the figs and core them. Place them open over a bowl, and cut off the ends of the stems. Cut the peppers into 1/2 inch strips, and cut the strips into 1 inch long strips. To prevent the figs from bleeding, cut them into 1 inch long strips. Place them in a salad bowl. In a small bowl, add the salsa and the taco seasoning. Stir until combined. Pour over the figs and let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 can mackerel, drained | 1 can corn, drained | 8 -12 lettuce leaves | 1/2 green pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons canned beef bouillon | 1 teaspoon fat-free lard
instructions: Mix mackerel, corn and pepper in a bowl and coat with fat free cooking spray. Divide among lettuce leaves. Top with remaining mixture. Serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,hard egg,biscuit,pineapple preserve,crabmeat,italian sausage,cranberry,kielbasa sausage
title: Creamy Cranberry Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 cup cranberries ( fresh cut or frozen ) | 1/2 lb kielbasa sausage ( hot or sweet ) | 1/2 lb imitation crabmeat ( shredded ) or 1/2 lb imitation crabmeat, chopped ( can also use imitation crab meat ) | 2 cups canned vegetables broth | 1 can cream of mushroom soup or 6 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1 can pineapple preserves | 4 hard-boiled eggs, cut lengthwise in half | 1 can italian sausage, sliced ( lupina, chorizo, or jalapeno slices )
instructions: Mix together cranberries, sausage, and imitation crab meat or other imitation crab meat. Combine soup and cranberry mixture. Mix well. Add water, mixing well until all ingredients are blended. Add peaches and pineapple preserves, mix well. Divide among 6 greased ramekins or large freezer bags. Bake at 375°f for 20 to 25 minutes. Turn off oven and allow to cool 1 to 2 hours before filling patties. Garnish patties with chopped hard boiled eggs. Note, i prefer to add a pinch or two of dried thyme and ginger. Use an egg slicer to help pierce the thick part of each patty. This is really good served with tomato sauce or basil sauce. This patties are addictive. Enjoy.

title: Sweet, Savory Lullaby
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers | 1 package green beans, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 8 mandarin oranges, sliced | 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the luncheon meat, green beans, and oranges. Arrange the nuts in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Spoon the mandarin orange mixture into the dish. Cover, and refrigerate several hours or overnight to chill and blend flavors.

title: Easy Peanut Oil
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut oil | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder
instructions: Wipe your oil well and place in a jar. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Curried Spicy Crab Meat
ingredients: 1 pint lump crabmeat, picked over and cut in half lengthwise | 3/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon saffron, ground | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger paste | 3 tablespoons sugar syrup | 1 mushroom, sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the crabmeat with the cream of tartar and saffron. Blend in the garlic powder, ginger paste, sugar syrup and mushrooms. Serve at once.

title: Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1/2 cup vegetable | 2 tablespoons tomatillo salsa
instructions: Combine ginger garlic paste, garam masala and enough water to give a thick paste consistency. Cook on high heat for 1 minute. Add a little more water if necessary. Turn heat to low simmer. Add tomatillo salsa. Cook for another 2 - 3 minutes. Serve with roti or naan.

title: Aussie Spinach Ale
ingredients: 400 g mixed mushrooms | 350 g baby spinach | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 3 2/3 cups self-raising flour, sifted | 6/4 cup beer
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c if you are using wholemeal and halfmeal, measure the mushroom and spinach into a large pan and cook over a medium heat for 5 minutes until tender, then drain, rinse in cold water and drain again. Stir together the mushrooms, mushrooms & spinach in a large bowl until well mixed. Stir in the yogurt, flour and beer into the mixture with a wooden spoon. Fold in a couple of handfuls of the flour if too wet. Spoon the mixture into an ovenproof dish & bake for 25 minutes until golden brown & cooked all the way through.

title: Roast Chicken and Cauliflower and Horseradish Crumble
ingredients: 1 baking pastry flour, use one packet, use more if needed | 200 g cauliflower, cut into small florets | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 85 g pecans, chopped | 225 g roasting chickens, from the shop, cut into pieces | 1 -2 teaspoon dry horseradish, extra
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c/455°f in a large, ovenproof bowl, mix the flours into the chicken. Stir in the nuts and then spread the extra horseradish on top. Bake for 25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked and golden brown and vegetables are tender. Serve with your favourite salad and crusty bread.

title: Chickpea, Lentil and French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 yellow onion, sliced | 4 cups vegetable broth | 8 ounces cooked hamburger, chopped | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup lentils, rinsed and picked over
instructions: Combine chickpeas, onion and broth in a medium stock pot. Bring to a boil. Add hamburger, stirring and breaking it up into smaller pieces as it cooks. Reduce heat. Let soup simmer until it thickens, about 45 minutes. Add lentils to soup. Cover and let soup heat through for 10 minutes, or longer if desired.

title: Chewy Poached Cherry and Walnut Parfait (Gaelicature)
ingredients: 1 lb sour milk chocolate ( or nutella, nutella, etc. ) | 1/2 cup soymilk | 9 tablespoons ground walnuts | 2 teaspoons ground coriander ( cilantro ) | 1 teaspoon ginger, grated | 1 cup dried cherries ( about 1 2/3 cups ) | lemon halved dill | fresh dill sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the chocolate in a small saucepan with a lid. Add the rest of the ingredients and blend with a spoon into a smooth mixture. Pour the chocolate mixture into an 8 cup/250ml capacity baking dish. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to set and the flavours to blend. Cut a lengthwise slit in each cherry, and insert a halved fresh dill sprig. Sprinkle top with a little extra dill.

title: Easy Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 small yellow pepper | 2 beef top sirloin steaks | 1/2 cup tzatziki sauce | 1/2 cup thinly sliced cooked hamburger | 2 tablespoons prepared tzatziki sauce
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak. Cut steak into chunks, about 1/2 inch thick. Thread beef, onion and pepper onto skewers. In a small bowl, combine tzatziki sauce and tzatziki sauce. Cover, and marinate steaks at least 1 hour. Preheat grill for medium high heat. Grill steaks 5 minutes per side, or to desired doneness. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees f. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 4 bunches cherry, halved | 12 ounces canned low-fat buttermilk
instructions: Remove pits and pits from the cherries. Slice the cherries into half moons. Put cherries and buttermilk in a shallow bowl. Gently stir until well mixed. Mush the cherries lightly in the buttermilk, then spoon onto individual plates.

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook the farfalle pasta until tender but firm, about 6 - 7 minutes, depending on the thickness of the pasta. Drain and run under cold water. title: Szechwan Spiced Crab

instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a zip top bag. Shake to mix well. Serve in a dish with sides.

instructions: Combine puy liloelwarm water, yellow pepper, celery, and chives in a bowl. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a skillet over medium heat. title: Red Cottage Kambalaka
ingredients: 1 kg ground mutton | 2 tablespoons red curry paste, paste | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | pistachios, roughly chopped
instructions: Combine the ground mince and the red curry paste in a bowl. Mix well. Shape the mixture into marble sized balls. Pour condensed soup on top and stir until the meat is coated with soup. Stir in the soy sauce. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 200°c. Grease a baking dish with vegetable oil. Place meatballs and vegetables in the dish. Bake for about 15 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti noodle,ham hock,lamb,lentil,tapioca flour,pappardelle pasta,orange peel,glutinous rice
title: Pasta With Lentils, Lamb and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup small dried lentils | 8 ounces lamb, cut into bite-size pieces | 8 ounces short spaghetti noodles, broken in half | 2 cups thickly sliced cooked lamb fat | 1/4 teaspoon grated orange peel | 3 tablespoons tapioca flour | 1/4 cup pappardelle pasta, broken into three pieces | 8 ounces dried rice
instructions: Place the lentils and boiling water in a large pot, and bring to the boil. Season with salt and pepper then cover and simmer until the noodles and lentils are tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 4 tablespoons apple juice ( about 1 3/4 cups ) | 4 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons grated fresh bread crumbs ( dry breadcrumbs )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and knead with hands until very well developed and smooth. Divide into 10 pieces. Pat each piece of mixture into shape into a round 10 by 1 inch. Place on parchment paper dusted baking sheet and bake in a preheated 450 f oven for 14 minutes or until light brown. Serve right away.

title: Moroccan Turnip Chips
ingredients: 1 lb turnip, peeled and sliced | kosher salt | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted
instructions: Boil water and cook turnips until tender, about 3 minutes per turn.

title: Coriander Bread

instructions: Mix the flour, coriander and baking powder together in a bowl. Knead the dough by hand 3 to 4 times. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes. Divide in half. Roll 1 ball into a 20 cm long roll, cut 2 cm. Thick fingers across. Place on a greased or nonstick baking tray, flatten a little and bake in a pre heated oven 200 c for 10 - 15 minutes, until lightly brown.

title: Copycat Mcallister's "taco Bell Style Pizza Filling
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pizza dough, depending on how much dough you like, and how deep you want, i prefer about 1 1/2 lbs | 1 teaspoon ciander seed, crushed | 1 -2 tablespoon taco seasoning mix, depending on your preferences | 2 tablespoons ground coriander ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 2 tablespoons chicken base, dissolved in or | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix, dissolved in or | 2 tablespoons chicken base, dissolved in or | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 lb extra lean ground beef or 1 lb turkey breast, browned, and finely crushed
instructions: Preparationfor dough, place 1 - 2 t. Of oil in a skillet, and put in the remaining ingredients except the meat. Brown meat.

title: Saffron Tarte Pastry
ingredients: 2 lbs pastry sheets | 2 teaspoons saffron threads, crushed | 1 lb catsup | 2 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Roll out filo dough. Prick all over with a fork. Put a heaping spoon on the bottom, with the back of a spoon. Put 1 tsp. Of the saffron inside the phyllo. Then put on one side with a teaspoon of catsup. Pinch the sides of the pastry together, on its side with your fingers. Cover and refridgerate for 30 minutes. Bake 375f degrees for 10 minutes. Brush with a little oil and bake another 5 minutes or until golden.

title: Macaroni With Tomato and Cornstarch
ingredients: 8 ounces macaroni | 1/2 cup tomato puree or 1/2 cup pure cherry tomatoes | 1/4 cup cornstarch, mixed with | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Put the macaroni in a large pot, add enough water to come up the side of the dish. Boil until tender, drain. Put the tomato puree and cornstarch paste into a small saucepan. Heat and whisk until the tomato begins to thicken. Pour over the dry macaroni. Serve warm.

title: Italian White Pizza With Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup mirin ( sweet japanese rice wine ) | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh oregano or 2 tablespoons fresh basil | 1 tablespoon minced fresh oregano or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons shaoxing wine or 2 teaspoons dry sherry | 1 teaspoon minced fresh oregano or 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon minced fresh oregano | 1 tablespoon minced fresh oregano or 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup shredded reduced-fat fontina cheese or 1/4 cup reduced-fat swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped peeled pitted unsalted cherry peppers
instructions: To make sauce, combine mirin, 1/4 cup water, 1 tablespoon fresh oregano or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano, and the wine in medium saucepan. Heat to boiling.

title: Bread Pudding a la Sharleen
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rye bread, crusts removed ( not the bread crust ) | 1/4 lb pine nuts, broken into small pieces | 2 tablespoons red chilies, drained, seeded and finely chopped ( i used dried red chile peppers ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried currants | kitchen bouquet
instructions: Grease a large shallow, oven proof dish and line the base with a thin layer of crumbs. Spread all of the chilies and pine nuts over the bread. Sprinkle the bread with the red chilies and the currants. Dissolve the kitchen bouquet in the boiling water, pour this into the dish. Cover with a sheet of waxed paper and weight it with a heavy can and the top with a dish that can move the pudding in a very slow steam. Steam for 2 hours, until tender and a pudding like consistency has formed. Pour into 4 tins, or bowls, and remove the pudding from the steamer. Serve warm.

title: Cherry Triples
ingredients: 3 cups cherries, pitted, well drained ( use pits for this ) | 2 cups polenta ( yellow cornmeal ) | 2 tablespoons triple sec | pepper, to taste
instructions: Place cherries and polenta in food processor.

title: Sweet Rosemary Blossom Tea
ingredients: 400 g rosemary leaves ( chopped fine ) | 3 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Pour 3 tbsp. Golden syrup into a tea cup and stir. Add the rosemary. Stir. Cover with tea cloth. Brew for about 30 mins until the liquid has reduced to a loose paste. Stir. Sse for 10 to 15 mins more, until it is loose and golden in color. Serve piping hot garnished with a scattering of sugar.

Random Ingredients: tart cherry,beef steak,marshmallow,chicken stock cube,baking powder
title: Beef and Cherry Fingers
ingredients: 400 g lean beef steaks | 8 fresh ready-made tart cherry | 1/4 cup chicken stock cube | 2 tablespoons baking powder | 30 g miniature marshmallows | marshmallows
instructions: Score the meat on the scores in the thickest part of a knife. Cut the cherry in half and put half in each slice. Put stock, vinegar and baking powder in a large saucepan and heat to boiling point, stirring until just combined. Pour over the meat and stir well, cover the pan and remove the lid of the pan. Simmer for about 1 hour until meat is cooked. Turn out onto a clean plate, cover and leave to rest for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, melt marshmallows and set them aside for topping up. Drain liquid off of steak and slice thinly. Spoon the meat and marshmallow mixture onto plates and top with marshmallows.

title: Herbs and Cardamom Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed herbs, chopped ( parsley, mint, chives or dill ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the herbs and cardamom together well. Using a mortar and pestle, add the spices to the herb mixture and mix well.

title: Sprits of the Fire 2007
ingredients: 16 ounces rigatoni pasta or 16 ounces penne pasta | 1 can golden syrup or ( 16 ounce ) can pineapple syrup | 1 head iceberg lettuce, rinsed and sliced
instructions: Cook your rigatoni for a 6 - 7 mins and drain. In a large bowl, mix your golden syrup and the pasta and mix. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese-Style Beef Burger
ingredients: 5 links hot dogs | 14 ounces baby portabella mushrooms, sliced, drained | 7 ounces sausages | 1/4 cup shaoxing wine | 1/4 cup frozen raspberries, thawed | 4 kaiser rolls, split
instructions: Prick sausages at the stem end with a fork, and reserve for another use. Rinse and dry mushrooms, trim the ends if necessary, and set aside. In a small bowl, combine the shaoxing wine and raspberry rinds. Cut a slit through each sausage link. Open. Fill the sausages with mushrooms, a few mushrooms at a time, and place on the sausages. Marinate at least 2 hours, but no more than 3 hours. Preheat a heavy skillet or griddle over high heat for about 2 minutes. Place the sasages on the skewers and cook until the tops are crusty and they are just a little crispy on the outside, 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Toast the rolls briefly to serve. Grill the rolls just until they are toasted, about another 2 minutes. Spread each with some reserved mushrooms, a little bit of the raspberry raspberry rind syrup, and some of the sausages. Serve with the toasted rolls.

title: Tastik Burger Sauce I
ingredients: 1/2 lb minced meatball | 1 ounce of fresh shiitake mushrooms | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1/2 cup lightly toasted breadcrumbs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, cover and freeze until firm.

title: Lard and Sage Cookies
ingredients: 1 lb palm sugar or 1 lb brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage or 1/2 teaspoon sage powder
instructions: Preheat your oven on 300 degrees celsius. If you have a candy thermometer, it will take about 150 minutes to reach 350 degrees. Add palm sugar to a bowl and rub into sugar with electric mixer. Add toasting ingredients and knead with hands until dough is firm enough to roll out. Roll out on a floured board, about 1/2 inch thick, to desired thickness. Cut into 1 inch rounds with cookie cutter, place on a baking sheet and bake in your oven for 20 minutes or until light brown. Allow to cool completely before filling your own cookies/spices.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,chicken bouillon,orange zest,bell pepper,red chili pepper flake,purpose flour
title: Fried Spicy Chicken
ingredients: 4 teaspoons all-purpose flour or 4 teaspoons cornstarch | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1 teaspoon orange zest ( grated ) | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes ( crushed or crushed depending on your taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1/2 medium bell pepper ( sliced, red or orange, i prefer red )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add chicken and garlic mixture and saute 5 minutes or until browned. Serve immediately or store in freezer. Can also be made in the oven for a terrific and satisfying meal.

title: Nana's Irish Hard-Boiled Eggs (Láinhas Avarones)
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1/4 cup sweet vermouth | 1/4 cup irish cream ( baileys )
instructions: Peel eggs and cut in half lenghtwise. Remove yolks and finely chop. Place in bowl with vermouth and baileys. Stir to mix. Add more vermouth if necessary to mix so yolks and egg don't break apart until fully blended. Let stand 1 hour before serving.

title: Momma's Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 beef chuck roast | 1 can kalamata olives, chopped | ice cube
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a deep freezer bag and freeze for at least 1 hour. Shake bag occasionally during the colder part of the cooking. To serve, reheat the roast in a 300 degree oven for 5 to 10 minutes, depending on the size of the roast. Serve hot.

title: Sauza
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs boneless ham, cut in 1-inch cubes | 4 cans beer ( a mexican is best ) | 1/2 cup rice wine, to taste
instructions: Arrange the ham in the bottom of a crock or enameled iron roasting pan large enough to fit the ham in a 1 1/2 quart oven. Pour the beer over the ham, making sure the beer goes all the way over the ham. Set the crock or roasting pan into a large roaster with a lid. Place the lid on the roaster and place it in a 400°f oven for 1 hour. After 1 hour turn the ham out of the pan, remove the lid, and carefully pour the beer into the pan juices. Return the ham to the oven for 30 minutes, basting every 20 minutes. The gravy will thicken. Stir in the rice wine. Serve warm.

title: Sesame Noodles
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame seeds, or to taste | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 package japanese egg noodles | 1 egg noodles, or as needed
instructions: Place sesame seeds in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir, shaking the skillet until sesame seeds begin to pop, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,oyster sauce,asian sesame oil,tahini,celery,cauliflower floret,peanut butter
title: Easy Chinese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 10 chicken wings, tips removed | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1/2 cup light soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons asian ( toasted ) sesame oil | 1 cup cauliflower floret, cut into bite size pieces | 1/4 cup chopped celery
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the chicken wings on baking sheet. In a bowl, mix peanut butter, tahini, soy sauce, sesame oil and remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: avocado,chicken stock cube,chicken breast,coconut cream,basil leaf,green chili pepper,zucchini
title: Thai Fish Soup
ingredients: 1 ounce dried basil leaves | 1 teaspoon green chile pepper | 1 medium chicken breast, cut into small chunks | 1 tablespoon reduced salt chicken stock cube | 4 ounces mixed fish, cubed | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 1 grated zucchini
instructions: Wash the dried basil leaves, chop coarsely and put in the stock. Add the chiles and set aside, covered, for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the remaining ingredients together in a medium saucepan. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Add the fish and basil, stir. Serve immediately.

title: Lager Beer
ingredients: 2 gallons of premium beer | 1 1/2 pints beer, chilled ( corona and pacific are good choices )
instructions: Mix the cardamom pods with the beer in a tall glass and stir to loosen the sediment. Stir well to loosen the sediment, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,cauliflower floret,hot italian sausage,spanish onion,vanilla bean,yellow bell pepper
title: Spanish Cauliflower with Sausage
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion ( about 4-5 ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, roughly chopped | 2 1/2 lbs cauliflower florets | 2 -3 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 1 large hot italian sausage, coarsely grated | 2 tablespoons vanilla beans
instructions: Chop onion and pepper into 1 inch pieces and toss with cinnimon seeds or grated pumpkin seeds. Add sausages and 2 tbsp water. Cover and simmer on low for 45 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally. Remove lid and cook for 15 - 10 minutes longer. Remove the sausage and set aside. Remove casing from cauliflower, cutting off the stems into pieces. Add cauliflower and spices to sausage and cook another 15 - 20 minutes covered. Remove cinnamon and serve.

title: Eggplant Vietnamese Style
ingredients: 1 eggplant | fish stock | 2 ounces firm tofu, drained | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup black beans, drained
instructions: Cut eggplant in half, then slice lengthwise into 1/8 slices. Place on plate in microwave. Cook eggplant and tofu 30 seconds each, or until lightly browned. Toss eggplant into a large bowl with fish stock. Let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a grill pan over medium high heat. Add eggs to eggplant and gently stir. Reduce heat to medium and cook 2 minutes or until egg whites are almost set. Turn eggplant over and cook 1 - 2 minutes longer, or until eggplant is slightly tender. Transfer eggplant mixture into a large serving bowl. Fold in tofu and white wine vinegar to tofu and eggplant. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,white onion,graham cracker pie crust,salad dressing,water chestnut,thyme,cranberry
title: Cranberry and Walnut Dip
ingredients: 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 container mayonnaise | 1 small white onion, chopped | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 package refrigerated graham cracker pie crust | 3 tablespoons salad dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the water chestnuts, mayonnaise, onion, cranberries, and thyme. Spread the mixture in the graham cracker pie crust. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f, and continue to bake 10 minutes. Serve warm with salad.

title: Homemade Flour Tortilla Receipe# 2 With a Bottle opener
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine the flour, half and half, salt and pepper in another bowl and mix well. The batter should be a bit thicker than the normal pancake batter consistency. Heat a small frying pan. Oil should be hot enough that a piece of pancake dropped into a drop of water placed slightly below the top of the pancake should sizzle quickly. Spray a paper towel with cooking spray or put a paper towel in a bowl. Use a funnel to pour the flour into the skillet and swirl around the bottom until the bottom is light brown about 1 minute on each side. Keep an eye on the pancake, as the tortilla might splatter. Slide the tortilla out of the skillet onto a warm plate covered with a large plate. Use another plate to keep the pancake steady. You can also cut it in chunks with kitchen shears if you like. Using a slotted spoon, slide the pancake from the floured plate onto the paper towel. Use the same scraper to gently scrape up the batter. You don't need to be careful, as the tortilla will have absorbed the batter. It should look like very moist, but don't worry. Slide the tortilla back into the bowl with the oil. Keep the tortilla covered and using that same scraper to scrape up the batter, you can work in one minute. Cut the tortilla into smaller wedges, like you would a tortilla. Serve hot.

title: Tomato Pesto Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon brown sugar, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped walnuts for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Blend the basil pesto, rotel tomatoes, creme fraiche, parsley, brown sugar, and walnuts in a food processor until smooth.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,kluski noodle,curry paste,maraschino cherry juice,beef stock,eggplant,thyme,artichoke heart
title: Bridies II
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground beef | 1 jar maraschino cherry juice, or more as needed | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 eggplant, diced | 1 can marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon curry paste, more to taste if desired | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1 package kluski noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook the ground beef in a large skillet over medium heat until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain fat. Spread pepper sauce in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the beef, cherry juice, picante sauce, eggplant, artichoke hearts, curry paste, and beef stock in a large saucepan over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,sun tomato,chunky salsa,duck,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Duck & Chunky Mexican Dip
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground chuck | 1 can button mushrooms ( drained ) | 1 jar chunky salsa | 6 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 1 cup sun-dried tomato, oil packed
instructions: Brown ground meat in skillet, crumbling as necessary. Drain off excess fat. Stir in mushrooms & salsa. Spoon into serving dish & top with cream cheese.

Random Ingredients: onion,salad dressing,taco shell,vegetable stock,steak,tomato,portobello mushroom cap
title: Flank Steak Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 lb flank steak, shaved | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 cup diced tomatoes | 1 portobello mushroom caps, sliced | 1/2 cup vegetables stock | 1/3 cup light salad dressing | 1 package taco shells, warmed
instructions: Cook steak and onions in vegetable or olive oil over medium heat about 5 minutes per side until cooked, but still pink. Remove from heat. Stir tomatoes, mushroom caps, and stock into steak mixture. Cover and let stand 20 minutes. Stir salad dressing into steak mixture. Spoon mixture onto taco shells.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,chicken bouillon cube,garlic salt,red bell pepper,cumin seed,gluten baking powder,egg noodle,pie shell
title: Easy Low-Fat Thai Red Curry Noodles With Crockpot Instructions
ingredients: 1 package gluten free baking powder, package | 1 teaspoon dried garlic salt | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste ( i used contadina's ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( i used knorr brand ) | 1 cup uncooked medium zucchini ( about 4 medium zucchini- about 3 medium zucchini ), finely chopped | 1/2 red bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 package refrigerated egg noodles, cooked and drained, per instructions on package | gluten-free baking powder | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray your crockpot with nonstick cooking spray. Combine egg noodles, salt and garlic salt. Mix together the 2 baking powder ingredients, add cumin seeds. Dump noodles into crockpot. Add red bell pepper, sautee gently, 5 minutes, until slightly tender. Add noodles and sautee for an additional 5 minutes. Turn crock pot to high, and pour in the egg noodles. If the broth doesn't reach the level of the noodles and the chicken bouillon add a little bit of water and whisk. If the noodles are drying out, add some more stock or water. Stir to combine. After about 5 minutes, turn heat down to low, and cover. Cook for 4 hours, stirring every 15 or 20 minutes. After 45 minutes, remove lid, and stir. If you are using a crockpot, set on high about 1/2 hour to thicken broth. Stir occasionally and adjust to ensure that the broth is not boiling over. To ensure that you don't get burnt at the end of the cooking process, turn heat down to low, cover and continue to cook at least 15 - 30 more minutes.. After 5 more minutes, stir in the egg noodles and stir again. Let sit 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,graham cracker crumb,yellow potato,pear,dijon mustard,half,thyme leave
title: Pear Potato & Pear Stir Fry
ingredients: 8 large ripe yellow potatoes, peeled and cut crosswise into 1/8-in. slices and slices should be about 1/4-in. diameter | 1 pear, peeled, cored, and cut crosswise into 1/8-in. slices | 1 medium pears or 1 medium pear, cored, cut crosswise into 1/8-in. slices ( 1 small ) | 1/4 cup grated fresh parmesan romano cheese | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme leave | crushed red pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons half-and-half, or as needed
instructions: Place potato slices in a lrg, shallow baking dish. Arrange pear slices over the potatoes, making sure each will have equal sized slices. Cover with foil and bake at 400°f for 25 - 30 minutes. Turn slices after 20 minutes, and bake 5 - 10 minutes more, until potatoes are tender & golden. Remove and set aside, uncovered, while preparing the pears, place pears in a medium hot frying pan with the 1/4 cup of grated cheese. Stir over medium heat, stirring constantly to prevent sticking, until cheese melts. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook just until heated through. Transfer to a platter and let cool at least 5 minutes, then serve over top of the potatoes with the pears & pears.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,swiss cheese,ra el hanout spice mix,buttermilk
title: Swiss Cheese Filling
ingredients: 1 container frozen buttermilk | 1 package shredded swiss cheese ( i like a combo of sharp and monterey jack ) | 1/4 teaspoon butter flavored extract | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: In a medium pot on medium heat, simmer buttermilk with shredded swiss cheese and butter flavored extract until soft but not boiling. Remove from heat and stir in chriss cheese. Use a pastry brush to spread mixture over the top of the cheese mixture. Let cool about 10 minutes. Once completely cooled, stir in other ingredients. Refrigerate over night or until completely cold before using the filling.

Random Ingredients: sherry,onion,seasoning salt,sage leaf,tomato soup,angel hair pasta
title: Angel Hair Pasta With Onions
ingredients: 2 onions, cut into thin half moons | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 3/4 cup dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 4 -6 dried sage leaves ( optional ) | 1 package angel hair pasta or ( 8 ounce ) package tube-shaped spaghetti
instructions: Heat large nonstick skillet. Add onions. Cover and cook for 4 - 5 minutes over medium heat until light golden brown. Uncover and stir. Add tomato soup, sherry and seasoning salt. Bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Serve hot with onion and soup.

title: Easy Salmon Chilie
ingredients: 2 cans salmon | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 can diced chilies
instructions: Empty all cans of soup and salmon into a crock pot or dutch oven until almost full. Turn on low and let everything simmer for 2 - 3 hours. Serve over white rice.

title: Empanadillas (Eggs)
ingredients: 12 eggs | 1 cup salad oil | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Hard boil the eggs, peel and remove yolks carefully with a slotted spoon. Add cornstarch to the egg whites and beat well until thick and creamy. Add 2 tbs water if the mixture is too dry. Pour egg mixture into frying pan and cook over medium heat for about 20 to 25 minutes until it starts to brown. When it is golden, turn onto serving plate and serve.

title: Homemade Sourdough Crackers
ingredients: 3 cups cake flour | 2 cups white vinegar
instructions: Mix flour and vinegar. Dough should be stiff. With floured hands, press mixture gently into 12 square greased or parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Make into rounds with floured fingers and prick well with a fork. Cover with a baking cloth and let stand for 1 hour. On a lightly floured surface, roll out dough into a square about 8 in diameter. Cut into 4 or 5 slices. Place one slice flat on a lightly greased cookie sheet and brush with vinegar. Repeat with remaining pastry and cookie sheet and oiled. Bake at 350° f for 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,broth,ziti pasta,italian herb,grain white rice,kidney bean
title: Italian Ziti & Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 box ziti pasta | 4 cups broth | 1 can kidney beans, with liquid | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs | grated monterey jack cheese | 1 cup instant long-grain white rice
instructions: Cook ziti in boiling water with salt for 8 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, heat broth over high heat. Stir in beans, seasonings, & rice. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to simmer, cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until ziti is cooked. Ladle into wide soup or soup bowls, & serve with grated cheese.

title: Pineapple Bean Salad with Sage Dressing
ingredients: cooking spray | 6 cups fresh pineapple - peeled, cored, and chopped | 1 box canned great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage, or to taste
instructions: Spray a 10x15 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Stir pineapple, great northern beans, mayonnaise, white wine, and sage together in the prepared baking dish. Cover the fruit with the prepared dressing.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,beef stock,chili pepper flake,kaffir lime leaf
title: Steamed Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters beef stock | 1 1/2 liters vegetable stock ( to cook, preferably vacuum packed ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dried chili pepper flakes | 1 kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Add all the ingredients into a pan and bring to the boil, covered, stirring, for 10 - 15 mins or until slightly thickened.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,vegetable,sun tomato oil,farfalle pasta,cashew,taco seasoning
title: Mexican Pasta With Fassoulia #5FIX
ingredients: 1 box fassoulia fuselle pasta | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 package sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 bag mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. In a large bowl, combine beans, sun dried tomatoes, and taco seasoning. Stir in vegetables. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add fassoulia & pasta & cook for 5 - 10 minutes or until al dente. Add additional seasoning as desired.

title: Cheese Filled Onions
ingredients: 4 medium emmenthaler cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup frozen corn oil, from a jar of roasted sweet peppers or 1/4 cup regular corn oil | 1/4 cup shredded basil leaves, packed | 2 teaspoons ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a large mixing bowl combine cheese, oil, basil and ice. Mix until well combined. Place the onion mixture, stirring, on a piece of baking parchment paper large enough to contain the onions in a 1 1/2 to 2 quart baking dish. Serve at once.

title: Persian Radishes With Vegetables in Oil
ingredients: radishes | nuoc nam ( vietnamese herb salt for radish ) | turmeric powder
instructions: Wash the radishes and peel them, then cut them into rings. Heat up the oil until its smoking hot enough to fry the radishes. Place the radishes in the oil and cover. After 15 to 20 minutes, flip the radishes.

title: Phyllo and Mustard Baklava (British Version)
ingredients: 1 box phyllo pastry | 1/4 cup dry mustard ( can be bought from some grocery stores, they do it nicely )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees and spray a 9x13 inch pan with spray, or use a non stick spray if not using a 9x13 inch pan. Open and remove sheets of phyllo and stack a few at a time until they have been used up. Do not stack them, as they tear later when removed from the stack. Line a 12 x 9 inch pan with a dampened cloth and spread about 1/4 cup of mustard on the inside of the phyllo sheets. Lay the phyllo sheets in a single layer in the pan. Take 4 sheets and lay them on their side, then spray with a little dry mustard for the tops. Layer 5 sheets of phyllo on the phyllo, spraying each and every phyllo sheet individually with your favorite spread the remaining mustard on top. You might have to dust the top with a little more mustard, depending on the amount of dry mustard. Repeat, layering the phyllo sheets until all have been used, making sure they are brushed with the mustard. Top with the remaining 5 sheets of phyllo, spraying them with the mustard. Bake for 25 minutes. Watch the baklava carefully, as it may burn at the top of the pan. Turn off the oven, open the door and allow the door to cool. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Hot-and-Sour Radish Sprouts
ingredients: 2 bags shredded radish sprouts | 1/3 cup red wine or 1/3 cup beer ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grated fresh lemon or 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Toss all ingredients in a large serving bowl. Serve hot.

title: Mace Butter
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Beat the butter until it is light and fluffy. Mix in the remaining dry ingredients. Chill in the refrigerator.

title: Ww 3 Points - Wild Rice With Roasted Parsley & navel Orange Peel
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato ( such as french fries or small red potatoes ) | 1 large navel orange, peeled, halved and juiced | 1/2 small poblano pepper, roasted, seeded, membranes removed, and cut into strips | 1 1/2 tablespoons wild rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275°. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly oil the baking sheet. Cook the potatoes in a large pot of boiling water until just tender, 2 to 4 minutes.

title: Nana's White Beans with Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds navy beans | 1 small red bell pepper, cut into long strips
instructions: Place navy beans and red bell pepper into a large container with a lid. Cover and shake until beans are coated in a thin layer of steam. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the soaked beans.

title: Homemade Mallow or Corned Fowl
ingredients: 1 cup malt vinegar | 1 cup poppy seeds
instructions: Bring the vinegar to a boil, then lower the temperature and simmer for about 10 minutes until the vinegar is reduced to 1/2 cup. Stir in the poppy seeds. Stuff the flousters with them and store at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,lime juice,mexican rice,kosher salt,bacon bit,almond paste,rice noodle,tahini
title: Mock Rice Noodle Salad in Lime-Baked Shells
ingredients: 1 package dry rice noodles | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 6 slices bacon bits | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice ( about 1/3 of a lime squeezed ) | 1 tablespoon almond paste or 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Soak rice noodles in boiling water for 20 minutes, or until just tender. Drain thoroughly and spread out on a plate. Combine the garlic powder and salt with the noodles in a small bowl and set aside. Place the bacon bits on a baking sheet to dry out and lightly brown. Cut into thin slivers across the bacon strips. In a large bowl or serving plate, whisk together the tahini, vinegar, and the lime juice. Pour evenly over the noodles and mix thoroughly. Set aside until ready to serve. Dry fried garlic slivers can be added to the mixture of vinegar dressing, if so desired. Serve hot, not chilled.

Random Ingredients: cheese,mango chutney,garlic salt,chicken stock,heavy whipping cream,oregano,juniper berry,hamburger
title: Smoked Mangy Mango Chutney Beef Burger
ingredients: 750 g ground burger | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 3/4 cups tasty cheese, shredded ( such as kraft ) | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon chopped garlic salt | 2 slices dried hamburger | 2 tablespoons oregano | 1 teaspoon juniper berries | 3 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Combine the chilli burger ingredients together in a large bowl. Shape the mixture into 8 burgers, about 5 cm thick and 1/2 cm deep. Seal the burger well with a slice of dried hamburger. Sprinkle with oregano, then roll in the whipped cream to coat well. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Heat the barbecue or bbq to high. Cook the burgers for about 4 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking.

title: Tunisian Molasses-Somali
ingredients: 1 english muffin, split in half crosswise and toasted | 2 thin green cardamom pods | 2 pods green cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons molasses ( or honey, or other flavored sugar )
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add cardamom pods and green cardamom pods to pan. Cook, moving the pods around a bit, until cardamom pods darken to a beautiful golden color, about 5 minutes. Remove cardamom pods from pan using a wide spatula and transfer to plate. Preheat broiler and place split halves into skillet. Lightly toast the tops of the split halves. Drizzle molasses or honey into pan so that they stick. Place half of the toasted english muffin halves on baking sheet and lightly toast under the broiler until the tops are light brown and cracked. Remove from the broiler. Place the remaining split halves and lightly sprinkle tops of whole split halves with a few grinds of black pepper. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cream,cream mushroom soup,apricot jam,italian sausage link
title: Italian Apricot Saususages
ingredients: 20 -25 italian sausages ( hot, sweet, or sweet ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 4 tablespoons sour cream | 1/4 cup apricot jam or 1/4 cup jelly
instructions: Heat grill. When heated, add sausage, cook turning once until brown on both sides. Mix soup, sour cream and apricot jam until blended well. Remove sausage from grill and place on a platter. Sprinkle with the top of the sausages. Spoon the soup mixture over the sausages and serve.

title: Spicy Baked Turkey Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb 93 % lean ground turkey | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 2 teaspoons chopped onions
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f combine turkey, baking powder, and onions. Spread mixture on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake at 425°f for 20 minutes, move the bird on to the baking sheet and continue baking till cooked through, about 20 minutes longer. Serve warm from a warm place.

title: Chevy's Favorite Margaritas
ingredients: 7 ounces tequila | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Put everything in a blender.

title: Spiced Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup tomato sauce | 1 1/2 cups bacon, diced | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Place the tomato sauce, bacon, jalepeno pepper, allspice, and paprika into a pot. Cook over medium heat until heated through. Bring to a boil.

title: Pesto Olives
ingredients: 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/3 cup pitted green olives
instructions: Remove top layer from olives. Slice the olive into four pieces, add to a blender. Add the sun dried tomatoes. Blend all ingredients together until mixture has consistency of mayonnaise. Add additional seasoning if more sauce is desired.

title: Broiled Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs | 2 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut chicken thighs into 1/4 inch cubes with a cleaver or other heavy knife. Thread the chicken thighs onto a broiler proof bamboo or soaked wooden skewer. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat, turning once, 15 to 20 minutes, or until cooked through, turning once halfway through cooking. While still hot slice bread into 1/2 inch slabs with slits all over. Serve with kebabs.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,chicken thigh fillet,yellow food coloring,mozzarella cheese,chive,ice water
title: Quick Chicken and Vegetable Calzone
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken thigh fillets | ice water | 1 zucchini, finely grated | 1/2 cup fresh chives, chopped | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, grated | red food coloring, to tint | 4 tablespoons champagne or 4 tablespoons boiling water
instructions: Put the chicken through a meat grinder or food processor to get rid of any excess fat and gristle, or put through a food processor to make a paste. Put a good size non stick frying pan under a low heat. Add a thin film of oil to allow the oil to set. Add the zucchini, chives and a little seasoning to the oil. If using fresh herbs, just put them through a food chopper, if used. Cook for a couple of minutes until they are softened. If using fresh herbs, just add to the pan at this stage, if using dried herbs, just stir them through. If using a blender, do the same. Add the marinated chicken to the pan, and cook over a low heat for several minutes, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon. Add a few drops of food colouring, according to your taste, to give the mixture a rich, vivid colour. If using a mortar and pestle, be careful with the colour. To do this, stir in 3 tablespoons of water, or enough to produce a slightly thick paste. Taste and add a pinch of red food coloring. Serve immediately with crusty french bread, crackers, or a green vegetable on the side.

title: Homemade Saffron
ingredients: 8 fresh saffron | salt | seasoning | 1 cup ground pork hock
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, pound saffron with seasoning, then rub in the ham hock. Pack into small plastic bags and refrigerate for 12 hours or overnight before using. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove air pockets from bags. Place bags in a roasting pan. Arrange the saffron on top of the saffron. Roast the saffron for 1 and 1/2 hours, or until the internal temperature is 160 degrees f or internal temperature is 165 degrees f and the saffron has a deep golden brown color.

Random Ingredients: lime,cooking oil,red radish,chicken broth,honey,garlic powder,red pepper sauce,bamboo shoot
title: Grilled Thai Radishes
ingredients: 3 red radishes, sliced thin | 1 can bamboo shoots ( drained ) | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 2 limes | 1/3 cup cooking oil | 2 teaspoons honey | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Marinate the radishes and bamboo shoots by combining the chicken broth, limes, honey, hot pepper sauce, lime juice, garlic powder and cooking oil. Set aside. Heat grill to high. Grill radish mixture for about 5 minutes per side. Turn and brush with marinade. Grill for another 5 minutes, brushing once more with remaining marinade.

Random Ingredients: amarula cream liqueur,fruit,scotch bonnet pepper,artichoke heart,flat leaf parsley
title: Creamy African Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 scotch bonnet peppers or 1/2 habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup amarula cream liqueur | 1/2 cup mixed fresh fruit, chopped ( pears, mango, apples, applesauce, sweet potatoes, okra )
instructions: Place artichoke hearts, parsley and chile in processor and blend until very coarsely chopped. Add remaining ingredients and process until smooth. Salt and pepper to taste. Keeps, refrigerated, in a covered glass container at room temperature 2 to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,pork tenderloin,lime,grainy mustard,white bread,dark brown sugar,worcestershire sauce
title: Grilled Pork Tenderloin With Crunchy Bread Crumb Topping
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 1 1/2 wide slices | 1 cup long grainy mustard | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon lime rind, grated | 1 1/4 cups crispy white bread, cubes, 1/2 day old | 2 cups broccoli, flowerets and tops, trimmed
instructions: Spread meat flat in shallow dish or pie plate. In medium bowl, mix together mustard, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, lime rind and half of the bread cubes. Evenly spread on meat. Place broccoli on top. Pour remaining mustard mixture over broccoli. Cover and chill. Prepare grill. Turning as needed so as meat cooks evenly. Cover and heat as directed above. When meat just starts to turn crispy on the outside, set timer for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,chicken stock vegetable,grand marnier,cauliflower,farfalle pasta,lemon
title: Buca Di Beppo Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 5 ounces broad broad farfalle pasta | 3 quarts chicken stock or 3 quarts vegetable stock | 1 lemon, cut into wedges | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup shredded fresh lemon rind
instructions: Fill a large pot with water or low sodium chicken stock.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive oil,dark soy sauce,currant,ramen noodle,half cream,milk
title: Scrambled Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces ramen noodles ( thin slices ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon currants | 1/3 cup spanish olive oil | 2 tablespoons skim milk
instructions: Saute rice noodles in olive oil for 2 minutes or until translucent.

title: Pasta & Bean Free
ingredients: 200 g dried linguine | 300 g baked beans | 3 tablespoons vanilla | 1 tablespoon self raising flour | 1 tablespoon walnut halves | 250 g baked beans | 3 tablespoons walnut halves, extra | banana slices and jam or vanilla sauce if desired
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Drain pasta & place back in saucepan, add baked beans & sugar, mix well. Remove from heat & allow to cool. Add vanilla & flour & mix thoroughly. Drain cooked pasta & bean paste from liquid & set aside. Stir in nuts & warm through. Transfer to serving dish & decorate with extra banana slices & jam or sauce.

Random Ingredients: clove,chile powder,malt vinegar,italian sausage,coriander seed,baking powder,onion salt,purpose flour
title: Grandma's Sausages (With Fiery Chili Vinegar)
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausages | 2 cups all purpose flour | 3 tablespoons chile powder | 2 tablespoons whole coriander seeds | 1/3 cup onion salt | 1/2 cup honey or 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºf. In large mixing bowl, thoroughly combine all ingredients. With clean hands, pat crumbly mixture on non stick griddle, or into large sausages. Place on greased foil. Bake for 10 minutes on lower rack. Turn over and bake for another 10 minutes. Allow to cool slightly, then split open and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,plum sauce,oregano,active yeast,corn flake,black olive,jalapeno pepper,vanilla essence
title: Pizza Bread
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1 cup crushed corn flakes, slightly heaping | 1 cup crushed cornflake | 1 cup crushed plum sauce | 1 can sliced black olives | 1 cup crushed cooked jalapeno pepper ( from a jar ) | 1 tablespoon oregano
instructions: In a small saucepan/pot, combine all the dry ingredients and warm to soften. Set aside to cool to lukewarm. Now add all the ingredients and mix well to combine. Transfer to a lightly greased loaf pan. Bake at 350f for 45 to 50 minutes, or until golden brown on top. Serve hot for warming pizzas or appetizers. Note, the recipe says to remove pan from oven after 30 to 35 minutes, but if you leave in for longer than 15 mins, then the middle of the bread will be hard.

title: Chipotle Tomato Salad
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes ( about 3 and 1/2 pounds total ) | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo
instructions: Cut each tomato in half crosswise and scrape out and discard the tomato pulp. Place them cut side up on a baking sheet. Sprinkle the edges with salt and let stand until soft and slightly darkened, about 20 minutes. When cool, coarsely chop the pulp and transfer it to a food processor and process until smooth. Add the mayonnaise and process until creamy, about 10 seconds more. Garnish with the chipotle and chopped tomato to serve.

Random Ingredients: rice,chicken stock cube,balsamic vinegar,chunky salsa,beef chuck,oil
title: Salsa Crusted Steak With Balsamic Rice
ingredients: 1 lb trimmed beef chuck, lean | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons good quality chunky salsa ( we use my salsa fresca ) | 20 ounces microwavable rice or 20 ounces cooked rice | 2 tablespoons oil | 4 tablespoons chicken stock cubes
instructions: In a large saute pan heat 1 tblsp oil on low heat, add meat and sear about 20 - 25 minutes depending on desired doneness. Remove meat and set aside reserving drippings. Add remaining oil over medium high, add rice, stir to coat and heat about 3 - 4 minutes or until golden brown. Dissolve chicken stock cube in 1/2 cup of water. Add to rice and stir to combine. Bring to boil, cover and reduce heat to simmer. Cook about 25 - 35 mins or until rice is almost cooked. Check after about 10 mins of cooking and add any juices, stir and serve alongside crumbled beef.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,chunky peanut butter,french haricot vert
title: French Bread With Peanuts
ingredients: 1 package dried french haricots vert | 1 packet onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter
instructions: Rinse and dry the french haricots vert. Place them in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and reserve the cooking water. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir together the onion soup mix and peanut butter. Set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place the dried french haricots verts in the boiling water, and cook until tender, about 8 minutes. Drain, then place in a 9x5x3 inch loaf pan. Spread each with the onion soup mix. Bake in the preheated oven until warmed through and beginning to crisp, about 30 minutes.

title: Nutty Ricotta Nests
ingredients: 1 pint ricotta cheese | 8 ounces roasted hazelnuts, chopped | 1 onion, medium-sized, chopped | 1 box corn chips | 1 box spaghetti ( or pasta of your choice ) | 1/4 cup kitchen bouquet ( or equivalent powdered instant granules ) or 1/4 cup other raw sugar | 1 pinch cayenne | 2 tablespoons vanilla
instructions: In food processor blend nuts and onions, process till they resemble bread crumbs, add seasonings, blend again till you have small pea sized pea size pea sized pea size pea size pea sized pea size pea size pea sized pieces of ricotta, refrigerate till ready to use. Cook broken spaghetti as directed, drain and place in large serving bowl and cover with cold water till ready to serve. After spaghetti is softened place a few pieces of spaghetti in bowl, cover with warm water, add nut mixture. Mix till mixed well and sprinkle with sugar, stir well till sugar has dissolved. Add vanilla. Serve at once or set aside. Variation, add a pinch of cayenne pepper to your taste.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,olive,cremini mushroom,pecorino cheese,tomato ketchup,walnut oil,mustard seed
title: Quick Calami (Japanese Stir-Fried Mushrooms and Rice)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 pound fresh cremini mushrooms, sliced | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 cup jasmine rice | 1/2 cup heinz tomato ketchup
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 tablespoon walnut oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Toss in the mustard seeds and fry until they begin to pop. Stir in the mushrooms and sun dried tomatoes and continue cooking about 3 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender. Remove to a plate. Continue cooking about 1 minute until all of the oil has been absorbed and mixture is heated through. In a separate skillet heat 1 tablespoon olive oil. Cook the rice according to package instructions, omitting oil. Drain the water released by the mushrooms and sun dried tomatoes. Transfer the cooked rice to the skillet and mix in the tomato ketchup. Continue cooking over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,squid ring,pineapple chunk,baking soda,wheat flour,arrowroot,water,graham cracker crumb
title: Quick Key Wat Easy Seafood Jumble-Spoon
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup water | 1 teaspoon arrowroot ( optional ) | 1 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste or 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour ( more or less for you ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda or 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 cup thawed crabmeat ( canned crabmeat is okay ) or 1 cup canned chunk-style tidbits, drained ( canned crabmeat is okay )
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs with water. Stir in arrowroot or garlic if using, or ginger and garlic paste, if using. Add canned pineapple and pineapple chunks, and mash together. Stir in whole wheat flour, baking soda or salt. Spoon into a lightly buttered square pan.. Bake at 350f degrees f for 15 minutes or until edges are lightly glazed. Serve warm with whipped cream, yogurt or cream.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,rice vinegar,couscous,serrano pepper,chinese five spice powder,pace picante sauce,cabbage,duck
title: Chinese Couscous Salad (Dinner for 2)
ingredients: 4 ounces cooked medium duck, sliced or 3/4 ounce lean ground beef | 1 1/2 cups cabbage, shredded | 1 serrano pepper, seeded, deveined and sliced ( from a jar ) | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons spanish hot picante sauce | 2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 package ladyfingers, sliced ( two 7.5 ounce packages for a complete meal ) | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 1/4 teaspoons five-spice powder
instructions: Cook meat mixture in a pan until browned, set aside. In a small bowl, mix together the first six ingredients. Spoon meat mixture over cabbage.

title: Bread Salad With Strawberries
ingredients: 12 slices bread, 1 inch thick | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh lemon peel | 2 cans whole strawberries, drained with juice left in ( approx 3 cups )
instructions: Cut out and discard crusts from bread and place in a large bowl. Toss with parsley, turmeric, lemon peel, and strawberries to cover evenly. Serve warm, at room temperature or chilled.

title: Italian Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chili oil | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | butter lettuce or lettuce roll
instructions: Combine the chili oil and cheese and spoon over the lettuce or roll the cheese. If using lettuce roll, steam them in the microwave, or put them in a sandwich press and grill them on top. They should be slightly crunchy on the outside, but tender inside. Remove the cheese and serve.

title: Somerset Chicken Wings
ingredients: 500 g chicken wings, cut into thirds | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 1 ounce garlic-infused olive oil | 1 tablespoon chicken wing fat, cut into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f arrange wings on a oven tray, skin side down. Brush with oil. Using a sharp knife slash the joints to separate the strands of wing membrane from the meaty joints. Add to the oven and roast for 45 minutes. Turn over and roast for 45 minutes or until cooked through. Turn on wings and sprinkle with sultanas and garlic infused olive oil. Serve with steamed couscous, veg or fruit.

title: Moroccan Oranges
ingredients: 2 lbs assorted long oranges or 2 lbs yellow and black oranges | 1/4 lb nuts ( optional )
instructions: Cut up the peel and the oranges and use a large bowl to weigh or cut them and remove the membrane. Put the orange peel into a large bowl and cover with the cold water. The water should cover the peel completely. Then, with a teaspoon and a half, pour in the water in a thin stream. Repeat a few times, but do not let the water boil. Remove the peel and orange from the water with a slotted spoon, and place into cold water. Drain and pat dry. Sprinkle on the nuts. Cover with plastic wrap and put in the fridge to set, about an hour.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,pesto sauce,black bean,mint leaf
title: Black Beans (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 cup shelled black beans | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/3 cup fresh mint leaves, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh pesto sauce
instructions: Rinse beans and place them in a bowl. Toss with 3/4 cup of water until thoroughly coated.

title: Yogurt-Marinated Wings
ingredients: 12 whole chicken wings | 6 cups plain yogurt ( whole or fat free ) | 1/3 cup white vinegar
instructions: If serving the night before, cover the wings in a plastic bag and place in the refrigerator. Remove air as needed and place in a preheated 250f oven. Turn and baste with the vinegar regularly. Cook until almost tender, approximately 1 hour 15 minutes. Add all of the yogurt and allow to cool to room temperature. Place wings in a large serving bowl and pour yogurt on top. Serve on a bed of chikki, lettuce leaves, french bread slices or crackers.

title: Bacon Wrapped Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 large-chopped fresh tomatoes in the palm of your hand | 1 cup hickory bacon
instructions: Place bacon on a cutting board and flatten with a rolling pin to an 1/4 inch square. Arrange a tomatoes in a small baking dish, leaving 1/2 inch of bacon fat in the pan. Place pan over medium heat and bring to a simmer, then cook until the bacon is beginning to caramelize, about 2 minutes. Remove pancake from tomatoes and discard bacon fat. Spread bacon on a cutting board and cut into 4 squares. Arrange a portion of the bacon around each tomato and roll up, securing with toothpicks or kitchen twine if desired. Place rolled tomatoes in the skillet and pour enough tomato juice over them to cover completely. Simmer for 5 minutes, then reduce heat to medium low and allow to cook gently for 25 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cream,msg,heavy whipping cream,self raising flour,stew beef chunk
title: Smothered Stove Beef :)
ingredients: 2 lbs stew beef chunks | 2 fluid ounces cream | 3 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 2 ounces self raising flour | 1 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 deg f/180 deg celsius. Cut meat into thin strips/flour pieces, roll them in the flour mixed with the msg. In a very hot grease baking dish roast meat on both sides for about 45 minutes. Serve with a tomato sauce, potato dumplings and sauce. Pour over cooked rice or noodles, top with sliced boiled potatoes, celery sticks, sausages, green beans, etc. For a vegetarian option omit the meat. For vegetarian use milk and eggs.

title: Wild Mushroom and Ham Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs wild mushrooms, cleaned | 1 lb of ham diced | 1 cup yogurt, plain or vanilla | 1 teaspoon rum flavoring | 1 cup cilantro leaf, fresh and finely minced | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Remove stems, chop or chop mushrooms and ham up into bite size pieces. Add to a large salad bowl. Top with yogurt, rum flavoring and cilantro and toss lightly.

title: Tamarind Cucumber Gimlet
ingredients: 2 medium cucumbers | 1 tablespoon pure wesson tamarind juice ( or 100ml of tamarind liquid ifn't available ) | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste ( or 1-2 tbsp. dried kerna )
instructions: Cut cucumbers in half and peel. Cut pulp into very small cubes. Heat 1 tablespoons of oil in medium sized saucepan and add tamarind liquid. Stir and let simmer for 10 minutes. Add vanilla and chipotle and stir. Add cucumber and tamarind and continue to simmer for a short time. Add whiskey and puree. Simmer for a few minutes. Serve warm over ice and keep refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,chuck roast,ginger garlic paste,tomato soup,radish
title: Smothered Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs chuck roast, cut into 3/4 inch strips | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup radish, sliced
instructions: Cover beef with water and bring back to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 3 1/2 hours or till meat is very tender. Remove meat and cool slightly. Shred meat. Strain liquid and reserve. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine the remaining ingredients and place into a 3l caserole dish. Place meat back in the oven. Heat through, about 20 minutes. Slather a little of this over sandwiches. Enjoy.

title: Lamb Stuffed With Dorito
ingredients: 1 package dried tri-colored doritos, crushed | 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb | 1 can chopped anchovy paste | 1 cup pasta sauce | 1 container sour cream or 1 cup greek yogurt | ice water ( for sealing the balls )
instructions: Note, you want to prepare the doritos at least 3 times in order to minimize prep. In a large skillet, over medium heat, brown minced lamb. Remove from heat. Drain any excess fat. In a large bowl, add the chopped anchovy paste, pasta sauce and sour cream. Dredge the ground lamb, drained tri colored doritos into the sour cream mix. Place them in a glass baking dish. Pour 1 inch of water into the pan to reach halfway up the side of the doritos. Place the pan on top of the stove over medium low heat.
