Heat until doritos have turned a deep orange or a little caramelized in color about 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat and remove top of doritos. With kitchen shears and a sharp knife carefully remove most of the soft dough from the inside of the bread and set aside. Carefully pull the soft dough out of the bread, leaving a small shell about 1/2 inch thick on the underside, scoop stuffing into the shell and put back into the bread. Place on a cookie sheet covered with foil. Repeat steps 7 - 9 three more times. Cook at 400 degrees for 20 minutes remove foil and bake about another 20 minutes or until the bread is completely dry and the doritos are warmed thoroughly. Serve with some sour cream on the side.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,wheat flour,white sugar,rosemary,head garlic,chicken broth,russet potato,steak
title: Shrimp and Garlic Soup
ingredients: 2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 small head garlic, chopped | 12 ounces uncooked medium shrimp - peeled, deveined, and tails removed | 10 cups chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 6 pounds flank steak, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, or as needed | 20 leaves fresh rosemary, divided
instructions: Place potatoes, head garlic, shrimp, chicken broth, rosemary, sugar, and flank steak cubes in a large pot and bring to a simmer. Cook until meat is tender, about 30 minutes. Remove meat with a slotted spoon and set aside. Strain the soup, pressing potatoes through the potatoes with your fingers. Return the shimp to the soup and bring to a boil again. Continue boiling until soup thickens, about 4 hours. Reserve 2 quarts of soup. To serve, ladle soup into serving bowls and garnish with fresh sprigs of rosemary.

title: Kathy's Pork, Ranch & Artichoke Wedges
ingredients: 2 lbs lean cooked pork, cut into 1-inch thick pieces | 1/2 cup ranch dressing mix ( i used hidden valley original ranch dressing mix ) | diced seeded artichoke heart | 2 -3 radish, chopped, with | 1 small amount of chopped or salted raw vegetables, of your choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place a small amount of oil into a 9x13 baking dish. Dredge pork wedges in oil. Place in baking dish. Sprinkle with salad dressing mix and desired amount of remaining salad dressing mix. Bake until heated through and bubbly about 35 - 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green onion,vegetable juice,radish,garlic salt,mirin,dijon mustard,plum tomato
title: Gazpacho
ingredients: 2 plum tomatoes, chopped | 4 green onions, sliced | 2 teaspoons minced garlic salt | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 1/2 lbs radishes, sliced | 3 tablespoons mirin ( rice wine ) | 1/3 cup vin santo or 1/3 cup sugar | 2 cans v8 vegetable juice cocktail, chilled
instructions: In blender combine tomatoes, green onions and garlic salt. Blend until smooth. In saucepan combine mustard, radish, mirin and worcestershire sauce. Heat until hot. Pour hot liquid into blender. Cover tightly and process on high for 3 - 4 minutes until smooth. Serve hot or chilled.

title: Bourbon Ham, Orange Peel and Parsley Hollandaise
ingredients: 4 slices fresh orange peel | 1 hard-cooked egg yolk | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon bourbon or 1 tablespoon whiskey | fresh parsley leaves, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Arrange 2 slices of the orange peel on each plate. Place the hard boiled egg yolk in a small bowl. Crush the egg yolk with a fork, and toss with the hoisin, bourbon or lime juice. Pour equal amounts of the yolk and the liquid over the egg yolk mixture. Garnish with a sprinkling of freshly chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,chive,red currant jelly,paprika,red chile,adobo sauce,plain yogurt,chunky salsa
title: Chunky Onion Pork Roll-Ups
ingredients: 8 ounces pork loin, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 cans red currant jelly | 2/3 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1/2 teaspoon smoked spanish paprika | 1/2 teaspoon minced chipotle chile | 1/2 teaspoon adobo sauce | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: Drain pork on paper towels. Place jelly, salsa, salsa, paprika, chile in a resealable plastic bag. Shake well. Place pork in a large ziploc bag. Pour jelly on top. Refrigerate pork overnight, turning several times. Preheat oven to 400°. Unwrap meat and refrigerate. Turn oven off. In a small bowl, combine yogurt and 2/3 cup water. Cover tightly and refrigerate until needed. Transfer contents of refrigerator, pork, and salsa mixture to a rimmed baking sheet. Cut meat rolls in half lengthwise and place in oven. Bake pork rolls 45 minutes at 400° or until pork is cooked through. Slice meat and serve with salsa mixture and warm onions slices.

title: Grilled Pork Loin
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds pork loin | 4 lime zest, grated
instructions: Score the pork fat and place into a nonporous, glass, or ceramic bowl with a cover. Pour the lime zest into a small bowl. Wash the bowl, and rub the pork fat into the pork. Cover, and refrigerate for 6 to 8 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium low heat. Lightly oil the grate. Spray with cooking spray. Remove the pork, and place on the preheated grill. Cook for 20 minutes, turning once, or until an instant read thermometer inserted into the center reaches 160 degrees f. Cut into slices, and serve with lime zest on the side.

Random Ingredients: mint,spanish onion,ginger,golden mushroom soup,mascarpone cheese,canola oil,hazelnut liqueur
title: Easy Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 medium spanish onion, sliced ( i use a small-medium onion ) | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup or ( 14 ounce ) can reduced-sodium golden mushroom soup | 1 container mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup hazelnut flavored liqueur ( like tia maria ) | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger ( or more, to taste ) | 1/4 cup toasted hazelnuts ( or chopped, toasted, toasted, or chopped )
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,anise seed,white flour,extra tofu,coconut milk,yukon gold potato,sirloin
title: Potato Beef Curry (Khao Phad Kho)
ingredients: 1 pound extra firm tofu, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 12 yukon gold potatoes, sliced into rounds | sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 2 cans unsweetened coconut milk | 1/4 cup white flour
instructions: Place the tofu in a medium saucepan, pour in enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, until the liquid has fully dried. Drain off any excess water, then mix in the potatoes, and set aside. Spray a nonstick skillet with nonstick spray, and set over high heat. When the oil shimmers, scatter the anise seeds around the pan. When they begin to pop, scatter the sirloin strips over it. When the sirloin begins to sizzle, sprinkle the aniseed and ancho powders over the beef. Toss to combine and cook until the beef is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Add the coconut milk and stir until the beef is well coated with coconut sauce. Place the flour in a shallow bowl or plate and spoon about 2 tablespoons of curry in, mixing until the mixture is well incorporated and doesn't clump. Place the beef and potato mixture in the skillet and stir to combine. Cover with a lid, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the potatoes are fork tender and the curry becomes thick, about 10 minutes.

title: Asian Eggplant & Smoked Venison  Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb lean smoked venison roast | 4 japanese eggplants or 4 regular eggplants | 2 cups strong white flour | 2 tablespoons black tea, steamed ( or chinese black tea ) | 1/2 cup radish, thinly sliced
instructions: On a cutting board, slice meat into thin strips approx 1/4' wide by 2'' long and 1/4'' thick. Roll them, on the same side, in flour. Cut the eggplant into 1/4 wide by 2'' slices. Roll them on the flat plate to get a grip of flour.

title: Beer and Yogurt Pitas
ingredients: 12 whole wheat pita bread | 1 1/2 cups nonfat sour cream or 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1 1/2 cups light beer ( or any dark beer ) | seasoning
instructions: Heat pitas under broiler until heated through. Spread one side of each pita with sour cream or yogurt. Spoon 2 tablespoonful of beer onto one side of each pita. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle with additional seasonings if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Crusty Rice Crispies
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 cup rice flour | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly spray a 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Stir rice flour and italian seasoning together in a bowl. Set aside. Press plastic wrap onto the top of the rice flour mixture. Cut a 2 inch slit in the side of mixture to vent steam. Roll into desired shapes using rice flour. Place in the prepared baking dish, and pat into a 7 inch circle around the rim. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

title: Chilli Sausages With Prosciutto (Italian Breakfast Item)
ingredients: 6 ounces prosciutto, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup sweet chili paste ( see note ) | 4 teaspoons fine semolina | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Line rimmed baking sheet with foil. Arrange prosciutto strips in a single layer on foil. Sprinkle chili paste over strips.

title: Roestevona (Stir Fried Squash)
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash | 1 can chopped mild green chilies
instructions: Peel squash and cut in half lengthwise, then in wedges. Scoop out the seeds. Combine with other ingredients and simmer on low until squash is tender, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: bacon bit,pine nut,asiago cheese,bisquick baking mix,mint leaf,red chili
title: Spicy Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups original bisquick baking mix | 4 tablespoons bacon bits | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1 mint leaf | 1/2 cup asiago cheese ( small grated variety ) | 1 -2 red chili, finely chopped
instructions: Mix the ingredients together thoroughly. Roll into golf ball sized balls. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the oven, until golden brown on the outside.

title: Cheesy Savoury Spareribs
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat | 8 cups natural yoghurt | parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 lb pork ribs
instructions: Marinate the spareribs in the yoghurt for 3 hours in the refrigerator, then grill. When ready to serve, cut ribs into serving sizes. Place spareribs on serving platter, cover with sauce, garnish with parmesan cheese.

title: Easy Apple Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 5 cups apple juice at the bottom of each can
instructions: In 3 to 4 qt soup pot combine soup, apple juice and enough water to cover the soup. Bring to boil, reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Crunchy Peanut Butter and Sour Cream Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and whisk until blended.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,pepper,mexican oregano,red wine vinegar,rib eye steak,ham,black olive
title: Grilled Beef Rib Eye Steak With Puerto Rican Panacotta Ajo
ingredients: 1 rib eye steak, about 1 pound | 1/3 lb italian sausage, removed from casing | 1/4 lb ham, cut into 1/4 cubes | 1/4 cup black olives, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | pepper, to taste
instructions: Sprinkle italian sausage on the rack of the grill. Grill meat over high direct heat 15 - 20 minutes, turning and rearranging meat as necessary, until cooked through. While the meat is grilling, combine the remaining ingredients and let cool to room temperature.

title: Kalamata Olive Toast
ingredients: 4 kalamata olives | 4 slices gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat griddle pan. Spread a little bit of olive oil on griddle pan. Place one kalamata olive in hand and squeeze a handful of gruyere cheese onto the olive. Grill the bread until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve hot immediately.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,chocolate hershey syrup,cucumber,italian seasoning,half cream
title: Creamy Italian Dressing for Cucumbers, Beef, & Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup light chocolate hershey syrup | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons crushed sherry ( rice wine vinegar ) or 2 tablespoons rice vermicelli flakes
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender, and puree into a smooth liquid. Refrigerate for at least one hour before using, or up to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: green chile,teriyaki sauce,dark brown sugar,cake flour,fennel seed
title: Taste of Home Indian Spiced Baked Barbecue Style Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon finely minced green chile | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 1/2 cups cake flour, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray 2 baking sheets with cooking spray. In a large bowl, stir together the sugar, fennel seeds, green chile, teriyaki sauce, and cake flour. Add the chopped green chile and mix well. Spoon some of the barbecue batter at a time onto the baking sheets, spacing them about 3 inches apart. Using the back of the spoon or a meat mallet, pound the bars to flatten the tops. Place on the prepared baking sheets, top with the remaining marinade, and close the top with a fork. Bake for 25 minutes, or until the tops are browned.

title: Noodleless Root Beer Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 5 cups chicken stock | 3/4 cup root beer | 12 ounces canned pumpkin-filled straws ( drained weight ) | 2 small yellow squash, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 3/4 cup mini marshmallows | tamari
instructions: Cook broth and pumpkin in 4 qt dutch oven over medium heat until boiling. Reduce heat to medium low and add beer, squash and marshmallows and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Add cornstarch and simmer until mixture thickens slightly, stirring frequently, about 3 minutes. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.

title: Sausage & Shiitake Mushrooms (Sausages With Puff Paste & Raisins)
ingredients: 1/2 kg boneless pork sausage | 50 g fresh shiitake mushrooms | 200 g bean sprouts | 150 g raw peanuts | 150 g raisins | 100 g lemon rind ( zest ) | 100 g yoghurt or 100 g sour cream | 150 g lard or 150 g oil
instructions: In a food processor put together the pork sausages, mushrooms, beansprouts, peanuts, raisins & zest. Pulse several times till it becomes a homogenous paste. Heat the oil and fry the sausages until browned on both sides. Take it out and put it on a plate. Add the sauce to the sauce and simmer till the sauce has the same thickness. Pour the sauce over the sausages and mushrooms and then serve.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,biscuit mix,avocado,chicken bouillon,green curry paste,wonton wrapper,tamari,whipping cream
title: Green Curry Chicken Won Tons
ingredients: 1 container refrigerated biscuit mix | 2/3 cup whipping cream | 3 tablespoons tamari | 2 teaspoons green curry paste | 1 teaspoon minced dried orange peel | 5 ounces cooked chicken or 5 ounces turkey, chopped | 2 tablespoons minced green curry paste | 2 teaspoons finely shredded orange peel | 20 wonton wrappers | 1 pinch vegetable oil or other cooking spray
instructions: Cook the biscuit mix according to package directions. Stir in the cream and tamari and mix thoroughly. Set aside. Spoon about 1 heaping teaspoon of the biscuit mixture into each wonton wrapper. Brush the center of a wonton wrapper with vegetable oil or spray with cooking spray and fold in half. Seal the edges with the tines of a fork. Bake at 350 degrees for 13 - 14 minutes or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Baked Flounder
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloins, 1-inch thick | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 3 pounds flounder fillets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place the pork tenderloins into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with marjoram. Cover each tenderloin fillet with just enough marinade to cover. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 1 1/2 hours, or until tender and flaky on the top.

title: Lima and Garlic Crock Pot
ingredients: 3/4 cup fresh lima beans ( or frozen ) | 3 medium boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 4 tablespoons instant yeast | 1 teaspoon garlic powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Place whole chicken breasts in the slow cooker. Mix remaining ingredients in a bowl to blend. Pour mixture in and over chicken. Cover the slow cooker, and set to low. Cook for 8 hours, or overnight.

title: Ajiaco (Dried Green Sauce)
ingredients: 2 dried red chilies | 1 ounce salami | 1 ounce brown sugar | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 3 tablespoons red chilies | 5 -6 apples, peeled, cored and chopped
instructions: Soak chilies in boiling water to soften just a few seconds, then place in blender or food processor with the salami and brown sugar. Blend or process until smooth. Place in an airtight container and serve with chopped apples to be eaten cold with.

title: Champagne Verrine
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh green grapes, washed | 4 lbs small parsnips ( about 2 1/2 lbs ) | 24 -24 ounces fresh button mushrooms
instructions: Rinse and drain the grapes. Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil and drop in the parsnips. Cook just until tender but still firm. Cut the grapes in half and set aside. Remove the peel from the mushrooms, cut out the stems, and slice the caps into 1/4 inch slices. Drain the grapes and parsnips and place in a large saucepan with enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil over moderate heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Add the mushrooms, cover, and remove from the heat. Let stand, covered, for 15 minutes. Drain thoroughly. Stir in the grapes, parsnips, and mushrooms to serve.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,breadcrumb,butter,pine nut,extra virgin olive oil,corn oil,chipotle chile adobo,canola oil
title: Pine Nut Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped pine nuts | 1/4 cup canola oil or 1/4 cup olive oil | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 2 teaspoons butter, cut in 1/4-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 - 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place nuts, oil, chiles and mustard in a skillet. Cook over medium heat 1 minute. Stir in oil/butter. Cook, stirring constantly, 1 - 2 minutes, scraping sides of skillet. Add remaining oil. Stir until butter melts and mixture is smooth. Pour over nuts. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 400° for 5 minutes. Stir before serving. Drizzle with mustard while warm.

Random Ingredients: bouillon granule,enchilada sauce,turnip,cooking spray,grain rice,red chile pepper,bow tie pasta,poblano chile
title: Mexicali Vegetable Rice-Au-Lentil
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package bow tie pasta | 1/2 cup uncooked long grain rice | 1 tablespoon bouillon granules | 1 can enchilada sauce | 8 poblano chiles | 1 small red chile pepper | 2 cups shredded rotisserie-cooked turnips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,beef sirloin,gruyere cheese,leek,nam pla,velveeta cheese,extra virgin olive oil
title: Grilled Beef Cubes With Gruyere Cheese and Lemons
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into cubes | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 leeks, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 12 ounces velveeta cheese, cubed | 8 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 12 ounces vermicelli or 12 ounces other long thin noodles | 1 tablespoon nam pla
instructions: Combine the beef with the olive oil and stir in the leeks.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,vegetable broth,tea,cottage cheese,bitter,cheese ravioli,chicken bouillon granule,tilapia fillet
title: Cottage Cheese & Smoked Fish Ravioli
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets ( or other light firm white fish ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 cup breadcrumbs ( i prefer white breadcrumb ) | 2 cans cottage cheese | 1 package frozen cheese ravioli | 1/3 cup tea ( earl gray recommended )
instructions: Place tilapia fillets on a plate and sprinkle with salt. Place broth and garlic powder in a blender and puree until smooth. Place bread crumbs in separate shallow bowl. Dip each tilapia fillet into bread crumbs, then coat with bread crumbs on both sides. Fry in a pan until fish is golden brown. Place tilapia on paper towels to drain the excess fat. To build each ravioli, place a piece of the vienna dough onto a flat sheet pan and top with 2 tbs of cottage cheese. Place another sheet of plastic wrap on top and press the ends together lightly to seal in the steam. Place the ravioli on top, put a fish slice on top and bake at 400 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes or until shrimp are no longer opaque.

title: Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/8 cup rice wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Wash and dry the chicken. Insert a skewer or skewer in the cavity. Add the vinegar and rice wine vinegar and gently massage the mixture into the chicken until well coated. Arrange the chicken in a baking pan skin side down. Roast the chicken in the oven for about 2 hours or until well browned and a meat thermometer inserted into the thigh registers 160 200f at the joint joint. Remove the chicken and place on a platter. Continue cooking the chicken until it is fork tender, about 45 minutes longer.

title: Hainan's Easy Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb caesar style pasta | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 2/3 cup sauerkraut, drained well | 1/4 cup peanuts
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water for about 6 - 8 minutes or until desired tenderness, drain and rinse under cold water and drain. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl. Toss with hot cooked pasta and top with chopped peanuts.

Random Ingredients: sauce,rotel tomato,kosher salt black pepper,bean sprout
title: Simple Mexican Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 bag frozen mixed beans sprouts | 1 package saucy hot sauce | 2 cans rotel tomatoes | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat the bag of mixed beans sprouts in medium saucepan over medium heat for approximately 5 - 7 minutes or until the green sprouts become tender. While the beans sprouts are coming to a boil put the hot sauce and rotel in a large bowl and toss with the contents of one can of rotel. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add the green sprouts and toss again. Serve over your favorite meal.

title: Frozen Broccoli
ingredients: 4 cups frozen broccoli florets, thawed | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons salsa ( choose your favorite style )
instructions: Pour pineapple juice in a plastic bag. Add broccoli to bag, seal and shake to coat evenly. Place in freezer for 15 minutes. Remove from freezer and transfer to a plastic container. Add salsa to bag. Coat the broccoli with salsa and shake well to coat evenly. Place on baking sheet and freeze. Cook according to package instructions. Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Filling (Jungle Meat Paste)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon finely grated orange rind | 1/2 lb fresh peas ( no need to thaw first )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together, adding a little water if necessary.

title: Roasted Peppers and Cheese
ingredients: 2 large yellow flat sweet peppers or 2 large poblano peppers | 2 eggs | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Cut peppers in half lengthwise. Arrange peppers in a lightly oiled broiler pan. In a small bowl blend eggs, cheese and pepper halves. Spoon mixture evenly over the peppers. Broil peppers in 400°f oven for about 12 minutes or until eggs are just set on top. Be careful not to over cook. Turn peppers frequently and broil 3 to 5 minutes longer, or until lightly browned. Serve warm or at room temperature on italian bread.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,anise seed,extra beef,pistachio,baby portabella mushroom
title: Pistachio Mushroom Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1/4 cup pistachios or 1/4 cup almonds, toasted | 2 ounces baby portabella mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 2 extra-lean ground beef
instructions: Preheat overn to 180 deg celsius. Grease a loaf pan, line and bake for 40 minutes. Toast pistachios for 5 mins or until golden brown. In bowl mix pistachios with mushrooms, flour and anise seeds. Take to baking paper lined loaf tin and bake for another 45 mins or until cooked. Cut into slices when cool or refrigerate for up 5 days. Slice and serve with melted fat free cheese if desired.

title: Linguine Linguine with Bacon, Cabbage, and Limes
ingredients: 3/4 cup bacon bits | 1 head savoy cabbage, thinly sliced | 2 bunches iceberg lettuce | iceberg lettuce | lime, cut into wedges | 1 package linguine | 1 cup sour laughing cow light liqueur or 1 cup regular laughing cow light
instructions: Heat the bacon bits in a skillet over medium heat just until they begin to bubble. Remove the bacon bits from the skillet, saving any drippings. Add the savoy cabbage and bollie lettuce to the bacon drippings.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,cider vinegar,red pepper flake,ponzu sauce,brandy,chili sauce
title: Ponzu Marinade for Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1/4 cup ponzu sauce | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup plain cider vinegar | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 dash crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 splash ponzu sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and whisk to combine. Place your chicken fillets in a shallow dish and pour the marinade over top. Add additional ponzu for flavor, if desired. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or over night, turning the fillets occasionally. You may bake the cooked fillets in a pan, brushing them with any leftover marinade before grilling, but we never do this. Grill on high heat for 10 minutes, then turn and grill for an additional 5 minutes, or until cooked through and medium rare.

Random Ingredients: string bean,garam masala,stock cube,granny smith apple,hoisin sauce,greek yogurt,bread flour,black eyed pea
title: Baby Kay Beans in the World
ingredients: 1 bunch string bean | 1/2 bunch garam masala | 1 granny smith apple | 1 garlic | 1 tablespoon ground black-eyed peas ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh grated hoisin sauce | 1 stock cube | 1 liter frenchy thick fat free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup extra stock or 1/2 cup skim cooking liquid
instructions: Clean the string bean, de bone and split the skin. Boil until tender and the beans split. Slice the apple and mix with 2/3 of the garam masala and some salt. Peel and de core the garlic, slice and put in a pestle and mortar. Add the beans and remaining ingredients. Mix well and simmer for 5 minutes. Taste for seasoning and adjust if required. Transfer to your serving bowl and let rest for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve with the remaining sauce in the dish or as a side dish. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,tequila,tomatillo salsa,red bell pepper,fuji apple,ham hock,chihuahua cheese
title: Tequila-Apple Panini - Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb tomatillo salsa | 1 lb ham hock, chopped small | 1/4 lb chihuahua cheese, shredded | 1/4 lb hake, chopped small | 1/2 red bell pepper, chopped small | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/2 cup tikama curry paste
instructions: Toss all ingredients together. Place in oiled iron skillet and bake at 350 until meat is cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,dill pickle,cilantro,baby spinach,salad green,gruyere cheese,sage,margarine
title: Chicago Style Spinach and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach | 1/4 cup margarine, melted | 1 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1 cup chopped fresh dill pickles | 1 1/4 teaspoons chopped fresh sage | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | salad greens
instructions: Combine spinach, melted margarine, cheeses, cilantro, pickles and sage. Arrange in a serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate salad for 30 minutes to chill and develop flavors before serving to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,mirin,mustard,kosher salt,pimiento,pork tenderloin,black bean,mango
title: Mango Pork Salad
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons dry mustard | 2 tablespoons pimentos, chopped | 2 tablespoons green bell peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons mangoes, chopped | 1 teaspoon korean pimiento | 1/4 teaspoon black beans | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Pound tenderloin lightly to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into 2 inch strips. Combine mustard, pimento, green bell pepper, mangoes, pimiento and black beans. Toss salad with dressing.

title: Clam Chorizo Bake
ingredients: 1 lb pork belly ( or other lean fatty pork ) | 2 ounces chorizo sausage ( or other thick sausage ) | 6 ounces small broccoli, cut into small florets | 2 tablespoons clam juice or 2 tablespoons white wine | 1 ounce mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the pork belly into 2 inch chunks and place in a bowl with the chorizo, broccoli, clam juice and mozzarella cheese. Mix thoroughly until thoroughly combined. Place into an ovenproof dish and bake for about 30 minutes or until the bacon is crisp, and the veggies have started to soften and wilt. Serve at once.

title: Radish Halves and Mandel Triangles
ingredients: 1 cup radish, sliced | 2 small cakes, cut into strips
instructions: Mix the radishes and cakes together into a mound on a plate or bowl. Spread a little oil on the edge of the mound to prevent it from puffing up. Fold the radishes and cakes over the radishes and keep them in the air for an hour. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,bitter melon,romaine lettuce leaf,black olive,fire tomato,fennel bulb
title: Bitter Melon & Olive Rolls in Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 bitter melon, seedless head about 1/2-inch x 3-inch, each about 9 1/2 lbs | 1 fennel bulb, thinly sliced | 2 roma lettuce leaves | 1 can sweet whole pitted black olives, drained | 1 can good-quality fire-roasted tomatoes, sliced | 3 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line cookie sheet with foil and place melon stalk on foil. Tear off tips of fennel fronds. Place fennel bulb in a small roasting pan about 2 inches in diameter. Drizzle vegetables with olive oil.

title: Simple Snow Peas - Chinese Style
ingredients: 1 package frozen snow peas | 1 small onion, diced
instructions: In a medium sized, deep saucepan, steam the snow peas for about 6 minutes, or until they are crisp tender and bright green. Place the snow peas in a colander to drain. When cool enough to handle, cut into 2 inch lengths. Pour off any water remaining in the pan, then return the snow pea pods to the pan. Mix in the onion and season with white pepper. Cook until heated through. Serve warm.

title: Fenugreek-Pancake With a Plot Twist
ingredients: 1 kg rutabagas, peeled and grated ( about 4 cups ) | 3 tablespoons finely grated fresh fenugreek seeds ( see note ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/3 cup finely chopped flat leaf parsley ( loosely packed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Pour cream into a large ovenproof dish, and leave to bubble for 15 - 20 minutes or until it almost reaches boiling point. Add grated rutabaga, and the fenugreek seeds. Cook for another 15 minutes or until the rutabaga is just tender. Remove from oven and spoon onto a serving platter. Sprinkle with chopped flat leaf parsley.

Random Ingredients: sage,cilantro stem,brown sugar,farfalle pasta,vanilla,chocolate chip,canadian bacon,mexican cheese
title: Cheese Baked Pasta
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 cup canadian bacon, sliced | 1 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded ( sharp cheddar or monterey jack, if you can find them ) | 8 ounces canadian bacon, thick and thin cut | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/3 cup chopped cilantro stem
instructions: Drain pasta 3 minutes. Place in a deep casserole dish. Add 1/2 cup cheese, half of the bacon, half of the spices, 1/3 cup of the brown sugar and 1/3 cup of the cilantro. Repeat layers. Bake uncovered in 350 degree oven for 45 - 50 minutes, until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: currant,yellow pea,green pea,tamarind pulp,red chilies,seasoning salt,sea salt
title: Green Pea (Shallow Soup)
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow split peas ( yellow guavarins are available at indian grocery stores ) | 1/2 cup dried currants | 2 fresh red chilies | 1 teaspoon tamarind pulp | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 1/8 teaspoon coarse seasoning salt
instructions: Wash split peas and dry them. Split chiles crosswise in two and place 1 inch or less of water in a 4 quart saucepan that contains about 1 - 2 inches of water and bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to gentle simmer. Add split peas, currants, chillies, tamarind pulp, salt and white salt. Cover and cook gently, stirring occasionally, about 15 minutes or until peas are very soft, but not mushy. Remove from heat. Cover tightly and store in refrigerator until ready to use. Variation, substitute dried red chiles for the red chilli and cook half as much. Add 1 tsp fresh ground black pepper or salt for texture. Variation, cook half as much split peas and half as is needed to get a somewhat mild soup.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,hazelnut,kalamata olive,rye bread,white wine vinegar,chicken drumstick,cardamom seed
title: Roast Moroccan Chicken
ingredients: 1 kg chicken drumsticks | 250 g kalamata olives | 150 g roasted hazelnuts | 100 g raw rye bread | 200 g sweet white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Dry fry the bread, and then remove the bread from over, allowing it to cool. Dry roast the nuts, toast in a dry frying pan, stirring. Add the roasted hazelnuts, and when they are roasted add the bread, spices, vinegar and raisins.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,pine nut,no boil lasagna noodle,clove,onion soup mix
title: Pine Nuts Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice ( about 10 oz. ) | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375°. Prepare lasagna noodles as directed on package. Drain well and run under warm water. Melt shortning. Combine with soup and cloves and pour over noodles, toss well. Arrange in greased casserole dish. Bake 25 - 30 minutes, until bubbly.

title: Sesame Espresso Soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup sesame seeds oil | 1/3 cup brewed espresso | 3 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over high heat. When warm to the touch but not smoking, pour in espresso and simmer, stirring, until reduced by half, about 2 minutes. Pour in 2 cups of the hot soup broth, stir to combine, and warm thoroughly. When the soup is hot but not boiling, transfer it to a blender, fill with 1/2 cup of the remaining coffee and puree. Return to the soup and serve.

title: Crispy Boursin Sliders
ingredients: 2 packages coleslaw mix | 3/4 cup pork fat, minced | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 2 tablespoons minced spring onions | 1 pound sliced prosciutto | 1 package shredded kasseri cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil to keep oven from getting hot. Drain cabbage mix well with pork fat, triple sec, and spring onions. Fill buns with meat mixture. Top with cheese. Place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: dark chili powder,white pepper,pomegranate juice,wine vinegar,adobo seasoning,pasta
title: Easy Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces pasta | 1 teaspoon pure chile powder | 4 teaspoons pomegranate juice | 3 teaspoon vinegar | 2 teaspoons dry white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: Boil pasta in lightly salted water until al dente. Drain and let cool. While al dente, combine all remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Toss pasta with sauce. Mix and serve.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,cardamom seed,red onion,maple syrup,polish sausage,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Pork, Sausage, and Onion Pockets
ingredients: 8 polish sausage rolls ( about 1 1/2 inches diameter ) | 4 large red onions, cut into 6 rings | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 2 1/2 - 3 tablespoons maple syrup, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Place pork slices on nonstick baking sheet. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Bake 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,red onion,celery rib,maraschino cherry,dark brown sugar
title: Cherry Risotto
ingredients: 40 g parmi arborio rice | 3 -4 tablespoons sweet red onions, chopped | 2 celery ribs, chopped, with tops on | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 2 -3 teaspoons maraschino cherries, drained
instructions: Cook rice in a large pan of boiling water with onions and celery until soft and fluffy, about 25 - 30 minutes. Stir in sugar and half of cherry and remove from heat. The risotto can also be heated immediately in a microwave for a smoother texture and color to make it thicker if necessary. Serve immediately.

title: Orange Spice
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces italian herb blend dried cherries or 1 1/2 ounces dried cranberries, dried cherries | 2 tablespoons orange zest, freshly shaved
instructions: Wash the berries thoroughly in plenty of water and remove any stalks. Dry the zest with a paper towel and shake well to remove any sand which might have settled to the bottom. Place the berries in a clean, dry saucepan and pour in the orange zest. Heat slowly until the fruit is warm but do not boil. Note, it’s worth this point to stir and stir the fruit gently after adding the orange zest so it doesn’t stick to the bottom of the pan while you cook the rest. Serve warm, with freshly grated parmesan cheese. This recipe yields about 2 liters.

title: Marsala Wine Dressing
ingredients: 15 ounces greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons dry marsala wine | 3 teaspoons thyme | 1/4 cup wine vinegar
instructions: Place all the dressing ingredients in a jar with a lid. Cover tightly with lid and shake. Store in refrigerator. Shake again before serving.

title: English Muffin Bread
ingredients: 1 kg texturized vegetable protein ( tvp ) | 480 g american cheese | 200 g pancetta, diced | 200 g margarine | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 1 cup maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: Wash and dry yeast. Measure your tvp and put it in a large bowl and add the oil mixed with the honey. Mix it. Add your cheese, pancetta, and dry yeast. Mix it until it is completely melted and the yeast has made it. This should take around 5 minute add the cherries. Mix. Dump it inches. Let the bread rise in a warm place until it's doubled in size. Bake 20 minutes at 190°c.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,white flour,fontina cheese,cherry,arabic bread,ketchup,lime wedge,avocado
title: Grilled Cheese Flatbread
ingredients: 1 slice arabic bread | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese | 1 small ripe avocado, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 2 tablespoon sliced pitted cherry, halved | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, or to taste | 2 teaspoons lime wedges, or to taste | 2 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat. Place bread on the preheated grill, and cook for 1 minute per side for medium. Place 1/2 cup fontina cheese and avocado in a separate bowl, and mash together with a spoon. Add ketchup, cherry, cumin, and lime juice to taste.

Random Ingredients: double cream,onion powder,pork,cilantro leaf,peach,white wine vinegar,orange
title: Pork Salad
ingredients: 1 kg pork or 1 kg beef | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon orange rind, grated and chopped | 1 peach, peeled and chopped | cilantro leaf, to garnish | double cream, to top | cilantro leaf, to decorate
instructions: Cut the pork or beef into 1 inch cubes. Put all the remaining ingredients except the cream and cilantro in a bowl and stir well. Heat the mixture over a medium heat, stirring continuously for 5 minutes. Divide the mixture between 4 bowls and top with the cream and cilantro. This can also be served with fresh fruit or pineapple salsa.

title: Puff Pastry Cream (Bunuelo Seco)
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chervil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. On a lightly floured work surface roll out half the pastry to 1/4 inch thick and 1/8 inch thick. Cut out 2 circles from the pastry. Place one circle in the top of a double boiler over boiling water. Cook one minute. Remove from heat. Remove 1 circle from the pastry and repeat with remaining pastry. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of fresh coriander and 1 tablespoon of chervil over each puff pastry circle. Bake 1 to 2 minutes and check the pastry is cooked. It should puff but be golden brown in color.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,cream mushroom soup,chicken breast half,purpose flour,corn bread mix,egg
title: Mock Chicken Souffle (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cubed | 1 egg | 1/2 cup sour cream or cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, drained | 1 box corn bread mix
instructions: Combine the chicken, egg, sour cream, ginger, and flour in a medium bowl, or pie plate, and mix until evenly coated. Place 1/2 can of cream of mushroom soup in the bottom of a slow cooker. Place the chicken mixture in the slow cooker. Top with the remaining can of cream of mushroom soup. Cover. Cook on low 3 1/2 to 5 hours. For a thicker soup, stir in the cornbread mix. Serve, or refrigerate for several hours.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,snow pea,romaine lettuce,wooden skewer,white onion,almond extract
title: Coconut Almond Nuts
ingredients: 6 wooden skewers | 3 cups finely cut romaine lettuce | 1 lb snow peas, trimmed | 1 cup white onion, chopped | 1/4 cup unsalted almonds, toasted | 2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Preheat your grill. Thread the lettuce, including any green parts, onto the skewers. If time permits, brush tops with oil. Grill the skewers over high heat, turning once, until browned, about 2 to 3 minutes per side. Divide the snow peas among the skewers and top with the onion. Sprinkle with almonds. Sprinkle with almond extract, and serve hot.

title: Mint-Crusted Chestnuts
ingredients: 2 cups hot water chestnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons shaved dried mint leaves | 4 tablespoons cracked graham crackers | 1 tablespoon curacao
instructions: Place the water chestnuts, mint, graham crackers and curacao in a bowl.

title: Gluten Free Pasta
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated egg roll wraps | 1 cup farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 package dry farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta with garlic and herbs | cooking tapioca | 12 pieces bread
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

title: Saffron Vanilla Cream
ingredients: 500 g vegan margarine | 175 g mexican cheese blend, shredded ( grated ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon saffron ( ground and powdered ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar ( mixed with 1 tbsp water )
instructions: Grease an 18x28 cupcake tin. Line the base with parchment paper to make the paper thin enough to line the sides. Use a 6 teaspoon biscuit cutter to cut 9 squares from the cheese mix and place on the paper to fit the tin. Spoon over the soft cheese mix and using a sharp knife, cut out shapes at an angle of 1 cm to 2 cm making small indents and place on the cheese base. Whip the cream with the saffron and icing sugar mix until stiff peaks form. Fold in the whipped cream. Pour into the tin and bake uncovered at 180 degrees c for about 30 minutes or until the centre appears dry, the centre spring back when pressed. Cool on a wire rack and turn out. To make the icing, in a small bowl using a teaspoon, soften the margarine in a small saucepan. Remove and stir in the cheese, cream and saffron with the water until smooth. Spread on individual serving plates and set aside. Serve with a swirl of cool chocolate on top.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,arborio rice,mexican cheese,chicken cutlet,green olive,green pepper,lemongrass,egg white
title: Spanish Chicken & Cheese Rice Balls
ingredients: 500 g chicken cutlets ( or equivalent quantity of leftover stir fry chicken ) | 300 g arborio rice | 4 green olives ( pitted ) | 1/4 large green pepper ( deseeded and finely chopped ) | 2 tablespoons lemongrass ( finely chopped ) | 2 egg whites ( lightly beaten ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 4 tablespoons fresh shredded mexican cheese ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to a boil. Add the rice and cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Tibetan Beef Rolls (For the Clay Pot)
ingredients: 12 ounces stewing beef | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon whole cardamom seeds
instructions: In a large cast iron frypan, brown the meat well. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer for about an hour and a half. Do not overcook serve on a bed of green tea or rice.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper lengthwise,garlic sprout,sun tomato,flat leaf parsley
title: Spicy Sun Dried Tomato and Garlic Sprouts
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, packed in oil, drained, rinsed, and chopped | 1/4 cup roasted garlic sprouts | 2 fresh green chile peppers, halved lengthwise, stemmed, seeded, and halved lengthwise | 1/2 cup chopped flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Place sun dried tomatoes in a skillet over medium heat, and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium low heat, and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Remove from heat and stir in sprouts, green chilies, and parsley. Transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with black pepper, and serve.

title: Mint Oil
ingredients: 1/2 kg finely sliced of the finest fresh mint | cooking oil
instructions: Use a glass bowl in which the mint has risen and has been covered with a tea towel. Add the oil, a little at a time, to this. Shave off a piece of the dried mint, and leave to drip for 15 minutes. Using a glass bottle with a funnel with star nozzle, add the mint to the oil. After 10 minutes, tip in all the mint leaves. Cover with a cloth, and leave overnight. On the next day, remove the mint and discard. The oil will keep for 20 days under a wet dome. If the oil does not leave the mint in long enough, keep shaking the bottle, shaking the bottle occasionally, and re use the oil. Use in other recipes.

title: Crispy Garlic Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons chinese rice wine or 1 1/2-2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 package frozen tea bags | 1 fresh sage leaves ( optional ) or 1 dried sage ( optional )
instructions: Remove cords if using a meat mallot, trim the fat from the tenderloin and then slice 1 inch thick. Place the meat in a large, heavy skillet. Sprinkle the meat with the rice and wine. Add 12 pods of sage, if using, according to the size of the bag. Turn the meat over, reduce the heat to a medium, and cook the meat for 4 - 5 minutes on each side or until a meat thermometer reads 160f for medium rare. Allow the meat to rest for 10 minutes. Remove the sage.

title: Asparagus and Tuna Pescatore
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dashi stock ( or other stock ) | 4 tablespoons grated asiago cheese ( or parmesan cheese, asiago preferred ) | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 yellow onion, minced | 1/2 lb fresh asparagus ( or 1/2 lb frozen asparagus spears, thawed if too soft ) | 0.5 can tuna, drained
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, saute the onion and asparagus in oil just until tender crisp and starting to brown. Remove from heat and add dashi and cheese. Taste, and adjust spices as needed. Place asparagus on a serving dish and top with tuna. Serve.

title: Broccoli Salad (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed and drained or 8 cups fresh broccoli florets, cleaned and cut into bite size pieces | 1 1/2 cups light mayonnaise | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 medium sour cream or 1/2 medium plain yogurt
instructions: Place the florets in a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise and canola oil, pour over the broccoli, then toss to coat. Let cool to room temperature. Stir in the mayonnaise and sour cream, then taste and adjust seasonings to your preference. Chill for 1/2 hour to blend flavors. Serve over salad greens or use lettuce leaves for the top.

title: Chickpea Rissoles With Dijon Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared rice vinegar or 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/3 cup dijon mustard, preferably grainy variety | 2 1/2 tablespoons chickpeas, drained | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon rice flour
instructions: In mixing bowl, whisk mustard with vinegar until combined and creamy. Stir in chickpeas. Season with salt and pepper if desired.

title: Quick Pasta Fagioli
ingredients: 1 cup refrigerated shell pasta, cooked | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1 package refrigerated pizza dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In medium bowl combine the cooked pasta, anise seed, and pizza dough. Grease 9x12 inch baking dish, and press or roll the pizza mixture into the bottom and about 2/3 inch up the sides. Bake in preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the crust is lightly browned. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Fried Red Chile Strips
ingredients: 1 green chile or 1 red chili pepper | 1/2 ounce epazote, leaves picked
instructions: Finely chop the chile, and then add it to a mortar and pestle, mixing together to make a paste. Add more chile to season if desired.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,flat leaf parsley,self raising flour,yellow bell pepper
title: Focaccia Without the Sun
ingredients: 3/4 cup grated fontina cheese ( regular parmesan fontina fontina can also be used ) | 1 -2 teaspoon finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, halved, stoned and sliced
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190c/fan 170c/gas 1 put 1 tbs of the cheese into a mixing bowl with the parsley, flour and pepper and toss with your fingers to combine. Pour onto a lightly floured surface and knead lightly, drawing in the remaining flour until the dough comes together. Shape the dough into a round shape. Wrap the dough in clingfilm and place in the oven for 30 - 35 mins or until the top of the dough is golden brown and firm to the touch. Serve warm with balsamic vinaigrette.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,red chili pepper,anchovy fillet,ziti pasta,pork
title: Pork and Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 3 3/4 lb ground pork or 3 3/4 lbs lean ground beef | 2 -4 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 small red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 anchovy fillet, fillet, minced
instructions: Cook and drain ziti pasta according to package directions. Cool to warm throughly. In large skillet cook ground pork and chili until meat is browned, drain. Add vinegar and drained pasta and pork mixture to skillet. Toss gently. Note, if mixture is too wet, just add a little water or more pasta water. Garnish with chives.

title: Scottish Bangers
ingredients: 12 ounces hamburger | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons light brown sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and knead until smooth. Roll into balls on a lightly floured surface. Cook on greased buns or on a medium temperature for 5 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Blueberry Dill Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup blueberries | 1 teaspoon fresh dill, minced ( optional )
instructions: To freeze, place the blueberries in an ice cream machine and freeze until solid. After 20 minutes, add the dill into the ice cream machine, and freeze until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: tuna olive oil,sherry,pork loin roast,clam juice,red onion,asafoetida powder
title: Vindaloo
ingredients: 1/3 pound pork loin roast, cut into 3/4 -inch cubes | 1 clove garlic, crushed | 1/4 red onion, minced | 3 tablespoons shaoxing wine or 3 tablespoons sherry | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 cans minced clams with juice | 2 tablespoons tuna in olive oil
instructions: Place the pork in a slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,spring onion,kosher salt black pepper,green chilies,green capsicum,coconut
title: Mushroom Chilli

instructions: Place all ingredients except the cream in a pan and cover. Allow to steam over a gentle heat until the capsicum is just softened, taking care not to let the moisture evaporate. Remove the cover, add the cream, and simmer until just thickened. Serve immediately.

title: Beef With Creamy Barley Risotto
ingredients: 6 beef tenderloin steaks, cut 1-inch thick | 4 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 bag frozen mixed peas | 1/4 cup biscuit mix
instructions: Toast biscuit mix according to package directions. Place steaks on cookie sheet sprayed with pam. Broil or grill about 6 - 8 minutes per side for medium rare. Serve topped with peas and a dollop of sour cream.

title: Fiesta Baked Rice

instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Rinse with a clean cool water.

instructions: Place all ingredients into a large bowl. Toss well to combine. Cover and refrigerate until required. Serve chilled or at room temperature with yoghurt or sweetened whipped cream.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Slice the taro roots lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices, about 3/8 inch thick, then slice diagonally into 2 or 3 inch pieces. Arrange them in a single layer on an oiled rimmed baking sheet. Roast until brown.

instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil with the turmeric and salt. Add half the pasta and cook until al dente. When cooked drain. title: Mandarin Rice Balls

instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill several hours until serving.

title: Crispy Peppers in Tortilla Shells

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Core pepper, and discard seeds. Place pepper on a baking pan. Cook 10 minutes in the preheated oven. When peppers are tender, remove from heat, and roll up. Place cut side down onto the baking sheet. Repeat layers, and bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes.

title: Rotkohl - Spicy Red Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 6 large red cabbage | 3 cans beef bouillon ( or 4 cups water and 1 cube of beef bouillon ) | 1/4 cup ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot. Bring to a boil.

title: Loco's Boke 'em Greens
ingredients: 1 bunch bok choy, chopped | 1 package chopped bacon | 2 packages taco seasoning mix, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place bacon in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until evenly browned, about 7 minutes.

title: Pumpkin & Parsnips English Muffin Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, divided | 2 cups parsnips ( peeled and cut into thin wedges ) | 1/2 cup currants or 1/2 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1/4 teaspoon tequila | 2 english muffins, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Put 1 tbsp of mustard seed in a skillet and cook over medium heat for a minute. Quickly whisk the remaining mustard seeds, the parsnips, currants, vinegar, oil, pumpkin pie spice and tequila into the remaining mustard seeds. Spread the mixture over the muffins and bake for 12 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve warm.

title: Baked Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces angel hair pasta, or as much as desired for size | 8 ounces pancetta, very finely chopped | 1 3/4 cups apple juice | 1 tablespoon tahini ( optional ) | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: caper,poblano chile,nonfat cottage cheese,yogurt,red bell pepper,hot italian sausage
title: Mexican Sausage Stuffed Poblano Chilies
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles | 2 tablespoons nonfat cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon drained capers | 3/4 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 red bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup yogurt, plain fat free if desired
instructions: Cut slit lengthwise 1/2 inch apart from top of chile, removing seeds and stems. Carefully remove seeds, and veins, leaving no small fibers. Rinse chiles, and pierce with a knife several times with a fork to remove as much membrane as possible. Remove seeds and veins by using a knife or potato masher, and holding between your fingers, carefully scoop out flesh. In a bowl, combine cottage cheese and capers.

title: Apple and Chard Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup dry quinoa | 2 medium tart green apples | 2 tablespoons raisins | 2/3 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1/3 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Rinse quinoa under running water, tossing to remove any excess water. Set aside. Core and dice the apples and place into a bowl. Cover with boiling water. Cover immediately and allow to stand 20 minutes, then drain. Combine the quinoa and apples.

title: Hot Pepper Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried tarragon, leaves | 1 small chili pepper, chopped or 3 tablespoons red hot pepper flakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Refrigerate 1 hour until flavors develop.

title: Rhubarb, Trout  and Bean Tear Taw Fritters
ingredients: 2 bunches rhubarb ( ends trimmed ) | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 3/4 pints cannellini beans, canned | 1 1/2 cups chopped onions, yellow and purple | 1 1/2 lbs smoked trout | 8 fresh peach slices, halved | 1 cup thinly sliced shallots | 1/4 cup grated beetroot cheese or 1/4 cup grated hard boiled egg
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large bowl toss together rhubarb, onion salt & flour til mixture is thick. In another bowl mix canned beans, onions, and pineapple slices with rhubarb mixture. On a sprayed or sprayed baking sheet, lightly flatten the bottom of each bun and spread a thin layer of the bean mixture on the bottom. Arrange on top the croutons in a row and arrange the smoked trout on top, in a row down center fold up the bun top side over the trout. Carefully fold the right and left halves over the fish just to center of the bun top. Carefully roll from 1 to 1 1/2 inches of the bun and seal with a wet, tapered toothpick. Repeat to make 12 fritter shaped tails. Spray or spray lightly with non stick cooking spray and put in a shallow baking pan. Cover tightly with foil and bake about 45 minutes to an hour remove toothpick and serve. Garnish, to serve, place 3 peach halves, 1 green onion and 1/4 cup coarsely chopped beetroot onto each plate. Sprinkle with greek olives.

title: Clam Sauce
ingredients: 5 ounces chopped shallots | 1 ounce chopped tomato with juice | 2 ounces chopped clams | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint ( optional )
instructions: Place shallots and tomato in a pan with a splash of cold water and the clams. Cook over a medium heat until they open, shake pan frequently so sauce covers base evenly with fluid. Pour over the mint if using and serve immediately over toast or crackers.

title: Mexican Charred Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean ( or other red beans ) | 1 orange bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces | cooking oats
instructions: Pour ½ cup water into a large saucepan and add the beans. Bring to a boil and then cook over low heat for 45 - 60 minutes, until just tender. Drain and refrigerate overnight for best results. Rinse off the beans and allow to steam dry for at least 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a 10 non stick skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle the beans with cooking oats then add the peppers. Reduce heat to low and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the peppers are tender. Serve at once with extra cooking oats or sour cream sauce.

title: Italian Baked Pasta
ingredients: 20 ounces pasta ( your favorite ) | 1 ounce italian breadcrumbs | 1 scallion | 1/3 walnuts, chopped
instructions: Cook the pasta until not quite al dente drain. Mash the italian bread crumbs with the scallion, add and mix in the pasta and walnuts. Remove from heat, cover and set aside in a warm place for about an hour, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is cooked well. The filling may be prepared in advance and baked at this stage. Keeps several days in the fridge, covered.

title: Tomatillo-Olive Noodle Omelet
ingredients: 1 medium tomatillo, husked | 3 -4 green olives, sliced | 1/4 cup stuffed green olive, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 packages egg noodles | 2 -3 cups ice water
instructions: Using a sharp knife, score top of tomatillo and olive slices on both sides. Place in a pan of water to cover. Bring to boiling and reduce to simmer. Cook about 1 hour, or until soft. Remove 1 1/2 cups of liquid and set aside. Using the same pan, add olives and remaining liquid and heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 7 - 10 minutes, or until liquid is reduced to about 2 1/2 cups, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly, then refrigerate for one hour, or until cold. When ready to cook the egg noodles, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add noodles. Cook for 8 - 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain and immediately add cold reserved liquid and beaten egg noodles, stirring gently. Let the mixture stand for 15 minutes or until eggs set, then turn out onto a serving plate. Serve with additional olives on the side.

Random Ingredients: niter kebbeh,pasta,garbanzo bean,margarine,bell pepper,lebanese cucumber,adobo seasoning,rice paper
title: Pasta Con Queso
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped lebanese cucumber | 1/2 cup finely chopped bell pepper | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning, chopped, white | 1 lb pastas | 1/2 cup uncooked rinsed garbanzo beans | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup oil | 1/2 tablespoon uncooked niter kebbeh ( the ethiopian spice blend found in any middle eastern grocery store ) | 2/3 cup crispy rice paper, cut into 2 inch strips
instructions: Mix the lebanese cucumber, bell pepper, adobo mixture and cooked rinsed, drained garbanzos and margarine or oil together. Arrange the pastas on a large, flat platter. Spread the mixture evenly over the pasta. Cut the crispy rice paper strips into 4 inch strips. Spoon the ments of the spicy mixture onto the pasta. Place the four inch strips on top of the noodles and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,soy sauce,bulk italian sausage,lump crabmeat
title: Chinese Crab Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw bulk italian sausage | 1/4 cup fresh lump crabmeat | 1/4 cup broccoli floret | 1 tablespoon soy sauce ( or to taste )
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet or wok. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mash using a fork. Shape into patties. Grill until cooked through.

title: Spinach and Chives with Tri-Colored Spiral Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb baby spinach | 1 package tri-color spiral noodles | 1 bunch fresh chives, snipped
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Add 1 lb. Of the baby spinach and cook for 1 - 2 minutes. Drain, squeeze out most of the water and set aside. In a large pot, bring 1 inch of salted water to a boil. Add the 3 lb. Of the baby spinach, along with a dash of salt. In a 2 1/2 quart casserole, pour the tri colored spiral pasta with the water, sprinkle with salt. Cover and continue boiling until al dente, about 13 minutes. Drain and serve immediately.

title: Spiced Carrots
ingredients: 5 -6 medium carrots, peeled | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
instructions: Slice carrots lengthwise into 1/8 inch thick rounds. Place carrots on a shallow pan and sprinkle with ginger. Heat the fat in a nonstick pan, preferably non stick. Cook over a fairly high heat for 3 - 5 minutes. When the fat is solid, lower heat and cook on a slow, steady basis until the carrots just begin to brown. Toss in your choice of spices and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,bread,extra virgin olive oil,tuna,egg white,dill weed,cherry tomato,crisco
title: Tuna Meatloaf
ingredients: 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 lbs beef roast, very well drained ( or other white meat ) | 1 can tuna, drained and flaked | 2 egg whites, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh dill weed | 1/2 cup crisco | 1 can diced cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons dried cherries or 2 tablespoons dried cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease a 1 cup loaf pan, sprinkle with flour, and set aside. Heat olive oil in a saute pan on medium heat. Drain meat of excess fat and place in loaf pan. Spread tuna evenly over meat. Mix egg whites and chopped dill and sprinkle over tuna. Top with crisco, cherry tomatoes, and dried cherries. Bake uncovered about 50 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 160f and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 15 minutes, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: passion fruit,star fruit,white button mushroom,salt cod fish
title: Portuguese Style Salt Cod or Halibut With Passionfruit and Starfruit Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs salt cod fish or 3 lbs halibut fillets | 1 large pinch salt ( kosher ) | 10 -12 small portuguese green small red star fruit | 3 medium passion fruit, peeled, seedless, and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Rinse cod and pat dry. Rub with salt and place in a very large, oven proof skillet. Add 2 1/2 inches of water. Cover and braise over a very low heat for 20 minutes. Flip the fish over and braise for 10 - 15 minutes more. Turn off the oven, remove from heat and let the cod stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Using your hands, carefully remove the fish as soon as possible from the water. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the fish to a deep serving plate, leaving the brine in the pan. Using a small spoon, scoop up enough juices to cover the fish.

title: Roasted Sage and Watercress Tea Ring
ingredients: 1 ounce sultana | 1 ounce cherries tomatoes | 1 ounce softened gelatin | 4 ounces boiling watercress | 1/4 pint of strong white pepper | 6 ounces self raising flour | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Mix together all the ingredients, cover in plastic wrap, then leave for 4 hours. Pour the mixture into a greased ring tin. Bake in a moderately hot oven for 30 minutes, until the top is dry and the tester comes out clean. Turn out on to a wire rack and allow to cool before breaking into small pieces.

title: Vegetable or Apple Nachos
ingredients: 3 tart apples ( mackerel, granny smith, jonathan or piper ) | 1 can sweet corn tortillas ( jiffy ) | 1 tablespoon grated cheese ( cheddar or a mild mexican blend of your choice ) | 3 tablespoons rotini pasta ( about a 1/2 cup per tortilla, i use my own ) or 3 tablespoons spaghetti ( about a 1/2 cup per tortilla, i use my own )
instructions: Peel, core and slice the apples, depending on the size. You can leave the stems on if you like. Rinse the tortillas in a pot of luke warm water. Spread a line of tortillas on a plate. Top with a line of apples. Sprinkle with the cheese. Dot with the rotini. Put under a broiler to melt the cheese. Eat as soon as you are ready with extra toppings as mentioned above.

title: Low Fat Greatbar Cranberry Goodbar Mix

instructions: Heat cereal. Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Rye's Wontons

instructions: To make the wontons, in a small bowl, combine the cold pressed tea, cheese and 1 teaspoon cheese. Add a few drops of sherry or vinegar to taste and whisk until smooth. In a deep bowl, lightly lightly beat your work surface. Place a tablespoon of the cheese mixture and a few drops of sherry in the center, then gather the corners of the dough toward the center in one piece and roll into a ball. Repeat with the remaining wontons. Place the rolls on a parchment lined baking sheet. title: Apricot Snapper
ingredients: 4 ounces red snapper fillets ( or a red snapper fillet - cut into 2 pieces ) | 12 -20 apricots | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | fresh coriander sprig ( optional ) | 8 ounces coriander sprigs, picked | 2 -3 tablespoons apricots, juice of ( optional ) | cornflour, for coating ( optional ) or cornflour, for coating ( optional )

title: Homemade Pizza Crust

instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread dough onto a lightly floured surface. Roll dough into a 9x12 inch rectangle. Arrange bread on an aluminum baking sheet and sprinkle with italian parsley, white pepper and ground black pepper.

instructions: Cook shells according to package directions. In large bowl, combine macaroni, lobsters, lobster glaze, sherry, cumin and half of the fruit. Heat oven to 375°f. Spoon lobster mixture into the shells and top with remaining fruit.

ingredients: 1 quart buttermilk | 2 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine ( or another dry white ) | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 pinch dark sesame oil | 1 pinch ground nutmeg
instructions: In a mixing bowl or glass serving bowl, combine buttermilk, sherry, nutmeg, sesame oil and ground nutmeg. Whisk mixture together. Serve hot, not cold.

title: Vodka Pizza Dough

instructions: Mix the vodka with the dough then turn out onto greased pizza pan. Let rise in a warm place for an hour or so, then bake at 220 deg c for 10 - 15 minutes, until it is golden brown.

title: Cranberry Noodles - Rice Sticks
ingredients: 100 g fresh cranberries | 4 sheets bacon | 150 g rice sticks
instructions: Blanch the cranberries with a teaspoon of salt in boiling water for 2 mins, then plunge into cold water and drain. Slice each square of bacon crossways into 8 pieces, then fry in a frying pan until crisp, then drain on paper towels, then place in a bowl of cold water, then set aside. Cook the noodles in a pan of boiling, slated water for 8 mins until tender, then drain and transfer to a bowl. Add 2 tbsp melted butter, the cranberries and dried red pepper to the noodles and toss to combine. Serve straightaway.

Random Ingredients: ice cream,flat leaf italian parsley,grain white rice,ancho chile powder,pineapple juice

instructions: Grate radishes and add to large bowl. Mix all remaining ingredients together and add to radishes. Allow to sit at room temperature for about 6 hrs or overnight if possible. You can add any spices you like to this chili salad.

instructions: In a large nonstick frypan, brown the beef in the coriander and cardamoms. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the peppercorns, garlic and salt and pepper.
