title: Owen's Mexican Okra and Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1 package uncooked quinoa | 1 package frozen okra ( thawed ) | 12 ounces cottage cheese, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 white onions, chopped | 1/2 cup dry spaghetti
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions, adding okra during last 2 minutes of cooking.

title: Paella Wraps  (Sausages & Peppers Filled)
ingredients: 12 pinches dried pasilla peppers | 6 kaiser rolls | 1/2 lb sweet kielbasa ( or 1/2 pound of each ) | vinegar, to taste
instructions: On a clean surface, wrap each pinch of kielbasa tightly in a square of waxed paper. Spray with veggie oil or oil. Set them in a steamer over boiling water. Bring to a boil and cook for 10 minutes. Place the rolls on a cutting board and cut lengthwise in half. Pull out the meat and place on a cutting board and cut each lengthwise into 3 pieces. Sauté the kielbasa with 2 tablespoons of the vinegar. Add salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot on the roll halves or in a burrito or wrap with a few dollop of soured cream and/or a drizzle of hot caramel sauce.

title: Baby Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup vinegar | 3 packages fresh baby spinach | 1 cup button mushroom, sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the vinegar and spinach. Pour over the chopped mushrooms.

title: Toast Point -- Non-Traditional Snack Bread and Butter Pudding (Gramma's Recipe)
ingredients: 1 cup rye bread ( or a combination of rye and pumpernickel ) | 2 ounces roasted sunflower seeds | 2 tablespoons rawleighs favourite sunflower seeds
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup of rye bread or pumpernickel and 1/2 cup sunflower seeds to make a smooth dip using some of the rye bread. Place in a bowl and sprinkle with more sunflower seeds to make a more dense snack. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Serve cold with cream or ice cream.

title: Lamb With Bowties
ingredients: 4 lbs lamb, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup prepared chicken broth ( bottled or home made ) | 2 cups lager beer ( you may substitute dark beer, though i've never tried that ) | 8 ounces spiral shaped pasta, cooked | 1/2 cup chicken broth ( bottled or home made )
instructions: Spray a large non reactive lg. Skillet pan with cooking spray and heat to medium. Sprinkle 1 tbs. Of salt all over the lamb, working quickly to coat the meat evenly. Add the chicken broth. Bring to a boil. As soon as the liquid is bubbling, reduce the heat to low. Cover tightly and cook slowly for 6 hours. Add the beer, cover tightly and cook for 2 hours longer or until lamb is tender and the liquid is reduced.. Cook pasta as directed on package, drain and toss with any remaining salt. Serve lamb with noodles and the bowtie sauce, if desired.

title: Gerryfruit Smoothie
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 6 tablespoons unsweetened apple juice | 1/2 cup chilled coffee | 1/2 cup freshly squeezed pink grapefruit juice | 6 cups red-wine-iced ham, cubed | 1/2 cup radish, chopped | 1 tablespoon grated kosher salt | 2 tablespoons distilled vinegar
instructions: Place hazelnuts in oven and preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a blender or food processor, puree the hazelnuts. Pour apple juice, coffee, grapefruit juice, ham, radishes, kosher salt, and vinegar into blender. Blend briefly and pour into serving glasses.

title: Tabbouleh III
ingredients: 3 cups bulgur, cracked wheat | 3 cups fresh mint leaves | 3 cups fresh sage leaves | 6 limes, juice of | 1 1/2 cups maraschino cherries
instructions: Boil the bulgur until its just soft and watery. Stir in 1 - ½ cups of mint leaves, sage and the lime juice.

title: Napa Goat's Feet
ingredients: 1/4 cup jalapeno, chopped from a jar | 1/2 cup tahini
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cover and chill in the fridge for about 3 hours. Serve as a dipping sauce for goat's feet.

Random Ingredients: cashew,tomato soup,orange zest,nuoc nam,basil pesto,chicken bouillon granule
title: Cambodian Cashews
ingredients: 2 lbs small cashews, lightly toasted | 1/3 cup nuoc nam | 1/3 cup basil pesto | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules or 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 can tomato soup
instructions: Place cashews in a bowl or ziplock bag, cover with cold water, and soak until soft, about 30 minutes. In a mixing bowl, combine cashews, nuoc nam, pesto, orange rind, and chicken bouillon. Pour over cashews, and mix until well coated. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. Heat a skillet to medium heat, or grill pan until it begins to smoke. Pour can of tomato soup into skillet. Stir sauce, cover, and cook for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,spanish onion,lemon juice,stewing beef,shortening,canola oil,pumpkin seed
title: Spanish Potluck Beef and Pumpkin Seeds(Or Baked Dried Beef)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/3 lb stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 1/2 cups sugar pumpkin seeds, see note ( or 1 1/2 cups fresh pumpkin seeds, see note ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 3 large spanish onions, sliced lengthwise into half-moons | 2 bananas or 2 -4 tablespoons sliced hot banana peppers | 5 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons shortening | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds ( optional )
instructions: Drain meat cubes well of any fat placed in container, i normally do this step by hand but any leftover fat or liquid will work fine. Brown meat cubes in 3 tbsp oil in a dutch oven coated with cooking spray. Drain well & transfer meat to large bowl. Add sugar powder, lemon juice, onions, peppers, oil and salt to taste. Toss to coat evenly & transfer to 1 1/2 quart oval casserole or baking dish. Cover tightly & bake at 300 degrees for 2 - 3 hours. While dish is at the right temperature, place 1/4 cup reserved pumpkin seeds in food processor until smooth. Add with a little water if necessary. If using dried beef, drain well to remove water.

title: English Muffin English Style
ingredients: 1 english muffin, toasted | 2 slices pepperoni | 2 teaspoons light corn syrup
instructions: Toast the bread. Place the pepperoni and the pepperoni slices on top of toast. Spread corn syup on the bread.

title: Faux Turnips
ingredients: 4 large turnips, peeled and halved | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 pinch cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the turnips out onto the prepared baking sheet. Combine peanut butter and cardamom seeds and set aside. Brush the turnips with the peanut butter mixture. Bake until lightly browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Chipotle Sauce for Beef
ingredients: 2 chipotle chiles in adobo | 3 cups beef bouillon ( can also use beef base ) | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro
instructions: Place whole chiles into a saucepan on the center burner of high and heat just until warm. Turn the burner to medium low setting. Add the beef bouillon to the saucepan and keep stirring. As it starts to simmer, heat the beef until it is very warm. Add the chipotle chili.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,hamburger,active yeast,beef rib,shrimp,dijon mustard,lemon juice
title: P F Chang's Shrimp Burger
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemon juice | 2 packages active dry yeast | 1/2 cup chili oil ( like heinz ) | 1/2 cup honey | 12 large shrimp, cooked and shelled | 12 hamburger rolls | dijon mustard
instructions: Whisk lemons in a large bowl with a touch of olive oil in a small bowl. Sprinkle the yeast over 1/2 cup of the lemon juice, pour over lemon juice, and let sit 5 minutes. Mix 1/4 cup of the chili oil and honey in a small bowl. Stir shrimp into the other lemon mixture. Add remaining lemon juice. Let sit in a warm place until mixture is bubbly. Split each pound of hamburger rolls in half, fill with mixture, and let sit 8 minutes. Place each half on an english mat, spread with a bit of mustard, and cover with a second side of the mat. Slide them back into the sandwich, and press the bottom and the side with fingers, to flatten. Turn the top of the mat over, flip, and place the other half on top. Cut the roll in half to serve, along with the shrimp/hamburger bun.

title: Guilt-Free Veggie Slaw
ingredients: 3 leeks | 2 cups raisins | 3/4 cup lime juice | 1/2 cup sweet mango chutney | 1 teaspoon curry powder, or more to taste | 1 lemon wedge, for garnish ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped spanish style cilantro or red onion, minced ( optional )
instructions: Cut leeks into 1/4 inch slices. Place them in a bowl. Drizzle with lime juice. Allow the leeks to stand for 1 1/2 hours to macerate. Place raisins and chutney into a small bowl. Stir in the curry powder. Spoon the raisin mixture over the leeks. Sprinkle with lemon wedge. Garnish with cilantro or red onion.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,taco seasoning mix,coconut cream,rice noodle,fruit
title: Fruit Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut cream | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1 package rice noodles | 3 cups mixed dried fruit ( i prefer pineapple and mango ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar or 1/2 teaspoon lemon sugar
instructions: Prepare noodle per package directions. Drain off excess water. Cover and microwave on high for 2 to 3 minutes, or until noodles are tender. Dip each noodle into melted taco seasoning. Divide noodle between 4 serving bowls and top with mixed dried fruits. Pour coconut cream over fruit.

title: Veal or Chicken Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground veal | 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken meat
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f and prepare a shallow roasting pan by greasing it well with vegetable oil. Combine ground veal, ground chicken and seasoned salt in a bowl. With your hands, thoroughly mix. Lightly press mixture into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until browned.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,green food coloring,monterey jack cheese,prosciutto,lettuce leaf,plain yogurt
title: Low Fat Prosciutto & Garlic Salad
ingredients: 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons green food coloring ( optional ) | 4 1/2 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto | 1 celery rib, thinly sliced | 2 -3 lettuce leaves, torn into bite size pieces | 8 slices monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a bowl, stir together yogurt, green food coloring, chopped prosciutto, celery, and lettuce until lettuce is evenly coated. Place 1/4 slice of cheese on the bottom of a dinner plate.

title: Cheese and Rice Cones
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked long grain rice ( not instant ) | 3 cups shredded fontina cheese ( parmesan, romano or romano ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely crushed graham cracker crumbs ( or as needed )
instructions: In saucepan, bring 4 cups water, rice and 3/4 teaspoon salt to a boil over high heat. Cover. Reduce heat to low, and cook 20 minutes. Uncover and continue cooking until water is absorbed, about 5 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed. Turn off heat. In large bowl, combine cheese with rice and cracker crumbs. With clean hands, gently mix with rice and cracker crumbs until evenly distributed. If desired, divide cheese mixture between 8 lightly greased cookie sheets. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon sea salt over tops of cheese. Bake at 450°f for 15 minutes.

title: Green Pea and Hazelnut Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup green peas | 1 bag fresh green peas | 1/2 cup toasted hazelnuts, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Bring medium pot of water to boil and cook green peas until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Place peas in large bowl. Stir in hazelnuts, cumin and vinegar. Add peas and nuts. Season with salt and pepper. To serve, sprinkle with extra toasted hazelnuts.

title: Baked Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 225 g fontina cheese | 225 g mini chocolate chip
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line a shallow baking tray with parchment paper. With electric mixer beat the mascarpone cheese, chocolate chips and 2 tablespoons of cold water in a large bowl with an electric mixer until smooth. Scrape into a medium size mixing bowl. Press the mixture quickly into the baking tray to form a 2cm thick layer of moussey crust. Bake, in a medium, ovenproof bowl at 200c for 8 - 12 minutes until golden. Remove bowl from oven. Spread moussey cream on mousse in a circular motion to cover base and sides of bowl. Cool completely before cutting.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,great northern bean,beef chuck,sweetcorn,beef chuck roast,vegetable oil cooking spray,almond
title: Beef and Sweetcorn Stew
ingredients: 350 g beef chuck roast, in large chunks or 400 g rump roast, in 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( or spray ) | 2 tablespoons sliced almonds | 1 can great northern beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 can sweetcorn ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 chicken stock cubes ( or 1 can beef stock mixed with a cube ) | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables ( defrosted )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas put the beef into a casserole dish, add in the oil, almonds & bay leaf. Season with sea salt and freshly ground pepper. Toss everything together well and then add the beans, sweetcorn and stock cubes. Bake with the lid on for at least 1 hour, occasionally shaking the dish to encourage the liquid to bubble up & thicken. The beef should be falling apart by the time your serving. Serve with cooked crusty bread.

title: Easy Baked Fish
ingredients: 2 cans fish fillets | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Spread the fish fillets with the parmesan cheese in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover the fillets with the parmesan cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 15 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Cheese Mousse With Caramelized Cauliflower
ingredients: 500 -625 g cauliflower | 4 -6 tablespoons gruyere cheese | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Put the cauliflower to boil with just a little water and simmer gently until soft. Once cooked but firm, drain off most of the water and set aside to cool slightly. Cut the cauliflower into thin wedges using a spoon, scrape out the base and finely shred them with a teaspoon or two of sharp knife. In a bowl, mix the cheese, vanilla and a little of the cauliflower water and pour over the cheese and stir to combine. Keep the mixture in the fridge while you prepare the rest of the ingredients. To serve, place a plate of cauliflower beside you and invert with a spoon carefully pour on one third of the cheese mixture. Top with another plate of cauliflower, and then the rest of the cheese mixture and serve.

title: Luby's Fettuccine and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine, cooked al dente | 1/4 cup red cabbage, finely chopped ( about 1/2 a cabbage ) | 2 cups beef broth | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds
instructions: Put the red cabbage in a bowl with a little olive oil and toss to coat well. When almost completely wilted, add beef broth and fenugreek seeds and mix together thoroughly. Add cooked pasta and toss well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,ginger garlic paste,chutney,arrowroot,white pepper,scallion,lime wedge,vegetable oil
title: Spicy Green Gram Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs small green gram beans, washed thoroughly and trimmed | 1 tablespoon finely minced fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 6 tablespoons chutney, preferably heinz | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions | lime wedge
instructions: Wash the green beans well. Cut off ends and cut into thirds diagonally. If the stems are large, cut each half diagonally into 2 to 3 pieces. In a medium bowl, mash together the ginger, garlic paste and arrowroot. Add the white pepper and cornstarch mixture and stir until thick and smooth. Stir in the chutney, green beans, scallions and lime wedges.

title: Apricot Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dried apricots, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 3 egg yolks | 1 1/4 cups water ( may need a bit more ) | 1/2 lb fresh apricot, husks removed
instructions: Soak apricots in hot water for 20 minutes, then drain. Strain apricots through a damp cloth and pat dry with paper towels. Heat ginger in a medium saucepan over medium high heat until fragrant, then add marinated apricots. Increase heat and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, about 15 - 20 minutes. Whisk egg yolks and water together and add to apricot mixture, stirring well to blend. Reduce heat to low and cook 1 - 2 minutes or until slightly thickened. If too thin for your liking, use a whisk or a spoon. If too thick, add some water a little at a time. Remove from heat and set aside. When ready to serve, transfer mixture into an ovenproof dish and top with cooked apricots. Place dish under broiler until golden brown.

title: Herring
ingredients: 1 jar pimento peppers ( the sweet green type ) | 1 red chili ( seeded and sliced ) | 1 can red habanero herring fillets ( drained of their oil and salt ) | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice ( juice of one orange )
instructions: Combine peppers, chile, and herring in a slow cooker. Add orange juice and stir. Cook on low heat setting 8 hours.

title: Jamaican Cabbage Rolls - Shrimp and Prawn Kebabs
ingredients: 250 g prawns, raw peeled ( i like to mince mine ) | 2 bunches cabbage leaves, shredded
instructions: Place prawn meat in a bowl and leave for 20 - 30 minutes. Place cabbage leaves on a plate and lay the shrimp on the leaves, pressing the prawn meat out so it is covered completely. Roll the leaves in the shredded cabbage until they are completely covered. Thread the skewers from the shrimp and roll firmly securing with wooden picks. Spray the griddle with olive oil and place all skewers into the skillet. Cook for 3 - 5 minutes on medium high heat before turning, until crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,cumin seed,red wine vinegar,part mozzarella cheese,nutritional yeast,white shoepeg corn
title: Tex Mex Corn Pizza
ingredients: 1 can white shoepeg corn, drained or 2 cups frozen corn kernels | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar or 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese ( shredded ) | 1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds
instructions: For the pizza, mix all ingredients except cheese in the bowl of your electric mixer. Mix on medium speed until the corn is well incorporated and mixture is smooth. Spread the mixture on your pizzas or a pizza stone and sprinkle with cumin seeds. If desired, spread your toppings using your hands to spread them. For the sauce, spread the warm filling on the dough inside the pizza crust. If desired, place mozzarella and cheese over the filling. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Let cool until the cheese is firm. Cut into wedges and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,thai chili sauce,catsup,beef bouillon cube,onion powder,pecan,blender hot sauce,baby potato
title: Pepper Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs baby potatoes, halved | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 4 -5 fresh curry leaves | 4 -6 tablespoons curry powder ( or more ) | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons catsup | 5 fluid ounces thai sweet chili sauce ( koon chun brand ) | finely chopped pecans ( to garnish )
instructions: Clean cut up potatoes, in a bowl combine all the ingredients except the pecans and mix well. Line the bottom of an 8 x8 or non stick skillet with a double layer of paper towels and place it in the freezer. Turn the potatoes after about 30 minutes of freezing. Place 1/3 of the potatoes in each of 2 or 3 oven safe pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes, until slightly brown. Remove from pan. Sprinkle with chopped pecans.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,milk chocolate chip,asiago cheese,barbecue sauce,dark soy sauce
title: Acapulco Queso Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole milk chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese | 1/2 cup finely chopped poblano chiles
instructions: Place chocolate chips in a small bowl, and then stir in soy sauce and barbecue sauce until smooth. Pour into a small skillet over medium heat. Spread each barbeque hot dog with a thin layer of soy cheese. Place the hot dog in the melted chocolate. Sprinkle each hot dog with the asiago cheese, and then with poblano pepper. Place the hot dogs in the microwave on high power for 10 seconds, to melt the cheese. Serve asapulco hot dogs with a side of your choice.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,soda water,rom tomato,hot italian sausage,beef rib,tomato ketchup,pineapple chunk
title: Beef Ribs in Baked Sausage & Pineapple
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs italian sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 pounds hot italian sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 4 lbs beef ribs, cut into 8 ribs | 1 teaspoon hot italian sausage sauce | 1 cup soda water | 3 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 2 roma tomatoes, cut into wedges | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained
instructions: To make the ribs, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 13x9 inch casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Mix the ribs, hot italian sausage, beef ribs, soda water and tomato ketchup in a large bowl. Arrange half of the pineapple chunks in the bottom of the dish. Top with half of the ribs and half of the tomato slices. Repeat with the remaining ribs and tomato slices in the dish. Dot with the remaining pineapple. Bake uncovered in the middle of the oven for 30 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,pinto bean,oregano,tarragon vinegar,pimiento,taco sauce,peanut butter
title: Daryl's Easy Pinto Beans and Peanut Butter Dip
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans | 3 tablespoons taco sauce | 2 tablespoons paprika | 2 tablespoons chopped pimientos | 20 1/2 ounces taco sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup peanut butter
instructions: Drain beans, rinse & drain. Combine all ingredients, mix well & refrigerate.

title: Beef Fingers
ingredients: 4 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 pint guinness stout, warmed to lukewarm | 4 teaspoons cumin | 4 teaspoons cracked black pepper | 8 teaspoons nutmeg, freshly grated | 8 teaspoons parsley leaves, finely shredded | 2 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts, finely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees celsius / 130 degrees fahrenheit. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Place filo pastry sheets in the oven on baking tray. Brush with 1 tablespoon of the guinness mixture and bake for 10 minutes or until golden. Cool. In the meantime combine the ground spices, parsley & the remaining guinness liqueur. Brush beef fingers with the guinness glaze & season with sea salt & freshly ground pepper. Cut the beef fingers into 5 fingers and transfer to a single layer. Top finger with a little of the spicy & nutmeg & continue to bake for 5 - 8 minutes until golden or cooked through. Sprinkle with peanuts and serve immediately.

title: Italian Salad With Beets and Macaroni
ingredients: 4 cups prepared macaroni | 1 1/2 quarts mixed greens ( chicory lettuce, spinach, bibb or curly endive ) | 1/2 cup beet greens | 12 slices caciocavallo or 12 slices mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese or 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup fresh marjoram or 1 tablespoon oregano | 3 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Mix with greens and beets, refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: white corn,half,bourbon,hamburger,romano cheese,serrano chile pepper,red potato,chunky salsa
title: Southern Living Southwestern Shepherd
ingredients: 4 pounds red potatoes, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 can white corn, drained | 1 loaf cooked hamburger | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half, or as needed | 1 1/2 cups sour cream or 1 1/2 cups plain greek yogurt | 1 1/2 cups grated romano cheese | 2 serrano chile peppers, seeded and minced | 1 cup thick & chunky salsa
instructions: Place the potatoes and corn in a large bowl. Gently toss to mix. Spread potatoes evenly on a serving platter. Arrange the potato mixture over the potatoes. Top the potatoes with hamburger, stirring to break up the chunks of hamburger. Heat the half and half in a small saucepan or skillet over medium low heat. Stir until the sauce thickens slightly, about 5 minutes.

title: Spicy Oranges for Two
ingredients: 1 large orange bell pepper, cut into rings ( or other type of red bell pepper ) | 8 slices button mushrooms or 8 slices baby portobello mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat the broiler setting. Place the pepper slices onto a hot baking sheet, and broil for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring frequently, or until the pepper becomes slightly charred. Place the mushrooms onto another baking sheet, and broil for about two minutes, just until they begin to wilt.

title: Italian Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 6 medium green bell peppers, cut into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Place the oregano in a coffee grinder.

title: Rice Crisp (Rice Bread Rolls)
ingredients: 2 cups stale bread, diced | 1 1/2 cups hot rice | 1/2 cup rye bread crumbs | 1/4 cup brandy ( i use a good brand, but any type of liqueur will do ) | ground cinnamon
instructions: Mix rice with hot rice, rye bread crumbs and brandy in a large bowl. Roll dough into 1 large rectangle and pinch the seams to make sure the dough is sealed and flaps. Arrange on a baking sheet, spacing very lightly. Cut a slit into the top of the rolls just below the rim. Sprinkle the tops with cinnamon. Bake in a 350f oven for 15 - 18 minutes, or until bread is crumbs are golden brown and crispy.

Random Ingredients: ortega taco sauce,salt black pepper,guacamole,vegetable broth
title: Easy & Delicious Avocado Soup
ingredients: 1 can campbell's healthy request vegetable broth | 1 can of el pato italian & reg ; mexi-flavored guacamole, divided | 1 can rotel taco sauce | 1 dash salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Stir everything together. Heat in microwave or in a soup pot. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve with tortilla chips or as a delicious dipping sauce for chips.

title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat spaghetti | 1 cup quinoa
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and season with salt. Cook spaghetti in boiling water until tender, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: soy yogurt,vanilla ice cream,flat leaf italian parsley,five spice powder,spanish onion
title: Chilled Onion Cheese & Butter Spread
ingredients: 1 cup finely-chopped spanish onion ( about 3 medium ) | 1/2 cup low-fat plain soy yogurt | 2 tablespoons finely-chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 pinch five-spice powder | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Blend onion, yogurt, parsley and five spice powder in an electric food processor until smooth. Spoon into serving glasses and serve with ice cream.

title: Shrimp Gizzards
ingredients: 10 shrimp paste ( such as 1 lb and 2 lbs ) | 2 cups dry white zinfandel wine
instructions: The easiest way to prepare shrimp paste is to roll the shrimp in the zinfandel wine to coat it evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours. Remove shrimp paste from refrigerator and dry thoroughly. Preheat broiler. Place shrimp paste on lightly oiled baking sheets. Broil for 3 to 5 minutes, until they begin to curl and turn pink. Turn off the heat, and carefully transfer shrimp to a large metal bowl. Drizzle about 2 tablespoons of shrimp wine from the jar over the shrimp, and using a fork, toss to coat. Let stand 10 minutes. Strain shrimp marinade into wine glass measuring cup, cover, and refrigerate at least 4 hours, preferably overnight. Remove shrimp from marinade. Thread shrimp onto 12 to 16 skewers, using remaining shrimp paste to coat each piece. Place skewers on a baking sheet or other baking sheet. Bake shrimp in preheated broiler for 3 to 5 minutes on each side, or until pink and shrimp are tender. Serve immediately, or they can be refrigerated indefinitely.

title: Quickie French Dip
ingredients: 6 slices rye bread | 1 jar beef gravy, chilled | 1 can or bottle beer ( or other dry white )
instructions: Toast the rye bread at 300 degrees until it's golden. Take the rye out and break or cut it up into smaller pieces. Toast the gravy until it's hot and bubbly. When the rye pieces are done put them on a plate of cheese. Add the beer or other dry white to your liking. Place the rye pieces in the gravy for a little bit. Enjoy.

title: Pasta Ai E Olio Con Carne (Pasta With Plantains)
ingredients: 2 large ripe plantains, peeled | 1 can black beans, drained ( cannellini ) | 1 jar tomato sauce | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 32 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked
instructions: Peel and cube the plantains. Place in a large bowl, pour in the beans and tomato sauce, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook rigatoni pasta according to package recommendations for al dente, and drain. Add rigatoni to tomato sauce, and mix well. Place mixture in a casserole dish, and top with the cooked rigatoni. Cover dish with a lid or tin foil, and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,cooking oat,monterey jack cheese,leek,guinness stout,dough,penne
title: Leek, Cheese and Guinness Pie
ingredients: 3/4 cup sliced leek, white and green parts | 5 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup guinness stout | 6 ounces dried penne | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 2 cans refrigerated ready-made pie crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a saucepan, combine the leeks and 5 cups vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer about 30 minutes. Drain the leeks and reserve. In a small bowl, combine the guinness and oats. Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Spread the dried pasta in the skillet. Arrange the leeks over the pasta, then pour the guinness and oats mixture over. Bake 40 minutes or until set and beginning to brown. Serve the pie warm.

title: Irish Scalloped Onions
ingredients: 1 -1 1/2 lb unsalted butter ( for sauteing ) or 1 -1 1/2 lb margarine ( for sauteing ) | 8 large onions
instructions: Cut the tops off the onions, and cut in thirds. Slightly butter one side of the onion and the tops. Spread out the butter, in one layer, in a casserole dish or a roasting pan at a shallow temperature. When the butter has melted, place the onions on top, and place in a 350f oven. In the center of the oven, bake for approximately 45 minutes, or until onions are browned.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,turnip,pineapple juice,calvados,hot chili sauce,garam masala,sirloin steak
title: Sultan of Swing
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin steak | 2 -3 tablespoons calvados ( apple brandy ) | 3 tablespoons pineapple juice | 10 -12 pinches garam masala | 2 -4 tablespoons hot chili sauce ( to taste ) | 2 -4 zucchini | 2 sweet peppers ( bell peppers )
instructions: The day before, marinate steak with the calvados, pineapple juice, hot sauce, and garam masala. The day before cooking, place zucchini and sweet peppers in an ungreased large baking dish. Pour marinade over steaks, turning to cover all sides. Cover with foil and marinade for 6 hours and up to 24 hours. Slice meat against the grain and serve with vegetables.

title: Killer Bar-B-Q Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon black raisins | 1 tablespoon jalapeno, seeds removed
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together worcestershire sauce, black raisins, and jalapeños.

title: Doughnuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 cup sourdough starter ( optional ) | 1 pinch dried crushed chili flakes, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a microwave safe bowl. Stir in sourdough starter, if using. Mix in chili flakes. Heat in microwave for 3 minutes.

title: Easy Tamarind Margaritas
ingredients: 3 fresh romaine lettuce hearts | 2 fluid ounces gold tequila | 1/2 fluid ounce tamarind juice
instructions: Peel and chop lettuce into thin strips. Bring all ingredients to room temperature and let sit for approximately 10 minutes before serving..

title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 container fat-free alfredo sauce | 1 package frozen salad greens, thawed | 1 cup reduced fat whipping cream | 5 large eggs substitute, beaten | 1 can chopped green chiles, drained | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 container reduced fat fat whipped topping
instructions: Spread alfredo sauce over the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange salad greens in a single layer over sauce. title: Persian Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 8 chicken cutlets | 2 tablespoons dried mint | 4 stalks of fresh mint
instructions: Soak the chicken until you are able to remove the tenders. Soak the mint in warm water for 20 - 30 minutes prior to placing the chicken skewers on the grill. Mix 3 - 4 tbsp of dried mint with 2 tbsp salt in a large bowl. Dry the chicken skewers with a clean kitchen towel. Brush each one with 1 tbsp of dried mint salt then place each piece of chicken on a flat metal skewer. Place the skewers on the rack of a grill pan. Place the pan of skewers over medium heat with the chicken, and cook until the chicken no longer pink inside.. To serve, slice the chicken into thin strips so that the strips are about 1/4 wide. Serve.

Random Ingredients: white rice,hoisin sauce,nut,chinese cabbage,black onion seed
title: Chinese Cabbage and Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 cups shredded white and green chinese cabbage | 1 1/4 cups cooked white rice | 1 tablespoon black onion seeds | 2 tablespoons whole dried seaweed ( not toasted ) | hoisin sauce ( optional ) | minced raw nuts ( optional )
instructions: Toss with hot dressing ingredients.

title: Quick and Easy Microwave Couscous
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 3 -5 cups cooked couscous
instructions: Stir the couscous and salt into the rice. Add the cooked couscous if you like. Microwave on high for 10 minutes. It shouldn't take more then 5 - 7 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Tuna and Pistachios for Two
ingredients: 4 cans tuna in water | 1/3 cup grated pistachios | 2 egg whites | 1 cup cold, diced rump roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 9x9 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Blend the tuna, pistachios, egg whites and water in a blender until smooth. Pour mixture into the pan in a thin layer. Bake at 300 degrees f for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the center is firm. Allow to stand for 15 minutes before slicing, or serve in a soup bowl.

title: Noodle and Beef Bake
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 8 ounces noodles | 8 ounces alfalfa sprouts | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 jar dried apricots, cut up
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place stew meat in a roasting pan. Arrange sprouts on beef. Cover with spaghetti sauce and apricots. Cover with foil. Bake about 1 hour or until noodles are tender.

title: Quick Spanish Rice and Farfalle from Company's Coming
ingredients: 1 package dry farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 1/2 tablespoons long grain white rice, or as needed | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the farfalle pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and immediately transfer farfalle to a large, deep bowl. Measure 1 1/4 cups of hot cooked farfalle pasta into the bowl with farfalle, and stir to coat. Cover, and refrigerate remaining farfalle pasta in the refrigerator, and bring to room temperature. Cook farfalle pasta in the reserved 1 1/4 cups of hot cooked farfalle pasta water, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.

title: Harry Potter's Dragon Strips
ingredients: 20 wonton wrappers | 4 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 9 ounces graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place about 10 wonton wrappers on each of four sheets of wax paper. Place a piece of chocolate in the center of each won ton wrapper. Place 5 won ton wrapper on top of chocolate. Sprinkle with about 1 teaspoon graham cracker crumbs. Fold over. Seal the edges slightly so they don't drop out of the wrappers. Repeat with remaining wrappers. Let the strips dry on wax paper for about 1 hour. Refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Lavender Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 beef stew meat, thawed | 6 tablespoons fresh lavender or 6 tablespoons fresh chives, minced | 3/4 cup tomato juice | 2 cans green beans
instructions: Place the beef, lavender or chives and tomato juice in a crockpot or dutch oven. Cook on high, 5 to 10 hours adding more hot water if needed. Turn setting to low and cook until beef is tender, about 5 to 10 minutes longer. Discard juice. Stir in the fresh green beans and heat through. If the gravy looks too thin, stir in a little cornstarch dissolved in a little water. Serve over cooked egg noodles or boiled or mashed potatoes.

title: Pasticciera (Cheese and Herb Fingers)
ingredients: 4 cups fresh grated sharp cheddar cheese | 2 cups fennel seeds ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons cardamom pods ( or to taste ) | fresh minced chives
instructions: In two bowls large enough to dip the fingers comfortably, place the grated cheese, fennel seeds and cardamom pods in them. Make sure the excess liquid gets into the cheese by dipping your finger in at a time. Dust with minced chives, if desired, until the fingers are well coated. Variations, use fresh, freshly grated parmesan or romano cheese for grinding and/or other flavors.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,chestnut mushroom,harissa,dark chocolate,turbinado sugar,yellow cherry tomato,clove
title: Moroccan Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 ounce dried chestnut mushrooms | 1 ounce dark chocolate, chopped to fit the cup of your food processor | 1/2 teaspoon harissa | 2 slices yellow cherry tomatoes | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon whole cloves, more if you wish ( or more ) | 2 ounces frozen peas and carrots | 1 1/2 ounces turbinado sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/ gas place mushrooms in bowl with the chocolate, harissa and tomatoes. Stir. Place in oven and bake for 10 - 15 minutes. Stir and pour into cups. Return to the oven for a further 8 - 15 minutes until golden in colour and the chocolate is melted. Remove the cloves if using. Top with chopped nuts or drizzle with melted chocolate.

title: White Rice With Beans and Coffee
ingredients: 2 cups white rice | 1 cup dried navy beans or 1 cup pink beans | 4 teaspoons instant coffee | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup light brown rice ( not instant ) | 1/2 cup shredded low fat fontina cheese
instructions: Rinse, wash and soak the beans overnight. The next day drain and rinse the beans and put in a medium size skillet. Stir in two cups of water and bring to a boil. While the beans are cooking, boil two cups of water and two teaspoons of instant coffee and add the two teaspoons of cornstarch. Stir the two teaspoons of instant coffee into two cups of hot water and stir together until the coffee is dissolved. Once the beans are done, strain them from the liquid and add to the beans in the skillet. Add the light brown rice and stir. Turn the heat to low and cook uncovered for ten to twelve minutes. Top with the cheese before serving.

title: Janes Drumsticks or Tried-Coconut-Apricot Wedges
ingredients: 3 cups shredded coconut | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 -2 chipotle pepper, minced ( depending on heat level desired ) | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, minced
instructions: Place all ingredients except the coriander into a zip top plastic bag or large zip top freezer bag and close. Shake to mix ingredients.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,kalamata olive,asparagus,asparagus spear,italian seasoning,fennel,porcini mushroom
title: Mushroom, Pesto, and Asparagus With Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted salted chopped fennel | 1 large fresh red chili powder | 1 lb fresh asparagus spear, trimmed | 3/4 ounce dried porcini mushrooms, soaked until soft ( i use white ) | 1/4 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed
instructions: In a food processor pulse the fennel and chile until it is coarsely chopped. Cut the asparagus into 4 or 5 pieces, about the length of the tip of the orange. Remove the tough stalks and cut them into 1 inch pieces. In a 12 inch saute pan with a little oil, on low or low, stir fry the asparagus in 1/2 cup water for about 3 and 1/2 minutes, just to release the flavor. Stir in the porcinis, italian seasoning, and olives.

title: New Zealand Curried Dumplings
ingredients: 1 small sweet potato ( about 6 ounces ) | 1 japanese eggplant | 1/3 - 3/4 cup canned clams, drained | 1 teaspoon molasses | 1 teaspoon curry leaf | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1/4 lb smoked fish fillet, chopped very fine ( can use canned tomatoes )
instructions: Rinse potato. Wash eggplant and slice in half lengthwise. Cut into 1/2 inch rounds. Place potato rounds in microwave safe pie dish. Cover with boiling water. Cook on high power for about 10 minutes, or until firm to the bite. Cool slightly. Peel potato and eggplant. Combine sweet potato, eggplant, clams and molasses. Use a fork to break up clams. When potatoes are cool enough to handle, remove them from their shells and puree them in a blender with curry leaf and fish. Drain shrimp if desired. Preheat a large non stick frypan to high heat. Put won ton wrappers on a lightly floured surface. Cover a table with wax paper and draw two opposing edges of won ton. Put a few spoonfuls of potato filling on one corner. Dip finger in water and wet other corner. Fold in half. Pinch corner to cover filling. Carefully slide folded dumpling up onto a clean surface. Wet fingers with a paper towel and put a tablespoon or 2 of potato filling in the centre. Fold dough over the filling once to form a triangle. Press edges with your fingers, then fold on the opposite side so that you have a triangle shaped package.

title: Polish Sausage
ingredients: 6 links polish sausage, sliced lengthwise | 1 can buttermilk | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill weed ( optional )
instructions: Place the sliced sausage in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, and stir in the buttermilk, dill weed, and a pinch of white sugar. Reduce the heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the sausage is crumbly, easily floured, and no longer pink in the center, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: peach,beef stew meat,hamburger,chili flake,soymilk,puff pastry,ghee butter,greek yogurt
title: Beef Curry Pastry Samosas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 2 lbs beef stew meat or 2 lbs boneless shin beef, cut into 3/4 inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 1/2 cup soy milk | 1 package thawed puff pastry sheets | 1 cup greek yogurt, stirred | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter )

Transfer the beef to the skillet with the peas and soy milk and cover. Reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for 3 hours or until the beef is very tender. To serve, unfold the pastry onto a floured work surface. Roll out the pastry to 1/8 inch thickness and cut into 3 pie or triangles. Sprinkle with half the yogurt sauce and lay 3 triangles on each pastry and top with more sauce. Serve with remaining yogurt sauce for dipping. The sambouse will keep for 2 days.

instructions: Wash the spinach until it wilts.

title: Spiced Oven-Roasted Beef With Collards

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Mix the anise seeds with the maple syrup and set aside. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray or lightly oil. title: Apricot and Lime Tart

title: Simple Microwave Coconut Kism

instructions: Spread the drained grated coconut evenly on a microwave safe plate. Sprinkle the saffron over the coconut. Microwave on high power level for 5 minutes. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves or sliced almonds.

title: Greek Grilled Patty

instructions: Preheat a grill for medium heat. Lay a patty on the work surface. Top with a slice of cheese, then a slice of olives. instructions: Preheat broiler. Place poblanos on a foil on a broiler pan. Broil 3 to 5 inches from heat, turning occasionally, until charred, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a plastic bag.

title: Real Swiss Roll

instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the sherry and anise seed. Place meat on a cutting board, and using a knife, cut 3 diagonal slits all the way down the length of the meat. Wrap each slit loosely in aluminum foil with two to three long strips of aluminum foil hanging over the entire surface of the meat. Place the roll in a large roasting pan, and place roasting pan on top of a burner on medium high heat. Place roasting pan into preheated oven, and turn the heat to 350 degrees f. title: Grilled Sausages (Or Chipolatas)

instructions: In a large pot, cover the water with salt and bring to a boil. Add the farfalle pasta and cook according to the package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. instructions: Whisk sesame seeds in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients.

instructions: Place cheese cubes in crockpot. Add blueberries. Pour remaining ingredients over top. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Serve with a dusting of powdered sugar.

instructions: Combine all ingredients including chives in blender and process until smooth. Pour mixture into medium bowl. Add rice milk and stir. Cover bowl and chill until ready to use. Can also make in the micro, adding the milk one tablespoon at a time until desired consistency is achieved.

instructions: Fry eggplant slices in a little bit of olive oil until golden brown on both sides. Remove from heat.

instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Place tuna, meat and onion halves on a grill basket or in a baking dish. Wrap tightly and grill with lid closed for 5 minutes. title: Potato Stuffed Red Bell Peppers

instructions: Cut the tops off of each red pepper and place on a cutting board, cut side down. Using a sharp knife, scrape down the inside of the peppers to remove the seeds. title: Lemon Lime Soda (For Shakes)
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 8 ounces lemon flavored carbonated beverages, such as appleton | 1 can tomato puree, such as del marigata | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Sift flour into a large bowl, stir in beverage, lemon flavoring, and ground mace. If desired, add more lemon flavored soda or carbonated beverage. Pour mixture into a funnel into a jar, and refrigerate 8 hours.

title: Stuffed Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms | 1 pork tenderloin | 3 napa cabbage, leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl, combine mushrooms and garlic. Spread inside of pork tenderloins and fill centers with mushrooms mixture. Bring ends of pork together and twist together to help seal. Place on a roasting pan with a little water in the center. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Turn pork tenderloins over and roast for 25 to 30 minutes longer. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f. Cut slices while still warm and serve with cabbage leaves.

title: Rye Bread - Finnish Bread machine
ingredients: 1/4 cup yellow mustard | 1/4 cup shallots or 1/4 cup white onion, minced | 1/2 cup white onion, minced | 1/2 cup rye flour | 5 cups bread flour | 4 teaspoons semolina ( optional )
instructions: In large bowl mix all the ingredients together with your breadmachine die. Process on bread setting, adding enough flour to maintain its texture.. See note below. Press start and walk away. I use a light crust medium. If you need to add a 1/2 cup of flour, you can, i suggest you do the last few minutes of mixing. My note, when working with rye flour, use a regular grade rye flour mix, and use rye flakes instead of rye. The rye flakes are not all the same, so this is where the heat is really needed. I always add the semolina, which makes the rye bread loaves very dry to begin with. The consistency doesn't change anything. I love rye flakes, so i usually add 2 tablespoons. I was told by a friend that it gives it some rye flavor. Instead of the rye flakes it is called kurka flakes. I buy these at a special, ethnic market. Some of the rye flakes are very fine in this recipe because they are slightly chewable. If they are not, i will use only 2 tablespoons or more of this mix. The rye flakes are made in very thin bread machines that take about 30 - 40 minutes to complete.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,ale,green chile pepper,oregano leaf,horseradish,amaretto,curry powder,green chili pepper
title: Bread and Butter Masala
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups plain flour | 1 teaspoon ground dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground green chile pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard or 1/2 teaspoon mild prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green chili pepper | 1 can chopped green chile peppers, drained | 5 -6 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place all of the dry ingredients in processor. Pulse two or three times until the mixture resembles coarse meal. Add all of the chile peppers and stir until combined. Spoon mixture onto a lightly floured board and knead briefly. Pat out to a 5 inch round. Using a 3 inch round cutter, slice bread rounds into a 3x4 inch rectangle, about 12 inches long. Place 1 tablespoon of the vegetable mixture in the center of each round. Brush top with amaretto. Starting with one side, pinch all around to seal. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake until tender and golden, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: molasses,watermelon,heavy whipping cream,onion soup mix,oregano leaf
title: Baked Watermelon Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs seedless watermelon, wedges | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon molasses | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. In an 8 inch nonstick skillet, combine the watermelon, cream and soup mix. Sprinkle in the molasses and dried oregano.

title: Irish Colcannon With Mushrooms
ingredients: 3/4 lb white potato, unpeeled | 12 -16 ounces baked beans ( i cook mine in the microwave until tender ) | 4 -5 ounces canned mixed mushrooms, drained | 1/2 cup fresh berries ( optional ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons horseradish cream ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 6 maraschino cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine potato, beans, mixed mushrooms, horseradish cream and cornflour in a pot and bring to the boil stirring constantly. Boil for 15 minutes and drain. Place mushroom mixture in a roasting tin, cover and bake for 30 minutes. Sprinkle berries on top and continue to bake for 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Magic Mambo (Tortellini) and Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet meatballs | 48 ounces tortellini ( any tubular pasta ) | 1/2 ounce chocolate | 2 tablespoons tamari | 3 teaspoons chili sauce | 2 teaspoons table salt | 1/4 cup ground hazelnuts or 1/4 cup pine nuts ( or more )
instructions: In a medium pot, add a few ounces of water and the sweet meatballs. Simmer until meatballs rise to top. Boil tortellini in plenty of water, drain and set aside. In another pot, melt chocolates. In the same pan, add 3 tsp of tamari, chili sauce, salt and nuts. Stir for 20 seconds to melt. Add meatballs and return to boil. Lower heat and simmer for 2 minutes. Garnish with more tamari and nuts. Serve.

title: Peach and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 6 slices cinnamon raisin bread, toasted | 3 fresh peaches - peeled, pitted and sliced | 1 cup crispy rice noodles
instructions: Spray a large bowl with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange slices of bread on a cutting board with the cut sides facing toward the center of a large cutting board. Arrange 2 peach slices, then 1 inch of crispy bread, overlapping slightly, over each slice. Top with a second slice of bread to make a sandwich. Repeat with remaining sandwiches and crumbs. Wrap individually in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 3 hours or as long as overnight. Cook rice noodles following the package directions. Serve as a snack with the remaining crispy bread.

title: Kenya Bok Choy (Choy With Condiments)
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 teaspoon cumin | 2 bunches bok choy
instructions: Wash the bok choy and trim off the root end. Take a 1cm slice from the bottom, remove the root ends and slice it vertically into pieces a reasonable portion of 1 cm thick, leaving some leaves to decorate the dish. Cut off the hard bottom stem portion of the bok choy and cut into 2 cm lengths. Take each piece of bok choy and separate the stalks from the leaves. In a deep skillet, cook bok choy for about 7 minutes or until softened. Drain on paper towel and place the pieces into a large warmed serving dish. Sprinkle the coriander and cumin powders over the bok choy pieces in the pan, turning the bok choy pieces over gently into the spices. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves. Serve immediately. Tip.

title: Chilli Beans and Chiles
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans | 2 whole red chilies, seeded and crushed | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Place beans and chilies in a saucepan and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,baking soda,vanilla bean,bread crumb,cajun seasoning
title: Toffee Bread II
ingredients: 1 cup bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 teaspoon ground baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 2 2 teaspoons vanilla beans or 2 teaspoons rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Mix together bread crumbs, sugar, baking soda, cajun seasoning, and vanilla beans in a bowl until well blended. Gently stir in crumb mixture until evenly blended. Bake in the preheated oven until top is pale and slightly browned, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: walnut,tomato juice,broth,chicken thigh,amaretti,spicy brown mustard,canola oil
title: Italian Grilled Chicken Kebabs With Amaretti
ingredients: 1/2 cup amaretti rolls or 1/2 cup regular granulated instant coffee-flavored biscuit, crushed | 1 cup tomatoes with juice, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons canola oil | 2 teaspoons spicy brown mustard | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs ( about 3 ) | 1 2/3 cups low-sodium broth ( or water )
instructions: In a 1 1/2 or 2 quart glass baking dish, lightly crush the biscuits with a rolling pin. In a bowl, stir the crushed biscuits and the tomato with 1/4 cup of the tomato juice to blend. In a 1 1/2 or 2 quart skillet, heat 2 tbs of the oil over moderate heat until it shimmers, then add the mustard and the chicken and cook, turning once, until the chicken is just cooked through, about 5 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Add the broth to the skillet. Bring to a simmer and stir in the remaining 4 tbs of tomato juice and the biscuit mixture and heat to boil. Divide the chicken among 4 large resealable plastic resealable plastic resealable plastic bags. Add the chicken and plastic bags to the broth and simmer, covered, turning the chicken occasionally, until the chicken is just cooked through, and the sauce is reduced to 1 1/2 cup, about 30 minutes. Serve the chicken and sauce in the reserved bowl, with the amaretti and/or biscuits on the side.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,lukewarm water,hot sauce,white cheddar cheese,coconut milk,beef bouillon cube,salt pepper,vegetable oil
title: Kesha (Ethiopian Cheese Bread) - a Crock-Pot Meal
ingredients: 6 cups white cheddar cheese, shredded ( or 3 cups shredded ) | 6 tablespoons fresh cream or 6 tablespoons yogurt | 1 onion, finely sliced | 3 -4 whole green cardamom pods, finely chopped | 6 -8 tablespoons lukewarm water | 1 beef bouillon cube | salt & fresh ground pepper | vegetable oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the bowl of a food processor, including the water. Process until smooth. Transfer to a crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or on high for 4 to 6 hours. Before serving, stir in the oil and serve. Makes enough for about 2 small servings. Be sure to mix for each bite the entire time and enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,clam,oregano leaf,mirin,peanut,self raising flour,barbeque sauce
title: Barbeque Clam Cookies
ingredients: 2 kg clams in shell | 2 liters self-raising flour | 150 g pine nuts | 50 g sugar | 300 barbeque sauce | chopped fresh oregano leaves or dried oregano | chopped dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Crush the clams in a bowl with a rolling pin. Add all the other ingredients except nuts. Mix thoroughly with hands until all ingredients form a coarse dough. Cover with plastic wrap and leave for 10 minutes. To make dipping sauce, divide the mixture into 10 - 12 balls. Roll each ball out on a floured surface until slightly flat. Fry in a hot pan for 3 - 4 minutes each side. Dipping sauce, dip balls into boiling barbecue sauce. Drain on absorbent kitchen paper. Drain on absorbent kitchen paper. Serve warm or cold.

title: Nuts
ingredients: 3/4 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup prepared marsala | 2 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon whole cardamom seeds | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together soy sauce, marsala, ginger, cardamom, coriander powder and turmeric until combined.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,sun tomato oil,oregano leaf,white wine vinegar,deli ham,vegetable oil olive,spanish onion
title: Sandwich Italian Hero
ingredients: 1 fresh deli ham, sliced into 2 inch thick slices | 1/4 cup vidalia onions or 1/4 cup spanish onion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained & quartered | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves | 4 ounces sliced deli ham | 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 packages ladyfingers, split
instructions: Heat grill. Cut ham in half horizontally, then cut each half crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Arrange ham and next 3 ingredients on a work surface. Sprinkle with oregano and roll.

Random Ingredients: shallot,orange zest,pasta,chuck roast,red chili powder,onion soup mix
title: Crock Pot French Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 8 ounces pasta, your choice, cooked and drained of any excess | 1 shallot, minced
instructions: If using chuck roast cut into 1/2 inch cubes, cut larger cubes into smaller pieces. Place all ingredients in crock pot and cook on low 6 to 8 hours but no longer the slow cooker setting recommended on package. Do not add salt during cooking process the longer you leave the lid open, the better flavor and you will taste your soup for yourself.

title: Scottish Sage Ginger Pie (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant minced fresh ginger in water | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 3 teaspoons dried minced onion flakes | 1 teaspoon ground sage | 2 cups soda water
instructions: Place the ginger into a 3 to 4 quart crock and set it on the side. Add the sugar, onion, sage, and stir. Pour in the soda water and stir. Turn the crock to high and let it sit for 5 hours. Turn the crock and allow it to sit for 1 hour longer. The sugar will have dissolved and the juice will turn dark and frothy.

title: Kolokythokeftedes
ingredients: 1 cup raw gherkin or 1 cup tzatziki | 1 1/2 cups fish stock | 2 teaspoons yellow mustard | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard, from a jar ( such as kerrygold brand ) | 1 dash baking soda | 1 dash harissa or 1 dash red hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place the gherkin, fish stock, 2 teaspoons of yellow mustard, worcestershire sauce, and 2 tablespoons of prepared yellow mustard in a saucepan over simmering water. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the baking soda, a splash of harissa, and a dash of hot pepper sauce. Allow to cool. Cover and refrigerate overnight, until well chilled. Serve with the sesame paste, toasted pita wedges or crackers.

title: Prikas Placku (Vietnamese Shrimp)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried lemongrass | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Place the lemongrass in a mortar and pound it with the teaspoon or pestle to extract as much liquid out of the garlic as possible. Add the cajun seasoning. Use as a marinade.

title: Balsamic Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white flour | 1 cup white flour | 1/3 cup fresh parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let sit for 1 hour at room temperature to allow flavors to blend and final flour absorbs it's taste.

Random Ingredients: fish stock,brussels sprout,cooking spray,coriander powder,flat leaf parsley,tomato onion,active yeast
title: Fish and Vegetable Careme Buns
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1/2 cup fish stock ( or chicken stock ) | 1 cup chopped tomato with onion, pulp included ( or use canned ) | cooking spray | 5 medium brussels sprouts, tops trimmed | 1 small-medium sprig flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, sprinkle yeast over 1 teaspoon of warm water then stir to mix. In a larger bowl add the rest of the water, stir well then set aside. Dissolve yeast in fish stock. Stir in tomato and onion pulp. Let stand until frothy. Drain brussels sprouts and arrange on baking sheet in about 4 inch size pieces. Brush tops with butter and sprinkle with salt. Cover baking sheets with plastic wrap, and let rise until doubled in size, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet over moderate heat until hot but not smoking, then spray with nonstick spray. Spoon or spoon brussels sprouts into skillet. Place about 6 brussels sprouts in a single layer among sprouts and bake until brussels sprouts are crisply colored and beginning to soften, about 4 minutes, spraying lightly with butter at 2 minute intervals. Transfer cooked brussels sprouts to a cutting board. Scrape bottoms with a sharp knife blade then transfer to a serving platter. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and enjoy.

title: Lemon Grass Beer Marinade for Meat and Vegetables
ingredients: 1/3 cup lemongrass | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Puree the lemongrass and rice wine in a blender until smooth, then mix it with the beer. The beer may be stored in the canning jar in the refrigerator for two to three months.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,crabmeat,mayonnaise,marinara sauce,red capsicum,lemon juice zest,white flour
title: Low-Fat Baked Crab Pastries
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat, drained and flaked | 1/2 cup low-fat mayonnaise ( i used light ) | 1/2 red capsicum, sliced | 1 small lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Mix together crabmeat, mayonnaise, red capsicum, lemon zest, flour and chilli paste in a bowl. Spoon 1 tablespoon of the fish sauce into a baking paper lined 20x9 inch baking tin and spread out to cover baking paper. Spoon crab mixture over the paste in the tin. Bake at c for 15 minutes until bubbly and starting to brown. Meanwhile whisk together marinara sauce and remaining 1 tablespoon of fish sauce until smooth and thick. Drizzle sauce over the crab in a thin diagonal pattern.

title: Hot Dogs With Egg-Lemon Yogurt
ingredients: 4 hot dogs | 1 1/3 cups plain yogurt, plain yogurt | 3/4 teaspoon mixed spice | 8 radishes | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/4 cup soda water | 2 tablespoons rum
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix lightly with a fork. Marinate hot dogs in yogurt overnight or for at least 1 hour. When ready to grill, cut off the excess fat. Lightly grill hot dogs until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5 minutes per side. Serve immediately on toothpicks. Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

title: Pear Agari
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mirin | 3 ripe anjou pears, sliced
instructions: In a small skillet fry the pear slices in a little oil for about 2 - 3 minutes. Pour the mirin over the pears and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,asafoetida powder,paprika,lasagna noodle,white breadcrumb,satay sauce
title: Mummy's French Onion Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow onions, sliced | 1/4 cup paprika | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder ( msg ) | 1 cup plain white breadcrumbs | 15 sheets white breadsticks ( cut in half diagonally, to make 8 triangles ) | 2 jars satay sauce ( kame shoyu )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a large stainless steel pot, pour enough water to coat the bottom of the pot. Add the sliced onions and cover with a generous layer of salt. Bring to a boil and simmer on medium setting for 30 minutes. Drain the onions and allow them to stand in the water to dry out as much as possible. Reserve the water and add the paprika to the onions. Add one tablespoon of asafoetida and 1/4 cup of white bread crumbs, and mix well. Turn down heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove meat from bones and set aside. Slice off a thin slice of about 4 inches long then break apart each noodle into 2 inch pieces. Layer some of the onions in the following order on the bottom of a 9 x 12 inch oven proof baking dish. Place a few triangles of the remaining beef, 1 tablespoon of satay sauce, some of the drained onions, 3 tablespoons of the spanish paprika, and some bread crumbs on top of the onions. Continue layering the layered ingredients until the dish is full. The dish is ready when you remove the layers of meat, sauce, bread crumbs, and crumbs from the bottom of the baking dish. Dot the top of the lasagna with the remaining spanish paprika so that it forms a flat top layer, then spread the rest of the sauce over the lasagna. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 1 1/4 hours, or until the top layer browns. Allow to rest for 15 minutes before cutting into squares.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,cauliflower floret,peppercorn,wheat spaghetti,tortilla,sunflower oil,celery,tarragon vinegar
title: Cauliflower and Sunflower Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower floret | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand, crushed | 1 teaspoon whole wheat spaghetti, broken into quarters | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon vinegar | fresh ground pepper | 6 large slices crusty tortillas or 6 large flat bread, to serve | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon flowers or 2 teaspoons fresh fennel flowers, for extra flavour
instructions: Put the cauliflower in a pan with a splash of water boiling over. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 8 - 10 mins until very tender. Drain and cool. Meanwhile put the sunflower oil, saffron, spaghetti, vinegar and pepper into a screw top jar or screw top jar. Shake well to combine. Tear off a piece of aluminium foil, place on your work surface and place on your cauliflower. Sprinkle with a little more pepper and add a handful of the mix. Fold each piece of foil over and enclose to make a little packet. Arrange in a shallow serving tin. Bake the nocchiato, uncovered on a grill pan. Grill or fry, wrapped in the foil, for 3 - 5 mins until puffed up. Leave to cool slightly, then serve topped with the herbs and tortillas or flatbread pieces. Delicious with steamed greens.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,flat leaf parsley,kaiser,kielbasa,salmon,sea bass fillet,buttermilk,puff pastry
title: Smoked Sea Bass and Smoked Kielbasa Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 kielbasa, sliced | sea bass fillet, skinned | 2 sheets ready rolled puff pastry | buttermilk ( optional ) | 2 sheets smoked kielbasa, cut diagonally into 5 mm slices ( or substitute any smoked smoked sausage ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | fresh flat leaf parsley, to garnish | killed smoked sea bass fillet, cut crossways into 12 slices
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate 160°c if using an oven fan forced oven, fan the oven off to a temperature of 190°c if using an oven fan forced oven, place the oven shelf ready on a baking trays. Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the kielbasa with the sea bass skin side down until dark golden. Transfer to a plate and set aside. Roll out the puff pastry sheets as thinly as possible and cut on a large, oblong sheet. Place each sheet on a flat tray and spoon a thin layer of buttermilk into the middle of each, leaving a 2cm bare border of pastry around the edge. Season with salt and pepper then arrange the smoked kielbasa rounds on top. Drape the smoked sea bass slices over the smoked kielbasa top layer and arrange the smoked sea bass slices along the bare border of the pastry. Roll the pastry over to enclose the smoked sea bass slices, tucking under the excess and trimming off any excess with a small sharp knife if desired. Lay on the tray and cut a steam hole in the centre of the pastry with a sharp knife if you wish. Place in the oven and cook for 15 minutes, then remove from oven and scatter with parsley and the smoked kielbasa slices. Return to oven and cook for a further 5 - 10 minutes until pastry is golden brown and the kielbasa slices are just cooked through.

title: Spicy Beans and Couscous
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed ( italian beans ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 box couscous
instructions: In a large dish, combine the beans, worcestershire sauce, and nutmeg. Stir in the couscous. Set aside. Bring water to a boil. Add the couscous mixture. Boil for about 2 minutes, or until the couscous is tender in the center. Fluff with a fork.

title: Aglio E Olio
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups orange juice | 1 cup club soda ( tall or cold ) | 4 fresh oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Combine orange juice, club soda, oregano leaves, garam masala and 3/4 c water in a medium heat proof container. Heat on low until hot. This will take about 5 minutes and will take even longer. Do not boil. This does not have to be an art, it should be done as a result of stirring when it boils, about 20 - 30 times. Pour over ice.

Random Ingredients: sage,chocolate,black cardamom pod,grand marnier,white wine,chicken breast half
title: Maurice (Chocolate Coated Chicken) With Sage
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves or 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenders | 1/2 cup dry white wine ( if using wine use 1/4 cup total ) | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup orange-flavored liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh sage | 6 ounces bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Trim skin from meat of chicken if desired. Place meat in a shallow baking dish or shallow roasting pan. Add wine, grand marnier, cardamom, and sage. Cover and marinate chicken for at least 1/2 hour.

title: Homemade Ham & Bay Leaves
ingredients: 1 lb serrano ham, cut into 2 by 1/2-inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 3 bay leaves
instructions: Dry ham out of refrigerator. Place ham in a large nonreactive crockpot. Sprinkle the almond extract onto ham. Cut a slit in each ham slice and fill slit with a heaping teaspoon of ham mixture. Add the bay leaves and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, or on high 4 - 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,tomato puree,sunflower oil,red bell pepper,vegetable oil olive,taco seasoning mix,seasoning salt,bell pepper
title: Homemade Taco Meat
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs ground round | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil ( or olive oil ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 4 red bell peppers, chopped | 4 ounces pepperoni, chopped | 1 can tomato puree | 1 1/2 cups sunflower oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. In a medium bowl, mix all ingredients thoroughly. Form into patties and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for about 20 minutes or until done. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,apple,canola oil,mustard,red pepper flake,currant,horseradish,linguine
title: Apple Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1 can beef stew meat, undrained | 1/3 cup currants | 1/3 cup canola oil | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 3 tablespoons prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons dry crushed red pepper flakes | 2 apples, cut into thick slices | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh horseradish, for garnish
instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water to separate. Combine all ingredients in a large serving bowl.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,ginger garlic paste,oat,sherry wine,pepper,red potato
title: Oats With Red Potatoes and Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb frozen mixed peppers, defrosted and cut into 1 1/2in cubes | 8 ounces red potatoes, cut into 1in pieces | 2 1/2 ounces ginger-garlic paste | 2/3 cup sherry wine | 4 ounces oats or 4 ounces regular oats | pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. In a roasting tin place the red potatoes, ginger garlic paste, sherry and a sprinkling of pepper and bake on the middle shelf for 45 minutes until they are tender.

title: Spanish Rice Mix - Microwave
ingredients: 3 cups spanish rice mix | 1 tablespoon honey ( optional )
instructions: Place rice mix in 5 quart microwave safe bowl. Cover and microwave on high for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,cooking sherry,club soda,vegetable oil,swiss cheese,prawn,stewing beef,apple cider vinegar
title: Crispy Swiss Appetizer Prawns
ingredients: 4 small prawns, peeled and deveined | 4 slices swiss cheese ( or you can use mild white cheese ) | 4 teaspoons cooking sherry | 12 ounces swiss cheese, preferably aged, grated ( or you can use any sharp cheddar in the american case too ) | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 3 drops club soda | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Put the prawns in a large bowl and cover with sherry. Allow to marinate for up to 2 hours. Put the grated cheese in a wide, shallow dish and dip both sides of the prawns in it to ensure they are well coated. Heat oil in a medium size frying pan. Drop the prawns into the hot oil and fry until they are cooked, and the cheese is golden. Remove and serve hot or cold with your favourite side dish.

title: Molletes De Chocolate
ingredients: 1 packet powdered gelatin | 500 ml evaporated milk chocolate chips | 6 calvados ( carambola )
instructions: In a bowl, sprinkle the gelatine over the chocolate and leave to soften. Heat the caramel and choclate together in a saucepan and drizzle over the gelatine and chocolate. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Fish Ball (Yogurt)
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 large firm fish | 1 tablespoon celery root ( finely chopped peeled if small ) | 1 liter vegetable stock | panko breadcrumbs | 5 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
instructions: Grate the parsley over a cloth towel in a large bowl and set aside. Drain the fish well, rinse well with cold water, pat dry with paper towels and cut into bite sized pieces. Set aside. Cut the celery root in half and cut it crosswise into sticks about the width of the fish. Set aside. Bring the stock to boil in pan on high heat. Add the minced parsley and celery root sticks and simmer for 5 minutes. Strain stock and return to heat. Place panko onto a plate. Brush the fish with melted butter and coat with panko. Roll up jelly roll style, pressing with fingers so panko can coat the meat well. When you are ready to cook, bring some water to boil in a large saucepan. When water is boiling add fish and 1t of the parsley mix and cook about 4 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,dark brown sugar,fenugreek seed,egg white
title: Fenugreek Egg Rolls (Karaa)
ingredients: 3 egg whites, at room temperature | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 bell pepper, cut into strips ( red, green or yellow )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Beat egg whites, brown sugar, and fenugreek seed in a large bowl until soft peaks form. Stir in bell pepper and set aside in a large baking dish. Using your hands, shape egg mixture into 1 inch balls. Arrange balls on top of bell pepper coated bread. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 20 minutes or until golden and slightly firm. Remove from oven, let cool slightly, and transfer to a wire rack to cool. Store in an airtight container. Variations, try adding brown sugar and/or fenugreek or any curry powder.

title: Potato Shredded Turnip
ingredients: 6 medium turnips, peeled, cut into 1/2 - 3/4/8-inch ( about 3 1/2 lbs ) | lemon pepper | 1/2 cup potato starch ( or cornstarch ) | 1 -4 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/3 cup salsa
instructions: In medium saucepan bring water to boil. Slip turnip slices in water until tender but not mushy. Drain. Cut into 2 inch lengths. Place on waxed paper or brown paper. Make 1 1/2 cups of the mixture, in a small bowl, combine potato starch and dijon. Stir in some of the warm water. Stir until dough is smooth. Add salsa and stir. Let rest for 15 minutes.

title: Rhodes
ingredients: 1 cup tomato paste | 1 cup simple syrup | 5 cups lettuce leaves or 5 cups boston lettuce | 1 small red chile ( optional )
instructions: Combine tomato paste, syrup and chile. Simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Drain liquid from tomato mixture and allow to cool. Chill and store in freezer. To serve, place lettuce leaves on dinner plates or in individual salad bowls or martini glasses. Spoon a ladle of rhodes sauce over the lettuce and top with a generous serving of remaining sauce.

title: Sauce Mardi Gras
ingredients: 1 jar marshmallows | 8 ladyfingers ( optional ) | 1 pound shaved beef brisket | 1 cup hot sauce, or more to taste | 1 cup watermelon juice | 1 cup water
instructions: Cook marshmallows in a large skillet over medium heat until soft and fragrant, about 5 minutes.

title: French Toast With Sweet Broccoli (Schabler Zwiebelka)
ingredients: 1/2 lb broccoli ( swiss brown is my preference ) | 2 slices rye bread | 3 tablespoons cold water | cinnamon ( for dusting )
instructions: Wash and slice broccoli into florets. Slice rye bread into long strips. Lightly dust with cinnamon, and dip into water. Fry in oil, until crunchy. Remove broccoli onto platter, and arrange around. Add a sprinkle of cinnamon over the top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,yellow squash,green mango,milk,roast
title: Caribbean Roast Vegetable Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large roast or 1 large pot roast, such as roast, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 4 cups yellow squash ( about 2 medium ) | 8 cups skim milk | 1 cup reduced-fat colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 large green mango, peeled and cut into 4 wedges
instructions: Cook potatoes in a 6 quart nonstick skilled over medium high heat, covered, stirring occasionally, until tender, 8 to10 minutes. Stir in squash and milk. Cover.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,crouton,hot pepper,cayenne,red wine vinegar,walnut oil,spaghetti sauce
title: Italian Sweet Peppers in Salt Sauce
ingredients: 10 green bell peppers, with tops | 1 tablespoon hot pepper, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/3 cup walnut oil | 1/4 cup crouton, lightly toasted
instructions: Place green pepper on oven rack in broiler pan and broil on high until charred, about 2 minutes.

title: Rice Polenta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups instant polenta | 10 green cardamom pods | 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice or 1 1/2 cups pearl barley, washed
instructions: Pour hot water into medium sized bowl. Add the cardamom pods, and then add instant polenta. Mix well to make a thick polenta. Let stand a few minutes. Add rice/parsley mix. Mix well, cover with wet cloth, and allow to stand in a cool place for 2 days before eating. You can also put polenta into a small pan, and bring it to a boil, stirring continuously until rice is cooked, and liquid is absorbed.

title: Minnesota Wild Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into chunks | 1 can sliced peaches, drained, juice reserved | 4 cubes ice | 1 1/2 cups shredded frozen broccoli, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 can turkey livers with spice | 2 teaspoons garlic salt
