instructions: Cook the cubed beef and sliced peaches in a large skillet over medium high heat until browned, about 10 minutes. Drain, remove from skillet. Place ice in the skillet and microwave on high power until hard, 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pecan,grainy mustard,yellow bell pepper,red kidney bean,beef
title: Beef & Bean Roundup
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 can red kidney beans | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup pecan pieces | 1/4 cup grainy mustard
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet over medium heat until done. Drain. Add kidney beans with liquid. Bring to a boil. Simmer 3 minutes. Stir in pecans and mustard. Heat through. Sprinkle on salad if desired.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,vinegar,fennel seed,shortening,beef stock chicken,sun tomato oil,turbinado sugar
title: Mozzarella-Stuffed French Blankets
ingredients: 6 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon fennel seeds | 36 ounces shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup beef stock, hot and your choice of flavor chicken | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon turbinado sugar ( to taste ) or 1/2 teaspoon sugar substitute ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, rinsed and chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f using the oil and fennel seeds that you have lightly toasted out your fondue pot in the microwave, roast the mozzarella until very white and soft and the cheese is meltingly creamy. Drain the excess fat and set the cheeses aside. In a bowl whip together the stock, vinegar, and sugar. Set aside to cool while preparing the filling. Wet your hands, take a piece of the cheese and roll it between your palms. Using a small spoon break off small flecks and stuff a little filling into the cheese and using a little water or another clean, dampened pastry cloth, press the cheese in to the corners of the paper, making sure the cheese does not go open at the seam. The ends should be about 1 1/2 in diameter so it doesn't roll out. Repeat with the remaining cheese and/or filling. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water at all times, they will be easier to remove from the dish. Brush the assembled french rolls with just enough of the melted cheese, and bake on a cookie sheet for about 15 minutes, or until lightly browned and set. Remove from the oven and brush the tops with more of the melted cheese.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,beef steak,chicken stock cube,vanilla sugar,dijon mustard,chuck,caper,peanut oil
title: Chicken Piccata
ingredients: 1 boneless chuck ( about 150g ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 chicken breast half ( about 200g ) | 1 boneless beef steak | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 60 g jarred capers, drained
instructions: Trim excess fat from chuck and cut a 1/4 incision between each slice. Cut each slice into 3 diagonal slices. Cut chuck steak diagonally into thick 2 cm pieces and beef steak diagonally into 1 inch strips. Heat half of the peanut oil in a large, non stick frying pan over medium high heat. Cook chicken, steak, and beef strips for about 5 mins each side, or until golden. Remove steak and beef strips from pan.

title: Mexican Chili
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds ground beef | 3/4 cup light corn syrup | 1 red chile, chopped
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet. Drain and discard any excess grease. Return hamburger to skillet.

Random Ingredients: yellow tomato,grain white rice,white cabbage,jasmine rice,onion,grand marnier,barbecue sauce,potato
title: Rice Cabbage Rolls With BBQ Sauce and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 bag simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion, peeled | 1/2 head white cabbage, cored and sliced ( about 1 pound ) | 1 can yellow tomatoes, diced | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce ( i use diana's bbq sauce, but can use more! ) | 1/4 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup onion, finely chopped | 1 cup jasmine rice ( i like jasmine rice best ) | 1/4 cup white cabbage, finely chopped | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f or gas mark in a large roasting pan, mix together diced potatoes, onions and half the marinade.

Random Ingredients: chicken cutlet,pearl onion,lamb chop,bell pepper,broccoli floret,nut,ranch bean,hard egg
title: Mom's Vegetable and Chicken Saute
ingredients: 8 -10 chicken cutlets, cooked and boned ( depending on size ) | 4 -5 hard-boiled eggs, boiled | 4 -5 medium dried chinese parsley mushrooms | 1 medium frozen broccoli floret, cooked, and cooled | 1/2 cup frozen pearl onion | 1/2 cup frozen mixed vegetables | 1 can chicken cutlets, cooked, and chopped | 3/4 - 1 cup ranch style beans
instructions: Prepare veggies. Drain tomatoes and cut into wedges. Prepare chicken and vegetables. Drain herbs. Dredge through entire stew. Saute in skillet. Add beans and chicken. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: emmenthaler cheese,tart apple,watermelon,tomatillo,chocolate chip,green chile,chipotle chile adobo,oregano leaf
title: Cinco De Mayo
ingredients: 1 pound tart, sour apple | 1 pound fresh tomatillos, husked | 1/2 pound fresh green chiles, coarsely chopped | 1 large red-leaf roasted tart apple | 2 cups shredded emmenthaler cheese | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped, or as needed | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 2 cups water
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Place one piece of aluminum foil on a flat surface, and layer it with one of the apple slices and one tomatillo, and green chilies. Layer the remaining apple and tomatillo layers, in a single layer, on top of the tortillas, and sprinkle with the shredded cheese. Sprinkle with dried oregano. Top with chipotle peppers and adobo. Starting at the top, fold up the sides to encase the filling. Seal the edges with a fork to ensure adequate pressure. Place the filled baking dish on a wire rack lined with aluminum foil. Place the remaining chipotle chiles on top of the cheese and bake 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from oven, and pour the water into a small saucepan.

title: Chicken and Spinach One Pot Meal
ingredients: 1/2 whole chicken, cut into four pieces, jointed | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek leaves | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 teaspoon fennel leaves | 1 baby spinach leaves | 1 lb linguine, cooked
instructions: Combine chicken with 1/2 tsp of allspice, fennel, saffron and fenugreek leaves. Sprinkle with rest of fennel. Place a spinach leaf on each piece of chicken and roll up. Place in pot, add spinach and toss. Cook on med high until spinach wilts and chicken is golden. Remove from heat, cover and set aside for 2 minutes. Remove twigs of spinach and serve.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,chili paste,apricot,red pepper,tabasco sauce,italian parsley
title: Sweet Potato & Tomato Sautee
ingredients: 1 -2 small sweet potato or 2 -3 small russet potatoes ( depending on size ) | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 teaspoons sweet chili paste | 1/2 cup dried apricot, chopped | 1/4 cup sweet red pepper, chopped ( fresh, canned or roasted ) | 1/3 cup chopped fresh italian parsley or 1/3 cup fresh cilantro
instructions: Peel the sweet potato then slice in half diagonally at 1/4 inch intervals. Remove all seeds and white on the inside of the potato and discard. Cut the potato into slices about 1/8 inch thick.

title: Spicy Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 -12 flour tortillas | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram ( optional, but i like it in! ) | 2 -5 dashes cayenne
instructions: On a hot griddle or frying pan, lightly brown one side of all of the tortillas briefly, and stack with 2 - 6 pairs of pairs of waxed paper. Top them with more cheese, your favorite toppings, spices, etc. I add shredded tomato, basil, chopped red onions, chili powder, etc. Enjoy.

title: Creamy Cashew Nut Dip
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, cut up | 32 ounces greek yogurt | 1 1/2 cups cashew nuts | 1 teaspoon sage | 1 large cauliflower, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Remove any membrane from steak. In a large bowl, spread out steak slices with a knife. Lay slices on a baking sheet. Bake until cooked through, about 25 to 30 minutes. While steak is baking, prepare cashew nuts. In a food processor, combine cashew nuts, sage and 1/2 of the yogurt. Pulse until smooth. After cooked, remove steak slices from oven, place on a plate, cover with a clean towel and let stand. Boil in a saucepan for about 10 minutes or until sauce thickens. Drain off excess oil. Stir cashew mixture into sauce and simmer until slightly thickened, but not soupy. Serve with steamed or baked cauliflower cauliflower.

title: Tomato Based Masala
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon ground chervil | 1 tomatoes, cut into 4 pieces
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together tahini, ginger, chervil, and tomato until the mixture forms a thick paste.

Random Ingredients: dough,pepperoni,lemon zest,red wine vinegar,beef bouillon cube
title: Crostini Di Melanzane E Salvia (Pepperoni-Beef C Sandwiches)
ingredients: 4 red bell peppers or 4 green bell peppers | 1 ounce pepperoni | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 4 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Line baking sheet with waxed paper. Cut bell peppers in half and remove stems and seeds. With a vegetable peeler, remove tops and seeds and slice each half into 1/4 inch wide strips. Transfer bell strips to a bowl of ice water to stop cooking. Place in the refrigerator while preparing the filling. Drain bell peppers and slice lengthwise into strips or matchsticks depending on their size. Pour boiling water over the beef cubes in a small bowl, and dissolve in the vinegar. Stir in the reserved bell pepper strips, pepperoni strips, lemon zest and pepper pieces. Arrange in a single layer on the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, or until bubbly. Serve.

title: Low Fat Mexican Bites
ingredients: 14 ounces tomatoes | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 3/4 teaspoon onion powder | 8 ladyfingers | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning mix
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. In medium size bowl, combine all ingredients. Line foil pan or a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with foil. Spoon half the tomato mixture evenly in pan. Spread with lady fingers. Spread with remaining tomato mixture. Sprinkle with taco seasoning. Cover with foil. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Irish Chocolate Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 4 ounces hershey's chocolate kisses | 1 bunch scallion, scallions, 2 chopped | 1 cup rhubarb, chopped | 1/8 cocoa powder, cocoa flavoured ( optional )
instructions: Cook kielbasa. When kielbasa has cooled, slice into 1/4 inch slices. Brown scallions and chives. Drain excess fat from pan, add kielbasa and chocolate to pan. Blend thoroughly.

title: Gingerbread Crumb Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup graham wafer crumbs | 1/2 cup ground gingerroot | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom seed | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 2 cans beer ( regular strength ) | 1/2 cup pistachios, chopped
instructions: In large bowl combine graham wafer crumbs, ginger, brown sugar, cardamom, vanilla. Add 2 cans of beer. Mix well. Place in casserole dish and cover with foil. Bake at 325 degrees f for 30 to 40 minutes. Garnish with chopped pistachios.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,kielbasa,pearl barley,pinto bean,corn chip,cottage cheese,musk lifesaver five flavor candy
title: Kielbasa and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces bulk kielbasa, casings removed | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 3 ounces giant valley frozen pearl barley, thawed ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese or 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 1/2 cup canned diced sweet peas or 1/2 cup canned corn chips | 2 tablespoons hummus for five-spice candy
instructions: Cook and stir kielbasa in a skillet over medium heat just until it begins to crisp, about 2 minute. Add beans, barley and peas. Toss to coat, then sprinkle with candy.

title: Karelian Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck or 2 lbs rump roast | 8 cups whipping cream ( double for thicker flavor ) | 2 lbs celery ribs, with leaves, cut into 2. 5 inch lengths | 8 bay leaves | 3/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 cup vodka ( optional )
instructions: Place roast in a 6 1/2 quart crockpot. Add all remaining ingredients except vodka. Cook on low heat for 6 hours. Using a slotted spoon, remove roast and reserve vegetables to a bowl. When ready to serve, skim fat from cooking liquid.

Random Ingredients: steak,jalapeno pepper,cremini mushroom,chili oil,squash,green chili pepper,white pepper
title: Jerk Steak and Veggies (Simmered Version)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 1 can jalapeno peppers | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons white pepper | 6 -8 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1 large yellow squash or 1 large green pepper, cut into 6 wedges | 1 can chopped green chili peppers | 1/4 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Cut steaks and vegetables into bite sized chunks. Pour chili oil into saucepan with a tight fitting lid, heat on medium heat until oil is hot but not smoking. Sauté vegetables in oil until tender crisp. If you need a little bit of juice, add some of it to pan with vegetables, cover and simmer for about 5 minutes. Drain veggies, stir and serve hot. If not using a gravy like i do it with my family’s jasmine rice.

title: Nopales Wrapped in Foil (Sage and Prawns)
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup cornmeal | 1 lime, zest of, finely grated | 1 bunch cilantro leaves, chopped finely | 1 bunch fresh sage, chopped | 6 tablespoons fine-quality olive, pitted and chopped | 12 nopales, cleaned and cut into thick strips
instructions: Heat a small amount of butter in a saucepan over a moderate heat, add the flour, whisking continuously until browned, about 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat and add the cornmeal, lime zest, and cilantro. Work the mixture into a dough. Keep mixing, as it thickens, for 3 - 4 minutes, or until the consistency resembles a runny paste and clumps form all over the ingredients of the dough. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and set aside. Add the sage to the oil and fry them in batches in the hot oil for 3 - 4 minutes, or until tender. Arrange nopales in a baking dish, spoon over the sage mixture, and bake in a preheated 180c oven for 20 minutes, or until the nopales are cooked and the sauce has thickened. You may also make nopalitos by wrapping the nopales loosely with cellophane strings and tying them with the cooking string. Cut in half across the tail then crosswise into wedges.

title: No-Cook Tomato Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 250 g no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon orange zest, grated | 1 tablespoon basil, chopped | spices
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cook on low for 15 minutes until thick, stirring frequently. Serve with your favourite pasta.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetarian Lasagna
ingredients: 1 bag no-boil lasagna noodles, any size | 1 package fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl, mix noodles and sprouts. Transfer to a greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Bake for 20 minutes or until hot. Sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,egg,chili paste,creme fraiche,halibut fillet,pastry crust pie,madeira wine
title: Macadamia-Crusted Halibut and Macadamia Empanadine
ingredients: 1 pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1 egg | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche, or to taste | 1 tablespoon madeira wine, or to taste | 1 tablespoon sweet chili paste, or to taste | 1 tablespoon macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped | 4 halibut fillets, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 9 inch pie plate with a double crust pastry. Mix the egg, creme fraiche, madeira, chili paste, and macadamia nuts together in a bowl. Add the halibut fillets, and coat with the egg mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until the fish is easily flaked with a fork, 40 to 45 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,self rising flour,chinese cabbage
title: Pork Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 medium head chinese cabbage | 1 jar sweet chili sauce | 3 cups self rising flour
instructions: Place cabbage in boiling water. Leave to simmer for a few minutes, and then, stem and chop cabbage into small pieces, about 1cm or so. Combine cabbage and sweet chili sauce in a large bowl. Make dough out of flour, about 1/2 cup each. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface, and knead dough quickly to produce a well formed crescent. Roll dough out until it's about 4cm thick. Cut dough into 8 slices, and place on lightly greased oven trays. Leave room for rising. Bake at cinwale for 25 - 35 minutes. Serve with your favourite dipping sauce.

title: Chile Pepper Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 pound cod fish fillets, cubed | 1/4 cup brewed tea, hot | 3 tablespoons filled chestnuts, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the chili powder and season with salt and pepper. Place fish in a nonmetallic dish. Stir the chili powder mixture into the fish and coat well. Let stand for 20 minutes. Pour the hot tea into a nonmetallic bowl and nestle fish in the flavored tea. Let sit for at least 30 minutes. Serve right away. Sprinkle seafood with reserved chili powder mixture and garnish with the chestnuts.

title: Crispy Tortellini Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces cheese tortellini, drained | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 ounce lemon juice
instructions: Cook the tortellini according to package directions except refrigerate until cold. Drain very well and transfer to a bowl. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill for one hour, then serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,green olive,tequila,onion soup mix,chipotle chile,olive
title: Chipotle Olive Dip for Tacos and Veggies
ingredients: 1 can drained ripe olives | 1 envelope dry italian salad dressing mix | 1 can drained drained roasted sweet peppers ( i like to use chipotle chiles ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 1/2 cups tequila | 1/2 cup pitted green olives
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in bowl and mix till well blended. Stir tequila into mixture until blended. Fold in green olives and mix well.

title: Soy Nori Pasta With Corned Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 cups cooked macaroni | 8 ounces salt pork, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/3 cup orange liqueur, of your choice | 2 ounces broccoli stems, cut into 2 inch pieces | salt, to taste
instructions: Cut the macaroni in quarters. Arrange the macaroni on a dish. Cut a lengthwise slit in each piece of salt pork. Dice the salt pork and cut the slices into strips, place on top of the macaroni. Heat the oil in a large skillet, add a little bit of the salt pork drippings and fry for about 3 minutes, until the salt pork and crispy pork are golden brown. Drain over paper towel and set aside. Wipe out the skillet very well after frying the slices. Add the orange liqueur and fry for 1 minute. Drain the macaroni well, add to the pan and stir fry for 3 minutes, remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towel. Arrange the cooked macaroni on top of the meat and vegetable, drizzle with the oil and serve.

title: Maryann's Old Hanoi Crab Cakes
ingredients: 3 ounces crabmeat | 1 ounce dark red kidney beans, cleaned, picked over, and chopped fine | 1/2 g fresh mace | 1/2 ml white wine | 1/2 ml crushed fresh crushed fresh mace
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Mix well again. Cover and chill before serving. This will keep in the refrigerator for several days, although it is better when chilled at least 1hour before serving.

title: Roast Beef With Molasses and Thyme
ingredients: 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 1 lb roast or 1 lb beef, of your choice
instructions: Mix molasses and thyme and spread generously on both sides of the meat. Let stand for 1 hour, then bake or grill until done.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,cabbage,ginger garlic paste,chili powder,risotto rice,hot water,cooking oil
title: Chinese Cabbage With Rice
ingredients: 1 cabbage | 1 cup risotto rice | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 cups hot water | 1 tablespoon chilli powder | salt and pepper
instructions: Wash and remove the outer outer green leaves of the cabbage. Cut into shreds. Peel the outer green leaves if any. Make sure they are the same width that the cabbage is thick and cut into shreds. Peel once more. Wash and remove the outer green leaves if any. Cut the cabbage into thin ribbons. Prepare the seasoning with the oil and ginger garlic paste. Stir until blended. Pour the hot water over the rice in a thick based pot which is not deep enough to pour the water. Add salt and chili powder, stir. Bring to the boil, lower heat, and cook, covered, for 15 minutes and then put on the lid and continue to cook for 10 more minutes. Turn off heat and leave for 10 minutes. Put the lid back on the pot and leave for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes open pot. Stir rice and cabbage. Add seasoning, and serve hot.

title: Vanilla Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | 150 g mushrooms, sliced | 100 g asparagus, sliced diagonally | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | butter
instructions: Cut wings at joints. Mix all the ingredients together and add to chicken. Let it marinate overnight at room temperature or for 8 to 10 hours in the fridge. Cook on bbq and fry until golden brown. Serve with hot cream.

title: Beef and Beetroot Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, fat trimmed and cut into strips | 1/4 lb beetroot, trimmed, chopped | 1/4 lb cauliflower floret, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoots, drained, chopped | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: In a large saucepan, stir together beef, beetroot, cauliflower, bamboo shoots and sugar. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer gently for 1 to 2 hours or until beef and beetroot are tender. Serve warm.

title: Slow Cooker Irish Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lamb shank | 2 tablespoons espresso | 1 cup italian sweet sausage, cut in to bite size pieces
instructions: Cut lamb in to 2 by 2 pieces, then into 1 inch chunks. Place lamb in slow cooker. Stir in espresso. Cover and cook on low setting for 4 hours. About 20 minutes before serving, stir in sausage.

title: Slim-goed Tortilla Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons italian parsley, fresh chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet chili flakes | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 8 ounces escarole, diced | 7 soft tortillas
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the tortillas and parsley. To prepare the beans, combine beans, escarole and chili flakes. Sprinkle the mixture over the tortillas. Serve at room temperature, or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: double acting baking powder,taco seasoning mix,green pepper,currant,superfine sugar
title: Taco Bell Spanish Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 15 ounces taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon double-acting baking powder | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 cup fresh currants | 1 medium green pepper, seeded and finely diced
instructions: Prepare taco bell seasoning according to packet instructions. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chicken Croissant
ingredients: 1 large poundcake | 3 pounds boneless chicken thighs | 2 1/2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut poundcake into 20 squares. Cut chicken, skin side down, into 18 squares. Place in a baking dish. Mix together the yeast and 1 package of the pound cake cubes and sprinkle this over the chicken. Cover and let rise in a warm place. Bake 350 degrees f for 2 hours, turning once. Bread should be golden.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,hot chili sauce,rye flour
title: Fried Rye Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 1 cup rye flour ( i use the kind in the ethnic aisle at the grocery store ) | 1 cup sweet hot chili sauce ( i prefer jalapeno mild, but not quite as hot ) | 1/4 cup finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll into a ball. If dough is sticky, add more flour. Place on a floured surface, cover with plastic wrap, and let rest for 10 minutes. Heat a large skillet on medium high heat. Coat pan with oil. When hot, place tortilla in pan and heat, about 20 seconds per side, until top is light brown. Remove tortilla from skillet and place on paper towels. Repeat process until all dough is used. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wheat berry,herb,white vinegar,parsley,chestnut mushroom,red chili pepper,heavy whipping cream,pork
title: Chilli Con Carne
ingredients: 3/4 cup chestnut mushroom, roughly chopped | 8 ounces fresh minced pork ( or sausage ) | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream, cold | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 1 red chili pepper, de-seeded and finely chopped | 3/4 cup whole wheat berries, soaked in warm water | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f lightly oil an 8 x8 inch baking dish. Place the mushrooms, pork and vinegar in a saucepan over medium high heat, stirring to combine with a wooden spoon or stir continuously until the pork slices are cooked, around 5 - 7 minutes. Add cream and herbs and simmer for 2 minutes. Spoon the mixture into the baking dish, then scatter over the chile pepper. Place the whole wheat berries into a bowl, pour water over to cover and leave to soak until soft. Drain the berries well and stir through the berry liquid and parsley. Serves 8.

title: Tofu With Beef and Tofu in Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 16 ounces firm tofu, drained and cut into bite-sized cubes | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 3 tablespoons queso fresco or 3 tablespoons kefalotiri ( mexican crumbly cheese ), divided - 2/3 cup | hot water
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Cut beef tenderloin crosswise in half lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/2 inch wide slices. Place steak, cheese and 1 tablespoon of cilantro in a 9x13 inch piece of aluminum foil. Drizzle each with about 1 teaspoon of hot water. Spread beef mixture evenly over beef in foil and transfer to broiler. Broil until beef is bubbly and beginning to brown, 5 to 7 minutes, turning once, about 5 minutes remaining. Serve with remaining 1 tablespoon cilantro and 1 tablespoon monterey jack cheese.

title: Tampa Bay Dip
ingredients: 1 cup prepared dressing | 2 1/2 teaspoons sage
instructions:
Dressing : | 2 fluid ounces prepared salad dressing 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Combine the 2 1/2 teaspoons sage and 2 1/2 teaspoons sage in a small bowl.

title: Italian Pear Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb ricotta cheese | 1 cup baby spinach | 1/2 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 1 ripe pear, peeled and sliced | 1/3 cup milk
instructions: Combine ricotta cheese and spinach in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,white cheddar cheese,mustard seed,cilantro leaf,peanut
title: White Christmas Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking rolled oats ( not instant ) | 1 cup minced white cheddar cheese ( or mild ) | 1/3 cup chopped peanuts ( or cashews ) | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Pour the first 13 ingrdients in a small bowl. Stir with a fork to combine the ingredients. Heat a large skillet or griddle over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Pour the oat mixture in and spread the oat mixture on the skillet with a spatula. The top surface of the oat should be opaque and slightly dry. Turn half the oat mixture on top of the other half, pressing lightly in any loose grains. When the oat mixture has become translucent, turn the oatmeal oat mixture again, pressing down firmly on the oat mixture. Turn over and spread the oat mixture back on top, again pressing lightly. Place a platter over the skillet and quickly turn the oat mixture into it. If the oatmeal oat mixture becomes excessively dry, add about 1/2 cup of water. Allow the oat mixture to cool, covered with a tea towel, for 12 - 18 minutes. Remove the oat mixture from the pan. Using a sharp knife or a small knife, tear the oat and oat into pieces about 1/2 square each. Store them in a tightly lidded jar in a cool dry place for up to 6 weeks. Oats can be made 3 days ahead. Reheat gently in a 325 degree oven.

Random Ingredients: pork,heavy whipping cream,beef tenderloin,salmon fillet,champagne vinegar,asiago cheese
title: Auberge Smoked Salmon and Asiago Cheese Fillet With Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 tablespoon gin or 1 tablespoon champagne vinegar | 1 teaspoon heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon grated asiago cheese, plus more for garnish | 1 tablespoon prepared minced smoked pork | 4 slices smoked salmon fillets | 8 ounces smoked pork and asiago cheese blend, cut into 8 thin slices
instructions: Put the gin, cream, and cheese in a large bowl. Set aside until needed. Heat a hot, lightly oiled ridged grill pan over medium high heat and spray with nonstick cooking oil spray. Arrange the smoked salmon slices on the grill. Cook until the salmon slices curl and start to brown around the edges, about 2 minutes. Transfer the fish to a platter and keep warm. Increase heat to high. Deglaze the pan with the vinaigrette using a little more vinegar. Cook until reduced by half, about 1 minute. Sprinkle over the smoked salmon fillets and top salmon fillets with the asiago cheese slices.

Random Ingredients: wheat pastry flour,balsamic vinegar,cider vinegar,sumac,basil leaf,white flour,extra virgin olive oil
title: Basil and Sumac Biscuits
ingredients: 3 large cups whole wheat pastry flour | 3 cups white flour | 3 1/2 teaspoons ground basil leaves | 3 1/2 teaspoons sumac | 3 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 3 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 7 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: To make crust, stir together flour, basil, sumac and vinegar. Add olive oil and olive oil while stirring vigorously. Do not overmix. Turn out onto floured surface and lightly knead gently. Roll out to desired size. Cut with cookie cutter or other 3/4 inch to 1/2 inch thickness. Using an oiled pastry wheel, cut out cookies. Place on greased baking sheet that has been brushed with olive oil. Bake at 375 degrees f. When nicely browned, turn over and bake on other side.

title: Fyka Toast (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 2 )
ingredients: 100 g fresh yeast | 2 tablespoons low fat curd cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley | 2 slices rye bread
instructions: Combine yeast, cottage cheese & parsley in bowl, mix. Dip bread in mixture and cook in a non stick frypan over medium high heat, for 3 - 5 mins, turning frequently till golden & crumbly.

title: Kebab-Inspired Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 boneless beef tenderloin | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place beef in a self sealing plastic bag, and top with cayenne pepper. Refrigerate for up to 1 week or up to 3 days. Prepare grill for high heat. Grill about 7 minutes per side, or to desired doneness.

title: Apple Diced Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 2 lbs apples or 2 lbs pears | 1 - 1 1/2 cup fish stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons celery seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Using a food processor or blender puree the apples. Combine them with any accumulated juices and season with salt. Add a litle water if it gets too thick. Store in the refrigerator until needed. Note, you may use fresh apples too if you prefer less tartness.

Random Ingredients: chinese egg noodle vermicelli,garlic,sriracha sauce,baking soda
title: Easy Asian Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1 package chinese egg noodles or 2 teaspoons dried vermicelli, broken | 1/2 cup sweet garlic, minced or 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 tablespoon a.1. original spicy sriracha sauce, 2 more teaspoons of a | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: In a bowl, combine noodles, garlic, a 1 and srsiacha sauce and baking soda and mix well. Drop by heaping tablespoons onto oiled cookie sheet.. Let cool 15 minutes. Turn off heat, and spoon desired amount onto noodles.

title: Thai Pork and Eggplant (Aubergine) Rolls
ingredients: 400 g long grain rice | 1 teaspoon salt pork, finely chopped or 1 teaspoon finely chopped chili | 1 eggplant, cut into 3mm cubes | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 2 -4 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1 teaspoon chili paste, to taste
instructions: Cook noodles until tender. Drain noodles, return to pan. Bring a small pan of water to the boil. Cook rice until 'al dente', drain, return to pan. Add salt pork or chlle and eggplant. Stir in cornflour, mix well. Heat through. Serve over hot sticky rice.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,corn,white bean,caper,lemongrass,coconut cream,celery rib,serrano chilies
title: Calypso Beans (Antiguan Style)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked white beans ( canned or from a can of white beans ) | 1 cup canned black-eyed peas | 1 cup frozen corn | 1/4 cup lemongrass | 8 serrano chilies | 1/4 cup shredded coconut cream | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 tablespoon capers
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender blend for 10 - 15 seconds. Pour into a large pot simmer for 45 minutes or until beans are cooked.

title: Green Beans in Soyy Sauce
ingredients: 5 green beans, trimmed | 2 -3 black cardamom pods ( or 10-15 black seeds - 1 black palm only ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Heat a large wok or frying pan, adding fish sauce, 2 or 3 fresh grinds of black cardamon pods and 3 or 4 finely chopped black palm leaves. Once it starts to crackle a little, add the green beans. Stir fry to cover with liquid. Add some water, lower the heat and simmer until the beans just start to soften, usually around 5 minutes. Add a touch more fish sauce if necessary. Note, it tastes quite hot, so don't let it boil. Note, depending on the variety of beans in your food, you may need to cook a little more than the original recipe or it may need to be thinened with a little more fish sauce. Serve over steamed greens.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,serrano pepper,graham cracker crumb,sesame oil,broccoli,yellow food coloring
title: Broccoli With Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1/4 cup sesame oil, divided | 2 lbs broccoli, tops cut off | 6 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 4 teaspoons yellow food coloring | 6 ounces graham cracker crumbs | 2 serrano peppers, slices cut into slivers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a small bowl, combine sesame oil, broccoli tops and five spice powder. Toss with a large spoon or in a food processor until evenly blended. Spread broccoli on a parchment lined baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,liquid pectin,peanut oil vegetable,tahini,beef,port wine,white pearl onion
title: Mongolian Beef
ingredients: 8 ounces beef, boneless sirloin tip, trimmed, cut into 1 inch pieces | 8 ounces white pearl onions, peeled, halved | 8 ounces yellow peppers, julienned, cut into strips | 1/2 cup white port wine | 4 ounces tahini | 1/2 cup liquid pectin ( or substitute one packet beef flavoured tahini ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Put meat in a large bowl and toss in onions, red peppers, wine, and 1 cup of the pectin. Let marinate at least 30 minutes or up to 8 hours. Drain, reserving marinade. Heat 1/2 cup of the reserved cooking liquid in a saucepan over high heat. When boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer until beef is almost cooked through about 10 minutes. When beef is done, remove it and set aside and keep warm. Add another 1/2 cup cooking liquid to skillet and boil until reduced to a thick sauce consistency. Add 3 tbsp of the tahini sauce to skillet and simmer until it has thickened. Turn off heat, add the remainder of the tahini sauce and the reserved beef and onions, and let mixture stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Rutabaga Crunch
ingredients: 2 cups oats | 2 cups rutabagas, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon accent seasoning | 1 packet dry salad seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. In a large bowl combine dry salad, oat meal, accent, and oat meal mix. Add rutabagas and mix. Transfer mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or parchment paper. Bake in 400f degrees oven until puffed, bubbly and golden brown. Remove and let drain on a rack.

Random Ingredients: half,soya milk,chipotle powder,salmon,mandarin orange segment,pepper sauce
title: Grilled Salmon With Mandarin Oranges, Soy Milk Masala & Chipotle Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound salmon, cut into 4 pieces | 2 tablespoons light soya milk | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 2 tablespoons chipotle powder, or more to taste | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce, or more to taste | 1 can mandarin orange segments, drained and rinsed
instructions: Combine salmon pieces, soy milk, half and half, chipotle powder, hot pepper sauce and oranges in a baking dish or bowl. Cover salmon with plastic wrap and marinate salmon 15 minutes. Place pan over medium heat, cover, and cook salmon for 15 to 20 minutes, until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Place the orange curds into a bowl and microwave on high until warmed, about 1 minute. Spoon the orange sauce over salmon.

title: Rosemary Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 1 large rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit. Combine the meat, rosemary, 1/2 loaf of crusty loaf, and the other 3/4 loaf. Mix everything up well, or you can put as much as you like i do about 1/4 1/2 to 1/3 of an inch in all.

Random Ingredients: chive,linguine,porcini mushroom,de arbol,chinese cabbage,purpose flour,chicken flavor bouillon
title: Chicken Chow Mein
ingredients: 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 1 1/2 pounds linguine | 10 ounces chicken flavor instant bouillon | 1 cup chopped chinese cabbage | 1/4 cup minced fresh chives | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, divided | 4 tablespoons thinly sliced chives, divided | 8 ounces dried currant-stuffed chinese cabbage
instructions: Place the dried mushrooms in a skillet, and pour a few inches of water over them to soak. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the linguine, and cook until tender, about 9 minutes. Drain. Place the chicken flavor bouillon and 2/3 c water into the skillet, and bring to a boil. Remove from the heat. Cover, and set aside for 20 minutes. Stir in the chives, and set aside. Place 3/4 c cabbage in the bottom of a large dish, and spoon half the noodles over it. Sprinkle the chives over the noodles, and divide the rest of the noodle mixture among the 4 serving dish. Top with the shredded chicken breasts, currants, and 1 tablespoon of chives. The remaining 1 tablespoon chives can be garnished with remaining chives.

title: German Sauerkraut Dip
ingredients: 1 lb sauerkraut, drained | 1 lb sour cream or 1 lb low-fat sour cream | 1/2 cup drained capers | 2 medium vidalia onions, thinly sliced | 1 package pignoli nuts
instructions: Line bottom half of a large bowl with sauerkraut. Stir in sour cream. Add the capers. Sprinkle the onions on top. Drain the pignoli nuts. Top with the onion slices, patting the nuts in slightly. Dip with melted butter. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Brisket of Beef With Naked Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef short ribs ( preferably eye- of round ) | 3 cups canned navy beans, rinsed well | 2 cups cashew nuts | 3 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons grenadine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place beef on roasting pan. Roast in oven until well browned, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven, and set aside. Reduce oven temperature to 300°f. Place beans in small saucepan with cold water. Bring to boil over medium heat, and cook uncovered, until just tender, about 10 minutes. Drain beans, reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Heat cashew nuts in small skillet over medium low heat, and toast them, stirring frequently, until lightly carmelized, about 10 minutes. Place nuts on plates, and set aside. Briefly return beef to roasting pan. Roast in oven 20 minutes at 300°f. Remove meat from pan. Place on carving board. Cover, and keep warm. Strain onions evenly into saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until slightly reduced, about 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in mustard seeds. Stir in reserved beans, reduce heat to low, and simmer, stirring frequently, until beans turn slightly brown, about 5 minutes. Discard any browned onions. Stir in brandy or grenadine. Slice meat against the grain. Serve beans on a platter, with onion sauce.

title: Ziti Beef & Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 2 packages ziti pasta | 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut in 1 inch cubes | 1 head cabbage ( about 1/2 pound ) or 1 head napa cabbage, cored & shredded | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1 medium banana, sliced
instructions: Heat a dutch oven over medium high heat until hot. Add tenderloins & bring to a boil. Place ziti in the pot & cover. Cook for 10 minutes.. Add cabbage, bamboo shoots & pepper & cook uncovered for about 4 minutes. Add meat & cook for 5 minutes or until the meat is tender. Do not over cook. Serve with bread crumbs.

title: Spicy Spiced Sausage With Cucumber Raita
ingredients: 1 package good quality pork sausage ( cut into 1/4 inch slices ) | 1 medium cucumber ( diced ) | 1 ripe water chestnut ( diced ) | 1/4 red onion ( diced small, about 1/4 cup ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 1/2 tablespoons cold water, if desired
instructions: Prepare the sweet dough recipe. In a large bowl stir together the sweet dough ingredients. If you like your dough a little stiff, you can also add a dash or two of cocoa powder which gives the dough a nice texture. Let dough rest in the refrigerator while preparing the other ingredients. Combine the sweet dough and meat in a bowl and mix well. Roll dough out 1 inch thick on a floured surface and cut with a 3 1/2 round cookie cutter. If your dough is very thick, you can add a touch more water. Dip your 1st cutter in cold water one or two times so the dough doesn't stick together. Heat pan over medium high heat. You can also use a deep skillet or other non stick skillet. Add pork slices. Brown on both sides. Remove to paper towels and sprinkle with additional cocoa powder or your choice of spices to taste. Enjoy with your favorite fruit and veggies while piping hot.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,roast beef,cardamom pod,radish,cold water,squid,enchilada sauce
title: Calabacitas
ingredients: 10 -12 ounces roast beef, diced very small | 1 small sweet potato or 1 small yukon gold potato, diced very small | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed or 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 4 ounces enchilada sauce | 4 ounces cold water | 3 -5 tablespoons cold water | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Pre heat the broiler. In a medium size bowl, add the diced beef. Add the sweet potato or yucca and stir gently. Add the cardamom and toss gently again. Add 1 teaspoons of the enchilada sauce and add 1 to 2 tablespoons of cold water. Mix to blend. Add bay leaf. Add additional 1 to 2 tablespoons of enchilada sauce if desired. If desired, stir in a few dashes of additional salt and pepper to taste. Place in a broiling dish, covered, and broil in the broiler until meat is no longer pink inside, about 8 - 10 minutes. Serve warm as a main course.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,penne pasta,maple syrup,granny smith apple,yellow bell pepper,horseradish,parsnip
title: Roasted Parsnip and Apple Penne With Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, peeled and cut in to 1/2 wedges | 1 medium granny smith apple, peeled cored and finely diced | 1 red chili pepper, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, cored, seeded and cut into 1/4 inch wedges | 1 tablespoon grated horseradish | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 lb penne pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Arrange parsnips and apple in a large baking pan. Arrange pepper slices on top. In a small bowl combine horseradish and horseradish mixture. Spoon horseradish and horseradish mixture over vegetables. Sprinkle parsnips and apple with remaining horseradish and horseradish mixture. Bake in preheated 375 degrees oven 40 to 50 minutes or until hot and sizzling. Serve over hot cooked penne.

title: Chilled Raisins With Mint
ingredients: 1/2 lb raisins ( about 3 3/4 cups ) | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Place raisins in a strainer and rinse under cold running water till water turns milky white. Soak the raisins in a bowl of warm water about 5 minutes, and drain. Cover, and chill for 1 hour. Strain and set aside at room temperature about 15 minutes before using. Meanwhile, cover a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside. Transfer the chilled raisins to a medium bowl, and stir in the mint and lemon juice. Using a slotted spoon, mash the raisins until smooth. Transfer to glass jars with a slotted spout or spoon. Seal with new lids, and process in a boiling water bath for 15 minutes. Let cool. Store in a dark, cool, dark pantry.

title: Kiri-Yogurt Vodka Swiss Monte Cristo (With Variations)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 1/2 tablespoons vodka | 1 ounce low-fat swiss cheese, julienned | 2 ounces jalapeno pepper, sliced | 2 ounces low-fat yogurt
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat broth and mirin over medium to low heat. Stir in vodka and then cheese. Heat until cheese is melted then stir in jalepenos and yogurt. Serve hot with dippers.

title: Quick Pizza Topping
ingredients: 2/3 cup country-style bread flour | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 3 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Mix the bobblet sauce, anchovies, bacon and basil together. Mix well. Spread on your favorite pizza crust or pizza dough. Use as you would regular pizza dough.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,salsa,rice noodle,egg yolk,italian tomato,white flour
title: Italian Sausage Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 4 cups cooked rice noodles | 2/3 cup salsa | 2 egg yolks | 1 cup unbleached white flour | 4 cups shredded swiss cheese ( preferably aged cheddar ) | 1 cup diced italian tomatoes ( not drained of any of its liquid )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked noodles and salsa. Mix well. Add the egg yolks, stirring well. Add the flour and mix. Drain the tomatoes and stir them into the egg mixture. Spread 1 cup of the mixture in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Lay the rice noodles on top. Drizzle evenly with the tomato and swiss cheese mixture. Cover with foil. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove foil and cook 10 - 25 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,turmeric,oregano,monterey jack cheese,canola oil,mayonnaise,jalapeno pepper,peanut butter
title: Smoky Jalapeno Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 jalapeno pepper, minced | 1/2 tablespoon red chile pepper, minced | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 pound shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the mayonnaise, jalapeno pepper, red pepper, peanut butter, oregano, and turmeric together in a bowl until smooth. Spread a thin layer of the sauce evenly on the bottom of a 9x10 inch baking dish. Place the shredded cheese into a separate, narrow bowl. Spread the jalapeno pepper mixture onto the cheese evenly, and spread to a thin layer. Top with the remaining cheese, and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is a light, golden, and bubbly, about 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,shiitake mushroom,green grape,caper,cherry jam,dark soy sauce,salt black pepper,sauce
title: Japanese Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 tablespoons cherry jam | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon sweet sauce | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 pinch hot sauce
instructions: Prepare boiling water for mushrooms, then soak for 15 minutes. Remove stems from mushrooms, rinse in cold water.

title: Tori Kara Age - Japanese Chicken with Cabbage
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken legs | 1/2 lb finely sliced cabbage | 1/2 lb finely sliced feta | 1/3 cup sake | 1/3 cup mixed herbs
instructions: Wash the chicken and remove the skin. Cut the meat into serving sized pieces. Heat water to the boil and add cabbage. Cook for 10 minutes and then drain the water. Place in a dish and add the salt, sake or fig juice. Pour the broth over the chicken and cabbage and serve.

Random Ingredients: date,beer,beet,vegetable stock,mascarpone cheese,beef broth,garlic paste,puff pastry
title: Mama's Beef Wellingtons
ingredients: 4 ounces beef broth | 4 ounces mascarpone cheese | 12 small puff pastry sheets | 1/4 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/2 cup dates, sliced | 1/2 cup low sodium beef broth | 8 ounces dry dates | 1 cup vegetable stock | grated pimento-stuffed beets, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f in a medium saucepan, combine the beef stock, mascarpone cheese and the garlic paste. Bring to boil and then lower heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the mixture is smooth. Pour the contents of the pan into a shallow bowl, tipping it into the bowl with the beef. Stir the dates and beef broth into this mixture. Cover with a piece of aluminium foil and put the dish out to cool for 10 minutes. Lightly flour an 11x17 baking dish. Lay out the puff pastry and cut four 4 inch squares. Pour half the beef mixture into each square of pastry and place on top of the beef. Dot with half the date mixture and then top with the remaining beef mixture and top with the rest of the pastry and date filling. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until it is golden and bubbling.

title: Puerto Rican Rice Tacos
ingredients: 4 cups rice | 1 can tuna | 3/4 cup thick & chunky salsa
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Bring 2 gallons of water to a boil, add 2 tbsp salt. Add rice, and let rice boil for 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, remove rice and place in the oven. Wash can and place in bowl, fill with water in bowl to cover rice, and steam for 20 minutes. You need to put a bowl in the sink in the sink. Stir often so it doesn't burn as the water cooks. When the water is boiling, add tuna, and salsa, cover pot, and place in oven.

title: Auntie Lori's Spanish Green and Red Sirloin Dip
ingredients: 1 package frozen green sweet peppers, thawed | 2 tablespoons minced onions | 2 tablespoons onion powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a zip lock bag and refrigerate overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Negima
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs sirloin, cut into slices about | 3 stalks green onions, chopped | 1 chicken stock cube | 2 sheets nori
instructions: Marinade, mix all ingredients together. Place on serving dish and keep warm for a few minutes, or set aside to let beef absorb some of the flavour from cooking and serve with rice, or as a side dish. Note, the nori may be bought tuna, beef, chicken or fish depending on your preferences.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,cumin powder,orange juice,milk,plain flour,red lentil,chipotle chile adobo,herb
title: Mushroom and Lentil Raita
ingredients: 200 g red lentils | 1 bunch fresh white mushroom | 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 150 g plain flour | 2 tablespoons dried herbs, basil, savory & oregano, chopped | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles in adobo, roughly chopped | 100 ml milk
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 f, 200°c. Boil the lentils in their water for 10 - 15 minutes until cooked through. Chop mushrooms and brown in a frying pan with the cumin, orange juice, flour, herbs and chipotles. Add this to the lentils and bring back to a boil. Add milk or water to cover the lentils and mix through. Transfer the lentils to an ovenproof casserole dish and bake for 20 minutes at 400°f. Serve.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,cannelloni tube,butter,green bean,chicken bouillon granule,black pepper,chicken stock,wheat flour
title: Chicken and Bean Mini Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chicken stock, boiling | 3 cups shredded whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 cups cannelloni tubes | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules or 1 teaspoon instant chicken stock powder | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 250 g dried whole green beans | 10 tablespoons unsalted butter
instructions: Combine stock and boiling liquid in a bowl, stirring until boiling. Add 1 cup flour, cannelloni, knead to combine. Place in a medium bowl with remaining flour, salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: green onion,asparagus,chicken stock vegetable,broccoli floret,catsup,worcestershire sauce,de provence,lemon peel
title: Irish Broccoli, Asparagus & Broccoli Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 package fresh broccoli florets | 1 package frozen asparagus, thawed | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 1/4 cup chicken stock or 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil or 1/4 teaspoon dried parsley | 1/8 teaspoon dried french-style mustard greens or 1/8 teaspoon lemon peel | 1 green onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients except green onions in a wok or shallow dish. Cook over medium high heat for several minutes or until vegetables are just tender crisp. Remove from wok and place on serving platter. Sprinkle with green onion.

title: Alfredo Sauce III
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup alfredo sauce ( homemade if possible ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add sugar and thyme. Cook about 1 minute, stirring. Add vegetable stock, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Strain sauce into saucepan. Add alfredo sauce and soy sauce. Heat over low heat until warm. Stirring all the while.

title: Figs
ingredients: 4 firm ripe figs, washed and cut to remove stems | 1 small hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1 tablespoon capers | 1/2 cup green coriander, chopped | 1 package taco seasoning | 1/2 cup low fat plain yogurt | 1/3 cup cornstarch
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the figs, eggs, capers, coriander, and taco seasoning. Spoon yogurt over the fig mixture and gently stir to combine. Chill. To serve, line an icecream cone with plastic wrap. Remove the icecream cone from the freezer and place in freezer. Once the ice cream cone has frozen, add the mint and stir to coat the entire outside of the cone with mint.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,turnip,self rising flour,yellow squash,picante sauce,self raising flour
title: Turnip and Mushroom Scrolls
ingredients: 8 ounces self-rising flour | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 2/3 cup self-raising vegetable cooking spray or 2/3 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 cup yellow squash, diced | 1/2 cup turnip, diced | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, chopped | 1 cup picante sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. In a medium bowl mix together the flour and oil. Add in the carrots, squash, and mushrooms and mix. Mix in the self raising flour and mix well. The dough should be firm but will not be sticky. Place about 1 tablespoon on baking tray and spray with vegetable oil. Place on top of baking paper in two small batches. Bake for 15 minutes. Once cooled sprinkle with additional picante. Serve with fruit sauce.

title: Raspberry Mousse
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice milk, boiled | 4 -5 ripe tomatoes | 3 ounces raspberry jam | 0.5 can beer | 3 teaspoons tomato ketchup
instructions: Place the raspberries, jam, and beer in a blender and blend until smooth. Add the tomato ketchup and blend just until you can see the mixed colours of the jam. Pour into glasses and refrigerate for 2 - 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,red potato,cake flour,thai fish sauce,salmon fillet,asparagus
title: Spiced Salmon
ingredients: 4 tablespoons curry paste or 4 tablespoons prepared brown curry paste, for a lighter flavour | 4 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 4 lbs white salmon fillets, cut into 2. 5cm wide diagonal slices | 2 1/4 cups unseasoned cake flour | 1 cup red potatoes | fresh ground white pepper, to taste
instructions: Make the curry paste, place curry paste in a heatproof bowl. Add fish sauce, cover and place in the refrigerator for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Coat an ovenproof frypan with cooking spray. Place the potato slices in a bowl of cold water and microwave for 1 - 2 minutes until the potatoes are just tender. Drain. Place the flour in a pile on top of each other and the white pepper. Dredge the fish slices in the seasoned flour, shaking off any excess flour. Place the fish onto the plate of curry paste, pressing to remove any excess. Scatter over any curry paste left in the frypan and spread with the fish sauce. Place on the oven shelf and bake for 12 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and golden brown and the potatoes are tender. Place the salmon on top of the vegetables in a serving dish and serve.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,sea salt,chili powder,irish cream,espresso powder,breadcrumb,brandy,onion
title: Smoked Irish Pulled Pork With Espresso Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1/2 cup coarse dried breadcrumbs | 2/3 cup dried onion ( roughly chopped ) | 2 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 1 teaspoon chili powder | sea salt | brandy ( optional ) | chili powder
instructions: In a bowl, toss pork with bread crumbs. Roll into 3 inch meatballs and brown. Drain and discard any excess fat. Combine all of the ingredients. Roll and tie in foil. Spray 4 - 6 quart slow cooker with pam. Put meatballs in slow cooker and cover with brandy. Cook 8 - 10 hours on low or 4 - 5 hours on high. Discard foil and serve in crock or gravy bowls with a side of gravy or fresh vegetables.

title: Chocolate Crumbs
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, softened | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1 cup asiago cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: In a medium bowl, cream together butter and cocoa. Stir in asiago cheese. Remove from heat. Stir in turmeric.

title: Lentils With Dried Onions
ingredients: 32 ounces dry green lentils | 2 1/2 cups molasses
instructions: Soak the lentils in 2 1/2 cups of water until the water is clear and the lentils are plumper. Drain. In a 2 1/2 cups measuring cup, add 1 1/2 2 tablespoons of molasses or treacle, mix well, and set aside. Put one 1/4 cup of molasses in a 3 quart saucepan over medium heat, stirring often, until it begins to bubble. Add the lentils, raise a heat to medium, and put a lid on the saucepan.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,cayenne pepper,cheese tortellini,ladyfinger,cream corn,fish,five spice powder,saffron thread
title: Cheese Tortellini With Saffron Cream Corn
ingredients: 1 container soft goat cheese tortellini, cooked | 12 ounces pork loin, grilled shredded | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 1/2 ounces fresh shrimp or 1 1/2 ounces cooked shrimp, chopped | 1 box frozen cheese tortellini, cooked | 1/3 - 1/2 cup fish, drained and chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons saffron threads, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Prepare tortellini according to package directions. When done, drain and keep warm. Make cream corn, while tortellini are cooking, in a saucepan, warm cream style corn just until warm. Add a little warm cream cheese to warm cream corn just before serving. Place finished cream corn on serving dish and top with a little warm cream corn. If desired, serve on bed of fresh chopped lettuce.

title: Beef, Clam and White Bean Salad With Noodles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 500 g rump steak, cut into strips | 2 leeks, chopped | 1 leek, white and green parts, sliced | 1 red shallot, finely sliced | 1 can white beans, drained | 400 g raw red potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 bottle red wine vinegar | 200 g egg noodles
instructions: Heat oil in a large frying pan. Add beef and cook until lightly browned. Transfer to a bowl. Add leeks to pan and cook 3 mins until crisp tender. Add leek, shallot and white beans to pan. Cook for 2 mins until softened. Return meat to pan. Pour in vinegar. Cover and cook over a high heat for 3 mins, stirring from time to time. Add egg noodles and simmer for 3 mins until egg noodles are just tender.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,italian sausage link,kaffir lime leaf
title: Italian Sausage and Potato Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 pound bulk sweet italian sausage links | 3 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed | 20 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Wash potatoes and pat dry using paper towels. In a large skillet, over medium heat, cook sausage until evenly brown. Drain grease from pan. In a medium bowl, combine sausage and potatoes. Stir in lime leaves. Shape mixture into 8 patties. Grill patties 10 minutes on each side, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,beef brisket,rice wine,habanero pepper,apricot,pico de gallo,chuck roast,deli roast beef
title: Hoisin Beef and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs chuck roast, trimmed of fat | 12 ounces dried apricots | 10 dried apricots | 1/2 lb deli roast beef or 1/2 lb sirloin roast | 1/2 lb deli roast beef or 1/2 lb hot pork, sliced thin | 1/2 lb julienne cooked beef brisket | 1/2 cup pico de gallo | 4 ounces cooked and drained ramen noodles
instructions: Place beef in roasting pan. Sprinkle with dried apricots & apricots. Place fat side down on rack in shallow pan. Roast at 500 degrees for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool and shred meat using two forks. Arrange beef on a platter & refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Remove strings from apricots & apricots. Slice open the meat & remove any bones & gristle. Slice the meat into 1/4 pieces & arrange on top of apricots & apricots. Arrange the beef on top of apricots. Cut and dice the beef into small pieces & arrange on top of beef. Toss the pico de gallo with the ramen noodles in a medium sized bowl. Serve on a large platter or individual plates with beef.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,coriander,vanilla essence,red curry paste,italian parsley,leaf lettuce,jalapeno pepper,pineapple tidbit
title: Red Curry Leaf Salad
ingredients: 4 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 4 slices pineapple tidbits | 2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped jalapeno peppers | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander | 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried fruit or 1/2 teaspoon crushed pineapple powder
instructions: Place lettuce, pineapple, chopped italian parsley, jalapeno peppers, corriander, red curry paste, bicarb, vanilla essence. Mix well. Top with crushed pineapple or other tropical fruit. Serve with steaming hot bread, melba toast, or toasted rice.

title: Swiss Cheese and Raspberry Jam Sandwich
ingredients: 3 slices swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Spread cheese with jam. Add pepper to taste. Cut in half diagonally. Serve with crackers or assorted crackers.

title: Pineapple Salsa Fresca De Molcajete
ingredients: 3 cans crushed pineapple, drained | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Combine the crushed pineapple with the lime juice and serve.

title: Quick Taco Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef sirloin steak | 1 head bibb lettuce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup beef stock
instructions: Trim fat from sirloin. Cut steak diagonally across grain into thin slices and then into 1/4 slices or thin bite sized pieces. Add beef slices to a large skillet and set over medium high heat. Add beef stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until meat is cooked. Remove beef and place on a warm plate. Tear lettuce and place on a baking sheet in a single layer. Place meat on lettuce and top with tomato and your favorite toppings.

title: Chop and Eat Veggie Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces cabbage, shredded | 2 tomatoes, chopped | 1 can artichoke heart, drained, chopped and oil based | 2 ounces white chocolate | 1 -2 tablespoon mango chutney
instructions: Put the cabbage, tomatoes, and artichokes in a bowl and microwave for 1 minute or until heated through. Place the oil in a small skillet and heat gently. Dump this over the veg. Toss to coat and heat everything up. Spread over salads and add the mango chutney.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,mirin,lime juice,hot sauce,vegetable oil,fillet catfish,lemon grass,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Easy Catfish and Lemongrass Soup
ingredients: 3 fillets catfish, about 1 1/2 pounds, 6-7 ounces total | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped lemongrass, ends trimmed, outer leaves removed, about 12 leaves, finely chopped | 1/3 cup mirin | 1/3 cup fresh lime juice | 2 -3 drops hot sauce | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, coarsely chopped
instructions: Light a grill pan, then arrange the catfish in one layer on the grill. Brush the fillets liberally with the oil.

title: Laffee's Beef Soup Base for Dipping
ingredients: 2 cups beef broth | 1 cup lemon grass, sliced | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Place ingredients in blender and blend on high until smooth. Serve with sliced lemons on the side.

Random Ingredients: white flour,channa dal,artificial sweetener,ginger paste,white onion
title: Ma'aloon (Moori Lentil Pie)
ingredients: 1 cup white lentils | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger paste | 1/2 tablespoon artificial sweetener | 1 medium sized white onion | 2 tablespoons white gram flour ( split bean flour in south africa ) | 3 -5 tablespoons channa dal
instructions: Soak the lentils in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain in a colander. Wash the onion in the remaining 2 - 3 tablespoons of white gram flour. Fry it in a little oil until brown. Remove the onions from the pan and add ginger paste. Saute for a minute. Add channa dal and gramflour, stir and allow it to cook for a minute or two. Add the red chilly chilly flakes and mix well. Cover and leave to cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove lid and serve hot with rotis or parantha.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,port wine,corn oil,celery salt,nori,tuna,alfredo sauce
title: Tuna and Port Kebabs With Creamy Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup port wine | 1/4 cup alfredo sauce | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemons or 1 1/2 teaspoons lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Combine the port wine, alfredo sauce, thai red curry paste, corn oil and lemon or lime juice in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,large mushroom,fish fillet,ice,baguette,sausage meat,butternut squash
title: Stuffed Fish Rolls on Bagette
ingredients: 1 lb large mushroom | 1 butternut squash, split lengthways, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 lb fresh fish fillet | 1/2 lb sausage meat | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 baguette, sliced 1/4 inch thick | crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Wash mushrooms and squash in a colander. Rinse, then slice into half moons. Lay out an oblong plate or piece of baking parchment on your counter and set aside. Cut fish fillet in half through the spine. Take out some of the soft underside of some of the lower part of the mushroom and squash and put some aside, cut side down. Take half the sausage meat and put half a portion of stuffing under the skin on the fish. Pull the flesh off the fish, but still holding the stuffing inside.

title: Mushrooms in Coconut Cream
ingredients: 12 fresh white mushrooms | 300 ml coconut cream | orange peel
instructions: Clean and wash the mushrooms. Bring the coconut cream to your boil, remove from stove. Slice the mushrooms and cut them in 2inch lengths. Sprinkle some of the orange peel in the cream. Plate up the mushrooms on a serving plate. Serve the rest of the cream in a small dish. You may serve these with fresh cream.

title: Way Too Easy Zucchini
ingredients: 6 -10 large zucchini, cleaned | hot sauce
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise and remove stalks and seeds, leaving a good 3/4 inch thick shell. Carefully remove seeds. Arrange in single layer in baking dish. Sprinkle with hot sauce. Cover and bake at 350°f for approximately 25 minutes or until zucchini is tender and begins to brown.

title: Mixed Nests Salmon Wrapped in Wrapped Creamed French Nests
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh mustard, prepared ( or your favorite mustard ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared horseradish ( i use 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish but bottled will work fine, but fresh is preferable ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons horseradish-flavored prepared horseradish ( i use 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish but bottled will work fine, but canned would work fine ) | cooked broccoli floret | 8 6 slices italian bread | 12 tortillas ( the green kind )
instructions: Combine 1 tbsp mustard with 1 1/2 tbsp horseradish. Combine 1/2 tbsp mustard and 1/3 cup horseradish. Toss with salmon until well coated. Let stand 10 - 15 minutes.. Wrap each sandwich in 1 slice italian bread. Wrap each in foil and serve.

title: Baked Mexican Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast | 3 cups long-grain white rice
instructions: The night before, place roast in roaster or casserole with enough water to cover and a large pinch of salt. Cover and let sit for 3 hours at room temperature or until cool enough to handle. Pull meat apart and put in a pot with water. Bring to a boil and skim off any foam that rises to the top. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Remove lid. Simmer, covered, another 1 1/2 hours. Remove meat and skim off fat remaining in roaster. Turn onto serving platter, sprinkle with rice, cover with cheese, and dig in.

title: Chocolate-Apricot Tapas
ingredients: 200 g dried apricots, soaked overnight and squeezed dry | 200 g black olives, pitted and chopped | 1 cup raisins
instructions: Heat oven to 160°c. Lightly grease a 20cm round cake tin. Spread the apricot soaked apricots lightly in the base of the prepared tin. Sprinkle the olives over the fruit. Spread the raisins over the fruit. Bake the tapas for 15 minutes or until firm. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,romaine lettuce,balsamic vinegar,lemon juice,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Romaine
ingredients: 8 ounces romaine lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces | 2 cups shredded fresh pecorino romano cheese | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 - 1 chipotle chiles, chopped | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped fresh romaine lettuce or 1/3 cup shredded italian seasoned dried lettuce
instructions: Toss all the ingredients together.

title: Hungarian Kielbasa & Barley
ingredients: 6 links kielbasa, cut in 2-inch pieces | 1 can chickpeas ( i use the black ones ) | 3 lbs potatoes, in 1-inch cubes | 1 dash dijon mustard | 3 tablespoons pearl barley | 3 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: Poke holes in all the sausage links with a fork. Add to boiling water. Cook slowly for 30 minutes. Drain if needed. Add to a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle 1tbsp of pearl barley on each one. Sprinkle 1tbsp potato starch over.

Random Ingredients: white bread dough,baby rocket,grape tomato,pineapple tidbit,orange zest,wheat germ,olive oil,macaroni
title: Macaroni Salad With Pineapple, Grape Tomatoes and Rocket Topping #RSC
ingredients: 200 g whole wheat bread dough ( your choice ) | 150 g macaroni, shells removed | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes | 1/4 cup pineapple tidbits ( fresh or canned ) | 1 orange, zest of ( finely grated ) | 120 g baby rocket ( about 10 ) | 2 tablespoons pineapples ( toasted and chopped ) | olive oil ( or a little extra virgin )
instructions: Bake oven, 200°c, gas mark 7 for 12 minutes. If you are using fresh macaroni, just boil them until soft and drain. If using canned tuna, drain it, don't rinse it and cut it in small chunks. Otherwise, use a good quality tuna packed in oil, not the drained tuna canned in oil. I use a fork to stab a hole in the thick bottom part of the bread dough about 1cm deep, and then pop it in the hot oven to bake for about 10 - 12 minutes. If you don't have a pizza cutter, just take up the dough about a cm apart and cut it into 6 - 8 equal circles. You'll need a cookie cutter to pop in any gaps, or whatever your cookie cutter is. I use a floured cookie cutter to do this. If your dough has tunnels when you poke one, it means you're all set to go. Cook macaroni for 10 - 12 minutes. If using canned coconut, drain it when cooked. If you're using canned pineapple, drain it when cooked. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well until everything is evenly distributed and combined. Adjust seasoning to taste. Serve in bowl, topped with macaroni croutons or as a topping for potato or zucchini salad.

title: Italian Chambord Raspberry
ingredients: 24 ounces dark seedless raisins | 1 1/2 ounces chambord raspberry liquor
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a shaker of ice & shake vigorously. Pour into a fresh glass, garnish with a green cherry, if desired, and serve.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,oregano leaf,sugar,single cream,lemon zest,broccoli,spring onion,ice
title: Roasted Broccoli in Cream-Sugar Syrup
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, separated into florets | 1 bunch spring onion, trimmed and sliced diagonally | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 1/3 cup sorghum or 1/3 cup sorghum, mixed with 3 tbsp water | 60 ml single cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar | 3 teaspoons dried oregano leaves or 3 teaspoons other mixed herbs | crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 350°f or gas mark place broccoli and spring onions in a roasting tin and drizzle with golden syrup. Roast in the oven for about 10 mins or until broccoli is tender and golden. Remove from oven and drain well. Stir together sorghum, cream, sugar, oregano and lemon zest and pour over the broccoli mixture. Cover with aluminium foil and bake for 5 mins or until hot and bubbling.

title: Avocado Salpicao
ingredients: 1 avocado - peeled, pitted, and sliced | 8 large lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup liquid smoke, or to taste
instructions: Place avocado slices in a mixing bowl. Toss lettuce with liquid smoke until limp, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pizza Strips
ingredients: 2 pounds prepared pizza crust, cut in half | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar, or more as needed | 1 small orange, juiced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread dough on a baking sheet and prick the top of dough with a fork. Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Stir pineapple, confectioners' sugar, and orange juice into the cooked dough until thoroughly mixed. Spread the pineapple filling evenly over the top of the crusts.

title: Raisin Grape Wheat
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk ( or plain yogurt ) | 4 -6 grapes ( depending on size, i like to use about 4 oz. ) or 4 -6 strawberries ( depending on size, i like to use about 4 oz. )
instructions: First, let 'the grapes absorb the yogurt'for approximately 10 minutes or so. Then, drain all of the yogurt, either with a colander, or with a strainer. Set your strainer on the lowest setting of your kitchen scale. The high setting makes the grape grain easier to wash when it drys off. You can get away with 2 teaspoons or so of yogurt for every cup of yogurt your strainer used to use, but the recipe editor can be a pain. At first, i just squish it all together a bit with my hands or the counter, but eventually after i've started working in my knuckles, it becomes a little sticky and the final yogurt will smell as good as the yogurt.

title: Easy Easy Beef Roulades
ingredients: 1 package beef stew meat, cut into one inch cubes | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2/3 cup dry red wine ( do not use cooking wine ), chilled
instructions: Mix together the beef stew meat, red wine vinegar, and chilled wine.

title: Alfredo Genovese
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces farfalle pasta | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( my addition ) | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Pour oil into skillet and heat on medium high. Add 1/4 teaspoon of mace into hot oil to make a nice red pearly blackened foaming smell. Boil the pasta until al dente, and then drain. Toss pasta with the warm oil and sprinkle ground mace into mixture. Serve.

title: Zesty Coriander Lime Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 cup coriander leaves, chopped
instructions: In a bowl, stir the lime zest, juice, and cornflour together until they have dissolved. Pour over the coriander leaves and toss to combine.

title: Tajine Nabe (Red Green Enchiladas)
ingredients: 10 soft lettuce leaves | 3/4 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 3/4 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup minced fresh coriander or 1/4 cup basil
instructions: In a large skillet, cover lettuce with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium, cover and simmer until tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Shred lettuce and combine with mirin, enchilada sauce and coriander in a bowl. Serve at once, dipping lettuce bowls in warm sauce.

title: Julia Child's Jasmine Rice With Escarole
ingredients: 6 -7 cups water ( enough water to boil into a kettle and add as many of the rice grains as your kettle can hold or you have to use 2 to 4 c water, depending on desired consistency... see note ) | 3 tablespoons margarine, melted | 4 cups escarole, cut into bite-sized pieces | 1 cup jasmine rice, long-grain, long-grain, long-grain, grainy, medium-grain, and rice arborio ( about 15 minutes or until jasmine rice is done )
instructions: In a large pot, combine the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Then reduce the heat to low and put lid on pot. Cook, covered, 45 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir the rice into the pot. Cook uncovered for 5 minutes or until heated through. It will continue to'swirl' in the steam. If not, uncover the pot and cook for five minutes longer. Fluff with a fork.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,parsley leaf,salt,yellow pea,egg noodle,asparagus,mexican cheese
title: Asparagus and Snow Peas With Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed | 3/4 lb snow peas, ends snapped off and strings removed | 8 ounces medium egg noodles | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 2 teaspoons salt | 2 large eggs
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and add the asparagus and snow peas. Simmer covered until the asparagus is crisp, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the asparagus and snow peas to a colander and run under cold water to stop the cooking. Rinse with cold water until cool. When the asparagus and snow peas are cool, break apart the asparagus and snow pea pieces. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and transfer to a large bowl. Combine the melted mexican cheese, parsley, salt, and asparagus, along with the eggs in a small bowl and fold to thoroughly combine. Ladle the asparagus and snow peas over the noodles, and stir to mix. Serve in a shallow dish or on individual plates.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,beef bouillon granule,seasoning salt,self rising flour
title: Almond Biscuits
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons instant beef bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Place flour, salt, and spices in bowl of electric mixer. Cut in flour with 2 knives or 2 pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Form dough into 8 - 1 1/2 inch round circles and put on greased baking sheet. Sprinkle with almond extract if desired. Bake 400 for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,peanut oil,chinese five spice powder,beef eye,garlic powder,leek,water chestnut
title: Grilled Beef for Two
