ingredients: 2 beef eye round | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon leek, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon water chestnut, finely sliced | 2 teaspoons peanut oil
instructions: Cut steak diagonally into two pieces. Combine 5 spice, tarragon, garlic powder, leek, and water chestnuts. Toss with beef, cover, and marinate for 1 hour. Heat wok, add oil and heat until smoking. Cook each piece of meat until desired doneness.

title: Mexican Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 beef round tip roast or 1 lamb loin roast | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup broth | 1 teaspoon chopped parsley | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 300degrees and bake loaf loaf for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until internal temperature is 170degrees. Let stand 10 minutes. Remove from loaf and let cool 1 hour. Shred and serve on toothpicks.

title: Chocolate and Olive Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 lb loaf sourdough bread | 2 eggs | 1/2 cup cocoa | 1/2 lb shredded loaf sourdough bread, not the light crust | 3/4 cup dried mixed sprouts | 1/4 cup dried chervil or 1/4 cup savory leaves | 1/4 cup dried oregano leaves
instructions: Slice or tear bread slices into large chunks. Combine egg, cocoa, shredded sourdough, sprouts, herbs and crumbled cooked meat. Combine well. Place the mixture into a shallow pan. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. The next day, turn out on to a well floured board. Roll into a rectangle about 35 inches long and 1/2 thick. Wrap again with the plastic wrap and place into the refrigerator. Turn over once or twice so that all sides are evenly covered with the chocolate mixture. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Heat a non stick skillet over high heat and add some of the meat mixture. Cook for 3 minutes then flip and brown another 3 minutes. Turn again and brown for 2 minutes. Remove from the pan and serve hot.

title: Grilled Calamari
ingredients: 1 yellow sweet pepper | 1 tablespoon margarine
instructions: Pre heat your grill. Slice the sweet pepper in half, removing seeds. Place in a bowl, mix all other ingredients with a fork, pour mixture over peppers, cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes while you grill or broil the fish. This can be served as appetizers as well if you do not have a prepped charcoal grill. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Pasta and Cheese
ingredients: 250 g orzo pasta | 200 g cottage cheese | 1 cup pasta, of your choice
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions. Strain and refrigerate pasta until cool. Toss with cottage cheese in large bowl. Add salt and pepper. Can be served immediately.

title: Quick Scallions
ingredients: 6 scallions ( shallots ), trimmed and finely chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Blanch the scallions in boiling, slated water in a small cast iron skillet for ten seconds and immediately remove immediately with tongs to a clean towel.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,raspberry preserve,cream cheese,hot red pepper flake
title: Berry Blush
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1 cup bean sprouts, lightly packed | 1/8 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/16 teaspoon hot raspberry preserves
instructions: With a mixer on low, blend cream cheese until smooth. In a separate bowl, add bean sprouts, red pepper flakes, and raspberry preserves. Blend until smooth.

title: Homemade Oranges
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups natural-style yogurt | 2 oranges, peeled and sliced ( blood pith removed ) | 2 teaspoons artificial sweetener | 1 teaspoon campari | 1 teaspoon artificial sweetener, for each tablespoon of yogurt with fruit if desired
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, stir together the yogurt, orange slices and sweetener.

Random Ingredients: prawn,lemon juice zest,watermelon,green food coloring,saffron,extra virgin olive oil
title: Chilled Watermelon Prawns With Lemon-Saffron Prawns
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 3 cups watermelon, seeded and thinly sliced ( about 6 cups ) | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | fresh green food coloring | 8 large prawns, shelled and deveined
instructions: In small saucpan, combine saffron and water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add drained watermelon.

Random Ingredients: deli roast beef,chinese five spice powder,beef chuck,chocolate candy bar,cointreau liqueur,kaffir lime leaf
title: Tropical Meat in a Chocoalte
ingredients: 3/4 cup cointreau liqueur | 1 1/4 teaspoons chinese five-spice powder | 32 slices deli roast beef ( cut 1-inch thick with a paring knife ) | 8 slices chocolate candy bars ( each cut in 6 slices ) | 8 slices deli roast beef, cut 1/8-inch thick between the narrow ends ( from deli ) | 1 bag kalamari vacuum seal chocolate candy bar, melted
instructions: In a glass bowl, combine the cointreau and 5 spice powder.

title: Broil (Beef and Cretons)
ingredients: 4 pounds sirloin ( trimmed of most of the fat ) | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the sirloin in a large roasting pan and rub it with 1 tbsp. Mustard seeds. Bake in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until very tender.

title: Lebanese Style Radish Salad
ingredients: 4 small radishes ( or one big ones ) | 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 2 romaine lettuce
instructions: Peel and slice the radishes thinly and place in a bowl. Mix the yogurt into the chopped radish onion, chilli paste and stir to combine. Pour over the radish and radish and toss lightly with chopsticks. Serve immediately on the side for a nice crisp lettuce spring when served. Enjoy.

title: Chinese Crunch
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and patted dry | 2 pak choi | 1 tablespoon buttermilk | 1/4 cup dry graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place thawed spinach, chilis in a large bowl. In a small bowl, mix buttermilk with crumbs until mixture resembles coarse crumbs and drizzle into spinach mixture. Sprinkle over spinach mixture and toss well to coat.

title: Maple Salmon with Maple Bacon Topping
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds salmon steaks, sliced | 1 1/2 cups real maple syrup | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange salmon on a greased baking pan. Sprinkle with maple syrup. Bake in the preheated oven until cooked through, 12 to 15 minutes. Top salmon with shredded mozzarella cheese. Heat maple syrup in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until melted. Spread on top of salmon.

title: Easy Pesto Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 6 eggs | tabasco sauce, to taste | fresh pesto sauce, to taste
instructions: Place the eggs in a saucepan over medium heat. Cover the pan and shake the pan once or twice to distribute the mixture. Do not open the pan until the mixture is solid enough to flip the eggs, about 10 minutes. Remove the eggs, let cool slightly, then coarsely chop. Transfer the cooked eggs to a bowl, and cover with the pesto. Sprinkle the tops with tabasco.

title: Fried Beans
ingredients: 1/3 cup sesame oil | 1 cup bean, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 oranges, juice and zest of
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Add the bean slices and fry for 5 minutes until golden brown. Then remove to plate. Add the orange juice and zest to the hot oil and stir fry for a further 5 minutes. If using fresh orange peel cut into julienne strips and add to the oil fry the strips for 3 - 5 minutes or until cooked. Drain and serve with rice or fried beans.

title: Garlic and Parmesan (Parmesan & Cassis)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine, melted | 1/4 teaspoon bottled and minced garlic salt ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon creme de cassis ( a good brand )
instructions: Sprinkle margarine on baking sheet.

title: Nutty Honey Roasted Chicken or Tuna
ingredients: 1 chicken or 1 tuna, cut into 2-by-3-inch cubes or ( 16 ounce ) lamb | 4 -5 large walnuts, coarsely coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon water | 1 large egg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut a slit into the side of the chicken or tuna a small sharp knife will produce a easier shape to remove the meat. Stick the walnuts into the cuts using your fingers. Place the chicken or tuna in a bowl or plate, and sprinkle rice vinegar and water over and around the meat. Add egg, and press walnuts into the skin of the meat. Place on parchment paper or aluminum foil in the center of the oven. Bake for 45 minutes or until the fish can be pulled from the bone.

title: Quick Mushroom Panini
ingredients: 2 shiitake mushrooms, quartered | 1 1/2 cups cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 pinch cumin | 1 baguette, cut in half lengthwise, cut through to make 4'mini sandwiches
instructions: Soak mushrooms in water to cover. Drain, reserving liquid and chopped mushrooms. Combine mushrooms, beans and flour in a skillet. Cook over medium high heat until liquid comes to a simmer. Add cumin and mushrooms and cook 5 minutes. Toast baguettes under broiler until golden brown. Spread with bean mixture. Add toasted bread on side and eat.

title: Cranberry Jam and Raspberry Bark
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups dried cranberry jam | 1 1/2 lbs raspberries or 1 1/2 lbs light raspberries | 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons granulated sugar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a baking pan and cover with plastic wrap or baking paper and let rise until doubled in size. Preheat oven to 350°.

title: Ginger Tacos With Fresh Corn Truffles
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas | 1/4 cup ginger puree | 1 small red chile pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Heat the griddle or skillet over medium heat. Place corn tortillas on griddle, and fry until golden brown, flipping once, about 3 minutes per side. Remove from the griddle, cool slightly before placing in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: green onion,flat leaf parsley,beef stew meat,brown rice,yellow tomato
title: Baked Beef and Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1- inch cubes | 2 cups brown rice | 3 1/2 cups tomatoes, chopped, fresh | 1/2 cup green onion, sliced, whites reserved | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275°. Arrange the meat cubes in a 3 quart casserole dish. Stir in the rice, tomatoes, green onions, and parsely. Cover and bake for 3 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally. Uncover and bake for 30 minutes more.

title: Lemon Onion and Almond Salad (Dried Cranberries)
ingredients: 2 packages dried cranberries | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Place the almonds in a small skillet and toast over medium low heat, shaking the pan often until toasted and fragrant, about 1 minute. Cool. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Add the almonds and toss until coated. Serves tip, to toast almonds, toast almonds while still warm, and increase the flavors slightly if the almonds begin to darken too much before the cranberries are added to the almonds, this is considered to be extra delicious after replacing the flavor a whole pack of dried ones have.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,beef tenderloin,tea,red kidney bean,phyllo dough,pepper
title: Beef Tenderloin Filled Phyllo Cups
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, 3/4 to 1 inch thick | 1 cup red kidney beans, and or 1 cup cooked cannellini beans ( both okay ) | 10 ounces frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | pepper | 1/4 cup strong tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Place beef tenderloin in a large nonstick skillet and cook over moderate heat to rare, 10 - 15 minutes for rare.

title: Lamb Tzatziki
ingredients: 150 g ground lamb | 200 ml spiced vanilla yogurt | 1/3 cup fresh herbs ( rosemary, sage, thyme, etc. chopped finely ) | 100 g raw sugar or 100 g raw raw honey | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( i use baking soda ) | 1 medium head cauliflower, shredded and washed in plenty of cold water | 1 medium cauliflower, roasted | 1/2 small head of cauliflower, roasted with skins, chopped into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix thoroughly with a large wooden spoon, it's not necessary to whip the meat too much but to get a smooth consistency. It should be the consistency of creamy play doh. Line a large baking tray with foil and line well with baking paper. Combine all of the ingredients for the dressing and whisk them together. Add the cauliflower and roasted cauliflower, and mix well until all of the cauliflower is fully coated with the mixture, pour into a serving dish and leave in the fridge. Note, you could also just mix up the ingredients in a food processor and mix until completely smooth and well combined, it's up to you if you're making the salad at the same time, but the tzatziki should still have some bite. Note 1, you could substitute any meat for the lamb, just use another veg for the lamb, but i didn't recommend either of those.

title: Mexican Veggies
ingredients: 1 bag baby carrots | 2 cans mexicorn, drained
instructions: Preheat oven on stove, mix the mexican vegetables, drained vegetable, and corn/jalapeno mix in a buttered 9x13 baking dish. Cover with foil, and bake for 45 minutes. Serve over rice if you don't eat them right away.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,spinach leaf,fruit,cherry,tamarind pulp,green pepper,white wine,horseradish
title: Spicy Hot Pot
ingredients: 1 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup red pepper or 1/3 cup orange pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried horseradish ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried fruit ( to taste ) or 1 tablespoon mixed fresh fruit ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried tamarind pulp or 1 1/2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 3 -4 fresh spinach leaves, washed washed and ends trimmed, spun dry, and chopped | white wine
instructions: Cook peppers and dried fruit in boiling water for about 10 - 15 minutes. Add tamarind pulp or tamarind paste and reduce heat to low. Add spinach and cook about 5 - 8 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat and stir in wine.

title: Baked Fish With Garnish
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh fish, cut into chunks | 4 eggs | 2 cups fresh graham cracker crumbs | 8 ounces brie cheese or 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded | 3 -5 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f. Coat a large baking dish with cooking spray. Combine the graham cracker crumbs, brie and tomato paste. Put the fish chunks in the cheese and bread crumbs to coat and then place into the baking dish. Add the remaining ingredients and toss gently so that each piece is covered. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Hawaiian Pesto Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 3 tablespoons prepared noodles | 4 hamburger buns
instructions: Combine the pineapple juice and noodles in a bowl and stir to coat noodles. Add more pineapple juice if the mixture is too thick. Top with the ham and top with the sliced hot buns.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,saltine cracker,hot red pepper flake,red bell pepper,sunflower oil,ziti pasta
title: Ziti With Pickles and Sunflower Oil
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely crushed saltines or 2 cups crackers | 1 cup sunflower oil | 1 cup hot red pepper flakes | 1 1/2 lbs ziti pasta or 1 1/2 lbs penne pasta | 2 red bell peppers, seeded if desired | 1/2 cup chopped dill pickle
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over moderately high heat. Add crushed saltines or crackers and hot peppers and stir 1 minute. Stir in ziti, bell peppers and the dill pickle. Cover and simmer gently 7 minutes, then increase heat to moderate and continue to cook until pasta is just tender. Drain pasta well and serve.

title: Pasta Shells
ingredients: 1 box pasta shells | 3 cups peppercorns
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. While waiting for the water to boil, place the shells into a pot of lightly salted, boiling water. Cook the pasta shells until tender but still firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain completely. Once pasta is cooked, drain and toss with the strained water. The shells will hold together better if you refrigerate for a few hours to get rid of excess moisture. Serve with a tossed salad of your choice.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,shrimp,salt black pepper,rice wine,sherry wine,pepper,oat,pork
title: Sausage and Noodles
ingredients: 3/4 lb sausage, any type, sliced 1/4-inch thick ( i prefer hillshire farms or canadian bacon, but use any flavor ) | 14 ounces shrimp, peeled, cooked | 10 ounces oat | 6 ounces rice wine, dry vermicelli type, not imitation ( rice vermicelli ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sherry wine ( or vermouth ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | cooked egg noodles ( optional ) or rice, as accompaniment ( optional )
instructions: Cook and drain chinese sausage. Slice the oat into very thin slices, each about 1/4 thick, and set aside. Cook and drain shrimp, draining and keeping separate in a bowl, of cold water. Remove all but 1 tbsp of oil from sausage, and cook and stir shrimp until they are tender and just beginning to turn pink, breaking up any clumps. Remove all but about 2 tbsp of oil, wipe sausage with kitchen towel, but reserve. Sprinkle shrimp with salt and pepper, and toss to coat. Add a tbsp or 2 of sherry, then toss again. Remove from heat and drain shrimp on paper towels. Place 1/4 lb sausage and 1/4 lb shrimp into a large bowl, and mix. Add 1/2 tsp ground sherry, 1 tsp salt. Stir in vermicelli to mix. Set aside 1 tbsp of sherry, 1 tbsp oil, and 1 tbsp water for garnish. Spoon half mixture into shallow serving dish, sprinkle with cheese and add remaining mixture. To cook noodles, place noodles on a platter, and top with sausages, shrimp and sausage. Garnish with cooked noodles. Serve with noodles, if desired.

title: Faux Thai Sauce for Chicken or Prawns
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh basil leaf | 1/4 cup dark seedless raisins or 1/4 cup sultana | 1/4 cup crushed roasted salted shrimp | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon instant minced garlic or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon mortadella | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat rye flour ( white or all-purpose ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped sweet sweet pickled ginger ( found at asian market )
instructions: In small bowl mix together fish sauce, pestle or other spice, garlic, mortadella, and ginger. In a large glass mixing bowl or shallow dish combine basil, dark and roasted salted shrimp with fish sauce mixture and stir vigorously till well combined. Sprinkle with white or all purpose flour and refrigerate till ready to use. Toss with your favorite chicken or prawns. Variation, add 1/4 cup sultanas or raisins when adding shrimp to taste, and add 1/3 cup sultanas or raisins after adding shrimp.

title: Quick and Easy Manicotti
ingredients: 36 manicotti, cooked and drained | 2 cups tequila | 1/4 cup thai fish sauce
instructions: Mix together tequila and fish sauce. Dip stuffed manicotti in sauce, then coat with remaining sauce. Place on cookie sheet, seam side down. Bake at 400 degrees for 12 - 15 minutes, or until heated through. Top with your favorite toppings.

title: Clams Casino
ingredients: 2 cans minced clams with juice | 1 package refrigerated fillings ( such as hard salami, kraft deli cheese and other hard salami ) | 1 package shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Open one can of clams and reserve in a bowl. In another bowl, add the 1 can of minced clams and then add the 1 cup of mashed clams. When the mixture is cooled mix well until it is somewhat of a paste like consistency. Fill each of the clams with equal portions of the cheese mixture, placing 1/2 cup or more in the hollow of each clam shell. Place the filled clams on a foil lined baking sheet and bake about 15 minutes in a 350 degree f oven, uncovered, until tops are lightly browned and the cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Gruyere Cheese With Cardamom (Swiss Cheese)
ingredients: 2 lbs gruyere cheese, grated | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod, lightly crushed
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place cheese in a small saucepan on medium heat and barely cover with water. Bring to a boil, cooking until melted and beginning to bubble, stirring often. Pour onto a serving dish, sprinkle with cardamom and serve immediately.

title: Crispy Spinach With Ricotta Cheese, Shrimp and Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb fresh baby spinach | 1 1/2 teaspoons shrimp paste | 3/4 1 1/2 ounces ricotta cheese or 1 1/2 ounces cottage cheese
instructions: In a small saucepan heat about 1/4 cup water until boiling. Meanwhile, peel spinach. Tear off a thick layer of thick stems by placing it in the water. Cover and cook for just a few moments and strain well. Put the shredded spinach in a medium sized bowl. Mix with remaining ingredients. Roll the spinach in the mixture.

title: Simple Mexican Bake
ingredients: 1 bag shredded mexican blend cheese | 12 ounces tomato sauce | 11 ounces cheddar cheese ( shredded ) | extra oil ( for frying ) | 2 -3 medium sized carrots
instructions: Preheat over to 400 degrees farenheit. Combine all ingredients in medium sized casserole dish or roaster or baking dish. Cover and bake for 30 - 45 minutes. Uncover for the last 15 minutes to brown. Let sit about 10 mins before slicing and serving. If it's too hot, you can just serve by itself.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,rib beef,raisin,white breadcrumb,parmesan cheese
title: Breaded Rouladen
ingredients: 1 -2 kg rouladen ( thin, but wide ) | 1 lb fresh white breadcrumb | 2 -3 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup raisins
instructions: Cut very thin membrane from the rouladen and arrange it on a greased oven tray. Mix the breadcrumbs with the cheese. Dip the rouladen into the breadcrumbs and press into the breadcrumb cheese mixture. Bake the rouladen on a moderate rack in a hot oven for about 40 min, brushing it with the glaze. When cooked, glaze with the vinegar and raison. This can be eaten either warm or cold as a main course.

title: Lentils With Horseradish
ingredients: 7 ounces french green lentil ( or yellow lentils ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons horseradish | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract ( or to taste )
instructions: Wash lentils and lentils thoroughly in a strainer. Transfer to a heavy pot of boiling, salted water and boil for 30 minutes or longer over medium heat. Drain into a bowl and let cool for 5 minutes. Place cooled lentils and lentils in a food processor. Add the horseradish, vanilla and 1 1/2 cups water and process in bursts, if needed, until thoroughly mixed, about 20 - 30 seconds. Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl. Serve warm or cold.

title: Pomegranate Pistou, Pistou and Lychees
ingredients: 1 cup pistou, pistou soaked in water | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 cup bamboo shoot, chopped | 1 cup fresh spearmint, snipped
instructions: To make pistou, rinse the pistou well and shake it to remove the sand, then shake it again to remove the sand. Sprinkle both sides with nutmeg. Wrap the pistou in a clean cloth and keep it in a warm place while preparing other ingredients. Toast the nuts in a hot skillet on both sides, adding a little oil if necessary, and stirring, for 2 minutes. Transfer to a large serving dish and serve.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,linguine,bell pepper,bean paste,worcestershire sauce
title: Faux Linguine
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons minced lemons, or to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon minced bell pepper | 1 teaspoon bean paste
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine cream, lemon juice, worcestershire sauce, pepper, and bean paste.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,canadian bacon,cocoa,button mushroom,orange peel,green chile,red chili pepper,chili
title: Champagne Banana Style Canapes
ingredients: 8 large canadian bacon, slices cut into 1/4 inch by 1/4 inch strips | 2 -3 medium green chile slices, finely chopped | 1/4 cup orange peel, grated, reserve juices | 2 tablespoons chili, finely chopped fresh ( canned or canned for heat, drained and minced ) | 1/2 cup red chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar or 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 3 large mushrooms, finely chopped ( about 3 ounces, depending on size ) | 1/4 cup canadian bacon, extra firm, cut into small slivers | 2 tablespoons cocoa, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. In large bowl, combine bacon, chiles, orange peel and chili. Stir in chili, vinegar and mushrooms. Arrange on a medium baking sheet lined with waxed paper. Bake for 20 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 425 degrees. Reduce oven temperature to 325 degrees. Sprinkle top of each slice with the extra 1 tsp cocoa, bake an additional 20 minutes, brushing or turning once, until golden brown.

title: Coriander and Brown Onions Stuffed Rice Balls
ingredients: 100 g arborio rice | 1 brown onion, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, roughly crushed
instructions: Start by steaming the rice in a large non stick frying pan, then add 2 tbsp oil and a generous pinch of salt. Stir the rice until it begins to turn a medium brown colour. Transfer the rice to a bowl and cover. Melt the remaining oil in the pan and fry the rice. Remove from the pan and drain the browned onion, then place in a mixing bowl and stir in the coriander in it. Allow to cool, then knead with your hands until it becomes firm and a little sticky. Using your hands, form the mixture into balls approximately the size of golf balls and flatten slightly into discs approximately 1 in diameter. Place in a shallow ovenproof dish, cover, and refrigerate for at least an hour. Preheat the oven to 200c/fan 220c/gas arrange the rice balls one at a time in a shallow heatproof dish. Sprinkle with the remaining coriander seeds. Bake the rice balls for 12 - 15 minutes so that it starts to crisp, then turn the oven down to 120c/fan 170c/gas cook for a further 15 minutes.

title: Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 jar beef gravy | 1 package pepperoni | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 2 or 3 quart slow cooker. Cook on low on setting for 7 hours, or on high setting for 3 or 4 hours.

title: Cranberry Pudding
ingredients: 1 can or bottle cranberries, drained | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 large egg whites
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place half of the cranberries in mini cupcake liners. Set aside remaining cranberries. Sprinkle kosher salt on 2 pieces of baking paper, then set aside. Separate the whites from the yolks as you would traditionally for use. Add egg whites to whites and beat until firm peaks form. Add salt and remaining cranberries and mix. Divide mixture among the prepared mini cups. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,chocolate chunk,cilantro leaf,italian tomato,spaghetti sauce
title: Sensational Spaghetti and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti sauce ( spaghetti, linguine, angel hair ) | 1 can italian-style tomatoes, drained and chopped | 3 cups snow peas, cut in half | 3 tablespoons snipped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 ounces good quality semi-sweet chocolate chunks ( such as godiva ), chopped
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions, omitting salt if desired. While pasta is cooking, combine sauce ingredients in medium saucepan over medium heat with 2/3 cup water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered, stirring often for about 7 minutes, until hot. Sprinkle over snow peas and cook until beginning to soften about 2 minutes. Stir in chocolate and serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,chinese rice wine,apple juice,sea bass fillet,beef,green chili,bay leaf
title: Braised Sea Bass With Apple and Chili
ingredients: 3 cups apple juice | 1 cup chinese rice wine | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 1/2 lbs sea bass fillets, rinsed and patted dry | 1 1/2 lbs whole green chilies ( jalapeno seeded, seeded, and chopped ) | 1 medium apple, peeled, cored, cut into chunks
instructions: Heat apple juice over med high heat in a medium saucepan.

title: Cranberry Salsa
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 2 tablespoons dried chopped tomatillo or 2 tablespoons thawed chopped fresh figs | 1 -2 fresh serrano chilies, stemmed, seeded, and minced or 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper | 1 cup canned diced figs
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve.

title: Mexican Seasoning - Salt Alternative to Dry Rub
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 2 cups mexican oregano ( dry mexican seasoning mix ) | 1 cup flour ( approximate ) | 1 teaspoon dried crushed cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Store in an airtight container in a cool dry place, such as a cool dry place with a shelf.

title: Chinese Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb chinese sausage, sliced into rounds | 1 lb cabbage, shredded | 1 lb self-raising flour | 3 -4 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, except vinegar in a bowl, leave until needed. Divide the mixture into 3 parts place each piece on a lightly oiled baking sheet then baste the pieces with the vinegar. Bake in a preheated 450'f oven for 20 minutes until they are brown. Serve hot.

title: Chicken Lumpia
ingredients: 1 lb chicken meat | 1 egg roll wrap, wrappers ( about 18-optional )
instructions: Roll chicken meat into 3/4 inch balls. Dip in egg roll wrap, and arrange on baking sheet. Bake at 375f for 20 - 30 minutes or until they are golden brown.

title: Swiss Chard and Monkfish Pasta.
ingredients: 2 -3 cups swiss chard ( fresh or frozen and washed ) | 1 can plum tomatoes | 12 ounces monkfish | wheat hair pasta
instructions: Boil water and cook pasta. Blanch greens for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain well on paper towels. Blend drained greens with tomatoes, monkfish, and celery in large bowl. Add salt and chill for a few hours or overnight. Sprinkle chopped parsley or parmigiano reggiano cheese on top before serving. Enjoy note, this recipe makes just a few servings. Please note, this dish can also be served cold.

Random Ingredients: peking duck,fish,black bean,vanilla,orange juice,asiago cheese,pickling spice
title: Famous Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peking duck, fat removed with the bone left on | 1 packet pickling spices | 1 can sliced black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 -2 tablespoon grated asiago cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 4 cups cooked pigeon ducks, cut in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Butter a 9 x 13 baking dish. Place peking duck in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: salmon steak,angel hair pasta,soy sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray,almond,turnip,bacon,tahini
title: Salmon With Turnips, Tahini, Almonds and Pilatas
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks ( about 1 1/2 inches thick ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 slices bacon, sliced 1/3-inch thick | 1 lb turnip, peeled, ends trimmed, halved lengthwise, and cut in 1 | 12 ounces angel hair pasta ( about 8 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons chopped almonds, toasted | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1/4 cup tahini
instructions: Spray ovenproof skillet with vegetable cooking spray. Place steaks on skillet and brown evenly, approximately 7 - 10 minutes per side. Remove steaks on a plate while making sauce. Add oil to heat in skillet if needed. Add bacon and turnip and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently for 3 minutes. Add pasta and almonds and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Add soy sauce and tahini and cook an additional 2 - 3 minutes until sauce thickens. Spoon mixture over fish and serve, garnish with pine nuts.

title: Paprika Crackers
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sea salt and black pepper | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( or less if desired )
instructions: Stir sea salt, black pepper and cayenne together in a small bowl until combined. Use a pastry brush to lightly coat two cookie sheets.

title: Raggmunk or Rouladen
ingredients: 500 g split peas | 150 g shredded pork | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Rinse dry peas, pick over the faggots and put in a large saucepan of boiling water. Cook covered for 10 minutes or until the float in the water. Drain and pat dry with a cloth. Cook the peas in a large pan of boiling water for about 20 minutes or until they are tender and the liquid has been absorbed. Remove and add the paprika. The smoked paprika is optional. Serve in bread bowls and a light salad with a salad of mixed greens.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,bibb lettuce,red cabbage,worcestershire sauce,pearl barley,garbanzo bean
title: Hearty Garbanzo Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight and drained | 1 red cabbage, cut into wedges | 1 1/4 cups pearl barley | 1 head bibb lettuce, washed well and spun dry | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 1-1/2 tablespoons ) | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce, plus more to taste ( about 1/4 cup )
instructions: Place the beans in a pot, cover with water by 2 inches, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain in a colander, return to the pot, and let cool until easy to handle. Shred the beans, discarding any tough or damaged portions, and set aside. Bring 2 quarts of cold water to a boil. Add the barley, and stir to separate. Add the green cabbage wedges, and return to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes, then remove from the heat. Cover, and set aside. Tear off four 6 inch pieces of kitchen twine, about 20 pieces, and drop into a bowl of water to prevent sticking. Drain and pat dry. Tear the lettuce leaves into 3 inch lengths and add to the bowl, along with the cheese and the worcestershire sauce. Toss gently to mix. Serve the salad warm or at room temperature. The salad can be prepared ahead of time, refrigerated, and frozen. Reheat before serving. To serve, stir in a tablespoon of worcestershire sauce, and add more cheese to taste.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,hazelnut,brown rice,cheese,vital wheat gluten,tortilla chip,toblerone chocolate bar
title: Yummy Brown Rice and Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry instant brown rice | 1 1/3 cups low fat, non fat free, microwaveable broth | 8 ounces mexican dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 4 -5 leaves shaved unsweetened cheese | 4 -5 miniature tortilla chips | 2 toblerone chocolate bars, melted
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine sesame oil and broth in a microwave safe measuring cup, and place over medium heat. When rice is nearly cooked, add hazelnuts.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,yogurt,angel hair pasta,sourdough bread,rump roast,oat,rice noodle
title: Delicious Crumpet & Noodle Salad Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package dried bread dough ( frozen or fresh ) | 7 ounces dry rice noodles or 7 ounces fresh vermicelli | 1 lb fresh rump roast, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon porcini mushroom, finely chopped | 1/3 - 1/2 cup sourdough bread, cut into 6 slices | 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon oats ( optional )
instructions: Punch rice noodles dry, then refrigerate until needed. In a large bowl, sprinkle uncooked noodles with a sprinkling of salt. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Thaw bread dough for about 30 minutes. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Steamed Classic Gnocchi With Cognac and Fennel
ingredients: 500 g mixed ladyfingers | 300 g potato traditional | 50 g cornflour | 2 tablespoons cognac | 300 ml muscat wine ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | sea salt | 2 tablespoons cognac
instructions: Place the sweet potato on to boil in salted water for about 20 minutes or until cooked and tender. Mash potatoes and add to the main dish. Add a little water to loosen anything sticking to the sides. Place the cornflour mixed with cold water in a small bowl and add to the other mixture. Season to taste. Heat a pan on medium high heat and add a little sea salt to taste. Roll palms of the mixture in the cornflour to get a thick sponge like consistency. Place the dough into the pan and bring to the boil. While waiting for the water to boil, prepare the sauce. Place a large non stick frying pan on the stove. Brush the pan with a little olive oil or butter and when the pan is very hot but not smoking, pour a few dolcelatore tablespoons of cognac into the pan. Add the chopped fennel and a couple tablespoons of water. Scoop up handfuls of the gnocchi into the pan and add to the pan. Turn the heat down to low and cover. Cook for 30 or 30 minutes. Serve with a nice green salad and a fresh glass of red or white wine.

title: Mango and Snow Pea Terrine
ingredients: 3 tablespoons instant espresso | 2 cups water | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon low calorie soy sauce | 1/3 cup white raisins | 1/2 cup barley, finely chopped | 1/2 tablespoon mango powder | cooking spray ( olive oil or olive oil flavored ) | 16 snow peas, cut in half lengthwise and stalks removed
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a bowl. Stir until completely disolved. Add all remaining ingredients except vegetables. Stir to mix. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. Drain vegetables and pat dry. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Spoon mixture into pan, spreading it out evenly. Spray tops with a bit of cooking spray. Sprinkle with snow peas. Turn edges on. Bake at 425°f for 8 minutes, or until top starts to brown.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,shrimp,cashew butter,tahini,flat leaf parsley,chicken bouillon cube
title: Quick and Easy Shrimp Satay
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 cup raw cashew butter | 1 tablespoon tahini | 10 ounces medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley ( for garnish )
instructions: Place a wok over high heat.

Random Ingredients: caper,triple sec,wheat pasta,green chili pepper,plum jam,red pepper flake,nori,self raising flour
title: Pasta With Capers and Sweet Chilli
ingredients: 450 g whole wheat pasta ( i prefer angel hair ) | 3 tablespoons extra light plum jam | 1 tablespoon chopped canned green chili pepper | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon extra light double sec | 2 teaspoons grated nori | 3 drops capers | 1/2 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the pasta in a large pan and cook uncovered. Meanwhile, place the pasta in a large bowl and add the warm capers and stir to combine. Cover and leave to stand for about 10 mins or until the pasta is cooked. Stir in the flour and cook until the mixture boils and thickens, stirring often and adding extra water if it becomes too thick. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan. Top with the chilli and serve with the tomato and capers.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,dill,chickpea flour,pork shoulder,cumin,oregano leaf
title: Pork-And-Spice Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder ( bone left on ) | 1 large bunch fresh dill, leaves picked ( about 6-inch ) | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup chickpea flour | heavy whipping cream
instructions: Using a knife, slice the pork crosswise with the bone at an angle to remove any remaining fat. Reserve 1/2 lb of the meat to make dipping sauce. In a blender or food processor mix the dill, cumin, and oregano. Set aside. Coarsely chop the remaining 2/3 lb meat. Place meat and chickpea flour in a separate bowl. Add ½ cup of the whipping cream, 1 tablespoon of the reserved dill, and ½ teaspoon of the cumin and oregeno. Add salt and pepper to taste. Spread the meat mixture on a large nonreactive cookie sheet and arrange it in a single layer with the skin side up. Use a meat mallet to pound the meat so that it is a ¼ thick. Refrigerate, tightly covered, until it's ready to serve. When ready to serve, preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Spread a heaping 1/4 cup of whipping cream on a parchment lined cookie sheet and bake until hot and bubbling, about 10 minutes. Carefully remove from the oven and spread remaining whipping cream on top. Serve the pork with dill and sour cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: spinach,apple juice,savory,beef chuck roast,tomato ketchup,brown sugar
title: Apple Beef in a Bar
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 15 ounces apple juice | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 teaspoon savory | 1 teaspoon tomato ketchup | 4 ounces frozen chopped spinach
instructions: Put roast in slow cooker. Mix remaining ingredients together except spinach. Pour sauce over beef. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours.

title: Gobi Mani
ingredients: 8 tablespoons margarine, unsalted | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 1/2 cups plain flour | 1 cup green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Heat 1 t margarine in a wok. Saute pepper for 3 - 4 minutes. Sprinkle on ginger paste, cook stirring for 1 minute. Add flour and cook stirring for one minute. Make a hole in the mixture with your stirring finger. Pour margarine slowly on top, and then put in the green bell pepper. Cook over moderate flame for 3 min, stirring gently. Remove to a warm dish.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper adobo sauce,star anise,thyme,white wine,button mushroom,green bell pepper,lemon,kidney bean
title: Tuscan Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 jar button mushrooms, drained and finely chopped | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and minced with seeds | 4 canned chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 bunch fresh thyme, leaves discarded | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 1/2 lemons, quartered
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine beans, mushrooms, red chili pepper, and chipotles.

title: Canned Chiles & Dipping Greens & Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 ounces mustard greens | 4 ounces chives, chopped | 4 tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 banana pepper, finely diced
instructions: In a dry skillet over medium heat, toast mustard greens & chives, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl & stir in chocajete. Garnish with diced avocado & diced tomatoes.

title: Minted Banana Split Foil With Pita Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup hulled split farro ( hulled long grain basmati ) | 1 cup dry semolina | 1 cup unsalted pumpkin seedless banana | 1/3 cup chopped dried cranberries | 1 -2 cup crumbled goat's cheese ( best quality ) or 1 -2 cup finely crumbled cotija cheese ( best quality ) | pepper | toasted pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Place the farro and semolina in a medium sized bowl, make sure the water doesn't start to water over night, or the farro can break when bent and can crack. Place the banana in the dry pan & gently toast under the broiler until it starts turning golden. Set aside to cool to room temperature. Spread the farro out on a cutting board, and cut into 4 by 2 by 2 by 2 inch squares, or you can just cut into squares as you would pizza dough. You may have to do this in batches. Spread a pinch of the chick pea filling over the farro, then layer the banana over, then drizzle with a couple of tablespoons of grapeseed oil and a sprinkling of pine nuts if using. Spread the goat's cheese over the faro, then drizzle with a little more oil. Broil the farro with the oil about 4 from the heat for 3 - 5 minutes or just until it starts to smoke slightly. As you watch and turn, drizzle with a little more oil as needed. When it's all nicely toasted, remove from the oven and shake off any excess. Drizzle with the grapeseed oil and drizzle with pine nuts, if using. Allow to cool and enjoy. Recipe can be made up to 2 days in advance, keep covered with a clean dampened cloth at room temperature. Keep in the fridge.

title: Chicken With Sultanas
ingredients: 1 kg chicken leg | cooking spray | 1 kg potato, skin on | 4 tablespoons sultanas | 400 g sweet potatoes, skin on | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/4 cup raisins | 2 cardamom pods, cracked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Spray the chicken with cooking spray. Put on oven tray and bake for 40 minutes remove from oven and sprinkle sultanas over the chicken. Place in a microwave on high for 1 minute and stir. Pour over the sugar and the raisins. Microwave on medium for 3 minutes. Turn chicken. Microwave for a further 1 minute. Transfer chicken to a serving plate and cover with foil. Microwave on high for 5 minutes pour sultana mixture over chicken. Serve with couscous and rice.

title: Crunchy Chicken Rollups
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, cutlets | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Cook the chicken breasts. Spray a small muffin tin with cooking spray and set aside. Pour rice vinegar over chicken and let it marinate for about 15 minutes. Place chicken cutlets on a greased cookie sheet. Roll each chicken. Let them rest for 2 minutes before applying pressure to the pan.

title: Lobster Quesadillas
ingredients: 3 small lobster, cleaned, quartered | 1 tablespoon ground sage | 4 -6 tablespoons taco-size flour tortillas | 20 taco-size flour tortillas | 24 sweet wine or 24 chilies, fresh, hot
instructions: Cook lobster in a little water over medium heat until just cooked through and firm. If lobster cools off and starts to get too dry, add more water. Transfer to a bowl covered in warm water. Peel and core lobster remove shells if desired. Cut in halves and mash with a fork. Add sage and mix. Heat 2 tablespoons tortilla on low until warmed. Spread 1 tablespoon lobster mixture in center of tortilla. Place 2 tablespoons of salsa in the center of the tortilla. Roll up tortilla. Repeat process until all tortillas are assembled. Place them in a warm frying pan over medium heat. When warm, flip over and top with remaining salsa. Spread hot mixture on 1 side and 1 side with rest of tortilla. Spray the outside of quesadillas with cooking spray. Heat in oven 10 - 15 minutes or until tortillas are golden brown and crispy.

Random Ingredients: za'atar spice mix,black sesame seed,cilantro leaf,red bell pepper,cranberry,milk,sultana raisin,mushroom cap
title: Vegetable Tabbouleh
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sultana raisins | 1 tablespoon black sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | 7 fluid ounces milk | 1 ounce fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons sliced black mushroom caps | cranberries | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons sliced za'atar vegetables with almonds
instructions: Toast the sultanas and black sesame seeds, mix with the za'atar. Place the milk and herbs in a small saucepan over a medium heat and bring to the boil, then remove from the heat. Stir the raisins into the hot milk. Remove from the heat and cover, leave until cool, then stir through the sultanas, black sesame seeds, chopped vegetables and dried nuts. Serve.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,focaccia bread,allspice,chili oil,yellow bell pepper
title: Spicy Grilled Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs yellow bell peppers, tops and seeds removed, thinly sliced lengthwise | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 4 teaspoons chili oil | 1/3 cup italian parsley, coarsely chopped plus extra | parsley, to garnish | 12 ounces focaccia bread, cut in 12 slices
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Arrange bell pepper pieces on rack in foil lined rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle with allspice and 2 teaspoons chili oil. Oil should remain just around edges. Place on grill. Close grill lid and grill to desired level of doneness, about 10 minutes for red bell peppers. Transfer to work surface and top with parsley. Heat remaining 2 teaspoons chili oil in skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Serve bell peppers with parsley drizzled on top. Garnish with additional parsley.

title: Chayote  With Watercress (Chayote Com S
ingredients: 1 anaheim chilies, halved ( i like to use poblanos ) or 1 serrano chile | 1/4 cup watercress | 1 cup white flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Cut chilies in half, remove seeds and roughly chop. Wash and tear the watercress into small pieces, and place in a large bowl. Place the flour in another bowl, and mix in the brown sugar to make the flour. Dredge each chile in flour and roll in green chili. Heat 1/3 cup water, or use a nonstick pan with a lid add the chilies, and bring to just under a boil. Cover and reduce heat, simmer for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat, and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Curried Veg-Coated Meatballs
ingredients: 1 cup split chickpea flour | 1 1/4 lbs ground veal | 1/3 cup golden raisin, chopped | 1 jar marinara sauce | 2 pinches curry leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix meatball ingredients. Shape mixture into 12 meatballs and bake, meatballs in preheated oven until all are browned, about 20 to 25 minutes. Serve either hot or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cherry heering,italian parsley,pork sausage,dark rum,beef bouillon cube,cauliflower
title: Crazy Dips
ingredients: 2 lbs pork sausage or 2 lbs lean pork loin | 1 head cauliflower | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 6 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Remove leaves from head of cauliflowers and cut into 1 inch lenghts. Cut into 1 - 1 inch sections. Cut the sausage into 1 inch chunks. Place in dutch oven, cover with water and boil until meat is tender. Bone meat if you wish and set aside meat. Slice or chop the rest of your meat into small bite size pieces. Return to dutch over, add water, cover, bring to a boil. Skim off fat as needed and add rum. Turn down heat to simmer and partially cover. Simmer for about 4 hours. If necessary, add water to keep from sticking. Add the cauliflower to the dutch oven. Simmer for about 30 more minutes or until cauliflower is done. Remove from heat. Drain meat from dutch oven and return meat to dutch oven. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat until hot, adding more water if necessary. Serve hot with bread or fried potato wedges.

title: Grilled Halibut With Quinoa and Oregano
ingredients: 2/3 cup quinoa, rinsed | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 2 cups halibut fillets
instructions: Preheat grill to medium over medium heat. Combine quinoa, oregano, and cayenne in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Over low heat, bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until rice is just tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile, lightly oil grill grate. Cook halibut to desired degree of doneness, 3 to 4 minutes per side for med rare.

title: Baked White Beans
ingredients: 600 g dried white beans, soaked overnight | 1 teaspoon tomato paste
instructions: Drain beans and place in casserole. Add tomato paste and enough water to cover the beans about 2 3/4cm above top layer of beans. Bake in oven for approximately 1 hour or until tender.

title: Spinach Shortbread
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain flour or 3/4 cup gluten-free flour | 1/2 cup cocoa | 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley ( packed ) | 2 tablespoons tomato puree
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Sift dry ingredients into large bowl and place bowl in oven, set timer for about 20 minutes. Incorporate fresh parsley, add rest on slow speed for a few seconds and slowly add the tomato puree. Mix well. Turn heat to high and cook for 8 - 10 minutes. Turn off oven and allow to sit for at least 10 minutes. Take out of oven place shortbread on lightly floured surface, flatten and cut the long way with cookie cutter. Using floured fingers, roll with hands into 3/4 inch rounds. Bake on ungreased baking sheet until well browned about 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: parsley,lamb loin chop,lemon zest,hot water,corn flake,mexican cheese
title: Cheesy Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 lamb loin chops | 4 teaspoons grated mexican blend cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn flakes | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated lemon zest | 1/4 cup hot water | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Trim fat from chop. Sprinkle with cheese, corn flakes, lemon zest and water. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 400 for 8 - 12 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley. Broil 4 from heat for 1 miunt.

title: Artichokes and Beer
ingredients: 2 large artichokes | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 bottle beer
instructions: Blanch artichokes in boiling water for 4 minutes. Drain, and cool in ice water. Poke holes through the top of the artichokes with a fork, and pour half the yogurt into each hole. Place artichokes in the remaining yogurt. Slowly pour beer into the holes until completely covered, about 15 minutes. Serve with a hearty bread salad.

title: Mexcellent Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 sheet phyllo pastry | 1 ham, diced | 1 can chopped green chilies
instructions: Roll out the phyllo pastry until it is very thin, and then cut down the center to fit the bottom of a glass or nonstick 9x13 pan. This is easier if you spray a pastry bag by layering one sheet with wax paper and 1 more with a damp cloth, like you would a paper bag for making enchiladas. Mix in the ham, chilies, and 2 tbsp of water until the mixture is all coated. Lay 1/3 of the phyllo pastry in the bottom of the pan. Lay the remaining 3 sheets of phyllo pastry on top, brushing each sheet with water as each sheet is layered and getting used up of all of it, then using the end of a pastry brush as a glue to glue the pastry all over the phyllo and sides. Use a long serrated knife to cut out a little steam in the phyllo. Repeat this with 3 more sheets of phyllo, brushing, and ending with a pastry brush. You should get a nice layer for the next enchildada, but not overwhelming with all material. Pour the enchilada into the pan with the sauce. Sprinkle the top with cheese. Place in preheated 375f oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,irish whiskey,salmon,flour,pineapple chunk juice
title: Spiced Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked salmon | 1/4 cup flour | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 2 bottles pineapple chunk juice | 2 fluid ounces irish whiskey
instructions: Combine flour and chili pepper in a baggy, or glass and shake to mix. Place salmon in a pan and coat in flour mixture. Shake off excess. Brown salmon on low heat approximately 5 minutes per side with a touch of olive oil. While the fish is drying in the pan, pour pineapple juice into the pan. Bring to a boil and reduce by about half. When salmon is cooked, remove from heat and place on serving platter. Put on your favorite sauce and serve over rice. I like to serve with mashed potatoes and fresh veggies.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,hot green chili pepper,cilantro stem,coriander,bread flour,fennel seed,spinach,parsley leaf
title: Spinach in Fennel and Parsley
ingredients: 1 lb spinach | 1 cup bread flour | 1 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped hot green chili peppers | 1/2 - 1 cup cilantro stem ( optional ) | 1 cucumber, peeled seeded and very thinly sliced
instructions: Wash, drain and chop spinach. Combine all ingredients in a food processor and process or blend until well mixed. Transfer liquid to a bowl and cool for five minutes. Divide mixture into six balls. Roll each ball out on your floured surface and place on a greased or lightly floured cookie sheet. Flatten each ball to 1/16 inch thickness and place about 1 teaspoon of spinach mixture diagonally across each one. Top each flattened spinach ball with a 1 tablespoon of greens, leaving a 1 inch border around them. Roll the dough around the greens to enclose the filling. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill until serving time.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,penne,bosc pear,basil,rigatoni pasta,tomato green chilies,kosher salt
title: Pasta With Fresh Tomatoes, Bosc Pears, and Basil
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb penne | 2 whole bosc pears | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, plus | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 3 tablespoons tomato-flavored green chilies, chopped | 2 cups chopped canned plum tomatoes with green chilies, well drained ( or can petite diced tomatoes ) | 2 tablespoons basil, chopped | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Cook rigatoni until just tender and drain. Meanwhile, prick pear halves with a fork.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,black bean,extra virgin olive oil,plum tomato,saffron,lime peel
title: Quinoa-And-Black Bean Salad With Saffron Lime Creole Topping
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa, rinsed, drained | 2 cups black beans, rinsed ( about 12 ounces ) | 4 plum tomatoes, seeded | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon finely shredded fresh lime peel or 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel | 1/8 teaspoon saffron, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large pot, combine quinoa, beans, tomatoes and 1/2 cup of water. Bring to boil, reduce heat to low, cover and cook until the desired tenderness, about 20 to 30 minutes. Add saffron.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,mustard powder,navy bean,coconut cream,mace,red pepper sauce,yukon gold potato
title: Potato And Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned navy beans, drained well | 3 medium yukon gold potatoes, cut into 1/2 rounds | 1 granny smith apple, quartered and thinly sliced ( or other tart apple ) | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 2 tablespoons canned red pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Set oven to 180 degrees celsius. Toss together the beans, potatoes, apple and coconut cream and red pepper sauce. Sprinkle mustard powder over.

Random Ingredients: sourdough bread,white wine,chicken drumstick,bread crumb,ginger paste,meatball,marjoram
title: Chicken Dumpling Toasties
ingredients: 2 cups fresh bread crumbs | 1 cup dry white wine | 2 tablespoons dried marjoram | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger paste | 1 teaspoon poultry ginger paste | 1 pound chicken drumsticks, lightly crushed | 1 package frozen small meatballs, thawed | 8 ounces sourdough bread, cut into small cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the bread crumbs, wine, marjoram, ginger paste, and poultry and ginger paste together in a bowl. Place the chicken drumsticks in a bowl and toss with the crumb mixture to coat. Place the chicken in a large baking dish and toss to coat. Arrange the bread cubes in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Turning once, top slices of bread with a few cubes of chicken breast. Return to the oven for another 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Spiced Drumsticks with Mint
ingredients: 8 large chicken drumsticks | 4 tablespoons ground mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees centigrade. Place a baking sheet in a preheated oven and bake chicken for 40 minutes or until cooked. Remove from oven and place a damp cloth on the drumsticks. Spread 1 tbsp ground mint in each drumstick. Place on a large, lightly buttered baking tray and bake for 20 minutes or until dry. Turn over and bake for 10 minutes or until sticky. Return to oven for a few minutes to brown mint. Serve with mint over a warm flat green salad. This mint flavoured chicken recipe is from my book, https, //www. Amazon. Com/mint flavoured chicken cooking wine recipe book. Asian food food food loaf recipespot. Shailtavoo/.

title: Avocado Chili
ingredients: 3 medium ripe avocados | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 tablespoon diced red bell pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Halve, pit, and seed the avocados. Cut each in half and scoop out the flesh with a melonballer into a bowl. Mash with a fork until the avocados are smooth with no large chunks. Add the chili paste, bell pepper, and hazelnuts. Mix well. Serve topped with parmesan for a true chili experience.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,plain flour,white bread,beef broth,white onion,ham,green onion,red kidney bean
title: Haggis
ingredients: 1 ounce plain flour | 3/4 ounce green onion, thinly sliced | 1 small white onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb ham, cut in thin strips | 1/2 lb red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 4 1/2 cups beef broth | 2 1/2 cups cooked black-eyed peas or 2 1/2 cups canned dark kidney beans, drained | 2 ounces light dark brown sugar
instructions: Sift flour into a large bowl, then stir in green onion, onion and ham. In a small saucepan, heat broth with beans and sugar, then simmer for 30 minutes. Pour liquid into bread mixture and stir to mix. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours to overnight.. Preheat oven to 375°f. Place 1 tablespoon of gravy into a well greased shallow ovenproof dish. Top with reserved ham and ham and bake for 40 - 50 minutes, or until golden. Remove from oven and serve with rest of gravy.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,self raising flour,coconut rum
title: Coconut Rum & Coconut Crumble (Cake)
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup desiccated coconut ( i use desiccated coconut ) | 1/2 cup self raising flour
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs, coconut and flour in a bowl. Add the coconut rum stirring to combine. Roll out and pierce into desired size. Bake in a moderate oven for 15 minutes until golden.

title: Italian Sausages With Cornflour
ingredients: 2 italian sausages, casings removed | 1 tablespoon whole black peppercorn, with pods | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Place sausage into a non stick skillet. Grind peppercorns and italian sausage together. Coat each piece of sausage with cornflour. Bake at 180c/355f for 30 minutes.

title: Potted Port Wine
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 1/4 cup port wine
instructions: Mix oil and wine together. Pour into a jar with a lid. Seal, and store in the fridge until serving.

Random Ingredients: coriander,yogurt,shrimp paste,cumin powder,red wine vinegar,pepper flake
title: Spicy Yogurt With Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup yogurt | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar or 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon curry paste with herbs ( chutney or tomato based on your own preference ) | 1/2 teaspoon shrimp paste | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon coriander | 1 teaspoon pepper flakes
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine all ingredients and mix very well. Place in fridge until ready to serve or serve in a shallow bowl.

title: Spinach with Chiles, Garlic, and Fresh Goat’s Feet
ingredients: 3 fresh serrano chile peppers, chopped | 2 bunches baby spinach | 2 pounds fresh goya guajillo chilies - stemmed, seeded, and quartered | toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Combine serrano peppers, spinach, and guajillo chiles in a bowl, and sprinkle with toothpicks to coat. Place on a large baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until greens are tender and beginning to blacken, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven, and pour chile mixture over top as evenly as possible.

title: Mixed Semolina and Chilli Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground sultanas | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/3 cup semolina | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 6 boneless pork chops, with bone 1/4-in slices | 1/4 cup chopped broccoli | 3 small dried sesame seeds ( optional ) | 2 dried serrano chile peppers
instructions: Combine saultanas, tamari, semolina and baking powder. Pat pork chops with tamari mixture, then sprinkle both sides with sultanas and sesame seeds. Prepare dipping sauce, combine water, broccoli, sesame seeds, chiles and peppers. Cook pork chops at very hot temperature turning occasionally to brown well and vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,cream tartar,extra beef,lemon peel,tomato paste,pickling spice,sauce
title: Slow Cooker Corned Beef With Red Cabbage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pickling spices | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1 1/2 cups red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons pickling spices | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, grated | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 dash cream of tartar
instructions: Mix pickling spice with hot sauce, tomato paste and ground beef. Place the cabbage on the bottom of a shallow 2 1/2 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting 7 hours without stirring. Stir beef mixture, lemon peel and sour cream into slow cooker. Cover and continue to cook on low setting 30 minutes longer. Season sauce with cream of tartar.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,pico de gallo,poppy seed,parsley,leafy green,egg noodle,celeriac,beef rib
title: Quick Microwave Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef short ribs | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1 1/2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 2 cups thinly sliced celeriac, cut crosswise into 6 thin slices | 2/3 cup pico de gallo | 2 cups coarsely torn fresh curly-leaf green leafy stems from a large bunch of fresh curly-leaf green
instructions: Place short ribs in a 3 1/2 quart glass casserole dish with 2 tablespoons of rice wine, parsley, and poppy seeds. Close lid tightly. Cover tightly in slow oven. Heat to 1 1/2 hours, stirring every 15 minutes. Add celeriac and cook covered for 1 hour, or until meat is tender. Uncover.

Random Ingredients: shallot,black olive,garlic powder,cider vinegar,raisin,taco seasoning mix,artichoke heart
title: Mexican Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup raisins | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup black olives, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon dried minced shallots or 1/2 teaspoon minced green onion | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup cider vinegar, chilled
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine raisins, artichokes, black olives, shallots, garlic powder and taco seasoning. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until liquid is reduced to about 2 t. Drain artichoke mixture and liquid to 3/4 cup, about 20 minutes. Combine olive mixture and vinegar in a medium bowl and stir well. Remove 1 cup raisin mixture and place 1 tsp in center of each corn chip. Spread the prepared dip over the chip and garnish with reserved raisins.

Random Ingredients: red potato,corn oil,lemon peel,tomato,grapeseed oil,italian parsley,sun tomato,quinoa
title: Quinoa with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 1 cup peeled, diced red potatoes | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup grapeseed oil | 2 cups diced tomatoes | 1/2 cup finely chopped italian parsley ( flat leaf italian ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped lemon peel | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Prepare quinoa by rinsing until water has gone from the sun to the sun. Then soak in water to cover for 30 - 45 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the quinoa and potatoes in a large pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender and starts to turn translucent. Stir in tomatoes, oil, potatoes, parsley, lemon peel, and sun dried tomatoes. Cover and continue cooking 15 - 20 minutes, or until the tomatoes have absorbed most of the water. Remove from heat and set aside to let cool. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,taco seasoning,tangerine juice,oregano,bread flour,dark chocolate,grape juice
title: Tex Mex Chocolate Muffins
ingredients: 4 ounces dark chocolate, such as mexican style | 3/4 cup tangerine juice | 1/4 cup grape juice | 3/4 cup bread flour, plus more | bread flour, for muffin pans, room temperature | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line 12 muffin cups with paper liners. In small sauce pan over low heat, melt chocolate with tangerine juice, grape juice and 3/4 cup bread flour. Bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,white vinegar,garlic powder,grain white rice
title: Easy Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/4 cup uncooked long grain white rice, uncooked | 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef tenderloin | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon white vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Mix rice, beef, garlic powder and vinegar. Lay beef out on a piece of plastic wrap. Using a sharp knife, cut about 30 deep diagonal slices from each meat, stopping halfway through the cutting. Repeat until all the beef is included in the dish. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes or until well browned. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Oatmeal
ingredients: 4 ounces porridge oats or 4 ounces porridge oats | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon vinegar
instructions: Mix the oats and tarragon vinegar with 1 tsp each of salt and pepper. Put into a bowl and add 1 cup very hot water. Leave to stand for 10 minutes. Take off the water and stir. Tip the oat mixture into a large bowl, knead it lightly to mix in, then roll into small balls. Cook the oatmeal on a well greased griddle, turning once, until golden. Serve with a crisp salad or cream. For vegetarian use vegetable stock.

title: French Bananas (Hedgiehogres De Banon)
ingredients: 2 bananas, ripe | 2 tablespoons sherry wine, sweet ( optional )
instructions: Peel the bananas and cut them lengthwise into thick bite sized pieces. In a heavy skillet, heat the sherry. Remove the skillet from heat and add the bananas, turning so they do not brown. Serve warm.

title: Pork Salad With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | 1/4 lb pork, sliced 1/4 inch | 32 slices lebanese cucumbers, thin slices | 36 kalamata olives, cut in half | 1/4 cup tomato and chili sauce | 1/4 cup mascarpone | 1 portabella mushroom, sliced
instructions: Place all ingredients except mango, on serving plate, top with mango slices. Enjoy.

title: Easy Low Fat Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Combine flour, garlic salt and tomato sauce in a blender. Blend until the mixture resembles cracker crumbs. Turn blender to low. Add rum if using. Store covered in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,pork tenderloin,salt black pepper,sea salt
title: Portabella Sticky Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 10 portabella mushrooms, stems removed
instructions: Preheat oven on broiler setting. Cut a slit into the center of the tenderloin, just enough to make a pocket. Rub half of the sea salt and half of the pepper on the pork, and place on a baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven until the center has turned a rich golden brown color, about 40 minutes. Turn the oven off, and allow the pork meat to rest in the oven until cool, about 1 hour. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Slice the tenderloin into slices until 1/4 inch thick. Heat the portabella mushrooms in the skillet, stirring to remove any browned bits of flavor. Season to taste with more salt and pepper, and serve alongside the pork slices.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,anise seed,rice,rice wine,pimiento,wide egg noodle,meat
title: Mama Faye's Noodles & Meat With Rice
ingredients: 8 ounces wide egg noodles, cooked | 1 lb cooked meat | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 -2 tablespoon pimiento or 1 -2 tablespoon bacon fat | 2 tablespoons dry rice wine | 1 -2 tablespoon minced pimiento | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the egg noodles, meat, lime zest and juice, zest, juice, pimiento pepper or bacon fat and rice wine. In a small frying pan, toast the anise seeds. Once the anise is aromatic and beginning to turn color, add the toasted seeds and the juice from the pimiento. Allow the liquid to cook down until it thickens a little. You may need to add more liquid. Pour mixture into the egg noodles and toss so they stick together. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: penne,head garlic,cherry tomato,cabbage,basmati rice,asafoetida powder,anchovy oil
title: Cabbage-Tomato Pasta Soup With Anchovies and Asafote
ingredients: 3 cups finely shredded cabbage | 3 cups finely shredded basmati rice ( not long grain rice but is a must ) | 1/2 small head of garlic, peeled | 1/4 cup anchovies packed in oil, cut into chunks | 1 pinch asafoetida powder or 1 pinch fahrenheit oil, for sprinkling | 10 cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 3/4 lb penne
instructions: Put shredded cabbage and rice in a pan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Cover and simmer until cabbage is tender and rice is fully cooked. Rice is usually done after fifteen minutes. Meanwhile, in a hot skillet, warm 1/2 tbs. Of the anchovy oil over medium heat for a minute, or until the anchovies start to give off a nice smell. Remove the anchovies and set aside. Bring the soup back to a boil again and add the remaining anchovies. Lower heat to low and simmer until the asafoetida is absorbed. While waiting for the soup to boil, place the cherry tomatoes and garlic in a blender. Add enough cold water to the blender to create 1 can of anchovy water. Shake the blender until the asafoetida is incorperated into the mixture. When the soup comes to a boil, add the tomato garlic mixture in the blender. Cover and cook until the tomatoes are tender. It should only take about 5 minutes. Add 1/3 cup water if the soup boils down. If the soup is too thick, add a little water.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,grapefruit juice,mint,green curry paste,black eyed pea,parsley,hard egg,plain flour
title: Grapefruit Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1/2 kg black-eyed peas, cooked, drained and rinsed well | 4 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 2 tablespoons parsley, finely chopped | 1 green curry paste ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 2 tablespoons grapefruit juice | 1 packet hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, finely chopped
instructions: Drain, wash and drain the black eyed peas well and cut the cooked eggs into quarters. Heat oil in a wok and stir fry the boiled eggs for 2 minutes. Remove from the wok, place in a bowl, set aside. In the same oil, dry fry the curry paste until aromatic. Add the crushed grapefruit juice and stir fry for one minute. Add the ranch dressing mix and stir. Serve over the black eyed peas with chopped fresh mint. Garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,tarragon,amchur powder,cherry tomato,fruit,cream cheese,yukon gold potato,pumpkin puree
title: Cornish Tails in Tasty Tasty Tomato Mash #5FIX
ingredients: 1 can sweet potatoes | 1 1/4 cups canned tart cherry tomatoes | 1 package cream cheese | 1 package tarragon | 2 teaspoons tarragon | 2 tablespoons dried fruit or 2 tablespoons canned pumpkin puree | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon guar gumbo taco seasoning | 1 -2 tablespoon amchur powder
instructions: In large mixing bowl, stir together sweet potatoes, cherry tomatoes, cream cheese and taco seasonings.

title: Vanilla Vodka Eggs
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Beat egg white until stiff with a mixer. Gradually add vodka. Fold egg white into vodka mixture. Cover and refrigerate. Refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,ginger garlic paste,catsup,potato water,brandy,red curry paste
title: Bombay Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup catsup | 1/3 cup potato water | 1/3 cup red curry paste | 1/4 cup brandy | 1/4 cup ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve with chicken or seafood.

title: White Bean and Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 2 packages lasagna noodles | 1 quart dry navy beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line 3 baking sheets with parchment paper. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook noodles for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain. Combine navy beans and mace in a large bowl. Spoon 1/2 of the dry noodles into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place 1/2 of the bean mixture over the noodles, breaking apart any pieces that don't fit. Sprinkle on remaining noodles and spread remaining bean mixture. Cover with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Remove foil, top with cooked sauce and continue baking 10 more minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: sauce,sumac,broccoli floret,portabella mushroom,tortilla,fish fillet,chili pepper flake
title: Grilled Whole Fish With Veggies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fish fillets, halved | 1/2 cup sweet red peppers or 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 medium fresh hot-tangerine pepper ( optional ) | 2 cups broccoli florets, trimmed | 1 cup portabella mushroom, sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac ( optional ) | 12 warm tortillas or 12 white flour tortillas
instructions: Place thawed fish in a baking dish. Place red or green peppers on top of fish. If using pepper flakes, add now and top with mushroom slices. Sprinkle with sumac and bake uncovered in a hot skillet until fish is cooked and fish flakes easily and lightly browned. While chicken or vegetables are grilling cook tortilla in oven or on cookie sheet until warm and pliable or wrap them in foil and heat in 350 degree oven for 20 minute let set for a few minutes. Flip fish over. Serve warm. Note, if using a bruschetta, place in a small baking dish and bake for about 15 minutes, flipping fish halfway through.

Random Ingredients: glace cherry,chocolate wafer,mostaccioli pasta,hot paprika,vanilla essence,baguette
title: Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 1 baguette, sliced and cut in half diagonally | sweet paprika ( to sprinkle ) | 100 g chocolate wafers | chocolate wafer | 1 glass hot paprika ( to sprinkle ) | 1 cup glace cherries, washed and finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups mostaccioli pasta
instructions: Arrange baguette slices in a single layer in a large shallow ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Pour hot sweet paprika over and stir until paprika is evenly distributed throughout. Add chocolate wafer crumbs and stir until crumbs are lightly moistened. Spread on top of paprika. Bake in a slow oven approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown. Meanwhile, melt chocolate wafer base in a bowl on the stove/broiler setting on 200ºc / 250ºf. Add cherries and stir until soft and evenly distributed. Remove from oven. Spread on top of chocolate covered baguette slices. Sprinkle with sweet paprika and return to oven. Bake 8 – 9 minutes, or until lightly toasted. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with more paprika before serving. Serve immediately.

title: Totally Melted Caribbean Peanut Butter
ingredients: 12 ounces melted cantaloupe | 1 large spanish onion, chopped
instructions: Dice onion up and mix in a bowl. Cut melted melted melted melted melted melted cantaloupe with a potato peeler. Mix in bowl and eat with pita bread as a side vegetable.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,stewing beef,part ricotta cheese,chili powder,mustard powder,rump steak,prosciutto,extra beef
title: The Incredible Beef Roll
ingredients: 250 g part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared mustard powder | 250 g lean stewing beef | 2 -3 tablespoons chili powder ( use more or less depending on heat desired but we've not used ) | 125 g prosciutto, chopped ( or 1-2 slices thick cut bacon ) | 125 g small rump steak, chopped into very small cubes | 12 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Heat the oven to 190c. Place the beef, ricotta, mustard powder and chilli powder in a food processor and process until smooth. Spread the beef in a large oven proof dish. Add the prosciutto and stir to combine. Top with rump steak and mint leaves. Bake for 30 minutes, checking and stirring every 20 minutes or so until it reaches your liking. The mint leaves will give off a smokey aroma.

title: Aloo Palak(Green Pea and Prawns With Tomato)
