ingredients: 2 cans plums tomatoes | 400 g medium prawns | 5 sprigs fresh coriander ( cilantro )
instructions: Rinse both cans of tomatoes under cold water, drain in a colander and squeeze with your fingers until almost all the liquid has been removed. Chop the tomatoes coarsely, discarding the stems and seeds. Heat a medium sauté pan over medium heat, add a little oil and when hot fry the prawns for about 4 - 5 minutes until just cooked, breaking up the prawns as they cook, but not yet cooked through. Remove and set aside. Add to the same pan the tomatoes, 3/4 cup water, and a pinch of salt and pepper, reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer, shaking the pan once or twice, for about 15 - 20 minutes or until the liquid has reduced by half. Stir the coriander through the tomato mixture, if using, then spoon into bowls and serve with the remaining tomatoes around.

title: Chile Pearl Barley  Dip
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups pear barley | 3 green chilies, seeded | 4 whole cardamom | 2 cups red chile | 3 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 cup caramel or 1 cup dark corn syrup
instructions: Place the barley and chilies in a bowl and cover with water. Set aside. Place the cardamom in a small pan and roast lightly over a low heat for 5 minutes, or until aromatic. Cool for 30 minutes. Remove the cardamom and discard. Place in a blender with the rest of the ingredients. Blend until combined. Spoon into a shallow serving dish. Chill overnight, but no longer than an hour.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,green cardamom,chicken breast half,self raising flour,yellow pepper,hungarian paprika,turmeric powder
title: Nigerian Chicken
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, each bone in | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 2 teaspoons green cardamoms | 4 small yellow peppers, sliced thinly | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise, scraped and scraped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup self-raising flour
instructions: In plastic bag fitted with large star nozzle, mix turmeric, paprika and cardamom. Add chicken pieces and toss to coat evenly. Add peppers and vanilla bean and toss lightly to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate overnight. In small bowl, stir together the flour and a little water. Dip chicken in flour mixture and drop, one at a time, into hot oil. Fry until golden brown and brown on both sides. Drain on paper towels.

title: Crock Pot Irish Lamb Chops
ingredients: 12 lamb chops, trimmed | 1 rutabagas, chopped ( optional ) | 1 lb trimmed green beans
instructions: Place the rutabaga and beans in the bottom of your crock pot, top with chops. Cover the chops with rutabagas and green beans.

title: Beef With Penny and Oregano
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean stewing beef | 1/2 lb red potatoes, cut in 3-inch chunks | 1 ounce pepperoni, cut in 1-inch pieces | 3 tablespoons pistachios, shelled, roasted | 1 ounce orange peel, grated | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Put everything together and in a pan and turn on very low, stirring occasionally to make sure everything gets a dark colour. Leave. After 1 1/2 hours open, stir well, then leave to simmer in low heat for a further 3 hours. Taste for seasoning. If you are serving it at a party, serve with freshly cooked buttered noodles and a good thick gravy. Note, for a thicker mash, boil the potato in water for 15 minutes, then drain.

title: Fresh Tamarind Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups tamarind paste ( tamarind powder with 1 tablespoon water added ) | 2 scallions
instructions: Wash the tamarind root well under running water and remove sand. Place it in a large bowl and cover with very hot water. Allow to soak for 15 minutes. Drain and discard water. Cut into 2 - 3 pieces. Peel the scallion and set in the bowl of a food processor or blender, with about 2 tablespoons of the soaking soaking water, and process very briefly. If the pulp looks dry, add about 1/2 cup boiling water. Stir and puree until smooth, set aside to cool. You should have about 1 1/2 cups of chutney. Pour in your tamarind mixture, bring to boiling, and simmer about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve at room temperature and enjoy.

title: Lori's Veal Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds veal cutlets ( round ), boned and cut into 2x2-inch pieces | 1/3 cup raisins
instructions: Arrange a layer of the veal pieces into a shallow bowl. Sprinkle each piece with raisins, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours. Preheat large skillet over medium heat. When surface of meat looks dry, add the veal.

Random Ingredients: mace,clam,sesame seed,sugar,bell pepper,red food coloring,orange marmalade
title: Mamaw's Spicy Clam Chowder
ingredients: 4 lbs small clams | 2 bell peppers | 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 3 dashes red food coloring
instructions: Clean clams and set aside. Cut bell pepper and remove stem and veins. Cut clams into smaller pieces. Rinse peppers under cold water and remove skin and blemishes. Discard shells. Break up clams with hands, shaking gently so that clams do not stick. Transfer to soup pot or slow cooker stoneware. Add pepper chunks, marmalade, sugar, mace, cloves, and food coloring. Taste and adjust color if needed. If soup tastes acidic, add sugar and food coloring, and stir. You should have a nice red color, but not a yellow color.

title: Aromatic Sweet-Cream
ingredients: 1/2 lb semolina | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 f. In a large bowl, toss together the semolina and sesame oil with a fork. Stir in the vanilla. Drain the canned pineapple juice into the bowl. Stir in the pineapple. Scoop the mixture into an 8 x 8, baking dish that is just large enough to accomodate the mixture. Smooth the surface. Bake in the oven 45 minutes, or until golden, basting often. Serve warm. Variation, substitute other sweeteners, such as walnut oil, coconut oil, or honey.

title: Peach and Celery Salad
ingredients: 4 large ripe peaches | 3 stalks celery ( about 2 1/4 lbs )
instructions: Peel and pit the peels and cut the peaches into 6 or 8 wedges each. Toss with celery and serve.

title: Easy Tortilla and Coriander Chicken Burritos
ingredients: 500 g chicken thigh fillet | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 80 g coriander, roughly chopped | sea salt | 1 tortilla, cut into 5 wedges
instructions: Place chicken pieces in medium bowl. Sprinkle with the coriander and toss until coated. Heat up a griddle pan over medium heat. Place tortilla in pan, cook for 1 - 2 minutes per side. Remove from heat, spread with cole slaw, and top with chicken. Serve with rice or frijoles for a wonderful burritos.

title: Oamc - Algerian Pepper and Aubergine Breakfast Skillet Meal
ingredients: 3 large aubergines, about 1lb, peeled and sliced | 1/2 lb bell pepper, trimmed rinsed, pith ends removed, chopped | 1 cup bulgur wheat
instructions: Heat oven to 230c/fan 200c/gas cut the aubergines into 1/4in slices. Place in a heat proof bowl with just enough water to cover. Place in oven and bake for approximately 1 hour until tender and golden. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Drain aubergines and set aside. Add all remaining ingredients to the bowl with aubergines and mix well. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,chicken stock cube,marshmallow,mexican corn,chicken leg,raisin,peppercorn,diet lemon lime soda
title: Lite Loco Chicken
ingredients: 1 can diet lemon lime soda | 1 tablespoon mixed peppercorns ( optional ) | 2 cups chicken broth | 1 beef broth cube ( optional ) | 1 can mexican-style corn | 2 chicken legs ( optional ) | 1/2 cup raisins | 2 cups miniature marshmallows
instructions: Soak raisins in honey until the scent disappears, add 1 cup of chocolate chips. Set aside. Combine broth cube and peppercorns in a saucepan. Slowly add the beef broth cube mixture, stirring until dissolved. Add corn, peas, and chicken. Simmer and simmer covered until the chicken falls apart, remove chicken and set aside. Add raisins to the simmering broth. Cover and simmer for 15 - 15 minutes, remove the cover and simmer until most of the liquid is reduced. Serve chicken over noodles or rice. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,dill weed,pork shoulder,bamboo shoot,spanish onion,bean,swordfish steak
title: Flemish-Style Swordfish and Pork
ingredients: 3 cups quick-cooking oats | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 12 ounces pork shoulder, cubed | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill weed | 2 pounds swordfish steaks, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the quick cooking oats in a large baking dish. Cook the onion in a skillet over medium high heat until onion is tender, about 3 minutes.

title: Habanero Peanuts
ingredients: 4 cups chopped snow peas | 1/3 cup gram flour | 1/3 cup canned habanero pepper, minced | 1/2 cup chilled yogurt
instructions: Place snow peas in a sieve.

title: Edamame and Salt Body Candy (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 dozen fresh edamame, cleaned and washed | 1 tablespoon raw salt ( or substitute salt ) | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 -2 teaspoon hot sauce ( or your choice ) | 3 cups ice water ( or more )
instructions: Using a fork mash together the salt, vinegar and hot sauce in a mortar and pestle or a bowl, making sure that the dissolved salt has dissolved. Add in the edamame, cover the bowl and gently press the edamame into a piece of plastic wrap that is just big enough to hold it all. Wrap the wrap in tin foil, pressing over the edamame to prevent a skin from forming. Refrigerate for 2 hours, or overnight. Remove the film on the surface, remove the plastic wrap and cut into 8 squares, placing each square on a tray. Prick each square with a fork all over, or line it with wax paper and a tea towel. Repeat with remaining cubes and serve.

Random Ingredients: white cake mix,basil pesto,red curry paste,pomegranate molasses,spinach leaf
title: Pana Colada Spinach Cake
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | 1 cup pomegranate molasses, or to taste | 1/2 cup basil pesto, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 package fresh spinach leaves, stems removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch pan, and line the bottom of the pan with parchment paper, then spread rice over the paper. Whisk pomegranate molasses, pesto, and curry paste in a bowl with a fork, and pour into prepared pan. Add spinach leaves, and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: flour,sea salt black pepper,chipotle chile adobo,pumpkin,cornbread,oatmeal,crescent,oyster sauce
title: Soy-Glazed Squash With Crunchy Oatbread
ingredients: 1/2 cup unbleached flour or 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup old fashioned oats, unsifted | 3/4 cup hoagie style oat meal, toasted and cooled | 1/4 cup pumpkin or 1/4 cup winter squash spice mix ( see ingredient note ) | 1 chipotle chiles in adobo, minced or 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, plus | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt and black pepper, to taste | 1 can crescent rolls, refrigerated | 1 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: For a less crusty crust, combine 1 tbsp flour with 1 tbsp old fashioned oats, whisk to combine.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,english cucumber,kaffir lime leaf,savory,pumpkin seed,sausage
title: Pumpkin Seed and Roasted Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin seeds | 30 ounces pumpkin-greens sausages, sliced or 15 ounces sausages, of your choice | 1 large zucchini or 1 large japanese eggplant | 1 large savory, leaf | 1 teaspoon dried cherries ( optional ) | 3 kaffir lime leaves, lightly crushed ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Spread pumpkin seeds on baking tray and roast about 2 - 3 minutes. You will need to cook them in a roasting pan so that they’re light brown. Allow to cool and peel away all skin. Tear off and discard any damaged or hard stem ends of the squash or zucchini, then place in a large bowl. Chop the sausages and mix with the sausages. Cut the zucchini or eggplant into 6 slices or 1 inch cubes, then toss in with the rest of the vegetables. Add the savory, cherries and lime leaves and mash with a fork or potato masher. Add more of whatever flavourings you would like and mix well, season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,thai basil,poblano chile,vanilla bean,vanilla sugar,parsley flake,ham,cheddar cheese
title: Carne Guisada
ingredients: 8 ounces ham, diced | 1 poblano chile, roasted ( diced ) | 1/2 large vanilla bean ( split ) | 2 tablespoons parsley flakes | 1/2 tablespoon cinnamon | 1/2 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 10 ounces cheddar cheese ( grated )
instructions: In a frying pan put all ingredients except cheese. Cook on low heat until the beans and peppers are almost soft. Stir. After 5 minutes add the cheese and mix until melted. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,red chile pepper,green curry paste,new mexico chile powder,italian seasoning,molasses,triple sec,kidney bean
title: Chinese Spicy Beef and Bean Chili
ingredients: 2 pounds sirloin, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package tri-colored fresh mushrooms | 2 tablespoons red chile pepper paste | 1 teaspoon mexican seasoning | 1 teaspoon new mexico chile powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon triple sec
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir sirloin in the hot skillet until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Tossed Romaine with Cardamom
ingredients: 30 slices round torpedo-hard salami ( torpedo size ) | 3/4 teaspoon mustard powder, or to taste | 6 romaine lettuce leaves, cut crossways into eight 1-inch sections | 1/4 pound thinly sliced pickled carrots ( optional )
instructions: Place torpedo slices, cut side up, in a shallow dish, and drizzle mustard powder on top. Cover, and refrigerate, stirring occasionally and flipping once, until chilled, about 5 minutes. Rinse lettuce leaves and pat dry with paper towels. Place lettuce leaves in a salad bowl, and top with sliced salami slices. Garnish with carrot slices, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,yellow squash,horseradish sauce,rice wine vinegar,bamboo skewer
title: Chinese Yellow Squash Skewers in Spicy Spices
ingredients: 1 lb yellow squash | 2 tablespoons horseradish sauce | 1 tablespoon maggi seasoning salt | horseradish sauce to taste | cooked rice wine vinegar
instructions: Halve squash lengthwise. Cut squash into long wedges. Cut squash into chunks about 1/4 inch wide. Thread squash cut sides down onto bamboo skewers. Arrange skewers on a foil lined baking sheet. Place in preheated oven and bake for about 30 minutes, or until squash is tender and juices run clear. Heat a small amount of oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Stir the horseradish sauce, maggi seasoning salt and grilled shrimp in the sauce until combined and hot. Place skewers on skewers and spoon over a large spoonful of the spicy horseradish sauce. Return skewers to the oven and bake for about 5 minutes, or until skewers are heated through.

Random Ingredients: penne,scallion,tabasco sauce,vanilla essence,tilapia fillet,green cardamom pod,cranberry,asiago cheese
title: Irish Penne With Creamy Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 bunches scallions, coarsely chopped ( spring onions ) | 12 green cardamom pods, bruised ( black peppercorns ) | 1/2 cup dried cranberries ( or more ) | 2 lbs tilapia fillets | 1/4 cup asiago cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence ( or lemon or lime if you wish ) | tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 1 lb penne, cooked al dente
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, scallion and cardamom pods just until the scallions are very tender and starting to turn golden. Stir in the cranberries and cook for 1 minute longer. Remove the cardamom pods and cranberries and set aside. Lightly coat a large skillet with cooking spray and set over medium high heat. When a drop of water sprinkled on top of the pan bead instantly evaporates, flip the tilapia fillets and coat with cooking spray. Brown them for 5 - 7 minutes per side or until a knife can pierce through the thickest part of the fish. Remove the fish to a plate. Return pan to high heat. Add the cheese and stir until melted and smooth. Stir in vanilla and tabasco. Bring to a boil. Pour over fish. Stir gently. Turn heat down to medium low. Cover and cook another 4 - 5 minutes or until the fish turns golden brown and the sauce is thickened and syrupy. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt, if necessary. Serve immediately over pasta.

title: Gran's Crunchy Slice
ingredients: 3 slices graham cracker crust | 1 cup sultanas
instructions: Break the graham cracker crust apart and spread out evenly with a floured rolling pin. Place the sultanas in a bowl and press into the centre of the cookie. Bake in a moderate oven until lightly browned, approx 20 minutes. Cut into 6 slices.

title: Cheat & Herb  Sausages
ingredients: 1 tablespoon spicy sausage, casing removed | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Remove the sausages from their casings and place on a well oiled baking sheet. Bake for 8 minutes then turn the sausage over, brush with 1 tablespoonful of tarragon, and cook for 5 minutes more, until the sausages have puffed and risen slightly at the edges. Serve immediately straight from the oven.

Random Ingredients: apricot,soy sauce,kirby cucumber,beef brisket,white hominy,granny smith apple
title: Ww Slow Cooker Corned Beef and Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1 can white hominy, drained | 1 granny smith apple, finely diced | 3 kirby cucumbers, chopped | 3 tablespoons apricots, chopped | 1/4 cup soy sauce
instructions: Place corned beef, hominy and apple into crock pot. Add soy sauce and apricots and stir well to combine. Cover and cook on low 7 hours or on high 3 1/2 hours or until beef and vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,lemon juice,kernel corn,sparkling wine,thyme leaf
title: Quick & Easy Tomato Corn
ingredients: 15 -20 ounces petite whole kernel corn | 1 bottle sparkling wine | 1/4 cup tomato puree or 1/4 cup tomato concentrate, heated ( no oil ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon fresh lemon juice ( to taste )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients and stir well. Cover and chill for a few hours or overnight. Keeps in the fridge for up to five days.

title: Apple Butter - Apple Schniezel
ingredients: 500 g marshmallows | 150 ml apple juice
instructions: Peel the marshmallows and cut them into 1cm cubes. Place the apple juice and marshmallows in a pan and stir over a gentle heat until melted and the marshmallows are thoroughly mixed together. Pour into an airtight container and keep in the fridge.

title: Smoky Parsnips on the Grill
ingredients: 1 large parsnip, scrubbed, peeled, chopped | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup pimento stuffed olive, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried basil | salt and pepper
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water, cook parsnips until tender but not falling apart, about 10 minutes. Drain well, then add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Season to suit individual tastes and serve.

title: Tomato Chile Salsa
ingredients: 3 cans stewed tomatoes with green chile peppers, undrained | 2 -3 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: Reserve 1 can stewed tomatoes and drain water. Set chile pepper aside. Combine reserved reserved tomatoes with reserved 1 can stewed tomatoes, mustard and chile pepper in a blender. Blend until smooth.

title: Chocolate Ravioli-Pancakes - Mande
ingredients: 2 packages of ravioli | 1 package unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Heat water in a frying pan at medium heat. When the water starts to boil, cut the chocolate into small chunks. Use a pastry brush to lightly coat the bottom of the pan. Heat the water and chocolate in the microwave on high for 15 - 20 seconds on high. When the chocolate is completely melted set it aside to cool slightly and stir until smooth. Spread the cooked raviolis in a pan and place in the freezer until firm. Remove half of the freezer from the raviolis, place it on a plate, and return it to the freezer. Add the remaining raviolis and return it to the freezer until you are ready to use them. When ready to use, add the chocolate and stir until smooth. Serve with toothpicks and a cup of hot milk.

title: Creamy Pesto Cauliflower and Cod
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cauliflower, chopped | 1/2 cup mild creole-style pesto sauce | 1/2 cup red cabbage, shredded | 3/4 cup cod, cubed | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning
instructions: Combine cauliflower, pesto sauce, cabbage, fish, and creole seasoning in a microwave safe serving dish. Cook microwave on high power for 8 to 10 minutes until vegetables are tender.

title: Crock Pot Squash
ingredients: 1 medium squash, cut into 3/4'cubes | 1 tablespoon fat free sour cream or 1 tablespoon mexican blend cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot, stirring regularly. Cook on low 4 hours.

title: Easy Balsamic Beef
ingredients: 1 sirloin, meat of choice | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 lb steak, cubed | 1/2 cup finely chopped spring onion | 1 container frozen reduced-fat topping, thawed
instructions: Place beef, vinegar and onions in a roasting pan. Bake at 325 degrees for about 2 hours. Heat oven to broil, brown meat with a little water. Pour reduced fat topping over meat, broil for 3 - 5 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,pesto sauce,orange liqueur,no salt tomato sauce,lime juice,mature cheddar cheese
title: Tomato Cheddar Canapés
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil ( or other neutral oil ) | 1 teaspoon orange-flavored liqueur ( emeril's essence ) | 1 cup no-salt-added tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons no-salt-added pesto sauce, or a bit of plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons no-salt-added no-sugar-added no-sauce tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lime juice ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup coarsely shredded medium-grind old dutch-style cheddar cheese ( for example )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the canola oil, orange flavored liqueur, and no-salt tomato sauce in a medium size bowl. Stir to combine. Add the pesto, lime juice, and cheese to the bowl, and stir to combine. Pour mixture into a pastry bag with a large plain tip. Seal the bag and shake until the mixture resembles fine bread crumbs. Transfer the mixture to the resealable gallon sized zipper top bag. Shake off excess oil. Sprinkle the canapés with the cheese and press the bag on top. Transfer the canapés to the lined baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes. Serve warm, or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,vanilla,vanilla ice cream,hot italian sausage,cocoa powder,tortilla,fruit
title: Sausage Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 3/4 cup shredded low-fat cheddar cheese | 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, divided | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup finely diced dried fruit | 6 6 tortillas, such as corn, flour or 6 tortillas
instructions: Brown sausage over medium heat.

title: Hot German Ham Slaw
ingredients: 1 package sliced deli ham | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 cup seedless raspberry, halved | 1 cup sweet red wine | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Place ham slices and corn in a large bowl.

title: Nungakaya Sambal Kachumber (Green Curry Pasties)
ingredients: 1 package firm-ripe green curry paste, halved lengthwise | 20 toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Cut a slit in one end of each curry paste corner, and set back up on the baking sheet. Drizzle oil onto the slashed bottoms of the curry pasties with the cut side uppermost until well coated. Place the pasties on the baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Roasted Sweet and Sour Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon coarse grain black pepper
instructions: Whisk together the vinegar and black pepper. Heat in a small heavy skillet over medium heat until hot but not bubbly. Add sweet and sour dipping sauce.

title: Bavarian Sea Scallops
ingredients: 100 ml active dry yeast | 500 ml warm water | 1 kg sea scallops | 1 garlic clove, crushed
instructions: Combine yeast, water and salt in a large bowl. Make a well in the centre and dissolve salt. Dip scallops in the yeast solution and leave until the scallops are glazed. Gently press scallops and garlic onto a tray with a metal spoon. Place scallops in a roasting dish in a single layer, cover tightly and keep warm in a warm place. Pre heat the oven to 220c and bake the scallops for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with kielbasa, vegemite, bread or breadcrumbs.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,salmon,tomato juice,cream chicken soup,jumbo shrimp,cannellini bean
title: Quick and Easy Seafood and Cannellini Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can pineapple juice | 1 1/2 cups canned salmon or 1 1/2 cups cooked shrimp | 1 can crushed tomatoes with juice, undrained
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the soup, beans, pineapple juice, salmon or shrimp and tomatoes. Heat through, but do not boil. Taste and add salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,kosher salt,confectioner ' sugar,tap water,fish sauce,coconut milk
title: Sweet Dipping Sauce for Seafood
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups unsweetened coconut milk | 14 tablespoons cold pressed tap water | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/3 cup finely chopped unsweetened coconut milk | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fish sauce | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar ( optional ) | kosher salt ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine all ingredients except confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: coriander,chocolate ice cream,wheat pastry flour,egg beater substitute,thyme leaf,clove,mint leaf
title: Cape Velvet Pie
ingredients: 8 ounces chocolate ice cream, softened | 2 tablespoons egg substitute | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme leaves ( chopped or 2 tsp. dried ) | 2 teaspoons fresh coriander leaves ( chopped or 1/2 tsp. dried ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves, to taste | 1 cup skim milk or 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: For the pie crust, beat ice cream, egg substitute and herbs in a big bowl with whisk. Add milk, stirring until smooth. Stir in flour. Press into an 8 inch pie or a 9 x 9 inch pie dish. Bake at 375º in center of oven about 35 minutes or until puffed and golden, and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Cran-Cucumber Relish
ingredients: 1 cup cranberry sauce ( i like kool-aid ) | 1 medium cucumber
instructions: Put cranberry sauce in a bowl and squeeze in the cucumbers before adding to the oil. Cover and shake very well. This relish can last in the fridge for several months.

Random Ingredients: hot red chilies,salt pepper,peanut oil,chili paste garlic,crescent dinner,chicken wing
title: Chinese Che Gio Pancake
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, separated and tips discarded | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | salt and pepper | 1 package crescent dinner roll | 1 can sliced dried hot red chilies ( or chili flakes of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Preheat 2 inch nonstick skillet over med high heat. Place chicken wings into skillet and cook, turning often, until browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer wings to crescents. Increase heat to med high and repeat with remaining chicken wings. Stir fry red chilies in oil until dark golden, about 2 minutes. Place chicken on plate with chilies. Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat remaining 1 tbsp oil in pan. Add crescents and cook, stirring, until deep golden brown, about 2 minutes. Add chicken mixture to skillet. Place in oven until cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and keep warm. Increase heat and add the remaining oil. When it is almost smoking, put 1 c c fried chilies in the pan. Cook until golden, about 2 minutes. Remove from pan and let cool slightly. Cut into 5 - 1 squares. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,red chili pepper,crouton,green chili
title: Lahmajoon (Bell Pepper Condiment)
ingredients: 2 cups croutons | 1/2 cup red bell pepper | 1/2 cup green chili | 1/2 cup ground red chili pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve.

title: Filling for Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 container refrigerated frozen whipped topping | 1 lb lean beef brisket, cut crosswise into thin slices | 4 ounces canned diced green chilies, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a large shallow baking dish, spread frozen whipped topping evenly. Arrange sliced brisket atop the whipped topping.

title: Italian Zucchini and Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed zucchini, zucchini, yellow squash, frozen can be used | 1 lb ground chicken | 1 can ketchup | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 jar pimentos, sliced | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Coat a 10 x 15 inch pan with cooking spray. Place zucchini, squash, and chicken in a mixing bowl and season with ketchup, oregano, italian seasoning, and pimentos. Pour mixture into prepared pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake uncovered in preheated 180c oven for 40 to 60 minutes, or until zucchini is tender. Cool slightly and cut into squares with a cookie cutter. Enjoy.

title: Cumin-Spiced Salt Crackers
ingredients: 3 cups ice | 1 tablespoon ground cumin ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric ( optional )
instructions: Stir together all ingredients in a small bowl. Mixture may also be covered and chilled, sealed, for up to 3 days. To crack crack, remove a portion of the mixture and roll in coarse cornmeal. Using floured hands, roll crackers into slightly flattened balls, 1/2 inch in diameter. Serve immediately. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: crookneck yellow squash,anchovy paste,sherry wine vinegar
title: Easy Crookneck Yellow Squash
ingredients: 4 cups peeled and diced crookneck yellow squash | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine potatoes and anchovy paste. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, for about ten minutes, until potatoes start to brown. Add water if mixture becomes dry. Cover pan with lid and cook over very low heat for 20 minutes. When squash is fork tender, transfer to serving or bowl and sprinkle with sherry vinegar.

title: Bamboo Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 can canned bamboo shoots | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 cup fat free chocolate syrup
instructions: Place bamboo in blender jar. Add diced tomatoes, chilies and syrup and blend until sauce is smooth. Pour sauce over drained bamboo shoots and blend until glaze is slightly thickened. Add more sauce if desired.

title: Lollyfinger Fritters or Easy Crepes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 -3 tablespoons ladyfingers ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a wide, nonstick saute pan or skillet over medium heat. Add the ladyfingers if using and cook, turning once or twice, until golden brown and crisp, about 2 - 3 minutes per side. Remove from heat. Drizzle 1/2 teaspoon olive oil over the top of the fritters. Use a spool to dip the ladyfingers into the hot oil. Allow to cook on the bottom, then the right side, allowing some of the oil and oil to drip back into the pan.

Random Ingredients: salt,anise seed,celery salt,mexican chocolate,lime juice zest,coriander powder
title: Anise Spice
ingredients: 500 g unsweetened mexican chocolate, melted and cooled | 2 1/3 cups freshly squeezed lime juice, from about 12 limes | 20 dried anise seeds | 1 tablespoon ground coriander powder | 1 teaspoon low-sodium instant malt extract or 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Using a wire whisk, combine the melted chocolate, lime juice and ground anise seeds to make the spice base. Remove and set aside the anise spice base from the fridge. In a small bowl, combine the coriander, malt powder, celery salt and lime juice. Pour the spice base and lime juice mixture into the spice base and let sit for 30 minutes. Strain into a sterilised container and store in the frig.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,peanut oil,red cabbage,spinach,italian turkey sausage link
title: Sausage and Red Cabbage with Spinach
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut oil | 4 italian turkey sausage links, casings removed | 400 g red cabbage ( about 1 1/2kg '' ) | 150 g fresh spinach | 2 garlic cloves, crushed
instructions: Heat oil and sausages over medium high heat, turning occasionally, for 3 - 4 minutes or until cooked through. Cut cabbage into 1 - 2 inch pieces, toss in a large bowl and add spinach. Season with salt and pepper. Sauté until wilted, 5 - 7 minutes. Garnish with garlic and serve.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,cooking oil,avocado,pineapple,table salt,carrot,gai lan,chinese five spice powder
title: Gai Lan Chicken Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 cup gai lan, chopped into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup zucchini, halved lengthwise, sliced crosswise into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup carrot, julienned | 1/4 cup canned crushed pineapple, drained and reserve 1/4 cup juice | 2 medium ripe avocados, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | cooking oil or cooking spray ( optional )
instructions: Spray nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Add cooking oil and five spice powder. Cook 1 minute or until fragrant. Add gai lan and zucchini. Cook 2 minutes or until softened. Stir in carrots. Transfer to a bowl, reserving 1/2 cup juice. Add pineapple and reserved pineapple juice. Toss well. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Serve, garnished with avocado slices.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,russet potato,fennel seed,kahlua,chicken broth,thyme sprig
title: Spicy Tater Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes, scrubbed | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth, canned | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 1 1/2 cups kahlua or 1 1/2 cups other coffee-flavored liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a large bowl, toss potatoes with chicken broth, salt, fennel seeds and thyme. Place on a baking sheet and bake until tender, about 1 hour. Remove and let cool slightly. Stir kahlua into the warm potatoes. Transfer potatoes to a large baking dish and set aside. Bake for 20 minutes more. Remove and let cool slightly before serving.

title: Smoked Salmon and Chilli Rice
ingredients: 1 cup sushi rice | 1 cup smoked salmon, thinly sliced | 2 medium tomatoes, sliced thinly | 2 teaspoons berbere | 1 teaspoon pernod | 1 english cucumber, thinly sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon irish whiskey | 1 -2 tablespoon crushed pernod, to taste
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a large pan. Cook over a high heat for about 5 - 10 minutes or until the rice is cooked. Fluff with a wooden spoon and serve.

title: Potato Mushroom Capsicum
ingredients: 7 white potatoes, washed, peeled and sliced thinly ( approx 2 pounds total ) | 4 cups light cream ( not whipped cream ) or 4 cups cremini mushroom capsicum, sliced thinly ( approx 2 pounds total ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice or 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons basil pesto ( or your favourite herb mix ) | 1 -2 tablespoon ground turmeric
instructions: Preheat griller. Place each sliced potato in a single layer on a tray lined with baking paper. Place under a hot griller and bake for about 20 minutes or until golden on each side. Meanwhile, in a large bowl mix together all other ingredients in a small bowl, reserving the pesto or chopped herb mix from the list of ingredients. Toss drained potatoes and pesto/herb mixture with toasted garlic breadcrumbs. Serve warm. Variation, instead of parmesan, you can use mozzarella cheese or asiago cheese if you wish, sprinkled over the top of the potato/pesto mixture just before serving.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,garlic salt,grain rice,cornflour,whipping cream,velveeta cheese,triple sec
title: Crock Pot Rice Divine Pudding
ingredients: 3 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 lb velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 14 ounces white mushrooms | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Brown mushrooms in a little olive oil or butter. Layer the ingredients into crock pot starting with rice followed by the cheese, followed by the mushrooms. Cover and cook on high setting 4 - 5 hours. You may add up to 3/4 cup water as needed. You may sprinkle cornflour over top, but this is not necessary at all. Also you can substitute a 1/2 cup of cream for the 2 1/2 tablespoons of triple sec. This is an interesting turn of summertime dish, not like ouzo in its flavor.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,cinnamon sugar,liquid smoke,arugula,poblano chile,white sesame seed,gold tequila,almond essence
title: Apple Samosa
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, stemmed, seeded, cut into strips | 4 cups arugula - stemmed, washed, trimmed | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds or 2 tablespoons sliced almonds, toasted | 3 tablespoons light-colored liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons fresh apple juice | 1/2 cup light agave syrup or 1/2 cup white sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 1 fluid ounce gold tequila ( i usually use mexican brand )
instructions: To roast poblanos, preheat the oven to 360 degrees f. Transfer the poblanos directly to a bowl. Toss with the arugula in a large bowl, then top with the sliced almonds, liquid smoke, liquid smoke, apple juice, agave syrup and tequila. Put the bowl in the oven and broil for 4 to 5 minutes, or until the arugula becomes crisp and lightly browned. Serve warm over grilled salmon, grilled chicken or shrimp.

title: Sausage Skewers
ingredients: 4 hot chili hot dogs | 4 links pork sausage
instructions: Prepare your hog or grill. Wash the sausage well. Take 3 - 4 links and put them on your skewers. Take the hot sausages and put them on the skewers. Let them soak up all the juice. Take your hog or grill and put it on medium heat. Let it cook for 30 - 40 minutes, turning occasionally.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,cayenne pepper,extra virgin olive oil,garlic scape,coffee,prawn,onion soup mix,palm sugar
title: Tietnamese Style Prawns
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons white palm sugar | 1 onion, chopped | 2 cloves garlic scapes, minced | 1 small bamboo shoot, finely chopped | 1 can condensed coffee | 1 packet onion soup mix | cayenne pepper to taste | 1 pound raw prawns, peeled and deveined
instructions: In a large, heavy skillet, heat 1/4 cup of olive oil. Saute onion, garlic, and scallions for 2 minutes. Add bamboo, coffee, soup mix, and a dash of cayenne pepper. Stir to blend. Add prawns, cover, and cook over medium heat until prawns turn pink. Serve immediately.

title: Irish Style Oster Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 -12 large oyster mushrooms, wiped clean | 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( optional )
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a large, heavy skillet, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for 6 to 8 minutes or until mushrooms are soft. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly to prevent burning. Place the caraway seeds in a mortar and pound with a pestle until the course powdery seeds taste their aroma. Place the mushrooms, drained of all but 1 tablespoon of the cooking liquid, into a clean skillet and add 1/2 teaspoon of the caraway seed powder or crushed red pepper flakes. Stir in the remaining caraway seed powder or crushed red pepper flakes if necessary. Simmer over low heat for 5 minutes, or until mixture is reduced to nearly the consistancy of porcini. Remove from heat and allow to stand, covered, for 30 minutes. Strain and store covered until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,extra tofu,hamburger,farfalle pasta,onion powder,brandy,apricot jam
title: Honduran Style Beef or Tofu Scramble
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra firm tofu or 1/2 cup firm tofu, finely diced, drained | 3 cups cooked hamburger or 3 cups shredded cooked beef | 1 jar apricot jam, jam style | 1/4 cup dry dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup cognac | 1 package farfalle pasta or, whole wheat spaghetti, cooked according to directions | onion powder
instructions: Combine well, and set aside. Mix the remaining ingredients very well.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,italian seasoning,kaffir lime leaf,pea,chicken stock
title: Kaffir Lime Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken piece | 2 pints chicken stock | 1 jar spaghetti sauce ( spaghetti or other brand ) | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 1 cup frozen peas
instructions: Boil the chicken pieces in chicken stock, until they are cooked through. Remove the chicken and set aside for later use. Combine the spaghetti sauce and dried italian seasoning. Stir into chicken. Mix well. Return the chicken to the stock. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Serve over noodles or rice. Garnish with additional fresh cilantro if desired.

title: Crayfish with Lemon
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato | 16 fluid ounces lemonade, chilled | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 12 leaves butter lettuce, with leaves | cilantro leaf, garnish | red pepper, garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Halve the potatoes lengthwise. Arrange on a baking sheet and bake for 30 min per batch. Cool slightly. Remove the potatoes from the oven and cut into medium sized chunks. Drain off any excess juices. Combine the potatoes, lemonade and cayenne in a bowl. Arrange on a serving platter. Arrange the lettuce leaves on top and drizzle with lemon juice. Garnish with cilantro leaves, red peppers. To make the lemon dressing, place all but a few of the lemon leaves into a jar. Add a small amount of water if needed, it should be liquid.

title: Pollo Asada--Tortilla Espanola
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 2 -3 slices of shredded fontina cheese
instructions: Put the first 3 ingredients into an oven safe dish. Cover with the fontina & bake for 45 minutes. The chicken will be cooked inside.

title: Nigella Lawson Bananas
ingredients: 8 bananas | 4 tablespoons brandy | 4 cloves garlic, crushed | 2 bamboo skewers
instructions: Cut the bananas in half lengthways and make sure they are all cut into 3cm pieces. Thread onto the skewers. Combine the brandy, garlic and banana pieces and brush onto them. Cook on a hot barbecue for about 10 - 15 minutes, or until the bananas are browned but still holding their shape. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,mascarpone cheese,orange zest,lettuce,sultana,pistachio,egg white,sauce
title: Pistachio Log With Dressing and Nutella for one
ingredients: 250 g low-fat mascarpone cheese | 1 egg white | 2 teaspoons fresh orange zest ( grated ) | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds ( finely ground ) | 3 drops hot sauce | 1 cup sultana ( chopped ) | lettuce ( to line serving plate's ) | 1 cup raw pistachios ( to line serving plate's )
instructions: Place all the dressing ingredients in a small bowl and blend until well combined. Line a baking tray with baking paper and scatter the sultanas and pistachios over. Tear off 3 - 4 strips of cling film, 2cm x 2cm & 1cm wide and place over the sultanas and pistachios. Brush the strips with the dressing and bake at c for 15 to 20 minutes until golden. Serve the log in lettuce leaves with the pistachio nuts alongside and the nuts for dipping.

title: Crock Pot for Carnitas
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Place brisket in crock pot. Pour cheese on top. Cook on high for 2 hours or on low for 7 hours. When carnitas are tender pull away from crock pot, place on flat plate, pull meat off bones and shred with two forks. Return meat to crock pot and continue cooking 3 - 4 hours more.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,purpose flour,balsamic vinegar,baby bok choy,seasoning,pumpkin puree,farfalle pasta
title: Pumpkin Noodle Bake
ingredients: 450 g farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon pepno-perm seasoning | 400 g pumpkin puree | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 3 cups baby bok choy, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta in lots of salt and a splash of oil until just tender but still a little firm to the bite. Meanwhile, whisk together the balsamic vinegar and pepno perm seasoning. Combine pasta and vinegar mixture with pumpkin and flour. Place in an ovenproof dish that has been lightly sprayed with cooking spray. Top with the sun dried tomatoes.

title: Nacho Chips
ingredients: 5 cups cornmeal | 3 cups romano cheese | 2 ounces canned sweet salsa ( or sour cream or plain yogurt )
instructions: Combine cornmeal and cheese in a heavy bottomed pot. Bring to a rolling boil and cook, stirring constantly, until it begins to pull away from the sides of the pan. Turn off the heat, and add salsa. When the mixture is cool, knead briefly on a lightly floured surface, or with hands. Place in plastic bag, cover, and chill until set.. Heat a griddle on medium heat. Form chips, dip into chilled salsa, and fry until golden brown, crispy, and slightly crispy on the outside. Store in a container.

title: Niter Keba
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground cloves | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( or more )
instructions: Mix or match ingredients, and store in an airtight container. Variation, use for basting while grilling. Use for seasoning bread.

title: Ponzu Sauce for Beef and Pork
ingredients: 2 ounces ponzu sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup marinated bar, from a high quality deli
instructions: Heat marinated bar from a high quality deli in a skillet. When bar is heated through add ponzu and marinated bar.

Random Ingredients: herring fillet,bok choy,anchovy,cider vinegar,peanut oil vegetable
title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 jar herring fillets ( or any other type of cooked fish ) | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon anchovy ( or 1 tsp of anchovy paste mixed into olive oil ) | 2 bunches bok choy ( about 1.5 lbs. )
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a medium sized sauce pan and heat over medium to medium high heat. Bring to a boil, then immediately remove from heat and set aside. Bring the herring fillet to room temp before continuing to boil and stir the mixture for about 20 - 30 minutes or until the herring flakes easily with a fork. Remove from heat and set aside. Boil the bok choy stems until just just softened. Drain and set aside. Rinse the herring under running water, pat dry with towel, and cut into bite size pieces. Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the herring, bok choy, and anchovy mixture and saute' or serve with rice.

title: Fantastic Boston Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 12 lettuce pieces ( i prefer the large ones ) | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, plus additional ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil on the counter. Place the lettuce into a bowl of cold water to prevent them getting cold. Rinse with cold water, drain, and place into the refrigerator. When ready to serve, place a piece of lettuce into a paper towel and squeeze the moist, sticky pulp out of each lettuce leaf. Heat a non stick frying pan over low heat for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and spread with 1 heaping tablespoon cinnamon for each wrap. Place some lettuce in the center of a warm, dry, crisp bun with the cinnamon. Cut off approximately 1/4 of the remaining roll. Place it on a plate, drizzle with 1 teaspoons cinnamon, and dig in.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,basil leaf,beef steak,rice noodle,yellow bell pepper,olive oil
title: Quick Beef and Basil Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top round steak, cubed | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 package thin beef flavored rice noodles ( rice sticks may be used if available ) | 1 cup coarsely chopped yellow bell pepper | 3/4 cup torn fresh basil leaf | 1 tablespoon fresh liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, stir fry steak in oil until beef is heated through. Remove and set aside to cool slightly. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine beef, noodles, green peppers, basil, and liquid smoke.

title: Jalapeno Lamb Meatballs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped jalapeno peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla custard powder ( the brand i have used is `` heinz ) | 1 lb ground lamb
instructions: Mix all until no clumps remain.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,chicken stock vegetable,coriander powder,blackberry,liquid smoke,nutritional yeast,cooking spray
title: Blackberry-Blackberry Soup Dip
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 cups chicken stock or 4 cups vegetable stock | 2 cups fresh blackberries or 2 cups frozen blackberries | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 2 tablespoons light dark rum ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Place the stock in a pot and bring to a boil. Add blackberries, nutritional yeast, rum, coriander and liquid smoke.

title: Welsh Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 3 lbs pork spareribs | 1/3 cup dryseasoning, such as mccormick's | 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed, halved, and cut into 1-inch wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Toss spareribs with enough dry seasoning to coat. Arrange in a single layer in a baking pan. Bake, turning once, until golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool, and then remove short rib bones with a slotted spoon, leaving as many bones as possible. Place potatoes in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, and simmer 5 minutes. Drain. Arrange pork in a single layer on a rack in a roasting pan. Reduce oven temperature to 325 degrees f. Cover roasting pan with foil, and bake 45 minutes, carefully turning ribs and basting frequently. Continue to bake, basting occasionally, until ribs are browned and cooked through, and vegetables are tender, about 5 hours longer. Remove foil from pan and let cool 20 minutes. Cut ribs into serving size pieces. Serve with potatoes.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,beef bouillon cube,maraschino cherry,salt pepper,biscuit crumb,butter,hard egg,baking soda
title: Baked Irish Crescents
ingredients: 2 cups biscuit crumbs | 1 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 3 tablespoons melted butter | 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 1/4 cup chopped maraschino cherry | 1 egg, lightly beaten | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix biscuit crumbs, grated cheddar cheese, and baking soda. In another bowl, mix melted butter with the ground beef, and then add the chopped cherry. Add the egg, and fold in, just until mixed. Shape into crescents. Place on the prepared baking sheet, and bake for about 20 minutes, until golden and bubbly.

title: Cheesy Mexican Corn
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 package mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Layer dry ingredients in the following order, corn, cheese. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Zesty Prawns & Spring Onion
ingredients: 60 g jalapeno peppers, chopped | 1/4 cup green spring onion
instructions: Combine pepper, spring onions, and jalabeno in a clean plastic bag. Seal and massage the ingredients for 2 minutes. Rinse the bag in cold water to remove all the liquid. Return to the dry pan with the prawns. Shake the bag. Tie the pan and contents with a kitchen string. Place on low heat and cook for 15 minutes or until the prawns are pink and the mixture is slightly darkened. Serve with jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: broth,pie shell,lettuce,roasting chicken,milk chocolate,swiss cheese,velveeta cheese
title: Chicken ROast Parcels With Velveeta Cheese
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 4 tablespoons velveeta cheese ( or other dairy-free cheese ) | 1 roasting chicken ( from a rotisserie chicken ) | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate | 8 slices swiss cheese | lettuce
instructions: Open your pie shell and place in the freezer. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Slice up the chicken. In a microwave safe bowl, melt 1 tablespoon of the velveeta cheese with the milk chocolate until mixed well. Spread the mixture evenly on the top of the pie shell. Place chicken slices inside the pie filling. Dot the top with the remaining 1 tablespoon of velveeta cheese. Wrap in aluminum foil. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes. Shred the rosterie chicken of rotisserie if you like, it can be left in the chicken for up to a week. If you're feeling froggy, microwave the chicken for about 2 minutes. Serve with a dollop of the sauce and garnish with lettuce.

title: Kielbasa, Pasta & Kielbasa Chips
ingredients: 6 ounces dry shell pasta | 1 lb kielbasa, sliced | 1 tablespoon dry mustard
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add kielbasa, cover, and cook until cooked through, but firm, about 5 minutes. Drain and mix into cooked pasta. Pour into large serving bowl and sprinkle with dry mustard. Serve with warm kielbasa chips.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,cream chicken soup,vegetable oil cooking spray,portobello mushroom,coleslaw mix
title: Delicious Sauteed Mushrooms
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package coleslaw mix | 1/2 head portobello mushrooms, sliced | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet or deep skillet over medium heat. Add chopped coleslaw mix.

title: Paprika-Salsa Blanca
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1 cup chopped peanuts
instructions: Pour coconut milk, enchilada sauce and chopped peanuts into a blender.

title: Mexican-Style Pepper-And-Paprika Dip Mix #5FIX
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed, toasted | 1 cup taco sauce | 2 poblano chiles | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: Heat a to medium nonreactive skillet over medium low heat. Add toasted cumin seeds to the hot skillet.

title: Spiced Non-Spicy Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole-wheat dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1 1/3 cups packed finely chopped onions or 1 1/3 cups chopped onion rings | 1 package active dry yeast | 1/2 head of cabbage or 1 large head butter lettuce
instructions: Spray coleslaw iron with non stick cooking spray. Place prepared coleslaw iron in the oven chamber. Select low rack in oven and pre heat to 325ºf. In a mixing bowl, combine mustard and turmeric and whisk to blend. Add onions and whisk. In a 5 to 6 quart stainless steel mixing bowl, combine yeast and dissolved yeast and whisk to combine. Add mustard mixture to bowl of dressing.

title: Jalapeno and Chorizo  Chicken and Lentil Casserole
ingredients: 1 -2 lb dried lentils or 1 -2 lb red lentil, washed and picked through | 1 -2 lb chorizo sausage ( or 2 links of sausage ) | 1 bunch coriander, washed and coarsely chopped ( i remove some of the stems ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/2 - 3/4 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/4-inch slices and cross-cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 -2 jalapeno, stemmed, seeded and chopped, to taste | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate ( or milk chocolate-or hazelnutella )
instructions: Place the lentils in a large pan of cold water. Set over a medium heat and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer very gently until they are falling off the bones, about 1 hour or more. This can also be done in the crockpot. Set the crockpot on low or medium heat and let it do its thing. While the lentils are cooking, in a frying pan, brown the chorizo until it is brown and it is crumbly. If you are using a sausage you may cook this longer, or, remove it from the pan when it is done. If you are using chorizo, you will need to cook it longer, or it will be too dry. Set aside over a bowl. When the lentils are done, drain them and place them in a big bowl, pour all of the excess water back into the pot. Let them sit out until they are cool enough to touch, several hours to an hour, depending on how much moisture they had left. Once they've got about 1/4 inch left, remove the stalks/stalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalpars. Chop these up finely and set aside. Now in the same frying pan, combine the chopped coriander, raisins and jalapenos. Heat over medium heat until hot. Add the chopped chorizo and cook until it is lightly browned. Add the drained lentils, chorizo, chocolate and enough of their cooking liquid to coat everything nicely. Put the crockpot on low or medium heat until everything is hot, about 5 or 10 minutes. Top each serving with a ladle of the hot lentils and/or chorizo mixture. Garnish with the chopped coriander. Serve hot. Note, if you want to freeze, do not thaw the lentils and chorizo.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,butter margarine,white chocolate,puff pastry,chili pepper flake
title: White Chocolate-Chili Pepper Tarts
ingredients: 5 ounces butter and margarine | 6 ounces unsweetened white chocolate | 1 -2 chili pepper flakes ( depending on taste ) | 1 teaspoon celery rib | 3 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed to room temperature
instructions: Melt chocolate then stir in the butter using a large metal spoon. Add chili flakes and celery and stir til melted and well mixed. Turn this into a large mixing bowl and add the philly and remaining margarine. Mix well. Set aside to cool slightly. Cut thawed pastry sheets into 1 long strips and use a 1 round cutter to slice into the rounds. Place a large spoonful of pastry on half of each cookie and then cover with 2 teaspoons of the melted chocolate. Place another cookie half over the top of the chocolate and top with another cookie half to form a cup with the pastry cups lid. Press the pastry cups lid shut and freeze until hard.

title: Caramelised Shortbread
ingredients: 1 lb caster sugar | 100 fat free half-and-half
instructions: Line base and sides of an 8 to 10 inch square pan with parchment paper. Sieve dry ingredients through a sieve, then add sugar. Beat well with a spoon or electric mixer until mixture is light and creamy. Spread caramel evenly in pan and chill for one hour. Spread over prepared pan. Cut into 4 squares.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,garlic powder,extra virgin olive oil,dumpling wrapper,mexican tomato,gouda cheese
title: Fabulous Shredded Beef Samosas
ingredients: 24 medium dumpling wrappers | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil, plus more for pan | 1 1/4 lbs boneless top sirloin ( chuck ), 1-inch cubes | 2 jars mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 1/2 cups shredded gouda cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350°. Place dumplings on a baking sheet and lightly brush with olive oil. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoons of oil over medium high heat in a large skillet. Cook beef until no longer pink. Add tomatoes and garlic powder. Return to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cover. Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly. Heat oven broiler. Place samosas on a baking sheet with sides.

Random Ingredients: topping,cranberry juice,chinese noodle,puff pastry,thai chili sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray,white flour
title: Thai Beef and Noodle Pies
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 package frozen topping, thawed | 1 package fresh chinese noodles, cut in half lengthwise, then sliced lengthwise into rounds | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/4 cup thai sweet chili sauce | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups cranberry juice | 1 cup dried sweetened cranberries or 1 cup fresh cranberries
instructions: Place the pastry on the flat of a dinner plate or the top third of a large dinner plate. Coat the bottom and a small saucepan with cooking spray. Arrange the noodles on the pastry, overlapping each noodle layer to 1/4 inch thickness. Top with the steak and spread evenly with sweet chili sauce. In the saucepan, bring the chicken stock or cranberry juice to a simmer over medium high heat. When the sauce comes to a boil, carefully pour it over the noodle and beef. Cover and set aside. Preheat an oven to 425° f. Place oven rack in the second highest position and heat the oven to 425°f. Place a sheet of parchment paper on a non stick cookie sheet and place in the preheated oven. Remove the pastry sheet from the oven and remove the parchment and parchment. Return it to the pan and remove the parchment. Repeat with the second sheet of pastry. Let the pastry sheets stand for 10 minutes. Using a sharp, wet knife, cut the rounds from the pastry into 12, 4 inch rounds. Transfer the rounds to the parchment baking sheet and bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the pies are puffed and golden. Let the pies cool on the cookie sheet and transfer them to a serving platter. Drizzle the pastry with chili sauce and serve with croutons for dipping.

title: Basic Chinese Coffee
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules
instructions: Spread the sesame seeds over a non stick baking tray and toast in the oven or until golden brown. Add the coffee granules to a bowl and stir well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,almond,chili paste,french haricot vert,pork shoulder roast
title: Pork and Vegetable Haricot Verts (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 cup french haricots vert, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 2 lbs pork shoulder roast, trimmed and cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes | 1 lb pork shoulder, trimmed of excess fat and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook the haricots verts, chile paste, and pork shoulder in a large dutch oven over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, or until the pork pieces are browned on all sides. Add the browned pork to the pan and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Stir in the beans and increase heat to medium. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 1 1/2 hours, or until a thin film of liquid remains on the surface. Turn the haricot verts out onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in a 350 degree f oven, stirring occasionally, until the beans are very tender, about 1 hour 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cover the surface of the pan with foil and bake for 15 minutes. Add almonds and bake 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: almond butter,yellow pepper,water chestnut,fenugreek seed,graham cracker,romaine lettuce heart,filling,lemon zest
title: Indian Chicken Salad
ingredients: filling : | 1 lemon, zest of | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken or 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey | 3/4 cup almond butter | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 2 romaine lettuce hearts | 1 large yellow pepper, finely diced | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Mix together lemon zest, lemon juice and ground chicken in a small bowl. Pour into large glass bowl and refrigerate mixture 1 hour. While the marinating mixture is chilling, prepare your dressing. To prepare dressing, place almond butter, fenugreek and 3/4 cup of water into a small skillet. Cook over medium low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is smooth and creamy and creamy. Remove from heat. Set aside. When the mixture is cool and flavors have mingled, chill remaining dressing and set aside. Using a sharp knife slice 1 inch off end of lettuce hearts and separate the lettuce hearts from the surrounding green leaves. Set aside. Place the green leaves in a bowl of chilled water until ready to use so they are easier to remove from water. Rinse and drain off excess water, then place in a large bowl. Add the turkey and 1/2 cup of the reserved dressing and toss to mix. Taste and adjust seasoning with lemon juice and additional lemon zest, lemon juice or to taste. Garnish chicken salad with reserved lettuce hearts, yellow pepper, water chestnuts. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,lime jell o gelatin,dark brown sugar,allspice
title: Italian Seasonal Pops - Gluten Free, Vegan
ingredients: 1 package lime jell-o gelatin | 2 cups dark brown sugar, firmly packed | 1/3 cup italian dressing | 1/2 teaspoon allspice ( optional )
instructions: In an 8 cup microwave safe bowl place jello powder in microwave and heat on high 10 minutes, stirring until jello has melted, stir in sugar and remaining ingredients. Microwave uncovered on medium high 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. When it has cooled completely, mix in to cold jello and mix well until thoroughly combined. Cover and refrigerate overnight or serve cold.

title: Potato and Sliced French Fries
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, peeled, cut in half | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Place potato halves in a pan cut side up. Pour mushroom soup into pan.

title: Roasted Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage | 150 g mushrooms, sliced | 200 g cheese, grated
instructions: Slice cabbage into thin stripes and place on large roasting pan. Slice the onions and place in pan. Cut mushrooms and place on top. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake in 200c for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green lentil,white balsamic vinegar,new potato,bay leaf,green bell pepper,parmesan cheese,cocoa powder
title: Chilean New Potato Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds small green lentils | 3 small new potatoes, thickly sliced | 3 green bell peppers, cut into strips | 1/2 package dry green balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup white balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 bay leaves | 1 can or bottle white white balsamic vinegar, reserved
instructions: Place the lentils into a large pot and cover with several inches of water.

title: Okra With Chicken and Barley
ingredients: 1 chicken, deboned, and coarsely chopped | 1 bag frozen sliced okra, thawed in fridge | 1/2 cup pearl barley, uncooked according to package instructions
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a baking dish or roasting pan, combine chicken, okra, barley, and 1/2 cup water. Pour remaining 1/2 cup water around the chicken. Cook, uncovered, for 30 to 40 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and well browned.

title: Mushroom Refried Beans
ingredients: 4 cups cremini mushrooms ( sliced ) | 2 cans kidney beans | 1 package taco seasoning mix
instructions: Drain beans and mushrooms reserving liquid. Add mushrooms, reserved liquid and seasonings to a large skillet and lightly brown the mushrooms. Transfer bean mixture to a medium sized crockpot and add the beans stir until well mixed and then place filled crockpot on low till heated through. Serve hot as is or with corn chips.

title: Kiwi and Kiwifruit Lasagna
ingredients: 21 ounces uncooked lasagna noodles | 1 large kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced
instructions: Spray inside of pan with nonstick spray. Place noodles on top of each other overlapping slightly. Top with sliced kiwifruit. Bake at 350 degrees f for 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand for five minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Mustard Greens and Squash in Hot Lemongrass
ingredients: 32 cups mustard greens | 3 large russet potatoes, diced | 5 habanero peppers, seeded and diced | 3 stalks lemongrass, chopped
instructions: Boil the lemongrass stalks and leaves for about 4 minutes. Remove from heat, cool. Peel off and discard the tender outer leaves. Set the lemongrass stalks aside, and slice into strips about 1/2 wide. In a large crock pot, combine mustard greens, potatoes, habanero peppers, lemongrass, and about 3 quarts of water. The water should cover the vegetables, or just about reach the top of the leaves. Cover, and cook the greens for 4 hours at 7 hours on high and 4 hours on low. If the water level is too low, raise the heat to low and keep it on low. When finished, the salad should be creamy and crisp.

title: Home Made Appetizer (Pickled Onions)
ingredients: 3 shallots, peeled | 1/4 cup pickling spices or 1/4 cup finely chopped onion
instructions: Slice the shallots lengthwise into 3/4 inch lengths. Soak in cold water until softened, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain the water off and transfer the sliced shallots to a jar. Add 1/4 cup sugar to the jar. Make sure the pickling spices are in there first, and let mellow over night. Add 1 more tablespoon of sugar per quart of water if needed. Close the lid tightly and shake well to mix. Let stand at room temperature for 20 to 30 days, shaking the jar twice a week.

Random Ingredients: egg white,poundcake,artichoke heart,cocoa powder,hoisin sauce,yoghurt,summer squash,teriyaki sauce
title: Moo Shu Beefcakes With Artichokes & Chocolate
ingredients: 1/2 lb of any cut-up cooked steak | 1/2 lb fresh poundcake, sliced thinly | 1 egg white | 1 -2 tablespoon yoshogurri dipping sauce ( i use teriyaki sauce ) | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup of chopped fresh garden herbs and olive ( such as dill or rocket ) | 1/4 cup of chopped artichoke heart | 1/4 cup chopped sweet potato ( optional )
instructions: Combine all of the marinade ingredients in a large glass bowl, and stir well to combine all the ingredients. Cut both the raw pound cake and the fresh baby artichoke hearts into chunks about 1/2 inch long and 1/2 inch high. Slice them into 1/4 inch thick slices, and set aside. Pour a bit of the marinade into a separate bowl. Dip each slice of steak into the remaining marinade for about a minute, to ensure that the marinade covers the steak completely. Coat each slice of steak and then into the yuka muka mixture until coated with the marinade. Place the coated slices on a foil lined baking sheet, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to several hours. Preheat the oven to 450°f arrange the chilled steak cakes on a cookie sheet or baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes, then carefully remove the foil and bake for additional 5 - 10 minutes until cooked to your taste.

title: Chinese Eggplant With Smoked Sausage and Fried Onions
ingredients: 2 chinese round eggplants, peeled and cut lengthwise into 3 slices ( about 3/4-inch thick ) | cooking spray
instructions: Position the rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 500 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with oil. Arrange the eggplant slices on the baking sheet, then bake 15 minutes, turning and rearranging each slice when it is slightly blackened in the center. Remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes. Cut into four slabs and divide evenly into four small pieces. Cook the sausages in a nonstick skillet until done. Slice the sausages into 3/8 thick pieces, then fry the onions in a nonstick 3 to 4 inch depth of oil until well browned on all sides and hot. Serve the onion on a bed of chinese rice, or serve on a hot platter.

title: Overnight Spiced Mustard Coffee
ingredients: 600 ml strong hot brewed coffee | 12 slices tea bags | 1 teaspoon mustard | 2 green cardamom pods | 3 -4 pieces maraschino cherry juice
instructions: In a large glass bowl, combine the mustard and hot coffee. Let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, open up the tea bags, removing the foam sacs with the tip of a paring knife. Set aside. Remove the cardamom pods and discard the strings and any seeds. Add the mustard seeds and cherries to the coffee. Stir with the dry mix 1 minute by using chopsticks. Pour into glasses and serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger,cilantro leaf,green cardamom,saltine cracker,green cardamom pod,tequila,tuna,kirsch
title: Tuna-Splavored Halushki
ingredients: 1/3 cup kirsch | 1 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 3/4 cup chopped green cardamom pods | 3/4 cup green cardamoms | 1/4 teaspoon powdered ginger | 1 teaspoon saltine crackers | 1 can tuna | 2 tablespoons tequila
instructions: Marinate the tuna in the kirsch overnight remove tuna from bag and discard marinade. Add remaining ingredients except crackers and tequila. Place tuna on a serving platter and pour marinade over. Garnish with crackers.

title: Dill Curd
ingredients: 2 cups fresh dill, snipped | 1/2 cup lemon curd, packed | 1/2 cup fresh dill, snipped
instructions: In a glass serving pitcher, stir together 1/2 the dill and the lemon curd. Stir in the remaining dill. Cover, and chill until serving.

title: Chicken in Honey Syrup
ingredients: 2 bone-in chicken breast halves | 1 cup honey syrup ( no sugar added ) | 1 cup icing sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl combine chicken and honey. Brush 1 cup of the syrup over both sides of chicken. Place the chicken in a 9x9 inch baking dish. Place remaining 1 cup of syrup in a small bowl and pour over chicken. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is cooked and syrup has thickened, about 45 minutes.

title: Roasted Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow squash | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 medium sweet onion, diced
instructions: Cut a slit in each squash end and scrape out the seeds. Rinse well under cold water. Place squash in a heavy duty aluminum or glass baking dish. Lightly sprinkle squash with salt. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and marinate overnight in the refrigerator. When ready to bake, heat oven to 400 degrees. Remove from marinade. Place squash on greased and lightly floured baking sheet. Bake 30 minutes. Turn, baste with marinade, and bake about 30 minutes, or until tender.

title: Spinach & Tamarind Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces spinach | 15 ounces fettuccine pasta | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp ( optional )
instructions: Clean spinach, and cut into small pieces. Bring a pan of water to a boil with tamarind pulp, and cook the pasta according to package instructions. Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium high heat, add the spinach, and saute until it wilts. Drain the pasta, and mix with sauce. Serve warm.

title: Magic Bullet Cheese Dip or Tofu
ingredients: 8 ounces sour cream | 8 ounces yellow miso | 4 tablespoons tandoori horseradish | 2 tablespoons grated cotija cheese | 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | walnuts
instructions: Mix everything together, and add nuts. Serve with assorted tortilla chips.

title: Potato and Honey-Peanut Salad
ingredients: 1 package pie shells | 2 pounds baby potatoes, quartered | 1 jar salad dressing | 1 tablespoon honey peanut | 1 tablespoon salad dressing for quick, low-sodium dressing for quick, spicy, and grainy
instructions: Lay the pie shells on a flat work surface and sprinkle evenly with 1/2 of the salad dressing. Arrange the potatoes around the edges of the dressing. Drizzle with 1/2 of the salad dressing, then sprinkle with 1/2 the peanut and 1/2 the peanut. Make sure you cover the stuffing tightly with foil to retain heat while rolling.

title: Iranian Lamb Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb lamb, ground | 2 -3 green onions, chopped finely | 1/2 tablespoon turmeric or 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form balls or patties. Brown in hot oil on both sides. Serve as is or add a little extra oil on top.

title: Italian Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pork tenderloins | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Cut pork into 2 inch x 1 inch strips. Mix cake flour, cheese and 1/4 cup cold water in small shallow dish. Add pork strips to flour mixture, turning so all sides are coated. Marinate for at least 1 hour or preferably overnight. Drain pork well. In skillet, brown pork in hot oil 1 or 2 minutes per side, or until well browned on all sides. Remove from heat. Serve with favorite pasta shape.

title: Mexican Seasoning Blend(Mild)
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon paprika | 1/4 tablespoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon ground ancho chile powder ( cayenne can be substituted if ancho chile unavailable ) | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 3/4 tablespoon gruyere cheese ( shredded or grated, to taste ) or 3/4 tablespoon parmesan cheese ( shredded or grated, to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight container for up to 3 weeks.

title: Thick Indian Banana 'n' Sprouts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry roasted red chili powder | 2 bananas, chopped | 1 cup canned pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup frozen peas | 1/2 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Combine the dried red chili powder, banana, pumpkin, peas, and bean sprouts in a skillet over medium high heat. Once the mixture starts to thicken, reduce heat to medium and simmer an additional 3 minutes, or until the bean sprouts are tender. Serve hot.

title: Fried Black Olive Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups black olives, pitted | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Place olive into a shallow bowl. Spray olives with vegetable oil, and toss to coat. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,farfalle pasta,pudding,turnip,green curry paste
title: Punjab Turnip and Curry Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 cups turnips or 2 cups turnips, peeled and cut diagonally into 1/2 `` dice | 1/2 cup green curry paste, to taste | 1 lb farfalle pasta, precooked and drained | 1 1/2 cups cooked instant pudding, reheated
instructions: Heat sesame oil in 12 inch skillet over high heat until very hot, almost smoking, about 30 seconds. Add turnips.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,clam juice,apple cider vinegar,clam,garlic granule,cod fish fillet
title: Hot-and-Sour Fish
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod fish fillets | 2 cans minced clams | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground chili pepper ( dried or hot ) | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cut cod crosswise into 6 thick slices. Place slices in a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray and lightly spray with cooking oil. Roast uncovered in preheated 375 degree oven for 35 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. While fish cooks, combine the remaining ingredients in a skillet. Over medium heat, bring to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring, for about 20 minutes. Remove fish from oven, and pour clam mixture over fish. Cover the dish with a piece of foil, and bake for 15 minutes. Uncover the dish, and return to oven, and cook an additional 15 to 20 minutes, or until fish is tender and flakes easily with fork.

title: Garlic, Escarole and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 head escarole | 5 -6 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Wash the escarole well and cut off the hard bit inside the body. Rinse and dry thoroughly. Remove and discard the white parts, but retain some of the outer leaves. Warm up the olive oil in a heavy casserole or a frying pan. Add about 4 - 5 tablespoons of peanut oil to the hot oil and fry the escarole well to the desired color. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: basil,spinach leaf,alfalfa sprout,chili pepper flake,dark brown sugar,no salt tomato
title: Spinach and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs spinach leaves | 2 cans no-salt-added stewed tomatoes | 1/4 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil | 2 cups alfalfa sprouts | 1/4 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup no-salt-added tomato juice or 1/2 cup water
instructions: Place the spinach over medium high heat, cover and steam for 2 - 3 minutes or until wilted. Drain and set aside to cool. Combine the tomatoes, brown sugar, basil and pepper flakes. Toss with the cooled spinach. Let stand at room temperature for at least 1 hour before serving. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Alfredo Con Carne [ Native American]
ingredients: 12 ounces meat | 3 teaspoons instant coffee ( optional ) | 8 tortillas | lettuce | pearl onions
