instructions: Put a few tablespoons of coffee on the bottom of your sauce pan, if you don't like it hot enough to overpower the other ingredients add some water. If you do this, you can also mix the coffee and water together, and press the hot coffee over the meat, the instant coffee can get you out of trouble with this. Spread out a tortillas with a little flour or a little cold water, and spread just a little bit of the coffee/water/hot coffee all over the tortillas. Add some onion slices, whatever you like, as well. Sprinkle some lettuce and put it in the microwave for 15 sec to soften the lettuce out some. Put the tortilla in the pan, and heat till the tortillas get a little crispy and brown on the bottom. Remove and serve it.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,vanilla essence,plum tomato,rice wine,cardamom seed
title: Danish Style Plum Tomatoes and Apples
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes ( ripe, peeled, cored and sliced or grated ) | 1/2 cup rice wine ( can substitute dry white wine ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence ( or extract ) | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds ( or 10-1/2-inch dried pods, crushed ) | 1 jar tart apples ( or equivalent )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Chill and serve as a garnish or serve as a dessert topping for fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,corn kernel,vanilla ice cream,wheat pita bread
title: Aussie Ice-Cream Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup finely shredded wheat pita bread | 1/4 cup frozen corn kernels | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup vanilla ice cream, softened
instructions: Place the cheese and corn kernels in a large bowl, and stir until the corn is completely well coated. Stir in the rice wine vinegar. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the rice cream onto each slice of the cheese mixture, and sandwich the cheese with a little of the bread to make a sandwich. Cut the sandwich in half, and serve.

title: Microwave Chunks
ingredients: 1 package aji yellow paste | 1/2 gallon graham cracker ( about 10 ounces )
instructions: Pour aji into a medium microwave safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high 100% power for 1 minute. Stir the powdered chiken into 1/2 gallon of graham cracker crumbs.

title: Baked Eggplant (Aubergine) With Peanuts
ingredients: 5 medium size eggplants | 3 tablespoons roasted peanuts | 2 tablespoons dried mixed italian herbs | 2 tablespoons desiccated coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c. Boil water then peel eggplants. Cut crosswise into 1/4 thick slices. Lightly grease 3 shallow ovenproof dishes with olive oil and set over a moderate heat. Place slices in one layer and brown on all sides, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a large ovenproof dish. Cover with a layer of eggplant/peanuts then scatter the herbs over. Top with a layer of coconut. Place dish in a preheated oven and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes or until cooked through and the coconut is golden. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: thyme,new potato,heavy whipping cream,cardamom seed,summer savory,radish,picante sauce,broccoli floret
title: Sweet Potato, Broccoli & Picante Soup
ingredients: 1 lb tiny new potatoes | 1 lb broccoli floret | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 20 -24 leaves fresh thyme | 1 tablespoon summer savory | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom seed | 8 ounces heavy whipping cream | 1 -2 radish, grated ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil for the new potatoes. While waiting for it to boil, in a large stockpot with a lid, add the broccous and potatoes and boil for about 10 minutes while you boil and cook the broccoli. When potatoes are done, scoop the vegetables into a colander and set in the sink. When the beans are done, drain water and add enough water so the potatoes are cooked but not mushy. When potatoes are done, cut them into pieces about 1/2 inch dice and chop the broccoli into even chunks. Add potatoes and broccoli back into the soup while you're waiting for the soup to boil. Mix 1 - 2 teaspoons of thyme, savory, cardamom, & heavy whipping cream in a bowl, add to the soup and mix thoroughly, then heat for about 2 - 3 mintues. Serve in bowls topped with grated radishes if desired.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,italian seasoning,ranch dressing mix,cheesecloth,flat leaf italian parsley,chickpea flour
title: Homemade Chickpea Fritters (From College)
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour or 1 can plain chickpea flour ( 2 1/2 ounces ) | 1 package fresh cheesecloth | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 1/2 - 2 cups good ranch dressing mix | flat-leaf italian parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Use a 1 1/2 3/4 ounce package of cheesecloth. Cut up the cheesecloth into 2 1/2 6 wide pieces. Place in a microwave safe dish or baking pan, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high for 1 minute. Pour cooked chickpea flour into a mixing bowl. Stir in 1/2 package of shredded cheesecloth. Stir in 1 teaspoon of red pepper flakes, italian seasoning, and italian seasoning. Mix thoroughly. Cover with remaining cheesecloth and microwave using high 2 1/2 minutes. Stir well. Spoon into a serving bowl, cover, and allow to cool slightly.

title: Baked Carrots in Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baby carrots, peeled ( or more ) | 2 1/4 cups vanilla ice cream | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Toss carrots with garlic salt. Spread on foil lined baking sheet. Bake about 30 - 40 minutes, or until tender and slightly browned a nice color has formed onto the carrots. Remove from oven, pour ice cream over carrots and serve immediately.

title: Easy Chile Con Queso (Chile Apple)
ingredients: 6 cups diced apples ( i prefer wolf river ) | 1 can ortega chiles ( mild or hot )
instructions: Combine apples in large bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature for an hour. Mix apples with chilis and refrigerate for 2 - 4 hours. To serve, pour contents into hot chilis, making sure to top with any remaining chilis.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,korean radish,bacon,lime juice,plain yogurt,curry powder
title: Korean Sausage, Radish and Chorizo Salad
ingredients: 3 links chorizo sausage, sliced thinly | 1/2 lb bacon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 large orange korean radish, trimmed and sliced thinly | 2 tablespoons curry powder, to taste | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: In a 10 nonstick pan cook the bacon over medium heat until crisp, and drain on paper towels. Reserve 1 tablespoon bacon fat, then cook and stir the chorizo and bacon fat for 5 minutes over medium heat, until browned. Add the orange korean radish and curry powder. Increase the heat to medium high, stir the spices around for just a few seconds to toast them, stirr in the yogurt and bring to a bubble. Reduce the heat to low. Cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add the reserved bacon fat. Stir the lime juice into the dressing into make sure the dressing coats the radish.

title: Beef Tagine
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef or 2 lbs lamb, preferably lean | 1/2 cup palm oil | 1 1/4 cups milk | 3/4 cup beef broth, canned | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Heat oil and add beef or lamb. Brown. Add curry leaves and stir. Slowly brown milk and add to meat. Put down heat and cover. Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve with couscous.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,orange juice zest,serrano pepper,mango powder,yellow squash
title: Yellow Squash, Avocado and Mango Salad
ingredients: 2 yellow squash, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 cups fresh baby spinach leaves | 1/2 sweet orange, juice and zest of, grated | 1 mango powder | 1 serrano pepper, sliced thinly
instructions: Toss the squash cubes with the lime zest in a bowl. Pour the orange juice into the bowl and stir well. Add the mango and serrano pepper. Toss to coat evenly. Taste and adjust the seasoning with more orange zest if desired.

Random Ingredients: barbeque sauce,tomato paste,vanilla bean,pine nut,bengal,cream cheese,cinnamon sugar,green chilies
title: Quick Creamy African Dahi Dip
ingredients: 1 package light cream cheese, diced | 1 tablespoon bengal ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon chili paste ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika ( sweet spanish paprika or chilli seeds ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 2 -3 green chilies or 2 -3 other chili, cut in half ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | barbeque sauce ( optional ) | pine nuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Heat cream cheese in microwave or oven. Blend in spices.

title: Tamarind Toast
ingredients: 200 g sweet bread ( french bread ) | 300 ml tamarind paste, diluted with | 50 ml dashi | 150 g chocolate, chopped
instructions: Cut the bread in half to form triangles, and then cut each triangle into triangles that are at least 18 cm in total. Take the slices of bread out of the freezer at least two hours before beginning to toast, and toast again at the same time. After taking out of the freezer, and at the same time, toast the chocolate in the microwave, stirring every 30 seconds to make sure everything is melted. Remove from the microwave, and in a shallow dish, pour the melted chocolate into the microwave safe dish. Heat the butter in the microwave for 20 seconds, until it's melted, and stir in the tamarind paste. Spread this mixture on the toast, and place the triangles on top of it to make a sandwich, and keep in the microwave until ready to serve.

title: Creamy Herbed Red Wine Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup red wine | 1/3 cup salad greens | 1/4 cup basil | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 cup rose water
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender in a 2 quart increments, blend until the vinaigrette is creamy and thick. Pour over salads, and chill completely before serving.

title: Greek Pasta Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces small shell pasta ( penne or rigatoni ) | 12 ounces italian tomatoes ( diced, use your favourite canned tomatoes ) | 2 -4 tablespoons green olive sauce ( use as much or as small as you need ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sweetened italian sweet pure mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs ( oregano, basil, rosemary powder, basil ) | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 2 -3 dashes hot sauce, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Boil water and cook pasta until tender. Mix together remaining ingredients. Add to cooked pasta and stir. Serve warm.

title: Lamb Chops With Greens & Herbs
ingredients: 1 kg good quality lamb chop | 150 g mixed salad greens
instructions: Trim off all excess fat. Place lamb chop onto a flat oven tray. Sprinkle over herbs. Place tray in a pre heated oven 180c for 20 - 30 mins or until chops is cooked through and well browned. Serve with salads.

title: Courgettes With Creamy Penne Pasta
ingredients: 600 g penne pasta | 1 large courgette, cut into thick diagonal slices | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons watercress | red food coloring ( optional ) | olive, sliced ( optional ) | bottled olive, for drizzling ( optional )
instructions: Boil the pasta in plenty of salted water. When the pasta is tender, drain well, then toss it through a large mixing bowl. Meanwhile, make your sauce. You can either mix all the ingredients together and keep warm in a low heat. To serve, place a small piece of courgette on a plate and pour on about 1 tbs of the cream of tartar.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,pumpkin,baby bok choy,edamame,tahini,urad dal,pine nut
title: Mixed Greens With Pumpkin and Edamame Noodles
ingredients: 1/3 cup sesame tahini ( creamy peanut butter ) | 4 -6 tablespoons tahini ( creamy chicken flavored lite ) | 2 -3 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cubes | 6 1/2 ounces raw pumpkin, diced | 1 dash salt | 1 cup edamame, packed | 1 medium baby bok choy, chopped | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together tahini, tahini, chicken oxo and stock cubes. Set aside. Slice pumpkins in half lengthwise and then into half inch thick slices.. Dice bok choy and add to pumpkin. Add prepared tahini mixture to pumpkin and bok choy mixture. Stir thoroughly. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour. In a small saucepan, stir fry edamame until just tender. Drain well. Remove plastic wrap, cover and set aside to dry over heat until ready to serve. Assemble with pina colada and pine nuts toasted in a 350 degrees f oven for 5 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: english mustard powder,thyme leaf,lamb,corn flake,red cabbage,sausage,swiss cheese,golden raisin
title: Sweet Mustard Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh lamb, cut into 1/2 inch slices ( bonless if desired ) | 1/2 lb fresh ground sausage | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup shredded red cabbage | 2 tablespoons english mustard powder | 1 tablespoon ground thyme leaves | 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray 13x9x2 glass baking dish with cooking spray. Combine all ingredients together and spoon into prepared dish and spread evenly. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until meat is fork tender.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,thai red curry paste,catsup,chard leaf,self rising flour
title: Asian Steamed Chard
ingredients: 1 cup chopped chard leaves | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste, or more to taste | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Stir chard, ginger, curry paste, catsup, and flour together in a bowl using a fork. Allow to marinate in the refrigerator until steaming.

title: Quick Nachos
ingredients: 8 -10 ounces plain doritos | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup honey | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon oregano leaves or 1/4 teaspoon basil leaves
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan with water and boil. Drop the doritos, one at a time, into the water. When they float, remove them and plunge in cold water. Drain and pat dry with a towel. Remove and discard the hard center of each. Set on paper towels to absorb the excess water. In a microwavable container with tight fitting lid, combine sherry, honey, balsamic and oregano. Microwave on high for 2 minutes or until the oils are released. Dip cooled doritos into the sauce, coating well. Let sit while you cook rice or tortillas. Serve warm. Note, you can use a baguette pan, or a crostini. Add the oregano to the oil in the pan to flavor the oil, stirring to coat evenly.

title: Rice & Cauliflower Corn Chips With Coconut Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower ( about 3 medium heads ) | cooking spray or corn oil | 3/4 cup crisp rice cereal | 1/4 cup flaked coconut | 1/2 cup white rice ( i use jasmine or basmati in all ) or 1/2 cup brown rice ( i use jasmine or basmati in all )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large bowl toss the cauliflower and rice together. Cut cereal into chunks and toss into the cereal with the coconut and dry ingredients. Spray a large non stick frying pan with cooking spray and heat over medium heat until it is hot but not smoking. Drop the corn chips in 2 tblsp oil and fry for two minutes each side or until golden brown. Serve with your favourite sweetened topping for a complete meal.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,avocado,sharp cheddar cheese,yukon gold potato,black pepper
title: Killer Foil Frites (Peruvian Potatoes)
ingredients: 1 package yukon gold potatoes, halved | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and diced coarse | 1 ripe avocado - peeled, pitted, and diced | 1/4 lb sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to high or preheat broiler. Place potato halves between sheets of waxed paper. Using a rolling pin, flatten with a rolling pin until potatoes have a 2x6 inch rectangle. Sprinkle with black pepper and add bell pepper and avocado. Sprinkle cheese over all. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving. Slice as desired and serve with corn chips.

Random Ingredients: english mustard,nutmeg,veal cutlet,pork tenderloin,ginger garlic paste,lard,green bean
title: Barefoot Contessa's Green Beans and Pork Tenderloin With Mustard and Ginger
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, washed and trimmed | 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 cups lightly packed fresh green leaves, washed & trimmed | 1/2 cup prepared mustard | 1/2 cup lard ( or butter or nonstick cooking spray ) | 2 packages fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Toss the green beans with the vegetable mixture. Rinse the tenderloin with cold water, then pat dry with paper towels. Heat the lard or butter in a 4 to 5 quart heavy pot over medium heat until the foam subsides, but do not burn it. Add the ginger garlic paste and cook over medium heat until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Remove the ginger infused garlic paste and discard. Add the mustard to the rendered liquid in the pot. Continue to cook until the mixture is a medium brown color, about 2 minutes longer. Return the pork tenderloin to the pot and pour the mustard mixture over it. Reduce heat to medium low and cook and stir until the liquid is reduced and the meat has begun to caramelize on the tips of the tenderloins, about 30 minutes. Transfer the meat to a platter, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour to marinate. When ready to serve, remove the pork from the refrigerator and reserve. Set out 2 plates, large enough to hold the meat and hot water to be served in later. Surround with the green beans and arrange the pork over the greens. Garnish with parsley, if desired.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,pecorino romano cheese,cardamom pod,topping,pearl barley,sun tomato oil,bulgur
title: Tabbouleh With Cardamom, Tomato, Topping, and Browned Flat Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup bulgur | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried active yeast | 1 cup quick cooking polenta or 1 cup bulgur | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained ( not packed in oil ) | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 12 cardamom pods
instructions: Combine bulgur, barley, and yeast in a large bowl. Cover and let ferment 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in polenta, sun dried tomatoes, and cheese.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla strip,eggplant,white bread,pumpkin,chili garlic sauce,monterey jack cheese,fava bean,tomato green chilies
title: Mexican Pizzas With Roasted Garlic and Fava Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry fava beans, soaked overnight in | 1 1/2 lbs ripe tomatoes and green chilies, seeded ( not canned ) | 4 cups loosely packed fresh pumpkin, peeled and coarsely chopped ( about 4 1/2 cups ) | 1/3 cup chili-garlic sauce | 12 corn tortilla strips | 12 ounces uncooked long eggplants, peeled, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In the jar with the onion and tomato, cover with hot water by half inch. Let stand 30 minutes. Drain and reserve the water. Remove and discard the onion and tomato mixture from the jar and mash the mixture with the chiles, pumpkin and garlic in 2 small to medium size bowl. In a 9x13x2 inch glass baking dish, toss together the corn tortillas, eggplant and cheese. Spoon 1/2 the bean mixture on top of the tortillas in the dish and top with another 1/2 the bean mixture and the remaining tortillas, eggplant mixture and cheese. Top with the remaining bean mixture. Roast in the preheated oven 30 minutes, or until the top is nicely browned on top.

Random Ingredients: wine,wheat flour tortilla,bean,angel hair pasta,bread flour,red chili,broccoli
title: Hot and Sour Bean and Broccoli Melt
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups angel hair pasta, cooked | 2 cups fresh broccoli or 2 cups frozen broccoli | 1 cup bean sprouts ( or 1/3 cup frozen broccoli spears ) | 2 cups bread flour | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon red chili, finely chopped | 1/3 cup wine ( optional )
instructions: Place pasta in a large dish and cover with boiling water. Cover and cook for 14 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,caper,extra tofu,queso fresco,salsa,italian plum tomato
title: Tropical Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, drained and cubed | 2 pounds lamb shanks | 1 jar salsa | 1 can italian plum tomato, drained | 1 jar capers, drained | 1 pound queso fresco, diced
instructions: Place tofu in a resealable plastic bag with salsa, and marinate at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place lamb shanks in a large oven proof skillet over medium heat. Cook until browned on the outside, about 10 minutes. Place 1/2 of the shrimp in the bottom of a saucepan over medium high heat, and pour in remaining marinade. Bring to a boil, and cook for about 1 minute. Place 1/2 of the lamb shanks in the bottom of your shank, and pour the meat and salsa mixture into the pan. Top with remaining shanks, and pour remaining salsa sauce over everything. Top with a handful of queso fresco.

Random Ingredients: grain bread,superfine sugar,orange juice concentrate,brie cheese,rotel
title: Brie and Orange Breakfast Sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf long grain bread | 1/2 lb brie cheese | 3 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1 can rotel or ( 12 ounce ) can drained rinsed drained red potatoes, drained
instructions: Cut bread into thick slices or cubes. Layer with cheese then bacon, orange juice concentrate and sugar each. Bake in a 325º oven until bread is crisp, about 45 minutes. Serve with fries..

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,green onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pepperoni,chili powder,spinach
title: Chef John's Pizza
ingredients: olive oil, or as needed ( optional ) | 1 pound beef bouillon cubes | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, defrosted and drained | 1 green onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, or to taste | 1/8 teaspoon pepperoni, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and stir in beef cubes. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until beef cubes are soft and easily shredded with a fork, about 8 minutes. Pour beef broth into a skillet to reduce until almost all of the liquid is evaporated, about 20 minutes. Place spinach and green onion in a bowl and add beef. Season to taste with chili powder and freshly grated parmigiano reggiano cheese to taste.

title: Simple Vietnamese Fish Cakes
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 lb ground fish ( any firm white fish like cod, pike, hake, monk fish )
instructions: In a small bowl combine fish with salt, fish sauce and stir until well mixed. Use immediately or place in refrigerator for up to 4 hrs to allow flavors to meld. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.

title: Pork Chops
ingredients: 6 pork loin chops | 4 large unpeeled red apples
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place pork chops in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Top with apples. Pour apples evenly over pork. Cover with foil. Bake in the preheated oven 1 hour. Uncover, and bake 10 minutes and pour juices into a saucepan.

title: Easy Tarragon Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the soup and tarragon. Place the soup and tarragon mixture into a saucepan or large pot over medium heat. Simmer 3 or 4 minutes, or until heated through.

title: The Reoop
ingredients: 1 package seasoned rice noodles | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 1/2 cup diced provolone cheese
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook rice noodles until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water. Place noodles in a large bowl, and toss with kahlua. Spray a large roasting pan with cooking spray. Transfer noodles to pan and sprinkle with provolone. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 pound uncooked egg noodles | 1/4 egg white | cayenne pepper to taste | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | cayenne pepper to taste | 2 -3 tablespoons cacao, powder ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the noodles thoroughly with the egg white, cayenne pepper, ground coriander and cacao powder. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Break the noodles several times with a fork, and break into smaller bits while cooking, so they cook evenly. Drain well.

title: Chocolate-Covered Shiitake Mushroom Rabe
ingredients: 2 ounces cremini mushrooms, caps left whole | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Place mushrooms and barley in a small saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once it boils, reduce the heat to low.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,cooking spray,mirin,panko breadcrumb,hot paprika,water,dark soy sauce,snow pea
title: Panko Pancakes for Two (Ww 7 points)
ingredients: 4 1/2 teaspoons reduced fat dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons mirin ( or 1 tblsp sweet rice wine, 1/2 tsp. ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons shaoxing water | 2 1/2 cups self rising flour, more if needed ( a whole wheat flour, about 3 cups-regular flour recommended ) | cooking spray | 2 cups panko breadcrumbs, divided | 12 snow peas, halved diagonally | 1/2 teaspoon sweet paprika
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in a bowl. Sift flour into a large bowl, then stir in the panko.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,green olive,coriander powder,liquid smoke,pepper sauce
title: Maggie's "nonfat" Low Fat Spiced Olive Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups skim-milk nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons olive, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup green olives, diced ( not in season ) | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Blend all ingredients on high speed, using a wand mixer full of the ingredients until ingredients are mixed well. Serve on crackers.

title: Portobello Mushrooms and Capsicums
ingredients: 250 g portobello mushrooms | 1 red capsicum ( red pepper ), cut into 2 cm slices
instructions: Place mushrooms, capsicum and salt in microwave safe bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 10 minutes until capsicums are tender.

title: Oaxacan Bow Wow or Sea Bass in a Salt Crust
ingredients: 4 sea bass fillets or 3/4 pound pacific sea bass | 1 package achiote powder | 1 1/2 cups mirin | 8 sunflower oil, for frying | 12 pieces fresh seaweed ( mizithra, sorrel, etc. ) ( optional ) or 12 pieces wood ears, stems discarded ( mizithra, sorrel, etc. ) ( optional )
instructions: The day before serving, season both sides of fish with achiote powder. In a bowl, stir together the mirin and sunflower oil. Place the fish in the bowl, using the dressing so that the fish can sit in the oil on both sides. Coat both sides of the fish with the dressing. Dredge them just a few moments in the dressing, and place on a large platter in the preheated oven until the fish flakes easily, about 30 minutes, depending on the thickness of the fillets.

title: Guacamole-Tortillas
ingredients: 16 ounces small shell pasta | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 1/3 cup guacamole ( homemade, or store brand ) | 8 -10 small whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Prepare pasta as directed on package. Set aside to cool slightly. Meanwhile, in large skillet cook lemon zest, stirring, until almost all of it is gone. Add confectioners' sugar and cook, stirring, until completely melted. Add guacamole and pasta and mix well. Fold in tortilla slices. Let stand, covered, for about 1 - 2 minutes in warm place. Use scissors or a knife to tear through bottom layer of tortilla slightly. Place on a tray and sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,white balsamic vinegar,pecorino romano cheese,cornstarch
title: Grated Cheddar and Pecorino Pecorino Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces aged cheddar cheese, 1-inch cubes ( about 1 cup ) | 16 ounces white balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Place the cheese cubes between two sheets of wax paper and crush with your fingertips using the back of a spoon. Do not work with too much force as the cheese will not melt very well. Place the cheese cubes between two sheets of waxed paper and crush with a spatula using the back of a spoon or the back of a heavy knife. Repeat with the remaining cheese cubes. Place the vinegar in a small saucepan over medium high heat and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium and let simmer until reduced to about one cup, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir the cheese and romano cheese together in a medium bowl. Whisk together the cornstarch and 2 teaspoons of warm water in another small bowl until it forms a paste. Pour the sauce into the cheese mixture and whisk until it begins to emulsify. Pour the cheese mixture over the cheese. Toss to coat and serve immediately or refrigerate for up to two days.

title: Chewy Asafoetida
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( indian five spice powder ) | 2 cups unbleached strong brewed coffee, room temperature or 2 cups hot water
instructions: In a large bowl, sprinkle the asafetida over the hot coffee and stir it well. Allow the coffee to settle slightly before using this additional 2 - 3 tablespoons of coffee. Add the powdered yeast to the mixture and beat the mixture for 2 minutes, or until frothy and foamy. Stir in 2 cups of the coffee and beat the mixture well. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit in a warm place for 1 hour, or until foamy.

title: Couscous Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried breadcrumbs | 6 tablespoons salad oil or 6 tablespoons olive oil | 6 tablespoons couscous ( short grain ) | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 5 cups packed grated fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in medium bowl. Let stand 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve.

title: Mock Paprikas
ingredients: 1 jar mayonnaise | 1 dash sherry wine | 1 dash paprika | 1 lb meatballs | 1 yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 stalk celery, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,queso fresco,spanish olive,red chilies,garlic chive,liquid smoke,tarragon,clam
title: Spanish Shrimp With Clams and Sausage
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs clams ( shucked ) | 1/2 teaspoon dry tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 8 ounces queso fresco ( about 3 - 4 cubes ) | 1 ounce spanish olives ( about 1 cup coarsely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon garlic chives ( chopped, fresh, green onion ) | 8 ounces italian sweet sausage ( casing removed, sweet or hot ) | 2 fresh red chilies ( chopped, for garnish )
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients in medium skillet over medium low heat. Stir occasionally.

title: Honey Beans in Hot Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb medium pinto bean, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons chile paste | 1 tablespoon roasted dry chile paste | 1/2 teaspoon liquid honey
instructions: In a saucepan with 2 cups water, bring the beans to a boil. Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until some of the water has evaporated. Drain and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the beans through chile paste, scraping the bottom of the bowl with a spoon to avoid any clumps. Mix in the buttermilk and honey. Heat a small skillet over medium high heat. Add the asafoetida and cook, stirring occasionally, for 30 seconds, or until fragrant. Stir the mixture into the water in the saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 25 minutes, until the beans are tender and creamy. Serve hot.

title: Coffee and Coffee Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can canned hot coffee creamer | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts | 1 tablespoon low-fat broth
instructions: Combine all of the above ingredients and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,thai red curry paste,liquid smoke,nutmeg,veal,ricotta
title: Spicy Baked Veal Lasagna
ingredients: 1/2 lb veal, ground | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 32 ounces ricotta | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Pound veal with a mallet to tenderize it. Heat remaining ingredients in small saucepan. Sauté ground meat over medium high heat 3 minutes. Transfer meat to a bowl. Let cool. Beat ricotta with a fork. Stir milk into ricotta. Spray a 13 x 9 inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. Spread 1/3 ricotta mixture in pan. Layer 1/3 veal over ricotta mixture and 1/3 ricotta mixture over meat. Layer 3 more layers of ricotta followed by the last layer. Spread remaining ricotta mixture on top of layer, sealing edges. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 day. Remove cover, increase oven temperature to 325 degrees. Bake, uncovered for 45 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before cutting.

title: Grapefruit Radish Grape Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon grapefruit juice | 3 ounces red seedless grapes | 3 green seedless radishes, sliced thinly into rounds
instructions: Combine together all ingredients in a bowl, stirring gently to coat. Chill 4 to 6 hours prior to serving.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,hoisin sauce,cinnamon,nori,almond extract,enchilada sauce,allspice
title: Sweet and Sour Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium enchilada sauce | 2 teaspoons low-sodium hoisin sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In saucepan, combine all ingredients except for almond extract. Over medium heat, cook, stirring often, until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat. Stir in almond extract. Bring to a boil. Cook, uncovered, 3 to 5 minutes or until sauce has thickened slightly. Stir frequently. Cool, about 10 minutes before using.

title: German Corn on the Cob (Dieter) Salad
ingredients: 3 corn oil, for frying | 4 dill pickles, seeded and thinly slice | 4 tablespoons mayonnaise ( fat free is ok )
instructions: To use 1 quart oil, heat oil to 320°f. Using a deep fryer, slice corn through the cob into 3/4 inch wide wedges and drop wedges into oil. The idea is this will cause the corn to sizzle and turn golden brown when cooked. Do not overcook. Remove after crisping on the outside, drain on paper towels. Place in bowl and drizzle with the mayonnaise to desired taste. Serve warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,chickpea,flat leaf parsley,phyllo pastry
title: Basta
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons chickpeas ( boiled ) | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup finely chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f. Place chicken breasts in a lightly buttered baking dish. Combine chickpeas and parsley, mash well, then spread mixture evenly onto chicken breasts. Bake for 45 min or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear. Serve with parsley.

title: Chinese Oranges
ingredients: 12 oranges | 1/2 cup peanuts, coarsely crushed
instructions: Peel the oranges & section each from their green outer skin. Cut the orange sections into thin rounds using a sharp knife. Spread the peanuts onto a plate & set aside. Sprinkle the peanuts & freshly ground black pepper into a shallow dish. Arrange the peel on top of the peanuts & sprinkle with the orange peel. Cover with plastic wrap & marinate them in the refridgerator for 12 - 24 hrs. Before opening the bag you should shake the peel a few times to coat. It gets easier to get the peel if it's stuck to the roll. Keep your hands over the pickles & shake them around so they don't burn remove the peel or save them for another use, sprinkle them with orange peel. Note, the orange skins may be eaten or eaten with toothpicks if desired.

title: Easy Brazilian Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 1 can pinto beans | 4 eggs | 1 chopped rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Pour beans into crockpot combine and mix beef and eggs into crockpot and cook on high for 7 - 12 hours or until done. Once fully cooked, chop steak and serve on top of beans. Sprinkle with rosemary.

title: Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ketchup | 1/2 cup water | 1/3 cup italian parsley, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in airtight container and shake well.

title: Red Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, rinsed & drained | 3 tablespoons yellow food coloring
instructions: Dissolve food coloring in 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan, stir in remaining 1/2 cup water and reduce heat to medium low. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture thickens, about 5 minutes. Stir in kidney beans and heat thoroughly. Cook and stir until heated through, about 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Garlic Bread on a Dollar
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic bread | 1 bunch baby bok choy
instructions: Open the garlic loaf with a whole bulb of garlic. Cut off around the base 1/2 a head, and cut the loaf in half lengthwise. Cut each half into 6 equal lengths. Remove any remaining garlic pods. Cut a slit along one end of the loaf. Wash the garlic in hot, clean and hot vinegar, and drain any excess vinegar in a colander. Dice the garlic to desired thickness and place the pieces of garlic onto the bread. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,spaghetti sauce mix,beef brisket,walnut oil,corn,mace,red bean,yellow onion
title: Delicious Spanish Style Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 2 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons walnut oil | 1 small yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 can red beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can corn, drained | 1 can spaghetti sauce mix ( i use old el paso )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Score the top side of the brisket all the way around the edge with sharp knife at 1 inch intervals. Brush the brisket with the oil. Mix bread crumbs and 2 teaspoons of the walnut oil. Tear off pieces of aluminum foil about 18 inches long and 1/2 inch wide and place on top of meat. Cover and bake in preheated oven for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until meat is fork tender. Remove meat from oven and let cool slightly before slicing. Combine beans and corn with half of the spaghetti sauce mix and remaining sauce mix in a bowl. Place the meat on a serving platter and spoon the bean mixture on top. Sprinkle with remaining walnuts and serve.

title: Linguine With Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 1/3 cup garlic paste | 3/4 cup horseradish
instructions: Place the linguine and garlic paste in a large saucepan of boiling water. Cook until tender but firm, 8 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, whisk horseradish into horseradish water. Heat the horseradish and garlic oil for 2 minutes. Add the linguine to the horseradish mixture and toss to coat. Transfer to a serving dish and serve.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,string bean,baby shrimp,red cabbage,watercress,balsamic vinegar,italian dressing
title: Shrimp and Veggies in Balsamic Cream Vinaigrette
ingredients: 6 cups red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 cup string bean, trimmed | 1 medium head baby shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 cups watercress, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 3/4 cup good balsamic vinaigrette | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cabbage and string beans. In a separate bowl, combine shrimp with watercress. Cover and refrigerate shrimp for 30 minutes. In a small bowl, combine vinegar and vinaigrette and stir to combine. Spoon shrimp mixture into a large serving bowl. Pour vinegar/vinaigrette over cabbage mixture.

title: Tortellini Con Queso (Tortellini Soup)
ingredients: 250 g cheese tortellini | 1 medium pumpkin, cut into small wedges
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water with a little bit of oil. Meanwhile place a layer of saltine on the bottom of a frypan and turn over. Place the pasta in the frypan with the reserved sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sautins on top. When the pasta is half cooked, pour the soup in the pan, then turn to low. Slice the pumpkin or squash and garnish with half a slice of the cheese.

title: Creamy Mint Mascarpone Salsa
ingredients: 8 ounces mascarpone cheese | 6 tablespoons salsa | salt and freshly cracked peppermint extract | white vinegar, to sweeten ( optional )
instructions: Put the mascarpone, salsa, and salt and peppermint extract into a blender.

title: Orange Salmon Ceviche
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 1/2 cup imitation lobster or 1 orange, cooked & chopped | 1/2 cucumber, chopped and seeded | 1/2 cup shredded cabbage | 1 dried orange blossom, soaked in a little milk & chopped | 1 cup canned salmon ( the type of flaked fish can be substituted if you prefer ) | 1 tablespoon dark-colored yellow food coloring ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped oregano
instructions: For the ceviche, combine the yogurt and the snipped imitation lobster in a small bowl. Cut the cucumber lengthwise & then quarter the long slivers. Squeeze each in your thumb, and then cut those slivers into small pieces. Add this to the yogurt mixture and stir to combine. Add the cucumber, cabbage, and orange blossom. Sprinkle the food color if using, or grind in a small food processor. If you like it more yellow, add about 1 tbsp of yellow food color. For the decoration, combine the chopped oregano and the white part of the orange with the salmon flakes or other flavourings of choice. Spoon the filling onto the danish or french bread dough you may want to make a smaller amount to get them to stick. Chill in the freezer until needed.

title: Tartar Sauce for Meat and Vegetables
ingredients: 1/3 cup raisins | 5 mandarin oranges, halved | 5 slices prosciutto, sliced | 1 can nonfat milk | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup dried packaged oatmeal, to sprinkle over meat | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange a quarter of the mandarin orange slice in the center of each rue.

title: Tandoori-Style Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 coriander, stem removed | 1 beef brisket
instructions: Score the rim by criss cross running a sharp knife through it. To remove any leaves that are not coriander, tie them with a string. Rub the coriander into the meat, leaving a tail fin covering the meat. Sprinkle the outside of the brisket pieces with salt, cover with a double layer of rearedder cheesecloth, and tie tightly with kitchen string. Place in a roasting pan, and pour in enough water to cover the meat and moisten the surface with water. Place in a 350 oven and roast until very tender, 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Remove beef from the oven, tent with foil, and let stand at room temperature while finishing cooking the sauce. Slice the beef on the diagonal and serve with remaining sauce. Serve with pan juices.

Random Ingredients: white balsamic vinegar,chickpea,tomato sauce,pizza dough,black tea,sesame oil,rom tomato
title: Chickpea Pizza - Indian-American Recipe
ingredients: 500 ml of canned chickpeas | 250 ml black tea | 1/4 cup white balsamic vine-ripened vinegar | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons sesame oil, to taste | 2 tablespoons finely chopped roma tomatoes | 1 pizza dough | 1/3 cup pickled tomatoes, and ( black )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chickpeas, tea, vinegar, tomato sauce, sesame oil and tomato. Mix well to combine. Place pizza dough on a large pizza board and stretch dough to a 7 inch size. Spread chickpea mixture evenly onto the dough. Top chickpea pizza with toppings of choice. Cook on a hot griddle pan or on the pan of your choice of stove top.

title: Hot Cheese and Herbs Applesauce
ingredients: 1/4 lb old cheese, cut in cubes | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice | 1/8 cup fresh apple juice | 1/4 cup mixed herbs, chopped
instructions: Pour all ingredients into blender and blend well. For sweeter applesauce, add 2 tbsp cold water.

title: Easy Indian Bread Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 4 slices white bread | 4 cherry tomatoes | 4 tablespoons cardamom powder
instructions: Place chicken breasts on a cookie sheet with the top on. Place under an oven grill for 30 minutes at 400 degrees covered. Take out and allow to cool. Remove chicken from grill and slice into about 3 pieces, then open each piece up like you would open a book. Place open bread pieces cut side up on plate and place tomato halves over the bread. Sprinkle a few cardamom powder and a few black seeds on the bread and tomato. Place the chicken on top of the tomatoes and serve with your favourite veggies.

title: Green Olive Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mango, cut into small cubes | 1 jar green olives, drained and sliced | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard ( or other mild mustard )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss well. Serve at once. Variation, replace 1/2 cup of each ingredient with 1/3 cup of chopped fresh mango.

title: Limas
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 6 pounds fresh asparagus, trimmed | 6 cans condensed consomme | 1 jar lima beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange chicken in a large pot or roasting pan. Cover with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook 30 minutes. Drain and cool slightly. Break up chicken into small pieces and place in a stock pot. Place in roasting pan. Open one can so as not to separate the chicken pieces.

title: Simple Noodle Bread Loaf
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 7 ounces noodles ( spaghetti, linguine, gorgonzola or fettuccine ) | nam pla ( thai sweet chili sauce )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Slice french loaf lengthwise. Scoop out center of bread, leaving a ½ inch thick shell approximately 1 inch thick around the outside. Remove the bread from pouch. Turn bread toasted top and cut into ¾ inch rounds. Set aside. Coarsely chop the linguine, stir in 3 ounces of noodles and 3 ounces of noodles into food processor. Blend until smooth. Spread the bread rounds on a baking sheet. Brush tops surface of bread with a little nam pla. Bake at 350°f for about 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 tablespoon soft sweetened coconut | 1 1/2 tablespoons soft cream | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1/4 cup sweetened flaked coconut | 1/2 sheet ladyfinger | 3 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Beat sugar and sour cream together in a small bowl until fluffy and well blended, about 3 minutes. Dissolve instant coffee by adding hot coconut flakes to the coconut cream and coffee granules in a small bowl. Dip ladyfingers in the coconut cream and then arrange them in a single layer on a serving plate. Brush generously with coffee mixture and sprinkle with the cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,cream cheese,splenda granular,icing sugar,sea salt,frying chicken,mint
title: Mint Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 600 g frying chicken, cut into bite size pieces | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup parsley leaves | 1/2 cup of fresh mint, chopped | 1/4 cup splenda granular | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Combine icing sugar, cream cheese and parsley and mix well. Add seasoning and then mix in chicken until coated. Fry chicken pieces until golden brown on both sides. Place in greased baking tray and bake at 180 c or 180 c for 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 3/4 cup angostura bitters
instructions: Mix the worcestershire sauce, bitters, and angostura bitters together in a bowl.

title: Brown Onions, Cornmeal and Cauliflower Mash
ingredients: 1 large brown onion | 1 head cauliflower | 2 russet potatoes | 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal
instructions: Peel and chop the onion very finely. Cut up the cauliflower into even smaller and thinner pieces.

Random Ingredients: pepper,corn oil,cardamom seed,italian sausage,mango,yellow pepper,sandwich bun,catsup
title: Sloppy Bombay Burger
ingredients: 4 tablespoons corn oil | 6 ounces hot italian sausages or 6 ounces sausage links | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 1 yellow pepper, seeded and sliced into thin rings | 1 yellow pepper, seeded and sliced into thin rings | 4 sandwich buns ( i use pepperoni sandwich buns, but other brands will do ) | freshly ground pepper
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a wok until very hot. Add the italian sausage and brown until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,green onion,asafoetida powder,pink champagne,tomato puree
title: Green Goddess Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon green goddess salad dressing or 1 teaspoon pink champagne | 1 teaspoons tom puree | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 green onions, finely chopped
instructions: Dissolve the asafetida in the yogurt. Add remaining ingredients to the yogurt and mix gently. To thin, add only a little water at a time as needed and mix again before adding more. Adjust nutritional content to taste.

title: Baked Tahini Pizza
ingredients: 1 boboli pizza crust | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 teaspoon oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Spread the tahini on the boboli pizza crust. Sprinkle the pizza with the tahini.

title: Beef and Bean Short Ribs
ingredients: 24 beef short ribs | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1 can refried beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a large baking pan. Place ribs into the baking pan and rub with onion soup mix. Bake uncovered for 12 to 15 hours or until meat easily flakes. To serve, place desired amount of beans in center of rice, place ribs around beans and serve.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,salt,white rice,bulb garlic
title: Garlic Rice With Garlic and Rice
ingredients: 1 bulb of garlic | 2 quarts extra virgin olive oil | 2 2 cups uncooked white rice or 2 cups arborio rice | coarse salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f trim head of garlic and separate cloves. Put on small baking sheet and place in lower third of oven. Fill with water to cover garlic, about 5 cups. Bake at 375°f for 2 hours, until cloves are soft and soft. Transfer cloves to bowl of a food processor or blender and puree with a small amount of water.

title: Simple Microwave Korean BBQ Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons coriander powder
instructions: Put all ingredients in a zip loc freezer bag, stir once, shake so well. Cook on high in microwave 10 - 12 minutes. Flip.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,chicken bouillon cube,icing sugar,cane sugar,olive oil
title: Sweet & Sour Sweet Spicy Macaroni
ingredients: 8 ounces pasta sauce | 2 tablespoons icing sugar ( fine granulated, white or dark ) | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon arrowroot or 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan. Add bouillon and cook for 1 minute. Add flour and arrowroot and stir to mix well. Add sauce, cook over a gentle boil until the consistency of thin oatmeal. Serve hot i like to serve it over my macaroni & broccoli.

title: Braised Ouzo Chicken Thighs (With Saffron and Oil)
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs bone-in chicken thighs, trimmed of excess fat | kaffir lime ouzo ( see note ) | 1/2 cup olive oil ( divided ) | 1 large white onion, halved vertically and cut into 8 wedges | 1 cup chopped fresh kale | 1 cup ouzo, sauce | 3 tablespoons minced pancetta or 3 tablespoons bacon fat, drippings reserved
instructions: If using chicken thighs with bone, do not add the bone. Rinse chicken with cold water, then pat dry. Place half the ouzo in a small bowl, cover and refrigerate for a few hours or preferably overnight. Heat olive oil over medium high heat in a dutch oven. Add chicken and cook, turning occasionally, until the chicken is well browned. Add the onion wedges, stir in the kale and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, until the greens just start to wilt. Deglaze the pan with 1/4 cup of the ouzo and scrape up any browned bits, then add 1/2 cup water and any leftover ouzo from the chicken. Cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken from pan. Add remaining ouzo to pan and stir. Cover and simmer over very low heat for another 3 - 5 minutes. Slide cooked chicken thighs, including any fat on top, into a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 hours or overnight, or until you are ready to serve. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small nonstick ovenproof skillet, heat remaining olive oil over medium high heat. Add pancetta or bacon fat and cook, stirring and breaking up pancetta with a wooden spoon, until crispy and browned, about 3 minutes. Using slotted spoon, transfer pancetta to paper towels to drain. Cut into small pieces or triangles and serve with ouzo as described above.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,mustard powder,baby carrot,cream mushroom soup,mace,potato,cumin seed
title: Creamy Potato Cumin Casserole #5FIX
ingredients: 2 cups baby carrots | 10 -12 medium potatoes ( i used yukon golds peeled and quartered ) | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon dried mustard powder | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon ground mace, i just added a dash of ground nutmeg | 1/8 - 1/4 tablespoon rice wine or 1/8-1/4 tablespoon dry white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2 pan. You want your bottom and sides to be about 1/4 inch high. In a medium size bowl, mix the remaining ingredients in your mixing bowl. Slice potatoes 1/8 inch thick and lay them out in a single layer in the pan. The more slices, the more spiky potato will be. Add the spiced potato mixture to the potatoes, stir, cover with the lid so the potato slices aren't sticking out. Bake for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Aussie Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 large ripe mango - halved, seeded and peeled | 6 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/4 teaspoon fresh-ground white pepper | 1 tablespoon mango puree or 1 tablespoon palm oil | 2 teaspoons palm oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Place the mango, icing sugar, pepper and gremolata in a large bowl, then stir in the palm oil and marjoram. Serve as suggested in intro.

title: Simple Beef Stock
ingredients: 2 lbs good quality lean beef, such as sirloin, very well trimmed of fat | 2 tablespoons sea salt ( to taste )
instructions: The coarse sea salt can be very fine, however it adds a particularly salty flavor to beef stock. Combine beef with sea salt in a saucepan and place over medium heat. Stir occasionally. Reduce the heat to just barely keep the stock warm.

title: Tortilla Salad (Healthy)
ingredients: 2 cups tortillas | 1/2 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1 cup spinach, chopped | 2/3 cup chickpeas, boiled, cooked | 1/2 mango, sliced | 1/2 mango, peeled and sliced | 2 teaspoons icing sugar ( optional ) | 1/4 apple, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Spread pesto over tortillas. Combine the chickpeas and sliced mango in a small bowl. Gently layer the spinach and chickpea mixture over the pesto. Sprinkle with icing sugar. Garnish with sliced apple.

title: Feta Burger
ingredients: 1 g feta, crumbled | 1 tablespoon basil, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon thyme leave, chopped | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 tablespoon unsweetened applesauce
instructions: Mix everything together and form into four burgers. Bake at 200c for about 10 - 15 mins each side or until cooked through and nice and browned.

title: Lima Bean Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 100 g fresh lima beans, trimmed | 50 g grated parmesan cheese
instructions: If using frozen lima beans, defrost the lima beans in the microwave for about 30seconds. If frozen, defrost. Place cheese into a small bowl. Microwave the lima beans, with salt, on high until warm. About 2 minutes. Stir. Drizzle a bit of olive oil onto the cheese and spread around. Toss the pasta into the cheese and pour the rest into a serving bowl. Toss the pasta and the rest. Serve.

title: Cucumber-Broiled Cheese Loaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 4 cups fresh bread, cut into 1/4-thick slices | 1 cucumber, peeled, halved, seeds removed | 4 large fat free tortillas
instructions: Combine the first 2 ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Arrange the toast in a shallow, nonreactive baking dish. Top each slice of bread with 1/2 cup of the cheese mixture and 2 slices of cucumber. Spoon on the madeira and top with the remaining slices of bread. Sprinkle with the zest and pepper. Pour the remaining 1/2 cup of madeira over the top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next morning, preheat the broiler. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,garlic paste,cream chicken soup,nutritional yeast
title: Cheesy Cheese
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon prepared garlic paste ( see note ) | 1 -2 tablespoon nutritional yeast ( optional )
instructions: Heat cream of chicken soup and yogurt over med. Heat until hot. Sprinkle with garlic paste and nutritional yeast if using. To serve, remove and place on plates with cheese.

title: Penne Pasta Shells
ingredients: 2 cans imitation crabmeat, drained and flaked | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 package dry penne
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring it to a rolling boil. Stir in penne and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,serrano ham,kalamata olive,scallion,italian dressing,black olive
title: Crostini With Salami & Olives
ingredients: 1/4 cup light italian seasoning, blend | 1 scallion, trimmed, finely chopped | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, pitted & chopped ( or a mixed type of olives ) | 1 - 1 1/2 slice kalamata olive, very thin slices ( optional ) | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup italian dressing | 1 -2 slice serrano ham ( thinly sliced )
instructions: Mix italian seasoning blend, scallion, olives, vinegar & italian dressing together. Place ham slices in a salad bowl & pour vinaigrette mixture over them. Let it set for 2 - 3 hours. Drain excess marinade from bowl. Serve on toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,rosemary leaf,cocoa powder,olive,dipping sauce,stewing beef,cocoa
title: Pepper Au Gratin Beef Strips
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 8 ounces pepper au gratin peppered olives | 4 ounces provolone cheese | 3 -4 tablespoons cocoa powder | olive oil, for drizzling | 1 tablespoon rosemary leaf | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream
instructions: Rinse beef and pat dry with paper towel. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Set aside. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees. Cut the top third of each pepper into thin slices. Lay pepper strips side by side on the work surface. Slice the top portion of beef into thin strips. Arrange the slices over the pepper strips and top with the provolone cheese. Place a few slices of provolone cheese onto each of the pepper beef strips. Sprinkle about 1/4 cup cocoa powder into each pile of beef and provolone cheese. Roll up the peppers and secure with a toothpick. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sprinkle with rosemary. Cover baking sheet in an open roasting pan. Bake until beef is tender when pierced with a fork, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,red potato,triple sec,vanilla extract,chicken broth,pumpernickel bread,bean
title: Chicken and Potato Baked in Pumpernickel Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs red potatoes, unpeeled, scrubbed well | 1 cup chicken broth | 3/4 cup triple sec | 1 medium chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup refried beans, any flavor | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 loaf pumpernickel bread, cut in half & toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bring potatoes to a boil in large pot of lightly salted water. Reduce heat to medium.

Random Ingredients: bean thread,green grape,taco seasoning,white pepper,green pea,bay leaf
title: Mexican Green Peas and Beans
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces bean threads ( white or brown ) | 1 1/2 cups white frozen green pea | 3 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 packet taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: grain brown rice,escarole,yellow squash,red bell pepper
title: Quick and Easy Brown Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 8 cups cold cooked long-grain brown rice ( or arborio ) | 1 large yellow squash | 2 cups thinly sliced red bell peppers | 1 medium head escarole, washed, head removed, and chopped
instructions: In a large, oven safe skillet, heat brown rice and squash over medium heat 4 - 5 minutes or until hot. Add bell peppers and cook 5 minutes or until squash is tender. Stir in escarole and cook 2 - 3 minutes longer. Fluff rice with a fork and serve.

title: Aussie Sunset
ingredients: 1 cup sweetened condensed red currant jelly | 1/4 cup southern comfort | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh ganache, or to taste
instructions: Stir red currant jelly, southern comfort, and ganache together in a microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: shallot,key lime juice,white sugar,beet,onion,red food coloring,half
title: Key Lime Gratinees
ingredients: 1 shallot, peeled and minced | 1 large onion, peeled and finely minced | 1/2 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons key lime juice | 2 cups half-and-half | 1 pound red food coloring, or as needed | 1 1/2 cups red food coloring, or as needed | 1 1/2 cups white sugar, or as needed
instructions: Place shallot, onion, 1/2 cup sugar, Key lime juice, half and half, red food coloring, and 2 cups of red food coloring in a blender. Blend until the mixture is fairly smooth. Pour into jars and store in refrigerator.

title: Chinese New Year Pretzels
ingredients: 1 can chicken broth | 1 teaspoon dried yeast granules | 1 cup homemade lemonade | 1 pound dry bread, cubes | 3 cups cubed cooked spareribs | 1 1 pound frozen active dry yeast granules
instructions: Combine the chicken broth and yeast in a saucepan with the lemonade. Bring to a boil over medium heat, whisking constantly. Return to a simmer. Place the bread cubes in the broth, and stir to soak. In a large bowl, mix together the fried yeast, spareribs, and the cooked bread cubes. Gradually mix in the yeast mixture until the dough is soft and well blended. Place in a large round baking dish, cover with a plate that will fit snugly in the baking dish, and set in a warm place. Let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume. Punch down, and shape into pretzels. Let drain in the refrigerator 5 to 10 minutes before baking. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the tops are browned and crispy.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,plain yogurt,shoulder lamb chop,sun tomato oil,nonfat cream,white wine,head broccoli
title: Lamb Chops With Broccoli, Sun-Dried Tomatoes and Cream
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 1/2 lbs medium shoulder lamb chops | 1 1/2 heads broccoli, trimmed, cut crosswise into 1 1/2 '' pieces | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 4 ounces thin spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: In small bowl, combine sun dried tomatoes and 1 tbsp of the oil.

Random Ingredients: ice water,feta,green onion,dill,tomato green chilies,white hominy,sun tomato
title: Green Chile Pozole
ingredients: 3 cans white hominy, drained | 2 cups ice water | 2 pounds frozen green onions, sliced | 1 package sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 bunch fresh dill, chopped
instructions: Bring hominy and water to boil in a large pot. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook 20 minutes. Stir in green onions, sun dried tomatoes, tomatoes with chilis, and dill. Continue cooking 20 minutes, or until heated through and flavors are blended.

title: Dal
ingredients: 12 saffron strands | 2 bunches swiss chard | 4 green chiles, chopped
instructions: Place the saffron strands in a small bowl and set aside. Separate the stems and stalks of chard. Chop both separately. In a large pot over medium heat, stir together the chard and the saffron. Let the chard wilt over medium heat for 1 minute, then remove it from the heat. Stir in the green chilies. Cool for 1 to 2 minutes, then serve.

Random Ingredients: kiwi,pork loin,golden superfine sugar,corn tortilla chip,kosher salt black pepper,coconut milk
title: Pork and Kiwi Tacos
ingredients: 32 ounces coconut milk | 3 lbs pork loin, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2/3 cup golden superfine sugar | 1/2 cup sweet corn tortilla chips | 3 kiwi, cut into quarters
instructions: Bring 2 cups of the coconut milk to a simmer in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Season the pork with salt and pepper. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer the meat until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Add the sugar and simmer until the pork is cooked through, another 20 minutes. Cool the pork for 25 minutes. Spread the corn tortillas on a platter and top with the pork, shredded kiwis, and remaining coconut milk. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: clove,sharp cheddar cheese,lamb shank,kalamata olive,gelatin,pinto bean,hungarian paprika,yellow mustard
title: Breaded Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 8 garlic cloves, minced | 2 tablespoons hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 1 cup kalamata olive, sliced | 4 lamb shanks ( about 2lb ) | 2 cans pinto beans | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 1 slice sharp cheddar cheese, cut into thin diagonal slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Pour ½ cup of water into nonstick or cast iron skillet to bottom of oven safe baking dish to heat. Add garlic, paprika and mustard and cook to a paste. Spread garlic mixture evenly over lamb shanks in dish. Stir together olives and remaining ingredients. Spread over lamb in dish. Bake in oven for 2 hours, basting with the marinade every 30 minutes, or until lamb is tender and cooked through. To serve, pour 1/4 cup water into colander set over a bowl. Set colander over sink for a few minutes to drain. Squeeze excess liquid from meat and discard. Cut lamb and serve with cheese.

Random Ingredients: beer,white flour,vanilla essence,swiss chard,hot chili sauce,butter,mint leaf,green cardamom pod
title: Steamed Swiss Chard (Coriander Chard)
ingredients: 3 bunches swiss chard ( or use baby leaves ) | 4 teaspoons white flour | 1 -2 teaspoon hot chili sauce | 1/2 medium fresh hot chili pepper, deseeded & finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves or 1 tablespoon fresh coriander leaves, finely chopped | 1 green cardamom pod, seeds included, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 liter ale or 1/2 liter light beer | 6 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves or 2 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves, finely chopped ( for garnishing )
instructions: For the steamed leaves, wash the chard well and dry thoroughly. Trim away the woody white membrane on the stems and base. Slice into 1 cm x 2 cm pieces. Place the flour in a large bowl. Slice the chilli pepper finely and stir into the flour. Add the chard and stir until the leaves are thoroughly coated with the flour. Add the chili sauce and stir well. Sprinkle with the mint and coriander and stir to ensure a paste is formed. Add the chopped green cardamom and stir gently to coat the leaves. Place the lid on and steam over high heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Pour in the ale or light beer and cover with a tight fitting lid. Steam for 2 - 3 minutes over medium heat. Take the lid off and steam for another 2 - 3 minutes to allow the chilli to be strong. Remove from the heat and allow to sit for 4 - 5 minutes until the leaves are firm but very glossy. Discard the herbs, slice and arrange on serving plates and scatter over the chopped herbs.

title: Roasted Corn
ingredients: 2 ears corn, shucked | 1 cup dark rum | 1 stick fresh sage, leaves crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse the corn thoroughly under cool running water, and remove the silk. Scrape any remaining husks and silk off the corn with a spoon. Place on a clean table, and allow to dry at least 6 hours or overnight. Place the kernels to the side of the corn so they will continue cooking on the same temperature during the baking process. Place the corn in a roasting pan or on a baking rack, and roast in the preheated oven, basting every 30 minutes to keep the kernels from burning, until the corn is a dark, almost black color. While the corn is roasting, combine the rum and sage. Heat a 1/2 inch olive oil in a sauté pan over medium heat. When the oil is very hot, pour in the rum mixture a cup at a time, stirring constantly, allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding the next. This will take about 1 1/2 cups of rum or 1 1/2 cups of dark rum, and will keep the corn from burning to the pan. Turn off the heat, and allow the corn to stand in the oil for about 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Alfajores - Danish Fingers from the Spice House
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers, sliced thinly | 1 jar apricot jam, chilled | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon dill, dried
instructions: Split ladyfingers horizontally. Prepare jam as instructed on package. Spread a layer of jam on the bottom of a lightly buttered shallow baking dish, layer one end of the ladyfingers, the apricot jam, diagonally on top. Repeat layers twice and sprinkle with anise seed and dried dill on both faces. Bake in preheated oven at 400f for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Kielbasa Seafood
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa | 1 lb scallops | 3/4 cup chili pepper flakes | 1/2 lb salted scallops
instructions: Trim the scallops and cut away the scallops. Place them in a large pot with a tight lid. Put on the chili flakes and water to cover the saute pan and bring to a boil. Turn off the burner and pour in the kielbasa sauce from the wok. Cut the salted scallops into 3/4 inch wide by 2 inch long pieces. Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat, until no longer colored. Put in the fresh salted scallops and serve.

title: Ziti With Roasted Peppers and Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 3 boxes ziti pasta or 36 ounces penne pasta | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 2 packages taco seasoning | 2 large bell peppers, halved ( any color )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f or 180°c. Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, place roasting pan over high heat. Add stock in 3/4 increments and stir often until all liquid is absorbed. Stir in taco seasoning and heat through. Remove from heat. Rinse pasta under cool water and drain. Place the peppers and the remaining ingredients in a large non stick fry pan or roasting pan. Place pan over high heat. To serve sprinkle with grated cheese, if desired. Serve hot..

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,black pepper,tomato puree,red chilies,rye bread
title: Spicy Pizza Dip
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread | red chilies, deseeded and finely diced | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | seasoning salt, to taste | ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place bread pieces in a bowl with a little bit of water. Soak for a few minutes, so they do not become mushy. Add the chillies and tomato puree. Season with seasoning salt and pepper. Mix gently. Serve warm with chips, vegetables or cold vegetables.

title: Fruit & Nuts 'n' Sprouts
ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit | 1 cup mixed sprouts | 1/4 cup shredded oat | 1 cup peas | 1 cup baby peas | 1 small vidalia onion, chopped | 8 baby asparagus, sliced | 1/4 cup bran cereal ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients and toss until well coated using your hands. Cover and refrigerate. Prepare the sprouts as per package instructions. After chilling for at least an hour, place in a large container and pour in the bran and bran.

title: Salt Free Margaritas
ingredients: 6 tablespoons tequila | 2 1/2 tablespoons non iodized salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker, fill and shake vigorously for 30 seconds to 1 minute. Note, if you like a thicker, thicker shake just be sure to stir it until everything is well mixed.

title: Cilantro-Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro, stems and leaves | 3 tablespoons shallots, fresh peeled | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil
instructions: Wash the coriander.

title: Mandarin Pickles
ingredients: 1 cup mandarin orange, chopped | 1/2 red shallot, chopped
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a jar with a tight sealing lid. Make sure everything is covered. Turn the jar upside down. Turn the jar over once more as to let all of the liquid inside the jar. Refrigerate until chilled.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,trout,irish whiskey,balsamic vinegar,green bell pepper,blueberry,gingerroot
title: Blueberry and Trout Saute
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 lb raw trout, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 green bell pepper, cut in 1 inch wide strips | 1 inch gingerroot, finely chopped | 2 cups fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Pour the vinegar into a small bowl and stir in the garam masala. Add trout and allow the fish to poach in the vinegar mixture over medium heat until cooked through, about 3 - 5 minutes per side. Place the pepper strips and ginger in the skillet. When the fish is done, drain the fish, cover and keep warm. Stir in the blueberries and whiskey.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,chickpea flour,beetroot,pork sausage,thai fish sauce,semolina,lamb shoulder,chipotle chile
title: Fried Sausages With Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chipotle chile | 1 teaspoon parsnip, fresh, chopped | 1 teaspoon leeks, choped chopped or 1 teaspoon scallion, minced | 1/2 teaspoon chickpea flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarse semolina | 4 -5 lean pork sausages, 1 1/2 inches long | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce or 3 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons beetroots, shredded ( about 1/4 cup )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the chipotle chile, parsnip, chile and scallions. In a small shallow dish, using your hands, mix the chickpea flour, semolina and 2 tablespoons of the fish sauce or soy sauce, toss to combine. Heat a heavy 12 skillet over a medium high heat. Coat with a little oil. Working in batches, add the sausages, cook, turning, for about 6 minutes or until golden brown on all sides. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the sausages to a plate. Pour off all but about 1 1/2 tablespoons fat from the skillet and heat over a high heat. Add the beetroot, reduce the heat to medium. Cook for 1 minute or until softened. Using tongs grasp the beetroot, pull each leaf individually by the stem, then pull apart with a broad metal spoon, leaving it whole. Scatter over the sausages. To serve, stack the vegetables and pile the meat on top. Cut into wedges or batons and drizzle with the rest of the fish sauce.

title: Italian Sausage-Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 1 1/3 cups hot sauce | 4 cups mashed potatoes
instructions: Cut sausage into 1 inch slices. Add the sausage and fry until browned and cooked through. Add hot sauce, potato, and simmer covered about 15 minutes.

title: Portuguese Pork Cone
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs pork, sliced in thin strips | 2 cups pimento-stuffed spanish onions, sliced | 2 tablespoons sweet spanish paprika or 2 tablespoons spanish smoked paprika | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 1 tablespoon low-sodium vanilla essence | 2 whole serrano chilies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the pork together and roll in paprika to coat all of the pork. Heat a little oil in a skillet and fry the pork on all sides until well browned on all sides and pork slices are well separated from any juices. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,salt black pepper,ginger,chuck roast,pork shoulder,chili paste,greek yogurt
title: Saliq
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless chuck roast | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1 1/2 cups plain greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons ground ginger | 1 tablespoon chili paste, or to taste | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon salt and black pepper
instructions: Place chuck and pork in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until pork is very tender, about 45 minutes. Drain.

title: Ziti with Spinach and Cream
ingredients: 1 box ziti pasta | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 2 ounces spinach leaves, fresh | 3 cups heavy cream
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions. While pasta is cooking, combine half and half and spinach in a medium sized sauce pan. Heat just over medium heat, stirring frequently. When half of the cream has been absorbed, slowly add the heavy cream. When mixture is warm to the touch, add the rest of the cream, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating well after each addition. Cook for about 2 more minutes. Drain pasta, adding spinach cream mixture and cook for 5 minutes or until liquid absorbed.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,swordfish steak,sambal oelek,pistachio,vegetable broth,liquid honey,pizza crust,grenadine
title: Kwasi's Thai Steak Gyros
ingredients: 1/2 gallon vegetable broth | 1/2 cup raw sugar and butter at room temperature | 1/4 cup sambal oelek ( vietnamese sweet chili paste ) | 2 tablespoons liquid honey ( optional ) | 2 pounds swordfish steaks | 1 crusty pizza crust, for 4 servings | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 cup pistachios | 2 tablespoons grenadine
instructions: Combine vegetable broth, sugar, sambal oelek, and honey in a large saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until syrupy, about 15 minutes. Pour mixture into a resealable plastic bag, and add swordfish.

title: Almond Chips
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 3 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 3/4 cup chopped almonds
instructions: Place potato wedges in a large saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook for 20 minutes, then drain. Bring limeade concentrate to a boil and add seasoning salt. Remove from heat and add potatoes, and raisins to the mixture. Toss lightly and cover. Leave at least one hour in fridge to thaw a bit before serving. Bake according to directions on seasoning packet.

title: Baked Pasta
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked farfalle pasta | 1 cup barbeque sauce | 1 cup semolina
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in hot water until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 9 minutes. Drain. Place farfalle noodles in a large bowl of ice cold water until the water returns to a boil. Remove from the cold water, drain, and set aside. Heat barbeque sauce in microwave or in a small saucepan over medium heat. Spread the farfalle noodles in the bottom of an 11x7 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the farfalle noodles are heated through and the sauce is bubbling, 25 to 30 minutes. Pour barbeque sauce over farfalle noodles in baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven until farfalle noodles are bubbly, 25 to 30 more minutes.

title: Tequila Cheese Tortilla
ingredients: 1 small wedge of a good quality tortilla, cut in 2 inch wedges ( approx ) | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise ( i use miracle whip brand ) | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes ( about 1/4 teaspoon ) | 1 -2 green cardamom pods, minced ( the size of a cardamom pod, but it can vary greatly in the amount ) | 1/4 ounce tequila ( i use patron lite brand )
instructions: First make the base with the crushed red pepper and cardamom. Set aside for now. Lay the wedge of tequila on a dry frying pan or griddle and cook over medium heat. Turn often until light brown on one side about 1 - 2 minutes. Turn onto a paper towel lined plate to cool. When cool, transfer to a cutting board.
