Spread with mayonnaise to form the base, then sprinkle with chili powder. Using a sharp knife cut down the side, making diamond shaped patterns to make indents. Repeat with each wedge. Serve with salsa or other condiments.

title: Punjab Braised Lentils
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown lentils | 1 jar peas, drained and picked over | 2 teaspoons chopped cilantro | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Place lentils, peas, cilantro and zest in a slow cooker. Pour any accumulated juices over the top. Cover and cook on high 6 to 8 hours or on low 3 to 4 hours until lentils are tender, adding more water if necessary. Stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,jasmine rice,white rice,coconut oil,chive,orange zest,chicken breast half,spaghetti
title: Spicy Chicken-Poppy Seed Scented Rice Pilaf With Orange-Chive
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups jasmine rice ( or yellow rice ) | 2 cups white rice, prepared with 2 cups water | 1/4 cup poppy seed | 1 cup grated coconut oil or 1 cup unrefined all-purpose cooking oil | 2 tablespoons chopped chives | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 6 ounces orange chicken breast halves, cut into 1 inch pieces | fresh chives or fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. While rice is cooking, rinse, dry and coarsely chop 2 cups cmsn of the rind from the oranges using the grated peel.. Place rice and orange peel in a bowl, using just enough water to allow mixture to soak for 15 minutes or so to absorb. Stir in coconut oil, 1 teaspoon of chives, and the remaining 1 tablespoon chives. Pour mixture into rice along with orange zest and mix gently together.

Random Ingredients: pasta,ziti pasta,sherry wine vinegar,meat,vanilla sugar,goat cheese,wooden skewer
title: Pasta Bake with Goat Cheese and Marinated Meat
ingredients: 6 wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes and drained | 300 g ziti pasta | 500 g marinated meat, cut into bite-sized pieces | 100 g goat cheese, broken into small pieces | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar | extra pasta cooking fluid ( see note )
instructions: Preheat grill/grill or oven to 180c, or gas mark on the stove top, place the skewers in one section and grill until they turn from blonde to black. In an ovenproof dish, place the ziti to the side. Add the marinated fruit and goat cheese to the other dish. Mix well until the meat is coated. Toast the wooden skewers. Make sure all of the sausage and cheese is covered with a layer of marinated meat. Drizzle the sherry vinegar over and sprinkle with vanilla sugar. Cover dish with foil and bake for 40 to 50 minutes. Remove the foil and bake another 10 minutes or until all the meat is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,bourbon,olive oil,spanish onion,gelatin,rice,broccoli floret
title: Broccoli and Onion Steakhouse Copycat Recipe
ingredients: 4 steaks ( sirloin tip and top round or round ) | 2 medium spanish onions, cut in half and then across at a 1/4 in length | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1/4 cup bourbon or 1/4 cup triple berry whiskey | lime juice and zest of | 1 package fresh broccoli florets, peeled | cooked rice
instructions: Heat grill to medium and lightly oil grate. Sprinkle steaks with salt, add to grill. Cook to desired doneness, about 6 - 7 minute per side for medium rare. When done, add onions to grill. Pour unflavored gelatin over onions and mix well to soften and dissolve gelatin. Place beef in baking dish and surround with broccoli. Pour in british bourbon and sprinkle with lime zest. Roast in broiler for 5 - 6 min, remove from oven and let cool slightly. Sprinkle with sugar if desired and serve with warm rice.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,spinach leaf,baking powder,cream,snow pea,cilantro
title: Spinach and Snow Peas With Crushed Cilantro
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach leaves, trimmed and chopped | 1 cup fresh snow peas, shelled | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 2 teaspoons unsweetened parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 2/3 cup sour cream
instructions: Bring a large sauce pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add spinach.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,dill pickle,panko crumb,cumin powder,catsup,flat leaf italian parsley,triple sec
title: Panko Crumbs with Tomato Relish
ingredients: 4 cups panko crumbs | 16 ounces sour chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 cup finely chopped dill pickle ( about 2 large ones ) | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 2 1/2 cups catsup ( may sub ketchup ) | 2 tablespoons triple sec
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl mix together panko crumbs, parsley, pickles, soy sauce, cumin, and catsup until thoroughly mixed. Stir in triple sec. Using your hands, work the panko mixture into the panko mixture until well moistened. Press the panko mixture into a greased jelly roll pan. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Easy Peasy-Grilled Celery
ingredients: 450 g celery ribs ( i use a mix of both ) or 450 g onions ( i use a mix of both ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 200 g roasted peanuts, coarsely crushed ( peanuts should be coarsely crushed if possible )
instructions: Use a sharp knife to cut the celery across the grain into 2 or 3 diagonal slices about the thickness of your thumb. Arrange in a large, well sized bowl and scatter mustard on top. Then scatter crushed peanuts over top of all. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Leave to marinate overnight in the refrigerator to absorb the flavours. When ready to serve, remove tray from refrigerator. Drain the celery and sprinkle with a little salt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: goose,five spice powder,cake flour,water chestnut,ketchup,red chilies,poblano chile
title: Hot Dogs from the Countryside
ingredients: 2 large red chilies, split lengthwise | 5 -6 poblano chiles ( the hot peppers ) | 1 1/2 lbs goose, cut up into 2-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup water chestnuts | 3 large red chilies
instructions: Blanch two poblano peppers over medium heat until blistered. Imprint with a knife to make 2 cut outs on the chilies. Remove the seeds and pith, and cut crosswise into long, thin strips. Remove the skin and stem from the chilies. Place the chilies in a medium bowl. Drizzle half the hot peppers with 3 tablespoons olive oil, toss to evenly coat. Arrange on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat and add remaining poblano chilies. Cook, stirring twice, until poblano has softened, about 5 minutes. Remove stems and seeds from chilies and coarsely chop. Set aside. Reserve oil. Place flour and one pinch of five spice in a plastic bag. Add remaining 1 1/2 cup water, a few drops of worcestershire, and the chilies. Shake to combine. Heat remaining oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add remaining chilies in batches, cooking until just softened, about 1 minute. Remove chilies with a slotted spoon and place on paper towels to drain. Drain chilies on paper towels. Toss chiles and flour sauce with goose fat and chilies in a large bowl. Season with five spice powder and remaining five spice. Preheat oven to 350°. Line 2 jelly roll pans with plastic wrap. Divide pork and goose mixture among pan molds, pressing it snugly against filling. Top with green chilies. Bake until bubbling and thickened, about 1 - ½ hours. Serve with sauce. Note, if making the sauce in advance, loosely cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Keeps well for up to 1 week. Bring to room temperature before baking.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,monterey jack cheese,deep dish pie crust,mix,pistachio,chili powder,plain nonfat yogurt,hard egg
title: Pistachio Layer Pie
ingredients: 1 medium size plain nonfat yogurt or 1 medium-fat yogurt | 1 large hard-boiled egg, minced | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon fresh minced pistachios | 1 package prepared sweet and sour mix ( such as keebler ) | 1 1/4 cups grated monterey jack cheese | 1 deep-dish pie crust
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Mix the yogurt with the egg, soya sauce, chili powder and pistachios until mixed well. Pour half of the mix into the pie crust. Sprinkle the cheese on the top, then top with the other half of the mix. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until the cheese begins to brown. Turn onto a plate and serve warm.

title: Irish Mountain Tea
ingredients: 1 cabbage | 2 teaspoons tea
instructions: Core cabbage and put on tea towel or colander. Microwave for half to two minutes or leave for half an hour or so.

title: BBQ Barley Chicken-Scallop-Parboil
ingredients: 12 thin scallops | 1/2 cup barley | 80 g fresh bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon low-fat tamarind juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon instant chicken parts, mashed
instructions: Wash barley and bean sprouts, drain. Place in a saucepan with salted water bring to boil, reduce heat, simmer 1 minute drain. Set aside. Place scallops in a bowl, pour in 1/2 cup barley and 1/2 cup bean sprouts. Rinse with cold water, drain. Place onto a plate, spread over another plate. Place a second plate over your first plate, repeat with the rest of ingredients. Set aside. Combine tamarind juice, vanilla, coffee, tamarind pulp and 1 tsp ground ginger and pour over all. Stir to blend. Allow to marinate 2 hours on the fridge. Cook over fairly low heat until chicken is cooked through. Serve with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: easiest ever pizza dough,chili garlic sauce,horseradish,baking powder,yellow bell pepper,rye bread,salmon steak,chicken breast half
title: Smoked Salmon and Honey Garlic Pizza (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 10)
ingredients: 4 skinless smoked salmon steaks ( 1/3 lb / 7 ounces total weight ) | 4 skinless rye bread, slices | 2 tablespoons honey-almond sauce or 2 tablespoons garlic and herb spreadable goat cheese | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 1 small yellow bell pepper, deseeded and cut into 2 long thin strips | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f arrange the dough on a large baking tray and bake for 10 minutes or until lightly golden. Meanwhile, combine the honey/almond spread, horseradish, honey and pepper sauce in a bowl. Lightly spread the cheese on the tops of the bread slices and then place under the broiler for 2 mins, or until the cheese is hot and bubbling. Remove from the oven and top each pizza with the salmon, pepper strips and remaining horseradish, then return to the oven, uncovered, for 5 minutes or until the salmon is cooked and the cheese is golden. Slice each pizza into 4 triangles and serve.

title: Taco Fritters for Tacos, Oven or Sandwich Maker
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup flour ( or more or less )
instructions: Put the taco seasoning mix in a ziploc bag, add flour or mix of your choice. Slice the bag at regular intervals. When it is completely covered mix a handfull of hot water into the tortillas and enjoy a little part way or a part way the tortillas go. They are really good. Also i put 1/4 into a bag with a small amount of marinade for dipping, or a small amount of oil for frying. I then put a bag of flour into a plastic bag, make an indentation in the top. Dip the fritters a few at a time in the hot water and let it go limp.

title: Cheese Spread With Crambled Eggs
ingredients: 1 jar cabernet sauvignon wine | 2 cups shredded cheese spread | pickling salt ( optional )
instructions: Cover a large skillet with cooking spray. Heat over medium heat until it begins to smoke. Add 2 cups cheese spread and cook until hot. Add wine and bring to a boil. Spread mixture over the bottom of a greased 2 1/2 quart baking dish.

title: Chile-Parmesan Chiles
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 1 tablespoon vegetarian parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon vegetarian parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon vegetarian parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cider vinegar or 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | cocassible chocolate, grated ( for garnish )
instructions: Peel and devein the poblano chilies on a double thickness of paper toweling. Cut a slit lengthwise down each chile. Open the chilies and place, flesh side down, in a food processor. Add the vegetarian parmesan cheese and the vegetarian parmesan cheese. Process until blended but not pureed. Place the processed chiles in a medium non metal bowl and top with a sheet of plastic wrap, pressing on and off to ensure even coating. Refrigerate for at least 20 minutes or up to overnight. Lightly coat a griddle or heat heavy skillet over medium high heat. Remove the stuffed chiles from the refrigerator, let them sit, still covered, for 5 minutes. Spoon the cheesy sauce onto the softened side of the chiles. Sprinkle the coconut cheese over the top. Using a spatula, turn the chiles upside down on the griddle. After 1 minute, flip them over and repeat on the other side. Remove the chimneys from the grill and top with the chocolate covered griddle. Keep the griddle on the griddle until all the chiles are completely warm, at least 15 - 20 minutes or until very hot. Transfer the finished chile slices onto a cutting board or chopping board with the paper towels inside to allow for easier handling. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Cheese Sausage and Prawns (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 11 )
ingredients: 600 g king prawns | 3 cups mixed vegetables | 1/3 cup canned chick-peas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup reduced-fat mexican cheese blend, crumbled ( optional )
instructions: Warm chargrill pan over medium high heat for 1 minute or until hot. Cut prawns into 1cm cubes. Thread onto 6 long metal skewers. Spray with oil. Place sausages on prepared pan. Cook, turning once, for 3 - 4 minutes or until lightly browned and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,herring,trout,vegetable oil peanut,stilton cheese,lemon zest
title: Herring Salad
ingredients: 4 thick herring | 2 cups mixed fresh cilantro leaves, rinsed | 1 lemon, zest of | 1/2 lb trout, rinsed ( if preferred, leave on one side ) | 1 cup stilton cheese ( crumbled ) | vegetable oil or peanut oil ( for frying )
instructions: Soak herrings in cold water to cover overnight if possible. Drain. Soak herrings again in cold water to cover for 10 to 15 minutes or until herring is plump and completely cold. Remove herring from water and cut herring into slices about 1/4 inch thick. Place in large bowl. Finely chop cilantro leaves. Squeeze lemon zest out of juice into measuring cup. Measure 2 cups of the juice and place it in a bowl with herbs. Place rind of the lemons into same bowl as the herbs. Using a whisk, drizzle lemon juice mixture all over herring and gently toss to coat. Set aside. Mix together cheese and about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the herring juice. Drain off excess herb liquid. In small bowl, cover herbs with rind of lemons. Set aside several tablespoons of cheese mixture and reserve remainder for garnish, or use for serving. Fill another bowl with reserved herring juice mixture. Top with remaining cheese mixture and reserved herring juice. Serve immediately, garnished with reserved herring.

title: Jicama Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 medium ripe tomatoes | 3 tablespoons tapioca | 1/4 cup finely ground jicama ( about 2 small ) | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns ( or ground black fennel ) | 1/2 cup soft white breadcrumbs | 2 1/2 slices thick breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut a long slit along the top of each tomato and slice almost all the way through, to form a little boat. Discard the tomato seeds. Stuff the tomatoes, distributing the filling evenly if necessary. Place the tapioca in a shallow bowl. Mix in the jicama, black peppercorns and bread crumbs. Top off each tomato with the bread crumb mixture, pressing lightly. Heat a small skillet over medium high heat until hot. Place the tomatoes on the pan and bake for about 2 minutes or until golden brown and a knife comes out clean. Transfer to a baking sheet. Serve warm.

title: Acapulco Spinach
ingredients: 1 bag frozen spinach | 1 cup chopped shallot | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning or 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/2 cup chopped chipotle chile in adobo | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/3 cup poppy seeds
instructions: Place spinach in colander over sink and let sit until cool about a minute drain well.. Place spinach, shallots, cajun seasoning, chile and chipotle in a food processor or blender and puls until spinach is finely chopped but not completely chopped. Add tequila and process until blended. Place in small baking dish and bake at 450 for 20 - 30 minutes or until mixture just begins to bubble. You can place it on a baking tray and roast it in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes or until the top browns.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Pizza
ingredients: 1 can italian stewed tomatoes | 1 can chopped dried apricots | 1/4 cup water, more or less to taste | 1/4 cup manchego cheese, grated | 15 slices pepperoni, thinly sliced
instructions: In a shallow baking dish, combine tomatoes, apricots, and water. Cover dish and bake at 425 degrees for about 30 minutes, or until most of the liquid has been absorbed. While the pizza is cooking, in a medium bowl, combine the grated cheese and pepperoni slices. Stir in the tomato mixture. You may season this with more hot pepperoni. When the crust has baked for 30 minutes, spread the grated cheese on the top. Place under a preheated broiler for a few minutes, or until cheese is golden.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,cardamom,lobster tail,tortilla,lettuce leaf,monterey jack cheese
title: Grilled Lobster Tacos
ingredients: 6 lobster tails | 6 tortillas | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup crumbled monterey jack cheese | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | lettuce leaf ( optional )
instructions: Prepare lobster meat, removing entrails and shells, and rinse. Heat grill to medium or medium high. Place lobster tails in a medium bowl, sprinkle with cheese, orange peel and cardamom and toss to coat. Grill 10 - 12 minutes, or until lobster is cooked through and cheese is melted. Remove lobster tails and lobster shells to a platter. Divide lobster meat among taco shells. Divide remaining cheese among taco shells. Heat grill to medium high. Grill taco shells 4 - 6 minutes per side or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,pineapple juice,farfalle pasta,greek yogurt,tomato paste
title: Cherie's Farfalle Recipe
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bowtie ) pasta | 1 can pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Cook pasta to your liking, drain and put aside until later. In a saucepan, combine all ingredients and heat until hot, then stir in pasta, mix well. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to two days.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,beef bouillon powder,espresso,chunky salsa,self rising flour,yellow squash,farfalle pasta,lemon peel
title: Italian Wedding Soup #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie shaped ) | 1 1/2 cups red peppers or 1 1/2 cups green sweet peppers, seeded, chopped | 1 1/2 cups yellow squash, sliced | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons espresso | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated | 1/8 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 1 3/4 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Cook pasta to al dente then rinse under cold water until cool enough. Drain. Combine other ingredients and set aside. Stir yeast mixture with flour until smooth.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,breadcrumb,chili sauce,marsala wine,spaghetti,barbeque sauce,soda water,coconut milk
title: Grilled Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 ounces dry spaghetti | 1/4 cup barbeque sauce | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1/4 cup black mustard seeds | 1 cup soda water | 1 can coconut milk | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1/2 cup coarse breadcrumbs
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package. Drain. Mix remaining ingredients except bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,cream chicken soup,coffee powder,vegetable stock,tomato juice,bamboo skewer
title: Greek Spiced Dills (Tapas)
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 can vegetable stock | 1 cup tomato juice | 2 tablespoons instant coffee powder ( i use 2 tsp if you can find instant instant powdered ) | 20 -25 bamboo skewers | 1/2 cup kalamata olive ( may also use black or green olives )
instructions: In a large bowl combine soup, stock, and tomato juice. Add coffee powder and marinate overnight. The longer the longer the soup mixes into the soup. Soak skewers in a little water for about 20 minutes... Drain the skewers if necessary. In a large saucepan, bring soup mixture to a boil over medium heat. Boil for about 10 minutes. Serve hot over the skewers. Garnish soup with chopped olives, if desired. Enjoy.

title: Kielbasa Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa, cut into 12 slices | 16 ounces semi-sweet chocolate | 1 pound mangoes, seeded and diced | 1 cup chopped candied citron
instructions: Melt chocolate in a double boiler over hot water, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. When melted, remove from heat and stir into chocolate. Chop kielbasa into 12 bite sized pieces, and place in a medium bowl. In the same bowl, pour about 1 or 2 tablespoons of chocolate butter onto each piece of sausage and stir to coat. Spread the chocolate mixture over the kielbasa in a thin layer. Sprinkle mango on top and refrigerate until almost set, at least 30 minutes and up to 2 days.

title: Amber's Cauliflower (Vegetable) Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets | 4 ounces prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup sliced green chili pepper | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 quart fresh strawberries, sliced, drained to make 4 cups
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the cauliflower and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, or until bright green and just tender when pierced with a knife. Drain immediately, rinse with cold water, drain well, and cut off the ends. In a large mixing bowl, mix together the prosciutto, green chiles, vinegar, and salt and pepper. Stir in the cauliflower. Refrigerate for 1 hour, stirring occasionally, before serving as a salad or as a side dish.

title: Mini Tortilla Triangles
ingredients: 1 scallion | 1 green tomato | 1 lb puff pastry, for mini tortilla triangles | 1/2 cup coriander powder | 10 flour tortillas, 8 x 4 inches
instructions: Trim ends and ends off a tomatoes. Use a vegetable peeler and carefully remove the skin. Brush tomatoes with vegetable oil and then sprinkle with coriander. Grutomize the whole and then sprinkle over the tomatoes. Lay a pastry sheet on the counter and spread 1 1/4 cups flour on it. Dip tortillas one by one in the flour and place them on the flour to make 12 little cakes. Place on a tray/pitlet on the tray/pitlet. Bake at 375°f for 45 minutes they will be puffed up and golden and very crisp. Leave to cool. The tortillas can be eaten immediately or wrapped in foil like a burrito, or just stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 2 - 5 days. The leftover filling can be stored in the freezer for up to 2 months. To prepare the mini tortilla triangles place approximately 4 mini tortillas on a tray/pitlet and spread with approximately 1/4 cup filling. Place on a tray/pitlet and stack them onto the tray/pitlet and stack together with the rest of the filling mixture and then roll each triangle in some coriander powder and serve.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,bulgur wheat,hoagie,ketchup,cayenne,vegetable broth,milk powder
title: Vegetarian Times of the Week Greek Bulgur Sandwich
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups vegetable broth ( i used homemade ) | 1 cup bulgur wheat | 1 tablespoon low-fat milk powder | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | four six-inch hoagie rolls
instructions: In a small saucepan, bring the broth to a boil with the bulgur. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 3 minutes. In a small bowl, combine the milk powder and ketchup. Set aside. Brush the top half of each roll with some of the milk powder mixture. Place the bottom halves on your cutting board and cut into quarters. This should yield about 4 tablespoons of filling. Spread half of the wheat bulgur mixture on each bottom section of the roll. Divide the filling among the four rolls, then top with the top half of the roll and press together to compact. Press a second piece of plastic wrap over the top and bottom and then the top of the roll to make the sandwich. Place sandwiches in freezer for at least 1 hour or up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,celery salt,chicken breast fillet,cheddar cheese,baking soda
title: Chicken Cheddar Pesto Bake
ingredients: 4 ounces cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 4 whole chicken breast fillets ( cooked & butterflied ) | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Mix cheese with chicken. Heat oven to 400°f. Combine remaining ingrediants except chicken in a bowl. Pour into shallow casserole dish. Top with chicken mixture. Cover & bake at 400°f for 20 mins or until cooked through.

title: Swiss Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles | 3 tablespoons bacon bits, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup chopped lettuce
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the egg noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the egg noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Heat a wok over medium high heat. Stir the bacon bits, smoked paprika, and walnuts into the hot wok. Cook and stir until bacon bits have turned a light tan color, about 2 minutes. Spread noodles out in the wok and sprinkle with swiss cheese. Top with lettuce and serve.

title: Sauteed Shiitake Mushrooms  (Adults Only)
ingredients: 6 dried shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | peanut oil
instructions: Punch down and remove stems. Place mushrooms in a medium bowl and sprinkle on italian seasoning. Toss to combine. Heat a wok over medium high heat add a couple of teaspoons of peanut oil and bring to high heat. Remove from heat and add mushrooms. Stir until hot throughout, remove. Repeat until done. Remove excess oil by stirring so it doesn't burn.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,italian salad dressing mix,rosemary sprig,goat cheese
title: Easy Maple and Goat Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 package dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 2 ounces goat cheese | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | fresh rosemary sprigs
instructions: For best flavor, allow the soup to cool to room temperature prior to preparing to use. For best results, allow soup to cool completely before storing in an airtight container at room temperature, or store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. This soup is best made just before serving. In a double boiler, heat the soup on low to medium heat until smooth, about 1 minute.

title: Frijoles Borrachos (Pinto Beans)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds dried pinto beans | 6 anchovy paste | 1/4 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped celery
instructions: Cover beans with water and soak 8 hours or overnight. Drain. Place in a large pot and sprinkle anchovy paste, parsley and celery over. Cover and simmer for about 1 hour, until beans are tender.

Random Ingredients: beet,gingerroot,chocolate ice cream,yellow squash,mascarpone,new mexico chile,green chile pepper,chili pepper
title: Chile Gratin
ingredients: 3/4 cup mascarpone | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate candies ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot | 2 fresh chili peppers ( seeded and chopped ) | 1 fresh hot green chile pepper ( seeded and chopped ) | 1 small fresh hot chili pepper ( seeded and chopped ) | 1 small yellow squash | 2 small beets | 3 cups sweet mexican-style chile pickle soup ( drained )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f & coat a shallow baking pan with cooking spray. In a bowl stir together mascarpone, chocolate candies, ginger, chiles, green & hot pepper. Cover and chill until firm, at least 3 hours. Trim the beets & cut into thin rounds, then transfer them to a baking pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Top each beet with 2 pickle soup spoonfuls of the tomato mixture & place beets in each of the bowls. Bake until bubbly, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven & serve with salsa.

title: Chipotle Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced chipotle chile | 1 cup beef, cooked | 1 1/2 cups fresh broccoli florets
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine chilies, beef, and 1 tablespoon water. Spray a medium skillet with cooking spray, and heat over medium heat until hot. Serve beef mixture on top of broccoli.

title: Turnip Greens & Mushroom Surprise
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 300 g turnip greens, washed, dried and coarsely chopped | 250 g cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | rocket, to serve
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of corn syrup into a small heavy based saucepan over low heat until bubbles rise. Add the turnip greens and stir for 2 minutes until softened. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of corn syrup. Cook, stirring, over medium heat for 2 minutes until the turnip greens begin to soften. Stir through mushrooms. Cover and cook over low heat for about 15 minutes or until the turnip greens and mushrooms are tender. Serve scattered with rocket.

title: Watermelon Snow Peas With Rose Ice
ingredients: 3/4 cup watermelon, finely diced | 3/4 cup snow peas, ends trimmed | 3/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1 tablespoon zesty italian seasoning ( i use zesty lemon seasoning for this, but zesty greek seasoning will do ) | crushed ice | 4 fluid ounces double cream
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the cream in a bowl and mix until well combined. Place a tall glass with ice in the freezer for at least two hours, or even overnight, this will give the ice a little texture but will keep it from melting.. After two hours, scrape out ice into the snow peas, stirring to scrape any chunks of water. Add cream, stir briefly, and serve.

title: Strawy Rice for One With Variations
ingredients: 1 bunch loose fresh spinach or 1 bunch frozen chopped spinach | 1 cup cooked rice | 1 ear of corn, husked and cut into 2 inch wedges ( or fresh straw mushrooms, if you prefer )
instructions: Prepare all ingredients before cooking. Set aside. Cook rice according to directions. Toss the hot rice with vegetables and serve.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,couscous,thyme sprig,plum tomato,dark sesame oil
title: Vegetable Confetti
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 6 small fresh thyme sprigs | 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh plum tomato | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 lb fresh shiitake mushroom, halved crosswise
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Bring 2 cups of warm water to a boil in a large bowl.

title: Tara's Easy Tomato 'n Bean Sprout Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon milk | 6 tomatoes, cut in wedges | 1 1/2 cups bean sprouts | 2 maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Stir the milk into the tomato wedges, and add them to a salad bowl. Scatter the bean sprouts on top of the tomato mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dried peas | 1/2 cup peanut butter
instructions: Add peas, peanut butter and heat on stove until boiling. Serve.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,basil,flat leaf parsley,bean thread noodle,serrano chilies,cream chicken soup,white pepper
title: Cauliflower Noodles with Basil
ingredients: 3 heads cauliflower, cored and cut into small florets | 2 serrano chilies, minced | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 cups light cream or fat free sour cream | 2 tablespoons dry basil or 2 tablespoons fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper or 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil, allowing at least 2 inches of excess foil to extend over sides of oven. Place the heads of cauliflower in a baking pan large enough to hold them in a single layer and drizzle with olive oil to lightly coat. Roast until crisp tender, about 45 to 55 minutes. Remove from the oven. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chiles and cook, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until fragrant and beginning to brown, about 1 minute. Remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to a bowl. When cool enough to handle, chop coarsely. Return the skillet to the stove and add the soup and simmer until warmed through, about 3 minutes. Transfer the soup to a blender, add the cream and puree 3/4 of this mixture. Return to hot sauce and reheat. Ladle soup into ovenproof bowls, top each with cauliflower, and sprinkle with basil, red wine, and parsley. Cook in oven until bubbly and warmed through, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,lemon pepper seasoning,liquid smoke,spanish onion,coriander,raisin,cumin powder
title: Baked Onions
ingredients: 3 lbs thinly sliced spanish onions | 1/2 cup water ( reserved after cooking onions for 10-15 minutes ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons spanish smoked lemon pepper seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry parsley or 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 3/4 1 1/2 tablespoons raisins or 3/4 cup sultana, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line a 9 inch circle or jelly roll pan with foil. Place onions in a large bowl and place pan on rack in oven. Bake 20 minutes or until onions are slightly softened but not brown. Remove pan from oven and cool onions 15 minutes. Place onions in a bowl and add remaining ingredients mixing well. Drain liquid from onion and add onions to onions, mixing thoroughly. Spread mixture in prepared pan and bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes or until edges are crispy and onions are tender and golden.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,kosher salt,thai basil,nonfat milk powder,quinoa
title: Thai Basil Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup green whole-leaf thai basil ( can use regular basil leaves ) | 1 cup quinoa, dried | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup, bottled roasted, preferred flavour | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Bring 2 1/2 to 3 - 3 pints of water to boil over high heat. Add quinoa. Boil for one minute. Pour into mixing bowl and let cool. Transfer to bowl of your choice, cover and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours. Transfer quinoa to small bowl. Mix all ingredients together in bowl, serve.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,extra virgin olive oil,potato starch
title: Oatmeal Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking rolled oats | 2 2/3 teaspoons potato starch | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix rolled oats, potato starch and olive with a fork. Shape potatoes into 4 balls. Bake for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,chocolate syrup,rice wine vinegar,puff pastry,lemon juice zest
title: Luxury Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed ( half a 17 x 11 x 1/4 cupcake ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 lemon, juice and zest of ( finely grated zest of 1 lemon ) | 3 ounces button mushrooms | chocolate syrup
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f roll the pastry out on a well floured board, then cut the dough and place it on a floured baking tray. Trim away any excess pastry and cut a cross into the base and sides of each mushroom, making sure it stands straights up close. Place the mushrooms onto the pastry base, then top the mushrooms with a dollop of chocolate syrup. Place the tray, seam side down, in the oven for 15 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown. Remove from the oven and leave to cool in the oven for 10 minutes or until warm. Slice into 12 rounds, then top each one with a tablespoon of chopped bittersweet chocolate and serve hot, with whipped cream. Chef's notes, i took a picture with how this dish turned out. I didn't bake the pastry for the 15 minutes or when the pastry had puffed up really. I didn't have a pastry brush so i used a fork, which, while well, allowed me to get the pastry to stick to the pan. I didn't cut it until i had used the chinese peanut butter.

Random Ingredients: ice,white wine,red bell pepper,poblano pepper,thyme leaf,cumin seed
title: Mexican Red Pepper Dip
ingredients: 2 cups chopped red bell peppers | 2 fresh poblano peppers, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 ounces ice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Cover and process on high for 30 seconds to 1 minute. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Indian Fried Mushrooms
ingredients: 10 button mushrooms | 2 1/2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Wash mushrooms with a wet cloth. Keep dry on kitchen paper towel and trim off the ends. Put 1 1/2 tbsp of ginger and 1 bay leaf in the center of each mushroom. Fill mushroom with fried mushrooms. Heat a non stick wok on high heat. When hot, put oil in it. When oil is ready, throw in the mushrooms. Stir fry mushrooms over high heat for 2 minutes. When water is getting in the wok, flip mushrooms over gently. Cook for about 15 minutes on medium heat. When it is tender, the wok will feel quite warm if you had closed the lid. Remove from heat and garnish with some freshly chopped coriander. Serve hot with indian breads.

title: Peach-Pork Chops with Peach Apples
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 1 peach, peeled, cored and sliced into 1 `` slices
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Place pork chops on a broiler pan, and place 4 peach slices on each chop. Broil under the preheated broiler until the pork firms, and the peach slices can be toasted briefly.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,red bell pepper,red table wine
title: Red Wine Roasted Pepper and Pineapple
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, trimmed and seeded | 2 cans pineapple chunks, drained | 2 cans or bottles red table wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Wrap the outside of the bell pepper with aluminum foil. Roast in the preheated oven until a deep chest has firmed and is charred all over, about 1 hour. Remove the bell pepper from the oven, and place in a resealable plastic bag. Place the drained pineapple chunks into the pan, and add the red wine. Squeeze out any excess air, and throw away any leftover skin. Place the mixture in a roasting pan, and place in the preheated oven. Roast in the preheated oven, turning once, until all the juices in the bottom of the pan have evaporated, but the peppers are still slightly moist, about 1 hour. Remove from oven, and let cool to warm, about 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Powdered Rum
ingredients: 2 lbs coriander roots or 2 lbs cilanto root ( root ends ) | 1/2 cup grand marnier, preferably unfiltered | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice or 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Pierce roots with a sharp knife and place them in a large pot. Add water, cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Skim off any scum that rises to the top. Reduce heat to very low and simmer for 1 hour. Remove roots and roots. Keep warm, covered by a cloth over a pan of hot water. Combine rum and spices and stir well. Remove roots and discard. Place roots and spices, stirring well, in a shallow serving bowl or bottle. Allow to cool. Cover and store indefinitely. Strain rum before making. The rum can also be stored in a sealed container for up to one week.

Random Ingredients: white turkey meat,lemon grass,pecorino romano cheese,apple juice,jicama,shell pasta,sage,corn chip
title: Turkey Cranberry Chowder
ingredients: 4 cups finely chopped white turkey meat | 1/4 cup chopped peeled, cored apple ( about 1 medium ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh lemon grass | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage | 1 cup small shell pasta, such as ditalini ( about 12 ounces ) or 1 cup other small shell pasta | 1 1/2 cups small jicama, peeled ( about 4 ounces ) | 1/2 cup finely shredded pecorino romano cheese | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups reduced-sodium canned reduced-sodium turkey broth
instructions: Cover and chill meat. Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: black bean,liquid smoke,cumin,mexican cheese,romaine lettuce,turkey breast,iceberg lettuce,black eyed pea
title: Smokey Mexican Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 cups romaine lettuce, thinly shredded | 1 can black beans, rinsed & drained | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup black-eyed peas, rinsed & drained | 1/2 lb sweet turkey breast, diced | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1/4 1/4 cup lettuce or 1/4 cup coriander | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the romaine, black beans, and iceberg lettuce. Add turkey, onion, cheese, salt and pepper. Tear the herbs from the lettuce bowl with fork into the bowl. Add liquid smoke & toss well.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,arugula leaf,cranberry,tzatziki,panko breadcrumb,cinnamon sugar,salsa fresca
title: Easy Baked Chicken Taco Bowl
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cinnamon sugar | 2 containers prepared tzatziki | 2 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs, divided | 1 1/4 cups frozen cranberries, thawed | 6 cups cubed fully cooked, cooked chicken meat | 1/2 cup chopped fresh arugula leaves | 2 teaspoons grated cinnamon sugar | 2 1/2 cups prepared salsa fresca
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix 2 teaspoons cinnamon sugar and tzatziki.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,italian salad dressing,white pearl onion,wheat pastry flour,hot pepper sauce,merlot,chilies,water chestnut
title: Napa Dave's Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole wheat pastry flour | 1 1/3 cups merlot | 1/3 cup water chestnut | 2 large green pickled chilies, sliced | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing ( wildtree italian salad dressing ) | 1 package frozen white pearl onions, thawed, drained, and divided | 5 1/2 cups hot cooked rigatoni pasta, broken into 1 inch pieces | hot pepper sauce
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. In a small bowl, stir together flour and merlot and water. Set aside. Finely chop chiles, onions and half the spring onion. Set aside the rest of the spring onions. In a large bowl, place the drained pasta, shrimp, vegetables, and reserved spring onions. Add dressing mixture, blending well. Stir in reserved spring onions, reserving 1/4 cup garnish. Garnish with remaining reserved shrimp, chopped green onion, reserved spring onion, and hot pepper sauce.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,cucumber,sun tomato oil,green bell pepper,oil
title: Cucumber Lime Salad
ingredients: 2 cucumbers | 1 sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 green bell pepper | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1/4 teaspoon lime zest
instructions: Halve the cucumbers lengthwise. Remove the seeds using a melon baller. Cut cucumber into 6 wedges. Cut the wedges into chunks. Toss the wedges in a salad bowl with 1/4 cup of the sun dried tomato oil, the chopped sun dried tomato, and the lime zest. Garnish with the remaining sun dried tomato oil and the chopped green pepper.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,vegetarian bean,bell pepper,grain white rice,cumin
title: Cuban-Style Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup veggie beans, such as romano beans or 1/2 cup pinto beans | 3/4 cup long-grain white rice | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 3 tablespoons fresh lime wedges or 3 tablespoons lemon wedges | 1/2 medium bell pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Cook your rice according to pkg. Directions, using beans instead of pinto beans. Transfer rice to a large deep serving dish and season to taste, along with cumin and lime juice. Garnish with the bell pepper, cover dish tightly and set aside to marinate for 2 hours. Bring a small saucepan of water to a boil over high heat. Add the rice and cook, uncovered, for 4 - 5 minutes, until heated through, stirring. Serve immediately or allow to chill for up to 3 hours.

title: Simple and Easy Rice Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 500 g rice noodles ( short noodles, usually sold at asian asian food stores, usually sold whole ) or 500 g cellophane noodles, soaked in warm water for 10 minutes ( short noodles, usually sold at asian food stores, usually sold whole ) | 2 teaspoons yeast | 200 g dark chocolate, chopped roughly | 1 g nori ( seaweed )
instructions: Break the noodles into 2cm lengths, boil for 3 minutes, drain, and place into an ovenproof bowl, making sure there is space between each slice. Place the yeast on a plate, or in a paper towel, and use a large spoon to stir in the hot water until dissolved. Place the chocolate and vegetable oil in a small pan and melt together until smooth. Place half the cooled noodles onto top of the melted chocolate mixture. Top with remaining noodles, and spread evenly with a rubber spatula. Place under a preheated grill for about 45 - 45 minutes, until the noodles are tender. Remove from the grill, and sprinkle with a few more shakes of salt, and serve sprinkled with the melted chocolate. This is good with kimchee, sorbet or yoghurt.

title: Lemongrass Shellfish Casserole
ingredients: 24 uncooked jumbo pasta shells | 1 stalk lemongrass, pounded flat | 1 can or bottle white liquor
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine lemongrass, and bottle of white liquor in a large bowl. Rinse the oysters and shellfish shells in cold water. Place a 9x13 inch pan on the bottom of the preheated oven, and add about 1/2 cup of the oysters into the pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, until shellfish are white, but not burnt. Remove shellfish and place in a clean saucepan and cover with warm water. Cook over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes, until the seafood is opaque.

Random Ingredients: oregano,sherry wine,white wine vinegar,veal,red potato,mustard seed,apricot
title: Spiced Veal
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cut on diagonal into thin slices | 1/4 cup mustard seeds | 5 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 6 red potatoes, cubed ( i prefer red or white- ) | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 2/3 cup apricot, chopped
instructions: Place veal and mustard seeds in a large, heavy frypan with 1 tb of oil. Scatter over the sherry and vinegar and bake, uncovered in a moderate oven 3 hours or until veal is tender and sauce is slightly thickened. Add the potato pieces and oregano, stir and bake another 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat remaining mustard seed over moderately low heat in a dry frying pan. Add remaining oil and when it are hot add 1/2 t. Salt. When mustard seeds are a rich brown, crack on a wooden board and pop, cracker should sputter. When mustard seeds are a dark brown, cracker should sputter. When mustard seeds have darkened, spread them over a dry oven plate and roast, stirring occasionally, until the mustard seeds are light brown on both sides. When mustard seeds have turned dark, cracker should crack on both sides. To keep from spoiling, after about 1 hour, reduce heat under pan until only a light film remains. Spread mustard on a dry hot platter and sprinkle with oregano before serving. Top with roasted vegetables and chopped apricots.

title: Lime Gravy and Chicken Gravy (Tastefully Easy)
ingredients: 10 chicken bouillon | 1 limes wedge ( for flavor ) or 2 teaspoons lime juice ( for flavor )
instructions: Crush some lime or lemon juice in a mortar and pestle. Stir the dissolved bouillon into the lime or lemon juice. Slowly stir in chicken broth in a thin stream while whisking vigorously. Simmer gently until chicken is cooked though. Strain stock and discard the solids. Place about 1 cup hot stock/stock into a blender.

title: Welsh Aged and Bacon Tea
ingredients: 2 ounces smoked streaky bacon ( such as hormel ) | 1 ounce fresh chipped sage | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 2 ounces tea, hot | 2 tablespoons mirin ( dark orange cooking wine )
instructions: Cut the smoked streaky bacon into 1 inch slices and place in a heatproof bowl with the sage and lime juice. Add the tea and mirin.

title: Yogurt Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint sour cream, room temperature | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt, room temperature | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 teaspoon fennel, finely minced | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning ( dried ) | 3/4 cup low-fat cheese | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate until ready to serve. Use in place of any other dipping sauce ingredients.

title: Pickled Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 -2 anjou pears or 3 anjou pear
instructions: Clean and cut the cauliflower into large flowerets. Heat the grill, or a medium frying pan over high heat. Dry the cauliflower until it turns dark green and starts to crisp up slightly. It should be just barely tender when you break the blade of a knife. This step takes about 3 - 5 minutes depending on thickness of cauliflower. Add the pickled carrots. Cook over medium heat for about 3 minutes, stirring continuously. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. Store in airtight jars.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,anise seed,yellow squash,coriander seed,peanut oil
title: Cottage Cheese With Yellow Squash
ingredients: 4 yellow squash, sliced lengthwise | 1 cup cottage cheese ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Heat oil in a non stick pan. Fry crushed aniseed and coriander seeds until they turn golden. Add squash and fry for about 3 - 4 minutes, stirring once. Add cottage cheese if using. Lower the temperature and stir in papadum/cocoa powder mix well. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve.

title: Gobblets on Eggs
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 1 hard-boiled egg
instructions: Peel and cut squash in to small dice. Cook in boiling water for 15 minutes. Drain and run under cold water to cool, then rub through a fine mesh sieve. Cut egg into slices and set aside. Place a knob of butter on a large plate and scoop out the flesh from the flesh. Scoop the flesh and some of the flesh into a colander and drain the skin off. Rinse the squash and cut in half. Cook over gentle gentle heat, breaking up clumps with the back of a spoon, for about 10 - 15 minutes or until soft, but not mushy. Add the egg slices and mix well. Grate knob of butter and add to mixture. Melt remaining butter in a nonstick frying pan, or heat a griddle. When very hot, add the egg and cook until just set and golden – it will take about 3 - 5 minutes if it starts to colour on the bottom. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,lemon juice,italian breadcrumb,onion soup mix,lettuce,pecan half,rump steak
title: Beef Burgers with Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/2 cup italian breadcrumbs | 1 package onion soup mix | 1/2 cup ground pecan halves | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 lb lean rump steak | 6 lettuce or 6 spinach leaves, washed | 1/4 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed
instructions: In shallow dish, combine breadcrumbs, soup mix, pecans and lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: coffee,nutmeg,flat leaf parsley,pork shoulder,white corn tortilla
title: Coffee-Stuffed Wraps
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cans white corn tortillas, drained | 2/3 cup strong brewed coffee, warmed | 1/4 bunch fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 pinch ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place pork in a large mixing bowl. Stir in beef tortillas, and 1/3 cup brewed coffee. Season with parsley, nutmeg, and a touch of salt and pepper. Spread stuffing over each tortilla and fold closed. Seal each roll with toothpicks. Place wrap, seam sides down, in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and pour remaining coffee over the wrap. Cover pan with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for about 1 hour, until meat is tender and stuffing is very hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,orange juice concentrate,cajun seasoning,vanilla sugar,coconut extract,egg white
title: Coconut Macaroon Breadsticks
ingredients: 2 boxes egg whites | 1 can organic tomato puree | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f / 160c. Whip egg whites to stiff peak stage. In a separate bowl, beat egg whites to stiff glossy. Gradually add remaining ingredients to the egg whites and mix well. Grease baking sheet. On a lightly floured surface, roll out 1/4 of the dough to fit into a 4 x 7 inch rectangle. Using a 2 - 3 inch pastry cutter, cut out a hole in the centre of the dough. Pour the 2 tbsp of egg whites into the hole in the dough. Tuck the dough in together and pinch. Cut the dough into 2 equal sized pieces. Roll out dough again to create two 4 x 6 inches rectangles, each slightly larger than the other. Repeat making two more breadsticks. Place the baking sheets onto a greased tray. Poke holes in each breadstick every 2 inches. Brush with a little egg wash, sprinkle with coconut, and bake for 50 - 60 minutes in the centre of the oven, stirring occasionally, until crispy and golden on top.

title: Edamame Beetroot
ingredients: 1 cup shelled edamame ( shelled ) | 200 g boiled pearl onions | spice | 1 pinch baking soda | 1 pinch mixed spice
instructions: Add baking soda to water. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Pour into baking tin. Bake at 160 deg c for 30 mins or until cooked. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: green peppercorn,habanero pepper,currant,romaine lettuce,vanilla pudding mix
title: Mexican Green Peppercorn Salad
ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding mix ( 2 boxes ) | 1/2 cup fresh green peppercorn ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon currants or 1 tablespoon raisins | 1 small habanero pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 romaine lettuce ( or other favorite salad green )
instructions: Prepare the vialone cheese package according to directions. To serve, put the pudding mix, peppercorns and currants into a mixing glass bowl. Add the habanero and let it get warm. Add the vialone and gently mix using a rubber spatula on low. When the cheese is melted and serving, divide the salad onto small plates and spread with vielas. Garnish with green olives.

title: Fettuccine Bombay (Pasta Curry)
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine pasta | 1/4 cup margarine | ground fresh black pepper | 2 cans of rotel-brand black olives, drained and chopped, with juice | 3 1/2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Brown the fettuccine in a dutch oven, over medium heat with olive oil, about 3 minutes. Add the curry powder, stir, allow some to burn, and then stir in the fettuccine with a large spoon. You may need to turn the heat down slightly as the spaghetti tends to stick.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,green food coloring,ginger garlic paste,apple
title: Yummy Apples
ingredients: 8 small apples | 3 green peppers, cut in long thin strips | green food coloring ( optional ) | ginger-garlic paste or ginger-garlic sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Grate the apples into tiny pieces. Remove the skin and seeds from the green peppers. Cut the green peppers into thin strips. Heat a frying pan and add some ghee. Add some green food coloring and then add a few gingersi paste or garlic sauce. Once it starts turning brown, sprinkle some food coloring if required. After a minute, add the red peppers. Cook for a few minutes on low heat. Once they turn color darker, take it off the stove. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,beef tenderloin,picante sauce,red kidney bean
title: Beef Tenderloin With Beans and Vegetables
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed of fat and tied | 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 package chopped broccoli florets
instructions: In large saucepan, cook beef in saucepan of boiling water 12 to 15 minutes or until meat is browned on all sides. Transfer meat to plate. Remove all but 3 tablespoons of fat from saucepan.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,cabbage,couscous,margarine,beef sirloin steak,parmigiano reggiano cheese,nonfat cream
title: Steak and Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 1 cup couscous | 1 1/2 cups chopped cabbage | 2/3 cup fat free parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 - 1 1/2 cup low-fat prepared pizza sauce | 1/3 cup nonfat sour cream
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced sirloin with the couscous, cheese, and 1/3 cup of the pizza sauce. Set aside. Meanwhile, in another bowl, combine the remaining pizza sauce and sour cream. Gently stir the sour cream into the couscous and beef mixture mixture until well combined and sauce is bubbling. Serve topped with reserved cheese and chopped fresh basil.

title: Simple Italian Sausage and Rice #RSC
ingredients: 4 italian sausages | 1 cup whole grain rice | 4 ounces smoked sweet italian sausage ( about 1 cup ) | 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 cup molasses
instructions: Wash and pat dry the sausage. Cut the sausage into slices 3 inches long. Cut the mushrooms into very thin slices and add them to a medium size pot. Add the sausages and place over medium/medium low heat, with a spoon not much more than 1/4 inch deep, being careful the sausages will spit on the spoon. Turn a gas grill to medium, or light charcoal or a gas stove. Let the sausages and sausage smoke for about 30 minutes. The mushrooms shrink a bit, and you may find they get spicier by the time the sausages are cooked. Let the sausages rest for 10 minutes, then remove them from the pot. Add molasses and mushrooms to the pot of sausage. It needs at least an hour, to let the juices blend to create a sticky consistency. Serve over white or brown rice and enjoy a bit of the flavor is subtle and delicious with a bit of italian flavor. If you can't wait for this to go, you can make a loaf and serve it with a side.

title: Grilled Kale (Ww)
ingredients: 200 g kale ( small leaves, about 1/2 '' in diameter ) | 350 g bamboo shoots ( canned or raw ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Tilt your oven on maximum/95% for high heat. Wash the kale. Break into large florets, then remove tough outer leaves with tweezers. Remove the stalks with the tough ribs and leaves by using kitchen scissors or a knife. Tear off the coarse outer leaves, and wash thoroughly in several changes of cold water. Wash, then boil for 10 minutes under no circumstances allow water to boil. When the water is boiling remove from heat, and allow to cool. Break the bamboo into chunks and soak in cold water for 20 minutes. Toss the kale with the maple syrup to coat. Heat a griddle pan until very hot, or use a grill to indirect heat the kale. Cook the kale for five minutes, or until wilted. Add the bamboo and fry for a further 5–6 minutes, or until the color changes. Toss in the caster sugar to caramelise the sugar. Continue to toss. Serve warm.

title: Baked Gumbo
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh okra | 1/2 pound crawfish tails, peeled and cubed | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 8 cups all-purpose flour, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook okra in boiling water until tender, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: corn muffin mix,kidney bean,caster sugar,ice cream
title: Canned Kidney Bean Tarts
ingredients: 310 g corn muffin mix | 310 g kidney beans, drained | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 3/4 cup ice cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Grease 12 hole 2cm tart pans. Mix together muffin mix, kidney beans and caster sugar. Add ice cream to the dry ingredients and stir until well mixed. Spoon mixture into prepared dishes and bake for 20 minutes or until firm. Cool in trays for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire racks to cool.

title: African Eggland (South Africa)
ingredients: 2 eggs | 2 ounces amarula cream liqueur
instructions: Separate egg whites from yolks. In double boiler or double crepepan over low heat mix the yolks with the amarula cream liqueur, stirring constantly. Cook over low heat, stirring frequently until thick like soft scrambled eggs and the amarula leaves are no longer translucent. Pour the egg yolk mixture into the double boiler, and let stand about 5 minutes. Pour into the bowl with the egg whites and gently fold. The egg whites will stay mostly in the yolk mixture.

title: Noodles
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta and return to the pot. Stir in mirin.

title: Tarragon and Parsley Roasted Red Bell Pepper
ingredients: 1 red pepper | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f split the pepper and remove the seeds and membrane. Mix the herbs together. Drizzle over the roasted red peppers. Put the roasted peppers on a large roasting tray and bake on the middle rack of the oven for 20 minutes.

title: Raspberry & Cream Rascals
ingredients: 1 can frozen raspberries | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon sweet white wine | 1 ear fresh corn kernels, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Place raspberries in a food processor or blender, blend until smooth.

title: Christmas Crisp!
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated pizza crust | 1 can pizza sauce ( any brand or homemade ) | 1/2 cup crumbled dried cranberries ( packed -optional ) | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring, for a little color on pizzas
instructions: Preheat pizza stone on lowest setting. Stretch or roll a regular bread ball sized dough ball out onto your pizza stone into a circle or rectangle shape. Spread pizza base evenly with your favourite sauce, i use kraft cranberry red sauce. Top with crumbled cranberries. Sprinkle worcestershire sauce on top of cranberries. Cut bread into slices to entertain younger children, or if using a snack dish, dip slices in sauce and fry individually until crispy. Serve with additional sauce.

title: Quick Snow Pea and Snow Chips
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh snow peas or 3/4 lb frozen snow peas, thawed | 8 -10 corn tortillas, cut into strips about 4 in long | brown gravy mix
instructions: Place snow peas and tortillas on a platter.

title: Simple, Delicious and Easy Chocolate Instant Recipes.
ingredients: 0.5 package chocolate | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 lime ( grated rind )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a pot and heat. If you need to wait longer, you can use two large microwavable cups for this. It will be much easier to use. Stir as it simmers for about 10 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Plantains & Shredded Red Bliss
ingredients: 1 lb plaited plantain, peeled | 2 1/2 cups rotini pasta, cooked | 1 teaspoon chili powder | flour, for dusting
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling salted water, cook plantains for 8 minutes or until tender but still firm. Drain. Cut plantains into 1/2 inch strips. In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, chili powder, and flour.

Random Ingredients: catsup,walnut half,baby bok choy,yeast,coconut cream,pecan,white bean
title: White Bean and Walnut Bread
ingredients: 1 cup raw walnuts ( not unsalted or unsalted ) | 2 cans white beans ( undrained and rinsed ) | 1 package dry yeast | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup coconut cream ( can use reduced fat or fat free ) | 2 1/2 cups baby bok choy | chopped pecans ( toasted as desired ) or dried fruit, toasting ( toasted as desired )
instructions: Grease a loaf pan with oil. If using unsalted or unsalted walnuts, place them in a small saucepan on medium heat. Toast, nuts and yeast in the microwave uncovered for 6 - 7 minutes to soften them. Add undrained, rinsed white beans, catsup, milk and 1 cup of water to bread machine. Select sweet bread setting. Add remaining 1/2 cup water and/or coconut cream to bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Turn bread on dough setting. Once cycle is complete, remove dough to a lightly floured surface and divide into 8 loaves. Place one loaf on a lightly greased baking pan, covering the other with plastic wrap. With scissors, cut off top of the loaf and discard. Carefully, trim crust of loaf if necessary and place on a cookie sheet. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, 20 minutes to about 75 - 80 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350°f. Remove remaining loaf from the loaf pan. Press seams and top and bottom of loaf with reserved bread crust. Using a serrated knife, cut loaf into 1 1/4 inch slices, then crosswise to form half moon shaped pieces. Place bread, cut side up, in the center of a large baking pan. With scissors or razor blade, create small holes in the bread for steam to escape. Bake bread in preheated oven for 40 - 45 minutes, or until tester inserted in center of loaf comes out clean. Remove bread from oven and transfer to serving platter. Surround bread with baby bok choy and sprinkle lightly with chopped pecans or dried fruit. Serve warm.

title: Roast Beef on a Hawaiian Roll
ingredients: 4 ounces cream cheese | 8 slices swiss cheese | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1 jar chopped sirloin tip roast | 1/4 cup brandy sauce or 1/4 cup whiskey
instructions: Spread cream cheese on top of each slice of swiss cheese. Place 1/4 of the walnuts on top of each slice of beef to within 1 or 2 inches of the edge. Cover with second swiss cheese slice, pressing to seal. Roll beef up jelly roll fashion. Place roll on a foil lined baking pan. Brush with brandy or whiskey and sprinkle with remaining nuts on top. Cover. Broil on high heat for approximately 5 minutes. Serve with a fruit salad.

Random Ingredients: pasilla pepper,whipping cream,dark chocolate,self raising flour
title: Chocolate & Pasilla Peppers & Cream Scrolls
ingredients: 4 dried pasilla peppers | 2 cups self raising flour | 7 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted & cooled | 1/2 cup whipping cream, whipped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c, 425f, gas mark line a baking tray with baking paper & place the peppers on it. Place the tray on oven rack & leave to sweat for 15 minutes. Turn the peppers over & place in a bowl of water, sit for 30 minues while making the ‘bowls’. Once the peppers have cool enough to handle slice off a thin strip about 1 cm wide & place it in a bowl of warm water, mix & set aside. Place the flour in a bowl, slowly whisk in the chocolate & cream. Once the flour has mixed into the mixture add the peppers & mix with a large flat bladed knife until the dough forms an even, pliable ball. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface & knead lightly by hand until smooth. Place the dough on the baking tray & flatten out in the palm of your hand until it is about 6 - 8 mm thick. Brush with melted chocolate & sprinkle on the dried pepper mixture. Bake in a moderate oven for 8 mins, or until the tops are firm to the touch & the tops lightly coloured. Remove from the oven & leave to cool to room temp, then cut into quarters.

title: Mock Beef Grits
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless beef chuck | 5 cups dry grits | 5 cups frozen, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place chuck into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven, 40 minutes to 1 hour. Combine the grits and water in a large pot. Cook, stirring frequently, until thickened, about 20 minutes. Spread grits over the top. Spread a thick layer of grits over the grits. Continue to bake until the grits are crispy to the tooth, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: milk powder,kielbasa,cardamom seed,fish,apple juice concentrate,olive oil,thai red curry paste,red chili pepper
title: Red Apple Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 onion, sliced | 1 tablespoon jamaican red curry paste | 500 g chopped steamed fish | 1 cup skim milk powder | 1/4 cup apple juice concentrate | 3 whole cardamom seeds | 1 small hot red chili pepper
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok over medium high heat. Add the onion and jamaican curry paste and cook stirring for 2 minutes or until onion is fragrant. Add the fish, milk powder and apple juice concentrate and bring to the boil. Reduce heat, partially cover the pan and simmer for 8 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in whole spices. Serve with boiled rice.

title: Easy Guacamole Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve with chips.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,phyllo pastry,crescent dinner,tabasco sauce,oatmeal,chili powder,black olive,mandarin orange
title: Chili Pastries (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 bag shredded oatmeal ( optional ) | 8 ounces small shell pasta | 1 package frozen crescent dinner rolls | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained reserving any juice | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 12 black olives, sliced thinly | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Cook oatmeal as directed on package and set aside. Drain pasta and set aside. Preheat oven to 375°f. Drain oranges reserving any juice. Cut dough into 8 pieces and roll each piece out into a thin rectangle. Spread 1 tablespoon of olive oil on each rectangle and spread with 1/8 teaspoon of tabasco. Place 1/8 teaspoon of chili powder on each strip, followed by 1/8 teaspoon of oatmeal, 1 tablespoon of mandarin orange juice, and 1/8 teaspoon sliced black olives. Roll each rectangle up starting on the long side, pressing and separating as necessary to seal. Spread 1/8 teaspoon of olive oil and chili powder onto each roll, place each roll on a cookie sheet and brush with remaining olive oil. Repeat with remaining rolls, olive oil and chili powder and zap in another skillet. Bake 25 - 30 minutes, or until golden and crisp. Remove toothpicks from rolls and serve warm.

title: Siniah's Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 ounces channa dal, rinsed and drained | 2 ounces bacon | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f put the chana dal and bacon into a roasting tin. Sprinkle over the chilli pepper. Put into the oven and bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,beef stew meat,beef chuck roast,orange zest,malt vinegar,eggplant,orange
title: Grilled Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 5 lbs beef chuck roast | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 6 large eggplants | 6 scotch bonnet peppers | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice
instructions: Prepare oat brine, put 3/4 cup hickory chips in a baking dish or bowl and coat with about 2 t. Cornstarch and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover with saran wrap and refrigerate overnight, for best results. Cut the beef into 1 1/2 to 2 inch chunks, removing the fat that stains. Place the beef chunks under cold running water and let stand for 2 hours, then drain and rinse. Cut off ends, then slice into bite sized chunks. Set meat, eggplant, scotch bonnet peppers, and 3/4 cup of reserved hickory chips aside. Drain the meat, reserving the marinade. Discard the liquid from the beef chunks. Grill the vegetables in a skillet for about 5 minutes covered with the reserved hickory chips. Meanwhile bring the reserved marinade to a boil in a heavy bottomed pot. Add the pork and cook over moderate heat, stirring, for another 5 minutes. Add the meat pieces and eggplant to the broth in the skillet, cover and cook until the meat is tender about 2 hours. To serve, ladle stew into shallow soup bowls and top with the reserved chip slices. Serve topped with a dollop of orange juice.

Random Ingredients: mustard,lettuce leaf,cream mushroom soup,beer,sharp cheddar cheese,ham,grape tomato
title: Ham and Cheese Rollups
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 cups shredded lettuce leaves | 1/3 cup chopped mild cured ham | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup beer ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 cup grape tomatoes ( optional ) or 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, halved ( optional )
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, combine soup and lettuce. Stir in ham, cheese, beer, mustard and tomatoes if using. Spoon into 8x8 greased jelly roll pan. Cover and chill 8 hours. Remove from pan and slice diagonally, about 1/4 inch thick. Serve with remaining soup mixture spooned onto rolls if desired.

title: Vietnamese Peppers
ingredients: 2 yellow bell peppers, seeded if desired | 2 teaspoons caster sugar ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Cut peppers in half lengthwise. Remove stem ends to keep peppers intact. Arrange peppers in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle evenly with sugar, then pepper. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until peppers are golden, turning peppers over halfway through. Serve warm or store in airtight container in fridge.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,blueberry,superfine sugar,tomato,squid,italian parsley,poblano chile,baby spinach leaf
title: Squid-Stuffed Poblanos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed anise seed, crushed | 2 poblano chiles | 1 medium ripe tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 3 tablespoons superfine sugar | 3 ounces baby arugula leaves, washed | 6 ounces baby spinach, in loose | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 3 ounces fresh blueberries ( optional )
instructions: Place the anise seed and poblano chiles on a plate and cover with boiling water. When the skin pops, scrape off the black skin and remove the seeds. Peel them and discard, and, if desired, remove the skin and ribs. Cut the chiles in half lengthwise, removing the core and seeds but leaving the others intact. Remove the seeds from the chiles with a teaspoon, and cut a slit lengthwise down the side of each for a lid for easier filling. Stuff the chiles with some of the tomato and sugar, placing about 1 tablespoon of the spinach in the slit. Fill with a handful of baby arugula leaves, an ounceful of fresh Baby Spinach, and a tablespoon of chopped fresh italian parsley. Continue filling the peppers with the remaining stuffing. Top with any remaining tomato, an ounceful of chopped baby spinach and fresh green onions if using. Garnish with an additional bunch of chopped Italian parsley or parsley.

Random Ingredients: salt,vegetable stock,cream cheese,caper,beef,purpose white flour,mustard seed
title: Stuffed Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup all-purpose white flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons dry mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons capers | 6 ounces cream cheese | 1/2 cup vegetable stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook beef with salt and pepper over medium heat until no longer pink. Drain. Stir in flour, mustard seeds and capers. Beat together cream cheese, vegetable stock and milk until smooth. Add to beef mixture. Stir in to blend. Cook until thickened. Divide among rolls, spreading with a spatula. Bake 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,beef bouillon granule,coconut,cardamom seed,italian sausage,irish whiskey
title: Coconut Kielbasa (Curry)
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded sweetened coconut | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 4 ounces italian sausage | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 1/2 cup baby spinach
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place a baking sheet on a medium baking sheet, and set aside. Place the coconut, cardamom seed, and sausage in a dutch oven, and cook and stir until well browned. Drain most of the fat from the skillet, but leave enough to coat the back of a spoon. Place the cooked sausage into the bowl with the coconut mixture. Place the whiskey in the pan, and stir. Place the spinach and baby spinach in the pan with the sausage. Pour the whiskey mixture over the sausage mixture. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the mixture is heated through.

title: Italian Chicken Legs
ingredients: 1 red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 4 skinless chicken leg quarters | 1/2 cup marsala
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place the cabbage in a medium baking dish and top with 1/2 cup of water. Bake for 30 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender. Meanwhile, place the chicken on a plate and cover with aluminum foil. Remove the aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes. Turn the chicken and bake for 2 minutes, or until browned. Remove chicken from the oven, place in a bowl, and set aside. Brush a medium size saucepan with nonstick cooking spray. Add the marsala and the remaining 2/3 cup water and bring to a boil. Add the chicken breasts and return to the oven. Turn the heat to broil. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and put back in the oven. Place under the broiler and broil for about 5 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has reduced. Serve in shallow soup bowls with a side dish of garlic mashed potatoes, as an entree or on italian sandwiches.

title: Red Pepper Honey Curry Sauce
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 3 tablespoons liquid honey | 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk ( optional )
instructions: In a pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray, cook the bell peppers on medium high heat until the skin has blackened and crisped. Using a slotted spoon remove the bell peppers and place in a paper bag. Let sit for five minutes. Remove the peppers and transfer liquid and drippings onto a medium sized sauce pan. Stir in the curry paste and let simmer for 5 minutes. Pour in the honey and sweetened condensed milk and mix well. Use immediately or refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,white bean,lime juice,raspberry vinegar,olive oil,garlic powder,ladyfinger
title: Prawns With White Beans, Raspberry Vinegar and Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons olive oil, divided | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 skinless chicken breast halves, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness | 1 can white beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup baby-finger steamed prawns, shelled and chopped | 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lime juice
instructions: In a large frying pan, heat 1 teaspoons of the oil over high heat. Sprinkle the garlic powder evenly over the chicken breasts, and sear each for 5 minutes on each side, or until cooked through. Remove the chicken from the pan. In a medium saucepan, heat the remaining olive oil, then sauté the shrimp just until golden, then set aside. Pour the vinegar and remaining 2 teaspoons oil into the pan, then stir in the shrimp and beans. Bring to a boil, then put the lid on to bubble for 2 minutes while you cook the chicken. Drain the chicken, then toss in the prawns in a bowl. Add the prawns to the pan. Stir in the remaining dressing and lime juice, then cook for a few minutes over low heat until warm but not boiling.

title: Microwave White Wine Cornmeal Polenta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 1 1/4 cups white wine | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained
instructions: Cook on high uncovered for 8 minutes. In a 2 quart casserole dish with a lid, mix the cornmeal, wine and rice until well blended. Turn out onto a baking sheet. Spray the top of the polenta with non stick spray. Set aside 3 tablespoons of the cornmeal mix to sprinkle over the top of the polenta as a garnish. Repeat with the remaining mix. Let stand for 10 minutes. Microwave on high uncovered 1 - 2 minutes or until polenta begins to bubble on the bottom. Transfer polenta onto serving plate, scatter cornmeal on the top and serve.

title: Crunchy Seed Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1 teaspoon sunflower seeds | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded, chopped | 1 tablespoon julienned nori ( seaweed ) | 4 teaspoons chopped coriander leaves | 1 cup buttermilk
