instructions: In a small bowl, mix the soya sauce, sunflower seeds, jalapeno pepper and nori. Serve with dip.

title: Spanish Inspired Beef and Macaroni
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 large spanish onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 box elbow macaroni
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain and combine with the onion and olive oil. Heat to boiling and reduce to medium. Serve over cooked macaroni.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed oil,soy sauce,wheat bread crumb,mozzarella cheese,berry cranberry sauce
title: Crunchy Cranberry Kebab (Kebab)
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat bread crumbs | 15 ounces reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 1/2 cups whole berry cranberry sauce ( i used trader joe's famous cranberry and maple cranberry sauces ) | 4 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded | toasted sesame seed oil
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place first 3 ingredients in a bowl. Mix until well combined. Shape into 1 inch round balls. Place on cookie sheet. Sprinkle with salt. If desired, broil for approximately 18 - 20 minutes, turning once, until lightly browned and cooked through. Serve with your favourite toppings.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,icing sugar,flour tortilla,walnut oil,salt black pepper,pinto bean,red bell pepper,macaroni
title: Pasta Fritters With Pinto Beans and Walnuts
ingredients: 250 g pinto beans, soaked overnight and drained | 60 g red bell peppers, drained chopped | 60 g walnut oil | icing sugar, to sprinkle | salt and black pepper | 500 400g cooked macaroni | parmesan cheese, to sprinkle
instructions: Heat 1cm of the oil in a large non stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the chopped onions and cook for 1 minute, add the pinto beans and bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 3 minutes uncovered, stirring often. Add the red peppers and turn up the heat slightly, cooking for 30 seconds. While stirring you need to keep the beans as hot as possible. Remove from heat and leave to cool to room temperature. While the beans are cooking, preheat the oven to 150c/fan 160c/gas cook the pasta according to the packet instructions until al dente then drain the pasta well. Stir the beans with the walnut oil,icing sugar, salt and pepper into the pasta. Top with extra freshly grated parmesan and serve. Variation #1, make a double thickness of dough using half a large springform tin. Cut the dough into 6 slices roughly the size of the bottom third of the tin. Wet both ends of the piece of dough with boiling cold water.

title: The Perfect Aioli
ingredients: 4 tablespoons agar-agar | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Put agar agar on a clean cloth and gather the corners. Spread the agar agar in a small, dry, dry teaspoon on the cloth. Lightly press with damp hands so you have a firm, even surface to work with. Let sit on counter for 30 minutes. Rinse and dry agar agar. Cut into small, narrow strips, or use a sharp knife. If they have any shape, cut strips into 4 equal pieces. Store in an airtight container.

title: Strawberries and Vegemite
ingredients: 4 cups ripe strawberries | 1 packet vegemite | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed oregano
instructions: Place the strawberries on the counter top and using a sharp knife, cut away the thick central pit. Cut away the skin from the center and gently crush the flesh with a fork. Stir through the vegemite, parsley, oregano and any juices from the strawberries. Place the mixture in a bowl and leave to mature in fridge.

title: American Cheese Crisps
ingredients: 1/2 lb american cheese | 3/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: Slice the cheese into a crinkle sized pieces, like fries. Heat up the peanut oil until a bit of peanut oil oozes out of the mixture. Dip the cheese in the oil and fry on one side till browned. Add more oil if necessary. Serve immediately. Note, this recipe lends itself to two variations each, but i usually use either a combination of slices of fresh white and alderberry cheeses such as pea pods, grievenitz, or even blue cheese. This way, the americans may break apart into a slightly chunky paste.

title: Green Olive Soup
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 cups fresh dashi stock | 3 1/3 tablespoons cornflour | 1 cup chopped green olives ( pitted, about 5 ounces ) | 2 cups torn fresh mint leaves | kosher salt
instructions: If using the stock, add it gradually to the cornflour mixture in a small bowl, stirring often, to make a thick paste. Stir in the olives and mint leaves to taste. Pour into large saucepan, bring to a boil, and reduce to a simmer until the liquid thickens. Taste and add salt.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,amaretto,white bread,vegetable oil cooking spray,chickpea,red chili pepper,taco seasoning
title: Italian Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/4 cup kalamata olive ( sliced or coarsely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon cooking spray | 1 1/2 ounces taco seasoning or 1 1/2 ounces vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons amaretto, plus more for drizzling ( or more ) | 16 teaspoons white bread, loaf cut into 1/2-inch cubes | red chili pepper, slices ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place chickpeas, olives, oil, & taco seasoning in a food processor or blender and puree until smooth, adding amaretto if needed to make this vegetarian, or process in an electric blender again for a thicker vinaigrette.

title: French 77
ingredients: 1 ounce cooking sherry | 2 teaspoons creme de cacao
instructions: Shake all ingredients in shaker until thoroughly mixed. Strain into chilled glass.

Random Ingredients: roast beef gravy,worcestershire sauce,lime,xanthan gum,peach,oyster sauce,pizza sauce
title: Spiced Sweet Buns
ingredients: 350 g roast beef in gravy, diced small cubes | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce ( vegetarian ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon poppyseed oil or 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1/4 teaspoon xanthan gum | 125 g pizza sauce | 1 lemon, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: If using vegan worcestershire sauce, mix with oyster sauce, worcestershire sauce, xanthan gum and poppyseed. In a wok, heat oil and fry marinated meat until golden.

title: Apple Corn Chowder - 6 Points
ingredients: 2 corn tortillas or 2 flour tortillas | 1/2 cup diced red potato | 1 can mushroom pieces ( drained ) | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 4 large cooked apples ( i like skirt steak-cut into small chunks ) | 1 package cooked spaghetti ( we like our chowder noodles in a tube or oval shape, about 1 cup )
instructions: Cook tortillas on pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray or butter for 2 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Remove corn tortillas from pan and allow to cool. Meanwhile, add potato, mushrooms and spaghetti sauce in a medium size saucepan. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until potatoes and veggies are tender, about 10 minutes. Add apple and spaghetti mixture to pot, stir to combine. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pineapple Breadcrumb Balls
ingredients: 2 large pineapple ( with the skin, not the stems ) | 4 cups bread flour | 1/2 cup powdered grape, seedless grapes | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1 teaspoon dry red wine ( if using sherry omit the red wine )
instructions: Peel the pineapple, discard the core. Cut in half. Place in a bowl and cover with sherry. Allow to soak for 1 hour. Drain well. Strain the marinade into another bowl, discard the liquid. Add the walnuts, grapes, worcestershire and herbs. In a separate bowl mix the flour with powdered sugar, a small amount at a time, until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add enough of the reserved pineapple marinade to make a stiff dough, but still somewhat liquid. Take a bit of this dough and roll into balls, then press a small hole into the center. Place the balls between sheets of wax paper and flatten to the size you want them to be roughly the same size. Use a fork to poke holes in the bread crumb mixture all over. Place the bread crumb balls into a shallow pan, then cover with a tea towel. Let the bread crumbs cool. After the bread crumbs have cooled a bit, roll them again in powdered sugar. The sugar will cause the crumbs to glue together to form the balls. Place the crumbs in a plastic bag and store in the refrigerator. Note, you can prepare the balls the night before because they will be less chewy. To store, let the bread crumbs dry completely before adding to the finished product. After the water has gotten bubbly, remove it from the bag and place in your storage container. If using fresh pineapple, rinse well with boiling water then place in your freezer container or bag. You will know when they are done because they are frozen. You can freeze or refrigerate for up to 3 weeks.

title: Chicken Thighs in Coconut
ingredients: 4 chicken thigh fillets, skin scored | pepper, a generous sprinkling of | coconut | sugar or sea salt, to taste | chopped chicken breast ( optional ) | 6 broccoli florets, cut in florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 350°f. Dry or brush both sides with cooking oil. Place one thigh of chicken in the centre of each plate. Sprinkle with pepper. Sprinkle with shredded coconut, mix and scatter with sliced chicken. Place in the oven for 10 minutes, brushing frequently. Serve hot with green salad.

title: French-Style Snapper
ingredients: 1 tablespoon french dressing | 1 can red snapper, undrained | 1/4 cup italian-style shredded chicken
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir the fresé dressing, chopped red snapper and shredded chicken together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,canadian bacon,savory,white bean,butter bean,onion soup mix,onion salt
title: Baked Beans With Canadian Bacon (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs small white beans | 24 1/2 ounces condensed onion soup mix | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup butter beans | 1/3 cup canadian bacon | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in crock pot. Cover. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or high for 3 - 4 hours.

title: Crock Pot Swedish Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 lbs hamburger | 1 large parsnip, cut into medium chunks | 1 large carrot, chopped | 1 cup fresh raspberry or 1 cup other berries | 1 tablespoon vegetarian worcestershire sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil | 24 canned beets, drained | 1 jar sweet pickled cherries
instructions: Brown the hamburger until no longer pink. Drain the excess fat. Mix all ingredients. Transfer to crock pot. Cook all day on low setting, but no longer. Top with pickled cherries to serve.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,bell pepper,ginger powder,white bread flour,chicken meat
title: Italian Restaurant Chicken Cutlets
ingredients: 2 bell peppers | 2 italian plum tomatoes | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 teaspoon white bread flour | 1 lb chicken meat or 1 lb poultry, cut in pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut vegetables into bite size pieces. Heat up a deep fryer or large pot of water to boiling. Put chicken pieces into hot deep fryer or pot on top of the water and cook until chicken is white throughout.. Remove chicken pieces from water, drain, return water to stove and put skillet over high heat. Add italian spices. Stir chicken and spices into the water with the peppers and tomatoes.

title: Mexican Okra Stew
ingredients: 8 okra, thawed | 10 corn on the cob, cut in half, lengthwise | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1/4 cup orange zest | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon orange juice or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon chopped pistachios, toasted
instructions: Place okra in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover and cook okra until tender, 2 - 3 minutes. Meanwhile in 2 quart saucepan, mix remaining ingredients. Bring to boiling. Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until okra is tender. Drain okra.

title: Sauce Haskel For Two!
ingredients: 24 ounces picante sauce ( or salsa ) | 3 -4 tablespoons apple cider | 1 can french-fried onions
instructions: Pour picante sauce into mixing bowl. Add onions. Add cider and mix. You may add some garlic powder or pepper. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mango powder,grain rice,cayenne,egg wrap,rye bread,chicken breast,mango,chocolate
title: Mango Chicken Rollups
ingredients: 1 can chicken breasts, mashed | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon mango powder | 2 cups cooked long grain rice | 1/2 cup diced mango | 20 egg roll wraps | 1/3 cup chocolate pieces ( optional ) | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped mango ( optional ) | cooked long grain rice, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat your oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the mashed chicken, cayenne, and mango powder until well blended. Layer the chicken mixture in center of each rice wrapper, starting with the rice, mango, and chicken mixture. Wrap each roll with a piece of chocolate. Wrap with egg roll wrap, and place on a cookie sheet. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until they reach an internal temperature of 175 degrees f. Garnish with mangoes and serve with optional garnishes.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,lasagna noodle,molasses,apple juice,peanut,spring onion,madeira wine
title: Noodle-Lorraine Salad
ingredients: 250 g lasagna noodles | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh madeira wine | 5 -6 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 1 large garlic clove, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons molasses | 2 -3 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Meanwhile cook the noodles according to packet directions, drain& rinse in cold water. Drain completely& arrange in rows on a large serving plate, leaving a little excess space between each row. Mix together the remaining ingredients& pour over noodles, mix well& serve.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,plum tomato,ginger,coconut cream,self rising flour,bow tie pasta,creamy peanut butter,vinegar
title: Plum Tomato & Peanut Butter Dessert
ingredients: 300 g bow tie pasta ( we like red pasta so-called angel hair pasta ) | 250 g plum tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon fresh grated ginger | 150 ml thick coconut cream or 150 ml light coconut cream | 300 ml thickened cream or 300 ml thickened cream | 60 g sour cream | 1 tablespoon apple juice or 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Cook the bowtie pasta in boiling water until al dente. Drain and leave to cool. Put the plum tomatoes into a heatproof bowl. In a small saucepan, combine the peanut butter, vinegar, ginger & coconut cream. Cook over medium heat, stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbling. Cool slightly. Beat the cream or cream and apple juice into the saucepan, stirring until the mixture thickens slightly. Pour over the cooked pasta and combine well. Tip, be sure to check the seasoning before pouring into an attractive serving dish. Garnish with chopped parsley & serve.

Random Ingredients: white wine,chili oil,garlic powder,cranberry,rice flour,rice wine,iceberg lettuce
title: Cranberry Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 bunch green lettuce, outer leaves discarded | 1 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup rice flour | 1/4 cup rice cooking wine | 2 -3 tablespoons chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Scoop out portions of the stuffing into lettuce bowl. Serve in lettuce wraps.

title: Marinated Pepper Fries
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs peppadews pepper, with peppers | 3 ounces marjoram ( dried sage )
instructions: Wash the peppadews. Trim the stem end and remove the seeds. Cut in half lengthwise. Place the cut side down on clean dry, cloth lined counter top. Sprinkle with dried sage. Pack the pepper into the pat of pepper. Wrap tightly. Refrigerate.

title: Spanish White Beans With Parsley
ingredients: 1 bag fresh cannellini beans ( about 1 lb. in weight ) | 2 yellow peppers ( about 1lb. in weight ) | 2 small zucchini ( about 1lb. in weight ) | 2 tablespoons capers | lemon juice and zest of | capers, for garnish
instructions: Rinse beans of excess water.

title: Mustard Watercress Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces watercress, well packed, washed, stems chopped | 12 teaspoons coarse grain mustard
instructions: Place all ingredients in a lettuce jar or plastic bag, sprinkle mustard over top and serve chilled or covered with plastic wrap and refrigerate. Best served warm or at room temperature.

title: Gingery's Mild Spice Smoked Paprika
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root
instructions: Rinse the inside of a mixing bowl with cold water, and shake off the excess. Combine the paprika, ginger, and salt in a small bowl. Tightly pack the smoked paprika into a small, 2 to 8 inch long piece of foil or waxed paper or cellophane wrapper. Bring one end of the foil or waxed paper or cellophane wrapper up and over the bowl you placed the smoked paprika inches fold the ends of the dough together over the mixture one or two times. Smooth or crimp the top. If you've made a wet paprika too dry, you may need to repeat this step a handful at a time. Keep a wet piece of foil hanging over the bowl as you work, allowing excess paprika to drain off. The mixture will be very dry and tough, and you may need to use the remaining paprika to stick the spice on your hands as you work. Set a piece of aluminum foil to cover the bottom of your smoker, or a piece of waxed paper you had previously wrapped the casing in, so the moisture does not escape. Smoke about 7 to 10 briquettes of hot smoke in a preheated smoker, or for about 10 minutes. Remove the foil or paper from the bowl, drizzle the top with a generous drizzle of smoke flavored liqueur, and continue smoking until the liqueur is fragrant and the briquettes are crisp, about 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot, drizzled with rum, or as a side dish with other dishes.

title: Nuts and Bolts
ingredients: 1 gallon mint | 2 cups mixed spice
instructions: Put the mint leaves whole in a small container.

Random Ingredients: peach,spinach,sourdough bread,baking soda,anaheim chili,pesto sauce,anise seed
title: Mexican Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 lb spinach | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon crushed anise seed | 2/3 cup pesto sauce | 1 sweetened peach | 1 anaheim chili, chopped finely | 8 slices sourdough bread
instructions: Toast aniseed in skillet on medium heat for about 45 seconds and remove from heat. Grind aniseed to a pea size mixture in a spice grinder. Wash fresh spinach with cold water until clean, dry and finely chopped. Toast aniseed, adding aniseed mixture and nuts as desired. Cut peeled sweet peas into thin slice and add slices to spinach mixture. Mix well. Chop chopped aniseed very finely in a mortar and pestle. Mix thoroughly. Place salad onto plates, drizzle with prepared pesto and garnish with aniseed pea slices.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,lemon zest,pecan,apple,button mushroom,serrano chilies
title: Wedding Apple Mushroom Balls
ingredients: 3 large apples, peeled, cored and grated | 4 large fresh button mushrooms, stemmed and thinly sliced | 2 serrano chilies, seeded and finely chopped ( use to taste, or use serrano oil if you don't like hot ) | 1 tablespoon lemon, zest of | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons toasted pecans, chopped ( lightly salted )
instructions: In a bowl, mix the grated apples, mushrooms, chiles and lemon zest together well. Sprinkle the chili flakes over the top and give them a sprinkling of toasted pecan pieces to coat. With your hands, mix everything together and roll into small balls the size of walnuts. Place the balls on a plate, cover and refrigerate until the apples are firm, 15 minutes. Drain off the excess moisture, and serve with hot chutney if desired.

title: Italian Stuffed Pork
ingredients: 1 lb lean pork belly | 1/2 cup sliced walnuts | 1/4 cup pesto sauce, bottled | 1 teaspoon minced serrano pepper | 1 teaspoon honey | 1/4 cup italian dressing, bottled | 1/8 cup chopped dates, lightly toasted
instructions: Cook pork, breaking into pieces or shreds and using a 3 inch round cutter cut in half lengthwise, about 8 minutes. In a small bowl soak walnuts in pesto in microwave for about 30 seconds on HIGH, or until they are browned. Put pork halves into a medium bowl, sprinkle with walnuts and top with remaining ingredients. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Steamed Strawberries
ingredients: 3 large strawberries | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | 2 cups rolled oats
instructions: Wash strawberries thoroughly. Thinly slice them. Place the cleaned strawberries in a steamer basket or other large pot/pan. Cover the wattle basket with 2 cups of water. Steam on high heat for about 2 minutes. Cool and strain liquid into bowl that can be placed under cold running water to stop the cooking process. When completely cool, transfer strawberries to a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight to really chill and really let the flavors mix together. When ready to serve, place oat in a small bowl for sprinkling on top.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,chili bean,coriander,velveeta cheese,chocolate candy bar,bulk italian sausage,chickpea
title: Chili-Curd Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb bulk mild italian sausage | 8 flour tortillas | 1 cup canned chili or can chickpeas with liquid | 1 1/2 cups velveeta cheese | 2 cups fresh coriander | 1/4 cup chocolate candy bar, roughly chopped | chocolate candy bar, for sprinkling on top, for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place sausage in fry pan, turning to brown evenly. Drain fat and reserve. Heat 1 cup of the liquid over medium high heat in a large saucepan or skillet. Add tortillas and cook, stirring, for a few seconds, or until browned. Transfer tortillas to an 8 or 9x13 baking dish. Drain excess fat and reserve. Add the remaining 1/2 cup liquid and chaves to the pan and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring. Stir in cheese and corriander. Briefly warm the tortillas in the microwave, about 20seconds on high. Spread a heaping tablespoon of sausage mixture on each tortilla, if desired, sprinkle each with 2 tbls. Of chocolate and 1 to 2 to 3 tbls. Of chaves, if desired. Layer tortillas with remaining ingredients, starting with one layer of tortillas, spread over the other, then sprinkle with more chocolate. Sprinkle top with extra chopped chocolate and additional chaves. Bake in oven for about 20 - 25 minutes, or until top is crisp and golden.

title: Hot Radishes With Irish Cream
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups thinly sliced leeks ( white and light green parts only ) | 1 1/2 cups frozen corn, defrosted | 6 -8 irish cream, stoned
instructions: Place radishes and corn in a bowl of ice cold water to cover. Let stand until they are just softened. When cool enough to handle, peel the radishes carefully, cutting off the white stem section of each radish. Cut the corn from the cob into bite size pieces if you like.

Random Ingredients: veal,part mozzarella cheese,broth,lemon juice zest,parsley leaf,virgin olive oil,limeade concentrate
title: Diet Version of "Pate" : a French Quarter Pate
ingredients: 2 cans chicken broth | 1/3 cup limeade concentrate, frozen concentrate | 1 lime, juice and zest of, in the measuring cup of the juice of the zest | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1/4 lb ground veal | 1/4 lb part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Place the chicken broth, limeade concentrate, lime rind, and olive oil into a blender container and process all ingredients until smooth. Pour the mixture into a mixing bowl and stir in the veal, cheese, lime juice and parsley. Taste and season to taste with salt and pepper before serving.

title: Green Chicken Curry Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 packages pork tenderloins | 2 tablespoons green curry paste
instructions: Preheat a large skillett on medium high to high heat for 5 minutes. In a small bowl mix the cumin and curry paste. Roll each pork tenderloin in the curry paste, patting on the curry paste if necessary. Place a few pieces of coated tenderloin on the prepared skillet. Reduce heat to medium and cook for 35 minutes, flip the tenderloins every 5 minutes or so. Reduce the temperature to low, cover, and continue cooking for 45 - 60 minutes, until tenderloins are crisp and internal juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,tomato sauce,cinnamon,panko breadcrumb,black bean,asiago cheese
title: Black Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans black beans ( drained ) | 2 jars tomato sauce ( any type will work, i like my own ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon ( optional ) | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs ( or asiago cheese ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease a 9x13 pan. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes.

title: Burgetta Roll (Pounded Beef Rolls)
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped veal or 1 cup cooked ground beef | 1/2 cup chopped fresh olives | 2 tablespoons finely chopped peeled sweet cinnamon | 1 lb thickly sliced beef tenderloin ( or sirloin steaks with the grain ) | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed, cut in half crosswise and layers separated, cut lengthwise into 16 equal squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine the beef, olives, cinnamon and 1/2 teaspoons salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper in a medium bowl and stir to blend. Add the meat mixture. Spread the filling evenly over the pastry rectangles, leaving 1/2 inch of pastry showing on all sides. Starting with 1 corner of the pastry closest to you, roll up the pastry to enclose the filling. Using a sharp pointed fork, trim the ends of the roll. Gently roll up each pastry wrapper tightly, beginning on the short side. Cut a few slits in the middle of each roll, taking care not to cut all the way through. Repeat with the remaining pastry. Arrange the rolls on a baking sheet. Bake, turning once, until a deep brown crust is produced, about 20 minutes.

title: Spicy Mexican Roast Beef (for the Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut into 2 by 1/2-inch pieces | 2 cups thick and chunky salsa ( mild, medium, or hot ) | 1/3 cup coffee, brewed strongly | 1/4 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Place roast in 4 quart slow cooker. Combine salsa and coffee in small bowl. Pour over roast. Cover with lid and cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours or on high setting for 5 hours. Turn beef over. Cover and continue to cook 15 minutes or until just cooked through. Serve on platter.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,herb,chard leaf,black olive,rice flour,splenda sugar substitute
title: Moroccan Chard Leaves (Beetroot) and Olives (Beets) Salad
ingredients: 1 lb chard leaves, rinsed and dried | 1/4 cup dried arabic mixed herbs, such as marjoram or 1/4 cup tarragon | 1/3 cup rice flour ( jasmine or basmati ) | 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute or 1 tablespoon other artificial sweetener | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper, to taste | 1 can sliced black olives, drained with juice
instructions: Place the soaked greens in a large serving bowl. Crush together the herbs and rice flour in a mortar or a cheese grinder. Mix with the splenda and cayenne until well blended. Add the greens to bowl and toss to mix and combine. Sprinkle the olives over the greens and sprinkle over the olives. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,green pea,vidalia onion,ritz cracker crumb,olive
title: Vidalia Onion Pie
ingredients: 1 jar stuffed olives ( sliced ) | 1 can mixed green pea ( sliced ) | 1/2 vidalia onion ( sliced thin ) | 1 package monterey jack pepper cheese ( sliced into 8 slices ) | ritz cracker crumbs ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients together, except for crackers. Place in a shallow dish. Pour crackers evenly on top. Bake in 375 degree oven for 25 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,iceberg lettuce,stewing beef,grain white rice
title: Lime Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 1/8 cups uncooked long-grain white rice | iceberg lettuce, torn into bite size pieces | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 8 ounces stewing beef, sliced and browned
instructions: Combine rice, lettuce and lime juice. Toss. Serve.

title: Asparagus 'n' Tofu Loaf
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, cut into 3/4-inch squares | 1 package frozen asparagus spears, thawed and drained well | 1/2 cup oatmeal, granulated | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 2 teaspoons ice, ice cold ( optional ) | 1 loaf french bread, thinly sliced ( such as tofurri or ciabatta )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a 9 x 13 metal pan coated with cooking spray, layer tofu, asparagus, oats, and bread crumbs. Drizzle with remaining tablespoon of olive oil. Cut garlic crosswise into 6 slices and sprinkle atop crust. Bake until bread crumbs are golden and asparagus is crisp tender and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Chocolate Bean Cakes
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 ounces chopped dried black mushrooms or 2 ounces green mushrooms | 1 1/2 ounces chopped desiccated coconut | 2/3 cup diced bittersweet chocolate | 1/2 lb vegetable shortening
instructions: Soften chopped mushrooms in melted vegetable shortening. Drain and reserve kidney beans and black mushrooms. Combine beans, mushrooms and coconut. Toss until well mixed. With floured hands, shape into small flat cakes. Press 1/3 cup mixture onto each cake. Set aside. Repeat with remaining mixture. Chill 1 hour, or store in plastic bag.

title: Peach Sausages With Armagnac Crumb Topping
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut in thin slices ( pork loin chops are good too ) | 1 1/2 cups uncooked mixed fruit (, apricots, cranberries ) | 2 tablespoons dried apricots or 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 3/4 lb country lean sausages, casings removed | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 3 tablespoons dry white breadcrumbs | 4 tablespoons armagnac or 4 tablespoons peach juice
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the pork. Toss the pork in the fruit crumbs until evenly coated. Arrange the sausages in a baking dish about 2 inches from the bottom and 1/4 of the way up the sides. In a small bowl, stir together the white pepper, ground mace, and bread crumbs. Sprinkle over the top. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Remove the plastic wrap from the sausages. Sprinkle the top of each sausage with the seasoned crumb mixture. Bake until lightly browned, 40 to 45 minutes. Transfer to a plate and serve.

title: Spiced Turkey Dogs
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chili seasoning mix | 4 cloves garlic, minced | 1 package miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix together the chili seasoning mix, garlic and marshmallows until evenly coated. Open the package of cereal and press one of the packages into a baking dish. Pour 1 1/2 tablespoon chili mixture into the center of the cereal. Lay the turkey dogs out on top of the chili. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned.

title: Chipotle Vinaigrette
ingredients: 5 chipotle chiles | 1 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup tamari or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom, ground
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender or food processor until smooth. Serve immediately.

title: Cheesy Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 large fresh mushrooms | 1 cup cream cheese | fresh thyme
instructions: Remove the mushrooms from their stems, and set them aside. Blend the cream cheese with the thyme, and stuff the mushroom caps. Place on a rack in a casserole dish, and bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,red kidney bean,chili paste,pesto sauce,almond extract
title: Cherry Jelly-Scented Red Beans
ingredients: 2 cups red kidney beans, dried | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup blueberries, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Pierce beans with knife or toothpick several times in desired amount of the way. Place in a large saucepan along with remaining ingredients. Bring beans to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until almost most of liquid is absorbed, about 3 hours.

title: Brazilian Shrimp Patties
ingredients: 1 large zucchini, halved lengthwise then sliced into about 1/4-inch wedges | 1 large parsnip, cut into 1/4-inch wedges | 1 tablespoon peanut fat or 1 tablespoon melted butter | 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1 teaspoon low-sodium balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f, place half the zucchini and parsnip in a 2 quart casserole. Sprinkle 1/4 tsp peanut or butter and remaining ingredients over casserole. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake until patties are puffy and hot throughout, about 20 to 25 minutes or until shrimp are cooked through.

Random Ingredients: macaroni,dark brown sugar,white vinegar,self rising flour,vegetable,green onion
title: Green Onion-Rice Slice
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped green onion | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh vegetables | 4 teaspoons malt free white vinegar | 1 1/3 cups white vinegar | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup cooked macaroni
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease a 9 x 3 cup cake pan, then set aside in a warm place. In a separate bowl combine the green onion, vegetables & malt free vinegar & set aside. In a separate bowl, measure dry ingredients, then stir in the flour & sugar. Add the dry ingredients to the onion mixture & mix well. Spoon the mixture into the prepared pan, then cut slivers across the top & bake for 35 minutes or until the top is golden brown before removing from oven. Allow to completely cool before slicing & eating.

title: Kosher Lime & Coconut Quinoa
ingredients: 3 cups watercress | 1 cup dry quinoa | 1/2 cup flaked coconut | 2/3 cup lime wedge | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a medium saucepan, combine the quinoa and water. Bring to the boil, cover partially and reduce heat to simmer over low heat. Cook covered, for about 20 minutes, until Quinoa is tender and water has been absorbed. Stir in the coconut and lime wedges and continue cooking, covered, until liquid has been absorbed. Transfer to a bowl and stir in baking soda. Serve warm or cool. Note, to stop it frothing up, make sure to add 1/2 2 tbsp of milk with a pinch or two of splenda. It will turn a light, fluffy topping when cooled.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cognac,water chestnut,taco seasoning mix,bibb lettuce,chili garlic sauce
title: Spinach Tacos with Mushrooms, Onions & Chili
ingredients: 2 head bibb lettuce | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 2 tablespoons shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup cognac or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 package baby spinach | chili-garlic sauce, for dipping
instructions: Wash heads and leaves but do not dry. Cut off outer leaves so salad will be separated. Slice head lengthwise in half. Remove tender center end and leave just enough for shells to sit upright. Pull leaves apart, leaving 1/4 wide strips of lettuce on the inside. Chop remaining 1/4 strips into thirds. Rinse and drain spinach. Spread about half of the pimento sauce inside each taco half.

title: Mandarin Sour Cream
ingredients: 4 mandarin oranges | 8 ounces sour cream ( or more )
instructions: Slice mandarins crosswise. Place in freezer for 5 - 6 minutes until partially frozen. Remove and place the slices in a glass container with one or more of the following, sour cream, or any other flavor, according to what you require. The sour cream may be added to a sauce or served in a small dipping bowl alongside. Variation, for sweetened sour cream, add 1 tablespoon of sugar to sour cream to sweeten sour cream slightly. For a more sour cream style or fruit flavor add a teaspoon of butter to soften sour cream.

title: Crock Pot Rice, Spanish Style
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups long grain white rice | 2 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar | 8 ounces swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine rice, tomatoes, oregano and sugar. Place cheese into crockpot on top of cooked rice mixture. Cover and cook on low for 2 to 4 hours. After 2 to 4 hours, add cheese back in.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,salt substitute,extra virgin olive oil
title: Salt Substitute Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup salt substitute, preferably kosher salt | 2 lbs chicken tenders | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: The purpose of the salt, plus the salt, is for the flavor and thickness of the chicken tenders. Rinse the tenders under cold water to rinse out residual salt, and pat dry. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit and lightly oil a shallow roasting pan with a removable bottom. Cut the tenders into three pieces of equal size about a third of an inch in height. Rub salt onto the tenders and roll in a large piece of parchment or corn meal. Spread the tenders in the pan and drizzle in olive oil. Bake for about 40 minutes. Turn the chicken over and cook for about 45 more minutes or until the chicken's internal temperature is 165 degrees fahrenheit in the thickest part of the thigh.

title: Beijing Spinach and Oatcakes
ingredients: 4 cups coarsely chopped spinach | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped napa cabbage | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped whole wheat bread | 4 teaspoons grand marnier | 8 teaspoons dried porridge oatmeal | 1/4 cup sweet chinese wine
instructions: Cook spinach and napa cabbage in hot oat cereal or steamed water until the vegetables are just wilted and just tender, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the grand marnier& porridge oatmeal. Spoon mixture evenly into 8 round or square cake pans. Let cool for 5 minutes, then cut into 8 squares or diamonds. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Coco -Papaya Zucchini Smoothie
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini | 1 medium papaya, peeled with skin on, deseeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup unsweetened desiccated coconut milk powder | 1/3 cup sweet red wine | 2 tablespoons double cream | 6 tablespoons sweet unsweetened applesauce
instructions: Cut zucchini into 1cm cubes or roughly chop the zucchini in batches. Place, peeled and deseeded, in a large jug with the mango, red wine, coconut milk, cream, applesauce and papaya. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,raisin,chicken wing,bread flour,cranberry,thyme sprig,cake pastry flour
title: Mustard Seed and Raisin Chicken Wings
ingredients: 20 kg sandwich bread flour or 20 kg sandwich flour, for breading | 2 kg chicken wings | 3 kg raisins | 2 liters cake-and-pastry flour | 35 g dried mixed seeds and herbs, mixed | 1 bunch fresh thyme sprigs | 1 g black mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 deg c, 190 deg c if using your pizza stone. Place dough on a floured work surface, and roll out to about 2mm thick. Use a 5cm cutter or a glass for slicing the dough. Use the same technique of a pizza cutter if you don't have one. Using your favourite bread flour, place the flour on a work surface and gradually add 100ml water. Stir the dough with the fingertips, drawing in flour as you add. Keep doing this 2 - 3 times. Gradually add remaining 50ml water, until you have a sticky, sticky dough. If it's too sticky, add more flour. On a floured work surface, roll out the dough to about 6mm thick. Use your favourite bread flour, and add 100ml of flour. Gently fold in the flour until you have a smooth dough that feels pliable but does not stick to your hands. Using a 3mm cutter, push out into 4cm diameter circles and cut out the centre of each circular. The centre is the widest point. Repeat with the remaining dough. Place the rounds on a oiled baking tray, and bake until light brown. Remove, and spread the breaded raisins on a baking tray. Place the tray in the oven to dry for 10 - 15 minutes. Toast the dried mixed herbs in a dry frying pan. Remove, and place seeds in a bowl. Bring the 2 litres of liquid together in a large frying pan on medium heat. Place the mustard seeds in a small bowl, and sprinkle a teaspoon of the mixed seeds over the. Bring the liquid to a slow boil and cook, stirring, until the seeds change colour. Immediately pour over the dry spices. Allow to cool completely before using. Preheat a grill, or preheat a grill pan. Remove the tray from the oven. When chicken wings are cool enough to handle, remove excess fat from the carcass and discard. Trim the wings of any excess fat if necessary, but remove any damaged parts or undesirable bits from the wings at the joint. Remove the excess fat, and tear the wings into smaller bits with your hands. Place all of the wings in a large saucepan or roasting tin. Add the honey and remaining mixed seeds to the stock. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. Turn off the heat. Allow to cool before using. Put the stock into a large bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove the tray from the oven, and place the birds on a flat oven tray. Sprinkle the dried herbs on the meat. Allow to stand for 2 hours or until the bread mixture has absorbed all of the liquid, and has dried. Pour the stock into four large ovenproof bowls, or onto 4 individual serving plates. Put hot stone or roasting tin into the oven to preheat. When the oven is hot, place the bowls on the rack. Heat for 5 - 10 minutes, then carefully remove the baking tray from the oven. Gently arrange the chicken on top of the mixed herbs, using a wooden spoon to press them down. Leave to stand for 30 minutes before using. This will help crisp the other coating of spices. Remove all the herbs before serving.

title: Barley Jelly Barley
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 1/2 cups dried tomatoes with basil | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sweet dark soy sauce
instructions: Place barley over medium heat. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to simmer. Cover and continue to simmer gently for 15 - 20 minutes, or until barley is tender and liquid is absorbed. While barley is cooking, soak tomatoes in hot water for a few minutes. Once barley is tender, transfer to a bowl and mash with a potato masher. When cooled, transfer to a blender and add in both sauces. Blend until smooth. Press into a jelly roll form and then leave in the refrigerator, covered, for several days to develop flavor and firmness.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,bourbon,italian seasoning,lemon peel,dark soy sauce,amaretto liqueur
title: Bourbon Mushroom Cured Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup dark soy sauce | 1 cup amaretto liqueur | 1/2 cup bourbon | 1 1/2 tablespoons cremini mushrooms, trimmed | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, coarsely grated for garnish | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the soy sauce, amaretto, bourbon, mushrooms, lemon peel, and italian seasoning. Toss to blend.

title: Yummy Quick Indian Tomato Appetizers!!
ingredients: 400 g mature tomatoes | 1 teaspoon ginger paste, grated | 1 teaspoon tomato and ginger paste, for tampering
instructions: Cut and cut the tomatoes. Take 1 tsp of ginger paste with tomato and ginger in a bowl. Mash them. Break into little pieces. Put equal amounts of tomato and ginger paste into 2 bowls. Keep 1/2 tsp of tomato ginger paste in each bowl. After half an hour, open the bowl and check the consistency of the tomatoes and ginger paste using a fork. Add 2 tsp of tomato and ginger paste into each bowl.

title: Pasta Fritters and Sausage
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour ( besan ) | 6 ounces italian sausage | 2 cups mixed fresh varieties red potatoes ( red and pareve ) | 4 large large eggs | 20 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Heat about 2 tbsp of the oil in a large, deep non stick pan. Tip in the sausage and cook for about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove sausage to a bowl, leaving the fat in the pan. Tip in the potatoes and cook for about 5 mins until cooked. Using a slotted spoon, push the potatoes into the sausage fat and cook them for a further ten minutes. Push all together using a large spoon. While the potato and sausage mixture are cooking, whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt until they’re creamy. Stir in the flour a little at a time. When you’re doing this, slowly pour the mix into the pan. When the mixture comes to a boil, add the tomatoes and stir. Bring to the boil and then simmer until the mixture thickens a little. Taste and add more salt if necessary. Taste and serve sprinkled with grated parmesan if desired.

title: Japanese Crabsticks
ingredients: 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons seasoned black pepper
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Dust a baking sheet with panko.

title: Nori (Nori)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind soy sauce | 2 tablespoons guacamole ( or your favorite flavor )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve immediately. May be adjusted to taste. Refrigerate leftovers tightly closed up to 3 days before serving to develop flavors.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,fruit cocktail,cheese,salad green,paprika,tortilla chip
title: Tortilla Chip Salad (Herbes De Provence)
ingredients: 6 ounces tortilla chips | 4 ounces mixed salad greens | 1 can fruit cocktail | chopped cheese, of your choice | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | paprika, to sprinkle on top
instructions: Preheat a skillet to 325 degrees. On a large plate, layer the tortilla chips, mixed salad greens, fruit cocktail, cheese, herbs de provence, and paprika, to form a layered layered serving on top.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,dark brown sugar,flour,white vinegar,cilantro leaf,macaroni,white flour,taco seasoning mix
title: Macaroni and Taco Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups cooked macaroni | 3/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 packages taco seasoning mix | 2/3 cup unbleached white flour | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a saucepan and cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens, about 5 to 10 minutes. Cool the mixture and divide it into 16 equal portions. Place the cornmeal, flour and cilantro in a large plastic bag. Moisten your hands with cold water and shape a portion of the macaroni in the center of the flour mixture then quickly twist, pull or pull apart any floury dough. Shake off excess flour and cook over medium heat, shaking the bag to prevent sticking, until golden brown, flipping the fritters once halfway through, about 2 minutes per side.

title: Turkish Cheesecake
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground hazelnuts, skinned | 1/2 cup chopped epazote | 4 scallions, finely chopped | 4 scallions | 2 teaspoons instant coffee, dissolved in | 2 teaspoons warm water | 1 1/2 lbs ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, chopped
instructions: In small bowl, mash the hazelnuts in sugar until coarsely ground.

Random Ingredients: red wine,swiss chard,beer,iceberg lettuce,cumin seed,beef eye,ajwain
title: Tunisian Barbecued Steak With Greens
ingredients: 1 1/4 1 1/4 lbs boneless beef eye round | 1/2 cup shredded swiss chard ( about 1 handful ) or 1/2 cup kale | 2 tablespoons canola oil or 2 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon fresh julienne julienne red onion | 1 1/2 cups beer or 1 1/2 cups dry white wine | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon ajwain ( optional )
instructions: In large heavy duty resealable bag, combine meat, chard, oil, wine and cumin seeds. Seal bag. Refrigerate, turning bag over occasionally, for 2 hours. Transfer beef, chard, wine and cumin seeds to rimmed baking sheet and refrigerate to marinate, covered, for 3 hours. Heat broiler. Remove meat from marinade and broil 1 to 2 minutes or until well browned. Place meat on a hot platter, place under broiler and finish cooking about 1 minute or until medium rare.

title: Thai Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 can chickpeas, drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/4 cup fresh minced red chili pepper | 2 tablespoons hoisin meal or 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 tablespoons molasses | 1 cup water | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for several hours to let flavors mingle. Brush the chicken lightly with olive oil. Remove the chicken from the marinade and grill, uncovered, over high heat for 10 minutes on each side. Serve immediately.

title: Choc-Pac-Pac (Pudding)
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh coconut-flavored pudding | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 can canned anaheim chilies, drained
instructions: Place pudding in a casserole dish. Layer the water chestnuts over the pudding. Sprinkle with vinegar. Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve, remove from refrigerator, and allow to set for 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Roasted Grilled Aubergines With Chili Glaze
ingredients: 3 tablespoons honey, plus more for glazing | 1 1/4 lbs large aubergines | 2 slices dried chiles | 4 medium baking potatoes | 1 cup pure maple syrup | 1 whole clove
instructions: Roast the chilies by placing them in a bowl with water to cover, then letting them sit for 20 minutes to loosen any dirt. Remove the chilies and stems, and place them in a saucepan and add a pinch or 2 of chilies seeds. Cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and cook for 10 minutes, then drain and pat dry with a towel. Cut the aubergines lengthwise into 6 wedges, and then toss into 4 piles of 6 pieces each. Place in a medium bowl. Place the soaked chilies in a food processor or blender and grind them into a fine powder. Place the ground chilies in a clean bowl.

title: Gorgonzola Spread
ingredients: 1 cup gorgonzola | 1/2 cup dates
instructions: Cut up gorgonzola into small pieces and put into clean container. Add dates and mix well. Serve as a dip that can sit in the fridge.

title: Chickpea and Crab Potato Salad With Turmeric
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas | 1/2 lb red potatoes or 1/2 lb yuca, cut in 1/4-inch cubes | 1/2 medium banana, chopped ( about 1 cup ) | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange peel or 1 1/2 teaspoons lime peel, finely grated | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 -3 drops tabasco sauce ( if you can find them )
instructions: In a small saucepan boil potatoes for 8 to 10 minutes or until just tender. Drain and chill. In a large bowl, combine chickpeas, potatoes, banana and mustard powder. Sprinkle in orange peel, turmeric, and tabasco. Stir to mix. Cover and chill at least 4 hours or overnight. Just before serving, adjust seasonings..

title: Buttered Swiss Beans
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsalted butter beans | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 4 cups fresh green onions, sliced | 2 1/4 lbs swiss beans, about ( i prefer red or green )
instructions: Place butter beans and 1 t cornstarch in a skillet over medium heat. Cook until tender and bubbly. Add remaining cornstarch and lemon peel. Mix cornstarch with warm water. Add to skillet and cook until mixture thickens. Add green onions and heat until tender, about 2 minutes. Drain in a colander. Serve hot.

title: BBQ Drumsticks (A Drumstick)
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken legs
instructions: Place chicken legs in a non metallic bowl, pour over enough water to cover, and leave to stand overnight. Pat dry the chicken legs with kitchen paper, then place in a large roasting tin which is big enough to accommodate them in 1 layer. Place into the oven for 45 - 60 minutes to 1 hour. When drumsticks are cooked, remove from the oven and set aside till cool enough to handle and remove any skin bits at the joints. Split the legsticks in half lengthways and pull out any remaining skin. Using a sharp knife cut each piece into 3 - 4 thick diagonal strips. Reserve some of the cooking water. Arrange strips under the skin of each drumstick in a jug or small dish and set aside. Serve with the reserved cooking water. Cook's note,. • the chicken legs' can be served on their own as a tasty treat, accompanied by a bowl of chutney, chopped fresh herbs and lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,asparagus spear,curry powder,nori,enchilada sauce,banana pepper
title: Spicy Banana-Pepper Saute with Asparagus & Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus spear | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 ripe banana pepper, sliced ( optional ) | 4 naan bread or 4 nori ( 8 inch sheets ) | 1 can enchilada sauce ( i use my enchilada sauce recipe ) or ( 32 ounce ) can salsa ( i use my enchilada sauce recipe )
instructions: Boil asparagus until tender. Place on towel and cool.. Peel asparagus, cut into 2 inch pieces.. In a small bowl, mix together syrup, curry powder, and banana until well blended. Heat 1 tbl canola oil in large nonstick skillet, add 1 tbl. Of sauce mix. Remove and set aside. When hot, add 1/4 c hot mixture of the cooked asparagus and 1/2 the curry mixture. Toss to lightly coat. Remove from heat when curry mixture starts to bubble again. Toss again. Add 1/2 the banana pepper slices, if using. Sprinkle with 1 tbls. Fresh chopped basil. Toss well. To serve, place 2 to 4 asparagus spears on each slice of bread and top with 1/2 a dab of enchilada sauce. Roll up and serve immediately.

title: Irish Rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups instant brown rice ( or rice with barley ) | 1 cup irish cream ( can use cream of coconut or anise flavored ) | 4 tablespoons oil
instructions: In a large frying pan, add oil and heat to medium. Add rice and stir until rice is coated with oil. Stir in cream of coconut or anise flavored coconut & irish cream. Stir well. Turn heat to low, cover and bake for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pear,green bell pepper,wheat flour,poblano chile,pasta sauce,pineapple
title: Spicy Pear Pasta
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, seeded and sliced | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup pineapple - peeled, cored and chopped | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 jar pasta sauce | 1/2 package fresh pasta sliced into rounds
instructions: Place poblanos in a dutch oven and add green bell pepper, pineapple, flour, and pasta sauce. Heat through but do not boil. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,chunky salsa,mint leaf,creme fraiche,green bell pepper,basmati rice
title: Mexican Rice Bowl
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 4 tablespoons creamy creme fraiche | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Combine rice and salsa in a bowl. Mix well. In a small bowl, whisk together creme fraiche and tabasco. Pour over rice mixture, tossing to coat. Add green bell pepper and mint leaves. Transfer to a serving bowl. Serve immediately or serve cold.

title: Olive-Stuffed Yams
ingredients: 1 yam, peeled and about 3/4-inch in diameter | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled & cut lengthwise into eighths | 3 tablespoons blanched slivered almonds, divided | 2 tablespoons bsaqen sherry wine | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cayenne, to taste | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon sherry wine ( optional ) | 1 cup soft unseasoned rice vinegar, plus additional
instructions: With a sharp knife, cut a small cross in the top of the yam. Cut each yam in half lengthwise. Using a sharp paring knife, make a slit in the center to push out the pulp of the yam. Save the pulp from the yam pulp. Cut a sliver of pulp from 1 egg and reserve it in a small bowl. Mash the pulp to make a paste, if necessary. Cut a half lengthwise slit along the top of the yam. Fill it with the yam pulp and set aside. Place the sliced egg in a bowl of cold water and soak for at least 15 minutes. Remove the shell and cut around the yam cavity. Place the stuffed yam inside a large bowl. Drain off the water from the yam. Carefully, squeeze out the excess water. Cut the yam pulp into 1/2 slices & set aside. Place the almond slivers, 2 teaspoons of slivered almonds, 1 egg yolk, & a pinch of cayenne into a mortar. Pound on a counter or electric mixer with the pestle to make crumbs. Add sherry & blend. Stuff the stuffed yam with the crumb mixture & arrange them in a baking dish. Place the baking dish in a hot oven on 1 to 1 1/2 t of the charcoal fire along with the reserved egg halves facing the fire. Make a couple more holes in the yam pulp and baste them with balsamic glaze. Place yams in the oven and toast them for about 10 minutes or until the yam pulp is puffed & caramelized looking.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,oregano leaf,fish fillet,apple cider,thai red curry paste,white onion,ginger
title: Grilled Fish With Thai Red Curry
ingredients: 1 lb fish fillet | 2 teaspoons minced white onions | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon apple cider | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 4 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Place fish fillets on the grill and brush with lime juice. Toast under grill until blackened on both sides, turning once, approximately 3 - 4 minutes total. Transfer fish to a cutting board. Scoop out flesh from center of the fish and discard or save for another recipe. Place fish in medium bowl. Arrange sliced onions on top. Finely chop ginger and sprinkle over the fish. Sauté curry paste and herbs in a small saucepan over low heat, covered, stirring until fragrant, about 1 minute. Spoon over fish. Garnish with whipping cream.

title: Spicy Strawberry English Muffin
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat english muffins, cut into 1/4-inch crumbs ( or other dry english muffin ) | 5 slices tomatoes, crusts removed | 1 cup assorted fresh mushrooms ( about 1 cup, or other fresh mushrooms ) | 2 tablespoons canned whole berries | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh red chile ( optional ) | 3/4 cup reduced-sodium broth ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl, gently stir together muffin crumbs and tomato slices.

title: Mexican Pork Cutlets
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium pork tenderloin | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 4 slices | 1 lime, cut into small wedges, for serving
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the egg substitute, stock, and pork. Add the cumin. Place bread slices on a plate and set aside. Spread each bread slice with some egg substitute. Place a slice on each plate. Spoon pork mixture onto bread slices, spreading to cover. Garnish with lime wedges.

title: Georgian Sausage (Fattigmans) (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style pork ribs, trimmed of excess fat & membrane | 5 tablespoons salt | 3 tablespoons turmeric powder | 3 tablespoons dill ( dried )
instructions: Note, 1 tablespoon of salt per pound of ribs may be added to aid in curing the spices.

title: Grand Marnier and Romaine Salad
ingredients: 2 cups skim milk, divided | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( orange liqueur ) | 1 head romaine lettuce, shredded | 1/3 cup low fat cottage cheese, drained
instructions: In a small bowl, mix 2 cups of skim milk with grand marnier and refrigerate for up to 2 hours. Line an 8x8 inch glass pan with lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,romano cheese,coriander powder,dark brown sugar,steak
title: Beef or Pork Kabobs
ingredients: 1 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 6 1/2 tablespoons ground coriander powder | 4 cups leftover roast, chopped or 4 lbs flank steaks | 1 1/4 cups grated romano cheese or 1 1/4 cups parmesan cheese
instructions: Mix brown sugar, coriander and coriander powder. Coat beef with mixture. Allow to sit at least 10 minutes at room temperature to absorb moisture. Barbecue or grill meat about 8 minutes per side, or until cooked through and tender. Top with romano.

title: Melt Beer Can "sauce" on Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 lb mushroom stems, washed, trimmed and trimmed | 12 ounces guinness stout | mushroom stems, drained
instructions: Pour vinegar and 1/4 cup water in a nonstick skillet, and warm at low medium heat until vinegar is absorbed, about 20 - 30 minutes. Add mushrooms and stir just until warm, about three minutes. Pour maltes into a small jar with a lid, press lid so that air bubbles can circulate. Seal and refrigerate. Serve mushroom mixture in a small bowl, drizzle with a little olive oil if desired. Garnish with mushroom stems. This also makes delicious garlic flavored stews, as garlic is easily marinated in a coating of oil like cornstarch.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,mandarin orange,green olive,avocado,green chili sauce
title: Mexican Fiesta Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces mandarin oranges, drained | 1 green chili sauce | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1 green olive, drained | 1 avocado, peeled, pitted, and diced
instructions: Mix mandarin oranges, chile sauce, mandarin oranges, and chopped green olives together in a bowl. Pour avocado onto the prepared dressing and stir gently. Chill before serving.

title: Lentils and Brown Lentils
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown lentils | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Wash and soak brown lentils. Place in a crockpot, add salt to taste. Cover and cook on low for 3 - 5 hours.

title: Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 500 g cremini mushrooms | 50 g walnut oil | pasta, of choice | walnut oil, to decorate
instructions: Heat up a medium fry pan with a dash of olive oil to make your pan easier to eat. Wash the mushrooms in water, making sure to remove the stalk or white part of the mushroom stems. Slice off the caps into very thin slices. If you have the option of buying sliced mushrooms you can omit this step and just use fresh mushrooms. Remove any thick pieces of the mushroom that are not quite done before they’re cleaned and slice each capsince thinly, leaving them about ½ centimetre thick so they are cooked later. Heat up a fry pan with a dash of olive oil. You can also use a cast iron pan for the pan. When it’s hot, add the mushrooms, making sure each mushroom is coated with olive oil. Do not overcook. When the mushrooms have fully cooked, add a teaspoon of walnut oil to each mushroom, taking care to not let the oil come to the top of the mushrooms. Turn off the fry pan. Place the pasta in a bowl and stir well. Once the pasta is cooked through, pour it into a separate bowl or a serving plate to serve, allowing the mushrooms to get a bit crispy. When the pasta is done, place it over a serving plate of sauce, garnish with fresh mint leaves, and pass around a bit of walnut oil.

Random Ingredients: hot chili pepper,red enchilada sauce,pork loin,arborio rice
title: Quick and Easy Red Enchilada Pork Bowl
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin | 1 can red enchilada sauce ( i used herdez brand ) | 2 cups uncooked arborio rice | 2 hot chili peppers, chopped
instructions: Cut pork into 1/2 inch strips and sautee in large skillet until browned. Reserve. Remove pork from pan and place in crock pot. Combine enchilada sauce with rice and pour over pork. Cover and cook on low for 3 - 4 hours. Serve over rice or add some chopped jalapeno peppers.

title: Gruene's Peppered Nuts
ingredients: 1 pound guinea fowl | 1 piece fresh seaweed, 4 inches long, or more to taste | 1/2 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange the peanut nuts on the baking sheet, and spread with an even layer of seaweed. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly colored and fragrant, 10 to 15 minutes. Scotch bonnet peppers can be found at asian or ethnic grocer stores.

Random Ingredients: potato flake,potato,ranch dressing,garlic salt,garbanzo bean chickpea
title: Mashed Potatoes and Canned Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 lb dry garbanzo beans ( chickpeas, washed and drained ) | 2 boxes uncle ben's hot mashed potatoes | 1 -2 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 packet dehydrated potato flakes | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Simple and Delicious Marinated Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef | 1 fennel bulb
instructions: Heat grill to medium. Brush fennel bulbs lightly with oil and place in the grill. Grill for a few minutes on each side or until tender. Let rest, slice, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,tofu,granny smith apple,chili paste,stewing beef
title: Vegetarian Beef and Tofu in Adobo Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups cubed stewing beef | 1 package firm tofu | 1/4 cup chili paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried dill weed or 2 tablespoons oregano ( you can mix or use fresh... ) | 1 granny smith apple, cut in 1 '' chunks
instructions: Cut the beef into cubes and set aside. In the slow cooker, blend the remaining ingredients with half of the water. Cook on high for 5 hours, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,spinach leaf,red pepper flake,cocoa powder
title: Spinach Pizzas
ingredients: 1/2 cup pizza sauce | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1 1/4 cups fresh spinach leaves | 1 1/4 cups cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a small bowl, stir together pizza sauce and red pepper flakes. Combine tomato paste with spinach in a microwave safe bowl on high for 1 minute. Microwave for 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,celery root,kosher salt,tomato green chilies,chili sauce,chicken part,cherry pie filling,chive
title: Homemade Chicken Enchilada
ingredients: 1 package fresh cherry pie filling | 2 cans stewed tomatoes and green chilies | 1 1/2 lbs chicken parts ( about 7 cups ) | 8 stalks celery root, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped chives | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 teaspoon dry crushed chili sauce | 1 cup sweet chili sauce, such as heinz | 1 english cucumber, cut into 1/2 inch dice
instructions: Prepare your oven to 400°. Place the cherry pie filling into a 9x13 inch baking pan. Arrange the chicken over the filling. Sprinkle with the celery root.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,parmesan cheese,catsup,orange,grand marnier,broccoli,kosher salt,kaffir lime leaf
title: Capelli (Capelli)
ingredients: 6 kaffir lime leaves, torn into 1/4 inch pieces ( about 1 cup ) | 1 lb broccoli, trimmed, cut into small florets | 1 can chickpeas ( garbanzo beans ), drained | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup orange juice or 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup grand marnier ( optional ) | kosher salt | parmesan cheese, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Place leaves in a food processor.

title: Irish Corned Beef and Vermicelli Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 2 lbs corned beef brisket | 10 slices rye bread | 1 package vermicelli, broken into 4 pieces | 2 small limes
instructions: Place corned beef in a large pan & cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to medium low, simmer for 45 minutes. Remove from heat & drain any liquid from the pan. Place rye & vermicelli in a large nonstick pan. Heat over medium heat until rice is hot& vermicelli is hot. Turning once, add corned beef, cook brisket, uncovered, for another 15 - 20 minutes until meat is tender, stirring occasionally. Remove from pan & slice into large pieces. Split slices & enjoy.

title: Baked Roma Tomatoes and Pork
ingredients: 4 roma tomatoes, cut in half, deseeded and roughly chopped | 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into thick slices

Remove roulides from the oven, remove foil and slice into 1 rounds and serve straight away.

instructions: Preheat your grill or broiler. Place the barbeque sauce, salami, salami, salami, salami and green enchilada sauces in a bowl and mix to combine. instructions: Blend cheese, mango and olives in a food processor til smooth. Mash together or mix with lime leaves. Spoon into serving glasses and top with cheese mixture.

instructions: Cut the broccoli in half and then crosswise into a 1 inch square.

instructions: Prepare yeast cake, place bread in a large mixing bowl. Add 3 cups of warm water with 1/4 cup of the melted margarine. Mix. Add the rest of the ingredients. Mix all together. Let sit for 10 minutes. Turn onto floured surface. Knead. Place on a large baking sheet and rise until light brown. Place in a preheated oven at 425° for 20 - 25 minutes. Top with your favorite toppings. Use your favorite toppings. Spread out on a baking sheet with a pizza peel or butter applied with a soft butter applied on the top. Top with a layer of shredded cheese or whatever toppings you choose. Bake in a 425° oven for 10 minutes or until cheese on top is melted.

title: Salt Baked Fish (Ceviche)

instructions: Wash the fish, place it in an oven proof pot or dutch oven that will fit it comfortably. Sprinkle with some spice, garlic salt and chillies if using, and cover with water. title: Mushroom Cheese Shells

instructions: Mix the mushroom slices with cilantro and hot pepper sauce in a medium size bowl. Pour the mixture into the shell halves, pressing it lightly on the sides to help hold together. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add salt and cook the shells for 4 - 6 minutes just until they rise to the surface. title: Pasta With Vanilla, Onion And Caramelised Carrots

instructions: Mix the corn flakes with 1 t oil to make a crumbly topping, set aside. Mix the shredded orange peel with 1/4 c grated cheese. Spread corn flakes over salad and top with the chicken, cucumber slices and orange rind.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange chicken legs in a large roasting pan. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper. Bake in preheated oven, about 40 minutes or until juices run clear. Baste once, then cover with aluminum foil and continue baking 15 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Homemade Phyllo Dough
ingredients: 14 sheets phyllo dough | 1 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Take out your 5 sheets of thawed filo dough, and roll them out on a lightly floured surface. Cut into pieces about 2 by 1/4 by 2 inches. Brush 1 sheet of filo with water while you roll out the remaining sheets to make the final sheet. Place the bean sprouts in a bowl, and sprinkle generously with salt. Sprinkle this on top of the 5 sheets of filo, and roll it with a rolling pin, as though you were rolling a large rectangle. You are now ready to go to make your final phyllo dough for use. Line a 9x13 inch pan with a damp kitchen towel, or if you have some damp buttered parchment paper, spray with a little olive oil spray. Cover with a clean towel, and lay it in the preheated oven. Place another 9x13 inch pan on top of the parchment, and spray with a little olive oil and repeat with the rest of the filo and sprouts. It is not necessary to grease a loaf pan, just lightly coat the top with olive oil. Bake in the preheated oven for about 25 to 30 minutes, checking and removing the phyllo after 5 to 10 minutes. This method should produce a somewhat crisp phyllo layered throughout the pan and a somewhat tacky finish to the phyllo. Remove the pan from the oven, and spray again with olive oil. Set it over a medium/low heat, and allow it to lightly smoke, for about 10 to 15 minutes. This will also ensure a crisp, chewy phyllo layered throughout the pan. When the phyllo is done, cut it into pieces about 2 by 1/2 by 1/8 pieces. Do not stack it, it will have fallen apart if layered on the next day, and should be okay. Allow all of the phyllo to cool for about 3 to 4 minutes before slicing, or you may use half of this for the filling and half as the filling.
