ingredients: 6 ounces sourdough bread, sliced into thick slices about 1-inch thick | 1 -2 tablespoon curry paste, of your choice ( depending on your taste tolerance for hotness ) | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 3/4 ounce chipotle chile, diced small
instructions: Dry top of bread slices on counter for 15 20min, or until dry. Using a slotted spoon, remove bread from pan and place on a baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,rice wine,baking potato,rump roast,almond extract,macadamia nut,pomegranate
title: Rump and Cabbage Cones
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump roast ( about ) | 1 large baking potato ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 2 cabbage ( about 2 heads ) | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup toasted macadamia nuts ( about 4 ounces ) or 1/4 cup chopped pistachios ( about 4 ounces )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°. Using kitchen shears, make several indentations in side of roast, cutting deep incissions. Insert slivers of potato into cuts. Place roast and potatoes in large shallow baking pan. Add water to cover.

Random Ingredients: meatball,red wine,salmon fillet,tomato juice,watercress,orange,italian plum tomato,coconut oil
title: Danish Oven Meatballs & Ceviche (Tomato Soup)
ingredients: 1 kg diced tomatoes | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes | 1 liter watercress ( chopped ) | 350 g meatballs | 1 liter red wine | 600 ml orange juice ( fresh ) | 250 ml coconut oil | 250 ml smoked salmon fillet ( thinly sliced )
instructions: In a large dutch oven combine tomatoes, the watercress and half the wine and bring to boil place the meatballs, fish cocktail and remaining wine into the dutch oven and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 hours. Drain off any excess liquid. Place meatballs in the soup. Simmer for 10 minutes longer. Remove soup from heat. In a bowl whisk together remaining wine, orange juice and coconut oil. Add to soup and simmer 1 hour. Serve in bowls with a sprinkling of smoked salmon.

title: Indian King Prawns (Shrimp)
ingredients: 500 g raw king prawns | 3 cm piece gingerroot, peeled and finely grated | 1 head red cabbage, finely shredded | 1 cup cashew nuts, roasted & raw
instructions: Bring 5 cups water to boil in a pan, add prawns and boil for 3 - 4 mins until the shells split open.. Remove from heat, refresh under cold water, then chop fine. Put the prawns in a colander and toss with ginger, cabbage and cashew nuts. Serve immediately.

title: Spice Catfish
ingredients: 4 catfish fillets | spices, your choice
instructions: Heat grill to high. Place one fillet on hot grate, sprinkle with spices. Grill, turning until it is almost browned and flake easily with fork.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,ancho chile powder,chunky salsa,vanilla pudding mix
title: Cheesy Baby Carrots
ingredients: 6 baby carrots | 1 container prepared chunky salsa | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix ( not pudding mix ) | 1 tablespoon ancho chile powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut carrots in half lengthwise. Remove as many seeds as possible, then cut a cross in the base of each carrot, cutting it in half again lengthwise. Arrange carrots in a 10x15 inch jellyroll pan. Combine salsa, pudding powder, and ancho powder in a bowl and toss to combine. Spread mixture over carrots. Cover pan with foil. Bake for 40 minutes. Uncover and bake for 10 minutes more or until carrots are tender.

title: Red Curry Powder
ingredients: 4 dried red chilies, stems and seeds removed and minced | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom, crushed
instructions: Place chilies in a dry skillet. Heat for no more than a minute. Pour the hot chilies over the onions. When they start to darken, stir them quickly or they will burn. Sprinkle the cardamom over the top. Allow to cool to room temperature and serve.

title: Capellini
ingredients: 1 jar olives | 250 -300 fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Drain all liquid off of the olives and chop finely. Prepare a bowl with a lid. Put olive oil in it at the corner of the bowl and put olive oil and chopped spinach in it. Mix it well. Put it on the table in a clear glass dish, pour olive oil from the jar on top of the spinach in the bowl. Enjoy a cold glass of ice cold water on the side.

Random Ingredients: sugar,chipotle chili sauce,tapioca,chili sauce,black pepper,cream celery soup,raspberry
title: Chili Sour Cream Dipping Sauce With Raspberries and Chili.
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can low-fat sweet chili sauce | 1 packet granulated sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground chili powder or 1 teaspoon chipotle chili sauce | 2 teaspoons tapioca | fresh ground black pepper | 1 lb fresh raspberry, cleaned and stemmed ( not frozen! ) | chili sauce
instructions: In a medium size mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients. Toss to mix well. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,pumpkin pie spice,ice water,cilantro leaf,egg yolk,xanthan gum,chili sauce
title: Gingered Pumpkin Custard
ingredients: 2 cups peeled diced fresh pumpkin ( about ) or 2 cups winter squash ( about ) | 1 cup ice water, to soften pumpkin | 4 large egg yolks | 1 large vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 tablespoon light chili sauce | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro leaf | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Lightly oil or melt 2 tbsp of the giner in a saucepan over medium. Combine egg yolks and remaining giner in mixing bowl. Whisk lightly until the mixture starts to foam. Transfer mixture to a separate bowl and whip until fluffy. Set aside. Using a potato masher, mashing squash with your fingertips or the back of a wooden spoon to form coarse strands. Dissolve vanilla bean in a little warm water just until mixture starts to foam, about 1 minute. Stir in chili sauce and cilantro leaves. Set aside. Using a medium saucepan bring 6 cups cold water to a boil.. In a large bowl, whisk together egg yolk mixture and pumpkin mixture until well blended. Divide mixture among prepared 8 cups. Cover, and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours or until set. Remove from refrigerator and serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,venison,leek,pistachio nut,raisin,stew meat,baby lima bean,stewing beef
title: Beef and Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cubed | 1 can baby lima beans | 12 baby shrimp | 2 teaspoons raisins | 3 small leeks, cleaned and sliced | 1 tablespoon pistachio nut, slivered | 1/2 teaspoon ground venison, or other ground veal ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons candied cherries ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons candied citron, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place stew meat into crock pot. Pour undrained lima beans over meat. Slice leeks, or if using leeks, and scatter with pistachio nuts. Add meat to crockpot and toss. Place lamb on top of vegetables and sprinkle with venison and cherries, if using. Cook until meat is tender and flavors combine, about 4 hours.

title: Green Tea (Or Beer)
ingredients: 1 1 cup mild green curry paste | 1/4 cup sweet dark beer | 1/4 cup fresh horseradish, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover and set aside while preparing your chosen teas. Bring water to a boil in a small saucepan, then decrease heat to medium and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Strain into a heat proof pitcher or pitcher. Serve hot or cold with assorted greens and a light beer. Enjoy.

title: Budget Beef Sirloin Rounds
ingredients: 10 sirloin, thin sliced | 3 green onions, cut into 4 | 2 1/2 cups cake flour | vegetable oil, for frying | 1 package beef gravy or ( 12 ounce ) package gravy, gravy mix
instructions: Heat 1/4 inch oil to medium high in large skillet. Dip both sides of each piece of sirloin in flour. Place each piece in oil. Quickly fry each piece over high heat. Remove each piece with slotted spoon. Place on paper towel lined plate. Repeat with second piece. After all the sirloin is cooked remove any remaining sirloin pieces in skillet. Set the sirloin pieces aside and wipe skillet clean. Return pan to medium high heat. Add 3 tablespoons gravy mix and cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Heat gravy mix over low heat until thickened. Pour over sirloin pieces. Serve hot.

title: Pasta Pastitsio (Macaroni and Noodles)
ingredients: 3 cups elbow macaroni ( or other large pasta ) | 1/3 cup cake flour or 1/3 cup cake flour | 1 teaspoon finely snipped chives
instructions: Cook macaroni by weight on boiling water until al dente. In a bowl, mix the flour and chives. Drain the macaroni. When pasta is cooked, drain the water and stir in the flour and water mixture,. Bring to a boil.

title: Korean-Style Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 cup caster sugar | 400 g hamburger
instructions: Lightly grease your hands with oil. Place sugar in a bowl and place the meat in. Toss gently to combine. Lightly oil a bbq/bbq plate. Place the meat on top and cook for 5 minutes on each side. Allow to rest for 2 minutes before removing from the grill. Serve with korean barbeque sauce. Yum.

Random Ingredients: thyme,jumbo pasta shell,tilapia fillet,lime,sharp cheddar cheese,tomato soup,brown sugar
title: Jamaican Street Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 package jumbo pasta shells | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 3 tablespoons fresh thyme, chopped | 2 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 lime, cut into wedges | 3 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cook pasta shells according to package directions and drain well.

Random Ingredients: wheat pastry flour,chili pepper flake,guajillo chilies,kahlua,vidalia onion,liverwurst,mushroom
title: Grilled Baked Liverwurst
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 2 teaspoons guajillo chilies | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili peppers flakes | 1/2 lb liverwurst, sliced lengthwise | 6 mushrooms, chopped medium | 3 tablespoons kahlua or 3 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1 large vidalia onion, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat grill. Combine flour, 1 teaspoon chilies, chili flakes and remaining 1/2 teaspoon chile flakes, and stir into liverwurst in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: salad leaf,mozzarella cheese,ketchup,pork tenderloin,fennel bulb,lettuce,roast beef,bay leaf
title: Sicilian Roast Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lbs small roast beef, sliced thinly | 2 large fennel bulbs, thick tip, cut into 3/4 inch slices | 1 garlic bulb | 1 -3 ounce ketchup or 1 -3 ounce tomato sauce, good quality | 1 1/2 - 2 cups salad leaves, loosely packed | 2 whole wheat sandwich rolls | 2 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 12 slices fontina or 12 slices provolone cheese
instructions: In a large skillet, over medium high heat, saute tenderloins, fennel, ketchup, and garlic. Add meat, stir and cook until meat is browned and vegetables are tender. Cut off ends and slice into large wedges, discard stems and fat. Place salad leaves onto rolls, top with roast beef, then cheese, overlapping slightly. Wrap with foil and warm in 200 degree oven for 1 hour. Cut into 4 slices using a serrated knife, or cut out bread slices from the sandwich rolls.

title: Maple Syrup Dilled Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 1 bunch fresh dill | 4 cups chicken stock ( or low sodium instant chicken stock ) | 1 scallion, finely chopped | grand marnier or orange juice
instructions: Boil the stock or stock until it has become clear, then remove from the heat and stir in the maple syrup until well blended. Set aside. Separate the dill, and cut off the stems. Slice the dill into long thin strips. Cut the scallion into 2 thin slivers. In a skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil on medium high heat and sauté the scallion, 1 tablespoon at a time, until just beginning to turn light gold, about 3 to 5 minutes. Set the cooked scallions aside, and allow them to cool, then mix in the maple syrup mixture. In a microwave safe bowl, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil on medium high heat for 30 second. When the oil is hot, add the dill. Stir and sauté until it is light gold, about 1 minute. Set aside. Wipe the skillet clean with a paper towel, and return it to the stove. Stir to break up any lumps. Add half of the cooled soup base to the pan, and stir to blend it into the base. Add the remaining soup base and scallions and cook for 3 minutes, stirring continuously. Add the maple mixture, and stir to blend all the ingredients together. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, then serve.

title: Artichokes & Ramen
ingredients: 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 1 1/2 packages instant ramen noodles
instructions: Defrost artichokes for 2 or 3 minutes. Tear off an 8 inch square piece of aluminum foil about 10x6 inches. Using either a sharp knife or scissors, cut the bag of ramen noodles into half inch long strips. Pour the frozen artichokes into a bowl of cold water to thaw. Slice the pieces into 1/2 inch long pieces. Drain the artichokes and set aside to use in the next step. Combine the drained ramen noodles and the artichokes in the bowl of hot water. Place the bag of noodles into the bowl with the artichokes. Add the reserved artichokes. Toss to evenly coat. Skins, if necessary, leave the bags open. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place a few artichoke hearts from bag into the pan. Cook, flipping a few times, until the bottom is lightly browned. Place the finished ramen blocks onto the hot pan to brown. Turn the artichokes over and cook until the bottom is lightly browned. Place the ramen noodles onto a plate and wrap with the plastic wrap to prevent sticking. Transfer with tongs into bowls.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,baking powder,saffron strand,yellow bell pepper,orange zest,ginger,beef broth,italian sausage
title: Spanish Sausage and Pepper Ragu
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage, sliced | 1 orange, zest of | 2 yellow bell peppers, sliced | 4 teaspoons orange zest | 4 saffron strands | 1 tablespoon ginger, minced | 2 tablespoons vanilla extract | 3 cups beef broth | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a heavy dutch oven fry the sausages in 1 tbls. Of olive oil until well browned. Remove from pot. Add remaining oil and saute the peppers one minute each. Add zest, ginger and saffron, then add beef broth and simmer a few minutes, stirring to combine. Add baking powder and simmer 1 minute more. Add the sausage slices, simmer an additional 2 - 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Vegetable Bhaji
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh tomatoes, quartered | 1/2 small cabbage, chopped ( red or green is best ) | 1/8 cup pimiento, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon spices | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Combine everything, except tomatoes and cabbage, in a casserole dish. Cover and bake at 325f for 20 - 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,chicken stock cube,chipotle chile,white wine,red chili powder
title: Aubergine's Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 5 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 2 1/2 cups white wine ( i use mexican cabernet sauvignon ) | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock cubes | 2 1/2 cups dried chipotle chiles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large mixing bowl and leave to rest for a couple of hours at least. Heat oil in casserole dish or heavy saucepan. Scoop small quantities of sauce into saucepan and stir constantly over medium heat for 3 mins or until sauce turns dark red colour.

title: Creamy Caper & Orange Bites
ingredients: 250 g cream-style cottage cheese | 4 tablespoons capers | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Mix all filling ingredients & put mixture in an oven dish lined with aluminium foil. Sprinkle lightly with caster sugar. Bake at 180c for 30 - 35 minutes or until the cheese is soft.

title: Creamy Italian Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 box egg noodles | 1/3 cup light brown rice, uncooked | 1 cup pizza sauce ( your favorite ) | 1 cucumber ( peeled, seeded, chopped or shredded ) | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cook noodles according to package directions set aside. While noodles are cooking in microwave combine rice, pizza sauce, cucumber, cream and coffee. Stir to combine. Drain cooked noodles and add to noodle mixture.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,elbow macaroni,arborio rice,pinto bean,egg,sausage,marinara sauce
title: Rice and Ham Casserole
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 cups dry elbow macaroni, broken into 1 inch pieces | 2 cups marinara sauce | 3 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 eggs | 2 cups cooked jumbo fresh pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup uncooked arborio rice
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large skillet, cook sausage in oil over medium heat until browned. Remove sausage and onion from skillet, and set aside. In a medium bowl, toss pasta with 1/4 cup of pasta sauce. Arrange half the pasta in a 3 quart casserole dish, then add half the sausage, then half the pinto beans. Repeat layers, ending with sausage. Pour remaining sauce over everything, and sprinkle with remaining pasta. Bake, covered, for 45 minutes. Uncover, and continue baking for 30 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Sprinkle with remaining pasta. To make rice, bring 2 cups of water to boil in saucepan, then add rice. Cover, and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 10 minutes, then remove from heat and allow to stand covered for 15 minutes. Fluff rice and allow to sit a few minutes before serving.

title: Easy Beans(Yummie)
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon bottled minced garlic | 1/4 teaspoon finely minced fresh cardamom pods ( optional ) | pierce bread or toast, toasted | tabasco sauce
instructions: Drain and rinse beans with cold water. Mash beans with potato masher or a fork, adding garlic, cardamom and tabasco sauce to taste. Cook over low heat, stirring often, until mixture is heated through and beginning to thicken, about 20 minutes. Serve warm over bread or toast.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,vanilla extract,black tea,aubergine,puff pastry,poblano chile,mirin,fine vermicelli
title: Black-Tongue French Toast
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry | 2 tablespoons ground black tea or 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice | 1 tablespoon fine vermicelli or 1 tablespoon finely minced pomegranate | 3 poblano chiles or 2 anaheim chilies, roughly chopped | 3 eggs | 7 tablespoons mirin | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 8 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place poblanos on a foil lined baking sheet and roast them on oven rack, turning occasionally, for 25 minutes or until aromatic and wrinkled. Allow to cool. Remove and discard pith from chiles. Cut chiles lengthwise into 6 wedges. Remove cores and seeds from chiles and finely chop. Place chiles in a bowl, pour boiling water over them until they have absorbed most of the water, then drain. In a medium bowl, whisk together all remaining ingredients, reserving enough liquid to moisten, add chiles and mix well. Heat a 10 inch nonstick frying pan or frying pan over medium heat, add pastry, shaking off excess moisture, and cook, stirring often, for 6 to 8 minutes or until golden brown. While pastry is cooking, set aside a small baking sheet so that it doesn't dry out while it cooks. Place a slice or two of the bread on each piece of toast and spoon the black tea mixture over the top. Sprinkle with remaining bread and serve hot.

title: Queso Blanco (Stuffed Peppers with Brandy)
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper ( hot pepper ) | 5 ounces sliced cream cheese | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking oats ( not instant ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons hershey's brandy ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons whiskey, may use a mild-sweet liquor ( optional )
instructions: Cut poblano pepper in half lengthwise and remove seeds and membrane on inside pepper. Remove stem, and discard. Slice pepper half lengthwise and remove seeds. Rinse and pat pepper dry with paper towels,. Place cream cheese inside pepper, spread with oats, and top with pepper on top. Sprinkle lightly with hershey's, if using. Melt a tbsp of butter, pour over mixture and serve at once, with chips.

title: Raspberry Beer (For Canning)
ingredients: 1 cup raspberries, cleaned | 12 ounces beer ( select a good brand ) | 2 pints raspberries, washed
instructions: Place raspberries in a pot. Heat raspberries on low heat until soft. Place about 6 pints of beer in a gallon sized canning jar. Using a holder carefully remove raspberries from can. Place the raspberries in the canning jar, making sure the cans are covered by the juice. Carefully, slide the can back into the canning canning canner. Close lid and set temperature to 225°f. Process for 10 minutes. If liquid has evaporated or the raspberries are not yet soft, continue to process. Remove from canner and let cool. Refrigerate indefinitely or keep in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

title: Sandy's Savory Vegetable Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs velveeta cheese | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 - 1 1/2 cup diced leftover meat or 1 -1 1/2 cup ham | 1 cup buttermilk ( to coat dip )
instructions: Add the velveeta, yoghurt and meat to a crockpot. Add buttermilk and let it warm up for about 15 minutes. Serve with sliced up vegetables.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,fig,ladyfinger,red pepper,sage leaf,large shrimp,pizza sauce,beef bouillon
title: Fig and Shrimp Mini Spicy Sicilian Shrimp Bake
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-sodium fat free pizza sauce | 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 lb uncooked large shrimp, peeled halved lengthwise, tails left on | 1/2 cup fat free refried beans | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves, crushed | 1 1/2 lbs fresh figs, halved and sliced crosswise | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1/4 teaspoon beef bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Grease a 9 x 13 inch baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine pizza sauce and 1 1/2 t. Brushing the bread with a pastry brush. Arrange the ladyfingers in overlapping rows across the bottom of the baking sheet. Top with the shrimp, then spread the refried beans over them. Sprinkle with the sage, crushed red pepper, and beef bouillon. Top with the remaining bread, pressing down slightly. Bake at 375°f for 35 minutes until crust is light brown. Serve warm.

title: Celery-French Dip
ingredients: 6 tablespoons low-sodium cream of celery soup | 1 tablespoon salad oil
instructions: In a small bowl, combine soup and oil. Serve chilled on tostados and serve with crackers.

title: Easy Italian Orzo for 1
ingredients: 2 cups dried orzo pasta | 1 tablespoon green bell pepper | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt, or to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add uncooked orzo pasta, and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain into a bowl, and set aside to cool, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the bell pepper, and salt. Cook and stir until browned and tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in the orzo, and continue cooking until heated through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ham,picante sauce,tomato puree,cardamom pod,texas toast bread
title: Tex-Mex Sopaipillas (Tex-Mex Sopaipillas)
ingredients: 2 large whole-grain sandwich-size texas toast thick bread, torn into pieces | 2 teaspoons tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 1/2 cups shredded cooked ham, divided | 4 tablespoons picante sauce, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Spread the bread pieces on a cookie sheet and sprinkle with half the tomato puree and cardamom. Bake in the preheated oven until the bread is golden, about 6 to 10 minutes. Spread the ham across one side of each bread piece. Spoon 3 tablespoons picante sauce onto the ham. Top with the second slice of bread. Broil until the cheese is melted and starting to brown, about 3 minutes. Flip onto a serving plate and top with the remaining tomato puree and cardamom. Serve immediately.

title: Pizzas - Restaurant-Style Salad
ingredients: 2 dozen iceburg lettuce | 4 ounces jalapenos, sliced and halved | 4 ounces italian style breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon sliced orange peel, thin strips | 1/2 cup cake flour
instructions: Cut out the very top end of the iceberg lettuce. Shred. Remove the very hard stems with your fingers. Tear or cut any large leaves of the lettuce into large chunks. Core the jalapenos. Seed and finely chop them. Mix the jalapenos with the breadcrumbs in a large bowl, add half and half. Dip the jalapenos in the flour for a few seconds on each side to help them stick. Fill the lettuce into a standard muffin tin or a 9 inch flat tin, pressing down gently to help them hollow out just a bit on the edges. Place in the freezer for about 10 - 15 minutes to firm up and soften, then remove the iceburg lettuce from the freezer. Spread out evenly on your work surface and sprinkle heavily with salt. Add the chopped jalapenos and sprinkle liberally with more of your seasoned bread crumbs. Dip one slice of the iceberg lettuce into the flour and then spread with half the cream. Then add the crumb mixture and place back in the freezer on a long platter or cookie sheet lined with plastic wrap pressed on it firmly. Repeat with the remaining slices and make 4 or 5 toothpicks through the lettuce. Put a slice of iceburg lettuce on a plate and place a toothpick through the top of the lettuce, then cut off the top piece. Serve.

title: Niku Shoyu (Korean Beef Rolls)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef flank steak | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 4 firm romaine leaves ( about 3 bunches )
instructions: Combine the soy sauce and half of a can of water. Add steak and marinate in refrigerator for at least 10 minutes. Drain steak, reserving marinade. Place meat on the leaves and roll tightly. Make sure it has a good seal. Place in shallow bamboo steamer or pot that has been coated with cooking spray. Cover with a large plate or platter and heat in microwave for 5 minutes. Serve with white rice.

title: Minted Tofu and Tofu Salad from the Mint Tree
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 1/2 cup yellow mustard seeds | 10 fresh mint leaves or 2 teaspoons dried mint leaves | 1 tablespoon white mustard seeds
instructions: Cut tofu into 1 inch squares. Sprinkle both sides with mustard seeds. Cook tofu in very hot, oiled skillet over medium high heat until golden brown. Drain. Set aside to cool slightly. When cool enough to handle, carefully scrape tofu from center into mixing bowl. Dice the tofu. Mix yogurt with tofu. Add mint and remaining mustard seeds. Let sit about 10 minutes for flavors to meld, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,lemon zest,pimiento,lemon juice,romano cheese,pepper flake,spanish onion,shiitake mushroom
title: Sicilian Style Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons pepper flakes | 1 cup spanish onion, diced | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, coarsely grated | 1 jar pimientos, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup craked lemon juice | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | grated romano cheese or parmesan cheese, if desired
instructions: In a skillet cook mushrooms in lemon juice over medium heat, stirring constantly, about 10 minutes, until very crisp tender. Remove from skillet, cover and set aside. Cover and keep warm over very low heat, stirring frequently, until mushrooms are completely cooked. Stir in the onion, lemon zest, pimientos, craked lemon juice, cranberries and hot pepper flakes. Serve mushroom mixture and garnish with grated cheese.

title: Thai Spiced Tomato Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato paste, diluted with | 1 cup water | 1/3 - 1/2 cup coconut oil
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth. Strain through a fine sieve/well ventilated room. Serve with cooked or roasted meats for a tasty stew.

title: Mexican Beans With Pesto and Pimientos
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drained & rinsed well | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained & well chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup diced pimiento | 1/2 bunch of jalapenos or 1/2 handful of fresh pimento, finely diced into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 lime, juice of | 1/2 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non stick saucepan or crockpot. Cover & cook on low for 4 - 5 hours, or on high for 3 hours. Discard the bay leaf. Serve warm or cool and serve.

title: Indian Nasi Sodi (Strawberries and Rice Dessert)
ingredients: 1 sheet of azafarani pasta | 2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 3 cups fresh strawberries, hulled and halved | 4 whole cardamom seeds | 10 whole cloves | 3 whole dried red chile peppers | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Boil the pasta 7 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Basic Baking Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: Combine all ingredients, and mix well. Use your hands to mix mixture until it forms a fine powder.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,seasoning italian salad dressing mix,ricotta cheese,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Easy Cheese and Parmesan Cheese Lasagna
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ricotta cheese | 1 package good seasonings italian salad dressing mix, prepared according to package directions | 1 container sour cream, divided | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning ( any italian salad dressing )
instructions: Put ricotta in a large bowl. Add 1 teaspoon of the Good Seasonings, sour cream and 1/8 teaspoon of the seasoning mix. Mix until well mixed and well blended and creamy. Spread the ricotta mixture on a lightly oiled foil lined baking sheet. Repeat until all the ingredients are used, making sure to coat with the olive oil. Bake at 350 degrees farenheit for 30 to 40 minutes, or until topping is golden brown. Note, when i bake this dish for an hour it may not brown all the way, so try a fork test if it does. Scoop out the cheesecakes and spread with a fork.

title: Baked Vegetables, from Vegetarian Times
ingredients: 500 g broccoli florets | 3 tablespoons red capsicums, thinly sliced | 1 bagouette, halved lengthways, sliced | 600 ml stock ( beef or chicken or fish may be used ) | 2 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or mark grease a 5cm x 23cm slice pan with oil, then line the base of the pan with the phyllo pastry. Brush the pastry with oil and lay the whole pack of pastry on top. Spread over the vegetables and sprinkle with the capsicum. Layer over the remaining pastry with the remaining vegetables, starting with the phyllo sheets and finishing with the tops. Bake for 35 minutes. Set out and cut into wedges to serve.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,tea,dark sesame oil,whipping cream,palm sugar
title: Chinese Barley Cream
ingredients: 3 cups pearl barley or 3 cups wild brown lentils, washed and drained | 1 1/2 cups hot tea | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons light palm sugar ( superfine ) or 2 tablespoons brown sugar syrup | 1/2 cup whipping cream ( double the cream of wheat )
instructions: Place the rice in a sieve, cover well with the water mixture and leave overnight or for at least 8 hours. Cook the barley in boiling water for 20 minutes, drain and set aside. Dissolve the sugar in the hot tea and pour over the barley, stirring briskly until just absorbed. Add the oil and stir well to combine. Whip the cream with the syrup and fold into the barley and sugar mixture. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Daikon Spritz
ingredients: 14 -16 ounces daikon sprouts | 12 ounces chocolate | 1/2 cup pecans | 1 cup regular barbecue sauce
instructions: Place sprouts in a medium saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a low boil. In a microwavable bowl, melt chocolate and nuts on medium high heat, stirring often. When all the bits are melted, continue stirring to avoid burning. Scoop out spritz with a slotted spoon, and sprinkle with remaining nuts. Enjoy.

title: Pan Seared Halibut
ingredients: 4 halibut, bone in, skinned | 1/4 orange peel | 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated ( or try vegemite ) | 4 slices halloumi cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Put halibut in a roasting pan with the orange peel on one side only. Place the ouzo on the other side of the halibut. Bake for about 15 to 20 minutes until well flakey. While the halibut is baking, sprinkle the parmigio over the halved halibut. Cut up the cheese into chunks. Remove the halibut from the oven and let sit for 30 minutes. Strain the juices from the pan and serve.

title: Pesto-Milled French Toast
ingredients: 12 egg roll wraps | 3/4 cup packed brown onion | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/4 cup light corn syrup, divided
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the onion and basil. Brush the wraps with 1 tablespoon of pesto and sprinkle with some of the onion/basil mixture. Roll up and wrap each up. In a 12 nonstick skillet, heat remaining 1 tablespoon pesto and corn syrup together and add the coated rolls. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,hummus,rum,chicken wing,water,kernel corn,superfine sugar,asiago cheese
title: Spicy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings, wing tips removed | 2 quarts water | 10 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1/2 cup rum | 1/2 cup hummus | 1/2 cup whole kernel corn, drained | 4 slices rye bread, about 3 inches thick | asiago cheese ( for topping )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Butter a baking sheet. Cut each wing thigh in half and remove wing tips. Rinse excess oil from wings and place them in a large pot. Add water, sugar, rum and hummus. Bring to a boil over high heat, then boil, uncovered, 45 minutes, turning chicken and separating pieces every 15 minutes. Toast bread in a separate skillet for a few minutes. Sprinkle each piece with asaguayan salt and place under broiler. Heat remaining olive oil in a small pot over medium heat until smoking. Add bread to bread and fry, stirring often, until golden, about 2 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve with asaguayan bread.

title: Salt and Pepper Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup crushed crabmeat | 2 teaspoons pickling spice ( salt if necessary )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in a clean tumbler.

title: Blueberry & Chilli Fry
ingredients: 1/4 cup flax seed | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries ( approx ) | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 8 soft tortillas, warmed | 1 tablespoon gluten free flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c fan/gas put the flax seeds and blueberries in a bowl & crush with a pestle. Stir in the chilli oil, then season. Arrange the tortillas in an ovenproof dish. Spoon in the blueberry & chilli mix, then bake, uncovered, for 12 - 15 mins, until golden & crisp. Serve warm with more chilli & flaxseed dressing if you like.

title: Crock Pot Spanish Style Barbecued Beef
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 jar spaghetti sauce ( pace picante al ajo brand with chili added ) | 4 -6 ounces instant rice | paprika
instructions: Rub ground paprika in the brisket. Pour jar of sauce over brisket. Cover and cook for 7 - 8 hours on low. Remove brisket with tongs, if the sauce is drying out, and place on a serving platter. Drain most of the liquid from the roasting jar, cover with foil, and let rest 15 minutes. Slice brisket into thin slices and serve with rice, spaghetti sauce, and desired amount of leftover sauce. A nice change from regular barbecue sauce is to use green chili sauce.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate seed,lobster,chicken broth,red kidney bean,chicken wing,cumin seed,cornstarch,pie crust
title: Spicy Lobster and Kidney Bean pie
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds | 24 ounces lobster, cooked, shelled and cooked | 3/4 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon ground pomegranate seeds | 1 unbaked pie crust ( optional ) | 3 -3 cups cooked chicken wings, thawed if frozen
instructions: Combine the lobster, kidney beans and broth in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,shallot,ra el hanout spice mix,irish cream,cumin,guacamole,cashew,red onion
title: Creamy Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb raw cashews | 1/2 cup red onion, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons shallots, minced | 1 1/4 cups guinness stout or 1 1/4 cups stout beer | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/3 cup irish cream or 1/3 cup brandy | 2 teaspoons cumin | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Rinse cashews and place in bowl with onions and shallots. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Add cashews to blender container, blend until smooth. Store in refrigerator for up to 5 days.

title: Spicy Chocolate Bocconcini
ingredients: 3 ounces bocconcini, crushed | 1 ounce chives, chopped | 1/2 ounce nu salt substitute | 3 ounces coffee, cold
instructions: Mix all ingrdients well together in the pot. Let set over night. Stir to make sure the spices are dissovled. Let chill if desired. Enjoy as is or over ice cream.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,salt black pepper,ice cream,cake flour
title: Apple Tart
ingredients: 1 cake flour, plus extra for dusting | 4 tart apples | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 200 ml ice cream, to serve
instructions: Place the flour on a board, add the butter and with your fingers, roll the mix into a sausage shape. Turn out onto a floured surface and roll out until very thin slice 2 1/2 inch thick cut out the top and brush with olive oil. Place the sliced apples on top and season with salt and pepper and cover with a damp cloth for about 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 220°c place the pastry on a high shelf in the oven and bake for 10 minutes until golden brown. Remove to a warm oven, stand for about 10 minutes then cut into 3cm wedges. Serve with icecream.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,broth,lime zest,apple juice,coriander seed,chicken wing
title: Chicken Kebab
ingredients: 10 chicken wings | 4 grape tomatoes | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups broth | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 2 teaspoons grated lime zest | 1/2 cup lime juice
instructions: Place chicken wings in a saucepan and cover with boiling water until tender, 2 - 3 minutes remove wings from pan to a bowl and rinse with cold water, drain off excess water. Place tomatoes and chicken stock in a saucepan over medium high heat. Cover and bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer 3 - 5 minutes or until tomatoes are soft and reduced to half. Add chicken to tomatoes and simmer 5 - 7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove chicken from tomato mixture, then transfer to a plate and refrigerate. Combine coriander seeds, lime zest and juice to taste in a small bowl. Spread over chicken and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: red wine,irish cream,sirloin,chili pepper flake,parmesan cheese
title: Irish-American Sandwich
ingredients: 6 slices italian bread ( toasted or your favorite bread ) | 1 lb ground sirloin | 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes | 1 can of chopped jalapenos or 4 roasted chili peppers, with liquid | 1 cup parmesan cheese or 1 cup asiago cheese, shredded
instructions: Brown meat and peppers over medium heat until meat is done. Add cheese and stir until melted and well mixed. Cover and place in refrigerator for 30 minutes or more. Toast under a hot grill until lightly browned. Serve on toasted and crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: green olive,stir fry sauce,beef chuck roast,orange,salad green,chili sauce
title: Gluten-Free Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast | 1 can green olives | 1 cup thai chili sauce | 1/2 cup thai red hot sauce | 1/2 cup bottled shrimp salad dressing ( any flavor ) | 1 orange, in thin wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place the roast in the slow cooker. Drain olives, reserving juice. Place in large bowl and add remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly with spoon. Pour sauce over beef. Cover and cook on high setting for 3 hours. Slice beef and serve on sandwich rolls with the juice.

title: Apple Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 4 cups cooked rice noodles ( i used fresh cooked asparagus ) | 1/2 1/2 cup apple or 1/2 cup pineapple ( peeled, cored, chopped ) | 14 ounces nonfat sour cream | 2 tablespoons light butter beans ( use 2 tblsp if you want more spice ) | 1 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water and drain again. In medium bowl, combine sour cream, butter beans, and flour. Gradually stir in cooked noodles. Gently mix in the noodles and sour cream mixture. Pour into 4 large, shallow casserole dish. Bake 30 - 45 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned on top.

title: Mango Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 ripe mango, peeled, deseeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 1/4 cup flaked iceberg lettuce | 2 teaspoons chopped canned chili peppers or 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine mango, almonds, lettuce, chili pepper flakes and seasoning in a bowl. Serve with icecream and/or cool whip or cream.

Random Ingredients: szechuan peppercorn,egg beater substitute,onion soup mix
title: Chinese Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 1 jar onion soup mix | 3 cups egg beaters | 1/4 cup szechuan peppercorns
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and put in the slow cooker. Beat egg whites until stiff and add to soup. Cook for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, on medium.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,vanilla bean,grape,bacon,cauliflower,raisin,mint leaf,artichoke heart
title: Pierogi Toss
ingredients: 4 lbs frozen pierogi ( fresh small, frozen or frozen ) | 1 cup crumbled bacon ( leftovers bacon can be frozen in a little bag ) | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained ( save juice ) | 1 pint fresh grape | 1 pint fresh mushrooms ( save juice ) | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 pinch of dried crushed mint leaves | 1/2 small vanilla bean, split in half lengthwise
instructions: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp. Add mushrooms and saute 5 minutes. Add reserved juice, bouillon granules and vanilla extract. Turn down heat and simmer for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally or just until it bubbles again. Set aside to cool. Pour into large freezer freezer freezer bags. Add frozen pierogis and raisins. Label and freeze. Bake in 350 degree oven on a cookie sheet with edges until golden brown. Cut into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut,pork,lump crabmeat,bean sprout,yellow pea,corn oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,spinach
title: Lump Crab Cakes With Spinach and Peas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 cups fresh spinach ( washed and coarsely torn into bite-size pieces ) | 15 ounces lump crabmeat, drained well ( in the can or refrigerated overnight ) | 1/3 cup crumbled parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/3 cup drained yellow split peas ( drained canned yellow peas can be used for a substitute ) or 1/3 cup peas ( drained canned yellow peas can be used for a substitute ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | pinch coconut, shaved ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a nonstick frying pan. Add the spinach and crab meat and saute for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Dees French Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can solid white tuna, drained | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 lb crab or 1/2 lb lamb liver, quartered if large | 1 cup catalfish fillet, drained
instructions: In a dutch oven, saute lamb cubes over medium high heat until brown. Stir in tuna. Cover and simmer 10 - 15 minutes. Stir in flour, bring to a boil. Stirring constantly, cook 3 - 5 minutes or until thickened slightly. Stir in catfish and cook 2 - 3 minutes or until fish is curled & flakes.

Random Ingredients: korean red pepper flake,anchovy paste,lobster tail,feta cheese,saffron thread,raisin
title: Lobster Stuffed Feta
ingredients: 18 ounces lobster tails, about 24 | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon chile paste or 1 tablespoon korean red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/4 cup seedless raisin | 5 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Wash and cook lobster in boiling water until cooked through, about 15 minutes. Drain well and pat dry. Slice the center of half the lobster lengthwise into four equal pieces. Place the shell side down in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pile on the cooked lobster pieces and sprinkle with anchovy paste, chile paste, saffron and raisins. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Potatoes and Apricots
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes | 6 lbs firm apricot, quartered | 2 -3 tablespoons bottled hot sauce | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 3/4 cup red wine vinegar ( preferably greek )
instructions: Cut up the apricots into chunks by hand or process in a food processor. Dry them on paper towels. Place in a large bowl. Mix in 3/4 cup of the hot sauce and the seasoning, adding more or less hot sauce to taste. The potatoes will be moist but not mushy. Toss them over the bowl until evenly coated. Set out in the refrigerator until flavors are well mixed. Preheat over to 450 degrees farenheit. Butter and flour a large 10 inch baking pan. Spread half of the potatoes across the bottom and up the sides of the pan. Layer the apricots and apricots evenly across the top. Spread the remaining potatoes evenly across the top and around the apricots. Spread the remaining apricots and apricots over the top of the potatoes. Dot the top with a kitchen brush dipped in oil. Sprinkle the top with the remaining 1/2 cup of hot sauce, if desired. Bake in pre heated oven for 20 - 25 minutes, or until the potato skins is cooked.

title: Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 8 beef short ribs ( each about 2 pound ) | heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat broiler. Wrap each beef short rib with a double thickness of heavy duty foil and place in a small broiler proof casserole. Broil about 5 inches from the heat 4 to 5 minutes, until just beginning to turn golden brown. Turn ribs and broil about 3 minutes. Pour 1/4 cup cream into a shallow dish.

title: Orange Peel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely grated
instructions: Heat oil in a small frying pan over medium low heat. Add orange peel and stir fry until fragrant and lightly browned. Let cool and store in a small airtight container.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,garlic butter,rump roast,cumin seed,pita bread,paprika,lemon lime beverage
title: Cubano Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast | 2 tablespoons pimento-garlic flavored garlic butter | 2 tablespoons smoked paprika | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 4 tablespoons lemon-lime beverage | 6 hoisin sauce, to taste | 2 pita breads, warmed
instructions: Cut meat into serving size pieces, then place in roaster or baking pan. Sprinkle with pimento/garlic flavored butter. Combine paprika, cumin seeds, lime beverage and hoisin sauce and pour over meat. Cover tightly and marinade refrigerated overnight. Place a piece of foil on top of each portion and heat in microwave for 3 minutes, until hot. Serve each person with a drizzle of sauce for dipping or toasting pita bread.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chili sauce,orange juice,jeera powder,orzo pasta,red currant,chipotle chile,brown sugar
title: Joram's Pasta With Glazed Chipotle, Orange and Chilli
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated orange juice | 1 tablespoon minced chipotle chile ( aji no pobado will also work ) | 1 tablespoon minced chipotle chili sauce | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chiles, seeded and minced ( aji no pobado ) | 0.5 bag dried jeharaio rice noodles | 2 teaspoons pureed chipotle chili sauce | 1 tablespoon pureed chipotle chile | 1/4 cup dried red currants | 1 tablespoon minced chipotle chile | 1 teaspoon pureed chipotle chile | 1 tablespoon sazon goya or 1 tablespoon jalapeno chile | 1 tablespoon dry anise pod
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the orange juice, chipotle and chile sauce, brown sugar, 1 tablespoon of the chipotle puree, dried chipotle, sazon and sugar. Bring to a boil over medium heat, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the flavors are well blended, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Remove from heat. Add the noodles and stir to separate. Cover and let sit until they are fluffy, about 5 minutes. Drain, and transfer noodles to a large bowl. Stir in the chipotle mixture and orange juice mixture remaining in the bowl. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add the dried chipotle, orange and chillie puree and stir to combine. Spoon in a small roasting pan, and roast the noodles at 450°f until the inside of the noodles becomes crisp and golden, 3 to 5 minutes. Serve hot. To prepare the chipotle chile sauce, in a small saucepan, combine the remaining 2 tablespoons chipotle puree, the dried anise pods and chili sauce and dry anise. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the anise pods become fragrant, about 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat, set aside to cool. When cool, store in the refrigerator in a small bowl.

title: Caramelized Chilies with Garlic
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 1/2 lbs serrano chili, seeded and thinly sliced lengthwise into 1/8-inch slices ( about ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or heavy skillet over moderately high heat until just smoking, then sauté the chilies, tossing them, until they are very dark and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Add the sesame oil and thyme and simmer the chilies, stirring occasionally, until they are very fragrant, about 10 minutes. Season the sauce with salt.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,black grape,mustard seed,onion powder,oregano leaf,heavy cream
title: Quick Cauliflower-Grape Soup
ingredients: 1 small onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground mustard seeds | 1 large cauliflower, coarsely chopped coarsely | 1 pint black grapes, halved | 1/2 cup heavy cream ( may need up to 1/2 cup more ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling water, blanch the onion in the water for 1 minute. Drain and set aside. Puree in a blender or food processor until smooth. Set aside. In a large soup pot or soup pot over medium high heat, stir in the mustard seeds. Let them get a bit bubbly and then add the cauliflower. Stir in the mustard seeds and cook for 1 minute. Add the grape halves, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until the grapes turn a light green color. Take off the heat. Add a couple of tablespoons of the cream and the oregano. Ladle the soup into bowls. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: almond,goya sazon,red chili pepper flake,cottage cheese,canadian bacon
title: Low Fat French Cheese
ingredients: 1 package fat-free cottage cheese | 1/4 cup fresh goya sazon | 0.5 package canadian bacon ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon of crushed red chili pepper flake | 1 tablespoon blanched almond, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Blend cottage cheese until smooth adding sazon and the canadian bacon. Add crushed chili pepper flakes and almonds. Mix well. Refrigerate for a couple hours to blend flavors.

title: Steamed Tamarind Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light dark soy sauce | 60 g button mushrooms | 30 g tamarind pulp | 1/2 small orange
instructions: Rinse the mushrooms, remove the stalks and cut the caps into small pieces. Cut the juice and zest from the orange into thin slices and place on a microwaveable serving dish with a cover. Place a microwave proof dish with a lid on top, add the dark soy sauce and microwave on high for 6 minutes. Take off the microwave dish and stir once the sauce has been incorporated. Sprinkle the mushrooms with the orange zest and drizzle the soy sauce over them. Leave to set for 5 minutes. Garnish with fresh orange zest and serve with steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,beef brisket,sage leaf,kosher salt,vermouth,teriyaki sauce,parsley leaf,italian breadcrumb
title: Crock Pot Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 2 lbs fresh brussels sprouts, halved or 1 1/2 lbs frozen brussels sprouts, thawed | 1 -3 lb beef brisket, fat trimmed | 2 tablespoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 12 fresh sage leaves, divided | 2 tablespoons parsley leaves, chopped | kosher salt
instructions: Combine teriyaki sauce and vermouth in a large crockpot on high for 3 - 4 hours, until mixture is bubbly and syrupy. Turn crockpot on low. Add brussels sprouts, 1 3/4 lbs brisket fat, 1/2 tablespoon sage leaves, parsley leaves, 2 tablespoons kosher salt, and 1/2 tablespoon pepper to crockpot. Cover and cook for 5 - 7 hours on high, or on low for up to 5 hours. Remove brisket from crockpot and shred across the grain into a fine shred. Return to crockpot. Mix brisket into sauce. Serve sauce on the side.

title: Mixed Herb Chicken
ingredients: 4 cups cooked chicken, cut to bite size pieces | 2 tablespoons almond paste | 1/2 cup spanish onion, sliced | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs ( i use basil, rosemary, oregano, and marjoram )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, add the chicken, almond paste and onion to coat. Mix with your hands so everything is covered in the almond and onion mixture. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Sauté until well heated and starting to brown.

title: Beef and Horseradish Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb top round steak, cut 1/4 thick | 8 ounces frozen meatballs, thawed | 2 tablespoons hoagie rolls, split horizontally | 1 bottle red seedless grapes | 4 tablespoons horseradish | 1 cup pickled red grapes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place meat, split rolls, meatballs, hoagie halves, horseradish, and grapes into 12x18 baking pan. Sprinkle with seeds from grapes. Bake uncovered about 40 minutes or until meat is tender.

title: Vegetable Jam
ingredients: 6 cups green cabbage | 1 cup red cabbage | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 cups tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 6 peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Cook all ingredients until tender. Add more juice and lemon juice if desired. Let cool. Pour into sterilized jars.

title: Tropical Fajitas
ingredients: 1 lb fresh hamburger | 1 1/2 leeks | 1 serrano pepper, sliced | 1 package taco seasoning | 1/2 cup dark rum or 1/2 cup rum flavoring | 4 pods cinnamon ( optional ) | 24 baby shrimp, cleaned
instructions: Brown hamburger, cut in small cubes, and then place in slow cooker. Saute leeks and chile until they begin to soften. Add taco seasoning, rum or flavoring, and cinnamon patties to slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours. Add baby shrimp during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Note the mixture may look moist initially, adding more coconut and/or cornstarch, but that's optional.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,black pepper,self rising flour,rice noodle,soya sauce,beef stew meat,chili pepper
title: Mokae - Korean Soy Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in 1-1/4-inch squares ( i like to put the beef in there and use a little salt, but it doesn't burn itself ) | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons chili peppers, minced ( optional ) | 3 1/2 ounces rice noodles, boiled ( banh ban dae ) | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup self rising flour | 1 ounce chocolate, grated ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients except flour and chocolate to a pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Stir and simmer for another 5 - 10 minutes or until the meat is cooked through. Transfer meat into a bowl and toss it lightly. Add flour and chocolate to meat mixture. Mix thoroughly. Roll meat in the mixture to coat well. Let stand for 3 - 5 minutes, then roll in the powdered sugar to coat well, and serve. Alternatively, you can eat this roll up, but after it has cooled a bit, you can let it cool and roll it up as you want.

title: Hot Chilli Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 teaspoon dried red chile, torn | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 onion, thinly sliced | 1 tomatoes, sliced | 8 chicken thighs, skin and fat removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. In small bowl, combine salt, allspice, chilli, orange juice, onions and tomato. Add chicken to bowl.

title: Lentils and Cream of Coconut Soup I
ingredients: 1 can lentils | 2 tablespoons light cream of coconut | cracked black pepper ( optional )
instructions: Bring all ingredients to boil in large saucepan over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes. Reduce heat to moderately low. Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes or until lentils are tender, stirring occasionally. Serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic,jumbo shrimp,parmesan cheese,tilapia fillet,jeera powder,heavy cream
title: Shrimp Florentine
ingredients: 1/4 cup heavy cream | 3 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 teaspoon jeera powder | 1 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 package fresh tilapia fillets | 1 teaspoon cilantro or 1 teaspoon fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Whisk cream, garlic, and janeh in a small bowl or glass measuring cup until blended. Stir shrimp until shrimp is opaque and evenly coated with mixture. Season with salt and pepper. Let stand for 1 - ½ hours. Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat and add the shrimp. Sauté for 2 minutes until just cooked through. Transfer to a platter and sprinkle with cilantro or parsley. Serve at once with pasta or greens.

title: Okra Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb okra | 1 teaspoon bacon fat or 1 teaspoon other neutral oil | 4 -6 slices bacon ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons red curry paste ( depends on the strength desired ) or 2 teaspoons hot red pepper paste ( depends on the strength desired ) | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon garlic ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fresh breadcrumb ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Clean and dice okra, removing stalk and seeds if desired. In a large wok, stir fry okra until nicely browned, about 2 minutes. Remove okra and drain. Set aside. In another wok, heat the bacon fat or oil until crisp. Add curry paste and fry for 1 or 2 minutes. Add okra and fry for 2 or 3 minutes. Add flour and stir fry for about 1 minute. Add garlic and pineapple if desired. Stir fry for 1 or 2 minutes. Return okra to the wok and cook on medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring. Add breadcrumbs and mix well. Serve over rice or with some veggies and maybe some ice cream.

title: Lentils and Nuts with Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentils | 1/4 cup gemelli pasta ( mini ) | 2 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute | 7 tablespoons assorted raw nuts, such as cashew pieces, hazelnuts, pistachios, walnuts, and cashew pieces, lightly toasted
instructions: Pour water into a large soup pot over high and bring to a boil. Add lentils, then cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 8 minutes. Stir in gemelli and cook 1 to 2 minutes longer, stirring. Remove from heat and stir in splenda. Garnish with nuts to serve.

title: Homemade Malt Dressing  (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1/2 cup oatmeal | 1/2 cup minced garlic ( or less ) | 1/2 cup cornstarch ( heaping if it has to be the full fat content! ) | 1/4 cup onion, minced | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 4 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( or more if you like less garlic )
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine all ingredients except vinegar and garlic. Mix it well until cornstarch is incorporated and mixture has the consistency of a light, wet salad dressing. Let sit for at least an hour before serving and then serve.

title: Chunky Pizza Sauce (For Pizza)
ingredients: 4 slices pepperoni | 1 cup tomato juice | 2 chicken stock cubes
instructions: Cook pizza base following pack. Add pepperoni and tomato into a little oil and cook until crispy. Stir in 1 cup of tomato juice. Add 3 cups of chicken stock cube and mix. Serve over fresh baked pizza base.

title: Rice Noodles and Spanish Onions
ingredients: 1 medium spanish onion, sliced | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 14 ounces rice noodles
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to package directions. Drain and cool to room temperature. Add the onion to a large bowl of cold water. Bring to a boil and immediately add rinsed rice noodles. When noodles start to fluff up, remove from heat and stir in onion. Let stand for 3 - 4 minutes to cool. You can serve noodles or rice sticks over the hot rice noodles.

title: Cranberry Sauce III
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh cranberries | 2 tablespoons ground sweetened cranberries | 3 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar, divided
instructions: Place the cranberries and sweetened cranberries in the bowl of a food processor, and process until finely chopped. Heat 2 tablespoons confectioners' sugar in a 2 quart saucepan over medium high heat until sizzling, about 2 minutes. Stir in half of the reserved sugar.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,grain rice,taco flour tortilla,italian salad dressing mix,plum tomato
title: Italian Rice Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing mix | 8 -12 flour tortillas | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 plum tomato, chopped | 6 cups cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Combine salad dressing mix and tortillas, and microwave 1 minute. Divide rice among tortillas, and sprinkle each with cream cheese, tomato and onion. Roll up, and wrap each in foil. Served warm or cold. These freeze very well.

Random Ingredients: apricot,thai fish sauce,gingerroot,pecan,self rising flour,sharp cheddar cheese,black bean
title: Cheesy Crumble
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried apricot, chopped coarse | 1/4 cup dried pecans, chopped coarse | 3 tablespoons self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons ground gingerroot ( or fresh ) | 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup thai fish sauce | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to spray with oil. In a small bowl, combine the apricots, pecans, flour, and ginger and roll into a ball. Transfer to a large mixing bowl and stir in the cheddar and fish sauce. Spread half the salsa equally on the base of an earthenware or glass baking dish. Add the cheese mixture and stir to coat. Spoon half the beans over the top of the cheese in an even layer. Top with the remaining salsa and spanish olives if using. Cover the dish and chill overnight. Bake for 45 minutes. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Baked Cherry Crunch Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup sour cherry or 1/4 cup apricot jam | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon italian dry bread, crumbs | 1 package cornbread mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees and spray 13x9 pan with pam. Mix dry bread crumbs and worcestershire sauce. Add cherries and mix well to coat. Spread mixture evenly into pan. Sprinkle over jam. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes or till bread is a golden brown. Let sit for 5 minutes and then remove to rack.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,cayenne pepper,chili sauce,biscuit,wheat pizza dough,vodka,brussels sprout,pasta shell
title: Spiced Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated biscuit, rounds | 1 cup spicy chili sauce | 1 lb brussels sprout, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 can refrigerated low-fat biscuits ( 2 1/2 x 1-inch squares ) | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 1/2 lbs cold baked pizza dough
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Cut 1 round biscuit from large tube in half. Separate into 2 pieces. Roll each piece to about a 6 in long square. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush tops with 1 1/2 tbsp spicy chili sauce. Bake 12 to 15 minutes, or until golden. Meanwhile, in small bowl, combine vodka, cayenne, asafetida, 1 2/3 tspnano. Remove brussels sprouts from brussels sprouts.

title: Quick and Easy Quick Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 12 slices low-sodium hamburger | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Spread 1 slice of low-sodium hamburger on top of a slice of hamburger to within 1/2 inch of the edges. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Close with the other slice of hamburger and press to compact the sandwiches. Serve hot.

title: Guaranese Roti
ingredients: 500 g ground lean pork | 2 cups arugula | 2 tablespoons chickpea flour
instructions: Combine the ground pork, chickpea flour and chickpea flour and knead into a dough. Divide the dough into 8. Shape each rotisserie into a flat patty, about 10 inches long. Heat your oven to 180c/160c/gas cut the rolled up portion into 8 wedges. Place them on a lightly greased baking tray and cook in your oven until browned and cooked through. Serve with any indian style raita or bread and pickles. Tip 1, cook on medium heat for approximately 15 minutes before adding veggies and letting them cook. Tip 2, you can use the pan juices to make a delicious garlic sauce.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,jalapeno pepper,green chilies,whipping cream,chicken wing,dark chocolate,coconut oil
title: Chunky Coconut Wings
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 3 green chilies, seeded and split lengthwise | 1/4 cup coconut oil | 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 jar roasted dark chocolate, chopped | 1/4 cup sweetened whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix chicken wings with dark brown sugar, sliced green chilies, coconut oil, and jalapenos in a large glass bowl. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 45 minutes. Stir occasionally. Transfer chicken to a serving plate. Add peanut sauce mixture and let stand 10 minutes. Stir in chocolate and cream.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,vanilla essence,orange,dill,vodka,graham cracker crumb,green chili pepper
title: Chilean Cheesecake
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange peel, finely grated | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice or 1/4 cup white vinegar | 3/4 cup instant graham cracker crumbs or 3/4 cup cracker crumbs | 1 small green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons finely chopped dill | 1 tablespoon finely chopped orange peel | fresh fresh orange rind, garnish
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients. Cover and chill thoroughly. Chill completely. Sprinkle with orange peel and orange rind and serve. Garnish with additional orange peel if desired.

title: Indian Spaghetti With Wild Rice and Walnuts
ingredients: 1/2 package spaghetti sauce, medium | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger, grated | 2 1/2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds, crushed | 4 ounces wild rice, cooked | 1 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in sauce pan. Simmer 15 minutes, uncovered. Rinse out pan and remove from heat. Pour hot sauce over warm wild rice and nuts, toss to coat. Serve either warm or at room temp.

title: Baked Chili Beer Canning
ingredients: 1 can chili | 12 ounces beer
instructions: Mash dry chili well. Put chili in pint or canning jars leaving 1/2 inch between seeds. Pour beer over the chili, leaving ½ inch wall of liquid on top. Top with other ½ inch of wall of liquid. Wipe rim and tighten rims with needle and thread. Refrigerate for 6 weeks before using. Boil 1 minute more.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,peach schnapps,spicy brown mustard,pam cooking spray,orange peel
title: Peking Peach Salad
ingredients: 6 ripe peaches or 6 peaches | 1/2 cup spicy brown mustard | 2 tablespoons peach schnapps | 3 tablespoons orange peel ( grated ) | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: Peel peaches and slice thinly, about 1/2 inch thick. Combine mustard, schnapps, orange peel, and turmeric powder. Add about ½ cup peach schnapps mixture to fruit and toss. Chill several hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,chicken breast,double cream,peanut oil vegetable,green plantain,tofu
title: Grilled Tofu
ingredients: 4 -8 medium green plantains, unpeeled ( each about the size of a whole ) | 2 cups chicken stock | 2 -4 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 -4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 lb fresh firm tofu, pressed cut into slices | 1/4 cup double cream | 6 ounces chicken breasts, cut into thin slices
instructions: Cut the ends off the plantains. Wash them, inside the slices, until the slices are somewhat open. Using the tip of a knife, slice the plantains lengthwise into about 1/2 strips. Cut the slices crosswise into strips, then crosswise into a 1 inch wide strip. Place 1 1/2 tablespoons water in a small bowl. Add the chicken stock to the water in a jug or small bowl and stir until the chicken is well coated. Add the cream and stir well. Set aside. Heat the grill to its highest temperature. Brush the grill with the peanut oil and arrange the cut plantains across it lengthwise. Grill the plantains until they are cooked. Use tongs to turn the plantains and check frequently so they don't burn. Alternatively, place the cooked plantains on a rack and grill until browned and soft. Remove to a plate and cut into thin strips. Wipe out the grill and set aside. Heat a medium skillet over medium heat. Add the tofu slices and saute until they are slightly crispy on the outside. Transfer the fried tofu to a plate as soon as they are done, taking care not to turn them over as they will become bitter. Heat the grill to its highest temperature. To assemble, place a few slices of the plantain onto the work surface. Place a few slices of the tofu onto the plantain. Toast the tofu under the grill on both sides until lightly brown and crisp. If necessary, slice the tofu into 1 inch wide strips. Put the fried tofu on top of the plantain slices. Top them with a few slices of the chicken and a few strips of the tofu. Top each portion with 2 tablespoons of the roasted toasted coconut sauce. If a sauce is needed, drizzle with a small amount of water.

title: Grilled Jalapeno-Cheese Potatoes
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 8 ounces shredded american cheese | 2 jalapenos, chopped | 1 fresh thyme sprig | 16 medium potatoes ( about 3 pounds )
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or girll broiler. Toast cumin and spread evenly on a large plate. Rub it onto cheese. Place potatoes on hot grill pan or broiler pan and sprinkle with cumin and sprinkle evenly with chopped jalapenos. Place a thyme sprig on top. Grill until edges brown, about 5 minutes. Turn edges of potato over, sprinkle with cumin, flip, and press down slightly. Grill until edges brown, about 6 minutes longer, and then rub potatoes with remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Cut into wedges to serve.

title: Lobster and Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 ounces lobster tails, cooked | 1 whole clove, minced
instructions: Cook pasta for 8 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,bacon,cumin powder,prune,liquid smoke,pork loin chop,dijon mustard
title: Dijon Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops, 1-inch thick | 6 slices bacon, chopped finely | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 jar prunes ( drained and sliced ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Lightly season pork chops with mustard powder. Place bacon and prunes in shallow pan or baking dish and drizzle with the mustard.

title: Passion Fruit Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried passion fruit pulp | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and heat through.

title: Frozen Tortilla Chips(Garth Brook)
ingredients: 2 -6 lbs soft saltine ( use the real salt or substitute ) | chipotle hot sauce
instructions: Heat a large cast iron skillet over medium heat. Dry saltine. Warm it by pressing it with your thumb and index finger just until it crackles. Carefully add hot saltines, a few at a time, into the hot pan. Using a slotted spatula, transfer them to a plastic bag and let cool for a few moments. Using tongs, pat and press a tortilla down into the softened saltine until it cracks when pressed, about 15 - 20 seconds on each side and a second on each side. If you can, simply cut them in half and set in a bowl and sprinkle with hot sauce.

title: Pasta With Jicama, Jicama and Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb pasta | 1 lb jicama, trimmed and shredded | 1/2 head cabbage, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Sauté jicama until lightly browned, drain. Steam jicama until crisp tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Grilled Duck and Pork
ingredients: 1 duck, 2-3 lbs | 2 piglets | 1/2 lb pork shoulder or 1/2 lb veal shoulder | 1 tablespoon ghee | 2 tablespoons pimento, finely chopped | 1 jar pimientos, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons mirin ( or other cooking mixture )
instructions: Wash duck and prick all over with a fork. Place on grill. Grill about 1 hour or until duck is brown. Remove from grill. Let rest until cool enough to handle. Remove fat and skin from duck. Cut into two pieces, place in a bowl and cover with cold water to cover and leave to stand at room temperature for 24 hours. In a large pot, saute pork, pig, papientos, and taki sauce. Add water if needed. Cook over low heat, stirring often and scraping the bottom of the pot, until sauce thickens and the pork is cooked through. Remove the duck from the bones and cut into pieces. Place in a plate and cover with foil, allowing to rest for 5 to 10 minutes. Serve with rice and salad, if using.

title: Smoked Salmon With Ginger Gravy
ingredients: 1 package fresh yeast | 1/2 pint beef drippings or 1/2 pint sherry wine | 5 lbs salmon steaks | 1 1/2 lbs fresh gingerroot, finely shredded
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 pint of the beef dripping. Sprinkle the top with a little of the remaining liquid. Add salt. Cut the salmon into three or four portions. Toss well to coat. Cover and leave overnight in a warm spot. Bring the remaining fat to the boil and fry the salmon for 2 or 3 minutes on each side. Remove from the pan and arrange on warmed plates. Add as much ginger as you desire. Serve the gravy hot with potatoes and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: tagliatelle pasta noodle,green chili pepper,tabasco sauce,pork shoulder,wine vinegar,double cream
title: Linguica's Signature Hot Pork Sausages
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder, cut into chunks | 6 fluid ounces wine vinegar | 7 fluid ounces double cream | 3 fluid ounces red hot green chili peppers, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 3 tablespoons dry sherry or 3 tablespoons scotch whisky
instructions: First of all, get all the ingredients hot. Put pork, into a large plastic bag, seal, and put on the grill. Grill for 15 minutes on each side, and then turn off grill and leave to rest for 15 minutes. Remove the sausages from grill, leave on one side to cool slightly. Meanwhile, deglaze the inside of the bag with red hot green chili, stir and let set for a couple of minutes. Pour contents into a pan, add the tabasco, and mix. Remove meat from the bag, and set aside. Pour contents into another pan, add wine vinegar, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, pour mixture over the pork in the bag. Close the lid and simmer on the medium heat for 15 minutes, then cover again and simmer on the lowest heat for another 30 minutes more, or until all the juices run clear when the pork is pierced with a fork. Serve at once. It is very important to cool the mixture for so long that the flavor can develop. When the pork slices are removed from the grill, put them onto plates, put on a plate, and cover with sherry, and serve with your favourite pasta, or as a dip for fresh vegetables.

title: Cucumber Risotto With Smoked Beer
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried arborio rice ( or other short grain rice ) | 6 ounces smoked beer | 1 1/4 cups skim milk | 3 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 4 ounces arborio rice wine or 4 ounces shirataki rice ( optional ) | 1 cucumber, seeded and coarsely chopped | 15 slices bamboo shoots, halved
instructions: Cover rice with warm water and let stand until water is absorbed and grains are tender, about 20 minutes. Drain well and set aside. Place the beer, milk and 1 tablespoon of the yogurt in a small saucepan. Bring just to a boil, whisking to dissolve any lumps. Remove from the heat. Cover. Let stand for 10 minutes. Toast the arborio rice in a dry nonstick skillet over low heat, stirring over moderate heat until the kernels are golden, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the remaining yogurt, rice wine or shirataki rice, cucumber, and bamboo shoots. Divide among four 5 ounce serving dishes and top with 1 slice of smoked beer.

title: Southern Perdue Burger
ingredients: 2 pounds ground fajita seasoning mix, finely crushed | 4 tablespoons dry buttermilk | 8 ounces cooked chopped pimiento | 1/2 cup prepared hot sauce, or to taste
instructions: Mix the fajita seasoning mix, buttermilk, and pimientos together in a skillet. Form mixture into 4 patties, and lightly brown over medium heat. Stir the hot sauce into the patties until thickened. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Polish Sausage Lasagna (Mamma's Recipe)
ingredients: 1 box lasagna noodles | 1 package beef bouillon cubes | 1 1/4 cups bread crumbs
instructions: Boil lasagna noodles 10 minutes per box directions. Drain, rinse, and boil for approximately 5 minutes. In a bowl mix soup into meat boullion until no lumps form. Add 1 lb. Of sausage and mix well. Put a layer of noodles in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Spread the meat/soup mixture over the noodles. Sprinkle a bit of bread crumbs on top. Cover with foil and bake at 400 degrees in a preheated oven for about 1 hour or until the noodles are tender.

Random Ingredients: rice krispies,espresso powder,molasses,beef bouillon cube,enchilada sauce,sirloin
title: Mexican Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 lbs ground sirloin | 10 ounces enchilada sauce ( mild, medium or hot ) | freshly grated irish coffee powder ( optional )
instructions: Mix 1 tablespoon of molasses and 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder in a medium bowl. Add the beef bouillon cube and use your hands to mix, breaking up meat into smaller chunks. Place meat into a large baking pan. Spread the remaining 1 tablespoon of molasses/instant espresso powder mixture over meat. Using your hands, mix meat with the marinade. Press meat into buttered pan. Bake at 350 f for 45 - 50 minutes.

title: Penne Alla Agua E Gira (Penne With Prawns)
ingredients: 200 g penne ( medium-sized ) | 100 g palm sugar or 100 g palm sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon salted clarified butter
instructions: Boil water in a medium size sauce pan, add penne, garlic and sugar. Cook until mixture is tender, drain and reserve. Bring salted butter to boil on high heat, then add penne and cook until it's a little translucent. Drain pasta, reserve 1/4 cup water in a medium sized serving dish. Pour reserved pasta water over pasta and serve.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts with Dried Beef (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 boneless chicken breasts, split horizontally into 4 pieces each, i prefer skinless but fat free | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless beef stew meat
instructions: Place cut up chicken breasts in a 3 1/2 4 quart crock pot. Sprinkle both sides with the fresh marjorian. Cut stew in half if using beef. Tuck the ends under and place on top. Pour remaining contents of the pot over the chicken. Cover and cook on high 15 minutes then low for 6 to 8 hours, or until the chicken is cooked through. You may add a little water to the crock if the broth dries out too rapidly. If you want this to be thick, you can thin it with water, if not. My crockpot method, cook the cut up chicken breasts in your crockpot on high 4 hours, then add the chicken to the broth. If you want it thicker, cook on high 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,green onion,green pea,peanut,turkey kielbasa,egg yolk,breadcrumb
title: Sausage Patties With Peas
ingredients: 1 lb turkey kielbasa | 8 ounces green peas | 1/3 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 egg yolk | 1/4 cup peanuts, chopped | 3 green onions, chopped, including tops
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Brown sausage in large skillet until thoroughly cooked. Cool, if necessary slice meat into 24 thin strips.
