Add peas, bread crumbs and worcestershire sauce to meat and mix well. Beat egg yolk and add to meat mixture. Mix well. Shape into patties and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle nuts on. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Top with onions.

title: Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb bulk kielbasa ( or substitute ground meat ) | 6 slices vermont cheese | 1/2 - 3/4 cup diced banana | 3/4 - 1 cup velveeta cheese
instructions: Brown kielbasa in 1 tbsp oil, drain. Spread kielbasa on both sides of bun.

title: Creamy Italian Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornflour | 2 cups skim milk | 1 small eggplant, diced into bite-sized pieces | 1 cup skim milk | 2 teaspoons molasses | 1 tablespoon pumpkin or 1 tablespoon corn, for topping | 10 ounces low-fat cranberry sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a sauce pan and stir to combine and simmer for 40 minutes or until creamy. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 5 minutes. Let stand for at least 10 minutes before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Chinese-Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken, deboned and quartered | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped | 1/4 cup pineapple chunk | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate or 1 1/2 tablespoons dry vermicelli, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to in a bowl, combine the green onions, pineapple, and chicken. Sprinkle with chopped chocolate. Place in a shallow baking dish, and cover with aluminum foil to weigh the chicken slightly. Bake for 60 - 75 minutes, until a meat thermometer reaches 170f.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pork tenderloin,red bell pepper,rump roast,corn,angel hair pasta
title: Baked Italian Pork Medallions
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin, halved lengthwise | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes | 2 cups frozen corn | 2 cups uncooked angel hair pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the pork tenderloins in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir the red bell pepper and red bell pepper strips with the crushed red pepper in a bowl to combine. Stir the corn into the peppers, then spread the corn mixture over pork. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until pork is cooked through and the peppers slightly tender.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,red cabbage,irish whiskey,brussels sprout,spring onion,phyllo dough,sparerib,thai red chili pepper
title: Thai Pork & Spring Onion Strudel
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo dough | 1 package trimmed country cut pork spareribs | 1 teaspoon kosher salt ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon kosher salt ( optional ) | 7 -10 leaves red cabbage, sliced | 3 spring onions, trimmed and cut diagonally into 2 inch lengths | 1 cup irish whiskey | 1 small thai red chili pepper, thinly sliced | 3 -4 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, for brushing | kosher salt
instructions: Heat a large pot. Cook the phyllo until golden and crisp, about 7 - 10 minutes per pound. Slice sheet in half, making 8 rectangles. Spread half the phyllo dough in the bottom of an 8 x 8 casserole dish. Layer the pork and spring onions evenly atop the phyllo dough. Drizzle 1 - 2 tablespoons of the whisky over the top of the vegetables. Repeat layering, using the rest of the phyllo dough, potatoes, herbs and whiskey to top off. Drizzle the remaining 2 tablespoons of whisky over the top. Finish by sprinkling 1 - 2 tablespoons of kosher salt on top. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 40 - 45 minutes. Let cool slightly, then cut through scored pieces into serving pieces.

title: Beef With Chickpeas and Oregano
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless beef sirloin | 1 cup dry chickpeas | 1 teaspoon dried oregano or 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 cup mixed salad greens
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Cut steak lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick medallions.

title: Baked Bulgar
ingredients: 2 large eggs | 1 tablespoon gelatin or 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1/2 tablespoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1 1/2 cups mashed potatoes | 1 cup mushroom soup
instructions: Cut bulgur, potatoes and onions finely. Mix potatoes, onion salt, gelatin powder in bowl. Break eggs and add, add water, mix thoroughly until it starts to set up, this should make a paste. Put mixture into a greased tin and bake in oven at 180c for about 45 minutes until set and nicely brown at edges.

title: English Mustard in Microwave
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely textured turnip ( about 15 per package ) | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard
instructions: Put 1 cup of coarsely textured turnip on the cutting board and place the cutting board on top of it. Using a paring knife, cut the turnip into a rough, coarse chop, 1 inch thick. Using a meat tenderizer or a potato shredder, press the turnip into the desired amount of mustard and close the lid. Place the microwave on high power for 2 minutes. Close the lid and microwave for another 2 minutes. Test for doneness by touching it with a fork. Do not lift the lid.

title: Macaroni W. Pork Chop Filling
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops | 1 package macaroni, cooked and drained | 1 can coconut or ( 16 ounce ) can other tropical flavored fruit salad dressing
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on box. Drain well and cool for 5 minutes. Stir in pork chops and macaroni. Cool completely. To coat pork chops, brush both sides with salad dressing. Grill or broil until done.

title: Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 2 cups bisquick | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 spanish onion | 10 ounces manchego cheese | spanish brick miniature marshmallow ( optional )
instructions: Spray cookie sheet with pam. Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil. In a bowl combine 1 cup biscuit crumbs with taco mix. Dice jalapeno if desired. Spread mixture into greased cookie sheet. Top with onion rings, jalapeños if desired. Bake at 450°f for 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from oven, sprinkle with cheese. Replace aluminum foil. Return to oven, and bake an additional 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned. Add marshmallows if desired.

title: Tostones
ingredients: taco seasoning, to taste | cornmeal, for coating
instructions: Prepare the taco shells in a hot skillet. Spray well with cooking spray. Drop about 2 tablespoons of cornmeal into the skillet. Cook until the cornmeal turns a golden brown color, about 1 minute. Using a spatula, flip the taco shells onto a plate. Cut into fourths and serve warm.

title: Herbes De Lima
ingredients: fresh thyme leave ( optional ) | peanut oil ( for frying )
instructions: Prepare thyme with the thyme leaves and refrigerate for upto 1 hour. Heat oil for deep frying, preferably with a minimum temperature of 360°f or until it is very hot.. Remove thyme from refrigerator. Dry thyme with a clean kitchen towel. Dry with a clean kitchen towel. Sprinkle with a little thyme leaves.... Serve with salads, soups or snacks.

title: Grilled Beef with Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak | 1 jar marshmallows | 2 -3 green chilies, seeded and diced | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 2 teaspoons brandy ( optional )
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Lightly oil grill. Combine all ingredients except for beef, mallows and chilies in plastic bag. Add steak to bag and marinate in refrigerator, turning several times. Thread on skewers. Grill until browned and tender and internal temperature reaches 160 degrees, about 15 minutes. Cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,onion soup mix,black sesame seed,cabbage,parsley,salt black pepper,worcestershire sauce
title: Wild Rice Vegetable Dip
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 1/2 cups shredded cabbage | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 cup diced green onions with top | 3 tablespoons dried minced onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 can black sesame seeds, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a 9 inch square pan with cooking spray. In a medium bowl combine onion soup mix, cabbage, parsley, green onions, dry onion soup mix, worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Mix well. In the prepared 9 inch square baking dish, spread the black sesame seeds, and mix evenly. Spoon the vegetable dip into the prepared dish. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Tenderloin Mexicorn Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup taco seasoning | 2 pounds beef tenderloin
instructions: Prepare grill for direct grilling, or heat grill pan directly over medium high heat. Lightly oil grill grate. Lightly spray grill basket with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle top side of roast with taco seasoning. Place roast on grill. Cook 8 minutes. Turn roast. Cook 8 minutes. Insert sharp knife in center of meat. Remove meat from grill. Spread evenly with chips. Cook 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,yoghurt,bay leaf,splenda granular,lime wedge,chili pepper flake,black pepper
title: Spiced Yoghurt and Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup reduced-fat natural yoghurt | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons reduced sodium splenda granular | 1 teaspoon lime wedge | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1 bay leaf ( optional ) | green food coloring, to desired darkness
instructions: Mix everything together and chill until ready to use. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine pasta,plain yogurt,butterscotch pudding mix,golden raisin,broth,steak,lime zest
title: Beef and Rice Lovers' Fettuccine With Butterscotch
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lean steak, cut into 25 to 30 medallions | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 packet butterscotch pudding mix | 1/2 cup chicken stock & 1/2 cup chicken broth or 1/2 cup broth | 1 tablespoon lime zest ( plus more, for garnish ) | 1 -2 tablespoon golden raisin ( or to taste ) | 12 ounces fettuccine pasta ( or wholemeal egg noodles, if you can't find butterscotch, broken into 2 to 3. 5cm lengths ) | 1 1/2 cups thickened plain yogurt
instructions: Trim steak of fat. Using a sharp knife, carefully slice steak diagonally into 20mm long strips, 2 inches wide, about 1/2cm thick. If you are running short on the zest, stir in a little extra so the flavour is evenly distributed. Place beef in shallow, large non metallic bowl with yoghurt. Cover and chill for 30 minutes. Place remaining ingredients, apart from pasta and raisins in a pot over medium heat. Bring just to the boil, cover and cook for 5 minutes, then remove lid and cook for 7 minutes more. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, combine yoghurt, hot butterscotch, chicken stock, lime zest, and remaining butterscotch and raisins, season well with salt and pepper and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, to cook the pasta, put a large pan of boiling water on to boil. When water comes to the boil, add the noodles and leave until just tender. Drain well and transfer immediately to a bowl of warm water. Drain, reserving a handful of noodles in the strainer. Add the noodles to the pan and bring to the boil, stirring until just heated through. Transfer to serving bowls and leave to cool slightly. Just before serving, stir the cooled noodles through the sauce, then divide between individual serving bowls. Garnish each serving with a small sprig of cilantro, if you like.

Random Ingredients: couscous,peanut butter,baby spinach leaf,haricot bean,hot mustard,chinkiang vinegar
title: Asian Spicy Hot & Spicy Bean Salad - Quick!
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 3/4 cup dried haricot beans ( not bean paste ) | 3/4 cup crunchy peanut butter, not smooth | 2 tablespoons chinkiang vinegar | 2 teaspoons mild hot mustard | 200 -250 g baby spinach leaves ( trimmed )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Place the couscous in a heavy baking pan & scatter over the haricots & peanut butter. Mix in the vinegar & mustard. Pour hot mustard over beans & toss well, making sure all the beans have been coated with the mustard. Season lightly w/o sea salt & stir in the spinach leaves. To serve, place on bed of roasted garlic toast if using. Can be cooled completely then allowed to cool completely & it will last for at least a few days in the fridge.

title: Sabzi Bamia (Black Beans With Okra)
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh okra | 3 1/2 cups black beans ( or 1 12-oz. pkg frozen okra ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/4 cup corn oil
instructions: Cut the okra meat into small pieces. Cut the beans and okra into small pieces. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, add the okra and okra. When okra begins to brown, add black beans. Cover and cook about 7 minutes or until okra is almost cooked through. Add spices and cook for about 1 minute. The okra and beans should be crisp tender. Serve with rice or pasta.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,raspberry,grain white rice,romaine lettuce,banana pepper
title: Banana Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 3 cups romaine lettuce | 2 packages frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 large banana pepper, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1/4 cup pitted and coarsely chopped kalamata olive
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, place romaine lettuce in a large salad bowl, layer with raspberries, banana pepper, olives and the cooked rice. Serve warm, or refrigerate. Cook rice according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,orange juice,tomato juice,enchilada sauce,black olive,self rising flour
title: Easy Southwestern Pizza
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 teaspoon ginger garlic paste | 3/4 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup sliced black olives
instructions: Place half the enchilada sauce in a bowl and cover with red and black olives. Mix well. Set aside. In a medium size mixing bowl, mix the onion powder, ginger garlic paste, and 2 cups of self rising flour. Slowly stir in the 3/4 cup of reserved enchilada sauce and the orange juice. Spread this mixture evenly over the top of the mixture on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish. Spread the remaining enchilada sauce evenly over the top of the topping and on the ungreased side. Top with the remaining flour. Bake at 375 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Scotch Shortcrust and Sausage Gravy (Australia)
ingredients: 6 ounces white flour | 6 ounces rump steak
instructions: Roll the shortcrust and sausage into thin sausages and steam them for 10 minutes on the stove top. Alternatively, you can tie a loop of kitchen string around the ends of the sausages and then press lightly on the ends of the sausages. Serve in warmed soup bowls or as a light meal with mash.

title: Cranberry-Cranberry Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberries | 2 cups flour or 2 cups breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: In a small bowl stir together dried cranberries and bread crumbs. Add liquid smoke if the mixture is too dry. Add wet ingredients and mix to a firm dough and shape into balls or cylinders. Flatten and roll into desired shape using 1 whole cranberry for each fritter. Heat a good non stick frying pan over medium heat and lightly brown fritters on each side, about 3 mins on each side.

title: Portuguese Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes | 3 tablespoons sweet potato starch | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut potatoes into 4 wedges and place in a medium bowl. Cover the bowl and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Drain off liquid. Preheat the grill. In a large bowl, mix sweet potato starch and olive oil. Stir in the sweet potato, tabasco sauce, and salt and pepper. Remove the potatoes from the bowl and pat dry with paper towels. Brush the potato slices with the potato starch mixture. Spray the grilling surface with cooking spray and line with the potato slices, oiled side down. Cook 15 minutes, or until the tops of the slices are lightly browned.

title: Turnip & Lemon Mustard Mash
ingredients: 1 cup turnip ( small cubes ) | 2 teaspoons lemon zest ( grated from about 3 lemons ) | 2 tablespoons light soymilk | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds
instructions: Combine the turnip & zest in a ceramic bowl with just enough water to cover by 2 inches. Cover & set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. Strain the liquid & reserve. Scatter the mustard seeds over the top & set aside for 15 minutes. Remove the turnips & peel from the water then coarsely chop using a knife & vegetable mill. Return the pureed turnip to the saucepan & add the soy milk & bring to a boil. Simmer until the liquid has almost gone syrupy, then remove from the heat & cover. Let stand 10 minutes to finish mashing, stir in the reserved mustard seeds & serve.

title: Linda's Peanut Butter Candy
ingredients: 250 g crunchy peanut butter | 1 orange, juice only | candle nuts
instructions: Place peanut butter in bowl and add enough orange juice to make one cup of peanut butter. Using a hand mixer, blend peanut butter into smooth paste. Add candied nuts and mix well. Shape into small balls with your hands. Place on a baking tray lined with baking paper and flatten slightly, about 30mm x 30cm. Mark into small diamond shapes with a sharp knife. Place in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes or up to two weeks.

title: Pesto Sun Dried Chiles
ingredients: 2 dried red chiles, stemmed and seeded and torn into pieces | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: In medium skillet, dry roast chiles over moderate heat until golden, 2 to 3 minutes. Add 1/4 cup heavy cream and simmer, stirring often, until sauce thickens slightly and syrupy but still slightly chunky, 1 to 2 minutes. Cool briefly and transfer to small bowl. Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Chinese Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large sweet potatoes, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup chopped drained canned apple | 3 tablespoons chopped pimiento | 2 cups chopped fresh snow peas
instructions: In a 2 quart casserole, sprinkle potatoes with chopped apple, pimiento and snow peas. Add water. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes. Serve.

title: Orange Colcannon
ingredients: 1 large white cabbage, cored | 1 teaspoon kitchen bouquet | 1 teaspoon orange peel
instructions: Core cabbage and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Place in a large bowl with kitchen bouquet, orange peel and kitchen sink. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours, turning cabbage over. Microwave cabbage on high power about 45 seconds until cabbage begins to soften.

title: Chinese Black peppercorns
ingredients: 2 cups black peppercorns | 4 buns, toasted ( wheat buns, white buns )
instructions: Wash black peppercorns in cold water, removing any coarse spots and stems. Place in a mortar and grind together using a pestle or a mortar and pestle. Store in a covered container until use. Makes about 2 cups of the black peppercorns mixed with about 20 to 30 whole wheat buns.

Random Ingredients: couscous,beetroot,ramen noodle,lettuce leaf,chili paste,whipping cream,chicken breast half,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Thai Chicken and Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast half, cut in 4 to 5 thin strips | 1 jar sweet chili paste ( thai ) | 1 package ramen noodles | 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 2 1/2 cups light whipping cream | 12 large lettuce leaves | 1 can sliced beets in syrup, drained | 1 cup couscous, uncooked
instructions: Cook chicken strips in hot paste over medium high heat for 3 to 5 minutes, or until lightly browned. Break noodles into 3 to 5 sections, and cook in boiling water for 2 minutes, or until tender or according to package directions. Transfer noodles to serving bowl, and keep warm. Heat cream, cream, soup, and yogurt in microwave for 2 minutes on high power or until warm. To serve, divide lettuce leaves among 4 to 6 serving bowls, and arrange chicken on top. Garnish with beets, and couscous.

title: Kalbi
ingredients: 1 cup dried rose water | 1/2 cup raw black sesame seeds, lightly toasted
instructions: Put the rose water and sesame seeds in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, or until tender.

title: The Queen of Hearts
ingredients: 4 -6 flour tortillas | 4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 cup dried currants ( optional ) or 2 cups raisins ( optional )
instructions: Spread mayonnaise onto tortillas evenly. Add any additional ingredients that you want to sprinkle over the tops of the tortillas. Roll up the tortillas and place on a sprayed oven proof skillet or serving plate. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,butter,crescent,raisin,baking soda,yellow onion,sesame seed,black bean
title: Creamy Black Bean & Raisin Tides
ingredients: 1 package dried black beans | 1 large yellow onion | 4 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 1/2 cups crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 cup butter | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 package refrigerated crescent rolls, separated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the black beans in a large saucepan.

title: Grilled Prosciutto With Parsley & Italian Herbs
ingredients: 1 ounce prosciutto | fresh italian parsley
instructions: Preheat your grill. Lay the prosciutto flat on your work surface. Top with a small handful of parsley. Dip your tip into a few drops of water to moisten and coat the prosciutto, making sure it is coated with a bit of the herbs. Place on grill, and continue to grill while grilling until crispy and toasty, 30 to 45 minutes. You may need to reduce the heat before eating to ensure it gets crispy.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,olive oil cooking spray,ketchup,walnut,tapioca flour,flat rice noodle,bamboo shoot,cornstarch
title: Crispy Noodles and Prawns
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups plain flour | 1 3/4 cups tapioca flour | 1 1/4 teaspoons cornstarch | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/3 cup chopped walnuts | 300 g baby prawns or 300 g barramundi prawns
instructions: Make the batter, sift the flours into a bowl, add the cornstarch, stir to blend well. If the batter is too thick, a little of the flour can be sprinkled over it. Add 3/4 cup water, mix to make a thick batter. Tip, i use my saly oven scale, i don't really measure anything when i do this, i put this in my scale, i've never measured anything so just make sure it's the correct amount you're aiming for. Spray a wok with the oil and add the prawns. Stir fry until they turn white, remove and set aside. Add the remaining sauce ingredients and bring to the boil. Add the prawns and mix well to coat. I usually use the premaded prawns, i bought them and cut them for me. Serve immediately.

title: Pinto Beans Frijoles
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto beans | 3 quinces, pared, cored and cut into wedges | 2 garlic heads, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1/4 cup adobo sauce, from jar
instructions: Wash and soak the beans overnight. In the morning, cook the quinces in boiling salted water for 30 minutes, then remove from the water and peel out the skins. Place the quinces, garlic and parsley in a cheesecloth, tie with kitchen string. Puncture the cheesecloth tightly with a knife or a fork.

title: Pesto & Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1/4 cup light basil pesto, prepared according to your taste ( i like homemade in a jar ) | 4 -5 pounds pork shoulder, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1-inch thick slices | 6 slices rye bread, toasted | italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread pesto over pork slices and place in a bowl or large, non metallic baking dish. Arrange pork slices in 2 rows in baking dish. Arrange rye bread on top of pork, making shallow criss cross marks on bread. Sprinkle generously with parsley. Bake about 2 hours or until pork is cooked through and bread is warmed through. Serve warm.

title: Grape Leaves (Puff Pastry)
ingredients: 6 fresh grape leaves | 8 sheets frozen puff pastry ( thawed )
instructions: Heat oven 400ºf. Place one sheet frozen pastry on top of the other, cut in half. Cut one more sheet of puff pastry into small rectangles 6 inches long by 5 inches wide. Place a small heaping teaspoon of the grapeseed filling in each rectangle and roll over in a log. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, repeat with remaining pastry, grapeseed filling, dough, and grape leaves on top. Bake 20 - 25 minutes until golden brown. Let cool 5 minutes on baking sheet.

title: Easy Beef Burritos (Stolen from the Canadian Treasury Recipe)
ingredients: 32 ounces stewing beef | 2 cups fresh ripe mangoes or 2 cups papayas | 10 burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: In a crockpot place the stew beef, mango's and tortillas. Cook on low for at least 8 hours. Take a handful of meat and mix in the flour or tortilla mix and store it in a zip loc® bag for later use.

title: Peaches in Spice Rub
ingredients: 2/3 cup yellow mustard seeds | 1/3 cup dried oregano leaves ( or 1/4 cup fresh chopped, crushed ) | 2 tablespoons ground cayenne pepper | 12 ripe peaches, peeled, about 2 pounds
instructions: Place mustard seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat. When they begin to pop, add oregano and cayenne. Cook 30 seconds, remove from heat. Dry peaches, cut into slices, then arrange on the hot mustard. Allow to sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Saucy Pineapple
ingredients: 1 large fresh pineapple chunk | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 package jumbo pasta shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a casserole dish. Place pineapple chunks into a blender and blend until coarsely chopped. Stir the flour into the blended pineapple and season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Sarasota's Spanish Oaxacan Green pepper Appetizers
ingredients: 2 large green peppers | 12 ounces canned artichoke hearts, drained | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Cut green pepper in half lengthwise. Peel off outer skins and cut into strips. Remove seeds and ribs and then cut strips crosswise into rings or rings 1/4 inch thick. Place peppers, fat side up, on a baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 35 minutes. Remove from oven. Stir in artichokes and white pepper. Serve.

title: Rainbow Coconut Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 cups snow peas, washed | mustard ( optional ) | chile powder ( optional ) | 1 cup coconut milk ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven on convection low setting. In a large baking dish, mix together snow peas with mustard and chili powder. Pour coconut milk evenly over mixture. Cover and bake for 10 - 15 minutes until tender. Sprinkle with additional mustard if desired.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,chicken bouillon,dark soy sauce,wide egg noodle,pork,red chili pepper flake
title: Vietnamese Noodles With Pork and Napa Cabbage
ingredients: 2 packages wide egg noodles ( dry ) | 1/4 lb pork, sliced thin ( i buy the loin ) | 1 medium napa cabbage, sliced thin ( i've used sweet cabbage for my vegies ) | 1 package chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Place hot water in pot. Dissolve the chicken bouillon in the hot water and dump the chicken broth over the pork. Set aside. Soak egg noodles for 3 hours. Drain. Rinse with cold water, and drain thoroughly. Set noodles aside. Place noodles and pork back into hot pot. Toss with cabbage and chili flakes and cook until noodles are cooked to your preference. Add the white wine. Serve immediately.

title: Mama's Cheese and Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 4 ounces gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 cup brown rice or 1 cup white rice
instructions: Rinse lettuce leaves. Chop well. Combine cheese and lemon juice and mix well. Toss lettuce with cheese mixture. Refrigerate 30 minutes.

title: Chipotle Shredded Green Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage ( about 1 pound ) or 1 head red cabbage ( about 1 pound ) | 2 teaspoons minced chipotle chiles, chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instructions: Place cabbage and chiles in a 13x9x2 baking dish.

title: Spicy Crab Meat
ingredients: 2 cans crabmeat | 3 tablespoons fresh dill, minced, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons imitation applesauce, or as desired | 1 cardamom seed
instructions: Line a 9 by 13 inch baking dish with several layers of paper towels to absorb moisture. Mash crabmeat and dill together in a bowl. Combine crabmeat mixture, sauce, cardamom seed, and 3 tablespoons of water.

title: Cousi
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, cut into smallish cubes | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/4 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Trim fat from meat with a vegetable peeler. Rinse well in a strainer. Brown meat in a frying pan with a little vegetable broth. Drain meat. Add saffron to drippings and cook several minutes, until slightly darkened. Pour vegetable broth over meat, add coconut and simmer slowly until meat is done. Serve with rice or couscous.

Random Ingredients: lebanese cucumber,pineapple tidbit,english muffin,grape tomato,golden raisin,baby spinach,red curry paste
title: Cucumber and Tomato Panini
ingredients: 1/2 english muffin, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons garbanese cucumbers, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise 1/4 inch-wide slices | 1/2 cup canned pineapple tidbits, drained, juice reserved ( reserve 2 tablespoons ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste, to taste | 1/4 cup golden raisin, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons frozen baby spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
instructions: Spread muffin with 1/2 cup of grape tomatoes and 1/2 cup of cucumber slices. Place on a baking sheet and bake at 400f for 8 minutes or until muffins are toasted and tomatoes have darkened slightly. Arrange cucumber quarters on a serving platter, then spoon the tomatoes and cucumber over top and sprinkle with raisins. Offer fresh spinach on the side for garnish and to add bite to the panini dish, preheat a large skillet over medium high. Sear curry paste, then stir in reserved grape tomato juice until dissolved. Add the remaining raisins and cook over medium heat for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Scatter the curry paste mixture over the top of the hot panini, followed by the spinach. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,large shrimp,rigatoni pasta,pasta,stove stuffing mix,garlic clove,ditalini pasta,fish stock
title: Pasta Stuffed With Prawns & Corned With Beef and Shellfish (Pasta Fagioli)
ingredients: 1 package large shrimp, peeled & deveined | 2 cups stove top stuffing mix | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 7/8 cup pasta | 2 cups fish stock | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1 package ditalini pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add coriander seeds & simmer 1 - 2 minutes. Add crushed garlic and shrimp to the pan and boil 1 minute then remove from the heat & set aside to cool. To make the stuffing, mix stuffing mix with 1/2 cup water, stir well until combined, then add stock & coriander seeds & set aside. Cook rigatoni, according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,virgin olive oil,anaheim chilies
title: Green Chile Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 long hot anaheim chilies, stemmed, seeded and halved lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch strips, then sliced crosswise into 1/2-inch strips | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange the chiles, cut side down, in a single layer on a baking sheet.

title: Italian Stew With the Pork
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage | 2 lbs potatoes, medium-sized, peeled and cut into chunks ( about 3 ) | 1 lb ground pork | 1 jar hot tapasco sauce ( or to taste ) | 3 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Brown hot pork in large nonstick skillet over high heat. Spray crockpot. Combine all ingredients in crockpot.

title: Beer Marinade for Beef or Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup beer | 1 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Measure the marjoram into a small plastic bag. Smash the marjoram with your hands to release all the flavorings, if desired. To use, in a shallow dish, mix beer and marjoram together. Place meat in liquid, and cover. Refrigerate, allowing meat to marinate as it marinates, 3 to 6 hours. Meat can also be broiled or baked right across the grill.

title: Easy Mexican Seasoning - Home-Make or Taco Filling for Meat-Filling for Tacos
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons marjoram or 4 teaspoons oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a bowl, mix the seasoning with 1 1/2 tablespoons of water, 1 teaspoon at a time. Mix well after each step. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,sherry,avocado,phyllo dough,fine salt,ham,self raising flour,cake flour
title: Porcini and Ham Sides
ingredients: 1/2 lb finely diced ham | 1/2 lb grated deli ham | 1 ounce porcini mushroom, finely chopped | 2 1/2 cups cake flour | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon fine salt | 1/2 cup sweet sherry | 1 medium avocado, halved, skinned and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Mix dry ingredients in bowl. Add sherry and mix well. Gradually add enough of the remaining sherry so the mixture is just moist. Fold in the mashed avocado. Place half of the mixture on a pastry board and shape into a thin rectangle. Dice remaining ham and cheese. Place half over the rectangle and make a roll. Line a baking tin with some baking parchment and fill with a small amount of sherry. Wrap pastry with foil and bake until golden brown, about 1 hour. Serve slices with a scoop of ice cream and syrup, or a fruit salad.

Random Ingredients: biscuit mix,wheat flour,salt substitute,angostura bitter,cabbage,pimiento,farfalle pasta,golden syrup
title: Steamed Fish Balls (Pasta With Pimientos)
ingredients: 1 egg | 3/4 lb farfalle pasta | 1 cup wheat flour | 3/4 cup finely shredded cabbage | 1 jar chopped pimientos | 1 jar sweetened condensed biscuit mix | 1 ounce golden syrup | 1 dash salt substitute ( to taste ) | 2 -4 tablespoons angostura bitters
instructions: Start a large pot of salted water to boil for the pasta. Meanwhile, to make the dough, put the egg into the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment or a small blender. Cut the farfalle in half from the wide end just below the blade. Set aside. To start the fish balls, first, make a hole in the center of the farfalle with your thumb, remove the crusts from the farfalle and cut the farfalle into 3/4 inch thick slices. This does not make it any thicker than thin spaghetti. Lay the slices down side by side on a cutting board or plate. With a knife, cut a horizontal slit down the center of each slice of farfalle. Insert the slices of farfalle into a small bowl and set aside to drain of excess water. Now begin to steam the farfalle for 12 to 15 minutes, or until they float to the top of the colander. Remove the cooked farfalle from the steamer and place on a large piece of waxed paper. While they are still warm, peel them off. Melt the golden syrup in a small saucepan over a medium high heat. Whisk in a pinch of salt and the bitters. Place the farfalle in the syrup and continue whisking until the farfalle are well drained. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,beef tamale,marinara sauce,english muffin,angostura aromatic bitter,granola cereal,cajun seasoning,red lentil
title: Soyjiki Tamale Meatloaf
ingredients: 12 ounces beef tamales | 3 english muffins, toasted and sliced | 12 ounces red lentils | 14 3/4 ounces garbanzo cereal or 14 3/4 ounces cranberry beans | 1/3 cup cajun seasoning | 1/3 cup angostura aromatic bitters | 1 teaspoon granola | hard-boiled egg, garnish optional
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Remove tamales from package, place on cutting board and cut off just the thin end to remove all of the tender flesh. Slice tamales into about 12 pieces and store in refrigerator in a plastic bag until needed. Place a dinner plate at the top of each slice of bread and lay a piece of bread on top of each piece of bread. In a large bowl, combine red lentils, garbanzo or cranberry beans and spices. Stir well to mix. Add meat and top with more bread slices to fit. Bake for 35 minutes or until brown and crispy. Cut into quarters and garnish with hard boiled egg, if using.

title: Hibiscus
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets | 6 fresh asparagus spears, ends trimmed | 7 ounces coleslaw
instructions: In a baking dish, toss the asparagus with 3 oz of coleslaw. Place fillets in the dish, then brush with the remaining coleslaw. Bake in a 350°f oven until cooked through, about 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Sauce Mimosa
ingredients: 10 ounces tomato soup | 8 ounces asparagus spears | 6 ounces hoisin sauce | 2 cups broth ( i use water )
instructions: Cook asparagus. When done, add soup and asparagus to the soup. Add hoison sauce. Stir to combine. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,yellow onion,serrano pepper,rib pork loin chop,sherry wine,palm sugar,raspberry
title: Raspberry-Lime Pork Chops with Rice and Nuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry sherry wine | 1 1/2 cups sliced yellow onions | 1/3 cup palm sugar or 1/3 cup brown sugar | 4 -6 rib-style pork loin chops, 1 inch thick | 10 cardamom seeds | 4 -6 fresh serrano peppers, stemmed, seeded, sliced into 1 `` wide rings ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberries
instructions: Heat the sherry in a small skillet over medium heat. Add the onions and sugar and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally and breaking up the sugar, until the onion is very soft and the liquid is reduced, about 35 minutes. If necessary cook longer to release some of the caramelized flavor.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,chicken wing,lime juice zest,date,pappardelle pasta,pickling spice,shell pasta
title: Sweet and Sour Chicken Wings
ingredients: 12 large chicken wings | 8 cups raw peanuts or 8 cups raw cashews, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon pickling spice | 1 tablespoon lime juice, zest of | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 bottle pappardelle pasta | 1 cup shell pasta, cooked
instructions: Preperation,. Rinse chicken wings in a sink or strainer until the water runs clear. Rinse in cold water until no longer visibly wet. Rinse all dry. Place all chicken wings in a large pot with 8 cups cold water, or to cover. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer slowly, partially covered, just until tender for about 1 hour. Drain wings, skim and discard the skins and carcass. You can also poach wings in the same pot for 3 hours on the stove, adding more water if necessary.. Reserve all wings and any juices in the pot. Drain the noodles and set aside. Simmer the pappardelle pasta, cook according to package instructions. Drain until just cool enough to handle. Slice the noodles in half or quarters. Place about 1 - 2 cups of the noodles in the bottom of each bowl. Arrange some of the peanuts on top of the noodles. Sprinkle some pickling spice on top. Place 1/2 cup of the reserved chicken wings on top of the peanuts. Continue layering noodles, peanuts, chicken wings, noodles, peanuts, and remaining pickling spices. Top with remaining peanuts and any reserved liquid. Serve with lime wedges. Note, the chicken wings can be made a couple of days in advance until used.

title: Wild Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups wild rice, rinsed | 5 cups peeled russet potatoes, cut into wedges ( about 7 potatoes ) | 2 tablespoons grainy mustard
instructions: Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with 3 cups water. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,lettuce leaf,sage,rosemary,dark sesame oil,port wine
title: Lettuce Leaves With Sesame Oil & Rosemary
ingredients: 8 lettuce leaves ( we used romaine ) | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon crushed rosemary | 2 teaspoons chopped sage | 1 teaspoon dry port wine or 1 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Blend all of the ingredients, except the lettuce leaves and dressing, in a blender on high speed for 1 minute. Line a rimmed baking sheet with 2 lettuce leaves and spread 2 tablespoons dressing over the top. Using 2 lettuce leaves, layer 2 more lettuce leaves, 2 more dressing, and 1 lettuce leaf stack. Toss the leaves between your palms to thoroughly coat the lettuce in dressing. Spread remaining dressing over the top and sides of lettuce leaves. Set aside for 15 minutes to fully marinate. Serve with warm grain artisan bread.

title: Sponge Cheese on Leaves
ingredients: 4 -6 fresh garden fresh goat's cheese | 300 ml double cream | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil or 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: The night before, remove the stems from the cheese. Wrap in a piece of cheese cloth and tie securely with string. Place on a kitchen towel, or in a shallow baking dish lined with foil. Put in a warm oven. The next morning, pre heat the cheese on a hot, dry frying pan for 2 - 3 minutes. When the cheese is golden brown all over, take it out and add a little cream. You may wish to drizzle the remaining cream evenly over the top of the cheese. Sprinkle the grapeseed oil over the cream, taking care not to burn anything. Leave to set up, or at least in the fridge overnight, allowing it to set. You may also wish to leave the cheese on for a few minutes, just to crisp it up a little. When you are ready to serve, pour over the cream, and allow to set gently before serving.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,bay leaf,pumpkin puree,cheddar cheese,avocado,asiago cheese
title: Pumpkin Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 can whole pumpkin seeds | 1/3 cup grated asiago cheese | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and diced | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 bay leaf
instructions: In a food processor or blender, blend pumpkin seeds and asiago cheese until smooth. Add pumpkin puree, avocado, and cheddar cheese and mix until combined. Place bay leaf in the center of a platter and place dip on top. Refrigerate at least 3 hours to allow flavors to blend before serving.

Random Ingredients: catsup,orange juice concentrate,daikon radish,dark brown sugar
title: Japanese Daikon Radish Appetizer or Baked Daikon Dies
ingredients: 4 daikon radishes, peeled | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium catsup | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons orange juice concentrate
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Cut each radish in half lengthwise, remove the hard end then finely slice 1/2 inch thick on the horizontal. Place on a baking sheet and brush with catsup. Sprinkle with brown sugar and dot with orange juice mixture. Bake until hot and starting to turn golden, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Slow Cooker Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 2 cups chopped cauliflower | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours.

title: Low-Fat French Onion (From Vegan Magazine)
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 1 tablespoon cheddar vinegar | 1/2 cup fat free sour cream or 1/2 cup skim milk yogurt | 1 small tomatoes, sliced or grated
instructions: Add ingredients to blender. Cover and blend at high setting until smooth. Pour into non stick sprayed casserole dish and cover and chill until ready to serve. Variation, add 1/2 teaspoon salt.

Random Ingredients: mace,chicken breast,serrano pepper,cream mushroom soup,lamb,grapefruit,broccoli floret,sugar
title: CSA Chicken With Broccoli Mash
ingredients: 1 boneless chicken breast, and cut into bite size pieces | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 2 ounces mushrooms | 1 ounce grapefruit, juice of | 3 -6 ounces small broccoli florets | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon mace
instructions: Fry chicken until fully cooked, and set aside. In a medium size bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, mushrooms, grapefruit juice, broccoli leaves, sugar, salt, marsala, and mace. Add chicken and cover. Let simmer over low medium heat until broccoli is tender. Serve over cooked white rice.

title: Sausage-Andouille  Sausages (Anu-Glace)
ingredients: 8 ounces andouille sausage | 16 ounces tomato salsa or 16 ounces v 8 tomatoes
instructions: Slice the sausages into 1/4 inch slices. Spray a skillet with cooking spray and place over medium heat. Fry sausage until golden brown on both sides. In a large bowl, mix together the salsa and sausage. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,couscous,lemon juice zest,green lentil,bell pepper,serrano pepper,pork
title: Dairy Free, Vegan Fried Green Lentils
ingredients: 3 cups green lentils ( or use romano beans ) | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 2 -4 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 serrano pepper ( or other hot pepper ) | 1 bell pepper | 2 tablespoons minced serrano peppers ( or other hot pepper ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | cooked cubed vegetarian pork
instructions: Cook lentils, as directed on box, and then drain. In a very large frying pan, warm the ranch, lemon juice, chili pepper, and lemon juice. When the lentils are done, add to the frying pan. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add veggies and stir. Serve immediately.

title: Curried Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage | 8 ounces thinly sliced deli ham ( i use oscar mayer ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3 teaspoons tomato ketchup | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup dried currant
instructions: Boil cabbage until soft. Meanwhile, cook ham throughly. Meanwhile, shred cabbage. Add remaining ingredients. Mix until well blended. To serve, add cabbage to the sauce and cook until it is heated through and coated well.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,italian herb seasoning,guacamole,poppy seed,cornmeal,egg noodle
title: Poppy Seed Noodles With Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces thin egg noodles | 2 cups cooked guacamole ( such as avgolemono ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 1 cup plain spelt breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Combine pasta, guacamole, italian seasoning, and cornmeal in a large bowl. Stir in breadcrumbs. Spoon into a greased 8 x 11 skillet. Cook over med low heat, until golden and bubbly, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with poppy seeds. Let stand 5 minutes. Cut into 4 x 1 inch squares.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,red pepper flake,elbow macaroni,celery,bouquet garni,dark brown sugar,mayonnaise
title: Best Ever Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon bouquet garni | 1 cup sour cream with chicken soup | 1/2 cup minced celery | 1 package elbow macaroni, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together mayonnaise, sugar, red pepper flakes and bouquet garni. Add sour cream and celery and mix lightly. In a 2 quart casserole dish, stir together macaroni and sauce. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Remove cover and bake for about 5 minutes, or until bubbly. Cool 1 minute before serving.

title: Simple Low-Fat Fried Curry Ritz
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons grams crushed red curry paste | 1 tablespoon sumac
instructions: In small bowl, mix together crumbs and curry paste. Then, with a pastry brush coat a nonstick frying pan with cooking spray. Dip graham crackers into the curry mixture, pressing to coat evenly. Fry crumbs until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,sugar snap pea,cider,yellow pepper,cornflour
title: Baked Corn Flans With Peas
ingredients: 1 can cornflour | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas | 2 yellow peppers, cut into strips | 2 cans black-eyed peas, drained | 3 tablespoons cider
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f in a baking dish, toss the cornflour with 1/4 cup warm water, and stir to combine. Slice the peas in half and toss with the peas in a non stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the peppers and stir to coat. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes, stirring about every 10 minutes, until the peppers are crisp and tender and the peas soft. Remove from the oven, stir in the cider and cornflour mixture, and cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Tomato-Braised Carrots
ingredients: 16 small carrots, peeled ( or 1kg of frozen ) | 1 stalk celery, cut diagonally into 3/4 inch slices | 1/4 cup white breadcrumb | 1/2 cup canned chopped tomato
instructions: Cut carrots and celery lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Place slices in large heavy skillet with a tight fitting lid. Sprinkle with bread crumbs, tomato and 1/4 cup water. Cover tightly and cook over low heat until carrots are tender, about 30 minutes. Uncover and cook over high heat 1/2 minutes longer to brown breadcrumbs. Serve.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,flat leaf parsley,pecorino romano cheese,beet,black pepper
title: Grilled Beet Bites
ingredients: 8 large flat-leaf parsley stalks | 1/4 cup coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese or 1/4 cup parmessano cheese | 1 1/4 teaspoons coarsely grated fresh pecorino romano cheese or 1 1/4 teaspoons parmesean cheese | 1 teaspoon coarsely grated fresh black pepper | 2 teaspoons coarse grainy mustard | 2 teaspoons coarse grainy mustard
instructions: Place flatleaf parsley stalks, 1/4 cup cheese and 1 teaspoon pepper in center of grill. Close grill and set timer to 15 minutes. Remove from grill, place beef slices on baking sheet, brush with 1 teaspoon mustard, top with remaining cheese mixture. Grill beef, uncovered, over direct medium heat until done, about 7 minutes for rare. Note, this goes nicely with grilled steak.

title: Rump Steak St. James's Style
ingredients: 1 cup clam juice | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs, chopped | 2 teaspoons marmalade, extra | 1 1/2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 5 lbs rump steak, trimmed and cut into 3 - 4 pieces | 2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: In a 3 to 4 quart casserole, mix clam juice, light corn syrup, mixed herbs and marmalade. Sprinkle yeast over juice mixture.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,garlic salt,green pepper,cardamom seed,gruyere cheese
title: Gruyere Cheese Ravioli
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 small green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Dough, mix together. Scoop out 1 1/2 cup of dough from a small bowl, roll into a ball. Place on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Let rest for a few minutes. Make sure dough does not get sticky. Form a circle out of dough into the center of parchment paper. Place a few pieces of pepper into the middle and stretch the edges of the circle. Brush with a little water to help seal. Repeat until all of the dough has been used. Top the dough with cheese. Cook, in a non stick pan, over medium high heat, stir the rava and cook for 4 - 5 minutes to make sure the cheese is melted. Cook the raviolies one at a time for 8 - 10 minutes or until lightly browned on the bottom. Use a spatula to remove the raviolies from the pan and place on a platter.

title: Cardamom-Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup soymilk | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed ( optional ) | 1/2 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut in 1-inch cubes | 3/4 cup dried split peas
instructions: Place the soymilk, cardamom seeds, and cayenne in a microwave safe bowl. Cook the beef in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove and add the peas to the container. Pour the soy milk mixture over the beef and peas, and mix thoroughly. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Check the soy milk and continue cooking until liquid is reduced and the meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: red onion,baby carrot,plum tomato,black mustard seed,green serrano chilies,ricotta cheese
title: Baby Carrots-Chilies Raita
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots | 3 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon whole black mustard seeds | 4 small seeded fresh plum tomatoes | 8 green serrano chilies | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh red onion
instructions: Cook carrots in lightly salted water until tender but still firm.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,apricot jam,ginger garlic paste,celery rib,sharp cheddar cheese,oregano leaf,button mushroom,cumin seed
title: Mushroom Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb button mushroom | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup corn oil | cumin seed | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon ground oregano leaves or 1 tablespoon fresh oregano | fresh oregano leaves, and | paprika and ginger-garlic sauce | fresh oregano leaves, and finely shredded to garnish
instructions: Clean and trim the mushrooms. Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the cumin seeds until they turn a dark reddish color. Remove the spices and stir in the spices. Remove from heat and stir in the cheese, ginger garlic paste, ground oregano and mix thoroughly. Fill the mushrooms with this preparation. Sprinkle paprika and finely shredded fresh oregano over the top and mix it through them. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Baklava Wreath (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tahini ( see directions for homemade recipe ) or 1 1/2 cups almond paste ( see directions for homemade recipe ) | 3 cups half-and-half | 6 -8 leaves frozen phyllo dough ( see instructions for recipe ) | 1/2 cup marzipan ( see instructions for homemade marzipan ) | 1 cup mixed olive ( optional ) | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 1 -2 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( optional ) | fresh strawberries, cut into a decorative pattern
instructions: To make the baklava, bring enough water to cover the bottom of a small saucepan. Add the olive paste. Cover, and boil over low heat about 25 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed. Cool. To make the baklava, preheat oven to 375°f, and lightly oil an 8x8 inch baking dish. Separate the phyllo sheets with a damp towel, and stack on clean paper towels. Using a pastry brush, spread marzipan over 1 or 2 sheets of phyllo. Sprinkle the nutmeg evenly over the marzipan, and drizzle about 1/4 of the marzipan mixture over the nutmeg. Dot with a few dabs of marzipan, or a handful if desired. Starting the long end, roll up, and jelly roll style into a rectangle about 3x3 inches. Using a long slice knife, cut off the ends at an angle, and cut along its length, then crosswise into about 4 equal strips. Continue until all the pastry has been used, laying a few vertical strips at a time over the filling. Repeat until you've used all the ingredients. Arrange the baklava in the prepared oven, then bake 25 minutes, then carefully turn over, and bake 15 minutes longer, or until golden. To serve, cut each piece into 4 squares for a colorful layered serving. Serve with strawberries.

title: Quick & Easy Mexican Rice & Raisins
ingredients: 1 bag uncle bill's long grain white rice | 1/2 bag raisins ( optional, but recommended ) | 15 ounces picante sauce, any flavor | 2 teaspoons mustard ( optional, i use tabasco ) | 4 ounces peels, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice. Drain, add raisins, optional picante sauce and mustard. You can adjust this based on your personal tastes. Put in a 9x13 pan in rows along with crushed peels. Cover with foil and bake in 350 degree oven for 45 min, turn the rice over and bake for an additional 10 min or until the rice is done.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 cup baby spinach | 1 1/4 cups good maldive malt vinegar
instructions: Wash the spinach and steam over boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes the wilted water is used to stop the cooking process. Remove from the heat and toss in the vinegar until well coated. Serve cold as part of the night with salads. Enjoy.

title: Orange Peel Steak
ingredients: 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 1/4 cups crushed fresh orange peel | 1 1/4 cups ice water
instructions: Prepare onion soup mix according to package directions. Lightly coat nonmetal griddle surface with cooking spray, pour onion soup mixture in & cook until no bits of onion remain. Stir frequently & when mixture turns light brown, remove from heat. To serve, spread orange peel around grill rack. Place a piece of meat on the peel & sprinkle with soup mixture.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,masala,green food coloring,mustard powder,molasses,oyster sauce,sun tomato,apple juice
title: Famous Miami Oyster Pastry
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup green food coloring | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 3/4 cup apple juice | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 jar honey-corn syrup-based gravy sauce | 1 dash worcestershire sauce
instructions: In small bowl, mix together molasses, sun dried tomatoes, and food coloring until desired shade of green. To make pastry for pie, unfold pastry on cookie sheet.

title: Thai Basil Tuna Fish
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chinese duck sauce | 3 cans tuna in water, drained | 4 leaves thai basil, torn into strips
instructions: Place the tuna and basil in a large bowl, and toss with the duck sauce. Cover, and refrigerate for about 1 hour before serving.

title: Duck Fajitas
ingredients: 20 large duck | lemon pepper | 2 liters boiling water, salted | powdered sugar, sifted | tortilla, warmed | chocolate, chopped | squash, chopped
instructions: Clean duck thoroughly under cool running water. Cut into quarters, remove any fat and silver skin or sinew. Score skin by holding on wing tips and running under cold running water, do not cut off the top part as this will make the duck tough. Spread duck with lemon pepper. Place on rack in roasting pan. Roast, uncovered, in a moderate oven until fat is rendered and duck is nicely browned and tender. Take duck out of the oven. Cover with aluminium foil and rest in a warm place for 15 minutes. Remove foil. Heat oven to 200°c. Remove duck from roasting pan. Cut fat from duck. Discard fat. Score skin again with a sharp knife. Arrange duck on warmed platter and cover with warmed plate. Sprinkle sifted powdered sugar over the flesh of the duck. Wrap in a large aluminium foil and leave in the oven for 15 minutes. Remove foil and discard. Remove platter from the oven. Turn grill temperature up to high, place platter over duck. Place platter on grill and allow duck to rest for 5 minutes. Turn oven off. Place duck breast side down on grill and brush with a glaze, sprinkle with lemon and sugar mixture. Close the door and continue to cook and baste until duck is cooked to your liking. Remove from oven. Serve with a side of warmed tortillas and a salad. Garnish with chopped chocolate and a small bunch of choped squash. Tips, the duck fat can also be used for cooking in other recipes calling for duck fat. You can easily replace the duck fat with other fat.

title: Black-Eyed Peas - Cornmeal
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 1 1/4 cups dry black-eyed peas | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar
instructions: Combine well and store in an airtight container for 1 - 3 months.

title: Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 can beef consomme | 1/4 cup dry vermouth
instructions: Combine the beef consomme and vermouth in the top of a double thickness of heavy cheesecloth or kitchen cloth, tying well at the outside edges. Suspend the cloth over a bowl or slow cooker until the consommé is fully dissolved. Cool completely. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Easy Apple Chutney
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tart apple, peeled and sliced | 1 can pinto beans, drained ( or beans of your choice )
instructions: Mix the ketchup and apple with the pinto beans and chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: butter,radish,wheat flour,romaine lettuce,poppy seed,sake,pimento pepper,graham cracker crumb
title: Radish Coins
ingredients: for the radishes : | 1/3 cup whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon poppy seeds | 1/4 cup shaved fresh radish | pimento and pimento shredded ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons softened butter ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons sushi nori ( sweet soy sauce ) | 4 tablespoons shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler. Combine the flour, poppy seeds, radishes, pimento, soy sauce, and shredded lettuce in a bowl. Divide the radish batter amongst 4 or 5 sheets of plastic wrap and flatten to 1/4 thick. Place a small amount of shredded lettuce on top. Roll from the center out to make a 3 inch diameter coin. Place on a baking sheet. Bake until pale golden brown, about 20 minutes. Slice diagonally and serve.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,monterey jack cheese,white fish fillet
title: Chef Bevski's Baked Fish
ingredients: 3 lbs white fish fillets, such as cod or 3 lbs cod, about 10 ounces each, 6 ounces each | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Place the fish in a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the fish generously with maple syrup. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400°f for 15 minutes or until the fish turns opaque.

title: Mexican Rice Bake
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice | 2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 jar salsa | 1/2 cup capers ( drained ) | 3 dates
instructions: Spray 13x9 pan with cooking spray. Combine rice, cheese, salsa, capers, and dates in medium bowl.

title: Mexican Tortilla Rollups
ingredients: 12 tortillas | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 can ro-tel tomatoes ( ro-tel tomatoes with basil flavor ) | 2 teaspoons dried sage
instructions: Lightly coat a 13 x 9 baking dish with cooking spray. Cut each tortilla in half crosswise & place on dish. Cover with foil. Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, using a food processor, puree ro tel tomatoes & garlic. Remove 1 tbsp of mixture & set aside for serving. Add remaining mixture w/tortillas. Spread reserved tomato mixture on tortillas. Roll up & serve with reserved tomato mixture for dipping.

title: Lebanese Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 cups fat-free veggie cheese, cut up | 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon chili | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 cup finely chopped walnuts
instructions: Place cheese in a bowl. Add yogurt, chili, and allspice. Sprinkle with nuts. Serve at once or refrigerate for 1 hour for more flavor before serving.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,fast rise yeast,cremini mushroom,taco sauce
title: Italian Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fleischmann's fast rise yeast | 1/4 cup sour cream ( lowfat or nonfat ) | 1 cup sour cream ( lowfat or nonfat ) | 5 cups light cremini mushrooms ( washed, dried, and torn ) | 1 jar taco sauce, lowgret medium
instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast and sour cream and let sit until foamy. Warm a heavy 10 inch skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle yeast mixture over warm skillet with some 1/2 cup water. Allow to sit until top surface of yeast is dry, about 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and 1/2 cup water. Stir well. Transfer heat to low. Cover, and allow to bake until bubbly and beginning to brown, 15 to 18 minutes. Uncover with a spatula and raise heat to medium high. Spread taco sauce evenly over crust. Turn dough over and spread evenly with sour cream mixture. Cover with a spatula and place pizza in oven. Bake 5 minutes. Remove from oven and leave in oven. Allow to cool 10 minutes. Serve with your favorite toppings.

title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: pasta, recipe prepared | 1/4 kg beef bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons lemongrass, chopped finely | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1/4 cup single cream | 1 pie crust, prepared | 200 g beef sausages, sliced thin
instructions: Saute beef bouillon, lemongrass and mace in pot at high, scraping up brown residues. Stir. Add cream and meat sausages and cook for 20 - 30 minutes over low heat, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking until liquid is reduced to about 1 cup. Season to taste.

title: Orange Peel and Horseradish Brochettes
ingredients: 2 oranges, peeled ( about 5 inches long ) | 3 teaspoons oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons gingerroot ( grated ) | 4 teaspoons horseradish, drained
instructions: Slice oranges into 1/8 inch thick slices, leaving peel on. Place in bowl. Heat the oil in large frying pan on medium high heat. When oil shimmers and emits a tiny, steady shake, add half of the orange peel and then rest of orange peel and ginger. Stir fry 30 seconds or until brown. Transfer orange peels to bowl with ginger. Stir in horseradish. Scatter remaining half of orange peel on top. Serve warm.

title: Egg Drop Sauce Gravy
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces hot sauce | 4 fluid ounces plain flour
instructions: Place the flour in a mixing bowl. Stir in the hot sauce and mix until blended. Pour into a pan made with a lid, or into a container of your choice. Heat on a low heat. Stir to mix, then leave to bubble for 1 minute. The bubbles will begin to look as steam rises from the top. Place a heatproof plate over the pan to keep it from moving. Pour the egg drop into the pan with a small knob of butter. Leave to bubble for 2 - 5 minutes, shaking the pan over with a metal spatula frequently to make sure the bubbles disappear. The underside will still be slightly soft. Pour over your favourite veg or meat. Leave to bubble gently for another 2 - 4 minutes or until the sauce has slightly darkened. Remove from the heat and leave to cool slightly. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bean,mexican cheese,hungarian paprika,rye bread,soya sauce,cucumber,self raising flour,italian turkey sausage
title: Italian Sausage & Bean Sandwich - Healthy Option
ingredients: 1/2 lb italian turkey sausage | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 2 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 cup mashed beans | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 3 slices rye bread, crusts removed | 1/2 cucumber, chopped
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices & fry until golden. Spray crockpot with nonstick cooking spray & place all ingredients in crockpot. Cook on low 2 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,marinara sauce,spicy brown mustard,baby spinach,garlic,splenda granular,chicken tender,espresso
title: Smoked Chicken and Spinach
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs chicken tenders ( cut the chicken up if necessary ) | 1 jar spicy brown mustard ( i like spicy brown pearl ) | 6 cups baby spinach | 1 jar marinara sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso ( coffee granules or brandy ) | 1 teaspoon splenda granular or 1 teaspoon sugar | 2 -3 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well, allow to marinate at least 30 minutes or up to several hours. Heat smoker to high, put chicken on, cover and smoke until juices run clear. Serve over cooked cooked baby spinach.

title: Mexican Pickled Jicama
ingredients: 2 large jicama, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 2 serrano peppers, stemmed and seeded
instructions: Place jicama, serrano chiles, and 1½ cups water in a bowl.

title: Avocado Dip II
ingredients: 1 can peeled and diced avocados | 1/2 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Place avocado in a bowl, and blend with mayonnaise. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: thai chili sauce,molasses,dill seed,italian parsley,grain rice,cannellini bean,stewing beef,creole seasoning
title: Lori's Beef and Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into small chunks | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 5 cans creole-style diced tomatoes with basil and garlic, drained | 1/3 cup molasses | 1/2 cup dried italian parsley | 1 teaspoon dried dill seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons thai chili sauce | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together all ingredients except the coriander and cilantro. Layer meat mixture, burying the whole sprigs in between the meat and beans in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish, pressing firmly. Spread the rest of the ingredients over the meat. Cover, baking at 350 degrees farenheit for 2 hours, or until meat is tender but not browned.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,heavy whipping cream,triple sec,shiitake mushroom
title: Creamy Shiitake Mushroom Mousse
ingredients: 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon triple sec
instructions: In a large bowl, beat cream with a handheld mixer on medium high until soft peaks form. Stir in mushrooms and bell pepper. Remove from bowl and beat in triple sec. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Polish Dill Cream Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups half-and-half cream, at room temperature | 1/3 cup dried dill weed | 1 -2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 3/4 cup lukewarm water
instructions: Stir all ingredients together in a small non aluminum bowl until well blended. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Use the chilled mixture sparingly after refrigeration, to bring out its flavour and make a smoother texture for spread. This is good served over chicken breasts, pork or other meat.

title: Macaroni and Wine
ingredients: 1 package macaroni noodles ( macaroni can be used depending on taste ) | 1 can sliced grape leaves ( don't drain! )
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until just tender.

title: Southwestern Spareribs (Caribbean)
ingredients: 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 2 tablespoons dijon-style sweet vermouth | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 1 lb beef country spareribs, trimmed | 1 head cauliflower, cut crosswise into florets | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: For the sauce, place picante sauce, vermouth, tabasco and sweet vermouth in large saucepan, making sure the ingredients are blended. Bring mixture to a boil. In a large skillet, lay spareribs in prepared pan and place over high heat. Reduce heat to low and cover. Let ribs cook, turning every 15 minutes, until browned, 7 to 9 minutes total. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add cauliflower and cook uncovered until tender, about 8 minutes. Drain cauliflower and return it to the pot. Cover and keep warm. When the ribs are done, drain them. Place 2 ribs on each warm plate and pour sauce evenly over them. Serve immediately.

title: Tahini Coleslaw
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon freshly grated orange zest | 1 cup finely shredded cabbage | 1/2 pound frozen broccoli florets, thawed and sliced
instructions: Mix the tahini, orange zest, and 3/4 cup of the cabbage in a salad bowl. Add the thawed broccoli.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,beef neck,red pepper flake,date,fish
title: Tunisian Roast Beef
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs beef neck bone | 1 1/2 lbs ground fish ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 8 -10 pitted dates, coarsely crushed ( optional )
instructions: Set oven to 300 degrees f. Insert meat thermometer into center of roast. Rub seasoning into meat. Pierce meat several times with a skewer. Place roast on rack in a roasting pan. Combine remaining ingredients in a small shallow baking dish, stirring to mix. Spread over roast. Cover loosely with foil and place roast on center rack of a roasting pan. Bake, turning once, 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Check liquid every 45 minutes. Remove roast from oven. Cover loosely with foil and cool 10 minutes. Uncover and let stand 5 minutes. Turn meat onto carving board, slice thickly, serve with accumulated juices from the pan. Slice into 1/2 to 3/4 slices, serve.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,corn,salt black pepper,coconut,heavy cream,banana
title: Sweet Corn in Cream
ingredients: 4 ears fresh sweet corn, shucked, cut in 6 to 8 pieces each ( or use canned, drained ) | 1 cup chopped canned sweet corn | 1 cup heavy whipping cream ( or whole milk, 1 percent or non dairy milk powder ) | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream and 2 tablespoons heavy cream | crushed ice | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1/4 cup shredded sweetened coconut
instructions: In a skillet sprayed with a cooking spray, saute the sweetcorn in the cream until just tender, about 3 minutes, tossing. Remove from heat, stir in the sweetened corn, and transfer the mixture to a large serving plate. Let cool. To serve, in a chilled serving bowl, whip the remaining cream with a fork or electric mixer until soft peaks form. Pour the cream over the corn, and add the flaked coconut. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Grilled Lobster & Horseradish Shrimp Cocktail & Chilli (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 14 )
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable broth ( reduced sodium ) | 1 tablespoon horseradish, grated | 12 ounces lobster meat | 4 ounces salsa ( low sodium ) | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 teaspoon fresh basil, chopped ( or coriander leaves ) | 2 tablespoons ice
instructions: Heat up grill and brush with oil. Grill or broil lobster for 4 - 5 minutes on each side or until golden and cooked through. Whilst grill is heating, combine all ingredients and serve drizzled with the horseradish sauce.

title: Mexican Hot Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken broth | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Combine chicken broth and cilantro in a small nonstick skillet. Bring to boil and simmer 15 minutes or until reduced to 1 teaspoon. Serve hot over tortilla chips.

title: Cheesy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided | 1 1/2 cups diced yellow onions | 3/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix 1 cup mozzarella cheese, 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, yellow onion, and 3 tablespoons cajun spice mix in a bowl until well blended. Spread remaining cheese mixture evenly over the top of each hot dog. Place hot dogs on an ungresed baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: coleslaw mix,pickle relish,chili pepper flake,cherry tomato
title: American Dressing for Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh cherries tomatoes | 1/2 cup sweet pickle relish | 3/4 teaspoon chili hot pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 3 tablespoons coleslaw mix
instructions: In a bowl combine cherries, relish, hot pepper, and coleslaw mix.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,vegetable oil,cauliflower,cumin,cheddar cheese,corn flake,green cabbage
title: Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1 cup shredded green cabbage | 1/4 cup sour cream, divided | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon corn flakes, crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. In a medium bowl, combine the mozzarella, ricotta and 3/4 cup swedish cheese. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with the cumin. On the bottom of a 9x9 inch baking dish, sprinkle 1/4 cup of the sour cream and sprinkle with the cheddar cheese mixture. Top with the cauliflower, then top with the remaining ½ cup cheese. Mix together the oil and corn flakes and drizzle over the cheeses. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: key lime juice,iceberg lettuce,salsa,oregano leaf,worcestershire sauce,yellow onion,lamb
title: Taco Burger
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1/2 cup yellow onion, sliced | 1/4 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons fresh key lime juice | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 1/4 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, onion, salsa, lime juice, worcestershire, oregano and lettuce. Divide into 4 equal portions, shaping each into a patty approximately the size of a large egg.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,tapioca starch,cotija cheese,lentil,saffron strand,mango powder,scallion
title: Lentils and Beer
ingredients: 350 g lentils, washed | 150 ml guinness stout | 4 tablespoons tapioca starch | 1/2 teaspoon mango powder | 100 g chopped scallions | 1 tablespoon saffron strand | 25 g cotija cheese, grated or 100 g feta cheese
instructions: Combine the lentils with the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 1 hour or until the lentils have absorbed all the water. Remove from the heat and leave for 5 minutes. Stir in the cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,asparagus,pineapple juice,broccoli,tea,chicken fillet,cream mushroom soup
title: Tropical Chicken
ingredients: 1 small broccoli, coarsely chopped | 500 g chicken fillets | 4 tablespoons tomato paste | 100 g cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons fresh pineapple juice | 300 g asparagus, chopped | 2 tablespoons brewed tea
instructions: Steam broccoli for 10 min or until tender. Slice chicken into thin strips. Combine tomato paste, soup, pineapple juice, pineapple and chicken in a microwave safe bowl. Cook uncovered in the microwave for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve over steamed asparagus.

Random Ingredients: chili bean paste,taco seasoning,mar bar,garlic salt,irish cream,beef rib,russet potato
title: Tex-Mex Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 pounds beef short ribs, cut into 2-inch wide slices | 1 can chili bean paste | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 cup irish cream | 1 large russet potato, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: Place short ribs in a shallow roasting pan. Combine chili bean paste, 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, and garlic salt in a blender.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,topping,kielbasa,blade steak,heavy cream,nonstick cooking spray,oregano leaf
title: Beef Roll in Creamy Rice Vinegar and Kielbasa (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb blade steak | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon kielbasa, cut into 1/4 by 1/8-inch sticks | nonstick cooking spray | 2 teaspoons quick-cooking spray
instructions: Cut fat from steak and trim excess fat.

title: French Tender Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 1 kg stewing beef, trimmed | 1 tomatoes, trimmed and cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Put the sugar in a shallow ceramic bowl. Toss the beef in the sugar and let it sit while you prepare the rest of the recipe. Drain the beef and leave it to stand for 10 minutes. Wrap a wooden skewer in a piece of beef and insert the tomato wedges. Heat a large heavy based frying pan. Add enough water to come halfway up the side of the meat. Heat to boiling point, then reduce the heat and simmer, covered for 3 hours or until the meat is tender. Check the liquid periodically and add more water if it evaporates too quickly into the liquid. Taste for seasoning and keep warm until serving.

Random Ingredients: cod,red chilies,garlic paste,onion flake,american cheese,white wine vinegar,cardamom seed
title: Bergie's Fish Chowder
ingredients: 6 cups peeled and deveined cod, cubed | 2 1/2 cups diced white american cheese | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 3 red chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: In a pot over medium low heat combine the cod, cheese, cardamom seeds and dried onion flakes. Stir until dissolved and evenly coated with spices. Cover with a lid or lid secured with a lid and simmer until mixture has reduced and thickened. Add the garlic paste and chopped red chilies. Add white wine vinegar. Cover and simmer until flavors have blended.

title: Rigatoni Rice With Pineapple-Basil Stuffing
ingredients: 5 ounces rigatoni pasta or 5 ounces penne pasta, uncooked | 1 cup long grain rice, uncooked | 8 ounces cheese, shredded | 1 can pineapple rings, drained | 1/4 lb basil, sliced | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse under running water, drain and keep warm, covered. In a large bowl combine the cooked rice, cheese, pineapple, basil and almonds, tossing well to mix. Transfer to a 9x9 in. Baking dish coated with cooking spray. Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally or until heated through and cheese starts to brown..

title: Roasted Caper and Lemons
ingredients: 3 cups drained capers | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper
