instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Pour capers into a baking dish, spreading them evenly. Sprinkle with lemon pepper. Bake, stirring occasionally, 25 minutes, or until browned.

title: Pasta With Bread and Egg
ingredients: 3 3 ounces dried short pasta or 3 ounces fettuccine | 2 ounces chopped white bread
instructions: Heat 2 cups water in a large frypan over low, stirring occasionally. Cook the pasta or fettuccine in the water until tender. Rinse under cold water, drain. Toss the pasta with the breadcrumbs. Cook's tip, if the pasta is to be eaten within an hour, use a slotted spoon to lift the pasta and bread into the pan. Serve hot.

title: Saffron Tighs or Twists
ingredients: 2 saffron | 2 leeks, diced | 36 wonton wrappers
instructions: Heat 2 inch water in pan. Take out saffron, pour out excess water and add to boiling water. Add diced leeks. Slightly sautee using a soup tieve or slotted spoon until the leek has softened. Remove from heat and set aside. Wipe saffron clean. Using a small, damp cloth, dip each wonton into boiling water for about 30 seconds. Place a pinch of saffron mix at one end of a wrapper and gather the sides. Pull corners up on top of the leeks. Using a wet knife, carefully place each filled wonton in the center, bring the edges together, pressing the edges tightly. Do not overfill. Serve immediately or they will become hard to work with.

title: Spiced Turkey Meat
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg turkey meat, trimmed of fat | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 tablespoon citrus rind, grated | 1 cup mushroom stems ( optional ) | 3/4 cup tequila | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade, extra | 2 tablespoons smoked paprika | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger juice
instructions: Score the turkey on both sides using a diamond pattern. Heat the oil in a saucepan over med high heat. Brown the turkey, a few pieces at a time for 1 - 2 mins each side. Remove turkey from the pan. Add the rind to the same pan. Stir fry 1 minute then add the mushrooms. Stir fry for 5 mins until they soften and release their juices. Stir in the tequila, orange marmalade, smoked paprika and ginger juice. Spoon the mixture into the cavity of the turkey, ensuring you leave plenty of space at the top of the meat. Cover. Reduce the heat and simmer 1 hr 30 mins till the meat starts to fall apart. The mixture will be a little dry. To serve, place a turkey on a bed of steamed brown rice and top with sauce.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,ricotta cheese,hoagie,cannellini bean,red chilies,dill
title: Cannellini Bean Heroes
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can chopped mild green chile peppers | 2 cans diced red chilies | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 4 hoagie rolls | 12 slices pickled red chilies, halved, or more as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine cannellini beans, green chile peppers, red chile peppers, ricotta cheese, dill, and 2 tablespoons red chile sauce. Arrange on a baking sheet. Bake for 2 hours in the preheated oven, or until filling is heated through and topping is bubbling. Serve on hoagie buns with sliced pickled red chilies, if desired.

title: Ginger Beer
ingredients: 600 ml ginger ale ( or a 16oz. can ) | 1 cube vegetable bouillon granule | 8 large fish fillets
instructions: Heat beer on the stove until it boils. This will take only a couple of minutes. While waiting for that, you need a saucepan on the stove. Stir in the bouillon. As soon as it is all boiling, add the fish pieces and stir to coat with the bouillon. Cook over medium heat until the fish are done to your liking. Serve with fresh vegetable fries.

title: Roasted Cauliflower and Shiitakes Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret, stems removed | 10 shiitake mushrooms | lemon pepper | 1 cup arugula leaves ( can use frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place cauliflower and mushrooms in a large roasting pan. Sprinkle with lemon pepper on top. Roast 25 minutes or until tender and mushrooms have given off their liquid. Meanwhile, prepare dressing by combining arugula and lemon juice. Pour dressing over cauliflower and mushrooms and continue to roast just until arugula is soft and crisp.

title: Venison with Blue Cheese and Barley.
ingredients: 2 lbs venison | 1 lb frozen pearl barley | 1/2 cup dried red chilies | 2 packages blue cheese | 1 package frozen mixed berries
instructions: Soak the venison in water for at least 4 hours before cooking. When ready to cook, prepare barley according to directions on the box. In another skillet, heat a little oil on a medium high, and cook venison for about 10 minutes, until it firms up a little. Take the venison out of the skillet and slice very thinly. In a casserole dish that will fit the venison, arrange the venison on the barley, and top with a layer of blue cheese. Spread the dried red chilies over the top, sprinkle the berries over the top, and a sprinkle of dried red chilies. If it looks like it needs more liquid, you can pour it in slowly. Cover and bake at 350f for 1 1/2 hours, or until internal temp reaches 170f. Let it rest another 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo sauce,pepperoncini pepper,cardamom,sesame seed,cream chicken soup,scallion
title: Quick Chicken Pepper Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 1/2 cups sliced pepperoncini peppers | 1/2 cup chopped scallions | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo sauce, seeded and minced | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom ( ground )
instructions: In a blender purée soup, sesame seeds, pepperoncini and scallions. Place in a saucepan. Add chili peppers, adobo sauce and cardamom. Heat soup to simmer.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,filet mignon steak,green pepper,coconut milk,baking soda,bay scallop,tomato sauce
title: Seafood (Filet Mignon) Rollettes (Fillet of Beef)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless filet mignon steaks | 2 medium green sweet peppers | 2 bay scallops | 2 cans coconut milk | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons celery salt | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Cut the tops off the peppers and place into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cut the steaks, lengthwise, 1/2 inch thick. Place in a single layer in a single layer and set aside. Cut the scallops into 1/2 inch wide slices across the grain. You may use any cut of meat that will fit your needs. Combine coconut milk, tomato sauce sauce and celery salt in a blender or food processor.

Random Ingredients: avocado,caster sugar,bean sprout,pam cooking spray,swordfish steak
title: Baked Swordfish & Avocado Salad
ingredients: 2 swordfish steaks, cut in 6 slices | 2 avocados, peeled and halved | 2 cups bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | pam cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c. Arrange swordfish in a single layer on a large baking tray. Pour over 1 tablespoon water and cover with foil. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes, until just cooked and firm. Meanwhile, make the dressing. Remove fish from the oven and set aside to cool slightly. Halve the avocados lengthways then put into a bowl. Squeeze any remaining avocado into a bowl. Put the bean sprouts into a small bowl of ice water to stop them from discolouring. Drain the fish under cold running water until cold. Drain and pat dry with paper towel. Arrange on 4 individual serving plates and drizzle with 1 tablespoon dressing. Sprinkle over the caster sugar, then serve immediately.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 ounces pimientos, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon caper or 1 teaspoon anchovy fillet, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh chives, minced | 1 tablespoon fresh basil or 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 cup ice cubes, crushed ( optional ) | 1/3 cup vanilla ice cream or 1/3 cup other almond ice cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Cover and chill at least 30 minutes, or up to 24 hours. Serve with fruit salad.

title: Quick Black Beans
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 2 1/2 cups cooked black beans
instructions: Turn on oven to 300°f. Coat a 3 1/2 quart casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine beans and black bean mixture. Cover and bake for 1 hour, stirring frequently. If toasted sesame seeds are desired, spread seeds on cookie sheet to lightly toast, 2 tablespoons per serving.

title: Posh Chicken & Sweet Potatoes With Coconut Milk
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken thighs | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 4 medium sweet potatoes | 2 medium carrots | 1 sprig rosemary sprig | 1 can light coconut milk | chopped fresh cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large saucepan, add the chopped sweet potatoes, carrots and rosemary sprigs. Season. Cook covered for 40 minutes, until carrots are tender. Remove chicken from pan, and cut into thin sliced. Place chicken and sweet potato mixture into pan with coconut milk. Add seasoning and cook over medium heat until warmed through, stirring for 1 - 2 minutes, until coated. Slice and serve. Garnish with cilantro.

title: Swiss Chard Prawns in Mustard
ingredients: 500 g swiss chard, leaves picked coarsely | 50 g plain flour | 1 1/4 kg large shrimp, peeled leaving tails intact ( i've never used the 2 pkg )
instructions: Remove stalks from chard and break leaves from stems. Place leaves in boiling water and cook for 2 minutes. Drain well and place in a large bowl. Add flour to chard mixture in bowl and mix with your hands until dough is the consistency of coarse breadcrumbs. Add shrimp and mix until well coated. Cover and leave for 30 minutes. Meanwhile preheat oven to 180°c. Line a large baking tray with baking paper and scatter chard mixture over the. Using your fingers or a wooden spoon place mixture under the hot oven and bake for about 10 minutes, or until prawns turn pink. Transfer prawn mixture to a bowl and serve either warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,cotija cheese,black pepper,jalapeno chile pepper,kale,black bean,white flour
title: Salsa for Zwt-9
ingredients: 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup cotija cheese ( can use parmesan ) or 1 cup asiago cheese, grated | 1 bunch kale, chopped ( no stems ) | 3 jalapeno chile peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh coarse ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Combine the canned tomatoes with the black beans, cheese & fresh greens in a bowl. Add the jalapeno and black pepper. Stir. Serve immediately. Yum.

title: Harissa Spoon Sweet
ingredients: 6 ounces white corn | 14 ounces mint | 6 ounces egg yolks | 200 -300 ml warm harissa
instructions: Heat a pan on a medium heat and add the harissa. Crush the mint leaves and add to the pan. When the mint starts to look wet, take off the stove and let it cool down for a few minutes more. While cooling the mint, beat the egg yolks with a medium sized pinch of salt using a mixer. Slowly add the warm mint mixture to the eggs and mix well.. The mint will give off a very mild aroma and start showing liquid in the mix. Don't worry about this bit. The taste is closer to real, as it will all eventually come together.. When it is at room temperature, remove from the heat and stir in the harissa. Let chill covered for at least one hour for flavours to combine. When serving you can use the harissa to top it up and/or on top of the cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,chipotle chile,madeira wine,matzo meal,red pepper,salami,tarragon,coriander
title: Smoked Hash
ingredients: 20 ounces smoked salami, thinly sliced | 1 jar madeira wine | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup tarragon | 1 tablespoon coriander | 1 -3 chipotle chile | crushed red pepper | matzo meal
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325 degrees and place rack in center of oven. Line a large roasting pan with a double layer of damp towel and place roasting pan on counter. Place smoked saltami into a plastic bag and pour in madeira. In a small bowl, combine soy sauce and spices. Shake off excess liquid from bag. Drain the smoked saltami, reserving the liquid, and place it in a large bowl with chopped tarragon and coriander. Drain the cooled smoked saltami and add to bowl with spice mixture. Dry the chilie peppers, remove seeds and veins and add to bowl with liquids. Mix lightly. In a separate bowl, mix the matzo meal with a bit of the reserved smoked sausage liquid. Spread the matzo meal over the meats and vegetables and coat well, pressing down slightly to help adhere.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,tart apple,gruyere cheese,pumpkin pie spice,chicken wing,cannellini bean,chili oil,strawberry
title: Spinach and Apple Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup cannellini beans ( soaked ) | 3 lbs tart apples ( such as granny smith apples ) | 12 cloves garlic, peeled | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 9 ounces baby spinach | 8 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 2 cups grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f, if using your oven to begin with, in a large mixing bowl, combine beans, apples, garlic, pumpkin pie spice, and chili oil. Season with additional salt and pepper. Transfer the mixture to a large casserole or baking dish and add the spinach and 3/4 cup of grated gruyere cheese. Stir to blend. Add the cheese over the top. Bake in the center of the oven for 45 - 50 minutes, stirring halfway through the baking time. The spinach mixture will release some liquid and start to thicken, making sure it is evenly distributed.

title: Parsley Fried Eggplant (Aubergine) Cakes
ingredients: 4 small eggplants | 1/4 cup bread crumbs | 1/4 cup uncooked white rice, rinsed | 2 garlic cloves, peeled and minced | 10 tablespoons bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Lightly oil rack in a large baking sheet. Cut eggplant lengthwise into 1/2 slices. Place slices on baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 25 minutes, until tender and beginning to brown. Remove from oven, and set aside. In a bowl, stir together 2 teaspoons bread crumbs and rice until well mixed and bread crumbs stick to the breadcrumb mixture. Remove eggplant slices from oven, and blot with paper towels. Coat both sides of each slice with bread crumb mixture, pressing bread crumbs into the eggplant. Lay flat on baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until crust is golden. Serve warm.

title: Crunchy Raw Vegan Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 lb small shell pasta or 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 4 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/4 cup raw coconut
instructions: Heat a large pot of water and boil the pasta until al dente. Drain the pasta in a colander. Mix together the fish sauce and coconut in a large bowl. Drain the pasta in the colander, shaking off excess water. Toss with the coconut mixture.

title: Taco Filling
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together ketchup, garlic powder, and cocoa powder. Let cool to room temperature.

title: Wild Rice Crust for Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, cooked | 1 2/3 cups unbleached bread machine yeast, dough ( i used 2 pkg. )
instructions: Measure wild rice in the order recommended by its manufacturer. Add yeast in 3 increments and mix thoroughly. Put dough on to your bread machine in the order recommended by its manufacturer.

title: Easy Cream of Chicken
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 3/4 cup white wine
instructions: In medium bowl mix soup and wine together. Dip chicken in the soup mixture. Arrange in baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for about an hour.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,chicken breast half,celery salt,clove,white cabbage,tomato green chilies,cucumber,chicken base
title: Santa Fe Oatmeal (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 bone-in skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons chicken base | 1 large cucumber, peeled and diced | 2 cups white cabbage, finely chopped | 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chilies ( i use ro-tel ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon clove | 2 cups oatmeal
instructions: Combine chicken with chicken base and onion in 4 crock pot crock pot. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 - 8 hours or high for 3 - 4 hours. Shred cooked chicken with fork or chopsticks and stir into juices along with remaining ingredients. Cover and continue cooking on high setting for 20 - 30 minutes or until mixture thickens. Serving suggestion, i warm the oatmeal with green salad for added protein.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,ladyfinger,chipotle chile,chicken broth,basmati rice,lasagna noodle,fontina cheese
title: Chipotle Restaurant Style Lasagna
ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles | 3 tablespoons whole grain mustard | 10 ounces mascarpone cheese or 10 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped canned chipotle chiles | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth or 1 1/2 cups mushroom broth | 1 ounce fontina cheese, shredded | 3 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente, according to package directions.

title: Crunchy Scottish Shortbread
ingredients: 4 cups corn flakes | 1 cup currants or 1 cup dried currant
instructions: Mix cornflakes and raisins. Add flour as needed. Dough should be slightly elastic.. If dough is sticky, add flour if dough is sticky, knead until smooth. Cut into squares with a glass that has been dipped in flour. Or with a cookie cutter, cut squares into strips. Or just using a pastry cutter, cut squares into strips or a sharp knife. Bake on ungreased 15 x 10 inch metal baking sheet at 325 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: farmer cheese,cardamom pod,baby clam,deep dish pie crust,white sugar,salad oil,asparagus,tart apple
title: Farmer Cheese Applesauce Tart
ingredients: deep dish pie crust, such as a 9-inch pie | 12 whole asparagus, trimmed | 2 large tart apples, cored | 1/4 cup vegetable salad oil | 1 package baby clams, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup white sugar | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon drained chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread the deep dish pie crust with vegetable salad oil. Arrange asparagus spears in circles to cover 1/4 inch from the edge and ends if you plan on serving them in a single layer, leaving about an inch of room at the top of the crust. Scatter the apple slices over asparagus. In a large bowl, mix the salad oil, baby clams, sugar, cardamom, and parsley. Carefully pour the dressing over the asparagus. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Remove plastic wrap, uncover tart, and sprinkle the top with a few more crushed almonds or shaved parmesan cheese.

title: Mexican Pearl Barley Parfait (Pear Barley Pie)
ingredients: 500 g pearl barley ( in the shell, not the pearl barley, just the pearl barley or barley that has been soaked overnight or in the fridge. ) | 3 cups chunky salsa | 1/2 cup orange peel, finely grated | 1/2 cup lemon peel, finely grated | 3 large egg yolks | 1 liter cracked ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Cook barley, according to pack instructions, and drain in a colander. Place rice in a bowl with salsa, orange and lemon and mix well. Fold in the egg yolks. Place the ice in a tall, non metallic, glass or ceramic pie dish. Pour the liquid in the dish to cover all of the surface. Carefully move the pie dish into the oven without touching it, and bake for 35 - 40 minutes or until the crust is lightly browned and the top has turned a pale golden brown colour. Remove from oven and leave in for a few minutes. Remove the pie dish from the oven. Using a sharp knife, cut several small slits into the baked crust, then insert a skewer or tooth pick into the crust to keep it from wobbling. Return to the oven to melt the cheese and reheat. Slice into wedges and serve hot. If you are serving more than one, you can keep the leftovers in the fridge for up to 2 days.

title: Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried marjoram | 2 slices beef short ribs | 3 cups jasmine rice
instructions: Rub marjoram into beef slices. Sprinkle ribs with more marjoram. Rinse rice well and drain. Place rice, meat and marinade in a roasting pan. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake short ribs for 1 hour.

title: Spicy Sambal Noodle
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage ( mild, casing removed ) | 1/2 cup sweet potato noodles ( not chunky or sweet ) | 1 cup light coconut milk | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chat masala, spice to taste | 1 lb linguine
instructions: Slice sausage in 1 - ½ inch pieces. In skillet, brown sausage until no longer pink on exterior, breaking into large chunks. Drain off grease. When cool enough to handle, add noodles and coconut milk to skillet and saute. When noodles are tender, drain and toss with heated mixture. Mix in more chile if using. Serve with plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: kale,triple sec,italian tomato,chickpea,red pepper,grainy mustard,salt black pepper,pork shoulder
title: Tuscan Sausage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salt-free bottled mustard | 8 links ground lean pork shoulder | 8 ounces italian cut sausage links ( with casings about 2 links ) | 1 lb kale, stems discarded, leaves coarsely chopped | 4 ounces chickpeas, drained | 2 cans italian-style diced tomatoes, undrained | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper ( or jalapeno pepper ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine mustard and pork in a small bowl, add sausage meat. Drain well. Using your hands, mix the sausage mixture and the kale well. Add 1/4 cup water and toss until the kale is well coated with the mustard mixture. Using your hands, form the sausage mixture into walnut sized cylinders about 1” x 3”. Grill the sausages over a pan of boiling water 7 minutes, turning once, or until cooked through. While sausages are grilling, combine diced tomatoes, jalapenos and crushed red pepper in a medium pot. Simmer over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, until reduced by half. Transfer hot tomato sauce to a bowl, add sausages and mash well. Serve hot. Drain sausages on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,mandarin orange,brie cheese,heavy cream,fish,allspice,ladyfinger,green chili pepper
title: Spicy Sausage Roll With Brie Sauce
ingredients: 20 ladyfingers | 1 jar whole allspice | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 1/2 lbs sausage links with casings removed or 1 1/2 lbs bratwursts, sliced thinly | 2 cans mandarin oranges | 2 packages brie cheese | 1 package green chili pepper, deveined and seeded | 2 lbs smoked fish, of your choice
instructions: Arrange 6 ladyfingers on counter. Pour 1/4 cup cream over ladyfingers.

title: Roasted Potato Salad #SP5
ingredients: 16 red potatoes, quartered | 32 ounces white wine vinegar | 1 lb fat free sourdough starter ( not low fat or fat-free )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Using a sharp knife, cut potatoes lengthwise around the middle.

title: Fig & Figs - Biscotti-Cooked Figs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup figs, finely chopped
instructions: Mix flour, figs and the juice of 1/4 cup water until batter resembles fine breadcrumbs or a slightly sticky consistency. If using a pastry bag fitted with a small plain tube, place flour in a plastic bag. Place the bag in a bowl & pour hot water into it to approximately 1 3/4 cups to moisten the bag. This may need to be done quickly. Place the bag of soaked figs in the bowl with the batter, pouring around the bag to coat. Place over a pan of simmering water & cook until the sauce thickens. Turn off the heat & cover with a clean towel. Leave the biscuits undisturbed, covered with a clean tea towel. Allow to cool for at least 10 minutes, then take off the cloth. Cut each biscotti into 4 - 6 serving sized pieces. Serve.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,picante sauce,rice noodle,part ricotta cheese,red pepper,margarita mix,flour tortilla,coconut
title: Noodle and Cheese Lasagna
ingredients: 12 rice noodles | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese | 8 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 8 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 jar picante sauce ( mild or medium ) | 8 ounces red peppers ( can use green ) | 1 package no-salt-added marshmallow mix | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper ( optional ) | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a 9×9 baking dish lightly oil the pan with cooking spray. Place noodles in bowl of a mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Drain, and rinse noodles with cold water. Add 3/4 pound of mozzarella to noodles and mix until well mixed. Add 1/8 cup more of mozzarella, then ricotta and mix until fully incorporated, adding more cheese if necessary. Spread about 1 cup of picante sauce over the bottom of the prepared dish. Place 4 flour tortillas over picante sauce, and spread 1/8 of the cheese mixture evenly over tortillas. Layer the next 4 ingredients on top of cheese, spreading slightly until all ingredients are used. Top cheese layer with remaining 4 flour tortillas, cover with waxed paper, and freeze for 2 hours. Place a large baking sheet on the middle rack and preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the lasagna on a baking rack and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the surface is crusty and top is golden brown. Let sit for 10 minutes before slicing. Makes 10 servings.

title: Ginger Apple Skewers
ingredients: 8 medium tart apples, such as golden delicious | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons ground ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice or 1/4 cup cider vinegar, as needed
instructions: Cut apples into 1/8 inch slices. Put apples in a strainer and sprinkle with ginger garlic ginger and garlic paste. Use a fork to crush the garlic into the meat. Transfer the mixture to an airtight container and refrigerate for 1 1/2 hours. Stir together lemon juice and cider, pour over apple skewers. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours or overnight. Skewer the apples occasionally with skewers. Serve warm.

title: Chorizo Cod (Dumpling Prices)
ingredients: 250 g dried macaroni | 170 g canned chorizo in adobo ( with pimento and a little of the chorizo ) | 100 g baby spinach | 1 dumpling wrapper | 200 g chorizo, cooked and chopped into big chunks | 2 3/4 teaspoon instant cocoa
instructions: Boil a pot of water and cook the macaroni to their package directions. Strain and cool to the touch. Meanwhile, finely chop the chorizo or leave chopped chorizo on, about 150g/12oz. Set aside. Heat a pot of water and cook the spinach. Drain spinach and return to the same pot along with the chorizo/spinachos. Add the dumpling wrappers and 2 pinch of the instant cocoa. Taste and season with more chili powder if desired. If you're using a fresh chorizo, cook it according to the package directions or buy chorizo off the internet. Add a couple of tablespoons of water to the pot so the dumplings don't sink when you lay them out on the surface and make sure you leave space in between the pieces so that they cook evenly. Cook for 5 minutes, until the dumplings float to the surface. Remove from the heat, cover with a damp cloth and let stand for 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,thai fish sauce,red leaf lettuce,garlic,yellow pepper,spaghetti,pea
title: Thai Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 cups frozen peas, thawed | 2 cups yellow sweet peppers or 2 cups red sweet peppers, cut into thin strips | 1 medium red leaf lettuce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 lb thin spaghetti
instructions: In a large bowl, toss thawed peas with the peppers, lettuce, garlic, fish sauce and nutmeg. Toss thoroughly. Cover and chill in refrigerator at least 1 hour and up to 24 hours. Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Toss with dressing just before serving.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,ketchup,splenda granular,parsnip,swiss chard,tabasco sauce,chicken leg
title: Sweet and Spicy Swiss Chard Salad W- Chicken
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard | 3 -4 chicken legs, skin removed | 1 bunch swiss chard | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ketchup ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon splenda granular ( to taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar ( to taste ) | tabasco sauce or other hot pepper sauce | 1 -3 tablespoon dried parsley
instructions: Rinse chard well, cut leaves off, and slice into thin cross sections. Wash and trim stems and tear chard, cut leaves in half crosswise, and then cut crosswise into slices. Cut chicken into thin strips, removing tough end pieces. Wash, rinsed chicken pieces, and place in a large salad bowl. Pour all remaining ingredients over the chicken and swiss chard, and toss lightly. Sprinkle with dried parsley and serve.

title: Mashed Pumpkin
ingredients: 4 cups pumpkin puree ( preferably a yellow pumpkin ) | 2 lbs lean ground meat ( i use turkey, beef and pork ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 beaten egg yolk | 4 ounces cooked, chopped deli meat
instructions: Mix together all ingredients until smooth. Put into casserole dish. Bake in a pre heated oven for 20 minutes. Serve with rice on the side. Note, this makes about 4 servings and the pumpkin gravy goes great with a salad. Note, if the pumpkin is not mashed, boil it to remove lumps.

title: Seared Scallops with Pineapple
ingredients: 12 large scallops | salt and pepper to taste | 2 tablespoons chopped drained canned pineapple | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/4 cup crushed ice
instructions: Preheat the grill for high heat. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Heat a skillet over medium heat, and coat with cooking spray. Season the scallops with salt and pepper on both sides. Lay scallops flat in the prepared baking sheet, about 2 inches apart. Pour pineapple over scallops, and top with water chestnuts. Top with lid, and grill until fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove fish to a platter, and garnish with crushed ice.

title: Quick Spanish Omelette
ingredients: 1 tablespoon egg whites | 1 lb broccoli floret, cleaned & washed | 1 can rotel
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add the egg whites. When the whites have started to turn golden, add the broccoli. Keep stirring, add the can of rotel. Put a lid on the pan & reduce heat. Cook covered on low for 2 - 3 minutes before cutting into wedges or squares.

title: Sweet and Spicy Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup mango chutney ( prepared ) | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Mix together. Stir to blend. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow flavors to blend.

title: Homemade Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Mix the sour cream and parmigiano reggiano cheese together in a bowl until the cheese is completely dissolved into the liquid. Let stand at room temperature until the pasta is needed.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,ice water,red chili pepper,yellow pepper,orange peel,coffee
title: Aunt Rita's Extremely Simple Microwave Coffee
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1/4 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1 cup hot water ( or coffee ) | 1 teaspoon orange peel, grated | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon red chili pepper, crushed | 2 -4 teaspoons shredded orange peel | 2 -5 teaspoons crushed red chili peppers | 1 tablespoon ice water
instructions: Prepare rice per package directions. Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl or dish, stirring after each addition, until coffee is melted. Add as much or as little as you like of the liquid to your liking.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,spicy pork sausage,vanilla extract,five spice powder,pine nut,chili paste,baby shrimp,wheat bread
title: Shrimp and Sausage Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb spicy pork sausage | 1/2 cup baby shrimp, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup pine nuts, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | warm whole wheat bread or cracker
instructions: Set the oven rack about 6 - 8 inches from the heat source and preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Cut the sausage links lengthwise into 1/8 inch slices. Arrange the sausage slices in one layer in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Broil, turning as needed, until browned and cooked through, 2 - 3 minutes per side. Transfer the browned sausage to a plate and set aside. Turn the oven to 325º f. Place the shrimp, pine nuts, vanilla, five spice powder, chili paste, chili powder, chili powder and shrimp in a large bowl. Toss mixture with 1/2 cup pork sausage. Transfer mixture to a small, round baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and chill at least 2 hours or up to 4 hours. Preheat the broiler. Cut the sandwich in half diagonally. Place equal portions of the shrimp mixture on bread and serve right away. Garnish the tops of each serviing sandwich with the additional pine nuts.

title: Chinese Pork Cakes With Strawberry Coulis
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, 1 1/4 inches thick | 3 eggs ( lightly beaten ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup whole kernel corn | 1/2 cup chinese cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded | 2 tablespoons whole cilantro stems, chopped | 3 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the pork chops, eggs, sour cream, corn, cabbage, lettuce and cilantro.

title: Grilled Crepes With Fennel and Poblanos
ingredients: 3 -4 crepes | 1 cup fennel bulb, trimmed, washed, trimmed, and patted dry | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 fresh poblano pepper, washed, and cut into strips
instructions: Heat a grill to its highest point. Brush some oil over your griddle or skillet, and place three large spoonsful of mixture onto the griddle. Fold the crepes in half and let cook for 4 to 6 minutes on each side, or until the underside is browned. Spread the crepes with lemon juice, and spread each one with the fennel bulb, salt, and a sprinkling of fish sauce. Add poblanos to pan and top with a second spoonsful of fennel mixture. Cover and cook 2 - 3 minutes, or until cheese is completely melted. Serve immediately.

title: Nacho Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dried shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 1 jar picante salsa
instructions: Place mushrooms in a medium pot over medium high heat. Pour salsa on top, and bring to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes to soften and cool. Transfer to a serving bowl, and top with reserved shiitake mushroom stems. Refrigerate at least one hour before serving.

title: Quinoa Stuffed Zucchini
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 puff pastry sheet | 1 cup zucchini, grated | 1 cup button mushroom, sliced | 1 1/2 cups cooked ground beef | 2/3 cup cooked quinoa, divided | 5 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup prepared gravy
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the bottom of a pie pan, or round baking dish, with the 1 teaspoon vanilla. Combine zucchini, mushrooms, and ground beef until well mixed. Roll out the 1 pastry sheet to fit into the pie pan. Place on top of the vanilla. Sprinkle top with 1/4 of the cheese. Add the other 1/4 of cheese to the filling. Using an oiled knife, mix the flour, confectioners' sugar, and vanilla together then spread all over the zucchini mixture. Top with the quinoa layer. Cut along the sides of the filling with a knife, so that it will not fall off when done. Bake for about 45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top before cutting. For gravy, combine the 2 tablespoons confectioners' sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla and pour over the quinoa mixture.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,pecorino romano cheese,grand marnier,thyme,parmigiano reggiano cheese,avocado,white wine vinegar
title: Avocado Appetizer
ingredients: 2 avocados | 2/3 cup dry white wine vinegar | 3/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese, divided | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 tablespoons pure mango chutney
instructions: Peel avocados and cut flesh into large chunks. Place shells on a baking sheet and freeze until solid, about 10 minutes. In a bowl, mash together avocados, parmigiano reggiano cheese, 3/4 cup romano cheese, thyme, grand marnier, and half of the chutney with a fork until creamy. Transfer mixture to a fondue pot and heat for about 5 minutes until slightly thickened. Serve with prawns or chicken.

Random Ingredients: salmon,guava,orange zest,green chilies,barbecue sauce,self rising flour,rice flour
title: Mexican Salmon & Chilies
ingredients: 4 green chilies, deseeded & chopped | 1 teaspoon orange zest, finely grated | 3/4 cup guava, skinned, chopped ( can use canned ) | 2 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup rice flour | 1 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, finely grated | 2 tablespoons green chilies, deseeded & chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 190°c if using oven proof bowls, place the chilies in an ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with the orange zest, then top with guava, stirring to soak up any excess juice. Combine the flour, rice flour, orange zest, 3/4 cup barbeque sauce and 2 tablespoons chopped green chilies in a bowl. Spoon over the chilies and bake for 20 - 25 mins or until set. Allow to cool, then stir through the remaining 3/4 cup barbecue sauce and scatter over salmon. Serve.

title: Aloo Ki Dal
ingredients: 500 g green chilies, crushed ( khatti, chilli, khatti mung dal ) | 5 cardamoms | 5 teaspoons crushed green cardamoms
instructions: Peel off the greenish parts of the chilies. Grind the green chillies to a fine paste. Add the ground chillies, 5 cardamoms and 4 teaspoons of green cardamoms. Mix well. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,dark soy sauce,soymilk,hamburger,pistachio nut,chili pepper,confectioner sugar
title: Peking Pork
ingredients: 1 pound pork tenderloin, sliced into thin strips | 1 can sweet chili pepper, drained and cut into very thin strips | 1/2 cup chili shao hsing ( dark soy sauce ) | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup finely sliced marshmallow ( optional ) | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 cup chopped, cooked hamburgers
instructions: Place pork strips into a resealable plastic bag, and squish with a spoon to make sure the meat is evenly coated. Combine all sauce ingredients in a separate container. Pour over pork, and mix thoroughly. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour or overnight. Drain pork, reserving marinade, and cook in a large skillet over medium heat until browned and no longer pink inside, about 35 minutes. Serve with reserved marinade, and dust with confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,pork rib,peanut,heavy cream,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese-Spiced Pork Ribs
ingredients: 2 lbs pork ribs | 1/2 cup heavy cream ( whipping cream if you must ) | 1/2 cup lemon juice zest | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts, chopped, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f rub salt onto ribs. Spread on aluminum foil and arrange into a baking pan. Bake for 30 minutes, or until nicely browned. While roast is baking, make the sauce. In medium saucepan, combine cream, zest, 5 spice powder, and half of the peanuts. Cook over low heat until well blended. Set aside while ribs roast. Remove the ham racks from the oven and brush with remaining lemon juice. Place ribs on serving platter.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,nori,cinnamon,corkscrew macaroni,orange juice,pistachio pudding mix,strawberry,white flour
title: Macaroni Salad With Strawberry-Raspberry Dressing
ingredients: 1 box corkscrew macaroni | 1 package of strawberry-raspberry puddings ( the jelly-flavoured packages in the boxed ) | 1 3/4 cups white flour | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 4 sheets nori
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,whipping cream,watercress,cardamom seed,egg yolk,nut almond,salt pork,onion
title: Creamy Egg and Nut Raita
ingredients: 300 g whipping cream, lightly beaten | 3/4 teaspoon salt pork, finely minced | 1/2 cup freshly chopped onion | 1 teaspoon green curry paste ( to taste ) | 2 egg yolks | 1/4 cup watercress, finely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped mixed nuts, chopped ( or nuts of choice ) | 1/3 cup freshly made roasted salted almonds, sliced, toasted or 1/3 cup almonds slivers, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the cream, salt, pork mince, onion and curry paste. Chill 30 minutes. In another bowl, combine the egg yolks with 1/4 cup watercress and nuts. Beat with a whisk or fork until light and fluffy. Combine egg mixture with cream mixture and gently stir until well blended. Stir in 1/3 of the hot cream and serve with remaining hot cream.

title: Hot Paneer Cheese with Peppers and Chocolate
ingredients: 2 cups panir, cubed | 1/4 cup dark chocolate, chopped | 1/4 cup roasted bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spread panir cubes on a baking sheet and roast for 15 - 17 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir chocolate and bell peppers into cooled crumb mixture. Spread on hot block of a block of the same width. Cut into 8 - 12 squares. Serve drizzled with extra melted chocolate.

title: Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 2 eggs | 6 -10 slices sausage ( optional ) | 1 can mushrooms ( drained ) | 1 jar of favorite hot sauce | 1/3 cup hot sauce ( from a jar of noodles ) | 1 tablespoon chopped pepper sauce ( from a jar of noodles )
instructions: Preheat oven 325°f. Combine tahini, eggs, seasonings and mushrooms in a large bowl. Mix well. Spread mixture over the bottoms of 8 x 8 inch cake pans. Roll up and place rolls seam side down. Pour hot sauce over top. Bake for 20 minutes. Serve with noodles.

title: Falafel
ingredients: 1 cup chickpeas, cooked | 1 cup fresh corn | 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Mix all together and stuff into a pita type or other flat bread. Serve with yogurt.

title: Potato, Filling, and Filling in Microwave
ingredients: 1 russet potato | 1/2 cup whole wheat ( not quick cooking ) | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, blend ( e.g. mccormick ) | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, grated, divided | 1 large baking potato | 2 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice, blend ( e.g. mccormick ) | 1/4 cup apricot preserves, heated
instructions: Wash potato thoroughly. Cut potato lengthwise into 6 slices, then crosswise into pieces 1/4 inch thick. Place potato slices on a microwave safe plate, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high power for 2 to 3 minutes or until tender. Pat dry with paper towels. Transfer potato slices to a clean dish, peel off wrap and discard. Spread a thick layer of mozzarella on the potato slices. Carefully sprinkle on 1/4 cup of the grated cheese. Top with a second layer of the potato slices. In a food proccesor place 1/4 cup of the grated cheese, chopped potato, 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice blend, and 2 tablespoons of warmed preserves. Add 1/4 cup of water if the stuffing looks too dry. Microwave on high power for about 3 minutes, covered, until cheese is melted. Spread remaining cheese mixture on top of potato slices. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 5 to 7 minutes or until vegetables are warmed.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,tomato sauce,cauliflower,ancho chili pepper,phyllo dough,tamarind paste,lettuce,eggplant
title: Chili Pouch Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 lb cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 eggplant, sliced into 1/8ths, about | 1/3 lb cabbage, cut into 1-inch wedges | 1 small dried ancho chili pepper ( optional ) | 1 container tamarind paste | 1 cup tomato sauce, about | 1 1/4 cups shredded lettuce | 8 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Place pork in a large, nonreactive bowl. Add cauliflower, eggplant, cabbage and chili. Toss to coat. Pour tomato paste over and toss to mix. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate at least 1 hour, tossing occasionally. Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Unwrap dough from the refrigerator. Cut 1 sheet of hot pepper into 1 1/2 x 3 inch strips. Working one piece at a time, roll out and slice into a circle 6 wide and 9 long. Spread tamarind paste thinly over the tortillas. Place 1 3/4 cups of pork mixture in the center of each tortilla. Fold up the sides and roll up. Seal by folding the two long sides together using the dampened fingers. Repeat on other side of each dough. Place in a 9x13 baking dish. Pour any excess oil or cooking juices from the baking dish onto the top of the burritos. Bake until browned on top, about 30 minutes. Top with lettuce, tomatoes, and remaining pepper strips.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,flat leaf italian parsley,habanero pepper
title: Homemade Spicy Oil
ingredients: 3 cups light white sugar | 2 habanero peppers, seeded and minced | 4 heads fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, coarsely chopped
instructions: Pour sugar into a small, heavy saucepan, and stir in habanero chiles, parsley and hot pepper. Cook over medium low heat until candy thermometer drops about 1/2 cup of syrup onto a piece of waxed paper, about 20 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Break candy into small bowls.

title: Coriander Tortilla Pasta Tossed With Coconut & Cream
ingredients: 1 package penne or ( 900 g ) package other dried tubular pasta | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup coriander powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground vanilla sugar | 3/4 cup vinegar ( white wine or rice vinegar ) | 2 tablespoons dry parsley flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Cook pasta according to directions, draining in a large pot of boiling water after about 1 minute. In a large bowl, combine sugar, vinegar and spices. Add pasta and stir til all the ingredients are blended together. Transfer to a large baking dish coated with cooking spray. Bake 10 minutes, then serve.

title: Baked Oaty-Fenugreek Rollups
ingredients: 24 inches rolled oats | 24 inches rolled oats | 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 package soft quick-cooking rolled oats | 1 package fenugreek leaves ( kharita, basil, etc. ) | onion, chopped | 1/4 cup minced onion | powdered vanilla | 12 toothpicks
instructions: In a large bowl, spread the rolled oats on two thirds of each side of each pork tenderloin square. Top with 1/2 each of fenugreek leaves, minced onion and chopped onions. Starting with one rolled rolled oat, roll up jelly roll style with seam side down and place seam side down on a foil lined baking sheet that has been dusted with a few flour. Repeat process with remaining pork. Pre heat oven to 375ºf. Sprinkle pork with 1 tablespoon kosher salt, then drizzle with 1 tablespoon of water. Bake at 375ºf for 35 to 45 minutes or until meat thermometer reads 160ºf remove from oven and let stand 10 to 15 minutes before slicing thinly. Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen meatballs | 1/2 cup baby carrots | 1 whole avocado, peeled & sliced | 1 lime, zest of, chopped | 8 ounces pepperoni, coarsley chopped
instructions: Place in large bowl meatballs& carrots. Cut avacado in half, peel and place on top of mixture. Shake zest and mix well with meatballs& carrots. Top with pepperoni. Enjoy and adjust seasonings to suit your taste.

Random Ingredients: steak,jalapeno pepper,vanilla,sharp cheddar cheese,chuck,chicken bouillon,irish cream,almond extract
title: Chipped Beef and Cheddar Spread
ingredients: 1 jar jalapeno peppers | 2 lbs ground chuck | 1 lb ground chuck | 3 cups sharp cheddar cheese | 1 pint irish cream | 1 cup chicken bouillon | 2 1/2 teaspoons chicken powder or 2 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh jalapeno peppers | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. In small saucepan, bring jalepenos to a boil just long enough to blanch them. Do not boil. Using slotted spoon or slotted spoon, remove and transfer jalepenos to baking rack set over rimmed baking sheet. Let cool at least 15 minutes. Drain and reserve jalepenos from jar reserving liquid. Chop jalepenos into small pieces and place in bowl. Using hands, mix beef, beef drippings, cheese, dried peppers, vanilla and almond extract with fork until mixture is combined. Spread in a 3 quart casserole dish and bake 1 hour or until bubbly. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight.

title: Low Fat Italian Dip
ingredients: 1 carton fat-free ricotta cheese | 8 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 can low sodium beef broth
instructions: Combine ricotta, feta cheese and italian seasoning with a mixer until well blended.

title: Caramel Mac 'n Cheese
ingredients: 250 g gemelli pasta, dry | 450 g unsalted dry-roasted unsalted peanuts | 50 g unsweetened shredded coconut | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | sweet basil for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Cook gemelli pasta in a pot of boiling hot water for 3 to 4 minutes or till just tender. Drain. Meanwhile dry roast peanuts in a dry skillet over moderately high heat, stirring, until golden. Remove from heat. Stir coconut and herbs into the peanuts. Divide pasta among 4 baking trays. Sprinkle mac 'n half of the nut mixture onto pasta. Top with remaining nut mixture. Bake, uncovered, for 5 to 10 minutes or till golden brown.

title: Smoked Ham or Hocks -- Sweden
ingredients: 12 ham hocks, rinsed and dry | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 8 ounces smoked goat cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place all of the ingredients in a baking dish, cover with olive oil or just enough to coat the bottom of the dish. Smear the cheese and bake for 3 hours at 300 degrees f. Remove from the oven and serve.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,vanilla bean,parmesan cheese,broth,water chestnut,italian tomato,galangal
title: Tomato Based Sauce for Dipping
ingredients: 2 large italian tomatoes | 1/2 cup onion | 1 -2 tablespoon gingerroot ( fresh chopped ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 cup broths ( any kind ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1/2 cup water chestnut, sliced thinly | parmesan cheese ( for sprinkling )
instructions: Cut 2 large tomatoes in half. Cut tomato halves into halves and discard ends.

Random Ingredients: island dressing,green chilies,green cardamom pod,white onion
title: Creamy Indian Onions
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces sour cream ( any flavor ) | 1/2 cup white onion, diced | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained | 1/4 cup thousand island dressing
instructions: Place sour cream, onion, chilies, thousand island dressing, and green cardamom in a blender and puree until thoroughly blended. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Quick and Easy English Grilled Cheese
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon honey | 8 ounces fontina cheese, sliced and diced | 1/2 cup sliced blanched almond | toasted almond, sprinkled on top of cheese ( optional )
instructions: Cover a nonstick griddle or skillet with cooking spray. Over a low flame, stir buttermilk, honey and diced fontina cheese until blended, about 15 minutes. Scatter almonds, if using, over cheese and cook until cheese is golden brown, about 1 minute. Cut into desired serving size pieces and drizzle with toasted almond glaze. Repeat to make 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: yeast,turmeric powder,sausage,dark soy sauce,orange liqueur,chile pequins,herb,fine egg noodle
title: Cousin June's Sausages
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs thick good quality sausage ( i prefer johnson if i live them ) | 1 teaspoon fine egg noodles | 1/2 teaspoon dried chile pequins ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried turmeric ( or your favourite pinch of turmeric powder ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fine egg noodles ( or 1 whole egg plus 1 whole egg plus 1 whole egg plus 1 egg ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( can subsitute light or no-sugar ) | 1/2 cup dried herbs ( i use coriander ) | 1 dash white sherry or 1 dash orange juice ( optional ) | 1 dash sambal oelek chile ( or hot sauce ) ( optional ) | herbs, of choice
instructions: First, cook the uncooked sausage. While waiting for water to boil, you should prepare the egg noodles, soak and prepare the chile pequins in hot water for about 20 minutes, then squeeze out excess water and slice into 1/4 inch rings and set all aside. When you are ready to cook your sausage mixture, put your sausages into a bowl with a little water and lightly brush the surface with white sherry or sambal oelek. If using dried herbs, soak them in hot water and squeeze out the water. You should have about 1½ cups of dried chile pequins from the first step. Then, put the sausages and the rest of the ingredients into a greased oven safe pyrex dish. Dot them with the egg noodles if using. Put in the oven while the chile pequins soak up the liquid and give it a good stir so that they cook through. When the chile pequins are cooked through, remove them to a plate as soon as they have cooled, then stir them back into the noodle mixture. Cover tightly with foil and bake in preheated oven at 325°f for about 1 hour. Check the dish every 15 minutes, so the bottom doesn't burn or get dry. During the last 15 minutes i check if the sauce is drying up, which should take about 15 - 18 minutes. If not, continue to add a few drops of sherry or orange juice if too, if too, and mix in more chile pequins. Serve warm with plain white basmati rice, if desired.

title: Lamb Chops or Pork Fritters for the Grill
ingredients: 4 lbs pork butt, 1/8 inch thick | 1 tablespoon tahini | 3 small zucchini | 2 tablespoons bread machine yeast | 3 lbs lamb chops or 3 lbs pork chops ( 1/8 inch thick )
instructions: Mix all ingredients except lamb or pork in the bread machine for about 15 minutes. Put the bread into the machine. Add lamb or pork chops and bread. Select the meat. Bake the bread in the oven at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes per pound. You can cook the pork in a separate pan, or with a touch of oil before baking.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,lemon zest,bulk italian sausage,rump roast,marinara sauce
title: Italian Sausage Stew
ingredients: 1 large rump roast, trimmed of excess fat | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 1 package bulk italian sausage | 1 jar marinara sauce ( your favorite brand )
instructions: Spray the inside of your crockpot with cooking spray. Place the roast in the crockpot, and rub with lemon zest. Place the sausage in a large frying pan over medium heat. Cook the sausage until no longer pink inside, and beginning to brown, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Stir in the marinara sauce. Cover the crockpot, and set on low for 5 hours. Remove the meat from the crockpot. Discard the zest from the lemon zest, and slice the meat into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Lebanese Chilli Seeds
ingredients: 1/4 cup kashmiri chili powder | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Stir together all but the salt. Allow to sit overnight. Next day grind the chilli powder well. Remove the seeds from the mixture into a smooth paste with a moistened spoon. Add the garam masala to the paste and mix well. Transfer to a covered bowl and refridgerate.

title: Cabbage, Barley and Carrot Soup
ingredients: 8 cups cooked pearl barley | 1 large carrot, chopped | 4 cups cabbage, shredded
instructions: Combine barley and carrot in a large saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat.

title: Greek Yogurt with Bacon
ingredients: 1 teaspoon bacon ( minced ) | 4 cups greek yogurt
instructions: Fry up the bacon till crispy. Remove from pan and set aside. Stir fry the yogurt in the same pan, over medium heat, till creamy and thickened. Turn off heat and enjoy.

title: Beef & Cauliflower Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef round, cut into 1-inch cubes ( i usually just buy the sirloin cut ) | 2 tablespoons green chili, chopped fresh | 2 lbs cremini mushrooms, halved | 1 cup cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Heat nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper. Working in batches, add beef to skillet and cook until brown on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch, adding more oil as needed between batches. Transfer beef and any accumulated juices to plates. Reduce heat to medium. Add chili, mushrooms and cauliflower to skillet in any remaining fat left in skillet. Stir fry, covered, 1 minute. Drain excess fat from skillet and return skillet to medium high heat. Add beef and any accumulated juices. Stir, uncovered, scraping up any browned bits and add liquid to skillet. Cover and cook until beef and cauliflower are tender, 1 to 1 - ½ to 2 minutes.

title: Vanilla Tuna Steak
ingredients: 1 tuna steak | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 dash white pepper
instructions: Grill or broil about 6 - 8 minutes per side until done. Cut up fine and serve. I like to broil my fish til it looks white but if you like your fish done a little better. This goes great with a fruit & fresh fruit sauce for a simple side dish. This also goes great with some fresh fruit and a good greek salad.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,tart apple,macaroni,sesame oil,ginger garlic paste,ouzo,cashew
title: Chicken Fried Capethe (Cashew Chicken)
ingredients: 12 -14 bone in chicken thighs | 1 tart apple, peeled cored and cut into 1/4 '' pieces | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 quart ouzo | 4 ounces cashews | 2 cups macaroni
instructions: In large deep skillet, fry chicken in hot ouzo on high heat until golden brown and cooked through. Drain and set aside. Add apples, ginger garlic paste, cashews and macaroni to pan. Cook, stirring frequently, until macaroni just begins to soften. Add chicken and toss to coat generously with macaroni and apple mixture. Serve in individual oven proof dinner plates with sauteed onions and fresh green peets.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,kaffir lime leaf,white wine,peanut oil,cheese,phyllo pastry,lemon lime beverage
title: Kaffir Lime Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 15 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaf, strips sliced fresh | 1 1/2 cups grated cheese | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 1/2 cups carbonated lemon-lime beverage ( or tonic and carbonated beverage ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Lightly oil a deep 9 pie dish. Heat peanut oil in a skillet over medium heat. Squeeze kaffir lime leaves to release water, then add to skillet. Reduce heat to medium low, then cook kaffir lime slices over medium heat until beginning to soften, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, and drain on a folded paper towel for 15 minutes. Pat excess moisture from kaffir lime slices, and set aside. Beat 1 1/2 cup grated cheese, 1/2 cup white wine, lemon lime beverage, and italian seasoning together in a bowl. Set aside 1/3 of the grated cheese in a small bowl, and set aside remaining cheese for another use. Cut 4 sheets of filo pastry into 12 even strips. Stack the 4 strips widthwise over remaining sheets of filo. Cut an additional piece of pastry into 4 or 5 strips and overlap corners of strips, forming a 2 inch wide strip. Cut strips lengthwise into 1 1/2 inch strips with a sharp knife. Repeat with 3 more strips and remaining strips. Arrange 4 strips of pastry over half of an ice bath, and brush with coconut flavored liqueur. Repeat process with remaining pastry and grated cheese. Bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Allow to cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chutney - for Dogs And Cats
ingredients: 4 chicken bouillon cubes ( or you can use 2 tsp boulon cubes ) | 3 tablespoons chutney ( spicy chutney ) | 5 -8 lettuce leaves | 2 large coriander ( leaves if you feel some may be too long ) ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a microwave safe glass bowl. Microwave for 30 seconds on medium high. Squeeze mixture to remove any excess liquid. Cover and cook on 600w until hot. Serve with your favourite salad or snacks. Keeps for up to a week in the fridge.

title: Apple Cider French Toast
ingredients: 8 slices of thick french bread | 2 ounces milk chocolate or 2 ounces milk chocolate | 1 can sweetened condensed milk & chutney, divided
instructions: Using a sharp knife remove bread from packaging. Place bread onto an oven proof pan that is just large enough to hold the two halves of the loaf. Place two chocolate squares into a microwave safe glass bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and microwave on high power for 3 minutes, stopping to stir every 30 seconds. Drain chocolate and whisk to combine. Add sugar and mix until melted. Remove chocolate from microwave and add 1 to 2 tablespoons of chutney to cream to create a lollipop. Pour cream on top of the bread slices. Return to microwave and cook on medium high for 30 seconds, turning bread slices once or twice until golden brown and cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: celery root,mustard powder,cardamom pod,sunflower oil,corn,lettuce,salsa,curry paste
title: Spicy Indo-Chinese Vegetable
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 500 g sliced celery root | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 2 teaspoons ground mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pods | 600 g shredded lettuce | 175 g chopped fresh corn | 200 ml salsa
instructions: Heat the oil in a large non stick fry pan. Add in the mustard powder and fry, stirring occasionally until very fragrant. Turn down heat and gently stir in the sliced celery root, curry and mustard powder. Let the vegetable mixture soften for a couple of minutes. Add in the ground cardamom. Add a handful of shredded lettuce and continue to stir until the lettuce is just soft. Add in a handful of chopped fresh corn and continue to stir until the lettuce is soft. Add in an additional handful of chopped fresh coriander and continue to stir. Serve over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,chili paste,lavender,red chili sauce,chuck steak
title: Vietnamese Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 kg chuck steak | 4 tablespoons red chili sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender
instructions: Boil meat and sauce for 20 mins drain and slice across the grain into 1 inch thick slices. Roll each slice in lavender or chilies. Serve with jasmine rice.

title: Yogurt-stuffed Mexican Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yogurt | 3 green onions, chopped | 2 3/4 cups corn tortilla chips, coarsely crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to combine yogurt, green onions, and corn tortilla chips in large bowl. Stir until well blended. Fill each reserved chip shell with yogurt mixture, about 2 heaping tablespoons per serving. Arrange in single layer on large baking sheet lined with foil. Bake for 35 minutes. Top with cheese and sprinkle with black pepper.

Random Ingredients: lemon,half cream,broccoli rabe,cake flour,iceberg lettuce,beef brisket
title: Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 8 ounces frozen broccoli rabe | 5 ounces baby leaves ready made cake flour | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1 cup half and half cream | 1 head iceberg lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large pot, add water to cover brisket. Boil and then drain meat. Cut cabbage in half and then remove core for garnish and then shred into 1 inch pieces. Mix the meat with the broccoli rabe and let marinate in cold water 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare cake flour by combining half and half cream with 1/2 cup cold water. In a small saucepan, add the remaining 1/2 cup of cold cream to the flour and stir until smooth. Slowly stir this thickened cream mixture into the warm mixture. Cover and let sit and cool to room temperature. Cut off top of iceberg lettuce and remove excess white bites, then tear into bite size pieces. Fill a large salad bowl with the meat and vegetables. Place the romaine leaves over the meat and gently fold all the ingredients together. The salad should now have a very light and fluffy topping that stays on a pretty green color. Garnish this salad with the remaining lettuce.

Random Ingredients: calorie sweetener,nutritional yeast,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,sparerib,chili sauce,large shrimp,leek,double cream
title: Shrimp & Potato Adobo Grilled Spareribs
ingredients: 2 large leeks | 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 2 tablespoons low-calorie sweetener | 6 lbs skinless, boneless spareribs | 1 envelope dried food-seasoned artificial sweetener | 1 package nutritional yeast | 2 teaspoons reduced-calorie sweetener | 1 can chipotle-infused chili sauce | 1 1/4 cups double cream or 1 1/4 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Trim the leeks, then cut 1 inch pieces into 1 inch lengths lengthwisewise slices. Place in a bowl and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 30 minutes. Add a few pinches of chipotles to the leeks and let stand overnight. Reserve 30 minutes of juice. Remove ribs from water, shake dry, and cut crosswise into 1 inch lengths. Place in a large nonstick skillet. Add reserved juice, 2 teaspoons sweetener, 2 teaspoons artificial sweetener, 2 teaspoons of sweetener, 1 packet of the adobo sauce. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, or until ribs are cooked. Remove ribs from skillet and keep warm. Strain cooking liquid through several layers of paper towels onto the ribs. Preheat grill or broiler. Brush the leeks with reserved cooking liquid and place on the grill or broiler racks. Brush grill with more cooking liquid and place ribs on the grill or broiler racks. Grill ribs over high heat, turning once, until browned and just cooked through, 12 to 15 minutes. During the last few minutes, brush the leeks with cooking liquid. Serve over noodles, rice or enchiladas.

Random Ingredients: sauce,graham cracker crust,chuck,french bean,pie shell,chili pepper,cannellini bean
title: French Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck | 1 can french beans | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 4 tablespoons hot sauce | 3 tablespoons chili peppers | 1 unbaked pie shell | 1 graham cracker crusts
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for cracker crust in a crock pot. Cook for 6 hours on high or 8 hours on low. Remove the crusts carefully. Scoop and serve.

title: Maggie's Easy & Delicious Eggplant
ingredients: 2 cans vegetable broth | 1 large eggplant, peeled & cubed | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate, broken into small pieces
instructions: Place eggplant cubes in a large pot, add water to cover & simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes or until tender. Drain liquid off of the eggplant & return to pot. Meanwhile, put the vegetable broth & dark chocolate into a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high power until chocolates start to melt, stir occasionally. Stir in the vegetable broth & heat through. Spoon the chocolates evenly over the eggplant. Serve hot.

title: Alton Brown's Wine Soaked Carpaccios
ingredients: 1 jar maraschino cherries | 2 tablespoons port wine
instructions: Fill a large bowl halfway with ice, and add the cherries to the ice. Gently toss the cherry mixture with a spoon so that the cherries are evenly coated. Pour the port wine in, and stir to mix. Let sit for 10 minutes. Strain the wine mixture through a strainer lined with cheesecloth and rinse the cherries, discarding any solids. Pack the cherry mixture into an oven proof baking dish, and place in a preheated 350f oven. Bake for 2 hours, or until the top starts to darken. Remove from the oven, and cool for 20 minutes. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Tobiko Donburi
ingredients: 4 cups finely chopped baking apples | 4 slices canadian bacon | 1/4 cup white sugar | 4 sheets nori | 4 teaspoons white sugar, divided
instructions: Whisk the 1/4 cup of sugar and the 4 sheets of nori in a bowl. Arrange the apples in the mixture until well coated. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of the sugar mixture over each apple, and fold the apple slices back into the sugar mix to coat. Place the tobiko sheets on a bamboo sushi mat. To use a rolling mat, gently roll the apple mixture into about an inch long cylinder. Spiral the cylinder so it becomes long, cigar shaped tibiko shaped sushi sticks with about 2 slices each. Skewer 3 smaller apples onto the skewers, leaving a 1 inch gap along the edges. Repeat with the remaining apple and nori. Bring water to a boil, and quickly submerge the tamarind tamarind balls into the boiling water. Cook the tamarind balls for 3 minutes. Remove tamarind balls with a strainer lined with a cotton towel to drain, and place on a dry cloth to dry overnight. Cut through the scored lines on the tamarind tines, and serve immediately. This goes perfectly with barbecues, stews, or steamed greens.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,nonfat milk powder,white flour,curry leaf,hamburger bun,cracker
title: Curried Beef Buns
ingredients: 1 1/8 lbs hamburger buns, split | 8 8 slices cooked ham ( thin strips ) or 8 slices cooked pork ( thin strips ) | 1 teaspoon curry leaf ( or 1/2-1 tsp curry powder ) | 1/8 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 3 -4 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 2 -3 cups whole wheat stone ground white flour
instructions: Split beef thinly and make into 1 inch squares. Combine beef and curry leaves and season with nutmeg, pinch of salt and pepper. Spread 1 1/8 cups of dry soy flour over the bottom of a shallow dish. Place one portion of beef mixture on top of the flour, roll up and secure with toothpick, if needed. Put beef rolls in the soy flour. Combine milk mixture and remaining dry ingredients in a bowl and pour over the beef rolls. Cover and refridgerate for several hours. Turn on the grill/broiler and let them get a good sear.

title: Pasta Salad With Smoked Beer
ingredients: 1/3 cup brown molasses | 1/3 cup nutritional yeast | 1 cup pinto beans | 1 cup rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1 head romaine lettuce, washed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine molasses, yeast, beans, and pasta. Cover and refrigerate for 20 to 30 minutes. Add dressing to salad, mix well. Garnish with romaine leaves.

title: Sesame & Pepper Seasoning Mix for Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sesame seeds, sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 3 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon dried chili flakes ( i used ancho )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a spice grinder.

title: Timbale (Filipino Pork and Pork Salad)
ingredients: 800 g pork shoulder, very thinly sliced | 3 lebanese cucumbers, cut into 8 lenghtwise strips | 4 -6 pork fillets, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons grand marnier, and | spaghetti or fish sauce, to taste
instructions: Cut pork into 6 - 8 thin strips. If you wish to make this meal for dinner, arrange cucumber strips in a circle around the outside edges of the plate. Arrange pork slices in overlapping lines around the cucumber slices around the pork. Place two filipino slices inside the pile. Dust the pork generously with grand marnier. Pour fish sauce over the top. Eat with spaghettini and rice.

Random Ingredients: white sesame seed,chicken breast,yellow pepper,mustard seed,thyme leave,madeira wine,soy sauce
title: Chicken Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons white sesame seeds | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cubed | 1 yellow pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 4 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon madeira wine
instructions: Heat a grill pan or wok over high heat with just enough oil to coat the pan. Sprinkle the sesame seeds with mustard seeds. Stir in the sesame seeds. Add the chicken pieces. Season with yellow pepper and mix thoroughly. Pour in 2 tablespoons soy sauce and stir. Cover and cook until the chicken has been fully cooked, stirring every 5 minutes, about 15 minutes. Stir in the madeira and cook 3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened. Remove the cover and reduce heat to low. Cook for 2 to 3 more minutes. Turn chicken over and spoon remaining soy sauce over. Cook until the chicken is glazed and the sauce has thickened and darkened, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes.

title: Fold-Fried Spinach, Onions, and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh spinach | 2 white onions, white parts only
instructions: Wash, dry, and slice spinach into strips about 1 1/2 inches long. Heat a wok over high heat. When it is hot, add about 2 tablespoons oil. When oil is hot, add spinach, and stir fry for a few seconds until the spinach wilts. Toss in onions, and stir fry until the onions are tender. Taste, and adjust seasonings.

title: Lekhake
ingredients: 1 lb self rising flour, sifted | 1 lb raisins or 1 lb sultana
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f, line a roasting tin with grease proof paper. Sift flour into a large bowl, mix in raisins, then add enough water so as to make a dough that's slightly sticky and pliable. Roll dough out very thin on a floured board, this might need more or less. Sprinkle dough with flour, knead a few times, then roll out to approx the same diameter. Traditionally around 1/2 inch intervals, but probably will probably be between 1/4 and 1/2 inch long. Cut into circles and prick with a fork, or place on greased oven trays, cover with greased parchment paper, and bake for 30 - 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Cheese & Nut Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mexican-style processed cheese ( velveeta works best ) | 5 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 1/4 cups soymilk | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Boil the mexican style processed cheese and soymilk together on low heat. Stir constantly until the cheese has completely melted. Combine the processed cheese with all other ingredients except the vanilla sugar. If you have trouble getting the mixture to smooth, try adding a bit of milk. It helps make sure the pudding is smooth and not sticky. If you have a problem getting the cheese to smooth, just add milk, and mix well. Pour into a shallow buttered 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle the vanilla sugar over the top. Bake at 325 degrees in a preheated oven for 45 - 60 minutes. Note, you may also use plain yogurt instead of the fish sauce. Also, try using nonfat milk instead of soymilk. I can never make it vegetarian. Also, for those looking for some of the mexican flavors at your local mexican market, you can use coconut milk, soy milk, coconut extract, or a can of sweetened condensed milk.

Random Ingredients: plum,salt black pepper,american cheese,tamarind pulp,brandy,basil,velveeta cheese,grape
title: Tamarind Sauce for Vegetables, Meat, or Chips
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese, cut into 1-inch squares | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp, soaked in | 1 tablespoon water | 1/4 lb american cheese, cut into 1 inch squares | 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 3 plums, seeded and diced | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, snipped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Mash the tamarind pulp and water in a small bowl or a medium pan and add the cheeses and diced tomatoes. Mix well and simmer the sauce, stirring constantly, until the cheese begins melting over low heat and the tomatoes begin turning slightly soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in the basil and brandy. Season with more tamarind pulp if desired.

title: Scallops in Veal Sauce (Firilloldsman's Villagers)
ingredients: 1 lb veal, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness | 1 lb sea scallops | 1/2 lb white pepper ( a jasoner's choice, or 1/2 tsp. ground red pepper ) | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground white pepper
instructions: Put the veal in a large, heavy skillet. Sprinkle over the white pepper, herbs and white pepper. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly.. When it starts to turn dark brown on the edges, reduce heat to low and continue cooking, without stirring, for 40 minutes, or until the veal is very tender. Keep an eye on it. After about 45 minutes, check that the veal is cooked. It may look dry, but be very careful not to burn the white pepper. When a meat thermometer registers 120 f, remove the veal from the skillet. Remove the cooked veal from the pan. Using 2 forks or a slotted spoon, break it into bite sized pieces. Serve hot. If refrigerated, allow to stand for at least 5 minutes before serving to absorb the flavors of the marinade.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,dill weed,cooking oil,plain flour,pumpkin,asparagus,cream mushroom soup
title: Chargrilled Haggis With Shiitake Mushroom & Asparagus & Pumpkin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/4 cup plain flour | 500 g pumpkin, cut into chunks | 4 large cremini mushrooms, roughly sliced lengthways | 400 g asparagus, trimmed, ends broken in 2 cm lengths | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon fresh dill weed ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in pan. Coat potato wedges with flour and cook in batches for 3 minutes each side or until golden. Set aside. Place remaining oil, pumpkin, mushrooms and asparagus in a large pan. Add soup and dill. Bring to boil and simmer for 8 minutes or until sauce is thickened and potatoes are tender. Season with salt and pepper if desired.

title: Pumpkin Crumble Pie (Pumpkin Toast)
ingredients: 1 pastry for double-crust pie | 150 g pumpkin puree | 1 slice short-grain bread | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c. Roll out dough to a 5cm thickness. Cut into 3 equal sized rounds and use 5cm rounds to stop it from cracking while cooking. Spoon pumpkin into the base of the ovenproof pie dish. Place bread slices on top of pumpkin. Drizzle with vanilla. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Creole Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Mix together.

title: Heather's Secret Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups pasta sauce | basil leaves | 1/2 cup loose tea
instructions: Heat the oven to 400degrees. Put the herbs in a pan and pour the tea over them. Turn down to 250/f and leave for one hour. Remove the tea and put the basil leaves in a blender and mix with the jar of pasta sauce. If the sauce is too thin, add a little more tea.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,superfine sugar,beef sirloin steak,nam pla,tri color spiral pasta
title: Phi Sig Beef
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sugar | 4 tablespoons nam pla | 4 tablespoons golden syrup | 4 tablespoons beef sirloin steaks or 4 tablespoons other lean steak | 4 ounces tri-color spiral shaped pasta
instructions: Boil water for spiral pasta, cook according to package directions. Toss the noodles with 5 tablespoons sugar, syrup, and remaining 1 tablespoon sugar. Serve with meat.

title: Roast Beef Burritos
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless roast | 1 -2 dried jalapeno pepper | 2 cups hot strong black coffee
instructions: Cut the roast into chunks about 3 - 5 inches long. Put meat in a large ziploc bag, cover with hot coffee, and refrigerate for 48 hours. Heat oven to 250 degrees. Remove meat. Reserve marinade. Arrange in a roasting tin. Make holes in the roast with a skewer or fork. Place roast and any reserved marinade into roasting pan. Roast for 2 - 3 hours, basting every 30 - 40 minutes. Turn off heat and tent with foil and let stand for at least 1 hour or longer. If liquid runs out of the roast, loosely tent foil with foil and place on dinner roll, or serve in flour tortillas for burritos.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,stiffly egg white,bicarbonate soda,soy sauce,salad oil
title: Crispy Egg-Free Bread
ingredients: 300 g split polished egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 450 g salad oil | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 500 g pita bread
instructions: Method,. Beat the egg white until very stiff and then add in the bicarb soda. Cut the pita bread into small triangles and dip the triangles in the mixture. Deep fry the bread slices at 150 degrees celcius until golden. Spray the bread with oil, then drain the excess oil and serve with the soy sauce for dipping.

title: Gigazhna With Almonds and Ginger
ingredients: 50 g ground almonds | 2 g gingerroot, peeled and grated | 1 green banana, peeled and diced | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
