instructions: Place the almonds and grated ginger in a mortar. Pound the mixture with a pestle until it resembles a smooth paste. Add the grated banana to taste and stir well. Add the chopped fresh flat leaf parsley and mix well. Serve.

title: BBQ Beef Strips
ingredients: 2 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 2 inch long strips | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 cup reduced-sodium vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, grated | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 5 tablespoons beer
instructions: Pour 2 tablespoons of teriyaki sauce into a glass or ceramic dish.

title: Beets Viva Madrid - Spanish Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 lb sweet pepperoncini pepper, small dice | 2 cups cooked beet, chilled and finely chopped | 1/4 cup cilantro, finely chopped | 1/4 cup peanuts, chopped | 4 teaspoons grated orange zest | salt and black pepper | 1/2 cup tequila
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together all ingredients except tequila and mix well. Add tequila and mix well again. Serve chilled or set for serving at room temperature.

title: Classic Syrup Glaze (For Dogs and Chips)
ingredients: 1 cup simple syrup | 1 large garlic clove, pressed ( optional )
instructions: Combine the sugar and garlic in a small saucepan and melt over medium low heat without stirring. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved, then allow to cool to room temperature. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove the garlic and discard it. Stir in the syrup and bring to a boil. Pour into the prepared pans and sprinkle with garlic.. Bake until golden brown, about 20 minutes. Allow to cool, then transfer from pan to a wire rack to cool to room temperature. Cover and let sit at room temperature for a few minutes before serving. Store covered in refrigerator up to 3 days.

title: Tomato and Raspberry Chili Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh raspberries | 15 ounces tomato sauce | 1 pinch hot sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons white flour | jalapeno
instructions: Chop up the raspberries and cut them into small pieces. Mix all the ingredients together in a heavy, non reactive saucepan. Bring to a boil, then transfer to a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 4 - 6 hours or on high for 3 - 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,scotch whisky,monterey jack cheese,lemon peel,grand marnier,adobo sauce
title: Grilled Squash With a Kick
ingredients: 1 teaspoon minced fresh lemon peel | 1/2 cup chopped yellow squash | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon scotch whisky | 1/4 teaspoon hot adobo sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grand marnier, liquor, to taste
instructions: To prepare the marinade, combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Marinate squash. Prepare grill. Grill squash. Serve squash with reserved marinade.

title: Wild Rice and Ricotta Stove
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice, uncooked | 3 cups ricotta cheese, strained
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions. Cool for 5 minutes, then stir in drained ricotta until well blended. Serve chilled. Note, the longer it is allowed to cool, the more creamy it will be.

title: Chilli Con Carne (Chilli and Beef Patties) for a Hearty Meal
ingredients: chili paste | 2 kg chuck or 2 kg round steaks
instructions: Rub the meat generously with chili paste. Barbecue under a preheated oven of 200oc for about 1/2 1 hour or until cooked through. Serve with vegetables and salads.

title: Chili and Tomato Quesadilla Fritters
ingredients: 4 large flour tortillas | 1 -2 teaspoon tomato and green chilies, chopped ( canned ) | 2 teaspoons coriander leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat large frypan. Pour enough oil or butter into pan to just cover the bottom of the pan. Heat until butter bubbles, then fry the tortillas for 30 seconds on each side and remove with slotted spoon, set aside. Repeat for other tortillas. Add chillies, coriander and seasoning to pan. Heat through. Place a slice of the tortilla on serving plate and top with a spoonful of the chilli and coriander dip.

Random Ingredients: cedar plank,pizza sauce,green pepper,cauliflower,prosciutto,chili paste garlic,egg noodle
title: Pittsburgh Football Bowl
ingredients: 2 untreated cedar planks | 1 large cauliflower | 6 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 1/2 lb thin egg noodles | 1 green pepper | 1/4 lb prosciutto, cut into squares | 1 jar pizza sauce | 1/4 lb sliced provolone cheese
instructions: Cut the cedar planks into four equal squares or half to eight triangles each. Place the patties in a gallon size ziploc bag. Add chilli paste and garlic. Mix until well mixed. Marinate overnight in refrigerator.. Boil water in a large pot. Remove from heat. Remove one piece of cauliflower at a time to keep it from cracking, scoop out the core and discard. Rinse cauliflower with cold water and pat dry. Bring water back to a boil, add cauliflower, and simmer until the cauliflower begins to soften. Drain excess water from boiling water.. Set aside. Preheat oven to 500°f. Lightly oil a large baking sheet, or use parchment paper. Dip each pattie individually in the sauce and place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake until golden brown. Remove from oven and top with provolone cheese and a sprinkling of tomato sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chili seasoning mix,marjoram,allspice,pear,flat leaf italian parsley,baby corn,cantaloupe
title: Spicy Melon With Aced Cantaloupe and Pickled Oranges
ingredients: 2 medium firm baby corn | 1/2 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 teaspoon chili seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon dried allspice | 1 ripe pared cantaloupe - halved, seeded, and cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 ripe pear, peeled, cored, cut into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Bring a medium pot of water to boil. Add the baby corn and cook until just tender, about 2 minutes. Drain. While the baby corn is still hot, stir in the parsley, chili seasoning mix, marjoram, and allspice. Spoon the melon into quart size glasses coated with cooking spray. Arrange the pickled cantaloupe and pear pieces around the melon, and around the melon. Serve immediately, and be sure to use lots of napkins, toothpicks, and/or towels.

Random Ingredients: cognac,vinegar,japanese eggplant,french baguette,pepper sauce,skin salmon fillet,corn oil
title: Battered Hantu Style Salmon Sandwiches
ingredients: 16 pieces skin-on salmon fillets, cut 1 inch thick | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 tablespoon ground pepper sauce | 4 tablespoons cognac | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 tablespoons vinegar | french baguettes, sliced diagonally | 1 tablespoon cracked pepper sauce
instructions: In medium size bowl, add all ingredients except for baguettes and cracked pepper sauce, and mix well. Cover bowl, and refrigerate for 1 hour or up to a day. Coat salmon with 1 tablespoon cracked pepper sauce. Place in a broiler proof dish, and broil until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer fish to serving plate, and arrange baguette slices around it. Drizzle with remaining pepper sauce, and serve.

title: Almond Horlicks (Almond Drink)
ingredients: 1 can almond extract | 2 cups water
instructions: Combine almond extract, water and almond to taste in a blender and puree. Serve in a glasses over ice.

title: Thai Sweet Beef (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb sirloin roast | 3/4 cup hot red chili sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º. Line a baking sheet with foil. Put meat in a ziplock bag, and pour hot sauce over meat. Marinate in refrigerator for 1 - 6 hours. Remove meat from bag about 15 minutes before cooking. Brush both sides of meat with sauce. Bake for about 1 hour, or until meat is browned.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,dark sesame oil,steak,russet potato,rosemary,sharp cheddar cheese,herbes de provence,lemon
title: French Grilled Beef With Kiwi Fondant Potatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 lbs flank steaks | 2 large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 3 kiwi fruits, washed, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 lemon, zest of
instructions: In a bowl lightly crush the dried herbs and spread it all over the beef. Leave the beef to stand uncovered in a medium bowl. In another bowl pour a little hot oil, then coat the beef with the herb mixture. Allow the beef to marinate at least at least 30 minutes, turning the grilling pan a few times. Lightly baste the beef occasionally with the oil and season with salt and pepper. The meat should be done now, perhaps 2 1/2 hours depending on your temperature in a skillet over medium high heat.. Meanwhile, place the potatoes in the preheated oven and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven. Add the kiwi and cheese and continue cooking until golden. Remove from the heat and stir in the lemon zest. Spoon the beef onto serving plates and serve with potato wedges on the side.

title: Cauliflower and Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef or 1 kg boneless beef | 200 g cauliflower florets | 1 head cabbage ( red one preferred, green preferred ) | 2 tablespoons capers
instructions: Cut the beef and cauliflower into small square pieces. Cut the red cabbage in wedges approximately 1 long and 1 large square. Make sure the pieces have a good shape. Drain the beef and cauliflower into a strainer. Toss the beef with a little salt. Arrange the beef and cauliflower pieces at the base of each plate. Garnish with capers. Place in the oven at 150c and cook for 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,vanilla extract,rye flour,red enchilada sauce,nacho flavor tortilla chip,arborio rice
title: Southwestern Beef With Rice and Nachos
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked arborio rice ( about 1/8 inch wide ) | 1/2 cup can red enchilada sauce ( such as smoky red enchilada sauce ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon nacho-flavor tortilla chips ( such as doritos ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 4 -8 slices deli-sliced white wine vinegar or 4 -8 slices red enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Rinse rice thoroughly in a sieve under cold water to cool completely. Combine remaining ingredients except vinegar and vanilla in large bowl. Mix thoroughly. Add rice and mix thoroughly. Spread rice mixture in 8x5x3 inch loaf pan or small crock and refrigerate until firm, at least 1 hour or overnight. Heat oven to 400°f. Spread vinegar over tortilla chips and arrange chips on a baking sheet, spacing evenly. Bake, stirring every 10 minutes, until golden, about 8 minutes. When crisp, place on baking sheet, cool, and remove from pan. Increase oven temperature to 450°f. Spread 1/4 cup of rice mixture over chips and top with enchilada sauce. Continue baking until heated through, about 15 minutes. Place 1/4 cup of rice mixture on each tortilla with a slice of black olive.

title: Simple Tropical Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 mango
instructions: Peel and dice mango. Place in a saucepan with 1/4 cup of water. Cook over low heat until the water is all absorbed. Add turmeric, saffron and 2 tspn of water. Stir until mixed well. Cook over low heat for a further 2 minutes or until mango is softened. Add the remaining 2 tspn water, bring to a boil, cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Leave to stand for 1 hour or longer for an even smoother texture. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,yeast,coconut,mascarpone,mustard seed,chili garlic sauce,bagel,grainy mustard
title: Tasty and Easy Savoury Bites!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon dry yeast | 300 ml shredded coconut | 1/2 cup mascarpone ( dairy or dairy free ) | 1/4 cup grainy mustard | 600 ml spicy mustard and chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 cup liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon dry mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 6 tablespoons shredded unsweetened coconut
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°c. Mix dry ingredients together in a bowl, mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Place in an oven tray and bake for 25 - 30 mins or until golden & crispy on top.

title: Oaty Chilli - Thai Vegetables
ingredients: 500 g mixed vegetables ( broccoli, carrots, beans, cauliflower ) | 1/2 cup oatmeal | cooking spray | 2 teaspoons lemongrass | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon brandy | 1 jalapeno pepper
instructions: Cut vegetables in half, lengthways if thicker, leave whole if thinner. Place in a non stick wok with a little oil, sprinke with soy sauce and half the spices. Toss lightly and stir fry till tender and starting to turn golden. Drizzle oyster sauce over, toss and repeat till all combined. Pour over the vegetables and mix lightly. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,breadcrumb,dill weed,celery rib,wine,heavy whipping cream,garlic salt,chive
title: Golden Gate Clear Gluten Free Dukkah
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups gluten free breadcrumbs | 3 1/2 tablespoons gluten free worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped | 2 tablespoons white wine | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. Mix together all ingredients in a bowl. Make sure all dry ingredients are covered. Dip entire bowl in warm water and let sit for a few minutes, until mixture forms soft crumbs. Add cream mixture to crumbs and mix well. Don't over mix, this might cause the gluten to melt. Spray a baking pan with oil. Spoon the clear gluten free clear ganache into the baking pan. Sprinkle remaining clear ganache over the top and poke lots of holes on top. Bake for 10 to 10 minutes or until it is golden brown and bubbly. You may have to watch the ganache closely, the clear ganache should come out a little crispy on the bottom but should look clear in it when it is almost done. Let cool to room temperature before eating.

title: Rigatoni With Artichokes, Pumpkin, and Pumpkin
ingredients: 2 1/4 ounces boxes rigatoni pasta or 2 1/4 ounces ziti pasta | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained, coarsely chopped ( or 1 pound canned artichoke hearts ) | 8 ounces canned pumpkin, with juice ( 2 1/4 cups ) | pimiento, drained, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 tablespoons rice, uncooked
instructions: Cook rigatoni as directed, drain. Meanwhile, drain artichokes and pumpkin. Drain artichokes well. In a large skillet melt butter or margarine. Add drained shrimp/pumpkin, artichokes, and rice. Stir well to coat. If you use cooked pasta, add it now. If you use ziti, cook until tender but firm to the bite. Add to the pasta and stir to coat.

title: Ginger Oyster
ingredients: 4 medium live lobsters ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons raw sugar crystals ( or brown ) | 2 teaspoons dried ginger | 4 tablespoons tomato puree or 4 tablespoons tamari | 4 tea bags
instructions: Scrub and coarsely chop the lobsters and place them in a large serving bowl. Add the sugar and ginger and mix thoroughly. Add the tomato puree or tamari and stir gently. Scoop the mixture into the prepared jars. Seal and store in the refrigerator 1 to 2 weeks before using, before adding the tea. The water should keep the shrimp heads from floating on the surface.

title: Low Fat Mexican Pumpkin Seeds for Burritos for 2
ingredients: 6 cups pumpkin, peeled, cut into 2-inch squares | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 cups salsa | 1/3 - 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In large skillet, heat oil till medium hot. Add pumpkin and cook over medium heat until browned lightly. In the meantime mix salsa and tabasco sauce in separate bowl. Stir hot oil mixture into pumpkin mixture. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes over medium heat or till mixture is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,artichoke,thyme leaf,chili pepper flake,cooking spray,oregano,butter,worcestershire sauce
title: Artichokes Stuffed With Guinness
ingredients: 2 artichokes, cleaned and trimmed | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 3/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 lb unsalted butter, at room temperature, cut into small pieces | 3 tablespoons minced fresh thyme leaves | cooking spray | 8 -9 fluid ounces guinness stout
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and steam the artichokes for about 5 minutes until tender, but not mushy. Drain and cut them into 1/8 inch thick slices. Place the artichokes in a medium bowl and toss with the worcestershire. Season with oregano, chili pepper flakes, and the thyme. Set aside to marinate. Make the roux, melt the butter in a small pan with the minced thyme leaves. Pour in the worcestershire sauce and whisk until smooth. Gradually whisk in the beer and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer 3 - 4 minutes, then remove from the heat and set aside for 5 minutes. Stuff the artichokes with the roux and bake them for 5 - 10 minutes, until heated through. Remove the artichokes from the oven and let rest at room temperature for five minutes. Spoon the guinness over the artichokes and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,creamy peanut butter,soymilk,yeast,thyme leave,curry powder
title: Bunuelos Vegan Fudge
ingredients: 125 g creamy peanut butter ( creamy is better for this recipe, but also for other protein alternatives such as goat milk or soy milk ) | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 400 ml soymilk | 350 g baby spinach ( or similar type of fresh spinach ) | freshly chopped fresh thyme leave
instructions: Grease and line two 18x28cm bread pans with non stick baking paper, allowing the paper to overhang the two ends of the pans a bit on the sides. Place oven on lowest speed, and place the pans on the middle rack of your oven. Set aside in a warm spot for 20 minutes, to allow the oven to rise. Beat together the peanut butter and yeast until combined, then gradually mix in the soy milk and yoghurt. Using the back of a small spoon, make small indentations in the peanut mixture and nestle the spuds of baby spinach in between the moistened peanut mixture. Sprinkle the thyme over. Preheat oven to 200c. With a slotted spatula, transfer the baked buns to a greased baking sheet, allowing space for rising. Bake at 200c for around 20 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,romaine lettuce,taco seasoning mix,vanilla bean
title: Mexican Tuna Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 container low-sodium taco seasoning mix | 2 1/2 tablespoons sugar-free taco seasoning mix | 1 beef bouillon cube | romaine lettuce | 1/2 vanilla bean, split and scraped
instructions: Place the taco seasoning mix, sugar free taco seasoning mix, and the bouillon cube in the bottom of a bowl or jar with a lid. Shake until smooth. Place the lettuce on your cutting board and cut on the diagonal into thin slices. Slice the vanilla bean into halves or quarters lengthwise. Toss well with the lettuce and the drained taco seasoning packet.

Random Ingredients: thyme,ice cube,superfine sugar,italian dressing,broccoli,flat leaf parsley,ketjap manis,tortilla
title: Spicy Broccoli Fajitas With French Onion Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb broccoli ( trimmed and diced ) | 4 crisp tortillas | 1/2 cup chopped sweet italian dressing | 10 ounces frozen french-fried onions ( thawed ) | 3 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon crushed fresh thyme | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley
instructions: Toss the broccoli in 4 tbsp of cold water in a large bowl. Place 3 corn tortillas on a baking sheet and grill under a preheated broiler, turning once, 3 - 5 minutes on each side or until crisp. Put the broccoli in a large bowl and sprinkle evenly with 1/2 tablespoon each of the dressing and the onions. Toss and set aside. Combine the ketjap manis, sugar and thyme in a small bowl. Stir in the remaining 1/2 cup dressing and mix well before adding it to the broccoli mixture. Toss, and then set aside. To serve, arrange the vegetables on a serving dish and drizzle with remaining dressing.

title: Veal, Mustard, and Nuts (Veal Creole)
ingredients: 2 cups broth ( reserved from cooking veal or beef ) | 2 lbs lean veal, at room temperature ( cut into bite-sized pieces ) | 1 cup mustard, coarse-chopped | 1 cup packed celery, finely chopped | 1 cup packed brown mustard | 2 tablespoons vinegar | tortilla chips
instructions: Bring broth to boil in large, heavy skillet over medium heat. Add veal and cook, stirring often, until browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer meat and juices to platter. Stir in mustard, celery, brown mustard, and vinegar, stirring until mustard begins to foam. Return meat and juices to skillet and cook over medium heat until liquid comes to boil and is thickened and syrupy, 5 to 7 minutes. Return meat mixture to skillet and stir in. Pour hot mustard liquid over meat mixture. Slightly flatten with back of heavy spoon, if desired. Serve immediately with chips.

title: French Pork Loin
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chives, minced | 4 tablespoons pork fat ( rendered fat )
instructions: Mix chives, pork fat, and pork spare ribs together well. Heat over low to medium heat for a few minutes, or until pork fat is completely solidified.

Random Ingredients: potato,graham wafer,kikkoman soy sauce,italian seasoning,cream tartar
title: Potato and Parmesan Chips
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into chips | 2 teaspoons kikkoman sweet soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 24 graham wafer rolls
instructions: Microwave sweet potatoes on high power for 25 seconds. Remove and set aside. Microwave sweet potato chips on high for 20 seconds.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,extra virgin olive oil,yellow squash,andouille sausage,creme de menthe,coconut nut
title: Grilled Sausage and Squash (Southern Style)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh pistachios | 1 tablespoon creme de menthe | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 8 links andouille sausages, 1 inch thick and cut into 2-inch lengths | 1 1/2 pounds yellow squash, cut into 2-inch lengths | 1/4 cup crumbled unsweetened coconut nuts
instructions: Place pistachios and creme de menthe in a small skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Drizzle olive oil over nut mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Transfer nuts to a plate. Return skillet to heat, add sausages, reduce heat to medium, and cook until golden on both sides, breaking up sausages with a spoon as they cook, about 5 minutes per side. Place yellow squash, squash lengthwise, in an 8x8 inch pan. Repeat process until all ingredients are grilled and sausages are completely cooked. Sprinkle with cotija cheese and top with pistachios.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,chuck,almond extract,chicken stock will,brown sugar,vegetable oil,lemon extract,maple syrup
title: Canadian Dry Sea Salt (Using a Meat Broth for a Large Hand)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 3 - 3 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 cup chicken stock ( use only chicken stock that is used for making the cure for meat making ) | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried lemon extract | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | maple syrup, warm
instructions: In a large pot, brown ground chuck in the pan. Drain off any excess fat before adding new chicken stock or water. Stir to mix, then add the brown sugar, salt and all of the remaining ingredients. Cover with lid. Bring to a low boil, then reduce heat slightly to a simmer. Simmer for 20 minutes. Serve over white rice, or as a side dish with french fries and applesauce. Use a pan that is fairly large that you can fit in your hand before placing the ground chuck into it. It helps the meat soak up the flavor of the sauce. The pot also helps you keep it submerged under any spills while cooking.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,cream mushroom soup,corn kernel,monterey jack cheddar cheese,daikon radish
title: Fiesta Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 large daikon radish, peeled and chopped | 1 cup corn kernels, drained | 1 jar condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups crumbled monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 8 fresh basil leaves, torn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the radish out in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a bowl combine the corn, soup, and cheese. Pour over the radish and radish. Sprinkle the basil over all. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,garlic powder,shortening,pork tenderloin,red chili powder,cannellini bean,vegetable broth,red wine vinegar
title: Zucchini Pork Vindaloo
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin ( i use very lean, but a whole tenderloin is traditional ) | 4 tablespoons shortening or 4 tablespoons canola oil, and | extra-virgin olive oil, for deep-frying | 6 large zucchini, cut into 1-inch slices | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 4 teaspoons garlic powder | 4 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup vegetable broth
instructions: Cut pork into 1 1/2 inch squares or julienne if large, and pound each piece until it is 1/2 inch thick. Cut each square in half, and cut into 1 1/2 inch wide strips. In a large dutch oven or other deep fryer, melt 2 tbls of the shortening, or two tablespoons of canola oil over moderately low heat. When the foaming subsides, add the zucchini strips and cook, stirring, until well browned and crisp tender, about 8 minutes. Add the chili powder, garlic powder, and beans and stir to combine. Add the 3 cups of the broth.

title: Mango Juice
ingredients: 1/2 mango, peeled and chopped | 1/2 fennel, bulb chopped
instructions: Place mango, fennel bulb, and mango juice in the freezer for about 1 1/2 hours so they don't continue to freeze solid.

title: Smoked Mustard
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons spicy brown mustard | 4 teaspoons spicy brown mustard | 1/4 cup sweet sherry wine
instructions: Whisk together the spicy brown mustard and sweet sherry in a small bowl. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,beef chuck,yellow squash,jumbo shrimp,white rice,gouda cheese,celery salt
title: Jambalaya With Shrimp - Arlene Robuchos
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked jumbo shrimp | 1 cup diced yellow squash | 1 cup diced celery salt | 1 cup cooked jumbo shrimp - peeled, deveined and chopped | 4 cups cooked white rice, warm | 1 cup shredded smoked gouda cheese | 1/2 cup red and yellow marmalade
instructions: Marinate beef and shrimp in 1 cup of the marinade for about 5 - 10 minutes in the refrigerator, or as long as overnight. Stir shrimp and celery salt in a large skillet or wok. Add shrimp and continue cooking until shrimp are just cooked. Turn heat down and add half the cooked rice, stirring well. Turn heat back up so shrimp are cooked but not over cooked. Top the shrimp with the cooked rice. Top with remaining cooked rice, cheese and marmalade.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,white vinegar,bamboo skewer,chive,lime juice,cider vinegar,red food coloring,cilantro leaf
title: Thai Hot Sweet and Sour Pickled Lemons
ingredients: 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/3 cup freshly squeezed lime juice | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh chives | 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring or 1/2 teaspoon green food coloring | 12 ounces very fresh thinly sliced prosciutto | 12 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 20 minutes
instructions: For the pickled pickled lemons, combine the cider vinegar, white and cider vinegars, lime juice, cilantro, chives, and food coloring in the top of a double boiler over boiling water. Whisk well.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,rigatoni pasta,sherry wine,italian salad dressing
title: Bean and Orzo Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta or ( 16 ounce ) box your favorite pasta | 3 cups orange marmalade | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 can italian salad dressing
instructions: Bring water to boil and cook rigatoni according to package directions. Combine orange marmalade, sherry, and salad dressing in bowl and toss with rigatoni. Place rigatoni in glass bowl or crockpot and add orange marmalade mixture. Bake at 300° f for 2 hours.

title: Yogurt Cheese - You'll Love a Bite & a Half!
ingredients: 1 cup yoghurt ( full fat or fat free ) | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve with bread, vegies or pita bread.

title: Lamb Stewed With Chipotle
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 lb lamb or 1 lb beef cut into 1 inch strips | 1 canned chipotle chile in adobo, cut into small segments
instructions: Heat oil in a pot. Brown meat in hot oil.

Random Ingredients: carrot diagonally,dill weed,queso fresco,sage leaf,tomato paste,vanilla
title: Mexican Style Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb queso fresco ( about 1 1/2 cups ) or 1/2 lb monterey jack cheese, shredded ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 teaspoons carottes dill weed | 1 teaspoon sage leaf, shredded | 4 large fresh sage leaves, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2 teaspoons instant mashed potatoes or 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth. Pour into an 8x8 baking dish and bake at 400 degrees f. For about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Cool and serve at room temperature on crackers or toasted baguettes with crackers.

title: Mock Harese
ingredients: 1 lb mock harese, in one piece | 1 medium onion, peeled and minced | 1 dozen hard-boiled eggs, peeled
instructions: Wash mock Harese well and pick out any stray bits of mock or onion. Dice the eggs.

title: Duck Confit  (Served in Hoisin Sauce)
ingredients: 1 kg quail, in the shell, deveined | 250 -300 g hoisin sauce ( a mix of sauces to taste is called ajwain, a japanese sweet sauce used for barbecues ) | 400 g deli turkey, cut into small ( precut pieces )
instructions: Take out the shells of the quail, the head and the intestines. Take the meat out of the shell and place it in a pot with the sauce and heat up. Place the legs in the pot and cover the pot. When it is heated open up. Do not remove the pot, just let it sit for several minutes until the legs become translucent. Put out the quail and its head and legs so you can take your serving platter or a serving bowl. Fill with cool hoisin sauce, if desired. I put this on top of cooked rice with fried egg, and you can eat this with or without eggs, fried tofu, or just eat the meat as is for dipping into hoisin sauce.

title: Mexican Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 4 tablespoons chopped onions ( from about 2 medium onions ) | 2/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( flat-leaf or curly ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce, outer leaves removed
instructions: Cook beef and onion in 2 1/2 cups water and onion mixture in covered skillet over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until beef is brown and mixture is hot and onion is tender, about 5 minutes. Cut away from heat and stir in cilantro. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Serve in lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,onion soup mix,chili pepper flake,sherry,sausage,leek,nori,bamboo shoot
title: Japanese Style - Hiroshima Style
ingredients: 4 pork chops, 1-1/2-inch thick | 1/2-1 tablespoon onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 teaspoon fresh leeks | 4 ounces sausage, 3/4-inch-thick and 1/2-inch-thick | 2 cups canned sliced bamboo shoots | 1 sheet nori, seaweed, dried seaweed sheets, toasted
instructions: Cut meat into thin, bite size strips. Bring 4 cups water to boil. Add pork to boiling water.

title: Spanish Olives
ingredients: 1 can green olives, drained | 1 cup sofrito sauce
instructions: Chop olives coarsely. Pour sofrito over olives, cover and put in refridgerator for 24 hours. Strain.

title: Yummy Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dry curd cottage cheese | 2 cups hot plain non-fat dry-roasted oyster sauce
instructions: Place cottage cheese in mixing bowl and add hot oyster sauce. Mix well, then pour into a bowl for dipping.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,berry,sugar syrup,taco seasoning,green chilies,liquid smoke,pecan
title: Easy Mexican Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 can diced green chilies | 1/2 - 2/3 cup chopped pecans, toasted | 1 1/2 cups sugar-free baked beans ( or use corn or soy beans ) | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 -3 tablespoons fat free liquid smoke
instructions: Mix beans, green chilies, and pecans in a medium sized bowl. In a separate bowl, add the taco seasoning, liquid smoke and fat free liquid smoke.

title: Indian Apple Noodle Katori
ingredients: 8 ounces noodles ( i use pita style ) | 2 cups apples ( i use granny smith ) | 2 jalapeno peppers | 1/4 cup white flour, seasoned, plus ( see description ) | white flour, divided | 4 ounces white plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup ground pecans
instructions: Start your steamer. Wash the pita and set it on your rice cooker. Add 1 cup white flour and 3 tablespoons of water to a small bowl and mix. Let sit for 10 minutes to begin the cooking process. Slice up the apples and jalapeños and mix with the seasoned flour and yogurt and set aside. Place your rice on the steamer and set for 5 minutes. While the rice is waiting for the water to boil, toast the pecans in a small skillet until golden, watching for the heat. Take your noodles out of the steamer and spread them with your cheese spread and sprinkle it with the pecans. Add 1/2 of the cooked noodles to the cheese spread and top with 1/2 of the cheese mix and top with some more noodles. Repeat the top layer with noodles and cheese. Drizzle some of the remaining yogurt and turmeric on top. Keep adding noodles on top until all the noodles and cheese are used up, and top with ground pecans. This amount of cheese and noodles can then be used for katori.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,hoagie,zucchini,onion flake,curry powder,lima bean,chinese noodle,dark chocolate
title: Chinese Spaghetti With Zucchini & Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked zucchini | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup chopped onions or 1/2 cup garlic | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 1/2 cups shredded zucchini or 1 1/2 cups chopped celery | 12 ounces cooked egg noodles | 10 ounces drained light dark chocolate ( optional ) | 12 hoagie rolls, split & toasted
instructions: Coat a 3 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Combine soup, onions & curry powder in large bowl, mixing well. Add zucchini & cook onion mixture until almost tender, stirring frequently. Stir in noodles & chocolate, if using. Spoon mixture into rolls, dividing evenly. Serve w/ warm toasted rolls.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,meat,radish,tamarind paste,fig,white onion,white wine vinegar,shrimp paste
title: Moroccan Shrimp and Meat Salad
ingredients: 6 medium shrimp paste | 2 1/2 cups greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon shrimp paste | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 1 pinch white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons chopped white onions | 3 tomatoes, chopped | 1 lb fresh ground meat | 3 -5 radishes, sliced thin
instructions: Cut shrimp, yogurt and tamarind paste in cubes. Cover and let refrigerate for 2 hours. In a large bowl, combine onions and tomatoes. Add shrimp paste.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,italian bread crumb,pistachio nut,ra el hanout spice mix,red cabbage
title: Easy Baked Red Cabbage With Chutney
ingredients: 1 small head red cabbage | 2 tablespoons ra-fool instant powdered ras el hanout spice mix | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1/4 - 1/2 cup toasted pistachio nut, chopped, about 2 tablespoons | 4 tablespoons italian seasoned bread crumbs
instructions: Core cabbage, if necessary. Using a 1 1/2 to 2 inch diameter floured knife, unroll and slice core into julienne strips, then cut strips crosswise into 1 1/2 to 2 inch lengths. If using the whole head of cabbage, cut up the leaves in two lengthwise wedges. Place in a bowl, add a small amount of water to moisten, then stir in 1/2 teaspoons salt and the powdered ras el hanout, and mix well. Drain cabbage wedges, if using, then toss with 1 tablespoon raita and 1 tablespoon pistachio nut pieces. Place each cabbage wedge on a sheet of plastic wrap. Coat each sheet of cabbage with a light coating of olive oil on both sides. Arrange cabbage in a baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining pistachios.

Random Ingredients: bean,basmati rice,kosher salt black pepper,garlic powder,carrot
title: Caribbean Rice (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1 can refried beans, heated | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper ( if using a meat grinder, just be aware of the hotness ) | garlic powder ( optional ) | carrot, cut into julienne strips ( optional )
instructions: Place rice into rice cooker and set as per manufacturer's instructions. Rinse rice with cold water.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,flat leaf parsley,bicarbonate soda,chipotle chile adobo,couscous,chickpea,vegetable stock chicken,mung bean sprout
title: Couscous with Chiles and Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock or 2 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup couscous | 100 g mung bean sprouts | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 200 g chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the bicarb soda and stock.

Random Ingredients: red wine,turnip,white wine,baking soda,confectioner ' sugar,rosemary,beef rib,daikon radish
title: Daikon Daikon Smoked Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef short ribs, cut crosswise into 1/4- to 1/2-inch slices | 4 1/2 teaspoons black peppercorns ( about 12 slices ) | 4 tablespoons red wine | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary, crumbled | 1/4 cup white wine | 1 1/2 cups peeled chopped turnips | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 8 large radishes, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Arrange rack in center of oven. Arrange short ribs on rimmed baking sheet. Place baking sheet on hot baking sheet. Bake short ribs until very tender, about 1 hour 45 minutes. Place 2 tbsp pepper flakes in small plate, sprinkle with 2 tbsp hot red wine. Stir to blend. Set aside. Combine 1 1/2 tsp rosemary, 1/4 cup white wine, 1/4 cup turnips and confectioners' sugar in small bowl. Heat remaining 1 1/2 tsp rosemary in small saucepan over medium heat until just beginning to melt, about 2 minutes. Pour 1 cup wine mixture over turnips and turnip mixture. Arrange radishes over top and sprinkle with remaining pepper flakes mixture. Pour remaining 1 1/2 cups wine mixture over radish mixture. Spoon remaining 1 1/2 cups wine mixture atop radish layer. Let stand about 1 hour. Sprinkle top with remaining 1 tbsp pepper flakes flakes. Bake short ribs until pork is glazed and tender, about 30 minutes. Serve from baking sheet. Makes 4 servings..

Random Ingredients: liquid sweetener,chili pepper flake,green pepper,chestnut puree,cilantro leaf,coconut milk
title: Thai Clear Milk Base
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters unsweetened coconut milk | 1 cup chestnut puree | 1/2 cup sweet green pepper or 1/2 cup red pepper | 1 -2 dried chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon liquid sweetener ( i prefer kikkoman sweetener ) or 1 tablespoon white sugar ( i prefer kikkoman sweetener ) | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Soak chestnut puree in warm water for at least 8 hours. In a medium saucepan, heat coconut milk slowly on low until it just starts to steam around the edges of the pan. If it's too watery, let it rest for 30 minutes before adding the other ingredients. Place all in blender and puree on low in 2 batches. Add sweetener to taste, or if desired, cilantro and blend well.

title: Anchovy Oysters
ingredients: 3 -4 anchovies, chopped finely | 2 cans whole oysters, drained | 5 large fresh oysters | 1 lb broad bean, halved if large and salted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f, gas mark 4, 200c, gas mark 5. Pour live oysters into saucepan and put on the top shelf of the oven for about 8 minutes or until the oysters have begun to soften, shaking pan every now and then to keep warm and toasted. Remove the anchovies from the pan when they have been cool. Scrub the oysters under a tap and remove the skin. Chop the oysters into 4 or 8 pieces, depending on size. Scrape the anchovies and oysters of any remaining juice from the anchovies into a small bowl. Toss gently with the bean halves and remove the shellfish from top shelf. Put under the broiler until the oysters start peeking, or until slightly hard. Arrange the oysters on warmed plates and scatter over the anchovy mash with a wooden spoon. Serve immediately, as the anchovy and bean mash will settle to the bottom of the plate if the acid in the liquid does not break through.

Random Ingredients: pepper,red grape,salt pork,vegetable oil cooking spray,gelatin,salt black pepper,margarine
title: Grasshopper Jelly (Grape Cheese)
ingredients: 1 package unflavored gelatin | 1 small red grape, washed and drained of all excess water | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/2 lb salt pork or 1/2 lb beef, sliced very thinly | 3/4 tablespoon salt | 1/3 tablespoon pepper | vegetable oil cooking spray | coarse salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Note, if using a beef, add salt and pepper to the cold water and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,granny smith apple,pasta,tortilla chip,asafoetida powder,macaroni,flat leaf parsley,margarine
title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 lb uncooked pasta ( wagon wheel, elbow macaroni or rotini work well ) | 2 -3 granny smith apples ( optional ) | 1 bunch baby spinach ( optional ) | 6 -8 ounces cooked macaroni ( or other pasta ) | 3 -4 teaspoons margarine ( optional ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 6 -8 large tortilla chips
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Mix everything together thoroughly. Set in fridge covered till ready to serve. I use trader joe's macaroni salad mix to make my own the following day, mix salad with your favourite macaroni type of cheese.

title: French Antilles
ingredients: 4 lebanese cucumbers | 4 zucchini | 1 cup roasted roast beef | 1 tablespoon zucchini | 2 tablespoons white beans | 1/2 cup catsup
instructions: Cut the cucumbers and zucchini into thin slices. Add the roast beef and mix it together. Cut the zucchini into thin slices. instructions: Place cucumber slices into a bowl.

ingredients: 1 package pork tenderloin | 3/4 pound fresh round steak, cut into 3 pieces | 2 jars taco sauce | 20 water chestnuts, drained | 1/2 pound sliced peppered, chopped fresh mushrooms | 1/2 pound fresh basil leaves, chopped | 1/2 pound grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 large yukon gold potato, cut in half lengthwise and into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Remove pork tenderloin and top with beef. Cook until the meat is a deep color, about 10 minutes. Add taco sauce, and cook until warmed through. Remove meat, and arrange on heated grill. In a separate skillet, bring water, mushrooms, basil, and cheese to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 2 minutes. Serve over hot cooked meat.

title: Chinese Beef Gravy for Beef
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Beat egg yolks.

title: Spanish Stew
ingredients: 1 package steak, sliced thin | 2 packages dry risotto rice | 1 pound baby carrots | 2 cans beef stew meat, drained and cut in cubes
instructions: Layer the steak between layers of paper towels, and pound it using the flat side of rice roller to flatten it a bit. Then lay in the center of the rice. Put the carrots on top, and top with two pounds of beef stew. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, and cover. Simmer for 1 hour, or until rice is tender, and vegetables are tender.

title: Easy Salmon With Cumin
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper seasoning | 2 teaspoons cumin | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon smoked cumin | 4 tablespoons crisco ( pumpkin spice blend )
instructions: Mix seasonings into salmon. Marinate for at least 1 hour.

title: Baked Szechwan Vegetables
ingredients: 4 large rutabagas ( yellow, green or white ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 3 cups thinly sliced peeled rutabagas | 1 tablespoon szechwan pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Cut rutabagas in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds with a teaspoon. Arrange on a cookie sheet in a single layer. Spray pam on baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven 40 to 45 minutes, turning halfway through cooking, until lightly browned. Meanwhile, make the spicy infused oil by combining the oils, turmeric and szechwan pepper in a small bowl. Remove the rutabaga from the oven and let cool for five minutes. Heat the oil in a medium skillet. Add the rutabaga, season with salt and toss to coat with oil.

title: Low Fat Greek Yogurt Balls
ingredients: 16 ounces low-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped italian parsley or 1 tablespoon dried parsley
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine the greek yogurt and parsley. Roll into small balls or balls.. Let sit 3 hours, so those flavors can mix.

title: Porcini Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup porcini mushrooms | 10 cherry peppers or 10 gershire peppers
instructions: Wrap each capful with an individual panchere. You’ll need a small plate. Cut the caps in half and secure the caps with string. Heat a small frying pan to medium high heat. Add the panchere and fry for about 1 minute per capful. Turn down the heat to medium and fry until golden. You can tell the panchere has taken on color, but it won’t take longer.

title: French Onion Soup Mix
ingredients: 1 packet dry onion soup mix | pepper
instructions: Combine 1 packet dry onion soup mix with pepper and 1/2 of the packet of the dry onion soup powder mix. Bake soup mix in crockpot on low for 10 - 15 minutes. You can eat this right away, or store in refrigerator over night. If you are using this soup instead of the dry onion soup mix mix, just store the dried onion soup mix in the fridge until ready to use. Store the reserved dry onion soup mix in the refrigerator. This is excellent for a souper meal. It freezes well. For an extra touch, add 1/3 cup cooked diced chicken or 1/3 cup chopped cooked turkey for flavor.

title: Ravioli
ingredients: 8 new potatoes | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, roasted | 300 g dark rum | 4 medium tortillas | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Place the potatoes in a saucepan with enough water to cover, bring to the boil and cook until just tender, drain and mash with the coriander. Heat the rum in a small pan, add the mashed potatoes and cook over a high heat for 4 minutes. Spoon the warm rum over the ravioli, sprinkle with pepper, and add extra rum if you like.

title: Spicy Grilled Chicken Giblets
ingredients: 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 4 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot | 8 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 4 teaspoons dry white pepper | 3 lbs chicken giblets ( i used frozen cut up pieces of chicken which were thawed ) | 3 lbs zucchini | 4 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Heat grill. In a bowl stir together cider vinegar, ginger root, tabasco sauce, and white pepper. Add chicken giblets and set aside. Brush grill rack with ghee. Lightly coat the grill with vegetable oil. Place chicken breasts on the grill rack. Cook the giblets until tender in a small amount of water for 10 to 15 minutes, or until just cooked through. Remove chicken and set aside to rest. Using a zucchini lengthwise grater scrape off the ends of the zucchini, being careful not to break the zucchini or the skin. Cut into 1 inch wide sticks. Heat 2 tablespoons ghee in a large skillet over medium heat. Add zucchini and sprinkle with salt. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, or until tender crisp, stirring constantly. Slice the chicken into thin slices. Heat remaining ghee in a heavy skillet over high heat. Add the chicken and cook until the browned on the outside. Remove from heat and spoon glaze over the chicken.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,granny smith apple,pasta,almond meal,ice cube,chipotle chile
title: Almond and Chipotle Pasta
ingredients: 400 g dry pasta | 1 chipotle chile | 200 g slivered almonds meal | 1 cup shredded lettuce | 1 granny smith apple, chopped ( optional ) | 3 ice cubes
instructions: Remove husks and damaged bean tops from pasta, cook in salted water according to packet directions. Meanwhile, roast chilli and almonds in a frying pan over a medium heat until golden. Cool slightly, then crush lightly with a mortar and pestle and add to dried pasta. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Serve and enjoy.

title: Easy Crock Pot Swedish Meat
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 jar tomato sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon cardamom pod ( to taste )
instructions: Place ground sirloin in the bottom of your crock pot. Pour tomato sauce over the sirloin. Place cardamom pods on top and add water so it can soak in the juices. Cover and cook for 8 hours. After 8 hours remove cardamom pods and shred meat using 2 forks mix meat well and serve over jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,cocoa powder,thai basil,vegetable oil,bulk italian sausage,spring onion,potato
title: Baked Sweet Potato Patties
ingredients: 200 g sweet potatoes, peeled, diced and cooked | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 cup chopped spring onion | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 2 tablespoons good quality pork stock or 2 tablespoons hot beef stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Combine the sweet potato and oil in a medium bowl. Combine the basil, spring onion and cocoa powder in a small bowl. Add to the potato and mix until the mixture resembles a chunky paste. Add the applesauce and stock. Mix and pour mix onto a non stick baking tray. Bake patties for 20 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Taste for Nuts
ingredients: 200 g glace cherries, halved | 150 g marshmallows | 1/4 cup red wine or 1/4 cup marsala | 1 packet enchilada sauce ( mild or spicy ) | 100 ml whipping cream | 1 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Line a large shallow dish with parchment or grease paper. Sprinkle cherries, marshmallows and marsala evenly over both sides of the dish. Set aside. Combine enchilada sauce and cream in small bowl, stir well. Pour mixture evenly over cherry mixture, sprinkle over tamari. Cool, then serve. Keep in fridge.

title: Tofu Crisp With Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage | 1 lb tofu, cubed into 1 inch squares | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets | 1 bunch of chopped corn | grated cheese
instructions: Brown sausage and remove from pan. Soak the frozen puff pastry sheets by placing them on a baking sheet, parchment on it for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, sautee chopped onions and tofu in chili oil. Add the sausage and tofu. Add baking soda and mix in. When sausage's cooked, add the frozen puff pastry sheets and mix well. Turn mixture out onto the baking sheet and sprinkle with cheese. Bake in a preheated oven at 400 degrees f for 10 - 12 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: wine,white flour,black olive,dark molasses,mayonnaise,brandy,tamari,new mexico chile
title: Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 12 new mexico chiles ( about 16-20 inches in length ) | 4 ounces good quality dark molasses, for basting | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup rum | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon wine ( optional ) | 8 ounces white flour | 1/2 teaspoon brandy ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon rum ( optional )
instructions: Remove seeds from chiles. In small pan, mix together molasses, brandy and mayonnaise. Warm over low heat until hot and smooth, about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients. Pour over chile peppers. Cool for 30 minutes to an hour to marinate. Remove stems from chiles and store in sealed plastic storage bag. Serve right away.

title: Chutney Snack
ingredients: 1/4 cup chutney | 24 slices pepperoni | 24 teaspoons dry sichuan chutney
instructions: Spread chutney on each slice of pepperoni. Sprinkle with chili powder. Top with sichuan chutney.

title: Smoky Stove-Top Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes | 2 cups white breadcrumbs | 1 can butter beans | 1 can cream | 1 1/2 lbs light sour cream
instructions: Peel potatoes, split in half lengthwise. Bring large pot of water to boil. Cut potatoes in half, cutting large pieces into chunks. Boil until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain potatoes and return to pot. Meanwhile, put beans in small saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Cook, uncovered, 5 minutes. Drain. Set aside. Mash potatoes. Place bread crumbs in bowl of food mixer and add butter and sour cream. Turn on and slowly add cream until you have a creamy mixture that's like a smooth, white texture. Add cream and mash to desired thickness. Add more sour cream or cream, to taste. Stir in potato chunks and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baby bella mushroom,tabasco sauce,pearl barley,plain white flour,jalapeno pepper,couscous
title: Beef Barley
ingredients: 300 g pearl barley | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 jalapeno pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoonstabasco sauce | 300 g baby bella mushrooms | 100 g plain white flour | 150 g couscous
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c. Place all ingredients into a pan and cook for approximately 2 hours. Serve with couscous.

title: Shredded Italian Appetizer  (An Italian Recipe for Many) (((Jubes)

instructions: Put garlic clove in a medium bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste, and add 1 t. Water to garlic. Drain well. Add remaining 1 1/2 t. Water. Use this as needed to keep the shredded lettuce moist. Use as a garnish.

title: Noodle Crepes With Grand Marnier
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unbleached flour | 2 cups egg noodles | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 egg seperately with 2 tablespoons cold water | 1 -2 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed lime juice, and zest of ( or 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons freshly squeezed lemon juice
instructions: Sprinkle the outside rim of a medium size sauce pan with 2 tablespoons flour, and set over medium heat. Lightly grease or spray with nonstick cooking spray, and set aside. Drain the noodles and noodles of excess grease and place them in the microwave to cook. Cook for only a minute or two so that the noodles are evenly browned. Drain when done, but do not rinse. Combine the two flours in a large bowl, add the noodles and noodles, egg seperately, mixing it well with the water, grand marnier, vanilla extract or lemon juice in a measuring cup until it reaches the desired consistency for your liking. Add salt and sugar. If using lemon, lemon zest or lime juice, stir to combine. Place the pan in the preheated oven, and when the temperature reaches 375 degrees f, cook the crepes for 3 - 4 minutes or until they are a golden color and firm. Slice onto warmed plates and drizzle liberally with vinaigrette.

title: Lettuce Wrapped in Portabella Mushroom Leaves
ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 4 large portabella mushrooms | 12 lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup corn oil
instructions: Make vinaigrette dressing by combining vinegar, tarragon, white pepper and mix. Cover and refrigerate. Wash and slice mushrooms. Fill mushroom caps lightly with vinegar mixture and then place leaves in center of each mushroom with 1 to 1 1/2 tbsp of the reserved vinaigrette dressing on the inside, place lettuce leaves on the lettuce leaves, secure with toothpicks, and serve warm.

title: Guacamole-Chicken Empanada Turnovers
ingredients: 6 ounces boneless skinless chicken meat | 1 white onion | 1/2 cup currants, soaked and cooled | 3/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 package crescent dinner rolls | avocado, slices ( garnish )
instructions: Cook and stir chicken, onion, currants and cilantro in medium skillet over medium heat until onion is tender.

title: Smoked Salmon and Jicama  Casserole
ingredients: 2 packages jicama, sliced paper-thin | 4 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 1/2 lbs smoked salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook jizie pan as directed on package, drain. Remove skin from jicama. Place 1/4 cup in microwave oven and heat on high 5 minutes, until jicama is tender crisp. Place jicama on cookie sheet lined with waxed paper. Top with sliced paper and foil and heat in microwave on high 3 minutes. Remove paper and foil and stir. Mix soup with flour and spices. Spoon into baking dish, then add smoked salmon. Bake at 375f for 25 minutes, covering with foil when cooked.

title: Yellow Rice With Spices (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice or 1 cup brown rice | 2 2 tablespoons mirin or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 3 1/2 teaspoons fresh sage or 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh dill sprigs | 2 teaspoons fresh ground allspice or 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger ( if using dried spices, omit the spice and omit the sugar ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons sea salt or 1 1/4 teaspoons table salt | 1 teaspoon powdered sazon or 1/2 teaspoon sumaq | 3/4 teaspoon vanilla ( optional but recommended! ) or 3/4 teaspoon almond extract ( optional but recommended! )
instructions: Rice cooker instructions,. Rinse and drain rice very well. Wash, drain and rinse 2 - 4 times with cold water. Let dried rice stand for 5 minutes. Put 2 cups rice in rice cooker, along with all other ingredients and vanilla/oil. Close lid and program regular or light crust. Set aside to cool. At 5 - 7 minutes, press and set aside the 2 tsp. Reserve spice mix. Note it is much more flavorful. Note for additional flavor, after making rice cooker the recipe can be increased to 4 - 5 tsp as well. If not using sazon mix, add the 1 tsp powdered dried sage or fresh sage, fresh dill or sage powder, 1/4 tsp of each. This way the spices can be mixed and dispersed. Note for variation, omit and increase the amount of allspice, allspice and sage in the original recipe. Note for an even richer flavor, add 1/2 a tsp of cardamom. Note for additional flavor, instead of using cardamom the allspice and cardamom will be ground a bit coarsely instead of ground, and this will result in a nutty smell when it cools down, but the flavor gets stronger as it cools. Note for a variation, omit the spices or leave out the allspice. Note for raisin rice, omit raisins and skip the sugar or sugar substitute if using dried spices. Note for walnut rice, omit raisins or other nuts of choice.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,pear,cooking wine,navy bean,sunflower seed,lettuce leaf
title: Pear and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds, toasted | 2 tablespoons cooking wine | 80 g navy beans, rinsed and drained if dry | 1/2 pear, peeled, cored and grated | 100 g lettuce leaves | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Place the sunflower seeds in a dry wok and add the water to cover. Bring to the boil, remove from the heat and set aside to cool. Place the beans in a saucepan with their water and the reserved sunflower seed mixture. Bring to the boil and simmer for 3 minutes or until tender. Drain, rinse and drain well. Add the grated pear and lettuce leaves to the bowl. Season with dark soy sauce and salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: juniper berry,aluminum foil,heavy cream,yellow bell pepper,stock,chuck roast,strawberry,pork sausage
title: Scotch Sausages and Strawberries
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast | 1 yellow bell pepper, roasted, peeled and diced | 8 ounces pickled streaky pork sausage | 8 ounces heavy cream | 4 ounces stock | 1 -2 ounce aluminum foil, wrapped in | juniper berries, to season | 6 fresh strawberries, washed ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut the sausage into approximately 4 squares and season thoroughly with salt. Place the roast in a large heavy based pan. Add enough water to come almost to the top of the meat. Cover and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer at a slow steady simmer for 3 hours. Once cooked, remove the sausage and wrap in the foil to cool. Slice. Place in an upright roasting tin and cover with foil. Leave at room temperature for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 300f degrees. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Combine the cream and half and half with the stock and bring to the boil over low heat. Pour over the meat in the roasting tin and place in the preheated oven. Cook for 4 - 5 hours, or until the meat and vegetables are very tender and beginning to fall apart, or alternatively put in a large pan and cook it for around 1 hour or until it is very tender, turning regularly. If you are planning on stuffing the gammon, place all the ingredients in a large pan with a good amount of water and cook gently, stirring, until the gammon has melted and mixed in ingredients.

title: Baked Spicy Tomato-Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 can roasted tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/3 cup garlic-flavored curry paste | 1/3 cup pernod ( a sweet white wine ) | 2 teaspoons pernod ( a hot dry white wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Heat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Stir the roasting pan's bottom with reynolds wrap aluminum foil and spray the foil with cooking spray. Open the tomatoes and drain juice from can and tomatoes through a colander, breaking up any large chunks. Reserve the juice, and stir the garlic and 2 tablespoons pernod in a small bowl with the tomatoes. Stir the pernod mixture into the tomatoes. Stir in the salt. Let stand for 15 minutes to blend flavors. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,chinese noodle,black pepper,adobo sauce,tomato pasta sauce,apple cider vinegar,spring onion,london broil beef
title: London broil Beef With Apples, Onions, & Beer
ingredients: 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh garlic | 2 lbs london broil beef, sliced | 1 can tomato-flavored pasta sauce | 1/4 cup adobo sauce | 12 ounces cellophane noodles ( i like japenã oelek brand ) | 3 -4 spring onions, sliced thin
instructions: Put broiler rack 6 inches from heat. To make vinaigrette, in a 3 to 4 quart stainless steel container combine the first 3 ingredients. Pour over beef, turning and coating the beef well, and marinate for 2 to 3 hours. To make sauce, in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart bowl, combine the pasta sauce, adobo sauce, and cider vinegar. Heat beef and marinade in tomato mixture in a covered pot, stirring occasionally, for about 1 hour and 10 minutes. Meanwhile, put a saucepan of boiling water on to boil. Add noodles and boil just until soft but not mushy. Drain, toss with sauce, and let stand 2 minutes. Serve immediately, passing remaining sauce separately.

title: Quick Coconut Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice or 2 cups basmati rice | 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 - 3/4 - 1 cup guacamole
instructions: Rinse the rice under running water until it starts sticking together. If the water is too warm, this will cause everything to separate. Place the rice in the rice cooker and follow the manufacturer's instructions. If you don't have an rice cooker, set the timer for 20 minutes to let the steam out and cook. Once the rice is done, drain it and place in a serving bowl. Add the coconut milk and guacamole to the rice and gently stir. I serve it chilled in a pretty bowl over some warm, drained white wax paper.

title: Malaysian Pork
ingredients: 1 kg pork shoulder | 100 g pancake syrup | 300 g pea | 2 tablespoons mixed spice | 2 teaspoons mango powder ( amchur ) or 1 tblsp dried mango leaves | 1 tablespoon lemongrass | 1 tablespoon port wine | 4 parsley sprigs
instructions: Trim excess fat and sinew from the meat. Trim any excess fat and sinew from the meat as well. Cut into 3/4 inch sized cubes.

title: Apple and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 cups instant quinoa ( cooked ) | 1 green apple, finely chopped | 25 ladyfingers ( cut in half ) | 25 g parmesan cheese | 3/4 cup catsup
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a nice bowl. Chill for about an hour. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ice water,asafoetida powder,celery rib,enchilada sauce,rice noodle,dark rum,flour
title: Drunken Noodle Balls
ingredients: 4 tablespoons flour or 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 2/3 cup ice water | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 large celery rib, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 package rice noodles, preferably long, thin, no-beef flavor | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: In a blender combine the flour, 1/3 cup water, rum, 1/2 t. Asafoetida, and celery. Process well. Soak noodles in hot water for about a minute to make them soften, drain, and place in a bowl. Toss with the remaining asafoetida. In a 12 inch heavy skillet, heat the remaining 1/3 cup of water, and fry the noodles tossing frequently, about 5 minutes or until tender and golden, stirring frequently. Drain and rinse noodles well in cold water. Place noodles on a plate, fill with noodles, and roll up loosely around the noodles. Place roll in a casserole, and pour enchilada sauce over the top. Cover and bake in a 350f oven for 25 - 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake for 5 - 10 more minutes until noodles look glazed. Variation, for thicker noodles, add 1 t. Cornstarch mixed with 4 t. Water, 1 tablespoons rum, and 1 t. Simmering over low heat for about 5 mnutes, or until the sauce is thickened slightly. Add more water if the sauce looks dry. Serve with chow mein noodles.

title: Beef Wellington
ingredients: 1 can beef chuck | 2 beef tenderloin steaks | 1 pound wonton wrappers, or as needed | 2 cups diced candied mixed fruits, or as needed
instructions: Mix beef chuck and tenderloin steaks together in a bowl. Place 2 wrappers and candied fruit in a row across the center of a wonton wrapper. Moisten one side of wrapper with water. Place a scant 1/4 cup of beef mixture into the center of wrapper, and gather the sides of the wrapper on top. Press the sides together to seal, and continue rolling the wrapper around the filling. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Place the filled wrappers into the skillet. Cook until golden brown, about 10 minutes.

title: Chinese Cabbage Dish
ingredients: 1 package beef stewing beef, sliced thinly | 1 whole head chinese cabbage, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro
instructions: Heat oil in a wok and fry cabbage wedges for 2 minutes until crispy brown. Remove cabbage to a paper bag. Place cabbage over the oil in the wok and cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until browned. Add meat and cilantro and cook for about 2 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: bacon,sharp cheddar cheese,virgin olive oil,guinness stout,sea scallop,beef stew meat,bechamel sauce
title: Grilled Irish Stout Beef and Scallops
ingredients: 4 teaspoons virgin olive oil, divided | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 3 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch chunks | sea scallops | 24 thick slices guinness stout | 24 ounces boudoir-style sharp cheddar cheese or 24 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 1 bottle beef and poupon style bechamel sauce
instructions: Preheat your grill and set your broiler pan on to high heat. Add 1 teaspoon of the oil and the bacon to a large cast iron skillet and cook until crisp. Remove the bacon and set aside. In the same skillet your bacon was cooked in add the remaining 2 teaspoons of oil and brown the beef quickly, stirring to separate the pieces. Remove the beef from the skillet. Season the meat with salt and pepper. Add the remaining 1 teaspoon of oil and bacon to the hot skillet and cook the scallops following the directions on the bag. While the scallops are cooking top each piece of beef with a slice of guinness and a slice of the cheddar cheese. Cover the pan and grill the beef until tender, around 10 to 12 minutes. Remove the beef, cheese slice and bacon slices from the pan and serve alongside the beer and beef slices.

title: Paleo Apple Gratin
ingredients: 5 tablespoons lime juice | 1 large bunch fresh mozzarella cheese or 1 medium grana padano | 1 grated lime, juice of | 6 small apples, peeled cored and sliced thin | 1/2 kg double cream
instructions: Make the gratin, place the first 3 ingredients in a bowl and mix with a wooden spoon until everything is well blended, but not too thickly. Cover with cling wrap and leave to stand in a cool place for 20 to 30 minutes. Put the apple slices in a large ovenproof dish, pour over the grated juice and set aside to macerate for 15 minutes. Put half the gratin in a saucepan or casserole dish, then spread over half the cream. Place the apple slices on top, followed by the crumbled cheese. Scatter over the remaining gratin. Dot the top with a little cream and cook under a preheated grill for 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,milk ricotta cheese,part mozzarella cheese,salt black pepper,chickpea,orange
title: Chunky, Quick and Easy Ricotta Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained with the liquid reserved | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 9 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 3/4 orange, juiced and zested | 1 tablespoon grated orange rind | 2 tablespoons skim milk mozzarella cheese | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Pulse chickpeas in a food processor until coarsely ground. Stir 2 tablespoons reserved chickpea liquid, 12 ounces of ricotta cheese, 3/4 orange zest, orange juice, and 1 tablespoon of grated orange zest into the ground chickpea mixture until combined. Spoon mixture into a 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon each of mozzarella cheese, remaining 2 ounces mozzarella cheese, salt, and black pepper over the top. Cover dish and refrigerate overnight, until the cheese is melted and the dip is cold and bubbly.

title: Tex Mex Shoulder-Shoulder Lamb Chops in Cheese and Salsa
ingredients: 4 shoulder lamb chops | dijon mustard, for dipping | 8 ounces cooked vegetarian beef strips | 12 ounces salsa verde taco-style cheese | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1/4 cup cilantro, coarsely chopped
instructions: Prepare all of your plates or plates as listed above. Dip each chop in dijon and grill until cooked through. Arrange on a platter with taco cheese, salsa verde and cilantro. Serve with corn tortillas.

title: Crispy Peanut Butter Arborio Rice
ingredients: 4 cups arborio rice or 4 cups carnaroli rice | 4 tablespoons smooth peanut butter
instructions: If using carnaroli rice it's best, just buy it already prepared. If you like it a little more crunchy, use the creamy peanut butter at this point. Bring 2 cups of water to a boil and add 1 tbs butter. Add rice and stir until it boils. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring once. Check texture and adjust with additional water if necessary. Remove from heat and stir in smooth peanut butter.

title: Raspberry Chilaquiles (Raspberry Chilaquiles)
ingredients: 6 large ripe raspberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup canned mild picante sauce | 3 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Drain raspberries thoroughly, coarsely chop, and put in a bowl. Add picante mix. Add garlic and stir through. If using canned chilaquiles, put them in a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, stopping occasionally to scrape down sides. If using canned chilquiles, drain well, and put in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate until needed. To serve, stir chilaquiles into the sauce and serve over lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,beef base,white cake mix
title: Easy and Delicious Momma's Cottage Pie
ingredients: 2 boxes white cake mix | 12 ouncesscotch bonnet peppers, finely minced or 12 ounces habanero peppers | 1 tablespoon beef base
instructions: Prepare white cake mix according to directions on package. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Serve by topping with chili paste or your favorite topping.

title: Lobster Cabbage in Red Wine
ingredients: 2 large head red cabbage | 6 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 lobster tails, unpeeled, meat picked off | 1 cup merlot, or as needed to cover
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place cabbage, potatoes, and turmeric in the pot, and continue boiling until potatoes are tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove the pot from the heat, and let stand until the lobster meat is cool, about 30 minutes. Slice lobster meat into 1/2-inch wide strips, reserving marinade. Pour enough manzanilla red wine into the pot to fill the empty spaces between the meat and potatoes. Return to a boil, and cook, stirring until stew thickens slightly, about 2 minutes. Season with salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,feta,lemon juice zest,horseradish,rose essence,corn kernel,parmesan cheese
title: Crispy Hidden Feta Spread
ingredients: 300 g feta, crumbled | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 teaspoon dried rose essence | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated | 2 cups corn kernels, well washed
instructions: Mix together feta, lemon juice zest and horseradish. Chop spring onion and combine with cheese and corn kernels. Stir well and chill until serving.

title: Spicy Vegetable Stir-Fry W- Ponzu Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon szechuan quervo gold medal dry thai peanut sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 tablespoon grand marnier or 1/2 tablespoon other liqueur | 1 1/2 cups fresh zucchini, halved lengthwise, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together soy sauce, quervo gold medal dry sauce and cornstarch.

title: The Original Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups mango chutney | 1 ounce taco seasoning, blend
instructions: Mix everything together, serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,corn oil,bread flour,enchilada sauce,green chili pepper
title: Tex-Mex Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cans stewed tomatoes in puree ( mexican ) | 1 can enchilada sauce, mild ( mild ) | 1 can green chili peppers | 2 cups bread flour ( or flour, i prefer whole wheat ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: First prepare sauce by heating corn oil in a saucepan on low med heat. Add green chili pepper, bread flour and 1 can of stewed tomatoes to pan. Cook for 10 mins on med high. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes. Add 1 can enchilada sauce and mix thoroughly. Let cool. Stir in the other can of stewed tomatoes and mix thoroughly. You can also use fresh green chili peppers if you prefer. Place mixture into casserole dish. In a separate bowl mix the other can of enchilada sauce with the bread flour until mixture resembles corn meal. Pour over enchiladas and bake for 25 - 30 mins in a 400â° oven till sauce thickens up and cheese is melted. Serve, hot and enjoy. Can be served warm or at room temp as is usually how my son likes his.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,flat leaf parsley,green onion,baby potato,mushroom,bicarbonate soda,saffron
title: Potato Mushroom Baking Balls
ingredients: 500 g baby potatoes | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 50 g flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 4 -5 mushrooms | 1 green onion, finely chopped | mrs dash seasoning, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cut potatoes in ½ inch squares. Wash mushrooms and chop finely. Chop onion and fry in olive oil to lightly brown. Add mushrooms, salt, seasoning and continue frying. Dip potato squares in potato batter. Bake on a tray at 150c for about 20 minutes..

title: Irish Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless stewing beef | 1 medium potato, cut into 3/4 cubes | 1/2 teaspoon chili | 1 lb baby carrots | 1 stalk celery, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 lb gruyere cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( may use emmenthal or swiss ) | 3/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Trim excess fat from stew beef. Cut meat into 3/4 cubes. Place potatoes, chili and carrots in 2 qt slow cooker. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Toss with meat. Sprinkle top with 1/2 cup of cheese. Cover and cook on low 4 - 5 hrs. Turn control to high. Stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,carnation milk,potato starch,sausage,cream mushroom soup
title: Coconut-Smoked Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 1 -2 lb ground sausage | 1 cup potato starch | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( campbell's ) | 1 can carnation evaporated milk | 1 -2 cup coconut cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f in a bowl, mix together the sausage, potato starch and condensed soup. In 10 x 15 inch pan, spread mixture evenly. Sprinkle coconut cream over sausage mixture. Bake at 375 degrees f for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Basic Beef Mix!
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups spicy brown mustard | 3 -4 tablespoons bottled hot sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store covered in the refrigerator at least 1 day before use. Great for roasts, barbeque or stir fry dishes.

title: Beef or Pork With Nuts
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1/2 cup pearl barley, uncooked | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 cup dried currant
instructions: Rinse roast well and pat dry. In an 8 or 10 quart slow cooker, place the barley, onion flakes and currants. Place roast on top. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours. When ready to serve, transfer to large platter, cut sides down. Skim fat from sauce. Serve with roast and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,green olive,papaya,dark rum,lemon wedge,seasoning salt
title: St. Vincent Rum Pork Roast
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs picnic pork roast, with bone and fat | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/2 cup water chestnut slices, sliced | 1/4 cup papaya, diced | 2 teaspoons maggi seasoning salt or 2 teaspoons salt | lemon wedge
instructions: Place roast in large container or plastic bag and pour rum, water chestnuts, papaya, seasoned salt and lemon wedges over meat. Seal tightly, marinate in fridge overnight, turning the meat after 2 days or longer. Heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Drain and discard marinade. Arrange roast in roasting pan and cook for 45 to 60 minutes or to desired doneness. Baste with marinade 2 or 3 times during cooking. Let meat sit for at least 15 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: sage,taco seasoning,broccoli,creme fraiche,onion salt,french baguette,hot sauce
title: Broccoli Bruschetta
ingredients: 1/2 head fresh broccoli, sliced and trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | hot sauce, to taste ( such as tabasco ) | 1/2 fluid ounce creme fraiche ( optional ) | 12 slices french baguettes, cut in half, toasted ( or sourdough style ) | 1 pinch of crushed dried sage
instructions: Preheat broiler in 350f degrees. Place broccoli in serving bowl. Sprinkle onion salt over just the broccoli stem in 1/2 teaspoon of the hot sauce. Broil broccoli, stirring once, until crisp tender, about 5 - 7 minutes. Spread remaining 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce over toasted baguettes or bread slices. Broil bread slices, buttered side down, until bottom is starting to brown, about 1 minute.

title: Simple, Simple Tasting Glaze for Fish or Shrimp
ingredients: 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Combine water, rice vinegar, and garam masala in a small saucepan. Bring to boiling over high heat, stir in rice vinegar mixture. Reduce heat and simmer until the glaze has reduced. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. When glaze is completely cool, stir well.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,ginger garlic paste,sea salt,peanut butter,spinach,gingerroot
