title: African Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb chopped fresh spinach | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, minced | 1 teaspoon green pepper, minced | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon pickled ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Heat a bit of oil in a small sauce pan over medium heat and saute ginger garlic paste for about 1 minute. Add the spinach and saute until wilted. Add peanut butter and mix thoroughly. Sprinkle with green pepper, sea salt and pickled ginger and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,bread crumb,caster sugar,grand marnier,red chili powder,part ricotta cheese,cremini mushroom,italian bread
title: Linda's Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 25 cremini mushrooms | 1 cup bread crumbs | 1 cup instant double cream of tartar | 4 ounces caster sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh red chili powder | 4 ounces italian bread | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese
instructions: Place cremini mushrooms into a pan of boiling water. Cook till tender, then drain and place in a bowl of ice water. Allow to completely cool, then remove stems, and cut larger mushroom caps in half and place caps in a bowl with the crumbs. Set aside. In a large bowl, add the cream of tartar, sugar, red chili powder, and italian bread and mix till a paste like consistency. Add the ricotta and mix well till mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add the dry mushroom caps, then fill them with the cream of tartar mixture to cover the caps. Place into freezer for about 15 minutes to allow the filling to set. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Unwrap the stuffed mixture and place on a baking board with a lip of parchment paper in the center. Bake for 10 mins, then flip, and bake for 8 mins more. Remove the tray from the oven, and place the filled mushroom caps on the plate with the paper on it. This will give a beautiful shiny top when served with fresh cream.

title: Quick Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil | 6 -8 ounces hot italian sausages
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet on medium heat. Meanwhile, cut sausages into 1 inch slices. Put the sausages into the hot oil. Cook, turning frequently, until the sausages reach desired doneness, 15 - 20 minutes and have a nice crusty browned crust for removing from heat. Drain the juices from the skillet.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,flat leaf parsley,flour,lasagna noodle,celery seed,double cream,cream mushroom soup
title: Creamy Lasagna
ingredients: 10 large flour tortillas | 250 ml double cream | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/3 cups flat leaf parsley, chopped and divided | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 packet lasagna noodles | 1 teaspoon flour
instructions: Mix soup, half the parsley, celery seeds, and ground white pepper in a bowl. Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet. Dip each tortilla into the soup mixture on both sides, set aside. Pour 1/4 of the cream into a 9x9 baking dish coated generously with a little oil. Place 1 t of the soup mixture in the center of each tortilla. Place 2 t of the noodles on top. Repeat, dipping each tortilla into the soup mixture until it is completely covered. Spread 1/4 of the soup mixture evenly across the tortillas. Repeat layering, using 1 tsp of parsley. Bake at 375 f for 30 minutes or until bubbly around the edges.

Random Ingredients: sausage,onion,liquid smoke,orange juice,golden syrup,grain white rice
title: Easy Microwave Sausages and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 4 -6 sausages ( depending on size of sausages ) | 2 cups orange juice ( approx 2-3 oranges depending on size ) | 2 medium onions, finely diced | 1/8 cup golden syrup | 1/8 cup light brown molasses ( optional ) or 1/8 cup dark molasses ( optional )
instructions: Wash, rinse & drain rice. Add rice and chopped sauté onions & golden syrup to a microwave safe dish. Mix orange juice, light molasses & light brown molasses if using, pour over rice and mix well. Cover with plastic wrap or dish towel and cook in microwave on high for 5 - 6 minutes..

title: Coconut Beef Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs lean top round steak, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp ( or 1 tsp tamarind powder, dissolved in 1/4 cup of water ) | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon tamarind puree or 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 1/4 cup boiling water | 1/2 cup fat free low-sodium beef broth | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 3/4 cup shredded coconut
instructions: In large non metal bowl or pot add cut up steak. Sprinkle both sides with 1/2 tbsp tamarind mixture. Set aside 1/2 tbsp to use for the garnish later. Place meat in steamer basket on rack above water and cover pot. Cook over medium to high heat for 25 minutes, then turn steak over and cook for 25 minutes more. Remove from steamer and let cool for 5 minute. While steak is cooling add all remaining ingredients, cover and refrigerate 4 - 12 hours. To serve, ladle soup into bowls and swirl in 1 tbsp. Of pickled coconut. Garnish with pickled cilantro if desired.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,raisin bread,banana,romaine lettuce leaf,allspice,cardamom seed,chicken broth,walnut
title: Scallops and Bananas with Coriander Stuffing
ingredients: 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce leaves | 4 tablespoons raisins bread, cut in half lengthwise | 12 large sea scallops | 1 can low sodium chicken broth | 3 ripe bananas, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts
instructions: Combine romaine, raisins halves, chicken broth, bananas, cardamom, and allspice in a large nonreactive saucepan. Cook 5 minutes or until bananas are tender. Remove pan from heat, cover and set aside for 5 minutes to let flavors mingle. Remove scallops from broth and cut into halves. Reserve broth. Arrange the scallops on a serving platter. Top with warm lettuce mixture. Sprinkle with nuts, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red chili,lemon,almond extract,ranch dressing,grape tomato,maraschino cherry
title: Tossed Cherry & Cretzel Antipasto
ingredients: 1 pint grape tomatoes, quartered and seeded | 1 tablespoon red chili | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1/8 cup low fat ranch dressing | 1 teaspoon lemon rind, grated | almonds, coarsely chopped, to garnish
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the almonds into a blender jar. Blend until smooth, about 20 seconds. Pour all ingredients into a serving dish and garnish with toasted almonds.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,tomato,kidney bean,broth,celery rib,great northern bean
title: Hearty Minestrone
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1 can kidney beans | 1 can great northern beans ( lima beans ) | 2 medium celery ribs | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 cup broth
instructions: Drain stewed tomatoes and reserve liquid. Chop canned beans. Place canned beans, chopped tomatoes, and reserved liquid together in a large saucepan. Stir in flour and cook, stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Add broth and reserved tomato liquid and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve soup hot and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red salmon,mango chutney,cannelloni tube,kale,yellow cake mix,mayonnaise,serrano pepper
title: Chutney and Salmon Cannelloni Salad
ingredients: 1 can salmon, drained and flaked | 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 can cannelloni tubes, drained and chilled | 1 can red salmon, drained and flaked | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 medium serrano pepper, thinly sliced | 1 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f and butter a 9x13x2 pan. In a medium bowl, combine salmon, cake, cannelloni, red salmon, mango chutney and serrano pepper. Combine mayonnaise and 2/3 cup water in a small saucepan, bring to a boil. Cook and stir 1 minute, pour over salad and toss. Spread the salad with the dressing. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,rosemary,baking soda,chard leaf,cauliflower,spinach leaf,sazon goya coriander annatto,taco shell
title: Garbanzo's Favourite Mexican Pizza #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb kale ( i use the leaves ) | 2 cups fresh spinach leaves ( you can buy the spinach in the freezer section of many supermarkets ) | 1 package sazon goya with coriander and annatto ( congo ) | 6 large pita bread ( or similar ) | 6 taco shells, to taste or 6 hoagie rolls, to serve | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1 package crispy ready to serve cooked pita bread or ( 3 1/2 ounce ) package sandwich buns, cut into quarters, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Prepare grill. To prepare pizza, rinse kale with cold water. Remove stems from spinach, wash lightly and chop coarse. In a large nonstick skillet, add sazon goya and 2 tablespoons cooking oil. Cook with cover over med/low to keep warm. Preheat oven 425°f cut the pita bread or hoagie pieces in half so that they are about 1/8 inch round and each half fits slightly close together. Brush or oil lightly on bread. Place the bread, cut side up, on a cookie sheet and place directly on heated grill or broiler. Grill approximately 3 - 5 minutes per side, or until crisp. Remove from heat and top with greens, sazon, bacon, rosemary, baking soda and if desired broil until hot. To serve pizza, place some of the hot greens and sazon over the hot pitas and spread with salsa, pita meat, sour cream and other favorite toppings. Enjoy note, do not use the microwave for this step, it has caused holes in the pizza crust and also imparts a delicious crispy crust.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,white onion,heinz tomato ketchup,salmon,vanilla ice cream,macaroni
title: Heinz Tomato Salmon Mac And Cheese
ingredients: 1 onion, sliced and cut into wedges | 6 ounces smoked salmon, cubed | 8 ounces heinz tomato ketchup | 1 red chile pepper, chopped | 200 g macaroni | 150 ml vanilla ice cream
instructions: Put everything together in a microwave proof bowl add 2 cups of water cover and microwave on high for 8 to 10 minutes. Turn setting down to low, stir every minute, leave on top of the bowl for 15 to 30 minutes. Serve on bread or toast.

title: Perfect Rice Every Time!
ingredients: 3 cups sweetened leftover sourdough starter ( such as ponzu or sourdough ) | 2 cups basmati rice | 2 tablespoons dried summer savory | 2 teaspoons dried summer savory
instructions: In a large pot, stir together the starter, rice and summer savory. Bring to a boil and then cover. Turn heat down and let simmer for 10 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to sit, covered, for 15 minutes. Stir and enjoy.

title: Easy Chicken Crackling
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs chicken cutlets | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Prepare and bake chicken as directed on the box. Insert 1/2 tsp poultry seasoning into each chicken cutlet. Microwave on high for 3 or 4 minutes.. You will know as the chicken is done after 3 or 4 minutes.

title: English Cheese Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup instant pecorino romano cheese, grated | 3 packages active dry yeast | 4 cups unbleached unbleached flour or 4 cups bread flour, 1 pound, 1 pound, 1 pound, 1 pound
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process until dough forms a ball about 1 1/2 minutes on high. Pour the dough into a greased bread pan, pat it into a tight round shape, and let rise until double in size, about 40 - 45 minutes, or until puffy and slightly loaves about double in size. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes, covering loosely with foil for the last 10 to 15 minutes to prevent the top from getting too brown. Cool completely on a wire rack before loaf is cool enough to handle, 1 - ½ hours, or refrigerate 2 days.

title: Easy Beef Stew
ingredients: 5 lbs lean boneless sirloin or 5 lbs round steaks, cut into 1 1/2 inches pieces | 2 cups orange juice | 4 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: In a large non stick skillet, over high heat, warm one tablespoon of the corn oil. Add half the beef and brown lightly. Repeat until all the meat has been browned.

title: Moorish Chow Mein (Vietnamese Spring Rolls)
ingredients: 1 lb mung bean sprouts | 1/2 lb turnip | crushed iceberg lettuce
instructions: Pick the mung sprouts, turnip into large pot of boiling water, and boil, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes or until desired amount of sprouts are crisp tender. Drain well. Drain the mung sprouts and set aside. Peel turnip and cut into 1/2 inch pieces and soak in cold water for 5 minutes. Drain well. Remove all but about 1/2 cup of the water from the pot, and place in a bowl, with shredded iceberg lettuce. Roll the vegetables with reserved water. Drain and serve with pickled ginger and/or sweet & sour sauce.

title: Mexican Chocolate Chicken Wings
ingredients: 3 cups cooked pasta | 3 whole chicken wings ( drumsticks and thighs ) | corn, frozen | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | 3 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Boil chicken wings until fork tender, about 25 - 30 minutes. Remove chicken from pot and dice into small pieces. Set aside. Add dark cocoa and choclate to pot, blend, and simmer until chocolate is melted. Remove from heat and whisk in guacamole until it is smooth. Pour into pot and stir until warm. Pour mixture back into pot and keep warm. Add cooked pasta and chicken wings and stir until coated with sauce. Serve with fresh fruit and a nice glass of white rum.

title: Couscous Basics
ingredients: 4 yellow sweet peppers | 2 tablespoons hot paprika
instructions: Peel, halve, seed, and cut up pepper into pieces. Spray inside of a casserole dish with cooking spray and sprinkle sweet pepper pieces evenly on top. Sprinkle paprika on top of all.

title: Harry's Delight
ingredients: 125 g golden raisins | 125 g raw caster sugar ( icing sugar ) | 1/4 cup miniature marshmallows or 1/4 cup almonds ( chopped )
instructions: Soak raisins in cold water for 15 minutes. Drain. Add sugar and marshmallows to the raisins. Line a 12 square tin with greaseproof paper and grease the paper. Spread the mixture evenly. Sprinkle the chopped nuts evenly over the top of the mixture. Bake at 190°c / 350°f. Cook for about 30 minutes or until the top starts to turn a light golden colour.

title: Quick and Easy Turkey Kebabs
ingredients: 6 -12 ounces turkey, cooked, cubed and cooked ( can add more if desired ) | 6 ounces mango chutney ( can also use fresh fruit )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes to let flavors meld. Thread onto a skewer that has been soaked in water for at least 5 minutes. Grill over medium heat for 3 - 5 min per side or till turkey is cooked and chutney is bubbling.

title: Mexican Dinner #2
ingredients: 10 ounces white beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans stewed tomatoes and green chilies, diced | 1 can diced tomatoes with jalapenos or ( 16 ounce ) can diced rotel tomatoes & chilies, without hot sauce | 3 cups instant mashed potatoes or 3 cups instant french's french's french's french's frenchfried onions | 1 red chile
instructions: Combine 1st six ingredients in a deep baking dish. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Duck-Duck Chowder
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 lb fresh duck | 6 beef bouillon granules | 16 fresh dill pickles, quartered | 14 ounces chocolate squares, chopped | 4 eggs, beaten
instructions: Place cranberries in a 2 qt saucepan and cover with warm water. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes. Drain cranberries. Reserve. Bring duck carcass to a boil and cool for 30 minutes. Remove neck and giblets. Set aside. Chop bones and bones. Cut duck into serving sized pieces, removing fat as necessary. Measure bones into 2 qt container. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled, at least 4 hours or overnight. Drain cranberries through a sieve. Discard solids. Add duck carcass, stock granules, pickles, and chocolate to blender and purée. Place in double boiler over very low heat. Bring to a boil stirring occasionally, just until melted. Remove from heat and beat in eggs. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

title: Carolina Irish Potato Salad
ingredients: 10 medium potatoes, cooked and peeled, about 1 lb. ( kipper potatoes ) | 1 cup applesauce | 1/2 white onion, minced
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill until serving time.

title: German Lentil Crockpot
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage ( casing removed ) | 6 ounces brown lentils | 15 ladyfingers | 1/2 cup kale ( shredded fine ) | 1/4 cup soya sauce
instructions: Remove sausage casings and sausage from casing and cut into chunks. Add the sausage chunks and mix with lentils. Add the lid and cook on low for 8 hours. Turn the crockpot on high and cook for 45 minutes. Turn crockpot onto a large platter and sprinkle with the soya sauce. Note, this recipe can also be made in a crockpot on low for 4 hours, but i prefer slowcooker and do it all the time. Let rest on a board for about 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Red Chili Oil
ingredients: 2 dried red chilies | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 cup vegetable broth or 1 cup water
instructions: Heat oil in skillet on medium heat. When oil/oil just starts to smoke, add chilies and stir fry until they are fragrant about 30 seconds. Immediately add water and cook till boiling again. Turn down heat and stir in all other ingredients, cover tightly and simmer till ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: tahini,pear,malt vinegar,salmon,garlic powder,anchovy paste,barbecue sauce,red pepper flake
title: Grilled Moroccan Salmon
ingredients: 4 teaspoons salt free barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste ( kesar, use fresh anchovy if you can find it but we had a bottle of kalamata or kalamata ) | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 lbs wild pacific salmon, skinned ( about 15oz each ) or 4 lbs other skinless, boneless salmon | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into resealable gallon size baggie.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,caster sugar,creamy peanut butter,salt pepper
title: Awesome Peanut Butter & Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: 175 g creamy peanut butter | 1 pinch caster sugar ( optional ) | 50 g golden syrup | 1 pinch salt & pepper, ground
instructions: First make the fudge fudge. Blend and then melt butter & sugar, if using, in a separate pan. Add in peanut butter & stir over a low heat. Don't let it bubble/curry like you would with peanut butter. Pour onto a baking paper lined tray & sprinkle with ground pepper. Cool till fudge starts to set. Cut into 12 squares.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,italian salad dressing,chili pepper flake,virgin olive oil,cherry tomato,bay scallop,mint
title: Chilled Scallops With Mint and Dried Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs bay scallops ( or more to taste ) | 1/2 cup fresh mint | 2 tablespoons vinaigrette salad dressing | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh mint | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | extra virgin olive oil ( for brushing )
instructions: Rinse and soak scallops in cold water for 1 hour, drain. Trim scallops of all but about 2 inches of the beard. Cut away white muscle muscle in center portion and pull out and white tissues under center portion. Place scallops and mint in a medium size mixing bowl. Pour vinaigrette dressing over scallops and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or as long as 1 day. Remove scallops from marinade and set aside. Chill mint sprigs in refrigerator until ready to use. Remove mint sprigs from martini shaker with a slotted spoon. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook scallops for 5 to 8 minutes, or until barely opaque and cooked through.

title: Mini Shepherd's Pies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut in 1/4 inch cubes | 1 cup mixed peeled fruit | 3/4 cup peeled apple cider | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1 1/2 cups gouda cheese, finely shredded | 1/2 cup leek, green parts only, sliced thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine beef, mixed fruits, and cider in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cover and cook until juices evaporate and mixture is reduced enough to coat the back of a spoon, stirring frequently. Transfer mixture to a large bowl. Spoon equal portions of meat mixture into each wonton wrapper. Roll wrapper around filling into a ball, and place on cookie sheet. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.

title: Homestyle Low Carb French Onion Dip
ingredients: 6 large vidalia onions ( about 1/2 pound ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dried parsley
instructions: Thoroughly dry the onions. Wash and dry the onions thoroughly. Trim excess and discard the brown outer layers. Peel the onions and slice into thin slices. Layer 1/3 the onions into a 9x13 glass pan. Sprinkle 1/3 of bouillon over onions. Sprinkle 1/3 bouillon over onions. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and let sit in a cool place to marinate for several hours or up to an hour. Stir occasionally. Store covered at room temperature for up to 2 days. Note, you can substitute beef consomme if desired. Makes about 1 quart.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,white wine vinegar,kirsch,red grape,dark chocolate,green olive
title: Grape Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 tablespoons good dark chocolate, grated | 500 g seedless red grapes or 500 g orange grape | 200 g red seedless grapes | 5 -6 green olives, cut in half | 2 -3 tablespoons chambord raspberry wine vinegar | peanut oil
instructions: Wash, dry and slice grapes. Heat oil and butter together in a frying pan. Add grapes and grapes and fry, stirring frequently for 3 minutes while gradually adding vinegar and stirring. Simmer for 3 - 4 minutes.

title: Coriander-Crusted Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice bran oil | 2 teaspoons pepper, course grind | 1 teaspoon cardamom, ground
instructions: Heat oil in wok or deep non stick pan. Toss in onion powder and mix well. Deep fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels and keep aside. Pour oil in wok or deep fryer to 350°f. Heat on high until very hot. Toss in hot crumb mixture and toss till mixture darkens. Sprinkle freshly ground coriander over and serve immediately.

title: Sausage and Apple Ring
ingredients: 5 links hot italian sausage | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup currants | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 package frozen miniature biscuits, unopened | 1 tablespoon chopped dried red candied apples
instructions: Slice the sausages crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Remove casings and casings. Place in a 6 quart slow cooker. Add stewed tomatoes with juice, currants, sesame oil, oregano, and hot italian sausage. Cover and cook on the low heat setting 8 to 10 hours. Remove sausage and set aside to cool slightly. Remove the lid, increase heat to high, and boil, uncovered, 30 seconds or until heated through. Stir and sprinkle with the reserved sausage. Let stand 5 minutes then carefully remove biscuits. Serve the rings warm, with the candied apples. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.

title: Salsa (Salsa Verde)
ingredients: 1 can green chili salsa ( salsa verde ) | 1 tablespoon fresh celery, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads, crushed
instructions: Combine ingredients in a medium sized bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,sun tomato,onion flake,pork rib,basmati rice,self raising flour
title: Pork Braised in Sun-Dried Tomato Syrup
ingredients: 400 g pork ribs, skinned | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 2 tablespoons onions flakes | 3 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 cup basmati rice, cooked | 3 tablespoons self-raising flour
instructions: Place all ingredients in a baking dish/bowl. Combine self raising flour and enough water to form a thick dough. Dip the pork into the mixture, coat with the flour mixture and leave for 40 minutes to a minimum of 1 hour in a warm place. Preheat oven to 170c/fan 140c/gas cook pork on the stove top on medium heat in a pan for about 40 mins turning once, until meat is lightly browned. Serve with a salad and a good green salad.

Random Ingredients: mint,ginger,olive,grand marnier,tomato green chilies,lemon peel,vanilla sugar
title: Spiced Minted Salsa
ingredients: 2 packages of fresh mint ( i use the dried mint, stems only. ) | 4 -5 tablespoons fresh lemon peels ( no pith ) | 1 can crushed tomatoes with green chilies | 2 -3 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 - 3/4 cup olive oil or 1/2-3/4 cup canola oil | 24 ounces canned diced tomatoes, drained. | 1 teaspoon grated fresh lemon peel
instructions: Soak fresh mint in lukewarm water for 30 minutes, or until soft. Wash mint and place in food processor. Process with mint sprigs until mint becomes finely chopped. Mix remaining ingredients and blend into mint. Serve over ice and enjoy.

title: Croustades
ingredients: 1 cup fresh asiago cheese, coarsely grated | 1 cup spring onion, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 3 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, gently stir together the asiago cheese, spring onions, turmeric and flour until a smooth texture has a creamy consistancy. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls into hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes, or until brown browned and puffed.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,spinach leaf,red pepper flake,flat leaf parsley
title: Sauteed Spinach With Parsley and Cumin Seeds (Shawarma Chai)
ingredients: 1 bag fresh spinach leaves | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Place the spinach leaves in a wok with 1 teaspoon of cumin seeds, 1/2 teaspoon of crushed red pepper and 2 tablespoons of chopped parsley and cook using very low heat. Let the spinach wilt and then mix in the remaining cumin powder and stir constantly over heat for 3 minutes. Remove and toss in the spinach and finish cooking with a little more crushed red pepper if desired. Serve the spinach as is or serve it in warm pita bread rounds.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,cream corn,pineapple chunk,italian sausage,barbecue sauce,corn oil,orange peel,celery salt
title: Hawaiian Sausages With Sweet Corn
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups hot bbq sauce | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 teaspoons celery salt | 1 teaspoon orange peel | 1 cup corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon barbecue sauce | 24 thin sweet italian sausages | 24 pineapple chunks
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together hot bbq sauce, vinegar, corn oil, celery salt and orange peel. Add corn oil, barbecue sauce and sausages. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours, turning once. Reserve any remaining sauce. Drain corn and arrange on a well oiled baking dish lined with foil. Roast at 400 degrees for 30 minutes. Brush each sausage with reserved barbecue sauce.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,goat cheese,palm oil,dill weed,pepper sauce
title: Taco Treats
ingredients: 1 package soft fresh goat cheese, cut into 16 equal portions | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix, or as desired | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill weed | 1/4 cup palm oil | 1 dash hot pepper sauce to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place goat cheese pieces into a bowl, and season with taco seasoning and dill weed. Whisk olive oil, palm oil, and hot pepper sauce together in a microwave safe bowl. Heat until the oil is hot, 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,anaheim chili,frying chicken,chicken,coconut,nonfat milk,pizza crust,chipotle powder
title: Chipotle Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1 can nonfat evaporated milk | 1/3 cup chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 frying chicken, cut into 8 serving pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder | 1 anaheim chili, cut into 8 slices | 10 sheets prepared pizza crust | 1 pound shredded, cooked chicken
instructions: Preheat the grill for high heat. In a medium bowl, combine 2/3 cup nonfat evaporated milk, 1/3 cup chipotle powder, garlic salt, and 1/2 teaspoon chipotle powder. Coat the chicken with the spices, and set aside. Place the remaining 1/3 cup evaporated milk, chili slices, 1/2 teaspoon chipotle powder, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon chipotle powder in a blender, and blend until smooth. Place the chicken pieces in a nonstick skillet over medium heat, and pour the remaining milk mixture into the skillet. Cover, and cook and stir just until the chicken is no longer pink in the center, and the bottom of the chicken is slightly charred. Arrange the grilled chicken pieces onto a serving platter, and cover with the sauce. Serve with rice, beans, and other suggested toppings as desired.

title: Easy Hungarian Spiced Hot Pot
ingredients: 1 tablespoon hungarian sweet paprika | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar | 2 cups chicken stock | 3 drops hot hungarian paprika or 3 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized pot, stirring frequently. Bring pot to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 30 - 45 minutes, or until mixture is creamy, thick and creamy. Remove from heat, skim fat. Pour hot liquid over hot dogs and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,cheese,heavy cream,shiitake mushroom,mint leaf,phyllo tart shell,splenda sugar substitute,vanilla
title: Vegetable Tart
ingredients: 3 cups shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1 1/2 cups splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ( optional ) | 1 prepared phyllo tart shell | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons shredded cheese ( optional )
instructions: Blend mushrooms, cream, vinegar and splenda together in a food processor till thick, adding vanilla if desired. Pour into a bowl and add the chopped mint leaves to the mixture. Spoon mixture into the pastry shells and top with cheese. Bake in a 350f oven for 25 mins or till crust is golden. Note, you may bake any mixture you like as a side dish i have tried doing in the summer. Just be sure to stir.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,green chili pepper,pear,chili garlic sauce,cooking oat,italian herb,pimiento strip
title: Italian Burger Spread
ingredients: 1 can pears, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 cup sliced pimiento strips ( can sub a small can of drained peppers ) | 1 jar sliced green chili peppers ( jarred ) | 2 tablespoons snipped dried italian herbs | 2 cans refrigerated fat-free cooking oats ( do not use quick release, as many cans will be needed in the oven ) | 1 lb lean hamburger | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Process the pears through a food chopper or with a hand held grater. Add the pimiento strips, chile peppers and italian herbs to the pears, chillies and nuts in a large bowl.

title: Quinoa and Hominy Mix (Nif Paleo)
ingredients: 2 cups hominy, rinsed | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard
instructions: Place the hominy and quinoa in separate batches in a large pan. In medium saucepan, cover with 2 cups water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 375°f spread the prepared quinoa mixture on a baking tray and top with the mustard. Bake for 1 hour, stirring frequently, until quinoa is golden and crisp and the mustard is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: mushroom stem,liquid smoke,pineapple juice,white flour,english cucumber,saffron powder,garlic clove
title: Hawaiian Cumin Crackers
ingredients: 1 quart pineapple juice, reserved | 1 -2 pinch saffron powder ( optional ) | 3/4 cup liquid smoke | 2 english cucumbers, sliced into 1/4'rounds | 1 -2 garlic clove, minced | 3/4 cup white flour ( approximately ) | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pour pineapple juice and saffron into a small bowl large enough to accommodate all slices of cucumber. Stir in enough liquid smoke to moisten cucumbers. Transfer to a large oven safe baking sheet. Spread sliced cucumbers, overlapping slices, in a slightly overlapping layer in the baking sheet on the top. Sprinkle garlic and flour over top. Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until the crust is browned. Remove from oven, turn over onto baking sheet for a few minutes longer. Break apart with a spoon.

title: Easy Peach Curry
ingredients: 1 package large tofu, drained and cubed | 2 cups diced fresh peaches ( optional ) | 2 kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 10 potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Place potatoes in a saucepan, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, then mash with a fork. Bring coconut milk back to a boil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry the tofu cubes in the saucepan until coated with coconut milk, 5 minutes. Remove tofu from skillet, and set aside. Simmer the bananas, peaches, kaffir lime leaves, and water in the coconut milk until heated though and tender, 10 to 15 minutes. To serve, place 2 to 3 curry scoops onto a plate, then arrange the tofu cubes over the top.

title: Sausage and Peppers
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, cut in chunks | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chili, dried
instructions: The day before cooking add all the chilis to a bowl and mix. When ready to saute put a little butter into a frying pan and place over med.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,pearl barley,rice noodle,parmesan cheese,steak,orange peel,basil leaf
title: Beef and Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup rice noodles, dried | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves | 3/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 4 slices orange peel
instructions: Mix ingredients for the beef and marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature or refrigerator. In a skillet, cover bones with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until desired doneness. Meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Transfer cooked noodles to a baking dish and toss with beef and marinade. Sprinkle with cheese and orange peel and broil until cheese is bubbly. Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,cardamom pod,currant,basil,sushi rice,apricot preserve,campbell tomato soup,corn
title: Vegan Fruited Sushi
ingredients: 4 cups sushi rice | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon ( try low sodium if necessary ) | 3/4 cup dried apricot preserves, i like to go with greek | 1/4 cup dried currant, i use fresh | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, cracked ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon corn ( optional ) | 1 can campbell tomato soup | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Combine rice, chicken bouillon and apricot preserves in pot and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until rice is soft and liquid absorbed about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile combine cardamom, corn. Add to rice mixture. Mix. Spread on cookie sheet or a piece of waxed paper and let cool. Serve with soy sauce.

title: Blueberry Tofu Margaritas
ingredients: 16 ounces firm tofu, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 medium onion, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup minced garlic | 1 cup fresh blueberries | 1 cup tequila | 1/2 cup brandy or 1/2 cup whiskey | 6 bay leaves | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh lime rind | 1 tablespoon minced onion
instructions: Mix the teriyaki sauce ingredients in a bowl, and stir well to blend. Put the tofu in a zip top bag. Pour the teriyaki sauce over it, squeeze out the air, and seal the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight. Meanwhile, mix together the blueberries, tequila, brandy, and bay leaves until well blended, transfer to a blender, and puree until smooth. In a skillet, heat the remaining marinade until it bubbles, then add the sauteed onions. Cook over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring constantly, until tender. Serve the tofu with the sauce, and garnish with the lime rind.

Random Ingredients: cherry,butter,goat cheese,daikon radish,basmati rice,chai tea,yucca root
title: Yia Yia's Big Bowl
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 4 ounces yia's spiced goat cheese, cut in 1/2-inch pieces | 1 bunch daikon radish, thinly sliced crosswise | 1 pint cherry, halved | 1 lb yia's yia's sweet potato radish, thinly sliced crosswise | 2 tablespoons chai tea, warmed and chilled | cooked basmati rice
instructions: Melt the butter in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Add the goat cheese, and cook until it's browned, about 20 seconds. Remove from the heat and divide the mixture among 4 individual dishes. When heated, spread each with the chai. Garnish with radish slices. Serve hot, passing the rice separately.

title: Wild Rice and Apricots
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice ( wild rice specifically ) | 1 cup canned apricot pieces ( drained ) | 1 1/2 cups cornmeal
instructions: Rinse wild rice thoroughly under running water. Rinse out a couple of handfuls of the rinses and add to a large skillet along with rice and apricots. Sprinkle cornmeal over all and just enough water to cover the rice. Bring to boil, then turn down to low and simmer for 1 hr, uncovering the pot and cooking for anywhere between 30 - 65 mins until rice is tender, and grains and apricots are moist and chewy.

title: Slow Cooker Machaca
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shoulder, cubed | 600 g white mushrooms, quartered | 1 1/2 cups salsa | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1200 ml broth
instructions: Place lamb and mushrooms in the crock of your slow cooker. Pour salsa, rosemary, cumin, and 2 cups of low fat broth over, and stir. Cook on high for 6 to 8 hours so the meat is falling off the bone. Remove and discard the rosemary and cumin. Spoon the broth back onto the meat. Serve in its broth with a side of spanish rice and green beans. For an added touch, you can cook it on high for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: turkey bacon,sesame oil,fish sauce,plantain,turkey sausage,curry leaf
title: Spiced Turkey Sausage and Plantain Fried Plantains
ingredients: 4 slices turkey bacon | 6 plantains, cut into fries | 8 ounces cooked turkey sausage | 8 -12 slices turkey bacon | 4 -6 large curry leaves | 2 tablespoons fish sauce ( ketjap manis ) | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Using a mandolin or food processor, finely grind the two slices of bacon. Use a mandolin if necessary. Trim the sausage of access fat and slice the bacon into thin slices. Fry the slices, in a few batches, in a large frying pan over medium high heat for about two minutes. Remove to paper towels to drain. Using the same pan, add the sausages to the same pan on medium high heat. Cook, turning occasionally, until lightly browned on both sides. Remove from the pan and set aside. Heat up half the sesame oil in the pan. Add the curry leaves and fry until fragrant. Add the sausage slices and fry for a few minutes, turning only once. Remove from heat. When all the sausages are browned, remove. Add the reserved bacon, fish sauce, and sesame oil to the same pan and simmer for a minute. Turn down heat and add the fried plantains. Mix well and add the fried plantains. Cook the plantains until warmed through, adding a few more sesame oil if needed. Serve warm with green hot tea.

title: Veal Taco Meat
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb stew meat | 1 can diced chilies, including liquid, divided | 1/2 cup veal, finely diced, divided | 3 tablespoons prepared filling, divided | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup of the juice from the can of chilies and the 1/2 cup of the vegies in a large dutch oven or pot with lid. Cover and heat on medium. Stir once in a while and remove when boiling. Reduce heat, if necessary, and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. When all the juice has been absorbed, remove from heat and stir in the vanilla.. Place dutch oven or pot with meat in freezer until the fat has risen to the top. Slice meat as desired. Remove fat if desired. Return meat to stove. Add filling and 2 t. Of the juice. Stir. Raise heat until it reaches medium heat. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes or until meat is cooked through and the liquids are reduced to about 1/2 2 cups. Serve on a platter with a lime wedges over tortillas/rolls, if desired.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage,pine nut,garlic granule,panko breadcrumb,tomatillo,beer
title: Spanish Sausage With Sausage
ingredients: 4 fresh tomatillos, husked and washed | 1 clove garlic granules | 1/3 cup pine nuts ( toasted ) | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup tomato based beer ( your favourite kind ) | 1 lb turkey sausage ( thick cut with the bone in or not )
instructions: In a food processor, take the tomatillos and garlic.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,mustard seed,superfine sugar,brown rice,mint leaf
title: Korean Sushi Roll
ingredients: 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds, toasted | 7 leaves mint leaves | 2 kiwi fruits, peeled halved and sliced | 300 -400 strokes whole-grain brown rice, for rolling
instructions: Put sugar in a bowl and place over low heat. When the sugar starts to melt, gradually stir in the mustard seeds. When they begin to sputter, remove from heat. Add the remaining ingredients, one by one, mixing well after each addition. Roll into long strips and pinch together the ends. Roll in a handful of cooked rice to coat. Slice into 4 equal pieces using a serrated knife or cleaver. Roll in extra sugar. Cut into quarters.

title: Mexican Fry Bread - Toast Machine
ingredients: 4 thin slices bread ( see bread machine instructions ) | 4 teaspoons tamari ( see notes. ) | 1 teaspoon moroccan mixed spice ( see notes. ) | 4 teaspoons taco sauce, see notes for variations
instructions: Select desired bread and amount of ingredients. Add extras ingredients and then press start or manual.

title: Champino Con Champino Rellenos (Champino Mushrooms)
ingredients: 24 fresh button mushrooms, cleaned | 1 cup sherry wine | 1 fresh hot ancho chile pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a roasting pan, combine mushrooms with sherry, ancho chile pepper, and salt. Roast in the preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender.

title: Kranti, Ham or Turkey
ingredients: 500 450 g kraut or 450 g goose liver | 2 -3 teaspoons dried marjoram | 4 -6 -8 dried cherries | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 -3 tablespoons pine nuts or 2 -3 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: In a shallow casserole or pot, place the cherries, chopped or crushed nuts and the vanilla. Place over medium heat, stirring with a wooden spoon to scrape the pan until boiling. Turn the heat down to low. When the bubbles appear, place a piece of kraut in the center of the pan and slowly pour in the hot cherries. Turn back the heat to low and cover the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, for approximately one hour and 45 minutes. Serve hot. If kranti browns too quickly, cover and allow to set on pan. When the kraut is soft, remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Add vanilla extract.

Random Ingredients: red potato,garlic powder,quinoa,saffron,coconut cream,taco seasoning mix,chutney,arborio rice
title: Quinoa and Potato Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 2 cups peeled and cubed red potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon paprika ( or to taste ) | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 2 cups grated low-fat coconut cream | cooked arborio rice
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a medium frying pan over medium heat, melt the coconut cream and saffron with paprika over medium heat. When the rice is half way done, stir in the potatoes and saffron and saffron mix, mixing well. Place the quinoa in a separate microwave safe bowl. Place the microwave safe bowl with the coconut cream in the microwave and cook on high power, about 5 minutes, then stir to combine. When the rice is almost finished cooking, stir in the potato mixture. Place the burritos in a serving bowl, pour the rice mixture over, and top with extra coconut cream and salsa if desired.

title: Tomatoes With Chiles and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 4 medium tomatoes | 2 arbol chiles | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | fresh cilantro leaves ( for garnish )
instructions: Remove stem and seeds of tomatoes, halve lengthwise and remove seeds from chiles. Cut chiles into halves lengthwise. Place chiles, cut side down, on plate. Heat oil or butter in skillet and fry, turning often, until deep golden brown, about 10 seconds. Turn chiles over and fry, turning frequently until golden brown on other side, about 10 seconds longer. With slotted spoon transfer chiles to paper towel lined plate. When all are cooked, remove from skillet and cool. Chop roughly and discard seeds and veins. Rinse chiles under hot water to remove chili skins. Combine chilies, pine nuts, vinegar and cilantro in small bowl, stirring well. Season with salt and pepper. Serve sliced tomatoes with tomato mixture.

Random Ingredients: green onion,yogurt,fontina cheese,mushroom,vegetable broth,biscuit mix,portabella mushroom
title: Vegetable Biscuits
ingredients: 1 package biscuit mix | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1 cup fat free sour cream or 1 cup fat-free yogurt | 3/4 cup shredded fontina cheese ( can use pepper jack ) | 3/4 cup sliced mushrooms ( can use more ) | 3/4 cup chopped portabella mushroom | 2 green onions, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In large bowl, combine biscuit mix, yogurt, sour cream and half of cheese. Mix well. Stir in remaining cheese until it is all incorporated. Roll dough into walnut size pieces and transfer onto greased cookie sheets. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove and top with remaining cheese, mushrooms and green onions. Return to oven for about 8 more minutes. Cool for about 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: genoa salami,green chili,date,watermelon,pepperoni,idaho potato,lemon juice zest
title: Pizza Potatoes With Dates and Salami
ingredients: 12 lbs idaho potatoes, rinsed and patted dry with paper towels | 8 slices genoa salami | 8 ounces salami | 8 ounces ground pepperoni | 4 large pitted dates, chopped | 16 medium green chili, chopped, mild | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pan and bring to a boil, then reduce to simmer. Cook for 45 - 60 minutes until potatoes are tender and drain off fat and cool. Pour into a greased, rectangular container with a lid or foil. Cover the bottom of the container with an even layer of warm pizza dough. Place a slice of salami on top and pinch the salami so it is covered. Place the salami at the side with the salami. Spread half the chopped green chilies over the salami and the salami. Place a layer of dates over the chilies. Top with a layer of the salami and the chilies. Do the same with the salami, dates and green chilies over the green chilies. Drizzle the lemon juice over the top. Wrap the foil over the edge of the container. Chill for an hour to allow flavors to meld and the dough to set up.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck steak,bean,fontina cheese,gruyere cheese,curry,szechuan peppercorn,egg yolk,red lentil
title: Curried Beef, Red Lentils, and Gruyere Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck steaks | 1/4 cup red lentil | 1/2 cup red lentil | 1 1/3 cups shredded fontina cheese or 1 1/3 cups muenster cheese | 4 large egg yolks | 3 ounces grated gruyere cheese | 8 ounces baked beans
instructions: Toast szechuan peppercorns in a small skillet over medium high heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 10 seconds. Cool, then grind peppercorns in mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Pat beef dry, then rub with peppercorn mixture. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Grill beef over high heat until cooked to desired doneness, about 15 minutes. Slice into 1 inch pieces. To make marrow dumplings, place 1 cup red lentils in small saucepan of boiling, salted water. Simmer until softened, about 10 minutes. Drain in colander and run under hot tap water to cool. Place in bowl and mash. Bring 7 1/2 cups water to boil in large saucepan. Add red lentils and boil, stirring occasionally, until al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain in collander and repeat with remaining water, if desired. Add cheese to lentils and mash until smooth, about 1 minute. Beat egg yolks and stir into lentils. Season with szechuan peppercorns and salt and pepper. Combine with beef and stir until blended. To form meatballs, place a few pieces of beef at a time in a flat layer on lightly buttered rack of a broiler pan. Spoon about 2 tablespoon of beef on top of beef. Place pan on top of burner and broil until beef is cooked through, about 4 to 7 minutes. To pan, remove pan from burner.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,mustard seed,yellow bell pepper,onion powder,green chili,baking potato,red bean,egg white
title: Red Beans and Potatoes
ingredients: 5 medium baking potatoes, unpeeled and cut in half | 1 can red beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can yellow bell peppers ( mild ) | 1 can chopped green chili ( hot or mild ) | 1 can onion soup mix ( i recommend knorr brand, with onion ) | 4 large egg whites ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | onion powder, to taste
instructions: Put potatoes in a pot of lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to a simmer and cook until fork tender, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix the beans, peppers, cooked red beans, onion soup mix, egg whites and mustard seeds. Line a greased and floured baking dish with potatoes. Layer the ingredients, starting with the potatoes. Continue layering. I use two 1/2 inch round pans. I do not use foil, since it helps produce nice pockets to check for doneness. Bake at 350f for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,cannellini bean,pineapple sauce,cheddar cheese,canola oil,lettuce leaf
title: Tuscan Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans ( drained weight ) | 1 can crushed pineapple in sauce ( reserve juice ) | 4 medium lettuce leaves | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( for serving ) | 1/4 cup canola oil, for dressing ( reserved from can of cannellini beans )
instructions: Drain the cannellini beans, reserving the juice, and set aside. In a medium bowl, stir together the cannellini beans and the pineapple juice. To serve, arrange lettuce leaves on a serving platter, top with cheese and beans. Drizzle with the reserved pineapple juice.

title: Easy Easy Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 7 ounces tomato soup | 7 ounces light muscovado sugar
instructions: Mix all together in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Remove from heat and cover with lid. Allow to heat for 4 minutes. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,purpose flour,dark sesame oil,vanilla extract,mustard powder
title: Spinach Genovese
ingredients: 1 bunch baby spinach | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour ( approximately ) | 3/8 teaspoon low-sodium instant mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil ( optional )
instructions: Place thawed spinach into a large pan. Sprinkle salt onto spinach and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and begin to cook on low heat, stirring occasionally until spinach is tender and just beginning to wilt. The cooking time will vary depending on the size of the spinach. Drain well and set aside to cool completely. Once cool, squeeze out excess moisture. Mix flour thru mustard powder into spinach. When the spinach cools, add a bit of the hot cooking liquid from the pan and use your fingers to mix thoroughly. If a consistency is too thick, add a bit more liquid. This will produce a thicker, more consistent mixture. When ready to use, stir in the vanilla. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight, or until ready to use. Will keep for an hour or two if refrigerated.

title: Tomato Pizzas
ingredients: 3 small tomatoes | 4 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 1 teaspoon crystal sugar
instructions: Cut each tomato in half and scoop out and discard seeds. Cut each tomato half in half again and scoop out all of the flesh into the hollowed out of each tomato half. Scoop out seeds with a spoon and place in a bowl along with remaining ingredients. Dress with your favourite sauce. Enjoy.

title: Chili Powder (Keralan Beef)
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 plum tomato, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon chili paste or 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Place beef in a medium bowl. In a small, nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray, cook beef over moderately high heat, stirring, until just brown, remove from skillet. Add tomato to skillet and cook, stirring, 1 minute or until just beginning to soften. Stir in chili paste and cardamom. Stir in beef and simmer, stirring occasionally, 1 minute to reheat mixture. Serve with rice, pasta, or as a topping for pita, pita chips, etc.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,liquid smoke,canadian bacon,chili paste garlic,soya sauce
title: Chili Barley (Canadian Bacon) Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1 bunch chili paste with garlic, crushed ( see note below ) | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/4 cup liquid smoke | 1/2 lb canadian bacon, coarsely chopped small to medium
instructions: Dissolve 2 tsp salt in 1/2 cup of water. Cook barley in 4 cups water until tender. Drain and set aside. In a large nonstick wok, heat oil over medium high heat. Add chile paste and garlic. When garlic sizzles, stir in barley. Stir soya sauce and liquid smoke together, reduce heat to low. Add the bacon and gently stir until evenly coated on all sides. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,coconut cream,serrano chilies,chicken breast half,baking powder,purpose flour
title: Sopa De Coco (Chicken in Coconut)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable stock | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - diced | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup ground flaked coconut, divided | 1 can coconut cream | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 seeded serrano chilies, minced
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the vegetable stock to a boil. Place chicken in the saucepan, and cook 5 minutes, or until juices run clear. Place the flour, 1/4 cup of the coconut crumbs, and 1/4 teaspoon of the ground pepper into a shallow bowl. Cut chicken into bite size pieces.

title: Grangy Mushroom Rolls
ingredients: 50 g fresh yeast | 300 ml of thick scotch whisky | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 4 -8 mushroom caps | 50 g fresh yeast, dissolved in | 150 ml of thick scotch whiskey
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 150 ml of the whole lot of white thick scotch and rum and let it sit for a few minutes whilst the yeast begins to froth. Mix in the remaining white thick liquor. Cut the mushrooms from the stems and place them inside the mushroom caps. Rub the yeast mixture over the caps and let sit in a warm spot. Heat the remaining whisky so that it begins to foam. Make your deep holes in the mushroom mixture with a large spoon. Pour this mixture into the boiling liquor. As soon as you hear the mixture boil remove the mushroom from the pan with a slotted spoon and place in a warm bowl. When you are ready to serve, brush the mushroom caps with the yeast solution. Let the risen mushroom mixture sit in a warm place and serve. This mushroom roll is also delicious served with a salad and garlic bread.

title: Dilled  Black Stuffed Olives
ingredients: 8 large black olives | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill weed ( not dill seed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a small mixing bowl, combine 1 teaspoon dill weed and 2 tablespoons black olives. With a pastry blender, finely chop the mixture. Stir in 2 tbsp of black olives to taste. Using your hands, form dough into a log about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Wrap in wax paper, and refrigerate on a rimmed baking sheet for 30 minute. Bake, covered, for about 20 minute remove from pan and slice diagonally. Let cool for 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a dish and serve.

title: Sage's Sultana and Orange Marmalade Salad
ingredients: 1 ounce white onion, finely minced | 1 tablespoon orange marmalade ( or other flavourful flavourful liquid ) | 1 tablespoon sultana ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a small bowl or bowl of a blender or food processor and pulse until well mixed. Season and serve immediately.

title: Ground Beef and Quinoa (Or Rice-Ato Blini)
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon butter flavor crisco | 3 cups red quinoa | 2 cups frozen cut green beans | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 tablespoons buttered-flavor crisco for coating the inside of the pan
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Heat the butter flavor crisco in heavy skillet on medium high heat. Add beef and sprinkle with salt. Cook and stir beef until evenly brown. Drain fat. Mix in red quinoa, green beans, cumin and thyme. Turn heat to low. Cover tightly and bake for 20 - 25 minutes. Remove cover, sprinkle with crisco, and bake an additional 15 minutes or until it is hot and the quinoa is hot and sticky.

title: Paneer (Yard Kebab)
ingredients: 500 ml yogurt | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Dissolve cornflour in a cup of water and mix the cornflour with it. Add the yogurt gradually, blend well, refrigerate, covered and set aside for 3 hours. Mix the vanilla with the vinegar and make small balls with this mixture in the refridgerator.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,tahini,chili sauce,yellow bell pepper,russet potato,skewer
title: Tahini Potato and Pepper Skewers
ingredients: 6 -7 medium russet potatoes, peeled | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1/4 cup sweet chili flakes | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 3 skewers
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash potatoes by hand. Stir in chili sauce, chili flakes and tahini and mix well. Halve bell pepper and remove seeds. Cut pepper halves into 1/2 inch pieces. Thread pepper halves onto skewers and baste with sauce. Grill over medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes, or until lightly charred and potatoes are tender.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,sun tomato,cauliflower,sage leaf,green bean,vanilla extract,banana pepper,beef brisket
title: Crock Pot Roast Beef Brisket With Cauliflower and Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 3/4 cup finely diced green beans ( with stems ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped drained sun-dried tomatoes | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 medium banana pepper, thinly sliced ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped peeled fresh carrot ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 large head trimmed cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh sage leaf
instructions: Place beef brisket in 1 1/2 quart slow cooker. If using a 3 1/2 quart slow cooker, combine the golden syrup, green beans, sun dried tomatoes, and vanilla extract.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,cheese,cayenne,tarragon,wheat spaghetti,provolone cheese,beef brisket,heavy cream
title: Corned Beef with Spaghetti and Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 large corned beef brisket | 1 cup plain flour, sifted | 150 ml heavy cream | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon prepared dijon-style cheese | 250 g of grated provolone cheese | 1 package whole wheat spaghetti
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place corned beef in large roasting tin and pour the 1 cup of flour into the tin. Drizzle with a tablespoon of the cream and mix. Add remaining cream and sour cream and cayenne, stir well to combine and add dried herbs. Place meat on top of onion in roasting tin. Pour the marinade over beef and roast in a 180c oven for approximately 2 hours. Remove the meat and slice the meat thinly. Return to oven for approximately 15 minutes. Serve with parmesan and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,chicken stock cube,chili seasoning mix,black tea,frying chicken,feta,topping
title: Aussie Style Roast Feta Chicken
ingredients: 1 frying chicken ( a whole, large breast, trimmed of excess fat ) | 2 tablespoons chili seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, thinly sliced | 6 tablespoons black tea | 1/2 cup reduced-fat chicken stock cubes | 1/3 cup crumbled feta | freshly toasted slice of continental farmhouse bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 200'c / 400'f. Remove the chicken from the leg bones and discard the neck and wing pieces. Chop up the chicken meat to you liking. Place the chicken pieces in a baking dish. Sprinkle the chilie paste, tomato and black tea over the chicken and then add 2 cups of water, stock and seasoning. Cover and bake for 1 hour, basting from time to time. Remove lid and top with crumbled feta. Return to the oven for 10 - 15 minutes longer until golden and bubbling and cooked through.

title: Chili Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 6 ounces bittersweet chocolate | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, melt the chocolate and sweet chili sauce together in the microwave until smooth. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate 1 - 2 hours. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,ghee butter,tabasco sauce,green chilies,mozzarella cheese,apricot half juice
title: Palak Paneer
ingredients: 200 g spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon ghee ( clarified butter ) | 4 green chilies | 1/2 cup apricot halves in juice | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese ( grated ) | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut off the stems of the greens and wash in a colander. Cut the leaves into small lengths. Heat the ghee in a skillet on a medium heat. Drop in the green chillies and chopped spinach leaves. Fry covered, stirring frequently. Remove after about 10 minutes. Add the apricots and toss them with the skillet, adding the tabasco sauce as soon as the feta starts to melt. Continue to stir for about 20 mins or until the cheesa is browning on top. Turn off the stove. Remove the spinach leaves from their pan. Spread out on a greased serving plate. Top with the feta mixture and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,white rice,cooking oil,pimento olive,cake flour,chunky salsa,lettuce leaf
title: Cuban Potato Bread With Pimentos, Green Olives and Salsa
ingredients: 1 5/8 lbs potatoes ( medium ) | 3 cups rice, cooked al dente | cooking oil | 2 packages frozen monterey jack & granoure cheese & herb cake flour | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup potato starch | 1 jar sliced pimentos stuffed olives, drained | 5 large lettuce leaves, washed | purchased chunky salsa
instructions: Wash potatoes and dice potatoes into bite sized cubes. Place them in a pot with enough water to cover, bring to a boil, and cook until they are tender. Drain and reserve the cooking water. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a 9x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, stir together beans, rice, grated cheese, 2 cups bean liquid and mix well. In a separate bowl stir together potatoes, 3 cups bean liquid, bean mixture, 1 package of cheese, 3 teaspoons potato starch and 1/4 cup of salsa. Spoon mixture into prepared baking dish, top the mixture with sliced olives and additional 3 teaspoons potato starch, and bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven, cut in half and pile on top of a bed of lettuce leaves.

title: Baja Chipotle Aioli
ingredients: 2 teaspoons abi tapioca ( make sure it's all paste-wash ) | 2 -4 chipotle chiles in adobo, depending on how many you're going to serve
instructions: Dry fry the abarim for a couple minutes until just beginning to turn golden. Set aside. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and cayenne if necessary. Drain off any excess oil. Tear chipotles into small pieces and fry in a little oil just until soft. You don't want crisp chips. Serve immediately on toothpicks.

title: Ethiopian Corn and Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 3 cups uncooked whole kernel corn, partially frozen | 1 pound ground beef | 2 teaspoons allspice berry | 1 tablespoon dried apricots
instructions: Place cardamom seed in a shallow skillet over medium heat.

title: Lamb Merguez
ingredients: 4 lbs leg of lamb | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 lemon, sliced
instructions: Clean lamb and rub with ginger paste. Marinate in refrigerator for minimum two hours. When ready to cook, bbq or grill as usual. Slice lamb and serve with lemon.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,chili pepper flake,veal,barley,pre mozzarella cheese,spinach
title: Spinach Beef  With Barley and Mozzarella
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 2 lbs lean ground beef chuck | 2 jars sliced mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 cups prepared barley | veal fat ( optional ) | barley | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
instructions: In large skillet, combine ground beef and ground veal. Cook, stirring to separate meat and cook until browned and meat is no longer pink. Add mushrooms and saute. Add barley and cook 1 minute. Turn into 13 x 9 inch baking pan or casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350°f 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve over spaghetti, pasta or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,serrano ham,beef chuck,ginger garlic paste
title: Kaipunjabi (Indonesian Stuffed Beef)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch pieces | 4 ounces serrano ham, julienned or 2 ounces other ham, julienned | 2 lbs fresh baby spinach | 1/2 cup ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Place meat in a large bowl and add water to cover. Let stand 1 hour to marinate. Drain, discarding salt and fat. Set aside. Place ham in a large, shallow roasting pan. Arrange in a single layer and press out any excess liquid. Sprinkle with ginger garlic paste. In 2 batches, arrange in a single layer on top of meat. Cover each with baby spinach, pressing in to compact leaves. Place meat in a roasting pan and cover with a lid containing very hot water. Bake in the middle of a preheated 325 oven for 1 hour. Reduce heat to 325 and continue baking for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Boom Chakalaka  (Filipino-Style Glaze)
ingredients: 1 cup light dark soy sauce | 1 cup guinness or 1 cup rotel | 4 teaspoons ginger powder | 6 slices ham | 5 tablespoons garnishes | 1 cup irish cream, for pouring over hot kakalaka
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour over kakalaka.

title: Creamy Coffee Curd
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 4 ounces mu shiitake mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 1 bunch basil leaves, chopped | 1 quart brewed coffee, cooled | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Heat the oven to 365 degrees f. In a big bowl, mix the rice flour and mushrooms to blend. Heat a small amount of the coffee in a saucepan over medium heat. Turn off the heat, cool a little, and add the hot coffee to the flour mixture, and stir, then stir the liquid back into the flour dough. It's a little wet at first, but it should come together by the time the dough forms a ball in the bowl. If the dough seems to dry while the coffee is heating, stir in a little more coffee. Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead it about 10 times. Shape the dough into a long rectangle, about 1/2 inch thick. Cut the rectangle into 6 or 8 even squares, and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Poke a few holes in the center of each square so it will be easy to pick up. Bake on the middle rack of a preheated oven until the edges begin to lightly brown, around 20 minutes. Remove from the oven, and allow to cool slightly before filling with the freshly grated mozzarella cheese. If using a casserole dish, place into a larger bowl along with a few small holes. Cover, and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: caper,cooking oat,chipotle powder,rigatoni pasta,grape tomato,premade puff pastry,pork loin roast,pepperoni
title: Pork Pasta & Capers
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces other large tubular pasta | 4 ounces pork loin roast, trimmed of fat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 lb refrigerated rapon capers | 12 grape tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats ( or other quick-cooking oat ) | 1/4 cup fresh capers ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling water 8 - 10 minutes or until al dente. Meanwhile, in 3 1/2 3 quart slow cooker, place pork in 3 1/2 quart plastic bag. Seal bag and add pork to bag.

title: Tofu Cabbage Salad With Dressing
ingredients: 1/8 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 medium head cabbage, shredded | 2 jicama, peeled, cut into matchsticks
instructions: Whisk together the tahini, lime juice, and sherry in a small bowl. Heat the canola oil in a 10 cup nonstick frying pan, pour in the tahini mixture, and carefully pour in the sherry. When the sherry evaporates and seems dry, pour the oil into a large bowl and add the cabbage. Toss to coat. Add the jicama and toss through the dressing. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,caper,egg,ice water,basmati rice,shrimp,broccoli floret,peach schnapps
title: Shrimp and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 package basmati rice | 2 cups apple juice ( like apple or peach brand ) | 6 cups broccoli florets | 2 cups frozen shrimp ( optional ) | 1 cup frozen peas and schnapps | 1/4 cup peach schnapps ( or peach or peach sauce ) | 1 egg
instructions: Wash rice. Boil apple juice for 2 1/2 minutes. Set aside. Boil broccoli for 2 minutes. Chop shrimp fine and rinse in cold water. Set aside. Cut peeled prawns into 2 inch length. Beat egg. Set aside and rinse rice. Place rice on a platter and top with 1 cup of apple or peach, 1/4 cup of the broccoli and 2 tb of olive oil. Mix shrimp with the sauce. Top with the shrimp mixture and remaining apple/peppered broccoli. Drizzle the rest of the apple/pepper+olive oil over all and let it sit for about 5min. Serve.

title: Shahi Mallow (Indian Sandwich )
ingredients: 3 ounces ham ( thin slices, not too thick ) | 7 ounces jarlsberg cheese ( thick slices ) | 12 -16 slices of good quality semisweet chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 6 ounces fillets
instructions: In a frying pan, put on a little peanut oil. Make sure the pan is very hot, if possible, and fry each piece of ham until it turns golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon while frying the rest. In the same frying pan, put on more oil, and fry the jarlsberg cheese until it's soft. You can use a spatula, but it is easier and cleaner to work with. Add some tamarind paste, and cardamom powder. The heat will come up just a bit, but keep stirring. Put the ham slices over the cheese, spread a little tamarind paste over the ham slices, and put the chocolate on top. Now for assembly, put ham slices onto a baking sheet, cut in half, and brush with egg white or clarified butter. Bake in a 200 degree f oven for about 20 minutes, but watch the temperature as well as the cheese. After 10 minutes, take out of the oven and let cool for a few minutes, then carefully slide the cheese slices onto the hot ham slices and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,yeast,chinese five spice powder,vidalia onion
title: Chinese 5-Spice Sticks
ingredients: 5 1/2 cups unbleached corn kernels, drained | 1 small vidalia onion, chopped | 2/3 cup minced dehydrated yeast | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together corn kernels, onion, and five spice powder. Cover and let sit in a warm place for about 45 minutes. After 1 hour, add the corn sticks and combine well. Cover and let sit in a warm spot for about 3 more hours. Stick into clean, dry jars, and store in a cool, dark place. Note, the dehydrated yeast makes a bitter yeast that mellow and is easy to mix. You can substitute another yeast or anise extract for the five spice powder.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,mustard powder,oregano,mace,chili powder,picante sauce,plum
title: Mexi Canapes
ingredients: 1/2 cup picante sauce, divided | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 9 large plums
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup picante sauce, pepperjack cheese and mustard powder and season with chili powder, oregano and mace. Rinse the plums and remove pit, and add the remaining picante sauce.

title: Czech Pepper and Turnip Mince Beef Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1 1/2 lbs turnips or 1 1/2 lbs rutabagas, grated | 1/3 cup potato starch | 1/4 cup hot chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup cool whip | 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon mrs. dash hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Form into 12 patties about 1 1/2 inches diameter. Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned on both sides. Do not overcook, they should be soft and tender.

title: Mexican Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups elbow macaroni | 1 can salmon fillets, drained and chopped | 1 can chili beans, undrained | 1 1/2 cups catsup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Prepare macaroni according to package directions, drain & rinse. While that cooks, heat the beans and catsup in saucepan until warmed through, not boiling. Set aside. Pour macaroni into a large baking dish & distribute salmon on top. Pour the chili beans mixture over the fish. Cover tightly & bake 30 minutes. Uncover & bake 5 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,passion fruit pulp,tabasco sauce,green,beet,apricot jam
title: Welsh Antilles Vinaigrette (Pensallet)
ingredients: 1 lb beet, cooked till tender, then finely chopped | 1 small green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 2 teaspoons passion fruit pulp, made with passion fruit
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and keep in an air tight container, covered.

title: Chipotle Ribs
ingredients: 3 celery ribs, including leaves
instructions: Preparation of the celery stems, trim and peel the celery leaves and set aside in a bowl. Cut away the root and rib ends from the center stalks of each celery stalk, then cut them crosswise into about 1/4 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,haddock fillet,vegetable oil,penne pasta,italian plum tomato,chili paste,chicken breast
title: Penne with Grilled Skirloom Tomatoes and Haddock
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 16 ounces skinless boneless chicken breast, cut into thick strips | 12 ounces uncooked dry penne pasta | 2 cups coarsely chopped italian plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1/2 cup italian plum tomatoes, chopped | 2 teaspoons hot pickled chipotle chili peppers in adobo, minced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to high and oil grill rack 3 to 4 inches from heat source. Spray a grill rack with nonstick cooking spray. Cook chicken in oil over medium high heat 7 minutes per side, until lightly browned. Remove chicken from the heat and set aside to cool. Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain pasta and return to the same skillet. Stir tomatoes and hot peppers into the pasta. Add cooked chicken and toss lightly to mix. If desired, drizzle with tomato paste and serve.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,ale,orange juice concentrate,yellow squash,chili sauce,cornichons,kidney bean
title: Vegetarian Chili Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups cooked kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup yellow squash, chopped | 3/4 cup canned cornichons | 1 cup orange juice concentrate, frozen concentrate | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 4 cups arborio rice | 1 cup italian-style chili-flavored carbonated beverage ( such as ironbeer )
instructions: In a large serving bowl, toss the kidney beans, squash, cornichons, and orange juice with the sweet chili sauce. Bring a pot of water to a boil.

title: Bean and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package frozen asparagus, thawed | 1/2 cup onion powder | 1 cup torn romaine lettuce
instructions: Strain and rinse all but the head and tails of the asparagus. Place in a large salad bowl. Chop asparagus coarsely. Add kidney beans, onion powder and shredded lettuce. Toss to combine. Chill several hours or until ready to serve.

title: Gourd and Apple Pan Fried With Carrots and Carrots
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/3 cup olive, cut in pieces | 1 1/2 lbs green gourd, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup yellow bell pepper, cut in strips | 2 large carrots, cut in 1 inch cubes | 16 olives
instructions: In a shallow bowl, mix flour and olive, stirring well to combine.

title: Indian Spiced Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 3/4 teaspoon curry | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Place the rice, rice wine, curry and cinnamon in a 2 quart saucepan. Cover, and simmer 25 minutes, until rice grains begin to dry slightly.

Random Ingredients: topping,beef shoulder,cocoa,flat leaf parsley,single cream,ice,chick pea
title: Chickpea-Filled Beef Shoulder and Chimichurri Ice
ingredients: 1 lb beef shoulder, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 15 ounces cooked chick-peas, drained | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups single cream or 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1/4 cup finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa ( preferably dutch-process ) | crushed ice | topping, for serving
instructions: Place beef and chickpeas in a heavy saucepan and cover with water.

title: Quick Italian Spinach
ingredients: 16 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 pinch oregano
instructions: Combine the ricotta cheese, spices and oregano in one bowl. Use a salad dressing blender wand or food processor add enough water to produce a smooth dressing. Note, be careful of the amounts of salt and saltiness of the olive oil.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,lettuce,tomato green chilies,linguine,raspberry,salad oil,apple cider vinegar
title: Sweet and Sour Lettuce
ingredients: 4 cups lettuce, torn | 3 fresh tomatoes, sliced | 3 cups diced raw apples ( i used a combination of red and white but i used the red ) or 3 cups diced raw green chilies ( i used a combination of red and white but i used the red ) | 2 cans raspberries, undrained | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1/4 - 1/2 cup homemade mayonnaise or 1/4-1/2 cup lowfat mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Toss first seven ingredients together in large bowl. Toss well. Cover and chill before serving.

title: Cottage Cheese and Fruit Salad
ingredients: 50 g cottage cheese | 120 g cranberries, hulled | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 60 g salad oil | 3 tablespoons peanut oil or 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. Eat enjoy.

title: New Orleans-Style Shrimp and Cod
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 teaspoon yeast | 4 cups small fresh shrimp - peeled, deveined, and cut into small pieces | 4 skinless, boneless cod fish fillets | 1 sprig fresh ginger root, finely chopped | 1 spanish onion, chopped
instructions: Stir orange juice into a large bowl. Sprinkle yeast over water in a large bowl, and sprinkle about 2 cups of the shrimp over the mixture.

title: Homestyle Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 bag frozen meat hash ( about 36 ) | 2/3 cup grated pepperjack cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: Preheat oven oven to 375 degrees f. Cook noodles according to package directions. While noodles are cooking, grease a 15x10x1 inchx1 inch baking dish. Spray the inside of the baking dish with cooking spray. Spread the meat hash on top of the meat. In a bowl, stir together the pepperjack cheese, 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture, and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. Spread over the top of the noodles. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes or until heated through, stirring halfway through. Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture over the top of the kugel.

title: Peach Chaat
