ingredients: 4 slices semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 3 small peaches, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Place the chocolate chips in the bowl of a heavy duty microwave safe bowl. Add the garam masala, and stir to blend. Add the peaches to the chocolate mixture, and microwave, covered, on high power until the chips are lightly golden, about 3 minutes. Place the peach slices over the top. Microwave, uncovered, until the peach slices are hot and tender, about 3 minutes.

title: Chickpea Chowder
ingredients: 3 cans chickpeas | 1 1/3 cups onions, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 cup raisins
instructions: Drain chick peas well. Mix all ingredients together and simmer on low heat about 50 minutes until flavors are well blended.

title: Herbed and Herb Noodles (Cookies)
ingredients: 12 ounces egg noodles | herbs, such as dill ( i use basil, but whatever you like to season your food with )
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Drain them well, and toss them with herbs.

title: Pasta With Lentils and Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup farfalle pasta | 2 cups milk | 1/3 cup soymilk | 1/3 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice or 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1 medium turnip, peeled, quartered, cored & chopped into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 large chile, seeded and chopped | 1/3 cup uncooked rigatoni pasta or 1/3 cup other long-grain pasta
instructions: Cook pasta, according to package directions. Drain of excess water, and set aside. Combine milk, soymilk, stock and tumeric in a nonstick saucepan, over low heat. When hot, whisk continuously until mixture bubbles, remove from heat. Add turnip pieces and chile, heat through but do not boil. Place pasta in large serving bowl. Spoon hot lentils over pasta, and toss well. Serve immediately.

title: Puerco Loco (Mexican Pork)
ingredients: 3 gallons pork, fat trimmed of any excess fat | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Trim fat from pork and tie with kitchen twine. Pour hot, hot water into large pot just so the fat can float. Put in salt, and bring to a boil. Cook for about 1 hour. Turn out onto cutting board and cut into 1 pieces depending on size. When all are cut into pieces use a slotted spoon so the fat can drain away.

title: Veal Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, trimmed | 3/4 lb jicama, peeled and cut into thin long pieces | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame oil | 1 lb veal, trimmed | 1/2 cup unblanched roasted cashews, roughly chopped
instructions: Slice the flank steak across the grain into thin strips. You should obtain 8 slices. The long strips look like spaghetti sheets. Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add the flank steak strips in a single layer, stirring constantly with a fork until cooked throughout, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, slice and dice the jicama. Add the jicama and veal to the pan and stir for 2 minutes or so, until the meat is cooked through, but still is slightly crisp. Stir in the cashews and toss to combine. Remove the meat from the pan and put it in a warm serving dish. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,jalapeno pepper,spring onion,fine breadcrumb,spanish onion,broccoli,vodka,raisin
title: Sensational Broccoli Balls (Gung Powe)
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli | 2 medium spanish onions | 1 jalapeno pepper, stem ( seeds removed and finely minced ) | 1 sprig fresh ginger paste | 8 ounces fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon raisins or 1 tablespoon dark raisin | 1 fluid ounce vodka ( optional ) | fine dry breadcrumb
instructions: Clean the Broccoli well to remove the hard leaves and remove the stalks. In a large pot of boiling water drop the broccoli with its stem and the onion and cook until it is just soft, about 3 minutes. Drain the water and mix with the broccoli and stir in the jalapeño, ginger and bread crumbs mix lightly. Cover and steam to desired texture and color. Taste and add additional salt and pepper if necessary. When done, spoon the mixture onto a small sheet of plastic wrap and roll it onto your work surface. Roll into a sausage shape, cutting off excess. When the balls are cold, roll in fine dry bread crumbs. Store in a paper bag with a seal underneath to avoid drying out.

title: Watermelon & Gruyere Gratin
ingredients: 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1 cup watermelon, cubed | 1 medium shallot, chopped | 300 g gruyere cheese, grated | 3/4 cup fresh mint sauce | 1 spring onion, finely sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c combine sugar and watermelon in a medium saucepan, cover and bring to the boil, simmer over moderate heat for 5 minutes. Place cheese, mint and spring onion in a mixing bowl and mash with a fork until mixture forms a firm paste. Remove pan from heat and stir through sugar cream and cool until mixture is required. Drain watermelon and reserve liquid. Stir through cheese mixture until incorporated. Spoon into greased shallow baking dish and bake for 30 - 35 mins or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Easy Toasted Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons breadcrumbs | 1 cup pita bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix bread crumbs and pita bread together, then set aside for 15 minutes. Press the crumb mixture onto the tops of the pita bread sticks. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Beef and Broccoli With Jamon Sausages
ingredients: 12 slices prosciutto | 12 slices roast beef | 12 sausages, sliced thin | 1 1/2 lbs fresh broccoli, chopped | 1/4 cup golden syrup ( i use honey ) | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: In saucepan, fry sliced sausages until heated through. Add peppers, golden syrup and garlic powder and simmer for 10 minutes. Add hot broccoli. Simmer for 2 minutes.

title: Kellie Weldon's English Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Mix together all and form each sausage into a 4 inch sausage link. Place sausage links on a foil lined baking pan. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and slice through the center with a knife to remove the meat and the sausage. Place back into oven and bake for 10 minutes longer. Serve warm.

title: Oregano, Red Capsicum and Orange Salad
ingredients: 2 red capsicums, roasted for 20 mins & sliced thinly | 1 red fresh mint sprig, plus extra | mint sprig, to serve | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice ( about a good handful ) | 100 g half-and-half
instructions: Place the capsicums on a baking tray & roast in the oven, uncovered, for 30 mins at 200c/400f or until slightly charred & softened. Using a skewer, poke a few holes in the skin to allow steam to escape. Remove from the oven & leave for 5 mins to cool. Strip the skin off of the capsicums & reserve. Place the roasted capsicum peppers, mint & orange juice in a food processor & purée until smooth. Fold through half and half, to taste, then spoon over the dressing.

title: Mirepoix and Asparagus
ingredients: 1 package mirepoix ( or more ) | 1 head savoy cabbage ( or another cabbage ) | 1 lb fresh asparagus ( or another wood woody veggies such as spinach, carrots or other veggies ) | 3/4 cup soymilk | 1 bunch fresh basil leaf ( optional ) | ice water, for boiling
instructions: Rinse the cabbage leaves and trim off the tips, then cut the stalks into 2 inch thick pieces. Peel and trim asparagus. Cut in pieces about the width of the asparagus spears, dropping them into cold water as you go. If using savoy cabbage, trim the leaves before cutting. If using napa cabbage, trim the cabbage leaves ahead of time and store in a zipper bag. If using napa cabbage, cut the leaf from the tips in half and remove the core, if using napa cabbage or other vegetables. Combine mascarpone with 1/4 cup of soymilk. Set aside and refrigerate. Place a steamer basket inside a shallow pan and add enough ice to cover the bottom. Put asparagus spears and cabbage in the steamer basket and cover. Let simmer for 10 minutes, then check after 10 minutes to make sure liquid level is not low. Continue to steam until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes. Add more water as needed to keep vegetables covered with liquid. Serve hot with soymilk, basil leaves, or mint.

title: Aloupe (Diet Friendly)
ingredients: 2 stalks green beans, cut in 1 inch pieces | 1 lb cantaloupe, peeled and cut in 1 inch cubes | 4 green beans, chopped | 1 granny smith apple, peeled & diced | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 can chopped green tomatoes with basil and olive oil ( regular oil makes this dish vegetarian )
instructions: Place all vegetables in a bowl that will fit snugly into your blender. Add all of the other ingredients and mix till combined well. Spoon into a 2 quart container. Cover securely and freeze. To serve, remove the plastic wrap and place the fruit on top of the meat and vegetables. Serve with rice, if desired.

Random Ingredients: linguine,grand marnier,green grape,vanilla extract,tomato puree,garlic salt
title: Linguine with Tomato Canned Tomatoes and Grape
ingredients: 16 ounces linguine | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 2 tablespoons pure vanilla extract | 1 can of diced tomatoes in tomato puree | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 1/4 cups green seedless grapes
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water cook linguine for 7 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, heat garlic salt until fragrant. Add vanilla extract. Add tomatoes and juice and heat gently, stirring. Add grand marnier and cook, stirring to melt. Reduce heat to low and slowly add fresh chopped green grapes. Serve with hot cooked pasta.

title: Linguica Salatasi - Asparagi W- Red Wine - Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus spear | 1 small red bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 3 saffron strands, slightly crushed ( about 2-3 pinches per serving ) | 1 cup red wine | 1/3 cup saffron strand, cut into strands
instructions: Cover the tips of the asparagus ends with cold water.

title: Barley and Onion (Barley-Onion Mix)
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed and drained | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons mirin ( sweet japanese sweet wine ), warmed
instructions: Place the barley in a large heatproof bowl large enough to accommodate your rice cooker. If you are using quick cooking, place the bowl on top of the water, cover and place on the counter or in your rice cooker.

title: Carrots- Parsnips in Caramelised Sugar
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips, washed, peeled and grated into a fine shreds ( about 3 cups ) | 2 extra large carrots, washed, peeled and grated into a fine shreds ( about 4 cups ) | 1 kg ladyfinger | 1 liter sugar cube, powdered | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat a few tablespoons of oil in a thick baseed saucepan. Toss the grated carrots and sugar cube in the oil and add to the skillet. Cook on high heat just until the sugar melts and turns golden brown. Lower heat and simmer for several minutes. Place the cooked carrots and grated parsnips in food processor or coffee grinder and grind to very finely chopped. Transfer to a large serving bowl. Pour on the caramelised sugar and serve warm, with more caramelised sugar spooned over the top.

title: The Singles and the Garlickyest Linguini
ingredients: 5 1/2 ounces linguine or 5 1/2 ounces spaghetti | 1 jalapeno, seed & stem, finely chopped, no seeds | 1 pinch sambal oelek
instructions: Cook the linguini following the directions on the package, but be careful not to overcook, or it may break. Drain and toss with one of the jalapenos. Serve with the rest of the jalapenos and a pinch of sambal oelek.

title: Kumquat's Fondue II

instructions: Place the potatoes into a pot and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then cook until almost tender, about 15 minutes. Remove to a separate pot or bowl. Cover with water.

title: Beer & Salsa

instructions: In a small bowl combine bread crumbs, cinnamon, pepper, lemon juice and chili. Dip the veggies into the cream. Shake off the excess bacon fat. Bring to room temperature before serving. Serve with crackers and other dippers.

title: Tortilla Salad

instructions: Remove each banana slice from the rind into a round serving dish. Combine the sliced bananas with the chopped jalapeno, prosciutto, habanero peppers, saffron strands and red chili powder. Marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

instructions: Place sun dried tomato in a bowl, sprinkle with sugar and set aside. Cook penne pasta according to package instructions. Place meatballs in a saucepan and stir in chili sauce. title: Crock Pot Risotto-Apple Stuffed Beef Risotto Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs stew beef chunks | 8 slices turkey bacon, diced | 12 ounces red enchilada sauce | 1 bunch marshmallows, chopped | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1 lb frozen small marshmallows | 7 ounces red enchilada sauce | 9 ounces graham cracker crumbs, crushed
instructions: Place beef, bacon, 2 1/2 oz of the enchilada sauce, marshmallows, marsala, and 1/2 cup of arborio in the crock pot. Cook on high about 4 hours or low all day. Add frozen marshmallows and remaining jar of enchilada sauce, stirring until melted. Spoon evenly into the casserole. title: Lethal Cheese with Bacon
ingredients: 5 slices bacon, chopped | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/4 cup shredded mexican cheese blend | 1/4 teaspoon cracked peppercorn | 2 teaspoons grated orange rind
instructions: Cook bacon in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until crisp. Drain. Add margarine and heat until melted, stirring frequently. Stir in cheese, peppercorns and rind and heat until cheese is melted.

title: Hazelnut Toast
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1/6 cup spanish onion, diced | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/9 cup dry white breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons canned beer | 4 slices good quality good quality white bread, sliced in a thin layer
instructions: Grind hazelnuts into a fine powder. In an extra large frypan, combine nuts, onion, anchovy paste, and bread crumbs. Heat, stirring frequently, until the bread slices are golden brown. Quickly add about 1/4 to 1/2 cup of the hot dry bread crumbs, stirring to coat all the bread slices. Sprinkle remaining crumbs around the toast and cook for another minute then flip over and repeat just until toast is heated through.

title: Garlic Stuffed Baked Pitas
ingredients: 1/4 cup miracle whip | 2 tablespoons miracle whip | 8 slices bacon | 1/2 cup minced celery rib | 1/4 cup minced mint leaf
instructions: In a small bowl combine your miracle whip and miracle whip and mix well. Heat a nonstick skillet with 2 tablespoons of the miracle whip mixture in it until hot. Add your bacon, celery and mint into it and cook until it becomes translucent. Take it out of the pan and stuff the center with the bacon and garlic mixture, leaving 2/3 of it on the top. Slightly spread the other 1/3 of the Miracle Whip mixture on the inside of the bun. Microwave it on high for 3 minutes to soften it, then spread it lightly on the top. Cut the bun in half, and then in half again.

title: Tortilla & Chickpea Salad

instructions: Tortillas, preheat a grill pan to medium. Tear tortillas into thin strips and arrange them on the grid, overlapping slightly. Bouillon and salad, remove the cores from the chickpeas, then rinse them and place them in a mixing bowl. Add the chopped mint and mincemeat, mix well then add the mashed potato, eggs, aubergine powder, hot water and vanilla extract, mixing well. Divide mixture among serving plates, top with shredded cheese and serve.

title: Pesto Swiss Rolled-up Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 slices lean pork tenderloin | 2/3 cup nonfat milk | 1 egg ( substitute, skim milk, or non dairy milk ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( i use paul newman's pesto'pesto for this, but any commercial pesto works ) | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | 3 tablespoons orange blossom water
instructions: Mix pesto with grated cheese and orange blossom water. Spread evenly onto the pork tenderloins. Place pork in crockpot. Combine remaining ingredients and pour mixture over pork. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or on high for 4 - 5 hours, until internal temperature reaches 155 f. Serve with bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,black olive,egg white,red potato,ice,salt black pepper
title: Mashed Potato Balls II
ingredients: 2 pounds red potatoes, cubed | 3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | salt and ground black pepper, or to taste | 2/3 cup rice vinegar | 2 egg whites, beaten
instructions: Place potatoes into a saucepan with enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside. When the potatoes are cool enough to handle, dice into 1/2 inch cubes. Beat eggs in a large bowl. Add potatoes, olives, salt, and pepper. Mix the egg whites in a separate bowl. Add the egg mixture to the potato mixture, stirring until well blended and smooth. Turn the mixture into a large, resealable plastic bag, and seal. Refrigerate 4 hours to overnight. Remove potato mixture from the bowl, and shape into balls. Serve with ketchup or tomato sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,basmati rice,flour tortilla,spanish onion,rib eye steak,asafoetida powder,rotini pasta
title: Beef and Rotini Tostadas #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb rib eye steak | 1 cup sliced spanish onion | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 cup rotini pasta | 1/2 cup low-fat rye bread | 1/2 teaspoon flour tortilla | 1 cup low-fat rotini pasta, refrigerated | 1 cup cooked asafoetida powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. Cut steak into thin strips, then quarter across the grain. In a baking dish place meat, sliced onion, and 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida. Bake for 15 minutes, stirring once or twice. Pour 1/2 cup rotini pasta into a large bowl. Remove meat meat from baking dish. Place cooked asafoetida in a sauce pan and cook for 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Add flour and cook for three minutes, stirring constantly. Drain pasta and place into pan with meat mixture. Mix until well mixed. Place on a cookie sheet and toast in oven for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and spread rotini on a plate. Serve meat and sauce mixture over the rotini.
